kjv_text: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.
bsb_text: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
aov_text: IN die begin het God die hemel en die aarde geskape.

kjv_text: And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.
bsb_text: Now the earth was formless and void, and darkness was over the surface of the deep. And the Spirit of God was hovering over the surface of the waters.
aov_text: En die aarde was woes en leeg, en duisternis was op die wêreldvloed, en die Gees van God het gesweef op die waters.

kjv_text: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.
bsb_text: And God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.
aov_text: En God het gesê: Laat daar lig wees! En daar was lig.

kjv_text: And God saw the light, that it was good: and God divided the light from the darkness.
bsb_text: And God saw that the light was good, and He separated the light from the darkness.
aov_text: Toe sien God dat die lig goed was. En God het skeiding gemaak tussen die lig en die duisternis;

kjv_text: And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night. And the evening and the morning were the first day.
bsb_text: God called the light “day,” and the darkness He called “night.” And there was evening, and there was morning—the first day.
aov_text: en God het die lig dag genoem, en die duisternis het Hy nag genoem. En dit was aand en dit was môre, die eerste dag.

kjv_text: And God said, Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.
bsb_text: And God said, “Let there be an expanse between the waters, to separate the waters from the waters.”
aov_text: En God het gesê: Laat daar ’n uitspansel wees tussen die waters, en laat dit skeiding maak tussen waters en waters.

kjv_text: And God made the firmament, and divided the waters which were under the firmament from the waters which were above the firmament: and it was so.
bsb_text: So God made the expanse and separated the waters beneath it from the waters above. And it was so.
aov_text: God het toe die uitspansel gemaak en die waters wat onder die uitspansel is, geskei van die waters wat bo die uitspansel is. En dit was so.

kjv_text: And God called the firmament Heaven. And the evening and the morning were the second day.
bsb_text: God called the expanse “sky.” And there was evening, and there was morning—the second day.
aov_text: En God het die uitspansel hemel genoem. En dit was aand en dit was môre, die tweede dag.

kjv_text: And God said, Let the waters under the heaven be gathered together unto one place, and let the dry land appear: and it was so.
bsb_text: And God said, “Let the waters under the sky be gathered into one place, so that the dry land may appear.” And it was so.
aov_text: En God het gesê: Laat die waters onder die hemel hulle op een plek versamel, sodat die droë grond sigbaar word. En dit was so.

kjv_text: And God called the dry land Earth; and the gathering together of the waters called he Seas: and God saw that it was good.
bsb_text: God called the dry land “earth,” and the gathering of waters He called “seas.” And God saw that it was good.
aov_text: En God het die droë grond aarde genoem, en die versameling van die waters het Hy see genoem. Toe sien God dat dit goed was.

kjv_text: And God said, Let the earth bring forth grass, the herb yielding seed, and the fruit tree yielding fruit after his kind, whose seed is in itself, upon the earth: and it was so.
bsb_text: Then God said, “Let the earth bring forth vegetation: seed-bearing plants and fruit trees, each bearing fruit with seed according to its kind.” And it was so.
aov_text: En God het gesê: Laat die aarde voortbring grasspruitjies, plante wat saad gee en bome wat, volgens hulle soorte, vrugte dra, waarin hulle saad is, op die aarde. En dit was so.

kjv_text: And the earth brought forth grass, and herb yielding seed after his kind, and the tree yielding fruit, whose seed was in itself, after his kind: and God saw that it was good.
bsb_text: The earth produced vegetation: seed-bearing plants according to their kinds and trees bearing fruit with seed according to their kinds. And God saw that it was good.
aov_text: Die aarde het voortgebring grasspruitjies, plante wat saad gee volgens hulle soorte en bome wat vrugte dra, waarin hulle saad is, volgens hulle soorte. Toe sien God dat dit goed was.

kjv_text: And the evening and the morning were the third day.
bsb_text: And there was evening, and there was morning—the third day.
aov_text: En dit was aand en dit was môre, die derde dag.

kjv_text: And God said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:
bsb_text: And God said, “Let there be lights in the expanse of the sky to distinguish between the day and the night, and let them be signs to mark the seasons and days and years.
aov_text: En God het gesê: Laat daar ligte wees aan die uitspansel van die hemel, om skeiding te maak tussen die dag en die nag; en laat hulle dien as tekens sowel vir vaste tye, asook vir dae sowel as jare.

kjv_text: And let them be for lights in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth: and it was so.
bsb_text: And let them serve as lights in the expanse of the sky to shine upon the earth.” And it was so.
aov_text: Laat hulle ook dien as ligte aan die uitspansel van die hemel om lig te gee op die aarde. En dit was so.

kjv_text: And God made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: he made the stars also.
bsb_text: God made two great lights: the greater light to rule the day and the lesser light to rule the night. And He made the stars as well.
aov_text: God het toe die twee groot ligte gemaak: die groot lig om te heers oor die dag en die klein lig om te heers oor die nag; ook die sterre.

kjv_text: And God set them in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth,
bsb_text: God set these lights in the expanse of the sky to shine upon the earth,
aov_text: En God het hulle aan die uitspansel van die hemel gestel om lig te gee op die aarde

kjv_text: And to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness: and God saw that it was good.
bsb_text: to preside over the day and the night, and to separate the light from the darkness. And God saw that it was good.
aov_text: en om teheers oor die dag en oor die nag en om skeiding te maak tussen die lig en die duisternis. Toe sien God dat dit goed was.

kjv_text: And the evening and the morning were the fourth day.
bsb_text: And there was evening, and there was morning—the fourth day.
aov_text: En dit was aand en dit was môre, die vierde dag.

kjv_text: And God said, Let the waters bring forth abundantly the moving creature that hath life, and fowl that may fly above the earth in the open firmament of heaven.
bsb_text: And God said, “Let the waters teem with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the sky.”
aov_text: En God het gesê: Laat die waters wemel met ’n gewemel van lewende wesens, en laat die voëls oor die aarde vlieg langs die uitspansel van die hemel.

kjv_text: And God created great whales, and every living creature that moveth, which the waters brought forth abundantly, after their kind, and every winged fowl after his kind: and God saw that it was good.
bsb_text: So God created the great sea creatures and every living thing that moves, with which the waters teemed according to their kinds, and every bird of flight after its kind. And God saw that it was good.
aov_text: En God het die groot seediere geskape en al die lewende wesens wat beweeg, waar die waters van wemel, volgens hulle soorte; en al die gevleuelde voëls volgens hulle soorte. Toe sien God dat dit goed was.

kjv_text: And God blessed them, saying, Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let fowl multiply in the earth.
bsb_text: Then God blessed them and said, “Be fruitful and multiply and fill the waters of the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.”
aov_text: En God het hulle geseën en gesê: Wees vrugbaar en vermeerder en vul die waters in die see, en laat die voëls op die aarde vermeerder.

kjv_text: And the evening and the morning were the fifth day.
bsb_text: And there was evening, and there was morning—the fifth day.
aov_text: En dit was aand en dit was môre, die vyfde dag.

kjv_text: And God said, Let the earth bring forth the living creature after his kind, cattle, and creeping thing, and beast of the earth after his kind: and it was so.
bsb_text: And God said, “Let the earth bring forth living creatures according to their kinds: livestock, land crawlers, and beasts of the earth according to their kinds.” And it was so.
aov_text: En God het gesê: Laat die aarde lewende wesens voortbring volgens hulle soorte: vee, kruipende diere en wilde diere van die aarde volgens hulle soorte. En dit was so.

kjv_text: And God made the beast of the earth after his kind, and cattle after their kind, and every thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind: and God saw that it was good.
bsb_text: God made the beasts of the earth according to their kinds, the livestock according to their kinds, and everything that crawls upon the earth according to its kind. And God saw that it was good.
aov_text: En God het die wilde diere van die aarde gemaak volgens hulle soorte en die vee volgens hulle soorte en al die diere wat op die grond kruip, volgens hulle soorte. Toe sien God dat dit goed was.

kjv_text: And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.
bsb_text: Then God said, “Let Us make man in Our image, after Our likeness, to rule over the fish of the sea and the birds of the air, over the livestock, and over all the earth itself and every creature that crawls upon it.”
aov_text: En God het gesê: Laat Ons mense maak na ons beeld, na ons gelykenis, en laat hulle heers oor die visse van die see en die voëls van die hemel en die vee en oor die hele aarde en oor al die diere wat op die aarde kruip.

kjv_text: So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.
bsb_text: So God created man in His own image; in the image of God He created him; male and female He created them.
aov_text: En God het die mens geskape na sy beeld; na die beeld van God het Hy hom geskape; man en vrou het Hy hulle geskape.

kjv_text: And God blessed them, and God said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth.
bsb_text: God blessed them and said to them, “Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the earth and subdue it; rule over the fish of the sea and the birds of the air and every creature that crawls upon the earth.”
aov_text: En God het hulle geseën, en God het vir hulle gesê: Wees vrugbaar en vermeerder en vul die aarde, onderwerp dit en heers oor die visse van die see en die voëls van die hemel en oor al die diere wat op die aarde kruip.

kjv_text: And God said, Behold, I have given you every herb bearing seed, which is upon the face of all the earth, and every tree, in the which is the fruit of a tree yielding seed; to you it shall be for meat.
bsb_text: Then God said, “Behold, I have given you every seed-bearing plant on the face of all the earth, and every tree whose fruit contains seed. They will be yours for food.
aov_text: Verder het God gesê: Ek gee nou aan julle al die plante wat saad gee, wat op die hele aarde is, en al die bome waar boomvrugte aan is, wat saad dra. Dit sal julle voedsel wees.

kjv_text: And to every beast of the earth, and to every fowl of the air, and to every thing that creepeth upon the earth, wherein there is life, I have given every green herb for meat: and it was so.
bsb_text: And to every beast of the earth and every bird of the air and every creature that crawls upon the earth—everything that has the breath of life in it—I have given every green plant for food.” And it was so.
aov_text: Maar aan al die diere van die aarde en al die voëls van die hemel en al die kruipende diere op die aarde, waarin ’n lewende siel is, gee Ek al die groen plante as voedsel. En dit was so.

kjv_text: And God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. And the evening and the morning were the sixth day.
bsb_text: And God looked upon all that He had made, and indeed, it was very good. And there was evening, and there was morning—the sixth day.
aov_text: Toe sien God alles wat Hy gemaak het, en—dit was baie goed. En dit was aand en dit was môre, die sesde dag.

kjv_text: Thus the heavens and the earth were finished, and all the host of them.
bsb_text: Thus the heavens and the earth were completed in all their vast array.
aov_text: SO is dan voltooi die hemel en die aarde met hulle ganse leërmag.

kjv_text: And on the seventh day God ended his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.
bsb_text: And by the seventh day God had finished the work He had been doing; so on that day He rested from all His work.
aov_text: En God het op die sewende dag sy werk voltooi wat Hy gemaak het, en op die sewende dag gerus van al sy werk wat Hy gemaak het.

kjv_text: And God blessed the seventh day, and sanctified it: because that in it he had rested from all his work which God created and made.
bsb_text: Then God blessed the seventh day and sanctified it, because on that day He rested from all the work of creation that He had accomplished.
aov_text: En God het die sewende dag geseën en dit geheilig, omdat Hy daarop gerus het van al sy werk wat God geskape het deur dit te maak.

kjv_text: These are the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created,
bsb_text: This is the account of the heavens and the earth when they were created,
aov_text: DIT is die geskiedenis van die hemel en die aarde toe hulle geskape is.

kjv_text: in the day that the LORD God made the earth and the heavens,
bsb_text: in the day that the LORD God made them.
aov_text: Die dag toe die HERE God die aarde en die hemel gemaak het,

kjv_text: And every plant of the field before it was in the earth, and every herb of the field before it grew: for the LORD God had not caused it to rain upon the earth, and there was not a man to till the ground.
bsb_text: Now no shrub of the field had yet appeared on the earth, nor had any plant of the field sprouted; for the LORD God had not yet sent rain upon the earth, and there was no man to cultivate the ground.
aov_text: was daar nog geen struike in die veld op die aarde nie, en geen plante van die veld het nog uitgespruit nie; want die HERE God het nog nie laat reën op die aarde nie, en daar was geen mens om die grond te bewerk nie.

kjv_text: But there went up a mist from the earth, and watered the whole face of the ground.
bsb_text: But springs welled up from the earth and watered the whole surface of the ground.
aov_text: Maar ’n mis het opgetrek uit die aarde en die hele aardbodem bevogtig.

kjv_text: And the LORD God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.
bsb_text: Then the LORD God formed man from the dust of the ground and breathed the breath of life into his nostrils, and the man became a living being.
aov_text: En die HERE God het die mens geformeer uit die stof van die aarde en in sy neus die asem van die lewe geblaas. So het dan die mens ’n lewende siel geword.

kjv_text: And the LORD God planted a garden eastward in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed.
bsb_text: And the LORD God planted a garden in Eden, in the east, where He placed the man He had formed.
aov_text: Ook het die HERE God ’n tuin geplant in Eden, in die Ooste, en daar aan die mens wat Hy geformeer het, ’n plek gegee.

kjv_text: And out of the ground made the LORD God to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of knowledge of good and evil.
bsb_text: Out of the ground the LORD God gave growth to every tree that is pleasing to the eye and good for food. And in the middle of the garden were the tree of life and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.
aov_text: En die HERE God het allerhande bome uit die grond laat uitspruit, begeerlik om te sien en goed om van te eet; ook die boom van die lewe in die middel van die tuin, en die boom van die kennis van goed en kwaad.

kjv_text: And a river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from thence it was parted, and became into four heads.
bsb_text: Now a river flowed out of Eden to water the garden, and from there it branched into four headwaters:
aov_text: En daar het ’n rivier uit Eden uitgegaan om die tuin nat te maak; en daarvandaan is dit verdeel en het vier lope geword.

kjv_text: The name of the first is Pison: that is it which compasseth the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;
bsb_text: The name of the first river is Pishon; it winds through the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold.
aov_text: Die naam van die eerste is die Pison. Dit is hy wat om die hele land Háwila loop waar die goud is.

kjv_text: And the gold of that land is good: there is bdellium and the onyx stone.
bsb_text: And the gold of that land is pure, and bdellium and onyx are found there.
aov_text: En die goud van dié land is goed. Daar is ook balsemgom en onikssteen.

kjv_text: And the name of the second river is Gihon: the same is it that compasseth the whole land of Ethiopia.
bsb_text: The name of the second river is Gihon; it winds through the whole land of Cush.
aov_text: En die naam van die tweede rivier is die Gihon. Dit is hy wat om die hele land Kus loop.

kjv_text: And the name of the third river is Hiddekel: that is it which goeth toward the east of Assyria. And the fourth river is Euphrates.
bsb_text: The name of the third river is Hiddekel; it runs along the east side of Assyria. And the fourth river is the Euphrates.
aov_text: En die naam van die derde rivier is die Hiddékel. Dit is hy wat oos van Assur loop. En die vierde rivier is die Frat.

kjv_text: And the LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it.
bsb_text: Then the LORD God took the man and placed him in the Garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it.
aov_text: Toe het die HERE God die mens geneem en hom in die tuin van Eden gestel om dit te bewerk en te bewaak.

kjv_text: And the LORD God commanded the man, saying, Of every tree of the garden thou mayest freely eat:
bsb_text: And the LORD God commanded him, “You may eat freely from every tree of the garden,
aov_text: En die HERE God het aan die mens bevel gegee en gesê: Van al die bome van die tuin mag jy vry eet,

kjv_text: But of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, thou shalt not eat of it: for in the day that thou eatest thereof thou shalt surely die.
bsb_text: but you must not eat from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil; for in the day that you eat of it, you will surely die.”
aov_text: maar van die boom van die kennis van goed en kwaad, daarvan mag jy nie eet nie; want die dag as jy daarvan eet, sal jy sekerlik sterwe.

kjv_text: And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him.
bsb_text: The LORD God also said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make for him a suitable helper.”
aov_text: Ook het die HERE God gesê: Dit is nie goed dat die mens alleen is nie. Ek sal vir hom ’n hulp maak wat by hom pas.

kjv_text: And out of the ground the LORD God formed every beast of the field, and every fowl of the air; and brought them unto Adam to see what he would call them: and whatsoever Adam called every living creature, that was the name thereof.
bsb_text: And out of the ground the LORD God formed every beast of the field and every bird of the air, and He brought them to the man to see what he would name each one. And whatever the man called each living creature, that was its name.
aov_text: En die HERE God het uit die aarde geformeer al die diere van die veld en al die voëls van die hemel en hulle na die mens gebring om te sien hoe hy hulle sou noem. En net soos die mens al die lewende wesens genoem het, so moes hulle naam wees.

kjv_text: And Adam gave names to all cattle, and to the fowl of the air, and to every beast of the field; but for Adam there was not found an help meet for him.
bsb_text: The man gave names to all the livestock, to the birds of the air, and to every beast of the field. But for Adam no suitable helper was found.
aov_text: So het die mens dan name gegee aan al die vee en aan die voëls van die hemel en aan al die wilde diere van die veld, maar vir die mens het hy geen hulp gevind wat by hom pas nie.

kjv_text: And the LORD God caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam, and he slept: and he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh instead thereof;
bsb_text: So the LORD God caused the man to fall into a deep sleep, and while he slept, He took one of the man’s ribs and closed up the area with flesh.
aov_text: Toe het die HERE God ’n diepe slaap op die mens laat val; en terwyl hy slaap, het Hy een van sy ribbebene geneem en die plek daarvan met vlees toegemaak.

kjv_text: And the rib, which the LORD God had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man.
bsb_text: And from the rib that the LORD God had taken from the man, He made a woman and brought her to him.
aov_text: En die HERE God bou die rib wat Hy van die mens geneem het, tot ’n vrou en bring haar na die mens.

kjv_text: And Adam said, This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man.
bsb_text: And the man said: “This is now bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh; she shall be called ‘woman,’ for out of man she was taken.”
aov_text: Toe sê die mens: Dit is nou eindelik been van my gebeente en vlees van my vlees. Sy sal mannin genoem word, want sy is uit die man geneem.

kjv_text: Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh.
bsb_text: For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and they will become one flesh.
aov_text: Daarom sal die man sy vader en moeder verlaat en sy vrou aankleef. En hulle sal een vlees wees.

kjv_text: And they were both naked, the man and his wife, and were not ashamed.
bsb_text: And the man and his wife were both naked, and they were not ashamed.
aov_text: En hulle was altwee naak, die mens en sy vrou, maar hulle het hul nie geskaam nie.

kjv_text: Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field which the LORD God had made. And he said unto the woman, Yea, hath God said, Ye shall not eat of every tree of the garden?
bsb_text: Now the serpent was more crafty than any beast of the field that the LORD God had made. And he said to the woman, “Did God really say, ‘You must not eat from any tree in the garden?’”
aov_text: MAAR die slang was listiger as al die diere van die veld wat die HERE God gemaak het. En hy sê vir die vrou: Is dit ook so dat God gesê het: Julle mag nie eet van al die bome van die tuin nie?

kjv_text: And the woman said unto the serpent, We may eat of the fruit of the trees of the garden:
bsb_text: The woman answered the serpent, “We may eat the fruit of the trees of the garden,
aov_text: En die vrou antwoord die slang: Van die vrugte van die bome in die tuin mag ons eet,

kjv_text: But of the fruit of the tree which is in the midst of the garden, God hath said, Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die.
bsb_text: but about the fruit of the tree in the middle of the garden, God has said, ‘You must not eat of it or touch it, or you will die.’”
aov_text: maar van die vrugte van die boom wat in die middel van die tuin is, het God gesê: Julle mag daarvan nie eet nie en dit nie aanroer nie, anders sal julle sterwe.

kjv_text: And the serpent said unto the woman, Ye shall not surely die:
bsb_text: “You will not surely die,” the serpent told her.
aov_text: Toe sê die slang vir die vrou: Julle sal gewis nie sterwe nie;

kjv_text: For God doth know that in the day ye eat thereof, then your eyes shall be opened, and ye shall be as gods, knowing good and evil.
bsb_text: “For God knows that in the day you eat of it, your eyes will be opened and you will be like God, knowing good and evil.”
aov_text: maar God weet dat as julle daarvan eet, julle oë sal oopgaan, sodat julle soos God sal wees deur goed en kwaad te ken.

kjv_text: And when the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was pleasant to the eyes, and a tree to be desired to make one wise, she took of the fruit thereof, and did eat, and gave also unto her husband with her; and he did eat.
bsb_text: When the woman saw that the tree was good for food and pleasing to the eyes, and that it was desirable for obtaining wisdom, she took the fruit and ate it. She also gave some to her husband who was with her, and he ate it.
aov_text: Toe sien die vrou dat die boom goed was om van te eet en dat hy ’n lus was vir die oë, ja, ’n boom wat ’n mens kan begeer om verstand te verkry; en sy neem van sy vrugte en eet en gee ook aan haar man by haar, en hy het geëet.

kjv_text: And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig leaves together, and made themselves aprons.
bsb_text: And the eyes of both of them were opened, and they knew that they were naked; so they sewed together fig leaves and made coverings for themselves.
aov_text: Toe gaan altwee se oë oop, en hulle word gewaar dat hulle naak is; en hulle het vyeblare aanmekaargewerk en vir hulle skorte gemaak.

kjv_text: And they heard the voice of the LORD God walking in the garden in the cool of the day: and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God amongst the trees of the garden.
bsb_text: Then the man and his wife heard the voice of the LORD God walking in the garden in the breeze of the day, and they hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God among the trees of the garden.
aov_text: En hulle het die stem van die HERE God gehoor terwyl Hy wandel in die tuin in die aandwindjie; en die mens en sy vrou het hulle verberg vir die aangesig van die HERE God tussen die bome van die tuin.

kjv_text: And the LORD God called unto Adam, and said unto him, Where art thou?
bsb_text: But the LORD God called out to the man, “Where are you?”
aov_text: Toe roep die HERE God na die mens en sê vir hom: Waar is jy?

kjv_text: And he said, I heard thy voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; and I hid myself.
bsb_text: “I heard Your voice in the garden,” he replied, “and I was afraid because I was naked; so I hid myself.”
aov_text: En hy antwoord: Ek het u geruis gehoor in die tuin en gevrees, want ek is naak; daarom het ek my verberg.

kjv_text: And he said, Who told thee that thou wast naked? Hast thou eaten of the tree, whereof I commanded thee that thou shouldest not eat?
bsb_text: “Who told you that you were naked?” asked the LORD God. “Have you eaten from the tree of which I commanded you not to eat?”
aov_text: En Hy sê: Wie het jou te kenne gegee dat jy naak is? Het jy geëet van die boom waarvan Ek jou beveel het om nie te eet nie?

kjv_text: And the man said, The woman whom thou gavest to be with me, she gave me of the tree, and I did eat.
bsb_text: And the man answered, “The woman whom You gave me, she gave me fruit from the tree, and I ate it.”
aov_text: En die mens antwoord: Die vrou wat U gegee het om by my te wees, sy het my van die boom gegee, en ek het geëet.

kjv_text: And the LORD God said unto the woman, What is this that thou hast done? And the woman said, The serpent beguiled me, and I did eat.
bsb_text: Then the LORD God said to the woman, “What is this you have done?” “The serpent deceived me,” she replied, “and I ate.”
aov_text: Daarop sê die HERE God aan die vrou: Wat het jy nou gedoen? En die vrou antwoord: Die slang het my bedrieg, en ek het geëet.

kjv_text: And the LORD God said unto the serpent, Because thou hast done this, thou art cursed above all cattle, and above every beast of the field; upon thy belly shalt thou go, and dust shalt thou eat all the days of thy life:
bsb_text: So the LORD God said to the serpent: “Because you have done this, cursed are you above all livestock and every beast of the field! On your belly will you go, and dust you will eat, all the days of your life.
aov_text: Toe sê die HERE God aan die slang: Omdat jy dit gedoen het, is jy vervloek onder al die vee en al die diere van die veld. Op jou buik moet jy seil, en stof moet jy eet al die dae van jou lewe.

kjv_text: And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.
bsb_text: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed. He will crush your head, and you will strike his heel.”
aov_text: En Ek sal vyandskap stel tussen jou en die vrou, en tussen jou saad en haar saad. Hý sal jou die kop vermorsel, en jý sal hom in die hakskeen byt.

kjv_text: Unto the woman he said, I will greatly multiply thy sorrow and thy conception; in sorrow thou shalt bring forth children; and thy desire shall be to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee.
bsb_text: To the woman He said: “I will sharply increase your pain in childbirth; in pain you will bring forth children. Your desire will be for your husband, and he will rule over you.”
aov_text: Aan die vrou het Hy gesê: Ek sal grootliks vermeerder jou moeite en jou swangerskap; met smart sal jy kinders baar; en na jou man sal jou begeerte wees, en hý sal oor jou heers.

kjv_text: And unto Adam he said, Because thou hast hearkened unto the voice of thy wife, and hast eaten of the tree, of which I commanded thee, saying, Thou shalt not eat of it: cursed is the ground for thy sake; in sorrow shalt thou eat of it all the days of thy life;
bsb_text: And to Adam He said: “Because you have listened to the voice of your wife and have eaten from the tree of which I commanded you not to eat, cursed is the ground because of you; through toil you will eat of it all the days of your life.
aov_text: En aan die mens het Hy gesê: Omdat jy geluister het na die stem van jou vrou en van die boom geëet het waarvan Ek jou beveel het om nie te eet nie—vervloek is die aarde om jou ontwil; met moeite sal jy daarvan eet al die dae van jou lewe.

kjv_text: Thorns also and thistles shall it bring forth to thee; and thou shalt eat the herb of the field;
bsb_text: Both thorns and thistles it will yield for you, and you will eat the plants of the field.
aov_text: Ook sal dit vir jou dorings en distels voortbring; en jy sal die plante van die veld eet.

kjv_text: In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return unto the ground; for out of it wast thou taken: for dust thou art, and unto dust shalt thou return.
bsb_text: By the sweat of your brow you will eat your bread, until you return to the ground—because out of it were you taken. For dust you are, and to dust you shall return.”
aov_text: In die sweet van jou aangesig sal jy brood eet totdat jy terugkeer na die aarde, want daaruit is jy geneem. Want stof is jy, en tot stof sal jy terugkeer.

kjv_text: And Adam called his wife's name Eve; because she was the mother of all living.
bsb_text: And Adam named his wife Eve, because she would be the mother of all the living.
aov_text: En die mens het sy vrou Eva genoem, omdat sy moeder geword het van alles wat lewe.

kjv_text: Unto Adam also and to his wife did the LORD God make coats of skins, and clothed them.
bsb_text: And the LORD God made garments of skin for Adam and his wife, and He clothed them.
aov_text: En die HERE God het vir die mens en sy vrou rokke van vel gemaak en hulle dit aangetrek.

kjv_text: And the LORD God said, Behold, the man is become as one of us, to know good and evil: and now, lest he put forth his hand, and take also of the tree of life, and eat, and live for ever:
bsb_text: Then the LORD God said, “Behold, the man has become like one of Us, knowing good and evil. And now, lest he reach out his hand and take also from the tree of life, and eat, and live forever...”
aov_text: Toe sê die HERE God: Nou het die mens geword soos een van Ons deur goed en kwaad te ken. As hy nou maar nie sy hand uitsteek en ook van die boom van die lewe neem en eet en lewe in ewigheid nie!

kjv_text: Therefore the LORD God sent him forth from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from whence he was taken.
bsb_text: Therefore the LORD God banished him from the Garden of Eden to work the ground from which he had been taken.
aov_text: Toe stuur die HERE God hom weg uit die tuin van Eden om die grond te bewerk waaruit hy geneem is.

kjv_text: So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.
bsb_text: So He drove out the man and stationed cherubim on the east side of the Garden of Eden, along with a whirling sword of flame to guard the way to the tree of life.
aov_text: So het Hy dan die mens weggedrywe en gérubs aan die oostekant van die tuin van Eden laat woon, met die swaard wat vlam en flikker, om die toegang tot die boom van die lewe te bewaak.

kjv_text: And Adam knew Eve his wife; and she conceived, and bare Cain, and said, I have gotten a man from the LORD.
bsb_text: And Adam had relations with his wife Eve, and she conceived and gave birth to Cain. “With the help of the LORD I have brought forth a man,” she said.
aov_text: EN die mens het sy vrou Eva beken, en sy het swanger geword en Kain gebaar en gesê: Ek het ’n man verkry met die hulp van die HERE.

kjv_text: And she again bare his brother Abel. And Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.
bsb_text: Later she gave birth to Cain’s brother Abel. Now Abel was a keeper of sheep, while Cain was a tiller of the soil.
aov_text: Daarna het sy ook sy broer Abel gebaar. En Abel het ’n skaapherder geword, en Kain ’n landbouer.

kjv_text: And in process of time it came to pass, that Cain brought of the fruit of the ground an offering unto the LORD.
bsb_text: So in the course of time, Cain brought some of the fruit of the soil as an offering to the LORD,
aov_text: En ná verloop van tyd het Kain van die vrugte van die land aan die HERE ’n offer gebring.

kjv_text: And Abel, he also brought of the firstlings of his flock and of the fat thereof. And the LORD had respect unto Abel and to his offering:
bsb_text: while Abel brought the best portions of the firstborn of his flock. And the LORD looked with favor on Abel and his offering,
aov_text: En Abel het ook van die eersgeborenes van sy kleinvee gebring, naamlik van hulle vet. En die HERE het Abel en sy offer genadig aangesien,

kjv_text: But unto Cain and to his offering he had not respect. And Cain was very wroth, and his countenance fell.
bsb_text: but He had no regard for Cain and his offering. So Cain became very angry, and his countenance fell.
aov_text: maar Kain en sy offer nie aangesien nie. Toe word Kain baie kwaad, en hy het sy hoof laat hang.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Cain, Why art thou wroth? and why is thy countenance fallen?
bsb_text: “Why are you angry,” said the LORD to Cain, “and why has your countenance fallen?
aov_text: En die HERE sê vir Kain: Waarom is jy kwaad, en waarom laat jy jou hoof hang?

kjv_text: If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door. And unto thee shall be his desire, and thou shalt rule over him.
bsb_text: If you do what is right, will you not be accepted? But if you refuse to do what is right, sin is crouching at your door; it desires you, but you must master it.”
aov_text: Is daar nie verheffing as jy goed doen nie? En as jy nie goed doen nie—die sonde lê en loer voor die deur, en sy begeerte is na jou; maar jý moet daaroor heers.

kjv_text: And Cain talked with Abel his brother: and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him.
bsb_text: Then Cain said to his brother Abel, “Let us go out to the field.” And while they were in the field, Cain rose up against his brother Abel and killed him.
aov_text: En Kain het met sy broer Abel gepraat; en toe hulle in die veld was, het Kain teen sy broer Abel opgestaan en hom doodgeslaan.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Cain, Where is Abel thy brother? And he said, I know not: Am I my brother's keeper?
bsb_text: And the LORD said to Cain, “Where is your brother Abel?” “I do not know!” he answered. “Am I my brother’s keeper?”
aov_text: Toe sê die HERE vir Kain: Waar is jou broer Abel? En hy antwoord: Ek weet nie. Is ek my broer se wagter?

kjv_text: And he said, What hast thou done? the voice of thy brother's blood crieth unto me from the ground.
bsb_text: “What have you done?” replied the LORD. “The voice of your brother’s blood cries out to Me from the ground.
aov_text: En Hy sê: Wat het jy gedoen? Die stem van die bloed van jou broer roep na My van die aarde af.

kjv_text: And now art thou cursed from the earth, which hath opened her mouth to receive thy brother's blood from thy hand;
bsb_text: Now you are cursed and banished from the ground, which has opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand.
aov_text: Daarom sal jy vervloek wees, ver van die grond wat sy mond oopgemaak het om die bloed van jou broer uit jou hand te ontvang.

kjv_text: When thou tillest the ground, it shall not henceforth yield unto thee her strength; a fugitive and a vagabond shalt thou be in the earth.
bsb_text: When you till the ground, it will no longer yield its produce to you. You will be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth.”
aov_text: As jy die grond bewerk, sal dit sy vermoë aan jou nie meer gee nie; ’n swerwer en vlugteling sal jy wees op die aarde.

kjv_text: And Cain said unto the LORD, My punishment is greater than I can bear.
bsb_text: But Cain said to the LORD, “My punishment is greater than I can bear.
aov_text: Daarop sê Kain vir die HERE: My skuld is te groot om dit te dra.

kjv_text: Behold, thou hast driven me out this day from the face of the earth; and from thy face shall I be hid; and I shall be a fugitive and a vagabond in the earth; and it shall come to pass, that every one that findeth me shall slay me.
bsb_text: Behold, this day You have driven me from the face of the earth, and from Your face I will be hidden; I will be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth, and whoever finds me will kill me.”
aov_text: Kyk, U verdryf my nou uit die land uit, en ek moet my verberg vir u aangesig: ’n swerwer en vlugteling sal ek op die aarde wees, en elkeen wat my kry, sal my doodslaan.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto him, Therefore whosoever slayeth Cain, vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold. And the LORD set a mark upon Cain, lest any finding him should kill him.
bsb_text: “Not so!” replied the LORD. “If anyone slays Cain, then Cain will be avenged sevenfold.” And the LORD placed a mark on Cain, so that no one who found him would kill him.
aov_text: Maar die HERE sê vir hom: Daarom, as enigeen Kain doodslaan, sal dit sewevoudig gewreek word. En die HERE het ’n teken gegee aan Kain, sodat enigeen wat hom kry, hom nie sou doodslaan nie.

kjv_text: And Cain went out from the presence of the LORD, and dwelt in the land of Nod, on the east of Eden.
bsb_text: So Cain went out from the presence of the LORD and settled in the land of Nod, east of Eden.
aov_text: Toe gaan Kain weg van die aangesig van die HERE, en hy het gewoon in die land Nod, aan die oostekant van Eden.

kjv_text: And Cain knew his wife; and she conceived, and bare Enoch: and he builded a city, and called the name of the city, after the name of his son, Enoch.
bsb_text: And Cain had relations with his wife, and she conceived and gave birth to Enoch. Then Cain built a city and named it after his son Enoch.
aov_text: En Kain het sy vrou beken, en sy het swanger geword en Henog gebaar. Daarna bou hy ’n stad en noem die stad na die naam van sy seun Henog.

kjv_text: And unto Enoch was born Irad: and Irad begat Mehujael: and Mehujael begat Methusael: and Methusael begat Lamech.
bsb_text: Now to Enoch was born Irad, and Irad was the father of Mehujael, and Mehujael was the father of Methusael, and Methusael was the father of Lamech.
aov_text: En vir Henog is Irad gebore; en Irad was die vader van Mehújael; en Mehújael was die vader van Metúsael; en Metúsael die vader van Lameg.

kjv_text: And Lamech took unto him two wives: the name of the one was Adah, and the name of the other Zillah.
bsb_text: And Lamech married two women, one named Adah and the other Zillah.
aov_text: En Lameg het vir hom twee vroue geneem. Die naam van die eerste was Ada, en die naam van die tweede Silla.

kjv_text: And Adah bare Jabal: he was the father of such as dwell in tents, and of such as have cattle.
bsb_text: Adah gave birth to Jabal; he was the father of those who dwell in tents and raise livestock.
aov_text: En Ada het Jabal gebaar. Hy was die vader van die tentbewoners en die veeboere.

kjv_text: And his brother's name was Jubal: he was the father of all such as handle the harp and organ.
bsb_text: And his brother’s name was Jubal; he was the father of all who play the harp and flute.
aov_text: Die naam van sy broer was Jubal. Hy was die vader van almal wat op siters en fluite speel.

kjv_text: And Zillah, she also bare Tubalcain, an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron: and the sister of Tubalcain was Naamah.
bsb_text: And Zillah gave birth to Tubal-cain, a forger of every implement of bronze and iron. And the sister of Tubal-cain was Naamah.
aov_text: En Silla het ook gebaar, naamlik Tubal-Kain, ’n smid wat allerhande koper- en ysterinstrumente gemaak het. En die suster van Tubal-Kain was Naéma.

kjv_text: And Lamech said unto his wives, Adah and Zillah, Hear my voice; ye wives of Lamech, hearken unto my speech: for I have slain a man to my wounding, and a young man to my hurt.
bsb_text: Then Lamech said to his wives: “Adah and Zillah, hear my voice; wives of Lamech, listen to my speech. For I have slain a man for wounding me, a young man for striking me.
aov_text: En Lameg het aan sy vroue gesê: Ada en Silla, hoor na my stem! Vroue van Lameg, luister na my woord! Voorwaar, ek slaan ’n man dood wat my wond en ’n seun wat my kwes.

kjv_text: If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold.
bsb_text: If Cain is avenged sevenfold, then Lamech seventy-sevenfold.”
aov_text: Want Kain sal sewe maal gewreek word, maar Lameg sewen-en-sewentig maal.

kjv_text: And Adam knew his wife again; and she bare a son, and called his name Seth: For God, said she, hath appointed me another seed instead of Abel, whom Cain slew.
bsb_text: And Adam again had relations with his wife, and she gave birth to a son and named him Seth, saying, “God has granted me another seed in place of Abel, since Cain killed him.”
aov_text: En Adam het sy vrou weer beken, en sy het ’n seun gebaar en hom Set genoem. Want, het sy gesê, God het my ’n ander kind geskenk in die plek van Abel, omdat Kain hom doodgeslaan het.

kjv_text: And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of the LORD.
bsb_text: And to Seth also a son was born, and he called him Enosh. At that time men began to call upon the name of the LORD.
aov_text: En ook vir Set is ’n seun gebore, wat hy Enos genoem het. Toe het hulle die Naam van die HERE begin aanroep.

kjv_text: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, in the likeness of God made he him;
bsb_text: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, He made him in His own likeness.
aov_text: DIT is die stamboom van Adam. Die dag toe God Adam geskape het, het Hy hom gemaak na die gelykenis van God.

kjv_text: Male and female created he them; and blessed them, and called their name Adam, in the day when they were created.
bsb_text: Male and female He created them, and He blessed them. And in the day they were created, He called them “man.”
aov_text: Man en vrou het Hy hulle geskape en hulle geseën en hulle mens genoem, die dag toe hulle geskape is.

kjv_text: And Adam lived an hundred and thirty years, and begat a son in his own likeness, after his image; and called his name Seth:
bsb_text: When Adam was 130 years old, he had a son in his own likeness, after his own image; and he named him Seth.
aov_text: Toe Adam honderd-en-dertig jaar oud was, het hy ’n seun verwek na sy gelykenis, na sy ewebeeld, en hom Set genoem.

kjv_text: And the days of Adam after he had begotten Seth were eight hundred years: and he begat sons and daughters:
bsb_text: And after he had become the father of Seth, Adam lived 800 years and had other sons and daughters.
aov_text: En die dae van Adam, ná die geboorte van Set, was agthonderd jaar. En hy het seuns en dogters gehad.

kjv_text: And all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years: and he died.
bsb_text: So Adam lived a total of 930 years, and then he died.
aov_text: So was dan al die dae van Adam wat hy geleef het, negehonderd-en-dertig jaar, en hy het gesterwe.

kjv_text: And Seth lived an hundred and five years, and begat Enos:
bsb_text: When Seth was 105 years old, he became the father of Enosh.
aov_text: Toe Set honderd-en-vyf jaar oud was, het hy die vader van Enos geword.

kjv_text: And Seth lived after he begat Enos eight hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters:
bsb_text: And after he had become the father of Enosh, Seth lived 807 years and had other sons and daughters.
aov_text: En Set het ná die geboorte van Enos nog agthonderd-en-sewe jaar gelewe. En hy het seuns en dogters gehad.

kjv_text: And all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years: and he died.
bsb_text: So Seth lived a total of 912 years, and then he died.
aov_text: So was dan al die dae van Set negehonderd-en-twaalf jaar, en hy het gesterwe.

kjv_text: And Enos lived ninety years, and begat Cainan:
bsb_text: When Enosh was 90 years old, he became the father of Kenan.
aov_text: Toe Enos negentig jaar oud was, het hy die vader van Kenan geword.

kjv_text: And Enos lived after he begat Cainan eight hundred and fifteen years, and begat sons and daughters:
bsb_text: And after he had become the father of Kenan, Enosh lived 815 years and had other sons and daughters.
aov_text: En Enos het ná die geboorte van Kenan nog agthonderd-en-vyftien jaar gelewe. En hy het seuns en dogters gehad.

kjv_text: And all the days of Enos were nine hundred and five years: and he died.
bsb_text: So Enosh lived a total of 905 years, and then he died.
aov_text: So was dan al die dae van Enos negehonderd-en-vyf jaar, en hy het gesterwe.

kjv_text: And Cainan lived seventy years, and begat Mahalaleel:
bsb_text: When Kenan was 70 years old, he became the father of Mahalalel.
aov_text: Toe Kenan sewentig jaar oud was, het hy die vader van Mahalálel geword.

kjv_text: And Cainan lived after he begat Mahalaleel eight hundred and forty years, and begat sons and daughters:
bsb_text: And after he had become the father of Mahalalel, Kenan lived 840 years and had other sons and daughters.
aov_text: En Kenan het ná die geboorte van Mahalálel nog agthonderd-en-veertig jaar gelewe. En hy het seuns en dogters gehad.

kjv_text: And all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years: and he died.
bsb_text: So Kenan lived a total of 910 years, and then he died.
aov_text: So was dan al die dae van Kenan negehonderd-en-tien jaar, en hy het gesterwe.

kjv_text: And Mahalaleel lived sixty and five years, and begat Jared:
bsb_text: When Mahalalel was 65 years old, he became the father of Jared.
aov_text: Toe Mahalálel vyf-en-sestig jaar oud was, het hy die vader van Jered geword.

kjv_text: And Mahalaleel lived after he begat Jared eight hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters:
bsb_text: And after he had become the father of Jared, Mahalalel lived 830 years and had other sons and daughters.
aov_text: En Mahalálel het ná die geboorte van Jered nog agthonderd-en-dertig jaar gelewe. En hy het seuns en dogters gehad.

kjv_text: And all the days of Mahalaleel were eight hundred ninety and five years: and he died.
bsb_text: So Mahalalel lived a total of 895 years, and then he died.
aov_text: So was dan al die dae van Mahalálel agthonderd-vyf-en-negentig jaar, en hy het gesterwe.

kjv_text: And Jared lived an hundred sixty and two years, and he begat Enoch:
bsb_text: When Jared was 162 years old, he became the father of Enoch.
aov_text: Toe Jered honderd-twee-en-sestig jaar oud was, het hy die vader van Henog geword.

kjv_text: And Jared lived after he begat Enoch eight hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:
bsb_text: And after he had become the father of Enoch, Jared lived 800 years and had other sons and daughters.
aov_text: En Jered het ná die geboorte van Henog nog agthonderd jaar gelewe. En hy het seuns en dogters gehad.

kjv_text: And all the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty and two years: and he died.
bsb_text: So Jared lived a total of 962 years, and then he died.
aov_text: So was dan al die dae van Jered negehonderd-twee-en-sestig jaar, en hy het gesterwe.

kjv_text: And Enoch lived sixty and five years, and begat Methuselah:
bsb_text: When Enoch was 65 years old, he became the father of Methuselah.
aov_text: Toe Henog vyf-en-sestig jaar oud was, het hy die vader van Metúsalag geword.

kjv_text: And Enoch walked with God after he begat Methuselah three hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:
bsb_text: And after he had become the father of Methuselah, Enoch walked with God 300 years and had other sons and daughters.
aov_text: En Henog het ná die geboorte van Metúsalag nog driehonderd jaar met God gewandel. En hy het seuns en dogters gehad.

kjv_text: And all the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty and five years:
bsb_text: So Enoch lived a total of 365 years.
aov_text: So was dan al die dae van Henog driehonderd-vyf-en-sestig jaar.

kjv_text: And Enoch walked with God: and he was not; for God took him.
bsb_text: Enoch walked with God, and then he was no more, because God had taken him away.
aov_text: En Henog het met God gewandel; en hy was daar nie meer nie, want God het hom weggeneem.

kjv_text: And Methuselah lived an hundred eighty and seven years, and begat Lamech:
bsb_text: When Methuselah was 187 years old, he became the father of Lamech.
aov_text: Toe Metúsalag honderd-sewen-en-tagtig jaar oud was, het hy die vader van Lameg geword.

kjv_text: And Methuselah lived after he begat Lamech seven hundred eighty and two years, and begat sons and daughters:
bsb_text: And after he had become the father of Lamech, Methuselah lived 782 years and had other sons and daughters.
aov_text: En Metúsalag het ná die geboorte van Lameg nog sewehonderd-twee-en-tagtig jaar gelewe. En hy het seuns en dogters gehad.

kjv_text: And all the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty and nine years: and he died.
bsb_text: So Methuselah lived a total of 969 years, and then he died.
aov_text: So was dan al die dae van Metúsalag negehonderd-negen-en-sestig jaar, en hy het gesterwe.

kjv_text: And Lamech lived an hundred eighty and two years, and begat a son:
bsb_text: When Lamech was 182 years old, he had a son.
aov_text: Toe Lameg honderd-twee-en-tagtig jaar oud was, het hy ’n seun verwek

kjv_text: And he called his name Noah, saying, This same shall comfort us concerning our work and toil of our hands, because of the ground which the LORD hath cursed.

kjv_text: And God saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.

aov_text: het dit die HERE berou dat Hy die mens op die aarde gemaak het, en daar was smart in sy hart.

aov_text: Maar Noag het genade gevind in die oë van die HERE.

aov_text: Dit is die geskiedenis van Noag. Noag was ’n regverdige, opregte man onder sy tydgenote. Noag het met God gewandel.

kjv_text: And Noah begat three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
bsb_text: And Noah had three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
aov_text: En Noag het drie seuns gehad: Sem, Gam en Jafet.

kjv_text: The earth also was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.

aov_text: Maar die aarde was verdorwe voor die aangesig van God, en die aarde was vol geweld.

aov_text: Só moet jy dit maak: driehonderd el die lengte van die ark, vyftig el sy breedte en dertig el sy hoogte.

aov_text: ’n Opening moet jy aan die ark maak; en op die maat van ’n el moet jy dit aan die bokant afwerk en die deur van die ark aan die sykant insit. Jy moet dit met ’n onderste, tweede en derde verdieping maak.

kjv_text: And, behold, I, even I, do bring a flood of waters upon the earth, to destroy all flesh, wherein is the breath of life, from under heaven; and every thing that is in the earth shall die.

bsb_text: But I will establish My covenant with you, and you will enter the ark—you and your sons and your wife and your sons’ wives with you.

bsb_text: And Noah did all that the LORD had commanded him.

aov_text: Van die rein diere en van die diere wat nie rein is nie, en van die voëls en van alles wat op die aarde kruip,

aov_text: Toe het Noag aan die end van veertig dae die venster oopgemaak van die ark wat hy gebou het,

kjv_text: Bring forth with thee every living thing that is with thee, of all flesh, both of fowl, and of cattle, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth; that they may breed abundantly in the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply upon the earth.
bsb_text: Bring out all the living creatures that are with you—birds, livestock, and everything that crawls upon the ground—so that they can spread out over the earth and be fruitful and multiply upon it.”
aov_text: Laat saam met jou uitgaan al die diere wat by jou is, van alle vlees: die voëls en die vee en al die diere wat op die aarde kruip, dat hulle kan wemel op die aarde en vrugbaar wees en vermeerder op die aarde.

kjv_text: And Noah went forth, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons' wives with him:
bsb_text: So Noah came out, along with his sons and his wife and his sons’ wives.
aov_text: Toe gaan Noag uit en sy seuns en sy vrou en die vroue van sy seuns saam met hom.

kjv_text: Every beast, every creeping thing, and every fowl, and whatsoever creepeth upon the earth, after their kinds, went forth out of the ark.
bsb_text: Every living creature, every creeping thing, and every bird—everything that moves upon the earth—came out of the ark, kind by kind.
aov_text: Al die diere, alles wat kruip, en al die voëls, alles wat op die aarde beweeg, volgens hulle soorte, het uit die ark uitgegaan.

kjv_text: And Noah builded an altar unto the LORD; and took of every clean beast, and of every clean fowl, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.
bsb_text: Then Noah built an altar to the LORD. And taking from every kind of clean animal and clean bird, he offered burnt offerings on the altar.
aov_text: En Noag het vir die HERE ’n altaar gebou en van al die rein diere en al die rein voëls geneem en brandoffers op die altaar gebring.

kjv_text: And the LORD smelled a sweet savour; and the LORD said in his heart, I will not again curse the ground any more for man's sake; for the imagination of man's heart is evil from his youth; neither will I again smite any more every thing living, as I have done.
bsb_text: When the LORD smelled the pleasing aroma, He said in His heart, “Never again will I curse the ground because of man, even though every inclination of his heart is evil from his youth. And never again will I destroy all living creatures as I have done.
aov_text: En die HERE het die lieflike geur geruik, en die HERE het in sy hart gesê: Ek sal die aarde verder nie meer vervloek ter wille van die mens nie, want die versinsels van die mens se hart is sleg van sy jeug af. En Ek sal verder nie meer al die lewende wesens tref soos Ek gedoen het nie.

kjv_text: While the earth remaineth, seedtime and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease.
bsb_text: As long as the earth endures, seedtime and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter, day and night shall never cease.”
aov_text: Van nou af sal al die dae van die aarde, saaityd en oestyd, koue en hitte, somer en winter, dag en nag nie ophou nie.

kjv_text: And God blessed Noah and his sons, and said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth.
bsb_text: And God blessed Noah and his sons and said to them, “Be fruitful and multiply and fill the earth.
aov_text: EN God het Noag en sy seuns geseën en aan hulle gesê: Wees vrugbaar en vermeerder en vul die aarde.

kjv_text: And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth, and upon every fowl of the air, upon all that moveth upon the earth, and upon all the fishes of the sea; into your hand are they delivered.
bsb_text: The fear and dread of you will fall on every living creature on the earth, every bird of the air, every creature that crawls on the ground, and all the fish of the sea. They are delivered into your hand.
aov_text: Die vrees en die skrik vir julle sal wees oor al die diere van die aarde en al die voëls van die hemel: alles wat op die aarde beweeg, en al die visse van die see. Hulle is in julle hand oorgegee.

kjv_text: Every moving thing that liveth shall be meat for you; even as the green herb have I given you all things.
bsb_text: Everything that lives and moves will be food for you; just as I gave you the green plants, I now give you all things.
aov_text: Alles wat beweeg en lewe, sal julle voedsel wees. Net soos die groen plante, gee Ek dit alles aan julle.

kjv_text: But flesh with the life thereof, which is the blood thereof, shall ye not eat.
bsb_text: But you must not eat meat with its lifeblood still in it.
aov_text: Net die vleis met sy siel, met sy bloed, mag julle nie eet nie.

kjv_text: And surely your blood of your lives will I require; at the hand of every beast will I require it, and at the hand of man; at the hand of every man's brother will I require the life of man.
bsb_text: And surely I will require the life of any man or beast by whose hand your lifeblood is shed. I will demand an accounting from anyone who takes the life of his fellow man:
aov_text: Maar wat julle eie bloed betref, dit sal Ek eis: van al die diere sal Ek dit eis. Ook van die mens, van die een teenoor die ander, sal Ek die siel van die mens eis.

kjv_text: Whoso sheddeth man's blood, by man shall his blood be shed: for in the image of God made he man.
bsb_text: Whoever sheds the blood of man, by man his blood will be shed; for in His own image God has made mankind.
aov_text: Hy wat die bloed van ’n mens vergiet, sy bloed sal deur die mens vergiet word; want God het die mens na sy beeld gemaak.

kjv_text: And you, be ye fruitful, and multiply; bring forth abundantly in the earth, and multiply therein.
bsb_text: But as for you, be fruitful and multiply; spread out across the earth and multiply upon it.”
aov_text: Maar julle, wees vrugbaar en vermeerder; wemel op die aarde en vermeerder daarop.

kjv_text: And God spake unto Noah, and to his sons with him, saying,
bsb_text: Then God said to Noah and his sons with him,
aov_text: Verder het God met Noag en sy seuns by hom gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: And I, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your seed after you;
bsb_text: “Behold, I now establish My covenant with you and your descendants after you,
aov_text: Maar Ek, kyk, Ek rig my verbond met julle op en met julle nageslag ná julle,

kjv_text: And with every living creature that is with you, of the fowl, of the cattle, and of every beast of the earth with you; from all that go out of the ark, to every beast of the earth.
bsb_text: and with every living creature that was with you—the birds, the livestock, and every beast of the earth—every living thing that came out of the ark.
aov_text: en met al die lewende wesens wat by julle is: die voëls, die vee en al die wilde diere van die aarde by julle—al wat uit die ark uitgegaan het, naamlik al die diere van die aarde.

kjv_text: And I will establish my covenant with you; neither shall all flesh be cut off any more by the waters of a flood; neither shall there any more be a flood to destroy the earth.
bsb_text: And I establish My covenant with you: Never again will all life be cut off by the waters of a flood; never again will there be a flood to destroy the earth.”
aov_text: En Ek rig my verbond met julle op, dat alle vlees nie meer deur die waters van die vloed uitgeroei sal word nie, en dat daar geen vloed meer sal wees om die aarde te verwoes nie.

kjv_text: And God said, This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:
bsb_text: And God said, “This is the sign of the covenant I am making between Me and you and every living creature with you, a covenant for all generations to come:
aov_text: En God het gesê: Dit is die teken van die verbond wat Ek sluit tussen My en julle en al die lewende wesens wat by julle is, vir ewige geslagte:

kjv_text: I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.
bsb_text: I have set My rainbow in the clouds, and it will be a sign of the covenant between Me and the earth.
aov_text: my boog gee Ek in die wolke; dit sal ’n teken wees van die verbond tussen My en die aarde.

kjv_text: And it shall come to pass, when I bring a cloud over the earth, that the bow shall be seen in the cloud:
bsb_text: Whenever I form clouds over the earth and the rainbow appears in the clouds,
aov_text: As Ek dan wolke oor die aarde bring en hierdie boog verskyn in die wolke,

kjv_text: And I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh; and the waters shall no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.
bsb_text: I will remember My covenant between Me and you and every living creature of every kind. Never again will the waters become a flood to destroy all life.
aov_text: dan sal Ek dink aan my verbond wat daar bestaan tussen My en julle en al die lewende wesens, in alle vlees. En die waters sal nie meer ’n vloed word om alle vlees te verdelg nie.

kjv_text: And the bow shall be in the cloud; and I will look upon it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is upon the earth.
bsb_text: And whenever the rainbow appears in the clouds, I will see it and remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of every kind that is on the earth.”
aov_text: As die boog dan in die wolke staan, sal Ek dit aansien om gedagtig te wees aan die ewige verbond tussen God en al die lewende wesens in alle vlees wat op die aarde is.

kjv_text: And God said unto Noah, This is the token of the covenant, which I have established between me and all flesh that is upon the earth.
bsb_text: So God said to Noah, “This is the sign of the covenant that I have established between Me and every creature on the earth.”
aov_text: En God het vir Noag gesê: Dit is die teken van die verbond wat Ek opgerig het tussen My en alle vlees wat op die aarde is.

kjv_text: And the sons of Noah, that went forth of the ark, were Shem, and Ham, and Japheth: and Ham is the father of Canaan.
bsb_text: The sons of Noah who came out of the ark were Shem, Ham, and Japheth. And Ham was the father of Canaan.
aov_text: EN die seuns van Noag wat uit die ark uitgegaan het, was Sem en Gam en Jafet. En Gam was die vader van Kanaän.

kjv_text: These are the three sons of Noah: and of them was the whole earth overspread.
bsb_text: These three were the sons of Noah, and from them the whole earth was populated.
aov_text: Hierdie drie was die seuns van Noag; en met hulle begin die uitbreiding van al die aardbewoners.

kjv_text: And Noah began to be an husbandman, and he planted a vineyard:
bsb_text: Now Noah, a man of the soil, proceeded to plant a vineyard.
aov_text: En Noag het as landbouer ’n wingerd begin plant.

kjv_text: And he drank of the wine, and was drunken; and he was uncovered within his tent.
bsb_text: But when he drank some of its wine, he became drunk and uncovered himself inside his tent.
aov_text: Maar toe hy van die wyn gedrink het, het hy dronk geword en naak in sy tent gelê.

kjv_text: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brethren without.
bsb_text: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw his father’s nakedness and told his two brothers outside.
aov_text: En Gam, die vader van Kanaän, het sy vader se naaktheid gesien en dit aan sy twee broers daarbuite te kenne gegee.

kjv_text: And Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it upon both their shoulders, and went backward, and covered the nakedness of their father; and their faces were backward, and they saw not their father's nakedness.
bsb_text: Then Shem and Japheth took a garment and placed it across their shoulders, and walking backward, they covered their father’s nakedness. Their faces were turned away so that they did not see their father’s nakedness.
aov_text: Toe neem Sem en Jafet die bo-kleed en hou dit op hulle skouers terwyl hulle agteruitloop, en hulle het die naaktheid van hulle vader bedek: hulle gesig was agtertoe gedraai, sodat hulle die naaktheid van hulle vader nie gesien het nie.

kjv_text: And Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his younger son had done unto him.
bsb_text: When Noah awoke from his drunkenness and learned what his youngest son had done to him,
aov_text: Toe Noag van sy wyn wakker word en merk wat sy jonger seun hom aangedoen het,

kjv_text: And he said, Cursed be Canaan; a servant of servants shall he be unto his brethren.
bsb_text: he said, “Cursed be Canaan! A servant of servants shall he be to his brothers.”
aov_text: sê hy: Vervloek is Kanaän! ’n Kneg van die knegte moet hy wees vir sy broers.

kjv_text: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.
bsb_text: He also declared: “Blessed be the LORD, the God of Shem! May Canaan be the servant of Shem.
aov_text: Verder het hy gesê: Geseënd is die HERE, die God van Sem. Maar Kanaän moet sy dienskneg wees.

kjv_text: God shall enlarge Japheth, and he shall dwell in the tents of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.
bsb_text: May God expand the territory of Japheth; may he dwell in the tents of Shem, and may Canaan be his servant.”
aov_text: Mag God aan Jafet ruimte verskaf, en mag hy woon in die tente van Sem! Maar Kanaän moet sy dienskneg wees.

kjv_text: And Noah lived after the flood three hundred and fifty years.
bsb_text: After the flood, Noah lived 350 years.
aov_text: En Noag het ná die vloed driehonderd-en-vyftig jaar gelewe.

kjv_text: And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years: and he died.
bsb_text: So Noah lived a total of 950 years, and then he died.
aov_text: So was dan al die dae van Noag negehonderd-en-vyftig jaar, en hy het gesterwe.

kjv_text: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth: and unto them were sons born after the flood.
bsb_text: This is the account of Noah’s sons Shem, Ham, and Japheth, who also had sons after the flood.
aov_text: EN dit is die stamboom van die seuns van Noag: Sem, Gam en Jafet—vir hulle is daar seuns gebore ná die vloed.

kjv_text: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.
bsb_text: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
aov_text: Die seuns van Jafet was: Gomer en Magog en Madai en Jawan en Tubal en Meseg en Tiras.

kjv_text: And the sons of Gomer; Ashkenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.
bsb_text: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
aov_text: En die seuns van Gomer was: Áskenas en Rifat en Togárma.

kjv_text: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
bsb_text: And the sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, the Kittites, and the Rodanites.
aov_text: En die seuns van Jawan was: Elísa en Tarsis, die Kittiërs en Dodaniete—

kjv_text: By these were the isles of the Gentiles divided in their lands; every one after his tongue, after their families, in their nations.
bsb_text: From these, the maritime peoples separated into their territories, according to their languages, by clans within their nations.
aov_text: uit hulle het verdeeld geraak die kuslande van die nasies, in hulle lande, elkeen na sy taal, volgens hulle geslagte, in hulle nasies.

kjv_text: And the sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, and Phut, and Canaan.
bsb_text: The sons of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
aov_text: En die seuns van Gam was: Kus en Misraim en Put en Kanaän.

kjv_text: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabtah, and Raamah, and Sabtechah: and the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.
bsb_text: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. And the sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
aov_text: En die seuns van Kus was: Seba en Háwila en Sabta en Raéma en Sábtega. En die seuns van Raéma: Skeba en Dedan.

kjv_text: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be a mighty one in the earth.
bsb_text: Cush was the father of Nimrod, who began to be a mighty one on the earth.
aov_text: Kus was ook die vader van Nimrod. Hý het begin om ’n geweldenaar op aarde te wees.

kjv_text: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD: wherefore it is said, Even as Nimrod the mighty hunter before the LORD.
bsb_text: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD; so it is said, “Like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before the LORD.”
aov_text: Hy was ’n geweldige jagter voor die aangesig van die HERE. Daarom sê hulle: Soos Nimrod, ’n geweldige jagter voor die aangesig van die HERE.

kjv_text: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel, and Erech, and Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
bsb_text: His kingdom began in Babylon, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
aov_text: En die begin van sy ryk was Babel en Ereg en Akkad en Kalne in die land Sínear.

kjv_text: Out of that land went forth Asshur, and builded Nineveh, and the city Rehoboth, and Calah,
bsb_text: From that land he went forth into Assyria, where he built Nineveh, Rehoboth-Ir, Calah,
aov_text: Uit hierdie land het hy getrek na Assur en gebou: Ninevé en Réhobot-Ir en Kalag

kjv_text: And Resen between Nineveh and Calah: the same is a great city.
bsb_text: and Resen, which is between Nineveh and the great city of Calah.
aov_text: en Resen, tussen Ninevé en Kalag—dit is die groot stad.

kjv_text: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,
bsb_text: Mizraim was the father of the Ludites, the Anamites, the Lehabites, the Naphtuhites,
aov_text: En Misraim was die vader van die Ludiete en Anamiete en Lehabiete en Naftuhiete

kjv_text: And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (out of whom came Philistim,) and Caphtorim.
bsb_text: the Pathrusites, the Casluhites (from whom the Philistines came), and the Caphtorites.
aov_text: en die Patrusiete en Kasluhiete—waaruit die Filistyne voortgekom het—en Kaftoriete.

kjv_text: And Canaan begat Sidon his first born, and Heth,
bsb_text: And Canaan was the father of Sidon his firstborn, and of the Hittites,
aov_text: En Kanaän was die vader van Sidon, sy eersgeborene, en Het

kjv_text: And the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgasite,
bsb_text: the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,
aov_text: en die Jebusiete en Amoriete en Girgasiete

kjv_text: And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,
bsb_text: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,
aov_text: en die Hewiete en Arkiete en Siniete

kjv_text: And the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite: and afterward were the families of the Canaanites spread abroad.
bsb_text: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites. Later the Canaanite clans were scattered,
aov_text: en die Arwadiete en Semariete en Hamatiete. En daarna het die geslagte van die Kanaäniete hulle versprei.

kjv_text: And the border of the Canaanites was from Sidon, as thou comest to Gerar, unto Gaza; as thou goest, unto Sodom, and Gomorrah, and Admah, and Zeboim, even unto Lasha.
bsb_text: and the borders of Canaan extended from Sidon toward Gerar as far as Gaza, and then toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, as far as Lasha.
aov_text: En die gebied van die Kanaäniete was van Sidon af in die rigting van Gerar tot by Gasa, in die rigting van Sodom en Gomorra en Adma en Sebóim tot by Lesa.

kjv_text: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, after their tongues, in their countries, and in their nations.
bsb_text: These are the sons of Ham according to their clans, languages, lands, and nations.
aov_text: Dit was die seuns van Gam volgens hulle geslagte, na hulle tale, in hulle lande, in hulle nasies.

kjv_text: Unto Shem also, the father of all the children of Eber, the brother of Japheth the elder, even to him were children born.
bsb_text: And sons were also born to Shem, the older brother of Japheth; Shem was the forefather of all the sons of Eber.
aov_text: En ook vir Sem, die stamvader van al die seuns van Heber, die ouer broer van Jafet, is seuns gebore.

kjv_text: The children of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram.
bsb_text: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, and Aram.
aov_text: Die seuns van Sem was: Elam en Assur en Arpagsad en Lud en Aram.

kjv_text: And the children of Aram; Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Mash.
bsb_text: The sons of Aram: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.
aov_text: En die seuns van Aram was: Us en Hul en Geter en Mas.

kjv_text: And Arphaxad begat Salah; and Salah begat Eber.
bsb_text: Arphaxad was the father of Shelah, and Shelah was the father of Eber.
aov_text: En Arpagsad was die vader van Selag, en Selag van Heber.

kjv_text: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of one was Peleg; for in his days was the earth divided; and his brother's name was Joktan.
bsb_text: Two sons were born to Eber: One was named Peleg, because in his days the earth was divided, and his brother was named Joktan.
aov_text: En vir Heber is twee seuns gebore; die naam van die een was Peleg, want in sy dae het die aardbewoners verdeeld geraak; en die naam van sy broer was Joktan.

kjv_text: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,
bsb_text: And Joktan was the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
aov_text: En Joktan was die vader van Almódad en Selef en Hasarmáwet en Jerag

kjv_text: And Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah,
bsb_text: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
aov_text: en Hadóram en Usal en Dikla

kjv_text: And Obal, and Abimael, and Sheba,
bsb_text: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,
aov_text: en Obal en Abímael en Skeba

kjv_text: And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab: all these were the sons of Joktan.
bsb_text: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were sons of Joktan.
aov_text: en Ofir en Háwila en Jobab. Hulle almal was seuns van Joktan.

kjv_text: And their dwelling was from Mesha, as thou goest unto Sephar a mount of the east.
bsb_text: Their territory extended from Mesha to Sephar, in the eastern hill country.
aov_text: En hulle woonplek was van Mesa af in die rigting van Sefar, die berg van die Ooste.

kjv_text: These are the sons of Shem, after their families, after their tongues, in their lands, after their nations.
bsb_text: These are the sons of Shem, according to their clans, languages, lands, and nations.
aov_text: Dit is die seuns van Sem volgens hulle geslagte, na hulle tale, in hulle lande, volgens hulle nasies.

kjv_text: These are the families of the sons of Noah, after their generations, in their nations: and by these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood.
bsb_text: All these are the clans of Noah’s sons, according to their generations and nations. From these the nations of the earth spread out after the flood.
aov_text: Dit is die geslagte van die seuns van Noag volgens hulle afstamming, in hulle nasies; en uit hulle het die nasies op die aarde hulle verdeel ná die vloed.

kjv_text: And the whole earth was of one language, and of one speech.
bsb_text: Now the whole world had one language and a common form of speech.
aov_text: EN die hele aarde het dieselfde taal gehad en een en dieselfde woorde.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, as they journeyed from the east, that they found a plain in the land of Shinar; and they dwelt there.
bsb_text: And as people journeyed eastward, they found a plain in the land of Shinar and settled there.
aov_text: En toe hulle wegtrek na die ooste, vind hulle ’n laagte in die land Sínear; en daar het hulle gaan woon.

kjv_text: And they said one to another, Go to, let us make brick, and burn them thoroughly. And they had brick for stone, and slime had they for morter.
bsb_text: And they said to one another, “Come, let us make bricks and bake them thoroughly.” So they used brick instead of stone, and tar instead of mortar.
aov_text: Daarop sê hulle vir mekaar: Kom laat ons stene vorm en dit goed brand. Hulle gebruik toe die bakstene vir bousteen en die lymgrond vir klei.

kjv_text: And they said, Go to, let us build us a city and a tower, whose top may reach unto heaven; and let us make us a name, lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth.
bsb_text: “Come,” they said, “let us build for ourselves a city with a tower that reaches to the heavens, that we may make a name for ourselves and not be scattered over the face of all the earth.”
aov_text: En hulle sê: Kom, laat ons vir ons ’n stad bou en ’n toring waarvan die spits tot aan die hemel reik; en laat ons vir ons ’n naam maak, sodat ons nie oor die hele aarde verstrooid raak nie.

kjv_text: And the LORD came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men builded.
bsb_text: Then the LORD came down to see the city and the tower that the sons of men were building.
aov_text: Toe daal die HERE neer om die stad en die toring te besien waaraan die mensekinders gebou het.

kjv_text: And the LORD said, Behold, the people is one, and they have all one language; and this they begin to do: and now nothing will be restrained from them, which they have imagined to do.
bsb_text: And the LORD said, “If they have begun to do this as one people speaking the same language, then nothing they devise will be beyond them.
aov_text: En die HERE sê: Daar is hulle nou een volk en het almal een taal! En dit is net die begin van hulle onderneming: nou sal niks vir hulle meer onmoontlik wees van wat hulle van plan is om te doen nie.

kjv_text: Go to, let us go down, and there confound their language, that they may not understand one another's speech.
bsb_text: Come, let Us go down and confuse their language, so that they will not understand one another’s speech.”
aov_text: Kom, laat Ons neerdaal en hulle taal daar verwar, sodat die een die taal van die ander nie kan verstaan nie.

kjv_text: So the LORD scattered them abroad from thence upon the face of all the earth: and they left off to build the city.
bsb_text: So the LORD scattered them from there over the face of all the earth, and they stopped building the city.
aov_text: So het die HERE hulle dan daarvandaan oor die hele aarde verstrooi; en hulle het opgehou om die stad te bou.
