kjv_text: Therefore is the name of it called Babel; because the LORD did there confound the language of all the earth: and from thence did the LORD scatter them abroad upon the face of all the earth.
bsb_text: That is why it is called Babel, for there the LORD confused the language of the whole world, and from that place the LORD scattered them over the face of all the earth.
aov_text: Daarom het hulle dit Babel genoem, want daar het die HERE die taal van die hele aarde verwar, en daarvandaan het die HERE hulle oor die hele aarde verstrooi.

kjv_text: These are the generations of Shem: Shem was an hundred years old, and begat Arphaxad two years after the flood:
bsb_text: This is the account of Shem. Two years after the flood, when Shem was 100 years old, he became the father of Arphaxad.
aov_text: DIT is die stamboom van Sem: Toe Sem honderd jaar oud was, het hy die vader van Arpagsad geword, twee jaar ná die vloed.

kjv_text: And Shem lived after he begat Arphaxad five hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.
bsb_text: And after he had become the father of Arphaxad, Shem lived 500 years and had other sons and daughters.
aov_text: En Sem het ná die geboorte van Arpagsad nog vyfhonderd jaar gelewe. En hy het seuns en dogters gehad.

kjv_text: And Arphaxad lived five and thirty years, and begat Salah:
bsb_text: When Arphaxad was 35 years old, he became the father of Shelah.
aov_text: Toe Arpagsad vyf-en-dertig jaar oud was, het hy die vader van Selag geword.

kjv_text: And Arphaxad lived after he begat Salah four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.
bsb_text: And after he had become the father of Shelah, Arphaxad lived 403 years and had other sons and daughters.
aov_text: En Arpagsad het ná die geboorte van Selag nog vierhonderd-en-drie jaar gelewe. En hy het seuns en dogters gehad.

kjv_text: And Salah lived thirty years, and begat Eber:
bsb_text: When Shelah was 30 years old, he became the father of Eber.
aov_text: Toe Selag dertig jaar oud was, het hy die vader van Heber geword.

kjv_text: And Salah lived after he begat Eber four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.
bsb_text: And after he had become the father of Eber, Shelah lived 403 years and had other sons and daughters.
aov_text: En Selag het ná die geboorte van Heber nog vierhonderd-en-drie jaar gelewe. En hy het seuns en dogters gehad.

kjv_text: And Eber lived four and thirty years, and begat Peleg:
bsb_text: When Eber was 34 years old, he became the father of Peleg.
aov_text: Toe Heber vier-en-dertig jaar oud was, het hy die vader van Peleg geword.

kjv_text: And Eber lived after he begat Peleg four hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters.
bsb_text: And after he had become the father of Peleg, Eber lived 430 years and had other sons and daughters.
aov_text: En Heber het ná die geboorte van Peleg nog vierhonderd-en-dertig jaar gelewe. En hy het seuns en dogters gehad.

kjv_text: And Peleg lived thirty years, and begat Reu:
bsb_text: When Peleg was 30 years old, he became the father of Reu.
aov_text: Toe Peleg dertig jaar oud was, het hy die vader van Rehu geword.

kjv_text: And Peleg lived after he begat Reu two hundred and nine years, and begat sons and daughters.
bsb_text: And after he had become the father of Reu, Peleg lived 209 years and had other sons and daughters.
aov_text: En Peleg het ná die geboorte van Rehu nog tweehonderd-en-nege jaar gelewe. En hy het seuns en dogters gehad.

kjv_text: And Reu lived two and thirty years, and begat Serug:
bsb_text: When Reu was 32 years old, he became the father of Serug.
aov_text: Toe Rehu twee-en-dertig jaar oud was, het hy die vader van Serug geword.

kjv_text: And Reu lived after he begat Serug two hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters.
bsb_text: And after he had become the father of Serug, Reu lived 207 years and had other sons and daughters.
aov_text: En Rehu het ná die geboorte van Serug nog tweehonderd-en-sewe jaar gelewe. En hy het seuns en dogters gehad.

kjv_text: And Serug lived thirty years, and begat Nahor:
bsb_text: When Serug was 30 years old, he became the father of Nahor.
aov_text: Toe Serug dertig jaar oud was, het hy die vader van Nahor geword.

kjv_text: And Serug lived after he begat Nahor two hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.
bsb_text: And after he had become the father of Nahor, Serug lived 200 years and had other sons and daughters.
aov_text: En Serug het ná die geboorte van Nahor tweehonderd jaar gelewe. En hy het seuns en dogters gehad.

kjv_text: And Nahor lived nine and twenty years, and begat Terah:
bsb_text: When Nahor was 29 years old, he became the father of Terah.
aov_text: Toe Nahor negen-en-twintig jaar oud was, het hy die vader van Tera geword.

kjv_text: And Nahor lived after he begat Terah an hundred and nineteen years, and begat sons and daughters.
bsb_text: And after he had become the father of Terah, Nahor lived 119 years and had other sons and daughters.
aov_text: En Nahor het ná die geboorte van Tera nog honderd-en-negentien jaar gelewe. En hy het seuns en dogters gehad.

kjv_text: And Terah lived seventy years, and begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
bsb_text: When Terah was 70 years old, he became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
aov_text: Toe Tera sewentig jaar oud was, het hy die vader geword van Abram, Nahor en Haran.

kjv_text: Now these are the generations of Terah: Terah begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran; and Haran begat Lot.
bsb_text: This is the account of Terah. Terah became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran. And Haran became the father of Lot.
aov_text: En dit is die stamboom van Tera: Tera het die vader geword van Abram, Nahor en Haran, en Haran van Lot.

kjv_text: And Haran died before his father Terah in the land of his nativity, in Ur of the Chaldees.
bsb_text: During his father Terah’s lifetime, Haran died in his native land, in Ur of the Chaldeans.
aov_text: En Haran het gesterwe terwyl sy vader Tera nog geleef het, in sy geboorteland, in Ur van die Chaldeërs.

kjv_text: And Abram and Nahor took them wives: the name of Abram's wife was Sarai; and the name of Nahor's wife, Milcah, the daughter of Haran, the father of Milcah, and the father of Iscah.
bsb_text: And Abram and Nahor took wives for themselves. Abram’s wife was named Sarai, and Nahor’s wife was named Milcah; she was the daughter of Haran, who was the father of both Milcah and Iscah.
aov_text: En Abram en Nahor het vir hulle vroue geneem. Die naam van Abram se vrou was Sarai, en die naam van Nahor se vrou was Milka, die dogter van Haran, die vader van Milka en die vader van Jiska.

kjv_text: But Sarai was barren; she had no child.
bsb_text: But Sarai was barren; she had no children.
aov_text: En Sarai was onvrugbaar, sy het geen kind gehad nie.

kjv_text: And Terah took Abram his son, and Lot the son of Haran his son's son, and Sarai his daughter in law, his son Abram's wife; and they went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan; and they came unto Haran, and dwelt there.
bsb_text: And Terah took his son Abram, his grandson Lot son of Haran, and his daughter-in-law Sarai the wife of Abram, and they set out from Ur of the Chaldeans for the land of Canaan. But when they arrived in Haran, they settled there.
aov_text: En Tera het sy seun Abram geneem en Lot, die seun van Haran, sy kleinseun, en Sarai, sy skoondogter, die vrou van sy seun Abram, en dié het saam met hulle uit Ur van die Chaldeërs getrek om na die land Kanaän te gaan. En hulle het tot by Haran gekom en daar gaan woon.

kjv_text: And the days of Terah were two hundred and five years: and Terah died in Haran.
bsb_text: Terah lived 205 years, and he died in Haran.
aov_text: En die dae van Tera was twee-honderd-en-vyf jaar, en Tera het in Haran gesterwe.

kjv_text: Now the LORD had said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father's house, unto a land that I will shew thee:
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to Abram, “Leave your country, your kindred, and your father’s household, and go to the land I will show you.
aov_text: EN die HERE het aan Abram gesê: Gaan jy uit jou land en uit jou familie en uit jou vader se huis, na die land wat Ek jou sal wys.

kjv_text: And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a blessing:
bsb_text: I will make you into a great nation, and I will bless you; I will make your name great, so that you will be a blessing.
aov_text: En Ek sal jou ’n groot nasie maak en jou seën en jou naam so groot maak, dat jy ’n seën sal wees.

kjv_text: And I will bless them that bless thee, and curse him that curseth thee: and in thee shall all families of the earth be blessed.
bsb_text: I will bless those who bless you and curse those who curse you; and all the families of the earth will be blessed through you.”
aov_text: En Ek sal seën diegene wat jou seën, en hom vervloek wat jou vervloek; en in jou sal al die geslagte van die aarde geseën word.

kjv_text: So Abram departed, as the LORD had spoken unto him; and Lot went with him: and Abram was seventy and five years old when he departed out of Haran.
bsb_text: So Abram departed, as the LORD had directed him, and Lot went with him. Abram was seventy-five years old when he left Haran.
aov_text: Toe het Abram weggetrek soos die HERE hom gesê het, en Lot het saam met hom getrek. En Abram was vyf-en-sewentig jaar oud by sy vertrek uit Haran.

kjv_text: And Abram took Sarai his wife, and Lot his brother's son, and all their substance that they had gathered, and the souls that they had gotten in Haran; and they went forth to go into the land of Canaan; and into the land of Canaan they came.
bsb_text: And Abram took his wife Sarai, his nephew Lot, and all the possessions and people they had acquired in Haran, and set out for the land of Canaan. When they came to the land of Canaan,
aov_text: En Abram het Sarai, sy vrou, en Lot, sy broerskind, geneem en al hulle besittings wat hulle bymekaargemaak en die slawe wat hulle in Haran verwerf het, en hulle het uitgetrek om na die land Kanaän te gaan en in die land Kanaän gekom.

kjv_text: And Abram passed through the land unto the place of Sichem, unto the plain of Moreh. And the Canaanite was then in the land.
bsb_text: Abram traveled through the land as far as the site of the Oak of Moreh at Shechem. And at that time the Canaanites were in the land.
aov_text: En Abram het deur die land getrek na die plek Sigem, tot by die terpentynboom More. Die Kanaäniete was toe in die land.

kjv_text: And the LORD appeared unto Abram, and said, Unto thy seed will I give this land: and there builded he an altar unto the LORD, who appeared unto him.
bsb_text: Then the LORD appeared to Abram and said, “I will give this land to your offspring.” So Abram built an altar there to the LORD, who had appeared to him.
aov_text: Daarop verskyn die HERE aan Abram en sê: Aan jou nageslag sal Ek hierdie land gee. Toe bou hy daar ’n altaar vir die HERE wat aan hom verskyn het.

kjv_text: And he removed from thence unto a mountain on the east of Bethel, and pitched his tent, having Bethel on the west, and Hai on the east: and there he builded an altar unto the LORD, and called upon the name of the LORD.
bsb_text: From there Abram moved on to the hill country east of Bethel and pitched his tent, with Bethel to the west and Ai to the east. There he built an altar to the LORD, and he called on the name of the LORD.
aov_text: En daarvandaan het hy verder versit na die gebergte oos van Bet-el en sy tent opgeslaan tussen Bet-el aan die weste- en Ai aan die oostekant, en daar vir die HERE ’n altaar gebou en die Naam van die HERE aangeroep.

kjv_text: And Abram journeyed, going on still toward the south.
bsb_text: And Abram journeyed on toward the Negev.
aov_text: Daarna het Abram al verder na die Suidland weggetrek.

kjv_text: And there was a famine in the land: and Abram went down into Egypt to sojourn there; for the famine was grievous in the land.
bsb_text: Now there was a famine in the land. So Abram went down to Egypt to live there for a while because the famine was severe.
aov_text: En daar was hongersnood in die land, sodat Abram na Egipte afgetrek het om daar as vreemdeling te vertoef; want die hongersnood was swaar in die land.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when he was come near to enter into Egypt, that he said unto Sarai his wife, Behold now, I know that thou art a fair woman to look upon:
bsb_text: As he was about to enter Egypt, he said to his wife Sarai, “Look, I know that you are a beautiful woman,
aov_text: En toe hy op die punt staan om Egipte in te trek, het hy met sy vrou Sarai gespreek: Kyk, ek weet dat jy ’n vrou is mooi van aansien.

kjv_text: Therefore it shall come to pass, when the Egyptians shall see thee, that they shall say, This is his wife: and they will kill me, but they will save thee alive.
bsb_text: and when the Egyptians see you, they will say, ‘This is his wife.’ Then they will kill me but will let you live.
aov_text: As die Egiptenaars jou nou sien, sal hulle sê: Dit is sy vrou—en hulle sal my doodmaak en jou laat lewe.

kjv_text: Say, I pray thee, thou art my sister: that it may be well with me for thy sake; and my soul shall live because of thee.
bsb_text: Please say you are my sister, so that I will be treated well for your sake, and on account of you my life will be spared.”
aov_text: Sê tog jy is my suster, dat dit met my goed kan gaan ter wille van jou en ek om jou ontwil in die lewe kan bly.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, that, when Abram was come into Egypt, the Egyptians beheld the woman that she was very fair.
bsb_text: So when Abram entered Egypt, the Egyptians saw that the woman was very beautiful.
aov_text: Toe Abram dan in Egipte gekom het, sien die Egiptenaars dat die vrou baie mooi was.

kjv_text: The princes also of Pharaoh saw her, and commended her before Pharaoh: and the woman was taken into Pharaoh's house.
bsb_text: When Pharaoh’s officials saw Sarai, they commended her to him, and she was taken into the palace of Pharaoh.
aov_text: Ook het die vorste van Farao haar gesien en haar by Farao geprys. En die vrou is na die paleis van Farao geneem.

kjv_text: And he entreated Abram well for her sake: and he had sheep, and oxen, and he asses, and menservants, and maidservants, and she asses, and camels.
bsb_text: He treated Abram well on her account, and Abram acquired sheep and cattle, male and female donkeys, menservants and maidservants, and camels.
aov_text: En hy het goed gedoen aan Abram om haar ontwil, sodat hy kleinvee en beeste en esels, slawe en slavinne, eselinne en kamele in besit gekry het.

kjv_text: And the LORD plagued Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai Abram's wife.
bsb_text: The LORD, however, afflicted Pharaoh and his household with severe plagues because of Abram’s wife Sarai.
aov_text: Maar die HERE het Farao en sy huis met groot plae besoek ter wille van Sarai, die vrou van Abram.

kjv_text: And Pharaoh called Abram, and said, What is this that thou hast done unto me? why didst thou not tell me that she was thy wife?
bsb_text: So Pharaoh summoned Abram and asked, “What have you done to me? Why didn’t you tell me she was your wife?
aov_text: Daarop laat Farao Abram roep en hy sê: Wat het jy my nou aangedoen? Waarom het jy my nie te kenne gegee dat sy jou vrou is nie?

kjv_text: Why saidst thou, She is my sister? so I might have taken her to me to wife: now therefore behold thy wife, take her, and go thy way.
bsb_text: Why did you say, ‘She is my sister,’ so that I took her as my wife? Now then, here is your wife. Take her and go!”
aov_text: Waarom het jy gesê: Sy is my suster—sodat ek haar vir my as vrou geneem het? Daar is jou vrou dan nou; neem haar en gaan weg.

kjv_text: And Pharaoh commanded his men concerning him: and they sent him away, and his wife, and all that he had.
bsb_text: Then Pharaoh gave his men orders concerning Abram, and they sent him away with his wife and all his possessions.
aov_text: En Farao het aan enkele manne aangaande hom bevel gegee, en hulle het hom weggebring met sy vrou en sy hele besitting.

kjv_text: And Abram went up out of Egypt, he, and his wife, and all that he had, and Lot with him, into the south.
bsb_text: So Abram went up out of Egypt into the Negev—he and his wife and all his possessions—and Lot was with him.
aov_text: SO het Abram dan uit Egipte na die Suidland opgetrek, hy met sy vrou en sy hele besitting, en Lot saam met hom.

kjv_text: And Abram was very rich in cattle, in silver, and in gold.
bsb_text: And Abram had become extremely wealthy in livestock and silver and gold.
aov_text: En Abram was baie ryk aan vee, aan silwer en goud.

kjv_text: And he went on his journeys from the south even to Bethel, unto the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Bethel and Hai;
bsb_text: From the Negev he journeyed from place to place toward Bethel, until he came to the place between Bethel and Ai where his tent had formerly been pitched,
aov_text: En hy het van plek tot plek uit die Suidland getrek tot by Bet-el, na die plek waar sy tent in die begin gestaan het, tussen Bet-el en Ai,

kjv_text: Unto the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first: and there Abram called on the name of the LORD.
bsb_text: to the site where he had built the altar. And there Abram called on the name of the LORD.
aov_text: na die plek van die altaar wat hy vroeër daar gebou het. En Abram het daar die Naam van die HERE aangeroep.

kjv_text: And Lot also, which went with Abram, had flocks, and herds, and tents.
bsb_text: Now Lot, who was traveling with Abram, also had flocks and herds and tents.
aov_text: En Lot, wat saam met Abram getrek het, het ook kleinvee en beeste en tente gehad.

kjv_text: And the land was not able to bear them, that they might dwell together: for their substance was great, so that they could not dwell together.
bsb_text: But the land was unable to support both of them while they stayed together, for they had so many possessions that they were unable to coexist.
aov_text: En die land kon hulle nie dra om saam te woon nie, want hulle besittings was groot, sodat hulle nie saam kon woon nie.

kjv_text: And there was a strife between the herdmen of Abram's cattle and the herdmen of Lot's cattle: and the Canaanite and the Perizzite dwelled then in the land.
bsb_text: And there was discord between the herdsmen of Abram and the herdsmen of Lot. At that time the Canaanites and the Perizzites were also living in the land.
aov_text: En daar het twis ontstaan tussen die veewagters van Abram en die veewagters van Lot. Ook het die Kanaäniete en Feresiete destyds in die land gewoon.

kjv_text: And Abram said unto Lot, Let there be no strife, I pray thee, between me and thee, and between my herdmen and thy herdmen; for we be brethren.
bsb_text: So Abram said to Lot, “Please let there be no contention between you and me, or between your herdsmen and my herdsmen. After all, we are brothers.
aov_text: Toe sê Abram vir Lot: Laat daar tog geen twis wees tussen my en jou, en tussen my wagters en jou wagters nie; ons is mos broers.

kjv_text: Is not the whole land before thee? separate thyself, I pray thee, from me: if thou wilt take the left hand, then I will go to the right; or if thou depart to the right hand, then I will go to the left.
bsb_text: Is not the whole land before you? Now separate yourself from me. If you go to the left, I will go to the right; if you go to the right, I will go to the left.”
aov_text: Lê die hele land nie voor jou oop nie? Skei jou tog van my af; gaan jy links, dan sal ek regs gaan, en gaan jy regs, dan sal ek links gaan.

kjv_text: And Lot lifted up his eyes, and beheld all the plain of Jordan, that it was well watered every where, before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, even as the garden of the LORD, like the land of Egypt, as thou comest unto Zoar.
bsb_text: And Lot looked out and saw that the whole plain of the Jordan, all the way to Zoar, was well watered like the garden of the LORD, like the land of Egypt. (This was before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah.)
aov_text: Toe slaan Lot sy oë op en sien dat die hele Jordaanstreek oral volop water het; voordat die HERE Sodom en Gomorra verwoes het, was dit in die rigting van Soar soos die tuin van die HERE, soos Egipteland.

kjv_text: Then Lot chose him all the plain of Jordan; and Lot journeyed east: and they separated themselves the one from the other.
bsb_text: So Lot chose the whole plain of the Jordan for himself and set out toward the east. And Abram and Lot parted company.
aov_text: En Lot het vir hom die hele Jordaanstreek gekies, en Lot het na die ooste getrek. So het hulle dan die een van die ander geskei.

kjv_text: Abram dwelled in the land of Canaan, and Lot dwelled in the cities of the plain, and pitched his tent toward Sodom.
bsb_text: Abram lived in the land of Canaan, but Lot settled in the cities of the plain and pitched his tent toward Sodom.
aov_text: Abram het bly woon in die land Kanaän, en Lot het gaan woon in die stede van die Jordaanstreek en sy tente tot by Sodom opgeslaan.

kjv_text: But the men of Sodom were wicked and sinners before the LORD exceedingly.
bsb_text: But the men of Sodom were wicked, sinning greatly against the LORD.
aov_text: En die manne van Sodom was sleg en groot sondaars voor die HERE.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Abram, after that Lot was separated from him, Lift up now thine eyes, and look from the place where thou art northward, and southward, and eastward, and westward:
bsb_text: After Lot had departed, the LORD said to Abram, “Now lift up your eyes from the place where you are, and look to the north and south and east and west,
aov_text: En die HERE sê vir Abram nadat Lot van hom geskei het: Slaan tog jou oë op en kyk van die plek waar jy staan, na die noorde en suide, na die ooste en weste;

kjv_text: For all the land which thou seest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed for ever.
bsb_text: for all the land that you see, I will give to you and your offspring forever.
aov_text: want die hele land wat jy sien, sal Ek aan jou gee en aan jou nageslag tot in ewigheid.

kjv_text: And I will make thy seed as the dust of the earth: so that if a man can number the dust of the earth, then shall thy seed also be numbered.
bsb_text: I will make your offspring like the dust of the earth, so that if one could count the dust of the earth, then your offspring could be counted.
aov_text: En Ek sal jou nageslag maak soos die stof van die aarde, sodat as iemand die stof van die aarde kan tel, jou nageslag ook getel kan word.

kjv_text: Arise, walk through the land in the length of it and in the breadth of it; for I will give it unto thee.
bsb_text: Get up and walk around the land, through its length and breadth, for I will give it to you.”
aov_text: Maak jou klaar, trek die land deur in sy lengte en sy breedte, want Ek sal dit aan jou gee.

kjv_text: Then Abram removed his tent, and came and dwelt in the plain of Mamre, which is in Hebron, and built there an altar unto the LORD.
bsb_text: So Abram moved his tent and went to live near the Oaks of Mamre at Hebron, where he built an altar to the LORD.
aov_text: Toe het Abram al verder tente opgeslaan en gaan woon by die terpentynbome van Mamre wat by Hebron is; en hy het daar vir die HERE ’n altaar gebou.

kjv_text: And it came to pass in the days of Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of nations;
bsb_text: In those days Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of Goiim
aov_text: EN in die dae van Ámrafel, die koning van Sínear, Aríog, die koning van Ellásar, Kedor-Laómer, die koning van Elam, en Tídeal, die koning van die nasies,

kjv_text: That these made war with Bera king of Sodom, and with Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, and Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela, which is Zoar.
bsb_text: went to war against Bera king of Sodom, Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (that is, Zoar).
aov_text: het hulle oorlog gevoer teen Bera, die koning van Sodom, en teen Birsa, die koning van Gomorra, Síneab, die koning van Adma, en Seméber, die koning van Sebóim, en teen die koning van Bela, dit is Soar.

kjv_text: All these were joined together in the vale of Siddim, which is the salt sea.
bsb_text: The latter five came as allies to the Valley of Siddim (that is, the Salt Sea).
aov_text: Hulle het almal hulle leërs verenig in die laagte Siddim, dit is die Soutsee.

kjv_text: Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.
bsb_text: For twelve years they had been subject to Chedorlaomer, but in the thirteenth year they rebelled.
aov_text: Twaalf jaar lank het hulle Kedor-Laómer toe al gedien, maar in die dertiende jaar het hulle opstandig geword.

kjv_text: And in the fourteenth year came Chedorlaomer, and the kings that were with him, and smote the Rephaims in Ashteroth Karnaim, and the Zuzims in Ham, and the Emims in Shaveh Kiriathaim,
bsb_text: In the fourteenth year, Chedorlaomer and the kings allied with him went out and defeated the Rephaites in Ashteroth-karnaim, the Zuzites in Ham, the Emites in Shaveh-kiriathaim,
aov_text: Toe kom Kedor-Laómer in die veertiende jaar, en die konings wat saam met hom was, en hulle verslaan die Refaïete in Ásterot-Karnaim en die Susiete in Ham en die Emiete in die vlakte van Kirjatáim

kjv_text: And the Horites in their mount Seir, unto Elparan, which is by the wilderness.
bsb_text: and the Horites in the area of Mount Seir, as far as El-paran, which is near the desert.
aov_text: en die Horiete op hulle gebergte Seïr, tot by El-Paran wat aan die woestyn lê.

kjv_text: And they returned, and came to Enmishpat, which is Kadesh, and smote all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, that dwelt in Hazezontamar.
bsb_text: Then they turned back to invade En-mishpat (that is, Kadesh), and they conquered the whole territory of the Amalekites, as well as the Amorites who lived in Hazazon-tamar.
aov_text: Daarop het hulle omgedraai en by En-Mispat, dit is Kades, gekom en die hele land van die Amalekiete verower en ook die Amoriete wat in Háseson-Tamar woon.

kjv_text: And there went out the king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, and the king of Admah, and the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (the same is Zoar;) and they joined battle with them in the vale of Siddim;
bsb_text: Then the king of Sodom, the king of Gomorrah, the king of Admah, the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (that is, Zoar) marched out and arrayed themselves for battle in the Valley of Siddim
aov_text: Toe trek die koning van Sodom uit en die koning van Gomorra en die koning van Adma en die koning van Sebóim en die koning van Bela, dit is Soar, en stel hulle in die laagte Siddim in slagorde teen hulle op,

kjv_text: With Chedorlaomer the king of Elam, and with Tidal king of nations, and Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar; four kings with five.
bsb_text: against Chedorlaomer king of Elam, Tidal king of Goiim, Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar—four kings against five.
aov_text: teen Kedor-Laómer, die koning van Elam, en Tídeal, die koning van die nasies, en Ámrafel, die koning van Sínear, en Aríog, die koning van Ellásar: vier konings teen vyf.

kjv_text: And the vale of Siddim was full of slimepits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and fell there; and they that remained fled to the mountain.
bsb_text: Now the Valley of Siddim was full of tar pits, and as the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, some men fell into the pits, but the survivors fled to the hill country.
aov_text: Maar die laagte Siddim was vol gate in die lymgrond; en toe die konings van Sodom en Gomorra wegvlug, het hulle daarin geval, en die wat oorgebly het, het na die gebergte gevlug.

kjv_text: And they took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their victuals, and went their way.
bsb_text: The four kings seized all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah and all their food, and they went on their way.
aov_text: En hulle het al die goed van Sodom en Gomorra en al hulle voedsel geneem en weggetrek.

kjv_text: And they took Lot, Abram's brother's son, who dwelt in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.
bsb_text: They also carried off Abram’s nephew Lot and his possessions, since Lot was living in Sodom.
aov_text: Hulle het ook Lot, Abram se broerskind, en al sy goed geneem en weggetrek—want hy was in Sodom woonagtig.

kjv_text: And there came one that had escaped, and told Abram the Hebrew; for he dwelt in the plain of Mamre the Amorite, brother of Eshcol, and brother of Aner: and these were confederate with Abram.
bsb_text: Then an escapee came and reported this to Abram the Hebrew. Now Abram was living near the Oaks of Mamre the Amorite, a brother of Eshcol and Aner, all of whom were bound by treaty to Abram.
aov_text: Toe kom daar een wat vrygeraak het, en vertel dit aan Abram, die Hebreër, wat woonagtig was by die terpentynbome van Mamre, die Amoriet, broer van Eskol en broer van Aner; en hulle was bondgenote van Abram.

kjv_text: And when Abram heard that his brother was taken captive, he armed his trained servants, born in his own house, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued them unto Dan.
bsb_text: And when Abram heard that his relative had been captured, he mobilized the 318 trained men born in his household, and they set out in pursuit as far as Dan.
aov_text: Toe Abram hoor dat sy broer as gevangene weggevoer is, het hy sy geoefende manne wat in sy huis gebore is, laat uittrek, driehonderd-en-agttien, en hulle tot by Dan agtervolg—

kjv_text: And he divided himself against them, he and his servants, by night, and smote them, and pursued them unto Hobah, which is on the left hand of Damascus.
bsb_text: During the night, Abram divided his forces and routed Chedorlaomer’s army, pursuing them as far as Hobah, north of Damascus.
aov_text: hy het hulle in die nag van verskillende kante aangeval, hy en sy dienaars, en hulle verslaan en hulle agtervolg tot by Hoba wat noord van Damaskus lê.

kjv_text: And he brought back all the goods, and also brought again his brother Lot, and his goods, and the women also, and the people.
bsb_text: He retrieved all the goods, as well as his relative Lot and his possessions, together with the women and the rest of the people.
aov_text: En hy het al die goed teruggebring, en ook sy broer Lot en sy goed teruggebring; en ook die vroue en die manskappe.

kjv_text: And the king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer, and of the kings that were with him, at the valley of Shaveh, which is the king's dale.
bsb_text: After Abram returned from defeating Chedorlaomer and the kings allied with him, the king of Sodom went out to meet him in the Valley of Shaveh (that is, the King’s Valley).
aov_text: Ná sy terugkoms van die oorwinning op Kedor-Laómer en die konings wat saam met hom was, het die koning van Sodom uitgetrek hom tegemoet na die laagte Sawe, dit is die Koningslaagte.

kjv_text: And Melchizedek king of Salem brought forth bread and wine: and he was the priest of the most high God.
bsb_text: Then Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine—since he was priest of God Most High—
aov_text: En Melgisédek, die koning van Salem, wat ’n priester van God, die Allerhoogste, was, het brood en wyn gebring

kjv_text: And he blessed him, and said, Blessed be Abram of the most high God, possessor of heaven and earth:
bsb_text: and he blessed Abram and said: “Blessed be Abram by God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth,
aov_text: en hom geseën en gesê: Geseënd is Abram deur God, die Allerhoogste, die Skepper van hemel en aarde.

kjv_text: And blessed be the most high God, which hath delivered thine enemies into thy hand. And he gave him tithes of all.
bsb_text: and blessed be God Most High, who has delivered your enemies into your hand.” Then Abram gave Melchizedek a tenth of everything.
aov_text: En geseënd is God, die Allerhoogste, wat u vyande in u hand gegee het. Toe gee hy hom die tiende van alles.

kjv_text: And the king of Sodom said unto Abram, Give me the persons, and take the goods to thyself.
bsb_text: The king of Sodom said to Abram, “Give me the people, but take the goods for yourself.”
aov_text: En die koning van Sodom sê vir Abram: Gee my die mense, maar neem die goed vir uself.

kjv_text: And Abram said to the king of Sodom, I have lift up mine hand unto the LORD, the most high God, the possessor of heaven and earth,
bsb_text: But Abram replied to the king of Sodom, “I have raised my hand to the LORD God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth,
aov_text: Toe antwoord Abram die koning van Sodom: Ek hef my hand op tot die HERE, God, die Allerhoogste, die Skepper van hemel en aarde,

kjv_text: That I will not take from a thread even to a shoelatchet, and that I will not take any thing that is thine, lest thou shouldest say, I have made Abram rich:
bsb_text: that I will not accept even a thread, or a strap of a sandal, or anything that belongs to you, lest you should say, ‘I have made Abram rich.’
aov_text: dat ek geen draad en geen skoenriem, ja, dat ek niks sal neem van alles wat uwe is nie, sodat u nie kan sê nie: Ek het Abram ryk gemaak.

kjv_text: Save only that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men which went with me, Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre; let them take their portion.
bsb_text: I will accept nothing but what my men have eaten and the share for the men who went with me—Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre. They may take their portion.”
aov_text: Niks vir my nie! Net wat die dienaars geëet het en die deel van die manne wat saam met my getrek het, Aner, Eskol en Mamre, laat dié hulle deel neem.

kjv_text: After these things the word of the LORD came unto Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not, Abram: I am thy shield, and thy exceeding great reward.
bsb_text: After these events, the word of the LORD came to Abram in a vision: “Do not be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your very great reward.”
aov_text: NÁ hierdie dinge het die woord van die HERE tot Abram gekom in ’n gesig en gesê: Vrees nie, Abram, Ek is vir jou ’n skild en jou loon is baie groot.

kjv_text: And Abram said, LORD God, what wilt thou give me, seeing I go childless, and the steward of my house is this Eliezer of Damascus?
bsb_text: But Abram replied, “O Lord GOD, what can You give me, since I remain childless, and the heir of my house is Eliezer of Damascus?”
aov_text: Toe vra Abram: Here HERE, wat sal U my gee, aangesien ek sonder kinders heengaan en die erfgenaam van my huis die Damaskéner Eliëser is?

kjv_text: And Abram said, Behold, to me thou hast given no seed: and, lo, one born in my house is mine heir.
bsb_text: Abram continued, “Behold, You have given me no offspring, so a servant in my household will be my heir.”
aov_text: Verder het Abram gesê: Aan my het U geen nageslag gegee nie; so sal dan die bediende van my huis my erfgenaam wees.

kjv_text: And, behold, the word of the LORD came unto him, saying, This shall not be thine heir; but he that shall come forth out of thine own bowels shall be thine heir.
bsb_text: Then the word of the LORD came to Abram, saying, “This one will not be your heir, but one who comes from your own body will be your heir.”
aov_text: Toe kom die woord van die HERE tot hom en sê: Hierdie een sal jou erfgenaam nie wees nie, maar die een wat uit jou liggaam sal voortkom, hy sal jou erfgenaam wees.

kjv_text: And he brought him forth abroad, and said, Look now toward heaven, and tell the stars, if thou be able to number them: and he said unto him, So shall thy seed be.
bsb_text: And the LORD took him outside and said, “Now look to the heavens and count the stars, if you are able.” Then He told him, “So shall your offspring be.”
aov_text: Daarop lei Hy hom uit na buite met die woorde: Kyk nou op na die hemel en tel die sterre as jy hulle kan tel. En Hy sê vir hom: So sal jou nageslag wees.

kjv_text: And he believed in the LORD; and he counted it to him for righteousness.
bsb_text: Abram believed the LORD, and it was credited to him as righteousness.
aov_text: En hy het in die HERE geglo; en Hy het hom dit tot geregtigheid gereken.

kjv_text: And he said unto him, I am the LORD that brought thee out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give thee this land to inherit it.
bsb_text: The LORD also told him, “I am the LORD, who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldeans to give you this land to possess.”
aov_text: Verder het Hy vir hom gesê: Ek is die HERE wat jou uitgelei het uit Ur van die Chaldeërs om jou hierdie land in besit te gee.

kjv_text: And he said, LORD God, whereby shall I know that I shall inherit it?
bsb_text: But Abram replied, “Lord GOD, how can I know that I will possess it?”
aov_text: En hy sê: Here HERE, waaraan sal ek weet dat ek dit in besit sal neem?

kjv_text: And he said unto him, Take me an heifer of three years old, and a she goat of three years old, and a ram of three years old, and a turtledove, and a young pigeon.
bsb_text: And the LORD said to him, “Bring Me a heifer, a goat, and a ram, each three years old, along with a turtledove and a young pigeon.”
aov_text: En Hy antwoord hom: Neem vir My ’n driejaaroud vers en ’n driejaaroud bokooi en ’n driejaaroud ram en ’n tortelduif en ’n jong duif.

kjv_text: And he took unto him all these, and divided them in the midst, and laid each piece one against another: but the birds divided he not.
bsb_text: So Abram brought all these to Him, split each of them down the middle, and laid the halves opposite each other. The birds, however, he did not cut in half.
aov_text: En hy het dit alles vir Hom gebring en dit middeldeur gedeel en die helftes teenoor mekaar gelê; maar die voëls het hy nie verdeel nie.

kjv_text: And when the fowls came down upon the carcases, Abram drove them away.
bsb_text: And the birds of prey descended on the carcasses, but Abram drove them away.
aov_text: Toe kom daar roofvoëls op die dooie diere af, maar Abram het hulle weggejaag.

kjv_text: And when the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell upon Abram; and, lo, an horror of great darkness fell upon him.
bsb_text: As the sun was setting, Abram fell into a deep sleep, and suddenly great terror and darkness overwhelmed him.
aov_text: En toe die son wou ondergaan, val daar ’n diepe slaap op Abram, en kyk, skrik en groot duisternis het hom oorval.

kjv_text: And he said unto Abram, Know of a surety that thy seed shall be a stranger in a land that is not theirs, and shall serve them; and they shall afflict them four hundred years;
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to Abram, “Know for certain that your descendants will be strangers in a land that is not their own, and they will be enslaved and mistreated four hundred years.
aov_text: Daarop sê Hy vir Abram: Weet vir seker dat jou nageslag vreemdelinge sal wees in die land wat aan hulle nie behoort nie; daar sal hulle diensbaar wees en verdruk word vierhonderd jaar lank.

kjv_text: And also that nation, whom they shall serve, will I judge: and afterward shall they come out with great substance.
bsb_text: But I will judge the nation they serve as slaves, and afterward they will depart with many possessions.
aov_text: Maar Ek sal ook die nasie oordeel aan wie hulle diensbaar moet wees, en daarna sal hulle uittrek met baie goed.

kjv_text: And thou shalt go to thy fathers in peace; thou shalt be buried in a good old age.
bsb_text: You, however, will go to your fathers in peace and be buried at a ripe old age.
aov_text: Maar jý sal na jou vaders gaan in vrede, jy sal in goeie ouderdom begrawe word.

kjv_text: But in the fourth generation they shall come hither again: for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet full.
bsb_text: In the fourth generation your descendants will return here, for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet complete.”
aov_text: En die vierde geslag sal hierheen terugkom, want die ongeregtigheid van die Amoriete is tot nog toe nie vol nie.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold a smoking furnace, and a burning lamp that passed between those pieces.
bsb_text: When the sun had set and darkness had fallen, behold, a smoking firepot and a flaming torch appeared and passed between the halves of the carcasses.
aov_text: En ná sononder, toe dit heeltemal donker was, gaan daar ’n rokende oond en vurige fakkel tussen dié stukke vleis deur.

kjv_text: In the same day the LORD made a covenant with Abram, saying, Unto thy seed have I given this land, from the river of Egypt unto the great river, the river Euphrates:
bsb_text: On that day the LORD made a covenant with Abram, saying, “To your descendants I have given this land—from the river of Egypt to the great River Euphrates—
aov_text: Op dié dag het die HERE met Abram ’n verbond gesluit en gesê: Aan jou nageslag gee Ek hierdie land, van die rivier van Egipte af tot by die groot rivier, die Eufraatrivier:

kjv_text: The Kenites, and the Kenizzites, and the Kadmonites,
bsb_text: the land of the Kenites, Kenizzites, Kadmonites,
aov_text: die Keniete en Kenissiete en Kadmoniete

kjv_text: And the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Rephaims,
bsb_text: Hittites, Perizzites, Rephaites,
aov_text: en Hetiete en Feresiete en Refaïete

kjv_text: And the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.
bsb_text: Amorites, Canaanites, Girgashites, and Jebusites.”
aov_text: en Amoriete en Kanaäniete en Girgasiete en Jebusiete.

kjv_text: Now Sarai Abram's wife bare him no children: and she had an handmaid, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.
bsb_text: Now Abram’s wife Sarai had borne him no children, but she had an Egyptian maidservant named Hagar.
aov_text: MAAR Sarai, die vrou van Abram, het vir hom geen kinders gebaar nie; en sy het ’n Egiptiese slavin gehad met die naam van Hagar.

kjv_text: And Sarai said unto Abram, Behold now, the LORD hath restrained me from bearing: I pray thee, go in unto my maid; it may be that I may obtain children by her. And Abram hearkened to the voice of Sarai.
bsb_text: So Sarai said to Abram, “Look now, the LORD has prevented me from bearing children. Please go to my maidservant; perhaps I can build a family by her.” And Abram listened to the voice of Sarai.
aov_text: En Sarai het vir Abram gesê: Jy weet, die HERE het my nie toegelaat om moeder te word nie. Gaan tog in by my slavin; miskien sal ek uit haar gebou word. En Abram het na Sarai geluister.

kjv_text: And Sarai Abram's wife took Hagar her maid the Egyptian, after Abram had dwelt ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to her husband Abram to be his wife.
bsb_text: So after he had lived in Canaan for ten years, his wife Sarai took her Egyptian maidservant Hagar and gave her to Abram to be his wife.
aov_text: Toe neem Sarai, die vrou van Abram, Hagar, die Egiptiese, haar slavin—nadat Abram tien jaar in die land Kanaän gewoon het—en gee haar aan haar man Abram om sy vrou te wees.

kjv_text: And he went in unto Hagar, and she conceived: and when she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.
bsb_text: And he slept with Hagar, and she conceived. But when Hagar realized that she was pregnant, she began to despise her mistress.
aov_text: En hy het by Hagar ingegaan, en sy het swanger geword. Maar toe sy sien dat sy swanger was, het haar meesteres veragtelik in haar oë geword.

kjv_text: And Sarai said unto Abram, My wrong be upon thee: I have given my maid into thy bosom; and when she saw that she had conceived, I was despised in her eyes: the LORD judge between me and thee.
bsb_text: Then Sarai said to Abram, “May the wrong done to me be upon you! I delivered my servant into your arms, and ever since she saw that she was pregnant, she has treated me with contempt. May the LORD judge between you and me.”
aov_text: En Sarai sê vir Abram: Die onreg my aangedoen, is op jou! Ek self het my slavin in jou skoot gegee, en nou dat sy sien dat sy swanger is, het ek veragtelik in haar oë geword. Laat die HERE oordeel tussen my en jou.

kjv_text: But Abram said unto Sarai, Behold, thy maid is in thy hand; do to her as it pleaseth thee. And when Sarai dealt hardly with her, she fled from her face.
bsb_text: “Here,” said Abram, “your servant is in your hands. Do whatever you want with her.” Then Sarai treated Hagar so harshly that she fled from her.
aov_text: En Abram antwoord Sarai: Daar is jou slavin in jou hand—doen met haar soos dit goed is in jou oë. Toe het Sarai haar sleg behandel, en sy het van haar af weggevlug.

kjv_text: And the angel of the LORD found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain in the way to Shur.
bsb_text: Now the angel of the LORD found Hagar by a spring of water in the desert—the spring along the road to Shur.
aov_text: En die Engel van die HERE het haar by ’n fontein in die woestyn gevind, by die fontein op pad na Sur,

kjv_text: And he said, Hagar, Sarai's maid, whence camest thou? and whither wilt thou go? And she said, I flee from the face of my mistress Sarai.
bsb_text: “Hagar, servant of Sarai,” he said, “where have you come from, and where are you going?” “I am running away from my mistress Sarai,” she replied.
aov_text: en gevra: Hagar, slavin van Sarai, waar kom jy vandaan, en waar gaan jy heen? En sy antwoord: Ek vlug van my meesteres Sarai af weg.

kjv_text: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, Return to thy mistress, and submit thyself under her hands.
bsb_text: So the angel of the LORD told her, “Return to your mistress and submit to her authority.”
aov_text: Toe sê die Engel van die HERE vir haar: Gaan terug na jou meesteres en verneder jou onder haar hande.

kjv_text: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, I will multiply thy seed exceedingly, that it shall not be numbered for multitude.
bsb_text: Then the angel added, “I will greatly multiply your offspring so that they will be too numerous to count.”
aov_text: Verder sê die Engel van die HERE vir haar: Ek sal jou nageslag grootliks vermeerder, sodat dit vanweë die menigte nie getel kan word nie.

kjv_text: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, Behold, thou art with child, and shalt bear a son, and shalt call his name Ishmael; because the LORD hath heard thy affliction.
bsb_text: The angel of the LORD proceeded: “Behold, you have conceived and will bear a son. And you shall name him Ishmael, for the LORD has heard your cry of affliction.
aov_text: Ook sê die Engel van die HERE vir haar: Kyk, jy is swanger en sal ’n seun baar, en jy moet hom Ismael noem, want die HERE het jou in jou ellende verhoor.

kjv_text: And he will be a wild man; his hand will be against every man, and every man's hand against him; and he shall dwell in the presence of all his brethren.
bsb_text: He will be a wild donkey of a man, and his hand will be against everyone, and everyone’s hand against him; he will live in hostility toward all his brothers.”
aov_text: En hý sal ’n wilde-esel van ’n mens wees: sy hand teen almal, en almal se hand teen hom! En hy sal teenoor al sy broers woon.

kjv_text: And she called the name of the LORD that spake unto her, Thou God seest me: for she said, Have I also here looked after him that seeth me?
bsb_text: So Hagar gave this name to the LORD who had spoken to her: “You are the God who sees me,” for she said, “Here I have seen the One who sees me!”
aov_text: Toe noem sy die Naam van die HERE wat met haar gespreek het: U is ’n God wat sien. Want sy het gesê: Het ek hier ook gesien na Hom wat my sien?

kjv_text: Wherefore the well was called Beerlahairoi; behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.
bsb_text: Therefore the well was called Beer-lahai-roi. It is located between Kadesh and Bered.
aov_text: Daarom noem hulle die put: Put van Lagai-Roï. Dit lê daar tussen Kades en Bered.

kjv_text: And Hagar bare Abram a son: and Abram called his son's name, which Hagar bare, Ishmael.
bsb_text: And Hagar bore Abram a son, and Abram gave the name Ishmael to the son she had borne.
aov_text: En Hagar het vir Abram ’n seun gebaar; en Abram het sy seun wat Hagar gebaar het, Ismael genoem.

kjv_text: And Abram was fourscore and six years old, when Hagar bare Ishmael to Abram.
bsb_text: Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore Ishmael to him.
aov_text: En Abram was ses-en-tagtig jaar oud toe Hagar Ismael vir Abram gebaar het.

kjv_text: And when Abram was ninety years old and nine, the LORD appeared to Abram, and said unto him, I am the Almighty God; walk before me, and be thou perfect.
bsb_text: When Abram was ninety-nine years old, the LORD appeared to him and said, “I am God Almighty. Walk before Me and be blameless.
aov_text: TOE Abram negen-en-negentig jaar oud was, het die HERE aan Abram verskyn en vir hom gesê: Ek is God, die Almagtige; wandel voor my aangesig, dan sal jy opreg wees.

kjv_text: And I will make my covenant between me and thee, and will multiply thee exceedingly.
bsb_text: I will establish My covenant between Me and you, and I will multiply you exceedingly.”
aov_text: En Ek wil my verbond sluit tussen My en jou, en jou buitengewoon vermeerder.

kjv_text: And Abram fell on his face: and God talked with him, saying,
bsb_text: Then Abram fell facedown, and God said to him,
aov_text: Toe val Abram op sy aangesig, en God het met hom gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: As for me, behold, my covenant is with thee, and thou shalt be a father of many nations.
bsb_text: “As for Me, this is My covenant with you: You will be the father of many nations.
aov_text: Wat My aangaan, kyk, my verbond is met jou, en jy sal die vader van ’n menigte van nasies word.

kjv_text: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram, but thy name shall be Abraham; for a father of many nations have I made thee.
bsb_text: No longer will you be called Abram, but your name will be Abraham, for I have made you a father of many nations.
aov_text: Daarom sal hulle jou nie meer Abram noem nie, maar jou naam sal wees Abraham, want Ek maak jou ’n vader van ’n menigte van nasies.

kjv_text: And I will make thee exceeding fruitful, and I will make nations of thee, and kings shall come out of thee.
bsb_text: I will make you exceedingly fruitful; I will make nations of you, and kings will descend from you.
aov_text: En Ek sal jou buitengewoon vrugbaar maak: Ek sal jou tot nasies maak, en konings sal uit jou voortkom.

kjv_text: And I will establish my covenant between me and thee and thy seed after thee in their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God unto thee, and to thy seed after thee.
bsb_text: I will establish My covenant as an everlasting covenant between Me and you and your descendants after you, to be your God and the God of your descendants after you.
aov_text: En Ek sal my verbond oprig tussen My en jou en jou nageslag ná jou in hulle geslagte as ’n ewige verbond, om vir jou ’n God te wees en vir jou nageslag ná jou.

kjv_text: And I will give unto thee, and to thy seed after thee, the land wherein thou art a stranger, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession; and I will be their God.
bsb_text: And to you and your descendants I will give the land where you are residing—all the land of Canaan—as an eternal possession; and I will be their God.”
aov_text: En Ek sal aan jou en jou nageslag ná jou die land van jou vreemdelingskap gee, die hele land Kanaän, as ’n ewige besitting; en Ek sal vir hulle ’n God wees.

kjv_text: And God said unto Abraham, Thou shalt keep my covenant therefore, thou, and thy seed after thee in their generations.
bsb_text: God also said to Abraham, “You must keep My covenant—you and your descendants in the generations after you.
aov_text: Verder het God aan Abraham gesê: Maar jý moet my verbond hou, jy en jou nageslag ná jou, van geslag tot geslag.

kjv_text: This is my covenant, which ye shall keep, between me and you and thy seed after thee; Every man child among you shall be circumcised.
bsb_text: This is My covenant with you and your descendants after you, which you are to keep: Every male among you must be circumcised.
aov_text: Dit is my verbond wat julle moet hou tussen My en julle en jou nageslag ná jou: Al wat manlik onder julle is, moet besny word—

kjv_text: And ye shall circumcise the flesh of your foreskin; and it shall be a token of the covenant betwixt me and you.
bsb_text: You are to circumcise the flesh of your foreskin, and this will be a sign of the covenant between Me and you.
aov_text: julle moet aan die vlees van julle voorhuid besny word, en dit sal ’n teken wees van die verbond tussen My en julle.

kjv_text: And he that is eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every man child in your generations, he that is born in the house, or bought with money of any stranger, which is not of thy seed.
bsb_text: Generation after generation, every male must be circumcised when he is eight days old, including those born in your household and those purchased from a foreigner—even those who are not your offspring.
aov_text: ’n Seuntjie van agt dae dan moet onder julle besny word, al wat manlik is in julle geslagte. Die wat in jou huis gebore is, en die wat van enige vreemdeling met geld gekoop is, wat nie van jou geslag is nie—

kjv_text: He that is born in thy house, and he that is bought with thy money, must needs be circumcised: and my covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.
bsb_text: Whether they are born in your household or purchased, they must be circumcised. My covenant in your flesh will be an everlasting covenant.
aov_text: die wat in jou huis gebore en wat met jou geld gekoop is, moet sekerlik besny word. So moet dan my verbond in julle vlees wees as ’n ewige verbond.

kjv_text: And the uncircumcised man child whose flesh of his foreskin is not circumcised, that soul shall be cut off from his people; he hath broken my covenant.
bsb_text: But if any male is not circumcised, he will be cut off from his people; he has broken My covenant.”
aov_text: En wat manlik is en die voorhuid het, wat nie aan die vlees van sy voorhuid besny is nie—dié siel moet uit sy volksgenote uitgeroei word: hy het my verbond verbreek.

kjv_text: And God said unto Abraham, As for Sarai thy wife, thou shalt not call her name Sarai, but Sarah shall her name be.
bsb_text: Then God said to Abraham, “As for Sarai your wife, do not call her Sarai, for her name is to be Sarah.
aov_text: Verder het God aan Abraham gesê: Sarai, jou vrou, moet jy nie Sarai noem nie, maar haar naam sal Sara wees.

kjv_text: And I will bless her, and give thee a son also of her: yea, I will bless her, and she shall be a mother of nations; kings of people shall be of her.
bsb_text: And I will bless her and will surely give you a son by her. I will bless her, and she will be the mother of nations; kings of peoples will descend from her.”
aov_text: En Ek sal haar seën en jou uit haar ook ’n seun gee; ja, Ek sal haar seën, sodat sy tot nasies sal word; konings van volke sal uit haar voortkom.

kjv_text: Then Abraham fell upon his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, Shall a child be born unto him that is an hundred years old? and shall Sarah, that is ninety years old, bear?
bsb_text: Abraham fell facedown. Then he laughed and said to himself, “Can a child be born to a man who is a hundred years old? Can Sarah give birth at the age of ninety?”
aov_text: Toe val Abraham op sy aangesig, en hy lag en sê in sy hart: Kan daar vir een wat honderd jaar oud is, ’n kind gebore word? Of kan Sara, wat negentig jaar oud is, baar?

kjv_text: And Abraham said unto God, O that Ishmael might live before thee!
bsb_text: And Abraham said to God, “O that Ishmael might live under Your blessing!”
aov_text: En Abraham sê aan God: Ag, mag Ismael lewe voor u aangesig!

kjv_text: And God said, Sarah thy wife shall bear thee a son indeed; and thou shalt call his name Isaac: and I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant, and with his seed after him.
bsb_text: But God replied, “Your wife Sarah will indeed bear you a son, and you are to name him Isaac. I will establish My covenant with him as an everlasting covenant for his descendants after him.
aov_text: Toe antwoord God: Voorwaar, jou vrou Sara sal vir jou ’n seun baar, en jy moet hom Isak noem; en Ek sal my verbond met hom oprig as ’n ewige verbond vir sy nageslag ná hom.

kjv_text: And as for Ishmael, I have heard thee: Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly; twelve princes shall he beget, and I will make him a great nation.
bsb_text: As for Ishmael, I have heard you, and I will surely bless him; I will make him fruitful and multiply him greatly. He will become the father of twelve rulers, and I will make him into a great nation.
aov_text: Ook wat Ismael aangaan, het Ek jou verhoor. Kyk, Ek seën hom en maak hom vrugbaar en vermeerder hom buitengewoon. Twaalf vorste sal hy verwek, en Ek sal hom ’n groot nasie maak.

kjv_text: But my covenant will I establish with Isaac, which Sarah shall bear unto thee at this set time in the next year.
bsb_text: But I will establish My covenant with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you at this time next year.”
aov_text: Maar my verbond sal Ek oprig met Isak wat Sara vir jou anderjaar op hierdie tyd sal baar.

kjv_text: And he left off talking with him, and God went up from Abraham.
bsb_text: When He had finished speaking with Abraham, God went up from him.
aov_text: En nadat Hy klaar met hom gespreek het, het God van Abraham af opgevaar.

kjv_text: And Abraham took Ishmael his son, and all that were born in his house, and all that were bought with his money, every male among the men of Abraham's house; and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the selfsame day, as God had said unto him.
bsb_text: On that very day Abraham took his son Ishmael and all those born in his household or purchased with his money—every male among the members of Abraham’s household—and he circumcised them, just as God had told him.
aov_text: Daarop neem Abraham sy seun Ismael en almal wat in sy huis gebore is, en almal wat met sy geld gekoop is, almal wat manlik was onder die mense in die huis van Abraham, en hy het die vlees van hulle voorhuid nog op daardie selfde dag besny, soos God met hom gespreek het.

kjv_text: And Abraham was ninety years old and nine, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
bsb_text: So Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he was circumcised,
aov_text: En Abraham was negen-en-negentig jaar oud toe hy aan die vlees van sy voorhuid besny is.

kjv_text: And Ishmael his son was thirteen years old, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
bsb_text: and his son Ishmael was thirteen;
aov_text: En sy seun Ismael was dertien jaar oud toe hy aan die vlees van sy voorhuid besny is.

kjv_text: In the selfsame day was Abraham circumcised, and Ishmael his son.
bsb_text: Abraham and his son Ishmael were circumcised on the same day.
aov_text: Op daardie selfde dag is Abraham en sy seun Ismael besny

kjv_text: And all the men of his house, born in the house, and bought with money of the stranger, were circumcised with him.
bsb_text: And all the men of Abraham’s household—both servants born in his household and those purchased from foreigners—were circumcised with him.
aov_text: en al die manne van sy huis—die wat in sy huis gebore en die wat van vreemdelinge met geld gekoop is, is saam met hom besny.

kjv_text: And the LORD appeared unto him in the plains of Mamre: and he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day;
bsb_text: Then the LORD appeared to Abraham by the Oaks of Mamre in the heat of the day, while he was sitting at the entrance of his tent.
aov_text: DAARNA het die HERE aan hom verskyn by die terpentynbome van Mamre tewyl hy by die ingang van die tent sit op die warmste van die dag.

kjv_text: And he lift up his eyes and looked, and, lo, three men stood by him: and when he saw them, he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself toward the ground,
bsb_text: And Abraham looked up and saw three men standing nearby. When he saw them, he ran from the entrance of his tent to meet them and bowed low to the ground.
aov_text: Toe hy sy oë opslaan en kyk, staan daar drie manne voor hom. En toe hy hulle sien, loop hy hulle tegemoet van die ingang van die tent af en buig hom na die aarde toe.

kjv_text: And said, My LORD, if now I have found favour in thy sight, pass not away, I pray thee, from thy servant:
bsb_text: “My lord,” said Abraham, “if I have found favor in your sight, please do not pass your servant by.
aov_text: En hy sê: My heer, as ek nou genade in u oë gevind het, gaan dan tog nie by u kneg verby nie.

kjv_text: Let a little water, I pray you, be fetched, and wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree:
bsb_text: Let a little water be brought, that you may wash your feet and rest yourselves under the tree.
aov_text: Laat hulle tog ’n bietjie water bring, en was u voete, en lê en rus onder die boom.

kjv_text: And I will fetch a morsel of bread, and comfort ye your hearts; after that ye shall pass on: for therefore are ye come to your servant. And they said, So do, as thou hast said.
bsb_text: And I will bring a bit of bread so that you may refresh yourselves. This is why you have passed your servant’s way. After that, you may continue on your way.” “Yes,” they replied, “you may do as you have said.”
aov_text: En laat ek ’n stukkie brood gaan haal, en versterk u hart—daarna kan u verder gaan—want daarom het u by u kneg aangekom. En hulle antwoord: Doen soos u gesê het.

kjv_text: And Abraham hastened into the tent unto Sarah, and said, Make ready quickly three measures of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes upon the hearth.
bsb_text: So Abraham hurried into the tent and said to Sarah, “Quick! Prepare three seahs of fine flour, knead it, and bake some bread.”
aov_text: Toe loop Abraham haastig in die tent na Sara en sê: Maak gou, knie drie mate meel, die beste, en maak roosterkoeke.

kjv_text: And Abraham ran unto the herd, and fetcht a calf tender and good, and gave it unto a young man; and he hasted to dress it.
bsb_text: Meanwhile, Abraham ran to the herd, selected a tender and choice calf, and gave it to a servant, who hurried to prepare it.
aov_text: Daarop loop Abraham na die beeste en vang ’n jong, mooi kalf en gee dit aan die dienaar, wat dit gou klaargemaak het.

kjv_text: And he took butter, and milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before them; and he stood by them under the tree, and they did eat.
bsb_text: Then Abraham brought curds and milk and the calf that had been prepared, and he set them before the men and stood by them under the tree as they ate.
aov_text: En hy neem dikmelk en soetmelk en die kalf wat hy klaargemaak het, en sit dit aan hulle voor, terwyl hy self by hulle onder die boom bly staan; en hulle het geëet.

kjv_text: And they said unto him, Where is Sarah thy wife? And he said, Behold, in the tent.
bsb_text: “Where is your wife Sarah?” they asked. “There, in the tent,” he replied.
aov_text: Toe sê hulle vir hom: Waar is Sara, u vrou? En hy antwoord: Daar in die tent.

kjv_text: And he said, I will certainly return unto thee according to the time of life; and, lo, Sarah thy wife shall have a son. And Sarah heard it in the tent door, which was behind him.
bsb_text: Then the LORD said, “I will surely return to you at this time next year, and your wife Sarah will have a son!” Now Sarah was behind him, listening at the entrance to the tent.
aov_text: En Hy sê: Ek sal oor ’n jaar sekerlik weer na jou toe kom—dan sal jou vrou Sara ’n seun hê. En Sara het geluister by die ingang van die tent wat agter Hom was.

kjv_text: Now Abraham and Sarah were old and well stricken in age; and it ceased to be with Sarah after the manner of women.
bsb_text: And Abraham and Sarah were already old and well along in years; Sarah had passed the age of childbearing.
aov_text: Maar Abraham en Sara was oud, ver op hulle dae; dit het met Sara nie meer volgens die reël van die vroue gegaan nie.

kjv_text: Therefore Sarah laughed within herself, saying, After I am waxed old shall I have pleasure, my lord being old also?
bsb_text: So she laughed to herself, saying, “After I am worn out and my master is old, will I now have this pleasure?”
aov_text: En Sara het by haarself gelag en gedink: Sal ek wellus hê nadat ek oud geword het en my heer oud is?

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Abraham, Wherefore did Sarah laugh, saying, Shall I of a surety bear a child, which am old?
bsb_text: And the LORD asked Abraham, “Why did Sarah laugh and say, ‘Can I really bear a child when I am old?’
aov_text: Toe sê die HERE vir Abraham: Waarom het Sara daar gelag en gedink: Sou ek ook werklik baar nou dat ek oud geword het?

kjv_text: Is any thing too hard for the LORD? At the time appointed I will return unto thee, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son.
bsb_text: Is anything too difficult for the LORD? At the appointed time I will return to you—in about a year—and Sarah will have a son.”
aov_text: Sou iets vir die HERE te wonderbaar wees? Hierdie tyd, oor ’n jaar, sal Ek na jou terugkom, en Sara sal ’n seun hê.

kjv_text: Then Sarah denied, saying, I laughed not; for she was afraid. And he said, Nay; but thou didst laugh.
bsb_text: But Sarah was afraid, so she denied it and said, “I did not laugh.” “No,” replied the LORD, “but you did laugh.”
aov_text: Maar Sara het dit ontken en gesê: Ek het nie gelag nie—want sy was bang. Maar Hy sê: Nee, maar jy het gelag.

kjv_text: And the men rose up from thence, and looked toward Sodom: and Abraham went with them to bring them on the way.
bsb_text: When the men got up to leave, they looked out over Sodom, and Abraham walked along with them to see them off.
aov_text: Toe staan die manne daarvandaan op, en hulle het gekyk na die kant van Sodom; en Abraham het saam met hulle gegaan om hulle weg te bring.

kjv_text: And the LORD said, Shall I hide from Abraham that thing which I do;
bsb_text: And the LORD said, “Shall I hide from Abraham what I am about to do?
aov_text: Daarop sê die HERE: Sal Ek vir Abraham verberg wat Ek gaan doen,

kjv_text: Seeing that Abraham shall surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth shall be blessed in him?
bsb_text: Abraham will surely become a great and powerful nation, and through him all the nations of the earth will be blessed.
aov_text: terwyl Abraham tog sekerlik ’n groot en magtige nasie sal word en al die nasies van die aarde in hom geseën sal word?

kjv_text: For I know him, that he will command his children and his household after him, and they shall keep the way of the LORD, to do justice and judgment; that the LORD may bring upon Abraham that which he hath spoken of him.
bsb_text: For I have chosen him, so that he will command his children and his household after him to keep the way of the LORD by doing what is right and just, in order that the LORD may bring upon Abraham what He has promised.”
aov_text: Want Ek het hom verkies, dat hy aan sy kinders en sy huis ná hom bevel sou gee dat hulle die weg van die HERE moet hou om geregtigheid en reg te doen; sodat die HERE oor Abraham kan bring wat Hy oor hom gespreek het.

kjv_text: And the LORD said, Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous;
bsb_text: Then the LORD said, “The outcry against Sodom and Gomorrah is great. Because their sin is so grievous,
aov_text: Verder het die HERE gesê: Die geroep oor Sodom en Gomorra is waarlik groot, en hulle sonde is waarlik baie swaar.

kjv_text: I will go down now, and see whether they have done altogether according to the cry of it, which is come unto me; and if not, I will know.
bsb_text: I will go down to see if their actions fully justify the outcry that has reached Me. If not, I will find out.”
aov_text: Ek wil neerdaal en sien of hulle werklik gehandel het soos die geroep oor hulle is wat by My gekom het; en so nie, Ek wil dit weet.

kjv_text: And the men turned their faces from thence, and went toward Sodom: but Abraham stood yet before the LORD.
bsb_text: And the two men turned away and went toward Sodom, but Abraham remained standing before the LORD.
aov_text: Toe het die manne daarvandaan weggedraai en na Sodom gegaan, maar Abraham het nog bly staan voor die aangesig van die HERE.

kjv_text: And Abraham drew near, and said, Wilt thou also destroy the righteous with the wicked?
bsb_text: Abraham stepped forward and said, “Will You really sweep away the righteous with the wicked?
aov_text: En Abraham het nader gekom en gesê: Sal U ook die regverdige saam met die goddelose ombring?

kjv_text: Peradventure there be fifty righteous within the city: wilt thou also destroy and not spare the place for the fifty righteous that are therein?
bsb_text: What if there are fifty righteous ones in the city? Will You really sweep it away and not spare the place for the sake of the fifty righteous ones who are there?
aov_text: Miskien is daar vyftig regverdiges binne-in die stad; sal U hulle ook ombring en die plek nie spaar ter wille van die vyftig regverdiges wat daarin is nie?

kjv_text: That be far from thee to do after this manner, to slay the righteous with the wicked: and that the righteous should be as the wicked, that be far from thee: Shall not the Judge of all the earth do right?
bsb_text: Far be it from You to do such a thing—to kill the righteous with the wicked, so that the righteous and the wicked are treated alike. Far be it from You! Will not the Judge of all the earth do what is right?”
aov_text: Laat dit ver van U wees om so iets te doen: om die regverdige saam met die goddelose om te bring, sodat die regverdige gelyk is met die goddelose. Laat dit ver van U wees! Sal die Regter van die ganse aarde geen reg doen nie?

kjv_text: And the LORD said, If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare all the place for their sakes.
bsb_text: So the LORD replied, “If I find fifty righteous ones within the city of Sodom, on their account I will spare the whole place.”
aov_text: Toe sê die HERE: As Ek in Sodom vyftig regverdiges vind binne-in die stad, dan sal Ek die hele plek spaar om hulle ontwil.

kjv_text: And Abraham answered and said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the LORD, which am but dust and ashes:
bsb_text: Then Abraham answered, “Now that I have ventured to speak to the Lord—though I am but dust and ashes—
aov_text: En Abraham antwoord en sê: Kyk tog, ek het dit gewaag om met die Here te spreek alhoewel ek stof en as is.

kjv_text: Peradventure there shall lack five of the fifty righteous: wilt thou destroy all the city for lack of five? And he said, If I find there forty and five, I will not destroy it.
bsb_text: suppose the fifty righteous ones lack five. Will You destroy the whole city for the lack of five?” He replied, “If I find forty-five there, I will not destroy it.”
aov_text: Miskien sal daar aan die vyftig regverdiges vyf ontbreek; sal U ter wille van vyf die hele stad verwoes? En Hy antwoord: Ek sal dit nie verwoes as Ek daar vyf-en-veertig vind nie.

kjv_text: And he spake unto him yet again, and said, Peradventure there shall be forty found there. And he said, I will not do it for forty's sake.
bsb_text: Once again Abraham spoke to the LORD, “Suppose forty are found there?” He answered, “On account of the forty, I will not do it.”
aov_text: En hy het nog verder met Hom gespreek en gesê: Miskien sal daar veertig gevind word. En Hy antwoord: Ek sal dit ter wille van die veertig nie doen nie.

kjv_text: And he said unto him, Oh let not the LORD be angry, and I will speak: Peradventure there shall thirty be found there. And he said, I will not do it, if I find thirty there.
bsb_text: Then Abraham said, “May the Lord not be angry, but let me speak further. Suppose thirty are found there?” He replied, “If I find thirty there, I will not do it.”
aov_text: Verder sê hy: Laat die Here tog nie toornig wees nie, en mag ek nog iets sê. Miskien sal daar dertig gevind word. En Hy antwoord: Ek sal dit nie doen as Ek daar dertig vind nie.

kjv_text: And he said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the LORD: Peradventure there shall be twenty found there. And he said, I will not destroy it for twenty's sake.
bsb_text: And Abraham said, “Now that I have ventured to speak to the Lord, suppose twenty are found there?” He answered, “On account of the twenty, I will not destroy it.”
aov_text: Toe sê hy: Kyk tog, ek het dit gewaag om met die Here te spreek. Miskien sal daar twintig gevind word. En Hy antwoord: Ek sal dit ter wille van die twintig nie verwoes nie.

kjv_text: And he said, Oh let not the LORD be angry, and I will speak yet but this once: Peradventure ten shall be found there. And he said, I will not destroy it for ten's sake.
bsb_text: Finally, Abraham said, “May the Lord not be angry, but let me speak once more. Suppose ten are found there?” And He answered, “On account of the ten, I will not destroy it.”
aov_text: Toe sê hy: Laat die Here tog nie toornig wees nie, en laat my net hierdie keer mag spreek. Miskien sal daar tien gevind word. En Hy antwoord: Ek sal dit ter wille van die tien nie verwoes nie.

kjv_text: And the LORD went his way, as soon as he had left communing with Abraham: and Abraham returned unto his place.
bsb_text: When the LORD had finished speaking with Abraham, He departed, and Abraham returned home.
aov_text: En die HERE het weggegaan toe Hy opgehou het om met Abraham te spreek, en Abraham het na sy woonplek teruggekeer.

kjv_text: And there came two angels to Sodom at even; and Lot sat in the gate of Sodom: and Lot seeing them rose up to meet them; and he bowed himself with his face toward the ground;
bsb_text: Now the two angels arrived at Sodom in the evening, and Lot was sitting in the gateway of the city. When Lot saw them, he got up to meet them, bowed facedown,
aov_text: EN die twee engele het in die aand in Sodom aangekom, terwyl Lot in die poort van Sodom sit; en toe Lot hulle sien, het hy opgestaan om hulle tegemoet te gaan en hom gebuig met die aangesig na die aarde toe

kjv_text: And he said, Behold now, my lords, turn in, I pray you, into your servant's house, and tarry all night, and wash your feet, and ye shall rise up early, and go on your ways. And they said, Nay; but we will abide in the street all night.
bsb_text: and said, “My lords, please turn aside into the house of your servant; wash your feet and spend the night. Then you can rise early and go on your way.” “No,” they answered, “we will spend the night in the square.”
aov_text: en gesê: Kyk tog, my here, draai tog uit na die huis van u dienaar en bly die nag oor en was u voete; dan kan u vroeg opstaan en u reis voortsit. Maar hulle antwoord: Nee, ons sal op die plein vernag.

kjv_text: And he pressed upon them greatly; and they turned in unto him, and entered into his house; and he made them a feast, and did bake unleavened bread, and they did eat.
bsb_text: But Lot insisted so strongly that they followed him into his house. He prepared a feast for them and baked unleavened bread, and they ate.
aov_text: Maar hy het baie by hulle aangehou, sodat hulle na hom uitgedraai en in sy huis gekom het. En hy het vir hulle ’n maaltyd berei en ongesuurde koeke gebak, en hulle het geëet.

kjv_text: But before they lay down, the men of the city, even the men of Sodom, compassed the house round, both old and young, all the people from every quarter:
bsb_text: Before they had gone to bed, all the men of the city of Sodom, both young and old, surrounded the house.
aov_text: Hulle het nog nie gaan slaap nie toe die manne van die stad, die manne van Sodom, die huis omsingel: jonk en oud, die hele bevolking, almal saam.

kjv_text: And they called unto Lot, and said unto him, Where are the men which came in to thee this night? bring them out unto us, that we may know them.
bsb_text: They called out to Lot, saying, “Where are the men who came to you tonight? Send them out to us so we can have relations with them!”
aov_text: En hulle het na Lot geroep en aan hom gesê: Waar is die manne wat vannag na jou gekom het? Bring hulle na ons toe uit, dat ons hulle kan beken.

kjv_text: And Lot went out at the door unto them, and shut the door after him,
bsb_text: Lot went outside to meet them, shutting the door behind him.
aov_text: Daarop gaan Lot na hulle toe uit voor die ingang en sluit die deur agter hom toe

kjv_text: And said, I pray you, brethren, do not so wickedly.
bsb_text: “Please, my brothers,” he pleaded, “don’t do such a wicked thing!
aov_text: en sê: My broers, moet tog nie kwaad doen nie.

kjv_text: Behold now, I have two daughters which have not known man; let me, I pray you, bring them out unto you, and do ye to them as is good in your eyes: only unto these men do nothing; for therefore came they under the shadow of my roof.
bsb_text: Look, I have two daughters who have never slept with a man. Let me bring them to you, and you can do to them as you please. But do not do anything to these men, for they have come under the protection of my roof.”
aov_text: Kyk tog, ek het twee dogters wat geen man beken het nie; laat ek dié na julle uitbring, en doen met hulle soos dit goed is in julle oë. Net aan hierdie manne moet julle niks doen nie, want daarom het hulle onder die skaduwee van my dak ingekom.

kjv_text: And they said, Stand back. And they said again, This one fellow came in to sojourn, and he will needs be a judge: now will we deal worse with thee, than with them. And they pressed sore upon the man, even Lot, and came near to break the door.
bsb_text: “Get out of the way!” they replied. And they declared, “This one came here as a foreigner, and he is already acting like a judge! Now we will treat you worse than them.” And they pressed in on Lot and moved in to break down the door.
aov_text: Toe antwoord hulle: Gee pad daar! En hulle sê: Hierdie een het gekom om hier as vreemdeling te vertoef en wil tog gedurig die baas speel. Nou sal ons jou meer kwaad doen as aan hulle. En hulle het sterk op die man, op Lot, aangedring en nader gekom om die deur oop te breek.

kjv_text: But the men put forth their hand, and pulled Lot into the house to them, and shut to the door.
bsb_text: But the men inside reached out, pulled Lot into the house with them, and shut the door.
aov_text: Maar die manne het hulle hand uitgesteek en Lot by hulle in die huis gebring en die deur toegesluit.

kjv_text: And they smote the men that were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great: so that they wearied themselves to find the door.
bsb_text: And they struck the men at the entrance, young and old, with blindness, so that they wearied themselves trying to find the door.
aov_text: Toe slaan hulle die manne wat by die ingang van die huis was, klein en groot, met blindheid, sodat hulle tevergeefs na die ingang gesoek het.

kjv_text: And the men said unto Lot, Hast thou here any besides? son in law, and thy sons, and thy daughters, and whatsoever thou hast in the city, bring them out of this place:
bsb_text: Then the two men said to Lot, “Do you have anyone else here—a son-in-law, your sons or daughters, or anyone else in the city who belongs to you? Get them out of here,
aov_text: Daarop sê die manne vir Lot: Wie het jy hier nog? ’n Skoonseun en jou seuns en jou dogters en almal wat jy het in die stad—bring hulle uit die plek uit;

kjv_text: For we will destroy this place, because the cry of them is waxen great before the face of the LORD; and the LORD hath sent us to destroy it.
bsb_text: because we are about to destroy this place. For the outcry to the LORD against its people is so great that He has sent us to destroy it.”
