aov_text: want ons gaan hierdie plek verwoes, omdat die geroep oor hulle groot is voor die aangesig van die HERE, en die HERE het ons gestuur om dit te verwoes.

kjv_text: And Lot went out, and spake unto his sons in law, which married his daughters, and said, Up, get you out of this place; for the LORD will destroy this city. But he seemed as one that mocked unto his sons in law.
bsb_text: So Lot went out and spoke to the sons-in-law who were pledged in marriage to his daughters. “Get up,” he said. “Get out of this place, for the LORD is about to destroy the city!” But his sons-in-law thought he was joking.
aov_text: Toe gaan Lot uit en praat met sy skoonseuns wat met sy dogters sou trou, en sê: Maak julle klaar, gaan uit hierdie plek uit, want die HERE gaan die stad verwoes. Maar hy was in die oë van sy skoonseuns soos een wat gekskeer.

kjv_text: And when the morning arose, then the angels hastened Lot, saying, Arise, take thy wife, and thy two daughters, which are here; lest thou be consumed in the iniquity of the city.
bsb_text: At daybreak the angels hurried Lot along, saying, “Get up! Take your wife and your two daughters who are here, or you will be swept away in the punishment of the city.”
aov_text: En toe die dag begin breek, het die engele by Lot aangedring en gesê: Maak jou klaar, neem jou vrou en jou twee dogters wat by jou is, dat jy weens die ongeregtigheid van die stad nie omkom nie.

kjv_text: And while he lingered, the men laid hold upon his hand, and upon the hand of his wife, and upon the hand of his two daughters; the LORD being merciful unto him: and they brought him forth, and set him without the city.
bsb_text: But when Lot hesitated, the men grabbed his hand and the hands of his wife and his two daughters. And they led them safely out of the city, because of the LORD’s compassion for them.
aov_text: Maar hy het nog getalm. Toe gryp die manne hom en sy vrou en sy twee dogters aan die hand, omdat die HERE hom wou verskoon; en hulle lei hom uit en bring hom buitekant die stad.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when they had brought them forth abroad, that he said, Escape for thy life; look not behind thee, neither stay thou in all the plain; escape to the mountain, lest thou be consumed.
bsb_text: As soon as the men had brought them out, one of them said, “Run for your lives! Do not look back, and do not stop anywhere on the plain! Flee to the mountains, or you will be swept away!”
aov_text: En toe hulle hulle na buite uitgelei het, sê Hy: Vlug vir jou lewe! Moenie omkyk nie, en moenie êrens in die Jordaanstreek bly staan nie. Vlug na die gebergte, dat jy nie omkom nie!

kjv_text: And Lot said unto them, Oh, not so, my LORD:
bsb_text: But Lot replied, “No, my lords, please!
aov_text: Daarop antwoord Lot hulle: Ag nee, my Here!

kjv_text: Behold now, thy servant hath found grace in thy sight, and thou hast magnified thy mercy, which thou hast shewed unto me in saving my life; and I cannot escape to the mountain, lest some evil take me, and I die:
bsb_text: Your servant has indeed found favor in your sight, and you have shown me great kindness by sparing my life. But I cannot run to the mountains; the disaster will overtake me, and I will die.
aov_text: Kyk tog, u kneg het genade in u oë gevind, en U het u guns groot gemaak wat U aan my bewys het deur my in die lewe te behou. Maar ek is nie in staat om na die gebergte te vlug sonder dat die onheil my inhaal en ek sterwe nie.

kjv_text: Behold now, this city is near to flee unto, and it is a little one: Oh, let me escape thither, (is it not a little one?) and my soul shall live.
bsb_text: Look, there is a town nearby where I can flee, and it is a small place. Please let me flee there—is it not a small place? Then my life will be saved.”
aov_text: Kyk tog, hierdie stad is naby om daarheen te vlug, en dit is klein. Laat my tog daarheen vlug—is dit nie klein nie?—dat ek kan lewe!

kjv_text: And he said unto him, See, I have accepted thee concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow this city, for the which thou hast spoken.
bsb_text: “Very well,” he answered, “I will grant this request as well, and will not demolish the town you indicate.
aov_text: En Hy sê vir hom: Kyk, Ek neem jou ook in hierdie saak in guns aan, sodat Ek die stad waarvan jy gespreek het, nie sal omkeer nie.

kjv_text: Haste thee, escape thither; for I cannot do anything till thou be come thither. Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.
bsb_text: Hurry! Run there quickly, for I cannot do anything until you reach it.” That is why the town was called Zoar.
aov_text: Vlug gou daarheen, want Ek kan niks doen voordat jy daar aankom nie. Daarom noem hulle die stad Soar.

kjv_text: The sun was risen upon the earth when Lot entered into Zoar.
bsb_text: And by the time the sun had risen over the land, Lot had reached Zoar.
aov_text: Die son het oor die aarde opgegaan toe Lot in Soar aankom.

kjv_text: Then the LORD rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from the LORD out of heaven;
bsb_text: Then the LORD rained down sulfur and fire on Sodom and Gomorrah—from the LORD out of the heavens.
aov_text: En die HERE het swawel en vuur oor Sodom en Gomorra laat reën van die HERE uit die hemel,

kjv_text: And he overthrew those cities, and all the plain, and all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew upon the ground.
bsb_text: Thus He destroyed these cities and the entire plain, including all the inhabitants of the cities and everything that grew on the ground.
aov_text: en Hy het hierdie stede omgekeer en die hele Jordaanstreek, ook al die inwoners van die stede en wat op die grond groei.

kjv_text: But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.
bsb_text: But Lot’s wife looked back, and she became a pillar of salt.
aov_text: En sy vrou het agter hom omgekyk, en sy het ’n soutpilaar geword.

kjv_text: And Abraham gat up early in the morning to the place where he stood before the LORD:
bsb_text: Early the next morning, Abraham got up and returned to the place where he had stood before the LORD.
aov_text: En Abraham is vroeg in die môre na die plek waar hy voor die aangesig van die HERE gestaan het.

kjv_text: And he looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and beheld, and, lo, the smoke of the country went up as the smoke of a furnace.
bsb_text: He looked down toward Sodom and Gomorrah and all the land of the plain, and he saw the smoke rising from the land like smoke from a furnace.
aov_text: Toe hy uitkyk oor Sodom en Gomorra en oor die hele land van die Jordaanstreek, sien hy dat die rook van die land optrek soos die rook van ’n smeltoond.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when God destroyed the cities of the plain, that God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in the which Lot dwelt.
bsb_text: So when God destroyed the cities of the plain, He remembered Abraham, and He brought Lot out of the catastrophe that destroyed the cities where he had lived.
aov_text: En onderwyl God die stede van die Jordaanstreek verwoes, het God aan Abraham gedink en Lot uitgelei uit die omkering toe Hy die stede omgekeer het waar Lot woonagtig was.

kjv_text: And Lot went up out of Zoar, and dwelt in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he feared to dwell in Zoar: and he dwelt in a cave, he and his two daughters.
bsb_text: Lot and his two daughters left Zoar and settled in the mountains—for he was afraid to stay in Zoar—where they lived in a cave.
aov_text: En Lot het uit Soar opgetrek en saam met sy twee dogters gaan woon op die gebergte, want hy was bang om in Soar te bly; daarom het hy saam met sy twee dogters in ’n spelonk gaan woon.

kjv_text: And the firstborn said unto the younger, Our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in unto us after the manner of all the earth:
bsb_text: One day the older daughter said to the younger, “Our father is old, and there is no man in the land to sleep with us, as is the custom over all the earth.
aov_text: En die oudste het aan die jongste gesê: Ons vader is oud, en daar is geen man in die land om, na die reël van die ganse aarde, by ons in te gaan nie.

kjv_text: Come, let us make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.
bsb_text: Come, let us get our father drunk with wine so we can sleep with him and preserve his line.”
aov_text: Kom, laat ons aan ons vader wyn gee om te drink en met hom gemeenskap hou, sodat ons deur ons vader ’n geslag in die lewe kan hou.

kjv_text: And they made their father drink wine that night: and the firstborn went in, and lay with her father; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.
bsb_text: So that night they got their father drunk with wine, and the firstborn went in and slept with her father; he was not aware when she lay down or when she got up.
aov_text: Hulle gee toe dié nag aan hulle vader wyn om te drink, en die oudste het gekom en met haar vader gemeenskap gehad sonder dat hy dit gewaar het toe sy gaan lê en toe sy opstaan.

kjv_text: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the firstborn said unto the younger, Behold, I lay yesternight with my father: let us make him drink wine this night also; and go thou in, and lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.
bsb_text: The next day the older daughter said to the younger, “Look, I slept with my father last night. Let us get him drunk with wine again tonight so you can go in and sleep with him and we can preserve our father’s line.”
aov_text: Die volgende dag sê die oudste aan die jongste: Kyk, ek het verlede nag met my vader gemeenskap gehad; laat ons hom vannag weer wyn gee om te drink; gaan dan in, hou met hom gemeenskap, dat ons deur ons vader ’n geslag in die lewe kan hou.

kjv_text: And they made their father drink wine that night also: and the younger arose, and lay with him; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.
bsb_text: So again that night they got their father drunk with wine, and the younger daughter went in and slept with him; he was not aware when she lay down or when she got up.
aov_text: Hulle gee toe dié nag weer aan hulle vader wyn om te drink, en die jongste het opgestaan en met hom gemeenskap gehad sonder dat hy dit gewaar het toe sy gaan lê en toe sy opstaan.

kjv_text: Thus were both the daughters of Lot with child by their father.
bsb_text: Thus both of Lot’s daughters became pregnant by their father.
aov_text: So het dan die twee dogters van Lot by hulle vader bevrug geword,

kjv_text: And the first born bare a son, and called his name Moab: the same is the father of the Moabites unto this day.
bsb_text: The older daughter gave birth to a son and named him Moab. He is the father of the Moabites of today.
aov_text: en die oudste het ’n seun gebaar en hom Moab genoem. Hy is die vader van die hedendaagse Moabiete.

kjv_text: And the younger, she also bare a son, and called his name Benammi: the same is the father of the children of Ammon unto this day.
bsb_text: The younger daughter also gave birth to a son, and she named him Ben-ammi. He is the father of the Ammonites of today.
aov_text: En die jongste het ook ’n seun gebaar en hom Ben-Ammi genoem. Hy is die vader van die hedendaagse Ammoniete.

kjv_text: And Abraham journeyed from thence toward the south country, and dwelled between Kadesh and Shur, and sojourned in Gerar.
bsb_text: Now Abraham journeyed from there to the region of the Negev and settled between Kadesh and Shur. While he was staying in Gerar,
aov_text: EN Abraham het daarvandaan weggetrek na die Suidland en gaan woon tussen Kades en Sur en in Gerar as vreemdeling vertoef.

kjv_text: And Abraham said of Sarah his wife, She is my sister: and Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.
bsb_text: Abraham said of his wife Sarah, “She is my sister.” So Abimelech king of Gerar had Sarah brought to him.
aov_text: En Abraham het van Sara, sy vrou, gesê: Sy is my suster. Toe laat Abiméleg, die koning van Gerar, Sara haal.

kjv_text: But God came to Abimelech in a dream by night, and said to him, Behold, thou art but a dead man, for the woman which thou hast taken; for she is a man's wife.
bsb_text: One night, however, God came to Abimelech in a dream and told him, “You are as good as dead because of the woman you have taken, for she is a married woman.”
aov_text: Maar God het in die nag by Abiméleg gekom in ’n droom en vir hom gesê: Kyk, jy sal sterwe ter wille van die vrou wat jy laat haal het, want sy is ’n getroude vrou.

kjv_text: But Abimelech had not come near her: and he said, LORD, wilt thou slay also a righteous nation?
bsb_text: Now Abimelech had not gone near her, so he replied, “Lord, would You destroy a nation even though it is innocent?
aov_text: Maar Abiméleg het nog nie naby haar gekom nie; daarom het hy gevra: Here, sal U ook ’n regverdige nasie ombring?

kjv_text: Said he not unto me, She is my sister? and she, even she herself said, He is my brother: in the integrity of my heart and innocency of my hands have I done this.
bsb_text: Didn’t Abraham tell me, ‘She is my sister’? And she herself said, ‘He is my brother.’ I have done this in the integrity of my heart and the innocence of my hands.”
aov_text: Het hy my nie self gesê nie: Sy is my suster? En sy het self ook gesê: Hy is my broer. In die onskuld van my hart en in die reinheid van my hande het ek dit gedoen.

kjv_text: And God said unto him in a dream, Yea, I know that thou didst this in the integrity of thy heart; for I also withheld thee from sinning against me: therefore suffered I thee not to touch her.
bsb_text: Then God said to Abimelech in the dream, “Yes, I know that you did this with a clear conscience, and so I have kept you from sinning against Me. That is why I did not let you touch her.
aov_text: Daarop antwoord God hom in die droom: Ek weet ook dat jy dit in die onskuld van jou hart gedoen het, en Ek self het jou daarvan teruggehou om nie teen My te sondig nie. Daarom het Ek jou nie toegelaat om haar aan te raak nie.

kjv_text: Now therefore restore the man his wife; for he is a prophet, and he shall pray for thee, and thou shalt live: and if thou restore her not, know thou that thou shalt surely die, thou, and all that are thine.
bsb_text: Now return the man’s wife, for he is a prophet; he will pray for you and you will live. But if you do not restore her, be aware that you will surely die—you and all who belong to you.”
aov_text: Gee dan nou die man se vrou terug, want hy is ’n profeet; en hy sal vir jou bid, dat jy kan lewe. Maar as jy haar nie teruggee nie, weet dan dat jy sekerlik sal sterwe, jy en almal wat aan jou behoort.

kjv_text: Therefore Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ears: and the men were sore afraid.
bsb_text: Early the next morning Abimelech got up and summoned all his servants; and when he described to them all that had happened, the men were terrified.
aov_text: Abiméleg is toe die môre vroeg op en het al sy dienaars geroep en die hele saak voor hulle ore vertel. Toe was die manne baie bang.

kjv_text: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said unto him, What hast thou done unto us? and what have I offended thee, that thou hast brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? thou hast done deeds unto me that ought not to be done.
bsb_text: Then Abimelech called Abraham and asked, “What have you done to us? How have I sinned against you, that you have brought such tremendous guilt upon me and my kingdom? You have done things to me that should not be done.”
aov_text: En Abiméleg het Abraham laat roep en hom gevra: Wat het jy ons aangedoen? En wat het ek teen jou gesondig, dat jy oor my en my koninkryk ’n groot sonde gebring het? Dinge wat nie mag gebeur nie, het jy my aangedoen.

kjv_text: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What sawest thou, that thou hast done this thing?
bsb_text: Abimelech also asked Abraham, “What prompted you to do such a thing?”
aov_text: Verder sê Abiméleg vir Abraham: Wat was jou bedoeling dat jy dit gedoen het?

kjv_text: And Abraham said, Because I thought, Surely the fear of God is not in this place; and they will slay me for my wife's sake.
bsb_text: Abraham replied, “I thought to myself, ‘Surely there is no fear of God in this place. They will kill me on account of my wife.’
aov_text: En Abraham antwoord: Ek het gedink daar is regtig geen vrees vir God in hierdie plek nie, sodat hulle my oor my vrou sal doodmaak.

kjv_text: And yet indeed she is my sister; she is the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.
bsb_text: Besides, she really is my sister, the daughter of my father—though not the daughter of my mother—and she became my wife.
aov_text: En sy is ook werklik my suster; sy is my vader se dogter, maar nie my moeder se dogter nie; en sy het my vrou geword.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when God caused me to wander from my father's house, that I said unto her, This is thy kindness which thou shalt shew unto me; at every place whither we shall come, say of me, He is my brother.
bsb_text: So when God had me journey from my father’s house, I said to Sarah, ‘This is how you can show your loyalty to me: Wherever we go, say of me, “He is my brother.”’”
aov_text: En toe God my uit die huis van my vader laat omswerf het, het ek aan haar gesê: Dit is die guns wat jy van jou kant aan my moet bewys—op elke plek waar ons kom, moet jy van my sê: Hy is my broer.

kjv_text: And Abimelech took sheep, and oxen, and menservants, and womenservants, and gave them unto Abraham, and restored him Sarah his wife.
bsb_text: So Abimelech brought sheep and cattle, menservants and maidservants, and he gave them to Abraham and restored his wife Sarah to him.
aov_text: Toe neem Abiméleg kleinvee en beeste, ook slawe en slavinne, en gee dit aan Abraham. Ook sy vrou Sara het hy aan hom teruggegee.

kjv_text: And Abimelech said, Behold, my land is before thee: dwell where it pleaseth thee.
bsb_text: And Abimelech said, “Look, my land is before you. Settle wherever you please.”
aov_text: En Abiméleg sê: Daar lê my land voor jou oop; woon waar dit goed is in jou oë.

kjv_text: And unto Sarah he said, Behold, I have given thy brother a thousand pieces of silver: behold, he is to thee a covering of the eyes, unto all that are with thee, and with all other: thus she was reproved.
bsb_text: And he said to Sarah, “See, I am giving your brother a thousand pieces of silver. It is your vindication before all who are with you; you are completely cleared.”
aov_text: En vir Sara sê hy: Hier gee ek aan jou broer duisend sikkels silwer. Kyk, dit is vir jou ’n bedekking van die oë met betrekking tot elkeen wat by jou is, sodat jy in elke opsig geregverdig is.

kjv_text: So Abraham prayed unto God: and God healed Abimelech, and his wife, and his maidservants; and they bare children.
bsb_text: Then Abraham prayed to God, and God healed Abimelech and his wife and his maidservants, so that they could again bear children—
aov_text: Toe het Abraham tot God gebid, en God het Abiméleg gesond gemaak; ook sy vrou en sy slavinne, sodat hulle kon baar.

kjv_text: For the LORD had fast closed up all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah Abraham's wife.
bsb_text: for on account of Abraham’s wife Sarah, the LORD had completely closed all the wombs in Abimelech’s household.
aov_text: Want die HERE het elke moederskoot van die huis van Abiméleg geheel en al toegesluit ter wille van Sara, die vrou van Abraham.

kjv_text: And the LORD visited Sarah as he had said, and the LORD did unto Sarah as he had spoken.
bsb_text: Now the LORD attended to Sarah as He had said, and the LORD did for Sarah what He had promised.
aov_text: EN die HERE het Sara besoek soos Hy beloof het; en die HERE het aan Sara gedoen soos Hy gespreek het:

kjv_text: For Sarah conceived, and bare Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.
bsb_text: So Sarah conceived and bore a son to Abraham in his old age, at the very time God had promised.
aov_text: Sara het bevrug geword en vir Abraham in sy ouderdom ’n seun gebaar op die bepaalde tyd wat God genoem het.

kjv_text: And Abraham called the name of his son that was born unto him, whom Sarah bare to him, Isaac.
bsb_text: And Abraham gave the name Isaac to the son Sarah bore to him.
aov_text: En Abraham het sy seun wat vir hom gebore is, wat Sara vir hom gebaar het, Isak genoem.

kjv_text: And Abraham circumcised his son Isaac being eight days old, as God had commanded him.
bsb_text: When his son Isaac was eight days old, Abraham circumcised him, as God had commanded him.
aov_text: En Abraham het sy seun Isak besny toe hy agt dae oud was, soos God hom beveel het.

kjv_text: And Abraham was an hundred years old, when his son Isaac was born unto him.
bsb_text: Abraham was a hundred years old when his son Isaac was born to him.
aov_text: En Abraham was honderd jaar oud toe sy seun Isak vir hom gebore is.

kjv_text: And Sarah said, God hath made me to laugh, so that all that hear will laugh with me.
bsb_text: Then Sarah said, “God has made me laugh, and everyone who hears of this will laugh with me.”
aov_text: En Sara het gesê: ’n Gelag het God my berei: elkeen wat dit hoor, sal oor my lag.

kjv_text: And she said, Who would have said unto Abraham, that Sarah should have given children suck? for I have born him a son in his old age.
bsb_text: She added, “Who would have told Abraham that Sarah would nurse children? Yet I have borne him a son in his old age.”
aov_text: Verder sê sy: Wie kon ooit aan Abraham voorspel het: Sara soog kinders? Want ek het ’n seun gebaar in sy ouderdom.

kjv_text: And the child grew, and was weaned: and Abraham made a great feast the same day that Isaac was weaned.
bsb_text: So the child grew and was weaned, and Abraham held a great feast on the day Isaac was weaned.
aov_text: En die kind het opgegroei en is gespeen. En Abraham het ’n groot maaltyd berei op die dag toe Isak gespeen is.

kjv_text: And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, which she had born unto Abraham, mocking.
bsb_text: But Sarah saw that the son whom Hagar the Egyptian had borne to Abraham was mocking her son,
aov_text: Toe sien Sara hoe die seun van Hagar, die Egiptiese slavin, wat sy vir Abraham gebaar het, spot;

kjv_text: Wherefore she said unto Abraham, Cast out this bondwoman and her son: for the son of this bondwoman shall not be heir with my son, even with Isaac.
bsb_text: and she said to Abraham, “Expel the slave woman and her son, for the slave woman’s son will never share in the inheritance with my son Isaac!”
aov_text: en sy sê aan Abraham: Jaag hierdie slavin en haar seun weg, want die seun van hierdie slavin mag nie saam met my seun Isak erwe nie.

kjv_text: And the thing was very grievous in Abraham's sight because of his son.
bsb_text: Now this matter distressed Abraham greatly because it concerned his son Ishmael.
aov_text: En die woord was baie verkeerd in die oë van Abraham vanweë sy seun.

kjv_text: And God said unto Abraham, Let it not be grievous in thy sight because of the lad, and because of thy bondwoman; in all that Sarah hath said unto thee, hearken unto her voice; for in Isaac shall thy seed be called.
bsb_text: But God said to Abraham, “Do not be distressed about the boy and your maidservant. Listen to everything that Sarah tells you, for through Isaac your offspring will be reckoned.
aov_text: Maar God het aan Abraham gesê: Laat dit nie verkeerd wees in jou oë ter wille van die seun en van jou slavin nie. Luister na Sara in alles wat sy van jou verlang, want deur Isak sal daar vir jou ’n nageslag genoem word.

kjv_text: And also of the son of the bondwoman will I make a nation, because he is thy seed.
bsb_text: But I will also make a nation of the slave woman’s son, because he is your offspring.”
aov_text: Maar Ek sal ook die seun van die slavin tot ’n nasie maak, omdat hy jou kind is.

kjv_text: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread, and a bottle of water, and gave it unto Hagar, putting it on her shoulder, and the child, and sent her away: and she departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba.
bsb_text: Early in the morning, Abraham got up, took bread and a skin of water, put them on Hagar’s shoulders, and sent her away with the boy. She left and wandered in the Wilderness of Beersheba.
aov_text: Toe is Abraham die môre vroeg op, en hy het brood en ’n sak met water geneem en dit aan Hagar gegee deur dit op haar skouer te sit, en ook die kind, en haar weggestuur. Sy het toe weggegaan en rondgedwaal in die woestyn van Berséba.

kjv_text: And the water was spent in the bottle, and she cast the child under one of the shrubs.
bsb_text: When the water in the skin was gone, she left the boy under one of the bushes.
aov_text: En toe die water in die sak op was, het sy die kind onder een van die bosse neergewerp

kjv_text: And she went, and sat her down over against him a good way off, as it were a bow shot: for she said, Let me not see the death of the child. And she sat over against him, and lift up her voice, and wept.
bsb_text: Then she went off and sat down nearby, about a bowshot away, for she said, “I cannot bear to watch the boy die!” And as she sat nearby, she lifted up her voice and wept.
aov_text: en geloop en op ’n afstand gaan sit so ver as ’n boog kan skiet; want sy het gesê: Ek wil die dood van die kind nie aansien nie. En sy het op ’n afstand gaan sit en haar stem verhef en geween.

kjv_text: And God heard the voice of the lad; and the angel of God called to Hagar out of heaven, and said unto her, What aileth thee, Hagar? fear not; for God hath heard the voice of the lad where he is.
bsb_text: Then God heard the voice of the boy, and the angel of God called to Hagar from heaven, “What is wrong, Hagar? Do not be afraid, for God has heard the voice of the boy where he lies.
aov_text: Toe hoor God die stem van die seun, en die Engel van God het na Hagar geroep uit die hemel en haar gevra: Wat is dit met jou, Hagar? Wees nie bevrees nie, want God het na die stem van die seun geluister op die plek waar hy is.

kjv_text: Arise, lift up the lad, and hold him in thine hand; for I will make him a great nation.
bsb_text: Get up, lift up the boy, and take him by the hand, for I will make him into a great nation.”
aov_text: Staan op, tel die seun op en hou hom vas met jou hand, want Ek sal hom ’n groot nasie maak.

kjv_text: And God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water; and she went, and filled the bottle with water, and gave the lad drink.
bsb_text: Then God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water. So she went and filled the skin with water and gave the boy a drink.
aov_text: Daarop het God haar oë geopen, en sy sien ’n put! En sy het geloop en die sak vol water gemaak en die seun laat drink.

kjv_text: And God was with the lad; and he grew, and dwelt in the wilderness, and became an archer.
bsb_text: And God was with the boy, and he grew up and settled in the wilderness and became a great archer.
aov_text: En God was met die seun; en hy het opgegroei en in die woestyn gewoon en ’n boogskutter geword:

kjv_text: And he dwelt in the wilderness of Paran: and his mother took him a wife out of the land of Egypt.
bsb_text: And while he was dwelling in the Wilderness of Paran, his mother got a wife for him from the land of Egypt.
aov_text: hy het in die woestyn Paran gewoon; en sy moeder het vir hom ’n vrou uit Egipteland geneem.

kjv_text: And it came to pass at that time, that Abimelech and Phichol the chief captain of his host spake unto Abraham, saying, God is with thee in all that thou doest:
bsb_text: At that time Abimelech and Phicol the commander of his army said to Abraham, “God is with you in all that you do.
aov_text: IN dié tyd het Abiméleg en Pigol, sy leërowerste, met Abraham gespreek en gesê: God is met jou in alles wat jy doen.

kjv_text: Now therefore swear unto me here by God that thou wilt not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son's son: but according to the kindness that I have done unto thee, thou shalt do unto me, and to the land wherein thou hast sojourned.
bsb_text: Now, therefore, swear to me here before God that you will not deal falsely with me or my children or descendants. Show to me and to the country in which you reside the same kindness that I have shown to you.”
aov_text: Sweer dan nou vir my hier by God dat jy met my en my kroos en my nageslag nie vals sal handel nie; dieselfde guns wat ek jou bewys het, moet jy aan my bewys en aan die land waarin jy as vreemdeling vertoef.

kjv_text: And Abraham said, I will swear.
bsb_text: And Abraham replied, “I swear it.”
aov_text: En Abraham antwoord: Ek sweer.

kjv_text: And Abraham reproved Abimelech because of a well of water, which Abimelech's servants had violently taken away.
bsb_text: But when Abraham complained to Abimelech about a well that Abimelech’s servants had seized,
aov_text: Maar Abraham het Abiméleg aangespreek oor ’n put wat die dienaars van Abiméleg met geweld geneem het.

kjv_text: And Abimelech said, I wot not who hath done this thing: neither didst thou tell me, neither yet heard I of it, but to day.
bsb_text: Abimelech replied, “I do not know who has done this. You did not tell me, so I have not heard about it until today.”
aov_text: Daarop antwoord Abiméleg: Ek weet nie wie dit gedoen het nie, en jy het my dit ook nie meegedeel nie, en ek het daar ook niks van gehoor nie as net vandag.

kjv_text: And Abraham took sheep and oxen, and gave them unto Abimelech; and both of them made a covenant.
bsb_text: So Abraham brought sheep and cattle and gave them to Abimelech, and the two men made a covenant.
aov_text: Toe neem Abraham kleinvee en beeste en gee dit aan Abiméleg; en hulle twee het ’n verbond gesluit;

kjv_text: And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.
bsb_text: Abraham separated seven ewe lambs from the flock,
aov_text: Abraham het naamlik die sewe ooilammers van die kleinvee eenkant uitgekeer.

kjv_text: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What mean these seven ewe lambs which thou hast set by themselves?
bsb_text: and Abimelech asked him, “Why have you set apart these seven ewe lambs?”
aov_text: Toe sê Abiméleg vir Abraham: Wat beteken hierdie sewe ooilammers wat jy uitgekeer het?

kjv_text: And he said, For these seven ewe lambs shalt thou take of my hand, that they may be a witness unto me, that I have digged this well.
bsb_text: He replied, “You are to accept the seven ewe lambs from my hand as my witness that I dug this well.”
aov_text: En hy antwoord: Die sewe ooilammers moet jy uit my hand aanneem, sodat dit vir my ’n getuienis kan wees dat ek hierdie put gegrawe het.

kjv_text: Wherefore he called that place Beersheba; because there they sware both of them.
bsb_text: So that place was called Beersheba, because it was there that the two of them swore an oath.
aov_text: Daarom noem hulle dié plek Berséba, omdat hulle twee daar gesweer het.

kjv_text: Thus they made a covenant at Beersheba: then Abimelech rose up, and Phichol the chief captain of his host, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.
bsb_text: After they had made the covenant at Beersheba, Abimelech and Phicol the commander of his army got up and returned to the land of the Philistines.
aov_text: So het hulle dan ’n verbond gesluit in Berséba. Daarna het Abiméleg en Pigol, sy leërowerste, klaargemaak en na die land van die Filistyne teruggegaan.

kjv_text: And Abraham planted a grove in Beersheba, and called there on the name of the LORD, the everlasting God.
bsb_text: And Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba, and there he called upon the name of the LORD, the Eternal God.
aov_text: En hy het ’n tamarisk in Berséba geplant en daar die Naam van die HERE, die ewige God, aangeroep.

kjv_text: And Abraham sojourned in the Philistines' land many days.
bsb_text: And Abraham resided in the land of the Philistines for a long time.
aov_text: En Abraham het baie dae as vreemdeling in die land van die Filistyne vertoef.

kjv_text: And it came to pass after these things, that God did tempt Abraham, and said unto him, Abraham: and he said, Behold, here I am.
bsb_text: Some time later God tested Abraham and said to him, “Abraham!” “Here I am,” he answered.
aov_text: NÁ hierdie dinge het God Abraham op die proef gestel en aan hom gesê: Abraham! En hy antwoord: Hier is ek!

kjv_text: And he said, Take now thy son, thine only son Isaac, whom thou lovest, and get thee into the land of Moriah; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.
bsb_text: “Take your son,” God said, “your only son Isaac, whom you love, and go to the land of Moriah. Offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains, which I will show you.”
aov_text: Toe sê Hy: Neem jou seun, jou enigste, wat jy liefhet, Isak, en gaan na die land Moría en offer hom daar as brandoffer op een van die berge wat Ek jou sal aanwys.

kjv_text: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and saddled his ass, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son, and clave the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went unto the place of which God had told him.
bsb_text: So Abraham got up early the next morning, saddled his donkey, and took along two of his servants and his son Isaac. He split the wood for a burnt offering and set out for the place God had designated.
aov_text: Daarop het Abraham die môre vroeg klaargemaak en sy esel opgesaal en twee van sy dienaars en sy seun Isak saam met hom geneem; en hy het hout gekloof vir ’n brandoffer en opgestaan en na die plek gegaan wat God hom aangewys het.

kjv_text: Then on the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place afar off.
bsb_text: On the third day Abraham looked up and saw the place in the distance.
aov_text: Op die derde dag toe slaan Abraham sy oë op en sien die plek van ver af.

kjv_text: And Abraham said unto his young men, Abide ye here with the ass; and I and the lad will go yonder and worship, and come again to you.
bsb_text: “Stay here with the donkey,” Abraham told his servants. “The boy and I will go over there to worship, and then we will return to you.”
aov_text: En Abraham sê aan sy dienaars: Bly julle hier met die esel; ek en die seun wil daarheen gaan om te aanbid en dan na julle terugkom.

kjv_text: And Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering, and laid it upon Isaac his son; and he took the fire in his hand, and a knife; and they went both of them together.
bsb_text: Abraham took the wood for the burnt offering and placed it on his son Isaac. He himself carried the fire and the sacrificial knife, and the two of them walked on together.
aov_text: En Abraham het die hout vir die brandoffer geneem en dit op sy seun Isak gesit, en die vuur en die mes in sy hand geneem. So het hulle twee dan saam geloop.

kjv_text: And Isaac spake unto Abraham his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I, my son. And he said, Behold the fire and the wood: but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?
bsb_text: Then Isaac said to his father Abraham, “My father!” “Here I am, my son,” he replied. “The fire and the wood are here,” said Isaac, “but where is the lamb for the burnt offering?”
aov_text: Toe spreek Isak met sy vader Abraham en sê: My vader! En hy antwoord: Hier is ek, my seun! En hy sê: Hier is die vuur en die hout, maar waar is die lam vir ’n brandoffer?

kjv_text: And Abraham said, My son, God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering: so they went both of them together.
bsb_text: Abraham answered, “God Himself will provide the lamb for the burnt offering, my son.” And the two walked on together.
aov_text: En Abraham antwoord: God sal vir Homself die lam vir ’n brandoffer voorsien, my seun. So het hulle twee dan saam geloop.

kjv_text: And they came to the place which God had told him of; and Abraham built an altar there, and laid the wood in order, and bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar upon the wood.
bsb_text: When they arrived at the place God had designated, Abraham built the altar there and arranged the wood. He bound his son Isaac and placed him on the altar, atop the wood.
aov_text: Toe hulle kom op die plek wat God hom aangewys het, het Abraham daar die altaar gebou en die hout reggelê; daarna het hy sy seun Isak gebind en hom op die altaar bo-op die hout gesit.

kjv_text: And Abraham stretched forth his hand, and took the knife to slay his son.
bsb_text: Then Abraham reached out his hand and took the knife to slaughter his son.
aov_text: Toe steek Abraham sy hand uit en neem die mes om sy seun te slag.

kjv_text: And the angel of the LORD called unto him out of heaven, and said, Abraham, Abraham: and he said, Here am I.
bsb_text: Just then the angel of the LORD called out to him from heaven, “Abraham, Abraham!” “Here I am,” he replied.
aov_text: Maar die Engel van die HERE het na hom van die hemel af geroep en gesê: Abraham, Abraham! En hy antwoord: Hier is ek!

kjv_text: And he said, Lay not thine hand upon the lad, neither do thou any thing unto him: for now I know that thou fearest God, seeing thou hast not withheld thy son, thine only son from me.
bsb_text: “Do not lay a hand on the boy or do anything to him,” said the angel, “for now I know that you fear God, since you have not withheld your only son from me.”
aov_text: En Hy sê: Moenie jou hand na die seun uitsteek nie, en doen hom niks nie; want nou weet Ek dat jy God vrees en jou seun, jou enigste, van My nie teruggehou het nie.

kjv_text: And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold behind him a ram caught in a thicket by his horns: and Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering in the stead of his son.
bsb_text: Then Abraham looked up and saw behind him a ram in a thicket, caught by its horns. So he went and took the ram and offered it as a burnt offering in place of his son.
aov_text: En toe Abraham sy oë opslaan, sien hy meteens ’n ram wat agter in die bos met sy horings vasgeraak het. En Abraham het gegaan en die ram geneem en dit as brandoffer in die plek van sy seun geoffer.

kjv_text: And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovahjireh: as it is said to this day, In the mount of the LORD it shall be seen.
bsb_text: And Abraham called that place The LORD Will Provide. So to this day it is said, “On the mountain of the LORD it will be provided.”
aov_text: En Abraham het dié plek genoem: Die HERE sal voorsien! Sodat vandag nog gesê word: Op die berg van die HERE sal dit voorsien word.

kjv_text: And the angel of the LORD called unto Abraham out of heaven the second time,
bsb_text: And the angel of the LORD called to Abraham from heaven a second time,
aov_text: Toe roep die Engel van die HERE vir die tweede keer na Abraham van die hemel af

kjv_text: And said, By myself have I sworn, saith the LORD, for because thou hast done this thing, and hast not withheld thy son, thine only son:
bsb_text: saying, “By Myself I have sworn, declares the LORD, that because you have done this and have not withheld your only son,
aov_text: en sê: Ek sweer by Myself, spreek die HERE, omdat jy dit gedoen het en jou seun, jou enigste, nie teruggehou het nie,

kjv_text: That in blessing I will bless thee, and in multiplying I will multiply thy seed as the stars of the heaven, and as the sand which is upon the sea shore; and thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies;
bsb_text: I will surely bless you, and I will multiply your descendants like the stars in the sky and the sand on the seashore. Your descendants will possess the gates of their enemies.
aov_text: dat Ek jou ryklik sal seën en jou nageslag grootliks sal vermeerder soos die sterre van die hemel en soos die sand wat aan die seestrand is; en jou nageslag sal die poort van sy vyande in besit neem.

kjv_text: And in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed; because thou hast obeyed my voice.
bsb_text: And through your offspring all nations of the earth will be blessed, because you have obeyed My voice.”
aov_text: En in jou nageslag sal al die nasies van die aarde geseën word, omdat jy na my stem geluister het.

kjv_text: So Abraham returned unto his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beersheba; and Abraham dwelt at Beersheba.
bsb_text: Abraham went back to his servants, and they got up and set out together for Beersheba. And Abraham settled in Beersheba.
aov_text: En Abraham het na sy dienaars teruggekeer; en hulle het klaargemaak en saam na Berséba gegaan. En Abraham het in Berséba bly woon.

kjv_text: And it came to pass after these things, that it was told Abraham, saying, Behold, Milcah, she hath also born children unto thy brother Nahor;
bsb_text: Some time later, Abraham was told, “Milcah has also borne sons to your brother Nahor:
aov_text: Ná hierdie dinge het hulle aan Abraham berig gebring en gesê: Kyk, Milka het ook vir jou broer Nahor seuns gebaar:

kjv_text: Huz his firstborn, and Buz his brother, and Kemuel the father of Aram,
bsb_text: Uz the firstborn, his brother Buz, Kemuel (the father of Aram),
aov_text: Us, sy eersgeborene, en Bus, sy broer, en Kémuel, die vader van Aram,

kjv_text: And Chesed, and Hazo, and Pildash, and Jidlaph, and Bethuel.
bsb_text: Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph, and Bethuel.”
aov_text: ook Kesed en Haso en Pildas en Jidlaf en Bétuel.

kjv_text: And Bethuel begat Rebekah: these eight Milcah did bear to Nahor, Abraham's brother.
bsb_text: And Bethuel became the father of Rebekah. Milcah bore these eight sons to Abraham’s brother Nahor.
aov_text: (En Bétuel was die vader van Rebekka.) Hierdie agt het Milka vir Nahor, die broer van Abraham, gebaar.

kjv_text: And his concubine, whose name was Reumah, she bare also Tebah, and Gaham, and Thahash, and Maachah.
bsb_text: Moreover, Nahor’s concubine, whose name was Reumah, bore Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.
aov_text: En sy byvrou met die naam van Reüma, sy het ook Tebag en Gaham en Tahas en Máäga gebaar.

kjv_text: And Sarah was an hundred and seven and twenty years old: these were the years of the life of Sarah.
bsb_text: Now Sarah lived to be 127 years old.
aov_text: EN die lewensdae van Sara was honderd-sewen-en-twintig jaar. Dit was die lewensjare van Sara.

kjv_text: And Sarah died in Kirjatharba; the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan: and Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.
bsb_text: She died in Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron) in the land of Canaan, and Abraham went out to mourn and to weep for her.
aov_text: En Sara het gesterwe in Kirjat-Arba, dit is Hebron, in die land Kanaän; en Abraham het gekom om oor Sara te rouklaag en haar te beween.

kjv_text: And Abraham stood up from before his dead, and spake unto the sons of Heth, saying,
bsb_text: Then Abraham got up from beside his dead wife and said to the Hittites,
aov_text: Daarna het Abraham opgestaan, van sy dode af weg, en met die seuns van Het gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: I am a stranger and a sojourner with you: give me a possession of a buryingplace with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.
bsb_text: “I am a foreigner and an outsider among you. Give me a burial site among you so that I can bury my dead.”
aov_text: Ek is ’n vreemdeling en bywoner onder julle. Gee my ’n graf as besitting by julle, dat ek my dode van my af weg kan begrawe.

kjv_text: And the children of Heth answered Abraham, saying unto him,
bsb_text: The Hittites replied to Abraham,
aov_text: Toe antwoord die seuns van Het vir Abraham en sê aan hom:

kjv_text: Hear us, my lord: thou art a mighty prince among us: in the choice of our sepulchres bury thy dead; none of us shall withhold from thee his sepulchre, but that thou mayest bury thy dead.
bsb_text: “Listen to us, sir. You are God’s chosen one among us. Bury your dead in the finest of our tombs. None of us will withhold his tomb for burying your dead.”
aov_text: Luister na ons, my heer! U is ’n vors van God onder ons. Begraaf u dode in die beste graf wat ons het; niemand van ons sal u sy graf weier om u dode te begrawe nie.

kjv_text: And Abraham stood up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, even to the children of Heth.
bsb_text: Then Abraham rose and bowed down before the people of the land, the Hittites.
aov_text: Toe staan Abraham op en buig hom voor die volk van die land, voor die seuns van Het;

kjv_text: And he communed with them, saying, If it be your mind that I should bury my dead out of my sight; hear me, and intreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,
bsb_text: “If you are willing for me to bury my dead,” he said to them, “listen to me, and approach Ephron son of Zohar on my behalf
aov_text: en hy het met hulle gespreek en gesê: As julle dit goedvind dat ek my dode van my af weg begrawe, luister dan na my en doen vir my ’n goeie woord by Efron, die seun van Sohar,

kjv_text: That he may give me the cave of Machpelah, which he hath, which is in the end of his field; for as much money as it is worth he shall give it me for a possession of a buryingplace amongst you.
bsb_text: to sell me the cave of Machpelah that belongs to him; it is at the end of his field. Let him sell it to me in your presence for full price, so that I may have a burial site.”
aov_text: dat hy aan my gee die spelonk van Magpéla wat aan hom behoort, wat aan die end van sy stuk grond lê; laat hy dit vir die volle som aan my gee, dat ek ’n graf onder julle mag besit.

kjv_text: And Ephron dwelt among the children of Heth: and Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the audience of the children of Heth, even of all that went in at the gate of his city, saying,
bsb_text: Now Ephron was sitting among the sons of Heth. So in the presence of all the Hittites who had come to the gate of his city, Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham,
aov_text: En Efron het tussen die seuns van Het gesit. Toe antwoord Efron, die Hetiet, vir Abraham voor die ore van die seuns van Het, van almal wat in die poort van sy stad ingegaan het:

kjv_text: Nay, my lord, hear me: the field give I thee, and the cave that is therein, I give it thee; in the presence of the sons of my people give I it thee: bury thy dead.
bsb_text: “No, my lord. Listen to me. I give you the field, and I give you the cave that is in it. I give it to you in the presence of my people. Bury your dead.”
aov_text: Nee, my heer, luister na my. Die stuk grond gee ek aan u; ook die spelonk wat daarin is, dit gee ek aan u; voor die oë van die seuns van my volk gee ek dit aan u; begraaf u dode.

kjv_text: And Abraham bowed down himself before the people of the land.
bsb_text: Again Abraham bowed down before the people of the land
aov_text: Daarop het Abraham hom voor die volk van die land neergebuig

kjv_text: And he spake unto Ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, But if thou wilt give it, I pray thee, hear me: I will give thee money for the field; take it of me, and I will bury my dead there.
bsb_text: and said to Ephron in their presence, “If you will please listen to me, I will pay you the price of the field. Accept it from me, so that I may bury my dead there.”
aov_text: en met Efron gespreek voor die ore van die volk van die land: Ja, as dit u is, ag, luister na my! Ek gee die geld vir die stuk grond; neem dit van my aan, dat ek my dode daar kan begrawe.

kjv_text: And Ephron answered Abraham, saying unto him,
bsb_text: Ephron answered Abraham,
aov_text: En Efron het Abraham geantwoord en aan hom gesê:

kjv_text: My lord, hearken unto me: the land is worth four hundred shekels of silver; what is that betwixt me and thee? bury therefore thy dead.
bsb_text: “Listen to me, my lord. The land is worth four hundred shekels of silver, but what is that between you and me? Bury your dead.”
aov_text: My heer, luister na my. ’n Stuk land van vierhonderd sikkels silwer—wat is dit tussen my en u? Begraaf maar u dode.

kjv_text: And Abraham hearkened unto Ephron; and Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver, which he had named in the audience of the sons of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, current money with the merchant.
bsb_text: Abraham agreed to Ephron’s terms and weighed out for him the price he had named in the hearing of the Hittites: four hundred shekels of silver, according to the standard of the merchants.
aov_text: Toe luister Abraham na Efron, en Abraham het aan Efron die geld afgeweeg waarvan hy gespreek het voor die ore van die seuns van Het—vierhonderd sikkels silwer gangbaar by die koopman.

kjv_text: And the field of Ephron, which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, and the cave which was therein, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all the borders round about, were made sure
bsb_text: So Ephron’s field at Machpelah near Mamre, the cave that was in it, and all the trees within the boundaries of the field were deeded over
aov_text: So het dan die stuk grond van Efron wat in Magpéla teenoor Mamre lê, die stuk grond en die spelonk wat daarin is, en al die bome op die stuk grond wat op die ganse gebied daarvan rondom staan,

kjv_text: Unto Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all that went in at the gate of his city.
bsb_text: to Abraham’s possession in the presence of all the Hittites who had come to the gate of his city.
aov_text: die eiendom van Abraham geword voor die oë van die seuns van Het, voor almal wat in die poort van sy stad ingegaan het.

kjv_text: And after this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre: the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan.
bsb_text: After this, Abraham buried his wife Sarah in the cave of the field at Machpelah near Mamre (that is, Hebron) in the land of Canaan.
aov_text: Daarna het Abraham toe sy vrou Sara begrawe in die spelonk van die stuk grond van Magpéla, oostelik van Mamre, dit is Hebron, in die land Kanaän.

kjv_text: And the field, and the cave that is therein, were made sure unto Abraham for a possession of a buryingplace by the sons of Heth.
bsb_text: So the field and its cave were deeded by the Hittites to Abraham as a burial site.
aov_text: So is dan die stuk grond en die spelonk wat daarin was, deur die seuns van Het aan Abraham afgestaan om dit as graf in eiendom te besit.

kjv_text: And Abraham was old, and well stricken in age: and the LORD had blessed Abraham in all things.
bsb_text: By now Abraham was old and well along in years, and the LORD had blessed him in every way.
aov_text: EN Abraham was oud en ver op sy dae, en die HERE het Abraham in alles geseën.

kjv_text: And Abraham said unto his eldest servant of his house, that ruled over all that he had, Put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh:
bsb_text: So Abraham instructed the chief servant of his household, who managed all he owned, “Place your hand under my thigh,
aov_text: Toe sê Abraham aan sy dienaar, die oudste van sy huis wat die opsig gehad het oor al sy goed: Lê tog jou hand onder my heup,

kjv_text: And I will make thee swear by the LORD, the God of heaven, and the God of the earth, that thou shalt not take a wife unto my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I dwell:
bsb_text: and I will have you swear by the LORD, the God of heaven and the God of earth, that you will not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites among whom I am dwelling,
aov_text: dat ek jou kan laat sweer by die HERE, die God van die hemel en die God van die aarde, dat jy vir my seun geen vrou sal neem uit die dogters van die Kanaäniete onder wie ek woon nie;

kjv_text: But thou shalt go unto my country, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son Isaac.
bsb_text: but will go to my country and my kindred to take a wife for my son Isaac.”
aov_text: maar dat jy na my land en my familie sal gaan om vir my seun Isak ’n vrou te neem.

kjv_text: And the servant said unto him, Peradventure the woman will not be willing to follow me unto this land: must I needs bring thy son again unto the land from whence thou camest?
bsb_text: The servant asked him, “What if the woman is unwilling to follow me to this land? Shall I then take your son back to the land from which you came?”
aov_text: Toe sê die dienaar vir hom: Miskien sal die vrou my nie wil volg na hierdie land nie. Moet ek u seun dan maar terugbring in die land waaruit u weggetrek het?

kjv_text: And Abraham said unto him, Beware thou that thou bring not my son thither again.
bsb_text: Abraham replied, “Make sure that you do not take my son back there.
aov_text: En Abraham antwoord hom: Neem jou tog in ag dat jy my seun nie weer daarheen bring nie.

kjv_text: The LORD God of heaven, which took me from my father's house, and from the land of my kindred, and which spake unto me, and that sware unto me, saying, Unto thy seed will I give this land; he shall send his angel before thee, and thou shalt take a wife unto my son from thence.
bsb_text: The LORD, the God of heaven, who brought me from my father’s house and my native land, who spoke to me and promised me on oath, saying, ‘To your offspring I will give this land’—He will send His angel before you so that you can take a wife for my son from there.
aov_text: Die HERE, die God van die hemel, wat my uit my vader se huis en uit my geboorteland weggeneem het, en wat met my gespreek en vir my gesweer het met die woorde: Aan jou nageslag sal Ek hierdie land gee—Hy sal sy engel voor jou uit stuur, en jy moet vir my seun daar ’n vrou gaan haal.

kjv_text: And if the woman will not be willing to follow thee, then thou shalt be clear from this my oath: only bring not my son thither again.
bsb_text: And if the woman is unwilling to follow you, then you are released from this oath of mine. Only do not take my son back there.”
aov_text: Maar as die vrou jou nie wil volg nie, dan is jy ontslae van hierdie eed aan my. Jy moet net my seun nie weer daarheen bring nie.

kjv_text: And the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and sware to him concerning that matter.
bsb_text: So the servant placed his hand under the thigh of his master Abraham and swore an oath to him concerning this matter.
aov_text: Toe lê die dienaar sy hand onder die heup van Abraham, sy heer, en hy het vir hom gesweer, met die oog op hierdie saak.

kjv_text: And the servant took ten camels of the camels of his master, and departed; for all the goods of his master were in his hand: and he arose, and went to Mesopotamia, unto the city of Nahor.
bsb_text: Then the servant took ten of his master’s camels and departed with all manner of good things from his master in hand. And he set out for Nahor’s hometown in Aram-naharaim.
aov_text: En die dienaar het tien kamele van die kamele van sy heer geneem en weggegaan met allerhande kosbare goed van sy heer by hom: hy het klaargemaak en na Mesopotámië, na die stad van Nahor, getrek.

kjv_text: And he made his camels to kneel down without the city by a well of water at the time of the evening, even the time that women go out to draw water.
bsb_text: As evening approached, he made the camels kneel down near the well outside the town at the time when the women went out to draw water.
aov_text: En hy het die kamele laat neerkniel buitekant die stad by ’n put, teen die aand, teen die tyd dat die vroue uitgaan om water te skep,

kjv_text: And he said, O LORD God of my master Abraham, I pray thee, send me good speed this day, and shew kindness unto my master Abraham.
bsb_text: “O LORD, God of my master Abraham,” he prayed, “please grant me success today, and show kindness to my master Abraham.
aov_text: en gesê: HERE, God van Abraham, my heer, laat ek haar tog vandag ontmoet, en bewys guns aan Abraham, my heer.

kjv_text: Behold, I stand here by the well of water; and the daughters of the men of the city come out to draw water:
bsb_text: Here I am, standing beside the spring, and the daughters of the townspeople are coming out to draw water.
aov_text: Hier staan ek by die fontein, terwyl die dogters van die manne van die stad uitkom om water te skep.

kjv_text: And let it come to pass, that the damsel to whom I shall say, Let down thy pitcher, I pray thee, that I may drink; and she shall say, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: let the same be she that thou hast appointed for thy servant Isaac; and thereby shall I know that thou hast shewed kindness unto my master.
bsb_text: Now may it happen that the girl to whom I say, ‘Please let down your jar that I may drink,’ and who responds, ‘Drink, and I will water your camels as well’—let her be the one You have appointed for Your servant Isaac. By this I will know that You have shown kindness to my master.”
aov_text: Laat dít nou tog gebeur: as die dogter aan wie ek sal sê: Hou tog jou kruik, dat ek kan drink, antwoord: Drink, en ek sal ook u kamele laat drink—dan is sy dit wat U bestem het vir u kneg Isak, en daaraan sal ek weet dat U guns aan my heer bewys het.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, before he had done speaking, that, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel, son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham's brother, with her pitcher upon her shoulder.
bsb_text: Before the servant had finished praying, Rebekah came out with her jar on her shoulder. She was the daughter of Bethuel son of Milcah, the wife of Abraham’s brother Nahor.
aov_text: Hy het nog nie klaar gespreek nie, of daar kom Rebekka uit wat vir Bétuel, die seun van Milka, die vrou van Nahor, Abraham se broer, gebore is, met haar kruik op haar skouer.

kjv_text: And the damsel was very fair to look upon, a virgin, neither had any man known her: and she went down to the well, and filled her pitcher, and came up.
bsb_text: Now the girl was very beautiful, a virgin who had not had relations with any man. She went down to the spring, filled her jar, and came up again.
aov_text: En die dogter was baie mooi van aansien, ’n jongmeisie, en geen man het haar beken nie. En sy het afgedaal na die fontein en haar kruik volgemaak en weer opgekom.

kjv_text: And the servant ran to meet her, and said, Let me, I pray thee, drink a little water of thy pitcher.
bsb_text: So the servant ran to meet her and said, “Please let me have a little water from your jar.”
aov_text: Toe loop die dienaar haar tegemoet en sê: Laat my tog ’n bietjie water uit jou kruik drink.

kjv_text: And she said, Drink, my lord: and she hasted, and let down her pitcher upon her hand, and gave him drink.
bsb_text: “Drink, my lord,” she replied, and she quickly lowered her jar to her hands and gave him a drink.
aov_text: En sy antwoord: Drink, my heer! Daarop laat sy gou haar kruik op haar hand afsak en laat hom drink.

kjv_text: And when she had done giving him drink, she said, I will draw water for thy camels also, until they have done drinking.
bsb_text: After she had given him a drink, she said, “I will also draw water for your camels, until they have had enough to drink.”
aov_text: Nadat sy hom genoeg laat drink het, sê sy: Ek sal vir u kamele ook skep totdat hulle genoeg gedrink het.

kjv_text: And she hasted, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again unto the well to draw water, and drew for all his camels.
bsb_text: And she quickly emptied her jar into the trough and ran back to the well to draw water, until she had drawn water for all his camels.
aov_text: Dadelik het sy toe haar kruik in die drinkbak leeggemaak en weer na die put geloop om te skep en vir al sy kamele geskep.

kjv_text: And the man wondering at her held his peace, to wit whether the LORD had made his journey prosperous or not.
bsb_text: Meanwhile, the man watched her silently to see whether or not the LORD had made his journey a success.
aov_text: En die man het haar stilswyend betrag om te weet of die HERE sy weg voorspoedig gemaak het of nie.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, as the camels had done drinking, that the man took a golden earring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold;
bsb_text: And after the camels had finished drinking, he took out a gold ring weighing a beka, and two gold bracelets for her wrists weighing ten shekels.
aov_text: En toe die kamele genoeg gedrink het, neem die man ’n goue ring, ’n halfsikkel in gewig, en twee armbande vir haar hande, tien sikkels goud in gewig.

kjv_text: And said, Whose daughter art thou? tell me, I pray thee: is there room in thy father's house for us to lodge in?
bsb_text: “Whose daughter are you?” he asked. “Please tell me, is there room in your father’s house for us to spend the night?”
aov_text: En hy sê: Wie se dogter is jy? Vertel my tog. Is daar plek vir ons in die huis van jou vader om te vernag?

kjv_text: And she said unto him, I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, which she bare unto Nahor.
bsb_text: She replied, “I am the daughter of Bethuel, the son that Milcah bore to Nahor.”
aov_text: Toe antwoord sy hom: Ek is die dogter van Bétuel, die seun van Milka wat sy vir Nahor gebaar het.

kjv_text: She said moreover unto him, We have both straw and provender enough, and room to lodge in.
bsb_text: Then she added, “We have plenty of straw and feed, as well as a place for you to spend the night.”
aov_text: Verder sê sy vir hom: Daar is ook strooi en voer in oorvloed by ons, ook plek om te vernag.

kjv_text: And the man bowed down his head, and worshipped the LORD.
bsb_text: Then the man bowed down and worshiped the LORD,
aov_text: Toe buig die man hom neer en aanbid die HERE

kjv_text: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of my master Abraham, who hath not left destitute my master of his mercy and his truth: I being in the way, the LORD led me to the house of my master's brethren.
bsb_text: saying, “Blessed be the LORD, the God of my master Abraham, who has not withheld His kindness and faithfulness from my master. As for me, the LORD has led me on the journey to the house of my master’s relatives.”
aov_text: met die woorde: Geloofd sy die HERE, die God van Abraham, my heer, wat sy goedertierenheid en sy trou aan my heer nie onttrek het nie. Wat my aangaan, die HERE het my op die weg gelei na die huis van die broers van my heer.

kjv_text: And the damsel ran, and told them of her mother's house these things.
bsb_text: The girl ran and told her mother’s household about these things.
aov_text: Daarna het die dogter geloop en in die huis van haar moeder vertel wat daar gebeur het.

kjv_text: And Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban: and Laban ran out unto the man, unto the well.
bsb_text: Now Rebekah had a brother named Laban, and he rushed out to the man at the spring.
aov_text: En Rebekka het ’n broer gehad met die naam van Laban, en Laban het uitgeloop na die man buite by die fontein.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when he saw the earring and bracelets upon his sister's hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, Thus spake the man unto me; that he came unto the man; and, behold, he stood by the camels at the well.
bsb_text: As soon as he saw the ring, and the bracelets on his sister’s wrists, and heard Rebekah’s words, “The man said this to me,” he went and found the man standing by the camels near the spring.
aov_text: Want toe hy die ring en die armbande aan die hande van sy suster sien en die woorde van sy suster Rebekka hoor, naamlik: So het die man met my gespreek—het hy na die man gegaan, terwyl hy nog daar staan by die kamele by die fontein,

kjv_text: And he said, Come in, thou blessed of the LORD; wherefore standest thou without? for I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.
bsb_text: “Come, you who are blessed by the LORD,” said Laban. “Why are you standing out here? I have prepared the house and a place for the camels.”
aov_text: en gesê: Kom in, geseënde van die HERE! Waarom staan jy buitekant terwyl ek die huis reggemaak het en ook plek vir die kamele?

kjv_text: And the man came into the house: and he ungirded his camels, and gave straw and provender for the camels, and water to wash his feet, and the men's feet that were with him.
bsb_text: So the man came to the house, and the camels were unloaded. Straw and feed were brought to the camels, and water to wash his feet and the feet of his companions.
aov_text: En die man het in die huis ingekom—die kamele is afgesaal en vir die kamele is strooi en voer gegee, en water om sy voete te was en die voete van die manne wat by hom was.

kjv_text: And there was set meat before him to eat: but he said, I will not eat, until I have told mine errand. And he said, Speak on.
bsb_text: Then a meal was set before the man, but he said, “I will not eat until I have told you what I came to say.” So Laban said, “Please speak.”
aov_text: Daarop het hulle ete voor hom neergesit; maar hy het gesê: Ek sal nie eet voordat ek my saak voorgedra het nie. En hy antwoord: Spreek maar.

kjv_text: And he said, I am Abraham's servant.
bsb_text: “I am Abraham’s servant,” he replied.
aov_text: Toe sê hy: Ek is die dienaar van Abraham.

kjv_text: And the LORD hath blessed my master greatly; and he is become great: and he hath given him flocks, and herds, and silver, and gold, and menservants, and maidservants, and camels, and asses.
bsb_text: “The LORD has greatly blessed my master, and he has become rich. He has given him sheep and cattle, silver and gold, menservants and maidservants, camels and donkeys.
aov_text: En die HERE het my heer baie geseën, sodat hy groot geword het, en aan hom kleinvee en beeste, silwer en goud, slawe en slavinne en kamele en esels gegee.

kjv_text: And Sarah my master's wife bare a son to my master when she was old: and unto him hath he given all that he hath.
bsb_text: My master’s wife Sarah has borne him a son in her old age, and my master has given him everything he owns.
aov_text: En Sara, die vrou van my heer, het vir my heer ’n seun gebaar nadat sy al oud was; en hy het aan hom alles oorgegee wat hy besit.

kjv_text: And my master made me swear, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife to my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I dwell:
bsb_text: My master made me swear an oath and said, ‘You shall not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites in whose land I dwell,
aov_text: En my heer het my laat sweer en gesê: Jy moet vir my seun geen vrou neem uit die dogters van die Kanaäniete in wie se land ek woon nie;

kjv_text: But thou shalt go unto my father's house, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son.
bsb_text: but you shall go to my father’s house and to my kindred to take a wife for my son.’
aov_text: maar jy moet gaan na die huis van my vader en na my geslag en vir my seun ’n vrou gaan haal.

kjv_text: And I said unto my master, Peradventure the woman will not follow me.
bsb_text: Then I asked my master, ‘What if the woman will not come back with me?’
aov_text: Toe het ek aan my heer gesê: Miskien sal die vrou my nie volg nie.

kjv_text: And he said unto me, The LORD, before whom I walk, will send his angel with thee, and prosper thy way; and thou shalt take a wife for my son of my kindred, and of my father's house:
bsb_text: And he told me, ‘The LORD, before whom I have walked, will send His angel with you and make your journey a success, so that you may take a wife for my son from my kindred and from my father’s house.
aov_text: Maar hy het my geantwoord: Die HERE voor wie se aangesig ek gewandel het, sal sy engel met jou saamstuur, en Hy sal jou weg voorspoedig maak, sodat jy vir my seun ’n vrou uit my geslag en uit die huis van my vader kan gaan haal.

kjv_text: Then shalt thou be clear from this my oath, when thou comest to my kindred; and if they give not thee one, thou shalt be clear from my oath.
bsb_text: And when you go to my kindred, if they refuse to give her to you, then you will be released from my oath.’
aov_text: Dan sal jy ontslae wees van die eed aan my: as jy by my geslag kom en hulle haar aan jou nie wil gee nie, dan is jy ontslae van die eed aan my.

kjv_text: And I came this day unto the well, and said, O LORD God of my master Abraham, if now thou do prosper my way which I go:
bsb_text: So when I came to the spring today, I prayed: O LORD, God of my master Abraham, if only You would make my journey a success!
aov_text: Ek het toe vandag by die fontein gekom en gesê: HERE, God van Abraham, my heer, as U dan my weg waar ek op gaan, voorspoedig wil maak—

kjv_text: Behold, I stand by the well of water; and it shall come to pass, that when the virgin cometh forth to draw water, and I say to her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water of thy pitcher to drink;
bsb_text: Here I am, standing beside this spring. Now if a maiden comes out to draw water and I say to her, ‘Please let me drink a little water from your jar,’
aov_text: ek staan hier by die fontein—laat dít nou tog gebeur: die jongmeisie wat uitkom om te skep en aan wie ek sal sê: Laat my tog ’n bietjie water uit jou kruik drink—

kjv_text: And she say to me, Both drink thou, and I will also draw for thy camels: let the same be the woman whom the LORD hath appointed out for my master's son.
bsb_text: and she replies, ‘Drink, and I will draw water for your camels as well,’ may she be the woman the LORD has appointed for my master’s son.

kjv_text: And before I had done speaking in mine heart, behold, Rebekah came forth with her pitcher on her shoulder; and she went down unto the well, and drew water: and I said unto her, Let me drink, I pray thee.
bsb_text: And before I had finished praying in my heart, there was Rebekah coming out with her jar on her shoulder, and she went down to the spring and drew water. So I said to her, ‘Please give me a drink.’
aov_text: Ek het nog nie klaar in my hart gespreek nie of daar het Rebekka uitgekom met haar kruik op die skouer en na die fontein afgedaal en geskep. Ek het toe vir haar gesê: Laat my tog drink!

kjv_text: And she made haste, and let down her pitcher from her shoulder, and said, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: so I drank, and she made the camels drink also.
bsb_text: She quickly lowered her jar from her shoulder and said, ‘Drink, and I will water your camels as well.’ So I drank, and she also watered the camels.
aov_text: En sy het dadelik haar kruik van haar laat afsak en gesê: Drink, en ek sal u kamele ook laat drink. En ek het gedrink, en sy het ook die kamele laat drink.

kjv_text: And I asked her, and said, Whose daughter art thou? And she said, The daughter of Bethuel, Nahor's son, whom Milcah bare unto him: and I put the earring upon her face, and the bracelets upon her hands.
bsb_text: Then I asked her, ‘Whose daughter are you?’ She replied, ‘The daughter of Bethuel son of Nahor, whom Milcah bore to him.’ So I put the ring on her nose and the bracelets on her wrists.
aov_text: Toe vra ek haar en sê: Wie se dogter is jy? En sy antwoord: Die dogter van Bétuel, die seun van Nahor wat Milka vir hom gebaar het. Daarop het ek die ring aan haar neus gesit en die armbande aan haar hande,

kjv_text: And I bowed down my head, and worshipped the LORD, and blessed the LORD God of my master Abraham, which had led me in the right way to take my master's brother's daughter unto his son.
bsb_text: Then I bowed down and worshiped the LORD; and I blessed the LORD, the God of my master Abraham, who led me on the right road to take the granddaughter of my master’s brother for his son.
aov_text: en ek het my in aanbidding neergebuig voor die HERE en die HERE geloof, die God van Abraham, my heer, wat my op die regte weg gelei het om die dogter van my heer se broer vir sy seun te gaan haal.

kjv_text: And now if ye will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me: and if not, tell me; that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.
bsb_text: Now if you will show kindness and faithfulness to my master, tell me; but if not, let me know, so that I may go elsewhere.”
aov_text: As julle dan nou guns en trou aan my heer wil bewys, sê dit vir my; en so nie, sê dit vir my, dat ek regs of links kan gaan.

kjv_text: Then Laban and Bethuel answered and said, The thing proceedeth from the LORD: we cannot speak unto thee bad or good.
bsb_text: Laban and Bethuel answered, “This is from the LORD; we have no choice in the matter.
aov_text: Toe antwoord Laban en Bétuel en sê: Van die HERE kom die saak; ons kan jou daar geen kwaad of goed van spreek nie.

kjv_text: Behold, Rebekah is before thee, take her, and go, and let her be thy master's son's wife, as the LORD hath spoken.
bsb_text: Rebekah is here before you. Take her and go, and let her become the wife of your master’s son, just as the LORD has decreed.”
aov_text: Daar staan Rebekka voor jou, neem haar en gaan heen, dat sy ’n vrou kan wees vir die seun van jou heer, soos die HERE gespreek het.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, that, when Abraham's servant heard their words, he worshipped the LORD, bowing himself to the earth.
bsb_text: When Abraham’s servant heard their words, he bowed down to the ground before the LORD.
aov_text: Toe die dienaar van Abraham hulle woorde hoor, het hy hom voor die HERE neergebuig na die aarde toe.

kjv_text: And the servant brought forth jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment, and gave them to Rebekah: he gave also to her brother and to her mother precious things.
bsb_text: Then he brought out jewels of silver and gold, and articles of clothing, and he gave them to Rebekah. He also gave precious gifts to her brother and her mother.
aov_text: Daarna het die dienaar silwer- en goue goed en klere uitgehaal en dit aan Rebekka gegee; ook aan haar broer en haar moeder het hy kosbare geskenke gegee.

kjv_text: And they did eat and drink, he and the men that were with him, and tarried all night; and they rose up in the morning, and he said, Send me away unto my master.
bsb_text: Then he and the men with him ate and drank and spent the night there. When they got up the next morning, he said, “Send me on my way to my master.”
aov_text: En hulle het geëet en gedrink, hy en die manne wat by hom was, en die nag oorgebly. Toe hulle die môre vroeg opgestaan het, sê hy: Laat my trek na my heer!

kjv_text: And her brother and her mother said, Let the damsel abide with us a few days, at the least ten; after that she shall go.
bsb_text: But her brother and mother said, “Let the girl remain with us ten days or so. After that, she may go.”
aov_text: Maar haar broer en haar moeder sê: Laat die dogter ’n dag of tien by ons bly; daarna kan jy heengaan.

kjv_text: And he said unto them, Hinder me not, seeing the LORD hath prospered my way; send me away that I may go to my master.
bsb_text: But he replied, “Do not delay me, since the LORD has made my journey a success. Send me on my way so that I may go to my master.”
aov_text: Maar hy antwoord hulle: Moet my nie ophou nie aangesien die HERE my weg voorspoedig gemaak het; laat my trek, dat ek na my heer kan gaan.

kjv_text: And they said, We will call the damsel, and enquire at her mouth.
bsb_text: So they said, “We will call the girl and ask her opinion.”
aov_text: Toe sê hulle: Laat ons die dogter roep en haar self vra.

kjv_text: And they called Rebekah, and said unto her, Wilt thou go with this man? And she said, I will go.
bsb_text: They called Rebekah and asked her, “Will you go with this man?” “I will go,” she replied.
aov_text: En hulle het Rebekka geroep en haar gevra: Wil jy met hierdie man saamgaan? En sy antwoord: Ja.

kjv_text: And they sent away Rebekah their sister, and her nurse, and Abraham's servant, and his men.
bsb_text: So they sent their sister Rebekah on her way, along with her nurse and Abraham’s servant and his men.
aov_text: Daarop het hulle Rebekka, hulle suster, en haar oppasser laat trek saam met die dienaar van Abraham en sy manne.

kjv_text: And they blessed Rebekah, and said unto her, Thou art our sister, be thou the mother of thousands of millions, and let thy seed possess the gate of those which hate them.
bsb_text: And they blessed Rebekah and said to her, “Our sister, may you become the mother of thousands upon thousands. May your offspring possess the gates of their enemies.”
aov_text: En hulle het Rebekka geseën en aan haar gesê: Ons suster, mag jy duisende van tienduisende word, en mag jou nageslag die poort van sy vyande in besit neem!

kjv_text: And Rebekah arose, and her damsels, and they rode upon the camels, and followed the man: and the servant took Rebekah, and went his way.
bsb_text: Then Rebekah and her servant girls got ready, mounted the camels, and followed the man. So the servant took Rebekah and left.
aov_text: Toe het Rebekka en haar diensmeisies hulle klaargemaak en op die kamele weggery en die man gevolg. So het die dienaar dan Rebekka saamgeneem en weggetrek.

kjv_text: And Isaac came from the way of the well Lahairoi; for he dwelt in the south country.
bsb_text: Now Isaac had just returned from Beer-lahai-roi, for he was living in the Negev.
aov_text: En Isak het uit die rigting van die put Lagai-Roï gekom; want hy het gaan woon in die Suidland.

kjv_text: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the eventide: and he lifted up his eyes, and saw, and, behold, the camels were coming.
bsb_text: Early in the evening, Isaac went out to the field to meditate, and looking up, he saw the camels approaching.
aov_text: En Isak het teen die aand uitgegaan om te peins in die veld. En toe hy sy oë opslaan, sien hy meteens kamele aankom.

kjv_text: And Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she lighted off the camel.
bsb_text: And when Rebekah looked up and saw Isaac, she got down from her camel
aov_text: Rebekka het ook haar oë opgeslaan en Isak gesien. Toe het sy van die kameel afgegly

kjv_text: For she had said unto the servant, What man is this that walketh in the field to meet us? And the servant had said, It is my master: therefore she took a vail, and covered herself.
bsb_text: and asked the servant, “Who is that man in the field coming to meet us?” “It is my master,” the servant answered. So she took her veil and covered herself.
aov_text: en aan haar dienaar gesê: Watter man is dit wat ons tegemoetloop in die veld? En die dienaar antwoord: Dit is my heer. Toe neem sy die sluier en bedek haar.

kjv_text: And the servant told Isaac all things that he had done.
bsb_text: Then the servant told Isaac all that he had done.
aov_text: Daarop het die dienaar aan Isak alles vertel wat hy gedoen het.

kjv_text: And Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah's tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife; and he loved her: and Isaac was comforted after his mother's death.
bsb_text: And Isaac brought her into the tent of his mother Sarah and took Rebekah as his wife. And Isaac loved her and was comforted after his mother’s death.
aov_text: En Isak het haar in die tent van sy moeder Sara ingebring en Rebekka geneem, en sy het sy vrou geword; en hy het haar liefgehad. So is Isak dan getroos ná die dood van sy moeder.

kjv_text: Then again Abraham took a wife, and her name was Keturah.
bsb_text: Now Abraham had taken another wife, named Keturah,
aov_text: EN Abraham het weer ’n vrou geneem met die naam van Ketúra.

kjv_text: And she bare him Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah.
bsb_text: and she bore him Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.
aov_text: En sy het vir hom Simran en Joksan en Medan en Mídian en Jisbak en Suag gebaar.

kjv_text: And Jokshan begat Sheba, and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were Asshurim, and Letushim, and Leummim.
bsb_text: Jokshan was the father of Sheba and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were the Asshurites, the Letushites, and the Leummites.
aov_text: En Joksan was die vader van Skeba en Dedan; en die kinders van Dedan was die Assuriete, Letusiete en Leümmiete.

kjv_text: And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Hanoch, and Abidah, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.
