bsb_text: The sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were descendants of Keturah.
aov_text: En die seuns van Mídian was: Efa en Efer en Henog en Abída en Eldaä. Hulle almal was seuns van Ketúra.

kjv_text: And Abraham gave all that he had unto Isaac.
bsb_text: Abraham left everything he owned to Isaac.
aov_text: En Abraham het aan Isak alles gegee wat hy besit het,

kjv_text: But unto the sons of the concubines, which Abraham had, Abraham gave gifts, and sent them away from Isaac his son, while he yet lived, eastward, unto the east country.
bsb_text: But while he was still alive, Abraham gave gifts to the sons of his concubines and sent them away from his son Isaac to the land of the east.
aov_text: maar aan die seuns van die byvroue van Abraham het Abraham geskenke gegee en hulle, nog by sy lewe, van sy seun Isak af oos laat wegtrek, na die Oosland.

kjv_text: And these are the days of the years of Abraham's life which he lived, an hundred threescore and fifteen years.
bsb_text: Abraham lived a total of 175 years.
aov_text: En dit is die dae van die lewensjare van Abraham wat hy geleef het: honderd-vyf-en-sewentig jaar.

kjv_text: Then Abraham gave up the ghost, and died in a good old age, an old man, and full of years; and was gathered to his people.
bsb_text: And at a ripe old age he breathed his last and died, old and contented, and was gathered to his people.
aov_text: Abraham het die asem uitgeblaas en in goeie ouderdom gesterwe, oud en afgeleef. En hy is by sy volksgenote versamel.

kjv_text: And his sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is before Mamre;
bsb_text: His sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah near Mamre, in the field of Ephron son of Zohar the Hittite.
aov_text: En sy seuns Isak en Ismael het hom begrawe in die spelonk van Magpéla, in die stuk grond van Efron, die seun van Sohar, die Hetiet, wat oos van Mamre lê,

kjv_text: The field which Abraham purchased of the sons of Heth: there was Abraham buried, and Sarah his wife.
bsb_text: This was the field that Abraham had bought from the Hittites. Abraham was buried there with his wife Sarah.
aov_text: die stuk grond wat Abraham van die seuns van Het gekoop het. Daar is Abraham begrawe en sy vrou Sara.

kjv_text: And it came to pass after the death of Abraham, that God blessed his son Isaac; and Isaac dwelt by the well Lahairoi.
bsb_text: After Abraham’s death, God blessed his son Isaac, who lived near Beer-lahai-roi.
aov_text: Ná die dood van Abraham het God sy seun Isak geseën; en Isak het gewoon by die put Lagai-Roï.

kjv_text: Now these are the generations of Ishmael, Abraham's son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah's handmaid, bare unto Abraham:
bsb_text: This is the account of Abraham’s son Ishmael, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s maidservant, bore to Abraham.
aov_text: En dit is die stamboom van Ismael, die seun van Abraham, wat Hagar, die Egiptiese, die slavin van Sara, vir Abraham gebaar het—

kjv_text: And these are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebajoth; and Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,
bsb_text: These are the names of the sons of Ishmael in the order of their birth: Nebaioth the firstborn of Ishmael, then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
aov_text: dit is die name van die seuns van Ismael, hulle name volgens hulle afstamming: die eersgeborene van Ismael, Nébajot; dan Kedar en Adbeël en Mibsam

kjv_text: And Mishma, and Dumah, and Massa,
bsb_text: Mishma, Dumah, Massa,
aov_text: en Misma en Duma en Massa,

kjv_text: Hadar, and Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah:
bsb_text: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.
aov_text: Hadad en Tema, Jetur, Nafis en Kedma.

kjv_text: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their towns, and by their castles; twelve princes according to their nations.
bsb_text: These were the sons of Ishmael, and these were their names by their villages and encampments—twelve princes of their tribes.
aov_text: Dit is die seuns van Ismael, en dit hulle name, in hulle dorpe en laers, twaalf vorste volgens hulle volkstamme.

kjv_text: And these are the years of the life of Ishmael, an hundred and thirty and seven years: and he gave up the ghost and died; and was gathered unto his people.
bsb_text: Ishmael lived a total of 137 years. Then he breathed his last and died, and was gathered to his people.
aov_text: En dit is die lewensjare van Ismael: honderd-sewen-en-dertig jaar; en hy het die asem uitgeblaas en gesterwe, en hy is versamel by sy volksgenote.

kjv_text: And they dwelt from Havilah unto Shur, that is before Egypt, as thou goest toward Assyria: and he died in the presence of all his brethren.
bsb_text: Ishmael’s descendants settled from Havilah to Shur, which is near the border of Egypt as you go toward Asshur. And they lived in hostility toward all their brothers.
aov_text: En hulle het gewoon van Háwila tot by Sur wat oos van Egipte lê in die rigting van Assur. Teenoor al sy broers het hy hom gevestig.

kjv_text: And these are the generations of Isaac, Abraham's son: Abraham begat Isaac:
bsb_text: This is the account of Abraham’s son Isaac. Abraham became the father of Isaac,
aov_text: EN dit is die geskiedenis van Isak, die seun van Abraham: Abraham was die vader van Isak.

kjv_text: And Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah to wife, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Padanaram, the sister to Laban the Syrian.
bsb_text: and Isaac was forty years old when he married Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Aramean from Paddan-aram and the sister of Laban the Aramean.
aov_text: En Isak was veertig jaar oud toe hy Rebekka, die dogter van Bétuel, die Arameër uit Paddan-Aram, die suster van Laban, die Arameër, vir hom as vrou geneem het.

kjv_text: And Isaac intreated the LORD for his wife, because she was barren: and the LORD was intreated of him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.
bsb_text: Later, Isaac prayed to the LORD on behalf of his wife, because she was barren. And the LORD heard his prayer, and his wife Rebekah conceived.
aov_text: En Isak het die HERE gesmeek met die oog op sy vrou, want sy was onvrugbaar; en die HERE het hom verhoor, sodat sy vrou Rebekka swanger geword het.

kjv_text: And the children struggled together within her; and she said, If it be so, why am I thus? And she went to enquire of the LORD.
bsb_text: But the children inside her struggled with each other, and she said, “Why is this happening to me?” So Rebekah went to inquire of the LORD,
aov_text: En die kinders het teen mekaar gestoot binne-in haar. Toe sê sy: As dit so gaan, waarvoor leef ek dan? Daarop het sy gegaan om die HERE te raadpleeg.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto her, Two nations are in thy womb, and two manner of people shall be separated from thy bowels; and the one people shall be stronger than the other people; and the elder shall serve the younger.
bsb_text: and He declared to her: “Two nations are in your womb, and two peoples from within you will be separated; one people will be stronger than the other, and the older will serve the younger.”
aov_text: En die HERE het haar geantwoord: Twee nasies is in jou skoot, en twee volke sal van mekaar gaan uit jou liggaam; en die een volk sal sterker wees as die ander volk; en die oudste sal die jongste dien.

kjv_text: And when her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.
bsb_text: When her time came to give birth, there were indeed twins in her womb.
aov_text: En toe haar dae vervul is dat sy moes baar, was daar ’n tweeling in haar skoot.

kjv_text: And the first came out red, all over like an hairy garment; and they called his name Esau.
bsb_text: The first one came out red, covered with hair like a fur coat; so they named him Esau.
aov_text: En die eerste is gebore—rooi, geheel en al soos ’n mantel van hare. Daarom het hulle hom Esau genoem.

kjv_text: And after that came his brother out, and his hand took hold on Esau's heel; and his name was called Jacob: and Isaac was threescore years old when she bare them.
bsb_text: After this, his brother came out grasping Esau’s heel; so he was named Jacob. And Isaac was sixty years old when the twins were born.
aov_text: En daarna is sy broer gebore, terwyl sy hand die hakskeen van Esau vashou. Daarom het hulle hom Jakob genoem. En Isak was sestig jaar oud by hulle geboorte.

kjv_text: And the boys grew: and Esau was a cunning hunter, a man of the field; and Jacob was a plain man, dwelling in tents.
bsb_text: When the boys grew up, Esau became a skillful hunter, a man of the field, while Jacob was a quiet man who stayed at home.
aov_text: En die seuns het opgegroei: Esau het ’n ervare jagter geword, ’n man van die veld; maar Jakob was ’n vredeliewende man wat in tente gewoon het.

kjv_text: And Isaac loved Esau, because he did eat of his venison: but Rebekah loved Jacob.
bsb_text: Because Isaac had a taste for wild game, he loved Esau; but Rebekah loved Jacob.
aov_text: En Isak het Esau liefgehad, want wildsvleis was na sy smaak; maar Rebekka het Jakob liefgehad.

kjv_text: And Jacob sod pottage: and Esau came from the field, and he was faint:
bsb_text: One day, while Jacob was cooking some stew, Esau came in from the field and was famished.
aov_text: En Jakob het ’n kooksel klaargemaak, en Esau het moeg uit die veld gekom.

kjv_text: And Esau said to Jacob, Feed me, I pray thee, with that same red pottage; for I am faint: therefore was his name called Edom.
bsb_text: He said to Jacob, “Let me eat some of that red stew, for I am famished.” (That is why he was also called Edom.)
aov_text: Toe sê Esau vir Jakob: Laat my tog sluk van die rooigoed daar, want ek is moeg. Daarom het hulle hom Edom genoem.

kjv_text: And Jacob said, Sell me this day thy birthright.
bsb_text: “First sell me your birthright,” Jacob replied.
aov_text: En Jakob antwoord: Verkoop eers jou eersgeboortereg aan my.

kjv_text: And Esau said, Behold, I am at the point to die: and what profit shall this birthright do to me?
bsb_text: “Look,” said Esau, “I am about to die, so what good is a birthright to me?”
aov_text: En Esau sê: Kyk, ek gaan sterwe, en wat baat die eersgeboortereg my dan?

kjv_text: And Jacob said, Swear to me this day; and he sware unto him: and he sold his birthright unto Jacob.
bsb_text: “Swear to me first,” Jacob said. So Esau swore to Jacob and sold him the birthright.
aov_text: Toe antwoord Jakob: Sweer eers vir my. En hy het vir hom gesweer en sy eersgeboortereg aan Jakob verkoop.

kjv_text: Then Jacob gave Esau bread and pottage of lentiles; and he did eat and drink, and rose up, and went his way: thus Esau despised his birthright.
bsb_text: Then Jacob gave some bread and lentil stew to Esau, who ate and drank and then got up and went away. Thus Esau despised his birthright.
aov_text: En Jakob het aan Esau brood en die kooksel lensies gegee; en hy het geëet en gedrink en opgestaan en weggegaan. So het Esau dan sy eersgeboortereg verag.

kjv_text: And there was a famine in the land, beside the first famine that was in the days of Abraham. And Isaac went unto Abimelech king of the Philistines unto Gerar.
bsb_text: Now there was another famine in the land, subsequent to the one that had occurred in Abraham’s time. And Isaac went to Abimelech king of the Philistines at Gerar.
aov_text: EN daar was hongersnood in die land, buiten die eerste hongersnood wat in die dae van Abraham gewees het. Daarom het Isak getrek na Abiméleg, die koning van die Filistyne, na Gerar.

kjv_text: And the LORD appeared unto him, and said, Go not down into Egypt; dwell in the land which I shall tell thee of:
bsb_text: The LORD appeared to Isaac and said, “Do not go down to Egypt. Settle in the land where I tell you.
aov_text: En die HERE het aan hom verskyn en gesê: Moenie aftrek na Egipte nie; woon in die land wat Ek jou sal aanwys.

kjv_text: Sojourn in this land, and I will be with thee, and will bless thee; for unto thee, and unto thy seed, I will give all these countries, and I will perform the oath which I sware unto Abraham thy father;
bsb_text: Stay in this land as a foreigner, and I will be with you and bless you. For I will give all these lands to you and your offspring, and I will confirm the oath that I swore to your father Abraham.
aov_text: Vertoef as vreemdeling in hierdie land, en Ek sal met jou wees en jou seën; want aan jou en jou nageslag sal Ek al hierdie lande gee: Ek sal die eed bevestig wat Ek vir jou vader Abraham gesweer het.

kjv_text: And I will make thy seed to multiply as the stars of heaven, and will give unto thy seed all these countries; and in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed;
bsb_text: I will make your descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky, and I will give them all these lands, and through your offspring all nations of the earth will be blessed,
aov_text: En Ek sal jou nageslag vermeerder soos die sterre van die hemel en aan jou nageslag al hierdie lande gee, en in jou nageslag sal al die nasies van die aarde geseën word;

kjv_text: Because that Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my charge, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws.
bsb_text: because Abraham listened to My voice and kept My charge, My commandments, My statutes, and My laws.”
aov_text: omdat Abraham na my stem geluister en my ordening, my gebooie, my insettinge en my wette onderhou het.

kjv_text: And Isaac dwelt in Gerar:
bsb_text: So Isaac settled in Gerar.
aov_text: So het Isak dan in Gerar gebly.

kjv_text: And the men of the place asked him of his wife; and he said, She is my sister: for he feared to say, She is my wife; lest, said he, the men of the place should kill me for Rebekah; because she was fair to look upon.
bsb_text: But when the men of that place asked about his wife, he said, “She is my sister.” For he was afraid to say, “She is my wife,” since he thought to himself, “The men of this place will kill me on account of Rebekah, because she is so beautiful.”
aov_text: En toe die manne van die plek hom na sy vrou vra, antwoord hy: Sy is my suster. Want hy was bang om te sê: My vrou—anders sal die manne van die plek, so het hy gedink, my miskien doodmaak ter wille van Rebekka; want sy was mooi van aansien.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when he had been there a long time, that Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window, and saw, and, behold, Isaac was sporting with Rebekah his wife.
bsb_text: When Isaac had been there a long time, Abimelech king of the Philistines looked down from the window and was surprised to see Isaac caressing his wife Rebekah.
aov_text: En toe hy al ’n lang tyd daar was, kyk Abiméleg, die koning van die Filistyne, deur die venster uit en sien hoe Isak speel met Rebekka, sy vrou.

kjv_text: And Abimelech called Isaac, and said, Behold, of a surety she is thy wife: and how saidst thou, She is my sister? And Isaac said unto him, Because I said, Lest I die for her.
bsb_text: Abimelech sent for Isaac and said, “So she is really your wife! How could you say, ‘She is my sister’?” Isaac replied, “Because I thought I might die on account of her.”
aov_text: En Abiméleg het Isak geroep en gesê: Kyk, sy is dan tog jou vrou! Hoe kon jy dan verklaar: Sy is my suster? En Isak antwoord hom: Ja, ek het gedink ek kan miskien om haar ontwil my lewe verloor!

kjv_text: And Abimelech said, What is this thou hast done unto us? one of the people might lightly have lien with thy wife, and thou shouldest have brought guiltiness upon us.
bsb_text: “What is this you have done to us?” asked Abimelech. “One of the people could easily have slept with your wife, and you would have brought guilt upon us.”
aov_text: En Abiméleg sê: Wat het jy ons nou aangedoen? Hoe maklik kon een van die mense met jou vrou gemeenskap gehad en jy ’n skuld oor ons gebring het!

kjv_text: And Abimelech charged all his people, saying, He that toucheth this man or his wife shall surely be put to death.
bsb_text: So Abimelech warned all the people, saying, “Whoever harms this man or his wife will surely be put to death.”
aov_text: Daarom gee Abiméleg bevel aan die hele volk en sê: Wie hierdie man of sy vrou aanraak, sal sekerlik gedood word.

kjv_text: Then Isaac sowed in that land, and received in the same year an hundredfold: and the LORD blessed him.
bsb_text: Now Isaac sowed seed in the land, and that very year he reaped a hundredfold. And the LORD blessed him,
aov_text: Isak het toe in dié land gesaai en daardie jaar honderdvoudig gewen, want die HERE het hom geseën.

kjv_text: And the man waxed great, and went forward, and grew until he became very great:
bsb_text: and he became richer and richer, until he was exceedingly wealthy.
aov_text: En die man het groot geword en altyddeur groter geword totdat hy baie groot was:

kjv_text: For he had possession of flocks, and possession of herds, and great store of servants: and the Philistines envied him.
bsb_text: He owned so many flocks and herds and servants that the Philistines envied him.
aov_text: hy het troppe kleinvee en beeste gehad en baie bediendes, sodat die Filistyne hom beny het.

kjv_text: For all the wells which his father's servants had digged in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped them, and filled them with earth.
bsb_text: So the Philistines took dirt and stopped up all the wells that his father’s servants had dug in the days of his father Abraham.
aov_text: En al die putte wat die dienaars van sy vader in die dae van sy vader Abraham gegrawe het, dié het die Filistyne toegestop en met grond opgevul.

kjv_text: And Abimelech said unto Isaac, Go from us; for thou art much mightier than we.
bsb_text: Then Abimelech said to Isaac, “Depart from us, for you are much too powerful for us.”
aov_text: Toe sê Abiméleg vir Isak: Trek weg van ons, want jy het vir ons veels te magtig geword.

kjv_text: And Isaac departed thence, and pitched his tent in the valley of Gerar, and dwelt there.
bsb_text: So Isaac left that place and encamped in the Valley of Gerar and settled there.
aov_text: Daarop het Isak vandaar weggetrek en laer opgeslaan in die dal by Gerar en daar bly woon.

kjv_text: And Isaac digged again the wells of water, which they had digged in the days of Abraham his father; for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham: and he called their names after the names by which his father had called them.
bsb_text: Isaac reopened the wells that had been dug in the days of his father Abraham, which the Philistines had stopped up after Abraham died. And he gave these wells the same names his father had given them.
aov_text: En Isak het die putte weer oopgegrawe wat hulle in die dae van sy vader Abraham gegrawe het, en wat die Filistyne ná die dood van Abraham toegestop het, en dit genoem na die name wat sy vader daaraan gegee het.

kjv_text: And Isaac's servants digged in the valley, and found there a well of springing water.
bsb_text: Then Isaac’s servants dug in the valley and found a well of fresh water there.
aov_text: En terwyl die dienaars van Isak in die dal grawe, vind hulle daar ’n put met lewendige water.

kjv_text: And the herdmen of Gerar did strive with Isaac's herdmen, saying, The water is ours: and he called the name of the well Esek; because they strove with him.
bsb_text: But the herdsmen of Gerar quarreled with Isaac’s herdsmen and said, “The water is ours!” So he named the well Esek, because they contended with him.
aov_text: En die herders van Gerar het getwis met die herders van Isak en gesê: Dit is óns water. Daarom het hy die put Esek genoem, omdat hulle met hom onenigheid gehad het.

kjv_text: And they digged another well, and strove for that also: and he called the name of it Sitnah.
bsb_text: Then they dug another well and quarreled over that one also; so he named it Sitnah.
aov_text: Daarop grawe hulle ’n ander put, en daaroor het hulle ook getwis. Daarom het hy dit Sitna genoem.

kjv_text: And he removed from thence, and digged another well; and for that they strove not: and he called the name of it Rehoboth; and he said, For now the LORD hath made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land.
bsb_text: He moved on from there and dug another well, and they did not quarrel over it. He named it Rehoboth and said, “At last the LORD has made room for us, and we will be fruitful in the land.”
aov_text: Toe het hy vandaar versit en ’n ander put gegrawe, en daaroor is nie getwis nie. Daarom het hy dit Réhobot genoem en gesê: Ja, nou het die HERE vir ons ruimte gemaak en kan ons vrugbaar wees in die land.

kjv_text: And he went up from thence to Beersheba.
bsb_text: From there Isaac went up to Beersheba,
aov_text: Daarna het hy vandaar opgetrek na Berséba.

kjv_text: And the LORD appeared unto him the same night, and said, I am the God of Abraham thy father: fear not, for I am with thee, and will bless thee, and multiply thy seed for my servant Abraham's sake.
bsb_text: and that night the LORD appeared to him and said, “I am the God of your father Abraham. Do not be afraid, for I am with you. I will bless you and multiply your descendants for the sake of My servant Abraham.”
aov_text: En die HERE het aan hom in dieselfde nag verskyn en gesê: Ek is die God van Abraham, jou vader. Moenie bang wees nie, want Ek is met jou; en Ek sal jou seën en jou nageslag vermeerder ter wille van Abraham, my kneg.

kjv_text: And he builded an altar there, and called upon the name of the LORD, and pitched his tent there: and there Isaac's servants digged a well.
bsb_text: So Isaac built an altar there and called on the name of the LORD, and he pitched his tent there. His servants also dug a well there.
aov_text: Toe bou hy daar ’n altaar, en hy het die Naam van die HERE aangeroep en daar sy tent opgeslaan; en die dienaars van Isak het daar ’n put gegrawe.

kjv_text: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar, and Ahuzzath one of his friends, and Phichol the chief captain of his army.
bsb_text: Later, Abimelech came to Isaac from Gerar, with Ahuzzath his adviser and Phicol the commander of his army.
aov_text: Daarop kom Abiméleg na hom van Gerar af, saam met Ahussat, sy vriend, en Pigol, sy leërowerste.

kjv_text: And Isaac said unto them, Wherefore come ye to me, seeing ye hate me, and have sent me away from you?
bsb_text: “Why have you come to me?” Isaac asked them. “You hated me and sent me away.”
aov_text: En Isak het hulle gevra: Waarom het julle na my gekom, terwyl julle my haat en my van julle af weggestuur het?

kjv_text: And they said, We saw certainly that the LORD was with thee: and we said, Let there be now an oath betwixt us, even betwixt us and thee, and let us make a covenant with thee;
bsb_text: “We can plainly see that the LORD has been with you,” they replied. “We recommend that there should now be an oath between us and you. Let us make a covenant with you
aov_text: Toe antwoord hulle: Ons het duidelik gesien dat die HERE met jou is. Daarom het ons gedink: Laat daar tog ’n eed tussen ons wees, tussen ons en jou; en laat ons ’n verbond met jou sluit:

kjv_text: That thou wilt do us no hurt, as we have not touched thee, and as we have done unto thee nothing but good, and have sent thee away in peace: thou art now the blessed of the LORD.
bsb_text: that you will not harm us, just as we have not harmed you but have done only good to you, sending you on your way in peace. And now you are blessed by the LORD.”
aov_text: jy moet ons geen kwaad doen nie, net soos ons jou nie aangeraak en aan jou niks as goed gedoen het nie en jou in vrede weggestuur het. Jy is nou eenmaal die geseënde van die HERE.

kjv_text: And he made them a feast, and they did eat and drink.
bsb_text: So Isaac prepared a feast for them, and they ate and drank.
aov_text: Toe berei hy vir hulle ’n maaltyd, en hulle het geëet en gedrink.

kjv_text: And they rose up betimes in the morning, and sware one to another: and Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.
bsb_text: And they got up early the next morning and swore an oath to each other. Then Isaac sent them on their way, and they left him in peace.
aov_text: En hulle is die môre vroeg op en het vir mekaar ’n eed gesweer. Daarop het Isak hulle laat gaan, en hulle het in vrede van hom af weggetrek.

kjv_text: And it came to pass the same day, that Isaac's servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had digged, and said unto him, We have found water.
bsb_text: On that same day, Isaac’s servants came and told him about the well they had dug. “We have found water!” they told him.
aov_text: Dieselfde dag kom toe die dienaars van Isak en vertel hom van die put wat hulle gegrawe het, en sê vir hom: Ons het water gekry.

kjv_text: And he called it Shebah: therefore the name of the city is Beersheba unto this day.
bsb_text: So he called it Shibah, and to this day the name of the city is Beersheba.
aov_text: En hy het dit Seba genoem. Daarom is die naam van die stad Berséba tot vandag toe.

kjv_text: And Esau was forty years old when he took to wife Judith the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Bashemath the daughter of Elon the Hittite:
bsb_text: When Esau was forty years old, he took as his wives Judith daughter of Beeri the Hittite and Basemath daughter of Elon the Hittite.
aov_text: Toe Esau veertig jaar oud was, het hy Judit, die dogter van Beëri, die Hetiet, vir hom as vrou geneem, en Basmat, die dogter van Elon, die Hetiet.

kjv_text: Which were a grief of mind unto Isaac and to Rebekah.
bsb_text: And they brought grief to Isaac and Rebekah.
aov_text: En hulle was vir Isak en Rebekka ’n bitter verdriet.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, that when Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his eldest son, and said unto him, My son: and he said unto him, Behold, here am I.
bsb_text: When Isaac was old and his eyes were so weak that he could no longer see, he called his older son Esau and said to him, “My son.” “Here I am,” Esau replied.
aov_text: TOE Isak oud geword het en sy oë swak was, sodat hy nie kon sien nie, het hy sy oudste seun Esau geroep en vir hom gesê: My seun! En hy het hom geantwoord: Hier is ek!

kjv_text: And he said, Behold now, I am old, I know not the day of my death:
bsb_text: “Look,” said Isaac, “I am now old, and I do not know the day of my death.
aov_text: Toe sê hy: Kyk tog, ek het oud geword, ek weet die dag van my dood nie.

kjv_text: Now therefore take, I pray thee, thy weapons, thy quiver and thy bow, and go out to the field, and take me some venison;
bsb_text: Take your weapons—your quiver and bow—and go out into the field to hunt some game for me.
aov_text: Neem dan nou tog jou wapens, jou pylkoker en jou boog, en gaan uit in die veld en jag vir my ’n stuk wild

kjv_text: And make me savoury meat, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat; that my soul may bless thee before I die.
bsb_text: Then prepare a tasty dish that I love and bring it to me to eat, so that I may bless you before I die.”
aov_text: en maak vir my lekker ete klaar soos ek dit graag wil hê; en bring dit vir my om te eet; sodat my siel jou kan seën voordat ek sterwe.

kjv_text: And Rebekah heard when Isaac spake to Esau his son. And Esau went to the field to hunt for venison, and to bring it.
bsb_text: Now Rebekah was listening to what Isaac told his son Esau. So when Esau went into the field to hunt game and bring it back,
aov_text: En Rebekka het geluister terwyl Isak met sy seun Esau spreek. En Esau het in die veld gegaan om ’n stuk wild te jag en dit te bring.

kjv_text: And Rebekah spake unto Jacob her son, saying, Behold, I heard thy father speak unto Esau thy brother, saying,
bsb_text: Rebekah said to her son Jacob, “Behold, I overheard your father saying to your brother Esau,
aov_text: Toe het Rebekka met haar seun Jakob gespreek: Kyk, ek het jou vader met jou broer Esau hoor spreek en sê:

kjv_text: Bring me venison, and make me savoury meat, that I may eat, and bless thee before the LORD before my death.
bsb_text: ‘Bring me some game and prepare me a tasty dish to eat, so that I may bless you in the presence of the LORD before I die.’
aov_text: Bring vir my ’n stuk wild en maak vir my lekker ete, dat ek kan eet en jou kan seën voor die aangesig van die HERE voor my dood.

kjv_text: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which I command thee.
bsb_text: Now, my son, listen to my voice and do exactly as I tell you.
aov_text: My seun, luister dan nou na my, na wat ek jou beveel.

kjv_text: Go now to the flock, and fetch me from thence two good kids of the goats; and I will make them savoury meat for thy father, such as he loveth:
bsb_text: Go out to the flock and bring me two choice young goats, so that I can make them into a tasty dish for your father—the kind he loves.
aov_text: Loop nou na die kleinvee en gaan haal vir my daar twee mooi bokkies, dat ek jou vader daarvan ’n lekker ete kan maak soos hy dit graag wil hê.

kjv_text: And thou shalt bring it to thy father, that he may eat, and that he may bless thee before his death.
bsb_text: Then take it to your father to eat, so that he may bless you before he dies.”
aov_text: Dan moet jy dit na jou vader bring, dat hy kan eet; sodat hy jou kan seën voor sy dood.

kjv_text: And Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man:
bsb_text: Jacob answered his mother Rebekah, “Look, my brother Esau is a hairy man, but I am smooth-skinned.
aov_text: Toe sê Jakob vir sy moeder Rebekka: Kyk, my broer Esau is ’n harige man, en ek is ’n gladde man.

kjv_text: My father peradventure will feel me, and I shall seem to him as a deceiver; and I shall bring a curse upon me, and not a blessing.
bsb_text: What if my father touches me? Then I would be revealed to him as a deceiver, and I would bring upon myself a curse rather than a blessing.”
aov_text: Miskien sal my vader my betas, en ek sal in sy oë wees soos ’n spotter; so sou ek dan ’n vloek oor my bring en nie ’n seën nie.

kjv_text: And his mother said unto him, Upon me be thy curse, my son: only obey my voice, and go fetch me them.
bsb_text: His mother replied, “Your curse be on me, my son. Just obey my voice and go get them for me.”
aov_text: Maar sy moeder antwoord hom: Laat jou vloek op my wees, my seun! Luister net na my en gaan haal dit vir my.

kjv_text: And he went, and fetched, and brought them to his mother: and his mother made savoury meat, such as his father loved.
bsb_text: So Jacob went and got two goats and brought them to his mother, who made the tasty food his father loved.
aov_text: Toe het hy dit gaan haal en na sy moeder gebring. En sy moeder het daarvan ’n lekker ete gemaak soos sy vader dit graag wou hê.

kjv_text: And Rebekah took goodly raiment of her eldest son Esau, which were with her in the house, and put them upon Jacob her younger son:
bsb_text: And Rebekah took the finest clothes in the house that belonged to her older son Esau, and she put them on her younger son Jacob.
aov_text: Ook neem Rebekka die beste klere van Esau, haar oudste seun, wat by haar in die huis was, en sy trek dit vir Jakob, haar jongste seun, aan;

kjv_text: And she put the skins of the kids of the goats upon his hands, and upon the smooth of his neck:
bsb_text: She also put the skins of the young goats on his hands and on the smooth part of his neck.
aov_text: en die velle van die bokkies trek sy oor sy hande en oor die gladdigheid van sy nek,

kjv_text: And she gave the savoury meat and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.
bsb_text: Then she handed her son Jacob the tasty food and bread she had made.
aov_text: en sy gee die lekker ete en die brood wat sy gemaak het, in die hand van Jakob, haar seun.

kjv_text: And he came unto his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I; who art thou, my son?
bsb_text: So Jacob went to his father and said, “My father.” “Here I am!” he answered. “Which one are you, my son?”
aov_text: Toe kom hy by sy vader en sê: My vader! En hy antwoord: Hier is ek! Wie is jy, my seun?

kjv_text: And Jacob said unto his father, I am Esau thy first born; I have done according as thou badest me: arise, I pray thee, sit and eat of my venison, that thy soul may bless me.
bsb_text: Jacob said to his father, “I am Esau, your firstborn. I have done as you told me. Please sit up and eat some of my game, so that you may bless me.”
aov_text: En Jakob sê aan sy vader: Ek is Esau, u eersgeborene. Ek het gedoen soos u my beveel het. Rig u tog op, sit en eet van my wildsvleis, dat u siel my kan seën.

kjv_text: And Isaac said unto his son, How is it that thou hast found it so quickly, my son? And he said, Because the LORD thy God brought it to me.
bsb_text: But Isaac asked his son, “How did you ever find it so quickly, my son?” “Because the LORD your God brought it to me,” he replied.
aov_text: Daarop het Isak aan sy seun gesê: Hoe het jy dit so gou gekry, my seun? En hy antwoord: Omdat die HERE u God dit my laat teëkom het.

kjv_text: And Isaac said unto Jacob, Come near, I pray thee, that I may feel thee, my son, whether thou be my very son Esau or not.
bsb_text: Then Isaac said to Jacob, “Please come closer so I can touch you, my son. Are you really my son Esau, or not?”
aov_text: En Isak sê vir Jakob: Kom tog nader, dat ek jou kan betas, my seun, of jy waarlik my seun Esau is of nie.

kjv_text: And Jacob went near unto Isaac his father; and he felt him, and said, The voice is Jacob's voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.
bsb_text: So Jacob came close to his father Isaac, who touched him and said, “The voice is the voice of Jacob, but the hands are the hands of Esau.”
aov_text: En Jakob het nader gekom na sy vader Isak, en hy het hom betas en gesê: Die stem is Jakob se stem, maar die hande is Esau se hande.

kjv_text: And he discerned him not, because his hands were hairy, as his brother Esau's hands: so he blessed him.
bsb_text: Isaac did not recognize him, because his hands were hairy like those of his brother Esau; so he blessed him.
aov_text: Maar hy het hom nie geëien nie, omdat sy hande harig was soos sy broer Esau se hande; en hy het hom geseën.

kjv_text: And he said, Art thou my very son Esau? And he said, I am.
bsb_text: Again he asked, “Are you really my son Esau?” And he replied, “I am.”
aov_text: Hy het naamlik gevra: Is jy waarlik my seun Esau? En hy het geantwoord: Ja.

kjv_text: And he said, Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son's venison, that my soul may bless thee. And he brought it near to him, and he did eat: and he brought him wine, and he drank.
bsb_text: “Serve me,” said Isaac, “and let me eat some of my son’s game, so that I may bless you.” Jacob brought it to him, and he ate; then he brought him wine, and he drank.
aov_text: Toe sê hy: Bring dit vir my nader, dat ek van die wildsvleis van my seun kan eet, sodat my siel jou kan seën. En hy het dit vir hom nader gebring, en hy het geëet. Hy het vir hom ook wyn gebring, en hy het gedrink.

kjv_text: And his father Isaac said unto him, Come near now, and kiss me, my son.
bsb_text: Then his father Isaac said to him, “Please come near and kiss me, my son.”
aov_text: Daarop sê sy vader Isak vir hom: Kom tog nader en soen my, my seun!

kjv_text: And he came near, and kissed him: and he smelled the smell of his raiment, and blessed him, and said, See, the smell of my son is as the smell of a field which the LORD hath blessed:
bsb_text: So he came near and kissed him. When Isaac smelled his clothing, he blessed him and said: “Ah, the smell of my son is like the smell of a field that the LORD has blessed.
aov_text: En hy het nader gekom en hom gesoen. Toe ruik hy die geur van sy klere, en hy seën hom en sê: Kyk, die geur van my seun is soos die geur van die veld wat die HERE geseën het.

kjv_text: Therefore God give thee of the dew of heaven, and the fatness of the earth, and plenty of corn and wine:
bsb_text: May God give to you the dew of heaven and the richness of the earth—an abundance of grain and new wine.
aov_text: En mag God jou gee van die dou van die hemel en van die vet grond van die aarde en oorvloed van koring en mos.

kjv_text: Let people serve thee, and nations bow down to thee: be lord over thy brethren, and let thy mother's sons bow down to thee: cursed be every one that curseth thee, and blessed be he that blesseth thee.
bsb_text: May peoples serve you and nations bow down to you. May you be the master of your brothers, and may the sons of your mother bow down to you. May those who curse you be cursed, and those who bless you be blessed.”
aov_text: Volke sal jou dien, en nasies voor jou neerbuig. Wees ’n heerser oor jou broers, en die seuns van jou moeder moet hulle voor jou neerbuig. Vervloek is hulle wat jou vloek, en geseënd hulle wat jou seën.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, as soon as Isaac had made an end of blessing Jacob, and Jacob was yet scarce gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, that Esau his brother came in from his hunting.
bsb_text: As soon as Isaac had finished blessing him and Jacob had left his father’s presence, his brother Esau returned from the hunt.
aov_text: Maar toe Isak Jakob klaar geseën het en Jakob nog skaars van sy vader Isak af weggegaan het, kom sy broer Esau van die jag af,

kjv_text: And he also had made savoury meat, and brought it unto his father, and said unto his father, Let my father arise, and eat of his son's venison, that thy soul may bless me.
bsb_text: He too made some tasty food, brought it to his father, and said to him, “My father, sit up and eat of your son’s game, so that you may bless me.”
aov_text: en hý maak ook ’n lekker ete en bring dit na sy vader en sê aan sy vader: Laat my vader hom oprig en eet van die wildsvleis van sy seun, sodat u siel my kan seën.

kjv_text: And Isaac his father said unto him, Who art thou? And he said, I am thy son, thy firstborn Esau.
bsb_text: But his father Isaac replied, “Who are you?” “I am Esau, your firstborn son,” he answered.
aov_text: En sy vader Isak vra hom: Wie is jy? En hy antwoord: Ek is u seun Esau, u eersgeborene.

kjv_text: And Isaac trembled very exceedingly, and said, Who? where is he that hath taken venison, and brought it me, and I have eaten of all before thou camest, and have blessed him? yea, and he shall be blessed.
bsb_text: Isaac began to tremble violently and said, “Who was it, then, who hunted the game and brought it to me? Before you came in, I ate it all and blessed him—and indeed, he will be blessed!”
aov_text: Toe skrik Isak geweldig en sê: Wie is dit dan wat wild gejag en vir my gebring het? En ek het van alles geëet voordat jy gekom het, en hom geseën—ook sal hy geseënd bly!

kjv_text: And when Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with a great and exceeding bitter cry, and said unto his father, Bless me, even me also, O my father.
bsb_text: When Esau heard his father’s words, he let out a loud and bitter cry and said to his father, “Bless me too, O my father!”
aov_text: Toe Esau die woorde van sy vader hoor, skreeu hy met ’n baie groot en bitter geroep, en hy sê vir sy vader: Seën mý ook, my vader!

kjv_text: And he said, Thy brother came with subtilty, and hath taken away thy blessing.
bsb_text: But Isaac replied, “Your brother came deceitfully and took your blessing.”
aov_text: En hy antwoord: Jou broer het gekom met bedrog en jou seën weggeneem.

kjv_text: And he said, Is not he rightly named Jacob? for he hath supplanted me these two times: he took away my birthright; and, behold, now he hath taken away my blessing. And he said, Hast thou not reserved a blessing for me?
bsb_text: So Esau declared, “Is he not rightly named Jacob? For he has cheated me twice. He took my birthright, and now he has taken my blessing.” Then he asked, “Haven’t you saved a blessing for me?”
aov_text: Daarop sê hy: Sou hulle hom Jakob noem, omdat hy my nou twee keer onderkruip het? My eersgeboortereg het hy geneem, en daar het hy nou my seën geneem! Verder vra hy: Het u vir my geen seën oorgehou nie?

kjv_text: And Isaac answered and said unto Esau, Behold, I have made him thy lord, and all his brethren have I given to him for servants; and with corn and wine have I sustained him: and what shall I do now unto thee, my son?
bsb_text: But Isaac answered Esau: “Look, I have made him your master and given him all his relatives as servants; I have sustained him with grain and new wine. What is left that I can do for you, my son?”
aov_text: Toe antwoord Isak en sê vir Esau: Kyk, ek het hom as heerser oor jou gestel en aan hom al sy broers as dienaars gegee; en ek het hom met koring en mos versorg. Wat kan ek dan nou vir jóu doen, my seun?

kjv_text: And Esau said unto his father, Hast thou but one blessing, my father? bless me, even me also, O my father. And Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.
bsb_text: Esau said to his father, “Do you have only one blessing, my father? Bless me too, O my father!” Then Esau wept aloud.
aov_text: Daarop het Esau aan sy vader gevra: Het u net een seën, my vader? Seën mý ook, my vader! En Esau het sy stem verhef en geween.

kjv_text: And Isaac his father answered and said unto him, Behold, thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of heaven from above;
bsb_text: His father Isaac answered him: “Behold, your dwelling place shall be away from the richness of the land, away from the dew of heaven above.
aov_text: Toe antwoord sy vader Isak en sê vir hom: Kyk, ver van die vet grond van die aarde sal jou woonplek wees, en ver van die dou van die hemel daarbo.

kjv_text: And by thy sword shalt thou live, and shalt serve thy brother; and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion, that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck.
bsb_text: You shall live by the sword and serve your brother. But when you rebel, you will tear his yoke from your neck.”
aov_text: En van jou swaard sal jy lewe, en jou broer sal jy dien. Maar as jy jou kragte inspan, sal jy sy juk van jou nek afruk.

kjv_text: And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him: and Esau said in his heart, The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then will I slay my brother Jacob.
bsb_text: Esau held a grudge against Jacob because of the blessing his father had given him. And Esau said in his heart, “The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then I will kill my brother Jacob.”
aov_text: En Esau was Jakob vyandig gesind vanweë die seën waarmee sy vader hom geseën het, en Esau het in sy hart gedink: Die dae van die rou oor my vader is naby; dan sal ek my broer Jakob doodmaak.

kjv_text: And these words of Esau her elder son were told to Rebekah: and she sent and called Jacob her younger son, and said unto him, Behold, thy brother Esau, as touching thee, doth comfort himself, purposing to kill thee.
bsb_text: When the words of her older son Esau were relayed to Rebekah, she sent for her younger son Jacob and told him, “Look, your brother Esau is consoling himself by plotting to kill you.
aov_text: Maar toe hulle aan Rebekka die woorde van Esau, haar oudste seun, vertel, stuur sy en laat Jakob, haar jongste seun, roep en sê vir hom: Kyk, jou broer Esau sal hom op jou wreek deur jou dood te maak.

kjv_text: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice; and arise, flee thou to Laban my brother to Haran;
bsb_text: So now, my son, obey my voice and flee at once to my brother Laban in Haran.
aov_text: My seun, luister dan nou na my: maak jou klaar, vlug tog na Haran, na my broer Laban,

kjv_text: And tarry with him a few days, until thy brother's fury turn away;
bsb_text: Stay with him for a while, until your brother’s fury subsides—
aov_text: en bly ’n rukkie by hom tot die woede van jou broer bedaar,

kjv_text: Until thy brother's anger turn away from thee, and he forget that which thou hast done to him: then I will send, and fetch thee from thence: why should I be deprived also of you both in one day?
bsb_text: until your brother’s rage against you wanes and he forgets what you have done to him. Then I will send for you and bring you back from there. Why should I lose both of you in one day?”
aov_text: tot die toorn van jou broer teen jou bedaar en hy vergeet het wat jy hom aangedoen het. Dan sal ek stuur en jou daar laat haal. Waarom moet ek julle altwee op een dag verloor?

kjv_text: And Rebekah said to Isaac, I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth: if Jacob take a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these which are of the daughters of the land, what good shall my life do me?
bsb_text: Then Rebekah said to Isaac, “I am weary of my life because of these Hittite women. If Jacob takes a Hittite wife from among them, what good is my life?”
aov_text: Verder sê Rebekka vir Isak: Ek is moeg vir my lewe vanweë die dogters van Het. As Jakob ’n vrou neem uit die dogters van Het, soos húlle is, uit die dogters van die land—waarvoor lewe ek dan?

kjv_text: And Isaac called Jacob, and blessed him, and charged him, and said unto him, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.
bsb_text: So Isaac called for Jacob and blessed him. “Do not take a wife from the Canaanite women,” he commanded.
aov_text: TOE het Isak Jakob geroep en hom geseën; en hy het hom bevel gegee met die woorde: Jy mag geen vrou neem uit die dogters van Kanaän nie.

kjv_text: Arise, go to Padanaram, to the house of Bethuel thy mother's father; and take thee a wife from thence of the daughters of Laban thy mother's brother.
bsb_text: “Go at once to Paddan-aram, to the house of your mother’s father Bethuel, and take a wife from among the daughters of Laban, your mother’s brother.
aov_text: Maak jou klaar, gaan na Paddan-Aram, na die huis van Bétuel, jou moeder se vader, en gaan haal vir jou daar ’n vrou uit die dogters van Laban, jou moeder se broer.

kjv_text: And God Almighty bless thee, and make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, that thou mayest be a multitude of people;
bsb_text: May God Almighty bless you and make you fruitful and multiply you, so that you may become a company of peoples.
aov_text: En mag God, die Almagtige, jou seën en jou vrugbaar maak en jou vermeerder, sodat jy ’n menigte van volke kan word.

kjv_text: And give thee the blessing of Abraham, to thee, and to thy seed with thee; that thou mayest inherit the land wherein thou art a stranger, which God gave unto Abraham.
bsb_text: And may He give the blessing of Abraham to you and your descendants, so that you may possess the land where you dwell as a foreigner, the land God gave to Abraham.”
aov_text: En mag Hy jou gee die seën van Abraham, aan jou en jou nageslag saam met jou, dat jy die land van jou vreemdelingskap in besit kan neem wat God aan Abraham gegee het.

kjv_text: And Isaac sent away Jacob: and he went to Padanaram unto Laban, son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, Jacob's and Esau's mother.
bsb_text: So Isaac sent Jacob to Paddan-aram, to Laban son of Bethuel the Aramean, the brother of Rebekah, who was the mother of Jacob and Esau.
aov_text: So het Isak Jakob dan weggestuur, en hy het na Paddan-Aram gegaan, na Laban, die seun van Bétuel, die Arameër, die broer van Rebekka, die moeder van Jakob en Esau.

kjv_text: When Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob, and sent him away to Padanaram, to take him a wife from thence; and that as he blessed him he gave him a charge, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan;
bsb_text: Now Esau learned that Isaac had blessed Jacob and sent him to Paddan-aram to take a wife there, commanding him, “Do not marry a Canaanite woman,”
aov_text: Toe Esau sien dat Isak Jakob geseën en hom na Paddan-Aram weggestuur het om daar vir hom ’n vrou te gaan haal, terwyl hy hom geseën en hom bevel gegee het met die woorde: Jy mag geen vrou uit die dogters van Kanaän neem nie;

kjv_text: And that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Padanaram;
bsb_text: and that Jacob had obeyed his father and mother and gone to Paddan-aram.
aov_text: en dat Jakob na sy vader en sy moeder geluister het om na Paddan-Aram te gaan;

kjv_text: And Esau seeing that the daughters of Canaan pleased not Isaac his father;
bsb_text: And seeing that his father Isaac disapproved of the Canaanite women,
aov_text: en toe Esau sien dat die dogters van Kanaän sleg was in die oë van sy vader Isak,

kjv_text: Then went Esau unto Ishmael, and took unto the wives which he had Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael Abraham's son, the sister of Nebajoth, to be his wife.
bsb_text: Esau went to Ishmael and married Mahalath, the sister of Nebaioth and daughter of Abraham’s son Ishmael, in addition to the wives he already had.
aov_text: het Esau na Ismael gegaan en Máhalat, die dogter van Ismael, die seun van Abraham, die suster van Nébajot, by sy vroue vir hom as vrou geneem.

kjv_text: And Jacob went out from Beersheba, and went toward Haran.
bsb_text: Meanwhile Jacob left Beersheba and set out for Haran.
aov_text: En Jakob het uit Berséba vertrek en na Haran gegaan.

kjv_text: And he lighted upon a certain place, and tarried there all night, because the sun was set; and he took of the stones of that place, and put them for his pillows, and lay down in that place to sleep.
bsb_text: On reaching a certain place, he spent the night there because the sun had set. And taking one of the stones from that place, he put it under his head and lay down to sleep.
aov_text: Daarop kom hy by ’n plek waar hy die nag oorgebly het, want die son was al onder. En hy neem een van die klippe van die plek en sit dit onder sy hoof, en hy gaan lê en slaap op dié plek.

kjv_text: And he dreamed, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven: and behold the angels of God ascending and descending on it.
bsb_text: And Jacob had a dream about a ladder that rested on the earth with its top reaching up to heaven, and God’s angels were going up and down the ladder.
aov_text: En hy het gedroom—daar is ’n leer op die aarde opgerig waarvan die spits tot aan die hemel reik, terwyl die engele van God daarlangs opgeklim en daarlangs neergedaal het.

kjv_text: And, behold, the LORD stood above it, and said, I am the LORD God of Abraham thy father, and the God of Isaac: the land whereon thou liest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed;
bsb_text: And there at the top the LORD was standing and saying, “I am the LORD, the God of your father Abraham and the God of Isaac. I will give you and your descendants the land on which you now lie.
aov_text: En kyk, die HERE het bo-aan gestaan en gesê: Ek is die HERE, die God van jou vader Abraham en die God van Isak. Die land waar jy op lê en slaap, sal Ek aan jou en jou nageslag gee;

kjv_text: And thy seed shall be as the dust of the earth, and thou shalt spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south: and in thee and in thy seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed.
bsb_text: Your descendants will be like the dust of the earth, and you will spread out to the west and east and north and south. All the families of the earth will be blessed through you and your offspring.
aov_text: en jou nageslag sal wees soos die stof van die aarde, en jy sal uitbrei na die weste en ooste, en na die noorde en suide; en in jou en jou nageslag sal al die geslagte van die aarde geseën word.

kjv_text: And, behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of.
bsb_text: Look, I am with you, and I will watch over you wherever you go, and I will bring you back to this land. For I will not leave you until I have done what I have promised you.”
aov_text: En kyk, Ek is met jou, en Ek sal jou bewaar oral waar jy heengaan, en Ek sal jou terugbring in hierdie land; want Ek sal jou nie verlaat nie, totdat Ek gedoen het wat Ek jou gesê het.

kjv_text: And Jacob awaked out of his sleep, and he said, Surely the LORD is in this place; and I knew it not.
bsb_text: When Jacob woke up, he thought, “Surely the LORD is in this place, and I was unaware of it.”
aov_text: Daarop word Jakob uit sy slaap wakker en sê: Waarlik, die HERE is op hierdie plek, en ék het dit nie geweet nie.

kjv_text: And he was afraid, and said, How dreadful is this place! this is none other but the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven.
bsb_text: And he was afraid and said, “How awesome is this place! This is none other than the house of God; this is the gate of heaven!”
aov_text: En hy het bevrees geword en gesê: Hoe vreeslik is hierdie plek! Dit is hier niks anders as ’n huis van God nie, en dit is hier die poort van die hemel.

kjv_text: And Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put for his pillows, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil upon the top of it.
bsb_text: Early the next morning, Jacob took the stone that he had placed under his head, and he set it up as a pillar. He poured oil on top of it,
aov_text: Toe staan Jakob die môre vroeg op en neem die klip wat hy onder sy hoof gesit het, en rig dit as ’n gedenksteen op; en hy het olie daaroor uitgegiet.

kjv_text: And he called the name of that place Bethel: but the name of that city was called Luz at the first.
bsb_text: and he called that place Bethel, though previously the city had been named Luz.
aov_text: En hy het die plek Bet-el genoem; maar die naam van die stad was tevore Lus.

kjv_text: And Jacob vowed a vow, saying, If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and raiment to put on,
bsb_text: Then Jacob made a vow, saying, “If God will be with me and watch over me on this journey, and if He will provide me with food to eat and clothes to wear,
aov_text: En Jakob het ’n gelofte gedoen en gesê: As God met my sal wees om my te bewaar op hierdie weg wat ek gaan, en aan my brood sal gee om te eet en klere om aan te trek,

kjv_text: So that I come again to my father's house in peace; then shall the LORD be my God:
bsb_text: so that I may return safely to my father’s house, then the LORD will be my God.
aov_text: en ek behoue na die huis van my vader sal terugkom, dan sal die HERE my God wees.

kjv_text: And this stone, which I have set for a pillar, shall be God's house: and of all that thou shalt give me I will surely give the tenth unto thee.
bsb_text: And this stone I have set up as a pillar will be God’s house, and of all that You give me I will surely give You a tenth.”
aov_text: En hierdie klip wat ek as gedenksteen opgerig het, sal ’n huis van God wees, en van alles wat U my gee, sal ek aan U sekerlik die tiendes afstaan.

kjv_text: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came into the land of the people of the east.
bsb_text: Jacob resumed his journey and came to the land of the people of the east.
aov_text: TOE lig Jakob sy voete op en gaan na die land van die kinders van die Ooste.

kjv_text: And he looked, and behold a well in the field, and, lo, there were three flocks of sheep lying by it; for out of that well they watered the flocks: and a great stone was upon the well's mouth.
bsb_text: He looked and saw a well in the field, and near it lay three flocks of sheep, because the sheep were watered from this well. And a large stone covered the mouth of the well.
aov_text: En meteens sien hy ’n put in die veld en drie troppe kleinvee wat daarby lê, want uit dié put het hulle die vee laat drink; en daar was ’n groot klip op die opening van die put.

kjv_text: And thither were all the flocks gathered: and they rolled the stone from the well's mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone again upon the well's mouth in his place.
bsb_text: When all the flocks had been gathered there, the shepherds would roll away the stone from the mouth of the well and water the sheep. Then they would return the stone to its place over the mouth of the well.
aov_text: En as al die troppe daar bymekaarkom, rol hulle die klip weg van die opening van die put en laat die vee drink; daarna sit hulle die klip weer op die opening van die put op sy plek.

kjv_text: And Jacob said unto them, My brethren, whence be ye? And they said, Of Haran are we.
bsb_text: “My brothers,” Jacob asked the shepherds, “where are you from?” “We are from Haran,” they answered.
aov_text: Toe sê Jakob vir hulle: My broers, waar is julle vandaan? En hulle antwoord: Ons kom van Haran.

kjv_text: And he said unto them, Know ye Laban the son of Nahor? And they said, We know him.
bsb_text: “Do you know Laban the grandson of Nahor?” Jacob asked. “We know him,” they replied.
aov_text: En hy vra hulle: Ken julle vir Laban, die seun van Nahor? En hulle antwoord: Ons ken hom.

kjv_text: And he said unto them, Is he well? And they said, He is well: and, behold, Rachel his daughter cometh with the sheep.
bsb_text: “Is he well?” Jacob inquired. “Yes,” they answered, “and here comes his daughter Rachel with his sheep.”
aov_text: Verder sê hy vir hulle: Gaan dit goed met hom? En hulle antwoord: Dit gaan goed; en daar kom sy dogter Ragel aan met die vee.

kjv_text: And he said, Lo, it is yet high day, neither is it time that the cattle should be gathered together: water ye the sheep, and go and feed them.
bsb_text: “Look,” said Jacob, “it is still broad daylight; it is not yet time to gather the livestock. Water the sheep and take them back to pasture.”
aov_text: En hy sê: Kyk, die dag is nog lank; dit is nie tyd om die vee bymekaar te maak nie. Laat die vee drink, en gaan heen, laat hulle wei.

kjv_text: And they said, We cannot, until all the flocks be gathered together, and till they roll the stone from the well's mouth; then we water the sheep.
bsb_text: But they replied, “We cannot, until all the flocks have been gathered and the stone has been rolled away from the mouth of the well. Then we will water the sheep.”
aov_text: Toe antwoord hulle: Ons kan nie voordat al die troppe bymekaar is nie; dan rol hulle die klip weg van die opening van die put, en ons laat die vee drink.

kjv_text: And while he yet spake with them, Rachel came with her father's sheep: for she kept them.
bsb_text: While he was still speaking with them, Rachel arrived with her father’s sheep, for she was a shepherdess.
aov_text: Terwyl hy nog met hulle praat, kom Ragel met die kleinvee van haar vader aan, want sy het hulle opgepas.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban his mother's brother, and the sheep of Laban his mother's brother, that Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well's mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother's brother.
bsb_text: As soon as Jacob saw Rachel, the daughter of his mother’s brother Laban, with Laban’s sheep, he went up and rolled the stone away from the mouth of the well and watered his uncle’s sheep.
aov_text: Toe Jakob Ragel sien, die dogter van Laban, sy moeder se broer, en die vee van Laban, sy moeder se broer, loop Jakob nader en rol die klip weg van die opening van die put, en hy laat die vee drink van Laban, sy moeder se broer.

kjv_text: And Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.
bsb_text: Then Jacob kissed Rachel and wept aloud.
aov_text: En Jakob het Ragel gesoen en sy stem verhef en geween.

kjv_text: And Jacob told Rachel that he was her father's brother, and that he was Rebekah's son: and she ran and told her father.
bsb_text: He told Rachel that he was Rebekah’s son, a relative of her father, and she ran and told her father.
aov_text: En Jakob het Ragel vertel dat hy haar vader se broer en die seun van Rebekka was. Daarop het sy geloop en dit aan haar vader vertel.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when Laban heard the tidings of Jacob his sister's son, that he ran to meet him, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. And he told Laban all these things.
bsb_text: When Laban heard the news about his sister’s son Jacob, he ran out to meet him. He embraced him and kissed him and brought him to his home, where Jacob told him all that had happened.
aov_text: Toe Laban die tyding hoor van Jakob, die seun van sy suster, loop hy hom tegemoet en omhels hom en soen hom en bring hom in sy huis. En hy het aan Laban al hierdie dinge vertel.

kjv_text: And Laban said to him, Surely thou art my bone and my flesh. And he abode with him the space of a month.
bsb_text: Then Laban declared, “You are indeed my own flesh and blood.” After Jacob had stayed with him a month,
aov_text: Toe sê Laban vir hom: Waarlik, jy is my been en my vlees. En hy het by hom ’n volle maand gebly.

kjv_text: And Laban said unto Jacob, Because thou art my brother, shouldest thou therefore serve me for nought? tell me, what shall thy wages be?
bsb_text: Laban said to him, “Just because you are my relative, should you work for nothing? Tell me what your wages should be.”
aov_text: Daarop het Laban aan Jakob gevra: Sou jy my verniet dien, omdat jy my broer is? Sê my wat jou loon moet wees.

kjv_text: And Laban had two daughters: the name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.
bsb_text: Now Laban had two daughters; the older was named Leah, and the younger was named Rachel.
aov_text: En Laban het twee dogters gehad—die naam van die oudste was Lea, en die naam van die jongste Ragel.

kjv_text: Leah was tender eyed; but Rachel was beautiful and well favoured.
bsb_text: Leah had weak eyes, but Rachel was shapely and beautiful.
aov_text: En Lea het dowwe oë gehad, maar Ragel was skoon van gestalte en mooi van aansien.

kjv_text: And Jacob loved Rachel; and said, I will serve thee seven years for Rachel thy younger daughter.
bsb_text: Since Jacob loved Rachel, he answered, “I will serve you seven years for your younger daughter Rachel.”
aov_text: En Jakob het Ragel liefgehad, daarom het hy gesê: Ek sal u sewe jaar dien vir Ragel, u jongste dogter.

kjv_text: And Laban said, It is better that I give her to thee, than that I should give her to another man: abide with me.
bsb_text: Laban replied, “Better that I give her to you than to another. Stay here with me.”
aov_text: Toe antwoord Laban: Dit is beter dat ek haar aan jou gee as dat ek haar aan ’n ander man gee. Bly by my.

kjv_text: And Jacob served seven years for Rachel; and they seemed unto him but a few days, for the love he had to her.
bsb_text: So Jacob served seven years for Rachel, yet it seemed but a few days because of his love for her.
aov_text: So het Jakob dan sewe jaar gedien vir Ragel; en hulle was in sy oë soos ’n paar dae, omdat hy haar liefgehad het.

kjv_text: And Jacob said unto Laban, Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in unto her.
bsb_text: Finally Jacob said to Laban, “Grant me my wife, for my time is complete, and I want to sleep with her.”
aov_text: Toe sê Jakob vir Laban: Gee tog my vrou, want my dienstyd is om, dat ek by haar kan ingaan.

kjv_text: And Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.
bsb_text: So Laban invited all the men of that place and prepared a feast.
aov_text: Daarop het Laban al die manne van die plek versamel en ’n maaltyd berei.

kjv_text: And it came to pass in the evening, that he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to him; and he went in unto her.
bsb_text: But when evening came, Laban took his daughter Leah and gave her to Jacob, and he slept with her.
aov_text: Maar in die aand het hy sy dogter Lea geneem en haar na hom gebring; en hy het by haar ingegaan.

kjv_text: And Laban gave unto his daughter Leah Zilpah his maid for an handmaid.
bsb_text: And Laban gave his servant girl Zilpah to his daughter Leah as her maidservant.
aov_text: En Laban het aan haar sy slavin Silpa gegee, naamlik aan sy dogter Lea, as slavin.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, that in the morning, behold, it was Leah: and he said to Laban, What is this thou hast done unto me? did not I serve with thee for Rachel? wherefore then hast thou beguiled me?
bsb_text: When morning came, there was Leah! “What have you done to me?” Jacob said to Laban. “Wasn’t it for Rachel that I served you? Why have you deceived me?”
aov_text: En die anderdagmôre—daar was dit Lea! Daarom het hy aan Laban gesê: Wat het u my nou aangedoen? Was ek nie vir Ragel by u in diens nie? Waarom het u my dan bedrieg?

kjv_text: And Laban said, It must not be so done in our country, to give the younger before the firstborn.
bsb_text: Laban replied, “It is not our custom here to give the younger daughter in marriage before the older.
aov_text: En Laban antwoord: Dit is hier by ons nie die gewoonte om die jongste voor die oudste weg te gee nie.

kjv_text: Fulfil her week, and we will give thee this also for the service which thou shalt serve with me yet seven other years.
bsb_text: Finish this week’s celebration, and we will give you the younger one in return for another seven years of work.”
aov_text: Hou die volle bruilofsweek met haar; dan sal ons jou die ander een ook gee vir die diens wat jy nóg sewe jaar by my moet volbring.

kjv_text: And Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week: and he gave him Rachel his daughter to wife also.
bsb_text: And Jacob did just that. He finished the week’s celebration, and Laban gave him his daughter Rachel as his wife.
aov_text: En Jakob het so gedoen: hy het die volle bruilofsweek met haar gehou. Toe gee hy sy dogter Ragel aan hom as vrou.

kjv_text: And Laban gave to Rachel his daughter Bilhah his handmaid to be her maid.
bsb_text: Laban also gave his servant girl Bilhah to his daughter Rachel as her maidservant.
aov_text: En Laban het aan sy dogter Ragel sy slavin Bilha gegee as slavin vir haar.

kjv_text: And he went in also unto Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him yet seven other years.
bsb_text: Jacob slept with Rachel as well, and indeed, he loved Rachel more than Leah. So he worked for Laban another seven years.
aov_text: En hy het ook by Ragel ingegaan en Ragel ook meer liefgehad as Lea. En hy was by hom nóg sewe jaar in diens.

kjv_text: And when the LORD saw that Leah was hated, he opened her womb: but Rachel was barren.
bsb_text: When the LORD saw that Leah was unloved, He opened her womb; but Rachel was barren.
aov_text: En toe die HERE sien dat Lea die nie-geliefde was, het Hy haar skoot geopen; maar Ragel was onvrugbaar.

kjv_text: And Leah conceived, and bare a son, and she called his name Reuben: for she said, Surely the LORD hath looked upon my affliction; now therefore my husband will love me.
bsb_text: And Leah conceived and gave birth to a son, and she named him Reuben, for she said, “The LORD has seen my affliction. Surely my husband will love me now.”
aov_text: En Lea het bevrug geword en ’n seun gebaar en hom Ruben genoem; want sy het gesê: Gewis, die HERE het my ellende aangesien, want nou sal my man my liefhê.

kjv_text: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Because the LORD hath heard that I was hated, he hath therefore given me this son also: and she called his name Simeon.
bsb_text: Again she conceived and gave birth to a son, and she said, “Because the LORD has heard that I am unloved, He has given me this son as well.” So she named him Simeon.
aov_text: En sy het weer bevrug geword en ’n seun gebaar en gesê: Gewis, die HERE het gehoor dat ek die nie-geliefde is en my hierdie een ook gegee. En sy het hom Símeon genoem.

kjv_text: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Now this time will my husband be joined unto me, because I have born him three sons: therefore was his name called Levi.
bsb_text: Once again Leah conceived and gave birth to a son, and she said, “Now at last my husband will become attached to me, because I have borne him three sons.” So he was named Levi.
aov_text: En sy het weer bevrug geword en ’n seun gebaar en gesê: Nou eindelik sal my man aan my geheg wees, omdat ek vir hom drie seuns gebaar het. Daarom het sy hom Levi genoem.

kjv_text: And she conceived again, and bare a son: and she said, Now will I praise the LORD: therefore she called his name Judah; and left bearing.
bsb_text: And once more she conceived and gave birth to a son and said, “This time I will praise the LORD.” So she named him Judah. Then Leah stopped having children.
aov_text: En sy het weer bevrug geword en ’n seun gebaar en gesê: Dié keer sal ek die HERE loof. Daarom het sy hom Juda genoem. En sy het opgehou met baar.

kjv_text: And when Rachel saw that she bare Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister; and said unto Jacob, Give me children, or else I die.
bsb_text: When Rachel saw that she was not bearing any children for Jacob, she envied her sister. “Give me children, or I will die!” she said to Jacob.
aov_text: EN toe Ragel sien dat sy vir Jakob geen kinders baar nie, het Ragel jaloers geword op haar suster en aan Jakob gesê: Gee vir my kinders of anders sterf ek.

kjv_text: And Jacob's anger was kindled against Rachel: and he said, Am I in God's stead, who hath withheld from thee the fruit of the womb?
bsb_text: Jacob became angry with Rachel and said, “Am I in the place of God, who has withheld children from you?”
aov_text: Toe het Jakob kwaad geword vir Ragel en gevra: Is ek dan in die plek van God wat die vrug van die skoot aan jou onthou het?

kjv_text: And she said, Behold my maid Bilhah, go in unto her; and she shall bear upon my knees, that I may also have children by her.
bsb_text: Then she said, “Here is my maidservant Bilhah. Sleep with her, that she may bear children for me, so that through her I too can build a family.”
aov_text: En sy antwoord: Daar is my slavin Bilha; gaan by haar in, dat sy op my knieë kan baar en ek ook uit haar gebou kan word.

kjv_text: And she gave him Bilhah her handmaid to wife: and Jacob went in unto her.
bsb_text: So Rachel gave Jacob her servant Bilhah as a wife, and he slept with her,
aov_text: Daarop het sy aan hom haar slavin Bilha as vrou gegee, en Jakob het by haar ingegaan.

kjv_text: And Bilhah conceived, and bare Jacob a son.
bsb_text: and Bilhah conceived and bore him a son.
aov_text: En Bilha het swanger geword en vir Jakob ’n seun gebaar.

kjv_text: And Rachel said, God hath judged me, and hath also heard my voice, and hath given me a son: therefore called she his name Dan.
bsb_text: Then Rachel said, “God has vindicated me; He has heard my plea and given me a son.” So she named him Dan.
aov_text: Toe sê Ragel: God het aan my reg verskaf en my ook verhoor en my ’n seun gegee. Daarom het sy hom Dan genoem.

kjv_text: And Bilhah Rachel's maid conceived again, and bare Jacob a second son.
bsb_text: And Rachel’s servant Bilhah conceived again and bore Jacob a second son.
aov_text: En Bilha, die slavin van Ragel, het weer bevrug geword en vir Jakob ’n tweede seun gebaar.

kjv_text: And Rachel said, With great wrestlings have I wrestled with my sister, and I have prevailed: and she called his name Naphtali.
bsb_text: Then Rachel said, “In my great struggles, I have wrestled with my sister and won.” So she named him Naphtali.
aov_text: Toe sê Ragel: Ek het bomenslike worstelinge met my suster geworstel en ook oorwin. En sy het hom Náftali genoem.

kjv_text: When Leah saw that she had left bearing, she took Zilpah her maid, and gave her Jacob to wife.
bsb_text: When Leah saw that she had stopped having children, she gave her servant Zilpah to Jacob as a wife.
aov_text: En toe Lea sien dat sy opgehou het met baar, neem sy haar slavin Silpa en gee haar aan Jakob as vrou.

kjv_text: And Zilpah Leah's maid bare Jacob a son.
bsb_text: And Leah’s servant Zilpah bore Jacob a son.
aov_text: En Silpa, die slavin van Lea, het vir Jakob ’n seun gebaar.

kjv_text: And Leah said, A troop cometh: and she called his name Gad.
bsb_text: Then Leah said, “How fortunate!” So she named him Gad.
aov_text: Toe sê Lea: Gelukkig! En sy het hom Gad genoem.

kjv_text: And Zilpah Leah's maid bare Jacob a second son.
bsb_text: When Leah’s servant Zilpah bore Jacob a second son,
aov_text: Daarna het Silpa, die slavin van Lea, vir Jakob ’n tweede seun gebaar.

kjv_text: And Leah said, Happy am I, for the daughters will call me blessed: and she called his name Asher.
bsb_text: Leah said, “How happy I am! For the women call me happy.” So she named him Asher.
aov_text: Toe sê Lea: Ek, gelukkige! want die dogters sal my gelukkig prys. En sy het hom Aser genoem.

kjv_text: And Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them unto his mother Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, Give me, I pray thee, of thy son's mandrakes.
bsb_text: Now during the wheat harvest, Reuben went out and found some mandrakes in the field. When he brought them to his mother, Rachel begged Leah, “Please give me some of your son’s mandrakes.”
aov_text: En Ruben het in die dae van die koringoes gegaan en in die veld liefdesappels gevind en dié na sy moeder Lea gebring. Toe sê Ragel vir Lea: Gee my tog van jou seun se liefdesappels.

kjv_text: And she said unto her, Is it a small matter that thou hast taken my husband? and wouldest thou take away my son's mandrakes also? And Rachel said, Therefore he shall lie with thee to night for thy son's mandrakes.
bsb_text: But Leah replied, “Is it not enough that you have taken away my husband? Now you want to take my son’s mandrakes as well?” “Very well,” said Rachel, “he may sleep with you tonight in exchange for your son’s mandrakes.”
aov_text: Maar sy antwoord haar: Is dit nie genoeg dat jy my man geneem het nie, dat jy ook my seun se liefdesappels wil neem? En Ragel sê: Daarom mag hy vir jou seun se liefdesappels vannag by jou slaap.

kjv_text: And Jacob came out of the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him, and said, Thou must come in unto me; for surely I have hired thee with my son's mandrakes. And he lay with her that night.
bsb_text: When Jacob came in from the field that evening, Leah went out to meet him and said, “You must come with me, for I have hired you with my son’s mandrakes.” So he slept with her that night.
aov_text: Toe Jakob dan die aand uit die veld kom, gaan Lea hom tegemoet met die woorde: Jy moet na mý kom, want ek het jou eerlik gehuur vir my seun se liefdesappels. En hy het dié nag by haar geslaap.

kjv_text: And God hearkened unto Leah, and she conceived, and bare Jacob the fifth son.
bsb_text: And God listened to Leah, and she conceived and bore a fifth son to Jacob.
aov_text: En God het Lea verhoor: sy het bevrug geword en vir Jakob ’n vyfde seun gebaar.

kjv_text: And Leah said, God hath given me my hire, because I have given my maiden to my husband: and she called his name Issachar.
bsb_text: Then Leah said, “God has rewarded me for giving my maidservant to my husband.” So she named him Issachar.
aov_text: Toe sê Lea: God het my loon gegee, omdat ek my slavin aan my man gegee het. En sy het hom Íssaskar genoem.

kjv_text: And Leah conceived again, and bare Jacob the sixth son.
bsb_text: Again Leah conceived and bore a sixth son to Jacob.
aov_text: En Lea het weer bevrug geword en vir Jakob ’n sesde seun gebaar.

kjv_text: And Leah said, God hath endued me with a good dowry; now will my husband dwell with me, because I have born him six sons: and she called his name Zebulun.
bsb_text: “God has given me a good gift,” she said. “This time my husband will honor me, because I have borne him six sons.” And she named him Zebulun.
aov_text: Toe sê Lea: God het my ’n mooi geskenk gegee; nou sal my man eindelik by my woon, want ek het vir hom ses seuns gebaar. En sy het hom Sébulon genoem.

kjv_text: And afterwards she bare a daughter, and called her name Dinah.
bsb_text: After that, Leah gave birth to a daughter and named her Dinah.
aov_text: En daarna het sy ’n dogter gebaar en haar Dina genoem.

kjv_text: And God remembered Rachel, and God hearkened to her, and opened her womb.
bsb_text: Then God remembered Rachel. He listened to her and opened her womb,
aov_text: En God het aan Ragel gedink, en God het haar verhoor en haar skoot geopen:

kjv_text: And she conceived, and bare a son; and said, God hath taken away my reproach:
bsb_text: and she conceived and gave birth to a son. “God has taken away my shame,” she said.
aov_text: sy het bevrug geword en ’n seun gebaar. Toe sê sy: God het my smaad weggeneem.

kjv_text: And she called his name Joseph; and said, The LORD shall add to me another son.
bsb_text: She named him Joseph, and said, “May the LORD add to me another son.”
aov_text: En sy het hom Josef genoem en gesê: Mag die HERE vir my ’n ander seun daar byvoeg!

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when Rachel had born Joseph, that Jacob said unto Laban, Send me away, that I may go unto mine own place, and to my country.
bsb_text: Now after Rachel had given birth to Joseph, Jacob said to Laban, “Send me on my way so I can return to my homeland.
aov_text: En nadat Ragel Josef gebaar het, sê Jakob vir Laban: Laat my trek, dat ek na my woonplek en my land kan gaan.

kjv_text: Give me my wives and my children, for whom I have served thee, and let me go: for thou knowest my service which I have done thee.
bsb_text: Give me my wives and children for whom I have served you, that I may go on my way. You know how hard I have worked for you.”
aov_text: Gee my vroue en my kinders waarvoor ek u gedien het, dat ek kan gaan; want u weet self hoe ek u gedien het.

kjv_text: And Laban said unto him, I pray thee, if I have found favour in thine eyes, tarry: for I have learned by experience that the LORD hath blessed me for thy sake.
bsb_text: But Laban replied, “If I have found favor in your eyes, please stay. I have learned by divination that the LORD has blessed me because of you.”
aov_text: Daarop antwoord Laban hom: As ek nou guns in jou oë gevind het—ek het waargeneem dat die HERE my om jou ontwil geseën het.

kjv_text: And he said, Appoint me thy wages, and I will give it.
bsb_text: And he added, “Name your wages, and I will pay them.”
aov_text: Verder sê hy: Bepaal vir my jou loon, en ek sal dit gee.

kjv_text: And he said unto him, Thou knowest how I have served thee, and how thy cattle was with me.
bsb_text: Then Jacob answered, “You know how I have served you and how your livestock have thrived under my care.
aov_text: Toe antwoord hy hom: U weet self hoe ek u gedien het en wat u vee by my geword het.

kjv_text: For it was little which thou hadst before I came, and it is now increased unto a multitude; and the LORD hath blessed thee since my coming: and now when shall I provide for mine own house also?
bsb_text: Indeed, you had very little before my arrival, but now your wealth has increased many times over. The LORD has blessed you wherever I set foot. But now, when may I also provide for my own household?”
aov_text: Want min was dit wat u vóór my koms gehad het, en dit het sterk vermeerder; en die HERE het u geseën op my voetspoor. Wanneer sal ek dan nou ook vir my huis werk?

kjv_text: And he said, What shall I give thee? And Jacob said, Thou shalt not give me any thing: if thou wilt do this thing for me, I will again feed and keep thy flock.
bsb_text: “What can I give you?” Laban asked. “You do not need to give me anything,” Jacob replied. “If you do this one thing for me, I will keep on shepherding and keeping your flocks.
aov_text: En hy vra: Wat moet ek jou gee? Toe antwoord Jakob: U hoef my niks te gee nie. As u hierdie ding vir my wil doen, wil ek weer u kleinvee oppas, ja, versorg—

kjv_text: I will pass through all thy flock to day, removing from thence all the speckled and spotted cattle, and all the brown cattle among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats: and of such shall be my hire.
bsb_text: Let me go through all your flocks today and remove from them every speckled or spotted sheep, every dark-colored lamb, and every spotted or speckled goat. These will be my wages.
