aov_text: ek sal vandag deur al u kleinvee deurgaan en daaruit al die gestippelde en bont vee uitkeer; al die vee onder die skaaplammers wat swart is, en die bontes en gestippeldes onder die bokke, dit moet my loon wees.

kjv_text: So shall my righteousness answer for me in time to come, when it shall come for my hire before thy face: every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and brown among the sheep, that shall be counted stolen with me.
bsb_text: So my honesty will testify for me when you come to check on my wages in the future. If I have any goats that are not speckled or spotted, or any lambs that are not dark-colored, they will be considered stolen.”
aov_text: En my regverdigheid sal later vír my getuig: as u kom om my loon na te gaan, sal alles wat nie gestippel of bont is onder die bokke, en wat nie swart is onder die skaaplammers nie, gesteelde goed by my wees.

kjv_text: And Laban said, Behold, I would it might be according to thy word.
bsb_text: “Agreed,” said Laban. “Let it be as you have said.”
aov_text: Toe antwoord Laban: Goed, laat dit wees volgens jou woord!

kjv_text: And he removed that day the he goats that were ringstraked and spotted, and all the she goats that were speckled and spotted, and every one that had some white in it, and all the brown among the sheep, and gave them into the hand of his sons.
bsb_text: That very day Laban removed all the streaked or spotted male goats and every speckled or spotted female goat—every one that had any white on it—and every dark-colored lamb, and he placed them under the care of his sons.
aov_text: En hy het dieselfde dag uitgekeer die gestreepte en bont bokke en al die gestippelde en bont bokooie, almal wat wit aan hulle gehad het, en almal wat swart was onder die skaaplammers, en dié aan sy seuns afgegee.

kjv_text: And he set three days' journey betwixt himself and Jacob: and Jacob fed the rest of Laban's flocks.
bsb_text: Then he put a three-day journey between himself and Jacob, while Jacob was shepherding the rest of Laban’s flocks.
aov_text: En hy het ’n afstand van drie dae bepaal tussen hom en Jakob; en Jakob het die orige kleinvee van Laban opgepas.

kjv_text: And Jacob took him rods of green poplar, and of the hazel and chestnut tree; and pilled white strakes in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.
bsb_text: Jacob, however, took fresh branches of poplar, almond, and plane trees, and peeled the bark, exposing the white inner wood of the branches.
aov_text: Toe neem Jakob vir hom groen latte van populier-, amandel- en plataanhout, en hy skil daarin wit strepe, sodat die wit van die latte uitkom;

kjv_text: And he set the rods which he had pilled before the flocks in the gutters in the watering troughs when the flocks came to drink, that they should conceive when they came to drink.
bsb_text: Then he set the peeled branches in the watering troughs in front of the flocks coming in to drink. So when the flocks were in heat and came to drink,
aov_text: en hy sit die latte wat hy geskil het, vlak voor die vee in die trogge, in die drinkbakke waar die vee kom drink het; en hulle het verhit geword as hulle kom drink.

kjv_text: And the flocks conceived before the rods, and brought forth cattle ringstraked, speckled, and spotted.
bsb_text: they mated in front of the branches. And they bore young that were streaked or speckled or spotted.
aov_text: En die vee het verhit geword by die latte, en die vee het gelam gestreeptes, gestippeldes en bontes.

kjv_text: And Jacob did separate the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the ringstraked, and all the brown in the flock of Laban; and he put his own flocks by themselves, and put them not unto Laban's cattle.
bsb_text: Jacob set apart the young, but made the rest face the streaked dark-colored sheep in Laban’s flocks. Then he set his own stock apart and did not put them with Laban’s animals.
aov_text: Toe skei Jakob die lammers, en hy draai die koppe van die vee na die gestreeptes en almal wat swart was onder Laban se vee. En hy het vir hom afsonderlike troppe gemaak en dié nie onder Laban se vee gesit nie.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, whensoever the stronger cattle did conceive, that Jacob laid the rods before the eyes of the cattle in the gutters, that they might conceive among the rods.
bsb_text: Whenever the stronger females of the flock were in heat, Jacob would place the branches in the troughs, in full view of the animals, so that they would breed in front of the branches.
aov_text: En elke keer as die sterkste diere verhit word, sit Jakob die latte voor die oë van die vee in die trogge, sodat hulle verhit sou word by die latte.

kjv_text: But when the cattle were feeble, he put them not in: so the feebler were Laban's, and the stronger Jacob's.
bsb_text: But if the animals were weak, he did not set out the branches. So the weaker animals went to Laban and the stronger ones to Jacob.
aov_text: Maar as die vee swakkerig was, het hy dit nie ingesit nie; so was dan die swakkes vir Laban en die sterkes vir Jakob.

kjv_text: And the man increased exceedingly, and had much cattle, and maidservants, and menservants, and camels, and asses.
bsb_text: Thus Jacob became exceedingly prosperous. He owned large flocks, maidservants and menservants, and camels and donkeys.
aov_text: En die man het buitengewoon uitgebrei en baie kleinvee en slavinne en slawe en kamele en esels gehad.

kjv_text: And he heard the words of Laban's sons, saying, Jacob hath taken away all that was our father's; and of that which was our father's hath he gotten all this glory.
bsb_text: Now Jacob heard that Laban’s sons were saying, “Jacob has taken away all that belonged to our father and built all this wealth at our father’s expense.”
aov_text: TOE hoor hy die woorde van die seuns van Laban, dat hulle sê: Jakob het alles geneem wat ons vader s’n was; en uit wat ons vader s’n was, het hy al hierdie rykdom verwerf.

kjv_text: And Jacob beheld the countenance of Laban, and, behold, it was not toward him as before.
bsb_text: And Jacob saw from the countenance of Laban that his attitude toward him had changed.
aov_text: Jakob het ook meteens aan die aangesig van Laban gesien dat hy nie meer vir hom was soos gister en eergister nie.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Jacob, Return unto the land of thy fathers, and to thy kindred; and I will be with thee.
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to Jacob, “Go back to the land of your fathers and to your kindred, and I will be with you.”
aov_text: En die HERE het aan Jakob gesê: Gaan terug na die land van jou vaders en na jou familie; en Ek sal met jou wees.

kjv_text: And Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field unto his flock,
bsb_text: So Jacob sent word and called Rachel and Leah to the field where his flocks were,
aov_text: Toe stuur Jakob en laat Ragel en Lea veld toe roep na sy kleinvee

kjv_text: And said unto them, I see your father's countenance, that it is not toward me as before; but the God of my father hath been with me.
bsb_text: and he told them, “I can see from your father’s countenance that his attitude toward me has changed; but the God of my father has been with me.
aov_text: en sê vir hulle: Ek sien dat die aangesig van julle vader teenoor my nie meer is soos gister en eergister nie, maar die God van my vader was met my.

kjv_text: And ye know that with all my power I have served your father.
bsb_text: You know that I have served your father with all my strength.
aov_text: En julle weet self dat ek met al my krag julle vader gedien het;

kjv_text: And your father hath deceived me, and changed my wages ten times; but God suffered him not to hurt me.
bsb_text: And although he has cheated me and changed my wages ten times, God has not allowed him to harm me.
aov_text: maar julle vader het my bedrieg: hy het my loon tien maal verander. Maar God het hom nie toegelaat om my skade aan te doen nie.

kjv_text: If he said thus, The speckled shall be thy wages; then all the cattle bare speckled: and if he said thus, The ringstraked shall be thy hire; then bare all the cattle ringstraked.
bsb_text: If he said, ‘The speckled will be your wages,’ then the whole flock bore speckled offspring. If he said, ‘The streaked will be your wages,’ then the whole flock bore streaked offspring.
aov_text: As hy sê: Die gestippeldes sal jou loon wees, dan lam al die vee gestippeldes. En as hy sê: Die gestreeptes sal jou loon wees, dan lam al die vee gestreeptes.

kjv_text: Thus God hath taken away the cattle of your father, and given them to me.
bsb_text: Thus God has taken away your father’s livestock and given them to me.
aov_text: So het God dan die vee van julle vader weggeneem en aan my gegee.

kjv_text: And it came to pass at the time that the cattle conceived, that I lifted up mine eyes, and saw in a dream, and, behold, the rams which leaped upon the cattle were ringstraked, speckled, and grisled.
bsb_text: When the flocks were breeding, I saw in a dream that the streaked, spotted, and speckled males were mating with the females.
aov_text: Eenkeer, in die tyd toe die kleinvee verhit was, het ek my oë opgeslaan en in ’n droom gesien dat die bokramme wat die kleinvee dek, gestreep, gestippeld en bont was.

kjv_text: And the angel of God spake unto me in a dream, saying, Jacob: And I said, Here am I.
bsb_text: In that dream the angel of God said to me, ‘Jacob!’ And I replied, ‘Here I am.’
aov_text: En die Engel van God sê vir my in die droom: Jakob! En ek antwoord: Hier is ek!

kjv_text: And he said, Lift up now thine eyes, and see, all the rams which leap upon the cattle are ringstraked, speckled, and grisled: for I have seen all that Laban doeth unto thee.
bsb_text: ‘Look up,’ he said, ‘and see that all the males that are mating with the flock are streaked, spotted, or speckled; for I have seen all that Laban has done to you.
aov_text: En Hy sê: Slaan tog jou oë op en kyk: al die bokramme wat die kleinvee dek, is gestreep, gestippeld en bont, want Ek het alles gesien wat Laban jou aandoen.

kjv_text: I am the God of Bethel, where thou anointedst the pillar, and where thou vowedst a vow unto me: now arise, get thee out from this land, and return unto the land of thy kindred.
bsb_text: I am the God of Bethel, where you anointed the pillar and made a solemn vow to Me. Now get up and leave this land at once, and return to your native land.’”
aov_text: Ek is die God van Bet-el waar jy die gedenksteen gesalf het, waar jy aan My ’n gelofte gedoen het. Maak jou dan nou klaar, trek weg uit hierdie land en gaan terug na jou geboorteland.

kjv_text: And Rachel and Leah answered and said unto him, Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father's house?
bsb_text: And Rachel and Leah replied, “Do we have any portion or inheritance left in our father’s house?
aov_text: Toe antwoord Ragel en Lea en sê vir hom: Het ons nog deel of erfenis in die huis van ons vader?

kjv_text: Are we not counted of him strangers? for he hath sold us, and hath quite devoured also our money.
bsb_text: Are we not regarded by him as outsiders? Not only has he sold us, but he has certainly squandered what was paid for us.
aov_text: Word ons nie deur hom as vreemdelinge beskou nie? Want hy het ons verkoop en die geld wat deur ons verkry is, geheel en al deurgebring.

kjv_text: For all the riches which God hath taken from our father, that is ours, and our children's: now then, whatsoever God hath said unto thee, do.
bsb_text: Surely all the wealth that God has taken away from our father belongs to us and to our children. So do whatever God has told you.”
aov_text: Want al die rykdom wat God van ons vader weggeneem het, kom ons en ons kinders toe. Doen dan nou alles wat God jou gesê het.

kjv_text: Then Jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives upon camels;
bsb_text: Then Jacob got up and put his children and his wives on camels,
aov_text: Toe maak Jakob hom klaar en laai sy kinders en sy vroue op die kamele,

kjv_text: And he carried away all his cattle, and all his goods which he had gotten, the cattle of his getting, which he had gotten in Padanaram, for to go to Isaac his father in the land of Canaan.
bsb_text: and he drove all his livestock before him, along with all the possessions he had acquired in Paddan-aram, to go to his father Isaac in the land in Canaan.
aov_text: en hy voer al sy vee weg en al sy goed wat hy versamel het, die vee wat syne was, wat hy in Paddan-Aram versamel het, om te gaan na sy vader Isak in die land Kanaän.

kjv_text: And Laban went to shear his sheep: and Rachel had stolen the images that were her father's.
bsb_text: Now while Laban was out shearing his sheep, Rachel stole her father’s household idols.
aov_text: Onderwyl Laban gaan om sy kleinvee te skeer, het Ragel die huisgode van haar vader gesteel.

kjv_text: And Jacob stole away unawares to Laban the Syrian, in that he told him not that he fled.
bsb_text: Moreover, Jacob deceived Laban the Aramean by not telling him that he was running away.
aov_text: En Jakob het Laban, die Arameër, mislei deur hom nie te vertel dat hy wou vlug nie.

kjv_text: So he fled with all that he had; and he rose up, and passed over the river, and set his face toward the mount Gilead.
bsb_text: So he fled with all his possessions, crossed the Euphrates, and headed for the hill country of Gilead.
aov_text: So het hy dan gevlug met alles wat hy gehad het: hy het hom klaargemaak en deur die Eufraat gegaan en sy aangesig gerig na die gebergte van Gílead.

kjv_text: And it was told Laban on the third day that Jacob was fled.
bsb_text: On the third day Laban was informed that Jacob had fled.
aov_text: En op die derde dag kry Laban die tyding dat Jakob gevlug het.

kjv_text: And he took his brethren with him, and pursued after him seven days' journey; and they overtook him in the mount Gilead.
bsb_text: So he took his relatives with him, pursued Jacob for seven days, and overtook him in the hill country of Gilead.
aov_text: Daarop het hy sy broers saam met hom geneem en hom agternagejaag, ’n afstand van sewe dae, en hom ingehaal in die gebergte van Gílead.

kjv_text: And God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream by night, and said unto him, Take heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.
bsb_text: But that night God came to Laban the Aramean in a dream and warned him, “Be careful not to say anything to Jacob, either good or bad.”
aov_text: Maar God het na Laban, die Arameër, in die nag gekom in ’n droom en vir hom gesê: Pas nou op dat jy met Jakob geen goed of kwaad spreek nie.

kjv_text: Then Laban overtook Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mount: and Laban with his brethren pitched in the mount of Gilead.
bsb_text: Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the hill country of Gilead when Laban overtook him, and Laban and his relatives camped there as well.
aov_text: En Laban het Jakob ingehaal; Jakob het sy tent al opgeslaan gehad in die gebergte, en Laban met sy broers het dit opgeslaan in die gebergte van Gílead.

kjv_text: And Laban said to Jacob, What hast thou done, that thou hast stolen away unawares to me, and carried away my daughters, as captives taken with the sword?
bsb_text: Then Laban said to Jacob, “What have you done? You have deceived me and carried off my daughters like captives of war!
aov_text: Toe vra Laban vir Jakob: Wat het jy gedoen dat jy my mislei en my dogters soos krygsgevangenes weggevoer het?

kjv_text: Wherefore didst thou flee away secretly, and steal away from me; and didst not tell me, that I might have sent thee away with mirth, and with songs, with tabret, and with harp?
bsb_text: Why did you run away secretly and deceive me, without even telling me? I would have sent you away with joy and singing, with tambourines and harps.
aov_text: Waarom het jy stilletjies gevlug en my mislei en my dit nie vertel nie, dat ek jou met vrolikheid en liedere, met tamboeryn en siter kon weggebring het?

kjv_text: And hast not suffered me to kiss my sons and my daughters? thou hast now done foolishly in so doing.
bsb_text: But you did not even let me kiss my grandchildren and my daughters goodbye. Now you have done a foolish thing.
aov_text: Ook het jy my nie toegelaat om my seuns en dogters te soen nie. Nou het jy dwaas gehandel.

kjv_text: It is in the power of my hand to do you hurt: but the God of your father spake unto me yesternight, saying, Take thou heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.
bsb_text: I have power to do you great harm, but last night the God of your father said to me, ‘Be careful not to say anything to Jacob, either good or bad.’
aov_text: Dit is in my mag om julle skade aan te doen, maar die God van julle vader het verlede nag met my gespreek en gesê: Pas nou op om met Jakob geen goed of kwaad te spreek nie.

kjv_text: And now, though thou wouldest needs be gone, because thou sore longedst after thy father's house, yet wherefore hast thou stolen my gods?
bsb_text: Now you have gone off because you long for your father’s house. But why have you stolen my gods?”
aov_text: Nou is jy dan eenmaal aan trek, omdat jy so erg verlang het na die huis van jou vader—maar waarom het jy my gode gesteel?

kjv_text: And Jacob answered and said to Laban, Because I was afraid: for I said, Peradventure thou wouldest take by force thy daughters from me.
bsb_text: “I was afraid,” Jacob answered, “for I thought you would take your daughters from me by force.
aov_text: Toe antwoord Jakob en sê vir Laban: Omdat ek bevrees was, want ek het gedink u sal miskien u dogters met geweld van my wegneem.

kjv_text: With whomsoever thou findest thy gods, let him not live: before our brethren discern thou what is thine with me, and take it to thee. For Jacob knew not that Rachel had stolen them.
bsb_text: If you find your gods with anyone here, he shall not live! In the presence of our relatives, see for yourself if anything is yours, and take it back.” For Jacob did not know that Rachel had stolen the idols.
aov_text: Die een by wie u u gode vind—hy mag nie lewe nie! Ondersoek wat by my is, in teenwoordigheid van ons broers, en neem dit vir u. Maar Jakob het nie geweet dat Ragel dit gesteel het nie.

kjv_text: And Laban went into Jacob's tent, and into Leah's tent, and into the two maidservants' tents; but he found them not. Then went he out of Leah's tent, and entered into Rachel's tent.
bsb_text: So Laban went into Jacob’s tent, then Leah’s tent, and then the tents of the two maidservants, but he found nothing. Then he left Leah’s tent and entered Rachel’s tent.
aov_text: Toe gaan Laban in die tent van Jakob en in die tent van Lea en in die tent van die twee slavinne, maar hy het niks gekry nie; en toe hy uit die tent van Lea uitgaan, kom hy in die tent van Ragel.

kjv_text: Now Rachel had taken the images, and put them in the camel's furniture, and sat upon them. And Laban searched all the tent, but found them not.
bsb_text: Now Rachel had taken Laban’s household idols, put them in the saddlebag of her camel, and was sitting on them. And Laban searched everything in the tent but found nothing.
aov_text: Maar Ragel het die huisgode geneem en dit in die kameelsaal weggepak en daarop gaan sit. En Laban het die hele tent deurgevoel, maar niks gekry nie.

kjv_text: And she said to her father, Let it not displease my lord that I cannot rise up before thee; for the custom of women is upon me. And he searched, but found not the images.
bsb_text: Rachel said to her father, “Sir, do not be angry that I cannot stand up before you; for I am having my period.” So Laban searched, but could not find the household idols.
aov_text: Daarop sê sy vir haar vader: My heer moet nie baie kwaai kyk nie, omdat ek nie vir u kan opstaan nie; want dit gaan met my volgens die reël van die vroue. En hy het gesoek maar die huisgode nie gekry nie.

kjv_text: And Jacob was wroth, and chode with Laban: and Jacob answered and said to Laban, What is my trespass? what is my sin, that thou hast so hotly pursued after me?
bsb_text: Then Jacob became incensed and challenged Laban. “What is my crime?” he said. “For what sin of mine have you so hotly pursued me?
aov_text: Toe word Jakob kwaad, en hy het met Laban getwis; en Jakob het geantwoord en vir Laban gesê: Wat is my oortreding, wat is my sonde, dat u my so vurig agternagesit het?

kjv_text: Whereas thou hast searched all my stuff, what hast thou found of all thy household stuff? set it here before my brethren and thy brethren, that they may judge betwixt us both.
bsb_text: You have searched all my goods! Have you found anything that belongs to you? Put it here before my brothers and yours, that they may judge between the two of us.
aov_text: Nou dat u al my goed deurgevoel het—wat het u van al u huisraad gevind? Sit dit hier neer voor my broers en u broers, en laat hulle oordeel tussen ons twee.

kjv_text: This twenty years have I been with thee; thy ewes and thy she goats have not cast their young, and the rams of thy flock have I not eaten.
bsb_text: I have been with you for twenty years now. Your sheep and goats have not miscarried, nor have I eaten the rams of your flock.
aov_text: Twintig jaar was ek nou by u. U skaap- en bokooie het geen misdrag gehad nie, en die ramme van u kleinvee het ek nie geëet nie.

kjv_text: That which was torn of beasts I brought not unto thee; I bare the loss of it; of my hand didst thou require it, whether stolen by day, or stolen by night.
bsb_text: I did not bring you anything torn by wild beasts; I bore the loss myself. And you demanded payment from me for what was stolen by day or night.
aov_text: Wat die wilde diere verskeur het, het ek nie na u gebring nie: ek moes dit vergoed; van my hand het u dit geëis, of dit al bedags gesteel is of snags gesteel is.

kjv_text: Thus I was; in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep departed from mine eyes.
bsb_text: As it was, the heat consumed me by day and the frost by night, and sleep fled from my eyes.
aov_text: Ek was ’n man wat bedags deur die hitte verteer is en snags deur die koue, en my slaap het gevlug van my oë.

kjv_text: Thus have I been twenty years in thy house; I served thee fourteen years for thy two daughters, and six years for thy cattle: and thou hast changed my wages ten times.
bsb_text: Thus for twenty years I have served in your household—fourteen years for your two daughters and six years for your flocks—and you have changed my wages ten times!
aov_text: Twintig jaar was ek nou in u huis; veertien jaar het ek u gedien vir u twee dogters en ses jaar vir u kleinvee; en u het my loon tien maal verander.

kjv_text: Except the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely thou hadst sent me away now empty. God hath seen mine affliction and the labour of my hands, and rebuked thee yesternight.
bsb_text: If the God of my father, the God of Abraham and the Fear of Isaac, had not been with me, surely by now you would have sent me away empty-handed. But God has seen my affliction and the toil of my hands, and last night He rendered judgment.”
aov_text: As die God van my vader, die God van Abraham en die Vrees van Isak, nie aan my kant was nie—ja, dan sou u my met leë hande weggestuur het. God het my ellende en die moeitevolle arbeid van my hande aangesien en verlede nag geoordeel.

kjv_text: And Laban answered and said unto Jacob, These daughters are my daughters, and these children are my children, and these cattle are my cattle, and all that thou seest is mine: and what can I do this day unto these my daughters, or unto their children which they have born?
bsb_text: But Laban answered Jacob, “These daughters are my daughters, these sons are my sons, and these flocks are my flocks! Everything you see is mine! Yet what can I do today about these daughters of mine or the children they have borne?
aov_text: Toe antwoord Laban en sê vir Jakob: Die dogters is my dogters, en die seuns is my seuns, en die kleinvee is my kleinvee, ja, alles wat jy sien, is myne; maar my dogters—wat sal ek hulle vandag kan aandoen of aan hulle seuns wat hulle gebaar het?

kjv_text: Now therefore come thou, let us make a covenant, I and thou; and let it be for a witness between me and thee.
bsb_text: Come now, let us make a covenant, you and I, and let it serve as a witness between you and me.”
aov_text: Kom dan nou, laat ons ’n verbond sluit, ek en jy, dat dit ’n getuie tussen my en jou kan wees.

kjv_text: And Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar.
bsb_text: So Jacob picked out a stone and set it up as a pillar,
aov_text: Daarop het Jakob ’n klip geneem en dit as gedenksteen opgerig.

kjv_text: And Jacob said unto his brethren, Gather stones; and they took stones, and made an heap: and they did eat there upon the heap.
bsb_text: and he said to his relatives, “Gather some stones.” So they took stones and made a mound, and there by the mound they ate.
aov_text: En Jakob het aan sy broers gesê: Bring klippe bymekaar! En hulle het klippe gaan haal en ’n hoop gemaak en daar op die hoop geëet.

kjv_text: And Laban called it Jegarsahadutha: but Jacob called it Galeed.
bsb_text: Laban called it Jegar-sahadutha, and Jacob called it Galeed.
aov_text: En Laban het dit Jegar-Sahadúta genoem, maar Jakob het dit Gal-ed genoem.

kjv_text: And Laban said, This heap is a witness between me and thee this day. Therefore was the name of it called Galeed;
bsb_text: Then Laban declared, “This mound is a witness between you and me this day.” Therefore the place was called Galeed.
aov_text: Toe sê Laban: Hierdie hoop is vandag ’n getuie tussen my en jou. Daarom het hulle dit Gal-ed genoem,

kjv_text: And Mizpah; for he said, The LORD watch between me and thee, when we are absent one from another.
bsb_text: It was also called Mizpah, because Laban said, “May the LORD keep watch between you and me when we are absent from each other.
aov_text: en ook Mispa, omdat hy gesê het: Mag die HERE wag hou tussen my en jou as ons mekaar nie meer sien nie.

kjv_text: If thou shalt afflict my daughters, or if thou shalt take other wives beside my daughters, no man is with us; see, God is witness betwixt me and thee.
bsb_text: If you mistreat my daughters or take other wives, although no one is with us, remember that God is a witness between you and me.”
aov_text: As jy my dogters mishandel, en as jy vroue neem by my dogters, dan is geen mens by ons nie: kyk, God is getuie tussen my en jou.

kjv_text: And Laban said to Jacob, Behold this heap, and behold this pillar, which I have cast betwixt me and thee:
bsb_text: Laban also said to Jacob, “Here is the mound, and here is the pillar I have set up between you and me.
aov_text: Verder sê Laban vir Jakob: Daar is dié hoop klippe, en daar is die gedenksteen wat ek tussen my en jou opgerig het—

kjv_text: This heap be witness, and this pillar be witness, that I will not pass over this heap to thee, and that thou shalt not pass over this heap and this pillar unto me, for harm.
bsb_text: This mound is a witness, and this pillar is a witness, that I will not go past this mound to harm you, and you will not go past this mound and pillar to harm me.
aov_text: hierdie hoop klippe is getuie, en die gedenksteen is getuie dat ék na jou kant toe hierdie hoop nie sal verbytrek nie, en dat jý na my kant toe hierdie hoop en hierdie gedenksteen nie sal verbytrek met slegte bedoelinge nie.

kjv_text: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge betwixt us. And Jacob sware by the fear of his father Isaac.
bsb_text: May the God of Abraham and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge between us.” So Jacob swore by the Fear of his father Isaac.
aov_text: Die God van Abraham en die God van Nahor, die God van hulle vader, sal regter tussen ons wees. En Jakob het gesweer by die Vrees van sy vader Isak.

kjv_text: Then Jacob offered sacrifice upon the mount, and called his brethren to eat bread: and they did eat bread, and tarried all night in the mount.
bsb_text: Then Jacob offered a sacrifice on the mountain and invited his relatives to eat a meal. And after they had eaten, they spent the night on the mountain.
aov_text: Toe het Jakob ’n offer gebring op die gebergte en sy broers genooi om brood te eet. En hulle het brood geëet en die nag in die gebergte oorgebly.

kjv_text: And early in the morning Laban rose up, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them: and Laban departed, and returned unto his place.
bsb_text: Early the next morning, Laban got up and kissed his grandchildren and daughters and blessed them. Then he left to return home.
aov_text: En Laban het die môre vroeg opgestaan en sy seuns en sy dogters gesoen en hulle geseën. Daarna het Laban vertrek en teruggekeer na sy woonplek.

kjv_text: And Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.
bsb_text: Jacob also went on his way, and the angels of God met him.
aov_text: JAKOB het ook verder gereis, en die engele van God het hom ontmoet.

kjv_text: And when Jacob saw them, he said, This is God's host: and he called the name of that place Mahanaim.
bsb_text: When Jacob saw them, he said, “This is the camp of God.” So he named that place Mahanaim.
aov_text: Toe hy hulle sien, sê Jakob: Dit is ’n leër van God! En hy het die plek Mahanáim genoem.

kjv_text: And Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother unto the land of Seir, the country of Edom.
bsb_text: Jacob sent messengers ahead of him to his brother Esau in the land of Seir, the country of Edom.
aov_text: En Jakob het boodskappers uitgestuur voor hom uit na sy broer Esau in die land Seïr, die landstreek van Edom,

kjv_text: And he commanded them, saying, Thus shall ye speak unto my lord Esau; Thy servant Jacob saith thus, I have sojourned with Laban, and stayed there until now:
bsb_text: He instructed them, “You are to say to my master Esau, ‘Your servant Jacob says: I have been staying with Laban and have remained there until now.
aov_text: en aan hulle bevel gegee met die woorde: So moet julle aan my heer, aan Esau, sê: So sê Jakob, u dienaar—ek het as vreemdeling vertoef by Laban en daar gebly tot nou toe;

kjv_text: And I have oxen, and asses, flocks, and menservants, and womenservants: and I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find grace in thy sight.
bsb_text: I have oxen, donkeys, flocks, menservants, and maidservants. I have sent this message to inform my master, so that I may find favor in your sight.’”
aov_text: en ek het beeste en esels, kleinvee en slawe en slavinne verwerf, en my heer dit laat weet, sodat ek guns mag vind in u oë.

kjv_text: And the messengers returned to Jacob, saying, We came to thy brother Esau, and also he cometh to meet thee, and four hundred men with him.
bsb_text: When the messengers returned to Jacob, they said, “We went to your brother Esau, and now he is coming to meet you—he and four hundred men with him.”
aov_text: En die boodskappers het na Jakob teruggekom en gesê: Ons het by u broer Esau gekom, en hy trek u alreeds tegemoet en vierhonderd man saam met hom.

kjv_text: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and distressed: and he divided the people that was with him, and the flocks, and herds, and the camels, into two bands;
bsb_text: In great fear and distress, Jacob divided his people into two camps, as well as the flocks and herds and camels.
aov_text: Toe het Jakob baie bevrees en benoud geword, en hy het die mense wat by hom was, sowel as die kleinvee en beeste en kamele in twee laers verdeel;

kjv_text: And said, If Esau come to the one company, and smite it, then the other company which is left shall escape.
bsb_text: He thought, “If Esau comes and attacks one camp, then the other camp can escape.”
aov_text: want hy het gedink: As Esau op die een laer afkom en dit verslaan, sal die laer wat oorbly, vryraak.

kjv_text: And Jacob said, O God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, the LORD which saidst unto me, Return unto thy country, and to thy kindred, and I will deal well with thee:
bsb_text: Then Jacob declared, “O God of my father Abraham, God of my father Isaac, the LORD who told me, ‘Go back to your country and to your kindred, and I will make you prosper,’
aov_text: En Jakob het gesê: o God van my vader Abraham en God van my vader Isak, o HERE, wat my beveel het: Gaan terug na jou land en na jou familie, en Ek sal aan jou goed doen—

kjv_text: I am not worthy of the least of all the mercies, and of all the truth, which thou hast shewed unto thy servant; for with my staff I passed over this Jordan; and now I am become two bands.
bsb_text: I am unworthy of all the kindness and faithfulness You have shown Your servant. Indeed, with only my staff I came across the Jordan, but now I have become two camps.
aov_text: ek is te gering vir al die gunste en al die trou wat U aan u kneg bewys het; want ek het met my staf oor hierdie Jordaan getrek en nou twee laers geword.

kjv_text: Deliver me, I pray thee, from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau: for I fear him, lest he will come and smite me, and the mother with the children.
bsb_text: Please deliver me from the hand of my brother Esau, for I am afraid that he may come and attack me and the mothers and children with me.
aov_text: Red my tog uit die hand van my broer, uit die hand van Esau, want ek is bang vir hom, dat hy sal kom en my doodslaan, die moeder saam met die kinders.

kjv_text: And thou saidst, I will surely do thee good, and make thy seed as the sand of the sea, which cannot be numbered for multitude.
bsb_text: But You have said, ‘I will surely make you prosper, and I will make your offspring like the sand of the sea, too numerous to count.’”
aov_text: U het tog self gesê: Ek sal sekerlik aan jou goed doen en jou nageslag maak soos die sand van die see wat vanweë die menigte nie getel kan word nie.

kjv_text: And he lodged there that same night; and took of that which came to his hand a present for Esau his brother;
bsb_text: Jacob spent the night there, and from what he had brought with him, he selected a gift for his brother Esau:
aov_text: En hy het die nag daar oorgebly en van wat in sy besit was, ’n geskenk geneem vir sy broer Esau:

kjv_text: Two hundred she goats, and twenty he goats, two hundred ewes, and twenty rams,
bsb_text: 200 female goats, 20 male goats, 200 ewes, 20 rams,
aov_text: tweehonderd bokooie en twintig bokke, tweehonderd skaapooie en twintig ramme,

kjv_text: Thirty milch camels with their colts, forty kine, and ten bulls, twenty she asses, and ten foals.
bsb_text: 30 milk camels with their young, 40 cows, 10 bulls, 20 female donkeys, and 10 male donkeys.
aov_text: dertig kameelkoeie wat in die melk was, met hulle kalfies, veertig koeie en tien bulle, twintig eselinne en tien jong esels;

kjv_text: And he delivered them into the hand of his servants, every drove by themselves; and said unto his servants, Pass over before me, and put a space betwixt drove and drove.
bsb_text: He entrusted them to his servants in separate herds and told them, “Go on ahead of me, and keep some distance between the herds.”
aov_text: en hy het hulle aan sy dienaars afgegee, elke trop afsonderlik, en aan sy dienaars gesê: Trek voor my uit, en laat ’n plek oop tussen trop en trop.

kjv_text: And he commanded the foremost, saying, When Esau my brother meeteth thee, and asketh thee, saying, Whose art thou? and whither goest thou? and whose are these before thee?
bsb_text: He instructed the one in the lead, “When my brother Esau meets you and asks, ‘To whom do you belong, where are you going, and whose animals are these before you?’
aov_text: Daarop gee hy aan die eerste een bevel en sê: As my broer Esau jou teëkom en jou vra: Aan wie behoort jy, en waarheen gaan jy, en wie s’n is die goed daar voor jou?

kjv_text: Then thou shalt say, They be thy servant Jacob's; it is a present sent unto my lord Esau: and, behold, also he is behind us.
bsb_text: then you are to say, ‘They belong to your servant Jacob. They are a gift, sent to my lord Esau. And behold, Jacob is behind us.’”
aov_text: dan moet jy antwoord: U dienaar Jakob s’n. Dit is ’n geskenk wat hy aan my heer Esau stuur; en kyk, hy self kom ook agter ons aan.

kjv_text: And so commanded he the second, and the third, and all that followed the droves, saying, On this manner shall ye speak unto Esau, when ye find him.
bsb_text: He also instructed the second, the third, and all those following behind the herds: “When you meet Esau, you are to say the same thing to him.
aov_text: En hy het ook bevel gegee aan die tweede en aan die derde en aan almal wat agter die troppe geloop het, en gesê: Net so moet julle Esau antwoord as julle hom kry—

kjv_text: And say ye moreover, Behold, thy servant Jacob is behind us. For he said, I will appease him with the present that goeth before me, and afterward I will see his face; peradventure he will accept of me.
bsb_text: You are also to say, ‘Look, your servant Jacob is right behind us.’” For he thought, “I will appease Esau with the gift that is going before me. After that I can face him, and perhaps he will accept me.”
aov_text: julle moet sê: Kyk, ook u dienaar Jakob kom agter ons aan. Want hy het gedink: Laat ek hom versoen met die geskenk wat voor my uit gaan, en daarna sy aangesig sien—miskien sal hy my in guns aanneem.

kjv_text: So went the present over before him: and himself lodged that night in the company.
bsb_text: So Jacob’s gifts went on before him, while he spent the night in the camp.
aov_text: So het die geskenk dan voor hom uit gegaan, maar hy self het dié nag in die laer gebly.

kjv_text: And he rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two womenservants, and his eleven sons, and passed over the ford Jabbok.
bsb_text: During the night Jacob got up and took his two wives, his two maidservants, and his eleven sons, and crossed the ford of the Jabbok.
aov_text: En hy het dieselfde nag opgestaan en sy twee vroue en sy twee slavinne en sy elf kinders geneem en deur die drif van die Jabbok getrek:

kjv_text: And he took them, and sent them over the brook, and sent over that he had.
bsb_text: He took them and sent them across the stream, along with all his possessions.
aov_text: hy het hulle geneem en hulle deur die rivier laat trek, ook laat deurtrek wat aan hom behoort het.

kjv_text: And Jacob was left alone; and there wrestled a man with him until the breaking of the day.
bsb_text: So Jacob was left all alone, and there a man wrestled with him until daybreak.
aov_text: Maar Jakob het alleen agtergebly, en ’n Man het met hom geworstel tot dagbreek.

kjv_text: And when he saw that he prevailed not against him, he touched the hollow of his thigh; and the hollow of Jacob's thigh was out of joint, as he wrestled with him.
bsb_text: When the man saw that he could not overpower Jacob, he struck the socket of Jacob’s hip and dislocated it as they wrestled.
aov_text: En toe Hy sien dat Hy hom nie kon oorwin nie, slaan Hy hom op sy heupbeen, sodat die heupbeen van Jakob uit lit geraak het in die worsteling met Hom.

kjv_text: And he said, Let me go, for the day breaketh. And he said, I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.
bsb_text: Then the man said, “Let me go, for it is daybreak.” But Jacob replied, “I will not let you go unless you bless me.”
aov_text: Toe sê Hy: Laat My gaan, want die dag het gebreek. Maar hy antwoord: Ek sal U nie laat gaan nie tensy dat U my seën.

kjv_text: And he said unto him, What is thy name? And he said, Jacob.
bsb_text: “What is your name?” the man asked. “Jacob,” he replied.
aov_text: En Hy vra hom: Hoe is jou naam? En hy antwoord: Jakob.

kjv_text: And he said, Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men, and hast prevailed.
bsb_text: Then the man said, “Your name will no longer be Jacob, but Israel, because you have struggled with God and with men, and you have prevailed.”
aov_text: Toe sê Hy: Jy sal nie meer Jakob genoem word nie, maar Israel; want jy het geworstel met God en met die mense en het oorwin.

kjv_text: And Jacob asked him, and said, Tell me, I pray thee, thy name. And he said, Wherefore is it that thou dost ask after my name? And he blessed him there.
bsb_text: And Jacob requested, “Please tell me your name.” But he replied, “Why do you ask my name?” Then he blessed Jacob there.
aov_text: Daarop vra Jakob en sê: Maak tog u Naam bekend! En Hy antwoord: Waarom vra jy tog na my Naam? En Hy het hom daar geseën.

kjv_text: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: for I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.
bsb_text: So Jacob named the place Peniel, saying, “Indeed, I have seen God face to face, and yet my life was spared.”
aov_text: Toe noem Jakob die plek Pniël; want, het hy gesê, ek het God gesien van aangesig tot aangesig, en tog is my lewe gered.

kjv_text: And as he passed over Penuel the sun rose upon him, and he halted upon his thigh.
bsb_text: The sun rose above him as he passed by Penuel, and he was limping because of his hip.
aov_text: En die son het vir hom opgegaan net toe hy Pniël verby was; en hy was mank aan sy heup.

kjv_text: Therefore the children of Israel eat not of the sinew which shrank, which is upon the hollow of the thigh, unto this day: because he touched the hollow of Jacob's thigh in the sinew that shrank.
bsb_text: Therefore to this day the Israelites do not eat the tendon which is at the socket of the hip, because the socket of Jacob’s hip was struck near that tendon.
aov_text: Daarom eet die kinders van Israel die heupsening, wat aan die heupbeen is, tot vandag toe nie, omdat Hy Jakob op die heupbeen, aan die heupsening, geslaan het.

kjv_text: And Jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, Esau came, and with him four hundred men. And he divided the children unto Leah, and unto Rachel, and unto the two handmaids.
bsb_text: Now Jacob looked up and saw Esau coming toward him with four hundred men. So he divided the children among Leah, Rachel, and the two maidservants.
aov_text: EN Jakob het sy oë opgeslaan, en toe hy meteens Esau sien aankom en vierhonderd man saam met hom, het hy die kinders onder Lea en Ragel en onder die twee slavinne verdeel.

kjv_text: And he put the handmaids and their children foremost, and Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph hindermost.
bsb_text: He put the maidservants and their children in front, Leah and her children next, and Rachel and Joseph at the rear.
aov_text: En hy het die slavinne met hulle kinders eerste, en Lea met haar kinders daaragter, en Ragel en Josef laaste opgestel;

kjv_text: And he passed over before them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.
bsb_text: But Jacob himself went on ahead and bowed to the ground seven times as he approached his brother.
aov_text: maar hy self het voor hulle uit gegaan en hom sewe maal na die aarde gebuig, totdat hy by sy broer gekom het.

kjv_text: And Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him: and they wept.
bsb_text: Esau, however, ran to him and embraced him, threw his arms around his neck, and kissed him. And they both wept.
aov_text: Toe loop Esau hom tegemoet en omhels hom en val hom om die hals en soen hom; en hulle het geween.

kjv_text: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, Who are those with thee? And he said, The children which God hath graciously given thy servant.
bsb_text: When Esau looked up and saw the women and children, he asked, “Who are these with you?” Jacob answered, “These are the children God has graciously given your servant.”
aov_text: Daarna het hy sy oë opgeslaan en die vroue en kinders gesien en gesê: Wie het jy daar by jou? En hy antwoord: Die kinders wat God uit genade aan u dienaar geskenk het.

kjv_text: Then the handmaidens came near, they and their children, and they bowed themselves.
bsb_text: Then the maidservants and their children approached and bowed down.
aov_text: En die slavinne het nader gekom, hulle en hulle kinders, en hulle neergebuig.

kjv_text: And Leah also with her children came near, and bowed themselves: and after came Joseph near and Rachel, and they bowed themselves.
bsb_text: Leah and her children also approached and bowed down, and then Joseph and Rachel approached and bowed down.
aov_text: En Lea het ook nader gekom met haar kinders en hul neergebuig; en daarna het Josef nader gekom en Ragel en hul neergebuig.

kjv_text: And he said, What meanest thou by all this drove which I met? And he said, These are to find grace in the sight of my lord.
bsb_text: “What do you mean by sending this whole company to meet me?” asked Esau. “To find favor in your sight, my lord,” Jacob answered.
aov_text: Daarop sê hy: Wat is jou bedoeling met daardie hele laer wat ek teëgekom het? En hy antwoord: Om guns te vind in die oë van my heer.

kjv_text: And Esau said, I have enough, my brother; keep that thou hast unto thyself.
bsb_text: “I already have plenty, my brother,” Esau replied. “Keep what belongs to you.”
aov_text: Maar Esau sê: Ek het baie, my broer! Wat joue is, laat dit joue bly!

kjv_text: And Jacob said, Nay, I pray thee, if now I have found grace in thy sight, then receive my present at my hand: for therefore I have seen thy face, as though I had seen the face of God, and thou wast pleased with me.
bsb_text: But Jacob insisted, “No, please! If I have found favor in your sight, then receive this gift from my hand. For indeed, I have seen your face, and it is like seeing the face of God, since you have received me favorably.
aov_text: Toe antwoord Jakob: Ag nee, as ek nou guns in u oë gevind het, neem dan my geskenk uit my hand aan. Want juis daarom het ek u aangesig te sien gekry soos ’n mens die aangesig van God sien, en u het behae in my gehad.

kjv_text: Take, I pray thee, my blessing that is brought to thee; because God hath dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough. And he urged him, and he took it.
bsb_text: Please accept my gift that was brought to you, because God has been gracious to me and I have all I need.” So Jacob pressed him until he accepted.
aov_text: Neem tog my begroetingsgeskenk wat u aangebied is, want God het my genade bewys, en ek het volop. En hy het by hom aangehou, sodat hy dit aangeneem het.

kjv_text: And he said, Let us take our journey, and let us go, and I will go before thee.
bsb_text: Then Esau said, “Let us be on our way, and I will go ahead of you.”
aov_text: Daarop sê hy: Laat ons opbreek en verder trek, en ek sal langs jou trek.

kjv_text: And he said unto him, My lord knoweth that the children are tender, and the flocks and herds with young are with me: and if men should overdrive them one day, all the flock will die.
bsb_text: But Jacob replied, “My lord knows that the children are frail, and I must care for sheep and cattle that are nursing their young. If they are driven hard for even a day, all the animals will die.
aov_text: Maar hy antwoord hom: My heer weet dat die kinders swak is, en dat ek lammerooie en melkkoeie by my het; as ’n mens hulle net een dag ooreis, dan sterf al die kleinvee.

kjv_text: Let my lord, I pray thee, pass over before his servant: and I will lead on softly, according as the cattle that goeth before me and the children be able to endure, until I come unto my lord unto Seir.
bsb_text: Please let my lord go ahead of his servant. I will continue on slowly, at a comfortable pace for the livestock and children, until I come to my lord at Seir.”
aov_text: My heer moet maar voor sy dienaar uit trek, en ék sal op my gemak trek na die gang van die vee wat voor my uit gaan, en na die gang van die kinders, tot ek by my heer in Seïr aankom.

kjv_text: And Esau said, Let me now leave with thee some of the folk that are with me. And he said, What needeth it? let me find grace in the sight of my lord.
bsb_text: “Let me leave some of my people with you,” Esau said. But Jacob replied, “Why do that? Let me find favor in the sight of my lord.”
aov_text: Toe sê Esau: Laat my tog van die manskappe wat by my is, by jou laat staan. En hy antwoord: Waarvoor dan? Laat my guns in die oë van my heer vind!

kjv_text: So Esau returned that day on his way unto Seir.
bsb_text: So that day Esau started on his way back to Seir,
aov_text: So het Esau dan dié dag teruggegaan padlangs na Seïr toe.

kjv_text: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth, and built him an house, and made booths for his cattle: therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.
bsb_text: but Jacob went on to Succoth, where he built a house for himself and shelters for his livestock; that is why the place was called Succoth.
aov_text: Maar Jakob het na Sukkot weggetrek en vir hom ’n huis gebou en takkrale vir sy vee gemaak. Daarom het hy die plek genoem Sukkot.

kjv_text: And Jacob came to Shalem, a city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Padanaram; and pitched his tent before the city.
bsb_text: After Jacob had come from Paddan-aram, he arrived safely at the city of Shechem in the land of Canaan, and he camped just outside the city.
aov_text: En Jakob het behoue aangekom by die stad Sigem wat in die land Kanaän is, toe hy van Paddan-Aram gekom het—hy het sy laer voor die stad opgeslaan

kjv_text: And he bought a parcel of a field, where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem's father, for an hundred pieces of money.
bsb_text: And the plot of ground where he pitched his tent, he purchased from the sons of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for a hundred pieces of silver.
aov_text: en die stuk grond gekoop waar hy sy tent opgeslaan het, van die seuns van Hemor, die vader van Sigem, vir honderd geldstukke.

kjv_text: And he erected there an altar, and called it EleloheIsrael.
bsb_text: There he set up an altar and called it El-Elohe-Israel.
aov_text: Daar het hy ook ’n altaar opgerig en dit genoem: Die God van Israel is God.

kjv_text: And Dinah the daughter of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.
bsb_text: Now Dinah, the daughter Leah had borne to Jacob, went out to visit the daughters of the land.
aov_text: EN Dina, die dogter van Lea, wat sy vir Jakob gebaar het, het uitgegaan om die dogters van die land te leer ken.

kjv_text: And when Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, prince of the country, saw her, he took her, and lay with her, and defiled her.
bsb_text: When Shechem son of Hamor the Hivite, the prince of the region, saw her, he took her and lay with her by force.
aov_text: Toe Sigem, die seun van Hemor, die Hewiet, die vors van die land, haar sien, het hy haar gegryp en met haar gemeenskap gehad en haar onteer.

kjv_text: And his soul clave unto Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the damsel, and spake kindly unto the damsel.
bsb_text: And his soul was drawn to Dinah, the daughter of Jacob. He loved the young girl and spoke to her tenderly.
aov_text: En sy siel het verkleef geraak aan Dina, die dogter van Jakob; en hy het die dogter liefgehad en na die hart van die dogter gespreek.

kjv_text: And Shechem spake unto his father Hamor, saying, Get me this damsel to wife.
bsb_text: So Shechem told his father Hamor, “Get me this girl as a wife.”
aov_text: Sigem het ook met sy vader Hemor gespreek en gesê: Neem daardie dogter vir my as vrou.

kjv_text: And Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter: now his sons were with his cattle in the field: and Jacob held his peace until they were come.
bsb_text: Jacob heard that Shechem had defiled his daughter Dinah, but since his sons were with his livestock in the field, he remained silent about it until they returned.
aov_text: Toe Jakob dan hoor dat hy sy dogter Dina onteer het, was sy seuns by sy vee in die veld; en Jakob het geswyg totdat hulle gekom het.

kjv_text: And Hamor the father of Shechem went out unto Jacob to commune with him.
bsb_text: Meanwhile, Shechem’s father Hamor came to speak with Jacob.
aov_text: En Hemor, die vader van Sigem, het na Jakob uitgegaan om met hom te spreek.

kjv_text: And the sons of Jacob came out of the field when they heard it: and the men were grieved, and they were very wroth, because he had wrought folly in Israel in lying with Jacob's daughter; which thing ought not to be done.
bsb_text: When Jacob’s sons heard what had happened, they returned from the field. They were filled with grief and fury, because Shechem had committed an outrage in Israel by lying with Jacob’s daughter—a thing that should not be done.
aov_text: En die seuns van Jakob het uit die veld gekom toe hulle dit hoor; en die manne was gegrief en baie kwaad, omdat hy ’n skanddaad in Israel begaan het deur met die dogter van Jakob gemeenskap te hou: so iets mag nie gebeur het nie.

kjv_text: And Hamor communed with them, saying, The soul of my son Shechem longeth for your daughter: I pray you give her him to wife.
bsb_text: But Hamor said to them, “My son Shechem longs for your daughter. Please give her to him as his wife.
aov_text: Toe spreek Hemor met hulle en sê: Die siel van my seun Sigem is verlief op julle dogter: gee haar tog aan hom as vrou

kjv_text: And make ye marriages with us, and give your daughters unto us, and take our daughters unto you.
bsb_text: Intermarry with us; give us your daughters, and take our daughters for yourselves.
aov_text: en verswaer julle met ons: gee aan ons julle dogters, en neem vir julle ons dogters.

kjv_text: And ye shall dwell with us: and the land shall be before you; dwell and trade ye therein, and get you possessions therein.
bsb_text: You may settle among us, and the land will be open to you. Live here, move about freely, and acquire your own property.”
aov_text: Bly maar by ons woon, en die land sal voor julle oop lê; woon en trek rond daarin en verwerf vaste besittings daarin.

kjv_text: And Shechem said unto her father and unto her brethren, Let me find grace in your eyes, and what ye shall say unto me I will give.
bsb_text: Then Shechem said to Dinah’s father and brothers, “Grant me this favor, and I will give you whatever you ask.
aov_text: En Sigem sê vir haar vader en haar broers: Laat my guns vind in julle oë, en wat julle van my eis, sal ek gee.

kjv_text: Ask me never so much dowry and gift, and I will give according as ye shall say unto me: but give me the damsel to wife.
bsb_text: Demand a high dowry and an expensive gift, and I will give you whatever you ask. Only give me the girl as my wife!”
aov_text: Vra my ’n baie groot koopprys en geskenk, en ek sal dit gee soos julle aan my sê; gee my net die dogter as vrou.

kjv_text: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father deceitfully, and said, because he had defiled Dinah their sister:
bsb_text: But because Shechem had defiled their sister Dinah, Jacob’s sons answered him and his father Hamor deceitfully.
aov_text: Toe antwoord die seuns van Jakob vir Sigem en Hemor, sy vader, met bedrog—hulle het so gespreek, omdat hy hulle suster Dina onteer het—

kjv_text: And they said unto them, We cannot do this thing, to give our sister to one that is uncircumcised; for that were a reproach unto us:
bsb_text: “We cannot do such a thing,” they said. “To give our sister to an uncircumcised man would be a disgrace to us.
aov_text: en sê vir hulle: Ons kan dit nie doen om ons suster aan ’n man te gee wat die voorhuid het nie, want dit sou ’n skande vir ons wees.

kjv_text: But in this will we consent unto you: If ye will be as we be, that every male of you be circumcised;
bsb_text: We will consent to this on one condition, that you become circumcised like us—every one of your males.
aov_text: Net op hierdie voorwaarde kan ons inwillig: as julle word soos ons deurdat almal wat manlik is onder julle, besny word.

kjv_text: Then will we give our daughters unto you, and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.
bsb_text: Then we will give you our daughters and take your daughters for ourselves. We will dwell among you and become one people.
aov_text: Dan sal ons ons dogters aan julle gee, en ons sal julle dogters vir ons neem; en ons sal by julle woon en een volk word.

kjv_text: But if ye will not hearken unto us, to be circumcised; then will we take our daughter, and we will be gone.
bsb_text: But if you will not agree to be circumcised, then we will take our sister and go.”
aov_text: Maar as julle nie na ons luister om besny te word nie, dan neem ons ons dogter en ons trek weg.

kjv_text: And their words pleased Hamor, and Shechem Hamor's son.
bsb_text: Their offer seemed good to Hamor and his son Shechem.
aov_text: En hulle woorde was goed in die oë van Hemor en in die oë van Sigem, die seun van Hemor.

kjv_text: And the young man deferred not to do the thing, because he had delight in Jacob's daughter: and he was more honourable than all the house of his father.
bsb_text: The young man, who was the most respected of all his father’s household, did not hesitate to fulfill this request, because he was delighted with Jacob’s daughter.
aov_text: En die jongman het nie versuim om dit te doen nie, want hy het sin gehad in die dogter van Jakob, en hy was die mees geëerde in die hele huis van sy vader.

kjv_text: And Hamor and Shechem his son came unto the gate of their city, and communed with the men of their city, saying,
bsb_text: So Hamor and his son Shechem went to the gate of their city and addressed the men of their city:
aov_text: Toe gaan Hemor en sy seun Sigem na die poort van hulle stad, en hulle spreek met die manne van hul stad en sê:

kjv_text: These men are peaceable with us; therefore let them dwell in the land, and trade therein; for the land, behold, it is large enough for them; let us take their daughters to us for wives, and let us give them our daughters.
bsb_text: “These men are at peace with us. Let them live and trade in our land; indeed, it is large enough for them. Let us take their daughters in marriage and give our daughters to them.
aov_text: Hierdie manne lewe in vrede met ons; daarom, laat hulle in die land woon en daarin rondtrek: die land lê mos alkante toe wyd voor hulle. Ons kan hulle dogters vir ons as vroue neem, en ons sal ons dogters aan hulle gee.

kjv_text: Only herein will the men consent unto us for to dwell with us, to be one people, if every male among us be circumcised, as they are circumcised.
bsb_text: But only on this condition will the men agree to dwell with us and be one people: if all our men are circumcised as they are.
aov_text: Maar net op hierdie voorwaarde sal die manne inwillig om by ons te woon, om een volk te word: as almal wat manlik is onder ons, besny word soos hulle besny is.

kjv_text: Shall not their cattle and their substance and every beast of theirs be ours? only let us consent unto them, and they will dwell with us.
bsb_text: Will not their livestock, their possessions, and all their animals become ours? Only let us consent to them, and they will dwell among us.”
aov_text: Hulle vee en hulle besittings en al hulle diere—sal dit nie ons s’n wees nie? Laat ons net inwillig, sodat hulle by ons kan bly woon.

kjv_text: And unto Hamor and unto Shechem his son hearkened all that went out of the gate of his city; and every male was circumcised, all that went out of the gate of his city.
bsb_text: All the men who went out of the city gate listened to Hamor and his son Shechem, and every male of the city was circumcised.
aov_text: En hulle het geluister na Hemor en na sy seun Sigem—almal wat uit sy stadspoort uitgegaan het; en almal wat manlik was, is besny, almal wat uit sy stadspoort uitgegaan het.

kjv_text: And it came to pass on the third day, when they were sore, that two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah's brethren, took each man his sword, and came upon the city boldly, and slew all the males.
bsb_text: Three days later, while they were still in pain, two of Jacob’s sons (Dinah’s brothers Simeon and Levi) took their swords, went into the unsuspecting city, and slaughtered every male.
aov_text: Maar op die derde dag, toe hulle in die pyn was, neem die twee seuns van Jakob, Símeon en Levi, broers van Dina, elkeen sy swaard, en hulle oorval die sorgelose stad en slaan almal dood wat manlik was.

kjv_text: And they slew Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem's house, and went out.
bsb_text: They killed Hamor and his son Shechem with their swords, took Dinah out of Shechem’s house, and went away.
aov_text: Hulle slaan ook Hemor en sy seun Sigem dood met die skerpte van die swaard; daarna neem hulle Dina uit die huis van Sigem uit en vertrek.

kjv_text: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain, and spoiled the city, because they had defiled their sister.
bsb_text: Jacob’s other sons came upon the slaughter and looted the city, because their sister had been defiled.
aov_text: Die seuns van Jakob het op die gesneuweldes afgekom en die stad geplunder, omdat hulle hulle suster onteer het.

kjv_text: They took their sheep, and their oxen, and their asses, and that which was in the city, and that which was in the field,
bsb_text: They took their flocks and herds and donkeys, and everything else in the city or in the field.
aov_text: Hulle kleinvee en hulle beeste en hulle esels—wat in die stad en in die veld was—het hulle weggeneem.

kjv_text: And all their wealth, and all their little ones, and their wives took they captive, and spoiled even all that was in the house.
bsb_text: They carried off all their possessions and women and children, and they plundered everything in their houses.
aov_text: En al hulle goed en al hulle kinders en hulle vroue het hulle as gevangenes weggevoer en as buit, en ook alles wat in die huise was.

kjv_text: And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, Ye have troubled me to make me to stink among the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites: and I being few in number, they shall gather themselves together against me, and slay me; and I shall be destroyed, I and my house.
bsb_text: Then Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, “You have brought trouble upon me by making me a stench to the Canaanites and Perizzites, the people of this land. We are few in number; if they unite against me and attack me, I and my household will be destroyed.”
aov_text: Toe sê Jakob vir Símeon en Levi: Julle het my ontroer dat julle my gehaat gemaak het by die inwoners van die land, die Kanaäniete en Feresiete, terwyl ek ’n klein klompie is. As hulle hul teen my versamel, sal hulle my verslaan, en ek sal verdelg word, ek en my huis.

kjv_text: And they said, Should he deal with our sister as with an harlot?
bsb_text: But they replied, “Should he have treated our sister like a prostitute?”
aov_text: Toe antwoord hulle: Hoe durf hy dan ons suster as ’n hoer behandel!

kjv_text: And God said unto Jacob, Arise, go up to Bethel, and dwell there: and make there an altar unto God, that appeared unto thee when thou fleddest from the face of Esau thy brother.
bsb_text: Then God said to Jacob, “Arise, go up to Bethel, and settle there. Build an altar there to the God who appeared to you when you fled from your brother Esau.”
aov_text: DAARNA het God vir Jakob gesê: Maak jou klaar, trek op na Bet-el en woon daar; en bou daar ’n altaar vir die God wat aan jou verskyn het toe jy op die vlug was vir jou broer Esau.

kjv_text: Then Jacob said unto his household, and to all that were with him, Put away the strange gods that are among you, and be clean, and change your garments:
bsb_text: So Jacob told his household and all who were with him, “Get rid of the foreign gods that are among you. Purify yourselves and change your garments.
aov_text: Toe sê Jakob aan sy huisgesin en aan almal wat by hom was: Verwyder die vreemde gode wat onder julle is, en reinig julle en trek ander klere aan;

kjv_text: And let us arise, and go up to Bethel; and I will make there an altar unto God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me in the way which I went.
bsb_text: Then let us arise and go to Bethel. I will build an altar there to God, who answered me in my day of distress. He has been with me wherever I have gone.”
aov_text: en laat ons klaarmaak en optrek na Bet-el; en ek sal daar ’n altaar bou vir die God wat my geantwoord het op die dag van my benoudheid en by my was op die weg wat ek gegaan het.

kjv_text: And they gave unto Jacob all the strange gods which were in their hand, and all their earrings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.
bsb_text: So they gave Jacob all their foreign gods and all their earrings, and Jacob buried them under the oak near Shechem.
aov_text: Toe gee hulle aan Jakob al die vreemde gode wat in hulle besit was, en die ringe aan hulle ore, en Jakob het dit begrawe onder die terpentynboom wat by Sigem is.

kjv_text: And they journeyed: and the terror of God was upon the cities that were round about them, and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob.
bsb_text: As they set out, a terror from God fell over the surrounding cities, so that they did not pursue Jacob’s sons.
aov_text: En toe hulle weggetrek het, kom daar ’n skrik van God op die stede rondom hulle, sodat hulle die seuns van Jakob nie agternagejaag het nie.

kjv_text: So Jacob came to Luz, which is in the land of Canaan, that is, Bethel, he and all the people that were with him.
bsb_text: So Jacob and everyone with him arrived in Luz (that is, Bethel) in the land of Canaan.
aov_text: So het Jakob dan in Lus aangekom wat in die land Kanaän is—dit is Bet-el—hy en al die mense wat by hom was,

kjv_text: And he built there an altar, and called the place Elbethel: because there God appeared unto him, when he fled from the face of his brother.
bsb_text: There Jacob built an altar, and he called that place El-bethel, because it was there that God had revealed Himself to Jacob as he fled from his brother.
aov_text: en hy het daar ’n altaar gebou en die plek El Bet-el genoem, omdat God daar aan hom geopenbaar is toe hy vir sy broer gevlug het.

kjv_text: But Deborah Rebekah's nurse died, and she was buried beneath Bethel under an oak: and the name of it was called Allonbachuth.
bsb_text: Now Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, died and was buried under the oak below Bethel. So Jacob named it Allon-bachuth.
aov_text: En Debora, die oppasser van Rebekka, het gesterwe, en sy is begrawe onderkant Bet-el, onder die eikeboom. En hulle het dit genoem: Eik van geween.

kjv_text: And God appeared unto Jacob again, when he came out of Padanaram, and blessed him.
bsb_text: After Jacob had returned from Paddan-aram, God appeared to him again and blessed him.
aov_text: Toe verskyn God weer aan Jakob, by sy terugkoms uit Paddan-Aram, en Hy seën hom;

kjv_text: And God said unto him, Thy name is Jacob: thy name shall not be called any more Jacob, but Israel shall be thy name: and he called his name Israel.
bsb_text: And God said to him, “Though your name is Jacob, you will no longer be called Jacob. Instead, your name will be Israel.” So God named him Israel.
aov_text: en God sê vir hom: Jou naam is Jakob; jy sal verder nie Jakob genoem word nie, maar Israel sal jou naam wees. En Hy het hom Israel genoem.

kjv_text: And God said unto him, I am God Almighty: be fruitful and multiply; a nation and a company of nations shall be of thee, and kings shall come out of thy loins;
bsb_text: And God told him, “I am God Almighty. Be fruitful and multiply. A nation—even a company of nations—shall come from you, and kings shall descend from you.
aov_text: Verder sê God vir hom: Ek is God, die Almagtige. Wees vrugbaar en vermeerder. ’n Nasie, ja, ’n menigte van nasies, sal van jou afstam, en konings sal uit jou lendene voortkom.

kjv_text: And the land which I gave Abraham and Isaac, to thee I will give it, and to thy seed after thee will I give the land.
bsb_text: The land that I gave to Abraham and Isaac I will give to you, and I will give this land to your descendants after you.”
aov_text: En die land wat Ek aan Abraham en Isak gegee het, sal Ek aan jou gee; en aan jou nageslag ná jou sal Ek die land gee.

kjv_text: And God went up from him in the place where he talked with him.
bsb_text: Then God went up from the place where He had spoken with him.
aov_text: Toe het God van hom af opgevaar op die plek waar Hy met hom gespreek het.

kjv_text: And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he talked with him, even a pillar of stone: and he poured a drink offering thereon, and he poured oil thereon.
bsb_text: So Jacob set up a pillar in the place where God had spoken with him—a stone marker—and he poured out a drink offering on it and anointed it with oil.
aov_text: En Jakob het ’n gedenksteen opgerig op die plek waar Hy met hom gespreek het, ’n gedenksteen van klip, en daarop ’n drankoffer uitgegiet en olie daarop gegooi.

kjv_text: And Jacob called the name of the place where God spake with him, Bethel.
bsb_text: Jacob called the place where God had spoken with him Bethel.
aov_text: En Jakob het die plek waar God met hom gespreek het, Bet-el genoem.

kjv_text: And they journeyed from Bethel; and there was but a little way to come to Ephrath: and Rachel travailed, and she had hard labour.
bsb_text: Later, they set out from Bethel, and while they were still some distance from Ephrath, Rachel began to give birth, and her labor was difficult.
aov_text: Daarna het hulle van Bet-el af weggetrek. En toe daar nog ’n kort ent pad was om by Efrat te kom, moes Ragel baar; en sy het dit swaar gehad by die bevalling.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when she was in hard labour, that the midwife said unto her, Fear not; thou shalt have this son also.
bsb_text: During her severe labor, the midwife said to her, “Do not be afraid, for you are having another son.”
aov_text: En terwyl sy dit swaar het by die bevalling, sê die vroedvrou vir haar: Wees nie bevrees nie, want dit is ook ’n seun vir u.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, as her soul was in departing, (for she died) that she called his name Benoni: but his father called him Benjamin.
bsb_text: And with her last breath—for she was dying—she named him Ben-oni. But his father called him Benjamin.
aov_text: En toe haar siel uitgaan—want sy het gesterwe—noem sy hom Ben-Oni. Maar sy vader het hom Benjamin genoem.

kjv_text: And Rachel died, and was buried in the way to Ephrath, which is Bethlehem.
bsb_text: So Rachel died and was buried on the way to Ephrath (that is, Bethlehem).
aov_text: So het Ragel dan gesterwe; en sy is begrawe op die pad na Efrat, dit is Betlehem.

kjv_text: And Jacob set a pillar upon her grave: that is the pillar of Rachel's grave unto this day.
bsb_text: Jacob set up a pillar on her grave; it marks Rachel’s tomb to this day.
aov_text: En Jakob het ’n gedenksteen op haar graf opgerig; dit is die gedenkteken van die graf van Ragel tot vandag toe.

kjv_text: And Israel journeyed, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Edar.
bsb_text: Israel again set out and pitched his tent beyond the Tower of Eder.
aov_text: En Israel het weggetrek en sy tent opgeslaan aan die ander kant van Migdal-Eder.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when Israel dwelt in that land, that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father's concubine: and Israel heard it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve:
bsb_text: While Israel was living in that region, Reuben went in and slept with his father’s concubine Bilhah, and Israel heard about it. Jacob had twelve sons:
aov_text: En terwyl Israel in dié land woon, het Ruben gegaan en met Bilha, sy vader se byvrou, gemeenskap gehad. En Israel het dit gehoor. En die seuns van Jakob was twaalf.

kjv_text: The sons of Leah; Reuben, Jacob's firstborn, and Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Zebulun:
bsb_text: The sons of Leah were Reuben the firstborn of Jacob, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun.
aov_text: Die seuns van Lea was: Ruben, die eersgeborene van Jakob, daarna Símeon en Levi en Juda en Íssaskar en Sébulon.

kjv_text: The sons of Rachel; Joseph, and Benjamin:
bsb_text: The sons of Rachel were Joseph and Benjamin.
aov_text: Die seuns van Ragel: Josef en Benjamin.

kjv_text: And the sons of Bilhah, Rachel's handmaid; Dan, and Naphtali:
bsb_text: The sons of Rachel’s maidservant Bilhah were Dan and Naphtali.
aov_text: En die seuns van Bilha, die slavin van Ragel: Dan en Náftali.

kjv_text: And the sons of Zilpah, Leah's handmaid; Gad, and Asher: these are the sons of Jacob, which were born to him in Padanaram.
bsb_text: And the sons of Leah’s maidservant Zilpah were Gad and Asher. These are the sons of Jacob, who were born to him in Paddan-aram.
aov_text: En die seuns van Silpa, die slavin van Lea: Gad en Aser. Dit is die seuns van Jakob wat vir hom in Paddan-Aram gebore is.

kjv_text: And Jacob came unto Isaac his father unto Mamre, unto the city of Arbah, which is Hebron, where Abraham and Isaac sojourned.
bsb_text: Jacob returned to his father Isaac at Mamre, near Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac had stayed.
aov_text: En Jakob het by sy vader Isak gekom in Mamre, by Kirjat-Arba, dit is Hebron, waar Abraham as vreemdeling vertoef het, en ook Isak.

kjv_text: And the days of Isaac were an hundred and fourscore years.
bsb_text: And Isaac lived 180 years.
aov_text: En die dae van Isak was honderd-en-tagtig jaar.

kjv_text: And Isaac gave up the ghost, and died, and was gathered unto his people, being old and full of days: and his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.
bsb_text: Then he breathed his last and died and was gathered to his people, old and full of years. And his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.
aov_text: En Isak het die asem uitgeblaas en gesterwe, en hy is by sy volksgenote versamel, oud en afgeleef. En sy seuns Esau en Jakob het hom begrawe.

kjv_text: Now these are the generations of Esau, who is Edom.
bsb_text: This is the account of Esau (that is, Edom).
aov_text: EN dit is die geskiedenis van Esau, dit is Edom.

kjv_text: Esau took his wives of the daughters of Canaan; Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon the Hivite;
bsb_text: Esau took his wives from the daughters of Canaan: Adah daughter of Elon the Hittite, Oholibamah daughter of Anah and granddaughter of Zibeon the Hivite,
aov_text: Esau het sy vroue geneem uit die dogters van Kanaän: Ada, die dogter van Elon, die Hetiet, en Oholibáma, die dogter van Ana, die dogter van Síbeon, die Hewiet;

kjv_text: And Bashemath Ishmael's daughter, sister of Nebajoth.
bsb_text: and Basemath daughter of Ishmael and sister of Nebaioth.
aov_text: en Basmat, die dogter van Ismael, die suster van Nébajot.

kjv_text: And Adah bare to Esau Eliphaz; and Bashemath bare Reuel;
bsb_text: And Adah bore Eliphaz to Esau, Basemath gave birth to Reuel,
aov_text: En Ada het vir Esau gebaar Élifas, en Basmat het gebaar Réhuel.

kjv_text: And Aholibamah bare Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah: these are the sons of Esau, which were born unto him in the land of Canaan.
bsb_text: and Oholibamah gave birth to Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. These were the sons of Esau, who were born to him in the land of Canaan.
aov_text: En Oholibáma het gebaar Jehus en Jáelam en Korag. Dit is die seuns van Esau wat vir hom gebore is in die land Kanaän.

kjv_text: And Esau took his wives, and his sons, and his daughters, and all the persons of his house, and his cattle, and all his beasts, and all his substance, which he had got in the land of Canaan; and went into the country from the face of his brother Jacob.
bsb_text: Later, Esau took his wives and sons and daughters and all the people of his household, along with his livestock, all his other animals, and all the property he had acquired in Canaan, and he moved to a land far away from his brother Jacob.
aov_text: Toe neem Esau sy vroue en sy seuns en sy dogters en al die mense van sy huis, sy vee en al sy diere en al sy besittings wat hy in die land Kanaän verwerf het, en hy trek na ’n land, wég van sy broer Jakob af;

kjv_text: For their riches were more than that they might dwell together; and the land wherein they were strangers could not bear them because of their cattle.
bsb_text: For their possessions were too great for them to dwell together; the land where they stayed could not support them because of their livestock.
aov_text: want hulle besittings was te groot om saam te woon, en die land van hulle vreemdelingskap kon hulle nie dra vanweë hulle vee nie.

kjv_text: Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.
bsb_text: So Esau (that is, Edom) settled in the area of Mount Seir.
aov_text: En Esau het gaan woon in die gebergte Seïr. Esau, dit is Edom.

kjv_text: And these are the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in mount Seir:
bsb_text: This is the account of Esau, the father of the Edomites, in the area of Mount Seir.
aov_text: Dit is dan die geskiedenis van Esau, die vader van die Edomiete, in die gebergte Seïr.

kjv_text: These are the names of Esau's sons; Eliphaz the son of Adah the wife of Esau, Reuel the son of Bashemath the wife of Esau.
bsb_text: These are the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz son of Esau’s wife Adah, and Reuel son of Esau’s wife Basemath.
aov_text: Dit is die name van die seuns van Esau: Élifas, die seun van Ada, die vrou van Esau; Réhuel, die seun van Basmat, die vrou van Esau.

kjv_text: And the sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.
bsb_text: The sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz.
aov_text: En die seuns van Élifas was: Teman, Omar, Sefo en Gáetam en Kenas.

kjv_text: And Timna was concubine to Eliphaz Esau's son; and she bare to Eliphaz Amalek: these were the sons of Adah Esau's wife.
bsb_text: Additionally, Timna, a concubine of Esau’s son Eliphaz, gave birth to Amalek. These are the grandsons of Esau’s wife Adah.
aov_text: En Timna was ’n byvrou van Élifas, die seun van Esau; en sy het vir Élifas gebaar Ámalek. Dit is die seuns van Ada, die vrou van Esau.

kjv_text: And these are the sons of Reuel; Nahath, and Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah: these were the sons of Bashemath Esau's wife.
bsb_text: These are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. They are the grandsons of Esau’s wife Basemath.
aov_text: En dit is die seuns van Réhuel: Nahat en Serag, Samma en Missa. Dit was die seuns van Basmat, die vrou van Esau.

kjv_text: And these were the sons of Aholibamah, the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon, Esau's wife: and she bare to Esau Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.
bsb_text: These are the sons of Esau’s wife Oholibamah (daughter of Anah and granddaughter of Zibeon) whom she bore to Esau: Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
aov_text: En dit was die seuns van Oholibáma, die dogter van Ana, die dogter van Síbeon, die vrou van Esau—sy het vir Esau gebaar Jehus en Jáelam en Korag.

kjv_text: These were dukes of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn son of Esau; duke Teman, duke Omar, duke Zepho, duke Kenaz,
bsb_text: These are the chiefs among the sons of Esau. The sons of Eliphaz the firstborn of Esau: Chiefs Teman, Omar, Zepho, Kenaz,
aov_text: Dit is die stamhoofde onder die seuns van Esau. Die seuns van Élifas, die eersgeborene van Esau, was: die stamhoof Teman, die stamhoof Omar, die stamhoof Sefo, die stamhoof Kenas,

kjv_text: Duke Korah, duke Gatam, and duke Amalek: these are the dukes that came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these were the sons of Adah.
bsb_text: Korah, Gatam, and Amalek. They are the chiefs of Eliphaz in the land of Edom, and they are the grandsons of Adah.
aov_text: die stamhoof Korag, die stamhoof Gáetam, die stamhoof Ámalek. Dit is die stamhoofde van Élifas in die land Edom; dit is die seuns van Ada.

kjv_text: And these are the sons of Reuel Esau's son; duke Nahath, duke Zerah, duke Shammah, duke Mizzah: these are the dukes that came of Reuel in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Bashemath Esau's wife.
