bsb_text: These are the sons of Esau’s son Reuel: Chiefs Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. They are the chiefs descended from Reuel in the land of Edom, and they are the grandsons of Esau’s wife Basemath.
aov_text: En dit is die seuns van Réhuel, die seun van Esau: die stamhoof Nahat, die stamhoof Serag, die stamhoof Samma, die stamhoof Missa. Dit is die stamhoofde van Réhuel in die land Edom. Dit is die seuns van Basmat, die vrou van Esau.

kjv_text: And these are the sons of Aholibamah Esau's wife; duke Jeush, duke Jaalam, duke Korah: these were the dukes that came of Aholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau's wife.
bsb_text: These are the sons of Esau’s wife Oholibamah: Chiefs Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. They are the chiefs descended from Esau’s wife Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah.
aov_text: En dit is die seuns van Oholibáma, die vrou van Esau: die stamhoof Jehus, die stamhoof Jáelam, die stamhoof Korag. Dit is die stamhoofde van Oholibáma, die dogter van Ana, die vrou van Esau.

kjv_text: These are the sons of Esau, who is Edom, and these are their dukes.
bsb_text: All these are the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and they were their chiefs.
aov_text: Dit is die seuns van Esau, en dit is hulle stamhoofde. Dit is Edom.

kjv_text: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, who inhabited the land; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah,
bsb_text: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, who were living in the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
aov_text: Dit is die seuns van Seïr, die Horiet, die eerste inwoners van die land: Lotan en Sobal en Síbeon en Ana

kjv_text: And Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan: these are the dukes of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.
bsb_text: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. They are the chiefs of the Horites, the descendants of Seir in the land of Edom.
aov_text: en Dison en Eser en Disan. Dit is die stamhoofde van die Horiete, die seuns van Seïr in die land Edom.

kjv_text: And the children of Lotan were Hori and Hemam; and Lotan's sister was Timna.
bsb_text: The sons of Lotan were Hori and Hemam. Timna was Lotan’s sister.
aov_text: En die seuns van Lotan was Hori en Hemam; en die suster van Lotan was Timna.

kjv_text: And the children of Shobal were these; Alvan, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
bsb_text: These are the sons of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
aov_text: En dit is die seuns van Sobal: Alwan en Manáhat en Ebal, Sefo en Onam.

kjv_text: And these are the children of Zibeon; both Ajah, and Anah: this was that Anah that found the mules in the wilderness, as he fed the asses of Zibeon his father.
bsb_text: These are the sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah. (This is the Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness as he was pasturing the donkeys of his father Zibeon.)
aov_text: En dit is die seuns van Síbeon: Aja en Ana. Dit is dié Ana wat die warm fonteine in die woestyn gekry het toe hy die esels van sy vader Síbeon opgepas het.

kjv_text: And the children of Anah were these; Dishon, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah.
bsb_text: These are the children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah daughter of Anah.
aov_text: En dit is die seuns van Ana: Dison; en Oholibáma was die dogter van Ana.

kjv_text: And these are the children of Dishon; Hemdan, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.
bsb_text: These are the sons of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
aov_text: En dit is die seuns van Dison: Hemdan en Esban en Jitran en Keran.

kjv_text: The children of Ezer are these; Bilhan, and Zaavan, and Akan.
bsb_text: These are the sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.
aov_text: Dit is die seuns van Eser: Bilhan en Saäwan en Akan.

kjv_text: The children of Dishan are these; Uz, and Aran.
bsb_text: These are the sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
aov_text: Dit is die seuns van Disan: Us en Aran.

kjv_text: These are the dukes that came of the Horites; duke Lotan, duke Shobal, duke Zibeon, duke Anah,
bsb_text: These are the chiefs of the Horites: Chiefs Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
aov_text: Dit is die stamhoofde van die Horiete: die stamhoof Lotan, die stamhoof Sobal, die stamhoof Síbeon, die stamhoof Ana,

kjv_text: Duke Dishon, duke Ezer, duke Dishan: these are the dukes that came of Hori, among their dukes in the land of Seir.
bsb_text: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. They are the chiefs of the Horites, according to their divisions in the land of Seir.
aov_text: die stamhoof Dison, die stamhoof Eser, die stamhoof Disan. Dit is die stamhoofde van die Horiete volgens hulle stamme in die land Seïr.

kjv_text: And these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom, before there reigned any king over the children of Israel.
bsb_text: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the Israelites:
aov_text: En dit is die konings wat geregeer het in die land Edom voordat daar ’n koning geregeer het oor die kinders van Israel:

kjv_text: And Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom: and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
bsb_text: Bela son of Beor reigned in Edom; the name of his city was Dinhabah.
aov_text: Bela, die seun van Beor, het geregeer in Edom; en die naam van sy stad was Dinhába.

kjv_text: And Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.
bsb_text: When Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah reigned in his place.
aov_text: En ná die dood van Bela het Jobab, die seun van Serag, van Bosra, in sy plek geregeer.

kjv_text: And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of Temani reigned in his stead.
bsb_text: When Jobab died, Husham from the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
aov_text: En ná die dood van Jobab het Husam, uit die land van die Temaniete, in sy plek geregeer.

kjv_text: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.
bsb_text: When Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the country of Moab, reigned in his place. And the name of his city was Avith.
aov_text: En ná die dood van Husam het Hadad, die seun van Bedad, wat die Midianiete verslaan het in die veld van Moab, in sy plek geregeer, en die naam van sy stad was Awit.

kjv_text: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.
bsb_text: When Hadad died, Samlah from Masrekah reigned in his place.
aov_text: En ná die dood van Hadad het Samla van Másreka in sy plek geregeer.

kjv_text: And Samlah died, and Saul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.
bsb_text: When Samlah died, Shaul from Rehoboth on the Euphrates reigned in his place.
aov_text: En ná die dood van Samla het Saul van Réhobot, aan die rivier, in sy plek geregeer.

kjv_text: And Saul died, and Baalhanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.
bsb_text: When Shaul died, Baal-hanan son of Achbor reigned in his place.
aov_text: En ná die dood van Saul het Baäl-Hanan, die seun van Akbor, in sy plek geregeer.

kjv_text: And Baalhanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pau; and his wife's name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
bsb_text: When Baal-hanan son of Achbor died, Hadad reigned in his place. His city was named Pau, and his wife’s name was Mehetabel daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-zahab.
aov_text: En ná die dood van Baäl-Hanan, die seun van Akbor, het Hadar in sy plek geregeer; en die naam van sy stad was Pahu; en die naam van sy vrou was Mehetábeël, die dogter van Matred, die dogter van Mésahab.

kjv_text: And these are the names of the dukes that came of Esau, according to their families, after their places, by their names; duke Timnah, duke Alvah, duke Jetheth,
bsb_text: These are the names of Esau’s chiefs, according to their families and regions, by their names: Chiefs Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,
aov_text: Dit is die name van die stamhoofde van Esau, volgens hulle geslagte, volgens hulle woonplekke, met hulle name: die stamhoof Timna, die stamhoof Alwa, die stamhoof Jetet,

kjv_text: Duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,
bsb_text: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,
aov_text: die stamhoof Oholibáma, die stamhoof Ela, die stamhoof Pinon,

kjv_text: Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,
bsb_text: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,
aov_text: die stamhoof Kenas, die stamhoof Teman, die stamhoof Mibsar,

kjv_text: Duke Magdiel, duke Iram: these be the dukes of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession: he is Esau the father of the Edomites.
bsb_text: Magdiel, and Iram. These were the chiefs of Edom, according to their settlements in the land they possessed. Esau was the father of the Edomites.
aov_text: die stamhoof Mágdiël, die stamhoof Iram. Dit is die stamhoofde van Edom, volgens hulle verblyfplekke in die land van hulle besitting. Dit is Esau, die stamvader van die Edomiete.

kjv_text: And Jacob dwelt in the land wherein his father was a stranger, in the land of Canaan.
bsb_text: Now Jacob lived in the land where his father had resided, the land of Canaan.
aov_text: EN Jakob het gewoon in die land van die vreemdelingskap van sy vader, in die land Kanaän.

kjv_text: These are the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brethren; and the lad was with the sons of Bilhah, and with the sons of Zilpah, his father's wives: and Joseph brought unto his father their evil report.
bsb_text: This is the account of Jacob. When Joseph was seventeen years old, he was tending the flock with his brothers, the sons of his father’s wives Bilhah and Zilpah, and he brought their father a bad report about them.
aov_text: Dit is die geskiedenis van Jakob. Josef het as seun van sewentien jaar die kleinvee opgepas saam met sy broers—hy was nog jonk—met die seuns van Bilha en die seuns van Silpa, die vroue van sy vader. En Josef het die slegte gerug oor hulle na hulle vader oorgebring.

kjv_text: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age: and he made him a coat of many colours.
bsb_text: Now Israel loved Joseph more than his other sons, because Joseph had been born to him in his old age; so he made him a robe of many colors.
aov_text: En Israel het Josef meer liefgehad as al sy seuns; want hy was vir hom ’n seun van die ouderdom; en hy het vir hom ’n lang rok met moue gemaak.

kjv_text: And when his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren, they hated him, and could not speak peaceably unto him.
bsb_text: When Joseph’s brothers saw that their father loved him more than any of them, they hated him and could not speak a kind word to him.
aov_text: Toe sy broers sien dat hulle vader hom meer as al sy broers liefhet, het hulle hom gehaat en kon nie vriendelik met hom praat nie.

kjv_text: And Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it his brethren: and they hated him yet the more.
bsb_text: Then Joseph had a dream, and when he told it to his brothers, they hated him even more.
aov_text: Ook het Josef ’n droom gehad wat hy aan sy broers vertel het. Daaroor het hulle hom nog meer gehaat.

kjv_text: And he said unto them, Hear, I pray you, this dream which I have dreamed:
bsb_text: He said to them, “Listen to this dream I had:
aov_text: Hy het naamlik vir hulle gesê: Hoor tog hierdie droom wat ek gehad het.

kjv_text: For, behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and, lo, my sheaf arose, and also stood upright; and, behold, your sheaves stood round about, and made obeisance to my sheaf.
bsb_text: We were binding sheaves of grain in the field, and suddenly my sheaf rose and stood upright, while your sheaves gathered around and bowed down to mine.”
aov_text: Kyk, ons was besig om gerwe te bind op die land toe meteens my gerf gaan staan en ook regop blý staan, terwyl julle gerwe daar rondom kom en hulle voor my gerf neerbuig.

kjv_text: And his brethren said to him, Shalt thou indeed reign over us? or shalt thou indeed have dominion over us? And they hated him yet the more for his dreams, and for his words.
bsb_text: “Do you intend to reign over us?” his brothers asked. “Will you actually rule us?” So they hated him even more because of his dream and his statements.
aov_text: Toe sê sy broers aan hom: Wil jy miskien oor ons regeer? of wil jy miskien oor ons heers? En hulle het hom nog meer gehaat oor sy drome en oor sy woorde.

kjv_text: And he dreamed yet another dream, and told it his brethren, and said, Behold, I have dreamed a dream more; and, behold, the sun and the moon and the eleven stars made obeisance to me.
bsb_text: Then Joseph had another dream and told it to his brothers. “Look,” he said, “I had another dream, and this time the sun and moon and eleven stars were bowing down to me.”
aov_text: Daarna het hy nog ’n ander droom gehad en dit aan sy broers vertel en gesê: Kyk, ek het nog ’n droom gehad—die son en die maan en elf sterre het hulle voor my neergebuig.

kjv_text: And he told it to his father, and to his brethren: and his father rebuked him, and said unto him, What is this dream that thou hast dreamed? Shall I and thy mother and thy brethren indeed come to bow down ourselves to thee to the earth?
bsb_text: He told his father and brothers, but his father rebuked him and said, “What is this dream that you have had? Will your mother and brothers and I actually come and bow down to the ground before you?”
aov_text: Toe hy dit aan sy vader en sy broers vertel, het sy vader hom hard bestraf en aan hom gesê: Wat is dit vir ’n droom wat jy gehad het? Moet ons werklik kom, ek en jou moeder en jou broers, om ons voor jou na die aarde neer te buig?

kjv_text: And his brethren envied him; but his father observed the saying.
bsb_text: And his brothers were jealous of him, but his father kept in mind what he had said.
aov_text: En sy broers was afgunstig op hom, maar sy vader het die saak in gedagte gehou.

kjv_text: And his brethren went to feed their father's flock in Shechem.
bsb_text: Some time later, Joseph’s brothers had gone to pasture their father’s flocks near Shechem.
aov_text: En sy broers het die kleinvee van hulle vader by Sigem gaan oppas.

kjv_text: And Israel said unto Joseph, Do not thy brethren feed the flock in Shechem? come, and I will send thee unto them. And he said to him, Here am I.
bsb_text: Israel said to him, “Are not your brothers pasturing the flocks at Shechem? Get ready; I am sending you to them.” “I am ready,” Joseph replied.
aov_text: Toe sê Israel vir Josef: Pas jou broers nie die vee op by Sigem nie? Kom, laat ek jou na hulle toe stuur. En hy antwoord hom: Hier is ek!

kjv_text: And he said to him, Go, I pray thee, see whether it be well with thy brethren, and well with the flocks; and bring me word again. So he sent him out of the vale of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.
bsb_text: Then Israel told him, “Go now and see how your brothers and the flocks are faring, and bring word back to me.” So he sent him off from the Valley of Hebron. And when Joseph arrived in Shechem,
aov_text: Toe sê hy vir hom: Gaan tog verneem na die welstand van jou broers en die welstand van die vee, en bring vir my berig terug. So het hy hom dan uit die dal van Hebron weggestuur, en hy het by Sigem aangekom.

kjv_text: And a certain man found him, and, behold, he was wandering in the field: and the man asked him, saying, What seekest thou?
bsb_text: a man found him wandering in the field and asked, “What are you looking for?”
aov_text: Daarop kry ’n man hom terwyl hy in die veld ronddwaal, en die man vra hom: Wat soek jy?

kjv_text: And he said, I seek my brethren: tell me, I pray thee, where they feed their flocks.
bsb_text: “I am looking for my brothers,” Joseph replied. “Can you please tell me where they are pasturing their flocks?”
aov_text: En hy antwoord: Ek soek my broers. Vertel my tog waar hulle die vee oppas.

kjv_text: And the man said, They are departed hence; for I heard them say, Let us go to Dothan. And Joseph went after his brethren, and found them in Dothan.
bsb_text: “They have moved on from here,” the man answered. “I heard them say, ‘Let us go to Dothan.’” So Joseph set out after his brothers and found them at Dothan.
aov_text: Toe sê die man: Hulle het hiervandaan weggetrek, want ek het hulle hoor sê: Laat ons na Dotan gaan. En Josef het agter sy broers aan gegaan en hulle in Dotan gevind.

kjv_text: And when they saw him afar off, even before he came near unto them, they conspired against him to slay him.
bsb_text: Now Joseph’s brothers saw him in the distance, and before he arrived, they plotted to kill him.
aov_text: En hulle het hom van ver af gesien. Maar voordat hy naby hulle kom, het hulle listig raad gehou teen hom om hom dood te maak.

kjv_text: And they said one to another, Behold, this dreamer cometh.
bsb_text: “Here comes that dreamer!” they said to one another.
aov_text: En hulle het vir mekaar gesê: Daar kom daardie dromer aan!

kjv_text: Come now therefore, and let us slay him, and cast him into some pit, and we will say, Some evil beast hath devoured him: and we shall see what will become of his dreams.
bsb_text: “Come now, let us kill him and throw him into one of the pits. We can say that a vicious animal has devoured him. Then we shall see what becomes of his dreams!”
aov_text: Kom dan nou, laat ons hom doodmaak en in een van die putte gooi en sê: ’n Wilde dier het hom opgeëet. Dan sal ons sien wat van sy drome word.

kjv_text: And Reuben heard it, and he delivered him out of their hands; and said, Let us not kill him.
bsb_text: When Reuben heard this, he tried to rescue Joseph from their hands. “Let us not take his life,” he said.
aov_text: Toe Ruben dit hoor, het hy hom uit hulle hand gered deur te sê: Laat ons hom nie doodslaan nie.

kjv_text: And Reuben said unto them, Shed no blood, but cast him into this pit that is in the wilderness, and lay no hand upon him; that he might rid him out of their hands, to deliver him to his father again.
bsb_text: “Do not shed his blood. Throw him into this pit in the wilderness, but do not lay a hand on him.” Reuben said this so that he could rescue Joseph from their hands and return him to his father.
aov_text: Ruben het ook vir hulle gesê: Moenie bloed vergiet nie; gooi hom in hierdie put wat in die woestyn is, maar moenie die hand aan hom slaan nie—sodat hy hom uit hulle hand kon red om hom na sy vader terug te bring.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when Joseph was come unto his brethren, that they stript Joseph out of his coat, his coat of many colours that was on him;
bsb_text: So when Joseph came to his brothers, they stripped him of his robe—the robe of many colors he was wearing—
aov_text: En toe Josef by sy broers kom, trek hulle Josef se rok uit, die rok met lang moue wat hy aangehad het,

kjv_text: And they took him, and cast him into a pit: and the pit was empty, there was no water in it.
bsb_text: and they took him and threw him into the pit. Now the pit was empty, with no water in it.
aov_text: en hulle neem hom en gooi hom in die put. Maar die put was leeg; daar was geen water in nie.

kjv_text: And they sat down to eat bread: and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and, behold, a company of Ishmeelites came from Gilead with their camels bearing spicery and balm and myrrh, going to carry it down to Egypt.
bsb_text: And as they sat down to eat a meal, they looked up and saw a caravan of Ishmaelites coming from Gilead. Their camels were carrying spices, balm, and myrrh on their way down to Egypt.
aov_text: Daarna het hulle gaan sit om brood te eet; en toe hulle hul oë opslaan, sien hulle meteens ’n reisgeselskap Ismaeliete wat uit Gílead kom—hulle kamele gelaai met speserye en balsem en gom—op pad om dit na Egipte af te bring.

kjv_text: And Judah said unto his brethren, What profit is it if we slay our brother, and conceal his blood?
bsb_text: Then Judah said to his brothers, “What profit will we gain if we kill our brother and cover up his blood?
aov_text: Toe sê Juda aan sy broers: Watter voordeel is dit dat ons ons broer doodmaak en sy bloed verberg?

kjv_text: Come, and let us sell him to the Ishmeelites, and let not our hand be upon him; for he is our brother and our flesh. And his brethren were content.
bsb_text: Come, let us sell him to the Ishmaelites and not lay a hand on him; for he is our brother, our own flesh.” And they agreed.
aov_text: Kom, laat ons hom aan die Ismaeliete verkoop, maar laat ons hand nie teen hom wees nie, want hy is ons broer, ons vlees. En sy broers het na hom geluister.

kjv_text: Then there passed by Midianites merchantmen; and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmeelites for twenty pieces of silver: and they brought Joseph into Egypt.
bsb_text: So when the Midianite traders passed by, his brothers pulled Joseph out of the pit and sold him for twenty shekels of silver to the Ishmaelites, who took him to Egypt.
aov_text: En toe Midianitiese koopmans verbykom, het hulle Josef uit die put uit opgetrek en uitgehaal en Josef aan die Ismaeliete verkoop vir twintig sikkels silwer. En húlle het Josef na Egipte gebring.

kjv_text: And Reuben returned unto the pit; and, behold, Joseph was not in the pit; and he rent his clothes.
bsb_text: When Reuben returned to the pit and saw that Joseph was not there, he tore his clothes,
aov_text: Toe Ruben by die put terugkom, was Josef nie in die put nie! Daarop skeur hy sy klere,

kjv_text: And he returned unto his brethren, and said, The child is not; and I, whither shall I go?
bsb_text: returned to his brothers, and said, “The boy is gone! What am I going to do?”
aov_text: en hy gaan na sy broers terug en sê: Die seun is nie daar nie! En ek, waar moet ek heen?

kjv_text: And they took Joseph's coat, and killed a kid of the goats, and dipped the coat in the blood;
bsb_text: Then they took Joseph’s robe, slaughtered a young goat, and dipped the robe in its blood.
aov_text: Toe neem hulle Josef se rok, en hulle slag ’n bok en steek die rok in die bloed,

kjv_text: And they sent the coat of many colours, and they brought it to their father; and said, This have we found: know now whether it be thy son's coat or no.
bsb_text: They sent the robe of many colors to their father and said, “We found this. Examine it to see whether it is your son’s robe or not.”
aov_text: en hulle stuur die lang rok weg en laat dit na hulle vader bring met die woorde: Dit het ons gevind. Kyk tog goed of dit die rok van u seun is of nie.

kjv_text: And he knew it, and said, It is my son's coat; an evil beast hath devoured him; Joseph is without doubt rent in pieces.
bsb_text: His father recognized it and said, “It is my son’s robe! A vicious animal has devoured him. Joseph has surely been torn to pieces!”
aov_text: En hy het dit herken en gesê: Die rok van my seun! ’n Wilde dier het hom opgeëet. Verskeur, verskeur is Josef!

kjv_text: And Jacob rent his clothes, and put sackcloth upon his loins, and mourned for his son many days.
bsb_text: Then Jacob tore his clothes, put sackcloth around his waist, and mourned for his son many days.
aov_text: Toe skeur Jakob sy klere en trek ’n roukleed om sy heupe, en hy het oor sy seun gerou, baie dae lank.

kjv_text: And all his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him; but he refused to be comforted; and he said, For I will go down into the grave unto my son mourning. Thus his father wept for him.
bsb_text: All his sons and daughters tried to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted. “No,” he said. “I will go down to Sheol mourning for my son.” So his father wept for him.
aov_text: En al sy seuns en al sy dogters het moeite gedoen om hom te troos, maar hy het geweier om hom te laat troos en gesê: Nee, treurende sal ek na my seun in die doderyk afdaal! So het sy vader hom dan beween.

kjv_text: And the Midianites sold him into Egypt unto Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh's, and captain of the guard.
bsb_text: Meanwhile, the Midianites sold Joseph in Egypt to Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh and captain of the guard.
aov_text: En die Midianiete het hom na Egipte verkoop aan Pótifar, ’n hofdienaar van Farao, die owerste van die lyfwag.

kjv_text: And it came to pass at that time, that Judah went down from his brethren, and turned in to a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.
bsb_text: About that time, Judah left his brothers and settled near a man named Hirah, an Adullamite.
aov_text: IN dié tyd het Juda afgetrek, van sy broers af weg, en uitgedraai na ’n man van Adúllam met die naam van Hira.

kjv_text: And Judah saw there a daughter of a certain Canaanite, whose name was Shuah; and he took her, and went in unto her.
bsb_text: There Judah saw the daughter of a Canaanite man named Shua, and he took her as a wife and slept with her.
aov_text: En Juda het daar die dogter van ’n Kanaänitiese man gesien met die naam van Sua; en hy het met haar getrou en by haar ingegaan.

kjv_text: And she conceived, and bare a son; and he called his name Er.
bsb_text: So she conceived and gave birth to a son, and Judah named him Er.
aov_text: En sy het bevrug geword en ’n seun gebaar, en sy het hom Er genoem.

kjv_text: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and she called his name Onan.
bsb_text: Again she conceived and gave birth to a son, and she named him Onan.
aov_text: Daarna het sy weer bevrug geword en ’n seun gebaar en hom Onan genoem.

kjv_text: And she yet again conceived, and bare a son; and called his name Shelah: and he was at Chezib, when she bare him.
bsb_text: Then she gave birth to another son and named him Shelah; it was at Chezib that she gave birth to him.
aov_text: En sy het nog weer ’n seun gebaar en hom Sela genoem; en hy was in Kesib toe sy hom gebaar het.

kjv_text: And Judah took a wife for Er his firstborn, whose name was Tamar.
bsb_text: Now Judah acquired a wife for Er, his firstborn, and her name was Tamar.
aov_text: En Juda het vir Er, sy eersgeborene, ’n vrou geneem, en haar naam was Tamar.

kjv_text: And Er, Judah's firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the LORD; and the LORD slew him.
bsb_text: But Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the LORD; so the LORD put him to death.
aov_text: Maar Er, die eersgeborene van Juda, het die HERE mishaag. Daarom het die HERE hom laat sterwe.

kjv_text: And Judah said unto Onan, Go in unto thy brother's wife, and marry her, and raise up seed to thy brother.
bsb_text: Then Judah said to Onan, “Sleep with your brother’s wife. Perform your duty as her brother-in-law and raise up offspring for your brother.”
aov_text: Toe sê Juda vir Onan: Gaan in by die vrou van jou broer en sluit die swaershuwelik met haar en verwek vir jou broer ’n nageslag.

kjv_text: And Onan knew that the seed should not be his; and it came to pass, when he went in unto his brother's wife, that he spilled it on the ground, lest that he should give seed to his brother.
bsb_text: But Onan knew that the offspring would not belong to him; so whenever he would sleep with his brother’s wife, he would spill his seed on the ground so that he would not produce offspring for his brother.
aov_text: Maar Onan het geweet dat die nageslag nie syne sou wees nie; daarom het hy, elke keer as hy by die vrou van sy broer ingaan, dit op die grond verderwe om vir sy broer geen nageslag te gee nie.

kjv_text: And the thing which he did displeased the LORD: wherefore he slew him also.
bsb_text: What he did was wicked in the sight of the LORD, so He put Onan to death as well.
aov_text: En dit was verkeerd in die oë van die HERE wat hy gedoen het; daarom het Hy hom ook laat sterwe.

kjv_text: Then said Judah to Tamar his daughter in law, Remain a widow at thy father's house, till Shelah my son be grown: for he said, Lest peradventure he die also, as his brethren did. And Tamar went and dwelt in her father's house.
bsb_text: Then Judah said to his daughter-in-law Tamar, “Live as a widow in your father’s house until my son Shelah grows up.” For he thought, “He may die too, like his brothers.” So Tamar went to live in her father’s house.
aov_text: Toe sê Juda vir Tamar, sy skoondogter: Bly ’n weduwee in die huis van jou vader totdat my seun Sela groot is. Want hy het gedink: Anders sterwe hy ook soos sy broers! So het Tamar dan gaan woon in die huis van haar vader.

kjv_text: And in process of time the daughter of Shuah Judah's wife died; and Judah was comforted, and went up unto his sheepshearers to Timnath, he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite.
bsb_text: After a long time Judah’s wife, the daughter of Shua, died. When Judah had finished mourning, he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite went up to his sheepshearers at Timnah.
aov_text: En ná verloop van geruime tyd het die dogter van Sua, die vrou van Juda, gesterwe. En toe Juda klaar getreur het, het hy opgegaan na die skeerders van sy kleinvee, na Timna toe, hy en sy vriend Hira, die Adullamiet.

kjv_text: And it was told Tamar, saying, Behold thy father in law goeth up to Timnath to shear his sheep.
bsb_text: When Tamar was told, “Your father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep,”
aov_text: En hulle het Tamar te kenne gegee en gesê: Kyk, jou skoonvader gaan op na Timna om sy kleinvee te skeer.

kjv_text: And she put her widow's garments off from her, and covered her with a vail, and wrapped herself, and sat in an open place, which is by the way to Timnath; for she saw that Shelah was grown, and she was not given unto him to wife.
bsb_text: she removed her widow’s garments, covered her face with a veil to disguise herself, and sat at the entrance to Enaim, which is on the way to Timnah. For she saw that although Shelah had grown up, she had not been given to him as a wife.
aov_text: Toe trek sy die klere van haar weduweeskap uit en bedek haar met ’n sluier en draai haar toe; en sy het gaan sit by die ingang van Enaim wat op die pad na Timna lê. Want sy het gesien dat Sela groot geword het, maar sy was aan hom nie as vrou gegee nie.

kjv_text: When Judah saw her, he thought her to be an harlot; because she had covered her face.
bsb_text: When Judah saw her, he thought she was a prostitute because she had covered her face.
aov_text: Toe Juda haar sien, het hy haar vir ’n hoer gehou, omdat sy haar gesig toegebind het;

kjv_text: And he turned unto her by the way, and said, Go to, I pray thee, let me come in unto thee; (for he knew not that she was his daughter in law.) And she said, What wilt thou give me, that thou mayest come in unto me?
bsb_text: Not realizing that she was his daughter-in-law, he went over to her and said, “Come now, let me sleep with you.” “What will you give me for sleeping with you?” she inquired.
aov_text: en hy het na haar uitgedraai by die pad en gesê: Kom tog, laat my by jou ingaan; want hy het nie geweet dat dit sy skoondogter was nie. En sy vra: Wat sal jy my gee as jy by my ingaan?

kjv_text: And he said, I will send thee a kid from the flock. And she said, Wilt thou give me a pledge, till thou send it?
bsb_text: “I will send you a young goat from my flock,” Judah answered. But she replied, “Only if you leave me something as a pledge until you send it.”
aov_text: En hy antwoord: Ek sal jou ’n boklam van die kleinvee af stuur. Toe sê sy: As jy ’n pand gee totdat jy dit stuur.

kjv_text: And he said, What pledge shall I give thee? And she said, Thy signet, and thy bracelets, and thy staff that is in thine hand. And he gave it her, and came in unto her, and she conceived by him.
bsb_text: “What pledge should I give you?” he asked. She answered, “Your seal and your cord, and the staff in your hand.” So he gave them to her and slept with her, and she became pregnant by him.
aov_text: En hy sê: Wat is die pand wat ek jou moet gee? Toe antwoord sy: Jou seëlring met die bandjie en jou staf wat in jou hand is. Hy gee dit toe aan haar en gaan by haar in, en sy het by hom swanger geword.

kjv_text: And she arose, and went away, and laid by her vail from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.
bsb_text: Then Tamar got up and departed. And she removed her veil and put on her widow’s garments again.
aov_text: En sy het opgestaan en weggegaan en haar sluier afgehaal en die klere van haar weduweeskap aangetrek.

kjv_text: And Judah sent the kid by the hand of his friend the Adullamite, to receive his pledge from the woman's hand: but he found her not.
bsb_text: Now when Judah sent his friend Hirah the Adullamite with the young goat to collect the items he had left with the woman, he could not find her.
aov_text: En Juda het die boklam gestuur deur middel van sy vriend, die Adullamiet, om die pand uit die hand van die vrou te gaan haal. Maar hy het haar nie gevind nie.

kjv_text: Then he asked the men of that place, saying, Where is the harlot, that was openly by the way side? And they said, There was no harlot in this place.
bsb_text: He asked the men of that place, “Where is the shrine prostitute who was beside the road at Enaim?” “No shrine prostitute has been here,” they answered.
aov_text: Toe vra hy die mense van haar woonplek: Waar is daardie hoer wat in Enaim by die pad was? En hulle antwoord: Hier was geen hoer nie.

kjv_text: And he returned to Judah, and said, I cannot find her; and also the men of the place said, that there was no harlot in this place.
bsb_text: So Hirah returned to Judah and said, “I could not find her, and furthermore, the men of that place said, ‘No shrine prostitute has been here.’”
aov_text: Daarop gaan hy na Juda terug met die berig: Ek het haar nie gevind nie. En die mense van die plek het ook gesê: Hier was geen hoer nie.

kjv_text: And Judah said, Let her take it to her, lest we be shamed: behold, I sent this kid, and thou hast not found her.
bsb_text: “Let her keep the items,” Judah replied. “Otherwise we will become a laughingstock. After all, I did send her this young goat, but you could not find her.”
aov_text: Toe sê Juda: Laat sy dit hou, dat ons nie ’n bespotting word nie. Kyk, ek het hierdie boklam gestuur, maar jy het haar nie gevind nie.

kjv_text: And it came to pass about three months after, that it was told Judah, saying, Tamar thy daughter in law hath played the harlot; and also, behold, she is with child by whoredom. And Judah said, Bring her forth, and let her be burnt.
bsb_text: About three months later, Judah was told, “Your daughter-in-law Tamar has prostituted herself, and now she is pregnant.” “Bring her out!” Judah replied. “Let her be burned to death!”
aov_text: Ná omtrent drie maande het hulle Juda laat weet en gesê: Tamar, jou skoondogter, het gehoereer, en sy is ook swanger deur hoerery! En Juda sê: Bring haar uit, dat sy verbrand kan word.

kjv_text: When she was brought forth, she sent to her father in law, saying, By the man, whose these are, am I with child: and she said, Discern, I pray thee, whose are these, the signet, and bracelets, and staff.
bsb_text: As she was being brought out, Tamar sent a message to her father-in-law: “I am pregnant by the man to whom these items belong.” And she added, “Please examine them. Whose seal and cord and staff are these?”
aov_text: Terwyl sy uitgebring word, laat sy haar skoonvader dit weet: By die man aan wie hierdie dinge behoort, is ek swanger. En sy het gesê: Kyk tog mooi aan wie hierdie seëlring en bandjies en staf behoort.

kjv_text: And Judah acknowledged them, and said, She hath been more righteous than I; because that I gave her not to Shelah my son. And he knew her again no more.
bsb_text: Judah recognized the items and said, “She is more righteous than I, since I did not give her to my son Shelah.” And he did not have relations with her again.
aov_text: En Juda het dit herken en gesê: Sy het reg teenoor my, want ek het haar mos nie aan my seun Sela gegee nie. En hy het haar verder nie meer beken nie.

kjv_text: And it came to pass in the time of her travail, that, behold, twins were in her womb.
bsb_text: When the time came for Tamar to give birth, there were twins in her womb.
aov_text: En toe sy sou baar, was daar ’n tweeling in haar skoot.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when she travailed, that the one put out his hand: and the midwife took and bound upon his hand a scarlet thread, saying, This came out first.
bsb_text: And as she was giving birth, one of them put out his hand; so the midwife took a scarlet thread and tied it around his wrist. “This one came out first,” she announced.
aov_text: En terwyl sy baar, het een die hand uitgesteek; en die vroedvrou het dit gegryp en ’n rooi draad om sy hand gebind en gesê: Hierdie een is eerste gebore.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, as he drew back his hand, that, behold, his brother came out: and she said, How hast thou broken forth? this breach be upon thee: therefore his name was called Pharez.
bsb_text: But when he pulled his hand back and his brother came out, she said, “You have broken out first!” So he was named Perez.
aov_text: Maar toe hy sy hand teruggetrek het, word sy broer gebore! En sy sê: Hoe kragtig het jy deurgebreek! En hulle het hom Peres genoem.

kjv_text: And afterward came out his brother, that had the scarlet thread upon his hand: and his name was called Zarah.
bsb_text: Then his brother came out with the scarlet thread around his wrist, and he was named Zerah.
aov_text: En daarna is sy broer gebore aan wie se hand die rooi draad was. En hulle het hom Serag genoem.

kjv_text: And Joseph was brought down to Egypt; and Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh, captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him of the hands of the Ishmeelites, which had brought him down thither.
bsb_text: Meanwhile, Joseph had been taken down to Egypt, where an Egyptian named Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh and captain of the guard, bought him from the Ishmaelites who had taken him there.
aov_text: EN Josef is afgebring na Egipte; en Pótifar, ’n hofdienaar van Farao, die owerste van die lyfwag, ’n Egiptiese man, het hom gekoop uit die hand van die Ismaeliete wat hom daarheen afgebring het.

kjv_text: And the LORD was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.
bsb_text: And the LORD was with Joseph, and he became a successful man, serving in the household of his Egyptian master.
aov_text: En die HERE was met Josef, sodat hy ’n voorspoedige man was; en hy het in die huis van sy heer, die Egiptenaar, gebly.

kjv_text: And his master saw that the LORD was with him, and that the LORD made all that he did to prosper in his hand.
bsb_text: When his master saw that the LORD was with him and made him prosper in all he did,
aov_text: En toe sy heer sien dat die HERE met hom was, en dat die HERE alles wat hy doen, in sy hand voorspoedig maak,

kjv_text: And Joseph found grace in his sight, and he served him: and he made him overseer over his house, and all that he had he put into his hand.
bsb_text: Joseph found favor in his sight and became his personal attendant. Potiphar put him in charge of his household and entrusted him with everything he owned.
aov_text: het Josef guns in sy oë gevind en hom gedien; en hy het hom aangestel oor sy huis, en alles wat in sy besit was, aan hom oorgegee.

kjv_text: And it came to pass from the time that he had made him overseer in his house, and over all that he had, that the LORD blessed the Egyptian's house for Joseph's sake; and the blessing of the LORD was upon all that he had in the house, and in the field.
bsb_text: From the time that he put Joseph in charge of his household and all he owned, the LORD blessed the Egyptian’s household on account of him. The LORD’s blessing was on everything he owned, both in his house and in his field.
aov_text: En vandat hy hom aangestel het oor sy huis en oor alles wat in sy besit was, het die HERE die huis van die Egiptenaar geseën ter wille van Josef; ja, die seën van die HERE was by alles wat syne was, in die huis en op die veld.

aov_text: Daarna het ek in my droom gesien, en kyk, sewe vol en mooi are skiet op aan een steel.

kjv_text: And, behold, seven ears, withered, thin, and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them:
bsb_text: After them, seven other heads of grain sprouted—withered, thin, and scorched by the east wind.
aov_text: En ná hulle spruit daar sewe are uit wat dor, maer en deur die oostewind verskroei was;

kjv_text: And the thin ears devoured the seven good ears: and I told this unto the magicians; but there was none that could declare it to me.
bsb_text: And the thin heads of grain swallowed the seven plump ones. I told this dream to the magicians, but no one could explain it to me.”
aov_text: en die sewe maer are het die sewe mooi are verslind. En ek het dit aan die towenaars meegedeel, maar niemand kon my inligting gee nie.

kjv_text: And Joseph said unto Pharaoh, The dream of Pharaoh is one: God hath shewed Pharaoh what he is about to do.
bsb_text: At this, Joseph said to Pharaoh, “The dreams of Pharaoh are one and the same. God has revealed to Pharaoh what He is about to do.
aov_text: Toe sê Josef vir Farao: Die droom van Farao is een en dieselfde. Wat God van plan is om te doen, het Hy aan Farao te kenne gegee.

kjv_text: The seven good kine are seven years; and the seven good ears are seven years: the dream is one.
bsb_text: The seven good cows are seven years, and the seven ripe heads of grain are seven years. The dreams have the same meaning.
aov_text: Die sewe mooi koeie is sewe jare; en die sewe mooi are is sewe jare; die droom is een en dieselfde.

kjv_text: And the seven thin and ill favoured kine that came up after them are seven years; and the seven empty ears blasted with the east wind shall be seven years of famine.
bsb_text: Moreover, the seven thin, ugly cows that came up after them are seven years, and so are the seven worthless heads of grain scorched by the east wind—they are seven years of famine.
aov_text: En die sewe maer en lelike koeie wat ná hulle opgekom het, is sewe jare; en die sewe maer, deur die oostewind verskroeide are sal sewe jare van hongersnood wees.

kjv_text: This is the thing which I have spoken unto Pharaoh: What God is about to do he sheweth unto Pharaoh.
bsb_text: It is just as I said to Pharaoh: God has shown Pharaoh what He is about to do.
aov_text: Dit is die woord wat ek tot Farao gespreek het: wat God van plan is om te doen, het Hy Farao laat sien.

kjv_text: Behold, there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt:
bsb_text: Behold, seven years of great abundance are coming throughout the land of Egypt,
aov_text: Kyk, daar kom sewe jare van groot oorvloed in die hele Egipteland;

kjv_text: And there shall arise after them seven years of famine; and all the plenty shall be forgotten in the land of Egypt; and the famine shall consume the land;
bsb_text: but seven years of famine will follow them. Then all the abundance in the land of Egypt will be forgotten, and the famine will devastate the land.
aov_text: maar daarna sal sewe jare van hongersnood aanbreek, en al die oorvloed sal in Egipteland vergeet word, en die hongersnood sal die land verteer.

kjv_text: And the plenty shall not be known in the land by reason of that famine following; for it shall be very grievous.
bsb_text: The abundance in the land will not be remembered, since the famine that follows it will be so severe.
aov_text: En van die oorvloed sal in die land niks gemerk word weens dié hongersnood wat daarna sal wees nie; want dit sal baie swaar wees.

kjv_text: And for that the dream was doubled unto Pharaoh twice; it is because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.
bsb_text: Moreover, because the dream was given to Pharaoh in two versions, the matter has been decreed by God, and He will carry it out shortly.
aov_text: En wat dit betref dat die droom twee maal vir Farao herhaal is—dit is omdat die saak deur God vas besluit is en God dit gou sal doen.

kjv_text: Now therefore let Pharaoh look out a man discreet and wise, and set him over the land of Egypt.
bsb_text: Now, therefore, Pharaoh should look for a discerning and wise man and set him over the land of Egypt.
aov_text: Laat Farao dan nou uitkyk na ’n verstandige en wyse man en hom aanstel oor Egipteland.

kjv_text: Let Pharaoh do this, and let him appoint officers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt in the seven plenteous years.
bsb_text: Let Pharaoh take action and appoint commissioners over the land to take a fifth of the harvest of Egypt during the seven years of abundance.
aov_text: Farao moet so maak en opsigters oor die land aanstel en in die sewe jare van oorvloed die vyfde deel hef van die opbrings van Egipteland.

kjv_text: And let them gather all the food of those good years that come, and lay up corn under the hand of Pharaoh, and let them keep food in the cities.
bsb_text: Under the authority of Pharaoh, let them collect all the excess food from these good years, that they may come and lay up the grain to be preserved as food in the cities.
aov_text: En hulle moet al die voedsel van hierdie goeie jare wat kom, versamel en onder leiding van Farao koring ophoop as voedsel in die stede en dit wegbêre.

kjv_text: And that food shall be for store to the land against the seven years of famine, which shall be in the land of Egypt; that the land perish not through the famine.
bsb_text: This food will be a reserve for the land during the seven years of famine to come upon the land of Egypt. Then the country will not perish in the famine.”
aov_text: So sal dan die voedsel ’n voorraad wees vir die land vir die sewe jare van hongersnood wat in Egipteland sal kom, sodat die land nie deur die hongersnood te gronde gaan nie.

kjv_text: And the thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.
bsb_text: This proposal pleased Pharaoh and all his officials.
aov_text: En die woord was goed in die oë van Farao en van al sy dienaars.

kjv_text: And Pharaoh said unto his servants, Can we find such a one as this is, a man in whom the Spirit of God is?
bsb_text: So Pharaoh asked them, “Can we find anyone like this man, in whom the Spirit of God abides?”
aov_text: Daarop het Farao aan sy dienaars gesê: Kan ons wel iemand vind soos hierdie man in wie die Gees van God is?

kjv_text: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Forasmuch as God hath shewed thee all this, there is none so discreet and wise as thou art:
bsb_text: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Since God has made all this known to you, there is no one as discerning and wise as you.
aov_text: En Farao sê vir Josef: Aangesien God dit alles aan jou bekend gemaak het, is daar niemand verstandig en wys soos jy nie.

kjv_text: Thou shalt be over my house, and according unto thy word shall all my people be ruled: only in the throne will I be greater than thou.
bsb_text: You shall be in charge of my house, and all my people are to obey your commands. Only with regard to the throne will I be greater than you.”
aov_text: Jý moet oor my huis wees, en na jou bevel moet my hele volk hulle skik; alleen deur die troon sal ek groter wees as jy.

kjv_text: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, See, I have set thee over all the land of Egypt.
bsb_text: Pharaoh also told Joseph, “I hereby place you over all the land of Egypt.”
aov_text: Verder het Farao vir Josef gesê: Kyk, ek stel jou aan oor die hele Egipteland.

kjv_text: And Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand, and put it upon Joseph's hand, and arrayed him in vestures of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck;
bsb_text: Then Pharaoh removed the signet ring from his finger, put it on Joseph’s finger, clothed him in garments of fine linen, and placed a gold chain around his neck.
aov_text: Toe trek Farao sy seëlring van sy hand af en sit dit aan die hand van Josef; en hy het hom fyn linneklere laat aantrek en die goue ketting om sy hals gehang

kjv_text: And he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had; and they cried before him, Bow the knee: and he made him ruler over all the land of Egypt.
bsb_text: He had Joseph ride in his second chariot, with men calling out before him, “Bow the knee!” So he placed him over all the land of Egypt.
aov_text: en hom laat ry op sy tweede rytuig; en hulle het voor hom uitgeroep: Pas op! So het hy hom dan oor die hele Egipteland aangestel.

kjv_text: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I am Pharaoh, and without thee shall no man lift up his hand or foot in all the land of Egypt.
bsb_text: And Pharaoh declared to Joseph, “I am Pharaoh, but without your permission, no one in all the land of Egypt shall lift his hand or foot.”
aov_text: En Farao sê vir Josef: Ek is Farao, maar sonder jou mag niemand sy hand of voet in die hele Egipteland verroer nie.

kjv_text: And Pharaoh called Joseph's name Zaphnathpaaneah; and he gave him to wife Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On. And Joseph went out over all the land of Egypt.
bsb_text: Pharaoh gave Joseph the name Zaphenath-paneah, and he gave him Asenath daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, to be his wife. And Joseph took charge of all the land of Egypt.
aov_text: En Farao het Josef genoem Sáfenat-Panéag en aan hom Ásenat, die dogter van Potiféra, die priester van On, as vrou gegee. En Josef het uitgetrek oor Egipteland.

kjv_text: And Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.
bsb_text: Now Joseph was thirty years old when he entered the service of Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph left Pharaoh’s presence and traveled throughout the land of Egypt.
aov_text: En Josef was dertig jaar oud toe hy voor Farao, die koning van Egipte, gestaan het; en Josef het van Farao af weggegaan en die hele Egipteland deurgetrek.

kjv_text: And in the seven plenteous years the earth brought forth by handfuls.
bsb_text: During the seven years of abundance, the land brought forth bountifully.
aov_text: En die land het met handvolle opgelewer in die sewe jare van oorvloed.

kjv_text: And he gathered up all the food of the seven years, which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities: the food of the field, which was round about every city, laid he up in the same.
bsb_text: During those seven years, Joseph collected all the excess food in the land of Egypt and stored it in the cities. In every city he laid up the food from the fields around it.
aov_text: Toe het hy al die voedsel van die sewe jare versamel wat in Egipteland gekom het, en voedsel in die stede weggesit—die voedsel van die land wat rondom elke stad was, het hy daarin weggesit.

kjv_text: And Joseph gathered corn as the sand of the sea, very much, until he left numbering; for it was without number.
bsb_text: So Joseph stored up grain in such abundance, like the sand of the sea, that he stopped keeping track of it; for it was beyond measure.
aov_text: So het Josef dan ’n baie groot hoeveelheid koring opgehoop soos die sand van die see, totdat hulle opgehou het om te tel, want dit was ontelbaar.

kjv_text: And unto Joseph were born two sons before the years of famine came, which Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On bare unto him.
bsb_text: Before the years of famine arrived, two sons were born to Joseph by Asenath daughter of Potiphera, priest of On.
aov_text: En vir Josef is twee seuns gebore—voordat die jaar van hongersnood gekom het—wat Ásenat, die dogter van Potiféra, die priester van On, vir hom gebaar het.

kjv_text: And Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh: For God, said he, hath made me forget all my toil, and all my father's house.
bsb_text: Joseph named the firstborn Manasseh, saying, “God has made me forget all my hardship and all my father’s household.”
aov_text: En Josef het die eersgeborene Manasse genoem; want, het hy gesê, God het my al my moeite laat vergeet en ook die hele huis van my vader.

kjv_text: And the name of the second called he Ephraim: For God hath caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction.
bsb_text: And the second son he named Ephraim, saying, “God has made me fruitful in the land of my affliction.”
aov_text: En die tweede het hy Efraim genoem; want, het hy gesê, God het my vrugbaar gemaak in die land van my ellende.

kjv_text: And the seven years of plenteousness, that was in the land of Egypt, were ended.
bsb_text: When the seven years of abundance in the land of Egypt came to an end,
aov_text: Toe het die sewe jare van oorvloed wat daar in Egipteland was, ten einde gekom,

kjv_text: And the seven years of dearth began to come, according as Joseph had said: and the dearth was in all lands; but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.
bsb_text: the seven years of famine began, just as Joseph had said. And although there was famine in every country, there was food throughout the land of Egypt.
aov_text: en die sewe jare van hongersnood het begin aankom soos Josef voorspel het. En daar was hongersnood in al die lande, maar in die hele Egipteland was daar brood.

kjv_text: And when all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread: and Pharaoh said unto all the Egyptians, Go unto Joseph; what he saith to you, do.
bsb_text: When extreme hunger came to all the land of Egypt and the people cried out to Pharaoh for food, he told all the Egyptians, “Go to Joseph and do whatever he tells you.”
aov_text: En toe die hele Egipteland honger gely en die volk na Farao geroep het om brood, sê Farao aan al die Egiptenaars: Gaan na Josef, doen wat hy julle sê.

kjv_text: And the famine was over all the face of the earth: And Joseph opened all the storehouses, and sold unto the Egyptians; and the famine waxed sore in the land of Egypt.
bsb_text: When the famine had spread over all the land, Joseph opened up all the storehouses and sold grain to the Egyptians; for the famine was severe in the land of Egypt.
aov_text: En die hongersnood was oor die hele oppervlakte van die aarde, en Josef het alles waarin iets was, oopgemaak en aan die Egiptenaars verkoop; en die hongersnood was swaar in Egipteland.

kjv_text: And all countries came into Egypt to Joseph for to buy corn; because that the famine was so sore in all lands.
bsb_text: And every nation came to Joseph in Egypt to buy grain, because the famine was severe over all the earth.
aov_text: En die hele wêreld het na Josef in Egipte gekom om koring te koop, want die hongersnood was swaar op die hele aarde.

kjv_text: Now when Jacob saw that there was corn in Egypt, Jacob said unto his sons, Why do ye look one upon another?
bsb_text: When Jacob learned that there was grain in Egypt, he said to his sons, “Why are you staring at one another?”
aov_text: TOE Jakob merk dat daar koring in Egipte was, het Jakob aan sy seuns gesê: Wat kyk julle so na mekaar?

kjv_text: And he said, Behold, I have heard that there is corn in Egypt: get you down thither, and buy for us from thence; that we may live, and not die.
bsb_text: “Look,” he added, “I have heard that there is grain in Egypt. Go down there and buy some for us, so that we may live and not die.”
aov_text: En hy sê: Kyk, ek het gehoor dat daar koring in Egipte is; trek daarheen af, en koop vir ons daar koring, dat ons kan lewe en nie sterwe nie.

kjv_text: And Joseph's ten brethren went down to buy corn in Egypt.
bsb_text: So ten of Joseph’s brothers went down to buy grain from Egypt.
aov_text: Daarop het tien van Josef se broers afgetrek om koring uit Egipte te koop.

kjv_text: But Benjamin, Joseph's brother, Jacob sent not with his brethren; for he said, Lest peradventure mischief befall him.
bsb_text: But Jacob did not send Joseph’s brother Benjamin with his brothers, for he said, “I am afraid that harm might befall him.”
aov_text: Maar Benjamin, die broer van Josef, het Jakob nie saam met sy broers gestuur nie; want hy het gedink: Altemit kan ’n ongeluk hom oorkom.

kjv_text: And the sons of Israel came to buy corn among those that came: for the famine was in the land of Canaan.
bsb_text: So the sons of Israel were among those who came to buy grain, since the famine had also spread to the land of Canaan.
aov_text: So het die seuns van Israel dan gekom om koring te koop onder diegene wat daar aangekom het; want daar was hongersnood in die land Kanaän.

kjv_text: And Joseph was the governor over the land, and he it was that sold to all the people of the land: and Joseph's brethren came, and bowed down themselves before him with their faces to the earth.
bsb_text: Now Joseph was the ruler of the land; he was the one who sold grain to all its people. So when his brothers arrived, they bowed down before him with their faces to the ground.
aov_text: En Josef was die maghebber oor die land, hy wat aan al die mense van die land koring verkoop het; daarom het die broers van Josef gekom en hulle voor hom met die aangesig na die aarde gebuig.

kjv_text: And Joseph saw his brethren, and he knew them, but made himself strange unto them, and spake roughly unto them; and he said unto them, Whence come ye? And they said, From the land of Canaan to buy food.
bsb_text: And when Joseph saw his brothers, he recognized them, but he treated them as strangers and spoke harshly to them. “Where have you come from?” he asked. “From the land of Canaan,” they replied. “We are here to buy food.”
aov_text: Sodra Josef sy broers sien, het hy hulle herken maar hom vreemd teenoor hulle gehou en hulle hard aangespreek en vir hulle gesê: Waar kom julle vandaan? En hulle antwoord: Uit die land Kanaän om voedsel te koop.

kjv_text: And Joseph knew his brethren, but they knew not him.
bsb_text: Although Joseph recognized his brothers, they did not recognize him.
aov_text: En Josef het sy broers herken, maar húlle het hom nie herken nie.

kjv_text: And Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed of them, and said unto them, Ye are spies; to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.
bsb_text: Joseph remembered his dreams about them and said, “You are spies! You have come to see if our land is vulnerable.”
aov_text: Toe dink Josef aan die drome wat hy aangaande hulle gedroom het; en hy sê vir hulle: Julle is spioene, julle het gekom om te kyk waar die land oop is.

kjv_text: And they said unto him, Nay, my lord, but to buy food are thy servants come.
bsb_text: “Not so, my lord,” they replied. “Your servants have come to buy food.
aov_text: Maar hulle het hom geantwoord: Nee, my heer, maar u dienaars het gekom om voedsel te koop.

kjv_text: We are all one man's sons; we are true men, thy servants are no spies.
bsb_text: We are all sons of one man. Your servants are honest men, not spies.”
aov_text: Ons is almal seuns van een man, ons is eerlike mense; u dienaars is geen spioene nie.

kjv_text: And he said unto them, Nay, but to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.
bsb_text: “No,” he told them. “You have come to see if our land is vulnerable.”
aov_text: Toe sê hy vir hulle: Nee, maar julle het gekom om te kyk waar die land oop is.

kjv_text: And they said, Thy servants are twelve brethren, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan; and, behold, the youngest is this day with our father, and one is not.
bsb_text: But they answered, “Your servants are twelve brothers, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan. The youngest is now with our father, and one is no more.”
aov_text: En hulle antwoord: U dienaars is twaalf in getal, ons is broers, seuns van een man in die land Kanaän; en kyk, die jongste is nou by ons vader, maar die een is daar nie meer nie.

kjv_text: And Joseph said unto them, That is it that I spake unto you, saying, Ye are spies:
bsb_text: Then Joseph declared, “Just as I said, you are spies!
aov_text: Toe sê Josef vir hulle: Dit is wat ek julle gesê het: Julle is spioene!

kjv_text: Hereby ye shall be proved: By the life of Pharaoh ye shall not go forth hence, except your youngest brother come hither.
bsb_text: And this is how you will be tested: As surely as Pharaoh lives, you shall not leave this place unless your youngest brother comes here.
aov_text: Hieraan sal julle getoets word: so waar as Farao leef, julle sal hiervandaan nie trek tensy dat julle jongste broer hierheen kom nie.

kjv_text: Send one of you, and let him fetch your brother, and ye shall be kept in prison, that your words may be proved, whether there be any truth in you: or else by the life of Pharaoh surely ye are spies.
bsb_text: Send one of your number to get your brother; the rest of you will be confined so that the truth of your words may be tested. If they are untrue, then as surely as Pharaoh lives, you are spies!”
aov_text: Stuur een van julle, dat hy julle broer gaan haal, maar júlle moet in die gevangenis bly. So sal dan julle woorde getoets word, of die waarheid by julle is of nie. So waar as Farao leef, julle is spioene!

kjv_text: And he put them all together into ward three days.
bsb_text: So Joseph imprisoned them for three days,
aov_text: Daarop het hy hulle saam drie dae lank in bewaring laat hou.

kjv_text: And Joseph said unto them the third day, This do, and live; for I fear God:
bsb_text: and on the third day he said to them, “I fear God. So do this and you will live:
aov_text: En op die derde dag sê Josef vir hulle: Doen dit, dan sal julle lewe; ek vrees God!

kjv_text: If ye be true men, let one of your brethren be bound in the house of your prison: go ye, carry corn for the famine of your houses:
bsb_text: If you are honest, leave one of your brothers in custody while the rest of you go and take back grain to relieve the hunger of your households.
aov_text: As julle eerlike mense is, laat een van julle broers gevange bly in die huis waar julle in bewaring is; maar gaan júlle, bring die koring vir die honger van julle huisgesinne weg,

kjv_text: But bring your youngest brother unto me; so shall your words be verified, and ye shall not die. And they did so.
bsb_text: Then bring your youngest brother to me so that your words can be verified, that you may not die.” And to this they consented.
aov_text: en bring julle jongste broer na my toe—dan sal julle woorde waar gemaak word, en julle sal nie sterwe nie. En hulle het so gedoen.

kjv_text: And they said one to another, We are verily guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the anguish of his soul, when he besought us, and we would not hear; therefore is this distress come upon us.
bsb_text: Then they said to one another, “Surely we are being punished because of our brother. We saw his anguish when he pleaded with us, but we would not listen. That is why this distress has come upon us.”
aov_text: Toe sê hulle vir mekaar: Voorwaar, ons boet nou vanweë ons broer, omdat ons die benoudheid van sy siel gesien het toe hy ons gesmeek het en ons nie geluister het nie—daarom kom hierdie benoudheid oor ons.

kjv_text: And Reuben answered them, saying, Spake I not unto you, saying, Do not sin against the child; and ye would not hear? therefore, behold, also his blood is required.
bsb_text: And Reuben responded, “Didn’t I tell you not to sin against the boy? But you would not listen. Now we must account for his blood!”
aov_text: Daarop antwoord Ruben hulle: Het ek nie vir julle gesê nie: Besondig julle nie aan die seun nie? Maar julle het nie geluister nie. Kyk, so word dan ook sy bloed geëis.

kjv_text: And they knew not that Joseph understood them; for he spake unto them by an interpreter.
bsb_text: They did not realize that Joseph understood them, since there was an interpreter between them.
aov_text: En hulle het nie geweet dat Josef dit verstaan nie, want daar was ’n tolk tussen hulle.

kjv_text: And he turned himself about from them, and wept; and returned to them again, and communed with them, and took from them Simeon, and bound him before their eyes.
bsb_text: And he turned away from them and wept. When he turned back and spoke to them, he took Simeon from them and had him bound before their eyes.
aov_text: Toe draai hy hom van hulle af weg en ween. Daarna het hy na hulle teruggegaan en met hulle gespreek; en hy het Símeon onder hulle uitgeneem en hom voor hulle oë gebind.

kjv_text: Then Joseph commanded to fill their sacks with corn, and to restore every man's money into his sack, and to give them provision for the way: and thus did he unto them.
bsb_text: Then Joseph gave orders to fill their bags with grain, to return each man’s silver to his sack, and to give them provisions for their journey. This order was carried out,
aov_text: Daarop gee Josef bevel om hulle sakke vol koring te maak en elkeen se geld weer in sy sak te sit en om aan hulle padkos vir die reis saam te gee. En so is aan hulle gedoen.

kjv_text: And they laded their asses with the corn, and departed thence.
bsb_text: and they loaded the grain on their donkeys and departed.
aov_text: En hulle het die koring op hulle esels gelaai en daar weggetrek.

kjv_text: And as one of them opened his sack to give his ass provender in the inn, he espied his money; for, behold, it was in his sack's mouth.
bsb_text: At the place where they lodged for the night, one of them opened his sack to get feed for his donkey, and he saw his silver in the mouth of the sack.
aov_text: En toe die een sy sak oopmaak om sy esel in die herberg voer te gee, sien hy sy geld; en kyk, dit was somaar bo in sy sak!

kjv_text: And he said unto his brethren, My money is restored; and, lo, it is even in my sack: and their heart failed them, and they were afraid, saying one to another, What is this that God hath done unto us?
bsb_text: “My silver has been returned!” he said to his brothers. “It is here in my sack.” Their hearts sank, and trembling, they turned to one another and said, “What is this that God has done to us?”
aov_text: En hy sê vir sy broers: My geld is teruggegee; hier lê dit dan ook in my sak! Toe het hulle hart hul begewe, en hulle draai verskrik na mekaar toe en sê: Wat het God ons nou aangedoen?

kjv_text: And they came unto Jacob their father unto the land of Canaan, and told him all that befell unto them; saying,
bsb_text: When they reached their father Jacob in the land of Canaan, they described to him all that had happened to them:
aov_text: En hulle het by hul vader Jakob in die land Kanaän gekom en hom alles vertel wat hulle wedervaar het en gesê:

kjv_text: The man, who is the lord of the land, spake roughly to us, and took us for spies of the country.
bsb_text: “The man who is lord of the land spoke harshly to us and accused us of spying on the country.
aov_text: Die man, die heer van die land, het ons hard aangespreek en ons vir spioene van die land gehou.

kjv_text: And we said unto him, We are true men; we are no spies:
bsb_text: But we told him, ‘We are honest men, not spies.
aov_text: Maar ons het aan hom gesê: Ons is eerlike mense, ons is geen spioene nie.

kjv_text: We be twelve brethren, sons of our father; one is not, and the youngest is this day with our father in the land of Canaan.
bsb_text: We are twelve brothers, sons of one father. One is no more, and the youngest is now with our father in the land of Canaan.’
aov_text: Ons is twaalf broers, seuns van ons vader; die een is daar nie meer nie, en die jongste is nou by ons vader in die land Kanaän.

kjv_text: And the man, the lord of the country, said unto us, Hereby shall I know that ye are true men; leave one of your brethren here with me, and take food for the famine of your households, and be gone:
bsb_text: Then the man who is lord of the land said to us, ‘This is how I will know whether you are honest: Leave one brother with me, take food to relieve the hunger of your households, and go.
aov_text: Daarop het die man, die heer van die land, aan ons gesê: Hieraan sal ek weet dat julle eerlike mense is—laat een van julle broers by my bly; en neem vir die honger van julle huisgesinne en trek weg,

kjv_text: And bring your youngest brother unto me: then shall I know that ye are no spies, but that ye are true men: so will I deliver you your brother, and ye shall traffick in the land.
bsb_text: But bring your youngest brother back to me so I will know that you are not spies but honest men. Then I will give your brother back to you, and you can trade in the land.’”
aov_text: en bring julle jongste broer na my toe; dan sal ek weet dat julle geen spioene is nie. As julle eerlike mense is, sal ek julle broer aan julle teruggee, en julle mag in die land rondtrek.

kjv_text: And it came to pass as they emptied their sacks, that, behold, every man's bundle of money was in his sack: and when both they and their father saw the bundles of money, they were afraid.
bsb_text: As they began emptying their sacks, there in each man’s sack was his bag of silver! And when they and their father saw the bags of silver, they were dismayed.
aov_text: En toe hulle hul sakke leegmaak, was elkeen se bondeltjie geld daar in sy sak! En toe hulle hul bondeljies geld sien, hulle en hul vader, was hulle bevrees.

kjv_text: And Jacob their father said unto them, Me have ye bereaved of my children: Joseph is not, and Simeon is not, and ye will take Benjamin away: all these things are against me.
bsb_text: Their father Jacob said to them, “You have deprived me of my sons. Joseph is gone and Simeon is no more. Now you want to take Benjamin. Everything is going against me!”
aov_text: Daarop sê Jakob, hulle vader, vir hulle: Julle beroof my van kinders. Josef is weg! En Símeon is weg! En Benjamin wil julle wegneem! Alles is teen my!

kjv_text: And Reuben spake unto his father, saying, Slay my two sons, if I bring him not to thee: deliver him into my hand, and I will bring him to thee again.
bsb_text: Then Reuben said to his father, “You may kill my two sons if I fail to bring him back to you. Put him in my care, and I will return him.”
aov_text: Toe spreek Ruben sy vader aan en sê: U kan my twee seuns doodmaak as ek hom nie na u terugbring nie. Vertrou hom aan my toe, en ék sal hom na u terugbring.

kjv_text: And he said, My son shall not go down with you; for his brother is dead, and he is left alone: if mischief befall him by the way in the which ye go, then shall ye bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.
bsb_text: But Jacob replied, “My son will not go down there with you, for his brother is dead, and he alone is left. If any harm comes to him on your journey, you will bring my gray hair down to Sheol in sorrow.”
aov_text: Maar hy sê: My seun sal nie saam met julle aftrek nie, want sy broer is dood, en hy het alleen oorgebly; en as ’n ongeluk hom oorkom op die pad wat julle sal gaan, dan sal julle my grys hare met kommer in die doderyk laat afdaal.

kjv_text: And the famine was sore in the land.
bsb_text: Now the famine was still severe in the land.
aov_text: EN die hongersnood was swaar in die land.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when they had eaten up the corn which they had brought out of Egypt, their father said unto them, Go again, buy us a little food.
bsb_text: So when Jacob’s sons had eaten all the grain they had brought from Egypt, their father said to them, “Go back and buy us a little more food.”
aov_text: En nadat die koring wat hulle uit Egipte gebring het, opgeëet was, sê hulle vader vir hulle: Gaan koop vir ons weer ’n bietjie voedsel.

kjv_text: And Judah spake unto him, saying, The man did solemnly protest unto us, saying, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.
bsb_text: But Judah replied, “The man solemnly warned us, ‘You will not see my face again unless your brother is with you.’
aov_text: Toe het Juda hom geantwoord: Die man het ons uitdruklik gewaarsku en gesê: Julle sal my aangesig nie sien as julle broer nie by julle is nie.

kjv_text: If thou wilt send our brother with us, we will go down and buy thee food:
bsb_text: If you will send our brother with us, we will go down and buy food for you.
aov_text: As u ons broer saam met ons stuur, sal ons aftrek en vir u voedsel koop;

kjv_text: But if thou wilt not send him, we will not go down: for the man said unto us, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.
bsb_text: But if you will not send him, we will not go; for the man told us, ‘You will not see my face again unless your brother is with you.’”
aov_text: maar as u hom nie stuur nie, sal ons nie aftrek nie; want die man het aan ons gesê: Julle sal my aangesig nie sien as julle broer nie by julle is nie.

kjv_text: And Israel said, Wherefore dealt ye so ill with me, as to tell the man whether ye had yet a brother?
bsb_text: “Why did you bring this trouble upon me?” Israel asked. “Why did you tell the man you had another brother?”
aov_text: Toe sê Israel: Waarom het julle so verkeerd teen my gehandel deur die man te vertel dat julle nog ’n broer het?

kjv_text: And they said, The man asked us straitly of our state, and of our kindred, saying, Is your father yet alive? have ye another brother? and we told him according to the tenor of these words: could we certainly know that he would say, Bring your brother down?
bsb_text: They replied, “The man questioned us in detail about ourselves and our family: ‘Is your father still alive? Do you have another brother?’ And we answered him accordingly. How could we possibly know that he would say, ‘Bring your brother here’?”
aov_text: En hulle antwoord: Die man het uitdruklik na ons en ons familie gevra met die woorde: Lewe julle vader nog? Het julle nog ’n broer? Toe het ons hom dit te kenne gegee volgens hierdie woorde. Kon ons dan ooit weet dat hy sou sê: Bring julle broer af?

kjv_text: And Judah said unto Israel his father, Send the lad with me, and we will arise and go; that we may live, and not die, both we, and thou, and also our little ones.
bsb_text: And Judah said to his father Israel, “Send the boy with me, and we will go at once, so that we may live and not die—neither we, nor you, nor our children.
aov_text: Daarop sê Juda aan sy vader Israel: Stuur die seun saam met my; dan sal ons klaarmaak en wegtrek, sodat ons kan lewe en nie sterwe nie—ons en ook u en ons kinders nie.

kjv_text: I will be surety for him; of my hand shalt thou require him: if I bring him not unto thee, and set him before thee, then let me bear the blame for ever:
bsb_text: I will guarantee his safety. You may hold me personally responsible. If I do not bring him back and set him before you, then may I bear the guilt before you all my life.
aov_text: Ek sal vir hom borg wees; van my hand kan u hom eis. As ek hom nie na u bring en voor u stel nie, sal ek lewenslank teenoor u skuldig staan.

kjv_text: For except we had lingered, surely now we had returned this second time.
bsb_text: If we had not delayed, we could have come and gone twice by now.”
aov_text: Ja, as ons nie getalm het nie, waarlik dan was ons nou al twee maal terug.

kjv_text: And their father Israel said unto them, If it must be so now, do this; take of the best fruits in the land in your vessels, and carry down the man a present, a little balm, and a little honey, spices, and myrrh, nuts, and almonds:
bsb_text: Then their father Israel said to them, “If it must be so, then do this: Put some of the best products of the land in your packs and carry them down as a gift for the man—a little balm and a little honey, spices and myrrh, pistachios and almonds.
aov_text: Toe het Israel, hulle vader, vir hulle gesê: As dit so is, doen dan dit: neem van die opbrings van die land in julle sakke en bring vir die man ’n geskenk af—bietjie balsem en bietjie heuning, speserye en gom, neute en amandels;

kjv_text: And take double money in your hand; and the money that was brought again in the mouth of your sacks, carry it again in your hand; peradventure it was an oversight:
bsb_text: Take double the silver with you so that you may return the silver that was put back into the mouths of your sacks. Perhaps it was a mistake.
aov_text: en neem dubbel soveel geld met julle saam en bring die geld wat weer bo in julle sakke gesit is, met julle saam terug. Miskien was dit ’n vergissing.

kjv_text: Take also your brother, and arise, go again unto the man:
bsb_text: Take your brother as well, and return to the man at once.
aov_text: En neem julle broer—maak julle klaar en gaan terug na die man.

kjv_text: And God Almighty give you mercy before the man, that he may send away your other brother, and Benjamin. If I be bereaved of my children, I am bereaved.
bsb_text: May God Almighty grant you mercy before the man, that he may release your other brother along with Benjamin. As for me, if I am bereaved, I am bereaved.”
aov_text: En mag God, die Almagtige, julle barmhartigheid verleen by die man, sodat hy julle ander broer en Benjamin saam met julle kan laat trek! En ek—as ek van kinders beroof is, dan is ek beroof.

kjv_text: And the men took that present, and they took double money in their hand, and Benjamin; and rose up, and went down to Egypt, and stood before Joseph.
bsb_text: So the men took these gifts, along with double the amount of silver, and Benjamin as well. Then they hurried down to Egypt and stood before Joseph.
aov_text: Daarop neem die manne dié geskenk, en hulle neem dubbel soveel geld saam met hulle en ook Benjamin, en hulle het klaargemaak en na Egipte afgetrek en voor Josef gaan staan.

kjv_text: And when Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the ruler of his house, Bring these men home, and slay, and make ready; for these men shall dine with me at noon.
bsb_text: When Joseph saw Benjamin with his brothers, he said to the steward of his house, “Take these men to my house. Slaughter an animal and prepare it, for they shall dine with me at noon.”
aov_text: Toe Josef Benjamin by hulle sien, sê hy aan die opsigter oor sy huis: Bring die manne in die huis en slag slagvee en maak dit gereed, want die manne moet vanmiddag by my eet.

kjv_text: And the man did as Joseph bade; and the man brought the men into Joseph's house.
bsb_text: The man did as Joseph had commanded and took the brothers to Joseph’s house.
aov_text: En die man het gedoen soos Josef beveel het, en die man het die manne in die huis van Josef gebring.

kjv_text: And the men were afraid, because they were brought into Joseph's house; and they said, Because of the money that was returned in our sacks at the first time are we brought in; that he may seek occasion against us, and fall upon us, and take us for bondmen, and our asses.
bsb_text: But the brothers were frightened that they had been taken to Joseph’s house. “We have been brought here because of the silver that was returned in our bags the first time,” they said. “They intend to overpower us and take us as slaves, along with our donkeys.”
aov_text: En die manne het gevrees, omdat hulle in die huis van Josef gebring is, en gesê: Ter wille van die geld wat die vorige keer in ons sakke teruggekom het, word ons ingebring om ons te oorrompel, ons te oorval en ons as slawe te neem, saam met ons esels.

kjv_text: And they came near to the steward of Joseph's house, and they communed with him at the door of the house,
bsb_text: So they approached Joseph’s steward and spoke to him at the entrance to the house.
aov_text: Daarom het hulle nader gekom na die man wat oor die huis van Josef was, en met hom gespreek by die ingang van die huis

kjv_text: And said, O sir, we came indeed down at the first time to buy food:
bsb_text: “Please, sir,” they said, “we really did come down here the first time to buy food.
aov_text: en gesê: Ag, my heer, ons het die vorige keer net afgetrek om voedsel te koop,

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when we came to the inn, that we opened our sacks, and, behold, every man's money was in the mouth of his sack, our money in full weight: and we have brought it again in our hand.
bsb_text: But when we came to the place we lodged for the night, we opened our sacks and, behold, each of us found his silver in the mouth of his sack! It was the full amount of our silver, and we have brought it back with us.
aov_text: maar toe ons in die herberg kom en ons sakke oopmaak, was elkeen se geld bo in sy sak—ons geld volgens sy gewig—en ons het dit saam met ons teruggebring.

kjv_text: And other money have we brought down in our hands to buy food: we cannot tell who put our money in our sacks.
