bsb_text: We have brought additional silver with us to buy food. We do not know who put our silver in our sacks.”
aov_text: Ons het ook ander geld saam met ons afgebring om voedsel te koop. Ons weet nie wie ons geld in ons sakke gesteek het nie.

kjv_text: And he said, Peace be to you, fear not: your God, and the God of your father, hath given you treasure in your sacks: I had your money. And he brought Simeon out unto them.
bsb_text: “It is fine,” said the steward. “Do not be afraid. Your God, the God of your father, gave you the treasure that was in your sacks. I received your silver.” Then he brought Simeon out to them.
aov_text: Toe antwoord hy: Vrede vir julle! Moenie bang wees nie! Julle God en die God van julle vader het julle ’n skat in jul sakke gegee. Julle geld het by my gekom. Daarop het hy Símeon na hulle uitgebring.

kjv_text: And the man brought the men into Joseph's house, and gave them water, and they washed their feet; and he gave their asses provender.
bsb_text: And the steward took the men into Joseph’s house, gave them water to wash their feet, and provided food for their donkeys.
aov_text: En die man het die manne in die huis van Josef gebring en water aan hulle gegee, en hulle het hul voete gewas; hy het ook hulle esels voer gegee.

kjv_text: And they made ready the present against Joseph came at noon: for they heard that they should eat bread there.
bsb_text: Since the brothers had been told that they were going to eat a meal there, they prepared their gift for Joseph’s arrival at noon.
aov_text: En hulle het die geskenk reggemaak teen dat Josef die middag sou kom, want hulle het gehoor dat hulle daar brood sou eet.

kjv_text: And when Joseph came home, they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house, and bowed themselves to him to the earth.
bsb_text: When Joseph came home, they presented him with the gifts they had brought, and they bowed to the ground before him.
aov_text: Toe Josef dan in die huis kom, het hulle vir hom die geskenk binnegebring wat by hulle was, en hulle voor hom neergebuig na die aarde toe.

kjv_text: And he asked them of their welfare, and said, Is your father well, the old man of whom ye spake? Is he yet alive?
bsb_text: He asked if they were well, and then he asked, “How is your elderly father you told me about? Is he still alive?”
aov_text: En hy het hulle na hul welstand gevra en gesê: Gaan dit goed met julle ou vader van wie julle gespreek het? Leef hy nog?

kjv_text: And they answered, Thy servant our father is in good health, he is yet alive. And they bowed down their heads, and made obeisance.
bsb_text: “Your servant our father is well,” they answered. “He is still alive.” And they bowed down to honor him.
aov_text: En hulle antwoord: Dit gaan goed met u dienaar, ons vader; hy lewe nog. En hulle het hul eerbiedig neergebuig.

kjv_text: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw his brother Benjamin, his mother's son, and said, Is this your younger brother, of whom ye spake unto me? And he said, God be gracious unto thee, my son.
bsb_text: When Joseph looked up and saw his brother Benjamin, his own mother’s son, he asked, “Is this your youngest brother, the one you told me about?” Then he declared, “May God be gracious to you, my son.”
aov_text: Toe slaan hy sy oë op en sien sy broer Benjamin, die seun van sy moeder, en sê: Is dit julle jongste broer van wie julle met my gespreek het? Daarop sê hy: Mag God jou genadig wees, my seun!

kjv_text: And Joseph made haste; for his bowels did yearn upon his brother: and he sought where to weep; and he entered into his chamber, and wept there.
bsb_text: Joseph hurried out because he was moved to tears for his brother, and he went to a private room to weep.
aov_text: En Josef het gou gemaak, want sy binneste was ontroerd oor sy broer: hy het geleentheid gesoek om te ween en in die kamer gegaan en daar geween.

kjv_text: And he washed his face, and went out, and refrained himself, and said, Set on bread.
bsb_text: Then he washed his face and came back out. Regaining his composure, he said, “Serve the meal.”
aov_text: Daarna het hy sy gesig gewas en uitgekom en hom bedwing en gesê: Bring die ete op!

kjv_text: And they set on for him by himself, and for them by themselves, and for the Egyptians, which did eat with him, by themselves: because the Egyptians might not eat bread with the Hebrews; for that is an abomination unto the Egyptians.
bsb_text: They separately served Joseph, his brothers, and the Egyptians. They ate separately because the Egyptians would not eat with the Hebrews, since that was detestable to them.
aov_text: Toe bring hulle dit vir hom besonders op en vir hulle besonders en vir die Egiptenaars wat by hom eet, besonders; want die Egiptenaars mag nie saam met die Hebreërs eet nie, omdat dit vir die Egiptenaars ’n gruwel is.

kjv_text: And they sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth: and the men marvelled one at another.
bsb_text: They were seated before Joseph in order by age, from the firstborn to the youngest, and the men looked at one another in astonishment.
aov_text: En hulle het gaan sit volgens sy bepaling, die eersgeborene na sy eersgeboorte en die jongste na sy jonkheid. Toe kyk die manne mekaar verbaas aan.

kjv_text: And he took and sent messes unto them from before him: but Benjamin's mess was five times so much as any of theirs. And they drank, and were merry with him.
bsb_text: When the portions were served to them from Joseph’s table, Benjamin’s portion was five times larger than any of the others. So they feasted and drank freely with Joseph.
aov_text: Hierop het hy aan hulle porsies uitgedeel van die ete wat voor hom staan; maar die porsie van Benjamin was vyf maal groter as die porsies van hulle almal. En hulle het gedrink en saam met hom vrolik geword.

kjv_text: And he commanded the steward of his house, saying, Fill the men's sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put every man's money in his sack's mouth.
bsb_text: Then Joseph instructed his steward: “Fill the men’s sacks with as much food as they can carry, and put each one’s silver in the mouth of his sack.
aov_text: TOE gee hy bevel aan die opsigter oor sy huis en sê: Maak die sakke van die manne vol met lewensmiddele soveel as hulle kan vervoer, en sit elkeen se geld bo in sy sak;

kjv_text: And put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack's mouth of the youngest, and his corn money. And he did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.
bsb_text: Put my cup, the silver one, in the mouth of the youngest one’s sack, along with the silver for his grain.” So the steward did as Joseph had instructed.
aov_text: en my beker, die silwerbeker, moet jy bo in die jongste se sak sit saam met die geld vir sy koring. En hy het gehandel volgens die woord wat Josef gespreek het.

kjv_text: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their asses.
bsb_text: At daybreak, the men were sent on their way with their donkeys.
aov_text: Toe dit die môre lig word, het hulle die manne laat trek, hulle met hul esels.

kjv_text: And when they were gone out of the city, and not yet far off, Joseph said unto his steward, Up, follow after the men; and when thou dost overtake them, say unto them, Wherefore have ye rewarded evil for good?
bsb_text: They had not gone far from the city when Joseph told his steward, “Pursue the men at once, and when you overtake them, ask, ‘Why have you repaid good with evil?
aov_text: Hulle het uit die stad uitgetrek, hulle was nog nie ver nie toe Josef aan die opsigter oor sy huis sê: Maak jou klaar en jaag die manne agterna; en as jy hulle inhaal, vra hulle dan: Waarom het julle kwaad vir goed vergelde?

kjv_text: Is not this it in which my lord drinketh, and whereby indeed he divineth? ye have done evil in so doing.
bsb_text: Is this not the cup my master drinks from and uses for divination? What you have done is wicked!’”
aov_text: Is dit nie die ding waaruit my heer drink en waarmee hy altyd waarneem nie? Julle het verkeerd gehandel met wat julle gedoen het.

kjv_text: And he overtook them, and he spake unto them these same words.
bsb_text: When the steward overtook them, he relayed these words to them.
aov_text: En hy het hulle ingehaal en hierdie woorde aan hulle meegedeel.

kjv_text: And they said unto him, Wherefore saith my lord these words? God forbid that thy servants should do according to this thing:
bsb_text: “Why does my lord say these things?” they asked. “Your servants could not possibly do such a thing.
aov_text: Toe sê hulle vir hom: Waarom spreek my heer sulke woorde? Dit is ver van u dienaars om so iets te doen.

kjv_text: Behold, the money, which we found in our sacks' mouths, we brought again unto thee out of the land of Canaan: how then should we steal out of thy lord's house silver or gold?
bsb_text: We even brought back to you from the land of Canaan the silver we found in the mouths of our sacks. Why would we steal silver or gold from your master’s house?
aov_text: Kyk, geld wat ons bo in ons sakke gevind het, het ons uit die land Kanaän aan u teruggebring—hoe sou ons dan silwer of goud uit die huis van u heer kan steel?

kjv_text: With whomsoever of thy servants it be found, both let him die, and we also will be my lord's bondmen.
bsb_text: If any of your servants is found to have it, he must die, and the rest will become slaves of my lord.”
aov_text: Dié een van u dienaars by wie dit gevind word, moet sterwe; en ons sal ook my heer se slawe wees.

kjv_text: And he said, Now also let it be according unto your words: he with whom it is found shall be my servant; and ye shall be blameless.
bsb_text: “As you say,” replied the steward. “But only the one who is found with the cup will be my slave, and the rest of you shall be free of blame.”
aov_text: Toe sê hy: Nou goed, laat dit wees soos julle gesê het. Dié een by wie dit gevind word, is my slaaf. Maar júlle sal vry wees.

kjv_text: Then they speedily took down every man his sack to the ground, and opened every man his sack.
bsb_text: So each one quickly lowered his sack to the ground and opened it.
aov_text: Daarop het hulle gou elkeen sy sak op die grond neergesit en elkeen sy sak oopgemaak.

kjv_text: And he searched, and began at the eldest, and left at the youngest: and the cup was found in Benjamin's sack.
bsb_text: The steward searched, beginning with the oldest and ending with the youngest—and the cup was found in Benjamin’s sack.
aov_text: En hy het gesoek; hy het begin by die oudste en opgehou by die jongste; en die beker is in Benjamin se sak gevind.

kjv_text: Then they rent their clothes, and laded every man his ass, and returned to the city.
bsb_text: Then they all tore their clothes, loaded their donkeys, and returned to the city.
aov_text: Toe skeur hulle hul klere, en elkeen laai sy esel, en hulle gaan na die stad terug.

kjv_text: And Judah and his brethren came to Joseph's house; for he was yet there: and they fell before him on the ground.
bsb_text: When Judah and his brothers arrived at Joseph’s house, he was still there, and they fell to the ground before him.
aov_text: En Juda het saam met sy broers in die huis van Josef gekom, terwyl hy nog daar was, en hulle het voor hom neergeval op die grond.

kjv_text: And Joseph said unto them, What deed is this that ye have done? wot ye not that such a man as I can certainly divine?
bsb_text: “What is this deed you have done?” Joseph declared. “Do you not know that a man like me can surely divine the truth?”
aov_text: Daarop sê Josef vir hulle: Wat is dit nou wat julle gedoen het? Weet julle nie dat ’n man soos ek dit ongetwyfeld moet waarneem nie?

kjv_text: And Judah said, What shall we say unto my lord? what shall we speak? or how shall we clear ourselves? God hath found out the iniquity of thy servants: behold, we are my lord's servants, both we, and he also with whom the cup is found.
bsb_text: “What can we say to my lord?” Judah replied. “How can we plead? How can we justify ourselves? God has exposed the iniquity of your servants. We are now my lord’s slaves—both we and the one who was found with the cup.”
aov_text: En Juda antwoord: Wat kan ons aan my heer sê? Wat kan ons spreek? En waarmee kan ons ons regverdig? God het die ongeregtigheid van u dienaars uitgevind. Kyk, ons is my heer se slawe, ons sowel as hy by wie die beker gevind is.

kjv_text: And he said, God forbid that I should do so: but the man in whose hand the cup is found, he shall be my servant; and as for you, get you up in peace unto your father.
bsb_text: But Joseph replied, “Far be it from me to do this. The man who was found with the cup will be my slave. The rest of you may return to your father in peace.”
aov_text: Maar hy sê: Dit is ver van my om dit te doen; die man by wie die beker gevind is, dié sal my slaaf wees. Maar trek júlle in vrede op na julle vader.

kjv_text: Then Judah came near unto him, and said, Oh my lord, let thy servant, I pray thee, speak a word in my lord's ears, and let not thine anger burn against thy servant: for thou art even as Pharaoh.
bsb_text: Then Judah approached Joseph and said, “Sir, please let your servant speak personally to my lord. Do not be angry with your servant, for you are equal to Pharaoh himself.
aov_text: Toe kom Juda nader na hom en sê: Ag, my heer, mag u dienaar tog ’n woord spreek voor die ore van my heer, en laat u toorn nie teen u dienaar ontvlam nie, want u staan gelyk met Farao.

kjv_text: My lord asked his servants, saying, Have ye a father, or a brother?
bsb_text: My lord asked his servants, ‘Do you have a father or a brother?’
aov_text: My heer het sy dienaars gevra en gesê: Het julle ’n vader of broer?

kjv_text: And we said unto my lord, We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother, and his father loveth him.
bsb_text: And we answered, ‘We have an elderly father and a younger brother, the child of his old age. The boy’s brother is dead. He is the only one of his mother’s sons left, and his father loves him.’
aov_text: En ons het my heer geantwoord: Ons het ’n ou vader; en daar is ’n jong seun, ’n kind van die ouderdom, maar sy broer is dood; en hy het alleen oorgebly van sy moeder, en sy vader het hom lief.

kjv_text: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Bring him down unto me, that I may set mine eyes upon him.
bsb_text: Then you told your servants, ‘Bring him down to me so that I can see him for myself.’
aov_text: Toe het u aan u dienaars gesê: Bring hom af na my toe, dat ek my oog op hom kan rig.

kjv_text: And we said unto my lord, The lad cannot leave his father: for if he should leave his father, his father would die.
bsb_text: So we said to my lord, ‘The boy cannot leave his father. If he were to leave, his father would die.’
aov_text: En ons het my heer geantwoord: Die seun kan sy vader nie verlaat nie, want sy vader sal sterwe as hy hom verlaat.

kjv_text: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Except your youngest brother come down with you, ye shall see my face no more.
bsb_text: But you said to your servants, ‘Unless your younger brother comes down with you, you will not see my face again.’
aov_text: Daarop het u aan u dienaars gesê: As julle jongste broer nie saam met julle afkom nie, sal julle my aangesig nie weer sien nie.

kjv_text: And it came to pass when we came up unto thy servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.
bsb_text: Now when we returned to your servant my father, we relayed your words to him.
aov_text: En toe ons na u dienaar, my vader, opgetrek het en hom die woorde van my heer te kenne gegee het,

kjv_text: And our father said, Go again, and buy us a little food.
bsb_text: Then our father said, ‘Go back and buy us some food.’
aov_text: het ons vader gesê: Gaan koop weer vir ons ’n bietjie voedsel.

kjv_text: And we said, We cannot go down: if our youngest brother be with us, then will we go down: for we may not see the man's face, except our youngest brother be with us.
bsb_text: But we answered, ‘We cannot go down there unless our younger brother goes with us. So if our younger brother is not with us, we cannot see the man.’
aov_text: Maar ons het gesê: Ons kan nie aftrek nie. As ons jongste broer by ons is, sal ons aftrek; want ons mag die aangesig van die man nie sien as ons jongste broer nie by ons is nie.

kjv_text: And thy servant my father said unto us, Ye know that my wife bare me two sons:
bsb_text: And your servant my father said to us, ‘You know that my wife bore me two sons.
aov_text: En u dienaar, my vader, het aan ons gesê: Júlle weet dat my vrou vir my twee gebaar het—

kjv_text: And the one went out from me, and I said, Surely he is torn in pieces; and I saw him not since:
bsb_text: When one of them was gone, I said: “Surely he has been torn to pieces.” And I have not seen him since.
aov_text: die een het van my af weggegaan, en ek het gesê: Voorwaar, hy is verskeur, verskeur! En ek het hom tot hiertoe nie gesien nie.

kjv_text: And if ye take this also from me, and mischief befall him, ye shall bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.
bsb_text: Now if you also take this one from me and harm comes to him, you will bring my gray hair down to Sheol in sorrow.’
aov_text: As julle nou hierdie een ook van my af wegneem en hom ’n ongeluk oorkom, dan sal julle my grys hare met droefenis in die doderyk laat afdaal.

kjv_text: Now therefore when I come to thy servant my father, and the lad be not with us; seeing that his life is bound up in the lad's life;
bsb_text: So if the boy is not with us when I return to your servant, and if my father, whose life is wrapped up in the boy’s life,
aov_text: As ek dan nou by u dienaar, my vader, kom en die seun nie by ons is nie—terwyl sy siel innig aan hom verkleef is—

kjv_text: It shall come to pass, when he seeth that the lad is not with us, that he will die: and thy servants shall bring down the gray hairs of thy servant our father with sorrow to the grave.
bsb_text: sees that the boy is not with us, he will die. Then your servants will have brought the gray hair of your servant our father down to Sheol in sorrow.
aov_text: sal hy sterwe as hy sien dat die seun daar nie is nie; en u dienaars sal die grys hare van u dienaar, ons vader, met kommer in die doderyk laat afdaal.

kjv_text: For thy servant became surety for the lad unto my father, saying, If I bring him not unto thee, then I shall bear the blame to my father for ever.
bsb_text: Indeed, your servant guaranteed the boy’s safety to my father, saying, ‘If I do not return him to you, I will bear the guilt before you, my father, all my life.’
aov_text: Want u dienaar het die seun deur borgskap van my vader verkry deurdat hy gesê het: As ek hom nie na u bring nie, sal ek lewenslank teenoor my vader skuldig staan.

kjv_text: Now therefore, I pray thee, let thy servant abide instead of the lad a bondman to my lord; and let the lad go up with his brethren.
bsb_text: Now please let your servant stay here as my lord’s slave in place of the boy. Let him return with his brothers.
aov_text: Laat u dienaar dan nou tog in die plek van die seun my heer se slaaf bly, en laat die seun saam met sy broers optrek.

kjv_text: For how shall I go up to my father, and the lad be not with me? lest peradventure I see the evil that shall come on my father.
bsb_text: For how can I go back to my father without the boy? I could not bear to see the misery that would overwhelm him.”
aov_text: Want hoe kan ek na my vader optrek as die seun nie by my is nie? Mag ek maar net die ellende nie aansien wat my vader sal tref nie!

kjv_text: Then Joseph could not refrain himself before all them that stood by him; and he cried, Cause every man to go out from me. And there stood no man with him, while Joseph made himself known unto his brethren.
bsb_text: Then Joseph could no longer control himself before all his attendants, and he cried out, “Send everyone away from me!” So none of them were with Joseph when he made himself known to his brothers.
aov_text: TOE kon Josef hom nie langer bedwing voor almal wat by hom gestaan het nie, en hy roep: Laat almal van my af weggaan! En daar het niemand by hom gestaan toe Josef hom aan sy broers bekend gemaak het nie.

kjv_text: And he wept aloud: and the Egyptians and the house of Pharaoh heard.
bsb_text: But he wept so loudly that the Egyptians heard him, and Pharaoh’s household soon heard of it.
aov_text: Daarop bars hy in trane uit, sodat die Egiptenaars en ook die huis van Farao dit gehoor het.

kjv_text: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I am Joseph; doth my father yet live? And his brethren could not answer him; for they were troubled at his presence.
bsb_text: Joseph said to his brothers, “I am Joseph! Is my father still alive?” But they were unable to answer him, because they were terrified in his presence.
aov_text: En Josef sê vir sy broers: Ek is Josef! Leef my vader nog? Maar sy broers kon hom nie antwoord nie, want hulle was verskrik voor hom.

kjv_text: And Joseph said unto his brethren, Come near to me, I pray you. And they came near. And he said, I am Joseph your brother, whom ye sold into Egypt.
bsb_text: Then Joseph said to his brothers, “Please come near me.” And they did so. “I am Joseph, your brother,” he said, “the one you sold into Egypt!
aov_text: Verder sê Josef vir sy broers: Kom tog nader na my. En toe hulle nader kom, sê hy: Ek is julle broer Josef vir wie julle na Egipte verkoop het.

kjv_text: Now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that ye sold me hither: for God did send me before you to preserve life.
bsb_text: And now, do not be distressed or angry with yourselves that you sold me into this place, because it was to save lives that God sent me before you.
aov_text: Maar wees nou nie bedroef nie, en laat daar geen ontstemming by julle wees dat julle my hierheen verkoop het nie. Want om lewens te behou, het God my voor julle uit gestuur.

kjv_text: For these two years hath the famine been in the land: and yet there are five years, in the which there shall neither be earing nor harvest.
bsb_text: For the famine has covered the land these two years, and there will be five more years without plowing or harvesting.
aov_text: Want daar was nou twee jaar hongersnood in die land, en daar is nog vyf jaar waarin nie geploeg of geoes sal word nie.

kjv_text: And God sent me before you to preserve you a posterity in the earth, and to save your lives by a great deliverance.
bsb_text: God sent me before you to preserve you as a remnant on the earth and to save your lives by a great deliverance.
aov_text: Maar God het my voor julle uit gestuur om vir julle ’n oorblyfsel op die aarde te verseker en om julle in die lewe te hou tot ’n groot verlossing.

kjv_text: So now it was not you that sent me hither, but God: and he hath made me a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and a ruler throughout all the land of Egypt.
bsb_text: Therefore it was not you who sent me here, but God, who has made me a father to Pharaoh—lord of all his household and ruler over all the land of Egypt.
aov_text: Júlle het my dan nou nie hierheen gestuur nie, maar God; en Hy het my ’n raadsman van Farao gemaak en ’n gebieder oor sy hele huis en ’n regeerder in die hele Egipteland.

kjv_text: Haste ye, and go up to my father, and say unto him, Thus saith thy son Joseph, God hath made me lord of all Egypt: come down unto me, tarry not:
bsb_text: Now return quickly to my father and tell him, ‘This is what your son Joseph says: God has made me lord of all Egypt. Come down to me without delay.
aov_text: Trek gou op na my vader en sê vir hom: So spreek u seun Josef: God het my ’n gebieder oor die hele Egipteland gemaak. Kom af na my, moenie versuim nie!

kjv_text: And thou shalt dwell in the land of Goshen, and thou shalt be near unto me, thou, and thy children, and thy children's children, and thy flocks, and thy herds, and all that thou hast:
bsb_text: You shall settle in the land of Goshen and be near me—you and your children and grandchildren, your flocks and herds, and everything you own.
aov_text: En u kan in die land Gosen woon en naby my wees, u en u kinders en u kindskinders en u kleinvee en u beeste en alles wat u besit.

kjv_text: And there will I nourish thee; for yet there are five years of famine; lest thou, and thy household, and all that thou hast, come to poverty.
bsb_text: And there I will provide for you, because there will be five more years of famine. Otherwise, you and your household and everything you own will come to destitution.’
aov_text: En ek sal u daar onderhou, want daar sal nog vyf jaar hongersnood wees; sodat u nie verarm nie, u en u huis en alles wat aan u behoort.

kjv_text: And, behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth that speaketh unto you.
bsb_text: Behold! You and my brother Benjamin can see that I, Joseph, am the one speaking with you.
aov_text: En kyk, julle oë sien dit, en die oë van my broer Benjamin, dat dit my mond is wat met julle spreek.

kjv_text: And ye shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that ye have seen; and ye shall haste and bring down my father hither.
bsb_text: Tell my father about all my splendor in Egypt and everything you have seen. And bring my father down here quickly.”
aov_text: Vertel my vader dan van al my heerlikheid in Egipte en van alles wat julle gesien het, en bring my vader gou hierheen af.

kjv_text: And he fell upon his brother Benjamin's neck, and wept; and Benjamin wept upon his neck.
bsb_text: Then Joseph threw his arms around his brother Benjamin and wept, and Benjamin wept as they embraced.
aov_text: Toe val hy sy broer Benjamin om die hals en ween; en ook Benjamin het aan sy hals geween.

kjv_text: Moreover he kissed all his brethren, and wept upon them: and after that his brethren talked with him.
bsb_text: Joseph kissed each of his brothers as he wept over them. And afterward his brothers talked with him.
aov_text: En hy het al sy broers gesoen en aan hulle hals geween; en daarna het sy broers met hom gespreek.

kjv_text: And the fame thereof was heard in Pharaoh's house, saying, Joseph's brethren are come: and it pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.
bsb_text: When the news reached Pharaoh’s house that Joseph’s brothers had come, Pharaoh and his servants were pleased.
aov_text: Toe die gerug in die huis van Farao gehoor word dat Josef se broers gekom het, was dit goed in die oë van Farao en van sy dienaars.

kjv_text: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Say unto thy brethren, This do ye; lade your beasts, and go, get you unto the land of Canaan;
bsb_text: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Tell your brothers, ‘Do as follows: Load your animals and return to the land of Canaan.
aov_text: En Farao het met Josef gespreek: Sê aan jou broers: Doen dit, laai julle diere en trek weg na die land Kanaän.

kjv_text: And take your father and your households, and come unto me: and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and ye shall eat the fat of the land.
bsb_text: Then bring your father and your families and return to me. I will give you the best of the land of Egypt, and you shall eat from the fat of the land.’
aov_text: En gaan haal julle vader en julle huisgesinne en kom na my toe, dan sal ek julle die beste van Egipteland gee; en eet die vettigheid van die land.

kjv_text: Now thou art commanded, this do ye; take you wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.
bsb_text: You are also directed to tell them: ‘Take wagons from the land of Egypt for your young children and your wives, and bring your father and come back.
aov_text: Jý kry dan bevel—doen dit: Neem vir julle uit Egipteland waens vir julle kinders en julle vroue, en vervoer julle vader en kom.

kjv_text: Also regard not your stuff; for the good of all the land of Egypt is yours.
bsb_text: But pay no regard to your belongings, for the best of all the land of Egypt is yours.’”
aov_text: En julle hoef geen spyt te hê oor julle huisraad nie, want die beste van die hele Egipteland is julle s’n.

kjv_text: And the children of Israel did so: and Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.
bsb_text: So the sons of Israel did as they were told. Joseph gave them wagons as Pharaoh had instructed, and he also gave them provisions for their journey.
aov_text: Die seuns van Israel het toe so gedoen; en Josef het vir hulle waens verskaf volgens die bevel van Farao en hulle padkos gegee vir die reis.

kjv_text: To all of them he gave each man changes of raiment; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver, and five changes of raiment.
bsb_text: He gave new garments to each of them, but to Benjamin he gave three hundred shekels of silver and five sets of clothes.
aov_text: Hy het aan hulle almal, man vir man, ’n stel nuwe klere gegee; maar aan Benjamin het hy driehonderd sikkels silwer en vyf stel nuwe klere gegee.

kjv_text: And to his father he sent after this manner; ten asses laden with the good things of Egypt, and ten she asses laden with corn and bread and meat for his father by the way.
bsb_text: And he sent to his father the following: ten donkeys loaded with the best of Egypt, and ten female donkeys loaded with grain and bread and provisions for his father’s journey.
aov_text: En net so het hy ook aan sy vader gestuur tien esels, gelaai met die beste goed van Egipte, en tien eselinne, gelaai met koring en brood en voedsel vir sy vader op die reis.

kjv_text: So he sent his brethren away, and they departed: and he said unto them, See that ye fall not out by the way.
bsb_text: Then Joseph sent his brothers on their way, and as they were leaving, he said to them, “Do not quarrel on the way!”
aov_text: Daarop het hy sy broers weggestuur, en hulle het vertrek; en hy het aan hulle gesê: Moenie vir mekaar kwaad word op die pad nie.

kjv_text: And they went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan unto Jacob their father,
bsb_text: So the brothers went up out of Egypt and came to their father Jacob in the land of Canaan.
aov_text: En hulle het opgetrek uit Egipte en in die land Kanaän aangekom by hulle vader Jakob.

kjv_text: And told him, saying, Joseph is yet alive, and he is governor over all the land of Egypt. And Jacob's heart fainted, for he believed them not.
bsb_text: “Joseph is still alive,” they said, “and he is ruler over all the land of Egypt!” But Jacob was stunned, for he did not believe them.
aov_text: Toe hulle hom vertel: Josef lewe nog—en dat hy regeerder is in die hele Egipteland—het sy hart beswyk, want hy het hulle nie geglo nie.

kjv_text: And they told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said unto them: and when he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob their father revived:
bsb_text: However, when they relayed all that Joseph had told them, and when he saw the wagons that Joseph had sent to carry him back, the spirit of their father Jacob was revived.
aov_text: Maar toe hulle hom al die woorde van Josef te kenne gee wat hy met hulle gespreek het, en hy die waens sien wat Josef gestuur het om hom te vervoer, het die gees van Jakob, hulle vader, lewendig geword.

kjv_text: And Israel said, It is enough; Joseph my son is yet alive: I will go and see him before I die.
bsb_text: “Enough!” declared Israel. “My son Joseph is still alive! I will go to see him before I die.”
aov_text: En Israel het gesê: Dit is genoeg! My seun Josef lewe nog! Ek sal gaan en hom sien voordat ek sterwe.

kjv_text: And Israel took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices unto the God of his father Isaac.
bsb_text: So Israel set out with all that he had, and when he came to Beersheba, he offered sacrifices to the God of his father Isaac.
aov_text: EN Israel het weggetrek met alles wat aan hom behoort het, en in Berséba gekom; en hy het offerandes gebring aan die God van sy vader Isak.

kjv_text: And God spake unto Israel in the visions of the night, and said, Jacob, Jacob. And he said, Here am I.
bsb_text: And that night God spoke to Israel in a vision: “Jacob, Jacob!” He said. “Here I am,” replied Jacob.
aov_text: En God het tot Israel gespreek in naggesigte en gesê: Jakob, Jakob! En hy antwoord: Hier is ek!

kjv_text: And he said, I am God, the God of thy father: fear not to go down into Egypt; for I will there make of thee a great nation:
bsb_text: “I am God,” He said, “the God of your father. Do not be afraid to go down to Egypt, for I will make you into a great nation there.
aov_text: Toe sê Hy: Ek is God, die God van jou vader. Moenie bevrees wees om na Egipte af te trek nie, want Ek sal jou daar ’n groot nasie maak.

kjv_text: I will go down with thee into Egypt; and I will also surely bring thee up again: and Joseph shall put his hand upon thine eyes.
bsb_text: I will go down with you to Egypt, and I will surely bring you back. And Joseph’s own hands will close your eyes.”
aov_text: Ek sal saam met jou aftrek na Egipte, en Ek sal jou gewis ook weer laat optrek; en Josef sal jou oë toedruk.

kjv_text: And Jacob rose up from Beersheba: and the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father, and their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.
bsb_text: Then Jacob departed from Beersheba, and the sons of Israel took their father Jacob in the wagons Pharaoh had sent to carry him, along with their children and wives.
aov_text: Daarna het Jakob weggetrek van Berséba af. En die seuns van Israel het hulle vader Jakob met hulle kinders en hulle vroue op die waens gelaai wat Farao gestuur het om hom te vervoer.

kjv_text: And they took their cattle, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt, Jacob, and all his seed with him:
bsb_text: They also took the livestock and possessions they had acquired in the land of Canaan, and Jacob and all his offspring went to Egypt.
aov_text: En hulle het hul vee en besittings geneem wat hulle in die land Kanaän verwerf het, en in Egipte gekom, Jakob en sy hele geslag saam met hom:

kjv_text: His sons, and his sons' sons with him, his daughters, and his sons' daughters, and all his seed brought he with him into Egypt.
bsb_text: Jacob took with him to Egypt his sons and grandsons, and his daughters and granddaughters—all his offspring.
aov_text: sy seuns en sy kleinseuns saam met hom; sy dogters en kleindogters en sy hele geslag het hy saam met hom in Egipte gebring.

kjv_text: And these are the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob's firstborn.
bsb_text: Now these are the names of the sons of Israel (Jacob and his descendants) who went to Egypt: Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn.
aov_text: En dit is die name van die seuns van Israel wat in Egipte gekom het—Jakob en sy seuns. Die eersgeborene van Jakob was Ruben.

kjv_text: And the sons of Reuben; Hanoch, and Phallu, and Hezron, and Carmi.
bsb_text: The sons of Reuben: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
aov_text: En die seuns van Ruben: Henog en Pallu en Hesron en Karmi.

kjv_text: And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman.
bsb_text: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman.
aov_text: En die seuns van Símeon: Jémuel en Jamin en Ohad en Jagin en Sohar en Saul, die seun van die Kanaänitiese vrou.

kjv_text: And the sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
bsb_text: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
aov_text: En die seuns van Levi: Gerson, Kehat en Merári.

kjv_text: And the sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah, and Pharez, and Zarah: but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. And the sons of Pharez were Hezron and Hamul.
bsb_text: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, and Zerah; but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.
aov_text: En die seuns van Juda: Er en Onan en Sela en Peres en Serag. Maar Er en Onan het gesterwe in die land Kanaän; en die seuns van Peres was Hesron en Hamul.

kjv_text: And the sons of Issachar; Tola, and Phuvah, and Job, and Shimron.
bsb_text: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puvah, Job, and Shimron.
aov_text: En die seuns van Íssaskar: Tola en Puwa en Job en Simron.

kjv_text: And the sons of Zebulun; Sered, and Elon, and Jahleel.
bsb_text: The sons of Zebulun: Sered, Elon, and Jahleel.
aov_text: En die seuns van Sébulon: Sered en Elon en Jágleël.

kjv_text: These be the sons of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob in Padanaram, with his daughter Dinah: all the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty and three.
bsb_text: These are the sons of Leah born to Jacob in Paddan-aram, in addition to his daughter Dinah. The total number of sons and daughters was thirty-three.
aov_text: Dit is die seuns van Lea wat sy vir Jakob gebaar het in Paddan-Aram, saam met sy dogter Dina; al die siele van sy seuns en dogters was drie-en-dertig.

kjv_text: And the sons of Gad; Ziphion, and Haggi, Shuni, and Ezbon, Eri, and Arodi, and Areli.
bsb_text: The sons of Gad: Ziphion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, and Areli.
aov_text: En die seuns van Gad: Sifjon en Haggi, Suni en Esbon, Eri en Aródi en Areëli.

kjv_text: And the sons of Asher; Jimnah, and Ishuah, and Isui, and Beriah, and Serah their sister: and the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel.
bsb_text: The children of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and their sister Serah. The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel.
aov_text: En die seuns van Aser: Jimna en Jiswa en Jiswi en Bería en Serag, hulle suster; en die seuns van Bería: Heber en Málkiël.

kjv_text: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter, and these she bare unto Jacob, even sixteen souls.
bsb_text: These are the sons of Jacob born to Zilpah—whom Laban gave to his daughter Leah—sixteen in all.
aov_text: Dit is die seuns van Silpa wat Laban aan sy dogter Lea gegee het; en sy het vir Jakob hierdie sestien siele gebaar.

kjv_text: The sons of Rachel Jacob's wife; Joseph, and Benjamin.
bsb_text: The sons of Jacob’s wife Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.
aov_text: Die seuns van Ragel, die vrou van Jakob: Josef en Benjamin.

kjv_text: And unto Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, which Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On bare unto him.
bsb_text: Manasseh and Ephraim were born to Joseph in the land of Egypt by Asenath daughter of Potiphera, priest of On.
aov_text: En vir Josef is in Egipteland gebore Manasse en Efraim wat Ásenat, die dogter van Potiféra, die priester van On, vir hom gebaar het.

kjv_text: And the sons of Benjamin were Belah, and Becher, and Ashbel, Gera, and Naaman, Ehi, and Rosh, Muppim, and Huppim, and Ard.
bsb_text: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, and Ard.
aov_text: En die seuns van Benjamin: Bela en Beger en Asbel, Gera en Naäman, Egi en Ros, Muppim en Huppim en Ard.

kjv_text: These are the sons of Rachel, which were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.
bsb_text: These are the sons of Rachel born to Jacob—fourteen in all.
aov_text: Dit is die seuns van Ragel wat vir Jakob gebore is, almal saam veertien siele.

kjv_text: And the sons of Dan; Hushim.
bsb_text: The son of Dan: Hushim.
aov_text: En die seuns van Dan: Husim.

kjv_text: And the sons of Naphtali; Jahzeel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shillem.
bsb_text: The sons of Naphtali: Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem.
aov_text: En die seuns van Náftali: Jágseël en Guni en Jeser en Sillem.

kjv_text: These are the sons of Bilhah, which Laban gave unto Rachel his daughter, and she bare these unto Jacob: all the souls were seven.
bsb_text: These are the sons of Jacob born to Bilhah, whom Laban gave to his daughter Rachel—seven in all.
aov_text: Dit is die seuns van Bilha wat Laban aan sy dogter Ragel gegee het; en sy het hulle vir Jakob gebaar, almal saam sewe siele.

kjv_text: All the souls that came with Jacob into Egypt, which came out of his loins, besides Jacob's sons' wives, all the souls were threescore and six;
bsb_text: All those belonging to Jacob who came to Egypt—his direct descendants, besides the wives of Jacob’s sons—numbered sixty-six persons.
aov_text: Al die siele wat aan Jakob behoort het en, uit sy heup afkomstig, na Egipte gegaan het, behalwe die vroue van die seuns van Jakob, was almal saam ses-en-sestig siele.

kjv_text: And the sons of Joseph, which were born him in Egypt, were two souls: all the souls of the house of Jacob, which came into Egypt, were threescore and ten.
bsb_text: And with the two sons who had been born to Joseph in Egypt, the members of Jacob’s family who went to Egypt were seventy in all.
aov_text: En die seuns van Josef wat vir hom in Egipte gebore is, was twee siele. Al die siele van die huis van Jakob wat in Egipte gekom het, was sewentig.

kjv_text: And he sent Judah before him unto Joseph, to direct his face unto Goshen; and they came into the land of Goshen.
bsb_text: Now Jacob had sent Judah ahead of him to Joseph to get directions to Goshen. When Jacob’s family arrived in the land of Goshen,
aov_text: En hy het Juda voor hom uit gestuur na Josef, dat dié voor hom uit die pad moes wys na Gosen; en hulle het in die land Gosen aangekom.

kjv_text: And Joseph made ready his chariot, and went up to meet Israel his father, to Goshen, and presented himself unto him; and he fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.
bsb_text: Joseph prepared his chariot and went there to meet his father Israel. Joseph presented himself to him, embraced him, and wept profusely.
aov_text: Toe span Josef sy wa in, en hy trek op, sy vader Israel tegemoet na Gosen. En toe hy homself aan hom vertoon, het hy om sy hals geval en lank aan sy hals geween.

kjv_text: And Israel said unto Joseph, Now let me die, since I have seen thy face, because thou art yet alive.
bsb_text: Then Israel said to Joseph, “Finally I can die, now that I have seen your face and know that you are still alive!”
aov_text: En Israel sê vir Josef: Nou kan ek sterwe nadat ek jou aangesig gesien het, dat jy nog leef!

kjv_text: And Joseph said unto his brethren, and unto his father's house, I will go up, and shew Pharaoh, and say unto him, My brethren, and my father's house, which were in the land of Canaan, are come unto me;
bsb_text: Joseph said to his brothers and to his father’s household, “I will go up and inform Pharaoh: ‘My brothers and my father’s household from the land of Canaan have come to me.
aov_text: Daarna het Josef met sy broers en die huis van sy vader gespreek: Ek sal optrek en aan Farao vertel en aan hom sê: My broers en die huis van my vader wat in die land Kanaän was, het na my gekom.

kjv_text: And the men are shepherds, for their trade hath been to feed cattle; and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.
bsb_text: The men are shepherds; they raise livestock, and they have brought their flocks and herds and all that they own.’
aov_text: En die manne is herders van kleinvee—want hulle was veeboere—en hulle het hul kleinvee en hul beeste en alles wat hulle besit, saamgebring.

kjv_text: And it shall come to pass, when Pharaoh shall call you, and shall say, What is your occupation?
bsb_text: When Pharaoh summons you and asks, ‘What is your occupation?’
aov_text: En as Farao julle laat roep en sê: Wat is julle nering?

kjv_text: That ye shall say, Thy servants' trade hath been about cattle from our youth even until now, both we, and also our fathers: that ye may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination unto the Egyptians.
bsb_text: you are to say, ‘Your servants have raised livestock ever since our youth—both we and our fathers.’ Then you will be allowed to settle in the land of Goshen, since all shepherds are detestable to the Egyptians.”
aov_text: dan moet julle antwoord: U dienaars was veeboere van ons jeug af tot nou toe, ons sowel as ons vaders—sodat julle in die land Gosen kan woon. Want elke herder van kleinvee is vir die Egiptenaars ’n gruwel.

kjv_text: Then Joseph came and told Pharaoh, and said, My father and my brethren, and their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have, are come out of the land of Canaan; and, behold, they are in the land of Goshen.
bsb_text: So Joseph went and told Pharaoh: “My father and my brothers, with their flocks and herds and all they own, have come from the land of Canaan and are now in Goshen.”
aov_text: DAAROP het Josef gekom en aan Farao vertel en gesê: My vader en my broers en hulle kleinvee en beeste en alles wat hulle besit, het gekom uit die land Kanaän, en daar is hulle nou in die land Gosen.

kjv_text: And he took some of his brethren, even five men, and presented them unto Pharaoh.
bsb_text: And he chose five of his brothers and presented them before Pharaoh.
aov_text: En hy het uit die getal van sy broers vyf man saamgeneem en hulle aan Farao voorgestel.

kjv_text: And Pharaoh said unto his brethren, What is your occupation? And they said unto Pharaoh, Thy servants are shepherds, both we, and also our fathers.
bsb_text: “What is your occupation?” Pharaoh asked Joseph’s brothers. “Your servants are shepherds,” they replied, “both we and our fathers.”
aov_text: Toe sê Farao aan sy broers: Wat is julle nering? En hulle antwoord Farao: U dienaars is herders van kleinvee, ons sowel as ons vaders.

kjv_text: They said moreover unto Pharaoh, For to sojourn in the land are we come; for thy servants have no pasture for their flocks; for the famine is sore in the land of Canaan: now therefore, we pray thee, let thy servants dwell in the land of Goshen.
bsb_text: Then they said to Pharaoh, “We have come to live in the land for a time, because there is no pasture for the flocks of your servants, since the famine in the land of Canaan has been severe. So now, please allow your servants to settle in the land of Goshen.”
aov_text: Verder sê hulle vir Farao: Ons het gekom om as vreemdelinge in die land te vertoef, want daar is geen weiding vir die kleinvee van u dienaars nie, omdat die hongersnood in die land Kanaän swaar is. Laat u dienaars dan nou tog in die land Gosen woon.

kjv_text: And Pharaoh spake unto Joseph, saying, Thy father and thy brethren are come unto thee:
bsb_text: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Now that your father and brothers have come to you,
aov_text: Daarop het Farao met Josef gespreek en gesê: Jou vader en jou broers het na jou gekom.

kjv_text: The land of Egypt is before thee; in the best of the land make thy father and brethren to dwell; in the land of Goshen let them dwell: and if thou knowest any men of activity among them, then make them rulers over my cattle.
bsb_text: the land of Egypt is before you; settle your father and brothers in the best part of the land. They may dwell in the land of Goshen. And if you know of any talented men among them, put them in charge of my own livestock.”
aov_text: Egipteland lê voor jou oop; laat jou vader en jou broers in die beste deel van die land woon; hulle kan in die land Gosen woon. En as jy weet dat daar onder hulle bekwame manne is, stel hulle dan aan as veeopsigters oor my eiendom.

kjv_text: And Joseph brought in Jacob his father, and set him before Pharaoh: and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.
bsb_text: Then Joseph brought in his father Jacob and presented him before Pharaoh, and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.
aov_text: Toe bring Josef sy vader Jakob in en stel hom aan Farao voor. En Jakob het Farao gegroet met ’n seënwens.

kjv_text: And Pharaoh said unto Jacob, How old art thou?
bsb_text: “How many years have you lived?” Pharaoh asked.
aov_text: Daarop sê Farao vir Jakob: Hoeveel is die dae van jou lewensjare?

kjv_text: And Jacob said unto Pharaoh, The days of the years of my pilgrimage are an hundred and thirty years: few and evil have the days of the years of my life been, and have not attained unto the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.
bsb_text: “My travels have lasted 130 years,” Jacob replied. “My years have been few and hard, and they have not matched the years of the travels of my fathers.”
aov_text: En Jakob het Farao geantwoord: Die dae van die jare van my vreemdelingskap is honderd-en-dertig jaar. Min in getal en vol teëspoed was die dae van my lewensjare, en hulle het nie gehaal by die dae van die lewensjare van my vaders gedurende die dae van hulle vreemdelingskap nie.

kjv_text: And Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from before Pharaoh.
bsb_text: Then Jacob blessed Pharaoh and departed from his presence.
aov_text: Toe het Jakob Farao gegroet met ’n seënwens en van Farao af weggegaan.

kjv_text: And Joseph placed his father and his brethren, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.
bsb_text: So Joseph settled his father and brothers in the land of Egypt and gave them property in the best part of the land, the district of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.
aov_text: En Josef het vir Jakob en sy broers woonplekke aangewys en aan hulle besitting in Egipteland gegee, in die beste deel van die land, in die landstreek Raämses, soos Farao beveel het.

kjv_text: And Joseph nourished his father, and his brethren, and all his father's household, with bread, according to their families.
bsb_text: Joseph also provided his father and brothers and all his father’s household with food for their families.
aov_text: En Josef het sy vader en sy broers en die hele huis van sy vader met brood onderhou ooreenkomstig die getal van die kinders.

kjv_text: And there was no bread in all the land; for the famine was very sore, so that the land of Egypt and all the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine.
bsb_text: There was no food, however, in all that region, because the famine was so severe; the lands of Egypt and Canaan had been exhausted by the famine.
aov_text: En daar was in die hele land geen brood nie, want die hongersnood was baie swaar, sodat Egipteland en die land Kanaän uitgeput was weens die hongersnood.

kjv_text: And Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the corn which they bought: and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh's house.
bsb_text: Joseph collected all the money to be found in the land of Egypt and the land of Canaan in exchange for the grain they were buying, and he brought it into Pharaoh’s palace.
aov_text: En Josef het al die geld versamel wat in Egipteland en in die land Kanaän te vinde was, vir die koring wat hulle gekoop het, en Josef het die geld in die paleis van Farao gebring.

kjv_text: And when money failed in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came unto Joseph, and said, Give us bread: for why should we die in thy presence? for the money faileth.
bsb_text: When the money from the lands of Egypt and Canaan was gone, all the Egyptians came to Joseph and said, “Give us food. Why should we die before your eyes? For our funds have run out!”
aov_text: En toe die geld in Egipteland en in die land Kanaän op was, het al die Egiptenaars na Josef gekom en gesê: Gee vir ons brood! En: Waarom moet ons voor u oë sterwe, want die geld is gedaan?

kjv_text: And Joseph said, Give your cattle; and I will give you for your cattle, if money fail.
bsb_text: “Then bring me your livestock,” said Joseph. “Since the money is gone, I will sell you food in exchange for your livestock.”
aov_text: En Josef antwoord: Gee julle vee, dan sal ek dit aan julle gee vir julle vee as die geld gedaan is.

kjv_text: And they brought their cattle unto Joseph: and Joseph gave them bread in exchange for horses, and for the flocks, and for the cattle of the herds, and for the asses: and he fed them with bread for all their cattle for that year.
bsb_text: So they brought their livestock to Joseph, and he gave them food in exchange for their horses, their flocks and herds, and their donkeys. Throughout that year he provided them with food in exchange for all their livestock.
aov_text: Toe bring hulle hul vee na Josef, en Josef het aan hulle brood gegee vir die perde en die besitting aan kleinvee en beeste en vir die esels; en hy het hulle dié jaar versorg met brood vir die waarde van al hulle besittings aan vee.

kjv_text: When that year was ended, they came unto him the second year, and said unto him, We will not hide it from my lord, how that our money is spent; my lord also hath our herds of cattle; there is not ought left in the sight of my lord, but our bodies, and our lands:
bsb_text: When that year was over, they came to him the second year and said, “We cannot hide from our lord that our money is gone and all our livestock belongs to you. There is nothing left for our lord except our bodies and our land.
aov_text: Toe dié jaar om was, het hulle na hom gekom in die tweede jaar en vir hom gesê: Ons kan dit vir my heer nie wegsteek nie, maar die geld is op en die besitting aan vee is my heer s’n. Daar het niks vir my heer oorgebly nie as net ons lyf en ons grond.

kjv_text: Wherefore shall we die before thine eyes, both we and our land? buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants unto Pharaoh: and give us seed, that we may live, and not die, that the land be not desolate.
bsb_text: Why should we perish before your eyes—we and our land as well? Purchase us and our land in exchange for food. Then we, along with our land, will be slaves to Pharaoh. Give us seed that we may live and not die, and that the land may not become desolate.”
aov_text: Waarom moet ons voor u oë te gronde gaan, ons sowel as ons landerye? Koop ons en ons grond vir brood, dan sal ons met ons grond aan Farao diensbaar wees; en gee saadkoring, dat ons kan lewe en nie sterwe nie, en dat die grond nie woes word nie.

kjv_text: And Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh; for the Egyptians sold every man his field, because the famine prevailed over them: so the land became Pharaoh's.
bsb_text: So Joseph acquired for Pharaoh all the land in Egypt; the Egyptians, one and all, sold their fields because the famine was so severe upon them. The land became Pharaoh’s,
aov_text: So het Josef dan al die grond van Egipte vir Farao opgekoop, want die Egiptenaars het elkeen sy stuk grond verkoop, omdat die hongersnood vir hulle te swaar was. So het die land dan Farao se eiendom geword.

kjv_text: And as for the people, he removed them to cities from one end of the borders of Egypt even to the other end thereof.
bsb_text: and Joseph reduced the people to servitude from one end of Egypt to the other.
aov_text: En wat die volk betref—hy het hulle laat verhuis na die stede, van die een end van die Egiptiese gebied na die ander end daarvan.

kjv_text: Only the land of the priests bought he not; for the priests had a portion assigned them of Pharaoh, and did eat their portion which Pharaoh gave them: wherefore they sold not their lands.
bsb_text: However, he did not acquire the priests’ portion of the land, for it had been given to them by Pharaoh. They ate the rations that Pharaoh supplied; so they did not sell their land.
aov_text: Net die grond van die priesters het hy nie gekoop nie; want die priesters het ’n vaste inkomste van Farao ontvang en van hulle vaste inkomste geëet wat Farao hulle toegestaan het. Daarom het hulle hul grond nie verkoop nie.

kjv_text: Then Joseph said unto the people, Behold, I have bought you this day and your land for Pharaoh: lo, here is seed for you, and ye shall sow the land.
bsb_text: Then Joseph said to the people, “Now that I have acquired you and your land for Pharaoh this day, here is seed for you to sow in the land.
aov_text: Toe sê Josef aan die volk: Kyk, ek het vandag julle en jul grond vir Farao gekoop: daar is saadkoring vir julle, dat julle die grond kan besaai.

kjv_text: And it shall come to pass in the increase, that ye shall give the fifth part unto Pharaoh, and four parts shall be your own, for seed of the field, and for your food, and for them of your households, and for food for your little ones.
bsb_text: At harvest time, you are to give a fifth of it to Pharaoh, and four-fifths will be yours as seed for the field and food for yourselves and your households and children.”
aov_text: En by die insameling moet julle ’n vyfde deel aan Farao afgee, en die ander vier dele sal julle eiendom wees, as saad vir die land en as voedsel vir julleself en die wat in julle huise is, en as voeding vir julle kinders.

kjv_text: And they said, Thou hast saved our lives: let us find grace in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh's servants.
bsb_text: “You have saved our lives,” they said. “We have found favor in our lord’s eyes, and we will be Pharaoh’s servants.”
aov_text: En hulle antwoord: U het ons lewe gered. Laat ons guns mag vind in die oë van my heer, dan sal ons die dienaars van Farao wees.

kjv_text: And Joseph made it a law over the land of Egypt unto this day, that Pharaoh should have the fifth part; except the land of the priests only, which became not Pharaoh's.
bsb_text: So Joseph established a law that a fifth of the produce belongs to Pharaoh, and it is in effect in the land of Egypt to this day. Only the priests’ land does not belong to Pharaoh.
aov_text: En Josef het dit ’n wet gemaak tot vandag toe vir die saaigrond van Egipte—die vyfde deel behoort aan Farao. Net die grond van die priesters alleen het nie die eiendom van Farao geword nie.

kjv_text: And Israel dwelt in the land of Egypt, in the country of Goshen; and they had possessions therein, and grew, and multiplied exceedingly.
bsb_text: Now the Israelites settled in the land of Egypt, in the region of Goshen. They acquired property there and became fruitful and increased greatly in number.
aov_text: So het Israel dan in Egipteland gewoon, in die land Gosen; en hulle het vaste besittings daarin verwerf en vrugbaar geword en sterk vermeerder.

kjv_text: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years: so the whole age of Jacob was an hundred forty and seven years.
bsb_text: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years, and the length of his life was 147 years.
aov_text: En Jakob het sewentien jaar in Egipteland gelewe, sodat die dae van Jakob, die jare van sy lewe, honderd-sewen-en-veertig jaar was.

kjv_text: And the time drew nigh that Israel must die: and he called his son Joseph, and said unto him, If now I have found grace in thy sight, put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh, and deal kindly and truly with me; bury me not, I pray thee, in Egypt:
bsb_text: When the time drew near for Israel to die, he called his son Joseph and said to him, “If I have found favor in your eyes, put your hand under my thigh and promise to show me kindness and faithfulness. Do not bury me in Egypt,
aov_text: En toe die dae van Israel nader kom dat hy moes sterwe, het hy sy seun Josef laat roep en vir hom gesê: As ek nou guns in jou oë gevind het, sit dan tog jou hand onder my heup en bewys my liefde en trou—begrawe my tog nie in Egipte nie.

kjv_text: But I will lie with my fathers, and thou shalt carry me out of Egypt, and bury me in their buryingplace. And he said, I will do as thou hast said.
bsb_text: but when I lie down with my fathers, carry me out of Egypt and bury me with them.” Joseph answered, “I will do as you have requested.”
aov_text: Wanneer ek met my vaders ontslaap het, bring my dan weg uit Egipte en begrawe my in hulle graf. En hy antwoord: Ek sal handel ooreenkomstig u woord.

kjv_text: And he said, Swear unto me. And he sware unto him. And Israel bowed himself upon the bed's head.
bsb_text: “Swear to me,” Jacob said. So Joseph swore to him, and Israel bowed in worship at the head of his bed.
aov_text: Toe sê hy: Sweer my dit tog. En hy het vir hom gesweer. Toe het Israel in aanbidding gebuig oor die koppenent van die bed.

kjv_text: And it came to pass after these things, that one told Joseph, Behold, thy father is sick: and he took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.
bsb_text: Some time later Joseph was told, “Your father is ill.” So he set out with his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.
aov_text: NÁ hierdie dinge het hulle aan Josef meegedeel: Kyk, u vader is siek. Toe neem hy sy twee seuns, Manasse en Efraim, met hom saam.

kjv_text: And one told Jacob, and said, Behold, thy son Joseph cometh unto thee: and Israel strengthened himself, and sat upon the bed.
bsb_text: When Jacob was told, “Your son Joseph has come to you,” Israel rallied his strength and sat up in bed.
aov_text: En hulle het aan Jakob berig gebring en gesê: Kyk, u seun Josef kom na u toe. Daarop het Jakob sy krag versamel en op die bed gaan sit.

kjv_text: And Jacob said unto Joseph, God Almighty appeared unto me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,
bsb_text: Jacob said to Joseph, “God Almighty appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and there He blessed me
aov_text: En Jakob het vir Josef gesê: God, die Almagtige, het aan my verskyn by Lus, in die land Kanaän, en my geseën

kjv_text: And said unto me, Behold, I will make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, and I will make of thee a multitude of people; and will give this land to thy seed after thee for an everlasting possession.
bsb_text: and told me, ‘Behold, I will make you fruitful and multiply you; I will make you a multitude of peoples, and will give this land to your descendants after you as an everlasting possession.’
aov_text: en vir my gesê: Kyk, Ek sal jou vrugbaar maak en jou vermeerder en jou tot ’n menigte van volke maak, en Ek sal aan jou nageslag ná jou hierdie land as ewige besitting gee.

kjv_text: And now thy two sons, Ephraim and Manasseh, which were born unto thee in the land of Egypt before I came unto thee into Egypt, are mine; as Reuben and Simeon, they shall be mine.
bsb_text: And now your two sons born to you in Egypt before I came to you here shall be reckoned as mine; Ephraim and Manasseh shall be mine, just as Reuben and Simeon are mine.
aov_text: Nou dan, jou twee seuns wat vir jou in Egipteland gebore is voordat ek in Egipte na jou gekom het, is myne. Efraim en Manasse sal myne wees net soos Ruben en Símeon.

kjv_text: And thy issue, which thou begettest after them, shall be thine, and shall be called after the name of their brethren in their inheritance.
bsb_text: Any children born to you after them shall be yours, and they shall be called by the names of their brothers in the territory they inherit.
aov_text: Maar jou nakomelinge wat jy ná hulle verwek het, sal joue wees. Hulle sal na die naam van hulle broers genoem word in dié se erfdeel.

kjv_text: And as for me, when I came from Padan, Rachel died by me in the land of Canaan in the way, when yet there was but a little way to come unto Ephrath: and I buried her there in the way of Ephrath; the same is Bethlehem.
bsb_text: Now as for me, when I was returning from Paddan, to my sorrow Rachel died along the way in the land of Canaan, some distance from Ephrath. So I buried her there beside the road to Ephrath” (that is, Bethlehem).
aov_text: En toe ek van Paddan gekom het, het Ragel by my gesterwe in die land Kanaän, op die reis toe daar nog ’n kort ent pad was om by Efrat te kom; en ek het haar daar begrawe langs die pad na Efrat, dit is Betlehem.

kjv_text: And Israel beheld Joseph's sons, and said, Who are these?
bsb_text: When Israel saw the sons of Joseph, he asked, “Who are these?”
aov_text: Toe Israel die seuns van Josef sien, sê hy: Wie is dit?

kjv_text: And Joseph said unto his father, They are my sons, whom God hath given me in this place. And he said, Bring them, I pray thee, unto me, and I will bless them.
bsb_text: Joseph said to his father, “They are the sons God has given me in this place.” So Jacob said, “Please bring them to me, that I may bless them.”
aov_text: En Josef antwoord sy vader: Dit is my seuns wat God my hier gegee het. En hy sê: Bring hulle tog by my, dat ek hulle kan seën.

kjv_text: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age, so that he could not see. And he brought them near unto him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.
bsb_text: Now Israel’s eyesight was poor because of old age; he could hardly see. Joseph brought his sons to him, and his father kissed them and embraced them.
aov_text: Maar Israel se oë was swaar van ouderdom, hy kon nie sien nie. En toe hy hulle by hom bring, het hy hulle gesoen en hulle omhels.

kjv_text: And Israel said unto Joseph, I had not thought to see thy face: and, lo, God hath shewed me also thy seed.
bsb_text: “I never expected to see your face again,” Israel said to Joseph, “but now God has let me see your children as well.”
aov_text: En Israel sê vir Josef: Ek het geen gedagte gehad om jou aangesig te sien nie, en kyk, God het my ook jou nageslag laat sien.

kjv_text: And Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.
bsb_text: Then Joseph removed his sons from his father’s knees and bowed facedown.
aov_text: Daarop laat Josef hulle van sy knieë af weggaan, en hy buig hom met sy aangesig na die aarde toe.

kjv_text: And Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel's left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel's right hand, and brought them near unto him.
bsb_text: And Joseph took both of them—with Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel’s left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel’s right hand—and brought them close to him.
aov_text: En Josef neem hulle twee, Efraim met sy regterhand, links van Israel, en Manasse met sy linkerhand, regs van Israel, en hy bring hulle by hom.

kjv_text: And Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid it upon Ephraim's head, who was the younger, and his left hand upon Manasseh's head, guiding his hands wittingly; for Manasseh was the firstborn.
bsb_text: But Israel stretched out his right hand and put it on the head of Ephraim, the younger; and crossing his hands, he put his left on Manasseh’s head, although Manasseh was the firstborn.
aov_text: Toe steek Israel sy regterhand uit en lê dit op die hoof van Efraim, hoewel hy die jongste was, en sy linkerhand op die hoof van Manasse: hy het sy hande oorkruis gehou, want Manasse was die eersgeborene.

kjv_text: And he blessed Joseph, and said, God, before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac did walk, the God which fed me all my life long unto this day,
bsb_text: Then he blessed Joseph and said: “May the God before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac walked, the God who has been my shepherd all my life to this day,
aov_text: En hy het Josef geseën en gesê: Die God voor wie se aangesig my vaders Abraham en Isak gewandel het, die God wat my as Herder my lewe lank gelei het tot vandag toe,

kjv_text: The Angel which redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads; and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth.
bsb_text: the angel who has redeemed me from all harm—may He bless these boys. And may they be called by my name and the names of my fathers Abraham and Isaac, and may they grow into a multitude upon the earth.”
aov_text: die Engel wat my uit elke teëspoed verlos het—mag Hy die seuns seën, en mag deur hulle my naam genoem word en die naam van my vaders Abraham en Isak, en mag hulle vermeerder in die land in menigte.

kjv_text: And when Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand upon the head of Ephraim, it displeased him: and he held up his father's hand, to remove it from Ephraim's head unto Manasseh's head.
bsb_text: When Joseph saw that his father had placed his right hand on Ephraim’s head, he was displeased and took his father’s hand to move it from Ephraim’s head to Manasseh’s.
aov_text: Toe Josef sien dat sy vader sy regterhand op die hoof van Efraim gelê het, was dit verkeerd in sy oë; en hy het die hand van sy vader gegryp om dit van die hoof van Efraim op die hoof van Manasse oor te bring.

kjv_text: And Joseph said unto his father, Not so, my father: for this is the firstborn; put thy right hand upon his head.
bsb_text: “Not so, my father!” Joseph said. “This one is the firstborn; put your right hand on his head.”
aov_text: En Josef sê aan sy vader: Nie so nie, my vader; want hierdie een is die eersgeborene: lê u regterhand op sy hoof.

kjv_text: And his father refused, and said, I know it, my son, I know it: he also shall become a people, and he also shall be great: but truly his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his seed shall become a multitude of nations.
bsb_text: But his father refused. “I know, my son, I know!” he said. “He too shall become a people, and he too shall be great; nevertheless, his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his offspring shall become a multitude of nations.”
aov_text: Maar sy vader weier en sê: Ek weet, my seun, ek weet. Hy sal ook ’n volk word, en hy sal ook groot word; nogtans sal sy jongste broer groter wees as hy, en sý nageslag sal ’n menigte van nasies word.

kjv_text: And he blessed them that day, saying, In thee shall Israel bless, saying, God make thee as Ephraim and as Manasseh: and he set Ephraim before Manasseh.
bsb_text: So that day Jacob blessed them and said: “By you shall Israel pronounce this blessing: ‘May God make you like Ephraim and Manasseh.’” So he put Ephraim before Manasseh.
aov_text: So het hy hulle dan dié dag geseën en gesê: Met jou sal Israel ’n seën toewens, met die woorde: Mag God jou maak soos Efraim en soos Manasse! So het hy dan Efraim voor Manasse gestel.

kjv_text: And Israel said unto Joseph, Behold, I die: but God shall be with you, and bring you again unto the land of your fathers.
bsb_text: Then Israel said to Joseph, “Look, I am about to die, but God will be with you and bring you back to the land of your fathers.
aov_text: Daarop sê Israel vir Josef: Kyk, ek gaan sterwe, maar God sal met julle wees, en Hy sal julle terug laat gaan na die land van julle vaders.

kjv_text: Moreover I have given to thee one portion above thy brethren, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.
bsb_text: And to you, as one who is above your brothers, I give the ridge of land that I took from the Amorites with my sword and bow.”
aov_text: En ék gee jou een stuk land bo jou broers, wat ek met my swaard en my boog van die Amoriete afgeneem het.

kjv_text: And Jacob called unto his sons, and said, Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which shall befall you in the last days.
bsb_text: Then Jacob called for his sons and said, “Gather around so that I can tell you what will happen to you in the days to come:
aov_text: DAARNA het Jakob sy seuns geroep en gesê: Kom bymekaar, dat ek julle kan verkondig wat julle aan die einde van die dae sal wedervaar.

kjv_text: Gather yourselves together, and hear, ye sons of Jacob; and hearken unto Israel your father.
bsb_text: Come together and listen, O sons of Jacob; listen to your father Israel.
aov_text: Versamel en hoor, seuns van Jakob, en luister na Israel, julle vader!

kjv_text: Reuben, thou art my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, the excellency of dignity, and the excellency of power:
bsb_text: Reuben, you are my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, excelling in honor, excelling in power.
aov_text: Ruben, jy is my eersgeborene, my krag en die eersteling van my sterkte; die vernaamste in hoogheid en die vernaamste in mag!

kjv_text: Unstable as water, thou shalt not excel; because thou wentest up to thy father's bed; then defiledst thou it: he went up to my couch.
bsb_text: Uncontrolled as the waters, you will no longer excel, because you went up to your father’s bed, onto my couch, and defiled it.
aov_text: Opbruising soos van waters—jy sal die vernaamste nie wees nie, want jy het die bed van jou vader beklim; toe het jy dit ontheilig. Hy het my bed beklim.

kjv_text: Simeon and Levi are brethren; instruments of cruelty are in their habitations.
bsb_text: Simeon and Levi are brothers; their swords are weapons of violence.
aov_text: Símeon en Levi is broers. Hulle wapens is werktuie van geweld.

kjv_text: O my soul, come not thou into their secret; unto their assembly, mine honour, be not thou united: for in their anger they slew a man, and in their selfwill they digged down a wall.
bsb_text: May I never enter their council; may I never join their assembly. For they kill men in their anger, and hamstring oxen on a whim.
aov_text: Laat my siel nie kom in hulle raad nie, laat my eer nie eens wees met hulle vergadering nie. Want in hul toorn het hulle manne doodgeslaan, en in hulle moedswilligheid het hulle beeste vermink.

kjv_text: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel: I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.
bsb_text: Cursed be their anger, for it is strong, and their wrath, for it is cruel! I will disperse them in Jacob and scatter them in Israel.
aov_text: Vervloek is hulle toorn, want dit is heftig; en hulle grimmigheid, want dit is hard. Ek sal hulle verdeel in Jakob en hulle verstrooi in Israel.

kjv_text: Judah, thou art he whom thy brethren shall praise: thy hand shall be in the neck of thine enemies; thy father's children shall bow down before thee.
bsb_text: Judah, your brothers shall praise you. Your hand shall be on the necks of your enemies; your father’s sons shall bow down to you.
aov_text: Juda, jy is dit! Jou sal jou broers loof. Jou hand sal op die nek van jou vyande wees; voor jou sal die seuns van jou vader hulle neerbuig.

kjv_text: Judah is a lion's whelp: from the prey, my son, thou art gone up: he stooped down, he couched as a lion, and as an old lion; who shall rouse him up?
bsb_text: Judah is a young lion—my son, you return from the prey. Like a lion he crouches and lies down; like a lioness, who dares to rouse him?
aov_text: Juda is ’n jong leeu; van die roof af het jy opgeklim, my seun. Hy buig hom, hy gaan lê soos ’n leeu en soos ’n leeuin; wie sal hom opjaag?

kjv_text: The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.
bsb_text: The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the staff from between his feet, until Shiloh comes and the allegiance of the nations is his.
aov_text: Die septer sal van Juda nie wyk nie, nòg die veldheerstaf tussen sy voete uit totdat Silo kom; en aan Hom sal die volke gehoorsaam wees.

kjv_text: Binding his foal unto the vine, and his ass's colt unto the choice vine; he washed his garments in wine, and his clothes in the blood of grapes:
bsb_text: He ties his donkey to the vine, his colt to the choicest branch. He washes his garments in wine, his robes in the blood of grapes.
aov_text: Hy maak sy jong esel vas aan die wingerdstok en die vul van sy eselin aan die edelste wynstok; hy was sy kleed in wyn en sy gewaad in druiwebloed.

kjv_text: His eyes shall be red with wine, and his teeth white with milk.
bsb_text: His eyes are darker than wine, and his teeth are whiter than milk.
aov_text: Hy is donkerder van oë as wyn en witter van tande as melk.

kjv_text: Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea; and he shall be for an haven of ships; and his border shall be unto Zidon.
bsb_text: Zebulun shall dwell by the seashore and become a harbor for ships; his border shall extend to Sidon.
aov_text: Sébulon sal woon by die strand van die see; en hy sal by die strand van die skepe wees, met die sykant na Sidon toe.

kjv_text: Issachar is a strong ass couching down between two burdens:
bsb_text: Issachar is a strong donkey, lying down between the sheepfolds.
aov_text: Íssaskar is ’n sterkgebeende esel wat tussen die veekrale lê.

kjv_text: And he saw that rest was good, and the land that it was pleasant; and bowed his shoulder to bear, and became a servant unto tribute.
bsb_text: He saw that his resting place was good and that his land was pleasant, so he bent his shoulder to the burden and submitted to labor as a servant.
aov_text: Toe hy sien dat die rus goed en die land lieflik is, het hy sy skouer gebuig om te dra, en hy moes dwangarbeid verrig.

kjv_text: Dan shall judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.
bsb_text: Dan shall provide justice for his people as one of the tribes of Israel.
aov_text: Dan sal aan sý volk reg verskaf net soos enigeen van die stamme van Israel.

kjv_text: Dan shall be a serpent by the way, an adder in the path, that biteth the horse heels, so that his rider shall fall backward.
bsb_text: He will be a snake by the road, a viper in the path that bites the horse’s heels so that its rider tumbles backward.
aov_text: Laat Dan ’n slang wees op die weg, ’n horingslang op die pad, wat die perd aan die hakskene byt, sodat sy ruiter agteroorval.

kjv_text: I have waited for thy salvation, O LORD.
bsb_text: I await Your salvation, O LORD.
aov_text: Op u verlossing wag ek, HERE!

kjv_text: Gad, a troop shall overcome him: but he shall overcome at the last.
bsb_text: Gad will be attacked by raiders, but he will attack their heels.
aov_text: Gad—’n bende sal hom aanval, maar hý sal hulle aan die hakskeen gryp.

kjv_text: Out of Asher his bread shall be fat, and he shall yield royal dainties.
bsb_text: Asher’s food will be rich; he shall provide royal delicacies.
aov_text: Aser, sy spys is vet, en hý lewer koninklike lekkernye.

kjv_text: Naphtali is a hind let loose: he giveth goodly words.
bsb_text: Naphtali is a doe set free that bears beautiful fawns.
aov_text: Náftali is soos ’n wildsbok so vry, hy wat mooi woorde laat hoor.

kjv_text: Joseph is a fruitful bough, even a fruitful bough by a well; whose branches run over the wall:
bsb_text: Joseph is a fruitful vine—a fruitful vine by a spring, whose branches scale the wall.
aov_text: Josef is ’n jong vrugteboom, ’n jong vrugteboom by ’n fontein; sy takke klim oor die muur.

kjv_text: The archers have sorely grieved him, and shot at him, and hated him:
bsb_text: The archers attacked him with bitterness; they aimed at him in hostility.
aov_text: Die boogskutters het hom wel geprikkel en hom beskiet en hom bestry,

kjv_text: But his bow abode in strength, and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of the mighty God of Jacob; (from thence is the shepherd, the stone of Israel:)
bsb_text: Yet he steadied his bow, and his strong arms were tempered by the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob, in the name of the Shepherd, the Rock of Israel,
aov_text: maar sy boog het sterk gebly, en die arms van sy hande was buigsaam, deur die hande van die Magtige van Jakob—daarvandaan waar die Herder, die Steen van Israel, is,

kjv_text: Even by the God of thy father, who shall help thee; and by the Almighty, who shall bless thee with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lieth under, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb:
bsb_text: by the God of your father who helps you, and by the Almighty who blesses you, with blessings of the heavens above, with blessings of the depths below, with blessings of the breasts and womb.
aov_text: van die God van jou vader, wat jou help, en met die hulp van die Almagtige wat jou seën met seëninge van die hemel daarbo, met seëninge van die watervloed wat daaronder lê, met seëninge van borste en moederskoot.

kjv_text: The blessings of thy father have prevailed above the blessings of my progenitors unto the utmost bound of the everlasting hills: they shall be on the head of Joseph, and on the crown of the head of him that was separate from his brethren.
bsb_text: The blessings of your father have surpassed the blessings of the ancient mountains and the bounty of the everlasting hills. May they rest on the head of Joseph, on the brow of the prince of his brothers.
