aov_text: Die seëninge wat jou vader ontvang het, oortref die seëninge van die ewige berge, die kostelike gawes van die ewige heuwels. Dit sal wees op die hoof van Josef en op die hoofskedel van die uitverkorene onder sy broers.

kjv_text: Benjamin shall ravin as a wolf: in the morning he shall devour the prey, and at night he shall divide the spoil.
bsb_text: Benjamin is a ravenous wolf; in the morning he devours the prey, in the evening he divides the plunder.”
aov_text: Benjamin is ’n wolf wat verskeur; in die môre eet hy sy prooi, en in die aand deel hy buit uit.

kjv_text: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel: and this is it that their father spake unto them, and blessed them; every one according to his blessing he blessed them.
bsb_text: These are the tribes of Israel, twelve in all, and this was what their father said to them. He blessed them, and he blessed each one with a suitable blessing.
aov_text: Húlle almal is die twaalf stamme van Israel; en dit is wat hulle vader aan hulle gesê het, en hy het hulle geseën; hy het hulle geseën, elkeen volgens sy besondere seën.

kjv_text: And he charged them, and said unto them, I am to be gathered unto my people: bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,
bsb_text: Then Jacob instructed them, “I am about to be gathered to my people. Bury me with my fathers in the cave in the field of Ephron the Hittite.
aov_text: Daarna het hy hulle bevel gegee en aan hulle gesê: Ek word versamel by my volk. Begrawe my by my vaders in die spelonk wat op die stuk grond van Efron, die Hetiet, is;

kjv_text: In the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field of Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a buryingplace.
bsb_text: The cave is in the field of Machpelah near Mamre, in the land of Canaan. This is the field Abraham purchased from Ephron the Hittite as a burial site.
aov_text: in die spelonk wat op die stuk grond van Magpéla is, wat oos van Mamre lê, in die land Kanaän; die stuk grond wat Abraham van Efron, die Hetiet, as eiendomsgraf gekoop het.

kjv_text: There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife; there they buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife; and there I buried Leah.
bsb_text: There Abraham and his wife Sarah are buried, there Isaac and his wife Rebekah are buried, and there I buried Leah.
aov_text: Daar het hulle Abraham begrawe en Sara, sy vrou; daar het hulle Isak begrawe en Rebekka, sy vrou; en daar het ek Lea begrawe—

kjv_text: The purchase of the field and of the cave that is therein was from the children of Heth.
bsb_text: The field and the cave that is in it were purchased from the Hittites.”
aov_text: die stuk grond en die spelonk wat daarin is, wat gekoop is van die seuns van Het.

kjv_text: And when Jacob had made an end of commanding his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, and yielded up the ghost, and was gathered unto his people.
bsb_text: When Jacob had finished instructing his sons, he pulled his feet into the bed and breathed his last, and he was gathered to his people.
aov_text: Toe Jakob klaar sy bevele aan sy seuns gegee het, trek hy sy voete terug op die bed en blaas die asem uit; en hy is by sy volksgenote versamel.

kjv_text: And Joseph fell upon his father's face, and wept upon him, and kissed him.
bsb_text: Then Joseph fell upon his father’s face, wept over him, and kissed him.
aov_text: TOE val Josef op sy vader se aangesig, en hy het oor hom geween en hom gesoen.

kjv_text: And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father: and the physicians embalmed Israel.
bsb_text: And Joseph directed the physicians in his service to embalm his father Israel. So they embalmed him,
aov_text: En Josef het aan sy dienaars, die geneeshere, bevel gegee om sy vader te balsem. En die geneeshere het Israel gebalsem.

kjv_text: And forty days were fulfilled for him; for so are fulfilled the days of those which are embalmed: and the Egyptians mourned for him threescore and ten days.
bsb_text: taking the forty days required to complete the embalming. And the Egyptians mourned for him seventy days.
aov_text: En veertig dae het daarvoor verbygegaan; want so lank duur die dae van balseming. En die Egiptenaars het hom sewentig dae lank beween.

kjv_text: And when the days of his mourning were past, Joseph spake unto the house of Pharaoh, saying, If now I have found grace in your eyes, speak, I pray you, in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,
bsb_text: When the days of mourning had passed, Joseph said to Pharaoh’s court, “If I have found favor in your eyes, please tell Pharaoh that
aov_text: En toe die dae van geween oor hom verby was, het Josef met die huis van Farao gespreek en gesê: As ek dan guns in julle oë gevind het, spreek tog dit voor die ore van Farao:

kjv_text: My father made me swear, saying, Lo, I die: in my grave which I have digged for me in the land of Canaan, there shalt thou bury me. Now therefore let me go up, I pray thee, and bury my father, and I will come again.
bsb_text: my father made me swear an oath when he said, ‘I am about to die. You must bury me in the tomb that I dug for myself in the land of Canaan.’ Now let me go and bury my father, and then return.”
aov_text: My vader het my laat sweer en gesê: Kyk, ek gaan sterwe; in my graf wat ek vir my in die land Kanaän uitgekap het, daar moet jy my begrawe. Laat my dan nou tog optrek en my vader begrawe. Daarna sal ek terugkom.

kjv_text: And Pharaoh said, Go up, and bury thy father, according as he made thee swear.
bsb_text: Pharaoh replied, “Go up and bury your father, as he made you swear to do.”
aov_text: En Farao sê: Trek op en begrawe jou vader soos hy jou laat sweer het.

kjv_text: And Joseph went up to bury his father: and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, and all the elders of the land of Egypt,
bsb_text: Then Joseph went to bury his father, and all the servants of Pharaoh accompanied him—the elders of Pharaoh’s household and all the elders of the land of Egypt—
aov_text: Toe het Josef opgetrek om sy vader te begrawe, en al die dienaars van Farao, die oudstes van sy huis, het saam met hom opgetrek, en al die oudstes van Egipteland;

kjv_text: And all the house of Joseph, and his brethren, and his father's house: only their little ones, and their flocks, and their herds, they left in the land of Goshen.
bsb_text: along with all of Joseph’s household, and his brothers, and his father’s household. Only their children and flocks and herds were left in Goshen.
aov_text: ook die hele huis van Josef en sy broers en die huis van sy vader. Net hulle kinders en hulle kleinvee en hulle beeste het hulle in die land Gosen laat agterbly.

kjv_text: And there went up with him both chariots and horsemen: and it was a very great company.
bsb_text: Chariots and horsemen alike went up with him, and it was an exceedingly large procession.
aov_text: En saam met hom het opgetrek strydwaens sowel as ruiters, sodat dit ’n baie groot trek was.

kjv_text: And they came to the threshingfloor of Atad, which is beyond Jordan, and there they mourned with a great and very sore lamentation: and he made a mourning for his father seven days.
bsb_text: When they reached the threshing floor of Atad, which is across the Jordan, they lamented and wailed loudly, and Joseph mourned for his father seven days.
aov_text: En toe hulle by die Steekdoring-dorsvloer kom, wat oos van die Jordaan lê, het hulle daar ’n groot en baie swaar rouklag gehou. En hy het oor sy vader rou laat bedrywe sewe dae lank.

kjv_text: And when the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, This is a grievous mourning to the Egyptians: wherefore the name of it was called Abelmizraim, which is beyond Jordan.
bsb_text: When the Canaanites of the land saw the mourning at the threshing floor of Atad, they said, “This is a solemn ceremony of mourning by the Egyptians.” Thus the place across the Jordan is called Abel-mizraim.
aov_text: Toe die inwoners van die land, die Kanaäniete, die roubedryf by die Steekdoring-dorsvloer sien, sê hulle: Dit is ’n swaar rou vir die Egiptenaars. Daarom het hulle dit Abel-Misraim genoem, wat oos van die Jordaan lê.

kjv_text: And his sons did unto him according as he commanded them:
bsb_text: So Jacob’s sons did as he had charged them.
aov_text: En sy seuns het met hom gedoen net soos hy hulle beveel het:

kjv_text: For his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field for a possession of a buryingplace of Ephron the Hittite, before Mamre.
bsb_text: They carried him to the land of Canaan and buried him in the cave at Machpelah in the field near Mamre, which Abraham had purchased from Ephron the Hittite as a burial site.
aov_text: sy seuns het hom weggebring na die land Kanaän en hom begrawe in die spelonk van die stuk grond van Magpéla, die stuk grond wat Abraham as eiendomsgraf gekoop het van Efron, die Hetiet, oos van Mamre.

kjv_text: And Joseph returned into Egypt, he, and his brethren, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.
bsb_text: After Joseph had buried his father, he returned to Egypt with his brothers and all who had gone with him to bury his father.
aov_text: Daarna het Josef na Egipte teruggegaan, hy en sy broers en almal wat saam met hom opgetrek het om sy vader te begrawe, nadat hy sy vader begrawe het.

kjv_text: And when Joseph's brethren saw that their father was dead, they said, Joseph will peradventure hate us, and will certainly requite us all the evil which we did unto him.
bsb_text: When Joseph’s brothers saw that their father was dead, they said, “What if Joseph bears a grudge? Then he will surely repay us for all the evil that we did to him.”
aov_text: Toe die broers van Josef sien dat hulle vader dood was, het hulle gesê: Sê nou Josef gaan ons as vyande behandel en hy gaan ons werklik vergelde al die kwaad wat ons hom aangedoen het!

kjv_text: And they sent a messenger unto Joseph, saying, Thy father did command before he died, saying,
bsb_text: So they sent word to Joseph, saying, “Before he died, your father commanded,
aov_text: Daarom het hulle hierdie boodskap na Josef gestuur: U vader het voor sy dood bevel gegee met hierdie woorde:

kjv_text: So shall ye say unto Joseph, Forgive, I pray thee now, the trespass of thy brethren, and their sin; for they did unto thee evil: and now, we pray thee, forgive the trespass of the servants of the God of thy father. And Joseph wept when they spake unto him.
bsb_text: ‘This is what you are to say to Joseph: I beg you, please forgive the transgression and sin of your brothers, for they did you wrong.’ So now, Joseph, please forgive the transgression of the servants of the God of your father.” When their message came to him, Joseph wept.
aov_text: So moet julle vir Josef sê: Ag, vergewe tog die oortreding van jou broers en hulle sonde, want hulle het jou kwaad aangedoen. Maar nou, vergewe tog die oortreding van ons wat die God van u vader dien. En Josef het geween toe hulle met hom spreek.

kjv_text: And his brethren also went and fell down before his face; and they said, Behold, we be thy servants.
bsb_text: His brothers also came to him, bowed down before him, and said, “We are your slaves!”
aov_text: En sy broers het ook self gegaan en voor hom neergeval en gesê: Kyk, ons is u slawe.

kjv_text: And Joseph said unto them, Fear not: for am I in the place of God?
bsb_text: But Joseph replied, “Do not be afraid. Am I in the place of God?
aov_text: Maar Josef het hulle geantwoord: Moenie bevrees wees nie; want is ek in die plek van God?

kjv_text: But as for you, ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.
bsb_text: As for you, what you intended against me for evil, God intended for good, in order to accomplish a day like this—to preserve the lives of many people.
aov_text: Want júlle het wel kwaad teen my bedink, maar God het dit ten goede gedink om te doen soos dit vandag is, om ’n groot volk in die lewe te hou.

kjv_text: Now therefore fear ye not: I will nourish you, and your little ones. And he comforted them, and spake kindly unto them.
bsb_text: Therefore do not be afraid. I will provide for you and your little ones.” So Joseph reassured his brothers and spoke kindly to them.
aov_text: Wees dan nou nie bevrees nie: ék sal julle en julle kinders onderhou. So het hy hulle dan getroos en na hulle hart gespreek.

kjv_text: And Joseph dwelt in Egypt, he, and his father's house: and Joseph lived an hundred and ten years.
bsb_text: Now Joseph and his father’s household remained in Egypt, and Joseph lived to the age of 110.
aov_text: En Josef het in Egipte gewoon, hy en die huis van sy vader. En Josef het honderd-en-tien jaar gelewe.

kjv_text: And Joseph saw Ephraim's children of the third generation: the children also of Machir the son of Manasseh were brought up upon Joseph's knees.
bsb_text: He saw Ephraim’s sons to the third generation, and indeed the sons of Machir son of Manasseh were brought up on Joseph’s knees.
aov_text: En Josef het van Efraim kinders gesien van die derde geslag. Ook die kinders van Magir, die seun van Manasse, is op Josef se knieë gebore.

kjv_text: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I die: and God will surely visit you, and bring you out of this land unto the land which he sware to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
bsb_text: Then Joseph said to his brothers, “I am about to die, but God will surely visit you and bring you up from this land to the land He promised on oath to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.”
aov_text: En Josef het aan sy broers gesê: Ek gaan sterwe, maar God sal gewis op julle ag gee en julle uit hierdie land laat optrek na die land wat Hy aan Abraham, Isak en Jakob met ’n eed beloof het.

kjv_text: And Joseph took an oath of the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you, and ye shall carry up my bones from hence.
bsb_text: And Joseph made the sons of Israel take an oath and said, “God will surely attend to you, and then you must carry my bones up from this place.”
aov_text: En Josef het die seuns van Israel laat sweer en gesê: As God sekerlik op julle ag sal gee—bring dan my gebeente hiervandaan op.

kjv_text: So Joseph died, being an hundred and ten years old: and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.
bsb_text: So Joseph died at the age of 110. And they embalmed his body and placed it in a coffin in Egypt.
aov_text: En Josef het gesterwe, honderd-en-tien jaar oud. En hulle het hom gebalsem, en hy is in ’n kis gesit in Egipte.

kjv_text: Now these are the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt; every man and his household came with Jacob.
bsb_text: These are the names of the sons of Israel who went to Egypt with Jacob, each with his family:
aov_text: EN dit is die name van die seuns van Israel wat in Egipte gekom het; saam met Jakob het hulle gekom, elkeen met sy huisgesin:

kjv_text: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah,
bsb_text: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah;
aov_text: Ruben, Símeon, Levi en Juda;

kjv_text: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin,
bsb_text: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin;
aov_text: Íssaskar, Sébulon en Benjamin;

kjv_text: Dan, and Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
bsb_text: Dan and Naphtali; Gad and Asher.
aov_text: Dan en Náftali, Gad en Aser.

kjv_text: And all the souls that came out of the loins of Jacob were seventy souls: for Joseph was in Egypt already.
bsb_text: The descendants of Jacob numbered seventy in all, including Joseph, who was already in Egypt.
aov_text: En al die siele wat uit Jakob se lende voortgekom het, was sewentig siele. Maar Josef was in Egipte.

kjv_text: And Joseph died, and all his brethren, and all that generation.
bsb_text: Now Joseph and all his brothers and all that generation died,
aov_text: En Josef het gesterwe, en al sy broers en daardie hele geslag.

kjv_text: And the children of Israel were fruitful, and increased abundantly, and multiplied, and waxed exceeding mighty; and the land was filled with them.
bsb_text: but the Israelites were fruitful and increased rapidly; they multiplied and became exceedingly numerous, so that the land was filled with them.
aov_text: Maar die kinders van Israel was vrugbaar en het baie geword, en hulle het vermeerder en buitengewoon magtig geword, sodat die land vol was van hulle.

kjv_text: Now there arose up a new king over Egypt, which knew not Joseph.
bsb_text: Then a new king, who did not know Joseph, came to power in Egypt.
aov_text: Toe staan daar ’n nuwe koning oor Egipte op wat niks van Josef geweet het nie.

kjv_text: And he said unto his people, Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we:
bsb_text: “Look,” he said to his people, “the Israelites have become too numerous and too powerful for us.
aov_text: Dié het aan sy volk gesê: Kyk, die volk van die kinders van Israel is meer en magtiger as ons.

kjv_text: Come on, let us deal wisely with them; lest they multiply, and it come to pass, that, when there falleth out any war, they join also unto our enemies, and fight against us, and so get them up out of the land.
bsb_text: Come, let us deal shrewdly with them, or they will increase even more; and if a war breaks out, they may join our enemies, fight against us, and leave the country.”
aov_text: Kom, laat ons ’n slim plan teen hulle beraam, sodat hulle nie kan vermeerder nie, en as ons in oorlog geraak, hulle ook nie by ons vyande aansluit en teen ons veg en uit die land optrek nie.

kjv_text: Therefore they did set over them taskmasters to afflict them with their burdens. And they built for Pharaoh treasure cities, Pithom and Raamses.
bsb_text: So the Egyptians appointed taskmasters over the Israelites to oppress them with forced labor. As a result, they built Pithom and Rameses as store cities for Pharaoh.
aov_text: Daar is toe opsigters van dwangarbeid oor hulle aangestel om hulle met harde arbeid te verdruk. En hulle het vir Farao die voorraadstede Pitom en Raämses gebou.

kjv_text: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and grew. And they were grieved because of the children of Israel.
bsb_text: But the more they were oppressed, the more they multiplied and flourished; so the Egyptians came to dread the Israelites.
aov_text: Maar hoe meer hulle verdruk is, hoe meer het hulle vermenigvuldig en hulle uitgebrei, sodat hulle bang geword het vir die kinders van Israel.

kjv_text: And the Egyptians made the children of Israel to serve with rigour:
bsb_text: They worked the Israelites ruthlessly
aov_text: Daarom het die Egiptenaars die kinders van Israel met hardheid laat dien

kjv_text: And they made their lives bitter with hard bondage, in morter, and in brick, and in all manner of service in the field: all their service, wherein they made them serve, was with rigour.
bsb_text: and made their lives bitter with hard labor in brick and mortar, and with all kinds of work in the fields. Every service they imposed was harsh.
aov_text: en hulle lewe verbitter deur swaar werk met klei en bakstene en deur allerhande werk in die landerye—al dié werk wat hulle met hardheid deur hulle laat verrig het.

kjv_text: And the king of Egypt spake to the Hebrew midwives, of which the name of the one was Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah:
bsb_text: Then the king of Egypt said to the Hebrew midwives, whose names were Shiphrah and Puah,
aov_text: En die koning van Egipte het met die Hebreeuse vroedvroue—die een se naam was Sifra en die ander se naam Pua—gespreek

kjv_text: And he said, When ye do the office of a midwife to the Hebrew women, and see them upon the stools; if it be a son, then ye shall kill him: but if it be a daughter, then she shall live.
bsb_text: “When you help the Hebrew women give birth, observe them on the birthstools. If the child is a son, kill him; but if it is a daughter, let her live.”
aov_text: en gesê: As julle die Hebreeuse vroue by ’n geboorte help, moet julle na die geboortestoel kyk: as dit ’n seun is, maak hom dood; maar is dit ’n dogter, laat haar lewe.

kjv_text: But the midwives feared God, and did not as the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the men children alive.
bsb_text: The midwives, however, feared God and did not do as the king of Egypt had instructed; they let the boys live.
aov_text: Maar die vroedvroue het God gevrees en nie gedoen soos die koning van Egipte aan hulle gesê het nie, maar die seuntjies laat lewe.

kjv_text: And the king of Egypt called for the midwives, and said unto them, Why have ye done this thing, and have saved the men children alive?
bsb_text: So the king of Egypt summoned the midwives and asked them, “Why have you done this? Why have you let the boys live?”
aov_text: Toe laat die koning van Egipte die vroedvroue roep, en hy sê vir hulle: Waarom het julle dit gedoen en die seuntjies laat lewe?

kjv_text: And the midwives said unto Pharaoh, Because the Hebrew women are not as the Egyptian women; for they are lively, and are delivered ere the midwives come in unto them.
bsb_text: The midwives answered Pharaoh, “The Hebrew women are not like the Egyptian women, for they are vigorous and give birth before a midwife arrives.”
aov_text: En die vroedvroue sê vir Farao: Die Hebreeuse vroue is nie soos die Egiptiese nie, want hulle is sterk—voordat die vroedvrou by hulle kom, het hulle al gebaar.

kjv_text: Therefore God dealt well with the midwives: and the people multiplied, and waxed very mighty.
bsb_text: So God was good to the midwives, and the people multiplied and became even more numerous.
aov_text: Maar God het aan die vroedvroue weldadigheid bewys. En die volk het vermenigvuldig en baie magtig geword.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, because the midwives feared God, that he made them houses.
bsb_text: And because the midwives feared God, He gave them families of their own.
aov_text: En omdat die vroedvroue God gevrees het, het Hy huisgesinne aan hulle geskenk.

kjv_text: And Pharaoh charged all his people, saying, Every son that is born ye shall cast into the river, and every daughter ye shall save alive.
bsb_text: Then Pharaoh commanded all his people: “Every son born to the Hebrews you must throw into the Nile, but every daughter you may allow to live.”
aov_text: Toe gee Farao aan sy hele volk bevel en sê: Al die seuns wat gebore word, moet julle in die Nyl werp, maar al die dogters kan julle laat lewe.

kjv_text: And there went a man of the house of Levi, and took to wife a daughter of Levi.
bsb_text: Now a man of the house of Levi married a daughter of Levi,
aov_text: EN ’n man uit die huis van Levi het gegaan en ’n dogter van Levi geneem.

kjv_text: And the woman conceived, and bare a son: and when she saw him that he was a goodly child, she hid him three months.
bsb_text: and she conceived and gave birth to a son. When she saw that he was a beautiful child, she hid him for three months.
aov_text: En die vrou het swanger geword en ’n seun gebaar. En toe sy sien dat hy mooi was, het sy hom drie maande lank weggesteek.

kjv_text: And when she could not longer hide him, she took for him an ark of bulrushes, and daubed it with slime and with pitch, and put the child therein; and she laid it in the flags by the river's brink.
bsb_text: But when she could no longer hide him, she got him a papyrus basket and coated it with tar and pitch. Then she placed the child in the basket and set it among the reeds along the bank of the Nile.
aov_text: Maar toe sy hom nie langer verborge kon hou nie, het sy vir hom ’n mandjie van biesies geneem en dit met lymgrond en pik bestryk; en sy het die seuntjie daarin neergelê en dit in die riete aan die kant van die Nyl gesit.

kjv_text: And his sister stood afar off, to wit what would be done to him.
bsb_text: And his sister stood at a distance to see what would happen to him.
aov_text: En sy suster het op ’n afstand gaan staan om te wete te kom wat met hom sou gebeur.

kjv_text: And the daughter of Pharaoh came down to wash herself at the river; and her maidens walked along by the river's side; and when she saw the ark among the flags, she sent her maid to fetch it.
bsb_text: Soon the daughter of Pharaoh went down to bathe in the Nile, and her attendants were walking along the riverbank. And when she saw the basket among the reeds, she sent her maidservant to retrieve it.
aov_text: En Farao se dogter het na die Nyl afgegaan om ’n bad te neem, terwyl haar diensmeisies aan die kant van die Nyl heen en weer geloop het. Toe sien sy die mandjie tussen die riete en stuur haar slavin en laat dit haal.

kjv_text: And when she had opened it, she saw the child: and, behold, the babe wept. And she had compassion on him, and said, This is one of the Hebrews' children.
bsb_text: When she opened it, she saw the child, and behold, the little boy was crying. So she had compassion on him and said, “This is one of the Hebrew children.”
aov_text: Nadat sy dit oopgemaak het, sien sy die kind, en kyk, dit was ’n seuntjie wat huil! En sy het hom jammer gekry en gesê: Dit is een van die kinders van die Hebreërs.

kjv_text: Then said his sister to Pharaoh's daughter, Shall I go and call to thee a nurse of the Hebrew women, that she may nurse the child for thee?
bsb_text: Then his sister said to Pharaoh’s daughter, “Shall I go and call one of the Hebrew women to nurse the child for you?”
aov_text: Toe sê sy suster aan die dogter van Farao: Sal ek vir u ’n pleegmoeder uit die Hebreeuse vroue gaan roep, dat sy vir u die seuntjie kan soog?

kjv_text: And Pharaoh's daughter said to her, Go. And the maid went and called the child's mother.
bsb_text: “Go ahead,” Pharaoh’s daughter told her. And the girl went and called the boy’s mother.
aov_text: En Farao se dogter antwoord haar: Ja. En die jongmeisie het geloop en die seuntjie se moeder geroep.

kjv_text: And Pharaoh's daughter said unto her, Take this child away, and nurse it for me, and I will give thee thy wages. And the woman took the child, and nursed it.
bsb_text: Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Take this child and nurse him for me, and I will pay your wages.” So the woman took the boy and nursed him.
aov_text: Daarop sê Farao se dogter vir haar: Neem hierdie seuntjie en soog hom vir my, en ek sal jou loon gee. En die vrou het die seuntjie geneem en hom gesoog.

kjv_text: And the child grew, and she brought him unto Pharaoh's daughter, and he became her son. And she called his name Moses: and she said, Because I drew him out of the water.
bsb_text: When the child had grown older, she brought him to Pharaoh’s daughter, and he became her son. She named him Moses and explained, “I drew him out of the water.”
aov_text: En toe die seuntjie groot geword het, bring sy hom na Farao se dogter; en hy het haar seun geword. En sy het hom Moses genoem en gesê: Ek het hom mos uit die water getrek.

kjv_text: And it came to pass in those days, when Moses was grown, that he went out unto his brethren, and looked on their burdens: and he spied an Egyptian smiting an Hebrew, one of his brethren.
bsb_text: One day, after Moses had grown up, he went out to his own people and observed their hard labor. He saw an Egyptian beating a Hebrew, one of his own people.
aov_text: En in dié dae toe Moses al groot was, het hy na sy broers uitgegaan en hulle harde arbeid aangesien. En hy het gesien hoe ’n Egiptiese man ’n Hebreeuse man, een uit sy broers, slaan.

kjv_text: And he looked this way and that way, and when he saw that there was no man, he slew the Egyptian, and hid him in the sand.
bsb_text: After looking this way and that and seeing no one, he struck down the Egyptian and hid his body in the sand.
aov_text: En hy het hierheen en daarheen gekyk, en toe hy sien dat daar niemand was nie, het hy die Egiptenaar doodgeslaan en hom in die sand begrawe.

kjv_text: And when he went out the second day, behold, two men of the Hebrews strove together: and he said to him that did the wrong, Wherefore smitest thou thy fellow?
bsb_text: The next day Moses went out and saw two Hebrews fighting. He asked the one in the wrong, “Why are you attacking your companion?”
aov_text: Die volgende dag het hy weer uitgegaan, en daar was twee Hebreeuse manne wat met mekaar veg. Hy vra toe vir die een wat ongelyk gehad het: Waarom slaan jy jou naaste?

kjv_text: And he said, Who made thee a prince and a judge over us? intendest thou to kill me, as thou killedst the Egyptian? And Moses feared, and said, Surely this thing is known.
bsb_text: But the man replied, “Who made you ruler and judge over us? Are you planning to kill me as you killed the Egyptian?” Then Moses was afraid and thought, “This thing I have done has surely become known.”
aov_text: En hy antwoord: Wie het jou as owerste en regter oor ons aangestel? Dink jy om my dood te slaan soos jy die Egiptenaar omgebring het? En Moses het gevrees en gesê: Waarlik, die saak het bekend geword!

kjv_text: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing, he sought to slay Moses. But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh, and dwelt in the land of Midian: and he sat down by a well.
bsb_text: When Pharaoh heard about this matter, he sought to kill Moses. But Moses fled from Pharaoh and settled in the land of Midian, where he sat down beside a well.
aov_text: En toe Farao van dié saak hoor, het hy probeer om Moses dood te maak. Maar Moses het van Farao af weggevlug en in die land Mídian gaan woon. En hy het by ’n put gesit.

kjv_text: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters: and they came and drew water, and filled the troughs to water their father's flock.
bsb_text: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters, and they came to draw water and fill the troughs to water their father’s flock.
aov_text: En die priester van Mídian het sewe dogters gehad: dié het gekom om te put en die drinkbakke vol te maak om hulle vader se kleinvee te laat drink.

kjv_text: And the shepherds came and drove them away: but Moses stood up and helped them, and watered their flock.
bsb_text: And when some shepherds came along and drove them away, Moses rose up to help them and watered their flock.
aov_text: Maar die veewagters het gekom en hulle weggedrywe. Toe staan Moses op en help hulle en laat hulle vee drink.

kjv_text: And when they came to Reuel their father, he said, How is it that ye are come so soon to day?
bsb_text: When the daughters returned to their father Reuel, he asked them, “Why have you returned so early today?”
aov_text: En toe hulle by hul vader Réhuel kom, sê hy: Waarom kom julle vandag so gou?

kjv_text: And they said, An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds, and also drew water enough for us, and watered the flock.
bsb_text: “An Egyptian rescued us from the shepherds,” they replied. “He even drew water for us and watered the flock.”
aov_text: En hulle antwoord: ’n Egiptiese man het ons uit die hand van die veewagters verlos; en hy het ook volop vir ons geput en die vee laat drink.

kjv_text: And he said unto his daughters, And where is he? why is it that ye have left the man? call him, that he may eat bread.
bsb_text: “So where is he?” their father asked. “Why did you leave the man behind? Invite him to have something to eat.”
aov_text: Daarop sê hy vir sy dogters: En waar is hy? Waarom het julle die man dan daar laat staan? Roep hom, dat hy brood kan eet.

kjv_text: And Moses was content to dwell with the man: and he gave Moses Zipporah his daughter.
bsb_text: Moses agreed to stay with the man, and he gave his daughter Zipporah to Moses in marriage.
aov_text: En Moses het ingewillig om by die man te bly, en hy het aan Moses sy dogter Sippóra gegee.

kjv_text: And she bare him a son, and he called his name Gershom: for he said, I have been a stranger in a strange land.
bsb_text: And she gave birth to a son, and Moses named him Gershom, saying, “I have become a foreigner in a foreign land.”
aov_text: En toe sy ’n seun baar, het hy hom Gersom genoem. Want hy het gesê: Ek het ’n vreemdeling in ’n vreemde land geword.

kjv_text: And it came to pass in process of time, that the king of Egypt died: and the children of Israel sighed by reason of the bondage, and they cried, and their cry came up unto God by reason of the bondage.
bsb_text: After a long time, the king of Egypt died. The Israelites groaned and cried out under their burden of slavery, and their cry for deliverance from bondage ascended to God.
aov_text: En in daardie lang tyd het die koning van Egipte gesterwe. En die kinders van Israel het gesug en geweeklaag vanweë die slawerny. En hulle geroep om hulp oor hulle slawerny het opgeklim tot God.

kjv_text: And God heard their groaning, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.
bsb_text: So God heard their groaning, and He remembered His covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
aov_text: En God het hulle gekerm gehoor, en God het gedink aan sy verbond met Abraham, met Isak en met Jakob.

kjv_text: And God looked upon the children of Israel, and God had respect unto them.
bsb_text: God saw the Israelites and took notice.
aov_text: En God het die kinders van Israel aangesien, en God het hulle geken.

kjv_text: Now Moses kept the flock of Jethro his father in law, the priest of Midian: and he led the flock to the backside of the desert, and came to the mountain of God, even to Horeb.
bsb_text: Meanwhile, Moses was shepherding the flock of his father-in-law Jethro, the priest of Midian. He led the flock to the far side of the wilderness and came to Horeb, the mountain of God.
aov_text: EN Moses het die kleinvee opgepas van sy skoonvader Jetro, die priester van Mídian. En toe hy die kleinvee agter die woestyn gedryf het, kom hy by die berg van God, by Horeb.

kjv_text: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush: and he looked, and, behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.
bsb_text: There the angel of the LORD appeared to him in a blazing fire from within a bush. Moses saw the bush ablaze with fire, but it was not consumed.
aov_text: Daarop verskyn die Engel van die HERE aan hom in ’n vuurvlam uit ’n doringbos. En toe hy weer sien, brand die doringbos in die vuur, maar die doringbos word nie verteer nie!

kjv_text: And Moses said, I will now turn aside, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burnt.
bsb_text: So Moses thought, “I must go over and see this marvelous sight. Why is the bush not burning up?”
aov_text: En Moses sê: Laat ek tog nader gaan en hierdie groot verskynsel bekyk, waarom die doringbos nie verbrand nie.

kjv_text: And when the LORD saw that he turned aside to see, God called unto him out of the midst of the bush, and said, Moses, Moses. And he said, Here am I.
bsb_text: When the LORD saw that he had gone over to look, God called out to him from within the bush, “Moses, Moses!” “Here I am,” he answered.
aov_text: Toe die HERE sien dat hy nuuskierig nader kom, roep God na hom uit die doringbos en sê: Moses, Moses! En hy antwoord: Hier is ek.

kjv_text: And he said, Draw not nigh hither: put off thy shoes from off thy feet, for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground.
bsb_text: “Do not come any closer,” God said. “Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy ground.”
aov_text: En Hy sê: Moenie nader kom nie. Trek jou skoene van jou voete af, want die plek waar jy op staan, is heilige grond.

kjv_text: Moreover he said, I am the God of thy father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. And Moses hid his face; for he was afraid to look upon God.
bsb_text: Then He said, “I am the God of your father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.” At this, Moses hid his face, for he was afraid to look at God.
aov_text: Verder sê Hy: Ek is die God van jou vader, die God van Abraham, die God van Isak en die God van Jakob. Toe het Moses sy aangesig verberg, want hy was bevrees om God aan te sien.

kjv_text: And the LORD said, I have surely seen the affliction of my people which are in Egypt, and have heard their cry by reason of their taskmasters; for I know their sorrows;
bsb_text: The LORD said, “I have indeed seen the affliction of My people in Egypt. I have heard them crying out because of their oppressors, and I am aware of their sufferings.
aov_text: En die HERE sê: Ek het duidelik gesien die ellende van my volk wat in Egipte is; en Ek het hulle jammerklagte oor hulle drywers gehoor, ja, Ek ken hulle smarte.

kjv_text: And I am come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land unto a good land and a large, unto a land flowing with milk and honey; unto the place of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites.
bsb_text: I have come down to rescue them from the hand of the Egyptians and to bring them up out of that land to a good and spacious land, a land flowing with milk and honey—the home of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
aov_text: Daarom het Ek neergedaal om hulle uit die hand van die Egiptenaars te verlos en hulle te laat optrek uit daardie land na ’n goeie en wye land, na ’n land wat oorloop van melk en heuning, na die woonplek van die Kanaäniete en Hetiete en Amoriete en Feresiete en Hewiete en Jebusiete.

kjv_text: Now therefore, behold, the cry of the children of Israel is come unto me: and I have also seen the oppression wherewith the Egyptians oppress them.
bsb_text: And now the cry of the Israelites has reached Me, and I have seen how severely the Egyptians are oppressing them.
aov_text: En nou, kyk, die jammerklagte van die kinders van Israel het tot by My gekom. Ook het Ek die verdrukking gesien waarmee die Egiptenaars hulle verdruk.

kjv_text: Come now therefore, and I will send thee unto Pharaoh, that thou mayest bring forth my people the children of Israel out of Egypt.
bsb_text: Therefore, go! I am sending you to Pharaoh to bring My people the Israelites out of Egypt.”
aov_text: Gaan dan nou heen, dat Ek jou na Farao kan stuur; en lei my volk, die kinders van Israel, uit Egipte uit.

kjv_text: And Moses said unto God, Who am I, that I should go unto Pharaoh, and that I should bring forth the children of Israel out of Egypt?
bsb_text: But Moses asked God, “Who am I, that I should go to Pharaoh and bring the Israelites out of Egypt?”
aov_text: Maar Moses het tot God gespreek: Wie is ek, dat ek na Farao sou gaan en dat ek die kinders van Israel uit Egipte sou lei?

kjv_text: And he said, Certainly I will be with thee; and this shall be a token unto thee, that I have sent thee: When thou hast brought forth the people out of Egypt, ye shall serve God upon this mountain.
bsb_text: “I will surely be with you,” God said, “and this will be the sign to you that I have sent you: When you have brought the people out of Egypt, all of you will worship God on this mountain.”
aov_text: En Hy antwoord: Ek sal met jou wees, en dit sal vir jou ’n teken wees dat Ek jou gestuur het: As jy die volk uit Egipte gelei het, sal julle op hierdie berg God dien.

kjv_text: And Moses said unto God, Behold, when I come unto the children of Israel, and shall say unto them, The God of your fathers hath sent me unto you; and they shall say to me, What is his name? what shall I say unto them?
bsb_text: Then Moses asked God, “Suppose I go to the Israelites and say to them, ‘The God of your fathers has sent me to you,’ and they ask me, ‘What is His name?’ What should I tell them?”
aov_text: Hierop het Moses tot God gespreek: Maar as ek by die kinders van Israel kom en aan hulle sê: Die God van julle vaders het my na julle gestuur, en hulle my vra: Hoe is sy naam?—wat moet ek hulle antwoord?

kjv_text: And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM: and he said, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, I AM hath sent me unto you.
bsb_text: God said to Moses, “I AM WHO I AM. This is what you are to say to the Israelites: ‘I AM has sent me to you.’”
aov_text: En God sê vir Moses: EK IS WAT EK IS. Ook sê Hy: So moet jy die kinders van Israel antwoord: EK IS het my na julle gestuur.

kjv_text: And God said moreover unto Moses, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, The LORD God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath sent me unto you: this is my name for ever, and this is my memorial unto all generations.
bsb_text: God also told Moses, “Say to the Israelites, ‘The LORD, the God of your fathers—the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob—has sent me to you.’ This is My name forever, and this is how I am to be remembered in every generation.
aov_text: Toe sê God verder vir Moses: Dit moet jy aan die kinders van Israel meedeel: Die HERE, die God van julle vaders, die God van Abraham, die God van Isak en die God van Jakob, het my na julle gestuur. Dit is my Naam vir ewig, en dit is my gedenknaam van geslag tot geslag.

kjv_text: Go, and gather the elders of Israel together, and say unto them, The LORD God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, appeared unto me, saying, I have surely visited you, and seen that which is done to you in Egypt:
bsb_text: Go, assemble the elders of Israel and say to them, ‘The LORD, the God of your fathers—the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—has appeared to me and said: I have surely attended to you and have seen what has been done to you in Egypt.
aov_text: Gaan heen en versamel die oudstes van Israel en sê vir hulle: Die HERE, die God van julle vaders, het aan my verskyn, die God van Abraham, Isak en Jakob, en het gesê: Ek het terdeë ag gegee op julle en op wat julle in Egipte aangedoen is.

kjv_text: And I have said, I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt unto the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, unto a land flowing with milk and honey.
bsb_text: And I have promised to bring you up out of your affliction in Egypt, into the land of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites—a land flowing with milk and honey.’
aov_text: Daarom het Ek besluit: Ek wil julle uit die ellende van Egipte laat optrek na die land van die Kanaäniete en Hetiete en Amoriete en Feresiete en Hewiete en Jebusiete, na ’n land wat oorloop van melk en heuning.

kjv_text: And they shall hearken to thy voice: and thou shalt come, thou and the elders of Israel, unto the king of Egypt, and ye shall say unto him, The LORD God of the Hebrews hath met with us: and now let us go, we beseech thee, three days' journey into the wilderness, that we may sacrifice to the LORD our God.
bsb_text: The elders of Israel will listen to what you say, and you must go with them to the king of Egypt and tell him, ‘The LORD, the God of the Hebrews, has met with us. Now please let us take a three-day journey into the wilderness, so that we may sacrifice to the LORD our God.’
aov_text: En hulle sal na jou luister. Dan moet jy met die oudstes van Israel na die koning van Egipte gaan, en julle moet vir hom sê: Die HERE, die God van die Hebreërs, het ons ontmoet; laat ons dan nou tog drie dagreise ver die woestyn intrek en aan die HERE, onse God, offer.

kjv_text: And I am sure that the king of Egypt will not let you go, no, not by a mighty hand.
bsb_text: But I know that the king of Egypt will not allow you to go unless a mighty hand compels him.
aov_text: Maar Ek weet dat die koning van Egipte julle nie sal laat gaan nie, ook nie deur ’n sterke hand nie.

kjv_text: And I will stretch out my hand, and smite Egypt with all my wonders which I will do in the midst thereof: and after that he will let you go.
bsb_text: So I will stretch out My hand and strike the Egyptians with all the wonders I will perform among them. And after that, he will release you.
aov_text: En Ek sal my hand uitstrek en Egipte met al my wonders teister wat Ek daarin sal doen; en daarna sal hy julle laat trek.

kjv_text: And I will give this people favour in the sight of the Egyptians: and it shall come to pass, that, when ye go, ye shall not go empty:
bsb_text: And I will grant this people such favor in the sight of the Egyptians that when you leave, you will not go away empty-handed.
aov_text: En Ek sal aan hierdie volk guns verleen in die oë van die Egiptenaars; en as julle dan trek, moet julle nie met leë hande trek nie,

kjv_text: But every woman shall borrow of her neighbour, and of her that sojourneth in her house, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment: and ye shall put them upon your sons, and upon your daughters; and ye shall spoil the Egyptians.
bsb_text: Every woman shall ask her neighbor and any woman staying in her house for silver and gold jewelry and clothing, and you will put them on your sons and daughters. So you will plunder the Egyptians.”
aov_text: maar elke vrou moet van haar buurvrou en van haar wat in haar huis vertoef, silwer- en goue voorwerpe en klere eis. En julle moet dit op julle seuns en dogters sit, en so Egipte berowe.

kjv_text: And Moses answered and said, But, behold, they will not believe me, nor hearken unto my voice: for they will say, The LORD hath not appeared unto thee.
bsb_text: Then Moses answered, “What if they do not believe me or listen to my voice? For they may say, ‘The LORD has not appeared to you.’”
aov_text: TOE antwoord Moses en sê: Maar as hulle my nie glo en na my stem nie luister nie, maar sê: Die HERE het nie aan jou verskyn nie?

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto him, What is that in thine hand? And he said, A rod.
bsb_text: And the LORD asked him, “What is that in your hand?” “A staff,” he replied.
aov_text: Daarop vra die HERE vir hom: Wat is daar in jou hand? En hy antwoord: ’n Staf.

kjv_text: And he said, Cast it on the ground. And he cast it on the ground, and it became a serpent; and Moses fled from before it.
bsb_text: “Throw it on the ground,” said the LORD. So Moses threw it on the ground, and it became a snake, and he ran from it.
aov_text: En Hy sê: Gooi dit op die grond. Toe gooi hy dit op die grond, en dit het ’n slang geword; en Moses het daarvoor gevlug.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Put forth thine hand, and take it by the tail. And he put forth his hand, and caught it, and it became a rod in his hand:
bsb_text: “Stretch out your hand and grab it by the tail,” the LORD said to Moses, who reached out his hand and caught the snake, and it turned back into a staff in his hand.
aov_text: Toe sê die HERE vir Moses: Steek jou hand uit en gryp dit aan die stert. Hierop het hy sy hand uitgesteek en dit gegryp, en dit het ’n staf in sy hand geword—

kjv_text: That they may believe that the LORD God of their fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath appeared unto thee.
bsb_text: “This is so that they may believe that the LORD, the God of their fathers—the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob—has appeared to you.”
aov_text: sodat hulle kan glo dat die HERE, die God van hulle vaders, die God van Abraham, die God van Isak en die God van Jakob, aan jou verskyn het.

kjv_text: And the LORD said furthermore unto him, Put now thine hand into thy bosom. And he put his hand into his bosom: and when he took it out, behold, his hand was leprous as snow.
bsb_text: Furthermore, the LORD said to Moses, “Put your hand inside your cloak.” So he put his hand inside his cloak, and when he took it out, his hand was leprous, white as snow.
aov_text: En die HERE het verder vir hom gesê: Steek tog jou hand in jou boesem. En hy het sy hand in sy boesem gesteek; en toe hy dit uittrek, was sy hand melaats, soos sneeu!

kjv_text: And he said, Put thine hand into thy bosom again. And he put his hand into his bosom again; and plucked it out of his bosom, and, behold, it was turned again as his other flesh.
bsb_text: “Put your hand back inside your cloak,” said the LORD. So Moses put his hand back inside his cloak, and when he took it out, it was restored, like the rest of his skin.
aov_text: En Hy sê: Steek jou hand weer in jou boesem. En hy het sy hand weer in sy boesem gesteek; en toe hy dit uit sy boesem uittrek, was dit weer soos sy ander vlees!

kjv_text: And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe thee, neither hearken to the voice of the first sign, that they will believe the voice of the latter sign.
bsb_text: And the LORD said, “If they refuse to believe you or heed the witness of the first sign, they may believe that of the second.
aov_text: En as hulle jou nie glo en aan die eerste teken geen gehoor gee nie, dan sal hulle die laaste teken glo.

kjv_text: And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe also these two signs, neither hearken unto thy voice, that thou shalt take of the water of the river, and pour it upon the dry land: and the water which thou takest out of the river shall become blood upon the dry land.
bsb_text: But if they do not believe even these two signs or listen to your voice, take some water from the Nile and pour it on the dry ground. Then the water you take from the Nile will become blood on the ground.”
aov_text: En as hulle ook hierdie twee tekens nie glo en na jou stem nie luister nie, neem dan van die Nyl se water en giet dit op die droë grond uit; dan sal die water wat jy uit die Nyl neem, op die droë grond bloed word.

kjv_text: And Moses said unto the LORD, O my LORD, I am not eloquent, neither heretofore, nor since thou hast spoken unto thy servant: but I am slow of speech, and of a slow tongue.
bsb_text: “Please, Lord,” Moses replied, “I have never been eloquent, neither in the past nor since You have spoken to Your servant, for I am slow of speech and tongue.”
aov_text: Toe sê Moses aan die HERE: Ag, Here, ek is nie ’n man van woorde nie—van gister of van eergister of vandat U met u kneg gespreek het nie; want ek is swaar van mond en swaar van tong.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto him, Who hath made man's mouth? or who maketh the dumb, or deaf, or the seeing, or the blind? have not I the LORD?
bsb_text: And the LORD said to him, “Who gave man his mouth? Or who makes the mute or the deaf, the sighted or the blind? Is it not I, the LORD?
aov_text: En die HERE antwoord hom: Wie het vir die mens die mond gemaak, of wie maak stom of doof, of siende of blind? Is dit nie Ek, die HERE, nie?

kjv_text: Now therefore go, and I will be with thy mouth, and teach thee what thou shalt say.
bsb_text: Now go! I will help you as you speak, and I will teach you what to say.”
aov_text: Gaan dan nou heen, en Ek sal met jou mond wees en jou leer wat jy moet sê.

kjv_text: And he said, O my LORD, send, I pray thee, by the hand of him whom thou wilt send.
bsb_text: But Moses replied, “Please, Lord, send someone else.”
aov_text: Maar hy sê: Ag, Here, stuur tog deur wie U wil stuur.

kjv_text: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Moses, and he said, Is not Aaron the Levite thy brother? I know that he can speak well. And also, behold, he cometh forth to meet thee: and when he seeth thee, he will be glad in his heart.
bsb_text: Then the anger of the LORD burned against Moses, and He said, “Is not Aaron the Levite your brother? I know that he can speak well, and he is now on his way to meet you. When he sees you, he will be glad in his heart.
aov_text: Toe ontvlam die toorn van die HERE teen Moses, en Hy sê: Is jou broer Aäron, die Leviet, nie daar nie? Ek weet dat hý goed kan praat. En hy gaan ook al uit om jou te ontmoet, en as hy jou sien, sal hy bly wees in sy hart.

kjv_text: And thou shalt speak unto him, and put words in his mouth: and I will be with thy mouth, and with his mouth, and will teach you what ye shall do.
bsb_text: You are to speak to him and put the words in his mouth. I will help both of you to speak, and I will teach you what to do.
aov_text: Jy moet dan met hom spreek en die woorde in sy mond lê. En Ék sal met jou mond en sy mond wees en julle leer wat julle moet doen.

kjv_text: And he shall be thy spokesman unto the people: and he shall be, even he shall be to thee instead of a mouth, and thou shalt be to him instead of God.
bsb_text: He will speak to the people for you. He will be your spokesman, and it will be as if you were God to him.
aov_text: En hý moet vir jou met die volk spreek, en dan sal hy vir jou ’n mond wees en jy vir hom ’n god wees.

kjv_text: And thou shalt take this rod in thine hand, wherewith thou shalt do signs.
bsb_text: But take this staff in your hand so you can perform signs with it.”
aov_text: Neem dan hierdie staf in jou hand waarmee jy die tekens moet doen.

kjv_text: And Moses went and returned to Jethro his father in law, and said unto him, Let me go, I pray thee, and return unto my brethren which are in Egypt, and see whether they be yet alive. And Jethro said to Moses, Go in peace.
bsb_text: Then Moses went back to his father-in-law Jethro and said to him, “Please let me return to my brothers in Egypt to see if they are still alive.” “Go in peace,” Jethro replied.
aov_text: TOE gaan Moses weg en kom by sy skoonvader Jetro terug, en hy sê vir hom: Laat my tog trek en na my broers teruggaan wat in Egipte is, om te sien of hulle nog lewe. En Jetro sê vir Moses: Gaan in vrede.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Moses in Midian, Go, return into Egypt: for all the men are dead which sought thy life.
bsb_text: Now the LORD had said to Moses in Midian, “Go back to Egypt, for all the men who sought to kill you are dead.”
aov_text: Ook het die HERE vir Moses in Mídian gesê: Gaan heen, keer terug na Egipte; want al die manne wat jou lewe gesoek het, is dood.

kjv_text: And Moses took his wife and his sons, and set them upon an ass, and he returned to the land of Egypt: and Moses took the rod of God in his hand.
bsb_text: So Moses took his wife and sons, put them on a donkey, and headed back to Egypt. And he took the staff of God in his hand.
aov_text: Moses neem toe sy vrou en sy seuns en laat hulle op ’n esel ry, terug na Egipteland. Moses het ook die staf van God in sy hand geneem.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, When thou goest to return into Egypt, see that thou do all those wonders before Pharaoh, which I have put in thine hand: but I will harden his heart, that he shall not let the people go.
bsb_text: The LORD instructed Moses, “When you go back to Egypt, see that you perform before Pharaoh all the wonders that I have put within your power. But I will harden his heart so that he will not let the people go.
aov_text: En die HERE sê vir Moses: Nou dat jy wegtrek om na Egipte terug te gaan, kyk dat jy al die wonders voor Farao doen wat Ek in jou mag gestel het. Maar Ék sal sy hart verhard, sodat hy die volk nie sal laat trek nie.

kjv_text: And thou shalt say unto Pharaoh, Thus saith the LORD, Israel is my son, even my firstborn:
bsb_text: Then tell Pharaoh that this is what the LORD says: ‘Israel is My firstborn son,
aov_text: Dan moet jy vir Farao sê: So spreek die HERE: My eersgebore seun is Israel.

kjv_text: And I say unto thee, Let my son go, that he may serve me: and if thou refuse to let him go, behold, I will slay thy son, even thy firstborn.
bsb_text: and I told you to let My son go so that he may worship Me. But since you have refused to let him go, behold, I will kill your firstborn son!’”
aov_text: Daarom beveel Ek jou: Laat my seun trek, dat hy My kan dien. Maar jy het geweier om hom te laat trek. Kyk, Ek sal jou eersgebore seun laat sterwe.

kjv_text: And it came to pass by the way in the inn, that the LORD met him, and sought to kill him.
bsb_text: Now at a lodging place along the way, the LORD met Moses and was about to kill him.
aov_text: En op die pad in die herberg het die HERE hom teëgekom en wou hom doodmaak.

kjv_text: Then Zipporah took a sharp stone, and cut off the foreskin of her son, and cast it at his feet, and said, Surely a bloody husband art thou to me.
bsb_text: But Zipporah took a flint knife, cut off her son’s foreskin, and touched it to Moses’ feet. “Surely you are a bridegroom of blood to me,” she said.
aov_text: Toe neem Sippóra ’n skerp klip en sny die voorhuid van haar seun af en gooi dit voor sy voete en sê: Waarlik, jy is vir my ’n bloedbruidegom!

kjv_text: So he let him go: then she said, A bloody husband thou art, because of the circumcision.
bsb_text: So the LORD let him alone. (When she said, “bridegroom of blood,” she was referring to the circumcision.)
aov_text: En Hy het hom laat staan. Toe het sy gesê: Bloedbruidegom!—met die oog op die besnydenis.

kjv_text: And the LORD said to Aaron, Go into the wilderness to meet Moses. And he went, and met him in the mount of God, and kissed him.
bsb_text: Meanwhile, the LORD had said to Aaron, “Go and meet Moses in the wilderness.” So he went and met Moses at the mountain of God and kissed him.
aov_text: Die HERE het ook aan Aäron gesê: Loop Moses tegemoet in die woestyn. En hy het geloop en hom by die berg van God aangetref en hom gesoen.

kjv_text: And Moses told Aaron all the words of the LORD who had sent him, and all the signs which he had commanded him.
bsb_text: And Moses told Aaron everything the LORD had sent him to say, and all the signs He had commanded him to perform.
aov_text: Daarop vertel Moses aan Aäron al die woorde van die HERE waarmee Hy hom gestuur het, en al die tekens wat Hy hom beveel het.

kjv_text: And Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the children of Israel:
bsb_text: Then Moses and Aaron went and assembled all the elders of the Israelites,
aov_text: En Moses en Aäron het vertrek en al die oudstes van die kinders van Israel bymekaar laat kom;

kjv_text: And Aaron spake all the words which the LORD had spoken unto Moses, and did the signs in the sight of the people.
bsb_text: and Aaron relayed everything the LORD had said to Moses. And Moses performed the signs before the people,
aov_text: en Aäron het al die woorde gespreek wat die HERE aan Moses gesê het, en die tekens gedoen voor die oë van die volk.

kjv_text: And the people believed: and when they heard that the LORD had visited the children of Israel, and that he had looked upon their affliction, then they bowed their heads and worshipped.
bsb_text: and they believed. And when they heard that the LORD had attended to the Israelites and had seen their affliction, they bowed down and worshiped.
aov_text: En die volk het geglo. En toe hulle hoor dat die HERE op die kinders van Israel ag gegee en hulle ellende aangesien het, het hulle in aanbidding neergebuig.

kjv_text: And afterward Moses and Aaron went in, and told Pharaoh, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Let my people go, that they may hold a feast unto me in the wilderness.
bsb_text: After that, Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh and said, “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Let My people go, so that they may hold a feast to Me in the wilderness.’”
aov_text: EN daarna gaan Moses en Aäron en sê vir Farao: So spreek die HERE, die God van Israel: Laat my volk trek, dat hulle vir My ’n fees kan hou in die woestyn.

kjv_text: And Pharaoh said, Who is the LORD, that I should obey his voice to let Israel go? I know not the LORD, neither will I let Israel go.
bsb_text: But Pharaoh replied, “Who is the LORD that I should obey His voice and let Israel go? I do not know the LORD, and I will not let Israel go.”
aov_text: Maar Farao antwoord: Wie is die HERE na wie se stem ek moet luister om Israel te laat trek? Ek ken die HERE nie, en ek sal Israel ook nie laat trek nie.

kjv_text: And they said, The God of the Hebrews hath met with us: let us go, we pray thee, three days' journey into the desert, and sacrifice unto the LORD our God; lest he fall upon us with pestilence, or with the sword.
bsb_text: “The God of the Hebrews has met with us,” they answered. “Please let us go on a three-day journey into the wilderness to sacrifice to the LORD our God, or He may strike us with plagues or with the sword.”
aov_text: Toe sê hulle: Die God van die Hebreërs het ons ontmoet; laat ons tog drie dagreise ver die woestyn intrek en aan die HERE onse God offer, sodat Hy ons nie tref met die pes of die swaard nie.

kjv_text: And the king of Egypt said unto them, Wherefore do ye, Moses and Aaron, let the people from their works? get you unto your burdens.
bsb_text: But the king of Egypt said to them, “Moses and Aaron, why do you draw the people away from their work? Get back to your labor!”
aov_text: Maar die koning van Egipte antwoord hulle: Moses en Aäron, waarom hou julle die volk van hulle werk af? Loop na julle werk toe.

kjv_text: And Pharaoh said, Behold, the people of the land now are many, and ye make them rest from their burdens.
bsb_text: Pharaoh also said, “Look, the people of the land are now numerous, and you would be stopping them from their labor.”
aov_text: Verder het Farao gesê: Kyk, die volk van die land is alreeds baie; en julle wil hulle laat ophou met hulle werk?

kjv_text: And Pharaoh commanded the same day the taskmasters of the people, and their officers, saying,
bsb_text: That same day Pharaoh commanded the taskmasters of the people and their foremen:
aov_text: Daarom het Farao dieselfde dag aan die drywers onder die volk en die opsigters bevel gegee en gesê:

kjv_text: Ye shall no more give the people straw to make brick, as heretofore: let them go and gather straw for themselves.
bsb_text: “You shall no longer supply the people with straw for making bricks. They must go and gather their own straw.
aov_text: Julle moet die volk geen strooi meer gee om bakstene te maak soos gister en eergister nie. Laat hulle self gaan en vir hulle strooi versamel.

kjv_text: And the tale of the bricks, which they did make heretofore, ye shall lay upon them; ye shall not diminish ought thereof: for they be idle; therefore they cry, saying, Let us go and sacrifice to our God.
bsb_text: But require of them the same quota of bricks as before; do not reduce it. For they are lazy; that is why they are crying out, ‘Let us go and sacrifice to our God.’
aov_text: Maar die hoeveelheid bakstene wat hulle gister en eergister gemaak het, moet julle hulle oplê en niks daarvan verminder nie; want hulle is lui. Daarom roep hulle en sê: Laat ons gaan, laat ons offer aan onse God!

kjv_text: Let there more work be laid upon the men, that they may labour therein; and let them not regard vain words.
bsb_text: Make the work harder on the men so they will be occupied and pay no attention to these lies.”
aov_text: Laat die werk swaar druk op die manne, dat hulle daarmee besig kan wees en nie op leuenagtige woorde let nie.

kjv_text: And the taskmasters of the people went out, and their officers, and they spake to the people, saying, Thus saith Pharaoh, I will not give you straw.
bsb_text: So the taskmasters and foremen of the people went out and said to them, “This is what Pharaoh says: ‘I am no longer giving you straw.
aov_text: Toe het die drywers van die volk en die opsigters uitgegaan en tot die volk gespreek en gesê: So spreek Farao: Ek gee julle geen strooi nie.

kjv_text: Go ye, get you straw where ye can find it: yet not ought of your work shall be diminished.
bsb_text: Go and get your own straw wherever you can find it; but your workload will in no way be reduced.’”
aov_text: Loop haal self vir julle strooi waar julle dit kan kry; maar van julle werk word niks verminder nie.

kjv_text: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble instead of straw.
bsb_text: So the people scattered all over the land of Egypt to gather stubble for straw.
aov_text: Toe het die volk in die hele Egipteland rondgegaan om stoppels te versamel vir strooi.

kjv_text: And the taskmasters hasted them, saying, Fulfil your works, your daily tasks, as when there was straw.
bsb_text: The taskmasters kept pressing them, saying, “Fulfill your quota each day, just as you did when straw was provided.”
aov_text: En die drywers het aangedryf en gesê: Voltooi julle werk volgens die eis van elke dag net soos toe daar strooi was.

kjv_text: And the officers of the children of Israel, which Pharaoh's taskmasters had set over them, were beaten, and demanded, Wherefore have ye not fulfilled your task in making brick both yesterday and to day, as heretofore?
bsb_text: Then the Israelite foremen, whom Pharaoh’s taskmasters had set over the people, were beaten and asked, “Why have you not fulfilled your quota of bricks yesterday or today, as you did before?”
aov_text: En die opsigters van die kinders van Israel wat Farao se drywers oor hulle aangestel het, het slae gekry, met die woorde: Waarom het julle gister en vandag nie soos tevore julle bepaalde werk, om stene te maak, volbring nie?

kjv_text: Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried unto Pharaoh, saying, Wherefore dealest thou thus with thy servants?
bsb_text: So the Israelite foremen went and appealed to Pharaoh: “Why are you treating your servants this way?
aov_text: Daarom het die opsigters van die kinders van Israel gegaan, en hulle het geweeklaag by Farao en gesê: Waarom maak u so met u dienaars?

kjv_text: There is no straw given unto thy servants, and they say to us, Make brick: and, behold, thy servants are beaten; but the fault is in thine own people.
bsb_text: No straw has been given to your servants, yet we are told, ‘Make bricks!’ Look, your servants are being beaten, but the fault is with your own people.”
aov_text: Aan u dienaars word geen strooi gegee nie, en hulle sê vir ons: Maak bakstene! En kyk, u dienaars word geslaan, maar die skuld lê by u volk.

kjv_text: But he said, Ye are idle, ye are idle: therefore ye say, Let us go and do sacrifice to the LORD.
bsb_text: “You are slackers!” Pharaoh replied. “Slackers! That is why you keep saying, ‘Let us go and sacrifice to the LORD.’
aov_text: Maar hy het geantwoord: Lui is julle, lui! Daarom sê julle: Laat ons gaan, laat ons aan die HERE offer.

kjv_text: Go therefore now, and work; for there shall no straw be given you, yet shall ye deliver the tale of bricks.
bsb_text: Now get to work. You will be given no straw, yet you must deliver the full quota of bricks.”
aov_text: Nou dan, loop werk! Maar strooi sal julle nie gegee word nie. Ewenwel moet julle die hoeveelheid bakstene aflewer.

kjv_text: And the officers of the children of Israel did see that they were in evil case, after it was said, Ye shall not minish ought from your bricks of your daily task.
bsb_text: The Israelite foremen realized they were in trouble when they were told, “You must not reduce your daily quota of bricks.”
aov_text: Toe sien die opsigters van die kinders van Israel dat dit sleg met hulle staan, omdat daar gesê is: Julle mag jul bakstene, volgens die eis van elke dag, nie verminder nie.

kjv_text: And they met Moses and Aaron, who stood in the way, as they came forth from Pharaoh:
bsb_text: When they left Pharaoh, they confronted Moses and Aaron, who stood waiting to meet them.
aov_text: En hulle het Moses en Aäron teëgekom, wat daar gestaan het om hulle te ontmoet as hulle van Farao af weggaan,

kjv_text: And they said unto them, The LORD look upon you, and judge; because ye have made our savour to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of his servants, to put a sword in their hand to slay us.
bsb_text: “May the LORD look upon you and judge you,” the foremen said, “for you have made us a stench before Pharaoh and his officials; you have placed in their hand a sword to kill us!”
aov_text: en het vir hulle gesê: Mag die HERE op julle let en oordeel, omdat julle ons gehaat gemaak het in die oë van Farao en in die oë van sy dienaars, sodat julle ’n swaard in hulle hand gegee het om ons om te bring.

kjv_text: And Moses returned unto the LORD, and said, LORD, wherefore hast thou so evil entreated this people? why is it that thou hast sent me?
bsb_text: So Moses returned to the LORD and asked, “Lord, why have You brought trouble upon this people? Is this why You sent me?
aov_text: TOE gaan Moses weer na die HERE en sê: Here, waarom het U hierdie volk kwaad aangedoen? Waarom het U my tog gestuur?

kjv_text: For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in thy name, he hath done evil to this people; neither hast thou delivered thy people at all.
bsb_text: Ever since I went to Pharaoh to speak in Your name, he has brought trouble on this people, and You have not delivered Your people in any way.”
aov_text: Want vandat ek na Farao gegaan het om in u Naam te spreek, het hy hierdie volk mishandel, en U het u volk glad nie verlos nie.

kjv_text: Then the LORD said unto Moses, Now shalt thou see what I will do to Pharaoh: for with a strong hand shall he let them go, and with a strong hand shall he drive them out of his land.
bsb_text: But the LORD said to Moses, “Now you will see what I will do to Pharaoh, for because of My mighty hand he will let the people go; because of My strong hand he will drive them out of his land.”
aov_text: Daarop het die HERE Moses geantwoord: Nou sal jy sien wat Ek Farao sal aandoen. Want deur ’n sterke hand sal hy hulle laat trek, ja, deur ’n sterke hand gedwing, sal hy hulle uit sy land uitdrywe.

kjv_text: And God spake unto Moses, and said unto him, I am the LORD:
bsb_text: God also told Moses, “I am the LORD.
aov_text: VERDER het God met Moses gespreek en vir hom gesê: Ek is die HERE.

kjv_text: And I appeared unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, by the name of God Almighty, but by my name JEHOVAH was I not known to them.
bsb_text: I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob as God Almighty, but by My name the LORD I did not make Myself known to them.
aov_text: En Ek het aan Abraham, aan Isak en aan Jakob verskyn as God, die Almagtige, maar met my Naam HERE het Ek My nie aan hulle bekend gemaak nie.

kjv_text: And I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their pilgrimage, wherein they were strangers.
bsb_text: I also established My covenant with them to give them the land of Canaan, the land where they lived as foreigners.
aov_text: Ook het Ek my verbond met hulle opgerig om hulle die land Kanaän te gee, die land van hulle vreemdelingskap waarin hulle vertoef het;

kjv_text: And I have also heard the groaning of the children of Israel, whom the Egyptians keep in bondage; and I have remembered my covenant.
bsb_text: Furthermore, I have heard the groaning of the Israelites, whom the Egyptians are enslaving, and I have remembered My covenant.
aov_text: en Ék het ook gehoor die gekerm van die kinders van Israel wat deur die Egiptenaars in slawerny gehou word, en Ek het aan my verbond gedink.

kjv_text: Wherefore say unto the children of Israel, I am the LORD, and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and I will rid you out of their bondage, and I will redeem you with a stretched out arm, and with great judgments:
bsb_text: Therefore tell the Israelites: ‘I am the LORD, and I will bring you out from under the yoke of the Egyptians and deliver you from their bondage. I will redeem you with an outstretched arm and with mighty acts of judgment.
aov_text: Daarom, sê aan die kinders van Israel: Ek is die HERE, en Ek sal julle onder die harde arbeid van die Egiptenaars uitlei en julle red uit hulle slawerny, en Ek sal julle verlos deur ’n uitgestrekte arm en deur groot strafgerigte;

kjv_text: And I will take you to me for a people, and I will be to you a God: and ye shall know that I am the LORD your God, which bringeth you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.
bsb_text: I will take you as My own people, and I will be your God. Then you will know that I am the LORD your God, who brought you out from under the yoke of the Egyptians.
aov_text: en Ek sal julle as my volk aanneem en vir julle ’n God wees. En julle sal erken dat Ek die HERE julle God is wat julle uitlei onder die harde arbeid van die Egiptenaars uit.

kjv_text: And I will bring you in unto the land, concerning the which I did swear to give it to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it you for an heritage: I am the LORD.
bsb_text: And I will bring you into the land that I swore to give to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. I will give it to you as a possession. I am the LORD!’”
aov_text: En Ek sal julle bring in die land waaromtrent Ek my hand opgehef het, om dit aan Abraham, aan Isak en aan Jakob te gee; en Ek sal dit aan julle as ’n besitting gee, Ek, die HERE.

kjv_text: And Moses spake so unto the children of Israel: but they hearkened not unto Moses for anguish of spirit, and for cruel bondage.
bsb_text: Moses relayed this message to the Israelites, but on account of their broken spirit and cruel bondage, they did not listen to him.
aov_text: Moses het toe so met die kinders van Israel gespreek, maar hulle het nie na Moses geluister nie, uit ongeduldigheid en weens die harde diens.

kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
bsb_text: So the LORD said to Moses,
aov_text: Verder het die HERE met Moses gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: Go in, speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.
bsb_text: “Go and tell Pharaoh king of Egypt to let the Israelites go out of his land.”
aov_text: Gaan spreek met Farao, die koning van Egipte, dat hy die kinders van Israel uit sy land moet laat uittrek.

kjv_text: And Moses spake before the LORD, saying, Behold, the children of Israel have not hearkened unto me; how then shall Pharaoh hear me, who am of uncircumcised lips?
bsb_text: But in the LORD’s presence Moses replied, “If the Israelites will not listen to me, then why would Pharaoh listen to me, since I am unskilled in speech?”
aov_text: Maar Moses het voor die aangesig van die HERE gespreek en gesê: As die kinders van Israel na my nie geluister het nie, hoe sal Farao dan na my luister terwyl ek onbesnede van lippe is?

kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, and gave them a charge unto the children of Israel, and unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.
bsb_text: Then the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron and gave them a charge concerning both the Israelites and Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the Israelites out of the land of Egypt.
aov_text: Daarop het die HERE met Moses en Aäron gespreek en hulle met ’n boodskap gestuur na die kinders van Israel en na Farao, die koning van Egipte, om die kinders van Israel uit Egipteland uit te lei.

kjv_text: These be the heads of their fathers' houses: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel; Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi: these be the families of Reuben.
bsb_text: These were the heads of their fathers’ houses: The sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel, were Hanoch and Pallu, Hezron and Carmi. These were the clans of Reuben.
aov_text: DIT is die hoofde van hulle families. Die seuns van Ruben, die eersgeborene van Israel: Henog en Pallu, Hesron en Karmi; dit is die geslagte van Ruben.

kjv_text: And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman: these are the families of Simeon.
bsb_text: The sons of Simeon were Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul, the son of a Canaanite woman. These were the clans of Simeon.
aov_text: En die seuns van Símeon: Jémuel en Jamin en Ohad en Jagin en Sohar en Saul, die seun van die Kanaänitiese vrou; dit is die geslagte van Símeon.

kjv_text: And these are the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari: and the years of the life of Levi were an hundred thirty and seven years.
bsb_text: These were the names of the sons of Levi according to their records: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari. Levi lived 137 years.
aov_text: En dit is die name van die seuns van Levi volgens hulle afstamming: Gerson en Kehat en Merári. En die lewensjare van Levi was honderd-sewen-en-dertig jaar.

kjv_text: The sons of Gershon; Libni, and Shimi, according to their families.
bsb_text: The sons of Gershon were Libni and Shimei, by their clans.
aov_text: Die seuns van Gerson: Libni en Símeï volgens hulle geslagte.

kjv_text: And the sons of Kohath; Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel: and the years of the life of Kohath were an hundred thirty and three years.
bsb_text: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel. Kohath lived 133 years.
aov_text: En die seuns van Kehat: Amram en Jishar en Hebron en Ússiël; en die lewensjare van Kehat was honderd-drie-en-dertig jaar.

kjv_text: And the sons of Merari; Mahali and Mushi: these are the families of Levi according to their generations.
bsb_text: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi. These were the clans of the Levites according to their records.
aov_text: En die seuns van Merári: Magli en Musi. Dit is die geslagte van Levi volgens hulle afstamming.

kjv_text: And Amram took him Jochebed his father's sister to wife; and she bare him Aaron and Moses: and the years of the life of Amram were an hundred and thirty and seven years.
bsb_text: And Amram married his father’s sister Jochebed, and she bore him Aaron and Moses. Amram lived 137 years.
aov_text: En Amram het Jogébed, sy tante, vir hom as vrou geneem, en sy het vir hom Aäron en Moses gebaar. En die lewensjare van Amram was honderd-sewen-en-dertig jaar.

kjv_text: And the sons of Izhar; Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.
bsb_text: The sons of Izhar were Korah, Nepheg, and Zichri.
aov_text: En die seuns van Jishar: Korag en Nefeg en Sigri.

kjv_text: And the sons of Uzziel; Mishael, and Elzaphan, and Zithri.
bsb_text: The sons of Uzziel were Mishael, Elzaphan, and Sithri.
aov_text: En die seuns van Ússiël: Mísael, Élsafan en Sitri.

kjv_text: And Aaron took him Elisheba, daughter of Amminadab, sister of Naashon, to wife; and she bare him Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
bsb_text: And Aaron married Elisheba, the daughter of Amminadab and sister of Nahshon, and she bore him Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
aov_text: En Aäron het Eliséba, die dogter van Ammínadab, die suster van Nagson, vir hom as vrou geneem; en sy het vir hom gebaar: Nadab en Abíhu, Eleásar en Ítamar.

kjv_text: And the sons of Korah; Assir, and Elkanah, and Abiasaph: these are the families of the Korhites.
bsb_text: The sons of Korah were Assir, Elkanah, and Abiasaph. These were the clans of the Korahites.
aov_text: En die seuns van Korag: Assir en Élkana en Abíasaf. Dit is die geslagte van die Koragiete.

kjv_text: And Eleazar Aaron's son took him one of the daughters of Putiel to wife; and she bare him Phinehas: these are the heads of the fathers of the Levites according to their families.
bsb_text: Aaron’s son Eleazar married one of the daughters of Putiel, and she bore him Phinehas. These were the heads of the Levite families by their clans.
aov_text: En Eleásar, die seun van Aäron, het vir hom een van die dogters van Pútiël as vrou geneem; en sy het vir hom Pínehas gebaar. Dit is die familiehoofde van die Leviete volgens hulle geslagte.

kjv_text: These are that Aaron and Moses, to whom the LORD said, Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies.
bsb_text: It was this Aaron and Moses to whom the LORD said, “Bring the Israelites out of the land of Egypt by their divisions.”
aov_text: Dit is Aäron en Moses aan wie die HERE gesê het: Lei die kinders van Israel uit Egipteland volgens hulle leërskare.

kjv_text: These are they which spake to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt: these are that Moses and Aaron.
bsb_text: Moses and Aaron were the ones who spoke to Pharaoh king of Egypt in order to bring the Israelites out of Egypt.
aov_text: Dit is hulle wat met Farao, die koning van Egipte, gespreek het om die kinders van Israel uit Egipte uit te lei. Dit is Moses en Aäron.
