bsb_text: so that it came between the camps of Egypt and Israel. The cloud was there in the darkness, but it lit up the night. So all night long neither camp went near the other.
aov_text: so het dit dan tussen die leër van die Egiptenaars en die leër van Israel in gekom. En die wolk was daar met die duisternis, en dit het die nag verlig, sodat die een nie naby die ander gekom het die hele nag deur nie.

kjv_text: And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea; and the LORD caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.
bsb_text: Then Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and all that night the LORD drove back the sea with a strong east wind that turned it into dry land. So the waters were divided,
aov_text: Toe steek Moses sy hand oor die see uit, en die HERE het deur ’n sterk oostewind die see laat wegvloei, die hele nag deur, en die see droog gemaak; en die waters is gekloof.

kjv_text: And the children of Israel went into the midst of the sea upon the dry ground: and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.
bsb_text: and the Israelites went through the sea on dry ground, with walls of water on their right and on their left.
aov_text: En die kinders van Israel het midde-in die see getrek op droë grond. En die waters was vir hulle ’n muur aan hul regter- en aan hul linkerkant.

kjv_text: And the Egyptians pursued, and went in after them to the midst of the sea, even all Pharaoh's horses, his chariots, and his horsemen.
bsb_text: And the Egyptians chased after them—all Pharaoh’s horses, chariots, and horsemen—and followed them into the sea.
aov_text: Toe het die Egiptenaars hulle gejaag en agter hulle aan getrek—al Farao se perde, sy strydwaens en sy ruiters—die see in.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, that in the morning watch the LORD looked unto the host of the Egyptians through the pillar of fire and of the cloud, and troubled the host of the Egyptians,
bsb_text: At morning watch, however, the LORD looked down on the army of the Egyptians from the pillar of fire and cloud, and He threw their camp into confusion.
aov_text: En in die môrewaak het die HERE, in die vuur- en wolkkolom, op die leër van die Egiptenaars afgekyk en die leër van die Egiptenaars in verwarring gebring.

kjv_text: And took off their chariot wheels, that they drave them heavily: so that the Egyptians said, Let us flee from the face of Israel; for the LORD fighteth for them against the Egyptians.
bsb_text: He caused their chariot wheels to wobble, so that they had difficulty driving. “Let us flee from the Israelites,” said the Egyptians, “for the LORD is fighting for them against Egypt!”
aov_text: En Hy het die wiele van hulle strydwaens laat insak en hulle met moeite laat voortgaan. Toe sê die Egiptenaars: Laat ons van Israel af wegvlug, want die HERE stry vir hulle teen die Egiptenaars.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Stretch out thine hand over the sea, that the waters may come again upon the Egyptians, upon their chariots, and upon their horsemen.
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand over the sea, so that the waters may flow back over the Egyptians and their chariots and horsemen.”
aov_text: Daarop sê die HERE vir Moses: Steek jou hand uit oor die see, dat die waters kan terugvloei oor die Egiptenaars, oor hulle strydwaens en oor hulle ruiters.

kjv_text: And Moses stretched forth his hand over the sea, and the sea returned to his strength when the morning appeared; and the Egyptians fled against it; and the LORD overthrew the Egyptians in the midst of the sea.
bsb_text: So Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and at daybreak the sea returned to its normal state. As the Egyptians were retreating, the LORD swept them into the sea.
aov_text: En Moses het sy hand oor die see uitgesteek, en die see het teen dagbreek in sy bedding teruggevloei, en die Egiptenaars het dit tegemoet gevlug. So het die HERE dan die Egiptenaars binne-in die see gestort.

kjv_text: And the waters returned, and covered the chariots, and the horsemen, and all the host of Pharaoh that came into the sea after them; there remained not so much as one of them.
bsb_text: The waters flowed back and covered the chariots and horsemen—the entire army of Pharaoh that had chased the Israelites into the sea. Not one of them survived.
aov_text: En toe die waters terugvloei, het hulle die strydwaens en die ruiters van Farao se hele leërmag wat agter hulle die see ingetrek het, oordek. Geeneen van hulle het oorgebly nie.

kjv_text: But the children of Israel walked upon dry land in the midst of the sea; and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.
bsb_text: But the Israelites had walked through the sea on dry ground, with walls of water on their right and on their left.
aov_text: Maar die kinders van Israel het binne-in die see op droë grond getrek. En die waters was vir hulle ’n muur aan hul regter- en aan hul linkerkant.

kjv_text: Thus the LORD saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead upon the sea shore.
bsb_text: That day the LORD saved Israel from the hand of the Egyptians, and Israel saw the Egyptians dead on the shore.
aov_text: So het die HERE Israel dan dié dag uit die hand van die Egiptenaars verlos. En Israel het die Egiptenaars dood gesien aan die kant van die see.

kjv_text: And Israel saw that great work which the LORD did upon the Egyptians: and the people feared the LORD, and believed the LORD, and his servant Moses.
bsb_text: When Israel saw the great power that the LORD had exercised over the Egyptians, the people feared the LORD and believed in Him and in His servant Moses.
aov_text: Ook het Israel die magtige daad gesien wat die HERE aan die Egiptenaars verrig het. Toe het die volk die HERE gevrees en geglo in die HERE en Moses, sy kneg.

kjv_text: Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song unto the LORD, and spake, saying, I will sing unto the LORD, for he hath triumphed gloriously: the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.
bsb_text: Then Moses and the Israelites sang this song to the LORD: “I will sing to the LORD, for He is highly exalted. The horse and rider He has thrown into the sea.
aov_text: TOE het Moses en die kinders van Israel hierdie lied tot eer van die HERE gesing; en dit is wat hulle gesê het: Ek wil sing tot eer van die HERE, want Hy is hoog verhewe. Die perd en sy ruiter het Hy in die see gewerp.

kjv_text: The LORD is my strength and song, and he is become my salvation: he is my God, and I will prepare him an habitation; my father's God, and I will exalt him.
bsb_text: The LORD is my strength and my song, and He has become my salvation. He is my God, and I will praise Him, my father’s God, and I will exalt Him.
aov_text: Die HERE is my krag en my psalm, en Hy het my tot heil geword. Hy is my God, Hom sal ek roem; die God van my vader, Hom sal ek verhef.

kjv_text: The LORD is a man of war: the LORD is his name.
bsb_text: The LORD is a warrior, the LORD is His name.
aov_text: Die HERE is ’n krygsman; HERE is sy naam.

kjv_text: Pharaoh's chariots and his host hath he cast into the sea: his chosen captains also are drowned in the Red sea.
bsb_text: Pharaoh’s chariots and army He has cast into the sea; the finest of his officers are drowned in the Red Sea.
aov_text: Hy het Farao se strydwaens en sy leërmag in die see gewerp. En sy beste vegsmanne het in die Skelfsee gesink.

kjv_text: The depths have covered them: they sank into the bottom as a stone.
bsb_text: The depths have covered them; they sank there like a stone.
aov_text: Die watervloede het hulle oordek. Hulle het in die kolke gesink soos ’n klip.

kjv_text: Thy right hand, O LORD, is become glorious in power: thy right hand, O LORD, hath dashed in pieces the enemy.
bsb_text: Your right hand, O LORD, is majestic in power; Your right hand, O LORD, has shattered the enemy.
aov_text: o HERE, u regterhand is verheerlik deur krag. U regterhand, o HERE, verpletter die vyand.

kjv_text: And in the greatness of thine excellency thou hast overthrown them that rose up against thee: thou sentest forth thy wrath, which consumed them as stubble.
bsb_text: You overthrew Your adversaries by Your great majesty. You unleashed Your burning wrath; it consumed them like stubble.
aov_text: En in u grote hoogheid werp U diegene neer wat teen U opstaan. U stuur u toorngloed uit: dit verteer hulle soos ’n stoppel.

kjv_text: And with the blast of thy nostrils the waters were gathered together, the floods stood upright as an heap, and the depths were congealed in the heart of the sea.
bsb_text: At the blast of Your nostrils the waters piled up; like a wall the currents stood firm; the depths congealed in the heart of the sea.
aov_text: En deur die geblaas van u neus het die waters hulle opgestapel, die strome het bly staan soos ’n wal, die watervloede het styf geword in die hart van die see.

kjv_text: The enemy said, I will pursue, I will overtake, I will divide the spoil; my lust shall be satisfied upon them; I will draw my sword, my hand shall destroy them.
bsb_text: The enemy declared, ‘I will pursue, I will overtake. I will divide the spoils; I will gorge myself on them. I will draw my sword; my hand will destroy them.’
aov_text: Die vyand het gesê: Ek sal agtervolg, inhaal, buit verdeel, my begeerte sal versadig word van hulle; ek sal my swaard trek, my hand sal hulle uitroei.

kjv_text: Thou didst blow with thy wind, the sea covered them: they sank as lead in the mighty waters.
bsb_text: But You blew with Your breath, and the sea covered them. They sank like lead in the mighty waters.
aov_text: U het met u asem geblaas: die see het hulle oordek; soos lood het hulle gesink in die geweldige waters.

kjv_text: Who is like unto thee, O LORD, among the gods? who is like thee, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?
bsb_text: Who among the gods is like You, O LORD? Who is like You—majestic in holiness, revered with praises, performing wonders?
aov_text: o HERE, wie is soos U onder die gode? Wie is soos U, verheerlik in heiligheid, gedug in roemryke dade, een wat wonders doen?

kjv_text: Thou stretchedst out thy right hand, the earth swallowed them.
bsb_text: You stretched out Your right hand, and the earth swallowed them up.
aov_text: U het u regterhand uitgestrek, die aarde het hulle verslind.

kjv_text: Thou in thy mercy hast led forth the people which thou hast redeemed: thou hast guided them in thy strength unto thy holy habitation.
bsb_text: With loving devotion You will lead the people You have redeemed; with Your strength You will guide them to Your holy dwelling.
aov_text: U het deur u guns die volk gelei wat U verlos het; U het hulle deur u krag na u heilige woning gevoer.

kjv_text: The people shall hear, and be afraid: sorrow shall take hold on the inhabitants of Palestina.
bsb_text: The nations will hear and tremble; anguish will grip the dwellers of Philistia.
aov_text: Die volke het dit gehoor, hulle het gesidder; weë het die inwoners van Filistéa aangegryp.

kjv_text: Then the dukes of Edom shall be amazed; the mighty men of Moab, trembling shall take hold upon them; all the inhabitants of Canaan shall melt away.
bsb_text: Then the chiefs of Edom will be dismayed; trembling will seize the leaders of Moab; those who dwell in Canaan will melt away,
aov_text: Toe is die stamhoofde van Edom verskrik, bewing het die magtiges van Moab aangegryp. Al die inwoners van Kanaän het gebewe.

kjv_text: Fear and dread shall fall upon them; by the greatness of thine arm they shall be as still as a stone; till thy people pass over, O LORD, till the people pass over, which thou hast purchased.
bsb_text: and terror and dread will fall on them. By the power of Your arm they will be as still as a stone until Your people pass by, O LORD, until the people You have bought pass by.
aov_text: Verskrikking en vrees het op hulle geval; deur die grootheid van u arm was hulle stom soos ’n klip, terwyl u volk deurtrek, HERE, terwyl die volk deurtrek wat U verwerf het.

kjv_text: Thou shalt bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of thine inheritance, in the place, O LORD, which thou hast made for thee to dwell in, in the Sanctuary, O LORD, which thy hands have established.
bsb_text: You will bring them in and plant them on the mountain of Your inheritance—the place, O LORD, You have prepared for Your dwelling, the sanctuary, O Lord, Your hands have established.
aov_text: U bring hulle in en plant hulle op die bergland van u erfenis, die plek, o HERE, wat U as vaste woonplek vir U berei het, die heiligdom wat u hande gestig het, o HERE!

kjv_text: The LORD shall reign for ever and ever.
bsb_text: The LORD will reign forever and ever!”
aov_text: Die HERE sal regeer vir ewig en altoos.

kjv_text: For the horse of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea, and the LORD brought again the waters of the sea upon them; but the children of Israel went on dry land in the midst of the sea.
bsb_text: For when Pharaoh’s horses, chariots, and horsemen went into the sea, the LORD brought the waters of the sea back over them. But the Israelites walked through the sea on dry ground.
aov_text: Want Farao se perd, met sy strydwaens en sy ruiters, het in die see ingegaan, en die HERE het die waters van die see oor hulle laat terugkom. Maar die kinders van Israel het binne-in die see op droë grond getrek.

kjv_text: And Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a timbrel in her hand; and all the women went out after her with timbrels and with dances.
bsb_text: Then Miriam the prophetess, Aaron’s sister, took a tambourine in her hand, and all the women followed her with tambourines and dancing.
aov_text: En Mirjam, die profetes, die suster van Aäron, het ’n tamboeryn in haar hand geneem; en al die vroue het uitgegaan agter haar aan, met tamboeryne en in koordanse.

kjv_text: And Miriam answered them, Sing ye to the LORD, for he hath triumphed gloriously; the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.
bsb_text: And Miriam sang back to them: “Sing to the LORD, for He is highly exalted; the horse and rider He has thrown into the sea.”
aov_text: En Mirjam het hulle al singende geantwoord: Sing tot eer van die HERE, want Hy is hoog verhewe. Hy het die perd met sy ruiter in die see gewerp.

kjv_text: So Moses brought Israel from the Red sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.
bsb_text: Then Moses led Israel from the Red Sea, and they went out into the Desert of Shur. For three days they walked in the desert without finding water.
aov_text: DAAROP het Moses die Israeliete laat wegtrek van die Skelfsee af, en hulle het uitgetrek na die woestyn Sur. Hulle het toe drie dae lank in die woestyn getrek en geen water gekry nie.

kjv_text: And when they came to Marah, they could not drink of the waters of Marah, for they were bitter: therefore the name of it was called Marah.
bsb_text: And when they came to Marah, they could not drink the water there because it was bitter. (That is why it was named Marah.)
aov_text: En hulle het in Mara gekom, maar kon die water van Mara nie drink nie, want dit was bitter. Daarom heet die plek Mara.

kjv_text: And the people murmured against Moses, saying, What shall we drink?
bsb_text: So the people grumbled against Moses, saying, “What are we to drink?”
aov_text: Toe murmureer die volk teen Moses en sê: Wat moet ons drink?

kjv_text: And he cried unto the LORD; and the LORD shewed him a tree, which when he had cast into the waters, the waters were made sweet: there he made for them a statute and an ordinance, and there he proved them,
bsb_text: And Moses cried out to the LORD, and the LORD showed him a log. And when he cast it into the waters, they were sweetened. There the LORD made for them a statute and an ordinance, and there He tested them,
aov_text: En hy het die HERE aangeroep, en die HERE het hom ’n stuk hout gewys; dit het hy in die water gegooi, en die water het soet geword. Daar het Hy vir hulle ’n insetting en verordening vasgestel en hulle daar beproef

kjv_text: And said, If thou wilt diligently hearken to the voice of the LORD thy God, and wilt do that which is right in his sight, and wilt give ear to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of these diseases upon thee, which I have brought upon the Egyptians: for I am the LORD that healeth thee.
bsb_text: saying, “If you will listen carefully to the voice of the LORD your God, and do what is right in His eyes, and pay attention to His commands, and keep all His statutes, then I will not bring on you any of the diseases I inflicted on the Egyptians. For I am the LORD who heals you.”
aov_text: en gesê: As jy getrou na die stem van die HERE jou God luister en doen wat reg is in sy oë, en luister na sy gebooie en al sy insettinge hou, dan sal Ek geeneen van die siektes op jou lê wat Ek op Egipteland gelê het nie; want Ek is die HERE wat jou gesond maak.

kjv_text: And they came to Elim, where were twelve wells of water, and threescore and ten palm trees: and they encamped there by the waters.
bsb_text: Then they came to Elim, where there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees, and they camped there by the waters.
aov_text: Daarop het hulle by Elim gekom, waar twaalf waterfonteine en sewentig palmbome was. En hulle het daar by die water laer opgeslaan.

kjv_text: And they took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Israel came unto the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the land of Egypt.
bsb_text: On the fifteenth day of the second month after they had left the land of Egypt, the whole congregation of Israel set out from Elim and came to the Desert of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai.
aov_text: TOE hulle van Elim af wegtrek, het die hele vergadering van die kinders van Israel in die woestyn Sin gekom, wat tussen Elim en Sinai lê, op die vyftiende dag van die tweede maand ná hulle uittog uit Egipteland.

kjv_text: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness:
bsb_text: And there in the desert they all grumbled against Moses and Aaron.
aov_text: En die hele vergadering van die kinders van Israel het teen Moses en teen Aäron in die woestyn gemurmureer.

kjv_text: And the children of Israel said unto them, Would to God we had died by the hand of the LORD in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the flesh pots, and when we did eat bread to the full; for ye have brought us forth into this wilderness, to kill this whole assembly with hunger.
bsb_text: “If only we had died by the LORD’s hand in the land of Egypt!” they said. “There we sat by pots of meat and ate our fill of bread, but you have brought us into this desert to starve this whole assembly to death!”
aov_text: En die kinders van Israel het aan hulle gesê: Het ons maar in Egipteland deur die hand van die HERE gesterwe toe ons by die vleispotte gesit en volop brood geëet het! Want julle het ons in hierdie woestyn uitgelei om hierdie hele vergadering van honger te laat sterwe.

kjv_text: Then said the LORD unto Moses, Behold, I will rain bread from heaven for you; and the people shall go out and gather a certain rate every day, that I may prove them, whether they will walk in my law, or no.
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Behold, I will rain down bread from heaven for you. Each day the people are to go out and gather enough for that day. In this way I will test whether or not they will follow My instructions.
aov_text: Toe sê die HERE vir Moses: Kyk, Ek sal vir julle brood uit die hemel laat reën; dan kan die volk uitgaan en die dagmaat van elke dag insamel, sodat Ek hulle kan beproef, of hulle in my wet sal wandel of nie.

kjv_text: And it shall come to pass, that on the sixth day they shall prepare that which they bring in; and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily.
bsb_text: Then on the sixth day, when they prepare what they bring in, it will be twice as much as they gather on the other days.”
aov_text: En op die sesde dag, as hulle berei wat hulle inbring, sal dit dubbel soveel wees as wat hulle daagliks insamel.

kjv_text: And Moses and Aaron said unto all the children of Israel, At even, then ye shall know that the LORD hath brought you out from the land of Egypt:
bsb_text: So Moses and Aaron said to all the Israelites, “This evening you will know that it was the LORD who brought you out of the land of Egypt,
aov_text: Toe sê Moses en Aäron aan al die kinders van Israel: Vanaand, dan sal julle weet dat die HERE julle uit Egipteland uitgelei het.

kjv_text: And in the morning, then ye shall see the glory of the LORD; for that he heareth your murmurings against the LORD: and what are we, that ye murmur against us?
bsb_text: and in the morning you will see the LORD’s glory, because He has heard your grumbling against Him. For who are we that you should grumble against us?”
aov_text: En môre vroeg, dan sal julle die heerlikheid van die HERE sien, omdat Hy julle murmureringe teen die HERE gehoor het—want wat is ons, dat julle teen ons murmureer?

kjv_text: And Moses said, This shall be, when the LORD shall give you in the evening flesh to eat, and in the morning bread to the full; for that the LORD heareth your murmurings which ye murmur against him: and what are we? your murmurings are not against us, but against the LORD.
bsb_text: And Moses added, “The LORD will give you meat to eat this evening and bread to fill you in the morning, for He has heard your grumbling against Him. Who are we? Your grumblings are not against us but against the LORD.”
aov_text: Daarop sê Moses: Dít sal gebeur as die HERE julle in die aand vleis gee om te eet en in die môre volop brood, omdat die HERE julle murmureringe hoor wat julle teen Hom murmureer. Want wat is ons? Julle murmureringe is nie teen ons nie, maar teen die HERE.

kjv_text: And Moses spake unto Aaron, Say unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, Come near before the LORD: for he hath heard your murmurings.
bsb_text: Then Moses said to Aaron, “Tell the whole congregation of Israel, ‘Come before the LORD, for He has heard your grumbling.’”
aov_text: Verder het Moses met Aäron gespreek: Sê aan die hele vergadering van die kinders van Israel: Kom nader voor die aangesig van die HERE, want Hy het julle murmureringe gehoor.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, as Aaron spake unto the whole congregation of the children of Israel, that they looked toward the wilderness, and, behold, the glory of the LORD appeared in the cloud.
bsb_text: And as Aaron was speaking to the whole congregation of Israel, they looked toward the desert, and there in a cloud the glory of the LORD appeared.
aov_text: En onderwyl Aäron die hele vergadering van die kinders van Israel toespreek, draai hulle na die woestyn toe en meteens verskyn die heerlikheid van die HERE in die wolk.

kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to Moses,
aov_text: Ook het die HERE met Moses gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel: speak unto them, saying, At even ye shall eat flesh, and in the morning ye shall be filled with bread; and ye shall know that I am the LORD your God.
bsb_text: “I have heard the grumbling of the Israelites. Tell them, ‘At twilight you will eat meat, and in the morning you will be filled with bread. Then you will know that I am the LORD your God.’”
aov_text: Ek het die murmureringe van die kinders van Israel gehoor; spreek met hulle en sê: Teen die aand sal julle vleis eet en in die môre met brood versadig word; en julle sal weet dat Ek die HERE julle God is.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, that at even the quails came up, and covered the camp: and in the morning the dew lay round about the host.
bsb_text: That evening quail came and covered the camp, and in the morning there was a layer of dew around the camp.
aov_text: En in die aand het daar kwartels opgekom en die laer oordek. En in die môre was daar ’n doulaag rondom die laer.

kjv_text: And when the dew that lay was gone up, behold, upon the face of the wilderness there lay a small round thing, as small as the hoar frost on the ground.
bsb_text: When the layer of dew had evaporated, there were thin flakes on the desert floor, as fine as frost on the ground.
aov_text: En nadat die doulaag opgetrek het, het daar oor die woestyn iets gelê wat fyn en korrelrig was, fyn soos ryp op die grond.

kjv_text: And when the children of Israel saw it, they said one to another, It is manna: for they wist not what it was. And Moses said unto them, This is the bread which the LORD hath given you to eat.
bsb_text: When the Israelites saw it, they asked one another, “What is it?” For they did not know what it was. So Moses told them, “It is the bread that the LORD has given you to eat.
aov_text: Toe die kinders van Israel dit sien, sê hulle vir mekaar: Wat is dit? Want hulle het nie geweet wat dit was nie. Daarop sê Moses vir hulle: Dit is die brood wat die HERE julle gee om te eet.

kjv_text: This is the thing which the LORD hath commanded, Gather of it every man according to his eating, an omer for every man, according to the number of your persons; take ye every man for them which are in his tents.
bsb_text: This is what the LORD has commanded: ‘Each one is to gather as much as he needs. You may take an omer for each person in your tent.’”
aov_text: Dit is die saak wat die HERE beveel het: Samel daarvan in, elkeen na sy behoefte: ’n gomer vir elke persoon volgens julle sieletal; elkeen moet dit neem vir die wat in sy tent is.

kjv_text: And the children of Israel did so, and gathered, some more, some less.
bsb_text: So the Israelites did this. Some gathered more, and some less.
aov_text: En die kinders van Israel het so gedoen: hulle het ingesamel, die een baie en die ander min.

kjv_text: And when they did mete it with an omer, he that gathered much had nothing over, and he that gathered little had no lack; they gathered every man according to his eating.
bsb_text: When they measured it by the omer, he who gathered much had no excess, and he who gathered little had no shortfall. Each one gathered as much as he needed to eat.
aov_text: Maar toe hulle dit met die gomer meet, het hy wat baie ingesamel het, niks oorgehad nie; en hy wat min ingesamel het, nie te min nie. Elkeen na sy behoefte het hulle ingesamel.

kjv_text: And Moses said, Let no man leave of it till the morning.
bsb_text: Then Moses said to them, “No one may keep any of it until morning.”
aov_text: En Moses het vir hulle gesê: Niemand moet daarvan laat oorbly tot môre toe nie.

kjv_text: Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto Moses; but some of them left of it until the morning, and it bred worms, and stank: and Moses was wroth with them.
bsb_text: But they did not listen to Moses; some people left part of it until morning, and it became infested with maggots and began to smell. So Moses was angry with them.
aov_text: Maar hulle het nie na Moses geluister nie: sommige het daarvan laat oorbly tot die môre toe. Toe kom daar wurms in en dit bederwe. Daarom het Moses baie kwaad geword vir hulle.

kjv_text: And they gathered it every morning, every man according to his eating: and when the sun waxed hot, it melted.
bsb_text: Every morning each one gathered as much as was needed, and when the sun grew hot, it melted away.
aov_text: En hulle het dit môre vir môre ingesamel, elkeen na sy behoefte; en as die son warm word, smelt dit weg.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, that on the sixth day they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for one man: and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses.
bsb_text: On the sixth day, they gathered twice as much food—two omers per person—and all the leaders of the congregation came and reported this to Moses.
aov_text: En op die sesde dag het hulle ’n dubbele porsie brood ingesamel, twee gomers vir elkeen. En al die owerstes van die vergadering het gekom en dit aan Moses vertel.

kjv_text: And he said unto them, This is that which the LORD hath said, To morrow is the rest of the holy sabbath unto the LORD: bake that which ye will bake to day, and seethe that ye will seethe; and that which remaineth over lay up for you to be kept until the morning.
bsb_text: He told them, “This is what the LORD has said: ‘Tomorrow is to be a day of complete rest, a holy Sabbath to the LORD. So bake what you want to bake, and boil what you want to boil. Then set aside whatever remains and keep it until morning.’”
aov_text: Toe sê hy vir hulle: Dit is wat die HERE gespreek het: Môre is dit rusdag, ’n heilige sabbat van die HERE. Wat julle wil bak, bak dit; en wat julle wil kook, kook dit; en bêre vir julle alles wat oor is, om dit te bewaar tot die môre toe.

kjv_text: And they laid it up till the morning, as Moses bade: and it did not stink, neither was there any worm therein.
bsb_text: So they set it aside until morning as Moses had commanded, and it did not smell or contain any maggots.
aov_text: En hulle het dit gebêre tot die môre toe, soos Moses beveel het; en dit het nie bederwe nie, en daar het geen wurms in gekom nie.

kjv_text: And Moses said, Eat that to day; for to day is a sabbath unto the LORD: to day ye shall not find it in the field.
bsb_text: “Eat it today,” Moses said, “because today is a Sabbath to the LORD. Today you will not find anything in the field.
aov_text: Toe sê Moses: Eet dit vandag, want dit is vandag die sabbat van die HERE. Vandag sal julle dit nie in die veld kry nie.

kjv_text: Six days ye shall gather it; but on the seventh day, which is the sabbath, in it there shall be none.
bsb_text: For six days you may gather, but on the seventh day, the Sabbath, it will not be there.”
aov_text: Ses dae lank moet julle dit insamel, maar op die sewende dag is dit sabbat; dan sal dit daar nie wees nie.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, that there went out some of the people on the seventh day for to gather, and they found none.
bsb_text: Yet on the seventh day some of the people went out to gather, but they did not find anything.
aov_text: En op die sewende dag het van die mense uitgegaan om in te samel, maar hulle het niks gekry nie.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, How long refuse ye to keep my commandments and my laws?
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “How long will you refuse to keep My commandments and instructions?
aov_text: Toe sê die HERE vir Moses: Hoe lank weier julle om my gebooie en my wette te onderhou?

kjv_text: See, for that the LORD hath given you the sabbath, therefore he giveth you on the sixth day the bread of two days; abide ye every man in his place, let no man go out of his place on the seventh day.
bsb_text: Understand that the LORD has given you the Sabbath; that is why on the sixth day He will give you bread for two days. On the seventh day, everyone must stay where he is; no one may leave his place.”
aov_text: Kyk, omdat die HERE julle die sabbat gegee het, daarom gee Hy julle op die sesde dag brood vir twee dae. Laat elkeen bly waar hy is; laat niemand op die sewende dag van sy woonplek af weggaan nie.

kjv_text: So the people rested on the seventh day.
bsb_text: So the people rested on the seventh day.
aov_text: So het die volk dan op die sewende dag gerus.

kjv_text: And the house of Israel called the name thereof Manna: and it was like coriander seed, white; and the taste of it was like wafers made with honey.
bsb_text: Now the house of Israel called the bread manna. It was white like coriander seed and tasted like wafers made with honey.
aov_text: En die huis van Israel het dit MAN genoem. En dit was wit soos koljandersaad, en dit het gesmaak soos heuningkoek.

kjv_text: And Moses said, This is the thing which the LORD commandeth, Fill an omer of it to be kept for your generations; that they may see the bread wherewith I have fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you forth from the land of Egypt.
bsb_text: Moses said, “This is what the LORD has commanded: ‘Keep an omer of manna for the generations to come, so that they may see the bread I fed you in the wilderness when I brought you out of the land of Egypt.’”
aov_text: Verder het Moses gesê: Dit is die saak wat die HERE beveel het: ’n Gomer vol moet daarvan bewaar word vir julle geslagte, dat hulle die brood kan sien wat Ek julle in die woestyn laat eet het, toe Ek julle uit Egipteland uitgelei het.

kjv_text: And Moses said unto Aaron, Take a pot, and put an omer full of manna therein, and lay it up before the LORD, to be kept for your generations.
bsb_text: So Moses told Aaron, “Take a jar and fill it with an omer of manna. Then place it before the LORD to be preserved for the generations to come.”
aov_text: Moses sê toe vir Aäron: Neem ’n kruik en gooi ’n gomer vol manna daarin, en sit dit voor die aangesig van die HERE neer, om dit vir julle geslagte te bewaar.

kjv_text: As the LORD commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.
bsb_text: And Aaron placed it in front of the Testimony, to be preserved just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
aov_text: Soos die HERE Moses beveel het, so het Aäron dit voor die Getuienis neergesit om bewaar te word.

kjv_text: And the children of Israel did eat manna forty years, until they came to a land inhabited; they did eat manna, until they came unto the borders of the land of Canaan.
bsb_text: The Israelites ate manna forty years, until they came to a land where they could settle; they ate manna until they reached the border of Canaan.
aov_text: En die kinders van Israel het die manna veertig jaar lank geëet totdat hulle in ’n bewoonde land gekom het. Die manna het hulle geëet totdat hulle by die grens van die land Kanaän gekom het.

kjv_text: Now an omer is the tenth part of an ephah.
bsb_text: (Now an omer is a tenth of an ephah.)
aov_text: En ’n gomer is die tiende van ’n efa.

kjv_text: And all the congregation of the children of Israel journeyed from the wilderness of Sin, after their journeys, according to the commandment of the LORD, and pitched in Rephidim: and there was no water for the people to drink.
bsb_text: Then the whole congregation of Israel left the Desert of Sin, moving from place to place as the LORD commanded. They camped at Rephidim, but there was no water for the people to drink.
aov_text: DAAROP het die hele vergadering van die kinders van Israel, volgens die bevel van die HERE, van plek tot plek uit die woestyn Sin getrek en laer opgeslaan in Ráfidim. En daar was geen water vir die volk om te drink nie.

kjv_text: Wherefore the people did chide with Moses, and said, Give us water that we may drink. And Moses said unto them, Why chide ye with me? wherefore do ye tempt the LORD?
bsb_text: So the people contended with Moses, “Give us water to drink.” “Why do you contend with me?” Moses replied. “Why do you test the LORD?”
aov_text: Toe twis die volk met Moses en sê: Gee julle vir ons water om te drink. Maar Moses antwoord hulle: Wat twis julle met my? Waarom versoek julle die HERE?

kjv_text: And the people thirsted there for water; and the people murmured against Moses, and said, Wherefore is this that thou hast brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us and our children and our cattle with thirst?
bsb_text: But the people thirsted for water there, and they grumbled against Moses: “Why have you brought us out of Egypt—to make us and our children and livestock die of thirst?”
aov_text: Maar die volk het daar gesmag na water, en die volk het teen Moses gemurmureer en gesê: Waarom het u ons dan uit Egipte laat optrek om my en my kinders en my vee van dors te laat omkom?

kjv_text: And Moses cried unto the LORD, saying, What shall I do unto this people? they be almost ready to stone me.
bsb_text: Then Moses cried out to the LORD, “What should I do with these people? A little more and they will stone me!”
aov_text: Toe het Moses die HERE aangeroep en gesê: Wat moet ek met hierdie volk doen? Dit skeel maar min of hulle stenig my.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go on before the people, and take with thee of the elders of Israel; and thy rod, wherewith thou smotest the river, take in thine hand, and go.
bsb_text: And the LORD said to Moses, “Walk on ahead of the people and take some of the elders of Israel with you. Take along in your hand the staff with which you struck the Nile, and go.
aov_text: En die HERE het Moses geantwoord: Trek voor die volk uit, en neem van die oudstes van Israel met jou saam; en neem jou staf waarmee jy die Nyl geslaan het, in jou hand en gaan weg.

kjv_text: Behold, I will stand before thee there upon the rock in Horeb; and thou shalt smite the rock, and there shall come water out of it, that the people may drink. And Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.
bsb_text: Behold, I will stand there before you by the rock at Horeb. And when you strike the rock, water will come out of it for the people to drink.” So Moses did this in the sight of the elders of Israel.
aov_text: Kyk, Ek sal daar voor jou by die rots op Horeb staan; dan moet jy die rots slaan, en daar sal water uit kom, dat die volk kan drink. En Moses het so gedoen voor die oë van die oudstes van Israel

kjv_text: And he called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because of the chiding of the children of Israel, and because they tempted the LORD, saying, Is the LORD among us, or not?
bsb_text: He named the place Massah and Meribah because the Israelites quarreled, and because they tested the LORD, saying, “Is the LORD among us or not?”
aov_text: en die plek Massa en Mériba genoem vanweë die twis van die kinders van Israel en omdat hulle die HERE versoek het deur te sê: Is die HERE in ons midde of nie?

kjv_text: Then came Amalek, and fought with Israel in Rephidim.
bsb_text: After this, the Amalekites came and attacked the Israelites at Rephidim.
aov_text: DAAROP het Ámalek gekom om teen Israel by Ráfidim te veg.

kjv_text: And Moses said unto Joshua, Choose us out men, and go out, fight with Amalek: to morrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the rod of God in mine hand.
bsb_text: So Moses said to Joshua, “Choose some of our men and go out to fight the Amalekites. Tomorrow I will stand on the hilltop with the staff of God in my hand.”
aov_text: En Moses het aan Josua gesê: Kies vir ons manne en trek uit, veg teen Ámalek. Môre sal ek op die top van die heuwel staan met die staf van God in my hand.

kjv_text: So Joshua did as Moses had said to him, and fought with Amalek: and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.
bsb_text: Joshua did as Moses had instructed him and fought against the Amalekites, while Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.
aov_text: En Josua het gedoen soos Moses aan hom gesê het, om te veg teen Ámalek. Maar Moses, Aäron en Hur het op die top van die heuwel geklim.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when Moses held up his hand, that Israel prevailed: and when he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.
bsb_text: As long as Moses held up his hands, Israel prevailed; but when he lowered them, Amalek prevailed.
aov_text: En telkens as Moses sy hand ophou, was Israel die sterkste; maar as hy sy hand laat sak, was Ámalek die sterkste.

kjv_text: But Moses' hands were heavy; and they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat thereon; and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side; and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun.
bsb_text: When Moses’ hands grew heavy, they took a stone and put it under him, and he sat on it. Then Aaron and Hur held his hands up, one on each side, so that his hands remained steady until the sun went down.
aov_text: Maar die hande van Moses het swaar geword; daarom het hulle ’n klip geneem en dit onder hom neergelê, dat hy daarop kon sit. En Aäron en Hur het sy hande ondersteun, die een duskant en die ander anderkant. So het sy hande dan vas gebly tot sononder.

kjv_text: And Joshua discomfited Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.
bsb_text: So Joshua overwhelmed Amalek and his army with the sword.
aov_text: En Josua het Ámalek en sy volk met die skerpte van die swaard ’n neerlaag toegebring.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Write this for a memorial in a book, and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua: for I will utterly put out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven.
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Write this on a scroll as a reminder and recite it to Joshua, because I will utterly blot out the memory of Amalek from under heaven.”
aov_text: Toe sê die HERE vir Moses: Skrywe dit as ’n aandenking in ’n boek en prent dit Josua in, dat Ek die gedagtenis van Ámalek onder die hemel heeltemal sal uitdelg.

kjv_text: And Moses built an altar, and called the name of it Jehovahnissi:
bsb_text: And Moses built an altar and named it The LORD Is My Banner.
aov_text: En Moses het ’n altaar gebou en dit genoem: Die HERE is my banier.

kjv_text: For he said, Because the LORD hath sworn that the LORD will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.
bsb_text: “Indeed,” he said, “a hand was lifted up toward the throne of the LORD. The LORD will war against Amalek from generation to generation.”
aov_text: En hy het gesê: Waarlik, die hand op die troon van die HERE! Oorlog het die HERE teen Ámalek van geslag tot geslag.

kjv_text: When Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses' father in law, heard of all that God had done for Moses, and for Israel his people, and that the LORD had brought Israel out of Egypt;
bsb_text: Now Moses’ father-in-law Jethro, the priest of Midian, heard about all that God had done for Moses and His people Israel, and how the LORD had brought Israel out of Egypt.
aov_text: TOE Jetro, die priester van Mídian, Moses se skoonvader, hoor alles wat God aan Moses en aan sy volk Israel gedoen het—dat die HERE Israel uit Egipte uitgelei het—

kjv_text: Then Jethro, Moses' father in law, took Zipporah, Moses' wife, after he had sent her back,
bsb_text: After Moses had sent back his wife Zipporah, his father-in-law Jethro had received her,
aov_text: het Jetro, Moses se skoonvader, Sippóra, die vrou van Moses, geneem—nadat hy haar teruggestuur het—

kjv_text: And her two sons; of which the name of the one was Gershom; for he said, I have been an alien in a strange land:
bsb_text: along with her two sons. One son was named Gershom, for Moses had said, “I have been a foreigner in a foreign land.”
aov_text: en haar twee seuns. (Die naam van die een was Gersom, want hy het gesê: Ek het ’n vreemdeling geword in ’n vreemde land;

kjv_text: And the name of the other was Eliezer; for the God of my father, said he, was mine help, and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh:
bsb_text: The other son was named Eliezer, for Moses had said, “The God of my father was my helper and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh.”
aov_text: en die naam van die ander was Eliëser; want, het hy gesê, die God van my vader is my hulp en het my van Farao se swaard verlos.)

kjv_text: And Jethro, Moses' father in law, came with his sons and his wife unto Moses into the wilderness, where he encamped at the mount of God:
bsb_text: Moses’ father-in-law Jethro, along with Moses’ wife and sons, came to him in the desert, where he was encamped at the mountain of God.
aov_text: En Jetro, Moses se skoonvader, het met sy seuns en sy vrou na Moses gekom in die woestyn waar hy by die berg van God met die laer gestaan het.

kjv_text: And he said unto Moses, I thy father in law Jethro am come unto thee, and thy wife, and her two sons with her.
bsb_text: He sent word to Moses, “I, your father-in-law Jethro, am coming to you with your wife and her two sons.”
aov_text: En hy het Moses laat weet: Ek, jou skoonvader Jetro, kom na jou met jou vrou en haar twee seuns saam met haar.

kjv_text: And Moses went out to meet his father in law, and did obeisance, and kissed him; and they asked each other of their welfare; and they came into the tent.
bsb_text: So Moses went out to meet his father-in-law and bowed down and kissed him. They greeted each other and went into the tent.
aov_text: Daarop gaan Moses uit, sy skoonvader tegemoet, en hy het gebuig en hom gesoen; en hulle het na mekaar se welstand gevra en in die tent ingegaan.

kjv_text: And Moses told his father in law all that the LORD had done unto Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel's sake, and all the travail that had come upon them by the way, and how the LORD delivered them.
bsb_text: Then Moses recounted to his father-in-law all that the LORD had done to Pharaoh and the Egyptians for Israel’s sake, all the hardships they had encountered along the way, and how the LORD had delivered them.
aov_text: Moses vertel toe aan sy skoonvader alles wat die HERE aan Farao en aan die Egiptenaars, ter wille van Israel, gedoen het; al die moeilikheid wat hulle op die pad oorgekom het, en dat die HERE hulle verlos het.

kjv_text: And Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which the LORD had done to Israel, whom he had delivered out of the hand of the Egyptians.
bsb_text: And Jethro rejoiced over all the good things the LORD had done for Israel, whom He had rescued from the hand of the Egyptians.
aov_text: En Jetro het hom verheug oor al die goeie wat die HERE aan Israel gedoen het, dat Hy hulle uit die hand van die Egiptenaars verlos het.

kjv_text: And Jethro said, Blessed be the LORD, who hath delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of Pharaoh, who hath delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.
bsb_text: Jethro declared, “Blessed be the LORD, who has delivered you from the hand of the Egyptians and of Pharaoh, and who has delivered the people from the hand of the Egyptians.
aov_text: Daarop sê Jetro: Geseënd is die HERE wat julle verlos het uit die hand van die Egiptenaars en uit die hand van Farao, wat die volk onder die hand van die Egiptenaars uit verlos het.

kjv_text: Now I know that the LORD is greater than all gods: for in the thing wherein they dealt proudly he was above them.
bsb_text: Now I know that the LORD is greater than all other gods, for He did this when they treated Israel with arrogance.”
aov_text: Nou weet ek dat die HERE groter is as al die gode, naamlik in die saak waarin hulle vermetel was teen hulle.

kjv_text: And Jethro, Moses' father in law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God: and Aaron came, and all the elders of Israel, to eat bread with Moses' father in law before God.
bsb_text: Then Moses’ father-in-law Jethro brought a burnt offering and sacrifices to God, and Aaron came with all the elders of Israel to eat bread with Moses’ father-in-law in the presence of God.
aov_text: Daarop het Jetro, Moses se skoonvader, ’n brandoffer en slagoffers geneem tot eer van God. En Aäron en al die oudstes van Israel het gekom om saam met Moses se skoonvader brood te eet voor die aangesig van God.

kjv_text: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses sat to judge the people: and the people stood by Moses from the morning unto the evening.
bsb_text: The next day Moses took his seat to judge the people, and they stood around him from morning until evening.
aov_text: En die volgende dag het Moses gesit om reg te spreek vir die volk; en die volk het voor Moses gestaan van die môre tot die aand toe.

kjv_text: And when Moses' father in law saw all that he did to the people, he said, What is this thing that thou doest to the people? why sittest thou thyself alone, and all the people stand by thee from morning unto even?
bsb_text: When his father-in-law saw all that Moses was doing for the people, he asked, “What is this that you are doing for the people? Why do you sit alone as judge, with all the people standing around you from morning till evening?”
aov_text: En toe Moses se skoonvader sien alles wat hy vir die volk doen, sê hy: Wat is dit wat jy vir die volk doen? Waarom sit jy alleen, en die hele volk staan voor jou van die môre tot die aand toe?

kjv_text: And Moses said unto his father in law, Because the people come unto me to enquire of God:
bsb_text: “Because the people come to me to inquire of God,” Moses replied.
aov_text: En Moses antwoord sy skoonvader: Omdat die volk na my kom om God te raadpleeg.

kjv_text: When they have a matter, they come unto me; and I judge between one and another, and I do make them know the statutes of God, and his laws.
bsb_text: “Whenever they have a dispute, it is brought to me to judge between one man and another, and I make known to them the statutes and laws of God.”
aov_text: As hulle ’n saak het, kom hulle na my; en dan moet ek regspreek tussen die partye en die insettinge van God en sy wette bekend maak.

kjv_text: And Moses' father in law said unto him, The thing that thou doest is not good.
bsb_text: But Moses’ father-in-law said to him, “What you are doing is not good.
aov_text: Maar Moses se skoonvader sê vir hom: Die ding wat jy doen, is nie goed nie.

kjv_text: Thou wilt surely wear away, both thou, and this people that is with thee: for this thing is too heavy for thee; thou art not able to perform it thyself alone.
bsb_text: Surely you and these people with you will wear yourselves out, because the task is too heavy for you. You cannot handle it alone.
aov_text: Jy sal heeltemal uitgeput raak, jy sowel as hierdie volk wat by jou is. Want die saak is te swaar vir jou; jy kan dit nie alleen doen nie.

kjv_text: Hearken now unto my voice, I will give thee counsel, and God shall be with thee: Be thou for the people to God-ward, that thou mayest bring the causes unto God:
bsb_text: Now listen to me; I will give you some advice, and may God be with you. You must be the people’s representative before God and bring their causes to Him.
aov_text: Luister nou na my; ek sal jou raad gee, en God sal met jou wees. Wat jou betref, wees jy die verteenwoordiger van die volk by God en bring jý die sake voor God,

kjv_text: And thou shalt teach them ordinances and laws, and shalt shew them the way wherein they must walk, and the work that they must do.
bsb_text: Teach them the statutes and laws, and show them the way to live and the work they must do.
aov_text: en onderrig hulle in die insettinge en die wette, en maak hulle die weg bekend waarop hulle moet gaan, en die werk wat hulle moet doen.

kjv_text: Moreover thou shalt provide out of all the people able men, such as fear God, men of truth, hating covetousness; and place such over them, to be rulers of thousands, and rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens:
bsb_text: Furthermore, select capable men from among the people—God-fearing, trustworthy men who are averse to dishonest gain. Appoint them over the people as leaders of thousands, of hundreds, of fifties, and of tens.
aov_text: Maar kies jy uit die hele volk bekwame manne wat God vrees, betroubare manne wat onregverdige wins haat. En stel dié aan oor hulle: owerstes oor duisend, owerstes oor honderd, owerstes oor vyftig en owerstes oor tien;

kjv_text: And let them judge the people at all seasons: and it shall be, that every great matter they shall bring unto thee, but every small matter they shall judge: so shall it be easier for thyself, and they shall bear the burden with thee.
bsb_text: Have these men judge the people at all times. Then they can bring you any major issue, but all minor cases they can judge on their own, so that your load may be lightened as they share it with you.
aov_text: en laat hulle voortdurend oor die volk die regspraak uitoefen: al die groot sake moet hulle na jou bring, maar in al die klein sake moet hulle self regspreek. Maak dit so ligter vir jou, en laat hulle saam met jou dra.

kjv_text: If thou shalt do this thing, and God command thee so, then thou shalt be able to endure, and all this people shall also go to their place in peace.
bsb_text: If you follow this advice and God so directs you, then you will be able to endure, and all these people can go home in peace.”
aov_text: As jy dit doen en God dit jou beveel, kan jy dit uithou en sal ook al hierdie mense tevrede na hulle woonplek gaan.

kjv_text: So Moses hearkened to the voice of his father in law, and did all that he had said.
bsb_text: Moses listened to his father-in-law and did everything he said.
aov_text: Moses het toe geluister na sy skoonvader en alles gedoen wat hy gesê het—

kjv_text: And Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.
bsb_text: So Moses chose capable men from all Israel and made them heads over the people as leaders of thousands, of hundreds, of fifties, and of tens.
aov_text: Moses het bekwame manne uit die hele Israel gekies en hulle as hoofde oor die volk aangestel—owerstes oor duisend, owerstes oor honderd, owerstes oor vyftig en owerstes oor tien.

kjv_text: And they judged the people at all seasons: the hard causes they brought unto Moses, but every small matter they judged themselves.
bsb_text: And they judged the people at all times; they would bring the difficult cases to Moses, but any minor issue they would judge themselves.
aov_text: En hulle het voortdurend oor die volk die regspraak uitgeoefen: die moeilike sake het hulle na Moses gebring, maar in al die klein sake self reggespreek.

kjv_text: And Moses let his father in law depart; and he went his way into his own land.
bsb_text: Then Moses sent his father-in-law on his way, and Jethro returned to his own land.
aov_text: Toe het Moses sy skoonvader laat gaan, en hy het na sy land getrek.

kjv_text: In the third month, when the children of Israel were gone forth out of the land of Egypt, the same day came they into the wilderness of Sinai.
bsb_text: In the third month, on the same day of the month that the Israelites had left the land of Egypt, they came to the Wilderness of Sinai.
aov_text: IN die derde maand ná die uittog van die kinders van Israel uit Egipteland, op dieselfde dag, het hulle in die woestyn Sinai gekom—

kjv_text: For they were departed from Rephidim, and were come to the desert of Sinai, and had pitched in the wilderness; and there Israel camped before the mount.
bsb_text: After they had set out from Rephidim, they entered the Wilderness of Sinai, and Israel camped there in front of the mountain.
aov_text: hulle het van Ráfidim af opgebreek en in die woestyn Sinai gekom en in die woestyn laer opgeslaan. En Israel het daar teenoor die berg laer opgeslaan.

kjv_text: And Moses went up unto God, and the LORD called unto him out of the mountain, saying, Thus shalt thou say to the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel;
bsb_text: Then Moses went up to God, and the LORD called to him from the mountain, “This is what you are to tell the house of Jacob and explain to the sons of Israel:
aov_text: Maar Moses het opgeklim na God toe, en die HERE het hom van die berg af toegeroep en gesê: So moet jy aan die huis van Jakob sê en aan die kinders van Israel verkondig:

kjv_text: Ye have seen what I did unto the Egyptians, and how I bare you on eagles' wings, and brought you unto myself.
bsb_text: ‘You have seen for yourselves what I did to Egypt, and how I carried you on eagles’ wings and brought you to Myself.
aov_text: Julle het self gesien wat Ek aan die Egiptenaars gedoen het, en dat Ek julle op arendsvlerke gedra en julle na My toe gebring het.

kjv_text: Now therefore, if ye will obey my voice indeed, and keep my covenant, then ye shall be a peculiar treasure unto me above all people: for all the earth is mine:
bsb_text: Now if you will indeed obey My voice and keep My covenant, you will be My treasured possession out of all the nations—for the whole earth is Mine.
aov_text: As julle dan nou terdeë na my stem luister en my verbond hou, sal julle my eiendom uit al die volke wees, want die hele aarde is myne.

kjv_text: And ye shall be unto me a kingdom of priests, and an holy nation. These are the words which thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel.
bsb_text: And unto Me you shall be a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.’ These are the words that you are to speak to the Israelites.”
aov_text: En júlle sal vir My ’n koninkryk van priesters en ’n heilige nasie wees. Dit is die woorde wat jy aan die kinders van Israel moet meedeel.

kjv_text: And Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and laid before their faces all these words which the LORD commanded him.
bsb_text: So Moses went back and summoned the elders of the people and set before them all these words that the LORD had commanded him.
aov_text: En Moses het gekom en die oudstes van die volk laat roep en hulle al hierdie woorde voorgehou wat die HERE hom beveel het.

kjv_text: And all the people answered together, and said, All that the LORD hath spoken we will do. And Moses returned the words of the people unto the LORD.
bsb_text: And all the people answered together, “We will do everything that the LORD has spoken.” So Moses brought their words back to the LORD.
aov_text: Toe antwoord die hele volk eenparig en sê: Alles wat die HERE gespreek het, sal ons doen. En Moses het die woorde van die volk aan die HERE oorgebring.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Lo, I come unto thee in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with thee, and believe thee for ever. And Moses told the words of the people unto the LORD.
bsb_text: The LORD said to Moses, “Behold, I will come to you in a dense cloud, so that the people will hear when I speak with you, and they will always put their trust in you.” And Moses relayed to the LORD what the people had said.
aov_text: En die HERE het met Moses gespreek: Kyk, Ek sal in ’n dik wolk na jou toe kom, dat die volk kan hoor as Ek met jou spreek, en hulle ook vir altyd aan jóu kan glo. Want Moses het die woorde van die volk aan die HERE meegedeel.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go unto the people, and sanctify them to day and to morrow, and let them wash their clothes,
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Go to the people and consecrate them today and tomorrow. They must wash their clothes
aov_text: Verder het die HERE aan Moses gesê: Gaan na die volk en heilig hulle vandag en môre, en laat hulle hul klere was

kjv_text: And be ready against the third day: for the third day the LORD will come down in the sight of all the people upon mount Sinai.
bsb_text: and be prepared by the third day, for on the third day the LORD will come down on Mount Sinai in the sight of all the people.
aov_text: en hulle gereed hou teen die derde dag. Want op die derde dag sal die HERE voor die oë van die hele volk op die berg Sinai afdaal.

kjv_text: And thou shalt set bounds unto the people round about, saying, Take heed to yourselves, that ye go not up into the mount, or touch the border of it: whosoever toucheth the mount shall be surely put to death:
bsb_text: And you are to set up a boundary for the people around the mountain and tell them, ‘Be careful not to go up on the mountain or touch its base. Whoever touches the mountain shall surely be put to death.
aov_text: Ook moet jy vir die volk ’n grens rondom aanwys en sê: Pas op dat julle nie op die berg klim of sy voet aanraak nie. Elkeen wat die berg aanraak, moet sekerlik gedood word.

kjv_text: There shall not an hand touch it, but he shall surely be stoned, or shot through; whether it be beast or man, it shall not live: when the trumpet soundeth long, they shall come up to the mount.
bsb_text: No hand shall touch him, but he shall surely be stoned or shot with arrows—whether man or beast, he must not live.’ Only when the ram’s horn sounds a long blast may they approach the mountain.”
aov_text: Geen hand mag hom aanraak nie; maar hy moet sekerlik gestenig of sekerlik met ’n pyl geskiet word; of dit ’n dier of ’n mens is—hy mag nie lewe nie. As die ramshoring lang geluide blaas, mag hulle op die berg klim.

kjv_text: And Moses went down from the mount unto the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes.
bsb_text: When Moses came down from the mountain to the people, he consecrated them, and they washed their clothes.
aov_text: Toe het Moses van die berg af na die volk gegaan en die volk geheilig, en hulle het hul klere gewas.

kjv_text: And he said unto the people, Be ready against the third day: come not at your wives.
bsb_text: “Be prepared for the third day,” he said to the people. “Do not draw near to a woman.”
aov_text: En hy het aan die volk gesê: Hou julle klaar teen die derde dag; moenie naby die vrou kom nie.

kjv_text: And it came to pass on the third day in the morning, that there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud upon the mount, and the voice of the trumpet exceeding loud; so that all the people that was in the camp trembled.
bsb_text: On the third day, when morning came, there was thunder and lightning. A thick cloud was upon the mountain, and a very loud blast of the ram’s horn went out, so that all the people in the camp trembled.
aov_text: En op die derde dag toe dit môre word, was daar donderslae en blitse en ’n swaar wolk op die berg en die geluid van ’n baie sterk basuin, sodat die hele volk wat in die laer was, gebeef het.

kjv_text: And Moses brought forth the people out of the camp to meet with God; and they stood at the nether part of the mount.
bsb_text: Then Moses brought the people out of the camp to meet with God, and they stood at the foot of the mountain.
aov_text: Daarop het Moses die volk uit die laer gelei om God te ontmoet, en hulle het gaan staan by die voet van die berg.

kjv_text: And mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke, because the LORD descended upon it in fire: and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mount quaked greatly.
bsb_text: Mount Sinai was completely enveloped in smoke, because the LORD had descended on it in fire. And the smoke rose like the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mountain quaked violently.
aov_text: En die hele berg Sinai het gerook, omdat die HERE in ’n vuur daarop neergedaal het. En sy rook het opgetrek soos die rook van ’n oond, en die hele berg het vreeslik gebewe.

kjv_text: And when the voice of the trumpet sounded long, and waxed louder and louder, Moses spake, and God answered him by a voice.
bsb_text: And as the sound of the ram’s horn grew louder and louder, Moses spoke and God answered him in the thunder.
aov_text: Toe die geluid van die basuin sterker en sterker word, het Moses gespreek, en God het hom telkens hardop geantwoord.

kjv_text: And the LORD came down upon mount Sinai, on the top of the mount: and the LORD called Moses up to the top of the mount; and Moses went up.
bsb_text: The LORD descended to the top of Mount Sinai and called Moses to the summit. So Moses went up,
aov_text: Terwyl die HERE op die berg Sinai neerdaal, op die top van die berg, het die HERE Moses na die top van die berg geroep, en Moses het opgeklim.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go down, charge the people, lest they break through unto the LORD to gaze, and many of them perish.
bsb_text: and the LORD said to him, “Go down and warn the people not to break through to see the LORD, lest many of them perish.
aov_text: En die HERE het vir Moses gesê: Klim af, waarsku die volk, dat hulle nie na die HERE toe deurbreek om te sien en baie van hulle dan val nie.

kjv_text: And let the priests also, which come near to the LORD, sanctify themselves, lest the LORD break forth upon them.
bsb_text: Even the priests who approach the LORD must consecrate themselves, or the LORD will break out against them.”
aov_text: En ook die priesters wat naby die HERE kom, moet hulleself heilig, sodat die HERE nie teen hulle losbreek nie.

kjv_text: And Moses said unto the LORD, The people cannot come up to mount Sinai: for thou chargedst us, saying, Set bounds about the mount, and sanctify it.
bsb_text: But Moses said to the LORD, “The people cannot come up Mount Sinai, for You solemnly warned us, ‘Put a boundary around the mountain and set it apart as holy.’”
aov_text: Toe het Moses die HERE geantwoord: Die volk kan nie op die berg Sinai klim nie, want U het ons self gewaarsku en gesê: Baken die berg af en heilig dit.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto him, Away, get thee down, and thou shalt come up, thou, and Aaron with thee: but let not the priests and the people break through to come up unto the LORD, lest he break forth upon them.
bsb_text: And the LORD replied, “Go down and bring Aaron with you. But the priests and the people must not break through to come up to the LORD, or He will break out against them.”
aov_text: Daarop sê die HERE vir hom: Gaan heen, klim af. Dan moet jy, en Aäron saam met jou, opklim; maar die priesters en die volk mag nie deurbreek om na die HERE toe op te klim nie, sodat Hy nie teen hulle losbreek nie.

kjv_text: So Moses went down unto the people, and spake unto them.
bsb_text: So Moses went down to the people and spoke to them.
aov_text: En Moses het na die volk toe afgeklim en hulle dit aangesê.

kjv_text: And God spake all these words, saying,
bsb_text: And God spoke all these words:
aov_text: TOE het God al hierdie woorde gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: I am the LORD thy God, which have brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
bsb_text: “I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
aov_text: Ek is die HERE jou God wat jou uit Egipteland, uit die slawehuis, uitgelei het.

kjv_text: Thou shalt have no other gods before me.
bsb_text: You shall have no other gods before Me.
aov_text: Jy mag geen ander gode voor my aangesig hê nie.

kjv_text: Thou shalt not make unto thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth:
bsb_text: You shall not make for yourself an idol in the form of anything in the heavens above, on the earth below, or in the waters beneath.
aov_text: Jy mag vir jou geen gesnede beeld of enige gelykenis maak van wat bo in die hemel is, of van wat onder op die aarde is, of van wat in die waters onder die aarde is nie.

kjv_text: Thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them: for I the LORD thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me;
bsb_text: You shall not bow down to them or worship them; for I, the LORD your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on their children to the third and fourth generations of those who hate Me,
aov_text: Jy mag jou voor hulle nie neerbuig en hulle nie dien nie; want Ek, die HERE jou God, is ’n jaloerse God wat die misdaad van die vaders besoek aan die kinders, aan die derde en aan die vierde geslag van die wat My haat;

kjv_text: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me, and keep my commandments.
bsb_text: but showing loving devotion to a thousand generations of those who love Me and keep My commandments.
aov_text: en Ek bewys barmhartigheid aan duisende van die wat My liefhet en my gebooie onderhou.

kjv_text: Thou shalt not take the name of the LORD thy God in vain; for the LORD will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.
bsb_text: You shall not take the name of the LORD your God in vain, for the LORD will not leave anyone unpunished who takes His name in vain.
aov_text: Jy mag die Naam van die HERE jou God nie ydellik gebruik nie, want die HERE sal die een wat sy Naam ydellik gebruik, nie ongestraf laat bly nie.

kjv_text: Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy.
bsb_text: Remember the Sabbath day by keeping it holy.
aov_text: Gedenk die sabbatdag, dat jy dit heilig.

kjv_text: Six days shalt thou labour, and do all thy work:
bsb_text: Six days you shall labor and do all your work,
aov_text: Ses dae moet jy arbei en al jou werk doen;

kjv_text: But the seventh day is the sabbath of the LORD thy God: in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates:
bsb_text: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD your God, on which you must not do any work—neither you, nor your son or daughter, nor your manservant or maidservant or livestock, nor the foreigner within your gates.
aov_text: maar die sewende dag is die sabbat van die HERE jou God; dan mag jy géén werk doen nie—jy of jou seun of jou dogter, of jou dienskneg of jou diensmaagd, of jou vee of jou vreemdeling wat in jou poorte is nie.

kjv_text: For in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that in them is, and rested the seventh day: wherefore the LORD blessed the sabbath day, and hallowed it.
bsb_text: For in six days the LORD made the heavens and the earth and the sea and all that is in them, but on the seventh day He rested. Therefore the LORD blessed the Sabbath day and set it apart as holy.
aov_text: Want in ses dae het die HERE die hemel en die aarde gemaak, die see en alles wat daarin is, en op die sewende dag het Hy gerus. Daarom het die HERE die sabbatdag geseën en dit geheilig.

kjv_text: Honour thy father and thy mother: that thy days may be long upon the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
bsb_text: Honor your father and mother, so that your days may be long in the land that the LORD your God is giving you.
aov_text: Eer jou vader en jou moeder, dat jou dae verleng mag word in die land wat die HERE jou God aan jou gee.

kjv_text: Thou shalt not kill.
bsb_text: You shall not murder.
aov_text: Jy mag nie doodslaan nie.

kjv_text: Thou shalt not commit adultery.
bsb_text: You shall not commit adultery.
aov_text: Jy mag nie egbreek nie.

kjv_text: Thou shalt not steal.
bsb_text: You shall not steal.
aov_text: Jy mag nie steel nie.

kjv_text: Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbour.
bsb_text: You shall not bear false witness against your neighbor.
aov_text: Jy mag geen valse getuienis teen jou naaste spreek nie.

kjv_text: Thou shalt not covet thy neighbour's house, thou shalt not covet thy neighbour's wife, nor his manservant, nor his maidservant, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor any thing that is thy neighbour's.
bsb_text: You shall not covet your neighbor’s house. You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife, or his manservant or maidservant, or his ox or donkey, or anything that belongs to your neighbor.”
aov_text: Jy mag nie jou naaste se huis begeer nie; jy mag nie jou naaste se vrou begeer nie, of sy dienskneg of sy diensmaagd, of sy os of sy esel of iets wat van jou naaste is nie.

kjv_text: And all the people saw the thunderings, and the lightnings, and the noise of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking: and when the people saw it, they removed, and stood afar off.
bsb_text: When all the people witnessed the thunder and lightning, the sounding of the ram’s horn, and the mountain enveloped in smoke, they trembled and stood at a distance.
aov_text: En toe die hele volk die donderslae en die blitse en die geluid van die basuin en die rokende berg bemerk, het die volk dit gesien en gebewe en op ’n afstand bly staan.

kjv_text: And they said unto Moses, Speak thou with us, and we will hear: but let not God speak with us, lest we die.
bsb_text: “Speak to us yourself and we will listen,” they said to Moses. “But do not let God speak to us, or we will die.”
aov_text: En hulle het vir Moses gesê: Spreek u met ons, dat ons kan luister; maar laat God nie met ons spreek nie, anders sterwe ons.

kjv_text: And Moses said unto the people, Fear not: for God is come to prove you, and that his fear may be before your faces, that ye sin not.
bsb_text: “Do not be afraid,” Moses replied. “For God has come to test you, so that the fear of Him may be before you, to keep you from sinning.”
aov_text: Toe antwoord Moses die volk: Wees nie bevrees nie, want God het gekom om julle te beproef en dat sy vrees voor julle oë mag wees, sodat julle nie sondig nie.

kjv_text: And the people stood afar off, and Moses drew near unto the thick darkness where God was.
bsb_text: And the people stood at a distance as Moses approached the thick darkness where God was.
aov_text: So het die volk dan op ’n afstand bly staan. Maar Moses het nader gegaan na die wolkedonkerheid waar God was.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Thus thou shalt say unto the children of Israel, Ye have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “This is what you are to tell the Israelites: ‘You have seen for yourselves that I have spoken to you from heaven.
aov_text: Toe sê die HERE vir Moses: So moet jy met die kinders van Israel spreek: Julle het self gesien dat Ek met julle van die hemel af gespreek het.

kjv_text: Ye shall not make with me gods of silver, neither shall ye make unto you gods of gold.
bsb_text: You are not to make any gods alongside Me; you are not to make for yourselves gods of silver or gold.
aov_text: Julle mag naas My geen silwergode maak en geen goue gode vir julle maak nie.

kjv_text: An altar of earth thou shalt make unto me, and shalt sacrifice thereon thy burnt offerings, and thy peace offerings, thy sheep, and thine oxen: in all places where I record my name I will come unto thee, and I will bless thee.
bsb_text: You are to make for Me an altar of earth, and sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and peace offerings, your sheep and goats and cattle. In every place where I cause My name to be remembered, I will come to you and bless you.
aov_text: ’n Altaar van grond moet jy vir My maak, en daarop moet jy jou brandoffers en dankoffers, jou kleinvee en beeste, offer. Op elke plek waar Ek my Naam sal laat gedenk, sal Ek na jou toe kom en jou seën.

kjv_text: And if thou wilt make me an altar of stone, thou shalt not build it of hewn stone: for if thou lift up thy tool upon it, thou hast polluted it.
bsb_text: Now if you make an altar of stones for Me, you must not build it with stones shaped by tools; for if you use a chisel on it, you will defile it.
aov_text: Maar as jy vir My ’n klipaltaar maak, mag jy dit nie bou van gekapte klip nie; want as jy jou ystergereedskap daaroor swaai, dan ontheilig jy dit.

kjv_text: Neither shalt thou go up by steps unto mine altar, that thy nakedness be not discovered thereon.
bsb_text: And you must not go up to My altar on steps, lest your nakedness be exposed on it.’
aov_text: Jy mag ook nie met trappe na my altaar opklim nie, dat jou skaamte nie daarop ontbloot word nie.

kjv_text: Now these are the judgments which thou shalt set before them.
bsb_text: “These are the ordinances that you are to set before them:
aov_text: EN dit is die verordeninge wat jy hulle moet voorhou:

kjv_text: If thou buy an Hebrew servant, six years he shall serve: and in the seventh he shall go out free for nothing.
bsb_text: If you buy a Hebrew servant, he is to serve you for six years. But in the seventh year, he shall go free without paying anything.
aov_text: As jy ’n Hebreeuse slaaf koop, moet hy ses jaar lank dien, maar in die sewende moet hy as vryman verniet weggaan.

kjv_text: If he came in by himself, he shall go out by himself: if he were married, then his wife shall go out with him.
bsb_text: If he arrived alone, he is to leave alone; if he arrived with a wife, she is to leave with him.
aov_text: As hy alleen kom, moet hy alleen vrygelaat word; as hy getroud is, moet sy vrou saam met hom vrygelaat word.

kjv_text: If his master have given him a wife, and she have born him sons or daughters; the wife and her children shall be her master's, and he shall go out by himself.
bsb_text: If his master gives him a wife and she bears him sons or daughters, the woman and her children shall belong to her master, and only the man shall go free.
aov_text: As sy heer aan hom ’n vrou gee en sy vir hom seuns of dogters baar, moet die vrou met haar kinders haar heer se eiendom wees, terwyl hy alleen vrygelaat word.

kjv_text: And if the servant shall plainly say, I love my master, my wife, and my children; I will not go out free:
bsb_text: But if the servant declares, ‘I love my master and my wife and children; I do not want to go free,’
aov_text: Maar as die slaaf reguit sê: Ek het my heer, my vrou en my kinders lief; ek wil nie as vryman weggaan nie—

kjv_text: Then his master shall bring him unto the judges; he shall also bring him to the door, or unto the door post; and his master shall bore his ear through with an aul; and he shall serve him for ever.
bsb_text: then his master is to bring him before the judges. And he shall take him to the door or doorpost and pierce his ear with an awl. Then he shall serve his master for life.
aov_text: dan moet sy heer hom na die owerhede bring en hom by die deur of die deurpos bring; en sy heer moet sy oor met ’n els deurboor; daarna moet hy hom vir altyd dien.

kjv_text: And if a man sell his daughter to be a maidservant, she shall not go out as the menservants do.
bsb_text: And if a man sells his daughter as a servant, she is not to go free as the menservants do.
aov_text: En as iemand sy dogter as slavin verkoop, mag sy nie soos die slawe weggaan nie.

kjv_text: If she please not her master, who hath betrothed her to himself, then shall he let her be redeemed: to sell her unto a strange nation he shall have no power, seeing he hath dealt deceitfully with her.
bsb_text: If she is displeasing in the eyes of her master who had designated her for himself, he must allow her to be redeemed. He has no right to sell her to foreigners, since he has broken faith with her.
aov_text: As sy haar heer nie beval nie wat haar vir homself bestem het, moet hy haar laat loskoop. Hy is nie geregtig om haar aan ’n vreemde volk te verkoop nie, omdat hy troueloos met haar gehandel het.

kjv_text: And if he have betrothed her unto his son, he shall deal with her after the manner of daughters.
bsb_text: And if he chooses her for his son, he must deal with her as with a daughter.
aov_text: Maar as hy haar vir sy seun bestem, moet hy met haar handel volgens die reg van die dogters;

kjv_text: If he take him another wife; her food, her raiment, and her duty of marriage, shall he not diminish.
bsb_text: If he takes another wife, he must not reduce the food, clothing, or marital rights of his first wife.
aov_text: as hy vir hom ’n ander een neem, mag hy haar voedsel, haar klere en haar huweliksgemeenskap nie verminder nie.

kjv_text: And if he do not these three unto her, then shall she go out free without money.
bsb_text: If, however, he does not provide her with these three things, she is free to go without monetary payment.
aov_text: En as hy hierdie drie dinge nie vir haar doen nie, kan sy verniet weggaan, sonder geld.

kjv_text: He that smiteth a man, so that he die, shall be surely put to death.
bsb_text: Whoever strikes and kills a man must surely be put to death.
aov_text: Hy wat ’n mens slaan, dat hy sterwe, moet sekerlik gedood word.

kjv_text: And if a man lie not in wait, but God deliver him into his hand; then I will appoint thee a place whither he shall flee.
bsb_text: If, however, he did not lie in wait, but God allowed it to happen, then I will appoint for you a place where he may flee.
aov_text: Maar as hy dit daar nie op toegelê het nie, maar God dit sy hand laat ontmoet het, dan sal Ek jou ’n plek aanwys waarheen hy kan vlug.

kjv_text: But if a man come presumptuously upon his neighbour, to slay him with guile; thou shalt take him from mine altar, that he may die.
bsb_text: But if a man schemes and acts willfully against his neighbor to kill him, you must take him away from My altar to be put to death.
