aov_text: Maar as iemand moedswillig teen sy naaste handel, om hom met lis dood te maak, moet jy hom van my altaar af wegneem, om te sterwe.

kjv_text: And he that smiteth his father, or his mother, shall be surely put to death.
bsb_text: Whoever strikes his father or mother must surely be put to death.
aov_text: En hy wat sy vader of moeder slaan, moet sekerlik gedood word.

kjv_text: And he that stealeth a man, and selleth him, or if he be found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.
bsb_text: Whoever kidnaps another man must be put to death, whether he sells him or the man is found in his possession.
aov_text: En hy wat ’n mens steel en hom verkoop—of as hy in sy besit gevind word—dié moet sekerlik gedood word.

kjv_text: And he that curseth his father, or his mother, shall surely be put to death.
bsb_text: Anyone who curses his father or mother must surely be put to death.
aov_text: En hy wat sy vader of moeder vloek, moet sekerlik gedood word.

kjv_text: And if men strive together, and one smite another with a stone, or with his fist, and he die not, but keepeth his bed:
bsb_text: If men are quarreling and one strikes the other with a stone or a fist, and he does not die but is confined to bed,
aov_text: En as manne twis en die een die ander slaan met ’n klip of met die vuis, sodat hy nie sterwe nie, maar bedlêend word—

kjv_text: If he rise again, and walk abroad upon his staff, then shall he that smote him be quit: only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall cause him to be thoroughly healed.
bsb_text: then the one who struck him shall go unpunished, as long as the other can get up and walk around outside with his staff. Nevertheless, he must compensate the man for his lost work and see that he is completely healed.
aov_text: as hy weer opstaan en buite met sy stok rondloop, moet hy wat geslaan het, ongestraf bly; net sy tydverlies moet hy vergoed en sorg dat hy heeltemal gesond word.

kjv_text: And if a man smite his servant, or his maid, with a rod, and he die under his hand; he shall be surely punished.
bsb_text: If a man strikes his manservant or maidservant with a rod, and the servant dies by his hand, he shall surely be punished.
aov_text: En as iemand sy slaaf of slavin met ’n stok slaan, dat dié onder sy hand sterwe, moet dit sekerlik gewreek word.

kjv_text: Notwithstanding, if he continue a day or two, he shall not be punished: for he is his money.
bsb_text: However, if the servant gets up after a day or two, the owner shall not be punished, since the servant is his property.
aov_text: Maar as hy ná een of twee dae nog lewe, moet dit nie gewreek word nie, want hy is sy eiendom.

kjv_text: If men strive, and hurt a woman with child, so that her fruit depart from her, and yet no mischief follow: he shall be surely punished, according as the woman's husband will lay upon him; and he shall pay as the judges determine.
bsb_text: If men who are fighting strike a pregnant woman and her child is born prematurely, but there is no further injury, he shall surely be fined as the woman’s husband demands and as the court allows.
aov_text: En as manne met mekaar veg en ’n swanger vrou so stamp dat haar vrug afgaan, maar daar geen ander letsel is nie, moet hy sekerlik boete betaal soos die man van die vrou hom dit oplê, en hy moet dit deur skeidsregters gee.

kjv_text: And if any mischief follow, then thou shalt give life for life,
bsb_text: But if a serious injury results, then you must require a life for a life—
aov_text: Maar is daar ’n letsel, dan moet jy gee lewe vir lewe,

kjv_text: Eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
bsb_text: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
aov_text: oog vir oog, tand vir tand, hand vir hand, voet vir voet,

kjv_text: Burning for burning, wound for wound, stripe for stripe.
bsb_text: burn for burn, wound for wound, and stripe for stripe.
aov_text: brandplek vir brandplek, wond vir wond, kwesplek vir kwesplek.

kjv_text: And if a man smite the eye of his servant, or the eye of his maid, that it perish; he shall let him go free for his eye's sake.
bsb_text: If a man strikes and blinds the eye of his manservant or maidservant, he must let the servant go free as compensation for the eye.
aov_text: En as iemand sy slaaf of slavin op die oog slaan en hy dit beskadig, moet hy hom vry laat weggaan vir sy oog.

kjv_text: And if he smite out his manservant's tooth, or his maidservant's tooth; he shall let him go free for his tooth's sake.
bsb_text: And if he knocks out the tooth of his manservant or maidservant, he must let the servant go free as compensation for the tooth.
aov_text: En as hy die tand van sy slaaf of die tand van sy slavin uitslaan, moet hy hom vry laat weggaan vir sy tand.

kjv_text: If an ox gore a man or a woman, that they die: then the ox shall be surely stoned, and his flesh shall not be eaten; but the owner of the ox shall be quit.
bsb_text: If an ox gores a man or woman to death, the ox must surely be stoned, and its meat must not be eaten. But the owner of the ox shall not be held responsible.
aov_text: En as ’n bees ’n man of ’n vrou stoot, sodat hy sterwe, moet die bees sekerlik gestenig word; en sy vleis mag nie geëet word nie, maar die baas van die bees sal ongestraf bly.

kjv_text: But if the ox were wont to push with his horn in time past, and it hath been testified to his owner, and he hath not kept him in, but that he hath killed a man or a woman; the ox shall be stoned, and his owner also shall be put to death.
bsb_text: But if the ox has a habit of goring, and its owner has been warned yet does not restrain it, and it kills a man or woman, then the ox must be stoned and its owner must also be put to death.
aov_text: Maar as die bees tevore al stoterig gewees het en sy baas gewaarsku was, maar dit nie opgepas het nie, en dit ’n man of ’n vrou doodmaak, moet die bees gestenig word, en sy baas moet ook gedood word.

kjv_text: If there be laid on him a sum of money, then he shall give for the ransom of his life whatsoever is laid upon him.
bsb_text: If payment is demanded of him instead, he may redeem his life by paying the full amount demanded of him.
aov_text: As aan hom losgeld opgelê word, moet hy vir die lossing van sy lewe alles gee wat hom opgelê word.

kjv_text: Whether he have gored a son, or have gored a daughter, according to this judgment shall it be done unto him.
bsb_text: If the ox gores a son or a daughter, it shall be done to him according to the same rule.
aov_text: Of dit ’n seun gestoot het of ’n dogter, volgens hierdie reg moet met hom gehandel word.

kjv_text: If the ox shall push a manservant or a maidservant; he shall give unto their master thirty shekels of silver, and the ox shall be stoned.
bsb_text: If the ox gores a manservant or maidservant, the owner must pay thirty shekels of silver to the master of that servant, and the ox must be stoned.
aov_text: As die bees ’n slaaf of slavin stoot, moet hy aan hulle heer dertig sikkels silwer gee, en die bees moet gestenig word.

kjv_text: And if a man shall open a pit, or if a man shall dig a pit, and not cover it, and an ox or an ass fall therein;
bsb_text: If a man opens or digs a pit and fails to cover it, and an ox or a donkey falls into it,
aov_text: En as iemand ’n put oopmaak, of as iemand ’n put grawe en dit nie toemaak nie, en ’n bees of esel val daarin,

kjv_text: The owner of the pit shall make it good, and give money unto the owner of them; and the dead beast shall be his.
bsb_text: the owner of the pit shall make restitution; he must pay its owner, and the dead animal will be his.
aov_text: moet die eienaar van die put vergoeding gee: hy moet aan die eienaar van die dier geld gee, maar die dooie dier moet syne wees.

kjv_text: And if one man's ox hurt another's, that he die; then they shall sell the live ox, and divide the money of it; and the dead ox also they shall divide.
bsb_text: If a man’s ox injures his neighbor’s ox and it dies, they must sell the live one and divide the proceeds; they also must divide the dead animal.
aov_text: En as iemand se bees die bees van ’n ander stoot, sodat dit sterwe, moet hulle die lewendige bees verkoop en die geld daarvan verdeel; en die dooie een moet hulle ook verdeel.

kjv_text: Or if it be known that the ox hath used to push in time past, and his owner hath not kept him in; he shall surely pay ox for ox; and the dead shall be his own.
bsb_text: But if it was known that the ox had a habit of goring, yet its owner failed to restrain it, he shall pay full compensation, ox for ox, and the dead animal will be his.
aov_text: Of as dit bekend was dat die bees tevore al stoterig gewees het, en sy baas dit nie opgepas het nie, moet hy ten volle bees vir bees vergoed; maar die dooie een moet syne wees.

kjv_text: If a man shall steal an ox, or a sheep, and kill it, or sell it; he shall restore five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.
bsb_text: “If a man steals an ox or a sheep and slaughters or sells it, he must repay five oxen for an ox and four sheep for a sheep.
aov_text: AS iemand ’n bees of ’n stuk kleinvee steel en dit slag of verkoop, moet hy vyf beeste vir ’n bees vergoed en vier stuks kleinvee vir ’n stuk kleinvee.

kjv_text: If a thief be found breaking up, and be smitten that he die, there shall no blood be shed for him.
bsb_text: If a thief is caught breaking in and is beaten to death, no one shall be guilty of bloodshed.
aov_text: As ’n dief betrap word terwyl hy inbreek, en hy word geslaan, sodat hy sterwe, sal daardeur geen bloedskuld ontstaan nie;

kjv_text: If the sun be risen upon him, there shall be blood shed for him; for he should make full restitution; if he have nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.
bsb_text: But if it happens after sunrise, there is guilt for his bloodshed. A thief must make full restitution; if he has nothing, he himself shall be sold for his theft.
aov_text: as die son oor hom opgegaan het, ontstaan daardeur bloedskuld. Hy moet ten volle vergoeding gee; as hy niks het nie, moet hy vir sy diefstal verkoop word.

kjv_text: If the theft be certainly found in his hand alive, whether it be ox, or ass, or sheep; he shall restore double.
bsb_text: If what was stolen is actually found alive in his possession—whether ox or donkey or sheep—he must pay back double.
aov_text: As die gesteelde goed—of dit ’n bees, ’n esel of ’n stuk kleinvee is—nog lewendig in sy besit gevind word, moet hy dubbel vergoeding gee.

kjv_text: If a man shall cause a field or vineyard to be eaten, and shall put in his beast, and shall feed in another man's field; of the best of his own field, and of the best of his own vineyard, shall he make restitution.
bsb_text: If a man grazes his livestock in a field or vineyard and allows them to stray so that they graze in someone else’s field, he must make restitution from the best of his own field or vineyard.
aov_text: As iemand ’n stuk veld of ’n wingerd laat afwei en sy vee vry laat loop, sodat dit in die veld van ’n ander wei, moet hy van die beste van sy veld en die beste van sy wingerd as vergoeding gee.

kjv_text: If fire break out, and catch in thorns, so that the stacks of corn, or the standing corn, or the field, be consumed therewith; he that kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.
bsb_text: If a fire breaks out and spreads to thornbushes so that it consumes stacked or standing grain, or the whole field, the one who started the fire must make full restitution.
aov_text: As ’n vuur uitbreek en die dorings vat, sodat ’n mied of die ongesnyde graan of die veld verteer word, moet hy wat die vuur aan die brand gesteek het, ten volle vergoeding gee.

kjv_text: If a man shall deliver unto his neighbour money or stuff to keep, and it be stolen out of the man's house; if the thief be found, let him pay double.
bsb_text: If a man gives his neighbor money or goods for safekeeping and they are stolen from the neighbor’s house, the thief, if caught, must pay back double.
aov_text: As iemand aan sy naaste geld of goed in bewaring gee, en dit word uit die man se huis gesteel, moet die dief, as hy uitgevind word, dubbel vergoeding gee.

kjv_text: If the thief be not found, then the master of the house shall be brought unto the judges, to see whether he have put his hand unto his neighbour's goods.
bsb_text: If the thief is not found, the owner of the house must appear before the judges to determine whether he has taken his neighbor’s property.
aov_text: As die dief nie uitgevind word nie, moet die eienaar van die huis na die owerhede gaan om te beslis of hy nie sy hand na sy naaste se goed uitgesteek het nie.

kjv_text: For all manner of trespass, whether it be for ox, for ass, for sheep, for raiment, or for any manner of lost thing, which another challengeth to be his, the cause of both parties shall come before the judges; and whom the judges shall condemn, he shall pay double unto his neighbour.
bsb_text: In all cases of illegal possession of an ox, a donkey, a sheep, a garment, or any lost item that someone claims, ‘This is mine,’ both parties shall bring their cases before the judges. The one whom the judges find guilty must pay back double to his neighbor.
aov_text: By alle sake van ontvreemding, of dit gaan oor ’n bees, oor ’n esel, oor kleinvee, oor klere of oor enigiets wat verloor is, waarvan iemand sê: Dit is myne!—moet die saak van altwee voor die owerhede kom; die een wat die owerhede skuldig verklaar, moet aan sy naaste dubbel vergoeding gee.

kjv_text: If a man deliver unto his neighbour an ass, or an ox, or a sheep, or any beast, to keep; and it die, or be hurt, or driven away, no man seeing it:
bsb_text: If a man gives a donkey, an ox, a sheep, or any other animal to be cared for by his neighbor, but it dies or is injured or stolen while no one is watching,
aov_text: As iemand aan sy naaste ’n esel of bees of stuk kleinvee of enige dier gee om op te pas, en dit gaan dood of kry ’n ongeluk of word weggevoer sonder dat iemand dit sien,

kjv_text: Then shall an oath of the LORD be between them both, that he hath not put his hand unto his neighbour's goods; and the owner of it shall accept thereof, and he shall not make it good.
bsb_text: an oath before the LORD shall be made between the parties to determine whether or not the man has taken his neighbor’s property. The owner must accept the oath and require no restitution.
aov_text: dan moet die eed by die HERE tussen hulle twee beslis, of hy nie sy hand na sy naaste se goed uitgesteek het nie; en die eienaar moet daarmee tevrede wees, en die ander hoef geen vergoeding te gee nie.

kjv_text: And if it be stolen from him, he shall make restitution unto the owner thereof.
bsb_text: But if the animal was actually stolen from the neighbor, he must make restitution to the owner.
aov_text: Maar as dit van hom weggesteel is, moet hy aan die eienaar vergoeding gee.

kjv_text: If it be torn in pieces, then let him bring it for witness, and he shall not make good that which was torn.
bsb_text: If the animal was torn to pieces, he shall bring it as evidence; he need not make restitution for the torn carcass.
aov_text: As dit verskeur is, moet hy dit as bewys bring; wat verskeur is, hoef hy nie te vergoed nie.

kjv_text: And if a man borrow ought of his neighbour, and it be hurt, or die, the owner thereof being not with it, he shall surely make it good.
bsb_text: If a man borrows an animal from his neighbor and it is injured or dies while its owner is not present, he must make full restitution.
aov_text: En as iemand van sy naaste iets te leen vra, en dit kry ’n ongeluk of gaan dood terwyl die eienaar daar nie by is nie, moet hy ten volle vergoeding gee.

kjv_text: But if the owner thereof be with it, he shall not make it good: if it be an hired thing, it came for his hire.
bsb_text: If the owner was present, no restitution is required. If the animal was rented, the fee covers the loss.
aov_text: As die eienaar daarby gewees het, hoef hy geen vergoeding te gee nie. As dit gehuur was, kom die huurgeld daarvoor.

kjv_text: And if a man entice a maid that is not betrothed, and lie with her, he shall surely endow her to be his wife.
bsb_text: If a man seduces a virgin who is not pledged in marriage and sleeps with her, he must pay the full dowry for her to be his wife.
aov_text: As iemand ’n jongmeisie wat nie verloof is nie, verlei en met haar gemeenskap het, moet hy haar vir die volle huweliksprys as sy vrou koop.

kjv_text: If her father utterly refuse to give her unto him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.
bsb_text: If her father absolutely refuses to give her to him, the man still must pay an amount comparable to the bridal price of a virgin.
aov_text: As haar vader beslis weier om haar aan hom te gee, moet hy geld gee volgens die huweliksprys vir jongmeisies.

kjv_text: Thou shalt not suffer a witch to live.
bsb_text: You must not allow a sorceress to live.
aov_text: Die towerheks mag jy nie laat lewe nie.

kjv_text: Whosoever lieth with a beast shall surely be put to death.
bsb_text: Whoever lies with an animal must surely be put to death.
aov_text: Elkeen wat met ’n dier gemeenskap het, moet sekerlik gedood word.

kjv_text: He that sacrificeth unto any god, save unto the LORD only, he shall be utterly destroyed.
bsb_text: If anyone sacrifices to any god other than the LORD alone, he must be set apart for destruction.
aov_text: Hy wat aan die gode offer, behalwe aan die HERE alleen, moet met die banvloek getref word.

kjv_text: Thou shalt neither vex a stranger, nor oppress him: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
bsb_text: You must not exploit or oppress a foreign resident, for you yourselves were foreigners in the land of Egypt.
aov_text: Jy mag ook die vreemdeling nie kwel of hom verdruk nie, want julle was vreemdelinge in Egipteland.

kjv_text: Ye shall not afflict any widow, or fatherless child.
bsb_text: You must not mistreat any widow or orphan.
aov_text: Julle mag geen weduwee of wees verdruk nie.

kjv_text: If thou afflict them in any wise, and they cry at all unto me, I will surely hear their cry;
bsb_text: If you do mistreat them, and they cry out to Me in distress, I will surely hear their cry.
aov_text: As jy hulle op enige manier verdruk, waarlik, dan sal Ek, as hulle na My roep, hulle geroep sekerlik hoor,

kjv_text: And my wrath shall wax hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.
bsb_text: My anger will be kindled, and I will kill you with the sword; then your wives will become widows and your children will be fatherless.
aov_text: en my toorn sal ontvlam, en Ek sal julle met die swaard ombring, sodat julle vroue weduwees en julle kinders wese word.

kjv_text: If thou lend money to any of my people that is poor by thee, thou shalt not be to him as an usurer, neither shalt thou lay upon him usury.
bsb_text: If you lend money to one of My people among you who is poor, you must not act as a creditor to him; you are not to charge him interest.
aov_text: As jy aan my volk, aan die arme by jou, geld leen, mag jy vir hom nie soos ’n skuldeiser wees nie: julle mag hom geen rente oplê nie.

kjv_text: If thou at all take thy neighbour's raiment to pledge, thou shalt deliver it unto him by that the sun goeth down:
bsb_text: If you take your neighbor’s cloak as collateral, return it to him by sunset,
aov_text: As jy ooit jou naaste se gewaad as pand neem, moet jy hom dit teruggee voor die son ondergaan;

kjv_text: For that is his covering only, it is his raiment for his skin: wherein shall he sleep? and it shall come to pass, when he crieth unto me, that I will hear; for I am gracious.
bsb_text: because his cloak is the only covering he has for his body. What else will he sleep in? And if he cries out to Me, I will hear, for I am compassionate.
aov_text: want dit is sy enigste bedekking, dit is die bekleding vir sy vel. Waarin moet hy anders slaap? En as hy na My roep, sal Ek hoor, want Ek is genadig.

kjv_text: Thou shalt not revile the gods, nor curse the ruler of thy people.
bsb_text: You must not blaspheme God or curse the ruler of your people.
aov_text: Jy mag God nie vloek nie, en ’n owerste onder jou volk mag jy nie verwens nie.

kjv_text: Thou shalt not delay to offer the first of thy ripe fruits, and of thy liquors: the firstborn of thy sons shalt thou give unto me.
bsb_text: You must not hold back offerings from your granaries or vats. You are to give Me the firstborn of your sons.
aov_text: Die offer uit jou volle opbrings en jou parskuip mag jy nie terughou nie. Die eersgeborene van jou seuns moet jy aan My gee.

kjv_text: Likewise shalt thou do with thine oxen, and with thy sheep: seven days it shall be with his dam; on the eighth day thou shalt give it me.
bsb_text: You shall do likewise with your cattle and your sheep. Let them stay with their mothers for seven days, but on the eighth day you are to give them to Me.
aov_text: Jy moet dieselfde doen met jou beeste en jou kleinvee: sewe dae moet dit by sy moeder wees; op die agtste dag moet jy dit aan My gee.

kjv_text: And ye shall be holy men unto me: neither shall ye eat any flesh that is torn of beasts in the field; ye shall cast it to the dogs.
bsb_text: You are to be My holy people. You must not eat the meat of a mauled animal found in the field; you are to throw it to the dogs.
aov_text: En julle moet vir My heilige mense wees. Daarom mag julle nie vleis eet wat in die veld verskeur is nie. Julle moet dit vir die honde gooi.

kjv_text: Thou shalt not raise a false report: put not thine hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness.
bsb_text: “You shall not spread a false report. Do not join the wicked by being a malicious witness.
aov_text: JY mag geen valse gerug rondstrooi nie. Verbind jou nie met die skuldige om ’n kwaadwillige getuie te wees nie.

kjv_text: Thou shalt not follow a multitude to do evil; neither shalt thou speak in a cause to decline after many to wrest judgment:
bsb_text: You shall not follow the crowd in wrongdoing. When you testify in a lawsuit, do not pervert justice by siding with the crowd.
aov_text: Jy mag die meerderheid nie volg in verkeerde dinge nie. En jy mag in ’n regsaak geen getuienis aflê agter die meerderheid aan om die reg te verdraai nie.

kjv_text: Neither shalt thou countenance a poor man in his cause.
bsb_text: And do not show favoritism to a poor man in his lawsuit.
aov_text: Ook mag jy die geringe nie voortrek in sy regsaak nie.

kjv_text: If thou meet thine enemy's ox or his ass going astray, thou shalt surely bring it back to him again.
bsb_text: If you encounter your enemy’s stray ox or donkey, you must return it to him.
aov_text: As jy jou vyand se bees of esel teëkom wat ronddwaal, moet jy dit sekerlik vir hom terugbring.

kjv_text: If thou see the ass of him that hateth thee lying under his burden, and wouldest forbear to help him, thou shalt surely help with him.
bsb_text: If you see the donkey of one who hates you fallen under its load, do not leave it there; you must help him with it.
aov_text: As jy jou vyand se esel onder sy pak sien lê, moet jy dit nie onverskillig aan hom oorlaat nie: jy moet dit sekerlik saam met hom aflaai.

kjv_text: Thou shalt not wrest the judgment of thy poor in his cause.
bsb_text: You shall not deny justice to the poor in their lawsuits.
aov_text: Jy mag die reg van jou arm mense in hulle regsaak nie verdraai nie.

kjv_text: Keep thee far from a false matter; and the innocent and righteous slay thou not: for I will not justify the wicked.
bsb_text: Stay far away from a false accusation. Do not kill the innocent or the just, for I will not acquit the guilty.
aov_text: Hou jou ver van valse sake af. En moenie die onskuldige en die wat reg het, ombring nie, want Ek sal die skuldige nie regverdig verklaar nie.

kjv_text: And thou shalt take no gift: for the gift blindeth the wise, and perverteth the words of the righteous.
bsb_text: Do not accept a bribe, for a bribe blinds those who see and twists the words of the righteous.
aov_text: Ook mag jy geen omkoopgeskenk aanneem nie; want die geskenk maak die siendes blind en verdraai die sake van die regverdiges.

kjv_text: Also thou shalt not oppress a stranger: for ye know the heart of a stranger, seeing ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
bsb_text: Do not oppress a foreign resident, since you yourselves know how it feels to be foreigners; for you were foreigners in the land of Egypt.
aov_text: Jy mag die vreemdeling ook nie verdruk nie; want julle ken self die gemoed van ’n vreemdeling, omdat julle vreemdelinge in Egipteland gewees het.

kjv_text: And six years thou shalt sow thy land, and shalt gather in the fruits thereof:
bsb_text: For six years you are to sow your land and gather its produce,
aov_text: En ses jaar lank moet jy jou land besaai en die opbrings daarvan insamel;

kjv_text: But the seventh year thou shalt let it rest and lie still; that the poor of thy people may eat: and what they leave the beasts of the field shall eat. In like manner thou shalt deal with thy vineyard, and with thy oliveyard.
bsb_text: but in the seventh year you must let it rest and lie fallow, so that the poor among your people may eat from the field and the wild animals may consume what they leave. Do the same with your vineyard and olive grove.
aov_text: maar in die sewende moet jy dit ongebruik en braak laat lê, dat die arm mense van jou volk kan eet; en wat hulle laat oorbly, kan die diere van die veld opeet. So moet jy doen met jou wingerd en jou olyfbome.

kjv_text: Six days thou shalt do thy work, and on the seventh day thou shalt rest: that thine ox and thine ass may rest, and the son of thy handmaid, and the stranger, may be refreshed.
bsb_text: For six days you are to do your work, but on the seventh day you must cease, so that your ox and your donkey may rest and the son of your maidservant may be refreshed, as well as the foreign resident.
aov_text: Ses dae moet jy jou werk verrig, maar op die sewende dag moet jy rus, dat jou os en jou esel kan uitrus en die seun van jou slavin en die vreemdeling kan asem skep.

kjv_text: And in all things that I have said unto you be circumspect: and make no mention of the name of other gods, neither let it be heard out of thy mouth.
bsb_text: Pay close attention to everything I have said to you. You must not invoke the names of other gods; they must not be heard on your lips.
aov_text: En in alles wat Ek julle gesê het, moet julle jul in ag neem. En die naam van ander gode mag julle nie vermeld nie; dit mag uit jou mond nie gehoor word nie.

kjv_text: Three times thou shalt keep a feast unto me in the year.
bsb_text: Three times a year you are to celebrate a feast to Me.
aov_text: Drie maal in die jaar moet jy vir My ’n fees hou.

kjv_text: Thou shalt keep the feast of unleavened bread: (thou shalt eat unleavened bread seven days, as I commanded thee, in the time appointed of the month Abib; for in it thou camest out from Egypt: and none shall appear before me empty:)
bsb_text: You are to keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread as I commanded you: At the appointed time in the month of Abib you are to eat unleavened bread for seven days, because that was the month you came out of Egypt. No one may appear before Me empty-handed.
aov_text: Die fees van die ongesuurde brode moet jy hou: sewe dae lank moet jy ongesuurde brode eet soos Ek jou beveel het, op die bepaalde tyd in die maand Abib, want daarin het jy uit Egipte uitgetrek—maar hulle mag nie met leë hande voor my aangesig verskyn nie;

kjv_text: And the feast of harvest, the firstfruits of thy labours, which thou hast sown in the field: and the feast of ingathering, which is in the end of the year, when thou hast gathered in thy labours out of the field.
bsb_text: You are also to keep the Feast of Harvest with the firstfruits of the produce from what you sow in the field. And keep the Feast of Ingathering at the end of the year, when you gather your produce from the field.
aov_text: verder die fees van die oes, van die eerstelinge van jou werk, van wat jy op die land saai; en ook die fees van die insameling aan die einde van die jaar as jy jou werk uit die land insamel.

kjv_text: Three times in the year all thy males shall appear before the LORD God.
bsb_text: Three times a year all your males are to appear before the Lord GOD.
aov_text: Drie maal in die jaar moet al jou manspersone voor die aangesig van die Here HERE verskyn.

kjv_text: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread; neither shall the fat of my sacrifice remain until the morning.
bsb_text: You must not offer the blood of My sacrifices with anything leavened, nor may the fat of My feast remain until morning.
aov_text: Jy mag die bloed van my offer nie saam met gesuurde brood offer nie. Ook mag die vet van my feesoffer nie tot die môre toe oorbly nie.

kjv_text: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring into the house of the LORD thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother's milk.
bsb_text: Bring the best of the firstfruits of your soil to the house of the LORD your God. You must not cook a young goat in its mother’s milk.
aov_text: Die beste van die eerstelinge van jou grond moet jy in die huis van die HERE jou God bring. Jy mag die bokkie nie kook in sy moeder se melk nie.

kjv_text: Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared.
bsb_text: Behold, I am sending an angel before you to protect you along the way and to bring you to the place I have prepared.
aov_text: Kyk, Ek stuur ’n Engel voor jou uit om jou op die pad te bewaar en om jou na die plek te bring wat Ek gereedgemaak het.

kjv_text: Beware of him, and obey his voice, provoke him not; for he will not pardon your transgressions: for my name is in him.
bsb_text: Pay attention to him and listen to his voice; do not defy him, for he will not forgive rebellion, since My Name is in him.
aov_text: Neem jou in ag vir Hom en luister na sy stem; wees nie wederstrewig teen Hom nie; want Hy sal julle oortreding nie vergewe nie, want my Naam is in Hom.

kjv_text: But if thou shalt indeed obey his voice, and do all that I speak; then I will be an enemy unto thine enemies, and an adversary unto thine adversaries.
bsb_text: But if you will listen carefully to his voice and do everything I say, I will be an enemy to your enemies and a foe to your foes.
aov_text: Maar as jy terdeë na sy stem luister en alles doen wat Ek sal sê, sal Ek die vyand van jou vyande en die teëstander van jou teëstanders wees.

kjv_text: For mine Angel shall go before thee, and bring thee in unto the Amorites, and the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites: and I will cut them off.
bsb_text: For My angel will go before you and bring you into the land of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites, and Jebusites, and I will annihilate them.
aov_text: Want my Engel sal voor jou uit gaan en jou bring na die Amoriete en Hetiete en Feresiete en Kanaäniete, Hewiete en Jebusiete; en Ek sal hulle vernietig.

kjv_text: Thou shalt not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor do after their works: but thou shalt utterly overthrow them, and quite break down their images.
bsb_text: You must not bow down to their gods or serve them or follow their practices. Instead, you are to demolish them and smash their sacred stones to pieces.
aov_text: Jy mag jou voor hulle gode nie neerbuig en hulle nie dien nie, ook mag jy nie doen na hulle werke nie; maar jy moet hulle heeltemal afbreek en hulle klippilare kort en klein slaan.

kjv_text: And ye shall serve the LORD your God, and he shall bless thy bread, and thy water; and I will take sickness away from the midst of thee.
bsb_text: So you shall serve the LORD your God, and He will bless your bread and your water. And I will take away sickness from among you.
aov_text: En julle moet die HERE julle God dien; dan sal Hy jou brood en jou water seën, en Ek sal siektes uit jou midde verwyder.

kjv_text: There shall nothing cast their young, nor be barren, in thy land: the number of thy days I will fulfil.
bsb_text: No woman in your land will miscarry or be barren; I will fulfill the number of your days.
aov_text: Daar sal geen misdragtige of onvrugbare in jou land wees nie. Ek sal die getal van jou dae vol maak.

kjv_text: I will send my fear before thee, and will destroy all the people to whom thou shalt come, and I will make all thine enemies turn their backs unto thee.
bsb_text: I will send My terror ahead of you and throw into confusion every nation you encounter. I will make all your enemies turn and run.
aov_text: Ek sal my skrik voor jou uit stuur en elke volk waarby jy kom, in verwarring bring. En Ek sal al jou vyande vir jou laat vlug.

kjv_text: And I will send hornets before thee, which shall drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before thee.
bsb_text: I will send the hornet before you to drive the Hivites and Canaanites and Hittites out of your way.
aov_text: Ook sal Ek perdebye voor jou uit stuur; dié sal die Hewiete, Kanaäniete en Hetiete voor jou uit verdrywe.

kjv_text: I will not drive them out from before thee in one year; lest the land become desolate, and the beast of the field multiply against thee.
bsb_text: I will not drive them out before you in a single year; otherwise the land would become desolate and wild animals would multiply against you.
aov_text: Ek sal hulle nie in een jaar voor jou uit verdrywe nie, dat die land nie woes word en die ongediertes nie teen jou te veel word nie.

kjv_text: By little and little I will drive them out from before thee, until thou be increased, and inherit the land.
bsb_text: Little by little I will drive them out ahead of you, until you become fruitful and possess the land.
aov_text: Ek sal hulle so langsamerhand voor jou uit verdrywe, totdat jy vrugbaar word en die land beërwe.

kjv_text: And I will set thy bounds from the Red sea even unto the sea of the Philistines, and from the desert unto the river: for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand; and thou shalt drive them out before thee.
bsb_text: And I will establish your borders from the Red Sea to the Sea of the Philistines, and from the desert to the Euphrates. For I will deliver the inhabitants into your hand, and you will drive them out before you.
aov_text: En Ek sal jou grense vasstel van die Skelfsee af tot by die See van die Filistyne, en van die woestyn af tot by die Eufraat. Want Ek sal die inwoners van die land in julle hand gee, en jy sal hulle voor jou uit verdrywe.

kjv_text: Thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.
bsb_text: You shall make no covenant with them or with their gods.
aov_text: Jy mag met hulle of met hulle gode geen verbond maak nie.

kjv_text: They shall not dwell in thy land, lest they make thee sin against me: for if thou serve their gods, it will surely be a snare unto thee.
bsb_text: They must not remain in your land, lest they cause you to sin against Me. For if you serve their gods, it will surely be a snare to you.”
aov_text: Hulle mag in jou land nie woon nie, dat hulle jou nie verlei om teen My te sondig nie. Want jy sal hulle gode dien, ja, dit sal vir jou ’n strik wees.

kjv_text: And he said unto Moses, Come up unto the LORD, thou, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship ye afar off.
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Come up to the LORD—you and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of Israel’s elders—and you are to worship at a distance.
aov_text: DAARNA het Hy vir Moses gesê: Klim na die HERE toe op, jy en Aäron, Nadab en Abíhu en sewentig van die oudstes van Israel, en buig julle neer van ver af.

kjv_text: And Moses alone shall come near the LORD: but they shall not come nigh; neither shall the people go up with him.
bsb_text: Moses alone shall approach the LORD, but the others must not come near. And the people may not go up with him.”
aov_text: En laat Moses alleen nader kom na die HERE toe, maar hulle moet nie nader kom nie; en die volk mag nie saam met hom opklim nie.

kjv_text: And Moses came and told the people all the words of the LORD, and all the judgments: and all the people answered with one voice, and said, All the words which the LORD hath said will we do.
bsb_text: When Moses came and told the people all the words and ordinances of the LORD, they all responded with one voice: “All the words that the LORD has spoken, we will do.”
aov_text: Toe Moses kom en aan die volk al die woorde van die HERE en al die verordeninge vertel, antwoord die hele volk met een stem en sê: Al die woorde wat die HERE gespreek het, sal ons doen.

kjv_text: And Moses wrote all the words of the LORD, and rose up early in the morning, and builded an altar under the hill, and twelve pillars, according to the twelve tribes of Israel.
bsb_text: And Moses wrote down all the words of the LORD. Early the next morning he got up and built an altar at the base of the mountain, along with twelve pillars for the twelve tribes of Israel.
aov_text: En Moses het al die woorde van die HERE opgeskrywe en die môre vroeg hom klaargemaak en onder die berg ’n altaar gebou, en twaalf gedenkstene volgens die twaalf stamme van Israel.

kjv_text: And he sent young men of the children of Israel, which offered burnt offerings, and sacrificed peace offerings of oxen unto the LORD.
bsb_text: Then he sent out some young men of Israel, and they offered burnt offerings and sacrificed young bulls as peace offerings to the LORD.
aov_text: En hy het jongmanne van die kinders van Israel gestuur; dié het brandoffers geoffer en as dankoffers bulle vir die HERE geslag.

kjv_text: And Moses took half of the blood, and put it in basons; and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.
bsb_text: Moses took half of the blood and put it in bowls, and the other half he sprinkled on the altar.
aov_text: En Moses het die helfte van die bloed geneem en dit in komme gegooi en die helfte van die bloed teen die altaar uitgegooi.

kjv_text: And he took the book of the covenant, and read in the audience of the people: and they said, All that the LORD hath said will we do, and be obedient.
bsb_text: Then he took the Book of the Covenant and read it to the people, who replied, “All that the LORD has spoken we will do, and we will be obedient.”
aov_text: En hy het die boek van die verbond geneem en dit voor die ore van die volk gelees. En hulle het gesê: Alles wat die HERE gespreek het, sal ons doen en daarna luister.

kjv_text: And Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, Behold the blood of the covenant, which the LORD hath made with you concerning all these words.
bsb_text: So Moses took the blood, sprinkled it on the people, and said, “This is the blood of the covenant that the LORD has made with you in accordance with all these words.”
aov_text: Toe neem Moses die bloed en gooi dit uit op die volk en sê: Dit is die bloed van die verbond wat die HERE met julle gesluit het op grond van al hierdie woorde.

kjv_text: Then went up Moses, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel:
bsb_text: Then Moses went up with Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel,
aov_text: Daarop het Moses opgeklim met Aäron, Nadab en Abíhu en sewentig van die oudstes van Israel.

kjv_text: And they saw the God of Israel: and there was under his feet as it were a paved work of a sapphire stone, and as it were the body of heaven in his clearness.
bsb_text: and they saw the God of Israel. Under His feet was a work like a pavement made of sapphire, as clear as the sky itself.
aov_text: En hulle het die God van Israel gesien, en onder sy voete net soos ’n vloerwerk van saffierstene en so helder soos die hemel self.

kjv_text: And upon the nobles of the children of Israel he laid not his hand: also they saw God, and did eat and drink.
bsb_text: But God did not lay His hand on the nobles of Israel; they saw Him, and they ate and drank.
aov_text: Maar Hy het sy hand nie na die uitgesoektes van die kinders van Israel uitgestrek nie, en hulle het God aanskou; daarop het hulle geëet en gedrink.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Come up to me into the mount, and be there: and I will give thee tables of stone, and a law, and commandments which I have written; that thou mayest teach them.
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Come up to Me on the mountain and stay here, so that I may give you the tablets of stone, with the law and commandments I have written for their instruction.”
aov_text: Toe sê die HERE vir Moses: Klim op die berg na My toe en vertoef daar, dat Ek jou die kliptafels kan gee en die wet en gebooie wat Ek geskryf het om hulle te onderrig.

kjv_text: And Moses rose up, and his minister Joshua: and Moses went up into the mount of God.
bsb_text: So Moses set out with Joshua his attendant and went up on the mountain of God.
aov_text: Hierop het Moses klaargemaak en Josua, sy dienaar. En Moses het op die berg van God geklim

kjv_text: And he said unto the elders, Tarry ye here for us, until we come again unto you: and, behold, Aaron and Hur are with you: if any man have any matters to do, let him come unto them.
bsb_text: And he said to the elders, “Wait here for us until we return to you. Aaron and Hur are here with you. Whoever has a dispute can go to them.”
aov_text: en aan die oudstes gesê: Wag hier vir ons tot ons na julle terugkom. En kyk, Aäron en Hur is by julle; wie regsake het, kan na hulle gaan.

kjv_text: And Moses went up into the mount, and a cloud covered the mount.
bsb_text: When Moses went up on the mountain, the cloud covered it,
aov_text: Toe Moses die berg opklim, het ’n wolk die berg oordek.

kjv_text: And the glory of the LORD abode upon mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days: and the seventh day he called unto Moses out of the midst of the cloud.
bsb_text: and the glory of the LORD settled on Mount Sinai. For six days the cloud covered it, and on the seventh day the LORD called to Moses from within the cloud.
aov_text: En die heerlikheid van die HERE het op die berg Sinai gebly, en die wolk het dit ses dae lank oordek. En op die sewende dag het Hy na Moses geroep uit die wolk.

kjv_text: And the sight of the glory of the LORD was like devouring fire on the top of the mount in the eyes of the children of Israel.
bsb_text: And the sight of the glory of the LORD was like a consuming fire on the mountaintop in the eyes of the Israelites.
aov_text: En die verskyning van die HERE se heerlikheid was in die oë van die kinders van Israel soos ’n verterende vuur op die top van die berg.

kjv_text: And Moses went into the midst of the cloud, and gat him up into the mount: and Moses was in the mount forty days and forty nights.
bsb_text: Moses entered the cloud as he went up on the mountain, and he remained on the mountain forty days and forty nights.
aov_text: En Moses het binne-in die wolk ingegaan en die berg opgeklim. En Moses was op die berg veertig dae en veertig nagte.

kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to Moses,
aov_text: TOE het die HERE met Moses gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring me an offering: of every man that giveth it willingly with his heart ye shall take my offering.
bsb_text: “Tell the Israelites to bring Me an offering. You are to receive My offering from every man whose heart compels him.
aov_text: Sê aan die kinders van Israel dat hulle aan My ’n offergawe moet bring; van elkeen wie se hart hom aandrywe, moet julle my offergawe bring.

kjv_text: And this is the offering which ye shall take of them; gold, and silver, and brass,
bsb_text: This is the offering you are to accept from them: gold, silver, and bronze;
aov_text: En dit is die offergawe wat julle van hulle kant moet bring: goud en silwer en koper;

kjv_text: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' hair,
bsb_text: blue, purple, and scarlet yarn; fine linen and goat hair;
aov_text: en pers en purperrooi en bloedrooi stowwe en fyn linne en bokhaar;

kjv_text: And rams' skins dyed red, and badgers' skins, and shittim wood,
bsb_text: ram skins dyed red and fine leather; acacia wood;
aov_text: en rooigeverfde ramsvelle en robbevelle en akasiahout;

kjv_text: Oil for the light, spices for anointing oil, and for sweet incense,
bsb_text: olive oil for the light; spices for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense;
aov_text: olie vir die kandelaar, speserye vir die salfolie en vir die reukwerk van speserye;

kjv_text: Onyx stones, and stones to be set in the ephod, and in the breastplate.
bsb_text: and onyx stones and gemstones to be mounted on the ephod and breastpiece.
aov_text: oniksstene en stene om in te lê vir die skouerkleed en die borstas.

kjv_text: And let them make me a sanctuary; that I may dwell among them.
bsb_text: And they are to make a sanctuary for Me, so that I may dwell among them.
aov_text: Ook moet hulle vir My ’n heiligdom maak, dat Ek in hulle midde kan woon.

kjv_text: According to all that I shew thee, after the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all the instruments thereof, even so shall ye make it.
bsb_text: You must make the tabernacle and design all its furnishings according to the pattern I show you.
aov_text: Volgens alles wat Ek jou laat sien—die voorbeeld van die tabernakel en die voorbeeld van alles wat daarby behoort—so moet julle dit maak.

kjv_text: And they shall make an ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
bsb_text: And they are to construct an ark of acacia wood, two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.
aov_text: HULLE moet dan ’n ark van akasiahout maak. Twee en ’n half el moet sy lengte, en anderhalf el sy breedte, en anderhalf el sy hoogte wees.

kjv_text: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, within and without shalt thou overlay it, and shalt make upon it a crown of gold round about.
bsb_text: Overlay it with pure gold both inside and out, and make a gold molding around it.
aov_text: En jy moet dit oortrek met suiwer goud, van binne en van buite moet jy dit oortrek. En jy moet daaraan ’n goue krans maak rondom.

kjv_text: And thou shalt cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in the four corners thereof; and two rings shall be in the one side of it, and two rings in the other side of it.
bsb_text: Cast four gold rings for it and fasten them to its four feet, two rings on one side and two on the other.
aov_text: En giet daarvoor vier goue ringe, en sit dit aan sy vier voete vas, só dat twee ringe aan die een kant en twee ringe aan die ander kant is.

kjv_text: And thou shalt make staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.
bsb_text: And make poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.
aov_text: En maak draaghoute van akasiahout, en trek dit oor met goud.

kjv_text: And thou shalt put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, that the ark may be borne with them.
bsb_text: Insert the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, in order to carry it.
aov_text: En steek die draaghoute in die ringe aan weerskante van die ark om die ark daarmee te dra.

kjv_text: The staves shall be in the rings of the ark: they shall not be taken from it.
bsb_text: The poles are to remain in the rings of the ark; they must not be removed.
aov_text: Die draaghoute moet in die ringe van die ark bly; hulle mag daar nie uit weggeneem word nie.

kjv_text: And thou shalt put into the ark the testimony which I shall give thee.
bsb_text: And place inside the ark the Testimony, which I will give you.
aov_text: Daarna moet jy in die ark die Getuienis sit wat Ek aan jou sal gee.

kjv_text: And thou shalt make a mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof.
bsb_text: And you are to construct a mercy seat of pure gold, two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.
aov_text: Maak ook ’n versoendeksel van suiwer goud. Twee en ’n half el moet sy lengte, en anderhalf el sy breedte wees.

kjv_text: And thou shalt make two cherubims of gold, of beaten work shalt thou make them, in the two ends of the mercy seat.
bsb_text: Make two cherubim of hammered gold at the ends of the mercy seat,
aov_text: Maak ook twee gérubs van goud. Van dryfwerk moet jy hulle maak, aan die twee ente van die versoendeksel.

kjv_text: And make one cherub on the one end, and the other cherub on the other end: even of the mercy seat shall ye make the cherubims on the two ends thereof.
bsb_text: one cherub on one end and one on the other, all made from one piece of gold.
aov_text: En maak een gérub aan die een ent en een gérub aan die ander ent. Uit een stuk, saam met die versoendeksel, moet julle die gérubs maak, aan die twee ente.

kjv_text: And the cherubims shall stretch forth their wings on high, covering the mercy seat with their wings, and their faces shall look one to another; toward the mercy seat shall the faces of the cherubims be.
bsb_text: And the cherubim are to have wings that spread upward, overshadowing the mercy seat. The cherubim are to face each other, looking toward the mercy seat.
aov_text: En die gérubs moet die vlerke boontoe uitgesprei hou, terwyl hulle met hul vlerke die versoendeksel beskut; en hulle aangesigte moet na mekaar toe wees; die gesigte van die gérubs moet op die versoendeksel gerig wees.

kjv_text: And thou shalt put the mercy seat above upon the ark; and in the ark thou shalt put the testimony that I shall give thee.
bsb_text: Set the mercy seat atop the ark, and put the Testimony that I will give you into the ark.
aov_text: En sit die versoendeksel bo-op die ark; maar in die ark moet jy die Getuienis neerlê wat Ek aan jou sal gee.

kjv_text: And there I will meet with thee, and I will commune with thee from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubims which are upon the ark of the testimony, of all things which I will give thee in commandment unto the children of Israel.
bsb_text: And I will meet with you there above the mercy seat, between the two cherubim that are over the ark of the Testimony; I will speak with you about all that I command you regarding the Israelites.
aov_text: En daar sal Ek met jou saamkom, en van die versoendeksel af, tussen die twee gérubs uit wat op die ark van die Getuienis is, sal Ek jou alles sê wat Ek jou vir die kinders van Israel sal beveel.

kjv_text: Thou shalt also make a table of shittim wood: two cubits shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
bsb_text: You are also to make a table of acacia wood two cubits long, a cubit wide, and a cubit and a half high.
aov_text: MAAK ook ’n tafel van akasiahout. Twee el moet sy lengte, en ’n el sy breedte, anderhalf el sy hoogte wees.

kjv_text: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, and make thereto a crown of gold round about.
bsb_text: Overlay it with pure gold and make a gold molding around it.
aov_text: En trek dit oor met suiwer goud, en maak daarvoor ’n goue krans rondom.

kjv_text: And thou shalt make unto it a border of an hand breadth round about, and thou shalt make a golden crown to the border thereof round about.
bsb_text: And make a rim around it a handbreadth wide and put a gold molding on the rim.
aov_text: Maak daarvoor ook ’n lys van ’n handbreed rondom; en maak ’n goue krans vir die lys rondom.

kjv_text: And thou shalt make for it four rings of gold, and put the rings in the four corners that are on the four feet thereof.
bsb_text: Make four gold rings for the table and fasten them to the four corners at its four legs.
aov_text: En maak daar vier goue ringe voor, en sit die ringe vas aan die vier hoeke van die vier pote.

kjv_text: Over against the border shall the rings be for places of the staves to bear the table.
bsb_text: The rings are to be close to the rim, to serve as holders for the poles used to carry the table.
aov_text: Naby die lys moet die ringe wees as plekke vir die draaghoute om die tafel te dra.

kjv_text: And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be borne with them.
bsb_text: Make the poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold, so that the table may be carried with them.
aov_text: En maak die draaghoute van akasiahout, en trek dit oor met goud; daarmee moet dan die tafel gedra word.

kjv_text: And thou shalt make the dishes thereof, and spoons thereof, and covers thereof, and bowls thereof, to cover withal: of pure gold shalt thou make them.
bsb_text: You are also to make the plates and dishes, as well as the pitchers and bowls for pouring drink offerings. Make them out of pure gold.
aov_text: Maak ook sy skottels en sy rookpanne en sy kanne en sy bekers waarmee gegiet moet word; van suiwer goud moet jy dit maak.

kjv_text: And thou shalt set upon the table shewbread before me alway.
bsb_text: And place the Bread of the Presence on the table before Me at all times.
aov_text: En op die tafel moet jy altyddeur toonbrood voor my aangesig neersit.

kjv_text: And thou shalt make a candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work shall the candlestick be made: his shaft, and his branches, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, shall be of the same.
bsb_text: Then you are to make a lampstand of pure, hammered gold. It shall be made of one piece, including its base and shaft, its cups, and its buds and petals.
aov_text: MAAK ook ’n kandelaar van suiwer goud. Van dryfwerk moet die kandelaar, sy voetstuk en sy stam gemaak word; sy kelkies, sy knoppe en sy blomme moet, daarmee saam, uit een stuk wees.

kjv_text: And six branches shall come out of the sides of it; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side:
bsb_text: Six branches are to extend from the sides of the lampstand—three on one side and three on the other.
aov_text: En ses arms moet uit die sykante daarvan uitgaan: drie arms van die kandelaar uit die een kant en drie arms van die kandelaar uit die ander kant.

kjv_text: Three bowls made like unto almonds, with a knop and a flower in one branch; and three bowls made like almonds in the other branch, with a knop and a flower: so in the six branches that come out of the candlestick.
bsb_text: There are to be three cups shaped like almond blossoms on the first branch, each with buds and petals, three on the next branch, and the same for all six branches that extend from the lampstand.
aov_text: Drie kelkies soos amandelblomme aan die een arm, ’n knop en ’n blom, en drie kelkies soos amandelblomme aan die ander arm, ’n knop en ’n blom—so moet dit wees aan die ses arms wat uit die kandelaar uitgaan.

kjv_text: And in the candlestick shall be four bowls made like unto almonds, with their knops and their flowers.
bsb_text: And on the lampstand there shall be four cups shaped like almond blossoms with buds and petals.
aov_text: Maar aan die kandelaar self moet vier kelkies soos amandelblomme wees, met knoppe en blomme:

kjv_text: And there shall be a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches that proceed out of the candlestick.
bsb_text: For the six branches that extend from the lampstand, a bud must be under the first pair of branches, a bud under the second pair, and a bud under the third pair.
aov_text: daar moet ’n knop wees onder die eerste paar arms wat daaruit uitgaan; en ’n knop onder die tweede paar arms wat daaruit uitgaan; en ’n knop onder die derde paar arms wat daaruit uitgaan—vir die ses arms wat uit die kandelaar uitgaan.

kjv_text: Their knops and their branches shall be of the same: all it shall be one beaten work of pure gold.
bsb_text: The buds and branches are to be all of one piece with the lampstand, hammered out of pure gold.
aov_text: Hulle knoppe en hulle arms moet, daarmee saam, uit een stuk wees—alles saam een stuk dryfwerk van suiwer goud.

kjv_text: And thou shalt make the seven lamps thereof: and they shall light the lamps thereof, that they may give light over against it.
bsb_text: Make seven lamps and set them up on the lampstand so that they illuminate the area in front of it.
aov_text: Jy moet ook sewe lampe daarvoor maak, en hulle moet sy lampe opsteek en die lig daarteenoor laat val aan die voorkant.

kjv_text: And the tongs thereof, and the snuffdishes thereof, shall be of pure gold.
bsb_text: The wick trimmers and their trays must be of pure gold.
aov_text: Sy snuiters en sy bakkies moet van suiwer goud wees.

kjv_text: Of a talent of pure gold shall he make it, with all these vessels.
bsb_text: The lampstand and all these utensils shall be made from a talent of pure gold.
aov_text: Van ’n talent suiwer goud moet hulle dit maak—al hierdie voorwerpe.

kjv_text: And look that thou make them after their pattern, which was shewed thee in the mount.
bsb_text: See to it that you make everything according to the pattern shown you on the mountain.
aov_text: En kyk dat jy dit maak volgens die voorbeeld daarvan wat jou op die berg getoon is.

kjv_text: Moreover thou shalt make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: with cherubims of cunning work shalt thou make them.
bsb_text: “You are to construct the tabernacle itself with ten curtains of finely spun linen, each with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and cherubim skillfully worked into them.
aov_text: EN die tabernakel moet jy van tien tentdoeke maak, van fyn dubbeldraad-linne en pers en purperrooi en bloedrooi stowwe, met gérubs; as kunstige werk moet jy dit maak.

kjv_text: The length of one curtain shall be eight and twenty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and every one of the curtains shall have one measure.
bsb_text: Each curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits long and four cubits wide—all curtains the same size.
aov_text: Die lengte van elke tentdoek moet agt-en-twintig el wees en die breedte van elke tentdoek vier el. Al die tentdoeke moet een maat hê.

kjv_text: The five curtains shall be coupled together one to another; and other five curtains shall be coupled one to another.
bsb_text: Five of the curtains are to be joined together, and the other five joined as well.
aov_text: Vyf van die tentdoeke moet aanmekaargewerk wees, die een aan die ander. En weer vyf tentdoeke aanmekaar, die een aan die ander.

kjv_text: And thou shalt make loops of blue upon the edge of the one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling; and likewise shalt thou make in the uttermost edge of another curtain, in the coupling of the second.
bsb_text: Make loops of blue material on the edge of the end curtain in the first set, and do the same for the end curtain in the second set.
aov_text: En jy moet lissies van pers stof maak aan die soom van die buitenste tentdoek van die een stel. En so moet jy dit maak aan die soom van die laaste tentdoek van die tweede stel.

kjv_text: Fifty loops shalt thou make in the one curtain, and fifty loops shalt thou make in the edge of the curtain that is in the coupling of the second; that the loops may take hold one of another.
bsb_text: Make fifty loops on one curtain and fifty loops on the end curtain of the second set, so that the loops line up opposite one another.
aov_text: Vyftig lissies moet jy aan die een tentdoek maak, en vyftig lissies moet jy maak aan die rand van die tentdoek wat aan die tweede stel behoort. Die lissies moet die een teenoor die ander wees.

kjv_text: And thou shalt make fifty taches of gold, and couple the curtains together with the taches: and it shall be one tabernacle.
bsb_text: Make fifty gold clasps as well, and join the curtains together with the clasps, so that the tabernacle will be a unit.
aov_text: Jy moet ook vyftig goue hakies maak en die tentdoeke saamvoeg met die hakies, die een aan die ander, sodat die tabernakel een geheel is.

kjv_text: And thou shalt make curtains of goats' hair to be a covering upon the tabernacle: eleven curtains shalt thou make.
bsb_text: You are to make curtains of goat hair for the tent over the tabernacle—eleven curtains in all.
aov_text: Ook moet jy doeke van bokhaar maak as ’n tentseil oor die tabernakel: elf tentdoeke moet jy dit maak.

kjv_text: The length of one curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and the eleven curtains shall be all of one measure.
bsb_text: Each of the eleven curtains is to be the same size—thirty cubits long and four cubits wide.
aov_text: Die lengte van elke tentdoek moet dertig el wees en die breedte van elke tentdoek vier el: die elf tentdoeke moet een maat hê.

kjv_text: And thou shalt couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shalt double the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tabernacle.
bsb_text: Join five of the curtains into one set and the other six into another. Then fold the sixth curtain over double at the front of the tent.
aov_text: En jy moet vyf van die tentdoeke besonders aanmekaarwerk en ses van die tentdoeke besonders. En die sesde tentdoek moet jy dubbel vou, aan die voorkant van die tent.

kjv_text: And thou shalt make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outmost in the coupling, and fifty loops in the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.
bsb_text: Make fifty loops along the edge of the end curtain in the first set, and fifty loops along the edge of the corresponding curtain in the second set.
aov_text: En jy moet vyftig lissies maak aan die soom van die laaste tentdoek van die een stel, en vyftig lissies aan die soom van die laaste tentdoek van die tweede stel.

kjv_text: And thou shalt make fifty taches of brass, and put the taches into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.
bsb_text: Make fifty bronze clasps and put them through the loops to join the tent together as a unit.
aov_text: Jy moet ook vyftig koperhakies maak en die hakies in die lissies steek; en jy moet die tent saamvoeg, sodat dit een geheel is.

kjv_text: And the remnant that remaineth of the curtains of the tent, the half curtain that remaineth, shall hang over the backside of the tabernacle.
bsb_text: As for the overlap that remains of the tent curtains, the half curtain that is left over shall hang down over the back of the tabernacle.
aov_text: En wat betref die oorhangende gedeelte aan die tentdoeke—die helfte van die tentdoek wat oorskiet, moet oorhang aan die agterkant van die tabernakel.

kjv_text: And a cubit on the one side, and a cubit on the other side of that which remaineth in the length of the curtains of the tent, it shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.
bsb_text: And the tent curtains will be a cubit longer on either side, and the excess will hang over the sides of the tabernacle to cover it.
aov_text: En die el wat aan weerskante oorskiet in die lengte van die tentdoeke, moet oorhang aan die sykante van die tabernakel, aan weerskante, om dit te oordek.

kjv_text: And thou shalt make a covering for the tent of rams' skins dyed red, and a covering above of badgers' skins.
bsb_text: Also make a covering for the tent out of ram skins dyed red, and over that a covering of fine leather.
aov_text: Jy moet ook vir die tent ’n dekkleed van rooigeverfde ramsvelle maak en ’n dekkleed van robbevelle daar bo-oor.

kjv_text: And thou shalt make boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood standing up.
bsb_text: You are to construct upright frames of acacia wood for the tabernacle.
aov_text: JY moet ook vir die tabernakel die regopstaande style van akasiahout maak.

kjv_text: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and a cubit and a half shall be the breadth of one board.
bsb_text: Each frame is to be ten cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.
aov_text: Die lengte van die styl moet tien el wees, en anderhalf el die breedte van elke styl.

kjv_text: Two tenons shall there be in one board, set in order one against another: thus shalt thou make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
bsb_text: Two tenons must be connected to each other for each frame. Make all the frames of the tabernacle in this way.
aov_text: Elke styl moet twee tappe hê wat met mekaar verbind is. So moet jy dit maak vir al die style van die tabernakel.

kjv_text: And thou shalt make the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards on the south side southward.
bsb_text: Construct twenty frames for the south side of the tabernacle,
aov_text: En die style vir die tabernakel moet jy maak: twintig style aan die suidekant, na die suide toe.

kjv_text: And thou shalt make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for his two tenons, and two sockets under another board for his two tenons.
bsb_text: with forty silver bases under the twenty frames—two bases for each frame, one under each tenon.
aov_text: Jy moet ook veertig silwervoetstukke onder die twintig style maak: twee voetstukke onder die een styl vir sy twee tappe en twee voetstukke onder die ander styl vir sy twee tappe.

kjv_text: And for the second side of the tabernacle on the north side there shall be twenty boards:
bsb_text: For the second side of the tabernacle, the north side, make twenty frames
aov_text: En vir die ander sykant van die tabernakel, aan die noordekant, twintig style

kjv_text: And their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
bsb_text: and forty silver bases—two bases under each frame.
aov_text: met hulle veertig silwervoetstukke: twee voetstukke onder die een styl en twee voetstukke onder die ander styl.

kjv_text: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward thou shalt make six boards.
bsb_text: Make six frames for the rear of the tabernacle, the west side,
aov_text: En vir die agterkant van die tabernakel, teen die weste, moet jy ses style maak.

kjv_text: And two boards shalt thou make for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.
bsb_text: and two frames for the two back corners of the tabernacle,
aov_text: Ook moet jy twee style maak vir die hoeke van die tabernakel, aan die agterkant.

kjv_text: And they shall be coupled together beneath, and they shall be coupled together above the head of it unto one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.
bsb_text: coupled together from bottom to top and fitted into a single ring. These will serve as the two corners.
aov_text: En hulle moet van onder dubbel wees, en net so moet hulle bo dubbel wees tot by die eerste ring. So moet dit met altwee wees; hulle moet die twee hoeke vorm.

kjv_text: And they shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
bsb_text: So there are to be eight frames and sixteen silver bases—two under each frame.
aov_text: So moet daar dan agt style wees met hulle silwervoetstukke, sestien voetstukke: twee voetstukke onder die een styl en twee voetstukke onder die ander styl.

kjv_text: And thou shalt make bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
bsb_text: You are also to make five crossbars of acacia wood for the frames on one side of the tabernacle,
aov_text: Jy moet ook dwarshoute van akasiahout maak: vyf vir die style van die een sykant van die tabernakel

kjv_text: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the two sides westward.
bsb_text: five for those on the other side, and five for those on the rear side of the tabernacle, to the west.
aov_text: en vyf dwarshoute vir die style van die ander sykant van die tabernakel; ook vyf dwarshoute vir die style van die agterkant van die tabernakel teen die weste.

kjv_text: And the middle bar in the midst of the boards shall reach from end to end.
bsb_text: The central crossbar in the middle of the frames shall extend from one end to the other.
aov_text: En die middelste dwarshout moet in die middel van die style oordwars loop, van die een ent na die ander.

kjv_text: And thou shalt overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars: and thou shalt overlay the bars with gold.
bsb_text: Overlay the frames with gold and make gold rings to hold the crossbars. Also overlay the crossbars with gold.
aov_text: En jy moet die style met goud oortrek; en hulle ringe, as plekke vir die dwarshoute, moet jy van goud maak. Die dwarshoute moet jy ook met goud oortrek.

kjv_text: And thou shalt rear up the tabernacle according to the fashion thereof which was shewed thee in the mount.
bsb_text: So you are to set up the tabernacle according to the pattern shown you on the mountain.
aov_text: So moet jy dan die tabernakel oprig volgens die plan wat jou op die berg getoon is.

kjv_text: And thou shalt make a vail of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen of cunning work: with cherubims shall it be made:
bsb_text: Make a veil of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen, with cherubim skillfully worked into it.
aov_text: VERDER moet jy ’n voorhangsel maak van pers en purperrooi en bloedrooi stowwe en fyn dubbeldraad-linne. As kunstige werk moet jy dit maak, met gérubs.

kjv_text: And thou shalt hang it upon four pillars of shittim wood overlaid with gold: their hooks shall be of gold, upon the four sockets of silver.
bsb_text: Hang it with gold hooks on four posts of acacia wood, overlaid with gold and standing on four silver bases.
aov_text: En jy moet dit ophang aan vier pilare van akasiahout wat met goud oorgetrek is en ook kramme van goud het en op vier silwervoetstukke staan.

kjv_text: And thou shalt hang up the vail under the taches, that thou mayest bring in thither within the vail the ark of the testimony: and the vail shall divide unto you between the holy place and the most holy.
bsb_text: And hang the veil from the clasps and place the ark of the Testimony behind the veil. So the veil will separate the Holy Place from the Most Holy Place.
aov_text: En jy moet die voorhangsel onder die hakies ophang; en bring die ark van die Getuienis daar, binnekant die voorhangsel. En die voorhangsel moet vir julle ’n skeiding maak tussen die Heilige en die Allerheiligste.

kjv_text: And thou shalt put the mercy seat upon the ark of the testimony in the most holy place.
bsb_text: Put the mercy seat on the ark of the Testimony in the Most Holy Place.
aov_text: En jy moet die versoendeksel op die ark van die Getuienis neerlê in die Allerheiligste.

kjv_text: And thou shalt set the table without the vail, and the candlestick over against the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south: and thou shalt put the table on the north side.
bsb_text: And place the table outside the veil on the north side of the tabernacle, and put the lampstand opposite the table, on the south side.
aov_text: En sit die tafel buitekant die voorhangsel, en die kandelaar teenoor die tafel aan die suidekant van die tabernakel. Maar die tafel moet jy aan die noordekant sit.

kjv_text: And thou shalt make an hanging for the door of the tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, wrought with needlework.
bsb_text: For the entrance to the tent, you are to make a curtain embroidered with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen.
aov_text: Jy moet ook vir die ingang van die tent ’n bedekking maak van pers en purperrooi en bloedrooi stowwe en fyn dubbeldraad-linne, veelkleurige werk.

kjv_text: And thou shalt make for the hanging five pillars of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, and their hooks shall be of gold: and thou shalt cast five sockets of brass for them.
bsb_text: Make five posts of acacia wood for the curtain, overlay them with gold hooks, and cast five bronze bases for them.
aov_text: En maak vir die bedekking vyf pilare van akasiahout, en trek hulle oor met goud; hulle kramme moet ook van goud wees; en jy moet daarvoor vyf kopervoetstukke giet.

kjv_text: And thou shalt make an altar of shittim wood, five cubits long, and five cubits broad; the altar shall be foursquare: and the height thereof shall be three cubits.
bsb_text: “You are to build an altar of acacia wood. The altar must be square, five cubits long, five cubits wide, and three cubits high.
aov_text: JY moet ook die altaar van akasiahout maak; vyf el moet die lengte wees en vyf el die breedte—vierkantig moet die altaar wees—en drie el sy hoogte.

kjv_text: And thou shalt make the horns of it upon the four corners thereof: his horns shall be of the same: and thou shalt overlay it with brass.
bsb_text: Make a horn on each of its four corners, so that the horns are of one piece, and overlay it with bronze.
aov_text: En jy moet sy horings op die vier hoeke maak; sy horings moet, daarmee saam, uit een stuk wees; en jy moet dit met koper oortrek.

kjv_text: And thou shalt make his pans to receive his ashes, and his shovels, and his basons, and his fleshhooks, and his firepans: all the vessels thereof thou shalt make of brass.
bsb_text: Make all its utensils of bronze—its pots for removing ashes, its shovels, its sprinkling bowls, its meat forks, and its firepans.
aov_text: En maak sy potte om die as te verwyder, ook sy skoppe en komme en vurke en vuurpanne. Al dié gereedskap moet jy van koper maak.

kjv_text: And thou shalt make for it a grate of network of brass; and upon the net shalt thou make four brasen rings in the four corners thereof.
bsb_text: Construct for it a grate of bronze mesh, and make a bronze ring at each of the four corners of the mesh.
aov_text: Jy moet daar ’n traliewerk aan maak, ’n netwerk van koper, en aan die net vier koperringe maak, aan die vier hoeke.

kjv_text: And thou shalt put it under the compass of the altar beneath, that the net may be even to the midst of the altar.
bsb_text: Set the grate beneath the ledge of the altar, so that the mesh comes halfway up the altar.
aov_text: En jy moet dit onder die lys van die altaar bevestig, onderaan, sodat die net tot by die helfte van die altaar kom.

kjv_text: And thou shalt make staves for the altar, staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with brass.
bsb_text: Additionally, make poles of acacia wood for the altar and overlay them with bronze.
aov_text: Jy moet ook draaghoute vir die altaar maak, draaghoute van akasiahout; en trek dit oor met koper.

kjv_text: And the staves shall be put into the rings, and the staves shall be upon the two sides of the altar, to bear it.
bsb_text: The poles are to be inserted into the rings so that the poles are on two sides of the altar when it is carried.
aov_text: En die draaghoute moet in die ringe gesteek word, sodat die draaghoute aan altwee kante van die altaar is as hulle dit dra.

kjv_text: Hollow with boards shalt thou make it: as it was shewed thee in the mount, so shall they make it.
bsb_text: Construct the altar with boards so that it is hollow. It is to be made just as you were shown on the mountain.
aov_text: Jy moet dit hol, van planke, maak. Soos dit jou op die berg getoon is, so moet hulle dit maak.

kjv_text: And thou shalt make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen of an hundred cubits long for one side:
bsb_text: You are also to make a courtyard for the tabernacle. On the south side of the courtyard make curtains of finely spun linen, a hundred cubits long on one side,
aov_text: JY moet ook die voorhof van die tabernakel maak. Aan die suidekant, na die suide toe, moet daar vir die voorhof behangsels wees van fyn dubbeldraad-linne; honderd el moet die lengte vir die een kant wees;

kjv_text: And the twenty pillars thereof and their twenty sockets shall be of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.
bsb_text: with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases, and silver hooks and bands on the posts.
aov_text: daarby twintig pilare met hulle twintig kopervoetstukke; die kramme en die ringe van die pilare moet van silwer wees.

kjv_text: And likewise for the north side in length there shall be hangings of an hundred cubits long, and his twenty pillars and their twenty sockets of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.
bsb_text: Likewise there are to be curtains on the north side, a hundred cubits long, with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases, and with silver hooks and bands on the posts.
aov_text: So moet daar ook aan die noordekant, in die lengte, behangsels wees, honderd el lank; daarby twintig pilare met hulle twintig kopervoetstukke. Die kramme en die ringe van die pilare moet van silwer wees.

kjv_text: And for the breadth of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits: their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.
bsb_text: The curtains on the west side of the courtyard shall be fifty cubits wide, with ten posts and ten bases.
aov_text: En in die breedte van die voorhof, aan die westekant, moet daar behangsels van vyftig el wees; daarby tien pilare en hulle tien voetstukke.

kjv_text: And the breadth of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.
bsb_text: The east side of the courtyard, toward the sunrise, is to be fifty cubits wide.
aov_text: En die breedte van die voorhof aan die oostekant, teen sonop, vyftig el—

kjv_text: The hangings of one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.
bsb_text: Make the curtains on one side fifteen cubits long, with three posts and three bases,
aov_text: sodat daar vyftien el behangsels vir die een kant is, daarby drie pilare en hulle drie voetstukke;

kjv_text: And on the other side shall be hangings fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.
bsb_text: and the curtains on the other side fifteen cubits long, with three posts and three bases.
aov_text: en vir die ander kant vyftien el behangsels, daarby drie pilare en hulle drie voetstukke;

kjv_text: And for the gate of the court shall be an hanging of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, wrought with needlework: and their pillars shall be four, and their sockets four.
bsb_text: The gate of the courtyard shall be twenty cubits long, with a curtain embroidered with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen. It shall have four posts and four bases.
aov_text: en vir die poort van die voorhof ’n bedekking van twintig el, van pers, purperrooi en bloedrooi stowwe en fyn dubbeldraad-linne, veelkleurige werk; daarby vier pilare en hulle vier voetstukke.

kjv_text: All the pillars round about the court shall be filleted with silver; their hooks shall be of silver, and their sockets of brass.
bsb_text: All the posts around the courtyard shall have silver bands, silver hooks, and bronze bases.
aov_text: Al die pilare van die voorhof moet rondom van silwerringe voorsien wees; hulle kramme moet van silwer wees en hulle voetstukke van koper.

kjv_text: The length of the court shall be an hundred cubits, and the breadth fifty every where, and the height five cubits of fine twined linen, and their sockets of brass.
bsb_text: The entire courtyard shall be a hundred cubits long and fifty cubits wide, with curtains of finely spun linen five cubits high, and with bronze bases.
aov_text: Die lengte van die voorhof moet honderd el wees en die breedte vyftig by vyftig en die hoogte vyf el, van fyn dubbeldraad-linne, daarby voetstukke van koper.

kjv_text: All the vessels of the tabernacle in all the service thereof, and all the pins thereof, and all the pins of the court, shall be of brass.
