bsb_text: All the utensils of the tabernacle for every use, including all its tent pegs and the tent pegs of the courtyard, shall be made of bronze.
aov_text: Aangaande al die gereedskap van die tabernakel, by sy hele bewerking, en al sy penne en al die penne van die voorhof, hulle moet van koper wees.

kjv_text: And thou shalt command the children of Israel, that they bring thee pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamp to burn always.
bsb_text: And you are to command the Israelites to bring you pure oil of pressed olives for the light, to keep the lamps burning continually.
aov_text: En jý moet die kinders van Israel beveel dat hulle vir jou suiwer, uitgestampte olyfolie vir die kandelaar bring, om gedurigdeur ’n brandende lamp te hê.

kjv_text: In the tabernacle of the congregation without the vail, which is before the testimony, Aaron and his sons shall order it from evening to morning before the LORD: it shall be a statute for ever unto their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel.
bsb_text: In the Tent of Meeting, outside the veil that is in front of the Testimony, Aaron and his sons are to tend the lamps before the LORD from evening until morning. This is to be a permanent statute for the Israelites for the generations to come.
aov_text: In die tent van samekoms, buitekant die voorhangsel wat voor die Getuienis is, moet Aäron en sy seuns dit regmaak om te brand van die aand tot die môre voor die aangesig van die HERE. Dit sal ’n ewige insetting wees in hulle geslagte, van die kant van die kinders van Israel.

kjv_text: And take thou unto thee Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him, from among the children of Israel, that he may minister unto me in the priest's office, even Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron's sons.
bsb_text: “Next, have your brother Aaron brought to you from among the Israelites, along with his sons Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar, to serve Me as priests.
aov_text: DAN moet jý jou broer Aäron, en sy seuns saam met hom, uit die kinders van Israel, laat nader kom na jou toe, dat hy vir My die priesteramp kan bedien: Aäron, Nadab en Abíhu, Eleásar en Ítamar, die seuns van Aäron.

kjv_text: And thou shalt make holy garments for Aaron thy brother for glory and for beauty.
bsb_text: Make holy garments for your brother Aaron, to give him glory and splendor.
aov_text: En jy moet vir jou broer Aäron heilige klere maak, tot eer en tot sieraad.

kjv_text: And thou shalt speak unto all that are wise hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they may make Aaron's garments to consecrate him, that he may minister unto me in the priest's office.
bsb_text: You are to instruct all the skilled craftsmen, whom I have filled with a spirit of wisdom, to make garments for Aaron’s consecration, so that he may serve Me as priest.
aov_text: Jý moet ook spreek met almal wat kunsvaardig is, wat Ek met die gees van wysheid vervul het, dat hulle vir Aäron klere maak, om hom te heilig, dat hy vir My die priesteramp kan bedien.

kjv_text: And these are the garments which they shall make; a breastplate, and an ephod, and a robe, and a broidered coat, a mitre, and a girdle: and they shall make holy garments for Aaron thy brother, and his sons, that he may minister unto me in the priest's office.
bsb_text: These are the garments that they shall make: a breastpiece, an ephod, a robe, a woven tunic, a turban, and a sash. They are to make these holy garments for your brother Aaron and his sons, so that they may serve Me as priests.
aov_text: En dit is die klere wat hulle moet maak: ’n borstas en ’n skouerkleed en ’n mantel en ’n kunstig bewerkte rok, ’n tulband en ’n gordel; so moet hulle dan vir Aäron, jou broer, heilige klere maak, en vir sy seuns, dat hy vir My die priesteramp kan bedien.

kjv_text: And they shall take gold, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen.
bsb_text: They shall use gold, along with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and fine linen.
aov_text: En hulle moet die goud en die pers en purperrooi en bloedrooi stowwe en die fyn linne neem.

kjv_text: And they shall make the ephod of gold, of blue, and of purple, of scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cunning work.
bsb_text: They are to make the ephod of finely spun linen embroidered with gold, and with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn.
aov_text: En hulle moet die skouerkleed maak van goud, pers en purperrooi en bloedrooi stowwe en fyn dubbeldraad-linne, as kunstige werk.

kjv_text: It shall have the two shoulderpieces thereof joined at the two edges thereof; and so it shall be joined together.
bsb_text: It shall have two shoulder pieces attached at two of its corners, so it can be fastened.
aov_text: Dit moet twee skouerstukke hê wat aan mekaar vas is; aan die twee bo-ente moet dit saamgevoeg word.

kjv_text: And the curious girdle of the ephod, which is upon it, shall be of the same, according to the work thereof; even of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
bsb_text: And the skillfully woven waistband of the ephod must be of one piece, of the same workmanship—with gold, with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and with finely spun linen.
aov_text: En die band wat daaraan is om dit vas te bind, moet van dieselfde werk en, daarmee saam, uit een stuk wees, van goud, pers en purperrooi en bloedrooi stowwe en fyn dubbeldraad-linne.

kjv_text: And thou shalt take two onyx stones, and grave on them the names of the children of Israel:
bsb_text: Take two onyx stones and engrave on them the names of the sons of Israel:
aov_text: En jy moet twee oniksstene neem en die name van die kinders van Israel daarop graveer:

kjv_text: Six of their names on one stone, and the other six names of the rest on the other stone, according to their birth.
bsb_text: six of their names on one stone and the remaining six on the other, in the order of their birth.
aov_text: ses van dié name op die een steen en die ses ander name op die ander steen volgens hulle geboortes.

kjv_text: With the work of an engraver in stone, like the engravings of a signet, shalt thou engrave the two stones with the names of the children of Israel: thou shalt make them to be set in ouches of gold.
bsb_text: Engrave the names of the sons of Israel on the two stones the way a gem cutter engraves a seal. Then mount the stones in gold filigree settings.
aov_text: Met graveerwerk, soos op ’n seëlsteen uitgesny word, moet jy die twee stene graveer volgens die name van die kinders van Israel. Jy moet hulle maak dat hulle vassit in kassies van goud.

kjv_text: And thou shalt put the two stones upon the shoulders of the ephod for stones of memorial unto the children of Israel: and Aaron shall bear their names before the LORD upon his two shoulders for a memorial.
bsb_text: Fasten both stones on the shoulder pieces of the ephod as memorial stones for the sons of Israel. Aaron is to bear their names on his two shoulders as a memorial before the LORD.
aov_text: En jy moet die twee stene op die skouerstukke van die skouerkleed bevestig as gedagtenisstene vir die kinders van Israel—Aäron moet hulle name op sy twee skouers dra voor die aangesig van die HERE om hulle in gedagtenis te bring.

kjv_text: And thou shalt make ouches of gold;
bsb_text: Fashion gold filigree settings
aov_text: Jy moet dan kassies van goud maak

kjv_text: And two chains of pure gold at the ends; of wreathen work shalt thou make them, and fasten the wreathen chains to the ouches.
bsb_text: and two chains of pure gold, made of braided cord work; and attach these chains to the settings.
aov_text: en twee kettings van suiwer goud; gedraai soos toutjies moet jy hulle maak; en maak die kettings, soos toutjies gedraai, aan die kassies vas.

kjv_text: And thou shalt make the breastplate of judgment with cunning work; after the work of the ephod thou shalt make it; of gold, of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, and of fine twined linen, shalt thou make it.
bsb_text: You are also to make a breastpiece of judgment with the same workmanship as the ephod. Construct it with gold, with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and with finely spun linen.
aov_text: Jy moet ook die borstas van beslissing maak van kunstige werk; soos die werk van die skouerkleed moet jy dit maak; van goud, pers en purperrooi en bloedrooi stowwe en van fyn dubbeldraad-linne moet jy dit maak.

kjv_text: Foursquare it shall be being doubled; a span shall be the length thereof, and a span shall be the breadth thereof.
bsb_text: It must be square when folded over double, a span long and a span wide.
aov_text: Vierkantig moet dit wees en dubbel gevou; ’n span sy lengte en ’n span sy breedte.

kjv_text: And thou shalt set in it settings of stones, even four rows of stones: the first row shall be a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this shall be the first row.
bsb_text: And mount on it a setting of gemstones, four rows of stones: In the first row there shall be a ruby, a topaz, and an emerald;
aov_text: En voorsien dit van ’n steeninvulling van vier rye stene: ’n ry met ’n karneool, ’n topaas en ’n smarag moet die eerste ry wees.

kjv_text: And the second row shall be an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.
bsb_text: in the second row a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond;
aov_text: En die tweede ry: ’n karbonkel, ’n saffier en ’n jaspis.

kjv_text: And the third row a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.
bsb_text: in the third row a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
aov_text: En die derde ry: ’n hiasint, ’n agaat en ’n ametis.

kjv_text: And the fourth row a beryl, and an onyx, and a jasper: they shall be set in gold in their inclosings.
bsb_text: and in the fourth row a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper. Mount these stones in gold filigree settings.
aov_text: En die vierde ry: ’n chrisoliet en ’n oniks en ’n sardoniks. Hulle moet in goud vasgesit wees by hulle invulling.

kjv_text: And the stones shall be with the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet; every one with his name shall they be according to the twelve tribes.
bsb_text: The twelve stones are to correspond to the names of the sons of Israel, each engraved like a seal with the name of one of the twelve tribes.
aov_text: En die stene moet volgens die name van die kinders van Israel twaalf wees, volgens hulle name. Soos op ’n seëlsteen uitgesny word, so moet hulle vir twaalf stamme wees, elkeen volgens sy naam.

kjv_text: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate chains at the ends of wreathen work of pure gold.
bsb_text: For the breastpiece, make braided chains like cords of pure gold.
aov_text: Jy moet ook by die borstas gedraaide kettings, soos toutjies gedraai, van suiwer goud maak.

kjv_text: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate two rings of gold, and shalt put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.
bsb_text: You are also to make two gold rings and fasten them to the two corners of the breastpiece.
aov_text: En maak by die borstas twee goue ringe; en bevestig die twee ringe aan die twee bo-ente van die borstas,

kjv_text: And thou shalt put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings which are on the ends of the breastplate.
bsb_text: Then fasten the two gold chains to the two gold rings at the corners of the breastpiece,
aov_text: en maak die twee goue toutjies aan die twee ringe vas, aan die bo-ente van die borstas;

kjv_text: And the other two ends of the two wreathen chains thou shalt fasten in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod before it.
bsb_text: and fasten the other ends of the two chains to the two filigree settings, attaching them to the shoulder pieces of the ephod at the front.
aov_text: en maak die twee ander ente van die twee toutjies vas aan die twee kassies, en bevestig dié dan aan die skouerstukke van die skouerkleed, aan die voorkant daarvan.

kjv_text: And thou shalt make two rings of gold, and thou shalt put them upon the two ends of the breastplate in the border thereof, which is in the side of the ephod inward.
bsb_text: Make two more gold rings and attach them to the other two corners of the breastpiece, on the inside edge next to the ephod.
aov_text: Jy moet ook twee goue ringe maak, en bevestig dié aan die twee onder-ente van die borstas, aan die kant wat teen die skouerkleed aan lê, aan die binnekant.

kjv_text: And two other rings of gold thou shalt make, and shalt put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart thereof, over against the other coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.
bsb_text: Make two additional gold rings and attach them to the bottom of the two shoulder pieces of the ephod, on its front, near its seam just above its woven waistband.
aov_text: En maak twee goue ringe, en bevestig dié aan die twee skouerstukke van die skouerkleed, onderaan, aan die voorkant daarvan, by sy verbinding, bo die band van die skouerkleed.

kjv_text: And they shall bind the breastplate by the rings thereof unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it may be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate be not loosed from the ephod.
bsb_text: The rings of the breastpiece shall be tied to the rings of the ephod with a cord of blue yarn, so that the breastpiece is above the waistband of the ephod and does not swing out from the ephod.
aov_text: En hulle moet die borstas met sy ringe aan die ringe van die skouerkleed met ’n pers toutjie vasbind, sodat dit bo die band van die skouerkleed is en die borstas nie van die skouerkleed afskuiwe nie.

kjv_text: And Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment upon his heart, when he goeth in unto the holy place, for a memorial before the LORD continually.
bsb_text: Whenever Aaron enters the Holy Place, he shall bear the names of the sons of Israel over his heart on the breastpiece of judgment, as a continual reminder before the LORD.
aov_text: So moet Aäron dan die name van die kinders van Israel in die borstas van beslissing op sy hart dra as hy in die heiligdom ingaan, om hulle in gedagtenis te bring voor die aangesig van die HERE gedurigdeur.

kjv_text: And thou shalt put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be upon Aaron's heart, when he goeth in before the LORD: and Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel upon his heart before the LORD continually.
bsb_text: And place the Urim and Thummim in the breastpiece of judgment, so that they will also be over Aaron’s heart whenever he comes before the LORD. Aaron will continually carry the judgment of the sons of Israel over his heart before the LORD.
aov_text: Jy moet ook in die borstas van beslissing die Urim en die Tummim sit, dat hulle op die hart van Aäron kan wees as hy voor die aangesig van die HERE ingaan. So moet Aäron dan die beslissing vir die kinders van Israel gedurigdeur op sy hart dra voor die aangesig van die HERE.

kjv_text: And thou shalt make the robe of the ephod all of blue.
bsb_text: You are to make the robe of the ephod entirely of blue cloth,
aov_text: En jy moet die mantel van die skouerkleed heeltemal van pers stof maak.

kjv_text: And there shall be an hole in the top of it, in the midst thereof: it shall have a binding of woven work round about the hole of it, as it were the hole of an habergeon, that it be not rent.
bsb_text: with an opening at its top in the center. Around the opening shall be a woven collar with an opening like that of a garment, so that it will not tear.
aov_text: En die opening vir die hoof moet in die middel daarvan wees. Rondom die opening moet ’n soom van wewerswerk wees. Soos die opening van ’n pantser moet dit daaraan wees, dat dit nie kan skeur nie.

kjv_text: And beneath upon the hem of it thou shalt make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, round about the hem thereof; and bells of gold between them round about:
bsb_text: Make pomegranates of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn all the way around the lower hem, with gold bells between them,
aov_text: En maak aan die soom daarvan granaatjies van pers en purperrooi en bloedrooi kleur, aan die soom daarvan rondom, en daar tussenin goue klokkies rondom:

kjv_text: A golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, upon the hem of the robe round about.
bsb_text: alternating the gold bells and pomegranates around the lower hem of the robe.
aov_text: ’n goue klokkie en ’n granaatjie, ’n goue klokkie en ’n granaatjie, aan die soom van die mantel rondom.

kjv_text: And it shall be upon Aaron to minister: and his sound shall be heard when he goeth in unto the holy place before the LORD, and when he cometh out, that he die not.
bsb_text: Aaron must wear the robe whenever he ministers, and its sound will be heard when he enters or exits the sanctuary before the LORD, so that he will not die.
aov_text: En Aäron moet dit aanhê om te kan dien, sodat die geluid daarvan gehoor word as hy in die heiligdom, voor die aangesig van die HERE, ingaan en as hy daar uitgaan, dat hy nie sterwe nie.

kjv_text: And thou shalt make a plate of pure gold, and grave upon it, like the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD.
bsb_text: You are to make a plate of pure gold and engrave on it as on a seal: HOLY TO THE LORD.
aov_text: Verder moet jy ’n plaat van suiwer goud maak en daarop graveer, soos op ’n seëlsteen uitgesny word: HEILIG AAN DIE HERE.

kjv_text: And thou shalt put it on a blue lace, that it may be upon the mitre; upon the forefront of the mitre it shall be.
bsb_text: Fasten to it a blue cord to mount it on the turban; it shall be on the front of the turban.
aov_text: En maak dit vas aan ’n pers toutjie, sodat dit aan die tulband kan wees; aan die voorkant van die tulband moet dit wees.

kjv_text: And it shall be upon Aaron's forehead, that Aaron may bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel shall hallow in all their holy gifts; and it shall be always upon his forehead, that they may be accepted before the LORD.
bsb_text: And it will be worn on Aaron’s forehead, so that he may bear the iniquity of the holy things that the sons of Israel consecrate with regard to all their holy gifts. It shall always be on his forehead, so that they may be acceptable before the LORD.
aov_text: So moet dit dan op die voorhoof van Aäron wees, sodat Aäron die skuld kan dra met betrekking tot die heilige dinge wat die kinders van Israel sal heilig—al hulle heilige gawes. En dit moet gedurigdeur op sy voorhoof wees, dat hulle voor die aangesig van die HERE welgevalle mag vind.

kjv_text: And thou shalt embroider the coat of fine linen, and thou shalt make the mitre of fine linen, and thou shalt make the girdle of needlework.
bsb_text: You are to weave the tunic with fine linen, make the turban of fine linen, and fashion an embroidered sash.
aov_text: Jy moet ook die rok van fyn linne kunstig bewerk. Jy moet ook ’n tulband van fyn linne maak, en ’n gordel moet jy van veelkleurige werk maak.

kjv_text: And for Aaron's sons thou shalt make coats, and thou shalt make for them girdles, and bonnets shalt thou make for them, for glory and for beauty.
bsb_text: Make tunics, sashes, and headbands for Aaron’s sons, to give them glory and splendor.
aov_text: En maak rokke vir die seuns van Aäron, en maak vir hulle gordels. Ook moet jy vir hulle musse maak, tot eer en tot sieraad.

kjv_text: And thou shalt put them upon Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him; and shalt anoint them, and consecrate them, and sanctify them, that they may minister unto me in the priest's office.
bsb_text: After you put these garments on your brother Aaron and his sons, anoint them, ordain them, and consecrate them so that they may serve Me as priests.
aov_text: En trek dit jou broer Aäron en sy seuns saam met hom aan. En salf hulle en stel hulle aan en heilig hulle, sodat hulle vir My die priesteramp kan bedien.

kjv_text: And thou shalt make them linen breeches to cover their nakedness; from the loins even unto the thighs they shall reach:
bsb_text: Make linen undergarments to cover their bare flesh, extending from waist to thigh.
aov_text: Maak ook vir hulle linnebroeke om die vlees van die skaamte te bedek. Dit moet van die heupe tot by die dye wees.

kjv_text: And they shall be upon Aaron, and upon his sons, when they come in unto the tabernacle of the congregation, or when they come near unto the altar to minister in the holy place; that they bear not iniquity, and die: it shall be a statute for ever unto him and his seed after him.
bsb_text: Aaron and his sons must wear them whenever they enter the Tent of Meeting or approach the altar to minister in the Holy Place, so that they will not incur guilt and die. This is to be a permanent statute for Aaron and his descendants.
aov_text: En Aäron en sy seuns moet dit aanhê as hulle in die tent van samekoms gaan, of as hulle nader kom na die altaar om in die heiligdom te dien, sodat hulle geen skuld op hulle laai en sterwe nie. Dit is ’n ewige insetting vir hom en vir sy nageslag ná hom.

kjv_text: And this is the thing that thou shalt do unto them to hallow them, to minister unto me in the priest's office: Take one young bullock, and two rams without blemish,
bsb_text: “Now this is what you are to do to consecrate Aaron and his sons to serve Me as priests: Take a young bull and two rams without blemish,
aov_text: EN dit is die saak wat jy vir hulle moet doen om hulle te heilig, dat hulle vir My die priesteramp kan bedien: Neem een jong bul en twee ramme wat sonder gebrek is,

kjv_text: And unleavened bread, and cakes unleavened tempered with oil, and wafers unleavened anointed with oil: of wheaten flour shalt thou make them.
bsb_text: along with unleavened bread, unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil. Make them out of fine wheat flour,
aov_text: en ongesuurde brood en ongesuurde koeke met olie gemeng en ongesuurde platkoeke met olie bestryk. Van fyn koringmeel moet jy dit maak.

kjv_text: And thou shalt put them into one basket, and bring them in the basket, with the bullock and the two rams.
bsb_text: put them in a basket, and present them in the basket, along with the bull and the two rams.
aov_text: En sit dit in een mandjie, en bring dit aan in die mandjie saam met die bul en die twee ramme.

kjv_text: And Aaron and his sons thou shalt bring unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shalt wash them with water.
bsb_text: Then present Aaron and his sons at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and wash them with water.
aov_text: Dan moet jy Aäron en sy seuns laat nader kom na die ingang van die tent van samekoms en hulle met water was.

kjv_text: And thou shalt take the garments, and put upon Aaron the coat, and the robe of the ephod, and the ephod, and the breastplate, and gird him with the curious girdle of the ephod:
bsb_text: Take the garments and clothe Aaron with the tunic, the robe of the ephod, the ephod itself, and the breastplate. Fasten the ephod on him with its woven waistband.
aov_text: En neem die klere en beklee Aäron met die rok en die mantel van die skouerkleed en die skouerkleed self en die borstas, en bind hom die band van die skouerkleed om.

kjv_text: And thou shalt put the mitre upon his head, and put the holy crown upon the mitre.
bsb_text: Put the turban on his head and attach the holy diadem to the turban.
aov_text: En sit die tulband op sy hoof, en bevestig die heilige kroon aan die tulband.

kjv_text: Then shalt thou take the anointing oil, and pour it upon his head, and anoint him.
bsb_text: Then take the anointing oil and anoint him by pouring it on his head.
aov_text: Neem dan die salfolie en giet dit op sy hoof en salf hom.

kjv_text: And thou shalt bring his sons, and put coats upon them.
bsb_text: Present his sons as well and clothe them with tunics.
aov_text: Ook sy seuns moet jy laat nader kom, en laat hulle die rokke aantrek,

kjv_text: And thou shalt gird them with girdles, Aaron and his sons, and put the bonnets on them: and the priest's office shall be theirs for a perpetual statute: and thou shalt consecrate Aaron and his sons.
bsb_text: Wrap the sashes around Aaron and his sons and tie headbands on them. The priesthood shall be theirs by a permanent statute. In this way you are to ordain Aaron and his sons.
aov_text: en omgord hulle met die gordel, Aäron en sy seuns, en bind vir hulle musse om, dat hulle die priesteramp kan besit as ’n ewige insetting. So moet jy dan Aäron en sy seuns as priesters aanstel.

kjv_text: And thou shalt cause a bullock to be brought before the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the bullock.
bsb_text: You are to present the bull at the front of the Tent of Meeting, and Aaron and his sons are to lay their hands on its head.
aov_text: En jy moet die bul aanbring voor die tent van samekoms; en Aäron en sy seuns moet hulle hande op die kop van die bul lê.

kjv_text: And thou shalt kill the bullock before the LORD, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
bsb_text: And you shall slaughter the bull before the LORD at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
aov_text: En slag die bul voor die aangesig van die HERE by die ingang van die tent van samekoms.

kjv_text: And thou shalt take of the blood of the bullock, and put it upon the horns of the altar with thy finger, and pour all the blood beside the bottom of the altar.
bsb_text: Take some of the blood of the bull and put it on the horns of the altar with your finger; then pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.
aov_text: Dan moet jy van die bloed van die bul neem en dit met jou vinger aan die horings van die altaar stryk; en al die orige bloed moet jy aan die onderkant van die altaar uitgiet.

kjv_text: And thou shalt take all the fat that covereth the inwards, and the caul that is above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and burn them upon the altar.
bsb_text: Take all the fat that covers the entrails and the lobe of the liver, and both kidneys with the fat on them, and burn them on the altar.
aov_text: En neem al die vet wat oor die binnegoed is, en die lap aan die lewer en die twee niere en die vet wat daaraan is, en steek dit op die altaar aan die brand.

kjv_text: But the flesh of the bullock, and his skin, and his dung, shalt thou burn with fire without the camp: it is a sin offering.
bsb_text: But burn the flesh of the bull and its hide and dung outside the camp; it is a sin offering.
aov_text: Maar die vleis van die bul en sy vel en sy mis moet jy buitekant die laer met vuur verbrand. Dit is ’n sondoffer.

kjv_text: Thou shalt also take one ram; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram.
bsb_text: Take one of the rams, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on its head.
aov_text: Neem dan die een ram, en Aäron en sy seuns moet hulle hande op die ram se kop lê;

kjv_text: And thou shalt slay the ram, and thou shalt take his blood, and sprinkle it round about upon the altar.
bsb_text: You are to slaughter the ram, take its blood, and sprinkle it on all sides of the altar.
aov_text: daarna moet jy die ram slag en sy bloed neem en dit rondom teen die altaar uitgooi.

kjv_text: And thou shalt cut the ram in pieces, and wash the inwards of him, and his legs, and put them unto his pieces, and unto his head.
bsb_text: Cut the ram into pieces, wash the entrails and legs, and place them with its head and other pieces.
aov_text: En die ram moet jy in sy stukke verdeel, en was sy binnegoed en pote en sit dit by die orige stukke en by die kop.

kjv_text: And thou shalt burn the whole ram upon the altar: it is a burnt offering unto the LORD: it is a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
bsb_text: Then burn the entire ram on the altar; it is a burnt offering to the LORD, a pleasing aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
aov_text: Jy moet dan die hele ram op die altaar aan die brand steek. Dit is ’n brandoffer aan die HERE; ’n lieflike geur, ’n vuuroffer is dit aan die HERE.

kjv_text: And thou shalt take the other ram; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram.
bsb_text: Take the second ram, and Aaron and his sons are to lay their hands on its head.
aov_text: Dan moet jy die ander ram neem, en Aäron en sy seuns moet hulle hande op die ram se kop lê;

kjv_text: Then shalt thou kill the ram, and take of his blood, and put it upon the tip of the right ear of Aaron, and upon the tip of the right ear of his sons, and upon the thumb of their right hand, and upon the great toe of their right foot, and sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.
bsb_text: Slaughter the ram, take some of its blood, and put it on the right earlobes of Aaron and his sons, on the thumbs of their right hands, and on the big toes of their right feet. Sprinkle the remaining blood on all sides of the altar.
aov_text: jy moet dan die ram slag en van sy bloed neem en dit stryk aan die regteroorlel van Aäron en aan die regteroorlel van sy seuns, ook aan die duim van hulle regterhand en aan die groottoon van hulle regtervoet. En die orige bloed moet jy rondom teen die altaar uitgooi.

kjv_text: And thou shalt take of the blood that is upon the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it upon Aaron, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon the garments of his sons with him: and he shall be hallowed, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons' garments with him.
bsb_text: And take some of the blood on the altar and some of the anointing oil and sprinkle it on Aaron and his garments, as well as on his sons and their garments. Then he and his garments will be consecrated, as well as his sons and their garments.
aov_text: Dan moet jy van die bloed wat aan die altaar is, neem en van die salfolie en dit sprinkel op Aäron en op sy klere sowel as op sy seuns en op die klere van sy seuns saam met hom, dat hy heilig kan wees en sy klere sowel as sy seuns en die klere van sy seuns saam met hom.

kjv_text: Also thou shalt take of the ram the fat and the rump, and the fat that covereth the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and the right shoulder; for it is a ram of consecration:
bsb_text: Take the fat from the ram, the fat tail, the fat covering the entrails, the lobe of the liver, both kidneys with the fat on them, and the right thigh (since this is a ram for ordination),
aov_text: En neem van die ram die vet en die vetstert, ook die vet wat oor die binnegoed is, en die lap aan die lewer en die twee niere met die vet wat daaraan is, en die regterboud—want dit is ’n wydingsram—

kjv_text: And one loaf of bread, and one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of the unleavened bread that is before the LORD:
bsb_text: along with one loaf of bread, one cake of bread made with oil, and one wafer from the basket of unleavened bread that is before the LORD.
aov_text: en een ronde brood en een oliebroodkoek en een platkoek uit die mandjie met ongesuurde koeke wat voor die aangesig van die HERE is.

kjv_text: And thou shalt put all in the hands of Aaron, and in the hands of his sons; and shalt wave them for a wave offering before the LORD.
bsb_text: Put all these in the hands of Aaron and his sons and wave them before the LORD as a wave offering.
aov_text: En lê dit alles op die hande van Aäron en op die hande van sy seuns, en beweeg dit as beweegoffer voor die aangesig van die HERE.

kjv_text: And thou shalt receive them of their hands, and burn them upon the altar for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour before the LORD: it is an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
bsb_text: Then take them from their hands and burn them on the altar atop the burnt offering as a pleasing aroma before the LORD; it is an offering made by fire to the LORD.
aov_text: Neem dit dan uit hulle hand en steek dit op die altaar aan die brand, bo-op die brandoffer, as lieflike geur voor die aangesig van die HERE. Dit is ’n vuuroffer aan die HERE.

kjv_text: And thou shalt take the breast of the ram of Aaron's consecration, and wave it for a wave offering before the LORD: and it shall be thy part.
bsb_text: Take the breast of the ram of Aaron’s ordination and wave it before the LORD as a wave offering, and it will be your portion.
aov_text: En neem die bors van die wydingsram van Aäron en beweeg dit as beweegoffer voor die aangesig van die HERE; daarna moet dit jou deel wees.

kjv_text: And thou shalt sanctify the breast of the wave offering, and the shoulder of the heave offering, which is waved, and which is heaved up, of the ram of the consecration, even of that which is for Aaron, and of that which is for his sons:
bsb_text: Consecrate for Aaron and his sons the breast of the wave offering that is waved and the thigh of the heave offering that is lifted up from the ram of ordination.
aov_text: En jy moet die bors van die beweegoffer heilig en die boud van die hefoffer, wat beweeg en gehef is van die wydingsram, wat vir Aäron en sy seuns geld.

kjv_text: And it shall be Aaron's and his sons' by a statute for ever from the children of Israel: for it is an heave offering: and it shall be an heave offering from the children of Israel of the sacrifice of their peace offerings, even their heave offering unto the LORD.
bsb_text: This will belong to Aaron and his sons as a regular portion from the Israelites, for it is the heave offering the Israelites will make to the LORD from their peace offerings.
aov_text: En dit moet vir Aäron en sy seuns wees tot ’n ewige insetting van die kant van die kinders van Israel, want dit is ’n hefoffer; en dit sal ’n hefoffer wees van die kant van die kinders van Israel, van hulle dankoffers—hulle hefoffer aan die HERE.

kjv_text: And the holy garments of Aaron shall be his sons' after him, to be anointed therein, and to be consecrated in them.
bsb_text: The holy garments that belong to Aaron will belong to his sons after him, so they can be anointed and ordained in them.
aov_text: En die heilige klere van Aäron moet vir sy seuns ná hom wees, om hulle daarin te salf en as priesters aan te stel.

kjv_text: And that son that is priest in his stead shall put them on seven days, when he cometh into the tabernacle of the congregation to minister in the holy place.
bsb_text: The son who succeeds him as priest and enters the Tent of Meeting to minister in the Holy Place must wear them for seven days.
aov_text: Die een van sy seuns wat in sy plek priester word, wat in die tent van samekoms sal ingaan om in die heiligdom te dien, moet dit sewe dae lank aantrek.

kjv_text: And thou shalt take the ram of the consecration, and seethe his flesh in the holy place.
bsb_text: You are to take the ram of ordination and boil its flesh in a holy place.
aov_text: En jy moet die wydingsram neem en sy vleis in ’n heilige plek kook.

kjv_text: And Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram, and the bread that is in the basket, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
bsb_text: At the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, Aaron and his sons are to eat the meat of the ram and the bread that is in the basket.
aov_text: Dan moet Aäron en sy seuns die ram se vleis eet en die brood wat in die mandjie is, by die ingang van die tent van samekoms.

kjv_text: And they shall eat those things wherewith the atonement was made, to consecrate and to sanctify them: but a stranger shall not eat thereof, because they are holy.
bsb_text: They must eat those things by which atonement was made for their ordination and consecration. But no outsider may eat them, because these things are sacred.
aov_text: En hulle moet dié dinge eet waarmee versoening bewerk is toe hulle as priesters aangestel en geheilig is; maar ’n onbevoegde mag daarvan nie eet nie, want dit is heilig.

kjv_text: And if ought of the flesh of the consecrations, or of the bread, remain unto the morning, then thou shalt burn the remainder with fire: it shall not be eaten, because it is holy.
bsb_text: And if any of the meat of ordination or any bread is left until the morning, you are to burn up the remainder. It must not be eaten, because it is sacred.
aov_text: En as daar van die vleis van die wydingsoffer of van die brood tot die môre toe oorbly, moet jy wat oor is, met vuur verbrand; dit mag nie geëet word nie, want dit is heilig.

kjv_text: And thus shalt thou do unto Aaron, and to his sons, according to all things which I have commanded thee: seven days shalt thou consecrate them.
bsb_text: This is what you are to do for Aaron and his sons based on all that I have commanded you, taking seven days to ordain them.
aov_text: So moet jy dan met Aäron en sy seuns doen net soos Ek jou beveel het. Sewe dae lank moet hulle wyding duur.

kjv_text: And thou shalt offer every day a bullock for a sin offering for atonement: and thou shalt cleanse the altar, when thou hast made an atonement for it, and thou shalt anoint it, to sanctify it.
bsb_text: Sacrifice a bull as a sin offering each day for atonement. Purify the altar by making atonement for it, and anoint it to consecrate it.
aov_text: Jy moet ook daagliks ’n sondofferbul tot versoening berei en die altaar ontsondig deur daarvoor versoening te doen; en jy moet dit salf om dit te heilig.

kjv_text: Seven days thou shalt make an atonement for the altar, and sanctify it; and it shall be an altar most holy: whatsoever toucheth the altar shall be holy.
bsb_text: For seven days you shall make atonement for the altar and consecrate it. Then the altar will become most holy; whatever touches the altar will be holy.
aov_text: Sewe dae lank moet jy versoening doen vir die altaar en dit heilig. So sal dan die altaar hoogheilig word: elkeen wat aan die altaar raak, word heilig.

kjv_text: Now this is that which thou shalt offer upon the altar; two lambs of the first year day by day continually.
bsb_text: This is what you are to offer regularly on the altar, each day: two lambs that are a year old.
aov_text: EN dit is wat jy op die altaar moet berei: twee jaaroud lammers gereeld elke dag.

kjv_text: The one lamb thou shalt offer in the morning; and the other lamb thou shalt offer at even:
bsb_text: Offer one lamb in the morning and the other at twilight.
aov_text: Die een lam moet jy in die môre berei, en die ander lam moet jy teen die aand berei,

kjv_text: And with the one lamb a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil; and the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering.
bsb_text: With the first lamb offer a tenth of an ephah of fine flour, mixed with a quarter hin of oil from pressed olives, and a drink offering of a quarter hin of wine.
aov_text: met ’n tiende van ’n efa fynmeel, gemeng met ’n kwart-hin uitgestampte olie, en as drankoffer ’n kwart-hin wyn vir die een lam.

kjv_text: And the other lamb thou shalt offer at even, and shalt do thereto according to the meat offering of the morning, and according to the drink offering thereof, for a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
bsb_text: And offer the second lamb at twilight with the same grain offering and drink offering as in the morning, as a pleasing aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
aov_text: En die ander lam moet jy teen die aand berei. Jy moet dit klaarmaak volgens die môrespysoffer en volgens die drankoffer wat daarby behoort, tot ’n lieflike geur. Dit is ’n vuuroffer aan die HERE.

kjv_text: This shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD: where I will meet you, to speak there unto thee.
bsb_text: For the generations to come, this burnt offering shall be made regularly at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting before the LORD, where I will meet you to speak with you.
aov_text: Dit moet ’n voortdurende brandoffer vir julle geslagte wees, by die ingang van die tent van samekoms, voor die aangesig van die HERE, waar Ek met julle sal saamkom om daar met jou te spreek.

kjv_text: And there I will meet with the children of Israel, and the tabernacle shall be sanctified by my glory.
bsb_text: I will also meet with the Israelites there, and that place will be consecrated by My glory.
aov_text: En daar sal Ek met die kinders van Israel saamkom en die tent sal deur my heerlikheid geheilig word.

kjv_text: And I will sanctify the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar: I will sanctify also both Aaron and his sons, to minister to me in the priest's office.
bsb_text: So I will consecrate the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and I will consecrate Aaron and his sons to serve Me as priests.
aov_text: So sal Ek dan die tent van samekoms en die altaar heilig. Ek sal Aäron en sy seuns ook heilig om vir My die priesteramp te bedien.

kjv_text: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will be their God.
bsb_text: Then I will dwell among the Israelites and be their God.
aov_text: En Ek sal onder die kinders van Israel woon en vir hulle ’n God wees;

kjv_text: And they shall know that I am the LORD their God, that brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, that I may dwell among them: I am the LORD their God.
bsb_text: And they will know that I am the LORD their God, who brought them out of the land of Egypt so that I might dwell among them. I am the LORD their God.
aov_text: en hulle sal weet dat Ek die HERE hulle God is wat hulle uit Egipteland uitgelei het om in hulle midde te woon. Ek is die HERE hulle God.

kjv_text: And thou shalt make an altar to burn incense upon: of shittim wood shalt thou make it.
bsb_text: “You are also to make an altar of acacia wood for the burning of incense.
aov_text: JY moet ook ’n altaar maak om reukwerk te brand. Van akasiahout moet jy dit maak.

kjv_text: A cubit shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof; foursquare shall it be: and two cubits shall be the height thereof: the horns thereof shall be of the same.
bsb_text: It is to be square, a cubit long, a cubit wide, and two cubits high. Its horns must be of one piece.
aov_text: ’n El moet sy lengte wees en ’n el sy breedte—vierkantig moet dit wees; en twee el sy hoogte. Sy horings moet, daarmee saam, uit een stuk wees.

kjv_text: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, the top thereof, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns thereof; and thou shalt make unto it a crown of gold round about.
bsb_text: Overlay with pure gold the top and all the sides and horns, and make a molding of gold around it.
aov_text: En jy moet dit met suiwer goud oortrek: die plaat en die sykante rondom en die horings. En maak daarvoor ’n goue krans rondom.

kjv_text: And two golden rings shalt thou make to it under the crown of it, by the two corners thereof, upon the two sides of it shalt thou make it; and they shall be for places for the staves to bear it withal.
bsb_text: And make two gold rings below the molding on opposite sides to hold the poles used to carry it.
aov_text: Maak ook twee goue ringe daarvoor onderkant die krans aan weerskante; jy moet dié aan die twee sykante maak. En hulle moet dien as plekke vir draaghoute om dit daarmee te dra.

kjv_text: And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.
bsb_text: Make the poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.
aov_text: En maak die draaghoute van akasiahout, en trek dit oor met goud.

kjv_text: And thou shalt put it before the vail that is by the ark of the testimony, before the mercy seat that is over the testimony, where I will meet with thee.
bsb_text: Place the altar in front of the veil that is before the ark of the Testimony—before the mercy seat that is over the Testimony—where I will meet with you.
aov_text: Sit dit dan voor die voorhangsel wat voor die ark van die Getuienis is, voor die versoendeksel wat oor die Getuienis is, waar Ek met jou sal saamkom.

kjv_text: And Aaron shall burn thereon sweet incense every morning: when he dresseth the lamps, he shall burn incense upon it.
bsb_text: And Aaron is to burn fragrant incense on it every morning when he tends the lamps.
aov_text: En Aäron moet daarop reukwerk van speserye aan die brand steek; elke môre as hy die lampe regmaak, moet hy dit aan die brand steek.

kjv_text: And when Aaron lighteth the lamps at even, he shall burn incense upon it, a perpetual incense before the LORD throughout your generations.
bsb_text: When Aaron sets up the lamps at twilight, he must burn the incense perpetually before the LORD for the generations to come.
aov_text: En as Aäron teen die aand die lampe opsteek, moet hy dit aan die brand steek as ’n voortdurende reukwerk voor die aangesig van die HERE in julle geslagte.

kjv_text: Ye shall offer no strange incense thereon, nor burnt sacrifice, nor meat offering; neither shall ye pour drink offering thereon.
bsb_text: On this altar you must not offer unauthorized incense or a burnt offering or grain offering; nor are you to pour a drink offering on it.
aov_text: Julle mag daarop geen vreemde reukwerk of brandoffer of spysoffer bring nie. Julle mag ook geen drankoffer daarop uitgiet nie.

kjv_text: And Aaron shall make an atonement upon the horns of it once in a year with the blood of the sin offering of atonements: once in the year shall he make atonement upon it throughout your generations: it is most holy unto the LORD.
bsb_text: Once a year Aaron shall make atonement on the horns of the altar. Throughout your generations he shall make atonement on it annually with the blood of the sin offering of atonement. The altar is most holy to the LORD.”
aov_text: En Aäron moet een maal in die jaar aan die horings daarvan versoening doen; met die bloed van die sondoffer van versoening moet hy een maal in die jaar daarvoor versoening doen vir julle geslagte. Hoogheilig is dit aan die HERE.

kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to Moses,
aov_text: VERDER het die HERE met Moses gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: When thou takest the sum of the children of Israel after their number, then shall they give every man a ransom for his soul unto the LORD, when thou numberest them; that there be no plague among them, when thou numberest them.
bsb_text: “When you take a census of the Israelites to number them, each man must pay the LORD a ransom for his life when he is counted. Then no plague will come upon them when they are numbered.
aov_text: As jy die volle getal van die kinders van Israel opneem volgens hulle geteldes, moet hulle, elkeen vir sy lewe, losgeld aan die HERE gee as hulle getel word, sodat geen plaag onder hulle mag wees as hulle getel word nie.

kjv_text: This they shall give, every one that passeth among them that are numbered, half a shekel after the shekel of the sanctuary: (a shekel is twenty gerahs:) an half shekel shall be the offering of the LORD.
bsb_text: Everyone who crosses over to those counted must pay a half shekel, according to the sanctuary shekel, which weighs twenty gerahs. This half shekel is an offering to the LORD.
aov_text: Dit moet hulle gee, elkeen wat na die geteldes oorgaan: ’n halfsikkel volgens die sikkel van die heiligdom—die sikkel is twintig gera—’n halfsikkel as offergawe aan die HERE.

kjv_text: Every one that passeth among them that are numbered, from twenty years old and above, shall give an offering unto the LORD.
bsb_text: Everyone twenty years of age or older who crosses over must give this offering to the LORD.
aov_text: Elkeen wat oorgaan na die geteldes, van twintig jaar oud en daarbo, moet die offergawe van die HERE gee.

kjv_text: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less than half a shekel, when they give an offering unto the LORD, to make an atonement for your souls.
bsb_text: In making the offering to the LORD to atone for your lives, the rich shall not give more than a half shekel, nor shall the poor give less.
aov_text: Die ryke moet nie meer en die arme moet nie minder as ’n halfsikkel bring nie, as hulle die offergawe van die HERE gee om vir julle siele versoening te doen.

kjv_text: And thou shalt take the atonement money of the children of Israel, and shalt appoint it for the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; that it may be a memorial unto the children of Israel before the LORD, to make an atonement for your souls.
bsb_text: Take the atonement money from the Israelites and use it for the service of the Tent of Meeting. It will serve as a memorial for the Israelites before the LORD to make atonement for your lives.”
aov_text: Neem dan die versoeningsgeld van die kinders van Israel en bestee dit aan die bediening van die tent van samekoms, dat dit die kinders van Israel in gedagtenis kan bring voor die aangesig van die HERE, om vir julle siele versoening te doen.

kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
bsb_text: And the LORD said to Moses,
aov_text: EN die HERE het met Moses gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: Thou shalt also make a laver of brass, and his foot also of brass, to wash withal: and thou shalt put it between the tabernacle of the congregation and the altar, and thou shalt put water therein.
bsb_text: “You are to make a bronze basin with a bronze stand for washing. Set it between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water in it,
aov_text: Jy moet ook ’n koperwaskom maak met sy kopervoetstuk, om in te was; en sit dit tussen die tent van samekoms en die altaar, en gooi water daarin,

kjv_text: For Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet thereat:
bsb_text: with which Aaron and his sons are to wash their hands and feet.
aov_text: dat Aäron en sy seuns hulle hande en hulle voete daaruit kan was.

kjv_text: When they go into the tabernacle of the congregation, they shall wash with water, that they die not; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn offering made by fire unto the LORD:
bsb_text: Whenever they enter the Tent of Meeting or approach the altar to minister by presenting an offering made by fire to the LORD, they must wash with water so that they will not die.
aov_text: As hulle in die tent van samekoms gaan, moet hulle hul met water was, sodat hulle nie sterwe nie; of as hulle naby die altaar kom om te dien deur ’n vuuroffer aan die HERE aan die brand te steek.

kjv_text: So they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they die not: and it shall be a statute for ever to them, even to him and to his seed throughout their generations.
bsb_text: Thus they are to wash their hands and feet so that they will not die; this shall be a permanent statute for Aaron and his descendants for the generations to come.”
aov_text: Hulle moet dan hul hande en hulle voete was, sodat hulle nie sterwe nie. En dit moet vir hulle ’n ewige insetting wees, vir hom en sy nageslag in hulle geslagte.

kjv_text: Moreover the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to Moses,
aov_text: VERDER het die HERE met Moses gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: Take thou also unto thee principal spices, of pure myrrh five hundred shekels, and of sweet cinnamon half so much, even two hundred and fifty shekels, and of sweet calamus two hundred and fifty shekels,
bsb_text: “Take the finest spices: 500 shekels of liquid myrrh, half that amount (250 shekels) of fragrant cinnamon, 250 shekels of fragrant cane,
aov_text: En jý, neem vir jou van die beste speserye: vyfhonderd sikkels fyn mirre en die helfte soveel geurige kaneel, tweehonderd-en-vyftig sikkels, en tweehonderd-en-vyftig sikkels geurige kalmoes

kjv_text: And of cassia five hundred shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, and of oil olive an hin:
bsb_text: 500 shekels of cassia—all according to the sanctuary shekel—and a hin of olive oil.
aov_text: en vyfhonderd sikkels kassie, volgens die sikkel van die heiligdom, en ’n hin olyfolie;

kjv_text: And thou shalt make it an oil of holy ointment, an ointment compound after the art of the apothecary: it shall be an holy anointing oil.
bsb_text: Prepare from these a sacred anointing oil, a fragrant blend, the work of a perfumer; it will be a sacred anointing oil.
aov_text: en maak daarvan heilige salfolie, ’n salfmengsel soos ’n salfmenger dit maak; heilige salfolie moet dit wees.

kjv_text: And thou shalt anoint the tabernacle of the congregation therewith, and the ark of the testimony,
bsb_text: Use this oil to anoint the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the Testimony,
aov_text: Daarmee moet jy dan die tent van samekoms salf en die ark van die Getuienis

kjv_text: And the table and all his vessels, and the candlestick and his vessels, and the altar of incense,
bsb_text: the table and all its utensils, the lampstand and its utensils, the altar of incense,
aov_text: en die tafel met al sy gereedskap en die kandelaar met sy gereedskap en die reukaltaar

kjv_text: And the altar of burnt offering with all his vessels, and the laver and his foot.
bsb_text: the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils, and the basin with its stand.
aov_text: en die brandofferaltaar met al sy gereedskap en die waskom met sy voetstuk.

kjv_text: And thou shalt sanctify them, that they may be most holy: whatsoever toucheth them shall be holy.
bsb_text: You are to consecrate them so that they will be most holy. Whatever touches them shall be holy.
aov_text: So moet jy hulle dan heilig, dat hulle hoogheilig kan wees. Elkeen wat aan hulle raak, word heilig.

kjv_text: And thou shalt anoint Aaron and his sons, and consecrate them, that they may minister unto me in the priest's office.
bsb_text: Anoint Aaron and his sons and consecrate them to serve Me as priests.
aov_text: Jy moet ook Aäron en sy seuns salf en hulle heilig om vir My die priesteramp te bedien.

kjv_text: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, This shall be an holy anointing oil unto me throughout your generations.
bsb_text: And you are to tell the Israelites, ‘This will be My sacred anointing oil for the generations to come.
aov_text: En jy moet met die kinders van Israel spreek en sê: Dit moet vir My ’n heilige salfolie wees in julle geslagte.

kjv_text: Upon man's flesh shall it not be poured, neither shall ye make any other like it, after the composition of it: it is holy, and it shall be holy unto you.
bsb_text: It must not be used to anoint an ordinary man, and you must not make anything like it with the same formula. It is holy, and it must be holy to you.
aov_text: Op geen mens se liggaam mag dit uitgegiet word nie; julle mag ook, na dieselfde voorskrif, so iets nie maak nie: heilig is dit; heilig moet dit vir julle wees.

kjv_text: Whosoever compoundeth any like it, or whosoever putteth any of it upon a stranger, shall even be cut off from his people.
bsb_text: Anyone who mixes perfume like it or puts it on an outsider shall be cut off from his people.’”
aov_text: Elkeen wat so iets meng of iets daarvan aan ’n onbevoegde laat kom, moet uit sy volksgenote uitgeroei word.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Take unto thee sweet spices, stacte, and onycha, and galbanum; these sweet spices with pure frankincense: of each shall there be a like weight:
bsb_text: The LORD also said to Moses, “Take fragrant spices—gum resin, onycha, galbanum, and pure frankincense—in equal measures,
aov_text: Verder het die HERE vir Moses gesê: Neem vir jou speserye: storaksgom en naeltjies en gálbanum—speserye en ook suiwer wierook; alles in gelyke hoeveelhede,

kjv_text: And thou shalt make it a perfume, a confection after the art of the apothecary, tempered together, pure and holy:
bsb_text: and make a fragrant blend of incense, the work of a perfumer, seasoned with salt, pure and holy.
aov_text: en maak daar reukwerk van, ’n mengsel soos die salfmenger dit maak, met sout gemeng, suiwer, heilig.

kjv_text: And thou shalt beat some of it very small, and put of it before the testimony in the tabernacle of the congregation, where I will meet with thee: it shall be unto you most holy.
bsb_text: Grind some of it into fine powder and place it in front of the Testimony in the Tent of Meeting, where I will meet with you. It shall be most holy to you.
aov_text: En vrywe ’n gedeelte daarvan heeltemal fyn, en sit ’n deel daarvan neer voor die Getuienis in die tent van samekoms, waar Ek met jou sal saamkom; hoogheilig moet dit vir julle wees.

kjv_text: And as for the perfume which thou shalt make, ye shall not make to yourselves according to the composition thereof: it shall be unto thee holy for the LORD.
bsb_text: You are never to use this formula to make incense for yourselves; you shall regard it as holy to the LORD.
aov_text: En die reukwerk wat jy moet maak—na dieselfde voorskrif mag julle vir julle nie maak nie; as iets heiligs aan die HERE moet dit vir jou wees.

kjv_text: Whosoever shall make like unto that, to smell thereto, shall even be cut off from his people.
bsb_text: Anyone who makes something like it to enjoy its fragrance shall be cut off from his people.”
aov_text: Elkeen wat so iets maak om daaraan te ruik, moet uit sy volksgenote uitgeroei word.

kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to Moses,
aov_text: VERDER het die HERE met Moses gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: See, I have called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah:
bsb_text: “See, I have called by name Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
aov_text: Kyk, Ek het Besáleël, die seun van Uri, die seun van Hur, van die stam van Juda, by sy naam geroep;

kjv_text: And I have filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship,
bsb_text: And I have filled him with the Spirit of God, with skill, ability, and knowledge in all kinds of craftsmanship,
aov_text: en Ek het hom vervul met die Gees van God, met wysheid en verstand en kennis en bekwaamheid vir allerhande werk,

kjv_text: To devise cunning works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,
bsb_text: to design artistic works in gold, silver, and bronze,
aov_text: om kunstige planne uit te dink, om dit uit te voer in goud en silwer en koper,

kjv_text: And in cutting of stones, to set them, and in carving of timber, to work in all manner of workmanship.
bsb_text: to cut gemstones for settings, and to carve wood, so that he may be a master of every craft.
aov_text: en deur snywerk in stene wat ingelê moet word, en deur houtsnywerk; om werksaam te wees in allerhande werk.

kjv_text: And I, behold, I have given with him Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan: and in the hearts of all that are wise hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded thee;
bsb_text: Moreover, I have selected Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, as his assistant. I have also given skill to all the craftsmen, that they may fashion all that I have commanded you:
aov_text: En kyk, Ek het hom Ohóliab bygegee, die seun van Ahísamag, van die stam van Dan. En in die hart van elkeen wat kunsvaardig is, het Ek wysheid gegee, dat hulle alles wat Ek jou beveel het, kan maak:

kjv_text: The tabernacle of the congregation, and the ark of the testimony, and the mercy seat that is thereupon, and all the furniture of the tabernacle,
bsb_text: the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the Testimony and the mercy seat upon it, and all the other furnishings of the tent—
aov_text: die tent van samekoms en die ark van die Getuienis en die versoendeksel wat daarop moet wees, en alles wat behoort by die tent,

kjv_text: And the table and his furniture, and the pure candlestick with all his furniture,
bsb_text: the table with its utensils, the pure gold lampstand with all its utensils,
aov_text: en die tafel met sy gereedskap en die suiwer kandelaar met al sy gereedskap

kjv_text: and the altar of incense,
bsb_text: the altar of incense,
aov_text: en die reukaltaar;

kjv_text: And the altar of burnt offering with all his furniture, and the laver and his foot,
bsb_text: the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the basin with its stand—
aov_text: ook die brandofferaltaar met al sy gereedskap en die waskom met sy voetstuk

kjv_text: And the cloths of service, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest's office,
bsb_text: as well as the woven garments, both the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments for his sons to serve as priests,
aov_text: en die kunstige klere en die heilige klere van die priester Aäron en die klere van sy seuns, om die priesteramp te bedien;

kjv_text: And the anointing oil, and sweet incense for the holy place: according to all that I have commanded thee shall they do.
bsb_text: in addition to the anointing oil and fragrant incense for the Holy Place. They are to make them according to all that I have commanded you.”
aov_text: ook die salfolie en die reukwerk van speserye vir die heiligdom—net soos Ek jou beveel het, moet hulle dit maak.

kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
bsb_text: And the LORD said to Moses,
aov_text: VERDER het die HERE met Moses gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: Speak thou also unto the children of Israel, saying, Verily my sabbaths ye shall keep: for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations; that ye may know that I am the LORD that doth sanctify you.
bsb_text: “Tell the Israelites, ‘Surely you must keep My Sabbaths, for this will be a sign between Me and you for the generations to come, so that you may know that I am the LORD who sanctifies you.
aov_text: Spreek jý met die kinders van Israel en sê: Julle moet sekerlik my sabbatte onderhou, want dit is ’n teken tussen My en julle in julle geslagte, sodat die mense kan weet dat Ek die HERE is wat julle heilig.

kjv_text: Ye shall keep the sabbath therefore; for it is holy unto you: every one that defileth it shall surely be put to death: for whosoever doeth any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
bsb_text: Keep the Sabbath, for it is holy to you. Anyone who profanes it must surely be put to death. Whoever does any work on that day must be cut off from among his people.
aov_text: Onderhou dan die sabbat, want dit moet vir julle heilig wees. Hy wat dit ontheilig, moet sekerlik gedood word; want elkeen wat daarop werk verrig, dié siel moet uitgeroei word onder sy volksgenote uit.

kjv_text: Six days may work be done; but in the seventh is the sabbath of rest, holy to the LORD: whosoever doeth any work in the sabbath day, he shall surely be put to death.
bsb_text: For six days work may be done, but the seventh day is a Sabbath of complete rest, holy to the LORD. Whoever does any work on the Sabbath day must surely be put to death.
aov_text: Ses dae lank kan werk verrig word, maar op die sewende dag moet dit wees ’n dag van volkome rus, heilig aan die HERE. Elkeen wat op die sabbatdag werk doen, moet sekerlik gedood word.

kjv_text: Wherefore the children of Israel shall keep the sabbath, to observe the sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant.
bsb_text: The Israelites must keep the Sabbath, celebrating it as a permanent covenant for the generations to come.
aov_text: En die kinders van Israel moet die sabbat onderhou deur die sabbat te vier in hulle geslagte as ’n ewige verbond.

kjv_text: It is a sign between me and the children of Israel for ever: for in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.
bsb_text: It is a sign between Me and the Israelites forever; for in six days the LORD made the heavens and the earth, but on the seventh day He rested and was refreshed.’”
aov_text: Tussen My en die kinders van Israel is dit vir ewig ’n teken; want in ses dae het die HERE die hemel en die aarde gemaak, maar op die sewende dag het Hy gerus en Hom verkwik.

kjv_text: And he gave unto Moses, when he had made an end of communing with him upon mount Sinai, two tables of testimony, tables of stone, written with the finger of God.
bsb_text: When the LORD had finished speaking with Moses on Mount Sinai, He gave him the two tablets of the Testimony, tablets of stone inscribed by the finger of God.
aov_text: En Hy het aan Moses, toe Hy geëindig het om met hom te spreek op die berg Sinai, die twee tafels van die Getuienis gegee, tafels van klip, beskrywe met die vinger van God.

kjv_text: And when the people saw that Moses delayed to come down out of the mount, the people gathered themselves together unto Aaron, and said unto him, Up, make us gods, which shall go before us; for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
bsb_text: Now when the people saw that Moses was delayed in coming down from the mountain, they gathered around Aaron and said, “Come, make us gods who will go before us. As for this Moses who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we do not know what has happened to him!”
aov_text: TOE die volk sien dat Moses vertoef om van die berg af te kom, het die volk rondom Aäron versamel en vir hom gesê: Kom, maak vir ons gode wat voor ons uit trek; want hierdie Moses, die man wat ons uit Egipteland laat optrek het, ons weet nie wat van hom geword het nie.

kjv_text: And Aaron said unto them, Break off the golden earrings, which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring them unto me.
bsb_text: So Aaron told them, “Take off the gold earrings that are on your wives and sons and daughters, and bring them to me.”
aov_text: En Aäron sê vir hulle: Ruk die goue ringe af wat aan die ore van julle vroue, julle seuns en julle dogters is, en bring dit vir my.

kjv_text: And all the people brake off the golden earrings which were in their ears, and brought them unto Aaron.
bsb_text: Then all the people took off their gold earrings and brought them to Aaron.
aov_text: Toe het die hele volk die goue ringe afgeruk wat aan hulle ore was, en dit na Aäron gebring.

kjv_text: And he received them at their hand, and fashioned it with a graving tool, after he had made it a molten calf: and they said, These be thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
bsb_text: He took the gold from their hands, and with an engraving tool he fashioned it into a molten calf. And they said, “These, O Israel, are your gods, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt!”
aov_text: En hy het dit uit hulle hand geneem en dit met die beitel bewerk en daar ’n gegote kalf van gemaak. Daarop sê hulle: Dit is jou gode, o Israel, wat jou uit Egipteland laat optrek het.

kjv_text: And when Aaron saw it, he built an altar before it; and Aaron made proclamation, and said, To morrow is a feast to the LORD.
bsb_text: When Aaron saw this, he built an altar before the calf and proclaimed: “Tomorrow shall be a feast to the LORD.”
aov_text: Toe Aäron dit sien, het hy daarvoor ’n altaar gebou. En Aäron het uitgeroep en gesê: Môre is daar fees tot eer van die HERE.

kjv_text: And they rose up early on the morrow, and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.
bsb_text: So the next day they arose, offered burnt offerings, and presented peace offerings. And the people sat down to eat and drink, and got up to indulge in revelry.
aov_text: En hulle het die ander dag vroeg klaargemaak en brandoffers geoffer en dankoffers aangebring; daarop het die volk gaan sit om te eet en te drink, en hulle het opgestaan om te speel.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go, get thee down; for thy people, which thou broughtest out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves:
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Go down at once, for your people, whom you brought up out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves.
aov_text: Toe sê die HERE vir Moses: Gaan heen, klim af, want jou volk wat jy uit Egipteland laat optrek het, het verderflik gehandel.

kjv_text: They have turned aside quickly out of the way which I commanded them: they have made them a molten calf, and have worshipped it, and have sacrificed thereunto, and said, These be thy gods, O Israel, which have brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
bsb_text: How quickly they have turned aside from the way that I commanded them! They have made for themselves a molten calf and have bowed down to it. They have sacrificed to it and said, ‘These, O Israel, are your gods, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt.’”
aov_text: En hulle het gou van die weg afgewyk wat Ek hulle beveel het. Hulle het vir hulle ’n gegote kalf gemaak en daarvoor neergebuig en daaraan geoffer en gesê: Dit is jou gode, o Israel, wat jou uit Egipteland laat optrek het.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people:
bsb_text: The LORD also said to Moses, “I have seen this people, and they are indeed a stiff-necked people.
aov_text: Verder het die HERE vir Moses gesê: Ek het hierdie volk gesien, en kyk, dit is ’n hardnekkige volk.

kjv_text: Now therefore let me alone, that my wrath may wax hot against them, and that I may consume them: and I will make of thee a great nation.
bsb_text: Now leave Me alone, so that My anger may burn against them and consume them. Then I will make you into a great nation.”
aov_text: Laat My dan nou begaan, dat my toorn teen hulle ontvlam en Ek hulle verteer. Dan sal Ek jou tot ’n groot nasie maak.

kjv_text: And Moses besought the LORD his God, and said, LORD, why doth thy wrath wax hot against thy people, which thou hast brought forth out of the land of Egypt with great power, and with a mighty hand?
bsb_text: But Moses sought the favor of the LORD his God, saying, “O LORD, why does Your anger burn against Your people, whom You brought out of the land of Egypt with great power and a mighty hand?
aov_text: Maar Moses het die HERE sy God om genade gesmeek en gesê: Waarom, o HERE, sou u toorn ontvlam teen u volk wat U met grote krag en met ’n sterke hand uit Egipteland uitgelei het?

kjv_text: Wherefore should the Egyptians speak, and say, For mischief did he bring them out, to slay them in the mountains, and to consume them from the face of the earth? Turn from thy fierce wrath, and repent of this evil against thy people.
bsb_text: Why should the Egyptians declare, ‘He brought them out with evil intent, to kill them in the mountains and wipe them from the face of the earth’? Turn from Your fierce anger and relent from doing harm to Your people.
aov_text: Waarom sou die Egiptenaars spreek en sê: In kwaadwilligheid het Hy hulle uitgelei om hulle in die berge om te bring en hulle van die aardbodem af te vernietig? Wend U af van die gloed van u toorn, en laat dit U berou oor die onheil van u volk.

kjv_text: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, thy servants, to whom thou swarest by thine own self, and saidst unto them, I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven, and all this land that I have spoken of will I give unto your seed, and they shall inherit it for ever.
bsb_text: Remember Your servants Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, to whom You swore by Your very self when You declared, ‘I will make your descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky, and I will give your descendants all this land that I have promised, and it shall be their inheritance forever.’”
aov_text: Gedenk aan Abraham, Isak en Israel, u knegte, vir wie U by Uself gesweer en aan wie U gesê het: Ek sal julle nageslag vermenigvuldig soos die sterre van die hemel, en hierdie hele land waarvan Ek gespreek het, sal Ek aan julle nageslag gee, dat hulle dit vir ewig kan beërwe.

kjv_text: And the LORD repented of the evil which he thought to do unto his people.
bsb_text: So the LORD relented from the calamity He had threatened to bring on His people.
aov_text: Toe het dit die HERE berou oor die onheil wat Hy gesê het dat Hy sy volk sou aandoen.

kjv_text: And Moses turned, and went down from the mount, and the two tables of the testimony were in his hand: the tables were written on both their sides; on the one side and on the other were they written.
bsb_text: Then Moses turned and went down the mountain with the two tablets of the Testimony in his hands. They were inscribed on both sides, front and back.
aov_text: En Moses het omgedraai en van die berg afgeklim, met die twee tafels van die Getuienis in sy hand, tafels wat op altwee kante beskrywe was; hulle was op die een en op die ander kant beskrywe.

kjv_text: And the tables were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, graven upon the tables.
bsb_text: The tablets were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, engraved on the tablets.
aov_text: En die tafels was die werk van God. Die skrif was ook die skrif van God, in die tafels gegraveer.

kjv_text: And when Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said unto Moses, There is a noise of war in the camp.
bsb_text: When Joshua heard the sound of the people shouting, he said to Moses, “The sound of war is in the camp.”
aov_text: En toe Josua die stem van die volk hoor hoe hulle juig, sê hy aan Moses: Daar is oorlogsgeraas in die laer.

kjv_text: And he said, It is not the voice of them that shout for mastery, neither is it the voice of them that cry for being overcome: but the noise of them that sing do I hear.
bsb_text: But Moses replied: “It is neither the cry of victory nor the cry of defeat; I hear the sound of singing!”
aov_text: Maar hy antwoord: Dit is nie die geluid van die wat sing van oorwinning nie; dit is ook nie die geluid van die wat sing van neerlaag nie: ek hoor die geluid van beurtgesang.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, as soon as he came nigh unto the camp, that he saw the calf, and the dancing: and Moses' anger waxed hot, and he cast the tables out of his hands, and brake them beneath the mount.
bsb_text: As Moses approached the camp and saw the calf and the dancing, he burned with anger and threw the tablets out of his hands, shattering them at the base of the mountain.
aov_text: En toe hy naby die laer kom en die kalf en koordanse sien, het die toorn van Moses ontvlam, en hy het die tafels uit sy hande gegooi en hulle onder aan die berg verbrysel.

kjv_text: And he took the calf which they had made, and burnt it in the fire, and ground it to powder, and strawed it upon the water, and made the children of Israel drink of it.
bsb_text: Then he took the calf they had made, burned it in the fire, ground it to powder, and scattered the powder over the face of the water. Then he forced the Israelites to drink it.
aov_text: En hy het die kalf geneem wat hulle gemaak het, en dit in die vuur verbrand en dit fyn gemaal. Toe het hy dit op die water gestrooi en die kinders van Israel dit laat drink.

kjv_text: And Moses said unto Aaron, What did this people unto thee, that thou hast brought so great a sin upon them?
bsb_text: “What did this people do to you,” Moses asked Aaron, “that you have led them into so great a sin?”
aov_text: En Moses het vir Aäron gesê: Wat het hierdie volk jou gedoen, dat jy so ’n groot sonde oor hulle gebring het?

kjv_text: And Aaron said, Let not the anger of my lord wax hot: thou knowest the people, that they are set on mischief.
bsb_text: “Do not be enraged, my lord,” Aaron replied. “You yourself know that the people are intent on evil.
aov_text: Toe antwoord Aäron: Laat die toorn van my heer nie ontvlam nie. U self ken die volk, dat hulle deur en deur sleg is.

kjv_text: For they said unto me, Make us gods, which shall go before us: for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
bsb_text: They told me, ‘Make us gods who will go before us. As for this Moses who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we do not know what has happened to him!’
aov_text: Hulle het dan aan my gesê: Maak vir ons gode wat voor ons uit trek, want hierdie Moses, die man wat ons uit Egipteland laat optrek het, ons weet nie wat van hom geword het nie.

kjv_text: And I said unto them, Whosoever hath any gold, let them break it off. So they gave it me: then I cast it into the fire, and there came out this calf.
bsb_text: So I said to them, ‘Whoever has gold, let him take it off,’ and they gave it to me. And when I threw it into the fire, out came this calf!”
aov_text: Daarop het ek hulle geantwoord: Wie goud het, laat dié dit afruk! En hulle het dit aan my gegee. En ek het dit in die vuur gegooi, en hierdie kalf het daaruit gekom.

kjv_text: And when Moses saw that the people were naked; (for Aaron had made them naked unto their shame among their enemies:)
bsb_text: Moses saw that the people were out of control, for Aaron had let them run wild and become a laughingstock to their enemies.
aov_text: Toe Moses sien dat die volk bandeloos was—want Aäron het hulle bandeloos laat word tot leedvermaak onder hulle teëstanders—

kjv_text: Then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, Who is on the LORD's side? let him come unto me. And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him.
bsb_text: So Moses stood at the entrance to the camp and said, “Whoever is for the LORD, come to me.” And all the Levites gathered around him.
aov_text: het Moses in die poort van die laer gaan staan en gesê: Wie vír die HERE is, kom na my toe! Toe het al die seuns van Levi by hom versamel.

kjv_text: And he said unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Put every man his sword by his side, and go in and out from gate to gate throughout the camp, and slay every man his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbour.
bsb_text: He told them, “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Each of you men is to fasten his sword to his side, go back and forth through the camp from gate to gate, and slay his brother, his friend, and his neighbor.’”
aov_text: En hy het vir hulle gesê: So spreek die HERE, die God van Israel: Laat elkeen sy swaard aangord aan sy heup. Gaan heen en weer van poort tot poort in die laer, en laat elkeen sy broer en elkeen sy vriend en elkeen sy naaste doodmaak.

kjv_text: And the children of Levi did according to the word of Moses: and there fell of the people that day about three thousand men.
bsb_text: The Levites did as Moses commanded, and that day about three thousand of the people fell dead.
aov_text: En die seuns van Levi het gehandel volgens die woord van Moses, en daar het van die volk op dié dag omtrent drieduisend man geval.

kjv_text: For Moses had said, Consecrate yourselves today to the LORD, even every man upon his son, and upon his brother; that he may bestow upon you a blessing this day.
bsb_text: Afterward, Moses said, “Today you have been ordained for service to the LORD, since each man went against his son and his brother; so the LORD has bestowed a blessing on you this day.”
aov_text: Toe het Moses gesê: Vul vandag julle hand om te offer aan die HERE—want elkeen is teen sy seun en teen sy broer—sodat Hy vandag ’n seën oor julle kan gee.

kjv_text: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses said unto the people, Ye have sinned a great sin: and now I will go up unto the LORD; peradventure I shall make an atonement for your sin.
bsb_text: The next day Moses said to the people, “You have committed a great sin. Now I will go up to the LORD; perhaps I can make atonement for your sin.”
aov_text: EN die volgende dag het Moses aan die volk gesê: Júlle het ’n groot sonde begaan; maar nou sal ek na die HERE opklim: miskien kan ek vir julle sonde versoening doen.

kjv_text: And Moses returned unto the LORD, and said, Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made them gods of gold.
bsb_text: So Moses returned to the LORD and said, “Oh, what a great sin these people have committed! They have made gods of gold for themselves.
aov_text: En Moses het na die HERE teruggegaan en gesê: Ag, hierdie volk het ’n groot sonde begaan en vir hulle goue gode gemaak.
