kjv_text: Yet now, if thou wilt forgive their sin--; and if not, blot me, I pray thee, out of thy book which thou hast written.
bsb_text: Yet now, if You would only forgive their sin.... But if not, please blot me out of the book that You have written.”
aov_text: Nou dan, as U tog maar hulle sonde wou vergewe! En so nie, delg my dan maar uit u boek wat U geskryf het!

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Whosoever hath sinned against me, him will I blot out of my book.
bsb_text: The LORD replied to Moses, “Whoever has sinned against Me, I will blot out of My book.
aov_text: Toe het die HERE Moses geantwoord: Wie teen My gesondig het, dié sal Ek uitdelg uit my boek.

kjv_text: Therefore now go, lead the people unto the place of which I have spoken unto thee: behold, mine Angel shall go before thee: nevertheless in the day when I visit I will visit their sin upon them.
bsb_text: Now go, lead the people to the place I described. Behold, My angel shall go before you. But on the day I settle accounts, I will punish them for their sin.”
aov_text: Maar gaan nou en lei die volk waarheen Ek jou gesê het. Kyk, my engel sal voor jou uit gaan. Maar die dag as Ek besoeking doen, dan sal Ek hulle sonde oor hulle besoek.

kjv_text: And the LORD plagued the people, because they made the calf, which Aaron made.
bsb_text: And the LORD sent a plague on the people because of what they had done with the calf that Aaron had made.
aov_text: So het die HERE dan die volk getref, omdat hulle die kalf gemaak het wat Aäron vervaardig het.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Depart, and go up hence, thou and the people which thou hast brought up out of the land of Egypt, unto the land which I sware unto Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, Unto thy seed will I give it:
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Leave this place, you and the people you brought up out of the land of Egypt, and go to the land that I promised to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob when I said, ‘I will give it to your descendants.’
aov_text: VERDER het die HERE met Moses gespreek: Gaan heen, trek hiervandaan op, jy en die volk wat jy uit Egipteland laat optrek het, na die land wat Ek met ’n eed aan Abraham, Isak en Jakob beloof het, met die woorde: Aan jou nageslag sal Ek dit gee;

kjv_text: And I will send an angel before thee; and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:
bsb_text: And I will send an angel before you, and I will drive out the Canaanites, Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
aov_text: en Ek sal ’n engel voor jou uit stuur—en die Kanaäniete, Amoriete, Hetiete, Feresiete, Hewiete en Jebusiete verdrywe—

kjv_text: Unto a land flowing with milk and honey: for I will not go up in the midst of thee; for thou art a stiffnecked people: lest I consume thee in the way.
bsb_text: Go up to a land flowing with milk and honey. But I will not go with you, because you are a stiff-necked people; otherwise, I might destroy you on the way.”
aov_text: na ’n land wat oorloop van melk en heuning; want Ek sal in jou midde nie optrek nie, omdat jy ’n hardnekkige volk is; anders sal jy op die weg verteer word.

kjv_text: And when the people heard these evil tidings, they mourned: and no man did put on him his ornaments.
bsb_text: When the people heard these bad tidings, they went into mourning, and no one put on any of his jewelry.
aov_text: Toe die volk hierdie onheilspellende woord hoor, het hulle getreur; en niemand het sy versiersels aangesit nie.

kjv_text: For the LORD had said unto Moses, Say unto the children of Israel, Ye are a stiffnecked people: I will come up into the midst of thee in a moment, and consume thee: therefore now put off thy ornaments from thee, that I may know what to do unto thee.
bsb_text: For the LORD had said to Moses, “Tell the Israelites, ‘You are a stiff-necked people. If I should go with you for a single moment, I would destroy you. Now take off your jewelry, and I will decide what to do with you.’”
aov_text: Die HERE het naamlik met Moses gespreek: Sê aan die kinders van Israel: Julle is ’n hardnekkige volk; as Ek vir een oomblik in jou midde sou optrek, sou Ek jou vernietig. Maar haal nou jou versiersels van jou af, dan sal Ek weet wat Ek met jou moet doen.

kjv_text: And the children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments by the mount Horeb.
bsb_text: So the Israelites stripped themselves of their jewelry from Mount Horeb onward.
aov_text: Toe het die kinders van Israel hulleself beroof van hul versiersels, van die berg Horeb af.

kjv_text: And Moses took the tabernacle, and pitched it without the camp, afar off from the camp, and called it the Tabernacle of the congregation. And it came to pass, that every one which sought the LORD went out unto the tabernacle of the congregation, which was without the camp.
bsb_text: Now Moses used to take the tent and pitch it at a distance outside the camp. He called it the Tent of Meeting, and anyone inquiring of the LORD would go to the Tent of Meeting outside the camp.
aov_text: En Moses het elke keer ’n tent geneem en dit vir hom buitekant die laer opgeslaan, ver van die laer af; en hy het dit genoem die tent van samekoms. En elkeen wat die HERE wou raadpleeg, het uitgegaan na die tent van samekoms wat buitekant die laer was.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when Moses went out unto the tabernacle, that all the people rose up, and stood every man at his tent door, and looked after Moses, until he was gone into the tabernacle.
bsb_text: Then, whenever Moses went out to the tent, all the people would stand at the entrances to their own tents and watch Moses until he entered the tent.
aov_text: En as Moses uitgaan na die tent, staan die hele volk op en gaan elkeen aan die ingang van sy tent staan. Dan kyk hulle Moses agterna tot hy in die tent ingegaan het.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, as Moses entered into the tabernacle, the cloudy pillar descended, and stood at the door of the tabernacle, and the Lord talked with Moses.
bsb_text: As Moses entered the tent, the pillar of cloud would come down and remain at the entrance, and the LORD would speak with Moses.
aov_text: En as Moses in die tent ingaan, kom die wolkkolom af en gaan by die ingang van die tent staan, en dan spreek Hy met Moses.

kjv_text: And all the people saw the cloudy pillar stand at the tabernacle door: and all the people rose up and worshipped, every man in his tent door.
bsb_text: When all the people saw the pillar of cloud standing at the entrance to the tent, they would stand up and worship, each one at the entrance to his own tent.
aov_text: En as die hele volk die wolkkolom sien staan by die ingang van die tent, staan die hele volk op en buig, elkeen aan die ingang van sy tent.

kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses face to face, as a man speaketh unto his friend. And he turned again into the camp: but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, departed not out of the tabernacle.
bsb_text: Thus the LORD would speak to Moses face to face, as a man speaks to his friend. Then Moses would return to the camp, but his young assistant Joshua son of Nun would not leave the tent.
aov_text: Dan spreek die HERE met Moses van aangesig tot aangesig soos ’n man met sy vriend spreek. Daarna gaan hy na die laer terug; maar sy dienaar Josua, ’n jongman, die seun van Nun, het hom nie uit die tent verwyder nie.

kjv_text: And Moses said unto the LORD, See, thou sayest unto me, Bring up this people: and thou hast not let me know whom thou wilt send with me. Yet thou hast said, I know thee by name, and thou hast also found grace in my sight.
bsb_text: Then Moses said to the LORD, “Look, You have been telling me, ‘Lead this people up,’ but You have not let me know whom You will send with me. Yet You have said, ‘I know you by name, and you have found favor in My sight.’
aov_text: Toe het Moses met die HERE gespreek: U sê nou wel aan my: Ek moet hierdie volk laat optrek, maar Ú laat my nie weet wie U saam met my sal stuur nie, hoewel U gesê het: Ek ken jou by die naam, en jy het ook genade in my oë gevind.

kjv_text: Now therefore, I pray thee, if I have found grace in thy sight, shew me now thy way, that I may know thee, that I may find grace in thy sight: and consider that this nation is thy people.
bsb_text: Now if indeed I have found favor in Your sight, please let me know Your ways, that I may know You and find favor in Your sight. Remember that this nation is Your people.”
aov_text: As ek dan nou genade in u oë gevind het, maak my dan tog u weë bekend, dat ek U kan ken; sodat ek genade in u oë kan vind. En bedink tog dat hierdie nasie u volk is.

kjv_text: And he said, My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest.
bsb_text: And the LORD answered, “My Presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”
aov_text: En Hy antwoord: Moet Ek self meegaan om jou die rusplek te verskaf?

kjv_text: And he said unto him, If thy presence go not with me, carry us not up hence.
bsb_text: “If Your Presence does not go with us,” Moses replied, “do not lead us up from here.
aov_text: Toe sê hy vir Hom: As U nie self meegaan nie, laat ons dan nie hiervandaan optrek nie.

kjv_text: For wherein shall it be known here that I and thy people have found grace in thy sight? is it not in that thou goest with us? so shall we be separated, I and thy people, from all the people that are upon the face of the earth.
bsb_text: For how then can it be known that Your people and I have found favor in Your sight, unless You go with us? How else will we be distinguished from all the other people on the face of the earth?”
aov_text: Want waaraan sou dan bekend word dat ek genade in u oë gevind het, ek en u volk? Is dit nie daaraan dat U met ons saamtrek nie? So sal ons, ek en u volk, onderskeie wees van elke volk wat op die aarde is.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, I will do this thing also that thou hast spoken: for thou hast found grace in my sight, and I know thee by name.
bsb_text: So the LORD said to Moses, “I will do this very thing you have asked, for you have found favor in My sight, and I know you by name.”
aov_text: Toe sê die HERE aan Moses: Ook hierdie versoek wat jy uitgespreek het, daaraan sal Ek voldoen; want jy het genade gevind in my oë, en Ek ken jou by die naam.

kjv_text: And he said, I beseech thee, shew me thy glory.
bsb_text: Then Moses said, “Please show me Your glory.”
aov_text: Daarop vra hy: Laat my tog u heerlikheid sien.

kjv_text: And he said, I will make all my goodness pass before thee, and I will proclaim the name of the LORD before thee; and will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will shew mercy on whom I will shew mercy.
bsb_text: “I will cause all My goodness to pass before you,” the LORD replied, “and I will proclaim My name—the LORD—in your presence. I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.”
aov_text: Maar Hy antwoord: Ek sal al my majesteit by jou laat verbygaan en voor jou die Naam van die HERE uitroep; maar Ek sal genadig wees vir wie Ek genadig wil wees, en My ontferm oor wie Ek My wil ontferm.

kjv_text: And he said, Thou canst not see my face: for there shall no man see me, and live.
bsb_text: But He added, “You cannot see My face, for no one can see Me and live.”
aov_text: Verder het Hy gesê: Jy kan my aangesig nie sien nie, want geen mens kan My sien en bly lewe nie.

kjv_text: And the LORD said, Behold, there is a place by me, and thou shalt stand upon a rock:
bsb_text: The LORD continued, “There is a place near Me where you are to stand upon a rock,
aov_text: Ook het die HERE gesê: Kyk, hier is ’n plek by My waar jy op die rots kan gaan staan.

kjv_text: And it shall come to pass, while my glory passeth by, that I will put thee in a clift of the rock, and will cover thee with my hand while I pass by:
bsb_text: and when My glory passes by, I will put you in a cleft of the rock and cover you with My hand until I have passed by.
aov_text: En as my heerlikheid verbygaan, sal Ek jou in die skeur van die rots stel en jou met my hand oordek totdat Ek verbygegaan het.

kjv_text: And I will take away mine hand, and thou shalt see my back parts: but my face shall not be seen.
bsb_text: Then I will take My hand away, and you will see My back; but My face must not be seen.”
aov_text: En as Ek my hand wegneem, sal jy My van agter sien; maar my aangesig kan nie gesien word nie.
