kjv_text: And spice, and oil for the light, and for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.
bsb_text: as well as spices and olive oil for the light, for the anointing oil, and for the fragrant incense.
aov_text: en die speserye en die olie vir die kandelaar en vir die salfolie en vir die reukwerk van speserye.

kjv_text: The children of Israel brought a willing offering unto the LORD, every man and woman, whose heart made them willing to bring for all manner of work, which the LORD had commanded to be made by the hand of Moses.
bsb_text: So all the men and women of the Israelites whose hearts prompted them brought a freewill offering to the LORD for all the work that the LORD through Moses had commanded them to do.
aov_text: Elke man en vrou wie se hart hulle aangedryf het om iets by te dra vir al die werk wat die HERE deur die diens van Moses beveel het om te verrig—as vrywillige offergawe aan die HERE het die kinders van Israel dit gebring.

kjv_text: And Moses said unto the children of Israel, See, the LORD hath called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah;
bsb_text: Then Moses said to the Israelites, “See, the LORD has called by name Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
aov_text: Daarop het Moses aan die kinders van Israel gesê: Kyk, die HERE het Besáleël, die seun van Uri, die seun van Hur, van die stam van Juda, by sy naam geroep;

kjv_text: And he hath filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship;
bsb_text: And He has filled him with the Spirit of God, with skill, ability, and knowledge in all kinds of craftsmanship,
aov_text: en Hy het hom met die Gees van God vervul, met wysheid, met verstand en met kennis en bekwaamheid vir allerhande werk;

kjv_text: And to devise curious works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,
bsb_text: to design artistic works in gold, silver, and bronze,
aov_text: en om kunstige planne uit te dink, om dié uit te voer in goud en silwer en koper,

kjv_text: And in the cutting of stones, to set them, and in carving of wood, to make any manner of cunning work.
bsb_text: to cut gemstones for settings, and to carve wood, so that he may be a master of every artistic craft.
aov_text: en deur snywerk in stene wat ingelê moet word, en deur houtsnywerk—om werksaam te wees in allerhande kunsarbeid.

kjv_text: And he hath put in his heart that he may teach, both he, and Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.
bsb_text: And the LORD has given both him and Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, the ability to teach others.
aov_text: Hy het dit ook in sy hart gegee om ander te onderrig, aan hom en aan Ohóliab, die seun van Ahísamag, van die stam van Dan.

kjv_text: Them hath he filled with wisdom of heart, to work all manner of work, of the engraver, and of the cunning workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, and in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of them that do any work, and of those that devise cunning work.
bsb_text: He has filled them with skill to do all kinds of work as engravers, designers, embroiderers in blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and fine linen, and as weavers—as artistic designers of every kind of craft.
aov_text: Hy het hulle vervul met kunsvaardigheid om allerhande werk te maak van ’n ambagsman en ’n kunstenaar en van ’n bewerker van veelkleurige goed in pers en purperrooi en bloedrooi stowwe en fyn linne, en van ’n wewer—hulle wat al die werk moes verrig en kunstige planne moes uitdink.

kjv_text: Then wrought Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whom the LORD put wisdom and understanding to know how to work all manner of work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that the LORD had commanded.
bsb_text: “So Bezalel, Oholiab, and every skilled person are to carry out everything commanded by the LORD, who has given them skill and ability to know how to perform all the work of constructing the sanctuary.”
aov_text: SO moet dan Besáleël en Ohóliab en elkeen wat kunsvaardig is, in wie die HERE wysheid en verstand gegee het om met kennis al die werk tot vervaardiging van die heiligdom te verrig, dit maak net soos die HERE beveel het.

kjv_text: And Moses called Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whose heart the LORD had put wisdom, even every one whose heart stirred him up to come unto the work to do it:
bsb_text: Then Moses summoned Bezalel, Oholiab, and every skilled person whom the LORD had gifted—everyone whose heart stirred him to come and do the work.
aov_text: En Moses het Besáleël en Ohóliab geroep en elkeen wat kunsvaardig was, in wie se hart die HERE wysheid gegee het; elkeen wie se hart hom opgewek het om aan die werk te gaan om dit klaar te maak.

kjv_text: And they received of Moses all the offering, which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, to make it withal. And they brought yet unto him free offerings every morning.
bsb_text: They received from Moses all the contributions that the Israelites had brought to carry out the service of constructing the sanctuary. Meanwhile, the people continued to bring freewill offerings morning after morning,
aov_text: En hulle het voor die oë van Moses ontvang al die offergawes wat die kinders van Israel vir die verrigting van die werk by die vervaardiging van die heiligdom gebring het. Maar húlle het vir hom nog elke môre vrywillige offergawes gebring.

kjv_text: And all the wise men, that wrought all the work of the sanctuary, came every man from his work which they made;
bsb_text: so that all the skilled craftsmen who were doing all the work on the sanctuary left their work
aov_text: Toe het al die kunsvaardige manne wat met al die werk by die heiligdom besig was, man vir man, van die werk af gekom waar hulle mee besig was,

kjv_text: And they spake unto Moses, saying, The people bring much more than enough for the service of the work, which the LORD commanded to make.
bsb_text: and said to Moses, “The people are bringing more than enough for doing the work the LORD has commanded us to do.”
aov_text: en hulle het met Moses gespreek en gesê: Die volk bring meer as wat nodig is vir die uitvoering van die werk waarvan die HERE die vervaardiging beveel het.

kjv_text: And Moses gave commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, Let neither man nor woman make any more work for the offering of the sanctuary. So the people were restrained from bringing.
bsb_text: After Moses had given an order, they sent a proclamation throughout the camp: “No man or woman should make anything else as an offering for the sanctuary.” So the people were restrained from bringing more,
aov_text: Daarop het Moses bevel gegee, en hulle het ’n oproep deur die laer laat gaan en gesê: Laat geen man of vrou verder enige werksaamheid verrig in verband met die offergawe vir die heiligdom nie. Toe het die volk opgehou om te bring;

kjv_text: For the stuff they had was sufficient for all the work to make it, and too much.
bsb_text: since what they already had was more than enough to perform all the work.
aov_text: want die boustof was vir hulle genoeg om die hele werk tot stand te bring; ja, daar het oorgebly.

kjv_text: And every wise hearted man among them that wrought the work of the tabernacle made ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: with cherubims of cunning work made he them.
bsb_text: All the skilled craftsmen among the workmen made the ten curtains for the tabernacle. They were made of finely spun linen, as well as blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, with cherubim skillfully worked into them.
aov_text: SO het dan almal wat kunsvaardig was onder die werksmense, die tabernakel uit tien tentdoeke vervaardig; uit fyn dubbeldraad-linne en pers en purperrooi en bloedrooi stowwe, met gérubs; as kunstige werk het hy dit gemaak.

kjv_text: The length of one curtain was twenty and eight cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: the curtains were all of one size.
bsb_text: Each curtain was twenty-eight cubits long and four cubits wide; all the curtains were the same size.
aov_text: Die lengte van elke tentdoek was agt-en-twintig el en die breedte van elke tentdoek vier el. Al die tentdoeke het een maat gehad.

kjv_text: And he coupled the five curtains one unto another: and the other five curtains he coupled one unto another.
bsb_text: And he joined five of the curtains together, and the other five he joined as well.
aov_text: En hy het vyf van die tentdoeke aanmekaargewerk, die een aan die ander; en weer vyf tentdoeke het hy aanmekaargewerk, die een aan die ander.

kjv_text: And he made loops of blue on the edge of one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling: likewise he made in the uttermost side of another curtain, in the coupling of the second.
bsb_text: He made loops of blue material on the edge of the end curtain in the first set, and also on the end curtain in the second set.
aov_text: En hy het lissies van pers stof gemaak aan die soom van die buitenste tentdoek van die een stel; so het hy dit gemaak aan die soom van die laaste tentdoek van die tweede stel.

kjv_text: Fifty loops made he in one curtain, and fifty loops made he in the edge of the curtain which was in the coupling of the second: the loops held one curtain to another.
bsb_text: He made fifty loops on one curtain and fifty loops on the end curtain of the second set, so that the loops lined up opposite one another.
aov_text: Vyftig lissies het hy gemaak aan die een tentdoek, en vyftig lissies het hy gemaak aan die rand van die tentdoek wat aan die tweede stel behoort het. Die lissies was die een teenoor die ander.

kjv_text: And he made fifty taches of gold, and coupled the curtains one unto another with the taches: so it became one tabernacle.
bsb_text: He also made fifty gold clasps to join the curtains together, so that the tabernacle was a unit.
aov_text: Hy het ook vyftig goue hakies gemaak en die tentdoeke saamgevoeg, die een aan die ander, met die hakies, sodat die tabernakel een geheel was.

kjv_text: And he made curtains of goats' hair for the tent over the tabernacle: eleven curtains he made them.
bsb_text: He then made curtains of goat hair for the tent over the tabernacle—eleven curtains in all.
aov_text: Verder het hy doeke van bokhaar gemaak as ’n tentseil oor die tabernakel: elf tentdoeke het hy dit gemaak.

kjv_text: The length of one curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits was the breadth of one curtain: the eleven curtains were of one size.
bsb_text: Each of the eleven curtains was the same size—thirty cubits long and four cubits wide.
aov_text: Die lengte van elke tentdoek was dertig el, en die breedte van elke tentdoek vier el: die elf tentdoeke het een maat gehad.

kjv_text: And he coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.
bsb_text: He joined five of the curtains into one set and the other six into another.
aov_text: En hy het vyf van die tentdoeke besonders aanmekaargewerk en ses van die tentdoeke besonders.

kjv_text: And he made fifty loops upon the uttermost edge of the curtain in the coupling, and fifty loops made he upon the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.
bsb_text: He made fifty loops along the edge of the end curtain in the first set, and fifty loops along the edge of the corresponding curtain in the second set.
aov_text: En hy het vyftig lissies gemaak aan die soom van die laaste tentdoek van die een stel, en vyftig lissies het hy gemaak aan die soom van die laaste tentdoek van die tweede stel.

kjv_text: And he made fifty taches of brass to couple the tent together, that it might be one.
bsb_text: He also made fifty bronze clasps to join the tent together as a unit.
aov_text: Hy het ook vyftig koperhakies gemaak om die tent saam te voeg, sodat dit een geheel was.

kjv_text: And he made a covering for the tent of rams' skins dyed red, and a covering of badgers' skins above that.
bsb_text: Additionally, he made for the tent a covering of ram skins dyed red, and over that a covering of fine leather.
aov_text: Ook het hy vir die tent ’n dekkleed van rooigeverfde ramsvelle gemaak en daar bo-oor ’n dekkleed van robbevelle.

kjv_text: And he made boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood, standing up.
bsb_text: Next, he constructed upright frames of acacia wood for the tabernacle.
aov_text: Hy het ook vir die tabernakel die regopstaande style van akasiahout gemaak.

kjv_text: The length of a board was ten cubits, and the breadth of a board one cubit and a half.
bsb_text: Each frame was ten cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.
aov_text: Die lengte van die styl was tien el, en anderhalf el die breedte van elke styl.

kjv_text: One board had two tenons, equally distant one from another: thus did he make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
bsb_text: Two tenons were connected to each other for each frame. He made all the frames of the tabernacle in this way.
aov_text: Elke styl het twee tappe gehad wat met mekaar verbind was. So het hy dit gemaak vir al die style van die tabernakel.

kjv_text: And he made boards for the tabernacle; twenty boards for the south side southward:
bsb_text: He constructed twenty frames for the south side of the tabernacle,
aov_text: En hy het die style vir die tabernakel gemaak: twintig style aan die suidekant, na die suide toe.

kjv_text: And forty sockets of silver he made under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for his two tenons, and two sockets under another board for his two tenons.
bsb_text: with forty silver bases to put under the twenty frames—two bases for each frame, one under each tenon.
aov_text: En hy het veertig silwervoetstukke onder die twintig style gemaak: twee voetstukke onder die een styl vir sy twee tappe en twee voetstukke onder die ander styl vir sy twee tappe.

kjv_text: And for the other side of the tabernacle, which is toward the north corner, he made twenty boards,
bsb_text: For the second side of the tabernacle, the north side, he made twenty frames
aov_text: Hy het ook vir die ander sykant van die tabernakel, aan die noordekant, twintig style gemaak

kjv_text: And their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
bsb_text: and forty silver bases—two bases under each frame.
aov_text: met hulle veertig silwervoetstukke: twee voetstukke onder die een styl en twee voetstukke onder die ander styl.

kjv_text: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.
bsb_text: He made six frames for the rear of the tabernacle, the west side,
aov_text: En vir die agterkant van die tabernakel, teen die weste, het hy ses style gemaak.

kjv_text: And two boards made he for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.
bsb_text: and two frames for the two back corners of the tabernacle,
aov_text: Ook het hy twee style vir die hoeke van die tabernakel aan die agterkant gemaak.

kjv_text: And they were coupled beneath, and coupled together at the head thereof, to one ring: thus he did to both of them in both the corners.
bsb_text: coupled together from bottom to top and fitted into a single ring. He made both corners in this way.
aov_text: En hulle was dubbel van onder, en net so was hulle bo dubbel tot by die eerste ring. So het hy dit gemaak vir altwee, vir die twee hoeke.

kjv_text: And there were eight boards; and their sockets were sixteen sockets of silver, under every board two sockets.
bsb_text: So there were eight frames and sixteen silver bases—two under each frame.
aov_text: So was daar dan agt style met hulle silwervoetstukke: sestien voetstukke; twee voetstukke onder elke styl.

kjv_text: And he made bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
bsb_text: He also made five crossbars of acacia wood for the frames on one side of the tabernacle,
aov_text: Hy het ook dwarshoute van akasiahout gemaak: vyf vir die style van die een sykant van die tabernakel

kjv_text: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the sides westward.
bsb_text: five for those on the other side, and five for those on the rear side of the tabernacle, to the west.
aov_text: en vyf dwarshoute vir die style van die ander sykant van die tabernakel; ook vyf dwarshoute vir die style van die agterkant van die tabernakel teen die weste.

kjv_text: And he made the middle bar to shoot through the boards from the one end to the other.
bsb_text: He made the central crossbar to run through the center of the frames, from one end to the other.
aov_text: En hy het die middelste dwarshout gemaak om oordwars te loop, in die middel van die style, van die een ent na die ander.

kjv_text: And he overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold to be places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.
bsb_text: And he overlaid the frames with gold and made gold rings to hold the crossbars. He also overlaid the crossbars with gold.
aov_text: En hy het die style met goud oorgetrek; en hulle ringe, as plekke vir die dwarshoute, het hy van goud gemaak. Die dwarshoute het hy ook met goud oorgetrek.

kjv_text: And he made a vail of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: with cherubims made he it of cunning work.
bsb_text: Next, he made the veil of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen, with cherubim skillfully worked into it.
aov_text: Verder het hy die voorhangsel gemaak van pers en purperrooi en bloedrooi stowwe en fyn dubbeldraad-linne; as kunstige werk het hy dit gemaak, met gérubs.

kjv_text: And he made thereunto four pillars of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold: their hooks were of gold; and he cast for them four sockets of silver.
bsb_text: He also made four posts of acacia wood for it and overlaid them with gold, along with gold hooks; and he cast four silver bases for the posts.
aov_text: En hy het vier pilare van akasiahout daarvoor gemaak en dit met goud oorgetrek; hulle kramme was ook van goud; en hy het daarvoor vier silwervoetstukke gegiet.

kjv_text: And he made an hanging for the tabernacle door of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, of needlework;
bsb_text: For the entrance to the tent, he made a curtain embroidered with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen,
aov_text: Hy het ook vir die ingang van die tent ’n bedekking gemaak van pers en purperrooi en bloedrooi stowwe en fyn dubbeldraad-linne, veelkleurige werk;

kjv_text: And the five pillars of it with their hooks: and he overlaid their chapiters and their fillets with gold: but their five sockets were of brass.
bsb_text: together with five posts and their hooks. He overlaid the tops of the posts and their bands with gold, and their five bases were bronze.
aov_text: en die vyf pilare wat daarby behoort, met hulle kramme; en hy het hulle toppe en ringe met goud oorgetrek; en hulle vyf voetstukke was van koper.

kjv_text: And Bezaleel made the ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half was the length of it, and a cubit and a half the breadth of it, and a cubit and a half the height of it:
bsb_text: Bezalel went on to construct the ark of acacia wood, two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.
aov_text: EN Besáleël het die ark van akasiahout gemaak; twee en ’n half el was sy lengte, en anderhalf el sy breedte, en anderhalf el sy hoogte.

kjv_text: And he overlaid it with pure gold within and without, and made a crown of gold to it round about.
bsb_text: He overlaid it with pure gold, both inside and out, and made a gold molding around it.
aov_text: En hy het dit oorgetrek met suiwer goud, van binne en van buite; en hy het daaraan ’n goue krans gemaak rondom.

kjv_text: And he cast for it four rings of gold, to be set by the four corners of it; even two rings upon the one side of it, and two rings upon the other side of it.
bsb_text: And he cast four gold rings for its four feet, two rings on one side and two on the other.
aov_text: En hy het daarvoor vier goue ringe gegiet, aan sy vier voete, só dat twee ringe aan die een kant en twee ringe aan die ander kant was.

kjv_text: And he made staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.
bsb_text: Then he made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.
aov_text: En hy het draaghoute van akasiahout gemaak en dit met goud oorgetrek;

kjv_text: And he put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.
bsb_text: He inserted the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark in order to carry it.
aov_text: en hy het die draaghoute in die ringe gesteek aan weerskante van die ark om die ark te dra.

kjv_text: And he made the mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half was the length thereof, and one cubit and a half the breadth thereof.
bsb_text: He constructed a mercy seat of pure gold, two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.
aov_text: Hy het ook ’n versoendeksel van suiwer goud gemaak. Twee en ’n half el was sy lengte, en anderhalf el sy breedte.

kjv_text: And he made two cherubims of gold, beaten out of one piece made he them, on the two ends of the mercy seat;
bsb_text: He made two cherubim of hammered gold at the ends of the mercy seat,
aov_text: Ook het hy twee gérubs van goud gemaak. Van dryfwerk het hy hulle gemaak, aan die twee ente van die versoendeksel.

kjv_text: One cherub on the end on this side, and another cherub on the other end on that side: out of the mercy seat made he the cherubims on the two ends thereof.
bsb_text: one cherub on one end and one on the other, all made from one piece of gold.
aov_text: Een gérub aan die een ent en een gérub aan die ander ent. Uit een stuk, saam met die versoendeksel, het hy die gérubs gemaak, aan die twee ente.

kjv_text: And the cherubims spread out their wings on high, and covered with their wings over the mercy seat, with their faces one to another; even to the mercy seatward were the faces of the cherubims.
bsb_text: And the cherubim had wings that spread upward, overshadowing the mercy seat. The cherubim faced each other, looking toward the mercy seat.
aov_text: En die gérubs het die vlerke boontoe uitgesprei gehou, terwyl hulle met hul vlerke die versoendeksel beskut; en hulle aangesigte was na mekaar toe. Die gesigte van die gérubs was op die versoendeksel gerig.

kjv_text: And he made the table of shittim wood: two cubits was the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof:
bsb_text: He also made the table of acacia wood two cubits long, a cubit wide, and a cubit and a half high.
aov_text: Hy het ook die tafel van akasiahout gemaak. Twee el was sy lengte, en ’n el sy breedte, en anderhalf el sy hoogte.

kjv_text: And he overlaid it with pure gold, and made thereunto a crown of gold round about.
bsb_text: He overlaid it with pure gold and made a gold molding around it.
aov_text: En hy het dit met suiwer goud oorgetrek en daarvoor ’n goue krans gemaak rondom.

kjv_text: Also he made thereunto a border of an handbreadth round about; and made a crown of gold for the border thereof round about.
bsb_text: And he made a rim around it a handbreadth wide and put a gold molding on the rim.
aov_text: Hy het ook daarvoor ’n lys van ’n handbreed gemaak rondom; en hy het ’n goue krans vir die lys gemaak rondom.

kjv_text: And he cast for it four rings of gold, and put the rings upon the four corners that were in the four feet thereof.
bsb_text: He cast four gold rings for the table and fastened them to the four corners at its four legs.
aov_text: Hy het ook vier goue ringe daarvoor gegiet; en hy het die ringe vasgesit aan die vier hoeke van die vier pote.

kjv_text: Over against the border were the rings, the places for the staves to bear the table.
bsb_text: The rings were placed close to the rim, to serve as holders for the poles used to carry the table.
aov_text: Naby die lys was die ringe as plekke vir die draaghoute om die tafel te dra.

kjv_text: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold, to bear the table.
bsb_text: He made the poles of acacia wood for carrying the table and overlaid them with gold.
aov_text: Hy het ook die draaghoute van akasiahout gemaak en dit met goud oorgetrek om die tafel te dra.

kjv_text: And he made the vessels which were upon the table, his dishes, and his spoons, and his bowls, and his covers to cover withal, of pure gold.
bsb_text: He also made the utensils for the table out of pure gold: its plates and dishes, as well as its bowls and pitchers for pouring drink offerings.
aov_text: En hy het die gereedskap gemaak wat op die tafel moes wees: sy skottels en sy rookpanne en sy bekers en sy kanne waarmee gegiet moes word, van suiwer goud.

kjv_text: And he made the candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work made he the candlestick; his shaft, and his branch, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, were of the same:
bsb_text: Then he made the lampstand out of pure hammered gold, all of one piece: its base and shaft, its cups, and its buds and petals.
aov_text: Hy het ook die kandelaar van suiwer goud gemaak. Van dryfwerk het hy die kandelaar gemaak, sy voetstuk en sy stam; sy kelkies, sy knoppe en sy blomme was, daarmee saam, uit een stuk.

kjv_text: And six branches going out of the sides thereof; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side thereof, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side thereof:
bsb_text: Six branches extended from the sides, three on one side and three on the other.
aov_text: En ses arms het uit die sykante daarvan uitgegaan: drie arms van die kandelaar uit die een kant en drie arms van die kandelaar uit die ander kant.

kjv_text: Three bowls made after the fashion of almonds in one branch, a knop and a flower; and three bowls made like almonds in another branch, a knop and a flower: so throughout the six branches going out of the candlestick.
bsb_text: There were three cups shaped like almond blossoms on the first branch, each with buds and petals, three on the next branch, and the same for all six branches that extended from the lampstand.
aov_text: Drie kelkies soos amandelblomme aan die een arm, ’n knop en ’n blom, en drie kelkies soos amandelblomme aan die ander arm, ’n knop en ’n blom—so was dit aan die ses arms wat uit die kandelaar uitgaan.

kjv_text: And in the candlestick were four bowls made like almonds, his knops, and his flowers:
bsb_text: And on the lampstand were four cups shaped like almond blossoms with buds and petals.
aov_text: Maar aan die kandelaar self was vier kelkies soos amandelblomme, met knoppe en blomme:

kjv_text: And a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches going out of it.
bsb_text: A bud was under the first pair of branches that extended from the lampstand, a bud under the second pair, and a bud under the third pair.
aov_text: daar was ’n knop onder die eerste paar arms wat daaruit uitgaan; en ’n knop onder die tweede paar arms wat daaruit uitgaan; en ’n knop onder die derde paar arms wat daaruit uitgaan—vir die ses arms wat daaruit uitgaan.

kjv_text: Their knops and their branches were of the same: all of it was one beaten work of pure gold.
bsb_text: The buds and branches were all of one piece with the lampstand, hammered out of pure gold.
aov_text: Hulle knoppe en hulle arms was, daarmee saam, uit een stuk—alles saam een stuk dryfwerk van suiwer goud.

kjv_text: And he made his seven lamps, and his snuffers, and his snuffdishes, of pure gold.
bsb_text: He also made its seven lamps, its wick trimmers, and trays of pure gold.
aov_text: En hy het sewe lampe daarvoor gemaak en sy snuiters en sy bakkies van suiwer goud.

kjv_text: Of a talent of pure gold made he it, and all the vessels thereof.
bsb_text: He made the lampstand and all its utensils from a talent of pure gold.
aov_text: Van ’n talent suiwer goud het hy dit gemaak met al sy gereedskap.

kjv_text: And he made the incense altar of shittim wood: the length of it was a cubit, and the breadth of it a cubit; it was foursquare; and two cubits was the height of it; the horns thereof were of the same.
bsb_text: He made the altar of incense out of acacia wood. It was square, a cubit long, a cubit wide, and two cubits high. Its horns were of one piece.
aov_text: En hy het die reukaltaar van akasiahout gemaak; ’n el was sy lengte en ’n el sy breedte, vierkantig, en twee el sy hoogte. Sy horings was, daarmee saam, uit een stuk.

kjv_text: And he overlaid it with pure gold, both the top of it, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns of it: also he made unto it a crown of gold round about.
bsb_text: And he overlaid with pure gold the top and all the sides and horns. Then he made a molding of gold around it.
aov_text: En hy het dit met suiwer goud oorgetrek: die plaat, die sykante en die horings. En hy het daarvoor ’n goue krans gemaak rondom.

kjv_text: And he made two rings of gold for it under the crown thereof, by the two corners of it, upon the two sides thereof, to be places for the staves to bear it withal.
bsb_text: He made two gold rings below the molding on opposite sides to hold the poles used to carry it.
aov_text: Hy het ook twee goue ringe daarvoor gemaak, onderkant die krans aan weerskante, aan die twee sykante, as plekke vir draaghoute om dit daarmee te dra.

kjv_text: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.
bsb_text: And he made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.
aov_text: En hy het die draaghoute van akasiahout gemaak en dit met goud oorgetrek.

kjv_text: And he made the holy anointing oil, and the pure incense of sweet spices, according to the work of the apothecary.
bsb_text: He also made the sacred anointing oil and the pure, fragrant incense, the work of a perfumer.
aov_text: Hy het ook die heilige salfolie gemaak en die suiwer reukwerk van speserye, soos ’n salfmenger dit maak.

kjv_text: And he made the altar of burnt offering of shittim wood: five cubits was the length thereof, and five cubits the breadth thereof; it was foursquare; and three cubits the height thereof.
bsb_text: Bezalel constructed the altar of burnt offering from acacia wood. It was square, five cubits long, five cubits wide, and three cubits high.
aov_text: HY het ook die brandofferaltaar van akasiahout gemaak. Vyf el was sy lengte en vyf el sy breedte, vierkantig, en drie el sy hoogte.

kjv_text: And he made the horns thereof on the four corners of it; the horns thereof were of the same: and he overlaid it with brass.
bsb_text: He made a horn at each of its four corners, so that the horns and altar were of one piece, and he overlaid the altar with bronze.
aov_text: En hy het sy horings op die vier hoeke gemaak; sy horings was, daarmee saam, uit een stuk; en hy het dit met koper oorgetrek.

kjv_text: And he made all the vessels of the altar, the pots, and the shovels, and the basons, and the fleshhooks, and the firepans: all the vessels thereof made he of brass.
bsb_text: He made all the altar’s utensils of bronze—its pots, shovels, sprinkling bowls, meat forks, and firepans.
aov_text: Hy het ook al die gereedskap van die altaar gemaak: die potte en die skoppe en die komme, die vurke en die vuurpanne. Al dié gereedskap het hy van koper gemaak.

kjv_text: And he made for the altar a brasen grate of network under the compass thereof beneath unto the midst of it.
bsb_text: He made a grate of bronze mesh for the altar under its ledge, halfway up from the bottom.
aov_text: Ook het hy vir die altaar ’n traliewerk gemaak, ’n netwerk van koper, onder sy lys, onderaan tot by die helfte van die altaar.

kjv_text: And he cast four rings for the four ends of the grate of brass, to be places for the staves.
bsb_text: At the four corners of the bronze grate he cast four rings as holders for the poles.
aov_text: En hy het vier ringe aan die vier ente van die kopertraliewerk gegiet, as plekke vir die draaghoute.

kjv_text: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with brass.
bsb_text: And he made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with bronze.
aov_text: En hy het die draaghoute van akasiahout gemaak en dit met koper oorgetrek.

kjv_text: And he put the staves into the rings on the sides of the altar, to bear it withal; he made the altar hollow with boards.
bsb_text: Then he inserted the poles into the rings on the sides of the altar for carrying it. He made the altar with boards so that it was hollow.
aov_text: En hy het die draaghoute in die ringe gesteek, aan die kante van die altaar, om dit daarmee te dra; hy het dit hol, van planke, gemaak.

kjv_text: And he made the laver of brass, and the foot of it of brass, of the lookingglasses of the women assembling, which assembled at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
bsb_text: Next he made the bronze basin and its stand from the mirrors of the women who served at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
aov_text: Hy het ook die koperwaskom gemaak met sy kopervoetstuk, uit die spieëls van die diensdoende vroue wat by die ingang van die tent van samekoms gedien het.

kjv_text: And he made the court: on the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, an hundred cubits:
bsb_text: Then he constructed the courtyard. The south side of the courtyard was a hundred cubits long and had curtains of finely spun linen,
aov_text: Hy het ook die voorhof gemaak. Aan die suidekant, na die suide toe, was daar die behangsels van die voorhof, van fyn dubbeldraad-linne, honderd el lank;

kjv_text: Their pillars were twenty, and their brasen sockets twenty; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.
bsb_text: with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases, and with silver hooks and bands on the posts.
aov_text: daarby twintig pilare met hulle twintig kopervoetstukke; die kramme en die ringe van die pilare was van silwer;

kjv_text: And for the north side the hangings were an hundred cubits, their pillars were twenty, and their sockets of brass twenty; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.
bsb_text: The north side was also a hundred cubits long, with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases. The hooks and bands of the posts were silver.
aov_text: en aan die noordekant honderd el; daarby twintig pilare met hulle twintig kopervoetstukke; die kramme en die ringe van die pilare was van silwer.

kjv_text: And for the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.
bsb_text: The west side was fifty cubits long and had curtains, with ten posts and ten bases. The hooks and bands of the posts were silver.
aov_text: En aan die westekant was daar behangsels, vyftig el lank; daarby tien pilare met hulle tien voetstukke; die kramme en die ringe van die pilare was van silwer.

kjv_text: And for the east side eastward fifty cubits.
bsb_text: And the east side, toward the sunrise, was also fifty cubits long.
aov_text: En aan die oostekant, teen son-op, was daar vyftig el;

kjv_text: The hangings of the one side of the gate were fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
bsb_text: The curtains on one side of the entrance were fifteen cubits long, with three posts and three bases.
aov_text: vyftien el behangsels vir die een kant, daarby drie pilare met hulle drie voetstukke;

kjv_text: And for the other side of the court gate, on this hand and that hand, were hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
bsb_text: And the curtains on the other side were also fifteen cubits long, with three posts and three bases as well.
aov_text: en vir die ander kant—aan weerskante van die poort van die voorhof—vyftien el behangsels, daarby drie pilare met hulle drie voetstukke.

kjv_text: All the hangings of the court round about were of fine twined linen.
bsb_text: All the curtains around the courtyard were made of finely spun linen.
aov_text: Al die behangsels van die voorhof rondom was van fyn dubbeldraad-linne;

kjv_text: And the sockets for the pillars were of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver; and the overlaying of their chapiters of silver; and all the pillars of the court were filleted with silver.
bsb_text: The bases for the posts were bronze, the hooks and bands were silver, and the plating for the tops of the posts was silver. So all the posts of the courtyard were banded with silver.
aov_text: en die voetstukke van die pilare was van koper, en die kramme en die ringe van die pilare van silwer; en die oortreksel van hulle toppe van silwer; en hulle self, al die pilare van die voorhof, was van silwerringe voorsien.

kjv_text: And the hanging for the gate of the court was needlework, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: and twenty cubits was the length, and the height in the breadth was five cubits, answerable to the hangings of the court.
bsb_text: The curtain for the entrance to the courtyard was embroidered with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen. It was twenty cubits long and, like the curtains of the courtyard, five cubits high,
aov_text: En die bedekking van die poort van die voorhof was veelkleurige werk, van pers en purperrooi en bloedrooi stowwe en fyn dubbeldraad-linne: twintig el was die lengte, en die hoogte—tewens die breedte van die stof—vyf el, net soos die behangsels van die voorhof.

kjv_text: And their pillars were four, and their sockets of brass four; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their chapiters and their fillets of silver.
bsb_text: with four posts and four bronze bases. Their hooks were silver, as well as the bands and the plating of their tops.
aov_text: Daarby vier pilare met hulle vier voetstukke van koper en hulle kramme van silwer, en die oortreksel van hulle toppe en hulle ringe van silwer.

kjv_text: And all the pins of the tabernacle, and of the court round about, were of brass.
bsb_text: All the tent pegs for the tabernacle and for the surrounding courtyard were bronze.
aov_text: En al die penne vir die tabernakel en die voorhof rondom was van koper.

kjv_text: This is the sum of the tabernacle, even of the tabernacle of testimony, as it was counted, according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, son to Aaron the priest.
bsb_text: This is the inventory for the tabernacle, the tabernacle of the Testimony, as recorded at Moses’ command by the Levites under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.
aov_text: DIT is die berekening van die koste van die tabernakel, van die tabernakel van die Getuienis, soos dit bereken is op bevel van Moses, deur die diens van die Leviete, onder leiding van Ítamar, die seun van die priester Aäron.

kjv_text: And Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that the LORD commanded Moses.
bsb_text: Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made everything that the LORD had commanded Moses.
aov_text: En Besáleël, die seun van Uri, die seun van Hur, van die stam van Juda, het alles gemaak wat die HERE Moses beveel het.

kjv_text: And with him was Aholiab, son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a cunning workman, and an embroiderer in blue, and in purple, and in scarlet, and fine linen.
bsb_text: With him was Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, designer, and embroiderer in blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and fine linen.
aov_text: En saam met hom Ohóliab, die seun van Ahísamag, van die stam van Dan, ’n ambagsman en kunstenaar en kunswewer in pers en in purperrooi en in bloedrooi stowwe en in fyn linne.

kjv_text: All the gold that was occupied for the work in all the work of the holy place, even the gold of the offering, was twenty and nine talents, and seven hundred and thirty shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary.
bsb_text: All the gold from the wave offering used for the work on the sanctuary totaled 29 talents and 730 shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel.
aov_text: Al die goud wat vir die werk gebruik is, by al die werk van die heiligdom—die goud wat as offer aangebied was, het bedra negen-en-twintig talente en sewehonderd-en-dertig sikkels volgens die sikkel van die heiligdom.

kjv_text: And the silver of them that were numbered of the congregation was an hundred talents, and a thousand seven hundred and threescore and fifteen shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
bsb_text: The silver from those numbered among the congregation totaled 100 talents and 1,775 shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel—
aov_text: En die silwer van die geteldes van die vergadering was honderd talente en duisend-sewehonderd-vyf-en-sewentig sikkels volgens die sikkel van die heiligdom;

kjv_text: A bekah for every man, that is, half a shekel, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for every one that went to be numbered, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty men.
bsb_text: a beka per person, that is, half a shekel, according to the sanctuary shekel, from everyone twenty years of age or older who had crossed over to be numbered, a total of 603,550 men.
aov_text: ’n beka vir elke persoon, dit is ’n halfsikkel volgens die sikkel van die heiligdom, van elkeen wat oorgegaan het na die geteldes, van twintig jaar oud en daarbo, naamlik seshonderd-en-drieduisend-vyfhonderd-en-vyftig man.

kjv_text: And of the hundred talents of silver were cast the sockets of the sanctuary, and the sockets of the vail; an hundred sockets of the hundred talents, a talent for a socket.
bsb_text: The hundred talents of silver were used to cast the bases of the sanctuary and the bases of the veil—100 bases from the 100 talents, one talent per base.
aov_text: En die honderd talente silwer het gedien om die voetstukke van die heiligdom en die voetstukke van die voorhangsel te giet; honderd voetstukke vir honderd talente, ’n talent vir ’n voetstuk.

kjv_text: And of the thousand seven hundred seventy and five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, and overlaid their chapiters, and filleted them.
bsb_text: With the 1,775 shekels of silver he made the hooks for the posts, overlaid their tops, and supplied bands for them.
aov_text: Maar van die duisend-sewehonderd-vyf-en-sewentig sikkels het hy kramme vir die pilare gemaak, en hy het hulle toppe oorgetrek en hulle van ringe voorsien.

kjv_text: And the brass of the offering was seventy talents, and two thousand and four hundred shekels.
bsb_text: The bronze from the wave offering totaled 70 talents and 2,400 shekels.
aov_text: En die koper wat as offer aangebied was, het bedra sewentig talente en tweeduisend-vierhonderd sikkels.

kjv_text: And therewith he made the sockets to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the brasen altar, and the brasen grate for it, and all the vessels of the altar,
bsb_text: He used it to make the bases for the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, the bronze altar and its bronze grating, all the utensils for the altar,
aov_text: En hy het daaruit die voetstukke van die ingang van die tent van samekoms gemaak en die koperaltaar en sy kopertraliewerk en al die gereedskap van die altaar;

kjv_text: And the sockets of the court round about, and the sockets of the court gate, and all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins of the court round about.
bsb_text: the bases for the surrounding courtyard and its gate, and all the tent pegs for the tabernacle and its surrounding courtyard.
aov_text: en die voetstukke van die voorhof rondom en die voetstukke van die poort van die voorhof en al die penne van die tabernakel, ook al die penne van die voorhof rondom.

kjv_text: And of the blue, and purple, and scarlet, they made cloths of service, to do service in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron; as the LORD commanded Moses.
bsb_text: From the blue, purple, and scarlet yarn they made specially woven garments for ministry in the sanctuary, as well as the holy garments for Aaron, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
aov_text: HULLE het ook kunstige klere van pers en purperrooi en bloedrooi stowwe gemaak om in die heiligdom te dien. Ook het hulle die heilige klere vir Aäron gemaak soos die HERE Moses beveel het.

kjv_text: And he made the ephod of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
bsb_text: Bezalel made the ephod of finely spun linen embroidered with gold, and with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn.
aov_text: En hy het die skouerkleed gemaak van goud, pers en purperrooi en bloedrooi stowwe en fyn dubbeldraad-linne.

kjv_text: And they did beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in the blue, and in the purple, and in the scarlet, and in the fine linen, with cunning work.
bsb_text: They hammered out thin sheets of gold and cut threads from them to interweave with the blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and fine linen—the work of a skilled craftsman.
aov_text: En hulle het van die goud dun plate geslaan, en hy het dit in drade gesny om dit in te werk in die pers en purperrooi en bloedrooi stowwe en in die fyn linne—’n kunstige werk.

kjv_text: They made shoulderpieces for it, to couple it together: by the two edges was it coupled together.
bsb_text: They made shoulder pieces for the ephod, which were attached at two of its corners, so it could be fastened.
aov_text: Hulle het daar skouerstukke aan gemaak wat aan mekaar vas was; aan die twee bo-ente was dit saamgevoeg.

kjv_text: And the curious girdle of his ephod, that was upon it, was of the same, according to the work thereof; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen; as the LORD commanded Moses.
bsb_text: And the skillfully woven waistband of the ephod was of one piece with the ephod, of the same workmanship—with gold, with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and with finely spun linen, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
aov_text: En die band wat daaraan was om dit vas te bind, was daarmee saam uit een stuk, van dieselfde werk, van goud, pers en purperrooi en bloedrooi stowwe en fyn dubbeldraad-linne, soos die HERE Moses beveel het.

kjv_text: And they wrought onyx stones inclosed in ouches of gold, graven, as signets are graven, with the names of the children of Israel.
bsb_text: They mounted the onyx stones in gold filigree settings, engraved like a seal with the names of the sons of Israel.
aov_text: Hulle het ook die oniksstene gemaak, vasgesit in kassies van goud, gegraveer soos op ’n seëlsteen ingesny word, volgens die name van die kinders van Israel.

kjv_text: And he put them on the shoulders of the ephod, that they should be stones for a memorial to the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses.
bsb_text: Then they fastened them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod as memorial stones for the sons of Israel, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
aov_text: En hy het hulle op die skouerstukke van die skouerkleed bevestig as gedagtenisstene aan die kinders van Israel, soos die HERE Moses beveel het.

kjv_text: And he made the breastplate of cunning work, like the work of the ephod; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
bsb_text: He made the breastpiece with the same workmanship as the ephod, with gold, with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and with finely spun linen.
aov_text: Hy het ook die borstas van kunstige werk gemaak soos die werk van die skouerkleed; van goud, pers en purperrooi en bloedrooi stowwe en fyn dubbeldraad-linne.

kjv_text: It was foursquare; they made the breastplate double: a span was the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof, being doubled.
bsb_text: It was square when folded over double, a span long and a span wide.
aov_text: Dit was vierkantig; dubbel gevou het hulle die borstas gemaak; ’n span sy lengte en ’n span sy breedte, dubbel gevou was dit.

kjv_text: And they set in it four rows of stones: the first row was a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this was the first row.
bsb_text: And they mounted on it four rows of gemstones: The first row had a ruby, a topaz, and an emerald;
aov_text: En hulle het daarin vier rye stene ingevul: ’n ry met ’n karneool, ’n topaas en ’n smarag was die eerste ry.

kjv_text: And the second row, an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.
bsb_text: the second row had a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond;
aov_text: En die tweede ry: ’n karbonkel, ’n saffier en ’n jaspis.

kjv_text: And the third row, a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.
bsb_text: the third row had a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
aov_text: En die derde ry: ’n hiasint, ’n agaat en ’n ametis.

kjv_text: And the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper: they were inclosed in ouches of gold in their inclosings.
bsb_text: and the fourth row had a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper. These stones were mounted in gold filigree settings.
aov_text: En die vierde ry: ’n chrisoliet, ’n oniks en ’n sardoniks; hulle is in kassies van goud vasgesit by hulle invulling.

kjv_text: And the stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet, every one with his name, according to the twelve tribes.
bsb_text: The twelve stones corresponded to the names of the sons of Israel. Each stone was engraved like a seal with the name of one of the twelve tribes.
aov_text: En die stene was volgens die name van die kinders van Israel twaalf, volgens hulle name. Soos op ’n seëlsteen uitgesny word, was hulle vir twaalf stamme, elkeen volgens sy naam.

kjv_text: And they made upon the breastplate chains at the ends, of wreathen work of pure gold.
bsb_text: For the breastpiece they made braided chains like cords of pure gold.
aov_text: Hulle het ook by die borstas gedraaide kettings gemaak, soos toutjies gedraai, van suiwer goud;

kjv_text: And they made two ouches of gold, and two gold rings; and put the two rings in the two ends of the breastplate.
bsb_text: They also made two gold filigree settings and two gold rings, and fastened the two rings to the two corners of the breastpiece.
aov_text: en hulle het twee goue kassies en twee goue ringe gemaak, en die twee ringe aan die twee bo-ente van die borstas bevestig,

kjv_text: And they put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings on the ends of the breastplate.
bsb_text: Then they fastened the two gold chains to the two gold rings at the corners of the breastpiece,
aov_text: en hulle het die twee goue toutjies aan die twee ringe aan die bo-ente van die borstas vasgemaak.

kjv_text: And the two ends of the two wreathen chains they fastened in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod, before it.
bsb_text: and they fastened the other ends of the two chains to the two filigree settings, attaching them to the shoulder pieces of the ephod at the front.
aov_text: Maar die twee ander ente van die twee toutjies het hulle aan die twee kassies vasgemaak en dié dan aan die skouerstukke van die skouerkleed bevestig, aan die voorkant daarvan.

kjv_text: And they made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, upon the border of it, which was on the side of the ephod inward.
bsb_text: They made two more gold rings and attached them to the other two corners of the breastpiece, on the inside edge next to the ephod.
aov_text: Hulle het ook twee goue ringe gemaak en dié aan die twee onder-ente van die borstas bevestig, aan die kant wat teen die skouerkleed aan lê, aan die binnekant.

kjv_text: And they made two other golden rings, and put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart of it, over against the other coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.
bsb_text: They made two additional gold rings and attached them to the bottom of the two shoulder pieces of the ephod, on its front, near the seam just above its woven waistband.
aov_text: En hulle het twee goue ringe gemaak en dié aan die twee skouerstukke van die skouerkleed bevestig, onderaan, aan die voorkant daarvan, by sy verbinding, bo die band van die skouerkleed.

kjv_text: And they did bind the breastplate by his rings unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not be loosed from the ephod; as the LORD commanded Moses.
bsb_text: Then they tied the rings of the breastpiece to the rings of the ephod with a cord of blue yarn, so that the breastpiece was above the waistband of the ephod and would not swing out from the ephod, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
aov_text: En hulle het die borstas, met sy ringe, aan die ringe van die skouerkleed met ’n pers toutjie vasgebind, sodat dit bo die band van die skouerkleed sou wees en die borstas nie van die skouerkleed kon afskuiwe nie, soos die HERE Moses beveel het.

kjv_text: And he made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.
bsb_text: They made the robe of the ephod entirely of blue cloth, the work of a weaver,
aov_text: En hy het die mantel van die skouerkleed van wewerswerk gemaak, heeltemal van pers stof.

kjv_text: And there was an hole in the midst of the robe, as the hole of an habergeon, with a band round about the hole, that it should not rend.
bsb_text: with an opening in the center of the robe like that of a garment, with a collar around the opening so that it would not tear.
aov_text: En die opening van die mantel was in die middel daarvan soos die opening van ’n pantser; die opening het ’n soom rondom gehad, dat dit nie sou skeur nie.

kjv_text: And they made upon the hems of the robe pomegranates of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen.
bsb_text: They made pomegranates of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and finely spun linen on the lower hem of the robe.
aov_text: En aan die soom van die mantel het hulle granaatjies gemaak van pers en purperrooi en bloedrooi stowwe en fyn dubbeldraad-linne.

kjv_text: And they made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates upon the hem of the robe, round about between the pomegranates;
bsb_text: They also made bells of pure gold and attached them around the hem between the pomegranates,
aov_text: Hulle het ook klokkies van suiwer goud gemaak en die klokkies tussen die granaatjies gesit, aan die soom van die mantel rondom, tussen die granaatjies in:

kjv_text: A bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, round about the hem of the robe to minister in; as the LORD commanded Moses.
bsb_text: alternating the bells and pomegranates around the lower hem of the robe to be worn for ministry, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
aov_text: ’n klokkie en ’n granaatjie, ’n klokkie en ’n granaatjie, aan die soom van die mantel rondom, vir die diens, soos die HERE Moses beveel het.

kjv_text: And they made coats of fine linen of woven work for Aaron, and for his sons,
bsb_text: For Aaron and his sons they made tunics of fine linen, the work of a weaver,
aov_text: Hulle het ook die rokke van fyn linne gemaak, van wewerswerk, vir Aäron en sy seuns;

kjv_text: And a mitre of fine linen, and goodly bonnets of fine linen, and linen breeches of fine twined linen,
bsb_text: as well as the turban of fine linen, the ornate headbands and undergarments of finely spun linen,
aov_text: en die tulband van fyn linne en die pronkmusse van fyn linne en die linnebroeke van fyn dubbeldraad-linne;

kjv_text: And a girdle of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, of needlework; as the LORD commanded Moses.
bsb_text: and the sash of finely spun linen, embroidered with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
aov_text: en die gordel van fyn dubbeldraad-linne en van pers en purperrooi en bloedrooi stowwe, veelkleurige werk, soos die HERE Moses beveel het.

kjv_text: And they made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote upon it a writing, like to the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD.
bsb_text: They also made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and they engraved on it, like an inscription on a seal: HOLY TO THE LORD.
aov_text: Hulle het ook die plaat van die heilige kroon van suiwer goud gemaak en daarop geskrywe met letters soos dit op ’n seëlsteen uitgesny word: HEILIG AAN DIE HERE.

kjv_text: And they tied unto it a lace of blue, to fasten it on high upon the mitre; as the LORD commanded Moses.
bsb_text: Then they fastened to it a blue cord to mount it on the turban, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
aov_text: En hulle het ’n pers toutjie daaraan vasgemaak om dit bo-op die tulband te bevestig, soos die HERE Moses beveel het.

kjv_text: Thus was all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation finished: and the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did they.
bsb_text: So all the work for the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting, was completed. The Israelites did everything just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
aov_text: So is dan al die werk aan die tabernakel van die tent van samekoms voltooi; en die kinders van Israel het dit gemaak net soos die HERE Moses beveel het; so het hulle dit gemaak.

kjv_text: And they brought the tabernacle unto Moses, the tent, and all his furniture, his taches, his boards, his bars, and his pillars, and his sockets,
bsb_text: Then they brought the tabernacle to Moses: the tent with all its furnishings, its clasps, its frames, its crossbars, and its posts and bases;
aov_text: En hulle het die tabernakel na Moses gebring, die tent self met alles wat daarby behoort, sy hakies, sy style, sy dwarshoute en sy pilare en sy voetstukke,

kjv_text: And the covering of rams' skins dyed red, and the covering of badgers' skins, and the vail of the covering,
bsb_text: the covering of ram skins dyed red, the covering of fine leather, and the veil of the covering;
aov_text: en die dekkleed van rooigeverfde ramsvelle en die dekkleed van robbevelle en die voorhangsel tot bedekking;

kjv_text: The ark of the testimony, and the staves thereof, and the mercy seat,
bsb_text: the ark of the Testimony with its poles and the mercy seat;
aov_text: die ark van die Getuienis met sy draaghoute en die versoendeksel;

kjv_text: The table, and all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread,
bsb_text: the table with all its utensils and the Bread of the Presence;
aov_text: die tafel met al sy gereedskap en die toonbrode;

kjv_text: The pure candlestick, with the lamps thereof, even with the lamps to be set in order, and all the vessels thereof, and the oil for light,
bsb_text: the pure gold lampstand with its row of lamps and all its utensils, as well as the oil for the light;
aov_text: die suiwer kandelaar met sy lampe, die lampe wat daarop gerangskik moes word, met al sy gereedskap en die olie vir die kandelaar;

kjv_text: And the golden altar, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the tabernacle door,
bsb_text: the gold altar, the anointing oil, the fragrant incense, and the curtain for the entrance to the tent;
aov_text: verder die goue altaar en die salfolie en die reukwerk van speserye en die bedekking vir die ingang van die tent;

kjv_text: The brasen altar, and his grate of brass, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,
bsb_text: the bronze altar with its bronze grating, its poles, and all its utensils; the basin with its stand;
aov_text: die koperaltaar en sy kopertraliewerk, sy draaghoute met al sy gereedskap, die waskom en sy voetstuk;

kjv_text: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and his sockets, and the hanging for the court gate, his cords, and his pins, and all the vessels of the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of the congregation,
bsb_text: the curtains of the courtyard with its posts and bases; the curtain for the gate of the courtyard, its ropes and tent pegs, and all the equipment for the service of the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting;
aov_text: die behangsels van die voorhof, sy pilare en sy voetstukke, en die bedekking vir die poort van die voorhof, die lyne en penne wat daarby behoort, en al die gereedskap vir die diens in die tabernakel van die tent van samekoms;

kjv_text: The cloths of service to do service in the holy place, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and his sons' garments, to minister in the priest's office.
bsb_text: and the woven garments for ministering in the sanctuary, both the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments for his sons to serve as priests.
aov_text: die kunstige klere, om in die heiligdom te dien, die heilige klere van die priester Aäron en die klere van sy seuns, om die priesteramp te bedien.

kjv_text: According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel made all the work.
bsb_text: The Israelites had done all the work just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
aov_text: Net soos die HERE Moses beveel het, so het die kinders van Israel die hele werk gemaak.

kjv_text: And Moses did look upon all the work, and, behold, they had done it as the LORD had commanded, even so had they done it: and Moses blessed them.
bsb_text: And Moses inspected all the work and saw that they had accomplished it just as the LORD had commanded. So Moses blessed them.
aov_text: En Moses het die hele werk bekyk—en hulle het dit gemaak soos die HERE beveel het, so het hulle dit gemaak. Toe het Moses hulle geseën.

kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to Moses,
aov_text: VERDER het die HERE met Moses gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: On the first day of the first month shalt thou set up the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.
bsb_text: “On the first day of the first month you are to set up the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting.
aov_text: Op die dag van die eerste maand, op die eerste van die maand, moet jy die tabernakel van die tent van samekoms oprig.

kjv_text: And thou shalt put therein the ark of the testimony, and cover the ark with the vail.
bsb_text: Put the ark of the Testimony in it and screen off the ark with the veil.
aov_text: En jy moet daarin plaas die ark van die Getuienis en die ark met die voorhangsel bedek.

kjv_text: And thou shalt bring in the table, and set in order the things that are to be set in order upon it; and thou shalt bring in the candlestick, and light the lamps thereof.
bsb_text: Then bring in the table and set out its arrangement; bring in the lampstand as well, and set up its lamps.
aov_text: Dan moet jy die tafel inbring en daarop regsit wat daarop behoort. Jy moet ook die kandelaar inbring en sy lampe opsteek.

kjv_text: And thou shalt set the altar of gold for the incense before the ark of the testimony, and put the hanging of the door to the tabernacle.
bsb_text: Place the gold altar of incense in front of the ark of the Testimony, and hang the curtain at the entrance to the tabernacle.
aov_text: En jy moet die goue altaar vir die reukwerk voor die ark van die Getuienis neersit. Dan moet jy die bedekking van die ingang van die tabernakel ophang.

kjv_text: And thou shalt set the altar of the burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.
bsb_text: Place the altar of burnt offering in front of the entrance to the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting.
aov_text: Jy moet ook die brandofferaltaar voor die ingang van die tabernakel van die tent van samekoms neersit.

kjv_text: And thou shalt set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and shalt put water therein.
bsb_text: And place the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water in it.
aov_text: En jy moet die waskom tussen die tent van samekoms en die altaar neersit en daar water in gooi.

kjv_text: And thou shalt set up the court round about, and hang up the hanging at the court gate.
bsb_text: Set up the surrounding courtyard and hang the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard.
aov_text: En maak die voorhof rondom, en hang die bedekking aan die poort van die voorhof op.

kjv_text: And thou shalt take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle, and all that is therein, and shalt hallow it, and all the vessels thereof: and it shall be holy.
bsb_text: Take the anointing oil and anoint the tabernacle and everything in it; consecrate it along with all its furnishings, and it shall be holy.
aov_text: Dan moet jy die salfolie neem, en jy moet die tabernakel salf en alles wat daarin is, en dit heilig met alles wat daarby behoort; en dit sal heilig wees.

kjv_text: And thou shalt anoint the altar of the burnt offering, and all his vessels, and sanctify the altar: and it shall be an altar most holy.
bsb_text: Anoint the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils; consecrate the altar, and it shall be most holy.
aov_text: Jy moet ook die brandofferaltaar salf met al sy gereedskap, en jy moet die altaar heilig, en die altaar sal hoogheilig wees.

kjv_text: And thou shalt anoint the laver and his foot, and sanctify it.
bsb_text: Anoint the basin and its stand and consecrate them.
aov_text: Salf dan die waskom en sy voetstuk, en heilig dit.

kjv_text: And thou shalt bring Aaron and his sons unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and wash them with water.
bsb_text: Then bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and wash them with water.
aov_text: Jy moet ook Aäron en sy seuns laat nader kom, na die ingang van die tent van samekoms toe, en jy moet hulle met water was.

kjv_text: And thou shalt put upon Aaron the holy garments, and anoint him, and sanctify him; that he may minister unto me in the priest's office.
bsb_text: And you are to clothe Aaron with the holy garments, anoint him, and consecrate him, so that he may serve Me as a priest.
aov_text: Trek Aäron dan die heilige klere aan; en salf hom en heilig hom, dat hy vir My die priesteramp kan bedien.

kjv_text: And thou shalt bring his sons, and clothe them with coats:
bsb_text: Bring his sons forward and clothe them with tunics.
aov_text: Jy moet ook sy seuns laat nader kom en hulle die rokke aantrek.

kjv_text: And thou shalt anoint them, as thou didst anoint their father, that they may minister unto me in the priest's office: for their anointing shall surely be an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.
bsb_text: Anoint them just as you anointed their father, so that they may also serve Me as priests. Their anointing will qualify them for a permanent priesthood throughout their generations.”
aov_text: Salf hulle dan, soos jy hulle vader gesalf het, dat hulle vir My die priesteramp kan bedien. En hul salwing moet vir hulle ’n ewige priesterskap in hulle geslagte wees.

kjv_text: Thus did Moses: according to all that the LORD commanded him, so did he.
bsb_text: Moses did everything just as the LORD had commanded him.
aov_text: En Moses het gedoen net soos die HERE hom beveel het; so het hy gedoen.

kjv_text: And it came to pass in the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, that the tabernacle was reared up.
bsb_text: So the tabernacle was set up on the first day of the first month of the second year.
aov_text: En in die eerste maand, in die tweede jaar, op die eerste van die maand, is die tabernakel opgerig.

kjv_text: And Moses reared up the tabernacle, and fastened his sockets, and set up the boards thereof, and put in the bars thereof, and reared up his pillars.
bsb_text: When Moses set up the tabernacle, he laid its bases, positioned its frames, inserted its crossbars, and set up its posts.
aov_text: En Moses het die tabernakel opgerig: hy het sy voetstukke neergesit en sy style daarop gesit en sy dwarshoute vasgemaak en sy pilare opgerig.

kjv_text: And he spread abroad the tent over the tabernacle, and put the covering of the tent above upon it; as the LORD commanded Moses.
bsb_text: Then he spread the tent over the tabernacle and put the covering over the tent, just as the LORD had commanded him.
aov_text: En hy het die tentseil oor die tabernakel gespan en die dekkleed van die tent daar bo-oor getrek, soos die HERE Moses beveel het.

kjv_text: And he took and put the testimony into the ark, and set the staves on the ark, and put the mercy seat above upon the ark:
bsb_text: Moses took the Testimony and placed it in the ark, attaching the poles to the ark; and he set the mercy seat atop the ark.
aov_text: Verder het hy die Getuienis geneem en dit in die ark neergelê en die draaghoute aan die kant van die ark ingesteek, en die versoendeksel het hy bo-op die ark gesit.

kjv_text: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the vail of the covering, and covered the ark of the testimony; as the LORD commanded Moses.
bsb_text: Then he brought the ark into the tabernacle, put up the veil for the screen, and shielded off the ark of the Testimony, just as the LORD had commanded him.
aov_text: Toe het hy die ark in die tabernakel gebring en die voorhangsel tot bedekking opgehang en die ark van die Getuienis bedek, soos die HERE Moses beveel het.

kjv_text: And he put the table in the tent of the congregation, upon the side of the tabernacle northward, without the vail.
bsb_text: Moses placed the table in the Tent of Meeting on the north side of the tabernacle, outside the veil.
aov_text: Hy het ook die tafel in die tent van samekoms neergesit, aan die kant van die tabernakel, teen die noorde, buitekant die voorhangsel.

kjv_text: And he set the bread in order upon it before the LORD; as the LORD had commanded Moses.
bsb_text: He arranged the bread on it before the LORD, just as the LORD had commanded him.
aov_text: En hy het die brood daarop gerangskik voor die aangesig van die HERE, soos die HERE Moses beveel het.

kjv_text: And he put the candlestick in the tent of the congregation, over against the table, on the side of the tabernacle southward.
bsb_text: He also placed the lampstand in the Tent of Meeting opposite the table on the south side of the tabernacle
aov_text: Hy het ook die kandelaar in die tent van samekoms gesit, teenoor die tafel, aan die suidekant van die tabernakel.

kjv_text: And he lighted the lamps before the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.
bsb_text: and set up the lamps before the LORD, just as the LORD had commanded him.
aov_text: En hy het die lampe opgesteek, voor die aangesig van die HERE, soos die HERE Moses beveel het.

kjv_text: And he put the golden altar in the tent of the congregation before the vail:
bsb_text: Moses placed the gold altar in the Tent of Meeting, in front of the veil,
aov_text: En hy het die goue altaar in die tent van samekoms neergesit, voor die voorhangsel,

kjv_text: And he burnt sweet incense thereon; as the LORD commanded Moses.
bsb_text: and he burned fragrant incense on it, just as the LORD had commanded him.
aov_text: en reukwerk van speserye daarop aan die brand gesteek, soos die HERE Moses beveel het.

kjv_text: And he set up the hanging at the door of the tabernacle.
bsb_text: Then he put up the curtain at the entrance to the tabernacle.
aov_text: Hy het ook die bedekking van die ingang van die tabernakel opgehang.

kjv_text: And he put the altar of burnt offering by the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation, and offered upon it the burnt offering and the meat offering; as the LORD commanded Moses.
bsb_text: He placed the altar of burnt offering near the entrance to the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting, and offered on it the burnt offering and the grain offering, just as the LORD had commanded him.
aov_text: En hy het die brandofferaltaar by die ingang van die tabernakel van die tent van samekoms neergesit, en hy het daarop die brandoffer en die spysoffer gebring, soos die HERE Moses beveel het.

kjv_text: And he set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and put water there, to wash withal.
bsb_text: He placed the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar and put water in it for washing;
aov_text: Hy het ook die waskom tussen die tent van samekoms en die altaar gesit, en hy het daar water in gegooi om mee te was.

kjv_text: And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet thereat:
bsb_text: and from it Moses, Aaron, and his sons washed their hands and feet.
aov_text: En Moses en Aäron en sy seuns het daaruit hulle hande en voete gewas.

kjv_text: When they went into the tent of the congregation, and when they came near unto the altar, they washed; as the LORD commanded Moses.
bsb_text: They washed whenever they entered the Tent of Meeting or approached the altar, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
aov_text: As hulle ingaan in die tent van samekoms of nader kom na die altaar, het hulle hul elke keer gewas, soos die HERE Moses beveel het.

kjv_text: And he reared up the court round about the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the hanging of the court gate. So Moses finished the work.
bsb_text: And Moses set up the courtyard around the tabernacle and the altar, and he hung the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard. So Moses finished the work.
aov_text: Hy het ook die voorhof opgerig, rondom die tabernakel en die altaar, en die bedekking vir die poort van die voorhof opgehang. So het Moses dan die werk voltooi.

kjv_text: Then a cloud covered the tent of the congregation, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
bsb_text: Then the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
aov_text: Toe het die wolk die tent van samekoms oordek, en die heerlikheid van die HERE het die tabernakel vervul,

kjv_text: And Moses was not able to enter into the tent of the congregation, because the cloud abode thereon, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
bsb_text: Moses was unable to enter the Tent of Meeting because the cloud had settled on it, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
aov_text: sodat Moses nie in die tent van samekoms kon ingaan nie, omdat die wolk daarop gerus en die heerlikheid van die HERE die tabernakel vervul het.

kjv_text: And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward in all their journeys:
bsb_text: Whenever the cloud was lifted from above the tabernacle, the Israelites would set out through all the stages of their journey.
aov_text: En as die wolk van die tabernakel af optrek, het die kinders van Israel elke keer weggetrek op al hulle togte;

kjv_text: But if the cloud were not taken up, then they journeyed not till the day that it was taken up.
bsb_text: If the cloud was not lifted, they would not set out until the day it was taken up.
aov_text: maar as die wolk nie optrek nie, dan trek hulle nie weg nie, totdat dit weer optrek.

kjv_text: For the cloud of the LORD was upon the tabernacle by day, and fire was on it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.
bsb_text: For the cloud of the LORD was over the tabernacle by day, and fire was in the cloud by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel through all their journeys.
aov_text: Want die wolk van die HERE was bedags op die tabernakel, en vuur was snags daarin, voor die oë van die hele huis van Israel, op al hulle togte.

kjv_text: And the LORD called unto Moses, and spake unto him out of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,
bsb_text: Then the LORD called to Moses and spoke to him from the Tent of Meeting, saying,
aov_text: EN die HERE het Moses geroep en met hom gespreek uit die tent van samekoms en gesê:

kjv_text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man of you bring an offering unto the LORD, ye shall bring your offering of the cattle, even of the herd, and of the flock.
bsb_text: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them: When any of you brings an offering to the LORD, you may bring as your offering an animal from the herd or the flock.
aov_text: Spreek met die kinders van Israel en sê vir hulle: As iemand van julle aan die HERE ’n offer wil bring, kan julle jul offer bring van vee—van beeste of van kleinvee.

kjv_text: If his offering be a burnt sacrifice of the herd, let him offer a male without blemish: he shall offer it of his own voluntary will at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD.
bsb_text: If one’s offering is a burnt offering from the herd, he is to present an unblemished male. He must bring it to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting for its acceptance before the LORD.
aov_text: As sy offer ’n brandoffer is van beeste, moet dit ’n bul sonder gebrek wees wat hy bring. By die ingang van die tent van samekoms moet hy dit bring, sodat hy welgevalle voor die aangesig van die HERE kan vind.

kjv_text: And he shall put his hand upon the head of the burnt offering; and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.
bsb_text: He is to lay his hand on the head of the burnt offering, so it can be accepted on his behalf to make atonement for him.
aov_text: En hy moet sy hand op die kop van die brandoffer lê, dan sal dit vir hom met welgevalle aangeneem word om versoening vir hom te doen.

kjv_text: And he shall kill the bullock before the LORD: and the priests, Aaron's sons, shall bring the blood, and sprinkle the blood round about upon the altar that is by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
bsb_text: And he shall slaughter the young bull before the LORD, and Aaron’s sons the priests are to present the blood and sprinkle it on all sides of the altar at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
aov_text: Dan moet hy die jong bul voor die aangesig van die HERE slag; en die seuns van Aäron, die priesters, moet die bloed bring en die bloed rondom teen die altaar uitgooi wat by die ingang van die tent van samekoms is.

kjv_text: And he shall flay the burnt offering, and cut it into his pieces.
bsb_text: Next, he is to skin the burnt offering and cut it into pieces.
aov_text: Dan moet hy die brandoffer afslag en dit in sy stukke verdeel.

kjv_text: And the sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire upon the altar, and lay the wood in order upon the fire:
bsb_text: The sons of Aaron the priest shall put a fire on the altar and arrange wood on the fire.
aov_text: En die seuns van Aäron, die priester, moet vuur op die altaar neersit en hout op die vuur reglê.

kjv_text: And the priests, Aaron's sons, shall lay the parts, the head, and the fat, in order upon the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar:
bsb_text: Then Aaron’s sons the priests are to arrange the pieces, including the head and the fat, atop the burning wood on the altar.
aov_text: Ook moet die seuns van Aäron, die priesters, die stukke, die kop en die vet reglê op die hout wat op die altaarvuur is.

kjv_text: But his inwards and his legs shall he wash in water: and the priest shall burn all on the altar, to be a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
