bsb_text: Do not turn to idols or make for yourselves molten gods. I am the LORD your God.
aov_text: Begeef julle nie tot die afgode en maak vir julle geen gegote gode nie. Ek is die HERE julle God.

kjv_text: And if ye offer a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD, ye shall offer it at your own will.
bsb_text: When you sacrifice a peace offering to the LORD, you shall offer it for your acceptance.
aov_text: En as julle ’n dankoffer aan die HERE slag, moet julle dit so offer, dat julle welgevalle kan vind.

kjv_text: It shall be eaten the same day ye offer it, and on the morrow: and if ought remain until the third day, it shall be burnt in the fire.
bsb_text: It shall be eaten on the day you sacrifice it, or on the next day; but what remains on the third day must be burned up.
aov_text: Op die dag as julle dit offer en die dag daarna, moet dit geëet word; maar wat tot die derde dag toe oorbly, moet met vuur verbrand word.

kjv_text: And if it be eaten at all on the third day, it is abominable; it shall not be accepted.
bsb_text: If any of it is eaten on the third day, it is tainted and will not be accepted.
aov_text: En as dit tog op die derde dag geëet word, sal dit ’n onrein ding wees; dit sal nie met welgevalle aangeneem word nie.

kjv_text: Therefore every one that eateth it shall bear his iniquity, because he hath profaned the hallowed thing of the LORD: and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
bsb_text: Whoever eats it will bear his iniquity, for he has profaned what is holy to the LORD. That person must be cut off from his people.
aov_text: En hy wat dit eet, moet sy ongeregtigheid dra, want wat heilig is aan die HERE, het hy ontheilig. Daarom moet dié siel uit sy volksgenote uitgeroei word.

kjv_text: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleanings of thy harvest.
bsb_text: When you reap the harvest of your land, you are not to reap to the very edges of your field or gather the gleanings of your harvest.
aov_text: En as julle die opbrings van julle land oes, moet jy die kant van jou land nie heeltemal afoes en die are wat val, nie versamel nie.

kjv_text: And thou shalt not glean thy vineyard, neither shalt thou gather every grape of thy vineyard; thou shalt leave them for the poor and stranger: I am the LORD your God.
bsb_text: You must not strip your vineyard bare or gather its fallen grapes. Leave them for the poor and the foreigner. I am the LORD your God.
aov_text: Jou wingerd moet jy ook nie skoon afoes nie, en die trossies wat van jou wingerd val, nie versamel nie. Vir die arme en die vreemdeling moet jy dit laat oorbly. Ek is die HERE julle God.

kjv_text: Ye shall not steal, neither deal falsely, neither lie one to another.
bsb_text: You must not steal. You must not lie or deceive one another.
aov_text: Julle mag nie steel nie, en julle mag nie lieg nie, en julle mag die een die ander nie bedrieg nie.

kjv_text: And ye shall not swear by my name falsely, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the LORD.
bsb_text: You must not swear falsely by My name and so profane the name of your God. I am the LORD.
aov_text: En julle mag nie vals sweer by my Naam en so die Naam van jou God ontheilig nie. Ek is die HERE.

kjv_text: Thou shalt not defraud thy neighbour, neither rob him: the wages of him that is hired shall not abide with thee all night until the morning.
bsb_text: You must not defraud your neighbor or rob him. You must not withhold until morning the wages due a hired hand.
aov_text: Jy mag jou naaste nie verdruk of beroof nie. Die dagloner se loon mag by jou nie tot die môre toe bly nie.

kjv_text: Thou shalt not curse the deaf, nor put a stumblingblock before the blind, but shalt fear thy God: I am the LORD.
bsb_text: You must not curse the deaf or place a stumbling block before the blind, but you shall fear your God. I am the LORD.
aov_text: Jy mag ’n dowe nie vloek nie, en voor die blinde geen struikelblok lê nie; maar jy moet jou God vrees. Ek is die HERE.

kjv_text: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment: thou shalt not respect the person of the poor, nor honor the person of the mighty: but in righteousness shalt thou judge thy neighbour.
bsb_text: You must not pervert justice; you must not show partiality to the poor or favoritism to the rich; you are to judge your neighbor fairly.
aov_text: Julle mag geen onreg doen in die gereg nie. Jy mag vir die geringe nie partydig wees nie en die aansienlike nie voortrek nie. Met geregtigheid moet jy oor jou naaste oordeel.

kjv_text: Thou shalt not go up and down as a talebearer among thy people: neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbour: I am the LORD.
bsb_text: You must not go about spreading slander among your people. You must not endanger the life of your neighbor. I am the LORD.
aov_text: Jy mag nie as ’n kwaadspreker onder jou volksgenote rondloop nie. Jy mag nie teen die lewe van jou naaste optree nie. Ek is die HERE.

kjv_text: Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart: thou shalt in any wise rebuke thy neighbour, and not suffer sin upon him.
bsb_text: You must not harbor hatred against your brother in your heart. Directly rebuke your neighbor, so that you will not incur guilt on account of him.
aov_text: Jy mag jou broer in jou hart nie haat nie. Jy moet jou naaste vrymoedig berispe, sodat jy om sy ontwil geen sonde op jou laai nie.

kjv_text: Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am the LORD.
bsb_text: Do not seek revenge or bear a grudge against any of your people, but love your neighbor as yourself. I am the LORD.
aov_text: Jy mag nie wraakgierig of haatdraend teenoor die kinders van jou volk wees nie, maar jy moet jou naaste liefhê soos jouself. Ek is die HERE.

kjv_text: Ye shall keep my statutes. Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with a diverse kind: thou shalt not sow thy field with mingled seed: neither shall a garment mingled of linen and woollen come upon thee.
bsb_text: You are to keep My statutes. You shall not crossbreed two different kinds of livestock; you shall not sow your fields with two kinds of seed; and you shall not wear clothing made of two kinds of material.
aov_text: Julle moet my insettinge hou. Twee soorte van jou vee mag jy nie laat paar nie. Jou akker moet jy nie met twee soorte saad besaai nie. En ’n kleed van twee soorte goed, van gemengde stof, mag nie op jou kom nie.

kjv_text: And whosoever lieth carnally with a woman, that is a bondmaid, betrothed to an husband, and not at all redeemed, nor freedom given her; she shall be scourged; they shall not be put to death, because she was not free.
bsb_text: If a man lies carnally with a slave girl promised to another man but who has not been redeemed or given her freedom, there must be due punishment. But they are not to be put to death, because she had not been freed.
aov_text: En as ’n man vleeslike gemeenskap het met ’n vrou wat ’n slavin is, vir ’n ander man bestemd, sonder dat sy ooit losgekoop of vryheid aan haar gegee is, dan moet daar bestraffing plaasvind. Hulle mag nie gedood word nie, want sy was nie vrygelaat nie.

kjv_text: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, even a ram for a trespass offering.
bsb_text: The man, however, must bring a ram to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting as his guilt offering to the LORD.
aov_text: En hy moet sy skuldoffer aan die HERE bring by die ingang van die tent van samekoms—’n ram as skuldoffer;

kjv_text: And the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before the LORD for his sin which he hath done: and the sin which he hath done shall be forgiven him.
bsb_text: The priest shall make atonement on his behalf before the LORD with the ram of the guilt offering for the sin he has committed, and he will be forgiven the sin he has committed.
aov_text: en die priester moet met die skuldofferram vir hom versoening doen voor die aangesig van die HERE weens die sonde wat hy gedoen het; en hy sal vergifnis ontvang vir sy sonde wat hy gedoen het.

kjv_text: And when ye shall come into the land, and shall have planted all manner of trees for food, then ye shall count the fruit thereof as uncircumcised: three years shall it be as uncircumcised unto you: it shall not be eaten of.
bsb_text: When you enter the land and plant any kind of tree for food, you shall regard the fruit as forbidden. For three years it will be forbidden to you and must not be eaten.
aov_text: En as julle in die land inkom en allerhande vrugtebome plant, moet julle hulle vrugte as verbode beskou; drie jaar lank moet hulle vir julle verbode wees; daar mag nie van geëet word nie.

kjv_text: But in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy to praise the LORD withal.
bsb_text: In the fourth year all its fruit must be consecrated as a praise offering to the LORD.
aov_text: Maar in die vierde jaar moet al hulle vrugte ’n heilige feesgawe aan die HERE wees;

kjv_text: And in the fifth year shall ye eat of the fruit thereof, that it may yield unto you the increase thereof: I am the LORD your God.
bsb_text: But in the fifth year you may eat its fruit; thus your harvest will be increased. I am the LORD your God.
aov_text: en in die vyfde jaar mag julle hulle vrugte eet—dit alles om hulle opbrings vir julle meer te maak. Ek is die HERE julle God.

kjv_text: Ye shall not eat any thing with the blood: neither shall ye use enchantment, nor observe times.
bsb_text: You must not eat anything with blood still in it. You must not practice divination or sorcery.
aov_text: Julle mag niks met bloed en al eet nie. Julle mag nie met verklaring van voortekens of goëlery omgaan nie.

kjv_text: Ye shall not round the corners of your heads, neither shalt thou mar the corners of thy beard.
bsb_text: You must not cut off the hair at the sides of your head or clip off the edges of your beard.
aov_text: Julle mag die rand van julle hoofhare nie rond wegskeer nie. Ook mag jy die rand van jou baard nie skend nie.

kjv_text: Ye shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor print any marks upon you: I am the LORD.
bsb_text: You must not make any cuts in your bodies for the dead or put tattoo marks on yourselves. I am the LORD.
aov_text: Julle mag ook ter wille van ’n dooie geen snye in julle vlees maak nie en geen ingeprikte tekening in julle vel maak nie. Ek is die HERE.

kjv_text: Do not prostitute thy daughter, to cause her to be a whore; lest the land fall to whoredom, and the land become full of wickedness.
bsb_text: You must not defile your daughter by making her a prostitute, or the land will be prostituted and filled with depravity.
aov_text: Ontheilig jou dogter nie deur haar vir hoerery aan te hou nie, sodat die land nie hoereer en die land vol skandelike dade word nie.

kjv_text: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am the LORD.
bsb_text: You must keep My Sabbaths and have reverence for My sanctuary. I am the LORD.
aov_text: Julle moet my sabbatte hou en my heiligdom ontsien. Ek is die HERE.

kjv_text: Regard not them that have familiar spirits, neither seek after wizards, to be defiled by them: I am the LORD your God.
bsb_text: You must not turn to mediums or spiritists; do not seek them out, or you will be defiled by them. I am the LORD your God.
aov_text: Begeef julle nie tot die geeste van afgestorwenes en die geeste wat waarsê nie. Soek hulle nie om julle deur hulle te verontreinig nie. Ek is die HERE julle God.

kjv_text: Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head, and honour the face of the old man, and fear thy God: I am the LORD.
bsb_text: You are to rise in the presence of the elderly, honor the aged, and fear your God. I am the LORD.
aov_text: Vir die grys hare moet jy opstaan, en die persoon van ’n grysaard eer; en jy moet jou God vrees. Ek is die HERE.

kjv_text: And if a stranger sojourn with thee in your land, ye shall not vex him.
bsb_text: When a foreigner resides with you in your land, you must not oppress him.
aov_text: En as ’n vreemdeling by jou in julle land vertoef, mag julle hom nie verdruk nie.

kjv_text: But the stranger that dwelleth with you shall be unto you as one born among you, and thou shalt love him as thyself; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.
bsb_text: You must treat the foreigner living among you as native-born and love him as yourself, for you were foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.
aov_text: Die vreemdeling wat by julle vertoef, moet vir julle wees soos ’n kind van die land wat onder julle is. En jy moet hom liefhê soos jouself, want julle was vreemdelinge in Egipteland. Ek is die HERE julle God.

kjv_text: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in meteyard, in weight, or in measure.
bsb_text: You must not use dishonest measures of length, weight, or volume.
aov_text: Julle mag geen onreg doen in die gereg, in lengtemaat, gewig of inhoudsmaat nie.

kjv_text: Just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin, shall ye have: I am the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt.
bsb_text: You shall maintain honest scales and weights, an honest ephah, and an honest hin. I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.
aov_text: Julle moet ’n regte weegskaal hê, regte weegstene, ’n regte efa en ’n regte hin. Ek is die HERE julle God wat julle uit Egipteland uitgelei het.

kjv_text: Therefore shall ye observe all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: I am the LORD.
bsb_text: You must keep all My statutes and all My ordinances and follow them. I am the LORD.”
aov_text: Daarom moet julle al my insettinge en al my verordeninge onderhou en dit doen. Ek is die HERE.

kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to Moses,
aov_text: VERDER het die HERE met Moses gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: Again, thou shalt say to the children of Israel, Whosoever he be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel, that giveth any of his seed unto Molech; he shall surely be put to death: the people of the land shall stone him with stones.
bsb_text: “Tell the Israelites, ‘Any Israelite or foreigner living in Israel who gives any of his children to Molech must be put to death. The people of the land are to stone him.
aov_text: Jy moet ook aan die kinders van Israel sê: Elkeen uit die kinders van Israel of uit die vreemdelinge wat in Israel vertoef, wat van sy kinders aan Molog gee, moet sekerlik gedood word. Die volk van die land moet hom stenig.

kjv_text: And I will set my face against that man, and will cut him off from among his people; because he hath given of his seed unto Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.
bsb_text: And I will set My face against that man and cut him off from his people, because by giving his offspring to Molech, he has defiled My sanctuary and profaned My holy name.
aov_text: En Ek sal my aangesig teen dié man rig en sal hom uitroei onder sy volk uit; want hy het van sy kinders aan Molog gegee om my heiligdom te verontreinig en my heilige Naam te ontheilig.

kjv_text: And if the people of the land do any ways hide their eyes from the man, when he giveth of his seed unto Molech, and kill him not:
bsb_text: And if the people of the land ever hide their eyes and fail to put to death the man who gives one of his children to Molech,
aov_text: En as die volk van die land hulle oë maar enigsins toemaak vir dié man as hy van sy kinders aan Molog gee, sodat hulle hom nie doodmaak nie,

kjv_text: Then I will set my face against that man, and against his family, and will cut him off, and all that go a whoring after him, to commit whoredom with Molech, from among their people.
bsb_text: then I will set My face against that man and his family and cut off from among their people both him and all who follow him in prostituting themselves with Molech.
aov_text: dan sal Ek my aangesig rig teen dié man en sy geslag, en Ek sal hom en almal wat agter hom aan hoereer om agter Molog aan te hoereer, uitroei onder hulle volk uit.

kjv_text: And the soul that turneth after such as have familiar spirits, and after wizards, to go a whoring after them, I will even set my face against that soul, and will cut him off from among his people.
bsb_text: Whoever turns to mediums or spiritists to prostitute himself with them, I will also set My face against that person and cut him off from his people.
aov_text: En as ’n persoon hom begewe tot die geeste van afgestorwenes en die geeste wat waarsê om agter hulle aan te hoereer, sal Ek my aangesig teen dié persoon rig en hom uitroei onder sy volk uit.

kjv_text: Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be ye holy: for I am the LORD your God.
bsb_text: Consecrate yourselves, therefore, and be holy, because I am the LORD your God.
aov_text: Toon dan dat julle heilig is en wees heilig, want Ek is die HERE julle God.

kjv_text: And ye shall keep my statutes, and do them: I am the LORD which sanctify you.
bsb_text: And you shall keep My statutes and practice them. I am the LORD who sanctifies you.
aov_text: En onderhou my insettinge en doen dit. Ek is die HERE wat julle heilig.

kjv_text: For every one that curseth his father or his mother shall be surely put to death: he hath cursed his father or his mother; his blood shall be upon him.
bsb_text: If anyone curses his father or mother, he must be put to death. He has cursed his father or mother; his blood shall be upon him.
aov_text: Want elkeen wat sy vader of moeder vloek, moet sekerlik gedood word. Hy het sy vader of sy moeder gevloek. Sy bloedskuld is op hom.

kjv_text: And the man that committeth adultery with another man's wife, even he that committeth adultery with his neighbour's wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.
bsb_text: If a man commits adultery with another man’s wife—with the wife of his neighbor—both the adulterer and the adulteress must surely be put to death.
aov_text: En as iemand owerspel doen met ’n man se vrou, owerspel doen met sy naaste se vrou, moet hy en sy wat owerspel doen, sekerlik gedood word.

kjv_text: And the man that lieth with his father's wife hath uncovered his father's nakedness: both of them shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
bsb_text: If a man lies with his father’s wife, he has uncovered his father’s nakedness. Both must surely be put to death; their blood is upon them.
aov_text: En as ’n man met sy vader se vrou gemeenskap het, het hy die skaamte van sy vader ontbloot. Hulle altwee moet sekerlik gedood word. Hulle bloedskuld is op hulle.

kjv_text: And if a man lie with his daughter in law, both of them shall surely be put to death: they have wrought confusion; their blood shall be upon them.
bsb_text: If a man lies with his daughter-in-law, both must surely be put to death. They have acted perversely; their blood is upon them.
aov_text: En as ’n man met sy skoondogter gemeenskap het, moet hulle altwee sekerlik gedood word. Hulle het ’n gruwelike vermenging bewerk. Hulle bloedskuld is op hulle.

kjv_text: If a man also lie with mankind, as he lieth with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
bsb_text: If a man lies with a man as with a woman, they have both committed an abomination. They must surely be put to death; their blood is upon them.
aov_text: En as ’n man met ’n manspersoon gemeenskap het soos ’n mens met ’n vrou het, het hulle altwee iets gruweliks gedoen. Hulle moet sekerlik gedood word. Hulle bloedskuld is op hulle.

kjv_text: And if a man take a wife and her mother, it is wickedness: they shall be burnt with fire, both he and they; that there be no wickedness among you.
bsb_text: If a man marries both a woman and her mother, it is depraved. Both he and they must be burned in the fire, so that there will be no depravity among you.
aov_text: En as ’n man ’n vrou en haar moeder neem, is dit ’n skandelike daad; hulle moet hom en dié twee met vuur verbrand: daar mag geen bloedskande onder julle wees nie.

kjv_text: And if a man lie with a beast, he shall surely be put to death: and ye shall slay the beast.
bsb_text: If a man lies carnally with an animal, he must be put to death. And you are also to kill the animal.
aov_text: En as ’n man vleeslike gemeenskap het met ’n dier, moet hy sekerlik gedood word, en die dier moet julle doodslaan.

kjv_text: And if a woman approach unto any beast, and lie down thereto, thou shalt kill the woman, and the beast: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
bsb_text: If a woman approaches any animal to mate with it, you must kill both the woman and the animal. They must surely be put to death; their blood is upon them.
aov_text: En as ’n vrou naby enige dier kom om daarmee te doen te hê, moet jy die vrou en die dier doodslaan. Hulle moet sekerlik gedood word. Hulle bloedskuld is op hulle.

kjv_text: And if a man shall take his sister, his father's daughter, or his mother's daughter, and see her nakedness, and she see his nakedness; it is a wicked thing; and they shall be cut off in the sight of their people: he hath uncovered his sister's nakedness; he shall bear his iniquity.
bsb_text: If a man marries his sister, whether the daughter of his father or of his mother, and they have sexual relations, it is a disgrace. They must be cut off in the sight of their people. He has uncovered the nakedness of his sister; he shall bear his iniquity.
aov_text: En as ’n man sy suster neem, sy vader se dogter of sy moeder se dogter, en hy haar skaamte sien en sy sy skaamte sien, is dit ’n skande. Daarom moet hulle voor die oë van die kinders van hulle volk uitgeroei word. Hy het die skaamte van sy suster ontbloot; hy moet sy ongeregtigheid dra.

kjv_text: And if a man shall lie with a woman having her sickness, and shall uncover her nakedness; he hath discovered her fountain, and she hath uncovered the fountain of her blood: and both of them shall be cut off from among their people.
bsb_text: If a man lies with a menstruating woman and has sexual relations with her, he has exposed the source of her flow, and she has uncovered the source of her blood. Both of them must be cut off from among their people.
aov_text: En as ’n man met ’n vrou gemeenskap het wat onwel is, en haar skaamte ontbloot—hy het haar fontein ontbloot en sý die fontein van haar bloed—dan moet hulle altwee uitgeroei word onder hulle volk uit.

kjv_text: And thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother's sister, nor of thy father's sister: for he uncovereth his near kin: they shall bear their iniquity.
bsb_text: You must not have sexual relations with the sister of your mother or your father, for it is exposing one’s own kin; both shall bear their iniquity.
aov_text: Ook mag jy die skaamte van jou moeder se suster en van jou vader se suster nie ontbloot nie, want hy het sy bloedverwante ontbloot; hulle moet hul ongeregtigheid dra.

kjv_text: And if a man shall lie with his uncle's wife, he hath uncovered his uncle's nakedness: they shall bear their sin; they shall die childless.
bsb_text: If a man lies with his uncle’s wife, he has uncovered the nakedness of his uncle. They will bear their sin; they shall die childless.
aov_text: En as ’n man met sy tante gemeenskap het, het hy die skaamte van sy oom ontbloot. Hulle moet hul sonde dra; sonder kinders sal hulle sterwe.

kjv_text: And if a man shall take his brother's wife, it is an unclean thing: he hath uncovered his brother's nakedness; they shall be childless.
bsb_text: If a man marries his brother’s wife, it is an act of impurity. He has uncovered the nakedness of his brother; they shall be childless.
aov_text: En as ’n man sy broer se vrou neem, is dit bloedskande. Hy het die skaamte van sy broer ontbloot; sonder kinders sal hulle wees.

kjv_text: Ye shall therefore keep all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: that the land, whither I bring you to dwell therein, spue you not out.
bsb_text: You are therefore to keep all My statutes and ordinances, so that the land where I am bringing you to live will not vomit you out.
aov_text: Onderhou dan al my insettinge en al my verordeninge en doen dit, dat die land waarheen Ek julle bring om daarin te woon, julle nie uitspuug nie.

kjv_text: And ye shall not walk in the manners of the nation, which I cast out before you: for they committed all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.
bsb_text: You must not follow the statutes of the nations I am driving out before you. Because they did all these things, I abhorred them.
aov_text: En julle mag nie wandel in die insettinge van die nasie wat Ek voor julle uit verdrywe nie; want al hierdie dinge het hulle gedoen; daarom het Ek ’n afsku van hulle gekry.

kjv_text: But I have said unto you, Ye shall inherit their land, and I will give it unto you to possess it, a land that floweth with milk and honey: I am the LORD your God, which have separated you from other people.
bsb_text: But I have told you that you will inherit their land, since I will give it to you as an inheritance—a land flowing with milk and honey. I am the LORD your God, who has set you apart from the peoples.
aov_text: En Ek het vir julle gesê: Júlle sal hulle land in besit neem, en Ék sal dit aan julle as besitting gee, ’n land wat oorloop van melk en heuning. Ek is die HERE julle God wat julle van die volke afgesonder het.

kjv_text: Ye shall therefore put difference between clean beasts and unclean, and between unclean fowls and clean: and ye shall not make your souls abominable by beast, or by fowl, or by any manner of living thing that creepeth on the ground, which I have separated from you as unclean.
bsb_text: You are therefore to distinguish between clean and unclean animals and birds. Do not become contaminated by any animal or bird, or by anything that crawls on the ground; I have set these apart as unclean for you.
aov_text: Daarom moet julle ’n onderskeid maak tussen die rein en onrein diere, en tussen die onrein en rein voëls; en maak julleself nie ’n gruwel deur diere of deur voëls of deur enigiets wat op die aarde roer nie—wat Ek vir julle afgesonder het deur dit onrein te verklaar.

kjv_text: And ye shall be holy unto me: for I the LORD am holy, and have severed you from other people, that ye should be mine.
bsb_text: You are to be holy to Me because I, the LORD, am holy, and I have set you apart from the nations to be My own.
aov_text: En julle moet vir My heilig wees, want Ek, die HERE, is heilig; en Ek het julle van die volke afgesonder om myne te wees.

kjv_text: A man also or woman that hath a familiar spirit, or that is a wizard, shall surely be put to death: they shall stone them with stones: their blood shall be upon them.
bsb_text: A man or a woman who is a medium or spiritist must surely be put to death. They shall be stoned; their blood is upon them.’”

kjv_text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land which I give you, then shall the land keep a sabbath unto the LORD.
bsb_text: “Speak to the Israelites and say to them: When you enter the land that I am giving you, the land itself must observe a Sabbath to the LORD.
aov_text: Spreek met die kinders van Israel en sê vir hulle: As julle in die land inkom wat Ek julle gee, moet die land ’n sabbat hou vir die HERE.

kjv_text: Six years thou shalt sow thy field, and six years thou shalt prune thy vineyard, and gather in the fruit thereof;
bsb_text: For six years you may sow your field and prune your vineyard and gather its crops.
aov_text: Ses jaar lank mag jy jou land saai en ses jaar lank jou wingerd snoei en die opbrings daarvan insamel;

kjv_text: But in the seventh year shall be a sabbath of rest unto the land, a sabbath for the LORD: thou shalt neither sow thy field, nor prune thy vineyard.
bsb_text: But in the seventh year there shall be a Sabbath of complete rest for the land—a Sabbath to the LORD. You are not to sow your field or prune your vineyard.
aov_text: maar in die sewende jaar moet daar vir die land volkome rus wees, ’n sabbat vir die HERE; jou land mag jy nie saai en jou wingerd nie snoei nie.

kjv_text: That which groweth of its own accord of thy harvest thou shalt not reap, neither gather the grapes of thy vine undressed: for it is a year of rest unto the land.
bsb_text: You are not to reap the aftergrowth of your harvest or gather the grapes of your untended vines. The land must have a year of complete rest.
aov_text: Wat van jou oes opslaan, moet jy nie afoes nie, en die druiwe van jou ongesnoeide wingerdstok nie afsny nie. Dit moet ’n jaar van rus vir die land wees.

kjv_text: And the sabbath of the land shall be meat for you; for thee, and for thy servant, and for thy maid, and for thy hired servant, and for thy stranger that sojourneth with thee,
bsb_text: Whatever the land yields during the Sabbath year shall be food for you—for yourself, your manservant and maidservant, the hired hand or foreigner who stays with you,
aov_text: En die opbrings van die sabbat van die land sal julle voedsel wees; vir jou en jou slaaf en jou slavin en jou dagloner en jou bywoner wat by jou vertoef,

kjv_text: And for thy cattle, and for the beast that are in thy land, shall all the increase thereof be meat.
bsb_text: and for your livestock and the wild animals in your land. All its growth may serve as food.
aov_text: en vir jou vee en die wild wat in jou land is, sal die hele opbrings daarvan wees om te eet.

kjv_text: And thou shalt number seven sabbaths of years unto thee, seven times seven years; and the space of the seven sabbaths of years shall be unto thee forty and nine years.
bsb_text: And you shall count off seven Sabbaths of years—seven times seven years—so that the seven Sabbaths of years amount to forty-nine years.
aov_text: Jy moet ook sewe jaarweke tel, sewe maal sewe jaar, sodat die dae van die sewe jaarweke vir jou negen-en-veertig jaar is.

kjv_text: Then shalt thou cause the trumpet of the jubile to sound on the tenth day of the seventh month, in the day of atonement shall ye make the trumpet sound throughout all your land.
bsb_text: Then you are to sound the horn far and wide on the tenth day of the seventh month, the Day of Atonement. You shall sound it throughout your land.
aov_text: Dan moet jy in die sewende maand, op die tiende van die maand, ’n basuingeklank laat deurgaan; op die versoendag moet julle die basuin deur julle hele land laat gaan.

kjv_text: And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout all the land unto all the inhabitants thereof: it shall be a jubile unto you; and ye shall return every man unto his possession, and ye shall return every man unto his family.
bsb_text: So you are to consecrate the fiftieth year and proclaim liberty in the land for all its inhabitants. It shall be your Jubilee, when each of you is to return to his property and to his clan.
aov_text: En julle moet die vyftigste jaar heilig en ’n vrylating in die land uitroep aan al sy bewoners. Dit moet vir julle ’n jubeljaar wees; dan moet julle elkeen na sy besitting en elkeen na sy geslag teruggaan.

kjv_text: A jubile shall that fiftieth year be unto you: ye shall not sow, neither reap that which groweth of itself in it, nor gather the grapes in it of thy vine undressed.
bsb_text: The fiftieth year will be a Jubilee for you; you are not to sow the land or reap its aftergrowth or harvest the untended vines.
aov_text: ’n Jubeljaar moet dit, die vyftigste jaar, vir julle wees. Julle mag nie saai nie, ook nie afoes wat dan opslaan of die druiwe van die onbesnoeide wingerdstok dan afsny nie.

kjv_text: For it is the jubile; it shall be holy unto you: ye shall eat the increase thereof out of the field.
bsb_text: For it is a Jubilee; it shall be holy to you. You may eat only the crops taken directly from the field.
aov_text: Want dit is ’n jubeljaar, dit moet vir julle heilig wees: van die land af moet julle die opbrings daarvan eet.

kjv_text: In the year of this jubile ye shall return every man unto his possession.
bsb_text: In this Year of Jubilee, each of you shall return to his own property.
aov_text: In hierdie jubeljaar moet julle elkeen na sy besitting teruggaan.

kjv_text: And if thou sell ought unto thy neighbour, or buyest ought of thy neighbour's hand, ye shall not oppress one another:
bsb_text: If you make a sale to your neighbor or a purchase from him, you must not take advantage of each other.
aov_text: Daarom, as jy iets aan jou naaste verkoop of van jou naaste koop, moet julle mekaar nie verdruk nie;

kjv_text: According to the number of years after the jubile thou shalt buy of thy neighbour, and according unto the number of years of the fruits he shall sell unto thee:
bsb_text: You are to buy from your neighbor according to the number of years since the last Jubilee; he is to sell to you according to the number of harvest years remaining.
aov_text: volgens die getal jare ná die jubeljaar moet jy van jou naaste koop; volgens die getal jare dat daar ’n oes is, moet hy dit aan jou verkoop;

kjv_text: According to the multitude of years thou shalt increase the price thereof, and according to the fewness of years thou shalt diminish the price of it: for according to the number of the years of the fruits doth he sell unto thee.
bsb_text: You shall increase the price in proportion to a greater number of years, or decrease it in proportion to a lesser number of years; for he is selling you a given number of harvests.
aov_text: volgens die groter aantal jare moet jy die koopprys daarvan vermeerder, en volgens die kleiner aantal jare moet jy die koopprys daarvan verminder, want hy verkoop aan jou die aantal oeste.

kjv_text: Ye shall not therefore oppress one another; but thou shalt fear thy God:for I am the LORD your God.
bsb_text: Do not take advantage of each other, but fear your God; for I am the LORD your God.
aov_text: Laat niemand dan sy naaste verdruk nie, en vrees jy jou God; want Ek is die HERE julle God.

kjv_text: Wherefore ye shall do my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them; and ye shall dwell in the land in safety.
bsb_text: You are to keep My statutes and carefully observe My judgments, so that you may dwell securely in the land.
aov_text: En doen my insettinge en onderhou my verordeninge en doen dit, dat julle veilig kan woon in die land.

kjv_text: And the land shall yield her fruit, and ye shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.
bsb_text: Then the land will yield its fruit, so that you can eat your fill and dwell in safety in the land.
aov_text: En die land sal sy vrug gee, en julle sal volop eet en veilig daarin woon.

kjv_text: And if ye shall say, What shall we eat the seventh year? behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase:
bsb_text: Now you may wonder, ‘What will we eat in the seventh year if we do not sow or gather our produce?’
aov_text: En as julle sê: Wat moet ons in die sewende jaar eet as ons nie mag saai nie en ons oes nie mag insamel nie? —

kjv_text: Then I will command my blessing upon you in the sixth year, and it shall bring forth fruit for three years.
bsb_text: But I will send My blessing upon you in the sixth year, so that the land will yield a crop sufficient for three years.
aov_text: dan gebied Ek my seën vir julle in die sesde jaar, en dit sal die oes vir die drie jare oplewer.

kjv_text: And ye shall sow the eighth year, and eat yet of old fruit until the ninth year; until her fruits come in ye shall eat of the old store.
bsb_text: While you are sowing in the eighth year, you will be eating from the previous harvest, until the ninth year’s harvest comes in.
aov_text: En in die agtste jaar moet julle saai en van die ou opbrings eet tot die negende jaar toe; totdat die opbrings hiervan inkom, moet julle die oue eet.

kjv_text: The land shall not be sold for ever: for the land is mine; for ye are strangers and sojourners with me.
bsb_text: The land must not be sold permanently, because it is Mine, and you are but foreigners and residents with Me.
aov_text: DIE grond moet ook nie vir altyd verkoop word nie; want die land is myne, omdat julle vreemdelinge en bywoners by My is.

kjv_text: And in all the land of your possession ye shall grant a redemption for the land.
bsb_text: Thus for every piece of property you possess, you must provide for the redemption of the land.
aov_text: Daarom moet julle, in die hele land van julle besitting, lossing van die grond toelaat.

kjv_text: If thy brother be waxen poor, and hath sold away some of his possession, and if any of his kin come to redeem it, then shall he redeem that which his brother sold.
bsb_text: If your brother becomes impoverished and sells some of his property, his nearest of kin may come and redeem what his brother has sold.
aov_text: As jou broer verarm en van sy besitting verkoop, moet sy losser wat sy nabestaande is, kom en hy moet los wat sy broer verkoop het.

kjv_text: And if the man have none to redeem it, and himself be able to redeem it;
bsb_text: Or if a man has no one to redeem it for him, but he prospers and acquires enough to redeem his land,
aov_text: En as iemand geen losser het nie, maar dit kan bekostig en genoeg vind vir die lossing,

kjv_text: Then let him count the years of the sale thereof, and restore the overplus unto the man to whom he sold it; that he may return unto his possession.
bsb_text: he shall calculate the years since its sale, repay the balance to the man to whom he sold it, and return to his property.
aov_text: moet hy die jare bereken dat dit verkoop is, en wat oorskiet, moet hy aan die man aan wie hy verkoop het, teruggee en dan na sy besitting teruggaan.

kjv_text: But if he be not able to restore it to him, then that which is sold shall remain in the hand of him that hath bought it until the year of jubile: and in the jubile it shall go out, and he shall return unto his possession.
bsb_text: But if he cannot obtain enough to repay him, what he sold will remain in possession of the buyer until the Year of Jubilee. In the Jubilee, however, it is to be released, so that he may return to his property.
aov_text: Maar as hy nie genoeg vind om dit terug te koop nie, moet die verkoopte goed in die hand van die koper bly tot die jubeljaar toe; maar in die jubeljaar moet dit vry word, en hy moet na sy besitting teruggaan.

kjv_text: And if a man sell a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it is sold; within a full year may he redeem it.
bsb_text: If a man sells a house in a walled city, he retains his right of redemption until a full year after its sale; during that year it may be redeemed.
aov_text: En as iemand ’n woonhuis in ’n ommuurde stad verkoop, moet daar reg van lossing wees tot die end van die jaar dat dit verkoop is; ’n jaar lank moet daar reg van lossing wees.

kjv_text: And if it be not redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall be established for ever to him that bought it throughout his generations: it shall not go out in the jubile.
bsb_text: If it is not redeemed by the end of a full year, then the house in the walled city is permanently transferred to its buyer and his descendants. It is not to be released in the Jubilee.
aov_text: Maar as dit nie gelos word voordat ’n hele jaar verby is nie, moet die huis wat in die ommuurde stad is, vir altyd die eiendom van sy koper bly vir sy geslagte; in die jubeljaar sal dit nie vry word nie.

kjv_text: But the houses of the villages which have no wall round about them shall be counted as the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall go out in the jubile.
bsb_text: But houses in villages with no walls around them are to be considered as open fields. They may be redeemed, and they shall be released in the Jubilee.
aov_text: Maar die huise van die dorpe wat rondom geen muur het nie, moet by die veld van die land gereken word; daar moet reg van lossing voor wees en in die jubeljaar moet dit vry word.

kjv_text: Notwithstanding the cities of the Levites, and the houses of the cities of their possession, may the Levites redeem at any time.
bsb_text: As for the cities of the Levites, the Levites always have the right to redeem their houses in the cities they possess.
aov_text: Wat die stede van die Leviete aangaan, die huise in die stede wat in hulle besit is—vir die Leviete moet daar ’n ewige reg van lossing wees.

kjv_text: And if a man purchase of the Levites, then the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, shall go out in the year of jubile: for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.
bsb_text: So whatever belongs to the Levites may be redeemed—a house sold in a city they possess—and must be released in the Jubilee, because the houses in the cities of the Levites are their possession among the Israelites.
aov_text: En as iemand van die Leviete dit sal los, moet die huis wat verkoop is, naamlik in die stad van sy besitting, in die jubeljaar vry word; want die huise in die stede van die Leviete is hulle besitting onder die kinders van Israel.

kjv_text: But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold; for it is their perpetual possession.
bsb_text: But the open pastureland around their cities may not be sold, for this is their permanent possession.
aov_text: En die weiveld om hulle stede mag nie verkoop word nie, want dit is ’n ewige besitting vir hulle.

kjv_text: And if thy brother be waxen poor, and fallen in decay with thee; then thou shalt relieve him: yea, though he be a stranger, or a sojourner; that he may live with thee.
bsb_text: Now if your countryman becomes destitute and cannot support himself among you, then you are to help him as you would a foreigner or stranger, so that he can continue to live among you.
aov_text: En as jou broer by jou verarm en agterraak, moet jy hom ondersteun, soos ’n vreemdeling en bywoner, dat hy by jou kan lewe.

kjv_text: Take thou no usury of him, or increase: but fear thy God; that thy brother may live with thee.
bsb_text: Do not take any interest or profit from him, but fear your God, that your countryman may live among you.
aov_text: Jy moenie rente of wins van hom neem nie, maar jy moet jou God vrees, dat jou broer by jou kan lewe.

kjv_text: Thou shalt not give him thy money upon usury, nor lend him thy victuals for increase.
bsb_text: You must not lend him your silver at interest or sell him your food for profit.
aov_text: Jou geld mag jy hom nie op rente gee nie, en jou eetware mag jy nie teen wins gee nie.

kjv_text: I am the LORD your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your God.
bsb_text: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt to give you the land of Canaan and to be your God.
aov_text: Ek is die HERE julle God wat julle uit Egipteland uitgelei het om julle die land Kanaän te gee, om julle God te wees.

kjv_text: And if thy brother that dwelleth by thee be waxen poor, and be sold unto thee; thou shalt not compel him to serve as a bondservant:
bsb_text: If a countryman among you becomes destitute and sells himself to you, then you must not force him into slave labor.
aov_text: En as jou broer by jou verarm en hom aan jou verkoop, mag jy hom nie as slaaf laat dien nie.

kjv_text: But as an hired servant, and as a sojourner, he shall be with thee, and shall serve thee unto the year of jubile:
bsb_text: Let him stay with you as a hired worker or temporary resident; he is to work for you until the Year of Jubilee.
aov_text: Soos ’n dagloner, soos ’n bywoner moet hy by jou wees; tot die jubeljaar toe moet hy by jou dien;

kjv_text: And then shall he depart from thee, both he and his children with him, and shall return unto his own family, and unto the possession of his fathers shall he return.
bsb_text: Then he and his children are to be released, and he may return to his clan and to the property of his fathers.
aov_text: dan moet hy vry van jou af weggaan, hy en sy kinders saam met hom; en hy moet na sy geslag terugkeer en na die besitting van sy vaders teruggaan.

kjv_text: For they are my servants, which I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: they shall not be sold as bondmen.
bsb_text: Because the Israelites are My servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt, they are not to be sold as slaves.
aov_text: Want hulle is my knegte wat Ek uit Egipteland uitgelei het; hulle mag nie verkoop word soos ’n mens ’n slaaf verkoop nie.

kjv_text: Thou shalt not rule over him with rigour; but shalt fear thy God.
bsb_text: You are not to rule over them harshly, but you shall fear your God.
aov_text: Jy mag nie met hardheid oor hom heers nie, maar jy moet jou God vrees.

kjv_text: Both thy bondmen, and thy bondmaids, which thou shalt have, shall be of the heathen that are round about you; of them shall ye buy bondmen and bondmaids.
bsb_text: Your menservants and maidservants shall come from the nations around you, from whom you may purchase them.
aov_text: Wat jou slaaf of jou slavin aangaan wat aan jou sal behoort—van die nasies wat rondom julle is, van hulle mag julle ’n slaaf of slavin koop.

kjv_text: Moreover of the children of the strangers that do sojourn among you, of them shall ye buy, and of their families that are with you, which they begat in your land: and they shall be your possession.
bsb_text: You may also purchase them from the foreigners residing among you or their clans living among you who are born in your land. These may become your property.
aov_text: En ook van die kinders van die bywoners wat by julle vertoef—van hulle mag julle koop en van hulle geslag wat by julle is, wat hulle in julle land verwek het; en dié sal vir julle ’n besitting wees.

kjv_text: And ye shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you, to inherit them for a possession; they shall be your bondmen for ever: but over your brethren the children of Israel, ye shall not rule one over another with rigour.
bsb_text: You may leave them to your sons after you to inherit as property; you can make them slaves for life. But as for your brothers, the Israelites, no man may rule harshly over his brother.
aov_text: En julle mag dié aan julle kinders ná julle nalaat as ’n erflike besitting; vir ewig mag julle hulle laat dien. Maar oor julle broers, die kinders van Israel, die een oor die ander—oor hom mag jy nie met hardheid heers nie.

kjv_text: And if a sojourner or stranger wax rich by thee, and thy brother that dwelleth by him wax poor, and sell himself unto the stranger or sojourner by thee, or to the stock of the stranger's family:
bsb_text: If a foreigner residing among you prospers, but your countryman dwelling near him becomes destitute and sells himself to the foreigner or to a member of his clan,
aov_text: En as ’n vreemdeling of bywoner by jou vermoënd word, en jou broer by hom verarm en hy homself aan ’n vreemdeling of bywoner by jou verkoop, of aan ’n familielid uit die geslag van ’n vreemdeling,

kjv_text: After that he is sold he may be redeemed again; one of his brethren may redeem him:
bsb_text: he retains the right of redemption after he has sold himself. One of his brothers may redeem him:
aov_text: dan moet daar vir hom, nadat hy hom verkoop het, reg van lossing wees; een van sy broers kan hom los,

kjv_text: Either his uncle, or his uncle's son, may redeem him, or any that is nigh of kin unto him of his family may redeem him; or if he be able, he may redeem himself.
bsb_text: either his uncle or cousin or any close relative from his clan may redeem him. Or if he prospers, he may redeem himself.
aov_text: of sy oom of sy oom se seun kan hom los, of een van sy naaste bloedverwante uit sy geslag kan hom los, of as hy dit kan bekostig, kan hy homself los.

kjv_text: And he shall reckon with him that bought him from the year that he was sold to him unto the year of jubile: and the price of his sale shall be according unto the number of years, according to the time of an hired servant shall it be with him.
bsb_text: He and his purchaser will then count the time from the year he sold himself up to the Year of Jubilee. The price of his sale will be determined by the number of years, based on the daily wages of a hired hand.
aov_text: En hy moet met sy koper reken van die jaar af dat hy hom aan hom verkoop het, tot die jubeljaar toe. En die prys waarvoor hy hom verkoop het, moet wees volgens die aantal jare; soos ’n dagloner sal hy dan dié tyd by hom gewees het.

kjv_text: If there be yet many years behind, according unto them he shall give again the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.
bsb_text: If many years remain, he must pay for his redemption in proportion to his purchase price.
aov_text: As daar nog baie jare is, moet hy volgens hulle sy losprys uit die geld waarvoor hy gekoop is, teruggee;

kjv_text: And if there remain but few years unto the year of jubile, then he shall count with him, and according unto his years shall he give him again the price of his redemption.
bsb_text: If only a few years remain until the Year of Jubilee, he is to calculate and pay his redemption according to his remaining years.
aov_text: en as daar maar min jare tot die jubeljaar toe oor is, moet hy daarmee rekening hou; volgens dié jare moet hy sy losprys teruggee.

kjv_text: And as a yearly hired servant shall he be with him: and the other shall not rule with rigour over him in thy sight.
bsb_text: He shall be treated like a man hired from year to year, but a foreign owner must not rule over him harshly in your sight.
aov_text: Soos een wat van jaar tot jaar loonarbeider is, moet hy by hom wees; hy mag nie met hardheid oor hom voor jou oë heers nie.

kjv_text: And if he be not redeemed in these years, then he shall go out in the year of jubile, both he, and his children with him.
bsb_text: Even if he is not redeemed in any of these ways, he and his children shall be released in the Year of Jubilee.
aov_text: En as hy nie op dié wyse gelos word nie, moet hy in die jubeljaar vrygelaat word, hy en sy kinders saam met hom.

kjv_text: For unto me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.
bsb_text: For the Israelites are My servants. They are My servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.
aov_text: Want die kinders van Israel is my knegte; my knegte is hulle wat Ek uit Egipteland uitgelei het. Ek is die HERE julle God.

kjv_text: Ye shall make you no idols nor graven image, neither rear you up a standing image, neither shall ye set up any image of stone in your land, to bow down unto it: for I am the LORD your God.
bsb_text: “You must not make idols for yourselves or set up a carved image or sacred pillar; you must not place a sculpted stone in your land to bow down to it. For I am the LORD your God.
aov_text: JULLE mag vir julle geen afgode maak nie; en ’n gesnede beeld of ’n klippilaar mag julle vir julle nie oprig nie en ’n steen met beeldhouwerk in julle land nie opstel om julle daarby neer te buig nie; want Ek is die HERE julle God.

kjv_text: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am the LORD.
bsb_text: You must keep My Sabbaths and have reverence for My sanctuary. I am the LORD.
aov_text: My sabbatte moet julle hou en my heiligdom ontsien. Ek is die HERE.

kjv_text: If ye walk in my statutes, and keep my commandments, and do them;
bsb_text: If you follow My statutes and carefully keep My commandments,
aov_text: As julle in my insettinge wandel en my gebooie hou en dit doen,

kjv_text: Then I will give you rain in due season, and the land shall yield her increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.
bsb_text: I will give you rains in their season, and the land will yield its produce, and the trees of the field will bear their fruit.
aov_text: sal Ek julle reëns gee op die regte tyd, en die land sal sy opbrings gee, en die bome van die veld sal hulle vrugte gee.

kjv_text: And your threshing shall reach unto the vintage, and the vintage shall reach unto the sowing time: and ye shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.
bsb_text: Your threshing will continue until the grape harvest, and the grape harvest will continue until sowing time; you will have your fill of food to eat and will dwell securely in your land.
aov_text: En die dorstyd sal vir julle aanhou tot die druiwe-oes, en die druiwe-oes sal aanhou tot die saaityd, en julle sal jul brood volop eet en veilig in julle land woon.

kjv_text: And I will give peace in the land, and ye shall lie down, and none shall make you afraid: and I will rid evil beasts out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.
bsb_text: And I will give peace to the land, and you will lie down with nothing to fear. I will rid the land of dangerous animals, and no sword will pass through your land.
aov_text: Ook sal Ek vrede gee in die land, sodat julle sal lê en rus sonder dat iemand julle skrikmaak; en Ek sal die wilde diere uit die land laat verdwyn, en geen swaard sal deur julle land trek nie.

kjv_text: And ye shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.
bsb_text: You will pursue your enemies, and they will fall by the sword before you.
aov_text: En julle sal jul vyande agtervolg, en hulle sal voor julle val deur die swaard.

kjv_text: And five of you shall chase an hundred, and an hundred of you shall put ten thousand to flight: and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.
bsb_text: Five of you will pursue a hundred, and a hundred of you will pursue ten thousand, and your enemies will fall by the sword before you.
aov_text: Vyf van julle sal honderd agtervolg, en honderd van julle sal tienduisend agtervolg; en julle vyande sal voor julle val deur die swaard.

kjv_text: For I will have respect unto you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, and establish my covenant with you.
bsb_text: I will turn toward you and make you fruitful and multiply you, and I will establish My covenant with you.
aov_text: En Ek sal My na julle wend en julle vrugbaar maak en julle vermenigvuldig; en my verbond sal Ek met julle bevestig.

kjv_text: And ye shall eat old store, and bring forth the old because of the new.
bsb_text: You will still be eating the old supply of grain when you need to clear it out to make room for the new.
aov_text: Julle sal ou koring van vorige jare eet en die oue laat plek maak vir die nuwe.

kjv_text: And I will set my tabernacle among you: and my soul shall not abhor you.
bsb_text: And I will make My dwelling place among you, and My soul will not despise you.
aov_text: En Ek sal my tabernakel onder julle oprig, en my siel sal van julle geen afsku hê nie.

kjv_text: And I will walk among you, and will be your God, and ye shall be my people.
bsb_text: I will walk among you and be your God, and you will be My people.
aov_text: En Ek sal in jul midde wandel en vir julle ’n God wees, en júlle sal vir My ’n volk wees.

kjv_text: I am the LORD your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, that ye should not be their bondmen; and I have broken the bands of your yoke, and made you go upright.
bsb_text: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt so that you would no longer be slaves to the Egyptians. I broke the bars of your yoke and enabled you to walk in uprightness.
aov_text: Ek is die HERE julle God wat julle uit Egipteland uitgelei het, dat julle nie hulle slawe moet wees nie; en Ek het julle jukskeie verbreek en het julle regop laat loop.

kjv_text: But if ye will not hearken unto me, and will not do all these commandments;
bsb_text: If, however, you fail to obey Me and to carry out all these commandments,
aov_text: Maar as julle nie na My luister en al hierdie gebooie nie doen nie;

kjv_text: And if ye shall despise my statutes, or if your soul abhor my judgments, so that ye will not do all my commandments, but that ye break my covenant:
bsb_text: and if you reject My statutes, despise My ordinances, and neglect to carry out all My commandments, and so break My covenant,
aov_text: en as julle my insettinge verwerp, en as julle siel van my verordeninge ’n afsku het, sodat julle nie al my gebooie doen nie en my verbond verbreek —

kjv_text: I also will do this unto you; I will even appoint over you terror, consumption, and the burning ague, that shall consume the eyes, and cause sorrow of heart: and ye shall sow your seed in vain, for your enemies shall eat it.
bsb_text: then this is what I will do to you: I will bring upon you sudden terror, wasting disease, and fever that will destroy your sight and drain your life. You will sow your seed in vain, because your enemies will eat it.
aov_text: dan sal Ék dit ook aan julle doen: Ek sal verskrikking oor julle beskik: die tering en die koors wat die oë verteer en die lewe laat versmag; julle sal ook tevergeefs julle saad saai, want julle vyande sal dit opeet.

kjv_text: And I will set my face against you, and ye shall be slain before your enemies: they that hate you shall reign over you; and ye shall flee when none pursueth you.
bsb_text: And I will set My face against you, so that you will be defeated by your enemies. Those who hate you will rule over you, and you will flee when no one pursues you.
aov_text: En Ek sal my aangesig teen julle rig, sodat julle voor jul vyande verslaan word; en julle haters sal oor julle heers, en julle sal vlug terwyl niemand julle agtervolg nie.

kjv_text: And if ye will not yet for all this hearken unto me, then I will punish you seven times more for your sins.
bsb_text: And if after all this you will not obey Me, I will proceed to punish you sevenfold for your sins.
aov_text: En as julle dan nog nie na My luister nie, sal Ek voortgaan om julle sewevoudig weens julle sondes te tugtig.

kjv_text: And I will break the pride of your power; and I will make your heaven as iron, and your earth as brass:
bsb_text: I will break down your stubborn pride and make your sky like iron and your land like bronze,
aov_text: En Ek sal julle trotse mag verbreek, en sal julle hemel maak soos yster en julle aarde soos koper.

kjv_text: And your strength shall be spent in vain: for your land shall not yield her increase, neither shall the trees of the land yield their fruits.
bsb_text: and your strength will be spent in vain. For your land will not yield its produce, and the trees of the land will not bear their fruit.
aov_text: En julle krag sal tevergeefs verbruik word, want julle land sal sy opbrings nie gee nie, en die bome van die land sal hulle vrugte nie gee nie.

kjv_text: And if ye walk contrary unto me, and will not hearken unto me; I will bring seven times more plagues upon you according to your sins.
bsb_text: If you walk in hostility toward Me and refuse to obey Me, I will multiply your plagues seven times, according to your sins.
aov_text: En as julle jul teen My versit en na My nie wil luister nie, sal Ek meer plae op julle lê, sewevoudig volgens julle sondes.

kjv_text: I will also send wild beasts among you, which shall rob you of your children, and destroy your cattle, and make you few in number; and your high ways shall be desolate.
bsb_text: I will send wild animals against you to rob you of your children, destroy your livestock, and reduce your numbers, until your roads lie desolate.
aov_text: En Ek sal die wilde diere van die veld onder julle in stuur, en dié sal julle kinderloos maak en julle vee uitroei en julle verminder, sodat julle paaie verlate sal wees.

kjv_text: And if ye will not be reformed by me by these things, but will walk contrary unto me;
bsb_text: And if in spite of these things you do not accept My discipline, but continue to walk in hostility toward Me,
aov_text: En as julle hierdeur jul nie deur My laat tugtig nie, maar julle teen My versit,

kjv_text: Then will I also walk contrary unto you, and will punish you yet seven times for your sins.
bsb_text: then I will act with hostility toward you, and I will strike you sevenfold for your sins.
aov_text: sal Ek My ook teen julle versit en julle ook sewevoudig tref weens julle sondes.

kjv_text: And I will bring a sword upon you, that shall avenge the quarrel of my covenant: and when ye are gathered together within your cities, I will send the pestilence among you; and ye shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy.
bsb_text: And I will bring a sword against you to execute the vengeance of the covenant. Though you withdraw into your cities, I will send a plague among you, and you will be delivered into the hand of the enemy.
aov_text: En Ek sal ’n swaard oor julle bring wat die wraak van die verbond sal uitoefen; en as julle dan in jul stede terugtrek, sal Ek pes onder julle in stuur, en julle sal in die hand van die vyand oorgegee word.

kjv_text: And when I have broken the staff of your bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver you your bread again by weight: and ye shall eat, and not be satisfied.
bsb_text: When I cut off your supply of bread, ten women will bake your bread in a single oven and dole out your bread by weight, so that you will eat but not be satisfied.
aov_text: As Ek vir julle die staf van die brood verbreek, sal tien vroue julle brood in een oond bak en julle brood by die gewig teruggee; en julle sal eet, maar nie versadig word nie.

kjv_text: And if ye will not for all this hearken unto me, but walk contrary unto me;
bsb_text: But if in spite of all this you do not obey Me, but continue to walk in hostility toward Me,
aov_text: As julle ook hierom nie na My luister nie, maar julle teen My versit,

kjv_text: Then I will walk contrary unto you also in fury; and I, even I, will chastise you seven times for your sins.
bsb_text: then I will walk in fury against you, and I, even I, will punish you sevenfold for your sins.
aov_text: sal Ek My in grimmigheid teen julle versit, en Ék sal julle ook sewevoudig tugtig weens julle sondes.

kjv_text: And ye shall eat the flesh of your sons, and the flesh of your daughters shall ye eat.
bsb_text: You will eat the flesh of your own sons and daughters.
aov_text: En julle sal die vlees van julle seuns eet, en die vlees van julle dogters sal julle eet.

kjv_text: And I will destroy your high places, and cut down your images, and cast your carcases upon the carcases of your idols, and my soul shall abhor you.
bsb_text: I will destroy your high places, cut down your incense altars, and heap your lifeless bodies on the lifeless remains of your idols; and My soul will despise you.
aov_text: En Ek sal julle hoogtes verwoes en julle sonpilare verdelg en julle lyke op die lyke van julle drekgode gooi; en my siel sal ’n afsku van julle hê.

kjv_text: And I will make your cities waste, and bring your sanctuaries unto desolation, and I will not smell the savour of your sweet odours.
bsb_text: I will reduce your cities to rubble and lay waste your sanctuaries, and I will refuse to smell the pleasing aroma of your sacrifices.
aov_text: En Ek sal julle stede puinhope maak en julle heiligdomme verwoes en julle lieflike geur nie ruik nie.

kjv_text: And I will bring the land into desolation: and your enemies which dwell therein shall be astonished at it.
bsb_text: And I will lay waste the land, so that your enemies who dwell in it will be appalled.
aov_text: Ja, Ek self sal die land verwoes, sodat julle vyande wat daarin gaan woon, daaroor verstom sal staan.

kjv_text: And I will scatter you among the heathen, and will draw out a sword after you: and your land shall be desolate, and your cities waste.
bsb_text: But I will scatter you among the nations and will draw out a sword after you as your land becomes desolate and your cities are laid waste.
aov_text: En Ek sal julle onder die volke verstrooi en ’n swaard agter julle uittrek; en julle land sal ’n wildernis en julle stede puinhope word.

kjv_text: Then shall the land enjoy her sabbaths, as long as it lieth desolate, and ye be in your enemies' land; even then shall the land rest, and enjoy her sabbaths.
bsb_text: Then the land shall enjoy its Sabbaths all the days it lies desolate, while you are in the land of your enemies. At that time the land will rest and enjoy its Sabbaths.
aov_text: Dan sal die land vir sy sabbatte vergoeding kry, al die dae van sy verwoesting, terwyl julle in die land van julle vyande is; dan sal die land rus en vir sy sabbatte vergoeding gee.

kjv_text: As long as it lieth desolate it shall rest; because it did not rest in your sabbaths, when ye dwelt upon it.
bsb_text: As long as it lies desolate, the land will have the rest it did not receive during the Sabbaths when you lived in it.
aov_text: Al die dae van sy verwoesting sal dit rus—die rus wat dit nie gehad het in julle sabbatte toe julle daarin gewoon het nie.

kjv_text: And upon them that are left alive of you I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies; and the sound of a shaken leaf shall chase them; and they shall flee, as fleeing from a sword; and they shall fall when none pursueth.
bsb_text: As for those of you who survive, I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies, so that even the sound of a windblown leaf will put them to flight. And they will flee as one flees the sword, and fall when no one pursues them.
aov_text: En wat aangaan diegene wat onder julle oorgebly het—Ek sal in hulle hart ’n vreesagtigheid bring in die lande van hulle vyande, sodat die geruis van ’n verwaaide blaar hulle op die loop sal ja; en hulle sal vlug, soos ’n mens vir ’n swaard vlug en val sonder dat iemand agtervolg.

kjv_text: And they shall fall one upon another, as it were before a sword, when none pursueth: and ye shall have no power to stand before your enemies.
bsb_text: They will stumble over one another as before the sword, though no one is behind them. So you will not be able to stand against your enemies.
aov_text: En hulle sal struikel die een oor die ander soos vir die swaard, alhoewel niemand agtervolg nie; en julle sal voor julle vyande nie kan standhou nie.

kjv_text: And ye shall perish among the heathen, and the land of your enemies shall eat you up.
bsb_text: You will perish among the nations, and the land of your enemies will consume you.
aov_text: Maar julle sal omkom onder die nasies, en die land van julle vyande sal julle verteer.

kjv_text: And they that are left of you shall pine away in their iniquity in your enemies' lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers shall they pine away with them.
bsb_text: Those of you who survive in the lands of your enemies will waste away in their iniquity and will decay in the sins of their fathers.
aov_text: En die wat onder julle oorgebly het, sal oor hulle ongeregtigheid wegteer in die lande van julle vyande, ja, ook oor die ongeregtighede van hulle vaders saam met hulle wegteer.

kjv_text: If they shall confess their iniquity, and the iniquity of their fathers, with their trespass which they trespassed against me, and that also they have walked contrary unto me;
bsb_text: But if they will confess their iniquity and that of their fathers in the unfaithfulness that they practiced against Me, by which they have also walked in hostility toward Me—
aov_text: Dan sal hulle hul ongeregtigheid bely en die ongeregtigheid van hulle vaders deurdat hulle ontrou teen My gehandel het; en ook dat hulle hul teen My versit het,

kjv_text: And that I also have walked contrary unto them, and have brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their uncircumcised hearts be humbled, and they then accept of the punishment of their iniquity:
bsb_text: and I acted with hostility toward them and brought them into the land of their enemies—and if their uncircumcised hearts will be humbled and they will make amends for their iniquity,
aov_text: sodat Ék My ook teen hulle versit het en hulle in die land van hul vyande moes bring; of, as hulle onbesnede hart hom dan verneder en hulle dan boet vir hul ongeregtigheid,

kjv_text: Then will I remember my covenant with Jacob, and also my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham will I remember; and I will remember the land.
bsb_text: then I will remember My covenant with Jacob and My covenant with Isaac and My covenant with Abraham, and I will remember the land.
aov_text: sal Ek dink aan my verbond met Jakob; en ook aan my verbond met Isak en ook aan my verbond met Abraham sal Ek dink, en aan die land sal Ek dink.

kjv_text: The land also shall be left of them, and shall enjoy her sabbaths, while she lieth desolate without them: and they shall accept of the punishment of their iniquity: because, even because they despised my judgments, and because their soul abhorred my statutes.
bsb_text: For the land will be abandoned by them, and it will enjoy its Sabbaths by lying desolate without them. And they will pay the penalty for their iniquity, because they rejected My ordinances and abhorred My statutes.
aov_text: Maar die land moet eers van hulle verlate wees en moet vir sy sabbatte vergoeding kry, terwyl dit woes lê sonder hulle; en húlle sal vir hul ongeregtigheid boet, omdat, ja, omdat hulle my verordeninge verwerp en hulle siel van my insettinge ’n afsku gehad het.

kjv_text: And yet for all that, when they be in the land of their enemies, I will not cast them away, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly, and to break my covenant with them: for I am the LORD their God.
bsb_text: Yet in spite of this, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject or despise them so as to destroy them and break My covenant with them; for I am the LORD their God.
aov_text: Maar ook dan, as hulle in die land van hul vyande is, verwerp Ek hulle nie en het Ek van hulle geen afsku, sodat Ek ’n einde aan hulle sou maak en my verbond met hulle sou verbreek nie; want Ek is die HERE hulle God.

kjv_text: But I will for their sakes remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the heathen, that I might be their God: I am the LORD.
bsb_text: But for their sake I will remember the covenant with their fathers, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the nations, that I might be their God. I am the LORD.”
aov_text: Maar Ek sal tot hulle beswil dink aan die verbond van die voorvaders wat Ek uit Egipteland voor die oë van die nasies uitgelei het om vir hulle ’n God te wees. Ek is die HERE.

kjv_text: These are the statutes and judgments and laws, which the LORD made between him and the children of Israel in mount Sinai by the hand of Moses.
bsb_text: These are the statutes, ordinances, and laws that the LORD established between Himself and the Israelites through Moses on Mount Sinai.
aov_text: Dit is die insettinge en die verordeninge en die wette wat die HERE tussen Hom en die kinders van Israel by die berg Sinai deur die diens van Moses gegee het.

kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to Moses,
aov_text: VERDER het die HERE met Moses gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When a man shall make a singular vow, the persons shall be for the LORD by thy estimation.
bsb_text: “Speak to the Israelites and say to them, ‘When someone makes a special vow to the LORD involving the value of persons,
aov_text: Spreek met die kinders van Israel en sê vir hulle: As iemand ’n besondere gelofte aflê—mense aan die HERE toewy volgens jou skatting,

kjv_text: And thy estimation shall be of the male from twenty years old even unto sixty years old, even thy estimation shall be fifty shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary.
bsb_text: if the valuation concerns a male from twenty to sixty years of age, then your valuation shall be fifty shekels of silver, according to the sanctuary shekel.
aov_text: dan moet jou skatting vir ’n manspersoon van twintig tot sestig jaar, dan moet jou skatting vyftig sikkels silwer wees, volgens die sikkel van die heiligdom.

kjv_text: And if it be a female, then thy estimation shall be thirty shekels.
bsb_text: Or if it is a female, then your valuation shall be thirty shekels.
aov_text: Maar is dit ’n vrou, dan moet jou skatting dertig sikkels wees.

kjv_text: And if it be from five years old even unto twenty years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male twenty shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
bsb_text: And if the person is from five to twenty years of age, then your valuation for the male shall be twenty shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
aov_text: En is dit iemand van vyf tot twintig jaar, dan moet jou skatting vir ’n manspersoon twintig sikkels wees en vir ’n vroulike tien sikkels.

kjv_text: And if it be from a month old even unto five years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male five shekels of silver, and for the female thy estimation shall be three shekels of silver.
bsb_text: Now if the person is from one month to five years of age, then your valuation for the male shall be five shekels of silver, and for the female three shekels of silver.
aov_text: Maar is dit iemand van ’n maand oud tot vyf jaar, dan moet jou skatting vir die manlike geslag vyf sikkels silwer wees en jou skatting vir die vroulike drie sikkels silwer.

kjv_text: And if it be from sixty years old and above; if it be a male, then thy estimation shall be fifteen shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
bsb_text: And if the person is sixty years of age or older, then your valuation shall be fifteen shekels for the male and ten shekels for the female.
aov_text: En is dit iemand van sestig jaar oud en daarbo—is dit ’n manspersoon, dan moet jou skatting vyftien sikkels wees en vir ’n vrou tien sikkels.

kjv_text: But if he be poorer than thy estimation, then he shall present himself before the priest, and the priest shall value him; according to his ability that vowed shall the priest value him.
bsb_text: But if the one making the vow is too poor to pay the valuation, he is to present the person before the priest, who shall set the value according to what the one making the vow can afford.
aov_text: Maar as hy te arm is vir die geskatte bedrag, moet hy voor die priester gestel word, sodat die priester hom kan skat; volgens wat hy kan bekostig wat die gelofte gedoen het, moet die priester hom skat.

kjv_text: And if it be a beast, whereof men bring an offering unto the LORD, all that any man giveth of such unto the LORD shall be holy.
bsb_text: If he vows an animal that may be brought as an offering to the LORD, any such animal given to the LORD shall be holy.
aov_text: En as dit vee is waarvan hulle aan die HERE ’n offer kan bring, moet alles wat hy daarvan aan die HERE gee, heilig wees.

kjv_text: He shall not alter it, nor change it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good: and if he shall at all change beast for beast, then it and the exchange thereof shall be holy.
bsb_text: He must not replace it or exchange it, either good for bad or bad for good. But if he does substitute one animal for another, both that animal and its substitute will be holy.
aov_text: Hy mag dit nie omwissel of omruil nie—’n goeie vir ’n slegte of ’n slegte vir ’n goeie nie; maar as hy tog ’n dier vir ’n ander een omruil, moet dit en die geruilde heilig wees.

kjv_text: And if it be any unclean beast, of which they do not offer a sacrifice unto the LORD, then he shall present the beast before the priest:
bsb_text: But if the vow involves any of the unclean animals that may not be brought as an offering to the LORD, the animal must be presented before the priest.
aov_text: En as dit enige onrein stuk vee is waarvan hulle aan die HERE geen offer mag bring nie, moet hy die dier voor die priester stel,

kjv_text: And the priest shall value it, whether it be good or bad: as thou valuest it, who art the priest, so shall it be.
bsb_text: The priest shall set its value, whether high or low; as the priest values it, the price will be set.
aov_text: en die priester moet dit skat of dit goed of sleg is; na jou skatting, priester, so sal dit wees.

kjv_text: But if he will at all redeem it, then he shall add a fifth part thereof unto thy estimation.
bsb_text: If, however, the owner decides to redeem the animal, he must add a fifth to its value.
aov_text: Maar as hy dit wil los, moet hy die vyfde deel daarvan bo jou skatting byvoeg.

kjv_text: And when a man shall sanctify his house to be holy unto the LORD, then the priest shall estimate it, whether it be good or bad: as the priest shall estimate it, so shall it stand.
bsb_text: Now if a man consecrates his house as holy to the LORD, then the priest shall value it either as good or bad. The price will stand just as the priest values it.
aov_text: En as iemand sy huis as heilige gawe aan die HERE toewy, moet die priester dit skat of dit goed of sleg is; soos die priester dit skat, so moet dit bly.

kjv_text: And if he that sanctified it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be his.
bsb_text: But if he who consecrated his house redeems it, he must add a fifth to the assessed value, and it will belong to him.
aov_text: En as hy wat dit geheilig het, sy huis wil los, moet hy die vyfde deel van die geld van jou skatting daar byvoeg; dan sal dit syne wees.

kjv_text: And if a man shall sanctify unto the LORD some part of a field of his possession, then thy estimation shall be according to the seed thereof: an homer of barley seed shall be valued at fifty shekels of silver.
bsb_text: If a man consecrates to the LORD a parcel of his land, then your valuation shall be proportional to the seed required for it—fifty shekels of silver for every homer of barley seed.
aov_text: En as iemand ’n stuk land van sy besitting aan die HERE heilig, moet jou skatting wees volgens die saad wat gesaai word: ’n homer garssaad op vyftig sikkels silwer.

kjv_text: If he sanctify his field from the year of jubile, according to thy estimation it shall stand.
bsb_text: If he consecrates his field during the Year of Jubilee, the price will stand according to your valuation.
aov_text: As hy sy stuk land van die jubeljaar af heilig—volgens jou skatting, so moet dit bly.

kjv_text: But if he sanctify his field after the jubile, then the priest shall reckon unto him the money according to the years that remain, even unto the year of the jubile, and it shall be abated from thy estimation.
bsb_text: But if he consecrates his field after the Jubilee, the priest is to calculate the price in proportion to the years left until the next Year of Jubilee, so that your valuation will be reduced.
aov_text: Maar as hy sy stuk land ná die jubeljaar heilig, moet die priester vir hom die geld bereken na die jare wat tot die volgende jubeljaar oor is; en dit moet van jou skatting afgetrek word.

kjv_text: And if he that sanctified the field will in any wise redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be assured to him.
bsb_text: And if the one who consecrated the field decides to redeem it, he must add a fifth to the assessed value, and it shall belong to him.
aov_text: En as hy wat die stuk land geheilig het, dit beslis wil los, moet hy die vyfde deel van die geld van jou skatting daar byvoeg; en dit sal syne bly.

kjv_text: And if he will not redeem the field, or if he have sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more.
bsb_text: If, however, he does not redeem the field, or if he has sold it to another man, it may no longer be redeemed.
