aov_text: En as hy die stuk land nie los nie, of as hy die stuk land aan ’n ander verkoop, mag dit nie meer gelos word nie;

kjv_text: But the field, when it goeth out in the jubile, shall be holy unto the LORD, as a field devoted; the possession thereof shall be the priest's.
bsb_text: When the field is released in the Jubilee, it will become holy, like a field devoted to the LORD; it becomes the property of the priests.
aov_text: maar die stuk land moet, as dit in die jubeljaar vry word, aan die HERE heilig wees soos ’n stuk land onder die ban; die besit daarvan kom aan die priester toe.

kjv_text: And if a man sanctify unto the LORD a field which he hath bought, which is not of the fields of his possession;
bsb_text: Now if a man consecrates to the LORD a field he has purchased, which is not a part of his own property,
aov_text: En as hy aan die HERE ’n stuk land heilig wat hy gekoop het, wat nie van die land van sy besitting is nie,

kjv_text: Then the priest shall reckon unto him the worth of thy estimation, even unto the year of the jubile: and he shall give thine estimation in that day, as a holy thing unto the LORD.
bsb_text: then the priest shall calculate for him the value up to the Year of Jubilee, and the man shall pay the assessed value on that day as a sacred offering to the LORD.
aov_text: moet die priester vir hom die bedrag van die skatting tot die jubeljaar bereken; en hy moet op dieselfde dag die skatting gee as ’n heilige gawe aan die HERE.

kjv_text: In the year of the jubile the field shall return unto him of whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land did belong.
bsb_text: In the Year of Jubilee the field shall return to the one from whom it was bought—the original owner of the land.
aov_text: In die jubeljaar moet die stuk land terugkom aan hom van wie hy dit gekoop het, aan hom wat in besit was van die stuk land.

kjv_text: And all thy estimations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs shall be the shekel.
bsb_text: Every valuation will be according to the sanctuary shekel, twenty gerahs to the shekel.
aov_text: En alles wat jy skat, moet volgens die sikkel van die heiligdom wees; die sikkel moet twintig gera wees.

kjv_text: Only the firstling of the beasts, which should be the LORD's firstling, no man shall sanctify it; whether it be ox, or sheep: it is the LORD's.
bsb_text: But no one may consecrate a firstborn of the livestock, because a firstborn belongs to the LORD. Whether it is an ox or a sheep, it is the LORD’s.
aov_text: Maar die eersgeborene van ’n dier wat as eersgeborene aan die HERE behoort, dit mag niemand heilig nie; of dit ’n bees is of ’n stuk kleinvee—dit behoort aan die HERE.

kjv_text: And if it be of an unclean beast, then he shall redeem it according to thine estimation, and shall add a fifth part of it thereto: or if it be not redeemed, then it shall be sold according to thy estimation.
bsb_text: But if it is among the unclean animals, then he may redeem it according to your valuation and add a fifth of its value. If it is not redeemed, then it shall be sold according to your valuation.
aov_text: Maar is dit van ’n onrein dier, dan moet hy dit na jou skatting loskoop en die vyfde deel daarvan byvoeg; en as dit nie gelos word nie, moet dit na jou skatting verkoop word.

kjv_text: Notwithstanding no devoted thing, that a man shall devote unto the LORD of all that he hath, both of man and beast, and of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed: every devoted thing is most holy unto the LORD.
bsb_text: Nothing that a man sets apart to the LORD from all he owns—whether a man, an animal, or his inherited land—can be sold or redeemed; everything so devoted is most holy to the LORD.
aov_text: Maar niks van die bangoed wat iemand aan die HERE wy, van alles wat aan hom behoort—mense of vee of grond wat in sy besit is—mag verkoop of gelos word nie. Al die bangoed moet aan die HERE hoogheilig wees.

kjv_text: None devoted, which shall be devoted of men, shall be redeemed; but shall surely be put to death.
bsb_text: No person set apart for destruction may be ransomed; he must surely be put to death.
aov_text: Elkeen wat onder die ban is, wat onder die mense met die ban getref is, mag nie losgekoop word nie; hy moet sekerlik gedood word.

kjv_text: And all the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land, or of the fruit of the tree, is the LORD's: it is holy unto the LORD.
bsb_text: Thus any tithe from the land, whether from the seed of the land or the fruit of the trees, belongs to the LORD; it is holy to the LORD.
aov_text: Ook al die tiendes van die land, van die graan van die land, van die vrugte van die bome, behoort aan die HERE; dit is heilig aan die HERE.

kjv_text: And if a man will at all redeem ought of his tithes, he shall add thereto the fifth part thereof.
bsb_text: If a man wishes to redeem part of his tithe, he must add a fifth to its value.
aov_text: Maar as iemand van sy tiende iets wil los, moet hy die vyfde deel daarvan byvoeg.

kjv_text: And concerning the tithe of the herd, or of the flock, even of whatsoever passeth under the rod, the tenth shall be holy unto the LORD.
bsb_text: Every tenth animal from the herd or flock that passes under the shepherd’s rod will be holy to the LORD.
aov_text: Wat betref al die tiendes van beeste en kleinvee—alles wat onder die herderstaf deurgaan—die tiende moet aan die HERE heilig wees.

kjv_text: He shall not search whether it be good or bad, neither shall he change it: and if he change it at all, then both it and the change thereof shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.
bsb_text: He must not inspect whether it is good or bad, and he shall not make any substitution. But if he does make a substitution, both the animal and its substitute shall become holy; they cannot be redeemed.’”
aov_text: Hulle mag nie ondersoek of dit goed of sleg is nie, en dit nie omruil nie; maar as hulle dit tog omruil, moet dit en die geruilde heilig wees; dit mag nie gelos word nie.

kjv_text: These are the commandments, which the LORD commanded Moses for the children of Israel in mount Sinai.
bsb_text: These are the commandments that the LORD gave to Moses for the Israelites on Mount Sinai.
aov_text: Dit is die gebooie wat die HERE Moses by die berg Sinai vir die kinders van Israel beveel het.

kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tabernacle of the congregation, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,
bsb_text: On the first day of the second month of the second year after the Israelites had come out of the land of Egypt, the LORD spoke to Moses in the Tent of Meeting in the Wilderness of Sinai. He said:
aov_text: VERDER het die HERE met Moses gespreek in die woestyn Sinai, in die tent van samekoms, op die eerste van die tweede maand, in die tweede jaar nadat hulle uit Egipteland uitgetrek het, en gesê:

kjv_text: Take ye the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, after their families, by the house of their fathers, with the number of their names, every male by their polls;
bsb_text: “Take a census of the whole congregation of Israel by their clans and families, listing every man by name, one by one.
aov_text: Neem julle die volle getal van die hele vergadering van die kinders van Israel op volgens hulle geslagte, volgens hulle families, na die getal name, almal wat manlik is, hoof vir hoof;

kjv_text: From twenty years old and upward, all that are able to go forth to war in Israel: thou and Aaron shall number them by their armies.
bsb_text: You and Aaron are to number those who are twenty years of age or older by their divisions—everyone who can serve in Israel’s army.
aov_text: van twintig jaar oud en daarbo, almal wat op kommando moet uittrek in Israel, dié moet julle tel volgens hulle leërafdelings, jy en Aäron.

kjv_text: And with you there shall be a man of every tribe; every one head of the house of his fathers.
bsb_text: And one man from each tribe, the head of each family, must be there with you.
aov_text: En met julle saam moet daar van elke stam ’n man wees, ’n man wat hoof is van sy families.

kjv_text: And these are the names of the men that shall stand with you: of the tribe of Reuben; Elizur the son of Shedeur.
bsb_text: These are the names of the men who are to assist you: From the tribe of Reuben, Elizur son of Shedeur;
aov_text: En dit is die name van die manne wat julle moet bystaan: Vir Ruben: Elísur, die seun van Sedéür;

kjv_text: Of Simeon; Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
bsb_text: from Simeon, Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai;
aov_text: vir Símeon: Selúmiël, die seun van Surísaddai;

kjv_text: Of Judah; Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
bsb_text: from Judah, Nahshon son of Amminadab;
aov_text: vir Juda: Nagson, die seun van Ammínadab;

kjv_text: Of Issachar; Nethaneel the son of Zuar.
bsb_text: from Issachar, Nethanel son of Zuar;
aov_text: vir Íssaskar: Netáneël, die seun van Suar;

kjv_text: Of Zebulun; Eliab the son of Helon.
bsb_text: from Zebulun, Eliab son of Helon;
aov_text: vir Sébulon: Elíab, die seun van Helon;

kjv_text: Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim; Elishama the son of Ammihud: of Manasseh; Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
bsb_text: from the sons of Joseph: from Ephraim, Elishama son of Ammihud, and from Manasseh, Gamaliel son of Pedahzur;
aov_text: vir die kinders van Josef: vir Efraim: Elisáma, die seun van Ammíhud; vir Manasse: Gámliël, die seun van Pedásur;

kjv_text: Of Benjamin; Abidan the son of Gideoni.
bsb_text: from Benjamin, Abidan son of Gideoni;
aov_text: vir Benjamin: Abídan, die seun van Gideóni;

kjv_text: Of Dan; Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
bsb_text: from Dan, Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai;
aov_text: vir Dan, Ahiëser, die seun van Ammísaddai;

kjv_text: Of Asher; Pagiel the son of Ocran.
bsb_text: from Asher, Pagiel son of Ocran;
aov_text: vir Aser: Págiël, die seun van Ogran;

kjv_text: Of Gad; Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
bsb_text: from Gad, Eliasaph son of Deuel;
aov_text: vir Gad: Éljasaf, die seun van Réhuel;

kjv_text: Of Naphtali; Ahira the son of Enan.
bsb_text: and from Naphtali, Ahira son of Enan.”
aov_text: vir Náftali: Ahíra, die seun van Enan.

kjv_text: These were the renowned of the congregation, princes of the tribes of their fathers, heads of thousands in Israel.
bsb_text: These men were appointed from the congregation; they were the leaders of the tribes of their fathers, the heads of the clans of Israel.
aov_text: Dit was hulle wat uit die vergadering opgeroep was, die owerstes van hulle voorvaderlike stamme, die stamhoofde van Israel.

kjv_text: And Moses and Aaron took these men which are expressed by their names:
bsb_text: So Moses and Aaron took these men who had been designated by name,
aov_text: Toe het Moses en Aäron dié manne geneem wat met hulle name aangewys was,

kjv_text: And they assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month, and they declared their pedigrees after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, by their polls.
bsb_text: and on the first day of the second month they assembled the whole congregation and recorded their ancestry by clans and families, counting one by one the names of those twenty years of age or older,
aov_text: en hulle het die hele vergadering op die eerste dag van die tweede maand bymekaar laat kom; en dié het hulle afkoms opgegee volgens hulle geslagte, volgens hulle families, na die getal name, van twintig jaar oud en daarbo, hoof vir hoof,

kjv_text: As the LORD commanded Moses, so he numbered them in the wilderness of Sinai.
bsb_text: just as the LORD had commanded Moses. So Moses numbered them in the Wilderness of Sinai:
aov_text: soos die HERE Moses beveel het. En hy het hulle getel in die woestyn Sinai.

kjv_text: And the children of Reuben, Israel's eldest son, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
bsb_text: From the sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel, according to the records of their clans and families, counting one by one the names of every male twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
aov_text: En die seuns van Ruben, die eersgeborene van Israel—hulle nakomelinge volgens hulle geslagte, volgens hulle families, na die getal name, hoof vir hoof, almal wat manlik was, van twintig jaar oud en daarbo, almal wat op kommando moet uittrek —

kjv_text: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Reuben, were forty and six thousand and five hundred.
bsb_text: those registered to the tribe of Reuben numbered 46,500.
aov_text: hulle geteldes van die stam van Ruben was ses-en-veertigduisend-vyfhonderd.

kjv_text: Of the children of Simeon, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, those that were numbered of them, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
bsb_text: From the sons of Simeon, according to the records of their clans and families, counting one by one the names of every male twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
aov_text: Van die seuns van Símeon, hulle nakomelinge volgens hulle geslagte, volgens hulle families, na die getal name, hoof vir hoof, almal wat manlik was, van twintig jaar oud en daarbo, almal wat op kommando moet uittrek —

kjv_text: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Simeon, were fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.
bsb_text: those registered to the tribe of Simeon numbered 59,300.
aov_text: hulle geteldes van die stam van Símeon was negen-en-vyftigduisend-driehonderd.

kjv_text: Of the children of Gad, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
bsb_text: From the sons of Gad, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
aov_text: Van die seuns van Gad, hulle nakomelinge volgens hulle geslagte, volgens hulle families, na die getal name, van twintig jaar oud en daarbo, almal wat op kommando moet uittrek —

kjv_text: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Gad, were forty and five thousand six hundred and fifty.
bsb_text: those registered to the tribe of Gad numbered 45,650.
aov_text: hulle geteldes van die stam van Gad was vyf-en-veertigduisend-seshonderd-en-vyftig.

kjv_text: Of the children of Judah, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
bsb_text: From the sons of Judah, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
aov_text: Van die seuns van Juda, hulle nakomelinge volgens hulle geslagte, volgens hulle families, na die getal name, van twintig jaar oud en daarbo, almal wat op kommando moet uittrek —

kjv_text: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Judah, were threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.
bsb_text: those registered to the tribe of Judah numbered 74,600.
aov_text: hulle geteldes van die stam van Juda was vier-en-sewentigduisend-seshonderd.

kjv_text: Of the children of Issachar, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
bsb_text: From the sons of Issachar, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
aov_text: Van die seuns van Íssaskar, hulle nakomelinge volgens hulle geslagte, volgens hulle families, na die getal name, van twintig jaar oud en daarbo, almal wat op kommando moet uittrek —

kjv_text: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Issachar, were fifty and four thousand and four hundred.
bsb_text: those registered to the tribe of Issachar numbered 54,400.
aov_text: hulle geteldes van die stam van Íssaskar was vier-en-vyftigduisend-vierhonderd.

kjv_text: Of the children of Zebulun, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
bsb_text: From the sons of Zebulun, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
aov_text: Van die seuns van Sébulon, hulle nakomelinge volgens hulle geslagte, volgens hulle families, na die getal name, van twintig jaar oud en daarbo, almal wat op kommando moet uittrek —

kjv_text: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Zebulun, were fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.
bsb_text: those registered to the tribe of Zebulun numbered 57,400.
aov_text: hulle geteldes van die stam van Sébulon was sewen-en-vyftigduisend-vierhonderd.

kjv_text: Of the children of Joseph, namely, of the children of Ephraim, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
bsb_text: From the sons of Joseph: From the sons of Ephraim, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
aov_text: Van die seuns van Josef, van die seuns van Efraim, hulle nakomelinge volgens hulle geslagte, volgens hulle families, na die getal name, van twintig jaar oud en daarbo, almal wat op kommando moet uittrek —

kjv_text: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Ephraim, were forty thousand and five hundred.
bsb_text: those registered to the tribe of Ephraim numbered 40,500.
aov_text: hulle geteldes van die stam van Efraim was veertigduisend-vyfhonderd;

kjv_text: Of the children of Manasseh, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
bsb_text: And from the sons of Manasseh, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
aov_text: van die seuns van Manasse, hulle nakomelinge volgens hulle geslagte, volgens hulle families, na die getal name, van twintig jaar oud en daarbo, almal wat op kommando moet uittrek —

kjv_text: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred.
bsb_text: those registered to the tribe of Manasseh numbered 32,200.
aov_text: hulle geteldes van die stam van Manasse was twee-en-dertigduisend-tweehonderd.

kjv_text: Of the children of Benjamin, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
bsb_text: From the sons of Benjamin, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
aov_text: Van die seuns van Benjamin, hulle nakomelinge volgens hulle geslagte, volgens hulle families, na die getal name, van twintig jaar oud en daarbo, almal wat op kommando moet uittrek —

kjv_text: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Benjamin, were thirty and five thousand and four hundred.
bsb_text: those registered to the tribe of Benjamin numbered 35,400.
aov_text: hulle geteldes van die stam van Benjamin was vyf-en-dertigduisend-vierhonderd.

kjv_text: Of the children of Dan, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
bsb_text: From the sons of Dan, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
aov_text: Van die seuns van Dan, hulle nakomelinge volgens hulle geslagte, volgens hulle families, na die getal name, van twintig jaar oud en daarbo, almal wat op kommando moet uittrek —

kjv_text: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Dan, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.
bsb_text: those registered to the tribe of Dan numbered 62,700.
aov_text: hulle geteldes van die stam van Dan was twee-en-sestigduisend-sewehonderd.

kjv_text: Of the children of Asher, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
bsb_text: From the sons of Asher, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
aov_text: Van die seuns van Aser, hulle nakomelinge volgens hulle geslagte, volgens hulle families, na die getal name, van twintig jaar oud en daarbo, almal wat op kommando moet uittrek —

kjv_text: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Asher, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.
bsb_text: those registered to the tribe of Asher numbered 41,500.
aov_text: hulle geteldes van die stam van Aser was een-en-veertigduisend-vyfhonderd.

kjv_text: Of the children of Naphtali, throughout their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
bsb_text: From the sons of Naphtali, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
aov_text: Van die seuns van Náftali, hulle nakomelinge volgens hulle geslagte, volgens hulle families, na die getal name, van twintig jaar oud en daarbo, almal wat op kommando moet uittrek —

kjv_text: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
bsb_text: those registered to the tribe of Naphtali numbered 53,400.
aov_text: hulle geteldes van die stam van Náftali was drie-en-vyftigduisend-vierhonderd.

kjv_text: These are those that were numbered, which Moses and Aaron numbered, and the princes of Israel, being twelve men: each one was for the house of his fathers.
bsb_text: These were the men numbered by Moses and Aaron, with the assistance of the twelve leaders of Israel, each one representing his family.
aov_text: Dit is die geteldes wat Moses en Aäron en die owerstes van Israel getel het; twaalf man was dit, elkeen vir sy families.

kjv_text: So were all those that were numbered of the children of Israel, by the house of their fathers, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war in Israel;
bsb_text: So all the Israelites twenty years of age or older who could serve in Israel’s army were counted according to their families.
aov_text: So was dan al die geteldes van die kinders van Israel volgens hulle families, van twintig jaar oud en daarbo, almal wat in Israel op kommando moet uittrek —

kjv_text: Even all they that were numbered were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
bsb_text: And all those counted totaled 603,550.
aov_text: al die geteldes dan was seshonderd-en-drieduisend-vyfhonderd-en-vyftig.

kjv_text: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not numbered among them.
bsb_text: The Levites, however, were not numbered along with them by the tribe of their fathers.
aov_text: Maar die Leviete, volgens hulle voorvaderlike stam, is onder hulle nie getel nie.

kjv_text: For the LORD had spoken unto Moses, saying,
bsb_text: For the LORD had said to Moses:
aov_text: Die HERE het naamlik met Moses gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: Only thou shalt not number the tribe of Levi, neither take the sum of them among the children of Israel:
bsb_text: “Do not number the tribe of Levi in the census with the other Israelites.
aov_text: Net die stam van Levi moet jy nie tel nie en hulle volle getal onder die kinders van Israel nie opneem nie;

kjv_text: But thou shalt appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of testimony, and over all the vessels thereof, and over all things that belong to it: they shall bear the tabernacle, and all the vessels thereof; and they shall minister unto it, and shall encamp round about the tabernacle.
bsb_text: Instead, you are to appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of the Testimony, all its furnishings, and everything in it. They shall carry the tabernacle and all its articles, care for it, and camp around it.
aov_text: maar stel jy die Leviete aan oor die tabernakel van die Getuienis en oor al sy gereedskap en oor alles wat daarby behoort. Húlle moet die tabernakel dra en alles wat daarby behoort, en húlle moet dit bedien en rondom die tabernakel laer opslaan.

kjv_text: And when the tabernacle setteth forward, the Levites shall take it down: and when the tabernacle is to be pitched, the Levites shall set it up: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
bsb_text: Whenever the tabernacle is to move, the Levites are to take it down, and whenever it is to be pitched, the Levites are to set it up. Any outsider who goes near it must be put to death.
aov_text: En as die tabernakel wegtrek, moet die Leviete dit afbreek; en as die tabernakel rus, moet die Leviete dit oprig; en die onbevoegde wat nader kom, moet gedood word.

kjv_text: And the children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, throughout their hosts.
bsb_text: The Israelites are to camp by their divisions, each man in his own camp and under his own standard.
aov_text: En die kinders van Israel moet laer opslaan elkeen op sy laerplek en elkeen by sy vaandel, volgens hulle leërafdelings.

kjv_text: But the Levites shall pitch round about the tabernacle of testimony, that there be no wrath upon the congregation of the children of Israel: and the Levites shall keep the charge of the tabernacle of testimony.
bsb_text: But the Levites are to camp around the tabernacle of the Testimony and watch over it, so that no wrath will fall on the congregation of Israel. So the Levites are responsible for the tabernacle of the Testimony.”
aov_text: Maar die Leviete moet laer opslaan rondom die tabernakel van die Getuienis, dat daar geen toorn oor die vergadering van die kinders van Israel kom nie. So moet dan die Leviete die diens van die tabernakel van die Getuienis waarneem.

kjv_text: And the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did they.
bsb_text: Thus the Israelites did everything just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
aov_text: En die kinders van Israel het dit gedoen; net soos die HERE Moses beveel het, so het hulle gedoen.

kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to Moses and Aaron:
aov_text: EN die HERE het met Moses en Aäron gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: Every man of the children of Israel shall pitch by his own standard, with the ensign of their father's house: far off about the tabernacle of the congregation shall they pitch.
bsb_text: “The Israelites are to camp around the Tent of Meeting at a distance from it, each man under his standard, with the banners of his family.
aov_text: Die kinders van Israel moet laer opslaan elkeen by sy vaandel by die veldtekens van hulle families; op ’n afstand rondom die tent van samekoms moet hulle laer opslaan.

kjv_text: And on the east side toward the rising of the sun shall they of the standard of the camp of Judah pitch throughout their armies: and Nahshon the son of Amminadab shall be captain of the children of Judah.
bsb_text: On the east side, toward the sunrise, the divisions of Judah are to camp under their standard: The leader of the descendants of Judah is Nahshon son of Amminadab,
aov_text: En die wat aan die oostekant, teen sonop, laer opslaan, moet wees: die vaandel van die laer van Juda volgens hulle leërafdelings; en Nagson, die seun van Ammínadab, moet owerste oor die seuns van Juda wees.

kjv_text: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.
bsb_text: and his division numbers 74,600.
aov_text: En sy leër met hulle geteldes was vier-en-sewentigduisend-seshonderd.

kjv_text: And those that do pitch next unto him shall be the tribe of Issachar: and Nethaneel the son of Zuar shall be captain of the children of Issachar.
bsb_text: The tribe of Issachar will camp next to it. The leader of the Issacharites is Nethanel son of Zuar,
aov_text: En die wat langs hom laer opslaan, moet wees die stam van Íssaskar; en Netáneël, die seun van Suar, moet owerste oor die seuns van Íssaskar wees.

kjv_text: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were fifty and four thousand and four hundred.
bsb_text: and his division numbers 54,400.
aov_text: En sy leër met hulle geteldes was vier-en-vyftigduisend-vierhonderd.

kjv_text: Then the tribe of Zebulun: and Eliab the son of Helon shall be captain of the children of Zebulun.
bsb_text: Next will be the tribe of Zebulun. The leader of the Zebulunites is Eliab son of Helon,
aov_text: Verder die stam van Sébulon; en Elíab, die seun van Helon, moet owerste oor die seuns van Sébulon wees.

kjv_text: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.
bsb_text: and his division numbers 57,400.
aov_text: En sy leër met sy geteldes was sewen-en-vyftigduisend-vierhonderd.

kjv_text: All that were numbered in the camp of Judah were an hundred thousand and fourscore thousand and six thousand and four hundred, throughout their armies. These shall first set forth.
bsb_text: The total number of men in the divisions of the camp of Judah is 186,400; they shall set out first.
aov_text: Al die geteldes in die laer van Juda was honderd-ses-en-tagtigduisend-vierhonderd volgens hulle leërafdelings. Hulle moet eerste opbreek.

kjv_text: On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their armies: and the captain of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur.
bsb_text: On the south side, the divisions of Reuben are to camp under their standard: The leader of the Reubenites is Elizur son of Shedeur,
aov_text: Die vaandel van die laer van Ruben volgens hulle leërafdelings moet aan die suidekant wees; en Elísur, die seun van Sedéür, moet owerste oor die seuns van Ruben wees.

kjv_text: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were forty and six thousand and five hundred.
bsb_text: and his division numbers 46,500.
aov_text: En sy leër met sy geteldes was ses-en-veertigduisend-vyfhonderd.

kjv_text: And those which pitch by him shall be the tribe of Simeon: and the captain of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
bsb_text: The tribe of Simeon will camp next to it. The leader of the Simeonites is Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai,
aov_text: En die wat langs hom laer opslaan, moet wees die stam van Símeon; en Selúmiël, die seun van Surísaddai, moet owerste oor die seuns van Símeon wees.

kjv_text: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.
bsb_text: and his division numbers 59,300.
aov_text: En sy leër met hulle geteldes was negen-en-vyftigduisend-driehonderd.

kjv_text: Then the tribe of Gad: and the captain of the sons of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.
bsb_text: Next will be the tribe of Gad. The leader of the Gadites is Eliasaph son of Deuel,
aov_text: Verder die stam van Gad; en Éljasaf, die seun van Réhuel, moet owerste oor die seuns van Gad wees.

kjv_text: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty and five thousand and six hundred and fifty.
bsb_text: and his division numbers 45,650.
aov_text: En sy leër met hulle geteldes was vyf-en-veertigduisend-seshonderden-vyftig.

kjv_text: All that were numbered in the camp of Reuben were an hundred thousand and fifty and one thousand and four hundred and fifty, throughout their armies. And they shall set forth in the second rank.
bsb_text: The total number of men in the divisions of the camp of Reuben is 151,450; they shall set out second.
aov_text: Al die geteldes in die laer van Ruben was honderd-een-en-vyftigduisend-vierhonderd-en-vyftig volgens hulle leërafdelings. En hulle moet tweede opbreek.

kjv_text: Then the tabernacle of the congregation shall set forward with the camp of the Levites in the midst of the camp: as they encamp, so shall they set forward, every man in his place by their standards.
bsb_text: In the middle of the camps, the Tent of Meeting is to travel with the camp of the Levites. They are to set out in the order they encamped, each in his own place under his standard.
aov_text: Daarna moet die tent van samekoms opbreek: die laer van die Leviete, tussen die ander laers in. Soos hulle laer opslaan, so moet hulle opbreek, elkeen op sy plek volgens hulle vaandels.

kjv_text: On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their armies: and the captain of the sons of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.
bsb_text: On the west side, the divisions of Ephraim are to camp under their standard: The leader of the Ephraimites is Elishama son of Ammihud,
aov_text: Die vaandel van die laer van Efraim volgens hulle leërafdelings moet aan die westekant wees; en Elisáma, die seun van Ammíhud, moet owerste oor die seuns van Efraim wees.

kjv_text: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty thousand and five hundred.
bsb_text: and his division numbers 40,500.
aov_text: En sy leër met hulle geteldes was veertigduisend-vyfhonderd.

kjv_text: And by him shall be the tribe of Manasseh: and the captain of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
bsb_text: The tribe of Manasseh will be next to it. The leader of the Manassites is Gamaliel son of Pedahzur,
aov_text: En langs hom die stam van Manasse; en Gámliël, die seun van Pedásur, moet owerste oor die seuns van Manasse wees.

kjv_text: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred.
bsb_text: and his division numbers 32,200.
aov_text: En sy leër met hulle geteldes was twee-en-dertigduisend-tweehonderd.

kjv_text: Then the tribe of Benjamin: and the captain of the sons of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.
bsb_text: Next will be the tribe of Benjamin. The leader of the Benjamites is Abidan son of Gideoni,
aov_text: Verder die stam van Benjamin; en Abídan, die seun van Gideóni, moet owerste oor die seuns van Benjamin wees.

kjv_text: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and five thousand and four hundred.
bsb_text: and his division numbers 35,400.
aov_text: En sy leër met hulle geteldes was vyf-en-dertigduisend-vierhonderd.

kjv_text: All that were numbered of the camp of Ephraim were an hundred thousand and eight thousand and an hundred, throughout their armies. And they shall go forward in the third rank.
bsb_text: The total number of men in the divisions of the camp of Ephraim is 108,100; they shall set out third.
aov_text: Al die geteldes in die laer van Efraim was honderd-en-agtduisend-eenhonderd volgens hulle leërafdelings. En hulle moet derde opbreek.

kjv_text: The standard of the camp of Dan shall be on the north side by their armies: and the captain of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
bsb_text: On the north side, the divisions of Dan are to camp under their standard: The leader of the Danites is Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai,
aov_text: Die vaandel van die laer van Dan moet aan die noordekant wees volgens hulle leërafdelings; en Ahiëser, die seun van Ammísaddai, moet owerste oor die seuns van Dan wees.

kjv_text: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.
bsb_text: and his division numbers 62,700.
aov_text: En sy leër met hulle geteldes was twee-en-sestigduisend-sewehonderd.

kjv_text: And those that encamp by him shall be the tribe of Asher: and the captain of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ocran.
bsb_text: The tribe of Asher will camp next to it. The leader of the Asherites is Pagiel son of Ocran,
aov_text: En die wat langs hom laer opslaan, moet wees die stam van Aser; en Págiël, die seun van Ogran, moet owerste oor die seuns van Aser wees.

kjv_text: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.
bsb_text: and his division numbers 41,500.
aov_text: En sy leër met hulle geteldes was een-en-veertigduisend-vyfhonderd.

kjv_text: Then the tribe of Naphtali: and the captain of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.
bsb_text: Next will be the tribe of Naphtali. The leader of the Naphtalites is Ahira son of Enan,
aov_text: Verder die stam van Náftali; en Ahíra, die seun van Enan, moet owerste oor die seuns van Náftali wees.

kjv_text: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
bsb_text: and his division numbers 53,400.
aov_text: En sy leër met hulle geteldes was drie-en-vyftigduisend-vierhonderd.

kjv_text: All they that were numbered in the camp of Dan were an hundred thousand and fifty and seven thousand and six hundred. They shall go hindmost with their standards.
bsb_text: The total number of men in the camp of Dan is 157,600; they shall set out last, under their standards.”
aov_text: Al die geteldes in die laer van Dan was honderd-sewen-en-vyftigduisend-seshonderd. Hulle moet laaste opbreek volgens hulle vaandels.

kjv_text: These are those which were numbered of the children of Israel by the house of their fathers: all those that were numbered of the camps throughout their hosts were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
bsb_text: These are the Israelites, numbered according to their families. The total of those counted in the camps, by their divisions, was 603,550.
aov_text: Dit is die geteldes van die kinders van Israel volgens hulle families. Al die geteldes van die laers volgens hulle leërafdelings was seshonderd-en-drieduisend-vyfhonderd-en-vyftig.

kjv_text: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses.
bsb_text: But the Levites were not counted among the other Israelites, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
aov_text: Maar die Leviete is onder die kinders van Israel nie getel nie, soos die HERE Moses beveel het.

kjv_text: And the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses: so they pitched by their standards, and so they set forward, every one after their families, according to the house of their fathers.
bsb_text: So the Israelites did everything the LORD commanded Moses; they camped under their standards in this way and set out in the same way, each man with his clan and his family.
aov_text: En die kinders van Israel het gedoen net soos die HERE Moses beveel het; so het hulle laer opgeslaan volgens hulle vaandels, en so het hulle opgebreek elkeen volgens sy geslagte, by sy families.

kjv_text: These also are the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that the LORD spake with Moses in mount Sinai.
bsb_text: This is the account of Aaron and Moses at the time the LORD spoke with Moses on Mount Sinai.
aov_text: EN dit is die nakomelinge van Aäron en Moses op die dag toe die HERE met Moses op die berg Sinai gespreek het.

kjv_text: And these are the names of the sons of Aaron; Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
bsb_text: These are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the firstborn, then Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
aov_text: En dit is die name van die seuns van Aäron: die eersgeborene Nadab, daarna Abíhu, Eleásar en Ítamar.

kjv_text: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests which were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest's office.
bsb_text: These were Aaron’s sons, the anointed priests, who were ordained to serve as priests.
aov_text: Dit is die name van die seuns van Aäron, die gesalfde priesters, wat hy aangestel het om die priesteramp te bedien.

kjv_text: And Nadab and Abihu died before the LORD, when they offered strange fire before the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children: and Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest's office in the sight of Aaron their father.
bsb_text: Nadab and Abihu, however, died in the presence of the LORD when they offered unauthorized fire before the LORD in the Wilderness of Sinai. And since they had no sons, only Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests during the lifetime of their father Aaron.
aov_text: Maar Nadab en Abíhu het gesterwe voor die aangesig van die HERE toe hulle vreemde vuur voor die aangesig van die HERE in die woestyn Sinai gebring het, en hulle het geen kinders gehad nie; maar Eleásar en Ítamar het die priesteramp bedien voor die oë van hulle vader Aäron.

kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to Moses,
aov_text: En die HERE het met Moses gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: Bring the tribe of Levi near, and present them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister unto him.
bsb_text: “Bring the tribe of Levi and present them to Aaron the priest to assist him.
aov_text: Laat die stam van Levi nader kom, en stel hulle voor die priester Aäron, dat hulle hom kan dien.

kjv_text: And they shall keep his charge, and the charge of the whole congregation before the tabernacle of the congregation, to do the service of the tabernacle.
bsb_text: They are to perform duties for him and for the whole congregation before the Tent of Meeting, attending to the service of the tabernacle.
aov_text: En hulle moet sy diens waarneem en die diens van die hele vergadering voor die tent van samekoms, om die dienswerk van die tabernakel te verrig.

kjv_text: And they shall keep all the instruments of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.
bsb_text: They shall take care of all the furnishings of the Tent of Meeting and fulfill obligations for the Israelites by attending to the service of the tabernacle.
aov_text: En hulle moet sorg vir al die gereedskap van die tent van samekoms en vir die diens van die kinders van Israel, om die dienswerk van die tabernakel te verrig.

kjv_text: And thou shalt give the Levites unto Aaron and to his sons: they are wholly given unto him out of the children of Israel.
bsb_text: Assign the Levites to Aaron and his sons; they have been given exclusively to him from among the Israelites.
aov_text: En jy moet die Leviete aan Aäron en sy seuns gee; hulle is heeltemal aan hom gegee uit die kinders van Israel.

kjv_text: And thou shalt appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall wait on their priest's office: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
bsb_text: So you shall appoint Aaron and his sons to carry out the duties of the priesthood; but any outsider who approaches the tabernacle must be put to death.”
aov_text: Maar Aäron en sy seuns moet jy aanstel, dat hulle hul priesteramp kan waarneem; en die onbevoegde wat nader kom, moet gedood word.

kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
bsb_text: Again the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
aov_text: En die HERE het met Moses gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: And I, behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the firstborn that openeth the matrix among the children of Israel: therefore the Levites shall be mine;
bsb_text: “Behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel in place of every firstborn Israelite from the womb. The Levites belong to Me,
aov_text: Kyk, Ek self het die Leviete geneem onder die kinders van Israel uit in die plek van al die eersgeborenes wat die moederskoot open, uit die kinders van Israel, dat die Leviete myne kan wees.

kjv_text: Because all the firstborn are mine; for on the day that I smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I hallowed unto me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and beast: mine shall they be: I am the LORD.
bsb_text: for all the firstborn are Mine. On the day I struck down every firstborn in the land of Egypt, I consecrated to Myself all the firstborn in Israel, both man and beast. They are Mine; I am the LORD.”
aov_text: Want al die eersgeborenes is myne: op die dag toe Ek al die eersgeborenes in Egipteland getref het, het Ek al die eersgeborenes in Israel vir My geheilig, mense sowel as diere; hulle moet myne wees. Ek is die HERE.

kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,
bsb_text: Then the LORD spoke to Moses in the Wilderness of Sinai, saying,
aov_text: En die HERE het met Moses gespreek in die woestyn Sinai en gesê:

kjv_text: Number the children of Levi after the house of their fathers, by their families: every male from a month old and upward shalt thou number them.
bsb_text: “Number the Levites by their families and clans. You are to count every male a month old or more.”
aov_text: Tel die seuns van Levi volgens hulle families, volgens hulle geslagte; almal wat manlik is, van ’n maand oud en daarbo—dié moet jy tel.

kjv_text: And Moses numbered them according to the word of the LORD, as he was commanded.
bsb_text: So Moses numbered them according to the word of the LORD, as he had been commanded.
aov_text: En Moses het hulle volgens die bevel van die HERE getel soos dit hom beveel is.

kjv_text: And these were the sons of Levi by their names; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari.
bsb_text: These were the sons of Levi by name: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
aov_text: En dit was die seuns van Levi volgens hulle name: Gerson en Kehat en Merári.

kjv_text: And these are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families; Libni, and Shimei.
bsb_text: These were the names of the sons of Gershon by their clans: Libni and Shimei.
aov_text: En dit is die name van die seuns van Gerson volgens hulle geslagte: Libni en Símeï.

kjv_text: And the sons of Kohath by their families; Amram, and Izehar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
bsb_text: The sons of Kohath by their clans were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
aov_text: En die seuns van Kehat volgens hulle geslagte: Amram en Jishar, Hebron en Ússiël.

kjv_text: And the sons of Merari by their families; Mahli, and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to the house of their fathers.
bsb_text: And the sons of Merari by their clans were Mahli and Mushi. These were the clans of the Levites, according to their families.
aov_text: En die seuns van Merári volgens hulle geslagte: Magli en Musi. Dit is die geslagte van die Leviete volgens hulle families.

kjv_text: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimites: these are the families of the Gershonites.
bsb_text: From Gershon came the Libnite clan and the Shimeite clan; these were the Gershonite clans.
aov_text: Aan Gerson behoort die geslag van die Libniete en die geslag van die Simeïete. Dit is die geslagte van die Gersoniete.

kjv_text: Those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, even those that were numbered of them were seven thousand and five hundred.
bsb_text: The number of all the males a month old or more was 7,500.
aov_text: Hulle geteldes volgens die getal van almal wat manlik was, van ’n maand oud en daarbo—húlle geteldes was seweduisend-vyfhonderd.

kjv_text: The families of the Gershonites shall pitch behind the tabernacle westward.
bsb_text: The Gershonite clans were to camp on the west, behind the tabernacle,
aov_text: Die geslagte van die Gersoniete moet laer opslaan agter die tabernakel aan die westekant.

kjv_text: And the chief of the house of the father of the Gershonites shall be Eliasaph the son of Lael.
bsb_text: and the leader of the families of the Gershonites was Eliasaph son of Lael.
aov_text: En owerste oor die familie van die Gersoniete moet Éljasaf, die seun van Lael, wees.

kjv_text: And the charge of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation shall be the tabernacle, and the tent, the covering thereof, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,
bsb_text: The duties of the Gershonites at the Tent of Meeting were the tabernacle and tent, its covering, the curtain for the entrance to the Tent of Meeting,
aov_text: En die seuns van Gerson moet by die tent van samekoms versorg: die tabernakel en die tent, sy dekkleed en die bedekking vir die ingang van die tent van samekoms;

kjv_text: And the hangings of the court, and the curtain for the door of the court, which is by the tabernacle, and by the altar round about, and the cords of it for all the service thereof.
bsb_text: the curtains of the courtyard, the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard that surrounds the tabernacle and altar, and the cords—all the service for these items.
aov_text: en die behangsels van die voorhof en die bedekking vir die ingang van die voorhof wat rondom die tabernakel en die altaar is, en sy lyne—alles wat by sy bediening behoort.

kjv_text: And of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Izeharites, and the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites: these are the families of the Kohathites.
bsb_text: From Kohath came the clans of the Amramites, the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites; these were the clans of the Kohathites.
aov_text: En aan Kehat het behoort die geslag van die Amramiete en die geslag van die Jishariete en die geslag van die Hebroniete en die geslag van die Ussiëliete. Dit is die geslagte van die Kehatiete.

kjv_text: In the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were eight thousand and six hundred, keeping the charge of the sanctuary.
bsb_text: The number of all the males a month old or more was 8,600. They were responsible for the duties of the sanctuary.
aov_text: Volgens die getal van almal wat manlik is, van ’n maand oud en daarbo, was daar agtduisend-seshonderd wat die diens van die heiligdom waargeneem het.

kjv_text: The families of the sons of Kohath shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle southward.
bsb_text: The clans of the Kohathites were to camp on the south side of the tabernacle,
aov_text: Die geslagte van die seuns van Kehat moet laer opslaan aan die kant van die tabernakel, aan die suidekant.

kjv_text: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.
bsb_text: and the leader of the families of the Kohathites was Elizaphan son of Uzziel.
aov_text: En die owerste oor die familie vir die geslagte van die Kehatiete moet wees Elísafan, die seun van Ússiël.

kjv_text: And their charge shall be the ark, and the table, and the candlestick, and the altars, and the vessels of the sanctuary wherewith they minister, and the hanging, and all the service thereof.
bsb_text: Their duties were the ark, the table, the lampstand, the altars, the articles of the sanctuary used with them, and the curtain—all the service for these items.
aov_text: En hulle moet versorg: die ark en die tafel en die kandelaar en die altare en die gereedskap van die heiligdom waarmee hulle diens doen, en die voorhangsel en alles wat by die bediening daarvan behoort.

kjv_text: And Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be chief over the chief of the Levites, and have the oversight of them that keep the charge of the sanctuary.
bsb_text: The chief of the leaders of the Levites was Eleazar son of Aaron the priest; he oversaw those responsible for the duties of the sanctuary.
aov_text: En die hoof van die owerstes van Levi moet wees Eleásar, die seun van Aäron, die priester, die opsigter oor die wat die diens van die heiligdom waarneem.

kjv_text: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites, and the family of the Mushites: these are the families of Merari.
bsb_text: From Merari came the clans of the Mahlites and Mushites; these were the Merarite clans.
aov_text: Aan Merári het behoort die geslag van die Magliete en die geslag van die Musiete. Dit is die geslagte van Merári.

kjv_text: And those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were six thousand and two hundred.
bsb_text: The number of all the males a month old or more was 6,200.
aov_text: En hulle geteldes volgens die getal van almal wat manlik is, van ’n maand oud en daarbo, was sesduisend-tweehonderd.

kjv_text: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail: these shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle northward.
bsb_text: The leader of the families of the Merarites was Zuriel son of Abihail; they were to camp on the north side of the tabernacle.
aov_text: En die owerste van die familie vir die geslagte van Merári moet wees Súriël, die seun van Abihail; hulle moet laer opslaan aan die kant van die tabernakel, aan die noordekant.

kjv_text: And under the custody and charge of the sons of Merari shall be the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and the sockets thereof, and all the vessels thereof, and all that serveth thereto,
bsb_text: The duties assigned to the sons of Merari were the tabernacle’s frames, crossbars, posts, bases, and all its equipment—all the service for these items,
aov_text: En die toesig van die seuns van Merári—wat hulle te besorg het—moet wees oor die style van die tabernakel en sy dwarshoute en sy pilare en sy voetstukke en al die gereedskap sowel as die hele diens wat daarby behoort;

kjv_text: And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords.
bsb_text: as well as the posts of the surrounding courtyard with their bases, tent pegs, and ropes.
aov_text: en die pilare van die voorhof rondom en hulle voetstukke en hulle penne en hulle lyne.

kjv_text: But those that encamp before the tabernacle toward the east, even before the tabernacle of the congregation eastward, shall be Moses, and Aaron and his sons, keeping the charge of the sanctuary for the charge of the children of Israel; and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
bsb_text: Moses, Aaron, and Aaron’s sons were to camp to the east of the tabernacle, toward the sunrise, before the Tent of Meeting. They were to perform the duties of the sanctuary as a service on behalf of the Israelites; but any outsider who approached the sanctuary was to be put to death.
aov_text: En die wat voor die tabernakel laer opslaan, aan die oostekant, voor die tent van samekoms, teen sonop, moet wees Moses en Aäron met sy seuns wat die diens van die heiligdom waarneem, naamlik die diens vir die kinders van Israel; en die onbevoegde wat nader kom, moet gedood word.

kjv_text: All that were numbered of the Levites, which Moses and Aaron numbered at the commandment of the LORD, throughout their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty and two thousand.
bsb_text: The total number of Levites that Moses and Aaron counted by their clans at the LORD’s command, including all the males a month old or more, was 22,000.
aov_text: Al die geteldes van die Leviete wat Moses en Aäron volgens die bevel van die HERE, volgens hulle geslagte getel het, almal wat manlik was, van ’n maand oud en daarbo, was twee-en-twintigduisend.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Number all the firstborn of the males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Number every firstborn male of the Israelites a month old or more, and list their names.
aov_text: En die HERE het aan Moses gesê: Tel al die manlike eersgeborenes van die kinders van Israel, van ’n maand oud en daarbo, en neem die getal van hulle name op.

kjv_text: And thou shalt take the Levites for me (I am the LORD) instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel; and the cattle of the Levites instead of all the firstlings among the cattle of the children of Israel.
bsb_text: You are to take the Levites for Me—I am the LORD—in place of all the firstborn of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites in place of all the firstborn of the livestock of the Israelites.”
aov_text: En jy moet vir My—Ek is die HERE—die Leviete neem in die plek van al die eersgeborenes onder die kinders van Israel, en die vee van die Leviete in die plek van al die eersgeborenes onder die vee van die kinders van Israel.

kjv_text: And Moses numbered, as the LORD commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.
bsb_text: So Moses numbered all the firstborn of the Israelites, as the LORD had commanded him.
aov_text: En Moses het, soos die HERE hom beveel het, al die eersgeborenes onder die kinders van Israel getel.

kjv_text: And all the firstborn males by the number of names, from a month old and upward, of those that were numbered of them, were twenty and two thousand two hundred and threescore and thirteen.
bsb_text: The total number of the firstborn males a month old or more, listed by name, was 22,273.
aov_text: En al die manlike eersgeborenes volgens die getal name, van ’n maand oud en daarbo, volgens hulle geteldes, was twee-en-twintigduisend-tweehonderd-drie-en-sewentig.

kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
bsb_text: Again the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
aov_text: En die HERE het met Moses gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites instead of their cattle; and the Levites shall be mine: I am the LORD.
bsb_text: “Take the Levites in place of all the firstborn of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites in place of their livestock. The Levites belong to Me; I am the LORD.
aov_text: Neem die Leviete in die plek van al die eersgeborenes onder die kinders van Israel, en die vee van die Leviete in die plek van hulle vee, sodat die Leviete myne kan wees. Ek is die HERE.

kjv_text: And for those that are to be redeemed of the two hundred and threescore and thirteen of the firstborn of the children of Israel, which are more than the Levites;
bsb_text: To redeem the 273 firstborn Israelites who outnumber the Levites,
aov_text: Wat aangaan die loskoping van die tweehonderd-drie-en-sewentig wat oor is bo die Leviete, uit die eersgeborenes van die kinders van Israel,

kjv_text: Thou shalt even take five shekels apiece by the poll, after the shekel of the sanctuary shalt thou take them: (the shekel is twenty gerahs:)
bsb_text: you are to collect five shekels for each one, according to the sanctuary shekel of twenty gerahs.
aov_text: moet jy per hoof vyf sikkels neem; volgens die sikkel van die heiligdom moet jy dit neem; die sikkel is twintig gera.

kjv_text: And thou shalt give the money, wherewith the odd number of them is to be redeemed, unto Aaron and to his sons.
bsb_text: Give the money to Aaron and his sons as the redemption price for the excess among the Israelites.”
aov_text: En jy moet die geld as losprys van die wat onder hulle oor is, aan Aäron en sy seuns gee.

kjv_text: And Moses took the redemption money of them that were over and above them that were redeemed by the Levites:
bsb_text: So Moses collected the redemption money from those in excess of the number redeemed by the Levites.
aov_text: Daarop het Moses die loskoopgeld geneem van die wat oor was bo die wat deur die Leviete losgekoop was;

kjv_text: Of the firstborn of the children of Israel took he the money; a thousand three hundred and threescore and five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
bsb_text: He collected the money from the firstborn of the Israelites: 1,365 shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel.
aov_text: van die eersgeborenes van die kinders van Israel het hy die geld geneem, duisend-driehonderd-vyf-en-sestig sikkels volgens die sikkel van die heiligdom.

kjv_text: And Moses gave the money of them that were redeemed unto Aaron and to his sons, according to the word of the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.
bsb_text: And Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and his sons in obedience to the word of the LORD, just as the LORD had commanded him.
aov_text: En Moses het die loskoopgeld aan Aäron en sy seuns gegee volgens die bevel van die HERE, soos die HERE Moses beveel het.

kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to Moses and Aaron,
aov_text: EN die HERE het met Moses en Aäron gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, after their families, by the house of their fathers,
bsb_text: “Take a census of the Kohathites among the Levites by their clans and families,
aov_text: Neem die volle getal van die seuns van Kehat op, onder die seuns van Levi uit, volgens hulle geslagte, volgens hulle families,

kjv_text: From thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all that enter into the host, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.
bsb_text: men from thirty to fifty years old—everyone who is qualified to serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting.
aov_text: van dertig jaar oud en daarbo, tot vyftig jaar, almal wat dienspligtig is, om werk by die tent van samekoms te verrig.

kjv_text: This shall be the service of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation, about the most holy things:
bsb_text: This service of the Kohathites at the Tent of Meeting regards the most holy things.
aov_text: Dit sal die dienswerk van die seuns van Kehat by die tent van samekoms wees, naamlik die hoogheilige dinge.

kjv_text: And when the camp setteth forward, Aaron shall come, and his sons, and they shall take down the covering vail, and cover the ark of testimony with it:
bsb_text: Whenever the camp sets out, Aaron and his sons are to go in, take down the veil of the curtain, and cover the ark of the Testimony with it.
aov_text: By die opbreek van die laer moet Aäron en sy seuns kom en die voor-hangsel tot bedekking afneem en daarmee die ark van die Getuienis bedek.

kjv_text: And shall put thereon the covering of badgers' skins, and shall spread over it a cloth wholly of blue, and shall put in the staves thereof.
bsb_text: They are to place over this a covering of fine leather, spread a solid blue cloth over it, and insert its poles.
aov_text: En hulle moet ’n dekkleed van robbevelle daarop sit en ’n doek, heeltemal van pers stof, daar bo-oor uitsprei en sy draaghoute insteek.

kjv_text: And upon the table of shewbread they shall spread a cloth of blue, and put thereon the dishes, and the spoons, and the bowls, and covers to cover withal: and the continual bread shall be thereon:
bsb_text: Over the table of the Presence they are to spread a blue cloth and place the plates and cups on it, along with the bowls and pitchers for the drink offering. The regular bread offering is to remain on it.
aov_text: Hulle moet ook oor die toonbroodtafel ’n pers doek uitsprei en daarop neersit die skottels en die rookpanne en die bekers en die drankofferkanne; ook moet die altydblywende brood daarop wees.

kjv_text: And they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet, and cover the same with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put in the staves thereof.
bsb_text: And they shall spread a scarlet cloth over them, cover them with fine leather, and insert the poles.
aov_text: Daarna moet hulle ’n skarlaken doek daaroor uitsprei en dit met ’n dekkleed van robbevelle toemaak en sy draaghoute insteek.

kjv_text: And they shall take a cloth of blue, and cover the candlestick of the light, and his lamps, and his tongs, and his snuffdishes, and all the oil vessels thereof, wherewith they minister unto it:
bsb_text: They are to take a blue cloth and cover the lampstand used for light, together with its lamps, wick trimmers, and trays, as well as the jars of oil with which to supply it.
aov_text: Dan moet hulle ’n pers doek neem en die kandelaar tot verligting bedek, met sy lampe en sy snuiters en sy bakkies en al sy oliekanne waarmee hulle daarby diens doen.

kjv_text: And they shall put it and all the vessels thereof within a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put it upon a bar.
bsb_text: Then they shall wrap it and all its utensils inside a covering of fine leather and put it on the carrying frame.
aov_text: En hulle moet dit met al sy gereedskap op ’n dekkleed van robbevelle neerlê en dit op die draagbaar sit.

kjv_text: And upon the golden altar they shall spread a cloth of blue, and cover it with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put to the staves thereof:
bsb_text: Over the gold altar they are to spread a blue cloth, cover it with fine leather, and insert the poles.
aov_text: En oor die goue altaar moet hulle ’n pers doek uitsprei en dit met ’n dekkleed van robbevelle toemaak en sy draaghoute insteek.

kjv_text: And they shall take all the instruments of ministry, wherewith they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a cloth of blue, and cover them with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put them on a bar:
bsb_text: They are to take all the utensils for serving in the sanctuary, place them in a blue cloth, cover them with fine leather, and put them on the carrying frame.
aov_text: Hulle moet ook al die gereedskap neem waarmee hulle diens in die heiligdom doen, en dit op ’n pers doek neerlê en met ’n dekkleed van robbevelle toemaak en dit op die draagbaar sit.

kjv_text: And they shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth thereon:
bsb_text: Then they shall remove the ashes from the bronze altar, spread a purple cloth over it,
aov_text: En hulle moet die as van die altaar verwyder en daar ’n purper doek oor uitsprei.

kjv_text: And they shall put upon it all the vessels thereof, wherewith they minister about it, even the censers, the fleshhooks, and the shovels, and the basons, all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread upon it a covering of badgers' skins, and put to the staves of it.
bsb_text: and place on it all the vessels used to serve there: the firepans, meat forks, shovels, and sprinkling bowls—all the equipment of the altar. They are to spread over it a covering of fine leather and insert the poles.
aov_text: En hulle moet al sy gereedskap daarop neersit waarmee hulle daarby diens doen: die vuurpanne, die vurke en die skoppe en die komme, al die gereedskap van die altaar; en hulle moet daar ’n dekkleed van robbevelle oor uitsprei en sy draaghoute insteek.

kjv_text: And when Aaron and his sons have made an end of covering the sanctuary, and all the vessels of the sanctuary, as the camp is to set forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to bear it: but they shall not touch any holy thing, lest they die. These things are the burden of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation.
bsb_text: When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the holy objects and all their equipment, as soon as the camp is ready to move, the Kohathites shall come and do the carrying. But they must not touch the holy objects, or they will die. These are the transportation duties of the Kohathites regarding the Tent of Meeting.
aov_text: En eers nadat Aäron en sy seuns, by die opbreek van die laer, klaar is met die toemaak van die heiligdom en van al die gereedskap van die heiligdom, moet die seuns van Kehat kom om te dra; maar hulle mag nie aan die heilige dinge raak nie, sodat hulle nie sterwe nie. Hierdie dinge is dit wat die seuns van Kehat moet dra van die tent van samekoms.

kjv_text: And to the office of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest pertaineth the oil for the light, and the sweet incense, and the daily meat offering, and the anointing oil, and the oversight of all the tabernacle, and of all that therein is, in the sanctuary, and in the vessels thereof.
bsb_text: Eleazar son of Aaron the priest shall oversee the oil for the light, the fragrant incense, the daily grain offering, and the anointing oil. He has oversight of the entire tabernacle and everything in it, including the holy objects and their utensils.”
aov_text: En die toesig van Eleásar, die seun van die priester Aäron, gaan oor die olie vir die kandelaar en die reukwerk van speserye en die voortdurende spysoffer en die salfolie; die toesig oor die hele tabernakel en oor alles wat daarin is: die heiligdom en bybehorende gereedskap.

kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to Moses and Aaron,
aov_text: En die HERE het met Moses en Aäron gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: Cut ye not off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites:
bsb_text: “Do not allow the Kohathite tribal clans to be cut off from among the Levites.
aov_text: Sorg dat die stam van die geslagte van die Kehatiete nie onder die Leviete uitgeroei word nie.

kjv_text: But thus do unto them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach unto the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden:
bsb_text: In order that they may live and not die when they come near the most holy things, do this for them: Aaron and his sons are to go in and assign each man his task and what he is to carry.
aov_text: Maar doen vir hulle dit, sodat hulle lewe en nie sterwe nie as hulle na die hoogheilige dinge aankom: Aäron en sy seuns moet ingaan en hulle aanstel elkeen oor sy dienswerk en oor wat hy moet dra.

kjv_text: But they shall not go in to see when the holy things are covered, lest they die.
bsb_text: But the Kohathites are not to go in and look at the holy objects, even for a moment, or they will die.”
aov_text: Maar hulle moet nie inkom om vir ’n oomblik die heiligdom te sien nie, sodat hulle nie sterwe nie.

kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
bsb_text: And the LORD said to Moses,
aov_text: En die HERE het met Moses gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: Take also the sum of the sons of Gershon, throughout the houses of their fathers, by their families;
bsb_text: “Take a census of the Gershonites as well, by their families and clans,
aov_text: Neem die volle getal op ook van die seuns van Gerson volgens hulle families, volgens hulle geslagte.

kjv_text: From thirty years old and upward until fifty years old shalt thou number them; all that enter in to perform the service, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.
bsb_text: from thirty to fifty years old, counting everyone who comes to serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting.
aov_text: Jy moet hulle tel van dertig jaar oud en daarbo, tot vyftig jaar, almal wat verplig is om diens te doen, om dienswerk te verrig by die tent van samekoms.

kjv_text: This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, to serve, and for burdens:
bsb_text: This is the service of the Gershonite clans regarding work and transport:
aov_text: Dit sal die dienswerk van die geslagte van die Gersoniete wees by die diens en by die vervoer:

kjv_text: And they shall bear the curtains of the tabernacle, and the tabernacle of the congregation, his covering, and the covering of the badgers' skins that is above upon it, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,
bsb_text: They are to carry the curtains of the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting with the covering of fine leather over it, the curtains for the entrance to the Tent of Meeting,
aov_text: hulle moet die tentdoeke van die tabernakel dra, ook die tent van samekoms, sy dekkleed en die dekkleed van robbevelle wat daar bo-oor is, en die bedekking vir die ingang van die tent van samekoms

kjv_text: And the hangings of the court, and the hanging for the door of the gate of the court, which is by the tabernacle and by the altar round about, and their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and all that is made for them: so shall they serve.
bsb_text: the curtains of the courtyard, and the curtains for the entrance at the gate of the courtyard that surrounds the tabernacle and altar, along with their ropes and all the equipment for their service. The Gershonites will do all that needs to be done with these items.
aov_text: en die behangsels van die voorhof en die bedekking vir die ingang van die poort van die voorhof wat rondom die tabernakel en die altaar is, en hulle lyne sowel as al die gereedskap wat by die bediening daarvan behoort; en alles wat daarvoor gedoen moet word, moet hulle verrig.

kjv_text: At the appointment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burdens, and in all their service: and ye shall appoint unto them in charge all their burdens.
bsb_text: All the service of the Gershonites—all their transport duties and other work—is to be done at the direction of Aaron and his sons; you are to assign to them all that they are responsible to carry.
aov_text: Die hele dienswerk van die seuns van die Gersoniete—alles wat hulle moet dra en hulle hele diens—moet wees volgens die bevel van Aäron en sy seuns; en julle moet hulle al hulle drawerk aanwys om dit waar te neem.

kjv_text: This is the service of the families of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation: and their charge shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
bsb_text: This is the service of the Gershonite clans at the Tent of Meeting, and their duties shall be under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.
aov_text: Dit is die dienswerk vir die geslagte van die seuns van die Gersoniete by die tent van samekoms; en wat hulle te besorg het, moet plaasvind onder leiding van Ítamar, die seun van die priester Aäron.

kjv_text: As for the sons of Merari, thou shalt number them after their families, by the house of their fathers;
bsb_text: As for the sons of Merari, you are to number them by their clans and families,
aov_text: Wat aangaan die seuns van Merári—dié moet jy tel volgens hulle geslagte, volgens hulle families.

kjv_text: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old shalt thou number them, every one that entereth into the service, to do the work of the tabernacle of the congregation.
bsb_text: from thirty to fifty years old, counting everyone who comes to serve in the work of the Tent of Meeting.
aov_text: Jy moet hulle tel van dertig jaar oud en daarbo, tot vyftig jaar, almal wat dienspligtig is, om die dienswerk van die tent van samekoms te verrig.

kjv_text: And this is the charge of their burden, according to all their service in the tabernacle of the congregation; the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and sockets thereof,
bsb_text: This is the duty for all their service at the Tent of Meeting: to carry the frames of the tabernacle with its crossbars, posts, and bases,
aov_text: En dit is wat by hulle drawerk besorg moet word, hulle hele dienswerk by die tent van samekoms: die style van die tabernakel met sy dwarshoute en sy pilare en sy voetstukke

kjv_text: And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service: and by name ye shall reckon the instruments of the charge of their burden.
bsb_text: and the posts of the surrounding courtyard with their bases, tent pegs, and ropes, including all their equipment and everything related to their use. You shall assign by name the items that they are responsible to carry.
aov_text: en die pilare van die voorhof rondom met hulle voetstukke en hulle penne en hulle lyne—al die gereedskap sowel as alles wat by die bediening daarvan behoort. En die gereedskap wat by hulle drawerk besorg moet word, moet julle met die naam aanwys.

kjv_text: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service, in the tabernacle of the congregation, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
bsb_text: This is the service of the Merarite clans according to all their work at the Tent of Meeting, under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.”
aov_text: Dit is die dienswerk vir die geslagte van die seuns van Merári, hulle hele diens by die tent van samekoms onder leiding van Ítamar, die seun van die priester Aäron.

kjv_text: And Moses and Aaron and the chief of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites after their families, and after the house of their fathers,
bsb_text: So Moses, Aaron, and the leaders of the congregation numbered the Kohathites by their clans and families,
aov_text: En Moses en Aäron en die owerstes van die vergadering het die seuns van die Kehatiete getel volgens hulle geslagte en volgens hulle families;

kjv_text: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation:
bsb_text: everyone from thirty to fifty years old who came to serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting.
aov_text: van dertig jaar oud en daarbo, tot vyftig jaar, almal wat dienspligtig was insake die dienswerk by die tent van samekoms.

kjv_text: And those that were numbered of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.
bsb_text: And those numbered by their clans totaled 2,750.
aov_text: En hulle geteldes was volgens hulle geslagte tweeduisend-sewehonderd-en-vyftig.

kjv_text: These were they that were numbered of the families of the Kohathites, all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, which Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
bsb_text: These were counted from the Kohathite clans, everyone who could serve at the Tent of Meeting. Moses and Aaron numbered them according to the command of the LORD through Moses.
aov_text: Dit is die geteldes van die geslagte van die Kehatiete, almal wat by die tent van samekoms gedien het, wat Moses en Aäron volgens die bevel van die HERE deur die diens van Moses getel het.

kjv_text: And those that were numbered of the sons of Gershon, throughout their families, and by the house of their fathers,
bsb_text: Then the Gershonites were numbered by their clans and families,
aov_text: En die geteldes van die seuns van Gerson volgens hulle geslagte en volgens hulle families,

bsb_text: everyone from thirty to fifty years old who came to serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting.
aov_text: van dertig jaar oud en daarbo, tot vyftig jaar, almal wat dienspligtig was insake die dienswerk by die tent van samekoms —

kjv_text: Even those that were numbered of them, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers, were two thousand and six hundred and thirty.
bsb_text: And those numbered by their clans and families totaled 2,630.
aov_text: hulle geteldes was volgens hulle geslagte, volgens hulle families, twee-duisend-seshonderd-en-dertig.

bsb_text: These were counted from the Gershonite clans who served at the Tent of Meeting, whom Moses and Aaron counted at the LORD’s command.
aov_text: Dit is die geteldes van die geslagte van Gerson se seuns, almal wat by die tent van samekoms gedien het, wat Moses en Aäron volgens die bevel van die HERE getel het.

bsb_text: And the Merarites were numbered by their clans and families,
aov_text: En die geteldes van die geslagte van Merári se seuns volgens hulle geslagte, volgens hulle families,
