bsb_text: everyone from thirty to fifty years old who came to serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting.
aov_text: van dertig jaar oud en daarbo, tot vyftig jaar, almal wat dienspligtig was insake die dienswerk by die tent van samekoms —

kjv_text: Even those that were numbered of them after their families, were three thousand and two hundred.
bsb_text: The men registered by their clans numbered 3,200.
aov_text: hulle geteldes was volgens hulle geslagte drieduisend-tweehonderd.

kjv_text: These be those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
bsb_text: These were counted from the Merarite clans, whom Moses and Aaron numbered at the LORD’s command through Moses.
aov_text: Dit is die geteldes van die geslagte van Merári se seuns wat Moses en Aäron volgens die bevel van die HERE deur die diens van Moses getel het.

aov_text: Al die getelde Leviete wat Moses en Aäron en die owerstes van Israel getel het, volgens hulle geslagte en volgens hulle families,

bsb_text: On the day Moses finished setting up the tabernacle, he anointed and consecrated it and all its furnishings, along with the altar and all its utensils.
aov_text: EN op die dag toe Moses die tabernakel klaar opgerig en dit gesalf en geheilig het met al sy gereedskap, en die altaar met al sy gereedskap, en hy dit gesalf en geheilig het,

kjv_text: That the princes of Israel, heads of the house of their fathers, who were the princes of the tribes, and were over them that were numbered, offered:
bsb_text: And the leaders of Israel, the heads of their families, presented an offering. These men were the tribal leaders who had supervised the registration.
aov_text: het die owerstes van Israel, die hoofde van hulle families, offers gebring—hulle was die owerstes van die stamme, hulle wat oor die geteldes gestaan het —

kjv_text: And they brought their offering before the LORD, six covered wagons, and twelve oxen; a wagon for two of the princes, and for each one an ox: and they brought them before the tabernacle.
bsb_text: They brought as their offering before the LORD six covered carts and twelve oxen—an ox from each leader and a cart from every two leaders—and presented them before the tabernacle.
aov_text: hulle het hul offer voor die aangesig van die HERE gebring: ses tentwaens en twaalf beeste; ’n wa vir twee owerstes en ’n bees vir elkeen; en hulle het dit voor die tabernakel gebring.

kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
bsb_text: And the LORD said to Moses,
aov_text: En die HERE het met Moses gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: Take it of them, that they may be to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; and thou shalt give them unto the Levites, to every man according to his service.
bsb_text: “Accept these gifts from them, that they may be used in the work of the Tent of Meeting. And give them to the Levites, to each man according to his service.”
aov_text: Neem dit van hulle aan, dat dit kan gebruik word om die dienswerk van die tent van samekoms te verrig; en jy moet dit aan die Leviete gee, aan elkeen volgens sy dienswerk.

kjv_text: And Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them unto the Levites.
bsb_text: So Moses took the carts and oxen and gave them to the Levites.
aov_text: Toe het Moses die waens en die beeste geneem en dit aan die Leviete gegee:

kjv_text: Two wagons and four oxen he gave unto the sons of Gershon, according to their service:
bsb_text: He gave the Gershonites two carts and four oxen, as their service required,
aov_text: twee waens en vier beeste het hy aan die seuns van Gerson gegee volgens hulle dienswerk;

kjv_text: And four wagons and eight oxen he gave unto the sons of Merari, according unto their service, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
bsb_text: and he gave the Merarites four carts and eight oxen, as their service required, all under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.
aov_text: en vier waens en agt beeste het hy aan die seuns van Merári gegee volgens hulle dienswerk, onder leiding van Ítamar, die seun van die priester Aäron.

kjv_text: But unto the sons of Kohath he gave none: because the service of the sanctuary belonging unto them was that they should bear upon their shoulders.
bsb_text: But he did not give any to the Kohathites, since they were to carry on their shoulders the holy objects for which they were responsible.
aov_text: Maar aan die seuns van Kehat het hy niks gegee nie; want die diens van die heiligdom het op hulle gerus: hulle moes dit op die skouers dra.

kjv_text: And the princes offered for dedicating of the altar in the day that it was anointed, even the princes offered their offering before the altar.
bsb_text: When the altar was anointed, the leaders approached with their offerings for its dedication and presented them before the altar.
aov_text: En die owerstes het die inwydingsgawe van die altaar gebring op die dag toe dit gesalf is, en die owerstes het hulle offer voor die altaar gebring.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, They shall offer their offering, each prince on his day, for the dedicating of the altar.

kjv_text: And he that offered his offering the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah:

kjv_text: And his offering was one silver charger, the weight thereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them were full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:

kjv_text: One spoon of ten shekels of gold, full of incense:
bsb_text: one gold dish weighing ten shekels, filled with incense;
aov_text: een rookpan van tien sikkels goud, vol reukwerk;

bsb_text: one young bull, one ram, and one male lamb a year old for a burnt offering;
aov_text: een jong bul, een ram, een jaaroud lam as brandoffer;

kjv_text: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
bsb_text: one male goat for a sin offering;
aov_text: een bokram as sondoffer;

kjv_text: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Pagiel the son of Ocran.
bsb_text: and a peace offering of two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Pagiel son of Ocran.
aov_text: en as dankoffer: twee beeste, vyf ramme, vyf bokramme, vyf jaaroud lammers. Dit was die offer van Págiël, die seun van Ogran.

kjv_text: On the twelfth day Ahira the son of Enan, prince of the children of Naphtali, offered:
bsb_text: On the twelfth day Ahira son of Enan, the leader of the Naphtalites, drew near.
aov_text: Op die twaalfde dag die owerste van die kinders van Náftali, Ahíra, die seun van Enan.

kjv_text: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
bsb_text: His offering was one silver platter weighing a hundred and thirty shekels, and one silver bowl weighing seventy shekels, both according to the sanctuary shekel and filled with fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering;
aov_text: Sy offer was: een silwerskottel, honderd-en-dertig sikkels in gewig; een silwerkom van sewentig sikkels volgens die sikkel van die heiligdom; altwee vol fynmeel met olie gemeng as spysoffer;

kjv_text: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
bsb_text: one gold dish weighing ten shekels, filled with incense;
aov_text: een rookpan van tien sikkels goud, vol reukwerk;

kjv_text: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
bsb_text: one young bull, one ram, and one male lamb a year old for a burnt offering;
aov_text: een jong bul, een ram, een jaaroud lam as brandoffer;

kjv_text: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
bsb_text: one male goat for a sin offering;
aov_text: een bokram as sondoffer;

kjv_text: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Ahira the son of Enan.
bsb_text: and a peace offering of two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Ahira son of Enan.
aov_text: en as dankoffer: twee beeste, vyf ramme, vyf bokramme, vyf jaaroud lammers. Dit was die offer van Ahíra, die seun van Enan.

kjv_text: This was the dedication of the altar, in the day when it was anointed, by the princes of Israel: twelve chargers of silver, twelve silver bowls, twelve spoons of gold:
bsb_text: So these were the offerings from the leaders of Israel for the dedication of the altar when it was anointed: twelve silver platters, twelve silver bowls, and twelve gold dishes.
aov_text: Dit was die inwydingsgawe van die altaar van die kant van Israel se owerstes op die dag toe dit gesalf is: twaalf silwerskottels, twaalf silwerkomme, twaalf goue rookpanne —

kjv_text: Each charger of silver weighing an hundred and thirty shekels, each bowl seventy: all the silver vessels weighed two thousand and four hundred shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
bsb_text: Each silver platter weighed a hundred and thirty shekels, and each silver bowl seventy shekels. The total weight of the silver articles was two thousand four hundred shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel.
aov_text: elke skottel honderd-en-dertig sikkels silwer, en elke kom sewentig; al die silwer van die goed was twee-duisend-vierhonderd volgens die sikkel van die heiligdom —

kjv_text: The golden spoons were twelve, full of incense, weighing ten shekels apiece, after the shekel of the sanctuary: all the gold of the spoons was an hundred and twenty shekels.
bsb_text: The twelve gold dishes filled with incense weighed ten shekels each, according to the sanctuary shekel. The total weight of the gold dishes was a hundred and twenty shekels.
aov_text: twaalf goue rookpanne, vol reukwerk; elke rookpan tien sikkels volgens die sikkel van die heiligdom; al die goud van die rookpanne was honderd-en-twintig sikkels.

kjv_text: All the oxen for the burnt offering were twelve bullocks, the rams twelve, the lambs of the first year twelve, with their meat offering: and the kids of the goats for sin offering twelve.
bsb_text: All the livestock for the burnt offering totaled twelve bulls, twelve rams, and twelve male lambs a year old—together with their grain offerings—and twelve male goats for the sin offering.
aov_text: Al die beeste vir die brandoffer was twaalf bulle; die ramme twaalf, die jaaroud lammers twaalf, met hulle spysoffer; en twaalf bokramme as sondoffer.

kjv_text: And all the oxen for the sacrifice of the peace offerings were twenty and four bullocks, the rams sixty, the he goats sixty, the lambs of the first year sixty. This was the dedication of the altar, after that it was anointed.
bsb_text: All the livestock sacrificed for the peace offering totaled twenty-four bulls, sixty rams, sixty male goats, and sixty male lambs a year old. This was the dedication offering for the altar after it was anointed.
aov_text: En al die beeste vir die dankoffer was vier-en-twintig bulle; die ramme sestig, die bokramme sestig, die jaaroud lammers sestig. Dit is die inwydingsgawe van die altaar nadat dit gesalf is.

kjv_text: And when Moses was gone into the tabernacle of the congregation to speak with him, then he heard the voice of one speaking unto him from off the mercy seat that was upon the ark of testimony, from between the two cherubims: and he spake unto him.
bsb_text: When Moses entered the Tent of Meeting to speak with the LORD, he heard the voice speaking to him from between the two cherubim above the mercy seat on the ark of the Testimony. Thus the LORD spoke to him.
aov_text: En as Moses in die tent van samekoms gegaan het om met Hom te spreek, het hy die stem met hom hoor spreek van die versoendeksel af wat op die ark van die Getuienis is, tussen die twee gérubs uit. So het Hy dan met hom gespreek.

kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to Moses,
aov_text: EN die HERE het met Moses gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: Speak unto Aaron, and say unto him, When thou lightest the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light over against the candlestick.
bsb_text: “Speak to Aaron and tell him: ‘When you set up the seven lamps, they are to light the area in front of the lampstand.’”
aov_text: Spreek met Aäron en sê vir hom: As jy die lampe opsteek, moet die sewe lampe aan die voorkant van die kandelaar lig gee.

kjv_text: And Aaron did so; he lighted the lamps thereof over against the candlestick, as the LORD commanded Moses.
bsb_text: And Aaron did so; he set up the lamps facing toward the front of the lampstand, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
aov_text: En Aäron het so gedoen: aan die voorkant van die kandelaar het hy dié lampe opgesteek soos die HERE Moses beveel het.

kjv_text: And this work of the candlestick was of beaten gold, unto the shaft thereof, unto the flowers thereof, was beaten work: according unto the pattern which the LORD had shewed Moses, so he made the candlestick.
bsb_text: This is how the lampstand was constructed: it was made of hammered gold from its base to its blossoms, fashioned according to the pattern the LORD had shown Moses.
aov_text: En dit was die maaksel van die kandelaar: dryfwerk uit goud; selfs sy voetstuk en sy blomme was dryfwerk; volgens die beeltenis wat die HERE aan Moses getoon het, so het hy die kandelaar gemaak.

kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
bsb_text: Again the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
aov_text: EN die HERE het met Moses gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.
bsb_text: “Take the Levites from among the Israelites and make them ceremonially clean.
aov_text: Neem die Leviete onder die kinders van Israel uit en reinig hulle.

kjv_text: And thus shalt thou do unto them, to cleanse them: Sprinkle water of purifying upon them, and let them shave all their flesh, and let them wash their clothes, and so make themselves clean.
bsb_text: This is what you must do to cleanse them: Sprinkle them with the water of purification. Have them shave their whole bodies and wash their clothes, and so purify themselves.
aov_text: En so moet jy met hulle doen om hulle te reinig: Sprinkel op hulle water van ontsondiging; en hulle moet ’n skeermes oor hulle hele liggaam laat gaan en hulle klere was en hulleself reinig.

kjv_text: Then let them take a young bullock with his meat offering, even fine flour mingled with oil, and another young bullock shalt thou take for a sin offering.
bsb_text: Then have them take a young bull with its grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil, and you are to take a second young bull for a sin offering.
aov_text: Daarna moet hulle ’n jong bul neem en die spysoffer wat daarby behoort: fynmeel met olie gemeng; en ’n ander jong bul moet jy as sondoffer neem.

kjv_text: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt gather the whole assembly of the children of Israel together:
bsb_text: Bring the Levites before the Tent of Meeting and assemble the whole congregation of Israel.
aov_text: En jy moet die Leviete voor die tent van samekoms laat nader kom en die hele vergadering van die kinders van Israel versamel.

kjv_text: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the LORD: and the children of Israel shall put their hands upon the Levites:
bsb_text: You are to present the Levites before the LORD and have the Israelites lay their hands upon them.
aov_text: Dan moet jy die Leviete voor die aangesig van die HERE laat nader kom, en die kinders van Israel moet hulle hande op die Leviete lê.

kjv_text: And Aaron shall offer the Levites before the LORD for an offering of the children of Israel, that they may execute the service of the LORD.
bsb_text: Aaron is to present the Levites before the LORD as a wave offering from the sons of Israel, so that they may perform the service of the LORD.
aov_text: En Aäron moet die Leviete as beweegoffer beweeg voor die aangesig van die HERE namens die kinders van Israel, sodat hulle daar kan wees om die dienswerk van die HERE te verrig.

kjv_text: And the Levites shall lay their hands upon the heads of the bullocks: and thou shalt offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, unto the LORD, to make an atonement for the Levites.
bsb_text: And the Levites are to lay their hands on the heads of the bulls, and offer to the LORD one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering, to make atonement for the Levites.
aov_text: En die Leviete moet hulle hande op die kop van die bulle lê; en berei jy een as sondoffer en een as brandoffer vir die HERE, om vir die Leviete versoening te doen.

kjv_text: And thou shalt set the Levites before Aaron, and before his sons, and offer them for an offering unto the LORD.
bsb_text: You are to have the Levites stand before Aaron and his sons and then present them before the LORD as a wave offering.
aov_text: Dan moet jy die Leviete stel voor Aäron en sy seuns en hulle as beweegoffer aan die HERE beweeg.

kjv_text: Thus shalt thou separate the Levites from among the children of Israel: and the Levites shall be mine.
bsb_text: In this way you shall separate the Levites from the rest of the Israelites, and the Levites will belong to Me.
aov_text: En jy moet die Leviete onder die kinders van Israel uit afsonder, dat die Leviete myne kan wees.

kjv_text: And after that shall the Levites go in to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt cleanse them, and offer them for an offering.
bsb_text: After you have cleansed them and presented them as a wave offering, they may come to serve at the Tent of Meeting.
aov_text: En daarna moet die Leviete inkom om die tent van samekoms te bedien. So moet jy hulle dan reinig en hulle as beweegoffer beweeg.

kjv_text: For they are wholly given unto me from among the children of Israel; instead of such as open every womb, even instead of the firstborn of all the children of Israel, have I taken them unto me.
bsb_text: For the Levites have been wholly given to Me from among the sons of Israel. I have taken them for Myself in place of all who come first from the womb, the firstborn of all the sons of Israel.
aov_text: Want hulle is heeltemal aan My gegee onder die kinders van Israel uit, in die plek van alles wat die moederskoot open—al die eersgeborenes uit die kinders van Israel—het Ek hulle vir My geneem.

kjv_text: For all the firstborn of the children of Israel are mine, both man and beast: on the day that I smote every firstborn in the land of Egypt I sanctified them for myself.
bsb_text: For every firstborn male in Israel is Mine, both man and beast. I set them apart for Myself on the day I struck down all the firstborn in the land of Egypt.
aov_text: Want al die eersgeborenes onder die kinders van Israel is myne, van mense en van diere; op die dag toe Ek al die eersgeborenes in Egipteland getref het, het Ek hulle vir My geheilig.

kjv_text: And I have taken the Levites for all the firstborn of the children of Israel.
bsb_text: But I have taken the Levites in place of all the firstborn among the sons of Israel.
aov_text: En Ek het die Leviete in die plek van al die eersgeborenes onder die kinders van Israel geneem

kjv_text: And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the tabernacle of the congregation, and to make an atonement for the children of Israel: that there be no plague among the children of Israel, when the children of Israel come nigh unto the sanctuary.
bsb_text: And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and his sons from among the Israelites, to perform the service for the Israelites at the Tent of Meeting and to make atonement on their behalf, so that no plague will come against the Israelites when they approach the sanctuary.”
aov_text: en die Leviete gegee—hulle is gegee aan Aäron en sy seuns onder die kinders van Israel uit om die dienswerk van die kinders van Israel in die tent van samekoms te verrig en om vir die kinders van Israel versoening te doen, sodat daar geen plaag mag wees onder die kinders van Israel as die kinders van Israel na die heiligdom aankom nie.

kjv_text: And Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel, did to the Levites according unto all that the LORD commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did the children of Israel unto them.
bsb_text: So Moses, Aaron, and the whole congregation of Israel did with the Levites everything that the LORD had commanded Moses they should do.
aov_text: En Moses en Aäron en die hele vergadering van die kinders van Israel het met die Leviete gedoen net soos die HERE Moses aangaande die Leviete beveel het; so het die kinders van Israel met hulle gedoen.

kjv_text: And the Levites were purified, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them as an offering before the LORD; and Aaron made an atonement for them to cleanse them.
bsb_text: The Levites purified themselves and washed their clothes, and Aaron presented them as a wave offering before the LORD. Aaron also made atonement for them to cleanse them.
aov_text: En die Leviete het hulleself ontsondig en hulle klere gewas, en Aäron het hulle beweeg as beweegoffer voor die aangesig van die HERE; en Aäron het versoening vir hulle gedoen om hulle te reinig.

kjv_text: And after that went the Levites in to do their service in the tabernacle of the congregation before Aaron, and before his sons: as the LORD had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did they unto them.
bsb_text: After that, the Levites came to perform their service at the Tent of Meeting in the presence of Aaron and his sons. Thus they did with the Levites just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
aov_text: En daarna het die Leviete gekom om hulle dienswerk in die tent van samekoms voor Aäron en sy seuns te verrig; soos die HERE Moses aangaande die Leviete beveel het, so het hulle met hulle gedoen.

kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
bsb_text: And the LORD said to Moses,
aov_text: En die HERE het met Moses gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: This is it that belongeth unto the Levites: from twenty and five years old and upward they shall go in to wait upon the service of the tabernacle of the congregation:
bsb_text: “This applies to the Levites: Men twenty-five years of age or older shall enter to perform the service in the work at the Tent of Meeting.
aov_text: Dit is die saak wat die Leviete betref: Van vyf-en-twintig jaar oud en daarbo moet hy kom om sy plig te vervul by die dienswerk van die tent van samekoms.

kjv_text: And from the age of fifty years they shall cease waiting upon the service thereof, and shall serve no more:
bsb_text: But at the age of fifty, they must retire from performing the work and no longer serve.
aov_text: Maar van vyftig jaar oud moet hy vry wees van diensplig en nie meer dien nie —

kjv_text: But shall minister with their brethren in the tabernacle of the congregation, to keep the charge, and shall do no service. Thus shalt thou do unto the Levites touching their charge.
bsb_text: After that, they may assist their brothers in fulfilling their duties at the Tent of Meeting, but they themselves are not to do the work. This is how you are to assign responsibilities to the Levites.”
aov_text: hy kan sy broers in die tent van samekoms behulpsaam wees om die diens waar te neem, maar dienswerk moet hy nie verrig nie. So moet jy met die Leviete doen insake hulle ampspligte.

kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,
bsb_text: In the first month of the second year after Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, the LORD spoke to Moses in the Wilderness of Sinai:
aov_text: EN die HERE het met Moses gespreek in die woestyn Sinai—in die tweede jaar nadat hulle uit Egipteland uitgetrek het, in die eerste maand—en gesê

kjv_text: Let the children of Israel also keep the passover at his appointed season.
bsb_text: “The Israelites are to observe the Passover at its appointed time.
aov_text: dat die kinders van Israel die pasga op die bepaalde tyd moet hou.

kjv_text: In the fourteenth day of this month, at even, ye shall keep it in his appointed season: according to all the rites of it, and according to all the ceremonies thereof, shall ye keep it.
bsb_text: You are to observe it at the appointed time, at twilight on the fourteenth day of this month, in accordance with its statutes and ordinances.”
aov_text: Op die veertiende dag in hierdie maand, teen die aand, moet julle dit op die bepaalde tyd hou; volgens al sy insettinge en al sy verordeninge moet julle dit hou.

kjv_text: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel, that they should keep the passover.
bsb_text: So Moses told the Israelites to observe the Passover,
aov_text: Toe het Moses met die kinders van Israel gespreek dat hulle die pasga moet hou.

kjv_text: And they kept the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month at even in the wilderness of Sinai: according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did the children of Israel.
bsb_text: and they did so in the Wilderness of Sinai, at twilight on the fourteenth day of the first month. The Israelites did everything just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
aov_text: En hulle het die pasga gehou op die veertiende dag van die eerste maand, teen die aand, in die woestyn Sinai; net soos die HERE Moses beveel het, so het die kinders van Israel gedoen.

kjv_text: And there were certain men, who were defiled by the dead body of a man, that they could not keep the passover on that day: and they came before Moses and before Aaron on that day:
bsb_text: But there were some men who were unclean due to a dead body, so they could not observe the Passover on that day. And they came before Moses and Aaron that same day
aov_text: En daar was manne wat deur die lyk van ’n mens onrein geword het en op dieselfde dag die pasga nie kon hou nie. Daarom het hulle nader gekom voor Moses en Aäron op dieselfde dag,

kjv_text: And those men said unto him, We are defiled by the dead body of a man: wherefore are we kept back, that we may not offer an offering of the LORD in his appointed season among the children of Israel?
bsb_text: and said to Moses, “We are unclean because of a dead body, but why should we be excluded from presenting the LORD’s offering with the other Israelites at the appointed time?”
aov_text: en dié manne het vir hom gesê: Ons is onrein deur die lyk van ’n mens; waarom moet ons te kort gedoen word, dat ons die offer van die HERE nie op die bepaalde tyd onder die kinders van Israel sou bring nie?

kjv_text: And Moses said unto them, Stand still, and I will hear what the LORD will command concerning you.
bsb_text: “Wait here until I find out what the LORD commands concerning you,” Moses replied.
aov_text: En Moses het vir hulle gesê: Bly staan, dat ek kan hoor wat die HERE julle sal beveel.

kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to Moses,
aov_text: Toe het die HERE met Moses gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If any man of you or of your posterity shall be unclean by reason of a dead body, or be in a journey afar off, yet he shall keep the passover unto the LORD.
bsb_text: “Tell the Israelites: ‘When any one of you or your descendants is unclean because of a dead body, or is away on a journey, he may still observe the Passover to the LORD.
aov_text: Spreek met die kinders van Israel en sê: As iemand van julle of van julle geslagte deur ’n lyk onrein word of op ’n ver reis is, moet hy tog die pasga vir die HERE hou.

kjv_text: The fourteenth day of the second month at even they shall keep it, and eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.
bsb_text: Such people are to observe it at twilight on the fourteenth day of the second month. They are to eat the lamb, together with unleavened bread and bitter herbs;
aov_text: In die tweede maand, op die veertiende dag, teen die aand, moet hulle dit hou; met ongesuurde brode en bitter kruie moet hulle dit eet.

kjv_text: They shall leave none of it unto the morning, nor break any bone of it: according to all the ordinances of the passover they shall keep it.
bsb_text: they may not leave any of it until morning or break any of its bones. They must observe the Passover according to all its statutes.
aov_text: Hulle moet daarvan niks laat oorbly tot die môre toe of ’n been daaraan breek nie; volgens die hele insetting van die pasga moet hulle dit hou.

kjv_text: But the man that is clean, and is not in a journey, and forbeareth to keep the passover, even the same soul shall be cut off from among his people: because he brought not the offering of the LORD in his appointed season, that man shall bear his sin.
bsb_text: But if a man who is ceremonially clean and is not on a journey still fails to observe the Passover, he must be cut off from his people, because he did not present the LORD’s offering at its appointed time. That man will bear the consequences of his sin.
aov_text: Maar die man wat rein is en nie op reis is nie en nalaat om die pasga te hou, dié siel moet uit sy volksgenote uitgeroei word; want hy het die offer van die HERE nie op die bepaalde tyd gebring nie. Dié man moet sy sonde dra.

kjv_text: And if a stranger shall sojourn among you, and will keep the passover unto the LORD; according to the ordinance of the passover, and according to the manner thereof, so shall he do: ye shall have one ordinance, both for the stranger, and for him that was born in the land.
bsb_text: If a foreigner dwelling among you wants to observe the Passover to the LORD, he is to do so according to the Passover statute and its ordinances. You are to apply the same statute to both the foreigner and the native of the land.’”
aov_text: En as ’n vreemdeling by julle vertoef en die pasga vir die HERE hou, moet hy dit hou volgens die insetting van die pasga en volgens die verordening daarvan. Dit moet een insetting vir julle wees, vir die vreemdeling sowel as die kind van die land.

kjv_text: And on the day that the tabernacle was reared up the cloud covered the tabernacle, namely, the tent of the testimony: and at even there was upon the tabernacle as it were the appearance of fire, until the morning.
bsb_text: On the day that the tabernacle, the Tent of the Testimony, was set up, the cloud covered it and appeared like fire above the tabernacle from evening until morning.
aov_text: EN op die dag toe hulle die tabernakel opgerig het, het die wolk die tabernakel van die tent van die Getuienis oordek, en in die aand was dit oor die tabernakel soos ’n gedaante van vuur, tot die môre toe.

kjv_text: So it was alway: the cloud covered it by day, and the appearance of fire by night.
bsb_text: It remained that way continually; the cloud would cover the tabernacle by day, and at night it would appear like fire.
aov_text: So was dit altyddeur: die wolk het dit oordek, en snags ’n gedaante van vuur.

kjv_text: And when the cloud was taken up from the tabernacle, then after that the children of Israel journeyed: and in the place where the cloud abode, there the children of Israel pitched their tents.
bsb_text: Whenever the cloud was lifted from above the Tent, the Israelites would set out, and wherever the cloud settled, there the Israelites would camp.
aov_text: En so dikwels as die wolk van die tent af optrek, het die kinders van Israel daarna weggetrek; en op die plek waar die wolk rus, daar het die kinders van Israel laer opgeslaan —

kjv_text: At the commandment of the LORD the children of Israel journeyed, and at the commandment of the LORD they pitched: as long as the cloud abode upon the tabernacle they rested in their tents.
bsb_text: At the LORD’s command the Israelites set out, and at the LORD’s command they camped. As long as the cloud remained over the tabernacle, they remained encamped.
aov_text: volgens die bevel van die HERE het die kinders van Israel weggetrek en volgens die bevel van die HERE laer opgeslaan; al die dae wat die wolk oor die tabernakel gerus het, het hulle in die laer gestaan.

kjv_text: And when the cloud tarried long upon the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept the charge of the LORD, and journeyed not.
bsb_text: Even when the cloud lingered over the tabernacle for many days, the Israelites kept the LORD’s charge and did not set out.
aov_text: En as die wolk baie dae oor die tabernakel bly, het die kinders van Israel die diens van die HERE waargeneem en nie weggetrek nie.

kjv_text: And so it was, when the cloud was a few days upon the tabernacle; according to the commandment of the LORD they abode in their tents, and according to the commandment of the LORD they journeyed.
bsb_text: Sometimes the cloud remained over the tabernacle for only a few days, and they would camp at the LORD’s command and set out at the LORD’s command.
aov_text: Maar somtyds was die wolk net ’n paar dae oor die tabernakel—volgens die bevel van die HERE het hulle laer opgeslaan, en volgens die bevel van die HERE het hulle weggetrek.

kjv_text: And so it was, when the cloud abode from even unto the morning, and that the cloud was taken up in the morning, then they journeyed: whether it was by day or by night that the cloud was taken up, they journeyed.
bsb_text: Sometimes the cloud remained only from evening until morning, and when it lifted in the morning, they would set out. Whether it was by day or by night, when the cloud was taken up, they would set out.
aov_text: En somtyds was die wolk daar van die aand tot die môre—as die wolk in die môre optrek, het hulle weggetrek; of by dag of by nag—as die wolk optrek, het hulle weggetrek;

kjv_text: Or whether it were two days, or a month, or a year, that the cloud tarried upon the tabernacle, remaining thereon, the children of Israel abode in their tents, and journeyed not: but when it was taken up, they journeyed.
bsb_text: Whether the cloud lingered for two days, a month, or longer, the Israelites camped and did not set out as long as the cloud remained over the tabernacle; but when it was lifted, they would set out.
aov_text: of ná twee dae of ’n maand of langer—as die wolk lank oor die tabernakel bly, het die kinders van Israel in die laer gestaan en nie weggetrek nie; en as dit optrek, het hulle weggetrek.

kjv_text: At the commandment of the LORD they rested in the tents, and at the commandment of the LORD they journeyed: they kept the charge of the LORD, at the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
bsb_text: They camped at the LORD’s command, and they set out at the LORD’s command; they carried out the LORD’s charge according to His command through Moses.
aov_text: Volgens die bevel van die HERE het hulle laer opgeslaan, en volgens die bevel van die HERE het hulle weggetrek. Hulle het die voorskrif van die HERE in ag geneem volgens die bevel van die HERE deur die diens van Moses.

kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to Moses,
aov_text: VERDER het die HERE met Moses gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: Make thee two trumpets of silver; of a whole piece shalt thou make them: that thou mayest use them for the calling of the assembly, and for the journeying of the camps.
bsb_text: “Make two trumpets of hammered silver to be used for calling the congregation and for having the camps set out.
aov_text: Maak vir jou twee silwertrompette; van dryfwerk moet jy dit maak; en hulle moet vir jou dien om die vergadering byeen te roep en om die laers te laat opbreek.

kjv_text: And when they shall blow with them, all the assembly shall assemble themselves to thee at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
bsb_text: When both are sounded, the whole congregation is to assemble before you at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
aov_text: As hulle dan daarop blaas, moet die hele vergadering by jou byeenkom by die ingang van die tent van samekoms.

kjv_text: And if they blow but with one trumpet, then the princes, which are heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves unto thee.
bsb_text: But if only one is sounded, then the leaders, the heads of the clans of Israel, are to gather before you.
aov_text: Maar as hulle op een daarvan blaas, moet by jou byeenkom die owerstes, die stamhoofde van Israel.

kjv_text: When ye blow an alarm, then the camps that lie on the east parts shall go forward.
bsb_text: When you sound short blasts, the camps that lie on the east side are to set out.
aov_text: En as julle alarm blaas, moet die laers opbreek wat aan die oostekant staan.

kjv_text: When ye blow an alarm the second time, then the camps that lie on the south side shall take their journey: they shall blow an alarm for their journeys.
bsb_text: When you sound the short blasts a second time, the camps that lie on the south side are to set out. The blasts are to signal them to set out.
aov_text: Maar as julle die tweede keer alarm blaas, moet die laers opbreek wat aan die suidekant staan. Alarm moet hulle blaas as hulle moet opbreek.

kjv_text: But when the congregation is to be gathered together, ye shall blow, but ye shall not sound an alarm.
bsb_text: To convene the assembly, you are to sound long blasts, not short ones.
aov_text: Maar as die vergadering byeen moet kom, moet julle blaas, maar nie alarm maak nie.

kjv_text: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow with the trumpets; and they shall be to you for an ordinance for ever throughout your generations.
bsb_text: The sons of Aaron, the priests, are to sound the trumpets. This shall be a permanent statute for you and the generations to come.
aov_text: En die seuns van Aäron, die priesters, moet op die trompette blaas; en dié trompette moet vir julle ’n ewige insetting in julle geslagte wees.

kjv_text: And if ye go to war in your land against the enemy that oppresseth you, then ye shall blow an alarm with the trumpets; and ye shall be remembered before the LORD your God, and ye shall be saved from your enemies.
bsb_text: When you enter into battle in your land against an adversary who attacks you, sound short blasts on the trumpets, and you will be remembered before the LORD your God and saved from your enemies.
aov_text: En as julle in jul land in oorlog kom teen die vyand wat met julle veg, moet julle met die trompette alarm blaas; dan sal aan julle gedink word voor die aangesig van die HERE julle God, en julle sal van jul vyande verlos word.

kjv_text: Also in the day of your gladness, and in your solemn days, and in the beginnings of your months, ye shall blow with the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; that they may be to you for a memorial before your God: I am the LORD your God.
bsb_text: And on your joyous occasions, your appointed feasts, and the beginning of each month, you are to blow the trumpets over your burnt offerings and fellowship offerings to serve as a reminder for you before your God. I am the LORD your God.”
aov_text: Op die dag as julle vrolik is, sowel as op julle feestye en by die begin van julle maande moet julle by jul brandoffers en by jul dankoffers op die trompette blaas: hulle sal dien om julle in gedagtenis te bring voor die aangesig van julle God. Ek is die HERE julle God.

kjv_text: And it came to pass on the twentieth day of the second month, in the second year, that the cloud was taken up from off the tabernacle of the testimony.
bsb_text: On the twentieth day of the second month of the second year, the cloud was lifted from above the tabernacle of the Testimony,
aov_text: IN die tweede jaar, in die tweede maand, op die twintigste van die maand, het die wolk opgetrek van die tabernakel van die Getuienis af.

kjv_text: And the children of Israel took their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud rested in the wilderness of Paran.
bsb_text: and the Israelites set out from the Wilderness of Sinai, traveling from place to place until the cloud settled in the Wilderness of Paran.
aov_text: En die kinders van Israel het van plek tot plek weggetrek uit die woestyn Sinai, en die wolk het gaan rus in die woestyn Paran.

kjv_text: And they first took their journey according to the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
bsb_text: They set out this first time according to the LORD’s command through Moses.
aov_text: So het hulle dan die eerste keer weggetrek volgens die bevel van die HERE deur die diens van Moses.

kjv_text: In the first place went the standard of the camp of the children of Judah according to their armies: and over his host was Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
bsb_text: First, the divisions of the camp of Judah set out under their standard, with Nahshon son of Amminadab in command.
aov_text: En eerste het weggetrek die vaandel van die laer van Juda se kinders volgens hulle leërafdelings; en oor sy afdeling was Nagson, die seun van Ammínadab.

kjv_text: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Issachar was Nethaneel the son of Zuar.
bsb_text: Nethanel son of Zuar was over the division of the tribe of Issachar,
aov_text: En oor die afdeling van die stam van Íssaskar se kinders was Netáneël, die seun van Suar.

kjv_text: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Zebulun was Eliab the son of Helon.
bsb_text: and Eliab son of Helon was over the division of the tribe of Zebulun.
aov_text: En oor die afdeling van die stam van Sébulon se kinders was Elíab, die seun van Helon.

kjv_text: And the tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari set forward, bearing the tabernacle.
bsb_text: Then the tabernacle was taken down, and the Gershonites and the Merarites set out, transporting it.
aov_text: Toe is die tabernakel afgebreek; en die seuns van Gerson en die seuns van Merári, die draers van die tabernakel, het weggetrek.

kjv_text: And the standard of the camp of Reuben set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elizur the son of Shedeur.
bsb_text: Then the divisions of the camp of Reuben set out under their standard, with Elizur son of Shedeur in command.
aov_text: Daarna het weggetrek die vaandel van die laer van Ruben volgens hulle leërafdelings; en oor sy afdeling was Elísur, die seun van Sedéür.

kjv_text: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Simeon was Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
bsb_text: Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai was over the division of the tribe of Simeon,
aov_text: En oor die afdeling van die stam van Símeon se kinders was Selúmiël, die seun van Surísaddai.

kjv_text: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Gad was Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
bsb_text: and Eliasaph son of Deuel was over the division of the tribe of Gad.
aov_text: En oor die afdeling van die stam van Gad se kinders was Éljasaf, die seun van Réhuel.

kjv_text: And the Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary: and the other did set up the tabernacle against they came.
bsb_text: Then the Kohathites set out, transporting the holy objects; the tabernacle was to be set up before their arrival.
aov_text: Daarna het die Kehatiete, die draers van die heiligdom, weggetrek. En die ander het die tabernakel opgerig voordat hulle aangekom het.

kjv_text: And the standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elishama the son of Ammihud.
bsb_text: Next, the divisions of the camp of Ephraim set out under their standard, with Elishama son of Ammihud in command.
aov_text: Daarna het weggetrek die vaandel van die laer van Efraim se kinders volgens hulle leërafdelings; en oor sy afdeling was Elisáma, die seun van Ammíhud.

kjv_text: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Manasseh was Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
bsb_text: Gamaliel son of Pedahzur was over the division of the tribe of Manasseh,
aov_text: En oor die afdeling van die stam van Manasse se kinders was Gámliël, die seun van Pedásur.

kjv_text: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Benjamin was Abidan the son of Gideoni.
bsb_text: and Abidan son of Gideoni was over the division of the tribe of Benjamin.
aov_text: En oor die afdeling van die stam van Benjamin se kinders was Abídan, die seun van Gideóni.

kjv_text: And the standard of the camp of the children of Dan set forward, which was the rereward of all the camps throughout their hosts: and over his host was Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
bsb_text: Finally, the divisions of the camp of Dan set out under their standard, serving as the rear guard for all units, with Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai in command.
aov_text: Toe het weggetrek die vaandel van die laer van Dan se kinders wat, volgens hulle leërafdelings, die agterhoede vir al die leërs was; en oor sy afdeling was Ahiëser, die seun van Ammísaddai.

kjv_text: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Asher was Pagiel the son of Ocran.
bsb_text: Pagiel son of Ocran was over the division of the tribe of Asher,
aov_text: En oor die afdeling van die stam van Aser se kinders was Págiël, die seun van Ogran.

kjv_text: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Naphtali was Ahira the son of Enan.
bsb_text: and Ahira son of Enan was over the division of the tribe of Naphtali.
aov_text: En oor die afdeling van die stam van Náftali se kinders was Ahíra, die seun van Enan.

kjv_text: Thus were the journeyings of the children of Israel according to their armies, when they set forward.
bsb_text: This was the order of march for the Israelite divisions as they set out.
aov_text: Dit is die optogte van die kinders van Israel volgens hulle leërafdelings. En hulle het weggetrek.

kjv_text: And Moses said unto Hobab, the son of Raguel the Midianite, Moses' father in law, We are journeying unto the place of which the LORD said, I will give it you: come thou with us, and we will do thee good: for the LORD hath spoken good concerning Israel.
bsb_text: Then Moses said to Hobab, the son of Moses’ father-in-law Reuel the Midianite, “We are setting out for the place of which the LORD said: ‘I will give it to you.’ Come with us, and we will treat you well, for the LORD has promised good things to Israel.”
aov_text: En Moses het vir Hobab, die seun van Réhuel, die Midianiet, die swaer van Moses, gesê: Ons trek na die plek waarvan die HERE gesê het: Ek sal dit aan julle gee. Trek saam met ons en ons sal aan jou goed doen; want die HERE het oor Israel goeie dinge gespreek.

kjv_text: And he said unto him, I will not go; but I will depart to mine own land, and to my kindred.
bsb_text: “I will not go,” Hobab replied. “Instead, I am going back to my own land and my own people.”
aov_text: Maar hy het vir hom gesê: Ek sal nie saamtrek nie; maar ek sal na my land en my familie gaan.

kjv_text: And he said, Leave us not, I pray thee; forasmuch as thou knowest how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and thou mayest be to us instead of eyes.
bsb_text: “Please do not leave us,” Moses said, “since you know where we should camp in the wilderness, and you can serve as our eyes.
aov_text: Toe sê hy: Moet ons tog nie verlaat nie, juis daarom dat jy weet hoe ons laer moet opslaan in die woestyn, en jy sal vir ons as oë dien.

kjv_text: And it shall be, if thou go with us, yea, it shall be, that what goodness the LORD shall do unto us, the same will we do unto thee.
bsb_text: If you come with us, we will share with you whatever good things the LORD gives us.”
aov_text: En as jy met ons saamtrek, sal ons daardie goeie wat die HERE aan ons sal doen, ook aan jou doen.

kjv_text: And they departed from the mount of the LORD three days' journey: and the ark of the covenant of the LORD went before them in the three days' journey, to search out a resting place for them.
bsb_text: So they set out on a three-day journey from the mountain of the LORD, with the ark of the covenant of the LORD traveling ahead of them for those three days to seek a resting place for them.
aov_text: En hulle het van die berg van die HERE af drie dagreise ver getrek; en die verbondsark van die HERE het drie dagreise ver voor hulle uit getrek om vir hulle ’n rusplek uit te soek.

kjv_text: And the cloud of the LORD was upon them by day, when they went out of the camp.
bsb_text: And the cloud of the LORD was over them by day when they set out from the camp.
aov_text: En die wolk van die HERE was bedags oor hulle as hulle uit die laer wegtrek.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when the ark set forward, that Moses said, Rise up, LORD, and let thine enemies be scattered; and let them that hate thee flee before thee.
bsb_text: Whenever the ark set out, Moses would say, “Rise up, O LORD! May Your enemies be scattered; may those who hate You flee before You.”
aov_text: En as die ark wegtrek, het Moses gesê: Staan op, HERE, dat u vyande verstrooi kan word en u haters voor u aangesig kan vlug.

kjv_text: And when it rested, he said, Return, O LORD, unto the many thousands of Israel.
bsb_text: And when it came to rest, he would say: “Return, O LORD, to the countless thousands of Israel.”
aov_text: En as dit rus, het hy gesê: Keer terug, HERE, na die tienduisende van die duisende van Israel!

kjv_text: And when the people complained, it displeased the LORD: and the LORD heard it; and his anger was kindled; and the fire of the LORD burnt among them, and consumed them that were in the uttermost parts of the camp.
bsb_text: Soon the people began to complain about their hardship in the hearing of the LORD, and when He heard them, His anger was kindled, and fire from the LORD blazed among them and consumed the outskirts of the camp.
aov_text: EN die volk het hulle voor die ore van die HERE beklaag dat dit sleg gaan. En toe die HERE dit hoor, het sy toorn ontvlam, en die vuur van die HERE het onder hulle gebrand en het gewoed aan die kant van die laer.

kjv_text: And the people cried unto Moses; and when Moses prayed unto the LORD, the fire was quenched.
bsb_text: And the people cried out to Moses, and he prayed to the LORD, and the fire died down.
aov_text: Toe het die volk na Moses geroep, en Moses het tot die HERE gebid; en die vuur het doodgegaan.

kjv_text: And he called the name of the place Taberah: because the fire of the LORD burnt among them.
bsb_text: So that place was called Taberah, because the fire of the LORD had burned among them.
aov_text: Daarom het hulle die plek Tabéra genoem, omdat die vuur van die HERE onder hulle gebrand het.

kjv_text: And the mixt multitude that was among them fell a lusting: and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, Who shall give us flesh to eat?
bsb_text: Meanwhile, the rabble among them had a strong craving for other food, and again the Israelites wept and said, “Who will feed us meat?
aov_text: EN die gemengde bevolking wat onder hulle was, is met lus bevang. Toe het die kinders van Israel ook weer geween en gesê: Wie sal vir ons vleis gee om te eet?

kjv_text: We remember the fish, which we did eat in Egypt freely; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlick:
bsb_text: We remember the fish we ate freely in Egypt, along with the cucumbers, melons, leeks, onions, and garlic.
aov_text: Ons dink aan die visse wat ons in Egipte verniet kon eet, aan die komkommers en die waterlemoene en die prei en die uie en die knoffel.

kjv_text: But now our soul is dried away: there is nothing at all, beside this manna, before our eyes.
bsb_text: But now our appetite is gone; there is nothing to see but this manna!”
aov_text: Maar nou is ons siel dor; daar’s glad niks nie: net die manna is voor ons oë.

kjv_text: And the manna was as coriander seed, and the colour thereof as the colour of bdellium.
bsb_text: Now the manna resembled coriander seed, and its appearance was like that of gum resin.
aov_text: Die manna was soos koljandersaad, en dit het gelyk na balsemgom.

kjv_text: And the people went about, and gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in a mortar, and baked it in pans, and made cakes of it: and the taste of it was as the taste of fresh oil.
bsb_text: The people walked around and gathered it, ground it on a handmill or crushed it in a mortar, then boiled it in a cooking pot or shaped it into cakes. It tasted like pastry baked with fine oil.
aov_text: Die volk het rondgeloop en dit versamel en in handmeule gemaal of in vysels gestamp, en hulle het dit in potte gekook en daarvan roosterkoeke gemaak. En die smaak daarvan was soos die smaak van oliekoeke.

kjv_text: And when the dew fell upon the camp in the night, the manna fell upon it.
bsb_text: When the dew fell on the camp at night, the manna would fall with it.
aov_text: En as die dou snags op die laer val, het die manna ook daarop geval.

kjv_text: Then Moses heard the people weep throughout their families, every man in the door of his tent: and the anger of the LORD was kindled greatly; Moses also was displeased.
bsb_text: Then Moses heard the people of family after family weeping at the entrances to their tents, and the anger of the LORD was kindled greatly, and Moses was also displeased.
aov_text: Toe het Moses die volk, volgens hulle geslagte, elkeen by die deur van sy tent hoor ween; en die toorn van die HERE het grootliks ontvlam; ook was dit verkeerd in die oë van Moses.

kjv_text: And Moses said unto the LORD, Wherefore hast thou afflicted thy servant? and wherefore have I not found favour in thy sight, that thou layest the burden of all this people upon me?
bsb_text: So Moses asked the LORD, “Why have You brought this trouble on Your servant? Why have I not found favor in Your sight, that You have laid upon me the burden of all these people?
aov_text: En Moses sê aan die HERE: Waarom het U u kneg kwaad aangedoen, en waarom het ek geen genade in u oë gevind nie, dat U die las van hierdie hele volk op my lê?

kjv_text: Have I conceived all this people? have I begotten them, that thou shouldest say unto me, Carry them in thy bosom, as a nursing father beareth the sucking child, unto the land which thou swarest unto their fathers?
bsb_text: Did I conceive all these people? Did I give them birth, so that You should tell me, ‘Carry them in your bosom, as a nurse carries an infant,’ to the land that You swore to give their fathers?
aov_text: Het ék hierdie hele volk dan ontvang? Of het ék hulle gebaar, dat U vir my sê: Dra hulle aan jou bors soos ’n oppasser die suigling dra, na die land wat U aan hulle vaders met ’n eed beloof het?

kjv_text: Whence should I have flesh to give unto all this people? for they weep unto me, saying, Give us flesh, that we may eat.
bsb_text: Where can I get meat for all these people? For they keep crying out to me, ‘Give us meat to eat!’
aov_text: Waarvandaan moet ek vleis kry om aan al hierdie volk te gee? Want hulle ween by my en sê: Gee vir ons vleis, dat ons kan eet.

kjv_text: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.
bsb_text: I cannot carry all these people by myself; it is too burdensome for me.
aov_text: Ek alleen kan hierdie hele volk nie dra nie, want dit is vir my te swaar.

kjv_text: And if thou deal thus with me, kill me, I pray thee, out of hand, if I have found favour in thy sight; and let me not see my wretchedness.
bsb_text: If this is how You are going to treat me, please kill me right now—if I have found favor in Your eyes—and let me not see my own wretchedness.”
aov_text: En as U so met my wil handel, slaan my dan maar liewer dood as ek genade in u oë gevind het, en laat ek my ongeluk nie aansien nie.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Gather unto me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom thou knowest to be the elders of the people, and officers over them; and bring them unto the tabernacle of the congregation, that they may stand there with thee.
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Bring Me seventy of the elders of Israel known to you as leaders and officers of the people. Bring them to the Tent of Meeting and have them stand there with you.
aov_text: Toe sê die HERE aan Moses: Bring vir My sewentig manne uit die oudstes van Israel bymekaar, van wie jy weet dat hulle oudstes van die volk en sy opsigters is, en bring hulle by die tent van samekoms, dat hulle daar by jou kan staan.

kjv_text: And I will come down and talk with thee there: and I will take of the spirit which is upon thee, and will put it upon them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with thee, that thou bear it not thyself alone.
bsb_text: And I will come down and speak with you there, and I will take some of the Spirit that is on you and put that Spirit on them. They will help you bear the burden of the people, so that you do not have to bear it by yourself.
aov_text: Dan sal Ek neerdaal en daar met jou spreek; en van die Gees wat op jou is, sal Ek afsonder en op hulle lê; en hulle sal jou help om die las van die volk te dra, sodat jy dit nie alleen hoef te dra nie.

kjv_text: And say thou unto the people, Sanctify yourselves against to morrow, and ye shall eat flesh: for ye have wept in the ears of the LORD, saying, Who shall give us flesh to eat? for it was well with us in Egypt: therefore the LORD will give you flesh, and ye shall eat.
bsb_text: And say to the people: Consecrate yourselves for tomorrow, and you will eat meat, because you have cried out in the hearing of the LORD, saying: ‘Who will feed us meat? For we were better off in Egypt!’ Therefore the LORD will give you meat, and you will eat.
aov_text: En aan die volk moet jy sê: Heilig julle teen môre; dan sal julle vleis eet. Want julle het voor die ore van die HERE geween en gesê: Wie sal vir ons vleis gee om te eet? want dit was vir ons goed in Egipte. Daarom sal die HERE vir julle vleis gee, en julle sal eet.

kjv_text: Ye shall not eat one day, nor two days, nor five days, neither ten days, nor twenty days;
bsb_text: You will eat it not for one or two days, nor for five or ten or twenty days,
aov_text: Julle sal nie een dag of twee dae eet nie, of vyf dae of tien dae of twintig dae nie —

kjv_text: But even a whole month, until it come out at your nostrils, and it be loathsome unto you: because that ye have despised the LORD which is among you, and have wept before him, saying, Why came we forth out of Egypt?
bsb_text: but for a whole month—until it comes out of your nostrils and makes you nauseous—because you have rejected the LORD, who is among you, and have cried out before Him, saying, ‘Why did we ever leave Egypt?’”
aov_text: ’n hele maand lank, totdat dit uit julle neus uitkom en julle daarvan walg; omdat julle die HERE wat in julle midde is, verwerp en voor sy aangesig gehuil en gesê het: Waarom het ons tog uit Egipte uitgetrek?

kjv_text: And Moses said, The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand footmen; and thou hast said, I will give them flesh, that they may eat a whole month.
bsb_text: But Moses replied, “Here I am among 600,000 men on foot, yet You say, ‘I will give them meat, and they will eat for a month.’
aov_text: Toe sê Moses: Seshonderdduisend te voet is die volk onder wie ek verkeer; en U het gesê: Ek sal aan hulle vleis gee, en hulle sal ’n hele maand lank eet!

kjv_text: Shall the flocks and the herds be slain for them, to suffice them? or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to suffice them?
bsb_text: If all our flocks and herds were slaughtered for them, would they have enough? Or if all the fish in the sea were caught for them, would they have enough?”
aov_text: Sal daar vir hulle kleinvee en beeste geslag word, sodat daar vir hulle genoeg sal wees? Of sal al die visse van die see vir hulle versamel word, sodat daar vir hulle genoeg is?

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Is the LORD's hand waxed short? thou shalt see now whether my word shall come to pass unto thee or not.
bsb_text: The LORD answered Moses, “Is the LORD’s arm too short? Now you will see whether or not My word will come to pass.”
aov_text: Maar die HERE sê vir Moses: Sou die hand van die HERE te kort wees? Nou sal jy sien of my woord vir jou uitkom of nie.

kjv_text: And Moses went out, and told the people the words of the LORD, and gathered the seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them round about the tabernacle.
bsb_text: So Moses went out and relayed to the people the words of the LORD, and he gathered seventy of the elders of the people and had them stand around the tent.
aov_text: Toe het Moses uitgegaan en die woorde van die HERE aan die volk te kenne gegee; en hy het sewentig manne uit die oudstes van die volk bymekaar laat kom en hulle rondom die tent laat staan.

kjv_text: And the LORD came down in a cloud, and spake unto him, and took of the spirit that was upon him, and gave it unto the seventy elders: and it came to pass, that, when the spirit rested upon them, they prophesied, and did not cease.
bsb_text: Then the LORD came down in the cloud and spoke to him, and He took some of the Spirit that was on Moses and placed that Spirit on the seventy elders. As the Spirit rested on them, they prophesied—but they never did so again.
aov_text: Daarop het die HERE neergedaal in die wolk en met hom gespreek; en Hy het van die Gees wat op hom was, afgesonder en op die sewentig oudstes gelê. En terwyl die Gees op hulle rus, het hulle geprofeteer; maar daarna nie meer nie.

kjv_text: But there remained two of the men in the camp, the name of the one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad: and the spirit rested upon them; and they were of them that were written, but went not out unto the tabernacle: and they prophesied in the camp.
bsb_text: Two men, however, had remained in the camp—one named Eldad and the other Medad—and the Spirit rested on them. They were among those listed, but they had not gone out to the tent, and they prophesied in the camp.
aov_text: Maar twee manne het in die laer agtergebly: die naam van die een was Eldad en die naam van die ander Medad; en die Gees het op hulle gerus—hulle het behoort by die wat opgeskrywe was, hoewel hulle nie na die tent uitgegaan het nie—en hulle het in die laer geprofeteer.

kjv_text: And there ran a young man, and told Moses, and said, Eldad and Medad do prophesy in the camp.
bsb_text: A young man ran and reported to Moses, “Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp.”
aov_text: Toe hardloop ’n seun en vertel dit aan Moses en sê: Eldad en Medad profeteer in die laer.

kjv_text: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his young men, answered and said, My lord Moses, forbid them.
bsb_text: Joshua son of Nun, the attendant to Moses since youth, spoke up and said, “Moses, my lord, stop them!”
aov_text: En Josua, die seun van Nun, die dienaar van Moses van sy jeug af, antwoord en sê: My heer Moses, belet hulle dit!

kjv_text: And Moses said unto him, Enviest thou for my sake? would God that all the LORD's people were prophets, and that the LORD would put his spirit upon them!
bsb_text: But Moses replied, “Are you jealous on my account? I wish that all the LORD’s people were prophets and that the LORD would place His Spirit on them!”
aov_text: Maar Moses sê vir hom: Ywer jy vir my? Ag, as die hele volk van die HERE maar profete was, dat die HERE sy Gees oor hulle mag gee!

kjv_text: And Moses gat him into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.
bsb_text: Then Moses returned to the camp, along with the elders of Israel.
aov_text: Daarop het Moses hom in die laer teruggetrek, hy en die oudstes van Israel.

kjv_text: And there went forth a wind from the LORD, and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, as it were a day's journey on this side, and as it were a day's journey on the other side, round about the camp, and as it were two cubits high upon the face of the earth.
bsb_text: Now a wind sent by the LORD came up, drove in quail from the sea, and brought them near the camp, about two cubits above the surface of the ground, for a day’s journey in every direction around the camp.
aov_text: Toe het ’n wind wat van die HERE kom, uitgevaar en kwartels van die see af oorgedrywe en op die laer gestrooi omtrent ’n dagreis hier en omtrent ’n dagreis daar, rondom die laer; en hulle was omtrent twee el bokant die grond.

kjv_text: And the people stood up all that day, and all that night, and all the next day, and they gathered the quails: he that gathered least gathered ten homers: and they spread them all abroad for themselves round about the camp.
bsb_text: All that day and night, and all the next day, the people stayed up gathering the quail. No one gathered less than ten homers, and they spread them out all around the camp.
aov_text: Toe het die volk opgestaan daardie hele dag en die hele nag en die hele volgende dag en die kwartels versamel. Hy wat die minste gehad het, het tien homer versamel. En hulle het dit oral vir hulle uitgesprei rondom die laer.

kjv_text: And while the flesh was yet between their teeth, ere it was chewed, the wrath of the LORD was kindled against the people, and the LORD smote the people with a very great plague.
bsb_text: But while the meat was still between their teeth, before it was chewed, the anger of the LORD burned against the people, and the LORD struck them with a severe plague.
aov_text: Die vleis was nog tussen hulle tande, voordat dit gekou was, toe die toorn van die HERE alreeds teen die volk ontvlam het, en die HERE het onder die volk ’n baie groot slagting teweeggebring.

kjv_text: And he called the name of that place Kibrothhattaavah: because there they buried the people that lusted.
bsb_text: So they called that place Kibroth-hattaavah, because there they buried the people who had craved other food.
aov_text: Daarom het hulle dié plek genoem Kibrot-Hattáäwa; want daar het hulle die volk begrawe wat so begerig was.

kjv_text: And the people journeyed from Kibrothhattaavah unto Hazeroth; and abode at Hazeroth.
bsb_text: From Kibroth-hattaavah the people moved on to Hazeroth, where they remained for some time.
aov_text: Van Kibrot-Hattáäwa af het die volk weggetrek na Háserot toe, en hulle het in Háserot gebly.

kjv_text: And Miriam and Aaron spake against Moses because of the Ethiopian woman whom he had married: for he had married an Ethiopian woman.
bsb_text: Then Miriam and Aaron criticized Moses because of the Cushite woman he had married, for he had taken a Cushite wife.
aov_text: EN Mirjam en Aäron het teen Moses gespreek vanweë die Kusitiese vrou wat hy geneem het; want hy het ’n Kusitiese vrou geneem.

kjv_text: And they said, Hath the LORD indeed spoken only by Moses? hath he not spoken also by us? And the LORD heard it.
bsb_text: “Does the LORD speak only through Moses?” they said. “Does He not also speak through us?” And the LORD heard this.
aov_text: En hulle het gesê: Het die HERE dan maar alleen met Moses gespreek? Het Hy nie ook met ons gespreek nie? En die HERE het dit gehoor.

kjv_text: (Now the man Moses was very meek, above all the men which were upon the face of the earth.)
bsb_text: Now Moses was a very humble man, more so than any man on the face of the earth.
aov_text: Maar die man Moses was baie sagmoedig, meer as al die mense op die aardbodem.

kjv_text: And the LORD spake suddenly unto Moses, and unto Aaron, and unto Miriam, Come out ye three unto the tabernacle of the congregation. And they three came out.
bsb_text: And suddenly the LORD said to Moses, Aaron, and Miriam, “You three, come out to the Tent of Meeting.” So the three went out,
aov_text: Toe het die HERE dadelik met Moses en Aäron en Mirjam gespreek: Julle drie, kom uit na die tent van samekoms! En hulle drie het uitgekom.

kjv_text: And the LORD came down in the pillar of the cloud, and stood in the door of the tabernacle, and called Aaron and Miriam: and they both came forth.
bsb_text: and the LORD came down in a pillar of cloud, stood at the entrance to the Tent, and summoned Aaron and Miriam. When both of them had stepped forward,
aov_text: En die HERE het in ’n wolkkolom neergedaal en by die ingang van die tent gaan staan. Daarna het Hy Aäron en Mirjam geroep, en hulle twee het uitgekom.

kjv_text: And he said, Hear now my words: If there be a prophet among you, I the LORD will make myself known unto him in a vision, and will speak unto him in a dream.
bsb_text: He said, “Hear now My words: If there is a prophet among you, I, the LORD, will reveal Myself to him in a vision; I will speak to him in a dream.
aov_text: Toe sê Hy: Hoor tog my woorde. As julle profeet van die HERE is, sal Ek deur ’n gesig My aan hom bekend maak, deur ’n droom sal Ek met hom spreek.

kjv_text: My servant Moses is not so, who is faithful in all mine house.
bsb_text: But this is not so with My servant Moses; he is faithful in all My house.
aov_text: So is dit nie met my kneg Moses nie: in my hele huis is hy getrou.

kjv_text: With him will I speak mouth to mouth, even apparently, and not in dark speeches; and the similitude of the LORD shall he behold: wherefore then were ye not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?
bsb_text: I speak with him face to face, clearly and not in riddles; he sees the form of the LORD. Why then were you unafraid to speak against My servant Moses?”
aov_text: Mond tot mond spreek Ek met hom, en deur aanskouing en nie deur duister woorde nie; en hy sien die verskyning van die HERE. Waarom het julle dan nie gevrees om teen my kneg, teen Moses, te spreek nie?

kjv_text: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against them; and he departed.
bsb_text: So the anger of the LORD burned against them, and He departed.
aov_text: En die toorn van die HERE het teen hulle ontvlam, en Hy het weggegaan.

kjv_text: And the cloud departed from off the tabernacle; and, behold, Miriam became leprous, white as snow: and Aaron looked upon Miriam, and, behold, she was leprous.
bsb_text: As the cloud lifted from above the Tent, suddenly Miriam became leprous, white as snow. Aaron turned toward her, saw that she was leprous,
aov_text: En toe die wolk van die tent af weggetrek het, kyk, toe was Mirjam melaats, soos sneeu. En Aäron het Mirjam aangekyk en—sy was melaats!

kjv_text: And Aaron said unto Moses, Alas, my lord, I beseech thee, lay not the sin upon us, wherein we have done foolishly, and wherein we have sinned.
bsb_text: and said to Moses, “My lord, please do not hold against us this sin we have so foolishly committed.
aov_text: Daarop sê Aäron vir Moses: Ag, my heer, lê tog nie op ons die sonde wat ons in ons dwaasheid begaan het nie.

kjv_text: Let her not be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he cometh out of his mother's womb.
bsb_text: Please do not let her be like a stillborn infant whose flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother’s womb.”
aov_text: Laat sy tog nie wees soos ’n dooie van wie se vleis, as hy uit sy moeder se skoot uitgaan, die helfte verteer is nie.

kjv_text: And Moses cried unto the LORD, saying, Heal her now, O God, I beseech thee.
bsb_text: So Moses cried out to the LORD, “O God, please heal her!”
aov_text: En Moses het die HERE aangeroep en gesê: o God, maak haar tog gesond!

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, If her father had but spit in her face, should she not be ashamed seven days? let her be shut out from the camp seven days, and after that let her be received in again.
bsb_text: But the LORD answered Moses, “If her father had but spit in her face, would she not have been in disgrace for seven days? Let her be confined outside the camp for seven days; after that she may be brought back in.”
aov_text: Toe sê die HERE vir Moses: As haar vader net maar in haar gesig gespuug het, sou sy nie sewe dae lank beskaamd wees nie? Laat sy sewe dae lank buitekant die laer opgesluit wees, en daarna mag sy opgeneem word.

kjv_text: And Miriam was shut out from the camp seven days: and the people journeyed not till Miriam was brought in again.
bsb_text: So Miriam was confined outside the camp for seven days, and the people did not move on until she was brought in again.
aov_text: En hulle het Mirjam sewe dae lank buitekant die laer opgesluit; en die volk het nie weggetrek voordat Mirjam opgeneem was nie.

kjv_text: And afterward the people removed from Hazeroth, and pitched in the wilderness of Paran.
bsb_text: After that, the people set out from Hazeroth and camped in the Wilderness of Paran.
aov_text: Maar daarna het die volk van Háserot af weggetrek en in die woestyn Paran laer opgeslaan.

kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
bsb_text: And the LORD said to Moses,
aov_text: EN die HERE het met Moses gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: Send thou men, that they may search the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel: of every tribe of their fathers shall ye send a man, every one a ruler among them.
bsb_text: “Send out for yourself men to spy out the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the Israelites. From each of their fathers’ tribes send one man who is a leader among them.”
aov_text: Stuur vir jou manne uit, dat hulle die land Kanaän wat Ek aan die kinders van Israel sal gee, kan verken. Van elke vaderlike stam moet julle een man stuur, elkeen ’n owerste onder hulle.

kjv_text: And Moses by the commandment of the LORD sent them from the wilderness of Paran: all those men were heads of the children of Israel.
bsb_text: So at the consent of the LORD, Moses sent them out from the Wilderness of Paran. All the men were leaders of the Israelites,
aov_text: En Moses het hulle uitgestuur uit die woestyn Paran, volgens die bevel van die HERE—hulle almal manne wat hoofde was van die kinders van Israel.

kjv_text: And these were their names: of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.
bsb_text: and these were their names: From the tribe of Reuben, Shammua son of Zaccur;
aov_text: En dit is hulle name: Van die stam van Ruben: Sámmua, die seun van Sakkur.

kjv_text: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.
bsb_text: from the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat son of Hori;
aov_text: Van die stam van Símeon: Safat, die seun van Hori.

kjv_text: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
bsb_text: from the tribe of Judah, Caleb son of Jephunneh;
aov_text: Van die stam van Juda: Kaleb, die seun van Jefúnne.

kjv_text: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.
bsb_text: from the tribe of Issachar, Igal son of Joseph;
aov_text: Van die stam van Íssaskar: Jígeal, die seun van Josef.

kjv_text: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Oshea the son of Nun.
bsb_text: from the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea son of Nun;
aov_text: Van die stam van Efraim: Hoséa, die seun van Nun.

kjv_text: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.
bsb_text: from the tribe of Benjamin, Palti son of Raphu;
aov_text: Van die stam van Benjamin: Palti, die seun van Rafu.

kjv_text: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.
bsb_text: from the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel son of Sodi;
aov_text: Van die stam van Sébulon: Gáddiël, die seun van Sodi.

kjv_text: Of the tribe of Joseph, namely, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.
bsb_text: from the tribe of Manasseh (a tribe of Joseph), Gaddi son of Susi;
aov_text: Van die stam van Josef, vir die stam van Manasse: Gaddi, die seun van Susi.

kjv_text: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.
bsb_text: from the tribe of Dan, Ammiel son of Gemalli;
aov_text: Van die stam van Dan: Ammíël, die seun van Gemálli.

kjv_text: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.
bsb_text: from the tribe of Asher, Sethur son of Michael;
aov_text: Van die stam van Aser: Setur, die seun van Mígael.

kjv_text: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.
bsb_text: from the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi son of Vophsi;
aov_text: Van die stam van Náftali: Nagbi, die seun van Wofsi.

kjv_text: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.
bsb_text: and from the tribe of Gad, Geuel son of Machi.
aov_text: Van die stam van Gad: Géhuel, die seun van Magi.

kjv_text: These are the names of the men which Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Oshea the son of Nun Jehoshua.
bsb_text: These were the names of the men Moses sent to spy out the land; and Moses gave to Hoshea son of Nun the name Joshua.
aov_text: Dit is die name van die manne wat Moses gestuur het om die land te verken; en Moses het Hoséa, die seun van Nun, Josua genoem.

kjv_text: And Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said unto them, Get you up this way southward, and go up into the mountain:
bsb_text: When Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, he told them, “Go up through the Negev and into the hill country.
aov_text: En Moses het hulle gestuur om die land Kanaän te verken en vir hulle gesê: Trek hier in die Suidland op en beklim die gebergte.

kjv_text: And see the land, what it is; and the people that dwelleth therein, whether they be strong or weak, few or many;
bsb_text: See what the land is like and whether its people are strong or weak, few or many.
aov_text: En bekyk die land, hoe dit is, en die volk wat daarin woon, of dit sterk of swak, of dit min of baie is;

kjv_text: And what the land is that they dwell in, whether it be good or bad; and what cities they be that they dwell in, whether in tents, or in strong holds;
bsb_text: Is the land where they live good or bad? Are the cities where they dwell open camps or fortifications?
aov_text: en hoe die land is waar hulle in woon, of dit goed of sleg is; en hoe die stede is waar hulle in woon, laers of vestings;

kjv_text: And what the land is, whether it be fat or lean, whether there be wood therein, or not. And be ye of good courage, and bring of the fruit of the land. Now the time was the time of the firstripe grapes.
bsb_text: Is the soil fertile or unproductive? Are there trees in it or not? Be courageous, and bring back some of the fruit of the land.” (It was the season for the first ripe grapes.)
aov_text: ook hoe die land is, of dit vet of skraal is, of daar bome in is of nie; en wees dapper en bring van die vrugte van die land saam. Dit was toe die tyd van die eerste druiwe.

kjv_text: So they went up, and searched the land from the wilderness of Zin unto Rehob, as men come to Hamath.
bsb_text: So they went up and spied out the land from the Wilderness of Zin as far as Rehob, toward Lebo-hamath.
aov_text: En hulle het opgetrek en die land verken van die woestyn Sin af tot by Rehob, na die ingang van Hammat —

kjv_text: And they ascended by the south, and came unto Hebron; where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
bsb_text: They went up through the Negev and came to Hebron, where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the descendants of Anak, dwelled. It had been built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.
aov_text: hulle het in die Suidland opgetrek en tot by Hebron gekom; en daar was Ahíman, Sesai en Talmai, die kinders van die Enakiete. En Hebron is sewe jaar voor Soan in Egipte gebou.

kjv_text: And they came unto the brook of Eshcol, and cut down from thence a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bare it between two upon a staff; and they brought of the pomegranates, and of the figs.
bsb_text: When they came to the Valley of Eshcol, they cut down a branch with a single cluster of grapes, which they carried on a pole between two men. They also took some pomegranates and figs.
aov_text: Daarop het hulle tot by die dal Eskol gekom en daar ’n rank met een tros druiwe afgesny, en twee het dit aan ’n draagstok gedra; ook van die granate en van die vye.

kjv_text: The place was called the brook Eshcol, because of the cluster of grapes which the children of Israel cut down from thence.
bsb_text: Because of the cluster of grapes the Israelites cut there, that place was called the Valley of Eshcol.
