kjv_text: For I will promote thee unto very great honour, and I will do whatsoever thou sayest unto me: come therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people.
bsb_text: for I will honor you richly and do whatever you say. So please come and put a curse on this people for me!’”
aov_text: Want ek sal jou baie hoog vereer en alles wat jy my sê, sal ek doen; daarom kom tog, vervloek hierdie volk vir my.

kjv_text: And Balaam answered and said unto the servants of Balak, If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the word of the LORD my God, to do less or more.
bsb_text: But Balaam replied to the servants of Balak, “If Balak were to give me his house full of silver and gold, I could not do anything small or great to go beyond the command of the LORD my God.
aov_text: Toe antwoord Bíleam en sê aan die dienaars van Balak: Al gee Balak my sy huis vol silwer en goud, ek kan die bevel van die HERE my God nie oortree om klein of groot te doen nie.

kjv_text: Now therefore, I pray you, tarry ye also here this night, that I may know what the LORD will say unto me more.
bsb_text: So now, please stay here overnight as the others did, that I may find out what else the LORD has to tell me.”
aov_text: Nou dan, bly julle tog ook vannag hier, dat ek mag weet wat die HERE verder aan my sal sê.

kjv_text: And God came unto Balaam at night, and said unto him, If the men come to call thee, rise up, and go with them; but yet the word which I shall say unto thee, that shalt thou do.
bsb_text: That night God came to Balaam and said, “Since these men have come to summon you, get up and go with them, but you must only do what I tell you.”
aov_text: En God het in die nag na Bíleam gekom en aan hom gesê: As die manne gekom het om jou te roep, staan dan op, gaan met hulle saam; maar net wat Ek jou sê, dit moet jy doen.

kjv_text: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his ass, and went with the princes of Moab.
bsb_text: So in the morning Balaam got up, saddled his donkey, and went with the princes of Moab.
aov_text: Toe maak Bíleam die môre klaar en saal sy eselin op, en hy het weggetrek saam met die vorste van Moab.

kjv_text: And God's anger was kindled because he went: and the angel of the LORD stood in the way for an adversary against him. Now he was riding upon his ass, and his two servants were with him.
bsb_text: Then God’s anger was kindled because Balaam was going along, and the angel of the LORD stood in the road to oppose him. Balaam was riding his donkey, and his two servants were with him.
aov_text: Maar die toorn van God het ontvlam, omdat hy weggetrek het; en die Engel van die HERE het gaan staan in die pad as sy teëparty, terwyl hy op sy esel ry en sy twee dienaars by hom was.

kjv_text: And the ass saw the angel of the LORD standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and the ass turned aside out of the way, and went into the field: and Balaam smote the ass, to turn her into the way.
bsb_text: When the donkey saw the angel of the LORD standing in the road with a drawn sword in his hand, she turned off the path and went into a field. So Balaam beat her to return her to the path.
aov_text: En die esel het die Engel van die HERE in die pad sien staan, met sy ontblote swaard in sy hand; daarom het die esel uit die pad uitgedraai en die veld ingeloop. Maar Bíleam het die esel geslaan om haar na die pad te stuur.

kjv_text: But the angel of the LORD stood in a path of the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.
bsb_text: Then the angel of the LORD stood in a narrow passage between two vineyards, with walls on either side.
aov_text: Daarom gaan die Engel van die HERE in ’n hol pad tussen die wingerde staan—’n muur duskant en ’n muur anderkant.

kjv_text: And when the ass saw the angel of the LORD, she thrust herself unto the wall, and crushed Balaam's foot against the wall: and he smote her again.
bsb_text: And the donkey saw the angel of the LORD and pressed herself against the wall, crushing Balaam’s foot against it. So he beat her once again.
aov_text: En toe die esel die Engel van die HERE sien, druk sy haarself teen die muur en druk ook Bíleam se voet teen die muur; daarom het hy haar weer geslaan.

kjv_text: And the angel of the LORD went further, and stood in a narrow place, where was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.
bsb_text: And the angel of the LORD moved on ahead and stood in a narrow place where there was no room to turn to the right or left.
aov_text: En die Engel van die HERE het weer verder gegaan en bly staan op ’n nou plek waar geen pad was om regs of links uit te draai nie.

kjv_text: And when the ass saw the angel of the LORD, she fell down under Balaam: and Balaam's anger was kindled, and he smote the ass with a staff.
bsb_text: When the donkey saw the angel of the LORD, she lay down under Balaam, and he became furious and beat her with his staff.
aov_text: Toe die esel die Engel van die HERE sien, gaan sy onder Bíleam lê. Daarop het Bíleam baie kwaad geword en die esel met ’n stok geslaan.

kjv_text: And the LORD opened the mouth of the ass, and she said unto Balaam, What have I done unto thee, that thou hast smitten me these three times?
bsb_text: Then the LORD opened the donkey’s mouth, and she said to Balaam, “What have I done to you that you have beaten me these three times?”
aov_text: Maar die HERE het die bek van die esel geopen, en sy sê vir Bíleam: Wat het ek jou gedoen, dat jy my nou al drie maal geslaan het?

kjv_text: And Balaam said unto the ass, Because thou hast mocked me: I would there were a sword in mine hand, for now would I kill thee.
bsb_text: Balaam answered the donkey, “You have made a fool of me! If I had a sword in my hand, I would kill you right now!”
aov_text: Daarop antwoord Bíleam die esel: Omdat jy die spot met my drywe. Was daar net ’n swaard in my hand—dan het ek jou sekerlik doodgeslaan.

kjv_text: And the ass said unto Balaam, Am not I thine ass, upon which thou hast ridden ever since I was thine unto this day? was I ever wont to do so unto thee? And he said, Nay.
bsb_text: But the donkey said to Balaam, “Am I not the donkey you have ridden all your life until today? Have I ever treated you this way before?” “No,” he replied.
aov_text: En die esel sê vir Bíleam: Is ek nie jou esel waar jy jou lewe lank op gery het tot vandag toe nie? Was dit ooit my gewoonte om so met jou te doen? En hy antwoord: Nee.

kjv_text: Then the LORD opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the angel of the LORD standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and he bowed down his head, and fell flat on his face.
bsb_text: Then the LORD opened Balaam’s eyes, and he saw the angel of the LORD standing in the road with a drawn sword in his hand. And Balaam bowed low and fell facedown.
aov_text: Toe open die HERE die oë van Bíleam, sodat hy die Engel van die HERE in die pad sien staan met sy ontblote swaard in sy hand, en hy het gebuig en op sy aangesig neergeval.

kjv_text: And the angel of the LORD said unto him, Wherefore hast thou smitten thine ass these three times? behold, I went out to withstand thee, because thy way is perverse before me:
bsb_text: The angel of the LORD asked him, “Why have you beaten your donkey these three times? Behold, I have come out to oppose you, because your way is perverse before me.
aov_text: En die Engel van die HERE vra hom: Waarom het jy jou esel nou al drie maal geslaan? Kyk, Ek self het uitgegaan as ’n teëparty, want jou weg loop gevaarlik steil in my oog!

kjv_text: And the ass saw me, and turned from me these three times: unless she had turned from me, surely now also I had slain thee, and saved her alive.
bsb_text: The donkey saw me and turned away from me these three times. If she had not turned away, then by now I would surely have killed you and let her live.”
aov_text: Maar die esel het My gesien en nou al drie maal voor My uitgedraai. As sy nie voor My uitgedraai het nie—dan het Ek jou alte seker gedood en haar laat lewe.

kjv_text: And Balaam said unto the angel of the LORD, I have sinned; for I knew not that thou stoodest in the way against me: now therefore, if it displease thee, I will get me back again.
bsb_text: “I have sinned,” Balaam said to the angel of the LORD, “for I did not realize that you were standing in the road to confront me. And now, if this is displeasing in your sight, I will go back home.”
aov_text: Toe antwoord Bíleam die Engel van die HERE: Ek het gesondig, want ek het nie geweet dat U teenoor my in die pad gestaan het nie. Maar nou, as dit verkeerd is in u oë, sal ek teruggaan.

kjv_text: And the angel of the LORD said unto Balaam, Go with the men: but only the word that I shall speak unto thee, that thou shalt speak. So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.
bsb_text: But the angel of the LORD said to Balaam, “Go with the men, but you are to speak only what I tell you.” So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.
aov_text: En die Engel van die HERE sê vir Bíleam: Gaan saam met die manne, maar net die woord wat Ek jou sê, dit moet jy spreek. So het Bíleam dan met die vorste van Balak saamgegaan.

kjv_text: And when Balak heard that Balaam was come, he went out to meet him unto a city of Moab, which is in the border of Arnon, which is in the utmost coast.
bsb_text: When Balak heard that Balaam was coming, he went out to meet him at the Moabite city on the Arnon border, at the edge of his territory.
aov_text: Toe Balak hoor dat Bíleam kom, het hy uitgetrek hom tegemoet na Ir-Moab wat by die grens van die Arnon lê, by die uiteinde van die grondgebied.

kjv_text: And Balak said unto Balaam, Did I not earnestly send unto thee to call thee? wherefore camest thou not unto me? am I not able indeed to promote thee to honour?
bsb_text: And he said to Balaam, “Did I not send you an urgent summons? Why did you not come to me? Am I really not able to richly reward you?”
aov_text: En Balak sê vir Bíleam: Het ek nie herhaaldelik na jou gestuur om jou te laat roep nie? Waarom het jy nie na my gekom nie? Is ek werklik nie in staat om jou te vereer nie?

kjv_text: And Balaam said unto Balak, Lo, I am come unto thee: have I now any power at all to say any thing? the word that God putteth in my mouth, that shall I speak.
bsb_text: “See, I have come to you,” Balaam replied, “but can I say just anything? I must speak only the word that God puts in my mouth.”
aov_text: En Bíleam het Balak geantwoord: Hier het ek na jou gekom. Is ek nou wel in staat om iets te spreek? Die woord wat God in my mond lê, dit sal ek spreek.

kjv_text: And Balaam went with Balak, and they came unto Kirjathhuzoth.
bsb_text: So Balaam accompanied Balak, and they came to Kiriath-huzoth.
aov_text: Bíleam het toe saam met Balak gegaan, en hulle het by Kirjat-Husot gekom.

kjv_text: And Balak offered oxen and sheep, and sent to Balaam, and to the princes that were with him.
bsb_text: Balak sacrificed cattle and sheep, and he gave portions to Balaam and the princes who were with him.
aov_text: En Balak het beeste en kleinvee geoffer en daarvan aan Bíleam gestuur en aan die vorste wat by hom was.

kjv_text: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Balak took Balaam, and brought him up into the high places of Baal, that thence he might see the utmost part of the people.
bsb_text: The next morning, Balak took Balaam and brought him up to Bamoth-baal. From there he could see the outskirts of the camp of the people.
aov_text: En in die môre het Balak Bíleam geneem en hom op die hoogtes van Baäl laat opklim vanwaar hy die kant van die volk kon sien.

kjv_text: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven oxen and seven rams.
bsb_text: Then Balaam said to Balak, “Build for me seven altars here, and prepare for me seven bulls and seven rams.”
aov_text: TOE sê Bíleam vir Balak: Bou vir my hier sewe altare en berei vir my hier sewe bulle en sewe ramme.

kjv_text: And Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bullock and a ram.
bsb_text: So Balak did as Balaam had instructed, and Balak and Balaam offered a bull and a ram on each altar.
aov_text: En Balak het gedoen soos Bíleam verlang het; en Balak en Bíleam het ’n bul en ’n ram op elke altaar geoffer.

kjv_text: And Balaam said unto Balak, Stand by thy burnt offering, and I will go: peradventure the LORD will come to meet me: and whatsoever he sheweth me I will tell thee. And he went to an high place.
bsb_text: “Stay here by your burnt offering while I am gone,” Balaam said to Balak. “Perhaps the LORD will meet with me. And whatever He reveals to me, I will tell you.” So Balaam went off to a barren height,
aov_text: Daarop sê Bíleam vir Balak: Bly by jou brandoffer staan, en ek sal heengaan; miskien sal die HERE my tegemoetkom, en wat Hy my ook al laat sien, sal ek jou bekend maak. En hy het na ’n kaal heuwel gegaan.

kjv_text: And God met Balaam: and he said unto him, I have prepared seven altars, and I have offered upon every altar a bullock and a ram.
bsb_text: and God met with him. “I have set up seven altars,” Balaam said, “and on each altar I have offered a bull and a ram.”
aov_text: En God het Bíleam tegemoetgekom, en hy het vir Hom gesê: Sewe altare het ek reggemaak en ’n bul en ’n ram op elke altaar geoffer.

kjv_text: And the LORD put a word in Balaam's mouth, and said, Return unto Balak, and thus thou shalt speak.
bsb_text: Then the LORD put a message in Balaam’s mouth, saying, “Return to Balak and give him this message.”
aov_text: Toe lê die HERE ’n woord in Bíleam se mond en sê: Gaan terug na Balak, en so moet jy spreek.

kjv_text: And he returned unto him, and, lo, he stood by his burnt sacrifice, he, and all the princes of Moab.
bsb_text: So he returned to Balak, who was standing there beside his burnt offering, with all the princes of Moab.
aov_text: En hy het na hom teruggegaan terwyl hy daar staan by sy brandoffer, hy en al die vorste van Moab.

kjv_text: And he took up his parable, and said, Balak the king of Moab hath brought me from Aram, out of the mountains of the east, saying, Come, curse me Jacob, and come, defy Israel.
bsb_text: And Balaam lifted up an oracle, saying: “Balak brought me from Aram, the king of Moab from the mountains of the east. ‘Come,’ he said, ‘put a curse on Jacob for me; come and denounce Israel!’
aov_text: En hy het sy spreuk aangehef en gesê: Uit Aram laat Balak my haal, die koning van Moab—uit die berge van die Ooste: Kom vervloek Jakob vir my, en kom, verwens Israel.

kjv_text: How shall I curse, whom God hath not cursed? or how shall I defy, whom the LORD hath not defied?
bsb_text: How can I curse what God has not cursed? How can I denounce what the LORD has not denounced?
aov_text: Hoe sal ek vloek wie Gód nie vloek nie? En hoe sal ek verwens vir wie die HERE nie verwens nie?

kjv_text: For from the top of the rocks I see him, and from the hills I behold him: lo, the people shall dwell alone, and shall not be reckoned among the nations.
bsb_text: For I see them from atop the rocky cliffs, and I watch them from the hills. Behold, a people dwelling apart, not reckoning themselves among the nations.
aov_text: Want van die top van die rotse af sien ek hom, en van die heuwels af aanskou ek hom. Kyk, ’n volk wat afgesonderd woon en hom nie tot die nasies reken nie.

kjv_text: Who can count the dust of Jacob, and the number of the fourth part of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous, and let my last end be like his!
bsb_text: Who can count the dust of Jacob or number even a fourth of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous; let my end be like theirs!”
aov_text: Wie het die stof van Jakob getel? En wie, volgens getal, die vierde deel van Israel? Laat my sterwe die dood van die opregtes, en laat my einde soos syne wees!

kjv_text: And Balak said unto Balaam, What hast thou done unto me? I took thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast blessed them altogether.
bsb_text: Then Balak said to Balaam, “What have you done to me? I brought you here to curse my enemies, and behold, you have only blessed them!”
aov_text: Toe sê Balak vir Bíleam: Wat het jy my aangedoen? Ek het jou laat haal om my vyande te vloek, en kyk, jy het net geseën!

kjv_text: And he answered and said, Must I not take heed to speak that which the LORD hath put in my mouth?
bsb_text: But Balaam replied, “Should I not speak exactly what the LORD puts in my mouth?”
aov_text: En hy antwoord daarop dít: Moet ek dan nie sorgvuldig alles spreek wat die HERE in my mond lê nie?

kjv_text: And Balak said unto him, Come, I pray thee, with me unto another place, from whence thou mayest see them: thou shalt see but the utmost part of them, and shalt not see them all: and curse me them from thence.
bsb_text: Then Balak said to him, “Please come with me to another place where you can see them. You will only see the outskirts of their camp—not all of them. And from there, curse them for me.”
aov_text: Daarop sê Balak vir hom: Kom tog saam met my na ’n ander plek vanwaar jy hom kan sien—net sy kant sal jy sien, maar heeltemal kan jy hom nie sien nie—en vervloek hom daarvandaan vir my.

kjv_text: And he brought him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar.
bsb_text: So Balak took him to the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, where he built seven altars and offered a bull and a ram on each altar.
aov_text: En hy het hom saamgeneem na die Veld van die Wagte, op die top van Pisga, en sewe altare gebou en ’n bul en ’n ram op elke altaar geoffer.

kjv_text: And he said unto Balak, Stand here by thy burnt offering, while I meet the LORD yonder.
bsb_text: Balaam said to Balak, “Stay here beside your burnt offering while I meet the LORD over there.”
aov_text: Toe sê hy vir Balak: Bly hier staan by jou brandoffer, en ek sal daar op ’n ontmoeting wag.

kjv_text: And the LORD met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, Go again unto Balak, and say thus.
bsb_text: And the LORD met with Balaam and put a message in his mouth, saying, “Return to Balak and speak what I tell you.”
aov_text: En die HERE het Bíleam ontmoet en ’n woord in sy mond gelê en gesê: Gaan terug na Balak, en so moet jy spreek.

kjv_text: And when he came to him, behold, he stood by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. And Balak said unto him, What hath the LORD spoken?
bsb_text: So he returned to Balak, who was standing there by his burnt offering with the princes of Moab. “What did the LORD say?” Balak asked.
aov_text: En hy het by hom gekom terwyl hy daar staan by sy brandoffer, en die vorste van Moab by hom. En Balak sê vir hom: Wat het die HERE gespreek?

kjv_text: And he took up his parable, and said, Rise up, Balak, and hear; hearken unto me, thou son of Zippor:
bsb_text: Then Balaam lifted up an oracle, saying: “Arise, O Balak, and listen; give ear to me, O son of Zippor.
aov_text: Toe hef hy sy spreuk aan en sê: Staan op, Balak, en hoor! Luister na my, seun van Sippor!

kjv_text: God is not a man, that he should lie; neither the son of man, that he should repent: hath he said, and shall he not do it? or hath he spoken, and shall he not make it good?
bsb_text: God is not a man, that He should lie, or a son of man, that He should change His mind. Does He speak and not act? Does He promise and not fulfill?
aov_text: God is geen man dat Hy sou lieg nie; of ’n mensekind dat dit Hom sou berou nie. Sou Hý iets sê en dit nie doen nie, of spreek en dit nie waar maak nie?

kjv_text: Behold, I have received commandment to bless: and he hath blessed; and I cannot reverse it.
bsb_text: I have indeed received a command to bless; He has blessed, and I cannot change it.
aov_text: Kyk, ek het ontvang om te seën; en het Hy geseën, dan kan ek dit nie keer nie.

kjv_text: He hath not beheld iniquity in Jacob, neither hath he seen perverseness in Israel: the LORD his God is with him, and the shout of a king is among them.
bsb_text: He considers no disaster for Jacob; He sees no trouble for Israel. The LORD their God is with them, and the shout of the King is among them.
aov_text: ’n Mens aanskou geen ongeregtigheid in Jakob en sien geen onheil in Israel nie. Die HERE sy God is met hom, en die gejubel tot eer van die Koning is by hom.

kjv_text: God brought them out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn.
bsb_text: God brought them out of Egypt with strength like a wild ox.
aov_text: God wat hulle uit Egipte uitgelei het, is vir hulle soos die horings van ’n buffel.

kjv_text: Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel: according to this time it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, What hath God wrought!
bsb_text: For there is no spell against Jacob and no divination against Israel. It will now be said of Jacob and Israel, ‘What great things God has done!’
aov_text: Want daar is geen towery teen Jakob of waarsêery teen Israel nie. Nou sal van Jakob en van Israel gesê word wat God gedoen het.

kjv_text: Behold, the people shall rise up as a great lion, and lift up himself as a young lion: he shall not lie down until he eat of the prey, and drink the blood of the slain.
bsb_text: Behold, the people rise like a lioness; they rouse themselves like a lion, not resting until they devour their prey and drink the blood of the slain.”
aov_text: Kyk, ’n volk wat opstaan soos ’n leeuin, en soos ’n leeu verhef hy hom. Hy gaan nie lê voordat hy roof eet en die bloed van die wat verslaan is, drink nie.

kjv_text: And Balak said unto Balaam, Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.
bsb_text: Now Balak said to Balaam, “Then neither curse them at all nor bless them at all!”
aov_text: Toe sê Balak vir Bíleam: Jy moet hulle glad nie vloek nie, en jy moet hulle glad nie seën nie.

kjv_text: But Balaam answered and said unto Balak, Told not I thee, saying, All that the LORD speaketh, that I must do?
bsb_text: But Balaam replied, “Did I not tell you that whatever the LORD says, I must do?”
aov_text: Maar Bíleam antwoord en sê vir Balak: Het ek nie dit met jou gespreek nie: Alles wat die HERE spreek, dit sal ek doen?

kjv_text: And Balak said unto Balaam, Come, I pray thee, I will bring thee unto another place; peradventure it will please God that thou mayest curse me them from thence.
bsb_text: “Please come,” said Balak, “I will take you to another place. Perhaps it will please God that you curse them for me from there.”
aov_text: Verder sê Balak vir Bíleam: Kom tog, ek sal jou na ’n ander plek saamneem; miskien sal dit reg wees in die oë van God dat jy hulle vir my daarvandaan vervloek.

kjv_text: And Balak brought Balaam unto the top of Peor, that looketh toward Jeshimon.
bsb_text: And Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, which overlooks the wasteland.
aov_text: Toe neem Balak Bíleam saam na die top van Peor wat oor die wildernis afkyk.

kjv_text: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bullocks and seven rams.
bsb_text: Then Balaam said, “Build for me seven altars here, and prepare for me seven bulls and seven rams.”
aov_text: Daarop sê Bíleam vir Balak: Bou vir my hier sewe altare, en berei vir my hier sewe bulle en sewe ramme.

kjv_text: And Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar.
bsb_text: So Balak did as Balaam had instructed, and he offered a bull and a ram on each altar.
aov_text: En Balak het gedoen soos Bíleam verlang het en ’n bul en ’n ram op elke altaar geoffer.

kjv_text: And when Balaam saw that it pleased the LORD to bless Israel, he went not, as at other times, to seek for enchantments, but he set his face toward the wilderness.
bsb_text: And when Balaam saw that it pleased the LORD to bless Israel, he did not resort to sorcery as on previous occasions, but he turned his face toward the wilderness.
aov_text: TOE Bíleam sien dat dit goed was in die oë van die HERE om Israel te seën, het hy hom nie soos die vorige kere tot towery gewend nie, maar sy gesig na die woestyn gedraai.

kjv_text: And Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel abiding in his tents according to their tribes; and the spirit of God came upon him.
bsb_text: When Balaam looked up and saw Israel encamped tribe by tribe, the Spirit of God came upon him,
aov_text: Toe Bíleam sy oë opslaan en Israel sien soos hy volgens sy stamme in die laer staan, het die Gees van God op hom gekom.

kjv_text: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, and the man whose eyes are open hath said:
bsb_text: and he lifted up an oracle, saying: “This is the prophecy of Balaam son of Beor, the prophecy of a man whose eyes are open,
aov_text: En hy het sy spreuk aangehef en gesê: Bíleam, die seun van Beor, spreek, en die man met geopende oog spreek.

kjv_text: He hath said, which heard the words of God, which saw the vision of the Almighty, falling into a trance, but having his eyes open:
bsb_text: the prophecy of one who hears the words of God, who sees a vision from the Almighty, who bows down with eyes wide open:
aov_text: Die hoorder van die woorde van God spreek, hy wat die gesigte van die Almagtige sien, wat neerval en geopende oë het.

kjv_text: How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob, and thy tabernacles, O Israel!
bsb_text: How lovely are your tents, O Jacob, your dwellings, O Israel!
aov_text: Hoe mooi is jou tente, o Jakob, jou wonings, o Israel!

kjv_text: As the valleys are they spread forth, as gardens by the river's side, as the trees of lign aloes which the LORD hath planted, and as cedar trees beside the waters.
bsb_text: They spread out like palm groves, like gardens beside a stream, like aloes the LORD has planted, like cedars beside the waters.
aov_text: Soos dale met waterlope wat hulle ver uitstrek, soos tuine by ’n rivier, soos alewees wat die HERE geplant het, soos seders by die water.

kjv_text: He shall pour the water out of his buckets, and his seed shall be in many waters, and his king shall be higher than Agag, and his kingdom shall be exalted.
bsb_text: Water will flow from his buckets, and his seed will have abundant water. His king will be greater than Agag, and his kingdom will be exalted.
aov_text: Water vloei uit sy emmers, en sy saad is by baie waters. En laat sy koning hoër wees as Agag, en sy koninkryk hom verhef!

kjv_text: God brought him forth out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn: he shall eat up the nations his enemies, and shall break their bones, and pierce them through with his arrows.
bsb_text: God brought him out of Egypt with strength like a wild ox, to devour hostile nations and crush their bones, to pierce them with arrows.
aov_text: God wat hom uit Egipte uitgelei het, is vir hom soos die horings van ’n buffel; hy sal nasies, sy vyande, verteer en hulle gebeente stukkend breek en met sy pyle verbrysel.

kjv_text: He couched, he lay down as a lion, and as a great lion: who shall stir him up? Blessed is he that blesseth thee, and cursed is he that curseth thee.
bsb_text: He crouches, he lies down like a lion; like a lioness, who dares to rouse him? Blessed are those who bless you and cursed are those who curse you.”
aov_text: Hy buig hom, hy gaan lê soos ’n leeu en soos ’n leeuin: wie sal hom opjaag? Geseënd is hulle wat jou seën, en vervloek is hulle wat jou vervloek!

kjv_text: And Balak's anger was kindled against Balaam, and he smote his hands together: and Balak said unto Balaam, I called thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast altogether blessed them these three times.
bsb_text: Then Balak’s anger burned against Balaam, and he struck his hands together and said to Balaam, “I summoned you to curse my enemies, but behold, you have persisted in blessing them these three times.
aov_text: Toe het Balak baie kwaad geword vir Bíleam en sy hande saamgeslaan, en Balak het aan Bíleam gesê: Ek het jou laat roep om my vyande te vloek, en kyk, jy het nou al drie maal net geseën!

kjv_text: Therefore now flee thou to thy place: I thought to promote thee unto great honour; but, lo, the LORD hath kept thee back from honour.
bsb_text: Therefore, flee at once to your home! I said I would richly reward you, but instead the LORD has denied your reward.”
aov_text: Trek dan nou gou na jou woonplek! Ek het gesê dat ek jou hoog sal vereer; maar kyk, die HERE het jou van verering teruggehou.

kjv_text: And Balaam said unto Balak, Spake I not also to thy messengers which thou sentest unto me, saying,
bsb_text: Balaam answered Balak, “Did I not already tell the messengers you sent me
aov_text: Toe het Bíleam vir Balak gesê: Het ek nie alreeds met jou boodskappers wat jy na my gestuur het, gespreek en gesê nie:

kjv_text: If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the commandment of the LORD, to do either good or bad of mine own mind; but what the LORD saith, that will I speak?
bsb_text: that even if Balak were to give me his house full of silver and gold, I could not do anything of my own accord, good or bad, to go beyond the command of the LORD? I will speak whatever the LORD says.
aov_text: Al gee Balak my sy huis vol silwer en goud, ek kan die bevel van die HERE nie oortree om goed of kwaad uit my eie hart te doen nie; wat die HERE spreek, dit sal ek spreek.

kjv_text: And now, behold, I go unto my people: come therefore, and I will advertise thee what this people shall do to thy people in the latter days.
bsb_text: Now I am going back to my people, but come, let me warn you what this people will do to your people in the days to come.”
aov_text: En nou, kyk, ek gaan na my volk toe. Kom, ek sal jou inligting gee, wat hierdie volk jou volk sal aandoen aan die einde van die dae.

kjv_text: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, and the man whose eyes are open hath said:
bsb_text: Then Balaam lifted up an oracle, saying, “This is the prophecy of Balaam son of Beor, the prophecy of a man whose eyes are open,
aov_text: Toe het hy sy spreuk aangehef en gesê: Bíleam, die seun van Beor, spreek, en die man met geopende oog spreek.

kjv_text: He hath said, which heard the words of God, and knew the knowledge of the most High, which saw the vision of the Almighty, falling into a trance, but having his eyes open:
bsb_text: the prophecy of one who hears the words of God, who has knowledge from the Most High, who sees a vision from the Almighty, who bows down with eyes wide open:
aov_text: Die hoorder van die woorde van God spreek, en hy wat die wetenskap van die Allerhoogste ken, wat die gesigte van die Almagtige sien, wat neerval en geopende oë het.

kjv_text: I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel, and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.
bsb_text: I see him, but not now; I behold him, but not near. A star will come forth from Jacob, and a scepter will arise from Israel. He will crush the skulls of Moab and strike down all the sons of Sheth.
aov_text: Ek sien hom, maar nie nou nie, ek aanskou hom, maar nie naby nie; ’n ster kom te voorskyn uit Jakob, en ’n septer kom uit Israel op, en hy verbrysel die slape van die hoof van Moab en werp al die oorlogsugtiges omver.

kjv_text: And Edom shall be a possession, Seir also shall be a possession for his enemies; and Israel shall do valiantly.
bsb_text: Edom will become a possession, as will Seir, his enemy; but Israel will perform with valor.
aov_text: Ook sal Edom ’n besitting wees; en Seïr, sy vyande, sal ’n besitting wees, maar Israel neem toe in krag.

kjv_text: Out of Jacob shall come he that shall have dominion, and shall destroy him that remaineth of the city.
bsb_text: A ruler will come from Jacob and destroy the survivors of the city.”
aov_text: En laat daar een uit Jakob heers en die vrygeraaktes uit die stede vernietig.

kjv_text: And when he looked on Amalek, he took up his parable, and said, Amalek was the first of the nations; but his latter end shall be that he perish for ever.
bsb_text: Then Balaam saw Amalek and lifted up an oracle, saying: “Amalek was first among the nations, but his end is destruction.”
aov_text: Toe hy Ámalek sien, het hy sy spreuk aangehef en gesê: Ámalek is die eersteling van die heidene, maar sy einde is ondergang.

kjv_text: And he looked on the Kenites, and took up his parable, and said, Strong is thy dwellingplace, and thou puttest thy nest in a rock.
bsb_text: Next he saw the Kenites and lifted up an oracle, saying: “Your dwelling place is secure, and your nest is set in a cliff.
aov_text: Toe hy die Keniete sien, het hy sy spreuk aangehef en gesê: Jou woonplek is vas, en jou nes is gebou op die rots.

kjv_text: Nevertheless the Kenite shall be wasted, until Asshur shall carry thee away captive.
bsb_text: Yet Kain will be destroyed when Asshur takes you captive.”
aov_text: Ewenwel sal Kain tot verwoesting wees. Hoe lank nog? Assur sal jou as gevangene wegvoer.

kjv_text: And he took up his parable, and said, Alas, who shall live when God doeth this!
bsb_text: Once more Balaam lifted up an oracle, saying: “Ah, who can live unless God has ordained it?
aov_text: Verder het hy sy spreuk aangehef en gesê: Wee, wie sal lewe as God dít beskik?

kjv_text: And ships shall come from the coast of Chittim, and shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber, and he also shall perish for ever.
bsb_text: Ships will come from the coasts of Cyprus; they will subdue Asshur and Eber, but they too will perish forever.”
aov_text: En skepe kom van die kant van die Kittiërs af, en hulle verneder Assur en hulle verneder Heber; en hy is ook tot ondergang bestem.

kjv_text: And Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place: and Balak also went his way.
bsb_text: Then Balaam arose and returned to his homeland, and Balak also went on his way.
aov_text: Toe het Bíleam hom klaargemaak en weggetrek en na sy woonplek teruggekeer. En Balak het ook sy koers gegaan.

kjv_text: And Israel abode in Shittim, and the people began to commit whoredom with the daughters of Moab.
bsb_text: While Israel was staying in Shittim, the men began to indulge in sexual immorality with the daughters of Moab,
aov_text: TOE Israel in Sittim gebly het, het die volk begin hoereer met die dogters van die Moabiete —

kjv_text: And they called the people unto the sacrifices of their gods: and the people did eat, and bowed down to their gods.
bsb_text: who also invited them to the sacrifices for their gods. And the people ate and bowed down to these gods.
aov_text: dié het die volk na die offers van hulle gode uitgenooi; en die volk het geëet en hulle neergebuig voor hulle gode.

kjv_text: And Israel joined himself unto Baalpeor: and the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel.
bsb_text: So Israel joined in worshiping Baal of Peor, and the anger of the LORD burned against them.
aov_text: So het Israel hom dan gekoppel aan Baäl-Peor, en die toorn van die HERE het teen Israel ontvlam.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Take all the heads of the people, and hang them up before the LORD against the sun, that the fierce anger of the LORD may be turned away from Israel.
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Take all the leaders of the people and execute them in broad daylight before the LORD, so that His fierce anger may turn away from Israel.”
aov_text: Toe sê die HERE vir Moses: Neem al die hoofde van die volk en hang die oortreders op in die volle son vir die HERE, sodat die toorngloed van die HERE van Israel afgewend kan word.

kjv_text: And Moses said unto the judges of Israel, Slay ye every one his men that were joined unto Baalpeor.
bsb_text: So Moses told the judges of Israel, “Each of you must kill all of his men who have joined in worshiping Baal of Peor.”
aov_text: Daarop het Moses aan die rigters in Israel gesê: Slaan elkeen sy manne dood wat hulle aan Baäl-Peor gekoppel het.

kjv_text: And, behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought unto his brethren a Midianitish woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, who were weeping before the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
bsb_text: Just then an Israelite man brought to his family a Midianite woman in the sight of Moses and the whole congregation of Israel while they were weeping at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
aov_text: En daar het ’n man gekom, een uit die kinders van Israel, en ’n Midianitiese vrou na sy volksgenote gebring, voor die oë van Moses en voor die oë van die hele vergadering van die kinders van Israel, terwyl hulle ween by die ingang van die tent van samekoms.

kjv_text: And when Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from among the congregation, and took a javelin in his hand;
bsb_text: On seeing this, Phinehas son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, got up from the assembly, took a spear in his hand,
aov_text: Toe Pínehas, die seun van Eleásar, die seun van die priester Aäron, dit sien, het hy uit die vergadering uit opgestaan en ’n spies in sy hand geneem

kjv_text: And he went after the man of Israel into the tent, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her belly. So the plague was stayed from the children of Israel.
bsb_text: followed the Israelite into his tent, and drove the spear through both of them—through the Israelite and on through the belly of the woman. So the plague against the Israelites was halted,
aov_text: en agter die Israelitiese man aan gegaan in die tent en hulle twee deurboor, die Israelitiese man en die vrou, in haar onderlyf. Daarna het die plaag onder die kinders van Israel opgehou.

kjv_text: And those that died in the plague were twenty and four thousand.
bsb_text: but those who died in the plague numbered 24,000.
aov_text: En die wat deur die plaag gesterf het, was vier-en-twintigduisend.

kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to Moses,
aov_text: Toe het die HERE met Moses gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, hath turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, while he was zealous for my sake among them, that I consumed not the children of Israel in my jealousy.
bsb_text: “Phinehas son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, has turned My wrath away from the Israelites; for he was zealous for My sake among them, so that I did not consume the Israelites in My zeal.
aov_text: Pínehas, die seun van Eleásar, die seun van die priester Aäron, het my grimmigheid van die kinders van Israel afgewend deurdat hy my ywer onder hulle geywer het, sodat Ek die kinders van Israel in my ywer nie verteer het nie.

kjv_text: Wherefore say, Behold, I give unto him my covenant of peace:
bsb_text: Declare, therefore, that I am granting him My covenant of peace.
aov_text: Daarom spreek: Kyk, Ek sluit met hom my vredeverbond,

kjv_text: And he shall have it, and his seed after him, even the covenant of an everlasting priesthood; because he was zealous for his God, and made an atonement for the children of Israel.
bsb_text: It will be a covenant of permanent priesthood for him and his descendants, because he was zealous for his God and made atonement for the Israelites.”
aov_text: en dit sal vir hom en sy nageslag ná hom die verbond van ewige priesterskap wees, omdat hy vir sy God geywer en versoening vir die kinders van Israel gedoen het.

kjv_text: Now the name of the Israelite that was slain, even that was slain with the Midianitish woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a chief house among the Simeonites.
bsb_text: The name of the Israelite who was slain with the Midianite woman was Zimri son of Salu, the leader of a Simeonite family.
aov_text: En die naam van die Israelitiese man wat verslaan is, wat saam met die Midianitiese vrou verslaan is, was Simri, die seun van Salu, owerste van ’n familie van die Simeoniete.

kjv_text: And the name of the Midianitish woman that was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur; he was head over a people, and of a chief house in Midian.
bsb_text: And the name of the slain Midianite woman was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur, a tribal chief of a Midianite family.
aov_text: En die naam van die Midianitiese vrou wat verslaan is, was Kosbi, die dogter van Sur. Hy was stamhoof van ’n familie in Mídian.

kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
bsb_text: And the LORD said to Moses,
aov_text: Verder het die HERE met Moses gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: Vex the Midianites, and smite them:
bsb_text: “Attack the Midianites and strike them dead.
aov_text: Behandel die Midianiete as vyand en verslaan hulle,

kjv_text: For they vex you with their wiles, wherewith they have beguiled you in the matter of Peor, and in the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of a prince of Midian, their sister, which was slain in the day of the plague for Peor's sake.
bsb_text: For they assailed you deceitfully when they seduced you in the matter of Peor and their sister Cozbi, the daughter of the Midianite leader, the woman who was killed on the day the plague came because of Peor.”
aov_text: want hulle het julle as vyand behandel deur hulle liste wat hulle teen julle bedink het in die saak van Peor en in die saak van Kosbi, die dogter van die vors van Mídian, hulle landgenoot, wat op die dag van die plaag weens Peor verslaan is.

kjv_text: And it came to pass after the plague, that the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,
bsb_text: After the plague had ended, the LORD said to Moses and Eleazar son of Aaron the priest,
aov_text: EN ná die plaag het die HERE met Moses en met Eleásar, die seun van die priester Aäron, gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: Take the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, throughout their fathers' house, all that are able to go to war in Israel.
bsb_text: “Take a census of the whole congregation of Israel by the houses of their fathers—all those twenty years of age or older who can serve in the army of Israel.”
aov_text: Neem julle die volle getal van die hele vergadering van die kinders van Israel op, van twintig jaar oud en daarbo, volgens hulle families, almal wat op kommando moet uittrek in Israel.

kjv_text: And Moses and Eleazar the priest spake with them in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,
bsb_text: So on the plains of Moab by the Jordan, across from Jericho, Moses and Eleazar the priest issued the instruction,
aov_text: En Moses en die priester Eleásar het hulle toegespreek in die vlaktes van Moab, by die Jordaan van Jérigo, en gesê:

kjv_text: Take the sum of the people, from twenty years old and upward; as the LORD commanded Moses and the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt.
bsb_text: “Take a census of the men twenty years of age or older, as the LORD has commanded Moses.” And these were the Israelites who came out of the land of Egypt:
aov_text: Laat hulle opneem van twintig jaar oud en daarbo, soos die HERE Moses beveel het. En die kinders van Israel wat uit Egipteland uitgetrek het, was:

kjv_text: Reuben, the eldest son of Israel: the children of Reuben; Hanoch, of whom cometh the family of the Hanochites: of Pallu, the family of the Palluites:
bsb_text: Reuben was the firstborn of Israel. These were the descendants of Reuben: The Hanochite clan from Hanoch, the Palluite clan from Pallu,
aov_text: Ruben, die eersgeborene van Israel; die seuns van Ruben was: van Henog die geslag van die Henogiete; van Pallu die geslag van die Palluïete;

kjv_text: Of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.
bsb_text: the Hezronite clan from Hezron, and the Carmite clan from Carmi.
aov_text: van Hesron die geslag van die Hesroniete; van Karmi die geslag van die Karmiete.

kjv_text: These are the families of the Reubenites: and they that were numbered of them were forty and three thousand and seven hundred and thirty.
bsb_text: These were the clans of Reuben, and their registration numbered 43,730.
aov_text: Dit is die geslagte van die Rubeniete; en hulle geteldes was drieen-veertigduisend-sewehonderd-endertig.

kjv_text: And the sons of Pallu; Eliab.
bsb_text: Now the son of Pallu was Eliab,
aov_text: En die seuns van Pallu was: Elíab;

kjv_text: And the sons of Eliab; Nemuel, and Dathan, and Abiram. This is that Dathan and Abiram, which were famous in the congregation, who strove against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah, when they strove against the LORD:
bsb_text: and the sons of Eliab were Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. It was Dathan and Abiram, chosen by the congregation, who fought against Moses and Aaron with the followers of Korah who rebelled against the LORD.
aov_text: en die seuns van Elíab was: Némuel en Datan en Abíram. Dit is Datan en Abíram wat na die vergadering opgeroep was, wat getwis het teen Moses en Aäron in die bende van Korag toe daar teen die HERE getwis is.

kjv_text: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah, when that company died, what time the fire devoured two hundred and fifty men: and they became a sign.
bsb_text: And the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them along with Korah, whose followers died when the fire consumed 250 men. They serve as a warning sign.
aov_text: En die aarde het sy mond oopgemaak en hulle verslind, saam met Korag, toe die bende gesterf het deurdat die vuur die tweehonderd-en-vyftig man verteer het; en hulle het tot ’n teken geword.

kjv_text: Notwithstanding the children of Korah died not.
bsb_text: However, the line of Korah did not die out.
aov_text: Maar die seuns van Korag het nie gesterf nie.

kjv_text: The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites: of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites: of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites:
bsb_text: These were the descendants of Simeon by their clans: The Nemuelite clan from Nemuel, the Jaminite clan from Jamin, the Jachinite clan from Jachin,
aov_text: Die seuns van Símeon volgens hulle geslagte: van Némuel die geslag van die Nemueliete; van Jamin die geslag van die Jaminiete; van Jagin die geslag van die Jaginiete;

kjv_text: Of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites: of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.
bsb_text: the Zerahite clan from Zerah, and the Shaulite clan from Shaul.
aov_text: van Serag die geslag van die Sargiete; van Saul die geslag van die Sauliete.

kjv_text: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty and two thousand and two hundred.
bsb_text: These were the clans of Simeon, and there were 22,200 men.
aov_text: Dit is die geslagte van die Simeoniete, twee-en-twintigduisend-tweehonderd.

kjv_text: The children of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites: of Haggi, the family of the Haggites: of Shuni, the family of the Shunites:
bsb_text: These were the descendants of Gad by their clans: The Zephonite clan from Zephon, the Haggite clan from Haggi, the Shunite clan from Shuni,
aov_text: Die seuns van Gad volgens hulle geslagte: van Sefon die geslag van die Sefoniete; van Haggi die geslag van die Haggiete; van Suni die geslag van die Suniete;

kjv_text: Of Ozni, the family of the Oznites: of Eri, the family of the Erites:
bsb_text: the Oznite clan from Ozni, the Erite clan from Eri,
aov_text: van Osni die geslag van die Osniete; van Eri die geslag van die Eriete;

kjv_text: Of Arod, the family of the Arodites: of Areli, the family of the Arelites.
bsb_text: the Arodite clan from Arod, and the Arelite clan from Areli.
aov_text: van Arod die geslag van die Arodiete; van Areëli die geslag van die Areëliete.

kjv_text: These are the families of the children of Gad according to those that were numbered of them, forty thousand and five hundred.
bsb_text: These were the clans of Gad, and their registration numbered 40,500.
aov_text: Dit is die geslagte van die seuns van Gad volgens hulle geteldes, veertigduisend-vyfhonderd.

kjv_text: The sons of Judah were Er and Onan: and Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.
bsb_text: The sons of Judah were Er and Onan, but they died in the land of Canaan.
aov_text: Die seuns van Juda was: Er en Onan; maar Er en Onan het gesterwe in die land Kanaän.

kjv_text: And the sons of Judah after their families were; of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites: of Pharez, the family of the Pharzites: of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites.
bsb_text: These were the descendants of Judah by their clans: The Shelanite clan from Shelah, the Perezite clan from Perez, and the Zerahite clan from Zerah.
aov_text: En die seuns van Juda volgens hulle geslagte: van Sela die geslag van die Selaniete; van Peres die geslag van die Parsiete; van Serag die geslag van die Sargiete.

kjv_text: And the sons of Pharez were; of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.
bsb_text: And these were the descendants of Perez: the Hezronite clan from Hezron and the Hamulite clan from Hamul.
aov_text: En die seuns van Peres: van Hesron die geslag van die Hesroniete; van Hamul die geslag van die Hamuliete.

kjv_text: These are the families of Judah according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and sixteen thousand and five hundred.
bsb_text: These were the clans of Judah, and their registration numbered 76,500.
aov_text: Dit is die geslagte van Juda volgens hulle geteldes, ses-en-sewentigduisend-vyfhonderd.

kjv_text: Of the sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites: of Pua, the family of the Punites:
bsb_text: These were the descendants of Issachar by their clans: The Tolaite clan from Tola, the Punite clan from Puvah,
aov_text: Die seuns van Íssaskar volgens hulle geslagte: van Tola die geslag van die Tolaïete; van Puwa die geslag van die Puniete;

kjv_text: Of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites: of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.
bsb_text: the Jashubite clan from Jashub, and the Shimronite clan from Shimron.
aov_text: van Jasub die geslag van die Jasubiete; van Simron die geslag van die Simroniete.

kjv_text: These are the families of Issachar according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and four thousand and three hundred.
bsb_text: These were the clans of Issachar, and their registration numbered 64,300.
aov_text: Dit is die geslagte van Íssaskar volgens hulle geteldes, vier-en-sestigduisend-driehonderd.

kjv_text: Of the sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Sardites: of Elon, the family of the Elonites: of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.
bsb_text: These were the descendants of Zebulun by their clans: The Seredite clan from Sered, the Elonite clan from Elon, and the Jahleelite clan from Jahleel.
aov_text: Die seuns van Sébulon volgens hulle geslagte: van Sered die geslag van die Sardiete; van Elon die geslag van die Eloniete; van Jágleël die geslag van die Jagleëliete.

kjv_text: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those that were numbered of them, threescore thousand and five hundred.
bsb_text: These were the clans of Zebulun, and their registration numbered 60,500.
aov_text: Dit is die geslagte van die Sebuloniete volgens hulle geteldes, sestigduisend-vyfhonderd.

kjv_text: The sons of Joseph after their families were Manasseh and Ephraim.
bsb_text: The descendants of Joseph included the clans of Manasseh and Ephraim.
aov_text: Die seuns van Josef volgens hulle geslagte was: Manasse en Efraim.

kjv_text: Of the sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites: and Machir begat Gilead: of Gilead come the family of the Gileadites.
bsb_text: These were the descendants of Manasseh: The Machirite clan from Machir, the father of Gilead, and the Gileadite clan from Gilead.
aov_text: Die seuns van Manasse: van Magir die geslag van die Magiriete. En Magir was die vader van Gílead; van Gílead die geslag van die Gileadiete.

kjv_text: These are the sons of Gilead: of Jeezer, the family of the Jeezerites: of Helek, the family of the Helekites:
bsb_text: These were the descendants of Gilead: the Iezerite clan from Iezer, the Helekite clan from Helek,
aov_text: Dit is die seuns van Gílead: van Jeser die geslag van die Jesriete; van Helek die geslag van die Helkiete;

kjv_text: And of Asriel, the family of the Asrielites: and of Shechem, the family of the Shechemites:
bsb_text: the Asrielite clan from Asriel, the Shechemite clan from Shechem,
aov_text: en van Ásriël die geslag van die Asriëliete; en van Segem die geslag van die Sigmiete;

kjv_text: And of Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites: and of Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.
bsb_text: the Shemidaite clan from Shemida, and the Hepherite clan from Hepher.
aov_text: en van Semída die geslag van die Semidaïete; en van Hefer die geslag van die Hefriete.

kjv_text: And Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
bsb_text: Now Zelophehad son of Hepher had no sons but only daughters. The names of his daughters were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
aov_text: Maar Selófhad, die seun van Hefer, het geen seuns gehad nie, maar net dogters. En die name van die dogters van Selófhad was: Magla en Noa, Hogla, Milka en Tirsa.

kjv_text: These are the families of Manasseh, and those that were numbered of them, fifty and two thousand and seven hundred.
bsb_text: These were the clans of Manasseh, and their registration numbered 52,700.
aov_text: Dit is die geslagte van Manasse; en hulle geteldes was twee-en-vyftigduisend-sewehonderd.

kjv_text: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthalhites: of Becher, the family of the Bachrites: of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.
bsb_text: These were the descendants of Ephraim by their clans: The Shuthelahite clan from Shuthelah, the Becherite clan from Becher, and the Tahanite clan from Tahan.
aov_text: Dit is die seuns van Efraim volgens hulle geslagte: van Sutélag die geslag van die Sutalgiete; van Beger die geslag van die Bagriete; van Tahan die geslag van die Tahaniete.

kjv_text: And these are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.
bsb_text: And the descendants of Shuthelah were the Eranite clan from Eran.
aov_text: En dit is die seuns van Sutélag: van Eran die geslag van die Eraniete.

kjv_text: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those that were numbered of them, thirty and two thousand and five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.
bsb_text: These were the clans of Ephraim, and their registration numbered 32,500. These clans were the descendants of Joseph.
aov_text: Dit is die geslagte van die seuns van Efraim volgens hulle geteldes, twee-en-dertigduisend-vyfhonderd. Dit is die seuns van Josef volgens hulle geslagte.

kjv_text: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites: of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites: of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites:
bsb_text: These were the descendants of Benjamin by their clans: The Belaite clan from Bela, the Ashbelite clan from Ashbel, the Ahiramite clan from Ahiram,
aov_text: Die seuns van Benjamin volgens hulle geslagte: van Bela die geslag van die Baliete; van Asbel die geslag van die Asbeliete; van Ahíram die geslag van die Ahiramiete;

kjv_text: Of Shupham, the family of the Shuphamites: of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.
bsb_text: the Shuphamite clan from Shupham, and the Huphamite clan from Hupham.
aov_text: van Sefúfam die geslag van die Sufamiete; van Hufam die geslag van die Hufamiete.

kjv_text: And the sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: of Ard, the family of the Ardites: and of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.
bsb_text: And the descendants of Bela from Ard and Naaman were the Ardite clan from Ard and the Naamite clan from Naaman.
aov_text: En die seuns van Bela was: Ard en Naäman; van Ard die geslag van die Ardiete; van Naäman die geslag van die Naämiete.

kjv_text: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families: and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and six hundred.
bsb_text: These were the clans of Benjamin, and their registration numbered 45,600.
aov_text: Dit is die seuns van Benjamin volgens hulle geslagte; en hulle geteldes was vyf-en-veertigduisend-seshonderd.

kjv_text: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.
bsb_text: These were the descendants of Dan by their clans: The Shuhamite clan from Shuham. These were the clans of Dan.
aov_text: Dit is die seuns van Dan volgens hulle geslagte: van Suham die geslag van die Suhamiete. Dit is die geslagte van Dan volgens hulle geslagte.

kjv_text: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those that were numbered of them, were threescore and four thousand and four hundred.
bsb_text: All of them were Shuhamite clans, and their registration numbered 64,400.
aov_text: Al die geslagte van die Suhamiete volgens hulle geteldes was vier-en-sestigduisend-vierhonderd.

kjv_text: Of the children of Asher after their families: of Jimna, the family of the Jimnites: of Jesui, the family of the Jesuites: of Beriah, the family of the Beriites.
bsb_text: These were the descendants of Asher by their clans: The Imnite clan from Imnah, the Ishvite clan from Ishvi, and the Beriite clan from Beriah.
aov_text: Die seuns van Aser volgens hulle geslagte: van Jimna die geslag van die Jimnaïete; van Jiswi die geslag van die Jiswiete; van Bería die geslag van die Beriïete;

kjv_text: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites: of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.
bsb_text: And these were the descendants of Beriah: the Heberite clan from Heber and the Malchielite clan from Malchiel.
aov_text: van die seuns van Bería: van Heber die geslag van die Hebriete; van Málkiël die geslag van die Malkiëliete.

kjv_text: And the name of the daughter of Asher was Sarah.
bsb_text: And the name of Asher’s daughter was Serah.
aov_text: En die naam van die dogter van Aser was Serag.

kjv_text: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those that were numbered of them; who were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
bsb_text: These were the clans of Asher, and their registration numbered 53,400.
aov_text: Dit is die geslagte van die seuns van Aser volgens hulle geteldes, drie-en-vyftigduisend-vierhonderd.

kjv_text: Of the sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites: of Guni, the family of the Gunites:
bsb_text: These were the descendants of Naphtali by their clans: The Jahzeelite clan from Jahzeel, the Gunite clan from Guni,
aov_text: Die seuns van Náftali volgens hulle geslagte: van Jágseël die geslag van die Jagseëliete; van Guni die geslag van die Guniete;

kjv_text: Of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites: of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.
bsb_text: the Jezerite clan from Jezer, and the Shillemite clan from Shillem.
aov_text: van Jeser die geslag van die Jisriete; van Sillem die geslag van die Sillemiete.

kjv_text: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families: and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and four hundred.
bsb_text: These were the clans of Naphtali, and their registration numbered 45,400.
aov_text: Dit is die geslagte van Náftali volgens hulle geslagte; en hulle geteldes was vyf-en-veertigduisend-vierhonderd.

kjv_text: These were the numbered of the children of Israel, six hundred thousand and a thousand seven hundred and thirty.
bsb_text: These men of Israel numbered 601,730 in all.
aov_text: Dit is die geteldes van die kinders van Israel: seshonderd-en-eenduisend-sewehonderd-en-dertig.

kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to Moses,
aov_text: En die HERE het met Moses gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: Unto these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.
bsb_text: “The land is to be divided among the tribes as an inheritance, according to the number of names.
aov_text: Vir hierdie mense moet die land as erfenis verdeel word volgens die getal name.

kjv_text: To many thou shalt give the more inheritance, and to few thou shalt give the less inheritance: to every one shall his inheritance be given according to those that were numbered of him.
bsb_text: Increase the inheritance for a large tribe and decrease it for a small one; each tribe is to receive its inheritance according to the number of those registered.
aov_text: Vir die wat baie is, moet jy hulle erfdeel groot maak; en vir die wat min is, moet jy hulle erfdeel klein maak; aan elke stam moet sy erfdeel volgens sy geteldes gegee word.

kjv_text: Notwithstanding the land shall be divided by lot: according to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.
bsb_text: Indeed, the land must be divided by lot; they shall receive their inheritance according to the names of the tribes of their fathers.
aov_text: Nogtans moet die land deur die lot verdeel word; volgens die name van hulle voorvaderlike stamme moet hulle erwe.

kjv_text: According to the lot shall the possession thereof be divided between many and few.
bsb_text: Each inheritance is to be divided by lot among the larger and smaller tribes.”
aov_text: Volgens die lot moet hulle erfenis verdeel word tussen die wat baie en die wat min is.

kjv_text: And these are they that were numbered of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites: of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites: of Merari, the family of the Merarites.
bsb_text: Now these were the Levites numbered by their clans: The Gershonite clan from Gershon, the Kohathite clan from Kohath, and the Merarite clan from Merari.
aov_text: En dit is die geteldes van Levi volgens hulle geslagte: van Gerson die geslag van die Gersoniete; van Kehat die geslag van die Kehatiete; van Merári die geslag van die Merariete.

kjv_text: These are the families of the Levites: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Korathites. And Kohath begat Amram.
bsb_text: These were the families of the Levites: The Libnite clan, the Hebronite clan, the Mahlite clan, the Mushite clan, and the Korahite clan. Now Kohath was the father of Amram,
aov_text: Dit is die geslagte van Levi: die geslag van die Libniete, die geslag van die Hebroniete, die geslag van die Magliete, die geslag van die Musiete, die geslag van die Koragiete. En Kehat was die vader van Amram.

kjv_text: And the name of Amram's wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, whom her mother bare to Levi in Egypt: and she bare unto Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.
bsb_text: and Amram’s wife was named Jochebed. She was also a daughter of Levi, born to Levi in Egypt. To Amram she bore Aaron, Moses, and their sister Miriam.
aov_text: En die naam van Amram se vrou was Jogébed, die dogter van Levi wat vir Levi in Egipte gebore is; en vir Amram het sy gebaar: Aäron en Moses en Mirjam, hulle suster.

kjv_text: And unto Aaron was born Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
bsb_text: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar were born to Aaron,
aov_text: En vir Aäron is gebore: Nadab en Abíhu, Eleásar en Ítamar.

kjv_text: And Nadab and Abihu died, when they offered strange fire before the LORD.
bsb_text: but Nadab and Abihu died when they offered unauthorized fire before the LORD.
aov_text: En Nadab en Abíhu het gesterwe toe hulle vreemde vuur voor die aangesig van die HERE gebring het.

kjv_text: And those that were numbered of them were twenty and three thousand, all males from a month old and upward: for they were not numbered among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.
bsb_text: The registration of the Levites totaled 23,000, every male a month old or more; they were not numbered among the other Israelites, because no inheritance was given to them among the Israelites.
aov_text: En hulle geteldes was drie-en-twingtigduisend, almal wat manlik was van ’n maand oud en daarbo. Want hulle is nie getel onder die kinders van Israel nie, omdat aan hulle geen erfdeel onder die kinders van Israel gegee is nie.

kjv_text: These are they that were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
bsb_text: These were the ones numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest when they counted the Israelites on the plains of Moab by the Jordan, across from Jericho.
aov_text: Dit is hulle wat deur Moses en die priester Eleásar getel is, wat die kinders van Israel in die vlaktes van Moab getel het, by die Jordaan van Jérigo.

kjv_text: But among these there was not a man of them whom Moses and Aaron the priest numbered, when they numbered the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.
bsb_text: Among all these, however, there was not one who had been numbered by Moses and Aaron the priest when they counted the Israelites in the Wilderness of Sinai.
aov_text: En onder hulle was daar niemand van die wat deur Moses en die priester Aäron getel is nie, toe hulle die kinders van Israel in die woestyn Sinai getel het.

kjv_text: For the LORD had said of them, They shall surely die in the wilderness. And there was not left a man of them, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
bsb_text: For the LORD had told them that they would surely die in the wilderness. Not one was left except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.
aov_text: Want die HERE het van hulle gesê: Sterwe sal hulle in die woestyn! En van hulle het niemand oorgebly nie buiten Kaleb, die seun van Jefúnne, en Josua, die seun van Nun.

kjv_text: Then came the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph: and these are the names of his daughters; Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.
bsb_text: Now the daughters of Zelophehad son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, belonged to the clans of Manasseh son of Joseph. These were the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah. They approached
aov_text: DAARNA het nader gekom die dogters van Selófhad, die seun van Hefer, die seun van Gílead, die seun van Magir, die seun van Manasse, van die geslagte van Manasse, die seun van Josef—dit is die name van sy dogters: Magla, Noa en Hogla en Milka en Tirsa —

kjv_text: And they stood before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,
bsb_text: the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, stood before Moses, Eleazar the priest, the leaders, and the whole congregation, and said,
aov_text: en hulle het gaan staan voor Moses en die priester Eleásar en voor die owerstes en die hele vergadering, by die ingang van die tent van samekoms, en gesê:

kjv_text: Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not in the company of them that gathered themselves together against the LORD in the company of Korah; but died in his own sin, and had no sons.
bsb_text: “Our father died in the wilderness, but he was not among the followers of Korah who gathered together against the LORD. Instead, he died because of his own sin, and he had no sons.
aov_text: Ons vader het in die woestyn gesterwe, en hy het nie behoort by die bende van die wat teen die HERE vergader het in die bende van Korag nie, maar hy het om sy sonde ontwil gesterwe en geen seuns gehad nie.

kjv_text: Why should the name of our father be done away from among his family, because he hath no son? Give unto us therefore a possession among the brethren of our father.
bsb_text: Why should the name of our father disappear from his clan because he had no sons? Give us property among our father’s brothers.”
aov_text: Waarom sou die naam van ons vader uit sy geslag weggeneem word, omdat hy geen seun gehad het nie? Gee ons ’n besitting onder die broers van ons vader.

kjv_text: And Moses brought their cause before the LORD.
bsb_text: So Moses brought their case before the LORD,
aov_text: Toe bring Moses hulle regsaak voor die aangesig van die HERE.

kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
bsb_text: and the LORD answered him,
aov_text: En die HERE het met Moses gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: The daughters of Zelophehad speak right: thou shalt surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father's brethren; and thou shalt cause the inheritance of their father to pass unto them.
bsb_text: “The daughters of Zelophehad speak correctly. You certainly must give them property as an inheritance among their father’s brothers, and transfer their father’s inheritance to them.
aov_text: Die dogters van Selófhad praat reg. Jy moet hulle sekerlik ’n erflike besitting onder die broers van hulle vader gee en die erfdeel van hulle vader op hulle laat oorgaan.

kjv_text: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a man die, and have no son, then ye shall cause his inheritance to pass unto his daughter.
bsb_text: Furthermore, you shall say to the Israelites, ‘If a man dies and leaves no son, you are to transfer his inheritance to his daughter.
aov_text: En met die kinders van Israel moet jy spreek en sê: As iemand sterwe en geen seun het nie, moet julle sy erfdeel op sy dogter laat oorgaan.

kjv_text: And if he have no daughter, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his brethren.
bsb_text: If he has no daughter, give his inheritance to his brothers.
aov_text: En as hy geen dogter het nie, moet julle sy erfdeel aan sy broers gee.

kjv_text: And if he have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his father's brethren.
bsb_text: If he has no brothers, give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.
aov_text: En as hy geen broers het nie, moet julle sy erfdeel aan die broers van sy vader gee.

kjv_text: And if his father have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his kinsman that is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it: and it shall be unto the children of Israel a statute of judgment, as the LORD commanded Moses.
bsb_text: And if his father has no brothers, give his inheritance to the next of kin from his clan, that he may take possession of it. This is to be a statutory ordinance for the Israelites, as the LORD has commanded Moses.’”
aov_text: En as sy vader geen broers het nie, moet julle sy erfdeel aan sy bloedverwant gee wat naaste aan hom is uit sy geslag, en dié moet dit in besit neem. En dit moet vir die kinders van Israel ’n regsinsetting wees, soos die HERE Moses beveel het.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Get thee up into this mount Abarim, and see the land which I have given unto the children of Israel.
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Go up this mountain of the Abarim range and see the land that I have given the Israelites.
aov_text: DAARNA het die HERE aan Moses gesê: Klim op hierdie gebergte Abárim, en bekyk die land wat Ek aan die kinders van Israel gegee het.

kjv_text: And when thou hast seen it, thou also shalt be gathered unto thy people, as Aaron thy brother was gathered.
bsb_text: After you have seen it, you too will be gathered to your people, as your brother Aaron was;
aov_text: En as jy dit gesien het, sal jy ook by jou volksgenote versamel word soos jou broer Aäron versamel is;

kjv_text: For ye rebelled against my commandment in the desert of Zin, in the strife of the congregation, to sanctify me at the water before their eyes: that is the water of Meribah in Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.
bsb_text: for when the congregation contended in the Wilderness of Zin, both of you rebelled against My command to show My holiness in their sight regarding the waters.” Those were the waters of Meribah in Kadesh, in the Wilderness of Zin.
aov_text: omdat julle in die woestyn Sin, toe die vergadering getwis het, teen my bevel wederstrewig gewees het om My by die water voor hulle oë te heilig. Dit is die water van Mériba by Kades, in die woestyn Sin.

kjv_text: And Moses spake unto the LORD, saying,
bsb_text: So Moses appealed to the LORD,
aov_text: Toe het Moses met die HERE gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: Let the LORD, the God of the spirits of all flesh, set a man over the congregation,
bsb_text: “May the LORD, the God of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the congregation
aov_text: Laat die HERE, die God van die geeste van alle vlees, ’n man oor die vergadering aanstel

kjv_text: Which may go out before them, and which may go in before them, and which may lead them out, and which may bring them in; that the congregation of the LORD be not as sheep which have no shepherd.
bsb_text: who will go out and come in before them, and who will lead them out and bring them in, so that the congregation of the LORD will not be like sheep without a shepherd.”
aov_text: wat voor hulle uittrek en wat voor hulle intrek, en wat hulle uitlei en wat hulle inlei; sodat die vergadering van die HERE nie mag wees soos skape wat geen wagter het nie.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Take thee Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the spirit, and lay thine hand upon him;
bsb_text: And the LORD replied to Moses, “Take Joshua son of Nun, a man with the Spirit in him, and lay your hands on him.
aov_text: Toe sê die HERE aan Moses: Neem vir jou Josua, die seun van Nun, ’n man in wie die Gees is; en lê hom die hand op,

kjv_text: And set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and give him a charge in their sight.
bsb_text: Have him stand before Eleazar the priest and the whole congregation, and commission him in their sight.
aov_text: en stel hom voor die priester Eleásar en voor die hele vergadering, en gee hom ’n opdrag voor hulle oë;

kjv_text: And thou shalt put some of thine honour upon him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may be obedient.
bsb_text: Confer on him some of your authority, so that the whole congregation of Israel will obey him.
aov_text: en lê op hom van jou hoogheid, sodat die hele vergadering van die kinders van Israel na hom kan luister.

kjv_text: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall ask counsel for him after the judgment of Urim before the LORD: at his word shall they go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he, and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.
bsb_text: He shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who will seek counsel for him before the LORD by the judgment of the Urim. At his command, he and all the Israelites with him—the entire congregation—will go out and come in.”
aov_text: En hy moet voor die priester Eleásar staan, dat dié vir hom die beslissing van die Urim kan vra voor die aangesig van die HERE; volgens sy uitspraak moet hulle uittrek en volgens sy uitspraak moet hulle intrek, hy en al die kinders van Israel saam met hom en die hele vergadering.

kjv_text: And Moses did as the LORD commanded him: and he took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation:
bsb_text: Moses did as the LORD had commanded him. He took Joshua, had him stand before Eleazar the priest and the whole congregation,
aov_text: En Moses het gedoen soos die HERE hom beveel het: hy het Josua geneem en hom voor die priester Eleásar en voor die hele vergadering gestel,

kjv_text: And he laid his hands upon him, and gave him a charge, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.
bsb_text: and laid his hands on him and commissioned him, as the LORD had instructed through Moses.
aov_text: en hy het hom die hande opgelê en hom ’n opdrag gegee soos die HERE deur die diens van Moses gespreek het.

kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to Moses,
aov_text: VERDER het die HERE met Moses gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, My offering, and my bread for my sacrifices made by fire, for a sweet savour unto me, shall ye observe to offer unto me in their due season.
bsb_text: “Command the Israelites and say to them: See that you present to Me at its appointed time the food for My offerings by fire, as a pleasing aroma to Me.
aov_text: Gee bevel aan die kinders van Israel en sê vir hulle: Julle moet daarvoor sorg om my offer, my spys vir my vuuroffers as lieflike geur vir My, op die bepaalde tyd aan My te bring.

kjv_text: And thou shalt say unto them, This is the offering made by fire which ye shall offer unto the LORD; two lambs of the first year without spot day by day, for a continual burnt offering.
bsb_text: And tell them that this is the offering made by fire you are to present to the LORD as a regular burnt offering each day: two unblemished year-old male lambs.
aov_text: En jy moet vir hulle sê: Dit is die vuuroffer wat julle aan die HERE moet bring: twee jaaroud lammers sonder gebrek elke dag as ’n voortdurende brandoffer.

kjv_text: The one lamb shalt thou offer in the morning, and the other lamb shalt thou offer at even;
bsb_text: Offer one lamb in the morning and the other at twilight,
aov_text: Die een lam moet jy in die môre berei, en die ander lam moet jy teen die aand berei;

kjv_text: And a tenth part of an ephah of flour for a meat offering, mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil.
bsb_text: along with a tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with a quarter hin of oil from pressed olives.
aov_text: met ’n tiende van ’n efa fynmeel as spysoffer, gemeng met ’n kwart-hin uitgestampte olie.

kjv_text: It is a continual burnt offering, which was ordained in mount Sinai for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD.
bsb_text: This is a regular burnt offering established at Mount Sinai as a pleasing aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
aov_text: Dit is die voortdurende brandoffer wat by die berg Sinai ingestel is as lieflike geur, ’n vuuroffer aan die HERE.

kjv_text: And the drink offering thereof shall be the fourth part of an hin for the one lamb: in the holy place shalt thou cause the strong wine to be poured unto the LORD for a drink offering.
bsb_text: The drink offering accompanying each lamb shall be a quarter hin. Pour out the offering of fermented drink to the LORD in the sanctuary area.
aov_text: En die drankoffer wat daarby behoort, moet wees ’n kwart-hin vir elke lam. In die heiligdom moet jy die drankoffer van sterk drank aan die HERE uitgiet.

kjv_text: And the other lamb shalt thou offer at even: as the meat offering of the morning, and as the drink offering thereof, thou shalt offer it, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
bsb_text: And offer the second lamb at twilight, with the same grain offering and drink offering as in the morning. It is an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
aov_text: En die ander lam moet jy teen die aand berei; met dieselfde spysoffer as in die môre en met die drankoffer wat daarby behoort, moet jy dit berei—’n vuuroffer van lieflike geur aan die HERE.

kjv_text: And on the sabbath day two lambs of the first year without spot, and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, and the drink offering thereof:
bsb_text: On the Sabbath day, present two unblemished year-old male lambs, accompanied by a grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil, as well as a drink offering.
aov_text: MAAR op die sabbatdag twee jaaroud lammers sonder gebrek en twee-tiendes van ’n efa fynmeel as spysoffer, met olie gemeng, en die drankoffer wat daarby behoort.
