kjv_text: This is the burnt offering of every sabbath, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.
bsb_text: This is the burnt offering for every Sabbath, in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.
aov_text: Dit is die brandoffer van die sabbat op elke sabbat, behalwe die voortdurende brandoffer en die drankoffer wat daarby behoort.

kjv_text: And in the beginnings of your months ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the LORD; two young bullocks, and one ram, seven lambs of the first year without spot;
bsb_text: At the beginning of every month, you are to present to the LORD a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old, all unblemished,
aov_text: En by die begin van julle maande moet julle ’n brandoffer aan die HERE bring: twee jong bulle en een ram, sewe jaaroud lammers sonder gebrek;

kjv_text: And three tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one bullock; and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one ram;
bsb_text: along with three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering with each bull, two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering with the ram,
aov_text: en drie-tiendes van ’n efa fynmeel as spysoffer, met olie gemeng, vir elke bul, en twee-tiendes fynmeel as spysoffer, met olie gemeng, vir die een ram;

kjv_text: And a several tenth deal of flour mingled with oil for a meat offering unto one lamb; for a burnt offering of a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD.
bsb_text: and a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering with each lamb. This is a burnt offering, a pleasing aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
aov_text: en een-tiende fynmeel as spysoffer, met olie gemeng, vir elke lam. Dit is ’n brandoffer, ’n lieflike geur, ’n vuuroffer aan die HERE.

kjv_text: And their drink offerings shall be half an hin of wine unto a bullock, and the third part of an hin unto a ram, and a fourth part of an hin unto a lamb: this is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.
bsb_text: Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine with each bull, a third of a hin with the ram, and a quarter hin with each lamb. This is the monthly burnt offering to be made at each new moon throughout the year.
aov_text: En hulle drankoffers moet wees ’n half-hin wyn vir ’n bul en ’n derde van ’n hin vir ’n ram en ’n kwart-hin vir ’n lam. Dit is die brandoffer by elke nuwemaan, vir die maande van die jaar.

kjv_text: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering unto the LORD shall be offered, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.
bsb_text: In addition to the regular burnt offering with its drink offering, one male goat is to be presented to the LORD as a sin offering.
aov_text: Ook moet een bokram as sondoffer aan die HERE berei word, behalwe die voortdurende brandoffer en die drankoffer wat daarby behoort.

kjv_text: And in the fourteenth day of the first month is the passover of the LORD.
bsb_text: The fourteenth day of the first month is the LORD’s Passover.
aov_text: EN in die eerste maand, op die veertiende dag van die maand, is die pasga van die HERE.

kjv_text: And in the fifteenth day of this month is the feast: seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.
bsb_text: On the fifteenth day of this month, there shall be a feast; for seven days unleavened bread is to be eaten.
aov_text: En op die vyftiende dag van hierdie maand is dit fees; sewe dae lank moet ongesuurde brode geëet word.

kjv_text: In the first day shall be an holy convocation; ye shall do no manner of servile work therein:
bsb_text: On the first day there is to be a sacred assembly; you must not do any regular work.
aov_text: Op die eerste dag moet daar ’n heilige samekoms wees; géén beroepswerk mag julle doen nie.

kjv_text: But ye shall offer a sacrifice made by fire for a burnt offering unto the LORD; two young bullocks, and one ram, and seven lambs of the first year: they shall be unto you without blemish:
bsb_text: Present to the LORD an offering made by fire, a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old, all unblemished.
aov_text: Maar julle moet as vuuroffer, as brandoffer aan die HERE bring: twee jong bulle en een ram en sewe jaaroud lammers; sonder gebrek moet hulle vir julle wees.

kjv_text: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil: three tenth deals shall ye offer for a bullock, and two tenth deals for a ram;
bsb_text: The grain offering shall consist of fine flour mixed with oil; offer three-tenths of an ephah with each bull, two-tenths of an ephah with the ram,
aov_text: En hulle spysoffer fynmeel met olie gemeng: drie-tiendes van ’n efa vir ’n bul en twee-tiendes vir ’n ram moet julle berei.

kjv_text: A several tenth deal shalt thou offer for every lamb, throughout the seven lambs:
bsb_text: and a tenth of an ephah with each of the seven lambs.
aov_text: Een-tiende moet jy vir elke lam van die sewe lammers berei.

kjv_text: And one goat for a sin offering, to make an atonement for you.
bsb_text: Include one male goat as a sin offering to make atonement for you.
aov_text: Daarby een bokram as sondoffer om vir julle versoening te doen.

kjv_text: Ye shall offer these beside the burnt offering in the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.
bsb_text: You are to present these in addition to the regular morning burnt offering.
aov_text: Behalwe die môrebrandoffer, wat as voortdurende brandoffer dien, moet julle dit berei.

bsb_text: “Take vengeance on the Midianites for the Israelites. After that, you will be gathered to your people.”
aov_text: Neem wraak vir die kinders van Israel op die Midianiete; daarna sal jy by jou volksgenote versamel word.

kjv_text: And Moses spake unto the people, saying, Arm some of yourselves unto the war, and let them go against the Midianites, and avenge the LORD of Midian.
bsb_text: So Moses told the people, “Arm some of your men for war, that they may go against the Midianites and execute the LORD’s vengeance on them.
aov_text: Daarop het Moses met die volk gespreek en gesê: Laat manne uit julle midde hul vir die oorlog wapen, dat hulle teen Mídian kan trek om die wraakgerig van die HERE aan Mídian te voltrek.

kjv_text: Of every tribe a thousand, throughout all the tribes of Israel, shall ye send to the war.
bsb_text: Send into battle a thousand men from each tribe of Israel.”
aov_text: Duisend vir elke stam van al die stamme van Israel moet julle na die oorlog stuur.

kjv_text: So there were delivered out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand of every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.
bsb_text: So a thousand men were recruited from each tribe of Israel—twelve thousand armed for war.
aov_text: Toe is daar uit die duisende van Israel duisend vir elke stam gelewer, twaalfduisend wat vir die oorlog gewapen was.

kjv_text: And Moses sent them to the war, a thousand of every tribe, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the holy instruments, and the trumpets to blow in his hand.
bsb_text: And Moses sent the thousand from each tribe into battle, along with Phinehas son of Eleazar the priest, who took with him the vessels of the sanctuary and the trumpets for signaling.
aov_text: En Moses het hulle na die oorlog gestuur, duisend vir elke stam, hulle en Pínehas, die seun van die priester Eleásar, na die oorlog, met die heilige voorwerpe en die trompette by hom om alarm te blaas.

kjv_text: And they warred against the Midianites, as the LORD commanded Moses; and they slew all the males.
bsb_text: Then they waged war against Midian, as the LORD had commanded Moses, and they killed every male.
aov_text: En hulle het oorlog toe getrek teen Mídian, soos die HERE Moses beveel het, en al die manlike persone gedood.

kjv_text: And they slew the kings of Midian, beside the rest of them that were slain; namely, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, five kings of Midian: Balaam also the son of Beor they slew with the sword.
bsb_text: Among the slain were Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba—the five kings of Midian. They also killed Balaam son of Beor with the sword.
aov_text: Ook het hulle die konings van Mídian gedood by die wat hulle verslaan het: Ewi en Rekem en Sur en Hur en Reba, die vyf konings van Mídian; ook het hulle Bíleam, die seun van Beor, met die swaard gedood.

kjv_text: And the children of Israel took all the women of Midian captives, and their little ones, and took the spoil of all their cattle, and all their flocks, and all their goods.
bsb_text: The Israelites captured the Midianite women and their children, and they plundered all their herds, flocks, and goods.
aov_text: Maar die kinders van Israel het die vroue van die Midianiete en hulle kinders as gevangenes weggevoer, en al hulle lasdiere en al hulle vee en al hulle rykdom geroof.

kjv_text: And they burnt all their cities wherein they dwelt, and all their goodly castles, with fire.
bsb_text: Then they burned all the cities where the Midianites had lived, as well as all their encampments,
aov_text: Verder, al hulle stede in hulle woonplekke en al hulle laers het hulle met vuur verbrand

kjv_text: And they took all the spoil, and all the prey, both of men and of beasts.
bsb_text: and carried away all the plunder and spoils, both people and animals.
aov_text: en al die roof geneem en al die buit, mense en diere.

kjv_text: And they brought the captives, and the prey, and the spoil, unto Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and unto the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by Jordan near Jericho.
bsb_text: They brought the captives, spoils, and plunder to Moses, to Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation of Israel at the camp on the plains of Moab, by the Jordan across from Jericho.
aov_text: Daarna het hulle die gevangenes en die buit en die roof na Moses en die priester Eleásar en na die vergadering van die kinders van Israel gebring in die laer, in die vlaktes van Moab wat by die Jordaan van Jérigo is.

kjv_text: And Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and all the princes of the congregation, went forth to meet them without the camp.
bsb_text: And Moses, Eleazar the priest, and all the leaders of the congregation went to meet them outside the camp.
aov_text: En toe Moses en die priester Eleásar en al die owerstes van die vergadering hulle buitekant die laer tegemoetgaan,

kjv_text: And Moses was wroth with the officers of the host, with the captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, which came from the battle.
bsb_text: But Moses was angry with the officers of the army—the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds—who were returning from the battle.
aov_text: het Moses kwaad geword vir die aanvoerders van die leër, die owerstes oor duisend en die owerstes oor honderd wat van die veldtog af gekom het.

kjv_text: And Moses said unto them, Have ye saved all the women alive?
bsb_text: “Have you spared all the women?” he asked them.
aov_text: En Moses het vir hulle gesê: Het julle al die vroue laat lewe?

kjv_text: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against the LORD in the matter of Peor, and there was a plague among the congregation of the LORD.
bsb_text: “Look, these women caused the sons of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to turn unfaithfully against the LORD at Peor, so that the plague struck the congregation of the LORD.
aov_text: Kyk, hulle was, deur die raad van Bíleam, vir die kinders van Israel ’n oorsaak van troubreuk teenoor die HERE in die saak van Peor, sodat die plaag in die vergadering van die HERE was.

kjv_text: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman that hath known man by lying with him.
bsb_text: So now, kill all the boys, as well as every woman who has had relations with a man,
aov_text: Maak dan nou dood almal wat van die manlike geslag onder die kinders is; en maak dood elke vrou wat gemeenskap met ’n man gehad het.

kjv_text: But all the women children, that have not known a man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.
bsb_text: but spare for yourselves every girl who has never had relations with a man.
aov_text: Maar laat al die kinders onder die vroulike persone wat geen gemeenskap met ’n man gehad het nie, vir julle in die lewe bly.

kjv_text: And do ye abide without the camp seven days: whosoever hath killed any person, and whosoever hath touched any slain, purify both yourselves and your captives on the third day, and on the seventh day.
bsb_text: All of you who have killed a person or touched the dead are to remain outside the camp for seven days. On the third day and the seventh day you are to purify both yourselves and your captives.
aov_text: En julle, slaan sewe dae lank ’n kamp op buitekant die laer; elkeen wat ’n mens gedood en elkeen wat aan ’n gesneuwelde geraak het—julle moet jul op die derde dag en op die sewende dag ontsondig, julle en jul gevangenes.

kjv_text: And purify all your raiment, and all that is made of skins, and all work of goats' hair, and all things made of wood.
bsb_text: And purify every garment and leather good, everything made of goat’s hair, and every article of wood.”
aov_text: Ook moet julle al die klere en elke ding van leer en alles wat van bokhaar gemaak is, en elke ding van hout ontsondig.

kjv_text: And Eleazar the priest said unto the men of war which went to the battle, This is the ordinance of the law which the LORD commanded Moses;
bsb_text: Then Eleazar the priest said to the soldiers who had gone into battle, “This is the statute of the law which the LORD has commanded Moses:
aov_text: En die priester Eleásar het aan die krygsmanne wat na die oorlog getrek het, gesê: Dit is die wetsinsetting wat die HERE Moses beveel het.

kjv_text: Only the gold, and the silver, the brass, the iron, the tin, and the lead,
bsb_text: Only the gold, silver, bronze, iron, tin, and lead—
aov_text: Net die goud en die silwer, die koper, die yster, die tin en die lood —

kjv_text: Every thing that may abide the fire, ye shall make it go through the fire, and it shall be clean: nevertheless it shall be purified with the water of separation: and all that abideth not the fire ye shall make go through the water.
bsb_text: everything that can withstand the fire—must be put through the fire, and it will be clean. But it must still be purified with the water of purification. And everything that cannot withstand the fire must pass through the water.
aov_text: elke ding wat in die vuur kan kom—moet julle deur die vuur laat deurgaan, en dit sal rein wees; ewenwel moet dit deur reinigingswater ontsondig word; maar alles wat nie in die vuur kan kom nie, moet julle deur die water laat deurgaan.

kjv_text: And ye shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and ye shall be clean, and afterward ye shall come into the camp.
bsb_text: On the seventh day you are to wash your clothes, and you will be clean. After that you may enter the camp.”
aov_text: Julle moet ook jul klere op die sewende dag was; dan sal julle rein wees; en daarna mag julle in die laer kom.

kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
bsb_text: The LORD said to Moses,
aov_text: Verder het die HERE met Moses gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: Take the sum of the prey that was taken, both of man and of beast, thou, and Eleazar the priest, and the chief fathers of the congregation:
bsb_text: “You and Eleazar the priest and the family heads of the congregation are to take a count of what was captured, both of man and beast.
aov_text: Neem die volle getal op van wat as buit weggevoer is, van mense en van diere, jy en die priester Eleásar en die familiehoofde van die vergadering;

kjv_text: And divide the prey into two parts; between them that took the war upon them, who went out to battle, and between all the congregation:
bsb_text: Then divide the captives between the troops who went out to battle and the rest of the congregation.
aov_text: en verdeel die buit tussen die wat met die oorlog te doen gehad het, wat op kommando uitgetrek het, én die hele vergadering.

kjv_text: And levy a tribute unto the Lord of the men of war which went out to battle: one soul of five hundred, both of the persons, and of the beeves, and of the asses, and of the sheep:
bsb_text: Set aside a tribute for the LORD from what belongs to the soldiers who went into battle: one out of every five hundred, whether persons, cattle, donkeys, or sheep.
aov_text: En hef ’n bydrae vir die HERE van die krygsmanne wat na die oorlog uitgetrek het—een uit elke vyfhonderd—van die mense en van die beeste en van die esels en van die kleinvee.

kjv_text: Take it of their half, and give it unto Eleazar the priest, for an heave offering of the LORD.
bsb_text: Take it from their half and give it to Eleazar the priest as an offering to the LORD.
aov_text: Van hulle helfte moet julle dit neem, en gee dit aan die priester Eleásar as ’n offergawe aan die HERE.

kjv_text: And of the children of Israel's half, thou shalt take one portion of fifty, of the persons, of the beeves, of the asses, and of the flocks, of all manner of beasts, and give them unto the Levites, which keep the charge of the tabernacle of the LORD.
bsb_text: From the Israelites’ half, take one out of every fifty, whether persons, cattle, donkeys, sheep, or other animals, and give them to the Levites who keep charge of the tabernacle of the LORD.”
aov_text: Maar uit die helfte van die kinders van Israel moet jy een neem, uitgehaal uit elke vyftig, uit die mense, uit die beeste, uit die esels en die kleinvee, uit al die diere; en jy moet dit aan die Leviete gee wat die diens by die tabernakel van die HERE waarneem.

kjv_text: And Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the LORD commanded Moses.
bsb_text: So Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the LORD had commanded Moses,
aov_text: En Moses en die priester Eleásar het gedoen soos die HERE Moses beveel het.

kjv_text: And the booty, being the rest of the prey which the men of war had caught, was six hundred thousand and seventy thousand and five thousand sheep,
bsb_text: and this plunder remained from the spoils the soldiers had taken: 675,000 sheep,
aov_text: En die buit, die oorskot van die roof wat die krygsmanne geneem het, was seshonderd-vyf-en-sewentigduisend stuks kleinvee;

kjv_text: And threescore and twelve thousand beeves,
bsb_text: 72,000 cattle,
aov_text: en twee-en-sewentigduisend beeste;

kjv_text: And threescore and one thousand asses,
bsb_text: 61,000 donkeys,
aov_text: en een-en-sestigduisend esels;

kjv_text: And thirty and two thousand persons in all, of women that had not known man by lying with him.
bsb_text: and 32,000 women who had not slept with a man.
aov_text: en mensesiele, uit die vroulike persone wat geen gemeenskap met ’n man gehad het nie, al die siele was twee-en-dertigduisend.

kjv_text: And the half, which was the portion of them that went out to war, was in number three hundred thousand and seven and thirty thousand and five hundred sheep:
bsb_text: This was the half portion for those who had gone to war: 337,500 sheep,
aov_text: En die helfte, die deel van hulle wat na die oorlog uitgetrek het, was in getal driehonderd-sewen-en-dertigduisend-vyfhonderd stuks kleinvee.

kjv_text: And the LORD's tribute of the sheep was six hundred and threescore and fifteen.
bsb_text: including a tribute to the LORD of 675,
aov_text: En die bydrae aan die HERE uit die kleinvee was seshonderd-vyf-en-sewentig.

kjv_text: And the beeves were thirty and six thousand; of which the LORD's tribute was threescore and twelve.
bsb_text: 36,000 cattle, including a tribute to the LORD of 72,
aov_text: En die beeste was ses-en-dertigduisend, en die bydrae daarvan aan die HERE twee-en-sewentig.

kjv_text: And the asses were thirty thousand and five hundred; of which the LORD's tribute was threescore and one.
bsb_text: 30,500 donkeys, including a tribute to the LORD of 61,
aov_text: En die esels was dertigduisend-vyfhonderd, en die bydrae daarvan aan die HERE een-en-sestig.

kjv_text: And the persons were sixteen thousand; of which the LORD's tribute was thirty and two persons.
bsb_text: and 16,000 people, including a tribute to the LORD of 32.
aov_text: En mensesiele was sestienduisend, en die bydrae daarvan aan die HERE twee-en-dertig siele.

kjv_text: And Moses gave the tribute, which was the LORD's heave offering, unto Eleazar the priest, as the LORD commanded Moses.
bsb_text: Moses gave the tribute to Eleazar the priest as an offering for the LORD, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
aov_text: En Moses het aan die priester Eleásar die bydrae gegee wat as offergawe aan die HERE bestem was, soos die HERE Moses beveel het.

kjv_text: And of the children of Israel's half, which Moses divided from the men that warred,
bsb_text: From the Israelites’ half, which Moses had set apart from the men who had gone to war,
aov_text: En uit die helfte van die kinders van Israel wat Moses van die vegsmanne afgedeel het —

kjv_text: (Now the half that pertained unto the congregation was three hundred thousand and thirty thousand and seven thousand and five hundred sheep,
bsb_text: this half belonged to the congregation: 337,500 sheep,
aov_text: die helfte van die vergadering uit die kleinvee was driehonderd-sewen-en-dertigduisend-vyfhonderd;

kjv_text: And thirty and six thousand beeves,
bsb_text: 36,000 cattle,
aov_text: en die beeste was ses-en-dertigduisend;

kjv_text: And thirty thousand asses and five hundred,
bsb_text: 30,500 donkeys,
aov_text: en die esels dertigduisend-vyfhonderd;

kjv_text: And sixteen thousand persons;)
bsb_text: and 16,000 people.
aov_text: en mensesiele sestienduisend —

kjv_text: Even of the children of Israel's half, Moses took one portion of fifty, both of man and of beast, and gave them unto the Levites, which kept the charge of the tabernacle of the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.
bsb_text: From the Israelites’ half, Moses took one out of every fifty persons and animals and gave them to the Levites who kept charge of the tabernacle of the LORD, as the LORD had commanded him.
aov_text: uit die helfte van die kinders van Israel het Moses geneem—van wat uitgehaal was, een uit elke vyftig, van mense en van diere—en hy het dit aan die Leviete gegee wat die diens by die tabernakel van die HERE waarneem, soos die HERE Moses beveel het.

kjv_text: And the officers which were over thousands of the host, the captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, came near unto Moses:
bsb_text: Then the officers who were over the units of the army—the commanders of thousands and of hundreds—approached Moses
aov_text: Toe het die aanvoerders oor die duisende van die leër, die owerstes oor duisend en die owerstes oor honderd, nader gekom na Moses

kjv_text: And they said unto Moses, Thy servants have taken the sum of the men of war which are under our charge, and there lacketh not one man of us.
bsb_text: and said, “Your servants have counted the soldiers under our command, and not one of us is missing.
aov_text: en aan Moses gesê: U dienaars het die volle getal van die krygsmanne opgeneem wat onder ons bevel was, en daarvan word nie een vermis nie.

kjv_text: We have therefore brought an oblation for the LORD, what every man hath gotten, of jewels of gold, chains, and bracelets, rings, earrings, and tablets, to make an atonement for our souls before the LORD.
bsb_text: So we have brought to the LORD an offering of the gold articles each man acquired—armlets, bracelets, rings, earrings, and necklaces—to make atonement for ourselves before the LORD.”
aov_text: Daarom bring elkeen van ons as offer aan die HERE wat hy aan goue goed gevind het: armkettings en armbande, vingerringe, oorringe en halssierade, om versoening te doen vir ons siele voor die aangesig van die HERE.

kjv_text: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of them, even all wrought jewels.
bsb_text: So Moses and Eleazar the priest received from them all the articles made out of gold.
aov_text: Toe het Moses en die priester Eleásar die goud, allerhande kunsvoorwerpe, van hulle aangeneem.

kjv_text: And all the gold of the offering that they offered up to the LORD, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels.
bsb_text: All the gold that the commanders of thousands and of hundreds presented as an offering to the LORD weighed 16,750 shekels.
aov_text: En al die goud van die offergawe wat hulle aan die HERE afgegee het, was sestienduisend-sewehonderd-en-vyftig sikkels, afkomstig van die owerstes oor duisend en die owerstes oor honderd.

kjv_text: (For the men of war had taken spoil, every man for himself.)
bsb_text: Each of the soldiers had taken plunder for himself.
aov_text: Die krygsmanne het elkeen na welgevalle buitgemaak.

kjv_text: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the tabernacle of the congregation, for a memorial for the children of Israel before the LORD.
bsb_text: And Moses and Eleazar the priest received the gold from the commanders of thousands and of hundreds and brought it into the Tent of Meeting as a memorial for the Israelites before the LORD.
aov_text: So het Moses en die priester Eleásar dan die goud van die owerstes oor duisend en oor honderd aangeneem en dit in die tent van samekoms gebring om die kinders van Israel voor die aangesig van die HERE in gedagtenis te bring.

kjv_text: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle: and when they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that, behold, the place was a place for cattle;
bsb_text: Now the Reubenites and Gadites, who had very large herds and flocks, surveyed the lands of Jazer and Gilead, and they saw that the region was suitable for livestock.
aov_text: EN die kinders van Ruben en die kinders van Gad het baie vee gehad, ’n groot menigte. En toe hulle die land van Jaéser en die land Gílead bekyk het, vind hulle uit dat die plek ’n plek vir vee was.

kjv_text: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spake unto Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and unto the princes of the congregation, saying,
bsb_text: So the Gadites and Reubenites came to Moses, Eleazar the priest, and the leaders of the congregation, and said,
aov_text: Daarop het die kinders van Gad en die kinders van Ruben gekom en met Moses en die priester Eleásar en met die owerstes van die vergadering gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Shebam, and Nebo, and Beon,
bsb_text: “Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon,
aov_text: Átarot en Dibon en Jaéser en Nimra en Hesbon en Eleále en Sebam en Nebo en Behon —

kjv_text: Even the country which the LORD smote before the congregation of Israel, is a land for cattle, and thy servants have cattle:
bsb_text: which the LORD conquered before the congregation of Israel, are suitable for livestock—and your servants have livestock.”
aov_text: die land wat die HERE voor die vergadering van Israel uit verower het—is ’n land vir vee, en u dienaars het vee.

kjv_text: Wherefore, said they, if we have found grace in thy sight, let this land be given unto thy servants for a possession, and bring us not over Jordan.
bsb_text: “If we have found favor in your sight,” they said, “let this land be given to your servants as a possession. Do not make us cross the Jordan.”
aov_text: Verder het hulle gesê: As ons genade in u oë gevind het, laat hierdie land aan u dienaars as ’n besitting gegee word; bring ons nie oor die Jordaan nie.

kjv_text: And Moses said unto the children of Gad and to the children of Reuben, Shall your brethren go to war, and shall ye sit here?
bsb_text: But Moses asked the Gadites and Reubenites, “Shall your brothers go to war while you sit here?
aov_text: Maar Moses het die kinders van Gad en die kinders van Ruben geantwoord: Sal julle broers oorlog toe trek, en wil júlle hier bly?

kjv_text: And wherefore discourage ye the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the LORD hath given them?
bsb_text: Why are you discouraging the Israelites from crossing into the land that the LORD has given them?
aov_text: Waarom tog wil julle die hart van die kinders van Israel daarvan afkerig maak om deur te trek in die land wat die HERE aan hulle gegee het?

kjv_text: Thus did your fathers, when I sent them from Kadeshbarnea to see the land.
bsb_text: This is what your fathers did when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to inspect the land.
aov_text: So het julle vaders gedoen toe ek hulle van Kades-Barnéa af gestuur het om die land te bekyk.

kjv_text: For when they went up unto the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which the LORD had given them.
bsb_text: For when your fathers went up to the Valley of Eshcol and saw the land, they discouraged the Israelites from entering the land that the LORD had given them.
aov_text: Toe hulle tot by die dal Eskol opgetrek en die land bekyk het, het hulle die hart van die kinders van Israel afkerig gemaak om in die land in te trek wat die HERE aan hulle gegee het.

kjv_text: And the LORD's anger was kindled the same time, and he sware, saying,
bsb_text: So the anger of the LORD was kindled that day, and He swore an oath, saying,
aov_text: Daarom het die toorn van die HERE dieselfde dag ontvlam, en Hy het gesweer en gesê:

kjv_text: Surely none of the men that came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me:
bsb_text: ‘Because they did not follow Me wholeheartedly, not one of the men twenty years of age or older who came out of Egypt will see the land that I swore to give Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—
aov_text: Waarlik, geeneen van die manne wat uit Egipte opgetrek het, van twintig jaar oud en daarbo, sal die land sien wat Ek aan Abraham, Isak en Jakob met ’n eed beloof het nie; want hulle het nie volhard om My te volg nie —

kjv_text: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite, and Joshua the son of Nun: for they have wholly followed the LORD.
bsb_text: not one except Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite and Joshua son of Nun—because they did follow the LORD wholeheartedly.’
aov_text: behalwe Kaleb, die seun van Jefúnne, die Kenissiet, en Josua, die seun van Nun; want hulle het volhard om die HERE te volg.

kjv_text: And the LORD's anger was kindled against Israel, and he made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation, that had done evil in the sight of the LORD, was consumed.
bsb_text: The anger of the LORD burned against Israel, and He made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until the whole generation who had done evil in His sight was gone.
aov_text: En die toorn van die HERE het teen Israel ontvlam, en Hy het hulle veertig jaar lank in die woestyn laat rondswerwe, totdat die hele geslag verteer was wat kwaad gedoen het in die oë van die HERE.

kjv_text: And, behold, ye are risen up in your fathers' stead, an increase of sinful men, to augment yet the fierce anger of the LORD toward Israel.
bsb_text: Now behold, you, a brood of sinners, have risen up in place of your fathers to further stoke the burning anger of the LORD against Israel.
aov_text: En kyk, julle het opgestaan in die plek van julle vaders, ’n egte kroos van sondige mense, om die toorngloed van die HERE teen Israel nog te vermeerder.

kjv_text: For if ye turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and ye shall destroy all this people.
bsb_text: For if you turn away from following Him, He will once again leave this people in the wilderness, and you will be the cause of their destruction.”
aov_text: As julle van Hom afvallig word, sal Hy hulle nog langer in die woestyn laat bly, en julle sal hierdie hele volk te gronde laat gaan.

kjv_text: And they came near unto him, and said, We will build sheepfolds here for our cattle, and cities for our little ones:
bsb_text: Then the Gadites and Reubenites approached Moses and said, “We want to build sheepfolds here for our livestock and cities for our little ones.
aov_text: Toe kom hulle na hom toe aan en sê: Ons sal hier skaapkrale bou vir ons vee en stede vir ons kinders.

kjv_text: But we ourselves will go ready armed before the children of Israel, until we have brought them unto their place: and our little ones shall dwell in the fenced cities because of the inhabitants of the land.
bsb_text: But we will arm ourselves and be ready to go ahead of the Israelites until we have brought them into their place. Meanwhile, our little ones will remain in the fortified cities for protection from the inhabitants of the land.
aov_text: Maar ons self sal ons haastig wapen voor die oë van die kinders van Israel, totdat ons hulle op hul woonplek bring; en ons kinders sal in die versterkte stede bly vanweë die bewoners van die land.

kjv_text: We will not return unto our houses, until the children of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance.
bsb_text: We will not return to our homes until every Israelite has taken possession of his inheritance.
aov_text: Ons sal nie na ons huise teruggaan voordat die kinders van Israel elkeen in besit van sy erfdeel gekom het nie.

kjv_text: For we will not inherit with them on yonder side Jordan, or forward; because our inheritance is fallen to us on this side Jordan eastward.
bsb_text: Yet we will not have an inheritance with them across the Jordan and beyond, because our inheritance has come to us on the east side of the Jordan.”
aov_text: Want ons sal nie saam met hulle wes van die Jordaan en verder weg erwe nie, omdat ons erfdeel duskant die Jordaan, teen sonop, ons s’n geword het.

kjv_text: And Moses said unto them, If ye will do this thing, if ye will go armed before the LORD to war,
bsb_text: Moses replied, “If you will do this—if you will arm yourselves before the LORD for battle,
aov_text: Toe sê Moses vir hulle: As julle dit doen, as julle jul voor die aangesig van die HERE vir die oorlog wapen

kjv_text: And will go all of you armed over Jordan before the LORD, until he hath driven out his enemies from before him,
bsb_text: and if every one of your armed men crosses the Jordan before the LORD, until He has driven His enemies out before Him,
aov_text: en elke gewapende man van julle voor die aangesig van die HERE deur die Jordaan trek, totdat Hy sy vyande voor sy aangesig uit verdrywe het

kjv_text: And the land be subdued before the LORD: then afterward ye shall return, and be guiltless before the LORD, and before Israel; and this land shall be your possession before the LORD.
bsb_text: then when the land is subdued before the LORD, you may return and be free of obligation to the LORD and to Israel. And this land will belong to you as a possession before the LORD.
aov_text: en die land voor die aangesig van die HERE onderwerp is, en julle daarna teruggaan, dan sal julle vrygestel wees voor die HERE en voor Israel, en hierdie land sal vir julle ’n besitting word voor die aangesig van die HERE.

kjv_text: But if ye will not do so, behold, ye have sinned against the LORD: and be sure your sin will find you out.
bsb_text: But if you do not do this, you will certainly sin against the LORD—and be assured that your sin will find you out.
aov_text: Maar as julle nie so doen nie, kyk, dan sondig julle teen die HERE, en weet dan dat julle sonde julle sal uitvind.

kjv_text: Build you cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which hath proceeded out of your mouth.
bsb_text: Build cities for your little ones and folds for your flocks, but do what you have promised.”
aov_text: Bou vir julle stede vir jul kinders en krale vir jul kleinvee, en doen wat uit julle mond uitgegaan het.

kjv_text: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben spake unto Moses, saying, Thy servants will do as my lord commandeth.
bsb_text: The Gadites and Reubenites said to Moses, “Your servants will do just as our lord commands.
aov_text: Toe het die kinders van Gad en die kinders van Ruben met Moses gespreek en gesê: U dienaars sal doen soos my heer beveel het.

kjv_text: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our cattle, shall be there in the cities of Gilead:
bsb_text: Our children, our wives, our livestock, and all our animals will remain here in the cities of Gilead.
aov_text: Ons kinders, ons vroue, ons vee en al ons lasdiere sal daar in die stede van Gílead bly;

kjv_text: But thy servants will pass over, every man armed for war, before the LORD to battle, as my lord saith.
bsb_text: But your servants are equipped for war, and every man will cross over to the battle before the LORD, just as our lord says.”
aov_text: maar u dienaars, almal wat vir die oorlog gewapen is, sal voor die aangesig van die HERE na die oorlog oortrek soos my heer gespreek het.

kjv_text: So concerning them Moses commanded Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel:
bsb_text: So Moses gave orders about them to Eleazar the priest, to Joshua son of Nun, and to the family leaders of the tribes of Israel.
aov_text: Toe het Moses aangaande hulle aan die priester Eleásar en aan Josua, die seun van Nun, en aan die familiehoofde uit die stamme van die kinders van Israel bevel gegee,

kjv_text: And Moses said unto them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over Jordan, every man armed to battle, before the LORD, and the land shall be subdued before you; then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession:
bsb_text: And Moses said to them, “If the Gadites and Reubenites cross the Jordan with you, with every man armed for battle before the LORD, and the land is subdued before you, then you are to give them the land of Gilead as a possession.
aov_text: en Moses het aan hulle gesê: As die kinders van Gad en die kinders van Ruben saam met julle deur die Jordaan trek, almal wat vir die oorlog gewapen is, voor die aangesig van die HERE, en die land voor julle uit onderwerp is, gee dan aan hulle die land Gílead as ’n besitting.

kjv_text: But if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.
bsb_text: But if they do not arm themselves and go across with you, then they must accept their possession among you in the land of Canaan.”
aov_text: Maar as hulle nie gewapend saam met julle oortrek nie, moet hulle onder julle in die land Kanaän besittings verkry.

kjv_text: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, As the LORD hath said unto thy servants, so will we do.
bsb_text: The Gadites and Reubenites replied, “As the LORD has spoken to your servants, so we will do.
aov_text: En die kinders van Gad en die kinders van Ruben het geantwoord en gesê: Wat die HERE aan u dienaars gesê het, so sal ons doen.

kjv_text: We will pass over armed before the LORD into the land of Canaan, that the possession of our inheritance on this side Jordan may be ours.
bsb_text: We will cross over into the land of Canaan armed before the LORD, that we may have our inheritance on this side of the Jordan.”
aov_text: Ons sal gewapend oortrek voor die aangesig van die HERE na die land Kanaän, en ons erflike besitting oos van die Jordaan sal ons s’n wees.

kjv_text: And Moses gave unto them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and unto half the tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land, with the cities thereof in the coasts, even the cities of the country round about.
bsb_text: So Moses gave to the Gadites, to the Reubenites, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan—the land including its cities and the territory surrounding them.
aov_text: So het Moses dan aan hulle gegee, aan die kinders van Gad en die kinders van Ruben en die halwe stam van Manasse, die seun van Josef, die koninkryk van Sihon, koning van die Amoriete, en die koninkryk van Og, koning van Basan, die land volgens sy stede met die grondgebied wat daarby behoort, die stede van die land rondom.

kjv_text: And the children of Gad built Dibon, and Ataroth, and Aroer,
bsb_text: And the Gadites built up Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,
aov_text: En die kinders van Gad het Dibon gebou en Átarot en Ároër

kjv_text: And Atroth, Shophan, and Jaazer, and Jogbehah,
bsb_text: Atroth-shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,
aov_text: en Áterot-Sofan en Jaéser en Jógbeha

kjv_text: And Bethnimrah, and Bethharan, fenced cities: and folds for sheep.
bsb_text: Beth-nimrah, and Beth-haran as fortified cities, and they built folds for their flocks.
aov_text: en Bet-Nimra en Bet-Haran, versterkte stede en skaapkrale.

kjv_text: And the children of Reuben built Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Kirjathaim,
bsb_text: The Reubenites built up Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,
aov_text: En die kinders van Ruben het Hesbon gebou en Eleále en Kirjataim

kjv_text: And Nebo, and Baalmeon, (their names being changed,) and Shibmah: and gave other names unto the cities which they builded.
bsb_text: as well as Nebo and Baal-meon (whose names were changed), and Sibmah. And they renamed the cities they rebuilt.
aov_text: en Nebo en Baäl-Meon—met verandering van die name—en Sibma; en hulle het die stede wat hulle gebou het, name gegee.

kjv_text: And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, and took it, and dispossessed the Amorite which was in it.
bsb_text: The descendants of Machir son of Manasseh went to Gilead, captured it, and drove out the Amorites who were there.
aov_text: En die seuns van Magir, die seun van Manasse, het na Gílead gegaan en dit verower en die Amoriete verdrywe wat daarin was.

kjv_text: And Moses gave Gilead unto Machir the son of Manasseh; and he dwelt therein.
bsb_text: So Moses gave Gilead to the clan of Machir son of Manasseh, and they settled there.
aov_text: En Moses het Gílead aan Magir, die seun van Manasse, gegee; en hy het daarin gewoon.

kjv_text: And Jair the son of Manasseh went and took the small towns thereof, and called them Havothjair.
bsb_text: Jair, a descendant of Manasseh, went and captured their villages and called them Havvoth-jair.
aov_text: En Jaïr, die seun van Manasse, het gegaan en hulle tentdorpe ingeneem en dit tentdorpe van Jaïr genoem.

kjv_text: And Nobah went and took Kenath, and the villages thereof, and called it Nobah, after his own name.
bsb_text: And Nobah went and captured Kenath and its villages and called it Nobah, after his own name.
aov_text: En Nobag het gegaan en Kenat en die onderhorige plekke ingeneem en dit sy naam Nobag gegee.

kjv_text: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt with their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.
bsb_text: These are the journeys of the Israelites when they came out of the land of Egypt by their divisions under the leadership of Moses and Aaron.
aov_text: DIT is die trekke van die kinders van Israel wat uit Egipteland uitgetrek het volgens hulle leërafdelings, onder leiding van Moses en Aäron.

kjv_text: And Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of the LORD: and these are their journeys according to their goings out.
bsb_text: At the LORD’s command, Moses recorded the stages of their journey. These are the stages listed by their starting points:
aov_text: Volgens die bevel van die HERE het Moses die plekke opgeskrywe vanwaar hulle van plek tot plek verder getrek het; en dit is hulle plekke vanwaar hulle al verder getrek het.

kjv_text: And they departed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the morrow after the passover the children of Israel went out with an high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians.
bsb_text: On the fifteenth day of the first month, on the day after the Passover, the Israelites set out from Rameses. They marched out defiantly in full view of all the Egyptians,
aov_text: Hulle het van Raämses af opgebreek in die eerste maand, op die vyftiende dag van die eerste maand; op die dag ná die pasga het die kinders van Israel deur ’n hoë hand voor die oë van al die Egiptenaars uitgetrek,

kjv_text: For the Egyptians buried all their firstborn, which the LORD had smitten among them: upon their gods also the LORD executed judgments.
bsb_text: who were burying all their firstborn, whom the LORD had struck down among them; for the LORD had executed judgment against their gods.
aov_text: terwyl die Egiptenaars besig was om dié te begrawe wat die HERE onder hulle verslaan het, al die eersgeborenes; ook het die HERE aan hulle gode strafgerigte voltrek.

kjv_text: And the children of Israel removed from Rameses, and pitched in Succoth.
bsb_text: The Israelites set out from Rameses and camped at Succoth.
aov_text: Toe die kinders van Israel van Raämses af opgebreek het, het hulle laer opgeslaan in Sukkot.

kjv_text: And they departed from Succoth, and pitched in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.
bsb_text: They set out from Succoth and camped at Etham, on the edge of the wilderness.
aov_text: En hulle het van Sukkot af opgebreek en laer opgeslaan in Etam wat aan die kant van die woestyn lê.

kjv_text: And they removed from Etham, and turned again unto Pihahiroth, which is before Baalzephon: and they pitched before Migdol.
bsb_text: They set out from Etham and turned back to Pi-hahiroth, opposite Baal-zephon, and they camped near Migdol.
aov_text: En hulle het van Etam af opgebreek en weggedraai na Pi-Hágirot wat oos van Baäl-Sefon lê; en hulle het laer opgeslaan voor Migdol.

kjv_text: And they departed from before Pihahiroth, and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness, and went three days' journey in the wilderness of Etham, and pitched in Marah.
bsb_text: They set out from Pi-hahiroth and crossed through the sea, into the wilderness, and they journeyed three days into the Wilderness of Etham and camped at Marah.
aov_text: En hulle het van Pi-Hágirot af opgebreek en dwarsdeur die see gegaan na die woestyn toe; en hulle het drie dagreise ver die woestyn van Etam ingetrek en laer opgeslaan in Mara.

kjv_text: And they removed from Marah, and came unto Elim: and in Elim were twelve fountains of water, and threescore and ten palm trees; and they pitched there.
bsb_text: They set out from Marah and came to Elim, where there were twelve springs and seventy palm trees, and they camped there.
aov_text: En hulle het van Mara af opgebreek en by Elim gekom; en in Elim was twaalf waterfonteine en sewentig palmbome, en hulle het daar laer opgeslaan.

kjv_text: And they removed from Elim, and encamped by the Red sea.
bsb_text: They set out from Elim and camped by the Red Sea.
aov_text: En hulle het van Elim af opgebreek en laer opgeslaan by die Skelfsee.

kjv_text: And they removed from the Red sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.
bsb_text: They set out from the Red Sea and camped in the Desert of Sin.
aov_text: En hulle het van die Skelfsee af opgebreek en laer opgeslaan in die woestyn Sin.

kjv_text: And they took their journey out of the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.
bsb_text: They set out from the Desert of Sin and camped at Dophkah.
aov_text: En hulle het uit die woestyn Sin opgebreek en laer opgeslaan in Dofka.

kjv_text: And they departed from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.
bsb_text: They set out from Dophkah and camped at Alush.
aov_text: En hulle het van Dofka af opgebreek en laer opgeslaan in Alus.

kjv_text: And they removed from Alush, and encamped at Rephidim, where was no water for the people to drink.
bsb_text: They set out from Alush and camped at Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.
aov_text: En hulle het van Alus af opgebreek en laer opgeslaan in Ráfidim; maar daar was geen water vir die volk om te drink nie.

kjv_text: And they departed from Rephidim, and pitched in the wilderness of Sinai.
bsb_text: They set out from Rephidim and camped in the Wilderness of Sinai.
aov_text: En hulle het van Ráfidim af opgebreek en laer opgeslaan in die woestyn Sinai.

kjv_text: And they removed from the desert of Sinai, and pitched at Kibrothhattaavah.
bsb_text: They set out from the Wilderness of Sinai and camped at Kibroth-hattaavah.
aov_text: En hulle het uit die woestyn Sinai opgebreek en laer opgeslaan in Kibrot-Hattáäwa.

kjv_text: And they departed from Kibrothhattaavah, and encamped at Hazeroth.
bsb_text: They set out from Kibroth-hattaavah and camped at Hazeroth.
aov_text: En hulle het van Kibrot-Hat-táäwa af opgebreek en laer opgeslaan in Háserot.

kjv_text: And they departed from Hazeroth, and pitched in Rithmah.
bsb_text: They set out from Hazeroth and camped at Rithmah.
aov_text: En hulle het van Háserot af opgebreek en laer opgeslaan in Ritma.

kjv_text: And they departed from Rithmah, and pitched at Rimmonparez.
bsb_text: They set out from Rithmah and camped at Rimmon-perez.
aov_text: En hulle het van Ritma af opgebreek en laer opgeslaan in Rimmon-Peres.

kjv_text: And they departed from Rimmonparez, and pitched in Libnah.
bsb_text: They set out from Rimmon-perez and camped at Libnah.
aov_text: En hulle het van Rimmon-Peres af opgebreek en laer opgeslaan in Libna.

kjv_text: And they removed from Libnah, and pitched at Rissah.
bsb_text: They set out from Libnah and camped at Rissah.
aov_text: En hulle het van Libna af opgebreek en laer opgeslaan in Rissa.

kjv_text: And they journeyed from Rissah, and pitched in Kehelathah.
bsb_text: They set out from Rissah and camped at Kehelathah.
aov_text: En hulle het van Rissa af opgebreek en laer opgeslaan in Keheláta.

kjv_text: And they went from Kehelathah, and pitched in mount Shapher.
bsb_text: They set out from Kehelathah and camped at Mount Shepher.
aov_text: En hulle het van Keheláta af opgebreek en laer opgeslaan by die berg Sefer.

kjv_text: And they removed from mount Shapher, and encamped in Haradah.
bsb_text: They set out from Mount Shepher and camped at Haradah.
aov_text: En hulle het van die berg Sefer af opgebreek en laer opgeslaan in Hárada.

kjv_text: And they removed from Haradah, and pitched in Makheloth.
bsb_text: They set out from Haradah and camped at Makheloth.
aov_text: En hulle het van Hárada af opgebreek en laer opgeslaan in Mákhelot.

kjv_text: And they removed from Makheloth, and encamped at Tahath.
bsb_text: They set out from Makheloth and camped at Tahath.
aov_text: En hulle het van Mákhelot af opgebreek en laer opgeslaan in Tahat.

kjv_text: And they departed from Tahath, and pitched at Tarah.
bsb_text: They set out from Tahath and camped at Terah.
aov_text: En hulle het van Tahat af opgebreek en laer opgeslaan in Terag.

kjv_text: And they removed from Tarah, and pitched in Mithcah.
bsb_text: They set out from Terah and camped at Mithkah.
aov_text: En hulle het van Terag af opgebreek en laer opgeslaan in Mitka.

kjv_text: And they went from Mithcah, and pitched in Hashmonah.
bsb_text: They set out from Mithkah and camped at Hashmonah.
aov_text: En hulle het van Mitka af opgebreek en laer opgeslaan in Hasmóna.

kjv_text: And they departed from Hashmonah, and encamped at Moseroth.
bsb_text: They set out from Hashmonah and camped at Moseroth.
aov_text: En hulle het van Hasmóna af opgebreek en laer opgeslaan in Móserot.

kjv_text: And they departed from Moseroth, and pitched in Benejaakan.
bsb_text: They set out from Moseroth and camped at Bene-jaakan.
aov_text: En hulle het van Móserot af opgebreek en laer opgeslaan in Bene-Jáäkan.

kjv_text: And they removed from Benejaakan, and encamped at Horhagidgad.
bsb_text: They set out from Bene-jaakan and camped at Hor-haggidgad.
aov_text: En hulle het van Bene-Jáäkan af opgebreek en laer opgeslaan in Hor-Hággidgad.

kjv_text: And they went from Horhagidgad, and pitched in Jotbathah.
bsb_text: They set out from Hor-haggidgad and camped at Jotbathah.
aov_text: En hulle het van Hor-Hággidgad af opgebreek en laer opgeslaan in Jotbáta.

kjv_text: And they removed from Jotbathah, and encamped at Ebronah.
bsb_text: They set out from Jotbathah and camped at Abronah.
aov_text: En hulle het van Jotbáta af opgebreek en laer opgeslaan in Abróna.

kjv_text: And they departed from Ebronah, and encamped at Eziongaber.
bsb_text: They set out from Abronah and camped at Ezion-geber.
aov_text: En hulle het van Abróna af opgebreek en laer opgeslaan in Éseon-Geber.

kjv_text: And they removed from Eziongaber, and pitched in the wilderness of Zin, which is Kadesh.
bsb_text: They set out from Ezion-geber and camped at Kadesh in the Wilderness of Zin.
aov_text: En hulle het van Éseon-Geber af opgebreek en laer opgeslaan in die woestyn Sin, dit is Kades.

kjv_text: And they removed from Kadesh, and pitched in mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.
bsb_text: They set out from Kadesh and camped at Mount Hor, on the outskirts of the land of Edom.
aov_text: En hulle het van Kades af opgebreek en laer opgeslaan by die berg Hor, aan die kant van die land Edom.

kjv_text: And Aaron the priest went up into mount Hor at the commandment of the LORD, and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the first day of the fifth month.
bsb_text: At the LORD’s command, Aaron the priest climbed Mount Hor and died there on the first day of the fifth month, in the fortieth year after the Israelites had come out of the land of Egypt.
aov_text: Toe het die priester Aäron volgens die bevel van die HERE op die berg Hor geklim en daar gesterwe, in die veertigste jaar ná die uittog van die kinders van Israel uit Egipteland, in die vyfde maand, op die eerste van die maand.

kjv_text: And Aaron was an hundred and twenty and three years old when he died in mount Hor.
bsb_text: Aaron was 123 years old when he died on Mount Hor.
aov_text: En Aäron was honderd-drie-en-twintig jaar oud toe hy op die berg Hor gesterf het.

kjv_text: And king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.
bsb_text: Now the Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the Negev in the land of Canaan, heard that the Israelites were coming.
aov_text: En die Kanaäniet, die koning van Arad, wat in die Suidland in die land Kanaän gewoon het, het gehoor dat die kinders van Israel aankom.

kjv_text: And they departed from mount Hor, and pitched in Zalmonah.
bsb_text: And the Israelites set out from Mount Hor and camped at Zalmonah.
aov_text: En hulle het van die berg Hor af opgebreek en laer opgeslaan in Sálmona.

kjv_text: And they departed from Zalmonah, and pitched in Punon.
bsb_text: They set out from Zalmonah and camped at Punon.
aov_text: En hulle het van Sálmona af opgebreek en laer opgeslaan in Punon.

kjv_text: And they departed from Punon, and pitched in Oboth.
bsb_text: They set out from Punon and camped at Oboth.
aov_text: En hulle het van Punon af opgebreek en laer opgeslaan in Obot.

kjv_text: And they departed from Oboth, and pitched in Ijeabarim, in the border of Moab.
bsb_text: They set out from Oboth and camped at Iye-abarim on the border of Moab.
aov_text: En hulle het van Obot af opgebreek en laer opgeslaan in Ijje-Haäbarim, by die grens van Moab.

kjv_text: And they departed from Iim, and pitched in Dibongad.
bsb_text: They set out from Iyim and camped at Dibon-gad.
aov_text: En hulle het van Ijjim af opgebreek en laer opgeslaan in Dibon-Gad.

kjv_text: And they removed from Dibongad, and encamped in Almondiblathaim.
bsb_text: They set out from Dibon-gad and camped at Almon-diblathaim.
aov_text: En hulle het van Dibon-Gad af opgebreek en laer opgeslaan in Almon-Diblataim.

kjv_text: And they removed from Almondiblathaim, and pitched in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
bsb_text: They set out from Almon-diblathaim and camped in the mountains of Abarim facing Nebo.
aov_text: En hulle het van Almon-Diblataim af opgebreek en laer opgeslaan in die gebergte Abárim, voor Nebo.

kjv_text: And they departed from the mountains of Abarim, and pitched in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
bsb_text: They set out from the mountains of Abarim and camped on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho.
aov_text: En hulle het van die gebergte Abárim af opgebreek en laer opgeslaan in die vlaktes van Moab, by die Jordaan van Jérigo.

kjv_text: And they pitched by Jordan, from Bethjesimoth even unto Abelshittim in the plains of Moab.
bsb_text: And there on the plains of Moab they camped by the Jordan, from Beth-jeshimoth to Abel-shittim.
aov_text: En hulle het laer opgeslaan by die Jordaan van Bet-Hajésimot af tot by Abel-Hassittim, in die vlaktes van Moab.

kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,
bsb_text: On the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho, the LORD said to Moses,
aov_text: En die HERE het met Moses gespreek in die vlaktes van Moab, by die Jordaan van Jérigo, en gesê:

kjv_text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye are passed over Jordan into the land of Canaan;
bsb_text: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them: When you cross the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
aov_text: Spreek met die kinders van Israel en sê vir hulle: As julle deur die Jordaan in die land Kanaän intrek,

kjv_text: Then ye shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and destroy all their pictures, and destroy all their molten images, and quite pluck down all their high places:
bsb_text: you must drive out before you all the inhabitants of the land, destroy all their carved images and cast idols, and demolish all their high places.
aov_text: moet julle al die bewoners van die land voor julle uit verdrywe en hulle beeldhouwerk verniel; ook moet julle al hulle gegote beelde verniel en al hulle hoogtes verwoes.

kjv_text: And ye shall dispossess the inhabitants of the land, and dwell therein: for I have given you the land to possess it.
bsb_text: You are to take possession of the land and settle in it, for I have given you the land to possess.
aov_text: En julle moet die land in besit neem en daarin woon; want Ek het die land aan julle gegee om dit te besit.

kjv_text: And ye shall divide the land by lot for an inheritance among your families: and to the more ye shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer ye shall give the less inheritance: every man's inheritance shall be in the place where his lot falleth; according to the tribes of your fathers ye shall inherit.
bsb_text: And you are to divide the land by lot according to your clans. Give a larger inheritance to a larger clan and a smaller inheritance to a smaller one. Whatever falls to each one by lot will be his. You will receive an inheritance according to the tribes of your fathers.
aov_text: En julle moet die land deur die lot as erfdeel verwerwe, volgens julle geslagte; vir die wat baie is, moet julle hulle erfdeel groot maak, en vir die wat min is, moet jy hulle erfdeel klein maak. Waar die lot vir iemand val, moet dit sy deel wees; volgens julle vaderlike stamme moet julle dit as erfdeel verwerwe.

kjv_text: But if ye will not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you; then it shall come to pass, that those which ye let remain of them shall be pricks in your eyes, and thorns in your sides, and shall vex you in the land wherein ye dwell.
bsb_text: But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land before you, those you allow to remain will become barbs in your eyes and thorns in your sides; they will harass you in the land where you settle.
aov_text: Maar as julle die bewoners van die land nie voor julle uit verdrywe nie, sal die wat julle van hulle laat oorbly, soos dorings in julle oë wees en soos angels in julle sye, en hulle sal julle beveg in die land waar julle in woon.

kjv_text: Moreover it shall come to pass, that I shall do unto you, as I thought to do unto them.
bsb_text: And then I will do to you what I had planned to do to them.”
aov_text: En soos Ek gedink het om aan hulle te doen, sal Ek aan julle doen.

kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to Moses,
aov_text: VERDER het die HERE met Moses gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land of Canaan; (this is the land that shall fall unto you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan with the coasts thereof:)
bsb_text: “Command the Israelites and say to them: When you enter the land of Canaan, it will be allotted to you as an inheritance with these boundaries:
aov_text: Gee bevel aan die kinders van Israel en sê vir hulle: As julle in die land Kanaän kom, sal dit die land wees wat aan julle as erfdeel sal val; die land Kanaän volgens sy grense.

kjv_text: Then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the coast of Edom, and your south border shall be the outmost coast of the salt sea eastward:
bsb_text: Your southern border will extend from the Wilderness of Zin along the border of Edom. On the east, your southern border will run from the end of the Salt Sea,
aov_text: Julle suidekant dan moet van die woestyn Sin af langs Edom wees; en julle suidelike grens moet aan die oostekant van die einde van die Soutsee af wees;

kjv_text: And your border shall turn from the south to the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass on to Zin: and the going forth thereof shall be from the south to Kadeshbarnea, and shall go on to Hazaraddar, and pass on to Azmon:
bsb_text: cross south of the Ascent of Akrabbim, continue to Zin, and go south of Kadesh-barnea. Then it will go on to Hazar-addar and proceed to Azmon,
aov_text: en julle grens moet suid van Skerpioennek swaai en oorloop na Sin toe, totdat dit doodloop suid van Kades-Barnéa; dan moet dit aanloop na Hasar-Addar en oor na Asmon toe.

kjv_text: And the border shall fetch a compass from Azmon unto the river of Egypt, and the goings out of it shall be at the sea.
bsb_text: where it will turn from Azmon, join the Brook of Egypt, and end at the Sea.
aov_text: Verder moet die grens swaai van Asmon af na die spruit van Egipte toe, sodat dit by die see doodloop.

kjv_text: And as for the western border, ye shall even have the great sea for a border: this shall be your west border.
bsb_text: Your western border will be the coastline of the Great Sea; this will be your boundary on the west.
aov_text: Aangaande die westelike grens, dit moet vir julle die Groot See saam met sy gebied wees; dit moet julle westelike grens wees.

kjv_text: And this shall be your north border: from the great sea ye shall point out for you mount Hor:
bsb_text: Your northern border will run from the Great Sea directly to Mount Hor,
aov_text: En dit moet julle noordelike grens wees: van die Groot See af moet julle jul grenslyn trek na die berg Hor.

kjv_text: From mount Hor ye shall point out your border unto the entrance of Hamath; and the goings forth of the border shall be to Zedad:
bsb_text: and from Mount Hor to Lebo-hamath, then extend to Zedad,
aov_text: Van die berg Hor af moet julle die grenslyn trek tot by die ingang na Hamat; en die grens moet doodloop by Sedad.

kjv_text: And the border shall go on to Ziphron, and the goings out of it shall be at Hazarenan: this shall be your north border.
bsb_text: continue to Ziphron, and end at Hazar-enan. This will be your boundary on the north.
aov_text: Dan moet die grens aanloop na Sifron toe, en dit moet doodloop by Hasar-Enan. Dit moet julle noordelike grens wees.

kjv_text: And ye shall point out your east border from Hazarenan to Shepham:
bsb_text: And your eastern border will run straight from Hazar-enan to Shepham,
aov_text: Verder moet julle as jul oostelike grens die lyn trek van Hasar-Enan af na Sefam toe.

kjv_text: And the coast shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border shall descend, and shall reach unto the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward:
bsb_text: then go down from Shepham to Riblah on the east side of Ain and continue along the slopes east of the Sea of Chinnereth.
aov_text: En die grens moet afloop van Sefam af na Haribla toe, oos van Ajin; dan moet die grens afloop en skrams oor die hange van die meer Kinnéret gaan, aan die oostekant.

kjv_text: And the border shall go down to Jordan, and the goings out of it shall be at the salt sea: this shall be your land with the coasts thereof round about.
bsb_text: Then the border will go down along the Jordan and end at the Salt Sea. This will be your land, defined by its borders on all sides.”
aov_text: Verder moet die grens afloop na die Jordaan totdat dit doodloop by die Soutsee. Dit moet vir julle die land wees volgens sy grense rondom.

kjv_text: And Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, This is the land which ye shall inherit by lot, which the LORD commanded to give unto the nine tribes, and to the half tribe:
bsb_text: So Moses commanded the Israelites, “Apportion this land by lot as an inheritance. The LORD has commanded that it be given to the nine and a half tribes.
aov_text: En Moses het aan die kinders van Israel bevel gegee en gesê: Dit is die land wat julle deur die lot as erfdeel sal verwerwe, wat die HERE beveel het om aan die nege stamme en aan die halwe stam te gee.

kjv_text: For the tribe of the children of Reuben according to the house of their fathers, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to the house of their fathers, have received their inheritance; and half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance:
bsb_text: For the tribes of the Reubenites and Gadites, along with the half-tribe of Manasseh, have already received their inheritance.
aov_text: Want die stam van die kinders van die Rubeniete volgens hulle families en die stam van die kinders van die Gadiete volgens hulle families en die halwe stam van Manasse het al ontvang—hulle het hul erfdeel ontvang.

kjv_text: The two tribes and the half tribe have received their inheritance on this side Jordan near Jericho eastward, toward the sunrising.
bsb_text: These two and a half tribes have received their inheritance across the Jordan from Jericho, toward the sunrise.”
aov_text: Die twee stamme en die halwe stam het hulle erfdeel aan die oostekant van die Jordaan van Jérigo, teen sonop, ontvang.

kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to Moses,
aov_text: Verder het die HERE met Moses gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: These are the names of the men which shall divide the land unto you: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.
bsb_text: “These are the names of the men who are to assign the land as an inheritance for you: Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun.
aov_text: Dit is die name van die manne wat vir julle die land as erfenis moet verdeel: die priester Eleásar en Josua, die seun van Nun.

kjv_text: And ye shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land by inheritance.
bsb_text: Appoint one leader from each tribe to distribute the land.
aov_text: Daarby moet julle uit elke stam een owerste neem om die land as erfenis te verdeel.

kjv_text: And the names of the men are these: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
bsb_text: These are their names: Caleb son of Jephunneh from the tribe of Judah;
aov_text: En dit is die name van die manne: van die stam van Juda—Kaleb, die seun van Jefúnne;

kjv_text: And of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.
bsb_text: Shemuel son of Ammihud from the tribe of Simeon;
aov_text: en van die stam van Símeon se kinders—Sémuel, die seun van Ámmihud;

kjv_text: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.
bsb_text: Elidad son of Chislon from the tribe of Benjamin;
aov_text: van die stam van Benjamin—Elídad, die seun van Kislon;

kjv_text: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Dan, Bukki the son of Jogli.
bsb_text: Bukki son of Jogli, a leader from the tribe of Dan;
aov_text: en van die stam van Dan se kinders as owerste—Bukki, die seun van Jogli;

kjv_text: The prince of the children of Joseph, for the tribe of the children of Manasseh, Hanniel the son of Ephod.
bsb_text: Hanniel son of Ephod, a leader from the tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph;
aov_text: van die kinders van Josef: van die stam van Manasse se kinders as owerste—Hánniël, die seun van Efod;

kjv_text: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Ephraim, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.
bsb_text: Kemuel son of Shiphtan, a leader from the tribe of Ephraim;
aov_text: en van die stam van Efraim se kinders as owerste—Kémuel, die seun van Siftan;

kjv_text: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Zebulun, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.
bsb_text: Eli-zaphan son of Parnach, a leader from the tribe of Zebulun;
aov_text: en van die stam van Sébulon se kinders as owerste—Elísafan, die seun van Parnag;

kjv_text: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Issachar, Paltiel the son of Azzan.
bsb_text: Paltiel son of Azzan, a leader from the tribe of Issachar;
aov_text: en van die stam van Íssaskar se kinders as owerste—Páltiël, die seun van Assan;

kjv_text: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Asher, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.
bsb_text: Ahihud son of Shelomi, a leader from the tribe of Asher;
aov_text: en van die stam van Aser se kinders as owerste—Ahíhud, die seun van Selómi;

kjv_text: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Naphtali, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.
bsb_text: and Pedahel son of Ammihud, a leader from the tribe of Naphtali.”
aov_text: en van die stam van Náftali se kinders as owerste—Pedáel, die seun van Ámmihud.

kjv_text: These are they whom the LORD commanded to divide the inheritance unto the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.
bsb_text: These are the ones whom the LORD commanded to apportion the inheritance to the Israelites in the land of Canaan.
aov_text: Dit is hulle aan wie die HERE bevel gegee het om die erfenis vir die kinders van Israel in die land Kanaän te verdeel.

kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,
bsb_text: Again the LORD spoke to Moses on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho:
aov_text: EN die HERE het met Moses gespreek in die vlaktes van Moab, by die Jordaan van Jérigo, en gesê:

kjv_text: Command the children of Israel, that they give unto the Levites of the inheritance of their possession cities to dwell in; and ye shall give also unto the Levites suburbs for the cities round about them.
bsb_text: “Command the Israelites to give, from the inheritance they will possess, cities for the Levites to live in and pasturelands around the cities.
aov_text: Gee bevel aan die kinders van Israel dat hulle aan die Leviete van hulle erflike besitting stede gee om te bewoon; ook moet julle weiveld rondom die stede aan die Leviete gee.

kjv_text: And the cities shall they have to dwell in; and the suburbs of them shall be for their cattle, and for their goods, and for all their beasts.
bsb_text: The cities will be for them to live in, and the pasturelands will be for their herds, their flocks, and all their other livestock.
aov_text: En die stede moet vir hulle dien om te bewoon; maar die weiveld wat daarby behoort, moet vir hulle diere en hulle besitting en al hulle lewende hawe wees.

kjv_text: And the suburbs of the cities, which ye shall give unto the Levites, shall reach from the wall of the city and outward a thousand cubits round about.
bsb_text: The pasturelands around the cities you are to give the Levites will extend a thousand cubits from the wall on every side.
aov_text: En die weiveld van die stede wat julle aan die Leviete gee, moet van die stadsmuur af buitentoe duisend el rondom wees.

kjv_text: And ye shall measure from without the city on the east side two thousand cubits, and on the south side two thousand cubits, and on the west side two thousand cubits, and on the north side two thousand cubits; and the city shall be in the midst: this shall be to them the suburbs of the cities.
bsb_text: You are also to measure two thousand cubits outside the city on the east, two thousand on the south, two thousand on the west, and two thousand on the north, with the city in the center. These areas will serve as larger pasturelands for the cities.
aov_text: En julle moet buitekant die stad meet: aan die oostekant tweeduisend el en aan die suidekant tweeduisend el en aan die westekant tweeduisend el en aan die noordekant tweeduisend el, en die stad in die middel. Dit moet vir hulle as weiveld van die stede dien.

kjv_text: And among the cities which ye shall give unto the Levites there shall be six cities for refuge, which ye shall appoint for the manslayer, that he may flee thither: and to them ye shall add forty and two cities.
bsb_text: Six of the cities you give the Levites are to be appointed as cities of refuge, to which a manslayer may flee. In addition to these, give the Levites forty-two other cities.
aov_text: En die stede wat julle aan die Leviete gee, moet die ses vrystede wees wat julle moet gee, dat die een wat ’n doodslag begaan het, daarheen kan vlug; en daarby moet julle twee-en-veertig stede gee.

kjv_text: So all the cities which ye shall give to the Levites shall be forty and eight cities: them shall ye give with their suburbs.
bsb_text: The total number of cities you give the Levites will be forty-eight, with their corresponding pasturelands.
aov_text: Al die stede wat julle aan die Leviete gee, moet wees agt-en-veertig stede, hulle saam met hul weiveld.

kjv_text: And the cities which ye shall give shall be of the possession of the children of Israel: from them that have many ye shall give many; but from them that have few ye shall give few: every one shall give of his cities unto the Levites according to his inheritance which he inheriteth.
bsb_text: The cities that you apportion from the territory of the Israelites should be given to the Levites in proportion to the inheritance of each tribe: more from a larger tribe and less from a smaller one.”
aov_text: En wat die stede betref wat julle uit die besitting van die kinders van Israel gee—julle moet van die wat baie is, baie neem, en van die wat min is, min neem; elke stam moet van sy stede aan die Leviete gee volgens die erfdeel wat elkeen gaan kry.

kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to Moses,
aov_text: Verder het die HERE met Moses gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come over Jordan into the land of Canaan;
bsb_text: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them: When you cross the Jordan into the land of Canaan,
aov_text: Spreek met die kinders van Israel en sê vir hulle: As julle deur die Jordaan na die land Kanaän trek,

kjv_text: Then ye shall appoint you cities to be cities of refuge for you; that the slayer may flee thither, which killeth any person at unawares.
bsb_text: designate cities to serve as your cities of refuge, so that a person who kills someone unintentionally may flee there.
aov_text: moet julle gunstig geleë stede vir julle uitsoek; as vrystede moet hulle vir julle dien, dat die een wat ’n doodslag begaan het, een wat per ongeluk ’n mens doodgeslaan het, daarheen kan vlug.

kjv_text: And they shall be unto you cities for refuge from the avenger; that the manslayer die not, until he stand before the congregation in judgment.
bsb_text: You are to have these cities as a refuge from the avenger, so that the manslayer will not die until he stands trial before the assembly.
aov_text: En die stede moet vir julle as toevlug dien vanweë die bloedwreker, sodat hy wat ’n doodslag begaan het, nie sterwe voordat hy voor die vergadering gestaan het om geoordeel te word nie.

kjv_text: And of these cities which ye shall give six cities shall ye have for refuge.
bsb_text: The cities you select will be your six cities of refuge.
aov_text: En die stede wat julle gee, moet vir julle, ses in getal, as vrystede dien.

kjv_text: Ye shall give three cities on this side Jordan, and three cities shall ye give in the land of Canaan, which shall be cities of refuge.
bsb_text: Select three cities across the Jordan and three in the land of Canaan as cities of refuge.
aov_text: Drie van die stede moet julle oos van die Jordaan gee, en drie daarvan moet julle in die land Kanaän gee; vrystede moet hulle wees.

kjv_text: These six cities shall be a refuge, both for the children of Israel, and for the stranger, and for the sojourner among them: that every one that killeth any person unawares may flee thither.
bsb_text: These six cities will serve as a refuge for the Israelites and for the foreigner or stranger among them, so that anyone who kills a person unintentionally may flee there.
aov_text: Vir die kinders van Israel en die vreemdeling en die bywoner onder hulle moet hierdie ses stede as toevlug dien, sodat elkeen daarheen kan vlug wat per ongeluk ’n mens doodgeslaan het.

kjv_text: And if he smite him with an instrument of iron, so that he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
bsb_text: If, however, anyone strikes a person with an iron object and kills him, he is a murderer; the murderer must surely be put to death.
aov_text: Maar as hy hom slaan met ’n ystervoorwerp, sodat hy sterwe, dan is hy ’n moordenaar; die moordenaar moet sekerlik gedood word.

kjv_text: And if he smite him with throwing a stone, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
bsb_text: Or if anyone has in his hand a stone of deadly size, and he strikes and kills another, he is a murderer; the murderer must surely be put to death.
aov_text: En as hy hom slaan met ’n klip in die hand—waardeur iemand kan sterwe—en hy sterwe, dan is hy ’n moordenaar; die moordenaar moet sekerlik gedood word.

kjv_text: Or if he smite him with an hand weapon of wood, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
bsb_text: If anyone has in his hand a deadly object of wood, and he strikes and kills another, he is a murderer; the murderer must surely be put to death.
aov_text: Of as hy hom slaan met ’n houtvoorwerp in die hand—waardeur iemand kan sterwe—en hy sterwe, dan is hy ’n moordenaar; die moordenaar moet sekerlik gedood word.

kjv_text: The revenger of blood himself shall slay the murderer: when he meeteth him, he shall slay him.
bsb_text: The avenger of blood is to put the murderer to death; when he finds him, he is to kill him.
aov_text: Die bloedwreker, hy moet die moordenaar doodmaak; as hy hom kry, moet hy hom doodmaak.

kjv_text: But if he thrust him of hatred, or hurl at him by laying of wait, that he die;
bsb_text: Likewise, if anyone maliciously pushes another or intentionally throws an object at him and kills him,
aov_text: En as hy hom uit haat stamp of met opset na hom gooi, sodat hy sterwe,

kjv_text: Or in enmity smite him with his hand, that he die: he that smote him shall surely be put to death; for he is a murderer: the revenger of blood shall slay the murderer, when he meeteth him.
bsb_text: or if in hostility he strikes him with his hand and he dies, the one who struck him must surely be put to death; he is a murderer. When the avenger of blood finds the murderer, he is to kill him.
aov_text: of hom uit vyandskap met sy hand slaan, sodat hy sterwe, dan moet hy wat geslaan het, sekerlik gedood word; hy is ’n moordenaar; die bloedwreker moet die moordenaar doodmaak as hy hom kry.
