kjv_text: But if he thrust him suddenly without enmity, or have cast upon him any thing without laying of wait,
bsb_text: But if anyone pushes a person suddenly, without hostility, or throws an object at him unintentionally,
aov_text: Maar as hy hom onvoorsiens, sonder vyandskap, stamp of enigiets sonder opset na hom gooi;

kjv_text: Or with any stone, wherewith a man may die, seeing him not, and cast it upon him, that he die, and was not his enemy, neither sought his harm:
bsb_text: or without looking drops a heavy stone that kills him, but he was not an enemy and did not intend to harm him,
aov_text: of as hy enige klip waardeur iemand kan sterwe—as hy, sonder om dit te sien, dit op hom laat val, sodat hy sterwe, terwyl hy geen vyand van hom was en sy onheil nie gesoek het nie,

kjv_text: Then the congregation shall judge between the slayer and the revenger of blood according to these judgments:
bsb_text: then the congregation must judge between the slayer and the avenger of blood according to these ordinances.
aov_text: dan moet die vergadering tussen hom wat doodgeslaan het, en die bloedwreker oordeel volgens hierdie voorskrifte.

kjv_text: And the congregation shall deliver the slayer out of the hand of the revenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to the city of his refuge, whither he was fled: and he shall abide in it unto the death of the high priest, which was anointed with the holy oil.
bsb_text: The assembly is to protect the manslayer from the hand of the avenger of blood. Then the assembly will return him to the city of refuge to which he fled, and he must live there until the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.
aov_text: En die vergadering moet hom wat ’n doodslag begaan het, red uit die hand van die bloedwreker, en die vergadering moet hom laat teruggaan na sy vrystad waarheen hy gevlug het; en hy moet daarin bly tot die dood van die hoëpriester wat met die heilige olie gesalf is.

kjv_text: But if the slayer shall at any time come without the border of the city of his refuge, whither he was fled;
bsb_text: But if the manslayer ever goes outside the limits of the city of refuge to which he fled
aov_text: Maar as hy wat ’n doodslag begaan het, ooit buitekant die grens van sy vrystad gaan waarheen hy moes vlug,

kjv_text: And the revenger of blood find him without the borders of the city of his refuge, and the revenger of blood kill the slayer; he shall not be guilty of blood:
bsb_text: and the avenger of blood finds him outside of his city of refuge and kills him, then the avenger will not be guilty of bloodshed
aov_text: en die bloedwreker hom buitekant die grens van sy vrystad kry, en die bloedwreker hom doodslaan wat ’n doodslag begaan het, dan sal daar vir hom geen bloedskuld wees nie.

kjv_text: Because he should have remained in the city of his refuge until the death of the high priest: but after the death of the high priest the slayer shall return into the land of his possession.
bsb_text: because the manslayer must remain in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest. Only after the death of the high priest may he return to the land he owns.
aov_text: Want hy moet in sy vrystad bly tot die dood van die hoëpriester; maar ná die dood van die hoëpriester mag die een wat ’n doodslag begaan het, teruggaan na die land waar sy besitting lê.

kjv_text: So these things shall be for a statute of judgment unto you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
bsb_text: This will be a statutory ordinance for you for the generations to come, wherever you live.
aov_text: En dit moet vir julle ’n regsinsetting wees in julle geslagte, in al julle woonplekke.

kjv_text: Whoso killeth any person, the murderer shall be put to death by the mouth of witnesses: but one witness shall not testify against any person to cause him to die.
bsb_text: If anyone kills a person, the murderer is to be put to death on the testimony of the witnesses. But no one is to be put to death based on the testimony of a lone witness.
aov_text: As iemand ’n mens doodslaan, moet die moordenaar op verklaring van getuies gedood word; maar een getuie is nie genoegsaam om iemand tot die dood te veroordeel nie.

kjv_text: Moreover ye shall take no satisfaction for the life of a murderer, which is guilty of death: but he shall be surely put to death.
bsb_text: You are not to accept a ransom for the life of a murderer who deserves to die; he must surely be put to death.
aov_text: Maar julle mag geen losgeld aanneem vir die lewe van ’n moordenaar wat skuldig is om te sterwe nie, want hy moet sekerlik gedood word.

kjv_text: And ye shall take no satisfaction for him that is fled to the city of his refuge, that he should come again to dwell in the land, until the death of the priest.
bsb_text: Nor should you accept a ransom for the person who flees to a city of refuge and allow him to return and live on his own land before the death of the high priest.
aov_text: Ook mag julle geen geld aanneem om iemand vry te stel van die vlug na sy vrystad—sodat hy kan teruggaan om in die land te woon—tot op die dood van die hoëpriester nie.

kjv_text: So ye shall not pollute the land wherein ye are: for blood it defileth the land: and the land cannot be cleansed of the blood that is shed therein, but by the blood of him that shed it.
bsb_text: Do not pollute the land where you live, for bloodshed pollutes the land, and no atonement can be made for the land on which the blood is shed, except by the blood of the one who shed it.
aov_text: En julle mag die land nie ontheilig waar julle in is nie; want die bloed ontheilig die land, en vir die land word geen versoening gedoen vir die bloed wat daarin vergiet is nie, as net deur die bloed van hom wat dit vergiet het.

kjv_text: Defile not therefore the land which ye shall inhabit, wherein I dwell: for I the LORD dwell among the children of Israel.
bsb_text: Do not defile the land where you live and where I dwell. For I, the LORD, dwell among the Israelites.”
aov_text: En jy mag die land waar julle in woon, nie verontreinig nie, omdat Ek daarin woon; want Ek, die HERE, woon in die midde van die kinders van Israel.

kjv_text: And the chief fathers of the families of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near, and spake before Moses, and before the princes, the chief fathers of the children of Israel:
bsb_text: Now the family heads of the clan of Gilead son of Machir son of Manasseh, one of the clans of Joseph, approached Moses and the leaders who were the heads of the Israelite families and addressed them,
aov_text: EN die familiehoofde van die geslag van die kinders van Gílead, die seun van Magir, die seun van Manasse, uit die geslagte van Josef se kinders, het nader gekom en voor Moses en die owerstes, die familiehoofde van die kinders van Israel, gespreek

kjv_text: And they said, The LORD commanded my lord to give the land for an inheritance by lot to the children of Israel: and my lord was commanded by the LORD to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother unto his daughters.
bsb_text: saying, “When the LORD commanded my lord to give the land as an inheritance to the Israelites by lot, He also commanded him to give the inheritance of our brother Zelophehad to his daughters.
aov_text: en gesê: Die HERE het aan my heer bevel gegee om die land deur die lot as erfenis aan die kinders van Israel te gee; ook het my heer van die HERE bevel ontvang om die erfdeel van ons broer Selófhad aan sy dogters te gee.

kjv_text: And if they be married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then shall their inheritance be taken from the inheritance of our fathers, and shall be put to the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall it be taken from the lot of our inheritance.
bsb_text: But if they marry any of the men from the other tribes of Israel, their inheritance will be withdrawn from the portion of our fathers and added to the tribe into which they marry. So our allotted inheritance would be taken away.
aov_text: As hulle nou die vroue word van een van die seuns uit die ander stamme van die kinders van Israel, dan word hulle erfdeel van ons vaders se erfdeel weggeneem en gevoeg by die erfdeel van die stam waarby hulle sal behoort; so sal dan die erfdeel wat ons deur die lot aangewys is, ingekort word.

kjv_text: And when the jubile of the children of Israel shall be, then shall their inheritance be put unto the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.
bsb_text: And when the Jubilee for the Israelites comes, their inheritance will be added to the tribe into which they marry and taken away from the tribe of our fathers.”
aov_text: En as die jubeljaar vir die kinders van Israel aanbreek, dan word hulle erfdeel gevoeg by die erfdeel van die stam waarby hulle sal behoort; so sal dan hulle erfdeel van die erfdeel van ons vaders se stam weggeneem word.

kjv_text: And Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the word of the LORD, saying, The tribe of the sons of Joseph hath said well.
bsb_text: So at the word of the LORD, Moses commanded the Israelites: “The tribe of the sons of Joseph speaks correctly.
aov_text: Toe het Moses die kinders van Israel volgens die bevel van die HERE gelas en gesê: Die stam van die kinders van Josef praat reg.

kjv_text: This is the thing which the LORD doth command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, Let them marry to whom they think best; only to the family of the tribe of their father shall they marry.
bsb_text: This is what the LORD has commanded concerning the daughters of Zelophehad: They may marry anyone they please, provided they marry within a clan of the tribe of their father.
aov_text: Dit is die saak wat die HERE aangaande die dogters van Selóf-had beveel het deur te sê: Laat hulle die vroue word van hom wat goed is in hulle oë; hulle moet net trou in ’n geslag van die stam van hulle vader,

kjv_text: So shall not the inheritance of the children of Israel remove from tribe to tribe: for every one of the children of Israel shall keep himself to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.
bsb_text: No inheritance in Israel may be transferred from tribe to tribe, because each of the Israelites is to retain the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.
aov_text: sodat die erfdeel van die kinders van Israel nie van stam tot stam oorgaan nie; want die kinders van Israel moet elkeen die erfdeel van die stam van sy vaders vashou.

kjv_text: And every daughter, that possesseth an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel, shall be wife unto one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may enjoy every man the inheritance of his fathers.
bsb_text: Every daughter who possesses an inheritance from any Israelite tribe must marry within a clan of the tribe of her father, so that every Israelite will possess the inheritance of his fathers.
aov_text: En elke dogter wat ’n erfdeel kry, uit die stamme van die kinders van Israel, moet die vrou word van een uit die geslag van die stam van haar vader, sodat die kinders van Israel elkeen die erfdeel van sy vaders kan erwe.

kjv_text: Neither shall the inheritance remove from one tribe to another tribe; but every one of the tribes of the children of Israel shall keep himself to his own inheritance.
bsb_text: No inheritance may be transferred from one tribe to another, for each tribe of Israel must retain its inheritance.”
aov_text: So sal dan ’n erfdeel nie van een stam na ’n ander stam oorgaan nie; want die stamme van die kinders van Israel moet elkeen sy erfdeel vashou.

kjv_text: Even as the LORD commanded Moses, so did the daughters of Zelophehad:
bsb_text: So the daughters of Zelophehad did as the LORD had commanded Moses.
aov_text: Soos die HERE Moses beveel het, so het die dogters van Selófhad gedoen:

kjv_text: For Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married unto their father's brothers' sons:
bsb_text: Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married to cousins on their father’s side.
aov_text: Magla, Tirsa en Hogla en Milka en Noa, die dogters van Selófhad, het die vroue geword van die seuns van hulle ooms;

kjv_text: And they were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.
bsb_text: They married within the clans of the descendants of Manasseh son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained within the tribe of their father’s clan.
aov_text: hulle het die vroue geword van manne uit die geslagte van die kinders van Manasse, die seun van Josef. So het dan hulle erfdeel gebly in die stam van die geslag van hulle vader.

kjv_text: These are the commandments and the judgments, which the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses unto the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
bsb_text: These are the commandments and ordinances that the LORD gave the Israelites through Moses on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho.
aov_text: Dit is die gebooie en die verordeninge wat die HERE deur die diens van Moses die kinders van Israel beveel het, in die vlaktes van Moab by die Jordaan van Jérigo.

kjv_text: These be the words which Moses spake unto all Israel on this side Jordan in the wilderness, in the plain over against the Red sea, between Paran, and Tophel, and Laban, and Hazeroth, and Dizahab.
bsb_text: These are the words that Moses spoke to all Israel in the wilderness east of the Jordan—in the Arabah opposite Suph—between Paran and Tophel, Laban, Hazeroth, and Dizahab.
aov_text: DIT is die woorde waarmee Moses die hele Israel toegespreek het oos van die Jordaan in die woestyn, in die Vlakte teenoor Suf, tussen Paran en Tofel en Laban en Háserot en Di-Sahab.

kjv_text: (There are eleven days' journey from Horeb by the way of mount Seir unto Kadeshbarnea.)
bsb_text: It is an eleven-day journey from Horeb to Kadesh-barnea by way of Mount Seir.
aov_text: Elf dae is die pad van Horeb af na die gebergte Seïr tot by Kades-Barnéa.

kjv_text: And it came to pass in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, that Moses spake unto the children of Israel, according unto all that the LORD had given him in commandment unto them;
bsb_text: In the fortieth year, on the first day of the eleventh month, Moses proclaimed to the Israelites all that the LORD had commanded him concerning them.
aov_text: En in die veertigste jaar, in die elfde maand, op die eerste van die maand, het Moses met die kinders van Israel gespreek net soos die HERE ten opsigte van hulle aan hom bevel gegee het;

kjv_text: After he had slain Sihon the king of the Amorites, which dwelt in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, which dwelt at Astaroth in Edrei:
bsb_text: This was after he had defeated Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon, and then at Edrei had defeated Og king of Bashan, who lived in Ashtaroth.
aov_text: nadat hy Sihon, die koning van die Amoriete, wat in Hesbon gewoon het, en Og, die koning van Basan, wat in Ástarot gewoon het, in Edréï verslaan het.

kjv_text: On this side Jordan, in the land of Moab, began Moses to declare this law, saying,
bsb_text: On the east side of the Jordan in the land of Moab, Moses began to explain this law, saying:
aov_text: Oos van die Jordaan in die land Moab het Moses onderneem om hierdie wet te verklaar deur te sê:

kjv_text: The LORD our God spake unto us in Horeb, saying, Ye have dwelt long enough in this mount:
bsb_text: The LORD our God said to us at Horeb: “You have stayed at this mountain long enough.
aov_text: Die HERE onse God het met ons by Horeb gespreek en gesê: Julle het lank genoeg by hierdie berg gebly.

kjv_text: Turn you, and take your journey, and go to the mount of the Amorites, and unto all the places nigh thereunto, in the plain, in the hills, and in the vale, and in the south, and by the sea side, to the land of the Canaanites, and unto Lebanon, unto the great river, the river Euphrates.
bsb_text: Resume your journey and go to the hill country of the Amorites; go to all the neighboring peoples in the Arabah, in the hill country, in the foothills, in the Negev, and along the seacoast to the land of the Canaanites and to Lebanon, as far as the great River Euphrates.
aov_text: Trek weg en breek op en gaan na die gebergte van die Amoriete en na al sy naburige plekke: die Vlakte, die Gebergte en die Laeveld en die Suidland en by die seekus—die land van die Kanaäniete en die Líbanon, tot by die groot rivier, die Eufraatrivier.

kjv_text: Behold, I have set the land before you: go in and possess the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, to give unto them and to their seed after them.
bsb_text: See, I have placed the land before you. Enter and possess the land that the LORD swore He would give to your fathers Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and to their descendants after them.”
aov_text: Kyk, Ek gee die land aan julle oor; gaan in en neem die land in besit wat die HERE aan julle vaders Abraham, Isak en Jakob met ’n eed beloof het om dit aan hulle te gee en aan hulle nageslag ná hulle.

kjv_text: And I spake unto you at that time, saying, I am not able to bear you myself alone:
bsb_text: At that time I said to you, “I cannot carry the burden for you alone.
aov_text: En ek het met julle in dié tyd gespreek en gesê: Ek kan julle alleen nie dra nie.

kjv_text: The LORD your God hath multiplied you, and, behold, ye are this day as the stars of heaven for multitude.
bsb_text: The LORD your God has multiplied you, so that today you are as numerous as the stars in the sky.
aov_text: Die HERE julle God het julle vermenigvuldig; en kyk, julle is vandag soos die sterre van die hemel in menigte.

kjv_text: (The LORD God of your fathers make you a thousand times so many more as ye are, and bless you, as he hath promised you!)
bsb_text: May the LORD, the God of your fathers, increase you a thousand times over and bless you as He has promised.
aov_text: Mag die HERE, die God van julle vaders, by julle byvoeg duisend maal soveel as wat julle is, en julle seën soos Hy julle beloof het!

kjv_text: How can I myself alone bear your cumbrance, and your burden, and your strife?
bsb_text: But how can I bear your troubles, burdens, and disputes all by myself?
aov_text: Hoe sou ek die moeilikheid en die las en die regsake van julle alleen kan dra?

kjv_text: Take you wise men, and understanding, and known among your tribes, and I will make them rulers over you.
bsb_text: Choose for yourselves wise, understanding, and respected men from each of your tribes, and I will appoint them as your leaders.”
aov_text: Bring tog wyse en verstandige en ervare manne aan volgens julle stamme, dat ek hulle as julle hoofde kan aanstel.

kjv_text: And ye answered me, and said, The thing which thou hast spoken is good for us to do.
bsb_text: And you answered me and said, “What you propose to do is good.”
aov_text: Hierop het julle my geantwoord en gesê: Die woord wat u gespreek het, is goed om uit te voer.

kjv_text: So I took the chief of your tribes, wise men, and known, and made them heads over you, captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, and captains over fifties, and captains over tens, and officers among your tribes.
bsb_text: So I took the leaders of your tribes, wise and respected men, and appointed them as leaders over you—as commanders of thousands, of hundreds, of fifties, and of tens, and as officers for your tribes.
aov_text: Toe het ek die hoofde van julle stamme, wyse en ervare manne, geneem en hulle as hoofde oor julle aangestel, owerstes oor duisend en owerstes oor honderd en owerstes oor vyftig en owerstes oor tien en opsigters volgens julle stamme.

kjv_text: And I charged your judges at that time, saying, Hear the causes between your brethren, and judge righteously between every man and his brother, and the stranger that is with him.
bsb_text: At that time I charged your judges: “Hear the disputes between your brothers, and judge fairly between a man and his brother or a foreign resident.
aov_text: En ek het in dié tyd aan julle regters bevel gegee en gesê: Neem julle broers in verhoor en oordeel regverdig tussen ’n man en sy broer en die vreemdeling wat by hom is.

kjv_text: Ye shall not respect persons in judgment; but ye shall hear the small as well as the great; ye shall not be afraid of the face of man; for the judgment is God's: and the cause that is too hard for you, bring it unto me, and I will hear it.
bsb_text: Show no partiality in judging; hear both small and great alike. Do not be intimidated by anyone, for judgment belongs to God. And bring to me any case too difficult for you, and I will hear it.”
aov_text: Julle mag in die gereg nie partydig wees nie; julle moet klein sowel as groot aanhoor; julle mag niemand ontsien nie, want die gereg is die saak van God. Maar die saak wat vir julle te moeilik is, moet julle na my toe bring, en ek sal dit in verhoor neem.

kjv_text: And I commanded you at that time all the things which ye should do.
bsb_text: And at that time I commanded you all the things you were to do.
aov_text: So het ek julle dan in dié tyd al die dinge beveel wat julle moet doen.

kjv_text: And when we departed from Horeb, we went through all that great and terrible wilderness, which ye saw by the way of the mountain of the Amorites, as the LORD our God commanded us; and we came to Kadeshbarnea.
bsb_text: And just as the LORD our God had commanded us, we set out from Horeb and went toward the hill country of the Amorites, through all the vast and terrifying wilderness you have seen. When we reached Kadesh-barnea,
aov_text: Toe het ons van Horeb af opgebreek, en ons het daardie hele groot en vreeslike woestyn deurgetrek wat julle op pad na die gebergte van die Amoriete gesien het, soos die HERE onse God ons beveel het; en ons het tot by Kades-Barnéa gekom.

kjv_text: And I said unto you, Ye are come unto the mountain of the Amorites, which the LORD our God doth give unto us.
bsb_text: I said: “You have reached the hill country of the Amorites, which the LORD our God is giving us.
aov_text: Toe het ek vir julle gesê: Julle het tot by die gebergte van die Amoriete gekom wat die HERE onse God aan ons sal gee.

kjv_text: Behold, the LORD thy God hath set the land before thee: go up and possess it, as the LORD God of thy fathers hath said unto thee; fear not, neither be discouraged.
bsb_text: See, the LORD your God has placed the land before you. Go up and take possession of it as the LORD, the God of your fathers, has told you. Do not be afraid or discouraged.”
aov_text: Kyk, die HERE jou God het die land aan jou oorgegee; trek op, neem dit in besit soos die HERE, die God van jou vaders, jou gesê het; wees nie bevrees en wees nie verskrik nie.

kjv_text: And ye came near unto me every one of you, and said, We will send men before us, and they shall search us out the land, and bring us word again by what way we must go up, and into what cities we shall come.
bsb_text: Then all of you approached me and said, “Let us send men ahead of us to search out the land and bring us word of what route to follow and which cities to enter.”
aov_text: Toe het julle almal na my toe aangekom en gesê: Laat ons manne voor ons uit stuur, dat hulle vir ons die land kan verken en ons berig kan bring aangaande die pad waarlangs ons moet optrek, en die stede waarby ons sal kom.

kjv_text: And the saying pleased me well: and I took twelve men of you, one of a tribe:
bsb_text: The plan seemed good to me, so I selected twelve men from among you, one from each tribe.
aov_text: En die saak was goed in my oë, sodat ek twaalf man uit julle, uit elke stam een man, geneem het.

kjv_text: And they turned and went up into the mountain, and came unto the valley of Eshcol, and searched it out.
bsb_text: They left and went up into the hill country, and came to the Valley of Eshcol and spied out the land.
aov_text: En hulle het weggedraai en na die gebergte opgetrek en tot by die dal Eskol gekom en dit verken.

kjv_text: And they took of the fruit of the land in their hands, and brought it down unto us, and brought us word again, and said, It is a good land which the LORD our God doth give us.
bsb_text: They took some of the fruit of the land in their hands, carried it down to us, and brought us word: “It is a good land that the LORD our God is giving us.”
aov_text: Hulle het toe van die vrugte van die land met hulle saamgeneem en dit na ons afgebring en aan ons verslag gegee en gesê: Die land wat die HERE onse God aan ons sal gee, is goed.

kjv_text: Notwithstanding ye would not go up, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God:
bsb_text: But you were unwilling to go up; you rebelled against the command of the LORD your God.
aov_text: Maar julle wou nie optrek nie, maar was wederstrewig teen die bevel van die HERE julle God.

kjv_text: And ye murmured in your tents, and said, Because the LORD hated us, he hath brought us forth out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us.
bsb_text: You grumbled in your tents and said, “Because the LORD hates us, He has brought us out of the land of Egypt to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites to be annihilated.
aov_text: En julle het in jul tente gemurmureer en gesê: Omdat die HERE ons haat, het Hy ons uit Egipteland uitgelei om ons in die hand van die Amoriete oor te gee, dat hulle ons verdelg.

kjv_text: Whither shall we go up? our brethren have discouraged our heart, saying, The people is greater and taller than we; the cities are great and walled up to heaven; and moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakims there.
bsb_text: Where can we go? Our brothers have made our hearts melt, saying: ‘The people are larger and taller than we are; the cities are large, with walls up to the heavens. We even saw the descendants of the Anakim there.’”
aov_text: Waarheen moet ons optrek? Ons broers het ons hart laat versmelt deur te sê: Dit is ’n volk groter en hoër van gestalte as ons; die stede is groot en tot aan die hemel versterk; en ons het daar ook die kinders van die Enakiete gesien.

kjv_text: Then I said unto you, Dread not, neither be afraid of them.
bsb_text: So I said to you: “Do not be terrified or afraid of them!
aov_text: Toe het ek aan julle gesê: Word nie verskrik en wees nie bevrees vir hulle nie.

kjv_text: The LORD your God which goeth before you, he shall fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes;
bsb_text: The LORD your God, who goes before you, will fight for you, just as you saw Him do for you in Egypt
aov_text: Die HERE julle God wat voor julle uit trek, Hy sal vir julle stry net soos Hy voor julle oë met julle in Egipte gedoen het

kjv_text: And in the wilderness, where thou hast seen how that the LORD thy God bare thee, as a man doth bear his son, in all the way that ye went, until ye came into this place.
bsb_text: and in the wilderness, where the LORD your God carried you, as a man carries his son, all the way by which you traveled until you reached this place.”
aov_text: en in die woestyn, waar jy gesien het hoe die HERE jou God jou gedra het soos ’n man sy seun dra, op die hele pad wat julle getrek het, totdat julle tot by hierdie plek gekom het.

kjv_text: Yet in this thing ye did not believe the LORD your God,
bsb_text: But in spite of all this, you did not trust the LORD your God,
aov_text: Maar ondanks hierdie woord het julle nie geglo in die HERE julle God nie,

kjv_text: Who went in the way before you, to search you out a place to pitch your tents in, in fire by night, to shew you by what way ye should go, and in a cloud by day.
bsb_text: who went before you on the journey, in the fire by night and in the cloud by day, to seek out a place for you to camp and to show you the road to travel.
aov_text: wat voor julle uit getrek het op die pad om vir julle ’n plek uit te soek om julle laer op te slaan, snags in die vuur om julle te laat sien op die pad waar julle langs moes trek, en bedags in die wolk.

kjv_text: And the LORD heard the voice of your words, and was wroth, and sware, saying,
bsb_text: When the LORD heard your words, He grew angry and swore an oath, saying,
aov_text: En toe die HERE die stem van julle woorde hoor, het Hy toornig geword en gesweer en gesê:

kjv_text: Surely there shall not one of these men of this evil generation see that good land, which I sware to give unto your fathers,
bsb_text: “Not one of the men of this evil generation shall see the good land I swore to give your fathers,
aov_text: Waarlik, geeneen van hierdie manne, hierdie verkeerde geslag, sal die goeie land sien wat Ek met ’n eed beloof het om aan julle vaders te gee nie —

kjv_text: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh; he shall see it, and to him will I give the land that he hath trodden upon, and to his children, because he hath wholly followed the LORD.
bsb_text: except Caleb son of Jephunneh. He will see it, and I will give him and his descendants the land on which he has set foot, because he followed the LORD wholeheartedly.”
aov_text: behalwe Kaleb, die seun van Jefúnne; hy sal dit sien, en aan hom en sy kinders sal Ek die land gee waarop hy geloop het, omdat hy volhard het om die HERE te volg.

kjv_text: Also the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, saying, Thou also shalt not go in thither.
bsb_text: The LORD was also angry with me on your account, and He said, “Not even you shall enter the land.
aov_text: Ook was die HERE toornig op my om julle ontwil, sodat Hy gesê het: Jy sal daar ook nie inkom nie.

kjv_text: But Joshua the son of Nun, which standeth before thee, he shall go in thither: encourage him: for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.
bsb_text: Joshua son of Nun, who stands before you, will enter it. Encourage him, for he will enable Israel to inherit the land.
aov_text: Josua, die seun van Nun, wat voor jou staan—hý sal daar inkom; versterk hom, want hý sal Israel dit laat beërwe.

kjv_text: Moreover your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, and your children, which in that day had no knowledge between good and evil, they shall go in thither, and unto them will I give it, and they shall possess it.
bsb_text: And the little ones you said would become captives—your children who on that day did not know good from evil—will enter the land that I will give them, and they will possess it.
aov_text: En julle kindertjies van wie julle gesê het: Hulle sal ’n buit word! en julle kinders wat vandag van geen goed of kwaad weet nie—húlle sal daar inkom en aan hulle sal Ek dit gee, en húlle sal dit in besit neem.

kjv_text: But as for you, turn you, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.
bsb_text: But you are to turn back and head for the wilderness along the route to the Red Sea.”
aov_text: Maar julle, draai om en trek weg na die woestyn op pad na die Skelfsee.

kjv_text: Then ye answered and said unto me, We have sinned against the LORD, we will go up and fight, according to all that the LORD our God commanded us. And when ye had girded on every man his weapons of war, ye were ready to go up into the hill.
bsb_text: “We have sinned against the LORD,” you replied. “We will go up and fight, as the LORD our God has commanded us.” Then each of you put on his weapons of war, thinking it easy to go up into the hill country.
aov_text: Toe het julle geantwoord en vir my gesê: Ons het teen die HERE gesondig; ons self sal optrek en veg net soos die HERE onse God ons beveel het. En toe julle elkeen sy oorlogswapens aangord en daar nog maklik oor dink om in die gebergte op te trek,

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto me, Say unto them, Go not up, neither fight; for I am not among you; lest ye be smitten before your enemies.
bsb_text: But the LORD said to me, “Tell them not to go up and fight, for I am not with you to keep you from defeat by your enemies.”
aov_text: het die HERE vir my gesê: Sê vir hulle: Julle mag nie optrek en veg nie—want Ek is nie in julle midde nie—dat julle nie voor julle vyande verslaan word nie.

kjv_text: So I spake unto you; and ye would not hear, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD, and went presumptuously up into the hill.
bsb_text: So I spoke to you, but you would not listen. You rebelled against the command of the LORD and presumptuously went up into the hill country.
aov_text: Maar toe ek met julle gespreek het, het julle nie geluister nie, maar julle was wederstrewig teen die bevel van die HERE en het vermetel in die gebergte opgetrek.

kjv_text: And the Amorites, which dwelt in that mountain, came out against you, and chased you, as bees do, and destroyed you in Seir, even unto Hormah.
bsb_text: Then the Amorites who lived in the hills came out against you and chased you like a swarm of bees. They routed you from Seir all the way to Hormah.
aov_text: Toe het die Amoriete wat in dié gebergte gewoon het, uitgetrek julle tegemoet en julle agtervolg soos die bye maak; en hulle het julle verstrooi in Seïr tot by Horma.

kjv_text: And ye returned and wept before the LORD; but the LORD would not hearken to your voice, nor give ear unto you.
bsb_text: And you returned and wept before the LORD, but He would not listen to your voice or give ear to you.
aov_text: En julle het teruggekom en voor die aangesig van die HERE geween, maar die HERE het na julle stem nie geluister en julle geen gehoor gegee nie.

kjv_text: So ye abode in Kadesh many days, according unto the days that ye abode there.
bsb_text: For this reason you stayed in Kadesh for a long time—a very long time.
aov_text: So het julle dan baie dae in Kades gebly, solank as julle daar gebly het.

kjv_text: Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea, as the LORD spake unto me: and we compassed mount Seir many days.
bsb_text: Then we turned back and headed for the wilderness by way of the Red Sea, as the LORD had instructed me, and for many days we wandered around Mount Seir.
aov_text: DAARNA het ons gedraai en weggetrek na die woestyn, op pad na die Skelfsee, soos die HERE aan my gesê het, en ons het om die gebergte Seïr getrek, baie dae lank.

kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto me, saying,
bsb_text: At this time the LORD said to me,
aov_text: Toe het die HERE met my gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: Ye have compassed this mountain long enough: turn you northward.
bsb_text: “You have been wandering around this hill country long enough; turn to the north
aov_text: Julle het lank genoeg om hierdie gebergte getrek. Draai noordwaarts weg

kjv_text: And command thou the people, saying, Ye are to pass through the coast of your brethren the children of Esau, which dwell in Seir; and they shall be afraid of you: take ye good heed unto yourselves therefore:
bsb_text: and command the people: ‘You will pass through the territory of your brothers, the descendants of Esau, who live in Seir. They will be afraid of you, so you must be very careful.
aov_text: en gee aan die volk bevel en sê: Julle gaan trek deur die grondgebied van julle broers die kinders van Esau wat in Seïr woon, en hulle sal vir julle vrees; pas dan goed op;

kjv_text: Meddle not with them; for I will not give you of their land, no, not so much as a foot breadth; because I have given mount Seir unto Esau for a possession.
bsb_text: Do not provoke them, for I will not give you any of their land, not even a footprint, because I have given Mount Seir to Esau as his possession.
aov_text: begeef julle nie in die oorlog teen hulle nie, want Ek sal julle van hulle land selfs nie ’n voetbreed gee nie; want Ek het aan Esau die gebergte Seïr as ’n besitting gegee.

kjv_text: Ye shall buy meat of them for money, that ye may eat; and ye shall also buy water of them for money, that ye may drink.
bsb_text: You are to pay them in silver for the food you eat and the water you drink.’”
aov_text: Voedsel moet julle van hulle vir geld koop, dat julle kan eet; en julle moet ook water van hulle vir geld koop, dat julle kan drink.

kjv_text: For the LORD thy God hath blessed thee in all the works of thy hand: he knoweth thy walking through this great wilderness: these forty years the LORD thy God hath been with thee; thou hast lacked nothing.
bsb_text: Indeed, the LORD your God has blessed you in all the work of your hands. He has watched over your journey through this vast wilderness. The LORD your God has been with you these forty years, and you have lacked nothing.
aov_text: Want die HERE jou God het jou geseën in al die werk van jou hand; Hy ken jou trek deur hierdie groot woestyn; nou veertig jaar lank was die HERE jou God met jou; geen ding het jou ontbreek nie.

kjv_text: And when we passed by from our brethren the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, through the way of the plain from Elath, and from Eziongaber, we turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.
bsb_text: So we passed by our brothers, the descendants of Esau, who live in Seir. We turned away from the Arabah road, which comes up from Elath and Ezion-geber, and traveled along the road of the Wilderness of Moab.
aov_text: Daarop het ons verder getrek, weg van ons broers, die kinders van Esau wat in Seïr woon, weg van die pad deur die Vlakte, weg van Elat en Éseon-Geber; ons het toe weggedraai en verder getrek op pad na die woestyn van Moab.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto me, Distress not the Moabites, neither contend with them in battle: for I will not give thee of their land for a possession; because I have given Ar unto the children of Lot for a possession.
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to me, “Do not harass the Moabites or provoke them to war, for I will not give you any of their land, because I have given Ar to the descendants of Lot as their possession.”
aov_text: Toe het die HERE vir my gesê: Behandel Moab nie as vyand en begeef jou nie in die oorlog teen hulle nie; want Ek sal jou niks van sy land as besitting gee nie, omdat Ek Ar aan die kinders van Lot as ’n besitting gegee het.

kjv_text: The Emims dwelt therein in times past, a people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims;
bsb_text: (The Emites used to live there, a people great and many, as tall as the Anakites.
aov_text: Die Emiete het tevore daarin gewoon, ’n volk groot en talryk en hoog van gestalte soos die Enakiete.

kjv_text: Which also were accounted giants, as the Anakims; but the Moabites call them Emims.
bsb_text: Like the Anakites, they were also regarded as Rephaim, though the Moabites called them Emites.
aov_text: Hulle word ook vir Refaïete gehou, soos die Enakiete; maar die Moabiete het hulle Emiete genoem.

kjv_text: The Horims also dwelt in Seir beforetime; but the children of Esau succeeded them, when they had destroyed them from before them, and dwelt in their stead; as Israel did unto the land of his possession, which the LORD gave unto them.
bsb_text: The Horites used to live in Seir, but the descendants of Esau drove them out. They destroyed the Horites from before them and settled in their place, just as Israel did in the land that the LORD gave them as their possession.)
aov_text: Ook het die Horiete tevore in Seïr gewoon; maar die kinders van Esau het hulle uit hul besitting verdrywe en voor hulle uit verdelg en in hulle plek gaan woon, net soos Israel gedoen het met die land van sy besitting wat die HERE aan hulle gegee het.

kjv_text: Now rise up, said I, and get you over the brook Zered. And we went over the brook Zered.
bsb_text: “Now arise and cross over the Brook of Zered.” So we crossed over the Brook of Zered.
aov_text: Maak nou klaar en trek oor die spruit Sered. Toe het ons oor die spruit Sered getrek.

kjv_text: And the space in which we came from Kadeshbarnea, until we were come over the brook Zered, was thirty and eight years; until all the generation of the men of war were wasted out from among the host, as the LORD sware unto them.
bsb_text: The time we spent traveling from Kadesh-barnea until we crossed over the Brook of Zered was thirty-eight years, until that entire generation of fighting men had perished from the camp, as the LORD had sworn to them.
aov_text: En die dae van ons trek van Kades-Barnéa af totdat ons oor die spruit Sered gegaan het, was agt-en-dertig jaar—totdat die hele geslag, die krygsmanne, uit die laer omgekom het soos die HERE hulle dit gesweer het.

kjv_text: For indeed the hand of the LORD was against them, to destroy them from among the host, until they were consumed.
bsb_text: Indeed, the LORD’s hand was against them, to eliminate them from the camp, until they had all perished.
aov_text: So was die hand van die HERE dan ook teen hulle om hulle uit die laer te vernietig totdat hulle omgekom het.

kjv_text: So it came to pass, when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people,
bsb_text: Now when all the fighting men among the people had died,
aov_text: En toe al die krygsmanne heeltemal onder die volk uit weggesterf het,

kjv_text: That the LORD spake unto me, saying,
bsb_text: the LORD said to me,
aov_text: het die HERE met my gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: Thou art to pass over through Ar, the coast of Moab, this day:
bsb_text: “Today you are going to cross the border of Moab at Ar.
aov_text: Jy trek vandag die grens van Moab by Ar oor,

kjv_text: And when thou comest nigh over against the children of Ammon, distress them not, nor meddle with them: for I will not give thee of the land of the children of Ammon any possession; because I have given it unto the children of Lot for a possession.
bsb_text: But when you get close to the Ammonites, do not harass them or provoke them, for I will not give you any of the land of the Ammonites. I have given it to the descendants of Lot as their possession.”
aov_text: en jy sal kom in die nabyheid van die kinders van Ammon; behandel hulle nie as vyande en begeef jou nie in die oorlog teen hulle nie; want Ek sal jou niks van die kinders van Ammon se land as besitting gee nie, omdat Ek dit aan die kinders van Lot as besitting gegee het.

kjv_text: (That also was accounted a land of giants: giants dwelt therein in old time; and the Ammonites call them Zamzummims;
bsb_text: (That too was regarded as the land of the Rephaim, who used to live there, though the Ammonites called them Zamzummites.
aov_text: Dit word ook as ’n land van Refaïete beskou; Refaïete het tevore daarin gewoon, en die Ammoniete het hulle Samsummiete genoem —

kjv_text: A people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims; but the LORD destroyed them before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead:
bsb_text: They were a people great and many, as tall as the Anakites. But the LORD destroyed them from before the Ammonites, who drove them out and settled in their place,
aov_text: ’n volk groot en talryk en hoog van gestalte soos die Enakiete—maar die HERE het dié voor hulle uit verdelg, sodat hulle dié uit hulle besitting verdryf en in hulle plek gaan woon het;

kjv_text: As he did to the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, when he destroyed the Horims from before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead even unto this day:
bsb_text: just as He had done for the descendants of Esau who lived in Seir, when He destroyed the Horites from before them. They drove them out and have lived in their place to this day.
aov_text: soos Hy in die geval van die kinders van Esau gedoen het wat in Seïr woon, voor wie Hy die Horiete verdelg het, sodat hulle dié uit hulle besitting verdryf en in hulle plek gaan woon het tot vandag toe.

kjv_text: And the Avims which dwelt in Hazerim, even unto Azzah, the Caphtorims, which came forth out of Caphtor, destroyed them, and dwelt in their stead.)
bsb_text: And the Avvim, who lived in villages as far as Gaza, were destroyed by the Caphtorites, who came out of Caphtor and settled in their place.)
aov_text: Ook het die Kaftoriete wat uit Kaftor afkomstig was, die Awiete wat in dorpe tot by Gasa gewoon het, verdelg en in hulle plek gaan woon.

kjv_text: Rise ye up, take your journey, and pass over the river Arnon: behold, I have given into thine hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land: begin to possess it, and contend with him in battle.
bsb_text: “Arise, set out, and cross the Arnon Valley. See, I have delivered into your hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land. Begin to take possession of it and engage him in battle.
aov_text: Maak julle klaar, breek op en trek deur die Arnonrivier. Kyk, Ek gee Sihon, die koning van Hesbon, die Amoriet, en sy land in jou hand; begin om in besit te neem, en begeef jou in die oorlog teen hom.

kjv_text: This day will I begin to put the dread of thee and the fear of thee upon the nations that are under the whole heaven, who shall hear report of thee, and shall tremble, and be in anguish because of thee.
bsb_text: This very day I will begin to put the dread and fear of you upon all the nations under heaven. They will hear the reports of you and tremble in anguish because of you.”
aov_text: Vandag sal Ek begin om die skrik en die vrees vir jou op die volke onder die hele hemel te lê, sodat hulle, as hulle die tyding aangaande jou hoor, voor jou sal sidder en bewe van angs.

kjv_text: And I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth unto Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,
bsb_text: So from the Wilderness of Kedemoth I sent messengers with an offer of peace to Sihon king of Heshbon, saying,
aov_text: Toe het ek boodskappers gestuur uit die woestyn Kedémot na Sihon, die koning van Hesbon, met woorde van vrede om te sê:

kjv_text: Let me pass through thy land: I will go along by the high way, I will neither turn unto the right hand nor to the left.
bsb_text: “Let us pass through your land; we will stay on the main road. We will not turn to the right or to the left.
aov_text: Laat my deur jou land gaan; ek sal net padlangs trek; ek sal nie regs of links uitdraai nie.

kjv_text: Thou shalt sell me meat for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink: only I will pass through on my feet;
bsb_text: You can sell us food to eat and water to drink in exchange for silver. Only let us pass through on foot,
aov_text: Voedsel moet jy my verkoop vir geld, dat ek kan eet; en water moet jy my gee vir geld, dat ek kan drink; laat my net te voet deurtrek —

kjv_text: (As the children of Esau which dwell in Seir, and the Moabites which dwell in Ar, did unto me;) until I shall pass over Jordan into the land which the LORD our God giveth us.
bsb_text: just as the descendants of Esau who live in Seir and the Moabites who live in Ar did for us, until we cross the Jordan into the land that the LORD our God is giving us.”
aov_text: soos die kinders van Esau wat in Seïr woon, en die Moabiete wat in Ar woon, met my gedoen het—totdat ek deur die Jordaan trek in die land wat die HERE onse God aan ons sal gee.

kjv_text: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him: for the LORD thy God hardened his spirit, and made his heart obstinate, that he might deliver him into thy hand, as appeareth this day.
bsb_text: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass through, for the LORD your God had made his spirit stubborn and his heart obstinate, that He might deliver him into your hand, as is the case this day.
aov_text: Maar Sihon, die koning van Hesbon, wou ons nie by hom laat deurtrek nie; want die HERE jou God het sy gees verhard en sy hart verstok, dat Hy hom in jou hand kon gee soos dit vandag is.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto me, Behold, I have begun to give Sihon and his land before thee: begin to possess, that thou mayest inherit his land.
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to me, “See, I have begun to deliver Sihon and his land over to you. Now begin to conquer and possess his land.”
aov_text: En die HERE het vir my gesê: Kyk, Ek begin om Sihon en sy land aan jou oor te gee; begin om in besit te neem, om sy land in besit te neem.

kjv_text: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to fight at Jahaz.
bsb_text: So Sihon and his whole army came out for battle against us at Jahaz.
aov_text: Toe het Sihon uitgetrek ons tegemoet, hy en sy hele volk, om te veg by Jahas.

kjv_text: And the LORD our God delivered him before us; and we smote him, and his sons, and all his people.
bsb_text: And the LORD our God delivered him over to us, and we defeated him and his sons and his whole army.
aov_text: En die HERE onse God het hom aan ons oorgegee, sodat ons hom en sy seuns en sy hele volk verslaan het.

kjv_text: And we took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed the men, and the women, and the little ones, of every city, we left none to remain:
bsb_text: At that time we captured all his cities and devoted to destruction the people of every city, including women and children. We left no survivors.
aov_text: En ons het in dié tyd al sy stede ingeneem en elke stad met die banvloek getref, manne en vroue en kinders; ons het niemand laat vryraak nie.

kjv_text: Only the cattle we took for a prey unto ourselves, and the spoil of the cities which we took.
bsb_text: We carried off for ourselves only the livestock and the plunder from the cities we captured.
aov_text: Net die vee het ons vir ons geroof en die buit van die stede wat ons ingeneem het.

kjv_text: From Aroer, which is by the brink of the river of Arnon, and from the city that is by the river, even unto Gilead, there was not one city too strong for us: the LORD our God delivered all unto us:
bsb_text: From Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Valley, along with the city in the valley, even as far as Gilead, not one city had walls too high for us. The LORD our God gave us all of them.
aov_text: Van Ároër af wat aan die kant van die Arnonrivier lê, en die stad in die dal, tot by Gílead was daar vir ons geen vesting onneembaar nie—die HERE onse God het alles aan ons oorgegee.

kjv_text: Only unto the land of the children of Ammon thou camest not, nor unto any place of the river Jabbok, nor unto the cities in the mountains, nor unto whatsoever the LORD our God forbad us.
bsb_text: But you did not go near the land of the Ammonites, or the land along the banks of the Jabbok River, or the cities of the hill country, or any place that the LORD our God had forbidden.
aov_text: Net naby die land van die kinders van Ammon het jy nie gekom nie: die hele kant van die Jabbokrivier en die stede van die gebergte en alles wat die HERE onse God verbied het.

kjv_text: Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.
bsb_text: Then we turned and went up the road to Bashan, and Og king of Bashan and his whole army came out to meet us in battle at Edrei.
aov_text: DAARNA het ons weggedraai en op pad na Basan opgetrek; en Og, die koning van Basan, het uitgetrek ons tegemoet, hy en sy hele volk, om te veg by Edréï.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto me, Fear him not: for I will deliver him, and all his people, and his land, into thy hand; and thou shalt do unto him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.
bsb_text: But the LORD said to me, “Do not fear him, for I have delivered him into your hand, along with all his people and his land. Do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon.”
aov_text: Toe het die HERE vir my gesê: Wees nie bevrees vir hom nie, want Ek gee hom en sy hele volk en sy land in jou hand; en jy moet met hom doen soos jy gedoen het met Sihon, die koning van die Amoriete, wat in Hesbon gewoon het.

kjv_text: So the LORD our God delivered into our hands Og also, the king of Bashan, and all his people: and we smote him until none was left to him remaining.
bsb_text: So the LORD our God also delivered Og king of Bashan and his whole army into our hands. We struck them down until no survivor was left.
aov_text: En die HERE onse God het ook Og, die koning van Basan, en sy hele volk in ons hand gegee, sodat ons hom verslaan het, totdat daar van hom niemand oor was wat vrygeraak het nie.

kjv_text: And we took all his cities at that time, there was not a city which we took not from them, threescore cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
bsb_text: At that time we captured all sixty of his cities. There was not a single city we failed to take—the entire region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
aov_text: En ons het in dié tyd al sy stede ingeneem; daar was geen vesting wat ons van hulle nie afgeneem het nie: sestig stede, die hele landstreek Argob, die koninkryk van Og in Basan.

kjv_text: All these cities were fenced with high walls, gates, and bars; beside unwalled towns a great many.
bsb_text: All these cities were fortified with high walls and gates and bars, and there were many more unwalled villages.
aov_text: Al hierdie stede was versterk met hoë mure, poorte en grendels, behalwe ’n groot menigte onbemuurde stede.

kjv_text: And we utterly destroyed them, as we did unto Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying the men, women, and children, of every city.
bsb_text: We devoted them to destruction, as we had done to Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying the men, women, and children of every city.
aov_text: En ons het hulle met die banvloek getref soos ons met Sihon, die koning van Hesbon, gedoen het deur elke stad, manne, vroue en kinders met die banvloek te tref.

kjv_text: But all the cattle, and the spoil of the cities, we took for a prey to ourselves.
bsb_text: But all the livestock and plunder of the cities we carried off for ourselves.
aov_text: Maar al die vee en die buit van die stede het ons vir ons geroof.

kjv_text: And we took at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites the land that was on this side Jordan, from the river of Arnon unto mount Hermon;
bsb_text: At that time we took from the two kings of the Amorites the land across the Jordan, from the Arnon Valley as far as Mount Hermon—
aov_text: So het ons dan in dié tyd die land uit die hand van die twee konings van die Amoriete duskant die Jordaan geneem, van die Arnonrivier af tot by die berg Hermon —

kjv_text: (Which Hermon the Sidonians call Sirion; and the Amorites call it Shenir;)
bsb_text: which the Sidonians call Sirion but the Amorites call Senir—
aov_text: die Sidoniërs noem Hermon Sirjon; maar die Amoriete noem dit Senir —

kjv_text: All the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, unto Salchah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
bsb_text: all the cities of the plateau, all of Gilead, and all of Bashan as far as the cities of Salecah and Edrei in the kingdom of Og.
aov_text: al die stede van die gelykveld en die hele Gílead en die hele Basan tot by Salga en Edréï, stede van die koninkryk van Og in Basan.

kjv_text: For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of giants; behold, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron; is it not in Rabbath of the children of Ammon? nine cubits was the length thereof, and four cubits the breadth of it, after the cubit of a man.
bsb_text: (For only Og king of Bashan had remained of the remnant of the Rephaim. His bed of iron, nine cubits long and four cubits wide, is still in Rabbah of the Ammonites.)
aov_text: Want Og, die koning van Basan, het net alleen oorgebly van die Refaïete. Is sy ledekant, ’n ysterledekant, nie daar in Rabba van die kinders van Ammon nie? Nege el is sy lengte en vier el sy breedte, gewone elle.

kjv_text: And this land, which we possessed at that time, from Aroer, which is by the river Arnon, and half mount Gilead, and the cities thereof, gave I unto the Reubenites and to the Gadites.
bsb_text: So at that time we took possession of this land. To the Reubenites and Gadites I gave the land beyond Aroer along the Arnon Valley, and half the hill country of Gilead, along with its cities.
aov_text: En hierdie land het ons in dié tyd in besit geneem: van Ároër af, wat by die Arnonrivier lê, en die helfte van die gebergte van Gílead met die stede daarvan het ek aan die Rubeniete en die Gadiete gegee.

kjv_text: And the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, being the kingdom of Og, gave I unto the half tribe of Manasseh; all the region of Argob, with all Bashan, which was called the land of giants.
bsb_text: To the half-tribe of Manasseh I gave the rest of Gilead and all of Bashan, the kingdom of Og. (The entire region of Argob, the whole territory of Bashan, used to be called the land of the Rephaim.)
aov_text: En die orige deel van Gílead saam met die hele Basan, die koninkryk van Og, het ek aan die halwe stam van Manasse gegee—die hele landstreek Argob. Daardie hele Basan word land van die Refaïete genoem.

kjv_text: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the country of Argob unto the coasts of Geshuri and Maachathi; and called them after his own name, Bashanhavothjair, unto this day.
bsb_text: Jair, a descendant of Manasseh, took the whole region of Argob as far as the border of the Geshurites and Maacathites. He renamed Bashan after himself, Havvoth-jair, by which it is called to this day.
aov_text: Jaïr, die seun van Manasse, het die hele landstreek Argob tot by die grens van die Gesuriete en die Maägatiete gekry en dit, naamlik Basan, na sy naam Jaïrsdorpe genoem tot vandag toe.

kjv_text: And I gave Gilead unto Machir.
bsb_text: To Machir I gave Gilead,
aov_text: En aan Magir het ek Gílead gegee.

kjv_text: And unto the Reubenites and unto the Gadites I gave from Gilead even unto the river Arnon half the valley, and the border even unto the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;
bsb_text: and to the Reubenites and Gadites I gave the territory from Gilead to the Arnon Valley (the middle of the valley was the border) and up to the Jabbok River, the border of the Ammonites.
aov_text: Maar aan die Rubeniete en die Gadiete het ek van Gílead af tot by die Arnonrivier gegee, die middel van die rivier, saam met sy oewerland, en tot by die Jabbokrivier, die grens van die kinders van Ammon.

kjv_text: The plain also, and Jordan, and the coast thereof, from Chinnereth even unto the sea of the plain, even the salt sea, under Ashdothpisgah eastward.
bsb_text: The Jordan River in the Arabah bordered it from Chinnereth to the Sea of the Arabah (the Salt Sea) with the slopes of Pisgah to the east.
aov_text: Daarby die Vlakte en die Jordaan, saam met sy grondgebied, van Kinnéret af tot by die See van die Vlakte, die Soutsee, onder aan die hange van Pisga teen die ooste.

kjv_text: And I commanded you at that time, saying, The LORD your God hath given you this land to possess it: ye shall pass over armed before your brethren the children of Israel, all that are meet for the war.
bsb_text: At that time I commanded you: “The LORD your God has given you this land to possess. All your men of valor are to cross over, armed for battle, ahead of your brothers, the Israelites.
aov_text: Verder het ek in dié tyd aan julle bevel gegee en gesê: Die HERE julle God het aan julle hierdie land gegee om dit in besit te neem; gewapend moet julle voor jul broers, die kinders van Israel, oortrek—al die dapper manne.

kjv_text: But your wives, and your little ones, and your cattle, (for I know that ye have much cattle,) shall abide in your cities which I have given you;
bsb_text: But your wives, your children, and your livestock—I know that you have much livestock—may remain in the cities I have given you,
aov_text: Net julle vroue en julle kinders en julle vee—ek weet dat julle baie vee het—kan in julle stede bly wat ek aan julle gegee het;

kjv_text: Until the LORD have given rest unto your brethren, as well as unto you, and until they also possess the land which the LORD your God hath given them beyond Jordan: and then shall ye return every man unto his possession, which I have given you.
bsb_text: until the LORD gives rest to your brothers as He has to you, and they too have taken possession of the land that the LORD your God is giving them across the Jordan. Then each of you may return to the possession I have given you.”
aov_text: totdat die HERE aan julle broers soos aan julle rus gee, en hulle ook die land in besit neem wat die HERE julle God aan hulle oorkant die Jordaan sal gee; dan kan julle teruggaan elkeen na sy besitting wat ek aan julle gegee het.

kjv_text: And I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, Thine eyes have seen all that the LORD your God hath done unto these two kings: so shall the LORD do unto all the kingdoms whither thou passest.
bsb_text: And at that time I commanded Joshua: “Your own eyes have seen all that the LORD your God has done to these two kings. The LORD will do the same to all the kingdoms you are about to enter.
aov_text: Ook het ek Josua in dié tyd beveel en gesê: Jou oë het alles gesien wat die HERE julle God aan hierdie twee konings gedoen het. So sal die HERE aan al die koninkryke doen waarheen jy oortrek.

kjv_text: Ye shall not fear them: for the LORD your God he shall fight for you.
bsb_text: Do not be afraid of them, for the LORD your God Himself will fight for you.”
aov_text: Julle moet vir hulle nie bang wees nie, want dit is die HERE julle God wat vir julle stry.

kjv_text: And I besought the LORD at that time, saying,
bsb_text: At that time I also pleaded with the LORD:
aov_text: Ook het ek die HERE in dié tyd gesmeek en gesê:

kjv_text: O Lord GOD, thou hast begun to shew thy servant thy greatness, and thy mighty hand: for what God is there in heaven or in earth, that can do according to thy works, and according to thy might?
bsb_text: “O Lord GOD, You have begun to show Your greatness and power to Your servant. For what god in heaven or on earth can perform such works and mighty acts as Yours?
aov_text: Here, HERE! Ú het begin om u kneg u grootheid en u sterke hand te laat sien; want watter God is daar in die hemel en op die aarde wat sulke werke en sulke magtige dade kan doen soos U?

kjv_text: I pray thee, let me go over, and see the good land that is beyond Jordan, that goodly mountain, and Lebanon.
bsb_text: Please let me cross over and see the good land beyond the Jordan—that pleasant hill country as well as Lebanon!”
aov_text: Laat my tog oortrek en die mooi land sien wat oorkant die Jordaan lê, daardie goeie bergland en die Líbanon!

kjv_text: But the LORD was wroth with me for your sakes, and would not hear me: and the LORD said unto me, Let it suffice thee; speak no more unto me of this matter.
bsb_text: But the LORD was angry with me on account of you, and He would not listen to me. “That is enough,” the LORD said to me. “Do not speak to Me again about this matter.
aov_text: Maar die HERE het toornig op my geword om julle ontwil en my nie verhoor nie; maar die HERE het vir my gesê: Dit is nou genoeg! Moenie nog verder met My oor hierdie saak spreek nie.

kjv_text: Get thee up into the top of Pisgah, and lift up thine eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and behold it with thine eyes: for thou shalt not go over this Jordan.
bsb_text: Go to the top of Pisgah and look to the west and north and south and east. See the land with your own eyes, for you will not cross this Jordan.
aov_text: Klim op die top van Pisga en slaan jou oë op na die weste en na die noorde en na die suide en na die ooste, en bekyk dit met jou oë; want jy mag oor hierdie Jordaan nie gaan nie.

kjv_text: But charge Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him: for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which thou shalt see.
bsb_text: But commission Joshua, encourage him, and strengthen him, for he will cross over ahead of the people and enable them to inherit the land that you will see.”
aov_text: Gee dan bevel aan Josua, en versterk hom en bemoedig hom, want hý sal voor hierdie volk uit deurtrek, en hý sal hulle die land wat jy sal sien, laat erwe.

kjv_text: So we abode in the valley over against Bethpeor.
bsb_text: So we stayed in the valley opposite Beth-peor.
aov_text: En ons het in die dal teenoor Bet-Peor gebly.

kjv_text: Now therefore hearken, O Israel, unto the statutes and unto the judgments, which I teach you, for to do them, that ye may live, and go in and possess the land which the LORD God of your fathers giveth you.
bsb_text: Hear now, O Israel, the statutes and ordinances I am teaching you to follow, so that you may live and may enter and take possession of the land that the LORD, the God of your fathers, is giving you.
aov_text: LUISTER dan nou, Israel, na die insettinge en die verordeninge wat ek julle leer om te doen, sodat julle mag lewe en inkom en die land wat die HERE, die God van julle vaders, aan julle sal gee, in besit mag neem.

kjv_text: Ye shall not add unto the word which I command you, neither shall ye diminish ought from it, that ye may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you.
bsb_text: You must not add to or subtract from what I command you, so that you may keep the commandments of the LORD your God that I am giving you.
aov_text: Julle mag by die woord wat ek julle beveel, niks byvoeg nie, en julle mag daar niks van weglaat nie; sodat julle die gebooie van die HERE julle God mag onderhou, wat ek julle beveel.

kjv_text: Your eyes have seen what the LORD did because of Baalpeor: for all the men that followed Baalpeor, the LORD thy God hath destroyed them from among you.
bsb_text: Your eyes have seen what the LORD did at Baal-peor, for the LORD your God destroyed from among you all who followed Baal of Peor.
aov_text: Julle oë het gesien wat die HERE weens Baäl-Peor gedoen het; want al die manne wat agter Baäl-Peor aan geloop het, dié het die HERE jou God onder jou uit verdelg.

kjv_text: But ye that did cleave unto the LORD your God are alive every one of you this day.
bsb_text: But you who held fast to the LORD your God are alive to this day, every one of you.
aov_text: Julle daarenteen wat die HERE julle God aangehang het, is vandag nog almal in die lewe.

kjv_text: Behold, I have taught you statutes and judgments, even as the LORD my God commanded me, that ye should do so in the land whither ye go to possess it.
bsb_text: See, I have taught you statutes and ordinances just as the LORD my God has commanded me, so that you may follow them in the land that you are about to enter and possess.
aov_text: Kyk, ek het julle insettinge en verordeninge geleer soos die HERE my God my beveel het, om so te handel in die land waarheen julle gaan om dit in besit te neem.

kjv_text: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the nations, which shall hear all these statutes, and say, Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.
bsb_text: Observe them carefully, for this will show your wisdom and understanding in the sight of the peoples, who will hear of all these statutes and say, “Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.”
aov_text: Onderhou dit dan en doen dit; want dit is julle wysheid en julle verstand voor die oë van die volke wat al hierdie insettinge sal hoor en sê: Waarlik, hierdie groot nasie is ’n wyse en verstandige volk.

kjv_text: For what nation is there so great, who hath God so nigh unto them, as the LORD our God is in all things that we call upon him for?
bsb_text: For what nation is great enough to have a god as near to them as the LORD our God is to us whenever we call on Him?
aov_text: Want watter groot nasie het gode wat vir hulle so naby is soos die HERE onse God so dikwels as ons Hom aanroep?

kjv_text: And what nation is there so great, that hath statutes and judgments so righteous as all this law, which I set before you this day?
bsb_text: And what nation is great enough to have righteous statutes and ordinances like this entire law I set before you today?
aov_text: En watter groot nasie is daar wat sulke regverdige insettinge en verordeninge het soos hierdie hele wet wat ek julle vandag voorhou?

kjv_text: Only take heed to thyself, and keep thy soul diligently, lest thou forget the things which thine eyes have seen, and lest they depart from thy heart all the days of thy life: but teach them thy sons, and thy sons' sons;
bsb_text: Only be on your guard and diligently watch yourselves, so that you do not forget the things your eyes have seen, and so that they do not slip from your heart as long as you live. Teach them to your children and grandchildren.
aov_text: Neem jou net in ag en wees terdeë op jou hoede, dat jy die dinge nie vergeet wat jou oë gesien het nie, en dat hulle uit jou hart nie wyk al die dae van jou lewe nie; en jy moet dit aan jou kinders en jou kindskinders bekend maak:

kjv_text: Specially the day that thou stoodest before the LORD thy God in Horeb, when the LORD said unto me, Gather me the people together, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they shall live upon the earth, and that they may teach their children.
bsb_text: The day you stood before the LORD your God at Horeb, the LORD said to me, “Gather the people before Me to hear My words, so that they may learn to fear Me all the days they live on the earth, and that they may teach them to their children.”
aov_text: die dag dat jy voor die aangesig van die HERE jou God by Horeb gestaan het, toe die HERE aan my gesê het: Vergader die volk vir My, en Ek sal hulle my woorde laat hoor, dat hulle kan leer om My te vrees al die dae wat hulle op die aarde lewe, en dit aan hulle kinders kan leer.

kjv_text: And ye came near and stood under the mountain; and the mountain burned with fire unto the midst of heaven, with darkness, clouds, and thick darkness.
bsb_text: You came near and stood at the base of the mountain, a mountain blazing with fire to the heavens, with black clouds and deep darkness.
aov_text: Toe het julle nader gekom en onder aan die berg gaan staan; en die berg het met vuur gebrand tot in die middel van die hemel, met duisternis, wolke en wolkedonkerheid.

kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto you out of the midst of the fire: ye heard the voice of the words, but saw no similitude; only ye heard a voice.
bsb_text: And the LORD spoke to you out of the fire. You heard the sound of the words, but saw no form; there was only a voice.
aov_text: En die HERE het met julle uit die vuur gespreek; julle het ’n stem van woorde gehoor, maar geen verskyning gesien nie—net ’n stem was daar.

kjv_text: And he declared unto you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even ten commandments; and he wrote them upon two tables of stone.
bsb_text: He declared to you His covenant, which He commanded you to follow—the Ten Commandments that He wrote on two tablets of stone.
aov_text: Toe het Hy aan julle sy verbond verkondig wat Hy julle beveel het om te doen, die tien woorde, en dit op twee kliptafels geskrywe.

kjv_text: And the LORD commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go over to possess it.
bsb_text: At that time the LORD commanded me to teach you the statutes and ordinances you are to follow in the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess.
aov_text: Ook het die HERE my in dié tyd bevel gegee om julle die insettinge en verordeninge te leer, dat julle dit kan doen in die land waarheen julle oortrek om dit in besit te neem.

kjv_text: Take ye therefore good heed unto yourselves; for ye saw no manner of similitude on the day that the LORD spake unto you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire:
bsb_text: So since you saw no form of any kind on the day the LORD spoke to you out of the fire at Horeb, be careful
aov_text: Neem julle dan terdeë in ag ter wille van julle siele—want julle het géén verskyning gesien op die dag dat die HERE by Horeb uit die vuur met julle gespreek het nie —

kjv_text: Lest ye corrupt yourselves, and make you a graven image, the similitude of any figure, the likeness of male or female,
bsb_text: that you do not act corruptly and make an idol for yourselves of any form or shape, whether in the likeness of a male or female,
aov_text: sodat julle nie verderflik handel deurdat julle vir julle ’n gesnede beeld, ’n gelykenis van enige afgodsbeeld, maak nie: ’n afbeelding van man of vrou,

kjv_text: The likeness of any beast that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged fowl that flieth in the air,
bsb_text: of any beast that is on the earth or bird that flies in the air,
aov_text: ’n afbeelding van enige dier wat op die aarde is, ’n afbeelding van enige gevleuelde voël wat in die lug vlieg,

kjv_text: The likeness of any thing that creepeth on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the waters beneath the earth:
bsb_text: or of any creature that crawls on the ground or fish that is in the waters below.
aov_text: ’n afbeelding van enigiets wat op die aarde kruip, ’n afbeelding van enige vis wat in die water onder die aarde is;

kjv_text: And lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven, and when thou seest the sun, and the moon, and the stars, even all the host of heaven, shouldest be driven to worship them, and serve them, which the LORD thy God hath divided unto all nations under the whole heaven.
bsb_text: When you look to the heavens and see the sun and moon and stars—all the host of heaven—do not be enticed to bow down and worship what the LORD your God has apportioned to all the nations under heaven.
aov_text: dat jy ook jou oë nie na die hemel opslaan, en as jy die son sien en die maan en die sterre, die hele leër van die hemel, jou laat verlei en voor hulle neerbuig en hulle dien nie—dinge wat die HERE jou God aan al die volke onder die hele hemel uitgedeel het.

kjv_text: But the LORD hath taken you, and brought you forth out of the iron furnace, even out of Egypt, to be unto him a people of inheritance, as ye are this day.
bsb_text: Yet the LORD has taken you and brought you out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be the people of His inheritance, as you are today.
aov_text: Maar die HERE het julle geneem en julle uit die ystersmeltoond, uit Egipte, uitgelei om sy erfvolk te wees soos dit vandag is.

kjv_text: Furthermore the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, and sware that I should not go over Jordan, and that I should not go in unto that good land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee for an inheritance:
bsb_text: The LORD, however, was angry with me on account of you, and He swore that I would not cross the Jordan to enter the good land that the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance.
aov_text: Ook was die HERE toornig op my om julle ontwil, en Hy het gesweer dat ek oor die Jordaan nie sal gaan en nie sal kom in die goeie land wat die HERE jou God jou as erfenis sal gee nie.

kjv_text: But I must die in this land, I must not go over Jordan: but ye shall go over, and possess that good land.
bsb_text: For I will not be crossing the Jordan, because I must die in this land. But you shall cross over and take possession of that good land.
aov_text: Want ek sal in hierdie land sterwe, ek sal oor die Jordaan nie gaan nie; maar julle sal oorgaan en daardie goeie land in besit neem.

kjv_text: Take heed unto yourselves, lest ye forget the covenant of the LORD your God, which he made with you, and make you a graven image, or the likeness of any thing, which the LORD thy God hath forbidden thee.
bsb_text: Be careful that you do not forget the covenant of the LORD your God that He made with you; do not make an idol for yourselves in the form of anything He has forbidden you.
aov_text: Neem julle in ag dat julle die verbond van die HERE julle God, wat Hy met julle gesluit het, nie vergeet en vir julle geen gesnede beeld maak nie—’n gelykenis van enigiets wat die HERE jou God jou verbied het.

kjv_text: For the LORD thy God is a consuming fire, even a jealous God.
bsb_text: For the LORD your God is a consuming fire, a jealous God.
aov_text: Want die HERE jou God is ’n verterende vuur, ’n jaloerse God.

kjv_text: When thou shalt beget children, and children's children, and ye shall have remained long in the land, and shall corrupt yourselves, and make a graven image, or the likeness of any thing, and shall do evil in the sight of the LORD thy God, to provoke him to anger:
bsb_text: After you have children and grandchildren and you have been in the land a long time, if you then act corruptly and make an idol of any form—doing evil in the sight of the LORD your God and provoking Him to anger—
aov_text: As jy kinders en kindskinders sal verwek en julle in die land verouderd sal wees en verderflik handel deurdat julle ’n gesnede beeld maak, ’n gelykenis van enigiets, en doen wat verkeerd is in die oë van die HERE jou God om Hom te terg,

kjv_text: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that ye shall soon utterly perish from off the land whereunto ye go over Jordan to possess it; ye shall not prolong your days upon it, but shall utterly be destroyed.
bsb_text: I call heaven and earth as witnesses against you this day that you will quickly perish from the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess. You will not live long upon it, but will be utterly destroyed.
aov_text: dan neem ek vandag die hemel en die aarde as getuies teen julle dat julle sekerlik gou uit die land sal vergaan waarheen julle oor die Jordaan trek om dit in besit te neem; julle sal die dae daarin nie verleng nie, maar sekerlik verdelg word.

kjv_text: And the LORD shall scatter you among the nations, and ye shall be left few in number among the heathen, whither the LORD shall lead you.
bsb_text: Then the LORD will scatter you among the peoples, and only a few of you will survive among the nations to which the LORD will drive you.
aov_text: En die HERE sal julle onder die volke verstrooi, en ’n klein klompie van julle sal onder die nasies oorbly waarheen die HERE julle sal drywe.

kjv_text: And there ye shall serve gods, the work of men's hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.
bsb_text: And there you will serve man-made gods of wood and stone, which cannot see or hear or eat or smell.
aov_text: En daar sal julle gode dien, die werk van mensehande, hout en klip wat nie sien en nie hoor en nie eet en nie ruik nie.

kjv_text: But if from thence thou shalt seek the LORD thy God, thou shalt find him, if thou seek him with all thy heart and with all thy soul.
bsb_text: But if from there you will seek the LORD your God, you will find Him if you seek Him with all your heart and with all your soul.
aov_text: Dan sal julle daarvandaan die HERE jou God soek en vind as jy Hom met jou hele hart en jou hele siel soek.

kjv_text: When thou art in tribulation, and all these things are come upon thee, even in the latter days, if thou turn to the LORD thy God, and shalt be obedient unto his voice;
bsb_text: When you are in distress and all these things have happened to you, then in later days you will return to the LORD your God and listen to His voice.
aov_text: As jy in die nood is en al hierdie dinge aan die einde van die dae oor jou kom, sal jy na die HERE jou God terugkeer en na sy stem luister.

kjv_text: (For the LORD thy God is a merciful God;) he will not forsake thee, neither destroy thee, nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which he sware unto them.
bsb_text: For the LORD your God is a merciful God; He will not abandon you or destroy you or forget the covenant with your fathers, which He swore to them by oath.
aov_text: Want die HERE jou God is ’n barmhartige God; Hy sal jou nie verlaat en jou nie in die verderf stort nie; en Hy sal die verbond van jou vaders wat Hy hulle besweer het, nie vergeet nie.
