kjv_text: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before thee, since the day that God created man upon the earth, and ask from the one side of heaven unto the other, whether there hath been any such thing as this great thing is, or hath been heard like it?
bsb_text: Indeed, ask now from one end of the heavens to the other about the days that long preceded you, from the day that God created man on earth: Has anything as great as this ever happened or been reported?
aov_text: Want doen tog ondersoek na die vorige dae wat voor jou gewees het, van die dag af dat God mense op die aarde geskape het, en van die een einde van die hemel tot by die ander einde van die hemel, of so iets groots gebeur het of iets dergeliks gehoor is.

kjv_text: Did ever people hear the voice of God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as thou hast heard, and live?
bsb_text: Has a people ever heard the voice of God speaking out of the fire, as you have, and lived?
aov_text: Het ’n volk die stem van God uit die vuur hoor spreek, soos jý gehoor het, en in die lewe gebly?

kjv_text: Or hath God assayed to go and take him a nation from the midst of another nation, by temptations, by signs, and by wonders, and by war, and by a mighty hand, and by a stretched out arm, and by great terrors, according to all that the LORD your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?
bsb_text: Or has any god tried to take as his own a nation out of another nation—by trials, signs, wonders, and war, by a strong hand and an outstretched arm, and by great terrors—as the LORD your God did for you in Egypt, before your eyes?
aov_text: Of het ’n god probeer om vir hom ’n nasie uit ’n ander nasie te gaan neem deur versoekinge, deur tekens en wonders en deur oorlog en deur ’n sterke hand en ’n uitgestrekte arm en deur groot skrikwekkende dade soos die HERE julle God met julle voor jou oë in Egipte gedoen het?

kjv_text: Unto thee it was shewed, that thou mightest know that the LORD he is God; there is none else beside him.
bsb_text: You were shown these things so that you would know that the LORD is God; there is no other besides Him.
aov_text: Jy self het dit te sien gekry, dat jy kan weet dat die HERE God is; daar is geen ander buiten Hom nie.

kjv_text: Out of heaven he made thee to hear his voice, that he might instruct thee: and upon earth he shewed thee his great fire; and thou heardest his words out of the midst of the fire.
bsb_text: He let you hear His voice from heaven to discipline you, and on earth He showed you His great fire, and you heard His words out of the fire.
aov_text: Uit die hemel het Hy jou sy stem laat hoor om jou te onderrig; en op die aarde het Hy jou sy groot vuur laat sien, en jy het sy woorde uit die vuur gehoor.

kjv_text: And because he loved thy fathers, therefore he chose their seed after them, and brought thee out in his sight with his mighty power out of Egypt;
bsb_text: Because He loved your fathers, He chose their descendants after them and brought you out of Egypt by His presence and great power,
aov_text: En omdat Hy jou vaders liefgehad en hulle nageslag na hulle uitverkies het, en Hy self jou deur sy grote krag uit Egipte uitgelei het,

kjv_text: To drive out nations from before thee greater and mightier than thou art, to bring thee in, to give thee their land for an inheritance, as it is this day.
bsb_text: to drive out before you nations greater and mightier than you, and to bring you into their land and give it to you for your inheritance, as it is this day.
aov_text: om nasies groter en magtiger as jy voor jou uit te verdrywe en jou in te bring om hulle land aan jou as erfenis te gee soos dit vandag is —

kjv_text: Know therefore this day, and consider it in thine heart, that the LORD he is God in heaven above, and upon the earth beneath: there is none else.
bsb_text: Know therefore this day and take to heart that the LORD is God in heaven above and on the earth below; there is no other.
aov_text: daarom moet jy vandag weet en ter harte neem dat die HERE God is, bo in die hemel en onder op die aarde; daar is geen ander nie.

kjv_text: Thou shalt keep therefore his statutes, and his commandments, which I command thee this day, that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, and that thou mayest prolong thy days upon the earth, which the LORD thy God giveth thee, for ever.
bsb_text: Keep His statutes and commandments, which I am giving you today, so that you and your children after you may prosper, and that you may live long in the land that the LORD your God is giving you for all time.
aov_text: En jy moet sy insettinge en sy gebooie hou wat ek jou vandag beveel, dat dit met jou en jou kinders ná jou goed mag gaan, en dat jy die dae mag verleng in die land wat die HERE jou God jou vir altyd sal gee.

kjv_text: Then Moses severed three cities on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;
bsb_text: Then Moses set aside three cities across the Jordan to the east
aov_text: TOE het Moses drie stede afgesonder oos van die Jordaan, teen sonop,

kjv_text: That the slayer might flee thither, which should kill his neighbour unawares, and hated him not in times past; and that fleeing unto one of these cities he might live:
bsb_text: to which a manslayer could flee after killing his neighbor unintentionally without prior malice. To save one’s own life, he could flee to one of these cities:
aov_text: sodat hy wat ’n doodslag begaan het, daarheen kon vlug, wat sy naaste sonder opset doodgeslaan het, terwyl hy hom van gister en eergister af nie vyandig was nie; sodat hy in een van hierdie stede kan vlug en in die lewe bly.

kjv_text: Namely, Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, of the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead, of the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, of the Manassites.
bsb_text: Bezer in the wilderness on the plateau belonging to the Reubenites, Ramoth in Gilead belonging to the Gadites, or Golan in Bashan belonging to the Manassites.
aov_text: Beser in die woestyn, in die landstreek van die gelykveld, vir die Rubeniete; en Ramot in Gílead vir die Gadiete; en Golan in Basan vir die Manassiete.

kjv_text: And this is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel:
bsb_text: This is the law that Moses set before the Israelites.
aov_text: EN dit is die wet wat Moses die kinders van Israel voorgehou het.

kjv_text: These are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which Moses spake unto the children of Israel, after they came forth out of Egypt,
bsb_text: These are the testimonies, statutes, and ordinances that Moses proclaimed to them after they had come out of Egypt,
aov_text: Dit is die getuienisse en die insettinge en die verordeninge wat Moses meegedeel het aan die kinders van Israel by hulle uittog uit Egipte,

kjv_text: On this side Jordan, in the valley over against Bethpeor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel smote, after they were come forth out of Egypt:
bsb_text: while they were in the valley across the Jordan facing Beth-peor in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon and was defeated by Moses and the Israelites after they had come out of Egypt.
aov_text: oos van die Jordaan, in die dal teenoor Bet-Peor, in die land van Sihon, die koning van die Amoriete, wat in Hesbon gewoon het, wat deur Moses en die kinders van Israel verslaan is by hulle uittog uit Egipte;

kjv_text: And they possessed his land, and the land of Og king of Bashan, two kings of the Amorites, which were on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;
bsb_text: They took possession of the land belonging to Sihon and to Og king of Bashan—the two Amorite kings across the Jordan to the east—
aov_text: en hulle het sy land in besit geneem en die land van Og, die koning van Basan, die twee konings van die Amoriete oos van die Jordaan teen sonop;

kjv_text: From Aroer, which is by the bank of the river Arnon, even unto mount Sion, which is Hermon,
bsb_text: extending from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Valley as far as Mount Siyon (that is, Hermon),
aov_text: van Ároër af, wat aan die kant van die Arnonrivier lê, tot by die berg Sion, dit is Hermon,

kjv_text: And all the plain on this side Jordan eastward, even unto the sea of the plain, under the springs of Pisgah.
bsb_text: including all the Arabah on the east side of the Jordan and as far as the Sea of the Arabah, below the slopes of Pisgah.
aov_text: en die hele Vlakte oos van die Jordaan teen sonop tot by die See van die Vlakte, onderaan die hange van Pisga.

kjv_text: And Moses called all Israel, and said unto them, Hear, O Israel, the statutes and judgments which I speak in your ears this day, that ye may learn them, and keep, and do them.
bsb_text: Then Moses summoned all Israel and said to them: Hear, O Israel, the statutes and ordinances that I declare in your hearing this day. Learn them and observe them carefully.
aov_text: EN Moses het die hele Israel laat roep en vir hulle gesê: Hoor, Israel, die insettinge en die verordeninge wat ek vandag voor julle ore uitspreek; julle moet dit leer en dit sorgvuldig hou.

kjv_text: The LORD our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.
bsb_text: The LORD our God made a covenant with us at Horeb.
aov_text: Die HERE onse God het by Horeb met ons ’n verbond gesluit.

kjv_text: The LORD made not this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive this day.
bsb_text: He did not make this covenant with our fathers, but with all of us who are alive here today.
aov_text: Met ons vaders het die HERE hierdie verbond nie gesluit nie, maar met ons self, ons wat hier vandag almal in die lewe is.

kjv_text: The LORD talked with you face to face in the mount out of the midst of the fire,
bsb_text: The LORD spoke with you face to face out of the fire on the mountain.
aov_text: Van aangesig tot aangesig het die HERE op die berg uit die vuur met julle gespreek —

kjv_text: (I stood between the LORD and you at that time, to shew you the word of the LORD: for ye were afraid by reason of the fire, and went not up into the mount;) saying,
bsb_text: At that time I was standing between the LORD and you to declare to you the word of the LORD, because you were afraid of the fire and would not go up the mountain. And He said:
aov_text: ek het in dié tyd tussen die HERE en julle gestaan om aan julle die woord van die HERE bekend te maak, want julle was bevrees vir die vuur en het nie op die berg geklim nie—en Hy het gesê:

kjv_text: I am the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
bsb_text: “I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
aov_text: Ek is die HERE jou God wat jou uit Egipteland, uit die slawehuis, uitgelei het.

kjv_text: Thou shalt have none other gods before me.
bsb_text: You shall have no other gods before Me.
aov_text: Jy mag geen ander gode voor my aangesig hê nie.

kjv_text: Thou shalt not make thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the waters beneath the earth:
bsb_text: You shall not make for yourself an idol in the form of anything in the heavens above, on the earth below, or in the waters beneath.
aov_text: Jy mag vir jou geen gesnede beeld of enige gelykenis maak van wat bo in die hemel is, of van wat onder op die aarde is, of van wat in die waters onder die aarde is nie.

kjv_text: Thou shalt not bow down thyself unto them, nor serve them: for I the LORD thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me,
bsb_text: You shall not bow down to them or worship them; for I, the LORD your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on their children to the third and fourth generations of those who hate Me,
aov_text: Jy mag jou voor hulle nie neerbuig en hulle nie dien nie; want Ek, die HERE jou God, is ’n jaloerse God wat die misdaad van die vaders besoek aan die kinders, en aan die derde en aan die vierde geslag van die wat My haat;

kjv_text: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me and keep my commandments.
bsb_text: but showing loving devotion to a thousand generations of those who love Me and keep My commandments.
aov_text: en Ek bewys barmhartigheid aan duisende van die wat My liefhet en my gebooie onderhou.

kjv_text: Thou shalt not take the name of the LORD thy God in vain: for the LORD will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.
bsb_text: You shall not take the name of the LORD your God in vain, for the LORD will not leave anyone unpunished who takes His name in vain.
aov_text: Jy mag die Naam van die HERE jou God nie ydellik gebruik nie, want die HERE sal die een wat sy Naam ydellik gebruik, nie ongestraf laat bly nie.

kjv_text: Keep the sabbath day to sanctify it, as the LORD thy God hath commanded thee.
bsb_text: Observe the Sabbath day by keeping it holy, as the LORD your God has commanded you.
aov_text: Onderhou die sabbatdag, dat jy dit heilig soos die HERE jou God jou beveel het.

kjv_text: Six days thou shalt labour, and do all thy work:
bsb_text: Six days you shall labor and do all your work,
aov_text: Ses dae moet jy arbei en al jou werk doen;

kjv_text: But the seventh day is the sabbath of the LORD thy God: in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, nor thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thine ox, nor thine ass, nor any of thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates; that thy manservant and thy maidservant may rest as well as thou.
bsb_text: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD your God, on which you must not do any work—neither you, nor your son or daughter, nor your manservant or maidservant, nor your ox or donkey or any of your livestock, nor the foreigner within your gates, so that your manservant and maidservant may rest as you do.
aov_text: maar die sewende dag is die sabbat van die HERE jou God; dan mag jy géén werk doen nie—jy of jou seun of jou dogter, of jou dienskneg of jou diensmaagd, of jou os of jou esel of enige dier van jou, of jou vreemdeling wat in jou poorte is nie; sodat jou dienskneg en jou diensmaagd kan rus soos jy.

kjv_text: And remember that thou wast a servant in the land of Egypt, and that the LORD thy God brought thee out thence through a mighty hand and by a stretched out arm: therefore the LORD thy God commanded thee to keep the sabbath day.
bsb_text: Remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and that the LORD your God brought you out of there with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm. That is why the LORD your God has commanded you to keep the Sabbath day.
aov_text: En jy moet daaraan dink dat jy in Egipteland ’n slaaf was, en die HERE jou God jou daarvandaan uitgelei het deur ’n sterke hand en ’n uitgestrekte arm; daarom het die HERE jou God jou beveel om die sabbatdag te hou.

kjv_text: Honour thy father and thy mother, as the LORD thy God hath commanded thee; that thy days may be prolonged, and that it may go well with thee, in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
bsb_text: Honor your father and your mother, as the LORD your God has commanded you, so that your days may be long and that it may go well with you in the land that the LORD your God is giving you.
aov_text: Eer jou vader en jou moeder soos die HERE jou God jou beveel het, dat jou dae verleng mag word en dat dit met jou goed mag gaan in die land wat die HERE jou God aan jou gee.

kjv_text: Thou shalt not kill.
bsb_text: You shall not murder.
aov_text: Jy mag nie doodslaan nie.

kjv_text: Neither shalt thou commit adultery.
bsb_text: You shall not commit adultery.
aov_text: En jy mag nie egbreek nie.

kjv_text: Neither shalt thou steal.
bsb_text: You shall not steal.
aov_text: En jy mag nie steel nie.

kjv_text: Neither shalt thou bear false witness against thy neighbour.
bsb_text: You shall not bear false witness against your neighbor.
aov_text: En jy mag geen valse getuienis teen jou naaste spreek nie.

kjv_text: Neither shalt thou desire thy neighbour's wife, neither shalt thou covet thy neighbour's house, his field, or his manservant, or his maidservant, his ox, or his ass, or any thing that is thy neighbour's.
bsb_text: You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife. You shall not covet your neighbor’s house or field, or his manservant or maidservant, or his ox or donkey, or anything that belongs to your neighbor.”
aov_text: En jy mag nie jou naaste se vrou begeer nie; en jy mag nie na jou naaste se huis hunker nie—na sy landerye of sy dienskneg of sy diensmaagd, sy os of sy esel of iets wat van jou naaste is nie.

kjv_text: These words the LORD spake unto all your assembly in the mount out of the midst of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice: and he added no more. And he wrote them in two tables of stone, and delivered them unto me.
bsb_text: The LORD spoke these commandments in a loud voice to your whole assembly out of the fire, the cloud, and the deep darkness on the mountain; He added nothing more. And He wrote them on two tablets of stone and gave them to me.
aov_text: Met hierdie woorde het die HERE julle hele vergadering op die berg, uit die vuur, die wolk en die wolkedonkerheid met ’n groot stem toegespreek, en niks meer nie; en Hy het dit op twee kliptafels geskrywe en dit aan my gegee.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when ye heard the voice out of the midst of the darkness, (for the mountain did burn with fire,) that ye came near unto me, even all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;
bsb_text: And when you heard the voice out of the darkness while the mountain was blazing with fire, all the heads of your tribes and your elders approached me,
aov_text: En toe julle die stem uit die duisternis hoor, terwyl die berg met vuur brand, het julle na my toe aangekom, al die hoofde van julle stamme en julle oudstes,

kjv_text: And ye said, Behold, the LORD our God hath shewed us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the midst of the fire: we have seen this day that God doth talk with man, and he liveth.
bsb_text: and you said, “Behold, the LORD our God has shown us His glory and greatness, and we have heard His voice out of the fire. Today we have seen that a man can live even if God speaks with him.
aov_text: en gesê: Kyk, die HERE onse God het ons sy heerlikheid en sy grootheid laat sien, en ons het sy stem uit die vuur gehoor; vandag het ons gesien dat God met die mens spreek en hy in die lewe bly.

kjv_text: Now therefore why should we die? for this great fire will consume us: if we hear the voice of the LORD our God any more, then we shall die.
bsb_text: But now, why should we die? For this great fire will consume us, and we will die, if we hear the voice of the LORD our God any longer.
aov_text: Maar waarom moet ons nou sterwe? Want hierdie groot vuur sal ons verteer. As ons die stem van die HERE onse God nog langer hoor, sal ons sterwe.

kjv_text: For who is there of all flesh, that hath heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as we have, and lived?
bsb_text: For who of all flesh has heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the fire, as we have, and survived?
aov_text: Want wie is daar van alle vlees wat die stem van die lewende God uit die vuur hoor spreek het soos ons en in die lewe gebly het?

kjv_text: Go thou near, and hear all that the LORD our God shall say: and speak thou unto us all that the LORD our God shall speak unto thee; and we will hear it, and do it.
bsb_text: Go near and listen to all that the LORD our God says. Then you can tell us everything the LORD our God tells you; we will listen and obey.”
aov_text: Gaan ú naderby en hoor alles wat die HERE onse God sal sê; dan kan ú ons alles meedeel wat die HERE onse God met u sal spreek, en ons sal dit hoor en doen.

kjv_text: And the LORD heard the voice of your words, when ye spake unto me; and the LORD said unto me, I have heard the voice of the words of this people, which they have spoken unto thee: they have well said all that they have spoken.
bsb_text: And the LORD heard the words you spoke to me, and He said to me, “I have heard the words that these people have spoken to you. They have done well in all that they have spoken.
aov_text: En die HERE het die stem van julle woorde gehoor toe julle met my gespreek het. Toe sê die HERE vir my: Ek het gehoor die stem van die woorde van hierdie volk wat hulle met jou gespreek het; dit is alles goed wat hulle gespreek het.

kjv_text: O that there were such an heart in them, that they would fear me, and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them, and with their children for ever!
bsb_text: If only they had such a heart to fear Me and keep all My commandments always, so that it might be well with them and with their children forever.
aov_text: Ag, as hulle maar so ’n hart gehad het om My te vrees en al my gebooie altyd te onderhou, dat dit met hulle en hul kinders vir ewig goed kan gaan.

kjv_text: Go say to them, Get you into your tents again.
bsb_text: Go and tell them: ‘Return to your tents.’
aov_text: Gaan sê vir hulle: Gaan maar terug na julle tente toe.

kjv_text: But as for thee, stand thou here by me, and I will speak unto thee all the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which thou shalt teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess it.
bsb_text: But you stand here with Me, that I may speak to you all the commandments and statutes and ordinances you are to teach them to follow in the land that I am giving them to possess.”
aov_text: Maar jy, bly hier by My staan, dat Ek jou kan meedeel al die gebooie en die insettinge en die verordeninge wat jy hulle moet leer, dat hulle dit kan doen in die land wat Ek hulle sal gee om dit in besit te neem.

kjv_text: Ye shall observe to do therefore as the LORD your God hath commanded you: ye shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.
bsb_text: So be careful to do as the LORD your God has commanded you; you are not to turn aside to the right or to the left.
aov_text: Sorg dan dat julle doen soos die HERE julle God julle beveel het; julle mag nie regs of links afwyk nie.

kjv_text: Ye shall walk in all the ways which the LORD your God hath commanded you, that ye may live, and that it may be well with you, and that ye may prolong your days in the land which ye shall possess.
bsb_text: You must walk in all the ways that the LORD your God has commanded you, so that you may live and prosper and prolong your days in the land that you will possess.
aov_text: In al die weë wat die HERE julle God julle beveel het, moet julle wandel, sodat julle kan lewe en dit met julle goed kan gaan en julle die dae kan verleng in die land wat julle in besit sal neem.

kjv_text: Now these are the commandments, the statutes, and the judgments, which the LORD your God commanded to teach you, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go to possess it:
bsb_text: These are the commandments and statutes and ordinances that the LORD your God has instructed me to teach you to follow in the land that you are about to enter and possess,
aov_text: DIT is dan die gebod, die insettinge en die verordeninge wat die HERE julle God beveel het om julle te leer, sodat julle dit kan doen in die land waarheen julle oortrek om dit in besit te neem;

kjv_text: That thou mightest fear the LORD thy God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command thee, thou, and thy son, and thy son's son, all the days of thy life; and that thy days may be prolonged.
bsb_text: so that you and your children and grandchildren may fear the LORD your God all the days of your lives by keeping all His statutes and commandments that I give you, and so that your days may be prolonged.
aov_text: dat jy die HERE jou God kan vrees om al sy insettinge en sy gebooie wat ek jou beveel, te hou—jy en jou kind en jou kindskind al die dae van jou lewe; en dat jou dae verleng kan word.

kjv_text: Hear therefore, O Israel, and observe to do it; that it may be well with thee, and that ye may increase mightily, as the LORD God of thy fathers hath promised thee, in the land that floweth with milk and honey.
bsb_text: Hear, O Israel, and be careful to observe them, so that you may prosper and multiply greatly in a land flowing with milk and honey, just as the LORD, the God of your fathers, has promised you.
aov_text: Hoor dan, Israel, en onderhou dit sorgvuldig, dat dit met jou goed kan gaan en dat julle baie kan vermenigvuldig soos die HERE die God van jou vaders jou beloof het, ’n land wat oorloop van melk en heuning.

kjv_text: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God is one LORD:
bsb_text: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God, the LORD is One.
aov_text: Hoor, Israel, die HERE onse God is ’n enige HERE.

kjv_text: And thou shalt love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.
bsb_text: And you shall love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength.
aov_text: Daarom moet jy die HERE jou God liefhê met jou hele hart en met jou hele siel en met al jou krag.

kjv_text: And these words, which I command thee this day, shall be in thine heart:
bsb_text: These words I am commanding you today are to be upon your hearts.
aov_text: En hierdie woorde wat ek jou vandag beveel, moet in jou hart wees;

kjv_text: And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.
bsb_text: And you shall teach them diligently to your children and speak of them when you sit at home and when you walk along the road, when you lie down and when you get up.
aov_text: en jy moet dit jou kinders inskerp en daaroor spreek as jy in jou huis sit en as jy op pad is en as jy gaan lê en as jy opstaan.

kjv_text: And thou shalt bind them for a sign upon thine hand, and they shall be as frontlets between thine eyes.
bsb_text: Tie them as reminders on your hands and bind them on your foreheads.
aov_text: Ook moet jy dit as ’n teken bind op jou hand, en dit moet as ’n voorhoofsband tussen jou oë wees.

kjv_text: And thou shalt write them upon the posts of thy house, and on thy gates.
bsb_text: Write them on the doorposts of your houses and on your gates.
aov_text: En jy moet dit op die deurposte van jou huis en op jou poorte skrywe.

kjv_text: And it shall be, when the LORD thy God shall have brought thee into the land which he sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give thee great and goodly cities, which thou buildedst not,
bsb_text: And when the LORD your God brings you into the land He swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, that He would give you—a land with great and splendid cities that you did not build,
aov_text: En as die HERE jou God jou inbring in die land wat Hy aan jou vaders, Abraham, Isak en Jakob, met ’n eed beloof het om jou te gee—groot en mooi stede wat jy nie gebou het nie,

kjv_text: And houses full of all good things, which thou filledst not, and wells digged, which thou diggedst not, vineyards and olive trees, which thou plantedst not;
bsb_text: with houses full of every good thing with which you did not fill them, with wells that you did not dig, and with vineyards and olive groves that you did not plant—
aov_text: en huise vol van allerhande goed wat jy nie gevul het nie, en uitgekapte reënbakke wat jy nie uitgekap, wingerde en olyfbome wat jy nie geplant het nie—

kjv_text: when thou shalt have eaten and be full;
bsb_text: and when you eat and are satisfied,
aov_text: en jy eet en versadig word,

kjv_text: Then beware lest thou forget the LORD, which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
bsb_text: be careful not to forget the LORD who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
aov_text: neem jou dan in ag dat jy die HERE nie vergeet wat jou uit Egipteland, uit die slawehuis, uitgelei het nie.

kjv_text: Thou shalt fear the LORD thy God, and serve him, and shalt swear by his name.
bsb_text: Fear the LORD your God, serve Him only, and take your oaths in His name.
aov_text: Jy moet die HERE jou God vrees en Hom dien; en by sy Naam moet jy sweer.

kjv_text: Ye shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the people which are round about you;
bsb_text: Do not follow other gods, the gods of the peoples around you.
aov_text: Julle mag nie agter ander gode aan loop uit die gode van die volke wat rondom julle is nie —

kjv_text: (For the LORD thy God is a jealous God among you) lest the anger of the LORD thy God be kindled against thee, and destroy thee from off the face of the earth.
bsb_text: For the LORD your God, who is among you, is a jealous God. Otherwise the anger of the LORD your God will be kindled against you, and He will wipe you off the face of the earth.
aov_text: want die HERE jou God is ’n jaloerse God by jou—sodat die toorn van die HERE jou God nie teen jou ontvlam en Hy jou van die aarde verdelg nie.

kjv_text: Ye shall not tempt the LORD your God, as ye tempted him in Massah.
bsb_text: Do not test the LORD your God as you tested Him at Massah.
aov_text: Julle mag die HERE julle God nie versoek soos julle Hom by Massa versoek het nie.

kjv_text: Ye shall diligently keep the commandments of the LORD your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he hath commanded thee.
bsb_text: You are to diligently keep the commandments of the LORD your God and the testimonies and statutes He has given you.
aov_text: Julle moet die gebooie van die HERE julle God en sy getuienisse en sy insettinge wat Hy jou beveel het, ywerig onderhou.

kjv_text: And thou shalt do that which is right and good in the sight of the LORD: that it may be well with thee, and that thou mayest go in and possess the good land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers,
bsb_text: Do what is right and good in the sight of the LORD, so that it may be well with you and that you may enter and possess the good land that the LORD your God swore to give your fathers,
aov_text: En jy moet doen wat reg en goed is in die oë van die HERE, dat dit met jou goed kan gaan en jy kan inkom en in besit neem die goeie land wat die HERE aan jou vaders met ’n eed beloof het,

kjv_text: To cast out all thine enemies from before thee, as the LORD hath spoken.
bsb_text: driving out all your enemies before you, as the LORD has said.
aov_text: terwyl Hy al jou vyande voor jou uit verjaag soos die HERE gespreek het.

kjv_text: And when thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying, What mean the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which the LORD our God hath commanded you?
bsb_text: In the future, when your son asks, “What is the meaning of the decrees and statutes and ordinances that the LORD our God has commanded you?”
aov_text: As jou seun jou later vra en sê: Wat beteken die getuienisse en die insettinge en die verordeninge wat die HERE onse God julle beveel het?

kjv_text: Then thou shalt say unto thy son, We were Pharaoh's bondmen in Egypt; and the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand:
bsb_text: then you are to tell him, “We were slaves of Pharaoh in Egypt, but the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand.
aov_text: dan moet jy aan jou seun sê: Ons was slawe van Farao in Egipte; maar die HERE het ons deur ’n sterke hand uit Egipte uitgelei.

kjv_text: And the LORD shewed signs and wonders, great and sore, upon Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his household, before our eyes:
bsb_text: Before our eyes the LORD inflicted great and devastating signs and wonders on Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his household.
aov_text: En die HERE het groot en onheilbrengende tekens en wonders voor ons oë in Egipte aan Farao en sy hele huis gedoen.

kjv_text: And he brought us out from thence, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he sware unto our fathers.
bsb_text: But He brought us out from there to lead us in and give us the land that He had sworn to our fathers.
aov_text: En Hy het ons daarvandaan uitgelei om ons in te bring, sodat Hy ons die land kan gee wat Hy aan ons vaders met ’n eed beloof het.

kjv_text: And the LORD commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear the LORD our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as it is at this day.
bsb_text: And the LORD commanded us to observe all these statutes and to fear the LORD our God, that we may always be prosperous and preserved, as we are to this day.
aov_text: En die HERE het ons beveel om al hierdie insettinge te volbring, om die HERE onse God te vrees, dat dit met ons altyd goed mag gaan, om ons in die lewe te hou soos dit vandag is.

kjv_text: And it shall be our righteousness, if we observe to do all these commandments before the LORD our God, as he hath commanded us.
bsb_text: And if we are careful to observe every one of these commandments before the LORD our God, as He has commanded us, then that will be our righteousness.”
aov_text: En dit sal geregtigheid vir ons wees as ons sorgvuldig al hierdie gebooie hou voor die aangesig van die HERE onse God soos Hy ons beveel het.

kjv_text: When the LORD thy God shall bring thee into the land whither thou goest to possess it, and hath cast out many nations before thee, the Hittites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, seven nations greater and mightier than thou;
bsb_text: When the LORD your God brings you into the land that you are entering to possess, and He drives out before you many nations—the Hittites, Girgashites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, seven nations larger and stronger than you—
aov_text: AS die HERE jou God jou inbring in die land waarheen jy gaan om dit in besit te neem, en Hy baie nasies voor jou uit verjaag: die Hetiete, Girgasiete, Amoriete, Kanaäniete, Feresiete, Hewiete en Jebusiete, sewe nasies, meer en magtiger as jy;

kjv_text: And when the LORD thy God shall deliver them before thee; thou shalt smite them, and utterly destroy them; thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor shew mercy unto them:
bsb_text: and when the LORD your God has delivered them over to you to defeat them, then you must devote them to complete destruction. Make no treaty with them and show them no mercy.
aov_text: en die HERE jou God hulle aan jou oorgee, dat jy hulle verslaan, dan moet jy hulle geheel en al met die banvloek tref; jy mag geen verbond met hulle maak en hulle nie genadig wees nie.

kjv_text: Neither shalt thou make marriages with them; thy daughter thou shalt not give unto his son, nor his daughter shalt thou take unto thy son.
bsb_text: Do not intermarry with them. Do not give your daughters to their sons or take their daughters for your sons,
aov_text: Jy mag jou ook nie met hulle verswaer nie—jy mag jou dogter nie gee aan sy seun, en sy dogter nie neem vir jou seun nie;

kjv_text: For they will turn away thy son from following me, that they may serve other gods: so will the anger of the LORD be kindled against you, and destroy thee suddenly.
bsb_text: because they will turn your sons away from following Me to serve other gods. Then the anger of the LORD will burn against you, and He will swiftly destroy you.
aov_text: want hy sal jou seun van My afvallig maak, sodat hulle ander gode dien en die toorn van die HERE teen julle ontvlam en Hy jou gou verdelg.

kjv_text: But thus shall ye deal with them; ye shall destroy their altars, and break down their images, and cut down their groves, and burn their graven images with fire.
bsb_text: Instead, this is what you are to do to them: tear down their altars, smash their sacred pillars, cut down their Asherah poles, and burn their idols in the fire.
aov_text: Maar julle moet met hulle so doen: hulle altare moet julle omgooi en hulle klippilare verbrysel en hulle heilige boomstamme omkap en hulle gesnede beelde met vuur verbrand.

kjv_text: For thou art an holy people unto the LORD thy God: the LORD thy God hath chosen thee to be a special people unto himself, above all people that are upon the face of the earth.
bsb_text: For you are a people holy to the LORD your God. The LORD your God has chosen you to be a people for His prized possession out of all peoples on the face of the earth.
aov_text: Want jy is ’n volk heilig aan die HERE jou God; jou het die HERE jou God uitverkies om uit al die volke wat op die aarde is, sy eiendomsvolk te wees.

kjv_text: The LORD did not set his love upon you, nor choose you, because ye were more in number than any people; for ye were the fewest of all people:
bsb_text: The LORD did not set His affection on you and choose you because you were more numerous than the other peoples, for you were the fewest of all peoples.
aov_text: Die HERE het ’n welgevalle aan julle gehad en julle uitverkies, nie omdat julle meer was as al die ander volke nie, want julle was die geringste van al die volke.

kjv_text: But because the LORD loved you, and because he would keep the oath which he had sworn unto your fathers, hath the LORD brought you out with a mighty hand, and redeemed you out of the house of bondmen, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
bsb_text: But because the LORD loved you and kept the oath He swore to your fathers, He brought you out with a mighty hand and redeemed you from the house of slavery, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
aov_text: Maar omdat die HERE julle liefgehad en die eed gehou het wat Hy vir julle vaders gesweer het, het die HERE julle met ’n sterke hand uitgelei en jou uit die slawehuis, uit die hand van Farao, die koning van Egipte, verlos.

kjv_text: Know therefore that the LORD thy God, he is God, the faithful God, which keepeth covenant and mercy with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations;
bsb_text: Know therefore that the LORD your God is God, the faithful God who keeps His covenant of loving devotion for a thousand generations of those who love Him and keep His commandments.
aov_text: Jy moet dan weet dat die HERE jou God God is, die getroue God wat die verbond en die goedertierenheid hou vir die wat Hom liefhet en sy gebooie onderhou, in duisend geslagte.

kjv_text: And repayeth them that hate him to their face, to destroy them: he will not be slack to him that hateth him, he will repay him to his face.
bsb_text: But those who hate Him He repays to their faces with destruction; He will not hesitate to repay to his face the one who hates Him.
aov_text: Maar aan die wat Hom haat, aan elkeen persoonlik, vergeld Hy dit, om hom te vernietig; Hy sal met sy hater nie versuim nie, hom persoonlik sal Hy dit vergelde.

kjv_text: Thou shalt therefore keep the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which I command thee this day, to do them.
bsb_text: So keep the commandments and statutes and ordinances that I am giving you to follow this day.
aov_text: Hou dan die gebod en die insettinge en die verordeninge wat ek jou vandag beveel om dit te volbring.

kjv_text: Wherefore it shall come to pass, if ye hearken to these judgments, and keep, and do them, that the LORD thy God shall keep unto thee the covenant and the mercy which he sware unto thy fathers:
bsb_text: If you listen to these ordinances and keep them carefully, then the LORD your God will keep His covenant and the loving devotion that He swore to your fathers.
aov_text: En omdat julle na hierdie verordeninge sal luister en dit hou en volbring, sal die HERE jou God vir jou die verbond en die goedertierenheid hou wat Hy jou vaders besweer het;

kjv_text: And he will love thee, and bless thee, and multiply thee: he will also bless the fruit of thy womb, and the fruit of thy land, thy corn, and thy wine, and thine oil, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep, in the land which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee.
bsb_text: He will love you and bless you and multiply you. He will bless the fruit of your womb and the produce of your land—your grain, new wine, and oil, the young of your herds and the lambs of your flocks—in the land that He swore to your fathers to give you.
aov_text: en Hy sal jou liefhê en jou seën en jou vermenigvuldig, en Hy sal die vrug van jou liggaam seën en die vrugte van jou land, jou koring en jou mos en jou olie, die aanteel van jou beeste en die aanteel van jou kleinvee, in die land wat Hy aan jou vaders met ’n eed beloof het om aan jou te gee.

kjv_text: Thou shalt be blessed above all people: there shall not be male or female barren among you, or among your cattle.
bsb_text: You will be blessed above all peoples; among you there will be no barren man or woman or livestock.
aov_text: Geseënd sal jy wees bo al die volke; daar sal by jou geen man of vrou onvrugbaar wees nie, ook nie onder jou vee nie.

kjv_text: And the LORD will take away from thee all sickness, and will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which thou knowest, upon thee; but will lay them upon all them that hate thee.
bsb_text: And the LORD will remove from you all sickness. He will not lay upon you any of the terrible diseases you knew in Egypt, but He will inflict them on all who hate you.
aov_text: En die HERE sal elke krankheid van jou wegneem en al die kwaai siektes van Egipte wat jy ken, nie op jou lê nie; maar Hy sal dit lê op almal wat jou haat.

kjv_text: And thou shalt consume all the people which the LORD thy God shall deliver thee; thine eye shall have no pity upon them: neither shalt thou serve their gods; for that will be a snare unto thee.
bsb_text: You must destroy all the peoples the LORD your God will deliver to you. Do not look on them with pity. Do not worship their gods, for that will be a snare to you.
aov_text: En jy sal al die volke verteer wat die HERE jou God aan jou oorgee; jou oog mag hulle nie verskoon nie, en jy mag hulle gode nie dien nie; want dit sal vir jou ’n strik wees.

kjv_text: If thou shalt say in thine heart, These nations are more than I; how can I dispossess them?
bsb_text: You may say in your heart, “These nations are greater than we are; how can we drive them out?”
aov_text: As jy in jou hart dink: Hierdie nasies is meer as ek, hoe sou ek hulle kan verdrywe? —

kjv_text: Thou shalt not be afraid of them: but shalt well remember what the LORD thy God did unto Pharaoh, and unto all Egypt;
bsb_text: But do not be afraid of them. Be sure to remember what the LORD your God did to Pharaoh and all Egypt:
aov_text: wees dan nie bevrees vir hulle nie; dink gedurig aan wat die HERE jou God aan Farao en die hele Egipte gedoen het,

kjv_text: The great temptations which thine eyes saw, and the signs, and the wonders, and the mighty hand, and the stretched out arm, whereby the LORD thy God brought thee out: so shall the LORD thy God do unto all the people of whom thou art afraid.
bsb_text: the great trials that you saw, the signs and wonders, and the mighty hand and outstretched arm by which the LORD your God brought you out. The LORD your God will do the same to all the peoples you now fear.
aov_text: die groot versoekinge wat jou oë gesien het, en die tekens en die wonders en die sterke hand en die uitgestrekte arm waardeur die HERE jou God jou uitgelei het; so sal die HERE jou God aan al die volke doen vir wie jy bevrees is.

kjv_text: Moreover the LORD thy God will send the hornet among them, until they that are left, and hide themselves from thee, be destroyed.
bsb_text: Moreover, the LORD your God will send the hornet against them until even the survivors hiding from you have perished.
aov_text: En die HERE jou God sal ook die perdebye onder hulle stuur totdat hulle omkom wat oorgebly het en wat vir jou weggekruip het.

kjv_text: Thou shalt not be affrighted at them: for the LORD thy God is among you, a mighty God and terrible.
bsb_text: Do not be terrified by them, for the LORD your God, who is among you, is a great and awesome God.
aov_text: Skrik nie vir hulle nie, want die HERE jou God is by jou, ’n groot en gedugte God.

kjv_text: And the LORD thy God will put out those nations before thee by little and little: thou mayest not consume them at once, lest the beasts of the field increase upon thee.
bsb_text: The LORD your God will drive out these nations before you little by little. You will not be enabled to eliminate them all at once, or the wild animals would multiply around you.
aov_text: En die HERE jou God sal hierdie nasies so langsamerhand voor jou uit verjaag; jy mag hulle nie gou vernietig nie, dat die ongediertes nie teen jou die oorhand kry nie.

kjv_text: But the LORD thy God shall deliver them unto thee, and shall destroy them with a mighty destruction, until they be destroyed.
bsb_text: But the LORD your God will give them over to you and throw them into great confusion, until they are destroyed.
aov_text: Maar die HERE jou God sal hulle aan jou oorgee en hulle in groot verwarring bring totdat hulle verdelg word.

kjv_text: And he shall deliver their kings into thine hand, and thou shalt destroy their name from under heaven: there shall no man be able to stand before thee, until thou have destroyed them.
bsb_text: He will hand their kings over to you, and you will wipe out their names from under heaven. No one will be able to stand against you; you will annihilate them.
aov_text: Ook sal Hy hulle konings in jou hand gee, dat jy hulle naam onder die hemel kan laat verdwyn; niemand sal teen jou standhou totdat jy hulle verdelg het nie.

kjv_text: The graven images of their gods shall ye burn with fire: thou shalt not desire the silver or gold that is on them, nor take it unto thee, lest thou be snared therein: for it is an abomination to the LORD thy God.
bsb_text: You must burn up the images of their gods; do not covet the silver and gold that is on them or take it for yourselves, or you will be ensnared by it; for it is detestable to the LORD your God.
aov_text: Die gesnede beelde van hulle gode moet julle met vuur verbrand; die silwer en die goud wat daaraan is, mag jy nie begeer of vir jou neem nie, dat jy nie daardeur verstrik raak nie; want dit is vir die HERE jou God ’n gruwel.

kjv_text: Neither shalt thou bring an abomination into thine house, lest thou be a cursed thing like it: but thou shalt utterly detest it, and thou shalt utterly abhor it; for it is a cursed thing.
bsb_text: And you must not bring any detestable thing into your house, or you, like it, will be set apart for destruction. You are to utterly detest and abhor it, because it is set apart for destruction.
aov_text: En jy mag geen gruwel in jou huis inbring nie, sodat jy nie net so onder die banvloek kom nie; jy moet daar heeltemal ’n afsku van hê en dit geheel en al as gruwel beskou; want dit is onder die banvloek.

kjv_text: All the commandments which I command thee this day shall ye observe to do, that ye may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers.
bsb_text: You must carefully follow every commandment I am giving you today, so that you may live and multiply, and enter and possess the land that the LORD swore to give your fathers.
aov_text: AL die gebooie wat ek jou vandag beveel, moet julle sorgvuldig hou, dat julle mag lewe en vermenigvuldig, en dat julle mag inkom en die land in besit neem wat die HERE aan julle vaders met ’n eed beloof het.

kjv_text: And thou shalt remember all the way which the LORD thy God led thee these forty years in the wilderness, to humble thee, and to prove thee, to know what was in thine heart, whether thou wouldest keep his commandments, or no.
bsb_text: Remember that these forty years the LORD your God led you all the way in the wilderness, so that He might humble you and test you in order to know what was in your heart, whether or not you would keep His commandments.
aov_text: En jy moet dink aan die hele pad waarlangs die HERE jou God jou nou veertig jaar lank in die woestyn gelei het tot jou verootmoediging en beproewing, om te weet wat in jou hart is, of jy sy gebooie sal hou of nie.

kjv_text: And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the LORD doth man live.
bsb_text: He humbled you, and in your hunger He gave you manna to eat, which neither you nor your fathers had known, so that you might understand that man does not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of the LORD.
aov_text: En Hy het jou verootmoedig en jou laat honger ly en jou die manna laat eet wat jy en jou vaders nie geken het nie, om aan jou bekend te maak dat die mens nie van brood alleen lewe nie, maar dat die mens lewe van alles wat uit die mond van die HERE uitgaan.

kjv_text: Thy raiment waxed not old upon thee, neither did thy foot swell, these forty years.
bsb_text: Your clothing did not wear out and your feet did not swell during these forty years.
aov_text: Jou klere het aan jou nie verslyt en jou voet het nou veertig jaar lank nie geswel nie.

kjv_text: Thou shalt also consider in thine heart, that, as a man chasteneth his son, so the LORD thy God chasteneth thee.
bsb_text: So know in your heart that just as a man disciplines his son, so the LORD your God disciplines you.
aov_text: Erken dan in jou hart dat die HERE jou God jou onderrig soos ’n man sy seun onderrig,

kjv_text: Therefore thou shalt keep the commandments of the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.
bsb_text: Therefore you shall keep the commandments of the LORD your God, walking in His ways and fearing Him.
aov_text: en hou die gebooie van die HERE jou God om in sy weë te wandel en Hom te vrees.

kjv_text: For the LORD thy God bringeth thee into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of fountains and depths that spring out of valleys and hills;
bsb_text: For the LORD your God is bringing you into a good land, a land of brooks and fountains and springs that flow through the valleys and hills;
aov_text: Want die HERE jou God bring jou in ’n goeie land, ’n land van waterstrome, fonteine en onderaardse riviere wat in die laagtes en op die berge uitkom;

kjv_text: A land of wheat, and barley, and vines, and fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of oil olive, and honey;
bsb_text: a land of wheat, barley, vines, fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of olive oil and honey;
aov_text: ’n land van koring en gars en wingerdstokke en vyebome en granate; ’n land van olieryke olyfbome en heuning;

kjv_text: A land wherein thou shalt eat bread without scarceness, thou shalt not lack any thing in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills thou mayest dig brass.
bsb_text: a land where you will eat food without scarcity, where you will lack nothing; a land whose rocks are iron and whose hills are ready to be mined for copper.
aov_text: ’n land waarin jy brood sonder skaarste sal eet, waarin niks jou sal ontbreek nie; ’n land waarvan die klippe yster is, en uit die berge waarvan jy koper sal uitkap;

kjv_text: When thou hast eaten and art full, then thou shalt bless the LORD thy God for the good land which he hath given thee.
bsb_text: When you eat and are satisfied, you are to bless the LORD your God for the good land that He has given you.
aov_text: en jy sal eet en versadig word en die HERE jou God loof oor die goeie land wat Hy jou gegee het.

kjv_text: Beware that thou forget not the LORD thy God, in not keeping his commandments, and his judgments, and his statutes, which I command thee this day:
bsb_text: Be careful not to forget the LORD your God by failing to keep His commandments and ordinances and statutes, which I am giving you this day.
aov_text: Neem jou in ag dat jy die HERE jou God nie vergeet deur sy gebooie en sy verordeninge en sy insettinge wat ek jou vandag beveel, nie te hou nie;

kjv_text: Lest when thou hast eaten and art full, and hast built goodly houses, and dwelt therein;
bsb_text: Otherwise, when you eat and are satisfied, when you build fine houses in which to dwell,
aov_text: sodat jy nie miskien eet en versadig word nie en mooi huise bou en bewoon,

kjv_text: And when thy herds and thy flocks multiply, and thy silver and thy gold is multiplied, and all that thou hast is multiplied;
bsb_text: and when your herds and flocks grow large and your silver and gold increase and all that you have is multiplied,
aov_text: en jou beeste en jou kleinvee vermeerder en jou silwer en goud vermeerder, ja, alles wat jy het, vermeerder —

kjv_text: Then thine heart be lifted up, and thou forget the LORD thy God, which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage;
bsb_text: then your heart will become proud, and you will forget the LORD your God who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
aov_text: en jou hart hom dan verhef, dat jy die HERE jou God vergeet wat jou uit Egipteland, uit die slawehuis, uitgelei het;

kjv_text: Who led thee through that great and terrible wilderness, wherein were fiery serpents, and scorpions, and drought, where there was no water; who brought thee forth water out of the rock of flint;
bsb_text: He led you through the vast and terrifying wilderness with its venomous snakes and scorpions, a thirsty and waterless land. He brought you water from the rock of flint.
aov_text: wat jou deur die groot en vreeslike woestyn gelei het, deur giftige slange en skerpioene en ’n dorsland sonder water; wat vir jou water uit die klipharde rots laat kom het;

kjv_text: Who fed thee in the wilderness with manna, which thy fathers knew not, that he might humble thee, and that he might prove thee, to do thee good at thy latter end;
bsb_text: He fed you in the wilderness with manna that your fathers had not known, in order to humble you and test you, so that in the end He might cause you to prosper.
aov_text: wat jou in die woestyn manna laat eet het, wat jou vaders nie geken het nie, om jou te verootmoedig en jou te beproef, om uiteindelik aan jou goed te doen —

kjv_text: And thou say in thine heart, My power and the might of mine hand hath gotten me this wealth.
bsb_text: You might say in your heart, “The power and strength of my hands have made this wealth for me.”
aov_text: en jy in jou hart dink: My krag en die sterkte van my hand het vir my hierdie rykdom verwerwe.

kjv_text: But thou shalt remember the LORD thy God: for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto thy fathers, as it is this day.
bsb_text: But remember that it is the LORD your God who gives you the power to gain wealth, in order to confirm His covenant that He swore to your fathers even to this day.
aov_text: Maar dink aan die HERE jou God, dat dit Hy is wat jou krag gee om rykdom te verwerwe, dat Hy sy verbond kan bevestig wat Hy aan jou vaders met ’n eed beloof het, soos dit vandag is.

kjv_text: And it shall be, if thou do at all forget the LORD thy God, and walk after other gods, and serve them, and worship them, I testify against you this day that ye shall surely perish.
bsb_text: If you ever forget the LORD your God and go after other gods to worship and bow down to them, I testify against you today that you will surely perish.
aov_text: Maar as jy nogtans die HERE jou God vergeet en agter ander gode aan loop en hulle dien en voor hulle neerbuig, dan verseker ek julle vandag dat julle sekerlik sal omkom;

kjv_text: As the nations which the LORD destroyeth before your face, so shall ye perish; because ye would not be obedient unto the voice of the LORD your God.
bsb_text: Like the nations that the LORD has destroyed before you, so you will perish if you do not obey the LORD your God.
aov_text: soos die nasies wat die HERE voor julle vernietig, so sal julle omkom, omdat julle na die stem van die HERE julle God nie geluister het nie.

kjv_text: Hear, O Israel: Thou art to pass over Jordan this day, to go in to possess nations greater and mightier than thyself, cities great and fenced up to heaven,
bsb_text: Hear, O Israel: Today you are about to cross the Jordan to go in and dispossess nations greater and stronger than you, with large cities fortified to the heavens.
aov_text: HOOR, Israel, jy trek vandag deur die Jordaan om nasies in besit te gaan neem wat groter en sterker is as jy, stede wat groot en tot aan die hemel versterk is,

kjv_text: A people great and tall, the children of the Anakims, whom thou knowest, and of whom thou hast heard say, Who can stand before the children of Anak!
bsb_text: The people are strong and tall, the descendants of the Anakim. You know about them, and you have heard it said, “Who can stand up to the sons of Anak?”
aov_text: ’n groot volk van hoë gestalte, die kinders van die Enakiete, wat jy self ken en van wie jy hoor sê het: Wie kan standhou voor die kinders van Enak?

kjv_text: Understand therefore this day, that the LORD thy God is he which goeth over before thee; as a consuming fire he shall destroy them, and he shall bring them down before thy face: so shalt thou drive them out, and destroy them quickly, as the LORD hath said unto thee.
bsb_text: But understand that today the LORD your God goes across ahead of you as a consuming fire; He will destroy them and subdue them before you. And you will drive them out and annihilate them swiftly, as the LORD has promised you.
aov_text: Weet dan vandag dat die HERE jou God die Een is wat voor jou oortrek soos ’n verterende vuur. Hý sal hulle vernietig en hulle voor jou onderwerp, sodat jy hulle gou kan verdrywe en tot niet maak soos die HERE jou beloof het.

kjv_text: Speak not thou in thine heart, after that the LORD thy God hath cast them out from before thee, saying, For my righteousness the LORD hath brought me in to possess this land: but for the wickedness of these nations the LORD doth drive them out from before thee.
bsb_text: When the LORD your God has driven them out before you, do not say in your heart, “Because of my righteousness the LORD has brought me in to possess this land.” Rather, the LORD is driving out these nations before you because of their wickedness.
aov_text: As die HERE jou God hulle voor jou uit verjaag, moet dan nie in jou hart spreek en sê: Die HERE het my ter wille van my geregtigheid ingebring om hierdie land in besit te neem nie; want weens die goddeloosheid van hierdie nasies verdryf die HERE hulle voor jou uit.

kjv_text: Not for thy righteousness, or for the uprightness of thine heart, dost thou go to possess their land: but for the wickedness of these nations the LORD thy God doth drive them out from before thee, and that he may perform the word which the LORD sware unto thy fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
bsb_text: It is not because of your righteousness or uprightness of heart that you are going in to possess their land, but it is because of their wickedness that the LORD your God is driving out these nations before you, to keep the promise He swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
aov_text: Nie ter wille van jou geregtigheid en die opregtheid van jou hart kom jy in om hulle land in besit te neem nie, maar weens die goddeloosheid van hierdie nasies verdryf die HERE jou God hulle voor jou uit, en om die woord te vervul wat die HERE vir jou vaders, Abraham, Isak en Jakob, gesweer het.

kjv_text: Understand therefore, that the LORD thy God giveth thee not this good land to possess it for thy righteousness; for thou art a stiffnecked people.
bsb_text: Understand, then, that it is not because of your righteousness that the LORD your God is giving you this good land to possess, for you are a stiff-necked people.
aov_text: Weet dan dat die HERE jou God nie ter wille van jou geregtigheid jou hierdie goeie land gee om dit in besit te neem nie, want jy is ’n hardnekkige volk.

kjv_text: Remember, and forget not, how thou provokedst the LORD thy God to wrath in the wilderness: from the day that thou didst depart out of the land of Egypt, until ye came unto this place, ye have been rebellious against the LORD.
bsb_text: Remember this, and never forget how you provoked the LORD your God in the wilderness. From the day you left the land of Egypt until you reached this place, you have been rebelling against the LORD.
aov_text: Dink daaraan, vergeet nie hoe jy die HERE jou God in die woestyn vertoorn het nie; van die dag af dat jy uit Egipteland uitgetrek het, totdat julle by hierdie plek gekom het, was julle wederstrewig teen die HERE.

kjv_text: Also in Horeb ye provoked the LORD to wrath, so that the LORD was angry with you to have destroyed you.
bsb_text: At Horeb you provoked the LORD, and He was angry enough to destroy you.
aov_text: Ja, by Horeb het julle die HERE vertoorn, sodat die HERE toornig was op julle om julle te verdelg.

kjv_text: When I was gone up into the mount to receive the tables of stone, even the tables of the covenant which the LORD made with you, then I abode in the mount forty days and forty nights, I neither did eat bread nor drink water:
bsb_text: When I went up on the mountain to receive the tablets of stone, the tablets of the covenant that the LORD made with you, I stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights. I ate no bread and drank no water.
aov_text: Toe ek op die berg geklim het om die kliptafels te ontvang, die tafels van die verbond wat die HERE met julle gesluit het, het ek veertig dae en veertig nagte lank op die berg gebly—brood het ek nie geëet en water nie gedrink nie —

kjv_text: And the LORD delivered unto me two tables of stone written with the finger of God; and on them was written according to all the words, which the LORD spake with you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly.
bsb_text: Then the LORD gave me the two stone tablets, inscribed by the finger of God with the exact words that the LORD spoke to you out of the fire on the mountain on the day of the assembly.
aov_text: en die HERE het my die twee kliptafels gegee wat beskrywe was met die vinger van God, en daarop al die woorde soos die HERE op die berg, uit die vuur, met julle gespreek het, op die dag van die vergadering.

kjv_text: And it came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights, that the LORD gave me the two tables of stone, even the tables of the covenant.
bsb_text: And at the end of forty days and forty nights, the LORD gave me the two stone tablets, the tablets of the covenant.
aov_text: En aan die einde van veertig dae en veertig nagte het die HERE my die twee kliptafels gegee, die tafels van die verbond,

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto me, Arise, get thee down quickly from hence; for thy people which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt have corrupted themselves; they are quickly turned aside out of the way which I commanded them; they have made them a molten image.
bsb_text: And the LORD said to me, “Get up and go down from here at once, for your people, whom you brought out of Egypt, have corrupted themselves. How quickly they have turned aside from the way that I commanded them! They have made for themselves a molten image.”
aov_text: en die HERE het vir my gesê: Staan op, klim hiervandaan gou af, want jou volk wat jy uit Egipte uitgelei het, het verderflik gehandel; hulle het gou afgewyk van die weg wat Ek hulle beveel het; hulle het vir hulle ’n gegote beeld gemaak.

kjv_text: Furthermore the LORD spake unto me, saying, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people:
bsb_text: The LORD also said to me, “I have seen this people, and they are indeed a stiff-necked people.
aov_text: Verder het die HERE met my gespreek en gesê: Ek het hierdie volk aangesien, en kyk, dit is ’n hardnekkige volk.

kjv_text: Let me alone, that I may destroy them, and blot out their name from under heaven: and I will make of thee a nation mightier and greater than they.
bsb_text: Leave Me alone, so that I may destroy them and blot out their name from under heaven. Then I will make you into a nation mightier and greater than they are.”
aov_text: Laat My staan dat Ek hulle verdelg en hulle naam onder die hemel uitdelg; en Ek sal jou ’n nasie maak wat magtiger is en meer as hulle.

kjv_text: So I turned and came down from the mount, and the mount burned with fire: and the two tables of the covenant were in my two hands.
bsb_text: So I went back down the mountain while it was blazing with fire, with the two tablets of the covenant in my hands.
aov_text: Daarop het ek omgedraai en van die berg afgeklim terwyl die berg met vuur brand, en die twee tafels van die verbond was in my twee hande.

kjv_text: And I looked, and, behold, ye had sinned against the LORD your God, and had made you a molten calf: ye had turned aside quickly out of the way which the LORD had commanded you.
bsb_text: And I saw how you had sinned against the LORD your God; you had made for yourselves a molten calf. You had turned aside quickly from the way that the LORD had commanded you.
aov_text: Toe sien ek dat julle waarlik teen die HERE julle God gesondig het; julle het vir julle ’n gegote kalf gemaak; julle het gou afgewyk van die weg wat die HERE julle beveel het.

kjv_text: And I took the two tables, and cast them out of my two hands, and brake them before your eyes.
bsb_text: So I took the two tablets and threw them out of my hands, shattering them before your eyes.
aov_text: En ek het die twee tafels gegryp en dit uit my twee hande gegooi en dit voor julle oë verbrysel.

kjv_text: And I fell down before the LORD, as at the first, forty days and forty nights: I did neither eat bread, nor drink water, because of all your sins which ye sinned, in doing wickedly in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger.
bsb_text: Then I fell down before the LORD for forty days and forty nights, as I had done the first time. I did not eat bread or drink water because of all the sin you had committed in doing what was evil in the sight of the LORD and provoking Him to anger.
aov_text: Daarop het ek voor die aangesig van die HERE neergeval, soos die eerste keer, veertig dae en veertig nagte lank—brood het ek nie geëet en water nie gedrink nie—vanweë al julle sonde wat julle begaan het deur te doen wat verkeerd is in die oë van die HERE om Hom te terg.

kjv_text: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure, wherewith the LORD was wroth against you to destroy you. But the LORD hearkened unto me at that time also.
bsb_text: For I was afraid of the anger and wrath that the LORD had directed against you, enough to destroy you. But the LORD listened to me this time as well.
aov_text: Want ek was bang vir die toorn en die grimmigheid waarmee die HERE op julle so toornig was, dat Hy julle wou verdelg; maar die HERE het my dié keer ook verhoor.

kjv_text: And the LORD was very angry with Aaron to have destroyed him: and I prayed for Aaron also the same time.
bsb_text: The LORD was angry enough with Aaron to destroy him, but at that time I also prayed for Aaron.
aov_text: Ook was die HERE baie toornig op Aäron, sodat Hy hom wou verdelg; maar ek het ook vir Aäron in dié tyd gebid.

kjv_text: And I took your sin, the calf which ye had made, and burnt it with fire, and stamped it, and ground it very small, even until it was as small as dust: and I cast the dust thereof into the brook that descended out of the mount.
bsb_text: And I took that sinful thing, the calf you had made, and burned it in the fire. Then I crushed it and ground it to powder as fine as dust, and I cast it into the stream that came down from the mountain.
aov_text: En ek het julle sonde, die kalf wat julle gemaak het, geneem en dit met vuur verbrand en dit stukkend gestamp en terdeë gemaal totdat dit so fyn soos stof was; en dié stof het ek in die stroom gegooi wat van die berg afkom.

kjv_text: And at Taberah, and at Massah, and at Kibrothhattaavah, ye provoked the LORD to wrath.
bsb_text: You continued to provoke the LORD at Taberah, at Massah, and at Kibroth-hattaavah.
aov_text: Ook by Tabéra en by Massa en by Kibrot-Hattáäwa het julle elke keer die HERE vertoorn.

kjv_text: Likewise when the LORD sent you from Kadeshbarnea, saying, Go up and possess the land which I have given you; then ye rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God, and ye believed him not, nor hearkened to his voice.
bsb_text: And when the LORD sent you out from Kadesh-barnea, He said, “Go up and possess the land that I have given you.” But you rebelled against the command of the LORD your God. You neither believed Him nor obeyed Him.
aov_text: En toe die HERE julle uit Kades-Barnéa gestuur het met die woorde: Trek op en neem die land in besit wat Ek julle gegee het—was julle wederstrewig teen die bevel van die HERE julle God en het julle Hom nie geglo en na sy stem nie geluister nie.

kjv_text: Ye have been rebellious against the LORD from the day that I knew you.
bsb_text: You have been rebelling against the LORD since the day I came to know you.
aov_text: Wederstrewig was julle teen die HERE van die dag af dat ek julle ken.

kjv_text: Thus I fell down before the LORD forty days and forty nights, as I fell down at the first; because the LORD had said he would destroy you.
bsb_text: So I fell down before the LORD for forty days and forty nights, because the LORD had said He would destroy you.
aov_text: En ek het neergeval voor die aangesig van die HERE, die veertig dae en veertig nagte wat ek neergeval het, omdat die HERE gesê het dat Hy julle wou verdelg.

kjv_text: I prayed therefore unto the LORD, and said, O Lord GOD, destroy not thy people and thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed through thy greatness, which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand.
bsb_text: And I prayed to the LORD and said, “O Lord GOD, do not destroy Your people, Your inheritance, whom You redeemed through Your greatness and brought out of Egypt with a mighty hand.
aov_text: En ek het die HERE gebid en gesê: Here, HERE, stort u volk en u erfdeel wat U deur u grootheid verlos het, wat U uit Egipte deur ’n sterke hand uitgelei het, nie in die verderf nie.

kjv_text: Remember thy servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; look not unto the stubbornness of this people, nor to their wickedness, nor to their sin:
bsb_text: Remember Your servants Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Overlook the stubbornness of this people and the wickedness of their sin.
aov_text: Dink aan u knegte Abraham, Isak en Jakob; kyk nie na die hardheid van hierdie volk of na hulle goddeloosheid en hulle sonde nie,

kjv_text: Lest the land whence thou broughtest us out say, Because the LORD was not able to bring them into the land which he promised them, and because he hated them, he hath brought them out to slay them in the wilderness.
bsb_text: Otherwise, those in the land from which You brought us out will say, ‘Because the LORD was not able to bring them into the land He had promised them, and because He hated them, He has brought them out to kill them in the wilderness.’
aov_text: sodat die land waar U ons uitgelei het, nie kan sê nie: Omdat die HERE hulle nie kon bring in die land wat Hy hulle beloof het nie, en omdat Hy hulle haat, het Hy hulle uitgelei om hulle in die woestyn te laat sterwe!

kjv_text: Yet they are thy people and thine inheritance, which thou broughtest out by thy mighty power and by thy stretched out arm.
bsb_text: But they are Your people, Your inheritance, whom You brought out by Your great power and outstretched arm.”
aov_text: Hulle is tog u volk en u erfdeel wat U deur u grote krag en u uitgestrekte arm uitgelei het.

kjv_text: At that time the LORD said unto me, Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first, and come up unto me into the mount, and make thee an ark of wood.
bsb_text: At that time the LORD said to me, “Chisel out two stone tablets like the originals, come up to Me on the mountain, and make an ark of wood.
aov_text: IN dié tyd het die HERE vir my gesê: Kap vir jou twee kliptafels soos die eerstes en klim op die berg na My toe; maak vir jou ook ’n ark van hout.

kjv_text: And I will write on the tables the words that were in the first tables which thou brakest, and thou shalt put them in the ark.
bsb_text: And I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke; and you are to place them in the ark.”
aov_text: En Ek sal op die tafels skrywe die woorde wat op die eerste tafels was, wat jy verbrysel het; en jy moet dit in die ark sit.

kjv_text: And I made an ark of shittim wood, and hewed two tables of stone like unto the first, and went up into the mount, having the two tables in mine hand.
bsb_text: So I made an ark of acacia wood, chiseled out two stone tablets like the originals, and went up the mountain with the two tablets in my hands.
aov_text: Toe het ek ’n ark van akasiahout gemaak en twee kliptafels soos die eerstes gekap en op die berg geklim met die twee tafels in my hand.

kjv_text: And he wrote on the tables, according to the first writing, the ten commandments, which the LORD spake unto you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly: and the LORD gave them unto me.
bsb_text: And the LORD wrote on the tablets what had been written previously, the Ten Commandments that He had spoken to you on the mountain out of the fire on the day of the assembly. The LORD gave them to me,
aov_text: En Hy het op die tafels, volgens die eerste skrif, die tien woorde geskrywe wat die HERE op die dag van die vergadering by die berg uit die vuur met julle gespreek het; en die HERE het dit aan my gegee.

kjv_text: And I turned myself and came down from the mount, and put the tables in the ark which I had made; and there they be, as the LORD commanded me.
bsb_text: and I went back down the mountain and placed the tablets in the ark I had made, as the LORD had commanded me; and there they have remained.
aov_text: En ek het omgedraai en van die berg afgeklim en die tafels in die ark gesit wat ek gemaak het; en dit was daar, soos die HERE my beveel het.

kjv_text: And the children of Israel took their journey from Beeroth of the children of Jaakan to Mosera: there Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest's office in his stead.
bsb_text: The Israelites traveled from Beeroth Bene-jaakan to Moserah, where Aaron died and was buried, and Eleazar his son succeeded him as priest.
aov_text: En die kinders van Israel het van Béërot Bené-Jáäkan weggetrek na Moséra toe. Daar het Aäron gesterwe, en daar is hy begrawe; en sy seun Eleásar het die priesteramp in sy plek bedien.

kjv_text: From thence they journeyed unto Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to Jotbath, a land of rivers of waters.
bsb_text: From there they traveled to Gudgodah, and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land with streams of water.
aov_text: Daarvandaan het hulle weggetrek na Gudgod, en van Gudgod na Jotbat, ’n land van waterstrome.

kjv_text: At that time the LORD separated the tribe of Levi, to bear the ark of the covenant of the LORD, to stand before the LORD to minister unto him, and to bless in his name, unto this day.
bsb_text: At that time the LORD set apart the tribe of Levi to carry the ark of the covenant of the LORD, to stand before the LORD to serve Him, and to pronounce blessings in His name, as they do to this day.
aov_text: In dié tyd het die HERE die stam van Levi afgesonder om die verbondsark van die HERE te dra, om voor die aangesig van die HERE in sy diens te staan en in sy Naam te seën tot vandag toe.

kjv_text: Wherefore Levi hath no part nor inheritance with his brethren; the LORD is his inheritance, according as the LORD thy God promised him.
bsb_text: That is why Levi has no portion or inheritance among his brothers; the LORD is his inheritance, as the LORD your God promised him.
aov_text: Daarom het Levi geen deel of erfenis saam met sy broers nie; die HERE is sy erfdeel, soos die HERE jou God hom beloof het.

kjv_text: And I stayed in the mount, according to the first time, forty days and forty nights; and the LORD hearkened unto me at that time also, and the LORD would not destroy thee.
bsb_text: I stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights, like the first time, and that time the LORD again listened to me and agreed not to destroy you.
aov_text: EN ék het op die berg gestaan soos die vorige dae, veertig dae en veertig nagte lank; en die HERE het my ook dié keer verhoor; die HERE wou jou nie in die verderf stort nie.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto me, Arise, take thy journey before the people, that they may go in and possess the land, which I sware unto their fathers to give unto them.
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to me, “Get up. Continue your journey ahead of the people, that they may enter and possess the land that I swore to their fathers to give them.”
aov_text: Maar die HERE het vir my gesê: Staan op, gaan heen om voor die volk uit verder te trek, dat hulle kan inkom en die land in besit neem wat Ek aan hulle vaders met ’n eed beloof het om aan hulle te gee.

kjv_text: And now, Israel, what doth the LORD thy God require of thee, but to fear the LORD thy God, to walk in all his ways, and to love him, and to serve the LORD thy God with all thy heart and with all thy soul,
bsb_text: And now, O Israel, what does the LORD your God ask of you but to fear the LORD your God by walking in all His ways, to love Him, to serve the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul,
aov_text: En nou, Israel, wat eis die HERE jou God van jou as net om die HERE jou God te vrees, in al sy weë te wandel en Hom lief te hê en die HERE jou God te dien met jou hele hart en met jou hele siel,

kjv_text: To keep the commandments of the LORD, and his statutes, which I command thee this day for thy good?
bsb_text: and to keep the commandments and statutes of the LORD that I am giving you this day for your own good?
aov_text: om te hou die gebooie van die HERE en sy insettinge wat ek jou vandag beveel, dat dit met jou goed kan gaan?

kjv_text: Behold, the heaven and the heaven of heavens is the LORD's thy God, the earth also, with all that therein is.
bsb_text: Behold, to the LORD your God belong the heavens, even the highest heavens, and the earth and everything in it.
aov_text: Kyk, aan die HERE jou God behoort die hemel, ook die hoogste hemel, die aarde en alles wat daarin is.

kjv_text: Only the LORD had a delight in thy fathers to love them, and he chose their seed after them, even you above all people, as it is this day.
bsb_text: Yet the LORD has set His affection on your fathers and loved them. And He has chosen you, their descendants after them, above all the peoples, even to this day.
aov_text: Maar net aan jou vaders het die HERE ’n welgevalle gehad om hulle lief te hê, en Hy het julle, hulle nageslag ná hulle, uit al die volke uitverkies, soos dit vandag is.

kjv_text: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no more stiffnecked.
bsb_text: Circumcise your hearts, therefore, and stiffen your necks no more.
aov_text: Besny dan die voorhuid van julle hart en verhard julle nek nie verder nie.

kjv_text: For the LORD your God is God of gods, and Lord of lords, a great God, a mighty, and a terrible, which regardeth not persons, nor taketh reward:
bsb_text: For the LORD your God is God of gods and Lord of lords, the great, mighty, and awesome God, showing no partiality and accepting no bribe.
aov_text: Want die HERE julle God is die God van die gode en die HERE van die here; die grote, magtige en gedugte God wat die persoon nie aansien en geen geskenk aanneem nie;

kjv_text: He doth execute the judgment of the fatherless and widow, and loveth the stranger, in giving him food and raiment.
bsb_text: He executes justice for the fatherless and widow, and He loves the foreigner, giving him food and clothing.
