bsb_text: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt, and the LORD your God redeemed you from that place. Therefore I am commanding you to do this.
aov_text: Maar jy moet daaraan dink dat jy ’n slaaf was in Egipte en die HERE jou God jou daaruit verlos het; daarom beveel ek jou om hierdie saak te doen.

kjv_text: When thou cuttest down thine harvest in thy field, and hast forgot a sheaf in the field, thou shalt not go again to fetch it: it shall be for the stranger, for the fatherless, and for the widow: that the LORD thy God may bless thee in all the work of thine hands.
bsb_text: If you are harvesting in your field and forget a sheaf there, do not go back to get it. It is to be left for the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow, so that the LORD your God may bless you in all the work of your hands.
aov_text: As jy jou oes op jou land insamel en ’n gerf op die land vergeet, mag jy nie omdraai om dit te gaan haal nie; vir die vreemdeling, die wees en die weduwee moet dit wees, dat die HERE jou God jou kan seën in al die werk van jou hande.

kjv_text: When thou beatest thine olive tree, thou shalt not go over the boughs again: it shall be for the stranger, for the fatherless, and for the widow.
bsb_text: When you beat the olives from your trees, you must not go over the branches again. What remains will be for the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow.
aov_text: As jy jou olywe afslaan, moet jy nie agter jou in die takke rond soek nie; vir die vreemdeling, die wees en die weduwee moet dit wees.

kjv_text: When thou gatherest the grapes of thy vineyard, thou shalt not glean it afterward: it shall be for the stranger, for the fatherless, and for the widow.
bsb_text: When you gather the grapes of your vineyard, you must not go over the vines again. What remains will be for the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow.
aov_text: As jy jou wingerd oes, moet jy agter jou nie skoon afoes nie; vir die vreemdeling, die wees en die weduwee moet dit wees.

kjv_text: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in the land of Egypt: therefore I command thee to do this thing.
bsb_text: Remember that you were slaves in the land of Egypt. Therefore I am commanding you to do this.
aov_text: En jy moet daaraan dink dat jy ’n slaaf was in Egipteland; daarom beveel ek jou om hierdie saak te doen.

kjv_text: If there be a controversy between men, and they come unto judgment, that the judges may judge them; then they shall justify the righteous, and condemn the wicked.
bsb_text: If there is a dispute between men, they are to go to court to be judged, so that the innocent may be acquitted and the guilty condemned.
aov_text: AS daar tussen manne ’n twis is en hulle na die gereg kom en die regters hulle vonnis en die regverdige regverdig verklaar en die skuldige skuldig verklaar,

kjv_text: And it shall be, if the wicked man be worthy to be beaten, that the judge shall cause him to lie down, and to be beaten before his face, according to his fault, by a certain number.
bsb_text: If the guilty man deserves to be beaten, the judge shall have him lie down and be flogged in his presence with the number of lashes his crime warrants.
aov_text: as dan die skuldige slae verdien, moet die regter hom laat lê en hom in sy teenwoordigheid met ’n aantal slae laat slaan ooreenkomstig sy skuld;

kjv_text: Forty stripes he may give him, and not exceed: lest, if he should exceed, and beat him above these with many stripes, then thy brother should seem vile unto thee.
bsb_text: He may receive no more than forty lashes, lest your brother be beaten any more than that and be degraded in your sight.
aov_text: veertig slae mag hy hom laat gee, nie meer nie, dat hy hom nie verder met baie slae bo dié laat slaan en jou broer voor jou oë veragtelik gemaak word nie.

kjv_text: Thou shalt not muzzle the ox when he treadeth out the corn.
bsb_text: Do not muzzle an ox while it is treading out the grain.
aov_text: Jy mag ’n os nie muilband as hy graan dors nie.

kjv_text: If brethren dwell together, and one of them die, and have no child, the wife of the dead shall not marry without unto a stranger: her husband's brother shall go in unto her, and take her to him to wife, and perform the duty of an husband's brother unto her.
bsb_text: When brothers dwell together and one of them dies without a son, the widow must not marry outside the family. Her husband’s brother is to take her as his wife and fulfill the duty of a brother-in-law for her.
aov_text: AS broers bymekaar woon en een van hulle sterwe sonder dat hy ’n seun het, dan mag die vrou van die oorledene nie daarbuite ’n vreemde man s’n word nie; haar swaer moet by haar ingaan en haar as sy vrou neem en die swaershuwelik met haar sluit;

kjv_text: And it shall be, that the firstborn which she beareth shall succeed in the name of his brother which is dead, that his name be not put out of Israel.
bsb_text: The first son she bears will carry on the name of the dead brother, so that his name will not be blotted out from Israel.
aov_text: en die eersgeborene wat sy baar, moet staan op naam van sy oorlede broer, dat sy naam nie uit Israel uitgedelg word nie.

kjv_text: And if the man like not to take his brother's wife, then let his brother's wife go up to the gate unto the elders, and say, My husband's brother refuseth to raise up unto his brother a name in Israel, he will not perform the duty of my husband's brother.
bsb_text: But if the man does not want to marry his brother’s widow, she is to go to the elders at the city gate and say, “My husband’s brother refuses to preserve his brother’s name in Israel. He is not willing to perform the duty of a brother-in-law for me.”
aov_text: Maar as dit die man nie beval om sy skoonsuster te neem nie, moet sy skoonsuster na die poort opgaan na die oudstes toe, en sê: My swaer weier om sy broer se naam in Israel in stand te hou; hy wil met my die swaershuwelik nie sluit nie —

kjv_text: Then the elders of his city shall call him, and speak unto him: and if he stand to it, and say, I like not to take her;
bsb_text: Then the elders of his city shall summon him and speak with him. If he persists and says, “I do not want to marry her,”
aov_text: dan moet die oudstes van sy stad hom roep en met hom spreek; bly hy dan daarby staan en sê: Dit beval my nie om haar te neem nie —

kjv_text: Then shall his brother's wife come unto him in the presence of the elders, and loose his shoe from off his foot, and spit in his face, and shall answer and say, So shall it be done unto that man that will not build up his brother's house.
bsb_text: his brother’s widow shall go up to him in the presence of the elders, remove his sandal, spit in his face, and declare, “This is what is done to the man who will not maintain his brother’s line.”
aov_text: dan moet sy skoonsuster voor die oë van die oudstes na hom toe nader kom en sy skoen van sy voet aftrek en in sy gesig spuug, en sy moet verklaar en sê: So moet met die man gedoen word wat die huis van sy broer nie wil bou nie.

kjv_text: And his name shall be called in Israel, The house of him that hath his shoe loosed.
bsb_text: And his family name in Israel will be called “The House of the Unsandaled.”
aov_text: En sy naam moet in Israel genoem word: Die huis van die kaalvoet.

kjv_text: When men strive together one with another, and the wife of the one draweth near for to deliver her husband out of the hand of him that smiteth him, and putteth forth her hand, and taketh him by the secrets:
bsb_text: If two men are fighting, and the wife of one steps in to rescue her husband from the one striking him, and she reaches out her hand and grabs his genitals,
aov_text: As manne met mekaar veg, die een met die ander, en die een se vrou aankom om haar man te red uit die hand van die een wat hom slaan, en haar hand uitsteek en hom by die skaamdele gryp,

kjv_text: Then thou shalt cut off her hand, thine eye shall not pity her.
bsb_text: you are to cut off her hand. You must show her no pity.
aov_text: dan moet jy haar hand afkap; jou oog mag nie verskoon nie.

kjv_text: Thou shalt not have in thy bag divers weights, a great and a small.
bsb_text: You shall not have two differing weights in your bag, one heavy and one light.
aov_text: JY mag nie twee soorte weegstene, ’n grote en ’n kleintjie, in jou sak hê nie.

kjv_text: Thou shalt not have in thine house divers measures, a great and a small.
bsb_text: You shall not have two differing measures in your house, one large and one small.
aov_text: Jy mag in jou huis nie twee soorte efas, ’n grote en ’n kleintjie, hê nie.

kjv_text: But thou shalt have a perfect and just weight, a perfect and just measure shalt thou have: that thy days may be lengthened in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
bsb_text: You must maintain accurate and honest weights and measures, so that you may live long in the land that the LORD your God is giving you.
aov_text: Jy moet ’n volle en regte gewig hê; jy moet ’n volle en regte efa hê; sodat jou dae verleng mag word in die land wat die HERE jou God jou sal gee.

kjv_text: For all that do such things, and all that do unrighteously, are an abomination unto the LORD thy God.
bsb_text: For everyone who behaves dishonestly in regard to these things is detestable to the LORD your God.
aov_text: Want almal wat hierdie dinge doen, is ’n gruwel vir die HERE jou God—almal wat onreg doen.

kjv_text: Remember what Amalek did unto thee by the way, when ye were come forth out of Egypt;
bsb_text: Remember what the Amalekites did to you along your way from Egypt,
aov_text: DINK aan wat Ámalek op die pad by julle uittog uit Egipte aan jou gedoen het,

kjv_text: How he met thee by the way, and smote the hindmost of thee, even all that were feeble behind thee, when thou wast faint and weary; and he feared not God.
bsb_text: how they met you on your journey when you were tired and weary, and they attacked all your stragglers; they had no fear of God.
aov_text: hoe hy jou op die pad teëgekom het en by jou die agterhoede, al die swakkes agter jou, verslaan het terwyl jy moeg en mat was, en hy God nie gevrees het nie.

kjv_text: Therefore it shall be, when the LORD thy God hath given thee rest from all thine enemies round about, in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee for an inheritance to possess it, that thou shalt blot out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven; thou shalt not forget it.
bsb_text: When the LORD your God gives you rest from the enemies around you in the land that He is giving you to possess as an inheritance, you are to blot out the memory of Amalek from under heaven. Do not forget!
aov_text: As dan die HERE jou God vir jou rus gee van al jou vyande rondom, in die land wat die HERE jou God jou as erfenis sal gee om dit in besit te neem, dan moet jy die gedagtenis van Ámalek onder die hemel uitdelg; vergeet dit nie.

kjv_text: And it shall be, when thou art come in unto the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee for an inheritance, and possessest it, and dwellest therein;
bsb_text: When you enter the land that the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance, and you take possession of it and settle in it,
aov_text: EN as jy in die land kom wat die HERE jou God jou as erfenis sal gee en jy dit in besit neem en daarin woon,

kjv_text: That thou shalt take of the first of all the fruit of the earth, which thou shalt bring of thy land that the LORD thy God giveth thee, and shalt put it in a basket, and shalt go unto the place which the LORD thy God shall choose to place his name there.
bsb_text: you are to take some of the firstfruits of all your produce from the soil of the land that the LORD your God is giving you and put them in a basket. Then go to the place the LORD your God will choose as a dwelling for His Name,
aov_text: dan moet jy neem uit die eerstelinge van al die vrugte van die land wat jy inbring uit jou land wat die HERE jou God jou sal gee, en dit in ’n mandjie sit; en jy moet gaan na die plek wat die HERE jou God sal uitkies om sy Naam daar te laat woon,

kjv_text: And thou shalt go unto the priest that shall be in those days, and say unto him, I profess this day unto the LORD thy God, that I am come unto the country which the LORD sware unto our fathers for to give us.
bsb_text: to the priest who is serving at that time, and say to him, “I declare today to the LORD your God that I have entered the land that the LORD swore to our fathers to give us.”
aov_text: en na die priester kom wat daar in dié dae sal wees, en jy moet vir hom sê: Ek verklaar vandag aan die HERE u God dat ek in die land gekom het wat die HERE aan ons vaders met ’n eed beloof het om aan ons te gee.

kjv_text: And the priest shall take the basket out of thine hand, and set it down before the altar of the LORD thy God.
bsb_text: Then the priest shall take the basket from your hands and place it before the altar of the LORD your God,
aov_text: En die priester moet die mandjie uit jou hand neem en dit voor die altaar van die HERE jou God neersit.

kjv_text: And thou shalt speak and say before the LORD thy God, A Syrian ready to perish was my father, and he went down into Egypt, and sojourned there with a few, and became there a nation, great, mighty, and populous:
bsb_text: and you are to declare before the LORD your God, “My father was a wandering Aramean, and he went down to Egypt few in number and lived there and became a great nation, mighty and numerous.
aov_text: Dan moet jy voor die aangesig van die HERE jou God verklaar en sê: My vader was ’n swerwende Arameër en het na Egipte afgetrek en daar as vreemdeling vertoef met min mense; maar hy het daar ’n groot, magtige en talryke nasie geword.

kjv_text: And the Egyptians evil entreated us, and afflicted us, and laid upon us hard bondage:
bsb_text: But the Egyptians mistreated us and afflicted us, putting us to hard labor.
aov_text: Maar die Egiptenaars het ons mishandel en ons verdruk en ’n harde diens op ons gelê.

kjv_text: And when we cried unto the LORD God of our fathers, the LORD heard our voice, and looked on our affliction, and our labour, and our oppression:
bsb_text: So we called out to the LORD, the God of our fathers; and the LORD heard our voice and saw our affliction, toil, and oppression.
aov_text: Toe het ons die HERE, die God van ons vaders, aangeroep; en die HERE het ons stem gehoor en ons ellende en ons moeite en ons verdrukking aangesien;

kjv_text: And the LORD brought us forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand, and with an outstretched arm, and with great terribleness, and with signs, and with wonders:
bsb_text: Then the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm, with great terror, signs, and wonders.
aov_text: en die HERE het ons uit Egipte uitgelei deur ’n sterke hand en ’n uitgestrekte arm en deur groot skrikwekkende dade en deur tekens en wonders;

kjv_text: And he hath brought us into this place, and hath given us this land, even a land that floweth with milk and honey.
bsb_text: And He brought us to this place and gave us this land, a land flowing with milk and honey.
aov_text: en Hy het ons na hierdie plek gebring en ons hierdie land gegee, ’n land wat oorloop van melk en heuning.

kjv_text: And now, behold, I have brought the firstfruits of the land, which thou, O LORD, hast given me. And thou shalt set it before the LORD thy God, and worship before the LORD thy God:
bsb_text: And now, behold, I have brought the firstfruits of the land that You, O LORD, have given me.” Then you are to place the basket before the LORD your God and bow down before Him.
aov_text: Hier het ek dan nou die eerstelinge gebring van die vrugte van die land wat U, HERE, my gegee het. Dan moet jy dit neersit voor die aangesig van die HERE jou God en jou neerbuig voor die aangesig van die HERE jou God.

kjv_text: And thou shalt rejoice in every good thing which the LORD thy God hath given unto thee, and unto thine house, thou, and the Levite, and the stranger that is among you.
bsb_text: So you shall rejoice—you, the Levite, and the foreigner dwelling among you—in all the good things the LORD your God has given to you and your household.
aov_text: En jy moet vrolik wees oor al die goeie dinge wat die HERE jou God jou en jou huis gegee het; jy en die Leviet en die vreemdeling wat by jou is.

kjv_text: When thou hast made an end of tithing all the tithes of thine increase the third year, which is the year of tithing, and hast given it unto the Levite, the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow, that they may eat within thy gates, and be filled;
bsb_text: When you have finished laying aside a tenth of all your produce in the third year, the year of the tithe, you are to give it to the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow, that they may eat and be filled within your gates.
aov_text: As jy al die tiendes van jou opbrings klaar afgesonder het in die derde jaar, die jaar van die tiendes, dan moet jy aan die Leviet, die vreemdeling, die wees en die weduwee gee, dat hulle in jou poorte kan eet en versadig word.

kjv_text: Then thou shalt say before the LORD thy God, I have brought away the hallowed things out of mine house, and also have given them unto the Levite, and unto the stranger, to the fatherless, and to the widow, according to all thy commandments which thou hast commanded me: I have not transgressed thy commandments, neither have I forgotten them:
bsb_text: Then you shall declare in the presence of the LORD your God, “I have removed from my house the sacred portion and have given it to the Levite, the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow, according to all the commandments You have given me. I have not transgressed or forgotten Your commandments.
aov_text: En jy moet voor die aangesig van die HERE jou God sê: Ek het die heilige goed uit die huis weggebring en dit ook aan die Leviet en die vreemdeling, die wees en die weduwee gegee, geheel en al volgens u gebod wat U my beveel het; ek het geeneen van u gebooie oortree of vergeet nie.

kjv_text: I have not eaten thereof in my mourning, neither have I taken away ought thereof for any unclean use, nor given ought thereof for the dead: but I have hearkened to the voice of the LORD my God, and have done according to all that thou hast commanded me.
bsb_text: I have not eaten any of the sacred portion while in mourning, or removed any of it while unclean, or offered any of it for the dead. I have obeyed the LORD my God; I have done everything You commanded me.
aov_text: Ek het daarvan in my rou nie geëet en daarvan as ’n onreine niks weggebring en daarvan aan ’n dooie niks gegee nie; ek het na die stem van die HERE my God geluister; ek het gedoen net soos U my beveel het.

kjv_text: Look down from thy holy habitation, from heaven, and bless thy people Israel, and the land which thou hast given us, as thou swarest unto our fathers, a land that floweth with milk and honey.
bsb_text: Look down from Your holy habitation, from heaven, and bless Your people Israel and the land You have given us as You swore to our fathers—a land flowing with milk and honey.”
aov_text: Kyk tog uit u heilige woning, uit die hemel, neer en seën u volk Israel en die land wat U ons gegee het, soos U aan ons vaders met ’n eed beloof het, ’n land wat oorloop van melk en heuning.

kjv_text: This day the LORD thy God hath commanded thee to do these statutes and judgments: thou shalt therefore keep and do them with all thine heart, and with all thy soul.
bsb_text: The LORD your God commands you this day to follow these statutes and ordinances. You must be careful to follow them with all your heart and with all your soul.
aov_text: Vandag beveel die HERE jou God jou om hierdie insettinge en verordeninge na te kom; onderhou dan en doen dit met jou hele hart en met jou hele siel.

kjv_text: Thou hast avouched the LORD this day to be thy God, and to walk in his ways, and to keep his statutes, and his commandments, and his judgments, and to hearken unto his voice:
bsb_text: Today you have proclaimed that the LORD is your God and that you will walk in His ways, keep His statutes and commandments and ordinances, and listen to His voice.
aov_text: Vandag het jy die HERE laat verklaar dat Hy vir jou ’n God sal wees, en dat jy in sy weë moet wandel en sy insettinge en sy gebooie en sy verordeninge moet hou en na sy stem moet luister.

kjv_text: And the LORD hath avouched thee this day to be his peculiar people, as he hath promised thee, and that thou shouldest keep all his commandments;
bsb_text: And today the LORD has proclaimed that you are His people and treasured possession as He promised, that you are to keep all His commandments,
aov_text: En die HERE het jou vandag laat verklaar dat jy vir Hom ’n eiendomsvolk sal wees soos Hy jou beloof het, en dat jy al sy gebooie sal onderhou;

kjv_text: And to make thee high above all nations which he hath made, in praise, and in name, and in honour; and that thou mayest be an holy people unto the LORD thy God, as he hath spoken.
bsb_text: that He will set you high in praise and name and honor above all the nations He has made, and that you will be a holy people to the LORD your God, as He has promised.
aov_text: en dat Hy jou dan die hoogste sal stel bo al die nasies wat Hy gemaak het, tot ’n lof en ’n roem en ’n sieraad, en dat jy ’n heilige volk aan die HERE jou God sal wees soos Hy beloof het.

kjv_text: And Moses with the elders of Israel commanded the people, saying, Keep all the commandments which I command you this day.
bsb_text: Then Moses and the elders of Israel commanded the people: “Keep all the commandments I am giving you today.
aov_text: EN Moses het saam met die oudstes van Israel aan die volk bevel gegee en gesê: Onderhou al die gebooie wat ek julle vandag beveel.

kjv_text: And it shall be on the day when ye shall pass over Jordan unto the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, that thou shalt set thee up great stones, and plaister them with plaister:
bsb_text: And on the day you cross the Jordan into the land that the LORD your God is giving you, set up large stones and coat them with plaster.
aov_text: En die dag as julle deur die Jordaan gaan in die land wat die HERE jou God jou sal gee, moet jy vir jou groot klippe oprig en dit met kalk bestryk.

kjv_text: And thou shalt write upon them all the words of this law, when thou art passed over, that thou mayest go in unto the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, a land that floweth with milk and honey; as the LORD God of thy fathers hath promised thee.
bsb_text: Write on them all the words of this law when you have crossed over to enter the land that the LORD your God is giving you, a land flowing with milk and honey, just as the LORD, the God of your fathers, has promised you.
aov_text: En jy moet as jy oortrek daarop skrywe al die woorde van hierdie wet, sodat jy kan kom in die land wat die HERE jou God jou sal gee, ’n land wat oorloop van melk en heuning, soos die HERE, die God van jou vaders, jou beloof het.

kjv_text: Therefore it shall be when ye be gone over Jordan, that ye shall set up these stones, which I command you this day, in mount Ebal, and thou shalt plaister them with plaister.
bsb_text: And when you have crossed the Jordan, you are to set up these stones on Mount Ebal, as I am commanding you today, and you are to coat them with plaster.
aov_text: As julle dan deur die Jordaan trek, moet julle hierdie klippe waaromtrent ek julle vandag bevel gee, op die berg Ebal oprig, en jy moet dit met kalk bestryk.

kjv_text: And there shalt thou build an altar unto the LORD thy God, an altar of stones: thou shalt not lift up any iron tool upon them.
bsb_text: Moreover, you are to build there an altar to the LORD your God, an altar of stones. You must not use any iron tool on them.
aov_text: En jy moet daar vir die HERE jou God ’n altaar bou, ’n altaar van klippe; jy mag geen yster daaroor swaai nie.

kjv_text: Thou shalt build the altar of the LORD thy God of whole stones: and thou shalt offer burnt offerings thereon unto the LORD thy God:
bsb_text: You shall build the altar of the LORD your God with uncut stones and offer upon it burnt offerings to the LORD your God.
aov_text: Van ongekapte klippe moet jy die altaar van die HERE jou God bou; en jy moet daarop brandoffers bring aan die HERE jou God.

kjv_text: And thou shalt offer peace offerings, and shalt eat there, and rejoice before the LORD thy God.
bsb_text: There you are to sacrifice your peace offerings, eating them and rejoicing in the presence of the LORD your God.
aov_text: Ook moet jy dankoffers slag en daar eet en vrolik wees voor die aangesig van die HERE jou God.

kjv_text: And thou shalt write upon the stones all the words of this law very plainly.
bsb_text: And you shall write distinctly upon these stones all the words of this law.”
aov_text: En jy moet op die klippe baie duidelik skrywe al die woorde van hierdie wet.

kjv_text: And Moses and the priests the Levites spake unto all Israel, saying, Take heed, and hearken, O Israel; this day thou art become the people of the LORD thy God.
bsb_text: Then Moses and the Levitical priests spoke to all Israel: “Be silent, O Israel, and listen! This day you have become the people of the LORD your God.
aov_text: Verder het Moses en die Levitiese priesters die hele Israel toegespreek en gesê: Wees stil en luister, o Israel! Vandag het jy die volk van die HERE geword.

kjv_text: Thou shalt therefore obey the voice of the LORD thy God, and do his commandments and his statutes, which I command thee this day.
bsb_text: You shall therefore obey the voice of the LORD your God and follow His commandments and statutes I am giving you today.”
aov_text: Daarom moet jy na die stem van die HERE jou God luister en sy gebooie en sy insettinge volbring wat ek jou vandag beveel.

kjv_text: And Moses charged the people the same day, saying,
bsb_text: On that day Moses commanded the people:
aov_text: En Moses het aan die volk op dié dag bevel gegee en gesê:

kjv_text: These shall stand upon mount Gerizim to bless the people, when ye are come over Jordan; Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Joseph, and Benjamin:
bsb_text: “When you have crossed the Jordan, these tribes shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.
aov_text: Hierdie stamme moet staan om die volk te seën op die berg Gerísim as julle deur die Jordaan getrek het: Símeon en Levi en Juda en Íssaskar en Josef en Benjamin.

kjv_text: And these shall stand upon mount Ebal to curse; Reuben, Gad, and Asher, and Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.
bsb_text: And these tribes shall stand on Mount Ebal to deliver the curse: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.
aov_text: En hierdie moet staan om te vervloek op die berg Ebal: Ruben, Gad en Aser en Sébulon, Dan en Náftali.

kjv_text: And the Levites shall speak, and say unto all the men of Israel with a loud voice,
bsb_text: Then the Levites shall proclaim in a loud voice to every Israelite:
aov_text: En die Leviete moet verklaar en aan al die manne van Israel hardop sê:

kjv_text: Cursed be the man that maketh any graven or molten image, an abomination unto the LORD, the work of the hands of the craftsman, and putteth it in a secret place. And all the people shall answer and say, Amen.
bsb_text: ‘Cursed is the man who makes a carved idol or molten image—an abomination to the LORD, the work of the hands of a craftsman—and sets it up in secret.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
aov_text: Vervloek is die man wat ’n gesnede of gegote beeld maak, ’n gruwel vir die HERE, werk van ’n ambagsman se hande, en dit in die geheim opstel; en die hele volk moet antwoord en sê: Amen.

kjv_text: Cursed be he that setteth light by his father or his mother. And all the people shall say, Amen.
bsb_text: ‘Cursed is he who dishonors his father or mother.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
aov_text: Vervloek is hy wat sy vader of sy moeder verag; en die hele volk moet sê: Amen.

kjv_text: Cursed be he that removeth his neighbour's landmark. And all the people shall say, Amen.
bsb_text: ‘Cursed is he who moves his neighbor’s boundary stone.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
aov_text: Vervloek is hy wat sy naaste se grenslyn verlê; en die hele volk moet sê: Amen.

kjv_text: Cursed be he that maketh the blind to wander out of the way. And all the people shall say, Amen.
bsb_text: ‘Cursed is he who lets a blind man wander in the road.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
aov_text: Vervloek is hy wat ’n blinde op die dwaalweg lei; en die hele volk moet sê: Amen.

kjv_text: Cursed be he that perverteth the judgment of the stranger, fatherless, and widow. And all the people shall say, Amen.
bsb_text: ‘Cursed is he who withholds justice from the foreigner, the fatherless, or the widow.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
aov_text: Vervloek is hy wat die reg van vreemdeling, wees en weduwee verdraai; en die hele volk moet sê: Amen.

kjv_text: Cursed be he that lieth with his father's wife; because he uncovereth his father's skirt. And all the people shall say, Amen.
bsb_text: ‘Cursed is he who sleeps with his father’s wife, for he has violated his father’s marriage bed.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
aov_text: Vervloek is hy wat met die vrou van sy vader gemeenskap het, want hy het die kombers van sy vader opgelig; en die hele volk moet sê: Amen.

kjv_text: Cursed be he that lieth with any manner of beast. And all the people shall say, Amen.
bsb_text: ‘Cursed is he who lies with any animal.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
aov_text: Vervloek is hy wat met enige dier gemeenskap het; en die hele volk moet sê: Amen.

kjv_text: Cursed be he that lieth with his sister, the daughter of his father, or the daughter of his mother. And all the people shall say, Amen.
bsb_text: ‘Cursed is he who sleeps with his sister, the daughter of his father or the daughter of his mother.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
aov_text: Vervloek is hy wat met sy suster, die dogter van sy vader of die dogter van sy moeder, gemeenskap het; en die hele volk moet sê: Amen.

kjv_text: Cursed be he that lieth with his mother in law. And all the people shall say, Amen.
bsb_text: ‘Cursed is he who sleeps with his mother-in-law.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
aov_text: Vervloek is hy wat met sy skoonmoeder gemeenskap het; en die hele volk moet sê: Amen.

kjv_text: Cursed be he that smiteth his neighbour secretly. And all the people shall say, Amen.
bsb_text: ‘Cursed is he who strikes down his neighbor in secret.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
aov_text: Vervloek is hy wat sy naaste in die geheim doodslaan; en die hele volk moet sê: Amen.

kjv_text: Cursed be he that taketh reward to slay an innocent person. And all the people shall say, Amen.
bsb_text: ‘Cursed is he who accepts a bribe to kill an innocent person.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
aov_text: Vervloek is hy wat ’n omkoopgeskenk aanneem om ’n persoon—onskuldige bloed—dood te slaan; en die hele volk moet sê: Amen.

kjv_text: Cursed be he that confirmeth not all the words of this law to do them. And all the people shall say, Amen.
bsb_text: ‘Cursed is he who does not put the words of this law into practice.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
aov_text: Vervloek is hy wat die woorde van hierdie wet nie hou om dit te doen nie; en die hele volk moet sê: Amen.

kjv_text: And it shall come to pass, if thou shalt hearken diligently unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to observe and to do all his commandments which I command thee this day, that the LORD thy God will set thee on high above all nations of the earth:
bsb_text: “Now if you faithfully obey the voice of the LORD your God and are careful to follow all His commandments I am giving you today, the LORD your God will set you high above all the nations of the earth.
aov_text: AS jy dan goed luister na die stem van die HERE jou God om sorgvuldig te hou al sy gebooie wat ek jou vandag beveel, dan sal die HERE jou God jou die hoogste stel bo al die nasies van die aarde.

kjv_text: And all these blessings shall come on thee, and overtake thee, if thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God.
bsb_text: And all these blessings will come upon you and overtake you, if you will obey the voice of the LORD your God:
aov_text: En al hierdie seëninge sal oor jou kom en jou inhaal as jy luister na die stem van die HERE jou God.

kjv_text: Blessed shalt thou be in the city, and blessed shalt thou be in the field.
bsb_text: You will be blessed in the city and blessed in the country.
aov_text: Geseënd sal jy wees in die stad, en geseënd sal jy wees in die veld.

kjv_text: Blessed shall be the fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy ground, and the fruit of thy cattle, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep.
bsb_text: The fruit of your womb will be blessed, as well as the produce of your land and the offspring of your livestock—the calves of your herds and the lambs of your flocks.
aov_text: Geseënd sal wees die vrug van jou liggaam en die vrugte van jou land en die vrug van jou vee, die aanteel van jou beeste en die aanteel van jou kleinvee.

kjv_text: Blessed shall be thy basket and thy store.
bsb_text: Your basket and kneading bowl will be blessed.
aov_text: Geseënd sal wees jou mandjie en jou bakskottel.

kjv_text: Blessed shalt thou be when thou comest in, and blessed shalt thou be when thou goest out.
bsb_text: You will be blessed when you come in and blessed when you go out.
aov_text: Geseënd sal jy wees by jou ingang, en geseënd sal jy wees by jou uitgang.

kjv_text: The LORD shall cause thine enemies that rise up against thee to be smitten before thy face: they shall come out against thee one way, and flee before thee seven ways.
bsb_text: The LORD will cause the enemies who rise up against you to be defeated before you. They will march out against you in one direction but flee from you in seven.
aov_text: Die HERE sal maak dat jou vyande wat teen jou opstaan, voor jou verslaan word; op een pad sal hulle teen jou uittrek en op sewe paaie voor jou uit vlug.

kjv_text: The LORD shall command the blessing upon thee in thy storehouses, and in all that thou settest thine hand unto; and he shall bless thee in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
bsb_text: The LORD will decree a blessing on your barns and on everything to which you put your hand; the LORD your God will bless you in the land He is giving you.
aov_text: Die HERE sal die seën oor jou gebied in jou skure en in alles waar jy jou hand aan slaan; en Hy sal jou seën in die land wat die HERE jou God jou sal gee.

kjv_text: The LORD shall establish thee an holy people unto himself, as he hath sworn unto thee, if thou shalt keep the commandments of the LORD thy God, and walk in his ways.
bsb_text: The LORD will establish you as His holy people, just as He has sworn to you, if you keep the commandments of the LORD your God and walk in His ways.
aov_text: Die HERE sal jou vir Hom as heilige volk bevestig soos Hy jou dit gesweer het, as jy die gebooie van die HERE jou God hou en in sy weë wandel.

kjv_text: And all people of the earth shall see that thou art called by the name of the LORD; and they shall be afraid of thee.
bsb_text: Then all the peoples of the earth will see that you are called by the name of the LORD, and they will stand in awe of you.
aov_text: En al die volke van die aarde sal sien dat die Naam van die HERE oor jou uitgeroep is, en hulle sal vir jou vrees.

kjv_text: And the LORD shall make thee plenteous in goods, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy ground, in the land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers to give thee.
bsb_text: The LORD will make you prosper abundantly—in the fruit of your womb, the offspring of your livestock, and the produce of your land—in the land that the LORD swore to your fathers to give you.
aov_text: En die HERE sal die goeie aan jou oorvloedig gee in die vrug van jou liggaam en in die vrug van jou vee en in die vrugte van jou land, in die land wat die HERE aan jou vaders met ’n eed beloof het om aan jou te gee.

kjv_text: The LORD shall open unto thee his good treasure, the heaven to give the rain unto thy land in his season, and to bless all the work of thine hand: and thou shalt lend unto many nations, and thou shalt not borrow.
bsb_text: The LORD will open the heavens, His abundant storehouse, to send rain on your land in season and to bless all the work of your hands. You will lend to many nations, but borrow from none.
aov_text: Die HERE sal sy goeie skatkamer, die hemel, vir jou oopmaak om die reën van jou land op die regte tyd te gee en om al die werk van jou hand te seën; en jy sal aan baie nasies uitleen, maar self nie hoef te leen nie.

kjv_text: And the LORD shall make thee the head, and not the tail; and thou shalt be above only, and thou shalt not be beneath; if that thou hearken unto the commandments of the LORD thy God, which I command thee this day, to observe and to do them:
bsb_text: The LORD will make you the head and not the tail; you will only move upward and never downward, if you hear and carefully follow the commandments of the LORD your God, which I am giving you today.
aov_text: En die HERE sal jou die kop en nie die stert maak nie, en jy sal net boontoe en nie ondertoe gaan nie as jy luister na die gebooie van die HERE jou God wat ek jou vandag beveel om te hou en te doen,

kjv_text: And thou shalt not go aside from any of the words which I command thee this day, to the right hand, or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.

aov_text: Vervloek sal jy wees in die stad, en vervloek sal jy wees in die veld.

kjv_text: The LORD shall make the pestilence cleave unto thee, until he have consumed thee from off the land, whither thou goest to possess it.

bsb_text: The LORD will strike you with wasting disease, with fever and inflammation, with scorching heat and drought, and with blight and mildew; these will pursue you until you perish.
aov_text: Die HERE sal jou swaar tref met tering en koors en vurige koors en ontsteking en droogte en brandkoring en heuningdou; en hulle sal jou vervolg totdat jy omkom.

kjv_text: And thy heaven that is over thy head shall be brass, and the earth that is under thee shall be iron.

aov_text: Die HERE sal maak dat jy voor jou vyande verslaan word; op een pad sal jy teen hom uittrek en op sewe paaie sal jy voor hom uit vlug; en jy sal ’n skrikbeeld vir al die koninkryke van die aarde word.

kjv_text: And thy carcase shall be meat unto all fowls of the air, and unto the beasts of the earth, and no man shall fray them away.
bsb_text: Your corpses will be food for all the birds of the air and beasts of the earth, with no one to scare them away.

bsb_text: Your ox will be slaughtered before your eyes, but you will not eat any of it. Your donkey will be taken away and not returned to you. Your flock will be given to your enemies, and no one will save you.

kjv_text: So that thou shalt be mad for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.

aov_text: En jy sal kranksinnig wees vanweë die gesig van jou oë wat jy sal sien.

bsb_text: The LORD will afflict you with painful, incurable boils on your knees and thighs, from the soles of your feet to the top of your head.
aov_text: Die HERE sal jou tref met bose swere aan die knieë en aan die bene—waarvan jy nie gesond kan word nie—van jou voetsool tot jou skedel.

kjv_text: The LORD shall bring thee, and thy king which thou shalt set over thee, unto a nation which neither thou nor thy fathers have known; and there shalt thou serve other gods, wood and stone.

kjv_text: And thou shalt become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword, among all nations whither the LORD shall lead thee.

aov_text: Seuns en dogters sal jy verwek, maar hulle sal vir jou nie wees nie; want hulle sal in gevangenskap gaan.

kjv_text: Moreover all these curses shall come upon thee, and shall pursue thee, and overtake thee, till thou be destroyed; because thou hearkenedst not unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded thee:
bsb_text: All these curses will come upon you. They will pursue you and overtake you until you are destroyed, since you did not obey the LORD your God and keep the commandments and statutes He gave you.
aov_text: En al hierdie vloeke sal oor jou kom en jou agtervolg en jou inhaal totdat jy verdelg is, omdat jy nie geluister het na die stem van die HERE jou God om sy gebooie en sy insettinge wat Hy jou beveel het, te hou nie;

aov_text: Die HERE sal teen jou ’n nasie bring van ver, van die einde van die aarde af, soos ’n arend vlieg—’n nasie wie se taal jy nie verstaan nie,

kjv_text: And thou shalt eat the fruit of thine own body, the flesh of thy sons and of thy daughters, which the LORD thy God hath given thee, in the siege, and in the straitness, wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee:

aov_text: Die vertroetelde en verwénde vrou by jou wat van verwendheid en weekheid nooit probeer het om haar voetsool op die grond neer te sit nie—haar oog sal die man wat sy liefhet en haar seun en haar dogter skeef aankyk,

bsb_text: You who were as numerous as the stars in the sky will be left few in number, because you would not obey the voice of the LORD your God.

aov_text: En jou lewe sal voor jou aan ’n draad hang, en jy sal nag en dag skrik en van jou lewe nie seker wees nie.

aov_text: as die hele Israel kom om te verskyn voor die aangesig van die HERE jou God op die plek wat Hy sal uitkies, moet jy hierdie wet voor die hele Israel, voor hulle ore lees.

kjv_text: Gather the people together, men, and women, and children, and thy stranger that is within thy gates, that they may hear, and that they may learn, and fear the LORD your God, and observe to do all the words of this law:
bsb_text: Assemble the people—men, women, children, and the foreigners within your gates—so that they may listen and learn to fear the LORD your God and to follow carefully all the words of this law.
aov_text: Laat die volk byeenkom, die manne en die vroue en die kinders en jou vreemdeling wat in jou poorte is, dat hulle kan hoor en dat hulle kan leer om die HERE julle God te vrees en sorgvuldig al die woorde van hierdie wet te hou.

kjv_text: And that their children, which have not known any thing, may hear, and learn to fear the LORD your God, as long as ye live in the land whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.
bsb_text: Then their children who do not know the law will listen and learn to fear the LORD your God, as long as you live in the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess.”
aov_text: En hulle kinders wat dit nie ken nie, moet hoor en leer om die HERE julle God te vrees al die dae wat julle lewe in die land waarheen julle deur die Jordaan trek om dit in besit te neem.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Behold, thy days approach that thou must die: call Joshua, and present yourselves in the tabernacle of the congregation, that I may give him a charge. And Moses and Joshua went, and presented themselves in the tabernacle of the congregation.
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Behold, the time of your death is near. Call Joshua and present yourselves at the Tent of Meeting, so that I may commission him.” So Moses and Joshua went and presented themselves at the Tent of Meeting.
aov_text: EN die HERE het vir Moses gesê: Kyk, jou dae kom nader dat jy moet sterwe; roep Josua, en gaan julle in die tent van samekoms staan, dat Ek aan hom bevel kan gee. Toe het Moses en Josua gegaan en in die tent van samekoms gaan staan.

kjv_text: And the LORD appeared in the tabernacle in a pillar of a cloud: and the pillar of the cloud stood over the door of the tabernacle.
bsb_text: Then the LORD appeared at the tent in a pillar of cloud, and the cloud stood over the entrance to the tent.
aov_text: En die HERE het in die tent in ’n wolkkolom verskyn terwyl die wolkkolom by die ingang van die tent bly staan het.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Behold, thou shalt sleep with thy fathers; and this people will rise up, and go a whoring after the gods of the strangers of the land, whither they go to be among them, and will forsake me, and break my covenant which I have made with them.
bsb_text: And the LORD said to Moses, “You will soon rest with your fathers, and these people will rise up and prostitute themselves with the foreign gods of the land they are entering. They will forsake Me and break the covenant I have made with them.
aov_text: Toe sê die HERE vir Moses: Kyk, jy ontslaap met jou vaders, en hierdie volk sal opstaan, en hulle sal die vreemde gode van die land waarheen hulle gaan, in sy midde agternahoereer en My verlaat en my verbond verbreek wat Ek met hulle gemaak het.

kjv_text: Then my anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide my face from them, and they shall be devoured, and many evils and troubles shall befall them; so that they will say in that day, Are not these evils come upon us, because our God is not among us?
bsb_text: On that day My anger will burn against them, and I will abandon them and hide My face from them, so that they will be consumed, and many troubles and afflictions will befall them. On that day they will say, ‘Have not these disasters come upon us because our God is no longer with us?’
aov_text: Dan sal my toorn op dié dag teen hulle ontvlam, en Ek sal hulle verlaat en my aangesig vir hulle verberg, sodat hulle verteer word en baie onheile en node hulle oorkom. Dan sal hulle op dié dag sê: Het hierdie onheile ons nie oorgekom, omdat onse God nie onder ons is nie?

kjv_text: And I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evils which they shall have wrought, in that they are turned unto other gods.
bsb_text: And on that day I will surely hide My face because of all the evil they have done by turning to other gods.
aov_text: Maar Ek sal op dié dag my aangesig heeltemal verberg weens al die kwaad wat hulle gedoen het; want hulle het na ander gode afgewyk.

kjv_text: Now therefore write ye this song for you, and teach it the children of Israel: put it in their mouths, that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Israel.
bsb_text: Now therefore, write down for yourselves this song and teach it to the Israelites; have them recite it, so that it may be a witness for Me against them.
aov_text: Skryf dan nou vir julle hierdie lied op, en leer dit aan die kinders van Israel; lê dit in hulle mond, dat hierdie lied vir My ’n getuie teen die kinders van Israel kan wees.

kjv_text: For when I shall have brought them into the land which I sware unto their fathers, that floweth with milk and honey; and they shall have eaten and filled themselves, and waxen fat; then will they turn unto other gods, and serve them, and provoke me, and break my covenant.
bsb_text: When I have brought them into the land that I swore to give their fathers, a land flowing with milk and honey, they will eat their fill and prosper. Then they will turn to other gods and worship them, and they will reject Me and break My covenant.
aov_text: Want Ek sal hulle inbring in die land wat Ek aan hulle vaders met ’n eed beloof het, wat oorloop van melk en heuning, en hulle sal eet en versadig en vet word; dan sal hulle afwyk na ander gode en dié dien, en hulle sal My verag en my verbond verbreek.

kjv_text: And it shall come to pass, when many evils and troubles are befallen them, that this song shall testify against them as a witness; for it shall not be forgotten out of the mouths of their seed: for I know their imagination which they go about, even now, before I have brought them into the land which I sware.
bsb_text: And when many troubles and afflictions have come upon them, this song will testify against them, because it will not be forgotten from the lips of their descendants. For I know their inclination, even before I bring them into the land that I swore to give them.”
aov_text: En as dan baie onheile en node oor hulle kom, dan sal hierdie lied in hulle aangesig as getuie antwoord—want dit sal uit die mond van hulle nageslag nie vergeet wees nie—want Ek ken hulle gedagtes wat hulle vandag koester voordat Ek hulle inbring in die land wat Ek met ’n eed beloof het.

kjv_text: Moses therefore wrote this song the same day, and taught it the children of Israel.
bsb_text: So that very day Moses wrote down this song and taught it to the Israelites.
aov_text: Toe het Moses hierdie lied op dié dag opgeskrywe en dit aan die kinders van Israel geleer.

kjv_text: And he gave Joshua the son of Nun a charge, and said, Be strong and of a good courage: for thou shalt bring the children of Israel into the land which I sware unto them: and I will be with thee.
bsb_text: Then the LORD commissioned Joshua son of Nun and said, “Be strong and courageous, for you will bring the Israelites into the land that I swore to give them, and I will be with you.”
aov_text: En Hy het aan Josua, die seun van Nun, bevel gegee en gesê: Wees sterk en vol moed, want jý sal die kinders van Israel inbring in die land wat Ek hulle met ’n eed beloof het; en Ek sal met jou wees.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when Moses had made an end of writing the words of this law in a book, until they were finished,
bsb_text: When Moses had finished writing in a book the words of this law from beginning to end,
aov_text: En toe Moses die woorde van hierdie wet klaar in ’n boek geskryf het tot die einde toe,

kjv_text: That Moses commanded the Levites, which bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, saying,
bsb_text: he gave this command to the Levites who carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD:
aov_text: het Moses aan die Leviete wat die verbondsark van die HERE gedra het, bevel gegee en gesê:

kjv_text: Take this book of the law, and put it in the side of the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, that it may be there for a witness against thee.
bsb_text: “Take this Book of the Law and place it beside the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, so that it may remain there as a witness against you.
aov_text: Neem hierdie wetboek en sit dit neer aan die kant van die verbondsark van die HERE julle God, dat dit daar as getuie teen jou kan wees.

kjv_text: For I know thy rebellion, and thy stiff neck: behold, while I am yet alive with you this day, ye have been rebellious against the LORD; and how much more after my death?
bsb_text: For I know how rebellious and stiff-necked you are. If you are already rebelling against the LORD while I am still alive, how much more will you rebel after my death!
aov_text: Want ék ken jou wederstrewigheid en jou hardnekkigheid. As julle, terwyl ek nog vandag by julle lewe, wederstrewig was teen die HERE—hoeveel te meer dan ná my dood!

kjv_text: Gather unto me all the elders of your tribes, and your officers, that I may speak these words in their ears, and call heaven and earth to record against them.
bsb_text: Assemble before me all the elders of your tribes and all your officers so that I may speak these words in their hearing and call heaven and earth to witness against them.
aov_text: Laat al die oudstes van julle stamme en julle opsigters by my vergader, dat ek voor hulle ore hierdie woorde kan spreek, en teen hulle die hemel en die aarde as getuies kan neem.

kjv_text: For I know that after my death ye will utterly corrupt yourselves, and turn aside from the way which I have commanded you; and evil will befall you in the latter days; because ye will do evil in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands.
bsb_text: For I know that after my death you will become utterly corrupt and turn from the path I have commanded you. And in the days to come, disaster will befall you because you will do evil in the sight of the LORD to provoke Him to anger by the work of your hands.”
aov_text: Want ek weet dat julle ná my dood gewis verderflik sal handel en sal afwyk van die weg wat ek julle beveel het, sodat die onheil julle aan die einde van die dae sal teëkom, omdat julle sal doen wat verkeerd is in die oë van die HERE om Hom deur die werk van julle hande te terg.

kjv_text: And Moses spake in the ears of all the congregation of Israel the words of this song, until they were ended.
bsb_text: Then Moses recited aloud to the whole assembly of Israel the words of this song from beginning to end:
aov_text: Toe het Moses voor die ore van die hele vergadering van Israel die woorde van hierdie lied tot die einde toe uitgespreek.

kjv_text: Give ear, O ye heavens, and I will speak; and hear, O earth, the words of my mouth.
bsb_text: Give ear, O heavens, and I will speak; hear, O earth, the words of my mouth.
aov_text: LUISTER, o hemele, dat ek kan spreek, en laat die aarde hoor die woorde van my mond.

kjv_text: My doctrine shall drop as the rain, my speech shall distil as the dew, as the small rain upon the tender herb, and as the showers upon the grass:
bsb_text: Let my teaching fall like rain and my speech settle like dew, like gentle rain on new grass, like showers on tender plants.
aov_text: Laat my leer drup soos die reën, my woord vloei soos die dou, soos reëndruppels op die grasspruitjies en soos reënbuie op die plante.

kjv_text: Because I will publish the name of the LORD: ascribe ye greatness unto our God.
bsb_text: For I will proclaim the name of the LORD. Ascribe greatness to our God!
aov_text: Want die Naam van die HERE roep ek uit: Gee grootheid aan onse God!

kjv_text: He is the Rock, his work is perfect: for all his ways are judgment: a God of truth and without iniquity, just and right is he.
bsb_text: He is the Rock, His work is perfect; all His ways are just. A God of faithfulness without injustice, righteous and upright is He.
aov_text: Die Rots—volkome is sy werk; want al sy weë is strafgerigte; ’n God van trou en sonder onreg; regverdig en reg is Hy.

kjv_text: They have corrupted themselves, their spot is not the spot of his children: they are a perverse and crooked generation.
bsb_text: His people have acted corruptly toward Him; the spot on them is not that of His children, but of a perverse and crooked generation.
aov_text: Hulle het verderflik teen Hom gehandel—die wat sy seuns nie was nie, maar hulle skandvlek—’n verkeerde en verdraaide geslag.

kjv_text: Do ye thus requite the LORD, O foolish people and unwise? is not he thy father that hath bought thee? hath he not made thee, and established thee?
bsb_text: Is this how you repay the LORD, O foolish and senseless people? Is He not your Father and Creator? Has He not made you and established you?
aov_text: Durf julle dit die HERE vergelde, o dwase en onwyse volk? Is Hý nie jou Vader wat jou geskape het nie; het Hý jou nie gemaak en jou toeberei nie?

kjv_text: Remember the days of old, consider the years of many generations: ask thy father, and he will shew thee; thy elders, and they will tell thee.
bsb_text: Remember the days of old; consider the years long past. Ask your father, and he will tell you, your elders, and they will inform you.
aov_text: Dink aan die dae van die ou tyd, let op die jare, van geslag tot geslag; vra jou vader, dat hy jou dit bekend maak; die ou mense, dat hulle jou dit sê.

kjv_text: When the Most High divided to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the sons of Adam, he set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Israel.
bsb_text: When the Most High gave the nations their inheritance, when He divided the sons of man, He set the boundaries of the peoples according to the number of the sons of God.
aov_text: Toe die Allerhoogste aan die nasies ’n erfdeel gegee het, toe Hy die mensekinders van mekaar geskei het, het Hy die grense van die volke vasgestel volgens die getal van die kinders van Israel.

kjv_text: For the LORD's portion is his people; Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.
bsb_text: But the LORD’s portion is His people, Jacob His allotted inheritance.
aov_text: Want die HERE se deel is sy volk, Jakob is sy afgemete erfdeel.

kjv_text: He found him in a desert land, and in the waste howling wilderness; he led him about, he instructed him, he kept him as the apple of his eye.
bsb_text: He found him in a desert land, in a barren, howling wilderness; He surrounded him, He instructed him, He guarded him as the apple of His eye.
aov_text: Hy het hom gevind in ’n woestynland en in ’n woeste wêreld, vol gehuil van die wildernis; Hy het hom omring, op hom ag gegee, hom bewaak soos sy oogappel.

kjv_text: As an eagle stirreth up her nest, fluttereth over her young, spreadeth abroad her wings, taketh them, beareth them on her wings:
bsb_text: As an eagle stirs up its nest and hovers over its young, He spread His wings to catch them and carried them on His pinions.
aov_text: Soos ’n arend sy nes opwek, oor sy kleintjies sweef, sy vlerke uitsprei, hulle opneem, hulle dra op sy vleuels —

kjv_text: So the LORD alone did lead him, and there was no strange god with him.
bsb_text: The LORD alone led him, and no foreign god was with him.
aov_text: die HERE alleen het hom gelei, en daar was geen vreemde god by hom nie.

kjv_text: He made him ride on the high places of the earth, that he might eat the increase of the fields; and he made him to suck honey out of the rock, and oil out of the flinty rock;
bsb_text: He made him ride on the heights of the land and fed him the produce of the field. He nourished him with honey from the rock and oil from the flinty crag,
aov_text: Hy het hom laat ry op die hoogtes van die aarde, en hy het die opbrings van die veld geëet; en Hy het hom heuning uit die rots laat suig en olie uit die klipharde rots;

kjv_text: Butter of kine, and milk of sheep, with fat of lambs, and rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the fat of kidneys of wheat; and thou didst drink the pure blood of the grape.
bsb_text: with curds from the herd and milk from the flock, with the fat of lambs, with rams from Bashan, and goats, with the choicest grains of wheat. From the juice of the finest grapes you drank the wine.
aov_text: dikmelk van beeste en melk van kleinvee, met die vet van lammers en ramme; stiere van Basan en bokke, met die niervet van koring; en druiwebloed het jy gedrink, skuimende wyn.

kjv_text: But Jeshurun waxed fat, and kicked: thou art waxen fat, thou art grown thick, thou art covered with fatness; then he forsook God which made him, and lightly esteemed the Rock of his salvation.
bsb_text: But Jeshurun grew fat and kicked—becoming fat, bloated, and gorged. He abandoned the God who made him and scorned the Rock of his salvation.
aov_text: Toe het Jesúrun vet geword en agterop geskop—jy het vet geword, dik geword, spekvet geword—en hy het God verwerp wat hom gemaak het, en die steenrots van sy heil geminag.

kjv_text: They provoked him to jealousy with strange gods, with abominations provoked they him to anger.
bsb_text: They provoked His jealousy with foreign gods; they enraged Him with abominations.
aov_text: Hulle het deur vreemde gode sy ywer gewek; deur gruwels Hom geterg.

kjv_text: They sacrificed unto devils, not to God; to gods whom they knew not, to new gods that came newly up, whom your fathers feared not.
bsb_text: They sacrificed to demons, not to God, to gods they had not known, to newly arrived gods, which your fathers did not fear.
aov_text: Hulle het aan die duiwels geoffer, wat nie-God is, gode wat aan hulle nie bekend was nie; nuwes wat kort gelede opgekom het, vir wie julle vaders nie gehuiwer het nie.

kjv_text: Of the Rock that begat thee thou art unmindful, and hast forgotten God that formed thee.
bsb_text: You ignored the Rock who brought you forth; you forgot the God who gave you birth.
aov_text: Die Steenrots wat jou verwek het, het jy veronagsaam; en jy het die God vergeet wat jou voortgebring het.

kjv_text: And when the LORD saw it, he abhorred them, because of the provoking of his sons, and of his daughters.
bsb_text: When the LORD saw this, He rejected them, provoked to anger by His sons and daughters.
aov_text: Toe die HERE dit sien, het Hy hulle verwerp, uit ergernis oor sy seuns en dogters.

kjv_text: And he said, I will hide my face from them, I will see what their end shall be: for they are a very froward generation, children in whom is no faith.
bsb_text: He said: “I will hide My face from them; I will see what will be their end. For they are a perverse generation—children of unfaithfulness.
aov_text: En Hy het gesê: Ek wil my aangesig vir hulle verberg, Ek wil sien wat hulle einde sal wees; want ’n heeltemal verkeerde geslag is hulle, kinders in wie geen trou is nie.

kjv_text: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God; they have provoked me to anger with their vanities: and I will move them to jealousy with those which are not a people; I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.
bsb_text: They have provoked My jealousy by that which is not God; they have enraged Me with their worthless idols. So I will make them jealous by those who are not a people; I will make them angry by a nation without understanding.
aov_text: Hulle het my ywer gewek deur wat nie-God is, My geterg deur hulle nietige afgode. Ek sal dan hulle ywer wek deur die wat ’n nie-volk is, deur ’n dwase nasie sal Ek hulle terg.

kjv_text: For a fire is kindled in mine anger, and shall burn unto the lowest hell, and shall consume the earth with her increase, and set on fire the foundations of the mountains.
bsb_text: For a fire has been kindled by My anger, and it burns to the depths of Sheol; it consumes the earth and its produce, and scorches the foundations of the mountains.
aov_text: Want ’n vuur is aangesteek in my toorn en het gebrand tot in die doderyk daaronder, en dit het die aarde met sy opbrings verteer en die fondamente van die berge aan die brand gesteek.

kjv_text: I will heap mischiefs upon them; I will spend mine arrows upon them.
bsb_text: I will heap disasters upon them; I will spend My arrows against them.
aov_text: Ek sal onheile op hulle ophoop; my pyle sal Ek op hulle wegskiet.

kjv_text: They shall be burnt with hunger, and devoured with burning heat, and with bitter destruction: I will also send the teeth of beasts upon them, with the poison of serpents of the dust.
bsb_text: They will be wasted from hunger and ravaged by pestilence and bitter plague; I will send the fangs of wild beasts against them, with the venom of vipers that slither in the dust.
aov_text: As hulle uitgeput is van honger en verteer deur koorsgloed en dodelike siekte, sal Ek die tand van wilde diere teen hulle loslaat met die gif van stofkruipers.

kjv_text: The sword without, and terror within, shall destroy both the young man and the virgin, the suckling also with the man of gray hairs.
bsb_text: Outside, the sword will take their children, and inside, terror will strike the young man and the young woman, the infant and the gray-haired man.
aov_text: Buitekant sal die swaard beroof, en in die binnekamers die verskrikking; die jongman sowel as die jongedogter, die suigling saam met die grysaard.

kjv_text: I said, I would scatter them into corners, I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men:
bsb_text: I would have said that I would cut them to pieces and blot out their memory from mankind,
aov_text: Ek sou gesê het: Ek wil hulle wegblaas, hulle gedagtenis onder die mense uitroei —

kjv_text: Were it not that I feared the wrath of the enemy, lest their adversaries should behave themselves strangely, and lest they should say, Our hand is high, and the LORD hath not done all this.
bsb_text: if I had not dreaded the taunt of the enemy, lest their adversaries misunderstand and say: ‘Our own hand has prevailed; it was not the LORD who did all this.’”
aov_text: as Ek nie vir die terging van die vyand bedug was nie, dat hulle teëstanders dit sou misverstaan en sê: Ons hand was hoog, en die HERE het dit alles nie gedoen nie.

kjv_text: For they are a nation void of counsel, neither is there any understanding in them.
bsb_text: Israel is a nation devoid of counsel, with no understanding among them.
aov_text: Want ’n nasie van verlore raadsplanne is hulle, en daar is geen verstand in hulle nie.

kjv_text: O that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!
bsb_text: If only they were wise, they would understand it; they would comprehend their fate.
aov_text: Was hulle wys, hulle sou dit insien, hulle sou op hulle einde let.

kjv_text: How should one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, except their Rock had sold them, and the LORD had shut them up?
bsb_text: How could one man pursue a thousand, or two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, unless the LORD had given them up?
aov_text: Hoe kan een dan duisend agtervolg en twee tienduisend op die vlug jaag, was dit nie dat hul Steenrots hulle verkoop en die HERE hulle oorgelewer het nie!

kjv_text: For their rock is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves being judges.
bsb_text: For their rock is not like our Rock, even our enemies concede.
aov_text: Want hulle steenrots is nie soos ons Steenrots nie—ja, ons vyande self is skeidsregters!

kjv_text: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, and of the fields of Gomorrah: their grapes are grapes of gall, their clusters are bitter:
bsb_text: But their vine is from the vine of Sodom and from the fields of Gomorrah. Their grapes are poisonous; their clusters are bitter.
aov_text: Want hulle wingerdstok is uit die wingerdstok van Sodom en uit die wingerde van Gomorra; hulle druiwe is giftige druiwe, bitter trosse dra hulle.

kjv_text: Their wine is the poison of dragons, and the cruel venom of asps.
bsb_text: Their wine is the venom of serpents, the deadly poison of cobras.
aov_text: Hulle wyn is slanggif en wrede addergif.

kjv_text: Is not this laid up in store with me, and sealed up among my treasures?
bsb_text: “Have I not stored up these things, sealed up within My vaults?
aov_text: Is dit nie by My opgegaar, in my skatkamers verseël nie?

kjv_text: To me belongeth vengeance, and recompence; their foot shall slide in due time: for the day of their calamity is at hand, and the things that shall come upon them make haste.
bsb_text: Vengeance is Mine; I will repay. In due time their foot will slip; for their day of disaster is near, and their doom is coming quickly.”
aov_text: My kom die wraak toe en die vergelding, op die tyd as hulle voet sal wankel; want die dag van hulle ondergang is naby, en wat oor hulle beskik is, kom gou.

kjv_text: For the LORD shall judge his people, and repent himself for his servants, when he seeth that their power is gone, and there is none shut up, or left.
bsb_text: For the LORD will vindicate His people and have compassion on His servants when He sees that their strength is gone and no one remains, slave or free.
aov_text: Want die HERE sal aan sy volk reg verskaf, en Hy sal medelyde hê met sy knegte as Hy sien dat hulle vashouplek weg is en dit met almal sonder uitsondering gedaan is.

kjv_text: And he shall say, Where are their gods, their rock in whom they trusted,
bsb_text: He will say: “Where are their gods, the rock in which they took refuge,
aov_text: Dan sal Hy sê: Waar is hulle gode, die steenrots waarin hulle toevlug geneem het,

kjv_text: Which did eat the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their drink offerings? let them rise up and help you, and be your protection.
bsb_text: which ate the fat of their sacrifices and drank the wine of their drink offerings? Let them rise up and help you; let them give you shelter!
aov_text: wat die vet van hulle slagoffers geëet het, die wyn van hulle drankoffer gedrink het? Laat hulle opstaan en julle help, dat daar oor julle ’n beskerming kan wees!

kjv_text: See now that I, even I, am he, and there is no god with me: I kill, and I make alive; I wound, and I heal: neither is there any that can deliver out of my hand.
bsb_text: See now that I am He; there is no God besides Me. I bring death and I give life; I wound and I heal, and there is no one who can deliver from My hand.
aov_text: Aanskou nou dat dit Ek is en dat daar geen god naas My is nie; Ek maak dood en maak lewend, Ek het verbrysel en Ek genees; en daar is niemand wat uit my hand red nie.

kjv_text: For I lift up my hand to heaven, and say, I live for ever.
bsb_text: For I lift up My hand to heaven and declare: As surely as I live forever,
aov_text: Want Ek sal my hand na die hemel ophef en sê: So waar as Ek ewig leef —

kjv_text: If I whet my glittering sword, and mine hand take hold on judgment; I will render vengeance to mine enemies, and will reward them that hate me.
bsb_text: when I sharpen My flashing sword, and My hand grasps it in judgment, I will take vengeance on My adversaries and repay those who hate Me.
aov_text: as Ek my glinsterende swaard skerp gemaak het en my hand na die strafgerig gryp, sal Ek wraak oefen op my teëstanders en my haters vergelde.

kjv_text: I will make mine arrows drunk with blood, and my sword shall devour flesh; and that with the blood of the slain and of the captives, from the beginning of revenges upon the enemy.
bsb_text: I will make My arrows drunk with blood, while My sword devours flesh—the blood of the slain and captives, the heads of the enemy leaders.”
aov_text: Ek sal my pyle dronk maak van bloed, en my swaard sal vlees eet: van die bloed van hom wat verslaan en gevang is, van die kop van die vyand se aanvoerders.

kjv_text: Rejoice, O ye nations, with his people: for he will avenge the blood of his servants, and will render vengeance to his adversaries, and will be merciful unto his land, and to his people.
bsb_text: Rejoice, O heavens, with Him, and let all God’s angels worship Him. Rejoice, O nations, with His people; for He will avenge the blood of His children. He will take vengeance on His adversaries and repay those who hate Him; He will cleanse His land and His people.
aov_text: Jubel, o nasies, oor sy volk, want Hy sal die bloed van sy knegte wreek, en Hy sal wraak oefen op sy teëstanders en versoening doen vir sy land en sy volk.

kjv_text: And Moses came and spake all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he, and Hoshea the son of Nun.
bsb_text: Then Moses came with Joshua son of Nun and recited all the words of this song in the hearing of the people.
aov_text: En Moses het gekom en al die woorde van hierdie lied voor die ore van die volk gespreek, hy en Hoséa, die seun van Nun.

kjv_text: And Moses made an end of speaking all these words to all Israel:
bsb_text: When Moses had finished reciting all these words to all Israel,
aov_text: En toe Moses met al hierdie woorde die hele Israel klaar toegespreek het,

kjv_text: And he said unto them, Set your hearts unto all the words which I testify among you this day, which ye shall command your children to observe to do, all the words of this law.
bsb_text: he said to them, “Take to heart all these words I testify among you today, so that you may command your children to carefully follow all the words of this law.
aov_text: sê hy vir hulle: Gee ag op al die woorde waarmee ek julle vandag waarsku, dat julle dit jul kinders beveel om al die woorde van hierdie wet sorgvuldig te hou.

kjv_text: For it is not a vain thing for you; because it is your life: and through this thing ye shall prolong your days in the land, whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.
bsb_text: For they are not idle words to you, because they are your life, and by them you will live long in the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess.”
aov_text: Want dit is geen vergeefse woord vir julle nie, maar dit is julle lewe; en deur hierdie woord sal julle die dae verleng in die land waarheen julle deur die Jordaan trek om dit in besit te neem.

kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Moses that selfsame day, saying,
bsb_text: On that same day the LORD said to Moses,
aov_text: Daarna het die HERE op daardie selfde dag met Moses gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: Get thee up into this mountain Abarim, unto mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, that is over against Jericho; and behold the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel for a possession:
bsb_text: “Go up into the Abarim Range to Mount Nebo, in the land of Moab across from Jericho, and view the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the Israelites as their own possession.
aov_text: Klim op hierdie gebergte Abárim, die berg Nebo, wat in die land Moab is, wat teenoor Jérigo lê, en aanskou die land Kanaän wat Ek aan die kinders van Israel as besitting sal gee;

kjv_text: And die in the mount whither thou goest up, and be gathered unto thy people; as Aaron thy brother died in mount Hor, and was gathered unto his people:
bsb_text: And there on the mountain that you climb, you will die and be gathered to your people, just as your brother Aaron died on Mount Hor and was gathered to his people.
aov_text: en sterwe op die berg waarheen jy opklim, en word versamel by jou volksgenote, soos jou broer Aäron gesterf het op die berg Hor en versamel is by sy volksgenote,

kjv_text: Because ye trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of MeribahKadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because ye sanctified me not in the midst of the children of Israel.
bsb_text: For at the waters of Meribah-kadesh in the Wilderness of Zin, both of you broke faith with Me among the Israelites by failing to treat Me as holy in their presence.
aov_text: omdat julle onder die kinders van Israel ontrou teen My gehandel het by die twiswater van Kades, in die woestyn Sin, omdat julle My nie geheilig het onder die kinders van Israel nie.

kjv_text: Yet thou shalt see the land before thee; but thou shalt not go thither unto the land which I give the children of Israel.
bsb_text: Although you shall see from a distance the land that I am giving the Israelites, you shall not enter it.”
aov_text: Want reg voor sal jy die land sien, maar jy sal daar nie inkom, in die land wat Ek aan die kinders van Israel sal gee nie.

kjv_text: And this is the blessing, wherewith Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.
bsb_text: This is the blessing that Moses the man of God pronounced upon the Israelites before his death.
aov_text: EN dit is die seën waarmee Moses, die man van God, die kinders van Israel geseën het voor sy dood.

kjv_text: And he said, The LORD came from Sinai, and rose up from Seir unto them; he shined forth from mount Paran, and he came with ten thousands of saints: from his right hand went a fiery law for them.
bsb_text: He said: “The LORD came from Sinai and dawned upon us from Seir; He shone forth from Mount Paran and came with myriads of holy ones, with flaming fire at His right hand.
aov_text: En hy het gesê: Die HERE het gekom van Sinai en vir hulle opgegaan van Seïr af; Hy het in ligglans verskyn van die gebergte Paran en gekom van heilige tienduisende af; aan sy regterhand was vlammende vuur vir hulle.

kjv_text: Yea, he loved the people; all his saints are in thy hand: and they sat down at thy feet; every one shall receive of thy words.
bsb_text: Surely You love the people; all the holy ones are in Your hand, and they sit down at Your feet; each receives Your words—
aov_text: Ja, Hy het die stamme lief. Al sy heiliges—hulle is in u hand; en hulle was gelaer by u voet; elkeen ontvang iets van u uitsprake.

kjv_text: Moses commanded us a law, even the inheritance of the congregation of Jacob.
bsb_text: the law that Moses gave us, the possession of the assembly of Jacob.
aov_text: Moses het ons die wet beveel, ’n besitting vir die vergadering van Jakob.

kjv_text: And he was king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people and the tribes of Israel were gathered together.
bsb_text: So the LORD became King in Jeshurun when the leaders of the people gathered, when the tribes of Israel came together.
aov_text: En Hy het Koning geword in Jesúrun, toe die hoofde van die volk vergader het, die stamme van Israel almal saam.

kjv_text: Let Reuben live, and not die; and let not his men be few.
bsb_text: Let Reuben live and not die, nor his men be few.”
aov_text: Laat Ruben lewe en nie sterwe nie, en laat sy manne ’n aantal wees.

kjv_text: And this is the blessing of Judah: and he said, Hear, LORD, the voice of Judah, and bring him unto his people: let his hands be sufficient for him; and be thou an help to him from his enemies.
bsb_text: And concerning Judah he said: “O LORD, hear the cry of Judah and bring him to his people. With his own hands he defends his cause, but may You be a help against his foes.”
aov_text: En dít vir Juda, en hy het gesê: Hoor, HERE, die stem van Juda, en bring hom na sy volk toe; met sy hande het hy geveg vir hulle, en wees U vir hom ’n hulp teenoor sy teëstanders.

kjv_text: And of Levi he said, Let thy Thummim and thy Urim be with thy holy one, whom thou didst prove at Massah, and with whom thou didst strive at the waters of Meribah;
bsb_text: Concerning Levi he said: “Give Your Thummim to Levi and Your Urim to Your godly one, whom You tested at Massah and contested at the waters of Meribah.
aov_text: En van Levi het hy gesê: U Tummim en u Urim is vir die man, u gunsgenoot, wat deur U beproef is in Massa, met wie U getwis het by die waters van Mériba;

kjv_text: Who said unto his father and to his mother, I have not seen him; neither did he acknowledge his brethren, nor knew his own children: for they have observed thy word, and kept thy covenant.
bsb_text: He said of his father and mother, ‘I do not consider them.’ He disregarded his brothers and did not know his own sons, for he kept Your word and maintained Your covenant.
aov_text: wat van sy vader en sy moeder gesê het: Ek sien hom nie, en sy broers nie erken het en van sy seuns niks geweet het nie; want hulle het u woord bewaar en u verbond gehou.

kjv_text: They shall teach Jacob thy judgments, and Israel thy law: they shall put incense before thee, and whole burnt sacrifice upon thine altar.
bsb_text: He will teach Your ordinances to Jacob and Your law to Israel; he will set incense before You and whole burnt offerings on Your altar.
aov_text: Hulle sal Jakob u verordeninge leer en Israel u wet; hulle sal reukwerk voor U neerlê en ’n voloffer op u altaar.

kjv_text: Bless, LORD, his substance, and accept the work of his hands: smite through the loins of them that rise against him, and of them that hate him, that they rise not again.
bsb_text: Bless his substance, O LORD, and accept the work of his hands. Smash the loins of those who rise against him, and of his foes so they can rise no more.”
aov_text: Seën, HERE, sy krag, en laat die werk van sy hande U welgevallig wees; verpletter die lendene van die wat teen hom opstaan en hom haat, sodat hulle nie kan opstaan nie.

kjv_text: And of Benjamin he said, The beloved of the LORD shall dwell in safety by him; and the Lord shall cover him all the day long, and he shall dwell between his shoulders.
bsb_text: Concerning Benjamin he said: “May the beloved of the LORD rest secure in Him; God shields him all day long, and upon His shoulders he rests.”
aov_text: Van Benjamin het hy gesê: Die beminde van die HERE—hy sal veilig by Hom woon; Hy beskerm hom die hele dag en woon tussen sy berghange.

kjv_text: And of Joseph he said, Blessed of the LORD be his land, for the precious things of heaven, for the dew, and for the deep that coucheth beneath,
bsb_text: Concerning Joseph he said: “May his land be blessed by the LORD with the precious dew from heaven above and the deep waters that lie beneath,
aov_text: En van Josef het hy gesê: Geseënd deur die HERE is sy land met die kostelikste gawe van die hemel, met dou en met die wêreldvloed wat onder lê,

kjv_text: And for the precious fruits brought forth by the sun, and for the precious things put forth by the moon,
