aov_text: en oor die Vlakte tot by die Kínnerotsee, na die ooste toe, en tot by die See van die Vlakte, die Soutsee, oostelik in die rigting van Bet-Hajésimot en teen die suide onderaan die hange van Pisga;

kjv_text: And the coast of Og king of Bashan, which was of the remnant of the giants, that dwelt at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,
bsb_text: And Og king of Bashan, one of the remnant of the Rephaim, who lived in Ashtaroth and Edrei.
aov_text: en die grondgebied van Og, die koning van Basan, uit ’n oorblyfsel van die Refaïete, wat in Ástarot en Edréï gewoon het,

kjv_text: And reigned in mount Hermon, and in Salcah, and in all Bashan, unto the border of the Geshurites and the Maachathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.
bsb_text: He ruled over Mount Hermon, Salecah, all of Bashan up to the border of the Geshurites and Maacathites, and half of Gilead to the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.
aov_text: en wat geheers het oor die gebergte Hermon en oor Salka en oor die hele Basan tot by die grens van die Gesuriete en die Maägatiete, en tot die helfte van Gílead, die grondgebied van Sihon, die koning van Hesbon.

kjv_text: Them did Moses the servant of the LORD and the children of Israel smite: and Moses the servant of the LORD gave it for a possession unto the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh.
bsb_text: Moses, the servant of the LORD, and the Israelites had struck them down and given their land as an inheritance to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
aov_text: Moses, die kneg van die HERE, en die kinders van Israel het hulle verslaan; en Moses, die kneg van die HERE, het dit as ’n besitting gegee aan die Rubeniete en die Gadiete en die halwe stam van Manasse.

kjv_text: And these are the kings of the country which Joshua and the children of Israel smote on this side Jordan on the west, from Baalgad in the valley of Lebanon even unto the mount Halak, that goeth up to Seir; which Joshua gave unto the tribes of Israel for a possession according to their divisions;
bsb_text: And these are the kings of the land that Joshua and the Israelites conquered beyond the Jordan to the west, from Baal-gad in the Valley of Lebanon to Mount Halak, which rises toward Seir (according to the allotments to the tribes of Israel, Joshua gave them as an inheritance
aov_text: En dit is die konings van die land wat Josua en die kinders van Israel verslaan het, duskant die Jordaan na die weste toe: van Baäl-Gad in die laagte van die Líbanon af tot by die Kaal Berg wat oploop na Seïr toe; en Josua het dit as ’n besitting aan die stamme van Israel gegee volgens hulle afdelings —

kjv_text: In the mountains, and in the valleys, and in the plains, and in the springs, and in the wilderness, and in the south country; the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites:
bsb_text: the hill country, the foothills, the Arabah, the slopes, the wilderness, and the Negev—the lands of the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites):
aov_text: op die Gebergte en in die Laeveld en in die Vlakte en aan die hange en in die woestyn en in die Suidland: die Hetiete, Amoriete en Kanaäniete, die Feresiete, Hewiete en Jebusiete:

kjv_text: The king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is beside Bethel, one;
bsb_text: the king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is near Bethel, one;
aov_text: die koning van Jérigo, een; die koning van Ai wat langsaan Bet-el lê, een;

kjv_text: The king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;
bsb_text: the king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;
aov_text: die koning van Jerusalem, een; die koning van Hebron, een;

kjv_text: The king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;
bsb_text: the king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;
aov_text: die koning van Jarmut, een; die koning van Lagis, een;

kjv_text: The king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;
bsb_text: the king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;
aov_text: die koning van Eglon, een; die koning van Geser, een;

kjv_text: The king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;
bsb_text: the king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;
aov_text: die koning van Debir, een; die koning van Geder, een;

kjv_text: The king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;
bsb_text: the king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;
aov_text: die koning van Horma, een; die koning van Arad, een;

kjv_text: The king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;
bsb_text: the king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;
aov_text: die koning van Libna, een; die koning van Adúllam, een;

kjv_text: The king of Makkedah, one; the king of Bethel, one;
bsb_text: the king of Makkedah, one; the king of Bethel, one;
aov_text: die koning van Makkéda, een; die koning van Bet-el, een;

kjv_text: The king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;
bsb_text: the king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;
aov_text: die koning van Tappúag, een; die koning van Hefer, een;

kjv_text: The king of Aphek, one; the king of Lasharon, one;
bsb_text: the king of Aphek, one; the king of Lasharon, one;
aov_text: die koning van Afek, een; die koning van Lassáron, een;

kjv_text: The king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;
bsb_text: the king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;
aov_text: die koning van Madon, een; die koning van Hasor, een;

kjv_text: The king of Shimronmeron, one; the king of Achshaph, one;
bsb_text: the king of Shimron-meron, one; the king of Achshaph, one;
aov_text: die koning van Simron-Meron, een; die koning van Agsaf, een;

kjv_text: The king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;
bsb_text: the king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;
aov_text: die koning van Táänag, een; die koning van Megíddo, een;

kjv_text: The king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam of Carmel, one;
bsb_text: the king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam in Carmel, one;
aov_text: die koning van Kedes, een; die koning van Jókneam, by die Karmel, een;

kjv_text: The king of Dor in the coast of Dor, one; the king of the nations of Gilgal, one;
bsb_text: the king of Dor in Naphath-dor, one; the king of Goiim in Gilgal, one;
aov_text: die koning van Dor, op die hoëveld van Dor, een; die koning van die heidene by Gilgal, een;

kjv_text: The king of Tirzah, one: all the kings thirty and one.
bsb_text: and the king of Tirzah, one. So there were thirty-one kings in all.
aov_text: die koning van Tirsa, een—al die konings saam, een-en-dertig.

kjv_text: Now Joshua was old and stricken in years; and the LORD said unto him, Thou art old and stricken in years, and there remaineth yet very much land to be possessed.
bsb_text: Now Joshua was old and well along in years, and the LORD said to him, “You are old and well along in years, but very much of the land remains to be possessed.
aov_text: EN toe Josua oud en ver op sy dae was, het die HERE vir hom gesê: Jy is oud en ver op jou dae, en daar het nog ’n baie groot stuk land oorgebly om in besit te neem.

kjv_text: This is the land that yet remaineth: all the borders of the Philistines, and all Geshuri,
bsb_text: This is the land that remains: All the territory of the Philistines and the Geshurites,
aov_text: Dit is die land wat oorgebly het: Al die landstreke van die Filistyne en al die Gesuriete,

kjv_text: From Sihor, which is before Egypt, even unto the borders of Ekron northward, which is counted to the Canaanite: five lords of the Philistines; the Gazathites, and the Ashdothites, the Eshkalonites, the Gittites, and the Ekronites; also the Avites:
bsb_text: from the Shihor east of Egypt to the territory of Ekron on the north (considered to be Canaanite territory)—that of the five Philistine rulers of Gaza, Ashdod, Ashkelon, Gath, and Ekron, as well as that of the Avvites;
aov_text: van die Sihor aan die kant van Egipte af tot by die grens van Ekron na die noorde, wat as Kanaänities gereken word; die vyf vorste van die Filistyne: dié van Gasa en dié van Asdod, dié van Áskelon, dié van Gat en dié van Ekron, en die Awiete

kjv_text: From the south, all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah that is beside the Sidonians unto Aphek, to the borders of the Amorites:
bsb_text: to the south, all the land of the Canaanites, from Mearah of the Sidonians to Aphek, as far as the border of the Amorites;
aov_text: in die suide; die hele land van die Kanaäniete en Méara wat aan die Sidoniërs behoort, tot by Afek, tot by die grens van die Amoriete;

kjv_text: And the land of the Giblites, and all Lebanon, toward the sunrising, from Baalgad under mount Hermon unto the entering into Hamath.
bsb_text: the land of the Gebalites; and all Lebanon to the east, from Baal-gad below Mount Hermon to Lebo-hamath.
aov_text: en die land van die Gibliete en die hele Líbanon aan die oostekant, van Baäl-Gad af, onderaan die berg Hermon, tot by die ingang na Hamat.

kjv_text: All the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon unto Misrephothmaim, and all the Sidonians, them will I drive out from before the children of Israel: only divide thou it by lot unto the Israelites for an inheritance, as I have commanded thee.
bsb_text: All the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon to Misrephoth-maim—all the Sidonians—I Myself will drive out before the Israelites. Be sure to divide it by lot as an inheritance to Israel, as I have commanded you.
aov_text: Al die bewoners van die gebergte, van die Líbanon af tot by Mísrefot-Maim, al die Sidoniërs—Ek self sal hulle voor die kinders van Israel uit verdrywe; laat dit net as erfdeel aan Israel val soos Ek jou beveel het.

kjv_text: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance unto the nine tribes, and the half tribe of Manasseh,
bsb_text: Now therefore divide this land as an inheritance to the nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh.”
aov_text: Verdeel dan nou hierdie land as erfdeel onder die nege stamme en die halwe stam van Manasse.

kjv_text: With whom the Reubenites and the Gadites have received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond Jordan eastward, even as Moses the servant of the LORD gave them;
bsb_text: The other half of Manasseh, along with the Reubenites and Gadites, had received the inheritance Moses had given them beyond the Jordan to the east, just as Moses the servant of the LORD had assigned to them:
aov_text: Saam met hom het die Rubeniete en die Gadiete hulle erfdeel ontvang wat Moses oorkant die Jordaan na die ooste toe aan hulle gegee het, soos Moses, die kneg van die HERE, dit aan hulle gegee het:

kjv_text: From Aroer, that is upon the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the river, and all the plain of Medeba unto Dibon;
bsb_text: The area from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Valley, along with the city in the middle of the valley, the whole plateau of Medeba as far as Dibon,
aov_text: van Ároër af wat aan die kant van die Arnonrivier lê, die stad in die middel van die dal, en die hele gelykveld van Médeba af tot by Dibon;

kjv_text: And all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, which reigned in Heshbon, unto the border of the children of Ammon;
bsb_text: and all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites who reigned in Heshbon, as far as the border of the Ammonites;
aov_text: en al die stede van Sihon, die koning van die Amoriete wat in Hesbon geregeer het, tot by die grens van die kinders van Ammon;

kjv_text: And Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maachathites, and all mount Hermon, and all Bashan unto Salcah;
bsb_text: also Gilead and the territory of the Geshurites and Maacathites, all of Mount Hermon, and all Bashan as far as Salecah—
aov_text: en Gílead en die grondgebied van die Gesuriete en Maägatiete en die hele berg Hermon en die hele Basan tot by Salka;

kjv_text: All the kingdom of Og in Bashan, which reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei, who remained of the remnant of the giants: for these did Moses smite, and cast them out.
bsb_text: the whole kingdom of Og in Bashan, who had reigned in Ashtaroth and Edrei and had remained as a remnant of the Rephaim. Moses had struck them down and dispossessed them,
aov_text: die hele koninkryk van Og in Basan, wat koning was in Ástarot en in Edréï (hy het oorgebly uit die laastes van die Refaïete; en Moses het hulle verslaan en verdrywe).

kjv_text: Nevertheless the children of Israel expelled not the Geshurites, nor the Maachathites: but the Geshurites and the Maachathites dwell among the Israelites until this day.
bsb_text: but the Israelites did not drive out the Geshurites or the Maacathites. So Geshur and Maacath dwell among the Israelites to this day.
aov_text: Maar die kinders van Israel het die Gesuriete en Maägatiete nie verdrywe nie, sodat Gesur en Maägat onder Israel gewoon het tot vandag toe.

kjv_text: Only unto the tribe of Levi he gave none inheritance; the sacrifices of the LORD God of Israel made by fire are their inheritance, as he said unto them.
bsb_text: To the tribe of Levi, however, Moses had given no inheritance. The offerings made by fire to the LORD, the God of Israel, are their inheritance, just as He had promised them.
aov_text: Net aan die stam van Levi het hy geen erfdeel gegee nie: die vuuroffers van die HERE, die God van Israel, dit is sy erfdeel, soos Hy hom beloof het.

kjv_text: And Moses gave unto the tribe of the children of Reuben inheritance according to their families.
bsb_text: This is what Moses had given to the clans of the tribe of Reuben:
aov_text: En Moses het aan die stam van die kinders van Ruben gegee volgens hulle geslagte;

kjv_text: And their coast was from Aroer, that is on the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the river, and all the plain by Medeba;
bsb_text: The territory from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Valley, along with the city in the middle of the valley, to the whole plateau beyond Medeba,
aov_text: sodat hulle die grondgebied ontvang het: van Ároër af wat aan die kant van die Arnonrivier lê, die stad in die middel van die dal, en die hele gelykveld tot by Médeba;

kjv_text: Heshbon, and all her cities that are in the plain; Dibon, and Bamothbaal, and Bethbaalmeon,
bsb_text: to Heshbon and all its cities on the plateau, including Dibon, Bamoth-baal, Beth-baal-meon,
aov_text: Hesbon en al sy stede wat in die gelykveld lê, Dibon en Bamot-Baäl en Bet-Baäl-Meon

kjv_text: And Jahaza, and Kedemoth, and Mephaath,
bsb_text: Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath,
aov_text: en Jahas en Kedémot en Mefáät;

kjv_text: And Kirjathaim, and Sibmah, and Zarethshahar in the mount of the valley,
bsb_text: Kiriathaim, Sibmah, Zereth-shahar on the hill in the valley,
aov_text: en Kirjatáim en Sibma en Seret-Hassáhar, op die gebergte van die dal,

kjv_text: And Bethpeor, and Ashdothpisgah, and Bethjeshimoth,
bsb_text: Beth-peor, the slopes of Pisgah, and Beth-jeshimoth—
aov_text: en Bet-Peor en die hange van die Pisga en Bet-Hajésimot;

kjv_text: And all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, which reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses smote with the princes of Midian, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, which were dukes of Sihon, dwelling in the country.
bsb_text: all the cities of the plateau and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon until Moses killed him and the chiefs of Midian (Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba), the princes of Sihon who lived in the land.
aov_text: en al die stede van die gelykveld en die hele koninkryk van Sihon, die koning van die Amoriete wat in Hesbon geregeer het, wat Moses verslaan het saam met die vorste van Mídian: Ewi en Rekem en Sur en Hur en Reba, die vorste van Sihon, inwoners van die land.

kjv_text: Balaam also the son of Beor, the soothsayer, did the children of Israel slay with the sword among them that were slain by them.
bsb_text: The Israelites also killed the diviner Balaam son of Beor along with the others they put to the sword.
aov_text: By hulle dooies het die kinders van Israel ook Bíleam, die seun van Beor, die waarsêer, met die swaard gedood.

kjv_text: And the border of the children of Reuben was Jordan, and the border thereof. This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben after their families, the cities and the villages thereof.
bsb_text: And the border of the Reubenites was the bank of the Jordan. This was the inheritance of the clans of the Reubenites, including the cities and villages.
aov_text: So was dan die grens van die kinders van Ruben: die Jordaan saam met sy gebied; dit was die erfdeel van die kinders van Ruben volgens hulle geslagte, die stede met hulle dorpe.

kjv_text: And Moses gave inheritance unto the tribe of Gad, even unto the children of Gad according to their families.
bsb_text: This is what Moses had given to the clans of the tribe of Gad:
aov_text: En Moses het aan die stam van Gad, die kinders van Gad, gegee volgens hulle geslagte;

kjv_text: And their coast was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, unto Aroer that is before Rabbah;
bsb_text: The territory of Jazer, all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the Ammonites as far as Aroer, near Rabbah;
aov_text: sodat hulle die grondgebied ontvang het van Jaéser en al die stede van Gílead en die helfte van die land van die kinders van Ammon, tot by Ároër wat teenoor Rabba lê,

kjv_text: And from Heshbon unto Ramathmizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim unto the border of Debir;
bsb_text: the territory from Heshbon to Ramath-mizpeh and Betonim, and from Mahanaim to the border of Debir;
aov_text: van Hesbon af tot by Ramat-Mispe en Bétonim; en van Mahanáim af tot by die grens van Lídbir;

kjv_text: And in the valley, Betharam, and Bethnimrah, and Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, Jordan and his border, even unto the edge of the sea of Chinnereth on the other side Jordan eastward.
bsb_text: and in the valley, Beth-haram, Beth-nimrah, Succoth, and Zaphon, with the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon (the territory on the east side of the Jordan up to the edge of the Sea of Chinnereth).
aov_text: en in die dal: Bet-Haram en Bet-Nimra en Sukkot en Safon, die oorblyfsel van die koninkryk van Sihon, die koning van Hesbon, die Jordaan saam met sy gebied, tot by die uiteinde van die Kinnéretsee, oorkant die Jordaan na die ooste toe.

kjv_text: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad after their families, the cities, and their villages.
bsb_text: This was the inheritance of the clans of the Gadites, including the cities and villages.
aov_text: Dit is die erfdeel van die kinders van Gad volgens hulle geslagte, die stede met hulle dorpe.

kjv_text: And Moses gave inheritance unto the half tribe of Manasseh: and this was the possession of the half tribe of the children of Manasseh by their families.
bsb_text: This is what Moses had given to the clans of the half-tribe of Manasseh, that is, to half the tribe of the descendants of Manasseh:
aov_text: Verder het Moses aan die halwe stam van Manasse gegee; sodat die halwe stam van die kinders van Manasse ontvang het volgens hulle geslagte —

kjv_text: And their coast was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the towns of Jair, which are in Bashan, threescore cities:
bsb_text: The territory from Mahanaim through all Bashan—all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, including all the towns of Jair that are in Bashan, sixty cities;
aov_text: hulle grondgebied was: van Mahanáim af, die hele Basan, die hele koninkryk van Og, die koning van Basan, en al die Jaïrsdorpe in Basan, sestig stede;

kjv_text: And half Gilead, and Ashtaroth, and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were pertaining unto the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, even to the one half of the children of Machir by their families.
bsb_text: half of Gilead; and Ashtaroth and Edrei, the royal cities of Og in Bashan. All this was for the clans of the descendants of Machir son of Manasseh, that is, half of the descendants of Machir.
aov_text: en die halwe Gílead en Ástarot en Edréï, stede van die koninkryk van Og in Basan, aan die kinders van Magir, die seun van Manasse—aan die helfte van die kinders van Magir volgens hulle geslagte.

kjv_text: These are the countries which Moses did distribute for inheritance in the plains of Moab, on the other side Jordan, by Jericho, eastward.
bsb_text: These were the portions Moses had given them on the plains of Moab beyond the Jordan, east of Jericho.
aov_text: Dit is wat Moses as erfenis uitgedeel het in die vlaktes van Moab, oos van die Jordaan van Jérigo teen die ooste;

kjv_text: But unto the tribe of Levi Moses gave not any inheritance: the LORD God of Israel was their inheritance, as he said unto them.
bsb_text: To the tribe of Levi, however, Moses had given no inheritance. The LORD, the God of Israel, is their inheritance, just as He had promised them.
aov_text: maar aan die stam van Levi het Moses geen erfdeel gegee nie; die HERE, die God van Israel, is self hulle erfdeel, soos Hy hulle beloof het.

kjv_text: And these are the countries which the children of Israel inherited in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed for inheritance to them.
bsb_text: Now these are the portions that the Israelites inherited in the land of Canaan, as distributed by Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the heads of the families of the tribes of Israel.
aov_text: EN dit is wat die kinders van Israel as erfdeel in die land Kanaän ontvang het, wat Eleásar, die priester, en Josua, die seun van Nun, en die familiehoofde van die stamme van die kinders van Israel aan hulle as erfenis uitgedeel het

kjv_text: By lot was their inheritance, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses, for the nine tribes, and for the half tribe.
bsb_text: Their inheritance was assigned by lot for the nine and a half tribes, as the LORD had commanded through Moses.
aov_text: deur verloting van hulle erfdeel, soos die HERE deur die diens van Moses beveel het, met betrekking tot die nege en ’n halwe stam.

kjv_text: For Moses had given the inheritance of two tribes and an half tribe on the other side Jordan: but unto the Levites he gave none inheritance among them.
bsb_text: For Moses had given the inheritance east of the Jordan to the other two and a half tribes. But he granted no inheritance among them to the Levites.
aov_text: Want Moses het die erfdeel van die twee en ’n halwe stam oos van die Jordaan gegee, maar aan die Leviete het hy geen erfdeel onder hulle gegee nie.

kjv_text: For the children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim: therefore they gave no part unto the Levites in the land, save cities to dwell in, with their suburbs for their cattle and for their substance.
bsb_text: The descendants of Joseph became two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim. And no portion of the land was given to the Levites, except for cities in which to live, along with pasturelands for their flocks and herds.
aov_text: Want die kinders van Josef was twee stamme: Manasse en Efraim; maar aan die Leviete het hulle geen aandeel in die land gegee nie, behalwe stede om in te woon, met hulle weiveld vir hulle vee en hulle goed.

kjv_text: As the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did, and they divided the land.
bsb_text: So the Israelites did as the LORD had commanded Moses, and they divided the land.
aov_text: Soos die HERE Moses beveel het, so het die kinders van Israel gedoen en die land verdeel.

kjv_text: Then the children of Judah came unto Joshua in Gilgal: and Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite said unto him, Thou knowest the thing that the LORD said unto Moses the man of God concerning me and thee in Kadeshbarnea.
bsb_text: Then the sons of Judah approached Joshua at Gilgal, and Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him, “You know what the LORD said to Moses the man of God at Kadesh-barnea about you and me.
aov_text: Toe het die kinders van Juda nader gekom na Josua in Gilgal, en Kaleb, die seun van Jefúnne, die Kenissiet, het vir hom gesê: U weet die woord wat die HERE met Moses, die man van God, in Kades-Barnéa gespreek het met betrekking tot my en met betrekking tot u.

kjv_text: Forty years old was I when Moses the servant of the LORD sent me from Kadeshbarnea to espy out the land; and I brought him word again as it was in mine heart.
bsb_text: I was forty years old when Moses the servant of the LORD sent me from Kadesh-barnea to spy out the land, and I brought back to him an honest report.
aov_text: Veertig jaar was ek oud toe Moses, die kneg van die HERE, my uitgestuur het van Kades-Barnéa af om die land te verken, en ek het hom berig gebring soos dit in my hart was;

kjv_text: Nevertheless my brethren that went up with me made the heart of the people melt: but I wholly followed the LORD my God.
bsb_text: Although my brothers who went with me made the hearts of the people melt with fear, I remained loyal to the LORD my God.
aov_text: maar my broers wat saam met my opgetrek het, het die hart van die volk laat versmelt, terwyl ek volgehou het om die HERE my God te volg.

kjv_text: And Moses sware on that day, saying, Surely the land whereon thy feet have trodden shall be thine inheritance, and thy children's for ever, because thou hast wholly followed the LORD my God.
bsb_text: On that day Moses swore to me, saying, ‘Surely the land on which you have set foot will be an inheritance to you and your children forever, because you have wholly followed the LORD my God.’
aov_text: En dié dag het Moses gesweer en gesê: Waarlik, die land wat jou voet betree het, sal aan jou en aan jou kinders in ewigheid as ’n erfdeel behoort, omdat jy volgehou het om die HERE my God te volg.

kjv_text: And now, behold, the LORD hath kept me alive, as he said, these forty and five years, even since the LORD spake this word unto Moses, while the children of Israel wandered in the wilderness: and now, lo, I am this day fourscore and five years old.
bsb_text: Now behold, as the LORD promised, He has kept me alive these forty-five years since He spoke this word to Moses, while Israel wandered in the wilderness. So here I am today, eighty-five years old,
aov_text: En nou, kyk, die HERE het my laat lewe, soos Hy gespreek het, nou al vyf-en-veertig jaar sedert die HERE hierdie woord met Moses gespreek het toe Israel in die woestyn getrek het; en kyk nou, ek is vandag vyf-en-tagtig jaar oud;

kjv_text: As yet I am as strong this day as I was in the day that Moses sent me: as my strength was then, even so is my strength now, for war, both to go out, and to come in.
bsb_text: still as strong today as I was the day Moses sent me out. As my strength was then, so it is now for war, for going out, and for coming in.
aov_text: ek is vandag nog so sterk soos die dag toe Moses my uitgestuur het; soos my krag toe was, so is my krag nou nog, om te veg en om uit te gaan en in te gaan.

kjv_text: Now therefore give me this mountain, whereof the LORD spake in that day; for thou heardest in that day how the Anakims were there, and that the cities were great and fenced: if so be the LORD will be with me, then I shall be able to drive them out, as the LORD said.
bsb_text: Now therefore give me this hill country that the LORD promised me on that day, for you yourself heard then that the Anakim were there, with great and fortified cities. Perhaps with the LORD’s help I will drive them out, as the LORD has spoken.”
aov_text: Gee my dan nou hierdie bergland waarvan die HERE daardie dag gespreek het; want u self het dié dag gehoor dat dáár Enakiete is en groot versterkte stede; miskien sal die HERE met my wees, sodat ek hulle kan verdrywe, soos die HERE gespreek het.

kjv_text: And Joshua blessed him, and gave unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh Hebron for an inheritance.
bsb_text: Then Joshua blessed Caleb son of Jephunneh and gave him Hebron as his inheritance.
aov_text: Toe het Josua hom geseën en aan Kaleb, die seun van Jefúnne, Hebron as erfdeel gegee.

kjv_text: Hebron therefore became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite unto this day, because that he wholly followed the LORD God of Israel.
bsb_text: Therefore Hebron belongs to Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite as an inheritance to this day, because he wholly followed the LORD, the God of Israel.
aov_text: Daarom het Hebron die erfdeel geword van Kaleb, die seun van Jefúnne, die Kenissiet, tot vandag toe, omdat hy volgehou het om die HERE, die God van Israel, te volg.

kjv_text: And the name of Hebron before was Kirjatharba; which Arba was a great man among the Anakims. And the land had rest from war.
bsb_text: (Hebron used to be called Kiriath-arba, after Arba, the greatest man among the Anakim.) Then the land had rest from war.
aov_text: En die naam van Hebron was tevore stad van Arba; hy was die grootste man onder die Enakiete. En die land het gerus van oorlog.

kjv_text: This then was the lot of the tribe of the children of Judah by their families; even to the border of Edom the wilderness of Zin southward was the uttermost part of the south coast.
bsb_text: Now the allotment for the clans of the tribe of Judah extended to the border of Edom, to the Wilderness of Zin at the extreme southern boundary:
aov_text: EN vir die stam van die kinders van Juda, volgens hulle geslagte, het die lot geval: teen die grens van Edom, suidelik na die woestyn Sin toe, tot ver in die suide;

kjv_text: And their south border was from the shore of the salt sea, from the bay that looketh southward:
bsb_text: Their southern border started at the bay on the southern tip of the Salt Sea,
aov_text: en hulle suidelike lyn was van die end van die Soutsee, van die tong af wat na die suide toe uitsteek;

kjv_text: And it went out to the south side to Maalehacrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and ascended up on the south side unto Kadeshbarnea, and passed along to Hezron, and went up to Adar, and fetched a compass to Karkaa:
bsb_text: proceeded south of the Ascent of Akrabbim, continued on to Zin, went over to the south of Kadesh-barnea, ran past Hezron up to Addar, and curved toward Karka.
aov_text: en dit loop aan suid van Skerpioennek en loop oor na Sin en loop op suid van Kades-Barnéa en loop oor na Hesron en loop op na Addar en swaai na Karka toe;

kjv_text: From thence it passed toward Azmon, and went out unto the river of Egypt; and the goings out of that coast were at the sea: this shall be your south coast.
bsb_text: It proceeded to Azmon, joined the Brook of Egypt, and ended at the Sea. This was their southern border.
aov_text: dan loop dit oor na Asmon en loop aan na die spruit van Egipte, sodat die lyn doodloop by die see; dit sal julle suidelike lyn wees.

kjv_text: And the east border was the salt sea, even unto the end of Jordan. And their border in the north quarter was from the bay of the sea at the uttermost part of Jordan:
bsb_text: The eastern border was the Salt Sea as far as the mouth of the Jordan. The northern border started from the bay of the sea at the mouth of the Jordan,
aov_text: En die oostelike lyn: Die Soutsee tot by die mond van die Jordaan. En die lyn aan die noordekant: Van die tong van die see, van die mond van die Jordaan af

kjv_text: And the border went up to Bethhogla, and passed along by the north of Betharabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben:
bsb_text: went up to Beth-hoglah, proceeded north of Beth-arabah, and went up to the Stone of Bohan son of Reuben.
aov_text: loop die lyn op na Bet-Hogla en loop oor noord van Bet-Áraba; dan loop die lyn op na die klip van Bohan, die seun van Ruben.

kjv_text: And the border went up toward Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, that is before the going up to Adummim, which is on the south side of the river: and the border passed toward the waters of Enshemesh, and the goings out thereof were at Enrogel:
bsb_text: Then the border went up to Debir from the Valley of Achor, turning north to Gilgal, which faces the Ascent of Adummim south of the ravine. It continued along the waters of En-shemesh and came out at En-rogel.
aov_text: Verder loop die lyn op na Debir, van die dal Agor af, en swaai dan noord na Gilgal wat teenoor die hoogte van Adúmmim, suidelik van die spruit lê; dan loop die lyn oor na die waters van die fontein Semes, sodat dit doodloop by die fontein Rogel.

kjv_text: And the border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom unto the south side of the Jebusite; the same is Jerusalem: and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lieth before the valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the end of the valley of the giants northward:
bsb_text: From there the border went up the Valley of Hinnom along the southern slope of the Jebusites (that is, Jerusalem) and ascended to the top of the hill that faces the Valley of Hinnom on the west, at the northern end of the Valley of Rephaim.
aov_text: Verder loop die lyn op na die dal Ben-Hinnom, na die suidelike hang van die Jebusiete, dit is Jerusalem; dan loop die lyn op na die top van die gebergte wat westelik voor die dal Hinnom lê, wat aan die noordelike einde van die dal Refaim is.

kjv_text: And the border was drawn from the top of the hill unto the fountain of the water of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of mount Ephron; and the border was drawn to Baalah, which is Kirjathjearim:
bsb_text: From the hilltop the border curved to the spring of the Waters of Nephtoah, proceeded to the cities of Mount Ephron, and then bent around toward Baalah (that is, Kiriath-jearim).
aov_text: Van die top van die berg af buig die lyn dan om na die fontein van die waters van Neftóag en loop aan na die stede van die gebergte Efron; verder buig die lyn om na Báäla, dit is Kirjat-Jeárim.

kjv_text: And the border compassed from Baalah westward unto mount Seir, and passed along unto the side of mount Jearim, which is Chesalon, on the north side, and went down to Bethshemesh, and passed on to Timnah:
bsb_text: The border curled westward from Baalah to Mount Seir, ran along the northern slope of Mount Jearim (that is, Chesalon), went down to Beth-shemesh, and crossed to Timnah.
aov_text: Dan swaai die lyn van Báäla af weg in westelike rigting na die gebergte Seïr en loop oor na die noordelike hang van die berg Jeárim, dit is Késalon, en loop af na Bet-Semes en loop oor na Timna.

kjv_text: And the border went out unto the side of Ekron northward: and the border was drawn to Shicron, and passed along to mount Baalah, and went out unto Jabneel; and the goings out of the border were at the sea.
bsb_text: Then it went out to the northern slope of Ekron, curved toward Shikkeron, proceeded to Mount Baalah, went on to Jabneel, and ended at the Sea.
aov_text: Verder loop die lyn aan noord na die hang van Ekron; dan buig die lyn om na Sikron en loop oor die berg Báäla en loop aan na Jábneël, sodat die lyn doodloop by die see.

kjv_text: And the west border was to the great sea, and the coast thereof. This is the coast of the children of Judah round about according to their families.
bsb_text: And the western border was the coastline of the Great Sea. These are the boundaries around the clans of the descendants of Judah.
aov_text: Die westelike grens was die Groot See saam met sy gebied; dit is die lyn rondom van die kinders van Juda volgens hulle geslagte.

kjv_text: And unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh he gave a part among the children of Judah, according to the commandment of the LORD to Joshua, even the city of Arba the father of Anak, which city is Hebron.
bsb_text: According to the LORD’s command to him, Joshua gave Caleb son of Jephunneh a portion among the sons of Judah—Kiriath-arba, that is, Hebron. (Arba was the forefather of Anak.)
aov_text: Maar aan Kaleb, die seun van Jefúnne, het hy ’n aandeel onder die kinders van Juda gegee, volgens die bevel van die HERE aan Josua: die stad van Arba, die vader van Enak, dit is Hebron.

kjv_text: And Caleb drove thence the three sons of Anak, Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.
bsb_text: And Caleb drove out from there the three sons of Anak—the descendants of Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.
aov_text: En Kaleb het die drie seuns van Enak: Sesai, Ahíman en Talmai, afstammelinge van Enak, daaruit verdrywe.

kjv_text: And he went up thence to the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before was Kirjathsepher.
bsb_text: From there he marched against the inhabitants of Debir (formerly known as Kiriath-sepher).
aov_text: En daarvandaan het hy opgetrek teen die inwoners van Debir; maar die naam van Debir was tevore Kirjat-Sefer;

kjv_text: And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kirjathsepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.
bsb_text: And Caleb said, “To the man who strikes down Kiriath-sepher and captures it, I will give my daughter Acsah in marriage.”
aov_text: en Kaleb het gesê: Hy wat Kirjat-Sefer verslaan en dit inneem, aan hom sal ek my dogter Agsa as vrou gee.

kjv_text: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.
bsb_text: So Othniel son of Caleb’s brother Kenaz captured the city, and Caleb gave his daughter Acsah to him in marriage.
aov_text: Daarop het Otniël, die seun van Kenas, die broer van Kaleb, dit ingeneem; en hy het sy dogter Agsa aan hom as vrou gegee.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, as she came unto him, that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she lighted off her ass; and Caleb said unto her, What wouldest thou?
bsb_text: One day Acsah came to Othniel and urged him to ask her father for a field. When she got off her donkey, Caleb asked her, “What do you desire?”
aov_text: En toe sy aankom, het sy hom aangespoor om van haar vader ’n stuk grond te vra; en toe sy van die esel afklim, sê Kaleb vir haar: Wat wil jy hê?

kjv_text: Who answered, Give me a blessing; for thou hast given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And he gave her the upper springs, and the nether springs.
bsb_text: “Give me a blessing,” she answered. “Since you have given me land in the Negev, give me springs of water as well.” So Caleb gave her both the upper and lower springs.
aov_text: En sy sê: Gee my tog ’n geskenk; omdat u my na ’n dor land versit het, moet u my waterfonteine gee. Toe gee hy haar fonteine op die hoogte en fonteine in die laagte.

kjv_text: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families.
bsb_text: This is the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Judah.
aov_text: Dit is die erfdeel van die stam van die kinders van Juda, volgens hulle geslagte.

kjv_text: And the uttermost cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the coast of Edom southward were Kabzeel, and Eder, and Jagur,
bsb_text: These were the southernmost cities of the tribe of Judah in the Negev toward the border of Edom: Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,
aov_text: En die stede van die uiteinde van die stam van Juda se kinders af tot by die grens van Edom was in die suide: Kábseël en Eder en Jagur,

kjv_text: And Kinah, and Dimonah, and Adadah,
bsb_text: Kinah, Dimonah, Adadah,
aov_text: en Kina en Dimóna en Adáda,

kjv_text: And Kedesh, and Hazor, and Ithnan,
bsb_text: Kedesh, Hazor, Ithnan,
aov_text: en Kedes en Hasor en Jitnan,

kjv_text: Ziph, and Telem, and Bealoth,
bsb_text: Ziph, Telem, Bealoth,
aov_text: Sif en Telem en Béalot,

kjv_text: And Hazor, Hadattah, and Kerioth, and Hezron, which is Hazor,
bsb_text: Hazor-hadattah, Kerioth-hezron (that is, Hazor),
aov_text: en Hasor-Hadátta en Kériot-Hesron, dit is Hasor;

kjv_text: Amam, and Shema, and Moladah,
bsb_text: Amam, Shema, Moladah,
aov_text: Amam en Sema en Mólada,

kjv_text: And Hazargaddah, and Heshmon, and Bethpalet,
bsb_text: Hazar-gaddah, Heshmon, Beth-pelet,
aov_text: en Hasar-Gadda en Hesmon en Bet-Palet,

kjv_text: And Hazarshual, and Beersheba, and Bizjothjah,
bsb_text: Hazar-shual, Beersheba, Biziothiah,
aov_text: en Hasar-Sual en Beër-Seba en Bisjótja,

kjv_text: Baalah, and Iim, and Azem,
bsb_text: Baalah, Iim, Ezem,
aov_text: Báäla en Ijjim en Esem,

kjv_text: And Eltolad, and Chesil, and Hormah,
bsb_text: Eltolad, Chesil, Hormah,
aov_text: en Éltolad en Kesil en Horma,

kjv_text: And Ziklag, and Madmannah, and Sansannah,
bsb_text: Ziklag, Madmannah, Sansannah,
aov_text: en Siklag en Madmánna en Sansánna,

kjv_text: And Lebaoth, and Shilhim, and Ain, and Rimmon: all the cities are twenty and nine, with their villages:
bsb_text: Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain, and Rimmon—twenty-nine cities in all, along with their villages.
aov_text: en Lebáot en Silhim en Ajin en Rimmon; al die stede saam negen-en-twintig, met hulle dorpe;

kjv_text: And in the valley, Eshtaol, and Zoreah, and Ashnah,
bsb_text: These were in the foothills: Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah,
aov_text: in die Laeveld: Estáol en Sórea en Asna,

kjv_text: And Zanoah, and Engannim, Tappuah, and Enam,
bsb_text: Zanoah, En-gannim, Tappuah, Enam,
aov_text: en Sanóag en En-Gannim, Tappúag en Enam,

kjv_text: Jarmuth, and Adullam, Socoh, and Azekah,
bsb_text: Jarmuth, Adullam, Socoh, Azekah,
aov_text: Jarmut en Adúllam, Sogo en Aséka,

kjv_text: And Sharaim, and Adithaim, and Gederah, and Gederothaim; fourteen cities with their villages:
bsb_text: Shaaraim, Adithaim, and Gederah (or Gederothaim)—fourteen cities, along with their villages.
aov_text: en Saäráim en Adítaim en Gedéra en Gedérotaim: veertien stede met hulle dorpe;

kjv_text: Zenan, and Hadashah, and Migdalgad,
bsb_text: Zenan, Hadashah, Migdal-gad,
aov_text: Senan en Hadása en Migdal-Gad,

kjv_text: And Dilean, and Mizpeh, and Joktheel,
bsb_text: Dilan, Mizpeh, Joktheel,
aov_text: en Dilean en Mispe en Jókteël,

kjv_text: Lachish, and Bozkath, and Eglon,
bsb_text: Lachish, Bozkath, Eglon,
aov_text: Lagis en Boskat en Eglon,

kjv_text: And Cabbon, and Lahmam, and Kithlish,
bsb_text: Cabbon, Lahmas, Chitlish,
aov_text: en Kabbon en Lagmas en Kitlis,

kjv_text: And Gederoth, Bethdagon, and Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages:
bsb_text: Gederoth, Beth-dagon, Naamah, and Makkedah—sixteen cities, along with their villages.
aov_text: en Gedérot, Bet-Dagon en Náäma en Makkéda: sestien stede met hulle dorpe;

kjv_text: Libnah, and Ether, and Ashan,
bsb_text: Libnah, Ether, Ashan,
aov_text: Libna en Eter en Asan,

kjv_text: And Jiphtah, and Ashnah, and Nezib,
bsb_text: Iphtah, Ashnah, Nezib,
aov_text: en Jiftag en Asna en Nesib,

kjv_text: And Keilah, and Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities with their villages:
bsb_text: Keilah, Achzib, and Mareshah—nine cities, along with their villages.
aov_text: en Kehíla en Agsib en Marésa: nege stede met hulle dorpe;

kjv_text: Ekron, with her towns and her villages:
bsb_text: Ekron, with its towns and villages;
aov_text: Ekron met sy onderhorige plekke en sy dorpe;

kjv_text: From Ekron even unto the sea, all that lay near Ashdod, with their villages:
bsb_text: from Ekron to the sea, all the cities near Ashdod, along with their villages;
aov_text: van Ekron af en na die weste toe, alles wat aan die kant van Asdod lê, met hulle dorpe;

kjv_text: Ashdod with her towns and her villages, Gaza with her towns and her villages, unto the river of Egypt, and the great sea, and the border thereof:
bsb_text: Ashdod, with its towns and villages; Gaza, with its towns and villages, as far as the Brook of Egypt and the coastline of the Great Sea.
aov_text: Asdod, sy onderhorige plekke en sy dorpe; Gasa, sy onderhorige plekke en sy dorpe, tot by die spruit van Egipte en die Groot See saam met sy gebied;

kjv_text: And in the mountains, Shamir, and Jattir, and Socoh,
bsb_text: These were in the hill country: Shamir, Jattir, Socoh,
aov_text: en op die Gebergte: Samir en Jattir en Sogo,

kjv_text: And Dannah, and Kirjathsannah, which is Debir,
bsb_text: Dannah, Kiriath-sannah (that is, Debir),
aov_text: en Danna en Kirjat-Sanna, dit is Debir,

kjv_text: And Anab, and Eshtemoh, and Anim,
bsb_text: Anab, Eshtemoh, Anim,
aov_text: en Anab en Estémo en Anim,

kjv_text: And Goshen, and Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities with their villages:
bsb_text: Goshen, Holon, and Giloh—eleven cities, along with their villages.
aov_text: en Gosen en Holon en Gilo: elf stede met hulle dorpe;

kjv_text: Arab, and Dumah, and Eshean,
bsb_text: Arab, Dumah, Eshan,
aov_text: Arab en Duma en Esean,

kjv_text: And Janum, and Bethtappuah, and Aphekah,
bsb_text: Janim, Beth-tappuah, Aphekah,
aov_text: en Janum en Bet-Tappúag en Aféka,

kjv_text: And Humtah, and Kirjatharba, which is Hebron, and Zior; nine cities with their villages:
bsb_text: Humtah, Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron), and Zior—nine cities, along with their villages.
aov_text: en Humta en Kirjat-Arba, dit is Hebron, en Sior: nege stede met hulle dorpe;

kjv_text: Maon, Carmel, and Ziph, and Juttah,
bsb_text: Maon, Carmel, Ziph, Juttah,
aov_text: Maon, Karmel en Sif en Jutta,

kjv_text: And Jezreel, and Jokdeam, and Zanoah,
bsb_text: Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoah,
aov_text: en Jísreël en Jókdeam en Sanóag,

kjv_text: Cain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities with their villages:
bsb_text: Kain, Gibeah, and Timnah—ten cities, along with their villages.
aov_text: Kain, Gíbea en Timna: tien stede met hulle dorpe;

kjv_text: Halhul, Bethzur, and Gedor,
bsb_text: Halhul, Beth-zur, Gedor,
aov_text: Halhul, Bet-Sur en Gedor,

kjv_text: And Maarath, and Bethanoth, and Eltekon; six cities with their villages:
bsb_text: Maarath, Beth-anoth, and Eltekon—six cities, along with their villages.
aov_text: en Máärat en Bet-Anot en Éltekon: ses stede met hulle dorpe;

kjv_text: Kirjathbaal, which is Kirjathjearim, and Rabbah; two cities with their villages:
bsb_text: Kiriath-baal (that is, Kiriath-jearim), and Rabbah—two cities, along with their villages.
aov_text: Kirjat-Baäl, dit is Kirjat-Jeárim, en Rabba: twee stede met hulle dorpe;

kjv_text: In the wilderness, Betharabah, Middin, and Secacah,
bsb_text: These were in the wilderness: Beth-arabah, Middin, Secacah,
aov_text: in die woestyn: Bet-Áraba, Middin en Segága,

kjv_text: And Nibshan, and the city of Salt, and Engedi; six cities with their villages.
bsb_text: Nibshan, the City of Salt, and En-gedi—six cities, along with their villages.
aov_text: en Nibsan en die Soutstad en Éngedi: ses stede met hulle dorpe.

kjv_text: As for the Jebusites the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah could not drive them out: but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Judah at Jerusalem unto this day.
bsb_text: But the descendants of Judah could not drive out the Jebusites living in Jerusalem. So to this day the Jebusites live there among the descendants of Judah.
aov_text: Maar die kinders van Juda kon die Jebusiete, die inwoners van Jerusalem, nie verdryf nie; daarom het die Jebusiete saam met die kinders van Juda in Jerusalem bly woon tot vandag toe.

kjv_text: And the lot of the children of Joseph fell from Jordan by Jericho, unto the water of Jericho on the east, to the wilderness that goeth up from Jericho throughout mount Bethel,
bsb_text: The allotment for the descendants of Joseph extended from the Jordan at Jericho to the waters of Jericho on the east, through the wilderness that goes up from Jericho into the hill country of Bethel.
aov_text: EN die lot het uitgekom vir die kinders van Josef: van die Jordaan van Jérigo af, oostelik van die waters van Jérigo, na die woestyn wat van Jérigo af oploop in die gebergte, na Bet-el;

kjv_text: And goeth out from Bethel to Luz, and passeth along unto the borders of Archi to Ataroth,
bsb_text: It went on from Bethel (that is, Luz) and proceeded to the border of the Archites in Ataroth.
aov_text: verder loop dit van Bet-el af aan na Lus en loop oor na die grondgebied van die Arkiete, na Átarot;

kjv_text: And goeth down westward to the coast of Japhleti, unto the coast of Bethhoron the nether, and to Gezer; and the goings out thereof are at the sea.
bsb_text: Then it descended westward to the border of the Japhletites as far as the border of Lower Beth-horon and on to Gezer, and it ended at the Sea.
aov_text: dan loop dit af in die weste na die grondgebied van die Jafletiete, tot by die gebied van Bet-Horon-Onder en tot by Geser, sodat dit doodloop by die see.

kjv_text: So the children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.
bsb_text: So Ephraim and Manasseh, the sons of Joseph, received their inheritance.
aov_text: So het dan die seuns van Josef, Manasse en Efraim, ’n erfdeel ontvang.

kjv_text: And the border of the children of Ephraim according to their families was thus: even the border of their inheritance on the east side was Atarothaddar, unto Bethhoron the upper;
bsb_text: This was the territory of the descendants of Ephraim by their clans: The border of their inheritance went from Ataroth-addar in the east to Upper Beth-horon
aov_text: En dit was die grondgebied van die kinders van Efraim volgens hulle geslagte—die lyn van hulle erfdeel was, in die ooste: Atrot-Addar tot by Bet-Horon-Bo;

kjv_text: And the border went out toward the sea to Michmethah on the north side; and the border went about eastward unto Taanathshiloh, and passed by it on the east to Janohah;
bsb_text: and out toward the Sea. From Michmethath on the north it turned eastward toward Taanath-shiloh and passed by it to Janoah on the east.
aov_text: dan loop die lyn aan na die see; in die noorde: Mígmetat; dan swaai die lyn in oostelike rigting na Táänat-Silo en loop oos daarvan oor na Janóag;

kjv_text: And it went down from Janohah to Ataroth, and to Naarath, and came to Jericho, and went out at Jordan.
bsb_text: From Janoah it went down to Ataroth and Naarah, and then reached Jericho and came out at the Jordan.
aov_text: en van Janóag loop dit af na Átarot en Náharat en raak dan aan Jérigo en loop op die Jordaan uit.

kjv_text: The border went out from Tappuah westward unto the river Kanah; and the goings out thereof were at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim by their families.
bsb_text: From Tappuah the border went westward to the Brook of Kanah and ended at the Sea. This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Ephraim,
aov_text: Van Tappúag af loop die lyn in westelike rigting na die spruit Kana; verder loop dit dood by die see. Dit is die erfdeel van die stam van die kinders van Efraim volgens hulle geslagte;

kjv_text: And the separate cities for the children of Ephraim were among the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.
bsb_text: along with all the cities and villages set apart for the descendants of Ephraim within the inheritance of Manasseh.
aov_text: en die stede wat vir die kinders van Efraim afgesonder was in die erfdeel van die kinders van Manasse, al die stede met hulle dorpe.

kjv_text: And they drave not out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer: but the Canaanites dwell among the Ephraimites unto this day, and serve under tribute.
bsb_text: But they did not drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer. So the Canaanites dwell among the Ephraimites to this day, but they are forced laborers.
aov_text: Maar hulle het die Kanaäniete, die inwoners van Geser, nie verdrywe nie; so het dan die Kanaäniete onder Efraim bly woon tot vandag toe; maar hulle moes dwangarbeid verrig.

kjv_text: There was also a lot for the tribe of Manasseh; for he was the firstborn of Joseph; to wit, for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead: because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.
bsb_text: Now this was the allotment for the tribe of Manasseh as Joseph’s firstborn son, namely for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh and father of the Gileadites, who had received Gilead and Bashan because Machir was a man of war.
aov_text: VERDER was dít die lot vir die stam van Manasse, omdat hy die eersgeborene van Josef was: Magir, die eersgeborene van Manasse, die vader van Gílead, het, omdat hy ’n krygsman was, Gílead en Basan ontvang;

kjv_text: There was also a lot for the rest of the children of Manasseh by their families; for the children of Abiezer, and for the children of Helek, and for the children of Asriel, and for the children of Shechem, and for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida: these were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph by their families.
bsb_text: So this allotment was for the rest of the descendants of Manasseh—the clans of Abiezer, Helek, Asriel, Shechem, Hepher, and Shemida. These are the other male descendants of the clans of Manasseh son of Joseph.
aov_text: ook die ander kinders van Manasse, volgens hulle geslagte, het ’n aandeel ontvang: die kinders van Abiëser en die kinders van Helek en die kinders van Ásriël en die kinders van Segem en die kinders van Hefer en die kinders van Semída; dit is die manlike kinders van Manasse, die seun van Josef, volgens hulle geslagte.

kjv_text: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters: and these are the names of his daughters, Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
bsb_text: But Zelophehad son of Hepher (the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh) had no sons but only daughters. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
aov_text: Maar Selófhad, die seun van Hefer, die seun van Gílead, die seun van Magir, die seun van Manasse, het nie seuns gehad nie, maar net dogters; en dit is die name van sy dogters: Magla en Noa, Hogla, Milka en Tirsa;

kjv_text: And they came near before Eleazar the priest, and before Joshua the son of Nun, and before the princes, saying, The LORD commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brethren. Therefore according to the commandment of the LORD he gave them an inheritance among the brethren of their father.
bsb_text: They approached Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the leaders, and said, “The LORD commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brothers.” So Joshua gave them an inheritance among their father’s brothers, in keeping with the command of the LORD.
aov_text: en hulle het nader gekom voor Eleásar, die priester, en voor Josua, die seun van Nun, en voor die owerstes, en gesê: Die HERE het Moses beveel om ons ’n erfdeel te gee onder ons broers. Daarop het hy hulle ’n erfdeel gegee, volgens die bevel van die HERE, onder die broers van hulle vader.

kjv_text: And there fell ten portions to Manasseh, beside the land of Gilead and Bashan, which were on the other side Jordan;
bsb_text: Thus ten shares fell to Manasseh, in addition to the land of Gilead and Bashan beyond the Jordan,
aov_text: So het dan aan Manasse tien aandele geval, behalwe die land Gílead en Basan wat oorkant die Jordaan lê.

kjv_text: Because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons: and the rest of Manasseh's sons had the land of Gilead.
bsb_text: because the daughters of Manasseh received an inheritance among his sons. And the land of Gilead belonged to the rest of the sons of Manasseh.
aov_text: Want die dogters van Manasse het ’n erfdeel ontvang onder sy seuns, terwyl die land Gílead aan die ander kinders van Manasse behoort het.

kjv_text: And the coast of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethah, that lieth before Shechem; and the border went along on the right hand unto the inhabitants of Entappuah.
bsb_text: Now the border of Manasseh went from Asher to Michmethath near Shechem, then southward to include the inhabitants of En-tappuah.
aov_text: En die lyn van Manasse was: van Aser af na Mígmetat, teenoor Sigem; dan loop die lyn regs na die inwoners van En-Tappúag —

kjv_text: Now Manasseh had the land of Tappuah: but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim;
bsb_text: The region of Tappuah belonged to Manasseh, but Tappuah itself, on the border of Manasseh, belonged to Ephraim.
aov_text: die landstreek van Tappúag het behoort aan Manasse, maar Tappúag, aan die grens van Manasse, aan die kinders van Efraim ö;

kjv_text: And the coast descended unto the river Kanah, southward of the river: these cities of Ephraim are among the cities of Manasseh: the coast of Manasseh also was on the north side of the river, and the outgoings of it were at the sea:
bsb_text: From there the border continued southward to the Brook of Kanah. There were cities belonging to Ephraim among the cities of Manasseh, but the border of Manasseh was on the north side of the brook and ended at the Sea.
aov_text: verder loop die lyn af na die spruit Kana, suid van die spruit: daardie stede, onder die stede van Manasse, behoort aan Efraim; en die lyn van Manasse is noord van die spruit en loop dood by die see.

kjv_text: Southward it was Ephraim's, and northward it was Manasseh's, and the sea is his border; and they met together in Asher on the north, and in Issachar on the east.
bsb_text: Ephraim’s territory was to the south, and Manasseh’s was to the north, having the Sea as its border and adjoining Asher on the north and Issachar on the east.
aov_text: Suid behoort dit aan Efraim, maar noord aan Manasse; en die see is sy lyn; dan raak hulle in die noorde aan Aser en in die ooste aan Íssaskar.

kjv_text: And Manasseh had in Issachar and in Asher Bethshean and her towns, and Ibleam and her towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and her towns, and the inhabitants of Endor and her towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and her towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns, even three countries.
bsb_text: Within Issachar and Asher, Manasseh was assigned Beth-shean, Ibleam, Dor (that is, Naphath), Endor, Taanach, and Megiddo, each with their surrounding settlements.
aov_text: En aan Manasse behoort in Íssaskar en Aser: Bet-Sean met sy onderhorige plekke en Jíbleam met sy onderhorige plekke en die inwoners van Dor met sy onderhorige plekke en die inwoners van En-Dor met sy onderhorige plekke en die inwoners van Táänag met sy onderhorige plekke en die inwoners van Megíddo met sy onderhorige plekke, die drie hoogtes.

kjv_text: Yet the children of Manasseh could not drive out the inhabitants of those cities; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.
bsb_text: But the descendants of Manasseh were unable to occupy these cities, because the Canaanites were determined to stay in this land.
aov_text: Maar die kinders van Manasse kon hierdie stede nie in besit neem nie, en die Kanaäniete het verkies om in dié land te bly woon.

kjv_text: Yet it came to pass, when the children of Israel were waxen strong, that they put the Canaanites to tribute, but did not utterly drive them out.
bsb_text: However, when the Israelites grew stronger, they put the Canaanites to forced labor; but they failed to drive them out completely.
aov_text: En toe die kinders van Israel sterker geword het, het hulle die Kanaäniete dienspligtig gemaak, maar hulle nie geheel en al verdrywe nie.

kjv_text: And the children of Joseph spake unto Joshua, saying, Why hast thou given me but one lot and one portion to inherit, seeing I am a great people, forasmuch as the LORD hath blessed me hitherto?
bsb_text: Then the sons of Joseph said to Joshua, “Why have you given us only one portion as an inheritance? We have many people, because the LORD has blessed us abundantly.”
aov_text: Toe het die kinders van Josef met Josua gespreek en gesê: Waarom het u my as erfdeel net een lot en een aandeel gegee terwyl ek tog ’n groot volk is, omdat die HERE my tot hiertoe geseën het?

kjv_text: And Joshua answered them, If thou be a great people, then get thee up to the wood country, and cut down for thyself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the giants, if mount Ephraim be too narrow for thee.
bsb_text: Joshua answered them, “If you have so many people that the hill country of Ephraim is too small for you, go to the forest and clear for yourself an area in the land of the Perizzites and the Rephaim.”
aov_text: En Josua het vir hulle gesê: As jy ’n groot volk is, trek dan op na die boswêreld en kap vir jou daar ’n plek skoon in die land van die Feresiete en Refaïete, ingeval die gebergte van Efraim vir jou te nou is.

kjv_text: And the children of Joseph said, The hill is not enough for us: and all the Canaanites that dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, both they who are of Bethshean and her towns, and they who are of the valley of Jezreel.
bsb_text: “The hill country is not enough for us,” they replied, “and all the Canaanites who live in the valley have iron chariots, both in Beth-shean with its towns and in the Valley of Jezreel.”
aov_text: Maar die kinders van Josef het gesê: Die gebergte sal nie vir ons genoeg wees nie, en al die Kanaäniete wat in die lae streke woon, het ysterwaens, dié van Bet-Sean met sy onderhorige plekke sowel as dié van die laagte van Jísreël.

kjv_text: And Joshua spake unto the house of Joseph, even to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying, Thou art a great people, and hast great power: thou shalt not have one lot only:
bsb_text: So Joshua said to the house of Joseph—to Ephraim and Manasseh—“You have many people and great strength. You shall not have just one allotment,
aov_text: Toe het Josua met die huis van Josef, met Efraim en Manasse gespreek en gesê: Jy is ’n groot volk en jy het groot krag: jy sal nie net een lot hê nie;

kjv_text: But the mountain shall be thine; for it is a wood, and thou shalt cut it down: and the outgoings of it shall be thine: for thou shalt drive out the Canaanites, though they have iron chariots, and though they be strong.
bsb_text: because the hill country will be yours as well. It is a forest; clear it, and its farthest limits will be yours. Although the Canaanites have iron chariots and although they are strong, you can drive them out.”
aov_text: want die gebergte sal joue wees—’n boswêreld is dit naamlik, en jy moet dit skoonkap; dan sal die uitlopers daarvan joue wees; want jy moet die Kanaäniet verdrywe, al het hy ysterwaens, al is hy sterk.

kjv_text: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled together at Shiloh, and set up the tabernacle of the congregation there. And the land was subdued before them.
bsb_text: Then the whole congregation of Israel assembled at Shiloh and set up the Tent of Meeting there. And though the land was subdued before them,
aov_text: DAAROP het die hele vergadering van die kinders van Israel in Silo byeengekom en daar die tent van samekoms opgeslaan, aangesien die land voor hulle onderwerp was.

kjv_text: And there remained among the children of Israel seven tribes, which had not yet received their inheritance.
bsb_text: there were still seven tribes of Israel who had not yet received their inheritance.
aov_text: Maar daar was onder die kinders van Israel nog sewe stamme oor wie se erfenis hulle nie verdeel het nie.

kjv_text: And Joshua said unto the children of Israel, How long are ye slack to go to possess the land, which the LORD God of your fathers hath given you?
bsb_text: So Joshua said to the Israelites, “How long will you put off entering and possessing the land that the LORD, the God of your fathers, has given you?
aov_text: Toe sê Josua aan die kinders van Israel: Hoe lank sal julle jul so traag hou om die land in besit te gaan neem wat die HERE, die God van julle vaders, aan julle gegee het?

kjv_text: Give out from among you three men for each tribe: and I will send them, and they shall rise, and go through the land, and describe it according to the inheritance of them; and they shall come again to me.
bsb_text: Appoint three men from each tribe, and I will send them out to survey the land and map it out, according to the inheritance of each. Then they will return to me
aov_text: Bring tog drie man uit elke stam, dat ek hulle kan uitstuur, en dat hulle kan klaarmaak en die land deurgaan en dit beskrywe met die oog op hulle erfdeel; dan moet hulle na my toe kom

kjv_text: And they shall divide it into seven parts: Judah shall abide in their coast on the south, and the house of Joseph shall abide in their coasts on the north.
bsb_text: and divide the land into seven portions. Judah shall remain in their territory in the south, and the house of Joseph shall remain in their territory in the north.
aov_text: en dit onder mekaar in sewe dele verdeel: Juda moet sy gebied in die suide behou, en die huis van Josef moet sy gebied in die noorde behou.

kjv_text: Ye shall therefore describe the land into seven parts, and bring the description hither to me, that I may cast lots for you here before the LORD our God.
bsb_text: When you have mapped out the seven portions of land and brought it to me, I will cast lots for you here in the presence of the LORD our God.
aov_text: Maar julle moet die land in sewe dele beskrywe en die beskrywing hier na my toe bring; dan sal ek vir julle die lot werp, hier voor die aangesig van die HERE onse God.

kjv_text: But the Levites have no part among you; for the priesthood of the LORD is their inheritance: and Gad, and Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh, have received their inheritance beyond Jordan on the east, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave them.
bsb_text: The Levites, however, have no portion among you, because their inheritance is the priesthood of the LORD. And Gad, Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh have already received the inheritance that Moses the servant of the LORD gave them beyond the Jordan to the east.”
aov_text: Want die Leviete het geen aandeel onder julle nie, omdat die priesterskap van die HERE hulle erfdeel is; en Gad en Ruben en die halwe stam van Manasse het hulle erfdeel ontvang oorkant die Jordaan in die ooste, wat Moses, die kneg van die HERE, hulle gegee het.

kjv_text: And the men arose, and went away: and Joshua charged them that went to describe the land, saying, Go and walk through the land, and describe it, and come again to me, that I may here cast lots for you before the LORD in Shiloh.
bsb_text: As the men got up to go out, Joshua commanded them to map out the land, saying, “Go and survey the land, map it out, and return to me. Then I will cast lots for you here in Shiloh in the presence of the LORD.”
aov_text: Die manne het toe klaargemaak en gegaan; en by hulle vertrek het Josua hulle bevel gegee om die land te beskrywe, met die woorde: Gaan heen, trek rond in die land en beskrywe dit, en kom na my terug; dan sal ek hier vir julle die lot werp voor die aangesig van die HERE in Silo.

kjv_text: And the men went and passed through the land, and described it by cities into seven parts in a book, and came again to Joshua to the host at Shiloh.
bsb_text: So the men departed and went throughout the land, mapping it city by city into seven portions. Then they returned with the document to Joshua at the camp in Shiloh.
aov_text: En die manne het gegaan en die land deurgetrek en dit in ’n boek beskrywe, volgens die stede, in sewe dele, en na Josua gekom in die laer van Silo.

kjv_text: And Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the LORD: and there Joshua divided the land unto the children of Israel according to their divisions.
bsb_text: And Joshua cast lots for them in the presence of the LORD at Shiloh, where he distributed the land to the Israelites according to their divisions.
aov_text: Toe het Josua vir hulle die lot gewerp in Silo, voor die aangesig van die HERE; en Josua het die land daar onder die kinders van Israel verdeel volgens hulle afdelings.

kjv_text: And the lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families: and the coast of their lot came forth between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.
bsb_text: The first lot came up for the clans of the tribe of Benjamin. Their allotted territory lay between the tribes of Judah and Joseph:
aov_text: EN die lot het opgekom van die stam van die kinders van Benjamin volgens hulle geslagte; en die gebied wat vir hulle deur die lot aangewys is, het uitgekom tussen die kinders van Juda en die kinders van Josef;

kjv_text: And their border on the north side was from Jordan; and the border went up to the side of Jericho on the north side, and went up through the mountains westward; and the goings out thereof were at the wilderness of Bethaven.
bsb_text: On the north side their border began at the Jordan, went up past the northern slope of Jericho, headed west through the hill country, and came out at the wilderness of Beth-aven.
aov_text: en hulle lyn aan die noordekant was: van die Jordaan af; dan loop die lyn op na die noordelike hang van Jérigo, en dit loop op in die gebergte in westelike rigting en loop dood by die woestyn van Bet-Awen;

kjv_text: And the border went over from thence toward Luz, to the side of Luz, which is Bethel, southward; and the border descended to Atarothadar, near the hill that lieth on the south side of the nether Bethhoron.
bsb_text: From there the border crossed over to the southern slope of Luz (that is, Bethel) and went down to Ataroth-addar on the hill south of Lower Beth-horon.
aov_text: en daarvandaan loop die lyn oor na Lus, na die suidelike hang van Lus, dit is Bet-el; verder loop die lyn af na Atrot-Addar, op die gebergte wat suid lê van Bet-Horon-Onder;

kjv_text: And the border was drawn thence, and compassed the corner of the sea southward, from the hill that lieth before Bethhoron southward; and the goings out thereof were at Kirjathbaal, which is Kirjathjearim, a city of the children of Judah: this was the west quarter.
bsb_text: On the west side the border curved southward from the hill facing Beth-horon on the south and came out at Kiriath-baal (that is, Kiriath-jearim), a city of the sons of Judah. This was the western side.
aov_text: dan buig die lyn om en swaai na die westekant, teen suid, van die gebergte wat suid teenoor Bet-Horon lê; verder loop dit dood by Kirjat-Baäl, dit is Kirjat-Jeárim, die stad van die kinders van Juda; dit is die westekant;

kjv_text: And the south quarter was from the end of Kirjathjearim, and the border went out on the west, and went out to the well of waters of Nephtoah:
bsb_text: On the south side the border began at the outskirts of Kiriath-jearim and extended westward to the spring at the Waters of Nephtoah.
aov_text: en die suidekant begin by die uiteinde van Kirjat-Jeárim; en die lyn loop aan in die weste en dan na die waterfontein van Neftóag;

kjv_text: And the border came down to the end of the mountain that lieth before the valley of the son of Hinnom, and which is in the valley of the giants on the north, and descended to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of Jebusi on the south, and descended to Enrogel,
bsb_text: Then it went down to the foot of the hill that faces the Valley of Hinnom at the northern end of the Valley of Rephaim and ran down the Valley of Hinnom toward the southern slope of the Jebusites and downward to En-rogel.
aov_text: dan loop die lyn af na die uiteinde van die berg wat teenoor die dal Ben-Hinnom, noordelik in die dal van die Refaïete lê; dan loop dit af na die dal Hinnom, na die suidelike hang van die Jebusiete, en loop af na die fontein Rogel;

kjv_text: And was drawn from the north, and went forth to Enshemesh, and went forth toward Geliloth, which is over against the going up of Adummim, and descended to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben,
bsb_text: From there it curved northward and proceeded to En-shemesh and on to Geliloth facing the Ascent of Adummim, and continued down to the Stone of Bohan son of Reuben.
aov_text: verder buig dit noord om en loop aan na die fontein Semes; dan loop dit aan na die klipkrale wat teenoor die hoogte van Adúmmim lê, en loop af na die klip van Bohan, die seun van Ruben;

kjv_text: And passed along toward the side over against Arabah northward, and went down unto Arabah:
bsb_text: Then it went on to the northern slope of Beth-arabah and went down into the valley.
aov_text: dan gaan dit oor na die hang teenoor die Áraba in noordelike rigting en loop af na die Áraba;

kjv_text: And the border passed along to the side of Bethhoglah northward: and the outgoings of the border were at the north bay of the salt sea at the south end of Jordan: this was the south coast.
bsb_text: The border continued to the northern slope of Beth-hoglah and came out at the northern bay of the Salt Sea, at the mouth of the Jordan. This was the southern border.
aov_text: verder loop die lyn oor na die hang van Bet-Hogla in noordelike rigting; dan loop die lyn dood by die noordelike tong van die Soutsee, aan die mond van die Jordaan in die suide; dit is die suidelike lyn;

kjv_text: And Jordan was the border of it on the east side. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin, by the coasts thereof round about, according to their families.
bsb_text: On the east side the border was the Jordan. These were the borders around the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Benjamin.
aov_text: en die Jordaan begrens dit aan die oostekant. Dit is die erfdeel van die kinders van Benjamin na hulle geslagte, volgens sy lyne rondom.

kjv_text: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, and Bethhoglah, and the valley of Keziz,
bsb_text: These were the cities of the clans of the tribe of Benjamin: Jericho, Beth-hoglah, Emek-keziz,
aov_text: En die stede van die stam van die kinders van Benjamin, volgens hulle geslagte, was: Jérigo en Bet-Hogla en Emek-Kesis,

kjv_text: And Betharabah, and Zemaraim, and Bethel,
bsb_text: Beth-arabah, Zemaraim, Bethel,
aov_text: en Bet-Áraba en Semaráim en Bet-el,

kjv_text: And Avim, and Parah, and Ophrah,
bsb_text: Avvim, Parah, Ophrah,
aov_text: en Haäwim en Para en Ofra,

kjv_text: And Chepharhaammonai, and Ophni, and Gaba; twelve cities with their villages:
bsb_text: Chephar-ammoni, Ophni, and Geba—twelve cities, along with their villages.
aov_text: en Kefar-Haämmóni en Ofni en Gaba: twaalf stede met hulle dorpe;

kjv_text: Gibeon, and Ramah, and Beeroth,
bsb_text: Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth,
aov_text: Gíbeon en Rama en Beërot,

kjv_text: And Mizpeh, and Chephirah, and Mozah,
bsb_text: Mizpeh, Chephirah, Mozah,
aov_text: en Mispe en Kefíra en Mosa,

kjv_text: And Rekem, and Irpeel, and Taralah,
bsb_text: Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah,
aov_text: en Rekem en Jírpeël en Táreala,

kjv_text: And Zelah, Eleph, and Jebusi, which is Jerusalem, Gibeath, and Kirjath; fourteen cities with their villages. This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.
bsb_text: Zelah, Haeleph, Jebus (that is, Jerusalem), Gibeah, and Kiriath-jearim—fourteen cities, along with their villages. This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Benjamin.
aov_text: en Sela, Elef en Jebúsi, dit is Jerusalem, Gíbeat, Kirjat; veertien stede met hulle dorpe. Dit is die erfdeel van die kinders van Benjamin volgens hulle geslagte.

kjv_text: And the second lot came forth to Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families: and their inheritance was within the inheritance of the children of Judah.
bsb_text: The second lot came out for the clans of the tribe of Simeon: Their inheritance lay within the territory of Judah
aov_text: EN die tweede lot het uitgekom vir Símeon, vir die stam van die kinders van Símeon volgens hulle geslagte; en hulle erfdeel was in die middel van die erfdeel van die kinders van Juda.

kjv_text: And they had in their inheritance Beersheba, and Sheba, and Moladah,
bsb_text: and included Beersheba (or Sheba), Moladah,
aov_text: En hulle het in hulle erfdeel gehad: Beër-Seba en Seba en Mólada,

kjv_text: And Hazarshual, and Balah, and Azem,
bsb_text: Hazar-shual, Balah, Ezem,
aov_text: en Hasar-Sual en Bala en Esem,

kjv_text: And Eltolad, and Bethul, and Hormah,
bsb_text: Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah,
aov_text: en Eltólad en Betul en Horma,

kjv_text: And Ziklag, and Bethmarcaboth, and Hazarsusah,
bsb_text: Ziklag, Beth-marcaboth, Hazar-susah,
aov_text: en Siklag en Bet-Hammarkábot en Hasar-Susa,

kjv_text: And Bethlebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities and their villages:
bsb_text: Beth-lebaoth, and Sharuhen—thirteen cities, along with their villages.
aov_text: en Bet-Lebáot en Sarúhen: dertien stede met hulle dorpe;

kjv_text: Ain, Remmon, and Ether, and Ashan; four cities and their villages:
bsb_text: Ain, Rimmon, Ether, and Ashan—four cities, along with their villages,
aov_text: Ajin, Rimmon en Eter en Asan: vier stede met hulle dorpe;

kjv_text: And all the villages that were round about these cities to Baalathbeer, Ramath of the south. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.
bsb_text: and all the villages surrounding these cities as far as Baalath-beer (Ramah of the Negev). This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Simeon.
aov_text: en al die dorpe wat rondom hierdie stede was, tot by Báälat-Beër, die Rama van die Suidland. Dit is die erfdeel van die stam van die kinders van Símeon volgens hulle geslagte.

kjv_text: Out of the portion of the children of Judah was the inheritance of the children of Simeon: for the part of the children of Judah was too much for them: therefore the children of Simeon had their inheritance within the inheritance of them.
bsb_text: The inheritance of the Simeonites was taken from the territory of Judah, because the share for Judah’s descendants was too large for them. So the Simeonites received an inheritance within Judah’s portion.
aov_text: Uit die aandeel van die kinders van Juda is die erfdeel van die kinders van Símeon, omdat die deel van die kinders van Juda vir hulle te groot was; daarom het die kinders van Símeon geërwe in die middel van húlle erfdeel.

kjv_text: And the third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families: and the border of their inheritance was unto Sarid:
bsb_text: The third lot came up for the clans of the tribe of Zebulun: The border of their inheritance stretched as far as Sarid.
aov_text: EN die derde lot het opgekom vir die kinders van Sébulon volgens hulle geslagte, en die lyn van hulle erfdeel was tot by Sarid.

kjv_text: And their border went up toward the sea, and Maralah, and reached to Dabbasheth, and reached to the river that is before Jokneam;
bsb_text: It went up westward to Maralah, reached Dabbesheth, and met the brook east of Jokneam.
aov_text: En hulle lyn loop op in westelike rigting na Marála en raak aan Dabbéset en aan die spruit wat teenoor Jókneam loop;

kjv_text: And turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrising unto the border of Chislothtabor, and then goeth out to Daberath, and goeth up to Japhia,
bsb_text: From Sarid it turned eastward along the border of Chisloth-tabor and went on to Daberath and up to Japhia.
aov_text: en van Sarid af swaai dit na die oostekant, teen sonop, na die gebied van Kislot-Tabor, en loop aan na Daberat en loop op na Jáfia;

kjv_text: And from thence passeth on along on the east to Gittahhepher, to Ittahkazin, and goeth out to Remmonmethoar to Neah;
bsb_text: From there it crossed eastward to Gath-hepher and to Eth-kazin; it extended to Rimmon and curved around toward Neah.
aov_text: en daarvandaan loop dit oor na die ooste teen sonop, na Gat-Hefer, na Et-Kasin, en loop aan na Rimmon wat hom na Nea toe uitstrek;

kjv_text: And the border compasseth it on the north side to Hannathon: and the outgoings thereof are in the valley of Jiphthahel:
bsb_text: Then the border circled around the north side of Neah to Hannathon and ended at the Valley of Iphtah-el.
aov_text: dan swaai die lyn noord daaromheen na Hannáton en loop dood by die dal Jiftag-El;

kjv_text: And Kattath, and Nahallal, and Shimron, and Idalah, and Bethlehem: twelve cities with their villages.
bsb_text: It also included Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem. There were twelve cities, along with their villages.
