aov_text: en Kattat en Náhalal en Simron en Jídeala en Betlehem: twaalf stede met hulle dorpe.

kjv_text: This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.
bsb_text: This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Zebulun, including these cities and their villages.
aov_text: Dit was die erfdeel van die kinders van Sébulon volgens hulle geslagte; hierdie stede met hulle dorpe.

kjv_text: And the fourth lot came out to Issachar, for the children of Issachar according to their families.
bsb_text: The fourth lot came out for the clans of the tribe of Issachar:
aov_text: VIR Íssaskar het die vierde lot uitgekom, vir die kinders van Íssaskar volgens hulle geslagte;

kjv_text: And their border was toward Jezreel, and Chesulloth, and Shunem,
bsb_text: Their territory included Jezreel, Chesulloth, Shunem,
aov_text: en hulle grondgebied was na Jísreël toe en Kesúllot en Sunem,

kjv_text: And Haphraim, and Shihon, and Anaharath,
bsb_text: Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath,
aov_text: en Hafaráim en Sion en Anagárat,

kjv_text: And Rabbith, and Kishion, and Abez,
bsb_text: Rabbith, Kishion, Ebez,
aov_text: en Rabbit en Kísjon en Ebes,

kjv_text: And Remeth, and Engannim, and Enhaddah, and Bethpazzez;
bsb_text: Remeth, En-gannim, En-haddah, and Beth-pazzez.
aov_text: en Remet en En-Gannim en En-Hadda en Bet-Pases;

kjv_text: And the coast reacheth to Tabor, and Shahazimah, and Bethshemesh; and the outgoings of their border were at Jordan: sixteen cities with their villages.
bsb_text: The border reached Tabor, Shahazumah, and Beth-shemesh, and ended at the Jordan. There were sixteen cities, along with their villages.
aov_text: en die lyn raak aan Tabor en Sahasíma en Bet-Semes, en hulle gebied loop dood by die Jordaan: sestien stede met hulle dorpe.

kjv_text: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities and their villages.
bsb_text: This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Issachar, including these cities and their villages.
aov_text: Dit is die erfdeel van die stam van die kinders van Íssaskar volgens hulle geslagte, die stede met hulle dorpe.

kjv_text: And the fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.
bsb_text: The fifth lot came out for the clans of the tribe of Asher:
aov_text: EN die vyfde lot het uitgekom vir die stam van die kinders van Aser volgens hulle geslagte;

kjv_text: And their border was Helkath, and Hali, and Beten, and Achshaph,
bsb_text: Their territory included Helkath, Hali, Beten, Achshaph,
aov_text: en hulle gebied was: Helkat en Hali en Beten en Agsaf,

kjv_text: And Alammelech, and Amad, and Misheal; and reacheth to Carmel westward, and to Shihorlibnath;
bsb_text: Allammelech, Amad, and Mishal. On the west the border touched Carmel and Shihor-libnath,
aov_text: en Allamméleg en Amead en Miseal; en raak in die weste aan die Karmel en aan Sihor-Libnat;

kjv_text: And turneth toward the sunrising to Bethdagon, and reacheth to Zebulun, and to the valley of Jiphthahel toward the north side of Bethemek, and Neiel, and goeth out to Cabul on the left hand,
bsb_text: then turned eastward toward Beth-dagon, touched Zebulun and the Valley of Iphtah-el, and went north to Beth-emek and Neiel, passing Cabul on the left.
aov_text: dan draai dit teen sonop na Bet-Dagon en raak aan Sébulon en die dal Jiftag-El in die noorde, Bet-Emek en Nehíël, en loop aan links by Kabul;

kjv_text: And Hebron, and Rehob, and Hammon, and Kanah, even unto great Zidon;
bsb_text: It went on to Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, and Kanah, as far as Greater Sidon.
aov_text: en Ebron en Rehob en Hammon en Kana tot by Groot-Sidon;

kjv_text: And then the coast turneth to Ramah, and to the strong city Tyre; and the coast turneth to Hosah; and the outgoings thereof are at the sea from the coast to Achzib:
bsb_text: The border then turned back toward Ramah as far as the fortified city of Tyre, turned toward Hosah, and came out at the Sea in the region of Achzib,
aov_text: dan draai die lyn na Rama en tot by die vesting Tirus; dan draai die lyn na Hosa en loop dood by die see, van die landstreek af wat na Agsib toe lê;

kjv_text: Ummah also, and Aphek, and Rehob: twenty and two cities with their villages.
bsb_text: Ummah, Aphek, and Rehob. There were twenty-two cities, along with their villages.
aov_text: en Umma en Afek en Rehob: twee-en-twintig stede met hulle dorpe.

kjv_text: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.
bsb_text: This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Asher, including these cities and their villages.
aov_text: Dit is die erfdeel van die stam van die kinders van Aser volgens hulle geslagte; hierdie stede met hulle dorpe.

kjv_text: The sixth lot came out to the children of Naphtali, even for the children of Naphtali according to their families.
bsb_text: The sixth lot came out for the clans of the tribe of Naphtali:
aov_text: VIR die kinders van Náftali het die sesde lot uitgekom, vir die kinders van Náftali volgens hulle geslagte;

kjv_text: And their coast was from Heleph, from Allon to Zaanannim, and Adami, Nekeb, and Jabneel, unto Lakum; and the outgoings thereof were at Jordan:
bsb_text: Their border started at Heleph and the great tree of Zaanannim, passing Adami-nekeb and Jabneel as far as Lakkum and ending at the Jordan.
aov_text: en hulle lyn was van Helef, van die eikeboom by Saänánnim af, en Adámi-Nekeb en Jabneël tot by Lakkum, en dit loop dood by die Jordaan;

kjv_text: And then the coast turneth westward to Aznothtabor, and goeth out from thence to Hukkok, and reacheth to Zebulun on the south side, and reacheth to Asher on the west side, and to Judah upon Jordan toward the sunrising.
bsb_text: Then the border turned westward to Aznoth-tabor and ran from there to Hukkok, touching Zebulun on the south side, Asher on the west, and Judah at the Jordan on the east.
aov_text: dan draai die lyn in westelike rigting na Asnot-Tabor en loop daarvandaan aan na Hukkok en raak in die suide aan Sébulon; en aan Aser raak dit in die weste, en aan Juda aan die Jordaan in die ooste;

kjv_text: And the fenced cities are Ziddim, Zer, and Hammath, Rakkath, and Chinnereth,
bsb_text: The fortified cities were Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, Chinnereth,
aov_text: en die versterkte stede: Siddim, Ser en Hammat, Rakkat en Kinnéret,

kjv_text: And Adamah, and Ramah, and Hazor,
bsb_text: Adamah, Ramah, Hazor,
aov_text: en Adama en Rama en Hasor,

kjv_text: And Kedesh, and Edrei, and Enhazor,
bsb_text: Kedesh, Edrei, En-hazor,
aov_text: en Kedes en Edréï en En-Hasor,

kjv_text: And Iron, and Migdalel, Horem, and Bethanath, and Bethshemesh; nineteen cities with their villages.
bsb_text: Iron, Migdal-el, Horem, Beth-anath, and Beth-shemesh. There were nineteen cities, along with their villages.
aov_text: en Jireon en Mígdal-El, Horem en Bet-Anat en Bet-Semes: negentien stede met hulle dorpe.

kjv_text: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families, the cities and their villages.
bsb_text: This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Naphtali, including these cities and their villages.
aov_text: Dit is die erfdeel van die stam van die kinders van Náftali volgens hulle geslagte, die stede met hulle dorpe.

kjv_text: And the seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families.
bsb_text: The seventh lot came out for the clans of the tribe of Dan:
aov_text: VIR die stam van die kinders van Dan, volgens hulle geslagte, het die sewende lot uitgekom.

kjv_text: And the coast of their inheritance was Zorah, and Eshtaol, and Irshemesh,
bsb_text: The territory of their inheritance included Zorah, Eshtaol, Ir-shemesh,
aov_text: En die lyn van hulle erfdeel omvat: Sórea en Estáol en Ir-Semes,

kjv_text: And Shaalabbin, and Ajalon, and Jethlah,
bsb_text: Shaalabbin, Aijalon, Ithlah,
aov_text: en Saälábbin en Ájalon en Jitla,

kjv_text: And Elon, and Thimnathah, and Ekron,
bsb_text: Elon, Timnah, Ekron,
aov_text: en Elon en Timnáta en Ekron,

kjv_text: And Eltekeh, and Gibbethon, and Baalath,
bsb_text: Eltekeh, Gibbethon, Baalath,
aov_text: en Élteke en Gíbbeton en Báälat,

kjv_text: And Jehud, and Beneberak, and Gathrimmon,
bsb_text: Jehud, Bene-berak, Gath-rimmon,
aov_text: en Jehud en Bené-Berak en Gat-Rimmon,

kjv_text: And Mejarkon, and Rakkon, with the border before Japho.
bsb_text: Me-jarkon, and Rakkon, including the territory across from Joppa.
aov_text: en Mé-Jarkon en Rakkon, met die gebied teenoor Jafo.

kjv_text: And the coast of the children of Dan went out too little for them: therefore the children of Dan went up to fight against Leshem, and took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and possessed it, and dwelt therein, and called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their father.
bsb_text: (Later, when the territory of the Danites was lost to them, they went up and fought against Leshem, captured it, and put it to the sword. So they took possession of Leshem, settled there, and renamed it after their father Dan.)
aov_text: Maar die kinders van Dan het hulle grondgebied kwytgeraak; daarom het die kinders van Dan opgetrek en teen Lesem geveg en dit ingeneem en verslaan met die skerpte van die swaard en dit in besit geneem en daarin gewoon; en hulle het Lesem Dan genoem na die naam van hulle vader Dan.

kjv_text: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families, these cities with their villages.
bsb_text: This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Dan, including these cities and their villages.
aov_text: Dit is die erfdeel van die stam van die kinders van Dan volgens hulle geslagte; hierdie stede met hulle dorpe.

kjv_text: When they had made an end of dividing the land for inheritance by their coasts, the children of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun among them:
bsb_text: When they had finished distributing the land into its territories, the Israelites gave Joshua son of Nun an inheritance among them,
aov_text: TOE hulle die land volgens sy grenslyne as erfenis geheel verdeel het, het die kinders van Israel aan Josua, die seun van Nun, ’n erfdeel onder hulle gegee;

kjv_text: According to the word of the LORD they gave him the city which he asked, even Timnathserah in mount Ephraim: and he built the city, and dwelt therein.
bsb_text: as the LORD had commanded. They gave him the city of Timnath-serah in the hill country of Ephraim, as he requested. He rebuilt the city and settled in it.
aov_text: op bevel van die HERE het hulle hom die stad gegee wat hy gevra het, Timnat-Serag op die gebergte van Efraim; en hy het die stad opgebou en daarin gaan woon.

kjv_text: These are the inheritances, which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel, divided for an inheritance by lot in Shiloh before the LORD, at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation. So they made an end of dividing the country.
bsb_text: These are the inheritances that Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the heads of the families distributed by lot to the tribes of Israel at Shiloh before the LORD at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting. So they finished dividing up the land.
aov_text: Dit is die erfdele wat Eleásar, die priester, en Josua, die seun van Nun, en die familiehoofde aan die stamme van die kinders van Israel as erfenis uitgedeel het deur die lot, in Silo, voor die aangesig van die HERE, by die ingang van die tent van samekoms; en hulle het die verdeling van die land beëindig.

kjv_text: The LORD also spake unto Joshua, saying,
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to Joshua,
aov_text: EN die HERE het met Josua gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: Speak to the children of Israel, saying, Appoint out for you cities of refuge, whereof I spake unto you by the hand of Moses:
bsb_text: “Tell the Israelites to designate the cities of refuge, as I instructed you through Moses,
aov_text: Spreek met die kinders van Israel en sê: Wys die vrystede vir julle aan waarvan Ek deur die diens van Moses met julle gespreek het,

kjv_text: That the slayer that killeth any person unawares and unwittingly may flee thither: and they shall be your refuge from the avenger of blood.
bsb_text: so that anyone who kills another unintentionally or accidentally may flee there. These will be your refuge from the avenger of blood.
aov_text: dat hy wat ’n doodslag begaan het—wat per ongeluk, sonder opset, ’n mens doodgeslaan het, daarheen kan vlug, sodat dié vir julle kan dien as toevlugsoord vanweë die bloedwreker.

kjv_text: And when they cried unto the LORD, he put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea upon them, and covered them; and your eyes have seen what I have done in Egypt: and ye dwelt in the wilderness a long season.
bsb_text: So your fathers cried out to the LORD, and He put darkness between you and the Egyptians, over whom He brought the sea and engulfed them. Your very eyes saw what I did to the Egyptians. Then you lived in the wilderness for a long time.
aov_text: maar hulle het die HERE aangeroep, en Hy het ’n duisternis gestel tussen julle en die Egiptenaars en die see oor hulle laat kom, sodat dit hulle oordek het, en julle eie oë het gesien wat Ek aan Egipte gedoen het. Daarna het julle baie dae in die woestyn gebly.

kjv_text: And I brought you into the land of the Amorites, which dwelt on the other side Jordan; and they fought with you: and I gave them into your hand, that ye might possess their land; and I destroyed them from before you.
bsb_text: Later, I brought you to the land of the Amorites who lived beyond the Jordan. They fought against you, but I delivered them into your hand, that you should possess their land when I destroyed them before you.
aov_text: Daarop het Ek julle gebring in die land van die Amoriete wat oos van die Jordaan gewoon het, en hulle het teen julle geveg; maar Ek het hulle in julle hand gegee, sodat julle hul land in besit geneem het, en Ek het hulle voor julle uit verdelg.

kjv_text: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and warred against Israel, and sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you:
bsb_text: Then Balak son of Zippor, the king of Moab, set out to fight against Israel. He sent for Balaam son of Beor to curse you,
aov_text: Toe het Balak, die seun van Sippor, die koning van Moab, hom klaargemaak en teen Israel geveg; en hy het gestuur om Bíleam, die seun van Beor, te roep om julle te vervloek;

kjv_text: But I would not hearken unto Balaam; therefore he blessed you still: so I delivered you out of his hand.
bsb_text: but I would not listen to Balaam. So he blessed you again and again, and I delivered you from his hand.
aov_text: maar Ek wou nie na Bíleam luister nie, sodat hy julle net geseën het; en Ek het julle uit sy hand gered.

kjv_text: And ye went over Jordan, and came unto Jericho: and the men of Jericho fought against you, the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Girgashites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites; and I delivered them into your hand.
bsb_text: After this, you crossed the Jordan and came to Jericho. The people of Jericho fought against you, as did the Amorites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hittites, Girgashites, Hivites, and Jebusites, and I delivered them into your hand.
aov_text: Toe julle die Jordaan deurgetrek en by Jérigo gekom het, het die burgers van Jérigo, die Amoriete en Feresiete en Kanaäniete en Hetiete en Girgasiete, die Hewiete en Jebusiete teen julle geveg; maar Ek het hulle in julle hand gegee

kjv_text: And I sent the hornet before you, which drave them out from before you, even the two kings of the Amorites; but not with thy sword, nor with thy bow.
bsb_text: I sent the hornet ahead of you, and it drove out the two Amorite kings before you, but not by your own sword or bow.
aov_text: en perdebye voor julle uit gestuur, wat hulle voor julle uit verdryf het,—die twee konings van die Amoriete—nie deur jou swaard en nie deur jou boog nie.

kjv_text: And I have given you a land for which ye did not labour, and cities which ye built not, and ye dwell in them; of the vineyards and oliveyards which ye planted not do ye eat.
bsb_text: So I gave you a land on which you did not toil and cities that you did not build, and now you live in them and eat from vineyards and olive groves that you did not plant.’
aov_text: So het Ek julle dan ’n land gegee waar julle nie aan gearbei en stede wat julle nie gebou het nie, dat julle daarin kan woon; wingerde en olyfbome wat julle nie geplant het nie, daar eet julle van.

kjv_text: Now therefore fear the LORD, and serve him in sincerity and in truth: and put away the gods which your fathers served on the other side of the flood, and in Egypt; and serve ye the LORD.
bsb_text: Now, therefore, fear the LORD and serve Him in sincerity and truth; cast aside the gods your fathers served beyond the Euphrates and in Egypt, and serve the LORD.
aov_text: Vrees dan nou die HERE en dien Hom in opregtheid en waarheid, en verwyder die gode wat julle vaders gedien het oorkant die Eufraat en in Egipte, en dien die HERE.

kjv_text: And if it seem evil unto you to serve the LORD, choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.
bsb_text: But if it is unpleasing in your sight to serve the LORD, then choose for yourselves this day whom you will serve, whether the gods your fathers served beyond the Euphrates, or the gods of the Amorites in whose land you are living. As for me and my house, we will serve the LORD!”
aov_text: Maar as dit verkeerd is in julle oë om die HERE te dien, kies dan vir julle vandag wie julle wil dien: òf die gode wat julle vaders daar oorkant die Eufraat gedien het, òf die gode van die Amoriete in wie se land julle woon; maar ek en my huis, ons sal die HERE dien.

kjv_text: And the people answered and said, God forbid that we should forsake the LORD, to serve other gods;
bsb_text: The people replied, “Far be it from us to forsake the LORD to serve other gods!
aov_text: Toe antwoord die volk en sê: Dit is ver van ons, dat ons die HERE sou verlaat om ander gode te dien;

kjv_text: For the LORD our God, he it is that brought us up and our fathers out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and which did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way wherein we went, and among all the people through whom we passed:
bsb_text: For the LORD our God brought us and our fathers out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery, and performed these great signs before our eyes. He also protected us throughout our journey and among all the nations through which we traveled.
aov_text: want die HERE onse God, dit is Hy wat ons en ons vaders uit Egipteland uit die slawehuis laat optrek het, en wat voor ons oë hierdie groot tekens gedoen het en ons bewaar het op die hele pad wat ons gegaan en onder al die volke waar ons dwarsdeur getrek het;

kjv_text: And the LORD drave out from before us all the people, even the Amorites which dwelt in the land: therefore will we also serve the LORD; for he is our God.
bsb_text: And the LORD drove out before us all the nations, including the Amorites who lived in the land. We too will serve the LORD, because He is our God!”
aov_text: en die HERE het al die volke en die Amoriet, die inwoner van die land, voor ons uit verdrywe. Ook ons sal die HERE dien, want Hy is onse God.

kjv_text: And Joshua said unto the people, Ye cannot serve the LORD: for he is an holy God; he is a jealous God; he will not forgive your transgressions nor your sins.
bsb_text: But Joshua said to the people, “You are not able to serve the LORD, for He is a holy God; He is a jealous God; He will not forgive your rebellion or your sins.
aov_text: Maar Josua het vir die volk gesê: Julle kan die HERE nie dien nie, want Hy is ’n heilige God, Hy is ’n jaloerse God; Hy sal julle oortreding en julle sondes nie vergewe nie.

kjv_text: If ye forsake the LORD, and serve strange gods, then he will turn and do you hurt, and consume you, after that he hath done you good.
bsb_text: If you forsake the LORD and serve foreign gods, He will turn and bring disaster on you and consume you, even after He has been good to you.”
aov_text: As julle die HERE verlaat en vreemde gode dien, sal Hy julle weer kwaad aandoen en julle vernietig, nadat Hy aan julle goed gedoen het.

kjv_text: And the people said unto Joshua, Nay; but we will serve the LORD.
bsb_text: “No!” replied the people. “We will serve the LORD!”
aov_text: Toe sê die volk vir Josua: Nee, maar ons sal die HERE dien.

kjv_text: And Joshua said unto the people, Ye are witnesses against yourselves that ye have chosen you the LORD, to serve him. And they said, We are witnesses.
bsb_text: Then Joshua told them, “You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen to serve the LORD.” “We are witnesses!” they said.
aov_text: Daarop sê Josua aan die volk: Julle is getuies teen julleself dat julle vir julleself die HERE gekies het om Hom te dien. En hulle sê: Ons is getuies.

kjv_text: Now therefore put away, said he, the strange gods which are among you, and incline your heart unto the LORD God of Israel.
bsb_text: “Now, therefore,” he said, “get rid of the foreign gods among you and incline your hearts to the LORD, the God of Israel.”
aov_text: Verwyder dan nou die vreemde gode wat onder julle is, en neig julle hart tot die HERE, die God van Israel.

kjv_text: And the people said unto Joshua, The LORD our God will we serve, and his voice will we obey.
bsb_text: So the people said to Joshua, “We will serve the LORD our God and obey His voice.”
aov_text: Daarop sê die volk aan Josua: Ons sal die HERE onse God dien en na sy stem luister.

kjv_text: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and set them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.
bsb_text: On that day Joshua made a covenant for the people, and there at Shechem he established for them a statute and ordinance.
aov_text: En op dié dag het Josua met die volk ’n verbond gesluit en vir hulle ’n insetting en ’n reg vasgestel in Sigem.

kjv_text: And Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God, and took a great stone, and set it up there under an oak, that was by the sanctuary of the LORD.
bsb_text: Joshua recorded these things in the Book of the Law of God. Then he took a large stone and set it up there under the oak that was near the sanctuary of the LORD.
aov_text: En Josua het hierdie woorde in die wetboek van God geskrywe en ’n groot klip geneem en dié daar opgerig onder die eikeboom wat by die heilige plek van die HERE is.

kjv_text: And Joshua said unto all the people, Behold, this stone shall be a witness unto us; for it hath heard all the words of the LORD which he spake unto us: it shall be therefore a witness unto you, lest ye deny your God.
bsb_text: And Joshua said to all the people, “You see this stone. It will be a witness against us, for it has heard all the words the LORD has spoken to us, and it will be a witness against you if you ever deny your God.”
aov_text: Toe sê Josua aan die hele volk: Kyk, hierdie klip sal ’n getuie teen ons wees, want hy het al die woorde van die HERE gehoor wat Hy met ons gespreek het; en hy sal ’n getuie teen julle wees, sodat julle jul God nie verloën nie.

kjv_text: So Joshua let the people depart, every man unto his inheritance.
bsb_text: Then Joshua sent the people away, each to his own inheritance.
aov_text: Toe het Josua die volk laat gaan, elkeen na sy erfdeel toe.

kjv_text: And it came to pass after these things, that Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died, being an hundred and ten years old.
bsb_text: Some time later, Joshua son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died at the age of 110.
aov_text: En ná hierdie dinge het Josua, die seun van Nun, die kneg van die HERE, gesterwe, honderd-en-tien jaar oud.

kjv_text: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnathserah, which is in mount Ephraim, on the north side of the hill of Gaash.
bsb_text: And they buried him in the land of his inheritance, at Timnath-serah in the hill country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.
aov_text: En hulle het hom begrawe op die grondgebied van sy erfdeel in Timnat-Serag wat op die gebergte van Efraim lê, noord van die berg Gaäs.

kjv_text: And Israel served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that overlived Joshua, and which had known all the works of the LORD, that he had done for Israel.
bsb_text: Israel had served the LORD throughout the days of Joshua and of the elders who outlived him and who had experienced all the works that the LORD had done for Israel.
aov_text: En Israel het die HERE gedien al die dae van Josua en al die dae van die oudstes wat lank ná Josua nog in die lewe was en met al die werke van die HERE bekend was wat Hy vir Israel gedoen het.

kjv_text: And the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt, buried they in Shechem, in a parcel of ground which Jacob bought of the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for an hundred pieces of silver: and it became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.
bsb_text: And the bones of Joseph, which the Israelites had brought up out of Egypt, were buried at Shechem in the plot of land that Jacob had purchased from the sons of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for a hundred pieces of silver. So it became an inheritance for Joseph’s descendants.
aov_text: Ook die gebeente van Josef wat die kinders van Israel uit Egipte saamgebring het, het hulle begrawe in Sigem, op die stuk grond wat Jakob van die kinders van Hemor, die vader van Sigem, vir honderd geldstukke gekoop het, en wat die kinders van Josef as erfdeel ontvang het.

kjv_text: And Eleazar the son of Aaron died; and they buried him in a hill that pertained to Phinehas his son, which was given him in mount Ephraim.
bsb_text: Eleazar son of Aaron also died, and they buried him at Gibeah, which had been given to his son Phinehas in the hill country of Ephraim.
aov_text: En toe Eleásar, die seun van Aäron, gesterf het, het hulle hom begrawe op die heuwel van sy seun Pínehas wat aan hom gegee was op die gebergte van Efraim.

kjv_text: Now after the death of Joshua it came to pass, that the children of Israel asked the LORD, saying, Who shall go up for us against the Canaanites first, to fight against them?
bsb_text: After the death of Joshua, the Israelites inquired of the LORD, “Who will be the first to go up and fight for us against the Canaanites?”
aov_text: EN ná die dood van Josua het die kinders van Israel die HERE geraadpleeg en gesê: Wie van ons moet eerste optrek teen die Kanaäniete om teen hulle te veg?

kjv_text: And the LORD said, Judah shall go up: behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.
bsb_text: “Judah shall go up,” answered the LORD. “Indeed, I have delivered the land into their hands.”
aov_text: En die HERE het gesê: Juda moet optrek. Kyk, Ek gee die land in sy hand.

kjv_text: And Judah said unto Simeon his brother, Come up with me into my lot, that we may fight against the Canaanites; and I likewise will go with thee into thy lot. So Simeon went with him.
bsb_text: Then the men of Judah said to their brothers the Simeonites, “Come up with us to our allotted territory, and let us fight against the Canaanites. And we likewise will go with you to your territory.” So the Simeonites went with them.
aov_text: Toe sê Juda aan sy broer Símeon: Trek saam met my op in my aandeel, dat ons die Kanaäniete kan beveg, dan sal ek ook met jou saam optrek in jou aandeel. En Símeon het saam met hom getrek;

kjv_text: And Judah went up; and the LORD delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand: and they slew of them in Bezek ten thousand men.
bsb_text: When Judah attacked, the LORD delivered the Canaanites and Perizzites into their hands, and they struck down ten thousand men at Bezek.
aov_text: en toe Juda optrek, het die HERE die Kanaäniete en Feresiete in hul hand gegee, sodat hulle tienduisend man van hulle by Besek verslaan het.

kjv_text: And they found Adonibezek in Bezek: and they fought against him, and they slew the Canaanites and the Perizzites.
bsb_text: And there they found Adoni-bezek and fought against him, striking down the Canaanites and Perizzites.
aov_text: En hulle het Adóni-Besek aangetref in Besek en teen hom geveg, en die Kanaäniete en Feresiete verslaan.

kjv_text: But Adonibezek fled; and they pursued after him, and caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his great toes.
bsb_text: As Adoni-bezek fled, they pursued him, seized him, and cut off his thumbs and big toes.
aov_text: En toe Adóni-Besek wegvlug, het hulle hom agternagejaag en hom gevang en sy duime en sy groottone afgekap.

kjv_text: And Adonibezek said, Threescore and ten kings, having their thumbs and their great toes cut off, gathered their meat under my table: as I have done, so God hath requited me. And they brought him to Jerusalem, and there he died.
bsb_text: Then Adoni-bezek said, “Seventy kings with their thumbs and big toes cut off have gathered the scraps under my table. As I have done to them, so God has repaid me.” And they brought him to Jerusalem, where he died.
aov_text: Daarop sê Adóni-Besek: Sewentig konings met afgekapte duime en groottone het onder my tafel krummels opgetel: soos ek gedoen het, so het God my vergeld. En hulle het hom na Jerusalem gebring, en daar het hy gesterwe.

kjv_text: Now the children of Judah had fought against Jerusalem, and had taken it, and smitten it with the edge of the sword, and set the city on fire.
bsb_text: Then the men of Judah fought against Jerusalem and captured it. They put the city to the sword and set it on fire.
aov_text: En die kinders van Juda het teen Jerusalem geveg en dit ingeneem en dit met die skerpte van die swaard verslaan en die stad aan die brand gesteek.

kjv_text: And afterward the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites, that dwelt in the mountain, and in the south, and in the valley.
bsb_text: Afterward, the men of Judah marched down to fight against the Canaanites living in the hill country, in the Negev, and in the foothills.
aov_text: En daarna het die kinders van Juda afgetrek om te veg teen die Kanaäniete wat op die Gebergte en in die Suidland en in die Laeveld gewoon het.

kjv_text: And Judah went against the Canaanites that dwelt in Hebron: (now the name of Hebron before was Kirjatharba:) and they slew Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai.
bsb_text: Judah also marched against the Canaanites who were living in Hebron (formerly known as Kiriath-arba), and they struck down Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai.
aov_text: Juda het dan teen die Kanaäniete uitgetrek, die inwoners van Hebron—maar die naam van Hebron was tevore Kirjat-Arba—en hulle het Sesai en Ahíman en Talmai verslaan.

kjv_text: And from thence he went against the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before was Kirjathsepher:
bsb_text: From there they marched against the inhabitants of Debir (formerly known as Kiriath-sepher).
aov_text: En daarvandaan het hy uitgetrek teen die inwoners van Debir—maar die naam van Debir was tevore Kirjat-Sefer.

kjv_text: And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kirjathsepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.
bsb_text: And Caleb said, “To the man who strikes down Kiriath-sepher and captures it, I will give my daughter Acsah in marriage.”
aov_text: En Kaleb het gesê: Hy wat Kirjat-Sefer verslaan en dit inneem, aan hom sal ek my dogter Agsa as vrou gee.

kjv_text: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.
bsb_text: So Othniel son of Caleb’s younger brother Kenaz captured the city, and Caleb gave his daughter Acsah to him in marriage.
aov_text: Daarop het Ótniël, die seun van Kenas, die jonger broer van Kaleb, dit ingeneem; en hy het sy dogter Agsa aan hom as vrou gegee.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when she came to him, that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she lighted from off her ass; and Caleb said unto her, What wilt thou?
bsb_text: One day Acsah came to Othniel and urged him to ask her father for a field. When she got off her donkey, Caleb asked her, “What do you desire?”
aov_text: En toe sy aankom, het sy hom aangespoor om van haar vader ’n stuk grond te vra; en toe sy van die esel afklim, sê Kaleb vir haar: Wat wil jy hê?

kjv_text: And she said unto him, Give me a blessing: for thou hast given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And Caleb gave her the upper springs and the nether springs.
bsb_text: “Give me a blessing,” she answered. “Since you have given me land in the Negev, give me springs of water as well.” So Caleb gave her both the upper and lower springs.
aov_text: En sy sê vir hom: Gee my tog ’n geskenk; omdat u my na ’n dor land versit het, moet u my waterfonteine gee. Toe gee Kaleb haar fonteine op die hoogte en fonteine in die laagte.

kjv_text: And the children of the Kenite, Moses' father in law, went up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Judah into the wilderness of Judah, which lieth in the south of Arad; and they went and dwelt among the people.
bsb_text: Now the descendants of Moses’ father-in-law, the Kenite, went up with the men of Judah from the City of Palms to the Wilderness of Judah in the Negev near Arad. They went to live among the people.
aov_text: En die kinders van die Keniet, die swaer van Moses, het saam met die kinders van Juda opgetrek uit die Palmstad na die woestyn van Juda wat in die suide van Arad lê; en hy het heengegaan en met die volk saamgewoon.

kjv_text: And Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they slew the Canaanites that inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. And the name of the city was called Hormah.
bsb_text: Then the men of Judah went with their brothers the Simeonites, attacked the Canaanites living in Zephath, and devoted the city to destruction. So it was called Hormah.
aov_text: En Juda het saam met sy broer Símeon getrek, en hulle het die Kanaäniete verslaan wat in Sefat gewoon het en dit met die banvloek getref; daarom noem hulle die stad Horma.

kjv_text: Also Judah took Gaza with the coast thereof, and Askelon with the coast thereof, and Ekron with the coast thereof.
bsb_text: And Judah also captured Gaza, Ashkelon, and Ekron—each with its territory.
aov_text: En Juda het Gasa met sy grondgebied en Áskelon met sy grondgebied en Ekron met sy grondgebied ingeneem.

kjv_text: And the LORD was with Judah; and he drave out the inhabitants of the mountain; but could not drive out the inhabitants of the valley, because they had chariots of iron.
bsb_text: The LORD was with Judah, and they took possession of the hill country; but they could not drive out the inhabitants of the plains because they had chariots of iron.
aov_text: En die HERE was met Juda, sodat hy die gebergte in besit geneem het; maar die bewoners van die laagte kon hy nie verdrywe nie, omdat hulle ysterwaens gehad het.

kjv_text: And they gave Hebron unto Caleb, as Moses said: and he expelled thence the three sons of Anak.
bsb_text: Just as Moses had promised, Judah gave Hebron to Caleb, who drove out the descendants of the three sons of Anak.
aov_text: En hulle het Hebron aan Kaleb gegee, soos Moses gespreek het; en hy het die drie seuns van Enak daaruit verdrywe.

kjv_text: And the children of Benjamin did not drive out the Jebusites that inhabited Jerusalem; but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem unto this day.
bsb_text: The Benjamites, however, failed to drive out the Jebusites living in Jerusalem. So to this day the Jebusites live there among the Benjamites.
aov_text: En die kinders van Benjamin het die Jebusiete, die inwoners van Jerusalem, nie verdrywe nie, sodat die Jebusiete saam met die kinders van Benjamin in Jerusalem woon tot vandag toe.

kjv_text: And the house of Joseph, they also went up against Bethel: and the LORD was with them.
bsb_text: The house of Joseph also attacked Bethel, and the LORD was with them.
aov_text: En die huis van Josef, hulle het ook opgetrek na Bet-el, en die HERE was met hulle.

kjv_text: And the house of Joseph sent to descry Bethel. (Now the name of the city before was Luz.)
bsb_text: They sent spies to Bethel (formerly known as Luz),
aov_text: En toe die huis van Josef Bet-el laat bespied—maar die naam van die stad was tevore Lus —

kjv_text: And the spies saw a man come forth out of the city, and they said unto him, Shew us, we pray thee, the entrance into the city, and we will shew thee mercy.
bsb_text: and when the spies saw a man coming out of the city, they said to him, “Please show us how to get into the city, and we will treat you kindly.”
aov_text: sien die spioene ’n man uit die stad uitkom, en hulle sê vir hom: Wys ons tog ’n plek om in die stad in te kom, dan sal ons jou ’n guns bewys.

kjv_text: And when he shewed them the entrance into the city, they smote the city with the edge of the sword; but they let go the man and all his family.
bsb_text: So the man showed them the entrance to the city, and they put the city to the sword but released that man and all his family.
aov_text: Hy wys hulle toe ’n plek om in die stad in te kom; en hulle het die stad verslaan met die skerpte van die swaard; maar die man en sy hele geslag het hulle laat gaan.

kjv_text: And the man went into the land of the Hittites, and built a city, and called the name thereof Luz: which is the name thereof unto this day.
bsb_text: And the man went to the land of the Hittites, built a city, and called it Luz, which is its name to this day.
aov_text: En die man het weggetrek na die land van die Hetiete, en hy het ’n stad gebou en dit Lus genoem; dit is sy naam tot vandag toe.

kjv_text: Neither did Manasseh drive out the inhabitants of Bethshean and her towns, nor Taanach and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Dor and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns: but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.
bsb_text: At that time Manasseh failed to drive out the inhabitants of Beth-shean, Taanach, Dor, Ibleam, Megiddo, and their villages; for the Canaanites were determined to dwell in that land.
aov_text: En Manasse het Bet-Sean met sy onderhorige plekke en Táänag met sy onderhorige plekke en die inwoners van Dor met sy onderhorige plekke en die inwoners van Jíbleam met sy onderhorige plekke en die inwoners van Megíddo met sy onderhorige plekke nie verdrywe nie; en die Kanaäniete het verkies om in hierdie land te bly woon.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when Israel was strong, that they put the Canaanites to tribute, and did not utterly drive them out.
bsb_text: When Israel became stronger, they pressed the Canaanites into forced labor, but they never drove them out completely.
aov_text: Maar toe Israel sterk word, het hy die Kanaäniete dienspligtig gemaak; hy het hulle egter nie heeltemal verdrywe nie.

kjv_text: Neither did Ephraim drive out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwelt in Gezer among them.
bsb_text: Ephraim also failed to drive out the Canaanites living in Gezer; so the Canaanites continued to dwell among them in Gezer.
aov_text: En Efraim het die Kanaäniete, die inwoners van Geser, nie verdrywe nie; sodat die Kanaäniete in sy midde in Geser bly woon het.

kjv_text: Neither did Zebulun drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites dwelt among them, and became tributaries.
bsb_text: Zebulun failed to drive out the inhabitants of Kitron and Nahalol; so the Canaanites lived among them and served as forced laborers.
aov_text: Sébulon het die inwoners van Kitron en die inwoners van Náhalol nie verdrywe nie; sodat die Kanaäniete in sy midde bly woon het; maar hulle het dienspligtig geword.

kjv_text: Neither did Asher drive out the inhabitants of Accho, nor the inhabitants of Zidon, nor of Ahlab, nor of Achzib, nor of Helbah, nor of Aphik, nor of Rehob:
bsb_text: Asher failed to drive out the inhabitants of Acco, Sidon, Ahlab, Achzib, Helbah, Aphik, and Rehob.
aov_text: Aser het die inwoners van Akko en die inwoners van Sidon en Aglab en Agsib en Helba en Afik en Rehob nie verdrywe nie;

kjv_text: But the Asherites dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: for they did not drive them out.
bsb_text: So the Asherites lived among the Canaanite inhabitants of the land, because they did not drive them out.
aov_text: sodat die Aseriete bly woon het onder die Kanaäniete, die bevolking van die land, want hulle het hulle nie verdrywe nie.

kjv_text: Neither did Naphtali drive out the inhabitants of Bethshemesh, nor the inhabitants of Bethanath; but he dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: nevertheless the inhabitants of Bethshemesh and of Bethanath became tributaries unto them.
bsb_text: Naphtali failed to drive out the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh and Beth-anath. So the Naphtalites also lived among the Canaanite inhabitants of the land, but the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh and Beth-anath served them as forced laborers.
aov_text: Náftali het die inwoners van Bet-Semes en die inwoners van Bet-Anat nie verdrywe nie, sodat hy bly woon het onder die Kanaäniete, die bevolking van die land; maar die inwoners van Bet-Semes en Bet-Anat het aan hulle dienspligtig geword.

kjv_text: And the Amorites forced the children of Dan into the mountain: for they would not suffer them to come down to the valley:
bsb_text: The Amorites forced the Danites into the hill country and did not allow them to come down into the plain.
aov_text: En die Amoriete het die kinders van Dan die gebergte in gedruk, want hulle het hul nie toegelaat om na die laagte af te kom nie;

kjv_text: But the Amorites would dwell in mount Heres in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim: yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became tributaries.
bsb_text: And the Amorites were determined to dwell in Mount Heres, Aijalon, and Shaalbim. But when the house of Joseph grew in strength, they pressed the Amorites into forced labor.
aov_text: sodat die Amoriete verkies het om te bly woon in Har-Heres, in Ájalon en in Sáälbim; maar die hand van die huis van Josef was swaar, sodat hulle dienspligtig geword het.

kjv_text: And the coast of the Amorites was from the going up to Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward.
bsb_text: And the border of the Amorites extended from the Ascent of Akrabbim to Sela and beyond.
aov_text: En die grens van die Amoriete was van Skerpioen-nek, van die rots af, en verder op.

kjv_text: And an angel of the LORD came up from Gilgal to Bochim, and said, I made you to go up out of Egypt, and have brought you unto the land which I sware unto your fathers; and I said, I will never break my covenant with you.
bsb_text: Now the angel of the LORD went up from Gilgal to Bochim and said, “I brought you up out of Egypt and led you into the land that I had promised to your fathers, and I said, ‘I will never break My covenant with you,
aov_text: TOE trek die Engel van die HERE van Gilgal op na Bogim en sê: Ek het julle uit Egipte laat optrek en julle gebring in die land wat Ek julle vaders met ’n eed beloof het, en gesê: Ek sal my verbond met julle in ewigheid nie verbreek nie;

kjv_text: And ye shall make no league with the inhabitants of this land; ye shall throw down their altars: but ye have not obeyed my voice: why have ye done this?
bsb_text: and you are not to make a covenant with the people of this land, but you shall tear down their altars.’ Yet you have not obeyed My voice. What is this you have done?
aov_text: maar julle mag geen verbond met die inwoners van hierdie land maak nie; hulle altare moet julle omgooi. Maar julle het nie na my stem geluister nie. Wat het julle nou gedoen?

kjv_text: Wherefore I also said, I will not drive them out from before you; but they shall be as thorns in your sides, and their gods shall be a snare unto you.
bsb_text: So now I tell you that I will not drive out these people before you; they will be thorns in your sides, and their gods will be a snare to you.”
aov_text: So sê Ek dan ook: Ek sal hulle nie voor julle uit verdrywe nie, sodat hulle vyande vir julle sal wees, en hulle gode ’n strik vir julle.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when the angel of the LORD spake these words unto all the children of Israel, that the people lifted up their voice, and wept.
bsb_text: When the angel of the LORD had spoken these words to all the Israelites, the people lifted up their voices and wept.
aov_text: En terwyl die Engel van die HERE met hierdie woorde al die kinders van Israel toespreek, het die volk hulle stem verhef en geween;

kjv_text: And they called the name of that place Bochim: and they sacrificed there unto the LORD.
bsb_text: So they called that place Bochim and offered sacrifices there to the LORD.
aov_text: en hulle het dié plek Bogim genoem en daar aan die HERE geoffer.

kjv_text: And when Joshua had let the people go, the children of Israel went every man unto his inheritance to possess the land.
bsb_text: After Joshua had dismissed the people, the Israelites went out to take possession of the land, each to his own inheritance.
aov_text: DAARNA het Josua die volk laat gaan, en die kinders van Israel het elkeen na sy erfdeel getrek om die land in besit te neem.

kjv_text: And the people served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that outlived Joshua, who had seen all the great works of the LORD, that he did for Israel.
bsb_text: And the people served the LORD throughout the days of Joshua and of the elders who outlived him, who had seen all the great works that the LORD had done for Israel.
aov_text: En die volk het die HERE gedien al die dae van Josua en al die dae van die oudstes wat ná Josua nog in die lewe was, en al die groot werke van die HERE gesien het wat Hy vir Israel gedoen het.

kjv_text: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died, being an hundred and ten years old.
bsb_text: And Joshua son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died at the age of 110.
aov_text: Maar Josua, die seun van Nun, die kneg van die HERE, het gesterwe, honderd-en-tien jaar oud;

kjv_text: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnathheres, in the mount of Ephraim, on the north side of the hill Gaash.
bsb_text: They buried him in the land of his inheritance, at Timnath-heres in the hill country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.
aov_text: en hulle het hom begrawe op die gebied van sy erfdeel in Timnat-Heres, op die gebergte van Efraim, noord van die berg Gaäs.

kjv_text: And also all that generation were gathered unto their fathers: and there arose another generation after them, which knew not the LORD, nor yet the works which he had done for Israel.
bsb_text: After that whole generation had also been gathered to their fathers, another generation rose up who did not know the LORD or the works that He had done for Israel.
aov_text: En toe ook daardie hele geslag by hulle vaders versamel is, staan daar ’n ander geslag ná hulle op wat die HERE en ook die werk wat Hy vir Israel gedoen het, nie geken het nie.

kjv_text: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD, and served Baalim:
bsb_text: And the Israelites did evil in the sight of the LORD and served the Baals.
aov_text: En die kinders van Israel het gedoen wat verkeerd was in die oë van die HERE: hulle het die Baäls gedien

kjv_text: And they forsook the LORD God of their fathers, which brought them out of the land of Egypt, and followed other gods, of the gods of the people that were round about them, and bowed themselves unto them, and provoked the LORD to anger.
bsb_text: Thus they forsook the LORD, the God of their fathers, who had brought them out of the land of Egypt, and they followed after various gods of the peoples around them. They bowed down to them and provoked the LORD to anger,
aov_text: en die HERE, die God van hulle vaders, verlaat wat hulle uit Egipteland uitgelei het, en hulle het agter ander gode aan geloop, van die gode van die volke wat rondom hulle was, en hulle daarvoor neergebuig en die HERE geterg.

kjv_text: And they forsook the LORD, and served Baal and Ashtaroth.
bsb_text: for they forsook Him and served Baal and the Ashtoreths.
aov_text: Maar toe hulle die HERE verlaat en die Baäl en die Astartes dien,

kjv_text: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and he delivered them into the hands of spoilers that spoiled them, and he sold them into the hands of their enemies round about, so that they could not any longer stand before their enemies.
bsb_text: Then the anger of the LORD burned against Israel, and He delivered them into the hands of those who plundered them. He sold them into the hands of their enemies all around, whom they were no longer able to resist.
aov_text: het die toorn van die HERE teen Israel ontvlam, en Hy het hulle oorgegee in die hand van rowers wat hulle beroof het; en Hy het hulle verkoop in die hand van hulle vyande rondom, sodat hulle nie meer kon standhou voor hulle vyande nie.

kjv_text: Whithersoever they went out, the hand of the LORD was against them for evil, as the LORD had said, and as the LORD had sworn unto them: and they were greatly distressed.
bsb_text: Wherever Israel marched out, the hand of the LORD was against them to bring calamity, just as He had sworn to them. So they were greatly distressed.
aov_text: Waarheen hulle ook al uittrek, was die hand van die HERE teen hulle ten kwade, soos die HERE gespreek en soos die HERE vir hulle gesweer het. Maar wanneer hulle dan in groot benoudheid raak,

kjv_text: Nevertheless the LORD raised up judges, which delivered them out of the hand of those that spoiled them.
bsb_text: Then the LORD raised up judges, who saved them from the hands of those who plundered them.
aov_text: verwek die HERE rigters wat hulle verlos uit die hand van hulle berowers.

kjv_text: And yet they would not hearken unto their judges, but they went a whoring after other gods, and bowed themselves unto them: they turned quickly out of the way which their fathers walked in, obeying the commandments of the LORD; but they did not so.
bsb_text: Israel, however, did not listen to their judges. Instead, they prostituted themselves with other gods and bowed down to them. They quickly turned from the way of their fathers, who had walked in obedience to the LORD’s commandments; they did not do as their fathers had done.
aov_text: Na hulle rigters het hulle egter ook nie geluister nie, maar agter ander gode aan gehoereer en hulle daarvoor neergebuig; gou het hulle afgewyk van die weg wat hulle vaders bewandel het in gehoorsaamheid aan die gebooie van die HERE: so het hulle nie gedoen nie.

kjv_text: And when the LORD raised them up judges, then the LORD was with the judge, and delivered them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge: for it repented the LORD because of their groanings by reason of them that oppressed them and vexed them.
bsb_text: Whenever the LORD raised up a judge for the Israelites, He was with that judge and saved them from the hands of their enemies while the judge was still alive; for the LORD was moved to pity by their groaning under those who oppressed them and afflicted them.
aov_text: En wanneer die HERE vir hulle rigters verwek, was die HERE met die rigter om hulle te verlos uit die hand van hul vyande al die dae van die rigter, omdat die HERE medelyde gehad het vanweë hulle gekerm oor hulle verdrukkers en hulle verdringers.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when the judge was dead, that they returned, and corrupted themselves more than their fathers, in following other gods to serve them, and to bow down unto them; they ceased not from their own doings, nor from their stubborn way.
bsb_text: But when the judge died, the Israelites became even more corrupt than their fathers, going after other gods to serve them and bow down to them. They would not give up their evil practices and stubborn ways.
aov_text: Maar wanneer die rigter dood was, het hulle nog erger as hulle vaders gehandel deur agter ander gode aan te loop, om hulle te dien en hulle daarvoor neer te buig: hulle het niks laat vaar van hulle handelinge en van hulle hardnekkige wandel nie.

kjv_text: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel; and he said, Because that this people hath transgressed my covenant which I commanded their fathers, and have not hearkened unto my voice;
bsb_text: So the anger of the LORD burned against Israel, and He said, “Because this nation has transgressed the covenant I laid down for their fathers and has not heeded My voice,
aov_text: Daarom het die toorn van die HERE teen Israel ontvlam, en Hy het gesê: Omdat hierdie nasie my verbond wat Ek hulle vaders beveel het, oortree en na my stem nie luister nie,

kjv_text: I also will not henceforth drive out any from before them of the nations which Joshua left when he died:
bsb_text: I will no longer drive out before them any of the nations Joshua left when he died.
aov_text: sal Ek ook verder geeneen van die nasies wat Josua by sy dood laat oorbly het, voor hulle uit verdrywe nie —

kjv_text: That through them I may prove Israel, whether they will keep the way of the LORD to walk therein, as their fathers did keep it, or not.
bsb_text: In this way I will test whether Israel will keep the way of the LORD by walking in it as their fathers did.”
aov_text: om Israel deur hulle op die proef te stel, of hulle die weg van die HERE sal hou deur daarin te wandel soos hulle vaders dit gehou het, of nie.

kjv_text: Therefore the LORD left those nations, without driving them out hastily; neither delivered he them into the hand of Joshua.
bsb_text: That is why the LORD had left those nations in place and had not driven them out immediately by delivering them into the hand of Joshua.
aov_text: Daarom het die HERE daardie nasies laat oorbly sonder om hulle dadelik te verdrywe, en hulle nie in die hand van Josua gegee nie.

kjv_text: Now these are the nations which the LORD left, to prove Israel by them, even as many of Israel as had not known all the wars of Canaan;
bsb_text: These are the nations that the LORD left to test all the Israelites who had not known any of the wars in Canaan,
aov_text: EN dit is die nasies wat die HERE laat oorbly het om Israel, almal wat al die oorloë van Kanaän nie geken het nie, deur hulle op die proef te stel —

kjv_text: Only that the generations of the children of Israel might know, to teach them war, at the least such as before knew nothing thereof;
bsb_text: if only to teach warfare to the subsequent generations of Israel, especially to those who had not known it formerly:
aov_text: net dat die geslagte van die kinders van Israel dit kan weet—om hulle te leer oorlog voer, ten minste die wat daar vroeër nie van geweet het nie:

kjv_text: Namely, five lords of the Philistines, and all the Canaanites, and the Sidonians, and the Hivites that dwelt in mount Lebanon, from mount Baalhermon unto the entering in of Hamath.
bsb_text: the five rulers of the Philistines, all the Canaanites, the Sidonians, and the Hivites who lived in the mountains of Lebanon from Mount Baal-hermon to Lebo-hamath.
aov_text: vyf vorste van die Filistyne en al die Kanaäniete en Sidoniërs en Hewiete wat in die gebergte Líbanon gewoon het, van die berg Baäl-Hermon af tot by die ingang na Hamat.

kjv_text: And they were to prove Israel by them, to know whether they would hearken unto the commandments of the LORD, which he commanded their fathers by the hand of Moses.
bsb_text: These nations were left to test the Israelites, to find out whether they would keep the commandments of the LORD, which He had given their fathers through Moses.
aov_text: Hulle was dan daar om deur hulle Israel op die proef te stel; om te weet of hulle na die gebooie van die HERE wat Hy hulle vaders deur Moses beveel het, sou luister.

kjv_text: And the children of Israel dwelt among the Canaanites, Hittites, and Amorites, and Perizzites, and Hivites, and Jebusites:
bsb_text: Thus the Israelites continued to live among the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
aov_text: SO het die kinders van Israel dan onder die Kanaäniete, Hetiete en Amoriete en Feresiete en Hewiete en Jebusiete gewoon,

kjv_text: And they took their daughters to be their wives, and gave their daughters to their sons, and served their gods.
bsb_text: And they took the daughters of these people in marriage, gave their own daughters to their sons, and served their gods.
aov_text: en húl dogters vir hulle as vroue geneem en hulle eie dogters aan húl seuns gegee en hul gode gedien.

kjv_text: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD, and forgat the LORD their God, and served Baalim and the groves.
bsb_text: So the Israelites did evil in the sight of the LORD; they forgot the LORD their God and served the Baals and the Asherahs.
aov_text: En die kinders van Israel het gedoen wat verkeerd was in die oë van die HERE en die HERE hulle God vergeet en die Baäls en die heilige boomstamme gedien.

kjv_text: Therefore the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of Chushanrishathaim king of Mesopotamia: and the children of Israel served Chushanrishathaim eight years.
bsb_text: Then the anger of the LORD burned against Israel, and He sold them into the hand of Cushan-rishathaim king of Aram-naharaim, and the Israelites served him eight years.
aov_text: Daarop het die toorn van die HERE teen Israel ontvlam, en Hy het hulle verkoop in die hand van Kusan Risatáim, die koning van Mesopotámië, en die kinders van Israel het Kusan Risatáim agt jaar lank gedien.

kjv_text: And when the children of Israel cried unto the LORD, the LORD raised up a deliverer to the children of Israel, who delivered them, even Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother.
bsb_text: But when the Israelites cried out to the LORD, He raised up Othniel son of Caleb’s younger brother Kenaz as a deliverer to save them.
aov_text: Maar toe die kinders van Israel die HERE aanroep, het die HERE ’n verlosser vir die kinders van Israel verwek, wat hulle verlos het: Ótniël, die seun van Kenas, die jonger broer van Kaleb.

kjv_text: And the Spirit of the LORD came upon him, and he judged Israel, and went out to war: and the LORD delivered Chushanrishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand; and his hand prevailed against Chushanrishathaim.
bsb_text: The Spirit of the LORD came upon him, and he became Israel’s judge and went out to war. And the LORD delivered Cushan-rishathaim king of Aram into the hand of Othniel, who prevailed against him.
aov_text: En die Gees van die HERE het op hom gekom, en hy het Israel gerig en uitgetrek om oorlog te voer; en die HERE het Kusan Risatáim, die koning van Aram, in sy hand gegee, sodat hy die oorhand oor Kusan Risatáim gekry het.

kjv_text: And the land had rest forty years. And Othniel the son of Kenaz died.
bsb_text: So the land had rest for forty years, until Othniel son of Kenaz died.
aov_text: Toe kry die land rus veertig jaar lank. En Ótniël, die seun van Kenas, het gesterwe.

kjv_text: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD: and the LORD strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel, because they had done evil in the sight of the LORD.
bsb_text: Once again the Israelites did evil in the sight of the LORD. So He gave Eglon king of Moab power over Israel, because they had done evil in the sight of the LORD.
aov_text: EN die kinders van Israel het weer gedoen wat verkeerd was in die oë van die HERE. Toe maak die HERE Eglon, die koning van Moab, sterk teen Israel, omdat hulle gedoen het wat verkeerd was in die oë van die HERE;

kjv_text: And he gathered unto him the children of Ammon and Amalek, and went and smote Israel, and possessed the city of palm trees.
bsb_text: After enlisting the Ammonites and Amalekites to join forces with him, Eglon attacked and defeated Israel, taking possession of the City of Palms.
aov_text: en hy versamel by hom die kinders van Ammon en Ámalek. Daarop het hy weggetrek en Israel verslaan, en hulle het die Palmstad in besit geneem.

kjv_text: So the children of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years.
bsb_text: The Israelites served Eglon king of Moab eighteen years.
aov_text: En die kinders van Israel het Eglon, die koning van Moab, agttien jaar lank gedien.

kjv_text: But when the children of Israel cried unto the LORD, the LORD raised them up a deliverer, Ehud the son of Gera, a Benjamite, a man lefthanded: and by him the children of Israel sent a present unto Eglon the king of Moab.
bsb_text: And again they cried out to the LORD, and He raised up Ehud son of Gera, a left-handed Benjamite, as their deliverer. So they sent him with tribute to Eglon king of Moab.
aov_text: Maar toe die kinders van Israel die HERE aanroep, het die HERE vir hulle as verlosser verwek: Ehud, die seun van Gera, die Benjaminiet, ’n man wat links was. Deur hom stuur toe die kinders van Israel die belasting aan Eglon, die koning van Moab.

kjv_text: But Ehud made him a dagger which had two edges, of a cubit length; and he did gird it under his raiment upon his right thigh.
bsb_text: Now Ehud had made for himself a double-edged sword a cubit long. He strapped it to his right thigh under his cloak
aov_text: En Ehud het vir hom ’n swaard gemaak, aan twee kante skerp, een el lank, en dit onder sy klere aan sy regterheup vasgegord;

kjv_text: And he brought the present unto Eglon king of Moab: and Eglon was a very fat man.
bsb_text: and brought the tribute to Eglon king of Moab, who was an obese man.
aov_text: en hy het die belasting aan Eglon, die koning van Moab, gebring; en Eglon was ’n baie vet man.

kjv_text: And when he had made an end to offer the present, he sent away the people that bare the present.
bsb_text: After Ehud had finished presenting the tribute, he ushered out those who had carried it.
aov_text: En toe hy die belasting volledig afgelewer het, bring hy die mense wat die belasting gedra het, weg;

kjv_text: But he himself turned again from the quarries that were by Gilgal, and said, I have a secret errand unto thee, O king: who said, Keep silence. And all that stood by him went out from him.
bsb_text: But upon reaching the idols near Gilgal, he himself turned back and said, “I have a secret message for you, O king.” “Silence,” said the king, and all his attendants left him.
aov_text: maar hy self het omgedraai by die gesnede beelde wat by Gilgal was, en gesê: Ek het ’n geheime opdrag aan u, o koning! Dié sê toe: Stil! En almal wat by hom staan, het van hom af weggegaan buitentoe.

kjv_text: And Ehud came unto him; and he was sitting in a summer parlour, which he had for himself alone. And Ehud said, I have a message from God unto thee. And he arose out of his seat.
bsb_text: Then Ehud approached him while he was sitting alone in the coolness of his upper room. “I have a word from God for you,” Ehud said, and the king rose from his seat.
aov_text: En toe Ehud by hom inkom, terwyl hy in die koel bo-kamer sit wat vir hom alleen was, sê Ehud: Ek het ’n woord van God aan u! En toe hy van sy stoel af opstaan,

kjv_text: And Ehud put forth his left hand, and took the dagger from his right thigh, and thrust it into his belly:
bsb_text: And Ehud reached with his left hand, pulled the sword from his right thigh, and plunged it into Eglon’s belly.
aov_text: steek Ehud sy linkerhand uit en gryp die swaard van sy regterheup af en steek dit in sy buik,

kjv_text: And the haft also went in after the blade; and the fat closed upon the blade, so that he could not draw the dagger out of his belly; and the dirt came out.
bsb_text: Even the handle sank in after the blade, and Eglon’s fat closed in over it, so that Ehud did not withdraw the sword from his belly. And Eglon’s bowels emptied.
aov_text: sodat selfs die hef agter die lem ingedring het en die vet, want hy het die swaard nie uit sy buik uitgetrek nie, om die lem toegesluit en by die wond uitgepuil het.

kjv_text: Then Ehud went forth through the porch, and shut the doors of the parlour upon him, and locked them.
bsb_text: Then Ehud went out through the porch, closing and locking the doors of the upper room behind him.
aov_text: Toe gaan Ehud uit op die galery, maar hy het die deure van die bo-kamer agter hom gesluit en gegrendel.

kjv_text: When he was gone out, his servants came; and when they saw that, behold, the doors of the parlour were locked, they said, Surely he covereth his feet in his summer chamber.
bsb_text: After Ehud was gone, Eglon’s servants came in and found the doors of the upper room locked. “He must be relieving himself in the cool room,” they said.
aov_text: Net toe hy uitgegaan het, kom sy dienaars; en toe hulle sien en kyk: die deure van die bo-kamer was gegrendel, sê hulle: Hy is seker besig om sy voete te bedek in die koel kamer.

kjv_text: And they tarried till they were ashamed: and, behold, he opened not the doors of the parlour; therefore they took a key, and opened them: and, behold, their lord was fallen down dead on the earth.
bsb_text: So they waited until they became worried and saw that he had still not opened the doors of the upper room. Then they took the key and opened the doors—and there was their lord lying dead on the floor.
aov_text: En hulle het gewag totdat hulle verleë was; maar—hy het die deure van die bo-kamer nie oopgemaak nie! En toe hulle die sleutel gaan haal en oopsluit, lê hulle heer daar dood op die grond!

kjv_text: And Ehud escaped while they tarried, and passed beyond the quarries, and escaped unto Seirath.
bsb_text: Ehud, however, had escaped while the servants waited. He passed by the idols and escaped to Seirah.
aov_text: Maar terwyl hulle nog talm, het Ehud ontvlug en die gesnede beelde verbygegaan en na Seïra ontsnap.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when he was come, that he blew a trumpet in the mountain of Ephraim, and the children of Israel went down with him from the mount, and he before them.
bsb_text: On arriving in Seirah, he blew the ram’s horn throughout the hill country of Ephraim. The Israelites came down with him from the hills, and he became their leader.
aov_text: En toe hy aankom, blaas hy op die ramshoring op die gebergte van Efraim, en die kinders van Israel het saam met hom van die gebergte afgetrek, en hy voor hulle uit.

kjv_text: And he said unto them, Follow after me: for the LORD hath delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand. And they went down after him, and took the fords of Jordan toward Moab, and suffered not a man to pass over.
bsb_text: “Follow me,” he told them, “for the LORD has delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand.” So they followed him down and seized the fords of the Jordan leading to Moab, and did not allow anyone to cross over.
aov_text: Toe sê hy vir hulle: Volg my, want die HERE gee julle vyande, die Moabiete, in julle hand; en hulle het agter hom aan afgetrek en die Moabiete van die driwwe van die Jordaan afgesny en niemand toegelaat om deur te gaan nie.

kjv_text: And they slew of Moab at that time about ten thousand men, all lusty, and all men of valour; and there escaped not a man.
bsb_text: At that time they struck down about ten thousand Moabites, all robust and valiant men. Not one of them escaped.
aov_text: En hulle het in dié tyd van Moab omtrent tienduisend man verslaan, almal goed geboude en almal dapper manne, en niemand het vrygekom nie.

kjv_text: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel. And the land had rest fourscore years.
bsb_text: So Moab was subdued under the hand of Israel that day, and the land had rest for eighty years.
aov_text: So moes Moab dan dié dag buig onder die hand van Israel; en die land het tagtig jaar lank gerus.

kjv_text: And after him was Shamgar the son of Anath, which slew of the Philistines six hundred men with an ox goad: and he also delivered Israel.
bsb_text: After Ehud came Shamgar son of Anath. And he too saved Israel, striking down six hundred Philistines with an oxgoad.
aov_text: Toe kom ná hom Samgar, die seun van Anat, wat van die Filistyne seshonderd man met ’n osdrywerstok verslaan het; en ook hy het Israel verlos.

kjv_text: And the children of Israel again did evil in the sight of the LORD, when Ehud was dead.
bsb_text: After Ehud died, the Israelites again did evil in the sight of the LORD.
aov_text: MAAR ná die dood van Ehud het die kinders van Israel weer gedoen wat verkeerd was in die oë van die HERE.

kjv_text: And the LORD sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, that reigned in Hazor; the captain of whose host was Sisera, which dwelt in Harosheth of the Gentiles.
bsb_text: So the LORD sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, who reigned in Hazor. The commander of his forces was Sisera, who lived in Harosheth-hagoyim.
aov_text: Daarom het die HERE hulle verkoop in die hand van Jabin, die koning van Kanaän, wat in Hasor geregeer het; en sy leërowerste was Sísera, ’n inwoner van Haróset van die heidene.

kjv_text: And the children of Israel cried unto the LORD: for he had nine hundred chariots of iron; and twenty years he mightily oppressed the children of Israel.
bsb_text: Then the Israelites cried out to the LORD, because Jabin had nine hundred chariots of iron, and he had harshly oppressed the Israelites for twenty years.
aov_text: En die kinders van Israel het die HERE aangeroep; want hy het nege-honderd ysterwaens gehad en die kinders van Israel twintig jaar lank swaar verdruk.

kjv_text: And Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lapidoth, she judged Israel at that time.
bsb_text: Now Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lappidoth, was judging Israel at that time.
aov_text: En Debóra, ’n profetes, die vrou van Láppidot, het in dié tyd Israel gerig;

kjv_text: And she dwelt under the palm tree of Deborah between Ramah and Bethel in mount Ephraim: and the children of Israel came up to her for judgment.
bsb_text: And she would sit under the Palm of Deborah between Ramah and Bethel in the hill country of Ephraim, where the Israelites would go up to her for judgment.
aov_text: en sy het gesit onder die palm van Debóra, tussen Rama en Bet-el, op die gebergte van Efraim; en die kinders van Israel het na haar opgegaan vir regspraak.

kjv_text: And she sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedeshnaphtali, and said unto him, Hath not the LORD God of Israel commanded, saying, Go and draw toward mount Tabor, and take with thee ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun?
bsb_text: She summoned Barak son of Abinoam from Kedesh in Naphtali and said to him, “Surely the LORD, the God of Israel, is commanding you: ‘Go and march to Mount Tabor, taking with you ten thousand men of Naphtali and Zebulun.
aov_text: Toe laat sy Barak, die seun van Abinóam, uit Kedes in Náftali, roep en sê vir hom: Het die HERE, die God van Israel, nie bevel gegee nie: Gaan, trek na die berg Tabor, en neem tienduisend man van die kinders van Náftali en van die kinders van Sébulon met jou saam?

kjv_text: And I will draw unto thee to the river Kishon Sisera, the captain of Jabin's army, with his chariots and his multitude; and I will deliver him into thine hand.
bsb_text: And I will draw out Sisera the commander of Jabin’s army, his chariots, and his troops to the River Kishon, and I will deliver him into your hand.’”
aov_text: dan sal Ek Sísera, die leërowerste van Jabin, met sy strydwaens en sy menigte na jou, na die spruit Kison trek, en Ek sal hom in jou hand gee.

kjv_text: And Barak said unto her, If thou wilt go with me, then I will go: but if thou wilt not go with me, then I will not go.
bsb_text: Barak said to her, “If you will go with me, I will go; but if you will not go with me, I will not go.”
aov_text: Maar Barak sê vir haar: As u met my saamtrek, sal ek gaan; maar as u nie met my saamtrek nie, gaan ek nie.

kjv_text: And she said, I will surely go with thee: notwithstanding the journey that thou takest shall not be for thine honour; for the LORD shall sell Sisera into the hand of a woman. And Deborah arose, and went with Barak to Kedesh.
bsb_text: “I will certainly go with you,” Deborah replied, “but the road you are taking will bring you no honor, because the LORD will be selling Sisera into the hand of a woman.” So Deborah got up and went with Barak to Kedesh,
aov_text: Toe sê sy: Ek sal sekerlik met jou saamtrek, maar die eer sal nie joue wees op die pad wat jy sal gaan nie; want die HERE sal Sísera in die hand van ’n vrou verkoop; en Debóra het opgestaan en saam met Barak na Kedes getrek.

kjv_text: And Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali to Kedesh; and he went up with ten thousand men at his feet: and Deborah went up with him.
bsb_text: where he summoned Zebulun and Naphtali. Ten thousand men followed him, and Deborah also went with him.
aov_text: Daarop het Barak Sébulon en Náftali bymekaargeroep na Kedes toe, en tienduisend man het op sy voetspore opgetrek, en Debóra het saam met hom opgetrek.

kjv_text: Now Heber the Kenite, which was of the children of Hobab the father in law of Moses, had severed himself from the Kenites, and pitched his tent unto the plain of Zaanaim, which is by Kedesh.
bsb_text: Now Heber the Kenite had moved away from the Kenites, the descendants of Hobab the father-in-law of Moses, and had pitched his tent by the great tree of Zaanannim, which was near Kedesh.
aov_text: En Heber, die Keniet, het hom afgeskei van Kain, van die kinders van Hobab, die swaer van Moses, en het sy tente opgeslaan tot by die terpentynboom by Saänáim, naby Kedes.

kjv_text: And they shewed Sisera that Barak the son of Abinoam was gone up to mount Tabor.
bsb_text: When Sisera was told that Barak son of Abinoam had gone up Mount Tabor,
aov_text: En toe hulle aan Sísera berig bring dat Barak, die seun van Abinóam, na die berg Tabor opgetrek het,

kjv_text: And Sisera gathered together all his chariots, even nine hundred chariots of iron, and all the people that were with him, from Harosheth of the Gentiles unto the river of Kishon.
bsb_text: he summoned all nine hundred of his iron chariots and all the men with him, from Harosheth-hagoyim to the River Kishon.
aov_text: het Sísera al sy strydwaens, nege-honderd ysterwaens, en al die manskappe wat by hom was, uit Haróset van die heidene na die spruit Kison bymekaargeroep.

kjv_text: And Deborah said unto Barak, Up; for this is the day in which the LORD hath delivered Sisera into thine hand: is not the LORD gone out before thee? So Barak went down from mount Tabor, and ten thousand men after him.
bsb_text: Then Deborah said to Barak, “Arise, for this is the day that the LORD has delivered Sisera into your hand. Has not the LORD gone before you?” So Barak came down from Mount Tabor with ten thousand men following him.
aov_text: Daarop sê Debóra vir Barak: Maak jou klaar, want dit is die dag waarop die HERE Sísera in jou hand gee. Trek die HERE nie voor jou uit nie? Toe trek Barak van die berg Tabor af, en tienduisend man agter hom aan.

kjv_text: And the LORD discomfited Sisera, and all his chariots, and all his host, with the edge of the sword before Barak; so that Sisera lighted down off his chariot, and fled away on his feet.
bsb_text: And in front of him the LORD routed with the sword Sisera, all his charioteers, and all his army. Sisera abandoned his chariot and fled on foot.
aov_text: En die HERE het Sísera met al die waens en die hele leër deur die skerpte van die swaard in verwarring gebring voor Barak uit, en Sísera het van sy wa afgeklim en te voet gevlug.

kjv_text: But Barak pursued after the chariots, and after the host, unto Harosheth of the Gentiles: and all the host of Sisera fell upon the edge of the sword; and there was not a man left.
bsb_text: Then Barak pursued the chariots and army as far as Harosheth-hagoyim, and the whole army of Sisera fell by the sword; not a single man was left.
aov_text: Maar Barak het die waens en die leër agternagejaag tot by Haróset van die heidene, en die hele leër van Sísera het deur die skerpte van die swaard geval; daar het selfs nie een oorgebly nie.

kjv_text: Howbeit Sisera fled away on his feet to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite: for there was peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.
bsb_text: Meanwhile, Sisera had fled on foot to the tent of Jael, the wife of Heber the Kenite, because there was peace between Jabin king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.
aov_text: Toe vlug Sísera te voet na die tent van Jael, die vrou van Heber, die Keniet; want daar was vrede tussen Jabin, die koning van Hasor, en die huis van Heber, die Keniet.

kjv_text: And Jael went out to meet Sisera, and said unto him, Turn in, my lord, turn in to me; fear not. And when he had turned in unto her into the tent, she covered him with a mantle.
bsb_text: Jael went out to greet Sisera and said to him, “Come in, my lord. Come in with me. Do not be afraid.” So he entered her tent, and she covered him with a blanket.
aov_text: En Jael het uitgegaan Sísera tegemoet en vir hom gesê: Draai uit, my heer, draai uit na my! Moenie bang wees nie! En hy het na haar uitgedraai, na die tent, en sy het hom met ’n kombers toegemaak.

kjv_text: And he said unto her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water to drink; for I am thirsty. And she opened a bottle of milk, and gave him drink, and covered him.
bsb_text: Sisera said to her, “Please give me a little water to drink, for I am thirsty.” So she opened a container of milk, gave him a drink, and covered him again.
aov_text: Daarop sê hy vir haar: Gee my tog ’n bietjie water om te drink, want ek het dors; sy maak toe die melksak oop en laat hom daaruit drink en maak hom weer toe.

kjv_text: Again he said unto her, Stand in the door of the tent, and it shall be, when any man doth come and enquire of thee, and say, Is there any man here? that thou shalt say, No.
bsb_text: “Stand at the entrance to the tent,” he said, “and if anyone comes and asks you, ‘Is there a man here?’ say, ‘No.’”
aov_text: En hy sê vir haar: Gaan staan by die tentdeur, en as iemand kom en jou vra en sê: Is hier iemand? antwoord dan: Nee.

kjv_text: Then Jael Heber's wife took a nail of the tent, and took an hammer in her hand, and went softly unto him, and smote the nail into his temples, and fastened it into the ground: for he was fast asleep and weary. So he died.
bsb_text: But as he lay sleeping from exhaustion, Heber’s wife Jael took a tent peg, grabbed a hammer, and went silently to Sisera. She drove the peg through his temple and into the ground, and he died.
aov_text: Toe neem Jael, die vrou van Heber, ’n tentpen en vat die hamer in haar hand en gaan stilletjies na hom en dryf die pen terwyl hy vas aan die slaap was dwarsdeur die slaap van sy hoof, sodat dit in die grond indring. So het hy dan bewusteloos geword en gesterwe.

kjv_text: And, behold, as Barak pursued Sisera, Jael came out to meet him, and said unto him, Come, and I will shew thee the man whom thou seekest. And when he came into her tent, behold, Sisera lay dead, and the nail was in his temples.
bsb_text: When Barak arrived in pursuit of Sisera, Jael went out to greet him and said to him, “Come, and I will show you the man you are seeking.” So he went in with her, and there lay Sisera dead, with a tent peg through his temple.
