aov_text: En kyk, terwyl Barak Sísera agtervolg, gaan Jael uit hom tegemoet en sê vir hom: Kom, en ek sal u die man wys wat u soek; en toe hy by haar inkom, lê Sísera daar dood, met die pen deur die slaap van sy hoof!

kjv_text: So God subdued on that day Jabin the king of Canaan before the children of Israel.
bsb_text: On that day God subdued Jabin king of Canaan before the Israelites.
aov_text: So het God dan op dié dag Jabin, die koning van Kanaän, voor die kinders van Israel onderwerp.

kjv_text: And the hand of the children of Israel prospered, and prevailed against Jabin the king of Canaan, until they had destroyed Jabin king of Canaan.
bsb_text: And the hand of the Israelites grew stronger and stronger against Jabin king of Canaan until they destroyed him.
aov_text: En die hand van die kinders van Israel het al swaarder gaan druk op Jabin, die koning van Kanaän, totdat hulle Jabin, die koning van Kanaän, uitgeroei het.

kjv_text: Then sang Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam on that day, saying,
bsb_text: On that day Deborah and Barak son of Abinoam sang this song:
aov_text: OP dié dag het Debóra en Barak, die seun van Abinóam, gesing en gesê:

kjv_text: Praise ye the LORD for the avenging of Israel, when the people willingly offered themselves.
bsb_text: “When the princes take the lead in Israel, when the people volunteer, bless the LORD.
aov_text: Omdat aanvoerders aangevoer het in Israel, omdat die volk hom gewillig getoon het—prys die HERE!

kjv_text: Hear, O ye kings; give ear, O ye princes; I, even I, will sing unto the LORD; I will sing praise to the LORD God of Israel.
bsb_text: Listen, O kings! Give ear, O princes! I will sing to the LORD; I will sing praise to the LORD, the God of Israel.
aov_text: Hoor, o konings! Luister, o vorste! Ek, tot eer van die HERE wil ek sing, tot eer van die HERE, die God van Israel, wil ek psalmsing.

kjv_text: LORD, when thou wentest out of Seir, when thou marchedst out of the field of Edom, the earth trembled, and the heavens dropped, the clouds also dropped water.
bsb_text: O LORD, when You went out from Seir, when You marched from the land of Edom, the earth trembled, the heavens poured out rain, and the clouds poured down water.
aov_text: HERE, toe U uitgetrek het uit Seïr, toe U voortgestap het uit die veld van Edom, het die aarde gebeef, ook het die hemel gedrup, ook het die wolke water gedrup.

kjv_text: The mountains melted from before the LORD, even that Sinai from before the LORD God of Israel.
bsb_text: The mountains quaked before the LORD, the One of Sinai, before the LORD, the God of Israel.
aov_text: Berge het gewankel voor die aangesig van die HERE uit, hierdie Sinai voor die aangesig van die HERE, die God van Israel.

kjv_text: In the days of Shamgar the son of Anath, in the days of Jael, the highways were unoccupied, and the travellers walked through byways.
bsb_text: In the days of Shamgar son of Anath, in the days of Jael, the highways were deserted and the travelers took the byways.
aov_text: In die dae van Samgar, die seun van Anat, in die dae van Jael, was die paaie verlate, en die reisigers het langs sypaaie gegaan.

kjv_text: The inhabitants of the villages ceased, they ceased in Israel, until that I Deborah arose, that I arose a mother in Israel.
bsb_text: Life in the villages ceased; it ended in Israel, until I, Deborah, arose, a mother in Israel.
aov_text: Leiers het ontbreek in Israel, ontbreek; totdat ek, Debóra, opgestaan het, ek, ’n moeder in Israel, opgestaan het.

kjv_text: They chose new gods; then was war in the gates: was there a shield or spear seen among forty thousand in Israel?
bsb_text: When they chose new gods, then war came to their gates. Not a shield or spear was found among forty thousand in Israel.
aov_text: Kies hulle nuwe gode, dan is daar oorlog in die poorte; was daar skild of spies te sien onder veertigduisend in Israel?

kjv_text: My heart is toward the governors of Israel, that offered themselves willingly among the people. Bless ye the LORD.
bsb_text: My heart is with the princes of Israel, with the volunteers among the people. Bless the LORD!
aov_text: My hart is vir die aanvoerders van Israel wat hulle gewillig betoon het onder die volk—prys die HERE!

kjv_text: Speak, ye that ride on white asses, ye that sit in judgment, and walk by the way.
bsb_text: You who ride white donkeys, who sit on saddle blankets, and you who travel the road, ponder
aov_text: Julle wat op wit eselinne ry, wat op tapyte sit, wandelaars langs die paaie, dink na!

kjv_text: They that are delivered from the noise of archers in the places of drawing water, there shall they rehearse the righteous acts of the LORD, even the righteous acts toward the inhabitants of his villages in Israel: then shall the people of the LORD go down to the gates.
bsb_text: the voices of the singers at the watering places. There they shall recount the righteous acts of the LORD, the righteous deeds of His villagers in Israel. Then the people of the LORD went down to the gates:
aov_text: Vanweë die stem van die boogskutters tussen die drinkplekke, besing hulle daar die regverdige dade van die HERE, die regverdige dade van sy leiding in Israel. Toe het die volk van die HERE afgetrek na die poorte toe.

kjv_text: Awake, awake, Deborah: awake, awake, utter a song: arise, Barak, and lead thy captivity captive, thou son of Abinoam.
bsb_text: ‘Awake, awake, O Deborah! Awake, awake, sing a song! Arise, O Barak, and take hold of your captives, O son of Abinoam!’
aov_text: Word wakker, word wakker, Debóra! Word wakker, word wakker, hef ’n lied aan! Staan op, Barak! en voer jou gevangenes weg, seun van Abinóam!

kjv_text: Then he made him that remaineth have dominion over the nobles among the people: the LORD made me have dominion over the mighty.
bsb_text: Then the survivors came down to the nobles; the people of the LORD came down to me against the mighty.
aov_text: Toe het die oorblyfsel van die vername manne van die volk afgetrek, toe het die HERE vir my afgetrek onder die helde.

kjv_text: Out of Ephraim was there a root of them against Amalek; after thee, Benjamin, among thy people; out of Machir came down governors, and out of Zebulun they that handle the pen of the writer.
bsb_text: Some came from Ephraim, with their roots in Amalek; Benjamin came with your people after you. The commanders came down from Machir, the bearers of the marshal’s staff from Zebulun.
aov_text: Uit Efraim, die wat hulle wortel in Ámalek het; Benjamin, agter jou aan onder jou manskappe; uit Magir trek die aanvoerders af, en uit Sébulon die wat met die werwerstaf uittrek;

kjv_text: And the princes of Issachar were with Deborah; even Issachar, and also Barak: he was sent on foot into the valley. For the divisions of Reuben there were great thoughts of heart.
bsb_text: The princes of Issachar were with Deborah, and Issachar was with Barak, rushing into the valley at his heels. In the clans of Reuben there was great indecision.
aov_text: en vorste in Íssaskar met Debóra saam; en Íssaskar soos Barak: in die dal storm hulle op sy voetspore. In die afdelings van Ruben was die voornemens van die hart groot.

kjv_text: Why abodest thou among the sheepfolds, to hear the bleatings of the flocks? For the divisions of Reuben there were great searchings of heart.
bsb_text: Why did you sit among the sheepfolds to hear the whistling for the flocks? In the clans of Reuben there was great indecision.
aov_text: Waarom het jy tussen die veekrale bly sit en luister na die fluitspel by die troppe vee? In die afdelings van Ruben was die voornemens van die hart groot.

kjv_text: Gilead abode beyond Jordan: and why did Dan remain in ships? Asher continued on the sea shore, and abode in his breaches.
bsb_text: Gilead remained beyond the Jordan. Dan, why did you linger by the ships? Asher stayed at the coast and remained in his harbors.
aov_text: Gílead het rustig oorkant die Jordaan gebly; en Dan, waarom vertoef hy by die skepe? Aser het bly sit aan die seekus en aan sy baaie rustig gebly.

kjv_text: Zebulun and Naphtali were a people that jeoparded their lives unto the death in the high places of the field.
bsb_text: Zebulun was a people who risked their lives; Naphtali, too, on the heights of the battlefield.
aov_text: Sébulon is ’n volk wat sy siel gering ag tot die dood toe; ook Náftali op die hoogvlaktes.

kjv_text: The kings came and fought, then fought the kings of Canaan in Taanach by the waters of Megiddo; they took no gain of money.
bsb_text: Kings came and fought; then the kings of Canaan fought at Taanach by the waters of Megiddo, but they took no plunder of silver.
aov_text: Konings het gekom, geveg; toe het die konings van Kanaän geveg by Táänag, by die waters van Megíddo—geen stuk silwer het hulle geneem nie.

kjv_text: They fought from heaven; the stars in their courses fought against Sisera.
bsb_text: From the heavens the stars fought; from their courses they fought against Sisera.
aov_text: Uit die hemel het die sterre geveg, uit hulle bane het hulle teen Sísera geveg;

kjv_text: The river of Kishon swept them away, that ancient river, the river Kishon. O my soul, thou hast trodden down strength.
bsb_text: The River Kishon swept them away, the ancient river, the River Kishon. March on, O my soul, in strength!
aov_text: die spruit Kison het hulle afgedrywe, die spruit van ontmoeting, die spruit Kison! Tree op, my siel, met mag!

kjv_text: Then were the horsehoofs broken by the means of the pransings, the pransings of their mighty ones.
bsb_text: Then the hooves of horses thundered—the mad galloping of his stallions.
aov_text: Toe het die perdepote geklap van die gejaag, die gejaag van hulle geweldiges.

kjv_text: Curse ye Meroz, said the angel of the LORD, curse ye bitterly the inhabitants thereof; because they came not to the help of the LORD, to the help of the LORD against the mighty.
bsb_text: ‘Curse Meroz,’ says the angel of the LORD. ‘Bitterly curse her inhabitants; for they did not come to help the LORD, to help the LORD against the mighty.’
aov_text: Vloek Meros, sê die Engel van die HERE; ja, vervloek sy inwoners, omdat hulle die HERE nie tot hulp gekom het nie, die HERE tot hulp onder die helde.

kjv_text: Blessed above women shall Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite be, blessed shall she be above women in the tent.
bsb_text: Most blessed among women is Jael, the wife of Heber the Kenite, most blessed of tent-dwelling women.
aov_text: Mag bo die vroue geseënd wees Jael, die vrou van Heber, die Keniet; geseënd wees bo die vroue in die tent!

kjv_text: He asked water, and she gave him milk; she brought forth butter in a lordly dish.
bsb_text: He asked for water, and she gave him milk. In a magnificent bowl she brought him curds.
aov_text: Water het hy gevra, melk het sy gegee, in ’n sierlike skottel het sy dikmelk gebring.

kjv_text: She put her hand to the nail, and her right hand to the workmen's hammer; and with the hammer she smote Sisera, she smote off his head, when she had pierced and stricken through his temples.
bsb_text: She reached for the tent peg, her right hand for the workman’s hammer. She struck Sisera and crushed his skull; she shattered and pierced his temple.
aov_text: Haar hand steek sy uit na die tentpen en haar regterhand na die werksman se hamer; en sy hamer Sísera, verpletter sy kop en verbrysel en deurboor die slaap van sy hoof.

kjv_text: At her feet he bowed, he fell, he lay down: at her feet he bowed, he fell: where he bowed, there he fell down dead.
bsb_text: At her feet he collapsed, he fell, there he lay still; at her feet he collapsed, he fell; where he collapsed, there he fell dead.
aov_text: Tussen haar voete sak hy inmekaar, val, lê daar! Tussen haar voete sak hy inmekaar, val; waar hy inmekaarsak, daar lê hy—morsdood.

kjv_text: The mother of Sisera looked out at a window, and cried through the lattice, Why is his chariot so long in coming? why tarry the wheels of his chariots?
bsb_text: Sisera’s mother looked through the window; she peered through the lattice and lamented: ‘Why is his chariot so long in coming? What has delayed the clatter of his chariots?’
aov_text: Deur die venster kyk die moeder van Sísera uit, en sy roep deur die venstertralie: Waarom vertoef sy wa om te kom? Waarom versuim die passe van sy wa-span?

kjv_text: Her wise ladies answered her, yea, she returned answer to herself,
bsb_text: Her wisest ladies answer; indeed she keeps telling herself,
aov_text: Die skranderste van haar vorstinne antwoord haar, ja, sy self antwoord op haar woorde:

kjv_text: Have they not sped? have they not divided the prey; to every man a damsel or two; to Sisera a prey of divers colours, a prey of divers colours of needlework, of divers colours of needlework on both sides, meet for the necks of them that take the spoil?
bsb_text: ‘Are they not finding and dividing the spoil—a girl or two for each warrior, a plunder of dyed garments for Sisera, the spoil of embroidered garments for the neck of the looter?’
aov_text: Hulle het seker buit gevind en verdeel dit: een slavin, twee slavinne vir elke man; ’n buit van bont klere vir Sísera, ’n buit van bont klere, veelkleurige; ’n bont doek, twee veelkleuriges as buit vir my hals.

kjv_text: So let all thine enemies perish, O LORD: but let them that love him be as the sun when he goeth forth in his might. And the land had rest forty years.
bsb_text: So may all Your enemies perish, O LORD! But may those who love You shine like the sun at its brightest.” And the land had rest for forty years.
aov_text: So moet al u vyande, HERE, omkom! Maar die wat Hom liefhet, is soos die opgang van die son in sy krag. En die land het veertig jaar lank gerus.

kjv_text: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD: and the LORD delivered them into the hand of Midian seven years.
bsb_text: Again the Israelites did evil in the sight of the LORD; so He delivered them into the hand of Midian for seven years,
aov_text: MAAR toe die kinders van Israel gedoen het wat verkeerd was in die oë van die HERE, het die HERE hulle oorgegee in die hand van die Midianiete, sewe jaar lank.

kjv_text: And the hand of Midian prevailed against Israel: and because of the Midianites the children of Israel made them the dens which are in the mountains, and caves, and strong holds.
bsb_text: and the hand of Midian prevailed against Israel. Because of the Midianites, the Israelites prepared shelters for themselves in the mountains, caves, and strongholds.
aov_text: En die Midianiete het die oorhand oor Israel gekry; vanweë die Midianiete het die kinders van Israel vir hulle die slote gemaak wat op die berge is, en die gate en die bergvestings.

kjv_text: And so it was, when Israel had sown, that the Midianites came up, and the Amalekites, and the children of the east, even they came up against them;
bsb_text: Whenever the Israelites would plant their crops, the Midianites, Amalekites, and other people of the east would come up and invade them,
aov_text: Want as Israel gesaai het, dan trek die Midianiete en Amalekiete en die kinders van die Ooste uit, en trek teen hulle op,

kjv_text: And they encamped against them, and destroyed the increase of the earth, till thou come unto Gaza, and left no sustenance for Israel, neither sheep, nor ox, nor ass.
bsb_text: encamping against them as far as Gaza and destroying the produce of the land. They left Israel with no sustenance, neither sheep nor oxen nor donkeys.
aov_text: slaan laers teen hulle op en verwoes die opbrings van die land in die rigting na Gasa, en hulle laat geen lewensmiddele, geen skaap of bees of esel in Israel oorbly nie.

kjv_text: For they came up with their cattle and their tents, and they came as grasshoppers for multitude; for both they and their camels were without number: and they entered into the land to destroy it.
bsb_text: For the Midianites came with their livestock and their tents like a great swarm of locusts. They and their camels were innumerable, and they entered the land to ravage it.
aov_text: Want hulle het met hul vee en hul tente opgetrek en gekom soos sprinkane in menigte, terwyl hulle en hul kamele ontelbaar was; so het hulle dan die land ingekom om dit te verwoes.

kjv_text: And Israel was greatly impoverished because of the Midianites; and the children of Israel cried unto the LORD.
bsb_text: Israel was greatly impoverished by Midian, and the Israelites cried out to the LORD.
aov_text: En Israel het deur die Midianiete baie arm geword, maar die kinders van Israel het die HERE aangeroep.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when the children of Israel cried unto the LORD because of the Midianites,
bsb_text: Now when the Israelites cried out to the LORD because of Midian,
aov_text: En toe die kinders van Israel die HERE aanroep vanweë die Midianiete,

kjv_text: That the LORD sent a prophet unto the children of Israel, which said unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, I brought you up from Egypt, and brought you forth out of the house of bondage;
bsb_text: He sent them a prophet, who told them, “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: I brought you up out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
aov_text: het die HERE ’n profeet na die kinders van Israel gestuur, en dié het vir hulle gesê: So spreek die HERE, die God van Israel: Ek self het julle laat optrek uit Egipte en julle uit die slawehuis uitgelei

kjv_text: And I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all that oppressed you, and drave them out from before you, and gave you their land;
bsb_text: I delivered you out of the hands of Egypt and all your oppressors. I drove them out before you and gave you their land.
aov_text: en julle gered uit die hand van die Egiptenaars en uit die hand van al julle verdrukkers en hulle voor julle uit verdrywe en hulle land aan julle gegee.

kjv_text: And I said unto you, I am the LORD your God; fear not the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but ye have not obeyed my voice.
bsb_text: And I said to you: ‘I am the LORD your God. You must not fear the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell.’ But you did not obey Me.”
aov_text: En Ek het aan julle gesê: Ek is die HERE julle God; julle mag die gode van die Amoriete in wie se land julle woon, nie vrees nie. Maar julle het nie na my stem geluister nie.

kjv_text: And there came an angel of the LORD, and sat under an oak which was in Ophrah, that pertained unto Joash the Abiezrite: and his son Gideon threshed wheat by the winepress, to hide it from the Midianites.
bsb_text: Then the angel of the LORD came and sat down under the oak in Ophrah that belonged to Joash the Abiezrite, where his son Gideon was threshing wheat in a winepress to hide it from the Midianites.
aov_text: Toe het die Engel van die HERE gekom en gaan sit onder die terpentynboom wat by Ofra staan, wat aan Joas, die Abiësriet, behoort het, terwyl sy seun Gídeon juis koring uitslaan in die parskuip om dit te beveilig teen die Midianiete.

kjv_text: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him, and said unto him, The LORD is with thee, thou mighty man of valour.
bsb_text: And the angel of the LORD appeared to Gideon and said, “The LORD is with you, O mighty man of valor.”
aov_text: En die Engel van die HERE het aan hom verskyn en vir hom gesê: Die HERE is met jou, dapper held!

kjv_text: And Gideon said unto him, Oh my Lord, if the LORD be with us, why then is all this befallen us? and where be all his miracles which our fathers told us of, saying, Did not the LORD bring us up from Egypt? but now the LORD hath forsaken us, and delivered us into the hands of the Midianites.
bsb_text: “Please, my Lord,” Gideon replied, “if the LORD is with us, why has all this happened to us? And where are all His wonders of which our fathers told us, saying, ‘Has not the LORD brought us up out of Egypt?’ But now the LORD has forsaken us and delivered us into the hand of Midian.”
aov_text: Toe vra Gídeon Hom: Ag, my heer, as die HERE met ons is, waarom het al hierdie dinge ons dan oorgekom? En waar is al sy wonders waar ons vaders ons van vertel het, deur te sê: Het die HERE ons nie uit Egipte laat optrek nie? Maar nou het die HERE ons verwerp en ons oorgegee in die hand van die Midianiete.

kjv_text: And the LORD looked upon him, and said, Go in this thy might, and thou shalt save Israel from the hand of the Midianites: have not I sent thee?
bsb_text: The LORD turned to him and said, “Go in the strength you have and save Israel from the hand of Midian. Am I not sending you?”
aov_text: Toe draai die HERE na hom toe en sê: Gaan in hierdie krag van jou en verlos Israel uit die hand van die Midianiete. Is dit nie Ek wat jou stuur nie?

kjv_text: And he said unto him, Oh my Lord, wherewith shall I save Israel? behold, my family is poor in Manasseh, and I am the least in my father's house.
bsb_text: “Please, my Lord,” Gideon replied, “how can I save Israel? Indeed, my clan is the weakest in Manasseh, and I am the youngest in my father’s house.”
aov_text: Maar hy vra Hom: Ag, Here, waarmee sou ek Israel verlos? Kyk, my geslag is die swakste in Manasse, en ek self die geringste in my familie.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto him, Surely I will be with thee, and thou shalt smite the Midianites as one man.
bsb_text: “Surely I will be with you,” the LORD replied, “and you will strike down all the Midianites as one man.”
aov_text: Toe sê die HERE vir hom: Ek sal met jou wees, sodat jy die Midianiete soos een man sal verslaan.

kjv_text: And he said unto him, If now I have found grace in thy sight, then shew me a sign that thou talkest with me.
bsb_text: Gideon answered, “If I have found favor in Your sight, give me a sign that it is You speaking with me.
aov_text: En hy antwoord Hom: As ek dan guns in u oë gevind het, doen vir my ’n teken, dat U dit is wat met my spreek.

kjv_text: Depart not hence, I pray thee, until I come unto thee, and bring forth my present, and set it before thee. And he said, I will tarry until thou come again.
bsb_text: Please do not depart from this place until I return to You. Let me bring my offering and set it before You.” And the LORD said, “I will stay until you return.”
aov_text: Verwyder U tog nie hiervandaan voordat ek by U kom en my gawe uitbring en voor U neersit nie. Hy sê toe: Ek sal bly totdat jy terugkom.

kjv_text: And Gideon went in, and made ready a kid, and unleavened cakes of an ephah of flour: the flesh he put in a basket, and he put the broth in a pot, and brought it out unto him under the oak, and presented it.
bsb_text: So Gideon went in and prepared a young goat and unleavened bread and an ephah of flour. He placed the meat in a basket and the broth in a pot and brought them out to present to Him under the oak.
aov_text: Toe het Gídeon ingegaan en ’n bokkie berei, en van ’n efa meel ongesuurde koeke; die vleis het hy in ’n mandjie gesit en die sous in ’n pot gegooi; en hy het dit na Hom uitgebring onder die terpentynboom en dit naby neergesit.

kjv_text: And the angel of God said unto him, Take the flesh and the unleavened cakes, and lay them upon this rock, and pour out the broth. And he did so.
bsb_text: And the angel of God said to him, “Take the meat and the unleavened bread, lay them on this rock, and pour out the broth.” And Gideon did so.
aov_text: Maar die Engel van God het vir hom gesê: Neem die vleis en die ongesuurde koeke, en sit dit op hierdie rots neer en gooi die sous daaroor uit. En hy het so gedoen.

kjv_text: Then the angel of the LORD put forth the end of the staff that was in his hand, and touched the flesh and the unleavened cakes; and there rose up fire out of the rock, and consumed the flesh and the unleavened cakes. Then the angel of the LORD departed out of his sight.
bsb_text: Then the angel of the LORD extended the tip of the staff that was in his hand and touched the meat and the unleavened bread. And fire flared from the rock and consumed the meat and the unleavened bread. Then the angel of the LORD vanished from his sight.
aov_text: Daarop steek die Engel van die HERE die punt van die staf wat in sy hand was, uit en raak die vleis en die ongesuurde koeke aan; toe gaan daar vuur op uit die rots en verteer die vleis en die ongesuurde koeke. Intussen het die Engel van die HERE verdwyn uit sy oë.

kjv_text: And when Gideon perceived that he was an angel of the LORD, Gideon said, Alas, O LORD God! for because I have seen an angel of the LORD face to face.
bsb_text: When Gideon realized that it was the angel of the LORD, he said, “Oh no, Lord GOD! I have seen the angel of the LORD face to face!”
aov_text: Toe Gídeon bemerk dat dit die Engel van die HERE was, sê Gídeon: Ag, Here HERE! want ek het die Engel van die HERE gesien van aangesig tot aangesig!

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto him, Peace be unto thee; fear not: thou shalt not die.
bsb_text: But the LORD said to him, “Peace be with you. Do not be afraid, for you will not die.”
aov_text: Maar die HERE sê vir hom: Vrede vir jou! Vrees nie! Jy sal nie sterwe nie.

kjv_text: Then Gideon built an altar there unto the LORD, and called it Jehovahshalom: unto this day it is yet in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
bsb_text: So Gideon built an altar to the LORD there and called it The LORD Is Peace. To this day it stands in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
aov_text: Toe bou Gídeon daar ’n altaar vir die HERE en noem dit: Die HERE is vrede! Dit staan vandag nog daar by Ofra van die Abiësriete.

kjv_text: And it came to pass the same night, that the LORD said unto him, Take thy father's young bullock, even the second bullock of seven years old, and throw down the altar of Baal that thy father hath, and cut down the grove that is by it:
bsb_text: On that very night the LORD said to Gideon, “Take your father’s young bull and a second bull seven years old, tear down your father’s altar to Baal, and cut down the Asherah pole beside it.
aov_text: En in dieselfde nag het die HERE vir hom gesê: Neem die bul van jou vader, naamlik die tweede bul van sewe jaar, en breek die altaar van Baäl af wat aan jou vader behoort, en kap die heilige boomstam af wat daar langsaan staan.

kjv_text: And build an altar unto the LORD thy God upon the top of this rock, in the ordered place, and take the second bullock, and offer a burnt sacrifice with the wood of the grove which thou shalt cut down.
bsb_text: Then build a proper altar to the LORD your God on the top of this stronghold. And with the wood of the Asherah pole you cut down, take the second bull and offer it as a burnt offering.”
aov_text: En bou vir die HERE jou God ’n altaar op die top van hierdie vesting deur opstapeling, en neem die tweede bul en bring dit as ’n brandoffer met die hout van die heilige boomstam wat jy moet afkap.

kjv_text: Then Gideon took ten men of his servants, and did as the LORD had said unto him: and so it was, because he feared his father's household, and the men of the city, that he could not do it by day, that he did it by night.
bsb_text: So Gideon took ten of his servants and did as the LORD had told him. But because he was too afraid of his father’s household and the men of the city, he did it by night rather than in the daytime.
aov_text: Toe het Gídeon tien man van sy dienaars geneem en gedoen soos die HERE aan hom gesê het; maar omdat hy te bang was vir sy familie en vir die manne van die stad, om dit oordag te doen, het hy dit in die nag gedoen.

kjv_text: And when the men of the city arose early in the morning, behold, the altar of Baal was cast down, and the grove was cut down that was by it, and the second bullock was offered upon the altar that was built.
bsb_text: When the men of the city got up in the morning, there was Baal’s altar torn down, with the Asherah pole cut down beside it and the second bull offered up on the newly built altar.
aov_text: En toe die manne van die stad die môre vroeg opstaan, lê die altaar van Baäl daar omgegooi en die heilige boomstam wat daar langsaan gestaan het, afgekap en die tweede bul geoffer op die altaar wat daar gebou was!

kjv_text: And they said one to another, Who hath done this thing? And when they enquired and asked, they said, Gideon the son of Joash hath done this thing.
bsb_text: “Who did this?” they said to one another. And after they had investigated thoroughly, they were told, “Gideon son of Joash did it.”
aov_text: Toe sê hulle, die een vir die ander: Wie het hierdie ding gedoen? En onderwyl hulle ondersoek en uitvra, sê hulle: Gídeon, die seun van Joas, het hierdie ding gedoen!

kjv_text: Then the men of the city said unto Joash, Bring out thy son, that he may die: because he hath cast down the altar of Baal, and because he hath cut down the grove that was by it.
bsb_text: Then the men of the city said to Joash, “Bring out your son. He must die, because he has torn down Baal’s altar and cut down the Asherah pole beside it.”
aov_text: Toe sê die manne van die stad vir Joas: Bring jou seun uit, hy moet sterwe, omdat hy die altaar van Baäl omgegooi het, en omdat hy die heilige boomstam wat daar langsaan gestaan het, afgekap het.

kjv_text: And Joash said unto all that stood against him, Will ye plead for Baal? will ye save him? he that will plead for him, let him be put to death whilst it is yet morning: if he be a god, let him plead for himself, because one hath cast down his altar.
bsb_text: But Joash said to all who stood against him, “Are you contending for Baal? Are you trying to save him? Whoever pleads his case will be put to death by morning! If Baal is a god, let him contend for himself with the one who has torn down his altar.”
aov_text: Maar Joas sê vir almal wat by hom staan: Wil júlle vir Baäl veg? Of wil julle hom help? Die wat vir hom veg, sal vanmôre nog gedood word. As hy ’n god is, laat hy vir homself veg, omdat hy sy altaar omgegooi het.

kjv_text: Therefore on that day he called him Jerubbaal, saying, Let Baal plead against him, because he hath thrown down his altar.
bsb_text: So on that day Gideon was called Jerubbaal, that is to say, “Let Baal contend with him,” because he had torn down Baal’s altar.
aov_text: Daarom het hy hom op dié dag Jerúbbaäl genoem en gesê: Laat Baäl teen hom veg, omdat hy sy altaar omgegooi het.

kjv_text: Then all the Midianites and the Amalekites and the children of the east were gathered together, and went over, and pitched in the valley of Jezreel.
bsb_text: Then all the Midianites, Amalekites, and other people of the east gathered together, crossed over the Jordan, and camped in the Valley of Jezreel.
aov_text: Toe het al die Midianiete en Amalekiete en die kinders van die Ooste aanmekaargesluit en deurgetrek en in die laagte van Jísreël laer opgeslaan.

kjv_text: But the Spirit of the LORD came upon Gideon, and he blew a trumpet; and Abiezer was gathered after him.
bsb_text: So the Spirit of the LORD came upon Gideon, who blew the ram’s horn and rallied the Abiezrites behind him.
aov_text: En die Gees van die HERE het Gídeon vervul; en hy het op die ramshoring geblaas, en die Abiësriete is agter hom aan opgeroep.

kjv_text: And he sent messengers throughout all Manasseh; who also was gathered after him: and he sent messengers unto Asher, and unto Zebulun, and unto Naphtali; and they came up to meet them.
bsb_text: Calling them to arms, Gideon sent messengers throughout Manasseh, as well as Asher, Zebulun, and Naphtali, so that they came up to meet him.
aov_text: Ook het hy boodskappers gestuur in die hele Manasse, en dié is ook agter hom aan opgeroep; ook het hy boodskappers gestuur in Aser en in Sébulon en in Náftali, en hulle het opgetrek, hulle tegemoet.

kjv_text: And Gideon said unto God, If thou wilt save Israel by mine hand, as thou hast said,
bsb_text: Then Gideon said to God, “If You are going to save Israel by my hand, as You have said,
aov_text: Toe het Gídeon met God gespreek: As U werklik deur my hand Israel wil verlos soos U gespreek het —

kjv_text: Behold, I will put a fleece of wool in the floor; and if the dew be on the fleece only, and it be dry upon all the earth beside, then shall I know that thou wilt save Israel by mine hand, as thou hast said.
bsb_text: then behold, I will place a fleece of wool on the threshing floor. If there is dew only on the fleece and all the ground is dry, then I will know that You are going to save Israel by my hand, as You have said.”
aov_text: ek sal die wolvlies op die dorsvloer neerlê: as daar net op die vlies dou is, terwyl die grond oral droog is, dan sal ek weet dat U deur my hand Israel wil verlos soos U gespreek het.

kjv_text: And it was so: for he rose up early on the morrow, and thrust the fleece together, and wringed the dew out of the fleece, a bowl full of water.
bsb_text: And that is what happened. When Gideon arose the next morning, he squeezed the fleece and wrung out the dew—a bowlful of water.
aov_text: En dit was so: toe hy die volgende môre vroeg opstaan, het hy die vlies uitgewring en die dou uit die vlies uitgedruk, ’n kom vol water.

kjv_text: And Gideon said unto God, Let not thine anger be hot against me, and I will speak but this once: let me prove, I pray thee, but this once with the fleece; let it now be dry only upon the fleece, and upon all the ground let there be dew.
bsb_text: Then Gideon said to God, “Do not be angry with me; let me speak one more time. Please allow me one more test with the fleece. This time let it be dry, and the ground covered with dew.”
aov_text: Toe het Gídeon met God gespreek: Laat u toorn nie teen my ontvlam nie, en laat my net hierdie keer mag spreek; laat my tog net hierdie keer met die vlies ’n proef neem: laat dit op die vlies alleen droog wees terwyl daar op die grond oral dou is.

kjv_text: And God did so that night: for it was dry upon the fleece only, and there was dew on all the ground.
bsb_text: And that night God did so. Only the fleece was dry, and dew covered the ground.
aov_text: En die HERE het daardie nag so gedoen: op die vlies alleen was dit droog, maar oral op die grond was daar dou.

kjv_text: Then Jerubbaal, who is Gideon, and all the people that were with him, rose up early, and pitched beside the well of Harod: so that the host of the Midianites were on the north side of them, by the hill of Moreh, in the valley.
bsb_text: Early in the morning Jerubbaal (that is, Gideon) and all the men with him camped beside the spring of Harod. And the camp of Midian was north of them in the valley near the hill of Moreh.
aov_text: DAARNA het Jerúbbaäl, dit is Gídeon, en al die manskappe wat by hom was, vroeg klaargemaak, en hulle het laer opgeslaan by die fontein Harod, terwyl die laer van die Midianiete ten noorde van hom was, van die heuwel More af in die dal.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Gideon, The people that are with thee are too many for me to give the Midianites into their hands, lest Israel vaunt themselves against me, saying, Mine own hand hath saved me.
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to Gideon, “You have too many people for Me to deliver Midian into their hands, lest Israel glorify themselves over Me, saying, ‘My own hand has saved me.’
aov_text: Toe sê die HERE vir Gídeon: Die manskappe by jou is te veel vir My om die Midianiete in hulle hand te gee; anders kan Israel hom teen My beroem deur te sê: My eie hand het my verlos.

kjv_text: Now therefore go to, proclaim in the ears of the people, saying, Whosoever is fearful and afraid, let him return and depart early from mount Gilead. And there returned of the people twenty and two thousand; and there remained ten thousand.
bsb_text: Now, therefore, proclaim in the hearing of the people: ‘Whoever is fearful and trembling may turn back and leave Mount Gilead.’” So twenty-two thousand of them turned back, but ten thousand remained.
aov_text: Roep dan nou tog uit voor die ore van die manskappe en sê: Die wat bang is en bewe, kan teruggaan en wegdraai van die gebergte van Gílead af. Toe het daar van die manskappe twee-en-twintigduisend omgedraai en tienduisend het oorgebly.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Gideon, The people are yet too many; bring them down unto the water, and I will try them for thee there: and it shall be, that of whom I say unto thee, This shall go with thee, the same shall go with thee; and of whomsoever I say unto thee, This shall not go with thee, the same shall not go.
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to Gideon, “There are still too many people. Take them down to the water, and I will sift them for you there. If I say to you, ‘This one shall go with you,’ he shall go. But if I say, ‘This one shall not go with you,’ he shall not go.”
aov_text: Daarop sê die HERE vir Gídeon: Die manskappe is nog te veel; bring hulle af na die water, dan sal Ek hulle daar vir jou uitsoek; en van wie Ek aan jou sê: Hierdie een mag met jou saamgaan—dié mag met jou saamgaan; maar elkeen van wie Ek aan jou sê: Hierdie een mag nie met jou saamgaan nie—dié mag nie gaan nie.

kjv_text: So he brought down the people unto the water: and the LORD said unto Gideon, Every one that lappeth of the water with his tongue, as a dog lappeth, him shalt thou set by himself; likewise every one that boweth down upon his knees to drink.
bsb_text: So Gideon brought the people down to the water, and the LORD said to him, “Separate those who lap the water with their tongues like a dog from those who kneel to drink.”
aov_text: Hy bring toe die manskappe af na die water; en die HERE sê vir Gídeon: Elkeen wat met sy tong die water oplek soos ’n hond lek, moet jy eenkant laat staan; en elkeen wat op sy knieë vooroor buig om te drink, anderkant.

kjv_text: And the number of them that lapped, putting their hand to their mouth, were three hundred men: but all the rest of the people bowed down upon their knees to drink water.
bsb_text: And the number of those who lapped the water with their hands to their mouths was three hundred men; all the others knelt to drink.
aov_text: En die aantal van die wat gelek het met hul hand na hul mond toe, was driehonderd man; en al die ander manskappe het op hulle knieë vooroor gebuig om water te drink.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Gideon, By the three hundred men that lapped will I save you, and deliver the Midianites into thine hand: and let all the other people go every man unto his place.
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to Gideon, “With the three hundred men who lapped the water I will save you and deliver the Midianites into your hand. But all the others are to go home.”
aov_text: Toe sê die HERE vir Gídeon: Deur die driehonderd man wat gelek het, sal Ek julle verlos en die Midianiete in jou hand gee; maar al die ander manskappe kan elkeen na sy woonplek gaan.

kjv_text: So the people took victuals in their hand, and their trumpets: and he sent all the rest of Israel every man unto his tent, and retained those three hundred men: and the host of Midian was beneath him in the valley.
bsb_text: So Gideon sent the rest of the Israelites to their tents but kept the three hundred men, who took charge of the provisions and rams’ horns of the others. And the camp of Midian lay below him in the valley.
aov_text: Daarop neem hulle die padkos van die manskappe en hulle ramshorings in hul hand; en hy het al die manskappe van Israel laat gaan, elkeen na sy tente toe; maar die driehonderd man het hy agtergehou, terwyl die laer van die Midianiete onderkant hom in die laagte was.

kjv_text: And it came to pass the same night, that the LORD said unto him, Arise, get thee down unto the host; for I have delivered it into thine hand.
bsb_text: That night the LORD said to Gideon, “Get up and go down against the camp, for I have delivered it into your hand.
aov_text: En daardie nag het die HERE vir hom gesê: Staan op, gaan af in die laer, want Ek gee dit in jou hand.

kjv_text: But if thou fear to go down, go thou with Phurah thy servant down to the host:
bsb_text: But if you are afraid to do so, then go down to the camp with your servant Purah
aov_text: En as jy bang is om af te gaan, gaan jy dan saam met jou dienaar Pura af na die laer toe

kjv_text: And thou shalt hear what they say; and afterward shall thine hands be strengthened to go down unto the host. Then went he down with Phurah his servant unto the outside of the armed men that were in the host.
bsb_text: and listen to what they are saying. Then your hands will be strengthened to attack the camp.” So he went with Purah his servant to the outposts where armed men were guarding the camp.
aov_text: en luister wat hulle praat; en daarna sal jou hande sterk word, en jy sal in die laer aftrek. Hy gaan toe af saam met sy dienaar Pura tot by die buitenste lyn van die gewapendes wat in die laer was.

kjv_text: And the Midianites and the Amalekites and all the children of the east lay along in the valley like grasshoppers for multitude; and their camels were without number, as the sand by the sea side for multitude.
bsb_text: Now the Midianites, Amalekites, and all the other people of the east had settled in the valley like a swarm of locusts, and their camels were as countless as the sand on the seashore.
aov_text: En die Midianiete en Amalekiete en al die kinders van die Ooste het in die laagte gelê soos sprinkane in menigte, en hulle kamele was ontelbaar soos die sand aan die seestrand in menigte.

kjv_text: And when Gideon was come, behold, there was a man that told a dream unto his fellow, and said, Behold, I dreamed a dream, and, lo, a cake of barley bread tumbled into the host of Midian, and came unto a tent, and smote it that it fell, and overturned it, that the tent lay along.
bsb_text: And as Gideon arrived, a man was telling his friend about a dream. “Behold, I had a dream,” he said, “and I saw a loaf of barley bread come tumbling into the Midianite camp. It struck the tent so hard that the tent overturned and collapsed.”
aov_text: En toe Gídeon aankom, vertel ’n man aan ’n ander juis ’n droom en sê: Kyk, ek het ’n droom gehad: Daar rol ’n hard gebakte garsbrood in die laer van die Midianiete en kom tot by die tent en slaan dit dat dit omval en keer dit onderstebo, en toe lê die tent daar!

kjv_text: And his fellow answered and said, This is nothing else save the sword of Gideon the son of Joash, a man of Israel: for into his hand hath God delivered Midian, and all the host.
bsb_text: His friend replied: “This is nothing less than the sword of Gideon son of Joash, the Israelite. God has delivered Midian and the whole camp into his hand.”
aov_text: En die ander een het geantwoord en gesê: Dit is niks anders nie as die swaard van Gídeon, die seun van Joas, die Israeliet; God het die Midianiete en die hele laer in sy hand gegee.

kjv_text: And it was so, when Gideon heard the telling of the dream, and the interpretation thereof, that he worshipped, and returned into the host of Israel, and said, Arise; for the LORD hath delivered into your hand the host of Midian.
bsb_text: When Gideon heard the dream and its interpretation, he bowed in worship. He returned to the camp of Israel and said, “Get up, for the LORD has delivered the camp of Midian into your hand.”
aov_text: Toe Gídeon dan die verhaal van die droom en sy uitlegging hoor, het hy aanbid; en hy het teruggekeer na die laer van Israel en gesê: Maak klaar, want die HERE gee die laer van die Midianiete in julle hand.

kjv_text: And he divided the three hundred men into three companies, and he put a trumpet in every man's hand, with empty pitchers, and lamps within the pitchers.
bsb_text: And he divided the three hundred men into three companies and gave each man a ram’s horn in one hand and a large jar in the other, containing a torch.
aov_text: En hy het die driehonderd man verdeel in drie dele en aan hulle almal ramshorings en leë kruike, met fakkels binne-in die kruike, in die hand gegee

kjv_text: And he said unto them, Look on me, and do likewise: and, behold, when I come to the outside of the camp, it shall be that, as I do, so shall ye do.
bsb_text: “Watch me and do as I do,” Gideon said. “When I come to the outskirts of the camp, do exactly as I do.
aov_text: en aan hulle gesê: Kyk na my en maak net so; en kyk, as ek by die buitenste lyn van die laer kom, dan moet julle maak net soos ek maak.

kjv_text: When I blow with a trumpet, I and all that are with me, then blow ye the trumpets also on every side of all the camp, and say, The sword of the LORD, and of Gideon.
bsb_text: When I and all who are with me blow our horns, then you are also to blow your horns from all around the camp and shout, ‘For the LORD and for Gideon!’”
aov_text: En as ek en almal wat by my is, op die ramshoring blaas, moet julle ook op die ramshorings blaas rondom die hele laer, en julle moet sê: Vir die HERE en vir Gídeon!

kjv_text: So Gideon, and the hundred men that were with him, came unto the outside of the camp in the beginning of the middle watch; and they had but newly set the watch: and they blew the trumpets, and brake the pitchers that were in their hands.
bsb_text: Gideon and the hundred men with him reached the outskirts of the camp at the beginning of the middle watch, just after the changing of the guard. They blew their horns and broke the jars that were in their hands.
aov_text: Toe kom Gídeon en die honderd man wat by hom was, by die buitenste lyn van die laer, met die begin van die middelste nagwaak toe hulle skaars die wagte uitgesit het, en hulle blaas op die ramshorings en slaan die kruike stukkend wat hulle in hul hand gehad het.

kjv_text: And the three companies blew the trumpets, and brake the pitchers, and held the lamps in their left hands, and the trumpets in their right hands to blow withal: and they cried, The sword of the LORD, and of Gideon.
bsb_text: The three companies blew their horns and shattered their jars. Holding the torches in their left hands and the horns in their right hands, they shouted, “A sword for the LORD and for Gideon!”
aov_text: Toe blaas die drie dele op die ramshorings en breek die kruike en hou met hulle linkerhand die fakkels en met hulle regterhand die ramshorings om te blaas, terwyl hulle uitroep: Die swaard van die HERE en van Gídeon!

kjv_text: And they stood every man in his place round about the camp; and all the host ran, and cried, and fled.
bsb_text: Each Israelite took his position around the camp, and the entire Midianite army fled, crying out as they ran.
aov_text: En hulle het bly staan elkeen op sy plek, rondom die laer. Daarop hardloop die hele laer, en hulle skreeu en vlug.

kjv_text: And the three hundred blew the trumpets, and the LORD set every man's sword against his fellow, even throughout all the host: and the host fled to Bethshittah in Zererath, and to the border of Abelmeholah, unto Tabbath.
bsb_text: And when the three hundred rams’ horns sounded, the LORD set all the men in the camp against one another with their swords. The army fled to Beth-shittah toward Zererah as far as the border of Abel-meholah near Tabbath.
aov_text: En toe die driehonderd op die ramshorings blaas, het die HERE die swaard van die een teen die ander gerig, ja, in die hele laer; en die laer het gevlug na Bet-Sitta, na Seréda toe, tot by die oewer van Abel-Mehóla by Tabbat.

kjv_text: And the men of Israel gathered themselves together out of Naphtali, and out of Asher, and out of all Manasseh, and pursued after the Midianites.
bsb_text: Then the men of Israel were called out from Naphtali, Asher, and all Manasseh, and they pursued the Midianites.
aov_text: En die manskappe van Israel uit Náftali en uit Aser en uit die hele Manasse is opgeroep, en hulle het die Midianiete agternagejaag.

kjv_text: And Gideon sent messengers throughout all mount Ephraim, saying, Come down against the Midianites, and take before them the waters unto Bethbarah and Jordan. Then all the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together, and took the waters unto Bethbarah and Jordan.
bsb_text: Gideon sent messengers throughout the hill country of Ephraim to say, “Come down against the Midianites and seize the waters of the Jordan ahead of them as far as Beth-barah.” So all the men of Ephraim were called out, and they captured the waters of the Jordan as far as Beth-barah.
aov_text: Ook het Gídeon boodskappers gestuur in die hele gebergte van Efraim om te sê: Trek af die Midianiete tegemoet, en sny hulle van die waters af tot by Bet-Bara en die Jordaan. So het dan al die manskappe van Efraim bymekaargekom en die waters beset tot by Bet-Bara en die Jordaan.

kjv_text: And they took two princes of the Midianites, Oreb and Zeeb; and they slew Oreb upon the rock Oreb, and Zeeb they slew at the winepress of Zeeb, and pursued Midian, and brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon on the other side Jordan.
bsb_text: They also captured Oreb and Zeeb, the two princes of Midian; and they killed Oreb at the rock of Oreb and Zeeb at the winepress of Zeeb. So they pursued the Midianites and brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon on the other side of the Jordan.
aov_text: En hulle het twee vorste van die Midianiete gevang, Oreb en Seëb; en Oreb het hulle gedood by die rots Oreb, en Seëb gedood by die parskuip Seëb, en hulle het die Midianiete agtervolg; en die hoof van Oreb en van Seëb het hulle na Gídeon gebring, oorkant die Jordaan.

kjv_text: And the men of Ephraim said unto him, Why hast thou served us thus, that thou calledst us not, when thou wentest to fight with the Midianites? And they did chide with him sharply.
bsb_text: Then the men of Ephraim said to Gideon, “Why have you done this to us? Why did you fail to call us when you went to fight against Midian?” And they contended with him violently.
aov_text: TOE sê die manskappe van Efraim vir hom: Wat is dit wat u ons aangedoen het, dat u ons nie geroep het toe u weggetrek het om teen die Midianiete te veg nie? En hulle het heftig met hom getwis.

kjv_text: And he said unto them, What have I done now in comparison of you? Is not the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abiezer?
bsb_text: But Gideon answered them, “Now what have I accomplished compared to you? Are not the gleanings of Ephraim better than the grape harvest of Abiezer?
aov_text: Maar hy sê vir hulle: Wat het ek nou gedoen in vergelyking met julle? Is die na-oes van Efraim nie beter as die wynoes van Abiëser nie?

kjv_text: God hath delivered into your hands the princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb: and what was I able to do in comparison of you? Then their anger was abated toward him, when he had said that.
bsb_text: God has delivered Oreb and Zeeb, the two princes of Midian, into your hand. What was I able to do compared to you?” When he had said this, their anger against him subsided.
aov_text: God het die vorste van Mídian, Oreb en Seëb, in julle hand gegee, maar wat kon ek doen in vergelyking met julle? Toe bedaar hulle opgewondenheid teenoor hom nadat hy hierdie woord gespreek het.

kjv_text: And Gideon came to Jordan, and passed over, he, and the three hundred men that were with him, faint, yet pursuing them.
bsb_text: Then Gideon and his three hundred men came to the Jordan and crossed it, exhausted yet still in pursuit.
aov_text: En Gídeon het gekom by die Jordaan, en hy en die driehonderd man wat by hom was, het oorgetrek, moeg en besig om te agtervolg.

kjv_text: And he said unto the men of Succoth, Give, I pray you, loaves of bread unto the people that follow me; for they be faint, and I am pursuing after Zebah and Zalmunna, kings of Midian.
bsb_text: So Gideon said to the men of Succoth, “Please give my troops some bread, for they are exhausted, and I am still pursuing Zebah and Zalmunna, the kings of Midian.”
aov_text: En hy sê aan die manne van Sukkot: Gee tog broodjies vir die manskappe wat op my voetspore volg, want hulle is moeg, en ek is besig om Seba en Sálmuna, die konings van die Midianiete, agterna te jaag.

kjv_text: And the princes of Succoth said, Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thine hand, that we should give bread unto thine army?
bsb_text: But the leaders of Succoth asked, “Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna already in your possession, that we should give bread to your army?”
aov_text: Maar die vorste van Sukkot vra: Is die handpalm van Seba en van Sálmuna nou al in u hand, dat ons aan u leër brood moet gee?

kjv_text: And Gideon said, Therefore when the LORD hath delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into mine hand, then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers.
bsb_text: “Very well,” Gideon replied, “when the LORD has delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into my hand, I will tear your flesh with the thorns and briers of the wilderness!”
aov_text: Toe sê Gídeon: Daarom, as die HERE Seba en Sálmuna in my hand gee, sal ek julle vlees met woestyndorings en distels dors.

kjv_text: And he went up thence to Penuel, and spake unto them likewise: and the men of Penuel answered him as the men of Succoth had answered him.
bsb_text: From there he went up to Penuel and asked the same from them, but the men of Penuel gave the same response as the men of Succoth.
aov_text: En daarvandaan het hy opgetrek na Pnuel en met hulle net so gespreek; maar die manne van Pnuel het hom geantwoord net soos die manne van Sukkot geantwoord het.

kjv_text: And he spake also unto the men of Penuel, saying, When I come again in peace, I will break down this tower.
bsb_text: So Gideon told the men of Penuel, “When I return in triumph, I will tear down this tower!”
aov_text: Daarop spreek hy ook met die mense van Pnuel en sê: As ek met vrede terugkom, sal ek hierdie toring omgooi.

kjv_text: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor, and their hosts with them, about fifteen thousand men, all that were left of all the hosts of the children of the east: for there fell an hundred and twenty thousand men that drew sword.
bsb_text: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor with their army of about fifteen thousand men—all that were left of the armies of the people of the east. A hundred and twenty thousand swordsmen had already fallen.
aov_text: Seba en Sálmuna was toe in Karkor, en hul leër by hulle, omtrent vyftienduisend, al wat oor was uit die hele leër van die kinders van die Ooste; maar die gesneuweldes was honderd-en-twintigduisend man wat die swaard kon uittrek.

kjv_text: And Gideon went up by the way of them that dwelt in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and smote the host: for the host was secure.
bsb_text: And Gideon went up by way of the caravan route east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and he attacked their army, taking them by surprise.
aov_text: En Gídeon het opgetrek met die pad van die tentbewoners, ten ooste van Nobag en Jógbeha, en hy het die leër verslaan terwyl die leër gerus was.

kjv_text: And when Zebah and Zalmunna fled, he pursued after them, and took the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna, and discomfited all the host.
bsb_text: When Zebah and Zalmunna fled, Gideon pursued and captured these two kings of Midian, routing their entire army.
aov_text: En Seba en Sálmuna het gevlug, maar hy het hulle agternagejaag en die twee konings van Mídian, Seba en Sálmuna, gevang nadat hy die hele leër uiteengejaag het.

kjv_text: And Gideon the son of Joash returned from battle before the sun was up,
bsb_text: After this, Gideon son of Joash returned from the battle along the Ascent of Heres.
aov_text: En toe Gídeon, die seun van Joas, terugkom uit die geveg, van die nek Heres af,

kjv_text: And caught a young man of the men of Succoth, and enquired of him: and he described unto him the princes of Succoth, and the elders thereof, even threescore and seventeen men.
bsb_text: There he captured a young man of Succoth and interrogated him. The young man wrote down for him the names of the seventy-seven leaders and elders of Succoth.
aov_text: vang hy ’n seun van die mense van Sukkot en vra hom uit; en dié het vir hom die vorste van Sukkot en sy oudstes opgeskrywe, sewen-en-sewentig man.

kjv_text: And he came unto the men of Succoth, and said, Behold Zebah and Zalmunna, with whom ye did upbraid me, saying, Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thine hand, that we should give bread unto thy men that are weary?
bsb_text: And Gideon went to the men of Succoth and said, “Here are Zebah and Zalmunna, about whom you taunted me, saying, ‘Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna already in your possession, that we should give bread to your weary men?’”
aov_text: En toe hy by die mense van Sukkot kom, sê hy: Hier is Seba en Sálmuna oor wie julle my gesmaad het deur te sê: Is die handpalm van Seba en van Sálmuna nou al in u hand, dat ons aan u vermoeide manskappe brood moet gee?

kjv_text: And he took the elders of the city, and thorns of the wilderness and briers, and with them he taught the men of Succoth.
bsb_text: Then he took the elders of the city, and using the thorns and briers of the wilderness, he disciplined the men of Succoth.
aov_text: Daarop neem hy die oudstes van die stad saam met die woestyndorings en die distels, en hy het die manne van Sukkot daarmee ’n les geleer.

kjv_text: And he beat down the tower of Penuel, and slew the men of the city.
bsb_text: He also pulled down the tower of Penuel and killed the men of the city.
aov_text: En die toring van Pnuel het hy omgegooi en die manne van die stad gedood.

kjv_text: Then said he unto Zebah and Zalmunna, What manner of men were they whom ye slew at Tabor? And they answered, As thou art, so were they; each one resembled the children of a king.
bsb_text: Next, Gideon asked Zebah and Zalmunna, “What kind of men did you kill at Tabor?” “Men like you,” they answered, “each one resembling the son of a king.”
aov_text: En hy het Seba en Sálmuna gevra: Wat vir manne was dit wat julle by Tabor gedood het? En hulle antwoord: Soos u, so was hulle: elkeen van gestalte koninklike seuns.

kjv_text: And he said, They were my brethren, even the sons of my mother: as the LORD liveth, if ye had saved them alive, I would not slay you.
bsb_text: “They were my brothers,” Gideon replied, “the sons of my mother! As surely as the LORD lives, if you had let them live, I would not kill you.”
aov_text: Daarop sê hy: Dit was my broers, seuns van my moeder. So waar as die HERE leef, as julle hulle laat leef het, sou ek julle nie doodmaak nie.

kjv_text: And he said unto Jether his firstborn, Up, and slay them. But the youth drew not his sword: for he feared, because he was yet a youth.
bsb_text: So he said to Jether, his firstborn, “Get up and kill them.” But the young man did not draw his sword; he was fearful because he was still a youth.
aov_text: En hy sê aan Jeter, sy eersgeborene: Staan op, maak hulle dood! Maar die seun het sy swaard nie uitgetrek nie, omdat hy bang was; want hy was nog ’n seun.

kjv_text: Then Zebah and Zalmunna said, Rise thou, and fall upon us: for as the man is, so is his strength. And Gideon arose, and slew Zebah and Zalmunna, and took away the ornaments that were on their camels' necks.
bsb_text: Then Zebah and Zalmunna said, “Get up and kill us yourself, for as the man is, so is his strength.” So Gideon got up and killed Zebah and Zalmunna, and he took the crescent ornaments from the necks of their camels.
aov_text: Toe sê Seba en Sálmuna: Staan u self op en val op ons aan, want soos die man is, is sy krag. Gídeon het toe opgestaan en Seba en Sálmuna gedood, en die maantjies wat aan die nekke van hulle kamele was, het hy geneem.

kjv_text: Then the men of Israel said unto Gideon, Rule thou over us, both thou, and thy son, and thy son's son also: for thou hast delivered us from the hand of Midian.
bsb_text: Then the Israelites said to Gideon, “Rule over us—you and your son and grandson—for you have saved us from the hand of Midian.”
aov_text: Daarop sê die manne van Israel vir Gídeon: Heers oor ons, u sowel as u seun en u kleinseun, want u het ons verlos uit die hand van die Midianiete.

kjv_text: And Gideon said unto them, I will not rule over you, neither shall my son rule over you: the LORD shall rule over you.
bsb_text: But Gideon replied, “I will not rule over you, nor will my son. The LORD shall rule over you.”
aov_text: Maar Gídeon antwoord hulle: Ek wil nie oor julle heers nie, en ook my seun mag nie oor julle heers nie: die HERE sal oor julle heers.

kjv_text: And Gideon said unto them, I would desire a request of you, that ye would give me every man the earrings of his prey. (For they had golden earrings, because they were Ishmaelites.)
bsb_text: Then he added, “Let me make a request of you, that each of you give me an earring from his plunder.” (For the enemies had gold earrings because they were Ishmaelites.)
aov_text: Verder het Gídeon vir hulle gesê: Ek wil aan julle ’n versoek doen: Gee nou elkeen vir my die ring uit sy buit! Want hulle het goue ringe gedra, omdat hulle Ismaeliete was.

kjv_text: And they answered, We will willingly give them. And they spread a garment, and did cast therein every man the earrings of his prey.
bsb_text: “We will give them gladly,” they replied. So they spread out a garment, and each man threw an earring from his plunder onto it.
aov_text: Toe sê hulle: Ons wil dit graag gee; en hulle het ’n mantel uitgesprei en elkeen ’n ring van sy buit daarop gegooi.

kjv_text: And the weight of the golden earrings that he requested was a thousand and seven hundred shekels of gold; beside ornaments, and collars, and purple raiment that was on the kings of Midian, and beside the chains that were about their camels' necks.
bsb_text: The weight of the gold earrings he had requested was 1,700 shekels, in addition to the crescent ornaments, the pendants, the purple garments of the kings of Midian, and the chains from the necks of their camels.
aov_text: En die gewig van die goue ringe wat hy gevra het, was sewentienhonderd sikkels goud, behalwe die maantjies en die oorversiersels en purper klere wat die konings van Mídian gedra het, en behalwe die kettings wat aan die nekke van hulle kamele was.

kjv_text: And Gideon made an ephod thereof, and put it in his city, even in Ophrah: and all Israel went thither a whoring after it: which thing became a snare unto Gideon, and to his house.
bsb_text: From all this Gideon made an ephod, which he placed in Ophrah, his hometown. But soon all Israel prostituted themselves by worshiping it there, and it became a snare to Gideon and his household.
aov_text: En Gídeon het daar ’n skouerkleed van gemaak en dit in sy stad, in Ofra, opgestel; en die hele Israel het dit daar agternagehoereer, en dit het vir Gídeon en sy huis ’n strik geword.

kjv_text: Thus was Midian subdued before the children of Israel, so that they lifted up their heads no more. And the country was in quietness forty years in the days of Gideon.
bsb_text: In this way Midian was subdued before the Israelites and did not raise its head again. So the land had rest for forty years in the days of Gideon,
aov_text: So moes die Midianiete dan buig voor die kinders van Israel, en hulle het hul hoof nie meer opgetel nie; en die land het in Gídeon se dae veertig jaar lank gerus.

kjv_text: And Jerubbaal the son of Joash went and dwelt in his own house.
bsb_text: and he—Jerubbaal son of Joash—returned home and settled down.
aov_text: En Jerúbbaäl, die seun van Joas, het in sy huis gaan woon.

kjv_text: And Gideon had threescore and ten sons of his body begotten: for he had many wives.
bsb_text: Gideon had seventy sons of his own, since he had many wives.
aov_text: En Gídeon het sewentig seuns gehad wat uit sy lende voortgekom het, want hy het baie vroue gehad.

kjv_text: And his concubine that was in Shechem, she also bare him a son, whose name he called Abimelech.
bsb_text: His concubine, who dwelt in Shechem, also bore him a son, and he named him Abimelech.
aov_text: En sy byvrou wat in Sigem was, het ook vir hom ’n seun gebaar, en hy het hom die naam Abiméleg gegee.

kjv_text: And Gideon the son of Joash died in a good old age, and was buried in the sepulchre of Joash his father, in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
bsb_text: Later, Gideon son of Joash died at a ripe old age and was buried in the tomb of his father Joash in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
aov_text: En Gídeon, die seun van Joas, het gesterf in goeie ouderdom en is begrawe in die graf van sy vader Joas, in Ofra van die Abiësriete.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, as soon as Gideon was dead, that the children of Israel turned again, and went a whoring after Baalim, and made Baalberith their god.
bsb_text: And as soon as Gideon was dead, the Israelites turned and prostituted themselves with the Baals, and they set up Baal-berith as their god.
aov_text: Maar net toe Gídeon dood was, het die kinders van Israel weer die Baäls agternagehoereer en van Baäl-Berít vir hulle ’n god gemaak.

kjv_text: And the children of Israel remembered not the LORD their God, who had delivered them out of the hands of all their enemies on every side:
bsb_text: The Israelites failed to remember the LORD their God who had delivered them from the hands of all their enemies on every side.
aov_text: En die kinders van Israel het nie gedink aan die HERE hulle God wat hulle uit die hand van al hul vyande rondom gered het nie.

kjv_text: Neither shewed they kindness to the house of Jerubbaal, namely, Gideon, according to all the goodness which he had shewed unto Israel.
bsb_text: They did not show kindness to the house of Jerubbaal (that is, Gideon) for all the good things he had done for Israel.
aov_text: En hulle het geen guns bewys aan die huis van Jerúbbaäl, dit is Gídeon, vir al die goed wat hy aan Israel gedoen het nie.

kjv_text: And Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem unto his mother's brethren, and communed with them, and with all the family of the house of his mother's father, saying,
bsb_text: Now Abimelech son of Jerubbaal went to his mother’s brothers at Shechem and said to them and to all the clan of his mother,
aov_text: EN Abiméleg, die seun van Jerúbbaäl, het heengegaan na Sigem, na die broers van sy moeder, en hy het met hulle en met die hele geslag van sy moeder se familie gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: Speak, I pray you, in the ears of all the men of Shechem, Whether is better for you, either that all the sons of Jerubbaal, which are threescore and ten persons, reign over you, or that one reign over you? remember also that I am your bone and your flesh.
bsb_text: “Please ask all the leaders of Shechem, ‘Is it better for you that seventy men, all the sons of Jerubbaal, rule over you, or just one man?’ Remember that I am your own flesh and blood.”
aov_text: Spreek tog voor die ore van al die burgers van Sigem: Wat is vir julle beter—dat sewentig man, almal seuns van Jerúbbaäl, oor julle heers, of dat een man oor julle heers? En dink daaraan dat ek julle gebeente en julle vlees is.

kjv_text: And his mother's brethren spake of him in the ears of all the men of Shechem all these words: and their hearts inclined to follow Abimelech; for they said, He is our brother.
bsb_text: And when his mother’s brothers spoke all these words about him in the presence of all the leaders of Shechem, their hearts were inclined to follow Abimelech, for they said, “He is our brother.”
aov_text: Toe die broers van sy moeder al hierdie woorde voor die ore van al die burgers van Sigem oor hom spreek, het hulle hart Abiméleg gevolg; want hulle het gesê: Hy is ons broer.

kjv_text: And they gave him threescore and ten pieces of silver out of the house of Baalberith, wherewith Abimelech hired vain and light persons, which followed him.
bsb_text: So they gave him seventy shekels of silver from the temple of Baal-berith, with which Abimelech hired some worthless and reckless men to follow him.
aov_text: Hulle het hom toe sewentig sikkels silwer uit die huis van Baäl-Berít gegee, en daarmee het Abiméleg ydele en ligsinnige manne gehuur, en hulle het hom gevolg.

kjv_text: And he went unto his father's house at Ophrah, and slew his brethren the sons of Jerubbaal, being threescore and ten persons, upon one stone: notwithstanding yet Jotham the youngest son of Jerubbaal was left; for he hid himself.
bsb_text: He went to his father’s house in Ophrah, and on one stone murdered his seventy brothers, the sons of Jerubbaal. But Jotham, the youngest son of Jerubbaal, survived, because he hid himself.
aov_text: En hy het in die huis van sy vader gegaan, in Ofra, en sy broers, die seuns van Jerúbbaäl, sewentig man, op een klip vermoor; maar Jotam, die jongste seun van Jerúbbaäl, het oorgebly, want hy het weggekruip.

kjv_text: And all the men of Shechem gathered together, and all the house of Millo, and went, and made Abimelech king, by the plain of the pillar that was in Shechem.
bsb_text: Then all the leaders of Shechem and Beth-millo gathered beside the oak at the pillar in Shechem and proceeded to make Abimelech their king.
aov_text: Daarop het al die burgers van Sigem en die hele huis Millo bymekaargekom en Abiméleg gaan koning maak by die terpentynboom van die gedenkteken wat by Sigem is.

kjv_text: And when they told it to Jotham, he went and stood in the top of mount Gerizim, and lifted up his voice, and cried, and said unto them, Hearken unto me, ye men of Shechem, that God may hearken unto you.
bsb_text: When this was reported to Jotham, he climbed to the top of Mount Gerizim, raised his voice, and cried out: “Listen to me, O leaders of Shechem, and may God listen to you.
aov_text: Toe hulle dit aan Jotam meedeel, het hy op die top van die berg Gerísim gaan staan en sy stem verhef en uitgeroep en aan hulle gesê: Luister na my, burgers van Sigem, sodat God na julle kan luister.

kjv_text: The trees went forth on a time to anoint a king over them; and they said unto the olive tree, Reign thou over us.
bsb_text: One day the trees set out to anoint a king for themselves. They said to the olive tree, ‘Reign over us.’
aov_text: Eendag het die bome gegaan om ’n koning oor hulle te salf en aan die olyfboom gesê: Wees koning oor ons!

kjv_text: But the olive tree said unto them, Should I leave my fatness, wherewith by me they honour God and man, and go to be promoted over the trees?
bsb_text: But the olive tree replied, ‘Should I stop giving my oil that honors both God and man, to hold sway over the trees?’
aov_text: Maar die olyfboom het vir hulle gesê: Sou ek my vettigheid opgee wat God en die mense in my prys, en oor die bome gaan swewe?

kjv_text: And the trees said to the fig tree, Come thou, and reign over us.
bsb_text: Then the trees said to the fig tree, ‘Come and reign over us.’
aov_text: Toe sê die bome vir die vyeboom: Kom jy, wees koning oor ons.

kjv_text: But the fig tree said unto them, Should I forsake my sweetness, and my good fruit, and go to be promoted over the trees?
bsb_text: But the fig tree replied, ‘Should I stop giving my sweetness and my good fruit, to hold sway over the trees?’
aov_text: Maar die vyeboom het vir hulle gesê: Sou ek my soetigheid en my goeie vrugte opgee en oor die bome gaan swewe?

kjv_text: Then said the trees unto the vine, Come thou, and reign over us.
bsb_text: Then the trees said to the grapevine, ‘Come and reign over us.’
aov_text: Toe sê die bome vir die wingerdstok: Kom jy, wees koning oor ons.

kjv_text: And the vine said unto them, Should I leave my wine, which cheereth God and man, and go to be promoted over the trees?
bsb_text: But the grapevine replied, ‘Should I stop giving my wine that cheers both God and man, to hold sway over the trees?’
aov_text: Maar die wingerdstok het vir hulle gesê: Sou ek my mos opgee wat God en die mense vrolik maak, en oor die bome gaan swewe?

kjv_text: Then said all the trees unto the bramble, Come thou, and reign over us.
bsb_text: Finally all the trees said to the thornbush, ‘Come and reign over us.’
aov_text: Toe sê al die bome vir die steekdoring: Kom jy, wees koning oor ons!

kjv_text: And the bramble said unto the trees, If in truth ye anoint me king over you, then come and put your trust in my shadow: and if not, let fire come out of the bramble, and devour the cedars of Lebanon.
bsb_text: But the thornbush replied, ‘If you really are anointing me as king over you, come and find refuge in my shade. But if not, may fire come out of the thornbush and consume the cedars of Lebanon.’
aov_text: En die steekdoring het vir die bome gesê: As julle in waarheid my as koning oor julle salf, kom dan, skuil in my skaduwee; maar so nie, laat daar dan vuur uitgaan uit die steekdoring en die seders van die Líbanon verteer.

kjv_text: Now therefore, if ye have done truly and sincerely, in that ye have made Abimelech king, and if ye have dealt well with Jerubbaal and his house, and have done unto him according to the deserving of his hands;
bsb_text: Now if you have acted faithfully and honestly in making Abimelech king, if you have done well by Jerubbaal and his family, and if you have done to him as he deserves—
aov_text: As julle dan nou in waarheid en in opregtheid gehandel het deur Abiméleg koning te maak, en as julle goed gedoen het aan Jerúbbaäl en sy huis, en as julle aan hom gedoen het na die verdienste van sy hande —

kjv_text: (For my father fought for you, and adventured his life far, and delivered you out of the hand of Midian:
bsb_text: for my father fought for you and risked his life to deliver you from the hand of Midian,
aov_text: julle vir wie my vader geveg en sy lewe gewaag het, en wat hy uit die hand van die Midianiete gered het,

kjv_text: And ye are risen up against my father's house this day, and have slain his sons, threescore and ten persons, upon one stone, and have made Abimelech, the son of his maidservant, king over the men of Shechem, because he is your brother;)
bsb_text: but you have risen up against my father’s house this day and killed his seventy sons on a single stone, and you have made Abimelech, the son of his maidservant, king over the leaders of Shechem because he is your brother—
aov_text: maar wat vandag opgestaan het teen die huis van my vader, en sy seuns, sewentig man, op een klip vermoor het en Abiméleg, die seun van sy slavin, koning gemaak het oor die burgers van Sigem omdat hy julle broer is —

kjv_text: If ye then have dealt truly and sincerely with Jerubbaal and with his house this day, then rejoice ye in Abimelech, and let him also rejoice in you:
bsb_text: if you have acted faithfully and honestly toward Jerubbaal and his house this day, then may you rejoice in Abimelech, and he in you.
aov_text: as julle dan vandag in waarheid en in opregtheid gehandel het met Jerúbbaäl en sy huis, wees dan vrolik oor Abiméleg, en mag hy ook vrolik wees oor julle.

kjv_text: But if not, let fire come out from Abimelech, and devour the men of Shechem, and the house of Millo; and let fire come out from the men of Shechem, and from the house of Millo, and devour Abimelech.
bsb_text: But if not, may fire come from Abimelech and consume the leaders of Shechem and Beth-millo, and may fire come from the leaders of Shechem and Beth-millo and consume Abimelech.”
aov_text: Maar so nie, laat daar dan vuur uitgaan uit Abiméleg en die burgers van Sigem en die huis Millo verteer; en laat daar vuur uitgaan uit die burgers van Sigem en uit die huis Millo en Abiméleg verteer.

kjv_text: And Jotham ran away, and fled, and went to Beer, and dwelt there, for fear of Abimelech his brother.
bsb_text: Then Jotham ran away, escaping to Beer, and he lived there for fear of his brother Abimelech.
aov_text: Daarop het Jotam padgegee en weggevlug en na Beër gegaan en daar gebly vanweë Abiméleg, sy broer.

kjv_text: When Abimelech had reigned three years over Israel,
bsb_text: After Abimelech had reigned over Israel for three years,
aov_text: Toe Abiméleg drie jaar oor Israel geheers het,

kjv_text: Then God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of Shechem; and the men of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech:
bsb_text: God sent a spirit of animosity between Abimelech and the leaders of Shechem and caused them to treat Abimelech deceitfully,
aov_text: het God ’n bose gees gestuur tussen Abiméleg en die burgers van Sigem, en die burgers van Sigem het troueloos gehandel teen Abiméleg,

kjv_text: That the cruelty done to the threescore and ten sons of Jerubbaal might come, and their blood be laid upon Abimelech their brother, which slew them; and upon the men of Shechem, which aided him in the killing of his brethren.
bsb_text: in order that the crime against the seventy sons of Jerubbaal might come to justice and their blood be avenged on their brother Abimelech and on the leaders of Shechem, who had helped him murder his brothers.
aov_text: sodat die onreg teen die sewentig seuns van Jerúbbaäl sou uitkom, en Hy hulle bloed sou lê op hul broer Abiméleg wat hulle vermoor het, ook op die burgers van Sigem wat sy hande versterk het om sy broers te vermoor.

kjv_text: And the men of Shechem set liers in wait for him in the top of the mountains, and they robbed all that came along that way by them: and it was told Abimelech.
bsb_text: The leaders of Shechem set up an ambush against Abimelech on the hilltops, and they robbed all who passed by them on the road. So this was reported to Abimelech.
aov_text: So het die burgers van Sigem dan teen hom hinderlae opgestel bo-op die berge en almal beroof wat op die pad by hulle verbykom. En dit is aan Abiméleg meegedeel.

kjv_text: And Gaal the son of Ebed came with his brethren, and went over to Shechem: and the men of Shechem put their confidence in him.
bsb_text: Meanwhile, Gaal son of Ebed came with his brothers and crossed into Shechem, and the leaders of Shechem put their confidence in him.
aov_text: Toe kom Gaäl, die seun van Ebed, met sy broers en hulle trek oor na Sigem toe; en die burgers van Sigem het op hom vertrou.

kjv_text: And they went out into the fields, and gathered their vineyards, and trode the grapes, and made merry, and went into the house of their god, and did eat and drink, and cursed Abimelech.
bsb_text: And after they had gone out into the fields, gathered grapes from their vineyards, and trodden them, they held a festival and went into the house of their god; and as they ate and drank, they cursed Abimelech.
aov_text: En hulle het uitgegaan in die veld en hulle wingerde afgeoes en uitgetrap en oesfees gehou; daarop het hulle in die huis van hulle god ingegaan en geëet en gedrink en Abiméleg gevloek.

kjv_text: And Gaal the son of Ebed said, Who is Abimelech, and who is Shechem, that we should serve him? is not he the son of Jerubbaal? and Zebul his officer? serve the men of Hamor the father of Shechem: for why should we serve him?
bsb_text: Then Gaal son of Ebed said, “Who is Abimelech, and who is Shechem, that we should serve him? Is he not the son of Jerubbaal, and is not Zebul his officer? You are to serve the men of Hamor, the father of Shechem. Why should we serve Abimelech?
aov_text: Toe sê Gaäl, die seun van Ebed: Wie is Abiméleg—en wat is Sigem—dat ons hom sou dien? Is hy nie die seun van Jerúbbaäl, en is Sebul nie sy stadsbestuurder nie? Dien die manne van Hemor, die vader van Sigem, maar waarom moet óns hom dien?

kjv_text: And would to God this people were under my hand! then would I remove Abimelech. And he said to Abimelech, Increase thine army, and come out.
bsb_text: If only this people were under my authority, I would remove Abimelech; I would say to him, ‘Muster your army and come out!’”
aov_text: Ag, was hierdie volk maar in my hand, dan sou ek Abiméleg wegjaag! En met die oog op Abiméleg het hy gesê: Vermeerder maar jou leër en trek uit!

kjv_text: And when Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed, his anger was kindled.
bsb_text: When Zebul the governor of the city heard the words of Gaal son of Ebed, he burned with anger.
aov_text: Toe Sebul, die owerste van die stad, die woorde van Gaäl, die seun van Ebed, hoor, het hy kwaad geword

kjv_text: And he sent messengers unto Abimelech privily, saying, Behold, Gaal the son of Ebed and his brethren be come to Shechem; and, behold, they fortify the city against thee.
