bsb_text: So he covertly sent messengers to Abimelech to say, “Look, Gaal son of Ebed and his brothers have come to Shechem and are stirring up the city against you.
aov_text: en listig boodskappers na Abiméleg gestuur om te sê: Kyk, Gaäl, die seun van Ebed, met sy broers, het in Sigem gekom, en kyk, hulle maak die stad teen u op.

kjv_text: Now therefore up by night, thou and the people that is with thee, and lie in wait in the field:
bsb_text: Now then, tonight you and the people with you are to come and lie in wait in the fields.
aov_text: Maak dan nou in die nag klaar, u met die manskappe wat by u is, en stel ’n hinderlaag op in die veld.

kjv_text: And it shall be, that in the morning, as soon as the sun is up, thou shalt rise early, and set upon the city: and, behold, when he and the people that is with him come out against thee, then mayest thou do to them as thou shalt find occasion.
bsb_text: And in the morning at sunrise, get up and advance against the city. When Gaal and his men come out against you, do to them whatever you are able.”
aov_text: Dan kan u in die môre vroeg as die son uitkom, u gereed hou en ’n aanval teen die stad maak; en as hy met die manskappe wat by hom is, uittrek na u toe, handel dan met hom na bevind van sake.

kjv_text: And Abimelech rose up, and all the people that were with him, by night, and they laid wait against Shechem in four companies.
bsb_text: So Abimelech and all his troops set out by night and lay in wait against Shechem in four companies.
aov_text: Daarop het Abiméleg en al die manskappe wat by hom was, in die nag klaargemaak en hinderlae in vier dele by Sigem opgestel.

kjv_text: And Gaal the son of Ebed went out, and stood in the entering of the gate of the city: and Abimelech rose up, and the people that were with him, from lying in wait.
bsb_text: Now Gaal son of Ebed went out and stood at the entrance of the city gate just as Abimelech and his men came out from their hiding places.
aov_text: En Gaäl, die seun van Ebed, het uitgegaan en by die ingang van die stadspoort gaan staan; en toe Abiméleg en al die manskappe wat by hom was, opstaan uit die hinderlaag,

kjv_text: And when Gaal saw the people, he said to Zebul, Behold, there come people down from the top of the mountains. And Zebul said unto him, Thou seest the shadow of the mountains as if they were men.
bsb_text: When Gaal saw the people, he said to Zebul, “Look, people are coming down from the mountains!” But Zebul replied, “The shadows of the mountains look like men to you.”
aov_text: sien Gaäl die manskappe en sê vir Sebul: Kyk, daar kom mense van die bergtoppe af; maar Sebul sê vir hom: Jy sien die skaduwee van die berge vir mense aan!

kjv_text: And Gaal spake again and said, See there come people down by the middle of the land, and another company come along by the plain of Meonenim.
bsb_text: Then Gaal spoke up again, “Look, people are coming down from the center of the land, and one company is coming by way of the Diviners’ Oak.”
aov_text: Maar Gaäl hou aan en sê: Kyk, daar kom mense van die hoogste punt van die land af, en een deel kom uit die rigting van die eik van die towenaar.

kjv_text: Then said Zebul unto him, Where is now thy mouth, wherewith thou saidst, Who is Abimelech, that we should serve him? is not this the people that thou hast despised? go out, I pray now, and fight with them.
bsb_text: “Where is your gloating now?” Zebul replied. “You said, ‘Who is Abimelech that we should serve him?’ Are these not the people you ridiculed? Go out now and fight them!”
aov_text: Daarop sê Sebul vir hom: Waar is nou jou mond waarmee jy gesê het: Wie is Abiméleg, dat ons hom sou dien? Is dit nie die manskappe wat jy verag het nie? Trek nou tog uit en veg teen hulle!

kjv_text: And Gaal went out before the men of Shechem, and fought with Abimelech.
bsb_text: So Gaal went out before the leaders of Shechem and fought against Abimelech,
aov_text: Toe trek Gaäl uit voor die burgers van Sigem en veg teen Abiméleg.

kjv_text: And Abimelech chased him, and he fled before him, and many were overthrown and wounded, even unto the entering of the gate.
bsb_text: but Abimelech pursued him, and Gaal fled before him. And many Shechemites fell wounded all the way to the entrance of the gate.
aov_text: Maar Abiméleg het hom agtervolg, en hy het voor hom uit gevlug, en baie het gesneuwel tot by die ingang van die poort.

kjv_text: And Abimelech dwelt at Arumah: and Zebul thrust out Gaal and his brethren, that they should not dwell in Shechem.
bsb_text: Abimelech stayed in Arumah, and Zebul drove Gaal and his brothers out of Shechem.
aov_text: En Abiméleg het in Áruma gebly, maar Sebul het Gaäl en sy broers verjaag, dat hulle nie in Sigem kon bly woon nie.

kjv_text: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the people went out into the field; and they told Abimelech.
bsb_text: The next day the people of Shechem went out into the fields, and this was reported to Abimelech.
aov_text: En toe die mense die volgende dag uittrek in die veld, is dit aan Abiméleg meegedeel.

kjv_text: And he took the people, and divided them into three companies, and laid wait in the field, and looked, and, behold, the people were come forth out of the city; and he rose up against them, and smote them.
bsb_text: So he took his men, divided them into three companies, and lay in wait in the fields. When he saw the people coming out of the city, he rose up against them and attacked them.
aov_text: Daarop het hy die manskappe geneem en hulle in drie dele verdeel en ’n hinderlaag opgestel in die veld; en toe hy sien dat die mense die stad uittrek, val hy op hulle aan en verslaan hulle.

kjv_text: And Abimelech, and the company that was with him, rushed forward, and stood in the entering of the gate of the city: and the two other companies ran upon all the people that were in the fields, and slew them.
bsb_text: Then Abimelech and the companies with him rushed forward and took their stand at the entrance of the city gate. The other two companies rushed against all who were in the fields and struck them down.
aov_text: Want Abiméleg en die dele wat by hom was, het ingestorm en gaan staan by die ingang van die stadspoort, en die ander twee dele het almal wat in die veld was, bestorm en hulle verslaan.

kjv_text: And Abimelech fought against the city all that day; and he took the city, and slew the people that was therein, and beat down the city, and sowed it with salt.
bsb_text: And all that day Abimelech fought against the city until he had captured it and killed its people. Then he demolished the city and sowed it with salt.
aov_text: En Abiméleg het daardie hele dag teen die stad geveg en die stad ingeneem en die mense wat daarin was, gedood en die stad afgebreek en dit met sout besaai.

kjv_text: And when all the men of the tower of Shechem heard that, they entered into an hold of the house of the god Berith.
bsb_text: On hearing of this, all the leaders in the tower of Shechem entered the inner chamber of the temple of El-berith.
aov_text: Toe al die burgers van die toring van Sigem dit hoor, gaan hulle in die kelder van die tempel van El-Berít in.

kjv_text: And it was told Abimelech, that all the men of the tower of Shechem were gathered together.
bsb_text: And when Abimelech was told that all the leaders in the tower of Shechem were gathered there,
aov_text: En toe dit aan Abiméleg meegedeel is dat al die burgers van die toring van Sigem bymekaargekom het,

kjv_text: And Abimelech gat him up to mount Zalmon, he and all the people that were with him; and Abimelech took an axe in his hand, and cut down a bough from the trees, and took it, and laid it on his shoulder, and said unto the people that were with him, What ye have seen me do, make haste, and do as I have done.
bsb_text: he and all his men went up to Mount Zalmon. Abimelech took his axe in his hand and cut a branch from the trees, which he lifted to his shoulder, saying to his men, “Hurry and do what you have seen me do.”
aov_text: klim Abiméleg, hy en al die manskappe wat by hom was, op die berg Salmon; en Abiméleg het byle met hom saamgeneem en ’n boomtak afgekap en opgetel en dit op sy skouer gesit en aan die manskappe wat by hom was, gesê: Wat julle my sien doen, doen dit my gou na.

kjv_text: And all the people likewise cut down every man his bough, and followed Abimelech, and put them to the hold, and set the hold on fire upon them; so that all the men of the tower of Shechem died also, about a thousand men and women.
bsb_text: So each man also cut his own branch and followed Abimelech. Then they piled the branches against the inner chamber and set it on fire above them, killing everyone in the tower of Shechem, about a thousand men and women.
aov_text: Daarop kap al die manskappe ook elkeen sy tak af en hulle volg Abiméleg en gooi dit op die kelder en steek die kelder bo-op hulle aan die brand, sodat ook al die mense van die Sigemstoring, omtrent duisend manne en vroue, gesterf het.

kjv_text: Then went Abimelech to Thebez, and encamped against Thebez, and took it.
bsb_text: Then Abimelech went to Thebez, encamped against it, and captured it.
aov_text: Daarna het Abiméleg na Tebes getrek en Tebes beleër en dit ingeneem.

kjv_text: But there was a strong tower within the city, and thither fled all the men and women, and all they of the city, and shut it to them, and gat them up to the top of the tower.
bsb_text: But there was a strong tower inside the city, and all the men, women, and leaders of the city fled there. They locked themselves in and went up to the roof of the tower.
aov_text: Maar in die middel van die stad was ’n sterk toring; en daarheen het al die manne en vroue en al die burgers van die stad gevlug, en hulle het agter hulle toegesluit en bo-op die dak van die toring geklim.

kjv_text: And Abimelech came unto the tower, and fought against it, and went hard unto the door of the tower to burn it with fire.
bsb_text: When Abimelech came to attack the tower, he approached its entrance to set it on fire.
aov_text: En Abiméleg het gekom tot by die toring en daarteen geveg; maar toe hy nader kom tot by die ingang van die toring om dit met vuur te verbrand,

kjv_text: And a certain woman cast a piece of a millstone upon Abimelech's head, and all to brake his skull.
bsb_text: But a woman dropped an upper millstone on Abimelech’s head, crushing his skull.
aov_text: gooi ’n vrou die boonste meulsteen op die hoof van Abiméleg en verbrysel sy skedel.

kjv_text: Then he called hastily unto the young man his armourbearer, and said unto him, Draw thy sword, and slay me, that men say not of me, A woman slew him. And his young man thrust him through, and he died.
bsb_text: He quickly called his armor-bearer, saying, “Draw your sword and kill me, lest they say of me, ‘A woman killed him.’” So Abimelech’s armor-bearer ran his sword through him, and he died.
aov_text: Toe roep hy gou die dienaar, sy wapendraer, en sê vir hom: Trek jou swaard uit en maak my van kant, dat hulle nie van my kan sê: ’n Vrou het hom gedood nie. Daarop het sy dienaar hom deurboor, en hy het gesterwe.

kjv_text: And when the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead, they departed every man unto his place.
bsb_text: And when the Israelites saw that Abimelech was dead, they all went home.
aov_text: En toe die manne van Israel sien dat Abiméleg dood was, het hulle elkeen na sy woonplek gegaan.

kjv_text: Thus God rendered the wickedness of Abimelech, which he did unto his father, in slaying his seventy brethren:
bsb_text: In this way God repaid the wickedness that Abimelech had done to his father in murdering his seventy brothers.
aov_text: So het God dan die kwaad van Abiméleg vergelde wat hy sy vader aangedoen het deur sy sewentig broers te vermoor.

kjv_text: And all the evil of the men of Shechem did God render upon their heads: and upon them came the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal.
bsb_text: And God also brought all the wickedness of the men of Shechem back upon their own heads. So the curse of Jotham son of Jerubbaal came upon them.
aov_text: En al die kwaad van die manne van Sigem het God op hulle eie hoof laat neerkom; en die vloek van Jotam, die seun van Jerúbbaäl, het oor hulle gekom.

kjv_text: And after Abimelech there arose to defend Israel Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar; and he dwelt in Shamir in mount Ephraim.
bsb_text: After the time of Abimelech, a man of Issachar, Tola son of Puah, the son of Dodo, rose up to save Israel. He lived in Shamir, in the hill country of Ephraim.
aov_text: EN ná Abiméleg het Tola, die seun van Pua, die seun van Dodo, ’n man uit Íssaskar, opgetree om Israel te verlos; en hy het gewoon in Samir op die gebergte van Efraim.

kjv_text: And he judged Israel twenty and three years, and died, and was buried in Shamir.
bsb_text: Tola judged Israel twenty-three years, and when he died, he was buried in Shamir.
aov_text: En hy het Israel drie-en-twintig jaar lank gerig; en hy het gesterwe en is in Samir begrawe.

kjv_text: And after him arose Jair, a Gileadite, and judged Israel twenty and two years.
bsb_text: Tola was followed by Jair the Gileadite, who judged Israel twenty-two years.
aov_text: En ná hom het Jaïr, die Gileadiet, opgetree, en hy het Israel twee-en-twintig jaar lank gerig.

kjv_text: And he had thirty sons that rode on thirty ass colts, and they had thirty cities, which are called Havothjair unto this day, which are in the land of Gilead.
bsb_text: He had thirty sons who rode on thirty donkeys. And they had thirty towns in the land of Gilead, which to this day are called Havvoth-jair.
aov_text: En hy het dertig seuns gehad, wat op dertig jong esels gery en dertig stede gehad het; dié word tot vandag toe die Jaïrsdorpe genoem wat in die land Gílead lê.

kjv_text: And Jair died, and was buried in Camon.
bsb_text: When Jair died, he was buried in Kamon.
aov_text: En Jaïr het gesterwe en is in Kamon begrawe.

kjv_text: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD, and served Baalim, and Ashtaroth, and the gods of Syria, and the gods of Zidon, and the gods of Moab, and the gods of the children of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines, and forsook the LORD, and served not him.
bsb_text: And again the Israelites did evil in the sight of the LORD. They served the Baals, the Ashtoreths, the gods of Aram, Sidon, and Moab, and the gods of the Ammonites and Philistines. Thus they forsook the LORD and did not serve Him.
aov_text: EN die kinders van Israel het weer gedoen wat verkeerd was in die oë van die HERE, en hulle het die Baäls en die Astartes gedien, en die gode van Aram en die gode van Sidon en die gode van Moab en die gode van die kinders van Ammon en die gode van die Filistyne, en hulle het die HERE verlaat en Hom nie gedien nie.

kjv_text: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and he sold them into the hands of the Philistines, and into the hands of the children of Ammon.
bsb_text: So the anger of the LORD burned against Israel, and He sold them into the hands of the Philistines and Ammonites,
aov_text: Daarom het die toorn van die HERE ontvlam teen Israel, en Hy het hulle verkoop in die hand van die Filistyne en in die hand van die kinders van Ammon.

kjv_text: And that year they vexed and oppressed the children of Israel: eighteen years, all the children of Israel that were on the other side Jordan in the land of the Amorites, which is in Gilead.
bsb_text: who that very year harassed and oppressed the Israelites, and did so for eighteen years to all the Israelites on the other side of the Jordan in Gilead, the land of the Amorites.
aov_text: En hulle het die kinders van Israel verpletter en verdruk in daardie jaar, agttien jaar lank, al die kinders van Israel wat oorkant die Jordaan gewoon het in die land van die Amoriete, wat in Gílead was.

kjv_text: Moreover the children of Ammon passed over Jordan to fight also against Judah, and against Benjamin, and against the house of Ephraim; so that Israel was sore distressed.
bsb_text: The Ammonites also crossed the Jordan to fight against Judah, Benjamin, and the house of Ephraim, and Israel was in deep distress.
aov_text: Daarby het die kinders van Ammon die Jordaan oorgetrek om ook teen Juda en Benjamin en die huis van Efraim te veg, sodat Israel dit baie benoud gehad het.

kjv_text: And the children of Israel cried unto the LORD, saying, We have sinned against thee, both because we have forsaken our God, and also served Baalim.
bsb_text: Then the Israelites cried out to the LORD, saying, “We have sinned against You, for we have indeed forsaken our God and served the Baals.”
aov_text: Toe roep die kinders van Israel die HERE aan en sê: Ons het teen U gesondig, want ons het onse God verlaat en die Baäls gedien.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto the children of Israel, Did not I deliver you from the Egyptians, and from the Amorites, from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines?
bsb_text: The LORD replied, “When the Egyptians, Amorites, Ammonites, Philistines,
aov_text: Maar die HERE het aan die kinders van Israel gesê: Het Ek julle nie van die Egiptenaars en van die Amoriete, van die kinders van Ammon en van die Filistyne —

kjv_text: The Zidonians also, and the Amalekites, and the Maonites, did oppress you; and ye cried to me, and I delivered you out of their hand.
bsb_text: Sidonians, Amalekites, and Maonites oppressed you and you cried out to Me, did I not save you from their hands?
aov_text: en toe die Sidoniërs en Amalekiete en Maoniete julle verdruk en julle My aangeroep het—julle uit hulle hand verlos nie?

kjv_text: Yet ye have forsaken me, and served other gods: wherefore I will deliver you no more.
bsb_text: But you have forsaken Me and served other gods, so I will no longer save you.
aov_text: Maar julle het My verlaat en ander gode gedien; daarom sal Ek julle nie meer verlos nie.

kjv_text: Go and cry unto the gods which ye have chosen; let them deliver you in the time of your tribulation.
bsb_text: Go and cry out to the gods you have chosen. Let them save you in your time of trouble.”
aov_text: Gaan heen en roep die gode aan wat julle verkies het; laat dié julle verlos in die tyd van julle benoudheid.

kjv_text: And the children of Israel said unto the LORD, We have sinned: do thou unto us whatsoever seemeth good unto thee; deliver us only, we pray thee, this day.
bsb_text: “We have sinned,” the Israelites said to the LORD. “Deal with us as You see fit; but please deliver us today!”
aov_text: Toe sê die kinders van Israel aan die HERE: Ons het gesondig; maak met ons net soos dit goed is in u oë; verlos ons tog net vandag.

kjv_text: And they put away the strange gods from among them, and served the LORD: and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.
bsb_text: So they put away the foreign gods from among them and served the LORD, and He could no longer bear the misery of Israel.
aov_text: En hulle het die vreemde gode uit hul midde verwyder en die HERE gedien; toe het Hy ongeduldig geword oor die moeite van Israel.

kjv_text: Then the children of Ammon were gathered together, and encamped in Gilead. And the children of Israel assembled themselves together, and encamped in Mizpeh.
bsb_text: Then the Ammonites were called to arms and camped in Gilead, and the Israelites assembled and camped at Mizpah.
aov_text: En die kinders van Ammon is byeengeroep en het laer opgeslaan in Gílead; maar die kinders van Israel het bymekaargekom en laer opgeslaan by Mispa.

kjv_text: And the people and princes of Gilead said one to another, What man is he that will begin to fight against the children of Ammon? he shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.
bsb_text: And the rulers of Gilead said to one another, “Whoever will launch the attack against the Ammonites will be the head of all who live in Gilead.”
aov_text: Toe sê die manskappe, die vorste van Gílead, die een aan die ander: Wie is die man wat sal begin om te veg teen die kinders van Ammon? Hy sal hoof wees oor al die inwoners van Gílead.

kjv_text: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valour, and he was the son of an harlot: and Gilead begat Jephthah.
bsb_text: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valor; he was the son of a prostitute, and Gilead was his father.
aov_text: EN Jefta, die Gileadiet, was ’n dapper held, maar hy was die seun van ’n hoer; en Gílead was die vader van Jefta.

kjv_text: And Gilead's wife bare him sons; and his wife's sons grew up, and they thrust out Jephthah, and said unto him, Thou shalt not inherit in our father's house; for thou art the son of a strange woman.
bsb_text: And Gilead’s wife bore him sons who grew up, drove Jephthah out, and said to him, “You shall have no inheritance in our father’s house, because you are the son of another woman.”
aov_text: En toe die vrou van Gílead vir hom seuns baar, en die seuns van die vrou groot word, het hulle Jefta weggejaag en vir hom gesê: Jy mag in ons familie nie erwe nie, want jy is die seun van ’n ander vrou.

kjv_text: Then Jephthah fled from his brethren, and dwelt in the land of Tob: and there were gathered vain men to Jephthah, and went out with him.
bsb_text: So Jephthah fled from his brothers and settled in the land of Tob, where worthless men gathered around him and traveled with him.
aov_text: Daarop vlug Jefta van sy broers af weg en hy gaan woon in die land Tob; en ligsinnige manne het by Jefta aangesluit en saam met hom uitgetrek.

kjv_text: And it came to pass in process of time, that the children of Ammon made war against Israel.
bsb_text: Some time later, when the Ammonites fought against Israel
aov_text: En ’n tyd daarna het die kinders van Ammon oorlog gevoer teen Israel.

kjv_text: And it was so, that when the children of Ammon made war against Israel, the elders of Gilead went to fetch Jephthah out of the land of Tob:
bsb_text: and made war with them, the elders of Gilead went to get Jephthah from the land of Tob.
aov_text: Maar toe die kinders van Ammon oorlog voer teen Israel, het die oudstes van Gílead Jefta gaan haal uit die land Tob;

kjv_text: And they said unto Jephthah, Come, and be our captain, that we may fight with the children of Ammon.
bsb_text: “Come,” they said, “be our commander, so that we can fight against the Ammonites.”
aov_text: en hulle het vir Jefta gesê: Kom en wees ons aanvoerder, dat ons kan veg teen die kinders van Ammon.

kjv_text: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead, Did not ye hate me, and expel me out of my father's house? and why are ye come unto me now when ye are in distress?
bsb_text: Jephthah replied to the elders of Gilead, “Did you not hate me and expel me from my father’s house? Why then have you come to me now, when you are in distress?”
aov_text: Maar Jefta antwoord die oudstes van Gílead: Het julle my nie gehaat en my uit my vader se huis weggejaag nie? Waarom kom julle dan nou na my, nou dat julle in die benoudheid sit?

kjv_text: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, Therefore we turn again to thee now, that thou mayest go with us, and fight against the children of Ammon, and be our head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.
bsb_text: They answered Jephthah, “This is why we now turn to you, that you may go with us, fight the Ammonites, and become leader over all of us who live in Gilead.”
aov_text: Toe sê die oudstes van Gílead vir Jefta: Daarom kom ons nou na jou terug, dat jy met ons kan saamtrek en teen die kinders van Ammon veg, en dat jy ons hoof kan wees oor al die inwoners van Gílead.

kjv_text: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead, If ye bring me home again to fight against the children of Ammon, and the LORD deliver them before me, shall I be your head?
bsb_text: But Jephthah asked them, “If you take me back to fight the Ammonites and the LORD gives them to me, will I really be your leader?”
aov_text: Daarop antwoord Jefta die oudstes van Gílead: As julle my laat terugkom om teen die kinders van Ammon te veg en die HERE hulle aan my oorgee, dan moet ek julle hoof word.

kjv_text: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, The LORD be witness between us, if we do not so according to thy words.
bsb_text: And the elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, “The LORD is our witness if we do not do as you say.”
aov_text: Toe sê die oudstes van Gílead vir Jefta: Die HERE sal hoorder wees tussen ons. Waarlik, soos jy gesê het, so sal ons doen.

kjv_text: Then Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him head and captain over them: and Jephthah uttered all his words before the LORD in Mizpeh.
bsb_text: So Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him their leader and commander. And Jephthah repeated all his terms in the presence of the LORD at Mizpah.
aov_text: So het Jefta dan met die oudstes van Gílead saamgegaan, en die volk het hom as hoof en aanvoerder oor hulle aangestel, en Jefta het al sy woorde voor die aangesig van die HERE in Mispa gespreek.

kjv_text: And Jephthah sent messengers unto the king of the children of Ammon, saying, What hast thou to do with me, that thou art come against me to fight in my land?
bsb_text: Then Jephthah sent messengers to the king of the Ammonites, saying, “What do you have against me that you have come to fight against my land?”
aov_text: Toe stuur Jefta boodskappers na die koning van die kinders van Ammon om te vra: Wat het ek met u te doen, dat u na my kom om teen my land te veg?

kjv_text: And the king of the children of Ammon answered unto the messengers of Jephthah, Because Israel took away my land, when they came up out of Egypt, from Arnon even unto Jabbok, and unto Jordan: now therefore restore those lands again peaceably.
bsb_text: The king of the Ammonites answered Jephthah’s messengers, “When Israel came up out of Egypt, they seized my land, from the Arnon to the Jabbok and all the way to the Jordan. Now, therefore, restore it peaceably.”
aov_text: En die koning van die kinders van Ammon sê aan die boodskappers van Jefta: Israel het my land geneem toe hy opgetrek het uit Egipte, van die Arnon af tot by die Jabbok en tot by die Jordaan; gee dit dan nou in vrede terug.

kjv_text: And Jephthah sent messengers again unto the king of the children of Ammon:
bsb_text: Jephthah again sent messengers to the king of the Ammonites
aov_text: En Jefta het nog weer boodskappers gestuur na die koning van die kinders van Ammon

kjv_text: And said unto him, Thus saith Jephthah, Israel took not away the land of Moab, nor the land of the children of Ammon:
bsb_text: to tell him, “This is what Jephthah says: Israel did not take away the land of Moab or of the Ammonites.
aov_text: en vir hom gesê: So sê Jefta: Israel het die land Moab en die land van die kinders van Ammon nie geneem nie.

kjv_text: But when Israel came up from Egypt, and walked through the wilderness unto the Red sea, and came to Kadesh;
bsb_text: But when Israel came up out of Egypt, they traveled through the wilderness to the Red Sea and came to Kadesh.
aov_text: Want Israel het toe hy uit Egipte opgetrek het, deur die woestyn gegaan tot by die Skelfsee en het by Kades gekom.

kjv_text: Then Israel sent messengers unto the king of Edom, saying, Let me, I pray thee, pass through thy land: but the king of Edom would not hearken thereto. And in like manner they sent unto the king of Moab: but he would not consent: and Israel abode in Kadesh.
bsb_text: Then Israel sent messengers to the king of Edom, saying, ‘Please let us pass through your land,’ but the king of Edom would not listen. They also sent messengers to the king of Moab, but he would not consent. So Israel stayed in Kadesh.
aov_text: En Israel het boodskappers gestuur na die koning van Edom om te sê: Laat my tog deur u land trek; maar die koning van Edom het geen gehoor gegee nie; en na die koning van Moab het hy gestuur, maar hy wou ook nie. Daarom het Israel in Kades gebly.

kjv_text: Then they went along through the wilderness, and compassed the land of Edom, and the land of Moab, and came by the east side of the land of Moab, and pitched on the other side of Arnon, but came not within the border of Moab: for Arnon was the border of Moab.
bsb_text: Then Israel traveled through the wilderness and bypassed the lands of Edom and Moab. They came to the east side of the land of Moab and camped on the other side of the Arnon. But they did not enter the territory of Moab, since the Arnon was its border.
aov_text: Verder het hy deur die woestyn gegaan en om die land Edom en die land Moab getrek en gekom aan die oostekant van die land Moab; en hulle het laer opgeslaan oorkant die Arnon, maar nie in die gebied van Moab ingekom nie, want die Arnon is die grens van Moab.

kjv_text: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, the king of Heshbon; and Israel said unto him, Let us pass, we pray thee, through thy land into my place.
bsb_text: And Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, who ruled in Heshbon, and said to him, ‘Please let us pass through your land into our own place.’
aov_text: Daarop het Israel boodskappers gestuur na Sihon, die koning van die Amoriete, die koning van Hesbon, en Israel het vir hom gesê: Laat ons tog deur u land trek na my plek toe.

kjv_text: But Sihon trusted not Israel to pass through his coast: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and pitched in Jahaz, and fought against Israel.
bsb_text: But Sihon would not trust Israel to pass through his territory. So he gathered all his people, encamped in Jahaz, and fought with Israel.
aov_text: Maar Sihon het Israel nie vertrou om deur sy gebied te trek nie, en Sihon het al sy manskappe versamel, en hulle het laer opgeslaan in Jahas en teen Israel geveg.

kjv_text: And the LORD God of Israel delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel, and they smote them: so Israel possessed all the land of the Amorites, the inhabitants of that country.
bsb_text: Then the LORD, the God of Israel, delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel, who defeated them. So Israel took possession of all the land of the Amorites who inhabited that country,
aov_text: Maar die HERE, die God van Israel, het Sihon en sy hele volk in die hand van Israel gegee, en dié het hulle verslaan; sodat Israel die hele land van die Amoriete, die inwoners van daardie land, in besit geneem het.

kjv_text: And they possessed all the coasts of the Amorites, from Arnon even unto Jabbok, and from the wilderness even unto Jordan.
bsb_text: seizing all the land from the Arnon to the Jabbok and from the wilderness to the Jordan.
aov_text: En hulle het die hele grondgebied van die Amoriete, van die Arnon af tot by die Jabbok en van die woestyn af tot by die Jordaan, in besit geneem.

kjv_text: So now the LORD God of Israel hath dispossessed the Amorites from before his people Israel, and shouldest thou possess it?
bsb_text: Now since the LORD, the God of Israel, has driven out the Amorites from before His people Israel, should you now possess it?
aov_text: So het die HERE, die God van Israel, dan die Amoriete voor sy volk Israel uit verdrywe, en wil u dit in besit neem?

kjv_text: Wilt not thou possess that which Chemosh thy god giveth thee to possess? So whomsoever the LORD our God shall drive out from before us, them will we possess.
bsb_text: Do you not possess whatever your god Chemosh grants you? So also, we possess whatever the LORD our God has granted us.
aov_text: Sal u dit nie in besit neem wat u god Kamos u as ’n besitting gee, en óns alles wat die HERE onse God voor ons uit verdrywe, in besit neem nie?

kjv_text: And now art thou any thing better than Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab? did he ever strive against Israel, or did he ever fight against them,
bsb_text: Are you now so much better than Balak son of Zippor, king of Moab? Did he ever contend with Israel or fight against them?
aov_text: En is u nou soveel beter as Balak, die seun van Sippor, die koning van Moab? Het hy ooit met Israel getwis, of ooit teen hulle geveg?

kjv_text: While Israel dwelt in Heshbon and her towns, and in Aroer and her towns, and in all the cities that be along by the coasts of Arnon, three hundred years? why therefore did ye not recover them within that time?
bsb_text: For three hundred years Israel has lived in Heshbon, Aroer, and their villages, as well as all the cities along the banks of the Arnon. Why did you not take them back during that time?
aov_text: Terwyl Israel in Hesbon met sy onderhorige plekke en in Ároër met sy onderhorige plekke en in al die stede wat langs die Arnon lê, driehonderd jaar lank gewoon het, waarom het julle dit dan nie in dié tyd ontset nie?

kjv_text: Wherefore I have not sinned against thee, but thou doest me wrong to war against me: the LORD the Judge be judge this day between the children of Israel and the children of Ammon.
bsb_text: I have not sinned against you, but you have done me wrong by waging war against me. May the LORD, the Judge, decide today between the Israelites and the Ammonites.”
aov_text: So het ék dan nie teen u gesondig nie, maar ú handel so sleg met my om teen my oorlog te voer. Mag die HERE, die Regter, vandag oordeel tussen die kinders van Israel en die kinders van Ammon!

kjv_text: Howbeit the king of the children of Ammon hearkened not unto the words of Jephthah which he sent him.
bsb_text: But the king of the Ammonites paid no heed to the message Jephthah sent him.
aov_text: Maar die koning van die kinders van Ammon het nie geluister na die woorde van Jefta wat hy hom laat weet het nie.

kjv_text: Then the Spirit of the LORD came upon Jephthah, and he passed over Gilead, and Manasseh, and passed over Mizpeh of Gilead, and from Mizpeh of Gilead he passed over unto the children of Ammon.
bsb_text: Then the Spirit of the LORD came upon Jephthah, and he passed through Gilead and Manasseh, then through Mizpah of Gilead. And from there he advanced against the Ammonites.
aov_text: Toe het die Gees van die HERE op Jefta gekom, en hy het oorgetrek na Gílead en Manasse en verder deur na Mispe in Gílead; en van Mispe in Gílead het hy deurgetrek na die kinders van Ammon.

kjv_text: And Jephthah vowed a vow unto the LORD, and said, If thou shalt without fail deliver the children of Ammon into mine hands,
bsb_text: Jephthah made this vow to the LORD: “If indeed You will deliver the Ammonites into my hand,
aov_text: En Jefta het aan die HERE ’n gelofte gedoen en gesê: As U werklik die kinders van Ammon in my hand gee,

kjv_text: Then it shall be, that whatsoever cometh forth of the doors of my house to meet me, when I return in peace from the children of Ammon, shall surely be the LORD's, and I will offer it up for a burnt offering.
bsb_text: then whatever comes out the door of my house to greet me on my triumphant return from the Ammonites will belong to the LORD, and I will offer it up as a burnt offering.”
aov_text: dan sal wat uitkom, wat uit die deure van my huis uitkom my tegemoet, as ek in vrede terugkom van die kinders van Ammon, aan die HERE behoort, en ek sal dit as ’n brandoffer bring.

kjv_text: So Jephthah passed over unto the children of Ammon to fight against them; and the LORD delivered them into his hands.

aov_text: Daarop het Jefta deurgetrek na die kinders van Ammon om teen hulle te veg, en die HERE het hulle in sy hand gegee.

kjv_text: And he smote them from Aroer, even till thou come to Minnith, even twenty cities, and unto the plain of the vineyards, with a very great slaughter. Thus the children of Ammon were subdued before the children of Israel.
bsb_text: With a great blow he devastated twenty cities from Aroer to the vicinity of Minnith, as far as Abel-keramim. So the Ammonites were subdued before the Israelites.
aov_text: En hy het hulle verslaan van Ároër af in die rigting na Minnit, twintig stede, en tot by Abel-Kerámim—’n baie groot slag; sodat die kinders van Ammon verneder is voor die kinders van Israel.

kjv_text: And Jephthah came to Mizpeh unto his house, and, behold, his daughter came out to meet him with timbrels and with dances: and she was his only child; beside her he had neither son nor daughter.
bsb_text: And when Jephthah returned home to Mizpah, there was his daughter coming out to meet him with tambourines and dancing! She was his only child; he had no son or daughter besides her.
aov_text: En toe Jefta in Mispa by sy huis kom, gaan sy dogter juis uit hom tegemoet met tamboeryne en koordanse; en sy was die enigste kind: hy het geen seun of dogter buiten haar gehad nie.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when he saw her, that he rent his clothes, and said, Alas, my daughter! thou hast brought me very low, and thou art one of them that trouble me: for I have opened my mouth unto the LORD, and I cannot go back.
bsb_text: As soon as Jephthah saw her, he tore his clothes and said, “No! Not my daughter! You have brought me to my knees! You have brought great misery upon me, for I have given my word to the LORD and cannot take it back.”
aov_text: En net toe hy haar sien, skeur hy sy klere en sê: Ag, my dogter, jy druk my heeltemal neer, en jý stort my in die ongeluk! Want ek het my mond geopen teenoor die HERE, en ek kan nie terugtrek nie.

kjv_text: And she said unto him, My father, if thou hast opened thy mouth unto the LORD, do to me according to that which hath proceeded out of thy mouth; forasmuch as the LORD hath taken vengeance for thee of thine enemies, even of the children of Ammon.
bsb_text: “My father,” she replied, “you have given your word to the LORD. Do to me as you have said, for the LORD has avenged you of your enemies, the Ammonites.”
aov_text: En sy antwoord hom: My vader, as u u mond geopen het teenoor die HERE, maak met my soos uit u mond uitgegaan het nadat die HERE u volkome wraak verskaf het op u vyande, op die kinders van Ammon.

kjv_text: And she said unto her father, Let this thing be done for me: let me alone two months, that I may go up and down upon the mountains, and bewail my virginity, I and my fellows.
bsb_text: She also said to her father, “Let me do this one thing: Let me wander for two months through the mountains with my friends and mourn my virginity.”
aov_text: Verder het sy vir haar vader gesê: Laat dít my toegestaan word: laat my twee maande vry, dat ek kan weggaan en afdaal na die berge en my maagdelike staat beween, ek en my vriendinne.

kjv_text: And he said, Go. And he sent her away for two months: and she went with her companions, and bewailed her virginity upon the mountains.
bsb_text: “Go,” he said. And he sent her away for two months. So she left with her friends and mourned her virginity upon the mountains.
aov_text: En hy sê: Gaan! En hy het haar vir twee maande laat gaan. Sy het toe weggegaan met haar vriendinne en haar maagdelike staat op die berge beween.

kjv_text: And it came to pass at the end of two months, that she returned unto her father, who did with her according to his vow which he had vowed: and she knew no man. And it was a custom in Israel,
bsb_text: After two months, she returned to her father, and he did to her as he had vowed. And she had never had relations with a man. So it has become a custom in Israel
aov_text: En aan die end van twee maande het sy na haar vader teruggekom, en hy het die gelofte wat deur hom gedoen is, aan haar voltrek; en sy het geen man beken nie. En dit het ’n gewoonte geword in Israel

kjv_text: That the daughters of Israel went yearly to lament the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite four days in a year.
bsb_text: that each year the young women of Israel go out for four days to lament the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite.
aov_text: dat die dogters van Israel jaar vir jaar heengaan om die dogter van Jefta, die Gileadiet, te besing, vier dae in die jaar.

kjv_text: And the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together, and went northward, and said unto Jephthah, Wherefore passedst thou over to fight against the children of Ammon, and didst not call us to go with thee? we will burn thine house upon thee with fire.
bsb_text: Then the men of Ephraim assembled and crossed the Jordan to Zaphon. They said to Jephthah, “Why have you crossed over to fight the Ammonites without calling us to go with you? We will burn your house down with you inside!”
aov_text: EN die manne van Efraim is saamgeroep en het oorgetrek na Safon toe en vir Jefta gesê: Waarom het u deurgetrek om teen die kinders van Ammon te veg en óns nie geroep om saam met u te trek nie? Ons sal u huis bo u met vuur verbrand.

kjv_text: And Jephthah said unto them, I and my people were at great strife with the children of Ammon; and when I called you, ye delivered me not out of their hands.
bsb_text: But Jephthah replied, “My people and I had a serious conflict with the Ammonites, and when I called, you did not save me out of their hands.
aov_text: Maar Jefta sê vir hulle: Ek en my volk het ’n hewige twis met die kinders van Ammon gehad, en ek het julle opgeroep, maar julle het my nie uit hulle hand verlos nie.

kjv_text: And when I saw that ye delivered me not, I put my life in my hands, and passed over against the children of Ammon, and the LORD delivered them into my hand: wherefore then are ye come up unto me this day, to fight against me?
bsb_text: When I saw that you would not save me, I risked my life and crossed over to the Ammonites, and the LORD delivered them into my hand. Why then have you come today to fight against me?”
aov_text: En toe ek sien dat jy nie help nie, het ek my lewe gewaag en deurgetrek na die kinders van Ammon; en die HERE het hulle in my hand gegee. Waarom het julle dan vandag teen my opgetrek om teen my oorlog te voer?

kjv_text: Then Jephthah gathered together all the men of Gilead, and fought with Ephraim: and the men of Gilead smote Ephraim, because they said, Ye Gileadites are fugitives of Ephraim among the Ephraimites, and among the Manassites.
bsb_text: Jephthah then gathered all the men of Gilead and fought against Ephraim. And the men of Gilead struck them down because the Ephraimites had said, “You Gileadites are fugitives in Ephraim, living in the territories of Ephraim and Manasseh.”
aov_text: Daarop versamel Jefta al die manne van Gílead om teen Efraim te veg; en die manne van Gílead het Efraim verslaan, omdat hulle gesê het: Julle, Gileadiete, is vlugtelinge van Efraim, in die midde van Efraim en Manasse.

kjv_text: And the Gileadites took the passages of Jordan before the Ephraimites: and it was so, that when those Ephraimites which were escaped said, Let me go over; that the men of Gilead said unto him, Art thou an Ephraimite? If he said, Nay;
bsb_text: The Gileadites captured the fords of the Jordan leading to Ephraim, and whenever a fugitive from Ephraim would say, “Let me cross over,” the Gileadites would ask him, “Are you an Ephraimite?” If he answered, “No,”
aov_text: En Gílead het die Efraimiete van die Jordaan-driwwe afgesny; en as die vlugtelinge van Efraim sê: Ek wil deurgaan—dan vra die manne van Gílead vir hom: Is jy ’n Efraimiet? As hy sê: Nee,

kjv_text: Then said they unto him, Say now Shibboleth: and he said Sibboleth: for he could not frame to pronounce it right. Then they took him, and slew him at the passages of Jordan: and there fell at that time of the Ephraimites forty and two thousand.
bsb_text: they told him, “Please say Shibboleth.” If he said, “Sibboleth,” because he could not pronounce it correctly, they seized him and killed him at the fords of the Jordan. So at that time 42,000 Ephraimites were killed.
aov_text: dan vra hulle hom: Sê bietjie: Sjibbolet! En as hy sê: Sibbolet! en nie ag gee om dit reg uit te spreek nie, dan gryp hulle hom en maak hom by die Jordaan-driwwe dood. So het daar dan in dié tyd van Efraim twee-en-veertigduisend man geval.

kjv_text: And Jephthah judged Israel six years. Then died Jephthah the Gileadite, and was buried in one of the cities of Gilead.
bsb_text: Jephthah judged Israel six years, and when he died, he was buried in one of the cities of Gilead.
aov_text: En Jefta het Israel ses jaar lank gerig; en Jefta, die Gileadiet, het gesterwe en is begrawe in een van die stede van Gílead.

kjv_text: And after him Ibzan of Bethlehem judged Israel.
bsb_text: After Jephthah, Ibzan of Bethlehem judged Israel.
aov_text: EN ná hom het Ebsan, uit Betlehem, Israel gerig.

kjv_text: And he had thirty sons, and thirty daughters, whom he sent abroad, and took in thirty daughters from abroad for his sons. And he judged Israel seven years.
bsb_text: He had thirty sons, as well as thirty daughters whom he gave in marriage to men outside his clan; and for his sons he brought back thirty wives from elsewhere. Ibzan judged Israel seven years.
aov_text: En hy het dertig seuns gehad, en dertig dogters het hy uitgehuwelik en van buite af dertig dogters vir sy seuns ingebring; en hy het Israel sewe jaar lank gerig.

kjv_text: Then died Ibzan, and was buried at Bethlehem.
bsb_text: Then Ibzan died, and he was buried in Bethlehem.
aov_text: En Ebsan het gesterwe en is begrawe in Betlehem.

kjv_text: And after him Elon, a Zebulonite, judged Israel; and he judged Israel ten years.
bsb_text: After Ibzan, Elon the Zebulunite judged Israel ten years.
aov_text: En ná hom het Elon, die Sebuloniet, Israel gerig; en hy het Israel tien jaar lank gerig.

kjv_text: And Elon the Zebulonite died, and was buried in Aijalon in the country of Zebulun.
bsb_text: Then Elon the Zebulunite died, and he was buried in Aijalon in the land of Zebulun.
aov_text: En Elon, die Sebuloniet, het gesterwe en is begrawe in Ájalon, in die land Sébulon.

kjv_text: And after him Abdon the son of Hillel, a Pirathonite, judged Israel.
bsb_text: After Elon, Abdon son of Hillel, from Pirathon, judged Israel.
aov_text: En ná hom het Abdon, die seun van Hillel, die Pireatoniet, Israel gerig.

kjv_text: And he had forty sons and thirty nephews, that rode on threescore and ten ass colts: and he judged Israel eight years.
bsb_text: He had forty sons and thirty grandsons, who rode on seventy donkeys. And he judged Israel eight years.
aov_text: En hy het veertig seuns en dertig kleinseuns gehad wat op sewentig jong esels gery het; en hy het Israel agt jaar lank gerig.

kjv_text: And Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died, and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the mount of the Amalekites.
bsb_text: Then Abdon son of Hillel, from Pirathon, died, and he was buried at Pirathon in Ephraim, in the hill country of the Amalekites.
aov_text: En Abdon, die seun van Hillel, die Pireatoniet, het gesterwe en is begrawe in Píreaton, in die land Efraim, op die gebergte van die Amalekiete.

kjv_text: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD; and the LORD delivered them into the hand of the Philistines forty years.
bsb_text: Again the Israelites did evil in the sight of the LORD, so He delivered them into the hand of the Philistines for forty years.
aov_text: EN toe die kinders van Israel weer doen wat verkeerd is in die oë van die HERE, het die HERE hulle oorgegee in die hand van die Filistyne, veertig jaar lank.

kjv_text: And there was a certain man of Zorah, of the family of the Danites, whose name was Manoah; and his wife was barren, and bare not.
bsb_text: Now there was a man from Zorah named Manoah, from the clan of the Danites, whose wife was barren and had no children.
aov_text: En daar was ’n man uit Sórea, uit die geslag van die Daniete, met die naam van Manóag; en sy vrou was onvrugbaar en het geen kinders gehad nie.

kjv_text: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto the woman, and said unto her, Behold now, thou art barren, and bearest not: but thou shalt conceive, and bear a son.
bsb_text: The angel of the LORD appeared to the woman and said to her, “It is true that you are barren and have no children; but you will conceive and give birth to a son.
aov_text: Maar die Engel van die HERE het aan die vrou verskyn en vir haar gesê: Kyk, jy is onvrugbaar en het geen kinders gehad nie, maar jy sal swanger word en ’n seun baar.

kjv_text: Now therefore beware, I pray thee, and drink not wine nor strong drink, and eat not any unclean thing:
bsb_text: Now please be careful not to drink wine or strong drink, and not to eat anything unclean.
aov_text: Neem jou dan nou tog in ag en drink geen wyn of sterk drank nie, en eet niks wat onrein is nie.

kjv_text: For, lo, thou shalt conceive, and bear a son; and no razor shall come on his head: for the child shall be a Nazarite unto God from the womb: and he shall begin to deliver Israel out of the hand of the Philistines.
bsb_text: For behold, you will conceive and give birth to a son. And no razor shall come over his head, because the boy will be a Nazirite to God from the womb, and he will begin the deliverance of Israel from the hand of the Philistines.”
aov_text: Want kyk, jy sal swanger word en ’n seun baar, en geen skeermes mag op sy hoof kom nie; want die seun sal van die moederskoot af ’n nasireër van God wees, en hy sal Israel begin verlos uit die hand van die Filistyne.

kjv_text: Then the woman came and told her husband, saying, A man of God came unto me, and his countenance was like the countenance of an angel of God, very terrible: but I asked him not whence he was, neither told he me his name:
bsb_text: So the woman went and told her husband, “A man of God came to me. His appearance was like the angel of God, exceedingly awesome. I did not ask him where he came from, and he did not tell me his name.
aov_text: Daarop kom die vrou in en spreek met haar man en sê: ’n Man van God het na my gekom, en sy voorkoms was soos die voorkoms van die Engel van God, baie vreeslik; maar ek het Hom nie gevra waar Hy vandaan was nie, en sy naam het Hy my nie meegedeel nie.

kjv_text: But he said unto me, Behold, thou shalt conceive, and bear a son; and now drink no wine nor strong drink, neither eat any unclean thing: for the child shall be a Nazarite to God from the womb to the day of his death.
bsb_text: But he said to me, ‘Behold, you will conceive and give birth to a son. Now, therefore, do not drink wine or strong drink, and do not eat anything unclean, because the boy will be a Nazirite to God from the womb until the day of his death.’”
aov_text: Maar Hy het vir my gesê: Kyk, jy sal swanger word en ’n seun baar; drink dan nou geen wyn of sterk drank nie, en eet niks wat onrein is nie; want die seun sal ’n nasireër van God wees van die moederskoot af tot die dag van sy dood toe.

kjv_text: Then Manoah intreated the LORD, and said, O my Lord, let the man of God which thou didst send come again unto us, and teach us what we shall do unto the child that shall be born.
bsb_text: Then Manoah prayed to the LORD, “Please, O Lord, let the man of God You sent us come to us again to teach us how to raise the boy who is to be born.”
aov_text: En Manóag het tot die HERE gebid en gesê: Ag, Here, laat tog die man van God wat U gestuur het, nog ’n keer na ons toe kom, dat hy ons kan leer hoe ons moet maak met die seun wat gebore sal word.

kjv_text: And God hearkened to the voice of Manoah; and the angel of God came again unto the woman as she sat in the field: but Manoah her husband was not with her.
bsb_text: And God listened to the voice of Manoah, and the angel of God returned to the woman as she was sitting in the field; but her husband Manoah was not with her.
aov_text: En God het geluister na die stem van Manóag, sodat die Engel van God nog ’n keer na die vrou gekom het terwyl sy in die veld sit en haar man Manóag nie by haar was nie.

kjv_text: And the woman made haste, and ran, and shewed her husband, and said unto him, Behold, the man hath appeared unto me, that came unto me the other day.
bsb_text: The woman ran quickly to tell her husband, “Behold, the man who came to me the other day has reappeared!”
aov_text: En die vrou het haastig geloop en haar man dit vertel en vir hom gesê: Kyk, die man het aan my verskyn wat die ander dag na my gekom het.

kjv_text: And Manoah arose, and went after his wife, and came to the man, and said unto him, Art thou the man that spakest unto the woman? And he said, I am.
bsb_text: So Manoah got up and followed his wife. When he came to the man, he asked, “Are you the man who spoke to my wife?” “I am,” he said.
aov_text: Toe staan Manóag op en loop agter sy vrou aan, en hy kom by die man en vra hom: Is U die man wat met dié vrou gespreek het? Toe sê Hy: Ja.

kjv_text: And Manoah said, Now let thy words come to pass. How shall we order the child, and how shall we do unto him?
bsb_text: Then Manoah asked, “When your words come to pass, what will be the boy’s rule of life and mission?”
aov_text: Daarop vra Manóag: As u woorde nou uitkom, wat moet die leefwyse en die werk van die seun wees?

kjv_text: And the angel of the LORD said unto Manoah, Of all that I said unto the woman let her beware.
bsb_text: So the angel of the LORD answered Manoah, “Your wife is to do everything I told her.
aov_text: Toe sê die Engel van die HERE aan Manóag: Vir alles wat Ek aan die vrou gesê het, moet sy haar in ag neem.

kjv_text: She may not eat of any thing that cometh of the vine, neither let her drink wine or strong drink, nor eat any unclean thing: all that I commanded her let her observe.
bsb_text: She must not eat anything that comes from the vine, nor drink any wine or strong drink, nor eat anything unclean. She must do everything I have commanded her.”
aov_text: Van alles wat van die wingerdstok afkomstig is, mag sy nie eet nie; en geen wyn of sterk drank moet sy drink nie en niks eet wat onrein is nie; alles wat Ek haar beveel het, moet sy onderhou.

kjv_text: And Manoah said unto the angel of the LORD, I pray thee, let us detain thee, until we shall have made ready a kid for thee.
bsb_text: “Please stay here,” Manoah said to the angel of the LORD, “and we will prepare a young goat for you.”
aov_text: Manóag sê aan die Engel van die HERE: Laat ons U tog ophou, dat ons ’n bokkie vir U kan berei.

kjv_text: And the angel of the LORD said unto Manoah, Though thou detain me, I will not eat of thy bread: and if thou wilt offer a burnt offering, thou must offer it unto the LORD. For Manoah knew not that he was an angel of the LORD.
bsb_text: And the angel of the LORD replied, “Even if I stay, I will not eat your food. But if you prepare a burnt offering, offer it to the LORD.” For Manoah did not know that it was the angel of the LORD.
aov_text: En die Engel van die HERE antwoord Manóag: Al hou jy My op, Ek sal nie van jou brood eet nie; maar as jy ’n brandoffer wil berei, offer dit dan aan die HERE. Want Manóag het nie geweet dat dit die Engel van die HERE was nie.

kjv_text: And Manoah said unto the angel of the LORD, What is thy name, that when thy sayings come to pass we may do thee honour?
bsb_text: Then Manoah said to the angel of the LORD, “What is your name, so that we may honor you when your word comes to pass?”
aov_text: Daarop vra Manóag die Engel van die HERE: Wat is u naam, dat ons U kan vereer as u woord uitkom?

kjv_text: And the angel of the LORD said unto him, Why askest thou thus after my name, seeing it is secret?
bsb_text: “Why do you ask my name,” said the angel of the LORD, “since it is beyond comprehension?”
aov_text: En die Engel van die HERE sê vir hom: Waarom vra jy dan na my naam terwyl hy wonderbaar is?

kjv_text: So Manoah took a kid with a meat offering, and offered it upon a rock unto the LORD: and the angel did wonderously; and Manoah and his wife looked on.
bsb_text: Then Manoah took a young goat and a grain offering and offered them on a rock to the LORD. And as Manoah and his wife looked on, the LORD did a marvelous thing.
aov_text: Toe neem Manóag die bokkie en die spysoffer en offer dit op die rots aan die HERE terwyl Hy wonderbaarlik handel voor die oë van Manóag en sy vrou:

kjv_text: For it came to pass, when the flame went up toward heaven from off the altar, that the angel of the LORD ascended in the flame of the altar. And Manoah and his wife looked on it, and fell on their faces to the ground.
bsb_text: When the flame went up from the altar to the sky, the angel of the LORD ascended in the flame. When Manoah and his wife saw this, they fell facedown to the ground.
aov_text: toe die vlam van die altaar opstyg na bo, het die Engel van die HERE in die vlam van die altaar opgevaar; en Manóag en sy vrou het dit gesien en met hulle aangesig op die grond geval.

kjv_text: But the angel of the LORD did no more appear to Manoah and to his wife. Then Manoah knew that he was an angel of the LORD.
bsb_text: And when the angel of the LORD did not appear again to Manoah and his wife, Manoah realized that it had been the angel of the LORD.
aov_text: En die Engel van die HERE het verder nie meer aan Manóag en sy vrou verskyn nie. Daarop bemerk Manóag dat dit die Engel van die HERE was.

kjv_text: And Manoah said unto his wife, We shall surely die, because we have seen God.
bsb_text: “We are going to die,” he said to his wife, “for we have seen God!”
aov_text: En Manóag sê vir sy vrou: Ons sal sekerlik sterwe, omdat ons God gesien het.

kjv_text: But his wife said unto him, If the LORD were pleased to kill us, he would not have received a burnt offering and a meat offering at our hands, neither would he have shewed us all these things, nor would as at this time have told us such things as these.
bsb_text: But his wife replied, “If the LORD had intended to kill us, He would not have accepted the burnt offering and the grain offering from our hands, nor would He have shown us all these things or spoken to us this way.”
aov_text: Maar sy vrou sê vir hom: As die HERE ons wou laat sterwe, sou Hy nie uit ons hand ’n brandoffer en ’n spysoffer aangeneem en ons al hierdie dinge laat sien en ons nou sulke dinge laat hoor het nie.

kjv_text: And the woman bare a son, and called his name Samson: and the child grew, and the LORD blessed him.
bsb_text: So the woman gave birth to a son and named him Samson. The boy grew, and the LORD blessed him.
aov_text: En die vrou het ’n seun gebaar en hom Simson genoem; en die kind het groot geword, en die HERE het hom geseën.

kjv_text: And the Spirit of the LORD began to move him at times in the camp of Dan between Zorah and Eshtaol.
bsb_text: And the Spirit of the LORD began to stir him at Mahaneh-dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol.
aov_text: En die Gees van die HERE het hom begin drywe in die laer van Dan tussen Sórea en Estáol.

kjv_text: And Samson went down to Timnath, and saw a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines.
bsb_text: One day Samson went down to Timnah, where he saw a young Philistine woman.
aov_text: TOE Simson afgegaan het na Timna, sien hy in Timna ’n vrou uit die dogters van die Filistyne;

kjv_text: And he came up, and told his father and his mother, and said, I have seen a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines: now therefore get her for me to wife.
bsb_text: So he returned and told his father and mother, “I have seen a daughter of the Philistines in Timnah. Now get her for me as a wife.”
aov_text: en hy het opgegaan en dit aan sy vader en sy moeder vertel en gesê: Ek het ’n vrou uit die dogters van die Filistyne in Timna gesien; neem haar dan nou as vrou vir my.

kjv_text: Then his father and his mother said unto him, Is there never a woman among the daughters of thy brethren, or among all my people, that thou goest to take a wife of the uncircumcised Philistines? And Samson said unto his father, Get her for me; for she pleaseth me well.
bsb_text: But his father and mother replied, “Can’t you find a young woman among your relatives or among any of our people? Must you go to the uncircumcised Philistines to get a wife?” But Samson told his father, “Get her for me, for she is pleasing to my eyes.”
aov_text: Maar sy vader en sy moeder sê vir hom: Is daar onder die dogters van jou broers en onder my hele volk nie ’n vrou, dat jy heengaan om ’n vrou uit die Filistyne, die onbesnedenes, te neem nie? En Simson sê aan sy vader: Neem haar vir my, want sy geval my.

kjv_text: But his father and his mother knew not that it was of the LORD, that he sought an occasion against the Philistines: for at that time the Philistines had dominion over Israel.
bsb_text: (Now his father and mother did not know this was from the LORD, who was seeking an occasion to move against the Philistines; for at that time the Philistines were ruling over Israel.)
aov_text: Maar sy vader en sy moeder het nie geweet dat dit van die HERE kom nie; want Hy het rede gesoek teen die Filistyne; in dié tyd naamlik het die Filistyne oor Israel geheers.

kjv_text: Then went Samson down, and his father and his mother, to Timnath, and came to the vineyards of Timnath: and, behold, a young lion roared against him.
bsb_text: Then Samson went down to Timnah with his father and mother and came to the vineyards of Timnah. Suddenly a young lion came roaring at him,
aov_text: En Simson het met sy vader en sy moeder afgegaan na Timna; en toe hulle by die wingerde van Timna kom, storm daar ’n jong leeu brullende op hom af.

kjv_text: And the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him, and he rent him as he would have rent a kid, and he had nothing in his hand: but he told not his father or his mother what he had done.
bsb_text: and the Spirit of the LORD came powerfully upon him, and he tore the lion apart with his bare hands as one would tear a young goat. But he did not tell his father or mother what he had done.
aov_text: Maar die Gees van die HERE het oor hom vaardig geword; en hy het dit verskeur soos ’n mens ’n bokkie verskeur sonder dat daar iets in sy hand was; maar hy het sy vader en sy moeder nie vertel wat hy gedoen het nie.

kjv_text: And he went down, and talked with the woman; and she pleased Samson well.
bsb_text: Then Samson continued on his way down and spoke to the woman, because she was pleasing to his eyes.
aov_text: Toe gaan hy af en praat met die vrou; en sy het Simson geval.

kjv_text: And after a time he returned to take her, and he turned aside to see the carcase of the lion: and, behold, there was a swarm of bees and honey in the carcase of the lion.
bsb_text: When Samson returned later to take her, he left the road to see the lion’s carcass, and in it was a swarm of bees, along with their honey.
aov_text: En ’n tyd daarna het hy teruggegaan om haar te gaan haal; en toe hy uitdraai om na die dooie leeu te kyk, was daar ’n swerm bye in die dooie liggaam van die leeu, en heuning.

kjv_text: And he took thereof in his hands, and went on eating, and came to his father and mother, and he gave them, and they did eat: but he told not them that he had taken the honey out of the carcase of the lion.
bsb_text: So he scooped some honey into his hands and ate it as he went along. And when he returned to his father and mother, he gave some to them and they ate it. But he did not tell them that he had taken the honey from the lion’s carcass.
aov_text: En hy het dit uitgehaal in sy hande en aldeur geloop en eet, en na sy vader en sy moeder gegaan en aan hulle gegee; en hulle het geëet, maar dat hy die heuning uit die dooie liggaam van die leeu uitgehaal het, vertel hy hulle nie.

kjv_text: So his father went down unto the woman: and Samson made there a feast; for so used the young men to do.
bsb_text: Then his father went to visit the woman, and Samson prepared a feast there, as was customary for the bridegroom.
aov_text: Daarop gaan sy vader na die vrou toe af, en Simson het daar ’n maaltyd berei; want so het die jongmanne gewoonlik gedoen.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when they saw him, that they brought thirty companions to be with him.
bsb_text: And when the Philistines saw him, they selected thirty men to accompany him.
aov_text: En toe hulle hom sien, neem hulle dertig vriende om by hom te wees.

kjv_text: And Samson said unto them, I will now put forth a riddle unto you: if ye can certainly declare it me within the seven days of the feast, and find it out, then I will give you thirty sheets and thirty change of garments:
bsb_text: “Let me tell you a riddle,” Samson said to them. “If you can solve it for me within the seven days of the feast, I will give you thirty linen garments and thirty sets of clothes.
aov_text: En Simson sê aan hulle: Laat my tog vir julle ’n raaisel opgee; as julle dit vir my reg uitlê gedurende die sewe dae van die maaltyd en dit uitvind, dan sal ek julle dertig hemde en dertig stel klere gee;

kjv_text: But if ye cannot declare it me, then shall ye give me thirty sheets and thirty change of garments. And they said unto him, Put forth thy riddle, that we may hear it.
bsb_text: But if you cannot solve it, you must give me thirty linen garments and thirty sets of clothes.” “Tell us your riddle,” they replied. “Let us hear it.”
aov_text: maar as julle dit vir my nie kan uitlê nie, dan moet júlle my dertig hemde en dertig stel klere gee. Toe sê hulle vir hom: Gee maar jou raaisel op, dat ons dit hoor.

kjv_text: And he said unto them, Out of the eater came forth meat, and out of the strong came forth sweetness. And they could not in three days expound the riddle.
bsb_text: So he said to them: “Out of the eater came something to eat, and out of the strong came something sweet.” For three days they were unable to explain the riddle.
aov_text: En hy sê vir hulle: Spys het uit die eter uitgegaan, en soetigheid uit die sterke. En drie dae lank kon hulle die raaisel nie uitlê nie.

kjv_text: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that they said unto Samson's wife, Entice thy husband, that he may declare unto us the riddle, lest we burn thee and thy father's house with fire: have ye called us to take that we have? is it not so?
bsb_text: So on the fourth day they said to Samson’s wife, “Entice your husband to explain the riddle to us, or we will burn you and your father’s household to death. Did you invite us here to rob us?”
aov_text: En op die vierde dag sê hulle aan die vrou van Simson: Haal jou man oor dat hy die raaisel vir ons uitlê, anders verbrand ons jou en die huis van jou vader met vuur; het julle ons genooi om ons te berowe, of hoe?

kjv_text: And Samson's wife wept before him, and said, Thou dost but hate me, and lovest me not: thou hast put forth a riddle unto the children of my people, and hast not told it me. And he said unto her, Behold, I have not told it my father nor my mother, and shall I tell it thee?
bsb_text: Then Samson’s wife came to him, weeping, and said, “You hate me! You do not really love me! You have posed to my people a riddle, but have not explained it to me.” “Look,” he said, “I have not even explained it to my father or mother, so why should I explain it to you?”
aov_text: Toe huil die vrou van Simson by hom en sê: Jy haat my net en het my nie lief nie; jy het my volksgenote die raaisel opgegee, maar vir mý het jy dit nie uitgelê nie. En hy antwoord haar: Kyk, vir my vader en my moeder het ek dit nie uitgelê nie, sou ek dit dan vir jou uitlê?

kjv_text: And she wept before him the seven days, while their feast lasted: and it came to pass on the seventh day, that he told her, because she lay sore upon him: and she told the riddle to the children of her people.
bsb_text: She wept the whole seven days of the feast, and finally on the seventh day, because she had pressed him so much, he told her the answer. And in turn she explained the riddle to her people.
aov_text: Maar sy het die sewe dae wat hulle maaltyd geduur het, by hom gehuil; en op die sewende dag het hy dit vir haar uitgelê; want sy het hom gepers en so die raaisel vir haar volksgenote uitgelê.

kjv_text: And the men of the city said unto him on the seventh day before the sun went down, What is sweeter than honey? And what is stronger than a lion? And he said unto them, If ye had not plowed with my heifer, ye had not found out my riddle.
bsb_text: Before sunset on the seventh day, the men of the city said to Samson: “What is sweeter than honey? And what is stronger than a lion?” So he said to them: “If you had not plowed with my heifer, you would not have solved my riddle!”
aov_text: Daarop sê die manne van die stad aan hom op die sewende dag voor sonsondergang: Wat is soeter as heuning, en wat is sterker as ’n leeu? En hy antwoord hulle: As julle nie met my kalf geploeg het nie, sou julle my raaisel nie geraai het nie.

kjv_text: And the Spirit of the LORD came upon him, and he went down to Ashkelon, and slew thirty men of them, and took their spoil, and gave change of garments unto them which expounded the riddle. And his anger was kindled, and he went up to his father's house.
bsb_text: Then the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him, and he went down to Ashkelon, killed thirty of their men, took their apparel, and gave their clothes to those who had solved the riddle. And burning with anger, Samson returned to his father’s house,
aov_text: En die Gees van die HERE het oor hom vaardig geword. Toe gaan hy af na Áskelon en slaan dertig man van hulle dood, en neem hulle uitrustings en gee die stelle klere aan die wat die raaisel uitgelê het; en hy het kwaad geword en opgegaan na die huis van sy vader.

kjv_text: But Samson's wife was given to his companion, whom he had used as his friend.
bsb_text: and his wife was given to one of the men who had accompanied him.
aov_text: En sy vriend wat as sy bruidsjonker gedien het, het die vrou van Simson gekry.

kjv_text: But it came to pass within a while after, in the time of wheat harvest, that Samson visited his wife with a kid; and he said, I will go in to my wife into the chamber. But her father would not suffer him to go in.
bsb_text: Later on, at the time of the wheat harvest, Samson took a young goat and went to visit his wife. “I want to go to my wife in her room,” he said. But her father would not let him enter.
aov_text: MAAR ’n tyd daarna het Simson in die dae van die koringoes sy vrou besoek met ’n bokkie en gesê: Laat ek na my vrou in die kamer ingaan; maar haar vader het hom nie toegelaat om in te gaan nie.

kjv_text: And her father said, I verily thought that thou hadst utterly hated her; therefore I gave her to thy companion: is not her younger sister fairer than she? take her, I pray thee, instead of her.
bsb_text: “I was sure that you thoroughly hated her,” said her father, “so I gave her to one of the men who accompanied you. Is not her younger sister more beautiful than she? Please take her instead.”
aov_text: En haar vader het gesê: Ek het verseker gedink dat jy niks om haar gee nie; daarom het ek haar aan jou metgesel gegee; is haar jonger suster nie mooier as sy nie? Laat sy tog joue word in haar plek.

kjv_text: And Samson said concerning them, Now shall I be more blameless than the Philistines, though I do them a displeasure.
bsb_text: Samson said to them, “This time I will be blameless in doing harm to the Philistines.”
aov_text: Maar Simson het vir hulle gesê: Hierdie keer is ek onskuldig teenoor die Filistyne as ek hulle kwaad aandoen.

kjv_text: And Samson went and caught three hundred foxes, and took firebrands, and turned tail to tail, and put a firebrand in the midst between two tails.
bsb_text: Then Samson went out and caught three hundred foxes. And he took torches, turned the foxes tail-to-tail, and fastened a torch between each pair of tails.
aov_text: Toe gaan Simson weg en vang driehonderd jakkalse; en hy neem fakkels en draai stert teen stert, en sit ’n fakkel in die middel tussen elke twee sterte in;

kjv_text: And when he had set the brands on fire, he let them go into the standing corn of the Philistines, and burnt up both the shocks, and also the standing corn, with the vineyards and olives.
bsb_text: Then he lit the torches and released the foxes into the standing grain of the Philistines, burning up the piles of grain and the standing grain, as well as the vineyards and olive groves.
aov_text: en hy steek die fakkels aan die brand en los hulle in die ongesnyde graan van die Filistyne; en hy het die miede sowel as die ongesnyde graan en die wingerde en olyfbome aan die brand gesteek.

kjv_text: Then the Philistines said, Who hath done this? And they answered, Samson, the son in law of the Timnite, because he had taken his wife, and given her to his companion. And the Philistines came up, and burnt her and her father with fire.
bsb_text: “Who did this?” the Philistines demanded. “It was Samson, the son-in-law of the Timnite,” they were told. “For his wife was given to his companion.” So the Philistines went up and burned her and her father to death.
aov_text: Toe vra die Filistyne: Wie het dit gedoen? En hulle sê: Simson, die skoonseun van die Timniet, omdat dié sy vrou geneem en haar aan sy metgesel gegee het. En die Filistyne het opgetrek en haar en haar vader se huis met vuur verbrand.

kjv_text: And Samson said unto them, Though ye have done this, yet will I be avenged of you, and after that I will cease.
bsb_text: And Samson told them, “Because you have done this, I will not rest until I have taken vengeance upon you.”
aov_text: Daarop sê Simson vir hulle: As julle so maak, sal ek sekerlik nie rus voordat ek my op julle gewreek het nie.

kjv_text: And he smote them hip and thigh with a great slaughter: and he went down and dwelt in the top of the rock Etam.
bsb_text: And he struck them ruthlessly with a great slaughter, and then went down and stayed in the cave at the rock of Etam.
aov_text: En hy het hulle lendelam geslaan, ’n groot slag. En hy het afgegaan en gebly in die rotskloof van Etam.

kjv_text: Then the Philistines went up, and pitched in Judah, and spread themselves in Lehi.
bsb_text: Then the Philistines went up, camped in Judah, and deployed themselves near the town of Lehi.
aov_text: Toe trek die Filistyne nader en slaan laer op in Juda en sprei hulleself uit by Legi.

kjv_text: And the men of Judah said, Why are ye come up against us? And they answered, To bind Samson are we come up, to do to him as he hath done to us.
bsb_text: “Why have you attacked us?” said the men of Judah. The Philistines replied, “We have come to arrest Samson and pay him back for what he has done to us.”
aov_text: En die manne van Juda vra: Waarom het julle teen ons opgetrek? En hulle sê: Ons het opgetrek om Simson te bind, om aan hom te doen soos hy aan ons gedoen het.

kjv_text: Then three thousand men of Judah went to the top of the rock Etam, and said to Samson, Knowest thou not that the Philistines are rulers over us? what is this that thou hast done unto us? And he said unto them, As they did unto me, so have I done unto them.
bsb_text: In response, three thousand men of Judah went to the cave at the rock of Etam, and they asked Samson, “Do you not realize that the Philistines rule over us? What have you done to us?” “I have done to them what they did to me,” he replied.
aov_text: Daarop trek drieduisend man uit Juda af na die rotskloof van Etam en vra vir Simson: Weet jy nie dat die Filistyne oor ons heers nie, en wat het jy ons nou aangedoen? En hy sê aan hulle: Soos hulle aan my gedoen het, so het ek aan hulle gedoen.

kjv_text: And they said unto him, We are come down to bind thee, that we may deliver thee into the hand of the Philistines. And Samson said unto them, Swear unto me, that ye will not fall upon me yourselves.
bsb_text: But they said to him, “We have come down to arrest you and hand you over to the Philistines.” Samson replied, “Swear to me that you will not kill me yourselves.”
aov_text: Toe sê hulle vir hom: Ons het afgekom om jou te bind, om jou oor te gee in die hand van die Filistyne. En Simson sê aan hulle: Sweer vir my dat julle nie self op my sal aanval nie.

kjv_text: And they spake unto him, saying, No; but we will bind thee fast, and deliver thee into their hand: but surely we will not kill thee. And they bound him with two new cords, and brought him up from the rock.
bsb_text: “No,” they answered, “we will not kill you, but we will tie you up securely and hand you over to them.” So they bound him with two new ropes and led him up from the rock.
aov_text: En hulle antwoord hom: Nee, ons sal jou net vasbind en oorgee in hulle hand, maar doodmaak sal ons jou stellig nie. Daarop bind hulle hom vas met twee nuwe toue en bring hom op uit die rots.

kjv_text: And when he came unto Lehi, the Philistines shouted against him: and the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him, and the cords that were upon his arms became as flax that was burnt with fire, and his bands loosed from off his hands.
bsb_text: When Samson arrived in Lehi, the Philistines came out shouting against him. And the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him. The ropes on his arms became like burnt flax, and the bonds broke loose from his hands.
aov_text: Toe hy tot by Legi kom, juig die Filistyne hom tegemoet; maar die Gees van die HERE het oor hom vaardig geword, en die toue wat aan sy arms was, het geword soos linnedrade wat in die vuur brand, en sy bande het versmelt van sy hande af.

kjv_text: And he found a new jawbone of an ass, and put forth his hand, and took it, and slew a thousand men therewith.
bsb_text: He found the fresh jawbone of a donkey, reached out his hand and took it, and struck down a thousand men.
aov_text: En hy het ’n vars eselskakebeen gevind en sy hand uitgesteek en dit geneem en daar duisend man mee verslaan.

kjv_text: And Samson said, With the jawbone of an ass, heaps upon heaps, with the jaw of an ass have I slain a thousand men.
bsb_text: Then Samson said: “With the jawbone of a donkey I have piled them into heaps. With the jawbone of a donkey I have slain a thousand men.”
aov_text: En Simson het gesê: Met ’n eselskakebeen het ek een klomp, twee klompe, met ’n eselskakebeen het ek duisend man verslaan.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when he had made an end of speaking, that he cast away the jawbone out of his hand, and called that place Ramathlehi.
bsb_text: And when Samson had finished speaking, he cast the jawbone from his hand; and he named that place Ramath-lehi.
aov_text: En toe hy klaar gespreek het, gooi hy die kakebeen uit sy hand en noem dié plek Kakebeenshoogte.

kjv_text: And he was sore athirst, and called on the LORD, and said, Thou hast given this great deliverance into the hand of thy servant: and now shall I die for thirst, and fall into the hand of the uncircumcised?
bsb_text: And being very thirsty, Samson cried out to the LORD, “You have accomplished this great deliverance through Your servant. Must I now die of thirst and fall into the hands of the uncircumcised?”
aov_text: Daarop kry hy baie dors en roep die HERE aan en sê: U het deur die hand van u kneg hierdie groot verlossing gegee, en moet ek nou van dors sterwe en in die hand van die onbesnedenes val?

kjv_text: But God clave an hollow place that was in the jaw, and there came water thereout; and when he had drunk, his spirit came again, and he revived: wherefore he called the name thereof Enhakkore, which is in Lehi unto this day.
bsb_text: So God opened up the hollow place in Lehi, and water came out of it. When Samson drank, his strength returned, and he was revived. That is why he named it En-hakkore, and it remains in Lehi to this day.
aov_text: Toe kloof God die holte wat by Legi is, en daar kom water uit; en hy het gedrink, en sy gees het teruggekom, en hy het weer opgelewe. Daarom noem hulle dit Roepersfontein, wat vandag nog by Legi is.

kjv_text: And he judged Israel in the days of the Philistines twenty years.
bsb_text: And Samson judged Israel for twenty years in the days of the Philistines.
aov_text: En hy het Israel gerig in die dae van die Filistyne, twintig jaar lank.

kjv_text: Then went Samson to Gaza, and saw there an harlot, and went in unto her.
bsb_text: One day Samson went to Gaza, where he saw a prostitute and went in to spend the night with her.
aov_text: EN Simson het na Gasa gegaan en daar ’n hoer gesien en by haar ingegaan.
