aov_text: En let op: As dit in die rigting van sy eie gebied na Bet-Semes opgaan, dan het Hy ons hierdie groot onheil aangedoen; maar so nie, dan weet ons dat sy hand ons nie getref het nie: dit het toevallig oor ons gekom.

kjv_text: And the men did so; and took two milch kine, and tied them to the cart, and shut up their calves at home:
bsb_text: So the men did as instructed. They took two milk cows, hitched them to the cart, and penned up their calves.
aov_text: Die manne doen toe so: hulle het twee melkkoeie geneem en dié voor die wa gespan en hulle kalwers by die huis agtergehou.

kjv_text: And they laid the ark of the LORD upon the cart, and the coffer with the mice of gold and the images of their emerods.
bsb_text: Then they put the ark of the LORD on the cart, along with the chest containing the gold rats and the images of the tumors.
aov_text: En hulle het die ark van die HERE op die wa gesit en die kissie met die goue muise en die beelde van hulle geswelle.

kjv_text: And the kine took the straight way to the way of Bethshemesh, and went along the highway, lowing as they went, and turned not aside to the right hand or to the left; and the lords of the Philistines went after them unto the border of Bethshemesh.
bsb_text: And the cows headed straight up the road toward Beth-shemesh, staying on that one highway and lowing as they went, never straying to the right or to the left. The rulers of the Philistines followed behind them to the border of Beth-shemesh.
aov_text: En die koeie het reguit padlangs geloop in die rigting van Bet-Semes; hulle het op die een grootpad aldeur geloop en bulk sonder om regs of links uit te draai, terwyl die vorste van die Filistyne agter hulle aan gaan tot by die grens van Bet-Semes.

kjv_text: And they of Bethshemesh were reaping their wheat harvest in the valley: and they lifted up their eyes, and saw the ark, and rejoiced to see it.
bsb_text: Now the people of Beth-shemesh were harvesting wheat in the valley, and when they looked up and saw the ark, they were overjoyed at the sight.
aov_text: En die mense van Bet-Semes was juis besig om die koringoes af te sny in die laagte. Toe hulle dan hul oë opslaan en die ark gewaar, was hulle bly om dit te sien.

kjv_text: And the cart came into the field of Joshua, a Bethshemite, and stood there, where there was a great stone: and they clave the wood of the cart, and offered the kine a burnt offering unto the LORD.
bsb_text: The cart came to the field of Joshua of Beth-shemesh and stopped there near a large rock. The people chopped up the cart and offered the cows as a burnt offering to the LORD.
aov_text: En die wa het by die land van Josua van Bet-Semes gekom en daar gaan staan; daar was ’n groot klip, en hulle het die hout van die wa gekloof en die koeie as ’n brandoffer aan die HERE geoffer.

kjv_text: And the Levites took down the ark of the LORD, and the coffer that was with it, wherein the jewels of gold were, and put them on the great stone: and the men of Bethshemesh offered burnt offerings and sacrificed sacrifices the same day unto the LORD.
bsb_text: And the Levites took down the ark of the LORD and the chest containing the gold objects, and they placed them on the large rock. That day the men of Beth-shemesh offered burnt offerings and made sacrifices to the LORD.
aov_text: En die Leviete het die ark van die HERE afgehaal met die kissie wat daarby was, waar die goue voorwerpe in was, en op die groot klip neergesit; en die manne van Bet-Semes het dieselfde dag aan die HERE brandoffers geoffer en slagoffers geslag.

kjv_text: And when the five lords of the Philistines had seen it, they returned to Ekron the same day.
bsb_text: And when the five rulers of the Philistines saw this, they returned to Ekron that same day.
aov_text: En toe die vyf vorste van die Filistyne dit sien, het hulle dieselfde dag teruggegaan na Ekron.

kjv_text: And these are the golden emerods which the Philistines returned for a trespass offering unto the LORD; for Ashdod one, for Gaza one, for Askelon one, for Gath one, for Ekron one;
bsb_text: As a guilt offering to the LORD, the Philistines had sent back one gold tumor for each city: Ashdod, Gaza, Ashkelon, Gath, and Ekron.
aov_text: En dit is die goue geswelle wat die Filistyne as ’n skuldoffer aan die HERE teruggegee het: vir Asdod een, vir Gasa een, vir Áskelon een, vir Gat een, vir Ekron een.

kjv_text: And the golden mice, according to the number of all the cities of the Philistines belonging to the five lords, both of fenced cities, and of country villages, even unto the great stone of Abel, whereon they set down the ark of the LORD: which stone remaineth unto this day in the field of Joshua, the Bethshemite.
bsb_text: The number of gold rats also corresponded to the number of Philistine cities belonging to the five rulers—the fortified cities and their outlying villages. And the large rock on which they placed the ark of the LORD stands to this day in the field of Joshua of Beth-shemesh.
aov_text: En die goue muise was volgens die getal van al die stede van die Filistyne wat aan die vyf vorste behoort het, van die versterkte stede sowel as van die onbemuurde dorpe. En die groot klip waar hulle die ark van die HERE op neergesit het, is tot vandag toe getuie op die stuk land van Josua, van Bet-Semes.

kjv_text: And he smote the men of Bethshemesh, because they had looked into the ark of the LORD, even he smote of the people fifty thousand and threescore and ten men: and the people lamented, because the LORD had smitten many of the people with a great slaughter.
bsb_text: But God struck down some of the people of Beth-shemesh because they looked inside the ark of the LORD. He struck down seventy men, and the people mourned because the LORD had struck them with a great slaughter.
aov_text: En Hy het onder die mense van Bet-Semes ’n slagting aangerig; Hy het naamlik onder die volk sewentig man en vyftigduisend man gedood, omdat hulle die ark van die HERE bekyk het; en die volk het getreur, omdat die HERE ’n groot slagting onder die volk aangerig het.

kjv_text: And the men of Bethshemesh said, Who is able to stand before this holy LORD God? and to whom shall he go up from us?
bsb_text: The men of Beth-shemesh asked, “Who can stand in the presence of the LORD, this holy God? To whom should the ark go up from here?”
aov_text: Toe sê die manne van Bet-Semes: Wie kan diens doen voor die aangesig van die HERE, hierdie heilige God? En na wie toe sal Hy optrek van ons af?

kjv_text: And they sent messengers to the inhabitants of Kirjathjearim, saying, The Philistines have brought again the ark of the LORD; come ye down, and fetch it up to you.
bsb_text: So they sent messengers to the people of Kiriath-jearim, saying, “The Philistines have returned the ark of the LORD. Come down and take it up with you.”
aov_text: Daarom het hulle boodskappers gestuur na die inwoners van Kirjat-Jeárim om te sê: Die Filistyne het die ark van die HERE teruggebring; kom af, bring dit op na julle toe.

kjv_text: And the men of Kirjathjearim came, and fetched up the ark of the LORD, and brought it into the house of Abinadab in the hill, and sanctified Eleazar his son to keep the ark of the LORD.
bsb_text: Then the men of Kiriath-jearim came for the ark of the LORD and took it into Abinadab’s house on the hill. And they consecrated his son Eleazar to guard the ark of the LORD.
aov_text: TOE het die manne van Kirjat-Jeárim gekom en die ark van die HERE gaan haal en dit in die huis van Abinádab op die heuwel gebring; en hulle het sy seun Eleásar geheilig om die ark van die HERE te bewaak.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, while the ark abode in Kirjathjearim, that the time was long; for it was twenty years: and all the house of Israel lamented after the LORD.
bsb_text: And from that day a long time passed, twenty years in all, as the ark remained at Kiriath-jearim. And all the house of Israel mourned and sought after the LORD.
aov_text: EN van die dag af dat die ark in Kirjat-Jeárim gebly het, het daar geruime tyd verloop—dit was twintig jaar—en die hele huis van Israel het agter die HERE aan geweeklaag.

kjv_text: And Samuel spake unto all the house of Israel, saying, If ye do return unto the LORD with all your hearts, then put away the strange gods and Ashtaroth from among you, and prepare your hearts unto the LORD, and serve him only: and he will deliver you out of the hand of the Philistines.
bsb_text: Then Samuel said to all the house of Israel, “If you are returning to the LORD with all your hearts, then rid yourselves of the foreign gods and Ashtoreths among you, prepare your hearts for the LORD, and serve Him only. And He will deliver you from the hand of the Philistines.”
aov_text: Maar Samuel het met die hele huis van Israel gespreek en gesê: As julle met jul hele hart julle tot die HERE bekeer, verwyder dan die vreemde gode en die Astartes onder julle uit, en rig julle hart op die HERE en dien Hom alleen; dan sal Hy julle red uit die hand van die Filistyne.

kjv_text: Then the children of Israel did put away Baalim and Ashtaroth, and served the LORD only.
bsb_text: So the Israelites put away the Baals and Ashtoreths and served only the LORD.
aov_text: Daarop het die kinders van Israel die Baäls en die Astartes verwyder en die HERE alleen gedien.

kjv_text: And Samuel said, Gather all Israel to Mizpeh, and I will pray for you unto the LORD.
bsb_text: Then Samuel said, “Gather all Israel to Mizpah, and I will pray to the LORD on your behalf.”
aov_text: Verder het Samuel gesê: Versamel die hele Israel by Mispa, dan sal ek tot die HERE vir julle bid.

kjv_text: And they gathered together to Mizpeh, and drew water, and poured it out before the LORD, and fasted on that day, and said there, We have sinned against the LORD. And Samuel judged the children of Israel in Mizpeh.
bsb_text: When they had gathered at Mizpah, they drew water and poured it out before the LORD. On that day they fasted, and there they confessed, “We have sinned against the LORD.” And Samuel judged the Israelites at Mizpah.
aov_text: Hulle kom toe bymekaar by Mispa, en hulle het water geskep en dit voor die aangesig van die HERE uitgegiet, en dié dag het hulle gevas en daar gesê: Ons het gesondig teen die HERE. En Samuel het die kinders van Israel in Mispa gerig.

kjv_text: And when the Philistines heard that the children of Israel were gathered together to Mizpeh, the lords of the Philistines went up against Israel. And when the children of Israel heard it, they were afraid of the Philistines.
bsb_text: When the Philistines heard that the Israelites had gathered at Mizpah, their rulers marched up toward Israel. And when the Israelites learned of this, they feared the Philistines
aov_text: Toe die Filistyne hoor dat die kinders van Israel by Mispa saamgekom het, het die vorste van die Filistyne teen Israel opgetrek. En die kinders van Israel het dit gehoor en bevrees geword vir die Filistyne.

kjv_text: And the children of Israel said to Samuel, Cease not to cry unto the LORD our God for us, that he will save us out of the hand of the Philistines.
bsb_text: and said to Samuel, “Do not stop crying out to the LORD our God for us, that He may save us from the hand of the Philistines.”
aov_text: En die kinders van Israel sê aan Samuel: Laat nie ná om die HERE onse God vir ons aan te roep nie, dat Hy ons uit die hand van die Filistyne verlos.

kjv_text: And Samuel took a sucking lamb, and offered it for a burnt offering wholly unto the LORD: and Samuel cried unto the LORD for Israel; and the LORD heard him.
bsb_text: Then Samuel took a suckling lamb and offered it as a whole burnt offering to the LORD. He cried out to the LORD on behalf of Israel, and the LORD answered him.
aov_text: Toe het Samuel ’n suiglam geneem en dit as ’n brandoffer in sy geheel aan die HERE geoffer, en Samuel het die HERE aangeroep vir Israel; en die HERE het hom verhoor.

kjv_text: And as Samuel was offering up the burnt offering, the Philistines drew near to battle against Israel: but the LORD thundered with a great thunder on that day upon the Philistines, and discomfited them; and they were smitten before Israel.
bsb_text: As the Philistines drew near to fight against Israel, Samuel was sacrificing the burnt offering. But that day the LORD thundered loudly against the Philistines and threw them into such confusion that they fled before Israel.
aov_text: Want onderwyl Samuel die brandoffer bring en die Filistyne nader kom om teen Israel te veg, het die HERE dit dié dag met ’n groot geluid laat donder oor die Filistyne, en Hy het hulle in verwarring gebring, sodat hulle verslaan is voor Israel.

kjv_text: And the men of Israel went out of Mizpeh, and pursued the Philistines, and smote them, until they came under Bethcar.
bsb_text: Then the men of Israel charged out of Mizpah and pursued the Philistines, striking them down all the way to an area below Beth-car.
aov_text: En die manskappe van Israel het uit Mispa uitgetrek en die Filistyne agtervolg en hulle verslaan tot onderkant Bet-Kar.

kjv_text: Then Samuel took a stone, and set it between Mizpeh and Shen, and called the name of it Ebenezer, saying, Hitherto hath the LORD helped us.
bsb_text: Afterward, Samuel took a stone and set it up between Mizpah and Shen. He named it Ebenezer, saying, “Thus far the LORD has helped us.”
aov_text: Toe het Samuel ’n klip geneem en dit opgerig tussen Mispa en Sen, en dit Ebenhaéser genoem en gesê: Tot hiertoe het die HERE ons gehelp.

kjv_text: So the Philistines were subdued, and they came no more into the coast of Israel: and the hand of the LORD was against the Philistines all the days of Samuel.
bsb_text: So the Philistines were subdued, and they stopped invading the territory of Israel. And the hand of the LORD was against the Philistines all the days of Samuel.
aov_text: En die Filistyne is verneder, sodat hulle verder nie meer die gebied van Israel binnegekom het nie, en die hand van die HERE was teen die Filistyne al die dae van Samuel.

kjv_text: And the cities which the Philistines had taken from Israel were restored to Israel, from Ekron even unto Gath; and the coasts thereof did Israel deliver out of the hands of the Philistines. And there was peace between Israel and the Amorites.
bsb_text: The cities from Ekron to Gath, which the Philistines had taken, were restored to Israel, who also delivered the surrounding territory from the hand of the Philistines. And there was peace between the Israelites and the Amorites.
aov_text: Ook die stede wat die Filistyne van Israel geneem het, het na Israel teruggekom, van Ekron af tot by Gat; en die gebied daarvan het Israel uit die hand van die Filistyne geruk. En daar was vrede tussen Israel en die Amoriete.

kjv_text: And Samuel judged Israel all the days of his life.
bsb_text: So Samuel judged Israel all the days of his life.
aov_text: En Samuel was rigter oor Israel al die dae van sy lewe.

kjv_text: And he went from year to year in circuit to Bethel, and Gilgal, and Mizpeh, and judged Israel in all those places.
bsb_text: Every year he would go on a circuit from Bethel to Gilgal to Mizpah, judging Israel in all these places.
aov_text: Hy het van jaar tot jaar rondgetrek na Bet-el en Gilgal en Mispa, en Israel op al hierdie plekke gerig.

kjv_text: And his return was to Ramah; for there was his house; and there he judged Israel; and there he built an altar unto the LORD.
bsb_text: Then he would return to Ramah because his home was there, and there he judged Israel and built an altar to the LORD.
aov_text: Dan gaan hy na Rama terug, want daar was sy huis; en daar het hy Israel gerig en daar vir die HERE ’n altaar gebou.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when Samuel was old, that he made his sons judges over Israel.
bsb_text: When Samuel grew old, he appointed his sons as judges over Israel.
aov_text: EN toe Samuel oud was, het hy sy seuns as rigters oor Israel aangestel.

kjv_text: Now the name of his firstborn was Joel; and the name of his second, Abiah: they were judges in Beersheba.
bsb_text: The name of his firstborn son was Joel, and the name of his second was Abijah. They were judges in Beersheba.
aov_text: Die naam van sy eersgeborene was Joël, en die naam van sy tweede Abía, rigters in Berséba.

kjv_text: And his sons walked not in his ways, but turned aside after lucre, and took bribes, and perverted judgment.
bsb_text: But his sons did not walk in his ways; they turned aside toward dishonest gain, accepting bribes and perverting justice.
aov_text: Maar sy seuns het nie in sy weë gewandel nie: hulle het onregverdige wins agternageloop en omkoopgeskenke aangeneem en die reg verdraai.

kjv_text: Then all the elders of Israel gathered themselves together, and came to Samuel unto Ramah,
bsb_text: So all the elders of Israel gathered together and came to Samuel at Ramah.
aov_text: Toe kom al die oudstes van Israel bymekaar, en hulle gaan na Samuel in Rama

kjv_text: And said unto him, Behold, thou art old, and thy sons walk not in thy ways: now make us a king to judge us like all the nations.
bsb_text: “Look,” they said, “you are old, and your sons do not walk in your ways. Now appoint a king to judge us like all the other nations.”
aov_text: en sê vir hom: Kyk, u is oud, en u seuns wandel nie in u weë nie; stel nou ’n koning oor ons aan om ons te rig soos by al die nasies.

kjv_text: But the thing displeased Samuel, when they said, Give us a king to judge us. And Samuel prayed unto the LORD.
bsb_text: But when they said, “Give us a king to judge us,” their demand was displeasing in the sight of Samuel; so he prayed to the LORD.
aov_text: Maar die woord was verkeerd in die oë van Samuel toe hulle gesê het: Gee ons ’n koning om ons te rig, en Samuel het tot die HERE gebid.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Samuel, Hearken unto the voice of the people in all that they say unto thee: for they have not rejected thee, but they have rejected me, that I should not reign over them.
bsb_text: And the LORD said to Samuel, “Listen to the voice of the people in all that they say to you. For it is not you they have rejected, but they have rejected Me as their king.
aov_text: Toe sê die HERE vir Samuel: Luister na die volk in alles wat hulle aan jou sê, want nie jou het hulle verwerp nie, maar My het hulle verwerp om nie koning oor hulle te wees nie.

kjv_text: According to all the works which they have done since the day that I brought them up out of Egypt even unto this day, wherewith they have forsaken me, and served other gods, so do they also unto thee.
bsb_text: Just as they have done from the day I brought them up out of Egypt until this day, forsaking Me and serving other gods, so they are doing to you.
aov_text: Soos al die werke wat hulle gedoen het, van dié dag af dat Ek hulle uit Egipte laat optrek het tot vandag toe, dat hulle My verlaat en ander gode gedien het—so doen hulle ook met jou.

kjv_text: Now therefore hearken unto their voice: howbeit yet protest solemnly unto them, and shew them the manner of the king that shall reign over them.
bsb_text: Now listen to them, but you must solemnly warn them and show them the manner of the king who will reign over them.”
aov_text: Luister dan nou na hulle: jy moet hulle net ernstig waarsku en hulle die reg van die koning meedeel wat oor hulle sal regeer.

kjv_text: And Samuel told all the words of the LORD unto the people that asked of him a king.
bsb_text: So Samuel spoke all the words of the LORD to the people who were asking him for a king.
aov_text: Samuel het toe al die woorde van die HERE oorgebring aan die volk wat ’n koning van hom gevra het.

kjv_text: And he said, This will be the manner of the king that shall reign over you: He will take your sons, and appoint them for himself, for his chariots, and to be his horsemen; and some shall run before his chariots.
bsb_text: He said, “This will be the manner of the king who will reign over you: He will take your sons and appoint them to his own chariots and horses, to run in front of his chariots.
aov_text: En hy het gesê: Dit sal die reg wees van die koning wat oor julle sal regeer: Julle seuns sal hy neem en hulle vir homself aanstel by sy wa en by sy perde, dat hulle voor sy wa uit hardloop;

kjv_text: And he will appoint him captains over thousands, and captains over fifties; and will set them to ear his ground, and to reap his harvest, and to make his instruments of war, and instruments of his chariots.
bsb_text: He will appoint some for himself as commanders of thousands and of fifties, and others to plow his ground, to reap his harvest, to make his weapons of war, and to equip his chariots.
aov_text: en om hulle vir homself aan te stel as owerstes oor duisend en owerstes oor vyftig, en om sy land te ploeg en om sy oes in te samel, en om sy oorlogswapens en gereedskap vir sy strydwaens te maak.

kjv_text: And he will take your daughters to be confectionaries, and to be cooks, and to be bakers.
bsb_text: And he will take your daughters to be perfumers, cooks, and bakers.
aov_text: Ook julle dogters sal hy neem as salfmengsters en as kooksters en baksters.

kjv_text: And he will take your fields, and your vineyards, and your oliveyards, even the best of them, and give them to his servants.
bsb_text: He will take the best of your fields and vineyards and olive groves and give them to his servants.
aov_text: En van julle lande en julle wingerde en julle olyfboorde sal hy die beste neem en aan sy dienaars gee.

kjv_text: And he will take the tenth of your seed, and of your vineyards, and give to his officers, and to his servants.
bsb_text: He will take a tenth of your grain and grape harvest and give it to his officials and servants.
aov_text: En van julle saailande en julle wingerde sal hy die tiendes neem en dit aan sy hofdienaars en sy dienaars gee.

kjv_text: And he will take your menservants, and your maidservants, and your goodliest young men, and your asses, and put them to his work.
bsb_text: And he will take your menservants and maidservants and your best cattle and donkeys and put them to his own use.
aov_text: En julle slawe en slavinne en julle beste jongmanne en julle esels sal hy neem en vir sy werk gebruik.

kjv_text: He will take the tenth of your sheep: and ye shall be his servants.
bsb_text: He will take a tenth of your flocks, and you yourselves will become his slaves.
aov_text: Van julle kleinvee sal hy die tiendes neem, en self sal julle sy slawe wees.

kjv_text: And ye shall cry out in that day because of your king which ye shall have chosen you; and the LORD will not hear you in that day.
bsb_text: When that day comes, you will beg for relief from the king you have chosen, but the LORD will not answer you on that day.”
aov_text: En in dié dag sal julle roep vanweë jul koning wat julle vir jul verkies het, en die HERE sal julle in dié dag nie verhoor nie.

kjv_text: Nevertheless the people refused to obey the voice of Samuel; and they said, Nay; but we will have a king over us;
bsb_text: Nevertheless, the people refused to listen to Samuel. “No!” they said. “We must have a king over us.
aov_text: Maar die volk het geweier om na Samuel te luister en gesê: Nee, maar daar moet ’n koning oor ons wees,

kjv_text: That we also may be like all the nations; and that our king may judge us, and go out before us, and fight our battles.
bsb_text: Then we will be like all the other nations, with a king to judge us, to go out before us, and to fight our battles.”
aov_text: dat ons ook kan wees soos al die nasies—dat ons koning ons kan rig en voor ons uit trek en ons oorloë voer.

kjv_text: And Samuel heard all the words of the people, and he rehearsed them in the ears of the LORD.
bsb_text: Samuel listened to all the words of the people and repeated them in the hearing of the LORD.
aov_text: En Samuel het al die woorde van die volk aangehoor en dit voor die ore van die HERE uitgespreek.

kjv_text: And the LORD said to Samuel, Hearken unto their voice, and make them a king. And Samuel said unto the men of Israel, Go ye every man unto his city.
bsb_text: “Listen to their voice,” the LORD said to Samuel. “Appoint a king for them.” Then Samuel told the men of Israel, “Everyone must go back to his city.”
aov_text: Toe sê die HERE vir Samuel: Luister na hulle en stel ’n koning oor hulle aan. En Samuel het vir die manne van Israel gesê: Gaan heen, elkeen na sy stad.

kjv_text: Now there was a man of Benjamin, whose name was Kish, the son of Abiel, the son of Zeror, the son of Bechorath, the son of Aphiah, a Benjamite, a mighty man of power.
bsb_text: Now there was a Benjamite, a powerful man, whose name was Kish son of Abiel, the son of Zeror, the son of Becorath, the son of Aphiah of Benjamin.
aov_text: EN daar was ’n man van Benjamin met die naam van Kis, die seun van Abíël, die seun van Seror, die seun van Begorat, die seun van Afíag, ’n Benjaminiet, ’n vermoënde man.

kjv_text: And he had a son, whose name was Saul, a choice young man, and a goodly: and there was not among the children of Israel a goodlier person than he: from his shoulders and upward he was higher than any of the people.
bsb_text: And he had a son named Saul, choice and handsome, without equal among the Israelites—a head taller than any of the people.
aov_text: En hy het ’n seun gehad met die naam van Saul, ’n jongman en mooi gebou, ja, daar was onder die kinders van Israel geeneen mooier as hy nie: van sy skouers af boontoe was hy hoër as die hele volk.

kjv_text: And the asses of Kish Saul's father were lost. And Kish said to Saul his son, Take now one of the servants with thee, and arise, go seek the asses.
bsb_text: One day the donkeys of Saul’s father Kish wandered off, and Kish said to his son Saul, “Take one of the servants and go look for the donkeys.”
aov_text: En toe die eselinne van Kis, die vader van Saul, weggeraak het, sê Kis aan sy seun Saul: Neem tog een van die dienaars met jou saam en maak jou klaar, gaan soek die esels.

kjv_text: And he passed through mount Ephraim, and passed through the land of Shalisha, but they found them not: then they passed through the land of Shalim, and there they were not: and he passed through the land of the Benjamites, but they found them not.
bsb_text: So Saul passed through the hill country of Ephraim and then through the land of Shalishah, but did not find the donkeys. He and the servant went through the region of Shaalim, but they were not there. Then they went through the land of Benjamin, and still they did not find them.
aov_text: Hy het toe die gebergte van Efraim deurgegaan en die land Salísa deurgegaan, maar hulle nie gekry nie; en hulle het die land Sáälim deurgegaan, maar daar was niks nie; en hy het die land Benjamin deurgegaan, maar hulle het niks gekry nie.

kjv_text: And when they were come to the land of Zuph, Saul said to his servant that was with him, Come, and let us return; lest my father leave caring for the asses, and take thought for us.
bsb_text: When they reached the land of Zuph, Saul said to his servant, “Come, let us go back, or my father will stop worrying about the donkeys and start worrying about us.”
aov_text: Toe hulle in die land Suf kom, sê Saul aan die dienaar wat by hom was: Kom, laat ons teruggaan; anders sien my vader van die esels af en word oor ons besorg.

kjv_text: And he said unto him, Behold now, there is in this city a man of God, and he is an honourable man; all that he saith cometh surely to pass: now let us go thither; peradventure he can shew us our way that we should go.
bsb_text: “Look,” said the servant, “in this city there is a man of God who is highly respected; everything he says surely comes to pass. Let us go there now. Perhaps he will tell us which way to go.”
aov_text: En hy antwoord hom: Maar kyk, in hierdie stad is ’n man van God, en die man is geëerd: alles wat hy spreek, kom sekerlik uit; laat ons nou daarheen gaan; miskien kan hy ons inlig oor die tog wat ons onderneem het.

kjv_text: Then said Saul to his servant, But, behold, if we go, what shall we bring the man? for the bread is spent in our vessels, and there is not a present to bring to the man of God: what have we?
bsb_text: “If we do go,” Saul replied, “what can we give the man? For the bread in our packs is gone, and there is no gift to take to the man of God. What do we have?”
aov_text: Toe vra Saul vir sy dienaar: Sê nou ons gaan—wat sal ons die man aanbied? Want die brood in ons sakke is op, en ’n geskenk is hier nie om die man van God aan te bied nie; wat het ons?

kjv_text: And the servant answered Saul again, and said, Behold, I have here at hand the fourth part of a shekel of silver: that will I give to the man of God, to tell us our way.
bsb_text: The servant answered him again. “Look,” he said, “I have here in my hand a quarter shekel of silver. I will give it to the man of God, and he will tell us our way.”
aov_text: En die dienaar het Saul weer geantwoord en gesê: Kyk, ek het nog ’n kwart sikkel silwer by my; dit sal ek aan die man van God gee, dat hy ons kan inlig oor ons tog.

kjv_text: (Beforetime in Israel, when a man went to enquire of God, thus he spake, Come, and let us go to the seer: for he that is now called a Prophet was beforetime called a Seer.)
bsb_text: (Formerly in Israel, a man on his way to inquire of God would say, “Come, let us go to the seer.” For the prophet of today was formerly called the seer.)
aov_text: Vroeër het die mense in Israel só gesê as hulle gaan om God te raadpleeg: Kom, laat ons na die siener gaan. Want die profeet van teenswoordig het hulle vroeër siener genoem.

kjv_text: Then said Saul to his servant, Well said; come, let us go. So they went unto the city where the man of God was.
bsb_text: “Good,” said Saul to his servant. “Come, let us go.” So they set out for the city where the man of God was.
aov_text: En Saul sê aan sy dienaar: Jou woord is goed; kom, laat ons gaan. Daarop gaan hulle na die stad waar die man van God was.

kjv_text: And as they went up the hill to the city, they found young maidens going out to draw water, and said unto them, Is the seer here?
bsb_text: And as they were climbing the hill to the city, they met some young women coming out to draw water and asked, “Is the seer here?”
aov_text: Terwyl hulle die opdraand na die stad opgaan, kom hulle meisies teë wat uitgaan om water te put, en vra vir hulle: Is die siener hier?

kjv_text: And they answered them, and said, He is; behold, he is before you: make haste now, for he came to day to the city; for there is a sacrifice of the people to day in the high place:
bsb_text: “Yes, he is ahead of you,” they answered. “Hurry now, for today he has come to the city because the people have a sacrifice on the high place.
aov_text: En dié antwoord hulle en sê: Daar is hy voor jou; maak nou gou, want vandag het hy in die stad gekom, omdat die volk vandag ’n offer op die hoogte het.

kjv_text: As soon as ye be come into the city, ye shall straightway find him, before he go up to the high place to eat: for the people will not eat until he come, because he doth bless the sacrifice; and afterwards they eat that be bidden. Now therefore get you up; for about this time ye shall find him.
bsb_text: As soon as you enter the city, you will find him before he goes up to the high place to eat. The people will not eat until he comes, because he must bless the sacrifice; after that, the guests will eat. Go up at once; you will find him.”
aov_text: As julle die stad ingaan, sal julle hom net aantref voordat hy opgaan na die hoogte om te eet; want die volk eet nie voordat hy kom nie, want hy seën die offer; daarna eet die genooides; gaan dan nou op, want julle sal hom nou juis aantref.

kjv_text: And they went up into the city: and when they were come into the city, behold, Samuel came out against them, for to go up to the high place.
bsb_text: So Saul and his servant went up toward the city, and as they were entering it, there was Samuel coming toward them on his way up to the high place.
aov_text: En hulle het opgegaan na die stad. Toe hulle op die punt was om binne-in die stad te gaan, kom Samuel meteens uit hulle tegemoet om op te gaan na die hoogte.

kjv_text: Now the LORD had told Samuel in his ear a day before Saul came, saying,
bsb_text: Now on the day before Saul’s arrival, the LORD had revealed to Samuel,
aov_text: Want die HERE het dit een dag voor die koms van Saul aan Samuel geopenbaar en gesê:

kjv_text: To morrow about this time I will send thee a man out of the land of Benjamin, and thou shalt anoint him to be captain over my people Israel, that he may save my people out of the hand of the Philistines: for I have looked upon my people, because their cry is come unto me.
bsb_text: “At this time tomorrow I will send you a man from the land of Benjamin, and you are to anoint him leader over My people Israel; he will save them from the hand of the Philistines. For I have looked upon My people, because their cry has come to Me.”
aov_text: Môre sulke tyd sal Ek ’n man uit die land Benjamin na jou stuur wat jy moet salf as ’n vors oor my volk Israel; en hy sal my volk verlos uit die hand van die Filistyne. Want Ek het my volk aangesien, omdat sy geroep na My gekom het.

kjv_text: And when Samuel saw Saul, the LORD said unto him, Behold the man whom I spake to thee of! this same shall reign over my people.
bsb_text: When Samuel saw Saul, the LORD told him, “Here is the man of whom I spoke; he shall rule over My people.”
aov_text: Toe Samuel vir Saul sien, het die HERE hom geantwoord: Hier is die man van wie Ek jou gesê het: Hy sal oor my volk heers.

kjv_text: Then Saul drew near to Samuel in the gate, and said, Tell me, I pray thee, where the seer's house is.
bsb_text: Saul approached Samuel in the gateway and asked, “Would you please tell me where the seer’s house is?”
aov_text: En Saul het nader gekom na Samuel binne-in die poort en gevra: Wys my tog waar die huis van die siener is?

kjv_text: And Samuel answered Saul, and said, I am the seer: go up before me unto the high place; for ye shall eat with me to day, and to morrow I will let thee go, and will tell thee all that is in thine heart.
bsb_text: “I am the seer,” Samuel replied. “Go up before me to the high place, for you shall eat with me today. And when I send you off in the morning, I will tell you all that is in your heart.
aov_text: Daarop het Samuel Saul geantwoord en gesê: Ek is die siener! Gaan voor my uit op na die hoogte, dan kan julle vandag saam met my eet; en ek sal jou môre vroeg laat gaan; en alles wat in jou hart is, sal ek jou te kenne gee.

kjv_text: And as for thine asses that were lost three days ago, set not thy mind on them; for they are found. And on whom is all the desire of Israel? Is it not on thee, and on all thy father's house?
bsb_text: As for the donkeys you lost three days ago, do not worry about them, for they have been found. And upon whom is all the desire of Israel, if not upon you and all your father’s house?”
aov_text: En wat die esels betref wat jy vandag al drie dae gelede vermis het—bekommer jou daar nie oor nie, want hulle is gevind. Maar aan wie behoort al wat begeerlik is in Israel? Is dit nie aan jou en jou hele familie nie?

kjv_text: And Saul answered and said, Am not I a Benjamite, of the smallest of the tribes of Israel? and my family the least of all the families of the tribe of Benjamin? wherefore then speakest thou so to me?
bsb_text: Saul replied, “Am I not a Benjamite from the smallest tribe of Israel, and is not my clan the least of all the clans of Benjamin? So why would you say such a thing to me?”
aov_text: En Saul antwoord en sê: Is ek nie ’n Benjaminiet, uit een van die kleinste van die stamme van Israel, en my geslag die geringste uit al die geslagte van die stam van Benjamin nie? Waarom spreek u dan so met my?

kjv_text: And Samuel took Saul and his servant, and brought them into the parlour, and made them sit in the chiefest place among them that were bidden, which were about thirty persons.
bsb_text: Then Samuel took Saul and his servant, brought them into the hall, and seated them in the place of honor among those who were invited—about thirty in all.
aov_text: Verder het Samuel Saul en sy dienaar geneem en hulle in die kamer gebring en hulle ’n plek gegee aan die hoof van die genooides, wat omtrent dertig man was.

kjv_text: And Samuel said unto the cook, Bring the portion which I gave thee, of which I said unto thee, Set it by thee.
bsb_text: And Samuel said to the cook, “Bring the portion I gave you and told you to set aside.”
aov_text: En Samuel het aan die kok gesê: Gee die stuk wat ek aan jou gegee het, waarvan ek vir jou gesê het: Sit dit by jou weg.

kjv_text: And the cook took up the shoulder, and that which was upon it, and set it before Saul. And Samuel said, Behold that which is left! set it before thee, and eat: for unto this time hath it been kept for thee since I said, I have invited the people. So Saul did eat with Samuel that day.
bsb_text: So the cook picked up the leg and what was attached to it and set it before Saul. Then Samuel said, “Here is what was kept back. It was set apart for you. Eat, for it has been kept for you for this occasion, from the time I said, ‘I have invited the people.’” So Saul dined with Samuel that day.
aov_text: Die kok dra toe die boud op met wat daaraan was, en sit dit voor Saul neer. En Samuel sê: Kyk, wat oorgebly het, is voor jou gesit; eet, want teen die bestemde tyd is dit vir jou bewaar toe ek gesê het: Ek nooi die volk. So het Saul dan dié dag saam met Samuel geëet.

kjv_text: And when they were come down from the high place into the city, Samuel communed with Saul upon the top of the house.
bsb_text: And after they had come down from the high place into the city, Samuel spoke with Saul on the roof of his house.
aov_text: Daarop het hulle van die hoogte afgegaan die stad in, en hy het met Saul gespreek op die dak.

kjv_text: And they arose early: and it came to pass about the spring of the day, that Samuel called Saul to the top of the house, saying, Up, that I may send thee away. And Saul arose, and they went out both of them, he and Samuel, abroad.
bsb_text: They got up early in the morning, and just before dawn Samuel called to Saul on the roof, “Get ready, and I will send you on your way!” So Saul arose, and both he and Samuel went outside together.
aov_text: En hulle het vroeg opgestaan. Toe die rooidag uitkom, het Samuel Saul op die dak geroep en gesê: Staan op, dat ek jou kan wegbring. En Saul het opgestaan, en hulle twee, hy en Samuel, het na buite gegaan.

kjv_text: And as they were going down to the end of the city, Samuel said to Saul, Bid the servant pass on before us, (and he passed on), but stand thou still a while, that I may shew thee the word of God.
bsb_text: As they were going down to the edge of the city, Samuel said to Saul, “Tell the servant to go on ahead of us, but you stay for a while, and I will reveal to you the word of God.” So the servant went on.
aov_text: Terwyl hulle by die einde van die stad afdaal, sê Samuel vir Saul: Beveel die dienaar dat hy voor ons uit verder gaan—en hy het verder gegaan—maar staan jy eers stil, dat ek jou die woord van God kan laat hoor.

kjv_text: Then Samuel took a vial of oil, and poured it upon his head, and kissed him, and said, Is it not because the LORD hath anointed thee to be captain over his inheritance?
bsb_text: Then Samuel took a flask of oil, poured it on Saul’s head, kissed him, and said, “Has not the LORD anointed you ruler over His inheritance?
aov_text: EN Samuel het die kruik met olie geneem en dit op sy hoof uitgegiet en hom gesoen en gesê: Het die HERE jou nie gesalf as vors oor sy erfdeel nie?

kjv_text: When thou art departed from me to day, then thou shalt find two men by Rachel's sepulchre in the border of Benjamin at Zelzah; and they will say unto thee, The asses which thou wentest to seek are found: and, lo, thy father hath left the care of the asses, and sorroweth for you, saying, What shall I do for my son?
bsb_text: When you leave me today, you will find two men at Rachel’s tomb in Zelzah on the border of Benjamin. They will say to you, ‘The donkeys you seek have been found, and now your father has stopped worrying about the donkeys and started worrying about you, asking, “What should I do about my son?”’
aov_text: As jy vandag van my af weggaan, sal jy by die graf van Ragel, op die grens van Benjamin in Selsag, twee manne aantref wat vir jou sal sê: Die esels wat jy gaan soek het, is gevind. En kyk, jou vader het die saak van die esels laat vaar en is besorg oor julle en vra: Wat kan ek vir my seun doen?

kjv_text: Then shalt thou go on forward from thence, and thou shalt come to the plain of Tabor, and there shall meet thee three men going up to God to Bethel, one carrying three kids, and another carrying three loaves of bread, and another carrying a bottle of wine:
bsb_text: Then you will go on from there until you come to the Oak of Tabor. Three men going up to God at Bethel will meet you there, one carrying three young goats, another carrying three loaves of bread, and another carrying a skin of wine.
aov_text: Gaan jy dan vandaar verder en kom by die terpentynboom van Tabor, dan sal drie manne jou daar kry wat na God, na Bet-el opgaan: een dra drie bokkies, en een dra drie broodjies, en een dra ’n sak wyn.

kjv_text: And they will salute thee, and give thee two loaves of bread; which thou shalt receive of their hands.
bsb_text: They will greet you and give you two loaves of bread, which you will accept from their hands.
aov_text: En hulle sal jou na die welstand vra en sal jou twee brode gee; dit moet jy dan uit hulle hand aanneem.

kjv_text: After that thou shalt come to the hill of God, where is the garrison of the Philistines: and it shall come to pass, when thou art come thither to the city, that thou shalt meet a company of prophets coming down from the high place with a psaltery, and a tabret, and a pipe, and a harp, before them; and they shall prophesy:
bsb_text: After that you will come to Gibeah of God, where the Philistines have an outpost. As you approach the city, you will meet a group of prophets coming down from the high place, preceded by harps, tambourines, flutes, and lyres, and they will be prophesying.
aov_text: Daarna sal jy kom by Gíbea van God waar die wagposte van die Filistyne is; en net soos jy daar die stad inkom, sal jy ’n groep profete ontmoet wat van die hoogte afkom, en voor hulle uit harpe en tamboeryne en fluite en siters, terwyl hulle self profeteer.

kjv_text: And the Spirit of the LORD will come upon thee, and thou shalt prophesy with them, and shalt be turned into another man.
bsb_text: Then the Spirit of the LORD will rush upon you, and you will prophesy with them; and you will be transformed into a different person.
aov_text: En die Gees van die HERE sal oor jou vaardig word, sodat jy saam met hulle sal profeteer en in ’n ander mens verander word.

kjv_text: And let it be, when these signs are come unto thee, that thou do as occasion serve thee; for God is with thee.
bsb_text: When these signs have come, do as the occasion demands, for God is with you.
aov_text: En as hierdie tekens vir jou uitkom, doen dan wat jou hand vind om te doen, want God is met jou.

kjv_text: And thou shalt go down before me to Gilgal; and, behold, I will come down unto thee, to offer burnt offerings, and to sacrifice sacrifices of peace offerings: seven days shalt thou tarry, till I come to thee, and shew thee what thou shalt do.
bsb_text: And you shall go before me to Gilgal, and surely I will come to you to offer burnt offerings and to sacrifice peace offerings. Wait seven days until I come to you and show you what you are to do.”
aov_text: En jy moet voor my uit na Gilgal afgaan, en kyk, ek sal na jou afkom om brandoffers te offer, om dankoffers te slag; sewe dae lank moet jy wag, totdat ek by jou kom en jou bekend maak wat jy moet doen.

kjv_text: And it was so, that when he had turned his back to go from Samuel, God gave him another heart: and all those signs came to pass that day.
bsb_text: As Saul turned to leave Samuel, God changed Saul’s heart, and all the signs came to pass that day.
aov_text: En net toe hy sy skouer draai om van Samuel af weg te gaan, het God sy hart verander, en al hierdie tekens het op dié dag uitgekom.

kjv_text: And when they came thither to the hill, behold, a company of prophets met him; and the Spirit of God came upon him, and he prophesied among them.
bsb_text: When Saul and his servant arrived at Gibeah, a group of prophets met him. Then the Spirit of God rushed upon him, and he prophesied along with them.
aov_text: Nadat hulle daar by Gíbea gekom het, ontmoet hom meteens ’n groep profete, en die Gees van God het oor hom vaardig geword, sodat hy onder hulle geprofeteer het.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when all that knew him beforetime saw that, behold, he prophesied among the prophets, then the people said one to another, What is this that is come unto the son of Kish? Is Saul also among the prophets?
bsb_text: All those who had formerly known Saul and saw him prophesying with the prophets asked one another, “What has happened to the son of Kish? Is Saul also among the prophets?”
aov_text: En toe elkeen wat hom van gister en eergister af geken het, sien dat hy saam met die profete profeteer, het die mense die een aan die ander gesê: Wat het tog gebeur met die seun van Kis? Is Saul ook onder die profete?

kjv_text: And one of the same place answered and said, But who is their father? Therefore it became a proverb, Is Saul also among the prophets?
bsb_text: Then a man who lived there replied, “And who is their father?” So the saying became a proverb: “Is Saul also among the prophets?”
aov_text: En ’n man daarvandaan het geantwoord en gesê: Wie is tog hulle vader? Daarom het dit ’n spreekwoord geword: Is Saul ook onder die profete?

kjv_text: And when he had made an end of prophesying, he came to the high place.
bsb_text: And when Saul had finished prophesying, he went up to the high place.
aov_text: Toe hy klaar was met profeteer, het hy op die hoogte aangekom.

kjv_text: And Saul's uncle said unto him and to his servant, Whither went ye? And he said, To seek the asses: and when we saw that they were no where, we came to Samuel.
bsb_text: Now Saul’s uncle asked him and his servant, “Where did you go?” “To look for the donkeys,” Saul replied. “When we saw they were not to be found, we went to Samuel.”
aov_text: En die oom van Saul het vir hom en sy dienaar gevra: Waar het julle heen gegaan? Daarop sê hy: Om die esels te soek; en toe ons sien dat hulle daar nie was nie, het ons na Samuel gegaan.

kjv_text: And Saul's uncle said, Tell me, I pray thee, what Samuel said unto you.
bsb_text: “Tell me,” Saul’s uncle asked, “what did Samuel say to you?”
aov_text: En die oom van Saul sê: Vertel my tog wat Samuel julle meegedeel het.

kjv_text: And Saul said unto his uncle, He told us plainly that the asses were found. But of the matter of the kingdom, whereof Samuel spake, he told him not.
bsb_text: And Saul replied, “He assured us that the donkeys had been found.” But Saul did not tell his uncle what Samuel had said about the kingship.
aov_text: Toe sê Saul vir sy oom: Hy het ons verseker meegedeel dat die esels gevind is. Maar die saak van die koningskap, waar Samuel van gespreek het, het hy hom nie vertel nie.

kjv_text: And Samuel called the people together unto the LORD to Mizpeh;
bsb_text: After this, Samuel summoned the people to the LORD at Mizpah
aov_text: En Samuel het die volk na die HERE in Mispa byeengeroep

kjv_text: And said unto the children of Israel, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, I brought up Israel out of Egypt, and delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all kingdoms, and of them that oppressed you:
bsb_text: and said to the Israelites, “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘I brought Israel up out of Egypt, and I rescued you from the hands of the Egyptians and of all the kingdoms that oppressed you.’
aov_text: en aan die kinders van Israel gesê: So spreek die HERE, die God van Israel: Ek het Israel uit Egipte laat optrek en julle gered uit die hand van die Egiptenaars en uit die hand van al die koninkryke wat julle verdruk het.

kjv_text: And ye have this day rejected your God, who himself saved you out of all your adversities and your tribulations; and ye have said unto him, Nay, but set a king over us. Now therefore present yourselves before the LORD by your tribes, and by your thousands.
bsb_text: But today you have rejected your God, who saves you from all your troubles and afflictions, and you have said to Him, ‘No, set a king over us.’ Now therefore present yourselves before the LORD by your tribes and clans.”
aov_text: Maar julle verwerp vandag julle God wat julle uit al jul onheile en node verlos het, en sê: Nee, maar jy moet ’n koning oor ons aanstel. Stel julle dan nou op voor die aangesig van die HERE volgens julle stamme en volgens julle geslagte.

kjv_text: And when Samuel had caused all the tribes of Israel to come near, the tribe of Benjamin was taken.
bsb_text: Thus Samuel had all the tribes of Israel come forward, and the tribe of Benjamin was selected.
aov_text: Toe Samuel dan al die stamme van Israel laat nader kom het, is die stam van Benjamin aangewys;

kjv_text: When he had caused the tribe of Benjamin to come near by their families, the family of Matri was taken, and Saul the son of Kish was taken: and when they sought him, he could not be found.
bsb_text: Then he had the tribe of Benjamin come forward by its clans, and the clan of Matri was selected. Finally, Saul son of Kish was selected. But when they looked for him, they could not find him.
aov_text: en toe hy die stam van Benjamin volgens sy geslagte laat nader kom het, is die geslag van Matri aangewys; verder is Saul, die seun van Kis, aangewys. En hulle het hom gesoek, maar hy was nie te vinde nie.

kjv_text: Therefore they enquired of the LORD further, if the man should yet come thither. And the LORD answered, Behold, he hath hid himself among the stuff.
bsb_text: So again they inquired of the LORD, “Has the man come here yet?” And the LORD replied, “Behold, he has hidden himself among the baggage.”
aov_text: En hulle het die HERE verder geraadpleeg: Het nog iemand hierheen gekom? En die HERE sê: Kyk, hy het tussen die pakgoed weggekruip.

kjv_text: And they ran and fetched him thence: and when he stood among the people, he was higher than any of the people from his shoulders and upward.
bsb_text: So they ran and brought Saul, and when he stood among the people, he was a head taller than any of the others.
aov_text: Daarop het hulle geloop en hom daarvandaan gebring; en toe hy tussen die mense gaan staan, was hy van sy skouers af boontoe hoër as die hele volk.

kjv_text: And Samuel said to all the people, See ye him whom the LORD hath chosen, that there is none like him among all the people? And all the people shouted, and said, God save the king.
bsb_text: Samuel said to all the people, “Do you see the one the LORD has chosen? There is no one like him among all the people.” And all the people shouted, “Long live the king!”
aov_text: En Samuel sê aan die hele volk: Sien julle hom wat die HERE uitgekies het? Want daar is nie een onder die hele volk soos hy nie. Toe juig die hele volk en sê: Mag die koning lewe!

kjv_text: Then Samuel told the people the manner of the kingdom, and wrote it in a book, and laid it up before the LORD. And Samuel sent all the people away, every man to his house.
bsb_text: Then Samuel explained to the people the rights of kingship. He wrote them on a scroll and laid it up before the LORD. And Samuel sent all the people away, each to his own home.
aov_text: Daarna het Samuel die reg van die koningskap voor die volk afgekondig en dit in ’n boek geskrywe en voor die aangesig van die HERE neergelê. En Samuel het die hele volk elkeen na sy huis laat gaan.

kjv_text: And Saul also went home to Gibeah; and there went with him a band of men, whose hearts God had touched.
bsb_text: Saul also went to his home in Gibeah, and the men of valor whose hearts God had touched went with him.
aov_text: En Saul het ook na sy huis gegaan in Gíbea; en die helde wie se hart God geroer het, het met hom saamgegaan.

kjv_text: But the children of Belial said, How shall this man save us? And they despised him, and brought him no presents. But he held his peace.
bsb_text: But some worthless men said, “How can this man save us?” So they despised him and brought him no gifts; but Saul remained silent about it.
aov_text: Maar die deugniete het gesê: Hoe kan hierdie man ons verlos? En hulle het hom verag en hom geen geskenk gebring nie; maar hy het hom doof gehou.

kjv_text: Then Nahash the Ammonite came up, and encamped against Jabeshgilead: and all the men of Jabesh said unto Nahash, Make a covenant with us, and we will serve thee.
bsb_text: Soon Nahash the Ammonite came up and laid siege to Jabesh-gilead. All the men of Jabesh said to him, “Make a treaty with us, and we will serve you.”
aov_text: EN Nahas, die Ammoniet, het opgetrek en Jabes in Gílead beleër; en al die manne van Jabes het aan Nahas gesê: Sluit met ons ’n verbond, dan sal ons u dien.

kjv_text: And Nahash the Ammonite answered them, On this condition will I make a covenant with you, that I may thrust out all your right eyes, and lay it for a reproach upon all Israel.
bsb_text: But Nahash the Ammonite replied, “I will make a treaty with you on one condition, that I may put out everyone’s right eye and bring reproach upon all Israel.”
aov_text: Maar Nahas, die Ammoniet, het vir hulle gesê: Op hierdie voorwaarde sal ek die verbond met julle sluit, dat ek julle almal die regteroog uitsteek en dit as ’n skande op die hele Israel kan lê.

kjv_text: And the elders of Jabesh said unto him, Give us seven days' respite, that we may send messengers unto all the coasts of Israel: and then, if there be no man to save us, we will come out to thee.
bsb_text: “Hold off for seven days,” replied the elders of Jabesh, “and let us send messengers throughout Israel. If there is no one to save us, we will surrender to you.”
aov_text: Toe sê die oudstes van Jabes vir hom: Laat ons sewe dae lank met rus, dat ons boodskappers in die hele gebied van Israel kan stuur; as daar dan niemand is wat ons verlos nie, sal ons na u toe uittrek.

kjv_text: Then came the messengers to Gibeah of Saul, and told the tidings in the ears of the people: and all the people lifted up their voices, and wept.
bsb_text: When the messengers came to Gibeah of Saul and relayed these words in the hearing of the people, they all wept aloud.
aov_text: En die boodskappers het in Gíbea van Saul gekom en die woorde voor die ore van die volk gespreek. Daarop verhef die hele volk hulle stem en ween.

kjv_text: And, behold, Saul came after the herd out of the field; and Saul said, What aileth the people that they weep? And they told him the tidings of the men of Jabesh.
bsb_text: Just then Saul was returning from the field, behind his oxen. “What troubles the people?” asked Saul. “Why are they weeping?” And they relayed to him the words of the men from Jabesh.
aov_text: Toe kom Saul juis aan agter die beeste van die veld af, en Saul sê: Wat is dit met die volk, dat hulle ween? En hulle vertel hom die woorde van die manne van Jabes.

kjv_text: And the Spirit of God came upon Saul when he heard those tidings, and his anger was kindled greatly.
bsb_text: When Saul heard their words, the Spirit of God rushed upon him, and he burned with great anger.
aov_text: En die Gees van God het oor Saul vaardig geword terwyl hy dié woorde hoor, en hy het baie kwaad geword.

kjv_text: And he took a yoke of oxen, and hewed them in pieces, and sent them throughout all the coasts of Israel by the hands of messengers, saying, Whosoever cometh not forth after Saul and after Samuel, so shall it be done unto his oxen. And the fear of the LORD fell on the people, and they came out with one consent.
bsb_text: He took a pair of oxen, cut them into pieces, and sent them by messengers throughout the land of Israel, proclaiming, “This is what will be done to the oxen of anyone who does not march behind Saul and Samuel.” Then the terror of the LORD fell upon the people, and they turned out as one man.
aov_text: En hy het ’n paar beeste geneem en hulle stukkend gesny en met boodskappers deur die hele gebied van Israel gestuur om te sê: Wie nie agter Saul en agter Samuel aan uittrek nie—so sal met sy beeste gedoen word. Toe val die skrik van die HERE op die volk en hulle trek soos een man uit.

kjv_text: And when he numbered them in Bezek, the children of Israel were three hundred thousand, and the men of Judah thirty thousand.
bsb_text: And when Saul numbered them at Bezek, there were 300,000 Israelites and 30,000 men of Judah.
aov_text: En hy het hulle gemonster in Besek: die kinders van Israel was driehonderdduisend en die manne van Juda dertigduisend.

kjv_text: And they said unto the messengers that came, Thus shall ye say unto the men of Jabeshgilead, To morrow, by that time the sun be hot, ye shall have help. And the messengers came and shewed it to the men of Jabesh; and they were glad.
bsb_text: So they said to the messengers who had come, “Tell the men of Jabesh-gilead: ‘Deliverance will be yours tomorrow by the time the sun is hot.’” And when the messengers relayed this to the men of Jabesh, they rejoiced.
aov_text: En hulle het aan die boodskappers wat gekom het, gesê: So moet julle aan die manne van Jabes in Gílead sê: Môre as die son op sy warmste is, sal julle hulp kry. Toe die boodskappers ingaan en dit aan die manne van Jabes meedeel, was hulle bly.

kjv_text: Therefore the men of Jabesh said, To morrow we will come out unto you, and ye shall do with us all that seemeth good unto you.
bsb_text: Then the men of Jabesh said to Nahash, “Tomorrow we will come out, and you can do with us whatever seems good to you.”
aov_text: En die manne van Jabes sê: Môre sal ons na julle uittrek, en julle kan met ons doen net soos dit goed is in julle oë.

kjv_text: And it was so on the morrow, that Saul put the people in three companies; and they came into the midst of the host in the morning watch, and slew the Ammonites until the heat of the day: and it came to pass, that they which remained were scattered, so that two of them were not left together.
bsb_text: The next day Saul organized the troops into three divisions, and during the morning watch they invaded the camp of the Ammonites and slaughtered them, until the hottest part of the day. And the survivors were so scattered that no two of them were left together.
aov_text: Maar die volgende môre het Saul die manskappe in drie afdelings opgestel, en hulle het met die môrewag in die laer ingekom en die Ammoniete verslaan tot op die warmste van die dag; en die ander het so verstrooid geraak dat nie twee onder hulle bymekaar gebly het nie.

kjv_text: And the people said unto Samuel, Who is he that said, Shall Saul reign over us? bring the men, that we may put them to death.
bsb_text: Then the people said to Samuel, “Who said that Saul should not reign over us? Bring those men here so we can kill them!”
aov_text: Daarna sê die manskappe vir Samuel: Wie is dit wat gevra het: Sou Saul oor ons regeer? Lewer die manne uit, dat ons hulle kan doodmaak.

kjv_text: And Saul said, There shall not a man be put to death this day: for to day the LORD hath wrought salvation in Israel.
bsb_text: But Saul ordered, “No one shall be put to death this day, for today the LORD has worked salvation in Israel.”
aov_text: Maar Saul antwoord: Op hierdie dag mag geen man gedood word nie, want vandag het die HERE ’n verlossing in Israel bewerk.

kjv_text: Then said Samuel to the people, Come, and let us go to Gilgal, and renew the kingdom there.
bsb_text: Then Samuel said to the people, “Come, let us go to Gilgal and renew the kingship there.”
aov_text: Toe sê Samuel aan die volk: Kom, laat ons na Gilgal gaan en daar die koningskap vernuwe.

kjv_text: And all the people went to Gilgal; and there they made Saul king before the LORD in Gilgal; and there they sacrificed sacrifices of peace offerings before the LORD; and there Saul and all the men of Israel rejoiced greatly.
bsb_text: So all the people went to Gilgal and confirmed Saul as king in the presence of the LORD. There they sacrificed peace offerings before the LORD, and Saul and all the Israelites rejoiced greatly.
aov_text: En die hele volk het na Gilgal getrek en daar Saul voor die aangesig van die HERE in Gilgal koning gemaak; en hulle het daar dankoffers voor die aangesig van die HERE geslag, en Saul met al die manne van Israel was daar uitermate vrolik.

kjv_text: And Samuel said unto all Israel, Behold, I have hearkened unto your voice in all that ye said unto me, and have made a king over you.
bsb_text: Then Samuel said to all Israel, “I have listened to your voice in all that you have said to me, and I have set over you a king.
aov_text: TOE sê Samuel aan die hele Israel: Kyk, ek het na julle geluister in alles wat julle aan my gesê het, en ’n koning oor julle aangestel.

kjv_text: And now, behold, the king walketh before you: and I am old and grayheaded; and, behold, my sons are with you: and I have walked before you from my childhood unto this day.
bsb_text: Now here is the king walking before you, and I am old and gray, and my sons are here with you. I have walked before you from my youth until this day.
aov_text: En kyk nou, die koning sal voor julle uit wandel, en ek het oud en grys geword, en my seuns is hier by julle. En ek het voor julle uit gewandel van my jeug af tot vandag toe.

kjv_text: Behold, here I am: witness against me before the LORD, and before his anointed: whose ox have I taken? or whose ass have I taken? or whom have I defrauded? whom have I oppressed? or of whose hand have I received any bribe to blind mine eyes therewith? and I will restore it you.
bsb_text: Here I am. Bear witness against me before the LORD and before His anointed: Whose ox or donkey have I taken? Whom have I cheated or oppressed? From whose hand have I accepted a bribe and closed my eyes? Tell me, and I will restore it to you.”
aov_text: Hier is ek; getuig teen my voor die HERE en voor sy gesalfde: wie se bees ek geneem het, en wie se esel ek geneem het, en wie ek verdruk of hard behandel het; en uit wie se hand ek omkoopgeld aangeneem het om my oë daarmee toe te maak—dan sal ek dit aan julle teruggee.

kjv_text: And they said, Thou hast not defrauded us, nor oppressed us, neither hast thou taken ought of any man's hand.
bsb_text: “You have not wronged us or oppressed us,” they replied, “nor have you taken anything from the hand of man.”
aov_text: En hulle antwoord: U het ons nie verdruk of ons hard behandel nie en uit niemand se hand iets aangeneem nie.

kjv_text: And he said unto them, The LORD is witness against you, and his anointed is witness this day, that ye have not found ought in my hand. And they answered, He is witness.
bsb_text: Samuel said to them, “The LORD is a witness against you, and His anointed is a witness today, that you have not found anything in my hand.” “He is a witness,” they replied.
aov_text: Daarop sê hy vir hulle: Die HERE is getuie teen julle, en getuie is sy gesalfde vandag, dat julle niks in my hand gevind het nie. En hulle roep: Hy is getuie.

kjv_text: And Samuel said unto the people, It is the LORD that advanced Moses and Aaron, and that brought your fathers up out of the land of Egypt.
bsb_text: Then Samuel said to the people, “The LORD is the One who appointed Moses and Aaron, and who brought your fathers up out of the land of Egypt.
aov_text: Verder het Samuel aan die volk gesê: Getuie is die HERE wat Moses en Aäron voortgebring en julle vaders uit Egipteland laat optrek het.

kjv_text: Now therefore stand still, that I may reason with you before the LORD of all the righteous acts of the LORD, which he did to you and to your fathers.
bsb_text: Now present yourselves, so that I may confront you before the LORD with all the righteous acts He has done for you and your fathers.
aov_text: Gaan staan dan nou, dat ek met julle gerig kan hou voor die aangesig van die HERE oor al die regverdige dade van die HERE wat Hy aan julle en julle vaders gedoen het.

kjv_text: When Jacob was come into Egypt, and your fathers cried unto the LORD, then the LORD sent Moses and Aaron, which brought forth your fathers out of Egypt, and made them dwell in this place.
bsb_text: When Jacob went to Egypt, your fathers cried out to the LORD, and He sent them Moses and Aaron, who brought your fathers out of Egypt and settled them in this place.
aov_text: Nadat Jakob in Egipte gekom en julle vaders die HERE aangeroep het, het die HERE Moses en Aäron gestuur; en hulle het julle vaders uit Egipte gelei, en Hy het hulle op hierdie plek laat woon.

kjv_text: And when they forgat the LORD their God, he sold them into the hand of Sisera, captain of the host of Hazor, and into the hand of the Philistines, and into the hand of the king of Moab, and they fought against them.
bsb_text: But they forgot the LORD their God, and He sold them into the hand of Sisera the commander of the army of Hazor, and into the hands of the Philistines and the king of Moab, who fought against them.
aov_text: Maar hulle het die HERE hul God vergeet; daarom het Hy hulle ver-koop in die hand van Sísera, die leërowerste van Hasor, en in die hand van die Filistyne en in die hand van die koning van Moab—wat teen hulle geveg het.

kjv_text: And they cried unto the LORD, and said, We have sinned, because we have forsaken the LORD, and have served Baalim and Ashtaroth: but now deliver us out of the hand of our enemies, and we will serve thee.
bsb_text: Then they cried out to the LORD and said, ‘We have sinned, for we have forsaken the LORD and served the Baals and Ashtoreths. Now deliver us from the hands of our enemies, that we may serve You.’
aov_text: Toe het hulle die HERE aangeroep en gesê: Ons het gesondig, want ons het die HERE verlaat en die Baäls en Astartes gedien; maar red ons nou uit die hand van ons vyande, dan sal ons U dien.

kjv_text: And the LORD sent Jerubbaal, and Bedan, and Jephthah, and Samuel, and delivered you out of the hand of your enemies on every side, and ye dwelled safe.
bsb_text: So the LORD sent Jerubbaal, Barak, Jephthah, and Samuel, and He delivered you from the hands of your enemies on every side, and you dwelt securely.
aov_text: En die HERE het Jerúbbaäl en Bedan en Jefta en Samuel gestuur en julle uit die hand van jul vyande rondom gered, sodat julle veilig gewoon het.

kjv_text: And when ye saw that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon came against you, ye said unto me, Nay; but a king shall reign over us: when the LORD your God was your king.
bsb_text: But when you saw that Nahash king of the Ammonites was moving against you, you said to me, ‘No, we must have a king to rule over us’—even though the LORD your God was your king.
aov_text: Maar toe julle sien dat Nahas, die koning van die kinders van Ammon, teen julle aankom, het julle aan my gesê: Nee, maar ’n koning moet oor ons regeer, terwyl die HERE julle God tog jul koning is.

kjv_text: Now therefore behold the king whom ye have chosen, and whom ye have desired! and, behold, the LORD hath set a king over you.
bsb_text: Now here is the king you have chosen, the one you requested. Behold, the LORD has placed a king over you.
aov_text: Hier is dan nou die koning wat julle uitgekies het, wat julle begeer het, en kyk, die HERE het ’n koning oor julle aangestel.

kjv_text: If ye will fear the LORD, and serve him, and obey his voice, and not rebel against the commandment of the LORD, then shall both ye and also the king that reigneth over you continue following the LORD your God:
bsb_text: If you fear the LORD and serve Him and obey His voice, and if you do not rebel against the command of the LORD, and if both you and the king who reigns over you follow the LORD your God, then all will be well.
aov_text: As julle maar die HERE vrees en Hom dien en na sy stem luister en nie wederstrewig is teen die mond van die HERE nie en julle self sowel as die koning wat oor julle regeer, die HERE julle God maar volg!

kjv_text: But if ye will not obey the voice of the LORD, but rebel against the commandment of the LORD, then shall the hand of the LORD be against you, as it was against your fathers.
bsb_text: But if you disobey the LORD and rebel against His command, then the hand of the LORD will be against you as it was against your fathers.
aov_text: Maar as julle nie na die stem van die HERE luister nie en wederstrewig is teen die mond van die HERE, dan sal die hand van die HERE teen julle wees soos teen julle vaders.

kjv_text: Now therefore stand and see this great thing, which the LORD will do before your eyes.
bsb_text: Now, therefore, stand and see this great thing that the LORD will do before your eyes.
aov_text: Gaan dus staan, en kyk na hierdie groot saak wat die HERE voor julle oë gaan doen.

kjv_text: Is it not wheat harvest to day? I will call unto the LORD, and he shall send thunder and rain; that ye may perceive and see that your wickedness is great, which ye have done in the sight of the LORD, in asking you a king.
bsb_text: Is it not the wheat harvest today? I will call on the LORD to send thunder and rain, so that you will know and see what a great evil you have committed in the sight of the LORD by asking for a king.”
aov_text: Is dit nie koringoestyd vandag nie? Ek sal die HERE aanroep, dat Hy donderslae en reën gee: weet dan en sien dit in dat julle kwaad groot is wat julle in die oë van die HERE gedoen het deur ’n koning vir julle te begeer.

kjv_text: So Samuel called unto the LORD; and the LORD sent thunder and rain that day: and all the people greatly feared the LORD and Samuel.
bsb_text: So Samuel called to the LORD, and on that day the LORD sent thunder and rain. As a result, all the people greatly feared the LORD and Samuel.
aov_text: Toe het Samuel die HERE aangeroep, en die HERE het donderslae en reën op dié dag gegee, sodat die hele volk baie bevrees geword het vir die HERE en vir Samuel.

kjv_text: And all the people said unto Samuel, Pray for thy servants unto the LORD thy God, that we die not: for we have added unto all our sins this evil, to ask us a king.
bsb_text: They pleaded with Samuel, “Pray to the LORD your God for your servants so that we will not die! For we have added to all our sins the evil of asking for a king.”
aov_text: Daarom het die hele volk vir Samuel gesê: Bid tot die HERE u God vir u knegte, dat ons nie sterf nie, omdat ons by al ons sondes nog kwaad gedoen het deur ’n koning vir ons te begeer.

kjv_text: And Samuel said unto the people, Fear not: ye have done all this wickedness: yet turn not aside from following the LORD, but serve the LORD with all your heart;
bsb_text: “Do not be afraid,” Samuel replied. “Even though you have committed all this evil, do not turn aside from following the LORD, but serve the LORD with all your heart.
aov_text: Toe sê Samuel vir die volk: Wees nie bevrees nie. Julle het al hierdie kwaad gedoen; maar wyk nie van die HERE af nie, en dien die HERE met julle hele hart.

kjv_text: And turn ye not aside: for then should ye go after vain things, which cannot profit nor deliver; for they are vain.
bsb_text: Do not turn aside after worthless things that cannot profit you or deliver you, for they are empty.
aov_text: En julle mag nie afwyk nie, want dan gaan julle agter nietige afgode aan wat nie kan help of red nie, omdat hulle nietighede is.

kjv_text: For the LORD will not forsake his people for his great name's sake: because it hath pleased the LORD to make you his people.
bsb_text: Indeed, for the sake of His great name, the LORD will not abandon His people, because He was pleased to make you His own.
aov_text: Want die HERE sal sy volk ter wille van sy grote Naam nie verwerp nie, omdat dit die HERE behaag het om van julle vir Hom ’n volk te maak.

kjv_text: Moreover as for me, God forbid that I should sin against the LORD in ceasing to pray for you: but I will teach you the good and the right way:
bsb_text: As for me, far be it from me that I should sin against the LORD by ceasing to pray for you. And I will continue to teach you the good and right way.
aov_text: Ook wat my betref, dit is ver van my dat ek teen die HERE sou sondig, dat ek sou ophou om vir julle te bid; maar ek sal julle in die goeie en regte weg onderrig.

kjv_text: Only fear the LORD, and serve him in truth with all your heart: for consider how great things he hath done for you.
bsb_text: Above all, fear the LORD and serve Him faithfully with all your heart; consider what great things He has done for you.
aov_text: Vrees net die HERE en dien Hom getrou met julle hele hart; want kyk watter groot dinge Hy by julle gedoen het.

kjv_text: But if ye shall still do wickedly, ye shall be consumed, both ye and your king.
bsb_text: But if you persist in doing evil, both you and your king will be swept away.”
aov_text: Maar as julle ooit verkeerd handel, sal julle self sowel as julle koning omkom.

kjv_text: Saul reigned one year; and when he had reigned two years over Israel,
bsb_text: Saul was thirty years old when he became king, and he reigned over Israel forty-two years.
aov_text: SAUL het ’n jaar geregeer. En toe hy twee jaar oor Israel geregeer het,

kjv_text: Saul chose him three thousand men of Israel; whereof two thousand were with Saul in Michmash and in mount Bethel, and a thousand were with Jonathan in Gibeah of Benjamin: and the rest of the people he sent every man to his tent.
bsb_text: He chose for himself three thousand men of Israel: Two thousand were with Saul at Michmash and in the hill country of Bethel, and a thousand were with Jonathan in Gibeah of Benjamin. And the rest of the troops he sent away, each to his own home.
aov_text: het Saul vir hom drieduisend man uit Israel uitgesoek; en by Saul was tweeduisend in Migmas en op die gebergte van Bet-el, en duisend was by Jónatan in Gíbea in Benjamin; maar die orige manskappe het hy laat gaan, elkeen na sy tente toe.

kjv_text: And Jonathan smote the garrison of the Philistines that was in Geba, and the Philistines heard of it. And Saul blew the trumpet throughout all the land, saying, Let the Hebrews hear.
bsb_text: Then Jonathan attacked the Philistine outpost at Geba, and the Philistines heard about it. So Saul blew the ram’s horn throughout the land, saying, “Let the Hebrews hear!”
aov_text: En Jónatan het die wagpos van die Filistyne verslaan wat in Geba was, en die Filistyne het dit gehoor. Daarop het Saul op die ramshoring laat blaas in die hele land om te sê: Laat die Hebreërs dit hoor!

kjv_text: And all Israel heard say that Saul had smitten a garrison of the Philistines, and that Israel also was had in abomination with the Philistines. And the people were called together after Saul to Gilgal.
bsb_text: And all Israel heard the news: “Saul has attacked an outpost of the Philistines, and now Israel has become a stench to the Philistines!” Then the people were summoned to join Saul at Gilgal.
aov_text: En die hele Israel het hoor sê: Saul het die wagpos van die Filistyne verslaan, en ook het Israel homself gehaat gemaak by die Filistyne. So is dan die manskappe opgeroep agter Saul aan na Gilgal toe.

kjv_text: And the Philistines gathered themselves together to fight with Israel, thirty thousand chariots, and six thousand horsemen, and people as the sand which is on the sea shore in multitude: and they came up, and pitched in Michmash, eastward from Bethaven.
bsb_text: Now the Philistines assembled to fight against Israel with three thousand chariots, six thousand horsemen, and troops as numerous as the sand on the seashore. They went up and camped at Michmash, east of Beth-aven.
aov_text: En die Filistyne het bymekaargekom om teen Israel te veg: drieduisend strydwaens en sesduisend perderuiters en voetgangers soos die sand wat op die seestrand is in menigte; en hulle het opgetrek en laer opgeslaan by Migmas, oos van Bet-Awen.

kjv_text: When the men of Israel saw that they were in a strait, (for the people were distressed,) then the people did hide themselves in caves, and in thickets, and in rocks, and in high places, and in pits.
bsb_text: Seeing that they were in danger because their troops were hard-pressed, the men of Israel hid in caves and thickets, among the rocks, and in cellars and cisterns.
aov_text: Toe die manne van Israel sien dat hulle in die nood is—want die volk was in die noute gedruk—het die volk weggekruip in die spelonke en in die doringbosse en in die rotse en in die grotte en in die kuile.

kjv_text: And some of the Hebrews went over Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead. As for Saul, he was yet in Gilgal, and all the people followed him trembling.
bsb_text: Some Hebrews even crossed the Jordan into the land of Gad and Gilead. Saul, however, remained at Gilgal, and all his troops were quaking in fear.
aov_text: En die Hebreërs het die Jordaan deurgetrek na die land Gad en Gílead; maar Saul was nog in Gilgal met al die manskappe wat bewende agter hom aan gegaan het.

kjv_text: And he tarried seven days, according to the set time that Samuel had appointed: but Samuel came not to Gilgal; and the people were scattered from him.
bsb_text: And Saul waited seven days for the time appointed by Samuel, but Samuel did not come to Gilgal, and the troops began to desert Saul.
aov_text: En hy het sewe dae lank gewag, tot die tyd wat Samuel bepaal het; maar toe Samuel nie na Gilgal kom nie en die manskappe van hom af verstrooid raak,

kjv_text: And Saul said, Bring hither a burnt offering to me, and peace offerings. And he offered the burnt offering.
bsb_text: So he said, “Bring me the burnt offering and the peace offerings.” And he offered up the burnt offering.
aov_text: het Saul gesê: Bring na my die brandoffer en die dankoffers; en hy het die brandoffer geoffer.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, that as soon as he had made an end of offering the burnt offering, behold, Samuel came; and Saul went out to meet him, that he might salute him.
bsb_text: Just as he finished offering the burnt offering, Samuel arrived, and Saul went out to greet him.
aov_text: En toe hy net gereed was om die brandoffer te bring, kom Samuel meteens daar aan; en Saul het uitgegaan hom tegemoet om hom te groet.

kjv_text: And Samuel said, What hast thou done? And Saul said, Because I saw that the people were scattered from me, and that thou camest not within the days appointed, and that the Philistines gathered themselves together at Michmash;
bsb_text: “What have you done?” Samuel asked. And Saul replied, “When I saw that the troops were deserting me, and that you did not come at the appointed time and the Philistines were gathering at Michmash,
aov_text: Daarop vra Samuel: Wat het jy gedoen? En Saul sê: Ek het gesien dat die manskappe verstrooid raak van my af; en toe u nie kom op die afgesproke tyd nie, terwyl die Filistyne in Migmas bymekaarkom,

kjv_text: Therefore said I, The Philistines will come down now upon me to Gilgal, and I have not made supplication unto the LORD: I forced myself therefore, and offered a burnt offering.
bsb_text: I thought, ‘Now the Philistines will descend upon me at Gilgal, and I have not sought the favor of the LORD.’ So I felt compelled to offer the burnt offering.”
aov_text: het ek gesê: Nou sal die Filistyne na my toe aftrek in Gilgal, en ek het die aangesig van die HERE nie om genade gesmeek nie; daarom het ek myself sterk gehou en die brandoffer gebring.
