kjv_text: And Samuel said to Saul, Thou hast done foolishly: thou hast not kept the commandment of the LORD thy God, which he commanded thee: for now would the LORD have established thy kingdom upon Israel for ever.
bsb_text: “You have acted foolishly,” Samuel declared. “You have not kept the command that the LORD your God gave you; if you had, the LORD would have established your kingdom over Israel for all time.
aov_text: Toe sê Samuel vir Saul: Jy het dwaas gehandel, jy het die gebod van die HERE jou God wat Hy jou beveel het, nie gehou nie; want anders sou die HERE jou koningskap oor Israel vir goed bevestig het.

kjv_text: But now thy kingdom shall not continue: the LORD hath sought him a man after his own heart, and the LORD hath commanded him to be captain over his people, because thou hast not kept that which the LORD commanded thee.
bsb_text: But now your kingdom will not endure; the LORD has sought a man after His own heart and appointed him ruler over His people, because you have not kept the command of the LORD.”
aov_text: Maar nou sal jou koningskap nie bestaan nie. Die HERE het vir Hom ’n man na sy hart gesoek; en die HERE het hom as vors oor sy volk aangestel, omdat jy nie gehou het wat die HERE jou beveel het nie.

kjv_text: And Samuel arose, and gat him up from Gilgal unto Gibeah of Benjamin. And Saul numbered the people that were present with him, about six hundred men.
bsb_text: Then Samuel set out from Gilgal and went up to Gibeah in Benjamin. And Saul numbered the troops who were with him, about six hundred men.
aov_text: Toe het Samuel klaargemaak en opgegaan van Gilgal na Gíbea in Benjamin, en Saul het die manskappe gemonster wat by hom aanwesig was, omtrent seshonderd man.

kjv_text: And Saul, and Jonathan his son, and the people that were present with them, abode in Gibeah of Benjamin: but the Philistines encamped in Michmash.
bsb_text: Now Saul and Jonathan his son and the troops with them were staying in Geba of Benjamin, while the Philistines camped at Michmash.
aov_text: Terwyl Saul en sy seun Jónatan en die manskappe wat by hulle aanwesig was, in Geba in Benjamin bly en die Filistyne by Migmas laer opslaan,

kjv_text: And the spoilers came out of the camp of the Philistines in three companies: one company turned unto the way that leadeth to Ophrah, unto the land of Shual:
bsb_text: And raiders went out of the Philistine camp in three divisions. One headed toward Ophrah in the land of Shual,
aov_text: het die roofkommando uitgetrek uit die laer van die Filistyne in drie afdelings: een deel het weggedraai op pad na Ofra, na die land Sual toe;

kjv_text: And another company turned the way to Bethhoron: and another company turned to the way of the border that looketh to the valley of Zeboim toward the wilderness.
bsb_text: another toward Beth-horon, and the third down the border road overlooking the Valley of Zeboim facing the wilderness.
aov_text: en een deel het weggedraai op pad na Bet-Horon, en een deel het weggedraai op pad na die grens wat oor die dal Sebóim na die woestyn uitkyk.

kjv_text: Now there was no smith found throughout all the land of Israel: for the Philistines said, Lest the Hebrews make them swords or spears:
bsb_text: And no blacksmith could be found in all the land of Israel, because the Philistines had said, “The Hebrews must not be allowed to make swords or spears.”
aov_text: En daar was geen smid te vinde in die hele land van Israel nie, want die Filistyne het gesê: Anders kan die Hebreërs swaarde of spiese maak.

kjv_text: But all the Israelites went down to the Philistines, to sharpen every man his share, and his coulter, and his axe, and his mattock.
bsb_text: Instead, all the Israelites would go down to the Philistines to sharpen their plowshares, mattocks, axes, and sickles.
aov_text: Daarom moes al die Israeliete na die Filistyne afgaan om elkeen sy kluitbreker of sy pik of sy byl of sy ploegskaar skerp te maak —

kjv_text: Yet they had a file for the mattocks, and for the coulters, and for the forks, and for the axes, and to sharpen the goads.
bsb_text: The charge was a pim for sharpening a plowshare or mattock, a third of a shekel for sharpening a pitchfork or an axe, and a third of a shekel for repointing an oxgoad.
aov_text: so dikwels as die snykant stomp was aan ploegskare en pikke en drietandvurke en byle; en om die osprikkels reg te maak.

kjv_text: So it came to pass in the day of battle, that there was neither sword nor spear found in the hand of any of the people that were with Saul and Jonathan: but with Saul and with Jonathan his son was there found.
bsb_text: So on the day of battle not a sword or spear could be found in the hands of the troops with Saul and Jonathan; only Saul and his son Jonathan had weapons.
aov_text: So het dit gekom dat daar in oorlogstyd geen swaard of spies te vinde was in die hand van al die manskappe wat by Saul en Jónatan was nie; maar by Saul en sy seun Jónatan was dit wel te vinde.

kjv_text: And the garrison of the Philistines went out to the passage of Michmash.
bsb_text: And a garrison of the Philistines had gone out to the pass at Michmash.
aov_text: En ’n wagpos van die Filistyne het uitgetrek na die pas van Migmas.

kjv_text: Now it came to pass upon a day, that Jonathan the son of Saul said unto the young man that bare his armour, Come, and let us go over to the Philistines' garrison, that is on the other side. But he told not his father.
bsb_text: One day Jonathan son of Saul said to the young man bearing his armor, “Come, let us cross over to the Philistine outpost on the other side.” But Jonathan did not tell his father.
aov_text: EN op ’n dag het Jónatan, die seun van Saul, aan die dienaar wat sy wapens dra, gesê: Kom, ons gaan oor na die wagpos van die Filistyne wat daar oorkant is. Maar aan sy vader het hy dit nie te kenne gegee nie.

kjv_text: And Saul tarried in the uttermost part of Gibeah under a pomegranate tree which is in Migron: and the people that were with him were about six hundred men;
bsb_text: Meanwhile, Saul was staying under the pomegranate tree in Migron on the outskirts of Gibeah. And the troops who were with him numbered about six hundred men,
aov_text: En Saul het gesit op die grens van Gíbea onder die granaatboom wat by Migron staan; en die manskappe by hom was omtrent seshonderd man.

kjv_text: And Ahiah, the son of Ahitub, Ichabod's brother, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eli, the LORD's priest in Shiloh, wearing an ephod. And the people knew not that Jonathan was gone.
bsb_text: including Ahijah, who was wearing an ephod. He was the son of Ichabod’s brother Ahitub son of Phinehas, the son of Eli the priest of the LORD in Shiloh. But the troops did not know that Jonathan had left.
aov_text: En Ahía, die seun van Ahítub, die broer van Íkabod, die seun van Pínehas, die seun van Eli, die priester van die HERE in Silo, het die skouerkleed gedra. Maar die manskappe het nie geweet dat Jónatan weggegaan het nie.

kjv_text: And between the passages, by which Jonathan sought to go over unto the Philistines' garrison, there was a sharp rock on the one side, and a sharp rock on the other side: and the name of the one was Bozez, and the name of the other Seneh.
bsb_text: Now there were cliffs on both sides of the pass that Jonathan intended to cross to reach the Philistine outpost. One was named Bozez and the other Seneh.
aov_text: Nou was daar tussen die passe waar Jónatan wou deurgaan na die wagpos van die Filistyne, ’n spits rots oorkant en ’n spits rots duskant, en die naam van die een was Boses en die naam van die ander Sene.

kjv_text: The forefront of the one was situate northward over against Michmash, and the other southward over against Gibeah.
bsb_text: One cliff stood to the north toward Michmash, and the other to the south toward Geba.
aov_text: Die een spits staan soos ’n pilaar noord teenoor Migmas, en die ander een suid teenoor Geba.

kjv_text: And Jonathan said to the young man that bare his armour, Come, and let us go over unto the garrison of these uncircumcised: it may be that the LORD will work for us: for there is no restraint to the LORD to save by many or by few.
bsb_text: Jonathan said to the young man bearing his armor, “Come, let us cross over to the outpost of these uncircumcised men. Perhaps the LORD will work on our behalf. Nothing can hinder the LORD from saving, whether by many or by few.”
aov_text: Jónatan dan het aan die dienaar wat sy wapens dra, gesê: Kom, ons gaan oor na die wagpos van daardie onbesnedenes; miskien sal die HERE vir ons optree, want by die HERE is daar geen verhindering om deur baie of deur min te verlos nie.

kjv_text: And his armourbearer said unto him, Do all that is in thine heart: turn thee; behold, I am with thee according to thy heart.
bsb_text: His armor-bearer replied, “Do all that is in your heart. Go ahead; I am with you heart and soul.”
aov_text: Toe sê sy wapendraer vir hom: Doen alles wat in u hart is, maak soos u wil; hier is ek by u volgens die wens van u hart.

kjv_text: Then said Jonathan, Behold, we will pass over unto these men, and we will discover ourselves unto them.
bsb_text: “Very well,” said Jonathan, “we will cross over toward these men and show ourselves to them.
aov_text: Daarop sê Jónatan: Kyk, ons sal na die manne toe oorgaan en ons aan hulle vertoon.

kjv_text: If they say thus unto us, Tarry until we come to you; then we will stand still in our place, and will not go up unto them.
bsb_text: If they say, ‘Wait until we come to you,’ then we will stay where we are and will not go up to them.
aov_text: As hulle vir ons só sê: Staan stil totdat ons by julle kom! dan moet ons op ons plek bly staan en nie na hulle opklim nie.

kjv_text: But if they say thus, Come up unto us; then we will go up: for the LORD hath delivered them into our hand: and this shall be a sign unto us.
bsb_text: But if they say, ‘Come on up,’ then we will go up, because this will be our sign that the LORD has delivered them into our hands.”
aov_text: Maar as hulle só sê: Kom op na ons toe! dan klim ons op, want dan het die HERE hulle in ons hand gegee; en dit sal vir ons die teken wees.

kjv_text: And both of them discovered themselves unto the garrison of the Philistines: and the Philistines said, Behold, the Hebrews come forth out of the holes where they had hid themselves.
bsb_text: So the two of them showed themselves to the outpost of the Philistines, who exclaimed, “Look, the Hebrews are coming out of the holes in which they were hiding!”
aov_text: Toe hulle twee hul aan die wagpos van die Filistyne vertoon, sê die Filistyne: Kyk, daar kom Hebreërs uit die gate uit waar hulle weggekruip het.

kjv_text: And the men of the garrison answered Jonathan and his armourbearer, and said, Come up to us, and we will shew you a thing. And Jonathan said unto his armourbearer, Come up after me: for the LORD hath delivered them into the hand of Israel.
bsb_text: So the men of the outpost called out to Jonathan and his armor-bearer, “Come on up, and we will teach you a lesson!” “Follow me,” Jonathan told his armor-bearer, “for the LORD has delivered them into the hand of Israel.”
aov_text: En die manne van die wagpos het Jónatan en sy wapendraer aangespreek en gesê: Klim op na ons toe, dan sal ons julle ’n les leer! Daarop sê Jónatan aan sy wapendraer: Klim op agter my aan, want die HERE het hulle in die hand van Israel gegee.

kjv_text: And Jonathan climbed up upon his hands and upon his feet, and his armourbearer after him: and they fell before Jonathan; and his armourbearer slew after him.
bsb_text: So Jonathan climbed up on his hands and feet, with his armor-bearer behind him. And the Philistines fell before Jonathan, and his armor-bearer followed and finished them off.
aov_text: En Jónatan het op sy hande en voete uitgeklim, en sy wapendraer agter hom aan; en hulle het voor Jónatan geval terwyl sy wapendraer agter hom aan van kant maak.

kjv_text: And that first slaughter, which Jonathan and his armourbearer made, was about twenty men, within as it were an half acre of land, which a yoke of oxen might plow.
bsb_text: In that first assault, Jonathan and his armor-bearer struck down about twenty men over half an acre of land.
aov_text: Hierdie eerste slag waarin Jónatan en sy wapendraer ongeveer twintig man verslaan het, het plaasgevind op omtrent die helfte van ’n aanvoorsel van ’n stuk land.

kjv_text: And there was trembling in the host, in the field, and among all the people: the garrison, and the spoilers, they also trembled, and the earth quaked: so it was a very great trembling.
bsb_text: Then terror struck the Philistines in the camp, in the field, and among all the people. Even those in the outposts and raiding parties trembled. Indeed, the earth quaked and panic spread from God.
aov_text: Toe kom daar ’n skrik in die laer, in die veld en onder al die manskappe; die wagpos en die roofkommando, hulle het ook geskrik, ja, die land het gebewe, sodat dit ’n skrik van God geword het.

kjv_text: And the watchmen of Saul in Gibeah of Benjamin looked; and, behold, the multitude melted away, and they went on beating down one another.
bsb_text: Now when Saul’s watchmen at Gibeah in Benjamin looked and saw the troops melting away and scattering in every direction,
aov_text: En toe die spioene van Saul in Gíbea in Benjamin sien dat die menigte daar verward heen en weer golf,

kjv_text: Then said Saul unto the people that were with him, Number now, and see who is gone from us. And when they had numbered, behold, Jonathan and his armourbearer were not there.
bsb_text: Saul said to the troops who were with him, “Call the roll and see who has left us.” And when they had called the roll, they saw that Jonathan and his armor-bearer were not there.
aov_text: sê Saul aan die manskappe wat by hom was: Hou tog ’n monstering en kyk wie van ons af weggegaan het. En by die monstering het geblyk dat Jónatan en sy wapendraer daar nie was nie.

kjv_text: And Saul said unto Ahiah, Bring hither the ark of God. For the ark of God was at that time with the children of Israel.
bsb_text: Then Saul said to Ahijah, “Bring the ark of God.” (For at that time it was with the Israelites.)
aov_text: Toe sê Saul vir Ahía: Bring die ark van God nader. Want die ark van God was in dié tyd by die kinders van Israel.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, while Saul talked unto the priest, that the noise that was in the host of the Philistines went on and increased: and Saul said unto the priest, Withdraw thine hand.
bsb_text: While Saul was talking to the priest, the commotion in the Philistine camp continued to increase. So Saul said to the priest, “Withdraw your hand.”
aov_text: En terwyl Saul nog met die priester spreek en die rumoer wat in die laer van die Filistyne was, altyddeur groter word, sê Saul vir die priester: Trek jou hand terug!

kjv_text: And Saul and all the people that were with him assembled themselves, and they came to the battle: and, behold, every man's sword was against his fellow, and there was a very great discomfiture.
bsb_text: Then Saul and all his troops assembled and marched to the battle, and they found the Philistines in total confusion, with each man wielding the sword against his neighbor.
aov_text: Saul en al die manskappe wat by hom was, is toe saamgeroep, en hulle het by die geveg aangekom; en kyk, die swaard van die een was teen die ander—’n baie groot verwarring.

kjv_text: Moreover the Hebrews that were with the Philistines before that time, which went up with them into the camp from the country round about, even they also turned to be with the Israelites that were with Saul and Jonathan.
bsb_text: And the Hebrews who had previously gone up into the surrounding camps of the Philistines now went over to the Israelites who were with Saul and Jonathan.
aov_text: Selfs die Hebreërs wat die Filistyne soos gister en eergister bygestaan het, wat verspreid met hulle saam in die leër opgetrek het, hulle het ook aangesluit by die Israeliete wat saam met Saul en Jónatan was.

kjv_text: Likewise all the men of Israel which had hid themselves in mount Ephraim, when they heard that the Philistines fled, even they also followed hard after them in the battle.
bsb_text: When all the Israelites who had been hiding in the hill country of Ephraim heard that the Philistines were fleeing, they also joined Saul and Jonathan in the battle.
aov_text: Toe al die manne van Israel wat op die gebergte van Efraim weggekruip het, hoor dat die Filistyne vlug, het dié hulle ook in die geveg agternagesit.

kjv_text: So the LORD saved Israel that day: and the battle passed over unto Bethaven.
bsb_text: So the LORD saved Israel that day, and the battle moved on beyond Beth-aven.
aov_text: En die HERE het Israel op dié dag verlos. Toe die geveg dan by Bet-Awen verbygaan,

kjv_text: And the men of Israel were distressed that day: for Saul had adjured the people, saying, Cursed be the man that eateth any food until evening, that I may be avenged on mine enemies. So none of the people tasted any food.
bsb_text: Now the men of Israel were in distress that day, for Saul had placed the troops under an oath, saying, “Cursed is the man who eats any food before evening, before I have taken vengeance on my enemies.” So none of the troops tasted any food.
aov_text: en die manne van Israel dié dag aangedryf word, het Saul die manskappe besweer en gesê: Vervloek is die man wat iets eet tot vanaand, sodat ek my op my vyande kan wreek. Daarom het al die manskappe aan niks geproe nie.

kjv_text: And all they of the land came to a wood; and there was honey upon the ground.
bsb_text: Then all the troops entered the forest, and there was honey on the ground.
aov_text: En al die mense het in ’n bos gekom, en daar was heuning op die veld.

kjv_text: And when the people were come into the wood, behold, the honey dropped; but no man put his hand to his mouth: for the people feared the oath.
bsb_text: And when they entered the forest and saw the flowing honey, not one of them put his hand to his mouth, because they feared the oath.
aov_text: Toe die manskappe in die bos kom, was daar oorvloed van heuning; maar niemand het met sy hand aan sy mond geraak nie, omdat die manskappe bevrees was vir die eed.

kjv_text: But Jonathan heard not when his father charged the people with the oath: wherefore he put forth the end of the rod that was in his hand, and dipped it in an honeycomb, and put his hand to his mouth; and his eyes were enlightened.
bsb_text: Jonathan, however, had not heard that his father had charged the people with the oath. So he reached out the end of the staff in his hand, dipped it into the honeycomb, and put his hand to his mouth; and his eyes brightened.
aov_text: Maar Jónatan het nie gehoor toe sy vader die manskappe besweer het nie en het die punt van die staf wat in sy hand was, uitgesteek en dit in ’n heuningkoek gedoop en sy hand aan sy mond gebring, en sy oë het helder geword.

kjv_text: Then answered one of the people, and said, Thy father straitly charged the people with an oath, saying, Cursed be the man that eateth any food this day. And the people were faint.
bsb_text: Then one of the soldiers told him, “Your father bound the troops with a solemn oath, saying, ‘Cursed is the man who eats food today.’ That is why the people are faint.”
aov_text: Daarop spreek een van die manskappe hom aan en sê: Jou vader het die manskappe met hierdie dure eed besweer: Vervloek is die man wat vandag iets eet. Daarom is die volk afgemat.

kjv_text: Then said Jonathan, My father hath troubled the land: see, I pray you, how mine eyes have been enlightened, because I tasted a little of this honey.
bsb_text: “My father has brought trouble to the land,” Jonathan replied. “Just look at how my eyes have brightened because I tasted a little of this honey.
aov_text: En Jónatan sê: My vader stort die land in die ongeluk; kyk tog hoe helder my oë nou is, omdat ek hierdie bietjie heuning geproe het.

kjv_text: How much more, if haply the people had eaten freely to day of the spoil of their enemies which they found? for had there not been now a much greater slaughter among the Philistines?
bsb_text: How much better it would have been if the troops had eaten freely today from the plunder they took from their enemies! Would not the slaughter of the Philistines have been much greater?”
aov_text: Hoeveel te meer as die manskappe vandag vry kon eet van die buit van hul vyande wat hulle gevind het! Maar nou is die slagting onder die Filistyne nie groot nie.

kjv_text: And they smote the Philistines that day from Michmash to Aijalon: and the people were very faint.
bsb_text: That day, after the Israelites had struck down the Philistines from Michmash to Aijalon, the people were very faint.
aov_text: Maar dié dag het hulle die Filistyne verslaan van Migmas af na Ájalon toe, en die manskappe was baie afgemat.

kjv_text: And the people flew upon the spoil, and took sheep, and oxen, and calves, and slew them on the ground: and the people did eat them with the blood.
bsb_text: So they rushed greedily to the plunder, taking sheep, cattle, and calves. They slaughtered them on the ground and ate meat with the blood still in it.
aov_text: En die manskappe het op die buit afgestorm, en kleinvee en beeste en kalwers geneem en dit op die grond geslag, en die manskappe het dit met bloed en al geëet.

kjv_text: Then they told Saul, saying, Behold, the people sin against the LORD, in that they eat with the blood. And he said, Ye have transgressed: roll a great stone unto me this day.
bsb_text: Then someone reported to Saul: “Look, the troops are sinning against the LORD by eating meat with the blood still in it.” “You have broken faith,” said Saul. “Roll a large stone over here at once.”
aov_text: Toe daar aan Saul geboodskap is: Kyk, die manskappe besondig hulle teen die HERE deur met bloed en al te eet, het hy gesê: Julle handel troueloos; rol nou ’n groot klip na my toe.

kjv_text: And Saul said, Disperse yourselves among the people, and say unto them, Bring me hither every man his ox, and every man his sheep, and slay them here, and eat; and sin not against the LORD in eating with the blood. And all the people brought every man his ox with him that night, and slew them there.
bsb_text: Then he said, “Go among the troops and tell them, ‘Each man must bring me his ox or his sheep, slaughter them in this place, and then eat. Do not sin against the LORD by eating meat with the blood still in it.’” So that night everyone brought his ox and slaughtered it there.
aov_text: Verder het Saul gesê: Versprei julle onder die manskappe en sê aan hulle: Bring na my elkeen sy bees en elkeen sy stuk kleinvee, en slag dit hier en eet; maar besondig julle nie teen die HERE deur met bloed en al te eet nie. En al die manskappe het elkeen in die nag sy bees met sy hand gebring en dit daar geslag.

kjv_text: And Saul built an altar unto the LORD: the same was the first altar that he built unto the LORD.
bsb_text: Then Saul built an altar to the LORD; it was the first time he had built an altar to the LORD.
aov_text: En Saul het vir die HERE ’n altaar gebou; dit was die eerste altaar wat hy vir die HERE gebou het.

kjv_text: And Saul said, Let us go down after the Philistines by night, and spoil them until the morning light, and let us not leave a man of them. And they said, Do whatsoever seemeth good unto thee. Then said the priest, Let us draw near hither unto God.
bsb_text: And Saul said, “Let us go down after the Philistines by night and plunder them until dawn, leaving no man alive!” “Do what seems good to you,” the troops replied. But the priest said, “We must consult God here.”
aov_text: Toe sê Saul: Laat ons in die nag aftrek agter die Filistyne aan, en laat ons onder hulle plunder totdat dit môre lig word; en ons moet nie een onder hulle laat oorbly nie. En hulle antwoord: Doen alles wat goed is in u oë. Maar die priester het gesê: Laat ons hier tot God nader.

kjv_text: And Saul asked counsel of God, Shall I go down after the Philistines? wilt thou deliver them into the hand of Israel? But he answered him not that day.
bsb_text: So Saul inquired of God, “Shall I go down after the Philistines? Will You give them into the hand of Israel?” But God did not answer him that day.
aov_text: Toe het Saul God geraadpleeg: Sal ek aftrek agter die Filistyne aan? Sal U hulle in Israel se hand gee? Maar Hy het hom dié dag nie geantwoord nie.

kjv_text: And Saul said, Draw ye near hither, all the chief of the people: and know and see wherein this sin hath been this day.
bsb_text: Therefore Saul said, “Come here, all you leaders of the troops, and let us investigate how this sin has occurred today.
aov_text: En Saul sê: Kom nader hierheen, al die hoofde van die volk, en ondersoek en kyk waarin hierdie sonde vandag begaan is.

kjv_text: For, as the LORD liveth, which saveth Israel, though it be in Jonathan my son, he shall surely die. But there was not a man among all the people that answered him.
bsb_text: As surely as the LORD who saves Israel lives, even if it is my son Jonathan, he must die!” But not one of the troops said a word.
aov_text: Want so waar as die HERE leef wat Israel verlos, al was dit ook in my seun Jónatan, dan moet hy sekerlik sterwe! Maar niemand uit al die manskappe het hom geantwoord nie.

kjv_text: Then said he unto all Israel, Be ye on one side, and I and Jonathan my son will be on the other side. And the people said unto Saul, Do what seemeth good unto thee.
bsb_text: Then Saul said to all Israel, “You stand on one side, and I and my son Jonathan will stand on the other side.” “Do what seems good to you,” the troops replied.
aov_text: Daarop sê hy aan die hele Israel: Julle moet eenkant staan, en ek en my seun Jónatan sal eenkant staan. En die manskappe antwoord Saul: Doen wat goed is in u oë.

kjv_text: Therefore Saul said unto the LORD God of Israel, Give a perfect lot. And Saul and Jonathan were taken: but the people escaped.
bsb_text: So Saul said to the LORD, the God of Israel, “Why have You not answered Your servant this day? If the fault is with me or my son Jonathan, respond with Urim; but if the fault is with the men of Israel, respond with Thummim.” And Jonathan and Saul were selected, but the people were cleared of the charge.
aov_text: Toe sê Saul aan die HERE: God van Israel, gee tog die waarheid! En Jónatan en Saul is aangewys, maar die manskappe het vry uitgegaan.

kjv_text: And Saul said, Cast lots between me and Jonathan my son. And Jonathan was taken.
bsb_text: Then Saul said, “Cast the lot between me and my son Jonathan.” And Jonathan was selected.
aov_text: En Saul sê: Werp die lot tussen my en my seun Jónatan. En Jónatan is aangewys.

kjv_text: Then Saul said to Jonathan, Tell me what thou hast done. And Jonathan told him, and said, I did but taste a little honey with the end of the rod that was in mine hand, and, lo, I must die.
bsb_text: “Tell me what you have done,” Saul commanded him. So Jonathan told him, “I only tasted a little honey with the end of the staff that was in my hand. And now I must die?”
aov_text: Daarop vra Saul vir Jónatan: Gee my tog te kenne wat jy gedoen het. En Jónatan het hom te kenne gegee en gesê: Ek het net ’n bietjie heuning geproe met die punt van die staf wat in my hand was; hier is ek, ek sal sterwe.

kjv_text: And Saul answered, God do so and more also: for thou shalt surely die, Jonathan.
bsb_text: And Saul declared, “May God punish me, and ever so severely, if you, Jonathan, do not surely die!”
aov_text: Toe sê Saul: Mag God aan my so doen en so daaraan toedoen, jy moet sekerlik sterwe, Jónatan!

kjv_text: And the people said unto Saul, Shall Jonathan die, who hath wrought this great salvation in Israel? God forbid: as the LORD liveth, there shall not one hair of his head fall to the ground; for he hath wrought with God this day. So the people rescued Jonathan, that he died not.
bsb_text: But the people said to Saul, “Must Jonathan die—he who accomplished such a great deliverance for Israel? Never! As surely as the LORD lives, not a hair of his head will fall to the ground, for with God’s help he has accomplished this today.” So the people rescued Jonathan, and he did not die.
aov_text: Maar die manskappe het aan Saul gesê: Moet Jónatan sterwe wat hierdie groot verlossing in Israel bewerk het? Volstrek nie! So waar as die HERE leef, geen haar van sy hoof sal op die aarde val nie! Want met God het hy dit vandag gedoen. So het die volk dan Jónatan losgekoop, dat hy nie gesterf het nie.

kjv_text: Then Saul went up from following the Philistines: and the Philistines went to their own place.
bsb_text: Then Saul gave up his pursuit of the Philistines, and the Philistines returned to their own land.
aov_text: Daarna het Saul agter die Filistyne teruggetrek, en die Filistyne het na hulle plek gegaan.

kjv_text: So Saul took the kingdom over Israel, and fought against all his enemies on every side, against Moab, and against the children of Ammon, and against Edom, and against the kings of Zobah, and against the Philistines: and whithersoever he turned himself, he vexed them.
bsb_text: After Saul had assumed the kingship over Israel, he fought against all his enemies on every side—the Moabites, the Ammonites, the Edomites, the kings of Zobah, and the Philistines. Wherever he turned, he routed them.
aov_text: SO het Saul dan die koningskap oor Israel verkry en oorlog gevoer rondom teen al sy vyande: teen Moab en teen die kinders van Ammon en teen Edom en teen die konings van Soba en teen die Filistyne; en oral waarheen hy hom gewend het, het hy straf geoefen.

kjv_text: And he gathered an host, and smote the Amalekites, and delivered Israel out of the hands of them that spoiled them.
bsb_text: He fought valiantly and defeated the Amalekites, delivering Israel from the hands of its plunderers.
aov_text: En hy het hom dapper gedra: hy het Ámalek verslaan en Israel gered uit die hand van sy berower.

kjv_text: Now the sons of Saul were Jonathan, and Ishui, and Melchishua: and the names of his two daughters were these; the name of the firstborn Merab, and the name of the younger Michal:
bsb_text: Now the sons of Saul were Jonathan, Ishvi, and Malchishua. His two daughters were named Merab (his firstborn) and Michal (his younger daughter).
aov_text: En die seuns van Saul was Jónatan en Jiswi en Malkisúa, en die naam van sy twee dogters: die naam van die oudste was Merab, en die naam van die jongste Migal.

kjv_text: And the name of Saul's wife was Ahinoam, the daughter of Ahimaaz: and the name of the captain of his host was Abner, the son of Ner, Saul's uncle.
bsb_text: His wife’s name was Ahinoam daughter of Ahimaaz. The name of the commander of his army was Abner, the son of Saul’s uncle Ner.
aov_text: En die naam van Saul se vrou was Ahínoam, ’n dogter van Ahímaäs; en die naam van sy leërowerste was Abner, die seun van Ner, die oom van Saul.

kjv_text: And Kish was the father of Saul; and Ner the father of Abner was the son of Abiel.
bsb_text: Saul’s father Kish and Abner’s father Ner were sons of Abiel.
aov_text: En Kis was die vader van Saul, en Ner, die vader van Abner, was die seun van Abíël.

kjv_text: And there was sore war against the Philistines all the days of Saul: and when Saul saw any strong man, or any valiant man, he took him unto him.
bsb_text: And the war with the Philistines was fierce for all the days of Saul. So whenever he noticed any strong or brave man, Saul would enlist him.
aov_text: Die oorlog teen die Filistyne was hewig al die dae van Saul; en waar Saul ook ’n held of ’n dapper man sien, het hy hom by hom opgeneem.

kjv_text: Samuel also said unto Saul, The LORD sent me to anoint thee to be king over his people, over Israel: now therefore hearken thou unto the voice of the words of the LORD.
bsb_text: Then Samuel said to Saul, “The LORD sent me to anoint you king over His people Israel. Now therefore, listen to the words of the LORD.
aov_text: TOE sê Samuel vir Saul: Die HERE het my gestuur om jou as koning te salf oor sy volk, oor Israel; luister dan nou na die stem van die woorde van die HERE.

kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I remember that which Amalek did to Israel, how he laid wait for him in the way, when he came up from Egypt.
bsb_text: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘I witnessed what the Amalekites did to the Israelites when they ambushed them on their way up from Egypt.
aov_text: So sê die HERE van die leërskare: Ek het terdeë gelet op wat Ámalek Israel aangedoen het, dat hy hom in die weg gestaan het by sy optog uit Egipte.

kjv_text: Now go and smite Amalek, and utterly destroy all that they have, and spare them not; but slay both man and woman, infant and suckling, ox and sheep, camel and ass.
bsb_text: Now go and attack the Amalekites and devote to destruction all that belongs to them. Do not spare them, but put to death men and women, children and infants, oxen and sheep, camels and donkeys.’”
aov_text: Gaan nou en verslaan Ámalek, en julle moet met die banvloek tref alles wat hy het; en jy mag hom nie verskoon nie, maar jy moet om die lewe bring man sowel as vrou, kind en suigling, bees en kleinvee, kameel en esel.

kjv_text: And Saul gathered the people together, and numbered them in Telaim, two hundred thousand footmen, and ten thousand men of Judah.
bsb_text: So Saul summoned the troops and numbered them at Telaim—200,000 foot soldiers and 10,000 men of Judah.
aov_text: Daarop het Saul die manskappe opgeroep en hulle gemonster in Teláim: tweehonderdduisend voetgangers en tienduisend man van Juda.

kjv_text: And Saul came to a city of Amalek, and laid wait in the valley.
bsb_text: Saul came to the city of Amalek and lay in wait in the valley.
aov_text: En toe Saul by die stad van Ámalek aankom en in die dal ’n hinderlaag opstel,

kjv_text: And Saul said unto the Kenites, Go, depart, get you down from among the Amalekites, lest I destroy you with them: for ye shewed kindness to all the children of Israel, when they came up out of Egypt. So the Kenites departed from among the Amalekites.
bsb_text: And he warned the Kenites, “Since you showed kindness to all the Israelites when they came up out of Egypt, go on and get away from the Amalekites. Otherwise I will sweep you away with them.” So the Kenites moved away from the Amalekites.
aov_text: sê Saul vir die Keniete: Gaan weg, verwyder julle, trek af onder die Amalekiete uit, dat ek julle nie met hulle saam wegruim nie; want julle het guns bewys aan al die kinders van Israel by hulle optog uit Egipte. Toe het die Keniete hulle verwyder onder die Amalekiete uit.

kjv_text: And Saul smote the Amalekites from Havilah until thou comest to Shur, that is over against Egypt.
bsb_text: Then Saul struck down the Amalekites all the way from Havilah to Shur, which is east of Egypt.
aov_text: En Saul het die Amalekiete verslaan van Hawíla af in die rigting van Sur wat oos van Egipte lê.

kjv_text: And he took Agag the king of the Amalekites alive, and utterly destroyed all the people with the edge of the sword.
bsb_text: He captured Agag king of Amalek alive, but devoted all the others to destruction with the sword.
aov_text: En Agag, die koning van Ámalek, het hy lewendig gevang, maar die hele volk deur die skerpte van die swaard met die banvloek getref.

kjv_text: But Saul and the people spared Agag, and the best of the sheep, and of the oxen, and of the fatlings, and the lambs, and all that was good, and would not utterly destroy them: but every thing that was vile and refuse, that they destroyed utterly.
bsb_text: Saul and his troops spared Agag, along with the best of the sheep and cattle, the fat calves and lambs, and the best of everything else. They were unwilling to destroy them, but they devoted to destruction all that was despised and worthless.
aov_text: Maar Saul en die manskappe het Agag gespaar, en die beste van die kleinvee en beeste, en die naas-bestes en die lammers en alles wat van waarde was—dit wou hulle nie met die banvloek tref nie; maar al die goed wat veragtelik en vervalle was, dit het hulle met die banvloek getref.

kjv_text: Then came the word of the LORD unto Samuel, saying,
bsb_text: Then the word of the LORD came to Samuel, saying,
aov_text: En die woord van die HERE het tot Samuel gekom en gesê:

kjv_text: It repenteth me that I have set up Saul to be king: for he is turned back from following me, and hath not performed my commandments. And it grieved Samuel; and he cried unto the LORD all night.
bsb_text: “I regret that I have made Saul king, for he has turned away from following Me and has not carried out My instructions.” And Samuel was distressed and cried out to the LORD all that night.
aov_text: Ek het berou gekry dat Ek Saul koning gemaak het, want hy het van My afvallig geword en my woorde nie uitgevoer nie. Toe het Samuel kwaad geword en die hele nag deur die HERE aangeroep.

kjv_text: And when Samuel rose early to meet Saul in the morning, it was told Samuel, saying, Saul came to Carmel, and, behold, he set him up a place, and is gone about, and passed on, and gone down to Gilgal.
bsb_text: Early in the morning Samuel got up to confront Saul, but he was told, “Saul has gone to Carmel, and behold, he has set up a monument for himself and has turned and gone down to Gilgal.”
aov_text: Maar die môre vroeg het Samuel hom klaargemaak om Saul te ontmoet. En aan Samuel is meegedeel en gesê: Saul het in Karmel aangekom, en kyk, hy het vir hom ’n gedenkteken opgerig; en hy het weggedraai en verbygegaan en afgetrek na Gilgal.

kjv_text: And Samuel came to Saul: and Saul said unto him, Blessed be thou of the LORD: I have performed the commandment of the LORD.
bsb_text: When Samuel reached him, Saul said to him, “May the LORD bless you. I have carried out the LORD’s instructions.”
aov_text: Toe Samuel by Saul kom, sê Saul vir hom: Mag u geseënd wees deur die HERE: ek het die woord van die HERE uitgevoer.

kjv_text: And Samuel said, What meaneth then this bleating of the sheep in mine ears, and the lowing of the oxen which I hear?
bsb_text: But Samuel replied, “Then what is this bleating of sheep and lowing of cattle that I hear?”
aov_text: Daarop vra Samuel: Maar wat vir ’n geblêr van kleinvee is dit in my ore en ’n gebulk van beeste wat ek hoor?

kjv_text: And Saul said, They have brought them from the Amalekites: for the people spared the best of the sheep and of the oxen, to sacrifice unto the LORD thy God; and the rest we have utterly destroyed.
bsb_text: Saul answered, “The troops brought them from the Amalekites; they spared the best sheep and cattle to sacrifice to the LORD your God, but the rest we devoted to destruction.”
aov_text: En Saul sê: Van die Amalekiete het hulle dit gebring, want die manskappe het die beste kleinvee en beeste gespaar om aan die HERE u God te offer; maar die ander het ons met die banvloek getref.

kjv_text: Then Samuel said unto Saul, Stay, and I will tell thee what the LORD hath said to me this night. And he said unto him, Say on.
bsb_text: “Stop!” exclaimed Samuel. “Let me tell you what the LORD said to me last night.” “Tell me,” Saul replied.
aov_text: Toe sê Samuel vir Saul: Hou op, dat ek jou kan meedeel wat die HERE vannag met my gespreek het. En hy antwoord hom: Spreek.

kjv_text: And Samuel said, When thou wast little in thine own sight, wast thou not made the head of the tribes of Israel, and the LORD anointed thee king over Israel?
bsb_text: And Samuel said, “Although you were once small in your own eyes, have you not become the head of the tribes of Israel? The LORD anointed you king over Israel
aov_text: En Samuel sê: Is jy, hoewel jy klein was in jou eie oë, nie tog die hoof van die stamme van Israel nie? En die HERE het jou as koning oor Israel gesalf.

kjv_text: And the LORD sent thee on a journey, and said, Go and utterly destroy the sinners the Amalekites, and fight against them until they be consumed.
bsb_text: and sent you on a mission, saying, ‘Go and devote to destruction the sinful Amalekites. Fight against them until you have wiped them out.’
aov_text: En die HERE het jou op die pad gestuur en gesê: Gaan heen en tref die sondaars, die Amalekiete, met die banvloek en veg teen hulle totdat hulle vernietig is.

kjv_text: Wherefore then didst thou not obey the voice of the LORD, but didst fly upon the spoil, and didst evil in the sight of the LORD?
bsb_text: So why did you not obey the LORD? Why did you rush upon the plunder and do evil in the sight of the LORD?”
aov_text: Waarom het jy dan nie na die stem van die HERE geluister nie en op die buit afgestorm en gedoen wat verkeerd is in die oë van die HERE?

kjv_text: And Saul said unto Samuel, Yea, I have obeyed the voice of the LORD, and have gone the way which the LORD sent me, and have brought Agag the king of Amalek, and have utterly destroyed the Amalekites.
bsb_text: “But I did obey the LORD,” Saul replied. “I went on the mission that the LORD gave me. I brought back Agag king of Amalek and devoted the Amalekites to destruction.
aov_text: Toe sê Saul vir Samuel: Ek het na die stem van die HERE geluister en gegaan op die pad waar die HERE my op gestuur het, en Agag, die koning van Ámalek, gebring; maar die Amalekiete het ek met die banvloek getref.

kjv_text: But the people took of the spoil, sheep and oxen, the chief of the things which should have been utterly destroyed, to sacrifice unto the LORD thy God in Gilgal.
bsb_text: The troops took sheep and cattle from the plunder, the best of the things devoted to destruction, in order to sacrifice them to the LORD your God at Gilgal.”
aov_text: Maar die manskappe het van die buit kleinvee en beeste geneem, die beste van die bangoed, om aan die HERE u God in Gilgal te offer.

kjv_text: And Samuel said, Hath the LORD as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, as in obeying the voice of the LORD? Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to hearken than the fat of rams.
bsb_text: But Samuel declared: “Does the LORD delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices as much as in obedience to His voice? Behold, obedience is better than sacrifice, and attentiveness is better than the fat of rams.
aov_text: Daarop sê Samuel: Het die HERE behae in brandoffers en slagoffers soos in gehoorsaamheid aan die stem van die HERE? Kyk, om gehoorsaam te wees is beter as slagoffer, om te luister beter as die vet van ramme.

kjv_text: For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is as iniquity and idolatry. Because thou hast rejected the word of the LORD, he hath also rejected thee from being king.
bsb_text: For rebellion is like the sin of divination, and arrogance is like the wickedness of idolatry. Because you have rejected the word of the LORD, He has rejected you as king.”
aov_text: Want wederstrewigheid is ’n sonde van waarsêery, en eiesinnigheid is afgodery en beeldediens. Omdat jy die woord van die HERE verwerp het, het Hy jou as koning verwerp.

kjv_text: And Saul said unto Samuel, I have sinned: for I have transgressed the commandment of the LORD, and thy words: because I feared the people, and obeyed their voice.
bsb_text: Then Saul said to Samuel, “I have sinned; I have transgressed the LORD’s commandment and your instructions, because I feared the people and obeyed their voice.
aov_text: Toe sê Saul vir Samuel: Ek het gesondig, omdat ek die bevel van die HERE en u woorde oortree het, want ek was bevrees vir die manskappe en het na hulle geluister.

kjv_text: Now therefore, I pray thee, pardon my sin, and turn again with me, that I may worship the LORD.
bsb_text: Now therefore, please forgive my sin and return with me so I can worship the LORD.”
aov_text: Vergeef dan nou tog my sonde en kom met my saam terug, dat ek die HERE kan aanbid.

kjv_text: And Samuel said unto Saul, I will not return with thee: for thou hast rejected the word of the LORD, and the LORD hath rejected thee from being king over Israel.
bsb_text: “I will not return with you,” Samuel replied. “For you have rejected the word of the LORD, and He has rejected you as king over Israel.”
aov_text: Maar Samuel sê vir Saul: Ek sal nie met jou saam teruggaan nie, omdat jy die woord van die HERE verwerp het, en nou het die HERE jou verwerp om koning oor Israel te wees.

kjv_text: And as Samuel turned about to go away, he laid hold upon the skirt of his mantle, and it rent.
bsb_text: As Samuel turned to go, Saul grabbed the hem of his robe, and it tore.
aov_text: Toe Samuel hom omdraai om weg te gaan, gryp hy die slip van sy mantel, maar dit het afgeskeur.

kjv_text: And Samuel said unto him, The LORD hath rent the kingdom of Israel from thee this day, and hath given it to a neighbour of thine, that is better than thou.
bsb_text: So Samuel said to him, “The LORD has torn the kingdom of Israel from you today and has given it to your neighbor who is better than you.
aov_text: En Samuel sê vir hom: Vandag het die HERE die koningskap oor Israel van jou afgeskeur en dit aan jou naaste gegee wat beter is as jy.

kjv_text: And also the Strength of Israel will not lie nor repent: for he is not a man, that he should repent.
bsb_text: Moreover, the Glory of Israel does not lie or change His mind, for He is not a man, that He should change His mind.”
aov_text: En ook lieg die Roem van Israel nie, en Hy ken geen berou nie; want Hy is geen mens, dat Hy berou sou hê nie.

kjv_text: Then he said, I have sinned: yet honour me now, I pray thee, before the elders of my people, and before Israel, and turn again with me, that I may worship the LORD thy God.
bsb_text: “I have sinned,” Saul replied. “Please honor me now before the elders of my people and before Israel. Come back with me, so that I may worship the LORD your God.”
aov_text: En hy sê: Ek het gesondig; eer my tog nou voor die oudstes van my volk en voor Israel, en kom saam met my terug, dat ek die HERE u God kan aanbid.

kjv_text: So Samuel turned again after Saul; and Saul worshipped the LORD.
bsb_text: So Samuel went back with Saul, and Saul worshiped the LORD.
aov_text: Samuel het toe teruggegaan agter Saul aan, en Saul het die HERE aanbid.

kjv_text: Then said Samuel, Bring ye hither to me Agag the king of the Amalekites. And Agag came unto him delicately. And Agag said, Surely the bitterness of death is past.
bsb_text: Then Samuel said, “Bring me Agag king of the Amalekites.” Agag came to him cheerfully, for he thought, “Surely the bitterness of death is past.”
aov_text: Daarop sê Samuel: Bring Agag, die koning van Ámalek, na my toe. Terwyl Agag dan opgeruimd na hom gaan, sê Agag: Waarlik, die bitterheid van die dood het gewyk.

kjv_text: And Samuel said, As thy sword hath made women childless, so shall thy mother be childless among women. And Samuel hewed Agag in pieces before the LORD in Gilgal.
bsb_text: But Samuel declared: “As your sword has made women childless, so your mother will be childless among women.” And Samuel hacked Agag to pieces before the LORD at Gilgal.
aov_text: Maar Samuel het gesê: Soos jou swaard vroue kinderloos gemaak het, so sal jou moeder onder die vroue kinderloos wees. Daarop het Samuel Agag in stukke gekap voor die aangesig van die HERE in Gilgal.

kjv_text: Then Samuel went to Ramah; and Saul went up to his house to Gibeah of Saul.
bsb_text: Then Samuel went to Ramah, but Saul went up to his home in Gibeah of Saul.
aov_text: Daarna gaan Samuel na Rama, en Saul het opgegaan na sy huis, na Gíbea van Saul.

kjv_text: And Samuel came no more to see Saul until the day of his death: nevertheless Samuel mourned for Saul: and the LORD repented that he had made Saul king over Israel.
bsb_text: And to the day of his death, Samuel never again visited Saul. Samuel mourned for Saul, and the LORD regretted that He had made Saul king over Israel.
aov_text: En Samuel het Saul tot die dag van sy dood nie meer gesien nie, want Samuel het getreur oor Saul; en die HERE het berou gehad dat Hy Saul koning gemaak het oor Israel.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Samuel, How long wilt thou mourn for Saul, seeing I have rejected him from reigning over Israel? fill thine horn with oil, and go, I will send thee to Jesse the Bethlehemite: for I have provided me a king among his sons.
bsb_text: Now the LORD said to Samuel, “How long are you going to mourn for Saul, since I have rejected him as king over Israel? Fill your horn with oil and go. I am sending you to Jesse of Bethlehem, for I have selected from his sons a king for Myself.”
aov_text: DAARNA sê die HERE aan Samuel: Hoe lank sal jy treur oor Saul, terwyl Ek hom verwerp het om koning te wees oor Israel? Vul jou horing met olie en gaan heen: Ek stuur jou na Ísai, die Betlehemiet, want Ek het onder sy seuns vir My ’n koning uitgesoek.

kjv_text: And Samuel said, How can I go? if Saul hear it, he will kill me. And the LORD said, Take an heifer with thee, and say, I am come to sacrifice to the LORD.
bsb_text: “How can I go?” Samuel asked. “Saul will hear of it and kill me!” The LORD answered, “Take a heifer with you and say, ‘I have come to sacrifice to the LORD.’
aov_text: Maar Samuel vra: Hoe kan ek gaan? As Saul dit hoor, sal hy my doodmaak. Toe sê die HERE: Neem ’n jong koei met jou saam en sê: Ek kom om aan die HERE te offer.

kjv_text: And call Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will shew thee what thou shalt do: and thou shalt anoint unto me him whom I name unto thee.
bsb_text: Then invite Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will show you what you are to do. You are to anoint for Me the one I indicate.”
aov_text: Nooi Ísai dan na die offermaaltyd, en Ek sal jou bekend maak wat jy moet doen, en jy moet die een vir My salf wat Ek jou sal noem.

kjv_text: And Samuel did that which the LORD spake, and came to Bethlehem. And the elders of the town trembled at his coming, and said, Comest thou peaceably?
bsb_text: So Samuel did what the LORD had said and went to Bethlehem. When the elders of the town met him, they trembled and asked, “Do you come in peace?”
aov_text: En Samuel het gedoen wat die HERE gespreek het; en toe hy by Betlehem aankom, het die oudstes van die stad hom bewend tegemoetgegaan en gevra: Is u koms vrede?

kjv_text: And he said, Peaceably: I am come to sacrifice unto the LORD: sanctify yourselves, and come with me to the sacrifice. And he sanctified Jesse and his sons, and called them to the sacrifice.
bsb_text: “In peace,” he replied. “I have come to sacrifice to the LORD. Consecrate yourselves and come with me to the sacrifice.” Then he consecrated Jesse and his sons and invited them to the sacrifice.
aov_text: En hy sê: Vrede! Ek kom om aan die HERE te offer; heilig julle, en kom met my saam aan die offermaaltyd. En hy het Ísai en sy seuns geheilig en hulle na die offermaaltyd genooi.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when they were come, that he looked on Eliab, and said, Surely the LORD's anointed is before him.
bsb_text: When they arrived, Samuel saw Eliab and said, “Surely here before the LORD is His anointed.”
aov_text: Toe hulle inkom en hy Elíab sien, dink hy: Gewis, hier staan voor die HERE sy gesalfde!

kjv_text: But the LORD said unto Samuel, Look not on his countenance, or on the height of his stature; because I have refused him: for the LORD seeth not as man seeth; for man looketh on the outward appearance, but the LORD looketh on the heart.
bsb_text: But the LORD said to Samuel, “Do not consider his appearance or height, for I have rejected him; the LORD does not see as man does. For man sees the outward appearance, but the LORD sees the heart.”
aov_text: Maar die HERE sê vir Samuel: Kyk nie na sy voorkoms en sy hoë gestalte nie, want Ek ag hom te gering. Want nie wat die méns sien, sien God nie; want die mens sien aan wat voor oë is, maar die HERE sien die hart aan.

kjv_text: Then Jesse called Abinadab, and made him pass before Samuel. And he said, Neither hath the LORD chosen this.
bsb_text: Then Jesse called Abinadab and presented him to Samuel, who said, “The LORD has not chosen this one either.”
aov_text: Toe roep Ísai Abinádab en laat hom voor Samuel verbygaan. Maar hy sê: Hierdie een het die HERE ook nie uitgekies nie.

kjv_text: Then Jesse made Shammah to pass by. And he said, Neither hath the LORD chosen this.
bsb_text: Next Jesse presented Shammah, but Samuel said, “The LORD has not chosen this one either.”
aov_text: Verder het Ísai Samma laat verbygaan. Maar hy sê: Hierdie een het die HERE ook nie uitgekies nie.

kjv_text: Again, Jesse made seven of his sons to pass before Samuel. And Samuel said unto Jesse, The LORD hath not chosen these.
bsb_text: Thus Jesse made seven of his sons pass before Samuel, but Samuel told him, “The LORD has not chosen any of these.”
aov_text: So het Ísai dan sy sewe seuns voor Samuel laat verbygaan, maar Samuel het aan Ísai gesê: Die HERE het hulle nie uitgekies nie.

kjv_text: And Samuel said unto Jesse, Are here all thy children? And he said, There remaineth yet the youngest, and, behold, he keepeth the sheep. And Samuel said unto Jesse, Send and fetch him: for we will not sit down till he come hither.
bsb_text: And Samuel asked him, “Are these all the sons you have?” “There is still the youngest,” Jesse replied, “but he is tending the sheep.” “Send for him,” Samuel replied. “For we will not sit down to eat until he arrives.”
aov_text: Verder het Samuel aan Ísai gevra: Is dit al die seuns? En hy sê: Die kleinste is nog oor, en kyk, hy pas skape op. Toe sê Samuel aan Ísai: Stuur en laat hom haal, want ons mag nie om die tafel gaan sit voordat hy hier kom nie.

kjv_text: And he sent, and brought him in. Now he was ruddy, and withal of a beautiful countenance, and goodly to look to. And the LORD said, Arise, anoint him: for this is he.
bsb_text: So Jesse sent for his youngest son and brought him in. He was ruddy, with beautiful eyes and a handsome appearance. And the LORD said, “Rise and anoint him, for he is the one.”
aov_text: Daarop het hy gestuur en hom laat kom; en hy was rooierig, met mooi oë en ’n mooi voorkoms. En die HERE sê: Staan op, salf hom, want dit is hy.

kjv_text: Then Samuel took the horn of oil, and anointed him in the midst of his brethren: and the Spirit of the LORD came upon David from that day forward. So Samuel rose up, and went to Ramah.
bsb_text: So Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him in the presence of his brothers, and the Spirit of the LORD rushed upon David from that day forward. Then Samuel set out and went to Ramah.
aov_text: Samuel neem toe die horing met olie en salf hom te midde van sy broers, en die Gees van die HERE het van dié dag af en verder oor Dawid vaardig geword. En Samuel het klaargemaak en na Rama gegaan.

kjv_text: But the Spirit of the LORD departed from Saul, and an evil spirit from the LORD troubled him.
bsb_text: After the Spirit of the LORD had departed from Saul, a spirit of distress from the LORD began to torment him.
aov_text: MAAR die Gees van die HERE het van Saul gewyk, en ’n bose gees, deur die HERE gestuur, het hom verskrik.

kjv_text: And Saul's servants said unto him, Behold now, an evil spirit from God troubleth thee.
bsb_text: Saul’s servants said to him, “Surely a spirit of distress from God is tormenting you.
aov_text: Toe sê die dienaars van Saul vir hom: Kyk tog, ’n bose gees van God verskrik u:

kjv_text: Let our lord now command thy servants, which are before thee, to seek out a man, who is a cunning player on an harp: and it shall come to pass, when the evil spirit from God is upon thee, that he shall play with his hand, and thou shalt be well.
bsb_text: Let our lord command your servants here to seek out someone who can skillfully play the harp. Whenever the spirit of distress from God is upon you, he is to play it, and you will be well.”
aov_text: laat ons heer net sê, en u dienaars wat voor u staan, sal ’n man soek wat op die siter kan speel; en as die bose gees van God oor u is, moet hy speel met sy hand, dan sal dit beter met u word.

kjv_text: And Saul said unto his servants, Provide me now a man that can play well, and bring him to me.
bsb_text: And Saul commanded his servants, “Find me someone who plays well, and bring him to me.”
aov_text: Daarop sê Saul aan sy dienaars: Kyk tog vir my uit na ’n man wat goed kan speel, en bring hom na my.

kjv_text: Then answered one of the servants, and said, Behold, I have seen a son of Jesse the Bethlehemite, that is cunning in playing, and a mighty valiant man, and a man of war, and prudent in matters, and a comely person, and the LORD is with him.
bsb_text: One of the servants answered, “I have seen a son of Jesse of Bethlehem who knows how to play the harp. He is a mighty man of valor, a warrior, eloquent and handsome, and the LORD is with him.”
aov_text: En een van die dienaars antwoord en sê: Kyk, ek het ’n seun van Ísai, die Betlehemiet, gesien wat kan speel, en hy is ’n dapper held en ’n krygsman en wel ter tale en mooi gebou, en die HERE is met hom.

kjv_text: Wherefore Saul sent messengers unto Jesse, and said, Send me David thy son, which is with the sheep.
bsb_text: So Saul sent messengers to Jesse and said, “Send me your son David, who is with the sheep.”
aov_text: Toe het Saul boodskappers na Ísai gestuur en gesê: Stuur tog jou seun Dawid wat by die skape is, na my.

kjv_text: And Jesse took an ass laden with bread, and a bottle of wine, and a kid, and sent them by David his son unto Saul.
bsb_text: And Jesse took a donkey loaded with bread, a skin of wine, and one young goat, and sent them to Saul with his son David.
aov_text: Ísai neem toe ’n esel, brood en ’n leersak met wyn en ’n bokkie en stuur dit met sy seun Dawid na Saul.

kjv_text: And David came to Saul, and stood before him: and he loved him greatly; and he became his armourbearer.
bsb_text: When David came to Saul and entered his service, Saul admired him greatly, and David became his armor-bearer.
aov_text: So het Dawid dan by Saul gekom en voor hom gestaan; en dié het hom baie liefgekry, sodat hy sy wapendraer geword het.

kjv_text: And Saul sent to Jesse, saying, Let David, I pray thee, stand before me; for he hath found favour in my sight.
bsb_text: Then Saul sent word to Jesse, saying, “Let David remain in my service, for I am pleased with him.”
aov_text: Daarna het Saul na Ísai gestuur om te sê: Laat Dawid tog voor my staan, want hy het guns in my oë gevind.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when the evil spirit from God was upon Saul, that David took an harp, and played with his hand: so Saul was refreshed, and was well, and the evil spirit departed from him.
bsb_text: And whenever the spirit from God came upon Saul, David would pick up his harp and play, and Saul would become well, and the spirit of distress would depart from him.
aov_text: En net wanneer daar ’n gees van God oor Saul kom, neem Dawid die siter en speel met sy hand; dan voel Saul verlig en word beter, en die bose gees wyk van hom.

kjv_text: Now the Philistines gathered together their armies to battle, and were gathered together at Shochoh, which belongeth to Judah, and pitched between Shochoh and Azekah, in Ephesdammim.
bsb_text: Now the Philistines gathered their forces for war at Socoh in Judah, and they camped between Socoh and Azekah in Ephes-dammim.
aov_text: EN die Filistyne het hulle leër versamel vir die oorlog en bymekaargekom by Sogo wat aan Juda behoort, en laer opgeslaan tussen Sogo en Aséka in Efes-Dammim.

kjv_text: And Saul and the men of Israel were gathered together, and pitched by the valley of Elah, and set the battle in array against the Philistines.
bsb_text: Saul and the men of Israel assembled and camped in the Valley of Elah, arraying themselves for battle against the Philistines.
aov_text: Maar Saul en die manne van Israel het byeengekom en laer opgeslaan in die dal van die terpentynboom en hulle in slagorde teenoor die Filistyne opgestel.

kjv_text: And the Philistines stood on a mountain on the one side, and Israel stood on a mountain on the other side: and there was a valley between them.
bsb_text: The Philistines stood on one hill and the Israelites stood on another, with the valley between them.
aov_text: En die Filistyne het duskant teen die berg en die Israeliete oorkant teen die berg gestaan, sodat die dal tussen hulle in was.

kjv_text: And there went out a champion out of the camp of the Philistines, named Goliath, of Gath, whose height was six cubits and a span.
bsb_text: Then a champion named Goliath, who was from Gath, came out from the Philistine camp. He was six cubits and a span in height,
aov_text: Toe kom daar ’n baasvegter uit die laers van die Filistyne, met die naam van Góliat, uit Gat; sy hoogte was ses el en ’n span.

kjv_text: And he had an helmet of brass upon his head, and he was armed with a coat of mail; and the weight of the coat was five thousand shekels of brass.
bsb_text: and he had a bronze helmet on his head. He wore a bronze coat of mail weighing five thousand shekels,
aov_text: Daar was ’n koperhelm op sy hoof, en hy het ’n pantser van skubbe aangehad—die gewig van die pantser was vyfduisend sikkels koper —

kjv_text: And he had greaves of brass upon his legs, and a target of brass between his shoulders.
bsb_text: and he had armor of bronze on his legs and a javelin of bronze slung between his shoulders.
aov_text: en skeenplate van koper was aan sy bene en ’n koperlans tussen sy skouers.

kjv_text: And the staff of his spear was like a weaver's beam; and his spear's head weighed six hundred shekels of iron: and one bearing a shield went before him.
bsb_text: The shaft of his spear was like a weaver’s beam, and its iron point weighed six hundred shekels. In addition, his shield bearer went before him.
aov_text: Die steel van sy spies was soos ’n wewersbalk, en die lem van sy spies was van seshonderd sikkels yster, en die skilddraer het voor hom uit geloop.

kjv_text: And he stood and cried unto the armies of Israel, and said unto them, Why are ye come out to set your battle in array? am not I a Philistine, and ye servants to Saul? choose you a man for you, and let him come down to me.
bsb_text: And Goliath stood and shouted to the ranks of Israel, “Why do you come out and array yourselves for battle? Am I not a Philistine, and are you not servants of Saul? Choose one of your men and have him come down against me.
aov_text: En hy het gaan staan en roep na die slagordes van Israel en vir hulle gesê: Waarom trek julle uit om jul in slagorde op te stel? Is ek nie die Filistyn, en julle dienaars van Saul nie? Kies vir julle ’n man uit, dat hy na my toe afkom.

kjv_text: If he be able to fight with me, and to kill me, then will we be your servants: but if I prevail against him, and kill him, then shall ye be our servants, and serve us.
bsb_text: If he is able to fight me and kill me, then we will be your servants. But if I prevail against him and kill him, then you shall be our servants and labor for us.”
aov_text: As hy teen my kan veg en my verslaan, sal ons julle slawe wees; maar as ek hom oorwin en hom verslaan, moet julle ons slawe wees en ons dien.

kjv_text: And the Philistine said, I defy the armies of Israel this day; give me a man, that we may fight together.
bsb_text: Then the Philistine said, “I defy the ranks of Israel this day! Give me a man to fight!”
aov_text: Verder sê die Filistyn: Ek daag die slagordes van Israel vandag uit! Gee my ’n man, dat ons saam kan veg.

kjv_text: When Saul and all Israel heard those words of the Philistine, they were dismayed, and greatly afraid.
bsb_text: On hearing the words of the Philistine, Saul and all the Israelites were dismayed and greatly afraid.
aov_text: Toe Saul en die hele Israel hierdie woorde van die Filistyn hoor, was hulle verskrik en baie bevrees.

kjv_text: Now David was the son of that Ephrathite of Bethlehemjudah, whose name was Jesse; and he had eight sons: and the man went among men for an old man in the days of Saul.
bsb_text: Now David was the son of a man named Jesse, an Ephrathite from Bethlehem of Judah who had eight sons in the days of Saul. And Jesse was old and well along in years.
aov_text: En Dawid was die seun van dié Efratiet, uit Betlehem-Juda, met die naam van Ísai; hy het agt seuns gehad, en die man was in Saul se dae oud, op jare gekom onder die manne.

kjv_text: And the three eldest sons of Jesse went and followed Saul to the battle: and the names of his three sons that went to the battle were Eliab the firstborn, and next unto him Abinadab, and the third Shammah.
bsb_text: The three older sons of Jesse had followed Saul into battle: The firstborn was Eliab, the second was Abinadab, and the third was Shammah.
aov_text: Maar die drie oudste seuns van Ísai het Saul al in die oorlog gevolg; en die name van sy drie seuns wat in die oorlog gegaan het, was: Elíab, die oudste, en sy tweede, Abinádab, en die derde, Samma.

kjv_text: And David was the youngest: and the three eldest followed Saul.
bsb_text: And David was the youngest. The three oldest had followed Saul,
aov_text: Dawid was die jongste, terwyl die drie oudstes Saul gevolg het.

kjv_text: But David went and returned from Saul to feed his father's sheep at Bethlehem.
bsb_text: but David went back and forth from Saul to tend his father’s sheep in Bethlehem.
aov_text: En Dawid het heen en weer gegaan van Saul om die kleinvee van sy vader in Betlehem op te pas.

kjv_text: And the Philistine drew near morning and evening, and presented himself forty days.
bsb_text: For forty days the Philistine came forward every morning and evening to take his stand.
aov_text: En die Filistyn het smôrens vroeg en saans nader gekom en gaan staan, veertig dae lank.

kjv_text: And Jesse said unto David his son, Take now for thy brethren an ephah of this parched corn, and these ten loaves, and run to the camp to thy brethren.
bsb_text: One day Jesse said to his son David, “Take this ephah of roasted grain and these ten loaves of bread for your brothers and hurry to their camp.
aov_text: Toe het Ísai aan sy seun Dawid gesê: Neem tog vir jou broers ’n efa van hierdie gebraaide koring en hierdie tien brode, en bring dit gou vir jou broers na die laer toe.

kjv_text: And carry these ten cheeses unto the captain of their thousand, and look how thy brethren fare, and take their pledge.
bsb_text: Take also these ten portions of cheese to the commander of their unit. Check on the welfare of your brothers and bring back an assurance from them.
aov_text: Maar hierdie tien skywe kaas moet jy bring na die owerste oor duisend, en jy moet ondersoek doen na die welstand van jou broers en van hulle ’n pand saambring.

kjv_text: Now Saul, and they, and all the men of Israel, were in the valley of Elah, fighting with the Philistines.
bsb_text: They are with Saul and all the men of Israel in the Valley of Elah, fighting against the Philistines.”
aov_text: En Saul en hulle en al die manne van Israel was besig om te veg teen die Filistyne in die dal van die terpentynboom.

kjv_text: And David rose up early in the morning, and left the sheep with a keeper, and took, and went, as Jesse had commanded him; and he came to the trench, as the host was going forth to the fight, and shouted for the battle.
bsb_text: So David got up early in the morning, left the flock with a keeper, loaded up, and set out as Jesse had instructed him. He reached the camp as the army was marching out to its position and shouting the battle cry.
aov_text: En die volgende môre vroeg het Dawid hom klaargemaak: die kleinvee aan die wagter afgegee en opgelaai en weggegaan soos Ísai hom beveel het. En toe hy by die wa-laer kom, hef die leërmag wat na die vegterrein uittrek, juis die krygsgeskreeu aan.

kjv_text: For Israel and the Philistines had put the battle in array, army against army.
bsb_text: And Israel and the Philistines arrayed in formation against each other.
aov_text: Israel sowel as die Filistyne het slagorde teenoor slagorde opgestel.

kjv_text: And David left his carriage in the hand of the keeper of the carriage, and ran into the army, and came and saluted his brethren.
bsb_text: Then David left his supplies in the care of the quartermaster and ran to the battle line. When he arrived, he asked his brothers how they were doing.
aov_text: Daarop gee Dawid sy pakgoed af onder bewaring van die oppasser van die pakgoed, en hy hardloop na die vegterrein. Toe hy daar aankom, vra hy sy broers na die welstand.

kjv_text: And as he talked with them, behold, there came up the champion, the Philistine of Gath, Goliath by name, out of the armies of the Philistines, and spake according to the same words: and David heard them.
bsb_text: And as he was speaking with them, suddenly the champion named Goliath, the Philistine from Gath, came forward from the Philistines and shouted his usual words, which David also heard.
aov_text: En terwyl hy met hulle spreek, kom juis die baasvegter—Góliat is sy naam, die Filistyn uit Gat—uit die slagordes van die Filistyne op en spreek daardie selfde woorde, sodat Dawid dit hoor.

kjv_text: And all the men of Israel, when they saw the man, fled from him, and were sore afraid.
bsb_text: When all the men of Israel saw Goliath, they fled from him in great fear.
aov_text: Maar toe al die manne van Israel die man sien, vlug hulle vir hom weg, want hulle was baie bang.

kjv_text: And the men of Israel said, Have ye seen this man that is come up? surely to defy Israel is he come up: and it shall be, that the man who killeth him, the king will enrich him with great riches, and will give him his daughter, and make his father's house free in Israel.
bsb_text: Now the men of Israel had been saying, “Do you see this man who keeps coming out to defy Israel? To the man who kills him the king will give great riches. And he will give him his daughter in marriage and exempt his father’s house from taxation in Israel.”
aov_text: En die manne van Israel sê: Het julle die man gesien wat daar opkom? Want hy kom op om Israel uit te daag. En die koning sal die man wat hom verslaan, oorlaai met groot rykdom; ook sal hy sy dogter aan hom gee en sy familie in Israel vrystel van belasting.

kjv_text: And David spake to the men that stood by him, saying, What shall be done to the man that killeth this Philistine, and taketh away the reproach from Israel? for who is this uncircumcised Philistine, that he should defy the armies of the living God?
bsb_text: David asked the men who were standing with him, “What will be done for the man who kills this Philistine and removes this disgrace from Israel? Just who is this uncircumcised Philistine, that he should defy the armies of the living God?”
aov_text: Daarop het Dawid die manne wat by hom staan, gevra en gesê: Wat sal met die man gebeur wat hierdie Filistyn verslaan en die smaad van Israel wegneem? Want wie is hierdie onbesnede Filistyn, dat hy die slagordes van die lewende God durf uitdaag?

kjv_text: And the people answered him after this manner, saying, So shall it be done to the man that killeth him.
bsb_text: The people told him about the offer, saying, “That is what will be done for the man who kills him.”
aov_text: En die manskappe gee hom dieselfde antwoord: Só sal met die man gebeur wat hom verslaan.

kjv_text: And Eliab his eldest brother heard when he spake unto the men; and Eliab's anger was kindled against David, and he said, Why camest thou down hither? and with whom hast thou left those few sheep in the wilderness? I know thy pride, and the naughtiness of thine heart; for thou art come down that thou mightest see the battle.
bsb_text: Now when David’s oldest brother Eliab heard him speaking to the men, his anger burned against David. “Why have you come down here?” he asked. “And with whom did you leave those few sheep in the wilderness? I know your pride and wickedness of heart—you have come down to see the battle!”
aov_text: Toe sy oudste broer Elíab hom met die manne hoor spreek, het Elíab baie kwaad geword vir Dawid en gesê: Waarom het jy eintlik afgekom, en aan wie het jy daardie klompie kleinvee in die woestyn afgegee? Ek ken jou vermetelheid en die boosheid van jou hart, want jy het afgekom om die geveg te sien.

kjv_text: And David said, What have I now done? Is there not a cause?
bsb_text: “What have I done now?” said David. “Was it not just a question?”
aov_text: En Dawid sê: Wat het ek nou gedoen? Ek vra maar net.

kjv_text: And he turned from him toward another, and spake after the same manner: and the people answered him again after the former manner.
bsb_text: Then he turned from him toward another and asked about the offer, and those people answered him just as the first ones had answered.
aov_text: En hy het by hom weggedraai na iemand anders en dieselfde woorde gespreek, en die manskappe het hom geantwoord volgens die eerste woorde.

kjv_text: And when the words were heard which David spake, they rehearsed them before Saul: and he sent for him.
bsb_text: Now David’s words were overheard and reported to Saul, who called for him.
aov_text: Toe hulle die woorde hoor wat Dawid spreek en dit voor Saul meedeel, het dié hom laat haal.

kjv_text: And David said to Saul, Let no man's heart fail because of him; thy servant will go and fight with this Philistine.
bsb_text: And David said to Saul, “Let no man’s heart fail on account of this Philistine. Your servant will go and fight him!”
aov_text: En Dawid het aan Saul gesê: Laat die manne se moed tog nie ter wille van hom sink nie. U dienaar sal gaan en teen hierdie Filistyn veg.

kjv_text: And Saul said to David, Thou art not able to go against this Philistine to fight with him: for thou art but a youth, and he a man of war from his youth.
bsb_text: But Saul replied, “You cannot go out against this Philistine to fight him. You are just a boy, and he has been a warrior from his youth.”
aov_text: Maar Saul het Dawid geantwoord: Jy kan nie na hierdie Filistyn gaan om teen hom te veg nie, want jy is ’n seun, en hy is ’n krygsman van sy jeug af.

kjv_text: And David said unto Saul, Thy servant kept his father's sheep, and there came a lion, and a bear, and took a lamb out of the flock:
bsb_text: David replied, “Your servant has been tending his father’s sheep, and whenever a lion or a bear came and carried off a lamb from the flock,
aov_text: Daarop sê Dawid aan Saul: U dienaar het vir sy vader die kleinvee opgepas, en as daar ’n leeu of ’n beer kom en ’n stuk kleinvee uit die trop wegdra,

kjv_text: And I went out after him, and smote him, and delivered it out of his mouth: and when he arose against me, I caught him by his beard, and smote him, and slew him.
bsb_text: I went after it, struck it down, and delivered the lamb from its mouth. If it reared up against me, I would grab it by its fur, strike it down, and kill it.
aov_text: dan gaan ek uit agter hom aan en verslaan hom en ruk dit uit sy bek uit; en as hy my aanval, gryp ek hom aan sy baard en verslaan hom en maak hom dood.

kjv_text: Thy servant slew both the lion and the bear: and this uncircumcised Philistine shall be as one of them, seeing he hath defied the armies of the living God.
bsb_text: Your servant has killed lions and bears; this uncircumcised Philistine will be like one of them, for he has defied the armies of the living God.”
aov_text: U dienaar het die leeu sowel as die beer doodgeslaan, en met hierdie onbesnede Filistyn sal dit gaan net soos met een van hulle, omdat hy die slagordes van die lewende God uitgedaag het.

kjv_text: David said moreover, The LORD that delivered me out of the paw of the lion, and out of the paw of the bear, he will deliver me out of the hand of this Philistine. And Saul said unto David, Go, and the LORD be with thee.
bsb_text: David added, “The LORD, who delivered me from the claws of the lion and the bear, will deliver me from the hand of this Philistine.” “Go,” said Saul, “and may the LORD be with you.”
aov_text: Verder sê Dawid: Die HERE wat my gered het uit die klou van die leeu en uit die klou van die beer, Hy sal my red uit die hand van hierdie Filistyn. Toe sê Saul vir Dawid: Gaan, en mag die HERE met jou wees!

kjv_text: And Saul armed David with his armour, and he put an helmet of brass upon his head; also he armed him with a coat of mail.
bsb_text: Then Saul clothed David in his own tunic, put a bronze helmet on his head, and dressed him in armor.
aov_text: En Saul het Dawid sy klere laat aantrek en ’n koperhelm op sy hoof gesit en hom ’n pantser laat aantrek.

kjv_text: And David girded his sword upon his armour, and he assayed to go; for he had not proved it. And David said unto Saul, I cannot go with these; for I have not proved them. And David put them off him.
bsb_text: David strapped his sword over the tunic and tried to walk, but he was not accustomed to them. “I cannot walk in these,” David said to Saul. “I am not accustomed to them.” So David took them off.
aov_text: En Dawid het sy swaard bo-oor sy klere vasgegord, en toe hy moeite doen om te loop, omdat hy dit nooit probeer het nie, sê Dawid vir Saul: Ek kan nie hierin loop nie, want ek het dit nooit probeer nie. En Dawid het dit uitgetrek.

kjv_text: And he took his staff in his hand, and chose him five smooth stones out of the brook, and put them in a shepherd's bag which he had, even in a scrip; and his sling was in his hand: and he drew near to the Philistine.
bsb_text: And David took his staff in his hand, selected five smooth stones from the brook, and put them in the pouch of his shepherd’s bag. And with his sling in hand, he approached the Philistine.
aov_text: Daarop neem hy sy staf in sy hand en soek vir hom uit die spruit vyf gladde klippe uit en steek dit in sy herderstas wat hy gehad het, naamlik in die slingersak; en met sy slinger in sy hand het hy nader gekom na die Filistyn.

kjv_text: And the Philistine came on and drew near unto David; and the man that bare the shield went before him.
bsb_text: Now the Philistine came closer and closer to David, with his shield-bearer before him.
aov_text: Ook die Filistyn het al nader en nader gekom na Dawid, en die skilddraer voor hom uit.

kjv_text: And when the Philistine looked about, and saw David, he disdained him: for he was but a youth, and ruddy, and of a fair countenance.
bsb_text: When the Philistine looked and saw David, he despised him because he was just a boy, ruddy and handsome.
aov_text: Toe die Filistyn opkyk en Dawid sien, het hy hom verag, omdat hy ’n seun was—rooierig, met ’n mooi voorkoms.

kjv_text: And the Philistine said unto David, Am I a dog, that thou comest to me with staves? And the Philistine cursed David by his gods.
bsb_text: “Am I a dog,” he said to David, “that you come at me with sticks?” And the Philistine cursed David by his gods.
aov_text: En die Filistyn vra vir Dawid: Is ek ’n hond dat jy met stokke na my toe kom? En die Filistyn het Dawid vervloek by sy gode.

kjv_text: And the Philistine said to David, Come to me, and I will give thy flesh unto the fowls of the air, and to the beasts of the field.
bsb_text: “Come here,” he called to David, “and I will give your flesh to the birds of the air and the beasts of the field!”
aov_text: Verder sê die Filistyn vir Dawid: Kom na my toe, dat ek jou vlees aan die voëls van die hemel en die diere van die veld kan gee.

kjv_text: Then said David to the Philistine, Thou comest to me with a sword, and with a spear, and with a shield: but I come to thee in the name of the LORD of hosts, the God of the armies of Israel, whom thou hast defied.
bsb_text: But David said to the Philistine, “You come against me with sword and spear and javelin, but I come against you in the name of the LORD of Hosts, the God of the armies of Israel, whom you have defied.
aov_text: Maar Dawid sê vir die Filistyn: Jy kom na my met ’n swaard en met ’n spies en met ’n lans, maar ek kom na jou in die Naam van die HERE van die leërskare, die God van die slagordes van Israel, wat jy uitgedaag het.
