aov_text: Daarop het Dawid en die manskappe wat by hom was, hulle stem verhef en geween totdat daar geen krag meer in hulle was om te ween nie.

kjv_text: And David's two wives were taken captives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.
bsb_text: David’s two wives, Ahinoam of Jezreel and Abigail the widow of Nabal of Carmel, had been taken captive.
aov_text: Ook Dawid se twee vroue, Ahínoam uit Jísreël, en Abígail, die vrou van Nabal, die Karmeliet, was as gevangenes weggevoer.

kjv_text: And David was greatly distressed; for the people spake of stoning him, because the soul of all the people was grieved, every man for his sons and for his daughters: but David encouraged himself in the LORD his God.
bsb_text: And David was greatly distressed because the people spoke of stoning him, because the soul of every man grieved for his sons and daughters. But David found strength in the LORD his God.
aov_text: En Dawid het dit baie benoud gehad, want die manskappe het gepraat om hom te stenig; want die siel van al die manskappe was verbitterd, elkeen oor sy seuns en sy dogters; maar Dawid het homself versterk in die HERE sy God.

kjv_text: And David said to Abiathar the priest, Ahimelech's son, I pray thee, bring me hither the ephod. And Abiathar brought thither the ephod to David.
bsb_text: Then David said to Abiathar the priest, the son of Ahimelech, “Bring me the ephod.” So Abiathar brought it to him,
aov_text: En Dawid sê vir Ábjatar, die priester, die seun van Ahiméleg: Bring tog die skouerkleed vir my hier. Daarop het Ábjatar die skouerkleed na Dawid gebring.

kjv_text: And David enquired at the LORD, saying, Shall I pursue after this troop? shall I overtake them? And he answered him, Pursue: for thou shalt surely overtake them, and without fail recover all.
bsb_text: and David inquired of the LORD: “Should I pursue these raiders? Will I overtake them?” “Pursue them,” the LORD replied, “for you will surely overtake them and rescue the captives.”
aov_text: En Dawid het die HERE geraadpleeg en gesê: Sal ek hierdie bende agternajaag? Sal ek dit inhaal? En Hy sê vir hom: Agtervolg, want jy sal sekerlik inhaal en sekerlik uitred.

kjv_text: So David went, he and the six hundred men that were with him, and came to the brook Besor, where those that were left behind stayed.
bsb_text: So David and his six hundred men went to the Brook of Besor, where some stayed behind
aov_text: Daarop het Dawid weggetrek, hy met die seshonderd man wat by hom was; en toe hulle by die spruit Besor kom, het die origes agtergebly.

kjv_text: But David pursued, he and four hundred men: for two hundred abode behind, which were so faint that they could not go over the brook Besor.
bsb_text: because two hundred men were too exhausted to cross the brook. But David and four hundred men continued in pursuit.
aov_text: Dawid het naamlik agtervolg, hy met vierhonderd man, terwyl tweehonderd man agtergebly het wat te moeg was om die spruit Besor deur te trek.

kjv_text: And they found an Egyptian in the field, and brought him to David, and gave him bread, and he did eat; and they made him drink water;
bsb_text: Now his men found an Egyptian in the field and brought him to David. They gave the man water to drink and food to eat—
aov_text: Toe vind hulle in die veld ’n Egiptenaar wat hulle na Dawid bring, en hulle gee hom brood om te eet en water om te drink.

kjv_text: And they gave him a piece of a cake of figs, and two clusters of raisins: and when he had eaten, his spirit came again to him: for he had eaten no bread, nor drunk any water, three days and three nights.
bsb_text: a piece of a fig cake and two clusters of raisins. So he ate and was revived, for he had not had any food or water for three days and three nights.
aov_text: Daarby gee hulle hom ’n stuk vyekoek en twee rosynekoeke. En toe hy geëet het, het hy weer bygekom; want hy het drie dae en drie nagte geen brood geëet of water gedrink nie.

kjv_text: And David said unto him, To whom belongest thou? and whence art thou? And he said, I am a young man of Egypt, servant to an Amalekite; and my master left me, because three days agone I fell sick.
bsb_text: Then David asked him, “To whom do you belong, and where are you from?” “I am an Egyptian,” he replied, “the slave of an Amalekite. My master abandoned me three days ago when I fell ill.
aov_text: En Dawid vra hom: Aan wie behoort jy? En waar kom jy vandaan? En hy sê: Ek is ’n Egiptiese seun, die slaaf van ’n Amalekitiese man, en my heer het my laat agterbly, omdat ek drie dae gelede siek geword het.

kjv_text: We made an invasion upon the south of the Cherethites, and upon the coast which belongeth to Judah, and upon the south of Caleb; and we burned Ziklag with fire.
bsb_text: We raided the Negev of the Cherethites, the territory of Judah, and the Negev of Caleb, and we burned down Ziklag.”
aov_text: Ons het ’n inval gedoen in die Suidland van die Kretiërs en in dié van Juda en in die Suidland van Kaleb, en Siklag met vuur verbrand.

kjv_text: And David said to him, Canst thou bring me down to this company? And he said, Swear unto me by God, that thou wilt neither kill me, nor deliver me into the hands of my master, and I will bring thee down to this company.
bsb_text: “Will you lead me to these raiders?” David asked. And the man replied, “Swear to me by God that you will not kill me or deliver me into the hand of my master, and I will lead you to them.”
aov_text: En Dawid vra hom: Sal jy my afbring na hierdie bende? En hy sê: Sweer vir my by God dat u my nie sal doodmaak en my nie sal uitlewer in die hand van my heer nie; dan sal ek u afbring na hierdie bende.

kjv_text: And when he had brought him down, behold, they were spread abroad upon all the earth, eating and drinking, and dancing, because of all the great spoil that they had taken out of the land of the Philistines, and out of the land of Judah.
bsb_text: So he led David down, and there were the Amalekites spread out over all the land, eating, drinking, and celebrating the great amount of plunder they had taken from the land of the Philistines and the land of Judah.
aov_text: En toe hy hom afgebring het, lê hulle daar verstrooid oor die oppervlakte van die hele land, besig om te eet en te drink en fees te vier met die ganse groot buit wat hulle uit die land van die Filistyne en uit die land Juda saamgeneem het.

kjv_text: And David smote them from the twilight even unto the evening of the next day: and there escaped not a man of them, save four hundred young men, which rode upon camels, and fled.
bsb_text: And David struck them down from twilight until the evening of the next day. Not a man escaped, except four hundred young men who fled, riding off on camels.
aov_text: En Dawid het hulle verslaan van die aandskemering af tot die aand van die volgende dag, sodat niemand van hulle vrygeraak het nie, behalwe vierhonderd jongmanne wat op kamele gespring en gevlug het.

kjv_text: And David recovered all that the Amalekites had carried away: and David rescued his two wives.
bsb_text: So David recovered everything the Amalekites had taken, including his two wives.
aov_text: So het Dawid dan alles gered wat die Amalekiete saamgeneem het; ook sy twee vroue het Dawid bevry.

kjv_text: And there was nothing lacking to them, neither small nor great, neither sons nor daughters, neither spoil, nor any thing that they had taken to them: David recovered all.
bsb_text: Nothing was missing, young or old, son or daughter, or any of the plunder the Amalekites had taken. David brought everything back.
aov_text: Niks van hulle is vermis nie—klein of groot, seuns of dogters, of iets van die buit, niks van alles wat hulle vir hul saamgeneem het nie; Dawid het alles teruggebring.

kjv_text: And David took all the flocks and the herds, which they drave before those other cattle, and said, This is David's spoil.
bsb_text: And he recovered all the flocks and herds, which his men drove ahead of the other livestock, calling out, “This is David’s plunder!”
aov_text: En Dawid het al die kleinvee en beeste afgeneem. Hulle het hul voor die ander vee gedrywe en gesê: Dit is Dawid se buit.

kjv_text: And David came to the two hundred men, which were so faint that they could not follow David, whom they had made also to abide at the brook Besor: and they went forth to meet David, and to meet the people that were with him: and when David came near to the people, he saluted them.
bsb_text: When David came to the two hundred men who had been too exhausted to follow him from the Brook of Besor, they came out to meet him and the troops with him. As David approached the men, he greeted them,
aov_text: Toe Dawid by die tweehonderd man kom wat te moeg was om agter Dawid aan te gaan en wat hulle by die spruit Besor laat bly het, trek hulle uit, Dawid en die manskappe wat by hom was, tegemoet; en Dawid het met die manskappe nader gekom en hulle na die welstand gevra.

kjv_text: Then answered all the wicked men and men of Belial, of those that went with David, and said, Because they went not with us, we will not give them ought of the spoil that we have recovered, save to every man his wife and his children, that they may lead them away, and depart.
bsb_text: but all the wicked and worthless men among those who had gone with David said, “Because they did not go with us, we will not share with them the plunder we recovered, except for each man’s wife and children. They may take them and go.”
aov_text: Daarop het al die slegte mense en die deugniete uit die manne wat met Dawid saamgegaan het, begin sê: Omdat hulle nie met ons saamgegaan het nie, sal ons hulle nie van die buit wat ons afgeneem het, gee nie; maar hulle kan elkeen sy vrou en sy kinders saamneem en weggaan.

kjv_text: Then said David, Ye shall not do so, my brethren, with that which the LORD hath given us, who hath preserved us, and delivered the company that came against us into our hand.
bsb_text: But David said, “My brothers, you must not do this with what the LORD has given us. He has protected us and delivered into our hands the raiders who came against us.
aov_text: Maar Dawid het gesê: Julle mag nie so maak nie, my broers, met wat die HERE ons gegee het, en Hy het ons bewaar en die bende wat ons oorval het, in ons hand gegee.

kjv_text: For who will hearken unto you in this matter? but as his part is that goeth down to the battle, so shall his part be that tarrieth by the stuff: they shall part alike.
bsb_text: Who will listen to your proposal? The share of the one who went to battle will match the share of the one who stayed with the supplies. They will share alike.”
aov_text: En wie sou in hierdie saak na julle luister? Want soos die deel van die wat in die geveg aftrek, so is ook die deel van die wat by die pakgoed bly; gelykop moet hulle deel.

kjv_text: And it was so from that day forward, that he made it a statute and an ordinance for Israel unto this day.
bsb_text: And so it has been from that day forward. David established this statute as an ordinance for Israel to this very day.
aov_text: So is dit dan van dié dag af en verder gewees; ja, hy het dit as ’n insetting en ’n verordening vir Israel vasgestel tot vandag toe.

kjv_text: And when David came to Ziklag, he sent of the spoil unto the elders of Judah, even to his friends, saying, Behold a present for you of the spoil of the enemies of the LORD;
bsb_text: When David arrived in Ziklag, he sent some of the plunder to his friends, the elders of Judah, saying, “Here is a gift for you from the plunder of the LORD’s enemies.”
aov_text: Toe Dawid dan in Siklag aankom, het hy van die buit aan die oudstes van Juda, sy stamgenote, gestuur en gesê: Hier is ’n geskenk vir julle uit die buit van die vyande van die HERE:

kjv_text: To them which were in Bethel, and to them which were in south Ramoth, and to them which were in Jattir,
bsb_text: He sent gifts to those in Bethel, Ramoth Negev, and Jattir;
aov_text: aan dié in Bet-el en aan dié in Ramot in die Suidland en aan dié in Jattir

kjv_text: And to them which were in Aroer, and to them which were in Siphmoth, and to them which were in Eshtemoa,
bsb_text: to those in Aroer, Siphmoth, and Eshtemoa;
aov_text: en aan dié in Ároër en aan dié in Sifmot en aan dié in Estemóa

kjv_text: And to them which were in Rachal, and to them which were in the cities of the Jerahmeelites, and to them which were in the cities of the Kenites,
bsb_text: to those in Racal and in the cities of the Jerahmeelites and Kenites;
aov_text: en aan dié in Ragal en aan dié in die stede van die Jeragmeëliete en aan dié in die stede van die Keniete

kjv_text: And to them which were in Hormah, and to them which were in Chorashan, and to them which were in Athach,
bsb_text: to those in Hormah, Bor-ashan, and Athach;
aov_text: en aan dié in Horma en aan dié in Bor-Asan en aan dié in Atag

kjv_text: And to them which were in Hebron, and to all the places where David himself and his men were wont to haunt.
bsb_text: and to those in Hebron and in all the places where David and his men had roamed.
aov_text: en aan dié in Hebron en aan al die plekke waar Dawid, hy en sy manne, rondgetrek het.

kjv_text: Now the Philistines fought against Israel: and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gilboa.
bsb_text: Now the Philistines fought against Israel, and the men of Israel fled before them, and many fell slain on Mount Gilboa.
aov_text: TERWYL die Filistyne teen Israel veg, het die manne van Israel vir die Filistyne weggevlug, en gesneuweldes het op die gebergte Gilbóa gelê.

kjv_text: And the Philistines followed hard upon Saul and upon his sons; and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Melchishua, Saul's sons.
bsb_text: The Philistines followed hard after Saul and his sons, and they killed Saul’s sons Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua.
aov_text: En die Filistyne het Saul en sy seuns agternagesit, en die Filistyne het Jónatan en Abinádab en Malkisúa, die seuns van Saul, gedood.

kjv_text: And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers hit him; and he was sore wounded of the archers.
bsb_text: When the battle intensified against Saul, the archers overtook him and wounded him critically.
aov_text: Toe die geveg dan swaar word teen Saul, en die manne, die boogskutters, hom aantref, het hy gebewe van angs vir die skutters.

kjv_text: Then said Saul unto his armourbearer, Draw thy sword, and thrust me through therewith; lest these uncircumcised come and thrust me through, and abuse me. But his armourbearer would not; for he was sore afraid. Therefore Saul took a sword, and fell upon it.
bsb_text: Then Saul said to his armor-bearer, “Draw your sword and run it through me, or these uncircumcised men will come and run me through and torture me!” But his armor-bearer was terrified and refused to do it. So Saul took his own sword and fell on it.
aov_text: En Saul het aan sy wapendraer gesê: Trek jou swaard uit en deurboor my daarmee, anders kom hierdie onbesnedenes en deurboor my en dryf die spot met my. Maar sy wapendraer wou nie, omdat hy baie bevrees was. Daarop neem Saul die swaard en val daarin.

kjv_text: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead, he fell likewise upon his sword, and died with him.
bsb_text: When his armor-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he too fell on his own sword and died with him.
aov_text: Toe sy wapendraer sien dat Saul dood was, het hy self ook in sy swaard geval en saam met hom gesterf.

kjv_text: So Saul died, and his three sons, and his armourbearer, and all his men, that same day together.
bsb_text: So Saul, his three sons, his armor-bearer, and all his men died together that same day.
aov_text: So het dan Saul en sy drie seuns en sy wapendraer, ook al sy manne op dieselfde dag almal saam gesterwe.

kjv_text: And when the men of Israel that were on the other side of the valley, and they that were on the other side Jordan, saw that the men of Israel fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they forsook the cities, and fled; and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.
bsb_text: When the Israelites along the valley and those on the other side of the Jordan saw that the army of Israel had fled and that Saul and his sons had died, they abandoned their cities and ran away. So the Philistines came and occupied their cities.
aov_text: Daarop sien die manne van Israel wat oorkant die vlakte en wat oorkant die Jordaan was, dat die manne van Israel gevlug het en dat Saul en sy seuns dood was, en hulle het die stede verlaat en gevlug; en die Filistyne het gekom en daarin gaan woon.

kjv_text: And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his three sons fallen in mount Gilboa.
bsb_text: The next day, when the Philistines came to strip the dead, they found Saul and his three sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.
aov_text: En toe die Filistyne die volgende dag kom om die gesneuweldes te plunder, kry hulle Saul en sy drie seuns nog daar lê op die gebergte Gilbóa.

kjv_text: And they cut off his head, and stripped off his armour, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to publish it in the house of their idols, and among the people.
bsb_text: They cut off Saul’s head, stripped off his armor, and sent messengers throughout the land of the Philistines to proclaim the news in the temples of their idols and among their people.
aov_text: En hulle het sy hoof afgekap en sy wapenrusting uitgetrek en dit in die land van die Filistyne rondgestuur om die blye boodskap te bring in die tempels van hulle afgode en aan die volk.

kjv_text: And they put his armour in the house of Ashtaroth: and they fastened his body to the wall of Bethshan.
bsb_text: They put his armor in the temple of the Ashtoreths and hung his body on the wall of Beth-shan.
aov_text: Daarna het hulle sy wapens in die Astarte-tempel neergelê, maar sy lyk teen die muur van Bet-San vasgeslaan.

kjv_text: And when the inhabitants of Jabeshgilead heard of that which the Philistines had done to Saul;
bsb_text: When the people of Jabesh-gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul,
aov_text: Toe die inwoners van Jabes in Gílead daarvan hoor—wat die Filistyne aan Saul gedoen het —

kjv_text: All the valiant men arose, and went all night, and took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons from the wall of Bethshan, and came to Jabesh, and burnt them there.
bsb_text: all their men of valor set out, journeyed all night, and retrieved the bodies of Saul and his sons from the wall of Beth-shan. When they arrived at Jabesh, they burned the bodies there.
aov_text: het al die dapper manne hulle gereedgemaak en die hele nag deur getrek; en hulle het die lyk van Saul en die lyke van sy seuns van die muur van Bet-San afgehaal en by Jabes gekom en hulle daar verbrand.

kjv_text: And they took their bones, and buried them under a tree at Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
bsb_text: Then they took their bones and buried them under the tamarisk tree in Jabesh, and they fasted seven days.
aov_text: En hulle het hul gebeente geneem en onder die tamarisk in Jabes begrawe en sewe dae lank gevas.

kjv_text: Now it came to pass after the death of Saul, when David was returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites, and David had abode two days in Ziklag;
bsb_text: After the death of Saul, David returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites and stayed in Ziklag two days.
aov_text: EN ná die dood van Saul, toe Dawid terug was van die verslaan van die Amalekiete en Dawid twee dae in Siklag gebly het,

kjv_text: It came even to pass on the third day, that, behold, a man came out of the camp from Saul with his clothes rent, and earth upon his head: and so it was, when he came to David, that he fell to the earth, and did obeisance.
bsb_text: On the third day a man with torn clothes and dust on his head arrived from Saul’s camp. When he came to David, he fell to the ground to pay him homage.
aov_text: kom daar op die derde dag ’n man uit die leër, van Saul af, met geskeurde klere en grond op sy hoof. En toe hy by Dawid kom, val hy op die grond en buig hom neer.

kjv_text: And David said unto him, From whence comest thou? And he said unto him, Out of the camp of Israel am I escaped.
bsb_text: “Where have you come from?” David asked. “I have escaped from the Israelite camp,” he replied.
aov_text: En Dawid sê vir hom: Waar kom jy vandaan? En hy antwoord hom: Ek het ontvlug uit die leër van Israel.

kjv_text: And David said unto him, How went the matter? I pray thee, tell me. And he answered, That the people are fled from the battle, and many of the people also are fallen and dead; and Saul and Jonathan his son are dead also.
bsb_text: “What was the outcome?” David asked. “Please tell me.” “The troops fled from the battle,” he replied. “Many of them fell and died. And Saul and his son Jonathan are also dead.”
aov_text: Verder sê Dawid vir hom: Wat het gebeur? Vertel my tog. Toe antwoord hy: Die manskappe het uit die geveg gevlug, en baie van die manskappe het ook geval en gesterwe; ja, ook Saul en sy seun Jónatan is dood.

kjv_text: And David said unto the young man that told him, How knowest thou that Saul and Jonathan his son be dead?
bsb_text: Then David asked the young man who had brought him the report, “How do you know that Saul and his son Jonathan are dead?”
aov_text: En Dawid vra die jongman wat hom die boodskap gebring het: Hoe weet jy dat Saul en sy seun Jónatan dood is?

kjv_text: And the young man that told him said, As I happened by chance upon mount Gilboa, behold, Saul leaned upon his spear; and, lo, the chariots and horsemen followed hard after him.
bsb_text: “I happened to be on Mount Gilboa,” he replied, “and there was Saul, leaning on his spear, with the chariots and the cavalry closing in on him.
aov_text: Daarop sê die jongman wat hom die boodskap gebring het: Ek was bygeval op die gebergte Gilbóa, en kyk, Saul het op sy spies geleun, terwyl die strydwaens en perderuiters hom agternasit;

kjv_text: And when he looked behind him, he saw me, and called unto me. And I answered, Here am I.
bsb_text: When he turned around and saw me, he called out and I answered, ‘Here I am!’
aov_text: en hy het agter hom omgekyk en my gesien en my geroep, en ek het gesê: Hier is ek.

kjv_text: And he said unto me, Who art thou? And I answered him, I am an Amalekite.
bsb_text: ‘Who are you?’ he asked. So I told him, ‘I am an Amalekite.’
aov_text: Toe vra hy my: Wie is jy? En ek antwoord hom: Ek is ’n Amalekiet.

kjv_text: He said unto me again, Stand, I pray thee, upon me, and slay me: for anguish is come upon me, because my life is yet whole in me.
bsb_text: Then he begged me, ‘Stand over me and kill me, for agony has seized me, but my life still lingers.’
aov_text: Daarop sê hy vir my: Kom staan tog by my en maak my van kant, omdat ’n duiseling my bevang het; want my lewe is nog heeltemal in my.

kjv_text: So I stood upon him, and slew him, because I was sure that he could not live after that he was fallen: and I took the crown that was upon his head, and the bracelet that was on his arm, and have brought them hither unto my lord.
bsb_text: So I stood over him and killed him, because I knew that after he had fallen he could not survive. And I took the crown that was on his head and the band that was on his arm, and I have brought them here to my lord.”
aov_text: En ek het by hom gaan staan en hom van kant gemaak, want ek het geweet dat hy ná sy val nie sou leef nie; en ek het die kroon wat op sy hoof en die armband wat om sy arm was, geneem en dit hier na my heer gebring.

kjv_text: Then David took hold on his clothes, and rent them; and likewise all the men that were with him:
bsb_text: Then David took hold of his own clothes and tore them, and all the men who were with him did the same.
aov_text: Toe gryp Dawid sy klere en skeur dit; net so al die manne wat by hom was.

kjv_text: And they mourned, and wept, and fasted until even, for Saul, and for Jonathan his son, and for the people of the LORD, and for the house of Israel; because they were fallen by the sword.
bsb_text: They mourned and wept and fasted until evening for Saul and his son Jonathan, and for the people of the LORD and the house of Israel, because they had fallen by the sword.
aov_text: En hulle het gerouklaag en geween en gevas tot die aand toe oor Saul en oor sy seun Jónatan en oor die volk van die HERE en oor die huis van Israel, omdat hulle deur die swaard geval het.

kjv_text: And David said unto the young man that told him, Whence art thou? And he answered, I am the son of a stranger, an Amalekite.
bsb_text: And David inquired of the young man who had brought him the report, “Where are you from?” “I am the son of a foreigner,” he answered. “I am an Amalekite.”
aov_text: Verder sê Dawid aan die jongman wat hom die boodskap gebring het: Waar kom jy vandaan? En hy antwoord: Ek is die seun van ’n vreemde man, ’n Amalekiet.

kjv_text: And David said unto him, How wast thou not afraid to stretch forth thine hand to destroy the LORD's anointed?
bsb_text: So David asked him, “Why were you not afraid to lift your hand to destroy the LORD’s anointed?”
aov_text: En Dawid sê vir hom: Hoe? Jy was nie bevrees om jou hand uit te steek om die gesalfde van die HERE om te bring nie?

kjv_text: And David called one of the young men, and said, Go near, and fall upon him. And he smote him that he died.
bsb_text: Then David summoned one of the young men and said, “Go, execute him!” So the young man struck him down, and he died.
aov_text: Daarop roep Dawid een van die jongmanne en sê: Kom nader, val op hom aan! En dié het hom neergeslaan, dat hy gesterf het.

kjv_text: And David said unto him, Thy blood be upon thy head; for thy mouth hath testified against thee, saying, I have slain the LORD's anointed.
bsb_text: For David had said to the Amalekite, “Your blood be on your own head because your own mouth has testified against you, saying, ‘I killed the LORD’s anointed.’”
aov_text: En Dawid het vir hom gesê: Jou bloed is op jou hoof, want jou mond getuig teen jou, omdat jy sê: Ek het die gesalfde van die HERE gedood.

kjv_text: And David lamented with this lamentation over Saul and over Jonathan his son:
bsb_text: Then David took up this lament for Saul and his son Jonathan,
aov_text: TOE het Dawid hierdie klaaglied aangehef oor Saul en oor sy seun Jónatan,

kjv_text: (Also he bade them teach the children of Judah the use of the bow: behold, it is written in the book of Jasher.)
bsb_text: and he ordered that the sons of Judah be taught the Song of the Bow. It is written in the Book of Jashar:
aov_text: en hy het beveel om die kinders van Juda die Booglied te leer; kyk, dit is geskrywe in die Boek van die Opregte.

kjv_text: The beauty of Israel is slain upon thy high places: how are the mighty fallen!
bsb_text: “Your glory, O Israel, lies slain on your heights. How the mighty have fallen!
aov_text: Die sieraad, o Israel—op jou hoogtes lê dit verslaan. Hoe het die helde geval!

kjv_text: Tell it not in Gath, publish it not in the streets of Askelon; lest the daughters of the Philistines rejoice, lest the daughters of the uncircumcised triumph.
bsb_text: Tell it not in Gath; proclaim it not in the streets of Ashkelon, lest the daughters of the Philistines rejoice, and the daughters of the uncircumcised exult.
aov_text: Vertel dit nie in Gat, verkondig dit nie op die strate van Áskelon nie, sodat die dogters van die Filistyne hulle nie verheug, die dogters van die onbesnedenes nie jubel nie!

kjv_text: Ye mountains of Gilboa, let there be no dew, neither let there be rain, upon you, nor fields of offerings: for there the shield of the mighty is vilely cast away, the shield of Saul, as though he had not been anointed with oil.
bsb_text: O mountains of Gilboa, may you have no dew or rain, no fields yielding offerings of grain. For there the shield of the mighty was defiled, the shield of Saul, no longer anointed with oil.
aov_text: Berge van Gilbóa, mag op julle geen dou en geen reën en geen velde van offergawes wees nie! Want daar is die skild van die helde weggegooi, die skild van Saul, sonder dat dit met olie gesalf is.

kjv_text: From the blood of the slain, from the fat of the mighty, the bow of Jonathan turned not back, and the sword of Saul returned not empty.
bsb_text: From the blood of the slain, from the fat of the mighty, the bow of Jonathan did not retreat, and the sword of Saul did not return empty.
aov_text: Sonder die bloed van die gesneuweldes, sonder die vet van die helde het die boog van Jónatan nie agteruitgewyk en die swaard van Saul nie leeg teruggekeer nie.

kjv_text: Saul and Jonathan were lovely and pleasant in their lives, and in their death they were not divided: they were swifter than eagles, they were stronger than lions.
bsb_text: Saul and Jonathan, beloved and delightful in life, were not divided in death. They were swifter than eagles, they were stronger than lions.
aov_text: Saul en Jónatan, die bemindes en lieflikes, is in hulle lewe en in hulle dood nie geskeie nie. Vinniger as arende was hulle, sterker as leeus.

kjv_text: Ye daughters of Israel, weep over Saul, who clothed you in scarlet, with other delights, who put on ornaments of gold upon your apparel.
bsb_text: O daughters of Israel, weep for Saul, who clothed you in scarlet and luxury, who decked your garments with ornaments of gold.
aov_text: Dogters van Israel, ween oor Saul, wat julle weelderig beklee het met skarlaken, wat goue versiersels aangebring het op julle gewaad.

kjv_text: How are the mighty fallen in the midst of the battle! O Jonathan, thou wast slain in thine high places.
bsb_text: How the mighty have fallen in the thick of battle! Jonathan lies slain on your heights.
aov_text: Hoe het die helde geval diep in die geveg! Jónatan lê verslaan op jou hoogtes.

kjv_text: I am distressed for thee, my brother Jonathan: very pleasant hast thou been unto me: thy love to me was wonderful, passing the love of women.
bsb_text: I grieve for you, Jonathan, my brother. You were delightful to me; your love to me was extraordinary, surpassing the love of women.
aov_text: Ek is benoud om jou ontwil, my broer Jónatan! Jy was vir my baie lieflik; jou liefde was vir my wonderliker as die liefde van vroue.

kjv_text: How are the mighty fallen, and the weapons of war perished!
bsb_text: How the mighty have fallen and the weapons of war have perished!”
aov_text: Hoe het die helde geval en die oorlogswapens verlore gegaan!

kjv_text: And it came to pass after this, that David enquired of the LORD, saying, Shall I go up into any of the cities of Judah? And the LORD said unto him, Go up. And David said, Whither shall I go up? And he said, Unto Hebron.
bsb_text: Some time later, David inquired of the LORD, “Should I go up to one of the towns of Judah?” “Go up,” the LORD answered. Then David asked, “Where should I go?” “To Hebron,” replied the LORD.
aov_text: EN daarna het Dawid die HERE geraadpleeg en gesê: Sal ek optrek in een van die stede van Juda? En die HERE het hom geantwoord: Trek op. Toe sê Dawid: Waarheen moet ek optrek? En Hy antwoord: Na Hebron.

kjv_text: So David went up thither, and his two wives also, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail Nabal's wife the Carmelite.
bsb_text: So David went there with his two wives, Ahinoam of Jezreel and Abigail the widow of Nabal of Carmel.
aov_text: En Dawid het daarheen opgetrek, en ook sy twee vroue, Ahínoam uit Jísreël, en Abígail, die vrou van Nabal, die Karmeliet.

kjv_text: And his men that were with him did David bring up, every man with his household: and they dwelt in the cities of Hebron.
bsb_text: David also took the men who were with him, each with his household, and they settled in the towns near Hebron.
aov_text: Dawid het ook sy manne wat by hom was, laat optrek, elkeen met sy huisgesin, en hulle het in die stede van Hebron gaan woon.

kjv_text: And the men of Judah came, and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah. And they told David, saying, That the men of Jabeshgilead were they that buried Saul.
bsb_text: Then the men of Judah came to Hebron, and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah. And they told David, “It was the men of Jabesh-gilead who buried Saul.”
aov_text: Daarna het die manne van Juda gekom en Dawid daar as koning oor die huis van Juda gesalf. Toe hulle aan Dawid meedeel en sê: Dit is die manne van Jabes in Gílead wat Saul begrawe het,

kjv_text: And David sent messengers unto the men of Jabeshgilead, and said unto them, Blessed be ye of the LORD, that ye have shewed this kindness unto your lord, even unto Saul, and have buried him.
bsb_text: So David sent messengers to the men of Jabesh-gilead to tell them, “The LORD bless you, because you showed this kindness to Saul your lord when you buried him.
aov_text: stuur Dawid boodskappers na die manne van Jabes in Gílead om aan hulle te sê: Mag julle geseënd wees deur die HERE, dat julle hierdie guns bewys het aan julle heer, aan Saul, en hom begrawe het.

kjv_text: And now the LORD shew kindness and truth unto you: and I also will requite you this kindness, because ye have done this thing.
bsb_text: Now may the LORD show you loving devotion and faithfulness, and I will also show you the same favor because you have done this.
aov_text: Mag die HERE julle dan nou guns en trou bewys, en ek self bewys ook hierdie goedheid aan julle, omdat julle hierdie ding gedoen het.

kjv_text: Therefore now let your hands be strengthened, and be ye valiant: for your master Saul is dead, and also the house of Judah have anointed me king over them.
bsb_text: Now then, be strong and courageous, for though Saul your lord is dead, the house of Judah has anointed me as their king.”
aov_text: En nou, laat julle hande sterk wees, en wees wakker manne; want julle heer Saul is dood. Daarby het die huis van Juda my ook as koning oor hulle gesalf.

kjv_text: But Abner the son of Ner, captain of Saul's host, took Ishbosheth the son of Saul, and brought him over to Mahanaim;
bsb_text: Meanwhile, Abner son of Ner, the commander of Saul’s army, took Saul’s son Ish-bosheth, moved him to Mahanaim,
aov_text: Maar Abner, die seun van Ner, die leërowerste van Saul, het Isbóset, die seun van Saul, geneem en hom oorgebring na Mahanáim

kjv_text: And made him king over Gilead, and over the Ashurites, and over Jezreel, and over Ephraim, and over Benjamin, and over all Israel.
bsb_text: and made him king over Gilead, Asher, Jezreel, Ephraim, and Benjamin—over all Israel.
aov_text: en hom koning gemaak oor Gílead en oor die Asuriete en oor Jísreël en oor Efraim en oor Benjamin en oor die hele Israel.

kjv_text: Ishbosheth Saul's son was forty years old when he began to reign over Israel, and reigned two years. But the house of Judah followed David.
bsb_text: Saul’s son Ish-bosheth was forty years old when he began to reign over Israel, and he reigned for two years. The house of Judah, however, followed David.
aov_text: Veertig jaar oud was Isbóset, die seun van Saul, toe hy koning geword het oor Israel, en hy het twee jaar geregeer; net die huis van Juda het Dawid gevolg.

kjv_text: And the time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months.
bsb_text: And the length of time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months.
aov_text: En die getal dae wat Dawid koning was in Hebron oor die huis van Juda, was sewe jaar en ses maande.

kjv_text: And Abner the son of Ner, and the servants of Ishbosheth the son of Saul, went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon.
bsb_text: One day Abner son of Ner and the servants of Ish-bosheth son of Saul marched out from Mahanaim to Gibeon.
aov_text: EN Abner, die seun van Ner, met die dienaars van Isbóset, die seun van Saul, het uitgetrek uit Mahanáim na Gíbeon.

kjv_text: And Joab the son of Zeruiah, and the servants of David, went out, and met together by the pool of Gibeon: and they sat down, the one on the one side of the pool, and the other on the other side of the pool.
bsb_text: So Joab son of Zeruiah, along with the servants of David, marched out and met them by the pool of Gibeon. And the two camps took up positions on opposite sides of the pool.
aov_text: Joab, die seun van Serúja, en die dienaars van Dawid het ook uitgetrek. En toe hulle mekaar ontmoet by die dam van Gíbeon, het hulle gaan sit aan weerskante van die dam.

kjv_text: And Abner said to Joab, Let the young men now arise, and play before us. And Joab said, Let them arise.
bsb_text: Then Abner said to Joab, “Let us have the young men get up and compete before us.” “Let them get up,” Joab replied.
aov_text: En Abner sê vir Joab: Laat die jongmanne hulle tog regmaak en voor ons speel. En Joab sê: Laat hulle regmaak.

kjv_text: Then there arose and went over by number twelve of Benjamin, which pertained to Ishbosheth the son of Saul, and twelve of the servants of David.
bsb_text: So they got up and were counted off—twelve for Benjamin and Ish-bosheth son of Saul, and twelve for David.
aov_text: Toe het hulle opgestaan, en twaalf is vir Benjamin afgetel, naamlik vir Isbóset, die seun van Saul; en twaalf van die dienaars van Dawid.

kjv_text: And they caught every one his fellow by the head, and thrust his sword in his fellow's side; so they fell down together: wherefore that place was called Helkathhazzurim, which is in Gibeon.
bsb_text: Then each man grabbed his opponent by the head and thrust his sword into his opponent’s side, and they all fell together. So this place, which is in Gibeon, is called Helkath-hazzurim.
aov_text: Maar die een het die ander aan die hoof gegryp, en die een se swaard was in die sy van die ander, sodat hulle saam geval het; daarom noem hulle dié plek Veld van Swaardskerptes, wat by Gíbeon is.

kjv_text: And there was a very sore battle that day; and Abner was beaten, and the men of Israel, before the servants of David.
bsb_text: The battle that day was intense, and Abner and the men of Israel were defeated by the servants of David.
aov_text: En dieselfde dag het die geveg buitengewoon hewig geword, maar Abner en die manne van Israel is verslaan voor die dienaars van Dawid.

kjv_text: And there were three sons of Zeruiah there, Joab, and Abishai, and Asahel: and Asahel was as light of foot as a wild roe.
bsb_text: The three sons of Zeruiah were there: Joab, Abishai, and Asahel. Now Asahel was fleet of foot like a wild gazelle,
aov_text: En daar was drie seuns van Serúja: Joab en Abísai en Ásahel; en Ásahel was lig op sy voete soos een van die gemsbokke wat in die veld is.

kjv_text: And Asahel pursued after Abner; and in going he turned not to the right hand nor to the left from following Abner.
bsb_text: and he chased Abner, not turning to the right or to the left in his pursuit.
aov_text: En Ásahel het Abner agternagejaag sonder om in sy koers regs of links agter Abner weg te draai.

kjv_text: Then Abner looked behind him, and said, Art thou Asahel? And he answered, I am.
bsb_text: And Abner glanced back and said, “Is that you, Asahel?” “It is,” Asahel replied.
aov_text: Toe kyk Abner agter hom om en sê: Is dit jy, Ásahel? En hy antwoord: Dit is ek.

kjv_text: And Abner said to him, Turn thee aside to thy right hand or to thy left, and lay thee hold on one of the young men, and take thee his armour. But Asahel would not turn aside from following of him.
bsb_text: So Abner told him, “Turn to your right or to your left, seize one of the young men, and take his equipment for yourself.” But Asahel would not stop chasing him.
aov_text: En Abner sê vir hom: Draai uit na jou regter- of linkerhand en gryp vir jou een van die jongmanne en neem sy uitrusting vir jou. Maar Ásahel wou nie agter hom wegdraai nie.

kjv_text: And Abner said again to Asahel, Turn thee aside from following me: wherefore should I smite thee to the ground? how then should I hold up my face to Joab thy brother?
bsb_text: Once again, Abner warned Asahel, “Stop chasing me. Why should I strike you to the ground? How could I show my face to your brother Joab?”
aov_text: En Abner sê nog ’n keer vir Ásahel: Jy moet padgee agter my; waarom moet ek jou teen die grond slaan? Hoe sou ek dan my aangesig kan ophef voor jou broer Joab?

kjv_text: Howbeit he refused to turn aside: wherefore Abner with the hinder end of the spear smote him under the fifth rib, that the spear came out behind him; and he fell down there, and died in the same place: and it came to pass, that as many as came to the place where Asahel fell down and died stood still.
bsb_text: But Asahel refused to turn away; so Abner thrust the butt of his spear into his stomach, and it came out his back, and he fell dead on the spot. And every man paused when he came to the place where Asahel had fallen and died.
aov_text: Maar hy het geweier om weg te draai. Toe steek Abner hom met die agterent van die spies in die onderlyf, sodat die spies agter hom uitkom en hy daar neerval en op die plek sterwe. En almal het bly staan wat aankom by die plek waar Ásahel geval en gesterwe het.

kjv_text: Joab also and Abishai pursued after Abner: and the sun went down when they were come to the hill of Ammah, that lieth before Giah by the way of the wilderness of Gibeon.
bsb_text: But Joab and Abishai pursued Abner. By sunset, they had gone as far as the hill of Ammah opposite Giah on the way to the wilderness of Gibeon.
aov_text: Maar Joab en Abísai het Abner agternagejaag, en die son het ondergegaan toe hulle by die heuwel Amma kom wat teenoor Giag lê, aan die pad na die woestyn van Gíbeon.

kjv_text: And the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together after Abner, and became one troop, and stood on the top of an hill.
bsb_text: The Benjamites rallied to Abner, formed a single unit, and took their stand atop a hill.
aov_text: En die kinders van Benjamin het agter Abner byeengekom en saam een skare geword, en hulle het gaan staan op die top van ’n sekere heuwel.

kjv_text: Then Abner called to Joab, and said, Shall the sword devour for ever? knowest thou not that it will be bitterness in the latter end? how long shall it be then, ere thou bid the people return from following their brethren?
bsb_text: Then Abner called out to Joab: “Must the sword devour forever? Do you not realize that this will only end in bitterness? How long before you tell the troops to stop pursuing their brothers?”
aov_text: Toe roep Abner na Joab en sê: Moet die swaard dan vir ewig verteer? Weet jy nie dat dit oplaas bitter sal wees nie? En hoe lank sal jy nie aan die manskappe sê dat hulle moet omdraai agter hulle broers vandaan nie?

kjv_text: And Joab said, As God liveth, unless thou hadst spoken, surely then in the morning the people had gone up every one from following his brother.
bsb_text: “As surely as God lives,” Joab replied, “if you had not spoken up, the troops would have continued pursuing their brothers until morning.”
aov_text: En Joab antwood: So waar as God leef, waarlik, as jy nie gespreek het nie, sou die manskappe môre eers weggetrek het, elkeen agter sy broer vandaan.

kjv_text: So Joab blew a trumpet, and all the people stood still, and pursued after Israel no more, neither fought they any more.
bsb_text: So Joab blew the ram’s horn, and all the troops stopped; they no longer pursued Israel or continued to fight.
aov_text: Toe blaas Joab op die ramshoring, en al die manskappe het stilgestaan en Israel nie langer agternagejaag en nie verder meer geveg nie.

kjv_text: And Abner and his men walked all that night through the plain, and passed over Jordan, and went through all Bithron, and they came to Mahanaim.
bsb_text: And all that night Abner and his men marched through the Arabah. They crossed the Jordan, marched all morning, and arrived at Mahanaim.
aov_text: Daarop het Abner en sy manne daardie hele nag die Vlakte deurgegaan en deur die Jordaan getrek en deur die hele Bitron en in Mahanáim aangekom.

kjv_text: And Joab returned from following Abner: and when he had gathered all the people together, there lacked of David's servants nineteen men and Asahel.
bsb_text: When Joab returned from pursuing Abner, he gathered all the troops. In addition to Asahel, nineteen of David’s servants were missing,
aov_text: En Joab het omgedraai agter Abner weg en al die manskappe versamel. En van Dawid se dienaars is negentien man en Ásahel vermis.

kjv_text: But the servants of David had smitten of Benjamin, and of Abner's men, so that three hundred and threescore men died.
bsb_text: but they had struck down 360 Benjamites who were with Abner.
aov_text: Maar die dienaars van Dawid het van Benjamin, naamlik onder die manne van Abner, geslaan—driehonderd-en-sestig man het gesterwe.

kjv_text: And they took up Asahel, and buried him in the sepulchre of his father, which was in Bethlehem. And Joab and his men went all night, and they came to Hebron at break of day.
bsb_text: Later, they took Asahel and buried him in his father’s tomb in Bethlehem. Then Joab and his men marched all night and reached Hebron at daybreak.
aov_text: En hulle het Ásahel opgetel en hom in die graf van sy vader, wat in Betlehem was, begrawe; en Joab en sy manne het die hele nag deur getrek, sodat dit vir hulle in Hebron lig geword het.

kjv_text: Now there was long war between the house of Saul and the house of David: but David waxed stronger and stronger, and the house of Saul waxed weaker and weaker.
bsb_text: Now the war between the house of Saul and the house of David was protracted. And David grew stronger and stronger, while the house of Saul grew weaker and weaker.
aov_text: EN daar was ’n lang oorlog tussen die huis van Saul en die huis van Dawid, en Dawid het altyd sterker geword, maar die huis van Saul altyd swakker.

kjv_text: And unto David were sons born in Hebron: and his firstborn was Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess;
bsb_text: And sons were born to David in Hebron: His firstborn was Amnon, by Ahinoam of Jezreel;
aov_text: EN vir Dawid is daar seuns in Hebron gebore. En sy eersgeborene was Amnon, by Ahínoam uit Jísreël;

kjv_text: And his second, Chileab, of Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite; and the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur;
bsb_text: his second was Chileab, by Abigail the widow of Nabal of Carmel; his third was Absalom, the son of Maacah daughter of King Talmai of Geshur;
aov_text: en sy tweede was Kíleab, by Abígail, die vrou van Nabal, die Karmeliet; en die derde was Absalom, die seun van Máäga, die dogter van Tálmai, die koning van Gesur;

kjv_text: And the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith; and the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital;
bsb_text: his fourth was Adonijah, the son of Haggith; his fifth was Shephatiah, the son of Abital;
aov_text: en die vierde Adónia, die seun van Haggit; en die vyfde Sefátja, die seun van Abítal;

kjv_text: And the sixth, Ithream, by Eglah David's wife. These were born to David in Hebron.
bsb_text: and his sixth was Ithream, by David’s wife Eglah. These sons were born to David in Hebron.
aov_text: en die sesde Jítream, by Egla, die vrou van Dawid. Hulle is vir Dawid in Hebron gebore.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, while there was war between the house of Saul and the house of David, that Abner made himself strong for the house of Saul.
bsb_text: During the war between the house of Saul and the house of David, Abner had continued to strengthen his position in the house of Saul.
aov_text: EN onderwyl daar oorlog was tussen die huis van Saul en die huis van Dawid, was Abner besig om homself te versterk in die huis van Saul.

kjv_text: And Saul had a concubine, whose name was Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah: and Ishbosheth said to Abner, Wherefore hast thou gone in unto my father's concubine?
bsb_text: Meanwhile, Saul had a concubine named Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah. So Ish-bosheth questioned Abner, “Why did you sleep with my father’s concubine?”
aov_text: Saul het naamlik ’n byvrou gehad wie se naam Rispa was, die dogter van Aja; en Isbóset het vir Abner gesê: Waarom het jy by die byvrou van my vader ingegaan?

kjv_text: Then was Abner very wroth for the words of Ishbosheth, and said, Am I a dog's head, which against Judah do shew kindness this day unto the house of Saul thy father, to his brethren, and to his friends, and have not delivered thee into the hand of David, that thou chargest me to day with a fault concerning this woman?
bsb_text: Abner was furious over Ish-bosheth’s accusation. “Am I the head of a dog that belongs to Judah?” he asked. “All this time I have been loyal to the house of your father Saul, to his brothers, and to his friends. I have not delivered you into the hand of David, but now you accuse me of wrongdoing with this woman!
aov_text: Toe word Abner baie kwaad oor die woorde van Isbóset en sê: Is ek dan die hondskop wat aan Juda behoort? Vandag bewys ek guns aan die huis van Saul, jou vader, aan sy broers en aan sy vriende; en ek het jou nie in die hand van Dawid laat raak nie, en tog verwyt jy my vandag die oortreding met ’n vrou?

kjv_text: So do God to Abner, and more also, except, as the LORD hath sworn to David, even so I do to him;
bsb_text: May God punish Abner, and ever so severely, if I do not do for David what the LORD has sworn to him:
aov_text: Mag God so aan Abner doen en so daaraan toedoen, sekerlik, soos die HERE Dawid met ’n eed beloof het, net so sal ek aan hom doen

kjv_text: To translate the kingdom from the house of Saul, and to set up the throne of David over Israel and over Judah, from Dan even to Beersheba.
bsb_text: to transfer the kingdom from the house of Saul and to establish the throne of David over Israel and Judah, from Dan to Beersheba.”
aov_text: deur die koningskap aan die huis van Saul te ontneem en die troon van Dawid op te rig oor Israel en oor Juda, van Dan tot Berséba.

kjv_text: And he could not answer Abner a word again, because he feared him.
bsb_text: And for fear of Abner, Ish-bosheth did not dare to say another word to him.
aov_text: En hy kon Abner verder geen antwoord gee nie, omdat hy vir hom bang was.

kjv_text: And Abner sent messengers to David on his behalf, saying, Whose is the land? saying also, Make thy league with me, and, behold, my hand shall be with thee, to bring about all Israel unto thee.
bsb_text: Then Abner sent messengers in his place to say to David, “To whom does the land belong? Make your covenant with me, and surely my hand will be with you to bring all Israel over to you.”
aov_text: Daarop het Abner boodskappers na Dawid in sy plek gestuur om te sê: Aan wie behoort die land? en: Sluit u verbond met my; en kyk, my hand sal met u wees om die hele Israel na u toe oor te bring.

kjv_text: And he said, Well; I will make a league with thee: but one thing I require of thee, that is, Thou shalt not see my face, except thou first bring Michal Saul's daughter, when thou comest to see my face.
bsb_text: “Good,” replied David, “I will make a covenant with you. But there is one thing I require of you: Do not appear before me unless you bring Saul’s daughter Michal when you come to see me.”
aov_text: En hy het gesê: Goed, ék sal met u ’n verbond sluit, maar een ding eis ek van u, naamlik: U mag my aangesig nie sien nie, of u moet eers Migal, die dogter van Saul, saambring as u kom om my aangesig te sien.

kjv_text: And David sent messengers to Ishbosheth Saul's son, saying, Deliver me my wife Michal, which I espoused to me for an hundred foreskins of the Philistines.
bsb_text: Then David sent messengers to say to Ish-bosheth son of Saul, “Give me back my wife, Michal, whom I betrothed to myself for a hundred Philistine foreskins.”
aov_text: Dawid het ook boodskappers gestuur na Isbóset, die seun van Saul, om te sê: Gee my vrou Migal met wie ek my verloof het vir honderd voorhuide van die Filistyne.

kjv_text: And Ishbosheth sent, and took her from her husband, even from Phaltiel the son of Laish.
bsb_text: So Ish-bosheth sent and took Michal from her husband Paltiel son of Laish.
aov_text: En Isbóset het gestuur en haar van die man, van Páltiël, die seun van Lais, afgeneem.

kjv_text: And her husband went with her along weeping behind her to Bahurim. Then said Abner unto him, Go, return. And he returned.
bsb_text: Her husband followed her, weeping all the way to Bahurim. Then Abner said to him, “Go back.” So he returned home.
aov_text: En haar man het saam met haar gegaan, terwyl hy agter haar aan loop en ween tot by Bahúrim. Toe sê Abner vir hom: Gaan terug. En hy het teruggegaan.

kjv_text: And Abner had communication with the elders of Israel, saying, Ye sought for David in times past to be king over you:
bsb_text: Now Abner conferred with the elders of Israel and said, “In the past you sought David as your king.
aov_text: En Abner het met die oudstes van Israel onderhandel en gesê: Gister sowel as eergister het julle aldeur Dawid as koning oor julle begeer.

kjv_text: Now then do it: for the LORD hath spoken of David, saying, By the hand of my servant David I will save my people Israel out of the hand of the Philistines, and out of the hand of all their enemies.
bsb_text: Now take action, because the LORD has said to David, ‘Through My servant David I will save My people Israel from the hands of the Philistines and of all their enemies.’”
aov_text: Voer dit dan nou uit, want die HERE het van Dawid gespreek en gesê: Deur die hand van my kneg Dawid sal Ek my volk Israel uit die hand van die Filistyne en uit die hand van al hulle vyande verlos.

kjv_text: And Abner also spake in the ears of Benjamin: and Abner went also to speak in the ears of David in Hebron all that seemed good to Israel, and that seemed good to the whole house of Benjamin.
bsb_text: Abner also spoke to the Benjamites and went to Hebron to tell David all that seemed good to Israel and to the whole house of Benjamin.
aov_text: En Abner het ook voor die ore van Benjamin gespreek; en Abner het ook gegaan om voor die ore van Dawid in Hebron te spreek alles wat goed was in die oë van Israel en in die oë van die hele huis van Benjamin.

kjv_text: So Abner came to David to Hebron, and twenty men with him. And David made Abner and the men that were with him a feast.
bsb_text: When Abner and twenty of his men came to David at Hebron, David held a feast for them.
aov_text: Toe Abner by Dawid in Hebron kom, en twintig man saam met hom, het Dawid vir Abner en die manne wat by hom was, ’n maaltyd aangerig.

kjv_text: And Abner said unto David, I will arise and go, and will gather all Israel unto my lord the king, that they may make a league with thee, and that thou mayest reign over all that thine heart desireth. And David sent Abner away; and he went in peace.
bsb_text: Then Abner said to David, “Let me go at once, and I will gather all Israel to my lord the king, that they may make a covenant with you, and that you may rule over all that your heart desires.” So David dismissed Abner, and he went in peace.
aov_text: En Abner sê vir Dawid: Ek wil my klaarmaak en die hele Israel by my heer die koning gaan versamel, dat hulle met u ’n verbond sluit; dan kan u heers oor alles wat u siel begeer. Daarop het Dawid Abner laat gaan, en hy het in vrede weggegaan.

kjv_text: And, behold, the servants of David and Joab came from pursuing a troop, and brought in a great spoil with them: but Abner was not with David in Hebron; for he had sent him away, and he was gone in peace.
bsb_text: Just then David’s soldiers and Joab returned from a raid, bringing with them a great plunder. But Abner was not with David in Hebron because David had sent him on his way in peace.
aov_text: Intussen kom die dienaars van Dawid en Joab juis van ’n rooftog af, en hulle bring ’n groot buit met hulle saam. Maar Abner was nie meer by Dawid in Hebron nie, want dié het hom laat gaan, en hy het in vrede vertrek.

kjv_text: When Joab and all the host that was with him were come, they told Joab, saying, Abner the son of Ner came to the king, and he hath sent him away, and he is gone in peace.
bsb_text: When Joab and all his troops arrived, he was informed, “Abner son of Ner came to see the king, who sent him on his way in peace.”
aov_text: Toe Joab en die hele kommando wat saam met hom was, tuiskom, deel hulle aan Joab mee en sê: Abner, die seun van Ner, het na die koning gekom, en dié het hom laat gaan, en hy het in vrede vertrek.

kjv_text: Then Joab came to the king, and said, What hast thou done? behold, Abner came unto thee; why is it that thou hast sent him away, and he is quite gone?
bsb_text: So Joab went to the king and said, “What have you done? Look, Abner came to you. Why did you dismiss him? Now he is getting away!
aov_text: Daarop kom Joab by die koning en sê: Wat het u gedoen? Kyk, Abner het by u gekom; waarom het u hom tog laat loop, dat hy somaar weggegaan het?

kjv_text: Thou knowest Abner the son of Ner, that he came to deceive thee, and to know thy going out and thy coming in, and to know all that thou doest.
bsb_text: Surely you realize that Abner son of Ner came to deceive you and to track your movements and all that you are doing.”
aov_text: U ken Abner, die seun van Ner, dat hy gekom het om u te mislei en om u uitgang en u ingang te weet, ja, om alles te weet wat u doen.

kjv_text: And when Joab was come out from David, he sent messengers after Abner, which brought him again from the well of Sirah: but David knew it not.
bsb_text: As soon as Joab had left David, he sent messengers after Abner, who brought him back from the well of Sirah; but David was unaware of it.
aov_text: En Joab het van Dawid af weggegaan en boodskappers agter Abner aan gestuur, wat hom teruggebring het van die put Hassira af sonder dat Dawid dit geweet het.

kjv_text: And when Abner was returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside in the gate to speak with him quietly, and smote him there under the fifth rib, that he died, for the blood of Asahel his brother.
bsb_text: When Abner returned to Hebron, Joab pulled him aside into the gateway, as if to speak to him privately, and there Joab stabbed him in the stomach. So Abner died on account of the blood of Joab’s brother Asahel.
aov_text: Toe Abner dan in Hebron terugkom, het Joab hom eenkant toe gelei in die middel van die poort om vertroulik met hom te praat en hom daar in die onderlyf gesteek, sodat hy gesterf het, oor die bloed van sy broer Ásahel.

kjv_text: And afterward when David heard it, he said, I and my kingdom are guiltless before the LORD for ever from the blood of Abner the son of Ner:
bsb_text: Afterward, David heard about this and said, “I and my kingdom are forever guiltless before the LORD concerning the blood of Abner son of Ner.
aov_text: Toe Dawid dit daarna hoor, sê hy: Ek en my koninkryk is voor die HERE vir ewig onskuldig aan die bloed van Abner, die seun van Ner.

kjv_text: Let it rest on the head of Joab, and on all his father's house; and let there not fail from the house of Joab one that hath an issue, or that is a leper, or that leaneth on a staff, or that falleth on the sword, or that lacketh bread.
bsb_text: May it whirl over the heads of Joab and the entire house of his father, and may the house of Joab never be without one having a discharge or skin disease, or one who leans on a staff or falls by the sword or lacks food.”
aov_text: Mag dit losbreek op die hoof van Joab en op sy hele familie, en mag die huis van Joab nie vry wees van een wat ’n vloeiing het of wat melaats is of wat op krukke loop of wat deur die swaard val of gebrek aan brood het nie.

kjv_text: So Joab and Abishai his brother slew Abner, because he had slain their brother Asahel at Gibeon in the battle.
bsb_text: (Joab and his brother Abishai murdered Abner because he had killed their brother Asahel in the battle at Gibeon.)
aov_text: Joab dan en Abísai, sy broer, het Abner vermoor, omdat hy hulle broer Ásahel by Gíbeon in die geveg gedood het.

kjv_text: And David said to Joab, and to all the people that were with him, Rend your clothes, and gird you with sackcloth, and mourn before Abner. And king David himself followed the bier.
bsb_text: Then David ordered Joab and all the people with him, “Tear your clothes, put on sackcloth, and mourn before Abner.” And King David himself walked behind the funeral bier.
aov_text: Verder het Dawid aan Joab en al die mense wat by hom was, gesê: Skeur julle klere en gord rouklere aan en rouklaag voor Abner uit! En koning Dawid het agter die baar aan gegaan.

kjv_text: And they buried Abner in Hebron: and the king lifted up his voice, and wept at the grave of Abner; and all the people wept.
bsb_text: When they buried Abner in Hebron, the king wept aloud at Abner’s tomb, and all the people wept.
aov_text: Toe hulle Abner in Hebron begrawe, het die koning sy stem verhef en geween by die graf van Abner; die hele volk het ook geween.

kjv_text: And the king lamented over Abner, and said, Died Abner as a fool dieth?
bsb_text: And the king sang this lament for Abner: “Should Abner die the death of a fool?
aov_text: En die koning het ’n klaaglied oor Abner aangehef en gesê: Moes Abner sterwe soos ’n dwaas sterwe?

kjv_text: Thy hands were not bound, nor thy feet put into fetters: as a man falleth before wicked men, so fellest thou. And all the people wept again over him.
bsb_text: Your hands were not bound, your feet were not fettered. As a man falls before the wicked, so also you fell.” And all the people wept over him even more.
aov_text: Jou hande was nie gebind en jou voete nie aangeraak met koperkettings nie. Soos ’n mens voor kwaaddoeners val, het jy geval. En die hele volk het nog meer oor hom geween.

kjv_text: And when all the people came to cause David to eat meat while it was yet day, David sware, saying, So do God to me, and more also, if I taste bread, or ought else, till the sun be down.
bsb_text: Then all the people came and urged David to eat something while it was still day, but David took an oath, saying, “May God punish me, and ever so severely, if I taste bread or anything else before the sun sets!”
aov_text: Daarop kom die hele volk om Dawid te beweeg dat hy brood moet eet terwyl dit nog dag was; maar Dawid het gesweer en gesê: Mag God so aan my doen en so daaraan toedoen as ek voor sonsondergang brood of enigiets proe.

kjv_text: And all the people took notice of it, and it pleased them: as whatsoever the king did pleased all the people.
bsb_text: All the people took note and were pleased. In fact, everything the king did pleased them.
aov_text: En die hele volk het dit opgemerk, en dit was goed in hulle oë: soos alles wat die koning gedoen het, was dit goed in die oë van die hele volk.

kjv_text: For all the people and all Israel understood that day that it was not of the king to slay Abner the son of Ner.
bsb_text: So on that day all the troops and all Israel were convinced that the king had no part in the murder of Abner son of Ner.
aov_text: En die hele volk en die hele Israel het dieselfde dag gemerk dat dit nie van die koning gekom het om Abner, die seun van Ner, dood te maak nie.

kjv_text: And the king said unto his servants, Know ye not that there is a prince and a great man fallen this day in Israel?
bsb_text: Then the king said to his servants, “Do you not realize that a great prince has fallen today in Israel?
aov_text: Verder het die koning aan sy dienaars gesê: Weet julle nie dat vandag ’n vors en ’n groot man in Israel geval het nie?

kjv_text: And I am this day weak, though anointed king; and these men the sons of Zeruiah be too hard for me: the LORD shall reward the doer of evil according to his wickedness.
bsb_text: And I am weak this day, though anointed as king, and these men, the sons of Zeruiah, are too fierce for me. May the LORD repay the evildoer according to his evil!”
aov_text: Maar ek is vandag swak, alhoewel ek as koning gesalf is, terwyl hierdie manne, die seuns van Serúja, harder is as ek. Mag die HERE die kwaaddoener vergelde na sy boosheid!

kjv_text: And when Saul's son heard that Abner was dead in Hebron, his hands were feeble, and all the Israelites were troubled.
bsb_text: Now when Ish-bosheth son of Saul heard that Abner had died in Hebron, he lost courage, and all Israel was dismayed.
aov_text: TOE die seun van Saul hoor dat Abner in Hebron gesterf het, het sy hande slap geword, en die hele Israel was verskrik.

kjv_text: And Saul's son had two men that were captains of bands: the name of the one was Baanah, and the name of the other Rechab, the sons of Rimmon a Beerothite, of the children of Benjamin: (for Beeroth also was reckoned to Benjamin.
bsb_text: Saul’s son had two men who were leaders of raiding parties. One was named Baanah and the other Rechab; they were sons of Rimmon the Beerothite of the tribe of Benjamin—Beeroth is considered part of Benjamin,
aov_text: En die seun van Saul het twee manne, owerstes van bendes, gehad: die naam van die een was Báëna en die naam van die ander Régab, seuns van Rimmon, die Beërotiet, uit die kinders van Benjamin, want Béërot is ook by Benjamin gereken.

kjv_text: And the Beerothites fled to Gittaim, and were sojourners there until this day.)
bsb_text: because the Beerothites fled to Gittaim and have lived there as foreigners to this day.
aov_text: En die Beërotiete het na Gittáim gevlug en was daar vreemdelinge tot vandag toe.

kjv_text: And Jonathan, Saul's son, had a son that was lame of his feet. He was five years old when the tidings came of Saul and Jonathan out of Jezreel, and his nurse took him up, and fled: and it came to pass, as she made haste to flee, that he fell, and became lame. And his name was Mephibosheth.
bsb_text: And Jonathan son of Saul had a son who was lame in his feet. He was five years old when the report about Saul and Jonathan came from Jezreel. His nurse picked him up and fled, but as she was hurrying to escape, he fell and became lame. His name was Mephibosheth.
aov_text: En Jónatan, die seun van Saul, het ’n seun gehad, lam aan altwee voete. Hy was vyf jaar oud toe die tyding aangaande Saul en Jónatan uit Jísreël gekom het, en sy oppasser het hom opgetel en gevlug; maar terwyl sy in haar haastigheid vlug, het hy geval en lam geword; en sy naam was Mefibóset.

kjv_text: And the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, Rechab and Baanah, went, and came about the heat of the day to the house of Ishbosheth, who lay on a bed at noon.
bsb_text: Now Rechab and Baanah, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, set out and arrived at the house of Ish-bosheth in the heat of the day, while the king was taking his midday nap.
aov_text: En die seuns van Rimmon, die Beërotiet, Régab en Báëna, het gegaan en by die huis van Isbóset gekom op die warmste van die dag toe hy in sy middagslaap lê.

kjv_text: And they came thither into the midst of the house, as though they would have fetched wheat; and they smote him under the fifth rib: and Rechab and Baanah his brother escaped.
bsb_text: They entered the interior of the house as if to get some wheat, and they stabbed him in the stomach. Then Rechab and his brother Baanah slipped away.
aov_text: En hulle het daar ingekom tot binne-in die huis om koring te gaan haal en hom in die onderlyf gesteek; en Régab en sy broer Báëna het ontvlug.

kjv_text: For when they came into the house, he lay on his bed in his bedchamber, and they smote him, and slew him, and beheaded him, and took his head, and gat them away through the plain all night.
bsb_text: They had entered the house while Ish-bosheth was lying on his bed, and having stabbed and killed him, they beheaded him, took his head, and traveled all night by way of the Arabah.
aov_text: Hulle het naamlik die huis ingegaan, terwyl hy op sy bed in sy slaapkamer lê, en hom doodgeslaan en sy hoof afgekap; en hulle het sy hoof saamgeneem en die hele nag deur geloop met die pad van die Vlakte

kjv_text: And they brought the head of Ishbosheth unto David to Hebron, and said to the king, Behold the head of Ishbosheth the son of Saul thine enemy, which sought thy life; and the LORD hath avenged my lord the king this day of Saul, and of his seed.
bsb_text: They brought the head of Ish-bosheth to David at Hebron and said to the king, “Here is the head of Ish-bosheth son of Saul, your enemy who sought your life. Today the LORD has granted vengeance to my lord the king against Saul and his offspring.”
aov_text: en die hoof van Isbóset na Dawid in Hebron gebring en aan die koning gesê: Hier is die hoof van Isbóset, die seun van Saul, u vyand wat u lewe gesoek het; maar die HERE het aan my heer die koning vandag wraak gegee op Saul en sy nageslag.

kjv_text: And David answered Rechab and Baanah his brother, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, and said unto them, As the LORD liveth, who hath redeemed my soul out of all adversity,
bsb_text: But David answered Rechab and his brother Baanah, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, “As surely as the LORD lives, who has redeemed my life from all distress,
aov_text: Maar Dawid het Régab en sy broer Báëna, die seuns van Rimmon, die Beërotiet, geantwoord en aan hulle gesê: So waar as die HERE leef wat my siel uit alle benoudheid verlos het,

kjv_text: When one told me, saying, Behold, Saul is dead, thinking to have brought good tidings, I took hold of him, and slew him in Ziklag, who thought that I would have given him a reward for his tidings:
bsb_text: when someone told me, ‘Look, Saul is dead,’ and thought he was a bearer of good news, I seized him and put him to death at Ziklag. That was his reward for his news!
aov_text: hom wat aan my berig gebring en gesê het: Kyk, Saul is dood!—terwyl hy in sy eie oë was soos een wat ’n goeie boodskap bring—het ek gegryp en hom in Siklag gedood, aan wie ek eintlik boodskappersloon moes gegee het;

kjv_text: How much more, when wicked men have slain a righteous person in his own house upon his bed? shall I not therefore now require his blood of your hand, and take you away from the earth?
bsb_text: How much more, when wicked men kill a righteous man in his own house and on his own bed, shall I not now require his blood from your hands and remove you from the earth!”
aov_text: hoeveel te meer sal ek dan nou nie, as goddelose mense ’n regverdige man in sy huis op sy bed vermoor, sy bloed van julle hand eis en julle van die aarde verdelg nie?

kjv_text: And David commanded his young men, and they slew them, and cut off their hands and their feet, and hanged them up over the pool in Hebron. But they took the head of Ishbosheth, and buried it in the sepulchre of Abner in Hebron.
bsb_text: So David commanded his young men, and they killed Rechab and Baanah. They cut off their hands and feet and hung their bodies by the pool in Hebron, but they took the head of Ish-bosheth and buried it in Abner’s tomb in Hebron.
aov_text: Toe het Dawid die jongmanne bevel gegee, en dié het hulle gedood en hul hande en voete afgekap en hulle opgehang by die dam in Hebron; maar die hoof van Isbóset het hulle geneem en dit begrawe in die graf van Abner in Hebron.

kjv_text: Then came all the tribes of Israel to David unto Hebron, and spake, saying, Behold, we are thy bone and thy flesh.
bsb_text: Then all the tribes of Israel came to David at Hebron and said, “Here we are, your own flesh and blood.
aov_text: TOE kom al die stamme van Israel na Dawid in Hebron, en hulle spreek en sê: Hier is ons, u been en u vlees is ons!

kjv_text: Also in time past, when Saul was king over us, thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and the LORD said to thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be a captain over Israel.
bsb_text: Even in times past, while Saul was king over us, you were the one who led Israel out and brought them back. And to you the LORD said, ‘You will shepherd My people Israel, and you will be ruler over them.’”
aov_text: Gister sowel as eergister toe Saul koning oor ons was, het ú Israel uit- en ingelei; en die HERE het aan u gesê: Jý moet my volk Israel oppas, en jý moet ’n vors wees oor Israel.

kjv_text: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and king David made a league with them in Hebron before the LORD: and they anointed David king over Israel.
bsb_text: So all the elders of Israel came to the king at Hebron, where King David made with them a covenant before the LORD. And they anointed him king over Israel.
aov_text: So het dan al die oudstes van Israel na die koning in Hebron gekom; en koning Dawid het met hulle ’n verbond in Hebron gesluit voor die aangesig van die HERE, en hulle het Dawid as koning oor Israel gesalf.

kjv_text: David was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years.
bsb_text: David was thirty years old when he became king, and he reigned forty years.
aov_text: Dertig jaar was Dawid oud toe hy koning geword het; veertig jaar het hy geregeer.

kjv_text: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years over all Israel and Judah.
bsb_text: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months, and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty-three years over all Israel and Judah.
aov_text: In Hebron het hy oor Juda sewe jaar en ses maande geregeer, en in Jerusalem het hy drie-en-dertig jaar oor die hele Israel en Juda geregeer.

kjv_text: And the king and his men went to Jerusalem unto the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land: which spake unto David, saying, Except thou take away the blind and the lame, thou shalt not come in hither: thinking, David cannot come in hither.
bsb_text: Now the king and his men marched to Jerusalem against the Jebusites who inhabited the land. The Jebusites said to David: “You will never get in here. Even the blind and lame can repel you.” For they thought, “David cannot get in here.”
aov_text: Toe die koning met sy manne na Jerusalem wegtrek teen die Jebusiete, die bewoners van die land, het hulle met Dawid gespreek en gesê: Jy sal hier nie inkom nie, maar die blindes en lammes sal jou verdrywe—dit wil sê: Dawid sal hier nie inkom nie.

kjv_text: Nevertheless David took the strong hold of Zion: the same is the city of David.
bsb_text: Nevertheless, David captured the fortress of Zion (that is, the City of David).
aov_text: Maar Dawid het die bergvesting Sion ingeneem; dit is die stad van Dawid.

kjv_text: And David said on that day, Whosoever getteth up to the gutter, and smiteth the Jebusites, and the lame and the blind, that are hated of David's soul, he shall be chief and captain. Wherefore they said, The blind and the lame shall not come into the house.
bsb_text: On that day he said, “Whoever attacks the Jebusites must use the water shaft to reach the lame and blind who are despised by David.” That is why it is said, “The blind and the lame will never enter the palace.”
aov_text: En Dawid het daardie dag gesê: Elkeen wat ’n Jebusiet verslaan, laat hom in die waterkanaal neerwerp die lammes sowel as die blindes, van wie Dawid se siel ’n afkeer het! Daarom sê hulle: ’n Blinde en ’n lamme mag nie in die huis kom nie.

kjv_text: So David dwelt in the fort, and called it the city of David. And David built round about from Millo and inward.
bsb_text: So David took up residence in the fortress and called it the City of David. He built it up all the way around, from the supporting terraces inward.
aov_text: En Dawid het in die bergvesting gaan woon en dit die stad van Dawid genoem; en Dawid het rondom, van Millo af na die binnekant, gebou.

kjv_text: And David went on, and grew great, and the LORD God of hosts was with him.
bsb_text: And David became greater and greater, for the LORD God of Hosts was with him.
aov_text: En Dawid het gedurigdeur groter geword, en die HERE, die God van die leërskare, was met hom.

kjv_text: And Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar trees, and carpenters, and masons: and they built David an house.
bsb_text: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent envoys to David, along with cedar logs, carpenters, and stonemasons, and they built a palace for David.
aov_text: Toe stuur Hiram, die koning van Tirus, boodskappers na Dawid met sederhout en skrynwerkers en klipkappers, en hulle het vir Dawid ’n huis gebou.

kjv_text: And David perceived that the LORD had established him king over Israel, and that he had exalted his kingdom for his people Israel's sake.
bsb_text: And David realized that the LORD had established him as king over Israel and had exalted his kingdom for the sake of His people Israel.
aov_text: So het Dawid dan gewaar geword dat die HERE hom as koning oor Israel bevestig en sy koningskap verhef het ter wille van sy volk Israel.

kjv_text: And David took him more concubines and wives out of Jerusalem, after he was come from Hebron: and there were yet sons and daughters born to David.
bsb_text: After he had arrived from Hebron, David took more concubines and wives from Jerusalem, and more sons and daughters were born to him.
aov_text: En Dawid het uit Jerusalem meer byvroue en vroue geneem, nadat hy uit Hebron gekom het; en vir Dawid is meer seuns en dogters gebore.

kjv_text: And these be the names of those that were born unto him in Jerusalem; Shammuah, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon,
bsb_text: These are the names of the children born to him in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,

bsb_text: For You have established Your people Israel as Your very own forever, and You, O LORD, have become their God.
aov_text: En U het u volk Israel vir U bevestig as ’n volk vir U tot in ewigheid; en U, HERE, het vir hulle ’n God geword.

kjv_text: And now, O LORD God, the word that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant, and concerning his house, establish it for ever, and do as thou hast said.
bsb_text: And now, O LORD God, confirm forever the word You have spoken concerning Your servant and his house. Do as You have promised,
aov_text: Laat dan nou, HERE God, die woord wat U oor u kneg en oor sy huis gespreek het, in vervulling gaan tot in ewigheid, en doen soos U gespreek het;

kjv_text: And let thy name be magnified for ever, saying, The LORD of hosts is the God over Israel: and let the house of thy servant David be established before thee.
bsb_text: so that Your name will be magnified forever when it is said, ‘The LORD of Hosts is God over Israel.’ And the house of Your servant David will be established before You.
aov_text: sodat u Naam groot kan wees tot in ewigheid deurdat hulle sê: Die HERE van die leërskare is God oor Israel; en die huis van u kneg Dawid sal voor u aangesig bestendig wees.

kjv_text: For thou, O LORD of hosts, God of Israel, hast revealed to thy servant, saying, I will build thee an house: therefore hath thy servant found in his heart to pray this prayer unto thee.
bsb_text: For You, O LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, have revealed this to Your servant when You said, ‘I will build a house for you.’ Therefore Your servant has found the courage to offer this prayer to You.
aov_text: Want U, HERE van die leërskare, God van Israel, het die oor van u kneg geopen en gesê: Ek sal vir jou ’n huis bou; daarom het u kneg vrymoedigheid gevind om hierdie gebed tot U te bid.

kjv_text: And now, O Lord GOD, thou art that God, and thy words be true, and thou hast promised this goodness unto thy servant:
bsb_text: And now, O Lord GOD, You are God! Your words are true, and You have promised this goodness to Your servant.
aov_text: En nou, Here HERE, U is God en u woorde is waarheid; en U het u kneg hierdie goeie saak toegesê.

kjv_text: Therefore now let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may continue for ever before thee: for thou, O Lord GOD, hast spoken it: and with thy blessing let the house of thy servant be blessed for ever.
bsb_text: Now therefore, may it please You to bless the house of Your servant, that it may continue forever before You. For You, O Lord GOD, have spoken, and with Your blessing the house of Your servant will be blessed forever.”
