aov_text: Laat dit U dan nou behaag en seën die huis van u kneg, sodat dit vir ewig voor u aangesig kan wees; want U, Here HERE, het dit gespreek, en deur u seën sal die huis van u kneg vir ewig geseënd wees.

kjv_text: And after this it came to pass that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them: and David took Methegammah out of the hand of the Philistines.
bsb_text: Some time later, David defeated the Philistines, subdued them, and took Metheg-ammah from the hand of the Philistines.
aov_text: EN daarna het Dawid die Filistyne verslaan en hulle onderwerp; en Dawid het die gesag oor die moederstad uit die hand van die Filistyne geneem.

kjv_text: And he smote Moab, and measured them with a line, casting them down to the ground; even with two lines measured he to put to death, and with one full line to keep alive. And so the Moabites became David's servants, and brought gifts.
bsb_text: David also defeated the Moabites, made them lie down on the ground, and measured them off with a cord. He measured off with two lengths those to be put to death, and with one length those to be spared. So the Moabites became subject to David and brought him tribute.
aov_text: Hy het die Moabiete ook verslaan en hulle gemeet met ’n lyn deur hulle op die grond te laat lê: en hy het twee mate gemeet om dood te maak en een volle maat om te laat lewe; en die Moabiete het Dawid se belastingpligtige knegte geword.

kjv_text: David smote also Hadadezer, the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his border at the river Euphrates.
bsb_text: David also defeated Hadadezer son of Rehob, king of Zobah, who had marched out to restore his dominion along the Euphrates River.
aov_text: Verder het Dawid Hadadéser, die seun van Rehob, die koning van Soba, verslaan, toe dié getrek het om sy mag aan die Eufraatrivier te herstel.

kjv_text: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven hundred horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: and David houghed all the chariot horses, but reserved of them for an hundred chariots.
bsb_text: David captured from him a thousand chariots, seven thousand charioteers, and twenty thousand foot soldiers, and he hamstrung all the horses except a hundred he kept for the chariots.
aov_text: En Dawid het van hom duisend-sewehonderd perderuiters afgeneem en twintigduisend man voetgangers, en Dawid het al die trekperde se hakskeensenings afgesny, maar honderd trekperde daarvan laat oorbly.

kjv_text: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to succour Hadadezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.
bsb_text: When the Arameans of Damascus came to help King Hadadezer of Zobah, David struck down twenty-two thousand men.
aov_text: En die Arameërs van Damaskus het gekom om Hadadéser, die koning van Soba, te help; maar Dawid het onder die Arameërs twee-en-twintigduisend man verslaan.

kjv_text: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus: and the Syrians became servants to David, and brought gifts. And the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.
bsb_text: Then he placed garrisons in Aram of Damascus, and the Arameans became subject to David and brought him tribute. So the LORD made David victorious wherever he went.
aov_text: En Dawid het wagposte in Aram-Damaskus uitgesit, sodat die Arameërs Dawid se belastingpligtige knegte was; en die HERE het Dawid die oorwinning gegee oral waar hy getrek het.

kjv_text: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
bsb_text: And David took the gold shields that belonged to the officers of Hadadezer and brought them to Jerusalem.
aov_text: En Dawid het die goue skilde geneem wat die dienaars van Hadadéser gedra het, en dit na Jerusalem gebring.

kjv_text: And from Betah, and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, king David took exceeding much brass.
bsb_text: And from Betah and Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, King David took a large amount of bronze.
aov_text: En uit Bétag en uit Berotái, stede van Hadadéser, het koning Dawid ontsaglik veel koper weggeneem.

kjv_text: When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had smitten all the host of Hadadezer,
bsb_text: When King Toi of Hamath heard that David had defeated the entire army of Hadadezer,
aov_text: Toe Toï, die koning van Hamat, hoor dat Dawid die hele leërmag van Hadadéser verslaan het,

kjv_text: Then Toi sent Joram his son unto king David, to salute him, and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer, and smitten him: for Hadadezer had wars with Toi. And Joram brought with him vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and vessels of brass:
bsb_text: he sent his son Joram to greet King David and bless him for fighting and defeating Hadadezer, who had been at war with Toi. Joram brought with him articles of silver and gold and bronze,
aov_text: stuur Toï sy seun Joram na koning Dawid om hom na die welstand te vra en hom geluk te wens, omdat hy teen Hadadéser geveg en hom verslaan het—want Hadadéser het gedurig oorlog gevoer met Toï—en in sy hand was silwer- en goue en kopervoorwerpe.

kjv_text: Which also king David did dedicate unto the LORD, with the silver and gold that he had dedicated of all nations which he subdued;
bsb_text: and King David dedicated these to the LORD, along with the silver and gold he had dedicated from all the nations he had subdued—
aov_text: Dit het koning Dawid ook aan die HERE geheilig, saam met die silwer en die goud wat hy geheilig het van al die nasies wat hy onderwerp het:

kjv_text: Of Syria, and of Moab, and of the children of Ammon, and of the Philistines, and of Amalek, and of the spoil of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.
bsb_text: from Edom and Moab, from the Ammonites and Philistines and Amalekites, and from the spoil of Hadadezer son of Rehob, king of Zobah.
aov_text: van die Arameërs en die Moabiete en van die kinders van Ammon en van die Filistyne en van die Amalekiete en van die buit van Hadadéser, die seun van Rehob, die koning van Soba.

kjv_text: And David gat him a name when he returned from smiting of the Syrians in the valley of salt, being eighteen thousand men.
bsb_text: And David made a name for himself when he returned from striking down eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
aov_text: En Dawid het naam gemaak toe hy, by sy terugkoms van die neerlaag van die Arameërs, in die Soutdal agttienduisend Edomiete verslaan het.

kjv_text: And he put garrisons in Edom; throughout all Edom put he garrisons, and all they of Edom became David's servants. And the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.
bsb_text: He placed garrisons throughout Edom, and all the Edomites were subject to David. So the LORD made David victorious wherever he went.
aov_text: En Dawid het wagposte in Edom uitgesit, in die hele Edom het hy wagposte uitgesit, en al die Edomiete het Dawid se knegte geword; en die HERE het Dawid die oorwinning gegee oral waar hy getrek het.

kjv_text: And David reigned over all Israel; and David executed judgment and justice unto all his people.
bsb_text: Thus David reigned over all Israel and administered justice and righteousness for all his people:
aov_text: En Dawid het oor die hele Israel geregeer, en Dawid het aan sy hele volk reg en geregtigheid gedoen.

kjv_text: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;
bsb_text: Joab son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was the recorder;
aov_text: En Joab, die seun van Serúja, was oor die leër; en Jósafat, die seun van Ahílud, was kanselier.

kjv_text: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, were the priests; and Seraiah was the scribe;
bsb_text: Zadok son of Ahitub and Ahimelech son of Abiathar were priests; Seraiah was the scribe;
aov_text: En Sadok, die seun van Ahítub, en Ahiméleg, die seun van Ábjatar, was priesters, en Serája was skrywer.

kjv_text: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over both the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David's sons were chief rulers.
bsb_text: Benaiah son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and Pelethites; and David’s sons were priestly leaders.
aov_text: En Benája, die seun van Jójada, was oor die Kreti en die Pleti, en die seuns van Dawid was priesters.

kjv_text: And David said, Is there yet any that is left of the house of Saul, that I may shew him kindness for Jonathan's sake?
bsb_text: Then David asked, “Is there anyone left from the house of Saul to whom I can show kindness for the sake of Jonathan?”
aov_text: EN Dawid het gesê: Is daar nog iemand oor van die huis van Saul, dat ek aan hom guns kan bewys ter wille van Jónatan?

kjv_text: And there was of the house of Saul a servant whose name was Ziba. And when they had called him unto David, the king said unto him, Art thou Ziba? And he said, Thy servant is he.
bsb_text: And there was a servant of Saul’s family named Ziba. They summoned him to David, and the king inquired, “Are you Ziba?” “I am your servant,” he replied.
aov_text: En die huis van Saul het ’n dienaar gehad, met die naam van Siba; en hulle het hom na Dawid geroep, en die koning het hom gevra: Is jy Siba? Toe antwoord hy: U dienaar!

kjv_text: And the king said, Is there not yet any of the house of Saul, that I may shew the kindness of God unto him? And Ziba said unto the king, Jonathan hath yet a son, which is lame on his feet.
bsb_text: So the king asked, “Is there anyone left of Saul’s family to whom I can show the kindness of God?” Ziba answered, “There is still Jonathan’s son, who is lame in both feet.”
aov_text: En die koning vra: Is daar nie nog iemand van die huis van Saul, dat ek die guns van God aan hom kan bewys nie? Toe sê Siba aan die koning: Daar is nog ’n seun van Jónatan, wat lam is aan altwee voete.

kjv_text: And the king said unto him, Where is he? And Ziba said unto the king, Behold, he is in the house of Machir, the son of Ammiel, in Lodebar.
bsb_text: “Where is he?” replied the king. And Ziba said, “Indeed, he is in Lo-debar at the house of Machir son of Ammiel.”
aov_text: En die koning vra hom: Waar is hy? Toe sê Siba aan die koning: Kyk, hy is in die huis van Magir, die seun van Ámmiël, in Lódebar.

kjv_text: Then king David sent, and fetched him out of the house of Machir, the son of Ammiel, from Lodebar.
bsb_text: So King David had him brought from the house of Machir son of Ammiel in Lo-debar.
aov_text: Daarop het koning Dawid gestuur en hom laat haal uit die huis van Magir, die seun van Ámmiël, uit Lódebar.

kjv_text: Now when Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, was come unto David, he fell on his face, and did reverence. And David said, Mephibosheth. And he answered, Behold thy servant!
bsb_text: And when Mephibosheth son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, came to David, he fell facedown in reverence. Then David said, “Mephibosheth!” “I am your servant,” he replied.
aov_text: Toe Mefibóset, die seun van Jónatan, die seun van Saul, by Dawid inkom, het hy op sy aangesig geval en hom neergebuig. En Dawid het gesê: Mefibóset! En hy het geantwoord: Hier is u dienaar.

kjv_text: And David said unto him, Fear not: for I will surely shew thee kindness for Jonathan thy father's sake, and will restore thee all the land of Saul thy father; and thou shalt eat bread at my table continually.
bsb_text: “Do not be afraid,” said David, “for surely I will show you kindness for the sake of your father Jonathan. I will restore to you all the land of your grandfather Saul, and you will always eat at my table.”
aov_text: En Dawid sê vir hom: Wees nie bevrees nie, want ek sal jou sekerlik guns bewys ter wille van jou vader Jónatan en al die grond van jou vader Saul aan jou teruggee, en jy self sal altyddeur aan my tafel brood eet.

kjv_text: And he bowed himself, and said, What is thy servant, that thou shouldest look upon such a dead dog as I am?
bsb_text: Mephibosheth bowed down and said, “What is your servant, that you should show regard for a dead dog like me?”
aov_text: Toe buig hy en sê: Wat is u dienaar, dat u na ’n dooie hond soos ek is, omgesien het?

kjv_text: Then the king called to Ziba, Saul's servant, and said unto him, I have given unto thy master's son all that pertained to Saul and to all his house.
bsb_text: Then the king summoned Saul’s servant Ziba and said to him, “I have given to your master’s grandson all that belonged to Saul and to all his house.
aov_text: En die koning het Siba, die dienaar van Saul, geroep en vir hom gesê: Alles wat Saul en sy hele huis gehad het, gee ek aan die seun van jou heer.

kjv_text: Thou therefore, and thy sons, and thy servants, shall till the land for him, and thou shalt bring in the fruits, that thy master's son may have food to eat: but Mephibosheth thy master's son shall eat bread alway at my table. Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.
bsb_text: You and your sons and servants are to work the ground for him and bring in the harvest, so that your master’s grandson may have food to eat. But Mephibosheth, your master’s grandson, is always to eat at my table.” Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.
aov_text: En jy moet vir hom die grond bewerk, jy en jou seuns en jou slawe, en jy moet voedsel inbring, dat die seun van jou heer brood het om te eet; maar Mefibóset, die seun van jou heer, sal altyddeur aan my tafel brood eet. En Siba het vyftien seuns en twintig slawe gehad.

kjv_text: Then said Ziba unto the king, According to all that my lord the king hath commanded his servant, so shall thy servant do. As for Mephibosheth, said the king, he shall eat at my table, as one of the king's sons.
bsb_text: And Ziba said to the king, “Your servant will do all that my lord the king has commanded.” So Mephibosheth ate at David’s table like one of the king’s own sons.
aov_text: Toe sê Siba aan die koning: Net soos my heer die koning sy dienaar beveel, so sal u dienaar doen; en Mefibóset het aan die tafel van Dawid geëet soos een van die koning se seuns.

kjv_text: And Mephibosheth had a young son, whose name was Micha. And all that dwelt in the house of Ziba were servants unto Mephibosheth.
bsb_text: And Mephibosheth had a young son named Mica, and all who dwelt in the house of Ziba were servants of Mephibosheth.
aov_text: En Mefibóset het ’n jong seun gehad met die naam van Miga, en almal wat in die huis van Siba gewoon het, was Mefibóset se dienaars.

kjv_text: So Mephibosheth dwelt in Jerusalem: for he did eat continually at the king's table; and was lame on both his feet.
bsb_text: So Mephibosheth lived in Jerusalem, because he always ate at the king’s table, and he was lame in both feet.
aov_text: En Mefibóset het in Jerusalem gewoon, want hy het altyddeur aan die koning se tafel geëet; en hy was lam aan altwee voete.

kjv_text: And it came to pass after this, that the king of the children of Ammon died, and Hanun his son reigned in his stead.
bsb_text: Some time later, the king of the Ammonites died and was succeeded by his son Hanun.
aov_text: EN daarna het die koning van die kinders van Ammon gesterwe, en sy seun Hanun het in sy plek koning geword.

kjv_text: Then said David, I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash, as his father shewed kindness unto me. And David sent to comfort him by the hand of his servants for his father. And David's servants came into the land of the children of Ammon.
bsb_text: And David said, “I will show kindness to Hanun son of Nahash, just as his father showed kindness to me.” So David sent some of his servants to console Hanun concerning his father. But when they arrived in the land of the Ammonites,
aov_text: Toe sê Dawid: Ek wil guns bewys aan Hanun, die seun van Nahas, soos sy vader aan my guns bewys het. Daarom het Dawid gestuur om hom deur sy dienaars oor sy vader te troos. Toe die dienaars van Dawid dan in die land van die kinders van Ammon kom,

kjv_text: And the princes of the children of Ammon said unto Hanun their lord, Thinkest thou that David doth honour thy father, that he hath sent comforters unto thee? hath not David rather sent his servants unto thee, to search the city, and to spy it out, and to overthrow it?
bsb_text: the princes of the Ammonites said to Hanun their lord, “Just because David has sent you comforters, do you really believe he is showing respect for your father? Has not David instead sent his servants to explore the city, spy it out, and overthrow it?”
aov_text: het die vorste van die kinders van Ammon aan Hanun, hulle heer, gesê: Eer Dawid u vader in u oë, omdat hy vir u troosters gestuur het? Het Dawid nie sy dienaars na u gestuur om die stad te deursoek en dit te verken en dit om te keer nie?

kjv_text: Wherefore Hanun took David's servants, and shaved off the one half of their beards, and cut off their garments in the middle, even to their buttocks, and sent them away.
bsb_text: So Hanun took David’s servants, shaved off half of each man’s beard, cut off their garments at the hips, and sent them away.
aov_text: Daarop neem Hanun die dienaars van Dawid en skeer die een helfte van hulle baard af en sny hulle klere in die helfte af, tot by hulle sitplekke; en hy het hulle laat gaan.

kjv_text: When they told it unto David, he sent to meet them, because the men were greatly ashamed: and the king said, Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown, and then return.
bsb_text: When this was reported to David, he sent messengers to meet the men, since they had been thoroughly humiliated. The king told them, “Stay in Jericho until your beards have grown back, and then return.”
aov_text: En toe hulle aan Dawid hiervan berig bring, stuur hy om hulle tegemoet te gaan, want die manne was baie skaam. En die koning het gesê: Bly in Jérigo totdat julle baard weer gegroei het; kom dan terug.

kjv_text: And when the children of Ammon saw that they stank before David, the children of Ammon sent and hired the Syrians of Bethrehob, and the Syrians of Zoba, twenty thousand footmen, and of king Maacah a thousand men, and of Ishtob twelve thousand men.
bsb_text: When the Ammonites realized that they had become a stench to David, they hired twenty thousand Aramean foot soldiers from Beth-rehob and Zoba, as well as a thousand men from the king of Maacah and twelve thousand men from Tob.
aov_text: Toe die kinders van Ammon sien dat hulle hul gehaat gemaak het by Dawid, het die kinders van Ammon gestuur en die Arameërs van Bet-Rehob en die Arameërs van Soba gehuur, twintigduisend voetgangers, en van die koning van Máäga, duisend man, en die manne van Tob, twaalfduisend man.

kjv_text: And when David heard of it, he sent Joab, and all the host of the mighty men.
bsb_text: On hearing this, David sent Joab and the entire army of mighty men.
aov_text: En Dawid het dit gehoor en Joab met die hele leër, die helde, gestuur.

kjv_text: And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the entering in of the gate: and the Syrians of Zoba, and of Rehob, and Ishtob, and Maacah, were by themselves in the field.
bsb_text: The Ammonites marched out and arrayed themselves for battle at the entrance of the city gate, while the Arameans of Zobah and Rehob and the men of Tob and Maacah were by themselves in the open country.
aov_text: En die kinders van Ammon het uitgetrek en die slagorde opgestel by die ingang van die poort, terwyl die Arameërs van Soba en Rehob en die manne van Tob en Máäga afsonderlik in die veld was.

kjv_text: When Joab saw that the front of the battle was against him before and behind, he chose of all the choice men of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians:
bsb_text: When Joab saw the battle lines before him and behind him, he selected some of the best men of Israel and arrayed them against the Arameans.
aov_text: Toe Joab sien dat ’n aanval van voor sowel as van agter hom bedreig, het hy uit al die uitgesoektes in Israel ’n keuse gedoen en hulle opgestel teenoor die Arameërs.

kjv_text: And the rest of the people he delivered into the hand of Abishai his brother, that he might put them in array against the children of Ammon.
bsb_text: And he placed the rest of the forces under the command of his brother Abishai, who arrayed them against the Ammonites.
aov_text: Maar die ander manskappe het hy onder bevel van sy broer Abísai geplaas en dié het hulle opgestel teenoor die kinders van Ammon.

kjv_text: And he said, If the Syrians be too strong for me, then thou shalt help me: but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee, then I will come and help thee.
bsb_text: “If the Arameans are too strong for me,” said Joab, “then you will come to my rescue. And if the Ammonites are too strong for you, then I will come to your rescue.
aov_text: En hy het gesê: As die Arameërs vir my te sterk word, moet jy my te hulp kom, en as die kinders van Ammon vir jou te sterk word, sal ek kom om jou te help.

kjv_text: Be of good courage, and let us play the men for our people, and for the cities of our God: and the LORD do that which seemeth him good.
bsb_text: Be strong and let us fight bravely for our people and for the cities of our God. May the LORD do what is good in His sight.”
aov_text: Wees sterk en laat ons ons sterk hou vir ons volk en vir die stede van onse God. Mag die HERE dan doen wat goed is in sy oë!

kjv_text: And Joab drew nigh, and the people that were with him, unto the battle against the Syrians: and they fled before him.
bsb_text: So Joab and his troops advanced to fight the Arameans, who fled before him.
aov_text: Daarop het Joab en die manskappe wat by hom was, nader gekom om teen die Arameërs te veg, en hulle het vir hom gevlug.

kjv_text: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled, then fled they also before Abishai, and entered into the city. So Joab returned from the children of Ammon, and came to Jerusalem.
bsb_text: When the Ammonites saw that the Arameans had fled, they too fled before Abishai, and they entered the city. So Joab returned from fighting against the Ammonites and came to Jerusalem.
aov_text: Toe die kinders van Ammon sien dat die Arameërs vlug, het hulle ook vir Abísai gevlug en die stad ingegaan. En Joab het van die kinders van Ammon af omgedraai en in Jerusalem aangekom.

kjv_text: And when the Syrians saw that they were smitten before Israel, they gathered themselves together.
bsb_text: When the Arameans saw that they had been defeated by Israel, they regrouped.
aov_text: Toe die Arameërs dan sien dat hulle voor Israel verslaan was, het hulle dig aaneengesluit.

kjv_text: And Hadarezer sent, and brought out the Syrians that were beyond the river: and they came to Helam; and Shobach the captain of the host of Hadarezer went before them.
bsb_text: Hadadezer sent messengers to bring more Arameans from beyond the Euphrates, and they came to Helam with Shobach the commander of Hadadezer’s army leading them.
aov_text: Ja, Hadaréser het gestuur en die Arameërs van oorkant die Eufraat laat uittrek, en hulle het in Helam aangekom, met Sobag, die leërowerste van Hadaréser, op hulle voorpunt.

kjv_text: And when it was told David, he gathered all Israel together, and passed over Jordan, and came to Helam. And the Syrians set themselves in array against David, and fought with him.
bsb_text: When this was reported to David, he gathered all Israel, crossed the Jordan, and went to Helam. Then the Arameans arrayed themselves against David and fought against him.
aov_text: Intussen het Dawid daarvan berig gekry en die hele Israel versamel en deur die Jordaan getrek en in Helam aangekom; en die Arameërs het hulle teenoor Dawid opgestel en teen hom geveg.

kjv_text: And the Syrians fled before Israel; and David slew the men of seven hundred chariots of the Syrians, and forty thousand horsemen, and smote Shobach the captain of their host, who died there.
bsb_text: But the Arameans fled before Israel, and David killed seven hundred charioteers and forty thousand foot soldiers. He also struck down Shobach the commander of their army, who died there.
aov_text: Maar die Arameërs het vir Israel gevlug, en Dawid het van die Arameërs sewehonderd trekperde en veertigduisend ruiters gedood, en Sobag, die leërowerste, so gewond, dat hy daar gesterf het.

kjv_text: And when all the kings that were servants to Hadarezer saw that they were smitten before Israel, they made peace with Israel, and served them. So the Syrians feared to help the children of Ammon any more.
bsb_text: When all the kings who were subject to Hadadezer saw that they had been defeated by Israel, they made peace with Israel and became subject to them. So the Arameans were afraid to help the Ammonites anymore.
aov_text: En toe al die onderhorige konings van Hadaréser sien dat hulle voor Israel verslaan was, het hulle met Israel vrede gesluit en hulle gedien; en die Arameërs was bevrees om die kinders van Ammon langer te help.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, after the year was expired, at the time when kings go forth to battle, that David sent Joab, and his servants with him, and all Israel; and they destroyed the children of Ammon, and besieged Rabbah. But David tarried still at Jerusalem.
bsb_text: In the spring, at the time when kings march out to war, David sent out Joab and his servants with the whole army of Israel. They destroyed the Ammonites and besieged Rabbah, but David remained in Jerusalem.
aov_text: EN ná verloop van die jaar, teen die tyd dat die konings uittrek, stuur Dawid Joab en sy dienaars saam met hom uit en die hele Israel. En hulle het die land van die kinders van Ammon verniel en Rabba beleër, terwyl Dawid in Jerusalem gebly het.

kjv_text: And it came to pass in an eveningtide, that David arose from off his bed, and walked upon the roof of the king's house: and from the roof he saw a woman washing herself; and the woman was very beautiful to look upon.
bsb_text: One evening David got up from his bed and strolled around on the roof of the palace. And from the roof he saw a woman bathing—a very beautiful woman.
aov_text: En teen die aand, toe Dawid van sy bed opgestaan het en op die dak van die paleis wandel, sien hy van die dak af ’n vrou wat besig was om ’n bad te neem; en die vrou was baie mooi van aansien.

kjv_text: And David sent and enquired after the woman. And one said, Is not this Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam, the wife of Uriah the Hittite?
bsb_text: So David sent and inquired about the woman, and he was told, “This is Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam and the wife of Uriah the Hittite.”
aov_text: En Dawid het ondersoek laat doen na die vrou, en hulle het gesê: Is dit nie Bátseba, die dogter van Elíam, die vrou van Uría die Hetiet nie?

kjv_text: And David sent messengers, and took her; and she came in unto him, and he lay with her; for she was purified from her uncleanness: and she returned unto her house.
bsb_text: Then David sent messengers to get her, and when she came to him, he slept with her. (Now she had just purified herself from her uncleanness.) Then she returned home.
aov_text: Daarop stuur Dawid boodskappers en laat haar haal. En toe sy by hom inkom, het hy met haar gemeenskap gehad, terwyl sy haar juis van haar onreinheid gereinig het. Daarna het sy na haar huis teruggegaan.

kjv_text: And the woman conceived, and sent and told David, and said, I am with child.
bsb_text: And the woman conceived and sent word to David, saying, “I am pregnant.”
aov_text: En die vrou het swanger geword en gestuur om Dawid te laat weet: Ek is swanger.

kjv_text: And David sent to Joab, saying, Send me Uriah the Hittite. And Joab sent Uriah to David.
bsb_text: At this, David sent orders to Joab: “Send me Uriah the Hittite.” So Joab sent him to David.
aov_text: En Dawid het Joab laat weet: Stuur Uría, die Hetiet, na my. En Joab het Uría na Dawid gestuur.

kjv_text: And when Uriah was come unto him, David demanded of him how Joab did, and how the people did, and how the war prospered.
bsb_text: When Uriah came to him, David asked how Joab and the troops were doing with the war.
aov_text: Toe Uría dan by hom kom, vra Dawid of dit goed gaan met Joab, en of dit goed gaan met die manskappe, en of dit goed gaan met die oorlog.

kjv_text: And David said to Uriah, Go down to thy house, and wash thy feet. And Uriah departed out of the king's house, and there followed him a mess of meat from the king.
bsb_text: Then he said to Uriah, “Go down to your house and wash your feet.” So Uriah left the palace, and a gift from the king followed him.
aov_text: En Dawid sê vir Uría: Gaan af na jou huis en was jou voete. En toe Uría uit die paleis uitgaan, het ’n geskenk van die koning hom gevolg.

kjv_text: But Uriah slept at the door of the king's house with all the servants of his lord, and went not down to his house.
bsb_text: But Uriah slept at the door of the palace with all his master’s servants; he did not go down to his house.
aov_text: Maar Uría het gaan slaap by die ingang van die paleis, by al die dienaars van sy heer, en nie na sy huis afgegaan nie.

kjv_text: And when they had told David, saying, Uriah went not down unto his house, David said unto Uriah, Camest thou not from thy journey? why then didst thou not go down unto thine house?
bsb_text: And David was told, “Uriah did not go home.” “Haven’t you just arrived from a journey?” David asked Uriah. “Why didn’t you go home?”
aov_text: En daar is aan Dawid meegedeel en gesê: Uría het nie na sy huis afgegaan nie. Toe vra Dawid vir Uría: Kom jy nie van ’n reis af nie? Waarom gaan jy nie af na jou huis nie?

kjv_text: And Uriah said unto David, The ark, and Israel, and Judah, abide in tents; and my lord Joab, and the servants of my lord, are encamped in the open fields; shall I then go into mine house, to eat and to drink, and to lie with my wife? as thou livest, and as thy soul liveth, I will not do this thing.
bsb_text: Uriah answered, “The ark and Israel and Judah are dwelling in tents, and my master Joab and his soldiers are camped in the open field. How can I go to my house to eat and drink and sleep with my wife? As surely as you live, and as your soul lives, I will not do such a thing!”
aov_text: En Uría sê vir Dawid: Die ark en Israel en Juda bly in hutte, en my heer Joab en die dienaars van my heer is gelaer in die oop veld; sou ek dan in my huis ingaan om te eet en te drink en by my vrou te slaap? So waar as u leef en u siel leef, ek sal dit nie doen nie!

kjv_text: And David said to Uriah, Tarry here to day also, and to morrow I will let thee depart. So Uriah abode in Jerusalem that day, and the morrow.
bsb_text: “Stay here one more day,” David said to Uriah, “and tomorrow I will send you back.” So Uriah stayed in Jerusalem that day and the next.
aov_text: En Dawid sê vir Uría: Bly vandag ook hier; dan sal ek jou môre laat gaan. En Uría het dié dag in Jerusalem gebly.

kjv_text: And when David had called him, he did eat and drink before him; and he made him drunk: and at even he went out to lie on his bed with the servants of his lord, but went not down to his house.
bsb_text: Then David invited Uriah to eat and drink with him, and he got Uriah drunk. And in the evening Uriah went out to lie down on his cot with his master’s servants, but he did not go home.
aov_text: Maar die volgende dag het Dawid hom genooi, en hy het voor sy aangesig geëet en gedrink, en hy het hom dronk gemaak. Toe gaan hy in die aand uit om op sy slaapplek by die dienaars van sy heer te gaan slaap; maar na sy huis het hy nie afgegaan nie.

kjv_text: And it came to pass in the morning, that David wrote a letter to Joab, and sent it by the hand of Uriah.
bsb_text: The next morning David wrote a letter to Joab and sent it with Uriah.
aov_text: En in die môre skrywe Dawid ’n brief aan Joab en stuur dit met Uría weg.

kjv_text: And he wrote in the letter, saying, Set ye Uriah in the forefront of the hottest battle, and retire ye from him, that he may be smitten, and die.
bsb_text: In the letter he wrote: “Put Uriah at the front of the fiercest battle; then withdraw from him, so that he may be struck down and killed.”
aov_text: En hy het in die brief geskrywe en gesê: Sit Uría op die voorpunt van die hewigste geveg; trek julle dan agter hom terug, dat hy in die slag kan sneuwel.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when Joab observed the city, that he assigned Uriah unto a place where he knew that valiant men were.
bsb_text: So as Joab besieged the city, he assigned Uriah to a place where he saw the strongest enemy soldiers.
aov_text: So het Joab dan, terwyl hy die stad verken, Uría op ’n plek gesit waarvan hy geweet het dat daar dapper manne was.

kjv_text: And the men of the city went out, and fought with Joab: and there fell some of the people of the servants of David; and Uriah the Hittite died also.
bsb_text: And when the men of the city came out and fought against Joab, some of David’s servants fell, and Uriah the Hittite also died.
aov_text: En toe die manne van die stad uittrek en met Joab veg, het daar van die manskappe, van die dienaars van Dawid, geval, en Uría, die Hetiet, het ook gesterwe.

kjv_text: Then Joab sent and told David all the things concerning the war;
bsb_text: Joab sent to David a full account of the battle
aov_text: Daarop stuur Joab om Dawid die hele beloop van die geveg mee te deel.

kjv_text: And charged the messenger, saying, When thou hast made an end of telling the matters of the war unto the king,
bsb_text: and instructed the messenger, “When you have finished giving the king all the details of the battle,
aov_text: En hy gee die boodskapper bevel en sê: Net soos jy die hele beloop van die geveg aan die koning klaar vertel het —

kjv_text: And if so be that the king's wrath arise, and he say unto thee, Wherefore approached ye so nigh unto the city when ye did fight? knew ye not that they would shoot from the wall?
bsb_text: if the king’s anger flares, he may ask you, ‘Why did you get so close to the city to fight? Did you not realize they would shoot from atop the wall?
aov_text: as dan die woede van die koning opkom en hy vir jou sê: Waarom het julle so naby die stad gekom om te veg? Het julle dan nie geweet dat hulle bo van die muur af sou skiet nie?

kjv_text: Who smote Abimelech the son of Jerubbesheth? did not a woman cast a piece of a millstone upon him from the wall, that he died in Thebez? why went ye nigh the wall? then say thou, Thy servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also.
bsb_text: Who was the one to strike Abimelech son of Jerubbesheth? Was it not a woman who dropped an upper millstone on him from the wall, so that he died in Thebez? Why did you get so close to the wall?’ If so, then you are to say, ‘Your servant Uriah the Hittite is dead as well.’”
aov_text: Wie het Abiméleg, die seun van Jerubbéset, verslaan? Het nie ’n vrou bo van die muur af ’n boonste meulsteen op hom gegooi, sodat hy in Tebes gesterf het nie? Waarom het julle so naby die muur gekom?—dan moet jy sê: U dienaar Uría, die Hetiet, is ook dood!

kjv_text: So the messenger went, and came and shewed David all that Joab had sent him for.
bsb_text: So the messenger set out and reported to David all that Joab had sent him to say.
aov_text: En die boodskapper het gegaan en aangekom en aan Dawid alles vertel wat Joab hom opgedra het.

kjv_text: And the messenger said unto David, Surely the men prevailed against us, and came out unto us into the field, and we were upon them even unto the entering of the gate.
bsb_text: The messenger said to David, “The men overpowered us and came out against us in the field, but we drove them back to the entrance of the gate.
aov_text: Die boodskapper het naamlik aan Dawid gesê: Die manne was vir ons te sterk en het teen ons uitgetrek die veld in, maar ons het hulle teruggedruk tot by die ingang van die poort.

kjv_text: And the shooters shot from off the wall upon thy servants; and some of the king's servants be dead, and thy servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also.
bsb_text: Then the archers shot at your servants from the wall, and some of the king’s servants were killed. And your servant Uriah the Hittite is dead as well.”
aov_text: Toe het die boogskutters bo van die muur af op u dienaars geskiet, sodat daar van die koning se dienaars gesterf het, en u dienaar Uría, die Hetiet, is ook dood.

kjv_text: Then David said unto the messenger, Thus shalt thou say unto Joab, Let not this thing displease thee, for the sword devoureth one as well as another: make thy battle more strong against the city, and overthrow it: and encourage thou him.
bsb_text: Then David told the messenger, “Say this to Joab: ‘Do not let this matter upset you, for the sword devours one as well as another. Strengthen your attack against the city and demolish it.’ Encourage him with these words.”
aov_text: Daarop het Dawid aan die boodskapper gesê: So moet jy aan Joab sê: Laat hierdie saak nie so verkeerd wees in jou oë nie, want die swaard verteer die een sowel as die ander; veg net dapper teen die stad en verwoes dit. So moet jy hom moed inpraat.

kjv_text: And when the wife of Uriah heard that Uriah her husband was dead, she mourned for her husband.
bsb_text: When Uriah’s wife heard that her husband was dead, she mourned for him.
aov_text: Toe die vrou van Uría hoor dat haar man Uría dood was, het sy gerouklaag oor haar heer.

kjv_text: And when the mourning was past, David sent and fetched her to his house, and she became his wife, and bare him a son. But the thing that David had done displeased the LORD.
bsb_text: And when the time of mourning was over, David had her brought to his house, and she became his wife and bore him a son. But the thing that David had done was evil in the sight of the LORD.
aov_text: Nadat die routyd verby was, het Dawid gestuur en haar in sy huis opgeneem; en sy het sy vrou geword en vir hom ’n seun gebaar. Maar die ding wat Dawid gedoen het, was verkeerd in die oë van die HERE.

kjv_text: And the LORD sent Nathan unto David. And he came unto him, and said unto him, There were two men in one city; the one rich, and the other poor.
bsb_text: Then the LORD sent Nathan to David, and when he arrived, he said, “There were two men in a certain city, one rich and the other poor.
aov_text: DAAROM het die HERE Natan na Dawid gestuur. Toe hy by hom inkom, sê hy vir hom: Daar was twee manne in ’n sekere stad, die een was ryk en die ander arm.

kjv_text: The rich man had exceeding many flocks and herds:
bsb_text: The rich man had a great number of sheep and cattle,
aov_text: Die ryke het ’n groot menigte kleinvee en beeste gehad,

kjv_text: But the poor man had nothing, save one little ewe lamb, which he had bought and nourished up: and it grew up together with him, and with his children; it did eat of his own meat, and drank of his own cup, and lay in his bosom, and was unto him as a daughter.
bsb_text: but the poor man had nothing except one small ewe lamb that he had bought. He raised it, and it grew up with him and his children. It shared his food and drank from his cup; it slept in his arms and was like a daughter to him.
aov_text: maar die arme het glad niks gehad nie, behalwe een klein ooilammetjie wat hy gekoop en in die lewe gehou het, en wat by hom en saam met sy kinders groot geword het; dit het van sy stukkie brood geëet en uit sy beker gedrink en in sy skoot geslaap, en dit was vir hom soos ’n dogter.

kjv_text: And there came a traveller unto the rich man, and he spared to take of his own flock and of his own herd, to dress for the wayfaring man that was come unto him; but took the poor man's lamb, and dressed it for the man that was come to him.
bsb_text: Now a traveler came to the rich man, who refrained from taking one of his own sheep or cattle to prepare for the traveler who had come to him. Instead, he took the poor man’s lamb and prepared it for his guest.”
aov_text: En toe daar besoek kom by die ryk man, het hy ontsien om van sy kleinvee of beeste te neem om vir die reisiger wat by hom gekom het, iets te berei; daarom het hy die ooilam van die arm man geneem en dit berei vir die man wat by hom gekom het.

kjv_text: And David's anger was greatly kindled against the man; and he said to Nathan, As the LORD liveth, the man that hath done this thing shall surely die:
bsb_text: David burned with anger against the man and said to Nathan: “As surely as the LORD lives, the man who did this deserves to die!
aov_text: En Dawid het baie kwaad geword vir die man en aan Natan gesê: So waar as die HERE leef, die man wat dit gedoen het, moet sterwe!

kjv_text: And he shall restore the lamb fourfold, because he did this thing, and because he had no pity.
bsb_text: Because he has done this thing and has shown no pity, he must pay for the lamb four times over.”
aov_text: En die ooilam moet hy viervoudig teruggee, omdat hy hierdie ding gedoen het en geen ontferming geken het nie.

kjv_text: And Nathan said to David, Thou art the man. Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, I anointed thee king over Israel, and I delivered thee out of the hand of Saul;
bsb_text: Then Nathan said to David, “You are that man! This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘I anointed you king over Israel, and I delivered you from the hand of Saul.
aov_text: Toe sê Natan vir Dawid: U is die man! So sê die HERE, die God van Israel: Ék het jou as koning gesalf oor Israel, en Ék het jou gered uit die hand van Saul;

kjv_text: And I gave thee thy master's house, and thy master's wives into thy bosom, and gave thee the house of Israel and of Judah; and if that had been too little, I would moreover have given unto thee such and such things.
bsb_text: I gave your master’s house to you and your master’s wives into your arms. I gave you the house of Israel and Judah, and if that was not enough, I would have given you even more.
aov_text: en Ek het die huis van jou heer aan jou gegee, en die vroue van jou heer in jou skoot, en Ek het die huis van Israel en Juda aan jou gegee; en as dit te min was, sou Ek aan jou nog meer sulke dinge daarby wil voeg.

kjv_text: Wherefore hast thou despised the commandment of the LORD, to do evil in his sight? thou hast killed Uriah the Hittite with the sword, and hast taken his wife to be thy wife, and hast slain him with the sword of the children of Ammon.
bsb_text: Why then have you despised the command of the LORD by doing evil in His sight? You put Uriah the Hittite to the sword and took his wife as your own, for you have slain him with the sword of the Ammonites.
aov_text: Waarom het jy die woord van die HERE verag deur te doen wat verkeerd is in sy oë? Uría, die Hetiet, het jy met die swaard verslaan, en sy vrou het jy vir jou as vrou geneem, nadat jy hom deur die swaard van die kinders van Ammon vermoor het.

kjv_text: Now therefore the sword shall never depart from thine house; because thou hast despised me, and hast taken the wife of Uriah the Hittite to be thy wife.
bsb_text: Now, therefore, the sword will never depart from your house, because you have despised Me and have taken the wife of Uriah the Hittite to be your own.’
aov_text: En nou sal die swaard vir ewig van jou huis nie wyk nie, omrede dat jy My verag het en die vrou van Uría, die Hetiet, geneem het om jou vrou te wees.

kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will raise up evil against thee out of thine own house, and I will take thy wives before thine eyes, and give them unto thy neighbour, and he shall lie with thy wives in the sight of this sun.
bsb_text: This is what the LORD says: ‘I will raise up adversity against you from your own house. Before your very eyes I will take your wives and give them to another, and he will lie with them in broad daylight.
aov_text: So sê die HERE: Kyk, Ek sal uit jou huis onheil oor jou verwek, en jou vroue voor jou oë neem en aan jou naaste gee, sodat hy by jou vroue sal slaap voor die oog van hierdie son.

kjv_text: For thou didst it secretly: but I will do this thing before all Israel, and before the sun.
bsb_text: You have acted in secret, but I will do this thing in broad daylight before all Israel.’”
aov_text: Want jy het dit in die geheim gedoen, maar Ek sal hierdie ding doen voor die hele Israel en in die volle sonlig.

kjv_text: And David said unto Nathan, I have sinned against the LORD. And Nathan said unto David, The LORD also hath put away thy sin; thou shalt not die.
bsb_text: Then David said to Nathan, “I have sinned against the LORD.” “The LORD has taken away your sin,” Nathan replied. “You will not die.
aov_text: En Dawid sê vir Natan: Ek het gesondig teen die HERE! En Natan sê vir Dawid: So het die HERE dan ook u sonde vergewe: u sal nie sterf nie.

kjv_text: Howbeit, because by this deed thou hast given great occasion to the enemies of the LORD to blaspheme, the child also that is born unto thee shall surely die.
bsb_text: Nevertheless, because by this deed you have shown utter contempt for the word of the LORD, the son born to you will surely die.”
aov_text: Maar omdat u die vyande van die HERE deur hierdie saak aanleiding gegee het om grootliks te laster, sal die kind wat vir u gebore is, ook sekerlik sterwe.

kjv_text: And Nathan departed unto his house. And the LORD struck the child that Uriah's wife bare unto David, and it was very sick.
bsb_text: After Nathan had gone home, the LORD struck the child that Uriah’s wife had borne to David, and he became ill.
aov_text: Toe gaan Natan na sy huis. En die HERE het die kind wat die vrou van Uría vir Dawid gebaar het, getref, sodat dit ernstig siek geword het.

kjv_text: David therefore besought God for the child; and David fasted, and went in, and lay all night upon the earth.
bsb_text: David pleaded with God for the boy. He fasted and went into his house and spent the night lying in sackcloth on the ground.
aov_text: En Dawid het die aangesig van God gesoek vir die kind, en Dawid het ’n tyd lank gevas en na binne gegaan en die hele nag deur op die grond gelê.

kjv_text: And the elders of his house arose, and went to him, to raise him up from the earth: but he would not, neither did he eat bread with them.
bsb_text: The elders of his household stood beside him to help him up from the ground, but he was unwilling and would not eat anything with them.
aov_text: Daarop kom die oudstes van sy huis na hom en wou hom van die grond laat opstaan, maar hy wou nie; ook het hy geen brood saam met hulle geëet nie.

kjv_text: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that the child died. And the servants of David feared to tell him that the child was dead: for they said, Behold, while the child was yet alive, we spake unto him, and he would not hearken unto our voice: how will he then vex himself, if we tell him that the child is dead?
bsb_text: On the seventh day the child died. But David’s servants were afraid to tell him that the child was dead, for they said, “Look, while the child was alive, we spoke to him, and he would not listen to us. So how can we tell him the child is dead? He may even harm himself.”
aov_text: En op die sewende dag het die kind gesterwe; en die dienaars van Dawid was bevrees om hom te vertel dat die kind dood was, want hulle het gesê: Kyk, toe die kind nog in die lewe was, het ons met hom gespreek, maar hy het nie na ons geluister nie. Hoe kan ons dan vir hom sê: Die kind is dood!—hy kan ’n verkeerde ding doen.

kjv_text: But when David saw that his servants whispered, David perceived that the child was dead: therefore David said unto his servants, Is the child dead? And they said, He is dead.
bsb_text: When David saw that his servants were whispering to one another, he perceived that the child was dead. So he asked his servants, “Is the child dead?” “He is dead,” they replied.
aov_text: Maar toe Dawid sien dat sy dienaars onder mekaar fluister, het Dawid gemerk dat die kind dood was. En Dawid sê aan sy dienaars: Is die kind dood? En hulle antwoord: Hy is dood.

kjv_text: Then David arose from the earth, and washed, and anointed himself, and changed his apparel, and came into the house of the LORD, and worshipped: then he came to his own house; and when he required, they set bread before him, and he did eat.
bsb_text: Then David got up from the ground, washed and anointed himself, changed his clothes, and went into the house of the LORD and worshiped. Then he went to his own house, and at his request they set food before him, and he ate.
aov_text: Toe het Dawid van die grond opgestaan en hom gewas en gesalf en ander klere aangetrek en in die huis van die HERE gegaan en aanbid. Daarop het hy in sy huis gekom en gevra dat hulle brood aan hom moet voorsit; en hy het geëet.

kjv_text: Then said his servants unto him, What thing is this that thou hast done? thou didst fast and weep for the child, while it was alive; but when the child was dead, thou didst rise and eat bread.
bsb_text: “What is this you have done?” his servants asked. “While the child was alive, you fasted and wept, but when he died, you got up and ate.”
aov_text: Toe vra sy dienaars hom: Wat is dit vir ’n ding wat u gedoen het? Ter wille van die lewende kind het u gevas en geween, maar net toe die kind dood was, het u opgestaan en brood geëet.

kjv_text: And he said, While the child was yet alive, I fasted and wept: for I said, Who can tell whether GOD will be gracious to me, that the child may live?
bsb_text: David answered, “While the child was alive, I fasted and wept, for I said, ‘Who knows? The LORD may be gracious to me and let him live.’
aov_text: En hy sê: Toe die kind nog in die lewe was, het ek gevas en geween, want ek het gedink: Wie weet—die HERE kan my genadig wees, sodat die kind in die lewe bly.

kjv_text: But now he is dead, wherefore should I fast? can I bring him back again? I shall go to him, but he shall not return to me.
bsb_text: But now that he is dead, why should I fast? Can I bring him back again? I will go to him, but he will not return to me.”
aov_text: Maar nou is hy dood—waarom sou ek dan vas? Sal ek hom nog kan terugbring? Ek gaan na hom, maar hy sal na my nie terugkeer nie.

kjv_text: And David comforted Bathsheba his wife, and went in unto her, and lay with her: and she bare a son, and he called his name Solomon: and the LORD loved him.
bsb_text: Then David comforted his wife Bathsheba, and he went to her and lay with her. So she gave birth to a son, and they named him Solomon. Now the LORD loved the child
aov_text: Daarna het Dawid sy vrou Bátseba getroos en by haar ingegaan en by haar geslaap. En sy het ’n seun gebaar, en hy het hom Salomo genoem. En die HERE het hom liefgehad,

kjv_text: And he sent by the hand of Nathan the prophet; and he called his name Jedidiah, because of the LORD.
bsb_text: and sent word through Nathan the prophet to name him Jedidiah because the LORD loved him.
aov_text: en Hy het hom deur Natan, die profeet, Jedídja laat noem, ter wille van die HERE.

kjv_text: And Joab fought against Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and took the royal city.
bsb_text: Meanwhile, Joab fought against Rabbah of the Ammonites and captured the royal fortress.
aov_text: En Joab het teen Rabba van die kinders van Ammon geveg en die koningstad ingeneem.

kjv_text: And Joab sent messengers to David, and said, I have fought against Rabbah, and have taken the city of waters.
bsb_text: Then Joab sent messengers to David to say, “I have fought against Rabbah and have captured the water supply of the city.
aov_text: Daarop stuur Joab boodskappers na Dawid om te sê: Ek het teen Rabba geveg, ook het ek die waterstad ingeneem.

kjv_text: Now therefore gather the rest of the people together, and encamp against the city, and take it: lest I take the city, and it be called after my name.
bsb_text: Now, therefore, assemble the rest of the troops, lay siege to the city, and capture it. Otherwise I will capture the city, and it will be named after me.”
aov_text: Maak u dan nou die orige manskappe bymekaar en beleër die stad en neem dit in, sodat ék nie die stad inneem en my naam daaroor uitgeroep word nie.

kjv_text: And David gathered all the people together, and went to Rabbah, and fought against it, and took it.
bsb_text: So David assembled all the troops and went to Rabbah; and he fought against it and captured it.
aov_text: Toe maak Dawid al die manskappe bymekaar, en hy het weggetrek na Rabba, daarteen geveg en dit ingeneem.

kjv_text: And he took their king's crown from off his head, the weight whereof was a talent of gold with the precious stones: and it was set on David's head. And he brought forth the spoil of the city in great abundance.
bsb_text: Then he took the crown from the head of their king. It weighed a talent of gold and was set with precious stones, and it was placed on David’s head. And David took a great amount of plunder from the city.
aov_text: En hy het die kroon van hulle koning van sy hoof afgeneem, waarvan die gewig ’n talent goud was, met ’n kosbare steen daarin, en dit het op die hoof van Dawid gekom; en ’n baie groot buit van die stad het hy uitgebring.

kjv_text: And he brought forth the people that were therein, and put them under saws, and under harrows of iron, and under axes of iron, and made them pass through the brick-kiln: and thus did he unto all the cities of the children of Ammon. So David and all the people returned unto Jerusalem.
bsb_text: David brought out the people who were there and put them to work with saws, iron picks, and axes, and he made them work at the brick kilns. He did the same to all the Ammonite cities. Then David and all his troops returned to Jerusalem.
aov_text: En die manskappe wat daarin was, het hy uitgebring en hy het hulle aan die werk gesit by die saag en by ysterpenne en ysterbyle, en hulle laat oorbring na die steenoonde; en so het hy met al die stede van die kinders van Ammon gedoen. Toe het Dawid met al die manskappe na Jerusalem teruggegaan.

kjv_text: And it came to pass after this, that Absalom the son of David had a fair sister, whose name was Tamar; and Amnon the son of David loved her.
bsb_text: After some time, David’s son Amnon fell in love with Tamar, the beautiful sister of David’s son Absalom.
aov_text: EN daarna het dít gebeur. Absalom, die seun van Dawid, het naamlik ’n mooi suster gehad met die naam van Tamar, en Amnon, die seun van Dawid, was verlief op haar.

kjv_text: And Amnon was so vexed, that he fell sick for his sister Tamar; for she was a virgin; and Amnon thought it hard for him to do anything to her.
bsb_text: Amnon was sick with frustration over his sister Tamar, for she was a virgin, and it seemed implausible for him to do anything to her.
aov_text: En Amnon het dit hom so aangetrek, dat hy siek was oor sy suster Tamar; want sy was ’n jongmeisie, en dit was in Amnon se oë onmoontlik om haar iets aan te doen.

kjv_text: But Amnon had a friend, whose name was Jonadab, the son of Shimeah David's brother: and Jonadab was a very subtil man.
bsb_text: Now Amnon had a friend named Jonadab, the son of David’s brother Shimeah. Jonadab was a very shrewd man,
aov_text: Maar Amnon het ’n vriend gehad, met die naam van Jónadab, ’n seun van Dawid se broer Símea; en Jónadab was ’n baie skrander man.

kjv_text: And he said unto him, Why art thou, being the king's son, lean from day to day? wilt thou not tell me? And Amnon said unto him, I love Tamar, my brother Absalom's sister.
bsb_text: so he asked Amnon, “Why are you, the son of the king, so depressed morning after morning? Won’t you tell me?” Amnon replied, “I am in love with Tamar, my brother Absalom’s sister.”
aov_text: En dié vra hom: Waarom lyk jy môre vir môre so bedruk, seun van die koning? Sal jy my dit nie te kenne gee nie? Toe sê Amnon vir hom: Ek is verlief op Tamar, die suster van my broer Absalom.

kjv_text: And Jonadab said unto him, Lay thee down on thy bed, and make thyself sick: and when thy father cometh to see thee, say unto him, I pray thee, let my sister Tamar come, and give me meat, and dress the meat in my sight, that I may see it, and eat it at her hand.
bsb_text: Jonadab told him, “Lie down on your bed and pretend you are ill. When your father comes to see you, say to him, ‘Please let my sister Tamar come and give me something to eat. Let her prepare it in my sight so I may watch her and eat it from her hand.’”
aov_text: Toe sê Jónadab vir hom: Gaan lê op jou bed en hou jou siek. As jou vader dan kom om jou te sien, moet jy vir hom sê: Laat my suster Tamar tog kom en my iets gee om te eet en die ete voor my oë klaarmaak, dat ek dit kan sien en uit haar hand eet.

kjv_text: So Amnon lay down, and made himself sick: and when the king was come to see him, Amnon said unto the king, I pray thee, let Tamar my sister come, and make me a couple of cakes in my sight, that I may eat at her hand.
bsb_text: So Amnon lay down and feigned illness. When the king came to see him, Amnon said, “Please let my sister Tamar come and make a couple of cakes in my sight, so that I may eat from her hand.”
aov_text: En Amnon het gaan lê en hom siek gehou. Toe die koning kom om hom te sien, sê Amnon aan die koning: Laat my suster Tamar tog kom en voor my oë twee koekies maak, dat ek uit haar hand kan eet.

kjv_text: Then David sent home to Tamar, saying, Go now to thy brother Amnon's house, and dress him meat.
bsb_text: Then David sent word to Tamar at the palace: “Please go to the house of Amnon your brother and prepare a meal for him.”
aov_text: Daarop het Dawid na Tamar in die huis gestuur en gesê: Gaan tog in die huis van jou broer Amnon en maak vir hom ete klaar.

kjv_text: So Tamar went to her brother Amnon's house; and he was laid down. And she took flour, and kneaded it, and made cakes in his sight, and did bake the cakes.
bsb_text: So Tamar went to the house of her brother Amnon, who was lying down. She took some dough, kneaded it, made cakes in his sight, and baked them.
aov_text: Toe gaan Tamar in die huis van haar broer Amnon terwyl hy daar lê, en sy het deeg geneem en geknie en koekies voor sy oë gemaak en die koekies gebak.

kjv_text: And she took a pan, and poured them out before him; but he refused to eat. And Amnon said, Have out all men from me. And they went out every man from him.
bsb_text: Then she brought the pan and set it down before him, but he refused to eat. “Send everyone away!” said Amnon. And everyone went out.
aov_text: En sy het die pan geneem en dit voor hom omgekeer, maar hy het geweier om te eet. En Amnon het gesê: Laat almal van my weggaan! En almal het van hom weggegaan.

kjv_text: And Amnon said unto Tamar, Bring the meat into the chamber, that I may eat of thine hand. And Tamar took the cakes which she had made, and brought them into the chamber to Amnon her brother.
bsb_text: Then Amnon said to Tamar, “Bring the food into the bedroom, so that I may eat it from your hand.” Tamar took the cakes she had made and went to her brother Amnon’s bedroom.
aov_text: Toe sê Amnon aan Tamar: Bring die ete in die slaapkamer, dat ek uit jou hand kan eet. En Tamar het die koekies wat sy gemaak het, geneem en vir haar broer Amnon in die slaapkamer gebring.

kjv_text: And when she had brought them unto him to eat, he took hold of her, and said unto her, Come lie with me, my sister.
bsb_text: And when she had brought them to him to eat, he took hold of her and said, “Come lie with me, my sister!”
aov_text: Terwyl sy dit nader bring na hom om te eet, het hy haar gegryp en vir haar gesê: Kom lê by my, my suster!

kjv_text: And she answered him, Nay, my brother, do not force me; for no such thing ought to be done in Israel: do not thou this folly.
bsb_text: “No, my brother!” she cried. “Do not humiliate me, for such a thing should never be done in Israel. Do not do this disgraceful thing!
aov_text: Maar sy sê vir hom: Asseblief nie, my broer, onteer my nie, want so iets mag in Israel nie gedoen word nie; moenie so ’n skande begaan nie.

kjv_text: And I, whither shall I cause my shame to go? and as for thee, thou shalt be as one of the fools in Israel. Now therefore, I pray thee, speak unto the king; for he will not withhold me from thee.
bsb_text: Where could I ever take my shame? And you would be like one of the fools in Israel! Please speak to the king, for he will not withhold me from you.”
aov_text: Waar sou ék tog met my skande heen, en jý sou soos een van die dwase in Israel wees; spreek dan tog nou met die koning, want hy sal my nie van jou terughou nie.

kjv_text: Howbeit he would not hearken unto her voice: but, being stronger than she, forced her, and lay with her.
bsb_text: But Amnon refused to listen to her, and being stronger, he violated her and lay with her.
aov_text: Maar hy wou nie na haar luister nie en het haar oorweldig en haar onteer en met haar gemeenskap gehad.

kjv_text: Then Amnon hated her exceedingly; so that the hatred wherewith he hated her was greater than the love wherewith he had loved her. And Amnon said unto her, Arise, be gone.
bsb_text: Then Amnon hated Tamar with such intensity that his hatred was greater than the love he previously had. “Get up!” he said to her. “Be gone!”
aov_text: Toe het Amnon ’n baie groot afkeer van haar gekry, ja, die afkeer wat hy van haar gekry het, was groter as die liefde waarmee hy haar liefgehad het; en Amnon sê vir haar: Staan op, gaan weg!

kjv_text: And she said unto him, There is no cause: this evil in sending me away is greater than the other that thou didst unto me. But he would not hearken unto her.
bsb_text: “No,” she replied, “sending me away is worse than this great wrong you have already done to me!” But he refused to listen to her.
aov_text: Maar sy sê vir hom: Aangaande die kwaad om my weg te stuur, dit is groter as die ander wat jy my aangedoen het. Maar hy wou nie na haar luister nie.

kjv_text: Then he called his servant that ministered unto him, and said, Put now this woman out from me, and bolt the door after her.
bsb_text: Instead, he called to his attendant and said, “Throw this woman out and bolt the door behind her!”
aov_text: Daarop roep hy sy kneg wat hom bedien, en sê: Stuur hierdie vrou tog van my af weg buitentoe, en sluit die deur agter haar toe.

kjv_text: And she had a garment of divers colours upon her: for with such robes were the king's daughters that were virgins apparelled. Then his servant brought her out, and bolted the door after her.
bsb_text: So Amnon’s attendant threw her out and bolted the door behind her. Now Tamar was wearing a robe of many colors, because this is what the king’s virgin daughters wore.
aov_text: En sy het ’n lang rok met moue aangehad, want sulke mantels het die koninklike dogters wat maagde was, gedra. Toe sy bediende haar buitentoe uitgebring en die deur agter haar toegesluit het,

kjv_text: And Tamar put ashes on her head, and rent her garment of divers colours that was on her, and laid her hand on her head, and went on crying.
bsb_text: And Tamar put ashes on her head and tore her robe. And putting her hand on her head, she went away crying bitterly.
aov_text: het Tamar as op haar hoof gestrooi en daardie lang rok met moue geskeur; daarby het sy haar hand op haar hoof gelê en aldeur geloop en weeklaag.

kjv_text: And Absalom her brother said unto her, Hath Amnon thy brother been with thee? but hold now thy peace, my sister: he is thy brother; regard not this thing. So Tamar remained desolate in her brother Absalom's house.
bsb_text: Her brother Absalom said to her, “Has your brother Amnon been with you? Be quiet for now, my sister. He is your brother. Do not take this thing to heart.” So Tamar lived as a desolate woman in the house of her brother Absalom.
aov_text: En haar broer Absalom sê vir haar: Was jou broer Amnon by jou? Swyg dan nou, my suster! Hy is jou broer, sit jou hart nie op hierdie saak nie. So het Tamar dan as ’n verlatene in die huis van haar broer Absalom gebly.

kjv_text: But when king David heard of all these things, he was very wroth.
bsb_text: When King David heard all this, he was furious.
aov_text: Toe koning Dawid al hierdie dinge hoor, het hy baie kwaad geword.

kjv_text: And Absalom spake unto his brother Amnon neither good nor bad: for Absalom hated Amnon, because he had forced his sister Tamar.
bsb_text: And Absalom never said a word to Amnon, either good or bad, because he hated Amnon for disgracing his sister Tamar.
aov_text: Maar Absalom het met Amnon geen kwaad of goed gepraat nie, maar Absalom het Amnon gehaat, omdat hy sy suster Tamar onteer het.

kjv_text: And it came to pass after two full years, that Absalom had sheepshearers in Baalhazor, which is beside Ephraim: and Absalom invited all the king's sons.
bsb_text: Two years later, when Absalom’s sheepshearers were at Baal-hazor near Ephraim, he invited all the sons of the king.
aov_text: En ná twee volle jare het Absalom skeerders gehad in Baäl-Hasor wat by Efraim is, en Absalom het al die seuns van die koning genooi.

kjv_text: And Absalom came to the king, and said, Behold now, thy servant hath sheepshearers; let the king, I beseech thee, and his servants go with thy servant.
bsb_text: And he went to the king and said, “Your servant has just hired shearers. Will the king and his servants please come with me?”
aov_text: Daarop kom Absalom by die koning en sê: Kyk tog, u dienaar het skeerders. Laat die koning en sy dienaars tog met u dienaar saamgaan.

kjv_text: And the king said to Absalom, Nay, my son, let us not all now go, lest we be chargeable unto thee. And he pressed him: howbeit he would not go, but blessed him.
bsb_text: “No, my son,” the king replied, “we should not all go, or we would be a burden to you.” Although Absalom urged him, he was not willing to go, but gave him his blessing.
aov_text: Maar die koning sê vir Absalom: Ag nee, my seun, laat ons tog nie almal saamgaan nie, sodat ons jou nie lastig val nie. En hy het by hom aangehou, maar hy wou nie gaan nie en het hom die afskeidseën gegee.

kjv_text: Then said Absalom, If not, I pray thee, let my brother Amnon go with us. And the king said unto him, Why should he go with thee?
bsb_text: “If not,” said Absalom, “please let my brother Amnon go with us.” “Why should he go with you?” the king asked.
aov_text: Daarop sê Absalom: So nie, laat my broer Amnon tog saam met ons gaan. Maar die koning sê vir hom: Waarom moet hy met jou saamgaan?

kjv_text: But Absalom pressed him, that he let Amnon and all the king's sons go with him.
bsb_text: But Absalom urged him, so the king sent Amnon and the rest of his sons.
aov_text: Toe Absalom dan by hom aanhou, het hy Amnon en al die seuns van die koning met hom saam laat gaan.

kjv_text: Now Absalom had commanded his servants, saying, Mark ye now when Amnon's heart is merry with wine, and when I say unto you, Smite Amnon; then kill him, fear not: have not I commanded you? be courageous, and be valiant.
bsb_text: Now Absalom had ordered his young men, “Watch Amnon until his heart is merry with wine, and when I order you to strike Amnon down, you are to kill him. Do not be afraid. Have I not commanded you? Be courageous and valiant!”
aov_text: En Absalom het sy dienaars bevel gegee en gesê: Let tog op, net soos Amnon se hart vrolik is van die wyn en ek vir julle sê: Slaan Amnon dood! dan moet julle hom doodmaak. Wees nie bevrees nie; het ék julle dit nie beveel nie? Wees sterk en wees wakker manne.

kjv_text: And the servants of Absalom did unto Amnon as Absalom had commanded. Then all the king's sons arose, and every man gat him up upon his mule, and fled.
bsb_text: So Absalom’s young men did to Amnon just as Absalom had ordered. Then all the other sons of the king got up, and each one fled on his mule.
aov_text: En die dienaars van Absalom het met Amnon gedoen soos Absalom hulle beveel het. Toe het al die seuns van die koning opgestaan, en hulle het elkeen op sy muil geklim en gevlug.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, while they were in the way, that tidings came to David, saying, Absalom hath slain all the king's sons, and there is not one of them left.
bsb_text: While they were on the way, a report reached David: “Absalom has struck down all the sons of the king; not one of them is left!”
aov_text: Terwyl hulle op pad was, kom die gerug by Dawid: Absalom het al die seuns van die koning doodgeslaan en nie een van hulle het oorgebly nie.

kjv_text: Then the king arose, and tare his garments, and lay on the earth; and all his servants stood by with their clothes rent.
bsb_text: Then the king stood up, tore his clothes, and lay down on the ground; and all his servants stood by with their clothes torn.
aov_text: Toe staan die koning op en skeur sy klere en gaan lê op die grond, terwyl al sy dienaars met geskeurde klere daarby staan.

kjv_text: And Jonadab, the son of Shimeah David's brother, answered and said, Let not my lord suppose that they have slain all the young men the king's sons; for Amnon only is dead: for by the appointment of Absalom this hath been determined from the day that he forced his sister Tamar.
bsb_text: But Jonadab, the son of David’s brother Shimeah, spoke up: “My lord must not think they have killed all the sons of the king, for only Amnon is dead. In fact, Absalom has planned this since the day Amnon violated his sister Tamar.
aov_text: Maar Jónadab, die seun van Dawid se broer Símea, het geantwoord en gesê: My heer moet nie dink dat hulle al die jongmanne, die seuns van die koning, gedood het nie, maar Amnon alleen is dood, want dit was aan die gesig van Absalom te sien van die dag af dat hy sy suster Tamar onteer het.

kjv_text: Now therefore let not my lord the king take the thing to his heart, to think that all the king's sons are dead: for Amnon only is dead.
bsb_text: So now, my lord the king, do not take to heart the report that all the sons of the king are dead. Only Amnon is dead.”
aov_text: My heer die koning moet dit dan nou nie ter harte neem en dink al die seuns van die koning is dood nie. Maar Amnon alleen is dood.

kjv_text: But Absalom fled. And the young man that kept the watch lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came much people by the way of the hill side behind him.
bsb_text: Meanwhile, Absalom had fled. When the young man standing watch looked up, he saw many people coming down the road west of him, along the side of the hill. And the watchman went and reported to the king, “I see men coming from the direction of Horonaim, along the side of the hill.”
aov_text: En Absalom het gevlug. Toe die jongman wat op wag staan, sy oë opslaan, sien hy dat daar ’n groot skare kom van ’n pad agter hom, aan die kant van die berg.

kjv_text: And Jonadab said unto the king, Behold, the king's sons come: as thy servant said, so it is.
bsb_text: So Jonadab said to the king, “Look, the sons of the king have arrived! It is just as your servant said.”
aov_text: En Jónadab sê aan die koning: Kyk, daar kom die seuns van die koning; volgens die woord van u dienaar, so het dit gebeur.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, as soon as he had made an end of speaking, that, behold, the king's sons came, and lifted up their voice and wept: and the king also and all his servants wept very sore.
bsb_text: And as he finished speaking, the sons of the king came in, wailing loudly. Then the king and all his servants also wept very bitterly.
aov_text: En net toe hy klaar gespreek het—daar kom die seuns van die koning aan en verhef hulle stem en ween. En ook die koning en al sy dienaars het geween met ’n baie groot geween.

kjv_text: But Absalom fled, and went to Talmai, the son of Ammihud, king of Geshur. And David mourned for his son every day.
bsb_text: Now Absalom fled and went to Talmai son of Ammihud, the king of Geshur. But David mourned for his son every day.
aov_text: Maar Absalom het gevlug en na Tálmai, die seun van Ammíhur, die koning van Gesur, gegaan. En Dawid het al die dae gerou oor sy seun.

kjv_text: So Absalom fled, and went to Geshur, and was there three years.
bsb_text: After Absalom had fled and gone to Geshur, he stayed there three years.
aov_text: En Absalom het gevlug en na Gesur gegaan, en hy was daar drie jaar lank.

kjv_text: And the soul of king David longed to go forth unto Absalom: for he was comforted concerning Amnon, seeing he was dead.
bsb_text: And King David longed to go to Absalom, for he had been consoled over Amnon’s death.
aov_text: En die gees van koning Dawid het baie verlang om na Absalom uit te gaan, want hy het homself getroos oor Amnon, dat hy dood was.

kjv_text: Now Joab the son of Zeruiah perceived that the king's heart was toward Absalom.
bsb_text: Now Joab son of Zeruiah perceived that the king’s heart longed for Absalom.
aov_text: TOE Joab, die seun van Serúja, merk dat die hart van die koning aan Absalom verkleef was,

kjv_text: And Joab sent to Tekoah, and fetched thence a wise woman, and said unto her, I pray thee, feign thyself to be a mourner, and put on now mourning apparel, and anoint not thyself with oil, but be as a woman that had a long time mourned for the dead:
bsb_text: So Joab sent to Tekoa to bring a wise woman from there. He told her, “Please pretend to be a mourner; put on clothes for mourning and do not anoint yourself with oil. Act like a woman who has mourned for the dead a long time.
aov_text: het Joab na Tekóa gestuur en daarvandaan ’n skrander vrou laat haal en aan haar gesê: Stel jou tog aan soos een wat treur, en trek rouklere aan; en salf jou nie met olie nie, maar hou jou soos ’n vrou wat al baie dae rou oor ’n dode.

kjv_text: And come to the king, and speak on this manner unto him. So Joab put the words in her mouth.
bsb_text: Then go to the king and speak these words to him.” And Joab put the words in her mouth.
aov_text: Gaan dan na die koning en spreek met hom volgens hierdie woord. En Joab het die woorde in haar mond gelê.

kjv_text: And when the woman of Tekoah spake to the king, she fell on her face to the ground, and did obeisance, and said, Help, O king.
bsb_text: When the woman from Tekoa went to the king, she fell facedown in homage and said, “Help me, O king!”
aov_text: En die vrou uit Tekóa het by die koning ingekom en op haar aangesig op die grond geval en gebuig en gesê: Help, o koning!

kjv_text: And the king said unto her, What aileth thee? And she answered, I am indeed a widow woman, and mine husband is dead.
bsb_text: “What troubles you?” the king asked her. “Indeed,” she said, “I am a widow, for my husband is dead.
aov_text: Toe vra die koning haar: Wat wil jy hê? En sy sê: Voorwaar, ek is ’n weduwee en my man is dood.

kjv_text: And thy handmaid had two sons, and they two strove together in the field, and there was none to part them, but the one smote the other, and slew him.
bsb_text: And your maidservant had two sons who were fighting in the field with no one to separate them, and one struck the other and killed him.
aov_text: En u dienares het twee seuns gehad, en hulle twee het met mekaar geveg in die veld; en daar was niemand om hulle uitmekaar te maak nie, sodat die een die ander neergeslaan en hom gedood het.

kjv_text: And, behold, the whole family is risen against thine handmaid, and they said, Deliver him that smote his brother, that we may kill him, for the life of his brother whom he slew; and we will destroy the heir also: and so they shall quench my coal which is left, and shall not leave to my husband neither name nor remainder upon the earth.
bsb_text: Now the whole clan has risen up against your maidservant and said, ‘Hand over the one who struck down his brother, that we may put him to death for the life of the brother whom he killed. Then we will cut off the heir as well!’ So they would extinguish my one remaining ember by not preserving my husband’s name or posterity on the earth.”
aov_text: En kyk, toe staan die hele geslag op teen u dienares, en hulle sê: Gee hom wat sy broer doodgeslaan het, dat ons hom kan doodmaak vir die lewe van sy broer wat hy vermoor het, ja, ook die erfgenaam kan verdelg. So wil hulle dan my vuurkool wat oorgebly het, uitdoof om vir my man geen naam of oorblyfsel op die aardbodem te laat bly nie.

kjv_text: And the king said unto the woman, Go to thine house, and I will give charge concerning thee.
bsb_text: “Go home,” the king said to the woman, “and I will give orders on your behalf.”
aov_text: En die koning antwoord die vrou: Gaan na jou huis, en ek sal oor jou bevel gee.

kjv_text: And the woman of Tekoah said unto the king, My lord, O king, the iniquity be on me, and on my father's house: and the king and his throne be guiltless.
bsb_text: But the woman of Tekoa said to the king, “My lord the king, may any blame be on me and on my father’s house, and may the king and his throne be guiltless.”
aov_text: Daarop sê die vrou uit Tekóa aan die koning: Op my, my heer die koning, en op my familie sal die skuld rus, maar die koning en sy troon is onskuldig.

kjv_text: And the king said, Whosoever saith ought unto thee, bring him to me, and he shall not touch thee any more.
bsb_text: “If anyone speaks to you,” said the king, “bring him to me, and he will not trouble you again!”
aov_text: En die koning antwoord: Elkeen wat met jou spreek, moet jy na my bring, dan sal hy jou verder nie meer aanraak nie.

kjv_text: Then said she, I pray thee, let the king remember the LORD thy God, that thou wouldest not suffer the revengers of blood to destroy any more, lest they destroy my son. And he said, As the LORD liveth, there shall not one hair of thy son fall to the earth.
bsb_text: “Please,” she replied, “may the king invoke the LORD your God to prevent the avenger of blood from increasing the devastation, so that my son may not be destroyed!” “As surely as the LORD lives,” he vowed, “not a hair of your son’s head will fall to the ground.”
aov_text: En sy sê: Laat die koning tog dink aan die HERE u God, sodat die bloedwreker nie te veel vernieling aanrig en hulle my seun nie verdelg nie. Toe sê hy: So waar as die HERE leef, nie een haar van jou seun sal op die grond val nie!

kjv_text: Then the woman said, Let thine handmaid, I pray thee, speak one word unto my lord the king. And he said, Say on.
bsb_text: Then the woman said, “Please, may your servant speak a word to my lord the king?” “Speak,” he replied.
aov_text: En die vrou vra: Laat u dienares tog ’n woord met my heer die koning spreek. En hy antwoord: Spreek.

kjv_text: And the woman said, Wherefore then hast thou thought such a thing against the people of God? for the king doth speak this thing as one which is faulty, in that the king doth not fetch home again his banished.
bsb_text: The woman asked, “Why have you devised a thing like this against the people of God? When the king says this, does he not convict himself, since he has not brought back his own banished son?
aov_text: Toe sê die vrou: Waarom het u dan so iets bedink teen die volk van God? Want daardeur dat die koning hierdie woord spreek, is hy soos ’n skuldige deurdat die koning sy eie verstotene nie laat terugkom nie.

kjv_text: For we must needs die, and are as water spilt on the ground, which cannot be gathered up again; neither doth God respect any person: yet doth he devise means, that his banished be not expelled from him.
bsb_text: For surely we will die and be like water poured out on the ground, which cannot be recovered. Yet God does not take away a life; but He devises ways that the banished one may not be cast out from Him.
aov_text: Want ons moet eenmaal sterwe en soos water wees wat uitgegooi word op die grond, wat ’n mens nie weer kan versamel nie; en God neem die lewe nie weg nie, maar Hy koester gedagtes om ’n verstotene nie van Hom af te stoot nie.

kjv_text: Now therefore that I am come to speak of this thing unto my lord the king, it is because the people have made me afraid: and thy handmaid said, I will now speak unto the king; it may be that the king will perform the request of his handmaid.
bsb_text: Now therefore, I have come to present this matter to my lord the king because the people have made me afraid. Your servant thought, ‘I will speak to the king. Perhaps he will grant the request of his maidservant.
