bsb_text: So he swayed the hearts of all the men of Judah as though they were one man, and they sent word to the king: “Return, you and all your servants.”
aov_text: So het hy dan die hart van al die manne van Juda sonder uitsondering geneig, sodat hulle die koning laat weet het: Kom terug, u met al u dienaars.

kjv_text: So the king returned, and came to Jordan. And Judah came to Gilgal, to go to meet the king, to conduct the king over Jordan.
bsb_text: So the king returned, and when he arrived at the Jordan, the men of Judah came to Gilgal to meet him and escort him across the Jordan.
aov_text: Daarop het die koning teruggegaan en by die Jordaan aangekom; en Juda het na Gilgal gekom om die koning tegemoet te gaan, om die koning oor die Jordaan te bring.

kjv_text: And Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite, which was of Bahurim, hasted and came down with the men of Judah to meet king David.
bsb_text: Then Shimei son of Gera, a Benjamite from Bahurim, hurried down with the men of Judah to meet King David,
aov_text: En Símeï, die seun van Géra, die Benjaminiet, wat uit Bahúrim was, het hom gehaas en saam met die manne van Juda afgekom om koning Dawid te ontmoet,

kjv_text: And there were a thousand men of Benjamin with him, and Ziba the servant of the house of Saul, and his fifteen sons and his twenty servants with him; and they went over Jordan before the king.
bsb_text: along with a thousand men of Benjamin, as well as Ziba the steward of the house of Saul and his fifteen sons and twenty servants. They rushed down to the Jordan before the king
aov_text: en duisend man uit Benjamin was saam met hom; verder Siba, die dienaar van Saul se huis, met sy vyftien seuns en sy twintig slawe saam met hom; en hulle het voor die koning al die Jordaan bereik.

kjv_text: And there went over a ferry boat to carry over the king's household, and to do what he thought good. And Shimei the son of Gera fell down before the king, as he was come over Jordan;
bsb_text: and crossed at the ford to carry over the king’s household and to do what was good in his sight. When Shimei son of Gera crossed the Jordan, he fell down before the king
aov_text: En die pont het heen en weer gevaar om die huis van die koning oor te bring en te doen wat goed was in sy oë. En Símeï, die seun van Géra, het voor die koning neergeval toe hy die Jordaan sou oortrek

kjv_text: And said unto the king, Let not my lord impute iniquity unto me, neither do thou remember that which thy servant did perversely the day that my lord the king went out of Jerusalem, that the king should take it to his heart.
bsb_text: and said, “My lord, do not hold me guilty, and do not remember your servant’s wrongdoing on the day my lord the king left Jerusalem. May the king not take it to heart.
aov_text: en aan die koning gesê: My heer moet my die skuld nie toereken en daar nie aan dink hoe u dienaar verkeerd gehandel het op die dag dat my heer die koning uit Jerusalem uitgetrek het, deurdat die koning dit ter harte sou neem nie.

kjv_text: For thy servant doth know that I have sinned: therefore, behold, I am come the first this day of all the house of Joseph to go down to meet my lord the king.
bsb_text: For your servant knows that I have sinned, so here I am today as the first of all the house of Joseph to come down to meet my lord the king.”
aov_text: Want u dienaar weet dat ék gesondig het; maar soos u sien, vandag het ek die eerste van die hele huis van Josef afgekom om my heer die koning tegemoet te gaan.

kjv_text: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered and said, Shall not Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed the LORD's anointed?
bsb_text: But Abishai son of Zeruiah said, “Shouldn’t Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed the LORD’s anointed?”
aov_text: Toe het Abísai, die seun van Serúja, geantwoord en gesê: Moet Símeï nie hieroor gedood word, dat hy die gesalfde van die HERE gevloek het nie?

kjv_text: And David said, What have I to do with you, ye sons of Zeruiah, that ye should this day be adversaries unto me? shall there any man be put to death this day in Israel? for do not I know that I am this day king over Israel?
bsb_text: And David replied, “Sons of Zeruiah, what have I to do with you, that you should be my adversaries today? Should any man be put to death in Israel today? Am I not indeed aware that today I am king over Israel?”
aov_text: Maar Dawid sê: Wat het ek met julle te doen, seuns van Serúja, dat julle vandag my teëstanders word? Sou iemand vandag in Israel gedood word? Want weet ek dan nie dat ek vandag koning oor Israel is nie?

kjv_text: Therefore the king said unto Shimei, Thou shalt not die. And the king sware unto him.
bsb_text: So the king said to Shimei, “You shall not die.” And the king swore an oath to him.
aov_text: Daarop sê die koning aan Símeï: Jy sal nie sterf nie. En die koning het vir hom gesweer.

kjv_text: And Mephibosheth the son of Saul came down to meet the king, and had neither dressed his feet, nor trimmed his beard, nor washed his clothes, from the day the king departed until the day he came again in peace.
bsb_text: Then Mephibosheth, Saul’s grandson, went down to meet the king. He had not cared for his feet or trimmed his mustache or washed his clothes from the day the king had left until the day he returned safely.
aov_text: Mefibóset, die kleinseun van Saul, het ook afgekom die koning tegemoet, en hy het sy voete nie skoongemaak en sy baard nie geskeer en sy klere nie gewas van die dag af dat die koning weggegaan het tot op die dag dat hy behoue teruggekom het nie;

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when he was come to Jerusalem to meet the king, that the king said unto him, Wherefore wentest not thou with me, Mephibosheth?
bsb_text: And he came from Jerusalem to meet the king, who asked him, “Mephibosheth, why did you not go with me?”
aov_text: en toe hy in Jerusalem die koning tegemoetkom, sê die koning vir hom: Waarom het jy nie met my saamgetrek nie, Mefibóset?

kjv_text: And he answered, My lord, O king, my servant deceived me: for thy servant said, I will saddle me an ass, that I may ride thereon, and go to the king; because thy servant is lame.
bsb_text: “My lord the king,” he replied, “because I am lame, I said, ‘I will have my donkey saddled so that I may ride on it and go with the king.’ But my servant Ziba deceived me,
aov_text: En hy antwoord: My heer die koning, my dienaar het my bedrieg; want u dienaar het gedink: Ek wil vir my die esel laat opsaal, dat ek daarop kan ry en met die koning kan saamtrek, want u dienaar is lam.

kjv_text: And he hath slandered thy servant unto my lord the king; but my lord the king is as an angel of God: do therefore what is good in thine eyes.
bsb_text: and he has slandered your servant to my lord the king. Yet my lord the king is like the angel of God, so do what is good in your eyes.
aov_text: Hy het ewenwel u dienaar by my heer die koning belaster, maar my heer die koning is soos ’n engel van God: doen dan wat goed is in u oë.

kjv_text: For all of my father's house were but dead men before my lord the king: yet didst thou set thy servant among them that did eat at thine own table. What right therefore have I yet to cry any more unto the king?
bsb_text: For all the house of my grandfather deserves death from my lord the king, yet you have set your servant among those who eat at your table. What further right, then, do I have to keep appealing to the king?”
aov_text: Want my hele familie was by my heer die koning niks anders as manne wat die dood verdien nie; tog het u u dienaar opgeneem onder die wat aan u tafel eet: watter regsaanspraak het ek dan nog meer om my verder op die koning te beroep?

kjv_text: And the king said unto him, Why speakest thou any more of thy matters? I have said, Thou and Ziba divide the land.
bsb_text: The king replied, “Why say any more? I hereby declare that you and Ziba are to divide the land.”
aov_text: Toe sê die koning vir hom: Waarom nog meer woorde? Ek sê: Jy en Siba moet die grond verdeel.

kjv_text: And Mephibosheth said unto the king, Yea, let him take all, forasmuch as my lord the king is come again in peace unto his own house.
bsb_text: And Mephibosheth said to the king, “Instead, since my lord the king has safely come to his own house, let Ziba take it all!”
aov_text: En Mefibóset het die koning geantwoord: Hy kan ook alles neem nadat my heer die koning behoue in sy huis gekom het.

kjv_text: And Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim, and went over Jordan with the king, to conduct him over Jordan.
bsb_text: Now Barzillai the Gileadite had come down from Rogelim to cross the Jordan with the king and send him on his way from there.
aov_text: Barsíllai, die Gileadiet, het ook afgekom van Rógelim en met die koning oor die Jordaan getrek om hom oor die Jordaan weg te bring.

kjv_text: Now Barzillai was a very aged man, even fourscore years old: and he had provided the king of sustenance while he lay at Mahanaim; for he was a very great man.
bsb_text: Barzillai was quite old, eighty years of age, and since he was a very wealthy man, he had provided for the king while he stayed in Mahanaim.
aov_text: En Barsíllai was baie oud, ’n man van tagtig jaar, en hy het die koning onderhou gedurende sy verblyf in Mahanáim, want hy was ’n baie vermoënde man.

kjv_text: And the king said unto Barzillai, Come thou over with me, and I will feed thee with me in Jerusalem.
bsb_text: The king said to Barzillai, “Cross over with me, and I will provide for you at my side in Jerusalem.”
aov_text: Toe sê die koning vir Barsíllai: Trek jy saam met my oor, dan sal ek jou by my in Jerusalem onderhou.

kjv_text: And Barzillai said unto the king, How long have I to live, that I should go up with the king unto Jerusalem?
bsb_text: But Barzillai replied, “How many years of my life remain, that I should go up to Jerusalem with the king?
aov_text: Maar Barsíllai het die koning geantwoord: Hoeveel sal die dae van my lewensjare dan wees, dat ek saam met die koning moet opgaan na Jerusalem?

kjv_text: I am this day fourscore years old: and can I discern between good and evil? can thy servant taste what I eat or what I drink? can I hear any more the voice of singing men and singing women? wherefore then should thy servant be yet a burden unto my lord the king?
bsb_text: I am now eighty years old. Can I discern what is good and what is not? Can your servant taste what he eats or drinks? Can I still hear the voice of singing men and women? Why should your servant be an added burden to my lord the king?
aov_text: Ek is vandag tagtig jaar oud. Kan ek tussen goed en kwaad onderskei? of sal u dienaar kan proe wat ek eet en wat ek drink? of sal ek nog kan aanhoor die stem van die sangers en die sangeresse? Waarom sal u dienaar my heer die koning dan nog tot ’n las wees?

kjv_text: Thy servant will go a little way over Jordan with the king: and why should the king recompense it me with such a reward?
bsb_text: Your servant could go with the king only a short distance past the Jordan; why should the king repay me with such a reward?
aov_text: U dienaar kan net ’n entjie saam met die koning trek oor die Jordaan. Waarom tog sou die koning hierdie vergelding aan my doen?

kjv_text: Let thy servant, I pray thee, turn back again, that I may die in mine own city, and be buried by the grave of my father and of my mother. But behold thy servant Chimham; let him go over with my lord the king; and do to him what shall seem good unto thee.
bsb_text: Please let your servant return, that I may die in my own city near the tomb of my father and mother. But here is your servant Chimham. Let him cross over with my lord the king, and do for him what is good in your sight.”
aov_text: Laat u dienaar tog maar omdraai, dat ek kan sterf in my stad by die graf van my vader en my moeder; maar hier is u dienaar Kimham. Laat hy saam met my heer die koning oortrek, en doen aan hom wat goed is in u oë.

kjv_text: And the king answered, Chimham shall go over with me, and I will do to him that which shall seem good unto thee: and whatsoever thou shalt require of me, that will I do for thee.
bsb_text: The king replied, “Chimham will cross over with me, and I will do for him what seems good in your sight, and I will do for you whatever you desire of me.”
aov_text: En die koning sê: Kimham kan saam met my oortrek, dan sal ek aan hom doen wat goed is in jou oë, en alles wat jy verkies om aan my op te dra, sal ek vir jou doen.

kjv_text: And all the people went over Jordan. And when the king was come over, the king kissed Barzillai, and blessed him; and he returned unto his own place.
bsb_text: So all the people crossed the Jordan, and then the king crossed over. The king kissed Barzillai and blessed him, and Barzillai returned home.
aov_text: Toe trek die hele volk die Jordaan oor. En nadat die koning ook oorgetrek het, soen die koning Barsíllai en groet hom; en hy het na sy woonplek teruggegaan.

kjv_text: Then the king went on to Gilgal, and Chimham went on with him: and all the people of Judah conducted the king, and also half the people of Israel.
bsb_text: Then the king went on to Gilgal, and Chimham crossed over with him. All the troops of Judah and half the troops of Israel escorted the king.
aov_text: Daarop het die koning verder getrek na Gilgal, en Kimham het saam met hom getrek, en die hele volk van Juda en ook die helfte van die volk van Israel het die koning verder gebring.

kjv_text: And, behold, all the men of Israel came to the king, and said unto the king, Why have our brethren the men of Judah stolen thee away, and have brought the king, and his household, and all David's men with him, over Jordan?
bsb_text: Soon all the men of Israel came to the king and asked, “Why did our brothers, the men of Judah, take you away secretly and bring the king and his household across the Jordan, together with all of David’s men?”
aov_text: METEENS kom toe al die manne van Israel by die koning aan en sê aan die koning: Waarom het ons broers, die manne van Juda, u gesteel en die koning en sy huis en al die manne van Dawid saam met hom oor die Jordaan gebring?

kjv_text: And all the men of Judah answered the men of Israel, Because the king is near of kin to us: wherefore then be ye angry for this matter? have we eaten at all of the king's cost? or hath he given us any gift?
bsb_text: And all the men of Judah replied to the men of Israel, “We did this because the king is our relative. Why does this anger you? Have we ever eaten at the king’s expense or received anything for ourselves?”
aov_text: Daarop antwoord al die manne van Juda die manne van Israel: Omdat die koning aan my verwant is; maar waarom is jy tog kwaad oor hierdie saak? Het ons ooit iets van die koning geëet, of is iets as ’n porsie vir ons weggedra?

kjv_text: And the men of Israel answered the men of Judah, and said, We have ten parts in the king, and we have also more right in David than ye: why then did ye despise us, that our advice should not be first had in bringing back our king? And the words of the men of Judah were fiercer than the words of the men of Israel.
bsb_text: “We have ten shares in the king,” answered the men of Israel, “so we have more claim to David than you. Why then do you despise us? Were we not the first to speak of restoring our king?” But the men of Judah pressed even harder than the men of Israel.
aov_text: En die manne van Israel het die manne van Juda geantwoord en gesê: Ek het tien aandele aan die koning en ook meer reg op Dawid as jy. Waarom het jy my dan veragtelik behandel? Was my woord dan nie die eerste om my koning terug te bring nie? Maar die woord van die manne van Juda was heftiger as die woord van die manne van Israel.

kjv_text: And there happened to be there a man of Belial, whose name was Sheba, the son of Bichri, a Benjamite: and he blew a trumpet, and said, We have no part in David, neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to his tents, O Israel.
bsb_text: Now a worthless man named Sheba son of Bichri, a Benjamite, happened to be there, and he blew the ram’s horn and shouted: “We have no share in David, no inheritance in Jesse’s son. Every man to his tent, O Israel!”
aov_text: EN daar was bygeval ’n deugniet met die naam van Seba, die seun van Bigri, ’n Benjaminiet—hy het op die ramshoring geblaas en gesê: Ons het geen deel aan Dawid, en ons het geen erfdeel aan die seun van Ísai nie: elkeen na sy tente toe, o Israel!

kjv_text: So every man of Israel went up from after David, and followed Sheba the son of Bichri: but the men of Judah clave unto their king, from Jordan even to Jerusalem.
bsb_text: So all the men of Israel deserted David to follow Sheba son of Bichri. But the men of Judah stayed by their king all the way from the Jordan to Jerusalem.
aov_text: Daarop trek al die manne van Israel van Dawid af weg, agter Seba, die seun van Bigri, aan; maar die manne van Juda het hulle koning aangehang van die Jordaan af tot by Jerusalem.

kjv_text: And David came to his house at Jerusalem; and the king took the ten women his concubines, whom he had left to keep the house, and put them in ward, and fed them, but went not in unto them. So they were shut up unto the day of their death, living in widowhood.
bsb_text: When David returned to his palace in Jerusalem, he took the ten concubines he had left to care for the palace, and he placed them in a house under guard. He provided for them, but he no longer slept with them. They were confined until the day of their death, living as widows.
aov_text: Toe Dawid in sy huis in Jerusalem kom, het die koning die tien vroue, die byvroue wat hy laat agterbly het om die huis op te pas, geneem en in ’n bewaakte huis gesit en hulle onderhou, maar nie by hulle ingegaan nie; en hulle was opgesluit tot die dag van hulle dood as lewenslange weduwees.

kjv_text: Then said the king to Amasa, Assemble me the men of Judah within three days, and be thou here present.
bsb_text: Then the king said to Amasa, “Summon the men of Judah to come to me within three days, and be here yourself.”
aov_text: Daarna sê die koning aan Amása: Roep vir my die manne van Juda binne drie dae byeen; kom staan jy dan hier.

kjv_text: So Amasa went to assemble the men of Judah: but he tarried longer than the set time which he had appointed him.
bsb_text: So Amasa went to summon Judah, but he took longer than the time allotted him.
aov_text: En Amása het gegaan om Juda byeen te roep, maar het langer weggebly as die bepaalde tyd wat hy vir hom vasgestel het.

kjv_text: And David said to Abishai, Now shall Sheba the son of Bichri do us more harm than did Absalom: take thou thy lord's servants, and pursue after him, lest he get him fenced cities, and escape us.
bsb_text: And David said to Abishai, “Now Sheba the son of Bichri will do us more harm than Absalom. Take your lord’s servants and pursue him, or he will find fortified cities and elude us.”
aov_text: Toe sê Dawid aan Abísai: Nou sal Seba, die seun van Bigri, ons meer kwaad doen as Absalom; neem jy die dienaars van jou heer en jaag hom agterna, sodat hy nie miskien vir hom versterkte stede vind en ons oog uitruk nie.

kjv_text: And there went out after him Joab's men, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and all the mighty men: and they went out of Jerusalem, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri.
bsb_text: So Joab’s men, along with the Cherethites, the Pelethites, and all the mighty men, marched out of Jerusalem in pursuit of Sheba son of Bichri.
aov_text: En daar het uitgetrek, agter hom aan, die manne van Joab en die Kreti en die Pleti en al die helde—hulle het uit Jerusalem uitgetrek om Seba, die seun van Bigri, agterna te jaag.

kjv_text: When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon, Amasa went before them. And Joab's garment that he had put on was girded unto him, and upon it a girdle with a sword fastened upon his loins in the sheath thereof; and as he went forth it fell out.
bsb_text: And while they were at the great stone in Gibeon, Amasa joined them. Now Joab was dressed in military attire, with a dagger strapped to his belt. And as he stepped forward, he slipped the dagger from its sheath.
aov_text: Terwyl hulle by die groot klip was wat by Gíbeon lê, kom Amása voor hulle uit. En Joab was omgord met sy wapenrok as sy kleed en daaroor was ’n gord met ’n swaard wat in die skede aan sy heupe vasgemaak was, en terwyl hy voortgaan, het dit geval.

kjv_text: And Joab said to Amasa, Art thou in health, my brother? And Joab took Amasa by the beard with the right hand to kiss him.
bsb_text: “Are you well, my brother?” Joab asked Amasa. And with his right hand Joab grabbed Amasa by the beard to kiss him.
aov_text: En Joab sê vir Amása: Gaan dit goed met jou, my broer? En Joab het met die regterhand die baard van Amása gegryp om hom te soen.

kjv_text: But Amasa took no heed to the sword that was in Joab's hand: so he smote him therewith in the fifth rib, and shed out his bowels to the ground, and struck him not again; and he died. So Joab and Abishai his brother pursued after Sheba the son of Bichri.
bsb_text: Amasa was not on guard against the dagger in Joab’s hand, and Joab stabbed him in the stomach and spilled out his intestines on the ground. And Joab did not need to strike him again, for Amasa was dead. Then Joab and his brother Abishai pursued Sheba son of Bichri.
aov_text: En Amása was nie op sy hoede vir die swaard wat in die hand van Joab was nie. Toe steek hy hom daarmee in die onderlyf en stort sy ingewande op die grond uit sonder om hom ’n tweede steek te gee, sodat hy gesterf het. Daarop het Joab en sy broer Abísai Seba, die seun van Bigri, agternagejaag.

kjv_text: And one of Joab's men stood by him, and said, He that favoureth Joab, and he that is for David, let him go after Joab.
bsb_text: One of Joab’s young men stood near Amasa and said, “Whoever favors Joab, and whoever is for David, let him follow Joab!”
aov_text: Maar ’n man uit die dienaars van Joab het daar by hom bly staan en gesê: Wie in Joab behae het en wie vir Dawid is, laat hom Joab volg!

kjv_text: And Amasa wallowed in blood in the midst of the highway. And when the man saw that all the people stood still, he removed Amasa out of the highway into the field, and cast a cloth upon him, when he saw that every one that came by him stood still.
bsb_text: But Amasa wallowed in his blood in the middle of the road, and when the man saw that all the troops were stopping there, he dragged the body off the road into a field and threw a garment over it.
aov_text: Terwyl Amása in die middel van die pad hom in die bloed lê en wentel en die man sien dat al die manskappe bly staan, het hy Amása uit die pad uit weggeneem na die veld en ’n kleed oor hom gegooi, omdat hy sien dat elkeen wat by hom kom, daar bly staan.

kjv_text: When he was removed out of the highway, all the people went on after Joab, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri.
bsb_text: As soon as Amasa’s body was removed from the road, all the men went on with Joab to pursue Sheba son of Bichri.
aov_text: Toe hy hom uit die pad verwyder het, trek al die manskappe verby agter Joab aan om Seba, die seun van Bigri, agterna te jaag.

kjv_text: And he went through all the tribes of Israel unto Abel, and to Bethmaachah, and all the Berites: and they were gathered together, and went also after him.
bsb_text: Sheba passed through all the tribes of Israel to Abel-beth-maacah and through the entire region of the Berites, who gathered together and followed him.
aov_text: En dié het deur al die stamme van Israel getrek na Abel en Bet-Máäga en die hele Berim; en hulle het byeengekom en ook agter hom aan gegaan.

kjv_text: And they came and besieged him in Abel of Bethmaachah, and they cast up a bank against the city, and it stood in the trench: and all the people that were with Joab battered the wall, to throw it down.
bsb_text: And Joab’s troops came and besieged Sheba in Abel-beth-maacah and built a siege ramp against the outer rampart of the city. As all the troops with Joab were battering the wall to topple it,
aov_text: En hulle het gekom en hom in Abel-Bet-Máäga beleër en ’n wal teen die stad opgegooi, wat teen die voorskans opgerys het. Terwyl al die manskappe van Joab besig was met verwoes om die muur te laat val,

kjv_text: Then cried a wise woman out of the city, Hear, hear; say, I pray you, unto Joab, Come near hither, that I may speak with thee.
bsb_text: a wise woman called out from the city, “Listen! Listen! Please tell Joab to come here so that I may speak with him.”
aov_text: roep ’n wyse vrou uit die stad: Luister, luister! Sê tog vir Joab: Kom hierheen, dat ek met u kan spreek.

kjv_text: And when he was come near unto her, the woman said, Art thou Joab? And he answered, I am he. Then she said unto him, Hear the words of thine handmaid. And he answered, I do hear.
bsb_text: When he had come near to her, the woman asked, “Are you Joab?” “I am,” he replied. “Listen to the words of your servant,” she said. “I am listening,” he answered.
aov_text: En toe hy nader kom na haar, sê die vrou: Is u Joab? En hy antwoord: Ja. En sy sê vir hom: Hoor die woorde van u dienares. En hy antwoord: Ek hoor.

kjv_text: Then she spake, saying, They were wont to speak in old time, saying, They shall surely ask counsel at Abel: and so they ended the matter.
bsb_text: Then the woman said, “Long ago they used to say, ‘Seek counsel at Abel,’ and that is how disputes were settled.
aov_text: Daarop spreek sy en sê: Vroeër was hulle gewoond om só te sê: Laat hulle Abel maar net raadpleeg! en so het hulle ’n saak afgehandel.

kjv_text: I am one of them that are peaceable and faithful in Israel: thou seekest to destroy a city and a mother in Israel: why wilt thou swallow up the inheritance of the LORD?
bsb_text: I am among the peaceable and faithful in Israel, but you are trying to destroy a city that is a mother in Israel. Why would you swallow up the LORD’s inheritance?”
aov_text: Ek is een van die vredeliewendes, van die getroues in Israel. U is daarop uit om ’n stad te vernietig, nogal ’n moeder in Israel. Waarom wil u die erfdeel van die HERE te gronde rig?

kjv_text: And Joab answered and said, Far be it, far be it from me, that I should swallow up or destroy.
bsb_text: “Far be it!” Joab declared. “Far be it from me to swallow up or destroy!
aov_text: En Joab antwoord en sê: Dit is ver, ver van my, dat ek te gronde sou rig en dat ek sou verwoes!

kjv_text: The matter is not so: but a man of mount Ephraim, Sheba the son of Bichri by name, hath lifted up his hand against the king, even against David: deliver him only, and I will depart from the city. And the woman said unto Joab, Behold, his head shall be thrown to thee over the wall.
bsb_text: That is not the case. But a man named Sheba son of Bichri, from the hill country of Ephraim, has lifted up his hand against the king, against David. Deliver him alone, and I will depart from the city.” “Look,” the woman replied, “his head will be thrown to you over the wall.”
aov_text: Die saak is nie so nie; maar ’n man van die gebergte van Efraim met die naam van Seba, die seun van Bigri, het sy hand opgehef teen die koning, teen Dawid: lewer hom alleen uit, dan wil ek van die stad af wegtrek. En die vrou sê vir Joab: Kyk, sy hoof sal oor die muur na u toe gegooi word.

kjv_text: Then the woman went unto all the people in her wisdom. And they cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri, and cast it out to Joab. And he blew a trumpet, and they retired from the city, every man to his tent. And Joab returned to Jerusalem unto the king.
bsb_text: Then the woman went to all the people with her wise counsel, and they cut off the head of Sheba son of Bichri and threw it to Joab. So he blew the ram’s horn and his men dispersed from the city, each to his own home. And Joab returned to the king in Jerusalem.
aov_text: En die vrou het haar in haar wysheid tot die hele volk gewend, en hulle het die hoof van Seba, die seun van Bigri, afgekap en na Joab oorgegooi. Toe het hy op die ramshoring geblaas, en hulle is verstrooi, weg van die stad af, elkeen na sy tente; en Joab het na Jerusalem, na die koning teruggegaan.

kjv_text: Now Joab was over all the host of Israel: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and over the Pelethites:
bsb_text: Now Joab was over the whole army of Israel; Benaiah son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and Pelethites;
aov_text: En Joab was oor die hele leër van Israel, en Benája, die seun van Jójada, oor die Kreti en oor die Pleti;

kjv_text: And Adoram was over the tribute: and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder:
bsb_text: Adoram was in charge of the forced labor; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was the recorder;
aov_text: en Adóram was oor die dwangarbeid, en Jósafat, die seun van Ahílud, was kanselier.

kjv_text: And Sheva was scribe: and Zadok and Abiathar were the priests:
bsb_text: Sheva was the scribe; Zadok and Abiathar were priests;
aov_text: En Seja was skrywer; en Sadok en Ábjatar priesters.

kjv_text: And Ira also the Jairite was a chief ruler about David.
bsb_text: and Ira the Jairite was David’s priest.
aov_text: En ook Ira, die Jaïriet, was priester by Dawid.

kjv_text: Then there was a famine in the days of David three years, year after year; and David enquired of the LORD. And the LORD answered, It is for Saul, and for his bloody house, because he slew the Gibeonites.
bsb_text: During the reign of David there was a famine for three successive years, and David sought the face of the LORD. And the LORD said, “It is because of the blood shed by Saul and his family, because he killed the Gibeonites.”
aov_text: EN toe daar in die dae van Dawid ’n hongersnood was, drie jaar lank, jaar ná jaar, het Dawid die aangesig van die HERE gesoek; en die HERE het gesê: Vanweë Saul en vanweë sy huis waarop bloedskuld rus, omdat hy die Gibeoniete omgebring het.

kjv_text: And the king called the Gibeonites, and said unto them; (now the Gibeonites were not of the children of Israel, but of the remnant of the Amorites; and the children of Israel had sworn unto them: and Saul sought to slay them in his zeal to the children of Israel and Judah.)
bsb_text: At this, David summoned the Gibeonites and spoke to them. (Now the Gibeonites were not Israelites, but a remnant of the Amorites. The Israelites had taken an oath concerning them, but in his zeal for Israel and Judah, Saul had sought to kill them.)
aov_text: Toe roep die koning die Gibeoniete en sê vir hulle—die Gibeoniete het naamlik nie behoort tot die kinders van Israel nie, maar by ’n oorblyfsel van die Amoriete; en hoewel die kinders van Israel vir hulle gesweer het, het Saul probeer om hulle om te bring in sy ywer vir die kinders van Israel en Juda —

kjv_text: Wherefore David said unto the Gibeonites, What shall I do for you? and wherewith shall I make the atonement, that ye may bless the inheritance of the LORD?
bsb_text: So David asked the Gibeonites, “What shall I do for you? How can I make amends so that you may bless the inheritance of the LORD?”
aov_text: Dawid dan het aan die Gibeoniete gesê: Wat moet ek vir julle doen, en waarmee moet ek versoening doen, dat julle die erfdeel van die HERE kan seën?

kjv_text: And the Gibeonites said unto him, We will have no silver nor gold of Saul, nor of his house; neither for us shalt thou kill any man in Israel. And he said, What ye shall say, that will I do for you.
bsb_text: The Gibeonites said to him, “We need no silver or gold from Saul or his house, nor should you put to death anyone in Israel for us.” “Whatever you ask, I will do for you,” he replied.
aov_text: Daarop sê die Gibeoniete vir hom: Dit is ons teenoor Saul en sy huis nie te doen om silwer en goud nie, en dit gaan vir ons nie daarom om iemand in Israel dood te maak nie. En hy vra: Wat dink julle dan moet ek vir julle doen?

kjv_text: And they answered the king, The man that consumed us, and that devised against us that we should be destroyed from remaining in any of the coasts of Israel,
bsb_text: And they answered the king, “As for the man who consumed us and plotted against us to exterminate us from existing within any border of Israel,
aov_text: En hulle sê vir die koning: Die man wat ons vernietig het en planne teen ons beraam het om ons te verdelg sonder dat ons in enige grondgebied van Israel kan voortbestaan —

kjv_text: Let seven men of his sons be delivered unto us, and we will hang them up unto the LORD in Gibeah of Saul, whom the LORD did choose. And the king said, I will give them.
bsb_text: let seven of his male descendants be delivered to us so that we may hang them before the LORD at Gibeah of Saul, the chosen of the LORD.” “I will give them to you,” said the king.
aov_text: laat sewe manne van sy seuns aan ons gegee word, dat ons hulle voor die HERE kan ophang in Gíbea van Saul, die uitverkorene van die HERE! En die koning het gesê: Ek sal hulle gee.

kjv_text: But the king spared Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan the son of Saul, because of the LORD's oath that was between them, between David and Jonathan the son of Saul.
bsb_text: Now the king spared Mephibosheth son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, because of the oath before the LORD between David and Jonathan son of Saul.
aov_text: Maar die koning het Mefibóset, die seun van Jónatan, die seun van Saul, verskoon vanweë die eed by die HERE wat tussen hulle was, tussen Dawid en Jónatan, die seun van Saul.

kjv_text: But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, whom she bare unto Saul, Armoni and Mephibosheth; and the five sons of Michal the daughter of Saul, whom she brought up for Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite:
bsb_text: But the king took Armoni and Mephibosheth, the two sons whom Rizpah daughter of Aiah had borne to Saul, as well as the five sons whom Merab daughter of Saul had borne to Adriel son of Barzillai the Meholathite.
aov_text: Toe neem die koning die twee seuns van Rispa, die dogter van Aja, wat sy vir Saul gebaar het, Armóni enMefibóset, en die vyf seuns van Merab, die dogter van Saul, wat sy vir Ádriël, die seun van Barsíllai, die Meholatiet, gebaar het;

kjv_text: And he delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites, and they hanged them in the hill before the LORD: and they fell all seven together, and were put to death in the days of harvest, in the first days, in the beginning of barley harvest.
bsb_text: And he delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites, and they hanged them on the hill before the LORD. So all seven of them fell together; they were put to death in the first days of the harvest, at the beginning of the barley harvest.
aov_text: en hy het hulle oorgegee in die hand van die Gibeoniete, wat hulle opgehang het op die berg voor die aangesig van die HERE, sodat al sewe tesame omgekom het; en hulle is gedood in die eerste dae van die oes, in die begin van die garsoes.

kjv_text: And Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth, and spread it for her upon the rock, from the beginning of harvest until water dropped upon them out of heaven, and suffered neither the birds of the air to rest on them by day, nor the beasts of the field by night.
bsb_text: And Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth and spread it out for herself on a rock. From the beginning of the harvest until the rain from heaven poured down on the bodies, she did not allow the birds of the air to rest on them by day, nor the beasts of the field by night.
aov_text: En Rispa, die dogter van Aja, het ’n sak geneem en dit vir haar oopgespan op die rots, van die begin van die oes af totdat daar water uit die hemel op hulle gegiet het, en sy het die voëls van die hemel oordag nie toegelaat om op hulle te gaan sit nie, en ook nie die diere van die veld in die nag nie.

kjv_text: And it was told David what Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, the concubine of Saul, had done.
bsb_text: When David was told what Saul’s concubine Rizpah, daughter of Aiah, had done,
aov_text: Toe aan Dawid meegedeel is wat Rispa, die dogter van Aja, die byvrou van Saul, gedoen het,

kjv_text: And David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son from the men of Jabeshgilead, which had stolen them from the street of Bethshan, where the Philistines had hanged them, when the Philistines had slain Saul in Gilboa:
bsb_text: he went and took the bones of Saul and his son Jonathan from the men of Jabesh-gilead, who had stolen them from the public square of Beth-shan where the Philistines had hung the bodies after they had struck down Saul at Gilboa.
aov_text: het Dawid gegaan en die bene van Saul en die bene van sy seun Jónatan van die burgers van Jabes in Gílead gaan haal, wat dit van die plein van Bet-San gesteel het, waar die Filistyne hulle opgehang het op die dag toe die Filistyne Saul op Gilbóa verslaan het.

kjv_text: And he brought up from thence the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son; and they gathered the bones of them that were hanged.
bsb_text: So David had the bones of Saul and his son Jonathan brought from there, along with the bones of those who had been hanged.
aov_text: En hy het die bene van Saul en die bene van sy seun Jónatan daarvandaan weggebring. Hulle het ook die bene van die wat opgehang is, versamel,

kjv_text: And the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son buried they in the country of Benjamin in Zelah, in the sepulchre of Kish his father: and they performed all that the king commanded. And after that God was intreated for the land.
bsb_text: And they buried the bones of Saul and his son Jonathan in Zela in the land of Benjamin, in the tomb of Saul’s father Kish. After they had done everything the king had commanded, God answered their prayers for the land.
aov_text: en die bene van Saul en van sy seun Jónatan in die land Benjamin, in Sela, in die graf van sy vader Kis begrawe; en hulle het alles gedoen volgens die bevel van die koning. En daarna het God Hom oor die land ontferm.

kjv_text: Moreover the Philistines had yet war again with Israel; and David went down, and his servants with him, and fought against the Philistines: and David waxed faint.
bsb_text: Once again the Philistines waged war against Israel, and David and his servants went down and fought against the Philistines; but David became exhausted.
aov_text: EN toe die Filistyne weer oorlog gehad het met Israel, het Dawid afgetrek, en sy dienaars saam met hom, en hulle het teen die Filistyne geveg, en Dawid het al moeg geword.

kjv_text: And Ishbibenob, which was of the sons of the giant, the weight of whose spear weighed three hundred shekels of brass in weight, he being girded with a new sword, thought to have slain David.
bsb_text: Then Ishbi-benob, a descendant of Rapha, whose bronze spear weighed three hundred shekels and who was bearing a new sword, resolved to kill David.
aov_text: En Jisbi-Benob wat uit die kinders van die Refaïete was—die gewig van sy spies was driehonderd sikkels koper in gewig, en hy was omgord met ’n nuwe swaard—het gedink om Dawid te verslaan.

kjv_text: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah succoured him, and smote the Philistine, and killed him. Then the men of David sware unto him, saying, Thou shalt go no more out with us to battle, that thou quench not the light of Israel.
bsb_text: But Abishai son of Zeruiah came to his aid, struck the Philistine, and killed him. Then David’s men swore to him, “You must never again go out with us to battle, so that the lamp of Israel may not be extinguished.”
aov_text: Maar Abísai, die seun van Serúja, het hom gehelp en die Filistyn verslaan en hom gedood. Toe het die manne van Dawid hom besweer en gesê: U mag nie meer saam met ons uittrek na die geveg nie, dat u die lamp van Israel nie uitblus nie.

kjv_text: And it came to pass after this, that there was again a battle with the Philistines at Gob: then Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Saph, which was of the sons of the giant.
bsb_text: Some time later at Gob, there was another battle with the Philistines. At that time Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Saph, one of the descendants of Rapha.
aov_text: En daarna was daar weer oorlog met die Filistyne in Gob. Toe het Síbbegai, die Husatiet, Saf, uit die kinders van die Refaïete, verslaan.

kjv_text: And there was again a battle in Gob with the Philistines, where Elhanan the son of Jaareoregim, a Bethlehemite, slew the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver's beam.
bsb_text: Once again there was a battle with the Philistines at Gob, and Elhanan son of Jair the Bethlehemite killed the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the shaft of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.
aov_text: En daar was weer oorlog met die Filistyne in Gob; en Élhanan, die seun van Jáäre-Orgim uit Betlehem, het Góliat, die Gittiet, wie se spiessteel soos ’n wewersbalk was, verslaan.

kjv_text: And there was yet a battle in Gath, where was a man of great stature, that had on every hand six fingers, and on every foot six toes, four and twenty in number; and he also was born to the giant.
bsb_text: And there was still another battle at Gath, where there was a man of great stature with six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot—twenty-four in all. He too was descended from Rapha,
aov_text: En daar was weer oorlog in Gat; en daar was ’n baie lang man, met ses vingers aan elke hand en ses tone aan elke voet, vier-en-twintig in getal, en hy was ook ’n afstammeling van die Refaïete.

kjv_text: And when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimeah the brother of David slew him.
bsb_text: and when he taunted Israel, Jonathan the son of David’s brother Shimei killed him.
aov_text: En hy het Israel gehoon, maar Jónatan, die seun van Símea, die broer van Dawid, het hom verslaan.

kjv_text: These four were born to the giant in Gath, and fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.
bsb_text: So these four descendants of Rapha in Gath fell at the hands of David and his servants.
aov_text: Hierdie vier was afstammelinge van die Refaïete in Gat, en hulle het geval deur die hand van Dawid en deur die hand van sy dienaars.

kjv_text: And David spake unto the LORD the words of this song in the day that the LORD had delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul:
bsb_text: And David sang this song to the LORD on the day the LORD had delivered him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul.
aov_text: EN Dawid het die woorde van hierdie lied tot die HERE gespreek op die dag toe die HERE hom gered het uit die hand van al sy vyande en uit die hand van Saul.

kjv_text: And he said, The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer;
bsb_text: He said: “The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer.
aov_text: En hy het gesê: Die HERE is my rots en my bergvesting en my redder;

kjv_text: The God of my rock; in him will I trust: he is my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge, my saviour; thou savest me from violence.
bsb_text: My God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield, and the horn of my salvation. My stronghold, my refuge, and my Savior, You save me from violence.
aov_text: God is my rots by wie ek skuil; my skild en die horing van my heil, my rotsvesting en my toevlug, my verlosser; van geweld het U my verlos.

kjv_text: I will call on the LORD, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.
bsb_text: I will call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; so shall I be saved from my enemies.
aov_text: Ek roep die HERE aan wat lofwaardig is, en van my vyande word ek verlos.

kjv_text: When the waves of death compassed me, the floods of ungodly men made me afraid;
bsb_text: For the waves of death engulfed me; the torrents of chaos overwhelmed me.
aov_text: Want die golwe van die dood het my omring, strome van onheil het my oorval.

kjv_text: The sorrows of hell compassed me about; the snares of death prevented me;
bsb_text: The cords of Sheol entangled me; the snares of death confronted me.
aov_text: Bande van die doderyk het my omring, strikke van die dood het my teëgekom.

kjv_text: In my distress I called upon the LORD, and cried to my God: and he did hear my voice out of his temple, and my cry did enter into his ears.
bsb_text: In my distress I called upon the LORD; I cried out to my God. And from His temple He heard my voice, and my cry for help reached His ears.
aov_text: Toe ek benoud was, het ek die HERE aangeroep, en ek het geroep tot my God; en uit sy paleis het Hy my stem gehoor, en my hulpgeroep was in sy ore.

kjv_text: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations of heaven moved and shook, because he was wroth.
bsb_text: Then the earth shook and quaked; the foundations of the heavens trembled; they were shaken because He burned with anger.
aov_text: Toe het die aarde geskud en gebewe, die fondamente van die hemel het gesidder en geskud, omdat Hy toornig was.

kjv_text: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.
bsb_text: Smoke rose from His nostrils, and consuming fire came from His mouth; glowing coals blazed forth.
aov_text: Rook in sy neus het opgegaan, en ’n vuur uit sy mond het verteer; kole uit Hom het gebrand.

kjv_text: He bowed the heavens also, and came down; and darkness was under his feet.
bsb_text: He parted the heavens and came down with dark clouds beneath His feet.
aov_text: En Hy het die hemel gebuig en neergedaal, en wolkedonkerheid was onder sy voete.

kjv_text: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: and he was seen upon the wings of the wind.
bsb_text: He mounted a cherub and flew; He soared on the wings of the wind.
aov_text: En Hy het op ’n gérub gery en gevlieg; ja, Hy het verskyn op die vlerke van die wind.

kjv_text: And he made darkness pavilions round about him, dark waters, and thick clouds of the skies.
bsb_text: He made darkness a canopy around Him, a gathering of water and thick clouds.
aov_text: En Hy het duisternis rondom Hom as hutte gestel, versameling van waters, diktes van wolke.

kjv_text: Through the brightness before him were coals of fire kindled.
bsb_text: From the brightness of His presence coals of fire blazed forth.
aov_text: Uit die glans voor Hom het gloeiende kole gebrand.

kjv_text: The LORD thundered from heaven, and the most High uttered his voice.
bsb_text: The LORD thundered from heaven; the voice of the Most High resounded.
aov_text: Uit die hemel het die HERE gedonder, en die Allerhoogste het sy stem laat hoor.

kjv_text: And he sent out arrows, and scattered them; lightning, and discomfited them.
bsb_text: He shot His arrows and scattered the foes; He hurled lightning and routed them.
aov_text: En Hy het pyle uitgestuur en hulle verstrooi, bliksems en hulle verwar.

kjv_text: And the channels of the sea appeared, the foundations of the world were discovered, at the rebuking of the LORD, at the blast of the breath of his nostrils.
bsb_text: The channels of the sea appeared, and the foundations of the world were exposed at the rebuke of the LORD, at the blast of the breath of His nostrils.
aov_text: En die beddings van die see het sigbaar geword, die fondamente van die wêreld is blootgelê, deur die dreiging van die HERE, vanweë die geblaas van die wind van sy neus.

kjv_text: He sent from above, he took me; he drew me out of many waters;
bsb_text: He reached down from on high and took hold of me; He drew me out of deep waters.
aov_text: Uit die hoogte het Hy sy hand uitgestrek, Hy het my gegryp, my uit groot waters getrek.

kjv_text: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them that hated me: for they were too strong for me.
bsb_text: He rescued me from my powerful enemy, from foes too mighty for me.
aov_text: Hy het my verlos van my magtige vyand, van my haters, omdat hulle te sterk was vir my.

kjv_text: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the LORD was my stay.
bsb_text: They confronted me in my day of calamity, but the LORD was my support.
aov_text: Hulle het my oorval op die dag van my nood, maar die HERE was my steun.

kjv_text: He brought me forth also into a large place: he delivered me, because he delighted in me.
bsb_text: He brought me out into the open; He rescued me because He delighted in me.
aov_text: En Hy het my uitgelei in die ruimte, Hy het my gered, omdat Hy behae in my gehad het.

kjv_text: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness: according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.
bsb_text: The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness; He has repaid me according to the cleanness of my hands.
aov_text: Die HERE het met my gehandel na my geregtigheid; na die reinheid van my hande het Hy my vergelde.

kjv_text: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
bsb_text: For I have kept the ways of the LORD and have not wickedly departed from my God.
aov_text: Want ek het die weë van die HERE gehou en nie goddeloos van my God afgewyk nie.

kjv_text: For all his judgments were before me: and as for his statutes, I did not depart from them.
bsb_text: For all His ordinances are before me; I have not disregarded His statutes.
aov_text: Want al sy verordeninge was voor my, en sy insettinge—daar het ek nie van afgewyk nie.

kjv_text: I was also upright before him, and have kept myself from mine iniquity.
bsb_text: And I have been blameless before Him and kept myself from iniquity.
aov_text: Maar ek was opreg voor Hom, en ek was op my hoede vir my ongeregtigheid.

kjv_text: Therefore the LORD hath recompensed me according to my righteousness; according to my cleanness in his eye sight.
bsb_text: So the LORD has repaid me according to my righteousness, according to my cleanness in His sight.
aov_text: So het die HERE my dan vergelde na my geregtigheid, na my reinheid voor sy oë.

kjv_text: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful, and with the upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright.
bsb_text: To the faithful You show Yourself faithful, to the blameless You show Yourself blameless;
aov_text: By die liefderyke betoon U Uself liefderyk, by die opregte man opreg,

kjv_text: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself unsavoury.
bsb_text: to the pure You show Yourself pure, but to the crooked You show Yourself shrewd.
aov_text: by die reine, rein; maar by die valse betoon U Uself verkeerd.

kjv_text: And the afflicted people thou wilt save: but thine eyes are upon the haughty, that thou mayest bring them down.
bsb_text: You save an afflicted people, but Your eyes are on the haughty to bring them down.
aov_text: En U verlos die verdrukte volk, maar u oë is teen die hoogmoediges; U verneder hulle.

kjv_text: For thou art my lamp, O LORD: and the LORD will lighten my darkness.
bsb_text: For You, O LORD, are my lamp; the LORD lights up my darkness.
aov_text: Want U is my lamp, o HERE! En die HERE laat my duisternis opklaar.

kjv_text: For by thee I have run through a troop: by my God have I leaped over a wall.
bsb_text: For in You I can charge an army; with my God I can scale a wall.
aov_text: Want met U loop ek ’n bende storm, met my God spring ek oor ’n muur.

kjv_text: As for God, his way is perfect; the word of the LORD is tried: he is a buckler to all them that trust in him.
bsb_text: As for God, His way is perfect; the word of the LORD is flawless. He is a shield to all who take refuge in Him.
aov_text: Die weg van God is volmaak; die woord van die HERE is gelouter; Hy is ’n skild vir almal wat by Hom skuil.

kjv_text: For who is God, save the LORD? and who is a rock, save our God?
bsb_text: For who is God besides the LORD? And who is the Rock except our God?
aov_text: Want wie is God buiten die HERE, en wie ’n rots buiten onse God?

kjv_text: God is my strength and power: and he maketh my way perfect.
bsb_text: God is my strong fortress and He makes my way clear.
aov_text: Die God wat my sterk toevlug is, en Hy het vir my ’n weg volkomelik uitgesoek.

kjv_text: He maketh my feet like hinds' feet: and setteth me upon my high places.
bsb_text: He makes my feet like those of a deer and stations me upon the heights.
aov_text: Hy maak my voete soos dié van herte en laat my staan op my hoogtes.

kjv_text: He teacheth my hands to war; so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.
bsb_text: He trains my hands for battle; my arms can bend a bow of bronze.
aov_text: Hy leer my hande om oorlog te voer, sodat my arms ’n koperboog span.

kjv_text: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy gentleness hath made me great.
bsb_text: You have given me Your shield of salvation, and Your gentleness exalts me.
aov_text: En U het my die skild van u uitredding gegee, en u neerbuigende goedheid het my groot gemaak.

kjv_text: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me; so that my feet did not slip.
bsb_text: You broaden the path beneath me so that my ankles do not give way.
aov_text: U het my voetstap onder my ruim gemaak, en my enkels het nie gewankel nie.

kjv_text: I have pursued mine enemies, and destroyed them; and turned not again until I had consumed them.
bsb_text: I pursued my enemies and destroyed them; I did not turn back until they were consumed.
aov_text: Ek het my vyande agtervolg en hulle verdelg en nie teruggekom voordat ek hulle vernietig het nie.

kjv_text: And I have consumed them, and wounded them, that they could not arise: yea, they are fallen under my feet.
bsb_text: I devoured and crushed them so they could not rise; they have fallen under my feet.
aov_text: Ja, ek het hulle vernietig en hulle verbrysel, sodat hulle nie weer opgestaan het nie, maar onder my voete geval het.

kjv_text: For thou hast girded me with strength to battle: them that rose up against me hast thou subdued under me.
bsb_text: You have armed me with strength for battle; You have subdued my foes beneath me.
aov_text: En U het my met krag omgord vir die stryd, U het my teëstanders onder my laat buk.

kjv_text: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies, that I might destroy them that hate me.
bsb_text: You have made my enemies retreat before me; I put an end to those who hated me.
aov_text: En U het my vyande vir my laat vlug; my haters, dié het ek vernietig.

kjv_text: They looked, but there was none to save; even unto the LORD, but he answered them not.
bsb_text: They looked, but there was no one to save them—to the LORD, but He did not answer.
aov_text: Hulle het rondgekyk, maar daar was geen verlosser nie; na die HERE, maar Hy het hulle nie geantwoord nie.

kjv_text: Then did I beat them as small as the dust of the earth, I did stamp them as the mire of the street, and did spread them abroad.
bsb_text: I ground them as the dust of the earth; I crushed and trampled them like mud in the streets.
aov_text: Toe het ek hulle vermaal soos die stof van die aarde, soos modder van die strate het ek hulle fyngemaal, hulle vertrap.

kjv_text: Thou also hast delivered me from the strivings of my people, thou hast kept me to be head of the heathen: a people which I knew not shall serve me.
bsb_text: You have delivered me from the strife of my people; You have preserved me as the head of nations; a people I had not known shall serve me.
aov_text: En U het my gered uit die getwis van my volk; U het my bewaar as ’n hoof van nasies; ’n volk wat ek nie geken het nie, het my gedien.

kjv_text: Strangers shall submit themselves unto me: as soon as they hear, they shall be obedient unto me.
bsb_text: Foreigners cower before me; when they hear me, they obey me.
aov_text: Uitlanders het al kruipende na my gekom; sodra hulle van my gehoor het, was hulle gehoorsaam aan my.

kjv_text: Strangers shall fade away, and they shall be afraid out of their close places.
bsb_text: Foreigners lose heart and come trembling from their strongholds.
aov_text: Uitlanders word kragteloos en kom met siddering uit hulle vestings.

kjv_text: The LORD liveth; and blessed be my rock; and exalted be the God of the rock of my salvation.
bsb_text: The LORD lives, and blessed be my Rock! And may God, the Rock of my salvation, be exalted—
aov_text: Die HERE leef! En geloofd sy my rots, en laat verhoog wees die God wat die rots is van my heil!

kjv_text: It is God that avengeth me, and that bringeth down the people under me,
bsb_text: the God who avenges me and brings down nations beneath me,
aov_text: Die God wat my die wraak gee en volke onder my neerwerp;

kjv_text: And that bringeth me forth from mine enemies: thou also hast lifted me up on high above them that rose up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.
bsb_text: who frees me from my enemies. You exalt me above my foes; You rescue me from violent men.
aov_text: en wat my uitlei onder my vyande uit; ja, U verhef my bo my teëstanders, U bevry my van die man van geweld.

kjv_text: Therefore I will give thanks unto thee, O LORD, among the heathen, and I will sing praises unto thy name.
bsb_text: Therefore I will praise You, O LORD, among the nations; I will sing praises to Your name.
aov_text: Daarom wil ek U loof, o HERE, onder die nasies, en tot eer van u Naam wil ek psalmsing;

kjv_text: He is the tower of salvation for his king: and sheweth mercy to his anointed, unto David, and to his seed for evermore.
bsb_text: Great salvation He brings to His king. He shows loving devotion to His anointed, to David and his descendants forever.”
aov_text: Hy is dit wat die verlossing van sy koning groot maak en goedertierenheid bewys aan sy gesalfde, aan Dawid en aan sy nageslag tot in ewigheid.

kjv_text: Now these be the last words of David. David the son of Jesse said, and the man who was raised up on high, the anointed of the God of Jacob, and the sweet psalmist of Israel, said,
bsb_text: These are the last words of David: “The oracle of David son of Jesse, the oracle of the man raised on high, the one anointed by the God of Jacob, and the sweet psalmist of Israel:
aov_text: EN dit is die laaste woorde van Dawid: Dawid spreek, die seun van Ísai, en die man wat hoog geplaas was, spreek, die gesalfde van die God van Jakob en die lieflike in die sange van Israel:

kjv_text: The Spirit of the LORD spake by me, and his word was in my tongue.
bsb_text: The Spirit of the LORD spoke through me; His word was on my tongue.
aov_text: Die Gees van die HERE spreek in my, en sy woord is op my tong.

kjv_text: The God of Israel said, the Rock of Israel spake to me, He that ruleth over men must be just, ruling in the fear of God.
bsb_text: The God of Israel spoke; the Rock of Israel said to me, ‘He who rules the people with justice, who rules in the fear of God,
aov_text: Die God van Israel het gesê, die Rots van Israel het tot my gespreek: ’n Heerser oor mense, ’n regverdige, ’n heerser in die vrees van God,

kjv_text: And he shall be as the light of the morning, when the sun riseth, even a morning without clouds; as the tender grass springing out of the earth by clear shining after rain.
bsb_text: is like the light of the morning at sunrise of a cloudless dawn, the glistening after the rain on the sprouting grass of the earth.’
aov_text: is soos die môrelig by sonsopgang, ’n môre sonder wolke as deur die glans ná die reën grasspruitjies uit die aarde uitkom.

kjv_text: Although my house be not so with God; yet he hath made with me an everlasting covenant, ordered in all things, and sure: for this is all my salvation, and all my desire, although he make it not to grow.
bsb_text: Is not my house right with God? For He has established with me an everlasting covenant, ordered and secured in every part. Will He not bring about my full salvation and my every desire?
aov_text: Want is my huis nie so by God nie? Want Hy het ’n ewige verbond vir my daargestel wat in alles gereël en verseker is; want al my heil en alle welgevalle, ja, sal Hy dit nie laat uitspruit nie?

kjv_text: But the sons of Belial shall be all of them as thorns thrust away, because they cannot be taken with hands:
bsb_text: But the worthless are all like thorns raked aside, for they can never be gathered by hand.
aov_text: Maar deugniete, hulle almal is soos weggegooide dorings, want ’n mens vat dit nie met die hand nie;

kjv_text: But the man that shall touch them must be fenced with iron and the staff of a spear; and they shall be utterly burned with fire in the same place.
bsb_text: The man who touches them must be armed with iron or with the shaft of a spear. The fire burns them to ashes in the place where they lie.”
aov_text: en elkeen wat hulle wil aanraak, wapen homself met ’n yster of die steel van ’n spies, en met vuur word hulle op daardie plek heeltemal verbrand.

kjv_text: These be the names of the mighty men whom David had: The Tachmonite that sat in the seat, chief among the captains; the same was Adino the Eznite: he lift up his spear against eight hundred, whom he slew at one time.
bsb_text: These are the names of David’s mighty men: Josheb-basshebeth the Tahchemonite was chief of the Three. He wielded his spear against eight hundred men, whom he killed at one time.
aov_text: DIT is die name van die helde wat Dawid gehad het: Joseb-Bassebet, ’n Tagkemoniet, die hoof van die adjudante; hy was Adino, die Esniet, teen agthonderd wat op een keer gesneuwel het.

kjv_text: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo the Ahohite, one of the three mighty men with David, when they defied the Philistines that were there gathered together to battle, and the men of Israel were gone away:
bsb_text: Next in command was Eleazar son of Dodo the Ahohite. As one of the three mighty men, he went with David to taunt the Philistines who had gathered for battle at Pas-dammim. The men of Israel retreated,
aov_text: En ná hom was Eleásar, die seun van Dodo, die Ahohiet, onder die drie helde by Dawid; toe hulle die Filistyne uitgedaag het wat daar bymekaar was om te veg, en die manne van Israel weggetrek het,

kjv_text: He arose, and smote the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand clave unto the sword: and the LORD wrought a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to spoil.
bsb_text: but Eleazar stood his ground and struck the Philistines until his hand grew weary and stuck to his sword. The LORD brought about a great victory that day. Then the troops returned to him, but only to plunder the dead.
aov_text: het hy opgestaan en onder die Filistyne geslaan totdat sy hand moeg geword en sy hand aan die swaard gekleef het, sodat die HERE daardie dag ’n groot oorwinning bewerk het. En die manskappe het teruggekom agter hom aan net om te buit.

kjv_text: And after him was Shammah the son of Agee the Hararite. And the Philistines were gathered together into a troop, where was a piece of ground full of lentiles: and the people fled from the Philistines.
bsb_text: And after him was Shammah son of Agee the Hararite. When the Philistines had banded together near a field full of lentils, Israel’s troops fled from them.
aov_text: En ná hom was Samma, die seun van Age, die Harariet. Toe die Filistyne by Legi bymekaarkom, waar ’n stuk land was vol lensies en die volk vir die Filistyne gevlug het,

kjv_text: But he stood in the midst of the ground, and defended it, and slew the Philistines: and the LORD wrought a great victory.
bsb_text: But Shammah took his stand in the middle of the field, defended it, and struck down the Philistines. So the LORD brought about a great victory.
aov_text: het hy hom opgestel in die middel van die stuk land en dit afgeneem en die Filistyne verslaan, sodat die HERE ’n groot oorwinning bewerk het.

kjv_text: And three of the thirty chief went down, and came to David in the harvest time unto the cave of Adullam: and the troop of the Philistines pitched in the valley of Rephaim.
bsb_text: At harvest time, three of the thirty chief men went down to David at the cave of Adullam, while a company of Philistines was encamped in the Valley of Rephaim.
aov_text: En drie van die dertig hoofde het afgetrek en teen die oestyd by Dawid by die spelonk van Adúllam aangekom, terwyl ’n hoop Filistyne in die laer staan in die dal Refáim.

kjv_text: And David was then in an hold, and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Bethlehem.
bsb_text: At that time David was in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was at Bethlehem.
aov_text: En Dawid was toe in die bergvesting; en ’n besetting van die Filistyne was toe in Betlehem.

kjv_text: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!
bsb_text: David longed for water and said, “Oh, that someone would get me a drink of water from the well near the gate of Bethlehem!”
aov_text: En Dawid het ’n begeerte voel opkom en gesê: Wie sal vir my water gee om te drink uit die put van Betlehem wat by die poort is?

kjv_text: And the three mighty men brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David: nevertheless he would not drink thereof, but poured it out unto the LORD.
bsb_text: So the three mighty men broke through the Philistine camp, drew water from the well near the gate of Bethlehem, and brought it back to David. But he refused to drink it; instead, he poured it out to the LORD,
aov_text: Toe het die drie helde deur die laer van die Filistyne gebreek en water geskep uit die put van Betlehem wat by die poort was, en dit gedra en na Dawid gebring; maar hy wou dit nie drink nie, en het dit tot eer van die HERE uitgegiet

kjv_text: And he said, Be it far from me, O LORD, that I should do this: is not this the blood of the men that went in jeopardy of their lives? therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mighty men.
bsb_text: saying, “Far be it from me, O LORD, to do this! Is this not the blood of the men who risked their lives?” So he refused to drink it. Such were the exploits of the three mighty men.
aov_text: en gesê: Dit is ver van my, HERE, dat ek dit sou doen! Sou ek die bloed drink van die manne wat met lewensgevaar gegaan het? En hy wou dit nie drink nie. Dit het die drie helde gedoen.

kjv_text: And Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief among three. And he lifted up his spear against three hundred, and slew them, and had the name among three.
bsb_text: Now Abishai, the brother of Joab and son of Zeruiah, was chief of the Three, and he lifted his spear against three hundred men, killed them, and won a name along with the Three.
aov_text: En Abísai, die broer van Joab, die seun van Serúja, hy was hoof van die drie, en hy het sy spies geswaai oor driehonderd wat gesneuwel het, en het ’n naam gehad onder die drie.

kjv_text: Was he not most honourable of three? therefore he was their captain: howbeit he attained not unto the first three.
bsb_text: Was he not more honored than the Three? And he became their commander, even though he was not included among the Three.
aov_text: Was hy onder die drie nie geëer nie? sodat hy hulle owerste geword het, maar tot by die eerste drie het hy nie gekom nie.

kjv_text: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man, of Kabzeel, who had done many acts, he slew two lionlike men of Moab: he went down also and slew a lion in the midst of a pit in time of snow:
bsb_text: And Benaiah son of Jehoiada was a man of valor from Kabzeel, a man of many exploits. He struck down two champions of Moab, and on a snowy day he went down into a pit and killed a lion.
aov_text: Verder Benája, die seun van Jójada, ’n sterk man, groot van daad, uit Kábseël; hy het die twee groot helde van Moab verslaan; en hy het afgegaan en ’n leeu binne-in ’n kuil doodgeslaan op ’n sneeudag.

kjv_text: And he slew an Egyptian, a goodly man: and the Egyptian had a spear in his hand; but he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian's hand, and slew him with his own spear.
bsb_text: He also killed an Egyptian, a huge man. Although the Egyptian had a spear in his hand, Benaiah went against him with a club, snatched the spear from his hand, and killed the Egyptian with his own spear.
aov_text: Hy het ook ’n Egiptenaar verslaan, ’n mooi man; en in die hand van die Egiptenaar was ’n spies; maar hy het na hom afgegaan met ’n stok en die spies uit die hand van die Egiptenaar geruk en hom met sy eie spies doodgesteek.

kjv_text: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among three mighty men.
bsb_text: These were the exploits of Benaiah son of Jehoiada, who won a name alongside the three mighty men.
aov_text: Dit het Benája, die seun van Jójada, gedoen; en hy het ’n naam gehad onder die drie helde.

kjv_text: He was more honourable than the thirty, but he attained not to the first three. And David set him over his guard.
bsb_text: He was most honored among the Thirty, but he did not become one of the Three. And David appointed him over his guard.
aov_text: Hy was geëerd onder die dertig, maar tot by die drie het hy nie gekom nie; en Dawid het hom aangestel oor sy lyfwag.

kjv_text: Asahel the brother of Joab was one of the thirty; Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
bsb_text: Now these were members of the Thirty: Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
aov_text: Ásahel, die broer van Joab, was onder die dertig; Élhanan, die seun van Dodo, uit Betlehem;

kjv_text: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,
bsb_text: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,
aov_text: Samma, die Harodiet; Elíka, die Harodiet;

kjv_text: Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,
bsb_text: Helez the Paltite, Ira son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,
aov_text: Heles, die Paltiet; Ira, die seun van Ikkes, die Tekoïet;

kjv_text: Abiezer the Anethothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite,
bsb_text: Abiezer the Anathothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite,
aov_text: Abiëser, die Ánatotiet; Mebunnái, die Husatiet;

kjv_text: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,
bsb_text: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,
aov_text: Salmon, die Ahohiet; Máharai, die Netofatiet;

kjv_text: Heleb the son of Baanah, a Netophathite, Ittai the son of Ribai out of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin,
bsb_text: Heled son of Baanah the Netophathite, Ittai son of Ribai from Gibeah of the Benjamites,
aov_text: Heleb, die seun van Baäna, die Netofatiet; Íttai, die seun van Ribai, uit Gíbea van die kinders van Benjamin;

kjv_text: Benaiah the Pirathonite, Hiddai of the brooks of Gaash,
bsb_text: Benaiah the Pirathonite, Hiddai from the brooks of Gaash,
aov_text: Benája, die Pirhatoniet; Híddai, uit Nahale-Gaäs;

kjv_text: Abialbon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,
bsb_text: Abi-albon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,
aov_text: Abi-Albon, die Arbatiet; Asmáwet, die Barhumiet;

kjv_text: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, of the sons of Jashen, Jonathan,
bsb_text: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, the sons of Jashen, Jonathan
aov_text: Éljagba, die Sáälboniet; die seuns van Jasen; Jónatan;

kjv_text: Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam the son of Sharar the Hararite,
bsb_text: son of Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam son of Sharar the Hararite,
aov_text: Samma, die Harariet; Ahíam, die seun van Sarar, die Árariet;

kjv_text: Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai, the son of the Maachathite, Eliam the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,
bsb_text: Eliphelet son of Ahasbai the Maacathite, Eliam son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,
aov_text: Elifélet, die seun van Ahasbái, die seun van ’n Maägatiet; Elíam, die seun van Agitófel, die Giloniet;

kjv_text: Hezrai the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite,
bsb_text: Hezro the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite,
aov_text: Hésro, die Karmeliet; Páärai, die Arbiet;

kjv_text: Igal the son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,
bsb_text: Igal son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,
aov_text: Jigeal, die seun van Natan, uit Soba; Bani, die Gadiet;

kjv_text: Zelek the Ammonite, Nahari the Beerothite, armourbearer to Joab the son of Zeruiah,
bsb_text: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, the armor-bearer of Joab son of Zeruiah,
aov_text: Selek, die Ammoniet; Náharai, die Beërotiet, die wapendraer van Joab, die seun van Serúja;

kjv_text: Ira an Ithrite, Gareb an Ithrite,
bsb_text: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
aov_text: Ira, die Jitriet; Gareb, die Jitriet;

kjv_text: Uriah the Hittite: thirty and seven in all.
bsb_text: and Uriah the Hittite. There were thirty-seven in all.
aov_text: Uría, die Hetiet—almal saam sewen-en-dertig.

kjv_text: And again the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel, and he moved David against them to say, Go, number Israel and Judah.
bsb_text: Again the anger of the LORD burned against Israel, and He stirred up David against them, saying, “Go and take a census of Israel and Judah.”
aov_text: EN die toorn van die HERE het weer teen Israel ontvlam, en Hy het Dawid teen hulle aangehits en gesê: Gaan tel Israel en Juda.

kjv_text: For the king said to Joab the captain of the host, which was with him, Go now through all the tribes of Israel, from Dan even to Beersheba, and number ye the people, that I may know the number of the people.
bsb_text: So the king said to Joab the commander of his army, who was with him, “Go now throughout the tribes of Israel from Dan to Beersheba and register the troops, so that I may know their number.”
aov_text: Toe sê die koning vir Joab, die leërowerste, wat by hom was: Trek tog rond onder al die stamme van Israel, van Dan tot Berséba, en tel julle die volk, sodat ek die getal van die volk kan weet.

kjv_text: And Joab said unto the king, Now the LORD thy God add unto the people, how many soever they be, an hundredfold, and that the eyes of my lord the king may see it: but why doth my lord the king delight in this thing?
bsb_text: But Joab replied to the king, “May the LORD your God multiply the troops a hundred times over, and may the eyes of my lord the king see it. But why does my lord the king want to do such a thing?”
aov_text: En Joab het aan die koning gesê: Ja, mag die HERE u God by die volk honderd maal meer byvoeg as wat hulle ook al is, en die oë van my heer die koning dit sien; maar waarom het my heer die koning behae in hierdie saak?

kjv_text: Notwithstanding the king's word prevailed against Joab, and against the captains of the host. And Joab and the captains of the host went out from the presence of the king, to number the people of Israel.
bsb_text: Nevertheless, the king’s word prevailed against Joab and against the commanders of the army. So Joab and the commanders of the army departed from the presence of the king to count the troops of Israel.
aov_text: Maar die woord van die koning het die oorhand gehad oor Joab en die leërowerstes, en Joab het met die leërowerstes van die koning af uitgegaan om die volk Israel te tel.

kjv_text: And they passed over Jordan, and pitched in Aroer, on the right side of the city that lieth in the midst of the river of Gad, and toward Jazer:
bsb_text: They crossed the Jordan and camped near Aroer, south of the town in the middle of the valley, and proceeded toward Gad and Jazer.
aov_text: En hulle het deur die Jordaan gegaan en laer opgeslaan by Ároër, regs van die stad wat binne-in die dal van Gad lê, en tot by Jaéser.

kjv_text: Then they came to Gilead, and to the land of Tahtimhodshi; and they came to Danjaan, and about to Zidon,
bsb_text: Then they went to Gilead and the land of Tahtim-hodshi, and on to Dan-jaan and around to Sidon.
aov_text: Verder het hulle in Gílead gekom en in die land Tagtim-Hodsi en na Dan-Jaän gekom en rondom na Sidon.

kjv_text: And came to the strong hold of Tyre, and to all the cities of the Hivites, and of the Canaanites: and they went out to the south of Judah, even to Beersheba.
bsb_text: They went toward the fortress of Tyre and all the cities of the Hivites and Canaanites. Finally, they went on to the Negev of Judah, to Beersheba.
aov_text: En hulle het gekom by die vesting Tirus en al die stede van die Hewiete en Kanaäniete, en hulle het uitgekom in die suide van Juda in Berséba.

kjv_text: So when they had gone through all the land, they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.
bsb_text: At the end of nine months and twenty days, having gone through the whole land, they returned to Jerusalem.
aov_text: So het hulle dan deur die hele land rondgetrek en in Jerusalem aangekom aan die einde van nege maande en twintig dae.

kjv_text: And Joab gave up the sum of the number of the people unto the king: and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men that drew the sword; and the men of Judah were five hundred thousand men.
bsb_text: And Joab reported to the king the total number of the troops. In Israel there were 800,000 men of valor who drew the sword, and in Judah there were 500,000.
aov_text: En Joab het die getal van die getelde volk aan die koning gegee; en Israel was agthonderdduisend weerbare manne wat die swaard uittrek, en die manne van Juda vyfhonderdduisend man.

kjv_text: And David's heart smote him after that he had numbered the people. And David said unto the LORD, I have sinned greatly in that I have done: and now, I beseech thee, O LORD, take away the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.
bsb_text: After David had numbered the troops, his conscience was stricken and he said to the LORD, “I have sinned greatly in what I have done. Now, O LORD, I beg You to take away the iniquity of Your servant, for I have acted very foolishly.”
aov_text: Maar Dawid se gewete het hom gekwel nadat hy die volk getel het, en Dawid het aan die HERE gesê: Ek het swaar gesondig deur wat ek gedoen het; HERE, vergeef dan nou tog die skuld van u kneg, want ek het baie dwaas gehandel.

kjv_text: For when David was up in the morning, the word of the LORD came unto the prophet Gad, David's seer, saying,
bsb_text: When David got up in the morning, a revelation from the LORD had come to Gad the prophet, David’s seer:
aov_text: Toe Dawid die môre opstaan—die woord van die HERE het naamlik tot die profeet Gad, die siener van Dawid, gekom en gesê:

kjv_text: Go and say unto David, Thus saith the LORD, I offer thee three things; choose thee one of them, that I may do it unto thee.
bsb_text: “Go and tell David that this is what the LORD says: ‘I am offering you three options. Choose one of them, and I will carry it out against you.’”
aov_text: Gaan heen en spreek met Dawid: So sê die HERE: Drie dinge lê Ek jou voor; kies vir jou een daaruit, dat Ek jou dit kan aandoen —

kjv_text: So Gad came to David, and told him, and said unto him, Shall seven years of famine come unto thee in thy land? or wilt thou flee three months before thine enemies, while they pursue thee? or that there be three days' pestilence in thy land? now advise, and see what answer I shall return to him that sent me.
bsb_text: So Gad went and said to David, “Do you choose to endure three years of famine in your land, three months of fleeing the pursuit of your enemies, or three days of plague upon your land? Now then, think it over and decide how I should reply to Him who sent me.”
aov_text: toe het Gad by Dawid gekom en dit aan hom bekend gemaak en aan hom gesê: Wil jy dat daar sewe jaar lank hongersnood in jou land kom, of wil jy drie maande lank vlug voor jou teëstanders uit dat hulle jou agtervolg, of moet daar drie dae lank pes wees in jou land? Ondersoek nou en sien watter antwoord ek my Sender moet bring.

kjv_text: And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let us fall now into the hand of the LORD; for his mercies are great: and let me not fall into the hand of man.
bsb_text: David answered Gad, “I am deeply distressed. Please, let us fall into the hand of the LORD, for His mercies are great; but do not let me fall into the hands of men.”
aov_text: Daarop sê Dawid vir Gad: Ek is baie benoud; laat ons tog val in die hand van die HERE, want sy barmhartighede is groot, maar laat my in die hand van mense nie val nie.
