aov_text: En hy het oor die bome gespreek, van die seder op die Líbanon tot die hisop wat teen die muur uitspruit; ook het hy gespreek oor die vee en oor die voëls en oor die kruipende diere en oor die visse.

kjv_text: And there came of all people to hear the wisdom of Solomon, from all kings of the earth, which had heard of his wisdom.
bsb_text: So men of all nations came to listen to Solomon’s wisdom, sent by all the kings of the earth, who had heard of his wisdom.
aov_text: En van al die volke het hulle gekom om na die wysheid van Salomo te luister, van al die konings van die aarde wat van sy wysheid gehoor het.

kjv_text: And Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants unto Solomon; for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the room of his father: for Hiram was ever a lover of David.
bsb_text: Now when Hiram king of Tyre heard that Solomon had been anointed king in his father’s place, he sent envoys to Solomon; for Hiram had always been a friend of David.
aov_text: EN Hiram, die koning van Tirus, het sy dienaars na Salomo gestuur, omdat hy gehoor het dat hulle hom in sy vader se plek as koning gesalf het, want Hiram was altyd ’n vriend van Dawid.

kjv_text: And Solomon sent to Hiram, saying,
bsb_text: And Solomon relayed this message to Hiram:
aov_text: Daarop laat Salomo aan Hiram weet:

kjv_text: Thou knowest how that David my father could not build an house unto the name of the LORD his God for the wars which were about him on every side, until the LORD put them under the soles of his feet.
bsb_text: “As you are well aware, due to the wars waged on all sides against my father David, he could not build a house for the Name of the LORD his God until the LORD had put his enemies under his feet.
aov_text: U weet self dat my vader Dawid geen huis vir die Naam van die HERE sy God kon bou nie vanweë die oorlog waarmee hulle hom omring het, totdat die HERE hulle onder sy voetsole gebring het.

kjv_text: But now the LORD my God hath given me rest on every side, so that there is neither adversary nor evil occurrent.
bsb_text: But now the LORD my God has given me rest on every side, and there is no adversary or crisis.
aov_text: Maar nou het die HERE my God my rus gegee rondom; daar is geen teëstander en daar is geen onheil wat dreig nie.

kjv_text: And, behold, I purpose to build an house unto the name of the LORD my God, as the LORD spake unto David my father, saying, Thy son, whom I will set upon thy throne in thy room, he shall build an house unto my name.
bsb_text: So behold, I plan to build a house for the Name of the LORD my God, according to what the LORD said to my father David: ‘I will put your son on your throne in your place, and he will build the house for My Name.’
aov_text: En kyk, ek is van plan om vir die Naam van die HERE my God ’n huis te bou soos die HERE met my vader Dawid gespreek en gesê het: Jou seun wat Ek in jou plek op jou troon sal sit, hy sal die huis vir my Naam bou.

kjv_text: Now therefore command thou that they hew me cedar trees out of Lebanon; and my servants shall be with thy servants: and unto thee will I give hire for thy servants according to all that thou shalt appoint: for thou knowest that there is not among us any that can skill to hew timber like unto the Sidonians.
bsb_text: Now therefore, order that cedars of Lebanon be cut down for me. My servants will be with your servants, and I will pay your servants whatever wages you set, for you know that there are none among us as skilled in logging as the Sidonians.”
aov_text: Gee dan nou bevel dat hulle vir my seders uit die Líbanon kap, en laat my dienaars saam met u dienaars wees, en die loon van u dienaars sal ek u gee net soos u sê; want u weet self dat onder ons niemand is wat verstaan om bome te kap soos die Sidoniërs nie.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when Hiram heard the words of Solomon, that he rejoiced greatly, and said, Blessed be the LORD this day, which hath given unto David a wise son over this great people.
bsb_text: When Hiram received Solomon’s message, he rejoiced greatly and said, “Blessed be the LORD this day! He has given David a wise son over this great people!”
aov_text: Net toe Hiram die woorde van Salomo hoor, was hy baie bly en sê: Geseënd is die HERE vandag wat vir Dawid ’n wyse seun gegee het oor hierdie groot volk.

kjv_text: And Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, I have considered the things which thou sentest to me for: and I will do all thy desire concerning timber of cedar, and concerning timber of fir.
bsb_text: Then Hiram sent a reply to Solomon, saying: “I have received your message; I will do all you desire regarding the cedar and cypress timber.
aov_text: Daarop laat Hiram aan Salomo weet: Ek het gehoor wat u my laat weet het; ék sal doen alles wat u verlang insake die sederhout en die sipreshout.

kjv_text: My servants shall bring them down from Lebanon unto the sea: and I will convey them by sea in floats unto the place that thou shalt appoint me, and will cause them to be discharged there, and thou shalt receive them: and thou shalt accomplish my desire, in giving food for my household.
bsb_text: My servants will haul the logs from Lebanon to the Sea, and I will float them as rafts by sea to the place you specify. There I will separate the logs, and you can take them away. And in exchange, you can meet my needs by providing my household with food.”
aov_text: My dienaars sal dit van die Líbanon na die see afbring, en ék sal daar vlotte van maak op die see, tot by die plek wat u my sal laat weet, en ek sal dit daar uitmekaar laat neem; dan kan ú dit laat wegneem; en ú moet doen wat ek verlang deur voedsel aan my huis te lewer.

kjv_text: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar trees and fir trees according to all his desire.
bsb_text: So Hiram provided Solomon with all the cedar and cypress timber he wanted,
aov_text: So het Hiram dan aan Salomo sederhout en sipreshout gelewer, soveel as hy wou hê,

kjv_text: And Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand measures of wheat for food to his household, and twenty measures of pure oil: thus gave Solomon to Hiram year by year.
bsb_text: and year after year Solomon would provide Hiram with 20,000 cors of wheat as food for his household, as well as 20,000 baths of pure olive oil.
aov_text: terwyl Salomo aan Hiram gelewer het twintigduisend kor koring as voedsel vir sy huis en twintig kor uitgestampte olie; so het Salomo aan Hiram jaar vir jaar gelewer.

kjv_text: And the LORD gave Solomon wisdom, as he promised him: and there was peace between Hiram and Solomon; and they two made a league together.
bsb_text: And the LORD gave Solomon wisdom, as He had promised him. There was peace between Hiram and Solomon, and the two of them made a treaty.
aov_text: En die HERE het aan Salomo wysheid gegee volgens sy belofte, en daar was vrede tussen Hiram en Salomo, en hulle twee het ’n verbond gesluit.

kjv_text: And king Solomon raised a levy out of all Israel; and the levy was thirty thousand men.
bsb_text: Then King Solomon conscripted a labor force of 30,000 men from all Israel.
aov_text: Verder het koning Salomo uit die hele Israel die dwangarbeiders laat opkom, sodat die dwangarbeiders dertigduisend man was.

kjv_text: And he sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand a month by courses: a month they were in Lebanon, and two months at home: and Adoniram was over the levy.
bsb_text: He sent them to Lebanon in monthly shifts of 10,000 men, so that they would spend one month in Lebanon and two months at home. And Adoniram was in charge of the forced labor.
aov_text: En hy het hulle gestuur na die Líbanon, tienduisend elke maand by beurte; een maand was hulle op die Líbanon, twee maande tuis; en Adoníram was oor die dwangarbeid.

kjv_text: And Solomon had threescore and ten thousand that bare burdens, and fourscore thousand hewers in the mountains;
bsb_text: Solomon had 70,000 porters and 80,000 stonecutters in the mountains,
aov_text: Salomo het ook sewentigduisend draers en tagtigduisend klipkappers op die gebergte gehad,

kjv_text: Beside the chief of Solomon's officers which were over the work, three thousand and three hundred, which ruled over the people that wrought in the work.
bsb_text: not including his 3,300 foremen who supervised the workers.
aov_text: behalwe die hoofopsigters van Salomo wat oor die werk was, drieduisend-driehonderd wat bevel gevoer het oor die mense wat die werk doen.

kjv_text: And the king commanded, and they brought great stones, costly stones, and hewed stones, to lay the foundation of the house.
bsb_text: And the king commanded them to quarry large, costly stones to lay the foundation of the temple with dressed stones.
aov_text: En die koning het bevel gegee om groot klippe, kosbare klippe uit te breek om die fondament van die huis met gekapte klippe te lê.

kjv_text: And Solomon's builders and Hiram's builders did hew them, and the stonesquarers: so they prepared timber and stones to build the house.
bsb_text: So Solomon’s and Hiram’s builders, along with the Gebalites, quarried the stone and prepared the timber and stone for the construction of the temple.
aov_text: En die bouers van Salomo en die bouers van Hiram en die Gibliete het dit gekap en die boomstamme en die klippe bewerk om die huis te bou.

kjv_text: And it came to pass in the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon's reign over Israel, in the month Zif, which is the second month, that he began to build the house of the LORD.
bsb_text: In the four hundred and eightieth year after the Israelites had come out of the land of Egypt, in the month of Ziv, the second month of the fourth year of Solomon’s reign over Israel, he began to build the house of the LORD.
aov_text: EN in die vierhonderd-en-tagtigste jaar ná die uittog van die kinders van Israel uit Egipteland, in die vierde jaar van Salomo se regering oor Israel, in die maand Sif—dit is die tweede maand—het hy die huis vir die HERE gebou.

kjv_text: And the house which king Solomon built for the LORD, the length thereof was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits.
bsb_text: The house that King Solomon built for the LORD was sixty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and thirty cubits high.
aov_text: En die huis wat koning Salomo vir die HERE gebou het, was sestig el in sy lengte en twintig in sy breedte en dertig el in sy hoogte.

kjv_text: And the porch before the temple of the house, twenty cubits was the length thereof, according to the breadth of the house; and ten cubits was the breadth thereof before the house.
bsb_text: The portico at the front of the main hall of the temple was twenty cubits long, extending across the width of the temple and projecting out ten cubits in front of the temple.
aov_text: En die voorportaal, aan die voorkant van die hoofvertrek van die huis, was twintig el in sy lengte, oor die breedte van die huis; tien el in sy breedte aan die voorkant van die huis.

kjv_text: And for the house he made windows of narrow lights.
bsb_text: He also had narrow windows framed high in the temple.
aov_text: En hy het aan die huis vensters gemaak met smal latwerk.

kjv_text: And against the wall of the house he built chambers round about, against the walls of the house round about, both of the temple and of the oracle: and he made chambers round about:
bsb_text: Against the walls of the temple and the inner sanctuary, Solomon built a chambered structure around the temple, in which he constructed the side rooms.
aov_text: En teen die muur van die huis het hy rondom ’n aanbousel opgetrek, aan die mure van die huis rondom die hoofvertrek en die binneste vertrek, en hy het dit rondom in verdiepings gemaak.

kjv_text: The nethermost chamber was five cubits broad, and the middle was six cubits broad, and the third was seven cubits broad: for without in the wall of the house he made narrowed rests round about, that the beams should not be fastened in the walls of the house.
bsb_text: The bottom floor was five cubits wide, the middle floor six cubits, and the third floor seven cubits. He also placed offset ledges around the outside of the temple, so that nothing would be inserted into its walls.
aov_text: Die onderste verdieping was vyf el in sy breedte en die middelste ses el in sy breedte en die derde sewe el in sy breedte; want hy het vir die huis rondom buitekant inkortings gemaak, om nie in die mure van die huis in te las nie.

kjv_text: And the house, when it was in building, was built of stone made ready before it was brought thither: so that there was neither hammer nor axe nor any tool of iron heard in the house, while it was in building.
bsb_text: The temple was constructed using finished stones cut at the quarry, so that no hammer or chisel or any other iron tool was heard in the temple while it was being built.
aov_text: En toe die huis gebou is, is dit opgetrek van klippe, kant en klaar uit die breekplek: hamers en koubeitels, enige ystergereedskap, is nie gehoor by die huis toe dit gebou is nie.

kjv_text: The door for the middle chamber was in the right side of the house: and they went up with winding stairs into the middle chamber, and out of the middle into the third.
bsb_text: The entrance to the bottom floor was on the south side of the temple. A stairway led up to the middle level, and from there to the third floor.
aov_text: Die ingang van die onderste verdieping was aan die suidelike sykant van die huis, en wenteltrappe het opgegaan na die middelste, en van die middelste na die derde.

kjv_text: So he built the house, and finished it; and covered the house with beams and boards of cedar.
bsb_text: So Solomon built the temple and finished it, roofing it with beams and planks of cedar.
aov_text: En toe hy die huis klaar gebou het, het hy die huis oordek, by wyse van vakke en rye, met sederhout.

kjv_text: And then he built chambers against all the house, five cubits high: and they rested on the house with timber of cedar.
bsb_text: He built chambers all along the temple, each five cubits high and attached to the temple with beams of cedar.
aov_text: En hy het die aanbousel teen die hele huis gebou; vyf el was elke verdieping hoog; en hy het dit aan die huis bevestig met sederbalke.

kjv_text: And the word of the LORD came to Solomon, saying,
bsb_text: Then the word of the LORD came to Solomon, saying:
aov_text: En die woord van die HERE het tot Salomo gekom en gesê:

kjv_text: Concerning this house which thou art in building, if thou wilt walk in my statutes, and execute my judgments, and keep all my commandments to walk in them; then will I perform my word with thee, which I spake unto David thy father:
bsb_text: “As for this temple you are building, if you walk in My statutes, carry out My ordinances, and keep all My commandments by walking in them, I will fulfill through you the promise I made to your father David.
aov_text: Wat hierdie huis betref, wat jy besig is om te bou—as jy wandel in my insettinge en my verordeninge uitvoer en al my gebooie onderhou om daarin te wandel, dan sal Ek my woord wat Ek tot jou vader Dawid gespreek het, aan jou vervul;

kjv_text: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will not forsake my people Israel.
bsb_text: And I will dwell among the Israelites and will not abandon My people Israel.”
aov_text: dan sal Ek onder die kinders van Israel woon en my volk Israel nie verlaat nie.

kjv_text: So Solomon built the house, and finished it.
bsb_text: So Solomon built the temple and finished it.
aov_text: Toe Salomo die huis klaar gebou het,

kjv_text: And he built the walls of the house within with boards of cedar, both the floor of the house, and the walls of the ceiling: and he covered them on the inside with wood, and covered the floor of the house with planks of fir.
bsb_text: He lined the interior walls with cedar paneling from the floor of the temple to the ceiling, and he covered the floor with cypress boards.
aov_text: het hy die mure van die huis van binne bedek met sederplanke; van die vloer van die huis af tot by die balke van die plafon het hy dit van binne met hout belê, en die vloer van die huis het hy met sipresplanke belê.

kjv_text: And he built twenty cubits on the sides of the house, both the floor and the walls with boards of cedar: he even built them for it within, even for the oracle, even for the most holy place.
bsb_text: He partitioned off the twenty cubits at the rear of the temple with cedar boards from floor to ceiling to form within the temple an inner sanctuary, the Most Holy Place.
aov_text: Verder het hy die twintig el van die agterkant van die huis met sederplanke bedek, van die vloer af tot by die balke, en dit aan die binnekant as ’n binneste vertrek, as ’n Allerheiligste, gebou.

kjv_text: And the house, that is, the temple before it, was forty cubits long.
bsb_text: And the main hall in front of this room was forty cubits long.
aov_text: En vooraan was die huis, dit is die hoofvertrek, veertig el.

kjv_text: And the cedar of the house within was carved with knops and open flowers: all was cedar; there was no stone seen.
bsb_text: The cedar paneling inside the temple was carved with gourds and open flowers. Everything was cedar; not a stone could be seen.
aov_text: En sederhout was aan die huis binnekant: snywerk van kolokwinte en oop blomknoppe, dit alles van sederhout; geen klip was daar te sien nie.

kjv_text: And the oracle he prepared in the house within, to set there the ark of the covenant of the LORD.
bsb_text: Solomon also prepared the inner sanctuary within the temple to set the ark of the covenant of the LORD there.
aov_text: So het hy dan ’n binneste vertrek binnekant in die middel van die huis ingerig om die verbondsark van die HERE daar neer te sit.

kjv_text: And the oracle in the forepart was twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in breadth, and twenty cubits in the height thereof: and he overlaid it with pure gold; and so covered the altar which was of cedar.
bsb_text: The inner sanctuary was twenty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and twenty cubits high. He overlaid the inside with pure gold, and he also overlaid the altar of cedar.
aov_text: En die binneste vertrek was twintig el in lengte en twintig el in breedte en twintig el in sy hoogte, en hy het dit oorgetrek met fyn goud; en die altaar het hy met sederhout bedek.

kjv_text: So Solomon overlaid the house within with pure gold: and he made a partition by the chains of gold before the oracle; and he overlaid it with gold.
bsb_text: So Solomon overlaid the inside of the temple with pure gold, and he extended gold chains across the front of the inner sanctuary, which was overlaid with gold.
aov_text: Verder het Salomo die huis van binne met fyn goud oorgetrek, en hy het ’n afsluiting met goue kettings gemaak voor die binneste vertrek, wat hy met goud oorgetrek het.

kjv_text: And the whole house he overlaid with gold, until he had finished all the house: also the whole altar that was by the oracle he overlaid with gold.
bsb_text: So he overlaid with gold the whole interior of the temple, until everything was completely finished. He also overlaid with gold the entire altar that belonged to the inner sanctuary.
aov_text: En die hele huis het hy met goud oorgetrek, totdat die hele huis daarmee bedek was; en die hele altaar wat by die binneste vertrek behoort, het hy met goud oorgetrek.

kjv_text: And within the oracle he made two cherubims of olive tree, each ten cubits high.
bsb_text: In the inner sanctuary he made two cherubim, each ten cubits high, out of olive wood.
aov_text: Verder het hy in die binneste vertrek twee gérubs gemaak van oliewenhout, tien el hoog.

kjv_text: And five cubits was the one wing of the cherub, and five cubits the other wing of the cherub: from the uttermost part of the one wing unto the uttermost part of the other were ten cubits.
bsb_text: One wing of the first cherub was five cubits long, and the other wing was five cubits long as well. So the full wingspan was ten cubits.
aov_text: En vyf el was die een vlerk van die gérub, en vyf el was die ander vlerk van die gérub: tien el van die een punt van sy vlerke tot by die ander punt daarvan.

kjv_text: And the other cherub was ten cubits: both the cherubims were of one measure and one size.
bsb_text: The second cherub also measured ten cubits; both cherubim had the same size and shape,
aov_text: En tien el die tweede gérub: altwee die gérubs het een maat en een gestalte gehad.

kjv_text: The height of the one cherub was ten cubits, and so was it of the other cherub.
bsb_text: and the height of each cherub was ten cubits.
aov_text: Die hoogte van die een gérub was tien el, en net so die ander gérub.

kjv_text: And he set the cherubims within the inner house: and they stretched forth the wings of the cherubims, so that the wing of the one touched the one wall, and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall; and their wings touched one another in the midst of the house.
bsb_text: And he placed the cherubim inside the innermost room of the temple. Since their wings were spread out, the wing of the first cherub touched one wall, while the wing of the second cherub touched the other wall, and in the middle of the room their wingtips touched.
aov_text: Toe het hy die gérubs in die middel van die binneste vertrek gesit, en die vlerke van die gérubs was uitgesprei, sodat die vlerk van die een aan die een muur en die vlerk van die ander gérub aan die ander muur raak, terwyl hulle vlerke, na die middel van die vertrek toe, vlerk teen vlerk raak.

kjv_text: And he overlaid the cherubims with gold.
bsb_text: He also overlaid the cherubim with gold.
aov_text: Verder het hy die gérubs met goud oorgetrek.

kjv_text: And he carved all the walls of the house round about with carved figures of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, within and without.
bsb_text: Then he carved the walls all around the temple, in both the inner and outer sanctuaries, with carved engravings of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers.
aov_text: En aan al die mure van die huis rondom, van die binneste en die buitenste vertrek, het hy figure van gérubs en palmbome en oop blomknoppe laat uitsny.

kjv_text: And the floor of the house he overlaid with gold, within and without.
bsb_text: And he overlaid the temple floor with gold in both the inner and outer sanctuaries.
aov_text: En die vloer van die huis, van die binneste en die buitenste vertrek, het hy met goud oorgetrek.

kjv_text: And for the entering of the oracle he made doors of olive tree: the lintel and side posts were a fifth part of the wall.
bsb_text: For the entrance to the inner sanctuary, Solomon constructed doors of olive wood with five-sided doorposts.
aov_text: En as ingang van die binneste vertrek het hy deure van oliewenhout gemaak; die uitspringende raamwerk van die deurposte het die vorm van ’n vyfhoek gehad.

kjv_text: The two doors also were of olive tree; and he carved upon them carvings of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, and overlaid them with gold, and spread gold upon the cherubims, and upon the palm trees.
bsb_text: The double doors were made of olive wood, and he carved into them cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers and overlaid the cherubim and palm trees with hammered gold.
aov_text: En die twee deurvleuels was van oliewenhout, en daarop het hy figure van gérubs en palmbome en oop blomknoppe laat uitsny en dit met goud oorgetrek, en die goud op die gérubs en op die palmbome ingeslaan.

kjv_text: So also made he for the door of the temple posts of olive tree, a fourth part of the wall.
bsb_text: In the same way he made four-sided doorposts of olive wood for the sanctuary entrance.
aov_text: En net so het hy vir die ingang van die hoofvertrek gemaak: deurposte van oliewenhout, vierkantig;

kjv_text: And the two doors were of fir tree: the two leaves of the one door were folding, and the two leaves of the other door were folding.
bsb_text: The two doors were made of cypress wood, and each had two folding panels.
aov_text: en twee deurvleuels van sipreshout: die een vleuel van twee draaibare helftes en die ander vleuel van twee draaibare helftes.

kjv_text: And he carved thereon cherubims and palm trees and open flowers: and covered them with gold fitted upon the carved work.
bsb_text: He carved into them cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers; and he overlaid them with gold, hammered evenly over the carvings.
aov_text: En hy het daarop gérubs en palmbome en oop blomknoppe uitgesny, en met goud, dun oor die snywerk uitgeslaan, oorgetrek.

kjv_text: And he built the inner court with three rows of hewed stone, and a row of cedar beams.
bsb_text: Solomon built the inner courtyard with three rows of dressed stone and one row of trimmed cedar beams.
aov_text: Verder het hy die binneste voorhof gebou van drie lae gekapte klip en een laag sederbalke.

kjv_text: In the fourth year was the foundation of the house of the LORD laid, in the month Zif:
bsb_text: The foundation of the house of the LORD was laid in the fourth year of Solomon’s reign, in the month of Ziv.
aov_text: In die vierde jaar is die fondament van die huis van die HERE gelê, in die maand Sif,

kjv_text: And in the eleventh year, in the month Bul, which is the eighth month, was the house finished throughout all the parts thereof, and according to all the fashion of it. So was he seven years in building it.
bsb_text: In his eleventh year and eighth month, the month of Bul, the temple was finished in every detail and according to every specification. So he built the temple in seven years.
aov_text: en in die elfde jaar, in die maand Bul—dit is die agtste maand—was die huis voltooi in al sy dele en volgens al sy vereistes, sodat hy sewe jaar daaraan gebou het.

kjv_text: But Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.
bsb_text: Solomon, however, took thirteen years to complete the construction of his entire palace.
aov_text: MAAR aan sy huis het Salomo dertien jaar gebou en die hele huis voltooi.

kjv_text: He built also the house of the forest of Lebanon; the length thereof was an hundred cubits, and the breadth thereof fifty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits, upon four rows of cedar pillars, with cedar beams upon the pillars.
bsb_text: He built the House of the Forest of Lebanon a hundred cubits long, fifty cubits wide, and thirty cubits high, with four rows of cedar pillars supporting the cedar beams.
aov_text: Hy het naamlik die huis van die Líbanon-bos gebou, honderd el in sy lengte en vyftig el in sy breedte en dertig el in sy hoogte, op vier rye sederpilare en sederbalke op die pilare.

kjv_text: And it was covered with cedar above upon the beams, that lay on forty five pillars, fifteen in a row.
bsb_text: The house was roofed with cedar above the beams that rested on the pillars—forty-five beams, fifteen per row.
aov_text: En dit was van bo oordek met sederhout, op die verdiepings wat rus op die pilare, vyf-en-veertig bo-vertrekke, vyftien in ’n ry.

kjv_text: And there were windows in three rows, and light was against light in three ranks.
bsb_text: There were three rows of high windows facing one another in three tiers.
aov_text: En daar was drie rye vensters van latwerk; en oop venster teenoor oop venster, drie maal.

kjv_text: And all the doors and posts were square, with the windows: and light was against light in three ranks.
bsb_text: All the doorways had rectangular frames, with the openings facing one another in three tiers.
aov_text: En al die deure met die vensters was vierkantig van houtwerk, en venster was teenoor venster, drie maal.

kjv_text: And he made a porch of pillars; the length thereof was fifty cubits, and the breadth thereof thirty cubits: and the porch was before them: and the other pillars and the thick beam were before them.
bsb_text: Solomon made his colonnade fifty cubits long and thirty cubits wide, with a portico in front of it and a canopy with pillars in front of the portico.
aov_text: En die pilare-voorhuis het hy gemaak, vyftig el in sy lengte en dertig el in sy breedte, met ’n voorportaal daarvoor, naamlik pilare en ’n afdak daaroor.

kjv_text: Then he made a porch for the throne where he might judge, even the porch of judgment: and it was covered with cedar from one side of the floor to the other.
bsb_text: In addition, he built a hall for the throne, the Hall of Justice, where he was to judge. It was paneled with cedar from floor to ceiling.
aov_text: Verder het hy die troonsaal gemaak waar hy reggespreek het, die regsaal, en dit was bedek met sederhout van vloer tot vloer.

kjv_text: And his house where he dwelt had another court within the porch, which was of the like work. Solomon made also an house for Pharaoh's daughter, whom he had taken to wife, like unto this porch.
bsb_text: And the palace where Solomon would live, set further back, was of similar construction. He also made a palace like this hall for Pharaoh’s daughter, whom he had married.
aov_text: Ook sy huis waar hy gewoon het, in die ander voorhof, van die saal af binnekant toe, was van dieselfde maaksel; en hy het vir die dogter van Farao wat Salomo geneem het, ’n huis gemaak soos hierdie saal.

kjv_text: All these were of costly stones, according to the measures of hewed stones, sawed with saws, within and without, even from the foundation unto the coping, and so on the outside toward the great court.
bsb_text: All these buildings were constructed with costly stones, cut to size and trimmed with saws inside and out from the foundation to the eaves, and from the outside to the great courtyard.
aov_text: Dit was alles van kosbare klippe, volgens die maat van gekapte klip, aan die binne- en buitekant met die saag bewerk, naamlik van die fondament af tot by die muurplate, en van die buitekant af tot by die groot voorhof.

kjv_text: And the foundation was of costly stones, even great stones, stones of ten cubits, and stones of eight cubits.
bsb_text: The foundations were laid with large, costly stones, some ten cubits long and some eight cubits long.
aov_text: En die fondament was van kosbare klippe, groot klippe, klippe van tien el en klippe van agt el.

kjv_text: And above were costly stones, after the measures of hewed stones, and cedars.
bsb_text: Above these were high-grade stones, cut to size, and cedar beams.
aov_text: En daar bo-op was kosbare klippe, volgens die maat van gekapte klip, en sederhout.

kjv_text: And the great court round about was with three rows of hewed stones, and a row of cedar beams, both for the inner court of the house of the LORD, and for the porch of the house.
bsb_text: The great courtyard was surrounded by three rows of dressed stone and a row of trimmed cedar beams, as were the inner courtyard and portico of the house of the LORD.
aov_text: En die groot voorhof was rondom van drie lae gekapte klip en ’n laag sederbalke, net soos by die binneste voorhof van die huis van die HERE en by die saal van die paleis.

kjv_text: And king Solomon sent and fetched Hiram out of Tyre.
bsb_text: Now King Solomon sent to bring Huram from Tyre.
aov_text: En koning Salomo het Hiram uit Tirus laat haal.

kjv_text: He was a widow's son of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a worker in brass: and he was filled with wisdom, and understanding, and cunning to work all works in brass. And he came to king Solomon, and wrought all his work.
bsb_text: He was the son of a widow from the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a craftsman in bronze. Huram had great skill, understanding, and knowledge for every kind of bronze work. So he came to King Solomon and carried out all his work.
aov_text: Hy was die seun van ’n weduvrou uit die stam van Náftali, en sy vader was ’n man van Tirus, ’n kopersmid; en hy was vol wysheid en verstand en kennis om allerhande werk in koper te maak. Hy het toe by koning Salomo gekom en al sy werk uitgevoer.

kjv_text: For he cast two pillars of brass, of eighteen cubits high apiece: and a line of twelve cubits did compass either of them about.
bsb_text: He cast two pillars of bronze, each eighteen cubits high and twelve cubits in circumference.
aov_text: HY het naamlik die twee pilare van koper gevorm; agttien el was die hoogte van die een pilaar, en ’n lyn van twaalf el kon die tweede pilaar omspan.

kjv_text: And he made two chapiters of molten brass, to set upon the tops of the pillars: the height of the one chapiter was five cubits, and the height of the other chapiter was five cubits:
bsb_text: He also made two capitals of cast bronze to set on top of the pillars, each capital five cubits high.
aov_text: En hy het twee kapitele gemaak om op die toppe van die pilare te sit, gietwerk van koper; vyf el was die hoogte van die een kapiteel, en vyf el was die hoogte van die ander kapiteel.

kjv_text: And nets of checker work, and wreaths of chain work, for the chapiters which were upon the top of the pillars; seven for the one chapiter, and seven for the other chapiter.
bsb_text: For the capitals on top of the pillars he made a network of lattice, with wreaths of chainwork, seven for each capital.
aov_text: Daar was vlegwerke—die maaksel van die vlegwerk was gedraaide drade, ’n maaksel van kettinkies—vir die kapitele op die top van die pilare; sewe vir die een kapiteel en sewe vir die ander kapiteel.

kjv_text: And he made the pillars, and two rows round about upon the one network, to cover the chapiters that were upon the top, with pomegranates: and so did he for the other chapiter.
bsb_text: Likewise, he made the pillars with two rows of pomegranates around each grating to cover each capital atop the pillars.
aov_text: Verder het hy die granaatjies gemaak, naamlik twee rye rondom oor die een vlegwerk, om die kapitele op die top van die pilare te bedek; en net so het hy vir die ander kapiteel gemaak.

kjv_text: And the chapiters that were upon the top of the pillars were of lily work in the porch, four cubits.
bsb_text: And the capitals atop the pillars in the portico were shaped like lilies, four cubits high.
aov_text: En die kapitele op die top van die pilare aan die voorportaal was vier el, lelievormig,

kjv_text: And the chapiters upon the two pillars had pomegranates also above, over against the belly which was by the network: and the pomegranates were two hundred in rows round about upon the other chapiter.
bsb_text: On the capitals of both pillars, just above the rounded projection next to the network, were the two hundred pomegranates in rows encircling each capital.
aov_text: naamlik die kapitele op die twee pilare bo-aan, verby die vlegwerk wat vlak op die bol was. En die granaatjies was tweehonderd, in rye rondom, ook oor die tweede kapiteel.

kjv_text: And he set up the pillars in the porch of the temple: and he set up the right pillar, and called the name thereof Jachin: and he set up the left pillar, and called the name thereof Boaz.
bsb_text: Thus he set up the pillars at the portico of the temple. The pillar to the south he named Jachin, and the pillar to the north he named Boaz.
aov_text: En hy het die pilare opgerig by die voorportaal van die hoofvertrek. Toe hy die regterpilaar opgerig het, noem hy dit Jagin; en toe hy die linkerpilaar opgerig het, noem hy dit Boas.

kjv_text: And upon the top of the pillars was lily work: so was the work of the pillars finished.
bsb_text: And the tops of the pillars were shaped like lilies. So the work of the pillars was completed.
aov_text: Toe die leliewerk op die top van die pilare was, was die werk aan die pilare voltooi.

kjv_text: And he made a molten sea, ten cubits from the one brim to the other: it was round all about, and his height was five cubits: and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.
bsb_text: He also made the Sea of cast metal. It was circular in shape, measuring ten cubits from rim to rim, five cubits in height, and thirty cubits in circumference.
aov_text: Verder het hy die see gemaak van gietwerk; van rand tot rand was tien el, heeltemal rond; en die hoogte daarvan was vyf el, en ’n lyn van dertig el kon dit rondom omspan.

kjv_text: And under the brim of it round about there were knops compassing it, ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about: the knops were cast in two rows, when it was cast.
bsb_text: Below the rim, ornamental buds encircled it, ten per cubit all the way around the Sea, cast in two rows as a part of the Sea.
aov_text: En kolokwinte onder die rand daarvan het dit rondom omring; tien op die el het hulle die see rondom omring: twee rye kolokwinte wat aan die gietwerk daarvan vasgegiet is.

kjv_text: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea was set above upon them, and all their hinder parts were inward.
bsb_text: The Sea stood on twelve oxen, three facing north, three facing west, three facing south, and three facing east. The Sea rested on them, with all their hindquarters toward the center.
aov_text: Dit het gestaan op twaalf beeste: drie kyk na die noorde, en drie kyk na die weste, en drie kyk na die suide, en drie kyk na die ooste toe, terwyl die see bo-op hulle was, en al hulle agterdele was binnekant toe.

kjv_text: And it was an hand breadth thick, and the brim thereof was wrought like the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies: it contained two thousand baths.
bsb_text: It was a handbreadth thick, and its rim was fashioned like the brim of a cup, like a lily blossom. It could hold two thousand baths.
aov_text: En die dikte daarvan was ’n handbreed, en sy rand was in die vorm van ’n bekerrand, soos ’n lelieblom; dit het tweeduisend bat gehou.

kjv_text: And he made ten bases of brass; four cubits was the length of one base, and four cubits the breadth thereof, and three cubits the height of it.
bsb_text: In addition, he made ten movable stands of bronze, each four cubits long, four cubits wide, and three cubits high.
aov_text: Hy het ook die tien afspoelwaentjies van koper gemaak; die lengte van elke afspoelwaentjie was vier el, en vier el sy breedte en drie el sy hoogte.

kjv_text: And the work of the bases was on this manner: they had borders, and the borders were between the ledges:
bsb_text: This was the design of the stands: They had side panels attached to uprights,
aov_text: En dit was die maaksel van die bak: dit het sluitplate gehad, naamlik sluitplate tussen die sporte;

kjv_text: And on the borders that were between the ledges were lions, oxen, and cherubims: and upon the ledges there was a base above: and beneath the lions and oxen were certain additions made of thin work.
bsb_text: and on the panels between the uprights were lions, oxen, and cherubim. On the uprights was a pedestal above, and below the lions and oxen were wreaths of beveled work.
aov_text: en op die sluitplate tussen die sporte was leeus, beeste en gérubs; en net so op die sporte; bokant en onderkant die leeus en beeste was afhangende kransversierings.

kjv_text: And every base had four brasen wheels, and plates of brass: and the four corners thereof had undersetters: under the laver were undersetters molten, at the side of every addition.
bsb_text: Each stand had four bronze wheels with bronze axles and a basin resting on four supports, with wreaths at each side.
aov_text: En elke afspoelwaentjie het vier koperwiele en koperasse gehad, en sy vier hoekstyle het skouerstukke gehad; onder teen die wasbak was die skouerstukke vasgegiet; teenoor elkeen was kranse.

kjv_text: And the mouth of it within the chapiter and above was a cubit: but the mouth thereof was round after the work of the base, a cubit and an half: and also upon the mouth of it were gravings with their borders, foursquare, not round.
bsb_text: The opening to each stand inside the crown at the top was one cubit deep, with a round opening like the design of a pedestal, a cubit and a half wide. And around its opening were engravings, but the panels of the stands were square, not round.
aov_text: En die opening daarvan was binnekant die kraag, en boontoe een el; en die opening daarvan was rond, in die vorm van ’n voetstuk, anderhalf el; en ook die opening daarvan was graveerwerk, maar die sluitplate daarvan was vierkantig, nie rond nie.

kjv_text: And under the borders were four wheels; and the axletrees of the wheels were joined to the base: and the height of a wheel was a cubit and half a cubit.
bsb_text: There were four wheels under the panels, and the axles of the wheels were attached to the stand; each wheel was a cubit and a half in diameter.
aov_text: En die vier wiele was onder die sluitplate, en die kloue van die wiele was in die bak, terwyl die hoogte van elke wiel anderhalf el was.

kjv_text: And the work of the wheels was like the work of a chariot wheel: their axletrees, and their naves, and their felloes, and their spokes, were all molten.
bsb_text: The wheels were made like chariot wheels; their axles, rims, spokes, and hubs were all of cast metal.
aov_text: En die maaksel van die wiele was in die vorm van ’n wawiel; die kloue en die vellings en die speke en die nawe daarvan was alles gietwerk.

kjv_text: And there were four undersetters to the four corners of one base: and the undersetters were of the very base itself.
bsb_text: Each stand had four handles, one for each corner, projecting from the stand.
aov_text: En vier skouerstukke was aan die vier hoeke van elke afspoelwaentjie; die skouerstukke daarvan was met die bak saam uit een stuk.

kjv_text: And in the top of the base was there a round compass of half a cubit high: and on the top of the base the ledges thereof and the borders thereof were of the same.
bsb_text: At the top of each stand was a circular band half a cubit high. The supports and panels were cast as a unit with the top of the stand.
aov_text: En bo-aan die afspoelwaentjie was daar ’n kraag van ’n half-el hoog, heeltemal rond; en bo-op die bak was die kloue en sluitplate daarvan, daarmee saam uit een stuk.

kjv_text: For on the plates of the ledges thereof, and on the borders thereof, he graved cherubims, lions, and palm trees, according to the proportion of every one, and additions round about.
bsb_text: He engraved cherubim, lions, and palm trees on the surfaces of the supports and panels, wherever each had space, with wreaths all around.
aov_text: En hy het op die vlakke van die kloue en sluitplate daarvan gérubs, leeus en palmbome gegraveer volgens die ruimte van elkeen, en blomkranse rondom.

kjv_text: After this manner he made the ten bases: all of them had one casting, one measure, and one size.
bsb_text: In this way he made the ten stands, each with the same casting, dimensions, and shape.
aov_text: So het hy die tien afspoelwaentjies gemaak: een en dieselfde gietwerk, een maat, een vorm het hulle almal gehad.

kjv_text: Then made he ten lavers of brass: one laver contained forty baths: and every laver was four cubits: and upon every one of the ten bases one laver.
bsb_text: He also made ten bronze basins, each holding forty baths and measuring four cubits across, one basin for each of the ten stands.
aov_text: Verder het hy tien koperwaskomme gemaak; elke kom het veertig bat gehou; elke kom was vier el; een kom was op elke bak van die tien afspoelwaentjies.

kjv_text: And he put five bases on the right side of the house, and five on the left side of the house: and he set the sea on the right side of the house eastward over against the south.
bsb_text: He set five stands on the south side of the temple and five on the north, and he put the Sea on the south side, at the southeast corner of the temple.
aov_text: Toe het hy die afspoelwaentjies opgestel: vyf aan die suidekant van die huis en vyf aan die noordekant van die huis; maar die see het hy aan die suidekant van die huis opgestel, teen die ooste na die suide toe.

kjv_text: And Hiram made the lavers, and the shovels, and the basons. So Hiram made an end of doing all the work that he made king Solomon for the house of the LORD:
bsb_text: Additionally, Huram made the pots, shovels, and sprinkling bowls. So Huram finished all the work that he had undertaken for King Solomon in the house of the LORD:
aov_text: Verder het Hiram die potte en die skoppe en die komme gemaak. So het Hiram dan al die werk voleindig wat hy vir koning Salomo in die huis van die HERE gedoen het:

kjv_text: The two pillars, and the two bowls of the chapiters that were on the top of the two pillars; and the two networks, to cover the two bowls of the chapiters which were upon the top of the pillars;
bsb_text: the two pillars; the two bowl-shaped capitals atop the pillars; the two sets of network covering both bowls of the capitals atop the pillars;
aov_text: twee pilare met die twee bolle van die kapitele wat op die top van die pilare was, en die twee stukke vlegwerk om die twee bolle van die kapitele op die top van die pilare te oordek;

kjv_text: And four hundred pomegranates for the two networks, even two rows of pomegranates for one network, to cover the two bowls of the chapiters that were upon the pillars;
bsb_text: the four hundred pomegranates for the two sets of network (two rows of pomegranates for each network covering both the bowl-shaped capitals atop the pillars);
aov_text: en die vierhonderd granaatjies vir die twee stukke vlegwerk: twee rye granaatjies vir elke vlegwerk, om die twee bolle van die kapitele bo-op die pilare te oordek;

kjv_text: And the ten bases, and ten lavers on the bases;
bsb_text: the ten stands; the ten basins on the stands;
aov_text: en die tien afspoelwaentjies en die tien waskomme op die afspoelwaentjies;

kjv_text: And one sea, and twelve oxen under the sea;
bsb_text: the Sea; the twelve oxen underneath the Sea;
aov_text: en die een see en die twaalf beeste onder die see;

kjv_text: And the pots, and the shovels, and the basons: and all these vessels, which Hiram made to king Solomon for the house of the LORD, were of bright brass.
bsb_text: and the pots, shovels, and sprinkling bowls. All the articles that Huram made for King Solomon in the house of the LORD were made of burnished bronze.
aov_text: en die potte en die skoppe en die komme: al hierdie voorwerpe wat Hiram vir koning Salomo in die huis van die HERE gemaak het, was van gepolyste koper.

kjv_text: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zarthan.
bsb_text: The king had them cast in clay molds in the plain of the Jordan between Succoth and Zarethan.
aov_text: In die Jordaanstreek waar die grond diep was, tussen Sukkot en Sartan, het die koning dit gegiet.

kjv_text: And Solomon left all the vessels unweighed, because they were exceeding many: neither was the weight of the brass found out.
bsb_text: Solomon left all these articles unweighed, because there were so many. The weight of the bronze could not be determined.
aov_text: En Salomo het al die voorwerpe ongeweeg laat bly vanweë die baie groot menigte; die gewig van die koper is nie bereken nie.

kjv_text: And Solomon made all the vessels that pertained unto the house of the LORD: the altar of gold, and the table of gold, whereupon the shewbread was,
bsb_text: Solomon also made all the furnishings for the house of the LORD: the golden altar; the golden table on which was placed the Bread of the Presence;
aov_text: Verder het Salomo al die voorwerpe wat in die huis van die HERE was, gemaak: die goue altaar en die tafel waar die toonbrode op moes lê, van goud;

kjv_text: And the candlesticks of pure gold, five on the right side, and five on the left, before the oracle, with the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs of gold,
bsb_text: the lampstands of pure gold in front of the inner sanctuary, five on the right side and five on the left; the gold flowers, lamps, and tongs;
aov_text: en die kandelaars, vyf regs en vyf links, voor die binneste vertrek, van fyn goud; en die blomwerk en die lampe en die snuiters, van goud;

kjv_text: And the bowls, and the snuffers, and the basons, and the spoons, and the censers of pure gold; and the hinges of gold, both for the doors of the inner house, the most holy place, and for the doors of the house, to wit, of the temple.
bsb_text: the pure gold basins, wick trimmers, sprinkling bowls, ladles, and censers; and the gold hinges for the doors of the inner temple (that is, the Most Holy Place) as well as for the doors of the main hall of the temple.
aov_text: en die skottels en die messe en die komme en die rookpanne en die vuurpanne, van fyn goud; en die skarniere vir die deure van die binneste vertrek, van die Allerheiligste, en vir die deure van die saal, van die hoofvertrek, van goud.

kjv_text: So was ended all the work that king Solomon made for the house of the LORD. And Solomon brought in the things which David his father had dedicated; even the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, did he put among the treasures of the house of the LORD.
bsb_text: So all the work that King Solomon had performed for the house of the LORD was completed. Then Solomon brought in the items his father David had dedicated—the silver, the gold, and the furnishings—and he placed them in the treasuries of the house of the LORD.
aov_text: En toe al die werk wat koning Salomo in die huis van die HERE gemaak het, gereed was, het Salomo die geheiligde gawes van sy vader Dawid ingebring; die silwer en die goud en die voorwerpe het hy in die skatkamers van die huis van die HERE neergesit.

kjv_text: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the chief of the fathers of the children of Israel, unto king Solomon in Jerusalem, that they might bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the city of David, which is Zion.
bsb_text: At that time Solomon assembled before him in Jerusalem the elders of Israel—all the tribal heads and family leaders of the Israelites—to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD from Zion, the City of David.
aov_text: DAARNA het Salomo die oudstes van Israel en al die stamhoofde, die familie-owerstes van die kinders van Israel, by koning Salomo in Jerusalem byeen laat kom om die verbondsark van die HERE uit die stad van Dawid, dit is Sion, op te bring.

kjv_text: And all the men of Israel assembled themselves unto king Solomon at the feast in the month Ethanim, which is the seventh month.
bsb_text: And all the men of Israel came together to King Solomon at the feast in the seventh month, the month of Ethanim.
aov_text: En al die manne van Israel het by koning Salomo op die fees vergader in die maand Étanim, dit is die sewende maand.

kjv_text: And all the elders of Israel came, and the priests took up the ark.
bsb_text: When all the elders of Israel had arrived, the priests took up the ark,
aov_text: Toe al die oudstes van Israel daar kom, het die priesters die ark opgeneem

kjv_text: And they brought up the ark of the LORD, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and all the holy vessels that were in the tabernacle, even those did the priests and the Levites bring up.
bsb_text: and they brought up the ark of the LORD and the Tent of Meeting with all its sacred furnishings. So the priests and Levites carried them up.
aov_text: en die ark van die HERE en die tent van samekoms gebring saam met al die heilige voorwerpe wat in die tent was; naamlik die priesters en die Leviete het dit gebring.

kjv_text: And king Solomon, and all the congregation of Israel, that were assembled unto him, were with him before the ark, sacrificing sheep and oxen, that could not be told nor numbered for multitude.
bsb_text: There, before the ark, King Solomon and the whole congregation of Israel who had assembled with him sacrificed so many sheep and oxen that they could not be counted or numbered.
aov_text: En terwyl koning Salomo en die hele by hom vergaderde gemeente van Israel saam met hom voor die ark staan, het hulle kleinvee en beeste geoffer wat vanweë die menigte nie getel of bereken kon word nie.

kjv_text: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the LORD unto his place, into the oracle of the house, to the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubims.
bsb_text: Then the priests brought the ark of the covenant of the LORD to its place in the inner sanctuary of the temple, the Most Holy Place, beneath the wings of the cherubim.
aov_text: Verder het die priesters die verbondsark van die HERE na sy plek gebring, in die binneste vertrek van die huis, in die Allerheiligste, onder die vlerke van die gérubs in.

kjv_text: For the cherubims spread forth their two wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubims covered the ark and the staves thereof above.
bsb_text: For the cherubim spread their wings over the place of the ark and overshadowed the ark and its poles.
aov_text: Want die gérubs het die vlerke uitgesprei oor die plek van die ark, sodat die gérubs die ark en sy draaghoute van bo af beskut het.

kjv_text: And they drew out the staves, that the ends of the staves were seen out in the holy place before the oracle, and they were not seen without: and there they are unto this day.
bsb_text: The poles extended far enough that their ends were visible from the Holy Place in front of the inner sanctuary, but not from outside the Holy Place; and they are there to this day.
aov_text: En die draaghoute was so lank, dat die punte van die draaghoute uit die Heilige, vlak voor die binneste vertrek, gesien kon word, maar verder buitentoe was hulle nie sigbaar nie; en hulle is daar tot vandag toe.

kjv_text: There was nothing in the ark save the two tables of stone, which Moses put there at Horeb, when the LORD made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of the land of Egypt.
bsb_text: There was nothing in the ark except the two stone tablets that Moses had placed in it at Horeb, where the LORD had made a covenant with the Israelites after they had come out of the land of Egypt.
aov_text: Daar was niks in die ark nie as net die twee kliptafels wat Moses by Horeb daarin neergelê het, toe die HERE ’n verbond met die kinders van Israel gesluit het by hulle uittog uit Egipteland.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy place, that the cloud filled the house of the LORD,
bsb_text: And when the priests came out of the Holy Place, the cloud filled the house of the LORD
aov_text: En toe die priesters uit die heiligdom uitgaan, het die wolk die huis van die HERE vervul.

kjv_text: So that the priests could not stand to minister because of the cloud: for the glory of the LORD had filled the house of the LORD.
bsb_text: so that the priests could not stand there to minister because of the cloud; for the glory of the LORD filled the house of the LORD.
aov_text: En die priesters kon vanweë die wolk nie staan om diens te doen nie, want die heerlikheid van die HERE het die huis van die HERE vervul.

kjv_text: Then spake Solomon, The LORD said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.
bsb_text: Then Solomon declared: “The LORD has said that He would dwell in the thick cloud.
aov_text: TOE het Salomo gesê: Die HERE het gesê dat Hy in donkerheid wil woon.

kjv_text: I have surely built thee an house to dwell in, a settled place for thee to abide in for ever.
bsb_text: I have indeed built You an exalted house, a place for You to dwell forever.”
aov_text: Verseker het ek vir U ’n woonhuis gebou, ’n vaste plek vir U om ewig in te woon.

kjv_text: And the king turned his face about, and blessed all the congregation of Israel: (and all the congregation of Israel stood;)
bsb_text: And as the whole assembly of Israel stood there, the king turned around and blessed them all
aov_text: Daarop draai die koning sy aangesig om en seën die hele vergadering van Israel, terwyl die hele vergadering van Israel staan.

kjv_text: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, which spake with his mouth unto David my father, and hath with his hand fulfilled it, saying,
bsb_text: and said: “Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, who has fulfilled with His own hand what He spoke with His mouth to my father David, saying,
aov_text: En hy sê: Geloofd sy die HERE, die God van Israel, wie se hand volbring het wat sy mond met my vader Dawid gespreek en gesê het:

kjv_text: Since the day that I brought forth my people Israel out of Egypt, I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel to build an house, that my name might be therein; but I chose David to be over my people Israel.
bsb_text: ‘Since the day I brought My people Israel out of Egypt, I have not chosen a city from any tribe of Israel in which to build a house so that My Name would be there. But I have chosen David to be over My people Israel.’
aov_text: Van die dag af dat Ek my volk Israel uit Egipte uitgelei het, het Ek geen stad verkies uit al die stamme van Israel om ’n huis te bou, dat my Naam daar sou wees nie; maar Ek het Dawid verkies om oor my volk Israel te wees.

kjv_text: And it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.
bsb_text: Now it was in the heart of my father David to build a house for the Name of the LORD, the God of Israel.
aov_text: Toe dit dan in die hart van my vader Dawid was om ’n huis te bou vir die Naam van die HERE, die God van Israel,

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto David my father, Whereas it was in thine heart to build an house unto my name, thou didst well that it was in thine heart.
bsb_text: But the LORD said to my father David, ‘Since it was in your heart to build a house for My Name, you have done well to have this in your heart.
aov_text: het die HERE aan my vader Dawid gesê: Dat dit in jou hart was om vir my Naam ’n huis te bou—daarin het jy goed gehandel, dat dit in jou hart was.

kjv_text: Nevertheless thou shalt not build the house; but thy son that shall come forth out of thy loins, he shall build the house unto my name.
bsb_text: Nevertheless, you are not the one to build it; but your son, your own offspring, will build the house for My Name.’
aov_text: Net maar, jý sal die huis nie bou nie, maar jou seun wat uit jou lendene sal voortkom, dié sal vir my Naam die huis bou.

kjv_text: And the LORD hath performed his word that he spake, and I am risen up in the room of David my father, and sit on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised, and have built an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.
bsb_text: Now the LORD has fulfilled the word that He spoke. I have succeeded my father David, and I sit on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised. I have built the house for the Name of the LORD, the God of Israel.
aov_text: En die HERE het sy woord vervul wat Hy gespreek het, sodat ek opgestaan het in die plek van my vader Dawid, en ek sit op die troon van Israel soos die HERE gespreek het; en ek het die huis gebou vir die Naam van die HERE, die God van Israel,

kjv_text: And I have set there a place for the ark, wherein is the covenant of the LORD, which he made with our fathers, when he brought them out of the land of Egypt.
bsb_text: And there I have provided a place for the ark, which contains the covenant of the LORD that He made with our fathers when He brought them out of the land of Egypt.”
aov_text: en daar ’n plek ingerig vir die ark, waarin die verbond van die HERE is, met ons vaders gesluit toe Hy hulle uit Egipteland uitgelei het.

kjv_text: And Solomon stood before the altar of the LORD in the presence of all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands toward heaven:
bsb_text: Then Solomon stood before the altar of the LORD in front of the whole assembly of Israel, spread out his hands toward heaven,
aov_text: Toe het Salomo voor die altaar van die HERE gaan staan, teenoor die hele vergadering van Israel, en sy hande uitgebrei na die hemel

kjv_text: And he said, LORD God of Israel, there is no God like thee, in heaven above, or on earth beneath, who keepest covenant and mercy with thy servants that walk before thee with all their heart:
bsb_text: and said: “O LORD, God of Israel, there is no God like You in heaven above or on earth below, keeping Your covenant of loving devotion with Your servants who walk before You with all their hearts.
aov_text: en gesê: HERE, God van Israel, daar is bo in die hemel of onder op die aarde geen God soos U nie, wat die verbond en die goedertierenheid hou vir u knegte wat voor u aangesig wandel met hulle hele hart,

kjv_text: Who hast kept with thy servant David my father that thou promisedst him: thou spakest also with thy mouth, and hast fulfilled it with thine hand, as it is this day.
bsb_text: You have kept Your promise to Your servant, my father David. What You spoke with Your mouth You have fulfilled with Your hand this day.
aov_text: wat vir u kneg, my vader Dawid, u belofte aan hom gehou het; ja, met u mond het U dit gespreek en met u hand volbring soos dit vandag is.

kjv_text: Therefore now, LORD God of Israel, keep with thy servant David my father that thou promisedst him, saying, There shall not fail thee a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Israel; so that thy children take heed to their way, that they walk before me as thou hast walked before me.
bsb_text: Therefore now, O LORD, God of Israel, keep for Your servant, my father David, what You promised when You said: ‘You will never fail to have a man to sit before Me on the throne of Israel, if only your descendants guard their way to walk before Me as you have done.’
aov_text: Hou nou ook, HERE, God van Israel, die belofte wat U aan u kneg, my vader Dawid, gedoen het, naamlik: Daar sal vir jou nooit ’n man voor my aangesig ontbreek wat op die troon van Israel sal sit nie as jou seuns net hulle weg in ag neem deur te wandel voor my aangesig soos jy voor my aangesig gewandel het.

kjv_text: And now, O God of Israel, let thy word, I pray thee, be verified, which thou spakest unto thy servant David my father.
bsb_text: And now, O God of Israel, please confirm what You promised to Your servant, my father David.
aov_text: Laat dan nou, o God van Israel, u woord tog waargemaak word wat U gespreek het tot u kneg, my vader Dawid.

kjv_text: But will God indeed dwell on the earth? behold, the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house that I have builded?
bsb_text: But will God indeed dwell upon the earth? Even heaven, the highest heaven, cannot contain You, much less this temple I have built.
aov_text: Maar sou God werklik op die aarde woon? Kyk, die hemel, ja, die hoogste hemel kan U nie bevat nie, hoeveel minder hierdie huis wat ek gebou het.

kjv_text: Yet have thou respect unto the prayer of thy servant, and to his supplication, O LORD my God, to hearken unto the cry and to the prayer, which thy servant prayeth before thee to day:
bsb_text: Yet regard the prayer and plea of Your servant, O LORD my God, so that You may hear the cry and the prayer that Your servant is praying before You today.
aov_text: Wend U dan tot die gebed van u kneg en tot sy smeking, HERE my God, deur te luister na die geroep en die gebed wat u kneg vandag voor u aangesig bid;

kjv_text: That thine eyes may be open toward this house night and day, even toward the place of which thou hast said, My name shall be there: that thou mayest hearken unto the prayer which thy servant shall make toward this place.
bsb_text: May Your eyes be open toward this temple night and day, toward the place of which You said, ‘My Name shall be there,’ so that You may hear the prayer that Your servant prays toward this place.
aov_text: sodat u oë oop mag wees nag en dag oor hierdie huis, oor die plek waarvan U gesê het: My Naam sal daar wees! sodat U mag luister na die gebed wat u kneg na hierdie plek toe sal bid.

kjv_text: And hearken thou to the supplication of thy servant, and of thy people Israel, when they shall pray toward this place: and hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place: and when thou hearest, forgive.
bsb_text: Hear the plea of Your servant and of Your people Israel when they pray toward this place. May You hear from heaven, Your dwelling place. May You hear and forgive.
aov_text: Luister dan na die smeking van u kneg en van u volk Israel wat hulle na hierdie plek toe sal bid; ja, mag U hoor elke gebed na u woonplek, na die hemel toe, en as U dit hoor, vergewe dan.

kjv_text: If any man trespass against his neighbour, and an oath be laid upon him to cause him to swear, and the oath come before thine altar in this house:
bsb_text: When a man sins against his neighbor and is required to take an oath, and he comes to take an oath before Your altar in this temple,
aov_text: As iemand teen sy naaste sondig en hulle hom ’n eed oplê om hom tot selfvervloeking te bring en hy voor u altaar in hierdie huis kom sweer,

kjv_text: Then hear thou in heaven, and do, and judge thy servants, condemning the wicked, to bring his way upon his head; and justifying the righteous, to give him according to his righteousness.
bsb_text: then may You hear from heaven and act. May You judge Your servants, condemning the wicked man by bringing down on his own head what he has done, and justifying the righteous man by rewarding him according to his righteousness.
aov_text: wil U dan hoor in die hemel en handel en u knegte reg verskaf deur die skuldige skuldig te verklaar en sy wandel op sy hoof te lê en die regverdige regverdig te verklaar deur hom te gee na sy geregtigheid.

kjv_text: When thy people Israel be smitten down before the enemy, because they have sinned against thee, and shall turn again to thee, and confess thy name, and pray, and make supplication unto thee in this house:
bsb_text: When Your people Israel are defeated before an enemy because they have sinned against You, and they return to You and confess Your name, praying and pleading with You in this temple,
aov_text: As u volk Israel verslaan word voor ’n vyand, omdat hulle teen U gesondig het, en hulle hul tot U bekeer en u Naam bely en tot U bid en smeek in hierdie huis,

kjv_text: Then hear thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of thy people Israel, and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest unto their fathers.
bsb_text: then may You hear from heaven and forgive the sin of Your people Israel. May You restore them to the land You gave to their fathers.
aov_text: wil U dan hoor in die hemel en die sonde van u volk Israel vergewe en hulle terugbring na die land wat U aan hulle vaders gegee het.

kjv_text: When heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against thee; if they pray toward this place, and confess thy name, and turn from their sin, when thou afflictest them:
bsb_text: When the skies are shut and there is no rain because Your people have sinned against You, and they pray toward this place and confess Your name, and they turn from their sins because You have afflicted them,
aov_text: As die hemel toegesluit bly, dat daar geen reën is nie, omdat hulle teen U gesondig het, maar hulle na hierdie plek toe bid en u Naam bely en van hulle sonde hul bekeer, omdat U hulle verootmoedig,

kjv_text: Then hear thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of thy servants, and of thy people Israel, that thou teach them the good way wherein they should walk, and give rain upon thy land, which thou hast given to thy people for an inheritance.
bsb_text: then may You hear from heaven and forgive the sin of Your servants, Your people Israel, so that You may teach them the good way in which they should walk. May You send rain on the land that You gave Your people as an inheritance.
aov_text: wil U dan hoor in die hemel en die sonde van u knegte en van u volk Israel vergewe—want U leer hulle die goeie weg waar hulle in moet wandel—en gee reën op u land wat U aan u volk as ’n erfenis gegee het.

kjv_text: If there be in the land famine, if there be pestilence, blasting, mildew, locust, or if there be caterpiller; if their enemy besiege them in the land of their cities; whatsoever plague, whatsoever sickness there be;
bsb_text: When famine or plague comes upon the land, or blight or mildew or locusts or grasshoppers, or when their enemy besieges them in their cities, whatever plague or sickness may come,
aov_text: As daar hongersnood is in die land, as daar pes is, as daar brandkoring, heuningdou, sprinkane, kaalvreters is, as sy vyand hom in die land, in sy poorte dit benoud maak, watter plaag, watter siekte ook al,

kjv_text: What prayer and supplication soever be made by any man, or by all thy people Israel, which shall know every man the plague of his own heart, and spread forth his hands toward this house:
bsb_text: then may whatever prayer or petition Your people Israel make—each knowing his own afflictions and spreading out his hands toward this temple—
aov_text: enige gebed, enige smeking wat enigeen van u hele volk Israel sal doen, as elkeen die plaag van sy hart ken, sodat hy sy hande na hierdie huis toe uitbrei —

kjv_text: Then hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place, and forgive, and do, and give to every man according to his ways, whose heart thou knowest; (for thou, even thou only, knowest the hearts of all the children of men;)
bsb_text: be heard by You from heaven, Your dwelling place. And may You forgive and act, and repay each man according to all his ways, since You know his heart—for You alone know the hearts of all men—
