aov_text: En die res van die volk wat in die stad oorgebly het, en die oorlopers wat na die koning van Babel oorgeloop het—die oorblyfsel van die menigte het Nebusarádan, die owerste van die lyfwag, in ballingskap weggevoer.

kjv_text: But the captain of the guard left of the poor of the land to be vinedressers and husbandmen.
bsb_text: But the captain of the guard left behind some of the poorest of the land to tend the vineyards and fields.
aov_text: Maar uit die armes van die land het die owerste van die lyfwag sommige laat agterbly as wynboere en as landbouers.

kjv_text: And the pillars of brass that were in the house of the LORD, and the bases, and the brasen sea that was in the house of the LORD, did the Chaldees break in pieces, and carried the brass of them to Babylon.
bsb_text: Moreover, the Chaldeans broke up the bronze pillars and stands and the bronze Sea in the house of the LORD, and they carried the bronze to Babylon.
aov_text: Verder het die Chaldeërs die koperpilare wat in die huis van die HERE was, en die afspoelwaentjies en die kopersee wat in die huis van die HERE was, stukkend gebreek en die koper daarvan na Babel weggevoer.

kjv_text: And the pots, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the spoons, and all the vessels of brass wherewith they ministered, took they away.
bsb_text: They also took away the pots, shovels, wick trimmers, dishes, and all the articles of bronze used in the temple service.
aov_text: Ook het hulle weggeneem die potte en skoppe en messe en rookpanne en al die kopergereedskap waarmee die diens verrig is.

kjv_text: And the firepans, and the bowls, and such things as were of gold, in gold, and of silver, in silver, the captain of the guard took away.
bsb_text: The captain of the guard also took away the censers and sprinkling bowls—anything made of pure gold or fine silver.
aov_text: En die owerste van die lyfwag het weggeneem die vuurpanne en die komme—wat van pure goud en van pure silwer was —

kjv_text: The two pillars, one sea, and the bases which Solomon had made for the house of the LORD; the brass of all these vessels was without weight.
bsb_text: As for the two pillars, the Sea, and the movable stands that Solomon had made for the house of the LORD, the weight of the bronze from all these articles was beyond measure.
aov_text: die twee pilare, die een see en die afspoelwaentjies wat Salomo vir die huis van die HERE gemaak het—die koper van al hierdie voorwerpe kon nie geweeg word nie.

kjv_text: The height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits, and the chapiter upon it was brass: and the height of the chapiter three cubits; and the wreathen work, and pomegranates upon the chapiter round about, all of brass: and like unto these had the second pillar with wreathen work.
bsb_text: Each pillar was eighteen cubits tall. The bronze capital atop one pillar was three cubits high, with a network of bronze pomegranates all around. The second pillar, with its network, was similar.
aov_text: Die hoogte van een pilaar was agttien el, en ’n kapiteel van koper was daarop, en die hoogte van die kapiteel was drie el; met vlegwerk en granaatjies op die kapiteel rondom, alles van koper; en net so aan die tweede pilaar, met die vlegwerk.

kjv_text: And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the door:
bsb_text: The captain of the guard also took away Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah the priest of second rank, and the three doorkeepers.
aov_text: Verder het die owerste van die lyfwag Serája, die hoofpriester, geneem en Sefánja, die tweede priester, en die drie drumpelwagters.

kjv_text: And out of the city he took an officer that was set over the men of war, and five men of them that were in the king's presence, which were found in the city, and the principal scribe of the host, which mustered the people of the land, and threescore men of the people of the land that were found in the city:
bsb_text: Of those still in the city, he took a court official who had been appointed over the men of war, as well as five royal advisors. He also took the scribe of the captain of the army, who had enlisted the people of the land, and sixty men who were found in the city.
aov_text: En uit die stad het hy geneem een hofdienaar wat oor die krygsmanne aangestel was, en vyf man uit die wat die koning se aangesig gesien het, wat in die stad aanwesig was, en die skrywer van die leërowerste wat die mense van die land vir krygsdiens oproep, en sestig man van die mense van die land wat in die stad aanwesig was.

kjv_text: And Nebuzaradan captain of the guard took these, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah:
bsb_text: Nebuzaradan captain of the guard took them and brought them to the king of Babylon at Riblah.
aov_text: Toe Nebusarádan, die owerste van die lyfwag, hulle neem, het hy hulle na die koning van Babel, na Ribla gebring.

kjv_text: And the king of Babylon smote them, and slew them at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was carried away out of their land.
bsb_text: There at Riblah in the land of Hamath, the king of Babylon struck them down and put them to death. So Judah was taken into exile, away from its own land.
aov_text: En die koning van Babel het hulle neergeslaan en hulle gedood in Ribla, in die land Hamat. En Juda is uit sy land in ballingskap weggevoer.

kjv_text: And as for the people that remained in the land of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had left, even over them he made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, ruler.
bsb_text: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, over the people he had left behind in the land of Judah.
aov_text: En wat die mense betref wat in die land Juda oorgebly het, wat Nebukadnésar, die koning van Babel, laat agterbly het, oor hulle het hy Gedálja, die seun van Ahíkam, die seun van Safan, aangestel.

kjv_text: And when all the captains of the armies, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah governor, there came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan the son of Careah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah the son of a Maachathite, they and their men.
bsb_text: When all the commanders of the armies and their men heard that the king of Babylon had appointed Gedaliah as governor, they came to Gedaliah at Mizpah—Ishmael son of Nethaniah, Johanan son of Kareah, Seraiah son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah son of the Maacathite, as well as their men.
aov_text: En toe al die owerstes van die leërs, hulle en die manne, hoor dat die koning van Babel Gedálja aangestel het, kom hulle na Gedálja, na Mispa, naamlik: Ismael, die seun van Ne-tánja, en Jóhanan, die seun van Karéag, en Serája, die seun van Tánhumet, die Netofatiet, en Jaäsánja, die seun van die Maägatiet, hulle met hul manne.

kjv_text: And Gedaliah sware to them, and to their men, and said unto them, Fear not to be the servants of the Chaldees: dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon; and it shall be well with you.
bsb_text: And Gedaliah took an oath before them and their men, assuring them, “Do not be afraid of the servants of the Chaldeans. Live in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it will be well with you.”
aov_text: En Gedálja het vir hulle en hul manne gesweer en aan hulle gesê: Wees nie bevrees vir die dienaars van die Chaldeërs nie, bly in die land en dien die koning van Babel; dan sal dit met julle goed gaan.

kjv_text: But it came to pass in the seventh month, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the seed royal, came, and ten men with him, and smote Gedaliah, that he died, and the Jews and the Chaldees that were with him at Mizpah.
bsb_text: In the seventh month, however, Ishmael son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, who was a member of the royal family, came with ten men and struck down and killed Gedaliah, along with the Judeans and Chaldeans who were with him at Mizpah.
aov_text: Maar in die sewende maand het Ismael, die seun van Netánja, die seun van Elisáma, uit die koninklike geslag, gekom en tien manne saam met hom en Gedálja doodgeslaan, ook die Jode en die Chaldeërs wat saam met hom in Mispa was.

kjv_text: And all the people, both small and great, and the captains of the armies, arose, and came to Egypt: for they were afraid of the Chaldees.
bsb_text: Then all the people small and great, together with the commanders of the army, arose and fled to Egypt for fear of the Chaldeans.
aov_text: Toe het die hele volk, klein en groot, hulle gereedgemaak, saam met die owerstes van die leërs, en na Egipte gegaan, want hulle was bevrees vir die Chaldeërs.

kjv_text: And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, that Evilmerodach king of Babylon in the year that he began to reign did lift up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah out of prison;
bsb_text: On the twenty-seventh day of the twelfth month of the thirty-seventh year of the exile of Judah’s King Jehoiachin, in the year Evil-merodach became king of Babylon, he released King Jehoiachin of Judah from prison.
aov_text: En in die sewen-en-dertigste jaar van die ballingskap van Jójagin, die koning van Juda, in die twaalfde maand, op die sewen-en-twintigste van die maand, het Evil-Meródag, die koning van Babel, in die jaar van sy troonsbestyging, Jójagin, die koning van Juda, uit die gevangenis verhef.

kjv_text: And he spake kindly to him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings that were with him in Babylon;
bsb_text: And he spoke kindly to Jehoiachin and set his throne above the thrones of the other kings who were with him in Babylon.
aov_text: En hy het vriendelik met hom gespreek en sy stoel gesit bokant die stoel van die konings wat by hom in Babel was.

kjv_text: And changed his prison garments: and he did eat bread continually before him all the days of his life.
bsb_text: So Jehoiachin changed out of his prison clothes, and he dined regularly at the king’s table for the rest of his life.
aov_text: En hy het sy gevangenisklere verwissel; en hy het gedurigdeur brood voor sy aangesig geëet, al die dae van sy lewe.

kjv_text: And his allowance was a continual allowance given him of the king, a daily rate for every day, all the days of his life.
bsb_text: And the king provided Jehoiachin a daily portion for the rest of his life.
aov_text: En aangaande sy lewensonderhoud, ’n vaste lewensonderhoud is hom toegestaan deur die koning na die eis van elke dag, al die dae van sy lewe.

kjv_text: Adam, Sheth, Enosh,
bsb_text: Adam, Seth, Enosh,
aov_text: ADAM, Set, Enos,

kjv_text: Kenan, Mahalaleel, Jered,
bsb_text: Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared,
aov_text: Kenan, Mahalálel, Jered,

kjv_text: Henoch, Methuselah, Lamech,
bsb_text: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech.
aov_text: Henog, Metúsalag, Lameg,

kjv_text: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
bsb_text: The sons of Noah: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
aov_text: Noag, Sem, Gam en Jafet.

kjv_text: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.
bsb_text: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
aov_text: Die seuns van Jafet was: Gomer en Magog en Madai en Jawan en Tubal en Meseg en Tiras.

kjv_text: And the sons of Gomer; Ashchenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.
bsb_text: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
aov_text: En die seuns van Gomer was: Áskenas en Rifat en Togárma.

kjv_text: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
bsb_text: And the sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, the Kittites, and the Rodanites.
aov_text: En die seuns van Jawan was: Elísa en Tarsísa, die Kittiërs en Rodaniete.

kjv_text: The sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
bsb_text: The sons of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
aov_text: Die seuns van Gam was: Kus en Misráim, Put en Kanaän.

kjv_text: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabta, and Raamah, and Sabtecha. And the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.
bsb_text: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
aov_text: En die seuns van Kus was: Seba en Hawíla en Sabta en Raéma en Sábtega; en die seuns van Raéma was: Skeba en Dedan.

kjv_text: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be mighty upon the earth.
bsb_text: Cush was the father of Nimrod, who began to be a mighty one on the earth.
aov_text: En Kus was die vader van Nimrod; hý het begin om ’n geweldenaar op die aarde te wees.

kjv_text: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,
bsb_text: Mizraim was the father of the Ludites, the Anamites, the Lehabites, the Naphtuhites,
aov_text: En Misráim was die vader van die Ludiete en Anamiete en Lehabiete en die Naftuhiete,

kjv_text: And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (of whom came the Philistines,) and Caphthorim.
bsb_text: the Pathrusites, the Casluhites (from whom the Philistines came), and the Caphtorites.
aov_text: en die Patrusiete en Kasluhiete—waaruit die Filistyne voortgekom het—en die Kaftoriete.

kjv_text: And Canaan begat Zidon his firstborn, and Heth,
bsb_text: And Canaan was the father of Sidon his firstborn, and of the Hittites,
aov_text: En Kanaän was die vader van Sidon, sy eersgeborene, en Het

kjv_text: The Jebusite also, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,
bsb_text: the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,
aov_text: en die Jebusiete en Amoriete en Girgasiete,

kjv_text: And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,
bsb_text: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,
aov_text: en die Hewiete en Arkiete en Siniete,

kjv_text: And the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.
bsb_text: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites.
aov_text: en die Arwadiete en Semariete en Hamatiete.

kjv_text: The sons of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram, and Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Meshech.
bsb_text: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, and Aram. The sons of Aram: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech.
aov_text: Die seuns van Sem was: Elam en Assur en Arpágsad en Lud en Aram en Us en Hul en Geter en Meseg.

kjv_text: And Arphaxad begat Shelah, and Shelah begat Eber.
bsb_text: Arphaxad was the father of Shelah, and Shelah was the father of Eber.
aov_text: En Arpágsad was die vader van Selag, en Selag van Heber.

kjv_text: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg; because in his days the earth was divided: and his brother's name was Joktan.
bsb_text: Two sons were born to Eber: One was named Peleg, because in his days the earth was divided, and his brother was named Joktan.
aov_text: En vir Heber is twee seuns gebore; die naam van die een was Peleg, want in sy dae het die aardbewoners verdeeld geraak; en sy broer se naam was Joktan.

kjv_text: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,
bsb_text: And Joktan was the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
aov_text: En Joktan was die vader van Almódad en Selef en Hasarmáwet en Jerag,

kjv_text: Hadoram also, and Uzal, and Diklah,
bsb_text: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
aov_text: en Hadóram en Usal en Dikla,

kjv_text: And Ebal, and Abimael, and Sheba,
bsb_text: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,
aov_text: en Ebal en Abímael en Skeba,

kjv_text: And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.
bsb_text: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were sons of Joktan.
aov_text: en Ofir en Hawíla en Jobab. Hulle almal was seuns van Joktan.

kjv_text: Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah,
bsb_text: So from Shem came Arphaxad, Shelah,
aov_text: SEM, Arpágsad, Selag,

kjv_text: Eber, Peleg, Reu,
bsb_text: Eber, Peleg, Reu,
aov_text: Heber, Peleg, Rehu,

kjv_text: Serug, Nahor, Terah,
bsb_text: Serug, Nahor, Terah,
aov_text: Serug, Nahor, Tera,

kjv_text: Abram; the same is Abraham.
bsb_text: and Abram (that is, Abraham).
aov_text: Abram; dit is Abraham.

kjv_text: The sons of Abraham; Isaac, and Ishmael.
bsb_text: The sons of Abraham were Isaac and Ishmael.
aov_text: Die seuns van Abraham was Isak en Ismael.

kjv_text: These are their generations: The firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,
bsb_text: These are their genealogies: Nebaioth the firstborn of Ishmael, then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
aov_text: Dit is hulle geslagsregister: die eersgeborene van Ismael was Nébajot, en Kedar en Ádbeël en Mibsam,

kjv_text: Mishma, and Dumah, Massa, Hadad, and Tema,
bsb_text: Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,
aov_text: Misma en Duma, Massa, Hadad en Tema,

kjv_text: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.
bsb_text: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These were the sons of Ishmael.
aov_text: Jetur, Nafis en Kedma; hulle was die seuns van Ismael.

kjv_text: Now the sons of Keturah, Abraham's concubine: she bare Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan; Sheba, and Dedan.
bsb_text: The sons born to Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.
aov_text: En die seuns van Ketúra, die byvrou van Abraham. Sy het gebaar: Simran en Joksan en Medan en Mídian en Jisbak en Suag. En die seuns van Joksan was Skeba en Dedan.

kjv_text: And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Henoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these are the sons of Keturah.
bsb_text: The sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All of these were Keturah’s sons.
aov_text: En die seuns van Mídian was: Efa en Efer en Henog en Abída en Éldaä. Hulle almal was seuns van Ketúra.

kjv_text: And Abraham begat Isaac. The sons of Isaac; Esau and Israel.
bsb_text: Abraham was the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.
aov_text: En Abraham was die vader van Isak. Die seuns van Isak was Esau en Israel;

kjv_text: The sons of Esau; Eliphaz, Reuel, and Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.
bsb_text: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
aov_text: die seuns van Esau: Élifas, Réhuel en Jehus en Jáelam en Korag.

kjv_text: The sons of Eliphaz; Teman, and Omar, Zephi, and Gatam, Kenaz, and Timna, and Amalek.
bsb_text: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz; and by Timna, Amalek.
aov_text: Die seuns van Élifas was: Teman en Omar, Sefi en Gáetam, Kenas en Timna en Ámalek.

kjv_text: The sons of Reuel; Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
bsb_text: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
aov_text: Die seuns van Réhuel was: Náhat, Serag, Samma en Missa.

kjv_text: And the sons of Seir; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah, and Dishon, and Ezar, and Dishan.
bsb_text: The sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.
aov_text: En die seuns van Seïr was: Lotan en Sobal en Síbeon en Ana en Dison en Eser en Disan.

kjv_text: And the sons of Lotan; Hori, and Homam: and Timna was Lotan's sister.
bsb_text: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam. Timna was Lotan’s sister.
aov_text: En die seuns van Lotan was Hori en Homam; en die suster van Lotan was Timna.

kjv_text: The sons of Shobal; Alian, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. And the sons of Zibeon; Aiah, and Anah.
bsb_text: The sons of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam. The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.
aov_text: Die seuns van Sobal was: Aljan en Manáhat en Ebal, Sefi en Onam; en die seuns van Síbeon was Aja en Ana.

kjv_text: The sons of Anah; Dishon. And the sons of Dishon; Amram, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.
bsb_text: The son of Anah: Dishon. The sons of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
aov_text: Die seuns van Ana was: Dison; en die seuns van Dison was: Hamran en Esban en Jitran en Keran.

kjv_text: The sons of Ezer; Bilhan, and Zavan, and Jakan. The sons of Dishan; Uz, and Aran.
bsb_text: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
aov_text: Die seuns van Eser was: Bilhan en Sáäwan en Jáäkan. Die seuns van Disan was Us en Aran.

kjv_text: Now these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the children of Israel; Bela the son of Beor: and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
bsb_text: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the Israelites: Bela son of Beor. His city was named Dinhabah.
aov_text: En dit is die konings wat in die land Edom geregeer het voordat daar ’n koning oor die kinders van Israel geregeer het: Bela, die seun van Beor; en die naam van sy stad was Dinhába;

kjv_text: And when Bela was dead, Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.
bsb_text: When Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah reigned in his place.
aov_text: en Bela het gesterwe, en in sy plek het geregeer Jobab, die seun van Serag, uit Bosra.

kjv_text: And when Jobab was dead, Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his stead.
bsb_text: When Jobab died, Husham from the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
aov_text: En Jobab het gesterwe, en Husam, uit die land van die Temaniete, het in sy plek geregeer.

kjv_text: And when Husham was dead, Hadad the son of Bedad, which smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.
bsb_text: When Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the country of Moab, reigned in his place. And the name of his city was Avith.
aov_text: En Husam het gesterwe, en Hadad, die seun van Bedad, wat die Midianiete in die veld van Moab verslaan het, het in sy plek geregeer; en die naam van sy stad was Awit.

kjv_text: And when Hadad was dead, Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.
bsb_text: When Hadad died, Samlah from Masrekah reigned in his place.
aov_text: En Hadad het gesterwe, en Samla uit Másreka het in sy plek geregeer.

kjv_text: And when Samlah was dead, Shaul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.
bsb_text: When Samlah died, Shaul from Rehoboth on the Euphrates reigned in his place.
aov_text: En Samla het gesterwe, en Saul uit Réhobot, aan die rivier, het in sy plek geregeer.

kjv_text: And when Shaul was dead, Baalhanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.
bsb_text: When Shaul died, Baal-hanan son of Achbor reigned in his place.
aov_text: En Saul het gesterwe, en Baäl-Hánan, die seun van Akbor, het in sy plek geregeer.

kjv_text: And when Baalhanan was dead, Hadad reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pai; and his wife's name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
bsb_text: When Baal-hanan died, Hadad reigned in his place. His city was named Pau, and his wife’s name was Mehetabel daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-zahab.
aov_text: Nadat Baäl-Hánan gesterf het, het Hadad in sy plek geregeer; en die naam van sy stad was Pahi; en die naam van sy vrou was Mehetábeël, die dogter van Matred, die dogter van Mésahab.

kjv_text: Hadad died also. And the dukes of Edom were; duke Timnah, duke Aliah, duke Jetheth,
bsb_text: Then Hadad died. Now the chiefs of Edom were Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,
aov_text: Toe Hadad gesterf het, was die vorste van Edom: die vors Timna, die vors Alja, die vors Jetet,

kjv_text: Duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,
bsb_text: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,
aov_text: die vors Oholibáma, die vors Ela, die vors Pinon,

kjv_text: Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,
bsb_text: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,
aov_text: die vors Kenas, die vors Teman, die vors Mibsar,

kjv_text: Duke Magdiel, duke Iram. These are the dukes of Edom.
bsb_text: Magdiel, and Iram. These were the chiefs of Edom.
aov_text: die vors Mágdiël, die vors Iram; dit was die vorste van Edom.

kjv_text: These are the sons of Israel; Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun,
bsb_text: These were the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,
aov_text: DIT is die seuns van Israel: Ruben, Símeon, Levi en Juda, Íssaskar en Sébulon,

kjv_text: Dan, Joseph, and Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
bsb_text: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
aov_text: Dan, Josef en Benjamin, Náftali, Gad en Aser.

kjv_text: The sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah: which three were born unto him of the daughter of Shua the Canaanitess. And Er, the firstborn of Judah, was evil in the sight of the LORD; and he slew him.
bsb_text: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, and Shelah. These three were born to him by Bath-shua the Canaanite. Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the LORD, who put him to death.
aov_text: Die seuns van Juda was: Er en Onan en Sela, drie vir hom gebore uit die dogter van Sua, die Kanaänitiese vrou; en Er, die eersgeborene van Juda, het die HERE mishaag, daarom het Hy hom laat sterwe.

kjv_text: And Tamar his daughter in law bore him Pharez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.
bsb_text: Tamar, Judah’s daughter-in-law, bore to him Perez and Zerah. Judah had five sons in all.
aov_text: En Tamar, sy skoondogter, het vir hom Peres en Serag gebaar. Al die seuns van Juda was vyf.

kjv_text: The sons of Pharez; Hezron, and Hamul.
bsb_text: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.
aov_text: Die seuns van Peres was Hesron en Hamul.

kjv_text: And the sons of Zerah; Zimri, and Ethan, and Heman, and Calcol, and Dara: five of them in all.
bsb_text: The sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara—five in all.
aov_text: En die seuns van Serag was: Simri en Etan en Heman en Kalkol en Dara; almal saam vyf.

kjv_text: And the sons of Carmi; Achar, the troubler of Israel, who transgressed in the thing accursed.
bsb_text: The son of Carmi: Achar, who brought trouble upon Israel by violating the ban on devoted things.
aov_text: En die seun van Karmi was: Agar, wat Israel in die ongeluk gestort het deurdat hy hom vergryp het aan die bangoed.

kjv_text: And the sons of Ethan; Azariah.
bsb_text: The son of Ethan: Azariah.
aov_text: En die seun van Etan was Asárja.

kjv_text: The sons also of Hezron, that were born unto him; Jerahmeel, and Ram, and Chelubai.
bsb_text: The sons who were born to Hezron: Jerahmeel, Ram, and Caleb.
aov_text: En die seuns van Hesron wat vir hom gebore is, was Jerágmeël en Ram en Kelúbai.

kjv_text: And Ram begat Amminadab; and Amminadab begat Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;
bsb_text: Ram was the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab was the father of Nahshon, a leader of the descendants of Judah.
aov_text: En Ram was die vader van Ammínadab, en Ammínadab van Nagson, die vors van die kinders van Juda.

kjv_text: And Nahshon begat Salma, and Salma begat Boaz,
bsb_text: Nahshon was the father of Salmon, and Salmon was the father of Boaz.
aov_text: En Nagson was die vader van Salma, en Salma van Boas;

kjv_text: And Boaz begat Obed, and Obed begat Jesse,
bsb_text: Boaz was the father of Obed, and Obed was the father of Jesse.
aov_text: en Boas van Obed, en Obed van Ísai;

kjv_text: And Jesse begat his firstborn Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimma the third,
bsb_text: Jesse was the father of Eliab his firstborn; Abinadab was born second, Shimea third,
aov_text: en Ísai was die vader van Elíab, sy eersgeborene, en van Abinádab, die tweede, en Símea, die derde;

kjv_text: Nethaneel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,
bsb_text: Nethanel fourth, Raddai fifth,
aov_text: van Netáneël, die vierde, van Ráddai, die vyfde,

kjv_text: Ozem the sixth, David the seventh:
bsb_text: Ozem sixth, and David seventh.
aov_text: van Osem, die sesde, van Dawid, die sewende.

kjv_text: Whose sisters were Zeruiah, and Abigail. And the sons of Zeruiah; Abishai, and Joab, and Asahel, three.
bsb_text: Their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. And the three sons of Zeruiah were Abishai, Joab, and Asahel.
aov_text: En hulle susters was Serúja en Abígail. En die seuns van Serúja was: Abísai en Joab en Ásahel, drie.

kjv_text: And Abigail bare Amasa: and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmeelite.
bsb_text: Abigail was the mother of Amasa, whose father was Jether the Ishmaelite.
aov_text: En Abígail het Amása gebaar; en die vader van Amása was Jeter, die Ismaeliet.

kjv_text: And Caleb the son of Hezron begat children of Azubah his wife, and of Jerioth: her sons are these; Jesher, and Shobab, and Ardon.
bsb_text: Caleb son of Hezron had children by his wife Azubah and by Jerioth. These were the sons of Azubah: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
aov_text: En Kaleb, die seun van Hesron, het by sy vrou Asúba Jeríot verwek. En dit is haar seuns: Jeser en Sobab en Ardon.

kjv_text: And when Azubah was dead, Caleb took unto him Ephrath, which bare him Hur.
bsb_text: When Azubah died, Caleb married Ephrath, who bore to him Hur.
aov_text: Toe Asúba gesterf het, het Kaleb vir hom Efrat geneem, en sy het vir hom Hur gebaar.

kjv_text: And Hur begat Uri, and Uri begat Bezaleel.
bsb_text: Hur was the father of Uri, and Uri was the father of Bezalel.
aov_text: En Hur was die vader van Uri; en Uri van Besáleël.

kjv_text: And afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he married when he was threescore years old; and she bare him Segub.
bsb_text: Later, Hezron slept with the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead. He had married her when he was sixty years old, and she bore to him Segub.
aov_text: Daarna het Hesron gegaan na die dogter van Magir, die vader van Gílead; en hy het haar geneem toe hy sestig jaar oud was; en sy het vir hom Segub gebaar.

kjv_text: And Segub begat Jair, who had three and twenty cities in the land of Gilead.
bsb_text: Segub was the father of Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.
aov_text: En Segub was die vader van Jaïr, en hy het drie-en-twintig stede in die land Gílead gehad.

kjv_text: And he took Geshur, and Aram, with the towns of Jair, from them, with Kenath, and the towns thereof, even threescore cities. All these belonged to the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.
bsb_text: But Geshur and Aram captured Havvoth-jair, along with Kenath and its sixty surrounding villages. All these were descendants of Machir the father of Gilead.
aov_text: En Gésur en Aram het die Jaïrsdorpe van hulle afgeneem, en Kenat met sy onderhorige plekke, sestig stede; hulle almal was seuns van Magir, die vader van Gílead.

kjv_text: And after that Hezron was dead in Calebephratah, then Abiah Hezron's wife bare him Ashur the father of Tekoa.
bsb_text: After Hezron died in Caleb-ephrathah, his wife Abijah bore to him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.
aov_text: En ná die dood van Hesron in Kaleb-Éfrata het Abía, die vrou van Hesron, vir hom ook Asgur, die vader van Tekóa, gebaar.

kjv_text: And the sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were, Ram the firstborn, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, and Ahijah.
bsb_text: The sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron: Ram his firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.
aov_text: En die seuns van Jerágmeël, die eersgeborene van Hesron, was: die eersgeborene Ram; verder Buna en Oren en Osem uit Ahía.

kjv_text: Jerahmeel had also another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.
bsb_text: Jerahmeel had another wife named Atarah, who was the mother of Onam.
aov_text: Jerágmeël het nog ’n ander vrou gehad met die naam van Atára; sy was die moeder van Onam.

kjv_text: And the sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were, Maaz, and Jamin, and Eker.
bsb_text: The sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel: Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
aov_text: En die seuns van Ram, die eersgeborene van Jerágmeël, was Maäs en Jamin en Eker.

kjv_text: And the sons of Onam were, Shammai, and Jada. And the sons of Shammai; Nadab, and Abishur.
bsb_text: The sons of Onam: Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.
aov_text: En die seuns van Onam was Sámmai en Jada; en die seuns van Sámmai: Nadab en Abísur.

kjv_text: And the name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail, and she bare him Ahban, and Molid.
bsb_text: Abishur’s wife was named Abihail, and she bore to him Ahban and Molid.
aov_text: En die naam van die vrou van Abísur was Abíhail; en sy het vir hom Agban en Molid gebaar.

kjv_text: And the sons of Nadab; Seled, and Appaim: but Seled died without children.
bsb_text: The sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim. Seled died without children.
aov_text: En die seuns van Nadab was Seled en Appáim; en Seled het gesterwe sonder kinders.

kjv_text: And the sons of Appaim; Ishi. And the sons of Ishi; Sheshan. And the children of Sheshan; Ahlai.
bsb_text: The son of Appaim: Ishi. The son of Ishi: Sheshan. The son of Sheshan: Ahlai.
aov_text: En die seuns van Appáim was Jíseï; en die seuns van Jíseï was Sesan; en die seuns van Sesan, Áglai.

kjv_text: And the sons of Jada the brother of Shammai; Jether, and Jonathan: and Jether died without children.
bsb_text: The sons of Jada the brother of Shammai: Jether and Jonathan. Jether died without children.
aov_text: En die seuns van Jada, die broer van Sámmai, was Jeter en Jónatan; en Jeter het gesterwe sonder kinders.

kjv_text: And the sons of Jonathan; Peleth, and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.
bsb_text: The sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the descendants of Jerahmeel.
aov_text: En die seuns van Jónatan was Pelet en Sasa. Dit was die seuns van Jerágmeël.

kjv_text: Now Sheshan had no sons, but daughters. And Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.
bsb_text: Sheshan had no sons, but only daughters; but he did have an Egyptian servant named Jarha.
aov_text: En Sesan het nie seuns gehad nie, net dogters; en Sesan het ’n Egiptiese dienaar gehad met die naam van Jarha;

kjv_text: And Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant to wife; and she bare him Attai.
bsb_text: Sheshan gave his daughter in marriage to his servant Jarha, and she bore to him Attai.
aov_text: en Sesan het sy dogter aan sy dienaar Jarha as vrou gegee; en sy het vir hom Áttai gebaar.

kjv_text: And Attai begat Nathan, and Nathan begat Zabad,
bsb_text: Attai was the father of Nathan, Nathan was the father of Zabad,
aov_text: En Áttai was die vader van Natan, en Natan van Sabad;

kjv_text: And Zabad begat Ephlal, and Ephlal begat Obed,
bsb_text: Zabad was the father of Ephlal, Ephlal was the father of Obed,
aov_text: en Sabad van Eflal, en Eflal van Obed;

kjv_text: And Obed begat Jehu, and Jehu begat Azariah,
bsb_text: Obed was the father of Jehu, Jehu was the father of Azariah,
aov_text: en Obed van Jehu, en Jehu van Asárja;

kjv_text: And Azariah begat Helez, and Helez begat Eleasah,
bsb_text: Azariah was the father of Helez, Helez was the father of Elasah,
aov_text: en Asárja van Heles, en Heles van Eleása;

kjv_text: And Eleasah begat Sisamai, and Sisamai begat Shallum,
bsb_text: Elasah was the father of Sismai, Sismai was the father of Shallum,
aov_text: en Eleása van Sísemai, en Sísemai van Sallum;

kjv_text: And Shallum begat Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begat Elishama.
bsb_text: Shallum was the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah was the father of Elishama.
aov_text: en Sallum van Jekámja, en Jekámja van Elisáma.

kjv_text: Now the sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were, Mesha his firstborn, which was the father of Ziph; and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.
bsb_text: The sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel: Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and Mareshah his second son, who was the father of Hebron.
aov_text: En die seuns van Kaleb, die broer van Jerágmeël, was Mesa, sy eersgeborene—hy was die vader van Sif—en die seuns van Marésa, die vader van Hebron.

kjv_text: And the sons of Hebron; Korah, and Tappuah, and Rekem, and Shema.
bsb_text: The sons of Hebron: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.
aov_text: En die seuns van Hebron was: Korag en Tappúag en Rekem en Sema.

kjv_text: And Shema begat Raham, the father of Jorkoam: and Rekem begat Shammai.
bsb_text: Shema was the father of Raham the father of Jorkeam, and Rekem was the father of Shammai.
aov_text: En Sema was die vader van Raham, die vader van Jórkeam; en Rekem van Sámmai.

kjv_text: And the son of Shammai was Maon: and Maon was the father of Bethzur.
bsb_text: The son of Shammai was Maon, and Maon was the father of Beth-zur.
aov_text: En die seun van Sámmai was Máon; en Máon was die vader van Bet-Sur.

kjv_text: And Ephah, Caleb's concubine, bare Haran, and Moza, and Gazez: and Haran begat Gazez.
bsb_text: Caleb’s concubine Ephah was the mother of Haran, Moza, and Gazez. Haran was the father of Gazez.
aov_text: En Efa, die byvrou van Kaleb, het Haran en Mosa en Gases gebaar; en Haran was die vader van Gases.

kjv_text: And the sons of Jahdai; Regem, and Jotham, and Gesham, and Pelet, and Ephah, and Shaaph.
bsb_text: The sons of Jahdai: Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.
aov_text: En die seuns van Jóhdai was: Regem en Jotam en Gesan en Pelet en Efa en Saäf.

kjv_text: Maachah, Caleb's concubine, bare Sheber, and Tirhanah.
bsb_text: Caleb’s concubine Maacah was the mother of Sheber and Tirhanah.
aov_text: Die byvrou van Kaleb, Máäga, het Seber en Tírhana gebaar;

kjv_text: She bare also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbenah, and the father of Gibea: and the daughter of Caleb was Achsa.
bsb_text: She was also the mother of Shaaph father of Madmannah, and of Sheva father of Machbenah and Gibea. Caleb’s daughter was Acsah.
aov_text: en sy het Saäf gebaar, die vader van Madmánna, Sewa, die vader van Magbéna en die vader van Gíbea; en die dogter van Kaleb was Agsa.

kjv_text: These were the sons of Caleb the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah; Shobal the father of Kirjathjearim,
bsb_text: These were the descendants of Caleb. The sons of Hur the firstborn of Ephrathah: Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim,
aov_text: Dit was die seuns van Kaleb. Die seuns van Hur, die eersgeborene van Éfrata, was Sobal, die vader van Kirjat-Jeárim,

kjv_text: Salma the father of Bethlehem, Hareph the father of Bethgader.
bsb_text: Salma the father of Bethlehem, and Hareph the father of Beth-gader.
aov_text: Salma, die vader van Betlehem, Haref, die vader van Bet-Gader.

kjv_text: And Shobal the father of Kirjathjearim had sons; Haroeh, and half of the Manahethites.
bsb_text: These were the descendants of Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim: Haroeh, half the Manahathites,
aov_text: En die seuns van Sobal, die vader van Kirjat-Jeárim, was Hároë en die helfte van Menúgōt.

kjv_text: And the families of Kirjathjearim; the Ithrites, and the Puhites, and the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; of them came the Zareathites, and the Eshtaulites.
bsb_text: and the clans of Kiriath-jearim—the Ithrites, Puthites, Shumathites, and Mishraites. From these descended the Zorathites and Eshtaolites.
aov_text: En die geslagte van Kirjat-Jeárim was: die Jitriete en Putiete en Sumatiete en die Misraïete; uit hulle het die Soreatiete en Estaoliete voortgekom.

kjv_text: The sons of Salma; Bethlehem, and the Netophathites, Ataroth, the house of Joab, and half of the Manahethites, the Zorites.
bsb_text: The descendants of Salma: Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth-beth-joab, half the Manahathites, the Zorites,
aov_text: Die seuns van Salma was: Betlehem en die Netofatiete, Atrot-Bet-Joab en die helfte van die Managtiete, die Soreïete.

kjv_text: And the families of the scribes which dwelt at Jabez; the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and Suchathites. These are the Kenites that came of Hemath, the father of the house of Rechab.
bsb_text: and the clans of the scribes who lived at Jabez—the Tirathites, Shimeathites, and Sucathites. These are the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.
aov_text: En die geslagte van die skrywers wat in Jabes gewoon het: die Tireatiete, die Simeatiete, die Sugatiete; dit is die Keniete wat van Hammat, die vader van die huis van Regab, afkomstig is.

kjv_text: Now these were the sons of David, which were born unto him in Hebron; the firstborn Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess:
bsb_text: These were the sons of David who were born to him in Hebron: The firstborn was Amnon by Ahinoam of Jezreel; the second was Daniel by Abigail of Carmel;
aov_text: DIT was die seuns van Dawid wat vir hom in Hebron gebore is: die eersgeborene Amnon, by Ahínoam, uit Jísreël; die tweede Daniël, by Abígail, uit Karmel;

kjv_text: The third, Absalom the son of Maachah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur: the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith:
bsb_text: the third was Absalom the son of Maacah daughter of King Talmai of Geshur; the fourth was Adonijah the son of Haggith;
aov_text: die derde Ábsalom, die seun van Máäga, die dogter van Tálmai, die koning van Gesur; die vierde Adónia, die seun van Haggit;

kjv_text: The fifth, Shephatiah of Abital: the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife.
bsb_text: the fifth was Shephatiah by Abital; and the sixth was Ithream by his wife Eglah.
aov_text: die vyfde Sefátja, by Abítal; die sesde Jítream, by sy vrou Egla.

kjv_text: These six were born unto him in Hebron; and there he reigned seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years.
bsb_text: These six sons were born to David in Hebron, where he reigned seven years and six months. And David reigned in Jerusalem thirty-three years,
aov_text: Ses is vir hom in Hebron gebore waar hy sewe jaar en ses maande geregeer het; en drie-en-dertig jaar het hy in Jerusalem geregeer.

kjv_text: And these were born unto him in Jerusalem; Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon, four, of Bathshua the daughter of Ammiel:
bsb_text: and these sons were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon. These four were born to him by Bathsheba daughter of Ammiel.
aov_text: En die volgende is vir hom in Jerusalem gebore: Símea en Sobab en Natan en Sálomo, vier by Bat-Sua, die dogter van Ámmiël.

kjv_text: Ibhar also, and Elishama, and Eliphelet,
bsb_text: David’s other sons were Ibhar, Elishua, Eliphelet,
aov_text: Verder Jibhar en Elisáma en Elifélet

kjv_text: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
bsb_text: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,
aov_text: en Noga en Nefeg, en Jáfia

kjv_text: And Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.
bsb_text: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet—nine in all.
aov_text: en Elisáma en Éljada en Elifélet, nege —

kjv_text: These were all the sons of David, beside the sons of the concubines, and Tamar their sister.
bsb_text: These were all the sons of David, besides the sons by his concubines. And Tamar was their sister.
aov_text: almal seuns van Dawid, behalwe die seuns van die byvroue; en Tamar was hulle suster.

kjv_text: And Solomon's son was Rehoboam, Abia his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
bsb_text: Solomon’s son was Rehoboam: Abijah was his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
aov_text: En die seun van Salomo was Rehábeam; sy seun was Abía; sy seun was Asa; sy seun was Jósafat;

kjv_text: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
bsb_text: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
aov_text: sy seun was Joram; sy seun was Ahásia; sy seun was Joas;

kjv_text: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
bsb_text: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
aov_text: sy seun was Amásia; sy seun was Asárja; sy seun was Jotam;

kjv_text: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
bsb_text: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
aov_text: sy seun was Agas; sy seun was Hiskía; sy seun was Manasse;

kjv_text: Amon his son, Josiah his son.
bsb_text: Amon his son, and Josiah his son.
aov_text: sy seun was Amon; sy seun was Josía.

kjv_text: And the sons of Josiah were, the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.
bsb_text: The sons of Josiah: Johanan was the firstborn, Jehoiakim the second, Zedekiah the third, and Shallum the fourth.
aov_text: En die seuns van Josía was: die eersgeborene Jóhanan, die tweede Jójakim, die derde Sedekía, die vierde Sallum.

kjv_text: And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.
bsb_text: The successors of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, and Zedekiah.
aov_text: En die seuns van Jójakim was: Jegónja, sy seun, Sedekía, sy seun.

kjv_text: And the sons of Jeconiah; Assir, Salathiel his son,
bsb_text: The descendants of Jeconiah the captive: Shealtiel his son,
aov_text: En die seuns van Jegónja was Assir; sy seun was Seáltiël;

kjv_text: Malchiram also, and Pedaiah, and Shenazar, Jecamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
bsb_text: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
aov_text: verder Malkíram en Pedája en Senassar, Jekámja, Hósama en Nedábja.

kjv_text: And the sons of Pedaiah were, Zerubbabel, and Shimei: and the sons of Zerubbabel; Meshullam, and Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister:
bsb_text: The sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei. The children of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah, their sister Shelomith,
aov_text: En die seuns van Pedája was Serubbábel en Símeï; en die seuns van Serubbábel was: Mesúllam en Hanánja; en Sélomit was hulle suster;

kjv_text: And Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, Jushabhesed, five.
bsb_text: and five others: Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab-hesed.
aov_text: en Hásuba en Ohel en Berégja en Hasádja, Jusab-Hesed, vyf.

kjv_text: And the sons of Hananiah; Pelatiah, and Jesaiah: the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shechaniah.
bsb_text: The descendants of Hananiah: Pelatiah, Jeshaiah, and the sons of Rephaiah, of Arnan, of Obadiah, and of Shecaniah.
aov_text: En die seuns van Hanánja was Pelátja, sy seun was Jesaja, sy seun was Refája, sy seun was Arnan, sy seun was Obádja, sy seun was Segánja.

kjv_text: And the sons of Shechaniah; Shemaiah: and the sons of Shemaiah; Hattush, and Igeal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat, six.
bsb_text: The six descendants of Shecaniah were Shemaiah and his sons: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat.
aov_text: En die seuns van Segánja was Semája; en die seuns van Semája was: Hattus en Jígeal en Baríag en Neárja en Safat, ses;

kjv_text: And the sons of Neariah; Elioenai, and Hezekiah, and Azrikam, three.
bsb_text: The sons of Neariah: Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam—three in all.
aov_text: en die seuns van Neárja was: Eljoënai en Hiskía en Asríkam, drie;

kjv_text: And the sons of Elioenai were, Hodaiah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Dalaiah, and Anani, seven.
bsb_text: The sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani—seven in all.
aov_text: en die seuns van Eljoënai was: Hodáwja en Eljásib en Pelája en Akkub en Jóhanan en Delája en Anáni, sewe.

kjv_text: The sons of Judah; Pharez, Hezron, and Carmi, and Hur, and Shobal.
bsb_text: The descendants of Judah: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.
aov_text: DIE seuns van Juda was: Peres, Hesron en Karmi en Hur en Sobal.

kjv_text: And Reaiah the son of Shobal begat Jahath; and Jahath begat Ahumai, and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.
bsb_text: Reaiah son of Shobal was the father of Jahath, and Jahath was the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These were the clans of the Zorathites.
aov_text: En Reája, die seun van Sobal, was die vader van Jahat, en Jahat van Ahúmai en van Lahad; dit is die geslagte van die Soreatiete;

kjv_text: And these were of the father of Etam; Jezreel, and Ishma, and Idbash: and the name of their sister was Hazelelponi:
bsb_text: These were the sons of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash. And their sister was named Hazzelelponi.
aov_text: en dit is die seuns van Etam: Jísreël en Jísma en Jidbas; en die naam van hulle suster was Hasselelpóni.

kjv_text: And Penuel the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah, the father of Bethlehem.
bsb_text: Penuel was the father of Gedor, and Ezer was the father of Hushah. These were the descendants of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah and the father of Bethlehem.
aov_text: En Pnuel was die vader van Gedor, en Eser die vader van Husa. Dit is die seuns van Hur, die eersgeborene van Éfrata, die vader van Betlehem.

kjv_text: And Ashur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
bsb_text: Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
aov_text: En Asgur, die vader van Tekóa, het twee vroue gehad: Hélea en Náära;

kjv_text: And Naarah bare him Ahuzam, and Hepher, and Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.
bsb_text: Naarah bore to him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the descendants of Naarah.
aov_text: en Náära het vir hom Ahússam en Hefer en die Temeniete en die Ahastariete gebaar. Dit was die seuns van Náära.

kjv_text: And the sons of Helah were, Zereth, and Jezoar, and Ethnan.
bsb_text: The sons of Helah were Zereth, Zohar, Ethnan,
aov_text: En die seuns van Hélea was: Seret, Jesóhar en Etnan.

kjv_text: And Coz begat Anub, and Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.
bsb_text: and Koz, who was the father of Anub and Zobebah and of the clans of Aharhel son of Harum.
aov_text: En Kōs was die vader van Anub en Hassobéba en van die geslagte van Ahárhel, die seun van Harum.

kjv_text: And Jabez was more honourable than his brethren: and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, Because I bare him with sorrow.
bsb_text: Now Jabez was more honorable than his brothers. His mother had named him Jabez, saying, “Because I bore him in pain.”
aov_text: En Jabes was meer geëerd as sy broers; en sy moeder het hom Jabes genoem en gesê: Ek het met smart gebaar.

kjv_text: And Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, Oh that thou wouldest bless me indeed, and enlarge my coast, and that thine hand might be with me, and that thou wouldest keep me from evil, that it may not grieve me! And God granted him that which he requested.
bsb_text: And Jabez called out to the God of Israel, “If only You would bless me and enlarge my territory! May Your hand be with me and keep me from harm, so that I will be free from pain.” And God granted the request of Jabez.
aov_text: En Jabes het die God van Israel aangeroep en gesê: As U my ryklik seën en my grondgebied vermeerder en u hand met my sal wees en U die onheil afweer, sodat my geen smart tref nie! En God het laat kom wat hy begeer het.

kjv_text: And Chelub the brother of Shuah begat Mehir, which was the father of Eshton.
bsb_text: Chelub the brother of Shuhah was the father of Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.
aov_text: En Kelub, die broer van Suha, was die vader van Mehir; hy is die vader van Eston.

kjv_text: And Eshton begat Bethrapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Irnahash. These are the men of Rechah.
bsb_text: Eshton was the father of Beth-rapha, of Paseah, and of Tehinnah the father of Ir-nahash. These were the men of Recah.
aov_text: En Eston was die vader van Bet-Ráfa en Paséag en Tehínna, die vader van die stad Nahas; dit is die manne van Rega.

kjv_text: And the sons of Kenaz; Othniel, and Seraiah: and the sons of Othniel; Hathath.
bsb_text: The sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah. The sons of Othniel: Hathath and Meonothai.
aov_text: En die seuns van Kenas was Ótniël en Serája; en die seuns van Ótniël: Hatat en Meonótai.

kjv_text: And Meonothai begat Ophrah: and Seraiah begat Joab, the father of the valley of Charashim; for they were craftsmen.
bsb_text: Meonothai was the father of Ophrah, and Seraiah was the father of Joab, the father of those living in Ge-harashim, which was given this name because its people were craftsmen.
aov_text: En Meonótai was die vader van Ofra, en Serája van Joab, die vader van die Handwerkersdal, want hulle was ambagsmanne.

kjv_text: And the sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh; Iru, Elah, and Naam: and the sons of Elah, even Kenaz.
bsb_text: The sons of Caleb son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam. The son of Elah: Kenaz.
aov_text: En die seuns van Kaleb, die seun van Jefúnne, was: Iru, Ela en Naäm, en die seuns van Ela: Kenas.

kjv_text: And the sons of Jehaleleel; Ziph, and Ziphah, Tiria, and Asareel.
bsb_text: The sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.
aov_text: En die seuns van Jehálleleël was: Sif en Sifa, Tíreja en Asáreël.

kjv_text: And the sons of Ezra were, Jether, and Mered, and Epher, and Jalon: and she bare Miriam, and Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
bsb_text: The sons of Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon. And Mered’s wife Bithiah gave birth to Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
aov_text: En die seuns van Esra was: Jeter en Mered en Efer en Jalon; en dit is die seuns van Bitja, die dogter van Farao, wat Mered as vrou geneem het; en sy het swanger geword en gebaar: Mirjam en Sámmai en Jisbag, die vader van Estemóa.

kjv_text: And his wife Jehudijah bare Jered the father of Gedor, and Heber the father of Socho, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. And these are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, which Mered took.
bsb_text: These were the children of Pharaoh’s daughter Bithiah. Mered also took a Judean wife, who gave birth to Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah.
aov_text: En sy Joodse vrou het gebaar Jered, die vader van Gedor, en Heber, die vader van Sogo, en Jekútiël, die vader van Sanóag.

kjv_text: And the sons of his wife Hodiah the sister of Naham, the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maachathite.
bsb_text: The sons of Hodiah’s wife, the sister of Naham, were the fathers of Keilah the Garmite and of Eshtemoa the Maacathite.
aov_text: En die seuns van die vrou van Hodíja, die suster van Naham, die vader van Kehíla, was die Garmiet, en Estemóa, die Maägatiet.

kjv_text: And the sons of Shimon were, Amnon, and Rinnah, Benhanan, and Tilon. And the sons of Ishi were, Zoheth, and Benzoheth.
bsb_text: The sons of Shimon: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben-hanan, and Tilon. The descendants of Ishi: Zoheth and Ben-zoheth.
aov_text: En die seuns van Simon was: Amnon en Rinna, Ben-Hánan en Tilon; en die seuns van Jíseï was Sohet en Ben-Sohet.

kjv_text: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah were, Er the father of Lecah, and Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of them that wrought fine linen, of the house of Ashbea,
bsb_text: The sons of Shelah son of Judah: Er the father of Lecah, Laadah the father of Mareshah and the clans of the linen workers at Beth-ashbea,
aov_text: Die seuns van Sela, die seun van Juda was: Er, die vader van Lega, en Láeda, die vader van Marésa, en die geslagte van die huis van die linnewewers van die huis van Asbéa;

kjv_text: And Jokim, and the men of Chozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had the dominion in Moab, and Jashubilehem. And these are ancient things.
bsb_text: Jokim, the men of Cozeba, and Joash and Saraph, who ruled in Moab and Jashubi-lehem. (These names are from ancient records.)
aov_text: verder Jokim en die manne van Koséba en Joas en Saraf—hulle wat oor Moab geheers het—en Jasubi-Léhem; maar die geskiedenisse is oud.

kjv_text: These were the potters, and those that dwelt among plants and hedges: there they dwelt with the king for his work.
bsb_text: These were the potters who lived at Netaim and Gederah. They lived there in the service of the king.
aov_text: Hulle was die pottebakkers en die inwoners van Netáim en Gedéra; daar het hulle gebly by die koning in sy diens.

kjv_text: The sons of Simeon were, Nemuel, and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul:
bsb_text: The descendants of Simeon: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul.
aov_text: DIE seuns van Símeon was: Némuel en Jamin, Jarib, Serag, Saul;

kjv_text: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.
bsb_text: The sons of Shaul: Shallum, Mibsam, and Mishma.
aov_text: Sallum was sy seun; Mibsam was sy seun; Misma was sy seun.

kjv_text: And the sons of Mishma; Hamuel his son, Zacchur his son, Shimei his son.
bsb_text: The sons of Mishma: Hammuel, Zaccur, and Shimei.
aov_text: En die seuns van Misma was: Hámmuel, sy seun, Sakkur, sy seun, Símeï, sy seun.

kjv_text: And Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brethren had not many children, neither did all their family multiply, like to the children of Judah.
bsb_text: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters, but his brothers did not have many children, so their whole clan did not become as numerous as the sons of Judah.
aov_text: En Símeï het sestien seuns en ses dogters gehad; maar sy broers het nie baie seuns gehad nie; en hulle hele geslag het nie so vermeerder soos die seuns van Juda nie.

kjv_text: And they dwelt at Beersheba, and Moladah, and Hazarshual,
bsb_text: They lived in Beersheba, Moladah, Hazar-shual,
aov_text: En hulle het gewoon in Berséba en Mólada en Hasar-Súal

kjv_text: And at Bilhah, and at Ezem, and at Tolad,
bsb_text: Bilhah, Ezem, Tolad,
aov_text: en in Bilha en Esem en Tolad

kjv_text: And at Bethuel, and at Hormah, and at Ziklag,
bsb_text: Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag,
aov_text: en in Bétuel en Horma en Siklag

kjv_text: And at Bethmarcaboth, and Hazarsusim, and at Bethbirei, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities unto the reign of David.
bsb_text: Beth-marcaboth, Hazar-susim, Beth-biri, and Shaaraim. These were their cities until the reign of David.
aov_text: en in Bet-Márkabot en Hasar-Susim, en Bet-Bíreï en Saäráim; dit was hulle stede totdat Dawid koning geword het.

kjv_text: And their villages were, Etam, and Ain, Rimmon, and Tochen, and Ashan, five cities:
bsb_text: And their villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan—five towns—
aov_text: En hulle dorpe was: Etam en Ajin, Rimmon en Togen en Asan, vyf stede;

kjv_text: And all their villages that were round about the same cities, unto Baal. These were their habitations, and their genealogy.
bsb_text: and all their surrounding villages as far as Baal. These were their settlements, and they kept a genealogical record:
aov_text: en al hulle dorpe wat in die omtrek van hierdie stede was, tot by Baäl; dit was hulle woonplekke, en hulle het hul geslagsregister gehad.

kjv_text: And Meshobab, and Jamlech, and Joshah, the son of Amaziah,
bsb_text: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah son of Amaziah,
aov_text: En Mésobab en Jamleg en Josa, die seun van Amásia,

kjv_text: And Joel, and Jehu the son of Josibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,
bsb_text: Joel, Jehu son of Joshibiah (son of Seraiah, son of Asiel),
aov_text: en Joël en Jehu, die seun van Josíbja, die seun van Serája, die seun van Ásiël,

kjv_text: And Elioenai, and Jaakobah, and Jeshohaiah, and Asaiah, and Adiel, and Jesimiel, and Benaiah,
bsb_text: Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah,
aov_text: en Eljoënai en Jaäkóba en Jesohája en Asája en Ádiël en Jesímiël en Benája

kjv_text: And Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah;
bsb_text: and Ziza son of Shiphi (son of Allon, son of Jedaiah, son of Shimri, son of Shemaiah).
aov_text: en Sisa, die seun van Sífeï, die seun van Allon, die seun van Jedája, die seun van Simri, die seun van Semája —

kjv_text: These mentioned by their names were princes in their families: and the house of their fathers increased greatly.
bsb_text: These men listed by name were the leaders of their clans. Their families increased greatly,
aov_text: die wat hier met hulle naam opgegee is, was vorste in hulle geslagte, en hulle families het sterk vermeerder.

kjv_text: And they went to the entrance of Gedor, even unto the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.
bsb_text: and they journeyed to the entrance of Gedor, to the east side of the valley, in search of pasture for their flocks.
aov_text: En hulle het getrek tot by die ingang na Gedor, tot oostelik van die dal, om weiveld vir hulle kleinvee te soek.

kjv_text: And they found fat pasture and good, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceable; for they of Ham had dwelt there of old.
bsb_text: There they found rich, good pasture, and the land was spacious, peaceful, and quiet; for some Hamites had lived there formerly.
aov_text: En hulle het geil en goeie weiveld gevind, en die land was na alkante toe wyd en stil en rustig, want mense van Gam het daar tevore gewoon;

kjv_text: And these written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and smote their tents, and the habitations that were found there, and destroyed them utterly unto this day, and dwelt in their rooms: because there was pasture there for their flocks.
bsb_text: These who were noted by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah. They attacked the Hamites and Meunites there in their dwellings, devoting them to destruction even to this day. Then they settled in their place, because there was pasture for their flocks.
aov_text: en die wat hier met hulle naam beskrywe is, het in die dae van Hiskía, die koning van Juda, gekom en hulle tente verslaan, en ook die Meüniete wat daar gevind is; en hulle het hul met die banvloek getref tot vandag toe; en hulle het in hulle plek gaan woon; want daar was weiveld vir hulle kleinvee.

kjv_text: And some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, and Neariah, and Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.
bsb_text: And five hundred of these Simeonites led by Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi, went to Mount Seir
aov_text: Ook het van hulle, van die seuns van Símeon, vyfhonderd man getrek na die gebergte Seïr; en Pelátja en Neárja en Refája en Ússiël, die seuns van Jíseï, was aan hulle hoof.

kjv_text: And they smote the rest of the Amalekites that were escaped, and dwelt there unto this day.
bsb_text: and struck down the remnant of the Amalekites who had escaped. And they have lived there to this day.
aov_text: En hulle het die oorblyfsel van die vrygeraaktes van Ámalek verslaan en daar gaan woon tot vandag toe.

kjv_text: Now the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel, (for he was the firstborn; but, forasmuch as he defiled his father's bed, his birthright was given unto the sons of Joseph the son of Israel: and the genealogy is not to be reckoned after the birthright.
bsb_text: These were the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel. Though he was the firstborn, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph son of Israel, because Reuben defiled his father’s bed. So he is not reckoned according to birthright.
aov_text: EN die seuns van Ruben, die eersgeborene van Israel—want hy was die eersgeborene; maar omdat hy die bed van sy vader ontheilig het, is sy eersgeboortereg aan die seuns van Josef, die seun van Israel, gegee, maar hy moes nie in die geslagsregister volgens die eersgeboortereg aangegee word nie;

kjv_text: For Judah prevailed above his brethren, and of him came the chief ruler; but the birthright was Joseph's:)
bsb_text: And though Judah prevailed over his brothers and a ruler came from him, the birthright belonged to Joseph.
aov_text: want Juda was sterk onder sy broers, en uit hom het een ’n vors geword, maar die eersgeboortereg het Josef gehad —

kjv_text: The sons, I say, of Reuben the firstborn of Israel were, Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
bsb_text: The sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
aov_text: die seuns van Ruben, die eersgeborene van Israel, was: Henog en Pallu, Hesron en Karmi.

kjv_text: The sons of Joel; Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,
bsb_text: The descendants of Joel: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,
aov_text: Die seuns van Joël: sy seun Semája, sy seun Gog, sy seun Símeï;

kjv_text: Micah his son, Reaia his son, Baal his son,
bsb_text: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,
aov_text: sy seun Miga, sy seun Reája, sy seun Baäl,

kjv_text: Beerah his son, whom Tilgathpilneser king of Assyria carried away captive: he was prince of the Reubenites.
bsb_text: and Beerah his son, whom Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria carried into exile. Beerah was a leader of the Reubenites.
aov_text: sy seun Beëra, vir wie Tiglat-Piléser, die koning van Assirië, in ballingskap weggevoer het; hy was ’n vors van die Rubeniete.

kjv_text: And his brethren by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was reckoned, were the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,
bsb_text: His relatives by their clans are recorded in their genealogy: Jeiel the chief, Zechariah,
aov_text: En sy broers volgens elkeen se geslag soos in die geslagsregister opgegee, volgens hulle afstamming, was: Jeï-el, die hoof; verder Sagaría

kjv_text: And Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who dwelt in Aroer, even unto Nebo and Baalmeon:
bsb_text: and Bela son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel. They settled in Aroer and as far as Nebo and Baal-meon.
aov_text: en Bela, die seun van Asas, die seun van Sema, die seun van Joël; hy wat in Ároër en tot by Nebo en Baäl-Méon gewoon het.

kjv_text: And eastward he inhabited unto the entering in of the wilderness from the river Euphrates: because their cattle were multiplied in the land of Gilead.
bsb_text: They also settled in the east as far as the edge of the desert that extends to the Euphrates River, because their livestock had increased in the land of Gilead.
aov_text: En teen die ooste het hy gewoon tot by die ingang na die woestyn, van die Eufraatrivier af; want hulle vee het baie geword in die land Gílead.

kjv_text: And in the days of Saul they made war with the Hagarites, who fell by their hand: and they dwelt in their tents throughout all the east land of Gilead.
bsb_text: During the days of Saul they waged war against the Hagrites, who were defeated at their hands, and they occupied the homes of the Hagrites throughout the region east of Gilead.
aov_text: En in die dae van Saul het hulle oorlog gevoer met die Hagareners, en toe dié in hulle hand geval het, het hulle in hulle tente gewoon aan die hele oostekant van Gílead.

kjv_text: And the children of Gad dwelt over against them, in the land of Bashan unto Salcah:
bsb_text: The descendants of Gad lived next to the Reubenites in the land of Bashan, as far as Salecah:
aov_text: EN die seuns van Gad het teenoor hulle in die land Basan gewoon tot by Salka.

kjv_text: Joel the chief, and Shapham the next, and Jaanai, and Shaphat in Bashan.
bsb_text: Joel was the chief, Shapham the second, then Jaanai and Shaphat, who lived in Bashan.
aov_text: Joël was die hoof, en Safam die tweede in rang, en Jaénai en Safat, in Basan.

kjv_text: And their brethren of the house of their fathers were, Michael, and Meshullam, and Sheba, and Jorai, and Jachan, and Zia, and Heber, seven.
bsb_text: Their kinsmen by families were Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber—seven in all.
aov_text: En hulle broers volgens hulle families was: Mígael en Mesúllam en Seba en Jórai en Jáekan en Sia en Eber, sewe.

kjv_text: These are the children of Abihail the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;
bsb_text: These were the sons of Abihail son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz.
aov_text: Dit was die seuns van Abígail, die seun van Huri, die seun van Jaróag, die seun van Gílead, die seun van Mígael, die seun van Jesísai, die seun van Jagdo, die seun van Bus.

kjv_text: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of the house of their fathers.
bsb_text: Ahi son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, was head of their family.
aov_text: Ahi, die seun van Ábdiël, die seun van Guni, was die hoof van hulle families.

kjv_text: And they dwelt in Gilead in Bashan, and in her towns, and in all the suburbs of Sharon, upon their borders.
bsb_text: They lived in Gilead, in Bashan and its towns, and throughout the pasturelands of Sharon.
aov_text: En hulle het gewoon in Gílead, in Basan en in sy onderhorige plekke en in al die weivelde van Saron tot waar dit ophou.

kjv_text: All these were reckoned by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.
bsb_text: All of them were reckoned in the genealogies during the reigns of Jotham king of Judah and Jeroboam king of Israel.
aov_text: Hulle almal is in die geslagsregister opgeneem in die dae van Jotam, die koning van Juda, en in die dae van Jeróbeam, die koning van Israel.

kjv_text: The sons of Reuben, and the Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, and to shoot with bow, and skilful in war, were four and forty thousand seven hundred and threescore, that went out to the war.
bsb_text: The Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh had 44,760 warriors—valiant men who carried the shield and sword, drew the bow, and were trained for battle.
aov_text: Van die seuns van Ruben en Gad en die halwe stam van Manasse, naamlik van die helde, manne wat skild en swaard dra en die boog span en ervare is in die oorlog, was daar vier-en-veertigduisend-sewehonderd-en-sestig wat op kommando moes uittrek.

kjv_text: And they made war with the Hagarites, with Jetur, and Nephish, and Nodab.
bsb_text: They waged war against the Hagrites, as well as Jetur, Naphish, and Nodab.
aov_text: En hulle het oorlog gevoer met die Hagareners en Jetur en Nafis en Nodab;

kjv_text: And they were helped against them, and the Hagarites were delivered into their hand, and all that were with them: for they cried to God in the battle, and he was intreated of them; because they put their trust in him.
bsb_text: And because they cried out to God in battle, they were helped against their enemies, and the Hagrites and all their allies were delivered into their hands. Because they put their trust in God, He answered their prayers.
aov_text: en hulle het hulp gekry teen hulle, en die Hagareners is in hulle hand oorgegee, en almal wat met hulle saam was; want hulle het God aangeroep in die oorlog, en Hy het hulle verhoor, omdat hulle op Hom vertrou het.

kjv_text: And they took away their cattle; of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred and fifty thousand, and of asses two thousand, and of men an hundred thousand.
bsb_text: They seized the livestock of the Hagrites—50,000 camels, 250,000 sheep, and 2,000 donkeys. They also took 100,000 captives,
aov_text: En hulle het hulle vee weggevoer: van hul kamele vyftigduisend; tweehonderd-en-vyftigduisend stuks kleinvee en tweeduisend esels en honderdduisend mense.

kjv_text: For there fell down many slain, because the war was of God. And they dwelt in their steads until the captivity.
bsb_text: and many others fell slain, because the battle belonged to God. And they occupied the land until the exile.
aov_text: Want baie gesneuweldes het daar gelê, omdat die oorlog van God was; en hulle het in hulle plek gewoon tot die ballingskap toe.

kjv_text: And the children of the half tribe of Manasseh dwelt in the land: they increased from Bashan unto Baalhermon and Senir, and unto mount Hermon.
bsb_text: Now the people of the half-tribe of Manasseh were numerous. They settled in the land from Bashan to Baal-hermon (that is, Senir, also known as Mount Hermon).
aov_text: EN die seuns van die halwe stam van Manasse het in die land gewoon van Basan af tot by Baäl-Hermon en Senir en die berg Hermon; hulle was baie.

kjv_text: And these were the heads of the house of their fathers, even Epher, and Ishi, and Eliel, and Azriel, and Jeremiah, and Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, mighty men of valour, famous men, and heads of the house of their fathers.
bsb_text: These were the heads of their families: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel. They were mighty men of valor, famous men, and heads of their families.
aov_text: En dit was die hoofde van hulle families, naamlik: Efer en Jíseï en Éliël en Ásriël en Jeremía en Hodáwja en Jagdíël, manne, dapper helde, manne van naam, hoofde van hulle families.

kjv_text: And they transgressed against the God of their fathers, and went a whoring after the gods of the people of the land, whom God destroyed before them.
bsb_text: But they were unfaithful to the God of their fathers, and they prostituted themselves with the gods of the peoples of the land, whom God had destroyed before them.
aov_text: Maar hulle het ontrou gehandel teen die God van hulle vaders, en die gode van die volke van die land wat God voor hulle uit verdelg het, agternagehoereer.

kjv_text: And the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgathpilneser king of Assyria, and he carried them away, even the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, and brought them unto Halah, and Habor, and Hara, and to the river Gozan, unto this day.
bsb_text: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria (that is, Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria) to take the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh into exile. And he brought them to Halah, Habor, Hara, and the river of Gozan, where they remain to this day.
aov_text: Daarom het die God van Israel die gees van Pul, die koning van Assirië, naamlik die gees van Tiglat-Piléser, die koning van Assirië, aangewakker, wat hulle, die Rubeniete en die Gadiete en die halwe stam van Manasse, in ballingskap weggevoer en hulle gebring het na Halag en Habor en Hara en die rivier van Gosan tot vandag toe.

kjv_text: The sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
bsb_text: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
aov_text: DIE seuns van Levi was: Gerson, Kehat en Merári.

kjv_text: And the sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
bsb_text: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
aov_text: En die seuns van Kehat was: Amram, Jishar en Hebron en Ússiël.

kjv_text: And the children of Amram; Aaron, and Moses, and Miriam. The sons also of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
bsb_text: The children of Amram: Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
aov_text: En die seuns van Amram was: Aäron en Moses, en Mirjam; en die seuns van Aäron was: Nadab en Abíhu, Eleásar en Ítamar.

kjv_text: Eleazar begat Phinehas, Phinehas begat Abishua,
bsb_text: Eleazar was the father of Phinehas, Phinehas was the father of Abishua,
aov_text: En Eleásar was die vader van Pínehas; Pínehas van Abisúa;

kjv_text: And Abishua begat Bukki, and Bukki begat Uzzi,
bsb_text: Abishua was the father of Bukki, Bukki was the father of Uzzi,
aov_text: en Abisúa van Bukki; en Bukki van Ussi;

kjv_text: And Uzzi begat Zerahiah, and Zerahiah begat Meraioth,
bsb_text: Uzzi was the father of Zerahiah, Zerahiah was the father of Meraioth,
aov_text: en Ussi van Serágja; en Serágja van Mérajot;

kjv_text: Meraioth begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,
bsb_text: Meraioth was the father of Amariah, Amariah was the father of Ahitub,
aov_text: en Mérajot van Amárja; en Amárja van Ahítub;

kjv_text: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Ahimaaz,
bsb_text: Ahitub was the father of Zadok, Zadok was the father of Ahimaaz,
aov_text: en Ahítub van Sadok; en Sadok van Ahímaäs;

kjv_text: And Ahimaaz begat Azariah, and Azariah begat Johanan,
bsb_text: Ahimaaz was the father of Azariah, Azariah was the father of Johanan,
aov_text: en Ahímaäs van Asárja; en Asárja van Jóhanan;

kjv_text: And Johanan begat Azariah, (he it is that executed the priest's office in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem:)
bsb_text: Johanan was the father of Azariah, who served as priest in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem,
aov_text: en Jóhanan van Asárja; dit is hy wat die priesteramp bedien het in die huis wat Salomo in Jerusalem gebou het.

kjv_text: And Azariah begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,
bsb_text: Azariah was the father of Amariah, Amariah was the father of Ahitub,
aov_text: En Asárja was die vader van Amárja; en Amárja van Ahítub;

kjv_text: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Shallum,
bsb_text: Ahitub was the father of Zadok, Zadok was the father of Shallum,
aov_text: en Ahítub van Sadok; en Sadok van Sallum;

kjv_text: And Shallum begat Hilkiah, and Hilkiah begat Azariah,
bsb_text: Shallum was the father of Hilkiah, Hilkiah was the father of Azariah,
aov_text: en Sallum van Hilkía; en Hilkía van Asárja;

kjv_text: And Azariah begat Seraiah, and Seraiah begat Jehozadak,
bsb_text: Azariah was the father of Seraiah, and Seraiah was the father of Jehozadak.
aov_text: en Asárja van Serája; en Serája van Jósadak;

kjv_text: And Jehozadak went into captivity, when the LORD carried away Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
bsb_text: Jehozadak went into captivity when the LORD sent Judah and Jerusalem into exile by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
aov_text: en Jósadak het saamgegaan toe die HERE Juda en Jerusalem deur die hand van Nebukadnésar in ballingskap weggevoer het.

kjv_text: The sons of Levi; Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
bsb_text: The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
aov_text: Die seuns van Levi was: Gersom, Kehat en Merári.

kjv_text: And these be the names of the sons of Gershom; Libni, and Shimei.
bsb_text: These are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.
aov_text: En dit is die name van die seuns van Gersom: Libni en Símeï.

kjv_text: And the sons of Kohath were, Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
bsb_text: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
aov_text: En die seuns van Kehat was: Amram en Jishar en Hebron en Ússiël.

kjv_text: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. And these are the families of the Levites according to their fathers.
bsb_text: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the clans of the Levites listed according to their fathers:
aov_text: Die seuns van Merári was Magli en Musi. En dit is die geslagte van die Leviete volgens hulle families:

kjv_text: Of Gershom; Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
bsb_text: Of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
aov_text: van Gersom—sy seun was Libni, sy seun Jahat, sy seun Simma,

kjv_text: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeaterai his son.
bsb_text: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, and Jeatherai his son.
aov_text: sy seun Joag, sy seun Iddo, sy seun Serag, sy seun Jéatrai.

bsb_text: The descendants of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,

kjv_text: Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,
bsb_text: Elkanah his son, Ebiasaph his son, Assir his son,
aov_text: sy seun Élkana, en sy seun Ébjasaf, en sy seun Assir,
