bsb_text: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.
aov_text: sy seun Tahat, sy seun Úriël, sy seun Ússia, en sy seun Saul.

kjv_text: And the sons of Elkanah; Amasai, and Ahimoth.
bsb_text: The descendants of Elkanah: Amasai, Ahimoth,
aov_text: En die seuns van Élkana was: Amásai en Áhimot en Élkana;

kjv_text: As for Elkanah: the sons of Elkanah; Zophai his son, and Nahath his son,
bsb_text: Elkanah his son, Zophai his son, Nahath his son,
aov_text: die seuns van Élkana: sy seun Sófai, en sy seun Nahat,

kjv_text: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.
bsb_text: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, and Elkanah his son.
aov_text: sy seun Elíab, sy seun Jeróham, sy seun Élkana.

kjv_text: And the sons of Samuel; the firstborn Vashni, and Abiah.
bsb_text: The sons of Samuel: Joel his firstborn and Abijah his second son.
aov_text: En die seuns van Samuel: die eersgeborene Joël, en die tweede Abía.

kjv_text: The sons of Merari; Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzza his son,
bsb_text: The descendants of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,
aov_text: Die seuns van Merári was: Magli; sy seun Libni, sy seun Símeï, sy seun Ussa;

kjv_text: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.
bsb_text: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, and Asaiah his son.
aov_text: sy seun Símea, sy seun Haggía, sy seun Asája.

kjv_text: And these are they whom David set over the service of song in the house of the LORD, after that the ark had rest.
bsb_text: These are the men David put in charge of the music in the house of the LORD after the ark rested there.
aov_text: En dit is hulle wat Dawid aangestel het vir die leiding van die sang in die huis van die HERE vandat die ark ’n rusplek gevind het.

kjv_text: And they ministered before the dwelling place of the tabernacle of the congregation with singing, until Solomon had built the house of the LORD in Jerusalem: and then they waited on their office according to their order.
bsb_text: They ministered with song before the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting, until Solomon built the house of the LORD in Jerusalem. And they performed their duties according to the regulations given them.
aov_text: En hulle het as sangers gedien voor die tabernakel van die tent van samekoms, totdat Salomo die huis van die HERE in Jerusalem gebou het; en hulle het in hul dienswerk gestaan volgens hulle ordening.

kjv_text: And these are they that waited with their children. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman a singer, the son of Joel, the son of Shemuel,
bsb_text: These are the men who served, together with their sons. From the Kohathites: Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,
aov_text: En dit is hulle wat in diens gestaan het saam met hulle seuns: van die seuns van die Kehatiete: Heman, die sanger, die seun van Joël, die seun van Samuel,

kjv_text: The son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,
bsb_text: the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,
aov_text: die seun van Élkana, die seun van Jeróham, die seun van Éliël, die seun van Toag,

kjv_text: The son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,
bsb_text: the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,
aov_text: die seun van Suf, die seun van Élkana, die seun van Mahat, die seun van Amásai,

kjv_text: The son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,
bsb_text: the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,
aov_text: die seun van Élkana, die seun van Joël, die seun van Asárja, die seun van Sefánja,

bsb_text: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,
aov_text: die seun van Tahat, die seun van Assir, die seun van Ébjasaf, die seun van Korag,

kjv_text: The son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
bsb_text: the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
aov_text: die seun van Jishar, die seun van Kehat, die seun van Levi, die seun van Israel.

kjv_text: And his brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berachiah, the son of Shimea,
bsb_text: Heman’s kinsman was Asaph, who served at his right hand: Asaph the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea,
aov_text: En sy broer was Asaf, wat aan sy regterhand gestaan het; Asaf was die seun van Berégja, die seun van Símea,

kjv_text: The son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchiah,
bsb_text: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah,
aov_text: die seun van Mígael, die seun van Baäséja, die seun van Malkía,

kjv_text: The son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,
bsb_text: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,
aov_text: die seun van Etni, die seun van Serag, die seun van Adája,

kjv_text: The son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,
bsb_text: the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,
aov_text: die seun van Etan, die seun van Simma, die seun van Símeï,

kjv_text: The son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.
bsb_text: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.
aov_text: die seun van Jahat, die seun van Gersom, die seun van Levi.

kjv_text: And their brethren the sons of Merari stood on the left hand: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,
bsb_text: On the left were their kinsmen, the sons of Merari: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,
aov_text: En hulle broers, die seuns van Merári, aan die linkerhand, was: Etan, die seun van Kisi, die seun van Abdi, die seun van Mallug,

kjv_text: The son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,
bsb_text: the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,
aov_text: die seun van Hasábja, die seun van Amásia, die seun van Hilkía,

kjv_text: The son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shamer,
bsb_text: the son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer,
aov_text: die seun van Amsi, die seun van Bani, die seun van Semer,

kjv_text: The son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.
bsb_text: the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.
aov_text: die seun van Magli, die seun van Musi, die seun van Merári, die seun van Levi.

kjv_text: Their brethren also the Levites were appointed unto all manner of service of the tabernacle of the house of God.
bsb_text: Their fellow Levites were assigned to every kind of service of the tabernacle, the house of God.
aov_text: En hulle broers, die Leviete, was bestemd vir al die dienswerk by die tabernakel van die huis van God.

kjv_text: But Aaron and his sons offered upon the altar of the burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, and were appointed for all the work of the place most holy, and to make an atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
bsb_text: But Aaron and his sons did all the work of the Most Holy Place. They presented the offerings on the altar of burnt offering and on the altar of incense to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
aov_text: Maar Aäron en sy seuns het offerrook laat opgaan op die brandofferaltaar en op die reukofferaltaar, vir al die werk in die Allerheiligste en om versoening te doen vir Israel, net soos Moses, die kneg van God, beveel het.

kjv_text: And these are the sons of Aaron; Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
bsb_text: These were the descendants of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
aov_text: En dit is die seuns van Aäron: Eleásar was sy seun, Pínehas sy seun, Abisúa sy seun;

kjv_text: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
bsb_text: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
aov_text: Bukki sy seun, Ussi sy seun, Serágja sy seun,

kjv_text: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
bsb_text: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
aov_text: Mérajot sy seun, Amárja sy seun, Ahítub sy seun,

kjv_text: Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.
bsb_text: Zadok his son, and Ahimaaz his son.
aov_text: Sadok sy seun, Ahímaäs sy seun.

kjv_text: Now these are their dwelling places throughout their castles in their coasts, of the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites: for theirs was the lot.
bsb_text: Now these were the territories assigned to the descendants of Aaron from the Kohathite clan for their settlements, because the first lot fell to them:
aov_text: En dit was hulle woonplekke volgens hulle laers in hulle grondgebied—aan die seuns van Aäron, aan die geslag van die Kehatiete, want aan hulle was die eerste lot.

kjv_text: And they gave them Hebron in the land of Judah, and the suburbs thereof round about it.
bsb_text: They were given Hebron in the land of Judah and its surrounding pasturelands.
aov_text: Aan hulle dan is gegee: Hebron, in die land Juda, met sy weiveld daar rondom;

kjv_text: But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
bsb_text: But the fields and villages around the city were given to Caleb son of Jephunneh.
aov_text: maar die saaigrond van die stad en sy dorpe het hulle aan Kaleb, die seun van Jefúnne, gegee.

kjv_text: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of Judah, namely, Hebron, the city of refuge, and Libnah with her suburbs, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa, with their suburbs,
bsb_text: So the descendants of Aaron were given Hebron (a city of refuge), Libnah, Jattir, Eshtemoa,
aov_text: En aan die seuns van Aäron het hulle die vrystad Hebron en Libna gegee met die weiveld daarvan, en Jattir en Estemóa met die weiveld daarvan,

kjv_text: And Hilen with her suburbs, Debir with her suburbs,
bsb_text: Hilen, Debir,
aov_text: en Hiles met sy weiveld, en Debir met sy weiveld,

kjv_text: And Ashan with her suburbs, and Bethshemesh with her suburbs:
bsb_text: Ashan, Juttah, and Beth-shemesh, together with their pasturelands.
aov_text: en Asan met sy weiveld, en Bet-Semes met sy weiveld;

kjv_text: And out of the tribe of Benjamin; Geba with her suburbs, and Alemeth with her suburbs, and Anathoth with her suburbs. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.
bsb_text: And from the tribe of Benjamin they were given Gibeon, Geba, Alemeth, and Anathoth, together with their pasturelands. So they had thirteen cities in all among their families.
aov_text: en van die stam van Benjamin: Geba met sy weiveld, en Alémet met sy weiveld, en Ánatot met sy weiveld. Al hulle stede in hulle geslagte was dertien stede.

kjv_text: And unto the sons of Kohath, which were left of the family of that tribe, were cities given out of the half tribe, namely, out of the half tribe of Manasseh, by lot, ten cities.
bsb_text: To the rest of the Kohathites, ten cities were allotted from the half-tribe of Manasseh.
aov_text: En aan die ander seuns van Kehat uit die geslag van die stam, uit die halwe stam, half Manasse, tien stede deur die lot.

kjv_text: And to the sons of Gershom throughout their families out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
bsb_text: The Gershomites, according to their clans, were allotted thirteen cities from the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and Manasseh in Bashan.
aov_text: En aan die seuns van Gersom, volgens hulle geslagte, uit die stam van Íssaskar en uit die stam van Aser en uit die stam van Náftali en uit die stam van Manasse in Basan, dertien stede.

kjv_text: Unto the sons of Merari were given by lot, throughout their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
bsb_text: The Merarites, according to their families, were allotted twelve cities from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.
aov_text: Aan die seuns van Merári volgens hulle geslagte uit die stam van Ruben en uit die stam van Gad en uit die stam van Sébulon deur die lot, twaalf stede.

kjv_text: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites these cities with their suburbs.
bsb_text: So the Israelites gave to the Levites these cities and their pasturelands.
aov_text: En die kinders van Israel het aan die Leviete die stede met hulle weiveld gegee:

kjv_text: And they gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities, which are called by their names.
bsb_text: They assigned by lot the cities named above from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin.
aov_text: hulle het deur die lot uit die stam van die seuns van Juda en uit die stam van die seuns van Símeon en uit die stam van die seuns van Benjamin hierdie stede gegee wat hulle met die naam genoem het.

kjv_text: And the residue of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their coasts out of the tribe of Ephraim.
bsb_text: And some of the clans of the Kohathites were given cities from the tribe of Ephraim for their territory:
aov_text: En aan die ander uit die geslagte van die seuns van Kehat—die stede van hulle grondgebied was uit die stam van Efraim.

kjv_text: And they gave unto them, of the cities of refuge, Shechem in mount Ephraim with her suburbs; they gave also Gezer with her suburbs,
bsb_text: They were given Shechem (a city of refuge) with its pasturelands in the hill country of Ephraim, and Gezer,
aov_text: En hulle het aan hulle die vrystad Sigem met sy weiveld, op die gebergte van Efraim, en Geser met sy weiveld gegee;

kjv_text: And Jokmeam with her suburbs, and Bethhoron with her suburbs,
bsb_text: Jokmeam, Beth-horon,
aov_text: en Jókmeam met sy weiveld, en Bet-Horon met sy weiveld,

kjv_text: And Aijalon with her suburbs, and Gathrimmon with her suburbs:
bsb_text: Aijalon, and Gath-rimmon, together with their pasturelands.
aov_text: en Ájalon met sy weiveld, en Gat-Rimmon met sy weiveld;

kjv_text: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh; Aner with her suburbs, and Bileam with her suburbs, for the family of the remnant of the sons of Kohath.
bsb_text: And from the half-tribe of Manasseh the remaining clans of the Kohathites were given Aner and Bileam, together with their pasturelands.
aov_text: en uit die halwe stam van Manasse: Aner met sy weiveld, en Bíleam met sy weiveld—vir die geslag van die ander seuns van Kehat.

kjv_text: Unto the sons of Gershom were given out of the family of the half tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, and Ashtaroth with her suburbs:
bsb_text: The Gershomites received the following: From the clan of the half-tribe of Manasseh they were given Golan in Bashan and also Ashtaroth, together with their pasturelands.
aov_text: Aan die seuns van Gersom uit die geslag van die halwe stam van Manasse: Gólan in Basan met sy weiveld, en Ástarot met sy weiveld;

kjv_text: And out of the tribe of Issachar; Kedesh with her suburbs, Daberath with her suburbs,
bsb_text: From the tribe of Issachar they were given Kedesh, Daberath,
aov_text: en uit die stam van Íssaskar: Kedes met sy weiveld, Dáberat met sy weiveld,

kjv_text: And Ramoth with her suburbs, and Anem with her suburbs:
bsb_text: Ramoth, and Anem, together with their pasturelands.
aov_text: en Ramot met sy weiveld, en Anem met sy weiveld;

kjv_text: And out of the tribe of Asher; Mashal with her suburbs, and Abdon with her suburbs,
bsb_text: From the tribe of Asher they were given Mashal, Abdon,
aov_text: en uit die stam van Aser: Masal met sy weiveld, en Abdon met sy weiveld,

kjv_text: And Hukok with her suburbs, and Rehob with her suburbs:
bsb_text: Hukok, and Rehob, together with their pasturelands.
aov_text: en Hukok met sy weiveld, en Rehob met sy weiveld;

kjv_text: And out of the tribe of Naphtali; Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs, and Hammon with her suburbs, and Kirjathaim with her suburbs.
bsb_text: And from the tribe of Naphtali they were given Kedesh in Galilee, Hammon, and Kiriathaim, together with their pasturelands.
aov_text: en uit die stam van Náftali: Kedes in Galiléa met sy weiveld, en Hammon met sy weiveld, en Kirjatáim met sy weiveld.

kjv_text: Unto the rest of the children of Merari were given out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmon with her suburbs, Tabor with her suburbs:
bsb_text: The Merarites (the rest of the Levites) received the following: From the tribe of Zebulun they were given Rimmono and Tabor, together with their pasturelands.
aov_text: Aan die ander seuns van Merári uit die stam van Sébulon: Rimmóno met sy weiveld, Tabor met sy weiveld;

kjv_text: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho, on the east side of Jordan, were given them out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer in the wilderness with her suburbs, and Jahzah with her suburbs,
bsb_text: From the tribe of Reuben east of the Jordan opposite Jericho they were given Bezer in the wilderness, Jahzah,
aov_text: en oorkant die Jordaan van Jérigo, aan die oostekant van die Jordaan, uit die stam van Ruben: Beser in die woestyn met sy weiveld, en Jahas met sy weiveld,

kjv_text: Kedemoth also with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs:
bsb_text: Kedemoth, and Mephaath, together with their pasturelands.
aov_text: en Kédemot met sy weiveld, en Mefáät met sy weiveld;

kjv_text: And out of the tribe of Gad; Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs, and Mahanaim with her suburbs,
bsb_text: And from the tribe of Gad they were given Ramoth in Gilead, Mahanaim,
aov_text: en uit die stam van Gad: Ramot in Gílead met sy weiveld, en Mahanáim met sy weiveld,

kjv_text: And Heshbon with her suburbs, and Jazer with her suburbs.
bsb_text: Heshbon, and Jazer, together with their pasturelands.
aov_text: en Hesbon met sy weiveld, en Jaéser met sy weiveld.

kjv_text: Now the sons of Issachar were, Tola, and Puah, Jashub, and Shimrom, four.
bsb_text: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron—four in all.
aov_text: EN die seuns van Íssaskar was: Tola en Pua, Jasub en Simron, vier.

kjv_text: And the sons of Tola; Uzzi, and Rephaiah, and Jeriel, and Jahmai, and Jibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their father's house, to wit, of Tola: they were valiant men of might in their generations; whose number was in the days of David two and twenty thousand and six hundred.
bsb_text: The sons of Tola: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, the heads of their families. In the days of David, 22,600 descendants of Tola were numbered in their genealogies as mighty men of valor.
aov_text: En die seuns van Tola was: Ussi en Refája en Jériël en Jágmai en Jibsam en Samuel, hoofde van hulle families, van Tola, dapper helde. Volgens hulle afstamming was hulle aantal in die dae van Dawid twee-en-twintigduisend-seshonderd.

kjv_text: And the sons of Uzzi; Izrahiah: and the sons of Izrahiah; Michael, and Obadiah, and Joel, Ishiah, five: all of them chief men.
bsb_text: The son of Uzzi: Izrahiah. The sons of Izrahiah: Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah. All five of them were chiefs.
aov_text: En die seuns van Ussi was Jisrágja; en die seuns van Jisrágja was: Mígael en Obádja en Joël, Jissía, vyf, almal hoofde.

kjv_text: And with them, by their generations, after the house of their fathers, were bands of soldiers for war, six and thirty thousand men: for they had many wives and sons.
bsb_text: In addition to them, according to their genealogy, they had 36,000 troops for battle, for they had many wives and children.
aov_text: En by hulle, volgens hulle afstamming, volgens hulle families, was die afdelings krygsmanne: ses-en-dertigduisend; want hulle het baie vroue en kinders gehad.

kjv_text: And their brethren among all the families of Issachar were valiant men of might, reckoned in all by their genealogies fourscore and seven thousand.
bsb_text: Their kinsmen belonging to all the families of Issachar who were mighty men of valor totaled 87,000, as listed in their genealogies.
aov_text: En hulle broers, van al die geslagte van Íssaskar, dapper helde: sewen-en-tagtigduisend tel hulle geslagsregister in sy geheel.

kjv_text: The sons of Benjamin; Bela, and Becher, and Jediael, three.
bsb_text: The three sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, and Jediael.
aov_text: BENJAMIN: Bela en Beger en Jedíael, drie.

kjv_text: And the sons of Bela; Ezbon, and Uzzi, and Uzziel, and Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of the house of their fathers, mighty men of valour; and were reckoned by their genealogies twenty and two thousand and thirty and four.
bsb_text: The sons of Bela: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri, heads of their families—five in all. There were 22,034 mighty men of valor listed in their genealogies.
aov_text: En die seuns van Bela was: Esbon en Ussi en Ússiël en Jérimot en Iri, vyf hoofde van families, dapper helde; en hulle geslagsregister het getel: twee-en-twintigduisend-vier-en-dertig.

kjv_text: And the sons of Becher; Zemira, and Joash, and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Omri, and Jerimoth, and Abiah, and Anathoth, and Alameth. All these are the sons of Becher.
bsb_text: The sons of Becher: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth; all these were Becher’s sons.
aov_text: En die seuns van Beger was: Semíra en Joas en Eliëser en Eljoënai en Omri en Jéremot en Abía en Ánatot en Alémet; hulle almal was seuns van Beger.

kjv_text: And the number of them, after their genealogy by their generations, heads of the house of their fathers, mighty men of valour, was twenty thousand and two hundred.
bsb_text: Their genealogies were recorded according to the heads of their families—20,200 mighty men of valor.
aov_text: En hulle geslagsregister het getel volgens hulle afstamming, hoofde van hulle families, dapper helde: twintigduisend-tweehonderd.

kjv_text: The sons also of Jediael; Bilhan: and the sons of Bilhan; Jeush, and Benjamin, and Ehud, and Chenaanah, and Zethan, and Tharshish, and Ahishahar.
bsb_text: The son of Jediael: Bilhan. The sons of Bilhan: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.
aov_text: En die seuns van Jedíael was Bilhan; en die seuns van Bilhan was: Jehus en Benjamin en Ehud en Kenáäna en Setan en Tarsis en Ahisáhar.

kjv_text: All these the sons of Jediael, by the heads of their fathers, mighty men of valour, were seventeen thousand and two hundred soldiers, fit to go out for war and battle.
bsb_text: All these sons of Jediael were heads of their families, mighty men of valor; there were 17,200 fit for battle.
aov_text: Hulle almal, seuns van Jedíael, volgens die hoofde van die families, dapper helde, was sewentienduisend-tweehonderd wat in die oorlog op kommando moes uittrek.

kjv_text: Shuppim also, and Huppim, the children of Ir, and Hushim, the sons of Aher.
bsb_text: The Shuppites and Huppites were descendants of Ir, and the Hushites were descendants of Aher.
aov_text: Ook Suppim en Huppim was seuns van Ir; Husim, seuns van Aher.

kjv_text: The sons of Naphtali; Jahziel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.
bsb_text: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, and Shallum—the descendants of Bilhah.
aov_text: Die seuns van Náftali was: Jágsiël en Guni en Jeser en Sallum, seuns van Bilha.

kjv_text: The sons of Manasseh; Ashriel, whom she bare: (but his concubine the Aramitess bare Machir the father of Gilead:
bsb_text: The descendants of Manasseh: Through his Aramean concubine, Asriel, as well as Machir the father of Gilead.
aov_text: DIE seuns van Manasse was Ásriël wat sy vrou gebaar het; sy Aramese byvrou het Magir gebaar, die vader van Gílead;

kjv_text: And Machir took to wife the sister of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister's name was Maachah;) and the name of the second was Zelophehad: and Zelophehad had daughters.
bsb_text: Machir took a wife from among the Huppites and Shuppites. The name of his sister was Maacah. Another descendant was named Zelophehad, who had only daughters.
aov_text: en Magir het van Huppim en Suppim ’n vrou geneem; die naam van sy suster was Máäga. En die naam van die tweede was Selófhad; en Selófhad het dogters gehad.

kjv_text: And Maachah the wife of Machir bare a son, and she called his name Peresh; and the name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.
bsb_text: Machir’s wife Maacah gave birth to a son, and she named him Peresh. His brother was named Sheresh, and his sons were Ulam and Rekem.
aov_text: En Máäga, die vrou van Magir, het ’n seun gebaar, en sy het hom Peres genoem; en die naam van sy broer was Seres, en sy seuns was Ulam en Rekem.

kjv_text: And the sons of Ulam; Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
bsb_text: The son of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
aov_text: En die seuns van Ulam was Bedan; dit is die seuns van Gílead, die seun van Magir, die seun van Manasse.

kjv_text: And his sister Hammoleketh bare Ishod, and Abiezer, and Mahalah.
bsb_text: His sister Hammolecheth gave birth to Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.
aov_text: En sy suster Moléket het Ishod en Abiëser en Magla gebaar.

kjv_text: And the sons of Shemidah were, Ahian, and Shechem, and Likhi, and Aniam.
bsb_text: And these were the sons of Shemida: Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.
aov_text: En die seuns van Semída was: Agjan en Segem en Likhi en Aníam.

kjv_text: And the sons of Ephraim; Shuthelah, and Bered his son, and Tahath his son, and Eladah his son, and Tahath his son,
bsb_text: The descendants of Ephraim: Shuthelah, Bered his son, Tahath his son, Eleadah his son, Tahath his son,
aov_text: EN die seuns van Efraim was Sútelag; en sy seun was Bered, en sy seun Tahat, en sy seun Eleáda, en sy seun Tahat,

kjv_text: And Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath that were born in that land slew, because they came down to take away their cattle.
bsb_text: Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son. Ezer and Elead were killed by the natives of Gath, because they went down to steal their livestock.
aov_text: en sy seun Sabad, en sy seun Sútelag en Eser en Élead; en die manne van Gat wat in die land gebore was, het hulle gedood, omdat húlle afgetrek het om hulle vee te neem.

kjv_text: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brethren came to comfort him.
bsb_text: Their father Ephraim mourned for many days, and his relatives came to comfort him.
aov_text: Daarom het hulle vader Efraim baie dae lank gerou, en sy broers het gekom om hom te troos.

kjv_text: And when he went in to his wife, she conceived, and bare a son, and he called his name Beriah, because it went evil with his house.
bsb_text: And again he slept with his wife, and she conceived and gave birth to a son. So he named him Beriah, because tragedy had come upon his house.
aov_text: Daarna het hy by sy vrou ingegaan, en sy het swanger geword en ’n seun gebaar; en hy het hom Bería genoem, omdat dit tydens ’n onheil in sy huis gebeur het.

kjv_text: (And his daughter was Sherah, who built Bethhoron the nether, and the upper, and Uzzensherah.)
bsb_text: His daughter was Sheerah, who built Lower and Upper Beth-horon, as well as Uzzen-sheerah.
aov_text: En sy dogter was Séëra; en sy het Bet-Horon-Onder en -Bo gebou, en Ussen-Séëra.

kjv_text: And Rephah was his son, also Resheph, and Telah his son, and Tahan his son,
bsb_text: Additionally, Rephah was his son, Resheph his son, Telah his son, Tahan his son,
aov_text: En sy seun was Refag, en Resef, en sy seun Telag, en sy seun Tahan;

kjv_text: Laadan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,
bsb_text: Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,
aov_text: sy seun Láedan; sy seun Ámmihud; sy seun Elisáma;

kjv_text: Non his son, Jehoshuah his son,
bsb_text: Nun his son, and Joshua his son.
aov_text: sy seun was Nun, sy seun Josua.

kjv_text: And their possessions and habitations were, Bethel and the towns thereof, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer, with the towns thereof; Shechem also and the towns thereof, unto Gaza and the towns thereof:
bsb_text: Their holdings and settlements included Bethel and its villages, Naaran to the east, Gezer and its villages to the west, and Shechem and its villages as far as Ayyah and its villages.
aov_text: En hulle besitting en hulle woonplekke was Bet-el met sy onderhorige plekke; en teen die ooste Náäran, en teen die weste Geser met sy onderhorige plekke; en Sigem met sy onderhorige plekke tot by Ajja met sy onderhorige plekke.

kjv_text: And by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Bethshean and her towns, Taanach and her towns, Megiddo and her towns, Dor and her towns. In these dwelt the children of Joseph the son of Israel.
bsb_text: And along the borders of Manasseh were Beth-shean, Taanach, Megiddo, and Dor, together with their villages. The descendants of Joseph son of Israel lived in these towns.
aov_text: En onder die bestuur van die seuns van Manasse was Bet-Séan met sy onderhorige plekke, Táänag met sy onderhorige plekke, Megíddo met sy onderhorige plekke, Dor met sy onderhorige plekke. Hierin het die seuns van Josef, die seun van Israel, gewoon.

kjv_text: The sons of Asher; Imnah, and Isuah, and Ishuai, and Beriah, and Serah their sister.
bsb_text: The children of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and their sister Serah.
aov_text: DIE seuns van Aser was: Jimma en Jiswa en Jiswi en Bería en Serag, hulle suster.

kjv_text: And the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel, who is the father of Birzavith.
bsb_text: The sons of Beriah: Heber, as well as Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.
aov_text: En die seuns van Bería was Heber en Málkiël; hy was die vader van Birsájit.

kjv_text: And Heber begat Japhlet, and Shomer, and Hotham, and Shua their sister.
bsb_text: Heber was the father of Japhlet, Shomer, and Hotham, and of their sister Shua.
aov_text: En Heber was die vader van Jaflet, en van Somer en Hotam en Sua, hulle suster.

kjv_text: And the sons of Japhlet; Pasach, and Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.
bsb_text: The sons of Japhlet: Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath. These were Japhlet’s sons.
aov_text: En die seuns van Jaflet was: Pasag en Bimhal en Aswat; dit was die seuns van Jaflet.

kjv_text: And the sons of Shamer; Ahi, and Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.
bsb_text: The sons of Shemer: Ahi, Rohgah, Hubbah, and Aram.
aov_text: En die seuns van Semer was: Ahi en Róhega, Jehúbba en Aram.

kjv_text: And the sons of his brother Helem; Zophah, and Imna, and Shelesh, and Amal.
bsb_text: The sons of his brother Helem: Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.
aov_text: En die seuns van sy broer Helem was: Sofag en Jimna en Seles en Amal.

kjv_text: The sons of Zophah; Suah, and Harnepher, and Shual, and Beri, and Imrah,
bsb_text: The sons of Zophah: Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,
aov_text: Die seuns van Sofag was: Suag en Harnéfer en Sual en Beri en Jimra,

kjv_text: Bezer, and Hod, and Shamma, and Shilshah, and Ithran, and Beera.
bsb_text: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.
aov_text: Beser en Hōd en Samma en Silsa en Jitran en Beëra.

kjv_text: And the sons of Jether; Jephunneh, and Pispah, and Ara.
bsb_text: The sons of Jether: Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.
aov_text: En die seuns van Jeter was: Jefúnne en Pispa en Ara.

kjv_text: And the sons of Ulla; Arah, and Haniel, and Rezia.
bsb_text: The sons of Ulla: Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.
aov_text: En die seuns van Ulla was: Arag en Hánniël en Risja.

kjv_text: All these were the children of Asher, heads of their father's house, choice and mighty men of valour, chief of the princes. And the number throughout the genealogy of them that were apt to the war and to battle was twenty and six thousand men.
bsb_text: All these were the descendants of Asher—heads of their families, choice and mighty men of valor, and chiefs among the leaders. The number of men fit for battle, recorded in their genealogies, was 26,000.
aov_text: Hulle almal was seuns van Aser, hoofde van families, uitgesoekte dapper helde, hoofde van die vorste; en hulle geslagsregister het betrekking gehad op diens in die oorlog; hulle aantal was ses-en-twintigduisend man.

kjv_text: Now Benjamin begat Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,
bsb_text: Benjamin was the father of Bela, his firstborn; Ashbel was the second born, Aharah the third,
aov_text: EN Benjamin was die vader van Bela, sy eersgeborene; die tweede, Asbel; en die derde, Agrag,

kjv_text: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
bsb_text: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
aov_text: die vierde, Noha; en die vyfde, Rafa.

kjv_text: And the sons of Bela were, Addar, and Gera, and Abihud,
bsb_text: The sons of Bela: Addar, Gera, Abihud,
aov_text: En Bela het seuns gehad: Addar en Gera en Abíhud

kjv_text: And Abishua, and Naaman, and Ahoah,
bsb_text: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,
aov_text: en Abisúa en Naäman en Ahóag

kjv_text: And Gera, and Shephuphan, and Huram.
bsb_text: Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.
aov_text: en Gera en Sefúfan en Huram.

kjv_text: And these are the sons of Ehud: these are the heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Geba, and they removed them to Manahath:
bsb_text: These were the descendants of Ehud who were the heads of the families living in Geba and were exiled to Manahath:
aov_text: En dit was die seuns van Ehud (hulle was hoofde van families van die inwoners van Geba, en hulle is in ballingskap na Manáhat weggevoer —

kjv_text: And Naaman, and Ahiah, and Gera, he removed them, and begat Uzza, and Ahihud.
bsb_text: Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera, who carried them into exile and who was the father of Uzza and Ahihud.
aov_text: Naäman en Ahía en Gera het hulle in ballingskap weggevoer); en hy was die vader van Ussa en van Ahíhud.

kjv_text: And Shaharaim begat children in the country of Moab, after he had sent them away; Hushim and Baara were his wives.
bsb_text: Shaharaim had sons in the country of Moab after he had divorced his wives Hushim and Baara.
aov_text: En Saharáim het in die veld van Moab, nadat hy sy vroue Husim en Báära verstoot het, die vader van kinders geword:

kjv_text: And he begat of Hodesh his wife, Jobab, and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcham,
bsb_text: His sons by his wife Hodesh: Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam,
aov_text: by sy vrou Hodes was hy die vader van Jobab en Sibja en Mesa en Malkam,

kjv_text: And Jeuz, and Shachia, and Mirma. These were his sons, heads of the fathers.
bsb_text: Jeuz, Sachia, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of families.
aov_text: en Jehus en Sagía en Mirma; dit was sy seuns, hoofde van families.

kjv_text: And of Hushim he begat Abitub, and Elpaal.
bsb_text: He also had sons by Hushim: Abitub and Elpaal.
aov_text: En by Husim was hy die vader van Abítub en Elpáäl.

kjv_text: The sons of Elpaal; Eber, and Misham, and Shamed, who built Ono, and Lod, with the towns thereof:
bsb_text: The sons of Elpaal: Eber, Misham, Shemed (who built Ono and Lod with its villages),
aov_text: En die seuns van Elpáäl was: Eber en Míseam en Semed; hy het Ono en Lod met sy onderhorige plekke gebou;

kjv_text: Beriah also, and Shema, who were heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who drove away the inhabitants of Gath:
bsb_text: and Beriah and Shema (who were the heads of families of the inhabitants of Aijalon and who drove out the inhabitants of Gath).
aov_text: en Bería en Sema; hulle was hoofde van families van die inwoners van Ájalon; hulle het die inwoners van Gat verjaag;

kjv_text: And Ahio, Shashak, and Jeremoth,
bsb_text: Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth,
aov_text: en Agjo, Sasak en Jerémot

kjv_text: And Zebadiah, and Arad, and Ader,
bsb_text: Zebadiah, Arad, Eder,
aov_text: en Sebádja en Arad en Eder

kjv_text: And Michael, and Ispah, and Joha, the sons of Beriah;
bsb_text: Michael, Ishpah, and Joha were the sons of Beriah.
aov_text: en Mígael en Jispa en Joha, die seuns van Bería;

kjv_text: And Zebadiah, and Meshullam, and Hezeki, and Heber,
bsb_text: Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber,
aov_text: en Sebádja en Mesúllam en Hiski en Heber

kjv_text: Ishmerai also, and Jezliah, and Jobab, the sons of Elpaal;
bsb_text: Ishmerai, Izliah, and Jobab were the sons of Elpaal.
aov_text: en Jísmerai en Jislía en Jobab, die seuns van Elpáäl;

kjv_text: And Jakim, and Zichri, and Zabdi,
bsb_text: Jakim, Zichri, Zabdi,
aov_text: en Jakim en Sigri en Sabdi

kjv_text: And Elienai, and Zilthai, and Eliel,
bsb_text: Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel,
aov_text: en Eliënai en Sílletai en Éliël

kjv_text: And Adaiah, and Beraiah, and Shimrath, the sons of Shimhi;
bsb_text: Adaiah, Beraiah, and Shimrath were the sons of Shimei.
aov_text: en Adája en Berája en Simrat, die seuns van Símeï;

kjv_text: And Ishpan, and Heber, and Eliel,
bsb_text: Ishpan, Eber, Eliel,
aov_text: en Jispan en Eber en Éliël

kjv_text: And Abdon, and Zichri, and Hanan,
bsb_text: Abdon, Zichri, Hanan,
aov_text: en Abdon en Sigri en Hanan

kjv_text: And Hananiah, and Elam, and Antothijah,
bsb_text: Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah,
aov_text: en Hanánja en Elam en Antotía

kjv_text: And Iphedeiah, and Penuel, the sons of Shashak;
bsb_text: Iphdeiah, and Penuel were the sons of Shashak.
aov_text: en Jifdéja en Pnúel, die seuns van Sasak;

kjv_text: And Shamsherai, and Shehariah, and Athaliah,
bsb_text: Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah,
aov_text: en Sámserai en Sehárja en Atálja

kjv_text: And Jaresiah, and Eliah, and Zichri, the sons of Jeroham.
bsb_text: Jaareshiah, Elijah, and Zichri were the sons of Jeroham.
aov_text: en Jaärésja en Elía en Sigri, die seuns van Jeróham.

kjv_text: These were heads of the fathers, by their generations, chief men. These dwelt in Jerusalem.
bsb_text: All these were heads of families, the chiefs according to their genealogies, and they lived in Jerusalem.
aov_text: Hulle was hoofde van families, volgens hulle afstamming, hoofde; hulle het in Jerusalem gewoon.

kjv_text: And at Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon; whose wife's name was Maachah:
bsb_text: Jeiel the father of Gibeon lived in Gibeon. His wife’s name was Maacah,
aov_text: En in Gíbeon het die vader van Gíbeon gewoon, en die naam van sy vrou was Máäga.

kjv_text: And his firstborn son Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Nadab,
bsb_text: and Abdon was his firstborn son, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab,
aov_text: En sy eersgebore seun was Abdon, verder Sur en Kis en Baäl en Nadab

kjv_text: And Gedor, and Ahio, and Zacher.
bsb_text: Gedor, Ahio, Zecher,
aov_text: en Gedor en Agjo en Seger.

kjv_text: And Mikloth begat Shimeah. And these also dwelt with their brethren in Jerusalem, over against them.
bsb_text: and Mikloth, who was the father of Shimeah. These also lived alongside their relatives in Jerusalem.
aov_text: En Miklot was die vader van Símea; en hulle het ook teenoor hulle broers in Jerusalem saam met hulle broers gewoon.

kjv_text: And Ner begat Kish, and Kish begat Saul, and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchishua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
bsb_text: Ner was the father of Kish, Kish was the father of Saul, and Saul was the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Esh-baal.
aov_text: En Ner was die vader van Kis, en Kis van Saul, en Saul van Jónatan en Malkisúa en Abinádab en Esbáäl.

kjv_text: And the son of Jonathan was Meribbaal; and Meribbaal begat Micah.
bsb_text: The son of Jonathan: Merib-baal, and Merib-baal was the father of Micah.
aov_text: En die seun van Jónatan was Merib-baäl, en Merib-baäl was die vader van Miga.

kjv_text: And the sons of Micah were, Pithon, and Melech, and Tarea, and Ahaz.
bsb_text: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.
aov_text: En die seuns van Miga was: Piton en Meleg en Taäréa en Agas.

kjv_text: And Ahaz begat Jehoadah; and Jehoadah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza,
bsb_text: Ahaz was the father of Jehoaddah, Jehoaddah was the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri, and Zimri was the father of Moza.
aov_text: En Agas was die vader van Jehóadda, en Jehóadda van Alémet en Asmáwet en Simri; en Simri was die vader van Mosa.

kjv_text: And Moza begat Binea: Rapha was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son:
bsb_text: Moza was the father of Binea. Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.
aov_text: En Mosa was die vader van Bínea; sý seun was Rafa; sý seun was Eleása; sý seun was Asel.

kjv_text: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.
bsb_text: Azel had six sons, and these were their names: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.
aov_text: En Asel het ses seuns gehad; en dít was hulle name: Asríkam, Bogru en Ísmael en Seárja en Obádja en Hanan; hulle almal was seuns van Asel.

kjv_text: And the sons of Eshek his brother were, Ulam his firstborn, Jehush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
bsb_text: The sons of his brother Eshek: Ulam was his firstborn, Jeush second, and Eliphelet third.
aov_text: En die seuns van Esek, sy broer, was: Ulam, sy eersgeborene, Jehus, die tweede, en Elifélet, die derde.

kjv_text: And the sons of Ulam were mighty men of valour, archers, and had many sons, and sons' sons, an hundred and fifty. All these are of the sons of Benjamin.
bsb_text: The sons of Ulam were mighty men of valor, archers, and they had many sons and grandsons—150 in all. All these were the descendants of Benjamin.
aov_text: En die seuns van Ulam was manne, dapper helde wat die boog gespan het, en hulle het baie kinders en kindskinders gehad, honderd-en-vyftig. Hulle was almal uit die seuns van Benjamin.

kjv_text: So all Israel were reckoned by genealogies; and, behold, they were written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah, who were carried away to Babylon for their transgression.
bsb_text: So all Israel was recorded in the genealogies written in the Book of the Kings of Israel. But Judah was exiled to Babylon because of their unfaithfulness.
aov_text: EN die hele Israel is in geslagsregisters opgeneem, en kyk, hulle is opgeskrywe in die boek van die konings van Israel. En die mense van Juda is in ballingskap na Babel weggevoer vanweë hulle ontrou.

kjv_text: Now the first inhabitants that dwelt in their possessions in their cities were, the Israelites, the priests, Levites, and the Nethinims.
bsb_text: Now the first to resettle their own property in their cities were Israelites, priests, Levites, and temple servants.
aov_text: En die wat vroeër in hulle besitting, in hulle stede gaan woon het, was: Israeliete, die priesters, die Leviete en die tempelbediendes.

kjv_text: And in Jerusalem dwelt of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim, and Manasseh;
bsb_text: These were some of the descendants of Judah, Benjamin, Ephraim, and Manasseh who lived in Jerusalem:
aov_text: En in Jerusalem het gewoon van die seuns van Juda en van die seuns van Benjamin en van die seuns van Efraim en Manasse:

kjv_text: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Pharez the son of Judah.
bsb_text: Uthai son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, a descendant of Perez son of Judah.
aov_text: Útai, die seun van Ammíhud, die seun van Omri, die seun van Imri, die seun van Bani, van die seuns van Peres, die seun van Juda;

kjv_text: And of the Shilonites; Asaiah the firstborn, and his sons.
bsb_text: From the Shilonites: Asaiah the firstborn and his sons.
aov_text: en van die Siloniete: Asája, die eersgeborene, en sy seuns;

kjv_text: And of the sons of Zerah; Jeuel, and their brethren, six hundred and ninety.
bsb_text: From the Zerahites: Jeuel and 690 relatives.
aov_text: en van die seuns van Serag: Jehúel en hulle broers, seshonderd-en-negentig;

kjv_text: And of the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hasenuah,
bsb_text: From the Benjamites: Sallu son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah;
aov_text: en van die seuns van Benjamin: Sallu, die seun van Mesúllam, die seun van Hodáwja, die seun van Hassenúa,

kjv_text: And Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri, and Meshullam the son of Shephathiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;
bsb_text: Ibneiah son of Jeroham; Elah son of Uzzi, the son of Michri; Meshullam son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;
aov_text: en Jíbneja, die seun van Jeróham, en Ela, die seun van Ussi, die seun van Migri, en Mesúllam, die seun van Sefátja, die seun van Rehúel, die seun van Jíbneja;

kjv_text: And their brethren, according to their generations, nine hundred and fifty and six. All these men were chief of the fathers in the house of their fathers.
bsb_text: and 956 of their relatives according to their genealogy. All these men were heads of their families.
aov_text: en hulle broers volgens hulle afstamming, negehonderd-ses-en-vyftig; al hierdie manne was familiehoofde van hulle families;

kjv_text: And of the priests; Jedaiah, and Jehoiarib, and Jachin,
bsb_text: From the priests: Jedaiah, Jehoiarib, and Jachin;
aov_text: en van die priesters: Jedája en Jójarib en Jagin,

kjv_text: And Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of God;
bsb_text: Azariah son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the chief official of God’s temple;
aov_text: en Asárja, die seun van Hilkía, die seun van Mesúllam, die seun van Sadok, die seun van Mérajot, die seun van Ahítub, die vors oor die huis van God;

kjv_text: And Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchijah, and Maasiai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;
bsb_text: Adaiah son of Jeroham, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah; Maasai son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;
aov_text: en Adája, die seun van Jeróham, die seun van Pasgur, die seun van Malkía, en Máesai, die seun van Ádiël, die seun van Jagséra, die seun van Mesúllam, die seun van Mesíllemit, die seun van Immer;

kjv_text: And their brethren, heads of the house of their fathers, a thousand and seven hundred and threescore; very able men for the work of the service of the house of God.
bsb_text: and 1,760 of their relatives, the heads of their families, able men for the work of the service of the house of God.
aov_text: en hulle broers, hoofde van hulle families, sewentienhonderd-en-sestig, dapper manne in die dienswerk van die huis van God;

kjv_text: And of the Levites; Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;
bsb_text: From the Levites: Shemaiah son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, a descendant of Merari;
aov_text: en van die Leviete: Semája, die seun van Hassub, die seun van Asríkam, die seun van Hasábja, van die seuns van Merári;

kjv_text: And Bakbakkar, Heresh, and Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Micah, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph;
bsb_text: Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal, and Mattaniah son of Mica, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph;
aov_text: en Bákbakkar, Heres en Galal en Máttanja, die seun van Miga, die seun van Sigri, die seun van Asaf;

kjv_text: And Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun, and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, that dwelt in the villages of the Netophathites.
bsb_text: Obadiah son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun; and Berechiah son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites.
aov_text: en Obádja, die seun van Semája, die seun van Galal, die seun van Jedútun; en Berégja, die seun van Asa, die seun van Élkana wat in die dorpe van die Netofatiete gewoon het.

kjv_text: And the porters were, Shallum, and Akkub, and Talmon, and Ahiman, and their brethren: Shallum was the chief;
bsb_text: These were the gatekeepers: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their relatives. Shallum was their chief;
aov_text: En die poortwagters was: Sallum en Akkub en Talmon en Ahíman en hulle broers; Sallum was die hoof,

kjv_text: Who hitherto waited in the king's gate eastward: they were porters in the companies of the children of Levi.
bsb_text: he was previously stationed at the King’s Gate on the east side. These were the gatekeepers from the camp of the Levites.
aov_text: en tot nou toe is hy in die koningspoort teen die ooste; hulle was die poortwagters van die laers van die seuns van Levi.

kjv_text: And Shallum the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brethren, of the house of his father, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the gates of the tabernacle: and their fathers, being over the host of the LORD, were keepers of the entry.
bsb_text: Shallum son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his relatives from the Korahites were assigned to guard the thresholds of the Tent, just as their fathers had been assigned to guard the entrance to the dwelling of the LORD.
aov_text: En Sallum, die seun van Korē, die seun van Ébjasaf, die seun van Korag, en sy broers uit sy familie, die Koragiete, was oor die dienswerk, as drumpelwagters van die tent, omdat hulle vaders by die laer van die HERE die ingang bewaak het.

kjv_text: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar was the ruler over them in time past, and the LORD was with him.
bsb_text: In earlier times Phinehas son of Eleazar had been in charge of the gatekeepers, and the LORD was with him.
aov_text: En Pínehas, die seun van Eleásar, was vroeër bevelhebber oor hulle. Mag die HERE met hom wees!

kjv_text: And Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was porter of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
bsb_text: Zechariah son of Meshelemiah was the gatekeeper at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
aov_text: Sagaría, die seun van Meselémja, was poortwagter by die ingang van die tent van samekoms.

kjv_text: All these which were chosen to be porters in the gates were two hundred and twelve. These were reckoned by their genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer did ordain in their set office.
bsb_text: The number of those chosen to be gatekeepers at the thresholds was 212. They were registered by genealogy in their villages. David and Samuel the seer had appointed them to their positions of trust.
aov_text: Hulle almal wat as drumpelwagters uitgesoek was, was tweehonderd-en-twaalf; hulle is in hul dorpe in die geslagsregister opgeneem. Dawid en die siener Samuel het hulle in hul ampsplig bevestig.

kjv_text: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of the house of the LORD, namely, the house of the tabernacle, by wards.
bsb_text: So they and their descendants were assigned to guard the gates of the house of the LORD—the house called the Tent.
aov_text: En hulle met hul seuns was aangestel oor die poorte van die huis van die HERE, van die tenthuis, om wag te hou.

kjv_text: In four quarters were the porters, toward the east, west, north, and south.
bsb_text: The gatekeepers were stationed on the four sides: east, west, north, and south.
aov_text: Die poortwagters moes aan die vier windstreke wees, na die ooste, weste, noorde en suide toe.

kjv_text: And their brethren, which were in their villages, were to come after seven days from time to time with them.
bsb_text: Their relatives came from their villages at fixed times to serve with them for seven-day periods.
aov_text: En hulle broers, in hulle dorpe, moes van tyd tot tyd vir sewe dae saam met hulle inkom.

kjv_text: For these Levites, the four chief porters, were in their set office, and were over the chambers and treasuries of the house of God.
bsb_text: But the four chief gatekeepers, who were Levites, were entrusted with the rooms and the treasuries of the house of God.
aov_text: Want in die ampsplig het hulle, die vier owerstes van die deurwagters, gestaan. Van die Leviete was oor die kamers en oor die skatte van die huis van God.

kjv_text: And they lodged round about the house of God, because the charge was upon them, and the opening thereof every morning pertained to them.
bsb_text: They would spend the night stationed around the house of God, because they were responsible for guarding it and opening it every morning.
aov_text: En hulle moes in die nag rondom die huis van God bly, want hulle het die wag gehad en moes elke môre oopsluit.

kjv_text: And certain of them had the charge of the ministering vessels, that they should bring them in and out by tale.
bsb_text: Some of them were in charge of the articles used in worship, to count them whenever they were brought in or taken out.
aov_text: En sommige van hulle was aangestel oor die gereedskap van die diens; want hulle moes dit voltallig inbring en voltallig uitbring.

kjv_text: Some of them also were appointed to oversee the vessels, and all the instruments of the sanctuary, and the fine flour, and the wine, and the oil, and the frankincense, and the spices.
bsb_text: Others were put in charge of the furnishings and other articles of the sanctuary, as well as the fine flour, wine, oil, frankincense, and spices.
aov_text: En sommige van hulle was aangestel oor die gereedskappe en oor al die heilige voorwerpe en oor die fynmeel en die wyn en die olie en die wierook en die speserye.

kjv_text: And some of the sons of the priests made the ointment of the spices.
bsb_text: And some of the sons of the priests mixed the spices.
aov_text: En van die seuns van die priesters was daar mengers van salf uit speserye.

kjv_text: And Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the set office over the things that were made in the pans.
bsb_text: A Levite named Mattithiah, the firstborn son of Shallum the Korahite, was entrusted with baking the bread.
aov_text: En Mattítja, uit die Leviete, wat die eersgeborene van die Koragiet Sallum was, het amptelik die toesig oor die bakwerk gehad.

kjv_text: And other of their brethren, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the shewbread, to prepare it every sabbath.
bsb_text: Some of their Kohathite brothers were responsible for preparing the rows of the showbread every Sabbath.
aov_text: En van die kinders van die Kehatiete, van hulle broers, moes sorg vir die toonbrode om dit elke sabbat klaar te maak.

kjv_text: And these are the singers, chief of the fathers of the Levites, who remaining in the chambers were free: for they were employed in that work day and night.
bsb_text: Those who were musicians, the heads of Levite families, stayed in the temple chambers and were exempt from other duties because they were on duty day and night.
aov_text: En dit was die sangers, hoofde van families van die Leviete, in die kamers, vry van ander diens; want hulle was dag en nag in hul dienswerk besig.

kjv_text: These chief fathers of the Levites were chief throughout their generations; these dwelt at Jerusalem.
bsb_text: All these were heads of Levite families, chiefs according to their genealogies, and they lived in Jerusalem.
aov_text: Dit was die hoofde van families van die Leviete, hoofde volgens hulle afstamming; hulle het in Jerusalem gewoon.

kjv_text: And in Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon, Jehiel, whose wife's name was Maachah,
bsb_text: Jeiel the father of Gibeon lived in Gibeon. His wife’s name was Maacah.
aov_text: En in Gíbeon het die vader van Gíbeon, Jeï-el, gewoon; en die naam van sy vrou was Máäga.

kjv_text: And his firstborn son Abdon, then Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Ner, and Nadab,
bsb_text: Abdon was his firstborn son, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
aov_text: En Abdon was sy eersgebore seun, dan Sur en Kis en Baäl en Ner en Nadab

kjv_text: And Gedor, and Ahio, and Zechariah, and Mikloth.
bsb_text: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth.
aov_text: en Gedor en Agjo en Sagaría en Miklot.

kjv_text: And Mikloth begat Shimeam. And they also dwelt with their brethren at Jerusalem, over against their brethren.
bsb_text: Mikloth was the father of Shimeam. They too lived alongside their relatives in Jerusalem.
aov_text: En Miklot was die vader van Símeam; en hulle het ook teenoor hulle broers in Jerusalem saam met hulle broers gewoon.

kjv_text: And Ner begat Kish; and Kish begat Saul; and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchishua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
bsb_text: Ner was the father of Kish, Kish was the father of Saul, and Saul was the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Esh-baal.
aov_text: En Ner was die vader van Kis, en Kis van Saul, en Saul van Jónatan en Malkisúa en Abinádab en Ésbaäl.

kjv_text: And the son of Jonathan was Meribbaal: and Meribbaal begat Micah.
bsb_text: The son of Jonathan: Merib-baal, who was the father of Micah.
aov_text: En die seun van Jónatan was Merib-baäl, en Merib-baäl was die vader van Miga.

kjv_text: And the sons of Micah were, Pithon, and Melech, and Tahrea, and Ahaz.
bsb_text: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz.
aov_text: En die seuns van Miga was: Piton en Meleg en Tagréa.

kjv_text: And Ahaz begat Jarah; and Jarah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza;
bsb_text: Ahaz was the father of Jarah; Jarah was the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri was the father of Moza.
aov_text: En Agas was die vader van Jaëra, en Jaëra van Alémet en Asmáwet en Simri; en Simri was die vader van Mosa;

kjv_text: And Moza begat Binea; and Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.
bsb_text: Moza was the father of Binea. Rephaiah was his son, Elasah his son, and Azel his son.
aov_text: en Mosa was die vader van Bínea; en sý seun was Refája, sý seun Eleása, sý seun Asel.

kjv_text: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan: these were the sons of Azel.
bsb_text: And Azel had six sons, and these were their names: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. These were the sons of Azel.
aov_text: En Asel het ses seuns gehad, en dít is hulle name: Asríkam, Bogru en Ísmael en Seárja en Obádja en Hanan; dit was die seuns van Asel.

kjv_text: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gilboa.
bsb_text: Now the Philistines fought against Israel, and the men of Israel fled before them, and many fell slain on Mount Gilboa.
aov_text: EN die Filistyne het teen Israel geveg, en die manne van Israel het vir die Filistyne weggevlug, en gesneuweldes het op die gebergte Gilbóa gelê.

kjv_text: And the Philistines followed hard after Saul, and after his sons; and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.
bsb_text: The Philistines followed hard after Saul and his sons, and they killed Saul’s sons Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua.
aov_text: En die Filistyne het Saul en sy seuns agternagesit, en die Filistyne het Jónatan en Abinádab en Malkisúa, die seuns van Saul, gedood.

kjv_text: And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers hit him, and he was wounded of the archers.
bsb_text: When the battle intensified against Saul, the archers overtook him and wounded him.
aov_text: En toe die geveg swaar word teen Saul en die boogskutters hom aantref, het hy gebewe van angs vir die skutters.

kjv_text: Then said Saul to his armourbearer, Draw thy sword, and thrust me through therewith; lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me. But his armourbearer would not; for he was sore afraid. So Saul took a sword, and fell upon it.
bsb_text: Then Saul said to his armor-bearer, “Draw your sword and run it through me, or these uncircumcised men will come and torture me!” But his armor-bearer was terrified and refused to do it. So Saul took his own sword and fell on it.
aov_text: En Saul het aan sy wapendraer gesê: Trek jou swaard uit en deurboor my daarmee; anders kom hierdie onbesnedenes en dryf die spot met my. Maar sy wapendraer wou nie, omdat hy baie bevrees was. Daarop neem Saul die swaard en val daarin.

kjv_text: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead, he fell likewise on the sword, and died.
bsb_text: When his armor-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he too fell on his own sword and died.
aov_text: Toe sy wapendraer sien dat Saul dood was, val hy self ook in die swaard, sodat hy gesterf het.

kjv_text: So Saul died, and his three sons, and all his house died together.
bsb_text: So Saul died together with his three sons and all his house.
aov_text: So het Saul en sy drie seuns dan gesterwe; en sy hele huis, almal saam, het gesterwe.

kjv_text: And when all the men of Israel that were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, then they forsook their cities, and fled: and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.
bsb_text: When all the Israelites in the valley saw that the army had fled and that Saul and his sons had died, they abandoned their cities and ran away. So the Philistines came and occupied their cities.
aov_text: Toe al die manne van Israel wat in die vlakte was, sien dat hulle gevlug het, en dat Saul en sy seuns dood was, het hulle hul stede verlaat en gevlug; en die Filistyne het gekom en daarin gaan woon.

kjv_text: And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his sons fallen in mount Gilboa.
bsb_text: The next day, when the Philistines came to strip the dead, they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.
aov_text: En toe die Filistyne die volgende dag kom om die gesneuweldes te plunder, vind hulle Saul en sy seuns nog daar lê op die gebergte Gilbóa.

kjv_text: And when they had stripped him, they took his head, and his armour, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to carry tidings unto their idols, and to the people.
bsb_text: They stripped Saul, cut off his head, took his armor, and sent messengers throughout the land of the Philistines to proclaim the news in the temple of their idols and among their people.
aov_text: En hulle het hom uitgetrek en sy hoof en sy wapens saamgeneem en dit in die land van die Filistyne rondgestuur om die blye boodskap vir hulle afgode en vir die volk te bring.

kjv_text: And they put his armour in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the temple of Dagon.
bsb_text: They put his armor in the temple of their gods and hung his head in the temple of Dagon.
aov_text: Daarna het hulle sy wapens in die huis van hulle god neergelê en sy hoofskedel in die huis van Dagon vasgeslaan.

kjv_text: And when all Jabeshgilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,
bsb_text: When the people of Jabesh-gilead heard about everything the Philistines had done to Saul,
aov_text: Toe die hele Jabes in Gílead hoor alles wat die Filistyne aan Saul gedoen het,

kjv_text: They arose, all the valiant men, and took away the body of Saul, and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
bsb_text: all their men of valor set out and retrieved the bodies of Saul and his sons and brought them to Jabesh. And they buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh and fasted seven days.
aov_text: het al die dapper manne hulle gereedgemaak en die lyk van Saul en die lyke van sy seuns saamgeneem en dit na Jabes gebring en hulle bene begrawe onder die terpentynboom in Jabes, en sewe dae lank gevas.

kjv_text: So Saul died for his transgression which he committed against the LORD, even against the word of the LORD, which he kept not, and also for asking counsel of one that had a familiar spirit, to enquire of it;
bsb_text: So Saul died for his unfaithfulness to the LORD, because he did not keep the word of the LORD and even consulted a medium for guidance,
aov_text: En Saul het gesterwe weens ontrou wat hy teen die HERE begaan het, weens die woord van die HERE wat hy nie gehou het nie; en ook omdat hy die gees van ’n afgestorwene om inligting gevra het,

kjv_text: And enquired not of the LORD: therefore he slew him, and turned the kingdom unto David the son of Jesse.
bsb_text: and he failed to inquire of the LORD. So the LORD put him to death and turned the kingdom over to David son of Jesse.
aov_text: maar die HERE nie geraadpleeg het nie. Daarom het Hy hom omgebring en die koningskap laat oorgaan op Dawid, die seun van Ísai.

kjv_text: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David unto Hebron, saying, Behold, we are thy bone and thy flesh.
bsb_text: Then all Israel came together to David at Hebron and said, “Here we are, your own flesh and blood.
aov_text: TOE kom die hele Israel by Dawid in Hebron bymekaar en sê: Kyk, ons is u been en u vlees.

kjv_text: And moreover in time past, even when Saul was king, thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and the LORD thy God said unto thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be ruler over my people Israel.
bsb_text: Even in times past, while Saul was king, you were the one who led Israel out and brought them back. And the LORD your God said, ‘You will shepherd My people Israel, and you will be ruler over them.’”
aov_text: Gister sowel as eergister, selfs toe Saul koning was, het u Israel uit- en ingelei; en die HERE u God het aan u gesê: Jý moet my volk Israel oppas, en jý moet ’n vors wees oor my volk Israel.

kjv_text: Therefore came all the elders of Israel to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD; and they anointed David king over Israel, according to the word of the LORD by Samuel.
bsb_text: So all the elders of Israel came to the king at Hebron, where David made a covenant with them before the LORD. And they anointed him king over Israel, according to the word of the LORD through Samuel.
aov_text: So het dan al die oudstes van Israel na die koning in Hebron gekom, en Dawid het met hulle ’n verbond gesluit in Hebron voor die aangesig van die HERE, en hulle het Dawid as koning oor Israel gesalf volgens die woord van die HERE deur die diens van Samuel.

kjv_text: And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, which is Jebus; where the Jebusites were, the inhabitants of the land.
bsb_text: Then David and all the Israelites marched to Jerusalem (that is, Jebus), where the Jebusites inhabited the land.
aov_text: En Dawid en die hele Israel het getrek na Jerusalem, dit is Jebus; en daar was die Jebusiete die bewoners van die land.

kjv_text: And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David, Thou shalt not come hither. Nevertheless David took the castle of Zion, which is the city of David.
bsb_text: The people of Jebus said to David, “You will never get in here.” Nevertheless, David captured the fortress of Zion (that is, the City of David).
aov_text: En die inwoners van Jebus het vir Dawid gesê: Jy sal hier nie inkom nie. Maar Dawid het die bergvesting Sion ingeneem, dit is die stad van Dawid.

kjv_text: And David said, Whosoever smiteth the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain. So Joab the son of Zeruiah went first up, and was chief.
bsb_text: Now David had said, “Whoever is the first to strike down a Jebusite will become chief commander.” And Joab son of Zeruiah went up first, and he became the chief.
aov_text: En Dawid het gesê: Elkeen wat eerste die Jebusiet verslaan, sal ’n hoof en ’n owerste word. Toe het Joab, die seun van Serúja, die eerste opgeklim en ’n hoof geword.

kjv_text: And David dwelt in the castle; therefore they called it the city of David.
bsb_text: So David took up residence in the fortress; that is why it was called the City of David.
aov_text: En Dawid het in die bergvesting gaan woon; daarom noem hulle dit die stad van Dawid.

kjv_text: And he built the city round about, even from Millo round about: and Joab repaired the rest of the city.
bsb_text: He built up the city around it, from the supporting terraces to the surrounding wall, while Joab restored the rest of the city.
aov_text: En hy het die stad rondom opgebou van Millo af tot by die omtrek; en Joab het die orige deel van die stad herstel.

kjv_text: So David waxed greater and greater: for the LORD of hosts was with him.
bsb_text: And David became greater and greater, for the LORD of Hosts was with him.
aov_text: En Dawid het gedurigdeur groter geword, en die HERE van die leërskare was met hom.

kjv_text: These also are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who strengthened themselves with him in his kingdom, and with all Israel, to make him king, according to the word of the LORD concerning Israel.
bsb_text: Now these were the chiefs of David’s mighty men, who, together with all Israel, bolstered and strengthened his kingdom, according to the word of the LORD concerning Israel.
aov_text: EN dít was die hoofde van die helde van Dawid wat hom kragtig bygestaan het in sy koningskap saam met die hele Israel om hom volgens die woord van die HERE koning te maak oor Israel.

kjv_text: And this is the number of the mighty men whom David had; Jashobeam, an Hachmonite, the chief of the captains: he lifted up his spear against three hundred slain by him at one time.
bsb_text: This is the list of David’s mighty men: Jashobeam son of Hachmoni was chief of the officers; he wielded his spear against three hundred men, whom he killed at one time.
aov_text: En dít is die getal van die helde van Dawid: Jasóbeam, die seun van Hagmóni, die hoof van die dertig; hy het sy spies geswaai oor driehonderd wat op een keer gesneuwel het.

kjv_text: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighties.
bsb_text: Next in command was Eleazar son of Dodo the Ahohite, one of the three mighty men.
aov_text: En ná hom was Eleásar, die seun van Dodo, die Ahohiet; hy was onder die drie helde.

kjv_text: He was with David at Pasdammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where was a parcel of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.
bsb_text: He was with David at Pas-dammim when the Philistines gathered there for battle. At the place with a field full of barley, the troops fled from the Philistines.
aov_text: Hy was saam met Dawid by Pas-Dámmim toe die Filistyne daar bymekaar was om te veg; en daar was ’n stuk land vol gars, en die volk het vir die Filistyne gevlug.

kjv_text: And they set themselves in the midst of that parcel, and delivered it, and slew the Philistines; and the LORD saved them by a great deliverance.
bsb_text: But Eleazar and David stationed themselves in the middle of the field and defended it. They struck down the Philistines, and the LORD brought about a great victory.
aov_text: Maar hy het hom in die middel van die stuk land opgestel en dit afgeneem en die Filistyne verslaan, sodat die HERE ’n groot oorwinning bewerk het.

kjv_text: Now three of the thirty captains went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the host of the Philistines encamped in the valley of Rephaim.
bsb_text: Three of the thirty chief men went down to David, to the rock at the cave of Adullam, while a company of Philistines was encamped in the Valley of Rephaim.
aov_text: En drie van die dertig hoofde het afgetrek na die rots, na Dawid, na die spelonk van Adúllam terwyl die laer van die Filistyne in die dal Refáim gestaan het.

kjv_text: And David was then in the hold, and the Philistines' garrison was then at Bethlehem.
bsb_text: At that time David was in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was at Bethlehem.
aov_text: En Dawid was toe in die bergvesting; en ’n besetting van die Filistyne was toe in Betlehem.

kjv_text: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Bethlehem, that is at the gate!
bsb_text: David longed for water and said, “Oh, that someone would get me a drink of water from the well near the gate of Bethlehem!”
aov_text: En Dawid het ’n begeerte voel opkom en gesê: Wie sal vir my water gee om te drink uit die put van Betlehem wat by die poort is?

kjv_text: And the three brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David: but David would not drink of it, but poured it out to the LORD,
bsb_text: So the Three broke through the Philistine camp, drew water from the well at the gate of Bethlehem, and brought it back to David. But he refused to drink it; instead, he poured it out to the LORD,
aov_text: Toe het die drie deur die laer van die Filistyne gebreek en water geskep uit die put van Betlehem wat by die poort was, en dit gedra en na Dawid gebring; maar Dawid wou dit nie drink nie en het dit voor die HERE uitgegiet

kjv_text: And said, My God forbid it me, that I should do this thing: shall I drink the blood of these men that have put their lives in jeopardy? for with the jeopardy of their lives they brought it. Therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mightiest.
bsb_text: saying, “Far be it from me, my God, to do this! How can I drink the blood of these men who risked their lives?” Because they had brought it at the risk of their lives, David refused to drink it. Such were the exploits of the three mighty men.
aov_text: en gesê: Mag my God my bewaar, dat ek dit sou doen! Sou ek die bloed van hierdie manne drink? Met lewensgevaar, ja, met lewensgevaar het hulle dit gebring! En hy wou dit nie drink nie. Dit het die drie helde gedoen.

kjv_text: And Abishai the brother of Joab, he was chief of the three: for lifting up his spear against three hundred, he slew them, and had a name among the three.
bsb_text: Now Abishai, the brother of Joab, was chief of the Three, and he lifted his spear against three hundred men, killed them, and won a name along with the Three.
aov_text: En Abísai, die broer van Joab, hy was hoof van die drie, en hy het sy spies geswaai oor driehonderd wat gesneuwel het, en ’n naam gehad onder die drie.

kjv_text: Of the three, he was more honourable than the two; for he was their captain: howbeit he attained not to the first three.
bsb_text: He was doubly honored above the Three, and he became their commander, even though he was not included among the Three.
aov_text: Uit die drie was hy onder die ander twee geëerd, sodat hy hulle owerste geword het; maar tot by die eerste drie het hy nie gekom nie.

kjv_text: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done many acts; he slew two lionlike men of Moab: also he went down and slew a lion in a pit in a snowy day.
bsb_text: And Benaiah son of Jehoiada was a man of valor from Kabzeel, a man of many exploits. He struck down two champions of Moab, and on a snowy day he went down into a pit and killed a lion.
aov_text: Benája, die seun van Jójada, ’n dapper man, groot van daad, uit Kábseël; hy het die twee groot helde van Moab verslaan; en hy het afgegaan en ’n leeu binne-in ’n kuil doodgeslaan op ’n sneeudag.

kjv_text: And he slew an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits high; and in the Egyptian's hand was a spear like a weaver's beam; and he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian's hand, and slew him with his own spear.
bsb_text: He also killed an Egyptian, a huge man five cubits tall. Although the Egyptian had a spear like a weaver’s beam in his hand, Benaiah went against him with a club, snatched the spear from his hand, and killed the Egyptian with his own spear.
aov_text: Hy het ook ’n Egiptenaar verslaan, ’n groot man, vyf el; en in die hand van die Egiptenaar was ’n spies soos ’n wewersbalk; maar hy het na hom afgegaan met ’n stok en die spies uit die hand van die Egiptenaar geruk en hom met sy eie spies doodgesteek.

kjv_text: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among the three mighties.
bsb_text: These were the exploits of Benaiah son of Jehoiada, who won a name alongside the three mighty men.
aov_text: Dit het Benája, die seun van Jójada, gedoen; en hy het ’n naam gehad onder die drie helde.

kjv_text: Behold, he was honourable among the thirty, but attained not to the first three: and David set him over his guard.
bsb_text: He was most honored among the Thirty, but he did not become one of the Three. And David appointed him over his guard.
aov_text: Hy was wel meer geëerd as die dertig, maar tot by die drie het hy nie gekom nie; en Dawid het hom aangestel oor sy lyfwag.

kjv_text: Also the valiant men of the armies were, Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
bsb_text: Now these were the mighty men: Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
aov_text: En die dapper helde was: Ásahel, die broer van Joab, Élhanan, die seun van Dodo, uit Betlehem;

kjv_text: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,
bsb_text: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,
aov_text: Sammot, die Harodiet; Heles, die Peloniet;

kjv_text: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Antothite,
bsb_text: Ira son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite,
aov_text: Ira, die seun van Ikkes, die Tekoïet; Abiëser, die Anatotiet;

kjv_text: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,
bsb_text: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,
aov_text: Síbbegai, die Husatiet; Ílai, die Ahohiet;

kjv_text: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,
bsb_text: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled son of Baanah the Netophathite,
aov_text: Máharai, die Netofatiet; Heled, die seun van Baäna, die Netofatiet;

kjv_text: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah, that pertained to the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,
bsb_text: Ithai son of Ribai from Gibeah of the Benjamites, Benaiah the Pirathonite,
aov_text: Ítai, die seun van Ríbai, uit Gíbea van die kinders van Benjamin; Benája, die Pireatoniet;

kjv_text: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,
bsb_text: Hurai from the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,
aov_text: Húrai, uit Nahale-Gaäs, Abíël, die Arabatiet;

kjv_text: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,
bsb_text: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,
aov_text: Asmáwet, die Baharumiet; Éljagba, die Saälboniet.

kjv_text: The sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shage the Hararite,
bsb_text: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan son of Shagee the Hararite,
aov_text: Die seuns van Hasem, die Gisoniet, was: Jónatan, die seun van Sage, die Harariet;

kjv_text: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,
bsb_text: Ahiam son of Sachar the Hararite, Eliphal son of Ur,
aov_text: Ahíam, die seun van Sagar, die Harariet; Elífal, die seun van Ur;

kjv_text: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,
bsb_text: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,
aov_text: Hefer, die Megeratiet; Ahía, die Peloniet;

kjv_text: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,
bsb_text: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai son of Ezbai,
aov_text: Hesro, die Karmeliet; Náärai, die seun van Ésbai;

kjv_text: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Haggeri,
bsb_text: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar son of Hagri,
aov_text: Joël, die broer van Natan; Mibhar, die seun van Hagri;

kjv_text: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite, the armourbearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah,
bsb_text: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, the armor-bearer of Joab son of Zeruiah,
aov_text: Selek, die Ammoniet; Nágrai, die Berotiet, die wapendraer van Joab, die seun van Serúja;

kjv_text: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
bsb_text: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
aov_text: Ira, die Jitriet; Gareb, die Jitriet;

kjv_text: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,
bsb_text: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad son of Ahlai,
aov_text: Uría, die Hetiet; Sabad, die seun van Aglai;

kjv_text: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a captain of the Reubenites, and thirty with him,
bsb_text: Adina son of Shiza the Reubenite, chief of the Reubenites, and the thirty with him,
