aov_text: Adína, die seun van Sisa, die Rubeniet, ’n hoof van die Rubeniete, en saam met hom was dertig;

kjv_text: Hanan the son of Maachah, and Joshaphat the Mithnite,
bsb_text: Hanan son of Maacah, Joshaphat the Mithnite,
aov_text: Hanan, die seun van Máäga; en Jósafat, die Mitniet;

kjv_text: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jehiel the sons of Hothan the Aroerite,
bsb_text: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite,
aov_text: Ussía, die Asteratiet; Sama en Jeï-el, die seuns van Hotam, die Ároëriet;

kjv_text: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,
bsb_text: Jediael son of Shimri and his brother Joha the Tizite,
aov_text: Jedíael, die seun van Simri; en Joha, sy broer, die Tisiet;

kjv_text: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,
bsb_text: Eliel the Mahavite, Jeribai and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, Ithmah the Moabite,
aov_text: Éliël van Maháwim en Jeríbai en Josáwja, die seuns van Elnáäm; en Jitma, die Moabiet;

kjv_text: Eliel, and Obed, and Jasiel the Mesobaite.
bsb_text: Eliel, Obed, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.
aov_text: Éliël en Obed en Jaäsiël van Mesobája.

kjv_text: Now these are they that came to David to Ziklag, while he yet kept himself close because of Saul the son of Kish: and they were among the mighty men, helpers of the war.
bsb_text: Now these were the men who came to David at Ziklag, while he was still banished from the presence of Saul son of Kish (they were among the mighty men who helped him in battle;
aov_text: EN dit is hulle wat na Dawid na Siklag gekom het toe hy nog uit die teenwoordigheid van Saul, die seun van Kis, verban was; hulle was ook onder die helde wat gehelp het in die oorlog,

kjv_text: They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in hurling stones and shooting arrows out of a bow, even of Saul's brethren of Benjamin.
bsb_text: they were archers using both the right and left hands to sling stones and shoot arrows; and they were Saul’s kinsmen from Benjamin):
aov_text: gewapend met die boog, wat regter- en linkerhand kon gebruik met slingerstene en met pyl en boog; hulle was uit die broers van Saul uit Benjamin:

kjv_text: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; and Jeziel, and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; and Berachah, and Jehu the Antothite,
bsb_text: Ahiezer their chief and Joash, who were the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; Jeziel and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; Beracah; Jehu the Anathothite;
aov_text: Ahiëser, die hoof, en Joas, seuns van Semáä, die Gibeatiet; en Jésiël en Pelet, seuns van Asmáwet; en Béraga en Jehu, uit Ánatot;

kjv_text: And Ismaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty, and over the thirty;
bsb_text: Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the Thirty and a leader over the Thirty;
aov_text: en Jismája, die Gibeoniet, ’n held onder die dertig en hoof oor die dertig;

kjv_text: and Jeremiah, and Jahaziel, and Johanan, and Josabad the Gederathite,
bsb_text: Jeremiah, Jahaziel, Johanan, and Jozabad the Gederathite;
aov_text: en Jeremía en Jahásiël en Jóhanan en Jósabad, uit Gedéra;

kjv_text: Eluzai, and Jerimoth, and Bealiah, and Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite,
bsb_text: Eluzai, Jerimoth, Bealiah, Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite;
aov_text: Elehúsai en Jerímot en Beálja en Semárja en Sefátja, uit Harif;

kjv_text: Elkanah, and Jesiah, and Azareel, and Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korhites,
bsb_text: Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer, and Jashobeam, who were Korahites;
aov_text: Élkana en Jissía en Asáreël en Joëser en Jasóbeam, die Koragiete;

kjv_text: And Joelah, and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.
bsb_text: and Joelah and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham from Gedor.
aov_text: en Joëla en Sebádja, die seuns van Jeróham, uit Gedor.

kjv_text: And of the Gadites there separated themselves unto David into the hold to the wilderness men of might, and men of war fit for the battle, that could handle shield and buckler, whose faces were like the faces of lions, and were as swift as the roes upon the mountains;
bsb_text: Some Gadites defected to David at his stronghold in the desert. They were mighty men of valor, trained for battle, experts with the shield and spear, whose faces were like the faces of lions and who were as swift as gazelles on the mountains:
aov_text: Ook van die Gadiete het hulle afgeskei na Dawid, na die bergvesting in die woestyn, dapper manne, krygsmanne in die oorlog, toegerus met skild en spies, en hulle gesigte was leeugesigte, en hulle was vinnig soos gemsbokke op die berge:

kjv_text: Ezer the first, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,
bsb_text: Ezer the chief, Obadiah the second in command, Eliab the third,
aov_text: Eser, die hoof, Obádja, die tweede, Elíab, die derde;

kjv_text: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,
bsb_text: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,
aov_text: Masmánna, die vierde, Jeremía, die vyfde;

kjv_text: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,
bsb_text: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,
aov_text: Áttai, die sesde, Éliël, die sewende;

kjv_text: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,
bsb_text: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,
aov_text: Jóhanan, die agtste, Élsabad, die negende;

kjv_text: Jeremiah the tenth, Machbanai the eleventh.
bsb_text: Jeremiah the tenth, and Machbanai the eleventh.
aov_text: Jeremía, die tiende, Magbánnai, die elfde.

kjv_text: These were of the sons of Gad, captains of the host: one of the least was over an hundred, and the greatest over a thousand.
bsb_text: These Gadites were army commanders, the least of whom was a match for a hundred, and the greatest for a thousand.
aov_text: Hulle was uit die seuns van Gad, hoofde oor die leër; een teen honderd, die kleinste; en die grootste, een teen duisend.

kjv_text: These are they that went over Jordan in the first month, when it had overflown all his banks; and they put to flight all them of the valleys, both toward the east, and toward the west.
bsb_text: These are the ones who crossed the Jordan in the first month when it was overflowing all its banks, and they put to flight all those in the valleys, both to the east and to the west.
aov_text: Dit is hulle wat deur die Jordaan gegaan het in die eerste maand terwyl hy vol was oor al sy walle; en hulle het al die bewoners van die laagtes verjaag teen die ooste en teen die weste.

kjv_text: And there came of the children of Benjamin and Judah to the hold unto David.
bsb_text: Other Benjamites and some men from Judah also came to David in his stronghold.
aov_text: En toe daar uit die seuns van Benjamin en Juda na die bergvesting na Dawid kom,

kjv_text: And David went out to meet them, and answered and said unto them, If ye be come peaceably unto me to help me, mine heart shall be knit unto you: but if ye be come to betray me to mine enemies, seeing there is no wrong in mine hands, the God of our fathers look thereon, and rebuke it.
bsb_text: And David went out to meet them, saying, “If you have come to me in peace to help me, my heart will be united with you; but if you have come to betray me to my enemies when my hands are free of violence, may the God of our fathers see it and judge you.”
aov_text: het Dawid uitgegaan hulle tegemoet en gespreek en vir hulle gesê: As julle met vrede na my kom om my te help, sal ek my van harte met julle verenig; maar as dit is om my aan my teëstanders te verraai, ofskoon daar geen onreg in my hande is nie—mag die God van ons vaders dit dan sien en straf!

kjv_text: Then the spirit came upon Amasai, who was chief of the captains, and he said, Thine are we, David, and on thy side, thou son of Jesse: peace, peace be unto thee, and peace be to thine helpers; for thy God helpeth thee. Then David received them, and made them captains of the band.
bsb_text: Then the Spirit came upon Amasai, the chief of the Thirty, and he said: “We are yours, O David! We are with you, O son of Jesse! Peace, peace to you, and peace to your helpers, for your God helps you.” So David received them and made them leaders of his troops.
aov_text: Toe het die Gees Amásai, die hoof van die dertig, vervul, en hy het gesê: Vír u, Dawid, en mét u, seun van Ísai, is ons. Vrede, vrede vir u, en vrede vir die wat u help, want u God help u! Daarop het Dawid hulle opgeneem en hulle aangestel as hoofde van die bende.

kjv_text: And there fell some of Manasseh to David, when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle: but they helped them not: for the lords of the Philistines upon advisement sent him away, saying, He will fall to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.
bsb_text: Some from Manasseh defected to David when he went with the Philistines to fight against Saul. (They did not help the Philistines because the Philistine rulers consulted and sent David away, saying, “It will cost us our heads if he defects to his master Saul.”)
aov_text: Ook uit Manasse het sommige oorgeloop na Dawid toe hy saam met die Filistyne gekom het om teen Saul te veg, maar sonder om hulle te help; want met oorleg het die vorste van die Filistyne hom weggestuur en gesê: Ten koste van ons hoofde sal hy na sy heer Saul toe oorloop.

kjv_text: As he went to Ziklag, there fell to him of Manasseh, Adnah, and Jozabad, and Jediael, and Michael, and Jozabad, and Elihu, and Zilthai, captains of the thousands that were of Manasseh.
bsb_text: When David went to Ziklag, these men of Manasseh defected to him: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai, chiefs of thousands in Manasseh.
aov_text: Terwyl hy na Siklag trek, het daar uit Manasse na hom oorgeloop: Adnag en Jósabad en Jedíael en Mígael en Jósabad en Elíhu en Sílletai, hoofde van die geslagte van Manasse.

kjv_text: And they helped David against the band of the rovers: for they were all mighty men of valour, and were captains in the host.
bsb_text: They helped David against the raiders, for they were all mighty men of valor and commanders in the army.
aov_text: En hulle het Dawid gehelp teen die bende, want hulle was almal dapper helde en owerstes in die leër.

kjv_text: For at that time day by day there came to David to help him, until it was a great host, like the host of God.
bsb_text: For at that time men came to David day after day to help him, until he had a great army, like the army of God.
aov_text: Want dag vir dag het hulle na Dawid gekom om hom te help, totdat dit ’n groot leër was soos ’n leër van God.

kjv_text: And these are the numbers of the bands that were ready armed to the war, and came to David to Hebron, to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the word of the LORD.
bsb_text: Now these are the numbers of men armed for battle who came to David at Hebron to turn Saul’s kingdom over to him, in accordance with the word of the LORD:
aov_text: EN dít is die getalle van die leërafdelings van die wat vir oorlog gewapen was, wat na Dawid in Hebron gekom het om die koningskap van Saul op hom oor te bring volgens die bevel van die HERE.

kjv_text: The children of Judah that bare shield and spear were six thousand and eight hundred, ready armed to the war.
bsb_text: From Judah: 6,800 armed troops bearing shields and spears.
aov_text: Die seuns van Juda wat skild en spies gedra het, was sesduisend-agthonderd, gewapend vir oorlog;

kjv_text: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valour for the war, seven thousand and one hundred.
bsb_text: From Simeon: 7,100 mighty men of valor, ready for battle.
aov_text: van die seuns van Símeon, dapper helde vir krygsdiens, seweduisend-eenhonderd;

kjv_text: Of the children of Levi four thousand and six hundred.
bsb_text: From Levi: 4,600,
aov_text: van die seuns van Levi, vierduisend-seshonderd;

kjv_text: And Jehoiada was the leader of the Aaronites, and with him were three thousand and seven hundred;
bsb_text: including Jehoiada, leader of the house of Aaron, with 3,700 men,
aov_text: en Jehójada, die bevelhebber van die Aäroniete, en saam met hom drieduisend-sewehonderd;

kjv_text: And Zadok, a young man mighty of valour, and of his father's house twenty and two captains.
bsb_text: and Zadok, a mighty young man of valor, with 22 commanders from his own family.
aov_text: en Sadok, ’n jongman, ’n dapper held, met sy familie: twee-en-twintig owerstes;

kjv_text: And of the children of Benjamin, the kindred of Saul, three thousand: for hitherto the greatest part of them had kept the ward of the house of Saul.
bsb_text: From Benjamin, the kinsmen of Saul: 3,000, most of whom had remained loyal to the house of Saul up to that time.
aov_text: en van die seuns van Benjamin, die broers van Saul, drieduisend: want die meeste van hulle het tot nog toe aan die huis van Saul getrou gebly;

kjv_text: And of the children of Ephraim twenty thousand and eight hundred, mighty men of valour, famous throughout the house of their fathers.
bsb_text: From Ephraim: 20,800 mighty men of valor, famous among their own clans.
aov_text: en van die seuns van Efraim, twintigduisend-agthonderd, dapper helde, manne van naam in hulle families;

kjv_text: And of the half tribe of Manasseh eighteen thousand, which were expressed by name, to come and make David king.
bsb_text: From the half-tribe of Manasseh: 18,000 designated by name to come and make David king.
aov_text: en van die halwe stam van Manasse agttienduisend wat met hulle naam aangewys was om Dawid koning te gaan maak;

kjv_text: And of the children of Issachar, which were men that had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do; the heads of them were two hundred; and all their brethren were at their commandment.
bsb_text: From Issachar, men who understood the times and knew what Israel should do: 200 chiefs with all their kinsmen at their command.
aov_text: en van die seuns van Íssaskar, met kundige insig wat die tye betref, om te weet wat Israel moes doen; hulle hoofde was tweehonderd, en al hulle broers onder hulle bevel;

kjv_text: Of Zebulun, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, with all instruments of war, fifty thousand, which could keep rank: they were not of double heart.
bsb_text: From Zebulun: 50,000 fit for service, trained for battle with all kinds of weapons of war, who with one purpose were devoted to David.
aov_text: van Sébulon wat op kommando moet uittrek, toegerus vir oorlog met allerhande krygswapens, vyftigduisend aaneengesluit, en nie met ’n dubbele hart nie;

kjv_text: And of Naphtali a thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty and seven thousand.
bsb_text: From Naphtali: 1,000 commanders, accompanied by 37,000 men with shield and spear.
aov_text: en van Náftali duisend owerstes, en saam met hulle sewen-en-dertigduisend met skild en spies;

kjv_text: And of the Danites expert in war twenty and eight thousand and six hundred.
bsb_text: From Dan: 28,600 prepared for battle.
aov_text: en van die Daniete, toegerus vir oorlog, agt-en-twintigduisend-seshonderd;

kjv_text: And of Asher, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, forty thousand.
bsb_text: From Asher: 40,000 fit for service, prepared for battle.
aov_text: en van Aser wat op kommando moet uittrek om hulle in slagorde op te stel, veertigduisend;

kjv_text: And on the other side of Jordan, of the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and of the half tribe of Manasseh, with all manner of instruments of war for the battle, an hundred and twenty thousand.
bsb_text: And from east of the Jordan, from Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh there: 120,000 armed with every kind of weapon of war.
aov_text: en van oorkant die Jordaan af, van die Rubeniete en die Gadiete en die halwe stam van Manasse, honderd-en-twintigduisend met allerhande wapens vir krygsdiens.

kjv_text: All these men of war, that could keep rank, came with a perfect heart to Hebron, to make David king over all Israel: and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.
bsb_text: All these men of war, arrayed for battle, came to Hebron fully determined to make David king over all Israel. And all the rest of the Israelites were of one mind to make David king.
aov_text: Al hierdie krygsmanne het, in slagorde aaneengesluit, met ’n onverdeelde hart na Hebron gekom om Dawid koning te maak oor die hele Israel; en ook al die orige Israeliete was een van hart om Dawid koning te maak.

kjv_text: And there they were with David three days, eating and drinking: for their brethren had prepared for them.
bsb_text: They spent three days there eating and drinking with David, for their relatives had provided for them.
aov_text: En hulle het daar saam met Dawid drie dae lank geëet en gedrink, want hulle broers het dit vir hulle berei.

kjv_text: Moreover they that were nigh them, even unto Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, brought bread on asses, and on camels, and on mules, and on oxen, and meat, meal, cakes of figs, and bunches of raisins, and wine, and oil, and oxen, and sheep abundantly: for there was joy in Israel.
bsb_text: And their neighbors from as far away as Issachar, Zebulun, and Naphtali came bringing food on donkeys, camels, mules, and oxen—abundant supplies of flour, fig cakes and raisin cakes, wine and oil, oxen and sheep. Indeed, there was joy in Israel.
aov_text: En selfs hulle nabestaandes tot by Íssaskar en Sébulon en Náftali het brood gebring op esels en op kamele en op muile en op beeste, meelkos, vyekoeke en rosynekoeke en wyn en olie en beeste en kleinvee in menigte, want daar was blydskap in Israel.

kjv_text: And David consulted with the captains of thousands and hundreds, and with every leader.
bsb_text: Then David conferred with all his leaders, the commanders of hundreds and of thousands.
aov_text: EN Dawid het raad gehou met die owerstes oor duisend en oor honderd, met elke bevelhebber;

kjv_text: And David said unto all the congregation of Israel, If it seem good unto you, and that it be of the LORD our God, let us send abroad unto our brethren every where, that are left in all the land of Israel, and with them also to the priests and Levites which are in their cities and suburbs, that they may gather themselves unto us:
bsb_text: And he said to the whole assembly of Israel, “If it seems good to you, and if this is of the LORD our God, let us send word far and wide to the rest of our brothers in all the land of Israel, and also to the priests and Levites in their cities and pasturelands, so that they may join us.
aov_text: en Dawid het aan die hele vergadering van Israel gesê: As julle dit goedvind en dit van die HERE onse God is, laat ons ons versprei en na ons broers stuur wat nog oor is in al die landstreke van Israel, en saam met hulle na die priesters en die Leviete in die stede waar hulle weiveld het, dat hulle by ons bymekaar moet kom.

kjv_text: And let us bring again the ark of our God to us: for we enquired not at it in the days of Saul.
bsb_text: Then let us bring back the ark of our God, for we did not inquire of Him in the days of Saul.”
aov_text: En laat ons die ark van onse God na ons toe oorbring, want in die dae van Saul het ons daar nie na gevra nie.

kjv_text: And all the congregation said that they would do so: for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.
bsb_text: And because this proposal seemed right to all the people, the whole assembly agreed to it.
aov_text: Toe sê die hele vergadering dat hulle so moes doen, want die saak was reg in die oë van die hele volk.

kjv_text: So David gathered all Israel together, from Shihor of Egypt even unto the entering of Hemath, to bring the ark of God from Kirjathjearim.
bsb_text: So David assembled all Israel, from the River Shihor in Egypt to Lebo-hamath, to bring the ark of God from Kiriath-jearim.
aov_text: En Dawid het die hele Israel versamel van die Sihor in Egipte af tot by die ingang na Hamat, om die ark van God uit Kirjat-Jeárim te gaan haal.

kjv_text: And David went up, and all Israel, to Baalah, that is, to Kirjathjearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up thence the ark of God the LORD, that dwelleth between the cherubims, whose name is called on it.
bsb_text: David and all Israel went up to Baalah of Judah (that is, Kiriath-jearim) to bring up from there the ark of God the LORD, who is enthroned between the cherubim—the ark that is called by the Name.
aov_text: Daarna het Dawid met die hele Israel opgetrek na Báäla, na Kirjat-Jeárim wat aan Juda behoort, om daarvandaan op te bring die ark van God die HERE wat op die gérubs troon, waaroor die Naam uitgeroep is.

kjv_text: And they carried the ark of God in a new cart out of the house of Abinadab: and Uzza and Ahio drave the cart.
bsb_text: So they carried the ark of God from the house of Abinadab on a new cart, with Uzzah and Ahio guiding the cart.
aov_text: En hulle het die ark van God op ’n nuwe wa vervoer uit die huis van Abinádab, en Ussa en Agjo het die wa gedrywe.

kjv_text: And David and all Israel played before God with all their might, and with singing, and with harps, and with psalteries, and with timbrels, and with cymbals, and with trumpets.
bsb_text: David and all the Israelites were celebrating before God with all their might, with songs and on harps and lyres, with tambourines, cymbals, and trumpets.
aov_text: En Dawid en die hele Israel het voor die aangesig van God met alle mag gespeel, sowel met liedere as met siters en harpe en tamboeryne en simbale en trompette.

kjv_text: And when they came unto the threshingfloor of Chidon, Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen stumbled.
bsb_text: When they came to the threshing floor of Chidon, Uzzah reached out and took hold of the ark, because the oxen had stumbled.
aov_text: Toe hulle by die dorsvloer van Kidon kom, het Ussa sy hand uitgesteek om die ark vas te hou, want die osse het gestruikel.

kjv_text: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Uzza, and he smote him, because he put his hand to the ark: and there he died before God.
bsb_text: And the anger of the LORD burned against Uzzah, and He struck him down because he had put his hand on the ark. So he died there before God.
aov_text: Daarop het die toorn van die HERE ontvlam teen Ussa, en Hy het hom getref, omdat hy sy hand na die ark uitgesteek het, sodat hy daar voor die aangesig van God gesterf het.

kjv_text: And David was displeased, because the LORD had made a breach upon Uzza: wherefore that place is called Perezuzza to this day.
bsb_text: Then David became angry because the LORD had burst forth against Uzzah; so he named that place Perez-uzzah, as it is called to this day.
aov_text: En Dawid het ontroerd geword, omdat die HERE ’n skeur aan Ussa geskeur het; daarom het hy daardie plek genoem Peres-Ussa, tot vandag toe.

kjv_text: And David was afraid of God that day, saying, How shall I bring the ark of God home to me?
bsb_text: That day David feared God and asked, “How can I ever bring the ark of God to me?”
aov_text: En Dawid het daardie dag vir God bevrees geword en gesê: Hoe kan ek die ark van God na my toe bring?

kjv_text: So David brought not the ark home to himself to the city of David, but carried it aside into the house of Obededom the Gittite.
bsb_text: So he did not move the ark with him to the City of David; instead, he took it aside to the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.
aov_text: Daarom het Dawid die ark nie by hom in die stad van Dawid laat inkom nie, maar dit laat wegdraai na die huis van Obed-Edom, die Git-tiet.

kjv_text: And the ark of God remained with the family of Obededom in his house three months. And the LORD blessed the house of Obededom, and all that he had.
bsb_text: Thus the ark of God remained with the family of Obed-edom in his house for three months, and the LORD blessed his household and everything he owned.
aov_text: En die ark van God het by die huis van Obed-Edom in sy huis gebly drie maande lank, en die HERE het die huis van Obed-Edom geseën met alles wat hy gehad het.

kjv_text: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and timber of cedars, with masons and carpenters, to build him an house.
bsb_text: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent envoys to David, along with cedar logs, stonemasons, and carpenters, to build a palace for him.
aov_text: TOE stuur Hiram, die koning van Tirus, boodskappers na Dawid met sederhout en messelaars en skrynwerkers om vir hom ’n huis te bou.

kjv_text: And David perceived that the LORD had confirmed him king over Israel, for his kingdom was lifted up on high, because of his people Israel.
bsb_text: And David realized that the LORD had established him as king over Israel and had highly exalted his kingdom for the sake of His people Israel.
aov_text: So het Dawid dan gewaargeword dat die HERE hom as koning oor Israel bevestig het en dat sy koningskap hoog verhewe was ter wille van sy volk Israel.

kjv_text: And David took more wives at Jerusalem: and David begat more sons and daughters.
bsb_text: And David took more wives in Jerusalem and became the father of more sons and daughters.
aov_text: En Dawid het in Jerusalem nog meer vroue geneem, en Dawid het die vader van nog meer seuns en dogters geword.

kjv_text: Now these are the names of his children which he had in Jerusalem; Shammua, and Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon,
bsb_text: These are the names of the children born to him in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
aov_text: En dit is die name van die kinders wat hy in Jerusalem gehad het: Sámmua en Sobab, Natan en Salomo

kjv_text: And Ibhar, and Elishua, and Elpalet,
bsb_text: Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet,
aov_text: en Jibhar en Elisúa en Elpélet

kjv_text: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
bsb_text: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,
aov_text: en Noga en Nefeg en Jafía

kjv_text: And Elishama, and Beeliada, and Eliphalet.
bsb_text: Elishama, Beeliada, and Eliphelet.
aov_text: en Elisáma en Beëljada en Elifélet.

kjv_text: And when the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David. And David heard of it, and went out against them.
bsb_text: When the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over all Israel, they all went in search of him; but David learned of this and went out to face them.
aov_text: Toe die Filistyne hoor dat Dawid as koning oor die hele Israel gesalf was, het al die Filistyne opgetrek om Dawid te soek. Toe Dawid dit hoor, het hy teen hulle uitgetrek.

kjv_text: And the Philistines came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
bsb_text: Now the Philistines had come and raided the Valley of Rephaim.
aov_text: En die Filistyne het gekom en hulle versprei in die dal Refáim.

kjv_text: And David enquired of God, saying, Shall I go up against the Philistines? And wilt thou deliver them into mine hand? And the LORD said unto him, Go up; for I will deliver them into thine hand.
bsb_text: So David inquired of God, “Should I go up against the Philistines? Will You deliver them into my hand?” “Go,” replied the LORD, “for I will deliver them into your hand.”
aov_text: Toe het Dawid God geraadpleeg en gesê: Sal ek optrek teen die Filistyne, en sal U hulle in my hand gee? En die HERE het aan hom gesê: Trek op, en Ek sal hulle in jou hand gee.

kjv_text: So they came up to Baalperazim; and David smote them there. Then David said, God hath broken in upon mine enemies by mine hand like the breaking forth of waters: therefore they called the name of that place Baalperazim.
bsb_text: So David and his men went up to Baal-perazim, where he defeated the Philistines and said, “Like a bursting flood, God has burst out against my enemies by my hand.” So they called that place Baal-perazim.
aov_text: En toe hulle optrek by Baäl- Pérasim, het Dawid hulle daar verslaan, en Dawid het gesê: God het deur my hand deur my vyande gebreek soos water deurbreek; daarom het hulle dié plek Baäl-Pérasim genoem.

kjv_text: And when they had left their gods there, David gave a commandment, and they were burned with fire.
bsb_text: There the Philistines abandoned their gods, and David ordered that they be burned in the fire.
aov_text: En hulle het hul gode daar agtergelaat; en Dawid het bevel gegee, en hulle is met vuur verbrand.

kjv_text: And the Philistines yet again spread themselves abroad in the valley.
bsb_text: Once again the Philistines raided the valley.
aov_text: Maar die Filistyne het hulle nog weer in die dal versprei.

kjv_text: Therefore David enquired again of God; and God said unto him, Go not up after them; turn away from them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees.
bsb_text: So David again inquired of God, who answered him, “Do not march up after them, but circle around them and attack them in front of the balsam trees.
aov_text: Toe raadpleeg Dawid God weer, en God het aan hom gesê: Jy moet nie agter hulle aan optrek nie; trek om, van hulle af weg, en val hulle vlak voor die balsembosse aan.

kjv_text: And it shall be, when thou shalt hear a sound of going in the tops of the mulberry trees, that then thou shalt go out to battle: for God is gone forth before thee to smite the host of the Philistines.
bsb_text: As soon as you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the balsam trees, move out to battle, because this will mean that God has marched out before you to strike the camp of the Philistines.”
aov_text: En as jy ’n geruis van voetstappe in die toppe van die balsembosse hoor, trek dan uit vir die geveg, want God het voor jou uitgetrek om die leër van die Filistyne te verslaan.

kjv_text: David therefore did as God commanded him: and they smote the host of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gazer.
bsb_text: So David did as God had commanded him, and they struck down the army of the Philistines all the way from Gibeon to Gezer.
aov_text: En Dawid het gedoen soos God hom beveel het, en hulle het die leër van die Filistyne verslaan van Gíbeon af tot by Geser.

kjv_text: And the fame of David went out into all lands; and the LORD brought the fear of him upon all nations.
bsb_text: And David’s fame went out into every land, and the LORD caused all nations to fear him.
aov_text: En die naam van Dawid het uitgegaan in al die lande, en die HERE het die skrik vir hom op al die nasies gelê.

kjv_text: And David made him houses in the city of David, and prepared a place for the ark of God, and pitched for it a tent.
bsb_text: David constructed buildings for himself in the City of David, and he prepared a place for the ark of God and pitched a tent for it.
aov_text: EN hy het vir hom huise gebou in die stad van Dawid, en ’n plek reggemaak vir die ark van God en daarvoor ’n tent opgeslaan.

kjv_text: Then David said, None ought to carry the ark of God but the Levites: for them hath the LORD chosen to carry the ark of God, and to minister unto him for ever.
bsb_text: Then David said, “No one but the Levites may carry the ark of God, because the LORD has chosen them to carry the ark of the LORD and to minister before Him forever.”
aov_text: Toe sê Dawid: Niemand mag die ark van God dra nie, behalwe die Leviete; want die HERE het hulle uitverkies om die ark van God te dra en om Hom tot in ewigheid te dien.

kjv_text: And David gathered all Israel together to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the LORD unto his place, which he had prepared for it.
bsb_text: And David assembled all Israel in Jerusalem to bring up the ark of the LORD to the place he had prepared for it.
aov_text: En Dawid het die hele Israel in Jerusalem versamel om die ark van die HERE te bring na sy plek wat hy daarvoor reggemaak het.

kjv_text: And David assembled the children of Aaron, and the Levites:
bsb_text: Then he gathered together the descendants of Aaron and the Levites:
aov_text: En Dawid het die seuns van Aäron en die Leviete versamel:

kjv_text: Of the sons of Kohath; Uriel the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twenty:
bsb_text: From the Kohathites, Uriel the chief and 120 of his relatives;
aov_text: van die seuns van Kehat: Úriël, die owerste, en sy broers, honderd-en-twintig;

kjv_text: Of the sons of Merari; Asaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred and twenty:
bsb_text: from the Merarites, Asaiah the chief and 220 of his relatives;
aov_text: van die seuns van Merári: Asája, die owerste, en sy broers, tweehonderd-en-twintig;

kjv_text: Of the sons of Gershom; Joel the chief, and his brethren an hundred and thirty:
bsb_text: from the Gershomites, Joel the chief and 130 of his relatives;
aov_text: van die seuns van Gersom: Joël, die owerste, en sy broers, honderd-en-dertig;

kjv_text: Of the sons of Elizaphan; Shemaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred:
bsb_text: from the Elizaphanites, Shemaiah the chief and 200 of his relatives;
aov_text: van die seuns van Elisáfan: Semája, die owerste, en sy broers, tweehonderd;

kjv_text: Of the sons of Hebron; Eliel the chief, and his brethren fourscore:
bsb_text: from the Hebronites, Eliel the chief and 80 of his relatives;
aov_text: van die seuns van Hebron: Éliël, die owerste, en sy broers, tagtig;

kjv_text: Of the sons of Uzziel; Amminadab the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twelve.
bsb_text: and from the Uzzielites, Amminadab the chief and 112 of his relatives.
aov_text: van die seuns van Ússiël: Amminádab, die owerste, en sy broers, honderd-en-twaalf.

kjv_text: And David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, and Joel, Shemaiah, and Eliel, and Amminadab,
bsb_text: David summoned the priests Zadok and Abiathar and the Levites Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab.
aov_text: En Dawid het Sadok en Ábjatar, die priesters, en die Leviete Úriël, Asája en Joël, Semája en Éliël en Amminádab laat roep

kjv_text: And said unto them, Ye are the chief of the fathers of the Levites: sanctify yourselves, both ye and your brethren, that ye may bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel unto the place that I have prepared for it.
bsb_text: And he said to them, “You are the heads of the Levitical families. You and your relatives must consecrate yourselves so that you may bring the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel, to the place I have prepared for it.
aov_text: en aan hulle gesê: Julle is hoofde van families van die Leviete; heilig julle, julle en jul broers, en bring die ark van die HERE, die God van Israel, op na die plek wat ek daarvoor reggemaak het.

kjv_text: For because ye did it not at the first, the LORD our God made a breach upon us, for that we sought him not after the due order.
bsb_text: It was because you Levites were not with us the first time that the LORD our God burst forth in anger against us. For we did not consult Him about the proper order.”
aov_text: Want omdat julle in die begin nie by was nie, het die HERE onse God teen ons uitgebreek, omdat ons Hom nie gesoek het soos dit behoort nie.

kjv_text: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel.
bsb_text: So the priests and Levites consecrated themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel.
aov_text: Daarop het die priesters en die Leviete hulle geheilig om die ark van die HERE, die God van Israel, te gaan haal.

kjv_text: And the children of the Levites bare the ark of God upon their shoulders with the staves thereon, as Moses commanded according to the word of the LORD.
bsb_text: And the Levites carried the ark of God on their shoulders with the poles, as Moses had commanded in accordance with the word of the LORD.
aov_text: En die seuns van die Leviete het die ark van God, soos Moses volgens die woord van die HERE beveel het, op hulle skouers gedra, met die draaghoute op hulle.

kjv_text: And David spake to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brethren to be the singers with instruments of musick, psalteries and harps and cymbals, sounding, by lifting up the voice with joy.
bsb_text: David also told the leaders of the Levites to appoint their relatives as singers to lift up their voices with joy, accompanied by musical instruments—harps, lyres, and cymbals.
aov_text: En Dawid het aan die owerstes van die Leviete gesê om hulle broers, die sangers, op te stel met musiekinstrumente, harpe en siters en simbale, om hulle te laat hoor deur die stem met blydskap te verhef.

kjv_text: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brethren, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brethren, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;
bsb_text: So the Levites appointed Heman son of Joel; from his brothers, Asaph son of Berechiah; from their brothers the Merarites, Ethan son of Kushaiah;
aov_text: Die Leviete het toe Heman, die seun van Joël, opgestel, en uit sy broers Asaf, die seun van Berégja; en uit die seuns van Merári, hulle broers, Etan, die seun van Kusája;

kjv_text: And with them their brethren of the second degree, Zechariah, Ben, and Jaaziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, Eliab, and Benaiah, and Maaseiah, and Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obededom, and Jeiel, the porters.
bsb_text: and with them their brothers next in rank: Zechariah, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, and the gatekeepers Obed-edom and Jeiel.
aov_text: en saam met hulle hul broers van die tweede rang: Sagaría, en Jasäiël en Semíramot en Jehíël en Unni, Elíab en Benája en Maäséja en Mattítja en Eliféle en Miknéja en Obed-Edom en Jeï-el, die poortwagters;

kjv_text: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were appointed to sound with cymbals of brass;
bsb_text: The musicians Heman, Asaph, and Ethan were to sound the bronze cymbals.
aov_text: en die sangers Heman, Asaf en Etan om met kopersimbale musiek te maak;

kjv_text: And Zechariah, and Aziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, and Eliab, and Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with psalteries on Alamoth;
bsb_text: Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah were to play the harps according to Alamoth.
aov_text: en Sagaría en Ásiël en Semíramot en Jehíël en Unni en Elíab en Maäséja en Benája met harpe, met sopraanstemme;

kjv_text: And Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obededom, and Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps on the Sheminith to excel.
bsb_text: And Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-edom, Jeiel, and Azaziah were to lead the music with lyres according to Sheminith.
aov_text: en Mattítja en Eliféle en Miknéja en Obed-Edom en Jeï-el en Asásja met siters om in die bas leiding te gee.

kjv_text: And Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was for song: he instructed about the song, because he was skilful.
bsb_text: Chenaniah the head Levite was the director of the music because he was highly skilled.
aov_text: En Kenánja, die owerste van die Leviete, was aangestel oor die vervoer; hy het die vervoer gereël want hy het dit verstaan.

kjv_text: And Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.
bsb_text: Berechiah and Elkanah were to be guardians of the ark.
aov_text: En Berégja en Élkana was poortwagters by die ark.

kjv_text: And Shebaniah, and Jehoshaphat, and Nethaneel, and Amasai, and Zechariah, and Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, did blow with the trumpets before the ark of God: and Obededom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.
bsb_text: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer—the priests—were to blow the trumpets before the ark of God. Obed-edom and Jehiah were also to be guardians of the ark.
aov_text: En die priesters Sebánja en Jósafat en Netáneël en Amásai en Sagaría en Benája en Eliëser het op die trompette geblaas voor die ark van God uit; en Obed-Edom en Jehía was poortwagters van die ark.

kjv_text: So David, and the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the house of Obededom with joy.
bsb_text: So David, the elders of Israel, and the commanders of thousands went with rejoicing to bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD from the house of Obed-edom.
aov_text: Dawid en die oudstes van Israel en die owerstes oor duisend het toe gegaan om die verbondsark van die HERE met vreugde uit die huis van Obed-Edom te gaan haal.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when God helped the Levites that bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, that they offered seven bullocks and seven rams.
bsb_text: And because God helped the Levites who were carrying the ark of the covenant of the LORD, they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.

aov_text: En U het u volk Israel vir U as ’n volk tot in ewigheid gemaak; en U, HERE, U het vir hulle ’n God geword.

kjv_text: Therefore now, LORD, let the thing that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant and concerning his house be established for ever, and do as thou hast said.
bsb_text: And now, O LORD, let the word You have spoken concerning Your servant and his house be established forever. Do as You have promised,
aov_text: Laat dan nou, HERE, die woord wat U oor u kneg en oor sy huis gespreek het, tot in ewigheid waar gemaak word, en doen soos U gespreek het.

kjv_text: Let it even be established, that thy name may be magnified for ever, saying, The LORD of hosts is the God of Israel, even a God to Israel: and let the house of David thy servant be established before thee.
bsb_text: so that Your name will be established and magnified forever when it is said, ‘The LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, is God over Israel.’ And may the house of Your servant David be established before You.
aov_text: Ja, laat dit waar gemaak word en laat u Naam groot word tot in ewigheid, deurdat hulle sê: Die HERE van die leërskare, die God van Israel, is Israel se God, en die huis van u kneg Dawid is bestendig voor u aangesig.

kjv_text: For thou, O my God, hast told thy servant that thou wilt build him an house: therefore thy servant hath found in his heart to pray before thee.
bsb_text: For You, my God, have revealed to Your servant that You will build a house for him. Therefore Your servant has found the courage to pray before You.
aov_text: Want U, my God, het die oor van u kneg geopen, dat U vir hom ’n huis sal stig; daarom het u kneg vrymoedigheid gevind om voor u aangesig te bid.

kjv_text: And now, LORD, thou art God, and hast promised this goodness unto thy servant:
bsb_text: And now, O LORD, You are God! And You have promised this goodness to Your servant.
aov_text: En nou, HERE, U is God, en U het hierdie goeie saak oor u kneg gespreek.

kjv_text: Now therefore let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may be before thee for ever: for thou blessest, O LORD, and it shall be blessed for ever.
bsb_text: So now You have been pleased to bless the house of Your servant, that it may continue forever before You. For You, O LORD, have blessed it, and it will be blessed forever.”
aov_text: Dit het U dan nou behaag om die huis van u kneg te seën om vir ewig voor u aangesig te wees; want U, HERE, het geseën, en dit sal vir ewig geseënd wees.

kjv_text: Now after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them, and took Gath and her towns out of the hand of the Philistines.
bsb_text: Some time later, David defeated the Philistines, subdued them, and took Gath and its villages from the hand of the Philistines.
aov_text: EN hierna het Dawid die Filistyne verslaan en hulle onderwerp; en hy het Gat met sy onderhorige plekke uit die hand van die Filistyne geneem.

kjv_text: And he smote Moab; and the Moabites became David's servants, and brought gifts.
bsb_text: David also defeated the Moabites, and they became subject to David and brought him tribute.
aov_text: Hy het ook die Moabiete verslaan, sodat die Moabiete Dawid se belastingpligtige knegte geword het.

kjv_text: And David smote Hadarezer king of Zobah unto Hamath, as he went to stablish his dominion by the river Euphrates.
bsb_text: As far as Hamath, David also defeated King Hadadezer of Zobah, who had marched out to establish his dominion along the Euphrates River.
aov_text: Dawid het ook Hadaréser, die koning van Soba, na Hamat toe verslaan, toe hy getrek het om sy mag aan die Eufraatrivier te bevestig.

kjv_text: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: David also houghed all the chariot horses, but reserved of them an hundred chariots.
bsb_text: David captured from him a thousand chariots, seven thousand charioteers, and twenty thousand foot soldiers, and he hamstrung all the horses except a hundred he kept for the chariots.
aov_text: En Dawid het van hom duisend strydwaens en seweduisend perderuiters en twintigduisend man voetgangers afgeneem; en Dawid het al die trekperde se hakskeensenings afgesny, maar honderd trekperde daarvan laat oorbly.

kjv_text: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadarezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.
bsb_text: When the Arameans of Damascus came to help King Hadadezer of Zobah, David struck down twenty-two thousand men.
aov_text: En die Arameërs van Damaskus het gekom om Hadaréser, die koning van Soba, te help; maar Dawid het onder die Arameërs twee-en-twintigduisend man verslaan.

kjv_text: Then David put garrisons in Syriadamascus; and the Syrians became David's servants, and brought gifts. Thus the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.
bsb_text: Then he placed garrisons in Aram of Damascus, and the Arameans became subject to David and brought him tribute. So the LORD made David victorious wherever he went.
aov_text: En Dawid het wagposte in Aram-Damaskus geplaas, sodat die Arameërs Dawid se belastingpligtige knegte was; en die HERE het Dawid die oorwinning gegee oral waar hy getrek het.

kjv_text: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadarezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
bsb_text: And David took the gold shields that belonged to the officers of Hadadezer and brought them to Jerusalem.
aov_text: En Dawid het die goue skilde geneem wat die dienaars van Hadaréser gedra het, en dit na Jerusalem gebring.

kjv_text: Likewise from Tibhath, and from Chun, cities of Hadarezer, brought David very much brass, wherewith Solomon made the brasen sea, and the pillars, and the vessels of brass.
bsb_text: And from Tibhath and Cun, cities of Hadadezer, David took a large amount of bronze, with which Solomon made the bronze Sea, the pillars, and various bronze articles.
aov_text: En uit Tibhat en uit Kun, stede van Hadaréser, het Dawid ontsaglik veel koper weggeneem; daarvan het Salomo die kopersee en die pilare en die kopergereedskappe gemaak.

kjv_text: Now when Tou king of Hamath heard how David had smitten all the host of Hadarezer king of Zobah;
bsb_text: When King Tou of Hamath heard that David had defeated the entire army of Hadadezer king of Zobah,
aov_text: Toe Toü, die koning van Hamat, hoor dat Dawid die hele leërmag van Hadaréser, die koning van Soba, verslaan het,

kjv_text: He sent Hadoram his son to king David, to enquire of his welfare, and to congratulate him, because he had fought against Hadarezer, and smitten him; (for Hadarezer had war with Tou;) and with him all manner of vessels of gold and silver and brass.
bsb_text: he sent his son Hadoram to greet King David and bless him for fighting and defeating Hadadezer, who had been at war with Tou. Hadoram brought all kinds of articles of gold and silver and bronze,
aov_text: stuur hy sy seun Hadóram na koning Dawid om hom na die welstand te vra en hom geluk te wens dat hy teen Hadaréser geveg en hom verslaan het, want Hadaréser was ’n vyand van Toü. Ook allerhande goue en silwer- en kopervoorwerpe het hy saamgebring.

kjv_text: Them also king David dedicated unto the LORD, with the silver and the gold that he brought from all these nations; from Edom, and from Moab, and from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from Amalek.
bsb_text: and King David dedicated these to the LORD, along with the silver and gold he had carried off from all these nations—from Edom and Moab, and from the Ammonites, Philistines, and Amalekites.
aov_text: Dit het koning Dawid ook aan die HERE geheilig saam met die silwer en die goud wat hy van al die nasies geneem het, van die Edomiete en van die Moabiete en van die kinders van Ammon en van die Filistyne en van die Amalekiete.

kjv_text: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah slew of the Edomites in the valley of salt eighteen thousand.
bsb_text: Moreover, Abishai son of Zeruiah struck down eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
aov_text: Ook het Abísai, die seun van Serúja, die Edomiete in die Soutdal verslaan, agttienduisend.

kjv_text: And he put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became David's servants. Thus the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.
bsb_text: He placed garrisons in Edom, and all the Edomites were subject to David. So the LORD made David victorious wherever he went.
aov_text: En hy het wagposte in Edom geplaas, sodat al die Edomiete knegte van Dawid geword het; en die HERE het Dawid die oorwinning gegee oral waar hy getrek het.

kjv_text: So David reigned over all Israel, and executed judgment and justice among all his people.
bsb_text: Thus David reigned over all Israel and administered justice and righteousness for all his people:
aov_text: En Dawid het oor die hele Israel geregeer en reg en geregtigheid aan sy hele volk gedoen.

kjv_text: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, recorder.
bsb_text: Joab son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was the recorder;
aov_text: En Joab, die seun van Serúja, was oor die leër; en Jósafat, die seun van Ahílud, was kanselier.

kjv_text: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Abimelech the son of Abiathar, were the priests; and Shavsha was scribe;
bsb_text: Zadok son of Ahitub and Ahimelech son of Abiathar were priests; Shavsha was the scribe;
aov_text: En Sadok, die seun van Ahítub, en Ahiméleg, die seun van Ábjatar, was priesters, en Sausa was skrywer.

kjv_text: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief about the king.
bsb_text: Benaiah son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and Pelethites; and David’s sons were chief officials at the king’s side.
aov_text: En Benája, die seun van Jójada, was oor die Kreti en die Pleti, en die oudste seuns van Dawid was in diens van die koning.

kjv_text: Now it came to pass after this, that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his stead.
bsb_text: Some time later, Nahash king of the Ammonites died and was succeeded by his son.
aov_text: DAARNA het Nahas, die koning van die kinders van Ammon, gesterwe, en sy seun het in sy plek koning geword.

kjv_text: And David said, I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father shewed kindness to me. And David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. So the servants of David came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun, to comfort him.
bsb_text: And David said, “I will show kindness to Hanun son of Nahash, because his father showed kindness to me.” So David sent messengers to console Hanun concerning his father. But when David’s servants arrived in the land of the Ammonites to console him,
aov_text: Toe sê Dawid: Ek wil guns bewys aan Hanun, die seun van Nahas, want sy vader het aan my guns bewys. Daarom het Dawid boodskappers gestuur om hom te troos oor sy vader. Toe dan die dienaars van Dawid in die land van die kinders van Ammon by Hanun aankom om hom te troos,

kjv_text: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, Thinkest thou that David doth honour thy father, that he hath sent comforters unto thee? are not his servants come unto thee for to search, and to overthrow, and to spy out the land?
bsb_text: the princes of the Ammonites said to Hanun, “Just because David has sent you comforters, do you really believe he is showing respect for your father? Have not his servants come to you to explore the land, spy it out, and overthrow it?”
aov_text: het die vorste van die kinders van Ammon vir Hanun gesê: Eer Dawid u vader in u oë, omdat hy vir u troosters gestuur het? Het sy dienaars nie na u gekom om die land te deursoek en dit om te keer en te verken nie?

kjv_text: Wherefore Hanun took David's servants, and shaved them, and cut off their garments in the midst hard by their buttocks, and sent them away.
bsb_text: So Hanun took David’s servants, shaved their beards, cut off their garments at the hips, and sent them away.
aov_text: Daarop neem Hanun die dienaars van Dawid en skeer hulle en sny hulle klere in die helfte af tot by die sitplek, en hy het hulle laat gaan.

kjv_text: Then there went certain, and told David how the men were served. And he sent to meet them: for the men were greatly ashamed. And the king said, Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown, and then return.
bsb_text: When someone came and told David about his men, he sent messengers to meet them, since the men had been thoroughly humiliated. The king told them, “Stay in Jericho until your beards have grown back, and then return.”
aov_text: En toe hulle heengegaan het en aan Dawid aangaande die manne berig gebring is, stuur hy bodes om hulle te ontmoet, want die manne was baie skaam; en die koning het gesê: Bly in Jérigo totdat julle baard weer gegroei het; kom dan terug.

kjv_text: And when the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire them chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, and out of Syriamaachah, and out of Zobah.
bsb_text: When the Ammonites realized that they had become a stench to David, Hanun and the Ammonites sent a thousand talents of silver to hire for themselves chariots and horsemen from Aram-naharaim, Aram-maacah, and Zobah.
aov_text: Toe die kinders van Ammon sien dat hulle hul by Dawid gehaat gemaak het, het Hanun en die kinders van Ammon duisend talente silwer gestuur om vir hulle strydwaens en perderuiters uit Mesopotámië en uit Aram-Máäga en uit Soba te huur.

kjv_text: So they hired thirty and two thousand chariots, and the king of Maachah and his people; who came and pitched before Medeba. And the children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to battle.
bsb_text: So they hired for themselves thirty-two thousand chariots, as well as the king of Maacah with his troops, who came and camped near Medeba while the Ammonites came from their cities and marched out for battle.
aov_text: En hulle het vir hulle twee-en-dertigduisend waens gehuur, en die koning van Máäga met sy manskappe; en hulle het gekom en voor Medéba laer opgeslaan; ook die kinders van Ammon het saamgekom uit hulle stede om oorlog te voer.

kjv_text: And when David heard of it, he sent Joab, and all the host of the mighty men.
bsb_text: On hearing this, David sent Joab and the entire army of mighty men.
aov_text: En Dawid het dit gehoor en Joab met die hele leër, die helde, gestuur.

kjv_text: And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array before the gate of the city: and the kings that were come were by themselves in the field.
bsb_text: The Ammonites marched out and arrayed themselves for battle at the entrance to the city, while the kings who had come stayed by themselves in the open country.
aov_text: En die kinders van Ammon het uitgetrek en hulle in slagorde opgestel by die ingang van die stad, terwyl die konings wat gekom het, afsonderlik in die veld was.

kjv_text: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose out of all the choice of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians.
bsb_text: When Joab saw the battle lines before him and behind him, he selected some of the best men of Israel and arrayed them against the Arameans.
aov_text: Toe Joab sien dat ’n aanval van voor sowel as van agter hom bedreig, het hy uit al die uitgesoektes in Israel uitgekies en hulle teenoor die Arameërs opgestel.

kjv_text: And the rest of the people he delivered unto the hand of Abishai his brother, and they set themselves in array against the children of Ammon.
bsb_text: And he placed the rest of the forces under the command of his brother Abishai, who arrayed them against the Ammonites.
aov_text: Maar die orige manskappe het hy onder bevel van sy broer Abísai gegee, en hulle het hul teenoor die kinders van Ammon opgestel.

kjv_text: And he said, If the Syrians be too strong for me, then thou shalt help me: but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee, then I will help thee.
bsb_text: “If the Arameans are too strong for me,” said Joab, “then you will come to my rescue. And if the Ammonites are too strong for you, then I will come to your rescue.
aov_text: En hy het gesê: As die Arameërs vir my te sterk word, dan moet jy my te hulp kom, en as die kinders van Ammon vir jou te sterk word, sal ek jou te hulp kom.

kjv_text: Be of good courage, and let us behave ourselves valiantly for our people, and for the cities of our God: and let the LORD do that which is good in his sight.
bsb_text: Be strong and let us fight bravely for our people and for the cities of our God. May the LORD do what is good in His sight.”
aov_text: Wees sterk en laat ons saam moedig wees vir ons volk en vir die stede van onse God. Mag die HERE dan doen wat goed is in sy oë!

kjv_text: So Joab and the people that were with him drew nigh before the Syrians unto the battle; and they fled before him.
bsb_text: So Joab and his troops advanced to fight the Arameans, who fled before him.
aov_text: Daarop het Joab en die manskappe wat by hom was, nader gekom vir die geveg voor die Arameërs, en hulle het vir hom gevlug.

kjv_text: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.
bsb_text: When the Ammonites saw that the Arameans had fled, they too fled before Joab’s brother Abishai, and they entered the city. So Joab went back to Jerusalem.
aov_text: Toe die kinders van Ammon sien dat die Arameërs vlug, het hulle ook vir sy broer Abísai gevlug en die stad ingegaan. En Joab het in Jerusalem aangekom.

kjv_text: And when the Syrians saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they sent messengers, and drew forth the Syrians that were beyond the river: and Shophach the captain of the host of Hadarezer went before them.
bsb_text: When the Arameans saw that they had been defeated by Israel, they sent messengers to bring more Arameans from beyond the Euphrates, with Shophach the commander of Hadadezer’s army leading them.
aov_text: Toe die Arameërs dan sien dat hulle voor Israel verslaan was, het hulle boodskappers gestuur en die Arameërs laat uittrek wat oorkant die Eufraat was, met Sofag, die leërowerste van Hadaréser, op hulle voorpunt.

kjv_text: And it was told David; and he gathered all Israel, and passed over Jordan, and came upon them, and set the battle in array against them. So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians, they fought with him.
bsb_text: When this was reported to David, he gathered all Israel, crossed the Jordan, advanced toward the Arameans, and arrayed for battle against them. When David lined up to engage them in battle, they fought against him.
aov_text: Intussen het Dawid daarvan berig ontvang en die hele Israel versamel en deur die Jordaan getrek. Toe hy by hulle aangekom het, het hy hom teen hulle opgestel; en nadat Dawid hom teenoor die Arameërs opgestel het, het hulle teen hom geveg.

kjv_text: But the Syrians fled before Israel; and David slew of the Syrians seven thousand men which fought in chariots, and forty thousand footmen, and killed Shophach the captain of the host.
bsb_text: But the Arameans fled before Israel, and David killed seven thousand of their charioteers and forty thousand foot soldiers. He also killed Shophach the commander of their army.
aov_text: Maar die Arameërs het vir Israel gevlug, en Dawid het van die Arameërs seweduisend trekperde en veertigduisend man voetgangers gedood; ook Sofag, die leërowerste, het hy gedood.

kjv_text: And when the servants of Hadarezer saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they made peace with David, and became his servants: neither would the Syrians help the children of Ammon any more.
bsb_text: When Hadadezer’s subjects saw that they had been defeated by Israel, they made peace with David and became subject to him. So the Arameans were unwilling to help the Ammonites anymore.
aov_text: En toe die dienaars van Hadaréser sien dat hulle voor Israel verslaan was, het hulle met Dawid vrede gesluit en hom gedien; en die Arameërs wou die kinders van Ammon nie verder help nie.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, that after the year was expired, at the time that kings go out to battle, Joab led forth the power of the army, and wasted the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David tarried at Jerusalem. And Joab smote Rabbah, and destroyed it.
bsb_text: In the spring, at the time when kings march out to war, Joab led out the army and ravaged the land of the Ammonites. He came to Rabbah and besieged it, but David remained in Jerusalem. And Joab attacked Rabbah and demolished it.
aov_text: EN ná verloop van ’n jaar, teen die tyd dat die konings uittrek, het Joab die leërmag aangevoer en die land van die kinders van Ammon verwoes; hy het ook gekom en Rabba beleër, terwyl Dawid in Jerusalem gebly het. En Joab het Rabba verslaan en dit afgebreek.

kjv_text: And David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and there were precious stones in it; and it was set upon David's head: and he brought also exceeding much spoil out of the city.
bsb_text: Then David took the crown from the head of their king. It was found to weigh a talent of gold and was set with precious stones, and it was placed on David’s head. And David took a great amount of plunder from the city.
aov_text: En Dawid het die kroon van Milkom van sy hoof afgeneem en bevind dat die gewig daarvan ’n talent goud was; en daarin was ’n kosbare steen, en dit het op die hoof van Dawid gekom; en hy het ’n baie groot buit van die stad uitgebring.

kjv_text: And he brought out the people that were in it, and cut them with saws, and with harrows of iron, and with axes. Even so dealt David with all the cities of the children of Ammon. And David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.
bsb_text: David brought out the people who were there and put them to work with saws, iron picks, and axes. And he did the same to all the Ammonite cities. Then David and all his troops returned to Jerusalem.
aov_text: Hy het ook die bevolking wat daarin was, uitgebring en hulle met die saag laat saag, en met ysterpenne en met byle laat werk; en so het Dawid gedoen met al die stede van die kinders van Ammon. Toe het Dawid met al die manskappe na Jerusalem teruggegaan.

kjv_text: And it came to pass after this, that there arose war at Gezer with the Philistines; at which time Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Sippai, that was of the children of the giant: and they were subdued.
bsb_text: Some time later, war broke out with the Philistines at Gezer. At that time Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Sippai, a descendant of the Rephaim, and the Philistines were subdued.
aov_text: EN daarna het daar by Geser oorlog ontstaan met die Filistyne; toe het Síbbegai, die Husatiet, Síppai, uit die kinders van die Refaïete, verslaan, sodat hulle onderworpe geraak het.

kjv_text: And there was war again with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair slew Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, whose spear staff was like a weaver's beam.
bsb_text: Once again there was a battle with the Philistines, and Elhanan son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the shaft of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.
aov_text: En daar was weer oorlog met die Filistyne; en Élhanan, die seun van Jaïr, het Lagmi, die broer van Goliat, die Gittiet, wie se spiessteel soos ’n wewersbalk was, verslaan.

kjv_text: And yet again there was war at Gath, where was a man of great stature, whose fingers and toes were four and twenty, six on each hand, and six on each foot and he also was the son of the giant.
bsb_text: And there was still another battle at Gath, where there was a man of great stature with six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot—twenty-four in all. He too was descended from Rapha,
aov_text: En daar was weer oorlog by Gat, en daar was ’n baie lang man met ses vingers aan elke hand en voet, vier-en-twintig; en hy was ook ’n afstammeling van die Refaïete.

kjv_text: But when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea David's brother slew him.
bsb_text: and when he taunted Israel, Jonathan the son of David’s brother Shimei killed him.
aov_text: En hy het Israel uitgedaag, maar Jónatan, die seun van Símea, die broer van Dawid, het hom verslaan.

kjv_text: These were born unto the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.
bsb_text: So these descendants of Rapha in Gath fell at the hands of David and his servants.
aov_text: Hulle was afstammelinge van die Refaïete in Gat, en hulle het geval deur die hand van Dawid en deur die hand van sy dienaars.

kjv_text: And Satan stood up against Israel, and provoked David to number Israel.
bsb_text: Then Satan rose up against Israel and incited David to take a census of Israel.
aov_text: TOE het Satan teen Israel opgetree en Dawid aangehits om Israel te tel.

kjv_text: And David said to Joab and to the rulers of the people, Go, number Israel from Beersheba even to Dan; and bring the number of them to me, that I may know it.
bsb_text: So David said to Joab and the commanders of the troops, “Go and count the Israelites from Beersheba to Dan and bring me a report, so that I may know their number.”
aov_text: En Dawid het aan Joab en die owerstes van die volk gesê: Gaan tel Israel van Berséba tot Dan, en bring vir my berig, dat ek hulle getal kan weet.

kjv_text: And Joab answered, The LORD make his people an hundred times so many more as they be: but, my lord the king, are they not all my lord's servants? why then doth my lord require this thing? why will he be a cause of trespass to Israel?
bsb_text: But Joab replied, “May the LORD multiply His troops a hundred times over. My lord the king, are they not all servants of my lord? Why does my lord want to do this? Why should he bring guilt on Israel?”
aov_text: En Joab sê: Mag die HERE by sy volk honderd maal meer byvoeg as wat hulle is; hulle is tog almal, my heer koning, my heer se dienaars. Waarom verlang my heer dit? Waarom moet Israel skuldig word?

kjv_text: Nevertheless the king's word prevailed against Joab. Wherefore Joab departed, and went throughout all Israel, and came to Jerusalem.
bsb_text: Nevertheless, the king’s word prevailed against Joab. So Joab departed and traveled throughout Israel, and then he returned to Jerusalem.
aov_text: Maar die woord van die koning het die oorhand gehad oor Joab, en Joab het uitgetrek en die hele Israel deurgetrek en in Jerusalem aangekom.

kjv_text: And Joab gave the sum of the number of the people unto David. And all they of Israel were a thousand thousand and an hundred thousand men that drew sword: and Judah was four hundred threescore and ten thousand men that drew sword.
bsb_text: And Joab reported to David the total number of the troops. In all Israel there were 1,100,000 men who drew the sword, including 470,000 in Judah.
aov_text: En Joab het die getal van die volkstelling aan Dawid gegee; en die hele Israel was elfhonderdduisend man wat die swaard uittrek, en Juda vierhonderd-en-sewentigduisend man wat die swaard uittrek.

kjv_text: But Levi and Benjamin counted he not among them: for the king's word was abominable to Joab.
bsb_text: But Joab did not include Levi and Benjamin in the count, because the king’s command was detestable to him.
aov_text: Maar Levi en Benjamin het hy nie onder hulle getel nie, want die woord van die koning was vir Joab ’n gruwel.

kjv_text: And God was displeased with this thing; therefore he smote Israel.
bsb_text: This command was also evil in the sight of God; so He struck Israel.
aov_text: En hierdie saak was verkeerd in die oë van God; daarom het Hy Israel swaar getref.

kjv_text: And David said unto God, I have sinned greatly, because I have done this thing: but now, I beseech thee, do away the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.
bsb_text: Then David said to God, “I have sinned greatly because I have done this thing. Now I beg You to take away the iniquity of Your servant, for I have acted very foolishly.”
aov_text: Toe sê Dawid tot God: Ek het swaar gesondig, dat ek hierdie ding gedoen het; maar vergeef tog nou die skuld van u kneg, want ek het my baie besondig.

kjv_text: And the LORD spake unto Gad, David's seer, saying,
bsb_text: And the LORD instructed Gad, David’s seer,
aov_text: En die HERE het met Gad, die siener van Dawid, gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: Go and tell David, saying, Thus saith the LORD, I offer thee three things: choose thee one of them, that I may do it unto thee.
bsb_text: “Go and tell David that this is what the LORD says: ‘I am offering you three options. Choose one of them, and I will carry it out against you.’”
aov_text: Gaan heen en spreek met Dawid en sê: So spreek die HERE: Drie dinge lê Ek jou voor; kies vir jou een daaruit, dat Ek dit aan jou kan doen.

kjv_text: So Gad came to David, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Choose thee
bsb_text: So Gad went and said to David, “This is what the LORD says: ‘You must choose
aov_text: Toe kom Gad by Dawid en sê vir hom: So spreek die HERE: Kies vir jou

kjv_text: Either three years' famine; or three months to be destroyed before thy foes, while that the sword of thine enemies overtaketh thee; or else three days the sword of the LORD, even the pestilence, in the land, and the angel of the LORD destroying throughout all the coasts of Israel. Now therefore advise thyself what word I shall bring again to him that sent me.
bsb_text: between three years of famine, three months of being swept away before your enemies and overtaken by their swords, or three days of the sword of the LORD—days of plague upon the land, with the angel of the LORD ravaging every part of Israel.’ Now then, decide how I should reply to Him who sent me.”
aov_text: òf drie jaar lank hongersnood, òf om drie maande lank om te kom vanweë jou teëstanders deurdat die swaard van jou vyande jou inhaal, òf drie dae lank die swaard van die HERE, naamlik pes in die land deurdat die engel van die HERE verderf aanrig in die hele grondgebied van Israel; oorweeg dan nou watter antwoord ek my Sender moet bring.

kjv_text: And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let me fall now into the hand of the LORD; for very great are his mercies: but let me not fall into the hand of man.
bsb_text: David answered Gad, “I am deeply distressed. Please, let me fall into the hand of the LORD, for His mercies are very great; but do not let me fall into the hands of men.”
aov_text: Daarop sê Dawid vir Gad: Ek is baie benoud; laat my tog in die hand van die HERE val, want sy barmhartighede is baie groot, maar laat my in die hand van mense nie val nie.

kjv_text: So the LORD sent pestilence upon Israel: and there fell of Israel seventy thousand men.
bsb_text: So the LORD sent a plague upon Israel, and seventy thousand men of Israel fell dead.
aov_text: En die HERE het ’n pes onder Israel beskik, en van Israel het daar sewentigduisend man geval.

kjv_text: And God sent an angel unto Jerusalem to destroy it: and as he was destroying, the LORD beheld, and he repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed, It is enough, stay now thine hand. And the angel of the LORD stood by the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.
bsb_text: Then God sent an angel to destroy Jerusalem, but as the angel was doing so, the LORD saw it and relented from the calamity, and He said to the angel who was destroying the people, “Enough! Withdraw your hand now!” At that time the angel of the LORD was standing by the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
aov_text: En God het ’n engel na Jerusalem gestuur om dit te verwoes; en terwyl hy dit verwoes, het die HERE dit gesien, en dit het Hom berou oor die onheil, en Hy het aan die engel wat die verwoesting moes aanrig, gesê: Genoeg, trek nou jou hand terug! En die engel van die HERE het by die dorsvloer van Ornan, die Jebusiet, gestaan.

kjv_text: And David lifted up his eyes, and saw the angel of the LORD stand between the earth and the heaven, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders of Israel, who were clothed in sackcloth, fell upon their faces.
bsb_text: When David lifted up his eyes and saw the angel of the LORD standing between heaven and earth, with a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem, David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell facedown.
aov_text: Toe Dawid sy oë opslaan, sien hy die engel van die HERE staan tussen die aarde en die hemel met sy ontblote swaard in sy hand oor Jerusalem uitgestrek. Daarop val Dawid en die oudstes, met rouklere bedek, op hulle aangesig.

kjv_text: And David said unto God, Is it not I that commanded the people to be numbered? even I it is that have sinned and done evil indeed; but as for these sheep, what have they done? let thine hand, I pray thee, O LORD my God, be on me, and on my father's house; but not on thy people, that they should be plagued.
bsb_text: And David said to God, “Was it not I who gave the order to count the people? I am the one who has sinned and acted wickedly. But these sheep, what have they done? O LORD my God, please let Your hand fall upon me and my father’s house, but do not let this plague remain upon Your people.”
aov_text: En Dawid sê tot God: Is dit nie ék wat beveel het om die volk te tel nie? Ja, dit is ek wat gesondig en baie verkeerd gehandel het; maar hierdie skape, wat het hulle gedoen? HERE, my God, laat u hand tog teen my en my familie wees, maar nie as ’n plaag teen u volk nie.

kjv_text: Then the angel of the LORD commanded Gad to say to David, that David should go up, and set up an altar unto the LORD in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.
bsb_text: Then the angel of the LORD ordered Gad to tell David to go up and build an altar to the LORD on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
aov_text: Daarop gee die engel van die HERE bevel aan Gad om aan Dawid te sê dat Dawid moet opgaan om vir die HERE ’n altaar op te rig op die dorsvloer van Ornan, die Jebusiet.

kjv_text: And David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spake in the name of the LORD.
bsb_text: So David went up at the word that Gad had spoken in the name of the LORD.
aov_text: En Dawid het opgegaan volgens die woord van Gad wat hy in die Naam van die HERE gespreek het.

kjv_text: And Ornan turned back, and saw the angel; and his four sons with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.
bsb_text: Now Ornan was threshing wheat when he turned and saw the angel; and his four sons who were with him hid themselves.
aov_text: Toe Ornan hom omdraai, sien hy die engel; en sy vier seuns wat by hom was, het hulle weggesteek; Ornan het naamlik koring gedors.

kjv_text: And as David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshingfloor, and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground.
bsb_text: David came to Ornan, and when Ornan looked out and saw David, he left the threshing floor and bowed facedown before David.
aov_text: Toe Dawid by Ornan kom, het Ornan opgekyk en Dawid gesien, en hy het van die dorsvloer uitgegaan en hom voor Dawid met sy aangesig na die aarde gebuig.

kjv_text: Then David said to Ornan, Grant me the place of this threshingfloor, that I may build an altar therein unto the LORD: thou shalt grant it me for the full price: that the plague may be stayed from the people.
bsb_text: Then David said to Ornan, “Grant me the site of this threshing floor, that I may build an altar to the LORD. Sell it to me for the full price, so that the plague upon the people may be halted.”
aov_text: Daarop sê Dawid vir Ornan: Gee aan my die plek van die dorsvloer, dat ek daarop vir die HERE ’n altaar kan bou; gee dit aan my vir die volle geld, sodat die plaag van die volk afgewend kan word.

kjv_text: And Ornan said unto David, Take it to thee, and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes: lo, I give thee the oxen also for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meat offering; I give it all.
bsb_text: Ornan said to David, “My lord the king may take whatever seems good. Look, I will give the oxen for the burnt offerings, the threshing sledges for the wood, and the wheat for the grain offering—I will give it all.”
aov_text: Maar Ornan sê vir Dawid: Neem dit vir u, en laat my heer die koning doen wat goed is in sy oë; kyk, ek gee die beeste as brandoffers en die sleë as hout en die koring as ’n spysoffer; ek gee dit alles.

kjv_text: And king David said to Ornan, Nay; but I will verily buy it for the full price: for I will not take that which is thine for the LORD, nor offer burnt offerings without cost.
bsb_text: “No,” replied King David, “I insist on paying the full price, for I will not take for the LORD what belongs to you, nor will I offer burnt offerings that cost me nothing.”
aov_text: Maar koning Dawid het vir Ornan gesê: Nee, maar ek wil dit verseker koop vir die volle geld; want ek wil nie wat aan jou behoort, vir die HERE neem, dat ek verniet ’n brandoffer sou bring nie.

kjv_text: So David gave to Ornan for the place six hundred shekels of gold by weight.
bsb_text: So David paid Ornan six hundred shekels of gold for the site.
aov_text: En Dawid het vir die plek seshonderd sikkels goud in gewig aan Ornan gegee.

kjv_text: And David built there an altar unto the LORD, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called upon the LORD; and he answered him from heaven by fire upon the altar of burnt offering.
bsb_text: And there he built an altar to the LORD and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. He called upon the LORD, who answered him with fire from heaven on the altar of burnt offering.
aov_text: En Dawid het daar vir die HERE ’n altaar gebou en brandoffers en dankoffers gebring. Onderwyl hy die HERE aanroep, het Hy hom met vuur uit die hemel op die brandofferaltaar geantwoord.

kjv_text: And the LORD commanded the angel; and he put up his sword again into the sheath thereof.
bsb_text: Then the LORD spoke to the angel, who put his sword back into its sheath.
aov_text: En die HERE het die engel beveel om sy swaard weer in die skede te steek.

kjv_text: At that time when David saw that the LORD had answered him in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.
bsb_text: At that time, when David saw that the LORD had answered him at the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite, he offered sacrifices there.
aov_text: In dié tyd, toe Dawid sien dat die HERE hom geantwoord het op die dorsvloer van Ornan, die Jebusiet, het hy daar geoffer;

kjv_text: For the tabernacle of the LORD, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of the burnt offering, were at that season in the high place at Gibeon.
bsb_text: For the tabernacle of the LORD that Moses had made in the wilderness and the altar of burnt offering were presently at the high place in Gibeon,
aov_text: want die tabernakel van die HERE wat Moses in die woestyn gemaak het, en die brandofferaltaar was in dié tyd op die hoogte in Gíbeon.

kjv_text: But David could not go before it to enquire of God: for he was afraid because of the sword of the angel of the LORD.
bsb_text: but David could not go before it to inquire of God, because he was afraid of the sword of the angel of the LORD.
