aov_text: En Dawid het nie daarvoor durf verskyn om God te soek nie, want hy was verskrik vanweë die swaard van die engel van die HERE.

kjv_text: Then David said, This is the house of the LORD God, and this is the altar of the burnt offering for Israel.
bsb_text: Then David said, “Here shall be the house of the LORD God, as well as the altar of burnt offering for Israel.”
aov_text: EN Dawid het gesê: Dit is die huis van die HERE God, en dit is die brandofferaltaar vir Israel.

kjv_text: And David commanded to gather together the strangers that were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to hew wrought stones to build the house of God.
bsb_text: So David gave orders to gather the foreigners in the land of Israel, from whom he appointed stonecutters to prepare finished stones for building the house of God.
aov_text: En Dawid het bevel gegee om die vreemdelinge wat in die land van Israel was, te versamel, en hy het klipkappers aangestel om gekapte klippe reg te slaan om die huis van God te bou.

kjv_text: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, and for the joinings; and brass in abundance without weight;
bsb_text: David provided a large quantity of iron to make the nails for the doors of the gateways and for the fittings, together with more bronze than could be weighed
aov_text: En Dawid het yster in groot hoeveelheid byeengebring as spykers vir die poortdeure en as kramme, en koper in menigte, onweegbaar;

kjv_text: Also cedar trees in abundance: for the Zidonians and they of Tyre brought much cedar wood to David.
bsb_text: and more cedar logs than could be counted; for the Sidonians and Tyrians had brought a large quantity of cedar logs to David.
aov_text: verder sederblokke, ontelbaar; want die Sidoniërs en die Tiriërs het vir Dawid sederblokke in menigte gebring.

kjv_text: And David said, Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be builded for the LORD must be exceeding magnifical, of fame and of glory throughout all countries: I will therefore now make preparation for it. So David prepared abundantly before his death.
bsb_text: And David said, “My son Solomon is young and inexperienced, and the house to be built for the LORD must be exceedingly magnificent—famous and glorious throughout all lands. Therefore I must make preparations for it.” So David made lavish preparations before his death.
aov_text: Want Dawid het gesê: My seun Salomo is jonk en teer, en die huis wat vir die HERE gebou moet word, moet buitengewoon groot wees, tot ’n roem en ’n sieraad van al die lande; laat my dan vir hom die bou voorberei. Daarom het Dawid voor sy dood groot toebereidsels gemaak.

kjv_text: Then he called for Solomon his son, and charged him to build an house for the LORD God of Israel.
bsb_text: Then David called for his son Solomon and instructed him to build a house for the LORD, the God of Israel.
aov_text: Daarop het hy sy seun Salomo geroep en hom bevel gegee om ’n huis vir die HERE, die God van Israel, te bou.

kjv_text: And David said to Solomon, My son, as for me, it was in my mind to build an house unto the name of the LORD my God:
bsb_text: “My son,” said David to Solomon, “it was in my heart to build a house for the Name of the LORD my God,
aov_text: En Dawid het aan Salomo gesê: My seun, ek self het my voorgeneem om ’n huis te bou vir die Naam van die HERE my God.

kjv_text: But the word of the LORD came to me, saying, Thou hast shed blood abundantly, and hast made great wars: thou shalt not build an house unto my name, because thou hast shed much blood upon the earth in my sight.
bsb_text: but this word of the LORD came to me: ‘You have shed much blood and waged great wars. You are not to build a house for My Name because you have shed so much blood on the ground before Me.
aov_text: Maar die woord van die HERE het tot my gekom en gesê: Jy het bloed in menigte vergiet en groot oorloë gevoer: jy mag nie vir my Naam ’n huis bou nie, omdat jy baie bloed op die aarde voor my aangesig vergiet het.

kjv_text: Behold, a son shall be born to thee, who shall be a man of rest; and I will give him rest from all his enemies round about: for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness unto Israel in his days.
bsb_text: But a son will be born to you who will be a man of rest. I will give him rest from all his enemies on every side; for his name will be Solomon, and I will grant to Israel peace and quiet during his reign.
aov_text: Kyk, ’n seun sal vir jou gebore word; hý sal ’n man van rus wees, en Ek sal hom rus verskaf van al sy vyande rondom; want Salomo sal sy naam wees, en vrede en rus sal Ek oor Israel in sy dae gee.

kjv_text: He shall build an house for my name; and he shall be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel for ever.
bsb_text: He is the one who will build a house for My Name. He will be My son, and I will be his Father. And I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever.’
aov_text: Hý sal vir my Naam ’n huis bou, en hý sal vir My ’n seun wees, en Ek vir hom ’n Vader; en Ek sal die troon van sy koningskap oor Israel bevestig tot in ewigheid.

kjv_text: Now, my son, the LORD be with thee; and prosper thou, and build the house of the LORD thy God, as he hath said of thee.
bsb_text: Now, my son, may the LORD be with you, and may you succeed in building the house of the LORD your God, as He said you would.
aov_text: Nou, my seun, mag die HERE met jou wees, dat jy voorspoedig kan wees om die huis van die HERE jou God te bou soos Hy oor jou gespreek het.

kjv_text: Only the LORD give thee wisdom and understanding, and give thee charge concerning Israel, that thou mayest keep the law of the LORD thy God.
bsb_text: Above all, may the LORD give you insight and understanding when He puts you in command over Israel, so that you may keep the Law of the LORD your God.
aov_text: Mag die HERE jou net insig en verstand gee en jou aanstel oor Israel; en dit om die wet van die HERE jou God te onderhou.

kjv_text: Then shalt thou prosper, if thou takest heed to fulfil the statutes and judgments which the LORD charged Moses with concerning Israel: be strong, and of good courage; dread not, nor be dismayed.
bsb_text: Then you will succeed, if you carefully follow the statutes and ordinances that the LORD commanded Moses for Israel. Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid or discouraged.
aov_text: Dan sal jy voorspoedig wees as jy sorgvuldig die insettinge en verordeninge onderhou wat die HERE aan Moses oor Israel beveel het; wees sterk en vol moed, wees nie bevrees en wees nie verskrik nie.

kjv_text: Now, behold, in my trouble I have prepared for the house of the LORD an hundred thousand talents of gold, and a thousand thousand talents of silver; and of brass and iron without weight; for it is in abundance: timber also and stone have I prepared; and thou mayest add thereto.
bsb_text: Now behold, I have taken great pains to provide for the house of the LORD—100,000 talents of gold, 1,000,000 talents of silver, and bronze and iron too great to be weighed. I have also provided timber and stone, and you may add to them.
aov_text: En kyk, deur my moeitevolle arbeid het ek vir die huis van die HERE honderdduisend talente goud en ’n miljoen talente silwer gereed gelê, en die koper en die yster is onweegbaar; want dit is daar in groot hoeveelheid; en hout en klippe het ek in gereedheid gebring; en jy kan daar nog meer byvoeg.

kjv_text: Moreover there are workmen with thee in abundance, hewers and workers of stone and timber, and all manner of cunning men for every manner of work.
bsb_text: You also have many workers: stonecutters, masons, carpenters, and men skilled in every kind of work—
aov_text: Verder is daar by jou werksmense in menigte: klipkappers en ambagsmanne in klip en hout, en allerhande kunstenaars in allerhande werk.

kjv_text: Of the gold, the silver, and the brass, and the iron, there is no number. Arise therefore, and be doing, and the LORD be with thee.
bsb_text: in gold and silver, bronze and iron—craftsmen beyond number. Now begin the work, and may the LORD be with you.”
aov_text: Wat die goud, die silwer en die koper en die yster betref, dit is ontelbaar. Maak jou klaar en gaan aan die werk, en mag die HERE met jou wees!

kjv_text: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying,
bsb_text: Then David ordered all the leaders of Israel to help his son Solomon:
aov_text: En Dawid het al die vorste van Israel bevel gegee om sy seun Salomo te help, en gesê:

kjv_text: Is not the LORD your God with you? and hath he not given you rest on every side? for he hath given the inhabitants of the land into mine hand; and the land is subdued before the LORD, and before his people.
bsb_text: “Is not the LORD your God with you, and has He not granted you rest on every side? For He has given the inhabitants of the land into my hand, and the land has been subdued before the LORD and His people.
aov_text: Was die HERE julle God nie met julle en het Hy julle nie rondom rus gegee nie? Ja, Hy het die inwoners van die land in my hand gegee, en die land is voor die aangesig van die HERE en voor sy volk onderwerp.

kjv_text: Now set your heart and your soul to seek the LORD your God; arise therefore, and build ye the sanctuary of the LORD God, to bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and the holy vessels of God, into the house that is to be built to the name of the LORD.
bsb_text: Now set your heart and soul to seek the LORD your God. Get started building the sanctuary of the LORD God, so that you may bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD and the holy articles of God into the temple that will be built for the Name of the LORD.”
aov_text: Rig nou julle hart en julle siel daarop om die HERE julle God te soek, en maak julle gereed en bou die heiligdom van die HERE God, dat julle die verbondsark van die HERE en die heilige voorwerpe van God kan bring in die huis wat vir die Naam van die HERE gebou sal word.

kjv_text: So when David was old and full of days, he made Solomon his son king over Israel.
bsb_text: When David was old and full of years, he installed his son Solomon as king over Israel.
aov_text: TOE Dawid oud en afgeleef was, het hy sy seun Salomo koning oor Israel gemaak.

kjv_text: And he gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.
bsb_text: Then he gathered all the leaders of Israel, as well as the priests and Levites.
aov_text: En hy het al die vorste van Israel en die priesters en die Leviete bymekaar laat kom.

kjv_text: Now the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years and upward: and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty and eight thousand.
bsb_text: The Levites thirty years of age or older were counted, and the total number of men was 38,000.
aov_text: En die Leviete is getel, van dertig jaar oud en daarbo, en hulle getal was, hoof vir hoof, agt-en-dertigduisend man.

kjv_text: Of which, twenty and four thousand were to set forward the work of the house of the LORD; and six thousand were officers and judges:
bsb_text: “Of these,” said David, “24,000 are to oversee the work of the house of the LORD, 6,000 are to be officers and judges,
aov_text: Van hulle moet vier-en-twintigduisend toesig hou oor die werk in die huis van die HERE en sesduisend opsigters en regters wees;

kjv_text: Moreover four thousand were porters; and four thousand praised the LORD with the instruments which I made, said David, to praise therewith.
bsb_text: 4,000 are to be gatekeepers, and 4,000 are to praise the LORD with the instruments I have made for giving praise.”
aov_text: en vierduisend poortwagters en vierduisend lofsangers tot eer van die HERE met die instrumente wat ek, het Dawid gesê, gemaak het om lof te sing.

kjv_text: And David divided them into courses among the sons of Levi, namely, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
bsb_text: Then David divided the Levites into divisions according to the sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
aov_text: En Dawid het hulle verdeel in afdelings volgens die seuns van Levi: Gerson, Kehat en Merári.

kjv_text: Of the Gershonites were, Laadan, and Shimei.
bsb_text: The Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.
aov_text: Van die Gersoniete: Láedan en Símeï.

kjv_text: The sons of Laadan; the chief was Jehiel, and Zetham, and Joel, three.
bsb_text: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the first, Zetham, and Joel—three in all.
aov_text: Die seuns van Láedan was: die hoof Jehíël en Setam en Joël, drie;

kjv_text: The sons of Shimei; Shelomith, and Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the chief of the fathers of Laadan.
bsb_text: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran—three in all. These were the heads of the families of Ladan.
aov_text: die seuns van Símeï was: Selómit en Hasíël en Haran, drie; dit was die familiehoofde van Láedan.

kjv_text: And the sons of Shimei were, Jahath, Zina, and Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.
bsb_text: And the sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, Jeush, and Beriah. These were the sons of Shimei—four in all.
aov_text: En die seuns van Símeï was: Jahat, Sina en Jehus en Bería; dit was die vier seuns van Símeï.

kjv_text: And Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second: but Jeush and Beriah had not many sons; therefore they were in one reckoning, according to their father's house.
bsb_text: Jahath was the first and Zizah was the second; but Jeush and Beriah did not have many sons, so they were counted as one family and received a single assignment.
aov_text: En Jahat was die hoof, en Sisa die tweede; maar Jehus en Bería het nie baie kinders gehad nie, sodat hulle saam ’n familie, een klas gevorm het.

kjv_text: The sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.
bsb_text: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel—four in all.
aov_text: Die seuns van Kehat was: Amram, Jishar, Hebron en Ússiël, vier.

kjv_text: The sons of Amram; Aaron and Moses: and Aaron was separated, that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons for ever, to burn incense before the LORD, to minister unto him, and to bless in his name for ever.
bsb_text: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses. Aaron and his descendants were set apart forever to consecrate the most holy things, to burn incense before the LORD, to minister before Him, and to pronounce blessings in His name forever.
aov_text: Die seuns van Amram was Aäron en Moses. En Aäron is afgesonder om die hoogheilige dinge te heilig, hy en sy seuns, tot in ewigheid, om offerrook te laat opgaan voor die aangesig van die HERE, om Hom te dien en om in sy Naam tot in ewigheid te seën.

kjv_text: Now concerning Moses the man of God, his sons were named of the tribe of Levi.
bsb_text: As for Moses the man of God, his sons were named among the tribe of Levi.
aov_text: En wat Moses, die man van God, betref, sy seuns is by die stam van Levi gereken.

kjv_text: The sons of Moses were, Gershom, and Eliezer.
bsb_text: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.
aov_text: Die seuns van Moses was Gersom en Eliëser;

kjv_text: Of the sons of Gershom, Shebuel was the chief.
bsb_text: The descendants of Gershom: Shebuel was the first.
aov_text: die seuns van Gersom: Sébuel, die hoof.

kjv_text: And the sons of Eliezer were, Rehabiah the chief. And Eliezer had none other sons; but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.
bsb_text: The descendants of Eliezer: Rehabiah was the first. Eliezer did not have any other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very numerous.
aov_text: En die seuns van Eliëser was Rehábja, die hoof; en Eliëser het nie ander seuns gehad nie, maar die seuns van Rehábja het buitengewoon vermeerder;

kjv_text: Of the sons of Izhar; Shelomith the chief.
bsb_text: The sons of Izhar: Shelomith was the first.
aov_text: die seuns van Jishar: Selómit, die hoof;

kjv_text: Of the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
bsb_text: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah was the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
aov_text: die seuns van Hebron: Jería, die hoof, Amárja, die tweede, Jahásiël, die derde, en Jekámeam, die vierde;

kjv_text: Of the sons of Uzziel; Micah the first, and Jesiah the second.
bsb_text: The sons of Uzziel: Micah was the first and Isshiah the second.
aov_text: die seuns van Ússiël: Miga, die hoof, en Jissía, die tweede;

kjv_text: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. The sons of Mahli; Eleazar, and Kish.
bsb_text: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.
aov_text: die seuns van Merári: Magli en Musi; die seuns van Magli: Eleásar en Kis.

kjv_text: And Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters: and their brethren the sons of Kish took them.
bsb_text: Eleazar died without having any sons; he had only daughters. Their cousins, the sons of Kish, married them.
aov_text: En Eleásar het gesterwe en geen seuns gehad nie, net dogters; en die seuns van Kis, hulle verwante, het hulle geneem.

kjv_text: The sons of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jeremoth, three.
bsb_text: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth—three in all.
aov_text: Die seuns van Musi was Magli en Eder en Jéremot, drie.

kjv_text: These were the sons of Levi after the house of their fathers; even the chief of the fathers, as they were counted by number of names by their polls, that did the work for the service of the house of the LORD, from the age of twenty years and upward.
bsb_text: These were the descendants of Levi by their families—the heads of families, registered individually by name—those twenty years of age or older who worked in the service of the house of the LORD.
aov_text: Dit was die seuns van Levi volgens hulle families, die familiehoofde, soos hulle getel is volgens die getal name, hoof vir hoof, wat die dienswerk in die huis van die HERE gedoen het, van twintig jaar oud en daarbo.

kjv_text: For David said, The LORD God of Israel hath given rest unto his people, that they may dwell in Jerusalem for ever:
bsb_text: For David had said, “The LORD, the God of Israel, has given rest to His people and has come to dwell in Jerusalem forever.
aov_text: Want Dawid het gesê: Die HERE, die God van Israel, het aan sy volk rus gegee, en Hy woon in Jerusalem tot in ewigheid;

kjv_text: And also unto the Levites; they shall no more carry the tabernacle, nor any vessels of it for the service thereof.
bsb_text: So now the Levites no longer need to carry the tabernacle or any of the articles for its service.”
aov_text: so hoef die Leviete dan ook nie meer die tabernakel en al sy voorwerpe vir sy diens te dra nie.

kjv_text: For by the last words of David the Levites were numbered from twenty years old and above:
bsb_text: For according to the final instructions of David, the Levites twenty years of age or older were counted,
aov_text: (Want volgens die laaste woorde van Dawid was dít die telling van die kinders van Levi: van twintig jaar oud en daarbo.)

kjv_text: Because their office was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of the LORD, in the courts, and in the chambers, and in the purifying of all holy things, and the work of the service of the house of God;
bsb_text: but their duty was to assist the descendants of Aaron with the service of the house of the LORD, being responsible for the courts and chambers, the purification of all the holy things, and the work of the service of the house of God,
aov_text: Maar hulle plek was langs die seuns van Aäron vir die diens in die huis van die HERE, as opsigters oor die voorhowe en oor die kamers en oor die reiniging van al die heilige dinge en oor die dienswerk in die huis van God;

kjv_text: Both for the shewbread, and for the fine flour for meat offering, and for the unleavened cakes, and for that which is baked in the pan, and for that which is fried, and for all manner of measure and size;
bsb_text: as well as for the rows of the showbread, the fine flour for the grain offering, the wafers of unleavened bread, the baking, the mixing, and all measurements of quantity and size.
aov_text: en vir die toonbrode en vir die fynmeel van die spysoffer en vir die ongesuurde platkoeke en vir die bakplaat en vir die deurmekaargeroerde spysoffer en vir al die inhoudsmate en lengtemate;

kjv_text: And to stand every morning to thank and praise the LORD, and likewise at even;
bsb_text: They were also to stand every morning to give thanks and praise to the LORD, and likewise in the evening.
aov_text: en om môre vir môre te staan om die HERE te loof en te prys, en net so saans;

kjv_text: And to offer all burnt sacrifices unto the LORD in the sabbaths, in the new moons, and on the set feasts, by number, according to the order commanded unto them, continually before the LORD:
bsb_text: Whenever burnt offerings were presented to the LORD on the Sabbaths, New Moons, and appointed feasts, they were to serve regularly before the LORD in the numbers prescribed for them.
aov_text: en vir al die offerwerk van die brandoffers aan die HERE op die sabbatte, op die nuwemane en op die feestye, in getal volgens die verordeninge daarvoor, gedurigdeur voor die aangesig van die HERE.

kjv_text: And that they should keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the holy place, and the charge of the sons of Aaron their brethren, in the service of the house of the LORD.
bsb_text: So the Levites were to carry out the responsibilities for the Tent of Meeting and the Holy Place, and, under their brothers the descendants of Aaron, the service of the house of the LORD.
aov_text: So moes hulle dan die diens waarneem van die tent van samekoms en die diens van die heiligdom en die diens tot hulp van die seuns van Aäron, hulle broers, vir die dienswerk in die huis van die HERE.

kjv_text: Now these are the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
bsb_text: These were the divisions of the descendants of Aaron. The sons of Aaron were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
aov_text: OOK die seuns van Aäron het hulle afdelings gehad. Die seuns van Aäron was Nadab en Abíhu, Eleásar en Ítamar.

kjv_text: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children: therefore Eleazar and Ithamar executed the priest's office.
bsb_text: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father did, and they had no sons; so Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.
aov_text: Maar Nadab en Abíhu het in teenwoordigheid van hulle vader gesterwe, en hulle het geen seuns gehad nie, sodat Eleásar en Ítamar die priesteramp bedien het.

kjv_text: And David distributed them, both Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, according to their offices in their service.
bsb_text: With the help of Eleazar’s descendant Zadok and Ithamar’s descendant Ahimelech, David divided them according to the offices of their service.
aov_text: En Dawid saam met Sadok, uit die seuns van Eleásar, en Ahiméleg, uit die seuns van Ítamar, het hulle volgens hulle amp in hul diens ingedeel.

kjv_text: And there were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and thus were they divided. Among the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen chief men of the house of their fathers, and eight among the sons of Ithamar according to the house of their fathers.
bsb_text: Since more leaders were found among Eleazar’s descendants than those of Ithamar, they were divided accordingly. There were sixteen heads of families from the descendants of Eleazar and eight from the descendants of Ithamar.
aov_text: Maar toe dit blyk dat die seuns van Eleásar talryker was aan gesinshoofde as die seuns van Ítamar, het hulle dié so ingedeel: vir die seuns van Eleásar sestien familiehoofde en vir die seuns van Ítamar volgens hulle families agt.

kjv_text: Thus were they divided by lot, one sort with another; for the governors of the sanctuary, and governors of the house of God, were of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.
bsb_text: Thus they were divided by lot, for there were officers of the sanctuary and officers of God among both Eleazar’s and Ithamar’s descendants.
aov_text: En hulle het hul deur die lot verdeel, die een sowel as die ander; want daar was heilige vorste en vorste van God uit die seuns van Eleásar en onder die seuns van Ítamar.

kjv_text: And Shemaiah the son of Nethaneel the scribe, one of the Levites, wrote them before the king, and the princes, and Zadok the priest, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and before the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites: one principal household being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.
bsb_text: The scribe, Shemaiah son of Nethanel, a Levite, recorded their names in the presence of the king and of the officers: Zadok the priest, Ahimelech son of Abiathar, and the heads of families of the priests and the Levites—one family being taken from Eleazar, and then one from Ithamar.
aov_text: En Semája, die seun van Netáneël, die skrywer, uit die Leviete, het hulle opgeskrywe in teenwoordigheid van die koning en die vorste en die priester Sadok en Ahiméleg, die seun van Ábjatar, en die familiehoofde van die priesters en van die Leviete; een familie is uitgeloot vir Eleásar, en telkens weer vir Ítamar.

kjv_text: Now the first lot came forth to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,
bsb_text: The first lot fell to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,
aov_text: En die eerste lot het uitgekom vir Jójarib, die tweede vir Jedája,

kjv_text: The third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,
bsb_text: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,
aov_text: die derde vir Harim, die vierde vir Seórim,

kjv_text: The fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,
bsb_text: the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,
aov_text: die vyfde vir Malkía, die sesde vir Mijámin,

kjv_text: The seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,
bsb_text: the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,
aov_text: die sewende vir Hakkos, die agtste vir Abía,

kjv_text: The ninth to Jeshuah, the tenth to Shecaniah,
bsb_text: the ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,
aov_text: die negende vir Jésua, die tiende vir Segánja,

kjv_text: The eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,
bsb_text: the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,
aov_text: die elfde vir Éljasib, die twaalfde vir Jakim,

kjv_text: The thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,
bsb_text: the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,
aov_text: die dertiende vir Huppa, die veertiende vir Jesébeab,

kjv_text: The fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,
bsb_text: the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,
aov_text: die vyftiende vir Bilga, die sestiende vir Immer,

kjv_text: The seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Aphses,
bsb_text: the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Happizzez,
aov_text: die sewentiende vir Hesir, die agttiende vir Happísses,

kjv_text: The nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezekel,
bsb_text: the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezkel,
aov_text: die negentiende vir Petágja, die twintigste vir Eségiël,

kjv_text: The one and twentieth to Jachin, the two and twentieth to Gamul,
bsb_text: the twenty-first to Jachin, the twenty-second to Gamul,
aov_text: die een-en-twintigste vir Jagin, die twee-en-twintigste vir Gamul,

kjv_text: The three and twentieth to Delaiah, the four and twentieth to Maaziah.
bsb_text: the twenty-third to Delaiah, and the twenty-fourth to Maaziah.
aov_text: die drie-en-twintigste vir Delája, die vier-en-twintigste vir Maäsja.

kjv_text: These were the orderings of them in their service to come into the house of the LORD, according to their manner, under Aaron their father, as the LORD God of Israel had commanded him.
bsb_text: This was their appointed order for service when they entered the house of the LORD, according to the regulations prescribed for them by their forefather Aaron, as the LORD, the God of Israel, had commanded him.
aov_text: Dit was hulle ampsorde vir hul diens, om in die huis van die HERE te gaan volgens die verordening deur hul vader Aäron aan hulle, soos die HERE, die God van Israel, hom beveel het.

kjv_text: And the rest of the sons of Levi were these: Of the sons of Amram; Shubael: of the sons of Shubael; Jehdeiah.
bsb_text: Now these were the remaining descendants of Levi: From the sons of Amram: Shubael; from the sons of Shubael: Jehdeiah.
aov_text: WAT die orige seuns van Levi betref, van die seuns van Amram: Súbael; van die seuns van Súbael: Jégdeja.

kjv_text: Concerning Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, the first was Isshiah.
bsb_text: As for Rehabiah, from his sons: The first was Isshiah.
aov_text: Wat Rehábja betref, van die seuns van Rehábja: Jissía, die hoof.

kjv_text: Of the Izharites; Shelomoth: of the sons of Shelomoth; Jahath.
bsb_text: From the Izharites: Shelomoth; from the sons of Shelomoth: Jahath.
aov_text: Van die Jishariete: Selómot; van die seuns van Selómot: Jahat.

kjv_text: And the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.
bsb_text: From the sons of Hebron: Jeriah was the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
aov_text: En die seuns van Hebron: Jería, die eerste; Amárja, die tweede; Jahásiël, die derde; Jekámeam, die vierde.

kjv_text: Of the sons of Uzziel; Michah: of the sons of Michah; Shamir.
bsb_text: From the sons of Uzziel: Micah; from the sons of Micah: Shamir.
aov_text: Die seuns van Ússiël: Miga; van die seuns van Miga: Samir.

kjv_text: The brother of Michah was Isshiah: of the sons of Isshiah; Zechariah.
bsb_text: The brother of Micah: Isshiah; from the sons of Isshiah: Zechariah.
aov_text: Die broer van Miga was Jissía; van die seuns van Jissía: Sagaría.

kjv_text: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi: the sons of Jaaziah; Beno.
bsb_text: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The son of Jaaziah: Beno.
aov_text: Die seuns van Merári was Magli en Musi; die seuns van sy seun Jaäsía.

kjv_text: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah; Beno, and Shoham, and Zaccur, and Ibri.
bsb_text: The descendants of Merari from Jaaziah: Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.
aov_text: Die seuns van Merári deur sy seun Jaäsía was Soham en Sakkur en Hibri.

kjv_text: Of Mahli came Eleazar, who had no sons.
bsb_text: From Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.
aov_text: Van Magli: Eleásar; dié het geen seuns gehad nie.

kjv_text: Concerning Kish: the son of Kish was Jerahmeel.
bsb_text: From Kish: Jerahmeel the son of Kish.
aov_text: Wat Kis betref, die seuns van Kis was Jerágmeël.

kjv_text: The sons also of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites after the house of their fathers.
bsb_text: And the sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites, according to their families.
aov_text: En die seuns van Musi was Magli en Eder en Jérimot. Dit was die seuns van die Leviete volgens hulle families.

kjv_text: These likewise cast lots over against their brethren the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, and Zadok, and Ahimelech, and the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites, even the principal fathers over against their younger brethren.
bsb_text: As their brothers the descendants of Aaron did, they also cast lots in the presence of King David and of Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of the families of the priests and Levites—the family heads and their younger brothers alike.
aov_text: En hulle het ook die lot gewerp net soos hulle broers, die seuns van Aäron, in teenwoordigheid van koning Dawid en Sadok en Ahiméleg en die familiehoofde van die priesters en van die Leviete: die familiehoof net soos sy jonger broer.

kjv_text: Moreover David and the captains of the host separated to the service of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who should prophesy with harps, with psalteries, and with cymbals: and the number of the workmen according to their service was:
bsb_text: Additionally, David and the commanders of the army set apart some of the sons of Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun to prophesy with the accompaniment of lyres, harps, and cymbals. The following is the list of the men who performed this service:
aov_text: EN Dawid en die leërowerstes het vir die diens die seuns van Asaf en Heman en Jedútun afgesonder, wat op siters en op harpe en op simbale besield gespeel het, en die getal van hulle wat die werk volgens hulle diens gedoen het, was —

kjv_text: Of the sons of Asaph; Zaccur, and Joseph, and Nethaniah, and Asarelah, the sons of Asaph under the hands of Asaph, which prophesied according to the order of the king.
bsb_text: From the sons of Asaph: Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asarelah. These sons of Asaph were under the direction of Asaph, who prophesied under the direction of the king.
aov_text: van die seuns van Asaf: Sakkur en Josef en Netánja en Asaréla, die seuns van Asaf; onder leiding van Asaf wat volgens aanwysing van die koning besield gespeel het.

kjv_text: Of Jeduthun: the sons of Jeduthun; Gedaliah, and Zeri, and Jeshaiah, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with a harp, to give thanks and to praise the LORD.
bsb_text: From the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah—six in all—under the direction of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with the harp, giving thanks and praise to the LORD.
aov_text: Van Jedútun, die seuns van Jedútun was Gedálja en Seri en Jesaja, Hasábja, Símeï en Mattítja, ses, onder leiding van hulle vader Jedútun wat op die siter besield gespeel het by die loof en prys van die HERE;

kjv_text: Of Heman: the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, and Romamtiezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth:
bsb_text: From the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth.
aov_text: van Heman, die seuns van Heman was Bukkía, Mattánja, Ússiël, Sébuel en Jérimot, Hanánja, Hanáni, Eliáta, Giddálti en Romámti-Eser, Josbekása, Mallóti, Hotir, Mahásiot.

kjv_text: All these were the sons of Heman the king's seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. And God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.
bsb_text: All these sons of Heman the king’s seer were given him through the promises of God to exalt him, for God had given Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.
aov_text: Hulle almal was seuns van Heman, die siener van die koning in die woorde van God. Om hom te versterk, het God aan Heman veertien seuns en drie dogters gegee.

kjv_text: All these were under the hands of their father for song in the house of the LORD, with cymbals, psalteries, and harps, for the service of the house of God, according to the king's order to Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman.
bsb_text: All these were under the direction of their fathers for the music of the house of the LORD with cymbals, harps, and lyres, for the service of the house of God. Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman were under the direction of the king.
aov_text: Hulle almal was onder leiding van hulle vader by die gesang in die huis van die HERE, met simbale, harpe en siters, vir die diens in die huis van God volgens aanwysing van die koning: Asaf en Jedútun en Heman.

kjv_text: So the number of them, with their brethren that were instructed in the songs of the LORD, even all that were cunning, was two hundred fourscore and eight.
bsb_text: Together with their relatives, who were all trained and skillful in the songs of the LORD, they numbered 288.
aov_text: En hulle getal saam met hulle broers wat geoefend was in die gesang tot eer van die HERE, almal meesters, was tweehonderd-agt-en-tagtig.

kjv_text: And they cast lots, ward against ward, as well the small as the great, the teacher as the scholar.
bsb_text: They cast lots for their duties, young and old alike, teacher as well as pupil.
aov_text: En hulle het die lot gewerp vir die reëling van die diens, die kleinste net soos die grootste, die meester saam met die leerling.

kjv_text: Now the first lot came forth for Asaph to Joseph: the second to Gedaliah, who with his brethren and sons were twelve:
bsb_text: The first lot, which was for Asaph, fell to Joseph, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all; the second to Gedaliah, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
aov_text: En die eerste lot het uitgekom vir Asaf, naamlik vir Josef; die tweede vir Gedálja; hy en sy broers en sy seuns was twaalf;

kjv_text: The third to Zaccur, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
bsb_text: the third to Zaccur, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
aov_text: die derde vir Sakkur; sy seuns en sy broers, twaalf;

kjv_text: The fourth to Izri, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
bsb_text: the fourth to Izri, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
aov_text: die vierde vir Jisri; sy seuns en sy broers, twaalf;

kjv_text: The fifth to Nethaniah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
bsb_text: the fifth to Nethaniah, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
aov_text: die vyfde vir Netánja; sy seuns en sy broers, twaalf;

kjv_text: The sixth to Bukkiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
bsb_text: the sixth to Bukkiah, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
aov_text: die sesde vir Bukkía, sy seuns en sy broers, twaalf;

kjv_text: The seventh to Jesharelah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
bsb_text: the seventh to Jesarelah, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
aov_text: die sewende vir Jesaréla; sy seuns en sy broers, twaalf;

kjv_text: The eighth to Jeshaiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
bsb_text: the eighth to Jeshaiah, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
aov_text: die agtste vir Jesaja; sy seuns en sy broers, twaalf;

kjv_text: The ninth to Mattaniah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
bsb_text: the ninth to Mattaniah, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
aov_text: die negende vir Mattánja; sy seuns en sy broers, twaalf;

kjv_text: The tenth to Shimei, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
bsb_text: the tenth to Shimei, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
aov_text: die tiende vir Símeï; sy seuns en sy broers, twaalf;

kjv_text: The eleventh to Azareel, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
bsb_text: the eleventh to Azarel, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
aov_text: die elfde vir Asáreël; sy seuns en sy broers, twaalf;

kjv_text: The twelfth to Hashabiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
bsb_text: the twelfth to Hashabiah, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
aov_text: die twaalfde vir Hasábja; sy seuns en sy broers, twaalf;

kjv_text: The thirteenth to Shubael, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
bsb_text: the thirteenth to Shubael, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
aov_text: die dertiende vir Súbael; sy seuns en sy broers, twaalf;

kjv_text: The fourteenth to Mattithiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
bsb_text: the fourteenth to Mattithiah, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
aov_text: die veertiende vir Mattítja; sy seuns en sy broers, twaalf;

kjv_text: The fifteenth to Jeremoth, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
bsb_text: the fifteenth to Jeremoth, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
aov_text: die vyftiende vir Jéremot; sy seuns en sy broers, twaalf;

kjv_text: The sixteenth to Hananiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
bsb_text: the sixteenth to Hananiah, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
aov_text: die sestiende vir Hanánja; sy seuns en sy broers, twaalf;

kjv_text: The seventeenth to Joshbekashah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
bsb_text: the seventeenth to Joshbekashah, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
aov_text: die sewentiende vir Josbekása; sy seuns en sy broers, twaalf;

kjv_text: The eighteenth to Hanani, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
bsb_text: the eighteenth to Hanani, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
aov_text: die agttiende vir Hanáni; sy seuns en sy broers, twaalf;

kjv_text: The nineteenth to Mallothi, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
bsb_text: the nineteenth to Mallothi, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
aov_text: die negentiende vir Mallóti; sy seuns en sy broers, twaalf;

kjv_text: The twentieth to Eliathah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
bsb_text: the twentieth to Eliathah, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
aov_text: die twintigste vir Eliáta; sy seuns en sy broers, twaalf;

kjv_text: The one and twentieth to Hothir, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
bsb_text: the twenty-first to Hothir, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
aov_text: die een-en-twintigste vir Hotir; sy seuns en sy broers, twaalf;

kjv_text: The two and twentieth to Giddalti, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
bsb_text: the twenty-second to Giddalti, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
aov_text: die twee-en-twintigste vir Giddálti; sy seuns en sy broers, twaalf;

kjv_text: The three and twentieth to Mahazioth, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
bsb_text: the twenty-third to Mahazioth, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
aov_text: die drie-en-twintigste vir Mahásiot; sy seuns en sy broers, twaalf;

kjv_text: The four and twentieth to Romamtiezer, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve.
bsb_text: and the twenty-fourth to Romamti-ezer, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all.
aov_text: die vier-en-twintigste vir Romámti-Eser; sy seuns en sy broers, twaalf.

kjv_text: Concerning the divisions of the porters: Of the Korhites was Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.
bsb_text: These were the divisions of the gatekeepers: From the Korahites: Meshelemiah son of Kore, one of the sons of Asaph.
aov_text: WAT die afdelings van die poortwagters betref, by die Koragiete het behoort Meselémja, die seun van Korē, van die seuns van Ébjasaf.

kjv_text: And the sons of Meshelemiah were, Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,
bsb_text: Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,
aov_text: En Meselémja het seuns gehad: Sagaría, die eersgeborene, Jedíael, die tweede, Sebádja, die derde, Játniël, die vierde,

kjv_text: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, Elioenai the seventh.
bsb_text: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, and Eliehoenai the seventh.
aov_text: Elam, die vyfde, Jóhanan, die sesde, Eljehóënai, die sewende.

kjv_text: Moreover the sons of Obededom were, Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, and Sacar the fourth, and Nethaneel the fifth,
bsb_text: And Obed-edom also had sons: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, Sachar the fourth, Nethanel the fifth,
aov_text: Obed-Edom het ook seuns gehad: Semája was die eersgeborene, Jósabad die tweede, Joag die derde en Sagar die vierde en Netáneël die vyfde,

kjv_text: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peulthai the eighth: for God blessed him.
bsb_text: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, and Peullethai the eighth. For God had blessed Obed-edom.
aov_text: Ámmiël die sesde, Íssaskar die sewende, Peülletai die agtste; want God het hom geseën.

kjv_text: Also unto Shemaiah his son were sons born, that ruled throughout the house of their father: for they were mighty men of valour.
bsb_text: Also to his son Shemaiah were born sons who ruled over their families because they were strong, capable men.
aov_text: Ook vir sy seun Semája is seuns gebore wat in hulle familie geheers het, want hulle was dapper helde.

kjv_text: The sons of Shemaiah; Othni, and Rephael, and Obed, Elzabad, whose brethren were strong men, Elihu, and Semachiah.
bsb_text: Shemaiah’s sons were Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad; his brothers were Elihu and Semachiah, also capable men.
aov_text: Die seuns van Semája was Otni en Réfael en Obed, Élsabad; sy broers, flukse manne: Elíhu en Semágja.

kjv_text: All these of the sons of Obededom: they and their sons and their brethren, able men for strength for the service, were threescore and two of Obededom.
bsb_text: All these were descendants of Obed-edom; they and their sons and brothers were capable men with strength to do the work—62 in all from Obed-edom.
aov_text: Hulle almal was uit die seuns van Obed-Edom, hulle en hul seuns en hul broers, flukse manne, bekwaam vir die diens; twee-en-sestig van Obed-Edom.

kjv_text: And Meshelemiah had sons and brethren, strong men, eighteen.
bsb_text: Meshelemiah also had sons and brothers who were capable men—18 in all.
aov_text: Meselémja het ook seuns en broers gehad, flukse manne, agttien.

kjv_text: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons; Simri the chief, (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him the chief;)
bsb_text: Hosah the Merarite also had sons: Shimri the first (although he was not the firstborn, his father had appointed him as the first),
aov_text: En Hosa, uit die seuns van Merári, het seuns gehad: Simri was die hoof; wel was hy nie die eersgeborene nie, maar sy vader het hom as hoof aangestel.

kjv_text: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth: all the sons and brethren of Hosah were thirteen.
bsb_text: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, and Zechariah the fourth. The sons and brothers of Hosah numbered 13 in all.
aov_text: Hilkía was die tweede, Tebálja die derde, Sagaría die vierde; al die seuns en broers van Hosa was dertien.

kjv_text: Among these were the divisions of the porters, even among the chief men, having wards one against another, to minister in the house of the LORD.
bsb_text: These divisions of the gatekeepers, through their chief men, had duties for ministering in the house of the LORD, just as their brothers did.
aov_text: Hierdie afdelings van die poortwagters, die gesinshoofde, het die wag gehad net soos hulle broers, om te dien in die huis van die HERE.

kjv_text: And they cast lots, as well the small as the great, according to the house of their fathers, for every gate.
bsb_text: They cast lots for each gate, according to their families, young and old alike.
aov_text: En hulle het die lot gewerp, klein en groot, volgens hulle families vir elke poort.

kjv_text: And the lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counsellor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.
bsb_text: The lot for the East Gate fell to Shelemiah. Then lots were cast for his son Zechariah, a wise counselor, and the lot for the North Gate fell to him.
aov_text: En die lot vir die ooste het op Selémja geval; ook vir sy seun Sagaría, wat ’n verstandige raadgewer was, het hulle die lot gewerp, en sy lot het uitgekom vir die noorde;

kjv_text: To Obededom southward; and to his sons the house of Asuppim.
bsb_text: The lot for the South Gate fell to Obed-edom, and the lot for the storehouses to his sons.
aov_text: op Obed-Edom vir die suide; en op sy seuns vir die huis van die voorrade;

kjv_text: To Shuppim and Hosah the lot came forth westward, with the gate Shallecheth, by the causeway of the going up, ward against ward.
bsb_text: The lots for the West Gate and the Shallecheth Gate on the ascending highway fell to Shuppim and Hosah. There were guards stationed at every watch.
aov_text: op Suppim en op Hosa vir die weste by die poort Salléget aan die grootpad wat opdraand loop, wag naas wag.

kjv_text: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and toward Asuppim two and two.
bsb_text: Each day there were six Levites on the east, four on the north, four on the south, and two pairs at the storehouse.
aov_text: Vir die ooste was ses Leviete; vir die noorde daagliks vier; vir die suide daagliks vier; maar by die huis van die voorrade telkens twee.

kjv_text: At Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.
bsb_text: As for the court on the west, there were four at the highway and two at the court.
aov_text: By die aanbousel, vir die weste, was vier aan die grootpad, twee by die aanbousel.

kjv_text: These are the divisions of the porters among the sons of Kore, and among the sons of Merari.
bsb_text: These were the divisions of the gatekeepers who were descendants of Korah and Merari.
aov_text: Dit was die afdelings van die poortwagters van die seuns van die Koragiete en van die seuns van Merári.

kjv_text: And of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of the house of God, and over the treasures of the dedicated things.
bsb_text: Now their fellow Levites were in charge of the treasuries of the house of God and the treasuries of the dedicated things.
aov_text: EN die Leviete, hulle broers, oor die skatte van die huis van God en oor die skatte van die heilige gawes was:

kjv_text: As concerning the sons of Laadan; the sons of the Gershonite Laadan, chief fathers, even of Laadan the Gershonite, were Jehieli.
bsb_text: From the descendants of Ladan, who were Gershonites through Ladan and heads of the families of Ladan the Gershonite, were Jehieli,
aov_text: die seuns van Láedan, die seuns van die Gersoniet Láedan, die familiehoofde van Láedan, die Gersoniet: Jehiëli;

kjv_text: The sons of Jehieli; Zetham, and Joel his brother, which were over the treasures of the house of the LORD.
bsb_text: the sons of Jehieli, Zetham, and his brother Joel. They were in charge of the treasuries of the house of the LORD.
aov_text: die seuns van Jehiëli: Setam en Joël, sy broer, was oor die skatte van die huis van die HERE.

kjv_text: Of the Amramites, and the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites:
bsb_text: From the Amramites, the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites:
aov_text: Wat die Amramiete, die Jishariete, die Hebroniete, die Ussiëliete betref,

kjv_text: And Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler of the treasures.
bsb_text: Shebuel, a descendant of Gershom son of Moses, was the officer in charge of the treasuries.
aov_text: Sébuel, die seun van Gersom, die seun van Moses, was owerste oor die skatte.

kjv_text: And his brethren by Eliezer; Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomith his son.
bsb_text: His relatives through Eliezer included Rehabiah his son, Jeshaiah his son, Joram his son, Zichri his son, and Shelomith his son.
aov_text: En wat sy broers, van Eliëser afkomstig, betref, sy seun was Rehábja, en sy seun Jesaja, en sy seun Joram, en sy seun Sigri, en sy seun Selómot.

kjv_text: Which Shelomith and his brethren were over all the treasures of the dedicated things, which David the king, and the chief fathers, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the host, had dedicated.
bsb_text: This Shelomith and his brothers were in charge of all the treasuries for the things dedicated by King David, by the heads of families who were the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, and by the army commanders.
aov_text: Hierdie Selómot en sy broers was oor al die skatte van die heilige gawes wat koning Dawid en die familiehoofde, en die owerstes oor duisend en oor honderd en die leërowerstes, geheilig het —

kjv_text: Out of the spoils won in battles did they dedicate to maintain the house of the LORD.
bsb_text: They had dedicated some of the plunder from their battles to the repair of the house of the LORD.
aov_text: van die oorloë en van die buit het hulle dit geheilig om die huis van die HERE daarmee uit te rus —

kjv_text: And all that Samuel the seer, and Saul the son of Kish, and Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah, had dedicated; and whosoever had dedicated any thing, it was under the hand of Shelomith, and of his brethren.
bsb_text: Everything that had been dedicated by Samuel the seer, Saul son of Kish, Abner son of Ner, and Joab son of Zeruiah, along with everything else that was dedicated, was under the care of Shelomith and his brothers.
aov_text: ook alles wat die siener Samuel geheilig het, en Saul, die seun van Kis, en Abner, die seun van Ner, en Joab, die seun van Serúja—wie ook al iets geheilig het, was onder bewaring van Selómot en sy broers.

kjv_text: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were for the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.
bsb_text: From the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons had the outside duties as officers and judges over Israel.
aov_text: VAN die Jishariete was Kenánja en sy seuns opsigters en regters oor Israel vir die uitwendige sake;

kjv_text: And of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brethren, men of valour, a thousand and seven hundred, were officers among them of Israel on this side Jordan westward in all the business of the LORD, and in the service of the king.
bsb_text: From the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his relatives, 1,700 capable men, had charge of the affairs of Israel west of the Jordan for all the work of the LORD and for the service of the king.
aov_text: van die Hebroniete het Hasábja en sy broers, dapper manne, duisend-sewehonderd, die opsig gehad oor Israel, duskant die Jordaan na die weste toe, vir enige werk van die HERE en vir die diens van die koning.

kjv_text: Among the Hebronites was Jerijah the chief, even among the Hebronites, according to the generations of his fathers. In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were sought for, and there were found among them mighty men of valour at Jazer of Gilead.
bsb_text: As for the Hebronites, Jerijah was the chief of the Hebronites, according to the genealogies of his ancestors. In the fortieth year of David’s reign the records were searched, and strong, capable men were found among the Hebronites at Jazer in Gilead.
aov_text: Van die Hebroniete was Jería die hoof—daar is na die Hebroniete volgens hulle afstamming, volgens families, ’n ondersoek ingestel in die veertigste jaar van die koningskap van Dawid, en daar is onder hulle dapper helde gevind in Jaéser in Gílead —

kjv_text: And his brethren, men of valour, were two thousand and seven hundred chief fathers, whom king David made rulers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, for every matter pertaining to God, and affairs of the king.
bsb_text: Among Jerijah’s relatives there were 2,700 capable men who were heads of families. King David appointed them over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh for every matter pertaining to God and to the affairs of the king.
aov_text: en sy broers, dapper manne, tweeduisend-sewehonderd familiehoofde; en koning Dawid het hulle aangestel oor die Rubeniete en die Gadiete en die halwe stam van die Manassiete vir enige saak van God en enige saak van die koning.

kjv_text: Now the children of Israel after their number, to wit, the chief fathers and captains of thousands and hundreds, and their officers that served the king in any matter of the courses, which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year, of every course were twenty and four thousand.
bsb_text: This is the list of the Israelites—the heads of families, the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, and their officers who served the king in every matter concerning the divisions on rotating military duty each month throughout the year. There were 24,000 men in each division:
aov_text: EN dit is die seuns van Israel volgens hulle getal, die familiehoofde en die owerstes oor duisend en oor honderd en hulle opsigters, wat die koning gedien het in al die sake van die afdelings wat maand vir maand gedurende al die maande van die jaar ingekom en uitgegaan het; elke afdeling was vier-en-twintigduisend:

kjv_text: Over the first course for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
bsb_text: Jashobeam son of Zabdiel was in charge of the first division, which was assigned the first month. There were 24,000 men in his division.
aov_text: oor die eerste afdeling vir die eerste maand was Jasóbeam, die seun van Sábdiël; en by sy afdeling was vier-en-twintigduisend.

kjv_text: Of the children of Perez was the chief of all the captains of the host for the first month.
bsb_text: He was a descendant of Perez and chief of all the army commanders for the first month.
aov_text: Uit die seuns van Peres was hy die hoof van al die leërowerstes vir die eerste maand.

kjv_text: And over the course of the second month was Dodai an Ahohite, and of his course was Mikloth also the ruler: in his course likewise were twenty and four thousand.
bsb_text: Dodai the Ahohite was in charge of the division for the second month, and Mikloth was the leader. There were 24,000 men in his division.
aov_text: En oor die afdeling vir die tweede maand was Dódai, die Ahohiet; en oor sy afdeling was die bevelhebber Miklot; by sy afdeling was ook vier-en-twintigduisend.

kjv_text: The third captain of the host for the third month was Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, a chief priest: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
bsb_text: The third army commander, as chief for the third month, was Benaiah son of Jehoiada the priest. There were 24,000 men in his division.
aov_text: Die derde leërowerste vir die derde maand was Benája, die seun van Jójada, die hoëpriester, en by sy afdeling was vier-en-twintigduisend.

kjv_text: This is that Benaiah, who was mighty among the thirty, and above the thirty: and in his course was Ammizabad his son.
bsb_text: This Benaiah was mighty among the Thirty and was over the Thirty, and his son Ammizabad was in charge of his division.
aov_text: Hierdie Benája was ’n held van die dertig en oor die dertig, en oor sy afdeling was sy seun, Ammísabad.

kjv_text: The fourth captain for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
bsb_text: The fourth, for the fourth month, was Joab’s brother Asahel, and his son Zebadiah was commander after him. There were 24,000 men in his division.
aov_text: Die vierde vir die vierde maand was Ásahel, die broer van Joab, en ná hom sy seun Sebádja; by sy afdeling was ook vier-en-twintigduisend.

kjv_text: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
bsb_text: The fifth, for the fifth month, was the commander Shamhuth the Izrahite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
aov_text: Die vyfde vir die vyfde maand was die owerste Samhut, die Jisragiet; by sy afdeling was ook vier-en-twintigduisend.

kjv_text: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
bsb_text: The sixth, for the sixth month, was Ira son of Ikkesh the Tekoite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
aov_text: Die sesde vir die sesde maand was Ira, die seun van Ikkes, die Tekoïet; by sy afdeling was ook vier-en-twintigduisend.

kjv_text: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
bsb_text: The seventh, for the seventh month, was Helez the Pelonite, an Ephraimite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
aov_text: Die sewende vir die sewende maand was Heles, die Peloniet, uit die seuns van Efraim; by sy afdeling was ook vier-en-twintigduisend.

kjv_text: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
bsb_text: The eighth, for the eighth month, was Sibbecai the Hushathite, a Zerahite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
aov_text: Die agtste vir die agtste maand was Síbbegai, die Husatiet, van die Sargiete; by sy afdeling was ook vier-en-twintigduisend.

kjv_text: The ninth captain for the ninth month was Abiezer the Anetothite, of the Benjamites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
bsb_text: The ninth, for the ninth month, was Abiezer the Anathothite, a Benjamite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
aov_text: Die negende vir die negende maand was Abiëser, die Anatotiet, van die Benjaminiete; by sy afdeling was ook vier-en-twintigduisend.

kjv_text: The tenth captain for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
bsb_text: The tenth, for the tenth month, was Maharai the Netophathite, a Zerahite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
aov_text: Die tiende vir die tiende maand was Máharai, die Netofatiet, van die Sargiete; by sy afdeling was ook vier-en-twintigduisend.

kjv_text: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
bsb_text: The eleventh, for the eleventh month, was Benaiah the Pirathonite, an Ephraimite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
aov_text: Die elfde vir die elfde maand was Benája, die Pireatoniet, uit die seuns van Efraim; by sy afdeling was ook vier-en-twintigduisend.

kjv_text: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
bsb_text: The twelfth, for the twelfth month, was Heldai the Netophathite, from the family of Othniel. There were 24,000 men in his division.
aov_text: Die twaalfde vir die twaalfde maand was Héldai, die Netofatiet, van Ótniël afkomstig; by sy afdeling was ook vier-en-twintigduisend.

kjv_text: Furthermore over the tribes of Israel: the ruler of the Reubenites was Eliezer the son of Zichri: of the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maachah:
bsb_text: These officers were in charge of the tribes of Israel: Over the Reubenites was Eliezer son of Zichri; over the Simeonites was Shephatiah son of Maacah;
aov_text: EN oor die stamme van Israel: bevelhebber oor die Rubeniete was Eliëser, die seun van Sigri; oor die Simeoniete was Safátja, die seun van Máäga;

kjv_text: Of the Levites, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel: of the Aaronites, Zadok:
bsb_text: over Levi was Hashabiah son of Kemuel; over Aaron was Zadok;
aov_text: oor die Leviete was Hasábja, die seun van Kémuel; oor die Aäroniete, Sadok;

kjv_text: Of Judah, Elihu, one of the brethren of David: of Issachar, Omri the son of Michael:
bsb_text: over Judah was Elihu, one of David’s brothers; over Issachar was Omri son of Michael;
aov_text: oor Juda was Elíhu, uit die broers van Dawid; oor Íssaskar was Omri, die seun van Mígael;

kjv_text: Of Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah: of Naphtali, Jerimoth the son of Azriel:
bsb_text: over Zebulun was Ishmaiah son of Obadiah; over Naphtali was Jerimoth son of Azriel;
aov_text: oor Sébulon was Jismája, die seun van Obádja; oor Náftali was Jérimot, die seun van Ásriël;

kjv_text: Of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah: of the half tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah:
bsb_text: over the Ephraimites was Hoshea son of Azaziah; over one of the half-tribes of Manasseh was Joel son of Pedaiah;
aov_text: oor die seuns van Efraim was Hoséa, die seun van Asásja; oor die halwe stam van Manasse was Joël, die seun van Pedája;

kjv_text: Of the half tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the son of Zechariah: of Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner:
bsb_text: over the half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead was Iddo son of Zechariah; over Benjamin was Jaasiel son of Abner;
aov_text: oor die halwe Manasse in Gílead was Iddo, die seun van Sagaría; oor Benjamin was Jaäsiël, die seun van Abner;

kjv_text: Of Dan, Azareel the son of Jeroham. These were the princes of the tribes of Israel.
bsb_text: and over Dan was Azarel son of Jeroham. These were the leaders of the tribes of Israel.
aov_text: oor Dan was Asáreël, die seun van Jeróham. Dit was die owerstes van die stamme van Israel.

kjv_text: But David took not the number of them from twenty years old and under: because the LORD had said he would increase Israel like to the stars of the heavens.
bsb_text: David did not count the men aged twenty or under, because the LORD had said that He would make Israel as numerous as the stars of the sky.
aov_text: Maar Dawid het die getal van die wat twintig jaar oud was en daaronder, nie laat opneem nie; want die HERE het gesê dat Hy Israel sou vermeerder soos die sterre aan die hemel.

kjv_text: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to number, but he finished not, because there fell wrath for it against Israel; neither was the number put in the account of the chronicles of king David.
bsb_text: Joab son of Zeruiah began to count the men but did not finish. For because of this census wrath came upon Israel, and the number was not entered in the Book of the Chronicles of King David.
aov_text: Joab, die seun van Serúja, het begin tel, maar nie voleindig nie, omdat hieroor ’n toorn oor Israel gekom het; daarom is die getal nie opgeneem in die optelling in die Kronieke van koning Dawid nie.

kjv_text: And over the king's treasures was Azmaveth the son of Adiel: and over the storehouses in the fields, in the cities, and in the villages, and in the castles, was Jehonathan the son of Uzziah:
bsb_text: Azmaveth son of Adiel was in charge of the royal storehouses. Jonathan son of Uzziah was in charge of the storehouses in the country, in the cities, in the villages, and in the fortresses.
aov_text: EN oor die skatte van die koning was Asmáwet, die seun van Ádiël; en oor die skatte in die land, in die stede en in die dorpe en in die torings, was Jónatan, die seun van Ussía.

kjv_text: And over them that did the work of the field for tillage of the ground was Ezri the son of Chelub:
bsb_text: Ezri son of Chelub was in charge of the workers in the fields who tilled the soil.
aov_text: En oor die landarbeiders, vir die landbou, was Esri, die seun van Kelub.

kjv_text: And over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite: over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars was Zabdi the Shiphmite:
bsb_text: Shimei the Ramathite was in charge of the vineyards. Zabdi the Shiphmite was in charge of the produce of the vineyards for the wine vats.
aov_text: En oor die wingerde was Símeï, die Ramatiet; en oor wat in die wingerde was aan wynvoorrade, was Sabdi, die Sifmiet.

kjv_text: And over the olive trees and the sycomore trees that were in the low plains was Baalhanan the Gederite: and over the cellars of oil was Joash:
bsb_text: Baal-hanan the Gederite was in charge of the olive and sycamore trees in the foothills. Joash was in charge of the stores of olive oil.
aov_text: En oor die olyfbome en die wildevyebome wat in die Laeveld is, was Baäl-Hanan, die Gederiet; en oor die olievoorrade was Joas.

kjv_text: And over the herds that fed in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite: and over the herds that were in the valleys was Shaphat the son of Adlai:
bsb_text: Shitrai the Sharonite was in charge of the herds grazing in Sharon. Shaphat son of Adlai was in charge of the herds in the valleys.
aov_text: En oor die beeste wat in Saron gewei het, was Sítrai, die Saroniet; maar oor die beeste in die vlaktes was Safat, die seun van Ádlai.

kjv_text: Over the camels also was Obil the Ishmaelite: and over the asses was Jehdeiah the Meronothite:
bsb_text: Obil the Ishmaelite was in charge of the camels. Jehdeiah the Meronothite was in charge of the donkeys.
aov_text: En oor die kamele was Obil, die Ismaeliet; en oor die eselinne was Jégdeja, die Meronotiet.

kjv_text: And over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagerite. All these were the rulers of the substance which was king David's.
bsb_text: Jaziz the Hagrite was in charge of the flocks. All these officials were in charge of King David’s property.
aov_text: En oor die kleinvee was Jasis, die Hagriet. Hulle almal was owerstes oor die besittinge van koning Dawid.

kjv_text: Also Jonathan David's uncle was a counsellor, a wise man, and a scribe: and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king's sons:
bsb_text: David’s uncle Jonathan was a counselor; he was a man of insight and a scribe. Jehiel son of Hachmoni attended to the sons of the king.
aov_text: En Jónatan, die oom van Dawid, was raadgewer; hy was ’n man van deursig en ’n geleerde; en Jéhiël, die seun van Hagmóni, was by die seuns van die koning.

kjv_text: And Ahithophel was the king's counsellor: and Hushai the Archite was the king's companion:
bsb_text: Ahithophel was the king’s counselor. Hushai the Archite was the king’s friend.
aov_text: En Agitófel was raadgewer van die koning; en Húsai, die Arkiet, was die vriend van die koning.

kjv_text: And after Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar: and the general of the king's army was Joab.
bsb_text: Ahithophel was succeeded by Jehoiada son of Benaiah, then by Abiathar. Joab was the commander of the king’s army.
aov_text: En ná Agitófel: Jójada, die seun van Benája, en Ábjatar; en die leërowerste van die koning was Joab.

kjv_text: And David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, and the captains of the companies that ministered to the king by course, and the captains over the thousands, and captains over the hundreds, and the stewards over all the substance and possession of the king, and of his sons, with the officers, and with the mighty men, and with all the valiant men, unto Jerusalem.
bsb_text: Now David summoned all the leaders of Israel to Jerusalem: the leaders of the tribes, the leaders of the divisions in the king’s service, the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, and the officials in charge of all the property and cattle of the king and his sons, along with the court officials and mighty men—every mighty man of valor.
aov_text: TOE het Dawid al die owerstes van Israel, die stamowerstes en die owerstes van die afdelings wat in die koning se diens was, en die owerstes oor duisend en die owerstes oor honderd en die owerstes oor al die besittings en vee van die koning en sy seuns, saam met die hofdienaars en die helde en elke dapper man in Jerusalem bymekaar laat kom.

kjv_text: Then David the king stood up upon his feet, and said, Hear me, my brethren, and my people: As for me, I had in mine heart to build an house of rest for the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and for the footstool of our God, and had made ready for the building:
bsb_text: Then King David rose to his feet and said, “Listen to me, my brothers and my people. It was in my heart to build a house as a resting place for the ark of the covenant of the LORD and as a footstool for our God. I had made preparations to build it,
aov_text: En koning Dawid het hom opgerig in staande houding en gesê: Luister na my, my broers en my volk! Ek self het my voorgeneem om ’n huis van rus vir die verbondsark van die HERE te bou en vir die voetbank van onse God, en ek het toebereidsels getref vir die bou.

kjv_text: But God said unto me, Thou shalt not build an house for my name, because thou hast been a man of war, and hast shed blood.
bsb_text: but God said to me, ‘You are not to build a house for My Name, because you are a man of war who has spilled blood.’
aov_text: Maar God het aan my gesê: Jy mag vir my Naam nie ’n huis bou nie, want jy is ’n man van oorloë, en jy het bloed vergiet.

kjv_text: Howbeit the LORD God of Israel chose me before all the house of my father to be king over Israel for ever: for he hath chosen Judah to be the ruler; and of the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he liked me to make me king over all Israel:
bsb_text: Yet the LORD, the God of Israel, chose me out of all my father’s house to be king over Israel forever. For He chose Judah as leader, and from the house of Judah He chose my father’s household, and from my father’s sons He was pleased to make me king over all Israel.
aov_text: Maar die HERE, die God van Israel, het my verkies uit my hele familie om vir altyd koning oor Israel te wees; want Hy het Juda as vors verkies, en in die huis van Juda my familie; en onder die seuns van my vader het Hy in my behae gehad om my koning te maak oor die hele Israel.

kjv_text: And of all my sons, (for the LORD hath given me many sons,) he hath chosen Solomon my son to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of the LORD over Israel.
bsb_text: And of all my sons—for the LORD has given me many sons—He has chosen Solomon my son to sit on the throne of the kingdom of the LORD over Israel.
aov_text: En uit al my seuns—want die HERE het my baie seuns gegee—het Hy my seun Salomo verkies om te sit op die troon van die koningskap van die HERE oor Israel.

kjv_text: And he said unto me, Solomon thy son, he shall build my house and my courts: for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.
bsb_text: And He said to me, ‘Solomon your son is the one who will build My house and My courts, for I have chosen him as My son, and I will be his Father.
aov_text: En Hy het aan my gesê: Jou seun Salomo, hy sal my huis en my voorhowe bou, want Ek het hom vir My as ’n seun verkies, en Ék sal vir hom ’n Vader wees.

kjv_text: Moreover I will establish his kingdom for ever, if he be constant to do my commandments and my judgments, as at this day.
bsb_text: I will establish his kingdom forever, if he resolutely carries out My commandments and ordinances, as is being done this day.’
aov_text: En Ek sal sy koningskap bevestig tot in ewigheid as hy getrou my gebooie en my verordeninge onderhou, soos vandag.

kjv_text: Now therefore in the sight of all Israel the congregation of the LORD, and in the audience of our God, keep and seek for all the commandments of the LORD your God: that ye may possess this good land, and leave it for an inheritance for your children after you for ever.
bsb_text: So now in the sight of all Israel, the assembly of the LORD, and in the hearing of our God, keep and seek out all the commandments of the LORD your God, so that you may possess this good land and leave it as an inheritance to your descendants forever.
aov_text: Nou dan, voor die oë van die hele Israel, die vergadering van die HERE, en voor die ore van onse God: Onderhou en soek al die gebooie van die HERE julle God, sodat julle hierdie goeie land kan besit en julle kinders ná julle tot in ewigheid kan laat erwe.

kjv_text: And thou, Solomon my son, know thou the God of thy father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind: for the LORD searcheth all hearts, and understandeth all the imaginations of the thoughts: if thou seek him, he will be found of thee; but if thou forsake him, he will cast thee off for ever.
bsb_text: As for you, Solomon my son, know the God of your father and serve Him wholeheartedly and with a willing mind, for the LORD searches every heart and understands the intent of every thought. If you seek Him, He will be found by you; but if you forsake Him, He will reject you forever.
aov_text: En jy, my seun Salomo, ken die God van jou vader en dien Hom met ’n volkome hart en met ’n gewillige siel, want die HERE deursoek al die harte, en Hy verstaan elke versinsel van die gedagtes. As jy Hom soek, sal Hy Hom deur jou laat vind; maar as jy Hom verlaat, sal Hy jou vir altyd verstoot.

kjv_text: Take heed now; for the LORD hath chosen thee to build an house for the sanctuary: be strong, and do it.
bsb_text: Consider now that the LORD has chosen you to build a house for the sanctuary. Be strong and do it.”
aov_text: Kyk nou, die HERE het jou verkies om ’n huis vir ’n heiligdom te bou; wees sterk en voer dit uit.

kjv_text: Then David gave to Solomon his son the pattern of the porch, and of the houses thereof, and of the treasuries thereof, and of the upper chambers thereof, and of the inner parlours thereof, and of the place of the mercy seat,
bsb_text: Then David gave his son Solomon the plans for the portico of the temple, its buildings, storehouses, upper rooms, inner rooms, and the room for the mercy seat.
aov_text: En Dawid het aan sy seun Salomo ’n voorbeeld gegee van die voorportaal en die daarby behorende geboue, van sy skatkamers en sy bovertrekke en sy binnevertrekke en van die vertrek van die versoendeksel;

kjv_text: And the pattern of all that he had by the spirit, of the courts of the house of the LORD, and of all the chambers round about, of the treasuries of the house of God, and of the treasuries of the dedicated things:
bsb_text: The plans contained everything David had in mind for the courts of the house of the LORD, for all the surrounding rooms, for the treasuries of the house of God and of the dedicated things,
aov_text: en ’n voorbeeld van alles wat by hom in die gees was: van die voorhowe van die huis van die HERE en van al die kamers rondom en die skatkamers van die huis van God en die skatkamers van die heilige gawes;

kjv_text: Also for the courses of the priests and the Levites, and for all the work of the service of the house of the LORD, and for all the vessels of service in the house of the LORD.
bsb_text: for the divisions of the priests and Levites, for all the work of service in the house of the LORD, and for all the articles of service in the house of the LORD:
aov_text: en van die afdelings van die priesters en die Leviete, en van al die dienswerk in die huis van die HERE en al die gereedskappe vir die diens in die huis van die HERE;

kjv_text: He gave of gold by weight for things of gold, for all instruments of all manner of service; silver also for all instruments of silver by weight, for all instruments of every kind of service:
bsb_text: the weight of all the gold articles for every kind of service; the weight of all the silver articles for every kind of service;
aov_text: aan goud, het hy gegee, volgens die gewig aan goud vir al die gereedskappe van elke diens; vir al die silwergereedskappe volgens die gewig, vir al die gereedskappe van elke diens;

kjv_text: Even the weight for the candlesticks of gold, and for their lamps of gold, by weight for every candlestick, and for the lamps thereof: and for the candlesticks of silver by weight, both for the candlestick, and also for the lamps thereof, according to the use of every candlestick.
bsb_text: the weight of the gold lampstands and their lamps, including the weight of each lampstand and its lamps; the weight of each silver lampstand and its lamps, according to the use of each lampstand;
aov_text: en die gewig aan goud vir die goue kandelaars en hulle lampe volgens die gewig van elke kandelaar en sy lampe; en vir die silwerkandelaars volgens die gewig van ’n kandelaar en sy lampe, ooreenkomstig die diens van elke kandelaar;

kjv_text: And by weight he gave gold for the tables of shewbread, for every table; and likewise silver for the tables of silver:
bsb_text: the weight of gold for each table of showbread, and of silver for the silver tables;
aov_text: en die goud volgens gewig vir die tafels van die toonbrode, vir elke tafel afsonderlik, en silwer vir die silwertafels;

kjv_text: Also pure gold for the fleshhooks, and the bowls, and the cups: and for the golden basons he gave gold by weight for every bason; and likewise silver by weight for every bason of silver:
bsb_text: the weight of the pure gold for the forks, sprinkling bowls, and pitchers; the weight of each gold dish; the weight of each silver bowl;
aov_text: en vir die vurke en komme en kanne, suiwer goud, en vir die goue bekers volgens die gewig van elke beker afsonderlik, en vir die silwerbekers volgens die gewig van elke beker afsonderlik;

kjv_text: And for the altar of incense refined gold by weight; and gold for the pattern of the chariot of the cherubims, that spread out their wings, and covered the ark of the covenant of the LORD.
bsb_text: the weight of the refined gold for the altar of incense; and the plans for the chariot of the gold cherubim that spread their wings and overshadowed the ark of the covenant of the LORD.
aov_text: en vir die reukaltaar gelouterde goud volgens gewig; en goud vir die voorbeeld van die wa, die gérubs, wat hul vlerke moet uitsprei en die verbondsark van die HERE moet beskut.
