kjv_text: And the king arising from the banquet of wine in his wrath went into the palace garden: and Haman stood up to make request for his life to Esther the queen; for he saw that there was evil determined against him by the king.
bsb_text: In his fury, the king arose from drinking his wine and went to the palace garden, while Haman stayed behind to beg Queen Esther for his life, for he realized that the king was planning a terrible fate for him.
aov_text: En die koning het in sy woede van die wynmaaltyd opgestaan en na die tuin van die paleis gegaan, terwyl Haman daar bly staan om van koningin Ester die behoud van sy lewe af te smeek; want hy het gesien dat die onheil oor hom by die koning vas besluit was.

kjv_text: Then the king returned out of the palace garden into the place of the banquet of wine; and Haman was fallen upon the bed whereon Esther was. Then said the king, Will he force the queen also before me in the house? As the word went out of the king's mouth, they covered Haman's face.
bsb_text: Just as the king returned from the palace garden to the banquet hall, Haman was falling on the couch where Esther was reclining. The king exclaimed, “Would he actually assault the queen while I am in the palace?” As soon as the words had left the king’s mouth, they covered Haman’s face.
aov_text: Toe die koning uit die tuin van die paleis in die saal van die wynmaaltyd terugkom, en Haman juis op die rusbank neergeval het waar Ester op sit, sê die koning: Wil hy die koningin ook nog geweld aandoen by my in die huis? Die woord was nouliks uit die mond van die koning of hulle het die gesig van Haman bedek.

kjv_text: And Harbonah, one of the chamberlains, said before the king, Behold also, the gallows fifty cubits high, which Haman had made for Mordecai, who had spoken good for the king, standeth in the house of Haman. Then the king said, Hang him thereon.
bsb_text: Then Harbonah, one of the eunuchs attending the king, said: “There is a gallows fifty cubits high at Haman’s house. He had it built for Mordecai, who gave the report that saved the king.” “Hang him on it!” declared the king.
aov_text: Daarop sê Harbóna, een van die hofdienaars voor die koning: Daar staan reeds die galg wat Haman laat maak het vir Mórdegai wat ten voordele van die koning gespreek het, by die huis van Haman, vyftig el hoog! Toe sê die koning: Hang hom daaraan op!

kjv_text: So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai. Then was the king's wrath pacified.
bsb_text: So they hanged Haman on the gallows he had prepared for Mordecai. Then the fury of the king subsided.
aov_text: En hulle het Haman opgehang aan die galg wat hy vir Mórdegai opgerig het, en die woede van die koning het bedaar.

kjv_text: On that day did the king Ahasuerus give the house of Haman the Jews' enemy unto Esther the queen. And Mordecai came before the king; for Esther had told what he was unto her.
bsb_text: That same day King Xerxes awarded Queen Esther the estate of Haman, the enemy of the Jews. And Mordecai entered the king’s presence because Esther had revealed his relation to her.
aov_text: OP dieselfde dag het koning Ahasvéros aan koningin Ester die huis gegee van Haman, die teëstander van die Jode; en Mórdegai het voor die koning gekom, want Ester het vertel wat hy van haar was.

kjv_text: And the king took off his ring, which he had taken from Haman, and gave it unto Mordecai. And Esther set Mordecai over the house of Haman.
bsb_text: The king removed the signet ring he had recovered from Haman and presented it to Mordecai. And Esther appointed Mordecai over the estate of Haman.
aov_text: En die koning het sy seëlring uitgetrek wat hy van Haman afgeneem het, en dit aan Mórdegai gegee; en Ester het Mórdegai aangestel oor die huis van Haman.

kjv_text: And Esther spake yet again before the king, and fell down at his feet, and besought him with tears to put away the mischief of Haman the Agagite, and his device that he had devised against the Jews.
bsb_text: And once again, Esther addressed the king. She fell at his feet weeping and begged him to revoke the evil scheme of Haman the Agagite, which he had devised against the Jews.
aov_text: EN Ester het weer voor die koning gespreek en voor sy voete neergeval en geween en hom gesmeek om die onheil van Haman, die Agagiet, en sy plan wat hy teen die Jode beraam het, te verydel.

kjv_text: Then the king held out the golden sceptre toward Esther. So Esther arose, and stood before the king,
bsb_text: The king extended the gold scepter toward Esther, and she arose and stood before the king.
aov_text: En die koning het die goue septer na Ester uitgesteek, en Ester het haar opgerig en voor die koning gaan staan

kjv_text: And said, If it please the king, and if I have found favour in his sight, and the thing seem right before the king, and I be pleasing in his eyes, let it be written to reverse the letters devised by Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, which he wrote to destroy the Jews which are in all the king's provinces:
bsb_text: “If it pleases the king,” she said, “and if I have found favor in his sight, and the matter seems proper to the king, and I am pleasing in his sight, may an order be written to revoke the letters that the scheming Haman son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, wrote to destroy the Jews in all the king’s provinces.
aov_text: en gesê: As die koning dit goedvind en ek genade voor hom gevind het en die saak reg is voor die koning en ek welgevallig is in sy oë, laat dan geskrywe word om die briewe met die plan van Haman, die seun van Hammedáta, die Agagiet, te herroep wat hy geskrywe het om die Jode wat in al die provinsies van die koning is, uit te roei.

kjv_text: For how can I endure to see the evil that shall come unto my people? or how can I endure to see the destruction of my kindred?
bsb_text: For how could I bear to see the disaster that would befall my people? How could I bear to see the destruction of my kindred?”
aov_text: Want hoe sou ek kan aansien die onheil wat my volk sal tref? En hoe sou ek kan aansien die ondergang van my geslag?

kjv_text: Then the king Ahasuerus said unto Esther the queen and to Mordecai the Jew, Behold, I have given Esther the house of Haman, and him they have hanged upon the gallows, because he laid his hand upon the Jews.
bsb_text: So King Xerxes said to Esther the Queen and Mordecai the Jew, “Behold, I have given Haman’s estate to Esther, and he was hanged on the gallows because he attacked the Jews.
aov_text: Toe sê koning Ahasvéros aan koningin Ester en aan die Jood Mórdegai: Kyk, die huis van Haman het ek aan Ester gegee, en hom het hulle aan die galg opgehang, omdat hy sy hand teen die Jode uitgesteek het.

kjv_text: Write ye also for the Jews, as it liketh you, in the king's name, and seal it with the king's ring: for the writing which is written in the king's name, and sealed with the king's ring, may no man reverse.
bsb_text: Now you may write in the king’s name as you please regarding the Jews, and seal it with the royal signet ring. For a decree that is written in the name of the king and sealed with the royal signet ring cannot be revoked.”
aov_text: Skryf julle maar, wat die Jode betref, soos julle dit goedvind uit naam van die koning, en verseël dit met die seëlring van die koning; want ’n geskrif, in naam van die koning geskrywe en verseël met die seëlring van die koning, kan nie herroep word nie.

kjv_text: Then were the king's scribes called at that time in the third month, that is, the month Sivan, on the three and twentieth day thereof; and it was written according to all that Mordecai commanded unto the Jews, and to the lieutenants, and the deputies and rulers of the provinces which are from India unto Ethiopia, an hundred twenty and seven provinces, unto every province according to the writing thereof, and unto every people after their language, and to the Jews according to their writing, and according to their language.
bsb_text: At once the royal scribes were summoned, and on the twenty-third day of the third month (the month of Sivan), they recorded all of Mordecai’s orders to the Jews and to the satraps, governors, and princes of the 127 provinces from India to Cush—writing to each province in its own script, to every people in their own language, and to the Jews in their own script and language.
aov_text: Toe is in dieselfde tyd die skrywers van die koning geroep, in die derde maand, dit is die maand Siwan, op die drie-en-twintigste daarvan; en daar is geskrywe net soos Mórdegai beveel het, aan die Jode en aan die landvoogde en die goewerneurs en die vorste van die provinsies wat van Indië af tot by Kus lê, honderd-sewen-en-twintig provinsies, aan elke provinsie volgens sy skrif en aan elke volk in sy taal, en aan die Jode volgens hulle skrif en in hulle taal —

kjv_text: And he wrote in the king Ahasuerus' name, and sealed it with the king's ring, and sent letters by posts on horseback, and riders on mules, camels, and young dromedaries:
bsb_text: Mordecai wrote in the name of King Xerxes and sealed it with the royal signet ring. He sent the documents by mounted couriers riding on swift horses bred from the royal mares.
aov_text: hy het laat skrywe uit naam van koning Ahasvéros en dit verseël met die seëlring van die koning en briewe gestuur met rapportgangers te perd wat gery het op koninklike renperde uit die stoetery,

kjv_text: Wherein the king granted the Jews which were in every city to gather themselves together, and to stand for their life, to destroy, to slay, and to cause to perish, all the power of the people and province that would assault them, both little ones and women, and to take the spoil of them for a prey,
bsb_text: By these letters the king permitted the Jews in each and every city the right to assemble and defend themselves, to destroy, kill, and annihilate all the forces of any people or province hostile to them, including women and children, and to plunder their possessions.
aov_text: dat die koning aan die Jode wat in elke stad woon, toegestaan het om bymekaar te kom en hulle lewe te verdedig, deur te verdelg en dood te maak en uit te roei elke gewapende mag van volk of provinsie wat hulle in benoudheid mag bring, saam met kindertjies en vroue, en hulle besittings as buit te plunder,

kjv_text: Upon one day in all the provinces of king Ahasuerus, namely, upon the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar.
bsb_text: The single day appointed throughout all the provinces of King Xerxes was the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, the month of Adar.
aov_text: op een dag in al die provinsies van koning Ahasvéros, op die dertiende van die twaalfde maand, dit is die maand Adar.

kjv_text: The copy of the writing for a commandment to be given in every province was published unto all people, and that the Jews should be ready against that day to avenge themselves on their enemies.
bsb_text: A copy of the text of the edict was to be issued in every province and published to all the people, so that the Jews would be ready on that day to avenge themselves on their enemies.
aov_text: ’n Afskrif van die bevelskrif moes as wet uitgevaardig word in elke provinsie, openbaar gemaak aan al die volke, sodat die Jode op dié dag gereed moes wees om hulle op hul vyande te wreek.

kjv_text: So the posts that rode upon mules and camels went out, being hastened and pressed on by the king's commandment. And the decree was given at Shushan the palace.
bsb_text: The couriers rode out in haste on their royal horses, pressed on by the command of the king. And the edict was also issued in the citadel of Susa.
aov_text: Die rapportgangers wat op die koninklike renperde gery het, het op bevel van die koning haastig en gou weggegaan, en die wet is in die vesting Susan uitgevaardig.

kjv_text: And Mordecai went out from the presence of the king in royal apparel of blue and white, and with a great crown of gold, and with a garment of fine linen and purple: and the city of Shushan rejoiced and was glad.
bsb_text: Mordecai went out from the presence of the king in royal garments of blue and white, with a large gold crown and a purple robe of fine linen. And the city of Susa shouted and rejoiced.
aov_text: En Mórdegai het van die koning weggegaan in ’n koninklike kleed van pers en wit, met ’n groot goue kroon op en ’n mantel van fyn linne en purperrooi stof, terwyl die stad Susan jubel en vrolik was.

kjv_text: The Jews had light, and gladness, and joy, and honour.
bsb_text: For the Jews it was a time of light and gladness, of joy and honor.
aov_text: Vir die Jode was daar lig en vrolikheid en vreugde en eer;

kjv_text: And in every province, and in every city, whithersoever the king's commandment and his decree came, the Jews had joy and gladness, a feast and a good day. And many of the people of the land became Jews; for the fear of the Jews fell upon them.
bsb_text: In every province and every city, wherever the king’s edict and decree reached, there was joy and gladness among the Jews, with feasting and celebrating. And many of the people of the land themselves became Jews, because the fear of the Jews had fallen upon them.
aov_text: en in al die provinsies en in al die stede waar die bevel van die koning en sy wet ook al aangekom het, was daar vrolikheid en vreugde by die Jode, maaltyd en feesdag; en baie uit die volke van die land het Jode geword, want die skrik vir die Jode het op hulle geval.

kjv_text: Now in the twelfth month, that is, the month Adar, on the thirteenth day of the same, when the king's commandment and his decree drew near to be put in execution, in the day that the enemies of the Jews hoped to have power over them, (though it was turned to the contrary, that the Jews had rule over them that hated them;)
bsb_text: On the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, the month of Adar, the king’s command and edict were to be executed. On this day the enemies of the Jews had hoped to overpower them, but their plan was overturned and the Jews overpowered those who hated them.
aov_text: EN in die twaalfde maand, dit is die maand Adar, op die dertiende dag daarvan, toe die bevel van die koning en sy wet uitgevoer sou word, op die dag toe die vyande van die Jode gehoop het om hulle te oorweldig—maar dit net omgekeerd was, sodat juis die Jode hulle haters sou oorweldig —

kjv_text: The Jews gathered themselves together in their cities throughout all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus, to lay hand on such as sought their hurt: and no man could withstand them; for the fear of them fell upon all people.
bsb_text: In each of the provinces of King Xerxes, the Jews assembled in their cities to attack those who sought to harm them. No man could withstand them, because the fear of them had fallen upon all peoples.
aov_text: het die Jode saamgekom in hulle stede in al die provinsies van koning Ahasvéros om die hand te slaan aan die wat hulle onheil gesoek het; en niemand het voor hulle standgehou nie, want die skrik vir hulle het op al die volke geval.

kjv_text: And all the rulers of the provinces, and the lieutenants, and the deputies, and officers of the king, helped the Jews; because the fear of Mordecai fell upon them.
bsb_text: And all the officials of the provinces, the satraps, the governors, and the king’s administrators helped the Jews, because the fear of Mordecai had fallen upon them.
aov_text: En al die vorste van die provinsies en die landvoogde en die goewerneurs en die beamptes van die koning het die Jode ondersteun, want die skrik vir Mórdegai het op hulle geval.

kjv_text: For Mordecai was great in the king's house, and his fame went out throughout all the provinces: for this man Mordecai waxed greater and greater.
bsb_text: For Mordecai exercised great power in the palace, and his fame spread throughout the provinces as he became more and more powerful.
aov_text: Want Mórdegai was groot in die paleis van die koning, en sy gerug het deur al die provinsies gegaan, omdat die man Mórdegai al groter geword het.

kjv_text: Thus the Jews smote all their enemies with the stroke of the sword, and slaughter, and destruction, and did what they would unto those that hated them.
bsb_text: The Jews put all their enemies to the sword, killing and destroying them, and they did as they pleased to those who hated them.
aov_text: En die Jode het onder hulle vyande ’n slagting aangerig deur die swaard en deur doodslag en verdelging, en met hulle haters na hulle goedvinde gehandel.

kjv_text: And in Shushan the palace the Jews slew and destroyed five hundred men.
bsb_text: In the citadel of Susa, the Jews killed and destroyed five hundred men,
aov_text: En in die vesting Susan het die Jode vyfhonderd man gedood en uitgeroei;

kjv_text: And Parshandatha, and Dalphon, and Aspatha,
bsb_text: including Parshandatha, Dalphon, Aspatha,
aov_text: en Parsandáta en Dalfon en Aspáta,

kjv_text: And Poratha, and Adalia, and Aridatha,
bsb_text: Poratha, Adalia, Aridatha,
aov_text: en Poráta en Adálja en Aridáta,

kjv_text: And Parmashta, and Arisai, and Aridai, and Vajezatha,
bsb_text: Parmashta, Arisai, Aridai, and Vaizatha.
aov_text: en Parmásta en Arísai en Arídai en Waisáta,

kjv_text: The ten sons of Haman the son of Hammedatha, the enemy of the Jews, slew they; but on the spoil laid they not their hand.
bsb_text: They killed these ten sons of Haman son of Hammedatha, the enemy of the Jews, but they did not lay a hand on the plunder.
aov_text: die tien seuns van Haman, die seun van Hammedáta, die teëstander van die Jode, het hulle gedood, maar na die buit hulle hand nie uitgesteek nie.

kjv_text: On that day the number of those that were slain in Shushan the palace was brought before the king.
bsb_text: On that day the number of those killed in the citadel of Susa was reported to the king,
aov_text: Op dieselfde dag het die getal van die wat in die vesting Susan gedood is, voor die koning gekom;

kjv_text: And the king said unto Esther the queen, The Jews have slain and destroyed five hundred men in Shushan the palace, and the ten sons of Haman; what have they done in the rest of the king's provinces? now what is thy petition? and it shall be granted thee: or what is thy request further? and it shall be done.
bsb_text: who said to Queen Esther, “In the citadel of Susa the Jews have killed and destroyed five hundred men, including Haman’s ten sons. What have they done in the rest of the royal provinces? Now what is your petition? It will be given to you. And what further do you request? It will be fulfilled.”
aov_text: en die koning het aan koningin Ester gesê: In die vesting Susan het die Jode vyfhonderd man gedood en uitgeroei benewens die tien seuns van Haman; wat sou hulle wel in die ander provinsies van die koning gedoen het? Wat is dan jou bede?—dit sal jou toegestaan word. En wat is verder jou versoek?—daaraan sal voldoen word.

kjv_text: Then said Esther, If it please the king, let it be granted to the Jews which are in Shushan to do to morrow also according unto this day's decree, and let Haman's ten sons be hanged upon the gallows.
bsb_text: Esther replied, “If it pleases the king, may the Jews in Susa also have tomorrow to carry out today’s edict, and may the bodies of Haman’s ten sons be hanged on the gallows.”
aov_text: Toe sê Ester: As die koning dit goedvind, laat môre ook aan die Jode wat in Susan is, toegestaan word om te handel volgens die wet wat geld vir vandag; en laat hulle die tien seuns van Haman aan die galg ophang.

kjv_text: And the king commanded it so to be done: and the decree was given at Shushan; and they hanged Haman's ten sons.
bsb_text: So the king commanded that this be done. An edict was issued in Susa, and they hanged the ten sons of Haman.
aov_text: En die koning het bevel gegee om so te doen; en ’n wet is in Susan uitgevaardig, en hulle het die tien seuns van Haman opgehang.

kjv_text: For the Jews that were in Shushan gathered themselves together on the fourteenth day also of the month Adar, and slew three hundred men at Shushan; but on the prey they laid not their hand.
bsb_text: On the fourteenth day of the month of Adar, the Jews in Susa came together again and put to death three hundred men there, but they did not lay a hand on the plunder.
aov_text: En die Jode wat in Susan was, het ook op die veertiende dag van die maand Adar saamgekom; en hulle het in Susan driehonderd man gedood, maar na die buit hulle hand nie uitgesteek nie.

kjv_text: But the other Jews that were in the king's provinces gathered themselves together, and stood for their lives, and had rest from their enemies, and slew of their foes seventy and five thousand, but they laid not their hands on the prey,
bsb_text: The rest of the Jews in the royal provinces also assembled to defend themselves and rid themselves of their enemies. They killed 75,000 who hated them, but they did not lay a hand on the plunder.
aov_text: En die ander Jode wat in die provinsies van die koning was, het saamgekom en hulle lewe verdedig en gerus van hul vyande; en hulle het onder hul haters vyf-en-sewentigduisend omgebring, maar na die buit hulle hand nie uitgesteek nie.

kjv_text: On the thirteenth day of the month Adar; and on the fourteenth day of the same rested they, and made it a day of feasting and gladness.
bsb_text: This was done on the thirteenth day of the month of Adar, and on the fourteenth day they rested, making it a day of feasting and joy.
aov_text: Dit was op die dertiende dag van die maand Adar; en op die veertiende daarvan het hulle gerus en dit ’n dag van maaltyd en vrolikheid gemaak.

kjv_text: But the Jews that were at Shushan assembled together on the thirteenth day thereof, and on the fourteenth thereof; and on the fifteenth day of the same they rested, and made it a day of feasting and gladness.
bsb_text: The Jews in Susa, however, had assembled on the thirteenth and the fourteenth days of the month. So they rested on the fifteenth day, making it a day of feasting and joy.
aov_text: Maar die Jode wat in Susan was, het op die dertiende en die veertiende daarvan byeengekom, en op die vyftiende daarvan gerus, sodat hulle dit ’n dag van maaltyd en vrolikheid gemaak het.

kjv_text: Therefore the Jews of the villages, that dwelt in the unwalled towns, made the fourteenth day of the month Adar a day of gladness and feasting, and a good day, and of sending portions one to another.
bsb_text: This is why the rural Jews, who live in the villages, observe the fourteenth day of the month of Adar as a day of joy and feasting. It is a holiday for sending gifts to one another.
aov_text: Daarom maak die Jode wat buite in die onbemuurde stede woon, van die veertiende dag van die maand Adar ’n dag van vrolikheid en maaltyd en ’n feesdag waarop hulle mekaar lekkernye stuur.

kjv_text: And Mordecai wrote these things, and sent letters unto all the Jews that were in all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus, both nigh and far,
bsb_text: Mordecai recorded these events and sent letters to all the Jews in all the provinces of King Xerxes, both near and far,
aov_text: EN Mórdegai het hierdie dinge opgeskrywe en briewe gestuur aan al die Jode wat in al die provinsies van koning Ahasvéros was, die wat naby en die wat ver was,

kjv_text: To stablish this among them, that they should keep the fourteenth day of the month Adar, and the fifteenth day of the same, yearly,
bsb_text: to establish among them an annual celebration on the fourteenth and fifteenth days of the month of Adar
aov_text: om vir hulle vas te stel dat hulle al jare die veertiende dag van die maand Adar en die vyftiende daarvan moes vier —

kjv_text: As the days wherein the Jews rested from their enemies, and the month which was turned unto them from sorrow to joy, and from mourning into a good day: that they should make them days of feasting and joy, and of sending portions one to another, and gifts to the poor.
bsb_text: as the days on which the Jews gained rest from their enemies and the month in which their sorrow turned to joy and their mourning into a holiday. He wrote that these were to be days of feasting and joy, of sending gifts to one another and to the poor.

kjv_text: Because it shut not up the doors of my mother's womb, nor hid sorrow from mine eyes.
bsb_text: For that night did not shut the doors of the womb to hide the sorrow from my eyes.
aov_text: Omdat hy vir my nie toegesluit het die deure van die moederskoot nie en moeite vir my oë nie verberg het nie.

kjv_text: Why died I not from the womb? why did I not give up the ghost when I came out of the belly?
bsb_text: Why did I not perish at birth; why did I not die as I came from the womb?
aov_text: Waarom het ek nie gesterf by die geboorte, nie uitgegaan uit die moederskoot en die asem uitgeblaas nie?

kjv_text: Why did the knees prevent me? or why the breasts that I should suck?
bsb_text: Why were there knees to receive me, and breasts that I should be nursed?
aov_text: Waarom het knieë my teëgekom, en waarom borste, dat ek moes drink?

kjv_text: For now should I have lain still and been quiet, I should have slept: then had I been at rest,
bsb_text: For now I would be lying down in peace; I would be asleep and at rest
aov_text: Want dan sou ek daar gelê en stil gewees het; ek sou geslaap, ek sou dan rus gehad het,

kjv_text: With kings and counsellors of the earth, which built desolate places for themselves;
bsb_text: with kings and counselors of the earth, who built for themselves cities now in ruins,
aov_text: saam met konings en raadsmanne van die aarde, wat puinhope weer opgebou het vir hulleself;

kjv_text: Or with princes that had gold, who filled their houses with silver:
bsb_text: or with princes who had gold, who filled their houses with silver.
aov_text: of saam met vorste wat goud besit, wat hulle huise met silwer gevul het.

kjv_text: Or as an hidden untimely birth I had not been; as infants which never saw light.
bsb_text: Or why was I not hidden like a stillborn child, like an infant who never sees daylight?
aov_text: Of ek sou, soos ’n weggestopte misgeboorte, nie bestaan het nie, soos kinders wat die lig nie gesien het nie.

kjv_text: There the wicked cease from troubling; and there the weary be at rest.
bsb_text: There the wicked cease from raging, and there the weary find rest.
aov_text: Daar hou die goddelose op met woel, en daar rus hulle wie se kragte uitgeput is.

kjv_text: There the prisoners rest together; they hear not the voice of the oppressor.
bsb_text: The captives enjoy their ease; they do not hear the voice of the oppressor.
aov_text: Die gevangenes is almal saam gerus; hulle hoor die stem van die drywer nie.

kjv_text: The small and great are there; and the servant is free from his master.
bsb_text: Both small and great are there, and the slave is freed from his master.
aov_text: Klein en groot is daar gelyk, en die slaaf is vry van sy heer.

kjv_text: Wherefore is light given to him that is in misery, and life unto the bitter in soul;
bsb_text: Why is light given to the miserable, and life to the bitter of soul,
aov_text: WAAROM gee Hy lig aan die ellendige en lewe aan die wat verbitterd is van siel;

kjv_text: Which long for death, but it cometh not; and dig for it more than for hid treasures;
bsb_text: who long for death that does not come, and search for it like hidden treasure,
aov_text: wat wag op die dood, en hy kom nie; en meer na hom grawe as na verborge skatte;

kjv_text: Which rejoice exceedingly, and are glad, when they can find the grave?
bsb_text: who rejoice and greatly exult when they can find the grave?
aov_text: wat bly sou wees met gejuig, hulle sou verheug as hulle die graf kon vind?

kjv_text: Why is light given to a man whose way is hid, and whom God hath hedged in?
bsb_text: Why is life given to a man whose way is hidden, whom God has hedged in?
aov_text: Waarom gee Hy lig aan ’n man wie se weg verborge is, ’n man wat deur God aan alle kante ingesluit is?

kjv_text: For my sighing cometh before I eat, and my roarings are poured out like the waters.
bsb_text: I sigh when food is put before me, and my groans pour out like water.
aov_text: Want soos my brood kom my gesug, en my gebrul word uitgestort soos water.

kjv_text: For the thing which I greatly feared is come upon me, and that which I was afraid of is come unto me.
bsb_text: For the thing I feared has overtaken me, and what I dreaded has befallen me.
aov_text: As ek iets vreesliks vrees, kom dit oor my; en die ding waarvoor ek bang is, kom na my toe.

kjv_text: I was not in safety, neither had I rest, neither was I quiet; yet trouble came.
bsb_text: I am not at ease or quiet; I have no rest, for trouble has come.”
aov_text: Ek het geen kalmte en geen stilte en geen rus nie, of daar kom die onrus!

kjv_text: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,
bsb_text: Then Eliphaz the Temanite replied:
aov_text: TOE antwoord Élifas, die Temaniet, en sê:

kjv_text: If we assay to commune with thee, wilt thou be grieved? but who can withhold himself from speaking?
bsb_text: “If one ventures a word with you, will you be wearied? Yet who can keep from speaking?
aov_text: As ’n mens dit met ’n woord by jou waag, sal jy ontstemd wees? Maar woorde inhou—wie kan dit?

kjv_text: Behold, thou hast instructed many, and thou hast strengthened the weak hands.
bsb_text: Surely you have instructed many, and have strengthened their feeble hands.
aov_text: Kyk, jy het baie mense tereggewys en slap hande versterk.

kjv_text: Thy words have upholden him that was falling, and thou hast strengthened the feeble knees.
bsb_text: Your words have steadied those who stumbled; you have braced the knees that were buckling.
aov_text: Jou woorde het opgerig die wat struikel, en jy het knikkende knieë versterk.

kjv_text: But now it is come upon thee, and thou faintest; it toucheth thee, and thou art troubled.
bsb_text: But now trouble has come upon you, and you are weary. It strikes you, and you are dismayed.
aov_text: Maar nou dat dit jóu oorkom, is jy moedverlore; nou dat dit jóu tref, is jy verslae!

kjv_text: Is not this thy fear, thy confidence, thy hope, and the uprightness of thy ways?
bsb_text: Is your reverence not your confidence, and the uprightness of your ways your hope?
aov_text: IS jou Godsvrees nie jou hoop, jou vrome wandel nie jou verwagting nie?

kjv_text: Remember, I pray thee, who ever perished, being innocent? or where were the righteous cut off?
bsb_text: Consider now, I plead: Who, being innocent, has ever perished? Or where have the upright been destroyed?
aov_text: Bedink tog, wie het ooit onskuldig omgekom, en waar is opregtes verdelg?

kjv_text: Even as I have seen, they that plow iniquity, and sow wickedness, reap the same.
bsb_text: As I have observed, those who plow iniquity and those who sow trouble reap the same.
aov_text: Volgens ek gesien het: Die wat onreg ploeg en moeite saai, dié maai dit.

kjv_text: By the blast of God they perish, and by the breath of his nostrils are they consumed.
bsb_text: By the breath of God they perish, and by the blast of His anger they are consumed.
aov_text: Deur die asem van God kom hulle om, en deur die geblaas van sy toorn word hulle vernietig.

kjv_text: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, and the teeth of the young lions, are broken.
bsb_text: The lion may roar, and the fierce lion may growl, yet the teeth of the young lions are broken.
aov_text: Die gebrul van die leeu en die stem van die bruller—ja, die tande van die jong leeus word uitgebreek.

kjv_text: The old lion perisheth for lack of prey, and the stout lion's whelps are scattered abroad.
bsb_text: The old lion perishes for lack of prey, and the cubs of the lioness are scattered.
aov_text: Die leeu kom om by gebrek aan prooi, en die kleintjies van die leeuin word verstrooi.

kjv_text: Now a thing was secretly brought to me, and mine ear received a little thereof.
bsb_text: Now a word came to me secretly; my ears caught a whisper of it.
aov_text: VERDER is ’n woord op geheimsinnige wyse na my gebring, en my oor het ’n gefluister daarvan opgevang,

kjv_text: In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falleth on men,
bsb_text: In disquieting visions in the night, when deep sleep falls on men,
aov_text: by die gedagtespel, uit naggesigte gebore, wanneer diepe slaap op die mense val.

kjv_text: Fear came upon me, and trembling, which made all my bones to shake.
bsb_text: fear and trembling came over me and made all my bones shudder.
aov_text: Skrik het oor my gekom en siddering en het my hele gebeente laat bewe.

kjv_text: Then a spirit passed before my face; the hair of my flesh stood up:
bsb_text: Then a spirit glided past my face, and the hair on my body bristled.
aov_text: Toe skuif daar ’n gees voor my verby; die hare van my vlees het opgerys.

kjv_text: It stood still, but I could not discern the form thereof: an image was before mine eyes, there was silence, and I heard a voice, saying,
bsb_text: It stood still, but I could not discern its appearance; a form loomed before my eyes, and I heard a whispering voice:
aov_text: Hy bly staan, maar ek kon sy gedaante nie herken nie—’n verskyning voor my oë! Ek hoor die gefluister van ’n stem wat sê:

kjv_text: Shall mortal man be more just than God? shall a man be more pure than his maker?
bsb_text: ‘Can a mortal be more righteous than God, or a man more pure than his Maker?
aov_text: Sou ’n sterfling regverdig wees voor God? Of ’n man rein wees voor sy Maker?

kjv_text: Behold, he put no trust in his servants; and his angels he charged with folly:
bsb_text: If God puts no trust in His servants, and He charges His angels with error,
aov_text: Kyk, in sy dienaars stel Hy geen vertroue nie, en by sy engele ontdek Hy dwaling.

kjv_text: How much less in them that dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, which are crushed before the moth?
bsb_text: how much more those who dwell in houses of clay, whose foundations are in the dust, who can be crushed like a moth!
aov_text: Hoeveel meer by hulle wat kleihuise bewoon, van wie die grondslag in die stof is, wat fyngedruk word soos ’n mot.

kjv_text: They are destroyed from morning to evening: they perish for ever without any regarding it.
bsb_text: They are smashed to pieces from dawn to dusk; unnoticed, they perish forever.
aov_text: Tussen môre en aand word hulle verpletter; hulle kom vir ewig om sonder dat iemand daar ag op gee.

kjv_text: Doth not their excellency which is in them go away? they die, even without wisdom.
bsb_text: Are not their tent cords pulled up, so that they die without wisdom?’
aov_text: Word hulle tentlyn nie losgeruk in hulle nie? Hulle sterwe, en dit sonder wysheid.

kjv_text: Call now, if there be any that will answer thee; and to which of the saints wilt thou turn?
bsb_text: “Call out if you please, but who will answer? To which of the holy ones will you turn?
aov_text: ROEP maar—is daar iemand wat jou antwoord gee? En na wie van die heiliges sal jy gaan?

kjv_text: For wrath killeth the foolish man, and envy slayeth the silly one.
bsb_text: For resentment kills a fool, and envy slays the simple.
aov_text: Want verbitterdheid vermoor die dwaas, en naywer maak die domme dood.

kjv_text: I have seen the foolish taking root: but suddenly I cursed his habitation.
bsb_text: I have seen a fool taking root, but suddenly his house was cursed.
aov_text: Ek self het gesien hoe ’n dwaas wortel skiet; maar skielik het ek sy woning vervloek.

kjv_text: His children are far from safety, and they are crushed in the gate, neither is there any to deliver them.
bsb_text: His sons are far from safety, crushed in court without a defender.
aov_text: Ver is sy kinders van geluk; en hulle word verbrysel in die poort sonder dat iemand red.

kjv_text: Whose harvest the hungry eateth up, and taketh it even out of the thorns, and the robber swalloweth up their substance.
bsb_text: The hungry consume his harvest, taking it even from the thorns, and the thirsty pant after his wealth.
aov_text: Wat hy geoes het, eet die hongerige op, en dié haal dit selfs uit die doringheining uit; en die ondergang hyg na hulle rykdom.

kjv_text: Although affliction cometh not forth of the dust, neither doth trouble spring out of the ground;
bsb_text: For distress does not spring from the dust, and trouble does not sprout from the ground.
aov_text: Want onheil kom nie voort uit die stof, en moeite spruit nie uit die grond nie.

kjv_text: Yet man is born unto trouble, as the sparks fly upward.
bsb_text: Yet man is born to trouble as surely as sparks fly upward.
aov_text: Maar die mens word vir moeite gebore soos die vonke boontoe vlieg.

kjv_text: I would seek unto God, and unto God would I commit my cause:
bsb_text: However, if I were you, I would appeal to God and lay my cause before Him—
aov_text: MAAR wat my aangaan, ek sou na God vra en my saak aan die Godheid voorlê,

kjv_text: Which doeth great things and unsearchable; marvellous things without number:
bsb_text: the One who does great and unsearchable things, wonders without number.
aov_text: aan Hom wat groot dinge doen en ondeurgrondelike, wonders sonder getal;

kjv_text: Who giveth rain upon the earth, and sendeth waters upon the fields:
bsb_text: He gives rain to the earth and sends water upon the fields.
aov_text: wat reën gee oor die aarde en waters uitstuur oor die velde;

kjv_text: To set up on high those that be low; that those which mourn may be exalted to safety.
bsb_text: He sets the lowly on high, so that mourners are lifted to safety.
aov_text: om nederiges op ’n hoogte te stel daarbo; en die wat in die rou is, verkry die hoogste geluk.

kjv_text: He disappointeth the devices of the crafty, so that their hands cannot perform their enterprise.
bsb_text: He thwarts the schemes of the crafty, so that their hands find no success.
aov_text: Hy wat die planne van listige mense verydel, sodat hulle hande niks kan uitrig wat standhou nie;

kjv_text: He taketh the wise in their own craftiness: and the counsel of the froward is carried headlong.
bsb_text: He catches the wise in their craftiness, and sweeps away the plans of the cunning.
aov_text: wat die wyse manne vang in hulle listigheid, en die raad van die slinkse mense misluk van haastigheid.

kjv_text: They meet with darkness in the day time, and grope in the noonday as in the night.
bsb_text: They encounter darkness by day and grope at noon as in the night.
aov_text: Oordag stuit hulle op duisternis, en soos in die nag tas hulle rond op die middag.

kjv_text: But he saveth the poor from the sword, from their mouth, and from the hand of the mighty.
bsb_text: He saves the needy from the sword in their mouth and from the clutches of the powerful.
aov_text: So verlos Hy dan van die swaard wat kom uit hulle mond, en die behoeftige uit die hand van die sterk man.

kjv_text: So the poor hath hope, and iniquity stoppeth her mouth.
bsb_text: So the poor have hope, and injustice shuts its mouth.
aov_text: So is daar dan verwagting vir die arme; en ongeregtigheid hou die mond toe.

kjv_text: Behold, happy is the man whom God correcteth: therefore despise not thou the chastening of the Almighty:
bsb_text: Blessed indeed is the man whom God corrects; so do not despise the discipline of the Almighty.
aov_text: KYK, gelukkig is die man wat God kasty; verwerp daarom die tugtiging van die Almagtige nie.

kjv_text: For he maketh sore, and bindeth up: he woundeth, and his hands make whole.
bsb_text: For He wounds, but He also binds; He strikes, but His hands also heal.
aov_text: Want Hý doen smart aan, maar verbind ook; Hy verbrysel, maar sy hande maak gesond.

kjv_text: He shall deliver thee in six troubles: yea, in seven there shall no evil touch thee.
bsb_text: He will rescue you from six calamities; no harm will touch you in seven.
aov_text: In ses benoudhede sal Hy jou red, ja, in sewe sal geen onheil jou tref nie.

kjv_text: In famine he shall redeem thee from death: and in war from the power of the sword.
bsb_text: In famine He will redeem you from death, and in battle from the stroke of the sword.
aov_text: In hongersnood verlos Hy jou van die dood en in die oorlog uit die mag van die swaard.

kjv_text: Thou shalt be hid from the scourge of the tongue: neither shalt thou be afraid of destruction when it cometh.
bsb_text: You will be hidden from the scourge of the tongue, and will not fear havoc when it comes.
aov_text: As die tong gésel, word jy weggesteek; en jy hoef nie te vrees vir verwoesting as dit kom nie.

kjv_text: At destruction and famine thou shalt laugh: neither shalt thou be afraid of the beasts of the earth.
bsb_text: You will laugh at destruction and famine, and need not fear the beasts of the earth.
aov_text: Oor verwoesting en broodsgebrek sal jy lag, en vir die wilde diere van die aarde hoef jy nie te vrees nie.

kjv_text: For thou shalt be in league with the stones of the field: and the beasts of the field shall be at peace with thee.
bsb_text: For you will have a covenant with the stones of the field, and the wild animals will be at peace with you.
aov_text: Want met die klippe van die veld is jou verbond, en die wilde diere van die veld is met jou bevriend.

kjv_text: And thou shalt know that thy tabernacle shall be in peace; and thou shalt visit thy habitation, and shalt not sin.
bsb_text: You will know that your tent is secure, and find nothing amiss when inspecting your home.
aov_text: En jy sal uitvind dat jou tent in vrede is; en as jy op jou woonplek rondkyk, sal jy niks vermis nie.

kjv_text: Thou shalt know also that thy seed shall be great, and thine offspring as the grass of the earth.
bsb_text: You will know that your offspring will be many, your descendants like the grass of the earth.
aov_text: Ook sal jy uitvind dat jou kroos talryk is en jou nakomelinge soos die plante van die aarde.

kjv_text: Thou shalt come to thy grave in a full age, like as a shock of corn cometh in in his season.
bsb_text: You will come to the grave in full vigor, like a sheaf of grain gathered in season.
aov_text: Op rype leeftyd sal jy na die graf gaan, soos ’n koringgerf ingebring word op sy tyd.

kjv_text: Lo this, we have searched it, so it is; hear it, and know thou it for thy good.
bsb_text: Indeed, we have investigated, and it is true! So hear it and know for yourself.”
aov_text: Kyk, dit het ons nagespeur, so is dit; hoor dit, en neem jy dit ter harte.

kjv_text: But Job answered and said,
bsb_text: Then Job replied:
aov_text: MAAR Job het geantwoord en gesê:

kjv_text: Oh that my grief were throughly weighed, and my calamity laid in the balances together!
bsb_text: “If only my grief could be weighed and placed with my calamity on the scales.
aov_text: Ag, was my verdriet maar goed geweeg en my ongeluk meteens in ’n skaal opgehef!

kjv_text: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the sea: therefore my words are swallowed up.
bsb_text: For then it would outweigh the sand of the seas—no wonder my words have been rash.
aov_text: Ja, dan sou dit swaarder wees as die sand van die see; daarom is my woorde onbedagsaam.

kjv_text: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me, the poison whereof drinketh up my spirit: the terrors of God do set themselves in array against me.
bsb_text: For the arrows of the Almighty have pierced me; my spirit drinks in their poison; the terrors of God are arrayed against me.
aov_text: Want die pyle van die Almagtige is in my, waarvan my gees die gif indrink; die verskrikkinge van God stel hulle teen my op.

kjv_text: Doth the wild ass bray when he hath grass? or loweth the ox over his fodder?
bsb_text: Does a wild donkey bray over fresh grass, or an ox low over its fodder?
aov_text: Balk die wilde-esel by die grasspruitjies? Of bulk ’n bees by sy voer?

kjv_text: Can that which is unsavoury be eaten without salt? or is there any taste in the white of an egg?
bsb_text: Is tasteless food eaten without salt, or is there flavor in the white of an egg?
aov_text: Word iets wat laf is, sonder sout geëet? Of is daar smaak in die wit van ’n eier?

kjv_text: The things that my soul refused to touch are as my sorrowful meat.
bsb_text: My soul refuses to touch them; they are loathsome food to me.
aov_text: My siel weier om dit aan te raak; dit is net soos my walglike spys.

kjv_text: Oh that I might have my request; and that God would grant me the thing that I long for!
bsb_text: If only my request were granted and God would fulfill my hope:
aov_text: AG, mag my bede maar uitkom, en mag God my verwagting maar gee!

kjv_text: Even that it would please God to destroy me; that he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!
bsb_text: that God would be willing to crush me, to unleash His hand and cut me off!
aov_text: En mag dit God behaag om my te verpletter, sy hand uit te strek en my af te sny!

kjv_text: Then should I yet have comfort; yea, I would harden myself in sorrow: let him not spare; for I have not concealed the words of the Holy One.
bsb_text: It still brings me comfort, and joy through unrelenting pain, that I have not denied the words of the Holy One.
aov_text: Dan sou ek nog troos hê; ja, ek sou van vreugde opspring in onbarmhartige smart; want die woorde van die Heilige het ek nie verloën nie.

kjv_text: What is my strength, that I should hope? and what is mine end, that I should prolong my life?
bsb_text: What strength do I have, that I should still hope? What is my future, that I should be patient?
aov_text: Wat is my krag, dat ek sou kan wag; en wat my uiteinde, dat ek geduldig sou wees?

kjv_text: Is my strength the strength of stones? or is my flesh of brass?
bsb_text: Is my strength like that of stone, or my flesh made of bronze?
aov_text: Is my krag ’n krag van klip of my vlees van koper?

kjv_text: Is not my help in me? and is wisdom driven quite from me?
bsb_text: Is there any help within me now that success is driven from me?
aov_text: Is ek dan nie hulpeloos in myself nie, en is redding nie vir my weggedrywe nie?

kjv_text: To him that is afflicted pity should be shewed from his friend; but he forsaketh the fear of the Almighty.
bsb_text: A despairing man should have the kindness of his friend, even if he forsakes the fear of the Almighty.
aov_text: VIR die moedelose moet daar liefde wees van die kant van sy vriend, ook al laat hy die vrees vir die Almagtige vaar.

kjv_text: My brethren have dealt deceitfully as a brook, and as the stream of brooks they pass away;
bsb_text: But my brothers are as faithless as wadis, as seasonal streams that overflow,
aov_text: My broers het troueloos gehandel soos ’n spruit, soos die bedding van spruite wat wegloop,

kjv_text: Which are blackish by reason of the ice, and wherein the snow is hid:
bsb_text: darkened because of the ice and the inflow of melting snow,
aov_text: wat troebel is vanweë die ys, waarin die sneeu hom verberg —

kjv_text: What time they wax warm, they vanish: when it is hot, they are consumed out of their place.
bsb_text: but ceasing in the dry season and vanishing from their channels in the heat.
aov_text: in die tyd van gloeihitte verdwyn hulle; as dit warm word, droog hulle op uit hul plek.

kjv_text: The paths of their way are turned aside; they go to nothing, and perish.
bsb_text: Caravans turn aside from their routes; they go into the wasteland and perish.
aov_text: Die paaie van hulle loop kronkelend weg en gaan heen in die wildernis en vergaan.

kjv_text: The troops of Tema looked, the companies of Sheba waited for them.
bsb_text: The caravans of Tema look for water; the travelers of Sheba hope to find it.
aov_text: Die karavane van Tema het uitgekyk, die reisigers van Skeba het daarop gewag.

kjv_text: They were confounded because they had hoped; they came thither, and were ashamed.
bsb_text: They are confounded because they had hoped; their arrival brings disappointment.
aov_text: Hulle het beskaamd gestaan in hul vertroue; hulle het daarby gekom en was teleurgesteld.

kjv_text: For now ye are nothing; ye see my casting down, and are afraid.
bsb_text: For now you are of no help; you see terror, and you are afraid.
aov_text: So het julle dan vir my niks geword nie: julle sien verskrikking, en julle het gevrees.

kjv_text: Did I say, Bring unto me? or, Give a reward for me of your substance?
bsb_text: Have I ever said, ‘Give me something; offer me a bribe from your wealth;
aov_text: Het ek dan gesê: Gee my iets? Of: Bring vir my ’n omkoopgeskenk uit julle vermoë?

kjv_text: Or, Deliver me from the enemy's hand? or, Redeem me from the hand of the mighty?
bsb_text: deliver me from the hand of the enemy; redeem me from the grasp of the ruthless’?
aov_text: Of: Red my uit die hand van die teëstander? Of: Verlos my uit die hand van tiranne?

kjv_text: Teach me, and I will hold my tongue: and cause me to understand wherein I have erred.
bsb_text: Teach me, and I will be silent. Help me understand how I have erred.
aov_text: ONDERRIG my, en ék sal swyg; en maak my duidelik waarin ek my misgaan het.

kjv_text: How forcible are right words! but what doth your arguing reprove?
bsb_text: How painful are honest words! But what does your argument prove?
aov_text: Hoe kragtig is opregte woorde, maar wat rig ’n bestraffing uit, van julle afkomstig?

kjv_text: Do ye imagine to reprove words, and the speeches of one that is desperate, which are as wind?
bsb_text: Do you intend to correct my words, and treat as wind my cry of despair?
aov_text: Dink julle om woorde te bestraf? Maar die woorde van ’n wanhopige is vir die wind!

kjv_text: Yea, ye overwhelm the fatherless, and ye dig a pit for your friend.
bsb_text: You would even cast lots for an orphan and barter away your friend.
aov_text: Ja, julle sou ’n wees uitloot en julle vriend verhandel.

kjv_text: Now therefore be content, look upon me; for it is evident unto you if I lie.
bsb_text: But now, please look at me. Would I lie to your face?
aov_text: Maar nou, kyk my asseblief aan: ek sal julle waarlik nie in jul gesig belieg nie.

kjv_text: Return, I pray you, let it not be iniquity; yea, return again, my righteousness is in it.
bsb_text: Reconsider; do not be unjust. Reconsider, for my righteousness is at stake.
aov_text: Keer tog terug—laat daar geen onreg wees nie! Ja, keer terug—nóg is my geregtigheid daar.

kjv_text: Is there iniquity in my tongue? cannot my taste discern perverse things?
bsb_text: Is there iniquity on my tongue? Can my mouth not discern malice?
aov_text: Is daar onreg op my tong? Of kan my verhemelte nie die onheile onderskei nie?

kjv_text: Is there not an appointed time to man upon earth? are not his days also like the days of an hireling?
bsb_text: “Is not man consigned to labor on earth? Are not his days like those of a hired hand?
aov_text: HET die mens nie ’n stryd op die aarde nie? En is sy dae nie soos die dae van ’n dagloner nie?

kjv_text: As a servant earnestly desireth the shadow, and as an hireling looketh for the reward of his work:
bsb_text: Like a slave he longs for shade; like a hireling he waits for his wages.
aov_text: Soos ’n slaaf wat hyg na die skaduwee, en soos ’n dagloner wat wag op sy werkloon,

kjv_text: So am I made to possess months of vanity, and wearisome nights are appointed to me.
bsb_text: So I am allotted months of futility, and nights of misery are appointed me.
aov_text: so het ek erfgenaam geword van maande van teleurstelling en is nagte van moeite vir my bestem.

kjv_text: When I lie down, I say, When shall I arise, and the night be gone? and I am full of tossings to and fro unto the dawning of the day.
bsb_text: When I lie down I think: ‘When will I get up?’ But the night drags on, and I toss and turn until dawn.
aov_text: As ek gaan lê, dink ek: Wanneer sal ek opstaan? Maar die aand is lank, en ek word sat van al die omdraai tot die môreskemering toe.

kjv_text: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust; my skin is broken, and become loathsome.
bsb_text: My flesh is clothed with worms and encrusted with dirt; my skin is cracked and festering.
aov_text: My vlees is bekleed met wurms en stofklonte; my vel trek opmekaar en etter dan weer.

kjv_text: My days are swifter than a weaver's shuttle, and are spent without hope.
bsb_text: My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle; they come to an end without hope.
aov_text: My dae is vinniger as ’n wewerspoel en verdwyn sonder verwagting.

kjv_text: O remember that my life is wind: mine eye shall no more see good.
bsb_text: Remember that my life is but a breath. My eyes will never again see happiness.
aov_text: Bedink tog dat my lewe wind is; my oog sal die voorspoed nie weer sien nie.

kjv_text: The eye of him that hath seen me shall see me no more: thine eyes are upon me, and I am not.
bsb_text: The eye that beholds me will no longer see me. You will look for me, but I will be no more.
aov_text: Die oog van hom wat my sien, sal my nie meer aanskou nie. U oë is op my—en ek is daar nie!

kjv_text: As the cloud is consumed and vanisheth away: so he that goeth down to the grave shall come up no more.
bsb_text: As a cloud vanishes and is gone, so he who goes down to Sheol does not come back up.
aov_text: Die wolk verdwyn en gaan heen—so kom hy nie weer op wat na die doderyk neerdaal nie.

kjv_text: He shall return no more to his house, neither shall his place know him any more.
bsb_text: He never returns to his house; his place remembers him no more.
aov_text: Hy sal nie meer teruggaan na sy huis nie, en sy plek sal hom nie meer ken nie.

kjv_text: Therefore I will not refrain my mouth; I will speak in the anguish of my spirit; I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.
bsb_text: Therefore I will not restrain my mouth; I will speak in the anguish of my spirit; I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.
aov_text: SO wil dan ook ék my mond nie hou nie, ek wil spreek in die benoudheid van my gees, ek wil klae in die bitterheid van my siel.

kjv_text: Am I a sea, or a whale, that thou settest a watch over me?
bsb_text: Am I the sea, or the monster of the deep, that You must keep me under guard?
aov_text: Is ek ’n see, of ’n groot seedier, dat U ’n wag teen my opstel?

kjv_text: When I say, My bed shall comfort me, my couch shall ease my complaint;
bsb_text: When I think my bed will comfort me and my couch will ease my complaint,
aov_text: As ek sê: My bed sal my troos, my slaapplek sal my klagte help dra,

kjv_text: Then thou scarest me with dreams, and terrifiest me through visions:
bsb_text: then You frighten me with dreams and terrify me with visions,
aov_text: dan verskrik U my deur drome en ontstel my deur gesigte,

kjv_text: So that my soul chooseth strangling, and death rather than my life.
bsb_text: so that I would prefer strangling and death over my life in this body.
aov_text: sodat ek die verwurging verkies, die dood meer as hierdie geraamte van my.

kjv_text: I loathe it; I would not live alway: let me alone; for my days are vanity.
bsb_text: I loathe my life! I would not live forever. Leave me alone, for my days are but a breath.
aov_text: Ek verfoei my lewe. Nie vir altyd sal ek lewe nie: laat my met rus, want my dae is nietigheid.

kjv_text: What is man, that thou shouldest magnify him? and that thou shouldest set thine heart upon him?
bsb_text: What is man that You should exalt him, that You should set Your heart upon him,
aov_text: Wat is die mens, dat U hom so hoog stel en dat U op hom ag gee?

kjv_text: And that thou shouldest visit him every morning, and try him every moment?
bsb_text: that You attend to him every morning, and test him every moment?
aov_text: En dat U hom elke môre soek, elke oomblik hom op die proef stel?

kjv_text: How long wilt thou not depart from me, nor let me alone till I swallow down my spittle?
bsb_text: Will You never look away from me, or leave me alone to swallow my spittle?
aov_text: Hoe lank sal U nie van my af wegkyk nie, my nie laat staan nie, totdat ek my speeksel insluk?

kjv_text: I have sinned; what shall I do unto thee, O thou preserver of men? why hast thou set me as a mark against thee, so that I am a burden to myself?
bsb_text: If I have sinned, what have I done to You, O watcher of mankind? Why have You made me Your target, so that I am a burden to You?
aov_text: As ek gesondig het, wat doen ek U aan, o Mensebewaker? Waarom het U my as mikpunt vir U opgestel, sodat ek myself tot ’n las is?

kjv_text: And why dost thou not pardon my transgression, and take away mine iniquity? for now shall I sleep in the dust; and thou shalt seek me in the morning, but I shall not be.
bsb_text: Why do You not pardon my transgression and take away my iniquity? For soon I will lie down in the dust; You will seek me, but I will be no more.”
aov_text: En waarom vergeef U nie my oortreding en neem my ongeregtigheid nie weg nie? Want weldra sal ek in die stof lê; dan sal U my soek, maar ek sal daar nie wees nie.

kjv_text: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,
bsb_text: Then Bildad the Shuhite replied:
aov_text: TOE het Bildad, die Suhiet, geantwoord en gesê:

kjv_text: How long wilt thou speak these things? and how long shall the words of thy mouth be like a strong wind?
bsb_text: “How long will you go on saying such things? The words of your mouth are a blustering wind.
aov_text: Hoe lank sal jy hierdie dinge spreek en die woorde van jou mond ’n geweldige wind wees?

kjv_text: Doth God pervert judgment? or doth the Almighty pervert justice?
bsb_text: Does God pervert justice? Does the Almighty pervert what is right?
aov_text: Sou God die reg verdraai, of die Almagtige die geregtigheid krenk?

kjv_text: If thy children have sinned against him, and he have cast them away for their transgression;
bsb_text: When your children sinned against Him, He gave them over to their rebellion.
aov_text: As jou kinders teen Hom gesondig het, het Hy hulle aan hul oortreding oorgegee.

kjv_text: If thou wouldest seek unto God betimes, and make thy supplication to the Almighty;
bsb_text: But if you would earnestly seek God and ask the Almighty for mercy,
aov_text: As jý na God soek en die Almagtige om genade smeek,

kjv_text: If thou wert pure and upright; surely now he would awake for thee, and make the habitation of thy righteousness prosperous.
bsb_text: if you are pure and upright, even now He will rouse Himself on your behalf and restore your righteous estate.
aov_text: as jy rein en opreg is, ja, dan sal Hy oor jou opwaak en jou woning herstel ooreenkomstig jou geregtigheid;

kjv_text: Though thy beginning was small, yet thy latter end should greatly increase.
bsb_text: Though your beginnings were modest, your latter days will flourish.
aov_text: dan sal jou begin gering wees, maar jou einde baie groot.

kjv_text: For enquire, I pray thee, of the former age, and prepare thyself to the search of their fathers:
bsb_text: Please inquire of past generations and consider the discoveries of their fathers.
aov_text: WANT doen tog navraag by die vorige geslag, en gee ag op wat hulle vaders nagespeur het;

kjv_text: (For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days upon earth are a shadow:)
bsb_text: For we were born yesterday and know nothing; our days on earth are but a shadow.
aov_text: (want ons is van gister en weet niks nie, omdat ons dae ’n skaduwee op die aarde is;)

kjv_text: Shall not they teach thee, and tell thee, and utter words out of their heart?
bsb_text: Will they not teach you and tell you, and speak from their understanding?
aov_text: sal húlle jou nie leer, jou dit nie sê en woorde uit hul hart voortbring nie?

kjv_text: Can the rush grow up without mire? can the flag grow without water?
bsb_text: Does papyrus grow where there is no marsh? Do reeds flourish without water?
aov_text: Skiet die biesie op waar geen moeras is nie? Groei die riet sonder water?

kjv_text: Whilst it is yet in his greenness, and not cut down, it withereth before any other herb.
bsb_text: While the shoots are still uncut, they dry up quicker than grass.
aov_text: Nog is dit in sy volle groei—sonder dat dit afgepluk word—dan verdor dit voor al die ander gras.

kjv_text: So are the paths of all that forget God; and the hypocrite's hope shall perish:
bsb_text: Such is the destiny of all who forget God; so the hope of the godless will perish.
aov_text: So gaan dit met almal wat God vergeet, en so vergaan die verwagting van die goddelose;

kjv_text: Whose hope shall be cut off, and whose trust shall be a spider's web.
bsb_text: His confidence is fragile; his security is in a spider’s web.
aov_text: sy hoop is afgesny en die voorwerp van sy vertroue is ’n spinnerak.

kjv_text: He shall lean upon his house, but it shall not stand: he shall hold it fast, but it shall not endure.
bsb_text: He leans on his web, but it gives way; he holds fast, but it does not endure.
aov_text: Hy steun op sy huis, maar dit bly nie staan nie; hy klem hom daaraan vas, maar dit hou geen stand nie.

kjv_text: He is green before the sun, and his branch shooteth forth in his garden.
bsb_text: He is a well-watered plant in the sunshine, spreading its shoots over the garden.
aov_text: Vol sap staan hy in die son, en sy ranke sprei uit oor sy tuin.

kjv_text: His roots are wrapped about the heap, and seeth the place of stones.
bsb_text: His roots wrap around the rock heap; he looks for a home among the stones.
aov_text: Sy wortels is gevleg oor ’n hoop klippe heen, ’n kliphuis deurboor hy.

kjv_text: If he destroy him from his place, then it shall deny him, saying, I have not seen thee.
bsb_text: If he is uprooted from his place, it will disown him, saying, ‘I never saw you.’
aov_text: As Hy hom vernietig uit sy plek, sal dit hom verloën en sê: Ek het jou nie gesien nie.

kjv_text: Behold, this is the joy of his way, and out of the earth shall others grow.
bsb_text: Surely this is the joy of his way; yet others will spring from the dust.
aov_text: Kyk, dit is die vreugde van sy lewensweg, en uit die stof spruit daar ander uit!

kjv_text: Behold, God will not cast away a perfect man, neither will he help the evil doers:
bsb_text: Behold, God does not reject the blameless, nor will He strengthen the hand of evildoers.
aov_text: Kyk, God verwerp die vrome nie, en Hy vat die kwaaddoeners nie aan die hand nie.

kjv_text: Till he fill thy mouth with laughing, and thy lips with rejoicing.
bsb_text: He will yet fill your mouth with laughter, and your lips with a shout of joy.
aov_text: Terwyl Hy jou mond met gelag vervul en jou lippe met gejuig,

kjv_text: They that hate thee shall be clothed with shame; and the dwelling place of the wicked shall come to nought.
bsb_text: Your enemies will be clothed in shame, and the tent of the wicked will be no more.”
aov_text: sal jou haters met skaamte beklee word, en die tent van die goddelose—weg is dit!

kjv_text: Then Job answered and said,
bsb_text: Then Job answered:
aov_text: MAAR Job het geantwoord en gesê:

kjv_text: I know it is so of a truth: but how should man be just with God?
bsb_text: “Yes, I know that it is so, but how can a mortal be righteous before God?
aov_text: Waarlik, ek weet dat dit so is; en hoe kan ’n mens regverdig wees by God?

kjv_text: If he will contend with him, he cannot answer him one of a thousand.
bsb_text: If one wished to contend with God, he could not answer Him one time out of a thousand.
aov_text: As hy sou begeer om met Hom te twis, nie een uit duisend sal hy Hom kan antwoord nie.

kjv_text: He is wise in heart, and mighty in strength: who hath hardened himself against him, and hath prospered?
bsb_text: God is wise in heart and mighty in strength. Who has resisted Him and prospered?
aov_text: Hy is wys van hart en sterk van krag; wie was hardnekkig teen Hom en het ongestraf gebly?

kjv_text: Which removeth the mountains, and they know not: which overturneth them in his anger.
bsb_text: He moves mountains without their knowledge and overturns them in His anger.
aov_text: Hy wat berge versit sonder dat hulle dit merk; wat hulle omkeer in sy toorn;

kjv_text: Which shaketh the earth out of her place, and the pillars thereof tremble.
bsb_text: He shakes the earth from its place, so that its foundations tremble.
aov_text: wat die aarde laat sidder uit sy plek, sodat sy pilare dril;

kjv_text: Which commandeth the sun, and it riseth not; and sealeth up the stars.
bsb_text: He commands the sun not to shine; He seals off the stars.
aov_text: wat bevel gee aan die son, en hy gaan nie op nie, en die sterre agter ’n seël wegsluit;

kjv_text: Which alone spreadeth out the heavens, and treadeth upon the waves of the sea.
bsb_text: He alone stretches out the heavens and treads on the waves of the sea.
aov_text: wat alleen die hemel uitspan en stap op die golwe van die see;

kjv_text: Which maketh Arcturus, Orion, and Pleiades, and the chambers of the south.
bsb_text: He is the Maker of the Bear and Orion, of the Pleiades and the constellations of the south.
aov_text: wat die Beer gemaak het, die Oríon en die Sewe-ster en die Kamers van die Suide;

kjv_text: Which doeth great things past finding out; yea, and wonders without number.
bsb_text: He does great things beyond searching out, and wonders without number.
aov_text: wat groot, ondeurgrondelike dinge doen en wonders sonder getal.

kjv_text: Lo, he goeth by me, and I see him not: he passeth on also, but I perceive him not.
bsb_text: Were He to pass by me, I would not see Him; were He to move, I would not recognize Him.
aov_text: Gaan Hy by my langs, dan sien ek Hom nie, en Hy skuif verby sonder dat ek Hom bemerk.

kjv_text: Behold, he taketh away, who can hinder him? who will say unto him, What doest thou?
bsb_text: If He takes away, who can stop Him? Who dares to ask Him, ‘What are You doing?’
aov_text: Sleep Hy weg—wie sal Hom teëhou? Wie vir Hom sê: Wat maak U?

kjv_text: If God will not withdraw his anger, the proud helpers do stoop under him.
bsb_text: God does not restrain His anger; the helpers of Rahab cower beneath Him.
aov_text: God wend sy toorn nie af nie; onder Hom moet die helpers van Rahab kruip.

kjv_text: How much less shall I answer him, and choose out my words to reason with him?
bsb_text: How then can I answer Him or choose my arguments against Him?
aov_text: HOEVEEL minder sal ék Hom kan antwoord, sal ek my woorde kan kies teenoor Hom;

kjv_text: Whom, though I were righteous, yet would I not answer, but I would make supplication to my judge.
bsb_text: For even if I were right, I could not answer. I could only beg my Judge for mercy.
aov_text: Hom wat ek nie kan antwoord nie, al was ek regverdig: ek kan my regter net om genade smeek!

kjv_text: If I had called, and he had answered me; yet would I not believe that he had hearkened unto my voice.
bsb_text: If I summoned Him and He answered me, I do not believe He would listen to my voice.
aov_text: As ek dagvaar en Hy my antwoord, glo ek nie dat Hy na my stem sal luister nie.

kjv_text: For he breaketh me with a tempest, and multiplieth my wounds without cause.
bsb_text: For He would crush me with a tempest and multiply my wounds without cause.
aov_text: Hy wat my deur ’n stormwind sou vernietig en my wonde sonder oorsaak sou vermeerder;

kjv_text: He will not suffer me to take my breath, but filleth me with bitterness.
bsb_text: He does not let me catch my breath, but overwhelms me with bitterness.
aov_text: my nie sou toelaat om asem te skep nie, maar my sou versadig met bitterhede.

kjv_text: If I speak of strength, lo, he is strong: and if of judgment, who shall set me a time to plead?
bsb_text: If it is a matter of strength, He is indeed mighty! If it is a matter of justice, who can summon Him?
aov_text: Kom dit aan op die krag van die sterkste—hier is Ek! En kom dit op reg aan—wie kan My dagvaar?

kjv_text: If I justify myself, mine own mouth shall condemn me: if I say, I am perfect, it shall also prove me perverse.
bsb_text: Even if I were righteous, my mouth would condemn me; if I were blameless, it would declare me guilty.
aov_text: Al was ek regverdig, my eie mond sou my veroordeel; al was ek onskuldig, Hy sou my as ’n verkeerde reken.

kjv_text: Though I were perfect, yet would I not know my soul: I would despise my life.
bsb_text: Though I am blameless, I have no concern for myself; I despise my own life.
aov_text: Vroom is ek! Ek gee niks om myself nie: ek verfoei my lewe!

kjv_text: This is one thing, therefore I said it, He destroyeth the perfect and the wicked.
bsb_text: It is all the same, and so I say, ‘He destroys both the blameless and the wicked.’
aov_text: DIT is net eenders—daarom sê ek: Die vrome en die goddelose vernietig Hy.

kjv_text: If the scourge slay suddenly, he will laugh at the trial of the innocent.
bsb_text: When the scourge brings sudden death, He mocks the despair of the innocent.
aov_text: As die gésel skielik doodmaak, spot Hy met die vertwyfeling van die onskuldiges.

kjv_text: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked: he covereth the faces of the judges thereof; if not, where, and who is he?
bsb_text: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked; He blindfolds its judges. If it is not He, then who is it?
aov_text: Die aarde is aan die mag van die goddelose oorgelewer, die gesig van die regters bind Hy toe. Is dit nie Hy nie, wie dan anders?

kjv_text: Now my days are swifter than a post: they flee away, they see no good.
bsb_text: My days are swifter than a runner; they flee without seeing good.
aov_text: Ja, my dae was gouer as ’n hardloper; hulle het weggevlug sonder om voorspoed te sien.

kjv_text: They are passed away as the swift ships: as the eagle that hasteth to the prey.
bsb_text: They sweep by like boats of papyrus, like an eagle swooping down on its prey.
aov_text: Hulle het verbygegly soos skepe van biesies, soos ’n arend wat neerskiet op sy prooi.

kjv_text: If I say, I will forget my complaint, I will leave off my heaviness, and comfort myself:
bsb_text: If I were to say, ‘I will forget my complaint and change my expression and smile,’
aov_text: As ek sê: Ek wil my geklaag vergeet, my droewige gesig laat vaar en vrolik word,

kjv_text: I am afraid of all my sorrows, I know that thou wilt not hold me innocent.
bsb_text: I would still dread all my sufferings; I know that You will not acquit me.
aov_text: dan is ek al bang vir al my smarte: ek weet dat U my nie sal vryspreek nie.

kjv_text: If I be wicked, why then labour I in vain?
bsb_text: Since I am already found guilty, why should I labor in vain?
aov_text: Ek sal tog skuldig wees—waarom sal ek my dan tevergeefs afmat?

kjv_text: If I wash myself with snow water, and make my hands never so clean;
bsb_text: If I should wash myself with snow and cleanse my hands with lye,
aov_text: Al was ek my met sneeu en reinig ek my hande met loog,

kjv_text: Yet shalt thou plunge me in the ditch, and mine own clothes shall abhor me.
bsb_text: then You would plunge me into the pit, and even my own clothes would despise me.
aov_text: dan sou U my in ’n poel indompel, sodat my klere van my ’n afsku kry.

kjv_text: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, and we should come together in judgment.
bsb_text: For He is not a man like me, that I can answer Him, that we can take each other to court.
aov_text: Want Hy is nie ’n man soos ek, dat ek Hom sou kan antwoord, dat ons saam na die gereg sou kan gaan nie.

kjv_text: Neither is there any daysman betwixt us, that might lay his hand upon us both.
bsb_text: Nor is there a mediator between us, to lay his hand upon us both.
aov_text: Daar is geen skeidsregter tussen ons wat sy hand op ons twee kan lê nie.

kjv_text: Let him take his rod away from me, and let not his fear terrify me:
bsb_text: Let Him remove His rod from me, so that His terror will no longer frighten me.
aov_text: Laat Hy sy roede van my wegneem, en laat sy verskrikking my nie beangstig nie;

kjv_text: Then would I speak, and not fear him; but it is not so with me.
bsb_text: Then I would speak without fear of Him. But as it is, I am on my own.
aov_text: dan wil ek spreek sonder dat ek vir Hom bevrees is; want só is dit met my nie gesteld nie.

kjv_text: My soul is weary of my life; I will leave my complaint upon myself; I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.
bsb_text: “I loathe my own life; I will express my complaint and speak in the bitterness of my soul.
aov_text: EK walg van my lewe; ek wil my geklaag die vrye loop gee; ek wil spreek in die bitterheid van my siel.

kjv_text: I will say unto God, Do not condemn me; shew me wherefore thou contendest with me.
bsb_text: I will say to God: Do not condemn me! Let me know why You prosecute me.
aov_text: Ek sê tot God: Veroordeel my nie; laat my weet waarom U met my twis.

kjv_text: Is it good unto thee that thou shouldest oppress, that thou shouldest despise the work of thine hands, and shine upon the counsel of the wicked?
bsb_text: Does it please You to oppress me, to reject the work of Your hands and favor the schemes of the wicked?
aov_text: Is dit voordeel vir U dat U verdruk; dat U die arbeid van u hande verwerp, terwyl U oor die planne van die goddelose lig laat skyn?

kjv_text: Hast thou eyes of flesh? or seest thou as man seeth?
bsb_text: Do You have eyes of flesh? Do You see as man sees?
aov_text: Het U vleeslike oë? Of sien U soos ’n mens sien?

kjv_text: Are thy days as the days of man? are thy years as man's days,
bsb_text: Are Your days like those of a mortal, or Your years like those of a man,
aov_text: Is u dae soos die dae van ’n mens, of u jare soos die dae van ’n man?

kjv_text: That thou enquirest after mine iniquity, and searchest after my sin?
bsb_text: that You should seek my iniquity and search out my sin—
aov_text: dat U soek na my ongeregtigheid en vra na my sonde,

kjv_text: Thou knowest that I am not wicked; and there is none that can deliver out of thine hand.
bsb_text: though You know that I am not guilty, and there is no deliverance from Your hand?
aov_text: ofskoon U weet dat ek nie skuldig is nie en dat daar niemand is wat uit u hand kan red nie?

kjv_text: Thine hands have made me and fashioned me together round about; yet thou dost destroy me.
bsb_text: Your hands shaped me and altogether formed me. Would You now turn and destroy me?
aov_text: U hande het my geformeer en my gemaak, heeltemal rondom; en U vernietig my!

kjv_text: Remember, I beseech thee, that thou hast made me as the clay; and wilt thou bring me into dust again?
bsb_text: Please remember that You molded me like clay. Would You now return me to dust?
aov_text: Bedink tog dat U my soos klei gevorm het, en wil U my tot stof laat terugkeer?

kjv_text: Hast thou not poured me out as milk, and curdled me like cheese?
bsb_text: Did You not pour me out like milk, and curdle me like cheese?
aov_text: Het U my nie soos melk uitgegiet en my soos kaas laat dik word nie?

kjv_text: Thou hast clothed me with skin and flesh, and hast fenced me with bones and sinews.
bsb_text: You clothed me with skin and flesh, and knit me together with bones and sinews.
aov_text: Met vel en vlees het U my beklee, en met beendere en senings het U my deurvleg.

kjv_text: Thou hast granted me life and favour, and thy visitation hath preserved my spirit.
bsb_text: You have granted me life and loving devotion, and Your care has preserved my spirit.
aov_text: Die lewe, ja, guns het U aan my bewys, en u sorg het my gees bewaak.

kjv_text: And these things hast thou hid in thine heart: I know that this is with thee.
bsb_text: Yet You concealed these things in Your heart, and I know that this was in Your mind:
aov_text: MAAR daarby het U dít verberg in u hart, ek weet dat dít u toeleg was:

kjv_text: If I sin, then thou markest me, and thou wilt not acquit me from mine iniquity.
bsb_text: If I sinned, You would take note, and would not acquit me of my iniquity.
aov_text: As ek gesondig het, sou U my waarneem en my nie vryspreek van my ongeregtigheid nie.

kjv_text: If I be wicked, woe unto me; and if I be righteous, yet will I not lift up my head. I am full of confusion; therefore see thou mine affliction;
bsb_text: If I am guilty, woe to me! And even if I am righteous, I cannot lift my head. I am full of shame and aware of my affliction.
aov_text: Was ek skuldig—wee my! En was ek regverdig, ek sou my hoof nie kon ophef nie, sat van skande en bewus van my ellende.

kjv_text: For it increaseth. Thou huntest me as a fierce lion: and again thou shewest thyself marvellous upon me.
bsb_text: Should I hold my head high, You would hunt me like a lion, and again display Your power against me.
aov_text: En as my hoof hom ophef, sou U my jaag soos ’n leeu en U opnuut wonderbaarlik teenoor my gedra.

kjv_text: Thou renewest thy witnesses against me, and increasest thine indignation upon me; changes and war are against me.
bsb_text: You produce new witnesses against me and multiply Your anger toward me. Hardships assault me in wave after wave.
aov_text: U sou altyd nuwe getuies teen my bring en u grimmigheid teen my vermeerder—altyd nuwe leërafdelings teen my!

kjv_text: Wherefore then hast thou brought me forth out of the womb? Oh that I had given up the ghost, and no eye had seen me!
bsb_text: Why then did You bring me from the womb? Oh, that I had died, and no eye had seen me!
aov_text: Waarom tog het U my uit die moederskoot laat uitgaan? Ek moes gesterf het sonder dat ’n oog my gesien het.

kjv_text: I should have been as though I had not been; I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.
bsb_text: If only I had never come to be, but had been carried from the womb to the grave.
aov_text: Ek moes gewees het of ek daar nie was nie; van die moederskoot af moes ek na die graf gedra gewees het.

kjv_text: Are not my days few? cease then, and let me alone, that I may take comfort a little,
bsb_text: Are my days not few? Withdraw from me, that I may have a little comfort,
aov_text: Is my dae nie min nie? Laat Hy ophou, my laat staan, dat ek ’n bietjie vrolik kan wees,

kjv_text: Before I go whence I shall not return, even to the land of darkness and the shadow of death;
bsb_text: before I go—never to return—to a land of darkness and gloom,
aov_text: voordat ek heengaan—en nie terugkom nie—na die land van duisternis en doodskaduwee,

kjv_text: A land of darkness, as darkness itself; and of the shadow of death, without any order, and where the light is as darkness.
bsb_text: to a land of utter darkness, of deep shadow and disorder, where even the light is like darkness.”
aov_text: ’n land van donkerheid, soos middernag, van doodskaduwee en wanorde, en dit gee ’n skynsel—soos middernag!

kjv_text: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,
bsb_text: Then Zophar the Naamathite replied:
aov_text: TOE het Sofar, die Naämatiet, geantwoord en gesê:

kjv_text: Should not the multitude of words be answered? and should a man full of talk be justified?
bsb_text: “Should this stream of words go unanswered and such a speaker be vindicated?
aov_text: Moet die menigte van woorde onbeantwoord bly? Of moet ’n loslippige man reg hê?

kjv_text: Should thy lies make men hold their peace? and when thou mockest, shall no man make thee ashamed?
bsb_text: Should your babbling put others to silence? Will you scoff without rebuke?
aov_text: Sou jou gepraat manne laat swyg, sodat jy spot—sonder dat iemand jou beskaamd maak —

kjv_text: For thou hast said, My doctrine is pure, and I am clean in thine eyes.
bsb_text: You have said, ‘My doctrine is sound, and I am pure in Your sight.’
aov_text: en sê: Suiwer is my leer, en rein is ek in u oë?

kjv_text: But oh that God would speak, and open his lips against thee;
bsb_text: But if only God would speak and open His lips against you,
aov_text: Maar, ag, as Gód maar wou spreek en sy lippe open teen jou!

kjv_text: And that he would shew thee the secrets of wisdom, that they are double to that which is! Know therefore that God exacteth of thee less than thine iniquity deserveth.
