bsb_text: and disclose to you the secrets of wisdom, for true wisdom has two sides. Know then that God exacts from you less than your iniquity deserves.
aov_text: En jou bekend wou maak dat die verborgenhede van die wysheid die insig verdubbel! Sodat jy kan weet dat God vir jou ’n deel van jou skuld deur die vingers sien.

kjv_text: Canst thou by searching find out God? canst thou find out the Almighty unto perfection?
bsb_text: Can you fathom the deep things of God or discover the limits of the Almighty?
aov_text: KAN jy die dieptes van God peil? Of sal jy kan deurdring tot by die volmaaktheid van die Almagtige?

kjv_text: It is as high as heaven; what canst thou do? deeper than hell; what canst thou know?
bsb_text: They are higher than the heavens—what can you do? They are deeper than Sheol—what can you know?
aov_text: Hoogtes van die hemel is dit—wat kan jy doen? Dieper as die doderyk—wat kan jy weet?

kjv_text: The measure thereof is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.
bsb_text: Their measure is longer than the earth and wider than the sea.
aov_text: Langer as die aarde is die maat daarvan en breër as die see.

kjv_text: If he cut off, and shut up, or gather together, then who can hinder him?
bsb_text: If He comes along to imprison you, or convenes a court, who can stop Him?
aov_text: As Hy verbyskuiwe en gevange neem en ’n regsvergadering oproep—wie sal Hom dan teëhou?

kjv_text: For he knoweth vain men: he seeth wickedness also; will he not then consider it?
bsb_text: Surely He knows the deceit of men. If He sees iniquity, does He not take note?
aov_text: Want Hý ken die valse mense, en Hy sien die ongeregtigheid sonder dat Hy juis daarop ag gee.

kjv_text: For vain man would be wise, though man be born like a wild ass's colt.
bsb_text: But a witless man can no more become wise than the colt of a wild donkey can be born a man!
aov_text: So kan dan ’n domme verstand verkry en ’n jong wilde-esel as mens gebore word.

kjv_text: If thou prepare thine heart, and stretch out thine hands toward him;
bsb_text: As for you, if you direct your heart and lift up your hands to Him,
aov_text: AS jý jou hart berei en jou hande uitbrei na Hom

kjv_text: If iniquity be in thine hand, put it far away, and let not wickedness dwell in thy tabernacles.
bsb_text: if you put away the iniquity in your hand, and allow no injustice to dwell in your tents,
aov_text: ö as daar ongeregtigheid in jou hand is, verwyder dit, en laat geen onreg in jou tente woon nie —

kjv_text: For then shalt thou lift up thy face without spot; yea, thou shalt be stedfast, and shalt not fear:
bsb_text: then indeed you will lift up your face without shame; you will stand firm and unafraid.
aov_text: ja, dan sal jy jou aangesig kan ophef, vry van smet; en jy sal vasstaan sonder om te vrees.

kjv_text: Because thou shalt forget thy misery, and remember it as waters that pass away:
bsb_text: For you will forget your misery, recalling it only as waters gone by.
aov_text: Ja, jý sal die moeite vergeet; soos aan water wat verbygeloop het, sal jy daaraan dink.

kjv_text: And thine age shall be clearer than the noonday: thou shalt shine forth, thou shalt be as the morning.
bsb_text: Your life will be brighter than noonday; its darkness will be like the morning.
aov_text: En helderder as die middag sal die lewe oprys; is dit donker—dit sal wees soos die môre!

kjv_text: And thou shalt be secure, because there is hope; yea, thou shalt dig about thee, and thou shalt take thy rest in safety.
bsb_text: You will be secure, because there is hope, and you will look around and lie down in safety.
aov_text: En jy sal vertrou, want daar is verwagting; en kyk jy rond—jy sal in veiligheid gaan slaap.

kjv_text: Also thou shalt lie down, and none shall make thee afraid; yea, many shall make suit unto thee.
bsb_text: You will lie down without fear, and many will court your favor.
aov_text: Ook sal jy lê sonder dat iemand jou skrikmaak; en baie sal jou guns soek.

kjv_text: But the eyes of the wicked shall fail, and they shall not escape, and their hope shall be as the giving up of the ghost.
bsb_text: But the eyes of the wicked will fail, and escape will elude them; they will hope for their last breath.”
aov_text: Maar die oë van die goddelose sal versmag, en die toevlug is vir hulle verlore; en hulle verwagting is—uitblasing van die laaste asem.

kjv_text: And Job answered and said,
bsb_text: Then Job answered:
aov_text: MAAR Job het geantwoord en gesê:

kjv_text: No doubt but ye are the people, and wisdom shall die with you.
bsb_text: “Truly then you are the people with whom wisdom itself will die!
aov_text: Waarlik, ja, julle is die regte mense, en saam met julle sterf die wysheid uit!

kjv_text: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you: yea, who knoweth not such things as these?
bsb_text: But I also have a mind; I am not inferior to you. Who does not know such things as these?
aov_text: Ook ek het verstand soos julle; ek staan nie vir julle terug nie; en wie weet sulke dinge nie?

kjv_text: I am as one mocked of his neighbour, who calleth upon God, and he answereth him: the just upright man is laughed to scorn.
bsb_text: I am a laughingstock to my friends, though I called on God, and He answered. The righteous and upright man is a laughingstock.
aov_text: Ek moet ’n belagging wees vir my vriend, ek wat God aangeroep en verhoring gevind het—’n belagging is die regverdige, die opregte!

kjv_text: He that is ready to slip with his feet is as a lamp despised in the thought of him that is at ease.
bsb_text: The one at ease scorns misfortune as the fate of those whose feet are slipping.
aov_text: Vir die ongeluk is daar veragting volgens die gedagte van hom wat lekker lewe; dit staan klaar vir hulle wie se voet wankel.

kjv_text: The tabernacles of robbers prosper, and they that provoke God are secure; into whose hand God bringeth abundantly.
bsb_text: The tents of robbers are safe, and those who provoke God are secure—those who carry their god in their hands.
aov_text: Rustig staan die tente van die verwoesters, en sekerheid is die deel van hulle wat God vertoorn, van hom wat sy god in sy hand dra.

kjv_text: But ask now the beasts, and they shall teach thee; and the fowls of the air, and they shall tell thee:
bsb_text: But ask the animals, and they will instruct you; ask the birds of the air, and they will tell you.
aov_text: MAAR vra tog vir die diere, dat hulle jou leer; en die voëls van die hemel, dat hulle jou te kenne gee;

kjv_text: Or speak to the earth, and it shall teach thee: and the fishes of the sea shall declare unto thee.
bsb_text: Or speak to the earth, and it will teach you; let the fish of the sea inform you.
aov_text: of spreek die aarde aan, dat dit jou leer, en laat die visse van die see jou vertel.

kjv_text: Who knoweth not in all these that the hand of the LORD hath wrought this?
bsb_text: Which of all these does not know that the hand of the LORD has done this?
aov_text: Wie weet nie deur al hierdie dinge dat die hand van die HERE dit gemaak het nie?

kjv_text: In whose hand is the soul of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind.
bsb_text: The life of every living thing is in His hand, as well as the breath of all mankind.
aov_text: In wie se hand die siel is van alles wat leef, en die gees van alle menslike vlees.

kjv_text: Doth not the ear try words? and the mouth taste his meat?
bsb_text: Does not the ear test words as the tongue tastes its food?
aov_text: Moet die oor nie woorde toets soos die verhemelte spys proe nie?

kjv_text: With the ancient is wisdom; and in length of days understanding.
bsb_text: Wisdom is found with the elderly, and understanding comes with long life.
aov_text: By die grysaards is wysheid, en in lengte van dae is verstand.

kjv_text: With him is wisdom and strength, he hath counsel and understanding.
bsb_text: Wisdom and strength belong to God; counsel and understanding are His.
aov_text: BY Hóm is wysheid en mag; Hý het raad en verstand.

kjv_text: Behold, he breaketh down, and it cannot be built again: he shutteth up a man, and there can be no opening.
bsb_text: What He tears down cannot be rebuilt; the man He imprisons cannot be released.
aov_text: Kyk, Hy breek af, en daar word nie opgebou nie; Hy sluit ’n man as gevangene op, en daar word nie oopgemaak nie.

kjv_text: Behold, he withholdeth the waters, and they dry up: also he sendeth them out, and they overturn the earth.
bsb_text: If He holds back the waters, they dry up, and if He releases them, they overwhelm the land.
aov_text: Kyk, Hy hou die waters terug, en hulle verdroog; ook laat Hy hulle los, en hulle keer die aarde om.

kjv_text: With him is strength and wisdom: the deceived and the deceiver are his.
bsb_text: True wisdom and power belong to Him. The deceived and the deceiver are His.
aov_text: By Hóm is krag en beleid; syne is die verdwaalde en hy wat laat dwaal.

kjv_text: He leadeth counsellors away spoiled, and maketh the judges fools.
bsb_text: He leads counselors away barefoot and makes fools of judges.
aov_text: Hy voer raadsmanne uitgeplunder weg, en regters maak Hy tot dwase.

kjv_text: He looseth the bond of kings, and girdeth their loins with a girdle.
bsb_text: He loosens the bonds placed by kings and fastens a belt around their waists.
aov_text: Hy maak die band los waar konings mee bind, en bind ’n lyfdoek om hulle heupe.

kjv_text: He leadeth princes away spoiled, and overthroweth the mighty.
bsb_text: He leads priests away barefoot and overthrows the established.
aov_text: Hy voer priesters uitgeplunder weg en bring wie vasstaan, tot ’n val.

kjv_text: He removeth away the speech of the trusty, and taketh away the understanding of the aged.
bsb_text: He deprives the trusted of speech and takes away the discernment of elders.
aov_text: Hy neem die spraak van die betroubare mense weg en beroof die ou mense van hul oordeel.

kjv_text: He poureth contempt upon princes, and weakeneth the strength of the mighty.
bsb_text: He pours out contempt on nobles and disarms the mighty.
aov_text: Hy stort veragting uit oor die edeles en maak die gordel van die magtiges slap.

kjv_text: He discovereth deep things out of darkness, and bringeth out to light the shadow of death.
bsb_text: He reveals the deep things of darkness and brings deep shadows into light.
aov_text: Hy openbaar dieptes uit die duisternis uit, en doodskaduwee bring Hy uit in die lig.

kjv_text: He increaseth the nations, and destroyeth them: he enlargeth the nations, and straiteneth them again.
bsb_text: He makes nations great and destroys them; He enlarges nations, then disperses them.
aov_text: Hy maak nasies groot en laat hulle omkom; Hy brei nasies uit en voer hulle weg.

kjv_text: He taketh away the heart of the chief of the people of the earth, and causeth them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.
bsb_text: He deprives the earth’s leaders of reason and makes them wander in a trackless wasteland.
aov_text: Hy neem die verstand weg van die volkshoofde van die land en laat hulle ronddwaal in ’n wildernis, sonder pad.

kjv_text: They grope in the dark without light, and he maketh them to stagger like a drunken man.
bsb_text: They grope in the darkness without light; He makes them stagger like drunkards.
aov_text: Hulle tas in die duisternis, sonder lig; en Hy laat hulle ronddwaal soos ’n dronk man.

kjv_text: Lo, mine eye hath seen all this, mine ear hath heard and understood it.
bsb_text: “Indeed, my eyes have seen all this; my ears have heard and understood.
aov_text: KYK, alles het my oog gesien, my oor gehoor en opgemerk.

kjv_text: What ye know, the same do I know also: I am not inferior unto you.
bsb_text: What you know, I also know; I am not inferior to you.
aov_text: Wat julle weet, weet ek ook: ek staan nie vir julle terug nie.

kjv_text: Surely I would speak to the Almighty, and I desire to reason with God.
bsb_text: Yet I desire to speak to the Almighty and argue my case before God.
aov_text: Maar ék sal met die Almagtige spreek, en ek verlang om te pleit by God.

kjv_text: But ye are forgers of lies, ye are all physicians of no value.
bsb_text: You, however, smear with lies; you are all worthless physicians.
aov_text: Maar julle pleister met leuens, kwaksalwers is julle almal.

kjv_text: O that ye would altogether hold your peace! and it should be your wisdom.
bsb_text: If only you would remain silent; for that would be your wisdom!
aov_text: Ag, as julle maar heeltemal wou swyg—dan sou dit vir julle wysheid wees!

kjv_text: Hear now my reasoning, and hearken to the pleadings of my lips.
bsb_text: Hear now my argument, and listen to the plea of my lips.
aov_text: Hoor tog na my verantwoording, en luister na die aanvalle van my lippe.

kjv_text: Will ye speak wickedly for God? and talk deceitfully for him?
bsb_text: Will you speak wickedly on God’s behalf or speak deceitfully for Him?
aov_text: Wil julle, tot verdediging van God, onreg spreek en ten behoewe van Hom bedrog laat hoor?

kjv_text: Will ye accept his person? will ye contend for God?
bsb_text: Would you show Him partiality or argue in His defense?
aov_text: Wil julle vir Hom partydig wees? Of wil julle vir God pleit?

kjv_text: Is it good that he should search you out? or as one man mocketh another, do ye so mock him?
bsb_text: Would it be well when He examined you? Could you deceive Him like a man?
aov_text: Sal dit goed wees as Hy julle ondersoek? Of wil julle Hom bedrieg soos ’n mens bedrieg word?

kjv_text: He will surely reprove you, if ye do secretly accept persons.
bsb_text: Surely He would rebuke you if you secretly showed partiality.
aov_text: Hy sal julle sekerlik straf as julle in die geheim partydig is.

kjv_text: Shall not his excellency make you afraid? and his dread fall upon you?
bsb_text: Would His majesty not terrify you? Would the dread of Him not fall upon you?
aov_text: Sal sy hoogheid julle nie verskrik nie, en die skrik vir Hom julle nie oorval nie?

kjv_text: Your remembrances are like unto ashes, your bodies to bodies of clay.
bsb_text: Your maxims are proverbs of ashes; your defenses are defenses of clay.
aov_text: Julle kernspreuke is spreuke van as, julle skanse word skanse van klei.

kjv_text: Hold your peace, let me alone, that I may speak, and let come on me what will.
bsb_text: Be silent, and I will speak. Then let come to me what may.
aov_text: LAAT my met rus; dan wil ék spreek; laat dan oor my kom wat wil.

kjv_text: Wherefore do I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in mine hand?
bsb_text: Why do I put myself at risk and take my life in my own hands?
aov_text: Waarom sou ek my vlees in my tande neem en my lewe neerlê in my hand?

kjv_text: Though he slay me, yet will I trust in him: but I will maintain mine own ways before him.
bsb_text: Though He slay me, I will hope in Him. I will still defend my ways to His face.
aov_text: Kyk, al wil Hy my ombring—ek hoop op Hom; ek sal tog my wandel voor sy aangesig bepleit.

kjv_text: He also shall be my salvation: for an hypocrite shall not come before him.
bsb_text: Moreover, this will be my salvation, for no godless man can appear before Him.
aov_text: Ook is dit my tot heil dat ’n goddelose voor sy aangesig nie sal kom nie.

kjv_text: Hear diligently my speech, and my declaration with your ears.
bsb_text: Listen carefully to my words; let my declaration ring in your ears.
aov_text: Luister goed na my rede en gee gehoor aan my verklaring.

kjv_text: Behold now, I have ordered my cause; I know that I shall be justified.
bsb_text: Behold, now that I have prepared my case, I know that I will be vindicated.
aov_text: Kyk tog, ek dra die regsaak voor; ek weet dat ék reg sal hê.

kjv_text: Who is he that will plead with me? for now, if I hold my tongue, I shall give up the ghost.
bsb_text: Can anyone indict me? If so, I will be silent and die.
aov_text: Wie durf my dan bestry? Ja, dan sou ek swyg en sterwe.

kjv_text: Only do not two things unto me: then will I not hide myself from thee.
bsb_text: Only grant these two things to me, so that I need not hide from You:
aov_text: Moet my net twee dinge nie aandoen nie, dan sal ek my vir u aangesig nie verberg nie:

kjv_text: Withdraw thine hand far from me: and let not thy dread make me afraid.
bsb_text: Withdraw Your hand from me, and do not let Your terror frighten me.
aov_text: trek u hand weg van my af, en laat die skrik vir U my nie beangstig nie.

kjv_text: Then call thou, and I will answer: or let me speak, and answer thou me.
bsb_text: Then call me, and I will answer, or let me speak, and You can reply.
aov_text: Klaag dan maar aan, en ék sal antwoord; of ek sal spreek, en gee U my antwoord.

kjv_text: How many are mine iniquities and sins? make me to know my transgression and my sin.
bsb_text: How many are my iniquities and sins? Reveal to me my transgression and sin.
aov_text: Hoeveel is my ongeregtighede en sondes; maak my my oortreding en sonde bekend.

kjv_text: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and holdest me for thine enemy?
bsb_text: Why do You hide Your face and consider me as Your enemy?
aov_text: Waarom verberg U u aangesig en hou my vir ’n vyand van U?

kjv_text: Wilt thou break a leaf driven to and fro? and wilt thou pursue the dry stubble?
bsb_text: Would You frighten a windblown leaf? Would You chase after dry chaff?
aov_text: Wil U ’n verwaaide blaar skrik aanja en die droë stoppel agtervolg,

kjv_text: For thou writest bitter things against me, and makest me to possess the iniquities of my youth.
bsb_text: For You record bitter accusations against me and bequeath to me the iniquities of my youth.
aov_text: dat U bitter dinge oor my beskik en my die ongeregtighede van my jeug laat erwe,

kjv_text: Thou puttest my feet also in the stocks, and lookest narrowly unto all my paths; thou settest a print upon the heels of my feet.
bsb_text: You put my feet in the stocks and stand watch over all my paths; You set a limit for the soles of my feet.
aov_text: en dat U my voete in die blok sit en al my paaie bewaak? U trek vir U ’n streep om die sole van my voete;

kjv_text: And he, as a rotten thing, consumeth, as a garment that is moth eaten.
bsb_text: So man wastes away like something rotten, like a moth-eaten garment.
aov_text: en dít iemand wat verval soos hout wat weggevreet is, soos ’n kleed wat die mot verteer.

kjv_text: Man that is born of a woman is of few days, and full of trouble.
bsb_text: “Man, who is born of woman, is short of days and full of trouble.
aov_text: DIE mens uit ’n vrou gebore, is kort van dae en sat van onrus.

kjv_text: He cometh forth like a flower, and is cut down: he fleeth also as a shadow, and continueth not.
bsb_text: Like a flower, he comes forth, then withers away; like a fleeting shadow, he does not endure.
aov_text: Hy spruit uit soos ’n blom en verwelk; ook vlug hy soos ’n skaduwee en hou nie stand nie.

kjv_text: And dost thou open thine eyes upon such an one, and bringest me into judgment with thee?
bsb_text: Do You open Your eyes to one like this? Will You bring him into judgment before You?
aov_text: En oor so een maak U die oë oop, en U bring my voor u gereg.

kjv_text: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? not one.
bsb_text: Who can bring out clean from unclean? No one!
aov_text: Ag, kon maar ’n reine voortkom uit ’n onreine—nie een nie!

kjv_text: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months are with thee, thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass;
bsb_text: Since his days are determined and the number of his months is with You, and since You have set limits that he cannot exceed,
aov_text: As dan sy dae vasgestel is, die getal van sy maande by U is, U vir hom grense gestel het waar hy nie oor kan gaan nie,

kjv_text: Turn from him, that he may rest, till he shall accomplish, as an hireling, his day.
bsb_text: look away from him and let him rest, so he can enjoy his day as a hired hand.
aov_text: kyk dan weg van hom af, dat hy kan rus—totdat hy soos ’n dagloner hom tevrede voel met sy dag.

kjv_text: For there is hope of a tree, if it be cut down, that it will sprout again, and that the tender branch thereof will not cease.
bsb_text: For there is hope for a tree: If it is cut down, it will sprout again, and its tender shoots will not fail.
aov_text: Want vir ’n boom is daar verwagting: as dit afgekap word, loop dit weer uit en sy loot ontbreek nie.

kjv_text: Though the root thereof wax old in the earth, and the stock thereof die in the ground;
bsb_text: If its roots grow old in the ground and its stump dies in the soil,
aov_text: As sy wortel oud word in die aarde en sy stam sterf in die stof —

kjv_text: Yet through the scent of water it will bud, and bring forth boughs like a plant.
bsb_text: at the scent of water it will bud and put forth twigs like a sapling.
aov_text: van die reuk van die water spruit dit weer uit, en dit maak ’n tak soos ’n jong plantjie.

kjv_text: But man dieth, and wasteth away: yea, man giveth up the ghost, and where is he?
bsb_text: But a man dies and is laid low; he breathes his last, and where is he?
aov_text: Maar ’n man sterwe en is magteloos; ja, ’n mens blaas die asem uit en—waar is hy?

kjv_text: As the waters fail from the sea, and the flood decayeth and drieth up:
bsb_text: As water disappears from the sea and a river becomes parched and dry,
aov_text: Die waters verdwyn uit die groot waterplas, en die rivier droog uit en lê droog —

kjv_text: So man lieth down, and riseth not: till the heavens be no more, they shall not awake, nor be raised out of their sleep.
bsb_text: so a man lies down and does not rise. Until the heavens are no more, he will not be awakened or roused from sleep.
aov_text: so lê die mens daar sonder om weer op te staan; totdat die hemele nie meer is nie, word hulle nie wakker of uit hul slaap opgewek nie.

kjv_text: O that thou wouldest hide me in the grave, that thou wouldest keep me secret, until thy wrath be past, that thou wouldest appoint me a set time, and remember me!
bsb_text: If only You would hide me in Sheol and conceal me until Your anger has passed! If only You would appoint a time for me and then remember me!
aov_text: Ag, as U my maar in die doderyk wou wegsteek, my wou verberg totdat u toorn bedaar het, my ’n bepaalde tyd wou stel en dan aan my wou dink!

kjv_text: If a man die, shall he live again? all the days of my appointed time will I wait, till my change come.
bsb_text: When a man dies, will he live again? All the days of my hard service I will wait, until my renewal comes.
aov_text: As ’n mens sterwe, sal hy weer lewe? Dan sou ek hoop al die dae van my stryd totdat my aflossing kom;

kjv_text: Thou shalt call, and I will answer thee: thou wilt have a desire to the work of thine hands.
bsb_text: You will call, and I will answer; You will desire the work of Your hands.
aov_text: U sou roep, en ek sou U antwoord, na die maaksel van u hande sou U verlang.

kjv_text: For now thou numberest my steps: dost thou not watch over my sin?
bsb_text: For then You would count my steps, but would not keep track of my sin.
aov_text: Want nou tel U my voetstappe. Let U nie op my sonde nie?

kjv_text: My transgression is sealed up in a bag, and thou sewest up mine iniquity.
bsb_text: My transgression would be sealed in a bag, and You would cover over my iniquity.
aov_text: My oortreding is verseël in ’n bondeltjie, en U sluit my ongeregtigheid weg.

kjv_text: And surely the mountain falling cometh to nought, and the rock is removed out of his place.
bsb_text: But as a mountain erodes and crumbles and a rock is dislodged from its place,
aov_text: Maar soos ’n berg stukkend val as dit neerstort, en ’n rots versit word uit sy plek;

kjv_text: The waters wear the stones: thou washest away the things which grow out of the dust of the earth; and thou destroyest the hope of man.
bsb_text: as water wears away the stones and torrents wash away the soil, so You destroy a man’s hope.
aov_text: die water klippe glad skuur; die stortvloede daarvan die grond van die aarde wegspoel; so is die verwagting van ’n mens—U maak dit tot niet.

kjv_text: Thou prevailest for ever against him, and he passeth: thou changest his countenance, and sendest him away.
bsb_text: You forever overpower him, and he passes on; You change his countenance and send him away.
aov_text: U oorweldig hom vir ewig, en hy gaan heen; U verander sy gelaat en stuur hom weg.

kjv_text: His sons come to honour, and he knoweth it not; and they are brought low, but he perceiveth it not of them.
bsb_text: If his sons receive honor, he does not know it; if they are brought low, he is unaware.
aov_text: Sy kinders kom in eer, maar hy word dit nie gewaar nie; en hulle word gering, maar hy let nie op hulle nie.

kjv_text: But his flesh upon him shall have pain, and his soul within him shall mourn.
bsb_text: He feels only the pain of his own body and mourns only for himself.”
aov_text: Net sy vlees aan hom voel pyn, en sy siel in hom treur.

kjv_text: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said,
bsb_text: Then Eliphaz the Temanite replied:
aov_text: TOE het Élifas, die Temaniet, geantwoord en gesê:

kjv_text: Should a wise man utter vain knowledge, and fill his belly with the east wind?
bsb_text: “Does a wise man answer with empty counsel or fill his belly with the hot east wind?
aov_text: Sal ’n wyse man met winderige wetenskap antwoord gee en sy buik vul met oostewind —

kjv_text: Should he reason with unprofitable talk? or with speeches wherewith he can do no good?
bsb_text: Should he argue with useless words or speeches that serve no purpose?
aov_text: deur te pleit met woorde wat nie baat en met beweringe waarmee hy niks uitrig nie?

kjv_text: Yea, thou castest off fear, and restrainest prayer before God.
bsb_text: But you even undermine the fear of God and hinder meditation before Him.
aov_text: Ja, jý breek die Godsvrees af en verstoor die stille oordenking voor die aangesig van God.

kjv_text: For thy mouth uttereth thine iniquity, and thou choosest the tongue of the crafty.
bsb_text: For your iniquity instructs your mouth, and you choose the language of the crafty.
aov_text: Want jou ongeregtigheid gee onderrig aan jou mond, en jy kies die taal van die listiges.

kjv_text: Thine own mouth condemneth thee, and not I: yea, thine own lips testify against thee.
bsb_text: Your own mouth, not mine, condemns you; your own lips testify against you.
aov_text: Jou eie mond veroordeel jou, en nie ek nie; ja, jou eie lippe getuig teen jou.

kjv_text: Art thou the first man that was born? or wast thou made before the hills?
bsb_text: Were you the first man ever born? Were you brought forth before the hills?
aov_text: Is jy die eerste as mens gebore en voor die heuwels in die wêreld gebring?

kjv_text: Hast thou heard the secret of God? and dost thou restrain wisdom to thyself?
bsb_text: Do you listen in on the council of God or limit wisdom to yourself?
aov_text: Het jy in die raad van God afgeluister en die wysheid na jou toe getrek?

kjv_text: What knowest thou, that we know not? what understandest thou, which is not in us?
bsb_text: What do you know that we do not? What do you understand that is not clear to us?
aov_text: Wat weet jy wat ons nie weet nie? Wat verstaan jy wat in ons nie is nie?

kjv_text: With us are both the grayheaded and very aged men, much elder than thy father.
bsb_text: Both the gray-haired and the aged are on our side—men much older than your father.
aov_text: Ook is daar grys hare, ook bejaardes onder ons, ryker in dae as jou vader.

kjv_text: Are the consolations of God small with thee? is there any secret thing with thee?
bsb_text: Are the consolations of God not enough for you, even words spoken gently to you?
aov_text: Is die vertroostinge van God vir jou te min, en ’n woord met sagtheid jou toegespreek?

kjv_text: Why doth thine heart carry thee away? and what do thy eyes wink at,
bsb_text: Why has your heart carried you away, and why do your eyes flash,
aov_text: WAAROM sleep jou hart jou weg? En waarom flikker jou oë so —

kjv_text: That thou turnest thy spirit against God, and lettest such words go out of thy mouth?
bsb_text: as you turn your spirit against God and pour such words from your mouth?
aov_text: dat jy jou toorn rig teen God en sulke woorde uit jou mond laat uitgaan?

kjv_text: What is man, that he should be clean? and he which is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?
bsb_text: What is man, that he should be pure, or one born of woman, that he should be righteous?
aov_text: Wat is die mens, dat hy rein sou wees? En hy wat uit ’n vrou gebore is, dat hy regverdig sou wees?

kjv_text: Behold, he putteth no trust in his saints; yea, the heavens are not clean in his sight.
bsb_text: If God puts no trust in His holy ones, if even the heavens are not pure in His eyes,
aov_text: Kyk, in sy heiliges stel Hy geen vertroue nie; ja, die hemele is nie rein in sy oë nie;

kjv_text: How much more abominable and filthy is man, which drinketh iniquity like water?
bsb_text: how much less man, who is vile and corrupt, who drinks injustice like water?
aov_text: hoeveel minder die afskuwelike en ontaarde, die mens wat onreg drink soos water!

kjv_text: I will shew thee, hear me; and that which I have seen I will declare;
bsb_text: Listen to me and I will inform you. I will describe what I have seen,
aov_text: Ek wil jou inlig, luister na my; en wat ek gesien het, wil ek vertel;

kjv_text: Which wise men have told from their fathers, and have not hid it:
bsb_text: what was declared by wise men and was not concealed from their fathers,
aov_text: wat die wyse manne verkondig sonder om iets te verberg, van hulle vaders af oorgelewer;

kjv_text: Unto whom alone the earth was given, and no stranger passed among them.
bsb_text: to whom alone the land was given when no foreigner passed among them.
aov_text: aan hulle alleen was die land gegee, en geen vreemdeling het nog onder hulle deurgetrek nie.

kjv_text: The wicked man travaileth with pain all his days, and the number of years is hidden to the oppressor.
bsb_text: A wicked man writhes in pain all his days; only a few years are reserved for the ruthless.
aov_text: AL sy dae leef die goddelose in angs, ja, al die jare deur wat vir die tiran bepaal is.

kjv_text: A dreadful sound is in his ears: in prosperity the destroyer shall come upon him.
bsb_text: Sounds of terror fill his ears; in his prosperity the destroyer attacks him.
aov_text: Skrikgeluide is in sy ore; in volle vrede oorval die verwoester hom.

kjv_text: He believeth not that he shall return out of darkness, and he is waited for of the sword.
bsb_text: He despairs of his return from darkness; he is marked for the sword.
aov_text: Hy glo nie dat hy uit die duisternis sal terugkeer nie; en hy is bestemd vir die swaard.

kjv_text: He wandereth abroad for bread, saying, Where is it? he knoweth that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.
bsb_text: He wanders about as food for vultures; he knows the day of darkness is at hand.
aov_text: Hy dwaal rond en soek brood. Waar is dit? Hy weet dat gereed is, ophande, die dag van duisternis.

kjv_text: Trouble and anguish shall make him afraid; they shall prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.
bsb_text: Distress and anguish terrify him, overwhelming him like a king poised to attack.
aov_text: Benoudheid en angs verskrik hom; dit oorweldig hom soos ’n koning wat gereed staan vir die aanval,

kjv_text: For he stretcheth out his hand against God, and strengtheneth himself against the Almighty.
bsb_text: For he has stretched out his hand against God and has vaunted himself against the Almighty,
aov_text: omdat hy sy hand uitgesteek het teen God en die Almagtige getrotseer het

kjv_text: He runneth upon him, even on his neck, upon the thick bosses of his bucklers:
bsb_text: rushing headlong at Him with a thick, studded shield.
aov_text: (hy het Hom stormgeloop met uitgerekte nek, met die dik bulte van sy skilde);

kjv_text: Because he covereth his face with his fatness, and maketh collops of fat on his flanks.
bsb_text: Though his face is covered with fat and his waistline bulges with flesh,
aov_text: omdat hy sy gesig met sy vet oordek en ’n vetlaag op sy heupe gevorm het,

kjv_text: And he dwelleth in desolate cities, and in houses which no man inhabiteth, which are ready to become heaps.
bsb_text: he will dwell in ruined cities, in abandoned houses destined to become rubble.
aov_text: en verdelgde stede bewoon het, huise wat nie bewoon moes word nie, wat bestem was om puinhope te bly.

kjv_text: He shall not be rich, neither shall his substance continue, neither shall he prolong the perfection thereof upon the earth.
bsb_text: He will no longer be rich; his wealth will not endure. His possessions will not overspread the land.
aov_text: HY bly nie ryk en sy vermoë hou nie stand nie, en hulle besitting buig nie soos koringare na die aarde toe nie.

kjv_text: He shall not depart out of darkness; the flame shall dry up his branches, and by the breath of his mouth shall he go away.
bsb_text: He will not escape from the darkness; the flame will wither his shoots, and the breath of God’s mouth will carry him away.
aov_text: Hy ontvlug nie die duisternis nie, die vlam laat sy spruit verdroog, en hy vergaan deur die geblaas van die mond van God.

kjv_text: Let not him that is deceived trust in vanity: for vanity shall be his recompence.
bsb_text: Let him not deceive himself with trust in emptiness, for emptiness will be his reward.
aov_text: Laat hom nie vertrou op nietigheid nie—hy kom bedroë uit!—want nietigheid sal sy vergelding wees.

kjv_text: It shall be accomplished before his time, and his branch shall not be green.
bsb_text: It will be paid in full before his time, and his branch will not flourish.
aov_text: Voor sy tyd word dit vervul, en sy palmtak bly nie meer groen nie.

kjv_text: He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and shall cast off his flower as the olive.
bsb_text: He will be like a vine stripped of its unripe grapes, like an olive tree that sheds its blossoms.
aov_text: Hy skud sy onryp druiwe af soos ’n wingerdstok en gooi sy bloeisel af soos ’n olyfboom.

kjv_text: For the congregation of hypocrites shall be desolate, and fire shall consume the tabernacles of bribery.
bsb_text: For the company of the godless will be barren, and fire will consume the tents of bribery.
aov_text: Want die bende van die goddelose is onvrugbaar, en vuur verteer die tente van omkopery.

kjv_text: They conceive mischief, and bring forth vanity, and their belly prepareth deceit.
bsb_text: They conceive trouble and give birth to evil; their womb is pregnant with deceit.”
aov_text: Hulle is swanger van moeite en baar onheil; en hulle skoot bring bedrog voort.

kjv_text: Then Job answered and said,
bsb_text: Then Job answered:
aov_text: MAAR Job het geantwoord en gesê:

kjv_text: I have heard many such things: miserable comforters are ye all.
bsb_text: “I have heard many things like these; miserable comforters are you all.
aov_text: Dergelike dinge het ek al baie gehoor: treurige vertroosters is julle almal.

kjv_text: Shall vain words have an end? or what emboldeneth thee that thou answerest?
bsb_text: Is there no end to your long-winded speeches? What provokes you to continue testifying?
aov_text: Kom daar nou ’n einde aan winderige woorde? Of wat prikkel jou dat jy antwoord?

kjv_text: I also could speak as ye do: if your soul were in my soul's stead, I could heap up words against you, and shake mine head at you.
bsb_text: I could also speak like you if you were in my place; I could heap up words against you and shake my head at you.
aov_text: Ek sou ook kon spreek soos julle as julle siel in die plek van my siel was; ek sou woorde aanmekaar kon koppel teen julle en my hoof oor julle skud;

kjv_text: But I would strengthen you with my mouth, and the moving of my lips should asswage your grief.
bsb_text: But I would encourage you with my mouth, and the consolation of my lips would bring relief.
aov_text: ek sou julle kon versterk met my mónd, en die troos van my lippe sou versagting aanbring!

kjv_text: Though I speak, my grief is not asswaged: and though I forbear, what am I eased?
bsb_text: Even if I speak, my pain is not relieved, and if I hold back, how will it go away?
aov_text: AS ek sou spreek, my smart word nie versag nie; en as ek ophou—watter verligting bring dit my?

kjv_text: But now he hath made me weary: thou hast made desolate all my company.
bsb_text: Surely He has now exhausted me; You have devastated all my family.
aov_text: Maar nou het Hy my uitgeput; U het my hele huishouding verwoes.

kjv_text: And thou hast filled me with wrinkles, which is a witness against me: and my leanness rising up in me beareth witness to my face.
bsb_text: You have bound me, and it has become a witness; my frailty rises up and testifies against me.
aov_text: En U het my gegryp—’n getuie het dit teen my geword; en my siekte staan teen my op, dit getuig openlik teen my.

kjv_text: He teareth me in his wrath, who hateth me: he gnasheth upon me with his teeth; mine enemy sharpeneth his eyes upon me.
bsb_text: His anger has torn me and opposed me; He gnashes His teeth at me. My adversary pierces me with His eyes.
aov_text: Sy toorn het verskeur en my as vyand behandel; Hy het teen my gekners met sy tande; as my teëstander kyk Hy my met skerp oë aan.

kjv_text: They have gaped upon me with their mouth; they have smitten me upon the cheek reproachfully; they have gathered themselves together against me.
bsb_text: They open their mouths against me and strike my cheeks with contempt; they join together against me.
aov_text: Hulle het hul mond teen my oopgespalk; smadelik het hulle my op die kakebeen geslaan; soos een man versamel hulle hul teen my.

kjv_text: God hath delivered me to the ungodly, and turned me over into the hands of the wicked.
bsb_text: God has delivered me to unjust men; He has thrown me to the clutches of the wicked.
aov_text: God gee my oor aan slegte mense en werp my in die hande van die goddelose.

kjv_text: I was at ease, but he hath broken me asunder: he hath also taken me by my neck, and shaken me to pieces, and set me up for his mark.
bsb_text: I was at ease, but He shattered me; He seized me by the neck and crushed me. He has set me up as His target;
aov_text: Ek het rustig gelewe; toe het Hy my verbrysel en my aan die nek gegryp en my verpletter; en Hy het my vir Hom as teiken opgestel.

kjv_text: His archers compass me round about, he cleaveth my reins asunder, and doth not spare; he poureth out my gall upon the ground.
bsb_text: His archers surround me. He pierces my kidneys without mercy and spills my gall on the ground.
aov_text: Sy pyle gons om my heen; Hy splits my niere sonder verskoning; Hy werp my gal op die grond uit.

kjv_text: He breaketh me with breach upon breach, he runneth upon me like a giant.
bsb_text: He breaks me with wound upon wound; He rushes me like a mighty warrior.
aov_text: Bres op bres breek Hy in my; Hy loop my storm soos ’n held.

kjv_text: I have sewed sackcloth upon my skin, and defiled my horn in the dust.
bsb_text: I have sewn sackcloth over my skin; I have buried my horn in the dust.
aov_text: ’n Roukleed het ek oor my vel vasgewerk en my horing in die stof gesteek.

kjv_text: My face is foul with weeping, and on my eyelids is the shadow of death;
bsb_text: My face is red with weeping, and deep shadows ring my eyes;
aov_text: My gesig het rooi geword van geween, en oor my ooglede is daar ’n doodskaduwee;

kjv_text: Not for any injustice in mine hands: also my prayer is pure.
bsb_text: yet my hands are free of violence and my prayer is pure.
aov_text: alhoewel daar geen gewelddaad in my hande is nie en my gebed rein is.

kjv_text: O earth, cover not thou my blood, and let my cry have no place.
bsb_text: O earth, do not cover my blood; may my cry for help never be laid to rest.
aov_text: o AARDE, moenie my bloed bedek nie, en laat daar geen rusplek vir my geroep wees nie.

kjv_text: Also now, behold, my witness is in heaven, and my record is on high.
bsb_text: Even now my witness is in heaven, and my advocate is on high.
aov_text: Selfs nou, kyk, in die hemel is my Getuie; en Hy wat saam met my getuig, is in die hoogtes.

kjv_text: My friends scorn me: but mine eye poureth out tears unto God.
bsb_text: My friends are my scoffers as my eyes pour out tears to God.
aov_text: My vriende spot met my; uit my oog drup trane tot God —

kjv_text: O that one might plead for a man with God, as a man pleadeth for his neighbour!
bsb_text: Oh, that a man might plead with God as he pleads with his neighbor!
aov_text: dat Hy kan pleit vir ’n man by God en as Menseseun vir sy naaste.

kjv_text: When a few years are come, then I shall go the way whence I shall not return.
bsb_text: For when only a few years are past I will go the way of no return.
aov_text: Want maar min jare kom—dan bewandel ek ’n pad waarlangs ek nie terugkeer nie.

kjv_text: My breath is corrupt, my days are extinct, the graves are ready for me.
bsb_text: “My spirit is broken; my days are extinguished; the grave awaits me.
aov_text: MY gees is verward, my dae is uitgeblus, die graf wag op my.

kjv_text: Are there not mockers with me? and doth not mine eye continue in their provocation?
bsb_text: Surely mockers surround me, and my eyes must gaze at their rebellion.
aov_text: Waarlik, bespottinge is my deel, en op hulle getwis moet my oog rus.

kjv_text: Lay down now, put me in a surety with thee; who is he that will strike hands with me?
bsb_text: Give me, I pray, the pledge You demand. Who else will be my guarantor?
aov_text: GEE tog ’n pand, staan borg vir my by U; wie anders sal vir my borgskap verleen?

kjv_text: For thou hast hid their heart from understanding: therefore shalt thou not exalt them.
bsb_text: You have closed their minds to understanding; therefore You will not exalt them.
aov_text: Want U het húlle hart gesluit vir verstand; daarom sal U hulle nie laat triomfeer nie.

kjv_text: He that speaketh flattery to his friends, even the eyes of his children shall fail.
bsb_text: If a man denounces his friends for a price, the eyes of his children will fail.
aov_text: Hy wat vriende aanklaag vir ’n buitaandeel—die oë van sy kinders sal versmag.

kjv_text: He hath made me also a byword of the people; and aforetime I was as a tabret.
bsb_text: He has made me a byword among the people, a man in whose face they spit.
aov_text: Maar Hy het my ’n spreekwoord vir die mense gemaak, en ek moet iemand wees wat hulle in die gesig spuug.

kjv_text: Mine eye also is dim by reason of sorrow, and all my members are as a shadow.
bsb_text: My eyes have grown dim with grief, and my whole body is but a shadow.
aov_text: Daarom het my oog dof geword van verdriet, en al my lede is soos ’n skaduwee.

kjv_text: Upright men shall be astonied at this, and the innocent shall stir up himself against the hypocrite.
bsb_text: The upright are appalled at this, and the innocent are stirred against the godless.
aov_text: Die opregtes is daaroor ontsteld, en die onskuldige kom teen die goddelose in opstand.

kjv_text: The righteous also shall hold on his way, and he that hath clean hands shall be stronger and stronger.
bsb_text: Yet a righteous one holds to his way, and the one with clean hands grows stronger.
aov_text: Nogtans hou die regverdige vas aan sy weg, en die wat rein van hande is, neem toe in krag.

kjv_text: But as for you all, do ye return, and come now: for I cannot find one wise man among you.
bsb_text: But come back and try again, all of you. For I will not find a wise man among you.
aov_text: MAAR, kom maar altyd weer aan, julle almal! ’n Wyse vind ek onder julle tog nie.

kjv_text: My days are past, my purposes are broken off, even the thoughts of my heart.
bsb_text: My days have passed; my plans are broken off—even the desires of my heart.
aov_text: My dae is verby, my planne tot niet, die wense van my hart.

kjv_text: They change the night into day: the light is short because of darkness.
bsb_text: They have turned night into day, making light seem near in the face of darkness.
aov_text: Van die nag maak hulle ’n dag; lig, sê hulle, is naby vanweë die duisternis.

kjv_text: If I wait, the grave is mine house: I have made my bed in the darkness.
bsb_text: If I look for Sheol as my home, if I spread out my bed in darkness,
aov_text: As ek hoop op die doderyk as my huis; in die duisternis my bed uitsprei,

kjv_text: I have said to corruption, Thou art my father: to the worm, Thou art my mother, and my sister.
bsb_text: and say to corruption, ‘You are my father,’ and to the worm, ‘My mother,’ or ‘My sister,’
aov_text: die grafkuil toeroep: My vader is jy; die wurms: My moeder en my suster,

kjv_text: And where is now my hope? as for my hope, who shall see it?
bsb_text: where then is my hope? Who can see any hope for me?
aov_text: waar is dan my verwagting? Ja, my verwagting, wie ontdek dit?

kjv_text: They shall go down to the bars of the pit, when our rest together is in the dust.
bsb_text: Will it go down to the gates of Sheol? Will we go down together into the dust?”
aov_text: Na die grendels van die doderyk sal dit neerdaal, wanneer daar tegelykertyd rus is in die stof.

kjv_text: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,
bsb_text: Then Bildad the Shuhite replied:
aov_text: TOE het Bildad, die Suhiet, geantwoord en gesê:

kjv_text: How long will it be ere ye make an end of words? mark, and afterwards we will speak.
bsb_text: “How long until you end these speeches? Show some sense, and then we can talk.
aov_text: Hoe lank wil julle jaag agter woorde? Word verstandig, en daarna sal ons spreek.

kjv_text: Wherefore are we counted as beasts, and reputed vile in your sight?
bsb_text: Why are we regarded as cattle, as stupid in your sight?
aov_text: Waarom word ons as vee gereken, is ons dom in julle oë?

kjv_text: He teareth himself in his anger: shall the earth be forsaken for thee? and shall the rock be removed out of his place?
bsb_text: You who tear yourself in anger—should the earth be forsaken on your account, or the rocks be moved from their place?
aov_text: Jy, iemand wat homself verskeur in sy toorn—sal om jou ontwil die aarde verlate wees of ’n rots uit sy plek versit word?

kjv_text: Yea, the light of the wicked shall be put out, and the spark of his fire shall not shine.
bsb_text: Indeed, the lamp of the wicked is extinguished; the flame of his fire does not glow.
aov_text: JA, die lig van die goddelose gaan dood, en die vlam van sy vuur bly nie flikker nie.

kjv_text: The light shall be dark in his tabernacle, and his candle shall be put out with him.
bsb_text: The light in his tent grows dark, and the lamp beside him goes out.
aov_text: Die lig in sy tent word duisternis, en sy lamp bo hom gaan dood.

kjv_text: The steps of his strength shall be straitened, and his own counsel shall cast him down.
bsb_text: His vigorous stride is shortened, and his own schemes trip him up.
aov_text: Sy geweldige treë word ingekort, en sy eie plan gooi hom omver.

kjv_text: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he walketh upon a snare.
bsb_text: For his own feet lead him into a net, and he wanders into its mesh.
aov_text: Want hy raak in ’n net deur sy eie voete, en hy loop oor die vlegwerk van ’n vangkuil.

kjv_text: The gin shall take him by the heel, and the robber shall prevail against him.
bsb_text: A trap seizes his heel; a snare grips him.
aov_text: ’n Vangnet gryp sy hakskeen, ’n strik hou hom vas.

kjv_text: The snare is laid for him in the ground, and a trap for him in the way.
bsb_text: A noose is hidden in the ground, and a trap lies in his path.
aov_text: ’n Tou is vir hom verberg in die grond en ’n valstrik vir hom op die pad.

kjv_text: Terrors shall make him afraid on every side, and shall drive him to his feet.
bsb_text: Terrors frighten him on every side and harass his every step.
aov_text: Verskrikkinge beangstig hom aan alle kante en jaag hom so ver as hy gaan.

kjv_text: His strength shall be hungerbitten, and destruction shall be ready at his side.
bsb_text: His strength is depleted, and calamity is ready at his side.
aov_text: Sy onheil het honger, en die ondergang staan gereed vir sy val.

kjv_text: It shall devour the strength of his skin: even the firstborn of death shall devour his strength.
bsb_text: It devours patches of his skin; the firstborn of death devours his limbs.
aov_text: Die eersgeborene van die dood verteer die lede van sy liggaam, hy verteer sy lede.

kjv_text: His confidence shall be rooted out of his tabernacle, and it shall bring him to the king of terrors.
bsb_text: He is torn from the shelter of his tent and is marched off to the king of terrors.
aov_text: Weggeruk word hy uit sy tent, die voorwerp van sy vertroue; en dit laat hom aanstap na die koning van die verskrikkinge.

kjv_text: It shall dwell in his tabernacle, because it is none of his: brimstone shall be scattered upon his habitation.
bsb_text: Fire resides in his tent; burning sulfur rains down on his dwelling.
aov_text: DAAR woon in sy tent iets wat hom nie toebehoort nie; swawel word gestrooi oor sy woning.

kjv_text: His roots shall be dried up beneath, and above shall his branch be cut off.
bsb_text: The roots beneath him dry up, and the branches above him wither away.
aov_text: Onder verdroog sy wortels, en bo verwelk sy tak.

kjv_text: His remembrance shall perish from the earth, and he shall have no name in the street.
bsb_text: The memory of him perishes from the earth, and he has no name in the land.
aov_text: Sy gedagtenis vergaan van die aarde af, en hy het geen naam op die wye veld nie.

kjv_text: He shall be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.
bsb_text: He is driven from light into darkness and is chased from the inhabited world.
aov_text: Hulle stoot hom uit die lig in die duisternis, en uit die wêreld verjaag hulle hom.

kjv_text: He shall neither have son nor nephew among his people, nor any remaining in his dwellings.
bsb_text: He has no offspring or posterity among his people, no survivor where he once lived.
aov_text: Hy het geen kroos of nageslag onder sy volk en niemand wat oorbly in sy wonings nie.

kjv_text: They that come after him shall be astonied at his day, as they that went before were affrighted.
bsb_text: Those in the west are appalled at his fate, while those in the east tremble in horror.
aov_text: Oor sy dag staan die mense van die Weste verskrik, en siddering gryp die mense van die Ooste aan.

kjv_text: Surely such are the dwellings of the wicked, and this is the place of him that knoweth not God.
bsb_text: Surely such is the dwelling of the wicked and the place of one who does not know God.”
aov_text: Sekerlik, so gaan dit met die wonings van die kwaaddoener en so met die plek van hom wat God nie ken nie.

kjv_text: Then Job answered and said,
bsb_text: Then Job answered:
aov_text: MAAR Job het geantwoord en gesê:

kjv_text: How long will ye vex my soul, and break me in pieces with words?
bsb_text: “How long will you torment me and crush me with your words?
aov_text: Hoe lank sal julle my siel kwel en my met woorde verbrysel?

kjv_text: These ten times have ye reproached me: ye are not ashamed that ye make yourselves strange to me.
bsb_text: Ten times now you have reproached me; you shamelessly mistreat me.
aov_text: Nou tien maal al doen julle my smaadheid aan, mishandel julle my sonder om julle te skaam.

kjv_text: And be it indeed that I have erred, mine error remaineth with myself.
bsb_text: Even if I have truly gone astray, my error concerns me alone.
aov_text: En het ek ook werklik my misgaan, dan bly my fout by my.

kjv_text: If indeed ye will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach:
bsb_text: If indeed you would exalt yourselves above me and use my disgrace against me,
aov_text: AS julle jul werklik teen my wil groot maak en teen my my smaadheid wil bewys,

kjv_text: Know now that God hath overthrown me, and hath compassed me with his net.
bsb_text: then understand that it is God who has wronged me and drawn His net around me.
aov_text: weet dan dat Gód my onregverdig behandel het en met sy net my rondom ingesluit het.

kjv_text: Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard: I cry aloud, but there is no judgment.
bsb_text: Though I cry out, ‘Violence!’ I get no response; though I call for help, there is no justice.
aov_text: As ek roep: Geweld! dan word ek nie verhoor nie; ek roep om hulp, maar daar is geen reg nie.

kjv_text: He hath fenced up my way that I cannot pass, and he hath set darkness in my paths.
bsb_text: He has blocked my way so I cannot pass; He has veiled my paths with darkness.
aov_text: Hy het my weg toegemuur, sodat ek nie verby kan nie; en oor my paaie het Hy duisternis gesprei.

kjv_text: He hath stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.
bsb_text: He has stripped me of my honor and removed the crown from my head.
aov_text: My eer het Hy van my afgetrek en die kroon van my hoof weggeneem.

kjv_text: He hath destroyed me on every side, and I am gone: and mine hope hath he removed like a tree.
bsb_text: He tears me down on every side until I am gone; He uproots my hope like a tree.
aov_text: Hy werp my aan alle kante omver, en—daar gaan ek! En Hy het my verwagting uitgeruk soos ’n boom.

kjv_text: He hath also kindled his wrath against me, and he counteth me unto him as one of his enemies.
bsb_text: His anger burns against me, and He counts me among His enemies.
aov_text: Ook het Hy sy toorn teen my laat ontvlam en my beskou as een van sy vyande.

kjv_text: His troops come together, and raise up their way against me, and encamp round about my tabernacle.
bsb_text: His troops advance together; they construct a ramp against me and encamp around my tent.
aov_text: As een man kom sy skare aan en baan ’n pad vir hulle teen my, en hulle slaan die laer op rondom my tent.

kjv_text: He hath put my brethren far from me, and mine acquaintance are verily estranged from me.
bsb_text: He has removed my brothers from me; my acquaintances have abandoned me.
aov_text: MY broers het Hy ver van my verwyder, en my bekendes het vir my heeltemal vreemd geword.

kjv_text: My kinsfolk have failed, and my familiar friends have forgotten me.
bsb_text: My kinsmen have failed me, and my friends have forgotten me.
aov_text: My nabestaandes ontbreek, en my vertroudes het my vergeet.

kjv_text: They that dwell in mine house, and my maids, count me for a stranger: I am an alien in their sight.
bsb_text: My guests and maidservants count me as a stranger; I am a foreigner in their sight.
aov_text: My bywoners en my slavinne beskou my as ’n vreemde; ’n onbekende het ek geword in hulle oë.

kjv_text: I called my servant, and he gave me no answer; I intreated him with my mouth.
bsb_text: I call for my servant, but he does not answer, though I implore him with my own mouth.
aov_text: Ek roep my slaaf, maar hy antwoord nie; met my mond moet ek hom smeek.

kjv_text: My breath is strange to my wife, though I intreated for the children's sake of mine own body.
bsb_text: My breath is repulsive to my wife, and I am loathsome to my own family.
aov_text: My asem is vir my vrou hinderlik, en my slegte reuk vir die kinders van my moeder se skoot.

kjv_text: Yea, young children despised me; I arose, and they spake against me.
bsb_text: Even little boys scorn me; when I appear, they deride me.
aov_text: Selfs jong seuns minag my; wil ek opstaan, dan spot hulle met my.

kjv_text: All my inward friends abhorred me: and they whom I loved are turned against me.
bsb_text: All my best friends despise me, and those I love have turned against me.
aov_text: Al my vertroude vriende het ’n afsku van my; en die wat ek liefgehad het, het hulle teen my gekeer.

kjv_text: My bone cleaveth to my skin and to my flesh, and I am escaped with the skin of my teeth.
bsb_text: My skin and flesh cling to my bones; I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.
aov_text: My gebeente kleef aan my vel en aan my vlees, en ek het slegs met my tandvlees ontsnap.

kjv_text: Have pity upon me, have pity upon me, O ye my friends; for the hand of God hath touched me.
bsb_text: Have pity on me, my friends, have pity, for the hand of God has struck me.
aov_text: Ontferm julle oor my, ontferm julle oor my, o my vriende, want die hand van God het my getref!

kjv_text: Why do ye persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?
bsb_text: Why do you persecute me as God does? Will you never get enough of my flesh?
aov_text: Waarom vervolg julle my, soos God, en word nie versadig van my vlees nie?

kjv_text: Oh that my words were now written! oh that they were printed in a book!
bsb_text: I wish that my words were recorded and inscribed in a book,
aov_text: Ag, mag my woorde tog maar opgeskrywe, mag hulle maar in ’n boek opgeteken word —

kjv_text: That they were graven with an iron pen and lead in the rock for ever!
bsb_text: by an iron stylus on lead, or chiseled in stone forever.
aov_text: met ’n ystergriffel en lood—vir altyd in ’n rots ingekap!

kjv_text: For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth:
bsb_text: But I know that my Redeemer lives, and in the end He will stand upon the earth.
aov_text: MAAR ek, ek weet: My Verlosser leef; en Hy sal as laaste oor die stof opstaan.

kjv_text: And though after my skin worms destroy this body, yet in my flesh shall I see God:
bsb_text: Even after my skin has been destroyed, yet in my flesh I will see God.
aov_text: En nadat hulle so my vel afgeskeur het, sal ek nogtans uit my vlees God aanskou;

kjv_text: Whom I shall see for myself, and mine eyes shall behold, and not another; though my reins be consumed within me.
bsb_text: I will see Him for myself; my eyes will behold Him, and not as a stranger. How my heart yearns within me!
aov_text: Hom wat ék sal aanskou my ten goede, en my oë—en geen vreemde nie—sal sien. My niere versmag van verlange in my binneste.

kjv_text: But ye should say, Why persecute we him, seeing the root of the matter is found in me?
bsb_text: If you say, ‘Let us persecute him, since the root of the matter lies with him,’
aov_text: As julle sê: Hoe sal ons hom vervolg, aangesien die wortel van die saak in hom gevind is! —

kjv_text: Be ye afraid of the sword: for wrath bringeth the punishments of the sword, that ye may know there is a judgment.
bsb_text: then you should fear the sword yourselves, because wrath brings punishment by the sword, so that you may know there is a judgment.”
aov_text: vrees dan vir die swaard, want grimmigheid is een van die oortredinge wat die swaard verdien, sodat julle kan weet dat daar ’n oordeel is.

kjv_text: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,
bsb_text: Then Zophar the Naamathite replied:
aov_text: TOE het Sofar, die Naämatiet, geantwoord en gesê:

kjv_text: Therefore do my thoughts cause me to answer, and for this I make haste.
bsb_text: “So my anxious thoughts compel me to answer, because of the turmoil within me.
aov_text: Daarom juis antwoord my gedagtes my, en wel weens my haastigheid in my.

kjv_text: I have heard the check of my reproach, and the spirit of my understanding causeth me to answer.
bsb_text: I have heard a rebuke that insults me, and my understanding prompts a reply.
aov_text: ’n Bestraffing wat vir my griewend is, moet ek aanhoor; maar die gees uit my verstand antwoord my.

kjv_text: Knowest thou not this of old, since man was placed upon earth,
bsb_text: Do you not know that from antiquity, since man was placed on the earth,
aov_text: WEET jy wel dit wat van altyd af was, vandat die mens op die aarde gemaak is:

kjv_text: That the triumphing of the wicked is short, and the joy of the hypocrite but for a moment?
bsb_text: the triumph of the wicked has been brief and the joy of the godless momentary?
aov_text: dat die gejubel van die goddelose kort van duur is en die vreugde van die roekelose net vir ’n oomblik?

kjv_text: Though his excellency mount up to the heavens, and his head reach unto the clouds;
bsb_text: Though his arrogance reaches the heavens, and his head touches the clouds,
aov_text: Al klim sy hoogheid na die hemel toe op, en al raak sy hoof aan die wolke —

kjv_text: Yet he shall perish for ever like his own dung: they which have seen him shall say, Where is he?
bsb_text: he will perish forever, like his own dung; those who had seen him will ask, ‘Where is he?’
aov_text: soos sy eie drek vergaan hy vir ewig; die wat hom gesien het, vra: Waar is hy?

kjv_text: He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found: yea, he shall be chased away as a vision of the night.
bsb_text: He will fly away like a dream, never to be found; he will be chased away like a vision in the night.
aov_text: Soos ’n droom vlieg hy weg, sodat ’n mens hom nie meer vind nie; en hy word verjaag soos ’n naggesig.

kjv_text: The eye also which saw him shall see him no more; neither shall his place any more behold him.
bsb_text: The eye that saw him will see him no more, and his place will no longer behold him.
aov_text: Die oog wat hom gesien het, sien hom nie meer nie; en sy plek aanskou hom nie meer nie.

kjv_text: His children shall seek to please the poor, and his hands shall restore their goods.
bsb_text: His sons will seek the favor of the poor, for his own hands must return his wealth.
aov_text: Sy kinders moet die guns soek van armes, en met eie hande moet hy sy vermoë teruggee.

kjv_text: His bones are full of the sin of his youth, which shall lie down with him in the dust.
bsb_text: The youthful vigor that fills his bones will lie down with him in the dust.
aov_text: Sy gebeente was vol van sy jeugdige krag; maar met hom saam lê dit in die stof.

kjv_text: Though wickedness be sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue;
bsb_text: Though evil is sweet in his mouth and he conceals it under his tongue,
aov_text: AL smaak die kwaad soet in sy mond, al verberg hy dit onder sy tong,

kjv_text: Though he spare it, and forsake it not; but keep it still within his mouth:
bsb_text: though he cannot bear to let it go and keeps it in his mouth,
aov_text: al spaar hy dit, en al wil hy dit nie laat vaar nie, maar dit terughou in sy verhemelte —

kjv_text: Yet his meat in his bowels is turned, it is the gall of asps within him.
bsb_text: yet in his stomach his food sours into the venom of cobras within him.
aov_text: tog word sy voedsel in sy ingewande verander, dit word gal van adders in sy binneste.

kjv_text: He hath swallowed down riches, and he shall vomit them up again: God shall cast them out of his belly.
bsb_text: He swallows wealth but vomits it out; God will force it from his stomach.
aov_text: Rykdom het hy verslind, maar hy moet dit weer uitspuug; uit sy buik dryf God dit weg.

kjv_text: He shall suck the poison of asps: the viper's tongue shall slay him.
bsb_text: He will suck the poison of cobras; the fangs of a viper will kill him.
aov_text: Die gif van adders suig hy in, die tong van ’n slang maak hom dood.

kjv_text: He shall not see the rivers, the floods, the brooks of honey and butter.
bsb_text: He will not enjoy the streams, the rivers flowing with honey and cream.
aov_text: Hy mag hom nie verlustig in beke, in vloeiende strome van heuning en dikmelk nie.

kjv_text: That which he laboured for shall he restore, and shall not swallow it down: according to his substance shall the restitution be, and he shall not rejoice therein.
bsb_text: He must return the fruit of his labor without consuming it; he cannot enjoy the profits of his trading.
aov_text: Wat hy deur arbeid verkry het, gee hy terug sonder om dit in te sluk; na die maat van sy ingeruilde rykdom sal hy nie bly wees nie.

kjv_text: Because he hath oppressed and hath forsaken the poor; because he hath violently taken away an house which he builded not;
bsb_text: For he has oppressed and forsaken the poor; he has seized houses he did not build.
aov_text: Want hy het die armes verdruk, aan hulle lot oorgelaat; ’n huis het hy geroof, maar hy sal dit nie opbou nie.

kjv_text: Surely he shall not feel quietness in his belly, he shall not save of that which he desired.
bsb_text: Because his appetite is never satisfied, he cannot escape with his treasure.
aov_text: Want hy het geen rus geken in sy binneste nie; so sal hy dan nie ontsnap met sy kosbare goed nie.

kjv_text: There shall none of his meat be left; therefore shall no man look for his goods.
bsb_text: Nothing is left for him to consume; thus his prosperity will not endure.
aov_text: Niks het ontkom aan sy vraatsug nie; daarom is sy voorspoed nie duursaam nie.

kjv_text: In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits: every hand of the wicked shall come upon him.
bsb_text: In the midst of his plenty, he will be distressed; the full force of misery will come upon him.
aov_text: By die volheid van sy oorvloed sal hy benoud wees: al die hande van ellendiges oorval hom.

kjv_text: When he is about to fill his belly, God shall cast the fury of his wrath upon him, and shall rain it upon him while he is eating.
bsb_text: When he has filled his stomach, God will vent His fury upon him, raining it down on him as he eats.
aov_text: OM sy buik te vul, sal Hy teen hom uitstuur sy toorngloed, en Hy sal dit op hom laat reën as sy voedsel.

kjv_text: He shall flee from the iron weapon, and the bow of steel shall strike him through.
bsb_text: Though he flees from an iron weapon, a bronze-tipped arrow will pierce him.
aov_text: Hy sal vlug vir die ysterwapens—’n koperboog sal hom deurboor.

kjv_text: It is drawn, and cometh out of the body; yea, the glittering sword cometh out of his gall: terrors are upon him.
bsb_text: It is drawn out of his back, the gleaming point from his liver. Terrors come over him.
aov_text: Hy trek—daar kom dit uit sy rug, en die glinsterende swaard gaan uit sy gal; verskrikkinge is op hom!

kjv_text: All darkness shall be hid in his secret places: a fire not blown shall consume him; it shall go ill with him that is left in his tabernacle.
bsb_text: Total darkness is reserved for his treasures. A fire unfanned will consume him and devour what is left in his tent.
aov_text: Pure duisternis is bewaar vir sy skatte; ’n vuur wat nie deur mense aangeblaas is nie, verteer hom; dit wei af wat in sy tent oorbly.

kjv_text: The heaven shall reveal his iniquity; and the earth shall rise up against him.
bsb_text: The heavens will expose his iniquity, and the earth will rise up against him.
aov_text: Die hemel openbaar sy ongeregtigheid, en die aarde staan teen hom op.

kjv_text: The increase of his house shall depart, and his goods shall flow away in the day of his wrath.
bsb_text: The possessions of his house will be removed, flowing away on the day of God’s wrath.
aov_text: Weggevoer word die opbrings van sy huis—goed wat wegspoel op die dag van sy toorn.

kjv_text: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, and the heritage appointed unto him by God.
bsb_text: This is the wicked man’s portion from God, the inheritance God has appointed him.”
aov_text: Dit is die deel van die goddelose mens van die kant van God en die erfdeel wat vir hom bestem is deur God.

kjv_text: But Job answered and said,
bsb_text: Then Job answered:
aov_text: MAAR Job het geantwoord en gesê:

kjv_text: Hear diligently my speech, and let this be your consolations.
bsb_text: “Listen carefully to my words; let this be your consolation to me.
aov_text: Luister goed na my rede, en laat dit die vertroostinge wees wat julle aanbied.

kjv_text: Suffer me that I may speak; and after that I have spoken, mock on.
bsb_text: Bear with me while I speak; then, after I have spoken, you may go on mocking.
aov_text: Verdra my, dat ek ook kan spreek; en nadat ek gespreek het, kan jy spot.

kjv_text: As for me, is my complaint to man? and if it were so, why should not my spirit be troubled?
bsb_text: Is my complaint against a man? Then why should I not be impatient?
aov_text: Wat my aangaan, geld my geklaag dan ’n mens? Of waarom sou ek nie ongeduldig word nie?

kjv_text: Mark me, and be astonished, and lay your hand upon your mouth.
bsb_text: Look at me and be appalled; put your hand over your mouth.
aov_text: Kyk my aan, en wees verskrik; en lê die hand op die mond.

kjv_text: Even when I remember I am afraid, and trembling taketh hold on my flesh.
bsb_text: When I remember, terror takes hold, and my body trembles in horror.
aov_text: JA, as ek daaraan dink, is ek glad verslae, en verskrikking gryp my vlees aan.

kjv_text: Wherefore do the wicked live, become old, yea, are mighty in power?
bsb_text: Why do the wicked live on, growing old and increasing in power?
aov_text: Waarom bly die goddelose lewe, word hulle oud, ja, neem hulle toe in krag?

kjv_text: Their seed is established in their sight with them, and their offspring before their eyes.
bsb_text: Their descendants are established around them, and their offspring before their eyes.
aov_text: Hulle nakomelinge bestaan voor hulle, in hul gemeenskap, en hul spruite voor hulle oë.

kjv_text: Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of God upon them.
bsb_text: Their homes are safe from fear; no rod of punishment from God is upon them.
aov_text: Hul huise het vrede, sonder skrik; en die roede van God is op hulle nie.

kjv_text: Their bull gendereth, and faileth not; their cow calveth, and casteth not her calf.
bsb_text: Their bulls breed without fail; their cows bear calves and do not miscarry.
aov_text: Sy stier bespring en mis nie; sy koei kalf en het geen misdrag nie.

kjv_text: They send forth their little ones like a flock, and their children dance.
bsb_text: They send forth their little ones like a flock; their children skip about,
aov_text: Hulle laat hul jong seuns loop soos ’n trop kleinvee, en hul kinders spring rond.

kjv_text: They take the timbrel and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the organ.
bsb_text: singing to the tambourine and lyre and making merry at the sound of the flute.
aov_text: Hulle sing by die tamboeryn en siter en is bly by die klank van die fluit.

kjv_text: They spend their days in wealth, and in a moment go down to the grave.
bsb_text: They spend their days in prosperity and go down to Sheol in peace.
aov_text: In voorspoed slyt hulle hul dae, en in ’n oomblik sink hulle in die doderyk af.

kjv_text: Therefore they say unto God, Depart from us; for we desire not the knowledge of thy ways.
bsb_text: Yet they say to God: ‘Leave us alone! For we have no desire to know Your ways.
aov_text: Tog het hulle tot God gesê: Bly ver van ons af; en: In die kennis van u weë het ons geen behae nie.

kjv_text: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? and what profit should we have, if we pray unto him?
bsb_text: Who is the Almighty, that we should serve Him, and what would we gain if we pray to Him?’
aov_text: Wat is die Almagtige dat ons Hom sou dien? En wat baat dit ons dat ons biddend by Hom aandring?

kjv_text: Lo, their good is not in their hand: the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
bsb_text: Still, their prosperity is not in their own hands, so I stay far from the counsel of the wicked.
aov_text: (Kyk, hulle voorspoed is nie in húl hand nie: die gesindheid van die goddelose is ver van my!)

kjv_text: How oft is the candle of the wicked put out! and how oft cometh their destruction upon them! God distributeth sorrows in his anger.
bsb_text: How often is the lamp of the wicked put out? Does disaster come upon them? Does God, in His anger, apportion destruction?
aov_text: Hoe selde gaan die lamp van die goddelose dood en oorval hul ondergang hulle! Deel Hy smarte uit in sy toorn,

kjv_text: They are as stubble before the wind, and as chaff that the storm carrieth away.
bsb_text: Are they like straw before the wind, like chaff swept away by a storm?
aov_text: word hulle soos strooi voor die wind, en soos kaf wat die stormwind wegvoer?

kjv_text: God layeth up his iniquity for his children: he rewardeth him, and he shall know it.
bsb_text: It is said that God lays up one’s punishment for his children. Let God repay the man himself, so he will know it.
aov_text: JULLE sê: God spaar sy onheil vir sy kinders op. Ek sê: Hy moes dit aan homself vergeld, dat hy kan voel!

kjv_text: His eyes shall see his destruction, and he shall drink of the wrath of the Almighty.
bsb_text: Let his eyes see his own destruction; let him drink for himself the wrath of the Almighty.
aov_text: Sy eie oë moes sy ongeluk sien, en sélf moes hy drink van die grimmigheid van die Almagtige.

kjv_text: For what pleasure hath he in his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off in the midst?
bsb_text: For what does he care about his household after him, when the number of his months has run out?
aov_text: Want wat gee hy om sy huis ná hom as die getal van sy maande afgesny is?

kjv_text: Shall any teach God knowledge? seeing he judgeth those that are high.
bsb_text: Can anyone teach knowledge to God, since He judges those on high?
aov_text: WIL iemand aan God kennis leer, Hom wat die hemelse wesens oordeel?

kjv_text: One dieth in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.
bsb_text: One man dies full of vigor, completely secure and at ease.
aov_text: Die een sterwe in volkome geluk, heeltemal gerus en tevrede.

kjv_text: His breasts are full of milk, and his bones are moistened with marrow.
bsb_text: His body is well nourished, and his bones are rich with marrow.
aov_text: Sy emmers is vol melk, en die murg van sy gebeente word deur en deur bevogtig.

kjv_text: And another dieth in the bitterness of his soul, and never eateth with pleasure.
bsb_text: Yet another man dies in the bitterness of his soul, having never tasted prosperity.
aov_text: Die ander daarenteen sterwe met bitterheid van siel sonder dat hy van die goeie geniet het.

kjv_text: They shall lie down alike in the dust, and the worms shall cover them.
bsb_text: But together they lie down in the dust, and worms cover them both.
aov_text: Saam lê hulle in die stof, en die wurms oordek hulle.

kjv_text: Behold, I know your thoughts, and the devices which ye wrongfully imagine against me.
bsb_text: Behold, I know your thoughts full well, the schemes by which you would wrong me.
aov_text: Kyk, ek ken julle gedagtes en die slim planne waarmee julle gewelddadig teen my optree.

kjv_text: For ye say, Where is the house of the prince? and where are the dwelling places of the wicked?
bsb_text: For you say, ‘Where now is the nobleman’s house, and where are the tents in which the wicked dwell?’
aov_text: As julle sê: Waar is die huis van die tiran, en waar die woontent van die goddelose —

kjv_text: Have ye not asked them that go by the way? and do ye not know their tokens,
bsb_text: Have you never asked those who travel the roads? Do you not accept their reports?
aov_text: het julle dan nie navraag gedoen by die reisigers nie (hulle bewyse kan julle tog nie loën nie!):

kjv_text: That the wicked is reserved to the day of destruction? they shall be brought forth to the day of wrath.
bsb_text: Indeed, the evil man is spared from the day of calamity, delivered from the day of wrath.
aov_text: dat die kwaaddoeners gespaar word op die dag van ondergang, dat hulle weggelei word op die dag van grimmigheid?

kjv_text: Who shall declare his way to his face? and who shall repay him what he hath done?
bsb_text: Who denounces his behavior to his face? Who repays him for what he has done?
aov_text: Wie gee hom openlik sy gedrag te kenne; en het hy gehandel—wie sal hom dit vergeld?

kjv_text: Yet shall he be brought to the grave, and shall remain in the tomb.
bsb_text: He is carried to the grave, and watch is kept over his tomb.
aov_text: Dan word hy na die graf gebring, en hulle sorg vir sy grafheuwel.

kjv_text: The clods of the valley shall be sweet unto him, and every man shall draw after him, as there are innumerable before him.
bsb_text: The clods of the valley are sweet to him; everyone follows behind him, and those before him are without number.
aov_text: Sag lê op hom die kluite van die dal; en agter hom trek al die mense aan soos daar ontelbares voor hom gewees het.

kjv_text: How then comfort ye me in vain, seeing in your answers there remaineth falsehood?
bsb_text: So how can you comfort me with empty words? For your answers remain full of falsehood.”
aov_text: Hoe troos julle my dan op so ’n nietige manier? En julle antwoorde—net troubreuk bly oor!

kjv_text: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,
bsb_text: Then Eliphaz the Temanite replied:
aov_text: TOE het Élifas, die Temaniet, geantwoord en gesê:

kjv_text: Can a man be profitable unto God, as he that is wise may be profitable unto himself?
bsb_text: “Can a man be of use to God? Can even a wise man benefit Him?
aov_text: Kan ’n man aan God ’n diens bewys? Nee, aan homself bewys die verstandige ’n diens.

kjv_text: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty, that thou art righteous? or is it gain to him, that thou makest thy ways perfect?
bsb_text: Does it delight the Almighty that you are righteous? Does He profit if your ways are blameless?
aov_text: Het die Almagtige daar belang by dat jy regverdig is? Of is dit voordeel vir Hom dat jy onberispelik wandel?

kjv_text: Will he reprove thee for fear of thee? will he enter with thee into judgment?
bsb_text: Is it for your reverence that He rebukes you and enters into judgment against you?
aov_text: Is dit oor jou Godsvrees dat Hy jou bestraf, dat Hy met jou na die gereg gaan?

kjv_text: Is not thy wickedness great? and thine iniquities infinite?
bsb_text: Is not your wickedness great? Are not your iniquities endless?
aov_text: Is jou boosheid nie groot en jou ongeregtighede nie sonder einde nie?

kjv_text: For thou hast taken a pledge from thy brother for nought, and stripped the naked of their clothing.
bsb_text: For you needlessly demanded security from your brothers and deprived the naked of their clothing.
aov_text: WANT jy het pand geneem van jou broers sonder noodsaak, en die klere van die naaktes het jy uitgetrek.

kjv_text: Thou hast not given water to the weary to drink, and thou hast withholden bread from the hungry.
bsb_text: You gave no water to the weary and withheld food from the famished,
aov_text: Aan die vermoeide het jy geen water gegee om te drink nie, en aan die hongerige het jy die brood onthou.

kjv_text: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth; and the honourable man dwelt in it.
bsb_text: while the land belonged to a mighty man, and a man of honor lived on it.
aov_text: Maar aan die man van geweld—aan hom behoort die land; en die aansienlike—hy moet daarin woon!

kjv_text: Thou hast sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.
bsb_text: You sent widows away empty-handed, and the strength of the fatherless was crushed.
aov_text: Weduwees het jy met leë hande weggestuur, en die arms van die wese is verbrysel.

kjv_text: Therefore snares are round about thee, and sudden fear troubleth thee;
bsb_text: Therefore snares surround you, and sudden peril terrifies you;
aov_text: Daarom is daar vangnette rondom jou en maak die vrees jou skielik skrik.

kjv_text: Or darkness, that thou canst not see; and abundance of waters cover thee.
bsb_text: it is so dark you cannot see, and a flood of water covers you.
aov_text: Of sien jy die duisternis nie en die oorvloed van waters wat jou bedek?

kjv_text: Is not God in the height of heaven? and behold the height of the stars, how high they are!
bsb_text: Is not God as high as the heavens? Look at the highest stars, how lofty they are!
aov_text: IS God nie hemelhoog nie? En aanskou hoe hoog die hoogste sterre staan.

kjv_text: And thou sayest, How doth God know? can he judge through the dark cloud?
bsb_text: Yet you say: ‘What does God know? Does He judge through thick darkness?
