aov_text: Maar jy sê: Wat weet God? Kan Hy deur donkerheid heen strafgerig hou?

kjv_text: Thick clouds are a covering to him, that he seeth not; and he walketh in the circuit of heaven.
bsb_text: Thick clouds veil Him so He does not see us as He traverses the vault of heaven.’
aov_text: Wolke is ’n bedekking vir Hom, sodat Hy nie sien nie; en oor die hemelgewelf wandel Hy.

kjv_text: Hast thou marked the old way which wicked men have trodden?
bsb_text: Will you stay on the ancient path that wicked men have trod?
aov_text: Wil jy die pad van die ou tyd hou, wat die kwaaddoeners bewandel het,

kjv_text: Which were cut down out of time, whose foundation was overflown with a flood:
bsb_text: They were snatched away before their time, and their foundations were swept away by a flood.
aov_text: wat gegryp is voor die tyd, wie se grondslag uitgegiet is soos ’n stroom,

kjv_text: Which said unto God, Depart from us: and what can the Almighty do for them?
bsb_text: They said to God, ‘Depart from us. What can the Almighty do to us?’
aov_text: wat tot God gesê het: Bly ver van ons af! en: Wat kan die Almagtige ons aandoen?

kjv_text: Yet he filled their houses with good things: but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
bsb_text: But it was He who filled their houses with good things; so I stay far from the counsel of the wicked.
aov_text: En tog het Hy hulle huise gevul met wat goed is. (Maar die gesindheid van die goddelose is ver van my!)

kjv_text: The righteous see it, and are glad: and the innocent laugh them to scorn.
bsb_text: The righteous see it and are glad; the innocent mock them:
aov_text: Die regverdiges sien dit en is bly, en die onskuldige spot met hulle en sê:

kjv_text: Whereas our substance is not cut down, but the remnant of them the fire consumeth.
bsb_text: ‘Surely our foes are destroyed, and fire has consumed their excess.’
aov_text: Waarlik, ons teëstander is verdelg; en wat hulle laat oorbly het, het die vuur verteer.

kjv_text: Acquaint now thyself with him, and be at peace: thereby good shall come unto thee.
bsb_text: Reconcile now and be at peace with Him; thereby good will come to you.
aov_text: SLUIT tog vriendskap met Hom, sodat jy vrede kan hê; daardeur sal goeie dinge oor jou kom.

kjv_text: Receive, I pray thee, the law from his mouth, and lay up his words in thine heart.
bsb_text: Receive instruction from His mouth, and lay up His words in your heart.
aov_text: Neem tog uit sy mond onderrig aan, en lê sy woorde weg in jou hart.

kjv_text: If thou return to the Almighty, thou shalt be built up, thou shalt put away iniquity far from thy tabernacles.
bsb_text: If you return to the Almighty, you will be restored. If you remove injustice from your tents
aov_text: As jy tot die Almagtige terugkeer, sal jy gebou word; as jy die onreg verwyder uit jou tent.

kjv_text: Then shalt thou lay up gold as dust, and the gold of Ophir as the stones of the brooks.
bsb_text: and consign your gold to the dust and the gold of Ophir to the stones of the ravines,
aov_text: En gooi die gouderts in die stof en tussen die rotse van die spruite die goud van Ofir.

kjv_text: Yea, the Almighty shall be thy defence, and thou shalt have plenty of silver.
bsb_text: then the Almighty will be your gold and the finest silver for you.
aov_text: Dan sal die Almagtige jou gouderts wees en stawe silwer vir jou.

kjv_text: For then shalt thou have thy delight in the Almighty, and shalt lift up thy face unto God.
bsb_text: Surely then you will delight in the Almighty and lift up your face to God.
aov_text: Want dan sal jy in die Almagtige jou verlustig en jou aangesig tot God ophef.

kjv_text: Thou shalt make thy prayer unto him, and he shall hear thee, and thou shalt pay thy vows.
bsb_text: You will pray to Him, and He will hear you, and you will fulfill your vows.
aov_text: Jy sal tot Hom bid, en Hy sal jou verhoor; en jy sal jou geloftes betaal.

kjv_text: Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee: and the light shall shine upon thy ways.
bsb_text: Your decisions will be carried out, and light will shine on your ways.
aov_text: Besluit jy iets, dan kom dit tot stand; en oor jou weë skyn ’n lig.

kjv_text: When men are cast down, then thou shalt say, There is lifting up; and he shall save the humble person.
bsb_text: When men are brought low and you say, ‘Lift them up!’ then He will save the lowly.
aov_text: As dié afdraand loop, dan sê jy: Boontoe! En hom wat neerslagtig is, verlos Hy.

kjv_text: He shall deliver the island of the innocent: and it is delivered by the pureness of thine hands.
bsb_text: He will deliver even one who is not innocent, rescuing him through the cleanness of your hands.”
aov_text: Hy red selfs hom wat nie onskuldig is nie: ja, hy word gered deur die reinheid van jou hande.

kjv_text: Then Job answered and said,
bsb_text: Then Job answered:
aov_text: MAAR Job het geantwoord en gesê:

kjv_text: Even to day is my complaint bitter: my stroke is heavier than my groaning.
bsb_text: “Even today my complaint is bitter. His hand is heavy despite my groaning.
aov_text: Nog altyd geld my geklaag as wederstrewigheid; my hand lê swaar op my gesug.

kjv_text: Oh that I knew where I might find him! that I might come even to his seat!
bsb_text: If only I knew where to find Him, so that I could go to His seat.
aov_text: Ag, as ek maar geweet het waar ek Hom kon vind, maar kon kom tot by sy woning!

kjv_text: I would order my cause before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.
bsb_text: I would plead my case before Him and fill my mouth with arguments.
aov_text: Dan sou ek die regsaak voor sy aangesig uiteensit en my mond met bewyse vul;

kjv_text: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would say unto me.
bsb_text: I would learn how He would answer, and consider what He would say.
aov_text: ek sou verneem die woorde wat Hy my sou antwoord, en verstaan wat Hy aan my sou sê.

kjv_text: Will he plead against me with his great power? No; but he would put strength in me.
bsb_text: Would He contend with me in His great power? No, He would certainly take note of me.
aov_text: Sou Hy met oormag teen my stry? Nee, maar Hý sou ag op my gee.

kjv_text: There the righteous might dispute with him; so should I be delivered for ever from my judge.
bsb_text: Then an upright man could reason with Him, and I would be delivered forever from my Judge.
aov_text: Dan sou daar ’n opregte met Hom staan en pleit, en ek sou vir ewig van my regter vrykom.

kjv_text: Behold, I go forward, but he is not there; and backward, but I cannot perceive him:
bsb_text: If I go east, He is not there, and if I go west, I cannot find Him.
aov_text: KYK, ek gaan na die ooste, en Hy is nie daar nie; en na die weste, maar ek bemerk Hom nie.

kjv_text: On the left hand, where he doth work, but I cannot behold him: he hideth himself on the right hand, that I cannot see him:
bsb_text: When He is at work in the north, I cannot behold Him; when He turns to the south, I cannot see Him.
aov_text: As Hy in die noorde werk, aanskou ek Hom nie; buig Hy af na die suide, dan sien ek Hom nie.

kjv_text: But he knoweth the way that I take: when he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.
bsb_text: Yet He knows the way I have taken; when He has tested me, I will come forth as gold.
aov_text: Want Hy weet hoe my wandel is; as Hy my toets, sal ek soos goud te voorskyn kom.

kjv_text: My foot hath held his steps, his way have I kept, and not declined.
bsb_text: My feet have followed in His tracks; I have kept His way without turning aside.
aov_text: Aan sy voetstap het my voet vasgehou; sy weg het ek bewaar sonder om uit te draai.

kjv_text: Neither have I gone back from the commandment of his lips; I have esteemed the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.
bsb_text: I have not departed from the command of His lips; I have treasured the words of His mouth more than my daily bread.
aov_text: Van die gebod van sy lippe het ek nie afgewyk nie; die woorde van sy mond het ek bewaar meer as my eie wet.

kjv_text: But he is in one mind, and who can turn him? and what his soul desireth, even that he doeth.
bsb_text: But He is unchangeable, and who can oppose Him? He does what He desires.
aov_text: MAAR Hy bly onveranderlik Een—wie sal Hom dan teëhou? En wat sy siel begeer, dit doen Hy.

kjv_text: For he performeth the thing that is appointed for me: and many such things are with him.
bsb_text: For He carries out His decree against me, and He has many such plans.
aov_text: Want Hy sal volbring wat oor my besluit is, en baie sulke dinge is daar by Hom.

kjv_text: Therefore am I troubled at his presence: when I consider, I am afraid of him.
bsb_text: Therefore I am terrified in His presence; when I consider this, I fear Him.
aov_text: Daarom is ek verskrik voor sy aangesig; as ek daarop ag gee, vrees ek vir Hom.

kjv_text: For God maketh my heart soft, and the Almighty troubleth me:
bsb_text: God has made my heart faint; the Almighty has terrified me.
aov_text: En God het my hart week gemaak, en die Almagtige het my verskrik.

kjv_text: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither hath he covered the darkness from my face.
bsb_text: Yet I am not silenced by the darkness, by the thick darkness that covers my face.
aov_text: Want ek vergaan nie vanweë die duisternis of vanweë my eie aangesig wat deur donkerheid oordek is nie.

kjv_text: Why, seeing times are not hidden from the Almighty, do they that know him not see his days?
bsb_text: “Why does the Almighty not reserve times for judgment? Why may those who know Him never see His days?
aov_text: WAAROM het die Almagtige vir Hom geen geregstye voorbehou nie, en sien die wat Hom ken, nie sy geregsdae nie?

kjv_text: Some remove the landmarks; they violently take away flocks, and feed thereof.
bsb_text: Men move boundary stones; they pasture stolen flocks.
aov_text: Grenslyne verlê hulle; ’n trop vee roof hulle en laat dit wei.

kjv_text: They drive away the ass of the fatherless, they take the widow's ox for a pledge.
bsb_text: They drive away the donkey of the fatherless and take the widow’s ox in pledge.
aov_text: Die esel van die wese dryf hulle weg, die bees van die weduwee neem hulle as pand.

kjv_text: They turn the needy out of the way: the poor of the earth hide themselves together.
bsb_text: They push the needy off the road and force all the poor of the land into hiding.
aov_text: Hulle stoot die behoeftiges van die pad af; die ellendiges van die land kruip almal saam weg.

kjv_text: Behold, as wild asses in the desert, go they forth to their work; rising betimes for a prey: the wilderness yieldeth food for them and for their children.
bsb_text: Indeed, like wild donkeys in the desert, the poor go to work foraging for food; the wasteland is food for their children.
aov_text: Kyk, soos wilde-esels in die woestyn trek hulle uit na hul werk, terwyl hulle soek na voedsel; die wildernis lewer brood vir hulle, vir die kinders.

kjv_text: They reap every one his corn in the field: and they gather the vintage of the wicked.
bsb_text: They gather fodder in the fields and glean the vineyards of the wicked.
aov_text: Op die veld gaan hulle voer haal, en in die wingerd van die goddelose hou hulle na-oes.

kjv_text: They cause the naked to lodge without clothing, that they have no covering in the cold.
bsb_text: Without clothing, they spend the night naked; they have no covering against the cold.
aov_text: Naak bring hulle die nag deur, sonder klere, en hulle het geen bedekking teen die koue nie.

kjv_text: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for want of a shelter.
bsb_text: Drenched by mountain rains, they huddle against the rocks for want of shelter.
aov_text: Van die stortbui van die berge word hulle nat; en by gebrek aan skuiling druk hulle hul teen die rotse vas.

kjv_text: They pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the poor.
bsb_text: The fatherless infant is snatched from the breast; the nursing child of the poor is seized for a debt.
aov_text: Hulle ruk die weeskind van die bors af; en wat die arme aan het, verpand hulle.

kjv_text: They cause him to go naked without clothing, and they take away the sheaf from the hungry;
bsb_text: Without clothing, they wander about naked. They carry the sheaves, but still go hungry.
aov_text: Naak gaan hulle heen, sonder klere; en terwyl hulle honger het, dra hulle gerwe aan.

kjv_text: Which make oil within their walls, and tread their winepresses, and suffer thirst.
bsb_text: They crush olives within their walls; they tread the winepresses, but go thirsty.
aov_text: Tussen die mure van dié mense pars hulle olie, trap die parskuipe terwyl hulle versmag van dors.

kjv_text: Men groan from out of the city, and the soul of the wounded crieth out: yet God layeth not folly to them.
bsb_text: From the city, men groan, and the souls of the wounded cry out, yet God charges no one with wrongdoing.
aov_text: Uit die stad kerm die manne, en die siel van die gewondes roep om hulp; tog gee God geen ag op die ongerymdheid daarvan nie.

kjv_text: They are of those that rebel against the light; they know not the ways thereof, nor abide in the paths thereof.
bsb_text: Then there are those who rebel against the light, not knowing its ways or staying on its paths.
aov_text: SULKE mense behoort by die vyande van die lig: hulle ken nie die weë daarvan nie en bly nie op die paaie daarvan nie.

kjv_text: The murderer rising with the light killeth the poor and needy, and in the night is as a thief.
bsb_text: When daylight is gone, the murderer rises to kill the poor and needy; in the night he is like a thief.
aov_text: Teen dagbreek staan die moordenaar op, hy maak die arme en behoeftige dood, en in die nag is hy soos die dief.

kjv_text: The eye also of the adulterer waiteth for the twilight, saying, No eye shall see me: and disguiseth his face.
bsb_text: The eye of the adulterer watches for twilight. Thinking, ‘No eye will see me,’ he covers his face.
aov_text: En die oog van die owerspeler neem die skemeraand waar en sê: Geen oog kan my sien nie; en hy sit ’n sluier voor sy gesig.

kjv_text: In the dark they dig through houses, which they had marked for themselves in the daytime: they know not the light.
bsb_text: In the dark they dig through houses; by day they shut themselves in, never to experience the light.
aov_text: In die duisternis breek hulle in die huise in; bedags sluit hulle hul op; hulle ken nie die lig nie.

kjv_text: For the morning is to them even as the shadow of death: if one know them, they are in the terrors of the shadow of death.
bsb_text: For to them, deep darkness is their morning; surely they are friends with the terrors of darkness!
aov_text: Want vir hulle saam is die stikdonker ’n môrestond, want hulle ken die verskrikkinge van die stikdonker.

kjv_text: He is swift as the waters; their portion is cursed in the earth: he beholdeth not the way of the vineyards.
bsb_text: They are but foam on the surface of the water; their portion of the land is cursed, so that no one turns toward their vineyards.
aov_text: Gou dryf hul voort op die oppervlakte van die water; hulle stuk grond word vervloek in die land; hulle begeef hul nie meer op pad na die wingerde nie.

kjv_text: Drought and heat consume the snow waters: so doth the grave those which have sinned.
bsb_text: As drought and heat consume the melting snow, so Sheol steals those who have sinned.
aov_text: Droogte, ook hitte, roof die sneeuwater weg—so die doderyk die wat gesondig het.

kjv_text: The womb shall forget him; the worm shall feed sweetly on him; he shall be no more remembered; and wickedness shall be broken as a tree.
bsb_text: The womb forgets them; the worm feeds on them; they are remembered no more. So injustice is like a broken tree.
aov_text: Die moederskoot vergeet hom; die wurms eet smaaklik aan hom; aan hom word nie meer gedink nie: so word dan die onreg gebreek soos ’n stuk hout —

kjv_text: He evil entreateth the barren that beareth not: and doeth not good to the widow.
bsb_text: They prey on the barren and childless, and show no kindness to the widow.
aov_text: hy wat die onvrugbare plunder wat nie baar nie, en aan die weduwee geen weldaad bewys nie.

kjv_text: He draweth also the mighty with his power: he riseth up, and no man is sure of life.
bsb_text: Yet by His power, God drags away the mighty; though rising up, they have no assurance of life.
aov_text: Tog laat Hy deur sy krag die magtiges lank lewe; hy wat al van sy lewe nie seker was nie, staan weer op.

kjv_text: Though it be given him to be in safety, whereon he resteth; yet his eyes are upon their ways.
bsb_text: He gives them a sense of security, but His eyes are on their ways.
aov_text: God gee hom veiligheid, en hy steun daarop; en sy oë is op hulle weë.

kjv_text: They are exalted for a little while, but are gone and brought low; they are taken out of the way as all other, and cut off as the tops of the ears of corn.
bsb_text: They are exalted for a moment, then they are gone; they are brought low and gathered up like all others; they are cut off like heads of grain.
aov_text: Hulle het hul verhef—’n kort rukkie, dan is hulle daar nie meer nie; en hulle word verneder; soos almal sterwe hulle; en soos die boonste van ’n halm word hulle afgesny.

kjv_text: And if it be not so now, who will make me a liar, and make my speech nothing worth?
bsb_text: If this is not so, then who can prove me a liar and reduce my words to nothing?”
aov_text: En is dit nou nie so nie, wie sal my van ’n leuen beskuldig en my rede tot niet maak?

kjv_text: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,
bsb_text: Then Bildad the Shuhite replied:
aov_text: TOE het Bildad, die Suhiet, geantwoord en gesê:

kjv_text: Dominion and fear are with him, he maketh peace in his high places.
bsb_text: “Dominion and awe belong to God; He establishes harmony in the heights of heaven.
aov_text: Heerskappy en verskrikking is by Hom wat vrede maak in sy hoogtes.

kjv_text: Is there any number of his armies? and upon whom doth not his light arise?
bsb_text: Can His troops be numbered? On whom does His light not rise?
aov_text: Is daar ’n getal vir sy leërskare? En oor wie rys sy lig nie op nie?

kjv_text: How then can man be justified with God? or how can he be clean that is born of a woman?
bsb_text: How then can a man be just before God? How can one born of woman be pure?
aov_text: Hoe sou dan ’n mens regverdig wees by God? En hoe sou hy rein wees wat uit ’n vrou gebore is?

kjv_text: Behold even to the moon, and it shineth not; yea, the stars are not pure in his sight.
bsb_text: If even the moon does not shine, and the stars are not pure in His sight,
aov_text: Kyk, selfs die maan—hy skyn nie helder nie; en die sterre is nie rein in sy oë nie.

kjv_text: How much less man, that is a worm? and the son of man, which is a worm?
bsb_text: how much less man, who is but a maggot, and the son of man, who is but a worm!”
aov_text: Hoeveel minder die mens, ’n maaier; en die mensekind, ’n wurm.

kjv_text: But Job answered and said,
bsb_text: Then Job answered:
aov_text: MAAR Job het geantwoord en gesê:

kjv_text: How hast thou helped him that is without power? how savest thou the arm that hath no strength?
bsb_text: “How you have helped the powerless and saved the arm that is feeble!
aov_text: Hoe goed het jy die onmagtige bygestaan, die kragtelose arm gehelp!

kjv_text: How hast thou counselled him that hath no wisdom? and how hast thou plentifully declared the thing as it is?
bsb_text: How you have counseled the unwise and provided fully sound insight!
aov_text: Hoe mooi het jy die onwyse raad gegee en beleid in oorvloed bekend gemaak!

kjv_text: To whom hast thou uttered words? and whose spirit came from thee?
bsb_text: To whom have you uttered these words? And whose spirit spoke through you?
aov_text: Aan wie het jy woorde te kenne gegee, en wie se gees het uit jou uitgegaan?

kjv_text: Dead things are formed from under the waters, and the inhabitants thereof.
bsb_text: The dead tremble—those beneath the waters and those who dwell in them.
aov_text: Die skimme is beangs onder die waters en onder die bewoners daarvan.

kjv_text: Hell is naked before him, and destruction hath no covering.
bsb_text: Sheol is naked before God, and Abaddon has no covering.
aov_text: Naak lê die doderyk voor Hom, en die plek van vertering het geen bedekking nie —

kjv_text: He stretcheth out the north over the empty place, and hangeth the earth upon nothing.
bsb_text: He stretches out the north over empty space; He hangs the earth upon nothing.
aov_text: voor Hom wat die noorde uitspan oor die chaos, wat die aarde ophang oor ’n niks;

kjv_text: He bindeth up the waters in his thick clouds; and the cloud is not rent under them.
bsb_text: He wraps up the waters in His clouds, yet the clouds do not burst under their own weight.
aov_text: wat die waters saambind in sy wolke sonder dat die wolkgevaarte daaronder skeur;

kjv_text: He holdeth back the face of his throne, and spreadeth his cloud upon it.
bsb_text: He covers the face of the full moon, spreading over it His cloud.
aov_text: wat die gesig van die troon toehou deurdat Hy sy wolk daaroor uitsprei.

kjv_text: He hath compassed the waters with bounds, until the day and night come to an end.
bsb_text: He has inscribed a horizon on the face of the waters at the boundary between light and darkness.
aov_text: Hy het ’n kring afgetrek oor die watervlakte tot waar lig in duisternis eindig.

kjv_text: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his reproof.
bsb_text: The foundations of heaven quake, astounded at His rebuke.
aov_text: Die pilare van die hemel wankel en staan verstom weens sy dreiging.

kjv_text: He divideth the sea with his power, and by his understanding he smiteth through the proud.
bsb_text: By His power He stirred the sea; by His understanding He shattered Rahab.
aov_text: Deur sy krag bring Hy die see in beroering, en deur sy verstand verpletter Hy Rahab.

kjv_text: By his spirit he hath garnished the heavens; his hand hath formed the crooked serpent.
bsb_text: By His breath the skies were cleared; His hand pierced the fleeing serpent.
aov_text: Deur sy asem word die hemel helder; sy hand het die vinnige slang deurboor.

kjv_text: Lo, these are parts of his ways: but how little a portion is heard of him? but the thunder of his power who can understand?
bsb_text: Indeed, these are but the fringes of His ways; how faint is the whisper we hear of Him! Who then can understand the thunder of His power?”
aov_text: Kyk, dit is maar die uitlopers van sy weë, en wat ’n fluisterwoord hoor ons maar van Hom! Wie sou dan die donder van sy magtige dade verstaan?

kjv_text: Moreover Job continued his parable, and said,
bsb_text: Job continued his discourse:
aov_text: EN Job het verder sy spreuk aangehef en gesê:

kjv_text: As God liveth, who hath taken away my judgment; and the Almighty, who hath vexed my soul;
bsb_text: “As surely as God lives, who has deprived me of justice—the Almighty, who has embittered my soul—
aov_text: So waar as God leef wat my my reg ontneem het, en die Almagtige wat my siel bitterheid aangedoen het —

kjv_text: All the while my breath is in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils;
bsb_text: as long as my breath is still within me and the breath of God remains in my nostrils,
aov_text: want my asem is nog heeltemal in my, en die lewensasem van God is in my neus —

kjv_text: My lips shall not speak wickedness, nor my tongue utter deceit.
bsb_text: my lips will not speak wickedness, and my tongue will not utter deceit.
aov_text: my lippe spreek geen onreg nie, en my tong verkondig geen bedrog nie!

kjv_text: God forbid that I should justify you: till I die I will not remove mine integrity from me.
bsb_text: I will never say that you are right; I will maintain my integrity until I die.
aov_text: Dit is ver van my dat ek julle gelyk sou gee; totdat ek die asem uitblaas, sal ek my onskuld nie prysgee nie.

kjv_text: My righteousness I hold fast, and will not let it go: my heart shall not reproach me so long as I live.
bsb_text: I will cling to my righteousness and never let go. As long as I live, my conscience will not accuse me.
aov_text: Aan my geregtigheid hou ek vas en laat dit nie los nie; my hart veroordeel geeneen van my dae nie.

kjv_text: Let mine enemy be as the wicked, and he that riseth up against me as the unrighteous.
bsb_text: May my enemy be like the wicked and my opponent like the unjust.
aov_text: MY vyand moet dus verskyn as goddelose en my teëstander as kwaaddoener.

kjv_text: For what is the hope of the hypocrite, though he hath gained, when God taketh away his soul?
bsb_text: For what is the hope of the godless when he is cut off, when God takes away his life?
aov_text: Want wat is die verwagting van die goddelose as Hy afsny—as God sy siel wegneem?

kjv_text: Will God hear his cry when trouble cometh upon him?
bsb_text: Will God hear his cry when distress comes upon him?
aov_text: Sal God sy geroep hoor as benoudheid oor hom kom?

kjv_text: Will he delight himself in the Almighty? will he always call upon God?
bsb_text: Will he delight in the Almighty? Will he call upon God at all times?
aov_text: Of sal hy hom kan verlustig in die Almagtige, God altyd kan aanroep?

kjv_text: I will teach you by the hand of God: that which is with the Almighty will I not conceal.
bsb_text: I will instruct you in the power of God. I will not conceal the ways of the Almighty.
aov_text: EK sal julle onderrig aangaande die hand van God; wat by die Almagtige is, sal ek nie verberg nie.

kjv_text: Behold, all ye yourselves have seen it; why then are ye thus altogether vain?
bsb_text: Surely all of you have seen it for yourselves. Why then do you keep up this empty talk?
aov_text: Kyk, julle het dit almal self aanskou, en waarom koester julle dan ’n ydele hoop?

kjv_text: This is the portion of a wicked man with God, and the heritage of oppressors, which they shall receive of the Almighty.
bsb_text: This is the wicked man’s portion from God—the heritage the ruthless receive from the Almighty.
aov_text: Dít is die deel van die goddelose mens by God en die erfdeel van die tiranne wat hulle van die Almagtige ontvang:

kjv_text: If his children be multiplied, it is for the sword: and his offspring shall not be satisfied with bread.
bsb_text: Though his sons are many, they are destined for the sword; and his offspring will never have enough food.
aov_text: as sy kinders baie word, is dit vir die swaard; en sy spruite word nie versadig met brood nie.

kjv_text: Those that remain of him shall be buried in death: and his widows shall not weep.
bsb_text: His survivors will be buried by the plague, and their widows will not weep for them.
aov_text: Die wat van hom oorbly, word deur die pes begrawe, en sy weduwees ween nie.

kjv_text: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare raiment as the clay;
bsb_text: Though he heaps up silver like dust and piles up a wardrobe like clay,
aov_text: As hy silwer ophoop soos stof en klere aanskaf soos modder —

kjv_text: He may prepare it, but the just shall put it on, and the innocent shall divide the silver.
bsb_text: what he lays up, the righteous will wear, and his silver will be divided by the innocent.
aov_text: hy skaf aan, maar die regverdige trek dit aan; en die onskuldige verdeel die silwer.

kjv_text: He buildeth his house as a moth, and as a booth that the keeper maketh.
bsb_text: The house he built is like a moth’s cocoon, like a hut set up by a watchman.
aov_text: Hy het sy huis gebou soos ’n mot en soos ’n skerm wat die oppasser maak.

kjv_text: The rich man shall lie down, but he shall not be gathered: he openeth his eyes, and he is not.
bsb_text: He lies down wealthy, but will do so no more; when he opens his eyes, all is gone.
aov_text: Ryk gaan hy lê, maar hy doen dit nie weer nie; hy maak sy oë oop en—is nie meer nie.

kjv_text: Terrors take hold on him as waters, a tempest stealeth him away in the night.
bsb_text: Terrors overtake him like a flood; a tempest sweeps him away in the night.
aov_text: Verskrikkinge oorval hom soos waterstrome; in die nag voer ’n stormwind hom weg.

kjv_text: The east wind carrieth him away, and he departeth: and as a storm hurleth him out of his place.
bsb_text: The east wind carries him away, and he is gone; it sweeps him out of his place.
aov_text: Die oostewind tel hom op, en daar gaan hy; en dit storm hom weg uit sy plek.

kjv_text: For God shall cast upon him, and not spare: he would fain flee out of his hand.
bsb_text: It hurls itself against him without mercy as he flees headlong from its power.
aov_text: En God werp op hom af sonder verskoning, vir sy hand moet hy haastig vlug.

kjv_text: Men shall clap their hands at him, and shall hiss him out of his place.
bsb_text: It claps its hands at him and hisses him out of his place.
aov_text: Hulle klap oor hom in hul hande en spot hom weg uit sy plek.

kjv_text: Surely there is a vein for the silver, and a place for gold where they fine it.
bsb_text: “Surely there is a mine for silver and a place where gold is refined.
aov_text: WANT vir die silwer is daar ’n plek waar dit uitkom, en ’n plek vir die goud wat hulle uitwas.

kjv_text: Iron is taken out of the earth, and brass is molten out of the stone.
bsb_text: Iron is taken from the earth, and copper is smelted from ore.
aov_text: Yster word uit die grond gehaal, en koper word uit klip gegiet.

kjv_text: He setteth an end to darkness, and searcheth out all perfection: the stones of darkness, and the shadow of death.
bsb_text: Man puts an end to the darkness; he probes the farthest recesses for ore in deepest darkness.
aov_text: ’n Einde maak die mens aan die duisternis, en tot die uiterste grens deursoek hy die klip van donkerheid en doodskaduwee.

kjv_text: The flood breaketh out from the inhabitant; even the waters forgotten of the foot: they are dried up, they are gone away from men.
bsb_text: Far from human habitation he cuts a shaft in places forgotten by the foot of man. Far from men he dangles and sways.
aov_text: Hy breek ’n mynskag, wég van hom wat bo woon; hulle wat vergeet is deur die voet daarbo, hulle hang ver van mense af, hulle swaai heen en weer.

kjv_text: As for the earth, out of it cometh bread: and under it is turned up as it were fire.
bsb_text: Food may come from the earth, but from below it is transformed as by fire.
aov_text: Die aarde—daar kom brood uit voort, maar daaronder word dit omgewoel soos deur vuur.

kjv_text: The stones of it are the place of sapphires: and it hath dust of gold.
bsb_text: Its rocks are the source of sapphires, containing flecks of gold.
aov_text: Die klippe daarvan is die plek van saffiere, en dit bevat stoffies van goud.

kjv_text: There is a path which no fowl knoweth, and which the vulture's eye hath not seen:
bsb_text: No bird of prey knows that path; no falcon’s eye has seen it.
aov_text: ’n Pad wat die roofvoël nie ken nie, en die oog van die valk het dit nie gespeur nie;

kjv_text: The lion's whelps have not trodden it, nor the fierce lion passed by it.
bsb_text: Proud beasts have never trodden it; no lion has ever prowled over it.
aov_text: waar die trotse roofdiere nie op trap nie, waar die leeu nie oor stap nie.

kjv_text: He putteth forth his hand upon the rock; he overturneth the mountains by the roots.
bsb_text: The miner strikes the flint; he overturns mountains at their base.
aov_text: Hy slaan sy hand aan die klipharde rots, hy woel die berge van die wortel af om.

kjv_text: He cutteth out rivers among the rocks; and his eye seeth every precious thing.
bsb_text: He hews out channels in the rocks, and his eyes spot every treasure.
aov_text: In die rotse breek hy gange uit, en sy oog sien allerhande kosbare dinge.

kjv_text: He bindeth the floods from overflowing; and the thing that is hid bringeth he forth to light.
bsb_text: He stops up the sources of the streams to bring what is hidden to light.
aov_text: Hy stop waterare toe, dat hulle nie drup nie; en wat verborge was, bring hy aan die lig.

kjv_text: But where shall wisdom be found? and where is the place of understanding?
bsb_text: But where can wisdom be found, and where does understanding dwell?
aov_text: MAAR die wysheid—waar word dit gevind? En waar is die plek van verstand?

kjv_text: Man knoweth not the price thereof; neither is it found in the land of the living.
bsb_text: No man can know its value, nor is it found in the land of the living.
aov_text: Die mens ken nie die waarde daarvan nie, en dit word in die land van die lewende nie gevind nie.

kjv_text: The depth saith, It is not in me: and the sea saith, It is not with me.
bsb_text: The ocean depths say, ‘It is not in me,’ while the sea declares, ‘It is not with me.’
aov_text: Die wêreldvloed sê: In my is dit nie; en die see sê: By my is dit nie.

kjv_text: It cannot be gotten for gold, neither shall silver be weighed for the price thereof.
bsb_text: It cannot be bought with gold, nor can its price be weighed out in silver.
aov_text: Fyn goud kan daarvoor nie gegee word nie, en geen silwer as koopprys daarvan afgeweeg word nie.

kjv_text: It cannot be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.
bsb_text: It cannot be valued in the gold of Ophir, in precious onyx or sapphire.
aov_text: Die goud van Ofir weeg daar nie teen op nie, ook nie die kosbare onikssteen en saffier nie.

kjv_text: The gold and the crystal cannot equal it: and the exchange of it shall not be for jewels of fine gold.
bsb_text: Neither gold nor crystal can compare to it, nor jewels of fine gold be exchanged for it.
aov_text: Goud en glas kan daarmee nie vergelyk word nie, en vir goue voorwerpe ruil ’n mens dit nie.

kjv_text: No mention shall be made of coral, or of pearls: for the price of wisdom is above rubies.
bsb_text: Coral and quartz are unworthy of mention; the price of wisdom is beyond rubies.
aov_text: Korale en kristal kan nie genoem word nie, en die besit van wysheid is meer werd as korale.

kjv_text: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, neither shall it be valued with pure gold.
bsb_text: Topaz from Cush cannot compare to it, nor can it be valued in pure gold.
aov_text: Die topaas van Kus kan daarmee nie vergelyk word nie, suiwer goud word daarteen nie opgeweeg nie.

kjv_text: Whence then cometh wisdom? and where is the place of understanding?
bsb_text: From where then does wisdom come, and where does understanding dwell?
aov_text: DIE wysheid dan—waar kom dit vandaan? En waar is die plek van die verstand?

kjv_text: Seeing it is hid from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the fowls of the air.
bsb_text: It is hidden from the eyes of every living thing and concealed from the birds of the air.
aov_text: Ja, dit is verborge vir die oë van alles wat leef, en weggesteek vir die voëls van die hemel.

kjv_text: Destruction and death say, We have heard the fame thereof with our ears.
bsb_text: Abaddon and Death say, ‘We have heard a rumor about it.’
aov_text: Die plek van vertering en die dood sê: Met ons ore het ons die gerug daarvan gehoor.

kjv_text: God understandeth the way thereof, and he knoweth the place thereof.
bsb_text: But God understands its way, and He knows its place.
aov_text: God weet die weg daarheen, en Hý ken die woonplek daarvan.

kjv_text: For he looketh to the ends of the earth, and seeth under the whole heaven;
bsb_text: For He looks to the ends of the earth and sees everything under the heavens.
aov_text: Want Hý sien tot by die eindes van die aarde; alles wat onder die hemel is, aanskou Hy.

kjv_text: To make the weight for the winds; and he weigheth the waters by measure.
bsb_text: When God fixed the weight of the wind and measured out the waters,
aov_text: Toe Hy vir die wind die gewig bepaal en die waters met die maat afgemeet het,

kjv_text: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder:
bsb_text: when He set a limit for the rain and a path for the thunderbolt,
aov_text: toe Hy vir die reën ’n wet gestel het en ’n weg vir die onweerstraal,

kjv_text: Then did he see it, and declare it; he prepared it, yea, and searched it out.
bsb_text: then He looked at wisdom and appraised it; He established it and searched it out.
aov_text: toe het Hy die wysheid gesien en dit verkondig; Hy het dit opgestel en dit ook deurvors.

kjv_text: And unto man he said, Behold, the fear of the LORD, that is wisdom; and to depart from evil is understanding.
bsb_text: And He said to man, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom, and to turn away from evil is understanding.’”
aov_text: Maar aan die mens het Hy gesê: Kyk, die vrees van die Here is wysheid; en om van die kwaad af te wyk, is verstand.

kjv_text: Moreover Job continued his parable, and said,
bsb_text: And Job continued his discourse:
aov_text: EN Job het verder sy spreuk aangehef en gesê:

kjv_text: Oh that I were as in months past, as in the days when God preserved me;
bsb_text: “How I long for the months gone by, for the days when God watched over me,
aov_text: Ag, was ek maar soos in die vorige maande, soos in die dae toe God my bewaar het;

kjv_text: When his candle shined upon my head, and when by his light I walked through darkness;
bsb_text: when His lamp shone above my head, and by His light I walked through the darkness,
aov_text: toe sy lamp bo my hoof geskyn het, ek by sy lig die duisternis deurwandel het;

kjv_text: As I was in the days of my youth, when the secret of God was upon my tabernacle;
bsb_text: when I was in my prime, when the friendship of God rested on my tent,
aov_text: soos ek was in my herfsdae toe die verborgenheid van God oor my tent was;

kjv_text: When the Almighty was yet with me, when my children were about me;
bsb_text: when the Almighty was still with me and my children were around me,
aov_text: toe die Almagtige nog by my was, my kinders rondom my;

kjv_text: When I washed my steps with butter, and the rock poured me out rivers of oil;
bsb_text: when my steps were bathed in cream and the rock poured out for me streams of oil!
aov_text: toe my voetstappe gewas is in dikmelk en die rots by my strome van olie uitgegiet het.

kjv_text: When I went out to the gate through the city, when I prepared my seat in the street!
bsb_text: When I went out to the city gate and took my seat in the public square,
aov_text: Toe ek uitgegaan het na die poort, op na die stad toe, op die markplein my sitplek reggemaak het,

kjv_text: The young men saw me, and hid themselves: and the aged arose, and stood up.
bsb_text: the young men saw me and withdrew, and the old men rose to their feet.
aov_text: het die seuns weggekruip as hulle my sien, en grysaards het hulle opgerig en bly staan.

kjv_text: The princes refrained talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.
bsb_text: The princes refrained from speaking and covered their mouths with their hands.
aov_text: Vorste het hulle woorde ingehou en die hand op hul mond gelê.

kjv_text: The nobles held their peace, and their tongue cleaved to the roof of their mouth.
bsb_text: The voices of the nobles were hushed, and their tongues stuck to the roofs of their mouths.
aov_text: Die stem van edeles is teruggehou, en hulle tong het gekleef aan hul verhemelte.

kjv_text: When the ear heard me, then it blessed me; and when the eye saw me, it gave witness to me:
bsb_text: For those who heard me called me blessed, and those who saw me commended me,
aov_text: Want het ’n oor net gehoor, dan prys dit my gelukkig; en het ’n oog net gesien, dan gee dit vir my getuienis.

kjv_text: Because I delivered the poor that cried, and the fatherless, and him that had none to help him.
bsb_text: because I rescued the poor who cried out and the fatherless who had no helper.
aov_text: Want ek het die ellendige gered wat om hulp geroep het, en die wees en hom wat geen helper het nie.

kjv_text: The blessing of him that was ready to perish came upon me: and I caused the widow's heart to sing for joy.
bsb_text: The dying man blessed me, and I made the widow’s heart sing for joy.
aov_text: Die seën van hom wat klaar was om onder te gaan, het op my gekom; en die hart van die weduwee het ek laat jubel.

kjv_text: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me: my judgment was as a robe and a diadem.
bsb_text: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me; justice was my robe and my turban.
aov_text: Die geregtigheid was my kleed, en ek sy kleed; my reg was soos ’n mantel en ’n tulband.

kjv_text: I was eyes to the blind, and feet was I to the lame.
bsb_text: I served as eyes to the blind and as feet to the lame.
aov_text: Oë was ek vir die blinde, en voete vir die lamme was ek.

kjv_text: I was a father to the poor: and the cause which I knew not I searched out.
bsb_text: I was a father to the needy, and I took up the case of the stranger.
aov_text: ’n Vader was ek vir die behoeftiges; en die regsaak van hom wat ek nie geken het nie, het ek ondersoek.

kjv_text: And I brake the jaws of the wicked, and plucked the spoil out of his teeth.
bsb_text: I shattered the fangs of the unjust and snatched the prey from his teeth.
aov_text: En ek het die tande van die kwaaddoener stukkend gebreek en die buit uit sy gebit geslinger.

kjv_text: Then I said, I shall die in my nest, and I shall multiply my days as the sand.
bsb_text: So I thought: ‘I will die in my nest and multiply my days as the sand.
aov_text: So het ek dan gedink: By my nes sal ek die asem uitblaas, en soos die feniks my dae vermenigvuldig.

kjv_text: My root was spread out by the waters, and the dew lay all night upon my branch.
bsb_text: My roots will spread out to the waters, and the dew will rest nightly on my branches.
aov_text: My wortel staan oop na die water toe, en dou vernag op my tak.

kjv_text: My glory was fresh in me, and my bow was renewed in my hand.
bsb_text: My glory is ever new within me, and my bow is renewed in my hand.’
aov_text: My eer is altyd nuut by my, en my boog bly jonk in my hand.

kjv_text: Unto me men gave ear, and waited, and kept silence at my counsel.
bsb_text: Men listened to me with expectation, waiting silently for my counsel.
aov_text: NA my het hulle geluister vol verwagting, en hulle het stil my raad aangehoor.

kjv_text: After my words they spake not again; and my speech dropped upon them.
bsb_text: After my words, they spoke no more; my speech settled on them like dew.
aov_text: Ná my woorde het hulle nie weer gespreek nie, en my rede het op hulle gedrup.

kjv_text: And they waited for me as for the rain; and they opened their mouth wide as for the latter rain.
bsb_text: They waited for me as for rain and drank in my words like spring showers.
aov_text: En hulle het op my gewag soos op reën, en hulle mond wyd oopgemaak soos vir lentereëns.

kjv_text: If I laughed on them, they believed it not; and the light of my countenance they cast not down.
bsb_text: If I smiled at them, they did not believe it; the light of my countenance was precious.
aov_text: Ek het hulle toegelag as hulle moedeloos was, en hulle kon die lig van my gesig nie verdonker nie.

kjv_text: I chose out their way, and sat chief, and dwelt as a king in the army, as one that comforteth the mourners.
bsb_text: I chose their course and presided as chief. So I dwelt as a king among his troops, as a comforter of the mourners.
aov_text: Het ek die weg na hulle toe gekies, dan sit ek as voorman en woon soos ’n koning onder die skare, soos een wat treuriges vertroos.

kjv_text: But now they that are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I would have disdained to have set with the dogs of my flock.
bsb_text: “But now they mock me, men younger than I am, whose fathers I would have refused to entrust with my sheep dogs.
aov_text: EN nóu lag hulle wat jonger is as ek, my uit—mense wie se vaders ek te min geag het om by my herdershonde te sit.

kjv_text: Yea, whereto might the strength of their hands profit me, in whom old age was perished?
bsb_text: What use to me was the strength of their hands, since their vigor had left them?
aov_text: Wat sou die krag van hulle hande my ook baat? Die frisse lewenskrag het by hulle verlore gegaan.

kjv_text: For want and famine they were solitary; fleeing into the wilderness in former time desolate and waste.
bsb_text: Gaunt from poverty and hunger, they gnawed the dry land, and the desolate wasteland by night.
aov_text: Hulle is uitgeput deur gebrek en honger, hulle wat die dor land afknaag in die donkerheid van woestheid en verwoesting;

kjv_text: Who cut up mallows by the bushes, and juniper roots for their meat.
bsb_text: They plucked mallow among the shrubs, and the roots of the broom tree were their food.
aov_text: hulle wat die soutkruid afpluk by die bossies, en die besemboswortel is hulle brood.

kjv_text: They were driven forth from among men, (they cried after them as after a thief;)
bsb_text: They were banished from among men, shouted down like thieves,
aov_text: Uit die samelewing word hulle weggejaag; die mense skreeu oor hulle soos oor ’n dief.

kjv_text: To dwell in the cliffs of the valleys, in caves of the earth, and in the rocks.
bsb_text: so that they lived on the slopes of the wadis, among the rocks and in holes in the ground.
aov_text: In die afgryslike klowe moet hulle woon, in gate in die grond en in rotse.

kjv_text: Among the bushes they brayed; under the nettles they were gathered together.
bsb_text: They cried out among the shrubs and huddled beneath the nettles.
aov_text: Tussen die bossies skreeu hulle, onder brandnekels kruip hulle bymekaar —

kjv_text: They were children of fools, yea, children of base men: they were viler than the earth.
bsb_text: A senseless and nameless brood, they were driven off the land.
aov_text: dwase, ja, eerlose mense wat met ’n sweep uit die land geslaan word.

kjv_text: And now am I their song, yea, I am their byword.
bsb_text: And now they mock me in song; I have become a byword among them.
aov_text: En nou het ek hulle spotlied geword en die onderwerp van hulle gepraat.

kjv_text: They abhor me, they flee far from me, and spare not to spit in my face.
bsb_text: They abhor me and keep far from me; they do not hesitate to spit in my face.
aov_text: Hulle het ’n afsku van my, staan op ’n afstand van my af en ontsien nie om my in die gesig te spuug nie.

kjv_text: Because he hath loosed my cord, and afflicted me, they have also let loose the bridle before me.
bsb_text: Because God has unstrung my bow and afflicted me, they have cast off restraint in my presence.
aov_text: Want Hy het my boogsnaar losgemaak en my verneder; so het hulle dan teenoor my die teuel laat skiet.

kjv_text: Upon my right hand rise the youth; they push away my feet, and they raise up against me the ways of their destruction.
bsb_text: The rabble arises at my right; they lay snares for my feet and build siege ramps against me.
aov_text: Aan die regterhand staan die gespuis op; hulle stoot my voete weg en gooi hul onheilspaaie teen my op.

kjv_text: They mar my path, they set forward my calamity, they have no helper.
bsb_text: They tear up my path; they profit from my destruction, with no one to restrain them.
aov_text: My pad verniel hulle, hulle help om my te laat val sonder dat hulle self ’n helper het.

kjv_text: They came upon me as a wide breaking in of waters: in the desolation they rolled themselves upon me.
bsb_text: They advance as through a wide breach; through the ruins they keep rolling in.
aov_text: Soos deur ’n wye bres kom hulle; te midde van die puinhope kom hulle aanrol.

kjv_text: Terrors are turned upon me: they pursue my soul as the wind: and my welfare passeth away as a cloud.
bsb_text: Terrors are turned loose against me; they drive away my dignity as by the wind, and my prosperity has passed like a cloud.
aov_text: Verskrikkinge is teen my gerig; hulle vervolg my hoogheid soos die wind, en soos ’n wolk het my geluk verbygegaan.

kjv_text: And now my soul is poured out upon me; the days of affliction have taken hold upon me.
bsb_text: And now my soul is poured out within me; days of affliction grip me.
aov_text: Daarom stort my siel hom nou uit in my; dae van ellende hou my vas.

kjv_text: My bones are pierced in me in the night season: and my sinews take no rest.
bsb_text: Night pierces my bones, and my gnawing pains never rest.
aov_text: Die nag deurboor my gebeente, en dit val van my af; en my knaende pyne rus nooit nie.

kjv_text: By the great force of my disease is my garment changed: it bindeth me about as the collar of my coat.
bsb_text: With great force He grasps my garment; He seizes me by the collar of my tunic.
aov_text: Deur goddelike oormag is my kleed ontredder; soos die kraag van my lyfrok omspan dit my.

kjv_text: He hath cast me into the mire, and I am become like dust and ashes.
bsb_text: He throws me into the mud, and I have become like dust and ashes.
aov_text: Hy het my in die modder gewerp, en ek het soos stof en as geword.

kjv_text: I cry unto thee, and thou dost not hear me: I stand up, and thou regardest me not.
bsb_text: I cry out to You for help, but You do not answer; when I stand up, You merely look at me.
aov_text: Ek roep U aan om hulp, maar U antwoord my nie; ek staan daar, en U staar my aan.

kjv_text: Thou art become cruel to me: with thy strong hand thou opposest thyself against me.
bsb_text: You have ruthlessly turned on me; You oppose me with Your strong hand.
aov_text: U is jeens my verander in ’n onbarmhartige; deur die sterkte van u hand behandel U my as vyand.

kjv_text: Thou liftest me up to the wind; thou causest me to ride upon it, and dissolvest my substance.
bsb_text: You snatch me up into the wind and drive me before it; You toss me about in the storm.
aov_text: U hef my op die wind, laat my daarop ry; en U laat my vergaan in stormgedruis.

kjv_text: For I know that thou wilt bring me to death, and to the house appointed for all living.
bsb_text: Yes, I know that You will bring me down to death, to the place appointed for all the living.
aov_text: Want ek weet: U wil my na die dood toe bring en na die huis waar al wat lewe, saamkom.

kjv_text: Howbeit he will not stretch out his hand to the grave, though they cry in his destruction.
bsb_text: Yet no one stretches out his hand to a ruined man when he cries for help in his distress.
aov_text: Maar sal iemand by die ineenstorting nie nog die hand uitsteek of by sy ondergang om dié rede om hulp roep nie?

kjv_text: Did not I weep for him that was in trouble? was not my soul grieved for the poor?
bsb_text: Have I not wept for those in trouble? Has my soul not grieved for the needy?
aov_text: Of het ek nie geween oor hom wat harde dae het nie? Was my siel nie bekommerd oor die behoeftige nie?

kjv_text: When I looked for good, then evil came unto me: and when I waited for light, there came darkness.
bsb_text: But when I hoped for good, evil came; when I looked for light, darkness fell.
aov_text: Want ek het op die goeie gehoop, en onheil het gekom; en ek het gewag op lig, en donkerheid het gekom.

kjv_text: My bowels boiled, and rested not: the days of affliction prevented me.
bsb_text: I am churning within and cannot rest; days of affliction confront me.
aov_text: My ingewande kook sonder ophou; dae van ellende het my teëgekom.

kjv_text: I went mourning without the sun: I stood up, and I cried in the congregation.
bsb_text: I go about blackened, but not by the sun. I stand up in the assembly and cry for help.
aov_text: Ek gaan daarheen in die rou, sonder son; ek staan op in die vergadering, ek roep om hulp.

kjv_text: I am a brother to dragons, and a companion to owls.
bsb_text: I have become a brother of jackals, a companion of ostriches.
aov_text: Ek het ’n broer geword vir die jakkalse en ’n vriend vir die volstruise.

kjv_text: My skin is black upon me, and my bones are burned with heat.
bsb_text: My skin grows black and peels, and my bones burn with fever.
aov_text: My vel het swart geword en val van my af, en my gebeente gloei van hitte.

kjv_text: My harp also is turned to mourning, and my organ into the voice of them that weep.
bsb_text: My harp is tuned to mourning and my flute to the sound of weeping.
aov_text: So het dan my siter ’n rouklag geword en my fluit ’n stem van die wat ween.

kjv_text: I made a covenant with mine eyes; why then should I think upon a maid?
bsb_text: “I have made a covenant with my eyes. How then could I gaze with desire at a virgin?
aov_text: EK het ’n verbond gesluit met my oë: hoe sou ek dan ag gegee het op ’n jonkvrou?

kjv_text: For what portion of God is there from above? and what inheritance of the Almighty from on high?
bsb_text: For what is the allotment of God from above, or the heritage from the Almighty on high?
aov_text: Wat tog is die lot wat God daarbo beskik, en die erfdeel van die Almagtige uit die hoogtes —

kjv_text: Is not destruction to the wicked? and a strange punishment to the workers of iniquity?
bsb_text: Does not disaster come to the unjust and calamity to the workers of iniquity?
aov_text: is dit nie ondergang vir die kwaaddoener en ongeluk vir die werkers van ongeregtigheid nie?

kjv_text: Doth not he see my ways, and count all my steps?
bsb_text: Does He not see my ways and count my every step?
aov_text: Sien Hý nie my weë nie, en tel Hy nie al my voetstappe nie?

kjv_text: If I have walked with vanity, or if my foot hath hasted to deceit;
bsb_text: If I have walked in falsehood or my foot has rushed to deceit,
aov_text: As ek met leuens omgegaan het en my voet gehardloop het na bedrog:

kjv_text: Let me be weighed in an even balance that God may know mine integrity.
bsb_text: let God weigh me with honest scales, that He may know my integrity.
aov_text: laat Hy my dan weeg op ’n regte weegskaal, sodat God my onskuld kan weet!

kjv_text: If my step hath turned out of the way, and mine heart walked after mine eyes, and if any blot hath cleaved to mine hands;
bsb_text: If my steps have turned from the path, if my heart has followed my eyes, or if impurity has stuck to my hands,
aov_text: As my gang afgewyk het van die weg en my hart agter my oë aangegaan het en aan my hande ’n vlek gekleef het —

kjv_text: Then let me sow, and let another eat; yea, let my offspring be rooted out.
bsb_text: then may another eat what I have sown, and may my crops be uprooted.
aov_text: laat my dan saai en iemand anders eet, en laat my uitspruitsels ontwortel word.

kjv_text: If mine heart have been deceived by a woman, or if I have laid wait at my neighbour's door;
bsb_text: If my heart has been enticed by my neighbor’s wife, or I have lurked at his door,
aov_text: As my hart verlok was oor ’n vrou, en ek geloer het by die deur van my naaste —

kjv_text: Then let my wife grind unto another, and let others bow down upon her.
bsb_text: then may my own wife grind grain for another, and may other men sleep with her.
aov_text: laat dan my vrou vir iemand anders maal en ander hulle oor haar buig.

kjv_text: For this is an heinous crime; yea, it is an iniquity to be punished by the judges.
bsb_text: For that would be a heinous crime, an iniquity to be judged.
aov_text: Want dit is ’n skandelike daad, en dit is ’n strafbare misdaad.

kjv_text: For it is a fire that consumeth to destruction, and would root out all mine increase.
bsb_text: For it is a fire that burns down to Abaddon; it would root out my entire harvest.
aov_text: Ja, dit is ’n vuur wat tot by die plek van vertering toe vreet en al my opbrings sou ontwortel.

kjv_text: If I did despise the cause of my manservant or of my maidservant, when they contended with me;
bsb_text: If I have rejected the cause of my manservant or maidservant when they made a complaint against me,
aov_text: As ek gering geag het die reg van my slaaf of van my slavin toe hulle ’n geskil met my gehad het —

kjv_text: What then shall I do when God riseth up? and when he visiteth, what shall I answer him?
bsb_text: what will I do when God rises to judge? How will I answer when called to account?
aov_text: wat sou ek dan doen as God opstaan? En wat Hom antwoord as Hy ondersoek doen?

kjv_text: Did not he that made me in the womb make him? and did not one fashion us in the womb?
bsb_text: Did not He who made me in the womb also make them? Did not the same One form us in the womb?
aov_text: Het Hy wat my in die moederskoot gemaak het, hom nie gemaak nie? En het Een ons nie in die geboorte toeberei nie?

kjv_text: If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail;
bsb_text: If I have denied the desires of the poor or allowed the widow’s eyes to fail,
aov_text: As ek die armes ’n versoek geweier het en die oë van die weduwee laat versmag het

kjv_text: Or have eaten my morsel myself alone, and the fatherless hath not eaten thereof;
bsb_text: if I have eaten my morsel alone, not sharing it with the fatherless—
aov_text: en my stukkie brood alleen geëet het sonder om die wees daarvan te laat saameet;

kjv_text: (For from my youth he was brought up with me, as with a father, and I have guided her from my mother's womb;)
bsb_text: though from my youth I reared him as would a father, and from my mother’s womb I guided the widow—
aov_text: (veelmeer het hy van my jeug af by my grootgeword soos by ’n vader, en van my moeder se skoot af het ek haar gelei!)

kjv_text: If I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or any poor without covering;
bsb_text: if I have seen one perish for lack of clothing, or a needy man without a cloak,
aov_text: as ek iemand sien omkom het sonder klere en dat daar geen bedekking vir die behoeftige was nie;

kjv_text: If his loins have not blessed me, and if he were not warmed with the fleece of my sheep;
bsb_text: if his heart has not blessed me for warming him with the fleece of my sheep,
aov_text: as sy lendene my nie geseën en hy hom nie warm gemaak het van die skeersel van my lammers nie;

kjv_text: If I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, when I saw my help in the gate:
bsb_text: if I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless because I saw that I had support in the gate,
aov_text: as ek my hand teen ’n wees beweeg het, omdat ek in die poort vir my hulp gesien het —

kjv_text: Then let mine arm fall from my shoulder blade, and mine arm be broken from the bone.
bsb_text: then may my arm fall from my shoulder and be torn from its socket.
aov_text: laat dan my skouer uit sy gewrig val en my arm van sy pyp afgebreek word.

kjv_text: For destruction from God was a terror to me, and by reason of his highness I could not endure.
bsb_text: For calamity from God terrifies me, and His splendor I cannot overpower.
aov_text: Want die ondergang wat God bewerk, was ’n skrik vir my; en weens sy hoogheid was ek onmagtig.

kjv_text: If I have made gold my hope, or have said to the fine gold, Thou art my confidence;
bsb_text: If I have put my trust in gold or called pure gold my security,
aov_text: As ek op goud my hoop gestel het en vir die fyn goud gesê het: My vertroue!

kjv_text: If I rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because mine hand had gotten much;
bsb_text: if I have rejoiced in my great wealth because my hand had gained so much,
aov_text: As ek bly gewees het, omdat my vermoë groot was en my hand baie verwerf het;

kjv_text: If I beheld the sun when it shined, or the moon walking in brightness;
bsb_text: if I have beheld the sun in its radiance or the moon moving in splendor,
aov_text: as ek die sonlig aangesien het wanneer dit helder skyn en die maan wat so pragtig daarheen gaan,

kjv_text: And my heart hath been secretly enticed, or my mouth hath kissed my hand:
bsb_text: so that my heart was secretly enticed and my hand threw a kiss from my mouth,
aov_text: en my hart heimlik verlei is, en ek met my hand hulle ’n kus toegewerp het —

kjv_text: This also were an iniquity to be punished by the judge: for I should have denied the God that is above.
bsb_text: this would also be an iniquity to be judged, for I would have denied God on high.
aov_text: ook dit sou ’n strafbare misdaad wees, want ek sou God daarbo verloën het.

kjv_text: If I rejoiced at the destruction of him that hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him:
bsb_text: If I have rejoiced in my enemy’s ruin, or exulted when evil befell him—
aov_text: As ek bly was oor die ongeluk van my hater en uitgejubel het toe onheil hom getref het;

kjv_text: Neither have I suffered my mouth to sin by wishing a curse to his soul.
bsb_text: I have not allowed my mouth to sin by asking for his life with a curse—
aov_text: (ja, ek het my verhemelte nie toegelaat om te sondig nie, om deur ’n vloek sy lewe te vorder nie!)

kjv_text: If the men of my tabernacle said not, Oh that we had of his flesh! we cannot be satisfied.
bsb_text: if the men of my house have not said, ‘Who is there who has not had his fill?’—
aov_text: as die mense in my tent nie gesê het: Wie kan iemand vind wat van sy vleesspys nie versadig is nie?

kjv_text: The stranger did not lodge in the street: but I opened my doors to the traveller.
bsb_text: but no stranger had to lodge on the street, for my door has been open to the traveler—
aov_text: (die vreemdeling het nie buitekant vernag nie; my deure het ek oopgemaak na die pad toe!)

kjv_text: If I covered my transgressions as Adam, by hiding mine iniquity in my bosom:
bsb_text: if I have covered my transgressions like Adam by hiding my guilt in my heart,
aov_text: as ek, soos Adam, my oortredinge bedek het deur my ongeregtigheid in my boesem weg te steek,

kjv_text: Did I fear a great multitude, or did the contempt of families terrify me, that I kept silence, and went not out of the door?
bsb_text: because I greatly feared the crowds and the contempt of the clans terrified me, so that I kept silent and would not go outside—
aov_text: omdat ek bang was vir die groot menigte en die veragting van die geslagte my laat skrik het, sodat ek my stil gehou, die deur nie uitgegaan het nie!

kjv_text: Oh that one would hear me! behold, my desire is, that the Almighty would answer me, and that mine adversary had written a book.
bsb_text: (Oh, that I had one to hear me! Here is my signature. Let the Almighty answer me; let my accuser compose an indictment.
aov_text: Ag, as iemand my maar wou aanhoor! Kyk hier my handtekening (laat die Almagtige my antwoord!) en die skrif wat my teëparty geskrywe het!

kjv_text: Surely I would take it upon my shoulder, and bind it as a crown to me.
bsb_text: Surely I would carry it on my shoulder and wear it like a crown.
aov_text: Waarlik, op my skouer sou ek dit dra; ek sou dit my ombind as ’n krans.

kjv_text: I would declare unto him the number of my steps; as a prince would I go near unto him.
bsb_text: I would give account of all my steps; I would approach Him like a prince.)—
aov_text: Die getal van my voetstappe sou ek Hom te kenne gee; as ’n vors sou ek na Hom toe aankom.

kjv_text: If my land cry against me, or that the furrows likewise thereof complain;
bsb_text: if my land cries out against me and its furrows weep together,
aov_text: As my saailand my aanklaag en sy vore almal saam ween;

kjv_text: If I have eaten the fruits thereof without money, or have caused the owners thereof to lose their life:
bsb_text: if I have devoured its produce without payment or broken the spirit of its tenants,
aov_text: as ek sy opbrings geëet het sonder betaling en die lewe van sy eienaars uitgeblaas het —

kjv_text: Let thistles grow instead of wheat, and cockle instead of barley. The words of Job are ended.
bsb_text: then let briers grow instead of wheat and stinkweed instead of barley.” Thus conclude the words of Job.
aov_text: laat dan distels in plaas van koring uitspruit en onkruid in plaas van gars. Hier eindig die woorde van Job.

kjv_text: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.
bsb_text: So these three men stopped answering Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.
aov_text: TOE het dié drie manne opgehou om Job te antwoord, omdat hy in sy eie oë regverdig was.

kjv_text: Then was kindled the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the kindred of Ram: against Job was his wrath kindled, because he justified himself rather than God.
bsb_text: This kindled the anger of Elihu son of Barachel the Buzite, of the family of Ram. He burned with anger against Job for justifying himself rather than God,
aov_text: En die toorn van Elíhu, die seun van Barágeël, die Busiet, uit die geslag van Ram, het ontvlam; teen Job het sy toorn ontvlam, omdat hy homself regverdig beskou het voor God.

kjv_text: Also against his three friends was his wrath kindled, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.
bsb_text: and he burned with anger against Job’s three friends because they had failed to refute Job, and yet had condemned him.
aov_text: Sy toorn het ook ontvlam teen sý drie vriende, omdat hulle geen antwoord gevind het nie en Job veroordeel het.

kjv_text: Now Elihu had waited till Job had spoken, because they were elder than he.
bsb_text: Now Elihu had waited to speak to Job because the others were older than he.
aov_text: Maar Elíhu het op Job gewag met sy woorde, omdat hulle ouer was as hy.

kjv_text: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, then his wrath was kindled.
bsb_text: But when he saw that the three men had no further reply, his anger was kindled.
aov_text: Maar toe Elíhu sien dat daar geen antwoord was in die mond van die drie manne nie, het sy toorn ontvlam.

kjv_text: And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said, I am young, and ye are very old; wherefore I was afraid, and durst not shew you mine opinion.
bsb_text: So Elihu son of Barachel the Buzite declared: “I am young in years, while you are old; that is why I was timid and afraid to tell you what I know.
aov_text: EN Elíhu, die seun van Barágeël, die Busiet, het begin en gesê: Ek is jonk, en u is hoogbejaard; daarom was ek beskroomd en het gevrees om my kennis aan u mee te deel.

kjv_text: I said, Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.
bsb_text: I thought that age should speak, and many years should teach wisdom.
aov_text: Ek het gesê: Laat die dae spreek en die veelheid van jare wysheid te kenne gee.

kjv_text: But there is a spirit in man: and the inspiration of the Almighty giveth them understanding.
bsb_text: But there is a spirit in a man, the breath of the Almighty, that gives him understanding.
aov_text: Maar dit is die Gees in die mens en die asem van die Almagtige wat hulle verstandig maak.

kjv_text: Great men are not always wise: neither do the aged understand judgment.
bsb_text: It is not only the old who are wise, or the elderly who understand justice.
aov_text: Nie die bejaardes is wys nie, en nie die oues verstaan wat reg is nie.

kjv_text: Therefore I said, Hearken to me; I also will shew mine opinion.
bsb_text: Therefore I say, ‘Listen to me; I too will declare what I know.’
aov_text: Daarom sê ek: Luister na my; ek wil ook my kennis meedeel.

kjv_text: Behold, I waited for your words; I gave ear to your reasons, whilst ye searched out what to say.
bsb_text: Indeed, I waited while you spoke; I listened to your reasoning; as you searched for words,
aov_text: Kyk, ek het gewag op u woorde; ek wou luister na verstandige taal van u, totdat u die regte woorde uitgevind het.

kjv_text: Yea, I attended unto you, and, behold, there was none of you that convinced Job, or that answered his words:
bsb_text: I paid you full attention. But no one proved Job wrong; not one of you rebutted his arguments.
aov_text: En ek het op u ag gegee; maar kyk: daar was niemand wat Job weerlê het nie, niemand van u wat sy woorde beantwoord het nie.

kjv_text: Lest ye should say, We have found out wisdom: God thrusteth him down, not man.
bsb_text: So do not claim, ‘We have found wisdom; let God, not man, refute him.’
aov_text: Sê maar net nie: Ons het wysheid aangetref, God alleen kan hom verslaan, geen mens nie.

kjv_text: Now he hath not directed his words against me: neither will I answer him with your speeches.
bsb_text: But Job has not directed his words against me, and I will not answer him with your arguments.
aov_text: Teen my tog het hy geen woorde ingebring nie; en met u redeneringe sal ek hom nie beantwoord nie.

kjv_text: They were amazed, they answered no more: they left off speaking.
bsb_text: Job’s friends are dismayed, with no more to say; words have escaped them.
aov_text: HULLE staan verslae; hulle antwoord nie meer nie; die woorde laat hulle in die steek.

kjv_text: When I had waited, (for they spake not, but stood still, and answered no more;)
bsb_text: Must I wait, now that they are silent, now that they stand and no longer reply?
aov_text: Sal ek dan wag, omdat hulle nie spreek nie, omdat hulle daar staan sonder antwoord?

kjv_text: I said, I will answer also my part, I also will shew mine opinion.
bsb_text: I too will answer; yes, I will declare what I know.
aov_text: Ek wil ook my deel antwoord; ek wil ook my kennis meedeel.

kjv_text: For I am full of matter, the spirit within me constraineth me.
bsb_text: For I am full of words, and my spirit within me compels me.
aov_text: Want ek is vol woorde; die gees in my binneste dring my.

kjv_text: Behold, my belly is as wine which hath no vent; it is ready to burst like new bottles.
bsb_text: Behold, my belly is like unvented wine; it is about to burst like a new wineskin.
aov_text: Kyk, my binneste is soos wyn wat geen opening het nie, soos nuwe leersakke wil dit bars.

kjv_text: I will speak, that I may be refreshed: I will open my lips and answer.
bsb_text: I must speak and find relief; I must open my lips and respond.
aov_text: Ek wil spreek om lug te kry, my lippe oopmaak en antwoord gee.

kjv_text: Let me not, I pray you, accept any man's person, neither let me give flattering titles unto man.
bsb_text: I will be partial to no one, nor will I flatter any man.
aov_text: Ek wil nie partydig wees nie; en ’n mens vlei, sal ek nie.

kjv_text: For I know not to give flattering titles; in so doing my maker would soon take me away.
bsb_text: For I do not know how to flatter, or my Maker would remove me in an instant.
aov_text: Want ek verstaan nie om te vlei nie; gou sou my Maker my wegneem!

kjv_text: Wherefore, Job, I pray thee, hear my speeches, and hearken to all my words.
bsb_text: “But now, O Job, hear my speech, and listen to all my words.
aov_text: MAAR hoor tog, o Job, na my rede, en luister na al my woorde.

kjv_text: Behold, now I have opened my mouth, my tongue hath spoken in my mouth.
bsb_text: Behold, I will open my mouth; my address is on the tip of my tongue.
aov_text: Kyk, ek het my mond oopgemaak; my tong spreek in my verhemelte.

kjv_text: My words shall be of the uprightness of my heart: and my lips shall utter knowledge clearly.
bsb_text: My words are from an upright heart, and my lips speak sincerely what I know.
aov_text: My woorde kom uit die opregtheid van my hart, en wat my lippe weet, spreek hulle suiwer uit.

kjv_text: The spirit of God hath made me, and the breath of the Almighty hath given me life.
bsb_text: The Spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Almighty gives me life.
aov_text: Die Gees van God het my geskape, en die asem van die Almagtige maak my lewend.

kjv_text: If thou canst answer me, set thy words in order before me, stand up.
bsb_text: Refute me if you can; prepare your case and confront me.
aov_text: As u kan, antwoord my; maak klaar teen my; staan gereed!

kjv_text: Behold, I am according to thy wish in God's stead: I also am formed out of the clay.
bsb_text: I am just like you before God; I was also formed from clay.
aov_text: Kyk, teenoor God staan ek in dieselfde verhouding as u: van klei is ek ook afgeknyp.

kjv_text: Behold, my terror shall not make thee afraid, neither shall my hand be heavy upon thee.
bsb_text: Surely no fear of me should terrify you; nor will my hand be heavy upon you.
aov_text: Kyk, vrees vir my hoef u nie te beangstig nie, en my las sal op u nie swaar wees nie.

kjv_text: Surely thou hast spoken in mine hearing, and I have heard the voice of thy words, saying,
bsb_text: Surely you have spoken in my hearing, and I have heard these very words:
aov_text: SEKERLIK, u het voor my ore gesê, en ek het die geluid van die woorde gehoor:

kjv_text: I am clean without transgression, I am innocent; neither is there iniquity in me.
bsb_text: ‘I am pure, without transgression; I am clean, with no iniquity in me.
aov_text: Rein is ek, sonder oortreding; suiwer is ek, en daar is geen skuld by my nie.

kjv_text: Behold, he findeth occasions against me, he counteth me for his enemy,
bsb_text: Yet God finds occasions against me; He counts me as His enemy.
aov_text: Kyk, Hy soek aanleidinge vir vyandskap teen my; Hy hou my vir ’n vyand van Hom.

kjv_text: He putteth my feet in the stocks, he marketh all my paths.
bsb_text: He puts my feet in the stocks; He watches over all my paths.’
aov_text: Hy sit my voete in die blok; Hy bewaak al my paaie.

kjv_text: Behold, in this thou art not just: I will answer thee, that God is greater than man.
bsb_text: Behold, you are not right in this matter. I will answer you, for God is greater than man.
aov_text: Kyk, daarin het u nie reg nie (antwoord ek u), want groter is God as ’n mens.

kjv_text: Why dost thou strive against him? for he giveth not account of any of his matters.
bsb_text: Why do you complain to Him that He answers nothing a man asks?
aov_text: Waarom het u teen Hom getwis, dat Hy op al die woorde van ’n mens nie antwoord nie?

kjv_text: For God speaketh once, yea twice, yet man perceiveth it not.
bsb_text: For God speaks in one way and in another, yet no one notices.
aov_text: WANT God spreek op een, ja, op twee maniere; maar die mens let daar nie op nie.

kjv_text: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falleth upon men, in slumberings upon the bed;
bsb_text: In a dream, in a vision in the night, when deep sleep falls upon men as they slumber on their beds,
aov_text: In die droom, in ’n naggesig, as diepe slaap op die mense val, tydens sluimeringe op die bed,

kjv_text: Then he openeth the ears of men, and sealeth their instruction,
bsb_text: He opens their ears and terrifies them with warnings
aov_text: dan open Hy die oor van die mense, en Hy druk die seël op die waarskuwing aan hulle;

kjv_text: That he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.
bsb_text: to turn a man from wrongdoing and keep him from pride,
aov_text: om die mens terug te hou van sy onderneming en trotsheid vir die man te verberg;

kjv_text: He keepeth back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.
bsb_text: to preserve his soul from the Pit and his life from perishing by the sword.
aov_text: sodat Hy sy siel kan red uit die kuil; en sy lewe, dat dit nie omkom deur die spies nie.

kjv_text: He is chastened also with pain upon his bed, and the multitude of his bones with strong pain:
bsb_text: A man is also chastened on his bed with pain and constant distress in his bones,
aov_text: OOK word hy getugtig met smart op sy bed en aanhoudende stryd in sy gebeente,

kjv_text: So that his life abhorreth bread, and his soul dainty meat.
bsb_text: so that he detests his bread, and his soul loathes his favorite food.
aov_text: sodat sy lewe hom laat walg van brood en sy siel van lieflingspys.

kjv_text: His flesh is consumed away, that it cannot be seen; and his bones that were not seen stick out.
bsb_text: His flesh wastes away from sight, and his hidden bones protrude.
aov_text: Sy vlees verdwyn, weg uit die gesig; en sy gebeente, wat onsigbaar was, steek uit.

kjv_text: Yea, his soul draweth near unto the grave, and his life to the destroyers.
bsb_text: He draws near to the Pit, and his life to the messengers of death.
aov_text: Ja, sy siel kom nader by die kuil en sy lewe by die dodende magte.

kjv_text: If there be a messenger with him, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to shew unto man his uprightness:
bsb_text: Yet if there is a messenger on his side, one mediator in a thousand, to tell a man what is right for him,
aov_text: Is daar dan vir hom ’n gesant, ’n tolk, een uit duisend, om die mens sy plig te kenne te gee;

kjv_text: Then he is gracious unto him, and saith, Deliver him from going down to the pit: I have found a ransom.
bsb_text: to be gracious to him and say, ‘Spare him from going down to the Pit; I have found his ransom,’
aov_text: en is Hy hom genadig en sê: Verlos hom, dat hy in die kuil nie afdaal nie: Ek het ’n losprys gevind —

kjv_text: His flesh shall be fresher than a child's: he shall return to the days of his youth:
bsb_text: then his flesh is refreshed like a child’s; he returns to the days of his youth.
aov_text: dan word sy vlees fris van jeugdige krag, hy keer terug na die dae van sy jonkheid.

kjv_text: He shall pray unto God, and he will be favourable unto him: and he shall see his face with joy: for he will render unto man his righteousness.
bsb_text: He prays to God and finds favor; he sees God’s face and shouts for joy, and God restores His righteousness to that man.
aov_text: Hy bid tot God, en Hy het ’n welbehae in hom, sodat hy sy aangesig sien met gejuig: so vergeld Hy dan aan die mens sy geregtigheid.

kjv_text: He looketh upon men, and if any say, I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it profited me not;
bsb_text: Then he sings before men with these words: ‘I have sinned and perverted what was right; yet I did not get what I deserved.
aov_text: Hy sing voor die mense en sê: Ek het gesondig en verdraai wat reg is, maar dit is my nie na verdienste vergeld nie.

kjv_text: He will deliver his soul from going into the pit, and his life shall see the light.
bsb_text: He redeemed my soul from going down to the Pit, and I will live to see the light.’
aov_text: Hy het my siel verlos, dat dit nie in die kuil ingegaan het nie, en my lewe mag hom verlustig in die lig.

kjv_text: Lo, all these things worketh God oftentimes with man,
bsb_text: Behold, all these things God does to a man, two or even three times,
aov_text: Kyk, dit alles doen God, twee keer, ja, drie keer met ’n mens

kjv_text: To bring back his soul from the pit, to be enlightened with the light of the living.
bsb_text: to bring back his soul from the Pit, that he may be enlightened with the light of life.
aov_text: om sy siel terug te bring van die kuil, sodat hy bestraal word met die lig van die lewe.

kjv_text: Mark well, O Job, hearken unto me: hold thy peace, and I will speak.
bsb_text: Pay attention, Job, and listen to me; be silent, and I will speak.
aov_text: Let op, o Job! Luister na my; swyg, en ék sal spreek.

kjv_text: If thou hast anything to say, answer me: speak, for I desire to justify thee.
bsb_text: But if you have something to say, answer me; speak up, for I would like to vindicate you.
aov_text: As u woorde het, antwoord my; spreek, want ek wil u graag gelyk gee.

kjv_text: If not, hearken unto me: hold thy peace, and I shall teach thee wisdom.
bsb_text: But if not, then listen to me; be quiet, and I will teach you wisdom.”
aov_text: So nie, luister ú dan na my; swyg, en ek sal u wysheid leer.

kjv_text: Furthermore Elihu answered and said,
bsb_text: Then Elihu continued:
aov_text: VERDER het Elíhu aangehef en gesê:

kjv_text: Hear my words, O ye wise men; and give ear unto me, ye that have knowledge.
bsb_text: “Hear my words, O wise men; give ear to me, O men of learning.
aov_text: Hoor my woorde, o wyse manne! En luister na my, u wat kennis het!

kjv_text: For the ear trieth words, as the mouth tasteth meat.
bsb_text: For the ear tests words as the mouth tastes food.
aov_text: Want die oor toets woorde soos die verhemelte die spys proe.

kjv_text: Let us choose to us judgment: let us know among ourselves what is good.
