bsb_text: Let us choose for ourselves what is right; let us learn together what is good.
aov_text: Laat ons vir onsself uitmaak wat reg is, en onder mekaar uitvind wat goed is.

kjv_text: For Job hath said, I am righteous: and God hath taken away my judgment.
bsb_text: For Job has declared, ‘I am righteous, yet God has deprived me of justice.
aov_text: Want Job het gesê: Ek is regverdig, en God het my my reg ontneem.

kjv_text: Should I lie against my right? my wound is incurable without transgression.
bsb_text: Would I lie about my case? My wound is incurable, though I am without transgression.’
aov_text: Ondanks my reg staan ek as leuenaar; ongeneeslik is my pylwond, en dit sonder oortreding!

kjv_text: What man is like Job, who drinketh up scorning like water?
bsb_text: What man is like Job, who drinks up derision like water?
aov_text: Waar is ’n man soos Job wat godslastering drink soos water?

kjv_text: Which goeth in company with the workers of iniquity, and walketh with wicked men.
bsb_text: He keeps company with evildoers and walks with wicked men.
aov_text: Wat in die geselskap loop van die werkers van ongeregtigheid en wandel saam met goddelose mense?

kjv_text: For he hath said, It profiteth a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.
bsb_text: For he has said, ‘It profits a man nothing that he should delight in God.’
aov_text: Want hy het gesê: Dit baat ’n man niks dat hy ’n welgevalle aan God het nie.

kjv_text: Therefore hearken unto me ye men of understanding: far be it from God, that he should do wickedness; and from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.
bsb_text: Therefore listen to me, O men of understanding. Far be it from God to do wrong, and from the Almighty to act unjustly.
aov_text: DAAROM, manne van verstand, luister na my: Ver is God van goddeloosheid en die Almagtige van onreg!

kjv_text: For the work of a man shall he render unto him, and cause every man to find according to his ways.
bsb_text: For according to a man’s deeds He repays him; according to a man’s ways He brings consequences.
aov_text: Veelmeer vergeld Hy die mens na sy werk, en volgens ’n man se wandel laat Hy hom ondervind.

kjv_text: Yea, surely God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert judgment.
bsb_text: Indeed, it is true that God does not act wickedly, and the Almighty does not pervert justice.
aov_text: Ja waarlik, God handel nie onregverdig nie, en die Almagtige verdraai nie die reg nie.

kjv_text: Who hath given him a charge over the earth? or who hath disposed the whole world?
bsb_text: Who gave Him charge over the earth? Who appointed Him over the whole world?
aov_text: Wie het aan Hom die aarde toevertrou, en wie het die hele wêreld gegrond?

kjv_text: If he set his heart upon man, if he gather unto himself his spirit and his breath;
bsb_text: If He were to set His heart to it and withdraw His Spirit and breath,
aov_text: As Hy op Homself ag sou gee, sy Gees en sy asem na Hom sou terugtrek,

kjv_text: All flesh shall perish together, and man shall turn again unto dust.
bsb_text: all flesh would perish together and mankind would return to the dust.
aov_text: dan sou alle vlees tesame die asem uitblaas en die mens sou tot stof terugkeer.

kjv_text: If now thou hast understanding, hear this: hearken to the voice of my words.
bsb_text: If you have understanding, hear this; listen to my words.
aov_text: As daar dan verstand by u is, hoor dit; luister na die stem van my woorde.

kjv_text: Shall even he that hateth right govern? and wilt thou condemn him that is most just?
bsb_text: Could one who hates justice govern? Will you condemn the just and mighty One,
aov_text: Kan ook een wat die reg haat, heers? Of durf u die Regverdige, die Geweldige, veroordeel?

kjv_text: Is it fit to say to a king, Thou art wicked? and to princes, Ye are ungodly?
bsb_text: who says to kings, ‘You are worthless!’ and to nobles, ‘You are wicked,’
aov_text: Durf iemand aan ’n koning sê: Jou deugniet! Aan die edeles: Jou goddelose!

kjv_text: How much less to him that accepteth not the persons of princes, nor regardeth the rich more than the poor? for they all are the work of his hands.
bsb_text: who is not partial to princes and does not favor rich over poor? For they are all the work of His hands.
aov_text: Hoeveel minder aan Hom wat die vorste nie voortrek nie en op die vername nie meer ag gee as op die arme nie; want hulle almal is die werk van sy hande.

kjv_text: In a moment shall they die, and the people shall be troubled at midnight, and pass away: and the mighty shall be taken away without hand.
bsb_text: They die in an instant, in the middle of the night. The people convulse and pass away; the mighty are removed without human hand.
aov_text: In ’n oomblik sterf hulle, en in die middel van die nag word ’n volk in beroering gebring en hulle gaan onder, en die magtige word weggedryf—nie deur ’n hand nie.

kjv_text: For his eyes are upon the ways of man, and he seeth all his goings.
bsb_text: For His eyes are on the ways of a man, and He sees his every step.
aov_text: Want sy oë is op die weë van die mens, en Hy sien al sy voetstappe.

kjv_text: There is no darkness, nor shadow of death, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.
bsb_text: There is no darkness or deep shadow where the workers of iniquity can hide.
aov_text: Daar is geen duisternis en daar is geen diepe donkerheid waarin die werkers van ongeregtigheid hulle kan wegsteek nie.

kjv_text: For he will not lay upon man more than right; that he should enter into judgment with God.
bsb_text: For God need not examine a man further or have him approach for judgment.
aov_text: Want Hy hoef nie lank op ’n mens ag te gee, dat hy voor God in die gereg sou gaan nie.

kjv_text: He shall break in pieces mighty men without number, and set others in their stead.
bsb_text: He shatters the mighty without inquiry and sets up others in their place.
aov_text: Hy verpletter die geweldiges sonder ondersoek en sit ander in hulle plek.

kjv_text: Therefore he knoweth their works, and he overturneth them in the night, so that they are destroyed.
bsb_text: Therefore, He recognizes their deeds; He overthrows them in the night and they are crushed.
aov_text: So ken Hy dan hulle werke en werp hulle omver in die nag, sodat hulle verbrysel word.

kjv_text: He striketh them as wicked men in the open sight of others;
bsb_text: He strikes them for their wickedness in full view,
aov_text: Hy straf hulle soos goddelose op die plek waar almal dit sien,

kjv_text: Because they turned back from him, and would not consider any of his ways:
bsb_text: because they turned aside from Him and had no regard for any of His ways.
aov_text: omdat hulle van Hom afgewyk en op geeneen van sy weë ag gegee het nie —

kjv_text: So that they cause the cry of the poor to come unto him, and he heareth the cry of the afflicted.
bsb_text: They caused the cry of the poor to come before Him, and He heard the outcry of the afflicted.
aov_text: om die geroep van die arme na Hom te laat kom, en dat Hy die geroep van die ellendiges sou hoor.

kjv_text: When he giveth quietness, who then can make trouble? and when he hideth his face, who then can behold him? whether it be done against a nation, or against a man only:
bsb_text: But when He remains silent, who can condemn Him? When He hides His face, who can see Him? Yet He watches over both man and nation,
aov_text: En gee Hý rus, wie durf Hom dan veroordeel? En verberg Hy die aangesig, wie kan Hom dan aanskou?—of dit al ’n nasie betref of ’n mens, almal saam;

kjv_text: That the hypocrite reign not, lest the people be ensnared.
bsb_text: that godless men should not rule or lay snares for the people.
aov_text: sodat die goddelose mense nie sal regeer, sodat hulle geen strikke vir die volk sal wees nie.

kjv_text: Surely it is meet to be said unto God, I have borne chastisement, I will not offend any more:
bsb_text: Suppose someone says to God, ‘I have endured my punishment; I will offend no more.
aov_text: WANT sê iemand wel tot Gód: Ek boet sonder dat ek sleg handel;

kjv_text: That which I see not teach thou me: if I have done iniquity, I will do no more.
bsb_text: Teach me what I cannot see; if I have done wrong, I will not do it again.’
aov_text: wat ek nie insien nie, leer Ú my dit; ás ek onreg gedoen het, ek sal dit nie meer doen nie —

kjv_text: Should it be according to thy mind? he will recompense it, whether thou refuse, or whether thou choose; and not I: therefore speak what thou knowest.
bsb_text: Should God repay you on your own terms when you have disavowed His? You must choose, not I; so tell me what you know.
aov_text: moet Hy volgens u mening tog vergelding doen? U is mos ontevrede, sodat ú moet sê wat beter is, en nie ek nie! Wat u dan weet—spreek dit uit!

kjv_text: Let men of understanding tell me, and let a wise man hearken unto me.
bsb_text: Men of understanding will declare to me, and the wise men who hear me will say:
aov_text: Manne van verstand sal vir my sê, en ’n wyse man wat my aanhoor:

kjv_text: Job hath spoken without knowledge, and his words were without wisdom.
bsb_text: ‘Job speaks without knowledge; his words lack insight.’
aov_text: Job spreek sonder kennis, en sy woorde is sonder verstand.

kjv_text: My desire is that Job may be tried unto the end because of his answers for wicked men.
bsb_text: If only Job were tried to the utmost for answering like a wicked man.
aov_text: Ag, mag Job getoets word tot die einde toe weens die antwoorde in die trant van kwaaddoeners.

kjv_text: For he addeth rebellion unto his sin, he clappeth his hands among us, and multiplieth his words against God.
bsb_text: For he adds rebellion to his sin; he claps his hands among us and multiplies his words against God.”
aov_text: Want hy voeg ’n oortreding by sy sonde; onder ons spreek hy smadelik en vermenigvuldig sy woorde teen God.

kjv_text: Elihu spake moreover, and said,
bsb_text: And Elihu went on to say:
aov_text: VERDER het Elíhu aangehef en gesê:

kjv_text: Thinkest thou this to be right, that thou saidst, My righteousness is more than God's?
bsb_text: “Do you think this is just? You say, ‘I am more righteous than God.’
aov_text: Hou u dit vir reg, noem u dit: my geregtigheid voor God,

kjv_text: For thou saidst, What advantage will it be unto thee? and, What profit shall I have, if I be cleansed from my sin?
bsb_text: For you ask, ‘What does it profit me, and what benefit do I gain apart from sin?’
aov_text: dat u vra wat dit u baat? Wat help dit my meer as wanneer ek sou sondig?
