kjv_text: Hast thou entered into the treasures of the snow? or hast thou seen the treasures of the hail,
bsb_text: Have you entered the storehouses of snow or observed the storehouses of hail,
aov_text: Het jy gekom by die skatkamers van die sneeu? En het jy die skatkamers van die hael gesien,

kjv_text: Which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?
bsb_text: which I hold in reserve for times of trouble, for the day of war and battle?
aov_text: wat Ek opgespaar het vir die tyd van benoudheid, vir die dag van stryd en oorlog?

kjv_text: By what way is the light parted, which scattereth the east wind upon the earth?
bsb_text: In which direction is the lightning dispersed, or the east wind scattered over the earth?
aov_text: Waar is tog die weg na die plek waar die lig gedeel word, die oostewind hom uitsprei oor die aarde?

kjv_text: Who hath divided a watercourse for the overflowing of waters, or a way for the lightning of thunder;
bsb_text: Who cuts a channel for the flood or clears a path for the thunderbolt,
aov_text: Wie het ’n kanaal gesplyt vir die stortvloed en ’n pad vir die onweerstraal;

kjv_text: To cause it to rain on the earth, where no man is; on the wilderness, wherein there is no man;
bsb_text: to bring rain on a barren land, on a desert where no man lives,
aov_text: om te laat reën op ’n land waar geen mens is nie, op ’n woestyn waar niemand woon nie;

kjv_text: To satisfy the desolate and waste ground; and to cause the bud of the tender herb to spring forth?
bsb_text: to satisfy the parched wasteland and make it sprout with tender grass?
aov_text: om woestheid en verwoesting te versadig en op die groeiplek jong gras te laat uitspruit?

kjv_text: Hath the rain a father? or who hath begotten the drops of dew?
bsb_text: Does the rain have a father? Who has begotten the drops of dew?
aov_text: Het die reën ’n vader? Of wie verwek die doudruppels?

kjv_text: Out of whose womb came the ice? and the hoary frost of heaven, who hath gendered it?
bsb_text: From whose womb does the ice emerge? Who gives birth to the frost from heaven,
aov_text: Uit wie se moederskoot kom die ys te voorskyn? En die ryp van die hemel—wie baar dit?

kjv_text: The waters are hid as with a stone, and the face of the deep is frozen.
bsb_text: when the waters become hard as stone and the surface of the deep is frozen?
aov_text: Die waters word hard soos ’n klip, en die oppervlakte van die watervloed sluit aanmekaar.

kjv_text: Canst thou bind the sweet influences of Pleiades, or loose the bands of Orion?
bsb_text: Can you bind the chains of the Pleiades or loosen the belt of Orion?
aov_text: Kan jy die bande van die Sewe-ster knoop? Of die toue van die Oríon losmaak?

kjv_text: Canst thou bring forth Mazzaroth in his season? or canst thou guide Arcturus with his sons?
bsb_text: Can you bring forth the constellations in their seasons or lead out the Bear and her cubs?
aov_text: Kan jy die Diereriem uitbring op sy tyd? En die Beer met sy kleintjies lei?

kjv_text: Knowest thou the ordinances of heaven? canst thou set the dominion thereof in the earth?
bsb_text: Do you know the laws of the heavens? Can you set their dominion over the earth?
aov_text: Ken jy die wette van die hemel? Of kan jy sy heerskappy oor die aarde bestel?

kjv_text: Canst thou lift up thy voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover thee?
bsb_text: Can you command the clouds so that a flood of water covers you?
aov_text: Kan jy jou stem na die wolke verhef, sodat ’n oorvloed van water jou oordek?

kjv_text: Canst thou send lightnings, that they may go, and say unto thee, Here we are?
bsb_text: Can you send the lightning bolts on their way? Do they report to you, ‘Here we are’?
aov_text: Kan jy die bliksems uitstuur, sodat hulle heengaan en vir jou sê: Hier is ons!

kjv_text: Who hath put wisdom in the inward parts? or who hath given understanding to the heart?
bsb_text: Who has put wisdom in the heart or given understanding to the mind?
aov_text: Wie het wysheid neergelê in die wolke? Of wie het verstand gegee aan die wolkgevaarte?

kjv_text: Who can number the clouds in wisdom? or who can stay the bottles of heaven,
bsb_text: Who has the wisdom to count the clouds? Or who can tilt the water jars of the heavens
aov_text: Wie kan die wolke met wysheid tel? En die watersakke van die hemel—wie giet hulle leeg

kjv_text: When the dust groweth into hardness, and the clods cleave fast together?
bsb_text: when the dust hardens into a mass and the clods of earth stick together?
aov_text: wanneer die stof saamvloei tot ’n stuk gietwerk en die kluite aanmekaar klewe?

kjv_text: Wilt thou hunt the prey for the lion? or fill the appetite of the young lions,
bsb_text: Can you hunt the prey for a lioness or satisfy the hunger of young lions
aov_text: KAN jy prooi jag vir die leeuin? Of die honger van die jong leeus stil maak

kjv_text: When they couch in their dens, and abide in the covert to lie in wait?
bsb_text: when they crouch in their dens and lie in wait in the thicket?
aov_text: as hulle neerbuig in die lêplekke, klaar sit in die skuilplek om te loer?

kjv_text: Who provideth for the raven his food? when his young ones cry unto God, they wander for lack of meat.
bsb_text: Who provides food for the raven when its young cry out to God as they wander about for lack of food?
aov_text: Wie berei vir die kraai sy spys as sy kleintjies roep tot God, ronddwaal by gebrek aan voedsel?

kjv_text: Knowest thou the time when the wild goats of the rock bring forth? or canst thou mark when the hinds do calve?
bsb_text: “Do you know when mountain goats give birth? Have you watched the doe bear her fawn?
aov_text: Weet jy die tyd as die steenbokke lam? Neem jy dit waar as die takbokooie voortbring?

kjv_text: Canst thou number the months that they fulfil? or knowest thou the time when they bring forth?
bsb_text: Can you count the months they are pregnant? Do you know the time they give birth?
aov_text: Tel jy die maande wat hulle dragtig is? En weet jy die tyd dat hulle lam?

kjv_text: They bow themselves, they bring forth their young ones, they cast out their sorrows.
bsb_text: They crouch down and bring forth their young; they deliver their newborn.
aov_text: Hulle buig hul krom, bring hulle kleintjies voort—weg is hulle weë!

kjv_text: Their young ones are in good liking, they grow up with corn; they go forth, and return not unto them.
bsb_text: Their young ones thrive and grow up in the open field; they leave and do not return.
aov_text: Hulle kleintjies word sterk, word groot in die veld, loop weg en kom na hulle nie terug nie.

kjv_text: Who hath sent out the wild ass free? or who hath loosed the bands of the wild ass?
bsb_text: Who set the wild donkey free? Who released the swift donkey from the harness?
aov_text: Wie het die wilde-esel so vry laat loop? En wie het die bande van die woestyn-esel losgemaak?

kjv_text: Whose house I have made the wilderness, and the barren land his dwellings.
bsb_text: I made the wilderness his home and the salt flats his dwelling.
aov_text: Vir hom het Ek die wildernis sy huis gemaak en die brak land sy woonplek.

kjv_text: He scorneth the multitude of the city, neither regardeth he the crying of the driver.
bsb_text: He scorns the tumult of the city and never hears the shouts of a driver.
aov_text: Hy lag oor die gewoel van die stad; die geskreeu van die drywer hoor hy nie.

kjv_text: The range of the mountains is his pasture, and he searcheth after every green thing.
bsb_text: He roams the mountains for pasture, searching for any green thing.
aov_text: Die omgewing van die berge is sy weiveld; en al wat groen is, soek hy uit.

kjv_text: Will the unicorn be willing to serve thee, or abide by thy crib?
bsb_text: Will the wild ox consent to serve you? Will he stay by your manger at night?
aov_text: Sal die buffel gewillig wees om jou te dien? Of sal hy vernag by jou krip?

kjv_text: Canst thou bind the unicorn with his band in the furrow? or will he harrow the valleys after thee?
bsb_text: Can you hold him to the furrow with a harness? Will he plow the valleys behind you?
aov_text: Kan jy die buffel aan die ploegvoor bind met sy trektou? Of sal hy die laagtes agter jou eg?

kjv_text: Wilt thou trust him, because his strength is great? or wilt thou leave thy labour to him?
bsb_text: Can you rely on his great strength? Will you leave your hard work to him?
aov_text: Sal jy op hom vertrou, omdat sy krag groot is? En aan hom jou arbeid oorlaat?

kjv_text: Wilt thou believe him, that he will bring home thy seed, and gather it into thy barn?
bsb_text: Can you trust him to bring in your grain and gather it to your threshing floor?
aov_text: Kan jy op hom reken, dat hy jou gesaaide sal inbring en bymekaarmaak op jou dorsvloer?

kjv_text: Gavest thou the goodly wings unto the peacocks? or wings and feathers unto the ostrich?
bsb_text: The wings of the ostrich flap joyfully, but cannot match the pinions and feathers of the stork.
aov_text: Die vlerk van die volstruis klap vrolik. Is dit ’n sagaardige vleuel en veer?

kjv_text: Which leaveth her eggs in the earth, and warmeth them in dust,
bsb_text: For she leaves her eggs on the ground and lets them warm in the sand.
aov_text: Want sy laat haar eiers op die grond lê en hou hulle warm op die grond;

kjv_text: And forgetteth that the foot may crush them, or that the wild beast may break them.
bsb_text: She forgets that a foot may crush them, or a wild animal may trample them.
aov_text: en vergeet dat ’n voet dit kan stukkend druk en die wilde diere van die veld dit kan vertrap.

kjv_text: She is hardened against her young ones, as though they were not hers: her labour is in vain without fear;
bsb_text: She treats her young harshly, as if not her own, with no concern that her labor was in vain.
aov_text: Hard behandel sy haar kleintjies asof dit nie hare is nie; is haar moeite tevergeefs—sy is nie bekommerd nie.

kjv_text: Because God hath deprived her of wisdom, neither hath he imparted to her understanding.
bsb_text: For God has deprived her of wisdom; He has not endowed her with understanding.
aov_text: Want God het haar die wysheid ontsê en haar geen deel gegee aan die verstand nie.

kjv_text: What time she lifteth up herself on high, she scorneth the horse and his rider.
bsb_text: Yet when she proudly spreads her wings, she laughs at the horse and its rider.
aov_text: Wanneer sy haarself in die hoogte klap, lag sy oor die perd en sy ruiter.

kjv_text: Hast thou given the horse strength? hast thou clothed his neck with thunder?
bsb_text: Do you give strength to the horse or adorn his neck with a mane?
aov_text: Gee jy aan die perd sterkte? Beklee jy sy nek met maanhare?

kjv_text: Canst thou make him afraid as a grasshopper? the glory of his nostrils is terrible.
bsb_text: Do you make him leap like a locust, striking terror with his proud snorting?
aov_text: Laat jy hom spring soos die sprinkaan? Sy trotse gesnuif is ’n verskrikking.

kjv_text: He paweth in the valley, and rejoiceth in his strength: he goeth on to meet the armed men.
bsb_text: He paws in the valley and rejoices in his strength; he charges into battle.
aov_text: Hy grawe in die laagte en is vrolik in sy krag; hy trek uit, die stryd tegemoet.

kjv_text: He mocketh at fear, and is not affrighted; neither turneth he back from the sword.
bsb_text: He laughs at fear, frightened of nothing; he does not turn back from the sword.
aov_text: Hy lag oor die vrees en word nie verskrik nie en draai nie om vir die swaard nie.

kjv_text: The quiver rattleth against him, the glittering spear and the shield.
bsb_text: A quiver rattles at his side, along with a flashing spear and lance.
aov_text: Op hom rammel die pylkoker, die flikkerende spies en lans.

kjv_text: He swalloweth the ground with fierceness and rage: neither believeth he that it is the sound of the trumpet.
bsb_text: Trembling with excitement, he devours the distance; he cannot stand still when the ram’s horn sounds.
aov_text: Onstuimig en wild verslind hy die grond en staan nie stil as die basuin klink nie.

kjv_text: He saith among the trumpets, Ha, ha; and he smelleth the battle afar off, the thunder of the captains, and the shouting.
bsb_text: At the blast of the horn, he snorts with fervor. He catches the scent of battle from afar—the shouts of captains and the cry of war.
aov_text: By elke basuinstoot sê hy: Heag! En van ver ruik hy die oorlog, die donderroep van die leërowerstes en die oorlogsgeskreeu.

kjv_text: Doth the hawk fly by thy wisdom, and stretch her wings toward the south?
bsb_text: Does the hawk take flight by your understanding and spread his wings toward the south?
aov_text: Sweef die valk opwaarts deur jou verstand en sprei sy vlerke uit na die suide toe?

kjv_text: Doth the eagle mount up at thy command, and make her nest on high?
bsb_text: Does the eagle soar at your command and make his nest on high?
aov_text: Of vlieg die adelaar hoog op jou bevel en bou hy hoog sy nes?

kjv_text: She dwelleth and abideth on the rock, upon the crag of the rock, and the strong place.
bsb_text: He dwells on a cliff and lodges there; his stronghold is on a rocky crag.
aov_text: Op die rots woon hy en vernag hy, op die rotspunt en bergvesting.

kjv_text: From thence she seeketh the prey, and her eyes behold afar off.
bsb_text: From there he spies out food; his eyes see it from afar.
aov_text: Daarvandaan loer hy op voedsel, sy oë kyk in die verte.

kjv_text: Her young ones also suck up blood: and where the slain are, there is she.
bsb_text: His young ones feast on blood; and where the slain are, there he is.”
aov_text: Ook slurp sy kleintjies bloed, en waar gesneuweldes lê, daar is hy.

kjv_text: Moreover the LORD answered Job, and said,
bsb_text: And the LORD said to Job:
aov_text: EN die HERE het Job geantwoord en gesê:

kjv_text: Shall he that contendeth with the Almighty instruct him? he that reproveth God, let him answer it.
bsb_text: “Will the faultfinder contend with the Almighty? Let him who argues with God give an answer.”
aov_text: Wil die berisper met die Almagtige twis? Laat hy wat God teregwys, hierop antwoord!

kjv_text: Then Job answered the LORD, and said,
bsb_text: Then Job answered the LORD:
aov_text: Toe het Job die HERE geantwoord en gesê:

kjv_text: Behold, I am vile; what shall I answer thee? I will lay mine hand upon my mouth.
bsb_text: “Behold, I am insignificant. How can I reply to You? I place my hand over my mouth.
aov_text: Kyk, ek is te gering. Wat kan ek U antwoord? Ek lê my hand op my mond.

kjv_text: Once have I spoken; but I will not answer: yea, twice; but I will proceed no further.
bsb_text: I have spoken once, but I have no answer—twice, but I have nothing to add.”
aov_text: Een maal het ek gespreek, maar sal nie meer antwoord nie; ja, twee maal, maar ek sal nie voortgaan nie.

kjv_text: Then answered the LORD unto Job out of the whirlwind, and said,
bsb_text: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind and said:
aov_text: EN die HERE het Job uit ’n storm geantwoord en gesê:

kjv_text: Gird up thy loins now like a man: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.
bsb_text: “Now brace yourself like a man; I will question you, and you shall inform Me.
aov_text: Gord tog jou heupe soos ’n man; Ek sal jou ondervra en onderrig jy My.

kjv_text: Wilt thou also disannul my judgment? wilt thou condemn me, that thou mayest be righteous?
bsb_text: Would you really annul My justice? Would you condemn Me to justify yourself?
aov_text: Wil jy werklik my reg verbreek, My veroordeel, dat jy gelyk kan hê?

kjv_text: Hast thou an arm like God? or canst thou thunder with a voice like him?
bsb_text: Do you have an arm like God’s? Can you thunder with a voice like His?
aov_text: Het jy dan ’n arm soos God? En kan jy donder met die stem soos Hy?

kjv_text: Deck thyself now with majesty and excellency; and array thyself with glory and beauty.
bsb_text: Then adorn yourself with majesty and splendor, and clothe yourself with honor and glory.
aov_text: Versier jou tog met heerlikheid en hoogheid, en beklee jou met majesteit en glorie!

kjv_text: Cast abroad the rage of thy wrath: and behold every one that is proud, and abase him.
bsb_text: Unleash the fury of your wrath; look on every proud man and bring him low.
aov_text: Giet jou toorn in strome uit; en kyk na alles wat hoog is, en verneder dit.

kjv_text: Look on every one that is proud, and bring him low; and tread down the wicked in their place.
bsb_text: Look on every proud man and humble him; trample the wicked where they stand.
aov_text: Kyk na alles wat hoog is, onderwerp dit; en werp die goddelose neer daar waar hulle staan.

kjv_text: Hide them in the dust together; and bind their faces in secret.
bsb_text: Bury them together in the dust; imprison them in the grave.
aov_text: Begrawe hulle almal saam in die stof; sluit hulle aangesigte in ’n verborge plek weg.

kjv_text: Then will I also confess unto thee that thine own right hand can save thee.
bsb_text: Then I will confess to you that your own right hand can save you.
aov_text: Dan sal ook Ek jou loof, omdat jou regterhand jou die oorwinning gee.

kjv_text: Behold now behemoth, which I made with thee; he eateth grass as an ox.
bsb_text: Look at Behemoth, which I made along with you. He feeds on grass like an ox.
aov_text: Kyk, daar is die seekoei wat Ek gemaak het saam met jou. Gras eet hy soos ’n bees.

kjv_text: Lo now, his strength is in his loins, and his force is in the navel of his belly.
bsb_text: See the strength of his loins and the power in the muscles of his belly.
aov_text: Kyk tog, sy krag is in sy kruis, en sy sterkte in die spiere van sy buik.

kjv_text: He moveth his tail like a cedar: the sinews of his stones are wrapped together.
bsb_text: His tail sways like a cedar; the sinews of his thighs are tightly knit.
aov_text: Hy hou sy stert reguit soos ’n seder; die senings van sy dye is inmekaar gevleg.

kjv_text: His bones are as strong pieces of brass; his bones are like bars of iron.
bsb_text: His bones are tubes of bronze; his limbs are rods of iron.
aov_text: Sy gebeente is pype van koper, sy bene soos stawe van yster.

kjv_text: He is the chief of the ways of God: he that made him can make his sword to approach unto him.
bsb_text: He is the foremost of God’s works; only his Maker can draw the sword against him.
aov_text: Hy is die eersteling van die weë van God; Hy wat hom gemaak het, het hom sy swaard verskaf.

kjv_text: Surely the mountains bring him forth food, where all the beasts of the field play.
bsb_text: The hills yield him their produce, while all the beasts of the field play nearby.
aov_text: Want die berge lewer vir hom voer, en al die wilde diere van die veld speel daar.

kjv_text: He lieth under the shady trees, in the covert of the reed, and fens.
bsb_text: He lies under the lotus plants, hidden among the reeds of the marsh.
aov_text: Onder lotusbome lê hy, in ’n skuilplek van riete en moeras.

kjv_text: The shady trees cover him with their shadow; the willows of the brook compass him about.
bsb_text: The lotus plants conceal him in their shade; the willows of the brook surround him.
aov_text: Lotusbome oordek hom as sy skaduwee, die rivierwilgers omring hom.

kjv_text: Behold, he drinketh up a river, and hasteth not: he trusteth that he can draw up Jordan into his mouth.
bsb_text: Though the river rages, Behemoth is unafraid; he remains secure, though the Jordan surges to his mouth.
aov_text: As die rivier swel—hy word nie verskrik nie; hy voel gerus, ook al bruis ’n Jordaan teen sy mond.

kjv_text: He taketh it with his eyes: his nose pierceth through snares.
bsb_text: Can anyone capture him as he looks on, or pierce his nose with a snare?
aov_text: Sal ’n mens hom gryp terwyl hy jou aankyk, met vangtoue sy neus deurboor?

kjv_text: Canst thou draw out leviathan with an hook? or his tongue with a cord which thou lettest down?
bsb_text: “Can you pull in Leviathan with a hook or tie down his tongue with a rope?
aov_text: Kan jy die krokodil met ’n hoek uittrek? En met ’n tou sy tong afdruk?

kjv_text: Canst thou put an hook into his nose? or bore his jaw through with a thorn?
bsb_text: Can you put a cord through his nose or pierce his jaw with a hook?
aov_text: Kan jy ’n tou van biesies in sy neus sit? En sy kakebeen met ’n haak deurboor?

kjv_text: Will he make many supplications unto thee? will he speak soft words unto thee?
bsb_text: Will he beg you for mercy or speak to you softly?
aov_text: Sal hy jou baie smeek? Of met jou spreek in sagte woorde?

kjv_text: Will he make a covenant with thee? wilt thou take him for a servant for ever?
bsb_text: Will he make a covenant with you to take him as a slave for life?
aov_text: Sal hy ’n verbond met jou sluit, dat jy hom vir altyd as slaaf aanneem?

kjv_text: Wilt thou play with him as with a bird? or wilt thou bind him for thy maidens?
bsb_text: Can you pet him like a bird or put him on a leash for your maidens?
aov_text: Sal jy met hom soos met ’n voëltjie speel? En hom vasbind vir jou meisiekinders?

kjv_text: Shall the companions make a banquet of him? shall they part him among the merchants?
bsb_text: Will traders barter for him or divide him among the merchants?
aov_text: Sal die viskopers met hom handel drywe, hom verdeel onder die koopmans?

kjv_text: Canst thou fill his skin with barbed irons? or his head with fish spears?
bsb_text: Can you fill his hide with harpoons or his head with fishing spears?
aov_text: Kan jy sy vel vol skerp ysters steek, en met ’n vissersharpoen sy kop?

kjv_text: Lay thine hand upon him, remember the battle, do no more.
bsb_text: If you lay a hand on him, you will remember the battle and never repeat it!
aov_text: Sit jou hand op hom; dink aan die geveg; jy sal dit nie weer doen nie.

kjv_text: Behold, the hope of him is in vain: shall not one be cast down even at the sight of him?
bsb_text: Surely hope of overcoming him is false. Is not the sight of him overwhelming?
aov_text: Kyk, elke hoop kom bedroë uit: sal ’n mens nie reeds by die sien van hom neerslaan nie?

kjv_text: None is so fierce that dare stir him up: who then is able to stand before me?
bsb_text: No one is so fierce as to rouse Leviathan. Then who is able to stand against Me?
aov_text: NIEMAND is so vermetel, dat hy hom durf terg nie; wie is hy dan wat voor My sou standhou?

kjv_text: Who hath prevented me, that I should repay him? whatsoever is under the whole heaven is mine.
bsb_text: Who has given to Me that I should repay him? Everything under heaven is Mine.
aov_text: Wie het eerste aan My gegee, dat Ek hom moet vergelde? Wat onder die ganse hemel is, is myne.

kjv_text: I will not conceal his parts, nor his power, nor his comely proportion.
bsb_text: I cannot keep silent about his limbs, his power and graceful form.
aov_text: Ek wil nie swyg oor sy lede en hoe dit staan met sy kragsvolheid en die skoonheid van sy uitrusting nie.

kjv_text: Who can discover the face of his garment? or who can come to him with his double bridle?
bsb_text: Who can strip off his outer coat? Who can approach him with a bridle?
aov_text: Wie het die boonste van sy pantser opgelig? In sy dubbele gebit—wie kan daarin deurdring?

kjv_text: Who can open the doors of his face? his teeth are terrible round about.
bsb_text: Who can open his jaws, ringed by his fearsome teeth?
aov_text: Die deure van sy gesig—wie het dit geopen? Rondom sy tande is verskrikking.

kjv_text: His scales are his pride, shut up together as with a close seal.
bsb_text: His rows of scales are his pride, tightly sealed together.
aov_text: ’n Voorwerp van trots is die groewe van die skilde, verseël met ’n vaste seël.

kjv_text: One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.
bsb_text: One scale is so near to another that no air can pass between them.
aov_text: Die een is so naby die ander, dat die wind daar nie tussenin kan kom nie.

kjv_text: They are joined one to another, they stick together, that they cannot be sundered.
bsb_text: They are joined to one another; they clasp and cannot be separated.
aov_text: Hulle kleef aanmekaar, hou aanmekaar vas, onafskeibaar.

kjv_text: By his neesings a light doth shine, and his eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.
bsb_text: His snorting flashes with light, and his eyes are like the rays of dawn.
aov_text: Sy genies laat lig skitter, en sy oë is soos die ooglede van die dageraad.

kjv_text: Out of his mouth go burning lamps, and sparks of fire leap out.
bsb_text: Firebrands stream from his mouth; fiery sparks shoot forth!
aov_text: Uit sy mond kom fakkels, spat vuurvonke uit.

kjv_text: Out of his nostrils goeth smoke, as out of a seething pot or caldron.
bsb_text: Smoke billows from his nostrils as from a boiling pot over burning reeds.
aov_text: Uit sy neusgate kom rook, soos uit ’n kokende pot met biesiesvuur daarby.

kjv_text: His breath kindleth coals, and a flame goeth out of his mouth.
bsb_text: His breath sets coals ablaze, and flames pour from his mouth.
aov_text: Sy asem laat kole ontvlam, en ’n vlam gaan uit sy mond.

kjv_text: In his neck remaineth strength, and sorrow is turned into joy before him.
bsb_text: Strength resides in his neck, and dismay leaps before him.
aov_text: In sy nek woon sterkte, en voor hom uit spring ontsteltenis.

kjv_text: The flakes of his flesh are joined together: they are firm in themselves; they cannot be moved.
bsb_text: The folds of his flesh are tightly joined; they are firm and immovable.
aov_text: Die klompe van sy vleis is vas aanmekaar, aan hom vasgegiet, onbeweeglik.

kjv_text: His heart is as firm as a stone; yea, as hard as a piece of the nether millstone.
bsb_text: His chest is as hard as a rock, as hard as a lower millstone!
aov_text: Sy hart is hard soos ’n klip, ja, hard soos die onderste meulsteen.

kjv_text: When he raiseth up himself, the mighty are afraid: by reason of breakings they purify themselves.
bsb_text: When Leviathan rises up, the mighty are terrified; they withdraw before his thrashing.
aov_text: As hy hom oplig, word die magtiges bang; van verbystering raak hulle buite hulself.

kjv_text: The sword of him that layeth at him cannot hold: the spear, the dart, nor the habergeon.
bsb_text: The sword that reaches him has no effect, nor does the spear or dart or arrow.
aov_text: Raak iemand hom met die swaard—dit hou nie stand nie; geen spies, lans of assegaai nie.

kjv_text: He esteemeth iron as straw, and brass as rotten wood.
bsb_text: He regards iron as straw and bronze as rotten wood.
aov_text: Yster is vir hom soos strooi; koper soos hout wat vergaan het.

kjv_text: The arrow cannot make him flee: slingstones are turned with him into stubble.
bsb_text: No arrow can make him flee; slingstones become like chaff to him.
aov_text: Die pyl laat hom nie vlug nie; slingerstene word vir hom soos stoppels.

kjv_text: Darts are counted as stubble: he laugheth at the shaking of a spear.
bsb_text: A club is regarded as straw, and he laughs at the sound of the lance.
aov_text: Knopkieries is vir hom soos stoppels, en hy lag oor die gesuis van die lans.

kjv_text: Sharp stones are under him: he spreadeth sharp pointed things upon the mire.
bsb_text: His undersides are jagged potsherds, spreading out the mud like a threshing sledge.
aov_text: Onderaan hom is spits skerwe: hy sprei ’n ware dorsslee uit op die modder.

kjv_text: He maketh the deep to boil like a pot: he maketh the sea like a pot of ointment.
bsb_text: He makes the depths seethe like a cauldron; he makes the sea like a jar of ointment.
aov_text: Hy laat die diepte kook soos ’n pot; die waterplas maak hy soos ’n kokende salfpot.

kjv_text: He maketh a path to shine after him; one would think the deep to be hoary.
bsb_text: He leaves a glistening wake behind him; one would think the deep had white hair!
aov_text: Agter hom verlig hy die pad: ’n mens sou die watervloed aansien vir grys hare.

kjv_text: Upon earth there is not his like, who is made without fear.
bsb_text: Nothing on earth is his equal—a creature devoid of fear!
aov_text: Sy gelyke is daar op die aarde nie, die skepsel sonder vrees.

kjv_text: He beholdeth all high things: he is a king over all the children of pride.
bsb_text: He looks down on all the haughty; he is king over all the proud.”
aov_text: Hy kyk alles aan wat hoog is; hy is koning oor al die trotse roofdiere.

kjv_text: Then Job answered the LORD, and said,
bsb_text: Then Job replied to the LORD:
aov_text: TOE het Job die HERE geantwoord en gesê:

kjv_text: I know that thou canst do every thing, and that no thought can be withholden from thee.
bsb_text: “I know that You can do all things and that no plan of Yours can be thwarted.
aov_text: Ek weet dat U alles kan doen en geen plan vir U onuitvoerbaar is nie.

kjv_text: Who is he that hideth counsel without knowledge? therefore have I uttered that I understood not; things too wonderful for me, which I knew not.
bsb_text: You asked, ‘Who is this who conceals My counsel without knowledge?’ Surely I spoke of things I did not understand, things too wonderful for me to know.
aov_text: Wie verberg die raadsbesluit daar sonder kennis? So het ek dan gespreek sonder om te verstaan, dinge te wonderbaar vir my, wat ek nie begryp nie.

kjv_text: Hear, I beseech thee, and I will speak: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.
bsb_text: You said, ‘Listen now, and I will speak. I will question you, and you shall inform Me.’
aov_text: Hoor tog, en ék sal spreek; ek sal U ondervra en onderrig U my!

kjv_text: I have heard of thee by the hearing of the ear: but now mine eye seeth thee.
bsb_text: My ears had heard of You, but now my eyes have seen You.
aov_text: Volgens hoorsê het ek van U gehoor; maar nou het my oog U gesien.

kjv_text: Wherefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes.
bsb_text: Therefore I retract my words, and I repent in dust and ashes.”
aov_text: Daarom herroep ek en het berou in stof en as.

kjv_text: And it was so, that after the LORD had spoken these words unto Job, the LORD said to Eliphaz the Temanite, My wrath is kindled against thee, and against thy two friends: for ye have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job hath.
bsb_text: After the LORD had spoken these words to Job, He said to Eliphaz the Temanite, “My wrath is kindled against you and your two friends. For you have not spoken about Me accurately, as My servant Job has.
aov_text: EN nadat die HERE Job toegespreek het met hierdie woorde, sê die HERE aan Élifas, die Temaniet: My toorn het ontvlam teen jou en jou twee vriende; want julle het nie reg van My gespreek soos my kneg Job nie.

kjv_text: Therefore take unto you now seven bullocks and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; and my servant Job shall pray for you: for him will I accept: lest I deal with you after your folly, in that ye have not spoken of me the thing which is right, like my servant Job.
bsb_text: So now, take seven bulls and seven rams, go to My servant Job, and sacrifice a burnt offering for yourselves. Then My servant Job will pray for you, for I will accept his prayer and not deal with you according to your folly. For you have not spoken accurately about Me, as My servant Job has.”
aov_text: Neem dan nou vir julle sewe bulle en sewe ramme, en gaan na my kneg Job en bring ’n brandoffer vir julle, en laat my kneg Job vir julle bid; want hom alleen sal Ek in guns aanneem, sodat Ek aan julle nie die dwaasheid laat vergelde nie; want julle het nie reg van My gespreek soos my kneg Job nie.

kjv_text: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went, and did according as the LORD commanded them: the LORD also accepted Job.
bsb_text: So Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite went and did as the LORD had told them; and the LORD accepted Job’s request.
aov_text: Toe het Élifas, die Temaniet, en Bildad, die Suhiet, en Sofar, die Naämatiet, heengegaan en gedoen soos die HERE aan hulle gesê het; en die HERE het Job in guns aangeneem.

kjv_text: And the LORD turned the captivity of Job, when he prayed for his friends: also the LORD gave Job twice as much as he had before.
bsb_text: After Job had prayed for his friends, the LORD restored his prosperity and doubled his former possessions.
aov_text: En die HERE het die lot van Job verander toe hy vir sy vriende gebid het; en die HERE het Job se besittings vermeerder tot dubbel soveel as voorheen.

kjv_text: Then came there unto him all his brethren, and all his sisters, and all they that had been of his acquaintance before, and did eat bread with him in his house: and they bemoaned him, and comforted him over all the evil that the LORD had brought upon him: every man also gave him a piece of money, and every one an earring of gold.
bsb_text: All his brothers and sisters and prior acquaintances came and dined with him in his house. They consoled him and comforted him over all the adversity that the LORD had brought upon him. And each one gave him a piece of silver and a gold ring.
aov_text: Ook het al sy broers en al sy susters en al sy bekendes van vroeër na hom gekom en met hom saam brood geëet in sy huis; en hulle het met hom medelyde gehad en hom vertroos oor al die onheil wat die HERE oor hom gebring het. En hulle het hom elkeen ’n geldstuk gegee en elkeen ’n goue ring.

kjv_text: So the LORD blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning: for he had fourteen thousand sheep, and six thousand camels, and a thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand she asses.
bsb_text: So the LORD blessed Job’s latter days more than his first. He owned 14,000 sheep, 6,000 camels, 1,000 yoke of oxen, and 1,000 female donkeys.
aov_text: En die HERE het die einde van Job meer geseën as sy begin; en hy het veertienduisend stuks kleinvee en sesduisend kamele en duisend paar beeste en duisend eselinne gehad.

kjv_text: He had also seven sons and three daughters.
bsb_text: And he also had seven sons and three daughters.
aov_text: Daarby het hy sewe seuns en drie dogters gehad.

kjv_text: And he called the name of the first, Jemima; and the name of the second, Kezia; and the name of the third, Kerenhappuch.
bsb_text: He named his first daughter Jemimah, his second Keziah, and his third Keren-happuch.
aov_text: En hy het die eerste genoem Jemíma en die tweede Kesía en die derde Kerenhappug.

kjv_text: And in all the land were no women found so fair as the daughters of Job: and their father gave them inheritance among their brethren.
bsb_text: No women as beautiful as Job’s daughters could be found in all the land, and their father granted them an inheritance among their brothers.
aov_text: En in die hele land is geen vroue gevind so mooi soos die dogters van Job nie; en hulle vader het hulle ’n erfdeel gegee onder hulle broers.

kjv_text: After this lived Job an hundred and forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons' sons, even four generations.
bsb_text: After this, Job lived 140 years and saw his children and their children to the fourth generation.
aov_text: En Job het daarna honderd-en-veertig jaar lank gelewe; en hy het sy kinders en kindskinders gesien, vier geslagte.

kjv_text: So Job died, being old and full of days.
bsb_text: And so Job died, old and full of years.
aov_text: En Job het gesterwe, oud en afgeleef.

kjv_text: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful.
bsb_text: Blessed is the man who does not walk in the counsel of the wicked, or set foot on the path of sinners, or sit in the seat of mockers.
aov_text: WELGELUKSALIG is die man wat nie wandel in die raad van die goddelose en nie staan op die weg van die sondaars en nie sit in die kring van die spotters nie;

kjv_text: But his delight is in the law of the LORD; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.
bsb_text: But his delight is in the Law of the LORD, and on His law he meditates day and night.
aov_text: maar sy behae is in die wet van die HERE, en hy oordink sy wet dag en nag.

kjv_text: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.
bsb_text: He is like a tree planted by streams of water, yielding its fruit in season, whose leaf does not wither, and who prospers in all he does.
aov_text: En hy sal wees soos ’n boom wat geplant is by waterstrome, wat sy vrugte gee op sy tyd en waarvan die blare nie verwelk nie; en alles wat hy doen, voer hy voorspoedig uit.

kjv_text: The ungodly are not so: but are like the chaff which the wind driveth away.
bsb_text: Not so the wicked! For they are like chaff driven off by the wind.
aov_text: So is die goddelose mense nie, maar soos kaf wat die wind verstrooi.

kjv_text: Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.
bsb_text: Therefore the wicked will not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the assembly of the righteous.
aov_text: Daarom sal die goddelose nie bestaan in die oordeel en die sondaars in die vergadering van die regverdiges nie.

kjv_text: For the LORD knoweth the way of the righteous: but the way of the ungodly shall perish.
bsb_text: For the LORD guards the path of the righteous, but the way of the wicked will perish.
aov_text: Want die HERE ken die weg van die regverdiges, maar die weg van die goddelose sal vergaan.

kjv_text: Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing?
bsb_text: Why do the nations rage and the peoples plot in vain?
aov_text: WAAROM woel die nasies en bedink die volke nietige dinge?

kjv_text: The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the LORD, and against his anointed, saying,
bsb_text: The kings of the earth take their stand and the rulers gather together, against the LORD and against His Anointed One:
aov_text: Die konings van die aarde staan gereed, en die vorste hou saam raad teen die HERE en teen sy Gesalfde en sê:

kjv_text: Let us break their bands asunder, and cast away their cords from us.
bsb_text: “Let us break Their chains and cast away Their cords.”
aov_text: Laat ons hulle bande stukkend ruk en hulle toue van ons afwerp!

kjv_text: He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh: the LORD shall have them in derision.
bsb_text: The One enthroned in heaven laughs; the Lord taunts them.
aov_text: Hy wat in die hemel woon, lag; die HERE spot met hulle.

kjv_text: Then shall he speak unto them in his wrath, and vex them in his sore displeasure.
bsb_text: Then He rebukes them in His anger, and terrifies them in His fury:
aov_text: Dan sal Hy hulle aanspreek in sy toorn, en in sy grimmigheid sal Hy hulle verskrik:

kjv_text: Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion.
bsb_text: “I have installed My King on Zion, upon My holy mountain.”
aov_text: Ék tog het my Koning gesalf oor Sion, my heilige berg.

kjv_text: I will declare the decree: the LORD hath said unto me, Thou art my Son; this day have I begotten thee.
bsb_text: I will proclaim the decree spoken to Me by the LORD: “You are My Son; today I have become Your Father.
aov_text: Ek wil vertel van die besluit: Die HERE het aan My gesê: U is my Seun, vandag het Ek self U gegenereer.

kjv_text: Ask of me, and I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession.
bsb_text: Ask Me, and I will make the nations Your inheritance, the ends of the earth Your possession.
aov_text: Eis van My, en Ek wil nasies gee as u erfdeel en die eindes van die aarde as u besitting.

kjv_text: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel.
bsb_text: You will break them with an iron scepter; You will shatter them like pottery.”
aov_text: U sal hulle verpletter met ’n ysterstaf, U sal hulle stukkend slaan soos ’n erdepot.

kjv_text: Be wise now therefore, O ye kings: be instructed, ye judges of the earth.
bsb_text: Therefore be wise, O kings; be admonished, O judges of the earth.
aov_text: Wees dan nou verstandig, o konings; laat julle waarsku, o regters van die aarde!

kjv_text: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
bsb_text: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
aov_text: Dien die HERE met vrees, en juig met bewing.

kjv_text: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish from the way, when his wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed are all they that put their trust in him.
bsb_text: Kiss the Son, lest He be angry and you perish in your rebellion, when His wrath ignites in an instant. Blessed are all who take refuge in Him.
aov_text: Kus die Seun, dat Hy nie toornig word en julle op die weg vergaan nie; want gou kan sy toorn ontvlam. Welgeluksalig is almal wat by Hom skuil!

kjv_text: A Psalm of David, when he fled from Absalom his son.
bsb_text: A Psalm of David, when he fled from his son Absalom.
aov_text: ’N PSALM van Dawid toe hy gevlug het vir sy seun Absalom.

kjv_text: Lord, how are they increased that trouble me! many are they that rise up against me.
bsb_text: O LORD, how my foes have increased! How many rise up against me!
aov_text: o HERE, hoe het my teëstanders vermenigvuldig! Baie staan teen my op.

kjv_text: Many there be which say of my soul, There is no help for him in God. Selah.
bsb_text: Many say of me, “God will not deliver him.” Selah
aov_text: Baie sê van my: Daar is geen heil vir hom by God nie. Sela.

kjv_text: But thou, O LORD, art a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of mine head.
bsb_text: But You, O LORD, are a shield around me, my glory, and the One who lifts my head.
aov_text: Maar U, HERE, is ’n skild wat my beskut, my eer en die Een wat my hoof ophef.

kjv_text: I cried unto the LORD with my voice, and he heard me out of his holy hill. Selah.
bsb_text: To the LORD I cry aloud, and He answers me from His holy mountain. Selah
aov_text: Luid roep ek die HERE aan, en Hy verhoor my van sy heilige berg. Sela.

kjv_text: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the LORD sustained me.
bsb_text: I lie down and sleep; I wake again, for the LORD sustains me.
aov_text: Ek het gaan lê en aan die slaap mag raak; ek het wakker geword, want die HERE ondersteun my.

kjv_text: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, that have set themselves against me round about.
bsb_text: I will not fear the myriads set against me on every side.
aov_text: Ek sal nie vrees vir tienduisende van mense wat rondom teen my gereed staan nie.

kjv_text: Arise, O LORD; save me, O my God: for thou hast smitten all mine enemies upon the cheek bone; thou hast broken the teeth of the ungodly.
bsb_text: Arise, O LORD! Save me, O my God! Strike all my enemies on the jaw; break the teeth of the wicked.
aov_text: Staan op, HERE; verlos my, my God! Want U het al my vyande op die kakebeen geslaan; U het die tande van die goddelose stukkend gebreek.

kjv_text: Salvation belongeth unto the LORD: thy blessing is upon thy people. Selah.
bsb_text: Salvation belongs to the LORD; may Your blessing be on Your people. Selah
aov_text: Die heil behoort aan die HERE; laat u seën wees oor u volk! Sela.

kjv_text: To the chief Musician on Neginoth, A Psalm of David.
bsb_text: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments.
aov_text: VIR die musiekleier; met snaarinstrumente. ’n Psalm van Dawid.

kjv_text: Hear me when I call, O God of my righteousness: thou hast enlarged me when I was in distress; have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.
bsb_text: Answer me when I call, O God of my righteousness! You have relieved my distress; show me grace and hear my prayer.
aov_text: As ek roep, verhoor my, o God van my geregtigheid! In benoudheid het U vir my ruimte gemaak; wees my genadig, en hoor my gebed!

kjv_text: O ye sons of men, how long will ye turn my glory into shame? how long will ye love vanity, and seek after leasing? Selah.
bsb_text: How long, O men, will my honor be maligned? How long will you love vanity and seek after lies? Selah
aov_text: o Manne, hoe lank sal my eer tot skande wees? Hoe lank sal julle die nietigheid liefhê, die leuen soek? Sela.

kjv_text: But know that the LORD hath set apart him that is godly for himself: the LORD will hear when I call unto him.
bsb_text: Know that the LORD has set apart the godly for Himself; the LORD hears when I call to Him.
aov_text: Weet tog dat die HERE vir Hom ’n gunsgenoot afgesonder het; die HERE hoor as ek Hom aanroep.

kjv_text: Stand in awe, and sin not: commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah.
bsb_text: Be angry, yet do not sin; on your bed, search your heart and be still. Selah
aov_text: Sidder, en moenie sondig nie; spreek in julle hart op julle bed, en wees stil. Sela.

kjv_text: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, and put your trust in the LORD.
bsb_text: Offer the sacrifices of the righteous and trust in the LORD.
aov_text: Offer offerandes van geregtigheid en vertrou op die HERE.

kjv_text: There be many that say, Who will shew us any good? LORD, lift thou up the light of thy countenance upon us.
bsb_text: Many ask, “Who can show us the good?” Shine the light of Your face upon us, O LORD.
aov_text: Baie sê: Wie sal ons die goeie laat sien? Verhef oor ons die lig van u aangesig, o HERE!

kjv_text: Thou hast put gladness in my heart, more than in the time that their corn and their wine increased.
bsb_text: You have filled my heart with more joy than when grain and new wine abound.
aov_text: Groter vreugde het U in my hart gegee as wanneer hulle koring en hulle mos oorvloedig is.

kjv_text: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety.
bsb_text: I will lie down and sleep in peace, for You alone, O LORD, make me dwell in safety.
aov_text: Ek wil in vrede gaan lê en meteens aan die slaap raak; want U, o HERE, alleen laat my in veiligheid woon.

kjv_text: To the chief Musician upon Nehiloth, A Psalm of David.
bsb_text: For the choirmaster, to be accompanied by flutes. A Psalm of David.
aov_text: VIR die musiekleier; met fluite. ’n Psalm van Dawid.

kjv_text: Give ear to my words, O LORD, consider my meditation.
bsb_text: Give ear to my words, O LORD; consider my groaning.
aov_text: o HERE, luister na my woorde, let op my versugting.

kjv_text: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God: for unto thee will I pray.
bsb_text: Attend to the sound of my cry, my King and my God, for to You I pray.
aov_text: Gee ag op die stem van my hulpgeroep, my Koning en my God, want tot U bid ek.

kjv_text: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O LORD; in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up.
bsb_text: In the morning, O LORD, You hear my voice; at daybreak I lay my plea before You and wait in expectation.
aov_text: In die môre, HERE, sal U my stem hoor; in die môre sal ek dit aan U voorlê en afwag.

kjv_text: For thou art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: neither shall evil dwell with thee.
bsb_text: For You are not a God who delights in wickedness; no evil can dwell with You.
aov_text: Want U is nie ’n God wat behae het in goddeloosheid nie; die kwaaddoener sal by U nie vertoef nie.

kjv_text: The foolish shall not stand in thy sight: thou hatest all workers of iniquity.
bsb_text: The boastful cannot stand in Your presence; You hate all workers of iniquity.
aov_text: Die onsinniges sal voor u oë nie standhou nie; U haat al die werkers van ongeregtigheid.

kjv_text: Thou shalt destroy them that speak leasing: the LORD will abhor the bloody and deceitful man.
bsb_text: You destroy those who tell lies; the LORD abhors the man of bloodshed and deceit.
aov_text: U sal die leuensprekers laat omkom; van die man van bloed en bedrog het die HERE ’n afsku.

kjv_text: But as for me, I will come into thy house in the multitude of thy mercy: and in thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple.
bsb_text: But I will enter Your house by the abundance of Your loving devotion; in reverence I will bow down toward Your holy temple.
aov_text: Maar ek, deur die grootheid van u goedertierenheid mag ek in u huis ingaan, my buig na u heilige tempel, in u vrees.

kjv_text: Lead me, O LORD, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; make thy way straight before my face.
bsb_text: Lead me, O LORD, in Your righteousness because of my enemies; make straight Your way before me.
aov_text: HERE, lei my in u geregtigheid om my vyande ontwil; maak u weg voor my reg.

kjv_text: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth; their inward part is very wickedness; their throat is an open sepulchre; they flatter with their tongue.
bsb_text: For not a word they speak can be trusted; destruction lies within them. Their throats are open graves; their tongues practice deceit.
aov_text: Want in hulle mond is niks betroubaars nie; hulle binneste bring onheil; hulle keel is ’n oop graf; hulle maak hul tong glad.

kjv_text: Destroy thou them, O God; let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions; for they have rebelled against thee.
bsb_text: Declare them guilty, O God; let them fall by their own devices. Drive them out for their many transgressions, for they have rebelled against You.
aov_text: Verklaar hulle skuldig, o God! Laat hulle val deur hul planne; dryf hulle weg oor die menigte van hul oortredinge, want hulle is wederstrewig teen U.

kjv_text: But let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.
bsb_text: But let all who take refuge in You rejoice; let them ever shout for joy. May You shelter them, that those who love Your name may rejoice in You.
aov_text: Maar laat húlle almal bly wees wat by U skuil; laat hulle vir ewig jubel, en beskut U hulle; en laat in U juig die wat u Naam liefhet.

kjv_text: For thou, LORD, wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt thou compass him as with a shield.
bsb_text: For surely You, O LORD, bless the righteous; You surround them with the shield of Your favor.
aov_text: Want U seën die regverdige, o HERE, U omring hom met welbehae soos met ’n skild.

kjv_text: To the chief Musician on Neginoth upon Sheminith, A Psalm of David.
bsb_text: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments, according to Sheminith. A Psalm of David.
aov_text: VIR die musiekleier; met snaarinstrumente; met basstem. ’n Psalm van Dawid.

kjv_text: O LORD, rebuke me not in thine anger, neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
bsb_text: O LORD, do not rebuke me in Your anger or discipline me in Your wrath.
aov_text: o HERE, straf my nie in u toorn nie, en kasty my nie in u grimmigheid nie.

kjv_text: Have mercy upon me, O LORD; for I am weak: O LORD, heal me; for my bones are vexed.
bsb_text: Be merciful to me, O LORD, for I am frail; heal me, O LORD, for my bones are in agony.
aov_text: Wees my genadig, HERE, want ek is verswak; maak my gesond, HERE, want my gebeente is verskrik.

kjv_text: My soul is also sore vexed: but thou, O LORD, how long?
bsb_text: My soul is deeply distressed. How long, O LORD, how long?
aov_text: Ja, my siel is baie verskrik; en U, HERE, tot hoe lank?

kjv_text: Return, O LORD, deliver my soul: oh save me for thy mercies' sake.
bsb_text: Turn, O LORD, and deliver my soul; save me because of Your loving devotion.
aov_text: Keer terug, HERE, red my siel; verlos my om u goedertierenheid ontwil.

kjv_text: For in death there is no remembrance of thee: in the grave who shall give thee thanks?
bsb_text: For there is no mention of You in death; who can praise You from Sheol?
aov_text: Want in die dood word aan U nie gedink nie; wie sal U loof in die doderyk?

kjv_text: I am weary with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.
bsb_text: I am weary from groaning; all night I flood my bed with weeping and drench my couch with tears.
aov_text: Ek is moeg van my gesug; elke nag laat ek my bed swem; ek deurweek my bed met my trane.

kjv_text: Mine eye is consumed because of grief; it waxeth old because of all mine enemies.
bsb_text: My eyes fail from grief; they grow dim because of all my foes.
aov_text: My oog het dof geword van verdriet; dit het swak geword vanweë al my teëstanders.

kjv_text: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; for the LORD hath heard the voice of my weeping.
bsb_text: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for the LORD has heard my weeping.
aov_text: Gaan weg van my, al julle werkers van ongeregtigheid, want die HERE het die stem van my geween gehoor.

kjv_text: The LORD hath heard my supplication; the LORD will receive my prayer.
bsb_text: The LORD has heard my cry for mercy; the LORD accepts my prayer.
aov_text: Die HERE het my smeking gehoor; die HERE neem my gebed aan.

kjv_text: Let all mine enemies be ashamed and sore vexed: let them return and be ashamed suddenly.
bsb_text: All my enemies will be ashamed and dismayed; they will turn back in sudden disgrace.
aov_text: Al my vyande sal beskaamd staan en baie verskrik word; hulle sal in ’n oomblik beskaamd omdraai.

kjv_text: Shiggaion of David, which he sang unto the LORD, concerning the words of Cush the Benjamite.
bsb_text: A Shiggaion of David, which he sang to the LORD concerning the words of Cush, a Benjamite.
aov_text: SJIGGAJŌN van Dawid wat hy tot eer van die HERE gesing het weens die woorde van Kus, die Benjaminiet.

kjv_text: O LORD my God, in thee do I put my trust: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me:
bsb_text: O LORD my God, I take refuge in You; save me and deliver me from all my pursuers,
aov_text: HERE, my God, by U skuil ek; verlos my van al my vervolgers en red my;

kjv_text: Lest he tear my soul like a lion, rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.
bsb_text: or they will shred my soul like a lion and tear me to pieces with no one to rescue me.
aov_text: sodat hy nie soos ’n leeu my verskeur en wegruk sonder dat iemand red nie.

kjv_text: O LORD my God, if I have done this; if there be iniquity in my hands;
bsb_text: O LORD my God, if I have done this, if injustice is on my hands,
aov_text: HERE, my God, as ek dit gedoen het, as daar onreg in my hande is,

kjv_text: If I have rewarded evil unto him that was at peace with me; (yea, I have delivered him that without cause is mine enemy:)
bsb_text: if I have rewarded my ally with evil, if I have plundered my foe without cause,
aov_text: as ek hóm kwaad aangedoen het wat in vrede met my geleef het (ja, ek het hom gered wat my sonder oorsaak vyandig was),

kjv_text: Let the enemy persecute my soul, and take it; yea, let him tread down my life upon the earth, and lay mine honour in the dust. Selah.
bsb_text: then may my enemy pursue me and overtake me; may he trample me to the ground and leave my honor in the dust. Selah
aov_text: mag die vyand my dan vervolg en inhaal en my lewe teen die grond vertrap en my eer in die stof laat woon. Sela.

kjv_text: Arise, O LORD, in thine anger, lift up thyself because of the rage of mine enemies: and awake for me to the judgment that thou hast commanded.
bsb_text: Arise, O LORD, in Your anger; rise up against the fury of my enemies. Awake, my God, and ordain judgment.
aov_text: Staan op, HERE, in u toorn, verhef U teen die grimmigheid van my teëstanders en ontwaak vir my, U wat die reg beveel het!

kjv_text: So shall the congregation of the people compass thee about: for their sakes therefore return thou on high.
bsb_text: Let the assembled peoples gather around You; take Your seat over them on high.
aov_text: En laat die vergadering van die volke U omring; keer dan bo hulle terug in die hoogte!

kjv_text: The LORD shall judge the people: judge me, O LORD, according to my righteousness, and according to mine integrity that is in me.
bsb_text: The LORD judges the peoples; vindicate me, O LORD, according to my righteousness and integrity.
aov_text: Die HERE oordeel die volke. Doen aan my reg, HERE, na my geregtigheid en na my onskuld wat by my is.

kjv_text: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end; but establish the just: for the righteous God trieth the hearts and reins.
bsb_text: Put an end to the evil of the wicked, but establish the righteous, O righteous God who searches hearts and minds.
aov_text: Laat tog die boosheid van die goddelose mense ’n einde neem, maar bevestig U die regverdige, ja, U wat harte en niere toets, o regverdige God!

kjv_text: My defence is of God, which saveth the upright in heart.
bsb_text: My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.
aov_text: My skild is by God wat die opregtes van hart verlos.

kjv_text: God judgeth the righteous, and God is angry with the wicked every day.
bsb_text: God is a righteous judge and a God who feels indignation each day.
aov_text: God is ’n regverdige regter, en ’n God wat elke dag toornig is.

kjv_text: If he turn not, he will whet his sword; he hath bent his bow, and made it ready.
bsb_text: If one does not repent, God will sharpen His sword; He has bent and strung His bow.
aov_text: As hy hom nie bekeer nie, maak Hy sy swaard skerp; Hy span sy boog en mik daarmee

kjv_text: He hath also prepared for him the instruments of death; he ordaineth his arrows against the persecutors.
bsb_text: He has prepared His deadly weapons; He ordains His arrows with fire.
aov_text: en berei vir hom dodelike werktuie; Hy maak sy pyle brandende wapens.

kjv_text: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity, and hath conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.
bsb_text: Behold, the wicked man travails with evil; he conceives trouble and births falsehood.
aov_text: Kyk, hy is in barensweë van onreg en is swanger van moeite; hy baar leuens.

kjv_text: He made a pit, and digged it, and is fallen into the ditch which he made.
bsb_text: He has dug a hole and hollowed it out; he has fallen into a pit of his own making.
aov_text: Hy het ’n kuil gegrawe en dit uitgehol; maar hy het geval in die vangkuil wat hy gemaak het.

kjv_text: His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate.
bsb_text: His trouble recoils on himself, and his violence falls on his own head.
aov_text: Die onheil wat hy gestig het, keer op sy hoof terug, en sy geweld kom op sy skedel neer.

kjv_text: I will praise the LORD according to his righteousness: and will sing praise to the name of the LORD most high.
bsb_text: I will thank the LORD for His righteousness and sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.
aov_text: Ek wil die HERE loof na sy geregtigheid en die Naam van die HERE, die Allerhoogste, psalmsing.

kjv_text: To the chief Musician upon Gittith, A Psalm of David.
bsb_text: For the choirmaster. According to Gittith. A Psalm of David.
aov_text: VIR die musiekleier; op die Gittiet. ’n Psalm van Dawid.

kjv_text: O LORD, our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth! who hast set thy glory above the heavens.
bsb_text: O LORD, our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth! You have set Your glory above the heavens.
aov_text: o HERE, onse Here, hoe heerlik is u Naam op die ganse aarde! U wat u majesteit gelê het op die hemele.

kjv_text: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou ordained strength because of thine enemies, that thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.
bsb_text: From the mouths of children and infants You have ordained praise on account of Your adversaries, to silence the enemy and avenger.
aov_text: Uit die mond van kinders en suiglinge het U sterkte gegrondves, om u teëstanders ontwil, om die vyand en wraakgierige stil te maak.

kjv_text: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;
bsb_text: When I behold Your heavens, the work of Your fingers, the moon and the stars, which You have set in place—
aov_text: As ek u hemel aanskou, die werk van u vingers, die maan en die sterre wat U toeberei het —

kjv_text: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?
bsb_text: what is man that You are mindful of him, or the son of man that You care for him?
aov_text: wat is die mens dat U aan hom dink, en die mensekind dat U hom besoek?

kjv_text: For thou hast made him a little lower than the angels, and hast crowned him with glory and honour.
bsb_text: You made him a little lower than the angels; You crowned him with glory and honor.
aov_text: U het hom ’n weinig minder gemaak as ’n goddelike wese en hom met eer en heerlikheid gekroon.

kjv_text: Thou madest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; thou hast put all things under his feet:
bsb_text: You made him ruler of the works of Your hands; You have placed everything under his feet:
aov_text: U laat hom heers oor die werke van u hande; U het alles onder sy voete gestel:

kjv_text: All sheep and oxen, yea, and the beasts of the field;
bsb_text: all sheep and oxen, and even the beasts of the field,
aov_text: skape en beeste, dié almal, en ook die diere van die veld,

kjv_text: The fowl of the air, and the fish of the sea, and whatsoever passeth through the paths of the seas.
bsb_text: the birds of the air and the fish of the sea, all that swim the paths of the seas.
aov_text: die voëls van die hemel en die visse van die see, wat trek deur die paaie van die see.

kjv_text: O LORD our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth!
bsb_text: O LORD, our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth!
aov_text: o HERE, onse Here, hoe heerlik is u Naam op die ganse aarde!

kjv_text: To the chief Musician upon Muthlabben, A Psalm of David.
bsb_text: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “The Death of the Son.” A Psalm of David.
aov_text: VIR die musiekleier; op die wysie van: „Sterf vir die Seun.” ’n Psalm van Dawid.

kjv_text: I will praise thee, O LORD, with my whole heart; I will shew forth all thy marvellous works.
bsb_text: I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart; I will recount all Your wonders.
aov_text: Ek wil die HERE loof met my hele hart; ek wil al u wonders vertel.

kjv_text: I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing praise to thy name, O thou most High.
bsb_text: I will be glad and rejoice in You; I will sing praise to Your name, O Most High.
aov_text: In U wil ek bly wees en juig; ek wil psalmsing tot eer van u Naam, o Allerhoogste,

kjv_text: When mine enemies are turned back, they shall fall and perish at thy presence.
bsb_text: When my enemies retreat, they stumble and perish before You.
aov_text: omdat my vyande agteruitwyk, struikel en omkom van voor u aangesig.

kjv_text: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; thou satest in the throne judging right.
bsb_text: For You have upheld my just cause; You sit on Your throne judging righteously.
aov_text: Want U het my reg en my regsaak behandel; U het gaan sit op die troon, o regverdige regter!

kjv_text: Thou hast rebuked the heathen, thou hast destroyed the wicked, thou hast put out their name for ever and ever.
bsb_text: You have rebuked the nations; You have destroyed the wicked; You have erased their name forever and ever.
aov_text: U het die heidene gedreig, die goddelose laat omkom, hulle naam uitgedelg vir ewig en altyd.

kjv_text: O thou enemy, destructions are come to a perpetual end: and thou hast destroyed cities; their memorial is perished with them.
bsb_text: The enemy has come to eternal ruin, and You have uprooted their cities; the very memory of them has vanished.
aov_text: Die vyande het omgekom—puinhope vir ewig; ook die stede wat U verwoes het; hulle gedagtenis, ja, dié het vergaan.

kjv_text: But the LORD shall endure for ever: he hath prepared his throne for judgment.
bsb_text: But the LORD abides forever; He has established His throne for judgment.
aov_text: Maar die HERE sit vir ewig; Hy het sy troon reggesit vir die oordeel.

kjv_text: And he shall judge the world in righteousness, he shall minister judgment to the people in uprightness.
bsb_text: He judges the world with justice; He governs the people with equity.
aov_text: En Hy self sal die wêreld oordeel in geregtigheid en die volke vonnis met reg.

kjv_text: The LORD also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.
bsb_text: The LORD is a refuge for the oppressed, a stronghold in times of trouble.
aov_text: So is die HERE dan ’n rotsvesting vir die verdrukte, ’n rotsvesting in tye van benoudheid.

kjv_text: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, LORD, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.
bsb_text: Those who know Your name trust in You, for You, O LORD, have not forsaken those who seek You.
aov_text: En hulle wat u Naam ken, sal op U vertrou, omdat U die wat U soek, nie verlaat nie, o HERE!

kjv_text: Sing praises to the LORD, which dwelleth in Zion: declare among the people his doings.
bsb_text: Sing praises to the LORD, who dwells in Zion; proclaim His deeds among the nations.
aov_text: Psalmsing tot eer van die HERE wat op Sion woon; verkondig onder die volke sy dade.

kjv_text: When he maketh inquisition for blood, he remembereth them: he forgetteth not the cry of the humble.
bsb_text: For the Avenger of bloodshed remembers; He does not ignore the cry of the afflicted.
aov_text: Want Hy wat die bloed soek, dink aan hulle; Hy vergeet die geroep van die ellendiges nie.

kjv_text: Have mercy upon me, O LORD; consider my trouble which I suffer of them that hate me, thou that liftest me up from the gates of death:
bsb_text: Be merciful to me, O LORD; see how my enemies afflict me! Lift me up from the gates of death,
aov_text: Wees my genadig, HERE, aanskou my ellende vanweë my haters, U wat my verhef uit die poorte van die dood;

kjv_text: That I may shew forth all thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion: I will rejoice in thy salvation.
bsb_text: that I may declare all Your praises—that within the gates of Daughter Zion I may rejoice in Your salvation.
aov_text: sodat ek al u roemryke dade kan vertel, in die poorte van die dogter van Sion kan juig oor u heil.

kjv_text: The heathen are sunk down in the pit that they made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.
bsb_text: The nations have fallen into a pit of their making; their feet are caught in the net they have hidden.
aov_text: Die heidene het gesink in die kuil wat hulle gemaak het; hulle voet is gevang in die net wat hulle gespan het.

kjv_text: The LORD is known by the judgment which he executeth: the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah.
bsb_text: The LORD is known by the justice He brings; the wicked are ensnared by the work of their hands. Higgaion Selah
aov_text: Die HERE het Hom bekend gemaak; Hy het strafgerig geoefen; die goddelose is verstrik in die werk van sy hande. Higgajōn. Sela.

kjv_text: The wicked shall be turned into hell, and all the nations that forget God.
bsb_text: The wicked will return to Sheol—all the nations who forget God.
aov_text: Die goddelose sal teruggaan na die doderyk, al die heidene wat God vergeet.

kjv_text: For the needy shall not alway be forgotten: the expectation of the poor shall not perish for ever.
bsb_text: For the needy will not always be forgotten; nor the hope of the oppressed forever dashed.
aov_text: Want die behoeftige sal nie vir altyd vergeet word, die verwagting van die ellendiges nie vir ewig verlore gaan nie.

kjv_text: Arise, O LORD; let not man prevail: let the heathen be judged in thy sight.
bsb_text: Rise up, O LORD, do not let man prevail; let the nations be judged in Your presence.
aov_text: Staan op, HERE, laat die mens nie sterk word nie; laat die heidene voor u aangesig geoordeel word!

kjv_text: Put them in fear, O LORD: that the nations may know themselves to be but men. Selah.
bsb_text: Lay terror upon them, O LORD; let the nations know they are but men. Selah
aov_text: o HERE, jaag hulle skrik aan; laat die heidene weet, hulle is mense! Sela.

kjv_text: Why standest thou afar off, O LORD? why hidest thou thyself in times of trouble?
bsb_text: Why, O LORD, do You stand far off? Why do You hide in times of trouble?
aov_text: O HERE, waarom staan U so ver weg en hou U verborge in tye van benoudheid?

kjv_text: The wicked in his pride doth persecute the poor: let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined.
bsb_text: In pride the wicked pursue the needy; let them be caught in the schemes they devise.
aov_text: In sy trotsheid vervolg die goddelose die ellendige. Laat hulle gegryp word in die listige planne wat hulle uitgedink het!

kjv_text: For the wicked boasteth of his heart's desire, and blesseth the covetous, whom the LORD abhorreth.
bsb_text: For the wicked man boasts in the cravings of his heart; he blesses the greedy and reviles the LORD.
aov_text: Want die goddelose juig oor die begeerte van sy siel; en hy seën hom wat onregverdige wins maak, hy verag die HERE.

kjv_text: The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek after God: God is not in all his thoughts.
bsb_text: In his pride the wicked man does not seek Him; in all his schemes there is no God.
aov_text: Die goddelose, met sy neus in die hoogte, sê: Hy ondersoek nie: daar is geen God nie—dit is al sy gedagtes!

kjv_text: His ways are always grievous; thy judgments are far above out of his sight: as for all his enemies, he puffeth at them.
bsb_text: He is secure in his ways at all times; Your lofty judgments are far from him; he sneers at all his foes.
aov_text: Sy weë is altyd voorspoedig; hoog daarbo is u gerigte, weg van hom af; al sy teëstanders—hy blaas op hulle.

kjv_text: He hath said in his heart, I shall not be moved: for I shall never be in adversity.
bsb_text: He says to himself, “I will not be moved; from age to age I am free of distress.”
aov_text: Hy sê in sy hart: Ek sal nie wankel nie; van geslag tot geslag is ek die een wat nie in die ongeluk sal wees nie.

kjv_text: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: under his tongue is mischief and vanity.
bsb_text: His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and violence; trouble and malice are under his tongue.
aov_text: Sy mond is vol van vloek en van bedrog en verdrukking; onder sy tong is moeite en onreg.

kjv_text: He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places doth he murder the innocent: his eyes are privily set against the poor.
bsb_text: He lies in wait near the villages; in ambush he slays the innocent; his eyes watch in stealth for the helpless.
aov_text: Hy sit in die hinderlae by die dorpe; in skuilplekke maak hy die onskuldige dood; sy oë loer op die ongelukkige.

kjv_text: He lieth in wait secretly as a lion in his den: he lieth in wait to catch the poor: he doth catch the poor, when he draweth him into his net.
bsb_text: He lies in wait like a lion in a thicket; he lurks to seize the oppressed; he catches the lowly in his net.
aov_text: Hy loer in die skuilhoek soos ’n leeu in sy lêplek; hy loer om die ellendige te vang; hy vang die ellendige deur sy net toe te trek;

kjv_text: He croucheth, and humbleth himself, that the poor may fall by his strong ones.
bsb_text: They are crushed and beaten down; the hapless fall prey to his strength.
aov_text: en verbryseld sink dié terneer, en die ongelukkiges val in sy mag.

kjv_text: He hath said in his heart, God hath forgotten: he hideth his face; he will never see it.
bsb_text: He says to himself, “God has forgotten; He hides His face and never sees.”
aov_text: Hy sê in sy hart: God vergeet dit; Hy verberg sy aangesig; vir ewig sien Hy dit nie.

kjv_text: Arise, O LORD; O God, lift up thine hand: forget not the humble.
bsb_text: Arise, O LORD! Lift up Your hand, O God! Do not forget the helpless.
aov_text: Staan op, HERE! o God, hef u hand op; vergeet die ellendiges nie!

kjv_text: Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God? he hath said in his heart, Thou wilt not require it.
bsb_text: Why has the wicked man renounced God? He says to himself, “You will never call me to account.”
aov_text: Die goddelose, waarom verag hy God en sê in sy hart: U soek dit nie?

kjv_text: Thou hast seen it; for thou beholdest mischief and spite, to requite it with thy hand: the poor committeth himself unto thee; thou art the helper of the fatherless.
bsb_text: But You have regarded trouble and grief; You see to repay it by Your hand. The victim entrusts himself to You; You are the helper of the fatherless.
aov_text: U het dit gesien; want U aanskou die moeite en verdriet, sodat ’n mens dit in u hand sal gee. Aan U gee die ongelukkige dit oor; U was ’n helper van die wees.

kjv_text: Break thou the arm of the wicked and the evil man: seek out his wickedness till thou find none.
bsb_text: Break the arm of the wicked and evildoer; call him to account for his wickedness until none is left to be found.
aov_text: Verbreek die arm van die goddelose en slegte; besoek sy goddeloosheid totdat U niks vind nie!

kjv_text: The LORD is King for ever and ever: the heathen are perished out of his land.
bsb_text: The LORD is King forever and ever; the nations perish from His land.
aov_text: Die HERE is Koning vir ewig en altyd; die heidene het vergaan uit sy land.

kjv_text: LORD, thou hast heard the desire of the humble: thou wilt prepare their heart, thou wilt cause thine ear to hear:
bsb_text: You have heard, O LORD, the desire of the humble; You will strengthen their hearts. You will incline Your ear,
aov_text: HERE, U het die begeerte van die ootmoediges gehoor; U sal hulle hart versterk, u oor sal luister

kjv_text: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that the man of the earth may no more oppress.
bsb_text: to vindicate the fatherless and oppressed, that the men of the earth may strike terror no more.
aov_text: om aan die wees en verdrukte reg te doen. Geen mens uit die aarde sal langer voortgaan om skrik aan te jaag nie.

kjv_text: To the chief Musician, [A Psalm] of David. In the LORD put I my trust: how say ye to my soul, Flee as a bird to your mountain?
bsb_text: For the choirmaster. Of David. In the LORD I take refuge. How then can you say to me: “Flee like a bird to your mountain!
aov_text: VIR die musiekleier. ’n Psalm van Dawid. By die HERE skuil ek. Hoe kan julle dan vir my sê: Vlug na julle berg soos ’n voël!

kjv_text: For, lo, the wicked bend their bow, they make ready their arrow upon the string, that they may privily shoot at the upright in heart.
bsb_text: For behold, the wicked bend their bows. They set their arrow on the string to shoot from the shadows at the upright in heart.
aov_text: Want kyk, die goddelose span die boog; hulle het hul pyl op die snaar reggesit om in die donker te skiet na die opregtes van hart.

kjv_text: If the foundations be destroyed, what can the righteous do?
bsb_text: If the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do?”
aov_text: As die fondamente omgegooi word, wat kan die regverdige doen?

kjv_text: The LORD is in his holy temple, the LORD's throne is in heaven: his eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.
bsb_text: The LORD is in His holy temple; the LORD is on His heavenly throne. His eyes are watching closely; they examine the sons of men.
aov_text: Die HERE is in sy heilige paleis; die troon van die HERE is in die hemel; sy oë sien, sy ooglede toets die mensekinders.

kjv_text: The LORD trieth the righteous: but the wicked and him that loveth violence his soul hateth.
bsb_text: The LORD tests the righteous and the wicked; His soul hates the lover of violence.
