kjv_text: For all his judgments were before me, and I did not put away his statutes from me.
bsb_text: For all His ordinances are before me; I have not disregarded His statutes.
aov_text: want al sy verordeninge was voor my, en sy insettinge het ek nie van my verwyder nie.

kjv_text: I was also upright before him, and I kept myself from mine iniquity.
bsb_text: And I have been blameless before Him and kept myself from iniquity.
aov_text: Maar ek was opreg by Hom, en ek was op my hoede vir my ongeregtigheid.

kjv_text: Therefore hath the LORD recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.
bsb_text: So the LORD has repaid me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in His sight.
aov_text: So het die HERE my dan vergelde na my geregtigheid, na die reinheid van my hande, voor sy oë.

kjv_text: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful; with an upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright;
bsb_text: To the faithful You show Yourself faithful, to the blameless You show Yourself blameless;
aov_text: By die liefderyke betoon U Uself liefderyk, by die opregte man opreg,

kjv_text: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself froward.
bsb_text: to the pure You show Yourself pure, but to the crooked You show Yourself shrewd.
aov_text: by die reine rein; maar by die valse betoon U Uself verkeerd.

kjv_text: For thou wilt save the afflicted people; but wilt bring down high looks.
bsb_text: For You save an afflicted people, but You humble those with haughty eyes.
aov_text: Want U verlos die verdrukte volk; maar U verneder die oë wat hoog is.

kjv_text: For thou wilt light my candle: the LORD my God will enlighten my darkness.
bsb_text: For You, O LORD, light my lamp; my God lights up my darkness.
aov_text: Want U laat my lamp skyn; die HERE my God laat my duisternis opklaar.

kjv_text: For by thee I have run through a troop; and by my God have I leaped over a wall.
bsb_text: For in You I can charge an army, and with my God I can scale a wall.
aov_text: Want met U loop ek ’n bende storm, en met my God spring ek oor ’n muur.

kjv_text: As for God, his way is perfect: the word of the LORD is tried: he is a buckler to all those that trust in him.
bsb_text: As for God, His way is perfect; the word of the LORD is flawless. He is a shield to all who take refuge in Him.
aov_text: Die weg van God is volmaak; die woord van die HERE is gelouter; Hy is ’n skild vir almal wat by Hom skuil.

kjv_text: For who is God save the LORD? or who is a rock save our God?
bsb_text: For who is God besides the LORD? And who is the Rock except our God?
aov_text: Want wie is God buiten die HERE, en wie is ’n rots behalwe onse God?

kjv_text: It is God that girdeth me with strength, and maketh my way perfect.
bsb_text: It is God who arms me with strength and makes my way clear.
aov_text: God is dit wat my met krag omgord en my weg volkome maak.

kjv_text: He maketh my feet like hinds' feet, and setteth me upon my high places.
bsb_text: He makes my feet like those of a deer and stations me upon the heights.
aov_text: Hy maak my voete soos dié van herte en laat my staan op my hoogtes.

kjv_text: He teacheth my hands to war, so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.
bsb_text: He trains my hands for battle; my arms can bend a bow of bronze.
aov_text: Hy leer my hande om oorlog te voer, sodat my arms ’n koperboog span.

kjv_text: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy right hand hath holden me up, and thy gentleness hath made me great.
bsb_text: You have given me Your shield of salvation; Your right hand upholds me, and Your gentleness exalts me.
aov_text: Ook het U my die skild van u uitredding gegee, en u regterhand het my ondersteun, en u neerbuigende goedheid het my groot gemaak.

kjv_text: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, that my feet did not slip.
bsb_text: You broaden the path beneath me so that my ankles do not give way.
aov_text: U het my voetstap ruim gemaak onder my, en my enkels het nie gewankel nie.

kjv_text: I have pursued mine enemies, and overtaken them: neither did I turn again till they were consumed.
bsb_text: I pursued my enemies and overtook them; I did not turn back until they were consumed.
aov_text: Ek het my vyande agtervolg en hulle ingehaal, en ek het nie teruggekom voordat ek hulle vernietig het nie.

kjv_text: I have wounded them that they were not able to rise: they are fallen under my feet.
bsb_text: I crushed them so they could not rise; they have fallen under my feet.
aov_text: Ek het hulle verbrysel, sodat hulle nie kon opstaan nie; hulle het geval onder my voete.

kjv_text: For thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle: thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me.
bsb_text: You have armed me with strength for battle; You have subdued my foes beneath me.
aov_text: En U het my met krag omgord vir die stryd; U het my teëstanders onder my laat buk.

kjv_text: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies; that I might destroy them that hate me.
bsb_text: You have made my enemies retreat before me; I put an end to those who hated me.
aov_text: En U het my vyande vir my laat vlug; en my haters, dié het ek vernietig.

kjv_text: They cried, but there was none to save them: even unto the LORD, but he answered them not.
bsb_text: They cried for help, but there was no one to save them—to the LORD, but He did not answer.
aov_text: Hulle het geroep om hulp, maar daar was geen verlosser nie—tot die HERE, maar Hy het hulle nie geantwoord nie.

kjv_text: Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind: I did cast them out as the dirt in the streets.
bsb_text: I ground them as dust in the face of the wind; I trampled them like mud in the streets.
aov_text: Toe het ek hulle vermaal soos stof voor die wind; ek het hulle uitgegooi soos modder van die strate.

kjv_text: Thou hast delivered me from the strivings of the people; and thou hast made me the head of the heathen: a people whom I have not known shall serve me.
bsb_text: You have delivered me from the strife of the people; You have made me the head of nations; a people I had not known shall serve me.
aov_text: U het my gered uit die getwis van die volk; U het my ’n hoof gemaak van nasies; ’n volk wat ek nie geken het nie, het my gedien.

kjv_text: As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me: the strangers shall submit themselves unto me.
bsb_text: When they hear me, they obey me; foreigners cower before me.
aov_text: Sodra hulle van my gehoor het, was hulle my gehoorsaam; uitlanders het kruipende na my gekom.

kjv_text: The strangers shall fade away, and be afraid out of their close places.
bsb_text: Foreigners lose heart and come trembling from their strongholds.
aov_text: Uitlanders word kragteloos en kom met siddering uit hulle vestings.

kjv_text: The LORD liveth; and blessed be my rock; and let the God of my salvation be exalted.
bsb_text: The LORD lives, and blessed be my Rock! And may the God of my salvation be exalted—
aov_text: Die HERE leef! En geloofd sy my rots, en laat verhoog wees die God van my heil!

kjv_text: It is God that avengeth me, and subdueth the people under me.
bsb_text: the God who avenges me and subdues nations beneath me,
aov_text: Die God wat my die wraak gee en volke aan my onderwerp;

kjv_text: He delivereth me from mine enemies: yea, thou liftest me up above those that rise up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.
bsb_text: who delivers me from my enemies. You exalt me above my foes; You rescue me from violent men.
aov_text: wat my red van my vyande; ja, U verhef my bo my teëstanders; U bevry my van die man van geweld.

kjv_text: Therefore will I give thanks unto thee, O LORD, among the heathen, and sing praises unto thy name.
bsb_text: Therefore I will praise You, O LORD, among the nations; I will sing praises to Your name.
aov_text: Daarom wil ek U loof, o HERE, onder die nasies, en tot eer van u Naam wil ek psalmsing.

kjv_text: Great deliverance giveth he to his king; and sheweth mercy to his anointed, to David, and to his seed for evermore.
bsb_text: Great salvation He brings to His king. He shows loving devotion to His anointed, to David and his descendants forever.
aov_text: Hy wat die verlossinge van sy koning groot maak en goedertierenheid bewys aan sy gesalfde, aan Dawid en aan sy nageslag tot in ewigheid.

kjv_text: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.
bsb_text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David.
aov_text: VIR die musiekleier. ’n Psalm van Dawid.

kjv_text: The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.
bsb_text: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of His hands.
aov_text: Die hemele vertel die eer van God, en die uitspansel verkondig die werk van sy hande.

kjv_text: Day unto day uttereth speech, and night unto night sheweth knowledge.
bsb_text: Day after day they pour forth speech; night after night they reveal knowledge.
aov_text: Die een dag stort vir die ander ’n boodskap uit, en die een nag kondig vir die ander kennis aan:

kjv_text: There is no speech nor language, where their voice is not heard.
bsb_text: Without speech or language, without a sound to be heard,
aov_text: daar is geen spraak en daar is geen woorde nie—onhoorbaar is hulle stem.

kjv_text: Their line is gone out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun,
bsb_text: their voice has gone out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world. In the heavens He has pitched a tent for the sun.
aov_text: Hulle meetsnoer gaan uit oor die hele aarde, en hulle woorde tot by die einde van die wêreld. Vir die son het Hy daarin ’n tent gemaak;

kjv_text: Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, and rejoiceth as a strong man to run a race.
bsb_text: Like a bridegroom emerging from his chamber, like a champion rejoicing to run his course,
aov_text: en dié is soos ’n bruidegom wat uitgaan uit sy slaapkamer; hy is bly soos ’n held om die pad te loop.

kjv_text: His going forth is from the end of the heaven, and his circuit unto the ends of it: and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.
bsb_text: it rises at one end of the heavens and runs its circuit to the other; nothing is deprived of its warmth.
aov_text: Sy uitgang is van die einde van die hemel af, en sy omloop tot by die eindes daarvan, en niks is verborge vir sy hitte nie.

kjv_text: The law of the LORD is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of the LORD is sure, making wise the simple.
bsb_text: The Law of the LORD is perfect, reviving the soul; the testimony of the LORD is trustworthy, making wise the simple.
aov_text: Die wet van die HERE is volmaak: dit verkwik die siel; die getuienis van die HERE is gewis: dit gee wysheid aan die eenvoudige.

kjv_text: The statutes of the LORD are right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of the LORD is pure, enlightening the eyes.
bsb_text: The precepts of the LORD are right, bringing joy to the heart; the commandments of the LORD are radiant, giving light to the eyes.
aov_text: Die bevele van die HERE is reg: hulle verbly die hart; die gebod van die HERE is suiwer: dit verlig die oë.

kjv_text: The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring for ever: the judgments of the LORD are true and righteous altogether.
bsb_text: The fear of the LORD is pure, enduring forever; the judgments of the LORD are true, being altogether righteous.
aov_text: Die vrees van die HERE is rein: dit bestaan tot in ewigheid; die verordeninge van die HERE is waarheid—tesame is hulle regverdig.

kjv_text: More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold: sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.
bsb_text: They are more precious than gold, than much pure gold; they are sweeter than honey, than honey from the comb.
aov_text: Hulle is begeerliker as goud, ja, as baie fyn goud; en soeter as heuning en heuningstroop.

kjv_text: Moreover by them is thy servant warned: and in keeping of them there is great reward.
bsb_text: By them indeed Your servant is warned; in keeping them is great reward.
aov_text: Ook word u kneg daardeur gewaarsku; in die onderhouding daarvan is groot loon.

kjv_text: Who can understand his errors? cleanse thou me from secret faults.
bsb_text: Who can discern his own errors? Cleanse me from my hidden faults.
aov_text: Die afdwalinge—wie bemerk hulle? Spreek my vry van die wat verborge is.

kjv_text: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous sins; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be innocent from the great transgression.
bsb_text: Keep Your servant also from willful sins; may they not rule over me. Then I will be blameless and cleansed of great transgression.
aov_text: Hou u kneg ook terug van moedswillige sondes; laat dit nie oor my heers nie. Dan sal ek onbestraflik wees en vry van groot oortreding.

kjv_text: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer.
bsb_text: May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be pleasing in Your sight, O LORD, my Rock and my Redeemer.
aov_text: Laat die woorde van my mond en die oordenking van my hart welbehaaglik wees voor u aangesig, o HERE, my rots en my verlosser!

kjv_text: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.
bsb_text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David.
aov_text: VIR die musiekleier. ’n Psalm van Dawid.

kjv_text: The LORD hear thee in the day of trouble; the name of the God of Jacob defend thee;
bsb_text: May the LORD answer you in the day of trouble; may the name of the God of Jacob protect you.
aov_text: Mag die HERE u verhoor in die dag van benoudheid! Mag die Naam van die God van Jakob u beskerm!

kjv_text: Send thee help from the sanctuary, and strengthen thee out of Zion;
bsb_text: May He send you help from the sanctuary and sustain you from Zion.
aov_text: Mag Hy u hulp stuur uit die heiligdom en u ondersteun uit Sion!

kjv_text: Remember all thy offerings, and accept thy burnt sacrifice; Selah.
bsb_text: May He remember all your gifts and look favorably on your burnt offerings. Selah
aov_text: Mag Hy dink aan al u spysoffers en u brandoffer met welgevalle aansien! Sela.

kjv_text: Grant thee according to thine own heart, and fulfil all thy counsel.
bsb_text: May He give you the desires of your heart and make all your plans succeed.
aov_text: Mag Hy u gee na u hart en al u voornemens vervul!

kjv_text: We will rejoice in thy salvation, and in the name of our God we will set up our banners: the LORD fulfil all thy petitions.
bsb_text: May we shout for joy at your victory and raise a banner in the name of our God. May the LORD grant all your petitions.
aov_text: Ons wil juig oor u oorwinning en die vaandels opsteek in die Naam van onse God. Mag die HERE al u begeertes vervul!

kjv_text: Now know I that the LORD saveth his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand.
bsb_text: Now I know that the LORD saves His anointed; He answers him from His holy heaven with the saving power of His right hand.
aov_text: Nou weet ek dat die HERE sy gesalfde verlos; Hy sal hom verhoor uit sy heilige hemel met magtige dade van verlossing van sy regterhand.

kjv_text: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the LORD our God.
bsb_text: Some trust in chariots and others in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.
aov_text: Sommige roem op strydwaens en ander op perde, maar óns sal roem op die Naam van die HERE onse God.

kjv_text: They are brought down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright.
bsb_text: They collapse and fall, but we rise up and stand firm.
aov_text: Húlle het inmekaargesak en geval, maar óns het opgestaan en ons weer opgerig.

kjv_text: Save, LORD: let the king hear us when we call.
bsb_text: O LORD, save the king. Answer us on the day we call.
aov_text: HERE, verlos die koning! Mag Hy ons verhoor op die dag as ons roep!

kjv_text: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.
bsb_text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David.
aov_text: VIR die musiekleier. ’n Psalm van Dawid.

kjv_text: The king shall joy in thy strength, O LORD; and in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!
bsb_text: O LORD, the king rejoices in Your strength. How greatly he exults in Your salvation!
aov_text: o HERE, die koning is bly oor u sterkte, en hoe baie juig hy oor u hulp!

kjv_text: Thou hast given him his heart's desire, and hast not withholden the request of his lips. Selah.
bsb_text: You have granted his heart’s desire and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah
aov_text: U het hom die wens van sy hart gegee en die begeerte van sy lippe nie geweier nie. Sela.

kjv_text: For thou preventest him with the blessings of goodness: thou settest a crown of pure gold on his head.
bsb_text: For You welcomed him with rich blessings; You placed on his head a crown of pure gold.
aov_text: Want U kom hom tegemoet met seëninge van die goeie; op sy hoof sit U ’n kroon van fyn goud.

kjv_text: He asked life of thee, and thou gavest it him, even length of days for ever and ever.
bsb_text: He asked You for life, and You granted it—length of days, forever and ever.
aov_text: Die lewe het hy van U begeer; U het hom dit gegee: lengte van dae, vir ewig en altyd.

kjv_text: His glory is great in thy salvation: honour and majesty hast thou laid upon him.
bsb_text: Great is his glory in Your salvation; You bestow on him splendor and majesty.
aov_text: Groot is sy eer deur u hulp; majesteit en heerlikheid het U op hom gelê.

kjv_text: For thou hast made him most blessed for ever: thou hast made him exceeding glad with thy countenance.
bsb_text: For You grant him blessings forever; You cheer him with joy in Your presence.
aov_text: Want U maak hom baie geseënd vir ewig; U maak hom bly met vreugde by u aangesig.

kjv_text: For the king trusteth in the LORD, and through the mercy of the most High he shall not be moved.
bsb_text: For the king trusts in the LORD; through the loving devotion of the Most High, he will not be shaken.
aov_text: Want die koning vertrou op die HERE, en deur die goedertierenheid van die Allerhoogste sal hy nie wankel nie.

kjv_text: Thine hand shall find out all thine enemies: thy right hand shall find out those that hate thee.
bsb_text: Your hand will apprehend all Your enemies; Your right hand will seize those who hate You.
aov_text: U hand sal al u vyande vind; u regterhand sal u haters vind.

kjv_text: Thou shalt make them as a fiery oven in the time of thine anger: the LORD shall swallow them up in his wrath, and the fire shall devour them.
bsb_text: You will place them in a fiery furnace at the time of Your appearing. In His wrath the LORD will engulf them, and the fire will consume them.
aov_text: U sal hulle maak soos ’n vurige oond as U verskyn; die HERE sal hulle verslind in sy toorn, en vuur sal hulle verteer.

kjv_text: Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.
bsb_text: You will wipe their descendants from the earth, and their offspring from the sons of men.
aov_text: U sal hulle vrug van die aarde af verdelg en hulle nageslag van die mensekinders af weg.

kjv_text: For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device, which they are not able to perform.
bsb_text: Though they intend You harm, the schemes they devise will not prevail.
aov_text: Want hulle het U met onheil bedreig; hulle het ’n listige plan uitgedink sonder om iets uit te rig.

kjv_text: Therefore shalt thou make them turn their back, when thou shalt make ready thine arrows upon thy strings against the face of them.
bsb_text: For You will put them to flight when Your bow is trained upon them.
aov_text: Want U sal hulle dwing om te vlug; met u boogsnare sal u mik op hulle gesig.

kjv_text: Be thou exalted, LORD, in thine own strength: so will we sing and praise thy power.
bsb_text: Be exalted, O LORD, in Your strength; we will sing and praise Your power.
aov_text: Verhef U, HERE, in u sterkte; ons wil u heldekrag eer met psalmgesang!

kjv_text: To the chief Musician upon Aijeleth Shahar, A Psalm of David.
bsb_text: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “The Doe of the Dawn.” A Psalm of David.
aov_text: VIR die musiekleier; op die wysie van: „Die hert van die dageraad.” ’n Psalm van Dawid.

kjv_text: My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me? why art thou so far from helping me, and from the words of my roaring?
bsb_text: My God, my God, why have You forsaken me? Why are You so far from saving me, so far from my words of groaning?
aov_text: My God, my God, waarom het U my verlaat, ver van my hulp, van die woorde van my gebrul?

kjv_text: O my God, I cry in the day time, but thou hearest not; and in the night season, and am not silent.
bsb_text: I cry out by day, O my God, but You do not answer, and by night, but I have no rest.
aov_text: My God, ek roep bedags, maar U antwoord nie; en snags, en ek kan nie swyg nie.

kjv_text: But thou art holy, O thou that inhabitest the praises of Israel.
bsb_text: Yet You are holy, enthroned on the praises of Israel.
aov_text: Tog is U die Heilige wat woon onder die lofsange van Israel!

kjv_text: Our fathers trusted in thee: they trusted, and thou didst deliver them.
bsb_text: In You our fathers trusted; they trusted and You delivered them.
aov_text: Op U het ons vaders vertrou; hulle het vertrou, en U het hulle uitgered.

kjv_text: They cried unto thee, and were delivered: they trusted in thee, and were not confounded.
bsb_text: They cried out to You and were set free; they trusted in You and were not disappointed.
aov_text: Hulle het U aangeroep en het ontvlug; op U het hulle vertrou en nie beskaamd gestaan nie.

kjv_text: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised of the people.
bsb_text: But I am a worm and not a man, scorned by men and despised by the people.
aov_text: Maar ek is ’n wurm en geen man nie, ’n smaad van die mense en verag deur die volk.

kjv_text: All they that see me laugh me to scorn: they shoot out the lip, they shake the head, saying,
bsb_text: All who see me mock me; they sneer and shake their heads:
aov_text: Almal wat my sien, spot met my; hulle steek die lip uit, hulle skud die hoof en sê:

kjv_text: He trusted on the LORD that he would deliver him: let him deliver him, seeing he delighted in him.
bsb_text: “He trusts in the LORD, let the LORD deliver him; let the LORD rescue him, since He delights in him.”
aov_text: Laat dit aan die HERE oor! Laat Hy hom red, laat Hy hom bevry: Hy het mos behae in hom!

kjv_text: But thou art he that took me out of the womb: thou didst make me hope when I was upon my mother's breasts.
bsb_text: Yet You brought me forth from the womb; You made me secure at my mother’s breast.
aov_text: Ja, U is dit wat my uit die moederskoot uitgetrek het, wat my veilig laat rus het aan my moeder se bors.

kjv_text: I was cast upon thee from the womb: thou art my God from my mother's belly.
bsb_text: From birth I was cast upon You; from my mother’s womb You have been my God.
aov_text: Aan U is ek oorgegee van die geboorte af; van die skoot van my moeder af is U my God.

kjv_text: Be not far from me; for trouble is near; for there is none to help.
bsb_text: Be not far from me, for trouble is near and there is no one to help.
aov_text: Wees nie ver van my af nie, want die nood is naby, want daar is geen helper nie.

kjv_text: Many bulls have compassed me: strong bulls of Bashan have beset me round.
bsb_text: Many bulls surround me; strong bulls of Bashan encircle me.
aov_text: Baie stiere het my omsingel, sterkes van Basan het my omring.

kjv_text: They gaped upon me with their mouths, as a ravening and a roaring lion.
bsb_text: They open their jaws against me like lions that roar and maul.
aov_text: Hulle het hul mond teen my oopgespalk soos ’n leeu wat verskeur en brul.

kjv_text: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint: my heart is like wax; it is melted in the midst of my bowels.
bsb_text: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are disjointed. My heart is like wax; it melts away within me.
aov_text: Ek is uitgestort soos water; al my beendere raak los; my hart het soos was geword; dit het gesmelt binne-in my ingewande.

kjv_text: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; and my tongue cleaveth to my jaws; and thou hast brought me into the dust of death.
bsb_text: My strength is dried up like a potsherd, and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You lay me in the dust of death.
aov_text: My krag is verdroog soos ’n potskerf, en my tong kleef aan my verhemelte; en U lê my neer in die stof van die dood.

kjv_text: For dogs have compassed me: the assembly of the wicked have inclosed me: they pierced my hands and my feet.
bsb_text: For dogs surround me; a band of evil men encircles me; they have pierced my hands and feet.
aov_text: Want honde het my omsingel; ’n bende kwaaddoeners het my omring; hulle het my hande en my voete deurgrawe.

kjv_text: I may tell all my bones: they look and stare upon me.
bsb_text: I can count all my bones; they stare and gloat over me.
aov_text: Al my beendere kan ek tel; húlle kyk, hulle sien met welgevalle op my neer!

kjv_text: They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.
bsb_text: They divide my garments among them and cast lots for my clothing.
aov_text: Hulle verdeel my klere onder mekaar en werp die lot oor my gewaad.

aov_text: Samek. Die verborgenheid van die HERE is vir die wat Hom vrees, en sy verbond om hulle dit bekend te maak.

kjv_text: Mine eyes are ever toward the LORD; for he shall pluck my feet out of the net.
bsb_text: My eyes are always on the LORD, for He will free my feet from the mesh.
aov_text: Ajin. My oë is altyddeur op die HERE, want Hý sal my voete uit die net uitlei.

kjv_text: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I am desolate and afflicted.

aov_text: Pe. Wend U tot my en wees my genadig, want ek is eensaam en ellendig.

bsb_text: Of David. The LORD is my light and my salvation—whom shall I fear? The LORD is the stronghold of my life—whom shall I dread?

bsb_text: A horse is a vain hope for salvation; even its great strength cannot save.

kjv_text: Behold, the eye of the LORD is upon them that fear him, upon them that hope in his mercy;
bsb_text: Surely the eyes of the LORD are on those who fear Him, on those whose hope is in His loving devotion
aov_text: Kyk, die oog van die HERE is op die wat Hom vrees, op die wat op sy goedertierenheid wag;

kjv_text: To deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.
bsb_text: to deliver them from death and keep them alive in famine.
aov_text: om hulle siel te red van die dood en hulle in die lewe te hou in hongersnood.

kjv_text: Our soul waiteth for the LORD: he is our help and our shield.
bsb_text: Our soul waits for the LORD; He is our help and our shield.
aov_text: Ons siel wag op die HERE; Hy is ons hulp en ons skild;

kjv_text: For our heart shall rejoice in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.
bsb_text: For our hearts rejoice in Him, since we trust in His holy name.
aov_text: want ons hart is bly in Hom, omdat ons op sy heilige Naam vertrou.

kjv_text: Let thy mercy, O LORD, be upon us, according as we hope in thee.
bsb_text: May Your loving devotion rest on us, O LORD, as we put our hope in You.
aov_text: Laat u goedertierenheid, HERE, oor ons wees net soos ons op U wag!

kjv_text: [A Psalm] of David, when he changed his behaviour before Abimelech; who drove him away, and he departed.
bsb_text: Of David, when he pretended to be insane before Abimelech, so that the king drove him away.
aov_text: ’N PSALM van Dawid, toe hy hom kranksinnig gehou het voor Abiméleg en dié hom weggejaag het, sodat hy heengegaan het.

kjv_text: I will bless the LORD at all times: his praise shall continually be in my mouth.
bsb_text: I will bless the LORD at all times; His praise will always be on my lips.
aov_text: Alef. Ek wil die HERE altyd loof; sy lof sal altyddeur in my mond wees.

kjv_text: My soul shall make her boast in the LORD: the humble shall hear thereof, and be glad.
bsb_text: My soul boasts in the LORD; let the oppressed hear and rejoice.
aov_text: Bet. My siel sal hom beroem in die HERE; die ootmoediges sal dit hoor en bly wees.

kjv_text: O magnify the LORD with me, and let us exalt his name together.
bsb_text: Magnify the LORD with me; let us exalt His name together.
aov_text: Gimel. Maak die HERE saam met my groot, en laat ons saam sy Naam verhef!

kjv_text: I sought the LORD, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.
bsb_text: I sought the LORD, and He answered me; He delivered me from all my fears.
aov_text: Dalet. Ek het die HERE gesoek, en Hy het my geantwoord en my uit al my vrees gered.

kjv_text: They looked unto him, and were lightened: and their faces were not ashamed.
bsb_text: Those who look to Him are radiant with joy; their faces shall never be ashamed.
aov_text: He. Hulle het Hom aangesien en gestraal van vreugde, en hulle aangesig hoef nie rooi van skaamte te word nie.

kjv_text: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
bsb_text: This poor man called out, and the LORD heard him; He saved him from all his troubles.
aov_text: Sajin. Hierdie ellendige het geroep, en die HERE het gehoor, en Hy het hom uit al sy benoudhede verlos.

kjv_text: The angel of the LORD encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.
bsb_text: The angel of the LORD encamps around those who fear Him, and he delivers them.
aov_text: Get. Die Engel van die HERE trek ’n laer rondom die wat Hom vrees, en red hulle uit.

kjv_text: O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.
bsb_text: Taste and see that the LORD is good; blessed is the man who takes refuge in Him!
aov_text: Tet. Smaak en sien dat die HERE goed is; welgeluksalig is die man wat by Hom skuil!

kjv_text: O fear the LORD, ye his saints: for there is no want to them that fear him.
bsb_text: Fear the LORD, you His saints, for those who fear Him lack nothing.
aov_text: Jod. Vrees die HERE, o sy heiliges, want die wat Hom vrees, het geen gebrek nie.

kjv_text: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: but they that seek the LORD shall not want any good thing.
bsb_text: Young lions go lacking and hungry, but those who seek the LORD lack no good thing.
aov_text: Kaf. Die jong leeus ly armoede en het honger; maar die wat die HERE soek, het geen gebrek aan enigiets nie.

kjv_text: Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of the LORD.
bsb_text: Come, children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of the LORD.
aov_text: Lamed. Kom, kinders, luister na my; ek wil julle die vrees van die HERE leer.

kjv_text: What man is he that desireth life, and loveth many days, that he may see good?
bsb_text: Who is the man who delights in life, who desires to see good days?
aov_text: Mem. Wie is die man wat lus het in die lewe, wat dae liefhet om die goeie te sien?

kjv_text: Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile.
bsb_text: Keep your tongue from evil and your lips from deceitful speech.
aov_text: Noen. Bewaar jou tong vir wat verkeerd is, en jou lippe dat hulle nie bedrog spreek nie.

kjv_text: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.
bsb_text: Turn away from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.
aov_text: Samek. Wyk af van wat verkeerd is, en doen wat goed is; soek die vrede en jaag dit na.

kjv_text: The eyes of the LORD are upon the righteous, and his ears are open unto their cry.
bsb_text: The eyes of the LORD are on the righteous, and His ears are inclined to their cry.
aov_text: Ajin. Die oë van die HERE is op die regverdiges, en sy ore tot hulle hulpgeroep.

kjv_text: The face of the LORD is against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.
bsb_text: But the face of the LORD is against those who do evil, to wipe out all memory of them from the earth.
aov_text: Pe. Die aangesig van die HERE is teen die kwaaddoeners, om hulle gedagtenis van die aarde af uit te roei.

kjv_text: The righteous cry, and the LORD heareth, and delivereth them out of all their troubles.
bsb_text: The righteous cry out, and the LORD hears; He delivers them from all their troubles.
aov_text: Sade. Hulle roep, en die HERE hoor, en Hy red hulle uit al hul benoudhede.

kjv_text: The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.
bsb_text: The LORD is near to the brokenhearted; He saves the contrite in spirit.
aov_text: Kof. Die HERE is naby die wat gebroke is van hart, en Hy verlos die wat verslae is van gees.

kjv_text: Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but the LORD delivereth him out of them all.
bsb_text: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him from them all.
aov_text: Resj. Menigvuldig is die teëspoede van die regverdige, maar uit dié almal red die HERE hom.

kjv_text: He keepeth all his bones: not one of them is broken.
bsb_text: He protects all his bones; not one of them will be broken.
aov_text: Sjin. Hy bewaar al sy bene: nie een daarvan word gebreek nie.

kjv_text: Evil shall slay the wicked: and they that hate the righteous shall be desolate.
bsb_text: Evil will slay the wicked, and the haters of the righteous will be condemned.
aov_text: Tau. Die onheil maak die goddelose dood; en die wat die regverdige haat, moet daarvoor boet.

kjv_text: The LORD redeemeth the soul of his servants: and none of them that trust in him shall be desolate.
bsb_text: The LORD redeems His servants, and none who take refuge in Him will be condemned.
aov_text: Die HERE verlos die siel van sy knegte; en almal wat by Hom skuil, hoef nie te boet nie.

kjv_text: [A Psalm] of David. Plead my cause, O LORD, with them that strive with me: fight against them that fight against me.
bsb_text: Of David. Contend with my opponents, O LORD; fight against those who fight against me.
aov_text: HERE, twis met die wat met my twis; bestry die wat my bestry!

kjv_text: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for mine help.
bsb_text: Take up Your shield and buckler; arise and come to my aid.
aov_text: Gryp die klein skild en die grote, en staan op as my hulp!

kjv_text: Draw out also the spear, and stop the way against them that persecute me: say unto my soul, I am thy salvation.
bsb_text: Draw the spear and javelin against my pursuers; say to my soul: “I am your salvation.”
aov_text: En trek die spies uit en stuit my vervolgers! Spreek tot my siel: Ek is jou heil!

kjv_text: Let them be confounded and put to shame that seek after my soul: let them be turned back and brought to confusion that devise my hurt.
bsb_text: May those who seek my life be disgraced and put to shame; may those who plan to harm me be driven back and confounded.
aov_text: Laat hulle wat my lewe soek, beskaamd staan en in die skande kom; laat hulle wat my ongeluk beraam, agteruitwyk en rooi van skaamte word!

kjv_text: Let them be as chaff before the wind: and let the angel of the LORD chase them.
bsb_text: May they be like chaff in the wind, as the angel of the LORD drives them away.
aov_text: Laat hulle word soos kaf voor die wind, terwyl die Engel van die HERE hulle wegstoot.

kjv_text: Let their way be dark and slippery: and let the angel of the LORD persecute them.
bsb_text: May their path be dark and slick, as the angel of the LORD pursues.
aov_text: Laat hulle weg duister en glibberig wees, terwyl die Engel van die HERE hulle vervolg!

kjv_text: For without cause have they hid for me their net in a pit, which without cause they have digged for my soul.
bsb_text: For without cause they laid their net for me; without reason they dug a pit for my soul.
aov_text: Want hulle het sonder oorsaak die kuil met hul net vir my verberg, hulle het sonder oorsaak gegrawe teen my lewe.

kjv_text: Let destruction come upon him at unawares; and let his net that he hath hid catch himself: into that very destruction let him fall.
bsb_text: May ruin befall them by surprise; may the net they hid ensnare them; may they fall into the hazard they created.
aov_text: Laat verwoesting oor hom kom sonder dat hy dit weet, en laat sy net hom vang wat hy gespan het; laat hom daarin val met verwoesting!

kjv_text: And my soul shall be joyful in the LORD: it shall rejoice in his salvation.
bsb_text: Then my soul will rejoice in the LORD and exult in His salvation.
aov_text: Maar my siel sal juig in die HERE, dit sal bly wees in sy heil.

kjv_text: All my bones shall say, LORD, who is like unto thee, which deliverest the poor from him that is too strong for him, yea, the poor and the needy from him that spoileth him?
bsb_text: All my bones will exclaim, “Who is like You, O LORD, who delivers the afflicted from the aggressor, the poor and needy from the robber?”
aov_text: Al my beendere sal sê: HERE, wie is soos U? U wat die ellendige red van die wat sterker is as hy; ja, die ellendige en behoeftige van sy berower!

kjv_text: False witnesses did rise up; they laid to my charge things that I knew not.
bsb_text: Hostile witnesses come forward; they make charges I know nothing about.
aov_text: Kwaadwillige getuies staan op; wat ek nie weet nie, vra hulle vir my.

kjv_text: They rewarded me evil for good to the spoiling of my soul.
bsb_text: They repay me evil for good, to the bereavement of my soul.
aov_text: Hulle vergeld my kwaad vir goed: verlatenheid vir my siel.

kjv_text: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth: I humbled my soul with fasting; and my prayer returned into mine own bosom.
bsb_text: Yet when they were ill, I put on sackcloth; I humbled myself with fasting, but my prayers returned unanswered.
aov_text: En ek—toe hulle siek was, het ek ’n roukleed gedra; ek het my siel gekwel met vas, en my gebed het teruggekeer in my boesem.

kjv_text: I behaved myself as though he had been my friend or brother: I bowed down heavily, as one that mourneth for his mother.
bsb_text: I paced about as for my friend or brother; I was bowed down with grief, like one mourning for his mother.
aov_text: Ek het rondgegaan asof dit ’n vriend, asof dit ’n broer van my was; ek het gebuk gegaan in die rou soos een wat oor sy moeder treur.

kjv_text: But in mine adversity they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together: yea, the abjects gathered themselves together against me, and I knew it not; they did tear me, and ceased not:
bsb_text: But when I stumbled, they assembled in glee; they gathered together against me. Assailants I did not know slandered me without ceasing.
aov_text: Maar as ek struikel, is hulle bly en kom bymekaar; hulle vergader teen my, lae mense en die wat ek nie ken nie; hulle laster sonder ophou.

kjv_text: With hypocritical mockers in feasts, they gnashed upon me with their teeth.
bsb_text: Like godless jesters at a feast, they gnashed their teeth at me.
aov_text: Onder die roekeloosste tafelspotters kners hulle met hul tande teen my.

kjv_text: Lord, how long wilt thou look on? rescue my soul from their destructions, my darling from the lions.
bsb_text: How long, O Lord, will You look on? Rescue my soul from their ravages, my precious life from these lions.
aov_text: Here, hoe lank sal U dit aansien? Bring my siel terug van hulle verwoestinge, my enigste van die jong leeus af.

kjv_text: I will give thee thanks in the great congregation: I will praise thee among much people.
bsb_text: Then I will give You thanks in the great assembly; I will praise You among many people.
aov_text: Ek sal U loof in ’n groot vergadering; onder ’n groot skare sal ek U prys.

kjv_text: Let not them that are mine enemies wrongfully rejoice over me: neither let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause.
bsb_text: Let not my enemies gloat over me without cause, nor those who hate me without reason wink in malice.
aov_text: Laat hulle oor my nie bly wees wat sonder grond my vyande is nie; laat die wat my sonder oorsaak haat, nie met die oë knip nie!

kjv_text: For they speak not peace: but they devise deceitful matters against them that are quiet in the land.
bsb_text: For they do not speak peace, but they devise deceitful schemes against those who live quietly in the land.
aov_text: Want hulle spreek nie van vrede nie, maar hulle bedink bedrieglike woorde teen die stilles in die land.

kjv_text: Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me, and said, Aha, aha, our eye hath seen it.
bsb_text: They gape at me and say, “Aha, aha! Our eyes have seen!”
aov_text: En hulle maak hul mond wyd oop teen my, hulle sê: Ha, ha, ons oog het dit gesien!

kjv_text: This thou hast seen, O LORD: keep not silence: O Lord, be not far from me.
bsb_text: O LORD, You have seen it; be not silent. O Lord, be not far from me.
aov_text: HERE, U het dit gesien, swyg nie. Here, wees nie ver van my af nie!

kjv_text: Stir up thyself, and awake to my judgment, even unto my cause, my God and my Lord.
bsb_text: Awake and rise to my defense, to my cause, my God and my Lord!
aov_text: Ontwaak en word wakker vir my reg; my God en Here, vir my regsaak.

kjv_text: Judge me, O LORD my God, according to thy righteousness; and let them not rejoice over me.
bsb_text: Vindicate me by Your righteousness, O LORD my God, and do not let them gloat over me.
aov_text: Doen aan my reg na u geregtigheid, HERE my God, en laat hulle oor my nie bly wees nie!

kjv_text: Let them not say in their hearts, Ah, so would we have it: let them not say, We have swallowed him up.
bsb_text: Let them not say in their hearts, “Aha, just what we wanted!” Let them not say, “We have swallowed him up!”
aov_text: Laat hulle in hul hart nie sê: Ha, ons begeerte! Laat hulle nie sê: Ons het hom verslind nie!

kjv_text: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together that rejoice at mine hurt: let them be clothed with shame and dishonour that magnify themselves against me.
bsb_text: May those who gloat in my distress be ashamed and confounded; may those who exalt themselves over me be clothed in shame and reproach.
aov_text: Laat hulle wat bly is oor my ongeluk, beskaamd staan en saam rooi van skaamte word; laat hulle wat hul teen my groot maak, met skaamte en skande beklee word!

kjv_text: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favour my righteous cause: yea, let them say continually, Let the LORD be magnified, which hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant.
bsb_text: May those who favor my vindication shout for joy and gladness; may they always say, “Exalted be the LORD who delights in His servant’s well-being.”
aov_text: Laat húlle jubel en bly wees wat ’n behae het in my geregtigheid; en laat hulle altyddeur sê: Groot is die HERE wat ’n welbehae het in die vrede van sy kneg!

kjv_text: And my tongue shall speak of thy righteousness and of thy praise all the day long.
bsb_text: Then my tongue will proclaim Your righteousness and Your praises all day long.
aov_text: En my tong sal u geregtigheid prys, u lof die hele dag deur.

kjv_text: To the chief Musician, [A Psalm] of David the servant of the LORD.
bsb_text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David, the servant of the LORD.
aov_text: VIR die musiekleier. ’n Psalm van Dawid, die kneg van die HERE.

kjv_text: The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart, that there is no fear of God before his eyes.
bsb_text: An oracle is in my heart regarding the transgression of the wicked man: There is no fear of God before his eyes.
aov_text: In die binneste van my hart sê die oortreding aangaande die goddelose: Daar is geen vrees van God voor sy oë nie.

kjv_text: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, until his iniquity be found to be hateful.
bsb_text: For his eyes are too full of conceit to detect or hate his own sin.
aov_text: Want dit vlei hom in sy oë in verband met die uitvind en haat van sy skuld.

kjv_text: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit: he hath left off to be wise, and to do good.
bsb_text: The words of his mouth are wicked and deceitful; he has ceased to be wise and well-doing.
aov_text: Die woorde van sy mond is onreg en bedrog; hy laat ná om verstandig te wees, om goed te doen.

kjv_text: He deviseth mischief upon his bed; he setteth himself in a way that is not good; he abhorreth not evil.
bsb_text: Even on his bed he plots wickedness; he sets himself on a path that is not good; he fails to reject evil.
aov_text: Hy bedink onreg op sy bed; hy gaan staan op ’n weg wat nie goed is nie; wat sleg is, verfoei hy nie.

kjv_text: Thy mercy, O LORD, is in the heavens; and thy faithfulness reacheth unto the clouds.
bsb_text: Your loving devotion, O LORD, reaches to the heavens, Your faithfulness to the clouds.
aov_text: o HERE, u goedertierenheid is tot in die hemele, u trou tot in die wolke.

kjv_text: Thy righteousness is like the great mountains; thy judgments are a great deep: O LORD, thou preservest man and beast.
bsb_text: Your righteousness is like the highest mountains; Your judgments are like the deepest sea. O LORD, You preserve man and beast.
aov_text: U geregtigheid is soos die berge van God; u oordele is ’n groot watervloed. HERE, u behou mense en diere!

kjv_text: How excellent is thy loving-kindness, O God! therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of thy wings.
bsb_text: How precious is Your loving devotion, O God, that the children of men take refuge in the shadow of Your wings!
aov_text: Hoe kosbaar is u goedertierenheid, o God! Daarom skuil die mensekinders onder die skaduwee van u vleuels.

kjv_text: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; and thou shalt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures.
bsb_text: They feast on the abundance of Your house, and You give them drink from Your river of delights.
aov_text: Hulle verkwik hul aan die vettigheid van u huis, en U laat hulle drink uit die stroom van u genietinge.

kjv_text: For with thee is the fountain of life: in thy light shall we see light.
bsb_text: For with You is the fountain of life; in Your light we see light.
aov_text: Want by U is die fontein van die lewe; in u lig sien ons die lig.

kjv_text: O continue thy loving-kindness unto them that know thee; and thy righteousness to the upright in heart.
bsb_text: Extend Your loving devotion to those who know You, and Your righteousness to the upright in heart.
aov_text: Laat u goedertierenheid voortduur vir die wat U ken, en u geregtigheid vir die opregtes van hart.

kjv_text: Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of the wicked remove me.
bsb_text: Let not the foot of the proud come against me, nor the hand of the wicked drive me away.
aov_text: Laat die voet van die trotsaard nie oor my kom nie, en laat die hand van die goddelose mense my nie verdryf nie.

kjv_text: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast down, and shall not be able to rise.
bsb_text: There the evildoers lie fallen, thrown down and unable to rise.
aov_text: Daar het die werkers van ongeregtigheid geval; hulle is neergestoot en kan nie weer opstaan nie.

kjv_text: [A Psalm] of David. Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be thou envious against the workers of iniquity.
bsb_text: Of David. Do not fret over those who do evil; do not envy those who do wrong.
aov_text: ’N PSALM van Dawid. Alef. Wees nie toornig op die kwaaddoeners nie, beny hulle nie wat onreg doen nie;

kjv_text: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the green herb.
bsb_text: For they wither quickly like grass and wilt like tender plants.
aov_text: want soos gras sal hulle gou verwelk, en soos groen grasspruitjies sal hulle verdroog.

kjv_text: Trust in the LORD, and do good; so shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed.
bsb_text: Trust in the LORD and do good; dwell in the land and cultivate faithfulness.
aov_text: Bet. Vertrou op die HERE, en doen wat goed is; bewoon die aarde en beoefen getrouheid,

kjv_text: Delight thyself also in the LORD: and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.
bsb_text: Delight yourself in the LORD, and He will give you the desires of your heart.
aov_text: en verlustig jou in die HERE; dan sal Hy jou gee die begeertes van jou hart.

kjv_text: Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.
bsb_text: Commit your way to the LORD; trust in Him, and He will do it.
aov_text: Gimel. Laat jou weg aan die HERE oor en vertrou op Hom, en Hý sal dit uitvoer;

kjv_text: And he shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday.
bsb_text: He will bring forth your righteousness like the dawn, your justice like the noonday sun.
aov_text: en Hy sal jou geregtigheid laat voortkom soos die lig en jou reg soos die middag.

kjv_text: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.
bsb_text: Be still before the LORD and wait patiently for Him; do not fret when men prosper in their ways, when they carry out wicked schemes.
aov_text: Dalet. Swyg voor die HERE en verwag Hom; wees nie toornig op hom wat voorspoedig in sy weg is nie, op die man wat listige planne uitvoer nie.

kjv_text: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.
bsb_text: Refrain from anger and abandon wrath; do not fret—it can only bring harm.
aov_text: He. Laat staan die toorn en verlaat die grimmigheid; wees nie toornig nie: dit is net om kwaad te stig.

kjv_text: For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon the LORD, they shall inherit the earth.
bsb_text: For the evildoers will be cut off, but those who hope in the LORD will inherit the land.
aov_text: Want die kwaaddoeners sal uitgeroei word; maar die wat die HERE verwag, hulle sal die aarde besit.

kjv_text: For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place, and it shall not be.
bsb_text: Yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more; though you look for them, they will not be found.
aov_text: Wau. En nog ’n klein rukkie en die goddelose sal daar nie wees nie; ja, jy sal ag gee op sy plek, maar hy sal daar nie wees nie.

kjv_text: But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
bsb_text: But the meek will inherit the land and delight in abundant prosperity.
aov_text: Die ootmoediges daarenteen sal die aarde besit en hulle verlustig oor groot vrede.

kjv_text: The wicked plotteth against the just, and gnasheth upon him with his teeth.
bsb_text: The wicked scheme against the righteous and gnash their teeth at them,
aov_text: Sajin. Die goddelose bedink listige planne teen die regverdige en kners met sy tande teen hom.

kjv_text: The LORD shall laugh at him: for he seeth that his day is coming.
bsb_text: but the Lord laughs, seeing that their day is coming.
aov_text: Die Here lag oor hom, want Hy sien dat sy dag kom.

kjv_text: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, and to slay such as be of upright conversation.
bsb_text: The wicked have drawn the sword and bent the bow to bring down the poor and needy, to slay those whose ways are upright.
aov_text: Get. Die goddelose het die swaard getrek en hulle boog gespan om die ellendige en behoeftige te laat val, om dié te slag wat opreg is van weg.

kjv_text: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.
bsb_text: But their swords will pierce their own hearts, and their bows will be broken.
aov_text: Hulle swaard sal in hul hart gaan, en hulle boë sal verbreek word.

aov_text: Kaf. Maar die goddelose sal omkom en die vyande van die HERE soos die prag van die weivelde; hulle verdwyn soos rook, hulle verdwyn.

aov_text: Lamed. Die goddelose leen en gee nie terug nie, maar die regverdige ontferm hom en gee;

aov_text: Mem. Deur die HERE word die gange van ’n man bevestig, en Hy het ’n welbehae in sy weg.

aov_text: As hy val, dan stort hy nie neer nie; want die HERE ondersteun sy hand.

aov_text: want die HERE het die reg lief en sal sy gunsgenote nie verlaat nie; vir ewig word hulle bewaar, maar die nageslag van die goddelose word uitgeroei.

bsb_text: The righteous will inherit the land and dwell in it forever.
aov_text: Die regverdiges sal die aarde besit en vir ewig daarop woon.

aov_text: Pe. Die mond van die regverdige verkondig wysheid, en sy tong spreek wat reg is.

bsb_text: Wait for the LORD and keep His way, and He will raise you up to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you will see it.
aov_text: Kof. Wag op die HERE en hou sy weg, en Hy sal jou verhoog, om die aarde te besit; jy sal met welgevalle neersien op die uitroeiing van die goddelose mense.

kjv_text: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree.
bsb_text: I have seen a wicked, ruthless man flourishing like a well-rooted native tree,

kjv_text: Yet he passed away, and, lo, he was not: yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.
bsb_text: yet he passed away and was no more; though I searched, he could not be found.
aov_text: Toe gaan iemand verby, en kyk, hy was daar nie; en ek het hom gesoek, maar hy was nie te vinde nie.

kjv_text: Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright: for the end of that man is peace.

aov_text: Sjin. Let op die vrome en kyk na die opregte, want daar is ’n toekoms vir die man van vrede.

aov_text: En die HERE help hulle en red hulle; Hy red hulle van die goddelose mense en verlos hulle, want hulle skuil by Hom.

bsb_text: A Psalm of David, for remembrance.
aov_text: ’N PSALM van Dawid, by die gedenkoffer.

bsb_text: O LORD, do not rebuke me in Your anger or discipline me in Your wrath.
aov_text: o HERE, straf my nie in u toorn nie en kasty my nie in u grimmigheid nie.

aov_text: Want u pyle het in my ingedring, en u hand het op my neergedaal.

aov_text: My wonde stink, hulle dra vanweë my dwaasheid.

bsb_text: I am bent and brought low; all day long I go about mourning.
aov_text: Ek is krom, heeltemal geboë; die hele dag gaan ek in die rou;

aov_text: want my lendene is vol ontsteking, en daar is geen heel plek in my vlees nie.

aov_text: Ek is kragteloos en heeltemal verbrysel; ek brul van die gebons van my hart.

aov_text: Here, voor U is al my begeertes, en my gesug is vir U nie verborge nie.

aov_text: My hart slaan vinnig, my krag het my verlaat; en die lig van my oë, ook dit is nie by my nie.

bsb_text: Those who seek my life lay snares; those who wish me harm speak destruction, plotting deceit all day long.
aov_text: en die wat my lewe soek, span strikke; en die wat my ongeluk soek, spreek van ondergang, en hulle bedink die hele dag bedrog.

kjv_text: But I, as a deaf man, heard not; and I was as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.
bsb_text: But like a deaf man, I do not hear; and like a mute man, I do not open my mouth.
aov_text: Maar ek is soos ’n dowe: ek hoor nie, en soos ’n stomme wat sy mond nie oopmaak nie.

aov_text: Ja, ek is soos ’n man wat nie hoor nie en in wie se mond geen teëspraak is nie;

aov_text: want op U, HERE, wag ek; Ú sal verhoor, Here my God!

kjv_text: For I said, Hear me, lest otherwise they should rejoice over me: when my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.
bsb_text: For I said, “Let them not gloat over me—those who taunt me when my foot slips.”
aov_text: Want ek het gesê: Laat hulle net nie bly wees oor my nie! Hulle wat by die wankeling van my voet hul groot maak teen my!

bsb_text: For I am ready to fall, and my pain is ever with me.
aov_text: Want ek is klaar om te val, en my smart is altyddeur voor my.

kjv_text: For I will declare mine iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.
bsb_text: Yes, I confess my iniquity; I am troubled by my sin.
aov_text: Ja, my ongeregtigheid bely ek, ek is bekommerd oor my sonde.

kjv_text: But mine enemies are lively, and they are strong: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.

aov_text: Verlaat my nie, o HERE! My God, wees nie ver van my af nie!

aov_text: Maak tog gou om my te help, Here, my heil!

aov_text: VIR die musiekleier; vir Jedútun. ’n Psalm van Dawid.

aov_text: Kyk, U het my dae ’n paar handbreedtes gemaak, en my leeftyd is soos niks voor U nie; ja, as pure nietigheid staan elke mens daar! Sela.

kjv_text: Surely every man walketh in a vain shew: surely they are disquieted in vain: he heapeth up riches, and knoweth not who shall gather them.
bsb_text: Surely every man goes about like a phantom; surely he bustles in vain; he heaps up riches not knowing who will haul them away.
aov_text: Waarlik, die mens wandel as skadubeeld rond; ja, hulle woel verniet; hulle stapel op en weet nie wie dit sal insamel nie.

kjv_text: And now, Lord, what wait I for? my hope is in thee.
bsb_text: And now, O Lord, for what do I wait? My hope is in You.
aov_text: En nou, wat verwag ek, o Here? My hoop is op U.

kjv_text: Deliver me from all my transgressions: make me not the reproach of the foolish.
bsb_text: Deliver me from all my transgressions; do not make me the reproach of fools.
aov_text: Red my van al my oortredinge; maak my nie ’n smaad van die dwaas nie.

aov_text: Ek is stom, ek sal my mond nie oopmaak nie; want Ú het dit gedoen.

aov_text: Neem u plaag van my weg; ek vergaan vanweë die bestryding van u hand.

aov_text: Wend u oog van my af, dat ek vrolik kan word voordat ek heengaan en daar nie meer is nie.

bsb_text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David.

kjv_text: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.
bsb_text: He put a new song in my mouth, a hymn of praise to our God. Many will see and fear and put their trust in the LORD.
aov_text: En Hy het ’n nuwe lied in my mond gegee, ’n lofsang tot eer van onse God. Baie sal dit sien en vrees en op die HERE vertrou.

kjv_text: Blessed is that man that maketh the LORD his trust, and respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.
bsb_text: Blessed is the man who has made the LORD his trust, who has not turned to the proud, nor to those who lapse into falsehood.
aov_text: Welgeluksalig is die man wat sy vertroue in die HERE stel en hom nie wend tot hoogmoediges en leuendienaars nie.

aov_text: Ek het lus, o my God, om u welbehae te doen, en u wet is binne-in my ingewande.

bsb_text: I proclaim righteousness in the great assembly; behold, I do not seal my lips, as You, O LORD, do know.
aov_text: Ek het ’n blye boodskap van geregtigheid in die groot vergadering verkondig; kyk, my lippe bedwing ek nie. HERE, U weet dit.

kjv_text: I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation: I have not concealed thy loving-kindness and thy truth from the great congregation.
bsb_text: I have not covered up Your righteousness in my heart; I have declared Your faithfulness and salvation; I have not concealed Your loving devotion and faithfulness from the great assembly.
aov_text: U geregtigheid bedek ek nie binne-in my hart nie; van u trou en u heil spreek ek; u goedertierenheid en u trou verberg ek nie vir die groot vergadering nie.

kjv_text: Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O LORD: let thy loving-kindness and thy truth continually preserve me.
bsb_text: O LORD, do not withhold Your mercy from me; Your loving devotion and faithfulness will always guard me.
aov_text: U, o HERE, sal u barmhartighede van my nie terughou nie; laat u goedertierenheid en u trou my altyddeur behoed.

bsb_text: For evils without number surround me; my sins have overtaken me, so that I cannot see. They are more than the hairs of my head, and my heart has failed within me.

kjv_text: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me: O LORD, make haste to help me.
bsb_text: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me; hurry, O LORD, to help me.
aov_text: Laat dit U behaag, HERE, om my te red; HERE, maak tog gou om my te help!

aov_text: Laat hulle wat vir my sê: Ha, ha! vanweë hul beskaming verskrik wees!

bsb_text: May all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; may those who love Your salvation always say, “The LORD be magnified!”
aov_text: Laat almal wat U soek, in U vrolik en bly wees; laat die liefhebbers van u heil altyddeur sê: Groot is die HERE!

kjv_text: But I am poor and needy; yet the Lord thinketh upon me: thou art my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.

aov_text: Al is ek ellendig en behoeftig—die Here dink aan my; U is my hulp en my redder; my God, vertoef tog nie!

kjv_text: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.
bsb_text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David.
aov_text: VIR die musiekleier. ’n Psalm van Dawid.

kjv_text: Blessed is he that considereth the poor: the LORD will deliver him in time of trouble.
bsb_text: Blessed is the one who cares for the poor; the LORD will deliver him in the day of trouble.
aov_text: Welgeluksalig is hy wat ag gee op die arme; die HERE sal hom red in die dag van onheil.

kjv_text: The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive; and he shall be blessed upon the earth: and thou wilt not deliver him unto the will of his enemies.
bsb_text: The LORD will protect and preserve him; He will bless him in the land and refuse to surrender him to the will of his foes.
aov_text: Die HERE sal hom bewaar en hom in die lewe hou; hy sal gelukkig gemaak word op die aarde. Ja, U kan hom nie oorgee aan die begeerte van sy vyande nie.

kjv_text: The LORD will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing: thou wilt make all his bed in his sickness.
bsb_text: The LORD will sustain him on his bed of illness and restore him from his bed of sickness.
aov_text: Die HERE sal hom ondersteun op die siekbed; sy hele slaapplek verander U as hy krank is.

kjv_text: I said, LORD, be merciful unto me: heal my soul; for I have sinned against thee.
bsb_text: I said, “O LORD, be gracious to me; heal me, for I have sinned against You.”
aov_text: Ék het gesê: o HERE, wees my genadig! Genees my, want ek het teen U gesondig.

kjv_text: Mine enemies speak evil of me, When shall he die, and his name perish?
bsb_text: My enemies say with malice: “When will he die and be forgotten?”
aov_text: My vyande spreek kwaad van my en sê: Wanneer sal hy sterwe en sy naam vergaan?

kjv_text: And if he come to see me, he speaketh vanity: his heart gathereth iniquity to itself; when he goeth abroad, he telleth it.
bsb_text: My visitor speaks falsehood; he gathers slander in his heart; he goes out and spreads it abroad.
aov_text: En as iemand kom om my te sien, dan praat hy leuens; sy hart vergader boosheid vir hom; gaan hy uit na buite, dan spreek hy daarvan.

kjv_text: All that hate me whisper together against me: against me do they devise my hurt.
bsb_text: All who hate me whisper against me; they imagine the worst for me:
aov_text: Al my haters tesame fluister onder mekaar teen my; teen my bedink hulle my onheil en sê:

kjv_text: An evil disease, say they, cleaveth fast unto him: and now that he lieth he shall rise up no more.
bsb_text: “A vile disease has been poured into him; he will never get up from where he lies!”
aov_text: Iets skandeliks is op hom uitgestort; en nou dat hy lê, sal hy nie weer opstaan nie.

kjv_text: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, hath lifted up his heel against me.
bsb_text: Even my close friend whom I trusted, the one who shared my bread, has lifted up his heel against me.
aov_text: Selfs die man wat met my in vrede lewe, op wie ek vertrou het, wat my brood eet, het die hakskeen teen my opgelig.

kjv_text: But thou, O LORD, be merciful unto me, and raise me up, that I may requite them.
bsb_text: But You, O LORD, be gracious to me and raise me up, that I may repay them.
aov_text: Maar U, o HERE, wees my genadig en rig my op, dat ek hulle dit kan vergelde!

kjv_text: By this I know that thou favourest me, because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.
bsb_text: By this I know that You delight in me, for my enemy does not triumph over me.
aov_text: Hieraan weet ek dat U ’n welbehae in my het: dat my vyand oor my nie juig nie.

kjv_text: And as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity, and settest me before thy face for ever.
bsb_text: In my integrity You uphold me and set me in Your presence forever.
aov_text: My tog, in my opregtheid ondersteun U my, en stel my voor u aangesig tot in ewigheid.

kjv_text: Blessed be the LORD God of Israel from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.
bsb_text: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Amen and Amen.
aov_text: Geloofd sy die HERE, die God van Israel, van ewigheid tot in ewigheid! Amen, ja amen.

kjv_text: To the chief Musician, Maschil, for the sons of Korah.
bsb_text: For the choirmaster. A Maskil of the sons of Korah.
aov_text: VIR die musiekleier. ’n Onderwysing van die kinders van Korag.

kjv_text: As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after thee, O God.
bsb_text: As the deer pants for streams of water, so my soul longs after You, O God.
aov_text: Soos ’n hert wat smag na waterstrome, so smag my siel na U, o God!

kjv_text: My soul thirsteth for God, for the living God: when shall I come and appear before God?
bsb_text: My soul thirsts for God, the living God. When shall I come and appear in God’s presence?
aov_text: My siel dors na God, na die lewende God; wanneer sal ek ingaan en voor die aangesig van God verskyn?

kjv_text: My tears have been my meat day and night, while they continually say unto me, Where is thy God?
bsb_text: My tears have been my food both day and night, while men ask me all day long, “Where is your God?”
aov_text: My trane is my spys dag en nag, omdat hulle die hele dag vir my sê: Waar is jou God?

kjv_text: When I remember these things, I pour out my soul in me: for I had gone with the multitude, I went with them to the house of God, with the voice of joy and praise, with a multitude that kept holyday.
bsb_text: These things come to mind as I pour out my soul: how I walked with the multitude, leading the procession to the house of God with shouts of joy and praise.
aov_text: Hieraan wil ek dink en my siel uitstort in my: hoe ek gewoond was om voort te trek met die skare, hulle gelei het na die huis van God, met die stem van jubel en lof—’n feesvierende menigte!

kjv_text: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted in me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him for the help of his countenance.
bsb_text: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him for the salvation of His presence.
aov_text: Wat buig jy jou neer, o my siel, en is onrustig in my? Hoop op God; want ek sal Hom nog loof—die verlossing van sy aangesig!

kjv_text: O my God, my soul is cast down within me: therefore will I remember thee from the land of Jordan, and of the Hermonites, from the hill Mizar.
bsb_text: O my God, my soul despairs within me. Therefore I remember You from the land of Jordan and the peaks of Hermon—even from Mount Mizar.
aov_text: o My God, my siel buig hom neer in my; daarom dink ek aan U uit die land van die Jordaan en die Hermons, van die klein gebergte af.

kjv_text: Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of thy waterspouts: all thy waves and thy billows are gone over me.
bsb_text: Deep calls to deep in the roar of Your waterfalls; all Your breakers and waves have rolled over me.
aov_text: Die vloed roep na die vloed by die gedruis van u waterstrome; al u bare en u golwe het oor my heengegaan.

kjv_text: Yet the LORD will command his loving-kindness in the day time, and in the night his song shall be with me, and my prayer unto the God of my life.
bsb_text: The LORD decrees His loving devotion by day, and at night His song is with me as a prayer to the God of my life.
aov_text: Maar die HERE sal oordag sy goedertierenheid gebied, en in die nag sal sy lied by my wees, ’n gebed tot die God van my lewe.

kjv_text: I will say unto God my rock, Why hast thou forgotten me? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
bsb_text: I say to God my Rock, “Why have You forgotten me? Why must I walk in sorrow because of the enemy’s oppression?”
aov_text: Ek wil spreek tot God: My rots, waarom vergeet U my? Waarom gaan ek in die rou deur die vyande se verdrukking?

kjv_text: As with a sword in my bones, mine enemies reproach me; while they say daily unto me, Where is thy God?
bsb_text: Like the crushing of my bones, my enemies taunt me, while they say to me all day long, “Where is your God?”
aov_text: Met ’n doodsteek in my gebeente smaad my teëstanders my as hulle die hele dag vir my sê: Waar is jou God?

kjv_text: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.
bsb_text: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him, my Savior and my God.
aov_text: Wat buig jy jou neer, o my siel, en wat is jy onrustig in my? Hoop op God, want ek sal Hom nog loof—die verlossing van my aangesig en my God!

kjv_text: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.
bsb_text: Vindicate me, O God, and plead my case against an ungodly nation; deliver me from deceitful and unjust men.
aov_text: DOEN aan my reg, o God, en verdedig my regsaak teen ’n onbarmhartige volk; red my van die man van bedrog en onreg!

kjv_text: For thou art the God of my strength: why dost thou cast me off? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
bsb_text: For You are the God of my refuge. Why have You rejected me? Why must I walk in sorrow because of the enemy’s oppression?
aov_text: Want U is die God van my toevlug; waarom verstoot U my dan? Waarom moet ek rondgaan in rougewaad deur die vyand se verdrukking?

kjv_text: O send out thy light and thy truth: let them lead me; let them bring me unto thy holy hill, and to thy tabernacles.
bsb_text: Send out Your light and Your truth; let them lead me. Let them bring me to Your holy mountain, and to the place where You dwell.
aov_text: Stuur u lig en u waarheid; laat dié my lei; laat dié my bring na u heilige berg en na u woninge,

kjv_text: Then will I go unto the altar of God, unto God my exceeding joy: yea, upon the harp will I praise thee, O God my God.
bsb_text: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my greatest joy. I will praise You with the harp, O God, my God.
aov_text: dat ek kan ingaan na die altaar van God, na die God van my jubelende blydskap en U kan loof met die siter, o God, my God!

kjv_text: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.
bsb_text: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him, my Savior and my God.
aov_text: Wat buig jy jou neer, o my siel, en wat is jy onrustig in my? Hoop op God, want ek sal Hom nog loof—die verlossing van my aangesig en my God!

kjv_text: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, Maschil.
bsb_text: For the choirmaster. A Maskil of the sons of Korah.
aov_text: VIR die musiekleier. Van die kinders van Korag. ’n Onderwysing.

kjv_text: We have heard with our ears, O God, our fathers have told us, what work thou didst in their days, in the times of old.
bsb_text: We have heard with our ears, O God; our fathers have told us the work You did in their days, in the days of old.
aov_text: o God, met ons ore het ons dit gehoor, ons vaders het ons dit vertel: ’n werk het U gedoen in hulle dae, in die dae van die voortyd.

kjv_text: How thou didst drive out the heathen with thy hand, and plantedst them; how thou didst afflict the people, and cast them out.
bsb_text: With Your hand You drove out the nations and planted our fathers there; You crushed the peoples and cast them out.
aov_text: U self het met u hand nasies verdrywe, maar húlle geplant; U het volke kwaad aangedoen, hulle daarenteen laat uitspruit.

kjv_text: For they got not the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them: but thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, because thou hadst a favour unto them.
bsb_text: For it was not by their sword that they took the land; their arm did not bring them victory. It was by Your right hand, Your arm, and the light of Your face, because You favored them.
aov_text: Want hulle het die land nie deur hul swaard in besit geneem nie, en hul arm het hulle nie die oorwinning gegee nie, maar u regterhand en u arm en die lig van u aangesig, omdat U ’n welbehae in hulle gehad het.

kjv_text: Thou art my King, O God: command deliverances for Jacob.
bsb_text: You are my King, O God, who ordains victories for Jacob.
aov_text: U self is my Koning, o God! Gebied die oorwinninge van Jakob.

kjv_text: Through thee will we push down our enemies: through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.
bsb_text: Through You we repel our foes; through Your name we trample our enemies.
aov_text: Deur U sal ons ons teëstanders omstoot; in u Naam sal ons hulle vertrap wat teen ons opstaan.

kjv_text: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.
bsb_text: For I do not trust in my bow, nor does my sword save me.
aov_text: Want ek vertrou nie op my boog nie, en my swaard sal my die oorwinning nie gee nie;

kjv_text: But thou hast saved us from our enemies, and hast put them to shame that hated us.
bsb_text: For You save us from our enemies; You put those who hate us to shame.
aov_text: maar U het ons verlos van ons teëstanders en ons haters beskaamd gemaak.

kjv_text: In God we boast all the day long, and praise thy name for ever. Selah.
bsb_text: In God we have boasted all day long, and Your name we will praise forever. Selah
aov_text: In God roem ons die hele dag, en u Naam sal ons loof tot in ewigheid. Sela.

kjv_text: But thou hast cast off, and put us to shame; and goest not forth with our armies.
bsb_text: But You have rejected and humbled us; You no longer go forth with our armies.
aov_text: En tog het U ons verstoot en tot skande gemaak, en U trek nie saam met ons leërs uit nie.

kjv_text: Thou makest us to turn back from the enemy: and they which hate us spoil for themselves.
bsb_text: You have made us retreat from the foe, and those who hate us have plundered us.
aov_text: U laat ons agteruitwyk vir die teëstander, en ons haters plunder na hartelus.

kjv_text: Thou hast given us like sheep appointed for meat; and hast scattered us among the heathen.
bsb_text: You have given us up as sheep to be devoured; You have scattered us among the nations.
aov_text: U gee ons oor soos slagvee, en U het ons onder die nasies verstrooi.

kjv_text: Thou sellest thy people for nought, and dost not increase thy wealth by their price.
bsb_text: You sell Your people for nothing; no profit do You gain from their sale.
aov_text: U verkoop u volk vir niks en het nie baie verdien deur hulle koopprys nie.

kjv_text: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to them that are round about us.
bsb_text: You have made us a reproach to our neighbors, a mockery and derision to those around us.
aov_text: U maak ons ’n smaad vir ons bure, ’n spot en beskimping vir die wat rondom ons is.

kjv_text: Thou makest us a byword among the heathen, a shaking of the head among the people.
bsb_text: You have made us a byword among the nations, a laughingstock among the peoples.
aov_text: U maak ons ’n spreekwoord onder die nasies, ’n hoofskudding onder die volke.

kjv_text: My confusion is continually before me, and the shame of my face hath covered me,
bsb_text: All day long my disgrace is before me, and shame has covered my face,
aov_text: My skande is die hele dag voor my, en die skaamte van my aangesig oordek my;

kjv_text: For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth; by reason of the enemy and avenger.
bsb_text: at the voice of the scorner and reviler, because of the enemy, bent on revenge.
aov_text: weens die stem van die smader en lasteraar, weens die blik van die vyand en wraakgierige.

kjv_text: All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten thee, neither have we dealt falsely in thy covenant.
bsb_text: All this has come upon us, though we have not forgotten You or betrayed Your covenant.
aov_text: Dit alles het oor ons gekom, en tog het ons U nie vergeet en nie bedrieglik gehandel teen u verbond nie.

kjv_text: Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from thy way;
bsb_text: Our hearts have not turned back; our steps have not strayed from Your path.
aov_text: Ons hart het nie agteruitgewyk nie, en ons gange het van u pad nie afgebuig nie,

kjv_text: Though thou hast sore broken us in the place of dragons, and covered us with the shadow of death.
bsb_text: But You have crushed us in the lair of jackals; You have covered us with deepest darkness.
aov_text: alhoewel U ons verbrysel het in ’n plek van jakkalse en ons met ’n doodskaduwee oordek.

kjv_text: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or stretched out our hands to a strange god;
bsb_text: If we had forgotten the name of our God or spread out our hands to a foreign god,
aov_text: As ons die Naam van onse God vergeet het en ons hande uitgebrei het na ’n vreemde god —

kjv_text: Shall not God search this out? for he knoweth the secrets of the heart.
bsb_text: would not God have discovered, since He knows the secrets of the heart?
aov_text: sou God dit nie naspeur nie? Want Hy ken die geheime van die hart.

kjv_text: Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.
bsb_text: Yet for Your sake we face death all day long; we are considered as sheep to be slaughtered.
aov_text: Maar om U ontwil word ons die hele dag gedood; ons word gereken as slagskape.

kjv_text: Awake, why sleepest thou, O Lord? arise, cast us not off for ever.
bsb_text: Wake up, O Lord! Why are You sleeping? Arise! Do not reject us forever.
aov_text: Ontwaak! Waarom slaap U, Here? Word tog wakker! Verstoot nie vir ewig nie!

kjv_text: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and forgettest our affliction and our oppression?
bsb_text: Why do You hide Your face and forget our affliction and oppression?
aov_text: Waarom verberg U u aangesig, vergeet U ons ellende en ons verdrukking?

kjv_text: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: our belly cleaveth unto the earth.
bsb_text: For our soul has sunk to the dust; our bodies cling to the earth.
aov_text: Want ons siel is in die stof neergebuig; ons buik kleef aan die aarde.

kjv_text: Arise for our help, and redeem us for thy mercies' sake.
bsb_text: Rise up; be our help! Redeem us on account of Your loving devotion.
aov_text: Staan op tot ons hulp en verlos ons om u goedertierenheid ontwil!

kjv_text: To the chief Musician upon Shoshannim, for the sons of Korah, Maschil, A Song of loves.
bsb_text: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “The Lilies.” A Maskil of the sons of Korah. A love song.
aov_text: VIR die musiekleier; op die wysie van: „Lelies.” Van die kinders van Korag. ’n Onderwysing. ’n Lied van die liefde.

kjv_text: My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue is the pen of a ready writer.
bsb_text: My heart is stirred by a noble theme as I recite my verses to the king; my tongue is the pen of a skillful writer.
aov_text: My hart word bewoë deur goeie woorde; ek dra my gedigte voor aangaande ’n Koning; my tong is die pen van ’n vaardige skrywer.
