kjv_text: Thou art fairer than the children of men: grace is poured into thy lips: therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.
bsb_text: You are the most handsome of men; grace has anointed your lips, since God has blessed you forever.
aov_text: U is veel skoner as die mensekinders; genade is uitgestort op u lippe; daarom het God U geseën vir ewig.

kjv_text: Gird thy sword upon thy thigh, O most mighty, with thy glory and thy majesty.
bsb_text: Strap your sword at your side, O mighty warrior; appear in your majesty and splendor.
aov_text: Gord u swaard aan die heup, o held, u majesteit en u heerlikheid;

kjv_text: And in thy majesty ride prosperously because of truth and meekness and righteousness; and thy right hand shall teach thee terrible things.
bsb_text: In your splendor ride forth in victory on behalf of truth and humility and justice; may your right hand show your awesome deeds.
aov_text: ja, u heerlikheid! Ry voorspoedig ter wille van waarheid en ootmoed en geregtigheid; en laat u regterhand U vreeslike dinge leer!

kjv_text: Thine arrows are sharp in the heart of the king's enemies; whereby the people fall under thee.
bsb_text: Your arrows pierce the hearts of the king’s foes; the nations fall beneath your feet.
aov_text: U pyle is skerp (volke val onder U!); hulle tref in die hart van die Koning se vyande.

kjv_text: Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: the sceptre of thy kingdom is a right sceptre.
bsb_text: Your throne, O God, endures forever and ever, and justice is the scepter of Your kingdom.
aov_text: U troon, o God, is vir ewig en altyd; die septer van u koninkryk is ’n regverdige septer.

kjv_text: Thou lovest righteousness, and hatest wickedness: therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.
bsb_text: You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, your God, has anointed you above your companions with the oil of joy.
aov_text: U het geregtigheid lief en haat goddeloosheid. Daarom het, o God, u God U gesalf met vreugde-olie bo u metgeselle.

kjv_text: All thy garments smell of myrrh, and aloes, and cassia, out of the ivory palaces, whereby they have made thee glad.
bsb_text: All your garments are fragrant with myrrh and aloes and cassia; from palaces of ivory the harps make you glad.
aov_text: Al u klere is mirre en alewee en kassie; uit ivoorpaleise maak snarespel U bly.

kjv_text: Kings' daughters were among thy honourable women: upon thy right hand did stand the queen in gold of Ophir.
bsb_text: The daughters of kings are among your honored women; the queen stands at your right hand, adorned with the gold of Ophir.
aov_text: Dogters van konings is onder u staatsdogters; die koningin staan aan u regterhand in goud van Ofir.

kjv_text: Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline thine ear; forget also thine own people, and thy father's house;
bsb_text: Listen, O daughter! Consider and incline your ear: Forget your people and your father’s house,
aov_text: Hoor, o dogter, en kyk en neig u oor, en vergeet u volk en die huis van u vader;

kjv_text: So shall the king greatly desire thy beauty: for he is thy Lord; and worship thou him.
bsb_text: and the king will desire your beauty; bow to him, for he is your lord.
aov_text: en as die Koning u skoonheid begeer—want Hy is u Heer—buig u dan voor Hom neer.

kjv_text: And the daughter of Tyre shall be there with a gift; even the rich among the people shall intreat thy favour.
bsb_text: The Daughter of Tyre will come with a gift; men of wealth will seek your favor.
aov_text: En, o dogter van Tirus—met geskenke sal hulle u guns soek, ja, die rykstes van die mense.

kjv_text: The king's daughter is all glorious within: her clothing is of wrought gold.
bsb_text: All glorious is the princess in her chamber; her gown is embroidered with gold.
aov_text: Louter heerlikheid is die Koning se dogter daarbinne; van gouddraad is haar kleding.

kjv_text: She shall be brought unto the king in raiment of needlework: the virgins her companions that follow her shall be brought unto thee.
bsb_text: In colorful garments she is led to the king; her virgin companions are brought before you.
aov_text: In veelkleurige gewade word sy na die Koning gelei; jonkvroue agter haar, haar vriendinne, word na U gebring.

kjv_text: With gladness and rejoicing shall they be brought: they shall enter into the king's palace.
bsb_text: They are led in with joy and gladness; they enter the palace of the king.
aov_text: Hulle word gelei met vreugde en gejuig; hulle gaan in die Koning se paleis in.

kjv_text: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children, whom thou mayest make princes in all the earth.
bsb_text: Your sons will succeed your fathers; you will make them princes throughout the land.
aov_text: In die plek van u vaders sal u seuns wees; U sal hulle aanstel as vorste in die hele land.

kjv_text: I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations: therefore shall the people praise thee for ever and ever.
bsb_text: I will commemorate your name through all generations; therefore the nations will praise you forever and ever.
aov_text: U Naam wil ek vermeld van geslag tot geslag; daarom sal die volke U loof vir ewig en altyd.

kjv_text: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth.
bsb_text: For the choirmaster. Of the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. A song.
aov_text: VIR die musiekleier. Van die kinders van Korag. Met sopraanstemme. ’n Lied.

kjv_text: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
bsb_text: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in times of trouble.
aov_text: God is vir ons ’n toevlug en sterkte; as hulp in benoudhede is Hy in hoë mate beproef.

kjv_text: Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea;
bsb_text: Therefore we will not fear, though the earth is transformed and the mountains are toppled into the depths of the seas,
aov_text: Daarom sal ons nie vrees nie, al waggel die aarde en al wankel die berge weg in die hart van die see.

kjv_text: Though the waters thereof roar and be troubled, though the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. Selah.
bsb_text: though their waters roar and foam and the mountains quake in the surge. Selah
aov_text: Laat sy waters bruis, laat hulle skuim; laat die berge bewe deur sy onstuimigheid! Sela.

kjv_text: There is a river, the streams whereof shall make glad the city of God, the holy place of the tabernacles of the most High.
bsb_text: There is a river whose streams delight the city of God, the holy place where the Most High dwells.
aov_text: Die stroompies van ’n rivier maak die Godstad bly, die heiligste van die woninge van die Allerhoogste.

kjv_text: God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: God shall help her, and that right early.
bsb_text: God is within her; she will not be moved. God will help her when morning dawns.
aov_text: God is daar binne-in, dit sal nie wankel nie; God sal dit help as die dag aanbreek.

kjv_text: The heathen raged, the kingdoms were moved: he uttered his voice, the earth melted.
bsb_text: Nations rage, kingdoms crumble; the earth melts when He lifts His voice.
aov_text: Nasies het gebruis, koninkryke het gewankel; Hy het sy stem verhef; die aarde bewe.

kjv_text: The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
bsb_text: The LORD of Hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress. Selah
aov_text: Die HERE van die leërskare is met ons; die God van Jakob is ’n rotsvesting vir ons. Sela.

kjv_text: Come, behold the works of the LORD, what desolations he hath made in the earth.
bsb_text: Come, see the works of the LORD, who brings devastation upon the earth.
aov_text: Kom, aanskou die dade van die HERE, wat verskriklike dinge oor die aarde bring,

kjv_text: He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth; he breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; he burneth the chariot in the fire.
bsb_text: He makes wars to cease throughout the earth; He breaks the bow and shatters the spear; He burns the shields in the fire.
aov_text: wat die oorloë laat ophou tot by die einde van die aarde, die boog verbreek en die spies stukkend slaan, die strydwaens met vuur verbrand.

kjv_text: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.
bsb_text: “Be still and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted over the earth.”
aov_text: Laat staan en weet dat Ek God is; Ek sal hoog wees onder die nasies, hoog op die aarde.

kjv_text: The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
bsb_text: The LORD of Hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress. Selah
aov_text: Die HERE van die leërskare is met ons; die God van Jakob is ’n rotsvesting vir ons. Sela.

kjv_text: To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Korah.
bsb_text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.
aov_text: VIR die musiekleier. Van die kinders van Korag. ’n Psalm.

kjv_text: O clap your hands, all ye people; shout unto God with the voice of triumph.
bsb_text: Clap your hands, all you peoples; shout unto God with a voice of triumph.
aov_text: Alle volke, klap met die hande; juig tot eer van God met ’n stem van gejubel!

kjv_text: For the LORD most high is terrible; he is a great King over all the earth.
bsb_text: How awesome is the LORD Most High, the great King over all the earth!
aov_text: Want die HERE, die Allerhoogste, is gedug, ’n groot Koning oor die hele aarde.

kjv_text: He shall subdue the people under us, and the nations under our feet.
bsb_text: He subdues nations beneath us, and peoples under our feet.
aov_text: Hy bring volke onder ons en nasies onder ons voete.

kjv_text: He shall choose our inheritance for us, the excellency of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.
bsb_text: He chooses our inheritance for us, the pride of Jacob, whom He loves. Selah
aov_text: Hy kies ons erfdeel vir ons uit, die trots van Jakob wat Hy liefhet. Sela.

kjv_text: God is gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet.
bsb_text: God has ascended amid shouts of joy, the LORD with the sound of the horn.
aov_text: God vaar op met gejuig, die HERE met basuingeklank.

kjv_text: Sing praises to God, sing praises: sing praises unto our King, sing praises.
bsb_text: Sing praises to God, sing praises; sing praises to our King, sing praises!
aov_text: Psalmsing tot eer van God, psalmsing! Psalmsing tot eer van ons Koning, psalmsing!

kjv_text: For God is the King of all the earth: sing ye praises with understanding.
bsb_text: For God is King of all the earth; sing profound praises to Him.
aov_text: Want God is Koning van die hele aarde; psalmsing met ’n onderwysing.

kjv_text: God reigneth over the heathen: God sitteth upon the throne of his holiness.
bsb_text: God reigns over the nations; God is seated on His holy throne.
aov_text: God regeer oor die nasies; God sit op sy heilige troon.

kjv_text: The princes of the people are gathered together, even the people of the God of Abraham: for the shields of the earth belong unto God: he is greatly exalted.
bsb_text: The nobles of the nations have assembled as the people of the God of Abraham; for the shields of the earth belong to God; He is highly exalted.
aov_text: Die edeles van die volke het vergader—’n volk van die God van Abraham; want aan God behoort die skilde van die aarde. Hoog verhewe is Hy!

kjv_text: A Song [and] Psalm for the sons of Korah.
bsb_text: A song. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.
aov_text: ’N LIED. ’n Psalm van die kinders van Korag.

kjv_text: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, in the mountain of his holiness.
bsb_text: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, His holy mountain.
aov_text: Die HERE is groot en baie lofwaardig in die stad van onse God, sy heilige berg!

kjv_text: Beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth, is mount Zion, on the sides of the north, the city of the great King.
bsb_text: Beautiful in loftiness, the joy of all the earth, like the peaks of Zaphon is Mount Zion, the city of the great King.
aov_text: Skoon deur sy verhewenheid, die vreugde van die hele aarde is die berg Sion, aan die noordekant, die stad van die groot Koning!

kjv_text: God is known in her palaces for a refuge.
bsb_text: God is in her citadels; He has shown Himself to be a fortress.
aov_text: God het Hom in sy paleise bekend gemaak as ’n rotsvesting.

kjv_text: For, lo, the kings were assembled, they passed by together.
bsb_text: For behold, the kings assembled; they all advanced together.
aov_text: Want kyk, die konings het bymekaargekom, tesame opgetrek.

kjv_text: They saw it, and so they marvelled; they were troubled, and hasted away.
bsb_text: They saw and were astounded; they fled in terror.
aov_text: Skaars het hulle dit gesien, of hulle het verstom, verskrik geword, in angs weggevlug.

kjv_text: Fear took hold upon them there, and pain, as of a woman in travail.
bsb_text: Trembling seized them there, anguish like a woman in labor.
aov_text: Bewing het hulle daar aangegryp, smart soos van een wat baar.

kjv_text: Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.
bsb_text: With a wind from the east You wrecked the ships of Tarshish.
aov_text: Deur die oostewind verbreek U die skepe van Tarsis.

kjv_text: As we have heard, so have we seen in the city of the LORD of hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish it for ever. Selah.
bsb_text: As we have heard, so we have seen in the city of the LORD of Hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish her forever. Selah
aov_text: Soos ons gehoor het, so het ons gesien in die stad van die HERE van die leërskare, in die stad van onse God: God sal dit bevestig tot in ewigheid. Sela.

kjv_text: We have thought of thy loving-kindness, O God, in the midst of thy temple.
bsb_text: Within Your temple, O God, we contemplate Your loving devotion.
aov_text: o God, ons dink aan u goedertierenheid binne-in u tempel.

kjv_text: According to thy name, O God, so is thy praise unto the ends of the earth: thy right hand is full of righteousness.
bsb_text: Your name, O God, like Your praise, reaches to the ends of the earth; Your right hand is full of righteousness.
aov_text: Soos u Naam, o God, so is u roem tot die eindes van die aarde toe; u regterhand is vol geregtigheid.

kjv_text: Let mount Zion rejoice, let the daughters of Judah be glad, because of thy judgments.
bsb_text: Mount Zion is glad, the daughters of Judah rejoice, on account of Your judgments.
aov_text: Laat die berg Sion bly wees, laat die dogters van Juda juig oor u oordele.

kjv_text: Walk about Zion, and go round about her: tell the towers thereof.
bsb_text: March around Zion, encircle her, count her towers,
aov_text: Gaan rondom Sion, trek daaromheen, tel sy torings;

kjv_text: Mark ye well her bulwarks, consider her palaces; that ye may tell it to the generation following.
bsb_text: consider her ramparts, tour her citadels, that you may tell the next generation.
aov_text: let op sy skanse, wandel deur sy paleise, sodat julle dit aan die volgende geslag kan vertel,

kjv_text: For this God is our God for ever and ever: he will be our guide even unto death.
bsb_text: For this God is our God forever and ever; He will be our guide even till death.
aov_text: dat hierdie God onse God is, vir ewig en altyd; Hý sal ons lei tot die dood toe.

kjv_text: To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Korah.
bsb_text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.
aov_text: VIR die musiekleier. Van die kinders van Korag. ’n Psalm.

kjv_text: Hear this, all ye people; give ear, all ye inhabitants of the world:
bsb_text: Hear this, all you peoples; listen, all inhabitants of the world,
aov_text: Hoor dit, alle volke, luister, alle bewoners van die wêreld,

kjv_text: Both low and high, rich and poor, together.
bsb_text: both low and high, rich and poor alike.
aov_text: geringes sowel as aansienlikes, tesame ryk en arm!

kjv_text: My mouth shall speak of wisdom; and the meditation of my heart shall be of understanding.
bsb_text: My mouth will impart wisdom, and the meditation of my heart will bring understanding.
aov_text: My mond sal louter wysheid spreek, en die oordenking van my hart is net verstand.

kjv_text: I will incline mine ear to a parable: I will open my dark saying upon the harp.
bsb_text: I will incline my ear to a proverb; I will express my riddle with the harp:
aov_text: Ek sal my oor neig tot ’n spreuk; ek sal my raaisel verklaar by die siter.

kjv_text: Wherefore should I fear in the days of evil, when the iniquity of my heels shall compass me about?
bsb_text: Why should I fear in times of trouble, when wicked usurpers surround me?
aov_text: Waarom sou ek vrees in dae van onheil, as die ongeregtigheid van my onderkruipers my omring —

kjv_text: They that trust in their wealth, and boast themselves in the multitude of their riches;
bsb_text: They trust in their wealth and boast in their great riches.
aov_text: die wat vertrou op hulle vermoë en hulle beroem op die grootheid van hulle rykdom?

kjv_text: None of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give to God a ransom for him:
bsb_text: No man can possibly redeem his brother or pay his ransom to God.
aov_text: Niemand kan ooit ’n broer loskoop nie; hy kan aan God sy losprys nie gee nie

kjv_text: (For the redemption of their soul is precious, and it ceaseth for ever:)
bsb_text: For the redemption of his soul is costly, and never can payment suffice,
aov_text: (want die losprys van hulle lewe is te kosbaar en vir ewig ontoereikend),

kjv_text: That he should still live for ever, and not see corruption.
bsb_text: that he should live on forever and not see decay.
aov_text: dat hy vir ewig sou voortlewe, die vernietiging nie sou sien nie.

kjv_text: For he seeth that wise men die, likewise the fool and the brutish person perish, and leave their wealth to others.
bsb_text: For it is clear that wise men die, and the foolish and the senseless both perish and leave their wealth to others.
aov_text: Want hy sien: wyse manne sterwe, die dwaas en die onverstandige kom tesame om en laat hulle vermoë aan ander na.

kjv_text: Their inward thought is, that their houses shall continue for ever, and their dwelling places to all generations; they call their lands after their own names.
bsb_text: Their graves are their eternal homes—their dwellings for endless generations—even though their lands were their namesakes.
aov_text: Hulle binneste gedagte is: hul huise sal vir ewig wees, hul wonings van geslag tot geslag; hulle noem die lande na hul name.

kjv_text: Nevertheless man being in honour abideth not: he is like the beasts that perish.
bsb_text: But a man, despite his wealth, cannot endure; he is like the beasts that perish.
aov_text: Maar die mens wat in aansien is, hou nie stand nie; hy is soos die diere wat vergaan.

kjv_text: This their way is their folly: yet their posterity approve their sayings. Selah.
bsb_text: This is the fate of the self-confident and their followers who endorse their sayings. Selah
aov_text: Dit is die weg van die wat op hulleself vertrou, en van hulle volgelinge wat in hul woorde ’n behae het. Sela.

kjv_text: Like sheep they are laid in the grave; death shall feed on them; and the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; and their beauty shall consume in the grave from their dwelling.
bsb_text: Like sheep they are destined for Sheol. Death will be their shepherd. The upright will rule them in the morning, and their form will decay in Sheol, far from their lofty abode.
aov_text: Soos skape word hulle bestem vir die doderyk; die dood is hulle herder, en die opregtes heers oor hulle in die môre; en hulle gestalte is daar vir die doderyk om te verteer, sodat daarvoor geen woning meer is nie.

kjv_text: But God will redeem my soul from the power of the grave: for he shall receive me. Selah.
bsb_text: But God will redeem my life from Sheol, for He will surely take me to Himself. Selah
aov_text: Maar God sal my siel loskoop van die mag van die doderyk, want Hy sal my opneem. Sela.

kjv_text: Be not thou afraid when one is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;
bsb_text: Do not be amazed when a man grows rich, when the splendor of his house increases.
aov_text: Wees nie bevrees as ’n man ryk word, as die rykdom van sy huis groot word nie;

kjv_text: For when he dieth he shall carry nothing away: his glory shall not descend after him.
bsb_text: For when he dies, he will carry nothing away; his abundance will not follow him down.
aov_text: want by sy dood sal hy van alles niks saamneem nie; sy heerlikheid sal nie neerdaal agter hom aan nie.

kjv_text: Though while he lived he blessed his soul: and men will praise thee, when thou doest well to thyself.
bsb_text: Though in his lifetime he blesses his soul—and men praise you when you prosper—
aov_text: Al ag hy homself gelukkig in sy lewe—en prys hulle jou, omdat jy aan jouself goed doen —

kjv_text: He shall go to the generation of his fathers; they shall never see light.
bsb_text: he will join the generation of his fathers, who will never see the light of day.
aov_text: tog gaan sy siel na die geslag van sy vaders; tot in ewigheid sal hulle die lig nie sien nie.

kjv_text: Man that is in honour, and understandeth not, is like the beasts that perish.
bsb_text: A man who has riches without understanding is like the beasts that perish.
aov_text: Die mens wat in aansien is en geen verstand het nie, is soos die diere wat vergaan.

kjv_text: A Psalm of Asaph. The mighty God, even the LORD, hath spoken, and called the earth from the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof.
bsb_text: A Psalm of Asaph. The Mighty One, God the LORD, speaks and summons the earth from where the sun rises to where it sets.
aov_text: ’N PSALM van Asaf. Die God van die gode, die HERE, spreek en roep die aarde, van die opgang van die son af tot sy ondergang toe.

kjv_text: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God hath shined.
bsb_text: From Zion, perfect in beauty, God shines forth.
aov_text: Uit Sion, die volkomenheid van skoonheid, verskyn God in ligglans.

kjv_text: Our God shall come, and shall not keep silence: a fire shall devour before him, and it shall be very tempestuous round about him.
bsb_text: Our God approaches and will not be silent! Consuming fire precedes Him, and a tempest rages around Him.
aov_text: Onse God kom en kan nie swyg nie. Vuur verteer voor sy aangesig, en rondom Hom storm dit geweldig.

kjv_text: He shall call to the heavens from above, and to the earth, that he may judge his people.
bsb_text: He summons the heavens above, and the earth, that He may judge His people:
aov_text: Hy roep na die hemel daarbo, en na die aarde, om sy volk te oordeel:

kjv_text: Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.
bsb_text: “Gather to Me My saints, who made a covenant with Me by sacrifice.”
aov_text: Versamel my gunsgenote vir My, hulle wat my verbond by die offer sluit!

kjv_text: And the heavens shall declare his righteousness: for God is judge himself. Selah.
bsb_text: And the heavens proclaim His righteousness, for God Himself is Judge. Selah
aov_text: En—die hemele verkondig sy geregtigheid, want God staan gereed om te oordeel! Sela.

kjv_text: Hear, O my people, and I will speak; O Israel, and I will testify against thee: I am God, even thy God.
bsb_text: “Hear, O My people, and I will speak, O Israel, and I will testify against you: I am God, your God.
aov_text: Hoor, my volk, dat Ek kan spreek; Israel, dat Ek jou dit kan inskerp: Ek is God, jou God!

kjv_text: I will not reprove thee for thy sacrifices or thy burnt offerings, to have been continually before me.
bsb_text: I do not rebuke you for your sacrifices, and your burnt offerings are ever before Me.
aov_text: Oor jou offers bestraf Ek jou nie, en jou brandoffers is altyddeur voor My.

kjv_text: I will take no bullock out of thy house, nor he goats out of thy folds.
bsb_text: I have no need for a bull from your stall or goats from your pens,
aov_text: Ek hoef uit jou huis geen stier te neem of bokke uit jou krale nie;

kjv_text: For every beast of the forest is mine, and the cattle upon a thousand hills.
bsb_text: for every beast of the forest is Mine—the cattle on a thousand hills.
aov_text: want al die wilde diere van die bos is myne, die vee op berge by duisende.

kjv_text: I know all the fowls of the mountains: and the wild beasts of the field are mine.
bsb_text: I know every bird in the mountains, and the creatures of the field are Mine.
aov_text: Ek ken al die voëls van die berge, en wat roer op die veld, is van My.

kjv_text: If I were hungry, I would not tell thee: for the world is mine, and the fulness thereof.
bsb_text: If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world is Mine, and the fullness thereof.
aov_text: As Ek honger het, sal Ek jou dit nie sê nie; want die wêreld is myne en sy volheid.

kjv_text: Will I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?
bsb_text: Do I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?
aov_text: Sou Ek vleis van stiere eet of bloed van bokke drink?

kjv_text: Offer unto God thanksgiving; and pay thy vows unto the most High:
bsb_text: Sacrifice a thank offering to God, and fulfill your vows to the Most High.
aov_text: Offer dank aan God, en betaal jou geloftes aan die Allerhoogste;

kjv_text: And call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.
bsb_text: Call upon Me in the day of trouble; I will deliver you, and you will honor Me.”
aov_text: en roep My aan in die dag van benoudheid: Ek sal jou uithelp, en jy moet My eer.

kjv_text: But unto the wicked God saith, What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, or that thou shouldest take my covenant in thy mouth?
bsb_text: To the wicked, however, God says, “What right have you to recite My statutes and to bear My covenant on your lips?
aov_text: Maar aan die goddelose sê God: Wat vertel jy nog my insettinge en neem jy my verbond in jou mond —

kjv_text: Seeing thou hatest instruction, and castest my words behind thee.
bsb_text: For you hate My instruction and cast My words behind you.
aov_text: terwyl jy die tug haat en my woorde agter jou werp?

kjv_text: When thou sawest a thief, then thou consentedst with him, and hast been partaker with adulterers.
bsb_text: When you see a thief, you befriend him, and throw in your lot with adulterers.
aov_text: As jy ’n dief sien, dan geval dit jou by hom, en jou deel is met die egbrekers.

kjv_text: Thou givest thy mouth to evil, and thy tongue frameth deceit.
bsb_text: You unleash your mouth for evil and unharness your tongue for deceit.
aov_text: Jou mond laat jy los in boosheid, en jou tong vleg bedrog.

kjv_text: Thou sittest and speakest against thy brother; thou slanderest thine own mother's son.
bsb_text: You sit and malign your brother; you slander your own mother’s son.
aov_text: Jy sit en praat teen jou broer, die seun van jou moeder beskimp jy.

kjv_text: These things hast thou done, and I kept silence; thou thoughtest that I was altogether such an one as thyself: but I will reprove thee, and set them in order before thine eyes.
bsb_text: You have done these things, and I kept silent; you thought I was just like you. But now I rebuke you and accuse you to your face.
aov_text: Hierdie dinge het jy gedoen, en sou Ek swyg? Jy dink Ek is net soos jy! Ek gaan jou straf en jou dit ordelik voor oë stel.

kjv_text: Now consider this, ye that forget God, lest I tear you in pieces, and there be none to deliver.
bsb_text: Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you to pieces, with no one to rescue you:
aov_text: Verstaan dit tog, o Godvergeters, sodat Ek nie verskeur sonder dat iemand red nie.

kjv_text: Whoso offereth praise glorifieth me: and to him that ordereth his conversation aright will I shew the salvation of God.
bsb_text: He who sacrifices a thank offering honors Me, and to him who rights his way, I will show the salvation of God.”
aov_text: Die een wat dank offer, eer My; en die een wat op sy weg ag gee, hom sal Ek die heil van God laat geniet.

kjv_text: To the chief Musician, [A Psalm] of David,
bsb_text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David.
aov_text: VIR die musiekleier. ’n Psalm van Dawid,

kjv_text: when Nathan the prophet came unto him, after he had gone in to Bathsheba.
bsb_text: When Nathan the prophet came to him after his adultery with Bathsheba.
aov_text: toe die profeet Natan na hom gekom het, nadat hy by Bátseba ingegaan het.

kjv_text: Have mercy upon me, O God, according to thy loving-kindness: according unto the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.
bsb_text: Have mercy on me, O God, according to Your loving devotion; according to Your great compassion, blot out my transgressions.
aov_text: Wees my genadig, o God, na u goedertierenheid; delg my oortredinge uit na die grootheid van u barmhartigheid.

kjv_text: Wash me throughly from mine iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.
bsb_text: Wash me clean of my iniquity and cleanse me from my sin.
aov_text: Was my heeltemal van my ongeregtigheid en reinig my van my sonde.

kjv_text: For I acknowledge my transgressions: and my sin is ever before me.
bsb_text: For I know my transgressions, and my sin is always before me.
aov_text: Want ék ken my oortredinge, en my sonde is altyddeur voor my.

kjv_text: Against thee, thee only, have I sinned, and done this evil in thy sight: that thou mightest be justified when thou speakest, and be clear when thou judgest.
bsb_text: Against You, You only, have I sinned and done what is evil in Your sight, so that You may be proved right when You speak and blameless when You judge.
aov_text: Teen U alleen het ek gesondig en gedoen wat verkeerd is in u oë, sodat U regverdig kan wees as U spreek, rein as U gerig hou.

kjv_text: Behold, I was shapen in iniquity; and in sin did my mother conceive me.
bsb_text: Surely I was brought forth in iniquity; I was sinful when my mother conceived me.
aov_text: Kyk, in ongeregtigheid is ek gebore, en in sonde het my moeder my ontvang.

kjv_text: Behold, thou desirest truth in the inward parts: and in the hidden part thou shalt make me to know wisdom.
bsb_text: Surely You desire truth in the inmost being; You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.
aov_text: Kyk, U het ’n welgevalle aan waarheid in die binneste, en in die verborgene maak U aan my wysheid bekend.

kjv_text: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.
bsb_text: Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean; wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.
aov_text: Ontsondig my met hisop, dat ek kan rein wees; was my, dat ek witter kan wees as sneeu.

kjv_text: Make me to hear joy and gladness; that the bones which thou hast broken may rejoice.
bsb_text: Let me hear joy and gladness; let the bones You have crushed rejoice.
aov_text: Laat my vreugde en blydskap hoor; laat die gebeente juig wat U verbrysel het.

kjv_text: Hide thy face from my sins, and blot out all mine iniquities.
bsb_text: Hide Your face from my sins and blot out all my iniquities.
aov_text: Verberg u aangesig vir my sondes en delg uit al my ongeregtighede.

kjv_text: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.
bsb_text: Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within me.
aov_text: Skep vir my ’n rein hart, o God, en gee opnuut in die binneste van my ’n vaste gees.

kjv_text: Cast me not away from thy presence; and take not thy holy spirit from me.
bsb_text: Cast me not away from Your presence; take not Your Holy Spirit from me.
aov_text: Verwerp my nie van u aangesig nie en neem u Heilige Gees nie van my weg nie.

kjv_text: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me with thy free spirit.
bsb_text: Restore to me the joy of Your salvation, and sustain me with a willing spirit.
aov_text: Gee my weer die vreugde van u heil, en ondersteun my deur ’n gewillige gees.

kjv_text: Then will I teach transgressors thy ways; and sinners shall be converted unto thee.
bsb_text: Then I will teach transgressors Your ways, and sinners will return to You.
aov_text: Ek wil die oortreders u weë leer, dat die sondaars hulle tot U kan bekeer.

kjv_text: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, thou God of my salvation: and my tongue shall sing aloud of thy righteousness.
bsb_text: Deliver me from bloodguilt, O God, the God of my salvation, and my tongue will sing of Your righteousness.
aov_text: Red my van bloedskuld, o God, God van my heil! Laat my tong u geregtigheid uitjubel.

kjv_text: O Lord, open thou my lips; and my mouth shall shew forth thy praise.
bsb_text: O Lord, open my lips, and my mouth will declare Your praise.
aov_text: Here, open my lippe, dat my mond u lof kan verkondig.

kjv_text: For thou desirest not sacrifice; else would I give it: thou delightest not in burnt offering.
bsb_text: For You do not delight in sacrifice, or I would bring it; You take no pleasure in burnt offerings.
aov_text: Want U het geen lus in slagoffer nie, anders sou ek dit gee; in brandoffer het U geen behae nie.

kjv_text: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.
bsb_text: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit; a broken and a contrite heart, O God, You will not despise.
aov_text: Die offers van God is ’n gebroke gees; ’n gebroke en verslae hart sal U, o God, nie verag nie!

kjv_text: Do good in thy good pleasure unto Zion: build thou the walls of Jerusalem.
bsb_text: In Your good pleasure, cause Zion to prosper; build up the walls of Jerusalem.
aov_text: Doen goed aan Sion na u welbehae; bou die mure van Jerusalem op.

kjv_text: Then shalt thou be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness, with burnt offering and whole burnt offering: then shall they offer bullocks upon thine altar.
bsb_text: Then You will delight in righteous sacrifices, in whole burnt offerings; then bulls will be offered on Your altar.
aov_text: Dan sal U ’n welbehae hê in die offers van geregtigheid, in brandoffer en voloffer; dan sal hulle stiere offer op u altaar.

kjv_text: To the chief Musician, Maschil, [A Psalm] of David,
bsb_text: For the choirmaster. A Maskil of David.
aov_text: VIR die musiekleier. ’n Onderwysing van Dawid,

kjv_text: when Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul, and said unto him, David is come to the house of Ahimelech.
bsb_text: After Doeg the Edomite went to Saul and told him, “David has gone to the house of Ahimelech.”
aov_text: toe Doëg, die Edomiet, gekom het en aan Saul te kenne gegee en aan hom gesê het: Dawid het in die huis van Ahiméleg ingegaan.

kjv_text: Why boastest thou thyself in mischief, O mighty man? the goodness of God endureth continually.
bsb_text: Why do you boast of evil, O mighty man? The loving devotion of God endures all day long.
aov_text: Wat beroem jy jou in die kwaad, o geweldige? Die goedertierenheid van God duur die hele dag!

kjv_text: Thy tongue deviseth mischiefs; like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.
bsb_text: Your tongue devises destruction like a sharpened razor, O worker of deceit.
aov_text: Jou tong beraam onheil, soos ’n geslypte skeermes, o werker van bedrog!

kjv_text: Thou lovest evil more than good; and lying rather than to speak righteousness. Selah.
bsb_text: You love evil more than good, falsehood more than speaking truth. Selah
aov_text: Jy hou meer van kwaad as van goed, van die leuen meer as om geregtigheid te spreek. Sela.

kjv_text: Thou lovest all devouring words, O thou deceitful tongue.
bsb_text: You love every word that devours, O deceitful tongue.
aov_text: Jy hou net van woorde wat verslind, o bedrieglike tong!

kjv_text: God shall likewise destroy thee for ever, he shall take thee away, and pluck thee out of thy dwelling place, and root thee out of the land of the living. Selah.
bsb_text: Surely God will bring you down to everlasting ruin; He will snatch you up and tear you away from your tent; He will uproot you from the land of the living. Selah
aov_text: So sal God jou dan ook vir ewig omverwerp, jou wegruk en jou uit die tent uitsleep; ja, Hy sal jou ontwortel uit die land van die lewendes. Sela.

kjv_text: The righteous also shall see, and fear, and shall laugh at him:
bsb_text: The righteous will see and fear; they will mock the evildoer, saying,
aov_text: En die regverdiges sal dit sien en vrees; en hulle sal oor hom lag en sê:

kjv_text: Lo, this is the man that made not God his strength; but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.
bsb_text: “Look at the man who did not make God his refuge, but trusted in the abundance of his wealth and strengthened himself by destruction.”
aov_text: Kyk, die man wat God nie tot sy toevlug gemaak het nie, maar vertrou het op die grootheid van sy rykdom, sterk was in sy begeerlikheid!

kjv_text: But I am like a green olive tree in the house of God: I trust in the mercy of God for ever and ever.
bsb_text: But I am like an olive tree flourishing in the house of God; I trust in the loving devotion of God forever and ever.
aov_text: Maar ek sal wees soos ’n groen olyfboom in die huis van God; ek vertrou op die goedertierenheid van God vir ewig en altyd.

kjv_text: I will praise thee for ever, because thou hast done it: and I will wait on thy name; for it is good before thy saints.
bsb_text: I will praise You forever, because You have done it. I will wait on Your name—for it is good—in the presence of Your saints.
aov_text: Vir ewig sal ek U loof, omdat U dit gedoen het; en ek sal u Naam verwag, want dié is goed, in teenwoordigheid van u gunsgenote.

kjv_text: To the chief Musician upon Mahalath, Maschil, [A Psalm] of David.
bsb_text: For the choirmaster. According to Mahalath. A Maskil of David.
aov_text: VIR die musiekleier; op die wysie van: „Máhalat.” ’n Onderwysing van Dawid.

kjv_text: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. Corrupt are they, and have done abominable iniquity: there is none that doeth good.
bsb_text: The fool says in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt; their ways are vile. There is no one who does good.
aov_text: Die dwaas sê in sy hart: Daar is geen God nie! Hulle het sleg gehandel en hul onreg afskuwelik gemaak; daar is niemand wat goed doen nie.

kjv_text: God looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, that did seek God.
bsb_text: God looks down from heaven upon the sons of men to see if any understand, if any seek God.
aov_text: God het uit die hemel neergesien op die mensekinders om te sien of daar iemand verstandig is, wat na God vra.

kjv_text: Every one of them is gone back: they are altogether become filthy; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
bsb_text: All have turned away, they have together become corrupt; there is no one who does good, not even one.
aov_text: Hulle het almal afgewyk, tesame het hulle ontaard; daar is niemand wat goed doen nie, ook nie een nie.

kjv_text: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread: they have not called upon God.
bsb_text: Will the workers of iniquity never learn? They devour my people like bread; they refuse to call upon God.
aov_text: Het die werkers van ongeregtigheid dan geen kennis nie, wat my volk opeet asof hulle brood eet? Hulle roep God nie aan nie.

kjv_text: There were they in great fear, where no fear was: for God hath scattered the bones of him that encampeth against thee: thou hast put them to shame, because God hath despised them.
bsb_text: There they are, overwhelmed with dread, where there was nothing to fear. For God has scattered the bones of those who besieged you. You put them to shame, for God has despised them.
aov_text: Dáár het skrik hulle oorweldig sonder dat daar skrik was; want God het die beendere verstrooi van hom wat jou beleër het; jy het hulle beskaamd gemaak, want God het hulle verwerp.

kjv_text: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When God bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
bsb_text: Oh, that the salvation of Israel would come from Zion! When God restores His captive people, let Jacob rejoice, let Israel be glad!
aov_text: Ag, mag die verlossing van Israel uit Sion kom! As God die lot van sy volk verander, dan sal Jakob juig, Israel sal bly wees.

kjv_text: To the chief Musician on Neginoth, Maschil, [A Psalm] of David,
bsb_text: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Maskil of David.
aov_text: VIR die musiekleier; met snaarinstrumente. ’n Onderwysing van Dawid,

kjv_text: when the Ziphims came and said to Saul, Doth not David hide himself with us?
bsb_text: When the Ziphites went to Saul and said, “Is David not hiding among us?”
aov_text: toe die Sifiete gekom en aan Saul gesê het: Het Dawid hom nie by ons weggesteek nie?

kjv_text: Save me, O God, by thy name, and judge me by thy strength.
bsb_text: Save me, O God, by Your name, and vindicate me by Your might!
aov_text: o God, verlos my deur u Naam, en doen aan my reg deur u mag!

kjv_text: Hear my prayer, O God; give ear to the words of my mouth.
bsb_text: Hear my prayer, O God; listen to the words of my mouth.
aov_text: o God, hoor my gebed, luister na die woorde van my mond!

kjv_text: For strangers are risen up against me, and oppressors seek after my soul: they have not set God before them. Selah.
bsb_text: For strangers rise up against me, and ruthless men seek my life—men with no regard for God. Selah
aov_text: Want vreemdes staan teen my op, en tiranne soek my lewe; hulle stel God nie voor hul oë nie. Sela.

kjv_text: Behold, God is mine helper: the Lord is with them that uphold my soul.
bsb_text: Surely God is my helper; the Lord is the sustainer of my soul.
aov_text: Kyk, God is my helper. Dit is die Here wat my siel ondersteun.

kjv_text: He shall reward evil unto mine enemies: cut them off in thy truth.
bsb_text: He will reward my enemies with evil. In Your faithfulness, destroy them.
aov_text: Hy sal my vyande die kwaad vergelde. Vernietig hulle in u trou!

kjv_text: I will freely sacrifice unto thee: I will praise thy name, O LORD; for it is good.
bsb_text: Freely I will sacrifice to You; I will praise Your name, O LORD, for it is good.
aov_text: Vrywillig wil ek aan U offer; ek wil u Naam, o HERE, loof, want dié is goed;

kjv_text: For he hath delivered me out of all trouble: and mine eye hath seen his desire upon mine enemies.
bsb_text: For He has delivered me from every trouble, and my eyes have stared down my foes.
aov_text: want dié het my uit alle benoudheid gered, en my oog het met welgevalle op my vyande neergesien.

kjv_text: To the chief Musician on Neginoth, Maschil, [A Psalm] of David.
bsb_text: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Maskil of David.
aov_text: VIR die musiekleier; met snaarinstrumente. ’n Onderwysing van Dawid.

kjv_text: Give ear to my prayer, O God; and hide not thyself from my supplication.
bsb_text: Listen to my prayer, O God, and do not ignore my plea.
aov_text: o God, hoor my gebed en verberg U nie vir my smeking nie.

kjv_text: Attend unto me, and hear me: I mourn in my complaint, and make a noise;
bsb_text: Attend to me and answer me. I am restless in my complaint, and distraught
aov_text: Luister na my en verhoor my; in my onrus dwaal ek rond en is verward,

kjv_text: Because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked: for they cast iniquity upon me, and in wrath they hate me.
bsb_text: at the voice of the enemy, at the pressure of the wicked. For they release disaster upon me and revile me in their anger.
aov_text: weens die geroep van die vyand, weens die geraas van die goddelose; want hulle stort onreg op my af, en in toorn behandel hulle my as vyand.

kjv_text: My heart is sore pained within me: and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.
bsb_text: My heart murmurs within me, and the terrors of death assail me.
aov_text: My hart krimp inmekaar in my binneste, en verskrikkinge van die dood het op my geval.

kjv_text: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, and horror hath overwhelmed me.
bsb_text: Fear and trembling grip me, and horror has overwhelmed me.
aov_text: Vrees en bewing kom oor my, en angs oordek my.

kjv_text: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! for then would I fly away, and be at rest.
bsb_text: I said, “Oh, that I had wings like a dove! I would fly away and find rest.
aov_text: Toe het ek gesê: Ag, had ek maar vlerke soos ’n duif, dan sou ek wegvlieg en wegbly!

kjv_text: Lo, then would I wander far off, and remain in the wilderness. Selah.
bsb_text: How far away I would flee! In the wilderness I would remain. Selah
aov_text: Kyk, ek sou ver wegvlug; ek sou vernag in die woestyn! Sela.

kjv_text: I would hasten my escape from the windy storm and tempest.
bsb_text: I would hurry to my shelter, far from this raging tempest.”
aov_text: Gou sou ek vir my ’n skuilplek soek teen die onstuimige wind, teen die storm.

kjv_text: Destroy, O Lord, and divide their tongues: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.
bsb_text: O Lord, confuse and confound their speech, for I see violence and strife in the city.
aov_text: Verwar, Here, verdeel hulle spraak, want ek sien geweld en twis in die stad.

kjv_text: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: mischief also and sorrow are in the midst of it.
bsb_text: Day and night they encircle the walls, while malice and trouble lie within.
aov_text: Dag en nag omring hulle dit op sy mure, en binnekant is onreg en moeite.

kjv_text: Wickedness is in the midst thereof: deceit and guile depart not from her streets.
bsb_text: Destruction is within; oppression and deceit never leave the streets.
aov_text: Wat onheil aanbring, is daarbinne, en verdrukking en bedrog wyk nie van sy markplein nie.

kjv_text: For it was not an enemy that reproached me; then I could have borne it: neither was it he that hated me that did magnify himself against me; then I would have hid myself from him:
bsb_text: For it is not an enemy who insults me; that I could endure. It is not a foe who rises against me; from him I could hide.
aov_text: Want dit is geen vyand wat my smaad nie, anders sou ek dit dra; dit is nie my hater wat hom teen my groot maak nie, anders sou ek my vir hom wegsteek;

kjv_text: But it was thou, a man mine equal, my guide, and mine acquaintance.
bsb_text: But it is you, a man like myself, my companion and close friend.
aov_text: maar jy, ’n man soos ek, my vriend en my vertroude!

kjv_text: We took sweet counsel together, and walked unto the house of God in company.
bsb_text: We shared sweet fellowship together; we walked with the crowd into the house of God.
aov_text: Ons wat innig met mekaar omgegaan het, in die huis van God gewandel het met die woelige skare.

kjv_text: Let death seize upon them, and let them go down quick into hell: for wickedness is in their dwellings, and among them.
bsb_text: Let death seize them by surprise; let them go down to Sheol alive, for evil is with them in their homes.
aov_text: Laat die dood hulle oorval, laat hulle lewendig in die doderyk neerdaal; want boosheid is in hulle woning, in hulle binneste.

kjv_text: As for me, I will call upon God; and the LORD shall save me.
bsb_text: But I call to God, and the LORD saves me.
aov_text: Maar ek, ek roep God aan, en die HERE sal my verlos.

kjv_text: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and he shall hear my voice.
bsb_text: Morning, noon, and night, I cry out in distress, and He hears my voice.
aov_text: Saans en smôrens en smiddags klaag ek en steun, en Hy hoor my stem.

kjv_text: He hath delivered my soul in peace from the battle that was against me: for there were many with me.
bsb_text: He redeems my soul in peace from the battle waged against me, even though many oppose me.
aov_text: Hy verlos my siel in vrede van die stryd teen my, want met menigtes is hulle teen my.

kjv_text: God shall hear, and afflict them, even he that abideth of old. Selah. Because they have no changes, therefore they fear not God.
bsb_text: God will hear and humiliate them—the One enthroned for the ages—Selah because they do not change and they have no fear of God.
aov_text: God sal hoor en hulle antwoord; ja, Hy wat op die troon sit van lankal af, Sela; omdat by hulle geen verbetering is en hulle God nie vrees nie.

kjv_text: He hath put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he hath broken his covenant.
bsb_text: My companion attacks his friends; he violates his covenant.
aov_text: Hy het sy hande uitgesteek teen die wat in vrede met hom geleef het; hy het sy verbond ontheilig.

kjv_text: The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet were they drawn swords.
bsb_text: His speech is smooth as butter, but war is in his heart. His words are softer than oil, yet they are swords unsheathed.
aov_text: Glad is die botterwoorde van sy mond, maar sy hart is oorlog; sy woorde is sagter as olie, maar hulle is ontblote swaarde.

kjv_text: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.
bsb_text: Cast your burden upon the LORD and He will sustain you; He will never let the righteous be shaken.
aov_text: Werp jou sorg op die HERE, en Hý sal jou onderhou; Hy sal nooit die regverdige laat wankel nie.

kjv_text: But thou, O God, shalt bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in thee.
bsb_text: But You, O God, will bring them down to the Pit of destruction; men of bloodshed and deceit will not live out half their days. But I will trust in You.
aov_text: Maar U, o God, sal hulle laat neerdaal in die put van vernietiging; manne van bloed en bedrog sal hulle dae nie tot op die helfte bring nie; maar ék vertrou op U.

kjv_text: To the chief Musician upon Jonathelemrechokim, Michtam of David, when the Philistines took him in Gath.
bsb_text: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “A Dove on Distant Oaks.” A Miktam of David, when the Philistines seized him in Gath.
aov_text: VIR die musiekleier; op die wysie van: „Die Duif van die ver Terebinte.” Van Dawid. ’n Gedig, toe die Filistyne hom gevang het in Gat.

kjv_text: Be merciful unto me, O God: for man would swallow me up; he fighting daily oppresseth me.
bsb_text: Be merciful to me, O God, for men are hounding me; all day they press their attack.
aov_text: Wees my genadig, o God, want mense vertrap my; hy wat my beveg, verdruk my die hele dag.

kjv_text: Mine enemies would daily swallow me up: for they be many that fight against me, O thou most High.
bsb_text: My enemies pursue me all day long, for many proudly assail me.
aov_text: My vyande vertrap my die hele dag, want baie veg teen my in hoogmoed.

kjv_text: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.
bsb_text: When I am afraid, I put my trust in You.
aov_text: Die dag as ek vrees, sal ék op U vertrou.

kjv_text: In God I will praise his word, in God I have put my trust; I will not fear what flesh can do unto me.
bsb_text: In God, whose word I praise—in God I trust. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
aov_text: Deur God sal ek sy woord prys; ek vertrou op God, ek vrees nie; wat kan vlees my doen?

kjv_text: Every day they wrest my words: all their thoughts are against me for evil.
bsb_text: All day long they twist my words; all their thoughts are on my demise.
aov_text: Die hele dag verdraai hulle my woorde; al hulle gedagtes is teen my, om kwaad te doen.

kjv_text: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, they mark my steps, when they wait for my soul.
bsb_text: They conspire, they lurk, they watch my steps while they wait to take my life.
aov_text: Hulle val aan, lê en loer—hulle let op my hakskene net soos hulle op my lewe geloer het.

kjv_text: Shall they escape by iniquity? in thine anger cast down the people, O God.
bsb_text: In spite of such sin, will they escape? In Your anger, O God, cast down the nations.
aov_text: Ondanks hul ongeregtigheid—sal hulle ontvlug? Werp volke neer in toorn, o God!

kjv_text: Thou tellest my wanderings: put thou my tears into thy bottle: are they not in thy book?
bsb_text: You have taken account of my wanderings. Put my tears in Your bottle—are they not in Your book?
aov_text: Ú het my omswerwinge getel; hou my trane in u kruik; is hulle nie in u boek nie?

kjv_text: When I cry unto thee, then shall mine enemies turn back: this I know; for God is for me.
bsb_text: Then my enemies will retreat on the day I cry for help. By this I will know that God is on my side.
aov_text: Dan sal my vyande agteruitwyk op die dag as ek roep; dit weet ek dat God aan my kant is.

kjv_text: In God will I praise his word: in the LORD will I praise his word.
bsb_text: In God, whose word I praise, in the LORD, whose word I praise,
aov_text: Deur God sal ek die woord prys; deur die HERE sal ek die woord prys.

kjv_text: In God have I put my trust: I will not be afraid what man can do unto me.
bsb_text: in God I trust; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
aov_text: Ek vertrou op God, ek vrees nie; wat kan ’n mens my doen?

kjv_text: Thy vows are upon me, O God: I will render praises unto thee.
bsb_text: Your vows are upon me, O God; I will render thank offerings to You.
aov_text: Op my, o God, rus geloftes aan U gedoen; lofoffers sal ek U betaal;

kjv_text: For thou hast delivered my soul from death: wilt not thou deliver my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living?
bsb_text: For You have delivered my soul from death, and my feet from stumbling, that I may walk before God in the light of life.
aov_text: want U het my siel gered van die dood—ja, my voete van struikeling—om te wandel voor die aangesig van God in die lig van die lewe.

kjv_text: To the chief Musician, Altaschith, Michtam of David, when he fled from Saul in the cave.
bsb_text: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Miktam of David, when he fled from Saul into the cave.
aov_text: VIR die musiekleier; op die wysie van: „Moenie verwoes nie.” Van Dawid. ’n Gedig, toe hy vir Saul in die spelonk gevlug het.

kjv_text: Be merciful unto me, O God, be merciful unto me: for my soul trusteth in thee: yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge, until these calamities be overpast.
bsb_text: Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy, for in You my soul takes refuge. In the shadow of Your wings I will take shelter until the danger has passed.
aov_text: Wees my genadig, o God, wees my genadig, want by U het my siel geskuil, en in die skaduwee van u vleuels sal ek skuil totdat die onheil verbygegaan het.

kjv_text: I will cry unto God most high; unto God that performeth all things for me.
bsb_text: I cry out to God Most High, to God who fulfills His purpose for me.
aov_text: Ek roep God, die Allerhoogste, aan, God wat dit vir my voleindig.

kjv_text: He shall send from heaven, and save me from the reproach of him that would swallow me up. Selah. God shall send forth his mercy and his truth.
bsb_text: He reaches down from heaven and saves me; He rebukes those who trample me. Selah God sends forth His loving devotion and His truth.
aov_text: Hy sal uit die hemel stuur en my verlos terwyl hy wat my vertrap, my smaadheid aandoen. Sela. God sal sy goedertierenheid en sy trou stuur.

kjv_text: My soul is among lions: and I lie even among them that are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.
bsb_text: My soul is among the lions; I lie down with ravenous beasts—with men whose teeth are spears and arrows, whose tongues are sharp swords.
aov_text: Ék moet onder leeus lê, wraakgieriges, mensekinders wie se tande spiese en pyle is, en wie se tong ’n skerp swaard is.

kjv_text: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; let thy glory be above all the earth.
bsb_text: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; may Your glory cover all the earth.
aov_text: Verhef U bo die hemele, o God, u heerlikheid bo die hele aarde!

kjv_text: They have prepared a net for my steps; my soul is bowed down: they have digged a pit before me, into the midst whereof they are fallen themselves. Selah.
bsb_text: They spread a net for my feet; my soul was despondent. They dug a pit before me, but they themselves have fallen into it! Selah
aov_text: Hulle het ’n net gespan vir my voetstappe, hulle het my siel neergebuig; hulle het ’n kuil voor my gegrawe, hulle val daar binne-in. Sela.

kjv_text: My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed: I will sing and give praise.
bsb_text: My heart is steadfast, O God, my heart is steadfast. I will sing and make music.
aov_text: My hart is gerus, o God, my hart is gerus; ek wil sing en psalmsing.

kjv_text: Awake up, my glory; awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.
bsb_text: Awake, my glory! Awake, O harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.
aov_text: Waak op, my eer! Waak op, harp en siter! Ek wil die dageraad wakker maak!

kjv_text: I will praise thee, O Lord, among the people: I will sing unto thee among the nations.
bsb_text: I will praise You, O Lord, among the nations; I will sing Your praises among the peoples.
aov_text: Ek wil U loof onder die volke, o Here, psalmsing tot u eer onder die nasies.

kjv_text: For thy mercy is great unto the heavens, and thy truth unto the clouds.
bsb_text: For Your loving devotion reaches to the heavens, and Your faithfulness to the clouds.
aov_text: Want u goedertierenheid is groot tot by die hemele en u trou tot by die wolke.

kjv_text: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: let thy glory be above all the earth.
bsb_text: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; may Your glory cover all the earth.
aov_text: Verhef U bo die hemele, o God, u heerlikheid bo die hele aarde!

kjv_text: To the chief Musician, Altaschith, Michtam of David.
bsb_text: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Miktam of David.
aov_text: VIR die musiekleier; op die wysie van: „Moenie verwoes nie.” Van Dawid. ’n Gedig.

kjv_text: Do ye indeed speak righteousness, O congregation? do ye judge uprightly, O ye sons of men?
bsb_text: Do you indeed speak justly, O rulers? Do you judge uprightly, O sons of men?
aov_text: Spreek julle waarlik geregtigheid, o gode? Oordeel julle die mensekinders regverdig?

kjv_text: Yea, in heart ye work wickedness; ye weigh the violence of your hands in the earth.
bsb_text: No, in your hearts you devise injustice; with your hands you mete out violence on the earth.
aov_text: Ja, julle bedryf ongeregtighede in die hart; julle weeg op aarde die geweld van julle hande af.

kjv_text: The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies.
bsb_text: The wicked are estranged from the womb; the liars go astray from birth.
aov_text: Afvallig is die goddelose mense van die geboorte af; die leuensprekers dwaal van die moederskoot af.

kjv_text: Their poison is like the poison of a serpent: they are like the deaf adder that stoppeth her ear;
bsb_text: Their venom is like the venom of a snake, like a cobra that shuts its ears,
aov_text: Hulle het gif soos die gif van ’n slang; soos ’n dowe adder wat sy oor toestop,

kjv_text: Which will not hearken to the voice of charmers, charming never so wisely.
bsb_text: refusing to hear the tune of the charmer who skillfully weaves his spell.
aov_text: wat nie luister na die stem van die besweerders, van hom wat ervare is om met towerspreuke om te gaan nie.

kjv_text: Break their teeth, O God, in their mouth: break out the great teeth of the young lions, O LORD.
bsb_text: O God, shatter their teeth in their mouths; O LORD, tear out the fangs of the lions.
aov_text: o God, verbreek hulle tande in hulle mond, slaan die tande van die jong leeus uit, o HERE!

kjv_text: Let them melt away as waters which run continually: when he bendeth his bow to shoot his arrows, let them be as cut in pieces.
bsb_text: May they vanish like water that runs off; when they draw the bow, may their arrows be blunted.
aov_text: Laat hulle vergaan soos water wat wegloop; as hy sy pyle rig, laat hulle wees asof hulle stomp geword het.

kjv_text: As a snail which melteth, let every one of them pass away: like the untimely birth of a woman, that they may not see the sun.
bsb_text: Like a slug that dissolves in its slime, like a woman’s stillborn child, may they never see the sun.
aov_text: Laat hulle wees soos ’n slak wat wegsmelt so ver as hy loop, soos ’n misgeboorte wat die son nie gesien het nie.

kjv_text: Before your pots can feel the thorns, he shall take them away as with a whirlwind, both living, and in his wrath.
bsb_text: Before your pots can feel the burning thorns—whether green or dry—He will sweep them away.
aov_text: Voordat julle potte die doringtak gewaar word, sal Hy dit wegstorm, die rou vleis sowel as die vuurgloed.

kjv_text: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance: he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.
bsb_text: The righteous will rejoice when they see they are avenged; they will wash their feet in the blood of the wicked.
aov_text: Die regverdige sal bly wees as hy die wraak sien; hy sal sy voete was in die bloed van die goddelose.

kjv_text: So that a man shall say, Verily there is a reward for the righteous: verily he is a God that judgeth in the earth.
bsb_text: Then men will say, “There is surely a reward for the righteous! There is surely a God who judges the earth!”
aov_text: En die mense sal sê: Gewis, daar is vrug vir die regverdige; gewis, daar is ’n God wat op die aarde oordeel!

kjv_text: To the chief Musician, Altaschith, Michtam of David; when Saul sent, and they watched the house to kill him.
bsb_text: Deliver me from my enemies, O my God; protect me from those who rise against me.
aov_text: VIR die musiekleier; op die wysie van: „Moenie verwoes nie.” Van Dawid. ’n Gedig, toe Saul gestuur het en hulle die huis laat bewaak het om hom dood te maak.

kjv_text: Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God: defend me from them that rise up against me.
bsb_text: Deliver me from my enemies, O my God; protect me from those who rise against me.
aov_text: Red my van my vyande, o my God! Beskerm my teen my teëstanders!

kjv_text: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from bloody men.
bsb_text: Deliver me from workers of iniquity, and save me from men of bloodshed.
aov_text: Red my van die werkers van ongeregtigheid, en verlos my van die manne van bloed!

kjv_text: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul: the mighty are gathered against me; not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O LORD.
bsb_text: See how they lie in wait for me. Fierce men conspire against me for no transgression or sin of my own, O LORD.
aov_text: Want kyk, hulle lê en loer op my lewe; sterkes val my aan, sonder oortreding en sonder sonde van my kant, o HERE!

kjv_text: They run and prepare themselves without my fault: awake to help me, and behold.
bsb_text: For no fault of my own, they move swiftly to attack me. Arise to help me, and take notice.
aov_text: Buiten my skuld hardloop hulle en maak hulle klaar. Ontwaak, my tegemoet, en kyk!

kjv_text: Thou therefore, O LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel, awake to visit all the heathen: be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. Selah.
bsb_text: O LORD God of Hosts, the God of Israel, rouse Yourself to punish all the nations; show no mercy to the wicked traitors. Selah
aov_text: Ja U, HERE, God van die leërskare, God van Israel, word wakker om oor al die heidene besoeking te doen; wees al die ongeregtige trouelose nie genadig nie! Sela.

kjv_text: They return at evening: they make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.
bsb_text: They return in the evening, snarling like dogs and prowling around the city.
aov_text: Elke aand kom hulle terug; hulle huil soos honde en dwaal deur die stad.

kjv_text: Behold, they belch out with their mouth: swords are in their lips: for who, say they, doth hear?
bsb_text: See what they spew from their mouths—sharp words from their lips: “For who can hear us?”
aov_text: Kyk, hulle smaal met hul mond; swaarde is op hulle lippe, want—wie sou dit hoor?

kjv_text: But thou, O LORD, shalt laugh at them; thou shalt have all the heathen in derision.
bsb_text: But You, O LORD, laugh at them; You scoff at all the nations.
aov_text: Maar U, o HERE, lag oor hulle; U spot met al die heidene.

kjv_text: Because of his strength will I wait upon thee: for God is my defence.
bsb_text: I will keep watch for You, O my strength, because You, O God, are my fortress.
aov_text: My Sterkte, op U wil ek wag, want God is my rotsvesting.

kjv_text: The God of my mercy shall prevent me: God shall let me see my desire upon mine enemies.
bsb_text: My God of loving devotion will come to meet me; God will let me stare down my foes.
aov_text: My genadige God sal my tegemoetkom; God sal my op my vyande laat neersien.

kjv_text: Slay them not, lest my people forget: scatter them by thy power; and bring them down, O Lord our shield.
bsb_text: Do not kill them, or my people will forget. Scatter them by Your power, and bring them down, O Lord, our shield.
aov_text: Moet hulle nie ombring nie, sodat my volk dit nie vergeet nie: laat hulle rondswerwe deur u krag, en werp hulle neer, o Here, ons Skild!

kjv_text: For the sin of their mouth and the words of their lips let them even be taken in their pride: and for cursing and lying which they speak.
bsb_text: By the sins of their mouths and the words of their lips, let them be trapped in their pride, in the curses and lies they utter.
aov_text: Sonde van hulle mond is die woord van hulle lippe; laat hulle dan gevang word in hul trots, en vanweë die vloek en die leuen wat hulle vertel.

kjv_text: Consume them in wrath, consume them, that they may not be: and let them know that God ruleth in Jacob unto the ends of the earth. Selah.
bsb_text: Consume them in wrath; consume them till they are no more, so it may be known to the ends of the earth that God rules over Jacob. Selah
aov_text: Vernietig hulle in grimmigheid, vernietig hulle, sodat hulle daar nie meer is nie; en laat hulle weet dat God heers in Jakob, tot by die eindes van die aarde! Sela.

kjv_text: And at evening let them return; and let them make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.
bsb_text: They return in the evening, snarling like dogs and prowling around the city.
aov_text: En elke aand kom hulle terug; hulle huil soos honde en dwaal deur die stad.

kjv_text: Let them wander up and down for meat, and grudge if they be not satisfied.
bsb_text: They scavenge for food, and growl if they are not satisfied.
aov_text: Húlle swerwe rond om voedsel te soek; as hulle nie versadig word nie, vertoef hulle die hele nag.

kjv_text: But I will sing of thy power; yea, I will sing aloud of thy mercy in the morning: for thou hast been my defence and refuge in the day of my trouble.
bsb_text: But I will sing of Your strength and proclaim Your loving devotion in the morning. For You are my fortress, my refuge in times of trouble.
aov_text: Maar ék sal sing van u sterkte en elke môre jubel oor u goedertierenheid, want U was ’n rotsvesting vir my en ’n toevlug in die dag toe ek benoud was.

kjv_text: Unto thee, O my strength, will I sing: for God is my defence, and the God of my mercy.
bsb_text: To You, O my strength, I sing praises, for You, O God, are my fortress, my God of loving devotion.
aov_text: My Sterkte, tot u eer wil ek psalmsing, want God is my rotsvesting, my genadige God.

kjv_text: To the chief Musician upon Shushaneduth, Michtam of David, to teach;
bsb_text: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “The Lily of the Covenant.” A Miktam of David for instruction.
aov_text: VIR die musiekleier; op die wysie van: „Die Lelie van die Getuienis.” ’n Gedig van Dawid, om te onderrig.

kjv_text: when he strove with Aramnaharaim and with Aramzobah, when Joab returned, and smote of Edom in the valley of salt twelve thousand.
bsb_text: When he fought Aram-naharaim and Aram-zobah, and Joab returned and struck down 12,000 Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
aov_text: Toe hy oorlog gevoer het teen die Arameërs van Mesopotámië en die Arameërs van Soba, en Joab teruggekom en die Edomiete verslaan het in die Soutdal, twaalfduisend.

kjv_text: O God, thou hast cast us off, thou hast scattered us, thou hast been displeased; O turn thyself to us again.
bsb_text: O God; You have broken us; You have been angry; restore us!
aov_text: o God, U het ons verstoot, ons vanmekaar geskeur; U was toornig; herstel ons!

kjv_text: Thou hast made the earth to tremble; thou hast broken it: heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.
bsb_text: You have shaken the land and torn it open. Heal its fractures, for it is quaking.
aov_text: U het die land laat bewe, dit gekloof; genees sy breuke, want dit wankel!

kjv_text: Thou hast shewed thy people hard things: thou hast made us to drink the wine of astonishment.
bsb_text: You have shown Your people hardship; we are staggered from the wine You made us drink.
aov_text: U het u volk harde dinge laat sien; U het ons bedwelmende wyn laat drink.

kjv_text: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.
bsb_text: You have raised a banner for those who fear You, that they may flee the bow. Selah
aov_text: U het aan die wat U vrees, ’n banier gegee, om te vlug vir die boog! Sela.

kjv_text: That thy beloved may be delivered; save with thy right hand, and hear me.
bsb_text: Respond and save us with Your right hand, that Your beloved may be delivered.
aov_text: Sodat u bemindes gered mag word; verlos deur u regterhand en verhoor ons!

kjv_text: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
bsb_text: God has spoken from His sanctuary: “I will triumph! I will parcel out Shechem and apportion the Valley of Succoth.
aov_text: God het gespreek in sy heiligdom: Ek wil jubel, Ek wil Sigem verdeel en die dal van Sukkot afmeet.

kjv_text: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;
bsb_text: Gilead is Mine, and Manasseh is Mine; Ephraim is My helmet, Judah is My scepter.
aov_text: Gílead is myne en Manasse is myne, en Efraim is die beskutting van my hoof; Juda is my veldheerstaf.

kjv_text: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe: Philistia, triumph thou because of me.
bsb_text: Moab is My washbasin; upon Edom I toss My sandal; over Philistia I shout in triumph.”
aov_text: Moab is my waskom; op Edom werp Ek my skoen; jubel oor My, o Filistéa!

kjv_text: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
bsb_text: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?
aov_text: Wie sal my bring in die versterkte stad? Wie kan my lei tot in Edom?

kjv_text: Wilt not thou, O God, which hadst cast us off? and thou, O God, which didst not go out with our armies?
bsb_text: Have You not rejected us, O God? Will You no longer march out, O God, with our armies?
aov_text: Het Ú, o God, ons nie verwerp nie? En U trek nie uit, o God, saam met ons leërs nie.

kjv_text: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.
bsb_text: Give us aid against the enemy, for the help of man is worthless.
aov_text: Verleen ons hulp teen die vyand, want die mens se hulp is ydelheid.

kjv_text: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.
bsb_text: With God we will perform with valor, and He will trample our enemies.
aov_text: In God sal ons kragtige dade doen, en Hy self sal ons vyande vertrap.

kjv_text: To the chief Musician upon Neginah, [A Psalm] of David.
bsb_text: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. Of David.
aov_text: VIR die musiekleier; met snaarinstrumente. ’n Psalm van Dawid.

kjv_text: Hear my cry, O God; attend unto my prayer.
bsb_text: Hear my cry, O God; attend to my prayer.
aov_text: o God, hoor my smeking, luister na my gebed!

kjv_text: From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
bsb_text: From the ends of the earth I call out to You whenever my heart is faint. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
aov_text: Van die einde van die aarde af roep ek U aan as my hart beswyk; lei my op ’n rots wat vir my te hoog is.

kjv_text: For thou hast been a shelter for me, and a strong tower from the enemy.
bsb_text: For You have been my refuge, a tower of strength against the enemy.
aov_text: Want U het ’n toevlug vir my geword, ’n sterk toring teen die vyand.

kjv_text: I will abide in thy tabernacle for ever: I will trust in the covert of thy wings. Selah.
bsb_text: Let me dwell in Your tent forever and take refuge in the shelter of Your wings. Selah
aov_text: Ek wil in u tent vertoef vir ewig, in die skuilplek van u vleuels my verberg. Sela.

kjv_text: For thou, O God, hast heard my vows: thou hast given me the heritage of those that fear thy name.
bsb_text: For You have heard my vows, O God; You have given me the inheritance reserved for those who fear Your name.
aov_text: Want U, o God, het my geloftes gehoor; U het die besitting gegee van die wat u Naam vrees.

kjv_text: Thou wilt prolong the king's life: and his years as many generations.
bsb_text: Increase the days of the king’s life; may his years span many generations.
aov_text: Mag U dae by die koning se dae byvoeg; mag sy jare wees soos van geslag tot geslag.

kjv_text: He shall abide before God for ever: O prepare mercy and truth, which may preserve him.
bsb_text: May he sit enthroned in God’s presence forever; appoint Your loving devotion and Your faithfulness to guard him.
aov_text: Mag hy vir ewig voor die aangesig van God op die troon sit; beskik goedertierenheid en trou, dat dié hom bewaar.

kjv_text: So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, that I may daily perform my vows.
bsb_text: Then I will ever sing praise to Your name and fulfill my vows day by day.
aov_text: Só wil ek psalmsing tot eer van u Naam tot in ewigheid, om my geloftes te betaal, dag ná dag.

kjv_text: To the chief Musician, to Jeduthun, A Psalm of David.
bsb_text: For the choirmaster. According to Jeduthun. A Psalm of David.
aov_text: VIR die musiekleier; op die wysie van: „Jedútun.” ’n Psalm van Dawid.

kjv_text: Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him cometh my salvation.
bsb_text: In God alone my soul finds rest; my salvation comes from Him.
aov_text: Ja, my siel is stil tot God; van Hom is my heil.

kjv_text: He only is my rock and my salvation; he is my defence; I shall not be greatly moved.
bsb_text: He alone is my rock and my salvation. He is my fortress; I will never be shaken.
aov_text: Hy alleen is my rots en my heil, my rotsvesting; ek sal nie grootliks wankel nie.

kjv_text: How long will ye imagine mischief against a man? ye shall be slain all of you: as a bowing wall shall ye be, and as a tottering fence.
bsb_text: How long will you threaten a man? Will all of you throw him down like a leaning wall or a tottering fence?
aov_text: Hoe lank sal julle aanstorm op ’n man, julle almal hom verbrysel soos ’n muur wat oorhang, ’n omgestote klipmuur?

kjv_text: They only consult to cast him down from his excellency: they delight in lies: they bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.
bsb_text: They fully intend to cast him down from his lofty perch; they delight in lies; with their mouths they bless, but inwardly they curse. Selah
aov_text: Ja, hulle hou raad om hom van sy hoogte af te stoot; hulle het behae in leuens; met hul mond seën hulle, maar met hul binneste vloek hulle. Sela.

kjv_text: My soul, wait thou only upon God; for my expectation is from him.
bsb_text: Rest in God alone, O my soul, for my hope comes from Him.
aov_text: Wees net maar stil tot God, my siel, want van Hom is my verwagting!

kjv_text: He only is my rock and my salvation: he is my defence; I shall not be moved.
bsb_text: He alone is my rock and my salvation; He is my fortress; I will not be shaken.
aov_text: Sekerlik, Hy is my rots en my heil, my rotsvesting; ek sal nie wankel nie.

kjv_text: In God is my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.
bsb_text: My salvation and my honor rest on God, my strong rock; my refuge is in God.
aov_text: By God is my heil en my eer; die rots van my sterkte, my toevlug is in God.

kjv_text: Trust in him at all times; ye people, pour out your heart before him: God is a refuge for us. Selah.
bsb_text: Trust in Him at all times, O people; pour out your hearts before Him. God is our refuge. Selah
aov_text: Vertrou op Hom altyd, o volk! Stort julle hart uit voor sy aangesig! God is ’n toevlug vir ons. Sela.

kjv_text: Surely men of low degree are vanity, and men of high degree are a lie: to be laid in the balance, they are altogether lighter than vanity.
bsb_text: Lowborn men are but a vapor, the exalted but a lie. Weighed on the scale, they go up; together they are but a vapor.
aov_text: Ja, nietigheid is die mensekinders, leuens is die aansienlikes; in die weegskaal moet hulle opgaan, almal saam is hulle minder as nietigheid.

kjv_text: Trust not in oppression, and become not vain in robbery: if riches increase, set not your heart upon them.
bsb_text: Place no trust in extortion, or false hope in stolen goods. If your riches increase, do not set your heart upon them.
aov_text: Vertrou nie op verdrukking en bou geen ydele hoop op rowery nie; as die vermoë aangroei, sit daar die hart nie op nie!

kjv_text: God hath spoken once; twice have I heard this; that power belongeth unto God.
bsb_text: God has spoken once; I have heard this twice: that power belongs to God,
aov_text: Een ding het God gespreek, twee is dit wat ek gehoor het: dat die sterkte aan God behoort,

kjv_text: Also unto thee, O Lord, belongeth mercy: for thou renderest to every man according to his work.
bsb_text: and loving devotion to You, O Lord. For You will repay each man according to his deeds.
aov_text: en aan U, o Here, behoort die goedertierenheid; want U vergeld elkeen na sy werk.

kjv_text: A Psalm of David, when he was in the wilderness of Judah.
bsb_text: A Psalm of David, when he was in the Wilderness of Judah.
aov_text: ’N PSALM van Dawid, toe hy in die woestyn van Juda was.

kjv_text: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;
bsb_text: O God, You are my God. Earnestly I seek You; my soul thirsts for You. My body yearns for You in a dry and weary land without water.
aov_text: o God, U is my God, U soek ek; my siel dors na U, my vlees smag na U, in ’n dor en uitgedroogde land, sonder water.

kjv_text: To see thy power and thy glory, so as I have seen thee in the sanctuary.
bsb_text: So I have seen You in the sanctuary and beheld Your power and glory.
aov_text: Só het ek U in die heiligdom aanskou, om u sterkte en u heerlikheid te sien.

kjv_text: Because thy loving-kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise thee.
bsb_text: Because Your loving devotion is better than life, my lips will glorify You.
aov_text: Want u goedertierenheid is beter as die lewe; my lippe moet U prys.

kjv_text: Thus will I bless thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in thy name.
bsb_text: So I will bless You as long as I live; in Your name I will lift my hands.
aov_text: Só sal ek U prys my lewe lank, in u Naam my hande ophef.

kjv_text: My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness; and my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips:
bsb_text: My soul is satisfied as with the richest of foods; with joyful lips my mouth will praise You.
