aov_text: Soos met vet en vettigheid sal my siel versadig word, en my mond sal roem met jubelende lippe

kjv_text: When I remember thee upon my bed, and meditate on thee in the night watches.
bsb_text: When I remember You on my bed, I think of You through the watches of the night.
aov_text: as ek aan U dink op my bed, in die nagwake oor U peins.

kjv_text: Because thou hast been my help, therefore in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.
bsb_text: For You are my help; I will sing for joy in the shadow of Your wings.
aov_text: Want U was ’n hulp vir my, en in die skaduwee van u vleuels sal ek jubel.

kjv_text: My soul followeth hard after thee: thy right hand upholdeth me.
bsb_text: My soul clings to You; Your right hand upholds me.
aov_text: My siel is aan U verkleef; u regterhand ondersteun my.

kjv_text: But those that seek my soul, to destroy it, shall go into the lower parts of the earth.
bsb_text: But those who seek my life to destroy it will go into the depths of the earth.
aov_text: Maar húlle wat soek om my lewe te verderwe, hulle sal kom in die onderste plekke van die aarde.

kjv_text: They shall fall by the sword: they shall be a portion for foxes.
bsb_text: They will fall to the power of the sword; they will become a portion for foxes.
aov_text: Hy sal oorgelewer word in die mag van die swaard; die deel van die jakkalse sal hulle word.

kjv_text: But the king shall rejoice in God; every one that sweareth by him shall glory: but the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.
bsb_text: But the king will rejoice in God; all who swear by Him will exult, for the mouths of liars will be shut.
aov_text: Maar die koning sal bly wees in God; elkeen wat by Hom sweer, sal hom beroem; want die mond van die leuensprekers sal gestop word.

kjv_text: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.
bsb_text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David.
aov_text: VIR die musiekleier. ’n Psalm van Dawid.

kjv_text: Hear my voice, O God, in my prayer: preserve my life from fear of the enemy.
bsb_text: Hear, O God, my voice of complaint; preserve my life from dread of the enemy.
aov_text: Hoor my stem, o God, in my klagte; bewaar my lewe vir die skrik van die vyand.

kjv_text: Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked; from the insurrection of the workers of iniquity:
bsb_text: Hide me from the scheming of the wicked, from the mob of workers of iniquity,
aov_text: Steek my weg vir die raad van die kwaaddoeners, vir die gewoel van die werkers van ongeregtigheid;

kjv_text: Who whet their tongue like a sword, and bend their bows to shoot their arrows, even bitter words:
bsb_text: who sharpen their tongues like swords and aim their bitter words like arrows,
aov_text: wat hulle tong skerp maak soos ’n swaard, hulle pyl rig—bitter woorde! —

kjv_text: That they may shoot in secret at the perfect: suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.
bsb_text: ambushing the innocent in seclusion, shooting suddenly, without fear.
aov_text: om in skuilplekke na die opregte te skiet; skielik skiet hulle hom en vrees nie.

kjv_text: They encourage themselves in an evil matter: they commune of laying snares privily; they say, Who shall see them?
bsb_text: They hold fast to their evil purpose; they speak of hiding their snares. “Who will see them?” they say.
aov_text: ’n Listige plan stel hulle vir hul vas; hulle spreek af om strikke te span; hulle sê: Wie sal dit sien?

kjv_text: They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search: both the inward thought of every one of them, and the heart, is deep.
bsb_text: They devise injustice and say, “We have perfected a secret plan.” For the inner man and the heart are mysterious.
aov_text: Hulle versin ongeregtighede: Ons is gereed! ’n Fyn uitgedinkte plan! Ja, ’n man se binneste en onpeilbare hart!

kjv_text: But God shall shoot at them with an arrow; suddenly shall they be wounded.
bsb_text: But God will shoot them with arrows; suddenly they will be wounded.
aov_text: Maar God tref hulle met ’n pyl, skielik is hulle wonde daar.

kjv_text: So they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves: all that see them shall flee away.
bsb_text: They will be made to stumble, their own tongues turned against them. All who see will shake their heads.
aov_text: En hulle tong laat hulle oor hulself struikel; almal wat hulle aansien, skud die hoof.

kjv_text: And all men shall fear, and shall declare the work of God; for they shall wisely consider of his doing.
bsb_text: Then all mankind will fear and proclaim the work of God; so they will ponder what He has done.
aov_text: En alle mense vrees en verkondig die werk van God en gee ag op wat Hy doen.

kjv_text: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall trust in him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.
bsb_text: Let the righteous rejoice in the LORD and take refuge in Him; let all the upright in heart exult.
aov_text: Die regverdige sal bly wees in die HERE en by Hom skuil, en al die opregtes van hart sal hulle beroem.

kjv_text: To the chief Musician, A Psalm [and] Song of David.
bsb_text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. A song.
aov_text: VIR die musiekleier. ’n Psalm van Dawid. ’n Lied.

kjv_text: Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Sion: and unto thee shall the vow be performed.
bsb_text: Praise awaits You, O God, in Zion; to You our vows will be fulfilled.
aov_text: Aan U kom ’n lofsang toe, o God, in Sion, en aan U moet die gelofte betaal word.

kjv_text: O thou that hearest prayer, unto thee shall all flesh come.
bsb_text: O You who listen to prayer, all people will come to You.
aov_text: o Hoorder van die gebed, tot U moet alle vlees kom!

kjv_text: Iniquities prevail against me: as for our transgressions, thou shalt purge them away.
bsb_text: When iniquities prevail against me, You atone for our transgressions.
aov_text: Ongeregtige dinge het die oorhand oor my gehad, maar U versoen ons oortredinge.

kjv_text: Blessed is the man whom thou choosest, and causest to approach unto thee, that he may dwell in thy courts: we shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, even of thy holy temple.
bsb_text: Blessed is the one You choose and bring near to dwell in Your courts! We are filled with the goodness of Your house, the holiness of Your temple.
aov_text: Welgeluksalig is hy wat U uitkies en laat nader kom, dat hy kan woon in u voorhowe. Ons wil versadig word met die goeie van u huis, die heiligheid van u paleis.

kjv_text: By terrible things in righteousness wilt thou answer us, O God of our salvation; who art the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of them that are afar off upon the sea:
bsb_text: With awesome deeds of righteousness You answer us, O God of our salvation, the hope of all the ends of the earth and of the farthest seas.
aov_text: Vreeslike dinge antwoord U ons in geregtigheid, o God van ons heil, vertroue van al die eindes van die aarde en van die verste see!

kjv_text: Which by his strength setteth fast the mountains; being girded with power:
bsb_text: You formed the mountains by Your power, having girded Yourself with might.
aov_text: Wat die berge grondves deur u krag, wat omgord is met mag,

kjv_text: Which stilleth the noise of the seas, the noise of their waves, and the tumult of the people.
bsb_text: You stilled the roaring of the seas, the pounding of their waves, and the tumult of the nations.
aov_text: wat die gebruis van die seë stilmaak, die gebruis van hulle golwe en die rumoer van die volke;

kjv_text: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.
bsb_text: Those who live far away fear Your wonders; You make the dawn and sunset shout for joy.
aov_text: sodat die bewoners van die eindes vrees vir u tekens; U laat die uitgange van die môre en die aand jubel.

kjv_text: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it: thou greatly enrichest it with the river of God, which is full of water: thou preparest them corn, when thou hast so provided for it.
bsb_text: You attend to the earth and water it; with abundance You enrich it. The streams of God are full of water, for You prepare our grain by providing for the earth.
aov_text: U het die land besoek en oorvloed gegee; U verryk dit grootliks; die stroom van God is vol water. U berei hulle koring; ja, so berei U die land.

kjv_text: Thou waterest the ridges thereof abundantly: thou settlest the furrows thereof: thou makest it soft with showers: thou blessest the springing thereof.
bsb_text: You soak its furrows and level its ridges; You soften it with showers and bless its growth.
aov_text: U maak sy vore nat, sy kluite gelyk; deur reënbuie maak U dit week; U seën sy uitspruitsel.

kjv_text: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.
bsb_text: You crown the year with Your bounty, and Your paths overflow with plenty.
aov_text: U kroon die jaar van u goedheid, en u voetspore drup van vettigheid.

kjv_text: They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness: and the little hills rejoice on every side.
bsb_text: The pastures of the wilderness overflow; the hills are robed with joy.
aov_text: Die weivelde van die woestyn drup, en die heuwels gord hulleself met gejuig.

kjv_text: The pastures are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, they also sing.
bsb_text: The pastures are clothed with flocks, and the valleys are decked with grain. They shout in triumph; indeed, they sing.
aov_text: Die weivelde is bekleed met troppe kleinvee, en die dale is bedek met koring; hulle juig, ook sing hulle.

kjv_text: To the chief Musician, A Song [or] Psalm.  Make a joyful noise unto God, all ye lands:
bsb_text: For the choirmaster. A song. A Psalm. Make a joyful noise to God, all the earth!
aov_text: VIR die musiekleier. ’n Lied. ’n Psalm. Juig tot eer van God, o ganse aarde!

kjv_text: Sing forth the honour of his name: make his praise glorious.
bsb_text: Sing the glory of His name; make His praise glorious.
aov_text: Besing die eer van sy Naam, maak heerlik sy lofsang!

kjv_text: Say unto God, How terrible art thou in thy works! through the greatness of thy power shall thine enemies submit themselves unto thee.
bsb_text: Say to God, “How awesome are Your deeds! So great is Your power that Your enemies cower before You.
aov_text: Sê tot God: Hoe vreeslik is u werke! Deur die grootheid van u sterkte sal u vyande kruipende na U toe kom.

kjv_text: All the earth shall worship thee, and shall sing unto thee; they shall sing to thy name. Selah.
bsb_text: All the earth bows down to You; they sing praise to You; they sing praise to Your name.” Selah
aov_text: Laat die hele aarde U aanbid en psalmsing tot u eer; laat dit u Naam verhef in psalmgesang. Sela.

kjv_text: Come and see the works of God: he is terrible in his doing toward the children of men.
bsb_text: Come and see the works of God; how awesome are His deeds toward mankind.
aov_text: Kom en aanskou die dade van God, Hy wat gedug is in werking oor die mensekinders.

kjv_text: He turned the sea into dry land: they went through the flood on foot: there did we rejoice in him.
bsb_text: He turned the sea into dry land; they passed through the waters on foot; there we rejoiced in Him.
aov_text: Hy het die see verander in droë land; hulle het te voet deur die rivier gegaan. Daar was ons bly in Hom.

kjv_text: He ruleth by his power for ever; his eyes behold the nations: let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah.
bsb_text: He rules forever by His power; His eyes watch the nations. Do not let the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah
aov_text: Hy heers vir ewig deur sy mag; sy oë hou wag oor die nasies. Laat die wederstrewiges hulleself nie verhef nie. Sela.

kjv_text: O bless our God, ye people, and make the voice of his praise to be heard:
bsb_text: Bless our God, O peoples; let the sound of His praise be heard.
aov_text: Loof, volke, onse God, en laat hoor die stem wat Hom roem —

kjv_text: Which holdeth our soul in life, and suffereth not our feet to be moved.
bsb_text: He preserves our lives and keeps our feet from slipping.
aov_text: wat aan ons siel die lewe gee en nie toelaat dat ons voet wankel nie.

kjv_text: For thou, O God, hast proved us: thou hast tried us, as silver is tried.
bsb_text: For You, O God, have tested us; You have refined us like silver.
aov_text: Want U het ons getoets, o God, U het ons gelouter soos ’n mens silwer louter.

kjv_text: Thou broughtest us into the net; thou laidst affliction upon our loins.
bsb_text: You led us into the net; You laid burdens on our backs.
aov_text: U het ons in die net gebring, ’n swaar las op ons heupe gelê.

kjv_text: Thou hast caused men to ride over our heads; we went through fire and through water: but thou broughtest us out into a wealthy place.
bsb_text: You let men ride over our heads; we went through fire and water, but You brought us into abundance.
aov_text: U het mense oor ons hoof laat ry; ons het in die vuur en in die water gekom, maar U het ons uitgelei in die oorvloed.

kjv_text: I will go into thy house with burnt offerings: I will pay thee my vows,
bsb_text: I will enter Your house with burnt offerings; I will fulfill my vows to You—
aov_text: Ek sal met brandoffers in u huis ingaan; ek sal U my geloftes betaal,

kjv_text: Which my lips have uttered, and my mouth hath spoken, when I was in trouble.
bsb_text: the vows that my lips promised and my mouth spoke in my distress.
aov_text: wat my lippe geuit en my mond uitgespreek het toe ek benoud was.

kjv_text: I will offer unto thee burnt sacrifices of fatlings, with the incense of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. Selah.
bsb_text: I will offer You fatlings as burnt offerings, with the fragrant smoke of rams; I will offer bulls and goats. Selah
aov_text: Brandoffers van vet diere sal ek U bring saam met offerrook van ramme; ek sal beeste saam met bokke berei. Sela.

kjv_text: Come and hear, all ye that fear God, and I will declare what he hath done for my soul.
bsb_text: Come and listen, all you who fear God, and I will declare what He has done for me.
aov_text: Kom luister, en laat my vertel, julle almal wat God vrees, wat Hy aan my siel gedoen het.

kjv_text: I cried unto him with my mouth, and he was extolled with my tongue.
bsb_text: I cried out to Him with my mouth and praised Him with my tongue.
aov_text: Ek het Hom aangeroep met my mond, en lofgesang was onder my tong.

kjv_text: If I regard iniquity in my heart, the Lord will not hear me:
bsb_text: If I had cherished iniquity in my heart, the Lord would not have listened.
aov_text: As ek ongeregtigheid bedoel het in my hart, sou die Here nie gehoor het nie.

kjv_text: But verily God hath heard me; he hath attended to the voice of my prayer.
bsb_text: But God has surely heard; He has attended to the sound of my prayer.
aov_text: Waarlik, God het gehoor; Hy het geluister na die stem van my gebed.

kjv_text: Blessed be God, which hath not turned away my prayer, nor his mercy from me.
bsb_text: Blessed be God, who has not rejected my prayer or withheld from me His loving devotion!
aov_text: Geloofd sy God wat my gebed nie afgewys en sy goedertierenheid aan my nie onttrek het nie!

kjv_text: To the chief Musician on Neginoth, A Psalm [or] Song.
bsb_text: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Psalm. A song.
aov_text: VIR die musiekleier; met snaarinstrumente. ’n Psalm. ’n Lied.

kjv_text: God be merciful unto us, and bless us; and cause his face to shine upon us; Selah.
bsb_text: May God be gracious to us and bless us, and cause His face to shine upon us, Selah
aov_text: Mag God ons genadig wees en ons seën; mag Hy sy aangesig by ons laat skyn! Sela.

kjv_text: That thy way may be known upon earth, thy saving health among all nations.
bsb_text: that Your ways may be known on earth, Your salvation among all nations.
aov_text: Sodat die mense op aarde u weg kan ken, onder al die nasies u heil.

kjv_text: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.
bsb_text: Let the peoples praise You, O God; let all the peoples praise You.
aov_text: Die volke sal U loof, o God, die volke almal saam sal U loof.

kjv_text: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy: for thou shalt judge the people righteously, and govern the nations upon earth. Selah.
bsb_text: Let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for You judge the peoples justly and lead the nations of the earth. Selah
aov_text: Die nasies sal bly wees en jubel, omdat U die volke regverdig oordeel en die nasies op aarde lei. Sela.

kjv_text: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.
bsb_text: Let the peoples praise You, O God; let all the peoples praise You.
aov_text: Die volke sal U loof, o God, die volke almal saam sal U loof.

kjv_text: Then shall the earth yield her increase; and God, even our own God, shall bless us.
bsb_text: The earth has yielded its harvest; God, our God, blesses us.
aov_text: Die aarde het sy opbrings gelewer; God, onse God, sal ons seën.

kjv_text: God shall bless us; and all the ends of the earth shall fear him.
bsb_text: God blesses us, that all the ends of the earth shall fear Him.
aov_text: God sal ons seën, en al die eindes van die aarde sal Hom vrees.

kjv_text: To the chief Musician, A Psalm [or] Song of David.
bsb_text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. A song.
aov_text: VIR die musiekleier. Van Dawid. ’n Psalm. ’n Lied.

kjv_text: Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered: let them also that hate him flee before him.
bsb_text: God arises. His enemies are scattered, and those who hate Him flee His presence.
aov_text: God staan op, sy vyande raak verstrooid, en sy haters vlug voor sy aangesig weg!

kjv_text: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away: as wax melteth before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.
bsb_text: As smoke is blown away, You will drive them out; as wax melts before the fire, the wicked will perish in the presence of God.
aov_text: Soos rook verdryf word, verdryf U hulle; soos was smelt voor die vuur, vergaan die goddelose voor die aangesig van God.

kjv_text: But let the righteous be glad; let them rejoice before God: yea, let them exceedingly rejoice.
bsb_text: But the righteous will be glad and rejoice before God; they will celebrate with joy.
aov_text: Maar die regverdiges is bly, hulle juig voor die aangesig van God, en hulle is vrolik met blydskap.

kjv_text: Sing unto God, sing praises to his name: extol him that rideth upon the heavens by his name JAH, and rejoice before him.
bsb_text: Sing to God! Sing praises to His name. Exalt Him who rides on the clouds—His name is the LORD—and rejoice before Him.
aov_text: Sing tot eer van God, psalmsing tot eer van sy Naam, vul die pad op vir Hom wat deur die woestynvlaktes ry: HERE is sy Naam; en jubel voor sy aangesig!

kjv_text: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.
bsb_text: A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in His holy habitation.
aov_text: ’n Vader van die wese en ’n regter van die weduwees is God in sy heilige woning.

kjv_text: God setteth the solitary in families: he bringeth out those which are bound with chains: but the rebellious dwell in a dry land.
bsb_text: God settles the lonely in families; He leads the prisoners out to prosperity, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.
aov_text: God laat die eensames woon in ’n huisgesin, Hy lei die gevangenes uit in voorspoed; maar die wederstrewiges woon in ’n dor land.

kjv_text: O God, when thou wentest forth before thy people, when thou didst march through the wilderness; Selah:
bsb_text: O God, when You went out before Your people, when You marched through the wasteland, Selah
aov_text: o God, toe U uitgetrek het voor u volk, toe U voortgestap het in die wildernis, Sela,

kjv_text: The earth shook, the heavens also dropped at the presence of God: even Sinai itself was moved at the presence of God, the God of Israel.
bsb_text: the earth shook and the heavens poured down rain before God, the One on Sinai, before God, the God of Israel.
aov_text: het die aarde gebewe! Ook het die hemele gedrup voor die aangesig van God; hierdie Sinai voor die aangesig van God, die God van Israel!

kjv_text: Thou, O God, didst send a plentiful rain, whereby thou didst confirm thine inheritance, when it was weary.
bsb_text: You sent abundant rain, O God; You refreshed Your weary inheritance.
aov_text: Met ’n milde reën het U, o God, u erfdeel besproei; en toe dit moeg was, het Ú dit versterk.

kjv_text: Thy congregation hath dwelt therein: thou, O God, hast prepared of thy goodness for the poor.
bsb_text: Your flock settled therein; O God, from Your bounty You provided for the poor.
aov_text: U skare het daarin gewoon; U het dit in u goedheid berei vir die ellendige, o God!

kjv_text: The Lord gave the word: great was the company of those that published it.
bsb_text: The Lord gives the command; a great company of women proclaim it:
aov_text: Die Here het die woord laat hoor—die vroue wat die goeie tyding gebring het, was ’n groot skare:

kjv_text: Kings of armies did flee apace: and she that tarried at home divided the spoil.
bsb_text: “Kings and their armies flee in haste; she who waits at home divides the plunder.
aov_text: Die konings van die leërskare vlug, hulle vlug; en sy wat tuis gebly het, verdeel die buit.

kjv_text: Though ye have lien among the pots, yet shall ye be as the wings of a dove covered with silver, and her feathers with yellow gold.
bsb_text: Though you lie down among the sheepfolds, the wings of the dove are covered with silver, and her feathers with shimmering gold.”
aov_text: As julle daar lê tussen die veekrale, is die vlerke van die duif oordek met silwer en sy vleuels met liggroen goud.

kjv_text: When the Almighty scattered kings in it, it was white as snow in Salmon.
bsb_text: When the Almighty scattered the kings in the land, it was like the snow falling on Zalmon.
aov_text: Toe die Almagtige konings daarin verstrooi het, het dit gesneeu op Salmon.

kjv_text: The hill of God is as the hill of Bashan; an high hill as the hill of Bashan.
bsb_text: A mountain of God is Mount Bashan; a mountain of many peaks is Mount Bashan.
aov_text: ’n Berg van God is die berg Basan, ’n berg met toppe is die berg Basan.

kjv_text: Why leap ye, ye high hills? this is the hill which God desireth to dwell in; yea, the LORD will dwell in it for ever.
bsb_text: Why do you gaze in envy, O mountains of many peaks? This is the mountain God chose for His dwelling, where the LORD will surely dwell forever.
aov_text: Waarom kyk julle afgunstig, o berge met toppe, na die berg wat God begeer het vir sy woning? Ja, die HERE sal daar woon tot in ewigheid.

kjv_text: The chariots of God are twenty thousand, even thousands of angels: the Lord is among them, as in Sinai, in the holy place.
bsb_text: The chariots of God are tens of thousands—thousands of thousands are they; the Lord is in His sanctuary as He was at Sinai.
aov_text: Die waens van God is tienduisende, duisend maal duisende; die Here is onder hulle; dit is Sinai in heiligheid.

kjv_text: Thou hast ascended on high, thou hast led captivity captive: thou hast received gifts for men; yea, for the rebellious also, that the LORD God might dwell among them.
bsb_text: You have ascended on high; You have led captives away. You have received gifts from men, even from the rebellious, that the LORD God may dwell there.
aov_text: U het opgeklim na die hoogte, U het gevangenes weggevoer, U het geskenke geneem onder die mense; ja, ook wederstrewiges om daar te woon, o HERE God!

kjv_text: Blessed be the Lord, who daily loadeth us with benefits, even the God of our salvation. Selah.
bsb_text: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burden, the God of our salvation. Selah
aov_text: Geloofd sy die Here! Dag ná dag dra Hy ons; God is ons heil! Sela.

kjv_text: He that is our God is the God of salvation; and unto GOD the Lord belong the issues from death.
bsb_text: Our God is a God of deliverance; the Lord GOD is our rescuer from death.
aov_text: God is vir ons ’n God van verlossinge, en die HERE Here het uitkomste teen die dood.

kjv_text: But God shall wound the head of his enemies, and the hairy scalp of such an one as goeth on still in his trespasses.
bsb_text: Surely God will crush the heads of His enemies, the hairy crowns of those who persist in guilty ways.
aov_text: Gewis, God sal die kop van sy vyande verbrysel, die harige skedel van hom wat in sy sondeskuld rondwandel.

kjv_text: The Lord said, I will bring again from Bashan, I will bring my people again from the depths of the sea:
bsb_text: The Lord said, “I will retrieve them from Bashan, I will bring them up from the depths of the sea,
aov_text: Die Here het gesê: Ek sal terugbring uit Basan, Ek sal terugbring uit die dieptes van die see;

kjv_text: That thy foot may be dipped in the blood of thine enemies, and the tongue of thy dogs in the same.
bsb_text: that your foot may be dipped in the blood of your foes—the tongues of your dogs in the same.”
aov_text: sodat jy jou voet kan steek in bloed, die tong van jou honde van die vyande sy deel kan hê.

kjv_text: They have seen thy goings, O God; even the goings of my God, my King, in the sanctuary.
bsb_text: They have seen Your procession, O God—the march of my God and King into the sanctuary.
aov_text: o God, hulle sien u optogte, die optogte van my God, my Koning in die heiligdom.

kjv_text: The singers went before, the players on instruments followed after; among them were the damsels playing with timbrels.
bsb_text: The singers lead the way, the musicians follow after, among the maidens playing tambourines.
aov_text: Vooraan gaan die sangers, daaragter die snaarspelers, tussen jongmeisies in wat die tamboeryn slaan.

kjv_text: Bless ye God in the congregations, even the Lord, from the fountain of Israel.
bsb_text: Bless God in the great congregation; bless the LORD from the fountain of Israel.
aov_text: Loof God, die Here, in die vergaderinge, julle wat is uit die fontein van Israel!

kjv_text: There is little Benjamin with their ruler, the princes of Judah and their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.
bsb_text: There is Benjamin, the youngest, ruling them, the princes of Judah in their company, the princes of Zebulun and of Naphtali.
aov_text: Daar is Benjamin, die kleinste, wat oor hulle geheers het; die vorste van Juda—hulle menigte; die vorste van Sébulon, die vorste van Náftali.

kjv_text: Thy God hath commanded thy strength: strengthen, O God, that which thou hast wrought for us.
bsb_text: Summon Your power, O God; show Your strength, O God, which You have exerted on our behalf.
aov_text: Jou God het jou sterkte gebied: betoon U sterk, o God, wat vir ons gewerk het!

kjv_text: Because of thy temple at Jerusalem shall kings bring presents unto thee.
bsb_text: Because of Your temple at Jerusalem kings will bring You gifts.
aov_text: Ter wille van u tempel in Jerusalem sal die konings aan U geskenke bring.

kjv_text: Rebuke the company of spearmen, the multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the people, till every one submit himself with pieces of silver: scatter thou the people that delight in war.
bsb_text: Rebuke the beast in the reeds, the herd of bulls among the calves of the nations, until it submits, bringing bars of silver. Scatter the nations who delight in war.
aov_text: Dreig die wilde gedierte van die riet—die trop stiere saam met die kalwers van die volke—die wat hulleself onderwerp met stukke silwer. Hy het die volke verstrooi wat lus het in oorloë.

kjv_text: Princes shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall soon stretch out her hands unto God.
bsb_text: Envoys will arrive from Egypt; Cush will stretch out her hands to God.
aov_text: Edeles sal uit Egipte kom, Kus sal haastig sy hande uitsteek na God.

kjv_text: Sing unto God, ye kingdoms of the earth; O sing praises unto the Lord; Selah:
bsb_text: Sing to God, O kingdoms of the earth; sing praises to the Lord—Selah
aov_text: o Koninkryke van die aarde, sing tot eer van God; psalmsing tot eer van die Here! Sela.

kjv_text: To him that rideth upon the heavens of heavens, which were of old; lo, he doth send out his voice, and that a mighty voice.
bsb_text: to Him who rides upon the highest heavens of old; behold, His mighty voice resounds.
aov_text: Van Hom wat ry in die hoogste hemele, wat uit die voortyd is; kyk, Hy verhef sy stem, ’n magtige stem.

kjv_text: Ascribe ye strength unto God: his excellency is over Israel, and his strength is in the clouds.
bsb_text: Ascribe the power to God, whose majesty is over Israel, whose strength is in the skies.
aov_text: Gee sterkte aan God! Sy hoogheid is oor Israel en sy sterkte in die wolke.

kjv_text: O God, thou art terrible out of thy holy places: the God of Israel is he that giveth strength and power unto his people. Blessed be God.
bsb_text: O God, You are awesome in Your sanctuary; the God of Israel Himself gives strength and power to His people. Blessed be God!
aov_text: Vreeslik is God uit jou heiligdomme, o Israel! Die God van Israel—Hy gee aan die volk sterkte en kragte. Geloofd sy God!

kjv_text: To the chief Musician upon Shoshannim, [A Psalm] of David.
bsb_text: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “Lilies.” Of David.
aov_text: VIR die musiekleier; op die wysie van: „Lelies.” ’n Psalm van Dawid.

kjv_text: Save me, O God; for the waters are come in unto my soul.
bsb_text: Save me, O God, for the waters are up to my neck.
aov_text: Verlos my, o God, want die waters het tot by die siel gekom.

kjv_text: I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.
bsb_text: I have sunk into the miry depths, where there is no footing; I have drifted into deep waters, where the flood engulfs me.
aov_text: Ek sink in grondelose modder waar geen staanplek is nie; ek het in waterdieptes gekom, en die stroom loop oor my.

kjv_text: I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.
bsb_text: I am weary from my crying; my throat is parched. My eyes fail, looking for my God.
aov_text: Ek is moeg van my geroep, my keel brand, my oë versmag terwyl ek wag op my God.

kjv_text: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of mine head: they that would destroy me, being mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: then I restored that which I took not away.
bsb_text: Those who hate me without cause outnumber the hairs of my head; many are those who would destroy me—my enemies for no reason. Though I did not steal, I must repay.
aov_text: Die wat my sonder oorsaak haat, is meer as die hare van my hoof; die wat klaar staan om my te vernietig, wat sonder grond my vyande is, is magtig; wat ek nie geroof het nie, moet ek dan teruggee.

kjv_text: O God, thou knowest my foolishness; and my sins are not hid from thee.
bsb_text: You know my folly, O God, and my guilt is not hidden from You.
aov_text: o God, Ú weet van my dwaasheid, en my skuldige dade is vir U nie verborge nie.

kjv_text: Let not them that wait on thee, O Lord GOD of hosts, be ashamed for my sake: let not those that seek thee be confounded for my sake, O God of Israel.
bsb_text: May those who hope in You not be ashamed through me, O Lord GOD of Hosts; may those who seek You not be dishonored through me, O God of Israel.
aov_text: Laat die wat U verwag, deur my nie beskaamd staan nie, o Here, HERE van die leërskare! Laat die wat U soek, deur my nie in die skande kom nie, o God van Israel!

kjv_text: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; shame hath covered my face.
bsb_text: For I have endured scorn for Your sake, and shame has covered my face.
aov_text: Want om U ontwil dra ek smaad, bedek skande my aangesig.

kjv_text: I am become a stranger unto my brethren, and an alien unto my mother's children.
bsb_text: I have become a stranger to my brothers and a foreigner to my mother’s sons,
aov_text: Vreemd het ek vir my broers geword en ’n onbekende vir die seuns van my moeder.

kjv_text: For the zeal of thine house hath eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.
bsb_text: because zeal for Your house has consumed me, and the insults of those who insult You have fallen on me.
aov_text: Want die ywer vir u huis het my verteer, en die smaadhede van die wat U smaad, het op my geval.

kjv_text: When I wept, and chastened my soul with fasting, that was to my reproach.
bsb_text: I wept and fasted, but it brought me reproach.
aov_text: Wat my aangaan, my siel het geween met vas; maar dit het smaadhede vir my geword.

kjv_text: I made sackcloth also my garment; and I became a proverb to them.
bsb_text: I made sackcloth my clothing, and I was sport to them.
aov_text: Ek het ook ’n rougewaad my kleding gemaak en vir hulle ’n spreekwoord geword.

kjv_text: They that sit in the gate speak against me; and I was the song of the drunkards.
bsb_text: Those who sit at the gate mock me, and I am the song of drunkards.
aov_text: Die wat in die poort sit, praat van my—ook die spotlied van die wat sterk drank drink.

kjv_text: But as for me, my prayer is unto thee, O LORD, in an acceptable time: O God, in the multitude of thy mercy hear me, in the truth of thy salvation.
bsb_text: But my prayer to You, O LORD, is for a time of favor. In Your abundant loving devotion, O God, answer me with Your sure salvation.
aov_text: Maar ek—my gebed is tot U, o HERE: in die tyd van genade, o God, verhoor my deur die grootheid van u goedertierenheid, deur die trou van u heil!

kjv_text: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.
bsb_text: Rescue me from the mire and do not let me sink; deliver me from my foes and out of the deep waters.
aov_text: Red my uit die modder en laat my nie sink nie; laat my gered word van my haters en uit waterdieptes.

kjv_text: Let not the waterflood overflow me, neither let the deep swallow me up, and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.
bsb_text: Do not let the floods engulf me or the depths swallow me up; let not the Pit close its mouth over me.
aov_text: Laat die waterstroom nie oor my loop en die diepte my nie verslind nie, en laat die put sy mond bo my nie toesluit nie!

kjv_text: Hear me, O LORD; for thy loving-kindness is good: turn unto me according to the multitude of thy tender mercies.
bsb_text: Answer me, O LORD, for Your loving devotion is good; turn to me in keeping with Your great compassion.
aov_text: Verhoor my, o HERE, want u goedertierenheid is goed; wend U tot my na die grootheid van u barmhartighede.

kjv_text: And hide not thy face from thy servant; for I am in trouble: hear me speedily.
bsb_text: Hide not Your face from Your servant, for I am in distress. Answer me quickly!
aov_text: En verberg u aangesig nie vir u kneg nie; want ek is benoud. Verhoor my dan gou!

kjv_text: Draw nigh unto my soul, and redeem it: deliver me because of mine enemies.
bsb_text: Draw near to my soul and redeem me; ransom me because of my foes.
aov_text: Kom nader na my siel, verlos dit; bevry my om my vyande ontwil.

kjv_text: Thou hast known my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: mine adversaries are all before thee.
bsb_text: You know my reproach, my shame and disgrace. All my adversaries are before You.
aov_text: Ú ken my smaad en my beskaming en my skande; al my teëstanders is voor U.

kjv_text: Reproach hath broken my heart; and I am full of heaviness: and I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; and for comforters, but I found none.
bsb_text: Insults have broken my heart, and I am in despair. I looked for sympathy, but there was none, for comforters, but I found no one.
aov_text: Die smaad breek my hart, en ek is verswak; ja, ek het gewag op medelyde, maar verniet; en op vertroosters, maar het hulle nie gevind nie.

kjv_text: They gave me also gall for my meat; and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.
bsb_text: They poisoned my food with gall and gave me vinegar to quench my thirst.
aov_text: En hulle het aan my gal gegee as my spys, en vir my dors het hulle my asyn laat drink.

kjv_text: Let their table become a snare before them: and that which should have been for their welfare, let it become a trap.
bsb_text: May their table become a snare; may it be a retribution and a trap.
aov_text: Laat hul tafel voor hulle ’n vangnet wees en vir hulle wat sorgeloos is, ’n strik.

kjv_text: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; and make their loins continually to shake.
bsb_text: May their eyes be darkened so they cannot see, and their backs be bent forever.
aov_text: Laat hulle oë duister word, sodat hulle nie sien nie; en maak dat hulle heupe altyddeur wankel.

kjv_text: Pour out thine indignation upon them, and let thy wrathful anger take hold of them.
bsb_text: Pour out Your wrath upon them, and let Your burning anger overtake them.
aov_text: Stort oor hulle u grimmigheid uit, en laat u toorngloed hulle inhaal.

kjv_text: Let their habitation be desolate; and let none dwell in their tents.
bsb_text: May their place be deserted; let there be no one to dwell in their tents.
aov_text: Laat hulle laer woes word, laat in hulle tente geen bewoner wees nie.

kjv_text: For they persecute him whom thou hast smitten; and they talk to the grief of those whom thou hast wounded.
bsb_text: For they persecute the one You struck and recount the pain of those You wounded.
aov_text: Want hulle vervolg hom wat deur Ú swaar getref is, en vertel van die smart van u gewondes.

kjv_text: Add iniquity unto their iniquity: and let them not come into thy righteousness.
bsb_text: Add iniquity to their iniquity; let them not share in Your righteousness.
aov_text: Voeg skuld by hulle skuld, en laat hulle nie in u geregtigheid kom nie.

kjv_text: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and not be written with the righteous.
bsb_text: May they be blotted out of the Book of Life and not listed with the righteous.
aov_text: Laat hulle uitgedelg word uit die boek van die lewe en nie saam met die regverdiges opgeskrywe word nie.

kjv_text: But I am poor and sorrowful: let thy salvation, O God, set me up on high.
bsb_text: But I am in pain and distress; let Your salvation protect me, O God.
aov_text: Maar ek is ellendig en in pyn: laat u hulp, o God, my beskerm!

kjv_text: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.
bsb_text: I will praise God’s name in song and exalt Him with thanksgiving.
aov_text: Ek wil die Naam van God prys met ’n lied en Hom groot maak met danksegging;

kjv_text: This also shall please the LORD better than an ox or bullock that hath horns and hoofs.
bsb_text: And this will please the LORD more than an ox, more than a bull with horns and hooves.
aov_text: en dit sal die HERE welgevalliger wees as beeste, as stiere wat horings en gesplitste kloue het.

kjv_text: The humble shall see this, and be glad: and your heart shall live that seek God.
bsb_text: The humble will see and rejoice. You who seek God, let your hearts be revived!
aov_text: As die ootmoediges dit sien, sal hulle bly wees; julle wat na God soek, laat julle hart lewe!

kjv_text: For the LORD heareth the poor, and despiseth not his prisoners.
bsb_text: For the LORD listens to the needy and does not despise His captive people.
aov_text: Want die HERE luister na die behoeftiges en verag sy gevangenes nie.

kjv_text: Let the heaven and earth praise him, the seas, and every thing that moveth therein.
bsb_text: Let heaven and earth praise Him, the seas and everything that moves in them.
aov_text: Laat hemel en aarde Hom prys, die see en alles wat daarin roer.

kjv_text: For God will save Zion, and will build the cities of Judah: that they may dwell there, and have it in possession.
bsb_text: For God will save Zion and rebuild the cities of Judah, that they may dwell there and possess it.
aov_text: Want God sal Sion verlos en die stede van Juda bou; en daar sal hulle woon en dit besit.

kjv_text: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell therein.
bsb_text: The descendants of His servants will inherit it, and those who love His name will settle in it.
aov_text: En die nageslag van sy knegte sal dit beërwe, en die liefhebbers van sy Naam sal daarin woon.

kjv_text: To the chief Musician, [A Psalm] of David, to bring to remembrance.
bsb_text: For the choirmaster. Of David. To bring remembrance.
aov_text: VIR die musiekleier. ’n Psalm van Dawid, by die gedenkoffer.

kjv_text: Make haste, O God, To deliver me; make haste to help me, O LORD.
bsb_text: Make haste, O God, to deliver me! Hurry, O LORD, to help me!
aov_text: o God, maak tog gou om my te red, o HERE, om my te help!

kjv_text: Let them be ashamed and confounded that seek after my soul: let them be turned backward, and put to confusion, that desire my hurt.
bsb_text: May those who seek my life be ashamed and confounded; may those who wish me harm be repelled and humiliated.
aov_text: Laat hulle wat my lewe soek, beskaamd staan en rooi van skaamte word; laat hulle wat behae het in my ongeluk, agteruitwyk en in die skande kom.

kjv_text: Let them be turned back for a reward of their shame that say, Aha, aha.
bsb_text: May those who say, “Aha, aha!” retreat because of their shame.
aov_text: Laat hulle wat sê: Ha, ha! teruggaan vanweë hul beskaming.

kjv_text: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: and let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.
bsb_text: May all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; may those who love Your salvation always say, “Let God be magnified!”
aov_text: Laat in U vrolik en bly wees almal wat U soek; en laat die liefhebbers van u heil altyddeur sê: Groot is God!

kjv_text: But I am poor and needy: make haste unto me, O God: thou art my help and my deliverer; O LORD, make no tarrying.
bsb_text: But I am poor and needy; hurry to me, O God. You are my help and my deliverer; O LORD, do not delay.
aov_text: Maar ek is ellendig en behoeftig: o God, kom tog gou na my! U is my hulp en my redder; HERE, vertoef tog nie!

kjv_text: In thee, O LORD, do I put my trust: let me never be put to confusion.
bsb_text: In You, O LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame.
aov_text: BY U, o HERE, skuil ek: laat my nie vir altyd beskaamd staan nie!

kjv_text: Deliver me in thy righteousness, and cause me to escape: incline thine ear unto me, and save me.
bsb_text: In Your justice, rescue and deliver me; incline Your ear and save me.
aov_text: Red my deur u geregtigheid en bevry my; neig u oor tot my en verlos my!

kjv_text: Be thou my strong habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: thou hast given commandment to save me; for thou art my rock and my fortress.
bsb_text: Be my rock of refuge, where I can always go. Give the command to save me, for You are my rock and my fortress.
aov_text: Wees vir my ’n rots om in te woon, om gedurig in te gaan; U wat bevel gegee het om my te verlos, want U is my rots en my bergvesting.

kjv_text: Deliver me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.
bsb_text: Deliver me, O my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the grasp of the unjust and ruthless.
aov_text: My God, red my uit die hand van die goddelose, uit die mag van hom wat onreg doen, en van die geweldenaar.

kjv_text: For thou art my hope, O Lord GOD: thou art my trust from my youth.
bsb_text: For You are my hope, O Lord GOD, my confidence from my youth.
aov_text: Want U is my verwagting, Here HERE, my vertroue van my jeug af.

kjv_text: By thee have I been holden up from the womb: thou art he that took me out of my mother's bowels: my praise shall be continually of thee.
bsb_text: I have leaned on You since birth; You pulled me from my mother’s womb. My praise is always for You.
aov_text: Op U het ek gesteun van die geboorte af, van die moederskoot af is U my bevryder; oor U is my lof altyddeur.

kjv_text: I am as a wonder unto many; but thou art my strong refuge.
bsb_text: I have become a portent to many, but You are my strong refuge.
aov_text: Ek was vir baie soos ’n wonder; maar U is my magtige toevlug.

kjv_text: Let my mouth be filled with thy praise and with thy honour all the day.
bsb_text: My mouth is filled with Your praise and with Your splendor all day long.
aov_text: My mond is vol van u lof, die hele dag van u roem.

kjv_text: Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength faileth.
bsb_text: Do not discard me in my old age; do not forsake me when my strength fails.
aov_text: Verwerp my nie in die tyd van die ouderdom nie, verlaat my nie as my krag gedaan is nie.

kjv_text: For mine enemies speak against me; and they that lay wait for my soul take counsel together,
bsb_text: For my enemies speak against me, and those who lie in wait for my life conspire,
aov_text: Want my vyande praat van my, en die wat op my lewe loer, hou saam raad

kjv_text: Saying, God hath forsaken him: persecute and take him; for there is none to deliver him.
bsb_text: saying, “God has forsaken him; pursue him and seize him, for there is no one to rescue him.”
aov_text: en sê: God het hom verlaat; agtervolg en gryp hom, want daar is geen redder nie!

kjv_text: O God, be not far from me: O my God, make haste for my help.
bsb_text: Be not far from me, O God. Hurry, O my God, to help me.
aov_text: o God, wees nie ver van my af nie; my God, maak tog gou om my te help!

kjv_text: Let them be confounded and consumed that are adversaries to my soul; let them be covered with reproach and dishonour that seek my hurt.
bsb_text: May the accusers of my soul be ashamed and consumed; may those who seek my harm be covered with scorn and disgrace.
aov_text: Laat hulle wat my as vyand behandel, beskaamd staan, verteer word; laat hulle wat my ongeluk soek, hulleself toedraai in smaad en skande.

kjv_text: But I will hope continually, and will yet praise thee more and more.
bsb_text: But I will always hope and will praise You more and more.
aov_text: Maar ék sal altyddeur hoop en al u lof vermeerder.

kjv_text: My mouth shall shew forth thy righteousness and thy salvation all the day; for I know not the numbers thereof.
bsb_text: My mouth will declare Your righteousness and Your salvation all day long, though I cannot know their full measure.
aov_text: My mond sal u geregtigheid vertel, die hele dag u heil; want ek ken nie die maat daarvan nie.

kjv_text: I will go in the strength of the Lord GOD: I will make mention of thy righteousness, even of thine only.
bsb_text: I will enter in the strength of the Lord GOD; I will proclaim Your righteousness—Yours alone.
aov_text: Ek sal kom met die magtige dade van die Here HERE; ek sal u geregtigheid vermeld, dié van U alleen.

kjv_text: O God, thou hast taught me from my youth: and hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works.
bsb_text: O God, You have taught me from my youth, and to this day I proclaim Your marvelous deeds.
aov_text: o God, U het my geleer van my jeug af, en tot nou toe verkondig ek u wonders.

kjv_text: Now also when I am old and greyheaded, O God, forsake me not; until I have shewed thy strength unto this generation, and thy power to every one that is to come.
bsb_text: Even when I am old and gray, do not forsake me, O God, until I proclaim Your power to the next generation, Your might to all who are to come.
aov_text: En ook tot die ouderdom en die grysheid toe—o God, verlaat my nie, totdat ek aan die volgende geslag u arm verkondig, aan almal wat sal kom, u mag.

kjv_text: Thy righteousness also, O God, is very high, who hast done great things: O God, who is like unto thee!
bsb_text: Your righteousness reaches to the heavens, O God, You who have done great things. Who, O God, is like You?
aov_text: Ook is u geregtigheid, o God, tot in die hoogte; U wat groot dinge gedoen het, o God, wie is soos U?

kjv_text: Thou, which hast shewed me great and sore troubles, shalt quicken me again, and shalt bring me up again from the depths of the earth.
bsb_text: Though You have shown me many troubles and misfortunes, You will revive me once again. Even from the depths of the earth You will bring me back up.
aov_text: U wat my baie en bange node laat sien het, sal my weer lewend maak en my weer ophaal uit die watervloede van die aarde.

kjv_text: Thou shalt increase my greatness, and comfort me on every side.
bsb_text: You will increase my honor and comfort me once again.
aov_text: Vermeerder my grootheid, en wend U om en troos my.

kjv_text: I will also praise thee with the psaltery, even thy truth, O my God: unto thee will I sing with the harp, O thou Holy One of Israel.
bsb_text: So I will praise You with the harp for Your faithfulness, O my God; I will sing praise to You with the lyre, O Holy One of Israel.
aov_text: So wil ek U dan ook loof met die instrument van die harp, u trou, my God! Ek wil psalmsing tot u eer op die siter, o Heilige van Israel!

kjv_text: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing unto thee; and my soul, which thou hast redeemed.
bsb_text: When I sing praise to You my lips will shout for joy, along with my soul, which You have redeemed.
aov_text: My lippe sal jubel as ek psalmsing tot u eer, en my siel, wat U verlos het.

kjv_text: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long: for they are confounded, for they are brought unto shame, that seek my hurt.
bsb_text: My tongue will indeed proclaim Your righteousness all day long, for those who seek my harm are disgraced and confounded.
aov_text: Ook sal my tong u geregtigheid die hele dag prys, want hulle het beskaamd gestaan, want hulle wat my ongeluk soek, het rooi van skaamte geword.

kjv_text: [A Psalm] for Solomon. Give the king thy judgments, O God, and thy righteousness unto the king's son.
bsb_text: Of Solomon. Endow the king with Your justice, O God, and the son of the king with Your righteousness.
aov_text: VAN Salomo. o God, gee aan die koning u regte en u geregtigheid aan die seun van die koning.

kjv_text: He shall judge thy people with righteousness, and thy poor with judgment.
bsb_text: May he judge Your people with righteousness and Your afflicted with justice.
aov_text: Laat hy u volk oordeel met geregtigheid en u ellendiges met reg.

kjv_text: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, and the little hills, by righteousness.
bsb_text: May the mountains bring peace to the people, and the hills bring righteousness.
aov_text: Die berge sal vrede dra vir die volk, en die heuwels, deur geregtigheid.

kjv_text: He shall judge the poor of the people, he shall save the children of the needy, and shall break in pieces the oppressor.
bsb_text: May he vindicate the afflicted among the people; may he save the children of the needy and crush the oppressor.
aov_text: Hy sal aan die ellendiges van die volk reg verskaf, die kinders van die behoeftige verlos en die verdrukker verbrysel.

kjv_text: They shall fear thee as long as the sun and moon endure, throughout all generations.
bsb_text: May they fear him as long as the sun shines, as long as the moon remains, through all generations.
aov_text: Hulle sal u vrees solank as die son skyn en solank as die maan daar is, van geslag tot geslag.

kjv_text: He shall come down like rain upon the mown grass: as showers that water the earth.
bsb_text: May he be like rain that falls on freshly cut grass, like spring showers that water the earth.
aov_text: Hy sal neerdaal soos reën op die grasveld, soos buie—’n swaar reën op die aarde.

kjv_text: In his days shall the righteous flourish; and abundance of peace so long as the moon endureth.
bsb_text: May the righteous flourish in his days and prosperity abound, until the moon is no more.
aov_text: In sy dae sal die regverdige bloei en volheid van vrede, totdat die maan nie meer is nie.

kjv_text: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, and from the river unto the ends of the earth.
bsb_text: May he rule from sea to sea, and from the Euphrates to the ends of the earth.
aov_text: En hy sal heers van see tot see en van die Rivier tot by die eindes van die aarde.

kjv_text: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; and his enemies shall lick the dust.
bsb_text: May the nomads bow before him, and his enemies lick the dust.
aov_text: Die bewoners van dor plekke sal voor hom kniel, en sy vyande sal die stof lek.

kjv_text: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall bring presents: the kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
bsb_text: May the kings of Tarshish and distant shores bring tribute; may the kings of Sheba and Seba offer gifts.
aov_text: Die konings van Tarsis en van die eilande sal geskenke aanbied, die konings van Skeba en Seba belasting aanbring.

kjv_text: Yea, all kings shall fall down before him: all nations shall serve him.
bsb_text: May all kings bow down to him and all nations serve him.
aov_text: Ja, al die konings sal hulle voor hom buig, al die nasies sal hom dien.

kjv_text: For he shall deliver the needy when he crieth; the poor also, and him that hath no helper.
bsb_text: For he will deliver the needy who cry out and the afflicted who have no helper.
aov_text: Want hy sal die behoeftige red wat daar roep om hulp, en die ellendige en wie geen helper het nie.

kjv_text: He shall spare the poor and needy, and shall save the souls of the needy.
bsb_text: He will take pity on the poor and needy and save the lives of the oppressed.
aov_text: Hy sal hom ontferm oor die arme en behoeftige, en die siele van die behoeftiges sal hy red.

kjv_text: He shall redeem their soul from deceit and violence: and precious shall their blood be in his sight.
bsb_text: He will redeem them from oppression and violence, for their blood is precious in his sight.
aov_text: Hy sal hulle siel verlos van verdrukking en geweld, en hulle bloed sal kosbaar wees in sy oë.

kjv_text: And he shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: prayer also shall be made for him continually; and daily shall he be praised.
bsb_text: Long may he live! May gold from Sheba be given him. May people ever pray for him; may they bless him all day long.
aov_text: Mag hy dan lewe! en mag hulle aan hom gee van die goud van Skeba en altyddeur vir hom bid; mag hulle die hele dag hom seën!

kjv_text: There shall be an handful of corn in the earth upon the top of the mountains; the fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: and they of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.
bsb_text: May there be an abundance of grain in the land; may it sway atop the hills. May its fruit trees flourish like the forests of Lebanon, and its people like the grass of the field.
aov_text: Mag daar volheid van koring wees in die land, op die top van die berge; mag die vrug daarvan ruis soos die Líbanon; en mag hulle bloei uit die stad soos die plante van die aarde!

kjv_text: His name shall endure for ever: his name shall be continued as long as the sun: and men shall be blessed in him: all nations shall call him blessed.
bsb_text: May his name endure forever; may his name continue as long as the sun shines. In him may all nations be blessed; may they call him blessed.
aov_text: Mag sy naam vir ewig wees; mag sy naam uitspruit solank as die son daar is! En mag al die nasies in hom geseën word, hom gelukkig prys!

kjv_text: Blessed be the LORD God, the God of Israel, who only doeth wondrous things.
bsb_text: Blessed be the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.
aov_text: Geloofd sy die HERE God, die God van Israel, wat alleen wonders doen!

kjv_text: And blessed be his glorious name for ever: and let the whole earth be filled with his glory; Amen, and Amen.
bsb_text: And blessed be His glorious name forever; may all the earth be filled with His glory. Amen and amen.
aov_text: En geloofd sy vir ewig sy heerlike Naam! En laat die hele aarde met sy heerlikheid vervul word! Amen, ja amen.

kjv_text: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.
bsb_text: Thus conclude the prayers of David son of Jesse.
aov_text: Hier eindig die gebede van Dawid, die seun van Ísai.

kjv_text: A Psalm of Asaph. Truly God is good to Israel, even to such as are of a clean heart.
bsb_text: A Psalm of Asaph. Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.
aov_text: ’N PSALM van Asaf. Waarlik, God is goed vir Israel, vir die wat rein van hart is.

kjv_text: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well nigh slipped.
bsb_text: But as for me, my feet had almost stumbled; my steps had nearly slipped.
aov_text: Maar wat my aangaan, my voete het amper gestruikel, my voetstappe het byna uitgegly.

kjv_text: For I was envious at the foolish, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
bsb_text: For I envied the arrogant when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
aov_text: Want ek was afgunstig op die onsinniges toe ek die voorspoed van die goddelose mense sien.

kjv_text: For there are no bands in their death: but their strength is firm.
bsb_text: They have no struggle in their death; their bodies are well-fed.
aov_text: Want daar is geen kwellings by hulle nie, gesond en vet is hulle liggaam.

kjv_text: They are not in trouble as other men; neither are they plagued like other men.
bsb_text: They are free of the burdens others carry; they are not afflicted like other men.
aov_text: In die moeite van sterwelinge is hulle nie, en saam met ander mense word hulle nie geplaag nie.

kjv_text: Therefore pride compasseth them about as a chain; violence covereth them as a garment.
bsb_text: Therefore pride is their necklace; a garment of violence covers them.
aov_text: Daarom is die trots om hulle soos ’n halssieraad, die geweld bedek hulle soos ’n gewaad.

kjv_text: Their eyes stand out with fatness: they have more than heart could wish.
bsb_text: From their prosperity proceeds iniquity; the imaginations of their hearts run wild.
aov_text: Hulle oë puil uit van vet; die inbeeldinge van die hart loop oor.

kjv_text: They are corrupt, and speak wickedly concerning oppression: they speak loftily.
bsb_text: They mock and speak with malice; with arrogance they threaten oppression.
aov_text: Hulle spot en spreek in boosheid verdrukking; hulle spreek uit die hoogte.

kjv_text: They set their mouth against the heavens, and their tongue walketh through the earth.
bsb_text: They set their mouths against the heavens, and their tongues strut across the earth.
aov_text: Hulle stel hul mond teen die hemel, en hul tong wandel op die aarde.

kjv_text: Therefore his people return hither: and waters of a full cup are wrung out to them.
bsb_text: So their people return to this place and drink up waters in abundance.
aov_text: Daarom draai hulle mense hul hierheen, en waters in volheid word deur hulle geslurp.

kjv_text: And they say, How doth God know? and is there knowledge in the most High?
bsb_text: The wicked say, “How can God know? Does the Most High have knowledge?”
aov_text: En hulle sê: Hoe sou God dit weet, en sou daar kennis by die Allerhoogste wees?

kjv_text: Behold, these are the ungodly, who prosper in the world; they increase in riches.
bsb_text: Behold, these are the wicked—always carefree as they increase their wealth.
aov_text: Kyk, so is die goddelose mense, en altyd onbesorg vermeerder hulle die rykdom!

kjv_text: Verily I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocency.
bsb_text: Surely in vain I have kept my heart pure; in innocence I have washed my hands.
aov_text: Waarlik, tevergeefs het ek my hart rein gehou en my hande in onskuld gewas.

kjv_text: For all the day long have I been plagued, and chastened every morning.
bsb_text: For I am afflicted all day long and punished every morning.
aov_text: Die hele dag tog is ek geslaan, en my tugtiging was daar elke môre.

kjv_text: If I say, I will speak thus; behold, I should offend against the generation of thy children.
bsb_text: If I had said, “I will speak this way,” then I would have betrayed Your children.
aov_text: As ek gesê het: Ek wil óók so spreek—dan sou ek ontrou gewees het aan die geslag van u kinders!

kjv_text: When I thought to know this, it was too painful for me;
bsb_text: When I tried to understand all this, it was troublesome in my sight
aov_text: Toe het ek nagedink om dit te verstaan, maar dit was moeite in my oë,

kjv_text: Until I went into the sanctuary of God; then understood I their end.
bsb_text: until I entered God’s sanctuary; then I discerned their end.
aov_text: totdat ek in die heiligdomme van God ingegaan en op hulle einde gelet het.

kjv_text: Surely thou didst set them in slippery places: thou castedst them down into destruction.
bsb_text: Surely You set them on slick ground; You cast them down into ruin.
aov_text: Waarlik, U stel hulle op gladde plekke; U laat hulle in puin val.

kjv_text: How are they brought into desolation, as in a moment! they are utterly consumed with terrors.
bsb_text: How suddenly they are laid waste, completely swept away by terrors!
aov_text: Hoe word hulle in ’n oomblik ’n voorwerp van verbasing, vergaan hulle, raak hulle tot niet deur verskrikkinge!

kjv_text: As a dream when one awaketh; so, O Lord, when thou awakest, thou shalt despise their image.
bsb_text: Like one waking from a dream, so You, O Lord, awaken and despise their form.
aov_text: Soos ’n droom nadat ’n mens wakker word, o Here, so verag U, as U opwaak, hulle beeld!

kjv_text: Thus my heart was grieved, and I was pricked in my reins.
bsb_text: When my heart was grieved and I was pierced within,
aov_text: Toe my hart bitter gestemd en ek in my niere geprikkel was,

kjv_text: So foolish was I, and ignorant: I was as a beast before thee.
bsb_text: I was senseless and ignorant; I was a brute beast before You.
aov_text: toe was ék dom en het niks geweet nie; ek was ’n dier by U.

kjv_text: Nevertheless I am continually with thee: thou hast holden me by my right hand.
bsb_text: Yet I am always with You; You hold my right hand.
aov_text: Nogtans is ek altyddeur by U; U het my regterhand gevat.

kjv_text: Thou shalt guide me with thy counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.
bsb_text: You guide me with Your counsel, and later receive me in glory.
aov_text: U sal my lei deur u raad en my daarna in heerlikheid opneem.

kjv_text: Whom have I in heaven but thee? and there is none upon earth that I desire beside thee.
bsb_text: Whom have I in heaven but You? And on earth I desire no one besides You.
aov_text: Wie het ek buiten U in die hemel? Buiten U begeer ek ook niks op die aarde nie.

kjv_text: My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.
bsb_text: My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
aov_text: Al beswyk my vlees en my hart—God is die rots van my hart en my deel tot in ewigheid.

kjv_text: For, lo, they that are far from thee shall perish: thou hast destroyed all them that go a whoring from thee.
bsb_text: Those far from You will surely perish; You destroy all who are unfaithful to You.
aov_text: Want kyk, die wat hulle ver van U af hou, vergaan; U roei almal uit wat van U afhoereer.

kjv_text: But it is good for me to draw near to God: I have put my trust in the Lord GOD, that I may declare all thy works.
bsb_text: But as for me, it is good to draw near to God. I have made the Lord GOD my refuge, that I may proclaim all Your works.
aov_text: Maar wat my aangaan, dit is vir my goed om naby God te wees; in die Here HERE het ek my toevlug gestel, om al u werke te vertel.

kjv_text: Maschil of Asaph. O God, why hast thou cast us off for ever? why doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture?
bsb_text: A Maskil of Asaph. Why have You rejected us forever, O God? Why does Your anger smolder against the sheep of Your pasture?
aov_text: ’N ONDERWYSING van Asaf. o God, waarom het U vir altyd verstoot? Waarom rook u toorn teen die skape van u weide?

kjv_text: Remember thy congregation, which thou hast purchased of old; the rod of thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed; this mount Zion, wherein thou hast dwelt.
bsb_text: Remember Your congregation, which You purchased long ago and redeemed as the tribe of Your inheritance—Mount Zion where You dwell.
aov_text: Dink aan u vergadering wat U in die voortyd verwerf het, wat U verlos het om die stam van u erfdeel te wees, aan die berg Sion waar U op gewoon het.

kjv_text: Lift up thy feet unto the perpetual desolations; even all that the enemy hath done wickedly in the sanctuary.
bsb_text: Turn Your steps to the everlasting ruins, to everything in the sanctuary the enemy has destroyed.
aov_text: Hef u voete op na die ewige puinhope: alles het die vyand in die heiligdom verniel.

kjv_text: Thine enemies roar in the midst of thy congregations; they set up their ensigns for signs.
bsb_text: Your foes have roared within Your meeting place; they have unfurled their banners as signs,
aov_text: U teëstanders het binne-in u vergaderplek gebrul; hulle het hul tekens as tekens gestel.

kjv_text: A man was famous according as he had lifted up axes upon the thick trees.
bsb_text: like men wielding axes in a thicket of trees
aov_text: Dit lyk soos wanneer iemand byle omhoog hef in ’n digte plek bome.

kjv_text: But now they break down the carved work thereof at once with axes and hammers.
bsb_text: and smashing all the carvings with hatchets and picks.
aov_text: En nou—die houtsnywerk daarvan het hulle alles met byl en hamers stukkend geslaan.

kjv_text: They have cast fire into thy sanctuary, they have defiled by casting down the dwelling place of thy name to the ground.
bsb_text: They have burned Your sanctuary to the ground; they have defiled the dwelling place of Your Name.
aov_text: Hulle het u heiligdom aan die brand gesteek; tot die grond toe het hulle die woonplek van u Naam ontheilig.

kjv_text: They said in their hearts, Let us destroy them together: they have burned up all the synagogues of God in the land.
bsb_text: They said in their hearts, “We will crush them completely.” They burned down every place where God met us in the land.
aov_text: Hulle het in hul hart gesê: Laat ons hulle almal saam onderdruk! Hulle het al die vergaderplekke van God in die land verbrand.

kjv_text: We see not our signs: there is no more any prophet: neither is there among us any that knoweth how long.
bsb_text: There are no signs for us to see. There is no longer any prophet. And none of us knows how long this will last.
aov_text: Ons sien nie ons tekens nie; daar is geen profeet meer nie, en by ons is daar niemand wat weet hoe lank nie.

kjv_text: O God, how long shall the adversary reproach? shall the enemy blaspheme thy name for ever?
bsb_text: How long, O God, will the enemy taunt You? Will the foe revile Your name forever?
aov_text: Hoe lank, o God, sal die teëstander smaad aandoen, sal die vyand u Naam vir altyd verag?

kjv_text: Why withdrawest thou thy hand, even thy right hand? pluck it out of thy bosom.
bsb_text: Why do You withdraw Your strong right hand? Stretch it out to destroy them!
aov_text: Waarom trek U u hand, ja, u regterhand, terug? Trek dit uit u boesem! Vernietig!

kjv_text: For God is my King of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.
bsb_text: Yet God is my King from ancient times, working salvation on the earth.
aov_text: Nogtans is God my Koning van die voortyd af, wat verlossinge werk op die aarde.

kjv_text: Thou didst divide the sea by thy strength: thou brakest the heads of the dragons in the waters.
bsb_text: You divided the sea by Your strength; You smashed the heads of the dragons of the sea;
aov_text: Ú het deur u sterkte die see geklief; Ú het die koppe van die seemonsters op die waters verbreek.

kjv_text: Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces, and gavest him to be meat to the people inhabiting the wilderness.
bsb_text: You crushed the heads of Leviathan; You fed him to the creatures of the desert.
aov_text: Ú het die koppe van die Leviátan verbrysel; U het hom gegee as voedsel vir ’n volk—vir woestyndiere.

kjv_text: Thou didst cleave the fountain and the flood: thou driedst up mighty rivers.
bsb_text: You broke open the fountain and the flood; You dried up the ever-flowing rivers.
aov_text: Ú het fontein en stroom oopgeslaan; Ú het standhoudende riviere laat opdroog.

kjv_text: The day is thine, the night also is thine: thou hast prepared the light and the sun.
bsb_text: The day is Yours, and also the night; You established the moon and the sun.
aov_text: Aan U behoort die dag, aan U behoort ook die nag; Ú het hemelligte en son vasgestel.

kjv_text: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth: thou hast made summer and winter.
bsb_text: You set all the boundaries of the earth; You made the summer and winter.
aov_text: Ú het al die grense van die aarde bepaal; somer en winter, Ú het hulle geformeer.

kjv_text: Remember this, that the enemy hath reproached, O LORD, and that the foolish people have blasphemed thy name.
bsb_text: Remember how the enemy has mocked You, O LORD, how a foolish people has spurned Your name.
aov_text: Dink hieraan: Die vyand het die HERE gesmaad, en ’n dwase volk het u Naam verag.

kjv_text: O deliver not the soul of thy turtledove unto the multitude of the wicked: forget not the congregation of thy poor for ever.
bsb_text: Do not deliver the soul of Your dove to beasts; do not forget the lives of Your afflicted forever.
aov_text: Gee aan die wilde diere die siel van u tortelduif nie oor nie; vergeet nie vir altyd die lewe van u ellendiges nie.

kjv_text: Have respect unto the covenant: for the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruelty.
bsb_text: Consider Your covenant, for haunts of violence fill the dark places of the land.
aov_text: Aanskou die verbond, want die donker plekke van die land is vol wonings van geweld.

kjv_text: O let not the oppressed return ashamed: let the poor and needy praise thy name.
bsb_text: Do not let the oppressed retreat in shame; may the poor and needy praise Your name.
aov_text: Laat die verdrukte nie beskaamd terugkom nie; laat die ellendige en behoeftige u Naam prys.

kjv_text: Arise, O God, plead thine own cause: remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee daily.
bsb_text: Rise up, O God; defend Your cause! Remember how the fool mocks You all day long.
aov_text: Staan op, o God, verdedig u saak; dink aan die smaad wat U die hele dag aangedoen word deur ’n dwaas.

kjv_text: Forget not the voice of thine enemies: the tumult of those that rise up against thee increaseth continually.
bsb_text: Do not disregard the clamor of Your adversaries, the uproar of Your enemies that ascends continually.
aov_text: Vergeet nie die geroep van u teëstanders nie—die rumoer van u opstandige vyande, wat altyddeur opgaan!

kjv_text: To the chief Musician, Altaschith, A Psalm [or] Song of Asaph.
bsb_text: For the choirmaster: To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Psalm of Asaph. A song.
aov_text: VIR die musiekleier; op die wysie van: „Moenie verwoes nie.” ’n Psalm van Asaf. ’n Lied.

kjv_text: Unto thee, O God, do we give thanks, unto thee do we give thanks: for that thy name is near thy wondrous works declare.
bsb_text: We give thanks to You, O God; we give thanks, for Your Name is near. The people declare Your wondrous works.
aov_text: Ons loof U, o God, ons loof, en naby is u Naam; hulle vertel u wonders.

kjv_text: When I shall receive the congregation I will judge uprightly.
bsb_text: “When I choose a time, I will judge fairly.
aov_text: As Ek die regte tydstip aangryp, oordeel Ék regverdig.

kjv_text: The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I bear up the pillars of it. Selah.
bsb_text: When the earth and all its dwellers quake, it is I who bear up its pillars. Selah
aov_text: Al wankel die aarde en al sy bewoners—Ék het sy pilare vasgestel. Sela.

kjv_text: I said unto the fools, Deal not foolishly: and to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:
bsb_text: I say to the proud, ‘Do not boast,’ and to the wicked, ‘Do not lift up your horn.
aov_text: Ek sê tot die onsinniges: Wees nie onsinnig nie! en tot die goddelose: Verhef die horing nie!

kjv_text: Lift not up your horn on high: speak not with a stiff neck.
bsb_text: Do not lift up your horn against heaven or speak with an outstretched neck.’”
aov_text: Verhef julle horing nie daarbo en spreek nie met trots uitgerekte nek nie.

kjv_text: For promotion cometh neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south.
bsb_text: For exaltation comes neither from east nor west, nor out of the desert,
aov_text: Want nie van die opgang of van die ondergang, ook nie van die woestyn van berghoogtes nie …

kjv_text: But God is the judge: he putteth down one, and setteth up another.
bsb_text: but it is God who judges; He brings down one and exalts another.
aov_text: maar God is regter: Hy verneder die een en verhef die ander.

kjv_text: For in the hand of the LORD there is a cup, and the wine is red; it is full of mixture; and he poureth out of the same: but the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall wring them out, and drink them.
bsb_text: For a cup is in the hand of the LORD, full of foaming wine mixed with spices. He pours from His cup, and all the wicked of the earth drink it down to the dregs.
aov_text: Want in die hand van die HERE is ’n beker, en die wyn skuim; dit is oorvloedig gemeng, en Hy skink daaruit; ja, die afsaksel daarvan moet al die goddelose van die aarde opslurp, uitdrink.

kjv_text: But I will declare for ever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
bsb_text: But I will proclaim Him forever; I will sing praise to the God of Jacob.
aov_text: Maar ék sal vir ewig verkondig—ek wil psalmsing tot eer van die God van Jakob.

kjv_text: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; but the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.
bsb_text: “All the horns of the wicked I will cut off, but the horns of the righteous will be exalted.”
aov_text: En ek sal al die horings van die goddelose mense stukkend breek; die horings van die regverdige sal verhef word.

kjv_text: To the chief Musician on Neginoth, A Psalm [or] Song of Asaph.
bsb_text: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Psalm of Asaph. A song.
aov_text: VIR die musiekleier; met snaarinstrumente. ’n Psalm van Asaf. ’n Lied.

kjv_text: In Judah is God known: his name is great in Israel.
bsb_text: God is known in Judah; His name is great in Israel.
aov_text: God is bekend in Juda, sy Naam is groot in Israel.

kjv_text: In Salem also is his tabernacle, and his dwelling place in Zion.
bsb_text: His tent is in Salem, His dwelling place in Zion.
aov_text: Ook het in Salem sy tent verrys en in Sion sy woning.

kjv_text: There brake he the arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah.
bsb_text: There He shattered the flaming arrows, the shield and sword and weapons of war. Selah
aov_text: Daar het Hy die blitspyle van die boog verbreek, skild en swaard en oorlog. Sela.

kjv_text: Thou art more glorious and excellent than the mountains of prey.
bsb_text: You are resplendent with light, more majestic than mountains filled with game.
aov_text: Glansryk is U, heerlik van die roofberge af!

kjv_text: The stouthearted are spoiled, they have slept their sleep: and none of the men of might have found their hands.
bsb_text: The valiant lie plundered; they sleep their last sleep. No men of might could lift a hand.
aov_text: Geplunder is die sterkes van hart; hulle het hul slaap gesluimer, en geeneen van die dapper manne het hulle hande gevind nie.

kjv_text: At thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, both the chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.
bsb_text: At Your rebuke, O God of Jacob, both horse and rider lie stunned.
aov_text: Deur u dreiging, o God van Jakob, het strydwa en perd saam bedwelmd geraak.

kjv_text: Thou, even thou, art to be feared: and who may stand in thy sight when once thou art angry?
bsb_text: You alone are to be feared. When You are angry, who can stand before You?
aov_text: U, vreeslik is U, en wie kan voor u aangesig bestaan as u toorn uitgebreek het?

kjv_text: Thou didst cause judgment to be heard from heaven; the earth feared, and was still,
bsb_text: From heaven You pronounced judgment, and the earth feared and was still
aov_text: Uit die hemel het U ’n oordeel laat hoor; die aarde het gevrees en stil geword,

kjv_text: When God arose to judgment, to save all the meek of the earth. Selah.
bsb_text: when God rose up to judge, to save all the lowly of the earth. Selah
aov_text: toe God opgestaan het vir die gerig, om al die ootmoediges van die land te verlos. Sela.

kjv_text: Surely the wrath of man shall praise thee: the remainder of wrath shalt thou restrain.
bsb_text: Even the wrath of man shall praise You; with the survivors of wrath You will clothe Yourself.
aov_text: Want die grimmigheid van die mens moet U loof; met die oorblyfsel van grimmighede gord U Uself.

kjv_text: Vow, and pay unto the LORD your God: let all that be round about him bring presents unto him that ought to be feared.
bsb_text: Make and fulfill your vows to the LORD your God; let all the neighboring lands bring tribute to Him who is to be feared.
aov_text: Doen geloftes en betaal dié aan die HERE julle God! Laat almal wat rondom Hom is, geskenke bring aan die Vreeslike,

kjv_text: He shall cut off the spirit of princes: he is terrible to the kings of the earth.
bsb_text: He breaks the spirits of princes; He is feared by the kings of the earth.
aov_text: wat die trots van die vorste wegsny, vreeslik is vir die konings van die aarde.

kjv_text: To the chief Musician, to Jeduthun, A Psalm of Asaph.
bsb_text: For the choirmaster. According to Jeduthun. A Psalm of Asaph.
aov_text: VIR die musiekleier; op die wysie van: „Jedútun.” ’n Psalm van Asaf.

kjv_text: I cried unto God with my voice, even unto God with my voice; and he gave ear unto me.
bsb_text: I cried out to God; I cried aloud to God to hear me.
aov_text: My stem is tot God en ek roep; my stem is tot God, dat Hy na my kan luister.

kjv_text: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord: my sore ran in the night, and ceased not: my soul refused to be comforted.
bsb_text: In the day of trouble I sought the Lord; through the night my outstretched hands did not grow weary; my soul refused to be comforted.
aov_text: Op die dag van my benoudheid soek ek die HERE; snags bly my hand uitgestrek sonder om moeg te word; my siel weier om getroos te word.

kjv_text: I remembered God, and was troubled: I complained, and my spirit was overwhelmed. Selah.
bsb_text: I remembered You, O God, and I groaned; I mused and my spirit grew faint. Selah
aov_text: As ek aan God dink, moet ek steun; peins ek, dan versmag my gees. Sela.

kjv_text: Thou holdest mine eyes waking: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.
bsb_text: You have kept my eyes from closing; I am too troubled to speak.
aov_text: U hou my ooglede oop; ek is onrustig en kan nie spreek nie.

kjv_text: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.
bsb_text: I considered the days of old, the years long in the past.
aov_text: Ek dink oor die dae van die voortyd, oor die ou, ou jare.

kjv_text: I call to remembrance my song in the night: I commune with mine own heart: and my spirit made diligent search.
bsb_text: At night I remembered my song; in my heart I mused, and my spirit pondered:
aov_text: Ek wil dink aan my snarespel in die nag, wil peins met my hart, en my gees deurvors:

kjv_text: Will the Lord cast off for ever? and will he be favourable no more?
bsb_text: “Will the Lord spurn us forever and never show His favor again?
aov_text: Sal die Here vir altyd verstoot en verder nie meer goedgunstig wees nie?

kjv_text: Is his mercy clean gone for ever? doth his promise fail for evermore?
bsb_text: Is His loving devotion gone forever? Has His promise failed for all time?
