aov_text: Hou sy goedertierenheid vir altyd op? Is dit met die belofte gedaan van geslag tot geslag?

kjv_text: Hath God forgotten to be gracious? hath he in anger shut up his tender mercies? Selah.
bsb_text: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has His anger shut off His compassion?” Selah
aov_text: Het God vergeet om genadig te wees? Of het Hy in toorn sy barmhartighede toegesluit? Sela.

kjv_text: And I said, This is my infirmity: but I will remember the years of the right hand of the most High.
bsb_text: So I said, “I am grieved that the right hand of the Most High has changed.”
aov_text: Toe het ek gesê: Dit is my grootste bekommernis dat die regterhand van die Allerhoogste verander!

kjv_text: I will remember the works of the LORD: surely I will remember thy wonders of old.
bsb_text: I will remember the works of the LORD; yes, I will remember Your wonders of old.
aov_text: Ek dink aan die dade van die HERE; ja, ek wil dink aan u wonders uit die voortyd

kjv_text: I will meditate also of all thy work, and talk of thy doings.
bsb_text: I will reflect on all You have done and ponder Your mighty deeds.
aov_text: en al u werk oordink, en ek wil peins oor u dade.

kjv_text: Thy way, O God, is in the sanctuary: who is so great a God as our God?
bsb_text: Your way, O God, is holy. What god is so great as our God?
aov_text: o God, u weg is in heiligheid. Wie is ’n groot God soos God?

kjv_text: Thou art the God that doest wonders: thou hast declared thy strength among the people.
bsb_text: You are the God who works wonders; You display Your strength among the peoples.
aov_text: U is die God wat wonders doen; U het u sterkte onder die volke bekend gemaak.

kjv_text: Thou hast with thine arm redeemed thy people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.
bsb_text: With power You redeemed Your people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah
aov_text: U het u volk met ’n sterk arm verlos, die kinders van Jakob en van Josef. Sela.

kjv_text: The waters saw thee, O God, the waters saw thee; they were afraid: the depths also were troubled.
bsb_text: The waters saw You, O God; the waters saw You and swirled; even the depths were shaken.
aov_text: Die waters het U gesien, o God, die waters het U gesien, hulle het gebewe; ja, die watervloede het gesidder.

kjv_text: The clouds poured out water: the skies sent out a sound: thine arrows also went abroad.
bsb_text: The clouds poured down water; the skies resounded with thunder; Your arrows flashed back and forth.
aov_text: Die wolke het water uitgegiet, die hemele het donder laat hoor, ook het u pyle rondgevlieg.

kjv_text: The voice of thy thunder was in the heaven: the lightnings lightened the world: the earth trembled and shook.
bsb_text: Your thunder resounded in the whirlwind; the lightning lit up the world; the earth trembled and quaked.
aov_text: U rollende donder het weerklink; bliksems het die wêreld verlig; die aarde het gesidder en gebewe.

kjv_text: Thy way is in the sea, and thy path in the great waters, and thy footsteps are not known.
bsb_text: Your path led through the sea, Your way through the mighty waters, but Your footprints were not to be found.
aov_text: U weg was in die see en u paaie in groot waters, en u spore was nie te beken nie.

kjv_text: Thou leddest thy people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
bsb_text: You led Your people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
aov_text: U het u volk soos skape gelei deur die hand van Moses en Aäron.

kjv_text: Maschil of Asaph. Give ear, O my people, to my law: incline your ears to the words of my mouth.
bsb_text: A Maskil of Asaph. Give ear, O my people, to my instruction; listen to the words of my mouth.
aov_text: ’N ONDERWYSING van Asaf. My volk, luister na my onderrig; neig julle oor tot die woorde van my mond.

kjv_text: I will open my mouth in a parable: I will utter dark sayings of old:
bsb_text: I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden from the beginning,
aov_text: Ek wil my mond open met ’n spreuk, raaisels uit die voortyd laat stroom.

kjv_text: Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.
bsb_text: that we have heard and known and our fathers have relayed to us.
aov_text: Wat ons gehoor het en weet en ons vaders ons vertel het,

kjv_text: We will not hide them from their children, shewing to the generation to come the praises of the LORD, and his strength, and his wonderful works that he hath done.
bsb_text: We will not hide them from their children, but will declare to the next generation the praises of the LORD and His might, and the wonders He has performed.
aov_text: sal ons nie verberg vir hulle kinders nie, maar aan die volgende geslag vertel die roemryke dade van die HERE en sy mag en sy wonders wat Hy gedoen het.

kjv_text: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children:
bsb_text: For He established a testimony in Jacob and appointed a law in Israel, which He commanded our fathers to teach to their children,
aov_text: Hy tog het ’n getuienis opgerig in Jakob en ’n wet gegee in Israel, wat Hy ons vaders beveel het—om dit aan hulle kinders bekend te maak,

kjv_text: That the generation to come might know them, even the children which should be born; who should arise and declare them to their children:
bsb_text: that the coming generation would know them—even children yet to be born—to arise and tell their own children
aov_text: sodat die volgende geslag dit kan weet, die kinders wat gebore word, dat hulle kan opstaan en vertel aan hulle kinders,

kjv_text: That they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments:
bsb_text: that they should put their confidence in God, not forgetting His works, but keeping His commandments.
aov_text: en hulle vertroue op God kan stel en die dade van God nie vergeet nie, maar sy gebooie kan bewaar,

kjv_text: And might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation; a generation that set not their heart aright, and whose spirit was not stedfast with God.
bsb_text: Then they will not be like their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation, whose heart was not loyal, whose spirit was not faithful to God.
aov_text: en nie word soos hulle vaders nie, ’n koppige en wederstrewige geslag, ’n geslag met ’n onvaste hart en wie se gees nie trou was teenoor God nie.

kjv_text: The children of Ephraim, being armed, and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.
bsb_text: The archers of Ephraim turned back on the day of battle.
aov_text: Die kinders van Efraim, gewapende boogskutters, het omgespring op die dag van oorlog.

kjv_text: They kept not the covenant of God, and refused to walk in his law;
bsb_text: They failed to keep God’s covenant and refused to live by His law.
aov_text: Hulle het die verbond van God nie gehou nie en geweier om te wandel in sy wet.

kjv_text: And forgat his works, and his wonders that he had shewed them.
bsb_text: They forgot what He had done, the wonders He had shown them.
aov_text: En hulle het sy dade vergeet en sy wonders wat Hy hulle laat sien het.

kjv_text: Marvellous things did he in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.
bsb_text: He worked wonders before their fathers in the land of Egypt, in the region of Zoan.
aov_text: Voor hulle vaders het Hy wonders gedoen, in die land Egipte, die veld van Soan.

kjv_text: He divided the sea, and caused them to pass through; and he made the waters to stand as an heap.
bsb_text: He split the sea and brought them through; He set the waters upright like a wall.
aov_text: Hy het die see geklief en hulle laat deurgaan en die waters laat staan soos ’n wal.

kjv_text: In the daytime also he led them with a cloud, and all the night with a light of fire.
bsb_text: He led them with a cloud by day and with a light of fire all night.
aov_text: En Hy het hulle bedags gelei met ’n wolk en die hele nag met ’n lig van vuur.

kjv_text: He clave the rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink as out of the great depths.
bsb_text: He split the rocks in the wilderness and gave them drink as abundant as the seas.
aov_text: Hy het rotse gekloof in die woestyn en hulle oorvloedig laat drink soos uit watervloede.

kjv_text: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.
bsb_text: He brought streams from the stone and made water flow down like rivers.
aov_text: En Hy het strome laat uitgaan uit die rots en die waters laat afloop soos riviere.

kjv_text: And they sinned yet more against him by provoking the most High in the wilderness.
bsb_text: But they continued to sin against Him, rebelling in the desert against the Most High.
aov_text: Nog het hulle voortgegaan om teen Hom te sondig, om wederstrewig te wees teen die Allerhoogste in die dor land.

kjv_text: And they tempted God in their heart by asking meat for their lust.
bsb_text: They willfully tested God by demanding the food they craved.
aov_text: En hulle het God versoek in hul hart deur voedsel te vra na hulle sin.

kjv_text: Yea, they spake against God; they said, Can God furnish a table in the wilderness?
bsb_text: They spoke against God, saying, “Can God really prepare a table in the wilderness?
aov_text: En hulle het teen God gespreek, hulle het gesê: Sou God ’n tafel kan dek in die woestyn?

kjv_text: Behold, he smote the rock, that the waters gushed out, and the streams overflowed; can he give bread also? can he provide flesh for his people?
bsb_text: When He struck the rock, water gushed out and torrents raged. But can He also give bread or supply His people with meat?”
aov_text: Kyk, Hy het die rots geslaan, dat waters gevloei en spruite gestroom het—sou Hy ook brood kan gee of vleis kan verskaf aan sy volk?

kjv_text: Therefore the LORD heard this, and was wroth: so a fire was kindled against Jacob, and anger also came up against Israel;
bsb_text: Therefore the LORD heard and was filled with wrath; so a fire was kindled against Jacob, and His anger flared against Israel,
aov_text: Daarom het die HERE gehoor en toornig geword, en ’n vuur is aangesteek teen Jakob, en toorn het ook opgegaan teen Israel;

kjv_text: Because they believed not in God, and trusted not in his salvation:
bsb_text: because they did not believe God or rely on His salvation.
aov_text: omdat hulle in God nie geglo en op sy hulp nie vertrou het nie.

kjv_text: Though he had commanded the clouds from above, and opened the doors of heaven,
bsb_text: Yet He commanded the clouds above and opened the doors of the heavens.
aov_text: En Hy het aan die wolke daarbo bevel gegee en die deure van die hemel oopgemaak;

kjv_text: And had rained down manna upon them to eat, and had given them of the corn of heaven.
bsb_text: He rained down manna for them to eat; He gave them grain from heaven.
aov_text: en Hy het manna op hulle laat reën om te eet en koring van die hemel aan hulle gegee.

kjv_text: Man did eat angels' food: he sent them meat to the full.
bsb_text: Man ate the bread of angels; He sent them food in abundance.
aov_text: Mense het die brood van die engele geëet; Hy het hulle volop padkos gestuur.

kjv_text: He caused an east wind to blow in the heaven: and by his power he brought in the south wind.
bsb_text: He stirred the east wind from the heavens and drove the south wind by His might.
aov_text: Hy het die oostewind laat uitbreek aan die hemel en die suidewind deur sy sterkte aangevoer;

kjv_text: He rained flesh also upon them as dust, and feathered fowls like as the sand of the sea:
bsb_text: He rained meat on them like dust, and winged birds like the sand of the sea.
aov_text: en Hy het vleis soos stof op hulle laat reën en gevleuelde voëls soos sand aan die seë;

kjv_text: And he let it fall in the midst of their camp, round about their habitations.
bsb_text: He felled them in the midst of their camp, all around their dwellings.
aov_text: en Hy het dit binne-in sy laer laat val, rondom sy wonings.

kjv_text: So they did eat, and were well filled: for he gave them their own desire;
bsb_text: So they ate and were well filled, for He gave them what they craved.
aov_text: Toe het hulle geëet en ten volle versadig geword, en hulle begeerte het Hy bevredig.

kjv_text: They were not estranged from their lust. But while their meat was yet in their mouths,
bsb_text: Yet before they had filled their desire, with the food still in their mouths,
aov_text: Hulle was nie weg van hul begeerte nie—hulle voedsel was nog in hulle mond —

kjv_text: The wrath of God came upon them, and slew the fattest of them, and smote down the chosen men of Israel.
bsb_text: God’s anger flared against them, and He put to death their strongest and subdued the young men of Israel.
aov_text: toe die toorn van God teen hulle opgegaan het en Hy ’n slagting onder hulle kragtige manne aangerig en die jongmanne van Israel neergewerp het.

kjv_text: For all this they sinned still, and believed not for his wondrous works.
bsb_text: In spite of all this, they kept on sinning; despite His wonderful works, they did not believe.
aov_text: Ondanks dit alles het hulle verder gesondig en nie aan sy wonders geglo nie.

kjv_text: Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, and their years in trouble.
bsb_text: So He ended their days in futility, and their years in sudden terror.
aov_text: So het Hy dan hulle dae laat vergaan in nietigheid en hulle jare in verskrikking.

kjv_text: When he slew them, then they sought him: and they returned and enquired early after God.
bsb_text: When He slew them, they would seek Him; they repented and searched for God.
aov_text: Elke keer as Hy hulle gedood het, het hulle na Hom gevra en teruggekom en God gesoek;

kjv_text: And they remembered that God was their rock, and the high God their redeemer.
bsb_text: And they remembered that God was their Rock, that God Most High was their Redeemer.
aov_text: en hulle het daaraan gedink dat God hul rots was en God, die Allerhoogste, hul verlosser.

kjv_text: Nevertheless they did flatter him with their mouth, and they lied unto him with their tongues.
bsb_text: But they deceived Him with their mouths, and lied to Him with their tongues.
aov_text: En hulle het Hom met hul mond gevlei en Hom met hul tong belieg;

kjv_text: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they stedfast in his covenant.
bsb_text: Their hearts were disloyal to Him, and they were unfaithful to His covenant.
aov_text: maar hulle hart het nie aan Hom vasgehou nie, en hulle was nie trou in sy verbond nie.

kjv_text: But he, being full of compassion, forgave their iniquity, and destroyed them not: yea, many a time turned he his anger away, and did not stir up all his wrath.
bsb_text: And yet He was compassionate; He forgave their iniquity and did not destroy them. He often restrained His anger and did not unleash His full wrath.
aov_text: Maar Hy is barmhartig, Hy versoen die ongeregtigheid en verdelg nie, en dikwels wend Hy sy toorn af en wek nie al sy grimmigheid op nie.

kjv_text: For he remembered that they were but flesh; a wind that passeth away, and cometh not again.
bsb_text: He remembered that they were but flesh, a passing breeze that does not return.
aov_text: En Hy het daaraan gedink dat hulle vlees was, ’n wind wat weggaan en nie terugkom nie.

kjv_text: How oft did they provoke him in the wilderness, and grieve him in the desert!
bsb_text: How often they disobeyed Him in the wilderness and grieved Him in the desert!
aov_text: Hoe dikwels was hulle wederstrewig teen Hom in die woestyn, het hulle Hom gegrief in die wildernis;

kjv_text: Yea, they turned back and tempted God, and limited the Holy One of Israel.
bsb_text: Again and again they tested God and provoked the Holy One of Israel.
aov_text: en hulle het God opnuut versoek en die Heilige van Israel gekrenk.

kjv_text: They remembered not his hand, nor the day when he delivered them from the enemy.
bsb_text: They did not remember His power—the day He redeemed them from the adversary,
aov_text: Hulle het nie aan sy hand gedink, aan die dag toe Hy hulle van die teëstander verlos het nie;

kjv_text: How he had wrought his signs in Egypt, and his wonders in the field of Zoan:
bsb_text: when He performed His signs in Egypt and His wonders in the fields of Zoan.
aov_text: toe Hy sy tekens gedoen het in Egipte en sy wonders in die veld van Soan.

kjv_text: And had turned their rivers into blood; and their floods, that they could not drink.
bsb_text: He turned their rivers to blood, and from their streams they could not drink.
aov_text: En Hy het hulle riviere verander in bloed en hulle strome, sodat hulle nie kon drink nie.

kjv_text: He sent divers sorts of flies among them, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.
bsb_text: He sent swarms of flies that devoured them, and frogs that devastated them.
aov_text: Hy het onder hulle steekvlieë gestuur wat hulle verteer het, en paddas wat verwoesting oor hulle gebring het.

kjv_text: He gave also their increase unto the caterpiller, and their labour unto the locust.
bsb_text: He gave their crops to the grasshopper, the fruit of their labor to the locust.
aov_text: En Hy het hulle opbrings aan die kaalvreter gegee en die vrug van hulle werk aan die treksprinkaan.

kjv_text: He destroyed their vines with hail, and their sycomore trees with frost.
bsb_text: He killed their vines with hailstones and their sycamore-figs with sleet.
aov_text: Hy het hulle wingerdstok deur die hael doodgemaak en hulle wildevyeboom deur ryp.

kjv_text: He gave up their cattle also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.
bsb_text: He abandoned their cattle to the hail and their livestock to bolts of lightning.
aov_text: Ook het Hy hulle diere aan die hael oorgegee en hulle vee aan die blitse.

kjv_text: He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, and indignation, and trouble, by sending evil angels among them.
bsb_text: He unleashed His fury against them, wrath, indignation, and calamity—a band of destroying angels.
aov_text: Hy het die gloed van sy toorn onder hulle gestuur, grimmigheid en woede en benoudheid, ’n uitsending van ongeluksbodes.

kjv_text: He made a way to his anger; he spared not their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence;
bsb_text: He cleared a path for His anger; He did not spare them from death but delivered their lives to the plague.
aov_text: Hy het ’n pad vir sy toorn gebaan, hulle siel nie gered van die dood nie, maar hulle lewe aan die pes oorgegee.

kjv_text: And smote all the firstborn in Egypt; the chief of their strength in the tabernacles of Ham:
bsb_text: He struck all the firstborn of Egypt, the virility in the tents of Ham.
aov_text: En Hy het al die eersgeborenes in Egipte getref, die eerstelinge van hul krag in die tente van Gam.

kjv_text: But made his own people to go forth like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
bsb_text: He led out His people like sheep and guided them like a flock in the wilderness.
aov_text: Maar Hy het sy volk laat wegtrek soos skape en hulle gelei soos ’n kudde in die woestyn.

kjv_text: And he led them on safely, so that they feared not: but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
bsb_text: He led them safely, so they did not fear, but the sea engulfed their enemies.
aov_text: Ja, Hy het hulle veilig gelei, sodat hulle nie gevrees het nie; maar die see het hulle vyande oordek.

kjv_text: And he brought them to the border of his sanctuary, even to this mountain, which his right hand had purchased.
bsb_text: He brought them to His holy land, to the mountain His right hand had acquired.
aov_text: En Hy het hulle gebring na sy heilige grondgebied, na die bergland wat sy regterhand verwerf het.

kjv_text: He cast out the heathen also before them, and divided them an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.
bsb_text: He drove out nations before them and apportioned their inheritance; He settled the tribes of Israel in their tents.
aov_text: En Hy het nasies voor hulle uit verdrywe en dié aan hulle as afgemete erfdeel laat val, en Hy het die stamme van Israel in húlle tente laat woon.

kjv_text: Yet they tempted and provoked the most high God, and kept not his testimonies:
bsb_text: But they tested and disobeyed God Most High, for they did not keep His decrees.
aov_text: Maar hulle het Hom versoek en was wederstrewig teen God, die Allerhoogste, en hulle het sy getuienisse nie onderhou nie.

kjv_text: But turned back, and dealt unfaithfully like their fathers: they were turned aside like a deceitful bow.
bsb_text: They turned back and were faithless like their fathers, twisted like a faulty bow.
aov_text: En hulle was afvallig en het troueloos gehandel soos hul vaders; hulle het omgedraai soos ’n bedrieglike boog.

kjv_text: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their graven images.
bsb_text: They enraged Him with their high places and provoked His jealousy with their idols.
aov_text: En hulle het Hom geterg deur hul hoogtes en deur hul gesnede beelde sy jaloersheid gewek.

kjv_text: When God heard this, he was wroth, and greatly abhorred Israel:
bsb_text: On hearing it, God was furious and rejected Israel completely.
aov_text: God het dit gehoor en toornig geword, en Hy het Israel heeltemal verwerp.

kjv_text: So that he forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men;
bsb_text: He abandoned the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent He had pitched among men.
aov_text: En Hy het die tabernakel in Silo prysgegee, die tent wat Hy opgeslaan het onder die mense.

kjv_text: And delivered his strength into captivity, and his glory into the enemy's hand.
bsb_text: He delivered His strength to captivity, and His splendor to the hand of the adversary.
aov_text: En Hy het sy sterkte oorgegee in gevangenskap en sy heerlikheid in die hand van die teëstander.

kjv_text: He gave his people over also unto the sword; and was wroth with his inheritance.
bsb_text: He surrendered His people to the sword because He was enraged by His heritage.
aov_text: En Hy het sy volk oorgelewer aan die swaard en toornig geword op sy erfdeel.

kjv_text: The fire consumed their young men; and their maidens were not given to marriage.
bsb_text: Fire consumed His young men, and their maidens were left without wedding songs.
aov_text: Die vuur het hulle jongmanne verteer, en hulle jongedogters is nie geprys nie.

kjv_text: Their priests fell by the sword; and their widows made no lamentation.
bsb_text: His priests fell by the sword, but their widows could not lament.
aov_text: Hulle priesters het deur die swaard geval, en hulle weduwees het nie geween nie.

kjv_text: Then the LORD awaked as one out of sleep, and like a mighty man that shouteth by reason of wine.
bsb_text: Then the Lord awoke as from sleep, like a mighty warrior overcome by wine.
aov_text: Toe het die Here wakker geword soos een wat slaap, soos ’n held wat oorweldig is deur die wyn;

kjv_text: And he smote his enemies in the hinder parts: he put them to a perpetual reproach.
bsb_text: He beat back His foes; He put them to everlasting shame.
aov_text: en Hy het sy teëstanders van agter geslaan, Hy het hulle ’n ewige smaadheid aangedoen.

kjv_text: Moreover he refused the tabernacle of Joseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim:
bsb_text: He rejected the tent of Joseph and refused the tribe of Ephraim.
aov_text: En Hy het die tent van Josef verwerp, en die stam van Efraim het Hy nie uitverkies nie,

kjv_text: But chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which he loved.
bsb_text: But He chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion, which He loved.
aov_text: maar die stam van Juda uitverkies, die berg Sion wat Hy liefhet.

kjv_text: And he built his sanctuary like high palaces, like the earth which he hath established for ever.
bsb_text: He built His sanctuary like the heights, like the earth He has established forever.
aov_text: En Hy het sy heiligdom soos hemelhoogtes gebou, soos die aarde wat hy vir ewig gegrondves het.

kjv_text: He chose David also his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds:
bsb_text: He chose David His servant and took him from the sheepfolds;
aov_text: En Hy het sy kneg Dawid uitverkies en hom van die skaapkrale af geneem.

kjv_text: From following the ewes great with young he brought him to feed Jacob his people, and Israel his inheritance.
bsb_text: from tending the ewes He brought him to be shepherd of His people Jacob, of Israel His inheritance.
aov_text: Agter die lammerooie het Hy hom gaan weghaal, om Jakob, sy volk, op te pas en Israel, sy erfdeel.

kjv_text: So he fed them according to the integrity of his heart; and guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.
bsb_text: So David shepherded them with integrity of heart and guided them with skillful hands.
aov_text: En hy het hulle opgepas na die opregtheid van sy hart en hulle gelei met die verstandige oorleg van sy hande.

kjv_text: A Psalm of Asaph. O GOD, the heathen are come into thine inheritance; thy holy temple have they defiled; they have laid Jerusalem on heaps.
bsb_text: A Psalm of Asaph. The nations, O God, have invaded Your inheritance; they have defiled Your holy temple and reduced Jerusalem to rubble.
aov_text: ’N PSALM van Asaf. o God, heidene het gekom in u erfdeel, hulle het u heilige tempel verontreinig, Jerusalem tot puinhope gemaak.

kjv_text: The dead bodies of thy servants have they given to be meat unto the fowls of the heaven, the flesh of thy saints unto the beasts of the earth.
bsb_text: They have given the corpses of Your servants as food to the birds of the air, the flesh of Your saints to the beasts of the earth.
aov_text: Hulle het die lyke van u knegte aan die voëls van die hemel tot spys gegee, die vlees van u gunsgenote aan die wilde diere van die land.

kjv_text: Their blood have they shed like water round about Jerusalem; and there was none to bury them.
bsb_text: They have poured out their blood like water all around Jerusalem, and there is no one to bury the dead.
aov_text: Hulle het húlle bloed rondom Jerusalem soos water uitgegiet sonder dat iemand hulle begrawe.

kjv_text: We are become a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and derision to them that are round about us.
bsb_text: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, a scorn and derision to those around us.
aov_text: Ons het vir ons bure ’n smaad geword, ’n spot en beskimping vir die wat rondom ons is.

kjv_text: How long, LORD? wilt thou be angry for ever? shall thy jealousy burn like fire?
bsb_text: How long, O LORD? Will You be angry forever? Will Your jealousy burn like fire?
aov_text: Hoe lank, HERE, sal U vir ewig toornig wees, sal u ywer brand soos ’n vuur?

kjv_text: Pour out thy wrath upon the heathen that have not known thee, and upon the kingdoms that have not called upon thy name.
bsb_text: Pour out Your wrath on the nations that do not acknowledge You, on the kingdoms that refuse to call on Your name,
aov_text: Stort u grimmigheid uit oor die heidene wat U nie ken nie, en oor die koninkryke wat u Naam nie aanroep nie.

kjv_text: For they have devoured Jacob, and laid waste his dwelling place.
bsb_text: for they have devoured Jacob and devastated his homeland.
aov_text: Want hulle het Jakob verteer en sy woning verwoes.

kjv_text: O remember not against us former iniquities: let thy tender mercies speedily prevent us: for we are brought very low.
bsb_text: Do not hold past sins against us; let Your compassion come quickly, for we are brought low.
aov_text: Reken ons die ongeregtighede van die voorvaders nie toe nie; laat u barmhartighede ons gou tegemoetkom, want ons is baie swak.

kjv_text: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of thy name: and deliver us, and purge away our sins, for thy name's sake.
bsb_text: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of Your name; deliver us and atone for our sins, for the sake of Your name.
aov_text: Help ons, o God van ons heil, om die eer van u Naam, en red ons en doen versoening oor ons sondes ter wille van u Naam.

kjv_text: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is their God? let him be known among the heathen in our sight by the revenging of the blood of thy servants which is shed.
bsb_text: Why should the nations ask, “Where is their God?” Before our eyes, make known among the nations Your vengeance for the bloodshed of Your servants.
aov_text: Waarom sou die heidene sê: Waar is hulle God? Laat voor ons oë onder die heidene bekend word die wraak oor die vergote bloed van u knegte.

kjv_text: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before thee; according to the greatness of thy power preserve thou those that are appointed to die;
bsb_text: May the groans of the captives reach You; by the strength of Your arm preserve those condemned to death.
aov_text: Laat die gesug van die gevangene voor u aangesig kom; laat die kinders van die dood oorbly na die grootheid van u arm.

kjv_text: And render unto our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom their reproach, wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord.
bsb_text: Pay back into the laps of our neighbors sevenfold the reproach they hurled at You, O Lord.
aov_text: En vergeld ons bure sewevoudig in hulle skoot die smaad waarmee hulle U, o Here, gesmaad het.

kjv_text: So we thy people and sheep of thy pasture will give thee thanks for ever: we will shew forth thy praise to all generations.
bsb_text: Then we Your people, the sheep of Your pasture, will thank You forever; from generation to generation we will declare Your praise.
aov_text: En ons, u volk en die skape van u weide, ons sal U vir ewig loof, van geslag tot geslag sal ons u lof vertel.

kjv_text: To the chief Musician upon Shoshannimeduth, A Psalm of Asaph.
bsb_text: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “The Lilies of the Covenant.” A Psalm of Asaph.
aov_text: VIR die musiekleier; op die wysie van: „Lelies.” ’n Getuienis. Van Asaf. ’n Psalm.

kjv_text: Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; thou that dwellest between the cherubims, shine forth.
bsb_text: Hear us, O Shepherd of Israel, who leads Joseph like a flock; You who sit enthroned between the cherubim, shine forth
aov_text: o Herder van Israel, hoor tog; U wat Josef soos skape lei, wat bo-oor die gérubs troon, verskyn in ligglans!

kjv_text: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh stir up thy strength, and come and save us.
bsb_text: before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh. Rally Your mighty power and come to save us.
aov_text: Wek u mag op voor Efraim en Benjamin en Manasse, en kom ons te hulp!

kjv_text: Turn us again, O God, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
bsb_text: Restore us, O God, and cause Your face to shine upon us, that we may be saved.
aov_text: o God, herstel ons, en laat u aangesig skyn, sodat ons verlos kan word!

kjv_text: O LORD God of hosts, how long wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy people?
bsb_text: O LORD God of Hosts, how long will Your anger smolder against the prayers of Your people?
aov_text: o HERE, God van die leërskare, hoe lank nog rook u toorn by die gebed van u volk?

kjv_text: Thou feedest them with the bread of tears; and givest them tears to drink in great measure.
bsb_text: You fed them with the bread of tears and made them drink the full measure of their tears.
aov_text: U het hulle tranebrood laat eet, hulle oorvloedig trane laat drink.

kjv_text: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbours: and our enemies laugh among themselves.
bsb_text: You make us contend with our neighbors; our enemies mock us.
aov_text: U het ons ’n voorwerp van stryd gemaak vir ons bure, en ons vyande drywe die spot.

kjv_text: Turn us again, O God of hosts, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
bsb_text: Restore us, O God of Hosts, and cause Your face to shine upon us, that we may be saved.
aov_text: o God van die leërskare, herstel ons, en laat u aangesig skyn, sodat ons verlos kan word!

kjv_text: Thou hast brought a vine out of Egypt: thou hast cast out the heathen, and planted it.
bsb_text: You uprooted a vine from Egypt; You drove out the nations and transplanted it.
aov_text: ’n Wingerdstok het U uitgetrek uit Egipte; U het die nasies uitgedrywe en hom geplant.

kjv_text: Thou preparedst room before it, and didst cause it to take deep root, and it filled the land.
bsb_text: You cleared the ground for it, and it took root and filled the land.
aov_text: U het voor hom plek gemaak, en hy het wortels geskiet en die land vervul.

kjv_text: The hills were covered with the shadow of it, and the boughs thereof were like the goodly cedars.
bsb_text: The mountains were covered by its shade, and the mighty cedars with its branches.
aov_text: Die berge was oordek met sy skaduwee, en met sy ranke die seders van God.

kjv_text: She sent out her boughs unto the sea, and her branches unto the river.
bsb_text: It sent out its branches to the Sea, and its shoots toward the River.
aov_text: Hy het sy ranke uitgebrei tot by die see en sy lote na die Rivier toe.

kjv_text: Why hast thou then broken down her hedges, so that all they which pass by the way do pluck her?
bsb_text: Why have You broken down its walls, so that all who pass by pick its fruit?
aov_text: Waarom het U sy mure stukkend gebreek, sodat almal wat met die pad verbygaan, hom kaalpluk?

kjv_text: The boar out of the wood doth waste it, and the wild beast of the field doth devour it.
bsb_text: The boar from the forest ravages it, and the creatures of the field feed upon it.
aov_text: Die wildevark uit die bos eet hom op, en wat roer op die veld, wei hom af.

kjv_text: Return, we beseech thee, O God of hosts: look down from heaven, and behold, and visit this vine;
bsb_text: Return, O God of Hosts, we pray! Look down from heaven and see! Attend to this vine—
aov_text: o God van die leërskare, kom tog terug; aanskou uit die hemel en kyk, en gee ag op hierdie wingerdstok;

kjv_text: And the vineyard which thy right hand hath planted, and the branch that thou madest strong for thyself.
bsb_text: the root Your right hand has planted, the son You have raised up for Yourself.
aov_text: en wees ’n beskerming vir wat u regterhand geplant het, en oor die seun wat U vir uself grootgemaak het.

kjv_text: It is burned with fire, it is cut down: they perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.
bsb_text: Your vine has been cut down and burned; they perish at the rebuke of Your countenance.
aov_text: Hy is met vuur verbrand, hy is afgekap; vanweë die dreiging van u aangesig kom hulle om.

kjv_text: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, upon the son of man whom thou madest strong for thyself.
bsb_text: Let Your hand be upon the man at Your right hand, on the son of man You have raised up for Yourself.
aov_text: Laat u hand wees oor die man van u regterhand, oor die menseseun wat U vir Uself grootgemaak het.

kjv_text: So will not we go back from thee: quicken us, and we will call upon thy name.
bsb_text: Then we will not turn away from You; revive us, and we will call on Your name.
aov_text: Dan sal ons nie van U afwyk nie; hou ons in die lewe, dan sal ons u Naam aanroep.

kjv_text: Turn us again, O LORD God of hosts, cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
bsb_text: Restore us, O LORD God of Hosts; cause Your face to shine upon us, that we may be saved.
aov_text: o HERE, God van die leërskare, herstel ons; laat u aangesig skyn, sodat ons verlos kan word!

kjv_text: To the chief Musician upon Gittith, A Psalm of Asaph.
bsb_text: For the choirmaster. According to Gittith. Of Asaph.
aov_text: VIR die musiekleier; op die Gittiet. ’n Psalm van Asaf.

kjv_text: Sing aloud unto God our strength: make a joyful noise unto the God of Jacob.
bsb_text: Sing for joy to God our strength; make a joyful noise to the God of Jacob.
aov_text: Jubel tot eer van God, ons sterkte! Juig tot eer van die God van Jakob!

kjv_text: Take a psalm, and bring hither the timbrel, the pleasant harp with the psaltery.
bsb_text: Lift up a song, strike the tambourine, play the sweet-sounding harp and lyre.
aov_text: Hef aan ’n lied en laat die tamboeryn klink, die lieflike siter saam met die harp.

kjv_text: Blow up the trumpet in the new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day.
bsb_text: Sound the ram’s horn at the New Moon, and at the full moon on the day of our Feast.
aov_text: Blaas die basuin op nuwemaan, op volmaan vir ons feesdag.

kjv_text: For this was a statute for Israel, and a law of the God of Jacob.
bsb_text: For this is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.
aov_text: Want dit is ’n insetting vir Israel, ’n verordening van die God van Jakob.

kjv_text: This he ordained in Joseph for a testimony, when he went out through the land of Egypt: where I heard a language that I understood not.
bsb_text: He ordained it as a testimony for Joseph when he went out over the land of Egypt, where I heard an unfamiliar language:
aov_text: Hy het dit ingestel as getuienis in Josef toe Hy uitgetrek het teen Egipteland. ’n Taal wat ek nie geken het nie, het ek gehoor:

kjv_text: I removed his shoulder from the burden: his hands were delivered from the pots.
bsb_text: “I relieved his shoulder of the burden; his hands were freed from the basket.
aov_text: Ek het sy skouer bevry van die las, sy hande het die mandjie gelos.

kjv_text: Thou calledst in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder: I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. Selah.
bsb_text: You called out in distress, and I rescued you; I answered you from the cloud of thunder; I tested you at the waters of Meribah. Selah
aov_text: In die nood het jy geroep, en Ek het jou uitgered; Ek het jou geantwoord in die skuilplek van die donder; Ek het jou getoets by die waters van Mériba. Sela.

kjv_text: Hear, O my people, and I will testify unto thee: O Israel, if thou wilt hearken unto me;
bsb_text: Hear, O My people, and I will warn you: O Israel, if only you would listen to Me!
aov_text: Hoor, my volk, en Ek wil jou dit inskerp; Israel, as jy tog na My wou luister!

kjv_text: There shall no strange god be in thee; neither shalt thou worship any strange god.
bsb_text: There must be no strange god among you, nor shall you bow to a foreign god.
aov_text: Daar mag by jou geen vreemde god wees nie, en voor ’n uitlandse god mag jy jou nie neerbuig nie.

kjv_text: I am the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.
bsb_text: I am the LORD your God, who brought you up out of Egypt. Open wide your mouth, and I will fill it.
aov_text: Ek is die HERE jou God wat jou laat optrek het uit Egipteland; maak jou mond wyd oop, dat Ek dit kan vul.

kjv_text: But my people would not hearken to my voice; and Israel would none of me.
bsb_text: But My people would not listen to Me, and Israel would not obey Me.
aov_text: Maar my volk het na my stem nie geluister nie, en Israel was vir My nie gewillig nie.

kjv_text: So I gave them up unto their own hearts' lust: and they walked in their own counsels.
bsb_text: So I gave them up to their stubborn hearts to follow their own devices.
aov_text: Toe het Ek hulle oorgegee aan die verhardheid van hul hart, dat hulle in hul eie planne kon wandel.

kjv_text: Oh that my people had hearkened unto me, and Israel had walked in my ways!
bsb_text: If only My people would listen to Me, if Israel would follow My ways,
aov_text: Ag, as my volk maar na My wou luister, Israel in my weë wou wandel!

kjv_text: I should soon have subdued their enemies, and turned my hand against their adversaries.
bsb_text: how soon I would subdue their enemies and turn My hand against their foes!
aov_text: Gou sou Ek hul vyande onderwerp en my hand teen hul teëstanders uitstrek.

kjv_text: The haters of the LORD should have submitted themselves unto him: but their time should have endured for ever.
bsb_text: Those who hate the LORD would feign obedience, and their doom would last forever.
aov_text: Die haters van die HERE sou kruipende na Hom toe kom; maar húlle tyd sou vir ewig wees.

kjv_text: He should have fed them also with the finest of the wheat: and with honey out of the rock should I have satisfied thee.
bsb_text: But I would feed you the finest wheat; with honey from the rock I would satisfy you.”
aov_text: Ja, Hy sou hulle voed met die beste van die koring; en met heuning uit die rots sou Ek jou versadig.

kjv_text: A Psalm of Asaph. God standeth in the congregation of the mighty; he judgeth among the gods.
bsb_text: A Psalm of Asaph. God presides in the divine assembly; He renders judgment among the gods:
aov_text: ’N PSALM van Asaf. God staan in die vergadering van die gode; Hy hou gerig te midde van die gode.

kjv_text: How long will ye judge unjustly, and accept the persons of the wicked? Selah.
bsb_text: “How long will you judge unjustly and show partiality to the wicked? Selah
aov_text: Hoe lank sal julle onregverdig oordeel en partydig wees vir die goddelose mense? Sela.

kjv_text: Defend the poor and fatherless: do justice to the afflicted and needy.
bsb_text: Defend the cause of the weak and fatherless; uphold the rights of the afflicted and oppressed.
aov_text: Doen reg aan die swakke en die wees; gee aan die ellendige en die arme sy reg.

kjv_text: Deliver the poor and needy: rid them out of the hand of the wicked.
bsb_text: Rescue the weak and needy; save them from the hand of the wicked.
aov_text: Red die swakke en behoeftige, bevry hulle uit die hand van die goddelose mense.

kjv_text: They know not, neither will they understand; they walk on in darkness: all the foundations of the earth are out of course.
bsb_text: They do not know or understand; they wander in the darkness; all the foundations of the earth are shaken.
aov_text: Hulle weet nie en verstaan nie; hulle loop rond in duisternis: al die fondamente van die aarde wankel.

kjv_text: I have said, Ye are gods; and all of you are children of the most High.
bsb_text: I have said, ‘You are gods; you are all sons of the Most High.’
aov_text: Ek self het gesê: Julle is gode, en julle is almal seuns van die Allerhoogste —

kjv_text: But ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.
bsb_text: But like mortals you will die, and like rulers you will fall.”
aov_text: nogtans sal julle sterwe soos mense, en soos een van die vorste sal julle val.

kjv_text: Arise, O God, judge the earth: for thou shalt inherit all nations.
bsb_text: Arise, O God, judge the earth, for all the nations are Your inheritance.
aov_text: Staan op, o God, oordeel die aarde! Want Ú het erfbesit van al die nasies.

kjv_text: A Song [or] Psalm of Asaph.
bsb_text: A song. A Psalm of Asaph.
aov_text: ’N LIED. ’n Psalm van Asaf.

kjv_text: Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.
bsb_text: O God, be not silent; be not speechless; be not still, O God.
aov_text: o God, hou U nie stil nie, swyg nie en rus nie, o God!

kjv_text: For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.
bsb_text: See how Your enemies rage, how Your foes have reared their heads.
aov_text: Want kyk, u vyande maak rumoer, en u haters steek die hoof op.

kjv_text: They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.
bsb_text: With cunning they scheme against Your people and conspire against those You cherish,
aov_text: Teen u volk smee hulle listig ’n plan en hou onder mekaar raad teen u verborgenes.

kjv_text: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.
bsb_text: saying, “Come, let us erase them as a nation; may the name of Israel be remembered no more.”
aov_text: Hulle sê: Kom, laat ons hulle vernietig, dat hulle geen volk meer is nie, sodat aan die naam van Israel nie meer gedink word nie.

kjv_text: For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against thee:
bsb_text: For with one mind they plot together, they form an alliance against You—
aov_text: Want hulle het van harte saam raad gehou; teen U sluit hulle ’n verbond:

kjv_text: The tabernacles of Edom, and the Ishmaelites; of Moab, and the Hagarenes;
bsb_text: the tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites, of Moab and the Hagrites,
aov_text: die tente van Edom en die Ismaeliete, Moab en die Hagareners,

kjv_text: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; the Philistines with the inhabitants of Tyre;
bsb_text: of Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek, of Philistia with the people of Tyre.
aov_text: Gebal en Ammon, en Ámalek, Filistéa saam met die inwoners van Tirus.

kjv_text: Assur also is joined with them: they have holpen the children of Lot. Selah.
bsb_text: Even Assyria has joined them, lending strength to the sons of Lot. Selah
aov_text: Ook het Assur by hulle aangesluit; hulle is ’n arm vir die kinders van Lot. Sela.

kjv_text: Do unto them as unto the Midianites; as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the brook of Kison:
bsb_text: Do to them as You did to Midian, as to Sisera and Jabin at the River Kishon,
aov_text: Maak met hulle soos met Mídian, soos met Sísera, soos met Jabin by die spruit Kison:

kjv_text: Which perished at Endor: they became as dung for the earth.
bsb_text: who perished at Endor and became like dung on the ground.
aov_text: hulle is verdelg by Endor, hulle het mis geword vir die grond.

kjv_text: Make their nobles like Oreb, and like Zeeb: yea, all their princes as Zebah, and as Zalmunna:
bsb_text: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, and all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,
aov_text: Maak hulle, hul edeles, soos Oreb en Seëb, en al hulle vorste soos Seba en Salmúna,

kjv_text: Who said, Let us take to ourselves the houses of God in possession.
bsb_text: who said, “Let us possess for ourselves the pastures of God.”
aov_text: wat sê: Laat ons die woninge van God vir ons in besit neem!

kjv_text: O my God, make them like a wheel; as the stubble before the wind.
bsb_text: Make them like tumbleweed, O my God, like chaff before the wind.
aov_text: My God, maak hulle soos strooi, soos stoppels voor die wind.

kjv_text: As the fire burneth a wood, and as the flame setteth the mountains on fire;
bsb_text: As fire consumes a forest, as a flame sets the mountains ablaze,
aov_text: Soos vuur wat ’n bos verbrand, en soos die vlam wat berge aan die brand steek —

kjv_text: So persecute them with thy tempest, and make them afraid with thy storm.
bsb_text: so pursue them with Your tempest, and terrify them with Your storm.
aov_text: vervolg hulle só met u storm en verskrik hulle met u stormwind.

kjv_text: Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek thy name, O LORD.
bsb_text: Cover their faces with shame, that they may seek Your name, O LORD.
aov_text: Oordek hulle aangesig met skande, dat hulle u Naam kan soek, o HERE!

kjv_text: Let them be confounded and troubled for ever; yea, let them be put to shame, and perish:
bsb_text: May they be ever ashamed and terrified; may they perish in disgrace.
aov_text: Laat hulle beskaamd staan en verskrik wees vir ewig, en laat hulle rooi van skaamte word en omkom;

kjv_text: That men may know that thou, whose name alone is JEHOVAH, art the most high over all the earth.
bsb_text: May they know that You alone, whose name is the LORD, are Most High over all the earth.
aov_text: sodat hulle kan weet dat U, wie se Naam HERE is, alleen die Allerhoogste is oor die hele aarde.

kjv_text: To the chief Musician upon Gittith, A Psalm for the sons of Korah.
bsb_text: For the choirmaster. According to Gittith. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.
aov_text: VIR die musiekleier; op die Gittiet. Van die kinders van Korag. ’n Psalm.

kjv_text: How amiable are thy tabernacles, O LORD of hosts!
bsb_text: How lovely is Your dwelling place, O LORD of Hosts!
aov_text: Hoe lieflik is u woninge, o HERE van die leërskare!

kjv_text: My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth for the courts of the LORD: my heart and my flesh crieth out for the living God.
bsb_text: My soul longs, even faints, for the courts of the LORD; my heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.
aov_text: My siel verlang, ja, smag na die voorhowe van die HERE; my hart en my vlees jubel uit tot die lewende God.

kjv_text: Yea, the sparrow hath found an house, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young, even thine altars, O LORD of hosts, my King, and my God.
bsb_text: Even the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she places her young near Your altars, O LORD of Hosts, my King and my God.
aov_text: Selfs vind die mossie ’n huis en die swaweltjie ’n nes vir haar, waar sy haar kleintjies neerlê, naamlik u altare, HERE van die leërskare, my Koning en my God!

kjv_text: Blessed are they that dwell in thy house: they will be still praising thee. Selah.
bsb_text: How blessed are those who dwell in Your house! They are ever praising You. Selah

bsb_text: I have found My servant David; with My sacred oil I have anointed him.
aov_text: Ek het Dawid, my kneg, gevind, met my heilige olie hom gesalf,

kjv_text: With whom my hand shall be established: mine arm also shall strengthen him.
bsb_text: My hand will sustain him; surely My arm will strengthen him.
aov_text: met wie my hand bestendig sal wees; ook sal my arm hom versterk.

kjv_text: The enemy shall not exact upon him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him.
bsb_text: No enemy will exact tribute; no wicked man will oppress him.
aov_text: Die vyand sal hom nie oorval en die kwaaddoener hom nie verdruk nie;

kjv_text: And I will beat down his foes before his face, and plague them that hate him.
bsb_text: I will crush his foes before him and strike down those who hate him.
aov_text: maar Ek sal sy teëstanders voor hom weg verpletter; en die wat hom haat, sal Ek verslaan.

kjv_text: But my faithfulness and my mercy shall be with him: and in my name shall his horn be exalted.
bsb_text: My faithfulness and loving devotion will be with him, and through My name his horn will be exalted.
aov_text: En my trou en my goedertierenheid sal met hom wees, en deur my Naam sal sy horing verhef word.

kjv_text: I will set his hand also in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.
bsb_text: I will set his hand over the sea, and his right hand upon the rivers.
aov_text: En Ek sal sy hand lê op die see en sy regterhand op die riviere.

kjv_text: He shall cry unto me, Thou art my father, my God, and the rock of my salvation.
bsb_text: He will call to Me, ‘You are my Father, my God, the Rock of my salvation.’
aov_text: Hy is dit wat My sal noem: U is my Vader, my God en die rots van my heil!

kjv_text: Also I will make him my firstborn, higher than the kings of the earth.
bsb_text: I will indeed appoint him as My firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.
aov_text: Ja, Ék sal hom ’n eersgeborene maak, die hoogste onder die konings van die aarde.

kjv_text: My mercy will I keep for him for evermore, and my covenant shall stand fast with him.
bsb_text: I will forever preserve My loving devotion for him, and My covenant with him will stand fast.
aov_text: Vir ewig sal Ek my goedertierenheid vir hom bewaar, en my verbond bly vir hom vas.

kjv_text: His seed also will I make to endure for ever, and his throne as the days of heaven.
bsb_text: I will establish his line forever, his throne as long as the heavens endure.
aov_text: En Ek sal sy nageslag vir ewig laat duur en sy troon soos die dae van die hemel.

kjv_text: If his children forsake my law, and walk not in my judgments;
bsb_text: If his sons forsake My law and do not walk in My judgments,
aov_text: As sy kinders my wet verlaat en in my regte nie wandel nie;

kjv_text: If they break my statutes, and keep not my commandments;
bsb_text: if they violate My statutes and fail to keep My commandments,
aov_text: as hulle my insettinge ontheilig en my gebooie nie hou nie,

kjv_text: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.
bsb_text: I will attend to their transgression with the rod, and to their iniquity with stripes.
aov_text: dan sal Ek hulle oortreding met die roede besoek en met plae hulle ongeregtigheid.

kjv_text: Nevertheless my loving-kindness will I not utterly take from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.
bsb_text: But I will not withdraw My loving devotion from him, nor ever betray My faithfulness.
aov_text: Maar my goedertierenheid sal Ek van hom nie wegneem en my trou nie verbreek nie.

kjv_text: My covenant will I not break, nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.
bsb_text: I will not violate My covenant or alter the utterance of My lips.
aov_text: Ek sal my verbond nie ontheilig nie, en wat oor my lippe gegaan het, sal Ek nie verander nie.

kjv_text: Once have I sworn by my holiness that I will not lie unto David.
bsb_text: Once and for all I have sworn by My holiness—I will not lie to David—
aov_text: Een maal het Ek gesweer by my heiligheid: Waarlik, Ek sal vir Dawid nie lieg nie!

kjv_text: His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne as the sun before me.
bsb_text: his offspring shall endure forever, and his throne before Me like the sun,
aov_text: Sy nageslag sal vir ewig wees en sy troon soos die son voor My.

kjv_text: It shall be established for ever as the moon, and as a faithful witness in heaven. Selah.
bsb_text: like the moon, established forever, a faithful witness in the sky.” Selah
aov_text: Soos die maan sal hy vir ewig vasstaan, en die getuie in die hemel is getrou. Sela.

kjv_text: But thou hast cast off and abhorred, thou hast been wroth with thine anointed.
bsb_text: Now, however, You have spurned and rejected him; You are enraged by Your anointed one.
aov_text: Maar U het self verstoot en verag, U het toornig geword teen u gesalfde.

kjv_text: Thou hast made void the covenant of thy servant: thou hast profaned his crown by casting it to the ground.
bsb_text: You have renounced the covenant with Your servant and sullied his crown in the dust.
aov_text: U het die verbond van u kneg tot niet gemaak, U het sy kroon ontheilig teen die grond.

kjv_text: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; thou hast brought his strong holds to ruin.
bsb_text: You have broken down all his walls; You have reduced his strongholds to rubble.
aov_text: U het al sy mure stukkend gebreek, sy vestings ’n puinhoop gemaak.

kjv_text: All that pass by the way spoil him: he is a reproach to his neighbours.
bsb_text: All who pass by plunder him; he has become a reproach to his neighbors.
aov_text: Almal wat met die pad verbygaan, het hom beroof; vir sy bure het hy ’n smaad geword.

kjv_text: Thou hast set up the right hand of his adversaries; thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.
bsb_text: You have exalted the right hand of his foes; You have made all his enemies rejoice.
aov_text: U het die regterhand van sy teëstanders verhef, al sy vyande bly gemaak.

kjv_text: Thou hast also turned the edge of his sword, and hast not made him to stand in the battle.
bsb_text: You have bent the edge of his sword and have not sustained him in battle.
aov_text: Ook het U die skerpte van sy swaard laat omdraai en hom nie laat standhou in die geveg nie.

kjv_text: Thou hast made his glory to cease, and cast his throne down to the ground.
bsb_text: You have ended his splendor and cast his throne to the ground.
aov_text: U het aan hom sy glans onttrek en sy troon teen die grond neergewerp.

kjv_text: The days of his youth hast thou shortened: thou hast covered him with shame. Selah.
bsb_text: You have cut short the days of his youth; You have covered him with shame. Selah
aov_text: U het die dae van sy jeug verkort, hom met skaamte oordek. Sela.

kjv_text: How long, LORD? wilt thou hide thyself for ever? shall thy wrath burn like fire?
bsb_text: How long, O LORD? Will You hide Yourself forever? Will Your wrath keep burning like fire?
aov_text: Hoe lank sal U, o HERE, Uself vir altyd verberg, sal u grimmigheid brand soos ’n vuur?

kjv_text: Remember how short my time is: wherefore hast thou made all men in vain?
bsb_text: Remember the briefness of my lifespan! For what futility You have created all men!
aov_text: Gedenk van watter lewensduur ek is, tot watter nietigheid U al die mensekinders geskape het!

kjv_text: What man is he that liveth, and shall not see death? shall he deliver his soul from the hand of the grave? Selah.
bsb_text: What man can live and never see death? Can he deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah
aov_text: Watter mens leef daar wat die dood nie sal sien nie, wat sy siel sal kan red uit die mag van die doderyk? Sela.

kjv_text: Lord, where are thy former loving-kindnesses, which thou swarest unto David in thy truth?
bsb_text: Where, O Lord, is Your loving devotion of old, which You faithfully swore to David?
aov_text: Here, waar is u vorige goedertierenhede wat U aan Dawid met ’n eed beloof het in u trou?

kjv_text: Remember, Lord, the reproach of thy servants; how I do bear in my bosom the reproach of all the mighty people;
bsb_text: Remember, O Lord, the reproach of Your servants, which I bear in my heart from so many people—
aov_text: Gedenk, Here, die smaad van u knegte, hoe ek in my boesem dra die smaad van al die baie volke,

kjv_text: Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O LORD; wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.
bsb_text: how Your enemies have taunted, O LORD, and have mocked every step of Your anointed one!
aov_text: waarmee u vyande, o HERE, smaad, waarmee hulle die voetstappe van u gesalfde smaad.

kjv_text: Blessed be the LORD for evermore. Amen, and Amen.
bsb_text: Blessed be the LORD forever! Amen and amen.
aov_text: Geloofd sy die HERE vir ewig! Amen, ja amen.

kjv_text: A Prayer of Moses the man of God. Lord, thou hast been our dwelling place in all generations.
bsb_text: A prayer of Moses the man of God. Lord, You have been our dwelling place through all generations.
aov_text: ’N GEBED van Moses, die man van God. Here, Ú was vir ons ’n toevlug van geslag tot geslag.

kjv_text: Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, thou art God.
bsb_text: Before the mountains were born or You brought forth the earth and the world, from everlasting to everlasting You are God.
aov_text: Voordat die berge gebore was en U die aarde en die wêreld voortgebring het, ja, van ewigheid tot ewigheid is U God.

kjv_text: Thou turnest man to destruction; and sayest, Return, ye children of men.
bsb_text: You return man to dust, saying, “Return, O sons of mortals.”
aov_text: U laat die mens terugkeer tot stof en sê: Keer terug, o mensekinders!

kjv_text: For a thousand years in thy sight are but as yesterday when it is past, and as a watch in the night.
bsb_text: For in Your sight a thousand years are but a day that passes, or a watch of the night.
aov_text: Want duisend jaar is in u oë soos die dag van gister as dit verbyskiet, en soos ’n nagwaak.

kjv_text: Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are as a sleep: in the morning they are like grass which groweth up.
bsb_text: You whisk them away in their sleep; they are like the new grass of the morning—
aov_text: Weggespoel het U hulle; hulle word ’n slaap; in die môre is hulle soos die gras wat weer uitspruit:

kjv_text: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; in the evening it is cut down, and withereth.
bsb_text: in the morning it springs up new, but by evening it fades and withers.
aov_text: in die môre bloei dit en spruit weer uit; in die aand sny ’n mens dit af, en dit verdor.

kjv_text: For we are consumed by thine anger, and by thy wrath are we troubled.
bsb_text: For we are consumed by Your anger and terrified by Your wrath.
aov_text: Want ons vergaan deur u toorn, en deur u grimmigheid word ons verskrik.

kjv_text: Thou hast set our iniquities before thee, our secret sins in the light of thy countenance.
bsb_text: You have set our iniquities before You, our secret sins in the light of Your presence.
aov_text: U stel ons ongeregtighede voor U, ons verborge sondes in die lig van u aangesig.

kjv_text: For all our days are passed away in thy wrath: we spend our years as a tale that is told.
bsb_text: For all our days decline in Your fury; we finish our years with a sigh.
aov_text: Want al ons dae gaan verby deur u grimmigheid, ons bring ons jare deur soos ’n gedagte.

kjv_text: The days of our years are threescore years and ten; and if by reason of strength they be fourscore years, yet is their strength labour and sorrow; for it is soon cut off, and we fly away.
bsb_text: The length of our days is seventy years—or eighty if we are strong—yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for they quickly pass, and we fly away.
aov_text: Die dae van ons jare—daarin is sewentig jaar, of as ons baie sterk is, tagtig jaar; en die uitnemendste daarvan is moeite en verdriet; want gou gaan dit verby, en ons vlieg daarheen.

kjv_text: Who knoweth the power of thine anger? even according to thy fear, so is thy wrath.
bsb_text: Who knows the power of Your anger? Your wrath matches the fear You are due.
aov_text: Wie ken die sterkte van u toorn en u grimmigheid, ooreenkomstig die vrees wat aan U verskuldig is?

kjv_text: So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.
bsb_text: So teach us to number our days, that we may present a heart of wisdom.
aov_text: Leer ons om ons dae so te tel dat ons ’n wyse hart mag bekom!

kjv_text: Return, O LORD, how long? and let it repent thee concerning thy servants.
bsb_text: Return, O LORD! How long will it be? Have compassion on Your servants.
aov_text: Keer terug, HERE! Tot hoe lank? En ontferm U oor u knegte.

kjv_text: O satisfy us early with thy mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
bsb_text: Satisfy us in the morning with Your loving devotion, that we may sing for joy and be glad all our days.
aov_text: Versadig ons in die môre met u goedertierenheid, sodat ons kan jubel en bly wees in al ons dae.

kjv_text: Make us glad according to the days wherein thou hast afflicted us, and the years wherein we have seen evil.
bsb_text: Make us glad for as many days as You have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.
aov_text: Maak ons bly na die dae waarin U ons verdruk het, na die jare waarin ons onheil gesien het.

kjv_text: Let thy work appear unto thy servants, and thy glory unto their children.
bsb_text: May Your work be shown to Your servants, and Your splendor to their children.
aov_text: Laat u werk vir u knegte sigbaar word en u heerlikheid oor hulle kinders.

kjv_text: And let the beauty of the LORD our God be upon us: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.
bsb_text: May the favor of the Lord our God rest upon us; establish for us the work of our hands—yes, establish the work of our hands!
aov_text: En laat die lieflikheid van die HERE onse God oor ons wees, en bevestig die werk van ons hande oor ons, ja, die werk van ons hande, bevestig dit!

kjv_text: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
bsb_text: He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the Almighty.
aov_text: HY wat in die skuilplek van die Allerhoogste sit, sal vernag in die skaduwee van die Almagtige.

kjv_text: I will say of the LORD, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.
bsb_text: I will say to the LORD, “You are my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust.”
aov_text: Ek sal tot die HERE sê: My toevlug en my bergvesting, my God op wie ek vertrou.

kjv_text: Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence.
bsb_text: Surely He will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly plague.
aov_text: Want Hy is dit wat jou sal red uit die net van die voëlvanger, van die verderflike pes.

kjv_text: He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.
bsb_text: He will cover you with His feathers; under His wings you will find refuge; His faithfulness is a shield and rampart.
aov_text: Hy sal jou dek met sy vlerke, en onder sy vleuels sal jy skuil; sy trou is ’n skild en pantser.

kjv_text: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day;
bsb_text: You will not fear the terror of the night, nor the arrow that flies by day,
aov_text: Jy hoef nie te vrees vir die skrik van die nag, vir die pyl wat bedags vlieg nie,

kjv_text: Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.
bsb_text: nor the pestilence that stalks in the darkness, nor the calamity that destroys at noon.
aov_text: vir die pes wat in die donker wandel, vir die siekte wat op die middag verwoes nie!

kjv_text: A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come nigh thee.
bsb_text: Though a thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand, no harm will come near you.
aov_text: Al val daar duisend aan jou sy en tienduisend aan jou regterhand—na jou sal dit nie aankom nie.

kjv_text: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked.
bsb_text: You will only see it with your eyes and witness the punishment of the wicked.
aov_text: Net met jou oë sal jy dit aanskou en die vergelding van die goddelose sien.

kjv_text: Because thou hast made the LORD, which is my refuge, even the most High, thy habitation;
bsb_text: Because you have made the LORD your dwelling—my refuge, the Most High—
aov_text: Want U, HERE, is my toevlug. Die Allerhoogste het jy jou beskutting gemaak.

kjv_text: There shall no evil befall thee, neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling.
bsb_text: no evil will befall you, no plague will approach your tent.
aov_text: Geen onheil sal jou tref en geen plaag naby jou tent kom nie;

kjv_text: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.
bsb_text: For He will command His angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways.
aov_text: want Hy sal sy engele aangaande jou bevel gee om jou te bewaar op al jou weë.

kjv_text: They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.
bsb_text: They will lift you up in their hands, so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.
aov_text: Hulle sal jou op die hande dra, sodat jy jou voet teen geen klip stamp nie.

kjv_text: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under feet.
bsb_text: You will tread on the lion and cobra; you will trample the young lion and serpent.
aov_text: Op die leeu en die adder sal jy trap, die jong leeu en die slang vertrap.

kjv_text: Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.
bsb_text: “Because he loves Me, I will deliver him; because he knows My name, I will protect him.
aov_text: Omdat hy My liefhet, sê God, daarom sal Ek hom red; Ek sal hom beskerm, omdat hy my Naam ken.

kjv_text: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him: I will be with him in trouble; I will deliver him, and honour him.
bsb_text: When he calls out to Me, I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him and honor him.
aov_text: Hy sal My aanroep, en Ek sal hom verhoor; in die nood sal Ek by hom wees; Ek sal hom uitred en eer aan hom gee.

kjv_text: With long life will I satisfy him, and shew him my salvation.
bsb_text: With long life I will satisfy him and show him My salvation.”
aov_text: Met lengte van dae sal Ek hom versadig, en Ek sal hom my heil laat sien.

kjv_text: A Psalm [or] Song for the sabbath day.
bsb_text: A Psalm. A song for the Sabbath day.
aov_text: ’N PSALM. ’n Lied vir die sabbatdag.

kjv_text: It is a good thing to give thanks unto the LORD, and to sing praises unto thy name, O most High:
bsb_text: It is good to praise the LORD, and to sing praises to Your name, O Most High,
aov_text: Dit is goed om die HERE te loof en tot eer van u Naam te psalmsing, o Allerhoogste,

kjv_text: To shew forth thy loving-kindness in the morning, and thy faithfulness every night,
bsb_text: to proclaim Your loving devotion in the morning and Your faithfulness at night
aov_text: om in die môre u goedertierenheid te verkondig en u getrouheid in die nagte;

kjv_text: Upon an instrument of ten strings, and upon the psaltery; upon the harp with a solemn sound.
bsb_text: with the ten-stringed harp and the melody of the lyre.
aov_text: by die tiensnarige instrument en by die harp, by snarespel op die siter.

kjv_text: For thou, LORD, hast made me glad through thy work: I will triumph in the works of thy hands.
bsb_text: For You, O LORD, have made me glad by Your deeds; I sing for joy at the works of Your hands.
aov_text: Want U het my bly gemaak, HERE, deur u dade; ek jubel oor die werke van u hande.

kjv_text: O LORD, how great are thy works! and thy thoughts are very deep.
bsb_text: How great are Your works, O LORD, how deep are Your thoughts!
aov_text: Hoe groot is u werke, o HERE; baie diep is u gedagtes!

kjv_text: A brutish man knoweth not; neither doth a fool understand this.
bsb_text: A senseless man does not know, and a fool does not understand,
aov_text: ’n Dom mens weet nie, en ’n dwaas verstaan dit nie:

kjv_text: When the wicked spring as the grass, and when all the workers of iniquity do flourish; it is that they shall be destroyed for ever:
bsb_text: that though the wicked sprout like grass, and all evildoers flourish, they will be forever destroyed.
aov_text: as die goddelose mense groei soos die plante en die werkers van ongeregtigheid bloei, is dit om hulle vir ewig te verdelg.

kjv_text: But thou, LORD, art most high for evermore.
bsb_text: But You, O LORD, are exalted forever!
aov_text: Maar U is hoog verhewe tot in ewigheid, HERE!

kjv_text: For, lo, thine enemies, O LORD, for, lo, thine enemies shall perish; all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.
bsb_text: For surely Your enemies, O LORD, surely Your enemies will perish; all evildoers will be scattered.
aov_text: Want kyk, u vyande, o HERE, want kyk, u vyande sal vergaan; al die werkers van ongeregtigheid sal verstrooi word.

kjv_text: But my horn shalt thou exalt like the horn of an unicorn: I shall be anointed with fresh oil.
bsb_text: But You have exalted my horn like that of a wild ox; with fine oil I have been anointed.
aov_text: Maar U verhoog my horing soos van ’n buffel; ek is met vars olie gesalf.

kjv_text: Mine eye also shall see my desire on mine enemies, and mine ears shall hear my desire of the wicked that rise up against me.
bsb_text: My eyes see the downfall of my enemies; my ears hear the wailing of my wicked foes.
aov_text: En my oog sien met welgevalle neer op die wat my voorlê, my ore hoor van die wat teen my as kwaaddoeners opstaan.

kjv_text: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree: he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
bsb_text: The righteous will flourish like a palm tree, and grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
aov_text: Die regverdige sal groei soos ’n palmboom; hy sal opgroei soos ’n seder op die Líbanon.

kjv_text: Those that be planted in the house of the LORD shall flourish in the courts of our God.
bsb_text: Planted in the house of the LORD, they will flourish in the courts of our God.
aov_text: Geplant in die huis van die HERE, sal hulle groei in die voorhowe van onse God.

kjv_text: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; they shall be fat and flourishing;
bsb_text: In old age they will still bear fruit; healthy and green they will remain,
aov_text: In die gryse ouderdom sal hulle nog vrugte dra, hulle sal vet en groen wees,

kjv_text: To shew that the LORD is upright: he is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
bsb_text: to proclaim, “The LORD is upright; He is my Rock, and in Him there is no unrighteousness.”
aov_text: om te verkondig dat die HERE reg is, my rots, en in Hom is geen onreg nie.

kjv_text: The LORD reigneth, he is clothed with majesty; the LORD is clothed with strength, wherewith he hath girded himself: the world also is stablished, that it cannot be moved.
bsb_text: The LORD reigns! He is robed in majesty; the LORD has clothed and armed Himself with strength. The world indeed is firmly established; it cannot be moved.
aov_text: DIE HERE is Koning; Hy is met hoogheid bekleed. Die HERE is bekleed, Hy het Hom met sterkte gegord. Ook staan die wêreld vas, sodat dit nie wankel nie.

kjv_text: Thy throne is established of old: thou art from everlasting.
bsb_text: Your throne was established long ago; You are from all eternity.
aov_text: Vas staan u troon van ouds af; van ewigheid af is U.

kjv_text: The floods have lifted up, O LORD, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their waves.
bsb_text: The floodwaters have risen, O LORD; the rivers have raised their voice; the seas lift up their pounding waves.
aov_text: Die riviere, o HERE, het verhef, die riviere het hulle gebruis verhef; die riviere verhef hulle geraas!

kjv_text: The LORD on high is mightier than the noise of many waters, yea, than the mighty waves of the sea.
bsb_text: Above the roar of many waters—the mighty breakers of the sea—the LORD on high is majestic.
aov_text: Meer as die gebruis van groot, geweldige waters, van die golwe van die see, is die HERE geweldig in die hoogte!

kjv_text: Thy testimonies are very sure: holiness becometh thine house, O LORD, for ever.
bsb_text: Your testimonies are fully confirmed; holiness adorns Your house, O LORD, for all the days to come.
aov_text: U getuienisse is baie betroubaar. Heiligheid pas by u huis, HERE, tot in lengte van dae!

kjv_text: O Lord God, to whom vengeance belongeth; O God, to whom vengeance belongeth, shew thyself.
bsb_text: O LORD, God of vengeance, O God of vengeance, shine forth.
aov_text: GOD van wraak, o HERE, God van wraak, verskyn in ligglans!

kjv_text: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: render a reward to the proud.
bsb_text: Rise up, O Judge of the earth; render a reward to the proud.
aov_text: Verhef U, o regter van die aarde, vergeld die trotsaards hulle dade!

kjv_text: LORD, how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked triumph?
bsb_text: How long will the wicked, O LORD, how long will the wicked exult?
