aov_text: Hy wat bedrog pleeg, mag binne-in my huis nie bly nie; wie leuens praat, kan voor my oë nie bestaan nie.

kjv_text: I will early destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all wicked doers from the city of the LORD.
bsb_text: Every morning I will remove all the wicked of the land, that I may cut off every evildoer from the city of the LORD.
aov_text: Elke môre sal ek al die goddelose van die land vernietig, om al die werkers van ongeregtigheid uit die stad van die HERE uit te roei.

kjv_text: A Prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed, and poureth out his complaint before the LORD.
bsb_text: A prayer of one who is afflicted, when he grows faint and pours out his lament before the LORD.
aov_text: ’N GEBED van ’n ellendige as hy beswyk en sy klagte uitstort voor die aangesig van die HERE.

kjv_text: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and let my cry come unto thee.
bsb_text: Hear my prayer, O LORD; let my cry for help come before You.
aov_text: o HERE, hoor my gebed, en laat my hulpgeroep tot by U kom!

kjv_text: Hide not thy face from me in the day when I am in trouble; incline thine ear unto me: in the day when I call answer me speedily.
bsb_text: Do not hide Your face from me in my day of distress. Incline Your ear to me; answer me quickly when I call.
aov_text: Verberg u aangesig nie vir my op die dag as ek in benoudheid is nie; neig u oor tot my; op die dag as ek roep, verhoor my gou!

kjv_text: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as an hearth.
bsb_text: For my days vanish like smoke, and my bones burn like glowing embers.
aov_text: Want my dae verdwyn soos rook en my gebeente gloei soos ’n vuurherd.

kjv_text: My heart is smitten, and withered like grass; so that I forget to eat my bread.
bsb_text: My heart is afflicted, and withered like grass; I even forget to eat my bread.
aov_text: Platgeslaan soos die plante en verdor is my hart; want ek vergeet om my brood te eet.

kjv_text: By reason of the voice of my groaning my bones cleave to my skin.
bsb_text: Through my loud groaning my flesh clings to my bones.
aov_text: Vanweë my harde gesug kleef my gebeente aan my vlees.

kjv_text: I am like a pelican of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the desert.
bsb_text: I am like a desert owl, like an owl among the ruins.
aov_text: Ek is soos ’n pelikaan van die woestyn, ek het geword soos ’n uil op die puinhope.

kjv_text: I watch, and am as a sparrow alone upon the house top.
bsb_text: I lie awake; I am like a lone bird on a housetop.
aov_text: Ek is slapeloos en het geword soos ’n eensame voël op die dak.

kjv_text: Mine enemies reproach me all the day; and they that are mad against me are sworn against me.
bsb_text: All day long my enemies taunt me; they ridicule me and curse me.
aov_text: Die hele dag smaad my vyande my; die wat teen my raas, gebruik my naam as ’n vloek.

kjv_text: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping,
bsb_text: For I have eaten ashes like bread and mixed my drink with tears
aov_text: Want ek eet as soos brood en meng my drank met trane,

kjv_text: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: for thou hast lifted me up, and cast me down.
bsb_text: because of Your indignation and wrath, for You have picked me up and cast me aside.
aov_text: vanweë u grimmigheid en u toorn; want U het my opgehef en my weggewerp.

kjv_text: My days are like a shadow that declineth; and I am withered like grass.
bsb_text: My days are like lengthening shadows, and I wither away like grass.
aov_text: My dae is soos ’n skaduwee wat lank geword het, en ek, soos die plante verdor ek.

kjv_text: But thou, O LORD, shalt endure for ever; and thy remembrance unto all generations.
bsb_text: But You, O LORD, sit enthroned forever; Your renown endures to all generations.
aov_text: Maar U, o HERE, U bly tot in ewigheid, en u gedenknaam van geslag tot geslag.

kjv_text: Thou shalt arise, and have mercy upon Zion: for the time to favour her, yea, the set time, is come.
bsb_text: You will rise up and have compassion on Zion, for it is time to show her favor—the appointed time has come.
aov_text: Ú sal opstaan, U oor Sion ontferm; want dit is tyd om hom genadig te wees, want die bestemde tyd het gekom.

kjv_text: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, and favour the dust thereof.
bsb_text: For Your servants delight in her stones and take pity on her dust.
aov_text: Want u knegte het sy klippe lief en het medelyde met sy puin.

kjv_text: So the heathen shall fear the name of the LORD, and all the kings of the earth thy glory.
bsb_text: So the nations will fear the name of the LORD, and all the kings of the earth will fear Your glory.
aov_text: Dan sal die heidene die Naam van die HERE vrees en al die konings van die aarde u heerlikheid;

kjv_text: When the LORD shall build up Zion, he shall appear in his glory.
bsb_text: For the LORD will rebuild Zion; He has appeared in His glory.
aov_text: omdat die HERE Sion opgebou het, in sy heerlikheid verskyn het,

kjv_text: He will regard the prayer of the destitute, and not despise their prayer.
bsb_text: He will turn toward the prayer of the destitute; He will not despise their prayer.
aov_text: Hom gewend het tot die gebed van wie ontbloot is, en hulle gebed nie verag het nie.

kjv_text: This shall be written for the generation to come: and the people which shall be created shall praise the LORD.
bsb_text: Let this be written for the generation to come, so that a people not yet created may praise the LORD.
aov_text: Dit sal vir die volgende geslag opgeskrywe word, en die volk wat geskape gaan word, sal die HERE loof;

kjv_text: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; from heaven did the LORD behold the earth;
bsb_text: For He looked down from the heights of His sanctuary; the LORD gazed out from heaven to earth
aov_text: omdat Hy van sy heilige hoogte neergesien het, die HERE uit die hemel op die aarde gelet het,

kjv_text: To hear the groaning of the prisoner; to loose those that are appointed to death;
bsb_text: to hear a prisoner’s groaning, to release those condemned to death,
aov_text: om die gekerm van die gevangene te hoor, om los te maak die kinders van die dood;

kjv_text: To declare the name of the LORD in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;
bsb_text: that they may proclaim the name of the LORD in Zion and praise Him in Jerusalem,
aov_text: sodat hulle in Sion die Naam van die HERE kan vermeld en sy lof in Jerusalem,

kjv_text: When the people are gathered together, and the kingdoms, to serve the LORD.
bsb_text: when peoples and kingdoms assemble to serve the LORD.
aov_text: as die volke almal saam vergader, ook die koninkryke om die HERE te dien.

kjv_text: He weakened my strength in the way; he shortened my days.
bsb_text: He has broken my strength on the way; He has cut short my days.
aov_text: Hy het my krag op die weg swak gemaak, my dae verkort.

kjv_text: I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: thy years are throughout all generations.
bsb_text: I say: “O my God, do not take me in the midst of my days! Your years go on through all generations.
aov_text: My God, sê ek, neem my nie weg in die helfte van my dae nie—u jare is van geslag tot geslag!

kjv_text: Of old hast thou laid the foundation of the earth: and the heavens are the work of thy hands.
bsb_text: In the beginning You laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of Your hands.
aov_text: In die voortyd het U die aarde gegrondves, en die hemele is die werk van u hande.

kjv_text: They shall perish, but thou shalt endure: yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; as a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed:
bsb_text: They will perish, but You remain; they will all wear out like a garment. Like clothing You will change them, and they will be passed on.
aov_text: Húlle sal vergaan, maar Ú sal bly; ja, hulle almal sal soos ’n kleed verslyt; U verwissel hulle soos ’n kledingstuk, en hulle verdwyn.

kjv_text: But thou art the same, and thy years shall have no end.
bsb_text: But You remain the same, and Your years will never end.
aov_text: Maar U bly dieselfde, en u jare het geen einde nie.

kjv_text: The children of thy servants shall continue, and their seed shall be established before thee.
bsb_text: The children of Your servants will dwell securely, and their descendants will be established before You.”
aov_text: Die kinders van u knegte sal woon, en hulle nageslag sal voor u aangesig bly bestaan.

kjv_text: [A Psalm] of David. Bless the LORD, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name.
bsb_text: Of David. Bless the LORD, O my soul; all that is within me, bless His holy name.
aov_text: ’N PSALM van Dawid. Loof die HERE, o my siel, en alles wat binne-in my is, sy heilige Naam!

kjv_text: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:
bsb_text: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and do not forget all His kind deeds—
aov_text: Loof die HERE, o my siel, en vergeet geeneen van sy weldade nie!

kjv_text: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases;
bsb_text: He who forgives all your iniquities and heals all your diseases,
aov_text: Wat al jou ongeregtigheid vergewe, wat al jou krankhede genees,

kjv_text: Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; who crowneth thee with loving-kindness and tender mercies;
bsb_text: who redeems your life from the Pit and crowns you with loving devotion and compassion,
aov_text: wat jou lewe verlos van die verderf, wat jou kroon met goedertierenheid en barmhartighede,

kjv_text: Who satisfieth thy mouth with good things; so that thy youth is renewed like the eagle's.
bsb_text: who satisfies you with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
aov_text: wat jou siel versadig met die goeie, sodat jou jeug weer nuut word soos dié van ’n arend.

kjv_text: The LORD executeth righteousness and judgment for all that are oppressed.
bsb_text: The LORD executes righteousness and justice for all the oppressed.
aov_text: Die HERE doen geregtigheid en reg aan almal wat verdruk word.

kjv_text: He made known his ways unto Moses, his acts unto the children of Israel.
bsb_text: He made known His ways to Moses, His deeds to the people of Israel.
aov_text: Hy het aan Moses sy weë bekend gemaak, aan die kinders van Israel sy dade.

kjv_text: The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy.
bsb_text: The LORD is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion.
aov_text: Barmhartig en genadig is die HERE, lankmoedig en groot van goedertierenheid.

kjv_text: He will not always chide: neither will he keep his anger for ever.
bsb_text: He will not always accuse us, nor harbor His anger forever.
aov_text: Hy sal nie vir altyd twis en nie vir ewig die toorn behou nie.

kjv_text: He hath not dealt with us after our sins; nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.
bsb_text: He has not dealt with us according to our sins or repaid us according to our iniquities.
aov_text: Hy handel met ons nie na ons sondes en vergeld ons nie na ons ongeregtighede nie.

kjv_text: For as the heaven is high above the earth, so great is his mercy toward them that fear him.
bsb_text: For as high as the heavens are above the earth, so great is His loving devotion for those who fear Him.
aov_text: Want so hoog as die hemel is bo die aarde, so geweldig is sy goedertierenheid oor die wat Hom vrees.

kjv_text: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.
bsb_text: As far as the east is from the west, so far has He removed our transgressions from us.
aov_text: So ver as die ooste verwyderd is van die weste, so ver verwyder Hy ons oortredinge van ons.

kjv_text: Like as a father pitieth his children, so the LORD pitieth them that fear him.
bsb_text: As a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear Him.
aov_text: Soos ’n vader hom ontferm oor die kinders, so ontferm die HERE Hom oor die wat Hom vrees.

kjv_text: For he knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we are dust.
bsb_text: For He knows our frame; He is mindful that we are dust.
aov_text: Want Hy, Hy weet watter maaksel ons is, gedagtig dat ons stof is.

kjv_text: As for man, his days are as grass: as a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.
bsb_text: As for man, his days are like grass—he blooms like a flower of the field;
aov_text: Die mens—soos die gras is sy dae; soos ’n blom van die veld, so bloei hy.

kjv_text: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; and the place thereof shall know it no more.
bsb_text: when the wind passes over, it vanishes, and its place remembers it no more.
aov_text: As die wind daaroor gaan, is dit nie meer nie en sy plek ken hom nie meer nie.

kjv_text: But the mercy of the LORD is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, and his righteousness unto children's children;
bsb_text: But from everlasting to everlasting the loving devotion of the LORD extends to those who fear Him, and His righteousness to their children’s children—
aov_text: Maar die goedertierenheid van die HERE is van ewigheid tot ewigheid oor die wat Hom vrees, en sy geregtigheid vir kindskinders,

kjv_text: To such as keep his covenant, and to those that remember his commandments to do them.
bsb_text: to those who keep His covenant and remember to obey His precepts.
aov_text: vir die wat sy verbond hou en aan sy bevele dink om dié te doen.

kjv_text: The LORD hath prepared his throne in the heavens; and his kingdom ruleth over all.
bsb_text: The LORD has established His throne in heaven, and His kingdom rules over all.
aov_text: Die HERE het sy troon in die hemel gevestig, en sy koninkryk heers oor alles.

kjv_text: Bless the LORD, ye his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word.
bsb_text: Bless the LORD, all His angels mighty in strength who carry out His word, who hearken to the voice of His command.
aov_text: Loof die HERE, sy engele, kragtige helde wat sy woord volbring, in gehoorsaamheid aan die stem van sy woord!

kjv_text: Bless ye the LORD, all ye his hosts; ye ministers of his, that do his pleasure.
bsb_text: Bless the LORD, all His hosts, you servants who do His will.
aov_text: Loof die HERE, al sy leërskare, sy dienaars wat sy welbehae doen!

kjv_text: Bless the LORD, all his works in all places of his dominion: bless the LORD, O my soul.
bsb_text: Bless the LORD, all His works in all places of His dominion. Bless the LORD, O my soul!
aov_text: Loof die HERE, al sy werke, op al die plekke van sy heerskappy! Loof die HERE, o my siel!

kjv_text: Bless the LORD, O my soul. O LORD my God, thou art very great; thou art clothed with honour and majesty.
bsb_text: Bless the LORD, O my soul! O LORD my God, You are very great; You are clothed with splendor and majesty.
aov_text: LOOF die HERE, o my siel! HERE my God, U is baie groot! Met majesteit en heerlikheid is U bekleed —

kjv_text: Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment: who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain:
bsb_text: He wraps Himself in light as with a garment; He stretches out the heavens like a tent,
aov_text: wat Uself omhul met die lig soos met ’n kleed, wat die hemel uitspan soos ’n tentdoek;

kjv_text: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters: who maketh the clouds his chariot: who walketh upon the wings of the wind:
bsb_text: laying the beams of His chambers in the waters above, making the clouds His chariot, walking on the wings of the wind.
aov_text: wat sy solders bou in die waters, wat van die wolke sy wa maak, wat op die vleuels van die wind wandel,

kjv_text: Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire:
bsb_text: He makes the winds His messengers, flames of fire His servants.
aov_text: wat van die winde sy boodskappers maak, van vuurvlamme sy dienaars.

kjv_text: Who laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be removed for ever.
bsb_text: He set the earth on its foundations, never to be moved.
aov_text: Hy het die aarde gegrond op sy grondveste, sodat dit vir ewig en altyd nie wankel nie.

kjv_text: Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a garment: the waters stood above the mountains.
bsb_text: You covered it with the deep like a garment; the waters stood above the mountains.
aov_text: U het dit met die wêreldvloed soos met ’n kleed oordek; die waters het bo-oor die berge gestaan.

kjv_text: At thy rebuke they fled; at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away.
bsb_text: At Your rebuke the waters fled; at the sound of Your thunder they hurried away—
aov_text: Vir u dreiging het hulle gevlug, vir die stem van u donder het hulle weggeskrik —

kjv_text: They go up by the mountains; they go down by the valleys unto the place which thou hast founded for them.
bsb_text: the mountains rose and the valleys sank to the place You assigned for them—
aov_text: berge het opgerys, laagtes het weggesak—na die plek wat U vir hulle reggemaak het.

kjv_text: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; that they turn not again to cover the earth.
bsb_text: You set a boundary they cannot cross, that they may never again cover the earth.
aov_text: ’n Grens het U gestel waar hulle nie oor mag gaan nie; hulle mag die aarde nie weer oordek nie.

kjv_text: He sendeth the springs into the valleys, which run among the hills.
bsb_text: He sends forth springs in the valleys; they flow between the mountains.
aov_text: Hy wat die fonteine uitstuur in die holtes: tussen die berge loop hulle deur.

kjv_text: They give drink to every beast of the field: the wild asses quench their thirst.
bsb_text: They give drink to every beast of the field; the wild donkeys quench their thirst.
aov_text: Hulle laat al die diere van die veld drink; die wilde-esels les hulle dors.

kjv_text: By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation, which sing among the branches.
bsb_text: The birds of the air nest beside the springs; they sing among the branches.
aov_text: By hulle woon die voëls van die hemel; tussen die takke uit laat hulle die stem hoor.

kjv_text: He watereth the hills from his chambers: the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works.
bsb_text: He waters the mountains from His chambers; the earth is satisfied by the fruit of His works.
aov_text: Hy laat die berge drink uit sy boonste kamers; die aarde word versadig uit die vrug van u werke.

kjv_text: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, and herb for the service of man: that he may bring forth food out of the earth;
bsb_text: He makes the grass grow for the livestock and provides crops for man to cultivate, bringing forth food from the earth:
aov_text: Hy laat gras uitspruit vir die diere en die plante tot diens van die mens: om broodkoring uit die aarde te laat voortkom,

kjv_text: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, and oil to make his face to shine, and bread which strengtheneth man's heart.
bsb_text: wine that gladdens the heart of man, oil that makes his face to shine, and bread that sustains his heart.
aov_text: en dat wyn die mens se hart kan bly maak; om die aangesig te laat blink van olie, en dat brood die mens se hart kan versterk.

kjv_text: The trees of the LORD are full of sap; the cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;
bsb_text: The trees of the LORD have their fill, the cedars of Lebanon that He planted,
aov_text: Die bome van die HERE word versadig, die seders van die Líbanon wat Hy geplant het;

kjv_text: Where the birds make their nests: as for the stork, the fir trees are her house.
bsb_text: where the birds build their nests; the stork makes her home in the cypresses.
aov_text: waar die voëls hulle neste maak, die ooievaar wie se huis die sipresse is.

kjv_text: The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats; and the rocks for the conies.
bsb_text: The high mountains are for the wild goats, the cliffs a refuge for the rock badgers.
aov_text: Die hoë berge is vir die steenbokke, die rotse is ’n skuilplek vir die dasse.

kjv_text: He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.
bsb_text: He made the moon to mark the seasons; the sun knows when to set.
aov_text: Hy het die maan gemaak vir die vaste tye; die son ken sy tyd om onder te gaan.

kjv_text: Thou makest darkness, and it is night: wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep forth.
bsb_text: You bring darkness, and it becomes night, when all the beasts of the forest prowl.
aov_text: U beskik die duisternis, en dit word nag, waarin al die diere van die bos uitkruip.

kjv_text: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their meat from God.
bsb_text: The young lions roar for their prey and seek their food from God.
aov_text: Die jong leeus brul om roof en begeer hulle voedsel van God.

kjv_text: The sun ariseth, they gather themselves together, and lay them down in their dens.
bsb_text: The sun rises, and they withdraw; they lie down in their dens.
aov_text: As die son opgaan, dan trek hulle hul terug en gaan lê in hul slaapplekke.

kjv_text: Man goeth forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening.
bsb_text: Man goes forth to his work and to his labor until evening.
aov_text: Die mens gaan uit na sy werk en na sy arbeid tot die aand toe.

kjv_text: O LORD, how manifold are thy works! in wisdom hast thou made them all: the earth is full of thy riches.
bsb_text: How many are Your works, O LORD! In wisdom You have made them all; the earth is full of Your creatures.
aov_text: Hoe talryk is u werke, o HERE! U het hulle almal met wysheid gemaak; die aarde is vol van u skepsele!

kjv_text: So is this great and wide sea, wherein are things creeping innumerable, both small and great beasts.
bsb_text: Here is the sea, vast and wide, teeming with creatures beyond number, living things both great and small.
aov_text: Daar is die see, groot en alkante toe wyd—daar is ’n gewemel sonder getal, klein diere saam met grotes.

kjv_text: There go the ships: there is that leviathan, whom thou hast made to play therein.
bsb_text: There the ships pass, and Leviathan, which You formed to frolic there.
aov_text: Daar gaan die skepe en die Leviátan wat U geformeer het om daarin te speel.

kjv_text: These wait all upon thee; that thou mayest give them their meat in due season.
bsb_text: All creatures look to You to give them their food in due season.
aov_text: Hulle almal wag op U, dat U hulle voedsel kan gee op die regte tyd.

kjv_text: That thou givest them they gather: thou openest thine hand, they are filled with good.
bsb_text: When You give it to them, they gather it up; when You open Your hand, they are satisfied with good things.
aov_text: U gee dit aan hulle, hulle tel dit op; U maak u hand oop, hulle word versadig met die goeie.

kjv_text: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled: thou takest away their breath, they die, and return to their dust.
bsb_text: When You hide Your face, they are terrified; when You take away their breath, they die and return to dust.
aov_text: U verberg u aangesig, hulle word verskrik; U neem hulle asem weg, hulle sterwe en keer terug tot hul stof.

kjv_text: Thou sendest forth thy spirit, they are created: and thou renewest the face of the earth.
bsb_text: When You send Your Spirit, they are created, and You renew the face of the earth.
aov_text: U stuur u Gees uit, hulle word geskape; en U maak die gelaat van die aarde nuut.

kjv_text: The glory of the LORD shall endure for ever: the LORD shall rejoice in his works.
bsb_text: May the glory of the LORD endure forever; may the LORD rejoice in His works.
aov_text: Laat die heerlikheid van die HERE vir ewig wees, laat die HERE bly wees oor sy werke,

kjv_text: He looketh on the earth, and it trembleth: he toucheth the hills, and they smoke.
bsb_text: He looks on the earth, and it trembles; He touches the mountains, and they smolder.
aov_text: Hy wat die aarde aankyk, en dit bewe; Hy raak die berge aan, en hulle rook.

kjv_text: I will sing unto the LORD as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
bsb_text: I will sing to the LORD all my life; I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
aov_text: Ek wil sing tot eer van die HERE solank as ek lewe, ek wil psalmsing tot eer van my God solank as ek daar is.

kjv_text: My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will be glad in the LORD.
bsb_text: May my meditation be pleasing to Him, for I rejoice in the LORD.
aov_text: Mag my oordenking Hom welgevallig wees: ék sal bly wees in die HERE!

kjv_text: Let the sinners be consumed out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless thou the LORD, O my soul. Praise ye the LORD.
bsb_text: May sinners vanish from the earth and the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, O my soul. Hallelujah!
aov_text: Mag die sondaars omkom van die aarde en die goddelose mense nie meer wees nie! Loof die HERE, o my siel! Halleluja!

kjv_text: O give thanks unto the LORD; call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.
bsb_text: Give thanks to the LORD, call upon His name; make known His deeds among the nations.
aov_text: LOOF die HERE, roep sy Naam aan, maak onder die volke sy dade bekend.

kjv_text: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him: talk ye of all his wondrous works.
bsb_text: Sing to Him, sing praises to Him; tell of all His wonders.
aov_text: Sing, psalmsing tot sy eer, spreek van al sy wonders.

kjv_text: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD.
bsb_text: Glory in His holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the LORD rejoice.
aov_text: Beroem julle in sy heilige Naam; laat die hart van die wat die HERE soek, bly wees.

kjv_text: Seek the LORD, and his strength: seek his face evermore.
bsb_text: Seek out the LORD and His strength; seek His face always.
aov_text: Vra na die HERE en sy sterkte; soek sy aangesig altyddeur.

kjv_text: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;
bsb_text: Remember the wonders He has done, His marvels, and the judgments He has pronounced,
aov_text: Dink aan sy wonders wat Hy gedoen het, aan sy wondertekens en die oordele van sy mond,

kjv_text: O ye seed of Abraham his servant, ye children of Jacob his chosen.
bsb_text: O offspring of His servant Abraham, O sons of Jacob, His chosen ones.
aov_text: o nageslag van Abraham, sy kneg, o kinders van Jakob, sy uitverkorenes!

kjv_text: He is the LORD our God: his judgments are in all the earth.
bsb_text: He is the LORD our God; His judgments carry throughout the earth.
aov_text: Hy, die HERE, is onse God; oor die hele aarde is sy oordele.

kjv_text: He hath remembered his covenant for ever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations.
bsb_text: He remembers His covenant forever, the word He ordained for a thousand generations—
aov_text: Hy dink vir ewig aan sy verbond, aan die woord wat Hy ingestel het vir duisend geslagte —

kjv_text: Which covenant he made with Abraham, and his oath unto Isaac;
bsb_text: the covenant He made with Abraham, and the oath He swore to Isaac.
aov_text: die verbond wat Hy met Abraham gesluit het, en sy eed aan Isak;

kjv_text: And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant:
bsb_text: He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree, to Israel as an everlasting covenant:
aov_text: wat Hy ook vir Jakob as insetting bekragtig het, vir Israel as ’n ewige verbond,

kjv_text: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance:
bsb_text: “I will give you the land of Canaan as the portion of your inheritance.”
aov_text: met die woorde: Ek sal aan jou die land Kanaän gee, julle aangewese erfdeel.

kjv_text: When they were but a few men in number; yea, very few, and strangers in it.
bsb_text: When they were few in number, few indeed, and strangers in the land,
aov_text: Toe hulle min mense was, min en vreemdelinge daarin,

kjv_text: When they went from one nation to another, from one kingdom to another people;
bsb_text: they wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another.
aov_text: en hulle getrek het van nasie tot nasie, van die een koninkryk na die ander volk,

kjv_text: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes;
bsb_text: He let no man oppress them; He rebuked kings on their behalf:
aov_text: het Hy geen mens toegelaat om hulle te verdruk nie; ook het Hy konings om hulle ontwil gestraf en gesê:

kjv_text: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.
bsb_text: “Do not touch My anointed ones! Do no harm to My prophets!”
aov_text: Raak my gesalfdes nie aan en doen my profete geen kwaad nie.

kjv_text: Moreover he called for a famine upon the land: he brake the whole staff of bread.
bsb_text: He called down famine on the land and cut off all their supplies of food.
aov_text: En Hy het ’n hongersnood oor die land geroep: elke staf van brood het Hy verbreek.

kjv_text: He sent a man before them, even Joseph, who was sold for a servant:
bsb_text: He sent a man before them—Joseph, sold as a slave.
aov_text: Hy het ’n man voor hulle uit gestuur: Josef is as slaaf verkoop.

kjv_text: Whose feet they hurt with fetters: he was laid in iron:
bsb_text: They bruised his feet with shackles and placed his neck in irons,
aov_text: Hulle het sy voete in boeie geknel, hy self het in die ysters gekom,

kjv_text: Until the time that his word came: the word of the LORD tried him.
bsb_text: until his prediction came true and the word of the LORD proved him right.
aov_text: tot op die tyd dat sy woord uitgekom het, die woord van die HERE hom beproef verklaar het.

kjv_text: The king sent and loosed him; even the ruler of the people, and let him go free.
bsb_text: The king sent and released him; the ruler of peoples set him free.
aov_text: Die koning het gestuur en hom losgemaak, die heerser van die volke, en hom losgelaat.

kjv_text: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all his substance:
bsb_text: He made him master of his household, ruler over all his substance,
aov_text: Hy het hom aangestel as heer oor sy huis en as heerser oor al sy goed;

kjv_text: To bind his princes at his pleasure; and teach his senators wisdom.
bsb_text: to instruct his princes as he pleased and teach his elders wisdom.
aov_text: om sy vorste te bind na sy begeerte, en aan sy oudstes moes hy wysheid leer.

kjv_text: Israel also came into Egypt; and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.
bsb_text: Then Israel entered Egypt; Jacob dwelt in the land of Ham.
aov_text: Toe het Israel na Egipte gekom, en Jakob het as vreemdeling vertoef in die land van Gam.

kjv_text: And he increased his people greatly; and made them stronger than their enemies.
bsb_text: And the LORD made His people very fruitful, more numerous than their foes,
aov_text: En Hy het sy volk baie vrugbaar gemaak en dit meer versterk as sy teëstanders.

kjv_text: He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal subtilly with his servants.
bsb_text: whose hearts He turned to hate His people, to conspire against His servants.
aov_text: Hy het hulle hart verander, om sy volk te haat, om listig teen sy knegte te handel.

kjv_text: He sent Moses his servant; and Aaron whom he had chosen.
bsb_text: He sent Moses His servant, and Aaron, whom He had chosen.
aov_text: Hy het Moses, sy kneg, gestuur en Aäron wat Hy uitgekies het.

kjv_text: They shewed his signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
bsb_text: They performed His miraculous signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
aov_text: Dié het onder hulle sy aangekondigde tekens gedoen en wonders in die land van Gam.

kjv_text: He sent darkness, and made it dark; and they rebelled not against his word.
bsb_text: He sent darkness, and it became dark—yet they defied His words.
aov_text: Hy het duisternis gestuur en dit donker gemaak; en hulle was teen sy woorde nie wederstrewig nie.

kjv_text: He turned their waters into blood, and slew their fish.
bsb_text: He turned their waters to blood and caused their fish to die.
aov_text: Hy het hulle waters verander in bloed en hulle visse laat sterwe.

kjv_text: Their land brought forth frogs in abundance, in the chambers of their kings.
bsb_text: Their land teemed with frogs, even in their royal chambers.
aov_text: Hulle land het gewemel van paddas, in die kamers van hulle konings.

kjv_text: He spake, and there came divers sorts of flies, and lice in all their coasts.
bsb_text: He spoke, and insects swarmed—gnats throughout their country.
aov_text: Hy het gespreek, en daar het steekvlieë gekom, muskiete in hulle hele grondgebied.

kjv_text: He gave them hail for rain, and flaming fire in their land.
bsb_text: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning throughout their land.
aov_text: Hy het hulle reëns hael gemaak, vuurvlamme in hulle land.

kjv_text: He smote their vines also and their fig trees; and brake the trees of their coasts.
bsb_text: He struck their vines and fig trees and shattered the trees of their country.
aov_text: En Hy het hulle wingerdstok en hulle vyeboom geslaan en die bome van hulle grondgebied verbreek.

kjv_text: He spake, and the locusts came, and caterpillers, and that without number,
bsb_text: He spoke, and the locusts came—young locusts without number.
aov_text: Hy het gespreek, en daar het sprinkane gekom en voetgangers sonder getal,

kjv_text: And did eat up all the herbs in their land, and devoured the fruit of their ground.
bsb_text: They devoured every plant in their land and consumed the produce of their soil.
aov_text: wat al die plante in hulle land opgeëet het, ja, opgeëet het die vrugte van hulle grond.

kjv_text: He smote also all the firstborn in their land, the chief of all their strength.
bsb_text: Then He struck all the firstborn in their land, the firstfruits of all their vigor.
aov_text: Hy het ook al die eersgeborenes in hulle land getref, die eerstelinge van al hulle krag.

kjv_text: He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and there was not one feeble person among their tribes.
bsb_text: He brought Israel out with silver and gold, and none among His tribes stumbled.
aov_text: Toe het Hy hulle laat uitgaan met silwer en goud, en onder sy stamme was daar niemand wat struikel nie.

kjv_text: Egypt was glad when they departed: for the fear of them fell upon them.
bsb_text: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the dread of Israel had fallen on them.
aov_text: Egipte was bly toe hulle uittrek, want vrees vir hulle het op hulle geval.

kjv_text: He spread a cloud for a covering; and fire to give light in the night.
bsb_text: He spread a cloud as a covering and a fire to light up the night.
aov_text: Hy het ’n wolk uitgebrei as bedekking en vuur om die nag te verlig.

kjv_text: The people asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
bsb_text: They asked, and He brought quail and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
aov_text: Hulle het gebid: toe laat Hy kwartels kom; en Hy het hulle versadig met hemelbrood.

kjv_text: He opened the rock, and the waters gushed out; they ran in the dry places like a river.
bsb_text: He opened a rock, and water gushed out; it flowed like a river in the desert.
aov_text: Hy het ’n rots oopgemaak, en waters het gevloei; dit het geloop deur die dor plekke—’n rivier!

kjv_text: For he remembered his holy promise, and Abraham his servant.
bsb_text: For He remembered His holy promise to Abraham His servant.
aov_text: Want Hy het gedink aan sy heilige woord, aan Abraham, sy kneg.

kjv_text: And he brought forth his people with joy, and his chosen with gladness:
bsb_text: He brought forth His people with rejoicing, His chosen with shouts of joy.
aov_text: En Hy het sy volk laat uitgaan met vreugde, sy uitverkorenes met gejubel.

kjv_text: And gave them the lands of the heathen: and they inherited the labour of the people;
bsb_text: He gave them the lands of the nations, that they might inherit the fruit of others’ labor,
aov_text: En Hy het aan hulle die lande van die heidene gegee, en wat deur volke met moeite verwerf is, het hulle in besit geneem,

kjv_text: That they might observe his statutes, and keep his laws. Praise ye the LORD.
bsb_text: that they might keep His statutes and obey His laws. Hallelujah!
aov_text: dat hulle sy insettinge kan onderhou en sy wette bewaar. Halleluja!

kjv_text: Praise ye the LORD. O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
bsb_text: Hallelujah! Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
aov_text: HALLELUJA! Loof die HERE, want Hy is goed, want sy goedertierenheid is tot in ewigheid.

kjv_text: Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD? who can shew forth all his praise?
bsb_text: Who can describe the mighty acts of the LORD or fully proclaim His praise?
aov_text: Wie kan die magtige dade van die HERE uitspreek, al sy roem verkondig?

kjv_text: Blessed are they that keep judgment, and he that doeth righteousness at all times.
bsb_text: Blessed are those who uphold justice, who practice righteousness at all times.
aov_text: Welgeluksalig is hulle wat die reg bewaar, die wat altyd geregtigheid doen.

kjv_text: Remember me, O LORD, with the favour that thou bearest unto thy people: O visit me with thy salvation;
bsb_text: Remember me, O LORD, in Your favor to Your people; visit me with Your salvation,
aov_text: Dink aan my, o HERE, na die welbehae in u volk, besoek my met u heil,

kjv_text: That I may see the good of thy chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation, that I may glory with thine inheritance.
bsb_text: that I may see the prosperity of Your chosen ones, and rejoice in the gladness of Your nation, and give glory with Your inheritance.
aov_text: dat ek kan aanskou die geluk van u uitverkorenes, dat ek bly kan wees in die blydskap van u volk, my kan beroem met u erfdeel.

kjv_text: We have sinned with our fathers, we have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.
bsb_text: We have sinned like our fathers; we have done wrong and acted wickedly.
aov_text: Ons het gesondig, saam met ons vaders; ons het verkeerd gedoen, goddeloos gehandel.

kjv_text: Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt; they remembered not the multitude of thy mercies; but provoked him at the sea, even at the Red sea.
bsb_text: Our fathers in Egypt did not grasp Your wonders or remember Your abundant kindness; but they rebelled by the sea, there at the Red Sea.
aov_text: Ons vaders in Egipte het nie ag gegee op u wonders, hulle het nie gedink aan die menigte van u goedertierenhede nie, maar was wederstrewig by die see, by die Skelfsee.

kjv_text: Nevertheless he saved them for his name's sake, that he might make his mighty power to be known.
bsb_text: Yet He saved them for the sake of His name, to make His power known.
aov_text: Maar Hy het hulle verlos om sy Naam ontwil, om sy mag bekend te maak.

kjv_text: He rebuked the Red sea also, and it was dried up: so he led them through the depths, as through the wilderness.
bsb_text: He rebuked the Red Sea, and it dried up; He led them through the depths as through a desert.
aov_text: En Hy het die Skelfsee gedreig, sodat dit opgedroog het, en hulle deur die watervloede laat gaan soos deur ’n woestyn.

kjv_text: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
bsb_text: He saved them from the hand that hated them; He redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
aov_text: En Hy het hulle verlos uit die hand van die hater en hulle bevry uit die hand van die vyand.

kjv_text: And the waters covered their enemies: there was not one of them left.
bsb_text: The waters covered their foes; not one of them remained.
aov_text: En die waters het hulle teëstanders oordek: nie een van hulle het oorgebly nie.

kjv_text: Then believed they his words; they sang his praise.
bsb_text: Then they believed His promises and sang His praise.
aov_text: Toe het hulle aan sy woorde geglo, hulle het sy lof gesing.

kjv_text: They soon forgat his works; they waited not for his counsel:
bsb_text: Yet they soon forgot His works and failed to wait for His counsel.
aov_text: Maar hulle het gou sy werke vergeet, op sy raadsbesluit nie gewag nie.

kjv_text: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, and tempted God in the desert.
bsb_text: They craved intensely in the wilderness and tested God in the desert.
aov_text: En hulle het baie begerig geword in die woestyn en God versoek in die wildernis.

kjv_text: And he gave them their request; but sent leanness into their soul.
bsb_text: So He granted their request, but sent a wasting disease upon them.
aov_text: Toe het Hy hulle gegee wat hulle gevra het, maar in hulle siel ’n maerte gestuur.

kjv_text: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron the saint of the LORD.
bsb_text: In the camp they envied Moses, as well as Aaron, the holy one of the LORD.
aov_text: En hulle was in die laer afgunstig op Moses, op Aäron, die heilige van die HERE.

kjv_text: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.
bsb_text: The earth opened up and swallowed Dathan; it covered the assembly of Abiram.
aov_text: Die aarde het oopgegaan en Datan verslind en die bende van Abíram oordek.

kjv_text: And a fire was kindled in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.
bsb_text: Then fire blazed through their company; flames consumed the wicked.
aov_text: En ’n vuur het gebrand onder hulle bende, ’n vlam die goddelose aan die brand gesteek.

kjv_text: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshipped the molten image.
bsb_text: At Horeb they made a calf and worshiped a molten image.
aov_text: Hulle het by Horeb ’n kalf gemaak en gebuig voor ’n gegote beeld.

kjv_text: Thus they changed their glory into the similitude of an ox that eateth grass.
bsb_text: They exchanged their Glory for the image of a grass-eating ox.
aov_text: En hulle het hul Heerlikheid verruil vir die afbeelding van ’n bees wat gras eet.

kjv_text: They forgat God their saviour, which had done great things in Egypt;
bsb_text: They forgot God their Savior, who did great things in Egypt,
aov_text: Hulle het God vergeet, hulle Verlosser, wat groot dinge gedoen het in Egipte,

kjv_text: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, and terrible things by the Red sea.
bsb_text: wondrous works in the land of Ham, and awesome deeds by the Red Sea.
aov_text: wonders in die land van Gam, vreeslike dinge by die Skelfsee.

kjv_text: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy them.
bsb_text: So He said He would destroy them—had not Moses His chosen one stood before Him in the breach to divert His wrath from destroying them.
aov_text: Toe het Hy gesê dat Hy hulle sou verdelg, as Moses, sy uitverkorene, nie voor sy aangesig in die bres gaan staan het om sy grimmigheid af te keer, dat Hy nie sou vernietig nie.

kjv_text: Yea, they despised the pleasant land, they believed not his word:
bsb_text: They despised the pleasant land; they did not believe His promise.
aov_text: Hulle het ook die kosbare land versmaad, sy woord nie geglo nie;

kjv_text: But murmured in their tents, and hearkened not unto the voice of the LORD.
bsb_text: They grumbled in their tents and did not listen to the voice of the LORD.
aov_text: en hulle het gemurmureer in hul tente, na die stem van die HERE nie geluister nie.

kjv_text: Therefore he lifted up his hand against them, to overthrow them in the wilderness:
bsb_text: So He raised His hand and swore to cast them down in the wilderness,
aov_text: Toe het Hy sy hand teen hulle opgehef om hulle neer te slaan in die woestyn,

kjv_text: To overthrow their seed also among the nations, and to scatter them in the lands.
bsb_text: to disperse their offspring among the nations and scatter them throughout the lands.
aov_text: en om hulle nageslag te versprei onder die nasies en hulle te verstrooi in die lande.

kjv_text: They joined themselves also unto Baalpeor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.
bsb_text: They yoked themselves to Baal of Peor and ate sacrifices offered to lifeless gods.
aov_text: Ook het hulle hul aan Baäl-Peor gekoppel en die offerandes aan die dooies geëet;

kjv_text: Thus they provoked him to anger with their inventions: and the plague brake in upon them.
bsb_text: So they provoked the LORD to anger with their deeds, and a plague broke out among them.
aov_text: en hulle het die HERE geterg deur hul dade, sodat ’n plaag onder hulle uitgebreek het.

kjv_text: Then stood up Phinehas, and executed judgment: and so the plague was stayed.
bsb_text: But Phinehas stood and intervened, and the plague was restrained.
aov_text: Toe het Pínehas opgetree en gerig geoefen, en die plaag het opgehou;

kjv_text: And that was counted unto him for righteousness unto all generations for evermore.
bsb_text: It was credited to him as righteousness for endless generations to come.
aov_text: en dit is hom gereken tot geregtigheid, van geslag tot geslag tot in ewigheid.

kjv_text: They angered him also at the waters of strife, so that it went ill with Moses for their sakes:
bsb_text: At the waters of Meribah they angered the LORD, and trouble came to Moses because of them.
aov_text: Hulle het Hom ook vertoorn by die waters van Mériba, en dit het met Moses sleg gegaan om hulle ontwil;

kjv_text: Because they provoked his spirit, so that he spake unadvisedly with his lips.
bsb_text: For they rebelled against His Spirit, and Moses spoke rashly with his lips.
aov_text: want hulle was wederstrewig teen sy Gees, sodat hy onverskillig gepraat het met sy lippe.

kjv_text: They did not destroy the nations, concerning whom the LORD commanded them:
bsb_text: They did not destroy the peoples as the LORD had commanded them,
aov_text: Hulle het die volke nie verdelg soos die HERE aan hulle gesê het nie,

kjv_text: But were mingled among the heathen, and learned their works.
bsb_text: but they mingled with the nations and adopted their customs.
aov_text: maar hul met die heidene vermeng en hulle werke geleer.

kjv_text: And they served their idols: which were a snare unto them.
bsb_text: They worshiped their idols, which became a snare to them.
aov_text: En hulle het hulle afgode gedien, en dit het vir hulle ’n strik geword.

kjv_text: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto devils,
bsb_text: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.
aov_text: Bowendien het hulle hul seuns en hul dogters aan die duiwels geoffer

kjv_text: And shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan: and the land was polluted with blood.
bsb_text: They shed innocent blood—the blood of their sons and daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan, and the land was polluted with blood.
aov_text: en onskuldige bloed vergiet—die bloed van hul seuns en hul dogters wat hulle aan die afgode van Kanaän geoffer het—sodat die land deur bloedskuld ontheilig is.

kjv_text: Thus were they defiled with their own works, and went a whoring with their own inventions.
bsb_text: They defiled themselves by their actions and prostituted themselves by their deeds.
aov_text: En hulle het onrein geword deur hul werke en gehoereer deur hul dade.

kjv_text: Therefore was the wrath of the LORD kindled against his people, insomuch that he abhorred his own inheritance.
bsb_text: So the anger of the LORD burned against His people, and He abhorred His own inheritance.
aov_text: Toe het die toorn van die HERE ontvlam teen sy volk, en Hy het ’n afsku gekry van sy erfdeel.

kjv_text: And he gave them into the hand of the heathen; and they that hated them ruled over them.
bsb_text: He delivered them into the hand of the nations, and those who hated them ruled over them.
aov_text: En Hy het hulle in die hand van die heidene gegee, en hulle haters het oor hulle geheers;

kjv_text: Their enemies also oppressed them, and they were brought into subjection under their hand.
bsb_text: Their enemies oppressed them, and subdued them under their hand.
aov_text: en hulle vyande het hulle verdruk, sodat hulle onder hul hand moes buig.

kjv_text: Many times did he deliver them; but they provoked him with their counsel, and were brought low for their iniquity.
bsb_text: Many times He rescued them, but they were bent on rebellion and sank down in their iniquity.
aov_text: Hy het hulle baiekeer gered; maar húlle was wederstrewig in hulle voorneme. So het hulle dan weggesink deur hul ongeregtigheid.

kjv_text: Nevertheless he regarded their affliction, when he heard their cry:
bsb_text: Nevertheless He heard their cry; He took note of their distress.
aov_text: Nogtans het Hy hulle benoudheid aangesien toe Hy hulle smeking gehoor het;

kjv_text: And he remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his mercies.
bsb_text: And He remembered His covenant with them, and relented by the abundance of His loving devotion.
aov_text: en Hy het tot hulle beswil aan sy verbond gedink en berou gekry na die veelheid van sy goedertierenhede.

kjv_text: He made them also to be pitied of all those that carried them captives.
bsb_text: He made them objects of compassion to all who held them captive.
aov_text: En Hy het hulle medelyde laat vind by almal wat hulle as gevangenes weggevoer het.

kjv_text: Save us, O LORD our God, and gather us from among the heathen, to give thanks unto thy holy name, and to triumph in thy praise.
bsb_text: Save us, O LORD our God, and gather us from the nations, that we may give thanks to Your holy name, that we may glory in Your praise.
aov_text: Verlos ons, HERE onse God, en versamel ons uit die nasies, dat ons u heilige Naam kan loof en ons beroem in u lof!

kjv_text: Blessed be the LORD God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting: and let all the people say, Amen. Praise ye the LORD.
bsb_text: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Let all the people say, “Amen!” Hallelujah!
aov_text: Geloofd sy die HERE, die God van Israel, van ewigheid tot ewigheid! En laat die hele volk sê: Amen. Halleluja!

kjv_text: O give thanks unto the LORD, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
bsb_text: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
aov_text: LOOF die HERE, want Hy is goed, want sy goedertierenheid is tot in ewigheid!

kjv_text: Let the redeemed of the LORD say so, whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy;
bsb_text: Let the redeemed of the LORD say so, whom He has redeemed from the hand of the enemy
aov_text: Dit moet die verlostes van die HERE sê, wat Hy uit die nood verlos het

kjv_text: And gathered them out of the lands, from the east, and from the west, from the north, and from the south.
bsb_text: and gathered from the lands, from east and west, from north and south.
aov_text: en uit die lande versamel het, van die ooste en die weste, van die noorde en van die see af.

kjv_text: They wandered in the wilderness in a solitary way; they found no city to dwell in.
bsb_text: Some wandered in desert wastelands, finding no path to a city in which to dwell.
aov_text: Hulle het gedwaal in die woestyn, op woeste paaie; ’n stad om in te woon het hulle nie gevind nie.

kjv_text: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.
bsb_text: They were hungry and thirsty; their soul fainted within them.
aov_text: Honger, ook dors was hulle; hulle siel het in hulle versmag.

kjv_text: Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.
bsb_text: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He delivered them from their distress.
aov_text: Toe het hulle die HERE aangeroep in hul benoudheid; uit hul angste het Hy hulle gered.

kjv_text: And he led them forth by the right way, that they might go to a city of habitation.
bsb_text: He led them on a straight path to reach a city where they could live.
aov_text: En Hy het hulle gelei op ’n regte pad om te gaan na ’n stad om in te woon.

kjv_text: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
bsb_text: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
aov_text: Laat hulle die HERE loof om sy goedertierenheid en om sy wonderdade aan die mensekinders;

kjv_text: For he satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.
bsb_text: For He satisfies the thirsty and fills the hungry with good things.
aov_text: want Hy het die dorstige siel versadig en die hongerige siel met die goeie vervul.

kjv_text: Such as sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron;
bsb_text: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, prisoners in affliction and chains,
aov_text: Die wat in duisternis en doodskaduwee gesit het, gevang in ellende en ysters —

kjv_text: Because they rebelled against the words of God, and contemned the counsel of the most High:
bsb_text: because they rebelled against the words of God and despised the counsel of the Most High.
aov_text: omdat hulle wederstrewig was teen die woorde van God en die raad van die Allerhoogste verwerp het,

kjv_text: Therefore he brought down their heart with labour; they fell down, and there was none to help.
bsb_text: He humbled their hearts with hard labor; they stumbled, and there was no one to help.
aov_text: het Hy hulle hart deur moeite verneder; hulle het gestruikel, en daar was geen helper nie.

kjv_text: Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.
bsb_text: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He saved them from their distress.
aov_text: Toe het hulle die HERE aangeroep in hul benoudheid; uit hul angste het Hy hulle verlos.

kjv_text: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and brake their bands in sunder.
bsb_text: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death and broke away their chains.
aov_text: Hy het hulle uit duisternis en doodskaduwee laat uitgaan en hulle bande verbreek.

kjv_text: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
bsb_text: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
aov_text: Laat hulle die HERE loof om sy goedertierenheid en om sy wonderdade aan die mensekinders;

kjv_text: For he hath broken the gates of brass, and cut the bars of iron in sunder.
bsb_text: For He has broken down the gates of bronze and cut through the bars of iron.
aov_text: want Hy het koperdeure verbreek en ystergrendels stukkend geslaan.

kjv_text: Fools because of their transgression, and because of their iniquities, are afflicted.
bsb_text: Fools, in their rebellious ways, and through their iniquities, suffered affliction.
aov_text: Die wat dwase was vanweë die weg van hulle oortreding en weens hulle ongeregtighede gepynig is —

kjv_text: Their soul abhorreth all manner of meat; and they draw near unto the gates of death.
bsb_text: They loathed all food and drew near to the gates of death.
aov_text: hulle siel het ’n afsku gehad van elke soort voedsel, en hulle het tot by die poorte van die dood gekom.

kjv_text: Then they cry unto the LORD in their trouble, and he saveth them out of their distresses.
bsb_text: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He saved them from their distress.
aov_text: Toe het hulle die HERE aangeroep in hul benoudheid; uit hul angste het Hy hulle verlos.

kjv_text: He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered them from their destructions.
bsb_text: He sent forth His word and healed them; He rescued them from the Pit.
aov_text: Hy het sy woord uitgestuur, dat Hy hulle kon gesond maak en hulle uit hul kuile red.

kjv_text: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
bsb_text: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
aov_text: Laat hulle die HERE loof om sy goedertierenheid en om sy wonderdade aan die mensekinders;

kjv_text: And let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works with rejoicing.
bsb_text: Let them offer sacrifices of thanksgiving and declare His works with rejoicing.
aov_text: en laat hulle lofoffers bring en met gejubel sy werke vertel.

kjv_text: They that go down to the sea in ships, that do business in great waters;
bsb_text: Others went out to sea in ships, conducting trade on the mighty waters.
aov_text: Die wat na die see toe afdaal in skepe, wat handel drywe op die groot waters —

kjv_text: These see the works of the LORD, and his wonders in the deep.
bsb_text: They saw the works of the LORD, and His wonders in the deep.
aov_text: húlle het die werke van die HERE gesien en sy wonders in die diepte.

kjv_text: For he commandeth, and raiseth the stormy wind, which lifteth up the waves thereof.
bsb_text: For He spoke and raised a tempest that lifted the waves of the sea.
aov_text: Want Hy het gespreek en ’n stormwind laat opsteek wat die golwe daarvan opgesweep het.

kjv_text: They mount up to the heaven, they go down again to the depths: their soul is melted because of trouble.
bsb_text: They mounted up to the heavens, then sunk to the depths; their courage melted in their anguish.
aov_text: Hulle het opgerys na die hemel, neergedaal na die dieptes—hulle siel het vergaan van wee.

kjv_text: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wit's end.
bsb_text: They reeled and staggered like drunkards, and all their skill was useless.
aov_text: Hulle het getuimel en gewaggel soos ’n dronk man, en al hulle wysheid is verwar.

kjv_text: Then they cry unto the LORD in their trouble, and he bringeth them out of their distresses.
bsb_text: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He brought them out of their distress.
aov_text: Toe het hulle die HERE aangeroep in hul benoudheid, en uit hul angste het Hy hulle uitgelei.

kjv_text: He maketh the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still.
bsb_text: He calmed the storm to a whisper, and the waves of the sea were hushed.
aov_text: Hy het die storm ’n gesuis gemaak, en hulle golwe het stil geword.

kjv_text: Then are they glad because they be quiet; so he bringeth them unto their desired haven.
bsb_text: They rejoiced in the silence, and He guided them to the harbor they desired.
aov_text: Toe was hulle bly, omdat dit rustig geword het, en Hy het hulle gelei na die hawe van hul begeerte.

kjv_text: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
bsb_text: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
aov_text: Laat hulle die HERE loof om sy goedertierenheid en om sy wonderdade aan die mensekinders.

kjv_text: Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people, and praise him in the assembly of the elders.
bsb_text: Let them exalt Him in the assembly of the people and praise Him in the council of the elders.
aov_text: En laat hulle Hom verhoog in die vergadering van die volk en Hom roem in die kring van die oudstes.

kjv_text: He turneth rivers into a wilderness, and the watersprings into dry ground;
bsb_text: He turns rivers into deserts, springs of water into thirsty ground,
aov_text: Hy het riviere ’n woestyn gemaak en waterfonteine ’n dorsland,

kjv_text: A fruitful land into barrenness, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.
bsb_text: and fruitful land into fields of salt, because of the wickedness of its dwellers.
aov_text: vrugbare land ’n brak aarde, oor die boosheid van die wat daarin woon.

kjv_text: He turneth the wilderness into a standing water, and dry ground into watersprings.
bsb_text: He turns a desert into pools of water and a dry land into flowing springs.
aov_text: Hy het die woestyn ’n waterplas gemaak en die dor land waterfonteine;

kjv_text: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell, that they may prepare a city for habitation;
bsb_text: He causes the hungry to settle there, that they may establish a city in which to dwell.
aov_text: en Hy het hongeriges daar laat bly, en hulle het ’n stad gestig om in te woon.

kjv_text: And sow the fields, and plant vineyards, which may yield fruits of increase.
bsb_text: They sow fields and plant vineyards that yield a fruitful harvest.
aov_text: En hulle het lande gesaai en wingerde geplant wat vrugte as opbrings verskaf het.

kjv_text: He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; and suffereth not their cattle to decrease.
bsb_text: He blesses them, and they multiply greatly; He does not let their herds diminish.
aov_text: En Hy het hulle geseën, sodat hulle sterk vermenigvuldig het, en hulle vee het Hy nie min gemaak nie.

kjv_text: Again, they are minished and brought low through oppression, affliction, and sorrow.
bsb_text: When they are decreased and humbled by oppression, evil, and sorrow,
aov_text: Toe het hulle min geword en weggesink deur die druk van onheil en kommer —

kjv_text: He poureth contempt upon princes, and causeth them to wander in the wilderness, where there is no way.
bsb_text: He pours out contempt on the nobles and makes them wander in a trackless wasteland.
aov_text: Hy wat veragting uitstort oor edeles en hulle laat dwaal in ’n woeste wêreld, sonder pad —

kjv_text: Yet setteth he the poor on high from affliction, and maketh him families like a flock.
bsb_text: But He lifts the needy from affliction and increases their families like flocks.
aov_text: Hy het die behoeftige beskerm teen verdrukking en die geslagte soos kuddes gemaak.

kjv_text: The righteous shall see it, and rejoice: and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.
bsb_text: The upright see and rejoice, and all iniquity shuts its mouth.
aov_text: Die opregtes sien dit en is bly, maar alle ongeregtigheid hou sy mond toe.

kjv_text: Whoso is wise, and will observe these things, even they shall understand the loving-kindness of the LORD.
bsb_text: Let him who is wise pay heed to these things and consider the loving devotion of the LORD.
aov_text: Wie wys is, laat hy op hierdie dinge ag gee, en laat hulle let op die goedertierenhede van die HERE.

kjv_text: A Song [or] Psalm of David.
bsb_text: A song. A Psalm of David.
aov_text: ’N LIED. ’n Psalm van Dawid.

kjv_text: O God, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.
bsb_text: My heart is steadfast, O God; I will sing and make music with all my being.
aov_text: My hart is gerus, o God! Ek wil sing en psalmsing, ja, ook my eer.

kjv_text: Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.
bsb_text: Awake, O harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.
aov_text: Waak op, harp en siter! Ek wil die dageraad wakker maak.

kjv_text: I will praise thee, O LORD, among the people: and I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.
bsb_text: I will praise You, O LORD, among the nations; I will sing Your praises among the peoples.
aov_text: Ek wil U loof onder die volke, o HERE, en psalmsing tot u eer, onder die nasies;

kjv_text: For thy mercy is great above the heavens: and thy truth reacheth unto the clouds.
bsb_text: For Your loving devotion extends beyond the heavens, and Your faithfulness reaches to the clouds.
aov_text: want u goedertierenheid is groot bo die hemel uit en u trou tot by die wolke.

kjv_text: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: and thy glory above all the earth;
bsb_text: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; may Your glory cover all the earth.
aov_text: Verhef U bo die hemele, o God, en u heerlikheid bo die hele aarde!

kjv_text: That thy beloved may be delivered: save with thy right hand, and answer me.
bsb_text: Respond and save us with Your right hand, that Your beloved may be delivered.
aov_text: Dat u bemindes gered kan word—verlos deur u regterhand en verhoor ons!

kjv_text: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
bsb_text: God has spoken from His sanctuary: “I will triumph! I will parcel out Shechem and apportion the Valley of Succoth.
aov_text: God het gespreek in sy heiligdom: Ek wil jubel, Ek wil Sigem verdeel en die dal van Sukkot afmeet.

kjv_text: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;
bsb_text: Gilead is Mine, and Manasseh is Mine; Ephraim is My helmet, Judah is My scepter.
aov_text: Gílead is myne, Manasse is myne, en Efraim is die beskutting van my hoof; Juda is my veldheerstaf.

kjv_text: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph.
bsb_text: Moab is My washbasin; upon Edom I toss My sandal; over Philistia I shout in triumph.”
aov_text: Moab is my waskom; op Edom werp Ek my skoen; oor Filistéa jubel Ek.

kjv_text: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
bsb_text: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?
aov_text: Wie sal my bring in die versterkte stad? Wie lei my tot in Edom?

kjv_text: Wilt not thou, O God, who hast cast us off? and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our hosts?
bsb_text: Have You not rejected us, O God? Will You no longer march out, O God, with our armies?
aov_text: Het U, o God, ons nie verwerp nie? En U trek nie uit, o God, saam met ons leërs nie.

kjv_text: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.
bsb_text: Give us aid against the enemy, for the help of man is worthless.
aov_text: Gee ons hulp teen die vyand, want die mens se hulp is vergeefse moeite.

kjv_text: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.
bsb_text: With God we will perform with valor, and He will trample our enemies.
aov_text: In God sal ons kragtige dade doen, en Hy self sal ons vyande vertrap.

kjv_text: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;
bsb_text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. O God of my praise, be not silent.
aov_text: VIR die musiekleier. Van Dawid. ’n Psalm. o God van my lof, moenie swyg nie!

kjv_text: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.
bsb_text: For wicked and deceitful mouths open against me; they speak against me with lying tongues.
aov_text: Want hulle het die mond van die goddelose en die mond van bedrog teen my oopgemaak; hulle het met my gespreek met ’n leuenagtige tong,

kjv_text: They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.
bsb_text: They surround me with hateful words and attack me without cause.
aov_text: en my met woorde van haat omring; ja, hulle het my sonder oorsaak beveg.

kjv_text: For my love they are my adversaries: but I give myself unto prayer.
bsb_text: In return for my love they accuse me, but I am a man of prayer.
aov_text: Vir my liefde behandel hulle my vyandig, terwyl ek tog gedurig bid.

kjv_text: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
bsb_text: They repay me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
aov_text: En hulle het my kwaad vir goed opgelê en haat vir my liefde.

kjv_text: Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.
bsb_text: Set over him a wicked man; let an accuser stand at his right hand.
aov_text: Stel ’n goddelose oor hom en laat ’n teëstander staan aan sy regterhand.

kjv_text: When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin.
bsb_text: When he is tried, let him be found guilty, and may his prayer be regarded as sin.
aov_text: As hy geoordeel word, laat hom as skuldige uitgaan, en laat sy gebed sonde word.

kjv_text: Let his days be few; and let another take his office.
bsb_text: May his days be few; may another take his position.
aov_text: Laat sy dae min wees; laat ’n ander sy amp neem.

kjv_text: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.
bsb_text: May his children be fatherless and his wife a widow.
aov_text: Laat sy kinders wese word en sy vrou ’n weduwee;

kjv_text: Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek their bread also out of their desolate places.
bsb_text: May his children wander as beggars, seeking sustenance far from their ruined homes.
aov_text: en laat sy kinders oral rondswerwe en bedel en brood soek, weg van hulle puinhope af.

kjv_text: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; and let the strangers spoil his labour.
bsb_text: May the creditor seize all he owns, and strangers plunder the fruits of his labor.
aov_text: Laat die skuldeiser alles neem wat hy het, en laat vreemdes sy goed buitmaak.

kjv_text: Let there be none to extend mercy unto him: neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children.
bsb_text: May there be no one to extend kindness to him, and no one to favor his fatherless children.
aov_text: Laat hom niemand hê wie se guns bestendig is, en laat niemand hom oor sy wese ontferm nie.

kjv_text: Let his posterity be cut off; and in the generation following let their name be blotted out.
bsb_text: May his descendants be cut off; may their name be blotted out from the next generation.
aov_text: Laat sy nakomelinge uitgeroei word; laat hulle naam uitgedelg word in die volgende geslag.

kjv_text: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with the LORD; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.
bsb_text: May the iniquity of his fathers be remembered before the LORD, and the sin of his mother never be blotted out.
aov_text: Laat die HERE gedagtig wees aan die ongeregtigheid van sy vaders, en laat die sonde van sy moeder nie uitgedelg word nie.

kjv_text: Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.
bsb_text: May their sins always remain before the LORD, that He may cut off their memory from the earth.
aov_text: Laat dié altyddeur voor die HERE wees, dat Hy hulle gedagtenis van die aarde af kan uitroei;

kjv_text: Because that he remembered not to shew mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man, that he might even slay the broken in heart.
bsb_text: For he never thought to show kindness, but pursued the poor and needy and brokenhearted, even to their death.
aov_text: omdat hy nie daaraan gedink het om guns te bewys nie, maar die ellendige en behoeftige man vervolg het en die moedelose van hart, om hom dood te maak.

kjv_text: As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him: as he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.
bsb_text: The cursing that he loved, may it fall on him; the blessing in which he refused to delight, may it be far from him.
aov_text: Ja, hy het die vloek liefgehad en—dit het oor hom gekom; en hy het geen welbehae gehad in die seën nie en—dit het ver van hom af gebly.

kjv_text: As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.
bsb_text: The cursing that he wore like a coat, may it soak into his body like water, and into his bones like oil.
aov_text: Hy het die vloek aangetrek soos ’n kleed en—dit het soos water in sy binneste gekom en soos olie in sy gebeente.

kjv_text: Let it be unto him as the garment which covereth him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.
bsb_text: May it be like a robe wrapped about him, like a belt tied forever around him.
aov_text: Laat dit vir hom wees soos ’n kleed waarin hy hom toedraai, en ’n gordel wat hy altyddeur ombind.

kjv_text: Let this be the reward of mine adversaries from the LORD, and of them that speak evil against my soul.
bsb_text: May this be the LORD’s reward to my accusers, to those who speak evil against me.
aov_text: Laat dit die loon van my teëstanders wees vanweë die HERE, en van hulle wat kwaad spreek teen my.

kjv_text: But do thou for me, O GOD the Lord, for thy name's sake: because thy mercy is good, deliver thou me.
bsb_text: But You, O GOD, the Lord, deal kindly with me for the sake of Your name; deliver me by the goodness of Your loving devotion.
aov_text: Maar U, o HERE Here, maak dit goed met my om u Naam ontwil; omdat u goedertierenheid goed is, red my.

kjv_text: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.
bsb_text: For I am poor and needy; my heart is wounded within me.
aov_text: Want ek is ellendig en behoeftig, en my hart is deurwond in my binneste.

kjv_text: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.
bsb_text: I am fading away like a lengthening shadow; I am shaken off like a locust.
aov_text: Ek gaan heen soos ’n skaduwee as dit lank word; ek is afgeskud soos ’n sprinkaan.

kjv_text: My knees are weak through fasting; and my flesh faileth of fatness.
bsb_text: My knees are weak from fasting, and my body grows lean and gaunt.
aov_text: My knieë knik van vas, en my vlees het maer geword, sonder vet.

kjv_text: I became also a reproach unto them: when they looked upon me they shaked their heads.
bsb_text: I am an object of scorn to my accusers; when they see me, they shake their heads.
aov_text: En ék het vir hulle ’n smaad geword; as hulle my sien, skud hulle hul hoof.

kjv_text: Help me, O LORD my God: O save me according to thy mercy:
bsb_text: Help me, O LORD my God; save me according to Your loving devotion.
aov_text: Help my, HERE my God! Verlos my na u goedertierenheid,

kjv_text: That they may know that this is thy hand; that thou, LORD, hast done it.
bsb_text: Let them know that this is Your hand, that You, O LORD, have done it.
aov_text: sodat hulle kan weet dat dit u hand is: U, o HERE, het dit gedoen.

kjv_text: Let them curse, but bless thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let thy servant rejoice.
bsb_text: Though they curse, You will bless. When they rise up, they will be put to shame, but Your servant will rejoice.
aov_text: Laat húlle vloek, maar U, seën U. Hulle het opgestaan en beskaamd geword, maar u kneg is bly.

kjv_text: Let mine adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.
bsb_text: May my accusers be clothed with disgrace; may they wear their shame like a robe.
aov_text: Laat my teëstanders beklee word met smaad en hulle toedraai in hul skande soos in ’n mantel.

kjv_text: I will greatly praise the LORD with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.
bsb_text: With my mouth I will thank the LORD profusely; I will praise Him in the presence of many.
aov_text: Ek sal die HERE hardop loof met my mond, en onder baie sal ek Hom prys;

kjv_text: For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save him from those that condemn his soul.
bsb_text: For He stands at the right hand of the needy one, to save him from the condemners of his soul.
aov_text: want Hy staan aan die regterhand van die behoeftige om hom te verlos van die wat hom veroordeel.

kjv_text: A Psalm of David. The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.
bsb_text: A Psalm of David. The LORD said to my Lord: “Sit at My right hand until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet.”
aov_text: VAN Dawid. ’n Psalm. Die HERE het tot my Here gespreek: Sit aan my regterhand, totdat Ek u vyande maak ’n voetbank vir u voete.

kjv_text: The LORD shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.
bsb_text: The LORD extends Your mighty scepter from Zion: “Rule in the midst of Your enemies.”
aov_text: U magtige septer sal die HERE uitstrek uit Sion en sê: Heers te midde van u vyande.

kjv_text: Thy people shall be willing in the day of thy power, in the beauties of holiness from the womb of the morning: thou hast the dew of thy youth.
bsb_text: Your people shall be willing on Your day of battle. Arrayed in holy splendor, from the womb of the dawn, to You belongs the dew of Your youth.
aov_text: U volk sal baie gewillig wees op die dag van u krygsmag; in heilige feesgewade, uit die moederskoot van die dageraad sal vir U wees die dou van u jong manskappe.

kjv_text: The LORD hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.
bsb_text: The LORD has sworn and will not change His mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”
aov_text: Die HERE het gesweer, en dit sal Hom nie berou nie: U is priester vir ewig volgens die orde van Melgisédek.

kjv_text: The Lord at thy right hand shall strike through kings in the day of his wrath.
