aov_text: Hulle het my amper vernietig op die aarde; maar ék het u bevele nie verlaat nie.

kjv_text: Quicken me after thy loving-kindness; so shall I keep the testimony of thy mouth.
bsb_text: Revive me according to Your loving devotion, that I may obey the testimony of Your mouth.
aov_text: Maak my lewend na u goedertierenheid, dat ek die getuienis van u mond kan onderhou.

kjv_text: For ever, O LORD, thy word is settled in heaven.
bsb_text: Your word, O LORD, is everlasting; it is firmly fixed in the heavens.
aov_text: Vir ewig, o HERE, staan u woord vas in die hemele.

kjv_text: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations: thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.
bsb_text: Your faithfulness continues through all generations; You established the earth, and it endures.
aov_text: U trou is van geslag tot geslag; U het die aarde bevestig, en dit bly staan.

kjv_text: They continue this day according to thine ordinances: for all are thy servants.
bsb_text: Your ordinances stand to this day, for all things are servants to You.
aov_text: Volgens u verordeninge bly hulle vandag nog staan, want alle dinge is u knegte.

kjv_text: Unless thy law had been my delights, I should then have perished in mine affliction.
bsb_text: If Your law had not been my delight, then I would have perished in my affliction.
aov_text: As u wet nie my verlustiging was nie, dan het ek omgekom in my ellende.

kjv_text: I will never forget thy precepts: for with them thou hast quickened me.
bsb_text: I will never forget Your precepts, for by them You have revived me.
aov_text: Ek sal u bevele tot in ewigheid nie vergeet nie, want deur hulle het U my lewend gemaak.

kjv_text: I am thine, save me; for I have sought thy precepts.
bsb_text: I am Yours; save me, for I have sought Your precepts.
aov_text: Aan U behoort ek: verlos my, want ek soek u bevele.

kjv_text: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: but I will consider thy testimonies.
bsb_text: The wicked wait to destroy me, but I will ponder Your testimonies.
aov_text: Die goddelose lê en wag op my, om my om te bring; ek gee ag op u getuienisse.

kjv_text: I have seen an end of all perfection: but thy commandment is exceeding broad.
bsb_text: I have seen a limit to all perfection, but Your commandment is without limit.
aov_text: Aan alle volmaaktheid het ek ’n einde gesien, maar u gebod is baie wyd.

kjv_text: O how love I thy law! it is my meditation all the day.
bsb_text: Oh, how I love Your law! All day long it is my meditation.
aov_text: Hoe lief het ek u wet; dit is my bepeinsing die hele dag.

kjv_text: Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies: for they are ever with me.
bsb_text: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for they are always with me.
aov_text: U gebooie maak my wyser as my vyande, want hulle is myne vir ewig.

kjv_text: I have more understanding than all my teachers: for thy testimonies are my meditation.
bsb_text: I have more insight than all my teachers, for Your testimonies are my meditation.
aov_text: Ek is verstandiger as al my leermeesters, want u getuienisse is my bepeinsing.

kjv_text: I understand more than the ancients, because I keep thy precepts.
bsb_text: I discern more than the elders, for I obey Your precepts.
aov_text: Ek het meer verstand as die ou mense, want ek bewaar u bevele.

kjv_text: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, that I might keep thy word.
bsb_text: I have kept my feet from every evil path, that I may keep Your word.
aov_text: Ek het my voete teruggehou van elke verkeerde pad, dat ek u woord kan bewaar.

kjv_text: I have not departed from thy judgments: for thou hast taught me.
bsb_text: I have not departed from Your ordinances, for You Yourself have taught me.
aov_text: Ek het van u verordeninge nie afgewyk nie, want Ú het my geleer.

kjv_text: How sweet are thy words unto my taste! yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!
bsb_text: How sweet are Your words to my taste—sweeter than honey in my mouth!
aov_text: Hoe soet is u beloftes vir my verhemelte, meer as heuning vir my mond.

kjv_text: Through thy precepts I get understanding: therefore I hate every false way.
bsb_text: I gain understanding from Your precepts; therefore I hate every false way.
aov_text: Uit u bevele kry ek verstand; daarom haat ek elke leuenpad.

kjv_text: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
bsb_text: Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.
aov_text: U woord is ’n lamp vir my voet en ’n lig vir my pad.

kjv_text: I have sworn, and I will perform it, that I will keep thy righteous judgments.
bsb_text: I have sworn and confirmed that I will keep Your righteous judgments.
aov_text: Ek het gesweer, en dit gehou, om u regverdige verordeninge te onderhou.

kjv_text: I am afflicted very much: quicken me, O LORD, according unto thy word.
bsb_text: I am severely afflicted, O LORD; revive me through Your word.
aov_text: Ek is baie diep neergedruk; HERE, maak my lewend na u woord!

kjv_text: Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me thy judgments.
bsb_text: Accept the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me Your judgments.
aov_text: Laat tog die vrywillige offerandes van my mond U behaag, o HERE, en leer my u verordeninge.

kjv_text: My soul is continually in my hand: yet do I not forget thy law.
bsb_text: I constantly take my life in my hands, yet I do not forget Your law.
aov_text: My lewe is altyddeur in my hand; nogtans vergeet ek u wet nie.

kjv_text: The wicked have laid a snare for me: yet I erred not from thy precepts.
bsb_text: The wicked have set a snare for me, but I have not strayed from Your precepts.
aov_text: Die goddelose het vir my ’n vangnet gespan; nogtans het ek van u bevele nie afgedwaal nie.

kjv_text: Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever: for they are the rejoicing of my heart.
bsb_text: Your testimonies are my heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
aov_text: Ek het u getuienisse vir ewig as erfdeel ontvang, want hulle is die vreugde van my hart.

kjv_text: I have inclined mine heart to perform thy statutes alway, even unto the end.
bsb_text: I have inclined my heart to perform Your statutes, even to the very end.
aov_text: Ek het my hart geneig, om u insettinge te betrag, vir ewig, tot die einde toe.

kjv_text: I hate vain thoughts: but thy law do I love.
bsb_text: The double-minded I despise, but Your law I love.
aov_text: Twyfelaars haat ek, maar u wet het ek lief.

kjv_text: Thou art my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.
bsb_text: You are my hiding place and my shield; I put my hope in Your word.
aov_text: U is my skuilplek en my skild; op u woord wag ek.

kjv_text: Depart from me, ye evildoers: for I will keep the commandments of my God.
bsb_text: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may obey the commandments of my God.
aov_text: Gaan weg van my, kwaaddoeners, dat ek die gebooie van my God kan bewaar!

kjv_text: Uphold me according unto thy word, that I may live: and let me not be ashamed of my hope.
bsb_text: Sustain me as You promised, that I may live; let me not be ashamed of my hope.
aov_text: Ondersteun my volgens u belofte, dat ek kan lewe; en maak my nie beskaamd vanweë my hoop nie.

kjv_text: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe: and I will have respect unto thy statutes continually.
bsb_text: Uphold me, and I will be saved, that I may always regard Your statutes.
aov_text: Steun my, dat ek verlos word; dan sal ek altyddeur op u insettinge let.

kjv_text: Thou hast trodden down all them that err from thy statutes: for their deceit is falsehood.
bsb_text: You reject all who stray from Your statutes, for their deceitfulness is in vain.
aov_text: U verag almal wat van u insettinge afdwaal, want hulle bedrieëry is leuens.

kjv_text: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross: therefore I love thy testimonies.
bsb_text: All the wicked on earth You discard like dross; therefore I love Your testimonies.
aov_text: U ruim al die goddelose van die aarde weg soos skuim; daarom het ek u getuienisse lief.

kjv_text: My flesh trembleth for fear of thee; and I am afraid of thy judgments.
bsb_text: My flesh trembles in awe of You; I stand in fear of Your judgments.
aov_text: My vlees sidder van skrik vir U, en ek vrees vir u oordele.

kjv_text: I have done judgment and justice: leave me not to mine oppressors.
bsb_text: I have done what is just and right; do not leave me to my oppressors.
aov_text: Ek het reg en geregtigheid gedoen: gee my nie oor aan my verdrukkers nie.

kjv_text: Be surety for thy servant for good: let not the proud oppress me.
bsb_text: Ensure Your servant’s well-being; do not let the arrogant oppress me.
aov_text: Wees borg vir u kneg ten goede; laat vermeteles my nie verdruk nie.

kjv_text: Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, and for the word of thy righteousness.
bsb_text: My eyes fail, looking for Your salvation, and for Your righteous promise.
aov_text: My oë smag na u heil en na die belofte van u geregtigheid.

kjv_text: Deal with thy servant according unto thy mercy, and teach me thy statutes.
bsb_text: Deal with Your servant according to Your loving devotion, and teach me Your statutes.
aov_text: Handel met u kneg na u goedertierenheid, en leer my u insettinge.

kjv_text: I am thy servant; give me understanding, that I may know thy testimonies.
bsb_text: I am Your servant; give me understanding, that I may know Your testimonies.
aov_text: Ek is u kneg; maak my verstandig, dat ek u getuienisse kan ken.

kjv_text: It is time for thee, LORD, to work: for they have made void thy law.
bsb_text: It is time for the LORD to act, for they have broken Your law.
aov_text: Dit is tyd vir die HERE om te handel: hulle het u wet verbreek.

kjv_text: Therefore I love thy commandments above gold; yea, above fine gold.
bsb_text: Therefore I love Your commandments more than gold, even the purest gold.
aov_text: Daarom het ek u gebooie lief, meer as goud, ja, as baie fyn goud.

kjv_text: Therefore I esteem all thy precepts concerning all things to be right; and I hate every false way.
bsb_text: Therefore I admire all Your precepts and hate every false way.
aov_text: Daarom hou ek al die bevele aangaande alles vir reg; elke leuenpad haat ek.

kjv_text: Thy testimonies are wonderful: therefore doth my soul keep them.
bsb_text: Wonderful are Your testimonies; therefore I obey them.
aov_text: U getuienisse is wonderbaar; daarom bewaar my siel hulle.

kjv_text: The entrance of thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple.
bsb_text: The unfolding of Your words gives light; it informs the simple.
aov_text: Die opening van u woorde gee lig; dit maak die eenvoudiges verstandig.

kjv_text: I opened my mouth, and panted: for I longed for thy commandments.
bsb_text: I open my mouth and pant, longing for Your commandments.
aov_text: Ek maak my mond wyd oop en hyg, want na u gebooie verlang ek.

kjv_text: Look thou upon me, and be merciful unto me, as thou usest to do unto those that love thy name.
bsb_text: Turn to me and show me mercy, as You do to those who love Your name.
aov_text: Wend U tot my en wees my genadig volgens die reg van die wat u Naam liefhet.

kjv_text: Order my steps in thy word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.
bsb_text: Order my steps in Your word; let no sin rule over me.
aov_text: Maak my voetstappe vas in u woord, en laat geen ongeregtigheid oor my heers nie.

kjv_text: Deliver me from the oppression of man: so will I keep thy precepts.
bsb_text: Redeem me from the oppression of man, that I may keep Your precepts.
aov_text: Verlos my van die mens se verdrukking, sodat ek u bevele kan onderhou.

kjv_text: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; and teach me thy statutes.
bsb_text: Make Your face shine upon Your servant, and teach me Your statutes.
aov_text: Laat u aangesig skyn oor u kneg, en leer my u insettinge.

kjv_text: Rivers of waters run down mine eyes, because they keep not thy law.
bsb_text: My eyes shed streams of tears because Your law is not obeyed.
aov_text: My oë loop af in strome van water, omdat hulle u wet nie onderhou nie.

kjv_text: Righteous art thou, O LORD, and upright are thy judgments.
bsb_text: Righteous are You, O LORD, and upright are Your judgments.
aov_text: HERE, U is regverdig, en reg is u verordeninge.

kjv_text: Thy testimonies that thou hast commanded are righteous and very faithful.
bsb_text: The testimonies You have laid down are righteous and altogether faithful.
aov_text: In geregtigheid het U u getuienisse beveel en in louter trou.

kjv_text: My zeal hath consumed me, because mine enemies have forgotten thy words.
bsb_text: My zeal has consumed me because my foes forget Your words.
aov_text: My ywer verteer my, omdat my teëstanders u woorde vergeet het.

kjv_text: Thy word is very pure: therefore thy servant loveth it.
bsb_text: Your promise is completely pure; therefore Your servant loves it.
aov_text: U woord is deur en deur gelouter, en u kneg het dit lief.

kjv_text: I am small and despised: yet do not I forget thy precepts.
bsb_text: I am lowly and despised, but I do not forget Your precepts.
aov_text: Ek is klein en verag, maar u bevele vergeet ek nie.

kjv_text: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law is the truth.
bsb_text: Your righteousness is everlasting and Your law is true.
aov_text: U geregtigheid is geregtigheid tot in ewigheid, en u wet is waarheid.

kjv_text: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me: yet thy commandments are my delights.
bsb_text: Trouble and distress have found me, but Your commandments are my delight.
aov_text: Benoudheid en angs het my getref, maar u gebooie is my verlustiging.

kjv_text: The righteousness of thy testimonies is everlasting: give me understanding, and I shall live.
bsb_text: Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding, that I may live.
aov_text: U getuienisse is geregtigheid tot in ewigheid; maak my verstandig, dat ek kan lewe.

kjv_text: I cried with my whole heart; hear me, O LORD: I will keep thy statutes.
bsb_text: I call with all my heart; answer me, O LORD! I will obey Your statutes.
aov_text: Ek het geroep van ganser harte; verhoor my, o HERE! Ek wil u insettinge bewaar.

kjv_text: I cried unto thee; save me, and I shall keep thy testimonies.
bsb_text: I call to You; save me, that I may keep Your testimonies.
aov_text: Ek het U aangeroep; verlos my, dat ek u getuienisse kan onderhou.

kjv_text: I prevented the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in thy word.
bsb_text: I rise before dawn and cry for help; in Your word I have put my hope.
aov_text: Voor die môreskemering roep ek om hulp; op u woord wag ek.

kjv_text: Mine eyes prevent the night watches, that I might meditate in thy word.
bsb_text: My eyes anticipate the watches of night, that I may meditate on Your word.
aov_text: My oë is die nagwake voor om u woord te oordink.

kjv_text: Hear my voice according unto thy loving-kindness: O LORD, quicken me according to thy judgment.
bsb_text: Hear my voice, O LORD, according to Your loving devotion; give me life according to Your justice.
aov_text: Hoor my stem na u goedertierenheid; o HERE, maak my lewend volgens u verordeninge.

kjv_text: They draw nigh that follow after mischief: they are far from thy law.
bsb_text: Those who follow after wickedness draw near; they are far from Your law.
aov_text: Hulle kom nader wat skandelike dade najaag, hulle wat ver van u wet af is.

kjv_text: Thou art near, O LORD; and all thy commandments are truth.
bsb_text: You are near, O LORD, and all Your commandments are true.
aov_text: U, o HERE, is naby, en al u gebooie is waarheid.

kjv_text: Concerning thy testimonies, I have known of old that thou hast founded them for ever.
bsb_text: Long ago I learned from Your testimonies that You have established them forever.
aov_text: Lankal het ek geweet uit u getuienisse dat U hulle vir ewig gegrond het.

kjv_text: Consider mine affliction, and deliver me: for I do not forget thy law.
bsb_text: Look upon my affliction and rescue me, for I have not forgotten Your law.
aov_text: Sien my ellende aan en red my, want u wet vergeet ek nie.

kjv_text: Plead my cause, and deliver me: quicken me according to thy word.
bsb_text: Defend my cause and redeem me; revive me according to Your word.
aov_text: Verdedig my regsaak en verlos my; maak my lewend volgens u belofte.

kjv_text: Salvation is far from the wicked: for they seek not thy statutes.
bsb_text: Salvation is far from the wicked because they do not seek Your statutes.
aov_text: Die heil is ver van die goddelose, want hulle soek u insettinge nie.

kjv_text: Great are thy tender mercies, O LORD: quicken me according to thy judgments.
bsb_text: Great are Your mercies, O LORD; revive me according to Your ordinances.
aov_text: HERE, u barmhartighede is menigvuldig; maak my lewend volgens u verordeninge.

kjv_text: Many are my persecutors and mine enemies; yet do I not decline from thy testimonies.
bsb_text: Though my persecutors and foes are many, I have not turned from Your testimonies.
aov_text: My vervolgers en my teëstanders is talryk; van u getuienisse wyk ek nie af nie.

kjv_text: I beheld the transgressors, and was grieved; because they kept not thy word.
bsb_text: I look on the faithless with loathing because they do not keep Your word.
aov_text: Ek het diegene gesien wat troueloos handel, en dit het my gewalg dat hulle u woord nie onderhou nie.

kjv_text: Consider how I love thy precepts: quicken me, O LORD, according to thy loving-kindness.
bsb_text: Consider how I love Your precepts, O LORD; give me life according to Your loving devotion.
aov_text: Aanskou dat ek u bevele liefhet; o HERE, maak my lewend na u goedertierenheid.

kjv_text: Thy word is true from the beginning: and every one of thy righteous judgments endureth for ever.
bsb_text: The entirety of Your word is truth, and all Your righteous judgments endure forever.
aov_text: Die hele inhoud van u woord is waarheid, en al u regverdige verordeninge is tot in ewigheid.

kjv_text: Princes have persecuted me without a cause: but my heart standeth in awe of thy word.
bsb_text: Rulers persecute me without cause, but my heart fears only Your word.
aov_text: Vorste het my sonder oorsaak vervolg, maar my hart vrees vir u woord.

kjv_text: I rejoice at thy word, as one that findeth great spoil.
bsb_text: I rejoice in Your promise like one who finds great spoil.
aov_text: Ek is vrolik oor u belofte soos een wat ’n groot buit vind.

kjv_text: I hate and abhor lying: but thy law do I love.
bsb_text: I hate and abhor falsehood, but Your law I love.
aov_text: Leuens haat ek en het daar ’n afsku van; u wet het ek lief.

kjv_text: Seven times a day do I praise thee because of thy righteous judgments.
bsb_text: Seven times a day I praise You for Your righteous judgments.
aov_text: Ek loof u sewe maal elke dag oor u regverdige verordeninge.

kjv_text: Great peace have they which love thy law: and nothing shall offend them.
bsb_text: Abundant peace belongs to those who love Your law; nothing can make them stumble.
aov_text: Die wat u wet liefhet, het groot vrede, en vir hulle is daar geen struikelblok nie.

kjv_text: LORD, I have hoped for thy salvation, and done thy commandments.
bsb_text: I wait for Your salvation, O LORD, and I carry out Your commandments.
aov_text: o HERE, ek hoop op u heil, en ek hou u gebooie.

kjv_text: My soul hath kept thy testimonies; and I love them exceedingly.
bsb_text: I obey Your testimonies and love them greatly.
aov_text: My siel onderhou u getuienisse, en ek het hulle baie lief.

kjv_text: I have kept thy precepts and thy testimonies: for all my ways are before thee.
bsb_text: I obey Your precepts and Your testimonies, for all my ways are before You.
aov_text: Ek onderhou u bevele en u getuienisse, want al my weë is voor U.

kjv_text: Let my cry come near before thee, O LORD: give me understanding according to thy word.
bsb_text: May my cry come before You, O LORD; give me understanding according to Your word.
aov_text: o HERE, laat my smeking nader kom voor u aangesig; maak my verstandig volgens u woord.

kjv_text: Let my supplication come before thee: deliver me according to thy word.
bsb_text: May my plea come before You; rescue me according to Your promise.
aov_text: Laat my smeking voor u aangesig kom; red my volgens u belofte.

kjv_text: My lips shall utter praise, when thou hast taught me thy statutes.
bsb_text: My lips pour forth praise, for You teach me Your statutes.
aov_text: My lippe sal lofsange laat uitstroom, want U leer my u insettinge.

kjv_text: My tongue shall speak of thy word: for all thy commandments are righteousness.
bsb_text: My tongue sings of Your word, for all Your commandments are righteous.
aov_text: My tong sal u woord besing, want al u gebooie is geregtigheid.

kjv_text: Let thine hand help me; for I have chosen thy precepts.
bsb_text: May Your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen Your precepts.
aov_text: Laat u hand my tot hulp wees, want ek het u bevele verkies.

kjv_text: I have longed for thy salvation, O LORD; and thy law is my delight.
bsb_text: I long for Your salvation, O LORD, and Your law is my delight.
aov_text: o HERE, ek verlang na u heil, en u wet is my verlustiging.

kjv_text: Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; and let thy judgments help me.
bsb_text: Let me live to praise You; may Your judgments sustain me.
aov_text: Laat my siel lewe, dat dit U kan loof; en laat u gerigte my help.

kjv_text: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek thy servant; for I do not forget thy commandments.
bsb_text: I have strayed like a lost sheep; seek Your servant, for I have not forgotten Your commandments.
aov_text: Ek het gedwaal soos ’n verlore skaap; soek u kneg, want u gebooie vergeet ek nie.

kjv_text: A Song of degrees. In my distress I cried unto the LORD, and he heard me.
bsb_text: A song of ascents. In my distress I cried to the LORD, and He answered me.
aov_text: ’N BEDEVAARTSLIED. Ek roep die HERE aan in my benoudheid, en Hy verhoor my.

kjv_text: Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips, and from a deceitful tongue.
bsb_text: Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips and a deceitful tongue.
aov_text: o HERE, red my siel van die valse lippe, van die bedrieglike tong!

kjv_text: What shall be given unto thee? or what shall be done unto thee, thou false tongue?
bsb_text: What will He do to you, and what will be added to you, O deceitful tongue?
aov_text: Wat sal Hy jou gee of wat vir jou daaraan toevoeg, o bedrieglike tong?

kjv_text: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.
bsb_text: Sharp arrows will come from the warrior, with burning coals of the broom tree!
aov_text: Skerp pyle van ’n held saam met gloeiende kole van besembosse.

kjv_text: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech, that I dwell in the tents of Kedar!
bsb_text: Woe to me that I dwell in Meshech, that I live among the tents of Kedar!
aov_text: Wee my dat ek as vreemdeling vertoef in Meseg, dat ek by die tente van Kedar woon!

kjv_text: My soul hath long dwelt with him that hateth peace.
bsb_text: Too long have I dwelt among those who hate peace.
aov_text: Te lank al woon my siel by die wat die vrede haat.

kjv_text: I am for peace: but when I speak, they are for war.
bsb_text: I am in favor of peace; but when I speak, they want war.
aov_text: Ek is vredeliewend; maar as ek spreek, is hulle op oorlog uit.

kjv_text: A Song of degrees. I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.
bsb_text: A song of ascents. I lift up my eyes to the hills. From where does my help come?
aov_text: ’N BEDEVAARTSLIED. Ek slaan my oë op na die berge: waar sal my hulp vandaan kom?

kjv_text: My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.
bsb_text: My help comes from the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
aov_text: My hulp is van die HERE wat hemel en aarde gemaak het.

kjv_text: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.
bsb_text: He will not allow your foot to slip; your Protector will not slumber.
aov_text: Hy kan jou voet nie laat wankel nie; jou Bewaarder kan nie sluimer nie.

kjv_text: Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep.
bsb_text: Behold, the Protector of Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
aov_text: Kyk, die Bewaarder van Israel sluimer of slaap nie.

kjv_text: The LORD is thy keeper: the LORD is thy shade upon thy right hand.
bsb_text: The LORD is your keeper; the LORD is the shade on your right hand.
aov_text: Die HERE is jou Bewaarder; die HERE is jou skaduwee aan jou regterhand.

kjv_text: The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.
bsb_text: The sun will not strike you by day, nor the moon by night.
aov_text: Die son sal jou bedags nie steek nie, die maan ook nie by nag nie.

kjv_text: The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul.
bsb_text: The LORD will guard you from all evil; He will preserve your soul.
aov_text: Die HERE sal jou bewaar vir elke onheil; jou siel sal Hy bewaar.

kjv_text: The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.
bsb_text: The LORD will watch over your coming and going, both now and forevermore.
aov_text: Die HERE sal jou uitgang en jou ingang bewaar, van nou af tot in ewigheid.

kjv_text: A Song of degrees. I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the LORD.

aov_text: ’N BEDEVAARTSLIED. Van Dawid. Ek was bly toe hulle vir my gesê het: Laat ons na die huis van die HERE gaan!

kjv_text: Our feet shall stand within thy gates, O Jerusalem.
bsb_text: Our feet are standing in your gates, O Jerusalem.
aov_text: Ons voete staan in jou poorte, o Jerusalem!

kjv_text: Jerusalem is builded as a city that is compact together:
bsb_text: Jerusalem is built up as a city united together,
aov_text: Jerusalem wat gebou is soos ’n stad wat goed saamgevoeg is,

bsb_text: where the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, as a testimony for Israel, to give thanks to the name of the LORD.
aov_text: waarheen die stamme optrek, die stamme van die HERE—’n voorskrif vir Israel!—om die Naam van die HERE te loof.

kjv_text: For there are set thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of David.
bsb_text: For there the thrones of judgment stand, the thrones of the house of David.
aov_text: Want daar staan die stoele vir die gereg, die stoele van die huis van Dawid.

bsb_text: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: “May those who love you prosper.
aov_text: Bid om die vrede van Jerusalem; mag hulle wat jou liefhet, rustig lewe!

bsb_text: May there be peace within your walls, and prosperity inside your fortresses.”
aov_text: Mag daar vrede wees in jou skanse, rus in jou paleise!

kjv_text: For my brethren and companions' sakes, I will now say, Peace be within thee.
bsb_text: For the sake of my brothers and friends, I will say, “Peace be within you.”
aov_text: Ter wille van my broers en my vriende wil ek spreek: Vrede in jou!

aov_text: Ter wille van die huis van die HERE onse God wil ek die goeie vir jou soek.

kjv_text: A Song of degrees. Unto thee lift I up mine eyes, O thou that dwellest in the heavens.

aov_text: ’N BEDEVAARTSLIED. Ek slaan my oë op tot U wat in die hemel troon.

kjv_text: Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hand of their masters, and as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress; so our eyes wait upon the LORD our God, until that he have mercy upon us.
bsb_text: As the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maidservant look to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes are on the LORD our God until He shows us mercy.
aov_text: Kyk, soos die oë van die knegte is op die hand van hulle heer, soos die oë van die diensmaagd is op die hand van haar meesteres—so is ons oë op die HERE onse God, totdat Hy ons genadig is.

kjv_text: Have mercy upon us, O LORD, have mercy upon us: for we are exceedingly filled with contempt.
bsb_text: Have mercy on us, O LORD, have mercy, for we have endured much contempt.
aov_text: Wees ons genadig, o HERE, wees ons genadig, want meer as versadig is ons van veragting;

kjv_text: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease, and with the contempt of the proud.
bsb_text: We have endured much scorn from the arrogant, much contempt from the proud.
aov_text: meer as versadig is ons siel van die spot van die oormoediges, van die veragting van die trotsaards!

kjv_text: A Song of degrees of David. If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, now may Israel say;
bsb_text: A song of ascents. Of David. If the LORD had not been on our side—let Israel now declare—
aov_text: ’N BEDEVAARTSLIED. Van Dawid. As die HERE nie vir ons was nie—laat Israel dit sê —

kjv_text: If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, when men rose up against us:
bsb_text: if the LORD had not been on our side when men attacked us,
aov_text: as die HERE nie vir ons was toe die mense teen ons opgestaan het nie,

kjv_text: Then they had swallowed us up quick, when their wrath was kindled against us:
bsb_text: when their anger flared against us, then they would have swallowed us alive,
aov_text: dan het hulle ons lewendig verslind toe hulle toorn teen ons ontvlam het;

kjv_text: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul:
bsb_text: then the floods would have engulfed us, then the torrent would have overwhelmed us,
aov_text: dan het die waters ons oorstroom, ’n stroom het oor ons siel gegaan;

kjv_text: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.
bsb_text: then the raging waters would have swept us away.
aov_text: dan het die trotse waters oor ons siel gegaan.

kjv_text: Blessed be the LORD, who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.
bsb_text: Blessed be the LORD, who has not given us as prey to their teeth.
aov_text: Geloofd sy die HERE wat ons aan hulle tande nie as buit oorgegee het nie!

kjv_text: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.
bsb_text: We have escaped like a bird from the snare of the fowler; the net is torn, and we have slipped away.

bsb_text: Our help is in the name of the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
aov_text: Ons hulp is in die Naam van die HERE wat hemel en aarde gemaak het.

bsb_text: A song of ascents. Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion. It cannot be moved; it abides forever.
aov_text: ’N BEDEVAARTSLIED. Die wat op die HERE vertrou, is soos die berg Sion wat nie wankel nie, maar bly tot in ewigheid.

kjv_text: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, so the LORD is round about his people from henceforth even for ever.
bsb_text: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds His people, both now and forevermore.
aov_text: Rondom Jerusalem is berge; so is die HERE rondom sy volk van nou af tot in ewigheid.

kjv_text: For the rod of the wicked shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands unto iniquity.
bsb_text: For the scepter of the wicked will not rest upon the land allotted to the righteous, so that the righteous will not put forth their hands to injustice.
aov_text: Want die septer van goddeloosheid sal nie rus op die erfdeel van die regverdiges nie, sodat die regverdiges hulle hande nie sal uitsteek na onreg nie.

kjv_text: Do good, O LORD, unto those that be good, and to them that are upright in their hearts.
bsb_text: Do good, O LORD, to those who are good, and to the upright in heart.
aov_text: HERE, doen goed aan die goeies en aan die wat opreg is in hulle harte.

kjv_text: As for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, the LORD shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity: but peace shall be upon Israel.
bsb_text: But those who turn to crooked ways the LORD will banish with the evildoers. Peace be upon Israel.
aov_text: Maar die wat langs krom paaie wegdraai, sal die HERE laat vergaan saam met die werkers van ongeregtigheid. Vrede oor Israel!

kjv_text: A Song of degrees. When the LORD turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream.
bsb_text: A song of ascents. When the LORD restored the captives of Zion, we were like dreamers.
aov_text: ’N BEDEVAARTSLIED. Toe die HERE die lot van Sion verander het, was ons soos die wat droom.

kjv_text: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing: then said they among the heathen, The LORD hath done great things for them.
bsb_text: Then our mouths were filled with laughter, our tongues with shouts of joy. Then it was said among the nations, “The LORD has done great things for them.”
aov_text: Toe is ons mond gevul met gelag en ons tong met gejubel; toe het hulle onder die heidene gesê: Die HERE het groot dinge aan hierdie mense gedoen.

kjv_text: The LORD hath done great things for us; whereof we are glad.
bsb_text: The LORD has done great things for us; we are filled with joy.
aov_text: Die HERE het groot dinge aan ons gedoen: ons was bly!

kjv_text: Turn again our captivity, O LORD, as the streams in the south.
bsb_text: Restore our captives, O LORD, like streams in the Negev.
aov_text: o HERE, verander ons lot soos waterstrome in die Suidland.

kjv_text: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.
bsb_text: Those who sow in tears will reap with shouts of joy.
aov_text: Die wat met trane saai, sal met gejubel maai.

kjv_text: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing precious seed, shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves with him.
bsb_text: He who goes out weeping, bearing a trail of seed, will surely return with shouts of joy, carrying sheaves of grain.
aov_text: Hy loop aldeur en ween en dra die saadkoring; hy sal sekerlik kom met gejubel en sy gerwe dra.

kjv_text: A Song of degrees for Solomon. Except the LORD build the house, they labour in vain that build it: except the LORD keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain.
bsb_text: A song of ascents. Of Solomon. Unless the LORD builds the house, its builders labor in vain; unless the LORD protects the city, its watchmen stand guard in vain.
aov_text: ’N BEDEVAARTSLIED. Van Salomo. As die HERE die huis nie bou nie, tevergeefs werk die wat daaraan bou; as die HERE die stad nie bewaar nie, tevergeefs waak die wagter.

kjv_text: It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: for so he giveth his beloved sleep.
bsb_text: In vain you rise early and stay up late, toiling for bread to eat—for He gives sleep to His beloved.
aov_text: Tevergeefs dat julle vroeg opstaan, laat opbly, brood van smarte eet—net so goed gee Hy dit aan sy beminde in die slaap!

kjv_text: Lo, children are an heritage of the LORD: and the fruit of the womb is his reward.
bsb_text: Children are indeed a heritage from the LORD, and the fruit of the womb is His reward.
aov_text: Kyk, seuns is ’n erfdeel van die HERE; die vrug van die moederskoot is ’n beloning.

kjv_text: As arrows are in the hand of a mighty man; so are children of the youth.
bsb_text: Like arrows in the hand of a warrior, so are children born in one’s youth.
aov_text: Soos pyle in die hand van ’n held, so is die seuns van die jeug.

kjv_text: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: they shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate.
bsb_text: Blessed is the man whose quiver is full of them. He will not be put to shame when he confronts the enemies at the gate.
aov_text: Gelukkig is die man wat sy pylkoker daarmee gevul het! Hulle sal nie beskaamd staan as hulle met die vyande in die poort spreek nie.

kjv_text: A Song of degrees. Blessed is every one that feareth the LORD; that walketh in his ways.
bsb_text: A song of ascents. Blessed are all who fear the LORD, who walk in His ways!
aov_text: ’N BEDEVAARTSLIED. Welgeluksalig is elkeen wat die HERE vrees, wat in sy weë wandel!

kjv_text: For thou shalt eat the labour of thine hands: happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.
bsb_text: For when you eat the fruit of your labor, blessings and prosperity will be yours.
aov_text: Die opbrings van jou hande sal jy sekerlik eet; gelukkig is jy, en dit gaan met jou goed!

kjv_text: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine by the sides of thine house: thy children like olive plants round about thy table.
bsb_text: Your wife will be like a fruitful vine flourishing within your house, your sons like olive shoots sitting around your table.
aov_text: Jou vrou is soos ’n vrugbare wingerdstok binne-in jou huis; jou kinders soos olyfboompies rondom jou tafel.

kjv_text: Behold, that thus shall the man be blessed that feareth the LORD.
bsb_text: In this way indeed shall blessing come to the man who fears the LORD.
aov_text: Kyk, so sal sekerlik geseën word die man wat die HERE vrees.

kjv_text: The LORD shall bless thee out of Zion: and thou shalt see the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.
bsb_text: May the LORD bless you from Zion, that you may see the prosperity of Jerusalem all the days of your life,
aov_text: Mag die HERE jou seën uit Sion, dat jy die voorspoed van Jerusalem mag aanskou al die dae van jou lewe!

kjv_text: Yea, thou shalt see thy children's children, and peace upon Israel.
bsb_text: that you may see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel!
aov_text: En dat jy jou kindskinders mag aanskou! Vrede oor Israel!

kjv_text: A Song of degrees. Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, may Israel now say:
bsb_text: A song of ascents. Many a time they have persecuted me from my youth—let Israel now declare—
aov_text: ’N BEDEVAARTSLIED. Alreeds te veel het hulle my as vyand behandel van my jeug af—laat Israel dit sê —

kjv_text: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth: yet they have not prevailed against me.
bsb_text: many a time they have persecuted me from my youth, but they have not prevailed against me.
aov_text: alreeds te veel het hulle my as vyand behandel van my jeug af; tog het hulle my nie oorwin nie.

kjv_text: The plowers plowed upon my back: they made long their furrows.
bsb_text: The plowmen plowed over my back; they made their furrows long.
aov_text: Ploeërs het op my rug geploeg; hulle het hul vore lank getrek.

kjv_text: The LORD is righteous: he hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.
bsb_text: The LORD is righteous; He has cut me from the cords of the wicked.
aov_text: Die HERE is regverdig: Hy het die toue van die goddelose afgekap.

kjv_text: Let them all be confounded and turned back that hate Zion.
bsb_text: May all who hate Zion be turned back in shame.
aov_text: Laat hulle beskaamd staan en agteruitwyk, almal wat Sion haat.

kjv_text: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, which withereth afore it groweth up:
bsb_text: May they be like grass on the rooftops, which withers before it can grow,
aov_text: Laat hulle word soos gras op die dakke wat verdor voordat ’n mens dit uittrek,

kjv_text: Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand; nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom.
bsb_text: unable to fill the hands of the reaper, or the arms of the binder of sheaves.
aov_text: waarmee die maaier sy hand en die gerwebinder sy arm nie vul nie.

kjv_text: Neither do they which go by say, The blessing of the LORD be upon you: we bless you in the name of the LORD.
bsb_text: May none who pass by say to them, “The blessing of the LORD be on you; we bless you in the name of the LORD.”
aov_text: Sodat die wat verbygaan, nie sê nie: Die seën van die HERE oor julle! Ons seën julle in die Naam van die HERE.

kjv_text: A Song of degrees. Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O LORD.
bsb_text: A song of ascents. Out of the depths I cry to You, O LORD!
aov_text: ’N BEDEVAARTSLIED. Uit die dieptes roep ek U aan, o HERE!

kjv_text: Lord, hear my voice: let thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.
bsb_text: O Lord, hear my voice; let Your ears be attentive to my plea for mercy.
aov_text: Here, hoor na my stem; laat u ore luister na die stem van my smekinge.

kjv_text: If thou, LORD, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who shall stand?
bsb_text: If You, O LORD, kept track of iniquities, then who, O Lord, could stand?
aov_text: As U, HERE, die ongeregtighede in gedagtenis hou, Here, wie sal bestaan?

kjv_text: But there is forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared.
bsb_text: But with You there is forgiveness, so that You may be feared.
aov_text: Maar by U is vergewing, dat U gevrees mag word.

kjv_text: I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.
bsb_text: I wait for the LORD; my soul does wait, and in His word I put my hope.
aov_text: Ek wag op die HERE; my siel wag, en ek hoop op sy woord.

bsb_text: My soul waits for the Lord more than watchmen wait for the morning—more than watchmen wait for the morning.
aov_text: My siel wag op die Here meer as wagters op die môre, wagters op die môre.

kjv_text: Let Israel hope in the LORD: for with the LORD there is mercy, and with him is plenteous redemption.
bsb_text: O Israel, put your hope in the LORD, for with the LORD is loving devotion, and with Him is redemption in abundance.
aov_text: Wag op die HERE, o Israel! want by die HERE is die goedertierenheid, en by Hom is daar veel verlossing;

kjv_text: And he shall redeem Israel from all his iniquities.
bsb_text: And He will redeem Israel from all iniquity.
aov_text: en Hy self sal Israel verlos van al sy ongeregtighede.

kjv_text: A Song of degrees of David. Lord, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty: neither do I exercise myself in great matters, or in things too high for me.
bsb_text: A song of ascents. Of David. My heart is not proud, O LORD, my eyes are not haughty. I do not aspire to great things or matters too lofty for me.
aov_text: ’N BEDEVAARTSLIED. Van Dawid. o HERE, my hart is nie hoog en my oë nie trots nie; ook wandel ek nie in dinge wat vir my te groot en te wonderbaar is nie.

kjv_text: Surely I have behaved and quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother: my soul is even as a weaned child.
bsb_text: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul; like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.
aov_text: Waarlik, ek het my siel tot bedaring gebring en stilgemaak; soos ’n gespeende kind by sy moeder, soos ’n gespeende kind is my siel in my.

kjv_text: Let Israel hope in the LORD from henceforth and for ever.
bsb_text: O Israel, put your hope in the LORD, both now and forevermore.
aov_text: Wag op die HERE, o Israel, van nou af tot in ewigheid!

kjv_text: A Song of degrees. Lord, remember David, and all his afflictions:
bsb_text: A song of ascents. O LORD, remember on behalf of David all the hardships he endured,
aov_text: ’N BEDEVAARTSLIED. o HERE, dink aan Dawid, aan al sy moeite;

kjv_text: How he sware unto the LORD, and vowed unto the mighty God of Jacob;
bsb_text: how he swore an oath to the LORD, and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:
aov_text: dat hy aan die HERE gesweer het, hierdie gelofte gedoen het aan die Magtige van Jakob:

kjv_text: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house, nor go up into my bed;
bsb_text: “I will not enter my house or get into my bed,
aov_text: Sekerlik sal ek nie ingaan in die tent van my woning of klim op die bed wat vir my gesprei is nie;

kjv_text: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, or slumber to mine eyelids,
bsb_text: I will not give sleep to my eyes or slumber to my eyelids,
aov_text: sekerlik sal ek my oë geen slaap gun, aan my ooglede geen sluimering nie,

kjv_text: Until I find out a place for the LORD, an habitation for the mighty God of Jacob.
bsb_text: until I find a place for the LORD, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob.”
aov_text: totdat ek ’n plek vind vir die HERE, ’n woning vir die Magtige van Jakob!

kjv_text: Lo, we heard of it at Ephratah: we found it in the fields of the wood.
bsb_text: We heard that the ark was in Ephrathah; we found it in the fields of Jaar.
aov_text: Kyk, ons het daarvan gehoor in Éfrata; ons het dit gevind in die velde van Jaär.

kjv_text: We will go into his tabernacles: we will worship at his footstool.
bsb_text: Let us go to His dwelling place; let us worship at His footstool.
aov_text: Laat ons na sy woning gaan, ons neerbuig voor die voetbank van sy voete.

kjv_text: Arise, O LORD, into thy rest; thou, and the ark of thy strength.
bsb_text: Arise, O LORD, to Your resting place, You and the ark of Your strength.
aov_text: Staan op na u rusplek, HERE, U en die ark van u sterkte!

kjv_text: Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness; and let thy saints shout for joy.
bsb_text: May Your priests be clothed with righteousness, and Your saints shout for joy.
aov_text: Laat u priesters bekleed wees met geregtigheid, en laat u gunsgenote jubel.

kjv_text: For thy servant David's sake turn not away the face of thine anointed.
bsb_text: For the sake of Your servant David, do not reject Your anointed one.
aov_text: Wys u gesalfde nie af nie, ter wille van Dawid, u kneg.

bsb_text: The LORD swore an oath to David, a promise He will not revoke: “One of your descendants I will place on your throne.
aov_text: Die HERE het aan Dawid gesweer in waarheid (Hy sal daarvan nie terugkom nie): Van die vrug van jou liggaam sal Ek laat sit op jou troon.

kjv_text: If thy children will keep my covenant and my testimony that I shall teach them, their children shall also sit upon thy throne for evermore.
bsb_text: If your sons keep My covenant and the testimony I will teach them, then their sons will also sit on your throne forever and ever.”
aov_text: As jou seuns my verbond hou en my getuienisse wat Ek hulle leer, dan sal húlle seuns ook vir ewig op jou troon sit.

kjv_text: For the LORD hath chosen Zion; he hath desired it for his habitation.
bsb_text: For the LORD has chosen Zion; He has desired it for His home:
aov_text: Want die HERE het Sion uitgekies, Hy het dit as woonplek vir Hom begeer en gesê:

kjv_text: This is my rest for ever: here will I dwell; for I have desired it.
bsb_text: “This is My resting place forever and ever; here I will dwell, for I have desired this home.
aov_text: Dit is my rusplek vir ewig; hier wil Ek woon, want Ek het dit begeer.

kjv_text: I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.
bsb_text: I will bless her with abundant provisions; I will satisfy her poor with bread.
aov_text: Sy voedsel sal Ek ryklik seën, sy behoeftiges versadig met brood;

kjv_text: I will also clothe her priests with salvation: and her saints shall shout aloud for joy.
bsb_text: I will clothe her priests with salvation, and her saints will sing out in joy.
aov_text: en sy priesters sal Ek met heil beklee, en sy gunsgenote sal vrolik jubel.

kjv_text: There will I make the horn of David to bud: I have ordained a lamp for mine anointed.
bsb_text: There I will make a horn grow for David; I have prepared a lamp for My anointed one.
aov_text: Daar sal Ek vir Dawid ’n horing laat uitspruit; Ek het vir my gesalfde ’n lamp toeberei.

kjv_text: His enemies will I clothe with shame: but upon himself shall his crown flourish.
bsb_text: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but the crown upon him will gleam.”
aov_text: Ek sal sy vyande met skaamte beklee, maar op hom sal sy kroon skitter.

kjv_text: A Song of degrees of David. Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!
bsb_text: A song of ascents. Of David. Behold, how good and pleasant it is when brothers live together in harmony!
aov_text: ’N BEDEVAARTSLIED. Van Dawid. Kyk, hoe goed en hoe lieflik is dit dat broers ook saamwoon!

kjv_text: It is like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, even Aaron's beard: that went down to the skirts of his garments;
bsb_text: It is like fine oil on the head, running down on the beard, running down Aaron’s beard over the collar of his robes.
aov_text: Dit is soos die kosbare olie op die hoof, wat afloop op die baard, die baard van Aäron, wat afloop op die soom van sy klere.

kjv_text: As the dew of Hermon, and as the dew that descended upon the mountains of Zion: for there the LORD commanded the blessing, even life for evermore.
bsb_text: It is like the dew of Hermon falling on the mountains of Zion. For there the LORD has bestowed the blessing of life forevermore.
aov_text: Dit is soos die dou van Hermon wat neerdaal op die berge van Sion; want daar gebied die HERE die seën, die lewe tot in ewigheid!

kjv_text: A Song of degrees. Behold, bless ye the LORD, all ye servants of the LORD, which by night stand in the house of the LORD.
bsb_text: A song of ascents. Come, bless the LORD, all you servants of the LORD who serve by night in the house of the LORD!
aov_text: ’N BEDEVAARTSLIED. Kom, loof die HERE, o alle knegte van die HERE wat snags in die huis van die HERE staan!

kjv_text: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary, and bless the LORD.
bsb_text: Lift up your hands to the sanctuary and bless the LORD!
aov_text: Hef julle hande op na die heiligdom, en loof die HERE!

kjv_text: The LORD that made heaven and earth bless thee out of Zion.
bsb_text: May the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth, bless you from Zion.

bsb_text: Before the mountains were settled, before the hills, I was brought forth,
aov_text: voordat die berge ingesink het, voor die heuwels is ek gebore;

kjv_text: While as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the highest part of the dust of the world.
bsb_text: before He made the land or fields, or any of the dust of the earth.
aov_text: toe Hy die aarde en die velde en al die stoffies van die wêreld nog nie gemaak het nie.

kjv_text: When he prepared the heavens, I was there: when he set a compass upon the face of the depth:
bsb_text: I was there when He established the heavens, when He inscribed a circle on the face of the deep,
aov_text: Toe Hy die hemele berei het, was ek daar; toe Hy ’n kring afgetrek het op die oppervlakte van die wêreldvloed;

kjv_text: When he established the clouds above: when he strengthened the fountains of the deep:
bsb_text: when He established the clouds above, when the fountains of the deep gushed forth,
aov_text: toe Hy die wolke daarbo bevestig het, toe die bronne van die wêreldvloed sterk geword het;

kjv_text: When he gave to the sea his decree, that the waters should not pass his commandment: when he appointed the foundations of the earth:
bsb_text: when He set a boundary for the sea, so that the waters would not surpass His command, when He marked out the foundations of the earth.
aov_text: toe Hy vir die see sy grens gestel het, dat die waters sy bevel nie sou oortree nie; toe Hy die fondamente van die aarde vasgelê het —

kjv_text: Then I was by him, as one brought up with him: and I was daily his delight, rejoicing always before him;
bsb_text: Then I was a skilled craftsman at His side, and His delight day by day, rejoicing always in His presence.
aov_text: toe was ek ’n kunstenaar naas Hom, en ek was dag vir dag vol verlustiging en het gespeel voor sy aangesig altyd,

kjv_text: Rejoicing in the habitable part of his earth; and my delights were with the sons of men.
bsb_text: I was rejoicing in His whole world, delighting together in the sons of men.
aov_text: en het gespeel op sy wêreldrond, en my verlustiginge was met die mensekinders.

kjv_text: Now therefore hearken unto me, O ye children: for blessed are they that keep my ways.
bsb_text: Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.
aov_text: Luister dan nou na my, seuns; want gelukkig is hulle wat my weë bewaar.

kjv_text: Hear instruction, and be wise, and refuse it not.
bsb_text: Listen to instruction and be wise; do not ignore it.
aov_text: Luister na tug en word wys, en verwerp dit nie.

kjv_text: Blessed is the man that heareth me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at the posts of my doors.
bsb_text: Blessed is the man who listens to me, watching daily at my doors, waiting at the posts of my doorway.
aov_text: Gelukkig is die mens wat na my luister, om dag vir dag te waak aan my deure, by die syposte van my poorte die wag te hou.

kjv_text: For whoso findeth me findeth life, and shall obtain favour of the LORD.
bsb_text: For whoever finds me finds life and obtains the favor of the LORD.
aov_text: Want hy wat my vind, het die lewe gevind en verkry ’n welbehae van die HERE.

kjv_text: But he that sinneth against me wrongeth his own soul: all they that hate me love death.
bsb_text: But he who fails to find me harms himself; all who hate me love death.”
aov_text: Maar hy wat my mis, benadeel sy eie lewe; almal wat my haat, het die dood lief.

kjv_text: Wisdom hath builded her house, she hath hewn out her seven pillars:
bsb_text: Wisdom has built her house; she has carved out her seven pillars.
aov_text: DIE Wysheid het haar huis gebou, haar sewe pilare uitgekap,

kjv_text: She hath killed her beasts; she hath mingled her wine; she hath also furnished her table.
bsb_text: She has prepared her meat and mixed her wine; she has also set her table.
aov_text: haar slagvee geslag, haar wyn gemeng, ook haar tafel gedek.

kjv_text: She hath sent forth her maidens: she crieth upon the highest places of the city,
bsb_text: She has sent out her maidservants; she calls out from the heights of the city.
aov_text: Sy het haar diensmeisies uitgestuur, sy nooi uit op die hange van die stadshoogtes:

kjv_text: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: as for him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,
bsb_text: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!” she says to him who lacks judgment.
aov_text: Wie eenvoudig is, laat hy inkom hierheen, wie verstandeloos is, vir hom sê sy:

kjv_text: Come, eat of my bread, and drink of the wine which I have mingled.
bsb_text: “Come, eat my bread and drink the wine I have mixed.
aov_text: Kom, eet julle van my brood, en drink van die wyn wat ek gemeng het;

kjv_text: Forsake the foolish, and live; and go in the way of understanding.
bsb_text: Leave your folly behind, and you will live; walk in the way of understanding.”
aov_text: laat staan die eenvoudigheid, dan sal julle lewe, en betree die weg van verstand.

kjv_text: He that reproveth a scorner getteth to himself shame: and he that rebuketh a wicked man getteth himself a blot.
bsb_text: He who corrects a mocker brings shame on himself; he who rebukes a wicked man taints himself.
aov_text: Hy wat ’n spotter teregwys, behaal vir homself skande, en hy wat ’n goddelose bestraf, vir homself ’n skandvlek.

kjv_text: Reprove not a scorner, lest he hate thee: rebuke a wise man, and he will love thee.
bsb_text: Do not rebuke a mocker, or he will hate you; rebuke a wise man, and he will love you.
aov_text: Bestraf ’n spotter nie, anders haat hy jou; bestraf ’n wyse, en hy sal jou liefhê.

kjv_text: Give instruction to a wise man, and he will be yet wiser: teach a just man, and he will increase in learning.
bsb_text: Instruct a wise man, and he will be wiser still; teach a righteous man, and he will increase his learning.
aov_text: Deel mee aan die wyse, en hy sal nog wyser word, leer die regverdige, en hy sal insig vermeerder.

kjv_text: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy is understanding.
bsb_text: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom, and knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
aov_text: Die beginsel van die wysheid is die vrees van die HERE, en kennis van die Heilige is verstand.

kjv_text: For by me thy days shall be multiplied, and the years of thy life shall be increased.
bsb_text: For through wisdom your days will be multiplied, and years will be added to your life.
aov_text: Want deur my word jou dae meer en word jare van lewe vir jou toegevoeg.

kjv_text: If thou be wise, thou shalt be wise for thyself: but if thou scornest, thou alone shalt bear it.
bsb_text: If you are wise, you are wise to your own advantage; but if you scoff, you alone will bear the consequences.
aov_text: As jy wys is, is jy wys tot jou voordeel, en is jy ’n spotter, dan moet jy dit alleen dra.

kjv_text: A foolish woman is clamorous: she is simple, and knoweth nothing.
bsb_text: The woman named Folly is loud; she is naive and knows nothing.
aov_text: Vrou Dwaasheid is onrustig, pure eenvoudigheid en heeltemal onkundig;

kjv_text: For she sitteth at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,
bsb_text: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat in the heights of the city,
aov_text: en sy sit by die deur van haar huis, op ’n stoel op die hoogtes van die stad,

kjv_text: To call passengers who go right on their ways:
bsb_text: calling out to those who pass by, who make their paths straight.
aov_text: om te nooi die wat op die weg verbygaan, die wat op hulle paaie reguit wandel:

kjv_text: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: and as for him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,
bsb_text: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!” she says to him who lacks judgment.
aov_text: Wie eenvoudig is, laat hy inkom hierheen! En die verstandelose, aan hom sê sy:

kjv_text: Stolen waters are sweet, and bread eaten in secret is pleasant.
bsb_text: “Stolen water is sweet, and bread eaten in secret is tasty!”
aov_text: Gesteelde waters is soet, en brood in die geheim geëet, is lekker.

kjv_text: But he knoweth not that the dead are there; and that her guests are in the depths of hell.
bsb_text: But they do not know that the dead are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.
aov_text: Maar hy weet nie dat dáár skimme is, dat haar genooides in die dieptes van die doderyk is nie.

kjv_text: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish son is the heaviness of his mother.
bsb_text: The proverbs of Solomon: A wise son brings joy to his father, but a foolish son grief to his mother.
aov_text: DIE spreuke van Salomo. ’n Wyse seun verbly die vader, maar ’n dwase seun is ’n bekommernis vir sy moeder.

kjv_text: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing: but righteousness delivereth from death.
bsb_text: Ill-gotten treasures profit nothing, but righteousness brings deliverance from death.
aov_text: Skatte deur goddeloosheid verwerf, bring geen voordeel nie, maar geregtigheid red van die dood.

kjv_text: The LORD will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish: but he casteth away the substance of the wicked.
bsb_text: The LORD does not let the righteous go hungry, but He denies the craving of the wicked.
aov_text: Die HERE laat die regverdige nie honger ly nie, maar die begeerlikheid van die goddelose stoot Hy weg.

kjv_text: He becometh poor that dealeth with a slack hand: but the hand of the diligent maketh rich.
bsb_text: Idle hands make one poor, but diligent hands bring wealth.
aov_text: Hy word arm wat met ’n trae hand werk, maar die hand van die vlytiges maak ryk.

kjv_text: He that gathereth in summer is a wise son: but he that sleepeth in harvest is a son that causeth shame.
bsb_text: He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during harvest is a disgraceful son.
aov_text: Hy wat in die somer wegbêre, is ’n verstandige seun; hy wat vas slaap in die oestyd, is ’n seun wat skande maak.

kjv_text: Blessings are upon the head of the just: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.
bsb_text: Blessings are on the head of the righteous, but the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.
aov_text: Seëninge is daar op die hoof van die regverdige, maar die mond van die goddelose verberg geweld.

kjv_text: The memory of the just is blessed: but the name of the wicked shall rot.
bsb_text: The memory of the righteous is a blessing, but the name of the wicked will rot.
aov_text: Die nagedagtenis van die regverdige is tot seën, maar die naam van die goddelose vergaan.

kjv_text: The wise in heart will receive commandments: but a prating fool shall fall.
bsb_text: A wise heart will receive commandments, but foolish lips will come to ruin.
aov_text: Hy wat wys van hart is, neem die gebooie aan, maar hy wat dwaas van lippe is, kom tot ’n val.

kjv_text: He that walketh uprightly walketh surely: but he that perverteth his ways shall be known.
bsb_text: He who walks in integrity walks securely, but he who perverts his ways will be found out.
aov_text: Hy wat in opregtheid wandel, wandel veilig, maar hy wat sy weë krom maak, word bekend.

kjv_text: He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow: but a prating fool shall fall.
bsb_text: He who winks the eye causes grief, and foolish lips will come to ruin.
aov_text: Hy wat met sy oog knip, veroorsaak smart, en hy wat dwaas spreek, kom tot ’n val.

kjv_text: The mouth of a righteous man is a well of life: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.
bsb_text: The mouth of the righteous is a fountain of life, but the mouth of the wicked conceals violence.
aov_text: Die mond van die regverdige is ’n fontein van lewe, maar die mond van die goddelose verberg geweld.

kjv_text: Hatred stirreth up strifes: but love covereth all sins.
bsb_text: Hatred stirs up dissension, but love covers all transgressions.
aov_text: Haat verwek twiste, maar liefde bedek al die oortredinge.

kjv_text: In the lips of him that hath understanding wisdom is found: but a rod is for the back of him that is void of understanding.
bsb_text: Wisdom is found on the lips of the discerning, but a rod is for the back of him who lacks judgment.
aov_text: Op die lippe van die verstandige word wysheid gevind, maar die roede is vir die rug van die verstandelose.

kjv_text: Wise men lay up knowledge: but the mouth of the foolish is near destruction.
bsb_text: The wise store up knowledge, but the mouth of the fool invites destruction.
aov_text: Die wyse lê kennis weg, maar die mond van die dwaas is ’n ondergang wat naby is.

kjv_text: The rich man's wealth is his strong city: the destruction of the poor is their poverty.
bsb_text: The wealth of the rich man is his fortified city, but poverty is the ruin of the poor.
aov_text: Die goed van die ryke is vir hom ’n sterk stad; die ondergang van die behoeftiges is hulle armoede.

kjv_text: The labour of the righteous tendeth to life: the fruit of the wicked to sin.
bsb_text: The labor of the righteous leads to life, but the gain of the wicked brings punishment.
aov_text: Wat die regverdige verwerf, is vir die lewe; die inkomste van die goddelose is tot sonde.

kjv_text: He is in the way of life that keepeth instruction: but he that refuseth reproof erreth.
bsb_text: Whoever heeds instruction is on the path to life, but he who ignores reproof goes astray.
aov_text: ’n Pad ten lewe is hy wat die tug in ag neem; maar hy wat die teregwysing veronagsaam, raak verdwaald.

kjv_text: He that hideth hatred with lying lips, and he that uttereth a slander, is a fool.
bsb_text: The one who conceals hatred has lying lips, and whoever spreads slander is a fool.
aov_text: Hy wat haat verberg, het valse lippe; en hy wat skindertaal uitstrooi, is ’n dwaas.

kjv_text: In the multitude of words there wanteth not sin: but he that refraineth his lips is wise.
bsb_text: When words are many, sin is unavoidable, but he who restrains his lips is wise.
aov_text: By veelheid van woorde ontbreek die oortreding nie; maar hy wat sy lippe inhou, handel verstandig.

kjv_text: The tongue of the just is as choice silver: the heart of the wicked is little worth.
bsb_text: The tongue of the righteous is choice silver, but the heart of the wicked has little worth.
aov_text: Die tong van die regverdige is uitgesoekte silwer; die hart van die goddelose is min werd.

kjv_text: The lips of the righteous feed many: but fools die for want of wisdom.
bsb_text: The lips of the righteous feed many, but fools die for lack of judgment.
aov_text: Die lippe van die regverdige help baie mense reg; maar die dwase sterf deur gebrek aan verstand.

kjv_text: The blessing of the LORD, it maketh rich, and he addeth no sorrow with it.
bsb_text: The blessing of the LORD enriches, and He adds no sorrow to it.
aov_text: Die seën van die HERE—dit maak ryk, en moeitevolle arbeid voeg daar niks by nie.

kjv_text: It is as sport to a fool to do mischief: but a man of understanding hath wisdom.
bsb_text: The fool delights in shameful conduct, but a man of understanding has wisdom.
aov_text: Dit is ’n vermaak vir ’n dwaas om ’n skandelike daad te doen, net so is wysheid vir ’n man van verstand.

kjv_text: The fear of the wicked, it shall come upon him: but the desire of the righteous shall be granted.
bsb_text: What the wicked man dreads will overtake him, but the desire of the righteous will be granted.
aov_text: Waar die goddelose bang voor is—dit kom oor hom; maar die begeerte van die regverdiges vervul Hy.

kjv_text: As the whirlwind passeth, so is the wicked no more: but the righteous is an everlasting foundation.
bsb_text: When the whirlwind passes, the wicked are no more, but the righteous are secure forever.
aov_text: Wanneer ’n stormwind verbygaan, is die goddelose nie meer nie; maar die regverdige is vir ewig gegrondves.

kjv_text: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to them that send him.
bsb_text: Like vinegar to the teeth and smoke to the eyes, so is the slacker to those who send him.
aov_text: Soos asyn vir die tande en soos rook vir die oë, so is die luiaard vir die wat hom stuur.

kjv_text: The fear of the LORD prolongeth days: but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.
bsb_text: The fear of the LORD prolongs life, but the years of the wicked will be cut short.
aov_text: Die vrees van die HERE vermeerder die dae, maar die jare van die goddelose word verkort.

kjv_text: The hope of the righteous shall be gladness: but the expectation of the wicked shall perish.
bsb_text: The hope of the righteous is joy, but the expectations of the wicked will perish.
aov_text: Die verwagting van die regverdiges is vreugde, maar die hoop van die goddelose vergaan.

kjv_text: The way of the LORD is strength to the upright: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.
bsb_text: The way of the LORD is a refuge to the upright, but destruction awaits those who do evil.
aov_text: Die weg van die HERE is vir die opregte ’n vesting, maar ’n ondergang vir die werkers van ongeregtigheid.

kjv_text: The righteous shall never be removed: but the wicked shall not inhabit the earth.
bsb_text: The righteous will never be shaken, but the wicked will not inhabit the land.
aov_text: Die regverdige sal vir ewig nie wankel nie, maar die goddelose sal in die land nie bly woon nie.

kjv_text: The mouth of the just bringeth forth wisdom: but the froward tongue shall be cut out.
bsb_text: The mouth of the righteous brings forth wisdom, but a perverse tongue will be cut out.
aov_text: Die mond van die regverdige laat wysheid uitspruit, maar die valse tong word uitgeroei.

kjv_text: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable: but the mouth of the wicked speaketh frowardness.
bsb_text: The lips of the righteous know what is fitting, but the mouth of the wicked is perverse.
aov_text: Die lippe van die regverdige weet wat welgevallig is, maar die mond van die goddelose is pure valsheid.

kjv_text: A false balance is abomination to the LORD: but a just weight is his delight.
bsb_text: Dishonest scales are an abomination to the LORD, but an accurate weight is His delight.
aov_text: ’N VALSE weegskaal is vir die HERE ’n gruwel, maar in ’n volle gewig het Hy behae.

kjv_text: When pride cometh, then cometh shame: but with the lowly is wisdom.
bsb_text: When pride comes, disgrace follows, but with humility comes wisdom.
aov_text: Kom die vermetelheid, dan kom die skande, maar by die beskeidenes is wysheid.

kjv_text: The integrity of the upright shall guide them: but the perverseness of transgressors shall destroy them.
bsb_text: The integrity of the upright guides them, but the perversity of the faithless destroys them.
aov_text: Die regskapenheid van die opregtes is vir hulle ’n leier, maar die valsheid van die ontroues vernietig hulle.

kjv_text: Riches profit not in the day of wrath: but righteousness delivereth from death.
bsb_text: Riches are worthless in the day of wrath, but righteousness brings deliverance from death.
aov_text: Goed bring geen voordeel op die dag van die grimmigheid nie, maar geregtigheid red van die dood.

kjv_text: The righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way: but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.
bsb_text: The righteousness of the blameless directs their path, but the wicked fall by their own wickedness.
aov_text: Die geregtigheid van die regskapene maak sy weg gelyk, maar die goddelose val deur sy goddeloosheid.

kjv_text: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them: but transgressors shall be taken in their own naughtiness.
bsb_text: The righteousness of the upright delivers them, but the faithless are trapped by their own desires.
aov_text: Die geregtigheid van die opregtes red hulle, maar deur hulle eie begeerlikheid word die ontroues gevang.

kjv_text: When a wicked man dieth, his expectation shall perish: and the hope of unjust men perisheth.
bsb_text: When the wicked man dies, his hope perishes, and the hope of his strength vanishes.
aov_text: By die dood van ’n goddelose mens gaan sy hoop tot niet, en die verwagting van die roekelose het vergaan.

kjv_text: The righteous is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked cometh in his stead.
bsb_text: The righteous man is delivered from trouble; in his place the wicked man goes in.
aov_text: Word die regverdige uit die benoudheid gered, dan kom die goddelose in sy plek.

kjv_text: An hypocrite with his mouth destroyeth his neighbour: but through knowledge shall the just be delivered.
bsb_text: With his mouth the ungodly man destroys his neighbor, but through knowledge the righteous are rescued.
aov_text: Deur die mond stort die roekelose sy naaste in die verderf, maar deur kennis word die regverdiges gered.

kjv_text: When it goeth well with the righteous, the city rejoiceth: and when the wicked perish, there is shouting.
bsb_text: When the righteous thrive, the city rejoices, and when the wicked perish, there are shouts of joy.
aov_text: Oor die voorspoed van die regverdiges jubel ’n stad, en as die goddelose omkom, is daar gejubel.

kjv_text: By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted: but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
bsb_text: By the blessing of the upright a city is built up, but by the mouth of the wicked it is torn down.
aov_text: Deur die seën van die opregtes kom ’n stad op, maar deur die mond van die goddelose word dit afgebreek.

kjv_text: He that is void of wisdom despiseth his neighbour: but a man of understanding holdeth his peace.
bsb_text: Whoever shows contempt for his neighbor lacks judgment, but a man of understanding remains silent.
aov_text: Die verstandelose verag sy naaste, maar ’n verstandige man bly stil.

kjv_text: A talebearer revealeth secrets: but he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth the matter.
bsb_text: A gossip reveals a secret, but a trustworthy person keeps a confidence.
aov_text: Die wat met kwaadsprekery omgaan, maak ’n geheim openbaar, maar hy wat betroubaar is van gees, bedek ’n saak.

kjv_text: Where no counsel is, the people fall: but in the multitude of counsellors there is safety.
bsb_text: For lack of guidance, a nation falls, but with many counselors comes deliverance.
aov_text: As daar nie goeie oorleg is nie, val ’n volk; maar in die veelheid van raadgewers is redding.

kjv_text: He that is surety for a stranger shall smart for it: and he that hateth suretiship is sure.
bsb_text: He who puts up security for a stranger will surely suffer, but the one who hates indebtedness is secure.
aov_text: Baie sleg word iemand behandel as hy vir ’n ander borg gestaan het; maar hy wat haat wie die handslag gee, is veilig.

kjv_text: A gracious woman retaineth honour: and strong men retain riches.
bsb_text: A gracious woman attains honor, but ruthless men gain only wealth.
aov_text: ’n Aanvallige vrou verkry eer, en die geweldenaars verkry rykdom.

kjv_text: The merciful man doeth good to his own soul: but he that is cruel troubleth his own flesh.
bsb_text: A kind man benefits himself, but a cruel man brings trouble on himself.
aov_text: ’n Man wat ’n weldaad bewys, doen goed aan sy eie siel, maar ’n wreedaard pynig sy eie vlees.

kjv_text: The wicked worketh a deceitful work: but to him that soweth righteousness shall be a sure reward.
bsb_text: The wicked man earns an empty wage, but he who sows righteousness reaps a true reward.
aov_text: Die goddelose behaal oneerlike wins, maar hy wat geregtigheid saai, ’n betroubare loon.

kjv_text: As righteousness tendeth to life: so he that pursueth evil pursueth it to his own death.
bsb_text: Genuine righteousness leads to life, but the pursuit of evil brings death.
aov_text: Ware geregtigheid lei tot die lewe, maar hy wat die kwaad najaag, jaag na sy dood.

kjv_text: They that are of a froward heart are abomination to the LORD: but such as are upright in their way are his delight.
bsb_text: The perverse in heart are an abomination to the LORD, but the blameless in their walk are His delight.
aov_text: Die wat verkeerd van hart is, is vir die HERE ’n gruwel; maar Hy het behae in die wat regskape van wandel is.

kjv_text: Though hand join in hand, the wicked shall not be unpunished: but the seed of the righteous shall be delivered.
bsb_text: Be assured that the wicked will not go unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will escape.
aov_text: Sekerlik, die slegte bly nie ongestraf nie; maar die geslag van regverdiges raak vry.

kjv_text: As a jewel of gold in a swine's snout, so is a fair woman which is without discretion.
bsb_text: Like a gold ring in a pig’s snout is a beautiful woman who lacks discretion.
aov_text: ’n Goue ring in ’n vark se snuit, so is ’n vrou wat mooi is maar sonder beleid.

kjv_text: The desire of the righteous is only good: but the expectation of the wicked is wrath.
bsb_text: The desire of the righteous leads only to good, but the hope of the wicked brings wrath.
aov_text: Die begeerte van die regverdiges is net ten goede, maar die hoop van die goddelose is ’n strafgerig van toorn.

kjv_text: There is that scattereth, and yet increaseth; and there is that withholdeth more than is meet, but it tendeth to poverty.
bsb_text: One gives freely, yet gains even more; another withholds what is right, only to become poor.
aov_text: Daar is een wat ruim uitdeel en nog meer kry, en een wat terughou meer as wat reg is, maar tot sy gebrek.

kjv_text: The liberal soul shall be made fat: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.
bsb_text: A generous soul will prosper, and he who refreshes others will himself be refreshed.
aov_text: Die siel wat seën, word versadig; en hy wat laaf, word self ook gelaaf.

kjv_text: He that withholdeth corn, the people shall curse him: but blessing shall be upon the head of him that selleth it.
bsb_text: The people will curse the hoarder of grain, but blessing will crown the one who sells it.
aov_text: Hy wat koring terughou, hom vloek die mense; maar seëning kom op die hoof van hom wat koring verkoop.

kjv_text: He that diligently seeketh good procureth favour: but he that seeketh mischief, it shall come unto him.
bsb_text: He who searches out good finds favor, but evil will come to him who seeks it.
aov_text: Wie die goeie nastreef, soek wat welgevallig is; maar hy wat die kwaad soek, oor hom sal dit kom.

kjv_text: He that trusteth in his riches shall fall; but the righteous shall flourish as a branch.
bsb_text: He who trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous will thrive like foliage.
aov_text: Wie op sy rykdom vertrou, dié sal val; maar die regverdiges sal soos blare uitspruit.

kjv_text: He that troubleth his own house shall inherit the wind: and the fool shall be servant to the wise of heart.
bsb_text: He who brings trouble on his house will inherit the wind, and the fool will be servant to the wise of heart.
aov_text: Wie sy huis in beroering bring, sal wind erwe, en ’n dwaas word ’n slaaf van hom wat wys van hart is.

kjv_text: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life; and he that winneth souls is wise.
bsb_text: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life, and he who wins souls is wise.
aov_text: Die vrug van die regverdige is ’n boom van die lewe, en hy wat siele win, is wys.

kjv_text: Behold, the righteous shall be recompensed in the earth: much more the wicked and the sinner.
bsb_text: If the righteous receive their due on earth, how much more the ungodly and the sinner!
aov_text: As die regverdige op aarde vergelding ontvang, hoeveel te meer die goddelose en die sondaar!

kjv_text: Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge: but he that hateth reproof is brutish.
bsb_text: Whoever loves discipline loves knowledge, but he who hates correction is stupid.
aov_text: EEN wat die tug liefhet, het kennis lief; maar wie die teregwysing haat, is dom.

kjv_text: A good man obtaineth favour of the LORD: but a man of wicked devices will he condemn.
bsb_text: The good man obtains favor from the LORD, but the LORD condemns a man who devises evil.
aov_text: Die goeie verkry ’n welbehae van die HERE, maar Hy veroordeel ’n slinkse man.

kjv_text: A man shall not be established by wickedness: but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
bsb_text: A man cannot be established through wickedness, but the righteous cannot be uprooted.
aov_text: Geen mens kan deur goddeloosheid bestaan nie, maar die wortel van die regverdiges wankel nie.

kjv_text: A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband: but she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones.
bsb_text: A wife of noble character is her husband’s crown, but she who causes shame is like decay in his bones.
aov_text: ’n Deugsame vrou is die kroon van haar man, maar een wat skande maak, is soos ’n verrotting in sy gebeente.

kjv_text: The thoughts of the righteous are right: but the counsels of the wicked are deceit.
bsb_text: The plans of the righteous are just, but the counsel of the wicked leads to deceit.
aov_text: Die gedagtes van die regverdiges is wat reg is, die slim planne van die goddelose is bedrog.

kjv_text: The words of the wicked are to lie in wait for blood: but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.
bsb_text: The words of the wicked lie in wait for blood, but the speech of the upright rescues them.
aov_text: Die woorde van die goddelose is om te loer op bloed, maar die mond van die opregtes red hulle.

kjv_text: The wicked are overthrown, and are not: but the house of the righteous shall stand.
bsb_text: The wicked are overthrown and perish, but the house of the righteous will stand.
aov_text: Die goddelose mense word omgekeer, en hulle is daar nie meer nie; maar die huis van die regverdiges bly staan.

kjv_text: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom: but he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised.
bsb_text: A man is praised according to his wisdom, but a twisted mind is despised.
aov_text: Ooreenkomstig sy insig word ’n man geprys; maar ’n verkeerde van hart sal verag word.

kjv_text: He that is despised, and hath a servant, is better than he that honoureth himself, and lacketh bread.
bsb_text: Better to be lightly esteemed yet have a servant, than to be self-important but lack food.
aov_text: Wie gering geag word en ’n slaaf het, is beter as hy wat hom vernaam aanstel en gebrek aan brood het.

kjv_text: A righteous man regardeth the life of his beast: but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.
bsb_text: A righteous man regards the life of his animal, but the tender mercies of the wicked are only cruelty.
aov_text: Die regverdige ken die natuur van sy dier, maar die barmhartigheid van die goddelose is wreed.

kjv_text: He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread: but he that followeth vain persons is void of understanding.
