bsb_text: The one who works his land will have plenty of food, but whoever chases fantasies lacks judgment.
aov_text: Wie sy land bewerk, het volop brood; maar hy wat nietighede najaag, het gebrek aan verstand.

kjv_text: The wicked desireth the net of evil men: but the root of the righteous yieldeth fruit.
bsb_text: The wicked desire the plunder of evil men, but the root of the righteous flourishes.
aov_text: Die goddelose begeer die vangs van verkeerde dinge, maar die wortel van die regverdiges lewer vrugte op.

kjv_text: The wicked is snared by the transgression of his lips: but the just shall come out of trouble.
bsb_text: An evil man is trapped by his rebellious speech, but a righteous man escapes from trouble.
aov_text: In die oortreding van die lippe lê daar ’n gevaarlike strik; maar die regverdige ontkom aan die benoudheid.

kjv_text: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth: and the recompence of a man's hands shall be rendered unto him.
bsb_text: By fruitful speech a man is filled with good things, and the work of his hands returns to him.
aov_text: Uit die vrug van iemand se mond word hy versadig met die goeie, en die daad van ’n mens se hande kom op hom terug.

kjv_text: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes: but he that hearkeneth unto counsel is wise.
bsb_text: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, but a wise man listens to counsel.
aov_text: Die weg van ’n dwaas is reg in sy eie oë, maar die wyse luister na raad.

kjv_text: A fool's wrath is presently known: but a prudent man covereth shame.
bsb_text: A fool’s anger is known at once, but a prudent man overlooks an insult.
aov_text: Die dwaas laat sy drif op die daad bekend word, maar die skrandere verberg skande.

kjv_text: He that speaketh truth sheweth forth righteousness: but a false witness deceit.
bsb_text: He who speaks the truth declares what is right, but a false witness speaks deceit.
aov_text: Hy wat die waarheid spreek, vertel wat reg is; maar ’n valse getuie bedrog.

kjv_text: There is that speaketh like the piercings of a sword: but the tongue of the wise is health.
bsb_text: Speaking rashly is like a piercing sword, but the tongue of the wise brings healing.
aov_text: Daar is een wat onverskillig woorde uitspreek soos swaardsteke, maar die tong van die wyse is genesing.

kjv_text: The lip of truth shall be established for ever: but a lying tongue is but for a moment.
bsb_text: Truthful lips endure forever, but a lying tongue lasts only a moment.
aov_text: ’n Betroubare lip bestaan vir altyd, maar ’n valse tong vir ’n oomblik.

kjv_text: Deceit is in the heart of them that imagine evil: but to the counsellors of peace is joy.
bsb_text: Deceit is in the hearts of those who devise evil, but the counselors of peace have joy.
aov_text: Bedrog is in die hart van die wat onheil bewerk; maar die wat vrede aanraai, het vreugde.

kjv_text: There shall no evil happen to the just: but the wicked shall be filled with mischief.
bsb_text: No harm befalls the righteous, but the wicked are filled with trouble.
aov_text: Geen enkele onheil tref die regverdige nie, maar die goddelose is vol ongeluk.

kjv_text: Lying lips are abomination to the LORD: but they that deal truly are his delight.
bsb_text: Lying lips are detestable to the LORD, but those who deal faithfully are His delight.
aov_text: Valse lippe is vir die HERE ’n gruwel, maar Hy het ’n welbehae in die wat getrou handel.

kjv_text: A prudent man concealeth knowledge: but the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness.
bsb_text: A shrewd man keeps his knowledge to himself, but a foolish heart proclaims its folly.
aov_text: ’n Skrander mens verberg sy kennis, maar die hart van die dwase roep hulle sotheid uit.

kjv_text: The hand of the diligent shall bear rule: but the slothful shall be under tribute.
bsb_text: The hand of the diligent will rule, but laziness ends in forced labor.
aov_text: Die hand van die vlytiges sal heers, maar traagheid lei tot dwangarbeid.

kjv_text: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but a good word maketh it glad.
bsb_text: Anxiety weighs down the heart of a man, but a good word cheers it up.
aov_text: Bekommernis in die hart van ’n mens druk dit neer, maar ’n vriendelike woord vrolik dit op.

kjv_text: The righteous is more excellent than his neighbour: but the way of the wicked seduceth them.
bsb_text: A righteous man is cautious in friendship, but the ways of the wicked lead them astray.
aov_text: Die regverdige vind sy weide uit, maar die weg van die goddelose laat hulle dwaal.

kjv_text: The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting: but the substance of a diligent man is precious.
bsb_text: A lazy man does not roast his game, but a diligent man prizes his possession.
aov_text: Hy wat traag is, jaag sy wild nie op nie, maar vlyt is ’n kosbare skat vir ’n mens.

kjv_text: In the way of righteousness is life: and in the pathway thereof there is no death.
bsb_text: There is life in the path of righteousness, but another path leads to death.
aov_text: Op die pad van geregtigheid is lewe, en die rigting van dié pad is onsterflikheid.

kjv_text: A wise son heareth his father's instruction: but a scorner heareth not rebuke.
bsb_text: A wise son heeds his father’s discipline, but a mocker does not listen to rebuke.
aov_text: ’N WYSE seun luister na die tug van die vader, maar ’n spotter hoor nie na berisping nie.

kjv_text: A man shall eat good by the fruit of his mouth: but the soul of the transgressors shall eat violence.
bsb_text: From the fruit of his lips a man enjoys good things, but the desire of the faithless is violence.
aov_text: Van die vrug van iemand se mond eet hy die goeie, maar die begeerte van die ontroues is ’n daad van geweld.

kjv_text: He that keepeth his mouth keepeth his life: but he that openeth wide his lips shall have destruction.
bsb_text: He who guards his mouth protects his life, but the one who opens his lips invites his own ruin.
aov_text: Wie sy mond bewaak, bewaar sy lewe; wie sy lippe wyd oopmaak, vir hom is daar ondergang.

kjv_text: The soul of the sluggard desireth, and hath nothing: but the soul of the diligent shall be made fat.
bsb_text: The slacker craves yet has nothing, but the soul of the diligent is fully satisfied.
aov_text: Die siel van die luiaard begeer, en daar is niks nie, maar die siel van die vlytiges word versadig.

kjv_text: A righteous man hateth lying: but a wicked man is loathsome, and cometh to shame.
bsb_text: The righteous hate falsehood, but the wicked bring shame and disgrace.
aov_text: Die regverdige haat leuentaal, maar die goddelose maak gehaat en handel skandelik.

kjv_text: Righteousness keepeth him that is upright in the way: but wickedness overthroweth the sinner.
bsb_text: Righteousness guards the man of integrity, but wickedness undermines the sinner.
aov_text: Geregtigheid bewaar die regskapene van wandel, maar goddeloosheid bring die sondaar tot ’n val.

kjv_text: There is that maketh himself rich, yet hath nothing: there is that maketh himself poor, yet hath great riches.
bsb_text: One pretends to be rich, but has nothing; another pretends to be poor, yet has great wealth.
aov_text: Daar is een wat hom ryk hou, en hy het glad niks nie; een wat hom arm hou, en hy het baie goed.

kjv_text: The ransom of a man's life are his riches: but the poor heareth not rebuke.
bsb_text: Riches may ransom a man’s life, but a poor man hears no threat.
aov_text: Die losprys vir die lewe van ’n man is sy rykdom, maar die arme hoor geen dreigement nie.

kjv_text: The light of the righteous rejoiceth: but the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.
bsb_text: The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is extinguished.
aov_text: Die lig van die regverdige brand vrolik, maar die lamp van die goddelose gaan dood.

kjv_text: Only by pride cometh contention: but with the well advised is wisdom.
bsb_text: Arrogance leads only to strife, but wisdom is with the well-advised.
aov_text: Vermetelheid gee net getwis af; maar by die wat hulle laat raai, is wysheid.

kjv_text: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished: but he that gathereth by labour shall increase.
bsb_text: Dishonest wealth will dwindle, but what is earned through hard work will be multiplied.
aov_text: Goed wat uit niks verkry is, word minder; maar hy wat met die hand bymekaarmaak, kry altyd meer.

kjv_text: Hope deferred maketh the heart sick: but when the desire cometh, it is a tree of life.
bsb_text: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but desire fulfilled is a tree of life.
aov_text: ’n Uitgestelde hoop maak die hart siek; maar ’n wens wat uitkom, is ’n lewensboom.

kjv_text: Whoso despiseth the word shall be destroyed: but he that feareth the commandment shall be rewarded.
bsb_text: He who despises instruction will pay the penalty, but the one who respects a command will be rewarded.
aov_text: Wie die Woord verag, moet dit ontgelde; maar hy wat die gebod vrees, ontvang vergelding.

kjv_text: The law of the wise is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.
bsb_text: The teaching of the wise is a fountain of life, turning one from the snares of death.
aov_text: Die onderrig van die wyse is ’n fontein van die lewe, om die strikke van die dood te ontwyk.

kjv_text: Good understanding giveth favour: but the way of transgressors is hard.
bsb_text: Good understanding wins favor, but the way of the faithless is difficult.
aov_text: ’n Goeie verstand verskaf guns, maar die weg van die ontroues is hard.

kjv_text: Every prudent man dealeth with knowledge: but a fool layeth open his folly.
bsb_text: Every prudent man acts with knowledge, but a fool displays his folly.
aov_text: Elke skrandere handel met kennis, maar die dwaas strooi sotheid rond.

kjv_text: A wicked messenger falleth into mischief: but a faithful ambassador is health.
bsb_text: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a faithful envoy brings healing.
aov_text: ’n Goddelose boodskapper val in die ongeluk, maar ’n betroubare boodskapper is ’n gerusstelling.

kjv_text: Poverty and shame shall be to him that refuseth instruction: but he that regardeth reproof shall be honoured.
bsb_text: Poverty and shame come to him who ignores discipline, but whoever heeds correction is honored.
aov_text: Armoede en skande is vir hom wat die tug verwerp; maar hy wat die teregwysing in ag neem, word geëer.

kjv_text: The desire accomplished is sweet to the soul: but it is abomination to fools to depart from evil.
bsb_text: Desire fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but turning from evil is detestable to fools.
aov_text: ’n Vervulde wens is soet vir die siel, maar om af te wyk van die kwaad, is ’n gruwel vir die dwase.

kjv_text: He that walketh with wise men shall be wise: but a companion of fools shall be destroyed.
bsb_text: He who walks with the wise will become wise, but the companion of fools will be destroyed.
aov_text: Gaan met die wyse om, dan word jy wys; maar hy wat met dwase verkeer, versleg.

kjv_text: Evil pursueth sinners: but to the righteous good shall be repayed.
bsb_text: Disaster pursues sinners, but prosperity is the reward of the righteous.
aov_text: Die onheil vervolg die sondaars, maar Hy sal die regverdiges met goed vergelde.

kjv_text: A good man leaveth an inheritance to his children's children: and the wealth of the sinner is laid up for the just.
bsb_text: A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children, but the sinner’s wealth is passed to the righteous.
aov_text: ’n Goeie mens laat sy kindskinders erwe, maar die vermoë van die sondaar word vir die regverdige weggebêre.

kjv_text: Much food is in the tillage of the poor: but there is that is destroyed for want of judgment.
bsb_text: Abundant food is in the fallow ground of the poor, but without justice it is swept away.
aov_text: Die braakland van die armes lewer oorvloedig spys op, maar daar is wat deur ongeregtigheid verlore gaan.

kjv_text: He that spareth his rod hateth his son: but he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes.
bsb_text: He who spares the rod hates his son, but he who loves him disciplines him diligently.
aov_text: Wie sy roede terughou, haat sy seun; maar hy wat hom liefhet, besoek hom met tugtiging.

kjv_text: The righteous eateth to the satisfying of his soul: but the belly of the wicked shall want.
bsb_text: A righteous man eats to his heart’s content, but the stomach of the wicked is empty.
aov_text: Die regverdige eet totdat hy versadig is; maar die maag van die goddelose ly gebrek.

kjv_text: Every wise woman buildeth her house: but the foolish plucketh it down with her hands.
bsb_text: Every wise woman builds her house, but a foolish one tears it down with her own hands.
aov_text: DIE wysheid van die vroue bou die huis, maar die sotheid breek dit met eie hande af.

kjv_text: He that walketh in his uprightness feareth the LORD: but he that is perverse in his ways despiseth him.
bsb_text: He who walks in uprightness fears the LORD, but the one who is devious in his ways despises Him.
aov_text: Wie in sy opregtheid wandel, vrees die HERE; maar hy wat verkeerd is in sy weë, verag Hom.

kjv_text: In the mouth of the foolish is a rod of pride: but the lips of the wise shall preserve them.
bsb_text: The proud speech of a fool brings a rod to his back, but the lips of the wise protect them.
aov_text: In die mond van die sot is ’n roede vir sy trots, maar die lippe van die wyse bewaar hulle.

kjv_text: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean: but much increase is by the strength of the ox.
bsb_text: Where there are no oxen, the manger is empty, but an abundant harvest comes through the strength of the ox.
aov_text: Waar geen beeste is nie, is die krip leeg, maar deur die krag van die os is die inkomste baie.

kjv_text: A faithful witness will not lie: but a false witness will utter lies.
bsb_text: An honest witness does not deceive, but a dishonest witness pours forth lies.
aov_text: ’n Betroubare getuie lieg nie, maar ’n valse getuie strooi leuens uit.

kjv_text: A scorner seeketh wisdom, and findeth it not: but knowledge is easy unto him that understandeth.
bsb_text: A mocker seeks wisdom and finds none, but knowledge comes easily to the discerning.
aov_text: Die spotter soek wysheid, en dit is nie daar nie; maar vir die verstandige is kennis maklik.

kjv_text: Go from the presence of a foolish man, when thou perceivest not in him the lips of knowledge.
bsb_text: Stay away from a foolish man; you will gain no knowledge from his speech.
aov_text: Gaan weg voor ’n dwase man, want jy het daar niks gemerk van die lippe van kennis nie.

kjv_text: The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way: but the folly of fools is deceit.
bsb_text: The wisdom of the prudent is to discern his way, but the folly of fools deceives them.
aov_text: Die wysheid van die skrandere is om sy weg te verstaan, maar die sotheid van die dwase is bedrog.

kjv_text: Fools make a mock at sin: but among the righteous there is favour.
bsb_text: Fools mock the making of amends, but goodwill is found among the upright.
aov_text: Die skuldoffer spot met die dwase, maar tussen die opregtes is daar welwillendheid.

kjv_text: The heart knoweth his own bitterness; and a stranger doth not intermeddle with his joy.
bsb_text: The heart knows its own bitterness, and no stranger shares in its joy.
aov_text: Die hart ken sy eie verdriet, en in sy blydskap kan ’n ander hom nie meng nie.

kjv_text: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown: but the tabernacle of the upright shall flourish.
bsb_text: The house of the wicked will be destroyed, but the tent of the upright will flourish.
aov_text: Die huis van die goddelose word verdelg, maar die tent van die opregtes bloei.

kjv_text: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.
bsb_text: There is a way that seems right to a man, but its end is the way of death.
aov_text: Daar is ’n weg wat vir ’n mens reg lyk, maar die einde daarvan is weë van die dood.

kjv_text: Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful; and the end of that mirth is heaviness.
bsb_text: Even in laughter the heart may ache, and joy may end in sorrow.
aov_text: Ook onder gelag kan die hart pyn ly, en die einde van so ’n blydskap is bekommernis.

kjv_text: The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways: and a good man shall be satisfied from himself.
bsb_text: The backslider in heart receives the fill of his own ways, but a good man is rewarded for his ways.
aov_text: Uit sy eie wandel word die verkeerde van hart versadig, maar die goeie man uit syne.

kjv_text: The simple believeth every word: but the prudent man looketh well to his going.
bsb_text: The simple man believes every word, but the prudent man watches his steps.
aov_text: Die eenvoudige glo elke woord, maar die skrandere let op sy voetstappe.

kjv_text: A wise man feareth, and departeth from evil: but the fool rageth, and is confident.
bsb_text: A wise man fears and turns from evil, but a fool is careless and reckless.
aov_text: Die wyse vrees en wyk af van die kwaad, maar die dwaas bruis op en is vol selfvertroue.

kjv_text: He that is soon angry dealeth foolishly: and a man of wicked devices is hated.
bsb_text: A quick-tempered man acts foolishly, and a devious man is hated.
aov_text: Wie kortgebonde is, begaan sotheid; en ’n slinkse man word gehaat.

kjv_text: The simple inherit folly: but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
bsb_text: The simple inherit folly, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
aov_text: Die eenvoudiges verkry sotheid as ’n erfenis, maar die skranderes word met kennis gekroon.

kjv_text: The evil bow before the good; and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
bsb_text: The evil bow before the good, and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
aov_text: Die slegtes moet buig voor die goeies, en die goddelose by die poorte van die regverdige.

kjv_text: The poor is hated even of his own neighbour: but the rich hath many friends.
bsb_text: The poor man is hated even by his neighbor, but many are those who love the rich.
aov_text: Die arme word selfs deur sy naaste gehaat, maar die vriende van die ryke is talryk.

kjv_text: He that despiseth his neighbour sinneth: but he that hath mercy on the poor, happy is he.
bsb_text: He who despises his neighbor sins, but blessed is he who shows kindness to the poor.
aov_text: Wie sy naaste verag, doen sonde; maar hy wat medelyde het met die ellendiges, hy is gelukkig.

kjv_text: Do they not err that devise evil? but mercy and truth shall be to them that devise good.
bsb_text: Do not those who contrive evil go astray? But those who plan goodness find loving devotion and faithfulness.
aov_text: Verdwaal hulle nie wat onheil bewerk nie? Maar liefde en trou is vir die wat die goeie bewerk.

kjv_text: In all labour there is profit: but the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury.
bsb_text: There is profit in all labor, but mere talk leads only to poverty.
aov_text: In enige moeitevolle arbeid is voordeel, maar praatjies is net tot gebrek.

kjv_text: The crown of the wise is their riches: but the foolishness of fools is folly.
bsb_text: The crown of the wise is their wealth, but the effort of fools is folly.
aov_text: Die kroon van die wyse is hulle rykdom, die sotheid van die dwase bly sotheid.

kjv_text: A true witness delivereth souls: but a deceitful witness speaketh lies.
bsb_text: A truthful witness saves lives, but one who utters lies is deceitful.
aov_text: ’n Betroubare getuie red lewens, maar hy wat leuens uitstrooi, is bedrog.

kjv_text: In the fear of the LORD is strong confidence: and his children shall have a place of refuge.
bsb_text: He who fears the LORD is secure in confidence, and his children shall have a place of refuge.
aov_text: In die vrees van die HERE lê ’n sterk sekerheid, ook vir die kinders van ’n sodanige sal daar ’n toevlug wees.

kjv_text: The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.
bsb_text: The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, turning a man from the snares of death.
aov_text: Die vrees van die HERE is ’n fontein van die lewe, om van die strikke van die dood af te wyk.

kjv_text: In the multitude of people is the king's honour: but in the want of people is the destruction of the prince.
bsb_text: A large population is a king’s splendor, but a lack of subjects is a prince’s ruin.
aov_text: In die menigte van die volk lê die heerlikheid van die koning, maar in die gebrek aan mense die ondergang van die vors.

kjv_text: He that is slow to wrath is of great understanding: but he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly.
bsb_text: A patient man has great understanding, but a quick-tempered man promotes folly.
aov_text: Die lankmoedige is groot van verstand, maar die kortgebondene behaal sotheid.

kjv_text: A sound heart is the life of the flesh: but envy the rottenness of the bones.
bsb_text: A tranquil heart is life to the body, but envy rots the bones.
aov_text: ’n Rustige hart is die lewe vir die vlees, maar hartstog ’n verrotting vir die gebeente.

kjv_text: He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker: but he that honoureth him hath mercy on the poor.
bsb_text: Whoever oppresses the poor taunts their Maker, but whoever is kind to the needy honors Him.
aov_text: Wie die geringe verdruk, versmaad sy Maker, maar hy wat hom oor die behoeftige ontferm, eer Hom.

kjv_text: The wicked is driven away in his wickedness: but the righteous hath hope in his death.
bsb_text: The wicked man is thrown down by his own sin, but the righteous man has a refuge even in death.
aov_text: In sy ongeluk word die goddelose omgestoot, maar die regverdige vind ’n toevlug by sy dood.

kjv_text: Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that hath understanding: but that which is in the midst of fools is made known.
bsb_text: Wisdom rests in the heart of the discerning; even among fools she is known.
aov_text: Wysheid rus in die hart van die verstandige, word selfs rugbaar te midde van die dwase.

kjv_text: Righteousness exalteth a nation: but sin is a reproach to any people.
bsb_text: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a disgrace to any people.
aov_text: Geregtigheid verhoog ’n volk, maar die sonde is ’n skandvlek vir die nasies.

kjv_text: The king's favour is toward a wise servant: but his wrath is against him that causeth shame.
bsb_text: A king delights in a wise servant, but his anger falls on the shameful.
aov_text: Die welbehae van die koning is vir ’n verstandige dienaar, maar een wat skande maak, is ’n voorwerp van sy grimmigheid.

kjv_text: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.
bsb_text: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
aov_text: ’N SAGTE antwoord keer die grimmigheid af, maar ’n krenkende woord laat die toorn opkom.

kjv_text: The tongue of the wise useth knowledge aright: but the mouth of fools poureth out foolishness.
bsb_text: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouth of the fool spouts folly.
aov_text: Die tong van die wyse getuig van grondige kennis, maar die mond van die dwase laat sotheid uitborrel.

kjv_text: The eyes of the LORD are in every place, beholding the evil and the good.
bsb_text: The eyes of the LORD are in every place, observing the evil and the good.
aov_text: Op elke plek is die oë van die HERE, en hulle beskou opmerksaam die slegtes en die goeies.

kjv_text: A wholesome tongue is a tree of life: but perverseness therein is a breach in the spirit.
bsb_text: A soothing tongue is a tree of life, but a perverse tongue crushes the spirit.
aov_text: Sagtheid van tong is ’n lewensboom, maar valsheid daarin is verbreking in die gees.

kjv_text: A fool despiseth his father's instruction: but he that regardeth reproof is prudent.
bsb_text: A fool rejects his father’s discipline, but whoever heeds correction is prudent.
aov_text: Die sot verag die tug van sy vader, maar hy wat op die teregwysing ag gee, word wys.

kjv_text: In the house of the righteous is much treasure: but in the revenues of the wicked is trouble.
bsb_text: The house of the righteous has great treasure, but the income of the wicked is trouble.
aov_text: In die huis van die regverdige is ’n groot skat, maar in die inkomste van die goddelose is verwarring.

kjv_text: The lips of the wise disperse knowledge: but the heart of the foolish doeth not so.
bsb_text: The lips of the wise spread knowledge, but not so the hearts of fools.
aov_text: Die lippe van die wyse strooi kennis uit, maar die hart van die dwase is nie reg nie.

kjv_text: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD: but the prayer of the upright is his delight.
bsb_text: The sacrifice of the wicked is detestable to the LORD, but the prayer of the upright is His delight.
aov_text: Die offer van die goddelose is vir die HERE ’n gruwel, maar die gebed van die opregtes is Hom welgevallig.

kjv_text: The way of the wicked is an abomination unto the LORD: but he loveth him that followeth after righteousness.
bsb_text: The LORD detests the way of the wicked, but He loves those who pursue righteousness.
aov_text: Die wandel van die goddelose is vir die HERE ’n gruwel, maar hom wat geregtigheid najaag, het Hy lief.

kjv_text: Correction is grievous unto him that forsaketh the way: and he that hateth reproof shall die.
bsb_text: Discipline is harsh for him who leaves the path; he who hates correction will die.
aov_text: ’n Strenge tugtiging is daar vir hom wat die pad verlaat; hy wat die teregwysing haat, sal sterwe.

kjv_text: Hell and destruction are before the LORD: how much more then the hearts of the children of men?
bsb_text: Sheol and Abaddon lie open before the LORD—how much more the hearts of men!
aov_text: Die doderyk en die plek van vertering lê oop voor die HERE, hoeveel te meer die harte van die mensekinders!

kjv_text: A scorner loveth not one that reproveth him: neither will he go unto the wise.
bsb_text: A mocker does not love to be reproved, nor will he consult the wise.
aov_text: Die spotter hou nie daarvan dat ’n mens hom bestraf nie, hy gaan nie na die wyse toe nie.

kjv_text: A merry heart maketh a cheerful countenance: but by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.
bsb_text: A joyful heart makes a cheerful countenance, but sorrow of the heart crushes the spirit.
aov_text: ’n Vrolike hart maak die aangesig bly, maar by verdriet van die hart is die gees neerslagtig.

kjv_text: The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge: but the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness.
bsb_text: A discerning heart seeks knowledge, but the mouth of a fool feeds on folly.
aov_text: Die hart van die verstandige soek na kennis, maar die mond van die dwase gaan met sotheid om.

kjv_text: All the days of the afflicted are evil: but he that is of a merry heart hath a continual feast.
bsb_text: All the days of the oppressed are bad, but a cheerful heart has a continual feast.
aov_text: Al die dae van die bedrukte is sleg, maar die vrolike van hart het gedurigdeur fees.

kjv_text: Better is little with the fear of the LORD than great treasure and trouble therewith.
bsb_text: Better a little with the fear of the LORD than great treasure with turmoil.
aov_text: Liewer ’n bietjie in die vrees van die HERE, as ’n groot skat en onrus daarby.

kjv_text: Better is a dinner of herbs where love is, than a stalled ox and hatred therewith.
bsb_text: Better a dish of vegetables where there is love than a fattened ox with hatred.
aov_text: Liewer ’n porsie groente waar liefde by is, as ’n vetgevoerde bees en haat daarby.

kjv_text: A wrathful man stirreth up strife: but he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife.
bsb_text: A hot-tempered man stirs up strife, but he who is slow to anger calms dispute.
aov_text: ’n Driftige man verwek twis, maar die lankmoedige laat die geskil bedaar.

kjv_text: The way of the slothful man is as an hedge of thorns: but the way of the righteous is made plain.
bsb_text: The way of the slacker is like a hedge of thorns, but the path of the upright is a highway.
aov_text: Die weg van die luiaard is soos ’n heining van dorings, maar die pad van die opregtes is reggemaak.

kjv_text: A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish man despiseth his mother.
bsb_text: A wise son brings joy to his father, but a foolish man despises his mother.
aov_text: ’n Wyse seun verbly sy vader, maar ’n dwase mens verag sy moeder.

kjv_text: Folly is joy to him that is destitute of wisdom: but a man of understanding walketh uprightly.
bsb_text: Folly is joy to one who lacks judgment, but a man of understanding walks a straight path.
aov_text: Sotheid is ’n vreugde vir die verstandelose, maar ’n man van verstand wandel reguit.

kjv_text: Without counsel purposes are disappointed: but in the multitude of counsellors they are established.
bsb_text: Plans fail for lack of counsel, but with many advisers they succeed.
aov_text: Planne misluk sonder beraadslaging, maar deur die veelheid van raadgewers kom dit tot stand.

kjv_text: A man hath joy by the answer of his mouth: and a word spoken in due season, how good is it!
bsb_text: A man takes joy in a fitting reply—and how good is a timely word!
aov_text: ’n Man het blydskap in die regte antwoord van sy mond, en hoe goed is ’n woord op sy tyd!

kjv_text: The way of life is above to the wise, that he may depart from hell beneath.
bsb_text: The path of life leads upward for the wise, that he may avoid going down to Sheol.
aov_text: Die pad van die lewe gaan vir die verstandige na bowe, sodat hy die doderyk daaronder ontwyk.

kjv_text: The LORD will destroy the house of the proud: but he will establish the border of the widow.
bsb_text: The LORD tears down the house of the proud, but He protects the boundaries of the widow.
aov_text: Die HERE ruk die huis van die trotsaards om, maar die grenslyn van die weduwee stel Hy vas.

kjv_text: The thoughts of the wicked are an abomination to the LORD: but the words of the pure are pleasant words.
bsb_text: The LORD detests the thoughts of the wicked, but the words of the pure are pleasant to Him.
aov_text: Die planne van die slegte is vir die HERE ’n gruwel, maar vriendelike woorde is rein.

kjv_text: He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house; but he that hateth gifts shall live.
bsb_text: He who is greedy for unjust gain brings trouble on his household, but he who hates bribes will live.
aov_text: Wie onregverdige wins maak, bring sy huis in beroering; maar hy wat geskenke haat, sal lewe.

kjv_text: The heart of the righteous studieth to answer: but the mouth of the wicked poureth out evil things.
bsb_text: The heart of the righteous ponders how to answer, but the mouth of the wicked blurts out evil.
aov_text: Die hart van die regverdige dink ná om te antwoord, maar die mond van die goddelose laat slegte dinge uitborrel.

kjv_text: The LORD is far from the wicked: but he heareth the prayer of the righteous.
bsb_text: The LORD is far from the wicked, but He hears the prayer of the righteous.
aov_text: Die HERE is ver van die goddelose, maar die gebed van die regverdiges hoor Hy.

kjv_text: The light of the eyes rejoiceth the heart: and a good report maketh the bones fat.
bsb_text: The light of the eyes cheers the heart, and good news nourishes the bones.
aov_text: Stralende oë verbly die hart; ’n goeie tyding maak die gebeente vet.

kjv_text: The ear that heareth the reproof of life abideth among the wise.
bsb_text: He who listens to life-giving reproof will dwell among the wise.
aov_text: Die oor wat na die teregwysing tot die lewe luister, sal onder die wyse vertoef.

kjv_text: He that refuseth instruction despiseth his own soul: but he that heareth reproof getteth understanding.
bsb_text: He who ignores discipline despises himself, but whoever heeds correction gains understanding.
aov_text: Hy wat die tug verwerp, ag sy eie lewe gering; maar hy wat na die teregwysing luister, verkry verstand.

kjv_text: The fear of the LORD is the instruction of wisdom; and before honour is humility.
bsb_text: The fear of the LORD is the instruction of wisdom, and humility comes before honor.
aov_text: Die vrees van die HERE is die tug van die wysheid, en nederigheid gaan aan die eer vooraf.

kjv_text: The preparations of the heart in man, and the answer of the tongue, is from the LORD.
bsb_text: The plans of the heart belong to man, but the reply of the tongue is from the LORD.
aov_text: DIE planne van die hart is van die mens, maar die antwoord van die tong kom van die HERE.

kjv_text: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; but the LORD weigheth the spirits.
bsb_text: All a man’s ways are pure in his own eyes, but his motives are weighed out by the LORD.
aov_text: Al die weë van ’n man is suiwer in sy oë, maar die HERE toets die geeste.

kjv_text: Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.
bsb_text: Commit your works to the LORD and your plans will be achieved.
aov_text: Laat jou werke aan die HERE oor, dan sal jou planne uitgevoer word.

kjv_text: The LORD hath made all things for himself: yea, even the wicked for the day of evil.
bsb_text: The LORD has made everything for His purpose—even the wicked for the day of disaster.
aov_text: Alles het die HERE gemaak vir sy doel, ja, ook die goddelose vir die dag van onheil.

kjv_text: Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to the LORD: though hand join in hand, he shall not be unpunished.
bsb_text: Everyone who is proud in heart is detestable to the LORD; be assured that he will not go unpunished.
aov_text: Elke hoogmoedige van hart is vir die HERE ’n gruwel; sekerlik, hy sal nie ongestraf bly nie.

kjv_text: By mercy and truth iniquity is purged: and by the fear of the LORD men depart from evil.
bsb_text: By loving devotion and faithfulness iniquity is atoned for, and by the fear of the LORD one turns aside from evil.
aov_text: Deur liefde en trou word die skuld versoen, en deur die vrees van die HERE wyk ’n mens af van die kwaad.

kjv_text: When a man's ways please the LORD, he maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him.
bsb_text: When a man’s ways please the LORD, He makes even the man’s enemies live at peace with him.
aov_text: As die HERE behae het in die weë van ’n man, dan laat Hy selfs sy vyande met hom vrede hou.

kjv_text: Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues without right.
bsb_text: Better a little with righteousness than great gain with injustice.
aov_text: Liewer ’n bietjie met geregtigheid, as ’n menigte van inkomste met onreg.

kjv_text: A man's heart deviseth his way: but the LORD directeth his steps.
bsb_text: A man’s heart plans his course, but the LORD determines his steps.
aov_text: Die hart van die mens dink sy weg uit, maar die HERE rig sy voetstappe.

kjv_text: A divine sentence is in the lips of the king: his mouth transgresseth not in judgment.
bsb_text: A divine verdict is on the lips of a king; his mouth must not betray justice.
aov_text: Die beslissing is op die lippe van die koning; in die regspraak handel sy mond nie ontrou nie.

kjv_text: A just weight and balance are the LORD's: all the weights of the bag are his work.
bsb_text: Honest scales and balances are from the LORD; all the weights in the bag are His concern.
aov_text: ’n Regte weegtoestel en weegskaal kom van die HERE, al die weegstene in die sak is sy werk.

kjv_text: It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness: for the throne is established by righteousness.
bsb_text: Wicked behavior is detestable to kings, for a throne is established through righteousness.
aov_text: Dit is ’n gruwel vir konings om goddeloosheid te doen, want deur geregtigheid word die troon bevestig.

kjv_text: Righteous lips are the delight of kings; and they love him that speaketh right.
bsb_text: Righteous lips are a king’s delight, and he who speaks honestly is beloved.
aov_text: Die konings het behae in regverdige lippe, en hulle het hóm lief wat regte dinge spreek.

kjv_text: The wrath of a king is as messengers of death: but a wise man will pacify it.
bsb_text: The wrath of a king is a messenger of death, but a wise man will pacify it.
aov_text: Die grimmigheid van die koning is soos boodskappers van die dood, maar ’n wyse man bring dit tot bedaring.

kjv_text: In the light of the king's countenance is life; and his favour is as a cloud of the latter rain.
bsb_text: When a king’s face brightens, there is life; his favor is like a rain cloud in spring.
aov_text: In die vriendelike blik van die koning is lewe, en sy welgevalle is soos ’n wolk van die laat reëns.

kjv_text: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold! and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!
bsb_text: How much better to acquire wisdom than gold! To gain understanding is more desirable than silver.
aov_text: Hoeveel beter is dit om wysheid te verkry as goud, en verkiesliker om verstand te verwerf as silwer.

kjv_text: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil: he that keepeth his way preserveth his soul.
bsb_text: The highway of the upright leads away from evil; he who guards his way protects his life.
aov_text: Die gemaakte pad van die opregtes is om van die kwaad af te wyk; hy wat op sy wandel ag gee, bewaar sy lewe.

kjv_text: Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.
bsb_text: Pride goes before destruction, and a haughty spirit before a fall.
aov_text: Trotsheid kom voor die verbreking, en hoogmoed kom voor die val.

kjv_text: Better it is to be of an humble spirit with the lowly, than to divide the spoil with the proud.
bsb_text: It is better to be lowly in spirit among the humble than to divide the spoil with the proud.
aov_text: Dit is beter om nederig van gees te wees saam met die ootmoediges as om buit te verdeel met die trotsaards.

kjv_text: He that handleth a matter wisely shall find good: and whoso trusteth in the LORD, happy is he.
bsb_text: Whoever heeds instruction will find success, and blessed is he who trusts in the LORD.
aov_text: Wie ag gee op die Woord, sal die goeie vind; en hy wat op die HERE vertrou, is gelukkig.

kjv_text: The wise in heart shall be called prudent: and the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning.
bsb_text: The wise in heart are called discerning, and pleasant speech promotes instruction.
aov_text: ’n Wyse van hart word verstandig genoem, en soetheid van lippe vermeerder die lering.

kjv_text: Understanding is a wellspring of life unto him that hath it: but the instruction of fools is folly.
bsb_text: Understanding is a fountain of life to its possessor, but the discipline of fools is folly.
aov_text: ’n Fontein van die lewe is die verstand vir sy besitter, maar die tugtiging van die sotte is sotheid.

kjv_text: The heart of the wise teacheth his mouth, and addeth learning to his lips.
bsb_text: The heart of the wise man instructs his mouth and adds persuasiveness to his lips.
aov_text: Die hart van die wyse maak sy mond verstandig en vermeerder die lering op sy lippe.

kjv_text: Pleasant words are as an honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
bsb_text: Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul and healing to the bones.
aov_text: Vriendelike woorde is soos ’n heuningkoek: soet vir die siel en ’n genesing vir die gebeente.

kjv_text: There is a way that seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.
bsb_text: There is a way that seems right to a man, but its end is the way of death.
aov_text: Daar is ’n weg wat vir ’n mens reg lyk, maar die einde daarvan is weë van die dood.

kjv_text: He that laboureth laboureth for himself; for his mouth craveth it of him.
bsb_text: A worker’s appetite works for him because his hunger drives him onward.
aov_text: Die honger van die werksman arbei vir hom, want sy mond jaag hom aan.

kjv_text: An ungodly man diggeth up evil: and in his lips there is as a burning fire.
bsb_text: A worthless man digs up evil, and his speech is like a scorching fire.
aov_text: ’n Deugniet grawe ’n kuil van onheil, en op sy lippe is soos ’n brandende vuur.

kjv_text: A froward man soweth strife: and a whisperer separateth chief friends.
bsb_text: A perverse man spreads dissension, and a gossip divides close friends.
aov_text: ’n Man van valse streke saai tweedrag, en ’n kwaadstoker skei vriende van mekaar.

kjv_text: A violent man enticeth his neighbour, and leadeth him into the way that is not good.
bsb_text: A violent man entices his neighbor and leads him down a path that is not good.
aov_text: ’n Man van geweld verlei sy naaste en lei hom op ’n weg wat nie goed is nie.

kjv_text: He shutteth his eyes to devise froward things: moving his lips he bringeth evil to pass.
bsb_text: He who winks his eye devises perversity; he who purses his lips is bent on evil.
aov_text: Hy wat sy oë toemaak om valsheid te bedink, wat sy lippe vasknyp, het die kwaad alreeds gedoen.

kjv_text: The hoary head is a crown of glory, if it be found in the way of righteousness.
bsb_text: Gray hair is a crown of glory; it is attained along the path of righteousness.
aov_text: Grysheid is ’n sierlike kroon; dit word gevind op die weg van geregtigheid.

kjv_text: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.
bsb_text: He who is slow to anger is better than a warrior, and he who controls his temper is greater than one who captures a city.
aov_text: Die lankmoedige is beter as ’n held; en hy wat sy gees beheers, as een wat ’n stad inneem.

kjv_text: The lot is cast into the lap; but the whole disposing thereof is of the LORD.
bsb_text: The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from the LORD.
aov_text: In die skoot word die lot gewerp, maar elke beslissing daarvan kom van die HERE.

kjv_text: Better is a dry morsel, and quietness therewith, than an house full of sacrifices with strife.
bsb_text: Better a dry morsel in quietness than a house full of feasting with strife.
aov_text: BETER is ’n stuk droë brood en rus daarby as ’n huis vol offermaaltye met getwis.

kjv_text: A wise servant shall have rule over a son that causeth shame, and shall have part of the inheritance among the brethren.
bsb_text: A wise servant will rule over a disgraceful son and share his inheritance as one of the brothers.
aov_text: ’n Verstandige dienaar sal heers oor ’n seun wat skande maak, en onder die broers sal hy die erfenis verdeel.

kjv_text: The fining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold: but the LORD trieth the hearts.
bsb_text: A crucible for silver and a furnace for gold, but the LORD is the tester of hearts.
aov_text: Die smeltkroes is vir die silwer en die oond vir die goud, maar die HERE toets die harte.

kjv_text: A wicked doer giveth heed to false lips; and a liar giveth ear to a naughty tongue.
bsb_text: A wicked man listens to evil lips; a liar gives ear to a destructive tongue.
aov_text: Die kwaaddoener gee ag op ’n bedrieglike lip, ’n leuenaar luister na ’n tong wat onheil stig.

kjv_text: Whoso mocketh the poor reproacheth his Maker: and he that is glad at calamities shall not be unpunished.
bsb_text: He who mocks the poor insults their Maker; whoever gloats over calamity will not go unpunished.
aov_text: Hy wat die arme bespot, versmaad sy Maker; hy wat bly is oor ’n ongeluk, sal nie ongestraf bly nie.

kjv_text: Children's children are the crown of old men; and the glory of children are their fathers.
bsb_text: Grandchildren are the crown of the aged, and the glory of a son is his father.
aov_text: Kindskinders is ’n kroon vir grysaards, en vir die kinders is hulle vader ’n eer.

kjv_text: Excellent speech becometh not a fool: much less do lying lips a prince.
bsb_text: Eloquent words are unfit for a fool; how much worse are lying lips to a ruler!
aov_text: Aanmatigende taal pas nie by ’n dwaas nie, hoeveel minder leuentaal by ’n edele!

kjv_text: A gift is as a precious stone in the eyes of him that hath it: whithersoever it turneth, it prospereth.
bsb_text: A bribe is a charm to its giver; wherever he turns, he succeeds.
aov_text: Kosbare edelgesteente is die omkoopgeskenk in die oë van sy besitter; oral waar hy heengaan, sal hy slaag.

kjv_text: He that covereth a transgression seeketh love; but he that repeateth a matter separateth very friends.
bsb_text: Whoever conceals an offense promotes love, but he who brings it up separates friends.
aov_text: Wie ’n oortreding bedek, soek liefde; maar hy wat ’n saak weer ophaal, skei vriende van mekaar.

kjv_text: A reproof entereth more into a wise man than an hundred stripes into a fool.
bsb_text: A rebuke cuts into a man of discernment deeper than a hundred lashes cut into a fool.
aov_text: ’n Berisping gaan by ’n verstandige dieper in as om ’n dwaas honderd maal te slaan.

kjv_text: An evil man seeketh only rebellion: therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.
bsb_text: An evil man seeks only rebellion; a cruel messenger will be sent against him.
aov_text: Die wederstrewige soek net onheil, maar ’n wrede boodskapper word teen hom uitgestuur.

kjv_text: Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.
bsb_text: It is better to meet a bear robbed of her cubs than a fool in his folly.
aov_text: Laat ’n beer wat van kleintjies beroof is, ’n mens ontmoet, maar nie ’n dwaas in sy sotheid nie.

kjv_text: Whoso rewardeth evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.
bsb_text: If anyone returns evil for good, evil will never leave his house.
aov_text: Hy wat kwaad vir goed vergelde, die kwaad sal uit sy huis nie wyk nie.

kjv_text: The beginning of strife is as when one letteth out water: therefore leave off contention, before it be meddled with.
bsb_text: To start a quarrel is to release a flood; so abandon the dispute before it breaks out.
aov_text: Die begin van ’n onenigheid is soos water wat jy laat deurbreek; daarom, laat die twis vaar voordat dit losbreek.

kjv_text: He that justifieth the wicked, and he that condemneth the just, even they both are abomination to the LORD.
bsb_text: Acquitting the guilty and condemning the righteous—both are detestable to the LORD.
aov_text: Hy wat die goddelose regverdig verklaar en die regverdige skuldig verklaar, hulle altwee is vir die HERE ’n gruwel.

kjv_text: Wherefore is there a price in the hand of a fool to get wisdom, seeing he hath no heart to it?
bsb_text: Why should the fool have money in his hand with no intention of buying wisdom?
aov_text: Waarom tog is daar geld in die hand van ’n dwaas om wysheid te koop terwyl hy geen verstand het nie?

kjv_text: A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.
bsb_text: A friend loves at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.
aov_text: Die vriend het altyd lief, en die broer word gebore met die oog op die nood.

kjv_text: A man void of understanding striketh hands, and becometh surety in the presence of his friend.
bsb_text: A man lacking judgment strikes hands in pledge and puts up security for his neighbor.
aov_text: Dit is ’n verstandelose mens wat handslag gee, wat borg staan vir sy naaste.

kjv_text: He loveth transgression that loveth strife: and he that exalteth his gate seeketh destruction.
bsb_text: He who loves transgression loves strife; he who builds his gate high invites destruction.
aov_text: Wie twis liefhet, het oortreding lief; hy wat sy deur hoog maak, soek verbreking.

kjv_text: He that hath a froward heart findeth no good: and he that hath a perverse tongue falleth into mischief.
bsb_text: The one with a perverse heart finds no good, and he whose tongue is deceitful falls into trouble.
aov_text: Wie verkeerd van hart is, vind die goeie nie; en hy wat vals is met sy tong, val in die ongeluk.

kjv_text: He that begetteth a fool doeth it to his sorrow: and the father of a fool hath no joy.
bsb_text: A man fathers a fool to his own grief; the father of a fool has no joy.
aov_text: Hy wat ’n dwaas verwek, vir hom sal dit ’n bekommernis word; en die vader van die dwaas sal nie bly wees nie.

kjv_text: A merry heart doeth good like a medicine: but a broken spirit drieth the bones.
bsb_text: A joyful heart is good medicine, but a broken spirit dries up the bones.
aov_text: ’n Vrolike hart bevorder die genesing, maar ’n verslae gees laat die gebeente uitdroog.

kjv_text: A wicked man taketh a gift out of the bosom to pervert the ways of judgment.
bsb_text: A wicked man takes a covert bribe to subvert the course of justice.
aov_text: Die goddelose neem ’n omkoopgeskenk aan wat uit die boesem kom om die paaie van die reg te buig.

kjv_text: Wisdom is before him that hath understanding; but the eyes of a fool are in the ends of the earth.
bsb_text: Wisdom is the focus of the discerning, but the eyes of a fool wander to the ends of the earth.
aov_text: Die verstandige hou die wysheid voor oë, maar die oë van die dwaas is by die einde van die aarde.

kjv_text: A foolish son is a grief to his father, and bitterness to her that bare him.
bsb_text: A foolish son brings grief to his father and bitterness to her who bore him.
aov_text: ’n Dwase seun is ’n verdriet vir sy vader en bitter smart vir haar wat hom gebaar het.

kjv_text: Also to punish the just is not good, nor to strike princes for equity.
bsb_text: It is surely not good to punish the innocent or to flog a noble for his honesty.
aov_text: Is dit alreeds nie goed om die regverdige te beboet nie—om edeles te slaan is onbetaamlik.

kjv_text: He that hath knowledge spareth his words: and a man of understanding is of an excellent spirit.
bsb_text: A man of knowledge restrains his words, and a man of understanding maintains a calm spirit.
aov_text: Wie sy woorde inhou, besit kennis; en hy wat kalm is van gees, is ’n man van verstand.

kjv_text: Even a fool, when he holdeth his peace, is counted wise: and he that shutteth his lips is esteemed a man of understanding.
bsb_text: Even a fool is considered wise if he keeps silent, and discerning when he holds his tongue.
aov_text: Selfs ’n sot sal as hy swyg, vir wys gereken word; as hy sy lippe toehou, vir verstandig.

kjv_text: Through desire a man, having separated himself, seeketh and intermeddleth with all wisdom.
bsb_text: He who isolates himself pursues selfish desires; he rebels against all sound judgment.
aov_text: HY wat hom afskei, soek sy eie begeerte; hy bestry alles wat waarlik tot voordeel strek.

kjv_text: A fool hath no delight in understanding, but that his heart may discover itself.
bsb_text: A fool does not delight in understanding, but only in airing his opinions.
aov_text: Die dwaas het geen behae in verstandigheid nie, maar net daarin dat sy hart openbaar word.

kjv_text: When the wicked cometh, then cometh also contempt, and with ignominy reproach.
bsb_text: With a wicked man comes contempt as well, and shame is accompanied by disgrace.
aov_text: As die goddelose kom, kom ook veragting; en saam met die skande, versmading.

kjv_text: The words of a man's mouth are as deep waters, and the wellspring of wisdom as a flowing brook.
bsb_text: The words of a man’s mouth are deep waters; the fountain of wisdom is a bubbling brook.
aov_text: Die woorde van ’n man se mond is diep waters, ’n stroom wat bruis, ’n fontein van wysheid.

kjv_text: It is not good to accept the person of the wicked, to overthrow the righteous in judgment.
bsb_text: Showing partiality to the wicked is not good, nor is depriving the innocent of justice.
aov_text: Om vir die goddelose partydig te wees, om die regverdige in die gereg weg te stoot, is nie goed nie.

kjv_text: A fool's lips enter into contention, and his mouth calleth for strokes.
bsb_text: A fool’s lips bring him strife, and his mouth invites a beating.
aov_text: Die lippe van die dwaas kom met getwis, en sy mond roep na slae.

kjv_text: A fool's mouth is his destruction, and his lips are the snare of his soul.
bsb_text: A fool’s mouth is his ruin, and his lips are a snare to his soul.
aov_text: Die mond van die dwaas is sy ondergang en sy lippe ’n strik vir sy lewe.

kjv_text: The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.
bsb_text: The words of a gossip are like choice morsels that go down into the inmost being.
aov_text: Die woorde van die kwaadstoker is soos lekkernye, en dit gly af na die kamers van die binneste.

kjv_text: He also that is slothful in his work is brother to him that is a great waster.
bsb_text: Whoever is slothful in his work is brother to him who destroys.
aov_text: Alreeds hy wat hom slap hou in sy werk, hy is ’n broer van ’n verwoester.

kjv_text: The name of the LORD is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.
bsb_text: The name of the LORD is a strong tower; the righteous run to it and are safe.
aov_text: Die Naam van die HERE is ’n sterk toring; die regverdige hardloop daarin en word beskut.

kjv_text: The rich man's wealth is his strong city, and as an high wall in his own conceit.
bsb_text: A rich man’s wealth is his fortified city; it is like a high wall in his imagination.
aov_text: Die goed van die ryke is sy sterk stad en soos ’n steil muur in sy verbeelding.

kjv_text: Before destruction the heart of man is haughty, and before honour is humility.
bsb_text: Before his downfall a man’s heart is proud, but humility comes before honor.
aov_text: Voor die verbreking is die mens se hart hoogmoedig, maar nederigheid gaan aan die eer vooraf.

kjv_text: He that answereth a matter before he heareth it, it is folly and shame unto him.
bsb_text: He who answers a matter before he hears it—this is folly and disgrace to him.
aov_text: Hy wat antwoord gee voordat hy gehoor het, vir hom sal dit ’n sotheid en ’n skande wees.

kjv_text: The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity; but a wounded spirit who can bear?
bsb_text: The spirit of a man can endure his sickness, but who can survive a broken spirit?
aov_text: Die gees van ’n man ondersteun hom in sy krankheid; maar ’n verslae gees—wie kan dit opbeur?

kjv_text: The heart of the prudent getteth knowledge; and the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge.
bsb_text: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, and the ear of the wise seeks it out.
aov_text: Die hart van die verstandige verwerf kennis, en die oor van wyse soek na kennis.

kjv_text: A man's gift maketh room for him, and bringeth him before great men.
bsb_text: A man’s gift opens doors for him, and brings him before great men.
aov_text: Die geskenk van iemand maak vir hom ruimte en bring hom in die teenwoordigheid van die aansienlikes.

kjv_text: He that is first in his own cause seemeth just; but his neighbour cometh and searcheth him.
bsb_text: The first to state his case seems right until another comes and cross-examines him.
aov_text: Hy wat die eerste in sy regsaak is, het reg; maar sy naaste kom en ondersoek hom terdeë.

kjv_text: The lot causeth contentions to cease, and parteth between the mighty.
bsb_text: Casting the lot ends quarrels and separates strong opponents.
aov_text: Die lot laat die geskille ophou en maak sterkes uitmekaar.

kjv_text: A brother offended is harder to be won than a strong city: and their contentions are like the bars of a castle.
bsb_text: An offended brother is harder to win than a fortified city, and disputes are like the bars of a castle.
aov_text: ’n Broer teen wie oortree is, is erger as ’n sterk stad; en geskille is soos die grendel van ’n paleis.

kjv_text: A man's belly shall be satisfied with the fruit of his mouth; and with the increase of his lips shall he be filled.
bsb_text: From the fruit of his mouth a man’s belly is filled; with the harvest from his lips he is satisfied.
aov_text: Van die vrug van iemand se mond word sy maag versadig; hy word versadig van die opbrings van sy lippe.

kjv_text: Death and life are in the power of the tongue: and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.
bsb_text: Life and death are in the power of the tongue, and those who love it will eat its fruit.
aov_text: Dood en lewe is in die mag van die tong; en elkeen wat dit graag gebruik, sal die vrug daarvan eet.

kjv_text: Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing, and obtaineth favour of the LORD.
bsb_text: He who finds a wife finds a good thing and obtains favor from the LORD.
aov_text: Wie ’n vrou gevind het, het iets goeds gevind en ’n welgevalle van die HERE verkry.

kjv_text: The poor useth intreaties; but the rich answereth roughly.
bsb_text: The poor man pleads for mercy, but the rich man answers harshly.
aov_text: Die arme spreek smekinge, maar die ryke antwoord harde dinge.

kjv_text: A man that hath friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.
bsb_text: A man of many companions may come to ruin, but there is a friend who stays closer than a brother.
aov_text: ’n Man met baie vriende word geruïneer, maar daar is ’n vriend wat sterker aanhang as ’n broer.

kjv_text: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity, than he that is perverse in his lips, and is a fool.
bsb_text: Better a poor man who walks with integrity than a fool whose lips are perverse.
aov_text: ’N ARME wat in sy regskapenheid wandel, is beter as ’n verkeerde van lippe en daarby ’n dwaas.

kjv_text: Also, that the soul be without knowledge, it is not good; and he that hasteth with his feet sinneth.
bsb_text: Even zeal is no good without knowledge, and he who hurries his footsteps misses the mark.
aov_text: Selfs ywer is sonder kennis nie goed nie; en hy wat haastig is met die voete, trap mis.

kjv_text: The foolishness of man perverteth his way: and his heart fretteth against the LORD.
bsb_text: A man’s own folly subverts his way, yet his heart rages against the LORD.
aov_text: ’n Mens se sotheid bederwe sy weg, maar sy hart is vertoorn op die HERE.

kjv_text: Wealth maketh many friends; but the poor is separated from his neighbour.
bsb_text: Wealth attracts many friends, but a poor man is deserted by his friend.
aov_text: Goed bring baie vriende aan, maar die arme word deur sy vriend verlaat.

kjv_text: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall not escape.
bsb_text: A false witness will not go unpunished, and one who utters lies will not escape.
aov_text: ’n Valse getuie bly nie ongestraf nie, en hy wat leuens uitstrooi, sal nie vrykom nie.

kjv_text: Many will intreat the favour of the prince: and every man is a friend to him that giveth gifts.
bsb_text: Many seek the favor of the prince, and everyone is a friend of the gift giver.
aov_text: Baie soek die guns van die edele, en die man van geskenke het ’n hoop vriende.

kjv_text: All the brethren of the poor do hate him: how much more do his friends go far from him? he pursueth them with words, yet they are wanting to him.
bsb_text: All the brothers of a poor man hate him—how much more do his friends avoid him! He may pursue them with pleading, but they are nowhere to be found.
aov_text: Al die broers van die arme haat hom; hoeveel te meer hou sy vriende hulle ver van hom af! Hy jaag agter hulle aan met woorde—weg is hulle!

kjv_text: He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul: he that keepeth understanding shall find good.
bsb_text: He who acquires wisdom loves himself; one who safeguards understanding will find success.
aov_text: Wie verstand verkry, het sy lewe lief; hy wat insig bewaar, sal die goeie vind.

kjv_text: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall perish.
bsb_text: A false witness will not go unpunished, and one who pours out lies will perish.
aov_text: ’n Valse getuie bly nie ongestraf nie, en hy wat leuens uitstrooi, kom om.

kjv_text: Delight is not seemly for a fool; much less for a servant to have rule over princes.
bsb_text: Luxury is unseemly for a fool—how much worse for a slave to rule over princes!
aov_text: Weelde pas nie vir ’n dwaas nie, hoeveel minder vir ’n kneg om oor vorste te heers!

kjv_text: The discretion of a man deferreth his anger; and it is his glory to pass over a transgression.
bsb_text: A man’s insight gives him patience, and his virtue is to overlook an offense.
aov_text: Die verstand van ’n mens maak hom lankmoedig, en dit is vir hom ’n eer om die oortreding te vergewe.

kjv_text: The king's wrath is as the roaring of a lion; but his favour is as dew upon the grass.
bsb_text: A king’s rage is like the roar of a lion, but his favor is like dew on the grass.
aov_text: Die grimmigheid van ’n koning is soos die gebrom van ’n jong leeu, maar sy welgevalle is soos dou op die plante.

kjv_text: A foolish son is the calamity of his father: and the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping.
bsb_text: A foolish son is his father’s ruin, and a quarrelsome wife is like a constant dripping.
aov_text: ’n Dwase seun is ’n ramp vir sy vader, en die gekyf van ’n vrou is ’n aanhoudende gedrup.

kjv_text: House and riches are the inheritance of fathers: and a prudent wife is from the LORD.
bsb_text: Houses and wealth are inherited from fathers, but a prudent wife is from the LORD.
aov_text: Huis en goed is ’n erfenis van die vaders, maar ’n verstandige vrou is van die HERE.

kjv_text: Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep; and an idle soul shall suffer hunger.
bsb_text: Laziness brings on deep sleep, and an idle soul will suffer hunger.
aov_text: Luiheid laat in ’n diep slaap val, en een wat traag is, moet honger ly.

kjv_text: He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his own soul; but he that despiseth his ways shall die.
bsb_text: He who keeps a commandment preserves his soul, but he who is careless in his ways will die.
aov_text: Wie die gebod hou, bewaar sy lewe; hy wat sy weë nie ag nie, sal sterwe.

kjv_text: He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the LORD; and that which he hath given will he pay him again.
bsb_text: Kindness to the poor is a loan to the LORD, and He will repay the lender.
aov_text: Wie hom ontferm oor die arme, leen aan die HERE; en Hy sal hom sy weldaad vergelde.

kjv_text: Chasten thy son while there is hope, and let not thy soul spare for his crying.
bsb_text: Discipline your son, for in that there is hope; do not be party to his death.
aov_text: Tugtig jou seun, want daar is hoop; maar laat dit nie in jou opkom om hom dood te maak nie.

kjv_text: A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment: for if thou deliver him, yet thou must do it again.
bsb_text: A man of great anger must pay the penalty; if you rescue him, you will have to do so again.
aov_text: Hy wat groot van woede is, sal die straf dra; want as jy wil red, dan maak jy dit nog erger.

kjv_text: Hear counsel, and receive instruction, that thou mayest be wise in thy latter end.
bsb_text: Listen to counsel and accept discipline, that you may be wise the rest of your days.
aov_text: Luister na raad en neem tug aan, sodat jy in die vervolg wys kan wees.

kjv_text: There are many devices in a man's heart; nevertheless the counsel of the LORD, that shall stand.
bsb_text: Many plans are in a man’s heart, but the purpose of the LORD will prevail.
aov_text: Baie planne is in ’n man se hart, maar die raad van die HERE, dié sal bestaan.

kjv_text: The desire of a man is his kindness: and a poor man is better than a liar.
bsb_text: The desire of a man is loving devotion; better to be poor than a liar.
aov_text: Die kostelike besit van ’n mens is sy weldadigheid; en liewer ’n arme as ’n leuenagtige man.

kjv_text: The fear of the LORD tendeth to life: and he that hath it shall abide satisfied; he shall not be visited with evil.
bsb_text: The fear of the LORD leads to life, that one may rest content, without visitation from harm.
aov_text: Die vrees van die HERE is tot die lewe; en versadig bring ’n mens die nag deur, sonder om deur ’n onheil besoek te word.

kjv_text: A slothful man hideth his hand in his bosom, and will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.
bsb_text: The slacker buries his hand in the dish; he will not even bring it back to his mouth.
aov_text: Steek die luiaard sy hand in die skottel, dan bring hy dit nie eens na sy mond terug nie.

kjv_text: Smite a scorner, and the simple will beware: and reprove one that hath understanding, and he will understand knowledge.
bsb_text: Strike a mocker, and the simple will beware; rebuke the discerning man, and he will gain knowledge.
aov_text: Slaan jy die spotter, dan word die eenvoudige bedagsaam; maar bestraf jy die verstandige, dan sal hy kennis verkry.

kjv_text: He that wasteth his father, and chaseth away his mother, is a son that causeth shame, and bringeth reproach.
bsb_text: He who assaults his father or evicts his mother is a son who brings shame and disgrace.
aov_text: Hy wat sy vader geweld aandoen en sy moeder wegjaag, is ’n seun wat skande maak en skandelik handel.

kjv_text: Cease, my son, to hear the instruction that causeth to err from the words of knowledge.
bsb_text: If you cease to hear instruction, my son, you will stray from the words of knowledge.
aov_text: Hou op, my seun, om na tug te luister, terwyl jy tog afdwaal van die woorde van kennis.

kjv_text: An ungodly witness scorneth judgment: and the mouth of the wicked devoureth iniquity.
bsb_text: A corrupt witness mocks justice, and a wicked mouth swallows iniquity.
aov_text: ’n Deugniet wat getuienis gee, spot met die reg, en die mond van die goddelose verslind onreg.

kjv_text: Judgments are prepared for scorners, and stripes for the back of fools.
bsb_text: Judgments are prepared for mockers, and beatings for the backs of fools.
aov_text: Vir die spotters staan strafgerigte klaar en slae vir die rug van die dwase.

kjv_text: Wine is a mocker, strong drink is raging: and whosoever is deceived thereby is not wise.
bsb_text: Wine is a mocker, strong drink is a brawler, and whoever is led astray by them is not wise.
aov_text: DIE wyn is ’n spotter, en sterk drank ’n lawaaimaker; en elkeen wat daardeur bedwelmd raak, is nie wys nie.

kjv_text: The fear of a king is as the roaring of a lion: whoso provoketh him to anger sinneth against his own soul.
bsb_text: The terror of a king is like the roar of a lion; whoever provokes him forfeits his own life.
aov_text: Die dreiging van die koning is soos die gebrom van ’n jong leeu; wie hom vertoorn, verbeur sy lewe.

kjv_text: It is an honour for a man to cease from strife: but every fool will be meddling.
bsb_text: It is honorable for a man to resolve a dispute, but any fool will quarrel.
aov_text: Dit is ’n eer vir ’n man om van twis weg te bly, maar elke sot breek los.

kjv_text: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the cold; therefore shall he beg in harvest, and have nothing.
bsb_text: The slacker does not plow in season; at harvest time he looks, but nothing is there.
aov_text: In die herfs ploeg die luiaard nie; en verlang hy iets in die oestyd, dan is daar niks nie.

kjv_text: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water; but a man of understanding will draw it out.
bsb_text: The intentions of a man’s heart are deep waters, but a man of understanding draws them out.
aov_text: Die raad in die hart van ’n man mag diep waters wees, ’n man van verstand sal dit tog uitskep.

kjv_text: Most men will proclaim every one his own goodness: but a faithful man who can find?
bsb_text: Many a man proclaims his loving devotion, but who can find a trustworthy man?
aov_text: Baie mense roem hulle eie welwillendheid, maar wie vind ’n betroubare man?

kjv_text: The just man walketh in his integrity: his children are blessed after him.
bsb_text: The righteous man walks with integrity; blessed are his children after him.
aov_text: Wie in sy regskapenheid wandel as ’n regverdige—gelukkig is sy kinders ná hom.

kjv_text: A king that sitteth in the throne of judgment scattereth away all evil with his eyes.
bsb_text: A king who sits on a throne to judge sifts out all evil with his eyes.
aov_text: ’n Koning wat op die regterstoel sit, wan met sy oë alles uit wat sleg is.

kjv_text: Who can say, I have made my heart clean, I am pure from my sin?
bsb_text: Who can say, “I have kept my heart pure; I am cleansed from my sin”?
aov_text: Wie kan sê: Ek het my hart suiwer gehou, ek is rein van my sonde?

kjv_text: Divers weights, and divers measures, both of them are alike abomination to the LORD.
bsb_text: Differing weights and unequal measures—both are detestable to the LORD.
aov_text: Twee soorte gewig, twee soorte maat—hulle altwee is vir die HERE ’n gruwel.

kjv_text: Even a child is known by his doings, whether his work be pure, and whether it be right.
bsb_text: Even a young man is known by his actions—whether his conduct is pure and upright.
aov_text: Die seun laat hom alreeds aan sy handelinge ken, of sy handelwyse suiwer en of dit reg is.

kjv_text: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, the LORD hath made even both of them.
bsb_text: Ears that hear and eyes that see—the LORD has made them both.
aov_text: ’n Oor wat hoor, en ’n oog wat sien—die HERE het hulle altwee gemaak.

kjv_text: Love not sleep, lest thou come to poverty; open thine eyes, and thou shalt be satisfied with bread.
bsb_text: Do not love sleep, or you will grow poor; open your eyes, and you will have plenty of food.
aov_text: Moenie die slaap liefhê, sodat jy arm word nie; maak jou oë oop, dat jy jou met brood kan versadig.

kjv_text: It is naught, it is naught, saith the buyer: but when he is gone his way, then he boasteth.
bsb_text: “Worthless, worthless!” says the buyer, but on the way out, he gloats.
aov_text: Sleg, sleg! sê die koper; maar as hy wegloop, beroem hy hom.

kjv_text: There is gold, and a multitude of rubies: but the lips of knowledge are a precious jewel.
bsb_text: There is an abundance of gold and rubies, but lips of knowledge are a rare treasure.
aov_text: Daar is goud en ’n menigte korale, maar ’n kosbare sieraad is die lippe van kennis.

kjv_text: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger: and take a pledge of him for a strange woman.
bsb_text: Take the garment of the one who posts security for a stranger; get collateral if it is for a foreigner.
aov_text: Neem sy kleed weg, want hy het vir ’n ander borg gestaan, en neem hom as pand vir die vreemdes.

kjv_text: Bread of deceit is sweet to a man; but afterwards his mouth shall be filled with gravel.
bsb_text: Food gained by fraud is sweet to a man, but later his mouth is full of gravel.
aov_text: Soet is vir ’n mens die brood van bedrog, maar daarna word sy mond vol gruisklippertjies.

kjv_text: Every purpose is established by counsel: and with good advice make war.
bsb_text: Set plans by consultation, and wage war under sound guidance.
aov_text: Planne kom deur beraadslaging tot stand; voer dan oorlog met goeie oorleg.

kjv_text: He that goeth about as a talebearer revealeth secrets: therefore meddle not with him that flattereth with his lips.
bsb_text: He who reveals secrets is a constant gossip; avoid the one who babbles with his lips.
aov_text: Wie met kwaadsprekery omgaan, maak ’n geheim openbaar; laat jou dus nie in met een wat sy lippe laat oopstaan nie.

kjv_text: Whoso curseth his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in obscure darkness.
bsb_text: Whoever curses his father or mother, his lamp will be extinguished in deepest darkness.
aov_text: Wie sy vader of sy moeder vloek, sy lamp gaan in pikdonker dood.

kjv_text: An inheritance may be gotten hastily at the beginning; but the end thereof shall not be blessed.
bsb_text: An inheritance gained quickly will not be blessed in the end.
aov_text: ’n Besit wat by die begin haastig bymekaargeskraap is—die einde daarvan sal tog nie geseënd wees nie.

kjv_text: Say not thou, I will recompense evil; but wait on the LORD, and he shall save thee.
bsb_text: Do not say, “I will avenge this evil!” Wait on the LORD, and He will save you.
aov_text: Moenie sê: Ek wil die kwaad vergelde nie! Wag op die HERE, dat Hy jou help.

kjv_text: Divers weights are an abomination unto the LORD; and a false balance is not good.
bsb_text: Unequal weights are detestable to the LORD, and dishonest scales are no good.
aov_text: Twee soorte gewig is vir die HERE ’n gruwel, en ’n valse weegskaal is nie goed nie.

kjv_text: Man's goings are of the LORD; how can a man then understand his own way?
bsb_text: A man’s steps are from the LORD, so how can anyone understand his own way?
aov_text: Die voetstappe van ’n man hang van die HERE af: hoe sou ’n mens dan sy weg verstaan?

kjv_text: It is a snare to the man who devoureth that which is holy, and after vows to make enquiry.
bsb_text: It is a trap for a man to dedicate something rashly, only later to reconsider his vows.
aov_text: Dit is vir die mens ’n strik dat hy onbedagsaam sê: Heilig! om dan eers ná die geloftes te oorweeg.

kjv_text: A wise king scattereth the wicked, and bringeth the wheel over them.
bsb_text: A wise king separates out the wicked and drives the threshing wheel over them.
aov_text: ’n Wyse koning wan die goddelose uit en laat die dorswiel oor hulle draai.

kjv_text: The spirit of man is the candle of the LORD, searching all the inward parts of the belly.
bsb_text: The spirit of a man is the lamp of the LORD, searching out his inmost being.
aov_text: Die gees van die mens is ’n lamp van die HERE, dit deursoek al die kamers van die binneste.

kjv_text: Mercy and truth preserve the king: and his throne is upholden by mercy.
bsb_text: Loving devotion and faithfulness preserve a king; by these he maintains his throne.
aov_text: Liefde en trou behoed die koning, en deur liefde stut hy sy troon.

kjv_text: The glory of young men is their strength: and the beauty of old men is the grey head.
bsb_text: The glory of young men is their strength, and gray hair is the splendor of the old.
aov_text: Die sieraad van die jongmanne is hulle krag, en die versiersel van grysaards is grys hare.

kjv_text: The blueness of a wound cleanseth away evil: so do stripes the inward parts of the belly.
bsb_text: Lashes and wounds scour evil, and beatings cleanse the inmost parts.
aov_text: Bloedige wonde suiwer die kwaad uit en slae die kamers van die binneste.

kjv_text: The king's heart is in the hand of the LORD, as the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.
bsb_text: The king’s heart is a waterway in the hand of the LORD; He directs it where He pleases.
aov_text: DIE koning se hart is in die hand van die HERE soos waterstrome: Hy lei dit waarheen Hy wil.

kjv_text: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes: but the LORD pondereth the hearts.
bsb_text: All a man’s ways seem right to him, but the LORD weighs the heart.
aov_text: Elke weg van ’n mens is reg in sy oë, maar die HERE toets die harte.

kjv_text: To do justice and judgment is more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice.
bsb_text: To do righteousness and justice is more desirable to the LORD than sacrifice.
aov_text: Om geregtigheid en reg te doen, is vir die HERE verkiesliker as offers.

kjv_text: An high look, and a proud heart, and the plowing of the wicked, is sin.
bsb_text: Haughty eyes and a proud heart—the guides of the wicked—are sin.
aov_text: Hoogheid van oë en trotsheid van hart—die glans van die goddelose is sonde.

kjv_text: The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenteousness; but of every one that is hasty only to want.
bsb_text: The plans of the diligent bring plenty, as surely as haste leads to poverty.
aov_text: Die planne van die vlytige is net tot voordeel, maar elkeen wat oorhaastig is, kom net tot gebrek.

kjv_text: The getting of treasures by a lying tongue is a vanity tossed to and fro of them that seek death.
bsb_text: Making a fortune by a lying tongue is a vanishing mist, a deadly pursuit.
aov_text: Die verwerwing van skatte deur ’n valse tong is ’n verwaaide asem—dodelike valstrikke.

kjv_text: The robbery of the wicked shall destroy them; because they refuse to do judgment.
bsb_text: The violence of the wicked will sweep them away because they refuse to do what is just.
aov_text: Die gewelddadigheid van die goddelose sleep hulle weg, want hulle weier om reg te doen.

kjv_text: The way of man is froward and strange: but as for the pure, his work is right.
bsb_text: The way of a guilty man is crooked, but the conduct of the innocent is upright.
aov_text: Gekronkeld is die weg van ’n skuldige mens; maar die reine—sy handeling is reg.

kjv_text: It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman in a wide house.
bsb_text: Better to live on a corner of the roof than to share a house with a quarrelsome wife.
aov_text: Dit is beter om op die hoek van ’n dak te woon as by ’n twisgierige vrou en ’n gemeenskaplike huis.

kjv_text: The soul of the wicked desireth evil: his neighbour findeth no favour in his eyes.
bsb_text: The soul of the wicked man craves evil; his neighbor finds no favor in his eyes.
aov_text: Die siel van die goddelose begeer die kwaad; sy naaste vind in sy oë geen genade nie.

kjv_text: When the scorner is punished, the simple is made wise: and when the wise is instructed, he receiveth knowledge.
bsb_text: When a mocker is punished, the simple gain wisdom; and when a wise man is instructed, he acquires knowledge.
aov_text: As ’n mens ’n spotter straf, word die eenvoudige bedagsaam; en as ’n mens ’n wyse onderrig, neem hy self kennis aan.

kjv_text: The righteous man wisely considereth the house of the wicked: but God overthroweth the wicked for their wickedness.
bsb_text: The Righteous One considers the house of the wicked and brings the wicked to ruin.
aov_text: Die regverdige let op die huis van die goddelose; Hy stort die goddelose in die ongeluk.

kjv_text: Whoso stoppeth his ears at the cry of the poor, he also shall cry himself, but shall not be heard.
bsb_text: Whoever shuts his ears to the cry of the poor, he too shall cry out and receive no answer.
aov_text: Wie sy oor toestop vir die geskreeu van die arme, hy sal self ook roep en nie verhoor word nie.

kjv_text: A gift in secret pacifieth anger: and a reward in the bosom strong wrath.
bsb_text: A gift in secret soothes anger, and a covert bribe pacifies great wrath.
aov_text: ’n Geskenk in die geheim bring die toorn tot bedaring en ’n geskenk in die skoot die heftige woede.

kjv_text: It is joy to the just to do judgment: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.
bsb_text: Justice executed is a joy to the righteous, but a terror to the workers of iniquity.
aov_text: Vreugde is dit vir die regverdige om reg te doen, maar ’n verskrikking vir die werkers van ongeregtigheid.

kjv_text: The man that wandereth out of the way of understanding shall remain in the congregation of the dead.
bsb_text: The man who strays from the path of understanding will rest in the assembly of the dead.
aov_text: ’n Mens wat afdwaal van die pad van verstand, sal in die vergadering van die skimme rus.

kjv_text: He that loveth pleasure shall be a poor man: he that loveth wine and oil shall not be rich.
bsb_text: He who loves pleasure will become poor; the one who loves wine and oil will never be rich.
aov_text: Wie van vrolikheid hou, is ’n man van gebrek; hy wat van wyn en olie hou, sal nie ryk word nie.

kjv_text: The wicked shall be a ransom for the righteous, and the transgressor for the upright.
bsb_text: The wicked become a ransom for the righteous, and the faithless for the upright.
aov_text: Die goddelose is ’n losprys vir die regverdige, en in die plek van die opregtes kom die ontroue.

kjv_text: It is better to dwell in the wilderness, than with a contentious and an angry woman.
bsb_text: Better to live in the desert than with a contentious and ill-tempered wife.
aov_text: Dit is beter om in ’n woeste land te woon as by ’n twisgierige vrou en ergernis.

kjv_text: There is treasure to be desired and oil in the dwelling of the wise; but a foolish man spendeth it up.
bsb_text: Precious treasures and oil are in the dwelling of the wise, but a foolish man consumes them.
aov_text: ’n Kosbare skat en olie is in die woning van die regverdige, maar ’n dwase mens bring dit deur.
