kjv_text: He that followeth after righteousness and mercy findeth life, righteousness, and honour.
bsb_text: He who pursues righteousness and loving devotion finds life, righteousness, and honor.
aov_text: Wie geregtigheid en weldadigheid najaag, sal die lewe, geregtigheid en eer vind.

kjv_text: A wise man scaleth the city of the mighty, and casteth down the strength of the confidence thereof.
bsb_text: A wise man scales the city of the mighty and pulls down the stronghold in which they trust.
aov_text: Die wyse beklim die stad van die helde en gooi die vesting neer waar dit op vertrou.

kjv_text: Whoso keepeth his mouth and his tongue keepeth his soul from troubles.
bsb_text: He who guards his mouth and tongue keeps his soul from distress.
aov_text: Hy wat sy mond en sy tong bewaar, bewaar sy siel van benoudhede.

kjv_text: Proud and haughty scorner is his name, who dealeth in proud wrath.
bsb_text: Mocker is the name of the proud and arrogant man—of him who acts with excessive pride.
aov_text: ’n Vermetele, ’n trotsaard word ’n spotter genoem, een wat in oormaat van vermetelheid handel.

kjv_text: The desire of the slothful killeth him; for his hands refuse to labour.
bsb_text: The craving of the slacker kills him because his hands refuse to work.
aov_text: Die begeerte van die luiaard sal hom doodmaak, want sy hande weier om te werk;

kjv_text: He coveteth greedily all the day long: but the righteous giveth and spareth not.
bsb_text: All day long he covets more, but the righteous give without restraint.
aov_text: die hele dag deur word daar dringend begeer, maar die regverdige gee en hou nie terug nie.

kjv_text: The sacrifice of the wicked is abomination: how much more, when he bringeth it with a wicked mind?
bsb_text: The sacrifice of the wicked is detestable—how much more so when brought with ill intent!
aov_text: Die offer van die goddelose is ’n gruwel; hoeveel te meer as hulle dit met skandelike bedoeling bring.

kjv_text: A false witness shall perish: but the man that heareth speaketh constantly.
bsb_text: A lying witness will perish, but the man who listens to truth will speak forever.
aov_text: ’n Leuenagtige getuie kom om; maar ’n man wat goed toeluister, spreek vir altyd.

kjv_text: A wicked man hardeneth his face: but as for the upright, he directeth his way.
bsb_text: A wicked man hardens his face, but the upright man makes his way sure.
aov_text: Die goddelose trek ’n onbeskaamde gesig, maar die opregte gee aan sy weë die regte rigting.

kjv_text: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the LORD.
bsb_text: There is no wisdom, no understanding, no counsel that can prevail against the LORD.
aov_text: Daar is geen wysheid, en daar is geen verstand, en daar is geen raad teenoor die HERE nie.

kjv_text: The horse is prepared against the day of battle: but safety is of the LORD.
bsb_text: A horse is prepared for the day of battle, but victory is of the LORD.
aov_text: Die perd word reggemaak vir die dag van die geveg, maar die oorwinning is deur die HERE.

kjv_text: A GOOD name is rather to be chosen than great riches, and loving favour rather than silver and gold.
bsb_text: A good name is more desirable than great riches; favor is better than silver and gold.
aov_text: ’N NAAM is verkiesliker as groot rykdom, guns beter as silwer en as goud.

kjv_text: The rich and poor meet together: the LORD is the maker of them all.
bsb_text: The rich and the poor have this in common: The LORD is Maker of them all.
aov_text: Rykes en armes ontmoet mekaar, die HERE het hulle almal gemaak.

kjv_text: A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself: but the simple pass on, and are punished.
bsb_text: The prudent see danger and take cover, but the simple keep going and suffer the consequences.
aov_text: ’n Skrander mens sien die onheil en verberg hom, maar die eenvoudiges gaan verder en word gestraf.

kjv_text: By humility and the fear of the LORD are riches, and honour, and life.
bsb_text: The rewards of humility and the fear of the LORD are wealth and honor and life.
aov_text: Die loon van nederigheid is die vrees van die HERE, is rykdom en eer en die lewe.

kjv_text: Thorns and snares are in the way of the froward: he that doth keep his soul shall be far from them.
bsb_text: Thorns and snares lie on the path of the perverse; he who guards his soul stays far from them.
aov_text: Dorings, vangnette lê op die pad van die verkeerde; hy wat sy siel wil bewaar, bly ver weg daarvandaan.

kjv_text: Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.
bsb_text: Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.
aov_text: Oefen die seun volgens die eis van sy weg; dan sal hy, ook as hy oud word, daar nie van afwyk nie.

kjv_text: The rich ruleth over the poor, and the borrower is servant to the lender.
bsb_text: The rich rule over the poor, and the borrower is slave to the lender.
aov_text: Die ryke heers oor die armes, en hy wat leen, is ’n slaaf van die man wat uitleen.

kjv_text: He that soweth iniquity shall reap vanity: and the rod of his anger shall fail.
bsb_text: He who sows injustice will reap disaster, and the rod of his fury will be destroyed.
aov_text: Wie onreg saai, sal onheil maai; en die stok van sy grimmigheid sal verdwyn.

kjv_text: He that hath a bountiful eye shall be blessed; for he giveth of his bread to the poor.
bsb_text: A generous man will be blessed, for he shares his bread with the poor.
aov_text: Wie vriendelik is, hy word geseën, omdat hy van sy brood aan die arme gee.

kjv_text: Cast out the scorner, and contention shall go out; yea, strife and reproach shall cease.
bsb_text: Drive out the mocker, and conflict will depart; even quarreling and insults will cease.
aov_text: Dryf die spotter weg, dan gaan die twis weg; en die stryery en die geskimp hou op.

kjv_text: He that loveth pureness of heart, for the grace of his lips the king shall be his friend.
bsb_text: He who loves a pure heart and gracious lips will have the king for a friend.
aov_text: Hy wat reinheid van hart liefhet, wie se lippe aangenaam is—die koning is sy vriend.

kjv_text: The eyes of the LORD preserve knowledge, and he overthroweth the words of the transgressor.
bsb_text: The LORD’s eyes keep watch over knowledge, but He frustrates the words of the faithless.
aov_text: Die oë van die HERE bewaar kennis; daarom verydel Hy die woorde van die ontroue.

kjv_text: The slothful man saith, There is a lion without, I shall be slain in the streets.
bsb_text: The slacker says, “There is a lion outside! I will be slain in the streets!”
aov_text: Die luiaard sê: Daar is ’n leeu buitekant; ek kan in die middel van die strate gedood word!

kjv_text: The mouth of strange women is a deep pit: he that is abhorred of the LORD shall fall therein.
bsb_text: The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit; he who is under the wrath of the LORD will fall into it.
aov_text: Die mond van die vreemde vroue is ’n diep kuil; hy op wie die HERE vertoornd is, sal daarin val.

kjv_text: Foolishness is bound in the heart of a child; but the rod of correction shall drive it far from him.
bsb_text: Foolishness is bound up in the heart of a child, but the rod of discipline drives it far from him.
aov_text: As die sotheid vassit in die hart van die seun, die tugroede sal dit daaruit verwyder.

kjv_text: He that oppresseth the poor to increase his riches, and he that giveth to the rich, shall surely come to want.
bsb_text: Oppressing the poor to enrich oneself or giving gifts to the rich will surely lead to poverty.
aov_text: Wie die arme verdruk, bevoordeel hom; hy wat aan die ryke gee, verarm hom net.

kjv_text: Bow down thine ear, and hear the words of the wise, and apply thine heart unto my knowledge.
bsb_text: Incline your ear and hear the words of the wise—apply your mind to my knowledge—
aov_text: GEE gehoor en luister na die woorde van die wyse manne, en let op my kennis.

kjv_text: For it is a pleasant thing if thou keep them within thee; they shall withal be fitted in thy lips.
bsb_text: for it is pleasing when you keep them within you and they are constantly on your lips.
aov_text: Want dit is lieflik as jy dit in jou binneste bewaar; mag hulle tesame gereed lê op jou lippe.

kjv_text: That thy trust may be in the LORD, I have made known to thee this day, even to thee.
bsb_text: So that your trust may be in the LORD, I instruct you today—yes, you.
aov_text: Dat jou vertroue op die HERE mag wees, daarom onderwys ek jou vandag, ja, vir jou.

kjv_text: Have not I written to thee excellent things in counsels and knowledge,
bsb_text: Have I not written for you thirty sayings about counsel and knowledge,
aov_text: Het ek jou nie kernagtige spreuke voorgeskrywe met raadgewinge en kennis,

kjv_text: That I might make thee know the certainty of the words of truth; that thou mightest answer the words of truth to them that send unto thee?
bsb_text: to show you true and reliable words, that you may soundly answer those who sent you?
aov_text: om jou bekend te maak waarheid, betroubare woorde, sodat jy woorde van waarheid kan antwoord aan die wat jou stuur nie?

kjv_text: Rob not the poor, because he is poor: neither oppress the afflicted in the gate:
bsb_text: Do not rob a poor man because he is poor, and do not crush the afflicted at the gate,
aov_text: Beroof die arme nie, omdat hy arm is, en verbrysel die ellendige nie in die poort nie.

kjv_text: For the LORD will plead their cause, and spoil the soul of those that spoiled them.
bsb_text: for the LORD will take up their case and will plunder those who rob them.
aov_text: Want die HERE sal hulle saak verdedig en hulle berowers van die lewe berowe.

kjv_text: Make no friendship with an angry man; and with a furious man thou shalt not go:
bsb_text: Do not make friends with an angry man, and do not associate with a hot-tempered man,
aov_text: Verkeer nie met ’n driftige man nie, en met ’n opvlieënde man moet jy nie omgaan nie,

kjv_text: Lest thou learn his ways, and get a snare to thy soul.
bsb_text: or you may learn his ways and entangle yourself in a snare.
aov_text: sodat jy nie gewend raak aan sy paaie en ’n strik vir jouself span nie.

kjv_text: Be not thou one of them that strike hands, or of them that are sureties for debts.
bsb_text: Do not be one who gives pledges, who puts up security for debts.
aov_text: Wees nie onder die wat ’n handslag gee, onder die wat vir skulde borg staan nie.

kjv_text: If thou hast nothing to pay, why should he take away thy bed from under thee?
bsb_text: If you have nothing with which to pay, why should your bed be taken from under you?
aov_text: As jy nie het om te betaal nie, waarom sal hulle jou bed onder jou uit neem?

kjv_text: Remove not the ancient landmark, which thy fathers have set.
bsb_text: Do not move an ancient boundary stone which your fathers have placed.
aov_text: Die ou grenslyne wat jou vaders gemaak het, moet jy nie verlê nie.

kjv_text: Seest thou a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings; he shall not stand before mean men.
bsb_text: Do you see a man skilled in his work? He will be stationed in the presence of kings; he will not stand before obscure men.
aov_text: Sien jy ’n man wat vaardig is in sy werk—hy kan voor konings staan, hy hoef nie voor geringes te staan nie.

kjv_text: When thou sittest to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before thee:
bsb_text: When you sit down to dine with a ruler, consider carefully what is set before you,
aov_text: SIT jy aan om saam met ’n heerser te eet, let dan net op wat vóór jou is,

kjv_text: And put a knife to thy throat, if thou be a man given to appetite.
bsb_text: and put a knife to your throat if you possess a great appetite.
aov_text: en sit ’n mes op jou keel as jy ’n goeie eetlus het.

kjv_text: Be not desirous of his dainties: for they are deceitful meat.
bsb_text: Do not crave his delicacies, for that food is deceptive.
aov_text: Moenie sy lekker ete begeer nie, want dit is bedrieglike spys.

kjv_text: Labour not to be rich: cease from thine own wisdom.
bsb_text: Do not wear yourself out to get rich; be wise enough to restrain yourself.
aov_text: Vermoei jou nie om ryk te word nie, laat staan jou slimheid.

kjv_text: Wilt thou set thine eyes upon that which is not? for riches certainly make themselves wings; they fly away as an eagle toward heaven.
bsb_text: When you glance at wealth, it disappears, for it makes wings for itself and flies like an eagle to the sky.
aov_text: Sou jy jou oë daarop laat afvlieg? Maar weg is dit! want skielik maak dit vir hom vlerke en vlieg soos die arend na die hemel toe!

kjv_text: Eat thou not the bread of him that hath an evil eye, neither desire thou his dainty meats:
bsb_text: Do not eat the bread of a stingy man, and do not crave his delicacies;
aov_text: Eet nie die brood van een wat afgunstig is nie, en begeer nie sy lekker ete nie.

kjv_text: For as he thinketh in his heart, so is he: Eat and drink, saith he to thee; but his heart is not with thee.
bsb_text: for he is keeping track, inwardly counting the cost. “Eat and drink,” he says to you, but his heart is not with you.
aov_text: Want soos hy in sy siel bereken, so is hy; eet en drink, sê hy vir jou, maar sy hart is nie met jou nie.

kjv_text: The morsel which thou hast eaten shalt thou vomit up, and lose thy sweet words.
bsb_text: You will vomit up what little you have eaten and waste your pleasant words.
aov_text: Jou stukkie wat jy geëet het, sal jy uitspuug; en dan het jy jou vriendelike woorde verspil.

kjv_text: Speak not in the ears of a fool: for he will despise the wisdom of thy words.
bsb_text: Do not speak to a fool, for he will despise the wisdom of your words.
aov_text: Spreek nie voor die ore van ’n dwaas nie, want hy sal die verstandigheid van jou woorde verag.

kjv_text: Remove not the old landmark; and enter not into the fields of the fatherless:
bsb_text: Do not move an ancient boundary stone or encroach on the fields of the fatherless,
aov_text: Verlê die ou grenslyne nie, en kom nie op die landerye van die wese nie.

kjv_text: For their redeemer is mighty; he shall plead their cause with thee.
bsb_text: for their Redeemer is strong; He will take up their case against you.
aov_text: Want hulle Verlosser is sterk, Hy sal hulle saak teen jou verdedig.

kjv_text: Apply thine heart unto instruction, and thine ears to the words of knowledge.
bsb_text: Apply your heart to instruction and your ears to words of knowledge.
aov_text: Bring jou hart na die tug en jou oor na woorde van kennis.

kjv_text: Withhold not correction from the child: for if thou beatest him with the rod, he shall not die.
bsb_text: Do not withhold discipline from a child; although you strike him with a rod, he will not die.
aov_text: Hou die tug nie terug van die seun nie; as jy hom met die roede slaan, sal hy nie sterwe nie.

kjv_text: Thou shalt beat him with the rod, and shalt deliver his soul from hell.
bsb_text: Strike him with a rod, and you will deliver his soul from Sheol.
aov_text: Jy sal hom wel met die roede slaan, maar sy lewe van die doderyk red.

kjv_text: My son, if thine heart be wise, my heart shall rejoice, even mine.
bsb_text: My son, if your heart is wise, my own heart will indeed rejoice.
aov_text: My seun, as jou hart wys word, dan sal my hart hom ook verheug.

kjv_text: Yea, my reins shall rejoice, when thy lips speak right things.
bsb_text: My inmost being will rejoice when your lips speak what is right.
aov_text: En my niere sal jubel as jou lippe spreek wat reg is.

kjv_text: Let not thine heart envy sinners: but be thou in the fear of the LORD all the day long.
bsb_text: Do not let your heart envy sinners, but always continue in the fear of the LORD.
aov_text: Laat jou hart die sondaars nie beny nie, maar wees die hele dag in die vrees van die HERE.

kjv_text: For surely there is an end; and thine expectation shall not be cut off.
bsb_text: For surely there is a future, and your hope will not be cut off.
aov_text: Waarlik, daar is ’n toekoms, en jou hoop sal nie verydel word nie.

kjv_text: Hear thou, my son, and be wise, and guide thine heart in the way.
bsb_text: Listen, my son, and be wise, and guide your heart on the right course.
aov_text: Hoor, my seun, en word wys, en rig jou hart reguit op die weg.

kjv_text: Be not among winebibbers; among riotous eaters of flesh:
bsb_text: Do not join those who drink too much wine or gorge themselves on meat.
aov_text: Wees nie onder die wynsuipers nie, onder die wat as vrate hulle hart ophaal.

kjv_text: For the drunkard and the glutton shall come to poverty: and drowsiness shall clothe a man with rags.
bsb_text: For the drunkard and the glutton will come to poverty, and drowsiness will clothe them in rags.
aov_text: Want ’n drinker en ’n vraat sal arm word, en slaperigheid laat stukkende klere dra.

kjv_text: Hearken unto thy father that begat thee, and despise not thy mother when she is old.
bsb_text: Listen to your father who gave you life, and do not despise your mother when she is old.
aov_text: Luister na jou vader wat jou verwek het, en verag jou moeder nie as sy oud geword het nie.

kjv_text: Buy the truth, and sell it not; also wisdom, and instruction, and understanding.
bsb_text: Invest in truth and never sell it—in wisdom and instruction and understanding.
aov_text: Koop waarheid en verkoop dit nie, ook wysheid en tug en verstand.

kjv_text: The father of the righteous shall greatly rejoice: and he that begetteth a wise child shall have joy of him.
bsb_text: The father of a righteous man will greatly rejoice, and he who fathers a wise son will delight in him.
aov_text: Die vader van ’n regverdige juig baie; en as iemand ’n wyse verwek het, dan is hy bly oor hom.

kjv_text: Thy father and thy mother shall be glad, and she that bare thee shall rejoice.
bsb_text: May your father and mother be glad, and may she who gave you birth rejoice!
aov_text: Laat jou vader en jou moeder bly wees, en laat sy juig wat jou gebaar het.

kjv_text: My son, give me thine heart, and let thine eyes observe my ways.
bsb_text: My son, give me your heart, and let your eyes delight in my ways.
aov_text: My seun, gee my jou hart, en laat jou oë ’n welgevalle hê in my weë.

kjv_text: For a whore is a deep ditch; and a strange woman is a narrow pit.
bsb_text: For a prostitute is a deep pit, and an adulteress is a narrow well.
aov_text: Want ’n hoer is ’n diep kuil, en ’n ontugtige vrou is ’n nou put.

kjv_text: She also lieth in wait as for a prey, and increaseth the transgressors among men.
bsb_text: Like a robber she lies in wait and multiplies the faithless among men.
aov_text: Sy lê ook en loer soos ’n rower en vermeerder die ontroues onder die mensdom.

kjv_text: Who hath woe? who hath sorrow? who hath contentions? who hath babbling? who hath wounds without cause? who hath redness of eyes?
bsb_text: Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has contentions? Who has complaints? Who has needless wounds? Who has bloodshot eyes?
aov_text: By wie is „Ag!”; by wie is „Wee my!”; by wie is getwis; by wie is geklaag; by wie is wonde sonder oorsaak; by wie is dofheid van oë?

kjv_text: They that tarry long at the wine; they that go to seek mixed wine.
bsb_text: Those who linger over wine, who go to taste mixed drinks.
aov_text: By die wat láát opbly by die wyn, by die wat ingaan om gemengde drank te proe.

kjv_text: Look not thou upon the wine when it is red, when it giveth his colour in the cup, when it moveth itself aright.
bsb_text: Do not gaze at wine while it is red, when it sparkles in the cup and goes down smoothly.
aov_text: Kyk nie na die wyn as dit rooiagtig lyk, as dit sy glans gee in die beker, glad na binne gly nie:

kjv_text: At the last it biteth like a serpent, and stingeth like an adder.
bsb_text: In the end it bites like a snake and stings like a viper.
aov_text: op die end byt dit soos ’n slang en spuug gif uit soos ’n basilisk.

kjv_text: Thine eyes shall behold strange women, and thine heart shall utter perverse things.
bsb_text: Your eyes will see strange things, and your mind will utter perversities.
aov_text: Jou oë sal vreemde dinge sien en jou hart verkeerde dinge spreek;

kjv_text: Yea, thou shalt be as he that lieth down in the midst of the sea, or as he that lieth upon the top of a mast.
bsb_text: You will be like one sleeping on the high seas or lying on the top of a mast:
aov_text: en jy sal wees soos een wat in die hart van die see lê en soos een wat op die top van die mas lê.

kjv_text: They have stricken me, shalt thou say, and I was not sick; they have beaten me, and I felt it not:
bsb_text: “They struck me, but I feel no pain! They beat me, but I did not know it!
aov_text: Hulle het my geslaan, sê jy dan, ek het geen pyn gevoel nie; hulle het my neergeslaan, ek het dit nie gemerk nie!

kjv_text: when shall I awake? I will seek it yet again.
bsb_text: When can I wake up to search for another drink?”
aov_text: Wanneer sal ek wakker word? Dan sal ek dit weer opnuut soek.

kjv_text: Be not thou envious against evil men, neither desire to be with them.
bsb_text: Do not envy wicked men or desire their company;
aov_text: WEES nie afgunstig op die kwaaddoeners nie, en begeer nie om met hulle saam te wees nie.

kjv_text: For their heart studieth destruction, and their lips talk of mischief.
bsb_text: for their hearts devise violence, and their lips declare trouble.
aov_text: Want hulle hart bedink verwoesting, en hulle lippe spreek moeite.

kjv_text: Through wisdom is an house builded; and by understanding it is established:
bsb_text: By wisdom a house is built and by understanding it is established;
aov_text: Deur wysheid word ’n huis gebou, en deur verstand word dit bevestig;

kjv_text: And by knowledge shall the chambers be filled with all precious and pleasant riches.
bsb_text: through knowledge its rooms are filled with every precious and beautiful treasure.
aov_text: en deur kennis word die kamers gevul met allerhande kosbare en lieflike goed.

kjv_text: A wise man is strong; yea, a man of knowledge increaseth strength.
bsb_text: A wise man is strong, and a man of knowledge enhances his strength.
aov_text: ’n Wyse man is sterk, en ’n man van kennis ontwikkel krag.

kjv_text: For by wise counsel thou shalt make thy war: and in multitude of counsellors there is safety.
bsb_text: Only with sound guidance should you wage war, and victory lies in a multitude of counselors.
aov_text: Want deur goeie oorleg kan jy voorspoedig oorlog voer, en die oorwinning is deur die menigte van raadgewers.

kjv_text: Wisdom is too high for a fool: he openeth not his mouth in the gate.
bsb_text: Wisdom is too high for a fool; he does not open his mouth in the meeting place.
aov_text: Die wysheid is vir die sot te hoog; in die poort maak hy sy mond nie oop nie.

kjv_text: He that deviseth to do evil shall be called a mischievous person.
bsb_text: He who plots evil will be called a schemer.
aov_text: Hy wat hom voorneem om kwaad te doen, word ’n skelm genoem.

kjv_text: The thought of foolishness is sin: and the scorner is an abomination to men.
bsb_text: A foolish scheme is sin, and a mocker is detestable to men.
aov_text: Die sonde is ’n dwase voorneme, en die spotter is ’n gruwel vir die mensdom.

kjv_text: If thou faint in the day of adversity, thy strength is small.
bsb_text: If you faint in the day of distress, how small is your strength!
aov_text: Gedra jy jou slap in die dag van benoudheid, dan skiet jou krag te kort.

kjv_text: If thou forbear to deliver them that are drawn unto death, and those that are ready to be slain;
bsb_text: Rescue those being led away to death, and restrain those stumbling toward the slaughter.
aov_text: Red die wat na die dood gesleep word, en die wat na die slagbank wankel, hou hulle tog terug!

kjv_text: If thou sayest, Behold, we knew it not; doth not he that pondereth the heart consider it? and he that keepeth thy soul, doth not he know it? and shall not he render to every man according to his works?
bsb_text: If you say, “Behold, we did not know about this,” does not He who weighs hearts consider it? Does not the One who guards your life know? Will He not repay a man according to his deeds?
aov_text: As jy sê: Kyk, ons het dit nie geweet nie!—sal Hy wat die harte toets, dit nie merk nie? En Hy wat let op jou siel, Hy kom dit te wete. En Hy vergeld die mens na sy werk.

kjv_text: My son, eat thou honey, because it is good; and the honeycomb, which is sweet to thy taste:
bsb_text: Eat honey, my son, for it is good, and the honeycomb is sweet to your taste.
aov_text: Eet heuning, my seun, want dit is goed, en heuningstroop is soet teen jou verhemelte.

kjv_text: So shall the knowledge of wisdom be unto thy soul: when thou hast found it, then there shall be a reward, and thy expectation shall not be cut off.
bsb_text: Know therefore that wisdom is sweet to your soul. If you find it, there is a future for you, and your hope will never be cut off.
aov_text: Erken dat die wysheid só is vir jou siel; as jy dit vind, dan is daar ’n toekoms, en jou hoop sal nie verydel word nie.

kjv_text: Lay not wait, O wicked man, against the dwelling of the righteous; spoil not his resting place:
bsb_text: Do not lie in wait, O wicked man, near the dwelling of the righteous; do not destroy his resting place.
aov_text: Loer nie, o goddelose, op die woning van die regverdige, verwoes sy verblyfplek nie.

kjv_text: For a just man falleth seven times, and riseth up again: but the wicked shall fall into mischief.
bsb_text: For though a righteous man may fall seven times, he still gets up; but the wicked stumble in bad times.
aov_text: Want sewe maal val die regverdige en staan weer op, maar die goddelose struikel in die ongeluk.

kjv_text: Rejoice not when thine enemy falleth, and let not thine heart be glad when he stumbleth:
bsb_text: Do not gloat when your enemy falls, and do not let your heart rejoice when he stumbles,
aov_text: As jou vyand val, verheug jou nie; en as hy struikel, laat jou hart nie juig nie,

kjv_text: Lest the LORD see it, and it displease him, and he turn away his wrath from him.
bsb_text: or the LORD will see and disapprove, and turn His wrath away from him.
aov_text: dat die HERE dit nie sien en dit miskien verkeerd is in sy oë en Hy sy toorn van hom afwend nie.

kjv_text: Fret not thyself because of evil men, neither be thou envious at the wicked;
bsb_text: Do not fret over evildoers, and do not be envious of the wicked.
aov_text: Vererg jou nie oor die kwaaddoeners nie, wees nie afgunstig op die goddelose nie.

kjv_text: For there shall be no reward to the evil man; the candle of the wicked shall be put out.
bsb_text: For the evil man has no future; the lamp of the wicked will be extinguished.
aov_text: Want die kwaaddoener het geen toekoms nie, die lamp van die goddelose gaan dood.

kjv_text: My son, fear thou the LORD and the king: and meddle not with them that are given to change:
bsb_text: My son, fear the LORD and the king, and do not associate with the rebellious.
aov_text: My seun, vrees die HERE en die koning, laat jou nie in met oproerige mense nie.

kjv_text: For their calamity shall rise suddenly; and who knoweth the ruin of them both?
bsb_text: For they will bring sudden destruction. Who knows what ruin they can bring?
aov_text: Want skielik sal hulle ongeluk opkom, en die uitgang van hulle jare, wie weet dit?

kjv_text: These things also belong to the wise. It is not good to have respect of persons in judgment.
bsb_text: These also are sayings of the wise: To show partiality in judgment is not good.
aov_text: Ook hierdie spreuke is van die wyse manne afkomstig. Om partydig te wees in die gereg, is verkeerd.

kjv_text: He that saith unto the wicked, Thou art righteous; him shall the people curse, nations shall abhor him:
bsb_text: Whoever tells the guilty, “You are innocent”—peoples will curse him, and nations will denounce him;
aov_text: Hy wat vir die skuldige sê: Jy het reg!—die volke sal hom vervloek, die nasies sal hom verwens.

kjv_text: But to them that rebuke him shall be delight, and a good blessing shall come upon them.
bsb_text: but it will go well with those who convict the guilty, and rich blessing will come upon them.
aov_text: Maar met die wat onpartydig straf, gaan dit goed; en oor hulle kom die seën van voorspoed.

kjv_text: Every man shall kiss his lips that giveth a right answer.
bsb_text: An honest answer given is like a kiss on the lips.
aov_text: Hy wat regte antwoorde gee, soen die lippe.

kjv_text: Prepare thy work without, and make it fit for thyself in the field; and afterwards build thine house.
bsb_text: Complete your outdoor work and prepare your field; after that, you may build your house.
aov_text: Maak jou werk buitekant reg, en bring dit vir jou op die land in orde; daarna moet jy dan jou huis bou.

kjv_text: Be not a witness against thy neighbour without cause; and deceive not with thy lips.
bsb_text: Do not testify against your neighbor without cause, and do not deceive with your lips.
aov_text: Wees nie sonder oorsaak getuie teen jou naaste nie; want mag jy met jou lippe mislei?

kjv_text: Say not, I will do so to him as he hath done to me: I will render to the man according to his work.
bsb_text: Do not say, “I will do to him as he has done to me; I will repay the man according to his work.”
aov_text: Moenie sê nie: Soos hy aan my gedoen het, so sal ek aan hom doen—ek sal die man vergelde na sy werk.

kjv_text: I went by the field of the slothful, and by the vineyard of the man void of understanding;
bsb_text: I went past the field of a slacker and by the vineyard of a man lacking judgment.
aov_text: Ek het by die land van ’n lui man verbygeloop en langs die wingerd van ’n verstandelose mens,

kjv_text: And, lo, it was all grown over with thorns, and nettles had covered the face thereof, and the stone wall thereof was broken down.
bsb_text: Thorns had grown up everywhere, thistles had covered the ground, and the stone wall was broken down.
aov_text: en kyk, dit was heeltemal toegegroei van die dorings, sy oppervlakte was oordek met brandnekels en sy klipmuur omgegooi.

kjv_text: Then I saw, and considered it well: I looked upon it, and received instruction.
bsb_text: I observed and took it to heart; I looked and received instruction:
aov_text: En ek het dit aanskou, ja, daarop gelet, gekyk, en lering aangeneem:

kjv_text: Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:
bsb_text: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to rest,
aov_text: Nog ’n bietjie slaap, nog ’n bietjie sluimer, nog ’n bietjie hande-vou om uit te rus;

kjv_text: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth; and thy want as an armed man.
bsb_text: and poverty will come upon you like a robber, and need like a bandit.
aov_text: dan kom jou armoede aangeloop en jou gebrek soos ’n gewapende man.

kjv_text: These are also proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out.
bsb_text: These are additional proverbs of Solomon, which were copied by the men of Hezekiah king of Judah:
aov_text: DIT is ook spreuke van Salomo, wat die manne van Hiskía, die koning van Juda, versamel het.

kjv_text: It is the glory of God to conceal a thing: but the honour of kings is to search out a matter.
bsb_text: It is the glory of God to conceal a matter and the glory of kings to search it out.
aov_text: Dit is die eer van God om ’n saak te verberg, maar die eer van konings om ’n saak na te speur.

kjv_text: The heaven for height, and the earth for depth, and the heart of kings is unsearchable.
bsb_text: As the heavens are high and the earth is deep, so the hearts of kings cannot be searched.
aov_text: Die hoogte van die hemele en die diepte van die aarde en die hart van die konings is ondeurgrondelik.

kjv_text: Take away the dross from the silver, and there shall come forth a vessel for the finer.
bsb_text: Remove the dross from the silver, and a vessel for a silversmith will come forth.
aov_text: Verwyder jy die skuim uit die silwer, dan sal daar vir die silwersmid ’n voorwerp uitkom;

kjv_text: Take away the wicked from before the king, and his throne shall be established in righteousness.
bsb_text: Remove the wicked from the king’s presence, and his throne will be established in righteousness.
aov_text: verwyder die goddelose voor die koning weg, dan sal sy troon deur geregtigheid bevestig word.

kjv_text: Put not forth thyself in the presence of the king, and stand not in the place of great men:
bsb_text: Do not exalt yourself in the presence of the king, and do not stand in the place of great men;
aov_text: Pronk nie voor die koning nie, en staan nie op die plek van die grotes nie.

kjv_text: For better it is that it be said unto thee, Come up hither; than that thou shouldest be put lower in the presence of the prince whom thine eyes have seen.
bsb_text: for it is better that he says to you, “Come up here!” than that you should be demoted in the presence of the prince. Even what you have seen with your own eyes,
aov_text: Want dit is beter dat vir jou gesê word: Kom op hierheen!—as dat jy verneder word voor ’n edele wat jou oë gesien het.

kjv_text: Go not forth hastily to strive, lest thou know not what to do in the end thereof, when thy neighbour hath put thee to shame.
bsb_text: do not bring hastily to court. Otherwise, what will you do in the end when your neighbor puts you to shame?
aov_text: Gaan nie haastig uit om te twis nie; anders, wat sal jy ten slotte doen as jou naaste jou in die skande steek?

kjv_text: Debate thy cause with thy neighbour himself; and discover not a secret to another:
bsb_text: Argue your case with your neighbor without betraying another’s confidence,
aov_text: Verdedig jou saak teen jou naaste, maar openbaar ’n ander se geheim nie,

kjv_text: Lest he that heareth it put thee to shame, and thine infamy turn not away.
bsb_text: lest the one who hears may disgrace you, and your infamy never go away.
aov_text: sodat een wat dit hoor, jou nie beskimp en jou slegte gerug nie ophou nie.

kjv_text: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in pictures of silver.
bsb_text: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver.
aov_text: Goue appels op versierde silwerborde, so is ’n woord op sy tyd gespreek.

kjv_text: As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover upon an obedient ear.
bsb_text: Like an earring of gold or an ornament of fine gold is a wise man’s rebuke to a listening ear.
aov_text: ’n Wyse bestraffer by ’n oor wat luister, is ’n goue ring en ’n goue sieraad.

kjv_text: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, so is a faithful messenger to them that send him: for he refresheth the soul of his masters.
bsb_text: Like the cold of snow in the time of harvest is a trustworthy messenger to those who send him; he refreshes the soul of his masters.
aov_text: Soos die verkoeling van sneeu op ’n oesdag, is ’n betroubare boodskapper vir sy senders; want hy verkwik die siel van sy heer.

kjv_text: Whoso boasteth himself of a false gift is like clouds and wind without rain.
bsb_text: Like clouds and wind without rain is the man who boasts of gifts never given.
aov_text: ’n Man wat hom beroem op ’n geskenk wat hy tog nie gee nie, is soos dampe en wind waar geen reënbui by is nie.

kjv_text: By long forbearing is a prince persuaded, and a soft tongue breaketh the bone.
bsb_text: Through patience a ruler can be persuaded, and a gentle tongue can break a bone.
aov_text: Deur lankmoedigheid word ’n vors oorgehaal, en ’n sagte tong verbreek die gebeente.

kjv_text: Hast thou found honey? eat so much as is sufficient for thee, lest thou be filled therewith, and vomit it.
bsb_text: If you find honey, eat just what you need, lest you have too much and vomit it up.
aov_text: Het jy heuning gevind, eet tot jy genoeg het, sodat jy daar nie sat van word en dit uitspuug nie.

kjv_text: Withdraw thy foot from thy neighbour's house; lest he be weary of thee, and so hate thee.
bsb_text: Seldom set foot in your neighbor’s house, lest he grow weary and hate you.
aov_text: Sit jou voet selde in jou naaste se huis, sodat hy nie van jou genoeg kry en jou haat nie.

kjv_text: A man that beareth false witness against his neighbour is a maul, and a sword, and a sharp arrow.
bsb_text: Like a club or sword or sharp arrow is a man who bears false witness against his neighbor.
aov_text: ’n Knopkierie en ’n swaard en ’n skerp pyl, so is ’n man wat teen sy naaste as valse getuie optree.

kjv_text: Confidence in an unfaithful man in time of trouble is like a broken tooth, and a foot out of joint.
bsb_text: Like a broken tooth or a foot out of joint is confidence in a faithless man in time of trouble.
aov_text: ’n Slegte tand en ’n voet wat swik, so is die vertroue op ’n ontroue in die dag van benoudheid.

kjv_text: As he that taketh away a garment in cold weather, and as vinegar upon nitre, so is he that singeth songs to an heavy heart.
bsb_text: Like one who removes a garment on a cold day or vinegar poured on a wound is one who sings songs to a heavy heart.
aov_text: Soos een wat ’n kleed uittrek op ’n koue dag, soos asyn op loog, so is een wat ’n bedroefde hart met liedere verwelkom.

kjv_text: If thine enemy be hungry, give him bread to eat; and if he be thirsty, give him water to drink:
bsb_text: If your enemy is hungry, give him food to eat, and if he is thirsty, give him water to drink.
aov_text: As jou vyand honger het, gee hom brood om te eet; en as hy dors het, gee hom water om te drink.

kjv_text: For thou shalt heap coals of fire upon his head, and the LORD shall reward thee.
bsb_text: For in so doing, you will heap burning coals on his head, and the LORD will reward you.
aov_text: Want jy hoop gloeiende kole op sy hoof, en die HERE sal jou dit vergelde.

kjv_text: The north wind driveth away rain: so doth an angry countenance a backbiting tongue.
bsb_text: As the north wind brings forth rain, so a backbiting tongue brings angry looks.
aov_text: Die noordewind bring ’n reënbui voort, en die tong wat agteraf praat—kwaai gesigte.

kjv_text: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman and in a wide house.
bsb_text: Better to live on a corner of the roof than to share a house with a quarrelsome wife.
aov_text: Om te woon op die hoek van ’n dak, is beter as by ’n twisgierige vrou en ’n gemeenskaplike huis.

kjv_text: As cold waters to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.
bsb_text: Like cold water to a weary soul is good news from a distant land.
aov_text: Koue water op ’n vermoeide siel, so is ’n goeie tyding uit ’n ver land.

kjv_text: A righteous man falling down before the wicked is as a troubled fountain, and a corrupt spring.
bsb_text: Like a muddied spring or a polluted well is a righteous man who gives way to the wicked.
aov_text: ’n Troebel fontein en ’n vuile bron, so is die regverdige wat wankel voor die goddelose.

kjv_text: It is not good to eat much honey: so for men to search their own glory is not glory.
bsb_text: It is not good to eat too much honey or to search out one’s own glory.
aov_text: Om baie heuning te eet, is nie goed nie, maar om swaar sake na te speur, is ’n eer.

kjv_text: He that hath no rule over his own spirit is like a city that is broken down, and without walls.
bsb_text: Like a city whose walls are broken down is a man who does not control his temper.
aov_text: ’n Afgebreekte stad sonder muur, so is ’n man wat sy gees nie kan inhou nie.

kjv_text: As snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, so honour is not seemly for a fool.
bsb_text: Like snow in summer and rain at harvest, honor does not befit a fool.
aov_text: SOOS sneeu in die somer en soos reën in die oestyd, so pas eer nie by ’n dwaas nie.

kjv_text: As the bird by wandering, as the swallow by flying, so the curse causeless shall not come.
bsb_text: Like a fluttering sparrow or darting swallow, an undeserved curse does not come to rest.
aov_text: Soos die voëltjie wegfladder, soos die swaweltjie wegvlieg, so is ’n vervloeking sonder oorsaak: dit kom nie uit nie.

kjv_text: A whip for the horse, a bridle for the ass, and a rod for the fool's back.
bsb_text: A whip for the horse, a bridle for the donkey, and a rod for the backs of fools!
aov_text: ’n Sweep is vir die perd, ’n toom vir die esel en ’n roede vir die rug van die dwase.

kjv_text: Answer not a fool according to his folly, lest thou also be like unto him.
bsb_text: Do not answer a fool according to his folly, or you yourself will be like him.
aov_text: Antwoord ’n dwaas nie na sy sotheid nie, sodat jy ook nie net soos hy word nie.

kjv_text: Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own conceit.
bsb_text: Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he become wise in his own eyes.
aov_text: Antwoord ’n dwaas na sy sotheid, sodat hy nie wys is in sy eie oë nie.

kjv_text: He that sendeth a message by the hand of a fool cutteth off the feet, and drinketh damage.
bsb_text: Like cutting off one’s own feet or drinking violence is the sending of a message by the hand of a fool.
aov_text: Hý kap sy voete af, hy ly onreg, wat ’n boodskap stuur deur middel van ’n dwaas.

kjv_text: The legs of the lame are not equal: so is a parable in the mouth of fools.
bsb_text: Like lame legs hanging limp is a proverb in the mouth of a fool.
aov_text: Soos die bene van ’n lamme slap afhang, so is ’n spreuk in die mond van die dwase.

kjv_text: As he that bindeth a stone in a sling, so is he that giveth honour to a fool.
bsb_text: Like binding a stone into a sling is the giving of honor to a fool.
aov_text: Soos een wat ’n klip in ’n slinger vasbind, so is hy wat eer gee aan ’n dwaas.

kjv_text: As a thorn goeth up into the hand of a drunkard, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.
bsb_text: Like a thorn that falls into the hand of a drunkard is a proverb in the mouth of a fool.
aov_text: Soos ’n doring wat in die hand van ’n dronkaard geraak het, so is ’n spreuk in die mond van die dwase.

kjv_text: The great God that formed all things both rewardeth the fool, and rewardeth transgressors.
bsb_text: Like an archer who wounds at random is he who hires a fool or passerby.
aov_text: Soos ’n skutter wat alles in gevaar bring, is hy wat ’n dwaas huur, sowel as hy wat verbygangers huur.

kjv_text: As a dog returneth to his vomit, so a fool returneth to his folly.
bsb_text: As a dog returns to its vomit, so a fool repeats his folly.
aov_text: Soos ’n hond wat na sy uitbraaksel teruggaan, is ’n dwaas wat sy sotheid weer ophaal.

kjv_text: Seest thou a man wise in his own conceit? there is more hope of a fool than of him.
bsb_text: Do you see a man who is wise in his own eyes? There is more hope for a fool than for him.
aov_text: Het jy ’n man gesien wat wys is in sy eie oë? Daar is meer hoop vir ’n dwaas as vir hom.

kjv_text: The slothful man saith, There is a lion in the way; a lion is in the streets.
bsb_text: The slacker says, “A lion is in the road! A fierce lion roams the public square!”
aov_text: Die luiaard sê: Daar is ’n leeu op die pad, ’n leeu op die pleine.

kjv_text: As the door turneth upon his hinges, so doth the slothful upon his bed.
bsb_text: As a door turns on its hinges, so the slacker turns on his bed.
aov_text: ’n Deur draai rond op sy skarniere, so die luiaard op sy bed.

kjv_text: The slothful hideth his hand in his bosom; it grieveth him to bring it again to his mouth.
bsb_text: The slacker buries his hand in the dish; it wearies him to bring it back to his mouth.
aov_text: Het die luiaard sy hand in die skottel gesteek, hy is te moeg om dit na sy mond terug te bring.

kjv_text: The sluggard is wiser in his own conceit than seven men that can render a reason.
bsb_text: The slacker is wiser in his own eyes than seven men who answer discreetly.
aov_text: Die luiaard is wyser in sy eie oë as sewe wat verstandig antwoord.

kjv_text: He that passeth by, and meddleth with strife belonging not to him, is like one that taketh a dog by the ears.
bsb_text: Like one who grabs a dog by the ears is a passerby who meddles in a quarrel not his own.
aov_text: Hy wat ’n verbylopende hond aan die ore gryp, is een wat hom vererg oor ’n twis wat hom nie aangaan nie.

kjv_text: As a mad man who casteth firebrands, arrows, and death,
bsb_text: Like a madman shooting firebrands and deadly arrows,
aov_text: Soos een wat onverskillig vuurpyle, dodelike pyle afskiet,

kjv_text: So is the man that deceiveth his neighbour, and saith, Am not I in sport?
bsb_text: so is the man who deceives his neighbor and says, “I was only joking!”
aov_text: so is die man wat sy naaste bedrieg en sê: Ek speel somaar.

kjv_text: Where no wood is, there the fire goeth out: so where there is no talebearer, the strife ceaseth.
bsb_text: Without wood, a fire goes out; without gossip, a conflict ceases.
aov_text: Deur gebrek aan hout gaan die vuur dood, en as daar geen kwaadstoker is nie, bedaar die twis.

kjv_text: As coals are to burning coals, and wood to fire; so is a contentious man to kindle strife.
bsb_text: Like charcoal for embers and wood for fire, so is a quarrelsome man for kindling strife.
aov_text: Soos kole die gloed en hout die vuur laat opvlam, so is ’n twisgierige man om ’n twis aan te hits.

kjv_text: The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.
bsb_text: The words of a gossip are like choice morsels that go down into the inmost being.
aov_text: Die woorde van ’n kwaadstoker is soos lekkernye, en dit gly af na die kamers van die binneste.

kjv_text: Burning lips and a wicked heart are like a potsherd covered with silver dross.
bsb_text: Like glaze covering an earthen vessel are burning lips and a wicked heart.
aov_text: Silwerskuim waarmee ’n potskerf oorgetrek is—so is gloeiende lippe en ’n slegte hart.

kjv_text: He that hateth dissembleth with his lips, and layeth up deceit within him;
bsb_text: A hateful man disguises himself with his speech, but he lays up deceit in his heart.
aov_text: Die hater veins met sy lippe, maar in sy binneste koester hy bedrog.

kjv_text: When he speaketh fair, believe him not: for there are seven abominations in his heart.
bsb_text: When he speaks graciously, do not believe him, for seven abominations fill his heart.
aov_text: As hy sy stem lieflik maak, vertrou hom nie; want sewe gruwels is in sy hart.

kjv_text: Whose hatred is covered by deceit, his wickedness shall be shewed before the whole congregation.
bsb_text: Though his hatred is concealed by deception, his wickedness will be exposed in the assembly.
aov_text: Al verberg die haat homself in bedrog, sy boosheid word in die vergadering openbaar.

kjv_text: Whoso diggeth a pit shall fall therein: and he that rolleth a stone, it will return upon him.
bsb_text: He who digs a pit will fall into it, and he who rolls a stone will have it roll back on him.
aov_text: Wie ’n kuil grawe, sal daarin val; en hy wat ’n klip rol, dit sal na hom terugkom.

kjv_text: A lying tongue hateth those that are afflicted by it; and a flattering mouth worketh ruin.
bsb_text: A lying tongue hates those it crushes, and a flattering mouth causes ruin.
aov_text: ’n Valse tong haat die wat hy verbrysel het, en ’n gladde mond bewerk ondergang.

kjv_text: Boast not thyself of to morrow; for thou knowest not what a day may bring forth.
bsb_text: Do not boast about tomorrow, for you do not know what a day may bring.
aov_text: BEROEM jou nie op die dag van môre nie, want jy weet nie wat die dag sal bring nie.

kjv_text: Let another man praise thee, and not thine own mouth; a stranger, and not thine own lips.
bsb_text: Let another praise you, and not your own mouth—a stranger, and not your own lips.
aov_text: Laat ’n ander jou prys en nie jou eie mond nie; ’n vreemde, en nie jou eie lippe nie.

kjv_text: A stone is heavy, and the sand weighty; but a fool's wrath is heavier than them both.
bsb_text: A stone is heavy and sand is a burden, but aggravation from a fool outweighs them both.
aov_text: Swaar is ’n klip, en die sand het gewig; maar die ergernis oor ’n sot is swaarder as altwee.

kjv_text: Wrath is cruel, and anger is outrageous; but who is able to stand before envy?
bsb_text: Wrath is cruel and anger is like a flood, but who can withstand jealousy?
aov_text: Woede is wreed, en toorn kook oor; maar wie kan voor jaloersheid standhou?

kjv_text: Open rebuke is better than secret love.
bsb_text: Better an open rebuke than love that is concealed.
aov_text: Openlike teregwysing is beter as verborge liefde.

kjv_text: Faithful are the wounds of a friend; but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.
bsb_text: The wounds of a friend are faithful, but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.
aov_text: Die wonde deur een wat liefhet, is opreg bedoel, maar die soene deur ’n vyand is oorvloedig.

kjv_text: The full soul loatheth an honeycomb; but to the hungry soul every bitter thing is sweet.
bsb_text: The soul that is full loathes honey, but to a hungry soul, any bitter thing is sweet.
aov_text: ’n Versadigde siel vertrap die heuningstroop, maar vir ’n hongerige siel is alles wat bitter is, soet.

kjv_text: As a bird that wandereth from her nest, so is a man that wandereth from his place.
bsb_text: Like a bird that strays from its nest is a man who wanders from his home.
aov_text: Soos ’n voël wat ver van sy nes af rondvlieg, so is ’n man wat ver van sy tuisplek af rondswerwe.

kjv_text: Ointment and perfume rejoice the heart: so doth the sweetness of a man's friend by hearty counsel.
bsb_text: Oil and incense bring joy to the heart, and the sweetness of a friend is counsel to the soul.
aov_text: Olie en reukwerk verbly die hart, net so die aangenaamheid van ’n vriend vanweë welgemeende raad.

kjv_text: Thine own friend, and thy father's friend, forsake not; neither go into thy brother's house in the day of thy calamity: for better is a neighbour that is near than a brother far off.
bsb_text: Do not forsake your friend or your father’s friend, and do not go to your brother’s house in the day of your calamity; better a neighbor nearby than a brother far away.
aov_text: Moenie jou vriend en die vriend van jou vader verlaat nie, en kom nie in die huis van jou broer op die dag van jou teëspoed nie. ’n Buurman wat naby is, is beter as ’n broer wat ver is.

kjv_text: My son, be wise, and make my heart glad, that I may answer him that reproacheth me.
bsb_text: Be wise, my son, and bring joy to my heart, so that I can answer him who taunts me.
aov_text: Wees wys, my seun, en verbly my hart, sodat ek hom wat my smaad, kan antwoord gee.

kjv_text: A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself; but the simple pass on, and are punished.
bsb_text: The prudent see danger and take cover; but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
aov_text: As ’n skrandere die onheil sien, verberg hy hom; maar die eenvoudiges gaan verder, word gestraf.

kjv_text: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger, and take a pledge of him for a strange woman.
bsb_text: Take the garment of him who posts security for a stranger; get collateral if it is for a foreigner.
aov_text: Neem sy kleed weg, want hy het vir ’n ander borg gestaan; en neem hom as pand vir ’n onbekende.

kjv_text: He that blesseth his friend with a loud voice, rising early in the morning, it shall be counted a curse to him.
bsb_text: If one blesses his neighbor with a loud voice early in the morning, it will be counted to him as a curse.
aov_text: Wie vroeg in die môre sy naaste met ’n harde stem ’n seën toeroep, dit sal hom as ’n vloek aangereken word.

kjv_text: A continual dropping in a very rainy day and a contentious woman are alike.
bsb_text: A constant dripping on a rainy day and a contentious woman are alike—
aov_text: ’n Aanhoudende gedrup op die dag van ’n stortreën en ’n twisgierige vrou is net eenders.

kjv_text: Whosoever hideth her hideth the wind, and the ointment of his right hand, which bewrayeth itself.
bsb_text: restraining her is like holding back the wind or grasping oil with one’s right hand.
aov_text: Wie haar wil teëhou, hou wind teë, en sy regterhand ontmoet olie.

kjv_text: Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.
bsb_text: As iron sharpens iron, so one man sharpens another.
aov_text: Yster slyp yster, so slyp die een mens die persoon van die ander.

kjv_text: Whoso keepeth the fig tree shall eat the fruit thereof: so he that waiteth on his master shall be honoured.
bsb_text: Whoever tends a fig tree will eat its fruit, and he who looks after his master will be honored.
aov_text: Wie ’n vyeboom oppas, sal sy vrugte eet; en hy wat vir sy heer sorg, sal geëer word.

kjv_text: As in water face answereth to face, so the heart of man to man.
bsb_text: As water reflects the face, so the heart reflects the true man.
aov_text: Soos in die water aangesig teenoor aangesig is, so is die hart van die mens teenoor die mens.

kjv_text: Hell and destruction are never full; so the eyes of man are never satisfied.
bsb_text: Sheol and Abaddon are never satisfied; so the eyes of man are never satisfied.
aov_text: Die doderyk en die plek van vertering word nie versadig nie; so word die oë van ’n mens nie versadig nie.

kjv_text: As the fining pot for silver, and the furnace for gold; so is a man to his praise.
bsb_text: A crucible for silver and a furnace for gold, but a man is tested by the praise accorded him.
aov_text: Die smeltkroes is vir die silwer en die oond vir die goud, so is ’n man volgens die roem wat hy geniet.

kjv_text: Though thou shouldest bray a fool in a mortar among wheat with a pestle, yet will not his foolishness depart from him.
bsb_text: Though you grind a fool like grain with mortar and a pestle, yet his folly will not depart from him.
aov_text: Al stamp jy die sot in ’n stampblok tussen graankorrels met ’n stamper, sy sotheid sal nie van hom wyk nie.

kjv_text: Be thou diligent to know the state of thy flocks, and look well to thy herds.
bsb_text: Be sure to know the state of your flocks, and pay close attention to your herds;
aov_text: Gee noukeurig ag op die voorkoms van jou skape, rig jou aandag op die troppe vee;

kjv_text: For riches are not for ever: and doth the crown endure to every generation?
bsb_text: for riches are not forever, nor does a crown endure to every generation.
aov_text: want ’n skat is nie vir ewig nie—of sal ’n kroon wees van geslag tot geslag?

kjv_text: The hay appeareth, and the tender grass sheweth itself, and herbs of the mountains are gathered.
bsb_text: When hay is removed and new growth appears and the grain from the hills is gathered,
aov_text: As die gras verdwyn en die jong gras verskyn en die bossies van die berge bymekaargemaak word,

kjv_text: The lambs are for thy clothing, and the goats are the price of the field.
bsb_text: the lambs will provide you with clothing, and the goats with the price of a field.
aov_text: dan is daar lammers vir jou kleding en bokke as ’n koopprys vir grond,

kjv_text: And thou shalt have goats' milk enough for thy food, for the food of thy household, and for the maintenance for thy maidens.
bsb_text: You will have plenty of goats’ milk to feed you—food for your household and nourishment for your maidservants.
aov_text: en genoeg bokmelk as voeding vir jou, as voeding vir jou huis en as lewensonderhoud vir jou diensmeisies.

kjv_text: The wicked flee when no man pursueth: but the righteous are bold as a lion.
bsb_text: The wicked flee when no one pursues, but the righteous are as bold as a lion.
aov_text: DIE goddelose vlug sonder dat daar ’n vervolger is, maar die regverdiges voel hulle veilig soos ’n jong leeu.

kjv_text: For the transgression of a land many are the princes thereof: but by a man of understanding and knowledge the state thereof shall be prolonged.
bsb_text: A land in rebellion has many rulers, but a man of understanding and knowledge maintains order.
aov_text: Deur die oortreding van ’n land word sy vorste baie, maar deur ’n verstandige mens met kennis is die reg duursaam.

kjv_text: A poor man that oppresseth the poor is like a sweeping rain which leaveth no food.
bsb_text: A destitute leader who oppresses the poor is like a driving rain that leaves no food.
aov_text: ’n Man wat arm is en die armes verdruk, is soos ’n reën wat wegspoel en geen brood bring nie.

kjv_text: They that forsake the law praise the wicked: but such as keep the law contend with them.
bsb_text: Those who forsake the law praise the wicked, but those who keep the law resist them.
aov_text: Die wat die wet verlaat, hulle prys die goddelose; maar die wat die wet onderhou, word vererg oor hulle.

kjv_text: Evil men understand not judgment: but they that seek the LORD understand all things.
bsb_text: Evil men do not understand justice, but those who seek the LORD comprehend fully.
aov_text: Slegte mense verstaan die reg nie, maar die wat die HERE soek, verstaan alles.

kjv_text: Better is the poor that walketh in his uprightness, than he that is perverse in his ways, though he be rich.
bsb_text: Better a poor man who walks with integrity than a rich man whose ways are perverse.
aov_text: Die arme wat in sy regskapenheid wandel, is beter as die verkeerde wat twee paaie wil loop en daarby ryk is.

kjv_text: Whoso keepeth the law is a wise son: but he that is a companion of riotous men shameth his father.
bsb_text: A discerning son keeps the law, but a companion of gluttons disgraces his father.
aov_text: Wie die wet bewaar, is ’n verstandige seun; maar hy wat met deurbringers omgaan, steek sy vader in die skande.

kjv_text: He that by usury and unjust gain increaseth his substance, he shall gather it for him that will pity the poor.
bsb_text: He who increases his wealth by interest and usury lays it up for one who is kind to the poor.
aov_text: Wie sy goed vermeerder deur rente en deur woeker, maak bymekaar vir een wat hom oor die armes sal ontferm.

kjv_text: He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer shall be abomination.
bsb_text: Whoever turns his ear away from hearing the law, even his prayer is detestable.
aov_text: Wie sy oor wegdraai om nie na die wet te luister nie, selfs sy gebed is ’n gruwel.

kjv_text: Whoso causeth the righteous to go astray in an evil way, he shall fall himself into his own pit: but the upright shall have good things in possession.
bsb_text: He who leads the upright along the path of evil will fall into his own pit, but the blameless will inherit what is good.
aov_text: Wie die opregtes laat verdwaal op ’n verkeerde weg, sal self in sy eie kuil val; maar die regskapenes sal die goeie beërwe.

kjv_text: The rich man is wise in his own conceit; but the poor that hath understanding searcheth him out.
bsb_text: A rich man is wise in his own eyes, but a poor man with discernment sees through him.
aov_text: ’n Ryk man is wys in sy eie oë; maar ’n arme wat verstandig is, ondersoek hom terdeë.

kjv_text: When righteous men do rejoice, there is great glory: but when the wicked rise, a man is hidden.
bsb_text: When the righteous triumph, there is great glory, but when the wicked rise, men hide themselves.
aov_text: As die regverdiges juig, is die heerlikheid groot; maar as die goddelose opkom, moet die mense gesoek word.

kjv_text: He that covereth his sins shall not prosper: but whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall have mercy.
bsb_text: He who conceals his sins will not prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them will find mercy.
aov_text: Hy wat sy oortredinge bedek, sal nie voorspoedig wees nie; maar hy wat dit bely en laat staan, sal barmhartigheid vind.

kjv_text: Happy is the man that feareth alway: but he that hardeneth his heart shall fall into mischief.
bsb_text: Blessed is the man who is always reverent, but he who hardens his heart falls into trouble.
aov_text: Gelukkig is die mens wat gedurigdeur vrees; maar hy wat sy hart verhard, sal in die onheil val.

kjv_text: As a roaring lion, and a ranging bear; so is a wicked ruler over the poor people.
bsb_text: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.
aov_text: ’n Leeu wat brom, en ’n beer wat hongerig is, so is ’n goddelose wat oor ’n arm volk heers.

kjv_text: The prince that wanteth understanding is also a great oppressor: but he that hateth covetousness shall prolong his days.
bsb_text: A leader who lacks judgment is also a great oppressor, but he who hates dishonest profit will prolong his days.
aov_text: ’n Vors wat gebrek aan verstand het, is wel ryk aan afpersinge, maar die wat onregverdige wins haat, sal die dae verleng.

kjv_text: A man that doeth violence to the blood of any person shall flee to the pit; let no man stay him.
bsb_text: A man burdened by bloodguilt will flee into the Pit; let no one support him.
aov_text: ’n Mens wat gedruk word deur die bloed van ’n mens, sal vlug tot by die graf; laat niemand hom vashou nie.

kjv_text: Whoso walketh uprightly shall be saved: but he that is perverse in his ways shall fall at once.
bsb_text: He who walks with integrity will be kept safe, but whoever is perverse in his ways will suddenly fall.
aov_text: Wie opreg wandel, sal gehelp word; maar hy wat verward is, wat die twee paaie betref, sal meteens val.

kjv_text: He that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread: but he that followeth after vain persons shall have poverty enough.
bsb_text: The one who works his land will have plenty of food, but whoever chases fantasies will have his fill of poverty.
aov_text: Wie sy land bewerk, het volop brood; maar hy wat nietighede najaag, het armoede volop.

kjv_text: A faithful man shall abound with blessings: but he that maketh haste to be rich shall not be innocent.
bsb_text: A faithful man will abound with blessings, but one eager to be rich will not go unpunished.
aov_text: ’n Betroubare man is ryk aan seëninge; maar hy wat haastig is om ryk te word, sal nie ongestraf bly nie.

kjv_text: To have respect of persons is not good: for for a piece of bread that man will transgress.
bsb_text: To show partiality is not good, yet a man will do wrong for a piece of bread.
aov_text: Om partydig te wees, is nie goed nie, want ook vir ’n stuk brood kan ’n man ’n oortreding begaan.

kjv_text: He that hasteth to be rich hath an evil eye, and considereth not that poverty shall come upon him.
bsb_text: A stingy man hastens after wealth and does not know that poverty awaits him.
aov_text: ’n Afgunstige man oorhaas hom om ryk te word, en hy weet nie dat gebrek oor hom sal kom nie.

kjv_text: He that rebuketh a man afterwards shall find more favour than he that flattereth with the tongue.
bsb_text: He who rebukes a man will later find more favor than one who flatters with his tongue.
aov_text: Hy wat ’n mens teregwys, sal agterna meer guns vind as hy wat vlei.

kjv_text: Whoso robbeth his father or his mother, and saith, It is no transgression; the same is the companion of a destroyer.
bsb_text: He who robs his father or mother, saying, “It is not wrong,” is a companion to the man who destroys.
aov_text: Wie sy vader of sy moeder berowe, en sê: Dit is geen oortreding nie!—hy is ’n bondgenoot van ’n man wat verderflik handel.

kjv_text: He that is of a proud heart stirreth up strife: but he that putteth his trust in the LORD shall be made fat.
bsb_text: A greedy man stirs up strife, but he who trusts in the LORD will prosper.
aov_text: Die hebsugtige verwek twis; maar hy wat op die HERE vertrou, word verkwik.

kjv_text: He that trusteth in his own heart is a fool: but whoso walketh wisely, he shall be delivered.
bsb_text: He who trusts in himself is a fool, but one who walks in wisdom will be safe.
aov_text: Wie op sy eie hart vertrou, hy is ’n dwaas; maar hy wat in wysheid wandel, word gered.

kjv_text: He that giveth unto the poor shall not lack: but he that hideth his eyes shall have many a curse.
bsb_text: Whoever gives to the poor will not be in need, but he who hides his eyes will receive many curses.
aov_text: Wie aan die arme gee, sal nie gebrek ly nie; maar hy wat sy oë toemaak, word swaar vervloek.

kjv_text: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves: but when they perish, the righteous increase.
bsb_text: When the wicked come to power, people hide themselves; but when they perish, the righteous flourish.
aov_text: As die goddelose opkom, verberg die mens homself; maar as hulle omkom, word die regverdiges baie.

kjv_text: He, that being often reproved hardeneth his neck, shall suddenly be destroyed, and that without remedy.
bsb_text: A man who remains stiff-necked after much reproof will suddenly be shattered beyond recovery.
aov_text: ’N MAN wat baie bestraf is, en sy nek verhard, sal onvoorsiens verbreek word sonder dat daar genesing is.

kjv_text: When the righteous are in authority, the people rejoice: but when the wicked beareth rule, the people mourn.
bsb_text: When the righteous flourish, the people rejoice, but when the wicked rule, the people groan.
aov_text: As die regverdiges talryk word, is die volk bly; maar as die goddelose heers, sug die volk.

kjv_text: Whoso loveth wisdom rejoiceth his father: but he that keepeth company with harlots spendeth his substance.
bsb_text: A man who loves wisdom brings joy to his father, but a companion of prostitutes squanders his wealth.
aov_text: ’n Man wat die wysheid liefhet, verbly sy vader; maar hy wat met hoere omgaan, bring die goed deur.

kjv_text: The king by judgment establisheth the land: but he that receiveth gifts overthroweth it.
bsb_text: By justice a king brings stability to the land, but a man who exacts tribute demolishes it.
aov_text: ’n Koning hou deur reg die land in stand, maar ’n man wat belastings afpers, verwoes dit.

kjv_text: A man that flattereth his neighbour spreadeth a net for his feet.
bsb_text: A man who flatters his neighbor spreads a net for his feet.
aov_text: ’n Man wat sy naaste vlei, sprei ’n net uit voor sy voetstappe.

kjv_text: In the transgression of an evil man there is a snare: but the righteous doth sing and rejoice.
bsb_text: An evil man is caught by his own sin, but a righteous one sings and rejoices.
aov_text: In die oortreding van ’n slegte mens is ’n strik, maar die regverdige sal jubel en bly wees.

kjv_text: The righteous considereth the cause of the poor: but the wicked regardeth not to know it.
bsb_text: The righteous consider the cause of the poor, but the wicked have no regard for such concerns.
aov_text: Die regverdige ken die reg van die armes, maar die goddelose verkry geen kennis nie.

kjv_text: Scornful men bring a city into a snare: but wise men turn away wrath.
bsb_text: Mockers inflame a city, but the wise turn away anger.
aov_text: Manne wat spot, bring ’n stad in oproer, maar die wyse bring die toorn tot bedaring.

kjv_text: If a wise man contendeth with a foolish man, whether he rage or laugh, there is no rest.
bsb_text: If a wise man goes to court with a fool, there will be raving and laughing with no resolution.
aov_text: Het ’n wyse man met ’n sot ’n regsaak, dan gaan die sot te kere en lag, sonder bedaring.

kjv_text: The bloodthirsty hate the upright: but the just seek his soul.
bsb_text: Men of bloodshed hate a blameless man, but the upright care for his life.
aov_text: Manne van bloed haat die regskapene, en hulle soek die lewe van die opregtes.

kjv_text: A fool uttereth all his mind: but a wise man keepeth it in till afterwards.
bsb_text: A fool vents all his anger, but a wise man holds it back.
aov_text: ’n Dwaas laat al sy toorn uitvaar, maar ’n wyse bring dit eindelik tot bedaring.

kjv_text: If a ruler hearken to lies, all his servants are wicked.
bsb_text: If a ruler listens to lies, all his officials will be wicked.
aov_text: ’n Heerser wat luister na ’n leuenagtige woord, sy dienaars is almal goddeloos.

kjv_text: The poor and the deceitful man meet together: the LORD lighteneth both their eyes.
bsb_text: The poor man and the oppressor have this in common: The LORD gives light to the eyes of both.
aov_text: Die arme en die man wat verdruk, ontmoet mekaar, die HERE verlig altwee se oë.

kjv_text: The king that faithfully judgeth the poor, his throne shall be established for ever.
bsb_text: A king who judges the poor with fairness—his throne will be established forever.
aov_text: ’n Koning wat getrou aan die armes reg verskaf, sy troon sal vir altyd bevestig wees.

kjv_text: The rod and reproof give wisdom: but a child left to himself bringeth his mother to shame.
bsb_text: A rod of correction imparts wisdom, but a child left to himself disgraces his mother.
aov_text: Die roede en die bestraffing gee wysheid; maar ’n seun wat aan homself oorgelaat word, steek sy moeder in die skande.

kjv_text: When the wicked are multiplied, transgression increaseth: but the righteous shall see their fall.
bsb_text: When the wicked thrive, rebellion increases; but the righteous will see their downfall.
aov_text: As die goddelose vermeerder, vermeerder die oortreding; maar die regverdiges aanskou met welgevalle hulle ondergang.

kjv_text: Correct thy son, and he shall give thee rest; yea, he shall give delight unto thy soul.
bsb_text: Discipline your son, and he will give you rest; he will bring delight to your soul.
aov_text: Tugtig jou seun, dan sal hy jou rus gee en aan jou siel vreugde verskaf.

kjv_text: Where there is no vision, the people perish: but he that keepeth the law, happy is he.
bsb_text: Where there is no vision, the people cast off restraint; but blessed is he who keeps the Law.
aov_text: As daar geen openbaring is nie, word die volk bandeloos; maar hy wat die wet onderhou, gelukkig is hy.

kjv_text: A servant will not be corrected by words: for though he understand he will not answer.
bsb_text: A servant cannot be corrected by words alone; though he understands, he will not respond.
aov_text: Met woorde laat ’n slaaf hom nie waarsku nie; want hy verstaan dit wel, maar hy steur hom daar nie aan nie.

kjv_text: Seest thou a man that is hasty in his words? there is more hope of a fool than of him.
bsb_text: Do you see a man who speaks in haste? There is more hope for a fool than for him.
aov_text: Het jy ’n man gesien wat haastig is in sy woorde? Vir ’n dwaas is daar meer hoop as vir hom.

kjv_text: He that delicately bringeth up his servant from a child shall have him become his son at the length.
bsb_text: A servant pampered from his youth will bring grief in the end.
aov_text: As ’n mens sy slaaf van jongs af verwen, word hy op die end ondankbaar.

kjv_text: An angry man stirreth up strife, and a furious man aboundeth in transgression.
bsb_text: An angry man stirs up dissension, and a hot-tempered man abounds in transgression.
aov_text: ’n Opvlieënde man verwek twis, en ’n driftige man is ryk aan oortreding.

kjv_text: A man's pride shall bring him low: but honour shall uphold the humble in spirit.
bsb_text: A man’s pride will bring him low, but a humble spirit will obtain honor.
aov_text: Die trotsheid van ’n mens verneder hom, maar die nederige van gees sal eer verkry.

kjv_text: Whoso is partner with a thief hateth his own soul: he heareth cursing, and bewrayeth it not.
bsb_text: A partner to a thief hates his own soul; he receives the oath, but does not testify.
aov_text: Hy wat saam met ’n dief deel, haat sy eie siel; hy hoor die beswering, maar openbaar niks nie.

kjv_text: The fear of man bringeth a snare: but whoso putteth his trust in the LORD shall be safe.
bsb_text: The fear of man is a snare, but whoever trusts in the LORD is set securely on high.
aov_text: Die vrees vir die mens span ’n strik; maar hy wat op die HERE vertrou, sal beskut word.

kjv_text: Many seek the ruler's favour; but every man's judgment cometh from the LORD.
bsb_text: Many seek the ruler’s favor, but a man receives justice from the LORD.
aov_text: Daar is baie wat die aangesig van die heerser soek, maar die reg van ’n mens kom van die HERE.

kjv_text: An unjust man is an abomination to the just: and he that is upright in the way is abomination to the wicked.
bsb_text: An unjust man is detestable to the righteous, and one whose way is upright is detestable to the wicked.
aov_text: ’n Man van onreg is vir die regverdiges ’n gruwel, en vir die goddelose is die opregte van wandel ’n gruwel.

kjv_text: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, even the prophecy: the man spake unto Ithiel, even unto Ithiel and Ucal,
bsb_text: These are the words of Agur son of Jakeh—the burden that this man declared to Ithiel: “I am weary, O God, and worn out.
aov_text: DIE woorde van Agur, die seun van Jake; die Godspraak. Die man spreek: Ek het my moeg gemaak, o God, ek het my moeg gemaak, o God, en ek versmag.

kjv_text: Surely I am more brutish than any man, and have not the understanding of a man.
bsb_text: Surely I am the most ignorant of men, and I lack the understanding of a man.
aov_text: Ja, ek is te dom om mens te kan wees, en ek het geen menseverstand nie.

kjv_text: I neither learned wisdom, nor have the knowledge of the holy.
bsb_text: I have not learned wisdom, and I have no knowledge of the Holy One.
aov_text: En ek het nie wysheid geleer, sodat ek kennis van die Heilige sou besit nie.

kjv_text: Who hath ascended up into heaven, or descended? who hath gathered the wind in his fists? who hath bound the waters in a garment? who hath established all the ends of the earth? what is his name, and what is his son's name, if thou canst tell?
bsb_text: Who has ascended to heaven and come down? Who has gathered the wind in His hands? Who has bound up the waters in His cloak? Who has established all the ends of the earth? What is His name, and what is the name of His Son—surely you know!
aov_text: Wie het na die hemel opgeklim en neergedaal? Wie het die wind in sy vuiste versamel? Wie het die waters in ’n kleed saamgebind? Wie het al die eindes van die aarde vasgestel? Hoe is sy Naam? En hoe is die Naam van sy Seun—as jy dit weet?

kjv_text: Every word of God is pure: he is a shield unto them that put their trust in him.
bsb_text: Every word of God is flawless; He is a shield to those who take refuge in Him.
aov_text: Elke woord van God is gelouter; Hy is ’n skild vir die wat by Hom skuil.

kjv_text: Add thou not unto his words, lest he reprove thee, and thou be found a liar.
bsb_text: Do not add to His words, lest He rebuke you and prove you a liar.
aov_text: Voeg by sy woorde niks by nie, sodat Hy van jou nie rekenskap vorder en jy as ’n leuenaar openbaar word nie.

kjv_text: Two things have I required of thee; deny me them not before I die:
bsb_text: Two things I ask of You—do not refuse me before I die:
aov_text: Twee dinge vra ek van U; onthou dit nie aan my voordat ek sterf nie:

kjv_text: Remove far from me vanity and lies: give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with food convenient for me:
bsb_text: Keep falsehood and deceitful words far from me. Give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with the bread that is my portion.
aov_text: Hou valsheid en leuentaal ver van my af; gee my nie armoede of rykdom nie, laat my geniet die brood wat vir my bestem is;

kjv_text: Lest I be full, and deny thee, and say, Who is the LORD? or lest I be poor, and steal, and take the name of my God in vain.
bsb_text: Otherwise, I may have too much and deny You, saying, ‘Who is the LORD?’ Or I may become poor and steal, profaning the name of my God.
aov_text: dat ek nie, as ek oorversadig geword het, U verloën nie, en sê: Wie is die HERE? En dat ek nie, as ek arm geword het, steel en my aan die Naam van my God vergryp nie.

kjv_text: Accuse not a servant unto his master, lest he curse thee, and thou be found guilty.
bsb_text: Do not slander a servant to his master, or he will curse you, and you will bear the guilt.
aov_text: Belaster nie ’n slaaf by sy heer nie, sodat hy jou nie vloek en jy daarvoor moet boet nie.

kjv_text: There is a generation that curseth their father, and doth not bless their mother.
bsb_text: There is a generation of those who curse their fathers and do not bless their mothers.
aov_text: Daar is ’n geslag wat sy vader vervloek en sy moeder nie seën nie,

kjv_text: There is a generation that are pure in their own eyes, and yet is not washed from their filthiness.
bsb_text: There is a generation of those who are pure in their own eyes and yet unwashed of their filth.
aov_text: ’n geslag wat rein is in sy eie oë en tog van sy vuiligheid nie gewas is nie,

kjv_text: There is a generation, O how lofty are their eyes! and their eyelids are lifted up.
bsb_text: There is a generation—how haughty are their eyes and pretentious are their glances—
aov_text: ’n geslag—hoe trots is sy oë, en hoe hoog is sy ooglede opgetrek! —

kjv_text: There is a generation, whose teeth are as swords, and their jaw teeth as knives, to devour the poor from off the earth, and the needy from among men.
bsb_text: there is a generation whose teeth are swords and whose jaws are knives, devouring the oppressed from the earth and the needy from among men.
aov_text: ’n geslag waarvan die tande swaarde is, waarvan die gebit messe is, om die ellendiges uit die land te verteer en die behoeftiges onder die mensdom uit.

kjv_text: The horseleach hath two daughters, crying, Give, give. There are three things that are never satisfied, yea, four things say not, It is enough:
bsb_text: The leech has two daughters: Give and Give. There are three things that are never satisfied, four that never say, ‘Enough!’:
aov_text: Die bloedsuier het twee dogters: Gee, gee! Drie is dit wat nie versadig word nie; vier sê nooit: Genoeg nie! —

kjv_text: The grave; and the barren womb; the earth that is not filled with water; and the fire that saith not, It is enough.
bsb_text: Sheol, the barren womb, land never satisfied with water, and fire that never says, ‘Enough!’
aov_text: die doderyk en die toegesluite moederskoot, die aarde wat nie genoeg water kry en die vuur wat nooit sê: Genoeg nie!

kjv_text: The eye that mocketh at his father, and despiseth to obey his mother, the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, and the young eagles shall eat it.
bsb_text: As for the eye that mocks a father and scorns obedience to a mother, may the ravens of the valley pluck it out and young vultures devour it.
aov_text: ’n Oog wat met die vader spot en die gehoorsaamheid vir die moeder verag—die kraaie van die dal sal dit uitpik, en die kuikens van die arend sal dit opeet.

kjv_text: There be three things which are too wonderful for me, yea, four which I know not:
bsb_text: There are three things too wonderful for me, four that I cannot understand:
aov_text: Drie is dit wat vir my te wonderbaar is, ja, vier wat ek nie begryp nie:

kjv_text: The way of an eagle in the air; the way of a serpent upon a rock; the way of a ship in the midst of the sea; and the way of a man with a maid.
bsb_text: the way of an eagle in the sky, the way of a snake on a rock, the way of a ship at sea, and the way of a man with a maiden.
aov_text: die weg van die arend in die lug, die weg van ’n slang oor ’n rots, die weg van ’n skip in die hart van die see, en die weg van ’n man by ’n maagd.

kjv_text: Such is the way of an adulterous woman; she eateth, and wipeth her mouth, and saith, I have done no wickedness.
bsb_text: This is the way of an adulteress: She eats and wipes her mouth and says, ‘I have done nothing wrong.’
aov_text: So is die weg van ’n vrou wat owerspel bedryf; sy eet en vee haar mond af en sê: Ek het geen sonde gedoen nie.

kjv_text: For three things the earth is disquieted, and for four which it cannot bear:
bsb_text: Under three things the earth trembles, under four it cannot bear up:
aov_text: Onder drie bewe die aarde, en onder vier kan hy dit nie uithou nie:

kjv_text: For a servant when he reigneth; and a fool when he is filled with meat;
bsb_text: a servant who becomes king, a fool who is filled with food,
