aov_text: onder ’n slaaf as hy koning word, en ’n dwaas as hy volop brood het;

kjv_text: For an odious woman when she is married; and an handmaid that is heir to her mistress.
bsb_text: an unloved woman who marries, and a maidservant who supplants her mistress.
aov_text: onder ’n nie-geliefde as sy tog ’n man kry, en ’n slavin as sy haar meesteres uit die besitting verdrywe.

kjv_text: There be four things which are little upon the earth, but they are exceeding wise:
bsb_text: Four things on earth are small, yet they are exceedingly wise:
aov_text: Vier is dit wat klein is op die aarde, maar hulle is uitermate wys:

kjv_text: The ants are a people not strong, yet they prepare their meat in the summer;
bsb_text: The ants are creatures of little strength, yet they store up their food in the summer;
aov_text: die miere is nie ’n sterk volk nie, en tog berei hulle hul voedsel in die somer;

kjv_text: The conies are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks;
bsb_text: the rock badgers are creatures of little power, yet they make their homes in the rocks;
aov_text: die klipdassies is nie ’n magtige volk nie, en tog maak hulle hul huis in die rots;

kjv_text: The locusts have no king, yet go they forth all of them by bands;
bsb_text: the locusts have no king, yet they all advance in formation;
aov_text: die sprinkane het geen koning nie, en tog trek die hele swerm in goeie orde uit;

kjv_text: The spider taketh hold with her hands, and is in kings' palaces.
bsb_text: and the lizard can be caught in one’s hands, yet it is found in the palaces of kings.
aov_text: die geitjie kan jy met die hande gryp, en tog is hy in die konings se paleise.

kjv_text: There be three things which go well, yea, four are comely in going:
bsb_text: There are three things that are stately in their stride, and four that are impressive in their walk:
aov_text: Drie is dit wat statig wegstap, ja, vier wat statig wegloop:

kjv_text: A lion which is strongest among beasts, and turneth not away for any;
bsb_text: a lion, mighty among beasts, refusing to retreat before anything;
aov_text: die leeu, die held onder die diere, wat vir niks omdraai nie;

kjv_text: A greyhound; an he goat also; and a king, against whom there is no rising up.
bsb_text: a strutting rooster; a he-goat; and a king with his army around him.
aov_text: die dier met gespierde heupe, of die bok, en ’n koning met die troepemag by hom.

kjv_text: If thou hast done foolishly in lifting up thyself, or if thou hast thought evil, lay thine hand upon thy mouth.
bsb_text: If you have foolishly exalted yourself or if you have plotted evil, put your hand over your mouth.
aov_text: As jy dwaas gewees het deur jou te verhef, of as jy vooraf nagedink het—die hand op die mond!

kjv_text: Surely the churning of milk bringeth forth butter, and the wringing of the nose bringeth forth blood: so the forcing of wrath bringeth forth strife.
bsb_text: For as the churning of milk yields butter, and the twisting of the nose draws blood, so the stirring of anger brings forth strife.”
aov_text: Want drukking van melk bring botter voort, en drukking van die neus bring bloed voort, en drukking van die toorn bring twis voort.

kjv_text: The words of king Lemuel, the prophecy that his mother taught him.
bsb_text: These are the words of King Lemuel—the burden that his mother taught him:
aov_text: DIE woorde van Lémuël, die koning van Massa, waarmee sy moeder hom vermaan het:

kjv_text: What, my son? and what, the son of my womb? and what, the son of my vows?
bsb_text: What shall I say, O my son? What, O son of my womb? What, O son of my vows?
aov_text: Wat, my seun, ja wat, seun van my skoot, ja wat, seun van my geloftes, sal ek sê?

kjv_text: Give not thy strength unto women, nor thy ways to that which destroyeth kings.
bsb_text: Do not spend your strength on women or your vigor on those who ruin kings.
aov_text: Gee jou krag nie aan vroue of jou omgang aan die wat konings uitroei nie.

kjv_text: It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine; nor for princes strong drink:
bsb_text: It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine, or for rulers to crave strong drink,
aov_text: Die konings, o Lémuël, die konings moet nie wyn drink nie, en die vorste moet nie sterk drank begeer nie;

kjv_text: Lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the judgment of any of the afflicted.
bsb_text: lest they drink and forget what is decreed, depriving all the oppressed of justice.
aov_text: anders drink hy en vergeet die insettinge en verdraai die reg van al die ellendiges.

kjv_text: Give strong drink unto him that is ready to perish, and wine unto those that be of heavy hearts.
bsb_text: Give strong drink to one who is perishing, and wine to the bitter in soul.
aov_text: Gee sterk drank aan hom wat wil ondergaan, en wyn aan die wat bitter bedroef is.

kjv_text: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.
bsb_text: Let him drink and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.
aov_text: Laat hy drink en sy armoede vergeet en aan sy moeite nie meer dink nie.

kjv_text: Open thy mouth for the dumb in the cause of all such as are appointed to destruction.
bsb_text: Open your mouth for those with no voice, for the cause of all the dispossessed.
aov_text: Maak jou mond oop vir die stomme, vir die regsaak van almal wat wegkwyn.

kjv_text: Open thy mouth, judge righteously, and plead the cause of the poor and needy.
bsb_text: Open your mouth, judge righteously, and defend the cause of the poor and needy.
aov_text: Maak jou mond oop, oordeel regverdig, en verskaf reg aan die ellendige en die behoeftige.

kjv_text: Who can find a virtuous woman? for her price is far above rubies.
bsb_text: A wife of noble character, who can find? She is far more precious than rubies.
aov_text: Alef. Wie sal ’n deugsame vrou vind? want haar waarde is ver bo korale.

kjv_text: The heart of her husband doth safely trust in her, so that he shall have no need of spoil.
bsb_text: The heart of her husband trusts in her, and he lacks nothing of value.
aov_text: Bet. Die hart van haar man vertrou op haar, en aan wins sal dit hom nie ontbreek nie.

kjv_text: She will do him good and not evil all the days of her life.
bsb_text: She brings him good and not harm all the days of her life.
aov_text: Gimel. Sy doen aan hom goed, en nie kwaad nie, al die dae van haar lewe.

kjv_text: She seeketh wool, and flax, and worketh willingly with her hands.
bsb_text: She selects wool and flax and works with eager hands.
aov_text: Dalet. Sy sorg vir wol en vlas, en sy werk met gewillige hande.

kjv_text: She is like the merchants' ships; she bringeth her food from afar.
bsb_text: She is like the merchant ships, bringing her food from afar.
aov_text: He. Sy is soos die skepe van ’n handelaar—van ver af bring sy haar brood in.

kjv_text: She riseth also while it is yet night, and giveth meat to her household, and a portion to her maidens.
bsb_text: She rises while it is still night to provide food for her household and portions for her maidservants.
aov_text: Wau. En sy staan op as dit nog nag is en gee voedsel aan haar huisgesin en die bestemde deel aan haar diensmeisies.

kjv_text: She considereth a field, and buyeth it: with the fruit of her hands she planteth a vineyard.
bsb_text: She appraises a field and buys it; from her earnings she plants a vineyard.
aov_text: Sajin. Sy dink na oor ’n stuk grond en koop dit, van die vrug van haar hande plant sy ’n wingerd.

kjv_text: She girdeth her loins with strength, and strengtheneth her arms.
bsb_text: She girds herself with strength and shows that her arms are strong.
aov_text: Get. Sy omgord haar lendene met krag en hou haar arms stewig.

kjv_text: She perceiveth that her merchandise is good: her candle goeth not out by night.
bsb_text: She sees that her gain is good, and her lamp is not extinguished at night.
aov_text: Tet. Sy voel dat haar wins goed is, in die nag gaan haar lamp nie dood nie.

kjv_text: She layeth her hands to the spindle, and her hands hold the distaff.
bsb_text: She stretches out her hands to the distaff and grasps the spindle with her fingers.
aov_text: Jod. Sy steek haar hande uit na die spinstok, en haar handpalms hou die spoel vas.

kjv_text: She stretcheth out her hand to the poor; yea, she reacheth forth her hands to the needy.
bsb_text: She opens her arms to the poor and reaches out her hands to the needy.
aov_text: Kaf. Sy brei haar handpalm uit na die ellendige, en sy steek haar hande uit na die behoeftige.

kjv_text: She is not afraid of the snow for her household: for all her household are clothed with scarlet.
bsb_text: When it snows, she has no fear for her household, for they are all clothed in scarlet.
aov_text: Lamed. Sy is nie bevrees vir haar huisgesin vanweë die sneeu nie, want haar hele huisgesin dra skarlaken stof.

kjv_text: She maketh herself coverings of tapestry; her clothing is silk and purple.
bsb_text: She makes coverings for her bed; her clothing is fine linen and purple.
aov_text: Mem. Sy maak vir haarself dekens, haar tabberd is van fyn linne en purper.

kjv_text: Her husband is known in the gates, when he sitteth among the elders of the land.
bsb_text: Her husband is known at the city gate, where he sits among the elders of the land.
aov_text: Noen. Haar man is bekend in die poorte as hy saam met die oudstes van die land sit.

kjv_text: She maketh fine linen, and selleth it; and delivereth girdles unto the merchant.
bsb_text: She makes linen garments and sells them; she delivers sashes to the merchants.
aov_text: Samek. Sy maak hemde en verkoop dit, en gordels lewer sy aan die handelaars.

kjv_text: Strength and honour are her clothing; and she shall rejoice in time to come.
bsb_text: Strength and honor are her clothing, and she can laugh at the days to come.
aov_text: Ajin. Sterkte en eer is haar kleed, en sy lag oor die dag wat kom.

kjv_text: She openeth her mouth with wisdom; and in her tongue is the law of kindness.
bsb_text: She opens her mouth with wisdom, and faithful instruction is on her tongue.
aov_text: Pe. Haar mond maak sy oop met wysheid, en vriendelike onderrigting is op haar tong.

kjv_text: She looketh well to the ways of her household, and eateth not the bread of idleness.
bsb_text: She watches over the affairs of her household and does not eat the bread of idleness.
aov_text: Sade. Opmerksaam gaan sy die werksaamhede van haar huis na, en die brood van luiheid eet sy nie.

kjv_text: Her children arise up, and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praiseth her.
bsb_text: Her children rise up and call her blessed; her husband praises her as well:
aov_text: Kof. Haar seuns tree op en noem haar gelukkig, haar man ook, en hy prys haar:

kjv_text: Many daughters have done virtuously, but thou excellest them all.
bsb_text: “Many daughters have done noble things, but you surpass them all!”
aov_text: Resj. Baie dogters het hulle knap gedra, maar jy oortref hulle almal.

kjv_text: Favour is deceitful, and beauty is vain: but a woman that feareth the LORD, she shall be praised.
bsb_text: Charm is deceptive and beauty is fleeting, but a woman who fears the LORD is to be praised.
aov_text: Sjin. Die bevalligheid is bedrog, en die skoonheid is nietigheid; ’n vrou wat die HERE vrees, sy moet geprys word.

kjv_text: Give her of the fruit of her hands; and let her own works praise her in the gates.
bsb_text: Give her the fruit of her hands, and let her works praise her at the gates.
aov_text: Tau. Gee haar van die vrug van haar hande, en laat haar werke haar prys in die poorte.

kjv_text: The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem.
bsb_text: These are the words of the Teacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem:
aov_text: DIE woorde van die Prediker, die seun van Dawid, die koning in Jerusalem.

kjv_text: Vanity of vanities, saith the Preacher, vanity of vanities; all is vanity.
bsb_text: “Futility of futilities,” says the Teacher, “futility of futilities! Everything is futile!”
aov_text: Alles tevergeefs, sê die Prediker, alles tevergeefs, dit is alles tevergeefs!

kjv_text: What profit hath a man of all his labour which he taketh under the sun?
bsb_text: What does a man gain from all his labor, at which he toils under the sun?
aov_text: Watter voordeel het die mens van al sy moeite waarmee hy hom vermoei onder die son?

kjv_text: One generation passeth away, and another generation cometh: but the earth abideth for ever.
bsb_text: Generations come and generations go, but the earth remains forever.
aov_text: Die een geslag gaan, en die ander geslag kom, en die aarde bly vir ewig staan.

kjv_text: The sun also ariseth, and the sun goeth down, and hasteth to his place where he arose.
bsb_text: The sun rises and the sun sets; it hurries back to where it rises.
aov_text: En die son gaan op, en die son gaan onder, en hy hyg na die plek waar hy opgaan.

kjv_text: The wind goeth toward the south, and turneth about unto the north; it whirleth about continually, and the wind returneth again according to his circuits.
bsb_text: The wind blows southward, then turns northward; round and round it swirls, ever returning on its course.
aov_text: Die wind gaan na die suide en slaan om na die noorde, gaan altyddeur rond, en die wind keer na sy kringloop terug.

kjv_text: All the rivers run into the sea; yet the sea is not full; unto the place from whence the rivers come, thither they return again.
bsb_text: All the rivers flow into the sea, yet the sea is never full; to the place from which the streams come, there again they flow.
aov_text: Al die strome loop in die see, en tog word die see nie vol nie; na die plek waarheen die riviere loop, daarheen loop hulle altyd weer.

kjv_text: All things are full of labour; man cannot utter it: the eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear filled with hearing.
bsb_text: All things are wearisome, more than one can describe; the eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear content with hearing.
aov_text: Al die dinge is so vermoeiend, geen mens kan dit uitspreek nie; die oog kry nie genoeg van sien nie, en die oor word nie vol van hoor nie.

kjv_text: The thing that hath been, it is that which shall be; and that which is done is that which shall be done: and there is no new thing under the sun.
bsb_text: What has been will be again, and what has been done will be done again; there is nothing new under the sun.
aov_text: Wat gewees het, dit sal daar weer wees; en wat gebeur het, dit sal weer gebeur, en daar is glad niks nuuts onder die son nie.

kjv_text: Is there any thing whereof it may be said, See, this is new? it hath been already of old time, which was before us.
bsb_text: Is there a case where one can say, “Look, this is new”? It has already existed in the ages before us.
aov_text: Is daar iets waarvan ’n mens kan sê: Kyk hier, dit is nuut? Dit was lankal daar in die ou tyd wat voor ons gewees het.

kjv_text: There is no remembrance of former things; neither shall there be any remembrance of things that are to come with those that shall come after.
bsb_text: There is no remembrance of those who came before, and those yet to come will not be remembered by those who follow after.
aov_text: Daar is geen nagedagtenis van die voorvaders nie; en ook van die nageslagte wat kom, sal daar geen nagedagtenis wees by die wat later sal wees nie.

kjv_text: I the Preacher was king over Israel in Jerusalem.
bsb_text: I, the Teacher, was king over Israel in Jerusalem.
aov_text: EK, Prediker, was koning oor Israel in Jerusalem.

kjv_text: And I gave my heart to seek and search out by wisdom concerning all things that are done under heaven: this sore travail hath God given to the sons of man to be exercised therewith.
bsb_text: And I set my mind to seek and explore by wisdom all that is done under heaven. What a heavy burden God has laid upon the sons of men to occupy them!
aov_text: En ek het my hart daarop gerig om met wysheid te ondersoek en na te speur alles wat onder die hemel gebeur. Dit is ’n moeilike taak wat God aan die mensekinders gegee het om hulle daarmee te kwel.

kjv_text: I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and, behold, all is vanity and vexation of spirit.
bsb_text: I have seen all the things that are done under the sun, and have found them all to be futile, a pursuit of the wind.
aov_text: Ek het al die werke gesien wat onder die son gedoen word, en kyk, dit was alles tevergeefs en ’n gejaag na wind.

kjv_text: That which is crooked cannot be made straight: and that which is wanting cannot be numbered.
bsb_text: What is crooked cannot be straightened, and what is lacking cannot be counted.
aov_text: Wat krom is, kan nie reguit word nie, en wat ontbreek, kan nie getel word nie.

kjv_text: I communed with mine own heart, saying, Lo, I am come to great estate, and have gotten more wisdom than all they that have been before me in Jerusalem: yea, my heart had great experience of wisdom and knowledge.
bsb_text: I said to myself, “Behold, I have grown and increased in wisdom beyond all those before me who were over Jerusalem, and my mind has observed a wealth of wisdom and knowledge.”
aov_text: Ek het met myself gespreek en gesê: Kyk, ék het groot en altyd groter wysheid verwerf bo almal wat voor my oor Jerusalem gewees het, en my hart het baie wysheid en kennis gesien.

kjv_text: And I gave my heart to know wisdom, and to know madness and folly: I perceived that this also is vexation of spirit.
bsb_text: So I set my mind to know wisdom and madness and folly; I learned that this, too, is a pursuit of the wind.
aov_text: Maar toe ek my hart daarop gerig het om wysheid en kennis, onverstandigheid en dwaasheid te leer ken, het ek ingesien dat dit ook ’n gejaag na wind is.

kjv_text: For in much wisdom is much grief: and he that increaseth knowledge increaseth sorrow.
bsb_text: For with much wisdom comes much sorrow, and as knowledge grows, grief increases.
aov_text: Want by baie wysheid is baie verdriet, en wie kennis vermeerder, vermeerder smart.

kjv_text: I said in mine heart, Go to now, I will prove thee with mirth, therefore enjoy pleasure: and, behold, this also is vanity.
bsb_text: I said to myself, “Come now, I will test you with pleasure; enjoy what is good!” But it proved to be futile.
aov_text: EK het in my hart gesê: Nou ja, ek sal jou met vreugde op die proef stel; geniet dan die goeie! Maar kyk, ook dit was tevergeefs.

kjv_text: I said of laughter, It is mad: and of mirth, What doeth it?
bsb_text: I said of laughter, “It is folly,” and of pleasure, “What does it accomplish?”
aov_text: Van die lag het ek gesê: Dit is onsinnig! en van die vreugde: Wat verskaf dit?

kjv_text: I sought in mine heart to give myself unto wine, yet acquainting mine heart with wisdom; and to lay hold on folly, till I might see what was that good for the sons of men, which they should do under the heaven all the days of their life.
bsb_text: I sought to cheer my body with wine and to embrace folly—my mind still guiding me with wisdom—until I could see what was worthwhile for men to do under heaven during the few days of their lives.
aov_text: Ek het in my hart daaroor nagedink om my liggaam met wyn te verkwik—terwyl my hart my met wysheid sou lei—en om aan die dwaasheid vas te hou totdat ek sou sien wat goed is vir die mensekinders, wat hulle moet doen onder die hemel gedurende die getal van hulle lewensdae.

kjv_text: I made me great works; I builded me houses; I planted me vineyards:
bsb_text: I expanded my pursuits. I built houses and planted vineyards for myself.
aov_text: Ek het groot werke onderneem: ek het vir my huise gebou, ek het vir my wingerde geplant.

kjv_text: I made me gardens and orchards, and I planted trees in them of all kind of fruits:
bsb_text: I made gardens and parks for myself, where I planted all kinds of fruit trees.
aov_text: Ek het vir my tuine en parke aangelê en daar allerhande vrugtebome in geplant.

kjv_text: I made me pools of water, to water therewith the wood that bringeth forth trees:
bsb_text: I built reservoirs to water my groves of flourishing trees.
aov_text: Ek het vir my damme gemaak om daaruit ’n bos met jong bome te besproei.

kjv_text: I got me servants and maidens, and had servants born in my house; also I had great possessions of great and small cattle above all that were in Jerusalem before me:
bsb_text: I acquired menservants and maidservants, and servants were born in my house. I also owned more herds and flocks than anyone in Jerusalem before me,
aov_text: Ek het slawe en slavinne gekoop en ook dié verkry wat in my huis gebore is; ek het ook ’n groot besitting van beeste en kleinvee gehad, meer as almal wat voor my in Jerusalem gewees het.

kjv_text: I gathered me also silver and gold, and the peculiar treasure of kings and of the provinces: I gat me men singers and women singers, and the delights of the sons of men, as musical instruments, and that of all sorts.
bsb_text: and I accumulated for myself silver and gold and the treasure of kings and provinces. I gathered to myself male and female singers, and the delights of the sons of men—many concubines.
aov_text: Ek het vir my ook silwer en goud versamel, en ’n eiendom van konings en provinsies; ek het vir my sangers en sangeresse verskaf en die genoeëns van die mensekinders: lieflinge in menigte.

kjv_text: So I was great, and increased more than all that were before me in Jerusalem: also my wisdom remained with me.
bsb_text: So I became great and surpassed all in Jerusalem who had preceded me; and my wisdom remained with me.
aov_text: En ek het groot en altyd groter geword bo almal wat voor my in Jerusalem gewees het; ook het my wysheid by my gebly.

kjv_text: And whatsoever mine eyes desired I kept not from them, I withheld not my heart from any joy; for my heart rejoiced in all my labour: and this was my portion of all my labour.
bsb_text: Anything my eyes desired, I did not deny myself. I refused my heart no pleasure. For my heart took delight in all my work, and this was the reward for all my labor.
aov_text: En alles wat my oë begeer het, het ek hulle nie ontsê nie; my hart het ek van geen enkele vreugde teruggehou nie, want my hart het hom verheug vanweë al my moeitevolle arbeid, en dit was my deel van al my moeitevolle arbeid.

kjv_text: Then I looked on all the works that my hands had wrought, and on the labour that I had laboured to do: and, behold, all was vanity and vexation of spirit, and there was no profit under the sun.
bsb_text: Yet when I considered all the works that my hands had accomplished and what I had toiled to achieve, I found everything to be futile, a pursuit of the wind; there was nothing to be gained under the sun.
aov_text: Toe het ek gekyk na al my werke wat my hande tot stand gebring het, en al die moeitevolle arbeid wat ek verrig het—en kyk, dit was alles tevergeefs en ’n gejaag na wind, en daar was geen voordeel onder die son nie.

kjv_text: And I turned myself to behold wisdom, and madness, and folly: for what can the man do that cometh after the king? even that which hath been already done.
bsb_text: Then I turned to consider wisdom and madness and folly; for what more can the king’s successor do than what has already been accomplished?
aov_text: Daarna het ek my begewe om wysheid en onverstandigheid en dwaasheid in oënskou te neem, want wat sal die mens kan doen wat ná die koning kom? Wat lankal gedoen is!

kjv_text: Then I saw that wisdom excelleth folly, as far as light excelleth darkness.
bsb_text: And I saw that wisdom exceeds folly, just as light exceeds darkness:
aov_text: Wel het ek gesien dat die wysheid die voorkeur het bo die dwaasheid soos die lig die voorkeur het bo die duisternis:

kjv_text: The wise man's eyes are in his head; but the fool walketh in darkness: and I myself perceived also that one event happeneth to them all.
bsb_text: The wise man has eyes in his head, but the fool walks in darkness. Yet I also came to realize that one fate overcomes them both.
aov_text: die wyse het sy oë in sy hoof, maar die dwaas wandel in die duisternis. Maar ek het óók ingesien dat een en dieselfde lot hulle almal tref.

kjv_text: Then said I in my heart, As it happeneth to the fool, so it happeneth even to me; and why was I then more wise? Then I said in my heart, that this also is vanity.
bsb_text: So I said to myself, “The fate of the fool will also befall me. What then have I gained by being wise?” And I said to myself that this too is futile.
aov_text: Daarom het ek in my hart gesê: Dieselfde wat die dwaas tref, sal my ook tref; waarvoor was ek dan so buitengewoon wys? En ek het in my hart gespreek dat dit ook tevergeefs is.

kjv_text: For there is no remembrance of the wise more than of the fool for ever; seeing that which now is in the days to come shall all be forgotten. And how dieth the wise man? as the fool.
bsb_text: For there is no lasting remembrance of the wise, just as with the fool, seeing that both will be forgotten in the days to come. Alas, the wise man will die just like the fool!
aov_text: Want daar sal op die duur net so min gedagtenis wees van die wyse as van die dwaas, omdat in die dae wat kom, alles lankal vergeet is; en hoe sterf die wyse net soos die dwaas!

kjv_text: Therefore I hated life; because the work that is wrought under the sun is grievous unto me: for all is vanity and vexation of spirit.
bsb_text: So I hated life, because the work that is done under the sun was grievous to me. For everything is futile and a pursuit of the wind.
aov_text: Daarom het ek die lewe gehaat, want die werk wat onder die son gedoen word, het my mishaag, omdat alles tevergeefs is en ’n gejaag na wind.

kjv_text: Yea, I hated all my labour which I had taken under the sun: because I should leave it unto the man that shall be after me.
bsb_text: I hated all for which I had toiled under the sun, because I must leave it to the man who comes after me.
aov_text: En ek het gehaat al my arbeid wat ek onder die son met moeite verrig het, dat ek dit moet oorlaat aan ’n mens wat ná my sal kom.

kjv_text: And who knoweth whether he shall be a wise man or a fool? yet shall he have rule over all my labour wherein I have laboured, and wherein I have shewed myself wise under the sun. This is also vanity.
bsb_text: And who knows whether that man will be wise or foolish? Yet he will take over all the labor at which I have worked skillfully under the sun. This too is futile.
aov_text: En wie weet of hy ’n wyse sal wees of ’n dwaas? Tog sal hy heers oor al my arbeid wat ek met moeite verrig en met wysheid verwerf het onder die son. Ook dit is dan tevergeefs.

kjv_text: Therefore I went about to cause my heart to despair of all the labour which I took under the sun.
bsb_text: So my heart began to despair over all the labor that I had done under the sun.
aov_text: Daarom het ek my begewe om my hart aan wanhoop oor te gee vanweë al die arbeid wat ek met moeite verrig het onder die son.

kjv_text: For there is a man whose labour is in wisdom, and in knowledge, and in equity; yet to a man that hath not laboured therein shall he leave it for his portion. This also is vanity and a great evil.
bsb_text: When there is a man who has labored with wisdom, knowledge, and skill, and he must give his portion to a man who has not worked for it, this too is futile and a great evil.
aov_text: Want daar is ’n mens wat hom met wysheid en kennis en bekwaamheid vermoei het; tog moet hy dit as deel oorgee aan ’n mens wat daaraan geen moeite bestee het nie. Ook dit is tevergeefs en ’n groot euwel.

kjv_text: For what hath man of all his labour, and of the vexation of his heart, wherein he hath laboured under the sun?
bsb_text: For what does a man get for all the toil and striving with which he labors under the sun?
aov_text: Want wat het die mens vir al sy arbeid en vir die strewe van sy hart waarmee hy hom vermoei onder die son?

kjv_text: For all his days are sorrows, and his travail grief; yea, his heart taketh not rest in the night. This is also vanity.
bsb_text: Indeed, all his days are filled with grief, and his task is sorrowful; even at night, his mind does not rest. This too is futile.
aov_text: Want al sy dae is smarte, en sy bemoeienis is verdriet; selfs snags rus sy hart nie. Dit is dan ook tevergeefs.

kjv_text: There is nothing better for a man, than that he should eat and drink, and that he should make his soul enjoy good in his labour. This also I saw, that it was from the hand of God.
bsb_text: Nothing is better for a man than to eat and drink and enjoy his work. I have also seen that this is from the hand of God.
aov_text: Dit is nie ’n goed wat in die mens kleef dat hy eet en drink en sy siel die goeie laat geniet by sy moeitevolle arbeid nie. Ek het gesien dat dit ook kom uit die hand van God.

kjv_text: For who can eat, or who else can hasten hereunto, more than I?
bsb_text: For apart from Him, who can eat and who can find enjoyment?
aov_text: Want wie kan eet en wie kan geniet sonder Hom?

kjv_text: For God giveth to a man that is good in his sight wisdom, and knowledge, and joy: but to the sinner he giveth travail, to gather and to heap up, that he may give to him that is good before God. This also is vanity and vexation of spirit.
bsb_text: To the man who is pleasing in His sight, He gives wisdom and knowledge and joy, but to the sinner He assigns the task of gathering and accumulating that which he will hand over to one who pleases God. This too is futile and a pursuit of the wind.
aov_text: Want aan ’n mens wat welgevallig is voor sy aangesig, gee Hy wysheid en kennis en vreugde, maar aan die sondaar lê Hy die taak op om bymekaar te maak en te versamel, om dit dan te gee aan een wat welgevallig is voor die aangesig van God. Ook dit is tevergeefs en ’n gejaag na wind.

kjv_text: To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven:
bsb_text: To everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven:
aov_text: ALLES het sy bepaalde uur, en vir elke saak onder die hemel is daar ’n tyd:

kjv_text: A time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted;
bsb_text: a time to be born and a time to die, a time to plant and a time to uproot,
aov_text: ’n tyd om gebore te word en ’n tyd om te sterwe, ’n tyd om te plant en ’n tyd om uit te roei wat geplant is,

kjv_text: A time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up;
bsb_text: a time to kill and a time to heal, a time to break down and a time to build,
aov_text: ’n tyd om dood te maak en ’n tyd om gesond te maak, ’n tyd om af te breek en ’n tyd om op te bou,

kjv_text: A time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;
bsb_text: a time to weep and a time to laugh, a time to mourn and a time to dance,
aov_text: ’n tyd om te ween en ’n tyd om te lag, ’n tyd om te weeklaag en ’n tyd om van vreugde rond te spring,

kjv_text: A time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together; a time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing;
bsb_text: a time to cast away stones and a time to gather stones together, a time to embrace and a time to refrain from embracing,
aov_text: ’n tyd om klippe weg te gooi en ’n tyd om klippe bymekaar te maak, ’n tyd om te omhels en ’n tyd om ver te wees van omhelsing,

kjv_text: A time to get, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to cast away;
bsb_text: a time to search and a time to count as lost, a time to keep and a time to discard,
aov_text: ’n tyd om te soek en ’n tyd om verlore te laat gaan, ’n tyd om te bewaar en ’n tyd om weg te gooi,

kjv_text: A time to rend, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and a time to speak;
bsb_text: a time to tear and a time to mend, a time to be silent and a time to speak,
aov_text: ’n tyd om te skeur en ’n tyd om aanmekaar te werk, ’n tyd om te swyg en ’n tyd om te spreek,

kjv_text: A time to love, and a time to hate; a time of war, and a time of peace.
bsb_text: a time to love and a time to hate, a time for war and a time for peace.
aov_text: ’n tyd om lief te hê en ’n tyd om te haat, ’n tyd vir oorlog en ’n tyd vir vrede.

kjv_text: What profit hath he that worketh in that wherein he laboureth?
bsb_text: What does the worker gain from his toil?
aov_text: Watter voordeel het hy wat werk, daardeur dat hy hom vermoei?

kjv_text: I have seen the travail, which God hath given to the sons of men to be exercised in it.
bsb_text: I have seen the burden that God has laid upon the sons of men to occupy them.
aov_text: Ek het die taak gesien wat God aan die mensekinders gegee het om hulle daarmee te kwel.

kjv_text: He hath made every thing beautiful in his time: also he hath set the world in their heart, so that no man can find out the work that God maketh from the beginning to the end.
bsb_text: He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in the hearts of men, yet they cannot fathom the work that God has done from beginning to end.
aov_text: Alles het Hy mooi gemaak op sy tyd; ook het Hy die eeu in hulle hart gelê sonder dat die mens die werk wat God doen, van begin tot end, kan uitvind.

kjv_text: I know that there is no good in them, but for a man to rejoice, and to do good in his life.
bsb_text: I know that there is nothing better for them than to rejoice and do good while they live,
aov_text: So het ek dan ingesien dat daar niks beters onder hulle is nie as om bly te wees en om goed te doen in die lewe.

kjv_text: And also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy the good of all his labour, it is the gift of God.
bsb_text: and also that every man should eat and drink and find satisfaction in all his labor—this is the gift of God.
aov_text: En ook—dat elke mens eet en drink en die goeie geniet by al sy moeitevolle arbeid; dit is ’n gawe van God.

kjv_text: I know that, whatsoever God doeth, it shall be for ever: nothing can be put to it, nor any thing taken from it: and God doeth it, that men should fear before him.
bsb_text: I know that everything God does endures forever; nothing can be added to it or taken from it. God does it so that they should fear Him.
aov_text: Ek het ingesien dat alles wat God doen, vir ewig sal bestaan; daar kan niks bygevoeg en daar kan niks van weggeneem word nie; en God het dit so gemaak dat hulle moet vrees voor sy aangesig.

kjv_text: That which hath been is now; and that which is to be hath already been; and God requireth that which is past.
bsb_text: What exists has already been, and what will be has already been, for God will call to account what has passed.
aov_text: Alles wat is, was alreeds; en wat sal wees, was alreeds; en God soek weer op wat verbygegaan het.

kjv_text: And moreover I saw under the sun the place of judgment, that wickedness was there; and the place of righteousness, that iniquity was there.
bsb_text: Furthermore, I saw under the sun that in the place of judgment there is wickedness, and in the place of righteousness there is wickedness.
aov_text: Verder het ek ook gesien onder die son die plek van die gereg—daar was onreg, en die plek van geregtigheid—daar was onreg.

kjv_text: I said in mine heart, God shall judge the righteous and the wicked: for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work.
bsb_text: I said in my heart, “God will judge the righteous and the wicked, since there is a time for every activity and every deed.”
aov_text: Ek het in my hart gesê: Gód sal die regverdige en die goddelose oordeel, want dáár is ’n tyd vir elke saak en vir elke werk.

kjv_text: I said in mine heart concerning the estate of the sons of men, that God might manifest them, and that they might see that they themselves are beasts.
bsb_text: I said to myself, “As for the sons of men, God tests them so that they may see for themselves that they are but beasts.”
aov_text: Ek het in my hart gesê: Ter wille van die mensekinders gebeur dit, dat God hulle kan beproef, en dat hulle kan insien dat hulle in hulleself vee is.

kjv_text: For that which befalleth the sons of men befalleth beasts; even one thing befalleth them: as the one dieth, so dieth the other; yea, they have all one breath; so that a man hath no preeminence above a beast: for all is vanity.
bsb_text: For the fates of both men and beasts are the same: As one dies, so dies the other—they all have the same breath. Man has no advantage over the animals, since everything is futile.
aov_text: Want die lot van die mensekinders is ook die lot van die veediere: hulle het een en dieselfde lot; soos die een sterwe, so sterwe die ander, en hulle almal het dieselfde asem, en ’n voorkeur van die mens bo die veediere is daar nie; want alles is tevergeefs.

kjv_text: All go unto one place; all are of the dust, and all turn to dust again.
bsb_text: All go to one place; all come from dust, and all return to dust.
aov_text: Alles gaan na een plek toe; alles is uit die stof, en alles keer na die stof terug.

kjv_text: Who knoweth the spirit of man that goeth upward, and the spirit of the beast that goeth downward to the earth?
bsb_text: Who knows if the spirit of man rises upward and the spirit of the animal descends into the earth?
aov_text: Wie bespeur dat die asem van die mensekinders opgaan boontoe, en dat die asem van die veediere neerdaal ondertoe in die aarde?

kjv_text: Wherefore I perceive that there is nothing better, than that a man should rejoice in his own works; for that is his portion: for who shall bring him to see what shall be after him?
bsb_text: I have seen that there is nothing better for a man than to enjoy his work, because that is his lot. For who can bring him to see what will come after him?
aov_text: So het ek dan gesien dat daar niks beters is as dat die mens hom verheug in sy werke nie, want dit is sy deel; want wie sal hom daartoe bring dat hy kan sien wat ná hom sal wees?

kjv_text: So I returned, and considered all the oppressions that are done under the sun: and behold the tears of such as were oppressed, and they had no comforter; and on the side of their oppressors there was power; but they had no comforter.
bsb_text: Again I looked, and I considered all the oppression taking place under the sun. I saw the tears of the oppressed, and they had no comforter; the power lay in the hands of their oppressors, and there was no comforter.
aov_text: DAARNA weer het ek gesien al die verdrukkinge wat onder die son plaasvind, en kyk, daar was trane van verdruktes, en vir hulle was daar geen trooster nie; en aan die kant van hulle verdrukkers was mag, maar daar was vir hulle geen trooster nie.

kjv_text: Wherefore I praised the dead which are already dead more than the living which are yet alive.
bsb_text: So I admired the dead, who had already died, above the living, who are still alive.
aov_text: Daarom het ek die dooies wat lankal gesterf het, gelukkig geprys bo die lewendes wat nog lewe,

kjv_text: Yea, better is he than both they, which hath not yet been, who hath not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.
bsb_text: But better than both is he who has not yet existed, who has not seen the evil that is done under the sun.
aov_text: en gelukkig bo hulle altwee hom wat nog nie gewees het en die verkeerde werk wat onder die son plaasvind, nie gesien het nie.

kjv_text: Again, I considered all travail, and every right work, that for this a man is envied of his neighbour. This is also vanity and vexation of spirit.
bsb_text: I saw that all labor and success spring from a man’s envy of his neighbor. This too is futile and a pursuit of the wind.
aov_text: Verder het ek gesien dat al die moeitevolle arbeid en al die bekwaamheid by die werk naywer is van die een teenoor die ander. Ook dit is tevergeefs en ’n gejaag na wind.

kjv_text: The fool foldeth his hands together, and eateth his own flesh.
bsb_text: The fool folds his hands and consumes his own flesh.
aov_text: Die dwaas vou sy hande en eet sy eie vlees op.

kjv_text: Better is an handful with quietness, than both the hands full with travail and vexation of spirit.
bsb_text: Better one handful with tranquility than two handfuls with toil and pursuit of the wind.
aov_text: Een handvol rus is beter as altwee vuiste vol moeite en gejaag na wind.

kjv_text: Then I returned, and I saw vanity under the sun.
bsb_text: Again, I saw futility under the sun.
aov_text: En weer het ek ’n vergeefse moeite gesien onder die son:

kjv_text: There is one alone, and there is not a second; yea, he hath neither child nor brother: yet is there no end of all his labour; neither is his eye satisfied with riches; neither saith he, For whom do I labour, and bereave my soul of good? This is also vanity, yea, it is a sore travail.
bsb_text: There is a man all alone, without even a son or brother. And though there is no end to his labor, his eyes are still not content with his wealth: “For whom do I toil and bereave my soul of enjoyment?” This too is futile—a miserable task.
aov_text: Daar is een allenig sonder ’n tweede, ook het hy geen seun of broer nie; tog is daar geen einde aan al sy moeitevolle arbeid nie, sy oë kry ook nie genoeg van rykdom nie. Vir wie tog vermoei ek my en laat my siel gebrek ly aan die goeie? Ook dit is tevergeefs en ’n verkeerde saak.

kjv_text: Two are better than one; because they have a good reward for their labour.
bsb_text: Two are better than one, because they have a good return for their labor.
aov_text: Twee is beter as een, want hulle het ’n goeie beloning vir hulle moeitevolle arbeid.

kjv_text: For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow: but woe to him that is alone when he falleth; for he hath not another to help him up.
bsb_text: For if one falls down, his companion can lift him up; but pity the one who falls without another to help him up!
aov_text: Want as hulle val, kan die een sy maat optel, maar wee die een wat val sonder dat daar ’n tweede is om hom op te tel.

kjv_text: Again, if two lie together, then they have heat: but how can one be warm alone?
bsb_text: Again, if two lie down together, they will keep warm; but how can one keep warm alone?
aov_text: Verder, as twee bymekaar lê, kry hulle warm; maar hoe kan een allenig warm word?

kjv_text: And if one prevail against him, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.
bsb_text: And though one may be overpowered, two can resist. Moreover, a cord of three strands is not quickly broken.
aov_text: En as iemand die een aanval, kan altwee hom teëstand bied; en ’n driedubbele lyn word nie gou verbreek nie.

kjv_text: Better is a poor and a wise child than an old and foolish king, who will no more be admonished.
bsb_text: Better is a poor but wise youth than an old but foolish king who no longer knows how to take a warning.
aov_text: Beter is ’n behoeftige maar wyse jongman as ’n ou maar dwase koning wat nie meer weet om hom te laat waarsku nie.

kjv_text: For out of prison he cometh to reign; whereas also he that is born in his kingdom becometh poor.
bsb_text: For the youth has come from the prison to the kingship, though he was born poor in his own kingdom.
aov_text: Want daardie een het uit die gevangenis uitgegaan om koning te word, alhoewel hy as ’n arme in die koninkryk van die ander gebore was.

kjv_text: I considered all the living which walk under the sun, with the second child that shall stand up in his stead.
bsb_text: I saw that all who lived and walked under the sun followed this second one, the youth who succeeded the king.
aov_text: Ek het gesien hoe al die lewendes wat onder die son wandel, aan die kant van die jongman was, van die tweede, wat sy opvolger sou word;

kjv_text: There is no end of all the people, even of all that have been before them: they also that come after shall not rejoice in him. Surely this also is vanity and vexation of spirit.
bsb_text: There is no limit to all the people who were before them. Yet the successor will not be celebrated by those who come even later. This too is futile and a pursuit of the wind.
aov_text: daar was geen einde aan al die mense, aan almal aan wie se hoof hy gestaan het nie. Tog sal die nageslag hulle nie oor hom verbly nie; so is dit ook tevergeefs en ’n gejaag na wind.

kjv_text: Keep thy foot when thou goest to the house of God, and be more ready to hear, than to give the sacrifice of fools: for they consider not that they do evil.
bsb_text: Guard your steps when you go to the house of God. Draw near to listen rather than to offer the sacrifice of fools, who do not know that they do wrong.
aov_text: Gee ag op jou voet as jy na die huis van God gaan, want om nader te kom en te hoor, is beter as dat dwase ’n slagoffer bring; want hulle het geen verstand nie, sodat hulle kwaad doen.

kjv_text: Be not rash with thy mouth, and let not thine heart be hasty to utter any thing before God: for God is in heaven, and thou upon earth: therefore let thy words be few.
bsb_text: Do not be quick to speak, and do not be hasty in your heart to utter a word before God. After all, God is in heaven and you are on earth. So let your words be few.
aov_text: WEES nie haastig met jou mond nie, en laat jou hart nie gou ’n woord uitbring voor die aangesig van God nie; want God is in die hemel, en jy op die aarde. Daarom moet jou woorde min wees.

kjv_text: For a dream cometh through the multitude of business; and a fool's voice is known by multitude of words.
bsb_text: As a dream comes through many cares, so the speech of a fool comes with many words.
aov_text: Want soos die droom kom deur baie drukte, so die gepraat van die dwaas deur baie woorde.

kjv_text: When thou vowest a vow unto God, defer not to pay it; for he hath no pleasure in fools: pay that which thou hast vowed.
bsb_text: When you make a vow to God, do not delay in fulfilling it, because He takes no pleasure in fools. Fulfill your vow.
aov_text: As jy ’n gelofte aan God gedoen het, stel nie uit om dit te betaal nie, want daar is geen welgevalle in dwase nie. Betaal wat jy belowe.

kjv_text: Better is it that thou shouldest not vow, than that thou shouldest vow and not pay.
bsb_text: It is better not to vow than to make a vow and not fulfill it.
aov_text: Dit is beter dat jy nie belowe nie as dat jy belowe en nie betaal nie.

kjv_text: Suffer not thy mouth to cause thy flesh to sin; neither say thou before the angel, that it was an error: wherefore should God be angry at thy voice, and destroy the work of thine hands?
bsb_text: Do not let your mouth cause your flesh to sin, and do not tell the messenger that your vow was a mistake. Why should God be angry with your words and destroy the work of your hands?
aov_text: Laat jou mond nie toe om op jou liggaam ’n sondeskuld te laai nie, en sê nie voor die gesant van God: Dit was ’n vergissing nie. Waarom moet God toornig word oor jou stem en die werk van jou hande verwoes?

kjv_text: For in the multitude of dreams and many words there are also divers vanities: but fear thou God.
bsb_text: For as many dreams bring futility, so do many words. Therefore, fear God.
aov_text: Want soos daar baie drome is, so is daar ook nietige woorde in menigte, maar vrees God!

kjv_text: If thou seest the oppression of the poor, and violent perverting of judgment and justice in a province, marvel not at the matter: for he that is higher than the highest regardeth; and there be higher than they.
bsb_text: If you see the oppression of the poor and the denial of justice and righteousness in the province, do not be astonished at the matter; for one official is watched by a superior, and others higher still are over them.
aov_text: As jy verdrukking van die arme en berowing van reg en geregtigheid sien in die land—verwonder jou nie oor die saak nie, want ’n hoër een loer op die hoë, en die hoëres weer op hulle.

kjv_text: Moreover the profit of the earth is for all: the king himself is served by the field.
bsb_text: The produce of the earth is taken by all; the king himself profits from the fields.
aov_text: Maar ’n voordeel vir ’n land onder alles is dit: ’n koning wat aan die landbou diensbaar word.

kjv_text: He that loveth silver shall not be satisfied with silver; nor he that loveth abundance with increase: this is also vanity.
bsb_text: He who loves money is never satisfied by money, and he who loves wealth is never satisfied by income. This too is futile.
aov_text: Hy wat geld liefhet, kry nie genoeg van geld nie, en wie rykdom liefhet, nie van inkomste nie; ook dit is dan tevergeefs.

kjv_text: When goods increase, they are increased that eat them: and what good is there to the owners thereof, saving the beholding of them with their eyes?
bsb_text: When good things increase, so do those who consume them; what then is the profit to the owner, except to behold them with his eyes?
aov_text: As die goed baie word, word die eters baie; watter voordeel het die besitter dan daarvan, behalwe dat sy oë dit aanskou?

kjv_text: The sleep of a labouring man is sweet, whether he eat little or much: but the abundance of the rich will not suffer him to sleep.
bsb_text: The sleep of the worker is sweet, whether he eats little or much, but the abundance of the rich man permits him no sleep.
aov_text: Soet is die slaap van die arbeider, of hy min en of hy baie eet; maar die oorversadiging van die ryke laat hom nie toe om te slaap nie.

kjv_text: There is a sore evil which I have seen under the sun, namely, riches kept for the owners thereof to their hurt.
bsb_text: There is a grievous evil I have seen under the sun: wealth hoarded to the harm of its owner,
aov_text: Daar is ’n smartlike onheil wat ek onder die son gesien het: rykdom wat deur sy besitter bewaar word tot sy eie ongeluk.

kjv_text: But those riches perish by evil travail: and he begetteth a son, and there is nothing in his hand.
bsb_text: or wealth lost in a failed venture, so when that man has a son there is nothing to pass on.
aov_text: Gaan hierdie rykdom verlore deur ’n ongeval, en het hy ’n seun verwek, dan besit dié niks nie.

kjv_text: As he came forth of his mother's womb, naked shall he return to go as he came, and shall take nothing of his labour, which he may carry away in his hand.
bsb_text: As a man came from his mother’s womb, so he will depart again, naked as he arrived. He takes nothing for his labor to carry in his hands.
aov_text: Soos hy uit die skoot van sy moeder uitgegaan het, gaan hy naak weer heen soos hy gekom het; en hy sal vir sy moeitevolle arbeid niks wegdra wat hy met hom kan saamneem nie.

kjv_text: And this also is a sore evil, that in all points as he came, so shall he go: and what profit hath he that hath laboured for the wind?
bsb_text: This too is a grievous evil: Exactly as a man is born, so he will depart. What does he gain as he toils for the wind?
aov_text: So is dit dan ook ’n smartlike onheil: net soos hy gekom het, so sal hy heengaan; watter voordeel het hy dan dat hy hom vermoei het vir wind?

kjv_text: All his days also he eateth in darkness, and he hath much sorrow and wrath with his sickness.
bsb_text: Moreover, all his days he eats in darkness, with much sorrow, sickness, and anger.
aov_text: Ook eet hy sy lewe lank in duisternis en het baie ergernis; daarby sy lyding en toorn!

kjv_text: Behold that which I have seen: it is good and comely for one to eat and to drink, and to enjoy the good of all his labour that he taketh under the sun all the days of his life, which God giveth him: for it is his portion.
bsb_text: Here is what I have seen to be good and fitting: to eat and drink, and to find satisfaction in all the labor one does under the sun during the few days of life that God has given him—for this is his lot.
aov_text: Kyk, wat ek as ’n goeie ding gesien het, wat voortreflik is, is dat iemand eet en drink en die goeie geniet vir al sy arbeid waarmee hy hom vermoei onder die son gedurende die getal van sy lewensdae wat God hom gee; want dit is sy deel.

kjv_text: Every man also to whom God hath given riches and wealth, and hath given him power to eat thereof, and to take his portion, and to rejoice in his labour; this is the gift of God.
bsb_text: Furthermore, God has given riches and wealth to every man, and He has enabled him to enjoy them, to accept his lot, and to rejoice in his labor. This is a gift from God.
aov_text: Ook vir elke mens aan wie God rykdom en skatte gegee het, en wat Hy in staat stel om daarvan te eet en sy deel te neem en hom te verheug by sy moeitevolle arbeid, is dit ’n gawe van God.

kjv_text: For he shall not much remember the days of his life; because God answereth him in the joy of his heart.
bsb_text: For a man seldom considers the days of his life, because God keeps him occupied with the joy of his heart.
aov_text: Want hy dink nie baie aan sy lewensdae nie, omdat God hom laat besig wees met die vreugde van sy hart.

kjv_text: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, and it is common among men:
bsb_text: There is another evil I have seen under the sun, and it weighs heavily upon mankind:
aov_text: DAAR is ’n onheil wat ek gesien het onder die son, en wat swaar druk op die mensdom:

kjv_text: A man to whom God hath given riches, wealth, and honour, so that he wanteth nothing for his soul of all that he desireth, yet God giveth him not power to eat thereof, but a stranger eateth it: this is vanity, and it is an evil disease.
bsb_text: God gives a man riches, wealth, and honor, so that he lacks nothing his heart desires; but God does not allow him to enjoy them. Instead, a stranger will enjoy them. This is futile and a grievous affliction.
aov_text: ’n Man aan wie God rykdom en skatte en eer gee, sodat hom niks ontbreek van alles wat hy kan begeer nie, maar God stel hom nie in staat om daarvan te geniet nie, want ’n vreemde geniet dit; dit is vergeefse moeite en ’n bitter lyding.

kjv_text: If a man beget an hundred children, and live many years, so that the days of his years be many, and his soul be not filled with good, and also that he have no burial; I say, that an untimely birth is better than he.
bsb_text: A man may father a hundred children and live for many years; yet no matter how long he lives, if he is unsatisfied with his prosperity and does not even receive a proper burial, I say that a stillborn child is better off than he.
aov_text: As ’n man honderd kinders verwek en baie jare lewe en die dae van sy jare baie is en sy siel nie genoeg kry van die goeie en hy ook nie ’n begrafnis het nie, dan sê ek: ’n Misgeboorte is beter as hy,

kjv_text: For he cometh in with vanity, and departeth in darkness, and his name shall be covered with darkness.
bsb_text: For a stillborn child enters in futility and departs in darkness, and his name is shrouded in obscurity.
aov_text: want in nietigheid kom dit, en in duisternis gaan dit heen, en met duisternis word die naam daarvan bedek;

kjv_text: Moreover he hath not seen the sun, nor known any thing: this hath more rest than the other.
bsb_text: The child, though neither seeing the sun nor knowing anything, has more rest than that man,
aov_text: ook het dit die son nie gesien of geken nie. Dit het meer rus as hy.

kjv_text: Yea, though he live a thousand years twice told, yet hath he seen no good: do not all go to one place?
bsb_text: even if he lives a thousand years twice over but fails to enjoy his prosperity. Do not all go to the same place?
aov_text: Ja, al lewe hy ook twee maal duisend jaar en geniet nie die goeie nie—gaan nie alles na een en dieselfde plek nie?

kjv_text: All the labour of man is for his mouth, and yet the appetite is not filled.
bsb_text: All a man’s labor is for his mouth, yet his appetite is never satisfied.
aov_text: Al die moeitevolle arbeid van ’n mens is vir sy mond, en tog word die begeerte nie bevredig nie.

kjv_text: For what hath the wise more than the fool? what hath the poor, that knoweth to walk before the living?
bsb_text: What advantage, then, has the wise man over the fool? What gain comes to the poor man who knows how to conduct himself before others?
aov_text: Want watter voorkeur het die wyse bo die dwaas, watter voorkeur die arme wat weet om hom te beweeg onder die lewendes?

kjv_text: Better is the sight of the eyes than the wandering of the desire: this is also vanity and vexation of spirit.
bsb_text: Better what the eye can see than the wandering of desire. This too is futile and a pursuit of the wind.
aov_text: Die aanskouing met die oë is beter as die geswerf van die begeerte. Ook dit is tevergeefs en ’n gejaag na wind.

kjv_text: That which hath been is named already, and it is known that it is man: neither may he contend with him that is mightier than he.
bsb_text: Whatever exists was named long ago, and what happens to a man is foreknown; but he cannot contend with one stronger than he.
aov_text: Wat hy ook is, lankal is sy naam genoem, en dit is bekend dat hy mens is: hy kan nie in die gereg gaan met Hom wat sterker is as hy nie.

kjv_text: Seeing there be many things that increase vanity, what is man the better?
bsb_text: For the more words, the more futility—and how does that profit anyone?
aov_text: Want hoe meer woorde, des te meer vermeerder hulle die nietigheid; watter voordeel het die mens daarvan?

kjv_text: For who knoweth what is good for man in this life, all the days of his vain life which he spendeth as a shadow? for who can tell a man what shall be after him under the sun?
bsb_text: For who knows what is good for a man during the few days in which he passes through his fleeting life like a shadow? Who can tell a man what will come after him under the sun?
aov_text: Want wie weet wat goed is vir die mens in die lewe gedurende die getal dae van sy nietige lewe wat hy soos ’n skaduwee deurbring? Want wie kan aan die mens bekend maak wat ná hom sal wees onder die son?

kjv_text: A good name is better than precious ointment; and the day of death than the day of one's birth.
bsb_text: A good name is better than fine perfume, and one’s day of death is better than his day of birth.
aov_text: ’N GOEIE naam is beter as goeie olie, en die sterfdag beter as die geboortedag.

kjv_text: It is better to go to the house of mourning, than to go to the house of feasting: for that is the end of all men; and the living will lay it to his heart.
bsb_text: It is better to enter a house of mourning than a house of feasting, since death is the end of every man, and the living should take this to heart.
aov_text: Dit is beter om te gaan na ’n klaaghuis as om te gaan na ’n huis van maaltyd; want die eerste is die einde van al die mense, en die lewende kan dit ter harte neem.

kjv_text: Sorrow is better than laughter: for by the sadness of the countenance the heart is made better.
bsb_text: Sorrow is better than laughter, for a sad countenance is good for the heart.
aov_text: Om verdrietig te wees, is beter as om te lag; want as die gesig droewig is, gaan dit goed met die hart.

kjv_text: The heart of the wise is in the house of mourning; but the heart of fools is in the house of mirth.
bsb_text: The heart of the wise is in the house of mourning, but the heart of fools is in the house of pleasure.
aov_text: Die hart van die wyse manne is in die klaaghuis, maar die hart van die dwase in die huis van vreugde.

kjv_text: It is better to hear the rebuke of the wise, than for a man to hear the song of fools.
bsb_text: It is better to heed a wise man’s rebuke than to listen to the song of fools.
aov_text: Dit is beter om te luister na die bestraffing van ’n wyse as dat ’n mens luister na die lied van die dwase.

kjv_text: For as the crackling of thorns under a pot, so is the laughter of the fool: this also is vanity.
bsb_text: For like the crackling of thorns under the pot, so is the laughter of the fool. This too is futile.
aov_text: Want soos die geknetter van doringtakke onder ’n pot, so is die gelag van ’n dwaas. Dit is dan ook tevergeefs.

kjv_text: Surely oppression maketh a wise man mad; and a gift destroyeth the heart.
bsb_text: Surely extortion turns a wise man into a fool, and a bribe corrupts the heart.
aov_text: Sekerlik, afpersing maak ’n wyse dwaas, en ’n geskenk bederwe die hart.

kjv_text: Better is the end of a thing than the beginning thereof: and the patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit.
bsb_text: The end of a matter is better than the beginning, and a patient spirit is better than a proud one.
aov_text: Die einde van ’n saak is beter as sy begin; ’n lankmoedige is beter as ’n hoogmoedige.

kjv_text: Be not hasty in thy spirit to be angry: for anger resteth in the bosom of fools.
bsb_text: Do not be quickly provoked in your spirit, for anger settles in the lap of a fool.
aov_text: Wees nie haastig in jou gees om jou te vererg nie, want ergernis rus in die boesem van die dwase.

kjv_text: Say not thou, What is the cause that the former days were better than these? for thou dost not enquire wisely concerning this.
bsb_text: Do not say, “Why were the old days better than these?” For it is unwise of you to ask about this.
aov_text: Moenie sê nie: Hoe kom dit dat die vorige dae beter was as die teenswoordige? want nie uit wysheid vra jy hierna nie.

kjv_text: Wisdom is good with an inheritance: and by it there is profit to them that see the sun.
bsb_text: Wisdom, like an inheritance, is good, and it benefits those who see the sun.
aov_text: Wysheid is net so goed as ’n erfdeel en ’n voordeel vir die wat die son sien.

kjv_text: For wisdom is a defence, and money is a defence: but the excellency of knowledge is, that wisdom giveth life to them that have it.
bsb_text: For wisdom, like money, is a shelter, and the advantage of knowledge is that wisdom preserves the life of its owner.
aov_text: Want wysheid is ’n beskutting, geld is ’n beskutting; maar die voordeel van kennis is: die wysheid hou die besitter daarvan in die lewe.

kjv_text: Consider the work of God: for who can make that straight, which he hath made crooked?
bsb_text: Consider the work of God: Who can straighten what He has bent?
aov_text: Aanskou die werk van God, want wie kan reguit maak wat Hy krom gemaak het?

kjv_text: In the day of prosperity be joyful, but in the day of adversity consider: God also hath set the one over against the other, to the end that man should find nothing after him.
bsb_text: In the day of prosperity, be joyful, but in the day of adversity, consider this: God has made one of these along with the other, so that a man cannot discover anything that will come after him.
aov_text: Wees goedsmoeds op die dag van voorspoed, en op die dag van onheil, bedink dan: Ook hierdie dag het God gemaak net soos daardie, daarom dat die mens ná sy dood niks meer sal ontdek nie.

kjv_text: All things have I seen in the days of my vanity: there is a just man that perisheth in his righteousness, and there is a wicked man that prolongeth his life in his wickedness.
bsb_text: In my futile life I have seen both of these: A righteous man perishing in his righteousness, and a wicked man living long in his wickedness.
aov_text: Alles het ek gesien in die dae van my nietigheid: daar is ’n regverdige wat ondanks sy regverdigheid omkom, en daar is ’n goddelose wat ondanks sy goddeloosheid lank lewe.

kjv_text: Be not righteous over much; neither make thyself over wise: why shouldest thou destroy thyself ?
bsb_text: Do not be overly righteous, and do not make yourself too wise. Why should you destroy yourself?
aov_text: Wees nie alte regverdig en hou jou nie buitengewoon wys nie: waarom sou jy jouself te gronde rig?

kjv_text: Be not over much wicked, neither be thou foolish: why shouldest thou die before thy time?
bsb_text: Do not be excessively wicked, and do not be a fool. Why should you die before your time?
aov_text: Wees nie alte goddeloos, en wees nie dwaas nie: waarom sou jy sterwe voor jou tyd?

kjv_text: It is good that thou shouldest take hold of this; yea, also from this withdraw not thine hand: for he that feareth God shall come forth of them all.
bsb_text: It is good to grasp the one and not let the other slip from your hand. For he who fears God will follow both warnings.
aov_text: Dit is goed dat jy aan die een vashou en ook van die ander jou hand nie aftrek nie; want die wat God vrees, ontkom aan dit alles.

kjv_text: Wisdom strengtheneth the wise more than ten mighty men which are in the city.
bsb_text: Wisdom makes the wise man stronger than ten rulers in a city.
aov_text: Die wysheid versterk die wyse meer as tien maghebbers wat in die stad is;

kjv_text: For there is not a just man upon earth, that doeth good, and sinneth not.
bsb_text: Surely there is no righteous man on earth who does good and never sins.
aov_text: want daar is geen regverdige mens op die aarde wat goed doen sonder om te sondig nie.

kjv_text: Also take no heed unto all words that are spoken; lest thou hear thy servant curse thee:
bsb_text: Do not pay attention to every word that is spoken, or you may hear your servant cursing you.
aov_text: Jy moet ook nie let op al die woorde wat die mense spreek nie, sodat jy nie hoor dat jou dienaar jou vloek nie.

kjv_text: For oftentimes also thine own heart knoweth that thou thyself likewise hast cursed others.
bsb_text: For you know in your heart that many times you yourself have cursed others.
aov_text: Want jou eie hart weet ook van baie gevalle dat jy self ook ander gevloek het.

kjv_text: All this have I proved by wisdom: I said, I will be wise; but it was far from me.
bsb_text: All this I tested by wisdom, saying, “I resolve to be wise.” But it was beyond me.
aov_text: Dit alles het ek met wysheid op die proef gestel; ek het gesê: Ek wil wys word, maar dit het ver van my gebly.

kjv_text: That which is far off, and exceeding deep, who can find it out?
bsb_text: What exists is out of reach and very deep. Who can fathom it?
aov_text: Wat bestaan, is ver en baie diep; wie kan dit begryp?

kjv_text: I applied mine heart to know, and to search, and to seek out wisdom, and the reason of things, and to know the wickedness of folly, even of foolishness and madness:
bsb_text: I directed my mind to understand, to explore, to search out wisdom and explanations, and to understand the stupidity of wickedness and the folly of madness.
aov_text: Ek het my daartoe gewend en my hart gerig om te weet en na te speur, en wysheid en ’n slotsom te soek, en om so die goddeloosheid as dwaasheid en die dwaasheid as onverstandigheid te leer ken.

kjv_text: And I find more bitter than death the woman, whose heart is snares and nets, and her hands as bands: whoso pleaseth God shall escape from her; but the sinner shall be taken by her.
bsb_text: And I find more bitter than death the woman who is a snare, whose heart is a net, and whose hands are chains. The man who pleases God escapes her, but the sinner is ensnared.
aov_text: En ek het iets uitgevind bitterder as die dood: die vrou wat strikke is, haar hart nette, haar hande boeie; hy wat goed is voor die aangesig van God, sal van haar vryraak, maar die sondaar word deur haar gevang.

kjv_text: Behold, this have I found, saith the preacher, counting one by one, to find out the account:
bsb_text: “Behold,” says the Teacher, “I have discovered this by adding one thing to another to find an explanation.
aov_text: Kyk, dit het ek uitgevind, sê die Prediker, deur die een by die ander te voeg, om ’n slotsom te vind —

kjv_text: Which yet my soul seeketh, but I find not: one man among a thousand have I found; but a woman among all those have I not found.
bsb_text: While my soul was still searching but not finding, among a thousand I have found one upright man, but among all these I have not found one such woman.
aov_text: wat my siel lank gesoek het, maar wat ek nie gevind het nie: een mens uit duisend het ek gevind, maar ’n vrou het ek onder soveel nie gevind nie.

kjv_text: Lo, this only have I found, that God hath made man upright; but they have sought out many inventions.
bsb_text: Only this have I found: I have discovered that God made men upright, but they have sought out many schemes.”
aov_text: Kyk, net dit het ek uitgevind: dat God die mens reg gemaak het, maar hulle het baie slim planne gesoek.

kjv_text: Who is as the wise man? and who knoweth the interpretation of a thing? a man's wisdom maketh his face to shine, and the boldness of his face shall be changed.
bsb_text: Who is like the wise man? Who knows the interpretation of a matter? A man’s wisdom brightens his face, and the sternness of his face is changed.
aov_text: WIE is soos die wyse, en wie weet die verklaring van die dinge? Die wysheid van ’n mens verhelder sy gesig, en die hardheid van sy gesig word daardeur verander.

kjv_text: I counsel thee to keep the king's commandment, and that in regard of the oath of God.
bsb_text: Keep the king’s command, I say, because of your oath before God.
aov_text: Ek sê: Neem die bevel van die koning in ag, en wel ter wille van die eed by God.

kjv_text: Be not hasty to go out of his sight: stand not in an evil thing; for he doeth whatsoever pleaseth him.
bsb_text: Do not hasten to leave his presence, and do not persist in a bad cause, for he will do whatever he pleases.
aov_text: Haas jou nie om van hom af weg te gaan nie; laat jou nie in met ’n slegte saak nie, want alles wat hy wil, doen hy.

kjv_text: Where the word of a king is, there is power: and who may say unto him, What doest thou?
bsb_text: For the king’s word is supreme, and who can say to him, “What are you doing?”
aov_text: Want die woord van die koning is magtig, en wie kan vir hom sê: Wat doen u?

kjv_text: Whoso keepeth the commandment shall feel no evil thing: and a wise man's heart discerneth both time and judgment.
bsb_text: Whoever keeps his command will come to no harm, and a wise heart knows the right time and procedure.
aov_text: Hy wat die gebod onderhou, sal geen kwaad ondervind nie; en die hart van ’n wyse sal die tyd en die regterlike beslissing belewe.

kjv_text: Because to every purpose there is time and judgment, therefore the misery of man is great upon him.
bsb_text: For there is a right time and procedure to every purpose, though a man’s misery weighs heavily upon him.
aov_text: Want vir elke ding is daar ’n tyd en ’n beslissing; want die boosheid van die mens druk swaar op hom.

kjv_text: For he knoweth not that which shall be: for who can tell him when it shall be?
bsb_text: Since no one knows what will happen, who can tell him what is to come?
aov_text: Want hy weet nie wat sal wees nie; want hoe dit sal wees—wie kan hom dit te kenne gee?

kjv_text: There is no man that hath power over the spirit to retain the spirit; neither hath he power in the day of death: and there is no discharge in that war; neither shall wickedness deliver those that are given to it.
bsb_text: As no man has power over the wind to contain it, so no one has authority over his day of death. As no one can be discharged in wartime, so wickedness will not release those who practice it.
aov_text: Daar is geen mens wat heerskappy het oor die wind om die wind teë te hou nie, en niemand het mag oor die dag van die dood nie, en daar is geen vrystelling in die oorlog nie; so sal ook die goddeloosheid hom wat dit begaan, nie red nie.

kjv_text: All this have I seen, and applied my heart unto every work that is done under the sun: there is a time wherein one man ruleth over another to his own hurt.
bsb_text: All this I have seen, applying my mind to every deed that is done under the sun; there is a time when one man lords it over another to his own detriment.
aov_text: Dit alles het ek gesien deurdat ek my hart gerig het op elke werk wat onder die son gedoen word, in ’n tyd waarin die een mens heers oor die ander tot sy ongeluk.

kjv_text: And so I saw the wicked buried, who had come and gone from the place of the holy, and they were forgotten in the city where they had so done: this is also vanity.
bsb_text: Then too, I saw the burial of the wicked who used to go in and out of the holy place, and they were praised in the city where they had done so. This too is futile.
aov_text: So het ek dan die goddelose sien begrawe word en die rus ingaan, terwyl die wat reg gehandel het, uit die heilige plek moes weggaan en in die stad vergeet is. Ook dit is dan nietigheid.

kjv_text: Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil.
bsb_text: When the sentence for a crime is not speedily executed, the hearts of men become fully set on doing evil.
aov_text: OMDAT die oordeel oor ’n verkeerde daad nie gou voltrek word nie, daarom is die hart van die mensekinders in hulle vol om kwaad te doen;

kjv_text: Though a sinner do evil an hundred times, and his days be prolonged, yet surely I know that it shall be well with them that fear God, which fear before him:
bsb_text: Although a sinner does evil a hundred times and still lives long, yet I also know that it will go well with those who fear God, who are reverent in His presence.
aov_text: aangesien ’n sondaar honderd maal kwaad doen en hy lank lewe—alhoewel ek weet dat dit goed sal gaan met die wat God vrees, omdat hulle voor sy aangesig vrees,

kjv_text: But it shall not be well with the wicked, neither shall he prolong his days, which are as a shadow; because he feareth not before God.
bsb_text: Yet because the wicked do not fear God, it will not go well with them, and their days will not lengthen like a shadow.
aov_text: en dit nie goed sal gaan met die goddelose, en hy die dae nie sal verleng soos ’n skaduwee nie, omdat hy voor die aangesig van God nie vrees nie.

kjv_text: There is a vanity which is done upon the earth; that there be just men, unto whom it happeneth according to the work of the wicked; again, there be wicked men, to whom it happeneth according to the work of the righteous: I said that this also is vanity.
bsb_text: There is a futility that is done on the earth: There are righteous men who get what the actions of the wicked deserve, and there are wicked men who get what the actions of the righteous deserve. I say that this too is futile.
aov_text: Dit is ’n nietigheid wat op die aarde gebeur, dat daar regverdiges is met wie dit gaan volgens die dade van die goddelose, en dat daar goddelose is met wie dit gaan volgens die dade van die regverdiges; so sê ek dan dat dit ook nietigheid is.

kjv_text: Then I commended mirth, because a man hath no better thing under the sun, than to eat, and to drink, and to be merry: for that shall abide with him of his labour the days of his life, which God giveth him under the sun.
bsb_text: So I commended the enjoyment of life, because there is nothing better for a man under the sun than to eat and drink and be merry. For this joy will accompany him in his labor during the days of his life that God gives him under the sun.
aov_text: Daarom het ek die vreugde geprys, dat daar niks beters is vir die mens onder die son nie as om te eet en te drink en hom te verheug, en dat dit hom mag begelei by sy moeitevolle arbeid gedurende die dae van sy lewe wat God hom gee onder die son.

kjv_text: When I applied mine heart to know wisdom, and to see the business that is done upon the earth: (for also there is that neither day nor night seeth sleep with his eyes:)
bsb_text: When I applied my mind to know wisdom and to observe the task that one performs on the earth—though his eyes do not see sleep in the day or even in the night—
aov_text: Toe ek my hart daarop gerig het om wysheid te leer ken en om te aanskou die dinge wat op die aarde gedoen word—ja, selfs bedags en snags niemand met sy oë die slaap sien nie —

kjv_text: Then I beheld all the work of God, that a man cannot find out the work that is done under the sun: because though a man labour to seek it out, yet he shall not find it; yea farther; though a wise man think to know it, yet shall he not be able to find it.
bsb_text: I saw every work of God, and that a man is unable to comprehend the work that is done under the sun. Despite his efforts to search it out, he cannot find its meaning; even if the wise man claims to know, he is unable to comprehend.
aov_text: het ek gesien al die werk van God, dat die mens die werk wat gedoen word onder die son, nie kan uitvind nie, omdat die mens hom vermoei om te soek en tog niks uitvind nie; ja, al sou die wyse dink dat hy dit verstaan—hy sal dit nie kan uitvind nie!

kjv_text: For all this I considered in my heart even to declare all this, that the righteous, and the wise, and their works, are in the hand of God: no man knoweth either love or hatred by all that is before them.
bsb_text: So I took all this to heart and concluded that the righteous and the wise, as well as their deeds, are in God’s hands. Man does not know what lies ahead, whether love or hate.
aov_text: WANT dit alles het ek ter harte geneem en dit alles het ek probeer deurgrond, dat die regverdiges en die wyse manne en hulle dade in die hand van God is, liefde sowel as haat; die mens weet niks van wat hom voorlê nie.

kjv_text: All things come alike to all: there is one event to the righteous, and to the wicked; to the good and to the clean, and to the unclean; to him that sacrificeth, and to him that sacrificeth not: as is the good, so is the sinner; and he that sweareth, as he that feareth an oath.
bsb_text: It is the same for all: There is a common fate for the righteous and the wicked, for the good and the bad, for the clean and the unclean, for the one who sacrifices and the one who does not. As it is for the good, so it is for the sinner; as it is for the one who makes a vow, so it is for the one who refuses to take a vow.
aov_text: Alles is gelyk vir almal: een en dieselfde lot is daar vir die regverdige en die goddelose, vir die goeie en die reine en die onreine, en vir hom wat offer en vir hom wat nie offer nie, die goeie ewe goed as die sondaar, vir hom wat sweer ewe goed as vir hom wat bang is vir ’n eed.

kjv_text: This is an evil among all things that are done under the sun, that there is one event unto all: yea, also the heart of the sons of men is full of evil, and madness is in their heart while they live, and after that they go to the dead.
bsb_text: This is an evil in everything that is done under the sun: There is one fate for everyone. Furthermore, the hearts of men are full of evil and madness while they are alive, and afterward they join the dead.
aov_text: Dit is ’n verkeerde ding by alles wat plaasvind onder die son, dat een en dieselfde lot almal tref, en ook die hart van die mensekinders vol boosheid is, en dat dwaasheid in hulle hart is gedurende hulle lewe; en daarna gaan dit na die dooies toe!

kjv_text: For to him that is joined to all the living there is hope: for a living dog is better than a dead lion.
bsb_text: There is hope, however, for anyone who is among the living; for even a live dog is better than a dead lion.
aov_text: Want solank as iemand by al die lewendes behoort, is daar hoop; want ’n lewendige hond is beter as ’n dooie leeu.

kjv_text: For the living know that they shall die: but the dead know not any thing, neither have they any more a reward; for the memory of them is forgotten.
bsb_text: For the living know that they will die, but the dead know nothing. They have no further reward, because the memory of them is forgotten.
aov_text: Want die lewendes weet dat hulle moet sterwe, maar die dooies weet glad niks nie, en hulle het geen loon meer nie, want hulle nagedagtenis word vergeet.

kjv_text: Also their love, and their hatred, and their envy, is now perished; neither have they any more a portion for ever in any thing that is done under the sun.
bsb_text: Their love, their hate, and their envy have already vanished, and they will never again have a share in all that is done under the sun.
