aov_text: Hulle liefde sowel as hulle haat, ook hulle naywer, het lankal verdwyn, en hulle het vir ewig geen deel meer aan alles wat gebeur onder die son nie.

kjv_text: Go thy way, eat thy bread with joy, and drink thy wine with a merry heart; for God now accepteth thy works.
bsb_text: Go, eat your bread with joy, and drink your wine with a cheerful heart, for God has already approved your works:
aov_text: Gaan dan heen, eet jou brood met vreugde, en drink jou wyn met ’n vrolike hart, want God het lankal behae in jou werke.

kjv_text: Let thy garments be always white; and let thy head lack no ointment.
bsb_text: Let your garments always be white, and never spare the oil for your head.
aov_text: Laat jou klere altyd wit wees, en laat olie op jou hoof nie ontbreek nie.

kjv_text: Live joyfully with the wife whom thou lovest all the days of the life of thy vanity, which he hath given thee under the sun, all the days of thy vanity: for that is thy portion in this life, and in thy labour which thou takest under the sun.
bsb_text: Enjoy life with your beloved wife all the days of the fleeting life that God has given you under the sun—all your fleeting days. For this is your portion in life and in your labor under the sun.
aov_text: Geniet die lewe met die vrou wat jy liefhet, al die dae van jou nietige lewe wat Hy jou gegee het onder die son—al jou nietige dae; want dit is jou deel aan die lewe en aan jou arbeid wat jy met moeite verrig onder die son.

kjv_text: Whatsoever thy hand findeth to do, do it with thy might; for there is no work, nor device, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in the grave, whither thou goest.
bsb_text: Whatever you find to do with your hands, do it with all your might, for in Sheol, where you are going, there is no work or planning or knowledge or wisdom.
aov_text: Alles wat jou hand vind om te doen, doen dit met jou mag, want daar is geen werk of oorleg of kennis of wysheid in die doderyk waar jy heengaan nie.

kjv_text: I returned, and saw under the sun, that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favour to men of skill; but time and chance happeneth to them all.
bsb_text: I saw something else under the sun: The race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong; neither is the bread to the wise, nor the wealth to the intelligent, nor the favor to the skillful. For time and chance happen to all.
aov_text: WEER het ek onder die son gesien dat die wedloop nie is vir die vinniges en die oorlog nie vir die helde nie; en ook die brood is nie vir die wyse of ook rykdom vir die slimmes of ook guns vir die verstandiges nie; want tyd en lotgeval tref hulle almal.

kjv_text: For man also knoweth not his time: as the fishes that are taken in an evil net, and as the birds that are caught in the snare; so are the sons of men snared in an evil time, when it falleth suddenly upon them.
bsb_text: For surely no man knows his time: Like fish caught in a cruel net or birds trapped in a snare, so men are ensnared in an evil time that suddenly falls upon them.
aov_text: Ja, die mens ken ook sy eie tyd nie, soos die visse wat gevang word in die gevaarlike net, en soos die voëls wat gevang word in die vangnet—soos hulle word die mensekinders verstrik in die tyd van onheil as dit hulle skielik oorval.

kjv_text: This wisdom have I seen also under the sun, and it seemed great unto me:
bsb_text: I have also seen this wisdom under the sun, and it was great to me:
aov_text: Ook het ek dit as wysheid gesien onder die son, en dit was groot in my oog:

kjv_text: There was a little city, and few men within it; and there came a great king against it, and besieged it, and built great bulwarks against it:
bsb_text: There was a small city with few men. A mighty king came against it, surrounded it, and built large siege ramps against it.
aov_text: daar was ’n klein stadjie en min manne daarin, en ’n groot koning het daarteen gekom en dit omsingel en groot beleëringswerke daarteen gebou.

kjv_text: Now there was found in it a poor wise man, and he by his wisdom delivered the city; yet no man remembered that same poor man.
bsb_text: Now a poor wise man was found in the city, and he saved the city by his wisdom. Yet no one remembered that poor man.
aov_text: En daarin is ’n arm wyse man gevind; dié het die stad deur sy wysheid gered, maar geen mens het aan daardie arm man gedink nie.

kjv_text: Then said I, Wisdom is better than strength: nevertheless the poor man's wisdom is despised, and his words are not heard.
bsb_text: And I said, “Wisdom is better than strength, but the wisdom of the poor man is despised, and his words are not heeded.”
aov_text: Toe het ek gesê: Wysheid is beter as heldekrag; maar die wysheid van die arme word verag, en na sy woorde word nie geluister nie.

kjv_text: The words of wise men are heard in quiet more than the cry of him that ruleth among fools.
bsb_text: The calm words of the wise are heeded over the shouts of a ruler among fools.
aov_text: Woorde van wyse manne, wat rustig aangehoor word, is beter as die geskreeu van ’n heerser onder die dwase.

kjv_text: Wisdom is better than weapons of war: but one sinner destroyeth much good.
bsb_text: Wisdom is better than weapons of war, but one sinner destroys much good.
aov_text: Wysheid is beter as oorlogswapens, maar een sondaar bederf baie goeie dinge.

kjv_text: Dead flies cause the ointment of the apothecary to send forth a stinking savour: so doth a little folly him that is in reputation for wisdom and honour.
bsb_text: As dead flies bring a stench to the perfumer’s oil, so a little folly outweighs wisdom and honor.
aov_text: DOOIE vlieë laat die salf van die apteker stink en bederwe; ’n bietjie dwaasheid weeg swaarder as wysheid, as eer.

kjv_text: A wise man's heart is at his right hand; but a fool's heart at his left.
bsb_text: A wise man’s heart inclines to the right, but the heart of a fool to the left.
aov_text: Die hart van die wyse is na regs, maar die hart van ’n dwaas is na links.

kjv_text: Yea also, when he that is a fool walketh by the way, his wisdom faileth him, and he saith to every one that he is a fool.
bsb_text: Even as the fool walks along the road, his sense is lacking, and he shows everyone that he is a fool.
aov_text: Ja, ook as die dwaas op die weg wandel, ontbreek sy verstand; en hy sê aan elkeen dat hy ’n dwaas is.

kjv_text: If the spirit of the ruler rise up against thee, leave not thy place; for yielding pacifieth great offences.
bsb_text: If the ruler’s temper flares against you, do not abandon your post, for calmness lays great offenses to rest.
aov_text: As die toorn van die heerser teen jou opkom, verlaat nie jou pos nie, want bedaardheid voorkom groot foute.

kjv_text: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, as an error which proceedeth from the ruler:
bsb_text: There is an evil I have seen under the sun—an error that proceeds from the ruler:
aov_text: Daar is ’n verkeerdheid wat ek onder die son gesien het, ’n dwaling wat van die maghebber uitgaan:

kjv_text: Folly is set in great dignity, and the rich sit in low place.
bsb_text: Folly is appointed to great heights, but the rich sit in lowly positions.
aov_text: die dwaasheid word op groot hoogtes gestel, en die rykes moet in die vernedering sit.

kjv_text: I have seen servants upon horses, and princes walking as servants upon the earth.
bsb_text: I have seen slaves on horseback, while princes go on foot like slaves.
aov_text: Ek het slawe te perd gesien en vorste wat soos slawe op die grond loop.

kjv_text: He that diggeth a pit shall fall into it; and whoso breaketh an hedge, a serpent shall bite him.
bsb_text: He who digs a pit may fall into it, and he who breaches a wall may be bitten by a snake.
aov_text: Wie ’n kuil grawe, kan daarin val; en een wat ’n muur afbreek, ’n slang kan hom byt.

kjv_text: Whoso removeth stones shall be hurt therewith; and he that cleaveth wood shall be endangered thereby.
bsb_text: The one who quarries stones may be injured by them, and he who splits logs endangers himself.
aov_text: Wie klippe uitbreek, kan hom daarmee seermaak; wie hout klowe, kan daardeur in gevaar kom.

kjv_text: If the iron be blunt, and he do not whet the edge, then must he put to more strength: but wisdom is profitable to direct.
bsb_text: If the axe is dull and the blade unsharpened, more strength must be exerted, but skill produces success.
aov_text: As die yster stomp geword het, en ’n mens die snykant nie geslyp het nie, moet hy die kragte meer inspan; maar wysheid is voordelig om iets te laat beantwoord.

kjv_text: Surely the serpent will bite without enchantment; and a babbler is no better.
bsb_text: If the snake bites before it is charmed, there is no profit for the charmer.
aov_text: As die slang byt voor die beswering, baat die besweerder nie.

kjv_text: The words of a wise man's mouth are gracious; but the lips of a fool will swallow up himself.
bsb_text: The words of a wise man’s mouth are gracious, but the lips of a fool consume him.
aov_text: Die woorde uit die mond van ’n wyse is aangenaam, maar die lippe van ’n dwaas verslind homself.

kjv_text: The beginning of the words of his mouth is foolishness: and the end of his talk is mischievous madness.
bsb_text: The beginning of his talk is folly, and the end of his speech is evil madness.
aov_text: Die begin van die woorde van sy mond is dwaasheid, en die einde van sy mond is skadelike onverstandigheid.

kjv_text: A fool also is full of words: a man cannot tell what shall be; and what shall be after him, who can tell him?
bsb_text: Yet the fool multiplies words. No one knows what is coming, and who can tell him what will come after him?
aov_text: En die dwaas gebruik baie woorde; maar die mens weet nie wat daar sal gebeur nie; en wat ná hom sal wees, wie kan hom dit te kenne gee?

kjv_text: The labour of the foolish wearieth every one of them, because he knoweth not how to go to the city.
bsb_text: The toil of a fool wearies him, for he does not know the way to the city.
aov_text: Die inspanning van die dwaas vermoei hom, omdat hy nie eens weet om na die stad te gaan nie.

kjv_text: Woe to thee, O land, when thy king is a child, and thy princes eat in the morning!
bsb_text: Woe to you, O land whose king is a youth, and whose princes feast in the morning.
aov_text: Wee jou, o land, as jou koning ’n kind is, en as jou vorste in die môre vroeg maaltyd hou.

kjv_text: Blessed art thou, O land, when thy king is the son of nobles, and thy princes eat in due season, for strength, and not for drunkenness!
bsb_text: Blessed are you, O land whose king is a son of nobles, and whose princes feast at the proper time—for strength and not for drunkenness.
aov_text: Gelukkig is jy, o land, as jou koning ’n edele is, en as jou vorste op die regte tyd maaltyd hou soos manne en nie soos drinkers nie.

kjv_text: By much slothfulness the building decayeth; and through idleness of the hands the house droppeth through.
bsb_text: Through laziness the roof caves in, and in the hands of the idle, the house leaks.
aov_text: Deur allerhande luiheid versak die balkwerk, en deur slapheid van die hande lek die huis.

kjv_text: A feast is made for laughter, and wine maketh merry: but money answereth all things.
bsb_text: A feast is prepared for laughter, and wine makes life merry, but money is the answer for everything.
aov_text: Vir plesier maak hulle maaltye klaar, en die wyn maak die lewe vrolik, en die geld verskaf alles.

kjv_text: Curse not the king, no not in thy thought; and curse not the rich in thy bedchamber: for a bird of the air shall carry the voice, and that which hath wings shall tell the matter.
bsb_text: Do not curse the king even in your thoughts, or curse the rich even in your bedroom, for a bird of the air may carry your words, and a winged creature may report your speech.
aov_text: Vloek die koning selfs in jou gedagte nie, en vloek in jou slaapkamer die ryke nie; want die voëls van die hemel sou die geluid kon wegvoer, en die gevleueldes die woord te kenne gee.

kjv_text: Cast thy bread upon the waters: for thou shalt find it after many days.
bsb_text: Cast your bread upon the waters, for after many days you will find it again.
aov_text: WERP jou brood uit op die water, want ná verloop van baie dae sal jy dit vind.

kjv_text: Give a portion to seven, and also to eight; for thou knowest not what evil shall be upon the earth.
bsb_text: Divide your portion among seven, or even eight, for you do not know what disaster may befall the land.
aov_text: Gee ’n deel aan sewe, ja, ook aan agt; want jy weet nie watter onheil daar op die aarde sal wees nie.

kjv_text: If the clouds be full of rain, they empty themselves upon the earth: and if the tree fall toward the south, or toward the north, in the place where the tree falleth, there it shall be.
bsb_text: If the clouds are full, they will pour out rain upon the earth; whether a tree falls to the south or to the north, in the place where it falls, there it will lie.
aov_text: As die wolke vol reën is, giet hulle dit uit op die aarde; en as ’n boom na die suide of na die noorde val, op die plek waar die boom val, daar bly hy lê.

kjv_text: He that observeth the wind shall not sow; and he that regardeth the clouds shall not reap.
bsb_text: He who watches the wind will fail to sow, and he who observes the clouds will fail to reap.
aov_text: Wie op die wind ag gee, sal nie saai nie; en wie na die wolke kyk, sal nie oes nie.

kjv_text: As thou knowest not what is the way of the spirit, nor how the bones do grow in the womb of her that is with child: even so thou knowest not the works of God who maketh all.
bsb_text: As you do not know the path of the wind, or how the bones are formed in a mother’s womb, so you cannot understand the work of God, the Maker of all things.
aov_text: Soos jy nie weet wat die weg van die wind is, of hoe die gebeente in die skoot van ’n swangere is nie, net so weet jy nie die werk van God wat alles doen nie.

kjv_text: In the morning sow thy seed, and in the evening withhold not thine hand: for thou knowest not whether shall prosper, either this or that, or whether they both shall be alike good.
bsb_text: Sow your seed in the morning, and do not rest your hands in the evening, for you do not know which will succeed, whether this or that, or if both will equally prosper.
aov_text: Saai jou saad in die môre, en laat teen die aand jou hand nie rus nie; want jy weet nooit watter een sal geluk nie, hierdie of daardie, en of altwee saam goed sal wees nie.

kjv_text: Truly the light is sweet, and a pleasant thing it is for the eyes to behold the sun:
bsb_text: Light is sweet, and it pleases the eyes to see the sun.
aov_text: Verder, soet is die lig, en goed is dit vir die oë om die son te aanskou.

kjv_text: But if a man live many years, and rejoice in them all; yet let him remember the days of darkness; for they shall be many. All that cometh is vanity.
bsb_text: So if a man lives many years, let him rejoice in them all. But let him remember the days of darkness, for they will be many. Everything to come is futile.
aov_text: Want as die mens baie jare lewe, moet hy hom in dié almal verheug en dink aan die dae van duisternis, dat dit baie sal wees; alles wat kom, is nietigheid.

kjv_text: Rejoice, O young man, in thy youth; and let thy heart cheer thee in the days of thy youth, and walk in the ways of thine heart, and in the sight of thine eyes: but know thou, that for all these things God will bring thee into judgment.
bsb_text: Rejoice, O young man, while you are young, and let your heart be glad in the days of your youth. Walk in the ways of your heart and in the sight of your eyes, but know that for all these things God will bring you to judgment.
aov_text: VERBLY jou, o jongeling, in jou jeug en laat jou hart jou vrolik maak in die dae van jou jonkheid; en wandel in die weë van jou hart en in die aanskouing van jou oë; maar weet dat God jou oor al hierdie dinge in die gerig sal bring.

kjv_text: Therefore remove sorrow from thy heart, and put away evil from thy flesh: for childhood and youth are vanity.
bsb_text: So banish sorrow from your heart, and cast off pain from your body, for youth and vigor are fleeting.
aov_text: En weer verdriet uit jou hart, en hou die kwale weg van jou liggaam, want die jeug en die jonkheid is nietigheid.

kjv_text: Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy youth, while the evil days come not, nor the years draw nigh, when thou shalt say, I have no pleasure in them;
bsb_text: Remember your Creator in the days of your youth, before the days of adversity come and the years approach of which you will say, “I find no pleasure in them,”
aov_text: EN dink aan jou Skepper in die dae van jou jonkheid voordat die ongelukkige dae kom en die jare aanbreek waarvan jy sal sê: Ek het daar geen behae in nie —

kjv_text: While the sun, or the light, or the moon, or the stars, be not darkened, nor the clouds return after the rain:
bsb_text: before the light of the sun, moon, and stars is darkened, and the clouds return after the rain,
aov_text: voordat die son en die lig en die maan en die sterre verduister word en die wolke terugkom ná die reën,

kjv_text: In the day when the keepers of the house shall tremble, and the strong men shall bow themselves, and the grinders cease because they are few, and those that look out of the windows be darkened,
bsb_text: on the day the keepers of the house tremble and the strong men stoop, when those grinding cease because they are few and those watching through windows see dimly,
aov_text: dié dag wanneer die wagters van die huis sal bewe en die sterk manne krom word en die malers die werk staak, omdat hulle te min geword het, en die wat deur die vensters kyk, verduister word,

kjv_text: And the doors shall be shut in the streets, when the sound of the grinding is low, and he shall rise up at the voice of the bird, and all the daughters of musick shall be brought low;
bsb_text: when the doors to the street are shut and the sound of the mill fades away, when one rises at the sound of a bird and all the daughters of song grow faint,
aov_text: en die deure na die straat gesluit word, terwyl die geruis van die meul verswak; en hy opstaan as die voëltjies begin sing en al die tone van die lied dof sal word.

kjv_text: Also when they shall be afraid of that which is high, and fears shall be in the way, and the almond tree shall flourish, and the grasshopper shall be a burden, and desire shall fail: because man goeth to his long home, and the mourners go about the streets:
bsb_text: when men fear the heights and dangers of the road, when the almond tree blossoms, the grasshopper loses its spring, and the caper berry shrivels—for then man goes to his eternal home and mourners walk the streets.
aov_text: Ook sal hy bang wees vir ’n hoogte, en verskriklike dinge sal op die pad wees! En die amandelboom sal in bloei staan, en die sprinkaan sal homself met moeite voortsleep, en die kapperkruid nutteloos wees; want die mens gaan na sy ewige huis, en die rouklaers sal op die straat rondgaan.

kjv_text: Or ever the silver cord be loosed, or the golden bowl be broken, or the pitcher be broken at the fountain, or the wheel broken at the cistern.
bsb_text: Remember Him before the silver cord is snapped and the golden bowl is crushed, before the pitcher is shattered at the spring and the wheel is broken at the well,
aov_text: Voordat die silwerdraad verwyder word en die goue oliekruik stukkend val en die kruik by die fontein gebreek word en die wiel stukkend in die put val

kjv_text: Then shall the dust return to the earth as it was: and the spirit shall return unto God who gave it.
bsb_text: before the dust returns to the ground from which it came and the spirit returns to God who gave it.
aov_text: en die stof na die aarde terugkeer soos dit gewees het, en die gees na God terugkeer wat dit gegee het.

kjv_text: Vanity of vanities, saith the preacher; all is vanity.
bsb_text: “Futility of futilities,” says the Teacher. “Everything is futile!”
aov_text: Alles tevergeefs, sê die Prediker, dit is alles tevergeefs.

kjv_text: And moreover, because the preacher was wise, he still taught the people knowledge; yea, he gave good heed, and sought out, and set in order many proverbs.
bsb_text: Not only was the Teacher wise, but he also taught the people knowledge; he pondered, searched out, and arranged many proverbs.
aov_text: EN behalwe dat die Prediker ’n wyse was, het hy die volk nog kennis geleer en het oorweeg en ondersoek; hy het baie spreuke opgestel.

kjv_text: The preacher sought to find out acceptable words: and that which was written was upright, even words of truth.
bsb_text: The Teacher searched to find delightful sayings and to record accurate words of truth.
aov_text: Die Prediker het gesoek om welgevallige woorde te vind en wat reg geskrywe is—woorde van waarheid.

kjv_text: The words of the wise are as goads, and as nails fastened by the masters of assemblies, which are given from one shepherd.
bsb_text: The words of the wise are like goads, and the anthologies of the masters are like firmly embedded nails driven by a single Shepherd.
aov_text: Die woorde van die wyse manne is soos prikkels; en soos spykers, diep ingeslaan, is die versamelde spreuke; hulle is deur die enige Herder gegee.

kjv_text: And further, by these, my son, be admonished: of making many books there is no end; and much study is a weariness of the flesh.
bsb_text: And by these, my son, be further warned: There is no end to the making of many books, and much study wearies the body.
aov_text: En buitendien, my seun, wees gewaarsku; aan baie boeke maak kom geen einde nie, en baie studie is vermoeiing van die vlees.

kjv_text: Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter: Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man.
bsb_text: When all has been heard, the conclusion of the matter is this: Fear God and keep His commandments, because this is the whole duty of man.
aov_text: Die hoofsaak van alles wat gehoor is, is: Vrees God en hou sy gebooie; want dit geld vir alle mense.

kjv_text: For God shall bring every work into judgment, with every secret thing, whether it be good, or whether it be evil.
bsb_text: For God will bring every deed into judgment, along with every hidden thing, whether good or evil.
aov_text: Want God sal elke werk bring in die gerig wat kom oor al die verborge dinge, goed of sleg.

kjv_text: The song of songs, which is Solomon's.
bsb_text: This is Solomon’s Song of Songs.
aov_text: DIE hooglied van Salomo.

kjv_text: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth: for thy love is better than wine.
bsb_text: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth! For your love is more delightful than wine.
aov_text: Laat hy my kus met kusse van sy mond; want u liefde is kosteliker as wyn.

kjv_text: Because of the savour of thy good ointments thy name is as ointment poured forth, therefore do the virgins love thee.
bsb_text: The fragrance of your perfume is pleasing; your name is like perfume poured out. No wonder the maidens adore you.
aov_text: U salf is aangenaam van geur, u naam is soos salf wat uitgegiet is; daarom het die jonkvroue u lief.

kjv_text: Draw me, we will run after thee: the king hath brought me into his chambers: we will be glad and rejoice in thee, we will remember thy love more than wine: the upright love thee.
bsb_text: Take me away with you—let us hurry! May the king bring me to his chambers. We will rejoice and delight in you; we will praise your love more than wine. It is only right that they adore you.
aov_text: Trek my agter u aan, laat ons gou maak! Die koning het my in sy binnekamers gebring. Ons wil juig en ons in u verheug, ons wil u liefde prys meer as wyn. Met reg het hulle u lief.

kjv_text: I am black, but comely, O ye daughters of Jerusalem, as the tents of Kedar, as the curtains of Solomon.
bsb_text: I am dark, yet lovely, O daughters of Jerusalem, like the tents of Kedar, like the curtains of Solomon.
aov_text: Ek is bruin gebrand maar lieflik, o dogters van Jerusalem, soos die tente van Kedar, soos die gordyne van Salomo.

kjv_text: Look not upon me, because I am black, because the sun hath looked upon me: my mother's children were angry with me; they made me the keeper of the vineyards; but mine own vineyard have I not kept.
bsb_text: Do not stare because I am dark, for the sun has gazed upon me. My mother’s sons were angry with me; they made me a keeper of the vineyards, but my own vineyard I have neglected.
aov_text: Moenie na my kyk omdat ek so bruinerig is, omdat die son my verbrand het nie: die seuns van my moeder was toornig op my; hulle het my aangestel as oppasser van die wingerde; my eie wingerd het ek nie opgepas nie.

kjv_text: Tell me, O thou whom my soul loveth, where thou feedest, where thou makest thy flock to rest at noon: for why should I be as one that turneth aside by the flocks of thy companions?
bsb_text: Tell me, O one I love, where do you pasture your sheep? Where do you rest them at midday? Why should I be like a veiled woman beside the flocks of your companions?
aov_text: Vertel my tog, my sielsbeminde, waar laat u wei, waar laat u smiddags die vee lê en rus? Want waarom sou ek wees soos een wat haar met ’n sluier toedraai by die kuddes van u metgeselle?

kjv_text: If thou know not, O thou fairest among women, go thy way forth by the footsteps of the flock, and feed thy kids beside the shepherds' tents.
bsb_text: If you do not know, O fairest of women, follow the tracks of the flock, and graze your young goats near the tents of the shepherds.
aov_text: As u dit self nie weet nie, mooiste onder die vroue, gaan dan uit op die spore van die skape en laat u bokkies wei by die hutte van die herders.

kjv_text: I have compared thee, O my love, to a company of horses in Pharaoh's chariots.
bsb_text: I compare you, my darling, to a mare among Pharaoh’s chariots.
aov_text: Met die perde voor ’n wa van Farao vergelyk ek u, my vriendin!

kjv_text: Thy cheeks are comely with rows of jewels, thy neck with chains of gold.
bsb_text: Your cheeks are beautiful with ornaments, your neck with strings of jewels.
aov_text: Lieflik is u wange tussen die kettinkies, u hals in die snoere.

kjv_text: We will make thee borders of gold with studs of silver.
bsb_text: We will make you ornaments of gold, studded with beads of silver.
aov_text: Ons sal vir u goue kettinkies maak met silwerknoppe.

kjv_text: While the king sitteth at his table, my spikenard sendeth forth the smell thereof.
bsb_text: While the king was at his table, my perfume spread its fragrance.
aov_text: So lank as die koning aan sy tafel was, het my nardus sy geur gegee.

kjv_text: A bundle of myrrh is my well-beloved unto me; he shall lie all night betwixt my breasts.
bsb_text: My beloved is to me a sachet of myrrh resting between my breasts.
aov_text: My beminde is vir my ’n bossie mirre wat tussen my borste rus.

kjv_text: My beloved is unto me as a cluster of camphire in the vineyards of Engedi.
bsb_text: My beloved is to me a cluster of henna blossoms in the vineyards of En-gedi.
aov_text: My beminde is vir my ’n tros hennablomme in die wingerde van Éngedi.

kjv_text: Behold, thou art fair, my love; behold, thou art fair; thou hast doves' eyes.
bsb_text: How beautiful you are, my darling! Oh, how very beautiful! Your eyes are like doves.
aov_text: Hoe mooi is u tog, my vriendin! Hoe mooi is u tog, u oë is soos duiwe!

kjv_text: Behold, thou art fair, my beloved, yea, pleasant: also our bed is green.
bsb_text: How handsome you are, my beloved! Oh, how delightful! The soft grass is our bed.
aov_text: Hoe mooi is u tog, my beminde, ja lieflik; ook is ons bed in die groenigheid.

kjv_text: The beams of our house are cedar, and our rafters of fir.
bsb_text: The beams of our house are cedars; our rafters are fragrant firs.
aov_text: Die balke van ons huise is seders, ons paneelwerk sipresse.

kjv_text: I am the rose of Sharon, and the lily of the valleys.
bsb_text: I am a rose of Sharon, a lily of the valley.
aov_text: EK is ’n narsing van Saron, ’n lelie van die dale.

kjv_text: As the lily among thorns, so is my love among the daughters.
bsb_text: Like a lily among the thorns is my darling among the maidens.
aov_text: Soos ’n lelie tussen die dorings, so is my vriendin onder die dogters.

kjv_text: As the apple tree among the trees of the wood, so is my beloved among the sons. I sat down under his shadow with great delight, and his fruit was sweet to my taste.
bsb_text: Like an apple tree among the trees of the forest is my beloved among the young men. I delight to sit in his shade, and his fruit is sweet to my taste.
aov_text: Soos ’n appelboom onder die bome van die bos, so is my beminde onder die seuns. Ek het verlang om in sy skaduwee te sit, en sy vrugte is soet vir my verhemelte.

kjv_text: He brought me to the banqueting house, and his banner over me was love.
bsb_text: He has brought me to the house of wine, and his banner over me is love.
aov_text: Hy het my in die wynhuis ingebring, en sy vaandel oor my was die liefde.

kjv_text: Stay me with flagons, comfort me with apples: for I am sick of love.
bsb_text: Sustain me with raisins; refresh me with apples, for I am faint with love.
aov_text: Versterk my met rosynekoeke, verkwik my met appels, want ek is krank van liefde.

kjv_text: His left hand is under my head, and his right hand doth embrace me.
bsb_text: His left hand is under my head, and his right arm embraces me.
aov_text: Laat sy linkerarm onder my hoof wees en sy regterarm my omhels.

kjv_text: I charge you, O ye daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, and by the hinds of the field, that ye stir not up, nor awake my love, till he please.
bsb_text: O daughters of Jerusalem, I adjure you by the gazelles and does of the field: Do not arouse or awaken love until the time is right.
aov_text: Ek besweer julle, dogters van Jerusalem, by die gemsbokke of by die takbokke van die veld, om nie die liefde wakker te maak of op te wek voordat dit die liefde behaag nie.

kjv_text: The voice of my beloved! behold, he cometh leaping upon the mountains, skipping upon the hills.
bsb_text: Listen! My beloved approaches. Look! Here he comes, leaping across the mountains, bounding over the hills.
aov_text: Hoor, my beminde, kyk, daar kom hy! Hy spring oor die berge, hy huppel oor die heuwels.

kjv_text: My beloved is like a roe or a young hart: behold, he standeth behind our wall, he looketh forth at the windows, shewing himself through the lattice.
bsb_text: My beloved is like a gazelle or a young stag. Look, he stands behind our wall, gazing through the windows, peering through the lattice.
aov_text: My beminde lyk soos ’n gemsbok of soos ’n jong takbok. Daar staan hy agter ons muur! Hy kyk deur die vensters in, hy speur deur die tralies heen.

kjv_text: My beloved spake, and said unto me, Rise up, my love, my fair one, and come away.
bsb_text: My beloved calls to me, “Arise, my darling. Come away with me, my beautiful one.
aov_text: My beminde begin toe en sê vir my: Staan op, my vriendin, my skone, kom dan tog!

kjv_text: For, lo, the winter is past, the rain is over and gone;
bsb_text: For now the winter is past; the rain is over and gone.
aov_text: Want kyk, die winter is verby, die reëntyd is oor, dit het verbygegaan.

kjv_text: The flowers appear on the earth; the time of the singing of birds is come, and the voice of the turtle is heard in our land;
bsb_text: The flowers have appeared in the countryside; the season of singing has come, and the cooing of turtledoves is heard in our land.
aov_text: Die bloeisels word gesien in die land, die sangtyd het aangebreek, en die tortelduif laat sy stem hoor in ons land.

kjv_text: The fig tree putteth forth her green figs, and the vines with the tender grape give a good smell. Arise, my love, my fair one, and come away.
bsb_text: The fig tree ripens its figs; the blossoming vines spread their fragrance. Arise, come away, my darling; come away with me, my beautiful one.”
aov_text: Die vyeboom laat sy voorvye uitswel, en die wingerdstokke wat bloei, versprei geur. Staan op, my vriendin, my skone, kom dan tog!

kjv_text: O my dove, that art in the clefts of the rock, in the secret places of the stairs, let me see thy countenance, let me hear thy voice; for sweet is thy voice, and thy countenance is comely.
bsb_text: O my dove in the clefts of the rock, in the crevices of the cliff, let me see your face, let me hear your voice; for your voice is sweet, and your countenance is lovely.
aov_text: My duif in die rotsklowe, in die skuilplek by die krans, laat my u gedaante sien, laat my u stem hoor; want u stem is soet, en u gedaante is lieflik.

kjv_text: Take us the foxes, the little foxes, that spoil the vines: for our vines have tender grapes.
bsb_text: Catch for us the foxes—the little foxes that ruin the vineyards—for our vineyards are in bloom.
aov_text: Vang julle vir ons die jakkalse, die klein jakkalse wat die wingerde verniel, want ons wingerde staan in die bloei.

kjv_text: My beloved is mine, and I am his: he feedeth among the lilies.
bsb_text: My beloved is mine and I am his; he pastures his flock among the lilies.
aov_text: My beminde is myne, en ek is syne wat herder is onder die lelies.

kjv_text: Until the day break, and the shadows flee away, turn, my beloved, and be thou like a roe or a young hart upon the mountains of Bether.
bsb_text: Before the day breaks and shadows flee, turn, my beloved, and be like a gazelle or a young stag on the mountains of Bether.
aov_text: Totdat die aandwind waai en die skaduwees vlug, kom aan, my beminde, maak soos die gemsbok of soos die jong takbok op die berge van skeiding.

kjv_text: By night on my bed I sought him whom my soul loveth: I sought him, but I found him not.
bsb_text: On my bed at night I sought the one I love; I sought him, but did not find him.
aov_text: OP my bed snags het ek gesoek na my sielsbeminde, ek het na hom gesoek, maar hom nie gevind nie.

kjv_text: I will rise now, and go about the city in the streets, and in the broad ways I will seek him whom my soul loveth: I sought him, but I found him not.
bsb_text: I will arise now and go about the city, through the streets and squares. I will seek the one I love. So I sought him but did not find him.
aov_text: Ek wil dan opstaan en in die stad rondgaan, in die strate en op die pleine wil ek na my sielsbeminde soek; ek het na hom gesoek, maar hom nie gevind nie.

kjv_text: The watchmen that go about the city found me: to whom I said, Saw ye him whom my soul loveth?
bsb_text: I encountered the watchmen on their rounds of the city: “Have you seen the one I love?”
aov_text: Die wagte wat in die stad rondgaan, het my aangetref. Het julle my sielsbeminde nie gesien nie?

kjv_text: It was but a little that I passed from them, but I found him whom my soul loveth: I held him, and would not let him go, until I had brought him into my mother's house, and into the chamber of her that conceived me.
bsb_text: I had just passed them when I found the one I love. I held him and would not let go until I had brought him to my mother’s house, to the chamber of the one who conceived me.
aov_text: Skaars het ek van hulle af verder gegaan, of ek het my sielsbeminde gevind; ek het hom vasgehou en hom nie gelos voordat ek hom gebring het in die huis van my moeder en in die binnekamer van haar wat my gebaar het nie.

kjv_text: I charge you, O ye daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, and by the hinds of the field, that ye stir not up, nor awake my love, till he please.
bsb_text: O daughters of Jerusalem, I adjure you by the gazelles and does of the field: Do not arouse or awaken love until the time is right.
aov_text: Ek besweer julle, dogters van Jerusalem, by die gemsbokke of by die takbokke van die veld om nie die liefde wakker te maak of op te wek voordat dit die liefde behaag nie.

kjv_text: Who is this that cometh out of the wilderness like pillars of smoke, perfumed with myrrh and frankincense, with all powders of the merchant?
bsb_text: Who is this coming up from the wilderness like a column of smoke, scented with myrrh and frankincense from all the spices of the merchant?
aov_text: WIE is dit wat daar opkom uit die woestyn soos rookpilare, omgeurd van mirre en wierook, van allerhande speserye van die koopman?

kjv_text: Behold his bed, which is Solomon's; threescore valiant men are about it, of the valiant of Israel.
bsb_text: Behold, it is Solomon’s carriage, escorted by sixty of the mightiest men of Israel.
aov_text: Kyk, dit is die draagstoel van Salomo, sestig helde daaromheen, van die helde van Israel,

kjv_text: They all hold swords, being expert in war: every man hath his sword upon his thigh because of fear in the night.
bsb_text: All are skilled with the sword, experienced in warfare. Each has his sword at his side prepared for the terror of the night.
aov_text: hulle almal met ’n swaard gewapend, geoefend vir oorlog, elkeen met sy swaard aan sy heup vanweë die nagtelike verskrikking.

kjv_text: King Solomon made himself a chariot of the wood of Lebanon.
bsb_text: King Solomon has made his carriage out of the timber of Lebanon.
aov_text: Koning Salomo het vir hom ’n draagstoel gemaak van die hout van die Líbanon;

kjv_text: He made the pillars thereof of silver, the bottom thereof of gold, the covering of it of purple, the midst thereof being paved with love, for the daughters of Jerusalem.
bsb_text: He has made its posts of silver, its base of gold, its seat of purple fabric. Its interior is inlaid with love by the daughters of Jerusalem.
aov_text: die steile daarvan het hy gemaak van silwer, die leuning van goud, die sitplek van purper, die binnekant mooi opgemaak—’n liefdegawe van die dogters van Jerusalem.

kjv_text: Go forth, O ye daughters of Zion, and behold king Solomon with the crown wherewith his mother crowned him in the day of his espousals, and in the day of the gladness of his heart.
bsb_text: Come out, O daughters of Zion, and gaze at King Solomon, wearing the crown his mother bestowed on the day of his wedding—the day of his heart’s rejoicing.
aov_text: Kom uit, dogters van Sion, en aanskou met vreugde die koning Salomo, die krans waarmee sy moeder hom bekrans het op sy troudag en op die dag dat sy hart vrolik is.

kjv_text: Behold, thou art fair, my love; behold, thou art fair; thou hast doves' eyes within thy locks: thy hair is as a flock of goats, that appear from mount Gilead.
bsb_text: How beautiful you are, my darling—how very beautiful! Your eyes are like doves behind your veil. Your hair is like a flock of goats streaming down Mount Gilead.
aov_text: HOE mooi is u tog, my vriendin, hoe mooi is u tog, u oë is soos duiwe deur u sluier heen; u hare is soos ’n kudde bokke wat van die gebergte van Gílead afgolf.

kjv_text: Thy teeth are like a flock of sheep that are even shorn, which came up from the washing; whereof every one bear twins, and none is barren among them.
bsb_text: Your teeth are like a flock of newly shorn sheep coming up from the washing; each has its twin, and not one of them is lost.
aov_text: U tande is soos ’n kudde pas geskeerde skape wat van die drinkplek opkom, wat almal tweelinge het, en geeneen onder hulle is sonder lam nie.

kjv_text: Thy lips are like a thread of scarlet, and thy speech is comely: thy temples are like a piece of a pomegranate within thy locks.
bsb_text: Your lips are like a scarlet ribbon, and your mouth is lovely. Your brow behind your veil is like a slice of pomegranate.
aov_text: U lippe is soos ’n skarlaken band, en u mond is lieflik. U slape is soos ’n granaatskyf deur u sluier heen.

kjv_text: Thy neck is like the tower of David builded for an armoury, whereon there hang a thousand bucklers, all shields of mighty men.
bsb_text: Your neck is like the tower of David, built with rows of stones; on it hang a thousand shields, all of them shields of warriors.
aov_text: U hals is soos die Dawidstoring, gebou met muurkranse waar die duisend skilde in hang, almal skilde van helde.

kjv_text: Thy two breasts are like two young roes that are twins, which feed among the lilies.
bsb_text: Your breasts are like two fawns, twins of a gazelle grazing among the lilies.
aov_text: U twee borste is soos twee lammers, tweelinge van ’n gemsbok, wat onder die lelies wei.

kjv_text: Until the day break, and the shadows flee away, I will get me to the mountain of myrrh, and to the hill of frankincense.
bsb_text: Before the day breaks and the shadows flee, I will make my way to the mountain of myrrh and to the hill of frankincense.
aov_text: Totdat die aandwind waai en die skaduwees vlug, sal ek gaan na die mirreberg en na die wierookheuwel.

kjv_text: Thou art all fair, my love; there is no spot in thee.
bsb_text: You are altogether beautiful, my darling; in you there is no flaw.
aov_text: Alles is mooi aan u, my vriendin, en daar is geen gebrek aan u nie.

kjv_text: Come with me from Lebanon, my spouse, with me from Lebanon: look from the top of Amana, from the top of Shenir and Hermon, from the lions' dens, from the mountains of the leopards.
bsb_text: Come with me from Lebanon, my bride, come with me from Lebanon! Descend from the peak of Amana, from the summits of Senir and Hermon, from the dens of the lions, from the mountains of the leopards.
aov_text: Saam met my van die Líbanon af, bruid, saam met my van die Líbanon af, o kom! Trek af van die top van Amána, van die top van Senir en van Hermon, van die lêplekke van die leeus, van die berge van die luiperds.

kjv_text: Thou hast ravished my heart, my sister, my spouse; thou hast ravished my heart with one of thine eyes, with one chain of thy neck.
bsb_text: You have captured my heart, my sister, my bride; you have stolen my heart with one glance of your eyes, with one jewel of your neck.
aov_text: U het my hart gesteel, my susterbruid, u het my hart gesteel met een straal van u oë, met een kettinkie van u halssieraad.

kjv_text: How fair is thy love, my sister, my spouse! how much better is thy love than wine! and the smell of thine ointments than all spices!
bsb_text: How delightful is your love, my sister, my bride! Your love is much better than wine, and the fragrance of your perfume than all spices.
aov_text: Hoe skoon is u liefde, my susterbruid, hoeveel beter is u liefde as wyn en die geur van u salf as al die speserye!

kjv_text: Thy lips, O my spouse, drop as the honeycomb: honey and milk are under thy tongue; and the smell of thy garments is like the smell of Lebanon.
bsb_text: Your lips, my bride, drip sweetness like the honeycomb; honey and milk are under your tongue, and the fragrance of your garments is like the aroma of Lebanon.
aov_text: Heuningstroop drup van u lippe af, bruid, heuning en melk is onder u tong, en die geur van u klere is soos die geur van die Líbanon.

kjv_text: A garden inclosed is my sister, my spouse; a spring shut up, a fountain sealed.
bsb_text: My sister, my bride, you are a garden locked up, a spring enclosed, a fountain sealed.
aov_text: My susterbruid is ’n geslote tuin, ’n geslote bron, ’n verseëlde fontein.

kjv_text: Thy plants are an orchard of pomegranates, with pleasant fruits; camphire, with spikenard,
bsb_text: Your branches are an orchard of pomegranates with the choicest of fruits, with henna and nard,
aov_text: U spruite is ’n park van granate met kostelike vrugte, hennablomme met nardus,

kjv_text: Spikenard and saffron; calamus and cinnamon, with all trees of frankincense; myrrh and aloes, with all the chief spices:
bsb_text: with nard and saffron, with calamus and cinnamon, with every kind of frankincense tree, with myrrh and aloes, with all the finest spices.
aov_text: nardus en saffraan, kalmoes en kaneel, met allerhande wierookstruike, mirre en alewee, met allerhande kostelike speserye.

kjv_text: A fountain of gardens, a well of living waters, and streams from Lebanon.
bsb_text: You are a garden spring, a well of fresh water flowing down from Lebanon.
aov_text: U is ’n fontein van die tuine, ’n put met lewende water wat van die Líbanon afvloei.

kjv_text: Awake, O north wind; and come, thou south; blow upon my garden, that the spices thereof may flow out. Let my beloved come into his garden, and eat his pleasant fruits.
bsb_text: Awake, O north wind, and come, O south wind. Breathe on my garden and spread the fragrance of its spices. Let my beloved come into his garden and taste its choicest fruits.
aov_text: Word wakker, noordewind, en kom, suidewind, deurwaai my tuin, laat sy balsemgeure uitvloei! Laat my beminde in sy tuin kom en van sy kostelike vrugte eet.

kjv_text: I am come into my garden, my sister, my spouse: I have gathered my myrrh with my spice; I have eaten my honeycomb with my honey; I have drunk my wine with my milk: eat, O friends; drink, yea, drink abundantly, O beloved.
bsb_text: I have come to my garden, my sister, my bride; I have gathered my myrrh with my spice. I have eaten my honeycomb with my honey; I have drunk my wine with my milk. Eat, O friends, and drink; drink freely, O beloved.
aov_text: EK het in my tuin gekom, my susterbruid, ek het my mirre met my balsem gepluk, ek het geëet van my heuningkoek met my heuning, ek het gedrink my wyn met my melk; eet, vriende, drink en word dronk, bemindes.

kjv_text: I sleep, but my heart waketh: it is the voice of my beloved that knocketh, saying, Open to me, my sister, my love, my dove, my undefiled: for my head is filled with dew, and my locks with the drops of the night.
bsb_text: I sleep, but my heart is awake. A sound! My beloved is knocking: “Open to me, my sister, my darling, my dove, my flawless one. My head is drenched with dew, my hair with the dampness of the night.”
aov_text: Ek het geslaap, maar my hart het gewaak. Hoor, my beminde klop: Maak vir my oop, my suster, my vriendin, my duif, my volmaakte! Want my hoof is vol dou, my haarlokke vol nagdruppels.

kjv_text: I have put off my coat; how shall I put it on? I have washed my feet; how shall I defile them?
bsb_text: I have taken off my robe—must I put it back on? I have washed my feet—must I soil them again?
aov_text: Ek het my kleed uitgetrek, hoe kan ek dit weer aantrek? Ek het my voete gewas, hoe kan ek dit weer vuil maak?

kjv_text: My beloved put in his hand by the hole of the door, and my bowels were moved for him.
bsb_text: My beloved put his hand to the latch; my heart pounded for him.
aov_text: My beminde het sy hand deur die deuropening gesteek; toe het my binneste oor hom in beroering gekom;

kjv_text: I rose up to open to my beloved; and my hands dropped with myrrh, and my fingers with sweet smelling myrrh, upon the handles of the lock.
bsb_text: I rose up to open for my beloved. My hands dripped with myrrh, my fingers with flowing myrrh on the handles of the bolt.
aov_text: ek het opgestaan om vir my beminde oop te maak, terwyl my hande drup van mirre en my vingers van vloeiende mirre op die handvatsels van die grendel.

kjv_text: I opened to my beloved; but my beloved had withdrawn himself, and was gone: my soul failed when he spake: I sought him, but I could not find him; I called him, but he gave me no answer.
bsb_text: I opened for my beloved, but he had turned and gone. My heart sank at his departure. I sought him, but did not find him. I called, but he did not answer.
aov_text: Ek het vir my beminde oopgemaak, maar my beminde het weggedraai, verbygegaan; ek het my besinning verloor toe hy gespreek het; ek het na hom gesoek, maar hom nie gevind nie; ek het na hom geroep, maar hy het my nie geantwoord nie.

kjv_text: The watchmen that went about the city found me, they smote me, they wounded me; the keepers of the walls took away my veil from me.
bsb_text: I encountered the watchmen on their rounds of the city. They beat me and bruised me; they took away my cloak, those guardians of the walls.
aov_text: Die wagte wat in die stad rondgaan, het my aangetref; hulle het my geslaan, my gewond; die wagte by die mure het my mantel van my afgeneem.

kjv_text: I charge you, O daughters of Jerusalem, if ye find my beloved, that ye tell him, that I am sick of love.
bsb_text: O daughters of Jerusalem, I adjure you, if you find my beloved, tell him I am sick with love.
aov_text: Ek besweer julle, dogters van Jerusalem, as julle my beminde vind, wat sal julle hom vertel? Dat ek krank is van liefde.

kjv_text: What is thy beloved more than another beloved, O thou fairest among women? what is thy beloved more than another beloved, that thou dost so charge us?
bsb_text: How is your beloved better than others, O most beautiful among women? How is your beloved better than another, that you charge us so?
aov_text: Wat is u beminde meer as ’n ander beminde, o skoonste onder die vroue—wat is u beminde meer as ’n ander beminde, dat u ons so besweer het?

kjv_text: My beloved is white and ruddy, the chiefest among ten thousand.
bsb_text: My beloved is dazzling and ruddy, outstanding among ten thousand.
aov_text: My beminde is skitterend wit en rooi, uitnemender as tienduisend.

kjv_text: His head is as the most fine gold, his locks are bushy, and black as a raven.
bsb_text: His head is purest gold; his hair is wavy and black as a raven.
aov_text: Sy hoof is goud, suiwer goud; sy haarlokke is golwende, swart soos ’n raaf,

kjv_text: His eyes are as the eyes of doves by the rivers of waters, washed with milk, and fitly set.
bsb_text: His eyes are like doves beside the streams of water, bathed in milk and mounted like jewels.
aov_text: sy oë soos duiwe by waterstrome, in melk gewas, sittend by ’n volle bron.

kjv_text: His cheeks are as a bed of spices, as sweet flowers: his lips like lilies, dropping sweet smelling myrrh.
bsb_text: His cheeks are like beds of spice, towers of perfume. His lips are like lilies, dripping with flowing myrrh.
aov_text: Sy wange is soos balsembeddings, terrasbeddings van geurige plante; sy lippe is lelies wat van vloeiende mirre drup.

kjv_text: His hands are as gold rings set with the beryl: his belly is as bright ivory overlaid with sapphires.
bsb_text: His arms are rods of gold set with beryl. His body is an ivory panel bedecked with sapphires.
aov_text: Sy hande is ronde stawe van goud, ingevul met chrisoliet, sy liggaam ’n kunswerk van ivoor, bedek met saffierstene.

kjv_text: His legs are as pillars of marble, set upon sockets of fine gold: his countenance is as Lebanon, excellent as the cedars.
bsb_text: His legs are pillars of marble set on bases of pure gold. His appearance is like Lebanon, as majestic as the cedars.
aov_text: Sy bene is marmerpilare wat rus op voetstukke van fyn goud; sy gestalte is soos die Líbanon, uitgesoek soos die seders.

kjv_text: His mouth is most sweet: yea, he is altogether lovely. This is my beloved, and this is my friend, O daughters of Jerusalem.
bsb_text: His mouth is most sweet; he is altogether lovely. This is my beloved, and this is my friend, O daughters of Jerusalem.
aov_text: Sy verhemelte is pure soetigheid, ja, hy is geheel en al die lieflikheid self. Dit is my beminde en dit is my vriend, dogters van Jerusalem.

kjv_text: Whither is thy beloved gone, O thou fairest among women? whither is thy beloved turned aside? that we may seek him with thee.
bsb_text: Where has your beloved gone, O most beautiful among women? Which way has he turned? We will seek him with you.
aov_text: WAAR het u beminde heengegaan, o skoonste onder die vroue? Waarheen het u beminde hom gewend, dat ons hom saam met u kan soek?

kjv_text: My beloved is gone down into his garden, to the beds of spices, to feed in the gardens, and to gather lilies.
bsb_text: My beloved has gone down to his garden, to the beds of spices, to pasture his flock in the gardens and to gather lilies.
aov_text: My beminde het afgeloop na sy tuin, na die balsembeddings om hom te vermaak in die tuine en om lelies te versamel.

kjv_text: I am my beloved's, and my beloved is mine: he feedeth among the lilies.
bsb_text: I belong to my beloved and he belongs to me; he pastures his flock among the lilies.
aov_text: Ek is my beminde s’n, en my beminde is myne—hy wat herder is onder die lelies.

kjv_text: Thou art beautiful, O my love, as Tirzah, comely as Jerusalem, terrible as an army with banners.
bsb_text: You are as beautiful, my darling, as Tirzah, as lovely as Jerusalem, as majestic as troops with banners.
aov_text: Mooi is u, my vriendin, soos Tirsa, lieflik soos Jerusalem, verskriklik soos slagordes met vaandels.

kjv_text: Turn away thine eyes from me, for they have overcome me: thy hair is as a flock of goats that appear from Gilead.
bsb_text: Turn your eyes away from me, for they have overcome me. Your hair is like a flock of goats streaming down from Gilead.
aov_text: Draai u oë van my af weg, want hulle verskrik my; u hare is soos ’n kudde bokke wat van Gílead afgolf.

kjv_text: Thy teeth are as a flock of sheep which go up from the washing, whereof every one beareth twins, and there is not one barren among them.
bsb_text: Your teeth are like a flock of sheep coming up from the washing; each has its twin, and not one of them is lost.
aov_text: U tande is soos ’n kudde skaapooie wat van die drinkplek af opkom, wat almal tweelinge het, en geeneen onder hulle is sonder lam nie.

kjv_text: As a piece of a pomegranate are thy temples within thy locks.
bsb_text: Your brow behind your veil is like a slice of pomegranate.
aov_text: U slape is soos ’n granaatskyf deur u sluier heen.

kjv_text: There are threescore queens, and fourscore concubines, and virgins without number.
bsb_text: There are sixty queens and eighty concubines, and maidens without number,
aov_text: Daar is sestig koninginne en tagtig byvroue en jonkvroue sonder getal.

kjv_text: My dove, my undefiled is but one; she is the only one of her mother, she is the choice one of her that bare her. The daughters saw her, and blessed her; yea, the queens and the concubines, and they praised her.
bsb_text: but my dove, my perfect one, is unique, the favorite of the mother who bore her. The maidens see her and call her blessed; the queens and concubines sing her praises.
aov_text: Een, dié is my duif, my volmaakte, die enigste vir haar moeder; sy is die uitverkorene vir die een wat haar gebaar het. Die dogters het haar gesien en haar gelukkig geprys, die koninginne en die byvroue, en haar geroem:

kjv_text: Who is she that looketh forth as the morning, fair as the moon, clear as the sun, and terrible as an army with banners?
bsb_text: Who is this who shines like the dawn, as fair as the moon, as bright as the sun, as majestic as the stars in procession?
aov_text: Wie is dit wat daar opkom soos die dageraad, mooi soos die maan, rein soos die son, verskriklik soos slagordes met vaandels?

kjv_text: I went down into the garden of nuts to see the fruits of the valley, and to see whether the vine flourished, and the pomegranates budded.
bsb_text: I went down to the walnut grove to see the blossoms of the valley, to see if the vines were budding or the pomegranates were in bloom.
aov_text: Ek het afgeloop na die neutetuin om te kyk na die uitspruitsels in die dal, om te kyk of die wingerdstok uitloop, die granate blom.

kjv_text: Or ever I was aware, my soul made me like the chariots of Amminadib.
bsb_text: Before I realized it, my desire had set me among the royal chariots of my people.
aov_text: Voordat ek dit geweet het, het my verlange my verplaas op die waens van my edele volk.

kjv_text: Return, return, O Shulamite; return, return, that we may look upon thee. What will ye see in the Shulamite? As it were the company of two armies.
bsb_text: Come back, come back, O Shulammite! Come back, come back, that we may gaze upon you. Why do you look at the Shulammite, as on the dance of Mahanaim?
aov_text: Kom terug, kom terug, Sulammitiese, kom terug, kom terug, dat ons u kan aansien. Wat sien julle aan die Sulammitiese? Iets soos die koordans van Mahanáim.

kjv_text: How beautiful are thy feet with shoes, O prince's daughter! the joints of thy thighs are like jewels, the work of the hands of a cunning workman.
bsb_text: How beautiful are your sandaled feet, O daughter of the prince! The curves of your thighs are like jewels, the handiwork of a master.
aov_text: HOE mooi is u skrede in die skoene, o edele dogter! Die golwende lyne van u heupe is soos halssierade, ’n werk van kunstenaarshande.

kjv_text: Thy navel is like a round goblet, which wanteth not liquor: thy belly is like an heap of wheat set about with lilies.
bsb_text: Your navel is a rounded goblet; it never lacks blended wine. Your waist is a mound of wheat encircled by the lilies.
aov_text: U nawel is ’n ronde kom—laat die gemengde wyn nie ontbreek nie. U liggaam is ’n hoop koring, omring deur lelies.

kjv_text: Thy two breasts are like two young roes that are twins.
bsb_text: Your breasts are like two fawns, twins of a gazelle.
aov_text: U twee borste is soos twee lammers, tweelinge van ’n gemsbok.

kjv_text: Thy neck is as a tower of ivory; thine eyes like the fishpools in Heshbon, by the gate of Bathrabbim: thy nose is as the tower of Lebanon which looketh toward Damascus.
bsb_text: Your neck is like a tower made of ivory; your eyes are like the pools of Heshbon by the gate of Bath-rabbim; your nose is like the tower of Lebanon, facing toward Damascus.
aov_text: U hals is soos ’n ivoortoring, u oë vywers in Hesbon by die poort Bat-Rabbim; u neus soos die toring van die Líbanon wat na Damaskus toe uitkyk.

kjv_text: Thine head upon thee is like Carmel, and the hair of thine head like purple; the king is held in the galleries.
bsb_text: Your head crowns you like Mount Carmel, the hair of your head like purple threads; the king is captured in your tresses.
aov_text: U hoof op u is soos die Karmel, en die golwende hare van u hoof soos purper—’n koning gevang in haarlokke!

kjv_text: How fair and how pleasant art thou, O love, for delights!
bsb_text: How fair and pleasant you are, O love, with your delights!
aov_text: Hoe mooi en hoe lieflik is u, o liefde, onder al die genietinge!

kjv_text: This thy stature is like to a palm tree, and thy breasts to clusters of grapes.
bsb_text: Your stature is like a palm tree; your breasts are clusters of fruit.
aov_text: U hoë gestalte daar lyk soos ’n dadelpalm, en u borste soos vrugtetrosse.

kjv_text: I said, I will go up to the palm tree, I will take hold of the boughs thereof: now also thy breasts shall be as clusters of the vine, and the smell of thy nose like apples;
bsb_text: I said, “I will climb the palm tree; I will take hold of its fruit.” May your breasts be like clusters of the vine, the fragrance of your breath like apples,
aov_text: Ek het gedink: Laat ek op die dadelpalm klim, laat ek sy trosse gryp; en laat u borste tog wees soos trosse van die wingerdstok, en die geur van u asem soos dié van appels,

kjv_text: And the roof of thy mouth like the best wine for my beloved, that goeth down sweetly, causing the lips of those that are asleep to speak.
bsb_text: and your mouth like the finest wine. May it flow smoothly to my beloved, gliding gently over lips and teeth.
aov_text: en u verhemelte soos die beste wyn wat vir my beminde saggies na binne gly, en oor die lippe vloei van die wat inslaap.

kjv_text: I am my beloved's, and his desire is toward me.
bsb_text: I belong to my beloved, and his desire is for me.
aov_text: Ek is my beminde s’n, en sy begeerte is na my.

kjv_text: Come, my beloved, let us go forth into the field; let us lodge in the villages.
bsb_text: Come, my beloved, let us go to the countryside; let us spend the night among the wildflowers.
aov_text: Kom, my beminde, laat ons uitgaan in die veld, laat ons in die dorpe vernag.

kjv_text: Let us get up early to the vineyards; let us see if the vine flourish, whether the tender grape appear, and the pomegranates bud forth: there will I give thee my loves.
bsb_text: Let us go early to the vineyards to see if the vine has budded, if the blossom has opened, if the pomegranates are in bloom—there I will give you my love.
aov_text: Laat ons vroeg na die wingerde gaan, laat ons sien of die wingerdstok uitloop, die druiwebloeisel oopgaan, die granate blom. Daar sal ek u my liefde gee.

kjv_text: The mandrakes give a smell, and at our gates are all manner of pleasant fruits, new and old, which I have laid up for thee, O my beloved.
bsb_text: The mandrakes send forth a fragrance, and at our door is every delicacy, new as well as old, that I have treasured up for you, my beloved.
aov_text: Die liefdesappels gee geur, en by ons deure is allerhande kostelike vrugte, vars en oud; o my beminde, dit het ek vir u weggebêre.

kjv_text: O that thou wert as my brother, that sucked the breasts of my mother! when I should find thee without, I would kiss thee; yea, I should not be despised.
bsb_text: O that you were to me like a brother who nursed at my mother’s breasts! If I found you outdoors, I would kiss you, and no one would despise me.
aov_text: AG, was u maar vir my soos ’n broer wat aan die borste van my moeder drink! As ek u daar buite vind, ek sou u kus; en tog sou hulle my nie verag nie.

kjv_text: I would lead thee, and bring thee into my mother's house, who would instruct me: I would cause thee to drink of spiced wine of the juice of my pomegranate.
bsb_text: I would lead you and bring you to the house of my mother who taught me. I would give you spiced wine to drink, the nectar of my pomegranates.
aov_text: Ek sou u lei, ek sou u bring in die huis van my moeder; sy sou my leer; ek sou u laat drink van die gekruide wyn, van my granaatmos.

kjv_text: His left hand should be under my head, and his right hand should embrace me.
bsb_text: His left hand is under my head, and his right arm embraces me.
aov_text: Laat sy linkerarm onder my hoof wees en sy regterarm my omhels.

kjv_text: I charge you, O daughters of Jerusalem, that ye stir not up, nor awake my love, until he please.
bsb_text: O daughters of Jerusalem, I adjure you: Do not arouse or awaken love until the time is right.
aov_text: Ek besweer julle, dogters van Jerusalem: Waarom wil julle wakker maak en waarom wil julle opwek die liefde voordat dit die liefde behaag?

kjv_text: Who is this that cometh up from the wilderness, leaning upon her beloved? I raised thee up under the apple tree: there thy mother brought thee forth: there she brought thee forth that bare thee.
bsb_text: Who is this coming up from the wilderness, leaning on her beloved? I roused you under the apple tree; there your mother conceived you; there she travailed and brought you forth.
aov_text: Wie is dit wat daar opkom uit die woestyn, wat leun op haar beminde? Onder die appelboom het ek u opgewek. Daar was u moeder in barensweë oor u, daar was sy in barensweë wat u voortgebring het.

kjv_text: Set me as a seal upon thine heart, as a seal upon thine arm: for love is strong as death; jealousy is cruel as the grave: the coals thereof are coals of fire, which hath a most vehement flame.
bsb_text: Set me as a seal over your heart, as a seal upon your arm. For love is as strong as death, its jealousy as unrelenting as Sheol. Its sparks are fiery flames, the fiercest blaze of all.
aov_text: Dra my soos ’n seëlring op u hart, soos ’n seëlring op u arm; want liefde is sterk soos die dood, die liefdes-ywer is hard soos die doderyk, sy gloed is ’n gloed van vuur, ’n vlam van die HERE.

kjv_text: Many waters cannot quench love, neither can the floods drown it: if a man would give all the substance of his house for love, it would utterly be contemned.
bsb_text: Mighty waters cannot quench love; rivers cannot sweep it away. If a man were to give all the wealth of his house for love, his offer would be utterly scorned.
aov_text: Groot waters kan die liefde nie uitblus en riviere dit nie oorstroom nie; al gee ’n man ook al die goed van sy huis vir die liefde, hulle sou hom diep verag.

kjv_text: We have a little sister, and she hath no breasts: what shall we do for our sister in the day when she shall be spoken for?
bsb_text: We have a little sister, and her breasts are not yet grown. What shall we do for our sister on the day she is spoken for?
aov_text: Ons het ’n klein sustertjie wat nog nie borste het nie; wat moet ons met ons suster maak dié dag as sy gevra word?

kjv_text: If she be a wall, we will build upon her a palace of silver: and if she be a door, we will inclose her with boards of cedar.
bsb_text: If she is a wall, we will build a tower of silver upon her. If she is a door, we will enclose her with panels of cedar.
aov_text: As sy ’n muur is, sal ons ’n silwerrand daarop bou, en as sy ’n deur is, sal ons dit met ’n sederplank toeslaan.

kjv_text: I am a wall, and my breasts like towers: then was I in his eyes as one that found favour.
bsb_text: I am a wall, and my breasts are like towers. So I have become in his eyes like one who brings peace.
aov_text: Ek is ’n muur, en my borste soos torings: toe het ek in sy oë geword soos een wat vrede vind.

kjv_text: Solomon had a vineyard at Baalhamon; he let out the vineyard unto keepers; every one for the fruit thereof was to bring a thousand pieces of silver.
bsb_text: Solomon had a vineyard in Baal-hamon. He leased it to the tenants. For its fruit, each was to bring a thousand shekels of silver.
aov_text: Salomo het ’n wingerd in Baäl-Hamon gehad; hy het die wingerd aan die oppassers oorgegee; elkeen moes vir sy vrugte duisend sikkels silwer inbring.

kjv_text: My vineyard, which is mine, is before me: thou, O Solomon, must have a thousand, and those that keep the fruit thereof two hundred.
bsb_text: But my own vineyard is mine to give; the thousand shekels are for you, O Solomon, and two hundred are for those who tend its fruit.
aov_text: My wingerd, myne, is hier voor my, die duisend sikkels is vir u, Salomo, en tweehonderd vir die wat sy vrugte bewaak.

kjv_text: Thou that dwellest in the gardens, the companions hearken to thy voice: cause me to hear it.
bsb_text: You who dwell in the gardens, my companions are listening for your voice. Let me hear it!
aov_text: U wat in die tuine woon—vriende luister na u stem; laat my dit hoor.

kjv_text: Make haste, my beloved, and be thou like to a roe or to a young hart upon the mountains of spices.
bsb_text: Come away, my beloved, and be like a gazelle or a young stag on the mountains of spices.
aov_text: Vlug, my beminde, en maak soos die gemsbok of die jong takbok op die balsemberge.

kjv_text: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.
bsb_text: This is the vision concerning Judah and Jerusalem that Isaiah son of Amoz saw during the reigns of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.
aov_text: DIE gesig van Jesaja, die seun van Amos, wat hy gesien het met betrekking tot Juda en Jerusalem, in die dae van Ussía, Jotam, Agas en Hiskía, die konings van Juda.

kjv_text: Hear, O heavens, and give ear, O earth: for the LORD hath spoken, I have nourished and brought up children, and they have rebelled against me.
bsb_text: Listen, O heavens, and give ear, O earth, for the LORD has spoken: “I have raised children and brought them up, but they have rebelled against Me.
aov_text: Hoor, o hemele, en luister, o aarde, want die HERE spreek: Ek het kinders grootgemaak en verhoog, maar húlle het teen My oortree.

kjv_text: The ox knoweth his owner, and the ass his master's crib: but Israel doth not know, my people doth not consider.
bsb_text: The ox knows its owner, and the donkey its master’s manger, but Israel does not know; My people do not understand.”
aov_text: ’n Os ken sy besitter en ’n esel die krip van sy eienaar, maar Israel het geen kennis nie, my volk verstaan nie.

kjv_text: Ah sinful nation, a people laden with iniquity, a seed of evildoers, children that are corrupters: they have forsaken the LORD, they have provoked the Holy One of Israel unto anger, they are gone away backward.
bsb_text: Alas, O sinful nation, a people laden with iniquity, a brood of evildoers, children of depravity! They have forsaken the LORD; they have despised the Holy One of Israel and turned their backs on Him.
aov_text: Wee die sondige nasie, die volk swaar van skuld, die geslag van kwaaddoeners, die kinders wat verderflik handel! Hulle het die HERE verlaat, die Heilige van Israel verag, hulle het agtertoe weggedraai.

kjv_text: Why should ye be stricken any more? ye will revolt more and more: the whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.
bsb_text: Why do you want more beatings? Why do you keep rebelling? Your head has a massive wound, and your whole heart is afflicted.
aov_text: Waar wil julle nog geslaan word, dat julle voortgaan met af te wyk? Die hele hoof is siek, en die hele hart is krank.

kjv_text: From the sole of the foot even unto the head there is no soundness in it; but wounds, and bruises, and putrifying sores: they have not been closed, neither bound up, neither mollified with ointment.
bsb_text: From the sole of your foot to the top of your head, there is no soundness—only wounds and welts and festering sores neither cleansed nor bandaged nor soothed with oil.
aov_text: Van die voetsool af tot die hoof toe is daar geen heel plek aan nie, maar wonde en kwesplekke en vars houe! Hulle is nie uitgedruk of verbind of met olie versag nie.

kjv_text: Your country is desolate, your cities are burned with fire: your land, strangers devour it in your presence, and it is desolate, as overthrown by strangers.
bsb_text: Your land is desolate; your cities are burned with fire. Foreigners devour your fields before you—a desolation demolished by strangers.
aov_text: Julle land is ’n wildernis, julle stede is met vuur verbrand, vreemdes verteer julle landerye in jul teenwoordigheid, en dit is ’n wildernis soos by ’n omkering deur vreemdes.

kjv_text: And the daughter of Zion is left as a cottage in a vineyard, as a lodge in a garden of cucumbers, as a besieged city.
bsb_text: And the Daughter of Zion is abandoned like a shelter in a vineyard, like a shack in a cucumber field, like a city besieged.
aov_text: En die dogter van Sion het oorgebly soos ’n skermpie in ’n wingerd, soos ’n slaapplekkie in ’n komkommertuin, soos ’n beleërde stad.

kjv_text: Except the LORD of hosts had left unto us a very small remnant, we should have been as Sodom, and we should have been like unto Gomorrah.
bsb_text: Unless the LORD of Hosts had left us a few survivors, we would have become like Sodom, we would have resembled Gomorrah.
aov_text: As die HERE van die leërskare vir ons nie ’n klein oorblyfsel oorgelaat het nie—soos Sodom sou ons geword het, ons sou net soos Gomorra gewees het.

kjv_text: Hear the word of the LORD, ye rulers of Sodom; give ear unto the law of our God, ye people of Gomorrah.
bsb_text: Hear the word of the LORD, you rulers of Sodom; listen to the instruction of our God, you people of Gomorrah!
aov_text: Hoor die woord van die HERE, owerstes van Sodom! Luister na die wet van onse God, volk van Gomorra!

kjv_text: To what purpose is the multitude of your sacrifices unto me? saith the LORD: I am full of the burnt offerings of rams, and the fat of fed beasts; and I delight not in the blood of bullocks, or of lambs, or of he goats.
bsb_text: “What good to Me is your multitude of sacrifices?” says the LORD. “I am full from the burnt offerings of rams and the fat of well-fed cattle; I take no delight in the blood of bulls and lambs and goats.
aov_text: Wat het Ek aan die menigte van julle slagoffers? sê die HERE. Ek is sat van die brandoffers van ramme en die vet van vetgemaakte kalwers; en Ek het geen behae in die bloed van stiere of lammers of bokke nie.

kjv_text: When ye come to appear before me, who hath required this at your hand, to tread my courts?
bsb_text: When you come to appear before Me, who has required this of you—this trampling of My courts?
aov_text: As julle kom om voor my aangesig te verskyn, wie het dit van julle hand geëis—om my voorhowe te vertrap?

kjv_text: Bring no more vain oblations; incense is an abomination unto me; the new moons and sabbaths, the calling of assemblies, I cannot away with; it is iniquity, even the solemn meeting.
bsb_text: Bring your worthless offerings no more; your incense is detestable to Me—your New Moons, Sabbaths, and convocations. I cannot endure iniquity in a solemn assembly.
aov_text: Bring nie meer skynheilige offergawes nie; gruwelike reukwerk is dit vir My. Nuwemane en sabbatte, die uitroep van samekomste—Ek verdra geen ongeregtigheid en feestyd nie!

kjv_text: Your new moons and your appointed feasts my soul hateth: they are a trouble unto me; I am weary to bear them.
bsb_text: I hate your New Moons and your appointed feasts. They have become a burden to Me; I am weary of bearing them.
aov_text: Julle nuwemane en julle feestye haat my siel; hulle is My ’n oorlas. Ek is moeg om dit te dra.

kjv_text: And when ye spread forth your hands, I will hide mine eyes from you: yea, when ye make many prayers, I will not hear: your hands are full of blood.
bsb_text: When you spread out your hands in prayer, I will hide My eyes from you; even though you multiply your prayers, I will not listen. Your hands are covered with blood.
aov_text: En as julle jul hande uitbrei, bedek Ek my oë vir julle; ook as julle die gebed vermenigvuldig, luister Ek nie: julle hande is vol bloed.

kjv_text: Wash you, make you clean; put away the evil of your doings from before mine eyes; cease to do evil;
bsb_text: Wash and cleanse yourselves. Remove your evil deeds from My sight. Stop doing evil!
aov_text: Was julle, reinig julle, neem die boosheid van julle handelinge voor my oë weg, hou op om kwaad te doen,

kjv_text: Learn to do well; seek judgment, relieve the oppressed, judge the fatherless, plead for the widow.
bsb_text: Learn to do right; seek justice and correct the oppressor. Defend the fatherless and plead the case of the widow.”
aov_text: leer om goed te doen, soek die reg, beteuel die verdrukker, doen reg aan die wees, verdedig die saak van die weduwee.

kjv_text: Come now, and let us reason together, saith the LORD: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.
bsb_text: “Come now, let us reason together,” says the LORD. “Though your sins are like scarlet, they will be as white as snow; though they are as red as crimson, they will become like wool.
aov_text: Kom nou en laat ons die saak uitmaak, sê die HERE: al was julle sondes soos skarlaken, dit sal wit word soos sneeu; al was dit rooi soos purper, dit sal word soos wol.

kjv_text: If ye be willing and obedient, ye shall eat the good of the land:
bsb_text: If you are willing and obedient, you will eat the best of the land.
aov_text: As julle gewillig is en luister, sal julle die goeie van die land eet.

kjv_text: But if ye refuse and rebel, ye shall be devoured with the sword: for the mouth of the LORD hath spoken it.
bsb_text: But if you resist and rebel, you will be devoured by the sword.” For the mouth of the LORD has spoken.
aov_text: Maar as julle weier en wederstrewig is, sal julle deur die swaard geëet word; want die mond van die HERE het dit gespreek.

kjv_text: How is the faithful city become an harlot! it was full of judgment; righteousness lodged in it; but now murderers.
bsb_text: See how the faithful city has become a harlot! She once was full of justice; righteousness resided within her, but now only murderers!
aov_text: Ag, hoe het die getroue vesting ’n hoer geword! Dit was vol reg, geregtigheid het daarin vernag—en nou moordenaars!

kjv_text: Thy silver is become dross, thy wine mixed with water:
bsb_text: Your silver has become dross; your fine wine is diluted with water.
aov_text: Jou silwer het skuim geword; jou wyn is vervals met water.

kjv_text: Thy princes are rebellious, and companions of thieves: every one loveth gifts, and followeth after rewards: they judge not the fatherless, neither doth the cause of the widow come unto them.
bsb_text: Your rulers are rebels, friends of thieves. They all love bribes and chasing after rewards. They do not defend the fatherless, and the plea of the widow never comes before them.
aov_text: Jou vorste is opstandelinge en metgeselle van diewe; elkeen van hulle het omkoopgeskenke lief en jaag beloninge na. Aan die wees doen hulle geen reg nie, en die saak van die weduwee kom nie voor hulle nie.

kjv_text: Therefore saith the LORD, the LORD of hosts, the mighty One of Israel, Ah, I will ease me of mine adversaries, and avenge me of mine enemies:
bsb_text: Therefore the Lord GOD of Hosts, the Mighty One of Israel, declares: “Ah, I will be relieved of My foes and avenge Myself on My enemies.
aov_text: Daarom spreek die Here HERE van die leërskare, die Magtige van Israel: o Wee, Ek sal vir My voldoening verskaf van my teëstanders en My wreek op my vyande!

kjv_text: And I will turn my hand upon thee, and purely purge away thy dross, and take away all thy tin:
bsb_text: I will turn My hand against you; I will thoroughly purge your dross; I will remove all your impurities.
aov_text: En Ek sal my hand teen jou uitstrek en jou skuim soos met loog uitsuiwer en al jou looddele wegneem.

kjv_text: And I will restore thy judges as at the first, and thy counsellors as at the beginning: afterward thou shalt be called, The city of righteousness, the faithful city.
bsb_text: I will restore your judges as at first, and your counselors as at the beginning. After that you will be called the City of Righteousness, the Faithful City.”
aov_text: En Ek sal jou weer regters gee soos vroeër en raadsmanne soos in die begin; daarna sal jy ’n stad van geregtigheid, ’n getroue vesting genoem word.

kjv_text: Zion shall be redeemed with judgment, and her converts with righteousness.
bsb_text: Zion will be redeemed with justice, her repentant ones with righteousness.
aov_text: Sion sal deur strafgerig verlos word en die van hom wat terugkeer, deur geregtigheid.

kjv_text: And the destruction of the transgressors and of the sinners shall be together, and they that forsake the LORD shall be consumed.
bsb_text: But rebels and sinners will together be shattered, and those who forsake the LORD will perish.
aov_text: Maar daar sal verbreking wees van die oortreders en die sondaars almal saam; en die wat die HERE verlaat, sal omkom.

kjv_text: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which ye have desired, and ye shall be confounded for the gardens that ye have chosen.
bsb_text: Surely you will be ashamed of the sacred oaks in which you have delighted; you will be embarrassed by the gardens that you have chosen.
aov_text: Want hulle sal in die skande kom weens die terpentynbome waar julle behae in het, en julle sal rooi van skaamte word oor die tuine wat julle verkies het.

kjv_text: For ye shall be as an oak whose leaf fadeth, and as a garden that hath no water.
bsb_text: For you will become like an oak whose leaves are withered, like a garden without water.
aov_text: Want julle sal wees soos ’n terpentynboom waarvan die blare verdor, en soos ’n tuin wat geen water het nie.

kjv_text: And the strong shall be as tow, and the maker of it as a spark, and they shall both burn together, and none shall quench them.
bsb_text: The strong man will become tinder and his work will be a spark; both will burn together, with no one to quench the flames.
aov_text: En die sterke word tot vlas en sy werk tot ’n vonk, en hulle sal altwee tesame brand sonder dat iemand uitblus.

kjv_text: The word that Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.
bsb_text: This is the message that was revealed to Isaiah son of Amoz concerning Judah and Jerusalem:
aov_text: DIE woord wat Jesaja, die seun van Amos, gesien het met betrekking tot Juda en Jerusalem.
