kjv_text: And it shall come to pass in the last days, that the mountain of the LORD's house shall be established in the top of the mountains, and shall be exalted above the hills; and all nations shall flow unto it.
bsb_text: In the last days the mountain of the house of the LORD will be established as the chief of the mountains; it will be raised above the hills, and all nations will stream to it.
aov_text: En aan die einde van die dae sal die berg van die huis van die HERE vasstaan op die top van die berge en verhewe wees bo die heuwels, en al die nasies sal daarheen toestroom.

kjv_text: And many people shall go and say, Come ye, and let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.
bsb_text: And many peoples will come and say: “Come, let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the house of the God of Jacob. He will teach us His ways so that we may walk in His paths.” For the law will go forth from Zion, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.
aov_text: En baie volke sal heengaan en sê: Kom laat ons optrek na die berg van die HERE, na die huis van die God van Jakob, dat Hy ons sy weë kan leer en ons in sy paaie kan wandel. Want uit Sion sal die wet uitgaan en die woord van die HERE uit Jerusalem.

kjv_text: And he shall judge among the nations, and shall rebuke many people: and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
bsb_text: Then He will judge between the nations and arbitrate for many peoples. They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation will no longer take up the sword against nation, nor train anymore for war.
aov_text: En Hy sal oordeel tussen die nasies en regspreek oor baie volke; en hulle sal van hul swaarde pikke smee en van hul spiese snoeimesse; nie meer sal nasie teen nasie die swaard ophef nie, en hulle sal nie meer leer om oorlog te voer nie.

kjv_text: O house of Jacob, come ye, and let us walk in the light of the LORD.
bsb_text: Come, O house of Jacob, let us walk in the light of the LORD.
aov_text: Kom, huis van Jakob, en laat ons wandel in die lig van die HERE!

kjv_text: Therefore thou hast forsaken thy people the house of Jacob, because they be replenished from the east, and are soothsayers like the Philistines, and they please themselves in the children of strangers.
bsb_text: For You have abandoned Your people, the house of Jacob, because they are filled with influences from the east; they are soothsayers like the Philistines; they strike hands with the children of foreigners.
aov_text: Want U het u volk verwerp, die huis van Jakob, omdat hulle vol is van wat die Ooste aanbied, en van goëlaars soos die Filistyne, en met die kinders van vreemdes dryf hulle handel.

kjv_text: Their land also is full of silver and gold, neither is there any end of their treasures; their land is also full of horses, neither is there any end of their chariots:
bsb_text: Their land is full of silver and gold, with no limit to their treasures; their land is full of horses, with no limit to their chariots.
aov_text: En hulle land is vol silwer en goud, en daar is geen end aan hulle skatte nie; en hulle land is vol perde, en daar is geen end aan hulle strydwaens nie.

kjv_text: Their land also is full of idols; they worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made:
bsb_text: Their land is full of idols; they bow down to the work of their hands, to what their fingers have made.
aov_text: Ook is hulle land vol afgode; voor die werk van hul hande buig hulle hul neer, voor wat hulle vingers gemaak het.

kjv_text: And the mean man boweth down, and the great man humbleth himself: therefore forgive them not.
bsb_text: So mankind is brought low, and man is humbled—do not forgive them!
aov_text: So moet dan die mens neergebuig en die man verneder word; en U moet hulle dit nie vergewe nie.

kjv_text: Enter into the rock, and hide thee in the dust, for fear of the LORD, and for the glory of his majesty.
bsb_text: Go into the rocks and hide in the dust from the terror of the LORD and the splendor of His majesty.
aov_text: Gaan in die rots en steek jou weg in die grond vanweë die skrik van die HERE en om die heerlikheid van sy majesteit ontwil.

kjv_text: The lofty looks of man shall be humbled, and the haughtiness of men shall be bowed down, and the LORD alone shall be exalted in that day.
bsb_text: The proud look of man will be humbled, and the loftiness of men brought low; the LORD alone will be exalted in that day.
aov_text: Die hoë oë van die mense sal verneder word, en die hoogheid van die manne neergebuig word; en die HERE alleen sal in dié dag verhewe wees.

kjv_text: For the day of the LORD of hosts shall be upon every one that is proud and lofty, and upon every one that is lifted up; and he shall be brought low:
bsb_text: For the Day of the LORD of Hosts will come against all the proud and lofty, against all that is exalted—it will be humbled—
aov_text: Want ’n dag is daar vir die HERE van die leërskare oor al wat trots en hoog is, en oor al wat verhewe is, sodat dit verneder kan word;

kjv_text: And upon all the cedars of Lebanon, that are high and lifted up, and upon all the oaks of Bashan,
bsb_text: against all the cedars of Lebanon, lofty and lifted up, against all the oaks of Bashan,
aov_text: en oor al die hoë en verhewe seders van die Líbanon en oor al die eikebome van Basan;

kjv_text: And upon all the high mountains, and upon all the hills that are lifted up,
bsb_text: against all the tall mountains, against all the high hills,
aov_text: en oor al die hoë berge en oor al die verhewe heuwels;

kjv_text: And upon every high tower, and upon every fenced wall,
bsb_text: against every high tower, against every fortified wall,
aov_text: en oor al die hoë torings en oor al die versterkte mure;

kjv_text: And upon all the ships of Tarshish, and upon all pleasant pictures.
bsb_text: against every ship of Tarshish, and against every stately vessel.
aov_text: en oor al die skepe van Tarsis en oor al die kosbare pronkstukke.

kjv_text: And the loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the haughtiness of men shall be made low: and the LORD alone shall be exalted in that day.
bsb_text: So the pride of man will be brought low, and the loftiness of men will be humbled; the LORD alone will be exalted in that day,
aov_text: Dan sal die hoogheid van die mense neergebuig en die trotsheid van die manne verneder word; en die HERE alleen sal in dié dag verhewe wees.

kjv_text: And the idols he shall utterly abolish.
bsb_text: and the idols will vanish completely.
aov_text: En die afgode sal geheel en al verdwyn.

kjv_text: And they shall go into the holes of the rocks, and into the caves of the earth, for fear of the LORD, and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.
bsb_text: Men will flee to caves in the rocks and holes in the ground, away from the terror of the LORD and from the splendor of His majesty, when He rises to shake the earth.
aov_text: En hulle sal gaan in die spelonke van die rotse en in die gate van die grond vanweë die skrik van die HERE en om die heerlikheid van sy majesteit ontwil, as Hy Hom gereed maak om die aarde te verskrik.

kjv_text: In that day a man shall cast his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which they made each one for himself to worship, to the moles and to the bats;
bsb_text: In that day men will cast away to the moles and bats their idols of silver and gold—the idols they made to worship.
aov_text: In dié dag sal die mens sy silwerafgode en sy goue afgode wat hy vir hom gemaak het om voor neer te buig, weggooi vir die molle en die vlermuise;

kjv_text: To go into the clefts of the rocks, and into the tops of the ragged rocks, for fear of the LORD, and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.
bsb_text: They will flee to caverns in the rocks and crevices in the cliffs, away from the terror of the LORD and from the splendor of His majesty, when He rises to shake the earth.
aov_text: om te gaan in die skeure van die rotse en in die klowe van die kranse vanweë die skrik van die HERE en om die heerlikheid van sy majesteit ontwil, as Hy Hom gereed maak om die aarde te verskrik.

kjv_text: Cease ye from man, whose breath is in his nostrils: for wherein is he to be accounted of ?
bsb_text: Put no more trust in man, who has only the breath in his nostrils. Of what account is he?
aov_text: Laat staan tog die mens wie se asem in sy neus is; want hoe min is hy werd!

kjv_text: For, behold, the Lord, the LORD of hosts, doth take away from Jerusalem and from Judah the stay and the staff, the whole stay of bread, and the whole stay of water.
bsb_text: For behold, the Lord GOD of Hosts is about to remove from Jerusalem and Judah both supply and support: the whole supply of food and water,
aov_text: WANT kyk, die Here HERE van die leërskare sal uit Jerusalem en uit Juda wegneem die stut en die steun, elke stut van brood en elke stut van water,

kjv_text: The mighty man, and the man of war, the judge, and the prophet, and the prudent, and the ancient,
bsb_text: the mighty man and the warrior, the judge and the prophet, the soothsayer and the elder,
aov_text: die held en die krygsman, die regter en die profeet en die waarsêer en die oudste;

kjv_text: The captain of fifty, and the honourable man, and the counsellor, and the cunning artificer, and the eloquent orator.
bsb_text: the commander of fifty and the dignitary, the counselor, the cunning magician, and the clever enchanter.
aov_text: die owerste oor vyftig en die aansienlike en die raadsman en die knap ambagsman en die ervare besweerder.

kjv_text: And I will give children to be their princes, and babes shall rule over them.
bsb_text: “I will make mere lads their leaders, and children will rule over them.”
aov_text: En Ek sal seuns hulle vorste maak, en moedswilliges sal oor hulle heers.

kjv_text: And the people shall be oppressed, every one by another, and every one by his neighbour: the child shall behave himself proudly against the ancient, and the base against the honourable.
bsb_text: The people will oppress one another, man against man, neighbor against neighbor; the young will rise up against the old, and the base against the honorable.
aov_text: En die mense sal mekaar verdruk, man teen man, en die een teen die ander; die seun sal die grysaard, die veragtelike sal die agbare stormloop.

kjv_text: When a man shall take hold of his brother of the house of his father, saying, Thou hast clothing, be thou our ruler, and let this ruin be under thy hand:
bsb_text: A man will seize his brother within his father’s house: “You have a cloak—you be our leader! Take charge of this heap of rubble.”
aov_text: As ’n man sy broer aangryp in die huis van sy vader en sê: Jy het ’n kleed, jy moet owerste oor ons wees, en laat hierdie ingestorte puinhoop onder jou toesig wees —

kjv_text: In that day shall he swear, saying, I will not be an healer; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing: make me not a ruler of the people.
bsb_text: On that day he will cry aloud: “I am not a healer. I have no food or clothing in my house. Do not make me leader of the people!”
aov_text: dan sal hy in dié dag uitroep en sê: Ek kan geen geneesheer wees nie, en in my huis is geen brood en geen kleed nie; maak my nie ’n owerste van die volke nie.

kjv_text: For Jerusalem is ruined, and Judah is fallen: because their tongue and their doings are against the LORD, to provoke the eyes of his glory.
bsb_text: For Jerusalem has stumbled and Judah has fallen because they spoke and acted against the LORD, defying His glorious presence.
aov_text: Want Jerusalem het gestruikel, en Juda het geval; want hulle tong en hulle dade is teen die HERE om sy oë, vol heerlikheid, te trotseer.

kjv_text: The shew of their countenance doth witness against them; and they declare their sin as Sodom, they hide it not. Woe unto their soul! for they have rewarded evil unto themselves.
bsb_text: The expression on their faces testifies against them, and like Sodom they flaunt their sin; they do not conceal it. Woe to them, for they have brought disaster upon themselves.
aov_text: Die uitdrukking van hulle gesig getuig teen hulle, en hul sonde maak hulle bekend, soos Sodom, sonder om iets weg te steek. Wee oor hulle siel, want hulle doen hulself kwaad aan!

kjv_text: Say ye to the righteous, that it shall be well with him: for they shall eat the fruit of their doings.
bsb_text: Tell the righteous it will be well with them, for they will enjoy the fruit of their labor.
aov_text: Sê van die regverdige dat dit met hom goed sal gaan; want die vrug van hul handelinge sal hulle eet.

kjv_text: Woe unto the wicked! it shall be ill with him: for the reward of his hands shall be given him.
bsb_text: Woe to the wicked; disaster is upon them! For they will be repaid with what their hands have done.
aov_text: Wee die goddelose! Met hom gaan dit sleg; want wat sy hande gewerk het, sal hom aangedoen word.

kjv_text: As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them. O my people, they which lead thee cause thee to err, and destroy the way of thy paths.
bsb_text: Youths oppress My people, and women rule over them. O My people, your guides mislead you; they turn you from your paths.
aov_text: Die drywers van my volk is kinders, en vroue heers oor hulle. o My volk, jou leiers is verleiers, en die weg wat jou pad moes wees, het hulle tot ’n dwaalweg gemaak.

kjv_text: The LORD standeth up to plead, and standeth to judge the people.
bsb_text: The LORD arises to contend; He stands to judge the people.
aov_text: Die HERE staan daar om ’n regstryd te voer: Hy tree op om die volke te vonnis.

kjv_text: The LORD will enter into judgment with the ancients of his people, and the princes thereof: for ye have eaten up the vineyard; the spoil of the poor is in your houses.
bsb_text: The LORD brings this charge against the elders and leaders of His people: “You have devoured the vineyard; the plunder of the poor is in your houses.
aov_text: Die HERE gaan na die gereg met die oudstes en die vorste van sy volk. Ja, júlle het die wingerd afgewei; wat aan die arm man ontroof is, is in julle huise.

kjv_text: What mean ye that ye beat my people to pieces, and grind the faces of the poor? saith the Lord GOD of hosts.
bsb_text: Why do you crush My people and grind the faces of the poor?” declares the Lord GOD of Hosts.
aov_text: Wat is dit met julle dat julle my volk vertrap en die ellendiges mishandel? spreek die Here HERE van die leërskare.

kjv_text: Moreover the LORD saith, Because the daughters of Zion are haughty, and walk with stretched forth necks and wanton eyes, walking and mincing as they go, and making a tinkling with their feet:
bsb_text: The LORD also says: “Because the daughters of Zion are haughty—walking with heads held high and wanton eyes, prancing and skipping as they go, jingling the bracelets on their ankles—
aov_text: Verder het die HERE gesê: Omdat die dogters van Sion trots is en loop met uitgerekte nek en met die oë lok, wegstap met trippelgang en hulle voetringe laat rinkel,

kjv_text: Therefore the LORD will smite with a scab the crown of the head of the daughters of Zion, and the LORD will discover their secret parts.
bsb_text: the Lord will bring sores on the heads of the daughters of Zion, and the LORD will make their foreheads bare.”
aov_text: daarom sal die HERE die skedel van die dogters van Sion skurf maak, en die HERE sal hulle skaamte ontbloot.

kjv_text: In that day the Lord will take away the bravery of their tinkling ornaments about their feet, and their cauls, and their round tires like the moon,
bsb_text: In that day the Lord will take away their finery: their anklets and headbands and crescents;
aov_text: In dié dag sal die Here wegneem die sieraad van die voetringe en die sonnetjies en die maantjies;

kjv_text: The chains, and the bracelets, and the mufflers,
bsb_text: their pendants, bracelets, and veils;
aov_text: die oorversiersels en die armbande en die sluiers;

kjv_text: The bonnets, and the ornaments of the legs, and the headbands, and the tablets, and the earrings,
bsb_text: their headdresses, ankle chains, and sashes; their perfume bottles and charms;
aov_text: die hoofversiersels en die voetkettinkies en die pronkgordels en die reukflessies en die towermiddels;

kjv_text: The rings, and nose jewels,
bsb_text: their signet rings and nose rings;
aov_text: die vingerringe en die neusringe;

kjv_text: The changeable suits of apparel, and the mantles, and the wimples, and the crisping pins,
bsb_text: their festive robes, capes, cloaks, and purses;
aov_text: die feesklere en die manteltjies en die tjalies en die handsakkies;

kjv_text: The glasses, and the fine linen, and the hoods, and the vails.
bsb_text: and their mirrors, linen garments, tiaras, and shawls.
aov_text: die handspieëltjies en die hemde en die tulbande en die wye mantels.

kjv_text: And it shall come to pass, that instead of sweet smell there shall be stink; and instead of a girdle a rent; and instead of well set hair baldness; and instead of a stomacher a girding of sackcloth; and burning instead of beauty.
bsb_text: Instead of fragrance there will be a stench; instead of a belt, a rope; instead of styled hair, baldness; instead of fine clothing, sackcloth; instead of beauty, shame.
aov_text: Dan sal daar in plaas van balsemgeur mufheid wees, en in plaas van ’n gordel ’n tou, en in plaas van gevlegte hare kaalheid, en in plaas van ’n pronkgewaad ’n roukleed, brandmerk in plaas van skoonheid.

kjv_text: Thy men shall fall by the sword, and thy mighty in the war.
bsb_text: Your men will fall by the sword, and your warriors in battle.
aov_text: Jou manne, o Sion, sal deur die swaard val en jou helde in die oorlog.

kjv_text: And her gates shall lament and mourn; and she being desolate shall sit upon the ground.
bsb_text: And the gates of Zion will lament and mourn; destitute, she will sit on the ground.
aov_text: En sy poorte sal klaag en treur, en hy sal uitgeskud op die aarde sit.

kjv_text: And in that day seven women shall take hold of one man, saying, We will eat our own bread, and wear our own apparel: only let us be called by thy name, to take away our reproach.
bsb_text: In that day seven women will take hold of one man and say, “We will eat our own bread and provide our own clothes. Just let us be called by your name. Take away our disgrace!”
aov_text: EN in dié dag sal sewe vroue een man aangryp en sê: Ons eie brood sal ons eet en ons eie kleed aantrek; laat net jou naam oor ons genoem word, neem ons smaadheid weg.

kjv_text: In that day shall the branch of the LORD be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the earth shall be excellent and comely for them that are escaped of Israel.
bsb_text: On that day the Branch of the LORD will be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the land will be the pride and glory of Israel’s survivors.
aov_text: In dié dag sal die Spruit van die HERE wees tot sieraad en heerlikheid, en die vrug van die land tot hoogheid en versiering vir die vrygeraaktes van Israel.

kjv_text: And it shall come to pass, that he that is left in Zion, and he that remaineth in Jerusalem, shall be called holy, even every one that is written among the living in Jerusalem:
bsb_text: Whoever remains in Zion and whoever is left in Jerusalem will be called holy—all in Jerusalem who are recorded among the living—
aov_text: En wie in Sion oorgebly het en gespaar is in Jerusalem, dié sal heilig genoem word, elkeen wat onder die lewendes opgeskrywe is in Jerusalem —

kjv_text: When the Lord shall have washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion, and shall have purged the blood of Jerusalem from the midst thereof by the spirit of judgment, and by the spirit of burning.
bsb_text: when the Lord has washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion and cleansed the bloodstains from the heart of Jerusalem by a spirit of judgment and a spirit of fire.
aov_text: as die Here die onreinheid van die dogters van Sion afgewas en die bloedskulde van Jerusalem daaruit weggespoel het deur die Gees van strafgerig en die Gees van uitdelging.

kjv_text: And the LORD will create upon every dwelling place of mount Zion, and upon her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day, and the shining of a flaming fire by night: for upon all the glory shall be a defence.
bsb_text: Then the LORD will create over all of Mount Zion and over her assemblies a cloud of smoke by day and a glowing flame of fire by night. For over all the glory there will be a canopy,
aov_text: Dan skep die HERE oor elke woonplek van die berg Sion en oor sy plekke van samekoms ’n wolk bedags en rook met die glans van vuurvlamme in die nag; want oor alles wat heerlik is, sal daar ’n beskutting wees.

kjv_text: And there shall be a tabernacle for a shadow in the day time from the heat, and for a place of refuge, and for a covert from storm and from rain.
bsb_text: a shelter to give shade from the heat by day, and a refuge and hiding place from the storm and the rain.
aov_text: En daar sal ’n afdak wees vir ’n skaduwee bedags teen die hitte en vir ’n skuilplek en toevlug teen die stortbui en die reën.

kjv_text: Now will I sing to my wellbeloved a song of my beloved touching his vineyard. My wellbeloved hath a vineyard in a very fruitful hill:
bsb_text: I will sing for my beloved a song of his vineyard: My beloved had a vineyard on a very fertile hill.
aov_text: LAAT my tog sing van my Beminde; ’n lied van my Beminde oor sy wingerd! My Beminde het ’n wingerd op ’n vrugbare heuwel.

kjv_text: And he fenced it, and gathered out the stones thereof, and planted it with the choicest vine, and built a tower in the midst of it, and also made a winepress therein: and he looked that it should bring forth grapes, and it brought forth wild grapes.
bsb_text: He dug it up and cleared the stones and planted the finest vines. He built a watchtower in the middle and dug out a winepress as well. He waited for the vineyard to yield good grapes, but the fruit it produced was sour!
aov_text: En Hy het dit omgespit en die klippe daar uitgehaal en dit beplant met edel wingerdstokke; en Hy het ’n toring daar binne-in gebou en ook ’n parskuip daarin uitgekap; en Hy het verwag dat dit druiwe sou dra, maar dit het wilde druiwe voortgebring.

kjv_text: And now, O inhabitants of Jerusalem, and men of Judah, judge, I pray you, betwixt me and my vineyard.
bsb_text: “And now, O dwellers of Jerusalem and men of Judah, I exhort you to judge between Me and My vineyard.
aov_text: Nou dan, inwoners van Jerusalem en manne van Juda, oordeel tog tussen My en my wingerd.

kjv_text: What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it? wherefore, when I looked that it should bring forth grapes, brought it forth wild grapes?
bsb_text: What more could I have done for My vineyard than I already did for it? Why, when I expected sweet grapes, did it bring forth sour fruit?
aov_text: Wat is daar meer te doen aan my wingerd wat Ek daar nie aan gedoen het nie? Waarom het Ek verwag dat dit druiwe sou dra, en dit het wilde druiwe voortgebring?

kjv_text: And now go to; I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard: I will take away the hedge thereof, and it shall be eaten up; and break down the wall thereof, and it shall be trodden down:
bsb_text: Now I will tell you what I am about to do to My vineyard: I will take away its hedge, and it will be consumed; I will tear down its wall, and it will be trampled.
aov_text: Laat My julle dan nou te kenne gee wat Ek met my wingerd gaan doen: Ek sal sy doringheining wegneem, sodat dit verwoes word; Ek sal sy muur stukkend breek, sodat dit vertrap word.

kjv_text: And I will lay it waste: it shall not be pruned, nor digged; but there shall come up briers and thorns: I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain upon it.
bsb_text: I will make it a wasteland, neither pruned nor cultivated, and thorns and briers will grow up. I will command the clouds that rain shall not fall on it.”
aov_text: En Ek sal dit ’n wildernis maak: dit sal nie gesnoei of omgespit word nie, maar opskiet met dorings en distels; en Ek sal die wolke gebied om nie daarop te reën nie.

kjv_text: For the vineyard of the LORD of hosts is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah his pleasant plant: and he looked for judgment, but behold oppression; for righteousness, but behold a cry.
bsb_text: For the vineyard of the LORD of Hosts is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah are the plant of His delight. He looked for justice, but saw bloodshed; for righteousness, but heard a cry of distress.
aov_text: Want die wingerd van die HERE van die leërskare is die huis van Israel, en die manne van Juda is die tuin van sy verlustiging; en Hy het gewag op reg, maar kyk, dit was bloedvergieting; op geregtigheid, maar kyk, dit was geskreeu!

kjv_text: Woe unto them that join house to house, that lay field to field, till there be no place, that they may be placed alone in the midst of the earth!
bsb_text: Woe to you who add house to house and join field to field until no place is left and you live alone in the land.
aov_text: Wee hulle wat huis aan huis trek, akker aan akker voeg, totdat daar geen plek meer is nie, en julle alleen grondeienaars in die land is.

kjv_text: In mine ears said the LORD of hosts, Of a truth many houses shall be desolate, even great and fair, without inhabitant.
bsb_text: I heard the LORD of Hosts declare: “Surely many houses will become desolate, great mansions left unoccupied.
aov_text: In my ore het die HERE van die leërskare gespreek: Waarlik, baie huise sal ’n woesteny word, die grotes en mooies sonder inwoner.

kjv_text: Yea, ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, and the seed of an homer shall yield an ephah.
bsb_text: For ten acres of vineyard will yield but a bath of wine, and a homer of seed only an ephah of grain.”
aov_text: Want tien morg wingerd sal een enkele bat oplewer, en ’n homer saad sal ’n efa opbring.

kjv_text: Woe unto them that rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink; that continue until night, till wine inflame them!
bsb_text: Woe to those who rise early in the morning in pursuit of strong drink, who linger into the evening, to be inflamed by wine.
aov_text: Wee hulle wat vroeg in die môre klaarmaak om sterk drank na te jaag, wat in die nag láát opbly terwyl die wyn hulle verhit.

kjv_text: And the harp, and the viol, the tabret, and pipe, and wine, are in their feasts: but they regard not the work of the LORD, neither consider the operation of his hands.
bsb_text: At their feasts are the lyre and harp, tambourines and flutes and wine. They disregard the actions of the LORD and fail to see the work of His hands.
aov_text: En daar is siter en harp, tamboeryn en fluit en wyn by hulle maaltyd; maar op die dade van die HERE gee hulle geen ag nie, en die werk van sy hande sien hulle nie.

kjv_text: Therefore my people are gone into captivity, because they have no knowledge: and their honourable men are famished, and their multitude dried up with thirst.
bsb_text: Therefore My people will go into exile for their lack of understanding; their dignitaries are starving and their masses are parched with thirst.
aov_text: Daarom gaan my volk in ballingskap weens gebrek aan kennis, en hulle aansienlikes word hongerlyers en hulle menigte versmag van dors.

kjv_text: Therefore hell hath enlarged herself, and opened her mouth without measure: and their glory, and their multitude, and their pomp, and he that rejoiceth, shall descend into it.
bsb_text: Therefore Sheol enlarges its throat and opens wide its enormous jaws, and down go Zion’s nobles and masses, her revelers and carousers!
aov_text: Daarom het die doderyk sy keel wyd oopgemaak en sy mond uitgerek sonder maat, en daarin sink hulle adel en hulle menigte en hulle luidrugtigheid en diegene onder hulle wat uitgelate is.

kjv_text: And the mean man shall be brought down, and the mighty man shall be humbled, and the eyes of the lofty shall be humbled:
bsb_text: So mankind will be brought low, and each man humbled; the arrogant will lower their eyes.
aov_text: Dan word die mens gebuig en die man verneder, en die oë van die hoogmoedige mense word verneder.

kjv_text: But the LORD of hosts shall be exalted in judgment, and God that is holy shall be sanctified in righteousness.
bsb_text: But the LORD of Hosts will be exalted by His justice, and the holy God will show Himself holy in righteousness.
aov_text: Maar hoog sal die HERE van die leërskare wees deur die strafgerig, en die heilige God sal Hom as die Heilige laat ken deur geregtigheid.

kjv_text: Then shall the lambs feed after their manner, and the waste places of the fat ones shall strangers eat.
bsb_text: Lambs will graze as in their own pastures, and strangers will feed in the ruins of the wealthy.
aov_text: En daar sal lammers wei soos op hulle eie weiveld, en rondtrekkers sal die puinhope van die ryk mense laat afeet.

kjv_text: Woe unto them that draw iniquity with cords of vanity, and sin as it were with a cart rope:
bsb_text: Woe to those who draw iniquity with cords of deceit and pull sin along with cart ropes,
aov_text: Wee hulle wat die ongeregtigheid nader trek met koorde van goddeloosheid, en die sonde soos met wa-toue;

kjv_text: That say, Let him make speed, and hasten his work, that we may see it: and let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw nigh and come, that we may know it!
bsb_text: to those who say, “Let Him hurry and hasten His work so that we may see it! Let the plan of the Holy One of Israel come so that we may know it!”
aov_text: wat sê: Laat Hy gou maak, laat Hy sy werk verhaas, dat ons dit kan sien! En laat die raad van die Heilige van Israel naby wees en kom, dat ons dit kan ken!

kjv_text: Woe unto them that call evil good, and good evil; that put darkness for light, and light for darkness; that put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!
bsb_text: Woe to those who call evil good and good evil, who turn darkness to light and light to darkness, who replace bitter with sweet and sweet with bitter.
aov_text: Wee hulle wat sleg goed noem en goed sleg, wat die duisternis lig maak en die lig duisternis, wat bitter soet maak en soet bitter.

kjv_text: Woe unto them that are wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!
bsb_text: Woe to those who are wise in their own eyes and clever in their own sight.
aov_text: Wee hulle wat in eie oë wys en na eie oordeel verstandig is.

kjv_text: Woe unto them that are mighty to drink wine, and men of strength to mingle strong drink:
bsb_text: Woe to those who are heroes in drinking wine and champions in mixing strong drink,
aov_text: Wee hulle wat helde is om wyn te drink en wakker manne om sterk drank te meng;

kjv_text: Which justify the wicked for reward, and take away the righteousness of the righteous from him!
bsb_text: who acquit the guilty for a bribe and deprive the innocent of justice.
aov_text: wat vir ’n omkoopgeskenk die skuldige regverdig verklaar en die reg van die regverdige hom ontneem.

kjv_text: Therefore as the fire devoureth the stubble, and the flame consumeth the chaff, so their root shall be as rottenness, and their blossom shall go up as dust: because they have cast away the law of the LORD of hosts, and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel.
bsb_text: Therefore, as a tongue of fire consumes the straw, and as dry grass shrivels in the flame, so their roots will decay and their blossoms will blow away like dust; for they have rejected the instruction of the LORD of Hosts and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel.
aov_text: Daarom, soos die vuurtong stoppels verteer en droë gras in die vlam inmekaarsak, so sal hulle wortel soos poeier word en hulle uitspruitsel soos stof opstuiwe; omdat hulle die wet van die HERE van die leërskare verwerp het en die woord van die Heilige van Israel verag het.

kjv_text: Therefore is the anger of the LORD kindled against his people, and he hath stretched forth his hand against them, and hath smitten them: and the hills did tremble, and their carcases were torn in the midst of the streets. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
bsb_text: Therefore the anger of the LORD burns against His people; His hand is raised against them to strike them down. The mountains quake, and the corpses lay like refuse in the streets. Despite all this, His anger is not turned away; His hand is still upraised.
aov_text: Daarom het die toorn van die HERE ontvlam teen sy volk en het Hy sy hand teen hulle uitgestrek en hulle swaar getref, sodat die berge gebeef het en hulle lyke soos vuilnis op die strate was. Ondanks dit alles is sy toorn nie afgewend nie, maar is sy hand nog uitgestrek.

kjv_text: And he will lift up an ensign to the nations from far, and will hiss unto them from the end of the earth: and, behold, they shall come with speed swiftly:
bsb_text: He lifts a banner for the distant nations and whistles for those at the ends of the earth. Behold—how speedily and swiftly they come!
aov_text: En Hy sal ’n banier ophef vir die nasies in die verte, en Hy fluit vir dié volk daar aan die einde van die aarde; en kyk, gou, haastig kom hulle.

kjv_text: None shall be weary nor stumble among them; none shall slumber nor sleep; neither shall the girdle of their loins be loosed, nor the latchet of their shoes be broken:
bsb_text: None of them grows weary or stumbles; no one slumbers or sleeps. No belt is loose and no sandal strap is broken.
aov_text: Geen vermoeide en geen struikelende is onder hulle nie; hulle sluimer of slaap nie, en die gord van hulle heupe word nie losgemaak nie, en die riem van hulle skoene breek nie;

kjv_text: Whose arrows are sharp, and all their bows bent, their horses' hoofs shall be counted like flint, and their wheels like a whirlwind:
bsb_text: Their arrows are sharpened, and all their bows are strung. The hooves of their horses are like flint; their chariot wheels are like a whirlwind.
aov_text: wie se pyle skerp is en al hulle boë gespan; die pote van hulle perde is soos ’n klipsteen en hulle wiele soos ’n stormwind.

kjv_text: Their roaring shall be like a lion, they shall roar like young lions: yea, they shall roar, and lay hold of the prey, and shall carry it away safe, and none shall deliver it.
bsb_text: Their roaring is like that of a lion; they roar like young lions. They growl and seize their prey; they carry it away from deliverance.
aov_text: Hulle gebrul is soos dié van ’n leeuin, hulle brul soos jong leeus en maak gedreun en gryp die prooi en sleep weg sonder dat iemand red.

kjv_text: And in that day they shall roar against them like the roaring of the sea: and if one look unto the land, behold darkness and sorrow, and the light is darkened in the heavens thereof.
bsb_text: In that day they will roar over it, like the roaring of the sea. If one looks over the land, he will see darkness and distress; even the light will be obscured by clouds.
aov_text: En in dié dag sal dit oor hulle dreun soos die gedreun van die see. As iemand die aarde aanskou, kyk, daar is angsvolle duisternis; en die lig is verduister deur die wolke.

kjv_text: In the year that king Uzziah died I saw also the LORD sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up, and his train filled the temple.
bsb_text: In the year that King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord seated on a throne, high and exalted; and the train of His robe filled the temple.
aov_text: IN die sterfjaar van koning Ussía het ek die Here sien sit op ’n hoë en verhewe troon, terwyl sy some die tempel gevul het.

kjv_text: Above it stood the seraphims: each one had six wings; with twain he covered his face, and with twain he covered his feet, and with twain he did fly.
bsb_text: Above Him stood seraphim, each having six wings: With two wings they covered their faces, with two they covered their feet, and with two they were flying.
aov_text: Serafs het bo Hom gestaan; elkeen het ses vlerke gehad: met twee het hy sy aangesig bedek, en met twee het hy sy voete bedek, en met twee het hy gevlieg.

kjv_text: And one cried unto another, and said, Holy, holy, holy, is the LORD of hosts: the whole earth is full of his glory.
bsb_text: And they were calling out to one another: “Holy, holy, holy is the LORD of Hosts; all the earth is full of His glory.”

aov_text: DIE volk wat in duisternis wandel, het ’n groot lig gesien; die wat woon in die land van die doodskaduwee, oor hulle het ’n lig geskyn.

kjv_text: Thou hast multiplied the nation, and not increased the joy: they joy before thee according to the joy in harvest, and as men rejoice when they divide the spoil.
bsb_text: You have enlarged the nation and increased its joy. The people rejoice before You as they rejoice at harvest time, as men rejoice in dividing the plunder.
aov_text: U het die nasie vermenigvuldig, hulle vreugde groot gemaak; hulle is vrolik voor u aangesig soos iemand vrolik is in die oestyd, soos iemand juig as die buit verdeel word.

kjv_text: For thou hast broken the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, as in the day of Midian.
bsb_text: For as in the day of Midian You have shattered the yoke of their burden, the bar across their shoulders, and the rod of their oppressor.
aov_text: Want die juk wat op hulle gedruk het, en die stok wat hulle rug getref het, die roede van hulle drywer, het U verbreek soos op die dag van Mídian.

kjv_text: For every battle of the warrior is with confused noise, and garments rolled in blood; but this shall be with burning and fuel of fire.
bsb_text: For every trampling boot of battle and every garment rolled in blood will be burned as fuel for the fire.
aov_text: Want elke soldateskoen wat daar wegstap met gedreun, en die kleed wat in bloed gerol is, dien tot verbranding, ’n prooi van die vuur.

kjv_text: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.
bsb_text: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given, and the government will be upon His shoulders. And He will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.
aov_text: Want ’n Kind is vir ons gebore, ’n Seun is aan ons gegee; en die heerskappy is op sy skouer, en Hy word genoem: Wonderbaar, Raadsman, Sterke God, Ewige Vader, Vredevors —

kjv_text: Of the increase of his government and peace there shall be no end, upon the throne of David, and upon his kingdom, to order it, and to establish it with judgment and with justice from henceforth even for ever. The zeal of the LORD of hosts will perform this.
bsb_text: Of the increase of His government and peace there will be no end. He will reign on the throne of David and over his kingdom, to establish and sustain it with justice and righteousness from that time and forevermore. The zeal of the LORD of Hosts will accomplish this.
aov_text: tot vermeerdering van die heerskappy en tot vrede sonder einde, op die troon van Dawid en oor sy koninkryk, om dit te bevestig en dit te versterk deur reg en deur geregtigheid, van nou af tot in ewigheid. Die ywer van die HERE van die leërskare sal dit doen.

kjv_text: The Lord sent a word into Jacob, and it hath lighted upon Israel.
bsb_text: The Lord has sent a message against Jacob, and it has fallen upon Israel.
aov_text: DIE HERE stuur ’n woord in Jakob, en dit val in Israel;

kjv_text: And all the people shall know, even Ephraim and the inhabitant of Samaria, that say in the pride and stoutness of heart,
bsb_text: All the people will know it—Ephraim and the dwellers of Samaria. With pride and arrogance of heart they will say:
aov_text: en die hele volk sal dit gewaarword, Efraim en die inwoners van Samaría, wat in trotsheid en grootsheid van hart sê:

kjv_text: The bricks are fallen down, but we will build with hewn stones: the sycomores are cut down, but we will change them into cedars.
bsb_text: “The bricks have fallen, but we will rebuild with finished stone; the sycamores have been felled, but we will replace them with cedars.”
aov_text: Die bakstene het geval, maar met gekapte klip sal ons bou; die wildevyebome is afgekap, maar ons sal seders in hulle plek neem!

kjv_text: Therefore the LORD shall set up the adversaries of Rezin against him, and join his enemies together;
bsb_text: The LORD has raised up the foes of Rezin against him and joined his enemies together.
aov_text: Maar die HERE gee aan die teëstanders van Resin die oorhand oor hulle, en hulle vyande sal Hy ophits:

kjv_text: The Syrians before, and the Philistines behind; and they shall devour Israel with open mouth. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
bsb_text: Aram from the east and Philistia from the west have devoured Israel with open mouths. Despite all this, His anger is not turned away; His hand is still upraised.
aov_text: die Arameërs van voor en die Filistyne van agter, dat hulle Israel met volle mond kan opeet. Ondanks dit alles is sy toorn nie afgewend nie, maar sy hand is nog uitgestrek.

kjv_text: For the people turneth not unto him that smiteth them, neither do they seek the LORD of hosts.
bsb_text: But the people did not return to Him who struck them; they did not seek the LORD of Hosts.
aov_text: Maar die volk bekeer hulle nie tot Hom wat hulle slaan nie, en hulle soek nie die HERE van die leërskare nie.

kjv_text: Therefore the LORD will cut off from Israel head and tail, branch and rush, in one day.
bsb_text: So the LORD will cut off Israel’s head and tail, both palm branch and reed in a single day.
aov_text: Daarom sny die HERE van Israel af kop en stert, palmtak en biesie, op een dag.

kjv_text: The ancient and honourable, he is the head; and the prophet that teacheth lies, he is the tail.
bsb_text: The head is the elder and honorable man, and the tail is the prophet who teaches lies.
aov_text: Die oudste en aansienlike, dié is die kop, en die profeet wat leuens profeteer, dié is die stert;

kjv_text: For the leaders of this people cause them to err; and they that are led of them are destroyed.
bsb_text: For those who guide this people mislead them, and those they mislead are swallowed up.
aov_text: en die leiers van hierdie volk het verleiers geword, en dié van hulle wat gelei word, is op ’n dwaalweg gebring.

kjv_text: Therefore the LORD shall have no joy in their young men, neither shall have mercy on their fatherless and widows: for every one is an hypocrite and an evildoer, and every mouth speaketh folly. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
bsb_text: Therefore the Lord takes no pleasure in their young men; He has no compassion on their fatherless and widows. For every one of them is godless and wicked, and every mouth speaks folly. Despite all this, His anger is not turned away; His hand is still upraised.
aov_text: Daarom sal die Here oor hulle jongmanne nie bly wees nie en Hom nie ontferm oor hulle wese en hulle weduwees nie; want hulle is almal roekelose mense en kwaaddoeners, en elke mond spreek goddeloosheid. Ondanks dit alles is sy toorn nie afgewend nie, maar sy hand is nog uitgestrek.

kjv_text: For wickedness burneth as the fire: it shall devour the briers and thorns, and shall kindle in the thickets of the forest, and they shall mount up like the lifting up of smoke.
bsb_text: For wickedness burns like a fire that consumes the thorns and briers and kindles the forest thickets which roll upward in billows of smoke.
aov_text: Want die goddeloosheid brand soos vuur; dit verteer dorings en distels en steek die digte takke van die bos aan die brand, sodat hulle in ’n rookpilaar opstyg.

kjv_text: Through the wrath of the LORD of hosts is the land darkened, and the people shall be as the fuel of the fire: no man shall spare his brother.
bsb_text: By the wrath of the LORD of Hosts the land is scorched, and the people are fuel for the fire. No man even spares his brother.
aov_text: Deur die grimmigheid van die HERE van die leërskare staan die land in vlamme en het die volk geword soos ’n prooi van die vuur; die een spaar die ander nie.

kjv_text: And he shall snatch on the right hand, and be hungry; and he shall eat on the left hand, and they shall not be satisfied: they shall eat every man the flesh of his own arm:
bsb_text: They carve out what is on the right, but they are still hungry; they eat what is on the left, but they are still not satisfied. Each one devours the flesh of his own offspring.
aov_text: En hulle byt na regs en het honger; hulle vreet na links en word nie versadig nie; hulle eet elkeen die vlees van sy eie arm:

kjv_text: Manasseh, Ephraim; and Ephraim, Manasseh: and they together shall be against Judah. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
bsb_text: Manasseh devours Ephraim, and Ephraim Manasseh; together they turn against Judah. Despite all this, His anger is not turned away; His hand is still upraised.
aov_text: Manasse vir Efraim, en Efraim vir Manasse, en hulle saam is teen Juda. Ondanks dit alles is sy toorn nie afgewend nie, maar sy hand is nog uitgestrek.

kjv_text: Woe unto them that decree unrighteous decrees, and that write grievousness which they have prescribed;
bsb_text: Woe to those who enact unjust statutes and issue oppressive decrees,
aov_text: WEE hulle wat heillose insettinge tot wet maak, en die skrywers wat moeite ywerig voorskrywe,

kjv_text: To turn aside the needy from judgment, and to take away the right from the poor of my people, that widows may be their prey, and that they may rob the fatherless!
bsb_text: to deprive the poor of fair treatment and withhold justice from the oppressed of My people, to make widows their prey and orphans their plunder.
aov_text: om die armes van die gereg weg te stoot en om die ellendiges onder my volk van die reg te beroof, sodat die weduwees hulle buit kan word en hulle die wese kan plunder.

kjv_text: And what will ye do in the day of visitation, and in the desolation which shall come from far? to whom will ye flee for help? and where will ye leave your glory?
bsb_text: What will you do on the day of reckoning when devastation comes from afar? To whom will you flee for help? Where will you leave your wealth?
aov_text: Maar wat sal julle doen op die dag van besoeking en by die verwoesting wat van ver af sal kom? Na wie sal julle vlug om hulp, en waar julle rykdom wegbêre?

kjv_text: Without me they shall bow down under the prisoners, and they shall fall under the slain. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
bsb_text: Nothing will remain but to crouch among the captives or fall among the slain. Despite all this, His anger is not turned away; His hand is still upraised.
aov_text: Hulle kan net maar buig soos geboeides en val soos diegene wat gedood is. Ondanks dit alles is sy toorn nie afgewend nie, maar sy hand is nog uitgestrek.

kjv_text: O Assyrian, the rod of mine anger, and the staff in their hand is mine indignation.
bsb_text: Woe to Assyria, the rod of My anger; the staff in their hands is My wrath.
aov_text: WEE Assur! die roede van my toorn en ’n stok is hy—in hulle hand is my grimmigheid!

kjv_text: I will send him against an hypocritical nation, and against the people of my wrath will I give him a charge, to take the spoil, and to take the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.
bsb_text: I will send him against a godless nation; I will dispatch him against a people destined for My rage, to take spoils and seize plunder, and to trample them down like clay in the streets.
aov_text: Ek sal hom stuur teen ’n roekelose nasie, en Ek sal hom bevel gee teen die volk van my grimmigheid, om buit te maak en roof in te samel en om hulle tot ’n vertrapping te maak soos modder van die strate.

kjv_text: Howbeit he meaneth not so, neither doth his heart think so; but it is in his heart to destroy and cut off nations not a few.
bsb_text: But this is not his intention; this is not his plan. For it is in his heart to destroy and cut off many nations.
aov_text: Maar hý bedoel dit nie so nie, en sy hart dink nie so nie; maar om te verdelg, is in sy hart, en om nasies uit te roei, nie min nie.

kjv_text: For he saith, Are not my princes altogether kings?
bsb_text: “Are not all my commanders kings?” he says.
aov_text: Want hy sê: Is my vorste nie almal saam konings nie?

kjv_text: Is not Calno as Carchemish? is not Hamath as Arpad? is not Samaria as Damascus?
bsb_text: “Is not Calno like Carchemish? Is not Hamath like Arpad? Is not Samaria like Damascus?
aov_text: Het dit met Kalno nie gegaan soos met Kárkemis, met Hamat soos met Arpad, met Samaría soos met Damaskus nie?

kjv_text: As my hand hath found the kingdoms of the idols, and whose graven images did excel them of Jerusalem and of Samaria;
bsb_text: As my hand seized the idolatrous kingdoms whose images surpassed those of Jerusalem and Samaria,
aov_text: Soos my hand die koninkryke van die afgode bereik het, alhoewel hulle gesnede beelde meer was as dié van Jerusalem en Samaría,

kjv_text: Shall I not, as I have done unto Samaria and her idols, so do to Jerusalem and her idols?
bsb_text: and as I have done to Samaria and its idols, will I not also do to Jerusalem and her idols?”
aov_text: sou ek nie, soos ek aan Samaría en sy afgode gedoen het, net so aan Jerusalem en sy afgode kan doen nie?

kjv_text: Wherefore it shall come to pass, that when the Lord hath performed his whole work upon mount Zion and on Jerusalem, I will punish the fruit of the stout heart of the king of Assyria, and the glory of his high looks.
bsb_text: So when the Lord has completed all His work against Mount Zion and Jerusalem, He will say, “I will punish the king of Assyria for the fruit of his arrogant heart and the proud look in his eyes.
aov_text: Maar as die Here al sy werk voltooi het op die berg Sion en in Jerusalem, dan sal Ek besoeking doen oor die vrug van die grootsheid van die hart van Assirië se koning en oor die gepraal van sy hoë oë.

kjv_text: For he saith, By the strength of my hand I have done it, and by my wisdom; for I am prudent: and I have removed the bounds of the people, and have robbed their treasures, and I have put down the inhabitants like a valiant man:
bsb_text: For he says: ‘By the strength of my hand I have done this, and by my wisdom, for I am clever. I have removed the boundaries of nations and plundered their treasures; like a mighty one I subdued their rulers.
aov_text: Want hy sê: Deur die krag van my hand het ek dit gedoen en deur my wysheid, want ek is verstandig; en die grense van die volke het ek verwyder, en hulle voorrade het ek geplunder; en die wat op trone sit, het ek soos ’n maghebber neergewerp.

kjv_text: And my hand hath found as a nest the riches of the people: and as one gathereth eggs that are left, have I gathered all the earth; and there was none that moved the wing, or opened the mouth, or peeped.
bsb_text: My hand reached as into a nest to seize the wealth of the nations. Like one gathering abandoned eggs, I gathered all the earth. No wing fluttered, no beak opened or chirped.’”
aov_text: En my hand het na die rykdom van die volke gegryp soos na ’n voëlnes, en ék het die hele aarde bymekaargeskraap soos ’n mens eiers bymekaarskraap wat verlaat is; en daar was niemand wat ’n vlerk verroer of ’n bek oopgemaak of gepiep het nie.

kjv_text: Shall the axe boast itself against him that heweth therewith? or shall the saw magnify itself against him that shaketh it? as if the rod should shake itself against them that lift it up, or as if the staff should lift up itself, as if it were no wood.
bsb_text: Does an axe raise itself above the one who swings it? Does a saw boast over him who saws with it? It would be like a rod waving the one who lifts it, or a staff lifting him who is not wood!
aov_text: Kan die byl hom beroem teen die wat daarmee kap, of die saag spog teen hom wat dit trek? Asof ’n staf húlle swaai wat hom ophef, asof ’n stok hóm ophef wat nie hout is nie!

kjv_text: Therefore shall the Lord, the Lord of hosts, send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory he shall kindle a burning like the burning of a fire.
bsb_text: Therefore the Lord GOD of Hosts will send a wasting disease among Assyria’s stout warriors, and under his pomp will be kindled a fire like a burning flame.
aov_text: Daarom sal die Here HERE van die leërskare onder sy vettes ’n maerte stuur; en onder sy heerlikheid sal Hy ’n brand laat uitslaan soos die brand van vuur.

kjv_text: And the light of Israel shall be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame: and it shall burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day;
bsb_text: And the Light of Israel will become a fire, and its Holy One a flame. In a single day it will burn and devour Assyria’s thorns and thistles.
aov_text: En die Lig van Israel sal ’n vuur wees, en sy Heilige ’n vlam; en dit sal sy distels en sy dorings verbrand en verteer op een dag.

kjv_text: And shall consume the glory of his forest, and of his fruitful field, both soul and body: and they shall be as when a standard-bearer fainteth.
bsb_text: The splendor of its forests and orchards, both soul and body, it will completely destroy, as a sickness consumes a man.
aov_text: Ook sal Hy die heerlikheid van sy bos en van sy vrugteboord verteer, van die siel af tot die vlees toe, sodat dit is soos wanneer ’n kranke wegkwyn.

kjv_text: And the rest of the trees of his forest shall be few, that a child may write them.
bsb_text: The remaining trees of its forests will be so few that a child could count them.
aov_text: En die oorblyfsel van die bome van sy bos sal min in getal wees, en ’n seuntjie sal hulle kan opskrywe.

kjv_text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the remnant of Israel, and such as are escaped of the house of Jacob, shall no more again stay upon him that smote them; but shall stay upon the LORD, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.
bsb_text: On that day the remnant of Israel and the survivors of the house of Jacob will no longer depend on him who struck them, but they will truly rely on the LORD, the Holy One of Israel.
aov_text: En in dié dag sal die oorblyfsel van Israel en die wat ontvlug het van die huis van Jakob, nie meer voortgaan om te steun op hom wat hulle slaan nie; maar hulle sal steun op die HERE, die Heilige van Israel, in opregtheid.

kjv_text: The remnant shall return, even the remnant of Jacob, unto the mighty God.
bsb_text: A remnant will return—a remnant of Jacob—to the Mighty God.
aov_text: Die oorblyfsel sal terugkom, die oorblyfsel van Jakob na die sterke God toe.

kjv_text: For though thy people Israel be as the sand of the sea, yet a remnant of them shall return: the consumption decreed shall overflow with righteousness.
bsb_text: Though your people, O Israel, be like the sand of the sea, only a remnant will return. Destruction has been decreed, overflowing with righteousness.
aov_text: Want al was jou volk, o Israel, soos die sand van die see, net ’n oorblyfsel van hulle sal terugkom; die verdelging is vas besluit en vloei oor van geregtigheid.

kjv_text: For the Lord GOD of hosts shall make a consumption, even determined, in the midst of all the land.
bsb_text: For the Lord GOD of Hosts will carry out the destruction decreed upon the whole land.
aov_text: Want ’n verdelging wat vas besluit is, sal die Here HERE van die leërskare voltrek in die midde van die hele aarde.

kjv_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD of hosts, O my people that dwellest in Zion, be not afraid of the Assyrian: he shall smite thee with a rod, and shall lift up his staff against thee, after the manner of Egypt.
bsb_text: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD of Hosts says: “O My people who dwell in Zion, do not fear Assyria, who strikes you with a rod and lifts his staff against you as the Egyptians did.
aov_text: Daarom, so sê die Here HERE van die leërskare: o My volk wat in Sion woon, wees nie bevrees vir Assur wat jou met die staf slaan en sy stok teen jou ophef op die manier van Egipte nie.

kjv_text: For yet a very little while, and the indignation shall cease, and mine anger in their destruction.
bsb_text: For in just a little while My fury against you will subside, and My anger will turn to their destruction.”
aov_text: Want nog ’n baie kort rukkie, dan is die grimmigheid ten einde, en my toorn gaan uit om húlle te vernietig.

kjv_text: And the LORD of hosts shall stir up a scourge for him according to the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb: and as his rod was upon the sea, so shall he lift it up after the manner of Egypt.
bsb_text: And the LORD of Hosts will brandish a whip against them, as when He struck Midian at the rock of Oreb. He will raise His staff over the sea, as He did in Egypt.
aov_text: En die HERE van die leërskare sal oor hom die gésel swaai soos Mídian verslaan is by die rots Oreb; en sy staf sal wees oor die see, en Hy sal dit ophef op die manier van Egipte.

kjv_text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that his burden shall be taken away from off thy shoulder, and his yoke from off thy neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing.
bsb_text: On that day the burden will be lifted from your shoulders, and the yoke from your neck. The yoke will be broken because your neck will be too large.
aov_text: En in dié dag sal sy las afgly van jou skouer en sy juk van jou nek, en die juk sal tot niet raak vanweë die vettigheid.

kjv_text: He is come to Aiath, he is passed to Migron; at Michmash he hath laid up his carriages:
bsb_text: Assyria has entered Aiath and passed through Migron, storing their supplies at Michmash.
aov_text: Hy oorval Ajat; hy trek deur Migron; in Migmas laat hy sy pakgoed agterbly.

kjv_text: They are gone over the passage: they have taken up their lodging at Geba; Ramah is afraid; Gibeah of Saul is fled.
bsb_text: They have crossed at the ford: “We will spend the night at Geba.” Ramah trembles; Gibeah of Saul flees.
aov_text: Hulle trek oor die nek. Laat Geba ons nagverblyf wees! Rama bewe, Gíbea van Saul vlug.

kjv_text: Lift up thy voice, O daughter of Gallim: cause it to be heard unto Laish, O poor Anathoth.
bsb_text: Cry aloud, O Daughter of Gallim! Listen, O Laishah! O wretched Anathoth!
aov_text: Skreeu dit uit, dogter van Gallim! Luister, Lais! Arme Ánatot!

kjv_text: Madmenah is removed; the inhabitants of Gebim gather themselves to flee.
bsb_text: Madmenah flees; the people of Gebim take refuge.
aov_text: Madména vlug, die inwoners van Gebim soek skuiling!

kjv_text: As yet shall he remain at Nob that day: he shall shake his hand against the mount of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.
bsb_text: Yet today they will halt at Nob, shaking a fist at the mount of Daughter Zion, at the hill of Jerusalem.
aov_text: Nog vandag staan hy in Nob, hy swaai sy hand teen die berg van die dogter van Sion, teen die heuwel van Jerusalem!

kjv_text: Behold, the Lord, the LORD of hosts, shall lop the bough with terror: and the high ones of stature shall be hewn down, and the haughty shall be humbled.
bsb_text: Behold, the Lord GOD of Hosts will lop off the branches with terrifying power. The tall trees will be cut down, the lofty ones will be felled.
aov_text: Maar kyk, die Here HERE van die leërskare slaan met skrikwekkende geweld die takke af, en die hoog uitgegroeides word omgekap en die verhewenes neergegooi;

kjv_text: And he shall cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, and Lebanon shall fall by a mighty one.
bsb_text: He will clear the forest thickets with an axe, and Lebanon will fall before the Mighty One.
aov_text: en Hy sal die digte takke van die bos met die yster omkap, en die Líbanon sal val deur die Heerlike.

kjv_text: And there shall come forth a rod out of the stem of Jesse, and a Branch shall grow out of his roots:
bsb_text: Then a shoot will spring up from the stump of Jesse, and a Branch from his roots will bear fruit.
aov_text: MAAR daar sal ’n takkie uitspruit uit die stomp van Ísai, en ’n loot uit sy wortels sal vrugte dra;

kjv_text: And the spirit of the LORD shall rest upon him, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the LORD;
bsb_text: The Spirit of the LORD will rest on Him—the Spirit of wisdom and understanding, the Spirit of counsel and strength, the Spirit of knowledge and fear of the LORD.
aov_text: en op Hom sal die Gees van die HERE rus, die Gees van wysheid en verstand, die Gees van raad en sterkte, die Gees van kennis en van die vrees van die HERE.

kjv_text: And shall make him of quick understanding in the fear of the LORD: and he shall not judge after the sight of his eyes, neither reprove after the hearing of his ears:
bsb_text: And He will delight in the fear of the LORD. He will not judge by what His eyes see, and He will not decide by what His ears hear,
aov_text: En Hy het ’n welgevalle aan die vrees van die HERE; en Hy sal nie regspreek na wat sy oë sien nie, en nie oordeel na wat sy ore hoor nie;

kjv_text: But with righteousness shall he judge the poor, and reprove with equity for the meek of the earth: and he shall smite the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips shall he slay the wicked.
bsb_text: but with righteousness He will judge the poor, and with equity He will decide for the lowly of the earth. He will strike the earth with the rod of His mouth and slay the wicked with the breath of His lips.
aov_text: maar aan die armes sal Hy in geregtigheid reg doen en die sagmoediges van die land met billikheid oordeel; maar Hy sal die aarde slaan met die roede van sy mond en met die asem van sy lippe die goddelose doodmaak.

kjv_text: And righteousness shall be the girdle of his loins, and faithfulness the girdle of his reins.
bsb_text: Righteousness will be the belt around His hips, and faithfulness the sash around His waist.
aov_text: En geregtigheid sal die gordel van sy lendene en trou die gordel van sy heupe wees.

kjv_text: The wolf also shall dwell with the lamb, and the leopard shall lie down with the kid; and the calf and the young lion and the fatling together; and a little child shall lead them.
bsb_text: The wolf will live with the lamb, and the leopard will lie down with the goat; the calf and young lion and fatling will be together, and a little child will lead them.
aov_text: Dan wei die wolf by die lam, en die luiperd gaan lê by die bokkie, en die kalf en die jong leeu en die vetgemaakte vee bymekaar, en ’n klein seuntjie sal hulle aanja.

kjv_text: And the cow and the bear shall feed; their young ones shall lie down together: and the lion shall eat straw like the ox.
bsb_text: The cow will graze with the bear, their young will lie down together, and the lion will eat straw like the ox.
aov_text: Die koei en die berin wei, en hulle kleintjies lê bymekaar; en die leeu eet strooi soos die os;

kjv_text: And the sucking child shall play on the hole of the asp, and the weaned child shall put his hand on the cockatrice' den.
bsb_text: The infant will play by the cobra’s den, and the toddler will reach into the viper’s nest.
aov_text: en die suigling speel by die gat van ’n adder, en die gespeende kind steek sy hand uit na die kuil van ’n basilisk.

kjv_text: They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain: for the earth shall be full of the knowledge of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea.
bsb_text: They will neither harm nor destroy on all My holy mountain, for the earth will be full of the knowledge of the LORD as the sea is full of water.
aov_text: Hulle sal geen kwaad doen of verderf aanrig op my hele heilige berg nie; want die aarde sal vol wees van die kennis van die HERE soos die waters die seebodem oordek.

kjv_text: And in that day there shall be a root of Jesse, which shall stand for an ensign of the people; to it shall the Gentiles seek: and his rest shall be glorious.
bsb_text: On that day the Root of Jesse will stand as a banner for the peoples. The nations will seek Him, and His place of rest will be glorious.
aov_text: En in dié dag sal die nasies vra na die wortel van Ísai, wat daar staan as ’n banier van die volke, en sy rusplek sal heerlik wees.

kjv_text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria, and from Egypt, and from Pathros, and from Cush, and from Elam, and from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.
bsb_text: On that day the Lord will extend His hand a second time to recover the remnant of His people from Assyria, from Egypt, from Pathros, from Cush, from Elam, from Shinar, from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.
aov_text: En in dié dag sal die Here weer vir die tweede keer sy hand uitstrek, om die oorblyfsel van sy volk los te koop wat sal oorbly uit Assirië en Egipte en Patros en Kus en Elam en Sínear en Hamat en uit die kuslande van die see;

kjv_text: And he shall set up an ensign for the nations, and shall assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.
bsb_text: He will raise a banner for the nations and gather the exiles of Israel; He will collect the scattered of Judah from the four corners of the earth.
aov_text: en Hy sal ’n banier ophef vir die nasies en bymekaar laat kom die seuns van Israel wat verdryf is, en versamel die dogters van Juda wat verstrooi is, uit die vier hoeke van die aarde.

kjv_text: The envy also of Ephraim shall depart, and the adversaries of Judah shall be cut off: Ephraim shall not envy Judah, and Judah shall not vex Ephraim.
bsb_text: Then the jealousy of Ephraim will depart, and the adversaries of Judah will be cut off. Ephraim will no longer envy Judah, nor will Judah harass Ephraim.
aov_text: Dan sal die naywer van Efraim verdwyn, en die teëstanders van Juda sal uitgeroei word; Efraim sal Juda nie beny nie, en Juda sal Efraim nie benoud maak nie.

kjv_text: But they shall fly upon the shoulders of the Philistines toward the west; they shall spoil them of the east together: they shall lay their hand upon Edom and Moab; and the children of Ammon shall obey them.
bsb_text: They will swoop down on the slopes of the Philistines to the west; together they will plunder the sons of the east. They will lay their hands on Edom and Moab, and the Ammonites will be subject to them.
aov_text: Maar hulle sal die Filistyne op die skouer vlieg teen die weste en saam die kinders van die Ooste plunder; Edom en Moab is die buit van hulle hand, en die kinders van Ammon is hulle onderdanig.

kjv_text: And the LORD shall utterly destroy the tongue of the Egyptian sea; and with his mighty wind shall he shake his hand over the river, and shall smite it in the seven streams, and make men go over dryshod.
bsb_text: The LORD will devote to destruction the gulf of the Sea of Egypt; with a scorching wind He will sweep His hand over the Euphrates. He will split it into seven streams for men to cross with dry sandals.
aov_text: En die HERE sal die seetong van Egipte met die banvloek tref en deur sy gloeiende wind sy hand oor die Eufraat swaai en dit uitmekaar slaan in sewe strome, sodat ’n mens met skoene daardeur kan loop.

kjv_text: And there shall be an highway for the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria; like as it was to Israel in the day that he came up out of the land of Egypt.
bsb_text: There will be a highway for the remnant of His people who remain from Assyria, as there was for Israel when they came up from the land of Egypt.
aov_text: En daar sal ’n grootpad wees vir die oorblyfsel van sy volk wat oorbly uit Assur, soos daar een gewees het vir Israel op die dag toe hulle uit Egipteland opgetrek het.

kjv_text: And in that day thou shalt say, O LORD, I will praise thee: though thou wast angry with me, thine anger is turned away, and thou comfortedst me.
bsb_text: In that day you will say: “O LORD, I will praise You. Although You were angry with me, Your anger has turned away, and You have comforted me.
aov_text: EN in dié dag sal jy sê: Ek dank U, HERE, dat U toornig op my gewees het; u toorn is afgewend, en U het my vertroos.

kjv_text: Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and not be afraid: for the LORD JEHOVAH is my strength and my song; he also is become my salvation.
bsb_text: Surely God is my salvation; I will trust and not be afraid. For the LORD GOD is my strength and my song, and He also has become my salvation.”
aov_text: Ja, God is my heil, ek sal vertrou en nie vrees nie; want die HERE HERE is my krag en my psalm, en Hy het my tot heil geword.

kjv_text: Therefore with joy shall ye draw water out of the wells of salvation.
bsb_text: With joy you will draw water from the springs of salvation,
aov_text: En julle sal water skep met vreugde uit die fonteine van heil.

kjv_text: And in that day shall ye say, Praise the LORD, call upon his name, declare his doings among the people, make mention that his name is exalted.
bsb_text: and on that day you will say: “Give praise to the LORD; proclaim His name! Make His works known among the peoples; declare that His name is exalted.
aov_text: En julle sal in dié dag sê: Dank die HERE, roep sy Naam aan, maak sy dade onder die volke bekend, verkondig dat sy Naam hoog is!

kjv_text: Sing unto the LORD; for he hath done excellent things: this is known in all the earth.
bsb_text: Sing to the LORD, for He has done glorious things. Let this be known in all the earth.
aov_text: Psalmsing tot eer van die HERE, want Hy het heerlike dinge gedoen; laat dit bekend wees op die hele aarde.

kjv_text: Cry out and shout, thou inhabitant of Zion: for great is the Holy One of Israel in the midst of thee.
bsb_text: Cry out and sing, O citizen of Zion, for great among you is the Holy One of Israel.”
aov_text: Juig en jubel, o inwoners van Sion! Want die Heilige van Israel is groot in julle midde.

kjv_text: The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz did see.
bsb_text: This is the burden against Babylon that Isaiah son of Amoz received:
aov_text: GODSPRAAK oor Babel wat Jesaja, die seun van Amos, gesien het.

kjv_text: Lift ye up a banner upon the high mountain, exalt the voice unto them, shake the hand, that they may go into the gates of the nobles.
bsb_text: Raise a banner on a barren hilltop; call aloud to them. Wave your hand, that they may enter the gates of the nobles.
aov_text: Hef op ’n banier op ’n kaal berg; roep hulle hardop toe, wink met die hand, dat hulle kan intrek deur die poorte van die edeles.

kjv_text: I have commanded my sanctified ones, I have also called my mighty ones for mine anger, even them that rejoice in my highness.
bsb_text: I have commanded My sanctified ones; I have even summoned My warriors to execute My wrath and exult in My triumph.
aov_text: Ek self het my geheiligdes ontbied; ook het Ek my helde tot my toorn geroep, my manne wat jubel in trotsheid.

kjv_text: The noise of a multitude in the mountains, like as of a great people; a tumultuous noise of the kingdoms of nations gathered together: the LORD of hosts mustereth the host of the battle.
bsb_text: Listen, a tumult on the mountains, like that of a great multitude! Listen, an uproar among the kingdoms, like nations gathered together! The LORD of Hosts is mobilizing an army for war.
aov_text: Hoor, ’n gedruis op die berge soos van baie mense! Hoor, ’n rumoer van die koninkryke, van versamelde nasies! Die HERE van die leërskare hou wapenskouing oor ’n oorlogsleër.

kjv_text: They come from a far country, from the end of heaven, even the LORD, and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land.
bsb_text: They are coming from faraway lands, from the ends of the heavens—the LORD and the weapons of His wrath—to destroy the whole country.
aov_text: Hulle kom uit ’n ver land, van die einde van die hemel af, die HERE en die werktuie van sy grimmigheid, om die hele aarde te verwoes.

kjv_text: Howl ye; for the day of the LORD is at hand; it shall come as a destruction from the Almighty.
bsb_text: Wail, for the Day of the LORD is near; it will come as destruction from the Almighty.
aov_text: Huil julle, want die dag van die HERE is naby; hy kom as ’n verwoesting van die Almagtige.

kjv_text: Therefore shall all hands be faint, and every man's heart shall melt:
bsb_text: Therefore all hands will fall limp, and every man’s heart will melt.
aov_text: Daarom word al die hande slap, en elke mensehart versmelt;

kjv_text: And they shall be afraid: pangs and sorrows shall take hold of them; they shall be in pain as a woman that travaileth: they shall be amazed one at another; their faces shall be as flames.
bsb_text: Terror, pain, and anguish will seize them; they will writhe like a woman in labor. They will look at one another, their faces flushed with fear.
aov_text: en hulle is verskrik, kry krampe en weë; hulle krimp inmekaar soos een wat baar; die een kyk die ander verbaas aan; hulle gesigte is vlammende gesigte.

kjv_text: Behold, the day of the LORD cometh, cruel both with wrath and fierce anger, to lay the land desolate: and he shall destroy the sinners thereof out of it.
bsb_text: Behold, the Day of the LORD is coming—cruel, with fury and burning anger—to make the earth a desolation and to destroy the sinners within it.
aov_text: Kyk, die dag van die HERE kom, verskriklik, met grimmigheid en toorngloed, om die aarde ’n woesteny te maak en sy sondaars daaruit te verdelg.

kjv_text: For the stars of heaven and the constellations thereof shall not give their light: the sun shall be darkened in his going forth, and the moon shall not cause her light to shine.
bsb_text: For the stars of heaven and their constellations will not give their light. The rising sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light.
aov_text: Want die sterre van die hemel en sy Oríons sal hulle lig nie laat skyn nie; die son is duister by sy opgang, en die maan laat sy lig nie skyn nie.

kjv_text: And I will punish the world for their evil, and the wicked for their iniquity; and I will cause the arrogancy of the proud to cease, and will lay low the haughtiness of the terrible.
bsb_text: I will punish the world for its evil and the wicked for their iniquity. I will end the haughtiness of the arrogant and lay low the pride of the ruthless.
aov_text: En Ek sal aan die wêreld sy boosheid besoek, en aan die goddelose hulle ongeregtigheid; en Ek sal die trots van die vermeteles laat ophou en die hoogmoed van tiranne verneder.

kjv_text: I will make a man more precious than fine gold; even a man than the golden wedge of Ophir.
bsb_text: I will make man scarcer than pure gold, and mankind rarer than the gold of Ophir.
aov_text: En Ek sal sterwelinge skaarser maak as fyn goud, en mense as goud van Ofir.

kjv_text: Therefore I will shake the heavens, and the earth shall remove out of her place, in the wrath of the LORD of hosts, and in the day of his fierce anger.
bsb_text: Therefore I will make the heavens tremble, and the earth will be shaken from its place at the wrath of the LORD of Hosts on the day of His burning anger.
aov_text: Daarom sal Ek die hemel laat sidder, en die aarde sal wyk uit sy plek met gebeef, vanweë die grimmigheid van die HERE van die leërskare en vanweë die dag van sy toorngloed.

kjv_text: And it shall be as the chased roe, and as a sheep that no man taketh up: they shall every man turn to his own people, and flee every one into his own land.
bsb_text: Like a hunted gazelle, like a sheep without a shepherd, each will return to his own people, each will flee to his native land.
aov_text: En soos ’n gemsbok wat gejaag word, en soos kleinvee wat niemand bymekaar maak nie, sal hulle elkeen draai na sy volk toe en elkeen vlug na sy land toe.

kjv_text: Every one that is found shall be thrust through; and every one that is joined unto them shall fall by the sword.
bsb_text: Whoever is caught will be stabbed, and whoever is captured will die by the sword.
aov_text: Elkeen wat gevind word, word deurboor; en elkeen wat gegryp word, val deur die swaard.

kjv_text: Their children also shall be dashed to pieces before their eyes; their houses shall be spoiled, and their wives ravished.
bsb_text: Their infants will be dashed to pieces before their eyes, their houses will be looted, and their wives will be ravished.
aov_text: En hulle kinders word voor hul oë verpletter, hul huise geplunder en hul vroue onteer.

kjv_text: Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, which shall not regard silver; and as for gold, they shall not delight in it.
bsb_text: Behold, I will stir up against them the Medes, who have no regard for silver and no desire for gold.
aov_text: Kyk, Ek verwek die Meders teen hulle, wat silwer nie ag nie en in goud geen behae het nie.

kjv_text: Their bows also shall dash the young men to pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb; their eye shall not spare children.
bsb_text: Their bows will dash young men to pieces; they will have no mercy on the fruit of the womb; they will not look with pity on the children.
aov_text: Maar hulle boë sal die seuns neerwerp, en hulle sal hul nie ontferm oor die vrug van die moederskoot nie; hulle oog sal die kinders nie verskoon nie.

kjv_text: And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldees' excellency, shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.
bsb_text: And Babylon, the jewel of the kingdoms, the glory of the pride of the Chaldeans, will be overthrown by God like Sodom and Gomorrah.
aov_text: So sal dan Babel, die sieraad van die koninkryke, die trotse pronkstuk van die Chaldeërs, wees soos toe God Sodom en Gomorra omgekeer het.

kjv_text: It shall never be inhabited, neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation: neither shall the Arabian pitch tent there; neither shall the shepherds make their fold there.
bsb_text: She will never be inhabited or settled from generation to generation; no nomad will pitch his tent there, no shepherd will rest his flock there.
aov_text: Mense sal daar in ewigheid nie woon nie, en dit sal van geslag tot geslag nie bewoon word nie; en die Arabier sal daar geen tent opslaan nie, en geen herders sal hulle vee daar laat lê en rus nie.

kjv_text: But wild beasts of the desert shall lie there; and their houses shall be full of doleful creatures; and owls shall dwell there, and satyrs shall dance there.
bsb_text: But desert creatures will lie down there, and howling creatures will fill her houses. Ostriches will dwell there, and wild goats will leap about.
aov_text: Maar daar sal boskatte lê, en hulle huise sal vol uile wees; en volstruise sal daar hou, en veldduiwels daar rondspring.

kjv_text: And the wild beasts of the islands shall cry in their desolate houses, and dragons in their pleasant palaces: and her time is near to come, and her days shall not be prolonged.
bsb_text: Hyenas will howl in her fortresses and jackals in her luxurious palaces. Babylon’s time is at hand, and her days will not be prolonged.
aov_text: En wildehonde sal huil in sy kastele en jakkalse in die vreugdepaleise; en naby is sy tyd om te kom, en sy dae sal nie verskuif word nie.

kjv_text: For the LORD will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land: and the strangers shall be joined with them, and they shall cleave to the house of Jacob.
