bsb_text: For the LORD will have compassion on Jacob; once again He will choose Israel and settle them in their own land. The foreigner will join them and unite with the house of Jacob.
aov_text: WANT die HERE sal Hom oor Jakob ontferm, en Hy sal Israel nog verkies en hulle in hul land laat vestig; en die vreemdeling sal hom by hulle voeg, en hulle sal hul aansluit by die huis van Jakob.

kjv_text: And the people shall take them, and bring them to their place: and the house of Israel shall possess them in the land of the LORD for servants and handmaids: and they shall take them captives, whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.
bsb_text: The nations will escort Israel and bring it to its homeland. Then the house of Israel will possess the nations as menservants and maidservants in the LORD’s land. They will make captives of their captors and rule over their oppressors.
aov_text: En die volke sal hulle neem en op hul woonplek bring; en die huis van Israel sal hulle in die land van die HERE as besitting verwerwe, as slawe en slavinne; en hulle sal dié gevange hou wat hulle as gevangenes weggevoer het, en oor hulle drywers heers.

kjv_text: And it shall come to pass in the day that the LORD shall give thee rest from thy sorrow, and from thy fear, and from the hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve,
bsb_text: On the day that the LORD gives you rest from your pain and torment, and from the hard labor into which you were forced,
aov_text: En op die dag as die HERE jou rus gee van jou smart en van jou onrus en van die harde diensbaarheid waarmee hulle jou laat dien het,

kjv_text: That thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon, and say, How hath the oppressor ceased! the golden city ceased!
bsb_text: you will sing this song of contempt against the king of Babylon: How the oppressor has ceased, and how his fury has ended!
aov_text: dan sal jy hierdie spotlied aanhef oor die koning van Babel en sê: Hoe het die drywer nou opgehou, opgehou die verdrukking!

kjv_text: The LORD hath broken the staff of the wicked, and the sceptre of the rulers.
bsb_text: The LORD has broken the staff of the wicked, the scepter of the rulers.
aov_text: Die HERE het die stok van die goddelose verbreek, die staf van die heersers,

kjv_text: He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke, he that ruled the nations in anger, is persecuted, and none hindereth.
bsb_text: It struck the peoples in anger with unceasing blows; it subdued the nations in rage with relentless persecution.
aov_text: wat die volke verwoes het in grimmigheid met slaan sonder ophou, wat in toorn oor die nasies geheers het met ’n agtervolging sonder verskoning.

kjv_text: The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet: they break forth into singing.
bsb_text: All the earth is at peace and at rest; they break out in song.
aov_text: Die hele aarde rus, is stil; hulle breek uit in jubel.

kjv_text: Yea, the fir trees rejoice at thee, and the cedars of Lebanon, saying, Since thou art laid down, no feller is come up against us.
bsb_text: Even the cypresses and cedars of Lebanon exult over you: “Since you have been laid low, no woodcutter comes against us.”
aov_text: Ook is die sipresse bly oor jou, die seders van die Líbanon, en hulle sê: Vandat jy daar lê, klim niemand na ons toe op om ons af te kap nie.

kjv_text: Hell from beneath is moved for thee to meet thee at thy coming: it stirreth up the dead for thee, even all the chief ones of the earth; it hath raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.
bsb_text: Sheol beneath is eager to meet you upon your arrival. It stirs the spirits of the dead to greet you—all the rulers of the earth. It makes all the kings of the nations rise from their thrones.
aov_text: Die doderyk daaronder is in beroering om jou ontwil, jou koms tegemoet; dit wek om jou ontwil die skimme op, al die bokke van die aarde; dit laat al die konings van die nasies van hulle trone opstaan.

kjv_text: All they shall speak and say unto thee, Art thou also become weak as we? art thou become like unto us?
bsb_text: They will all respond to you, saying, “You too have become weak, as we are; you have become like us!”
aov_text: Hulle hef almal aan en sê vir jou: Ook jy het kragteloos geword soos ons; jy het soos ons geword.

kjv_text: Thy pomp is brought down to the grave, and the noise of thy viols: the worm is spread under thee, and the worms cover thee.
bsb_text: Your pomp has been brought down to Sheol, along with the music of your harps. Maggots are your bed and worms your blanket.
aov_text: Jou trots is neergewerp in die doderyk, die geruis van jou harpe; onder jou is wurms as ’n bed gesprei, en maaiers is jou bedekking.

kjv_text: How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! how art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!
bsb_text: How you have fallen from heaven, O day star, son of the dawn! You have been cut down to the ground, O destroyer of nations.
aov_text: Hoe het jy uit die hemel geval, o môrester, seun van die dageraad! Hoe lê jy teen die aarde neergeslaan, oorweldiger van die nasies!

kjv_text: For thou hast said in thine heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God: I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north:
bsb_text: You said in your heart: “I will ascend to the heavens; I will raise my throne above the stars of God. I will sit on the mount of assembly, in the far reaches of the north.
aov_text: En jý het in jou hart gesê: Ek wil opklim in die hemel, my troon verhef bo die sterre van God en sit op die berg van samekoms in die uithoeke van die Noorde.

kjv_text: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will be like the most High.
bsb_text: I will ascend above the tops of the clouds; I will make myself like the Most High.”
aov_text: Ek wil klim bo die hoogtes van die wolke, my gelykstel met die Allerhoogste!

kjv_text: Yet thou shalt be brought down to hell, to the sides of the pit.
bsb_text: But you will be brought down to Sheol, to the lowest depths of the Pit.
aov_text: Ja, in die doderyk sal jy neergewerp word, in die diepste plekke van die kuil!

kjv_text: They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee, and consider thee, saying, Is this the man that made the earth to tremble, that did shake kingdoms;
bsb_text: Those who see you will stare; they will ponder your fate: “Is this the man who shook the earth and made the kingdoms tremble,
aov_text: Die wat jou sien, beskou jou, hulle let op jou en sê: Is dit die man wat die aarde laat sidder het, koninkryke laat beef het?

kjv_text: That made the world as a wilderness, and destroyed the cities thereof; that opened not the house of his prisoners?
bsb_text: who turned the world into a desert and destroyed its cities, who refused to let the captives return to their homes?”
aov_text: Die wêreld soos ’n woestyn gemaak en sy stede verwoes het, wat sy gevangenes nie losgelaat het huis toe nie?

kjv_text: All the kings of the nations, even all of them, lie in glory, every one in his own house.
bsb_text: All the kings of the nations lie in state, each in his own tomb.
aov_text: Al die konings van die nasies, hulle almal rus met eer, elkeen in sy huis;

kjv_text: But thou art cast out of thy grave like an abominable branch, and as the raiment of those that are slain, thrust through with a sword, that go down to the stones of the pit; as a carcase trodden under feet.
bsb_text: But you are cast out of your grave like a rejected branch, covered by those slain with the sword, and dumped into a rocky pit like a carcass trampled underfoot.
aov_text: maar jý is gewerp, ver van jou graf, soos ’n afskuwelike uitspruitsel, oordek met die wat verslaan is, wat deurboor is met die swaard, wat neerdaal na die klippe van die grafkuil soos vertrapte aas.

kjv_text: Thou shalt not be joined with them in burial, because thou hast destroyed thy land, and slain thy people: the seed of evildoers shall never be renowned.
bsb_text: You will not join them in burial, since you have destroyed your land and slaughtered your own people. The offspring of the wicked will never again be mentioned.
aov_text: Jy word nie met hulle in die graf verenig nie, want jy het jou land verwoes, jou volk gedood; die nageslag van die kwaaddoeners word vir ewig nie genoem nie.

kjv_text: Prepare slaughter for his children for the iniquity of their fathers; that they do not rise, nor possess the land, nor fill the face of the world with cities.
bsb_text: Prepare a place to slaughter his sons for the iniquities of their forefathers. They will never rise up to possess a land or cover the earth with their cities.
aov_text: Maak ’n slagbank gereed vir sy seuns, om die ongeregtigheid van hulle vaders ontwil, dat hulle nie opstaan en die aarde in besit neem en die bodem van die wêreld vol stede maak nie.

kjv_text: For I will rise up against them, saith the LORD of hosts, and cut off from Babylon the name, and remnant, and son, and nephew, saith the LORD.
bsb_text: “I will rise up against them,” declares the LORD of Hosts. “I will cut off from Babylon her name and her remnant, her offspring and her posterity,” declares the LORD.
aov_text: So sal Ek dan teen hulle opstaan, spreek die HERE van die leërskare, en van Babel uitroei die naam en die oorblyfsel, kroos en nageslag, spreek die HERE.

kjv_text: I will also make it a possession for the bittern, and pools of water: and I will sweep it with the besom of destruction, saith the LORD of hosts.
bsb_text: “I will make her a place for owls and for swamplands; I will sweep her away with the broom of destruction,” declares the LORD of Hosts.
aov_text: En Ek sal dit ’n besitting maak van krimpvarkies en tot waterplasse; en Ek sal dit wegvee met die besem van verdelging, spreek die HERE van die leërskare.

kjv_text: The LORD of hosts hath sworn, saying, Surely as I have thought, so shall it come to pass; and as I have purposed, so shall it stand:
bsb_text: The LORD of Hosts has sworn: “Surely, as I have planned, so will it be; as I have purposed, so will it stand.
aov_text: DIE HERE van die leërskare het gesweer en gesê: Waarlik, soos Ek gedink het, so gebeur dit; en soos Ek besluit het, kom dit tot stand:

kjv_text: That I will break the Assyrian in my land, and upon my mountains tread him under foot: then shall his yoke depart from off them, and his burden depart from off their shoulders.
bsb_text: I will break Assyria in My land; I will trample him on My mountain. His yoke will be taken off My people, and his burden removed from their shoulders.”
aov_text: om Assur te verbreek in my land, en op my berge sal Ek hom vertrap, sodat sy juk van hulle kan afgly en sy las van hulle skouer kan wyk.

kjv_text: This is the purpose that is purposed upon the whole earth: and this is the hand that is stretched out upon all the nations.
bsb_text: This is the plan devised for the whole earth, and this is the hand stretched out over all the nations.
aov_text: Dit is die besluit wat geneem is oor die hele aarde, en dit is die hand wat uitgestrek is oor al die nasies;

kjv_text: For the LORD of hosts hath purposed, and who shall disannul it? and his hand is stretched out, and who shall turn it back?
bsb_text: The LORD of Hosts has purposed, and who can thwart Him? His hand is outstretched, so who can turn it back?
aov_text: want die HERE van die leërskare het dit besluit—wie sal dit kan verydel? En sy hand is uitgestrek—wie sal dit kan afkeer?

kjv_text: In the year that king Ahaz died was this burden.
bsb_text: In the year that King Ahaz died, this burden was received:
aov_text: IN die sterfjaar van koning Agas het hierdie Godspraak uitgegaan.

kjv_text: Rejoice not thou, whole Palestina, because the rod of him that smote thee is broken: for out of the serpent's root shall come forth a cockatrice, and his fruit shall be a fiery flying serpent.
bsb_text: Do not rejoice, all you Philistines, that the rod that struck you is broken. For a viper will spring from the root of the snake, and a flying serpent from its egg.
aov_text: Wees nie bly, o ganse land van die Filistyne, dat die roede verbreek is wat jou geslaan het nie; want uit die wortel van die slang sal ’n basilisk voortkom, en sy vrug sal ’n vlieënde draak wees.

kjv_text: And the firstborn of the poor shall feed, and the needy shall lie down in safety: and I will kill thy root with famine, and he shall slay thy remnant.
bsb_text: Then the firstborn of the poor will find pasture, and the needy will lie down in safety, but I will kill your root by famine, and your remnant will be slain.
aov_text: En die eersgeborenes van die armes sal wei, en die behoeftiges sal veilig lê en rus; maar jou wortel sal Ek deur honger laat sterwe, en jou oorblyfsel sal hy doodmaak.

kjv_text: Howl, O gate; cry, O city; thou, whole Palestina, art dissolved: for there shall come from the north a smoke, and none shall be alone in his appointed times.
bsb_text: Wail, O gate! Cry out, O city! Melt away, all you Philistines! For a cloud of smoke comes from the north, and there are no stragglers in its ranks.
aov_text: Huil, o poort! Skreeu, o stad! Bewe, o ganse land van die Filistyne! Want uit die noorde kom rook, en daar is geen afswerwer onder sy skare nie.

kjv_text: What shall one then answer the messengers of the nation? That the LORD hath founded Zion, and the poor of his people shall trust in it.
bsb_text: What answer will be given to the envoys of that nation? “The LORD has founded Zion, where His afflicted people will find refuge.”
aov_text: Wat sal hulle dan die boodskappers van die nasie antwoord? Dat die HERE Sion gegrondves het, en dat die ellendiges van sy volk daarin sal skuil.

kjv_text: The burden of Moab. Because in the night Ar of Moab is laid waste, and brought to silence; because in the night Kir of Moab is laid waste, and brought to silence;
bsb_text: This is the burden against Moab: Ar in Moab is ruined, destroyed in a night! Kir in Moab is devastated, destroyed in a night!
aov_text: GODSPRAAK oor Moab. Waarlik, in die nag is Ar-Moab verwoes, vernietig! Waarlik, in die nag is Kir-Moab verwoes, vernietig!

kjv_text: He is gone up to Bajith, and to Dibon, the high places, to weep: Moab shall howl over Nebo, and over Medeba: on all their heads shall be baldness, and every beard cut off.
bsb_text: Dibon goes up to its temple to weep at its high places. Moab wails over Nebo, as well as over Medeba. Every head is shaved, every beard is cut off.
aov_text: Hulle gaan op na die tempel, en Dibon na die hoogtes om te ween; Moab huil op Nebo en in Medéba; op al hulle hoofde is ’n kaalte, elke baard is afgeskeer.

kjv_text: In their streets they shall gird themselves with sackcloth: on the tops of their houses, and in their streets, every one shall howl, weeping abundantly.
bsb_text: In its streets they wear sackcloth; on the rooftops and in the public squares they all wail, falling down weeping.
aov_text: Op hul strate het hulle rouklere aangegord; op hulle dakke en op hulle pleine huil alles en smelt weg in geween.

kjv_text: And Heshbon shall cry, and Elealeh: their voice shall be heard even unto Jahaz: therefore the armed soldiers of Moab shall cry out; his life shall be grievous unto him.
bsb_text: Heshbon and Elealeh cry out; their voices are heard as far as Jahaz. Therefore the soldiers of Moab cry out; their souls tremble within.
aov_text: Hesbon en Eleále skreeu, hulle stem word gehoor tot Jahas toe; daarom hef die gewapende manne van Moab ’n angsgeskreeu aan, sy siel sidder.

kjv_text: My heart shall cry out for Moab; his fugitives shall flee unto Zoar, an heifer of three years old: for by the mounting up of Luhith with weeping shall they go it up; for in the way of Horonaim they shall raise up a cry of destruction.
bsb_text: My heart cries out over Moab; her fugitives flee as far as Zoar, as far as Eglath-shelishiyah. With weeping they ascend the slope of Luhith; they lament their destruction on the road to Horonaim.
aov_text: My hart skreeu oor Moab, sy vlugtelinge kom tot by Soar, Eglat-Selisia. Want die hoogte van Luhit beklim hulle met geween; ja, op pad na Horonáim laat hulle ’n geskreeu van verwoesting weerklink;

kjv_text: For the waters of Nimrim shall be desolate: for the hay is withered away, the grass faileth, there is no green thing.
bsb_text: The waters of Nimrim are dried up, and the grass is withered; the vegetation is gone, and the greenery is no more.
aov_text: want die waters van Nimrim word ’n woesteny, ja, die gras is verdor, die grasspruitjies het vergaan, daar is geen groenigheid nie.

kjv_text: Therefore the abundance they have gotten, and that which they have laid up, shall they carry away to the brook of the willows.
bsb_text: So they carry their wealth and belongings over the Brook of the Willows.
aov_text: Daarom gaan hulle die oorwins wat hulle gemaak het, en hulle voorraad, oor die Wilgerspruit dra.

kjv_text: For the cry is gone round about the borders of Moab; the howling thereof unto Eglaim, and the howling thereof unto Beerelim.
bsb_text: For their outcry echoes to the border of Moab. Their wailing reaches Eglaim; it is heard in Beer-elim.
aov_text: Want die geskreeu gaan rond in die grondgebied van Moab, sy gehuil tot by Eglaim en sy gehuil tot by Beër-Elim.

kjv_text: For the waters of Dimon shall be full of blood: for I will bring more upon Dimon, lions upon him that escapeth of Moab, and upon the remnant of the land.
bsb_text: The waters of Dimon are full of blood, but I will bring more upon Dimon—a lion upon the fugitives of Moab and upon the remnant of the land.
aov_text: Want die waters van Dimon is vol bloed; want Ek sal oor Dimon nog meer bring, ’n leeu oor dié van Moab wat ontvlug het, en oor die oorblyfsel van die land.

kjv_text: Send ye the lamb to the ruler of the land from Sela to the wilderness, unto the mount of the daughter of Zion.
bsb_text: Send the tribute lambs to the ruler of the land, from Sela in the desert to the mount of Daughter Zion.
aov_text: STUUR die lammers van die regeerder van die land uit die rotsstreek weg na die woestyn, na die berg van die dogter van Sion.

kjv_text: For it shall be, that, as a wandering bird cast out of the nest, so the daughters of Moab shall be at the fords of Arnon.
bsb_text: Like fluttering birds pushed out of the nest, so are the daughters of Moab at the fords of the Arnon:
aov_text: En soos voëls wat vlug, ’n nes wat verjaag is, sal die dogters van Moab wees by die driwwe van die Arnon.

kjv_text: Take counsel, execute judgment; make thy shadow as the night in the midst of the noonday; hide the outcasts; bewray not him that wandereth.
bsb_text: “Give us counsel; render a decision. Shelter us at noonday with shade as dark as night. Hide the refugees; do not betray the one who flees.
aov_text: Gee raad, gee beslissing, maak jou skaduwee soos die nag op die volle middag, verberg die wat verdryf is, verraai die vlugteling nie!

kjv_text: Let mine outcasts dwell with thee, Moab; be thou a covert to them from the face of the spoiler: for the extortioner is at an end, the spoiler ceaseth, the oppressors are consumed out of the land.
bsb_text: Let my fugitives stay with you; be a refuge for Moab from the destroyer.” When the oppressor has gone, destruction has ceased, and the oppressors have vanished from the land,
aov_text: Laat my mense wat verdryf is, by jou vertoef! Aangaande Moab, wees vir hulle ’n skuilplek vanweë die verwoester. Want gedaan is die verdrukker, klaar is dit met die verwoesting, weg is die vertrappers uit die land!

kjv_text: And in mercy shall the throne be established: and he shall sit upon it in truth in the tabernacle of David, judging, and seeking judgment, and hasting righteousness.
bsb_text: in loving devotion a throne will be established in the tent of David. A judge seeking justice and hastening righteousness will sit on it in faithfulness.
aov_text: En opgerig is deur goedgunstigheid ’n troon, en daarop sit een in getrouheid in Dawid se tent, ’n regter wat die reg soek en gou is in geregtigheid.

kjv_text: We have heard of the pride of Moab; he is very proud: even of his haughtiness, and his pride, and his wrath: but his lies shall not be so.
bsb_text: We have heard of Moab’s pomposity, his exceeding pride and conceit, his overflowing arrogance. But his boasting is empty.
aov_text: Ons het gehoor van die trotsheid van Moab—hy is baie trots!—van sy hoogmoed en sy trotsheid en sy grimmigheid, sy onbehoorlike grootpratery.

kjv_text: Therefore shall Moab howl for Moab, every one shall howl: for the foundations of Kirhareseth shall ye mourn; surely they are stricken.
bsb_text: Therefore let Moab wail; let them wail together for Moab. Moan for the raisin cakes of Kir-hareseth, you who are utterly stricken.
aov_text: Daarom sal Moab oor Moab huil, almal saam huil; oor die druiwekoeke van Kir-Haréset sal julle sug, heeltemal verslae.

kjv_text: For the fields of Heshbon languish, and the vine of Sibmah: the lords of the heathen have broken down the principal plants thereof, they are come even unto Jazer, they wandered through the wilderness: her branches are stretched out, they are gone over the sea.
bsb_text: For the fields of Heshbon have withered, along with the grapevines of Sibmah. The rulers of the nations have trampled its choicest vines, which had reached as far as Jazer and spread toward the desert. Their shoots had spread out and passed over the sea.
aov_text: Want die wingerde van Hesbon het verwelk; die wingerdstok van Sibma—sy edele druiwe het die beheersers van die nasies neergewerp; dit het gekom tot by Jaéser, dit het in die woestyn ingedwaal; sy ranke het uitgesprei, het oor die see gegaan.

kjv_text: Therefore I will bewail with the weeping of Jazer the vine of Sibmah: I will water thee with my tears, O Heshbon, and Elealeh: for the shouting for thy summer fruits and for thy harvest is fallen.
bsb_text: So I weep with Jazer for the vines of Sibmah; I drench Heshbon and Elealeh with my tears. Triumphant shouts have fallen silent over your summer fruit and your harvest.
aov_text: Daarom beween ek die wingerdstok van Sibma met die geween van Jaéser; ek maak jou nat met my trane, Hesbon en Eleále, omdat die vreugdegeroep jou somervrugte en jou oes oorval het,

kjv_text: And gladness is taken away, and joy out of the plentiful field; and in the vineyards there shall be no singing, neither shall there be shouting: the treaders shall tread out no wine in their presses; I have made their vintage shouting to cease.
bsb_text: Joy and gladness are removed from the orchard; no one sings or shouts in the vineyards. No one tramples the grapes in the winepresses; I have put an end to the cheering.
aov_text: en vreugde en gejuig weggeneem is uit die vrugteboord, en in die wingerde nie gejubel of gejuig word nie; die druiwetrapper trap geen wyn in die parskuipe nie; Ek het die vreugdegeroep laat ophou.

kjv_text: Wherefore my bowels shall sound like an harp for Moab, and mine inward parts for Kirharesh.
bsb_text: Therefore my heart laments for Moab like a harp, my inmost being for Kir-heres.
aov_text: Daarom klaag my ingewande oor Moab soos ’n siter, en my binneste oor Kir-Heres.

kjv_text: And it shall come to pass, when it is seen that Moab is weary on the high place, that he shall come to his sanctuary to pray; but he shall not prevail.
bsb_text: When Moab appears on the high place, when he wearies himself and enters his sanctuary to pray, it will do him no good.
aov_text: En as Moab verskyn, as hy hom vermoei op die hoogte en in sy heiligdom ingaan om te aanbid, dan sal hy niks uitrig nie.

kjv_text: This is the word that the LORD hath spoken concerning Moab since that time.
bsb_text: This is the message that the LORD spoke earlier concerning Moab.
aov_text: Dit is die woord wat die HERE tevore teen Moab gespreek het.

kjv_text: But now the LORD hath spoken, saying, Within three years, as the years of an hireling, and the glory of Moab shall be contemned, with all that great multitude; and the remnant shall be very small and feeble.
bsb_text: And now the LORD says, “In three years, as a hired worker counts the years, Moab’s splendor will become an object of contempt, with all her many people. And those who are left will be few and feeble.”
aov_text: En nou spreek die HERE en sê: Binne drie jaar—soos die jare van ’n dagloner—sal die heerlikheid van Moab veragtelik gemaak word saam met die hele groot menigte; en die oorblyfsel sal min, gering, onmagtig wees.

kjv_text: The burden of Damascus. Behold, Damascus is taken away from being a city, and it shall be a ruinous heap.
bsb_text: This is the burden against Damascus: “Behold, Damascus is no longer a city; it has become a heap of ruins.
aov_text: GODSPRAAK oor Damaskus. Kyk, Damaskus word weggeneem, sodat dit geen stad meer is nie, maar dit sal ’n vervalle puinhoop word.

kjv_text: The cities of Aroer are forsaken: they shall be for flocks, which shall lie down, and none shall make them afraid.
bsb_text: The cities of Aroer are forsaken; they will be left to the flocks, which will lie down with no one to fear.
aov_text: Die stede Ároër sal verlate wees; vir die troppe vee sal hulle wees wat daar sal lê sonder dat iemand hulle skrikmaak.

kjv_text: The fortress also shall cease from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus, and the remnant of Syria: they shall be as the glory of the children of Israel, saith the LORD of hosts.
bsb_text: The fortress will disappear from Ephraim, and the sovereignty from Damascus. The remnant of Aram will be like the splendor of the Israelites,” declares the LORD of Hosts.
aov_text: En die vesting sal verdwyn uit Efraim, en die koningskap uit Damaskus; en met die oorblyfsel van Aram sal dit gaan soos met die heerlikheid van die kinders van Israel, spreek die HERE van die leërskare.

kjv_text: And in that day it shall come to pass, that the glory of Jacob shall be made thin, and the fatness of his flesh shall wax lean.
bsb_text: “In that day the splendor of Jacob will fade, and the fat of his body will waste away,
aov_text: En in dié dag sal die heerlikheid van Jakob gering word, en die vet van sy vlees sal wegteer.

kjv_text: And it shall be as when the harvestman gathereth the corn, and reapeth the ears with his arm; and it shall be as he that gathereth ears in the valley of Rephaim.
bsb_text: as the reaper gathers the standing grain and harvests the ears with his arm, as one gleans heads of grain in the Valley of Rephaim.
aov_text: En dit sal wees soos wanneer die maaier die ongesnyde graan bymekaarvat en sy arm die are afmaai; ja, dit sal wees soos wanneer iemand are optel in die dal Refaim.

kjv_text: Yet gleaning grapes shall be left in it, as the shaking of an olive tree, two or three berries in the top of the uppermost bough, four or five in the outmost fruitful branches thereof, saith the LORD God of Israel.
bsb_text: Yet gleanings will remain, like an olive tree that has been beaten—two or three berries atop the tree, four or five on its fruitful branches,” declares the LORD, the God of Israel.
aov_text: Maar ’n na-oes sal daarin oorbly soos by die afslaan van die olywe: twee, drie vruggies bo in die top; vier, vyf in die takke van die vrugteboom, spreek die HERE, die God van Israel.

kjv_text: At that day shall a man look to his Maker, and his eyes shall have respect to the Holy One of Israel.
bsb_text: In that day men will look to their Maker and turn their eyes to the Holy One of Israel.
aov_text: In dié dag sal die mens kyk na sy Maker, en sy oë sal sien op die Heilige van Israel;

kjv_text: And he shall not look to the altars, the work of his hands, neither shall respect that which his fingers have made, either the groves, or the images.
bsb_text: They will not look to the altars they have fashioned with their hands or to the Asherahs and incense altars they have made with their fingers.
aov_text: en hy sal nie kyk na die altare nie, die werk van sy hande; en wat sy vingers gemaak het, sal hy nie aansien nie: die heilige boomstamme en die sonpilare.

kjv_text: In that day shall his strong cities be as a forsaken bough, and an uppermost branch, which they left because of the children of Israel: and there shall be desolation.
bsb_text: In that day their strong cities will be like forsaken thickets and summits, abandoned to the Israelites and to utter desolation.
aov_text: In dié dag sal die stede wat sy toevlug was, wees soos die bouvalle van die bos en van die bergtop wat verlaat is vanweë die kinders van Israel, en dit sal ’n wildernis wees.

kjv_text: Because thou hast forgotten the God of thy salvation, and hast not been mindful of the rock of thy strength, therefore shalt thou plant pleasant plants, and shalt set it with strange slips:
bsb_text: For you have forgotten the God of your salvation and failed to remember the Rock of your refuge. Therefore, though you cultivate delightful plots and set out cuttings from exotic vines—
aov_text: Want jy het vergeet die God van jou heil en nie gedink aan die rots wat jou toevlug was nie. Daarom lê jy lieflike tuine aan en beplant dit met uitlandse wingerdstokke;

kjv_text: In the day shalt thou make thy plant to grow, and in the morning shalt thou make thy seed to flourish: but the harvest shall be a heap in the day of grief and of desperate sorrow.
bsb_text: though on the day you plant you make them grow, and on that morning you help your seed sprout—yet the harvest will vanish on the day of disease and incurable pain.
aov_text: die dag as jy plant, laat jy dit groei, en in die môre laat jy jou saad uitspruit; maar dit sal wees ’n hoop geoeste graan op die dag van krankheid en ongeneeslike smart.

kjv_text: Woe to the multitude of many people, which make a noise like the noise of the seas; and to the rushing of nations, that make a rushing like the rushing of mighty waters!
bsb_text: Alas, the tumult of many peoples; they rage like the roaring seas and clamoring nations; they rumble like the crashing of mighty waters.
aov_text: WEE die gebruis van baie volke—soos die gebruis van die see, so bruis hulle! En die gedruis van nasies—soos die gedruis van geweldige waters, so maak hulle gedruis!

kjv_text: The nations shall rush like the rushing of many waters: but God shall rebuke them, and they shall flee far off, and shall be chased as the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like a rolling thing before the whirlwind.
bsb_text: The nations rage like the rush of many waters. He rebukes them, and they flee far away, driven before the wind like chaff on the hills, like tumbleweeds before a gale.
aov_text: Nasies maak gedruis soos die gedruis van baie waters; maar Hy dreig hulle, en hulle vlug ver weg en word gejaag soos kaf van die berge voor die wind en soos strooi voor die stormwind.

kjv_text: And behold at eveningtide trouble; and before the morning he is not. This is the portion of them that spoil us, and the lot of them that rob us.
bsb_text: In the evening, there is sudden terror! Before morning, they are no more! This is the portion of those who loot us and the lot of those who plunder us.
aov_text: In die aand—daar is verskrikking! Voordat dit môre word, is hulle nie meer nie. Dit is die deel van hulle wat ons plunder, en die lot van hulle wat ons beroof.

kjv_text: Woe to the land shadowing with wings, which is beyond the rivers of Ethiopia:
bsb_text: Woe to the land of whirring wings, along the rivers of Cush,
aov_text: WEE die land van vlerkgegons wat anderkant die riviere van Kus lê;

kjv_text: That sendeth ambassadors by the sea, even in vessels of bulrushes upon the waters, saying, Go, ye swift messengers, to a nation scattered and peeled, to a people terrible from their beginning hitherto; a nation meted out and trodden down, whose land the rivers have spoiled!
bsb_text: which sends couriers by sea, in papyrus vessels on the waters. Go, swift messengers, to a people tall and smooth-skinned, to a people widely feared, to a powerful nation of strange speech, whose land is divided by rivers.
aov_text: wat boodskappers stuur oor die groot water en in skuite van biesies oor die waters! Gaan weg, vinnige boodskappers, na die hoog uitgegroeide nasie met die blink vel, na die wyd en syd gevreesde volk, die nasie gewoond om te gebied en te vertrap, wie se land deur riviere deursny word.

kjv_text: All ye inhabitants of the world, and dwellers on the earth, see ye, when he lifteth up an ensign on the mountains; and when he bloweth a trumpet, hear ye.
bsb_text: All you people of the world and dwellers of the earth, when a banner is raised on the mountains, you will see it; when a ram’s horn sounds, you will hear it.
aov_text: Al julle bewoners van die wêreld en bewoners van die aarde, as ’n banier opgehef word op die berge, kyk! En as die basuin geblaas word, luister!

kjv_text: For so the LORD said unto me, I will take my rest, and I will consider in my dwelling place like a clear heat upon herbs, and like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.
bsb_text: For this is what the LORD has told me: “I will quietly look on from My dwelling place, like shimmering heat in the sunshine, like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.”
aov_text: Want so het die HERE vir my gesê: Ek wag rustig en aanskou uit my woonplek, soos glinsterende hitte bo die sonlig, soos ’n douwolk in die hitte van die oestyd.

kjv_text: For afore the harvest, when the bud is perfect, and the sour grape is ripening in the flower, he shall both cut off the sprigs with pruning hooks, and take away and cut down the branches.
bsb_text: For before the harvest, when the blossom is gone and the flower becomes a ripening grape, He will cut off the shoots with a pruning knife and remove and discard the branches.
aov_text: Want voor die oes, as die bloeisel volgroeid is en die blom ’n ryp druiwekorrel word, sal Hy die ranke afsny met snoeimesse en die lote wegkap;

kjv_text: They shall be left together unto the fowls of the mountains, and to the beasts of the earth: and the fowls shall summer upon them, and all the beasts of the earth shall winter upon them.
bsb_text: They will all be left to the mountain birds of prey, and to the beasts of the land. The birds will feed on them in summer, and all the wild animals in winter.
aov_text: hulle word almal saam oorgegee aan die roofvoëls van die berge en aan die wilde diere van die aarde; en die roofvoëls sal daarop die somer deurbring, en al die wilde diere van die aarde sal daarop oorwinter.

kjv_text: In that time shall the present be brought unto the LORD of hosts of a people scattered and peeled, and from a people terrible from their beginning hitherto; a nation meted out and trodden under foot, whose land the rivers have spoiled, to the place of the name of the LORD of hosts, the mount Zion.
bsb_text: At that time gifts will be brought to the LORD of Hosts—from a people tall and smooth-skinned, from a people widely feared, from a powerful nation of strange speech, whose land is divided by rivers—to Mount Zion, the place of the Name of the LORD of Hosts.
aov_text: In dié tyd sal aan die HERE van die leërskare geskenke gebring word van die hoog uitgegroeide volk met die blink vel en van die wyd en syd gevreesde volk, die nasie gewoond om te gebied en te vertrap, wie se land deur riviere deursny word, na die plek van die Naam van die HERE van die leërskare, na die berg Sion.

kjv_text: The burden of Egypt. Behold, the LORD rideth upon a swift cloud, and shall come into Egypt: and the idols of Egypt shall be moved at his presence, and the heart of Egypt shall melt in the midst of it.
bsb_text: This is the burden against Egypt: Behold, the LORD rides on a swift cloud; He is coming to Egypt. The idols of Egypt will tremble before Him, and the hearts of the Egyptians will melt within them.
aov_text: GODSPRAAK oor Egipte. Kyk, die HERE ry op ’n vinnige wolk en kom na Egipte toe; en die afgode van Egipte wankel voor sy aangesig, en die hart van Egipte smelt in sy binneste.

kjv_text: And I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians: and they shall fight every one against his brother, and every one against his neighbour; city against city, and kingdom against kingdom.
bsb_text: “So I will incite Egyptian against Egyptian; brother will fight against brother, neighbor against neighbor, city against city, and kingdom against kingdom.
aov_text: En Ek sal Egipte teen Egipte ophits, sodat hulle sal veg, elkeen teen sy broer en elkeen teen sy naaste, stad teen stad, koninkryk teen koninkryk.

kjv_text: And the spirit of Egypt shall fail in the midst thereof; and I will destroy the counsel thereof: and they shall seek to the idols, and to the charmers, and to them that have familiar spirits, and to the wizards.
bsb_text: Then the spirit of the Egyptians will be emptied out from among them, and I will frustrate their plans, so that they will resort to idols and spirits of the dead, to mediums and spiritists.
aov_text: En die gees van Egipte sal radeloos word in sy binneste, en sy planne sal Ek verwar; dan raadpleeg hulle die afgode en die besweerders en die geeste van afgestorwenes en die geeste wat waarsê.

kjv_text: And the Egyptians will I give over into the hand of a cruel lord; and a fierce king shall rule over them, saith the Lord, the LORD of hosts.
bsb_text: I will deliver the Egyptians into the hands of harsh masters, and a fierce king will rule over them,” declares the Lord GOD of Hosts.
aov_text: En Ek sal Egipte oorgee in die hand van ’n harde meester, en ’n strenge koning sal oor hulle heers, spreek die Here HERE van die leërskare.

kjv_text: And the waters shall fail from the sea, and the river shall be wasted and dried up.
bsb_text: The waters of the Nile will dry up, and the riverbed will be parched and empty.
aov_text: En die waters sal uit die groot waterplas verdwyn, en die rivier sal uitdroog en droog lê.

kjv_text: And they shall turn the rivers far away; and the brooks of defence shall be emptied and dried up: the reeds and flags shall wither.
bsb_text: The canals will stink; the streams of Egypt will trickle and dry up; the reeds and rushes will wither.
aov_text: En die strome sal stink; die strome van Egipte sal swak word en uitdroog; riet en biesies sal verwelk.

kjv_text: The paper reeds by the brooks, by the mouth of the brooks, and every thing sown by the brooks, shall wither, be driven away, and be no more.
bsb_text: The bulrushes by the Nile, by the mouth of the river, and all the fields sown along the Nile, will wither, blow away, and be no more.
aov_text: Die weivelde by die Nyl, by die mond van die Nyl, en elke saailand van die Nyl sal verdor, verwaai en nie meer wees nie.

kjv_text: The fishers also shall mourn, and all they that cast angle into the brooks shall lament, and they that spread nets upon the waters shall languish.
bsb_text: Then the fishermen will mourn, all who cast a hook into the Nile will lament, and those who spread nets on the waters will pine away.
aov_text: En die vissers sal klaag, en almal wat hoeke in die Nyl uitgooi, rou bedrywe; en die wat visnette uitsprei oor die waters, sal verkwyn.

kjv_text: Moreover they that work in fine flax, and they that weave networks, shall be confounded.
bsb_text: The workers in flax will be dismayed, and the weavers of fine linen will turn pale.
aov_text: En die bewerkers van uitgekamde vlas staan beskaamd, en die wewers van wit stowwe.

kjv_text: And they shall be broken in the purposes thereof, all that make sluices and ponds for fish.
bsb_text: The workers in cloth will be dejected, and all the hired workers will be sick at heart.
aov_text: En sy steunpilare word verbrysel; almal wat vir loon werk, sielsbedroef.

kjv_text: Surely the princes of Zoan are fools, the counsel of the wise counsellors of Pharaoh is become brutish: how say ye unto Pharaoh, I am the son of the wise, the son of ancient kings?
bsb_text: The princes of Zoan are mere fools; Pharaoh’s wise counselors give senseless advice. How can you say to Pharaoh, “I am one of the wise, a son of eastern kings”?
aov_text: Die vorste van Soan is net dwase, die raad van Farao se slimste raadgewers het domheid geword. Hoe kan julle vir Farao sê: Ek is ’n seun van die wyse manne, ’n seun van die konings uit die voortyd?

kjv_text: Where are they? where are thy wise men? and let them tell thee now, and let them know what the LORD of hosts hath purposed upon Egypt.
bsb_text: Where are your wise men now? Let them tell you and reveal what the LORD of Hosts has planned against Egypt.
aov_text: Waar is hulle dan, jou wyse manne? Laat hulle jou tog te kenne gee, dat ’n mens kan weet wat die HERE van die leërskare oor Egipte besluit het.

kjv_text: The princes of Zoan are become fools, the princes of Noph are deceived; they have also seduced Egypt, even they that are the stay of the tribes thereof.
bsb_text: The princes of Zoan have become fools; the princes of Memphis are deceived. The cornerstones of her tribes have led Egypt astray.
aov_text: Die vorste van Soan het dwase geword, die vorste van Nof is bedroë; Egipte is op ’n dwaalweg gebring deur hulle wat die hoeksteen van die stamme is.

kjv_text: The LORD hath mingled a perverse spirit in the midst thereof: and they have caused Egypt to err in every work thereof, as a drunken man staggereth in his vomit.
bsb_text: The LORD has poured into her a spirit of confusion. Egypt has been led astray in all she does, as a drunkard staggers through his own vomit.
aov_text: Die HERE het daarin ’n gees van bedwelming gegiet, en Egipte is op ’n dwaalweg gebring in al sy werk, soos ’n dronkaard tuimel in sy uitbraaksel.

kjv_text: Neither shall there be any work for Egypt, which the head or tail, branch or rush, may do.
bsb_text: There is nothing Egypt can do—head or tail, palm or reed.
aov_text: So is daar dan vir Egipte geen werk wat gedoen word deur kop of stert, palmtak of biesie nie.

kjv_text: In that day shall Egypt be like unto women: and it shall be afraid and fear because of the shaking of the hand of the LORD of hosts, which he shaketh over it.
bsb_text: In that day the Egyptians will be like women. They will tremble with fear beneath the uplifted hand of the LORD of Hosts, when He brandishes it against them.
aov_text: In dié dag sal die Egiptenaars wees soos die vroue: hulle sal bewe en vrees vir die handgeswaai van die HERE van die leërskare wat Hy teen hulle swaai.

kjv_text: And the land of Judah shall be a terror unto Egypt, every one that maketh mention thereof shall be afraid in himself, because of the counsel of the LORD of hosts, which he hath determined against it.
bsb_text: The land of Judah will bring terror to Egypt; whenever Judah is mentioned, Egypt will tremble over what the LORD of Hosts has planned against it.
aov_text: En die land Juda sal vir die Egiptenaars ’n skrik wees: as iemand daarvan melding maak by hulle, bewe hulle vanweë die besluit van die HERE van die leërskare wat Hy teen hulle geneem het.

kjv_text: In that day shall five cities in the land of Egypt speak the language of Canaan, and swear to the LORD of hosts; one shall be called, The city of destruction.
bsb_text: In that day five cities in the land of Egypt will speak the language of Canaan and swear allegiance to the LORD of Hosts. One of them will be called the City of the Sun.
aov_text: In dié dag sal daar vyf stede in Egipteland wees wat die taal van Kanaän spreek en by die HERE van die leërskare sweer; een sal genoem word: Stad van verwoesting.

kjv_text: In that day shall there be an altar to the LORD in the midst of the land of Egypt, and a pillar at the border thereof to the LORD.
bsb_text: In that day there will be an altar to the LORD in the center of the land of Egypt, and a pillar to the LORD near her border.
aov_text: In dié dag sal daar ’n altaar wees vir die HERE binne-in Egipteland en ’n gedenksteen vir die HERE by die grens.

kjv_text: And it shall be for a sign and for a witness unto the LORD of hosts in the land of Egypt: for they shall cry unto the LORD because of the oppressors, and he shall send them a saviour, and a great one, and he shall deliver them.
bsb_text: It will be a sign and a witness to the LORD of Hosts in the land of Egypt. When they cry out to the LORD because of their oppressors, He will send them a savior and defender to rescue them.
aov_text: En dit sal wees ’n teken en ’n getuie vir die HERE van die leërskare in Egipteland; as hulle die HERE aanroep vanweë die verdrukkers, sal Hy aan hulle ’n redder stuur en ’n stryder wat hulle sal verlos.

kjv_text: And the LORD shall be known to Egypt, and the Egyptians shall know the LORD in that day, and shall do sacrifice and oblation; yea, they shall vow a vow unto the LORD, and perform it.
bsb_text: The LORD will make Himself known to Egypt, and on that day Egypt will acknowledge the LORD. They will worship with sacrifices and offerings; they will make vows to the LORD and fulfill them.
aov_text: En die HERE sal Hom aan die Egiptenaars bekend maak, en die Egiptenaars sal die HERE ken in dié dag; en hulle sal Hom dien met slagoffers en spysoffers en geloftes doen aan die HERE en dit betaal.

kjv_text: And the LORD shall smite Egypt: he shall smite and heal it: and they shall return even to the LORD, and he shall be intreated of them, and shall heal them.
bsb_text: And the LORD will strike Egypt with a plague; He will strike them but heal them. They will turn to the LORD, and He will hear their prayers and heal them.
aov_text: En die HERE sal die Egiptenaars slaan, slaan en genees; en hulle sal hul tot die HERE bekeer, en Hy sal hulle verhoor en hulle genees.

kjv_text: In that day shall there be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria, and the Egyptians shall serve with the Assyrians.
bsb_text: In that day there will be a highway from Egypt to Assyria. The Assyrians will go to Egypt, and the Egyptians to Assyria. The Egyptians and Assyrians will worship together.
aov_text: In dié dag sal daar ’n grootpad wees van Egipte na Assirië, en Assiriërs sal in Egipte kom en Egiptenaars in Assirië; en Egipte sal saam met Assirië die HERE dien.

kjv_text: In that day shall Israel be the third with Egypt and with Assyria, even a blessing in the midst of the land:
bsb_text: In that day Israel will join a three-party alliance with Egypt and Assyria—a blessing upon the earth.
aov_text: In dié dag sal Israel die derde wees naas Egipte en Assirië, ’n seën in die midde van die aarde,

kjv_text: Whom the LORD of hosts shall bless, saying, Blessed be Egypt my people, and Assyria the work of my hands, and Israel mine inheritance.
bsb_text: The LORD of Hosts will bless them, saying, “Blessed be Egypt My people, Assyria My handiwork, and Israel My inheritance.”
aov_text: omdat die HERE van die leërskare hom geseën het, met die woorde: Geseënd is my volk Egipte en my maaksel Assirië en my erfdeel Israel!

kjv_text: In the year that Tartan came unto Ashdod, (when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him,) and fought against Ashdod, and took it;
bsb_text: Before the year that the chief commander, sent by Sargon king of Assyria, came to Ashdod and attacked and captured it,
aov_text: IN die jaar toe die tartan na Asdod gekom het, toe Sargon, die koning van Assirië, hom gestuur het, en hy teen Asdod geveg en dit ingeneem het;

kjv_text: At the same time spake the LORD by Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, Go and loose the sackcloth from off thy loins, and put off thy shoe from thy foot. And he did so, walking naked and barefoot.
bsb_text: the LORD had already spoken through Isaiah son of Amoz, saying, “Go, remove the sackcloth from your waist and the sandals from your feet.” And Isaiah did so, walking around naked and barefoot.
aov_text: in dié tyd het die HERE deur die diens van Jesaja, die seun van Amos, gespreek en gesê: Gaan gord die haarmantel van jou heupe af los, en trek jou skoene van jou voete af. Hy het toe so gedoen en naak en kaalvoet geloop.

kjv_text: And the LORD said, Like as my servant Isaiah hath walked naked and barefoot three years for a sign and wonder upon Egypt and upon Ethiopia;
bsb_text: Then the LORD said, “Just as My servant Isaiah has gone naked and barefoot for three years as a sign and omen against Egypt and Cush,
aov_text: Daarop het die HERE gesê: Soos my kneg Jesaja naak en kaalvoet geloop het, drie jaar lank, as teken en sinnebeeld met betrekking tot Egipte en Kus,

kjv_text: So shall the king of Assyria lead away the Egyptians prisoners, and the Ethiopians captives, young and old, naked and barefoot, even with their buttocks uncovered, to the shame of Egypt.
bsb_text: so the king of Assyria will lead away the captives of Egypt and the exiles of Cush, young and old alike, naked and barefoot, with bared buttocks—to Egypt’s shame.
aov_text: so sal die koning van Assirië die gevangenes van Egipte en die ballinge van Kus wegdrywe, jonk en oud, naak en kaalvoet en ontbloot aan die agterdele—’n smaad vir Egipte.

kjv_text: And they shall be afraid and ashamed of Ethiopia their expectation, and of Egypt their glory.
bsb_text: Those who made Cush their hope and Egypt their boast will be dismayed and ashamed.
aov_text: En hulle sal verslae wees en beskaamd staan vanweë Kus, hulle toeverlaat, en vanweë Egipte, hulle trots.

kjv_text: And the inhabitant of this isle shall say in that day, Behold, such is our expectation, whither we flee for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria: and how shall we escape?
bsb_text: And on that day the dwellers of this coastland will say, ‘See what has happened to our source of hope, those to whom we fled for help and deliverance from the king of Assyria! How then can we escape?’”
aov_text: En die inwoners van hierdie kusland sal in dié dag sê: Kyk, só gaan dit met ons toeverlaat waarheen ons gevlug het om hulp, om gered te word van die koning van Assirië—hoe sal óns dan ontvlug?

kjv_text: The burden of the desert of the sea. As whirlwinds in the south pass through; so it cometh from the desert, from a terrible land.
bsb_text: This is the burden against the Desert by the Sea: Like whirlwinds sweeping through the Negev, an invader comes from the desert, from a land of terror.
aov_text: GODSPRAAK oor die woestyn van die see. Soos stormwinde in die Suidland deurtrek, kom dit uit die woestyn, uit ’n vreeslike land!

kjv_text: A grievous vision is declared unto me; the treacherous dealer dealeth treacherously, and the spoiler spoileth. Go up, O Elam: besiege, O Media; all the sighing thereof have I made to cease.
bsb_text: A dire vision is declared to me: “The traitor still betrays, and the destroyer still destroys. Go up, O Elam! Lay siege, O Media! I will put an end to all her groaning.”
aov_text: ’n Harde gesig is my te kenne gegee: Die ontroue handel troueloos, en die verwoester verwoes. Trek op, Elam! Beleër, Médië! Aan alle gesug maak Ek ’n einde.

kjv_text: Therefore are my loins filled with pain: pangs have taken hold upon me, as the pangs of a woman that travaileth: I was bowed down at the hearing of it; I was dismayed at the seeing of it.
bsb_text: Therefore my body is filled with anguish. Pain grips me, like the pains of a woman in labor. I am bewildered to hear, I am dismayed to see.
aov_text: Daarom is my heupe vol siddering, weë het my aangegryp soos die weë van een wat baar; ek buig my krom, sodat ek nie hoor nie; ek is verskrik, sodat ek nie sien nie.

kjv_text: My heart panted, fearfulness affrighted me: the night of my pleasure hath he turned into fear unto me.
bsb_text: My heart falters; fear makes me tremble. The twilight of my desire has turned to horror.
aov_text: My hart duisel, angs oorval my; dit maak vir my die skemeraand wat ek liefhet, tot ’n verskrikking.

kjv_text: Prepare the table, watch in the watchtower, eat, drink: arise, ye princes, and anoint the shield.
bsb_text: They prepare a table, they lay out a carpet, they eat, they drink! Rise up, O princes, oil the shields!
aov_text: Hulle maak die tafel gereed, hulle sprei die tapyt, hulle eet, drink … . Staan op, o vorste, salf die skild!

kjv_text: For thus hath the LORD said unto me, Go, set a watchman, let him declare what he seeth.
bsb_text: For this is what the Lord says to me: “Go, post a lookout and have him report what he sees.
aov_text: Want so het die Here vir my gesê: Gaan heen, sit ’n wag uit; laat hom te kenne gee wat hy sien;

kjv_text: And he saw a chariot with a couple of horsemen, a chariot of asses, and a chariot of camels; and he hearkened diligently with much heed:
bsb_text: When he sees chariots with teams of horsemen, riders on donkeys, riders on camels, he must be alert, fully alert.”
aov_text: en sien hy ’n stoet ruiters, twee aan twee, ’n stoet esels, ’n stoet kamele, dan moet hy skerp luister, so skerp as hy kan.

kjv_text: And he cried, A lion: My lord, I stand continually upon the watchtower in the daytime, and I am set in my ward whole nights:
bsb_text: Then the lookout shouted: “Day after day, my lord, I stand on the watchtower; night after night I stay at my post.
aov_text: En hy het geroep soos ’n leeu. Op die wagtoring, Here, staan ek gedurig by dag, en op my wagpos stel ek my al die nagte.

kjv_text: And, behold, here cometh a chariot of men, with a couple of horsemen. And he answered and said, Babylon is fallen, is fallen; and all the graven images of her gods he hath broken unto the ground.
bsb_text: Look, here come the riders, horsemen in pairs.” And one answered, saying: “Fallen, fallen is Babylon! All the images of her gods lie shattered on the ground!”
aov_text: En kyk, daar kom ’n stoet manne, ruiters twee aan twee. Toe het hy aangehef en gesê: Geval, geval het Babel, en hulle het al die gesnede beelde van sy gode verbrysel teen die grond.

kjv_text: O my threshing, and the corn of my floor: that which I have heard of the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, have I declared unto you.
bsb_text: O my people, crushed on the threshing floor, I tell you what I have heard from the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel.
aov_text: o My vertrapte en gedorste volk, wat ek gehoor het van die HERE van die leërskare, die God van Israel, het ek julle bekend gemaak.

kjv_text: The burden of Dumah. He calleth to me out of Seir, Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?
bsb_text: This is the burden against Dumah: One calls to me from Seir, “Watchman, what is left of the night? Watchman, what is left of the night?”
aov_text: GODSPRAAK oor Duma. Daar roep een my toe van Seïr af: Wagter, hoe ver is dit in die nag? Wagter, hoe ver in die nag?

kjv_text: The watchman said, The morning cometh, and also the night: if ye will enquire, enquire ye: return, come.
bsb_text: The watchman replies, “Morning has come, but also the night. If you would inquire, then inquire. Come back yet again.”
aov_text: Die wagter sê: Die môre kom, en ook die nag. Wil julle vra, vra; keer terug, kom.

kjv_text: The burden upon Arabia. In the forest in Arabia shall ye lodge, O ye travelling companies of Dedanim.
bsb_text: This is the burden against Arabia: In the thickets of Arabia you must lodge, O caravans of Dedanites.
aov_text: GODSPRAAK teen Arabië. In die bos in Arabië moet julle vernag, karavane van die Dedaniete!

kjv_text: The inhabitants of the land of Tema brought water to him that was thirsty, they prevented with their bread him that fled.
bsb_text: Bring water for the thirsty, O dwellers of Tema; meet the refugees with food.
aov_text: Bring vir die dorstige water tegemoet! Die inwoners van die land Tema het die vlugteling met brood teëgekom.

kjv_text: For they fled from the swords, from the drawn sword, and from the bent bow, and from the grievousness of war.
bsb_text: For they flee from the sword—the sword that is drawn—from the bow that is bent, and from the stress of battle.
aov_text: Want hulle het gevlug vir swaarde, vir die swaard wat uitgetrek en vir die boog wat gespan is, en vir die druk van die oorlog.

kjv_text: For thus hath the LORD said unto me, Within a year, according to the years of an hireling, and all the glory of Kedar shall fail:
bsb_text: For this is what the Lord says to me: “Within one year, as a hired worker would count it, all the glory of Kedar will be gone.
aov_text: Want so het die Here vir my gesê: Binne ’n jaar—soos die jare van ’n dagloner—sal al die heerlikheid van Kedar verdwyn.

kjv_text: And the residue of the number of archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, shall be diminished: for the LORD God of Israel hath spoken it.
bsb_text: The remaining archers, the warriors of Kedar, will be few.” For the LORD, the God of Israel, has spoken.
aov_text: En wat oorbly van die getal boë van die Kedareense helde, sal min wees; want die HERE, die God van Israel, het dit gespreek.

kjv_text: The burden of the valley of vision. What aileth thee now, that thou art wholly gone up to the housetops?
bsb_text: This is the burden against the Valley of Vision: What ails you now, that you have all gone up to the rooftops,
aov_text: GODSPRAAK oor die dal van die gesig. Wat is dit dan met jou dat jy, jou hele bevolking, op die dakke geklim het,

kjv_text: Thou that art full of stirs, a tumultuous city, a joyous city: thy slain men are not slain with the sword, nor dead in battle.
bsb_text: O city of commotion, O town of revelry? Your slain did not die by the sword, nor were they killed in battle.
aov_text: rumoerige, woelige stad, uitgelate vesting? Die wat in jou verslaan is, is nie deur die swaard verslaan en het nie in die oorlog gesterwe nie.

kjv_text: All thy rulers are fled together, they are bound by the archers: all that are found in thee are bound together, which have fled from far.
bsb_text: All your rulers have fled together, captured without a bow. All your fugitives were captured together, having fled to a distant place.
aov_text: Al jou owerstes het almal saam gevlug, sonder boog is hulle gebind; almal wat in jou gegryp is, is almal saam gebind; hulle het ver weggevlug.

kjv_text: Therefore said I, Look away from me; I will weep bitterly, labour not to comfort me, because of the spoiling of the daughter of my people.
bsb_text: Therefore I said, “Turn away from me, let me weep bitterly! Do not try to console me over the destruction of the daughter of my people.”
aov_text: Daarom sê ek: Kyk weg van my af, dat ek bitterlik kan ween; dring nie aan om my te troos oor die verwoesting van die dogter van my volk nie;

kjv_text: For it is a day of trouble, and of treading down, and of perplexity by the Lord GOD of hosts in the valley of vision, breaking down the walls, and of crying to the mountains.
bsb_text: For the Lord GOD of Hosts has set a day of tumult and trampling and confusion in the Valley of Vision—of breaking down the walls and crying to the mountains.
aov_text: want dit is ’n dag van rumoer en vertrapping en verwarring deur die Here, die HERE van die leërskare, in die dal van die gesig—omgooi van mure en geskreeu na die gebergte toe!

kjv_text: And Elam bare the quiver with chariots of men and horsemen, and Kir uncovered the shield.
bsb_text: Elam takes up a quiver, with chariots and horsemen, and Kir uncovers the shield.
aov_text: En Elam het die pylkoker geneem, met waens, manskappe, ruiters; en Kir het die skild ontbloot.

kjv_text: And it shall come to pass, that thy choicest valleys shall be full of chariots, and the horsemen shall set themselves in array at the gate.
bsb_text: Your choicest valleys are full of chariots, and horsemen are posted at the gates.
aov_text: Dan word jou beste dale met strydwaens gevul, en die ruiters staan gereed in die rigting van die poort;

kjv_text: And he discovered the covering of Judah, and thou didst look in that day to the armour of the house of the forest.
bsb_text: He has uncovered the defenses of Judah. On that day you looked to the weapons in the House of the Forest.
aov_text: en die beskutting van Juda word weggeneem. En in dié dag kyk jy na die wapens in die Huis van die Bos,

kjv_text: Ye have seen also the breaches of the city of David, that they are many: and ye gathered together the waters of the lower pool.
bsb_text: You saw that there were many breaches in the walls of the City of David. You collected water from the lower pool.
aov_text: en julle sien die skeure van die stad van Dawid, dat hulle baie is, en julle vang die waters van die Onderste Dam op.

kjv_text: And ye have numbered the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses have ye broken down to fortify the wall.
bsb_text: You counted the houses of Jerusalem and tore them down to strengthen the wall.
aov_text: En julle tel die huise van Jerusalem, en die huise breek julle af om die muur te versterk.

kjv_text: Ye made also a ditch between the two walls for the water of the old pool: but ye have not looked unto the maker thereof, neither had respect unto him that fashioned it long ago.
bsb_text: You built a reservoir between the walls for the waters of the ancient pool, but you did not look to the One who made it, or consider Him who planned it long ago.
aov_text: En julle maak ’n dam tussen die twee mure vir die water van die Ou Dam; maar julle kyk nie na Hom wat dit gedoen het nie, en Hom wat dit lankal beskik het, sien julle nie.

kjv_text: And in that day did the Lord GOD of hosts call to weeping, and to mourning, and to baldness, and to girding with sackcloth:
bsb_text: On that day the Lord GOD of Hosts called for weeping and wailing, for shaven heads and the wearing of sackcloth.
aov_text: En in dié dag roep die Here, die HERE van die leërskare, tot geween en tot rouklag en tot kaalskering en tot omgording van die roukleed;

kjv_text: And behold joy and gladness, slaying oxen, and killing sheep, eating flesh, and drinking wine: let us eat and drink; for to morrow we shall die.
bsb_text: But look, there is joy and gladness, butchering of cattle and slaughtering of sheep, eating of meat and drinking of wine: “Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die!”
aov_text: maar kyk, daar is vreugde en vrolikheid, beeste word doodgemaak en skape geslag, vleis geëet en wyn gedrink, met die woorde: Laat ons eet en drink, want môre sterf ons.

kjv_text: And it was revealed in mine ears by the LORD of hosts, Surely this iniquity shall not be purged from you till ye die, saith the Lord GOD of hosts.
bsb_text: The LORD of Hosts has revealed in my hearing: “Until your dying day, this sin of yours will never be atoned for,” says the Lord GOD of Hosts.
aov_text: Maar die HERE van die leërskare het Hom in my ore geopenbaar en gesê: Waarlik, hierdie ongeregtigheid word vir julle nie versoen totdat julle sterwe nie! sê die Here, die HERE van die leërskare.

kjv_text: Thus saith the Lord GOD of hosts, Go, get thee unto this treasurer, even unto Shebna, which is over the house, and say,
bsb_text: This is what the Lord GOD of Hosts says: “Go, say to Shebna, the steward in charge of the palace:
aov_text: SO sê die Here, die HERE van die leërskare: Kom, gaan in by daardie bestuurder, by Sebna, wat oor die paleis aangestel is, en sê:

kjv_text: What hast thou here? and whom hast thou here, that thou hast hewed thee out a sepulchre here, as he that heweth him out a sepulchre on high, and that graveth an habitation for himself in a rock?
bsb_text: What are you doing here, and who authorized you to carve out a tomb for yourself here—to chisel your tomb in the height and cut your resting place in the rock?
aov_text: Wat het jy hier, en wie het jy hier, dat jy vir jou hier ’n graf uitgekap het soos een wat in die hoogte sy graf uitkap, wat in die rots vir hom ’n woning uithol?

kjv_text: Behold, the LORD will carry thee away with a mighty captivity, and will surely cover thee.
bsb_text: Look, O mighty man! The LORD is about to shake you violently. He will take hold of you,
aov_text: Kyk, die HERE sal jou wegslinger, soos ’n man iets wegslinger, en jou vas inmekaar rol,

kjv_text: He will surely violently turn and toss thee like a ball into a large country: there shalt thou die, and there the chariots of thy glory shall be the shame of thy lord's house.
bsb_text: roll you into a ball, and sling you into a wide land. There you will die, and there your glorious chariots will remain—a disgrace to the house of your master.
aov_text: jou vas inmekaar draai soos ’n tol garing, jou soos ’n bal wegslinger na ’n land wat alkante toe wyd is; daar sal jy sterwe, en daar sal jou pronkwaens wees, o skandvlek van die huis van jou heer!

kjv_text: And I will drive thee from thy station, and from thy state shall he pull thee down.
bsb_text: I will remove you from office, and you will be ousted from your position.
aov_text: En Ek sal jou wegstoot uit jou pos, en uit jou plek sal Hy jou wegruk.

kjv_text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah:
bsb_text: On that day I will summon My servant, Eliakim son of Hilkiah.
aov_text: En in dié dag sal Ek my kneg Éljakim, die seun van Hilkía, roep;

kjv_text: And I will clothe him with thy robe, and strengthen him with thy girdle, and I will commit thy government into his hand: and he shall be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Judah.
bsb_text: I will clothe him with your robe and tie your sash around him. I will put your authority in his hand, and he will be a father to the dwellers of Jerusalem and to the house of Judah.
aov_text: en Ek sal hom jou gewaad aantrek en hom gord met jou gordel, en jou mag sal Ek in sy hand lê, en hy sal vir die inwoners van Jerusalem en vir die huis van Juda ’n vader wees.

kjv_text: And the key of the house of David will I lay upon his shoulder; so he shall open, and none shall shut; and he shall shut, and none shall open.
bsb_text: I will place on his shoulder the key to the house of David. What he opens no one can shut, and what he shuts no one can open.
aov_text: En Ek sal die sleutel van die huis van Dawid op sy skouer lê; en hy sal oopmaak, en niemand sal sluit nie; en hy sal sluit, en niemand sal oopmaak nie.

kjv_text: And I will fasten him as a nail in a sure place; and he shall be for a glorious throne to his father's house.
bsb_text: I will drive him like a peg into a firm place, and he will be a throne of glory for the house of his father.
aov_text: En Ek sal hom inslaan soos ’n pen in ’n vaste plek, en hy sal ’n eretroon wees vir die huis van sy vader.

kjv_text: And they shall hang upon him all the glory of his father's house, the offspring and the issue, all vessels of small quantity, from the vessels of cups, even to all the vessels of flagons.
bsb_text: So they will hang on him all the glory of his father’s house: the descendants and the offshoots—all the lesser vessels, from bowls to every kind of jar.
aov_text: En hulle sal aan hom ophang die hele swaarte van die huis van sy vader, die spruite en die wilde lote, al die klein huisraad, van komme af tot allerhande kruike toe.

kjv_text: In that day, saith the LORD of hosts, shall the nail that is fastened in the sure place be removed, and be cut down, and fall; and the burden that was upon it shall be cut off: for the LORD hath spoken it.
bsb_text: In that day, declares the LORD of Hosts, the peg driven into a firm place will give way; it will be sheared off and fall, and the load upon it will be cut down.” Indeed, the LORD has spoken.
aov_text: In dié dag, spreek die HERE van die leërskare, sal die pen padgee wat in ’n vaste plek ingeslaan is: dit word afgebreek en val, en die drag goed wat daaraan hang, raak tot niet, want die HERE het dit gespreek.

kjv_text: The burden of Tyre. Howl, ye ships of Tarshish; for it is laid waste, so that there is no house, no entering in: from the land of Chittim it is revealed to them.
bsb_text: This is the burden against Tyre: Wail, O ships of Tarshish, for Tyre is laid waste, without house or harbor. Word has reached them from the land of Cyprus.
aov_text: GODSPRAAK oor Tirus. Huil, skepe van Tarsis! want dit is verwoes, sodat daar geen huis, geen terugkeer meer is nie. Uit die land van die Kittiërs het dit aan hulle openbaar geword.

kjv_text: Be still, ye inhabitants of the isle; thou whom the merchants of Zidon, that pass over the sea, have replenished.
bsb_text: Be silent, O dwellers of the coastland, you merchants of Sidon, whose traders have crossed the sea.
aov_text: Staan verstom, inwoners van die kusland! Die koopmans van Sidon wat oor die see vaar, het jou vroëer gevul.

kjv_text: And by great waters the seed of Sihor, the harvest of the river, is her revenue; and she is a mart of nations.
bsb_text: On the great waters came the grain of Shihor; the harvest of the Nile was the revenue of Tyre; she was the merchant of the nations.
aov_text: En op groot waters is die saad van Sigor, die oes van die Nyl, in hom ingebring; en so het hy ’n handelswins vir die nasies geword.

kjv_text: Be thou ashamed, O Zidon: for the sea hath spoken, even the strength of the sea, saying, I travail not, nor bring forth children, neither do I nourish up young men, nor bring up virgins.
bsb_text: Be ashamed, O Sidon, the stronghold of the sea, for the sea has spoken: “I have not been in labor or given birth. I have not raised young men or brought up young women.”
aov_text: Staan beskaamd, Sidon, want die see, die vesting van die see, spreek en sê: Ek het geen weë gehad en nie gebaar nie, en ek het geen jongmanne grootgemaak of jongedogters opgevoed nie.

kjv_text: As at the report concerning Egypt, so shall they be sorely pained at the report of Tyre.
bsb_text: When the report reaches Egypt, they will writhe in agony over the news of Tyre.
aov_text: As die tyding na Egipte kom, beef hulle daar van angs by die tyding aangaande Tirus.

kjv_text: Pass ye over to Tarshish; howl, ye inhabitants of the isle.
bsb_text: Cross over to Tarshish; wail, O inhabitants of the coastland!
aov_text: Vaar na Tarsis oor, huil, inwoners van die kusland!

kjv_text: Is this your joyous city, whose antiquity is of ancient days? her own feet shall carry her afar off to sojourn.
bsb_text: Is this your jubilant city, whose origin is from antiquity, whose feet have taken her to settle far away?
aov_text: Is dít julle uitgelate stad wat in die dae van die voortyd sy oorsprong het, wie se voete hom ver weggedra het om in vreemde lande te vertoef?

kjv_text: Who hath taken this counsel against Tyre, the crowning city, whose merchants are princes, whose traffickers are the honourable of the earth?
bsb_text: Who planned this against Tyre, the bestower of crowns, whose traders are princes, whose merchants are renowned on the earth?
aov_text: Wie het dit besluit oor Tirus, die uitdeler van krone, wie se koopmans vorste, wie se handelaars die edeles van die aarde was?

kjv_text: The LORD of hosts hath purposed it, to stain the pride of all glory, and to bring into contempt all the honourable of the earth.
bsb_text: The LORD of Hosts planned it, to defile all its glorious beauty, to disgrace all the renowned of the earth.
aov_text: Die HERE van die leërskare het dit besluit, om te ontheilig al die pralende trots, om die edeles van die aarde in veragting te bring.

kjv_text: Pass through thy land as a river, O daughter of Tarshish: there is no more strength.
bsb_text: Cultivate your land like the Nile, O Daughter of Tarshish; there is no longer a harbor.
aov_text: Stroom oor jou land soos die Nyl, dogter van Tarsis! Daar is geen gordel meer wat hinder nie.

kjv_text: He stretched out his hand over the sea, he shook the kingdoms: the LORD hath given a commandment against the merchant city, to destroy the strong holds thereof.
bsb_text: The LORD has stretched out His hand over the sea; He has made kingdoms tremble. He has given a command that the strongholds of Canaan be destroyed.
aov_text: Hy het sy hand uitgestrek oor die see, koninkryke laat sidder! Die HERE het bevel gegee met betrekking tot Kanaän, dat sy vestings verwoes moet word.

kjv_text: And he said, Thou shalt no more rejoice, O thou oppressed virgin, daughter of Zidon: arise, pass over to Chittim; there also shalt thou have no rest.
bsb_text: He said, “You shall rejoice no more, O oppressed Virgin Daughter of Sidon. Get up and cross over to Cyprus—even there you will find no rest.”
aov_text: En Hy het gesê: Jy sal verder nie meer uitgelate wees nie, o onteerde jonkvrou, dogter van Sidon! Maak jou klaar, vaar oor na die Kittiërs toe; ook daar sal jy geen rus hê nie.

kjv_text: Behold the land of the Chaldeans; this people was not, till the Assyrian founded it for them that dwell in the wilderness: they set up the towers thereof, they raised up the palaces thereof; and he brought it to ruin.
bsb_text: Look at the land of the Chaldeans—a people now of no account. The Assyrians destined it for the desert creatures; they set up their siege towers and stripped its palaces. They brought it to ruin.
aov_text: Kyk, die land van die Chaldeërs—dit is die volk wat tot niet gegaan het: Assur het dit bestem vir die woestyndiere, het sy wagtorings daarteen opgerig, het die paleise daarvan verwoes, het dit ’n puinhoop gemaak.

kjv_text: Howl, ye ships of Tarshish: for your strength is laid waste.
bsb_text: Wail, O ships of Tarshish, for your harbor has been destroyed!
aov_text: Huil, skepe van Tarsis, want julle vesting is verwoes!

kjv_text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Tyre shall be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king: after the end of seventy years shall Tyre sing as an harlot.
bsb_text: At that time Tyre will be forgotten for seventy years—the span of a king’s life. But at the end of seventy years, it will happen to Tyre as in the song of the harlot:
aov_text: En in dié dag sal Tirus vergeet word, sewentig jaar lank, soos die dae van een koning. Aan die einde van sewentig jaar sal dit met Tirus gaan volgens die hoerelied:

kjv_text: Take an harp, go about the city, thou harlot that hast been forgotten; make sweet melody, sing many songs, that thou mayest be remembered.
bsb_text: “Take up your harp, stroll through the city, O forgotten harlot. Make sweet melody, sing many a song, so you will be remembered.”
aov_text: Neem die siter, gaan rond in die stad, vergete hoer! Speel mooi, sing baie, dat hulle aan jou kan dink.

kjv_text: And it shall come to pass after the end of seventy years, that the LORD will visit Tyre, and she shall turn to her hire, and shall commit fornication with all the kingdoms of the world upon the face of the earth.
bsb_text: And at the end of seventy years, the LORD will restore Tyre. Then she will return to hire as a prostitute and sell herself to all the kingdoms on the face of the earth.
aov_text: En aan die einde van sewentig jaar sal die HERE op Tirus ag gee, en sy sal terugkeer na haar hoereloon en hoereer met al die koninkryke van die aarde wat op die aardbodem is.

kjv_text: And her merchandise and her hire shall be holiness to the LORD: it shall not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise shall be for them that dwell before the LORD, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.
bsb_text: Yet her profits and wages will be set apart to the LORD; they will not be stored or saved, for her profit will go to those who live before the LORD, for abundant food and fine clothing.
aov_text: Maar haar handelswins en haar hoereloon sal aan die HERE heilig wees; dit sal nie opgehoop of weggesit word nie; maar haar wins sal wees vir die wat voor die aangesig van die HERE woon, om te eet tot versadiging en vir pragtige klere.

kjv_text: Behold, the LORD maketh the earth empty, and maketh it waste, and turneth it upside down, and scattereth abroad the inhabitants thereof.
bsb_text: Behold, the LORD lays waste the earth and leaves it in ruins. He will twist its surface and scatter its inhabitants—
aov_text: KYK, die HERE maak die aarde leeg en verwoes dit, en Hy keer sy oppervlakte om en verstrooi sy bewoners.

kjv_text: And it shall be, as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the lender, so with the borrower; as with the taker of usury, so with the giver of usury to him.
bsb_text: people and priest alike, servant and master, maid and mistress, buyer and seller, lender and borrower, creditor and debtor.
aov_text: Dieselfde lot tref die volk en die priester, die slaaf en sy heer, die slavin en haar meesteres, die koper en die verkoper, die uitlener en die lener, die skuldeiser en die skuldenaar.

kjv_text: The land shall be utterly emptied, and utterly spoiled: for the LORD hath spoken this word.
bsb_text: The earth will be utterly laid waste and thoroughly plundered. For the LORD has spoken this word.
aov_text: Die aarde word heeltemal leeg gemaak en heeltemal geplunder, want die HERE het hierdie woord gespreek.

kjv_text: The earth mourneth and fadeth away, the world languisheth and fadeth away, the haughty people of the earth do languish.
bsb_text: The earth mourns and withers; the world languishes and fades; the exalted of the earth waste away.
aov_text: Die aarde treur, dit verwelk; die wêreld versmag, dit verwelk; en die hoogstes van die mense van die aarde versmag.

kjv_text: The earth also is defiled under the inhabitants thereof; because they have transgressed the laws, changed the ordinance, broken the everlasting covenant.
bsb_text: The earth is defiled by its people; they have transgressed the laws; they have overstepped the decrees and broken the everlasting covenant.
aov_text: Want die aarde is ontheilig onder sy bewoners; want hulle het die wette oortree, die insetting geskend, die ewige verbond verbreek.

kjv_text: Therefore hath the curse devoured the earth, and they that dwell therein are desolate: therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men left.
bsb_text: Therefore a curse has consumed the earth, and its inhabitants must bear the guilt; the earth’s dwellers have been burned, and only a few survive.
aov_text: Daarom verteer die vloek die aarde en moet sy bewoners boet; daarom word die bewoners van die aarde deur ’n gloed verteer en bly daar min mense oor.

kjv_text: The new wine mourneth, the vine languisheth, all the merryhearted do sigh.
bsb_text: The new wine dries up, the vine withers. All the merrymakers now groan.
aov_text: Die mos treur, die wingerdstok verwelk, almal wat bly van hart is, sug.

kjv_text: The mirth of tabrets ceaseth, the noise of them that rejoice endeth, the joy of the harp ceaseth.
bsb_text: The joyful tambourines have ceased; the noise of revelers has stopped; the joyful harp is silent.
aov_text: Weg is die vreugde van die tamboeryne, die gedruis van die uitgelate mense hou op, weg is die vreugde van die siter!

kjv_text: They shall not drink wine with a song; strong drink shall be bitter to them that drink it.
bsb_text: They no longer sing and drink wine; strong drink is bitter to those who consume it.
aov_text: Hulle drink geen wyn onder gesang nie; die sterk drank smaak bitter vir die wat dit drink.

kjv_text: The city of confusion is broken down: every house is shut up, that no man may come in.
bsb_text: The city of chaos is shattered; every house is closed to entry.
aov_text: Verbreek is die verlate vesting; al die huise staan toegesluit, sodat niemand daar kan inkom nie.

kjv_text: There is a crying for wine in the streets; all joy is darkened, the mirth of the land is gone.
bsb_text: In the streets they cry out for wine. All joy turns to gloom; rejoicing is exiled from the land.
aov_text: Daar is ’n gejammer oor wyn op die strate; al die vrolikheid het ondergegaan, die vreugde van die aarde is verban.

kjv_text: In the city is left desolation, and the gate is smitten with destruction.
bsb_text: The city is left in ruins; its gate is reduced to rubble.
aov_text: Wat in die stad oorgebly het, is verwoesting; en die poort is tot ’n puinhoop stukkend geslaan.
