kjv_text: When thus it shall be in the midst of the land among the people, there shall be as the shaking of an olive tree, and as the gleaning grapes when the vintage is done.
bsb_text: So will it be on the earth and among the nations, like a harvested olive tree, like a gleaning after a grape harvest.
aov_text: Want so sal dit wees op die aarde, onder die volke, soos by die afslaan van die olywe, soos by die na-oes as die druiwe-oes verby is.

kjv_text: They shall lift up their voice, they shall sing for the majesty of the LORD, they shall cry aloud from the sea.
bsb_text: They raise their voices, they shout for joy; from the west they proclaim the majesty of the LORD.
aov_text: Hulle daar hef hul stem op, hulle jubel; vanweë die majesteit van die HERE juig hulle van die see af:

kjv_text: Wherefore glorify ye the LORD in the fires, even the name of the LORD God of Israel in the isles of the sea.
bsb_text: Therefore glorify the LORD in the east. Extol the name of the LORD, the God of Israel in the islands of the sea.
aov_text: Daarom, eer die HERE in die lande van die son, op die kuslande van die see die Naam van die HERE, die God van Israel!

kjv_text: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs, even glory to the righteous. But I said, My leanness, my leanness, woe unto me! the treacherous dealers have dealt treacherously; yea, the treacherous dealers have dealt very treacherously.
bsb_text: From the ends of the earth we hear singing: “Glory to the Righteous One.” But I said, “I am wasting away! I am wasting away! Woe is me.” The treacherous betray; the treacherous deal in treachery.
aov_text: Van die einde van die aarde af hoor ons lofgesange: Glorie aan die regverdige! Maar ek sê: Ek teer weg, ek teer weg, wee my! Die ontroues handel troueloos, en in troueloosheid handel die ontroues troueloos.

kjv_text: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, are upon thee, O inhabitant of the earth.
bsb_text: Terror and pit and snare await you, O dweller of the earth.
aov_text: Die skrik en die kuil en die strik oor jou, o bewoner van die aarde!

kjv_text: And it shall come to pass, that he who fleeth from the noise of the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that cometh up out of the midst of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for the windows from on high are open, and the foundations of the earth do shake.
bsb_text: Whoever flees the sound of panic will fall into the pit, and whoever climbs from the pit will be caught in the snare. For the windows of heaven are open, and the foundations of the earth are shaken.
aov_text: En hy wat vlug vir die skrikgeroep, val in die kuil; en hy wat uit die kuil uitklim, word in die strik gevang. Want die sluise uit die hoogte het oopgegaan, en die fondamente van die aarde bewe.

kjv_text: The earth is utterly broken down, the earth is clean dissolved, the earth is moved exceedingly.
bsb_text: The earth is utterly broken apart, the earth is split open, the earth is shaken violently.
aov_text: Die aarde word geheel en al verbreek, die aarde is geheel en al aan wankel, die aarde word geheel en al geskud.

kjv_text: The earth shall reel to and fro like a drunkard, and shall be removed like a cottage; and the transgression thereof shall be heavy upon it; and it shall fall, and not rise again.
bsb_text: The earth staggers like a drunkard and sways like a shack. Earth’s rebellion weighs it down, and it falls, never to rise again.
aov_text: Die aarde waggel geheel en al soos ’n dronkaard en swaai heen en weer soos ’n naghut; en sy oortreding is swaar op hom; en hy sal val en nie weer opstaan nie.

kjv_text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the LORD shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth.
bsb_text: In that day the LORD will punish the host of heaven above and the kings of the earth below.
aov_text: En in dié dag sal die HERE besoeking doen oor die leërskare van die hoogte in die hoogte en oor die konings van die aarde op die aarde;

kjv_text: And they shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison, and after many days shall they be visited.
bsb_text: They will be gathered together like prisoners in a pit. They will be confined to a dungeon and punished after many days.
aov_text: en hulle sal opgesluit word soos gevangenes opgesluit word in ’n kuil en bewaar word in ’n kerker; maar ná baie dae sal daar op hulle ag gegee word.

kjv_text: Then the moon shall be confounded, and the sun ashamed, when the LORD of hosts shall reign in mount Zion, and in Jerusalem, and before his ancients gloriously.
bsb_text: The moon will be confounded and the sun will be ashamed; for the LORD of Hosts will reign on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, and before His elders with great glory.
aov_text: En die maan sal rooi word van skaamte, en die son sal skaam wees; want die HERE van die leërskare sal regeer op die berg Sion en in Jerusalem, en voor sy oudstes sal daar heerlikheid wees.

kjv_text: O Lord, thou art my God; I will exalt thee, I will praise thy name; for thou hast done wonderful things; thy counsels of old are faithfulness and truth.
bsb_text: O LORD, You are my God! I will exalt You; I will praise Your name. For You have worked wonders—plans formed long ago—in perfect faithfulness.
aov_text: HERE, U is my God! U sal ek verhoog; u Naam sal ek loof; want U het wonders gedoen, raadsbesluite uit ver tye, waarheid en trou.

kjv_text: For thou hast made of a city an heap; of a defenced city a ruin: a palace of strangers to be no city; it shall never be built.
bsb_text: Indeed, You have made the city a heap of rubble, the fortified town a ruin. The fortress of strangers is a city no more; it will never be rebuilt.
aov_text: Want U het van ’n stad ’n hoop klippe gemaak, van ’n versterkte vesting ’n puinhoop; ’n paleis van vreemdes, dat dit geen stad meer is nie; vir ewig sal dit nie herbou word nie.

kjv_text: Therefore shall the strong people glorify thee, the city of the terrible nations shall fear thee.
bsb_text: Therefore, a strong people will honor You. The cities of ruthless nations will revere You.
aov_text: Daarom sal ’n magtige volk U eer, die vesting van tirannieke nasies U vrees.

kjv_text: For thou hast been a strength to the poor, a strength to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shadow from the heat, when the blast of the terrible ones is as a storm against the wall.
bsb_text: For You have been a refuge for the poor, a stronghold for the needy in distress, a refuge from the storm, a shade from the heat. For the breath of the ruthless is like rain against a wall,
aov_text: Want U was ’n vesting vir die arme, ’n vesting vir die behoeftige toe hy benoud was; ’n skuilplek teen die stortreën, ’n skaduwee teen die hitte—want die geblaas van die tiranne is soos ’n stortreën teen ’n muur.

kjv_text: Thou shalt bring down the noise of strangers, as the heat in a dry place; even the heat with the shadow of a cloud: the branch of the terrible ones shall be brought low.
bsb_text: like heat in a dry land. You subdue the uproar of foreigners. As the shade of a cloud cools the heat, so the song of the ruthless is silenced.
aov_text: Soos hitte in ’n dor land het U die rumoer van vreemdes gedemp, soos hitte deur die skaduwee van ’n wolk; die triomfsang van die tiranne moes verstom.

kjv_text: And in this mountain shall the LORD of hosts make unto all people a feast of fat things, a feast of wines on the lees, of fat things full of marrow, of wines on the lees well refined.
bsb_text: On this mountain the LORD of Hosts will prepare a banquet for all the peoples, a feast of aged wine, of choice meat, of finely aged wine.
aov_text: En die HERE van die leërskare sal op hierdie berg vir al die volke berei ’n maaltyd van vetspyse, ’n maaltyd van ou wyn, van vetspyse vol murg, van gesuiwerde ou wyn.

kjv_text: And he will destroy in this mountain the face of the covering cast over all people, and the vail that is spread over all nations.
bsb_text: On this mountain He will swallow up the shroud that enfolds all peoples, the sheet that covers all nations;
aov_text: En Hy sal op hierdie berg vernietig die uitgespreide sluier wat al die volke omsluier, en die omhulsel waarmee al die nasies bedek is.

kjv_text: He will swallow up death in victory; and the Lord GOD will wipe away tears from off all faces; and the rebuke of his people shall he take away from off all the earth: for the LORD hath spoken it.
bsb_text: He will swallow up death forever. The Lord GOD will wipe away the tears from every face and remove the disgrace of His people from the whole earth. For the LORD has spoken.
aov_text: Hy sal die dood vir ewig vernietig, en die Here HERE sal die trane van alle aangesigte afvee; en Hy sal die smaad van sy volk van die hele aarde af wegneem; want die HERE het dit gespreek.

kjv_text: And it shall be said in that day, Lo, this is our God; we have waited for him, and he will save us: this is the LORD; we have waited for him, we will be glad and rejoice in his salvation.
bsb_text: And in that day it will be said, “Surely this is our God; we have waited for Him, and He has saved us. This is the LORD for whom we have waited. Let us rejoice and be glad in His salvation.”
aov_text: En hulle sal in dié dag sê: Kyk, dit is onse God op wie ons gewag het, dat Hy ons kan verlos; dit is die HERE op wie ons gewag het: laat ons juig en bly wees oor sy hulp.

kjv_text: For in this mountain shall the hand of the LORD rest, and Moab shall be trodden down under him, even as straw is trodden down for the dunghill.
bsb_text: For the hand of the LORD will rest on this mountain. But Moab will be trampled in his place as straw is trodden into the dung pile.
aov_text: Want die hand van die HERE sal rus op hierdie berg; maar Moab sal vertrap word op sy plek soos strooi vertrap word in die water van ’n miskuil.

kjv_text: And he shall spread forth his hands in the midst of them, as he that swimmeth spreadeth forth his hands to swim: and he shall bring down their pride together with the spoils of their hands.
bsb_text: He will spread out his hands within it, as a swimmer spreads his arms to swim. His pride will be brought low, despite the skill of his hands.
aov_text: En as hy sy hande daarin uitsprei soos ’n swemmer dit uitsprei om te swem, dan sal Hy sy trotsheid afdruk tegelyk met die kunsgrepe van sy hande.

kjv_text: And the fortress of the high fort of thy walls shall he bring down, lay low, and bring to the ground, even to the dust.
bsb_text: The high-walled fortress will be brought down, cast to the ground, into the dust.
aov_text: En die steil versterkings van jou mure werp Hy neer, gooi Hy af, laat Hy kom tot op die grond, tot in die stof.

kjv_text: In that day shall this song be sung in the land of Judah; We have a strong city; salvation will God appoint for walls and bulwarks.
bsb_text: In that day this song will be sung in the land of Judah: We have a strong city; salvation is established as its walls and ramparts.
aov_text: IN dié dag sal hierdie lied gesing word in die land Juda: ’n Sterk stad het ons; God stel heil tot mure en skanse.

kjv_text: Open ye the gates, that the righteous nation which keepeth the truth may enter in.
bsb_text: Open the gates so a righteous nation may enter—one that remains faithful.
aov_text: Maak oop die poorte, dat die regverdige nasie kan ingaan wat die trou bewaar!

kjv_text: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.
bsb_text: You will keep in perfect peace the steadfast of mind, because he trusts in You.
aov_text: U sal ’n standvastige gesindheid in volle vrede bewaar, want hulle vertrou op U.

kjv_text: Trust ye in the LORD for ever: for in the LORD JEHOVAH is everlasting strength:
bsb_text: Trust in the LORD forever, because GOD the LORD is the Rock eternal.
aov_text: Vertrou op die HERE vir ewig, want in die Here HERE is ’n ewige rots.

kjv_text: For he bringeth down them that dwell on high; the lofty city, he layeth it low; he layeth it low, even to the ground; he bringeth it even to the dust.
bsb_text: For He has humbled those who dwell on high; He lays the lofty city low. He brings it down to the ground; He casts it into the dust.
aov_text: Want Hy het die bewoners van die hoogte neergewerp, die steil vesting; Hy het dit afgegooi, afgegooi tot by die grond, dit laat kom tot in die stof.

kjv_text: The foot shall tread it down, even the feet of the poor, and the steps of the needy.
bsb_text: Feet trample it down—the feet of the oppressed, the steps of the poor.
aov_text: Die voet vertrap dit, die voete van die ellendige, die voetstappe van die armes.

kjv_text: The way of the just is uprightness: thou, most upright, dost weigh the path of the just.
bsb_text: The path of the righteous is level; You clear a straight path for the upright.
aov_text: Die pad van die regverdige is gelyk; U maak die spoor van die regverdige gelyk.

kjv_text: Yea, in the way of thy judgments, O LORD, have we waited for thee; the desire of our soul is to thy name, and to the remembrance of thee.
bsb_text: Yes, we wait for You, O LORD; we walk in the path of Your judgments. Your name and renown are the desire of our souls.
aov_text: Ook in die weg van u oordele het ons U verwag, o HERE! Tot u Naam en tot u gedenknaam gaan die begeerte van ons siel uit.

kjv_text: With my soul have I desired thee in the night; yea, with my spirit within me will I seek thee early: for when thy judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness.
bsb_text: My soul longs for You in the night; indeed, my spirit seeks You at dawn. For when Your judgments come upon the earth, the people of the world learn righteousness.
aov_text: Met my siel begeer ek U in die nag; ook met my gees in my binneste soek ek U; want as u oordele op die aarde is, leer die inwoners van die wêreld geregtigheid.

kjv_text: Let favour be shewed to the wicked, yet will he not learn righteousness: in the land of uprightness will he deal unjustly, and will not behold the majesty of the LORD.
bsb_text: Though grace is shown to the wicked man, he does not learn righteousness. In the land of righteousness he acts unjustly and fails to see the majesty of the LORD.
aov_text: Word aan die goddelose genade bewys, dan leer hy geen geregtigheid nie; wat onreg is, doen hy in ’n land van reg, en hy sien die hoogheid van die HERE nie.

kjv_text: LORD, when thy hand is lifted up, they will not see: but they shall see, and be ashamed for their envy at the people; yea, the fire of thine enemies shall devour them.
bsb_text: O LORD, Your hand is upraised, but they do not see it. They will see Your zeal for Your people and be put to shame. The fire set for Your enemies will consume them!
aov_text: HERE, is u hand opgehef, hulle sien dit nie; maar hulle sal dit sien en beskaamd staan; die ywer vir die volk, ook die vuur teen u teëstanders sal hulle verteer.

kjv_text: LORD, thou wilt ordain peace for us: for thou also hast wrought all our works in us.
bsb_text: O LORD, You will establish peace for us. For all that we have accomplished, You have done for us.
aov_text: HERE, U sal vir ons vrede beskik, want U het ook al ons werk vir ons volbring.

kjv_text: O LORD our God, other lords beside thee have had dominion over us: but by thee only will we make mention of thy name.
bsb_text: O LORD our God, other lords besides You have had dominion, but Your name alone do we confess.
aov_text: HERE, onse God, ander here buiten U het oor ons geheers, maar deur U alleen prys ons ú Naam.

kjv_text: They are dead, they shall not live; they are deceased, they shall not rise: therefore hast thou visited and destroyed them, and made all their memory to perish.
bsb_text: The dead will not live; the departed spirits will not rise. Therefore You have punished and destroyed them; You have wiped out all memory of them.
aov_text: Dooie mense herlewe nie, skimme staan nie op nie; daarom het U hulle besoek en verdelg en alle gedagtenis aan hulle laat vergaan.

kjv_text: Thou hast increased the nation, O LORD, thou hast increased the nation: thou art glorified: thou hadst removed it far unto all the ends of the earth.
bsb_text: You have enlarged the nation, O LORD; You have enlarged the nation. You have gained glory for Yourself; You have extended all the borders of the land.
aov_text: U het, o HERE, die nasie vermeerder; U het die nasie vermeerder, Uself verheerlik; U het al die grense van die land uitgebrei.

kjv_text: LORD, in trouble have they visited thee, they poured out a prayer when thy chastening was upon them.
bsb_text: O LORD, they sought You in their distress; when You disciplined them, they poured out a quiet prayer.
aov_text: HERE, in benoudheid het hulle U gesoek; hulle het stille gebede uitgegiet toe u tugtiging hulle getref het.

kjv_text: Like as a woman with child, that draweth near the time of her delivery, is in pain, and crieth out in her pangs; so have we been in thy sight, O LORD.
bsb_text: As a woman with child about to give birth writhes and cries out in pain, so were we in Your presence, O LORD.
aov_text: Soos ’n bevrugte vrou wat naby die tyd kom dat sy moet baar, inmekaar krimp, skreeu in haar weë, so was ons vanweë u aangesig, o HERE!

kjv_text: We have been with child, we have been in pain, we have as it were brought forth wind; we have not wrought any deliverance in the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.
bsb_text: We were with child; we writhed in pain; but we gave birth to wind. We have given no salvation to the earth, nor brought any life into the world.
aov_text: Ons was swanger, het weë gehad—dit was asof ons wind gebaar het; ons het die land geen redding aangebring nie, en daar is geen wêreldbewoners gebore nie.

kjv_text: Thy dead men shall live, together with my dead body shall they arise. Awake and sing, ye that dwell in dust: for thy dew is as the dew of herbs, and the earth shall cast out the dead.
bsb_text: Your dead will live; their bodies will rise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust! For your dew is like the dew of the morning, and the earth will bring forth her dead.
aov_text: U dode sal herlewe, my lyke sal opstaan. Waak op en jubel, julle wat in die stof woon! Want u dou is ’n dou van die lig, en die aarde sal aan skimme die lewenslig skenk.

kjv_text: Come, my people, enter thou into thy chambers, and shut thy doors about thee: hide thyself as it were for a little moment, until the indignation be overpast.
bsb_text: Go, my people, enter your rooms and shut your doors behind you. Hide yourselves a little while until the wrath has passed.
aov_text: Kom, my volk, gaan in jou binnekamers en sluit jou deur agter jou toe, verberg jou vir ’n klein oomblik, totdat die grimmigheid verbygaan.

kjv_text: For, behold, the LORD cometh out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity: the earth also shall disclose her blood, and shall no more cover her slain.
bsb_text: For behold, the LORD is coming out of His dwelling to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity. The earth will reveal her bloodshed and will no longer conceal her slain.
aov_text: Want kyk, die HERE sal uit sy plek uitgaan om die ongeregtigheid van die bewoners van die aarde oor hulle te besoek; en die aarde sal die bloed openbaar maak wat deur hom gedrink is, en die wat op hom gedood is, nie langer toedek nie.

kjv_text: In that day the LORD with his sore and great and strong sword shall punish leviathan the piercing serpent, even leviathan that crooked serpent; and he shall slay the dragon that is in the sea.
bsb_text: In that day the LORD will take His sharp, great, and mighty sword, and bring judgment on Leviathan the fleeing serpent—Leviathan the coiling serpent—and He will slay the dragon of the sea.
aov_text: IN dié dag sal die HERE met sy harde en groot en sterk swaard besoeking doen oor die Leviátan, die vinnige slang, en oor die Leviátan, die kronkelende slang; en Hy sal die draak doodmaak wat in die groot water is.

kjv_text: In that day sing ye unto her, A vineyard of red wine.
bsb_text: In that day: “Sing about a fruitful vineyard.
aov_text: In dié dag sal daar wees ’n wingerd van skuimende wyn—sing daarvan!

kjv_text: I the LORD do keep it; I will water it every moment: lest any hurt it, I will keep it night and day.
bsb_text: I, the LORD, am its keeper; I water it continually. I guard it night and day so no one can disturb it;
aov_text: Ek, die HERE, bewaak dit: elke oomblik sal Ek hom bevogtig; Ek sal hom nag en dag bewaak, sodat niks hom kan tref nie.

kjv_text: Fury is not in me: who would set the briers and thorns against me in battle? I would go through them, I would burn them together.
bsb_text: I am not angry. If only thorns and briers confronted Me, I would march and trample them, I would burn them to the ground.
aov_text: Geen grimmigheid is by My nie. Kry Ek doring of distel, in oorlog sou Ek daarop aanval, dit alles saam verbrand.

kjv_text: Or let him take hold of my strength, that he may make peace with me; and he shall make peace with me.
bsb_text: Or let them lay claim to My protection; let them make peace with Me—yes, let them make peace with Me.”
aov_text: Of hulle moet my beskutting aangryp, vrede met My maak, vrede met My maak.

kjv_text: He shall cause them that come of Jacob to take root: Israel shall blossom and bud, and fill the face of the world with fruit.
bsb_text: In the days to come, Jacob will take root. Israel will bud and blossom and fill the whole world with fruit.
aov_text: In die dae wat kom, sal Jakob wortel skiet, Israel sal bloei en uitbot, sodat hulle die wêreld vol vrugte sal maak.

kjv_text: Hath he smitten him, as he smote those that smote him? or is he slain according to the slaughter of them that are slain by him?
bsb_text: Has the LORD struck Israel as He struck her oppressors? Was she killed like those who slayed her?
aov_text: Het Hy hom geslaan met die slag wat sy teëstander getref het? Of is hy gedood met ’n slagting soos die wat deur Hom gedood is?

kjv_text: In measure, when it shooteth forth, thou wilt debate with it: he stayeth his rough wind in the day of the east wind.
bsb_text: By warfare and exile You contended with her and removed her with a fierce wind, as on the day the east wind blows.
aov_text: Met mate het U met hom afgereken toe U hom verstoot het; Hy het hom verdrywe met sy geweldige wind op die dag van die oostewind.

kjv_text: By this therefore shall the iniquity of Jacob be purged; and this is all the fruit to take away his sin; when he maketh all the stones of the altar as chalkstones that are beaten in sunder, the groves and images shall not stand up.
bsb_text: Therefore Jacob’s guilt will be atoned for, and the full fruit of the removal of his sin will be this: When he makes all the altar stones like crushed bits of chalk, no Asherah poles or incense altars will remain standing.
aov_text: Daarom sal hiermee die skuld van Jakob versoen word, en dit is die volle vrug van die wegneming van sy sonde: as hy al die altaarklippe maak soos verbryselde kalkklippe, die heilige boomstamme en die sonpilare nie meer oprys nie.

kjv_text: Yet the defenced city shall be desolate, and the habitation forsaken, and left like a wilderness: there shall the calf feed, and there shall he lie down, and consume the branches thereof.
bsb_text: For the fortified city lies deserted—a homestead abandoned, a wilderness forsaken. There the calves graze, and there they lie down; they strip its branches bare.
aov_text: Want die versterkte stad is eensaam, ’n woning wat ontvolk en verlate is soos die woestyn; daar wei kalwers en daar lê hulle, en hulle eet sy takke af.

kjv_text: When the boughs thereof are withered, they shall be broken off: the women come, and set them on fire: for it is a people of no understanding: therefore he that made them will not have mercy on them, and he that formed them will shew them no favour.
bsb_text: When its limbs are dry, they are broken off. Women come and use them for kindling; for this is a people without understanding. Therefore their Maker has no compassion on them, and their Creator shows them no favor.
aov_text: As sy takke verdor het, word hulle afgebreek; vroue kom en steek dit aan die brand; want dit is ’n volk sonder verstand. Daarom sal hulle Maker Hom nie oor hulle ontferm nie en sal hulle Formeerder aan hulle geen genade bewys nie.

kjv_text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the LORD shall beat off from the channel of the river unto the stream of Egypt, and ye shall be gathered one by one, O ye children of Israel.
bsb_text: In that day the LORD will thresh from the flowing Euphrates to the Wadi of Egypt, and you, O Israelites, will be gathered one by one.
aov_text: En in dié dag sal die HERE vrugte afslaan, van die stroom van die Eufraat af tot by die spruit van Egipte, en júlle sal ingesamel word, een vir een, o kinders van Israel!

kjv_text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the great trumpet shall be blown, and they shall come which were ready to perish in the land of Assyria, and the outcasts in the land of Egypt, and shall worship the LORD in the holy mount at Jerusalem.
bsb_text: And in that day a great ram’s horn will sound, and those who were perishing in Assyria will come forth with those who were exiles in Egypt. And they will worship the LORD on the holy mountain in Jerusalem.
aov_text: En in dié dag sal daar met ’n groot basuin geblaas word; dan sal kom die wat verlore is in die land Assur en die wat verdryf is in Egipteland, en hulle sal die HERE aanbid op die heilige berg in Jerusalem.

kjv_text: Woe to the crown of pride, to the drunkards of Ephraim, whose glorious beauty is a fading flower, which are on the head of the fat valleys of them that are overcome with wine!
bsb_text: Woe to the majestic crown of Ephraim’s drunkards, to the fading flower of his glorious splendor, set on the summit above the fertile valley, the pride of those overcome by wine.
aov_text: WEE die trotse kroon van die dronkaards van Efraim, en wee die blom wat verwelk, sy pronksieraad, wat daar is op die top van die vrugbare dal van hulle wat deur die wyn verslaan is.

kjv_text: Behold, the Lord hath a mighty and strong one, which as a tempest of hail and a destroying storm, as a flood of mighty waters overflowing, shall cast down to the earth with the hand.
bsb_text: Behold, the Lord has one who is strong and mighty. Like a hailstorm or destructive tempest, like a driving rain or flooding downpour, he will smash that crown to the ground.
aov_text: Kyk, die Here het een wat sterk en magtig is, soos ’n haelstorm, ’n storm vol verwoesting, soos ’n stortbui van geweldige, oorlopende waters wat teen die grond gooi met krag.

kjv_text: The crown of pride, the drunkards of Ephraim, shall be trodden under feet:
bsb_text: The majestic crown of Ephraim’s drunkards will be trampled underfoot.
aov_text: Met voete sal vertrap word die trotse kroon van die dronkaards van Efraim;

kjv_text: And the glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fat valley, shall be a fading flower, and as the hasty fruit before the summer; which when he that looketh upon it seeth, while it is yet in his hand he eateth it up.
bsb_text: The fading flower of his beautiful splendor, set on the summit above the fertile valley, will be like a ripe fig before the summer harvest: Whoever sees it will take it in his hand and swallow it.
aov_text: en die blom wat verwelk, sy pronksieraad, wat daar is op die top van die vrugbare dal, sal wees soos ’n voorvy voor die vrugte-oes: iemand sien dit skaars of, terwyl dit nog in sy hand is, sluk hy dit weg.

kjv_text: In that day shall the LORD of hosts be for a crown of glory, and for a diadem of beauty, unto the residue of his people,
bsb_text: On that day the LORD of Hosts will be a crown of glory, a diadem of splendor to the remnant of His people,
aov_text: In dié dag sal die HERE van die leërskare wees tot ’n sierlike kroon en ’n pragtige krans vir die oorblyfsel van sy volk,

kjv_text: And for a spirit of judgment to him that sitteth in judgment, and for strength to them that turn the battle to the gate.
bsb_text: a spirit of justice to him who sits in judgment, and a strength to those who repel the onslaught at the gate.
aov_text: en tot ’n gees van strafgerig vir hom wat sit oor die gereg, en tot ’n sterkte vir hulle wat die geveg terugdring na die poort toe.

kjv_text: But they also have erred through wine, and through strong drink are out of the way; the priest and the prophet have erred through strong drink, they are swallowed up of wine, they are out of the way through strong drink; they err in vision, they stumble in judgment.
bsb_text: These also stagger from wine and stumble from strong drink: Priests and prophets reel from strong drink and are befuddled by wine. They stumble because of strong drink, muddled in their visions and stumbling in their judgments.
aov_text: En ook die manne hier wankel deur die wyn en waggel deur sterk drank; priester en profeet wankel deur sterk drank, hulle is verward van die wyn, hulle waggel van sterk drank, hulle wankel as hulle gesigte sien, hulle waggel by die regspraak.

kjv_text: For all tables are full of vomit and filthiness, so that there is no place clean.
bsb_text: For all their tables are covered with vomit; there is not a place without filth.
aov_text: Want al die tafels is vol walglike uitbraaksel, sodat daar geen plek is nie.

kjv_text: Whom shall he teach knowledge? and whom shall he make to understand doctrine? them that are weaned from the milk, and drawn from the breasts.
bsb_text: Whom is He trying to teach? To whom is He explaining His message? To infants just weaned from milk? To babies removed from the breast?
aov_text: Vir wie wil hy dan kennis leer, en vir wie wil hy die openbaring verstaanbaar maak? Vir die wat van die melk gespeen, wat van die moederborste weggeneem is?

kjv_text: For precept must be upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little, and there a little:
bsb_text: For they hear: “Order on order, order on order, line on line, line on line; a little here, a little there.”
aov_text: Want dit is gebod op gebod, gebod op gebod, reël op reël, reël op reël, hier ’n bietjie, daar ’n bietjie.

kjv_text: For with stammering lips and another tongue will he speak to this people.
bsb_text: Indeed, with mocking lips and foreign tongues, He will speak to this people
aov_text: Ja, Hy sal deur lippe wat hakkel, en deur ’n vreemde tong met hierdie volk spreek,

kjv_text: To whom he said, This is the rest wherewith ye may cause the weary to rest; and this is the refreshing: yet they would not hear.
bsb_text: to whom He has said: “This is the place of rest, let the weary rest; this is the place of repose.” But they would not listen.
aov_text: Hy wat aan hulle gesê het: Dit is die rus, gee rus aan die vermoeides, en dit is die verkwikking. Maar hulle wou nie luister nie.

kjv_text: But the word of the LORD was unto them precept upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little, and there a little; that they might go, and fall backward, and be broken, and snared, and taken.
bsb_text: Then the word of the LORD to them will become: “Order on order, order on order, line on line, line on line; a little here, a little there,” so that they will go stumbling backward and will be injured, ensnared, and captured.
aov_text: Daarom sal die woord van die HERE vir hulle wees gebod op gebod, gebod op gebod, reël op reël, reël op reël, hier ’n bietjie, daar ’n bietjie, sodat hulle kan heengaan en agteruit struikel en verbreek en verstrik en gevang word.

kjv_text: Wherefore hear the word of the LORD, ye scornful men, that rule this people which is in Jerusalem.
bsb_text: Therefore hear the word of the LORD, O scoffers who rule this people in Jerusalem.
aov_text: Daarom, hoor die woord van die HERE, julle spotters, heersers oor hierdie volk wat in Jerusalem is!

kjv_text: Because ye have said, We have made a covenant with death, and with hell are we at agreement; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, it shall not come unto us: for we have made lies our refuge, and under falsehood have we hid ourselves:
bsb_text: For you said, “We have made a covenant with death; we have fashioned an agreement with Sheol. When the overwhelming scourge passes through it will not touch us, because we have made lies our refuge and falsehood our hiding place.”
aov_text: Omdat julle sê: Ons het ’n verbond met die dood gesluit, en met die doderyk het ons ’n verdrag aangegaan; as die golwende gésel deurtrek, sal hy na ons nie kom nie; want ons het die leuen ons skuilplek gemaak en ons in bedrog weggesteek —

kjv_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD, Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious corner stone, a sure foundation: he that believeth shall not make haste.
bsb_text: So this is what the Lord GOD says: “See, I lay a stone in Zion, a tested stone, a precious cornerstone, a sure foundation; the one who believes will never be shaken.
aov_text: daarom, so sê die Here HERE: Kyk, Ek lê in Sion ’n grondsteen, ’n beproefde steen, ’n kosbare hoeksteen wat vas gegrondves is; hy wat glo, sal nie haastig wees nie.

kjv_text: Judgment also will I lay to the line, and righteousness to the plummet: and the hail shall sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters shall overflow the hiding place.
bsb_text: I will make justice the measuring line and righteousness the level. Hail will sweep away your refuge of lies, and water will flood your hiding place.
aov_text: En Ek sal die reg tot ’n riglyn maak, en die geregtigheid tot ’n skietlood; en die hael sal die leuendak wegruk en die water die skuilplek wegspoel.

kjv_text: And your covenant with death shall be disannulled, and your agreement with hell shall not stand; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, then ye shall be trodden down by it.
bsb_text: Your covenant with death will be dissolved, and your agreement with Sheol will not stand. When the overwhelming scourge passes through, you will be trampled by it.
aov_text: En julle verbond met die dood sal uitgewis word, en julle verdrag met die doderyk nie standhou nie; as die golwende gésel deurtrek, sal julle deur hom vertrap word.

kjv_text: From the time that it goeth forth it shall take you: for morning by morning shall it pass over, by day and by night: and it shall be a vexation only to understand the report.
bsb_text: As often as it passes through, it will carry you away; it will sweep through morning after morning, by day and by night.” The understanding of this message will bring sheer terror.
aov_text: So dikwels as hy deurtrek, sal hy julle gryp; want môre vir môre sal hy deurtrek, by dag en by nag. En dit sal net verskrikking wees om so ’n openbaring te verneem.

kjv_text: For the bed is shorter than that a man can stretch himself on it: and the covering narrower than that he can wrap himself in it.
bsb_text: Indeed, the bed is too short to stretch out on, and the blanket too small to wrap around you.
aov_text: Want die bed sal te kort wees dat iemand hom daarop kan uitrek, en die kombers te smal dat iemand hom daarin kan toedraai.

kjv_text: For the LORD shall rise up as in mount Perazim, he shall be wroth as in the valley of Gibeon, that he may do his work, his strange work; and bring to pass his act, his strange act.
bsb_text: For the LORD will rise up as at Mount Perazim. He will rouse Himself as in the Valley of Gibeon, to do His work, His strange work, and to perform His task, His disturbing task.
aov_text: Want die HERE sal Hom gereed maak soos by die berg Pérasim; Hy sal aanstorm soos in die dal by Gíbeon om sy werk te doen—vreemd is sy werk! En om sy daad te verrig—ongehoord is sy daad!

kjv_text: Now therefore be ye not mockers, lest your bands be made strong: for I have heard from the Lord GOD of hosts a consumption, even determined upon the whole earth.
bsb_text: So now, do not mock, or your shackles will become heavier. Indeed, I have heard from the Lord GOD of Hosts a decree of destruction against the whole land.
aov_text: Gedra julle dan nou nie soos spotters, dat julle bande nie vaster word nie; want ek het van die Here HERE van die leërskare gehoor ’n verdelging wat vas besluit is, oor die hele aarde.

kjv_text: Give ye ear, and hear my voice; hearken, and hear my speech.
bsb_text: Listen and hear my voice. Pay attention and hear what I say.
aov_text: Luister, en hoor na my stem; let op, en hoor my woord!

kjv_text: Doth the plowman plow all day to sow? doth he open and break the clods of his ground?
bsb_text: Does the plowman plow for planting every day? Does he continuously loosen and harrow the soil?
aov_text: Ploeg die ploeër die hele dag om te saai? Skeur hy sy akker oop, en eg hy die hele dag?

kjv_text: When he hath made plain the face thereof, doth he not cast abroad the fitches, and scatter the cummin, and cast in the principal wheat and the appointed barley and the rie in their place?
bsb_text: When he has leveled its surface, does he not sow caraway and scatter cumin? He plants wheat in rows and barley in plots, and rye within its border.
aov_text: Is dit nie só nie: As hy dit bo-op gelykgemaak het, gooi hy swart komyn uit en strooi komyn en saai koring in rye en gars in vakke en spelt langs die kant.

kjv_text: For his God doth instruct him to discretion, and doth teach him.
bsb_text: For his God instructs and teaches him properly.
aov_text: En sy God het hom onderrig hoe om dit te doen, Hy leer hom.

kjv_text: For the fitches are not threshed with a threshing instrument, neither is a cart wheel turned about upon the cummin; but the fitches are beaten out with a staff, and the cummin with a rod.
bsb_text: Surely caraway is not threshed with a sledge, and the wheel of a cart is not rolled over the cumin. But caraway is beaten out with a stick, and cumin with a rod.
aov_text: Want swart komyn word nie met die slee gedors nie, en die wawiel word nie oor komyn gerol nie; maar swart komyn word uitgeslaan met ’n stok en komyn met ’n hout.

kjv_text: Bread corn is bruised; because he will not ever be threshing it, nor break it with the wheel of his cart, nor bruise it with his horsemen.
bsb_text: Grain for bread must be ground, but it is not endlessly threshed. Though the wheels of the cart roll over it, the horses do not crush it.
aov_text: Word broodkoring fyngestamp? Nee, nie altyddeur dors hulle dit nie; en al dryf hulle die wawiel en die perde daaroor—hulle stamp dit nie fyn nie.

kjv_text: This also cometh forth from the LORD of hosts, which is wonderful in counsel, and excellent in working.
bsb_text: This also comes from the LORD of Hosts, who is wonderful in counsel and excellent in wisdom.
aov_text: Ook dit kom van die HERE van die leërskare: Hy is wonderbaar van raad, groot van beleid.

kjv_text: Woe to Ariel, to Ariel, the city where David dwelt! add ye year to year; let them kill sacrifices.
bsb_text: Woe to you, O Ariel, the city of Ariel where David camped! Year upon year let your festivals recur.
aov_text: WEE Áriël, Áriël, stad waar Dawid laer opgeslaan het! Voeg jaar by jaar; laat die feeste hulle kringloop volbring —

kjv_text: Yet I will distress Ariel, and there shall be heaviness and sorrow: and it shall be unto me as Ariel.
bsb_text: And I will constrain Ariel, and there will be mourning and lamentation; she will be like an altar hearth before Me.
aov_text: dan sal Ek Áriël benoud maak, en daar sal geklaag en geklag wees, en dit sal vir My soos Áriël wees.

kjv_text: And I will camp against thee round about, and will lay siege against thee with a mount, and I will raise forts against thee.
bsb_text: I will camp in a circle around you; I will besiege you with towers and set up siege works against you.
aov_text: En Ek sal in ’n kring teen jou laer opslaan en jou met wagposte beleër en skanse teen jou oprig.

kjv_text: And thou shalt be brought down, and shalt speak out of the ground, and thy speech shall be low out of the dust, and thy voice shall be, as of one that hath a familiar spirit, out of the ground, and thy speech shall whisper out of the dust.
bsb_text: You will be brought low, you will speak from the ground, and out of the dust your words will be muffled. Your voice will be like a spirit from the ground; your speech will whisper out of the dust.
aov_text: Dan sal jy diep uit die grond spreek, en op dowwe toon sal jou woord uit die stof voortkom; en jou stem sal uit die grond opkom soos dié van die gees van ’n afgestorwene, en uit die stof sal jou woord piep.

kjv_text: Moreover the multitude of thy strangers shall be like small dust, and the multitude of the terrible ones shall be as chaff that passeth away: yea, it shall be at an instant suddenly.
bsb_text: But your many foes will be like fine dust, the multitude of the ruthless like blowing chaff. Then suddenly, in an instant,
aov_text: Maar die menigte van jou vyande sal word soos dun stof, en die menigte van die tiranne soos kaf wat wegwaai; en dit sal heeltemal onverwags gebeur.

kjv_text: Thou shalt be visited of the LORD of hosts with thunder, and with earthquake, and great noise, with storm and tempest, and the flame of devouring fire.
bsb_text: you will be visited by the LORD of Hosts with thunder and earthquake and loud noise, with windstorm and tempest and consuming flame of fire.
aov_text: Vanweë die HERE van die leërskare sal jy in genade besoek word, met donder en aardbewing en groot gedruis, wind en storm en die vlam van ’n verterende vuur.

kjv_text: And the multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, even all that fight against her and her munition, and that distress her, shall be as a dream of a night vision.
bsb_text: All the many nations going out to battle against Ariel—even all who war against her, laying siege and attacking her—will be like a dream, like a vision in the night,
aov_text: En soos ’n droom, ’n naggesig, sal die menigte van al die nasies wees wat oorlog toe trek teen Áriël, ja, almal wat teen hom oorlog toe trek en teen sy bergvesting en hom benoud maak.

kjv_text: It shall even be as when an hungry man dreameth, and, behold, he eateth; but he awaketh, and his soul is empty: or as when a thirsty man dreameth, and, behold, he drinketh; but he awaketh, and, behold, he is faint, and his soul hath appetite: so shall the multitude of all the nations be, that fight against mount Zion.
bsb_text: as when a hungry man dreams he is eating, then awakens still hungry; as when a thirsty man dreams he is drinking, then awakens faint and parched. So will it be for all the many nations who go to battle against Mount Zion.
aov_text: En soos ’n hongerige droom dat hy eet, maar hy word wakker en—sy siel is leeg; en soos ’n dorstige droom dat hy drink, maar hy word wakker en—hy is moeg en sy siel versmag: só sal die menigte van al die nasies wees wat oorlog toe trek teen die berg Sion.

kjv_text: Stay yourselves, and wonder; cry ye out, and cry: they are drunken, but not with wine; they stagger, but not with strong drink.
bsb_text: Stop and be astonished; blind yourselves and be sightless; be drunk, but not with wine; stagger, but not from strong drink.
aov_text: Vertoef, en verwonder julle! Wees blind en verblind! Hulle is dronk, maar nie van wyn nie; hulle waggel, maar nie van sterk drank nie.

kjv_text: For the LORD hath poured out upon you the spirit of deep sleep, and hath closed your eyes: the prophets and your rulers, the seers hath he covered.
bsb_text: For the LORD has poured out on you a spirit of deep sleep. He has shut your eyes, O prophets; He has covered your heads, O seers.
aov_text: Want die HERE het oor julle uitgegiet ’n gees van diepe slaap, en Hy het julle oë—die profete—toegesluit en julle hoofde—die sieners—toegebind.

kjv_text: And the vision of all is become unto you as the words of a book that is sealed, which men deliver to one that is learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee: and he saith, I cannot; for it is sealed:
bsb_text: And the entire vision will be to you like the words sealed in a scroll. If it is handed to someone to read, he will say, “I cannot, because it is sealed.”
aov_text: So het dan die gesig van al hierdie dinge vir julle geword soos die woorde van ’n verseëlde boek wat hulle gee aan iemand wat kan lees, met die woorde: Lees dit tog! Maar hy sê: Ek kan nie, want dit is verseël.

kjv_text: And the book is delivered to him that is not learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee: and he saith, I am not learned.
bsb_text: Or if the scroll is handed to one unable to read, he will say, “I cannot read.”
aov_text: Of hulle gee die boek aan iemand wat nie kan lees nie, met die woorde: Lees dit tog! Maar hy sê: Ek kan nie lees nie.

kjv_text: Wherefore the Lord said, Forasmuch as this people draw near me with their mouth, and with their lips do honour me, but have removed their heart far from me, and their fear toward me is taught by the precept of men:
bsb_text: Therefore the Lord said: “These people draw near to Me with their mouths and honor Me with their lips, but their hearts are far from Me. Their worship of Me is but rules taught by men.
aov_text: En die Here het gesê: Omdat hierdie volk nader kom met hulle mond en My eer met hulle lippe, terwyl hulle hul hart ver van My hou, sodat hulle vrees vir My ’n aangeleerde mensegebod is,

kjv_text: Therefore, behold, I will proceed to do a marvellous work among this people, even a marvellous work and a wonder: for the wisdom of their wise men shall perish, and the understanding of their prudent men shall be hid.
bsb_text: Therefore I will again confound these people with wonder upon wonder. The wisdom of the wise will vanish, and the intelligence of the intelligent will be hidden.”
aov_text: daarom sal Ek voortgaan om wonderlik te handel met hierdie volk, wonderlik en wonderbaar; en die wysheid van hulle wyse manne sal vergaan, en die verstand van hulle verstandige mense sal wegskuil.

kjv_text: Woe unto them that seek deep to hide their counsel from the LORD, and their works are in the dark, and they say, Who seeth us? and who knoweth us?
bsb_text: Woe to those who dig deep to hide their plans from the LORD. In darkness they do their works and say, “Who sees us, and who will know?”
aov_text: Wee hulle wat planne diep verberg vir die HERE, wie se werk in duisternis plaasvind; en hulle sê: Wie sien ons en wie ken ons?

kjv_text: Surely your turning of things upside down shall be esteemed as the potter's clay: for shall the work say of him that made it, He made me not? or shall the thing framed say of him that framed it, He had no understanding?
bsb_text: You have turned things upside down, as if the potter were regarded as clay. Shall what is formed say to him who formed it, “He did not make me”? Can the pottery say of the potter, “He has no understanding”?
aov_text: o Julle verkeerdheid! Of moet die pottebakker beskou word as klei, dat die maaksel van sy maker kan sê: Hy het my nie gemaak nie, en die vormsel van sy vormer kan sê: Hy het geen verstand nie?

kjv_text: Is it not yet a very little while, and Lebanon shall be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field shall be esteemed as a forest?
bsb_text: In a very short time, will not Lebanon become an orchard, and the orchard seem like a forest?
aov_text: Sal dit nie nog ’n baie kort rukkie duur dat die Líbanon in ’n vrugteboord verander word, en die vrugteboord vir ’n bos gereken word nie?

kjv_text: And in that day shall the deaf hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind shall see out of obscurity, and out of darkness.
bsb_text: On that day the deaf will hear the words of the scroll, and out of the deep darkness the eyes of the blind will see.
aov_text: En in dié dag sal die dowes Skrifwoorde hoor, en uit donkerheid en duisternis sal die oë van die blindes sien.

kjv_text: The meek also shall increase their joy in the LORD, and the poor among men shall rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.
bsb_text: The humble will increase their joy in the LORD, and the poor among men will rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.
aov_text: En die ootmoediges sal vreugde op vreugde smaak in die HERE, en die behoeftiges onder die mense sal juig in die Heilige van Israel.

kjv_text: For the terrible one is brought to nought, and the scorner is consumed, and all that watch for iniquity are cut off:
bsb_text: For the ruthless will vanish, the mockers will disappear, and all who look for evil will be cut down—
aov_text: Want gedaan is dit met die tiran, en klaar is dit met die spotter, en uitgeroei is almal wat op ongeregtigheid bedag is —

kjv_text: That make a man an offender for a word, and lay a snare for him that reproveth in the gate, and turn aside the just for a thing of nought.
bsb_text: those who indict a man with a word, who ensnare the mediator at the gate, and who with false charges deprive the innocent of justice.
aov_text: hulle wat ’n mens as sondaar brandmerk ter wille van ’n woord, en strikke span vir hom wat vir die reg opkom in die poort, en die regverdige met nietige voorwendsels wegstoot.

kjv_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD, who redeemed Abraham, concerning the house of Jacob, Jacob shall not now be ashamed, neither shall his face now wax pale.
bsb_text: Therefore the LORD who redeemed Abraham says of the house of Jacob: “No longer will Jacob be ashamed and no more will his face grow pale.
aov_text: Daarom, so sê die HERE tot die huis van Jakob, Hy wat Abraham verlos het: Jakob sal nou nie meer beskaamd staan nie, en nou sal sy aangesig nie meer bleek word nie;

kjv_text: But when he seeth his children, the work of mine hands, in the midst of him, they shall sanctify my name, and sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and shall fear the God of Israel.
bsb_text: For when he sees his children around him, the work of My hands, they will honor My name, they will sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and they will stand in awe of the God of Israel.
aov_text: want as hy, as sy kinders die werk van my hande in sy midde sien, sal hulle my Naam heilig; ja, hulle sal die Heilige van Jakob heilig en vir die God van Israel met ontsag vervul wees;

kjv_text: They also that erred in spirit shall come to understanding, and they that murmured shall learn doctrine.
bsb_text: Then the wayward in spirit will come to understanding, and those who grumble will accept instruction.”
aov_text: en hulle wat dwalende van gees is, sal insig verkry, en die murmureerders sal lering aanneem.

kjv_text: Woe to the rebellious children, saith the LORD, that take counsel, but not of me; and that cover with a covering, but not of my spirit, that they may add sin to sin:
bsb_text: “Woe to the rebellious children,” declares the LORD, “to those who carry out a plan that is not Mine, who form an alliance, but against My will, heaping up sin upon sin.
aov_text: WEE die opstandige kinders, spreek die HERE, wat ’n plan uitvoer, maar dit is nie uit My nie; wat ’n verbond sluit, en dit is nie uit my Gees nie, om sonde op sonde te stapel;

kjv_text: That walk to go down into Egypt, and have not asked at my mouth; to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to trust in the shadow of Egypt!
bsb_text: They set out to go down to Egypt without asking My advice, to seek shelter under Pharaoh’s protection and take refuge in Egypt’s shade.
aov_text: wat gaan om na Egipte af te trek, en hulle raadpleeg my mond nie, om toevlug te soek onder die beskutting van Farao en om te skuil in die skaduwee van Egipte.

kjv_text: Therefore shall the strength of Pharaoh be your shame, and the trust in the shadow of Egypt your confusion.
bsb_text: But Pharaoh’s protection will become your shame, and the refuge of Egypt’s shade your disgrace.
aov_text: Maar die beskutting van Farao sal julle tot skande wees, en die skuiling in die skaduwee van Egipte tot smaadheid.

kjv_text: For his princes were at Zoan, and his ambassadors came to Hanes.
bsb_text: For though their princes are at Zoan and their envoys have arrived in Hanes,
aov_text: Want hulle vorste is in Soan, en hulle boodskappers het in Hanes aangekom;

kjv_text: They were all ashamed of a people that could not profit them, nor be an help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach.
bsb_text: everyone will be put to shame because of a people useless to them. They cannot be of help; they are good for nothing but shame and reproach.”
aov_text: almal staan beskaamd vanweë die volk wat hulle geen voordeel aanbring nie, geen hulp en geen voordeel nie, maar skande en smaadheid daarby.

kjv_text: The burden of the beasts of the south: into the land of trouble and anguish, from whence come the young and old lion, the viper and fiery flying serpent, they will carry their riches upon the shoulders of young asses, and their treasures upon the bunches of camels, to a people that shall not profit them.
bsb_text: This is the burden against the beasts of the Negev: Through a land of hardship and distress, of lioness and lion, of viper and flying serpent, they carry their wealth on the backs of donkeys and their treasures on the humps of camels, to a people of no profit to them.
aov_text: Godspraak oor die diere van die Suidland. In ’n land van benoudheid en angs, waar leeuin en leeu uitkom, adder en vlieënde draak, vervoer hulle op die rugge van esels hul rykdomme en op die bulte van kamele hul skatte, na ’n volk wat geen voordeel bring nie.

kjv_text: For the Egyptians shall help in vain, and to no purpose: therefore have I cried concerning this, Their strength is to sit still.
bsb_text: Egypt’s help is futile and empty; therefore I have called her Rahab Who Sits Still.
aov_text: En Egipte—nietig en leeg is sy hulp; daarom noem ek dit: Rahab wat stilsit.

kjv_text: Now go, write it before them in a table, and note it in a book, that it may be for the time to come for ever and ever:
bsb_text: Go now, write it on a tablet in their presence and inscribe it on a scroll; it will be for the days to come, a witness forever and ever.
aov_text: Gaan nou in, skryf dit op ’n tafel in hulle teenwoordigheid en teken dit op in ’n boek, dat dit kan bly vir later dae, vir altyd, tot in ewigheid.

kjv_text: That this is a rebellious people, lying children, children that will not hear the law of the LORD:
bsb_text: These are rebellious people, deceitful children, children unwilling to obey the LORD’s instruction.
aov_text: Want dit is ’n wederstrewige volk, leuenagtige kinders, kinders wat die wet van die HERE nie wil hoor nie;

kjv_text: Which say to the seers, See not; and to the prophets, Prophesy not unto us right things, speak unto us smooth things, prophesy deceits:
bsb_text: They say to the seers, “Stop seeing visions!” and to the prophets, “Do not prophesy to us the truth! Speak to us pleasant words; prophesy illusions.
aov_text: wat aan die sieners sê: Sien nie! en aan die profete: Profeteer vir ons nie wat reg is nie; spreek vleitaal vir ons, profeteer bedrieëry;

kjv_text: Get you out of the way, turn aside out of the path, cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us.
bsb_text: Get out of the way; turn off the road. Rid us of the Holy One of Israel!”
aov_text: wyk af van die weg, buig af van die pad, laat die Heilige van Israel voor ons aangesig verdwyn!

kjv_text: Wherefore thus saith the Holy One of Israel, Because ye despise this word, and trust in oppression and perverseness, and stay thereon:
bsb_text: Therefore this is what the Holy One of Israel says: “Because you have rejected this message, trusting in oppression and relying on deceit,
aov_text: Daarom, so sê die Heilige van Israel: Omdat julle hierdie woord verwerp en vertrou op verdrukking en slinksheid en daarop steun,

kjv_text: Therefore this iniquity shall be to you as a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking cometh suddenly at an instant.
bsb_text: this iniquity of yours is like a breach about to fail, a bulge in a high wall, whose collapse will come suddenly—in an instant!
aov_text: daarom sal hierdie skuld vir julle wees soos ’n los stuk wat wil val, wat oorhang in ’n hoë muur, waarvan die instorting heeltemal onverwags kom.

kjv_text: And he shall break it as the breaking of the potters' vessel that is broken in pieces; he shall not spare: so that there shall not be found in the bursting of it a sherd to take fire from the hearth, or to take water withal out of the pit.
bsb_text: It will break in pieces like a potter’s jar, shattered so that no fragment can be found. Not a shard will be found in the dust large enough to scoop the coals from a hearth or to skim the water from a cistern.”
aov_text: Ja, Hy sal dit verbreek soos die kruik van ’n pottebakker verbreek word, wat sonder verskoning stukkend geslaan word, sodat by die brokstukke daarvan geen skerf gevind word om vuur uit die vuurherd te gaan haal of om water uit die kuil te skep nie.

kjv_text: For thus saith the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel; In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength: and ye would not.
bsb_text: For the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel, has said: “By repentance and rest you would be saved; your strength would lie in quiet confidence—but you were not willing.”
aov_text: Want so sê die Here HERE, die Heilige van Israel: In terugkeer en rus lê julle heil, in stil wees en vertroue bestaan julle krag; maar julle wou nie

kjv_text: But ye said, No; for we will flee upon horses; therefore shall ye flee: and, We will ride upon the swift; therefore shall they that pursue you be swift.
bsb_text: “No,” you say, “we will flee on horses.” Therefore you will flee! “We will ride swift horses,” but your pursuers will be faster.
aov_text: en het gesê: Nee, maar op perde sal ons vlieg—daarom sal julle moet vlug! en: Op renperde sal ons ry—daarom sal julle vervolgers laat jaag!

kjv_text: One thousand shall flee at the rebuke of one; at the rebuke of five shall ye flee: till ye be left as a beacon upon the top of a mountain, and as an ensign on an hill.
bsb_text: A thousand will flee at the threat of one; at the threat of five you will all flee, until you are left alone like a pole on a mountaintop, like a banner on a hill.
aov_text: Eenduisend van julle sal vlug vir die oorlogsgeroep van een enkele, vir die oorlogsgeroep van vyf, totdat julle oorbly soos ’n vlagpaal op ’n bergtop en soos ’n banier op ’n heuwel.

kjv_text: And therefore will the LORD wait, that he may be gracious unto you, and therefore will he be exalted, that he may have mercy upon you: for the LORD is a God of judgment: blessed are all they that wait for him.
bsb_text: Therefore the LORD longs to be gracious to you; therefore He rises to show you compassion, for the LORD is a just God. Blessed are all who wait for Him.
aov_text: En daarom sal die HERE met ongeduld daarop wag om julle genadig te wees, en daarom sal Hy Hom verhef om Hom oor julle te ontferm; want die HERE is ’n God van die gerig. Welgeluksalig almal wat op Hom wag!

kjv_text: For the people shall dwell in Zion at Jerusalem: thou shalt weep no more: he will be very gracious unto thee at the voice of thy cry; when he shall hear it, he will answer thee.
bsb_text: O people in Zion who dwell in Jerusalem, you will weep no more. He will surely be gracious when you cry for help; when He hears, He will answer you.
aov_text: Want ’n volk sal op Sion, in Jerusalem, woon; jy sal nie meer ween nie; sekerlik sal Hy jou genade bewys op jou hulpgeroep; sodra Hy hoor, antwoord Hy jou.

kjv_text: And though the Lord give you the bread of adversity, and the water of affliction, yet shall not thy teachers be removed into a corner any more, but thine eyes shall see thy teachers:
bsb_text: The Lord will give you the bread of adversity and the water of affliction, but your Teacher will no longer hide Himself—with your own eyes you will see Him.
aov_text: Die Here gee julle wel brood van benoudheid en water van bedruktheid, maar jou leraars sal hulle nie langer verberg nie—maar jou oë sal jou leraars sien;

kjv_text: And thine ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying, This is the way, walk ye in it, when ye turn to the right hand, and when ye turn to the left.
bsb_text: And whether you turn to the right or to the left, your ears will hear this command behind you: “This is the way. Walk in it.”
aov_text: en jou ore sal ’n woord agter jou hoor wat sê: Dit is die weg, wandel daarop! wanneer julle regs of wanneer julle links wil gaan.

kjv_text: Ye shall defile also the covering of thy graven images of silver, and the ornament of thy molten images of gold: thou shalt cast them away as a menstruous cloth; thou shalt say unto it, Get thee hence.
bsb_text: So you will desecrate your silver-plated idols and your gold-plated images. You will throw them away like menstrual cloths, saying to them, “Be gone!”
aov_text: En julle sal verontreinig die oortreksel van jou gesnede beelde van silwer en die beslag van jou gegote beeld van goud; jy sal dit weggooi soos iets wat besoedel is. Weg daarmee! sal jy daarvan sê.

kjv_text: Then shall he give the rain of thy seed, that thou shalt sow the ground withal; and bread of the increase of the earth, and it shall be fat and plenteous: in that day shall thy cattle feed in large pastures.
bsb_text: Then He will send rain for the seed that you have sown in the ground, and the food that comes from your land will be rich and plentiful. On that day your cattle will graze in open pastures.
aov_text: Dan sal Hy reën gee vir die saad waarmee jy die grond besaai, en broodkoring wat die grond voortbring, en dit sal smaaklik en voedsaam wees; jou vee sal in dié dag wei op ’n uitgestrekte weiveld;

kjv_text: The oxen likewise and the young asses that ear the ground shall eat clean provender, which hath been winnowed with the shovel and with the fan.
bsb_text: The oxen and donkeys that work the ground will eat salted fodder, winnowed with shovel and pitchfork.
aov_text: en die osse en die esels wat die grond bewerk, sal voer met sout eet, wat uitgewan is met skop en gaffel;

kjv_text: And there shall be upon every high mountain, and upon every high hill, rivers and streams of waters in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.
bsb_text: And from every high mountain and every raised hill, streams of water will flow in the day of great slaughter, when the towers fall.
aov_text: en op elke hoë berg en op elke verhewe heuwel sal strome wees, waterlope, op die dag van die groot slagting as die torings val.

kjv_text: Moreover the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun, and the light of the sun shall be sevenfold, as the light of seven days, in the day that the LORD bindeth up the breach of his people, and healeth the stroke of their wound.
bsb_text: The light of the moon will be as bright as the sun, and the light of the sun will be seven times brighter—like the light of seven days—on the day that the LORD binds up the brokenness of His people and heals the wounds He has inflicted.
aov_text: En die lig van die maan sal wees soos die lig van die son, en die lig van die son sal sewevoudig wees, soos die lig van sewe dae, op die dag as die HERE die breuk van sy volk verbind en die wond gesond maak wat aan hulle geslaan is.

kjv_text: Behold, the name of the LORD cometh from far, burning with his anger, and the burden thereof is heavy: his lips are full of indignation, and his tongue as a devouring fire:
bsb_text: Behold, the Name of the LORD comes from afar, with burning anger and dense smoke. His lips are full of fury, and His tongue is like a consuming fire.
aov_text: KYK, die Naam van die HERE kom van ver af, sy toorn brand, swaar wolke kom op; sy lippe is vol grimmigheid en sy tong soos ’n verterende vuur,

kjv_text: And his breath, as an overflowing stream, shall reach to the midst of the neck, to sift the nations with the sieve of vanity: and there shall be a bridle in the jaws of the people, causing them to err.
bsb_text: His breath is like a rushing torrent that rises to the neck. He comes to sift the nations in a sieve of destruction; He bridles the jaws of the peoples to lead them astray.
aov_text: en sy asem soos ’n oorlopende stroom wat tot by die nek kom—om nasies te sif met ’n sif van vernietiging; en ’n toom wat verkeerd stuur, is in die kakebene van die volke.

kjv_text: Ye shall have a song, as in the night when a holy solemnity is kept; and gladness of heart, as when one goeth with a pipe to come into the mountain of the LORD, to the mighty One of Israel.
bsb_text: You will sing as on the night of a holy festival, and your heart will rejoice like one who walks to the music of a flute, going up to the mountain of the LORD, to the Rock of Israel.
aov_text: Die lied sal by julle wees soos in die nag as die fees gevier word, en julle sal vrolik wees van hart soos die wat met die fluite loop, om te kom op die berg van die HERE, na die Steenrots van Israel.

kjv_text: And the LORD shall cause his glorious voice to be heard, and shall shew the lighting down of his arm, with the indignation of his anger, and with the flame of a devouring fire, with scattering, and tempest, and hailstones.
bsb_text: And the LORD will cause His majestic voice to be heard and His mighty arm to be revealed, striking in angry wrath with a flame of consuming fire, and with cloudburst, storm, and hailstones.
aov_text: En die HERE sal sy stem vol majesteit laat hoor en die neerdaling van sy arm laat sien, met grimmige toorn en die vlam van ’n verterende vuur, storm en stortreën en haelkorrels.

kjv_text: For through the voice of the LORD shall the Assyrian be beaten down, which smote with a rod.
bsb_text: For Assyria will be shattered at the voice of the LORD; He will strike them with His scepter.
aov_text: Want vir die stem van die HERE sal Assur verskrik wees; met die stok sal Hy slaan,

kjv_text: And in every place where the grounded staff shall pass, which the LORD shall lay upon him, it shall be with tabrets and harps: and in battles of shaking will he fight with it.
bsb_text: And with every stroke of the rod of punishment that the LORD brings down on them, the tambourines and lyres will sound as He battles with weapons brandished.
aov_text: en elke swaai van die roede wat vir hom beskik is, wat die HERE op hom laat val, sal wees onder begeleiding van tamboeryn en sitermusiek, en met ’n uitgeswaaide vegtersarm sal Hy teen hulle veg.

kjv_text: For Tophet is ordained of old; yea, for the king it is prepared; he hath made it deep and large: the pile thereof is fire and much wood; the breath of the LORD, like a stream of brimstone, doth kindle it.
bsb_text: For Topheth has long been prepared; it has been made ready for the king. Its funeral pyre is deep and wide, with plenty of fire and wood. The breath of the LORD, like a torrent of burning sulfur, sets it ablaze.
aov_text: Want ’n Tofet is van gister af gereedgemaak, ook is dit vir die koning berei; diep en wyd het Hy die houtstapel daarvan aangelê met vuur en hout in menigte; die asem van die HERE is soos ’n stroom van swawel wat dit aan die brand steek.

kjv_text: Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help; and stay on horses, and trust in chariots, because they are many; and in horsemen, because they are very strong; but they look not unto the Holy One of Israel, neither seek the LORD!
bsb_text: Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help, who rely on horses, who trust in their abundance of chariots and in their multitude of horsemen. They do not look to the Holy One of Israel; they do not seek the LORD.
aov_text: WEE hulle wat na Egipte aftrek om hulp en hulle verlaat op perde, en wat vertrou op strydwaens, omdat daar baie is, en op ruiters, omdat hulle baie talryk is, maar hulle sien nie op die Heilige van Israel en hulle soek nie die HERE nie.

kjv_text: Yet he also is wise, and will bring evil, and will not call back his words: but will arise against the house of the evildoers, and against the help of them that work iniquity.
bsb_text: Yet He too is wise and brings disaster; He does not call back His words. He will rise up against the house of the wicked and against the allies of evildoers.
aov_text: Nogtans is Hy ook wys, en Hy laat die onheil kom en trek sy woorde nie terug nie: Hy sal opstaan teen die huis van die kwaaddoeners en teen die helpers van die wat ongeregtigheid werk.

kjv_text: Now the Egyptians are men, and not God; and their horses flesh, and not spirit. When the LORD shall stretch out his hand, both he that helpeth shall fall, and he that is holpen shall fall down, and they all shall fail together.
bsb_text: But the Egyptians are men, not God; their horses are flesh, not spirit. When the LORD stretches out His hand, the helper will stumble, and the one he helps will fall; both will perish together.
aov_text: Ja, die Egiptenaars is mense en nie God nie, en hulle perde is vlees en nie gees nie; as die HERE sy hand uitstrek, dan struikel die helper, en wie gehelp is, val; en saam gaan hulle almal te gronde.

kjv_text: For thus hath the LORD spoken unto me, Like as the lion and the young lion roaring on his prey, when a multitude of shepherds is called forth against him, he will not be afraid of their voice, nor abase himself for the noise of them: so shall the LORD of hosts come down to fight for mount Zion, and for the hill thereof.
bsb_text: For this is what the LORD has said to me: “Like a lion roaring or a young lion over its prey—and though a band of shepherds is called out against it, it is not terrified by their shouting or subdued by their clamor—so the LORD of Hosts will come down to do battle on Mount Zion and its heights.
aov_text: Want so het die HERE vir my gesê: Soos ’n leeu en ’n jong leeu knor oor sy prooi wanneer die volle getal herders teen hom bymekaargeroep word, sonder dat hy skrik vir hulle stem of ingee vir hulle geraas—só sal die HERE van die leërskare neerdaal om in die stryd uit te trek teen die berg Sion en teen sy heuwel.

kjv_text: As birds flying, so will the LORD of hosts defend Jerusalem; defending also he will deliver it; and passing over he will preserve it.
bsb_text: Like birds hovering overhead, so the LORD of Hosts will protect Jerusalem. He will shield it and deliver it; He will pass over it and preserve it.”
aov_text: Soos voëls wat fladder, so sal die HERE van die leërskare Jerusalem beskut, beskut en red, verskoon en bevry.

kjv_text: Turn ye unto him from whom the children of Israel have deeply revolted.
bsb_text: Return to the One against whom you have so blatantly rebelled, O children of Israel.
aov_text: Bekeer julle tot Hom van wie die kinders van Israel diep afgeval het.

kjv_text: For in that day every man shall cast away his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which your own hands have made unto you for a sin.
bsb_text: For on that day, every one of you will reject the idols of silver and gold that your own hands have sinfully made.
aov_text: Want in dié dag sal hulle elkeen sy silwerafgode en sy goue afgode verwerp, wat julle hande vir julle tot sonde gemaak het.

kjv_text: Then shall the Assyrian fall with the sword, not of a mighty man; and the sword, not of a mean man, shall devour him: but he shall flee from the sword, and his young men shall be discomfited.
bsb_text: “Then Assyria will fall, but not by the sword of man; a sword will devour them, but not one made by mortals. They will flee before the sword, and their young men will be put to forced labor.
aov_text: En Assur sal val deur die swaard, nie van ’n man nie; en die swaard, nie van ’n mens nie, sal hom verteer; en hy sal voor die swaard vlug, en sy jongmanne sal dienspligtig word;

kjv_text: And he shall pass over to his strong hold for fear, and his princes shall be afraid of the ensign, saith the LORD, whose fire is in Zion, and his furnace in Jerusalem.
bsb_text: Their rock will pass away for fear, and their princes will panic at the sight of the battle standard,” declares the LORD, whose fire is in Zion, whose furnace is in Jerusalem.
aov_text: en sy rots sal uitmekaar stuif van skrik, en sy vorste sal verskrik die banier verlaat, spreek die HERE, wat ’n vuur het op Sion en ’n oond in Jerusalem.

kjv_text: Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in judgment.
bsb_text: Behold, a king will reign in righteousness, and princes will rule with justice.
aov_text: KYK, ’n koning sal regeer in geregtigheid, en die vorste sal heers volgens reg.

kjv_text: And a man shall be as an hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the tempest; as rivers of water in a dry place, as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land.
bsb_text: Each will be like a shelter from the wind, a refuge from the storm, like streams of water in a dry land, like the shadow of a great rock in an arid land.
aov_text: En elkeen sal wees soos ’n toevlug teen die wind en ’n skuiling teen die stortreën, soos waterstrome in ’n dor streek, soos die skaduwee van ’n swaar rots in ’n land wat versmag.

kjv_text: And the eyes of them that see shall not be dim, and the ears of them that hear shall hearken.
bsb_text: Then the eyes of those who see will no longer be closed, and the ears of those who hear will listen.
aov_text: Dan sal nie meer verblind wees die oë van die wat sien nie; en die ore van hulle wat hoor, sal luister;

kjv_text: The heart also of the rash shall understand knowledge, and the tongue of the stammerers shall be ready to speak plainly.
bsb_text: The mind of the rash will know and understand, and the stammering tongue will speak clearly and fluently.
aov_text: en die hart van die onbedagsames sal leer om te verstaan, en die tong van die hakkelaars sal gou wees om duidelik te spreek;

kjv_text: The vile person shall be no more called liberal, nor the churl said to be bountiful.
bsb_text: No longer will a fool be called noble, nor a scoundrel be respected.
aov_text: die dwaas sal nie meer ’n edele genoem word nie, en van die skelm sal nie gesê word dat hy vernaam is nie.

kjv_text: For the vile person will speak villany, and his heart will work iniquity, to practise hypocrisy, and to utter error against the LORD, to make empty the soul of the hungry, and he will cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.
bsb_text: For a fool speaks foolishness; his mind plots iniquity. He practices ungodliness and speaks falsely about the LORD; he leaves the hungry empty and deprives the thirsty of drink.
aov_text: Want ’n dwaas spreek dwaasheid en sy hart bring onheil voort, deur goddeloosheid te bedrywe en dwaling te spreek oor die HERE, deur die begeerte van die hongerige onvervuld te laat en die drank van die dorstige te laat ontbreek.

kjv_text: The instruments also of the churl are evil: he deviseth wicked devices to destroy the poor with lying words, even when the needy speaketh right.
bsb_text: The weapons of the scoundrel are destructive; he hatches plots to destroy the poor with lies, even when the plea of the needy is just.
aov_text: En die skelm—sy middele is sleg, hý beraam skandelike dade om die ellendiges te ruïneer met leuentaal, ook as die behoeftige spreek wat reg is.

kjv_text: But the liberal deviseth liberal things; and by liberal things shall he stand.
bsb_text: But a noble man makes honorable plans; he stands up for worthy causes.
aov_text: Maar die edele beraam edele dade, en hý hou stand in wat edel is.

kjv_text: Rise up, ye women that are at ease; hear my voice, ye careless daughters; give ear unto my speech.
bsb_text: Stand up, you complacent women; listen to me. Give ear to my word, you overconfident daughters.
aov_text: STAAN op, geruste vroue, hoor my stem! Sorgelose dogters, luister na my woord!

kjv_text: Many days and years shall ye be troubled, ye careless women: for the vintage shall fail, the gathering shall not come.
bsb_text: In a little more than a year you will tremble, O secure ones. For the grape harvest will fail and the fruit harvest will not arrive.
aov_text: ’n Jaar en ’n paar dae—en julle sal sidder, sorgelose dogters! Want dit is gedaan met die druiwe-oes, daar sal geen insameling van vrugte kom nie.

kjv_text: Tremble, ye women that are at ease; be troubled, ye careless ones: strip you, and make you bare, and gird sackcloth upon your loins.
bsb_text: Shudder, you ladies of leisure; tremble, you daughters of complacency. Strip yourselves bare and put sackcloth around your waists.
aov_text: Bewe, geruste vroue! Sidder, sorgelose dogters! Trek julle uit, ontbloot julle en gord rougewade om julle lendene.

kjv_text: They shall lament for the teats, for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.
bsb_text: Beat your breasts for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vines,
aov_text: Hulle slaan op die bors vanweë die begeerlike velde, vanweë die vrugbare wingerdstok;

kjv_text: Upon the land of my people shall come up thorns and briers; yea, upon all the houses of joy in the joyous city:
bsb_text: and for the land of my people, overgrown with thorns and briers—even for every house of merriment in this city of revelry.
aov_text: vanweë die akkers van my volk wat met dorings en distels opskiet, ja, vanweë al die huise van vreugde van die uitgelate stad.

kjv_text: Because the palaces shall be forsaken; the multitude of the city shall be left; the forts and towers shall be for dens for ever, a joy of wild asses, a pasture of flocks;
bsb_text: For the palace will be forsaken, the busy city abandoned. The hill and the watchtower will become caves forever—the delight of wild donkeys and a pasture for flocks—
aov_text: Want die paleis is verlate, die stadsgewoel is in eensaamheid verander; die Heuwel en die Wagtoring dien as spelonke vir ewig, ’n vreugde vir die wilde-esels, ’n weiveld vir die troppe vee —

kjv_text: Until the spirit be poured upon us from on high, and the wilderness be a fruitful field, and the fruitful field be counted for a forest.
bsb_text: until the Spirit is poured out upon us from on high. Then the desert will be an orchard, and the orchard will seem like a forest.
aov_text: totdat oor ons uitgegiet word die Gees uit die hoogte; dan word die woestyn ’n vrugteboord, en die vrugteboord self word vir ’n bos gereken.

kjv_text: Then judgment shall dwell in the wilderness, and righteousness remain in the fruitful field.
bsb_text: Then justice will inhabit the wilderness, and righteousness will dwell in the fertile field.
aov_text: En die reg woon in die woestyn, en die geregtigheid hou verblyf in die vrugteboord.

kjv_text: And the work of righteousness shall be peace; and the effect of righteousness quietness and assurance for ever.
bsb_text: The work of righteousness will be peace; the service of righteousness will be quiet confidence forever.
aov_text: En die werking van die geregtigheid sal vrede wees, en die voortbrengsel van die geregtigheid rus en veiligheid tot in ewigheid.

kjv_text: And my people shall dwell in a peaceable habitation, and in sure dwellings, and in quiet resting places;
bsb_text: Then my people will dwell in a peaceful place, in safe and secure places of rest.
aov_text: En my volk sal woon in ’n plek van vrede en in veilige wonings en in plekke van ongestoorde rus.

kjv_text: When it shall hail, coming down on the forest; and the city shall be low in a low place.
bsb_text: But hail will level the forest, and the city will sink to the depths.
aov_text: Maar dit sal hael as die bos inmekaarstort en die stad wegsak in die laagte.

kjv_text: Blessed are ye that sow beside all waters, that send forth thither the feet of the ox and the ass.
bsb_text: Blessed are those who sow beside abundant waters, who let the ox and donkey range freely.
aov_text: Welgeluksalig is julle wat by alle waters saai, wat die voet van os en esel vry laat loop!
