kjv_text: Woe to thee that spoilest, and thou wast not spoiled; and dealest treacherously, and they dealt not treacherously with thee! when thou shalt cease to spoil, thou shalt be spoiled; and when thou shalt make an end to deal treacherously, they shall deal treacherously with thee.
bsb_text: Woe to you, O destroyer never destroyed, O traitor never betrayed! When you have finished destroying, you will be destroyed. When you have finished betraying, you will be betrayed.
aov_text: WEE jou, verwoester, wat self nie verwoes is nie, en troubreker teen wie nie troueloos gehandel is nie! As jy klaar is met verwoes, sal jy verwoes word; en as jy klaar is met troubreuk, sal hulle troueloos teen jou handel.

kjv_text: O LORD, be gracious unto us; we have waited for thee: be thou their arm every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.
bsb_text: O LORD, be gracious to us! We wait for You. Be our strength every morning and our salvation in time of trouble.
aov_text: HERE, wees ons genadig, op U wag ons; wees hulle arm elke môre, ja, ons verlossing in die tyd van benoudheid!

kjv_text: At the noise of the tumult the people fled; at the lifting up of thyself the nations were scattered.
bsb_text: The peoples flee the thunder of Your voice; the nations scatter when You rise.
aov_text: Vir die dawergeluid vlug die volke; vanweë u verheffing word die nasies verstrooi.

kjv_text: And your spoil shall be gathered like the gathering of the caterpiller: as the running to and fro of locusts shall he run upon them.
bsb_text: Your spoil, O nations, is gathered as by locusts; like a swarm of locusts men sweep over it.
aov_text: Dan word julle buit weggeskraap soos sprinkane wegskraap; soos sprinkane hardloop, hardloop hulle daarop los.

kjv_text: The LORD is exalted; for he dwelleth on high: he hath filled Zion with judgment and righteousness.
bsb_text: The LORD is exalted, for He dwells on high; He has filled Zion with justice and righteousness.
aov_text: Die HERE is verhewe, want Hy woon in die hoogte; Hy het Sion vervul met reg en geregtigheid.

kjv_text: And wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of thy times, and strength of salvation: the fear of the LORD is his treasure.
bsb_text: He will be the sure foundation for your times, a storehouse of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge. The fear of the LORD is Zion’s treasure.
aov_text: En daar sal bestendigheid van jou tye wees, ’n rykdom van volle verlossing, van wysheid en kennis; die vrees van die HERE sal sy skat wees.

kjv_text: Behold, their valiant ones shall cry without: the ambassadors of peace shall weep bitterly.
bsb_text: Behold, their valiant ones cry aloud in the streets; the envoys of peace weep bitterly.
aov_text: Kyk, die helde skreeu daarbuite, die boodskappers van vrede ween bitterlik.

kjv_text: The highways lie waste, the wayfaring man ceaseth: he hath broken the covenant, he hath despised the cities, he regardeth no man.
bsb_text: The highways are deserted; travel has ceased. The treaty has been broken, the witnesses are despised, and human life is disregarded.
aov_text: Die grootpaaie is verlate; die wat padlangs trek, bly weg. Hy het die verbond verbreek, die stede gering geag, mense nie gereken nie.

kjv_text: The earth mourneth and languisheth: Lebanon is ashamed and hewn down: Sharon is like a wilderness; and Bashan and Carmel shake off their fruits.
bsb_text: The land mourns and languishes; Lebanon is ashamed and decayed. Sharon is like a desert; Bashan and Carmel shake off their leaves.
aov_text: Die land treur, dit verwelk; die Líbanon staan beskaamd, dit verkwyn; Saron het geword soos ’n woestynvlakte, Basan en Karmel staan sonder blare.

kjv_text: Now will I rise, saith the LORD; now will I be exalted; now will I lift up myself.
bsb_text: “Now I will arise,” says the LORD. “Now I will lift Myself up. Now I will be exalted.
aov_text: Nou sal Ek opstaan, sê die HERE; nou sal Ek My verhef, nou sal Ek My oprig.

kjv_text: Ye shall conceive chaff, ye shall bring forth stubble: your breath, as fire, shall devour you.
bsb_text: You conceive chaff; you give birth to stubble. Your breath is a fire that will consume you.
aov_text: Julle gaan swanger van strooi, julle sal stoppels baar; julle geblaas is ’n vuur wat julle sal verteer.

kjv_text: And the people shall be as the burnings of lime: as thorns cut up shall they be burned in the fire.
bsb_text: The peoples will be burned to ashes, like thorns cut down and set ablaze.
aov_text: Dan word die volke ’n kalkbrandery, afgekapte doringbosse wat met vuur verbrand word.

kjv_text: Hear, ye that are far off, what I have done; and, ye that are near, acknowledge my might.
bsb_text: You who are far off, hear what I have done; you who are near, acknowledge My might.”
aov_text: Hoor, julle wat ver is, wat Ek gedoen het; en julle wat naby is, erken my mag!

kjv_text: The sinners in Zion are afraid; fearfulness hath surprised the hypocrites. Who among us shall dwell with the devouring fire? who among us shall dwell with everlasting burnings?
bsb_text: The sinners in Zion are afraid; trembling grips the ungodly: “Who of us can dwell with a consuming fire? Who of us can dwell with everlasting flames?”
aov_text: Die sondaars in Sion bewe, siddering het die roekelose aangegryp. Hulle sê: Wie van ons kan woon by ’n verterende vuur, wie van ons kan woon by ’n ewige gloed?

kjv_text: He that walketh righteously, and speaketh uprightly; he that despiseth the gain of oppressions, that shaketh his hands from holding of bribes, that stoppeth his ears from hearing of blood, and shutteth his eyes from seeing evil;
bsb_text: He who walks righteously and speaks with sincerity, who refuses gain from extortion, whose hand never takes a bribe, who stops his ears against murderous plots and shuts his eyes tightly against evil—
aov_text: Hy wat in geregtigheid wandel en spreek wat reg is, wat gewin deur afpersinge versmaad, wat sy hande uitskud om geen omkoopgeskenk aan te gryp nie, wat sy oor toestop om van geen bloedskuld te hoor nie, en sy oë sluit om wat sleg is, nie te sien nie —

kjv_text: He shall dwell on high: his place of defence shall be the munitions of rocks: bread shall be given him; his waters shall be sure.
bsb_text: he will dwell on the heights; the mountain fortress will be his refuge; his food will be provided and his water assured.
aov_text: hy sal op hoogtes woon, rotsvestings is sy burg; sy brood word hom gegee, sy water is gewis.

kjv_text: Thine eyes shall see the king in his beauty: they shall behold the land that is very far off.
bsb_text: Your eyes will see the King in His beauty and behold a land that stretches afar.
aov_text: Jou oë sal die Koning in sy skoonheid aanskou, dit sal ’n wyd uitgestrekte land sien.

kjv_text: Thine heart shall meditate terror. Where is the scribe? where is the receiver? where is he that counted the towers?
bsb_text: Your mind will ponder the former terror: “Where is he who tallies? Where is he who weighs? Where is he who counts the towers?”
aov_text: Jou hart sal die deurgestane verskrikking oordink en sê: Waar is hy wat getel het? Waar is hy wat geweeg het? Waar is hy wat die torings opgeskryf het?

kjv_text: Thou shalt not see a fierce people, a people of a deeper speech than thou canst perceive; of a stammering tongue, that thou canst not understand.
bsb_text: You will no longer see the insolent, a people whose speech is unintelligible, who stammer in a language you cannot understand.
aov_text: Jy sal die onbeskaamde volk nie meer sien nie, die volk met duister, onverstaanbare spraak, met onbegryplike hakkeltong.

kjv_text: Look upon Zion, the city of our solemnities: thine eyes shall see Jerusalem a quiet habitation, a tabernacle that shall not be taken down; not one of the stakes thereof shall ever be removed, neither shall any of the cords thereof be broken.
bsb_text: Look upon Zion, the city of our appointed feasts. Your eyes will see Jerusalem, a peaceful pasture, a tent that does not wander; its tent pegs will not be pulled up, nor will any of its cords be broken.
aov_text: Aanskou Sion, die stad van ons feestelike samekoms! Jou oë sal Jerusalem sien as veilige woonplek, as tent wat nie wegtrek nie, waarvan die penne nooit meer uitgeruk word nie en geeneen van sy toue ooit losgeskeur word nie.

kjv_text: But there the glorious LORD will be unto us a place of broad rivers and streams; wherein shall go no galley with oars, neither shall gallant ship pass thereby.
bsb_text: But there the Majestic One, our LORD, will be for us a place of rivers and wide canals, where no galley with oars will row, and no majestic vessel will pass.
aov_text: Maar daar sal die HERE vir ons heerlik wees; dit sal ’n plek van riviere wees, van breë strome; geen vloot van roeiskepe sal daarop vaar nie, en geen trotse skip sal daaroor gaan nie.

kjv_text: For the LORD is our judge, the LORD is our lawgiver, the LORD is our king; he will save us.
bsb_text: For the LORD is our Judge, the LORD is our lawgiver, the LORD is our King. It is He who will save us.
aov_text: Want die HERE is ons Regter, die HERE is ons Aanvoerder, die HERE is ons Koning: Hý sal ons verlos.

kjv_text: Thy tacklings are loosed; they could not well strengthen their mast, they could not spread the sail: then is the prey of a great spoil divided; the lame take the prey.
bsb_text: Your ropes are slack; they cannot secure the mast or spread the sail. Then an abundance of spoils will be divided, and even the lame will carry off plunder.
aov_text: Jou toue hang slap, hulle hou die voetstuk van hulle mas nie styf nie, hulle ontplooi nie die banier nie; dan word roofbuit verdeel in menigte, selfs die lammes maak buit.

kjv_text: And the inhabitant shall not say, I am sick: the people that dwell therein shall be forgiven their iniquity.
bsb_text: And no resident of Zion will say, “I am sick.” The people who dwell there will be forgiven of iniquity.
aov_text: En geen inwoner sal sê: Ek is siek nie; aan die mense wat daarin woon, is die skuld vergewe.

kjv_text: Come near, ye nations, to hear; and hearken, ye people: let the earth hear, and all that is therein; the world, and all things that come forth of it.
bsb_text: Come near, O nations, to listen; pay attention, O peoples. Let the earth hear, and all that fills it, the world and all that springs from it.
aov_text: KOM nader, o volke, om te hoor; en nasies, luister! Laat die aarde hoor, en die volheid daarvan, die wêreld en alles wat daaruit voortkom.

kjv_text: For the indignation of the LORD is upon all nations, and his fury upon all their armies: he hath utterly destroyed them, he hath delivered them to the slaughter.
bsb_text: The LORD is angry with all the nations and furious with all their armies. He will devote them to destruction; He will give them over to slaughter.
aov_text: Want die toorn van die HERE is oor al die nasies, en grimmigheid oor al hulle leërskare; Hy het hulle met die banvloek getref, Hy het hulle oorgegee om geslag te word.

kjv_text: Their slain also shall be cast out, and their stink shall come up out of their carcases, and the mountains shall be melted with their blood.
bsb_text: Their slain will be left unburied, and the stench of their corpses will rise; the mountains will flow with their blood.
aov_text: En hulle gesneuweldes sal weggewerp word, en die stank van hulle lyke gaan op, en die berge smelt van hulle bloed.

kjv_text: And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll: and all their host shall fall down, as the leaf falleth off from the vine, and as a falling fig from the fig tree.
bsb_text: All the stars of heaven will be dissolved. The skies will be rolled up like a scroll, and all their stars will fall like withered leaves from the vine, like foliage from the fig tree.
aov_text: En al die leërskare van die hemel vergaan, en die hemel word inmekaar gerol soos ’n boek en al sy leërskare val af soos ’n blad van die wingerdstok afval en soos vye afval van die vyeboom.

kjv_text: For my sword shall be bathed in heaven: behold, it shall come down upon Idumea, and upon the people of my curse, to judgment.
bsb_text: When My sword has drunk its fill in the heavens, then it will come down upon Edom, upon the people I have devoted to destruction.
aov_text: Want my swaard het dronk geword in die hemel; kyk, dit kom af op Edom en op die volk van my banvloek, om geoordeel te word.

kjv_text: The sword of the LORD is filled with blood, it is made fat with fatness, and with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams: for the LORD hath a sacrifice in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Idumea.
bsb_text: The sword of the LORD is bathed in blood. It drips with fat—with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams. For the LORD has a sacrifice in Bozrah, a great slaughter in the land of Edom.
aov_text: Die swaard van die HERE is vol bloed, dit drup van vet, van die bloed van lammers en bokke, van die niervet van ramme; want die HERE het ’n slagoffer in Bosra en ’n groot slagting in die land Edom.

kjv_text: And the unicorns shall come down with them, and the bullocks with the bulls; and their land shall be soaked with blood, and their dust made fat with fatness.
bsb_text: And the wild oxen will fall with them, the young bulls with the strong ones. Their land will be drenched with blood, and their soil will be soaked with fat.
aov_text: Dan val die buffels saam met hulle, en die jong stiere saam met die stiere; en hulle land word dronk van bloed, en hulle stof versadig van vet.

kjv_text: For it is the day of the LORD's vengeance, and the year of recompences for the controversy of Zion.
bsb_text: For the LORD has a day of vengeance, a year of recompense for the cause of Zion.
aov_text: Want die HERE hou ’n dag van wraak, ’n jaar van vergelding in die regsaak van Sion.

kjv_text: And the streams thereof shall be turned into pitch, and the dust thereof into brimstone, and the land thereof shall become burning pitch.
bsb_text: Edom’s streams will be turned to tar, and her soil to sulfur; her land will become a blazing pitch.
aov_text: En sy strome sal in pik verander word en sy stof in swawel, en sy land sal brandende pik word.

kjv_text: It shall not be quenched night nor day; the smoke thereof shall go up for ever: from generation to generation it shall lie waste; none shall pass through it for ever and ever.
bsb_text: It will not be quenched—day or night. Its smoke will ascend forever. From generation to generation it will lie desolate; no one will ever again pass through it.
aov_text: Dit sal snags of oordag nie uitgeblus word nie; vir ewig gaan sy rook op; van geslag tot geslag lê dit woes, vir altyd en ewig trek niemand daardeur nie.

kjv_text: But the cormorant and the bittern shall possess it; the owl also and the raven shall dwell in it: and he shall stretch out upon it the line of confusion, and the stones of emptiness.
bsb_text: The desert owl and screech owl will possess it, and the great owl and raven will dwell in it. The LORD will stretch out over Edom a measuring line of chaos and a plumb line of destruction.
aov_text: Maar die pelikaan en die krimpvarkie neem dit in besit, en die uil en die kraai woon daarin. En Hy sal die riglyn van woestheid daaroor span en die skietlood van vormloosheid.

kjv_text: They shall call the nobles thereof to the kingdom, but none shall be there, and all her princes shall be nothing.
bsb_text: No nobles will be left to proclaim a king, and all her princes will come to nothing.
aov_text: Sy edeles—daar sal hulle geen koninkryk meer uitroep nie, en met al sy vorste is dit gedaan.

kjv_text: And thorns shall come up in her palaces, nettles and brambles in the fortresses thereof: and it shall be an habitation of dragons, and a court for owls.
bsb_text: Her towers will be overgrown with thorns, her fortresses with thistles and briers. She will become a haunt for jackals, an abode for ostriches.
aov_text: En sy paleise word begroei met dorings, brandnekels en distels sal in sy vestings wees. En dit sal ’n lêplek van jakkalse, ’n verblyf vir die volstruise wees.

kjv_text: The wild beasts of the desert shall also meet with the wild beasts of the island, and the satyr shall cry to his fellow; the screech owl also shall rest there, and find for herself a place of rest.
bsb_text: The desert creatures will meet with hyenas, and one wild goat will call to another. There the night creature will settle and find her place of repose.
aov_text: En boskatte kom wildehonde teë, en veldduiwels ontmoet mekaar; ook woon die naggees daar in vrede en vind ’n rusplek vir hom.

kjv_text: There shall the great owl make her nest, and lay, and hatch, and gather under her shadow: there shall the vultures also be gathered, every one with her mate.
bsb_text: There the owl will make her nest; she will lay and hatch her eggs and gather her brood under her shadow. Even there the birds of prey will gather, each with its mate.
aov_text: Daar maak die pylslang sy nes en lê eiers en broei dit uit en koester haar kleintjies daar in die skaduwee; ook sal die kuikendiewe daar bymekaarkom, die een by die ander.

kjv_text: Seek ye out of the book of the LORD, and read: no one of these shall fail, none shall want her mate: for my mouth it hath commanded, and his spirit it hath gathered them.
bsb_text: Search and read the scroll of the LORD: Not one of these will go missing, not one will lack her mate, because He has ordered it by His mouth, and He will gather them by His Spirit.
aov_text: Soek in die boek van die HERE en lees! Nie een van hierdie wesens ontbreek nie, die een mis die ander nie; want my mond—dié het dit beveel, en sy Gees—dié het hulle bymekaargebring.

kjv_text: And he hath cast the lot for them, and his hand hath divided it unto them by line: they shall possess it for ever, from generation to generation shall they dwell therein.
bsb_text: He has allotted their portion; His hand has distributed it by measure. They will possess it forever; they will dwell in it from generation to generation.
aov_text: En Hý het vir hulle die lot gewerp, en sy hand het die land aan hulle met die meetsnoer uitgedeel; tot in ewigheid sal hulle dit besit, van geslag tot geslag daarin woon.

kjv_text: The wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them; and the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the rose.
bsb_text: The wilderness and the land will be glad; the desert will rejoice and blossom like a rose.
aov_text: DIE woestyn en die dor land sal bly wees, en die wildernis sal juig en bloei soos ’n narsing;

kjv_text: It shall blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing: the glory of Lebanon shall be given unto it, the excellency of Carmel and Sharon, they shall see the glory of the LORD, and the excellency of our God.
bsb_text: It will bloom profusely and rejoice with joy and singing. The glory of Lebanon will be given to it, the splendor of Carmel and Sharon. They will see the glory of the LORD, the splendor of our God.
aov_text: dit sal lustig bloei en juig, ja, met gejuig en gejubel; die heerlikheid van die Líbanon is aan hom gegee, die sieraad van Karmel en Saron; hulle dáár sal sien die heerlikheid van die HERE, die sieraad van onse God.

kjv_text: Strengthen ye the weak hands, and confirm the feeble knees.
bsb_text: Strengthen the limp hands and steady the feeble knees!
aov_text: Versterk die slap hande en maak die struikelende knieë vas.

kjv_text: Say to them that are of a fearful heart, Be strong, fear not: behold, your God will come with vengeance, even God with a recompence; he will come and save you.
bsb_text: Say to those with anxious hearts: “Be strong, do not fear! Behold, your God will come with vengeance. With divine retribution He will come to save you.”
aov_text: Sê aan die wat vervaard is van hart: Wees sterk, wees nie bevrees nie! Kyk, julle God kom met wraak, met goddelike vergelding; Hy self sal kom en julle verlos.

kjv_text: Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, and the ears of the deaf shall be unstopped.
bsb_text: Then the eyes of the blind will be opened and the ears of the deaf unstopped.
aov_text: Dan sal die oë van die blindes geopen en die ore van die dowes ontsluit word.

kjv_text: Then shall the lame man leap as an hart, and the tongue of the dumb sing: for in the wilderness shall waters break out, and streams in the desert.
bsb_text: Then the lame will leap like a deer and the mute tongue will shout for joy. For waters will gush forth in the wilderness, and streams in the desert.
aov_text: Dan sal die lamme spring soos ’n takbok, en die tong van die stomme sal jubel; want in die woestyn breek waters uit en strome in die wildernis.

kjv_text: And the parched ground shall become a pool, and the thirsty land springs of water: in the habitation of dragons, where each lay, shall be grass with reeds and rushes.
bsb_text: The parched ground will become a pool, the thirsty land springs of water. In the haunt where jackals once lay, there will be grass and reeds and papyrus.
aov_text: En die gloeiende grond sal ’n waterplas word, en die dorsland fonteine van water; in die plek van die jakkalse waar hulle gelê en rus het, is gras met riete en biesies.

kjv_text: And an highway shall be there, and a way, and it shall be called The way of holiness; the unclean shall not pass over it; but it shall be for those: the wayfaring men, though fools, shall not err therein.
bsb_text: And there will be a highway called the Way of Holiness. The unclean will not travel it—only those who walk in the Way—and fools will not stray onto it.
aov_text: En dáár sal ’n grootpad wees en ’n weg wat die heilige weg genoem sal word; geen onreine sal daarop voorttrek nie, maar vir húlle sal dit wees; wie die weg bewandel—selfs die dwase sal nie dwaal nie.

kjv_text: No lion shall be there, nor any ravenous beast shall go up thereon, it shall not be found there; but the redeemed shall walk there:
bsb_text: No lion will be there, and no vicious beast will go up on it. Such will not be found there, but the redeemed will walk upon it.
aov_text: Dáár sal geen leeu wees nie, en geen verskeurende dier sal daarop kom of daar aangetref word nie; maar die verlostes sal daarop wandel;

kjv_text: And the ransomed of the LORD shall return, and come to Zion with songs and everlasting joy upon their heads: they shall obtain joy and gladness, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.
bsb_text: So the redeemed of the LORD will return and enter Zion with singing, crowned with everlasting joy. Gladness and joy will overtake them, and sorrow and sighing will flee.
aov_text: en die losgekooptes van die HERE sal teruggaan en na Sion kom met gejubel, en ewige vreugde sal op hulle hoof wees; vreugde en blydskap sal hulle verkry, maar kommer en gesug vlug weg.

kjv_text: Now it came to pass in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah, that Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the defenced cities of Judah, and took them.
bsb_text: In the fourteenth year of Hezekiah’s reign, Sennacherib king of Assyria attacked and captured all the fortified cities of Judah.
aov_text: EN in die veertiende jaar van koning Hiskía het Sánherib, die koning van Assirië, opgetrek teen al die versterkte stede van Juda en dit verower.

kjv_text: And the king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem unto king Hezekiah with a great army. And he stood by the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller's field.
bsb_text: And the king of Assyria sent the Rabshakeh, with a great army, from Lachish to King Hezekiah at Jerusalem. And he stopped by the aqueduct of the upper pool, on the road to the Launderer’s Field.
aov_text: Toe stuur die koning van Assirië die rábsake uit Lagis na Jerusalem, na koning Hiskía met ’n swaar leër; en hy het gaan staan by die watervoor van die Boonste Dam, by die grootpad van die Bleikveld.

kjv_text: Then came forth unto him Eliakim, Hilkiah's son, which was over the house, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, Asaph's son, the recorder.
bsb_text: Then Eliakim son of Hilkiah the palace administrator, Shebna the scribe, and Joah son of Asaph the recorder, went out to him.
aov_text: Daarop gaan Éljakim, die seun van Hilkía, wat oor die paleis was, en Sebna, die skrywer, en Joa, die seun van Asaf, die kanselier, na hom toe uit.

kjv_text: And Rabshakeh said unto them, Say ye now to Hezekiah, Thus saith the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence is this wherein thou trustest?
bsb_text: The Rabshakeh said to them, “Tell Hezekiah that this is what the great king, the king of Assyria, says: What is the basis of this confidence of yours?
aov_text: En die rábsake sê vir hulle: Sê tog aan Hiskía: So spreek die groot koning, die koning van Assirië: Wat is dit vir ’n vertroue wat jy koester?

kjv_text: I say, sayest thou, (but they are but vain words) I have counsel and strength for war: now on whom dost thou trust, that thou rebellest against me?
bsb_text: You claim to have a strategy and strength for war, but these are empty words. In whom are you now trusting, that you have rebelled against me?
aov_text: Jy dink: Net ’n woord van die lippe is raad en dapperheid vir die oorlog. Op wie vertrou jy nou, dat jy teen my in opstand kom?

kjv_text: Lo, thou trustest in the staff of this broken reed, on Egypt; whereon if a man lean, it will go into his hand, and pierce it: so is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all that trust in him.
bsb_text: Look now, you are trusting in Egypt, that splintered reed of a staff that will pierce the hand of anyone who leans on it. Such is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who trust in him.
aov_text: Kyk, jy vertrou op dié geknakte rietstok, op Egipte, wat, as iemand daarop leun, in sy hand ingaan en dit deurboor; so is Farao, die koning van Egipte, vir almal wat op hom vertrou.

kjv_text: But if thou say to me, We trust in the LORD our God: is it not he, whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away, and said to Judah and to Jerusalem, Ye shall worship before this altar?
bsb_text: But if you say to me, ‘We trust in the LORD our God,’ is He not the One whose high places and altars Hezekiah has removed, saying to Judah and Jerusalem, ‘You must worship before this altar’?
aov_text: Maar as jy vir my sê: Ons vertrou op die HERE onse God—is dit nie Hy wie se hoogtes en wie se altare Hiskía verwyder het nie deur aan Juda en Jerusalem te sê: Voor hierdie altaar moet julle buig?

kjv_text: Now therefore give pledges, I pray thee, to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give thee two thousand horses, if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them.
bsb_text: Now, therefore, make a bargain with my master, the king of Assyria. I will give you two thousand horses—if you can put riders on them!
aov_text: Nou dan, wed tog met my heer, die koning van Assirië, en ek sal jou tweeduisend perde gee as jy vir jou ruiters daarop kan lewer.

kjv_text: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master's servants, and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?
bsb_text: For how can you repel a single officer among the least of my master’s servants when you depend on Egypt for chariots and horsemen?
aov_text: Hoe sal jy dan die aanval van ’n enkele goewerneur van my heer se geringste dienaars kan afslaan? Maar jy vertrou op Egipte vir strydwaens en perderuiters!

kjv_text: And am I now come up without the LORD against this land to destroy it? the LORD said unto me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.
bsb_text: So now, was it apart from the LORD that I have come up against this land to destroy it? The LORD Himself said to me, ‘Go up against this land and destroy it.’”
aov_text: Het ek dan nou sonder die HERE teen hierdie land opgetrek om dit te verwoes? Die HERE het vir my gesê: Trek op teen hierdie land en verwoes dit.

kjv_text: Then said Eliakim and Shebna and Joah unto Rabshakeh, Speak, I pray thee, unto thy servants in the Syrian language; for we understand it: and speak not to us in the Jews' language, in the ears of the people that are on the wall.
bsb_text: Then Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah said to the Rabshakeh, “Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, since we understand it. Do not speak to us in Hebrew in the hearing of the people on the wall.”
aov_text: Toe sê Éljakim en Sebna en Joa vir die rábsake: Praat tog met u dienaars Aramees, want ons verstaan dit; en moenie met ons Joods praat voor die ore van die manskappe wat op die muur is nie.

kjv_text: But Rabshakeh said, Hath my master sent me to thy master and to thee to speak these words? hath he not sent me to the men that sit upon the wall, that they may eat their own dung, and drink their own piss with you?
bsb_text: But the Rabshakeh replied, “Has my master sent me to speak these words only to you and your master, and not to the men sitting on the wall, who are destined with you to eat their own dung and drink their own urine?”
aov_text: Maar die rábsake het gesê: Het my heer my na jou heer en na jou gestuur om hierdie woorde te spreek? Is dit nie na die manne wat op die muur sit, dat hulle hul eie drek kan eet en hul eie water kan drink saam met julle nie?

kjv_text: Then Rabshakeh stood, and cried with a loud voice in the Jews' language, and said, Hear ye the words of the great king, the king of Assyria.
bsb_text: Then the Rabshakeh stood and called out loudly in Hebrew: “Hear the words of the great king, the king of Assyria!
aov_text: Toe gaan die rábsake staan en roep hardop in die Joodse taal en sê: Hoor die woorde van die groot koning, die koning van Assirië!

kjv_text: Thus saith the king, Let not Hezekiah deceive you: for he shall not be able to deliver you.
bsb_text: This is what the king says: Do not let Hezekiah deceive you, for he cannot deliver you.
aov_text: So sê die koning: Laat Hiskía julle nie bedrieg nie, want hy sal julle nie kan red nie.

kjv_text: Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the LORD, saying, The LORD will surely deliver us: this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.
bsb_text: Do not let Hezekiah persuade you to trust in the LORD when he says, ‘The LORD will surely deliver us; this city will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.’
aov_text: En Hiskía moet julle nie op die HERE laat vertrou nie deur te sê: Die HERE sal ons sekerlik red; hierdie stad sal nie in die hand van die koning van Assirië oorgegee word nie.

kjv_text: Hearken not to Hezekiah: for thus saith the king of Assyria, Make an agreement with me by a present, and come out to me: and eat ye every one of his vine, and every one of his fig tree, and drink ye every one the waters of his own cistern;
bsb_text: Do not listen to Hezekiah, for this is what the king of Assyria says: Make peace with me and come out to me. Then every one of you will eat from his own vine and his own fig tree, and drink water from his own cistern,
aov_text: Luister nie na Hiskía nie; want so sê die koning van Assirië: Sluit met my vriendskap en trek uit na my toe en eet elkeen van sy wingerdstok en elkeen van sy vyeboom en drink elkeen die water van sy put,

kjv_text: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of corn and wine, a land of bread and vineyards.
bsb_text: until I come and take you away to a land like your own—a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards.
aov_text: totdat ek kom en julle meeneem na ’n land soos julle land, ’n land van koring en mos, ’n land van brood en wingerde.

kjv_text: Beware lest Hezekiah persuade you, saying, The LORD will deliver us. Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?
bsb_text: Do not let Hezekiah mislead you when he says, ‘The LORD will deliver us.’ Has the god of any nation ever delivered his land from the hand of the king of Assyria?
aov_text: Laat Hiskía julle nie verlei nie deur te sê: Die HERE sal ons red! Het die gode van die nasies elkeen sy land gered uit die hand van die koning van Assirië?

kjv_text: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arphad? where are the gods of Sepharvaim? and have they delivered Samaria out of my hand?
bsb_text: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim? Have they delivered Samaria from my hand?
aov_text: Waar is die gode van Hamat en Arpad? Waar die gode van Sefarváim? En het hulle miskien Samaría gered uit my hand?

kjv_text: Who are they among all the gods of these lands, that have delivered their land out of my hand, that the LORD should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?
bsb_text: Who among all the gods of these lands has delivered his land from my hand? How then can the LORD deliver Jerusalem from my hand?”
aov_text: Wie is daar onder al die gode van hierdie lande wat hulle land gered het uit my hand, dat die HERE Jerusalem uit my hand sou red?

kjv_text: But they held their peace, and answered him not a word: for the king's commandment was, saying, Answer him not.
bsb_text: But the people remained silent and did not answer a word, for Hezekiah had commanded, “Do not answer him.”
aov_text: Maar hulle het stilgebly en hom niks geantwoord nie; want dit was die bevel van die koning: Julle moet hom nie antwoord nie.

kjv_text: Then came Eliakim, the son of Hilkiah, that was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph, the recorder, to Hezekiah with their clothes rent, and told him the words of Rabshakeh.
bsb_text: Then Hilkiah’s son Eliakim the palace administrator, Shebna the scribe, and Asaph’s son Joah the recorder came to Hezekiah with their clothes torn, and they relayed to him the words of the Rabshakeh.
aov_text: Toe het Éljakim, die seun van Hilkía, wat oor die paleis was, en Sebna, die skrywer, en Joa, die seun van Asaf, die kanselier, met geskeurde klere by Hiskía gekom en hom die woorde van die rábsake te kenne gegee.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when king Hezekiah heard it, that he rent his clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the LORD.
bsb_text: On hearing this report, King Hezekiah tore his clothes, put on sackcloth, and entered the house of the LORD.
aov_text: EN toe koning Hiskía dit hoor, het hy sy klere geskeur en hom met ’n roukleed bedek en in die huis van die HERE gegaan.

kjv_text: And he sent Eliakim, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests covered with sackcloth, unto Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.
bsb_text: And he sent Eliakim the palace administrator, Shebna the scribe, and the leading priests, all wearing sackcloth, to the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz
aov_text: Daarna stuur hy Éljakim, wat oor die paleis was, en Sebna, die skrywer, en die oudstes van die priesters, met rouklere bedek, na die profeet Jesaja, die seun van Amos.

kjv_text: And they said unto him, Thus saith Hezekiah, This day is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and of blasphemy: for the children are come to the birth, and there is not strength to bring forth.
bsb_text: to tell him, “This is what Hezekiah says: Today is a day of distress, rebuke, and disgrace; for children have come to the point of birth, but there is no strength to deliver them.
aov_text: En hulle sê vir hom: So sê Hiskía: Vandag is ’n dag van benoudheid en straf en lastering; want die kinders het tot by die geboorte gekom, maar daar is geen krag om te baar nie.

kjv_text: It may be the LORD thy God will hear the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God, and will reprove the words which the LORD thy God hath heard: wherefore lift up thy prayer for the remnant that is left.
bsb_text: Perhaps the LORD your God will hear the words of the Rabshakeh, whom his master the king of Assyria has sent to defy the living God, and He will rebuke him for the words that the LORD your God has heard. Therefore lift up a prayer for the remnant that still survives.”
aov_text: Miskien sal die HERE u God die woorde hoor van die rábsake wat deur sy heer, die koning van Assirië, gestuur is om die lewende God te smaad, en sal Hy hom straf oor die woorde wat die HERE u God gehoor het; hef dan ’n gebed op vir die oorblyfsel wat nog aanwesig is.

kjv_text: So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah.
bsb_text: So the servants of King Hezekiah went to Isaiah,
aov_text: En toe die dienaars van koning Hiskía by Jesaja kom,

kjv_text: And Isaiah said unto them, Thus shall ye say unto your master, Thus saith the LORD, Be not afraid of the words that thou hast heard, wherewith the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.

bsb_text: Tell us the things that are to come, so that we may know that you are gods. Yes, do something good or evil, that we may look on together in dismay.
aov_text: Gee te kenne dinge wat later sal kom, sodat ons kan weet dat julle gode is; ja, doen goed of doen kwaad, dat ons verbaas kan staan en dit saam kan sien.

kjv_text: Behold, ye are of nothing, and your work of nought: an abomination is he that chooseth you.
bsb_text: Behold, you are nothing and your work is of no value. Anyone who chooses you is detestable.
aov_text: Kyk, julle is niks, en julle werk is niks; ’n gruwel is hy wat julle uitkies.

kjv_text: I have raised up one from the north, and he shall come: from the rising of the sun shall he call upon my name: and he shall come upon princes as upon morter, and as the potter treadeth clay.
bsb_text: I have raised up one from the north, and he has come—one from the east who calls on My name. He will march over rulers as if they were mortar, like a potter who treads the clay.
aov_text: Ek het uit die Noorde een verwek, en hy het gekom; van die opgang van die son af een wat my Naam sal aanroep; en hy kom oor die owerstes soos oor modder, en soos ’n pottebakker die klei trap.

kjv_text: Who hath declared from the beginning, that we may know? and beforetime, that we may say, He is righteous? yea, there is none that sheweth, yea, there is none that declareth, yea, there is none that heareth your words.
bsb_text: Who has declared this from the beginning, so that we may know, and from times past, so that we may say: ‘He was right’? No one announced it, no one foretold it, no one heard your words.
aov_text: Wie het dit te kenne gegee van die begin af, dat ons daar kennis van kan neem; of vantevore al, dat ons kan sê: Hy het reg? Ja, daar is niemand wat dit te kenne gee, ja, niemand wat dit laat hoor, ja, niemand wat julle woorde hoor nie.

kjv_text: The first shall say to Zion, Behold, behold them: and I will give to Jerusalem one that bringeth good tidings.
bsb_text: I was the first to tell Zion: ‘Look, here they are!’ And I gave to Jerusalem a herald of good news.
aov_text: As die Eerste sê Ek aan Sion: Hier, hier is dit! En aan Jerusalem gee Ek ’n verkondiger van goeie boodskap.

kjv_text: For I beheld, and there was no man; even among them, and there was no counsellor, that, when I asked of them, could answer a word.
bsb_text: When I look, there is no one; there is no counselor among them; when I ask them, they have nothing to say.
aov_text: En Ek kyk rond, maar daar is niemand nie; en onder hulle, maar daar is geen raadgewer, dat Ek hulle kan vra en hulle antwoord kan gee nie.

kjv_text: Behold, they are all vanity; their works are nothing: their molten images are wind and confusion.
bsb_text: See, they are all a delusion; their works amount to nothing; their images are as empty as the wind.
aov_text: Kyk, hulle is almal niks, hulle werke is niks, wind en nietigheid is hulle gegote beelde.

kjv_text: Behold my servant, whom I uphold; mine elect, in whom my soul delighteth; I have put my spirit upon him: he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles.
bsb_text: “Here is My Servant, whom I uphold, My Chosen One, in whom My soul delights. I will put My Spirit on Him, and He will bring justice to the nations.
aov_text: DAAR is my Kneg wat Ek ondersteun, my Uitverkorene in wie my siel ’n welbehae het. Ek het my Gees op Hom gelê; Hy sal die reg na die nasies uitbring.

kjv_text: He shall not cry, nor lift up, nor cause his voice to be heard in the street.
bsb_text: He will not cry out or raise His voice, nor make His voice heard in the streets.
aov_text: Hy sal nie skreeu of uitroep of sy stem op die straat laat hoor nie.

kjv_text: A bruised reed shall he not break, and the smoking flax shall he not quench: he shall bring forth judgment unto truth.
bsb_text: A bruised reed He will not break and a smoldering wick He will not extinguish; He will faithfully bring forth justice.
aov_text: Die geknakte riet sal Hy nie verbreek en die dowwe lamppit nie uitblus nie; met getrouheid sal Hy die reg uitbring.

kjv_text: He shall not fail nor be discouraged, till he have set judgment in the earth: and the isles shall wait for his law.
bsb_text: He will not grow weak or discouraged before He has established justice on the earth. In His law the islands will put their hope.”
aov_text: Hy sal nie dof brand of geknak word, totdat Hy die reg op aarde gegrond het nie; en die eilande wag op sy leer.

kjv_text: Thus saith God the LORD, he that created the heavens, and stretched them out; he that spread forth the earth, and that which cometh out of it; he that giveth breath unto the people upon it, and spirit to them that walk therein:
bsb_text: This is what God the LORD says—He who created the heavens and stretched them out, who spread out the earth and its offspring, who gives breath to the people on it and life to those who walk in it:
aov_text: So sê God, die HERE, wat die hemele geskape en hulle uitgesprei het, die aarde uitgespan het saam met wat daaruit voortkom, wat aan die aardbewoners die asem gee en die gees aan wie daarop wandel:

kjv_text: I the LORD have called thee in righteousness, and will hold thine hand, and will keep thee, and give thee for a covenant of the people, for a light of the Gentiles;
bsb_text: “I, the LORD, have called you for a righteous purpose, and I will take hold of your hand. I will keep you and appoint you to be a covenant for the people and a light to the nations,
aov_text: Ek, die HERE, het U geroep in geregtigheid, en Ek vat u hand en behoed U en gee U as ’n verbond van die volk, as ’n lig van die nasies,

kjv_text: To open the blind eyes, to bring out the prisoners from the prison, and them that sit in darkness out of the prison house.
bsb_text: to open the eyes of the blind, to bring prisoners out of the dungeon and those sitting in darkness out from the prison house.
aov_text: om blinde oë te open; om gevangenes uit die kerker uit te lei, uit die gevangenis diegene wat in die duisternis sit.

kjv_text: I am the LORD: that is my name: and my glory will I not give to another, neither my praise to graven images.
bsb_text: I am the LORD; that is My name! I will not yield My glory to another or My praise to idols.
aov_text: EK is die HERE, dit is my Naam; en my eer sal Ek aan geen ander gee, of ook my lof aan die gesnede beelde nie.

kjv_text: Behold, the former things are come to pass, and new things do I declare: before they spring forth I tell you of them.
bsb_text: Behold, the former things have happened, and now I declare new things. Before they spring forth I proclaim them to you.”
aov_text: Kyk, die vorige dinge het gekom, en nuwe dinge verkondig Ek; voordat hulle uitspruit, laat Ek julle dit hoor.

kjv_text: Sing unto the LORD a new song, and his praise from the end of the earth, ye that go down to the sea, and all that is therein; the isles, and the inhabitants thereof.
bsb_text: Sing to the LORD a new song—His praise from the ends of the earth—you who go down to the sea, and all that is in it, you islands, and all who dwell in them.
aov_text: Sing tot eer van die HERE ’n nuwe lied, sy lof van die einde van die aarde af—julle wat op die see vaar, en alles wat daarin is, eilande en bewoners daarvan.

kjv_text: Let the wilderness and the cities thereof lift up their voice, the villages that Kedar doth inhabit: let the inhabitants of the rock sing, let them shout from the top of the mountains.
bsb_text: Let the desert and its cities raise their voices; let the villages of Kedar cry aloud. Let the people of Sela sing for joy; let them cry out from the mountaintops.
aov_text: Laat die woestyn en sy stede uitroep, die dorpe waar Kedar woon! Laat die rotsbewoners jubel, van die top van die berge af skreeu!

kjv_text: Let them give glory unto the LORD, and declare his praise in the islands.
bsb_text: Let them give glory to the LORD and declare His praise in the islands.
aov_text: Laat hulle aan die HERE die eer gee en sy lof in die eilande verkondig!

kjv_text: The LORD shall go forth as a mighty man, he shall stir up jealousy like a man of war: he shall cry, yea, roar; he shall prevail against his enemies.
bsb_text: The LORD goes forth like a mighty one; He stirs up His zeal like a warrior. He shouts; yes, He roars in triumph over His enemies:
aov_text: Die HERE sal uittrek soos ’n held; Hy sal die ywer opwek soos ’n krygsman; Hy sal die strydkreet aanhef, ja, uitskreeu, teen sy vyande Hom as held openbaar.

kjv_text: I have long time holden my peace; I have been still, and refrained myself: now will I cry like a travailing woman; I will destroy and devour at once.
bsb_text: “I have kept silent from ages past; I have remained quiet and restrained. But now I will groan like a woman in labor; I will at once gasp and pant.
aov_text: Ek het baie lank geswyg, My stil gehou, My bedwing. Ek sal uitskreeu soos een wat baar, Ek sal hard asemhaal en hyg tegelykertyd.

kjv_text: I will make waste mountains and hills, and dry up all their herbs; and I will make the rivers islands, and I will dry up the pools.
bsb_text: I will lay waste the mountains and hills and dry up all their vegetation. I will turn the rivers into dry land and drain the marshes.
aov_text: Ek sal berge en heuwels woes maak en al hulle plante laat verdroog; en Ek sal riviere tot eilande maak en waterplasse laat opdroog.

kjv_text: And I will bring the blind by a way that they knew not; I will lead them in paths that they have not known: I will make darkness light before them, and crooked things straight. These things will I do unto them, and not forsake them.
bsb_text: I will lead the blind by a way they did not know; I will guide them on unfamiliar paths. I will turn darkness into light before them and rough places into level ground. These things I will do for them, and I will not forsake them.
aov_text: En Ek sal blindes lei op ’n weg wat hulle nie ken nie, hulle laat loop op paaie wat vir hulle onbekend is; Ek sal die duisternis lig maak voor hulle uit en die hobbelagtige plekke gelyktes. Dit is die dinge wat Ek doen en nie nalaat nie.

kjv_text: They shall be turned back, they shall be greatly ashamed, that trust in graven images, that say to the molten images, Ye are our gods.
bsb_text: But those who trust in idols and say to molten images, ‘You are our gods!’ will be turned back in utter shame.
aov_text: Maar die wat op gesnede beelde vertrou, wat aan gegote beelde sê: Julle is ons gode—dié sal agteruitwyk, diep beskaamd staan.

kjv_text: Hear, ye deaf; and look, ye blind, that ye may see.
bsb_text: Listen, you deaf ones; look, you blind ones, that you may see!
aov_text: HOOR, julle dowes, en kyk, julle blindes, om te kan sien.

kjv_text: Who is blind, but my servant? or deaf, as my messenger that I sent? who is blind as he that is perfect, and blind as the LORD's servant?
bsb_text: Who is blind but My servant, or deaf like the messenger I am sending? Who is blind like My covenant partner, or blind like the servant of the LORD?
aov_text: Wie is blind buiten my kneg en doof soos my boodskapper wat Ek stuur? Wie is blind soos die vertroude vriend, en blind soos die kneg van die HERE?

kjv_text: Seeing many things, but thou observest not; opening the ears, but he heareth not.
bsb_text: Though seeing many things, you do not keep watch. Though your ears are open, you do not hear.”
aov_text: Jy het wel baie dinge gesien, maar daar geen ag op gegee nie; die ore oop gehad, maar jy hoor nie.

kjv_text: The LORD is well pleased for his righteousness' sake; he will magnify the law, and make it honourable.
bsb_text: The LORD was pleased, for the sake of His righteousness, to magnify His law and make it glorious.
aov_text: Dit het die HERE behaag ter wille van sy geregtigheid om die onderwysing groot en heerlik te maak.

kjv_text: But this is a people robbed and spoiled; they are all of them snared in holes, and they are hid in prison houses: they are for a prey, and none delivereth; for a spoil, and none saith, Restore.
bsb_text: But this is a people plundered and looted, all trapped in caves or imprisoned in dungeons. They have become plunder with no one to rescue them, and loot with no one to say, “Send them back!”
aov_text: En tog is dit ’n beroofde en geplunderde volk; hulle is almal gebonde in kerkers, verborge in gevangenisse; hulle het ’n buit geword sonder dat iemand red, ’n plundering sonder dat iemand sê: Gee terug!

kjv_text: Who among you will give ear to this? who will hearken and hear for the time to come?
bsb_text: Who among you will pay attention to this? Who will listen and obey hereafter?
aov_text: Wie onder julle luister na hierdie dinge? Wie merk op, hoor dit ook vir die toekoms?

kjv_text: Who gave Jacob for a spoil, and Israel to the robbers? did not the LORD, he against whom we have sinned? for they would not walk in his ways, neither were they obedient unto his law.
bsb_text: Who gave Jacob up for spoil, and Israel to the plunderers? Was it not the LORD, against whom we have sinned? They were unwilling to walk in His ways, and they would not obey His law.
aov_text: Wie het Jakob oorgegee as ’n plundering en Israel aan die berowers? Is dit nie die HERE teen wie ons gesondig het nie? En hulle wou in sy weë nie wandel nie en het na sy wet nie geluister nie.

kjv_text: Therefore he hath poured upon him the fury of his anger, and the strength of battle: and it hath set him on fire round about, yet he knew not; and it burned him, yet he laid it not to heart.
bsb_text: So He poured out on them His furious anger and the fierceness of battle. It enveloped them in flames, but they did not understand; it consumed them, but they did not take it to heart.
aov_text: Daarom het Hy oor hulle uitgestort die gloed van sy toorn en die geweld van die oorlog; en dit het hulle rondom aan die brand gesteek, maar hulle het dit nie bemerk nie; en dit het hulle gebrand, maar hulle het dit nie ter harte geneem nie.

kjv_text: But now thus saith the LORD that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel, Fear not: for I have redeemed thee, I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.
bsb_text: Now this is what the LORD says—He who created you, O Jacob, and He who formed you, O Israel: “Do not fear, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by your name; you are Mine!
aov_text: MAAR nou, so sê die HERE, jou Skepper, o Jakob, en jou Formeerder, o Israel: Wees nie bevrees nie, want Ek het jou verlos; Ek het jou by jou naam geroep; jy is myne!

kjv_text: When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.
bsb_text: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; and when you go through the rivers, they will not overwhelm you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be scorched; the flames will not set you ablaze.
aov_text: As jy deur die water gaan, is Ek by jou; en deur die riviere—hulle sal jou nie oorstroom nie; as jy deur vuur gaan, sal jy jou nie skroei nie, en die vlam sal jou nie brand nie.

kjv_text: For I am the LORD thy God, the Holy One of Israel, thy Saviour: I gave Egypt for thy ransom, Ethiopia and Seba for thee.
bsb_text: For I am the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior; I give Egypt for your ransom, Cush and Seba in your place.
aov_text: Want Ek is die HERE, jou God, die Heilige van Israel, jou Heiland; Ek het Egipte gegee as losprys vir jou, Kus en Seba in jou plek.

kjv_text: Since thou wast precious in my sight, thou hast been honourable, and I have loved thee: therefore will I give men for thee, and people for thy life.
bsb_text: Because you are precious and honored in My sight, and because I love you, I will give men in exchange for you and nations in place of your life.
aov_text: Omdat jy kostelik is in my oë, hooggeag is, en Ek jou liefhet, daarom gee Ek mense in jou plek en volke vir jou lewe.

kjv_text: Fear not: for I am with thee: I will bring thy seed from the east, and gather thee from the west;
bsb_text: Do not be afraid, for I am with you; I will bring your offspring from the east and gather you from the west.
aov_text: Wees nie bevrees nie, want Ek is met jou; Ek sal jou geslag van die ooste af aanbring en jou versamel van die weste af.

kjv_text: I will say to the north, Give up; and to the south, Keep not back: bring my sons from far, and my daughters from the ends of the earth;
bsb_text: I will say to the north, ‘Give them up!’ and to the south, ‘Do not hold them back!’ Bring My sons from afar, and My daughters from the ends of the earth—
aov_text: Ek sal sê aan die noorde: Gee! en aan die suide: Hou nie terug nie! Bring my seuns van ver, en my dogters van die einde van die aarde af,

kjv_text: Even every one that is called by my name: for I have created him for my glory, I have formed him; yea, I have made him.
bsb_text: everyone called by My name and created for My glory, whom I have indeed formed and made.”
aov_text: elkeen wat na my Naam genoem is en wat Ek geskape het tot my eer, wat Ek geformeer, wat Ek ook gemaak het.

kjv_text: Bring forth the blind people that have eyes, and the deaf that have ears.
bsb_text: Bring out a people who have eyes but are blind, and who have ears but are deaf.
aov_text: Bring uit die volk wat blind is en tog oë het, en die dowes wat ore het.

kjv_text: Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the people be assembled: who among them can declare this, and shew us former things? let them bring forth their witnesses, that they may be justified: or let them hear, and say, It is truth.
bsb_text: All the nations gather together and the peoples assemble. Who among them can declare this, and proclaim to us the former things? Let them present their witnesses to vindicate them, so that others may hear and say, “It is true.”
aov_text: AL die nasies het saam vergader, en die volke is versamel. Wie onder hulle kan sulke dinge verkondig? En laat hulle ons die vorige dinge bekend maak! Laat hulle hul getuies bring, dat hulle in die gelyk gestel kan word; en laat hulle hoor en sê: Dit is die waarheid!

kjv_text: Ye are my witnesses, saith the LORD, and my servant whom I have chosen: that ye may know and believe me, and understand that I am he: before me there was no God formed, neither shall there be after me.
bsb_text: “You are My witnesses,” declares the LORD, “and My servant whom I have chosen, so that you may consider and believe Me and understand that I am He. Before Me no god was formed, and after Me none will come.
aov_text: Júlle is my getuies, spreek die HERE, en my kneg wat Ek uitverkies het, sodat julle kan weet en My kan glo en insien dat dit Ek is—voor My is geen God geformeer nie, en ná My sal daar geeneen wees nie.

kjv_text: I, even I, am the LORD; and beside me there is no saviour.
bsb_text: I, yes I, am the LORD, and there is no Savior but Me.
aov_text: Ek, Ek is die HERE, en daar is geen Heiland buiten My nie.

kjv_text: I have declared, and have saved, and I have shewed, when there was no strange god among you: therefore ye are my witnesses, saith the LORD, that I am God.
bsb_text: I alone decreed and saved and proclaimed—I, and not some foreign god among you. So you are My witnesses,” declares the LORD, “that I am God.
aov_text: Ék het verkondig en verlos en dit laat hoor, en daar was geen ander god onder julle nie; en julle is my getuies, spreek die HERE, en Ek is God.

kjv_text: Yea, before the day was I am he; and there is none that can deliver out of my hand: I will work, and who shall let it?
bsb_text: Even from eternity I am He, and none can deliver out of My hand. When I act, who can reverse it?”
aov_text: Ook van vandag af is Ek dit, en niemand red uit my hand nie; Ek werk, en wie kan dit keer?

kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD, your redeemer, the Holy One of Israel; For your sake I have sent to Babylon, and have brought down all their nobles, and the Chaldeans, whose cry is in the ships.
bsb_text: Thus says the LORD your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: “For your sake, I will send to Babylon and bring them all as fugitives, even the Chaldeans, in the ships in which they rejoice.
aov_text: So sê die HERE, jou Losser, die Heilige van Israel: Om julle ontwil het Ek na Babel gestuur, en Ek sal hulle almal as vlugtelinge laat afdaal, naamlik die Chaldeërs, in die skepe waarop hulle gejuig het.

kjv_text: I am the LORD, your Holy One, the creator of Israel, your King.
bsb_text: I am the LORD, your Holy One, the Creator of Israel, and your King.”
aov_text: Ek is die HERE, julle Heilige; die Skepper van Israel, julle Koning.

kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD, which maketh a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty waters;
bsb_text: Thus says the LORD, who makes a way in the sea and a path through the surging waters,
aov_text: So sê die HERE wat in die see ’n weg en in die sterk waters ’n pad gemaak het,

kjv_text: Which bringeth forth the chariot and horse, the army and the power; they shall lie down together, they shall not rise: they are extinct, they are quenched as tow.
bsb_text: who brings out the chariots and horses, the armies and warriors together, to lie down, never to rise again; to be extinguished, snuffed out like a wick:
aov_text: wat waens en perde, leërmag en held laat uittrek het; tesame lê hulle, hulle sal nie opstaan nie; hulle is uitgeblus, soos ’n lamppit uitgedoof.

kjv_text: Remember ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old.
bsb_text: “Do not call to mind the former things; pay no attention to the things of old.
aov_text: Dink nie aan die vorige dinge nie, en slaan geen ag op wat vroeër gebeur het nie.

kjv_text: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
bsb_text: Behold, I am about to do something new; even now it is coming. Do you not see it? Indeed, I will make a way in the wilderness and streams in the desert.
aov_text: Kyk, Ek gaan iets nuuts maak; nou sal dit uitspruit; sal julle dit nie merk nie? Ja, Ek maak ’n pad in die woestyn, riviere in die wildernis.

kjv_text: The beast of the field shall honour me, the dragons and the owls: because I give waters in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert, to give drink to my people, my chosen.
bsb_text: The beasts of the field will honor Me, the jackals and the ostriches, because I provide water in the wilderness and rivers in the desert, to give drink to My chosen people.
aov_text: Die wilde diere van die veld sal My eer, die jakkalse en die volstruise; want Ek gee waters in die woestyn, riviere in die wildernis om my volk, my uitverkorene, te laat drink.

kjv_text: This people have I formed for myself; they shall shew forth my praise.
bsb_text: The people I formed for Myself will declare My praise.
aov_text: Die volk wat Ek vir My geformeer het, hulle sal my lof verkondig.

kjv_text: But thou hast not called upon me, O Jacob; but thou hast been weary of me, O Israel.
bsb_text: But you have not called on Me, O Jacob, because you have grown weary of Me, O Israel.
aov_text: NOGTANS het jy Mý nie aangeroep, o Jakob, dat jy jou vir My sou vermoei het nie, o Israel!

kjv_text: Thou hast not brought me the small cattle of thy burnt offerings; neither hast thou honoured me with thy sacrifices. I have not caused thee to serve with an offering, nor wearied thee with incense.
bsb_text: You have not brought Me sheep for burnt offerings, nor honored Me with your sacrifices. I have not burdened you with offerings, nor wearied you with frankincense.
aov_text: Jy het vir My nie gebring die kleinvee van jou brandoffers nie, en met jou slagoffers het jy My nie geëer nie; Ek het jou geen oorlas aangedoen met spysoffers en jou nie vermoei met wierook nie.

kjv_text: Thou hast bought me no sweet cane with money, neither hast thou filled me with the fat of thy sacrifices: but thou hast made me to serve with thy sins, thou hast wearied me with thine iniquities.
bsb_text: You have not bought Me sweet cane with your silver, nor satisfied Me with the fat of your sacrifices. But you have burdened Me with your sins; you have wearied Me with your iniquities.
aov_text: Jy het vir My geen kalmoes met geld gekoop en met die vet van jou slagoffers My nie verkwik nie; maar jy het My oorlas aangedoen met jou sondes, jy het My vermoei met jou ongeregtighede.

kjv_text: I, even I, am he that blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake, and will not remember thy sins.
bsb_text: I, yes I, am He who blots out your transgressions for My own sake and remembers your sins no more.
aov_text: Ek, Ek is dit wat jou oortredinge uitdelg om My ontwil, en aan jou sondes dink Ek nie.

kjv_text: Put me in remembrance: let us plead together: declare thou, that thou mayest be justified.
bsb_text: Remind Me, let us argue the matter together. State your case, so that you may be vindicated.
aov_text: Maak My indagtig; laat ons teen mekaar pleit; vertel jy, dat jy in die gelyk gestel kan word.

kjv_text: Thy first father hath sinned, and thy teachers have transgressed against me.
bsb_text: Your first father sinned, and your spokesmen rebelled against Me.
aov_text: Jou eerste vader het gesondig, en jou tolke het teen My oortree.

kjv_text: Therefore I have profaned the princes of the sanctuary, and have given Jacob to the curse, and Israel to reproaches.
bsb_text: So I will disgrace the princes of your sanctuary, and I will devote Jacob to destruction and Israel to reproach.”
aov_text: So het Ek dan heilige vorste ontheilig en Jakob aan die banvloek oorgegee en Israel aan beskimpinge.

kjv_text: Yet now hear, O Jacob my servant; and Israel, whom I have chosen:
bsb_text: But now listen, O Jacob My servant, Israel, whom I have chosen.
aov_text: MAAR luister nou, my kneg Jakob, en Israel wat Ek uitverkies het!

kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD that made thee, and formed thee from the womb, which will help thee; Fear not, O Jacob, my servant; and thou, Jesurun, whom I have chosen.
bsb_text: This is the word of the LORD, your Maker, who formed you from the womb and who will help you: “Do not be afraid, O Jacob My servant, Jeshurun, whom I have chosen.
aov_text: So sê die HERE, jou Maker en jou Formeerder van die moederskoot af, wat jou help: Wees nie bevrees nie, Jakob, my kneg, en Jesúrun wat Ek uitverkies het!

kjv_text: For I will pour water upon him that is thirsty, and floods upon the dry ground: I will pour my spirit upon thy seed, and my blessing upon thine offspring:
bsb_text: For I will pour water on the thirsty land, and currents on the dry ground. I will pour out My Spirit on your descendants, and My blessing on your offspring.
aov_text: Want Ek sal water giet op die dorsland en strome op die droë grond; Ek sal my Gees op jou kroos giet en my seën op jou nakomelinge.

kjv_text: And they shall spring up as among the grass, as willows by the water courses.
bsb_text: They will sprout among the grass like willows by flowing streams.
aov_text: En hulle sal uitspruit tussen die gras in, soos wilgerbome by waterlope.

kjv_text: One shall say, I am the LORD's; and another shall call himself by the name of Jacob; and another shall subscribe with his hand unto the LORD, and surname himself by the name of Israel.
bsb_text: One will say, ‘I belong to the LORD,’ another will call himself by the name of Jacob, and still another will write on his hand, ‘The LORD’s,’ and will take the name of Israel.”
aov_text: Die een sal sê: Ek behoort aan die HERE; en die ander sal die naam van Jakob uitroep; en die ander sal met sy hand skrywe: Ek behoort aan die HERE, en hom met die erenaam Israel noem.

kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD the King of Israel, and his redeemer the LORD of hosts; I am the first, and I am the last; and beside me there is no God.
bsb_text: Thus says the LORD, the King and Redeemer of Israel, the LORD of Hosts: “I am the first and I am the last, and there is no God but Me.
aov_text: SO sê die HERE, die Koning van Israel en sy Losser, die HERE van die leërskare: Ek is die Eerste, en Ek is die Laaste, en buiten My is daar geen God nie.

kjv_text: And who, as I, shall call, and shall declare it, and set it in order for me, since I appointed the ancient people? and the things that are coming, and shall come, let them shew unto them.
bsb_text: Who then is like Me? Let him say so! Let him declare his case before Me, since I established an ancient people. Let him foretell the things to come, and what is to take place.
aov_text: En wie roep soos Ek—laat hom dit dan te kenne gee en aan My voorlê—vandat Ek die volk van die ou tyd gegrond het? En laat hulle die toekomstige dinge en wat sal gebeur, te kenne gee.

kjv_text: Fear ye not, neither be afraid: have not I told thee from that time, and have declared it? ye are even my witnesses. Is there a God beside me? yea, there is no God; I know not any.
bsb_text: Do not tremble or fear. Have I not told you and declared it long ago? You are My witnesses! Is there any God but Me? There is no other Rock; I know not one.”
aov_text: Wees nie verskrik nie, en moenie bewe nie! Het Ek jou dit nie lank tevore laat hoor en te kenne gegee nie? En júlle is my getuies! Is daar ’n God buiten My? Ja, daar is geen rotssteen nie; Ek ken geeneen nie.

kjv_text: They that make a graven image are all of them vanity; and their delectable things shall not profit; and they are their own witnesses; they see not, nor know; that they may be ashamed.
bsb_text: All makers of idols are nothing, and the things they treasure are worthless. Their witnesses fail to see or comprehend, so they are put to shame.
aov_text: Hulle wat gesnede beelde maak, is almal nietigheid, en hulle lieflinge bring geen voordeel nie; en hulle getuies—dié sien niks en weet niks, sodat hulle beskaamd staan.

kjv_text: Who hath formed a god, or molten a graven image that is profitable for nothing?
bsb_text: Who fashions a god or casts an idol which profits him nothing?
aov_text: Wie maak ’n god en giet ’n beeld wat geen voordeel aanbring nie?

kjv_text: Behold, all his fellows shall be ashamed: and the workmen, they are of men: let them all be gathered together, let them stand up; yet they shall fear, and they shall be ashamed together.
bsb_text: Behold, all his companions will be put to shame, for the craftsmen themselves are only human. Let them all assemble and take their stand; they will all be brought to terror and shame.
aov_text: Kyk, al sy aanhangers sal beskaamd staan; en die ambagsmanne is uit die mense! Laat hulle almal bymekaarkom, gaan staan, verskrik wees, tesame beskaamd staan!

kjv_text: The smith with the tongs both worketh in the coals, and fashioneth it with hammers, and worketh it with the strength of his arms: yea, he is hungry, and his strength faileth: he drinketh no water, and is faint.
bsb_text: The blacksmith takes a tool and labors over the coals; he fashions an idol with hammers and forges it with his strong arms. Yet he grows hungry and loses his strength; he fails to drink water and grows faint.
aov_text: Die ystersmid het ’n byl en werk in die gloed; en hy maak hom met hamers en bewerk hom met sy sterk arm; daarby word hy honger en het geen krag nie; drink hy geen water nie, dan word hy moeg.

kjv_text: The carpenter stretcheth out his rule; he marketh it out with a line; he fitteth it with planes, and he marketh it out with the compass, and maketh it after the figure of a man, according to the beauty of a man; that it may remain in the house.
bsb_text: The woodworker extends a measuring line; he marks it out with a stylus; he shapes it with chisels and outlines it with a compass. He fashions it in the likeness of man, like man in all his glory, that it may dwell in a shrine.
aov_text: Die timmerman span ’n lyn; hy trek hom af met ’n potlood; hy bewerk hom met skawe en teken hom met ’n passer en maak hom na die beeltenis van ’n man, na die skoonheid van ’n mens, om in ’n huis te woon.

kjv_text: He heweth him down cedars, and taketh the cypress and the oak, which he strengtheneth for himself among the trees of the forest: he planteth an ash, and the rain doth nourish it.
bsb_text: He cuts down cedars or retrieves a cypress or oak. He lets it grow strong among the trees of the forest. He plants a laurel, and the rain makes it grow.
aov_text: Een gaan sederbome afkap, en hy neem ’n steeneik of ’n eikeboom en laat een vir hom opgroei onder die bome van die bos. Hy het ’n pynboom geplant, en die reën het dit grootgemaak.

kjv_text: Then shall it be for a man to burn: for he will take thereof, and warm himself; yea, he kindleth it, and baketh bread; yea, he maketh a god, and worshippeth it; he maketh it a graven image, and falleth down thereto.
bsb_text: It serves as fuel for man. He takes some of it to warm himself, and he kindles a fire and bakes his bread; he even fashions it into a god and worships it; he makes an idol and bows down to it.
aov_text: Dan dien dit die mens as brandhout, en hy neem daarvan en maak hom warm; ook steek hy dit aan die brand en bak brood; ook maak hy daar ’n god van en buig hom daarvoor neer; hy maak daar ’n gesnede beeld van en kniel daarvoor neer.

kjv_text: He burneth part thereof in the fire; with part thereof he eateth flesh; he roasteth roast, and is satisfied: yea, he warmeth himself, and saith, Aha, I am warm, I have seen the fire:
bsb_text: He burns half of it in the fire, and he roasts meat on that half. He eats the roast and is satisfied. Indeed, he warms himself and says, “Ah! I am warm; I see the fire.”
aov_text: Die helfte daarvan het hy in die vuur verbrand: by die een helfte eet hy vleis, hy maak braaivleis klaar en word versadig; ook maak hy hom warm en sê: Ha, ek het warm geword, ek het vuur gesien!

kjv_text: And the residue thereof he maketh a god, even his graven image: he falleth down unto it, and worshippeth it, and prayeth unto it, and saith, Deliver me; for thou art my god.
bsb_text: From the rest he makes a god, his graven image. He bows down to it and worships; he prays to it and says, “Save me, for you are my god.”
aov_text: En van wat oor is, maak hy ’n god, sy gesnede beeld; hy kniel daarvoor neer en buig hom en aanbid dit en sê: Red my, want u is my god!

kjv_text: They have not known nor understood: for he hath shut their eyes, that they cannot see; and their hearts, that they cannot understand.
bsb_text: They do not comprehend or discern, for He has shut their eyes so they cannot see and closed their minds so they cannot understand.
aov_text: Hulle weet nie en verstaan nie, want hulle oë is toegesmeer, sodat hulle nie sien nie, hulle harte, sodat hulle nie verstaan nie;

kjv_text: And none considereth in his heart, neither is there knowledge nor understanding to say, I have burned part of it in the fire; yea, also I have baked bread upon the coals thereof; I have roasted flesh, and eaten it: and shall I make the residue thereof an abomination? shall I fall down to the stock of a tree?
bsb_text: And no one considers in his heart, no one has the knowledge or insight to say, “I burned half of it in the fire, and I baked bread on its coals; I roasted meat and I ate. Shall I make something detestable with the rest of it? Shall I bow down to a block of wood?”
aov_text: en niemand neem dit ter harte nie, en daar is geen kennis of verstand om te sê nie: Die helfte daarvan het ek verbrand in die vuur, en ook het ek op die kole daarvan brood gebak; ek het vleis gebraai en geëet; en sal ek van die oorblyfsel daarvan ’n gruwel maak? Sal ek neerkniel voor ’n stuk hout?

kjv_text: He feedeth on ashes: a deceived heart hath turned him aside, that he cannot deliver his soul, nor say, Is there not a lie in my right hand?
bsb_text: He feeds on ashes. His deluded heart has led him astray, and he cannot deliver himself or say, “Is not this thing in my right hand a lie?”
aov_text: Hy wat hom besig hou met as, ’n bedroë hart het hom verlei; sodat hy sy siel nie kan red, of kan sê nie: Is daar geen leuen in my regterhand nie?

kjv_text: Remember these, O Jacob and Israel; for thou art my servant: I have formed thee; thou art my servant: O Israel, thou shalt not be forgotten of me.
bsb_text: Remember these things, O Jacob, for you are My servant, O Israel. I have made you, and you are My servant; O Israel, I will never forget you.
aov_text: Dink aan hierdie dinge, o Jakob en Israel! Want jy is my kneg; Ek het jou geformeer; jy is my kneg, Israel! Jy sal deur My nie vergeet word nie.

kjv_text: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, thy transgressions, and, as a cloud, thy sins: return unto me; for I have redeemed thee.
bsb_text: I have blotted out your transgressions like a cloud, and your sins like a mist. Return to Me, for I have redeemed you.
aov_text: Ek delg jou oortredinge uit soos ’n newel en jou sondes soos ’n wolk; keer terug na My, want Ek het jou verlos.

kjv_text: Sing, O ye heavens; for the LORD hath done it: shout, ye lower parts of the earth: break forth into singing, ye mountains, O forest, and every tree therein: for the LORD hath redeemed Jacob, and glorified himself in Israel.
bsb_text: Sing for joy, O heavens, for the LORD has done this; shout aloud, O depths of the earth. Break forth in song, O mountains, you forests and all your trees. For the LORD has redeemed Jacob, and revealed His glory in Israel.
aov_text: Jubel, o hemele, want die HERE het dit gedoen. Juig, dieptes van die aarde! Breek uit in gejubel, o berge, bosse en al die bome daarin! Want die HERE het Jakob verlos, en Hy sal Homself verheerlik aan Israel.

kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD, thy redeemer, and he that formed thee from the womb, I am the LORD that maketh all things; that stretcheth forth the heavens alone; that spreadeth abroad the earth by myself;
bsb_text: Thus says the LORD, your Redeemer who formed you from the womb: “I am the LORD, who has made all things, who alone stretched out the heavens, who by Myself spread out the earth,
aov_text: SO sê die Here, jou Verlosser, en Hy wat jou geformeer het van die moederskoot af: Ek is die HERE wat alles volbring, wat die hemel uitspan, Ek alleen, en wat die aarde uitsprei—wie was met My? —

kjv_text: That frustrateth the tokens of the liars, and maketh diviners mad; that turneth wise men backward, and maketh their knowledge foolish;
bsb_text: who foils the signs of false prophets and makes fools of diviners, who confounds the wise and turns their knowledge into nonsense,
aov_text: wat die tekens van die leuenprofete vernietig en die waarsêers tot dwase maak; wat die wyse agteruit laat wyk en hulle kennis domheid maak;

kjv_text: That confirmeth the word of his servant, and performeth the counsel of his messengers; that saith to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be inhabited; and to the cities of Judah, Ye shall be built, and I will raise up the decayed places thereof:
bsb_text: who confirms the message of His servant and fulfills the counsel of His messengers, who says of Jerusalem, ‘She will be inhabited,’ and of the cities of Judah, ‘They will be rebuilt, and I will restore their ruins,’
aov_text: wat die woord van sy kneg vervul en die voorsegging van sy boodskappers volbring; wat van Jerusalem sê: Dit moet bewoon word; en van die stede van Juda: Hulle moet herbou word, en Ek sal sy puinhope oprig;

kjv_text: That saith to the deep, Be dry, and I will dry up thy rivers:
bsb_text: who says to the depths of the sea, ‘Be dry, and I will dry up your currents,’
aov_text: wat vir die diepte sê: Verdroog! en jou riviere sal Ek laat verdroog;

kjv_text: That saith of Cyrus, He is my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure: even saying to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be built; and to the temple, Thy foundation shall be laid.
bsb_text: who says of Cyrus, ‘My shepherd will fulfill all that I desire,’ who says of Jerusalem, ‘She will be rebuilt,’ and of the temple, ‘Let its foundation be laid.’”
aov_text: wat van Kores sê: Hy is my herder, en hy sal alles volbring wat My behaag deurdat hy van Jerusalem sê: Dit moet gebou word, en die tempel moet gegrond word.

kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have holden, to subdue nations before him; and I will loose the loins of kings, to open before him the two leaved gates; and the gates shall not be shut;
bsb_text: This is what the LORD says to Cyrus His anointed, whose right hand I have grasped to subdue nations before him, to disarm kings, to open the doors before him, so that the gates will not be shut:
aov_text: SO sê die HERE aan sy gesalfde, aan Kores, wie se regterhand Ek gevat het om nasies voor hom neer te werp, terwyl Ek die lendene van konings losgord; om voor hom deure oop te maak, en poorte sal nie gesluit bly nie:

kjv_text: I will go before thee, and make the crooked places straight: I will break in pieces the gates of brass, and cut in sunder the bars of iron:
bsb_text: “I will go before you and level the mountains; I will break down the gates of bronze and cut through the bars of iron.
aov_text: Ek self sal voor jou uit gaan en hoogtes gelykmaak; koperdeure sal Ek verbreek en ystergrendels stukkend slaan.

kjv_text: And I will give thee the treasures of darkness, and hidden riches of secret places, that thou mayest know that I, the LORD, which call thee by thy name, am the God of Israel.
bsb_text: I will give you the treasures of darkness and the riches hidden in secret places, so that you may know that I am the LORD, the God of Israel, who calls you by name.
aov_text: En Ek sal jou die skatte gee wat in die donkerheid is en die verborge rykdomme, sodat jy kan weet dat Ek die HERE is wat jou by jou naam roep, die God van Israel;

kjv_text: For Jacob my servant's sake, and Israel mine elect, I have even called thee by thy name: I have surnamed thee, though thou hast not known me.
bsb_text: For the sake of Jacob My servant and Israel My chosen one, I call you by name; I have given you a title of honor, though you have not known Me.
aov_text: ter wille van Jakob, my kneg, en Israel, my uitverkorene, het Ek jou by jou naam geroep; Ek het jou ’n erenaam gegee, hoewel jy My nie geken het nie.

kjv_text: I am the LORD, and there is none else, there is no God beside me: I girded thee, though thou hast not known me:
bsb_text: I am the LORD, and there is no other; there is no God but Me. I will equip you for battle, though you have not known Me,
aov_text: Ek is die HERE, en daar is geen ander nie; buiten My is daar geen God nie; Ek omgord jou, hoewel jy My nie geken het nie,

kjv_text: That they may know from the rising of the sun, and from the west, that there is none beside me. I am the LORD, and there is none else.
bsb_text: so that all may know, from where the sun rises to where it sets, that there is none but Me; I am the LORD, and there is no other.
aov_text: sodat hulle kan weet van die opgang van die son en van sy ondergang af dat daar buiten My geeneen is nie; Ek is die HERE, en daar is geen ander nie;

kjv_text: I form the light, and create darkness: I make peace, and create evil: I the LORD do all these things.
bsb_text: I form the light and create the darkness; I bring prosperity and create calamity. I, the LORD, do all these things.
aov_text: wat die lig formeer en die duisternis skep, die heil bewerk en die onheil skep: Ek, die HERE, is dit wat al hierdie dinge doen.
