aov_text: Want jou Maker is jou Man; HERE van die leërskare is sy Naam; en die Heilige van Israel is jou Verlosser. Hy sal die God van die hele aarde genoem word.

kjv_text: For the LORD hath called thee as a woman forsaken and grieved in spirit, and a wife of youth, when thou wast refused, saith thy God.
bsb_text: For the LORD has called you back, like a wife deserted and wounded in spirit, like the rejected wife of one’s youth,” says your God.
aov_text: Want soos ’n verlate vrou en ’n bedroefde van gees het die HERE jou geroep, en soos ’n vrou uit die jeugtyd as sy versmaad was, sê jou God.

kjv_text: For a small moment have I forsaken thee; but with great mercies will I gather thee.
bsb_text: “For a brief moment I forsook you, but with great compassion I will bring you back.
aov_text: Vir ’n klein oomblik het Ek jou verlaat, maar met groot ontferminge sal Ek jou vergader.

kjv_text: In a little wrath I hid my face from thee for a moment; but with everlasting kindness will I have mercy on thee, saith the LORD thy Redeemer.
bsb_text: In a surge of anger I hid My face from you for a moment, but with everlasting kindness I will have compassion on you,” says the LORD your Redeemer.
aov_text: In ’n uitstorting van toorn het Ek vir ’n oomblik my aangesig vir jou verberg, maar met ewige goedertierenheid ontferm Ek My oor jou, sê die HERE, jou Verlosser.

kjv_text: For this is as the waters of Noah unto me: for as I have sworn that the waters of Noah should no more go over the earth; so have I sworn that I would not be wroth with thee, nor rebuke thee.
bsb_text: “For to Me this is like the days of Noah, when I swore that the waters of Noah would never again cover the earth. So I have sworn that I will not be angry with you or rebuke you.
aov_text: Soos in die dae van Noag is dit vir My: soos Ek gesweer het dat die waters van Noag nie meer oor die aarde sou gaan nie, so het Ek gesweer dat Ek nie op jou toornig sal wees of jou sal dreig nie.

kjv_text: For the mountains shall depart, and the hills be removed; but my kindness shall not depart from thee, neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed, saith the LORD that hath mercy on thee.
bsb_text: Though the mountains may be removed and the hills may be shaken, My loving devotion will not depart from you, and My covenant of peace will not be broken,” says the LORD, who has compassion on you.
aov_text: Want berge mag wyk en heuwels wankel, maar my goedertierenheid sal van jou nie wyk en my vredeverbond nie wankel nie, sê die HERE, jou Ontfermer.

kjv_text: O thou afflicted, tossed with tempest, and not comforted, behold, I will lay thy stones with fair colours, and lay thy foundations with sapphires.
bsb_text: “O afflicted city, lashed by storms, without solace, surely I will set your stones in antimony and lay your foundations with sapphires.
aov_text: Jy, ellendige, deur storm gejaagde, ongetrooste! Kyk, Ek lê jou stene in sierklei, en Ek grondves jou in saffiere;

kjv_text: And I will make thy windows of agates, and thy gates of carbuncles, and all thy borders of pleasant stones.
bsb_text: I will make your pinnacles of rubies, your gates of sparkling jewels, and all your walls of precious stones.
aov_text: en jou borswerings maak Ek van robyne en jou poorte van karbonkels en jou hele ringmuur van edelgesteentes.

kjv_text: And all thy children shall be taught of the LORD; and great shall be the peace of thy children.
bsb_text: Then all your sons will be taught by the LORD, and great will be their prosperity.
aov_text: En al jou kinders sal deur die HERE geleer wees, en die vrede van jou kinders sal groot wees.

kjv_text: In righteousness shalt thou be established: thou shalt be far from oppression; for thou shalt not fear: and from terror; for it shall not come near thee.
bsb_text: In righteousness you will be established, far from oppression, for you will have no fear. Terror will be far removed, for it will not come near you.
aov_text: Deur geregtigheid sal jy bevestig word; wees ver van verdrukking, want jy hoef nie bevrees te wees nie; en ver van verskrikking, want dit sal nie by jou kom nie.

kjv_text: Behold, they shall surely gather together, but not by me: whosoever shall gather together against thee shall fall for thy sake.
bsb_text: If anyone attacks you, it is not from Me; whoever assails you will fall before you.
aov_text: As hulle ook die aanval begin—dit is nie uit My nie; wie jou aanval, sal oor jou val.

kjv_text: Behold, I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire, and that bringeth forth an instrument for his work; and I have created the waster to destroy.
bsb_text: Behold, I have created the craftsman who fans the coals into flame and forges a weapon fit for its task; and I have created the destroyer to wreak havoc.
aov_text: Kyk, Ék het die smid geskape wat die koolvuur aanblaas en ’n wapen voortbring volgens sy ambag; ook het Ék die verderwer geskape om te verniel.

kjv_text: No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper; and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of the LORD, and their righteousness is of me, saith the LORD.
bsb_text: No weapon formed against you shall prosper, and you will refute every tongue that accuses you. This is the heritage of the servants of the LORD, and their vindication is from Me,” declares the LORD.
aov_text: Elke wapen wat teen jou gesmee word, sal niks uitrig nie; en elke tong wat teen jou opstaan in die gereg, sal jy weerlê. Dit is die erfdeel van die knegte van die HERE en hulle geregtigheid wat uit My is, spreek die HERE.

kjv_text: Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters, and he that hath no money; come ye, buy, and eat; yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.
bsb_text: “Come, all you who are thirsty, come to the waters; and you without money, come, buy, and eat! Come, buy wine and milk without money and without cost!
aov_text: O ALMAL wat dors het, kom na die waters; en wie geen geld het nie, kom, koop en eet; ja, kom, koop sonder geld en sonder prys, wyn en melk!

kjv_text: Wherefore do ye spend money for that which is not bread? and your labour for that which satisfieth not? hearken diligently unto me, and eat ye that which is good, and let your soul delight itself in fatness.
bsb_text: Why spend money on that which is not bread, and your labor on that which does not satisfy? Listen carefully to Me, and eat what is good, and your soul will delight in the richest of foods.
aov_text: Waarom weeg julle geld af vir wat geen brood is nie, en julle arbeid vir wat nie kan versadig nie? Luister aandagtig na My en eet die goeie, en laat julle siel hom in vettigheid verlustig.

kjv_text: Incline your ear, and come unto me: hear, and your soul shall live; and I will make an everlasting covenant with you, even the sure mercies of David.
bsb_text: Incline your ear and come to Me; listen, so that your soul may live. I will make with you an everlasting covenant—My loving devotion promised to David.
aov_text: Neig julle oor en kom na My toe, luister, en julle siel sal lewe; Ek wil met julle ’n ewige verbond sluit: die bestendige genadebewyse van Dawid.

kjv_text: Behold, I have given him for a witness to the people, a leader and commander to the people.
bsb_text: Behold, I have made him a witness to the nations, a leader and commander of the peoples.
aov_text: Kyk, Ek het hom tot ’n getuie van die volke gemaak, tot ’n vors en gebieder van die nasies.

kjv_text: Behold, thou shalt call a nation that thou knowest not, and nations that knew not thee shall run unto thee because of the LORD thy God, and for the Holy One of Israel; for he hath glorified thee.
bsb_text: Surely you will summon a nation you do not know, and nations who do not know you will run to you. For the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, has bestowed glory on you.”
aov_text: Kyk, nasies wat jy nie geken het nie, sal jy roep; en nasies wat jou nie geken het nie, sal na jou hardloop, ter wille van die HERE jou God en van die Heilige van Israel, omdat Hy jou verheerlik het.

kjv_text: Seek ye the LORD while he may be found, call ye upon him while he is near:
bsb_text: Seek the LORD while He may be found; call on Him while He is near.
aov_text: Soek die HERE terwyl Hy nog te vinde is; roep Hom aan terwyl Hy naby is.

kjv_text: Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts: and let him return unto the LORD, and he will have mercy upon him; and to our God, for he will abundantly pardon.
bsb_text: Let the wicked man forsake his own way and the unrighteous man his own thoughts; let him return to the LORD, that He may have compassion, and to our God, for He will freely pardon.
aov_text: Laat die goddelose sy weg verlaat en die kwaaddoener sy gedagtes; en laat hy hom tot die HERE bekeer, dan sal Hy hom barmhartig wees; en tot onse God, want Hy vergeef menigvuldiglik.

kjv_text: For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, saith the LORD.
bsb_text: “For My thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways My ways,” declares the LORD.
aov_text: Want my gedagtes is nie julle gedagtes nie, en julle weë is nie my weë nie, spreek die HERE.

kjv_text: For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.
bsb_text: “For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so My ways are higher than your ways and My thoughts than your thoughts.
aov_text: Want soos die hemel hoër is as die aarde, so is my weë hoër as julle weë en my gedagtes as julle gedagtes.

kjv_text: For as the rain cometh down, and the snow from heaven, and returneth not thither, but watereth the earth, and maketh it bring forth and bud, that it may give seed to the sower, and bread to the eater:
bsb_text: For just as rain and snow fall from heaven and do not return without watering the earth, making it bud and sprout, and providing seed to sow and food to eat,
aov_text: Want soos die reën en die sneeu van die hemel neerdaal en daarheen nie terugkeer nie, maar die aarde deurvogtig en maak dat dit voortbring en uitspruit en saad gee aan die saaier en brood aan die eter;

kjv_text: So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it.
bsb_text: so My word that proceeds from My mouth will not return to Me empty, but it will accomplish what I please, and it will prosper where I send it.
aov_text: so sal my woord wees wat uit my mond uitgaan: dit sal nie leeg na My terugkeer nie, maar doen wat My behaag en voorspoedig wees in alles waartoe Ek dit stuur.

kjv_text: For ye shall go out with joy, and be led forth with peace: the mountains and the hills shall break forth before you into singing, and all the trees of the field shall clap their hands.
bsb_text: You will indeed go out with joy and be led forth in peace; the mountains and hills will burst into song before you, and all the trees of the field will clap their hands.
aov_text: Want met vreugde sal julle uittrek en met vrede gelei word; die berge en heuwels sal voor julle in gejubel uitbreek, en al die bome van die veld in die hande klap.

kjv_text: Instead of the thorn shall come up the fir tree, and instead of the brier shall come up the myrtle tree: and it shall be to the LORD for a name, for an everlasting sign that shall not be cut off.
bsb_text: Instead of the thornbush, a cypress will grow, and instead of the brier, a myrtle will spring up; they will make a name for the LORD, an everlasting sign, never to be destroyed.”
aov_text: Vir ’n doringboom sal ’n sipres opgaan; vir ’n distel sal ’n mirteboom opgaan; en dit sal vir die HERE wees tot ’n naam, tot ’n ewige teken wat nie uitgeroei sal word nie.

kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD, Keep ye judgment, and do justice: for my salvation is near to come, and my righteousness to be revealed.
bsb_text: This is what the LORD says: “Maintain justice and do what is right, for My salvation is coming soon, and My righteousness will be revealed.
aov_text: SO sê die HERE: Bewaar die reg en doen geregtigheid; want my heil is naby om te kom en my geregtigheid om geopenbaar te word.

kjv_text: Blessed is the man that doeth this, and the son of man that layeth hold on it; that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it, and keepeth his hand from doing any evil.
bsb_text: Blessed is the man who does this, and the son of man who holds it fast, who keeps the Sabbath without profaning it and keeps his hand from doing any evil.”
aov_text: Welgeluksalig is die mens wat dit doen en die mensekind wat daaraan vashou; wat die sabbat hou, sodat hy dit nie ontheilig nie, en sy hand terughou, dat dit geen kwaad doen nie.

kjv_text: Neither let the son of the stranger, that hath joined himself to the LORD, speak, saying, The LORD hath utterly separated me from his people: neither let the eunuch say, Behold, I am a dry tree.
bsb_text: Let no foreigner who has joined himself to the LORD say, “The LORD will utterly exclude me from His people.” And let the eunuch not say, “I am but a dry tree.”
aov_text: En laat die uitlander wat hom by die HERE aangesluit het, nie spreek en sê: Die HERE sal my gewis afskei van sy volk nie; en laat die ontmande nie sê: Kyk, ek is ’n droë boom nie.

kjv_text: For thus saith the LORD unto the eunuchs that keep my sabbaths, and choose the things that please me, and take hold of my covenant;
bsb_text: For this is what the LORD says: “To the eunuchs who keep My Sabbaths, who choose what pleases Me and hold fast to My covenant—
aov_text: Want so sê die HERE aan die ontmandes wat my sabbatte hou en verkies wat My behaag en vashou aan my verbond:

kjv_text: Even unto them will I give in mine house and within my walls a place and a name better than of sons and of daughters: I will give them an everlasting name, that shall not be cut off.
bsb_text: I will give them, in My house and within My walls, a memorial and a name better than that of sons and daughters. I will give them an everlasting name that will not be cut off.
aov_text: Ek sal aan hulle in my huis en binnekant my mure ’n gedenkteken en ’n naam gee wat beter is as seuns en dogters; ’n ewige naam gee Ek aan hulle, wat nie uitgeroei sal word nie.

kjv_text: Also the sons of the stranger, that join themselves to the LORD, to serve him, and to love the name of the LORD, to be his servants, every one that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it, and taketh hold of my covenant;
bsb_text: And the foreigners who join themselves to the LORD to minister to Him, to love the name of the LORD, and to be His servants—all who keep the Sabbath without profaning it and who hold fast to My covenant—
aov_text: En die uitlanders wat hulle by die HERE aangesluit het, om Hom te dien en om die Naam van die HERE lief te hê deur sy knegte te wees—elkeen wat die sabbat hou, sodat hy dit nie ontheilig nie, en hulle wat vashou aan my verbond,

kjv_text: Even them will I bring to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in my house of prayer: their burnt offerings and their sacrifices shall be accepted upon mine altar; for mine house shall be called an house of prayer for all people.
bsb_text: I will bring them to My holy mountain and make them joyful in My house of prayer. Their burnt offerings and sacrifices will be accepted on My altar, for My house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations.”
aov_text: hulle sal Ek bring na my heilige berg, en Ek sal hulle vreugde laat smaak in my huis van gebed; hulle brandoffers en hulle slagoffers sal welgevallig wees op my altaar; want my huis sal ’n huis van gebed genoem word vir al die volke.

kjv_text: The Lord GOD, which gathereth the outcasts of Israel saith, Yet will I gather others to him, beside those that are gathered unto him.
bsb_text: Thus declares the Lord GOD, who gathers the dispersed of Israel: “I will gather to them still others besides those already gathered.”
aov_text: Die Here HERE wat versamel diegene wat van Israel verdryf is, spreek: Ek sal by hom nog meer versamel, by sy versameldes.

kjv_text: All ye beasts of the field, come to devour, yea, all ye beasts in the forest.
bsb_text: Come, all you beasts of the field; eat greedily, all you beasts of the forest.
aov_text: AL julle wilde diere van die veld, kom eet! Al julle wilde diere in die bos!

kjv_text: His watchmen are blind: they are all ignorant, they are all dumb dogs, they cannot bark; sleeping, lying down, loving to slumber.
bsb_text: Israel’s watchmen are blind, they are all oblivious; they are all mute dogs, they cannot bark; they are dreamers lying around, loving to slumber.
aov_text: Hulle wagte is almal blind, hulle merk niks nie; hulle is almal stom honde wat nie kan blaf nie; wat dromerig lê, lief is om te sluimer.

kjv_text: Yea, they are greedy dogs which can never have enough, and they are shepherds that cannot understand: they all look to their own way, every one for his gain, from his quarter.
bsb_text: Like ravenous dogs, they are never satisfied. They are shepherds with no discernment; they all turn to their own way, each one seeking his own gain:
aov_text: En die honde is gulsig, hulle ken geen versadiging nie; en herders is hulle wat nie weet om op te merk nie; almal loop hulle eie pad, elkeen na sy onregverdige wins, almal saam.

kjv_text: Come ye, say they, I will fetch wine, and we will fill ourselves with strong drink; and to morrow shall be as this day, and much more abundant.
bsb_text: “Come, let me get the wine, let us imbibe the strong drink, and tomorrow will be like today, only far better!”
aov_text: Kom, sê hulle, laat ek wyn gaan haal, en laat ons sterk drank drink, en die dag van môre sal wees soos vandag, buitengewoon groot!

kjv_text: The righteous perisheth, and no man layeth it to heart: and merciful men are taken away, none considering that the righteous is taken away from the evil to come.
bsb_text: The righteous perish, and no one takes it to heart; devout men are swept away, while no one considers that the righteous are guided from the presence of evil.
aov_text: DIE regverdige kom om, en daar is niemand wat dit ter harte neem nie; en die vromes word weggeruk sonder dat iemand daarop let; want die regverdige word weggeruk vanweë die boosheid.

kjv_text: He shall enter into peace: they shall rest in their beds, each one walking in his uprightness.
bsb_text: Those who walk uprightly enter into peace; they find rest, lying down in death.
aov_text: Hy gaan in die vrede in: hulle sal rus op hulle bedde—hy wat sy reguit pad loop.

kjv_text: But draw near hither, ye sons of the sorceress, the seed of the adulterer and the whore.
bsb_text: “But come here, you sons of a sorceress, you offspring of adulterers and prostitutes!
aov_text: Maar julle, kom hierheen, kinders van ’n towerheks, geslag van ’n owerspeler en van haar wat hoereer!

kjv_text: Against whom do ye sport yourselves? against whom make ye a wide mouth, and draw out the tongue? are ye not children of transgression, a seed of falsehood,
bsb_text: Whom are you mocking? At whom do you snarl and stick out your tongue? Are you not children of transgression, offspring of deceit,
aov_text: Oor wie maak julle jul vrolik? Oor wie spalk julle die mond oop, steek julle die tong uit? Is julle nie kinders van oortreding, ’n leuenagtige geslag nie,

kjv_text: Enflaming yourselves with idols under every green tree, slaying the children in the valleys under the clifts of the rocks?
bsb_text: who burn with lust among the oaks, under every luxuriant tree, who slaughter your children in the valleys, under the clefts of the rocks?
aov_text: wat verhit is by die terpentynbome, onder elke groen boom; wat die kinders slag in die dale, onderkant die rotsklowe?

kjv_text: Among the smooth stones of the stream is thy portion; they, they are thy lot: even to them hast thou poured a drink offering, thou hast offered a meat offering. Should I receive comfort in these?
bsb_text: Your portion is among the smooth stones of the valley; indeed, they are your lot. Even to them you have poured out a drink offering and offered a grain offering. Should I relent because of these?
aov_text: By die gladde klippe van die dal is jou deel; dit, dit is jou lot; ook het jy vir hulle drankoffers uitgegiet, spysoffers gebring! Sou Ek daarmee vrede hê?

kjv_text: Upon a lofty and high mountain hast thou set thy bed: even thither wentest thou up to offer sacrifice.
bsb_text: On a high and lofty hill you have made your bed, and there you went up to offer sacrifices.
aov_text: Jy het jou bed op ’n hoë en verhewe berg gemaak; ook het jy daar opgeklim om offers te bring.

kjv_text: Behind the doors also and the posts hast thou set up thy remembrance: for thou hast discovered thyself to another than me, and art gone up; thou hast enlarged thy bed, and made thee a covenant with them; thou lovedst their bed where thou sawest it.
bsb_text: Behind the door and doorpost you have set up your memorial. Forsaking Me, you uncovered your bed; you climbed up and opened it wide. And you have made a pact with those whose bed you have loved; you have gazed upon their nakedness.
aov_text: En agter die deur en die deurpos het jy jou gedenkteken gesit; want, ontrou aan My, het jy jou bed ontbloot en beklim en wyd gemaak, en jy het vir jou bepaal die loon wat van hulle moes kom; jy het hulle byslaap liefgehad, jy het die vlees gesien.

kjv_text: And thou wentest to the king with ointment, and didst increase thy perfumes, and didst send thy messengers far off, and didst debase thyself even unto hell.
bsb_text: You went to Molech with oil and multiplied your perfumes. You have sent your envoys a great distance; you have descended even to Sheol itself.
aov_text: En jy het na die koning getrek met olie en jou salf baie gemaak; en jy het jou boodskappers gestuur na ver plekke, ja, diep na die doderyk toe.

kjv_text: Thou art wearied in the greatness of thy way; yet saidst thou not, There is no hope: thou hast found the life of thine hand; therefore thou wast not grieved.
bsb_text: You are wearied by your many journeys, but you did not say, “There is no hope!” You found renewal of your strength; therefore you did not grow weak.
aov_text: Jy het moeg geword deur jou groot reis; tog het jy nie gesê: Dit is tevergeefs nie! Vernuwing van jou krag het jy gevind; daarom het jy nie uitgeput geraak nie.

kjv_text: And of whom hast thou been afraid or feared, that thou hast lied, and hast not remembered me, nor laid it to thy heart? have not I held my peace even of old, and thou fearest me not?
bsb_text: Whom have you dreaded and feared, so that you lied and failed to remember Me or take this to heart? Is it not because I have long been silent that you do not fear Me?
aov_text: Maar vir wie was jy bedug en bevrees?—want jy het ’n leuenaar geword en aan My nie gedink nie; jy het dit nie ter harte geneem nie. Is dit nie omdat Ek swyg nie, en dit baie lank al, dat jy My nie vrees nie?

kjv_text: I will declare thy righteousness, and thy works; for they shall not profit thee.
bsb_text: I will expose your righteousness and your works, and they will not profit you.
aov_text: Ék sal jou geregtigheid bekend maak en jou werke, dat hulle jou geen voordeel bring nie.

kjv_text: When thou criest, let thy companies deliver thee; but the wind shall carry them all away; vanity shall take them: but he that putteth his trust in me shall possess the land, and shall inherit my holy mountain;
bsb_text: When you cry out, let your companies of idols deliver you! Yet the wind will carry off all of them, a breath will take them away. But he who seeks refuge in Me will inherit the land and possess My holy mountain.”
aov_text: As jy skreeu, laat jou hoop gode jou red; maar die wind lig hulle almal op, ’n luggie neem hulle weg. Maar wie op My vertrou, sal die land beërwe en my heilige bergland in besit neem.

kjv_text: And shall say, Cast ye up, cast ye up, prepare the way, take up the stumblingblock out of the way of my people.
bsb_text: And it will be said, “Build it up, build it up, prepare the way, take every obstacle out of the way of My people.”
aov_text: EN hulle sal sê: Vul op, vul op, berei die weg, verwyder die struikelblok uit die weg van my volk.

kjv_text: For thus saith the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity, whose name is Holy; I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also that is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite ones.
bsb_text: For thus says the One who is high and lifted up, who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy: “I dwell in a high and holy place, and with the oppressed and humble in spirit, to restore the spirit of the lowly and revive the heart of the contrite.
aov_text: Want so sê die Hoë en Verhewene wat in die ewigheid woon, Heilig is sy Naam: Ek woon in die hoogte en in die heilige plek en by die verbryselde en nederige van gees, om te laat herlewe die gees van die nederiges en te laat herlewe die hart van die verbryseldes.

kjv_text: For I will not contend for ever, neither will I be always wroth: for the spirit should fail before me, and the souls which I have made.
bsb_text: For I will not accuse you forever, nor will I always be angry; for then the spirit of man would grow weak before Me, with the breath of those I have made.
aov_text: Want Ek sal nie vir ewig twis en nie vir altyd toornig wees nie, want die gees sou voor my aangesig versmag en die siele wat Ek self gemaak het.

kjv_text: For the iniquity of his covetousness was I wroth, and smote him: I hid me, and was wroth, and he went on frowardly in the way of his heart.
bsb_text: I was enraged by his sinful greed, so I struck him and hid My face in anger; yet he kept turning back to the desires of his heart.
aov_text: Ek was toornig vanweë die ongeregtigheid van hulle hebsug en het hulle geslaan terwyl Ek My toornig verberg het; ewenwel het hulle afkerig voortgegaan op hulle eie weg.

kjv_text: I have seen his ways, and will heal him: I will lead him also, and restore comforts unto him and to his mourners.
bsb_text: I have seen his ways, but I will heal him; I will guide him and restore comfort to him and his mourners,
aov_text: Ek het hulle weë gesien, en Ek sal hulle genees; en Ek sal hulle lei en aan hulle weer vertroosting skenk, naamlik aan hulle treuriges.

kjv_text: I create the fruit of the lips; Peace, peace to him that is far off, and to him that is near, saith the LORD; and I will heal him.
bsb_text: bringing praise to their lips. Peace, peace to those far and near,” says the LORD, “and I will heal them.”
aov_text: Ek skep die vrug van die lippe; vrede, vrede vir die wat ver en die wat naby is, sê die HERE; en Ek sal hulle genees.

kjv_text: But the wicked are like the troubled sea, when it cannot rest, whose waters cast up mire and dirt.
bsb_text: But the wicked are like the storm-tossed sea, for it cannot be still, and its waves churn up mire and muck.
aov_text: Maar die goddelose is soos ’n onstuimige see; want dit kan nie tot rus kom nie, en sy waters gooi slyk en modder op.

kjv_text: There is no peace, saith my God, to the wicked.
bsb_text: “There is no peace,” says my God, “for the wicked.”
aov_text: Geen vrede, sê my God, vir die goddelose nie!

kjv_text: Cry aloud, spare not, lift up thy voice like a trumpet, and shew my people their transgression, and the house of Jacob their sins.
bsb_text: “Cry aloud, do not hold back! Raise your voice like a ram’s horn. Declare to My people their transgression and to the house of Jacob their sins.
aov_text: ROEP uit die keel, hou nie terug nie, verhef jou stem soos ’n basuin! En verkondig aan my volk hulle oortreding en aan die huis van Jakob hulle sondes.

kjv_text: Yet they seek me daily, and delight to know my ways, as a nation that did righteousness, and forsook not the ordinance of their God: they ask of me the ordinances of justice; they take delight in approaching to God.
bsb_text: For day after day they seek Me and delight to know My ways, like a nation that does what is right and does not forsake the justice of their God. They ask Me for righteous judgments; they delight in the nearness of God.”
aov_text: Wel soek hulle My dag vir dag en het ’n behae in die kennis van my weë! Soos ’n nasie wat geregtigheid doen en die reg van sy God nie verlaat nie, vra hulle My na die regverdige verordeninge; hulle het ’n behae in die toenadering tot God.

kjv_text: Wherefore have we fasted, say they, and thou seest not? wherefore have we afflicted our soul, and thou takest no knowledge? Behold, in the day of your fast ye find pleasure, and exact all your labours.
bsb_text: “Why have we fasted, and You have not seen? Why have we humbled ourselves, and You have not noticed?” “Behold, on the day of your fast, you do as you please, and you oppress all your workers.
aov_text: Waarom vas ons, en U sien dit nie? Waarom kwel ons ons siel, en U weet dit nie?—Kyk, op die dag as julle vas, soek julle geleentheid om sake te doen, en julle jaag al jul arbeiders aan.

kjv_text: Behold, ye fast for strife and debate, and to smite with the fist of wickedness: ye shall not fast as ye do this day, to make your voice to be heard on high.
bsb_text: You fast with contention and strife to strike viciously with your fist. You cannot fast as you do today and have your voice be heard on high.
aov_text: Kyk, om te twis en te kyf, vas julle, en om te slaan met misdadige vuis; julle vas nie nou om julle stem in die hoogte te laat hoor nie.

kjv_text: Is it such a fast that I have chosen? a day for a man to afflict his soul? is it to bow down his head as a bulrush, and to spread sackcloth and ashes under him? wilt thou call this a fast, and an acceptable day to the LORD?
bsb_text: Is this the fast I have chosen: a day for a man to deny himself, to bow his head like a reed, and to spread out sackcloth and ashes? Will you call this a fast and a day acceptable to the LORD?
aov_text: Is dít die vas wat Ek verkies, die dag as die mens sy siel gaan kwel: dat hy sy hoof buig soos ’n biesie en sak en as uitsprei om sy bed te wees? Noem jy dit vas en ’n dag wat die HERE welgevallig is?

kjv_text: Is not this the fast that I have chosen? to loose the bands of wickedness, to undo the heavy burdens, and to let the oppressed go free, and that ye break every yoke?
bsb_text: Isn’t this the fast that I have chosen: to break the chains of wickedness, to untie the cords of the yoke, to set the oppressed free and tear off every yoke?
aov_text: Is dít nie die vas wat Ek verkies nie: dat julle losmaak die bande van goddeloosheid, dat julle afhaal die stroppe van die juk en vry laat weggaan die verdruktes en elke juk stukkend breek?

kjv_text: Is it not to deal thy bread to the hungry, and that thou bring the poor that are cast out to thy house? when thou seest the naked, that thou cover him; and that thou hide not thyself from thine own flesh?
bsb_text: Isn’t it to share your bread with the hungry, to bring the poor and homeless into your home, to clothe the naked when you see him, and not to turn away from your own flesh and blood?
aov_text: Is dit nie dat jy jou brood breek vir hom wat honger het, en ellendiges, swerwelinge in die huis inbring nie? As jy iemand sien wat naak is, dat jy hom klee, en jou vir jou eie vlees nie verberg nie?

kjv_text: Then shall thy light break forth as the morning, and thine health shall spring forth speedily: and thy righteousness shall go before thee; the glory of the LORD shall be thy rereward.
bsb_text: Then your light will break forth like the dawn, and your healing will come quickly. Your righteousness will go before you, and the glory of the LORD will be your rear guard.
aov_text: Dan sal jou lig deurbreek soos die dageraad en jou genesing skielik uitspruit; en jou geregtigheid sal voor jou uit gaan, die heerlikheid van die HERE jou agterhoede wees.

kjv_text: Then shalt thou call, and the LORD shall answer; thou shalt cry, and he shall say, Here I am. If thou take away from the midst of thee the yoke, the putting forth of the finger, and speaking vanity;
bsb_text: Then you will call, and the LORD will answer; you will cry out, and He will say, ‘Here I am.’ If you remove the yoke from your midst, the pointing of the finger and malicious talk,
aov_text: Dan sal jy roep, en die HERE sal antwoord; jy sal skreeu om hulp, en Hy sal sê: Hier is Ek! As jy van jou verwyder die verdrukking, die uitsteek van die vinger en die leuenagtige woord,

kjv_text: And if thou draw out thy soul to the hungry, and satisfy the afflicted soul; then shall thy light rise in obscurity, and thy darkness be as the noon day:
bsb_text: and if you give yourself to the hungry and satisfy the afflicted soul, then your light will go forth in the darkness, and your night will be like noonday.
aov_text: en jou siel laat uitgaan na die hongerige, en die neergeboë siel versadig; dan sal jou lig opgaan in die duisternis en jou donkerheid wees soos die middag.

kjv_text: And the LORD shall guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in drought, and make fat thy bones: and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters fail not.
bsb_text: The LORD will always guide you; He will satisfy you in a sun-scorched land and strengthen your frame. You will be like a well-watered garden, like a spring whose waters never fail.
aov_text: En die HERE sal jou gedurigdeur lei en jou siel versadig in dor plekke en jou gebeente sterk maak; en jy sal wees soos ’n tuin wat goed besproei is en soos ’n fontein van waters waarvan die water nooit teleurstel nie.

kjv_text: And they that shall be of thee shall build the old waste places: thou shalt raise up the foundations of many generations; and thou shalt be called, The repairer of the breach, The restorer of paths to dwell in.
bsb_text: Your people will rebuild the ancient ruins; you will restore the age-old foundations; you will be called Repairer of the Breach, Restorer of the Streets of Dwelling.
aov_text: En die wat uit jou voortkom, sal die ou puinhope bou; die fondamente van vorige geslagte sal jy oprig, en jy sal genoem word: Herbouer van gebreekte mure, hersteller van paaie, om bewoonbaar te maak.

kjv_text: If thou turn away thy foot from the sabbath, from doing thy pleasure on my holy day; and call the sabbath a delight, the holy of the LORD, honourable; and shalt honour him, not doing thine own ways, nor finding thine own pleasure, nor speaking thine own words:
bsb_text: If you turn your foot from breaking the Sabbath, from doing as you please on My holy day, if you call the Sabbath a delight, and the LORD’s holy day honorable, if you honor it by not going your own way or seeking your own pleasure or speaking idle words,
aov_text: As jy jou voet terughou van die sabbat—om nie jou sake op my heilige dag te doen nie, en as jy die sabbat ’n verlustiging noem en die heilige dag van die HERE hooghou; en as jy dit eer deur nie jou gewone gang te gaan nie, nie geleentheid vir jou sake soek of ydele taal spreek nie;

kjv_text: Then shalt thou delight thyself in the LORD; and I will cause thee to ride upon the high places of the earth, and feed thee with the heritage of Jacob thy father: for the mouth of the LORD hath spoken it.
bsb_text: then you will delight yourself in the LORD, and I will make you ride on the heights of the land and feed you with the heritage of your father Jacob.” For the mouth of the LORD has spoken.
aov_text: dan sal jy jou verlustig in die HERE, en Ek sal jou laat ry oor die hoogtes van die aarde en jou laat geniet die erfdeel van jou vader Jakob; want die mond van die HERE het dit gespreek.

kjv_text: Behold, the LORD's hand is not shortened, that it cannot save; neither his ear heavy, that it cannot hear:
bsb_text: Surely the arm of the LORD is not too short to save, nor His ear too dull to hear.
aov_text: KYK, die hand van die HERE is nie te kort om te help nie, en sy oor is nie te swaar om te hoor nie;

kjv_text: But your iniquities have separated between you and your God, and your sins have hid his face from you, that he will not hear.
bsb_text: But your iniquities have built barriers between you and your God, and your sins have hidden His face from you, so that He does not hear.
aov_text: maar julle ongeregtighede het ’n skeidsmuur geword tussen julle en julle God, en julle sondes het sy aangesig vir julle verberg, sodat Hy nie hoor nie.

kjv_text: For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity; your lips have spoken lies, your tongue hath muttered perverseness.
bsb_text: For your hands are stained with blood, and your fingers with iniquity; your lips have spoken lies, and your tongue mutters injustice.
aov_text: Want julle hande is met bloed bevlek en julle vingers met ongeregtigheid; julle lippe spreek leuen, julle tong fluister onreg.

kjv_text: None calleth for justice, nor any pleadeth for truth: they trust in vanity, and speak lies; they conceive mischief, and bring forth iniquity.
bsb_text: No one calls for justice; no one pleads his case honestly. They rely on empty pleas; they tell lies; they conceive mischief and give birth to iniquity.
aov_text: Daar is niemand wat aanklaag in geregtigheid en niemand wat ’n regstryd voer in waarheid nie; hulle vertrou op nietigheid en spreek valsheid, met moeite gaan hulle swanger en baar onheil.

kjv_text: They hatch cockatrice' eggs, and weave the spider's web: he that eateth of their eggs dieth, and that which is crushed breaketh out into a viper.
bsb_text: They hatch the eggs of vipers and weave a spider’s web. Whoever eats their eggs will die; crack one open, and a viper is hatched.
aov_text: Basilisk-eiers broei hulle uit, en spinnerakke weef hulle; hy wat van hulle eiers eet, moet sterwe; en as dit stukkend gedruk word, bars daar ’n adder uit.

kjv_text: Their webs shall not become garments, neither shall they cover themselves with their works: their works are works of iniquity, and the act of violence is in their hands.
bsb_text: Their cobwebs cannot be made into clothing, and they cannot cover themselves with their works. Their deeds are sinful deeds, and acts of violence are in their hands.
aov_text: Hulle weefsels deug nie vir klere nie, en met hulle voortbrengsels kan niemand hom toemaak nie; hulle werke is onheilswerke, en die daad van geweld is in hulle hande.

kjv_text: Their feet run to evil, and they make haste to shed innocent blood: their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity; wasting and destruction are in their paths.
bsb_text: Their feet run to evil; they are swift to shed innocent blood. Their thoughts are sinful thoughts; ruin and destruction lie in their wake.
aov_text: Hulle voete hardloop om kwaad te doen en is haastig om onskuldige bloed te vergiet; hulle gedagtes is onheilsgedagtes, verwoesting en verbreking is in hulle paaie.

kjv_text: The way of peace they know not; and there is no judgment in their goings: they have made them crooked paths: whosoever goeth therein shall not know peace.
bsb_text: The way of peace they have not known, and there is no justice in their tracks. They have turned them into crooked paths; no one who treads on them will know peace.
aov_text: Die weg van vrede ken hulle nie, en daar is geen reg in hulle spore nie; hulle maak hul paaie krom, niemand wat daarop loop, ken die vrede nie.

kjv_text: Therefore is judgment far from us, neither doth justice overtake us: we wait for light, but behold obscurity; for brightness, but we walk in darkness.
bsb_text: Therefore justice is far from us, and righteousness does not reach us. We hope for light, but there is darkness; for brightness, but we walk in gloom.
aov_text: Daarom is die reg ver van ons en bereik die geregtigheid ons nie; ons wag op lig, maar kyk, daar is duisternis; op ’n helder skynsel, maar ons wandel in dikke donkerheid.

kjv_text: We grope for the wall like the blind, and we grope as if we had no eyes: we stumble at noon day as in the night; we are in desolate places as dead men.
bsb_text: Like the blind, we feel our way along the wall, groping like those without eyes. We stumble at midday as in the twilight; among the vigorous we are like the dead.
aov_text: Ons tas rond langs die muur soos blindes, en soos die wat geen oë het nie, tas ons rond; ons struikel op die middag soos in die skemeraand; ons is onder die gesondes soos dooie mense.

kjv_text: We roar all like bears, and mourn sore like doves: we look for judgment, but there is none; for salvation, but it is far off from us.
bsb_text: We all growl like bears and moan like doves. We hope for justice, but find none, for salvation, but it is far from us.
aov_text: Ons brom almal soos bere, en soos duiwe kir ons aanhoudend; ons wag op reg, maar dit is nie daar nie; op heil—dit bly ver van ons.

kjv_text: For our transgressions are multiplied before thee, and our sins testify against us: for our transgressions are with us; and as for our iniquities, we know them;
bsb_text: For our transgressions are multiplied before You, and our sins testify against us. Our transgressions are indeed with us, and we know our iniquities:
aov_text: Want ons oortredinge is baie voor U, en ons sondes getuig teen ons; want ons oortredinge staan voor ons, en ons ongeregtighede—ons ken hulle:

kjv_text: In transgressing and lying against the LORD, and departing away from our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood.
bsb_text: rebelling and denying the LORD, turning away from our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering lies from the heart.
aov_text: die afval en verloëning van die HERE en afwyking van agter onse God; die uitspreek van verdrukking en oortreding, die opneem en uitstoot van leuentaal uit die hart.

kjv_text: And judgment is turned away backward, and justice standeth afar off: for truth is fallen in the street, and equity cannot enter.
bsb_text: So justice is turned away, and righteousness stands at a distance. For truth has stumbled in the public square, and honesty cannot enter.
aov_text: So word dan die reg teruggedring en die geregtigheid bly staan van ver; want die waarheid struikel op die mark, en wat reg is, kan nie binnekom nie.

kjv_text: Yea, truth faileth; and he that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey: and the LORD saw it, and it displeased him that there was no judgment.
bsb_text: Truth is missing, and whoever turns from evil becomes prey. The LORD looked and was displeased that there was no justice.
aov_text: Ja, die waarheid word vermis; en wie afwyk van die kwaad, word geplunder. Toe het die HERE dit gesien, en dit was verkeerd in sy oë dat daar geen reg was nie.

kjv_text: And he saw that there was no man, and wondered that there was no intercessor: therefore his arm brought salvation unto him; and his righteousness, it sustained him.
bsb_text: He saw that there was no man; He was amazed that there was no one to intercede. So His own arm brought salvation, and His own righteousness sustained Him.
aov_text: En Hy het gesien dat daar niemand was nie en Hom verbaas dat niemand tussenbei tree nie; daarom het sy arm Hom gehelp en sy geregtigheid het Hom ondersteun.

kjv_text: For he put on righteousness as a breastplate, and an helmet of salvation upon his head; and he put on the garments of vengeance for clothing, and was clad with zeal as a cloak.
bsb_text: He put on righteousness like a breastplate, and the helmet of salvation on His head; He put on garments of vengeance and wrapped Himself in a cloak of zeal.
aov_text: En Hy het geregtigheid aangetrek soos ’n pantser, en die helm van heil was op sy hoof; en die klere van wraak het Hy aangetrek as kleding en Hom gewikkel in die ywer soos in ’n mantel.

kjv_text: According to their deeds, accordingly he will repay, fury to his adversaries, recompence to his enemies; to the islands he will repay recompence.
bsb_text: So He will repay according to their deeds: fury to His enemies, retribution to His foes, and recompense to the islands.
aov_text: Volgens die dade, daarmee ooreenkomstig sal Hy vergelde: grimmigheid aan sy teëstanders, vergelding aan sy vyande; aan die eilande sal Hy die loon vergelde.

kjv_text: So shall they fear the name of the LORD from the west, and his glory from the rising of the sun. When the enemy shall come in like a flood, the Spirit of the LORD shall lift up a standard against him.
bsb_text: So shall they fear the name of the LORD where the sun sets, and His glory where it rises. For He will come like a raging flood, driven by the breath of the LORD.
aov_text: En hulle sal die Naam van die HERE vrees van die westekant af, en sy heerlikheid van die opgang van die son af; want Hy sal kom soos ’n saamgeperste stroom wat die asem van die HERE aandrywe.

kjv_text: And the Redeemer shall come to Zion, and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob, saith the LORD.
bsb_text: “The Redeemer will come to Zion, to those in Jacob who turn from transgression,” declares the LORD.
aov_text: Maar vir Sion kom Hy as Verlosser en vir die wat in Jakob hulle bekeer van oortreding, spreek die HERE.

kjv_text: As for me, this is my covenant with them, saith the LORD; My spirit that is upon thee, and my words which I have put in thy mouth, shall not depart out of thy mouth, nor out of the mouth of thy seed, nor out of the mouth of thy seed's seed, saith the LORD, from henceforth and for ever.
bsb_text: “As for Me, this is My covenant with them,” says the LORD. “My Spirit will not depart from you, and My words that I have put in your mouth will not depart from your mouth or from the mouths of your children and grandchildren, from now on and forevermore,” says the LORD.
aov_text: Wat My aangaan, dit is my verbond met hulle, sê die HERE: My Gees wat op jou is, en my woorde wat Ek in jou mond gelê het, sal uit jou mond nie wyk nie, en ook nie uit die mond van jou kroos en uit die mond van die kroos van jou kroos, sê die HERE, van nou af tot in ewigheid nie.

kjv_text: Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee.
bsb_text: Arise, shine, for your light has come, and the glory of the LORD rises upon you.
aov_text: STAAN op, word verlig; want jou lig kom, en die heerlikheid van die HERE gaan oor jou op.

kjv_text: For, behold, the darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness the people: but the LORD shall arise upon thee, and his glory shall be seen upon thee.
bsb_text: For behold, darkness covers the earth, and thick darkness is over the peoples; but the LORD will rise upon you, and His glory will appear over you.
aov_text: Want kyk, die duisternis sal die aarde oordek en donkerheid die volke; maar oor jóu sal die HERE opgaan, en sy heerlikheid sal oor jou gesien word.

kjv_text: And the Gentiles shall come to thy light, and kings to the brightness of thy rising.
bsb_text: Nations will come to your light, and kings to the brightness of your dawn.
aov_text: En nasies sal trek na jou lig, en konings na jou stralende opgang.

kjv_text: Lift up thine eyes round about, and see: all they gather themselves together, they come to thee: thy sons shall come from far, and thy daughters shall be nursed at thy side.
bsb_text: Lift up your eyes and look around: They all gather and come to you; your sons will come from afar, and your daughters will be carried on the arm.
aov_text: Slaan jou oë rondom op en kyk—hulle almal kom bymekaar, hulle kom na jou toe; jou seuns kom van ver, en jou dogters word op die heup gedra.

kjv_text: Then thou shalt see, and flow together, and thine heart shall fear, and be enlarged; because the abundance of the sea shall be converted unto thee, the forces of the Gentiles shall come unto thee.
bsb_text: Then you will look and be radiant, and your heart will tremble and swell with joy, because the riches of the sea will be brought to you, and the wealth of the nations will come to you.
aov_text: Dan sal jy dit sien en straal van vreugde, en jou hart sal ontroer en verruim word; want die rykdom van die see gaan na jou toe oor, die skatte van die nasies kom na jou toe aan.

kjv_text: The multitude of camels shall cover thee, the dromedaries of Midian and Ephah; all they from Sheba shall come: they shall bring gold and incense; and they shall shew forth the praises of the LORD.
bsb_text: Caravans of camels will cover your land, young camels of Midian and Ephah, and all from Sheba will come, bearing gold and frankincense and proclaiming the praises of the LORD.
aov_text: ’n Menigte kamele sal jou oordek, die jong kamele van Mídian en Efa; hulle sal almal uit Skeba kom; hulle bring goud en wierook en verkondig met blydskap die roemryke dade van die HERE.

kjv_text: All the flocks of Kedar shall be gathered together unto thee, the rams of Nebaioth shall minister unto thee: they shall come up with acceptance on mine altar, and I will glorify the house of my glory.
bsb_text: All the flocks of Kedar will be gathered to you; the rams of Nebaioth will serve you and go up on My altar with acceptance; I will adorn My glorious house.
aov_text: Al die kleinvee van Kedar sal vir jou versamel word, die ramme van Nebájot sal jou dien; hulle kom as welgevallige offer op my altaar, en Ek sal my heerlike huis heerlik maak.

kjv_text: Who are these that fly as a cloud, and as the doves to their windows?
bsb_text: Who are these who fly like clouds, like doves to their shelters?
aov_text: Wie is dit wat daar aangevlieg kom soos ’n wolk en soos duiwe na hulle vensters?

kjv_text: Surely the isles shall wait for me, and the ships of Tarshish first, to bring thy sons from far, their silver and their gold with them, unto the name of the LORD thy God, and to the Holy One of Israel, because he hath glorified thee.
bsb_text: Surely the islands will wait for Me, with the ships of Tarshish in the lead, to bring your children from afar, with their silver and gold, to the honor of the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, for He has glorified you.
aov_text: Ja, op My wag die eilande, en die skepe van Tarsis kom vooraan, om jou seuns van ver te bring. Hul silwer en hul goud is by hulle, vir die Naam van die HERE jou God en vir die Heilige van Israel, omdat Hy jou heerlik gemaak het.

kjv_text: And the sons of strangers shall build up thy walls, and their kings shall minister unto thee: for in my wrath I smote thee, but in my favour have I had mercy on thee.
bsb_text: Foreigners will rebuild your walls, and their kings will serve you. Although I struck you in anger, yet in favor I will show you mercy.
aov_text: En uitlanders sal jou mure bou, en hulle konings sal jou dien; want in my toorn het Ek jou geslaan, maar in my welbehae het Ek My oor jou ontferm.

kjv_text: Therefore thy gates shall be open continually; they shall not be shut day nor night; that men may bring unto thee the forces of the Gentiles, and that their kings may be brought.
bsb_text: Your gates will always stand open; they will never be shut, day or night, so that the wealth of the nations may be brought into you, with their kings being led in procession.
aov_text: En jou poorte sal altyddeur oopstaan; hulle sal bedags of snags nie gesluit word nie, om na jou toe aan te bring die rykdom van die nasies en hulle konings in triomftog.

kjv_text: For the nation and kingdom that will not serve thee shall perish; yea, those nations shall be utterly wasted.
bsb_text: For the nation or kingdom that will not serve you will perish; it will be utterly destroyed.
aov_text: Want die nasie en die koninkryk wat jou nie sal dien nie, sal ondergaan, en dié nasies sal seker verwoes word.

kjv_text: The glory of Lebanon shall come unto thee, the fir tree, the pine tree, and the box together, to beautify the place of my sanctuary; and I will make the place of my feet glorious.
bsb_text: The glory of Lebanon will come to you—its cypress, elm, and boxwood together—to adorn the place of My sanctuary, and I will glorify the place of My feet.
aov_text: Die heerlikheid van die Líbanon sal na jou toe kom, die sipres, die plataan en die denneboom almal saam, om te versier die plek van my heiligdom; en Ek sal die plek van my voete heerlik maak.

kjv_text: The sons also of them that afflicted thee shall come bending unto thee; and all they that despised thee shall bow themselves down at the soles of thy feet; and they shall call thee, The city of the LORD, The Zion of the Holy One of Israel.
bsb_text: The sons of your oppressors will come and bow down to you; all who reviled you will fall facedown at your feet and call you the City of the LORD, Zion of the Holy One of Israel.
aov_text: En die seuns van hulle wat jou verdruk het, sal gebukkend na jou toe trek; en almal wat jou verag het, sal hulle neerbuig by jou voetsole; en hulle sal jou noem: Stad van die HERE, Sion van die Heilige van Israel.

kjv_text: Whereas thou hast been forsaken and hated, so that no man went through thee, I will make thee an eternal excellency, a joy of many generations.
bsb_text: Whereas you have been forsaken and despised, with no one passing through, I will make you an everlasting pride, a joy from age to age.
aov_text: In plaas dat jy verlate en gehaat is sonder dat iemand daar deurtrek, sal Ek jou maak tot ’n ewige heerlikheid, ’n vreugde van geslag tot geslag.

kjv_text: Thou shalt also suck the milk of the Gentiles, and shalt suck the breast of kings: and thou shalt know that I the LORD am thy Saviour and thy Redeemer, the mighty One of Jacob.
bsb_text: You will drink the milk of nations and nurse at the breasts of royalty; you will know that I, the LORD, am your Savior and your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.
aov_text: En jy sal die melk van nasies suig en die bors van konings suig en sal weet dat Ek, die HERE, jou Heiland is, en jou Losser die Magtige van Jakob.

kjv_text: For brass I will bring gold, and for iron I will bring silver, and for wood brass, and for stones iron: I will also make thy officers peace, and thine exactors righteousness.
bsb_text: Instead of bronze I will bring you gold; I will bring silver in place of iron, bronze instead of wood, and iron instead of stones. I will appoint peace as your governor and righteousness as your ruler.
aov_text: Vir koper bring Ek goud en vir yster bring Ek silwer, en vir hout koper en vir klippe yster; en Ek sal Vrede as jou owerheid aanstel en Geregtigheid as jou bestuurders.

kjv_text: Violence shall no more be heard in thy land, wasting nor destruction within thy borders; but thou shalt call thy walls Salvation, and thy gates Praise.
bsb_text: No longer will violence be heard in your land, nor ruin or destruction within your borders. But you will name your walls Salvation and your gates Praise.
aov_text: Van geweld sal in jou land nie meer gehoor word nie—van geen verwoesting of verbreking in jou grondgebied nie; maar jy sal jou mure Heil noem en jou poorte Lof.

kjv_text: The sun shall be no more thy light by day; neither for brightness shall the moon give light unto thee: but the LORD shall be unto thee an everlasting light, and thy God thy glory.
bsb_text: No longer will the sun be your light by day, nor the brightness of the moon shine on your night; for the LORD will be your everlasting light, and your God will be your splendor.
aov_text: Die son sal bedags jou lig nie meer wees nie, en as glans sal die maan vir jou geen skynsel gee nie; maar die HERE sal vir jou wees ’n ewige lig, en jou God sal jou sieraad wees.

kjv_text: Thy sun shall no more go down; neither shall thy moon withdraw itself: for the LORD shall be thine everlasting light, and the days of thy mourning shall be ended.
bsb_text: Your sun will no longer set, and your moon will not wane; for the LORD will be your everlasting light, and the days of your sorrow will cease.
aov_text: Jou son sal nie meer ondergaan nie, en jou maan nie kleiner word nie; want die HERE sal vir jou wees ’n ewige lig, en die dae van jou treurigheid is verby.

kjv_text: Thy people also shall be all righteous: they shall inherit the land for ever, the branch of my planting, the work of my hands, that I may be glorified.
bsb_text: Then all your people will be righteous; they will possess the land forever; they are the branch of My planting, the work of My hands, so that I may be glorified.
aov_text: En jou volk sal almal regverdiges wees, vir ewig sal hulle die land besit—as lote deur My geplant, ’n werk van my hande, tot my verheerliking.

kjv_text: A little one shall become a thousand, and a small one a strong nation: I the LORD will hasten it in his time.
bsb_text: The least of you will become a thousand, and the smallest a mighty nation. I am the LORD; in its time I will accomplish it quickly.
aov_text: Die kleinste sal ’n geslag word en die geringste ’n magtige nasie. Ek, die HERE, sal dit op die regte tyd gou laat kom.

kjv_text: The Spirit of the Lord GOD is upon me; because the LORD hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound;
bsb_text: The Spirit of the Lord GOD is on Me, because the LORD has anointed Me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent Me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives and freedom to the prisoners,
aov_text: DIE Gees van die Here HERE is op My, omdat die HERE My gesalf het om ’n blye boodskap te bring aan die ootmoediges; Hy het My gestuur om te verbind die gebrokenes van hart, om vir die gevangenes ’n vrylating uit te roep en vir die geboeides opening van die gevangenis;

kjv_text: To proclaim the acceptable year of the LORD, and the day of vengeance of our God; to comfort all that mourn;
bsb_text: to proclaim the year of the LORD’s favor and the day of our God’s vengeance, to comfort all who mourn,
aov_text: om uit te roep ’n jaar van die welbehae van die HERE en ’n dag van die wraak van onse God; om al die treurendes te troos;

kjv_text: To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that he might be glorified.
bsb_text: to console the mourners in Zion—to give them a crown of beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, and a garment of praise for a spirit of despair. So they will be called oaks of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that He may be glorified.
aov_text: om vir die treurendes in Sion te beskik dat aan hulle gegee word sieraad vir as, vreugde-olie vir treurigheid, ’n gewaad van lof vir ’n verslae gees; sodat hulle genoem kan word terebinte van geregtigheid, ’n planting van die HERE, tot sy verheerliking.

kjv_text: And they shall build the old wastes, they shall raise up the former desolations, and they shall repair the waste cities, the desolations of many generations.
bsb_text: They will rebuild the ancient ruins; they will restore the places long devastated; they will renew the ruined cities, the desolations of many generations.
aov_text: En hulle sal die ou puinhope bou, die verwoeste plekke uit vroeër dae weer oprig en die verwoeste stede weer nuut maak wat woes was van geslag tot geslag.

kjv_text: And strangers shall stand and feed your flocks, and the sons of the alien shall be your plowmen and your vinedressers.
bsb_text: Strangers will stand and feed your flocks, and foreigners will be your plowmen and vinedressers.
aov_text: Die vreemdelinge sal staan en julle kleinvee oppas, en uitlanders sal julle landbouers en wynboere wees.

kjv_text: But ye shall be named the Priests of the LORD: men shall call you the Ministers of our God: ye shall eat the riches of the Gentiles, and in their glory shall ye boast yourselves.
bsb_text: But you will be called the priests of the LORD; they will speak of you as ministers of our God; you will feed on the wealth of nations, and you will boast in their riches.
aov_text: Maar júlle sal priesters van die HERE genoem word; aan julle sal gesê word: Dienaars van onse God! Julle sal die rykdom van die nasies eet en op hulle heerlikheid julle beroem.

kjv_text: For your shame ye shall have double; and for confusion they shall rejoice in their portion: therefore in their land they shall possess the double: everlasting joy shall be unto them.
bsb_text: Instead of shame, My people will have a double portion, and instead of humiliation, they will rejoice in their share; and so they will inherit a double portion in their land, and everlasting joy will be theirs.
aov_text: In plaas van julle skande ontvang julle ’n dubbele deel; en in plaas van die smaad sal hulle jubel oor hul deel. Daarom sal hulle in hul land ’n dubbele deel in besit neem, ewige vreugde geniet.

kjv_text: For I the LORD love judgment, I hate robbery for burnt offering; and I will direct their work in truth, and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.
bsb_text: For I, the LORD, love justice; I hate robbery and iniquity; in My faithfulness I will give them their recompense and make an everlasting covenant with them.
aov_text: Want Ek, die HERE, het die reg lief; Ek haat die roof met onreg, en Ek sal hulle getrou hul loon gee en ’n ewige verbond met hulle sluit.

kjv_text: And their seed shall be known among the Gentiles, and their offspring among the people: all that see them shall acknowledge them, that they are the seed which the LORD hath blessed.
bsb_text: Their descendants will be known among the nations, and their offspring among the peoples. All who see them will acknowledge that they are a people the LORD has blessed.
aov_text: En hulle nageslag sal bekend word onder die nasies en hulle nakomelinge onder die volke; almal wat hulle sien, sal hulle daarvoor aansien dat hulle ’n geslag is wat die HERE geseën het.

kjv_text: I will greatly rejoice in the LORD, my soul shall be joyful in my God; for he hath clothed me with the garments of salvation, he hath covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decketh himself with ornaments, and as a bride adorneth herself with her jewels.
bsb_text: I will rejoice greatly in the LORD, my soul will exult in my God; for He has clothed me with garments of salvation and wrapped me in a robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom wears a priestly headdress, as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.
aov_text: Ek is baie bly in die HERE, my siel juig in my God; want Hy het my beklee met die klere van heil, my in die mantel van geregtigheid gewikkel—soos ’n bruidegom wat priesterlik die hoofversiersel ombind, en soos ’n bruid wat haar versier met haar juwele.

kjv_text: For as the earth bringeth forth her bud, and as the garden causeth the things that are sown in it to spring forth; so the Lord GOD will cause righteousness and praise to spring forth before all the nations.
bsb_text: For as the earth brings forth its growth, and as a garden enables seed to spring up, so the Lord GOD will cause righteousness and praise to spring up before all the nations.
aov_text: Want soos die aarde sy plante voortbring, en soos ’n tuin sy gewasse laat uitspruit, so sal die Here HERE geregtigheid en lof laat uitspruit voor die oog van al die nasies.

kjv_text: For Zion's sake will I not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem's sake I will not rest, until the righteousness thereof go forth as brightness, and the salvation thereof as a lamp that burneth.
bsb_text: For Zion’s sake I will not keep silent, and for Jerusalem’s sake I will not keep still, until her righteousness shines like a bright light, her salvation like a blazing torch.
aov_text: TER wille van Sion sal Ek nie swyg nie en ter wille van Jerusalem nie stil wees nie, totdat sy geregtigheid uitbreek soos ’n glans en sy heil soos ’n fakkel wat brand.

kjv_text: And the Gentiles shall see thy righteousness, and all kings thy glory: and thou shalt be called by a new name, which the mouth of the LORD shall name.
bsb_text: Nations will see your righteousness, and all kings your glory. You will be called by a new name that the mouth of the LORD will bestow.
aov_text: En die nasies sal jou geregtigheid sien en al die konings jou heerlikheid; en jy sal met ’n nuwe naam genoem word wat die mond van die HERE sal noem.

kjv_text: Thou shalt also be a crown of glory in the hand of the LORD, and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God.
bsb_text: You will be a crown of glory in the hand of the LORD, a royal diadem in the palm of your God.
aov_text: En jy sal ’n sierlike kroon wees in die hand van die HERE en ’n koninklike tulband in die hand van jou God.

kjv_text: Thou shalt no more be termed Forsaken; neither shall thy land any more be termed Desolate: but thou shalt be called Hephzibah, and thy land Beulah: for the LORD delighteth in thee, and thy land shall be married.
bsb_text: No longer will you be called Forsaken, nor your land named Desolate; but you will be called Hephzibah, and your land Beulah; for the LORD will take delight in you, and your land will be His bride.
aov_text: Jy sal nie meer genoem word Verlatene nie, en jou land sal nie meer genoem word Wildernis nie. Maar jy sal genoem word: my welbehae, en jou land: die getroude; want die HERE het ’n behae in jou, en jou land sal getroud wees.

kjv_text: For as a young man marrieth a virgin, so shall thy sons marry thee: and as the bridegroom rejoiceth over the bride, so shall thy God rejoice over thee.
bsb_text: For as a young man marries a young woman, so your sons will marry you; and as a bridegroom rejoices over his bride, so your God will rejoice over you.
aov_text: Want soos ’n jonkman ’n jongedogter trou, so sal jou kinders jou trou; en soos die bruidegom bly is oor die bruid, sal jou God oor jou bly wees.

kjv_text: I have set watchmen upon thy walls, O Jerusalem, which shall never hold their peace day nor night: ye that make mention of the LORD, keep not silence,
bsb_text: On your walls, O Jerusalem, I have posted watchmen; they will never be silent day or night. You who call on the LORD shall take no rest for yourselves,
aov_text: o Jerusalem, Ek het wagte op jou mure uitgesit wat gedurigdeur die hele dag en die hele nag nie sal swyg nie. o Julle wat die HERE herinner aan sy beloftes—moenie rus nie

kjv_text: And give him no rest, till he establish, and till he make Jerusalem a praise in the earth.
bsb_text: nor give Him any rest until He establishes Jerusalem and makes her the praise of the earth.
aov_text: en laat Hom nie met rus nie, totdat Hy Jerusalem bevestig en maak tot ’n lof op aarde!

kjv_text: The LORD hath sworn by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength, Surely I will no more give thy corn to be meat for thine enemies; and the sons of the stranger shall not drink thy wine, for the which thou hast laboured:
bsb_text: The LORD has sworn by His right hand and by His mighty arm: “Never again will I give your grain to your enemies for food, nor will foreigners drink the new wine for which you have toiled.
aov_text: Die HERE het gesweer by sy regterhand en by sy magtige arm: Waarlik, Ek sal jou koring nie meer gee dat jou vyande dit eet nie, en uitlanders sal jou mos nie drink waarvoor jy gewerk het nie.

kjv_text: But they that have gathered it shall eat it, and praise the LORD; and they that have brought it together shall drink it in the courts of my holiness.
bsb_text: For those who harvest grain will eat it and praise the LORD, and those who gather grapes will drink the wine in My holy courts.”
aov_text: Maar hulle wat dit insamel, sal dit eet en die HERE prys; en hulle wat dit oes, sal dit drink in my heilige voorhowe.

kjv_text: Go through, go through the gates; prepare ye the way of the people; cast up, cast up the highway; gather out the stones; lift up a standard for the people.
bsb_text: Go out, go out through the gates; prepare the way for the people! Build it up, build up the highway; clear away the stones; raise a banner for the nations!
aov_text: Gaan in, gaan in deur die poorte, berei die weg van die volk! Vul op, vul op die grootpad, gooi die klippe weg, steek ’n banier op oor die volke!

kjv_text: Behold, the LORD hath proclaimed unto the end of the world, Say ye to the daughter of Zion, Behold, thy salvation cometh; behold, his reward is with him, and his work before him.
bsb_text: Behold, the LORD has proclaimed to the ends of the earth, “Say to Daughter Zion: See, your Savior comes! Look, His reward is with Him, and His recompense goes before Him.”
aov_text: Kyk, die HERE laat dit hoor tot by die einde van die aarde: Sê aan die dogter van Sion: Kyk, jou heil kom; kyk, sy loon is by Hom en sy beloning is voor sy aangesig.

kjv_text: And they shall call them, The holy people, The redeemed of the LORD: and thou shalt be called, Sought out, A city not forsaken.
bsb_text: And they will be called the Holy People, the Redeemed of The LORD; and you will be called Sought Out, A City Not Forsaken.
aov_text: En hulle sal genoem word: die heilige volk, die verlostes van die HERE; en jy sal genoem word: die begeerde, die stad wat nie verlaat is nie.

kjv_text: Who is this that cometh from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? this that is glorious in his apparel, travelling in the greatness of his strength? I that speak in righteousness, mighty to save.
bsb_text: Who is this coming from Edom, from Bozrah with crimson-stained garments? Who is this robed in splendor, marching in the greatness of His strength? “It is I, proclaiming vindication, mighty to save.”
aov_text: WIE is dit wat daar aankom uit Edom, met bloedrooi klere uit Bosra? Hy daar, pragtig in sy gewaad, wat agteroor buig in die volheid van sy krag? Dit is Ek wat in geregtigheid spreek, wat magtig is om te verlos.

kjv_text: Wherefore art thou red in thine apparel, and thy garments like him that treadeth in the winefat?
bsb_text: Why are Your clothes red, and Your garments like one who treads the winepress?
aov_text: Waarom is u gewaad so rooi, en u klere soos dié van een wat die wynpers trap?

kjv_text: I have trodden the winepress alone; and of the people there was none with me: for I will tread them in mine anger, and trample them in my fury; and their blood shall be sprinkled upon my garments, and I will stain all my raiment.
bsb_text: “I have trodden the winepress alone, and no one from the nations was with Me. I trampled them in My anger and trod them down in My fury; their blood spattered My garments, and all My clothes were stained.
aov_text: Ek het die pers alleen getrap, en van die volke was niemand by My nie; en Ek het hulle getrap in my toorn en hulle vertrap in my grimmigheid, sodat hulle lewensap op my klere gespat en Ek my hele gewaad bevlek het.

kjv_text: For the day of vengeance is in mine heart, and the year of my redeemed is come.
bsb_text: For the day of vengeance was in My heart, and the year of My redemption had come.
aov_text: Want die dag van wraak was in my hart, en die jaar van my verlossing het gekom.

kjv_text: And I looked, and there was none to help; and I wondered that there was none to uphold: therefore mine own arm brought salvation unto me; and my fury, it upheld me.
bsb_text: I looked, but there was no one to help; I was appalled that no one assisted. So My arm brought Me salvation, and My own wrath upheld Me.
aov_text: En Ek het uitgekyk, maar daar was geen helper nie; en Ek het My verbaas, maar daar was niemand wat ondersteun nie. Toe het my arm My gehelp en my grimmigheid het My ondersteun.

kjv_text: And I will tread down the people in mine anger, and make them drunk in my fury, and I will bring down their strength to the earth.
bsb_text: I trampled the nations in My anger; in My wrath I made them drunk and poured out their blood on the ground.”
aov_text: En Ek het volke vertrap in my toorn en hulle dronk gemaak in my grimmigheid; en Ek het hulle lewensap op die aarde laat afloop.

kjv_text: I will mention the loving-kindnesses of the LORD, and the praises of the LORD, according to all that the LORD hath bestowed on us, and the great goodness toward the house of Israel, which he hath bestowed on them according to his mercies, and according to the multitude of his loving-kindnesses.
bsb_text: I will make known the LORD’s loving devotion and His praiseworthy acts, because of all that the LORD has done for us—the many good things for the house of Israel according to His great compassion and loving devotion.
aov_text: EK sal die goedertierenhede van die HERE prys, die roemryke dade van die HERE, ooreenkomstig alles wat die HERE aan ons bewys het, en die veelvuldige goedheid jeens die huis van Israel wat Hy aan hulle bewys het, na sy barmhartighede en na die grootheid van sy goedertierenhede.

kjv_text: For he said, Surely they are my people, children that will not lie: so he was their Saviour.
bsb_text: For He said, “They are surely My people, sons who will not be disloyal.” So He became their Savior.
aov_text: Want Hy het gesê: Hulle is tog my volk, kinders wat nie sal lieg nie. So het Hy dan vir hulle ’n Heiland geword.

kjv_text: In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them: in his love and in his pity he redeemed them; and he bare them, and carried them all the days of old.
bsb_text: In all their distress, He too was afflicted, and the Angel of His Presence saved them. In His love and compassion He redeemed them; He lifted them up and carried them all the days of old.
aov_text: In al hulle benoudheid was Hy benoud, en die Engel van sy aangesig het hulle verlos; deur sy liefde en deur sy medelyde het Hý hulle verlos; en Hy het hulle opgehef en hulle gedra, al die dae van die ou tyd.

kjv_text: But they rebelled, and vexed his holy Spirit: therefore he was turned to be their enemy, and he fought against them.
bsb_text: But they rebelled and grieved His Holy Spirit. So He turned and became their enemy, and He Himself fought against them.
aov_text: Maar húlle was wederstrewig en het sy Heilige Gees bedroef; daarom het Hy vir hulle in ’n vyand verander: Hy self het teen hulle gestry.

kjv_text: Then he remembered the days of old, Moses, and his people, saying, Where is he that brought them up out of the sea with the shepherd of his flock? where is he that put his holy Spirit within him?
bsb_text: Then His people remembered the days of old, the days of Moses. Where is He who brought them through the sea with the shepherds of His flock? Where is the One who set His Holy Spirit among them,
aov_text: Toe het sy volk gedink aan die dae van die ou tyd, van Moses: Waar is Hy wat hulle uit die see laat optrek het saam met die herder van sy kudde? Waar is Hy wat sy Heilige Gees in hulle midde gegee het?

kjv_text: That led them by the right hand of Moses with his glorious arm, dividing the water before them, to make himself an everlasting name?
bsb_text: who sent His glorious arm to lead them by the right hand of Moses, who divided the waters before them to gain for Himself everlasting renown,
aov_text: Wat sy heerlike arm laat trek het aan die regterhand van Moses; wat die waters voor hulle uit gekloof het, om vir Hom ’n ewige Naam te maak?

kjv_text: That led them through the deep, as an horse in the wilderness, that they should not stumble?
bsb_text: who led them through the depths like a horse in the wilderness, so that they did not stumble?
aov_text: Wat hulle deur die watervloede laat trek het soos ’n perd deur die woestyn, sonder om te struikel?

kjv_text: As a beast goeth down into the valley, the Spirit of the LORD caused him to rest: so didst thou lead thy people, to make thyself a glorious name.
bsb_text: Like cattle going down to the valley, the Spirit of the LORD gave them rest. You led Your people this way to make for Yourself a glorious name.
aov_text: Soos vee wat aftrek in die laagte, het die Gees van die HERE hulle na die rus gelei. Só het U u volk gelei, om vir U ’n heerlike Naam te maak.

kjv_text: Look down from heaven, and behold from the habitation of thy holiness and of thy glory: where is thy zeal and thy strength, the sounding of thy bowels and of thy mercies toward me? are they restrained?
bsb_text: Look down from heaven and see, from Your holy and glorious habitation. Where are Your zeal and might? Your yearning and compassion for me are restrained.
aov_text: Kyk van die hemel neer en aanskou uit u heilige en heerlike woning! Waar is u ywer en u magtige dade? Die ontroering van u binneste en u barmhartighede het hulle jeens my ingehou.

kjv_text: Doubtless thou art our father, though Abraham be ignorant of us, and Israel acknowledge us not: thou, O LORD, art our father, our redeemer; thy name is from everlasting.
bsb_text: Yet You are our Father, though Abraham does not know us and Israel does not acknowledge us. You, O LORD, are our Father; our Redeemer from Everlasting is Your name.
aov_text: Want U is ons Vader! Want Abraham weet van ons nie, en Israel ken ons nie. U, o HERE, is ons Vader; ons Verlosser is van ouds af u Naam.

kjv_text: O LORD, why hast thou made us to err from thy ways, and hardened our heart from thy fear? Return for thy servants' sake, the tribes of thine inheritance.
bsb_text: Why, O LORD, do You make us stray from Your ways and harden our hearts from fearing You? Return, for the sake of Your servants, the tribes of Your heritage.
aov_text: HERE, waarom laat U ons wegdwaal van u weë? Waarom verhard U ons hart, sodat ons U nie vrees nie? Keer terug ter wille van u knegte, die stamme van u erfdeel!

kjv_text: The people of thy holiness have possessed it but a little while: our adversaries have trodden down thy sanctuary.
bsb_text: For a short while Your people possessed Your holy place, but our enemies have trampled Your sanctuary.
aov_text: U heilige volk het dit vir ’n kort rukkie besit; ons teëstanders het u heiligdom vertrap.

kjv_text: We are thine: thou never barest rule over them; they were not called by thy name.
bsb_text: We have become like those You never ruled, like those not called by Your name.
aov_text: Ons het geword soos hulle oor wie U nie van ouds af geheers het nie, oor wie u Naam nie uitgeroep is nie.

kjv_text: Oh that thou wouldest rend the heavens, that thou wouldest come down, that the mountains might flow down at thy presence,
bsb_text: If only You would rend the heavens and come down, so that mountains would quake at Your presence,
aov_text: AG, as U maar die hemele wou skeur, wou neerdaal, dat die berge wankel voor u aangesig

kjv_text: As when the melting fire burneth, the fire causeth the waters to boil, to make thy name known to thine adversaries, that the nations may tremble at thy presence!
bsb_text: as fire kindles the brushwood and causes the water to boil, to make Your name known to Your enemies, so that the nations will tremble at Your presence!
aov_text: —soos vuur die houtjies aan die brand steek, vuur die water laat opborrel—om u Naam aan u teëstanders bekend te maak, sodat nasies voor u aangesig kan bewe

kjv_text: When thou didst terrible things which we looked not for, thou camest down, the mountains flowed down at thy presence.
bsb_text: When You did awesome works that we did not expect, You came down, and the mountains trembled at Your presence.
aov_text: wanneer U vreeslike dinge doen waar ons nie op gehoop het nie—as U maar wou neerdaal, sodat die berge wankel voor u aangesig!

kjv_text: For since the beginning of the world men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, neither hath the eye seen, O God, beside thee, what he hath prepared for him that waiteth for him.
bsb_text: From ancient times no one has heard, no ear has perceived, no eye has seen any God besides You, who acts on behalf of those who wait for Him.
aov_text: Van ouds af tog het niemand dit gehoor of verneem nie, geen oog het ’n God gesien wat werksaam is vir wie op Hom wag nie, behalwe U.
