kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD, Behold, a people cometh from the north country, and a great nation shall be raised from the sides of the earth.
bsb_text: This is what the LORD says: “Behold, an army is coming from the land of the north; a great nation is stirred up from the ends of the earth.
aov_text: So sê die HERE: Kyk, daar kom ’n volk uit die Noordland, en ’n groot nasie word opgewek uit die agterhoeke van die aarde.

kjv_text: They shall lay hold on bow and spear; they are cruel, and have no mercy; their voice roareth like the sea; and they ride upon horses, set in array as men for war against thee, O daughter of Zion.
bsb_text: They grasp the bow and spear; they are cruel and merciless. Their voice roars like the sea, and they ride upon horses, lined up like men in formation against you, O Daughter of Zion.”
aov_text: Boog en lans hanteer hulle; hulle is wreed en sonder barmhartigheid; hulle stem bruis soos die see, en hulle ry op perde, gewapend soos ’n man vir die oorlog, teen jou, o dogter van Sion!

kjv_text: We have heard the fame thereof: our hands wax feeble: anguish hath taken hold of us, and pain, as of a woman in travail.
bsb_text: We have heard the report; our hands hang limp. Anguish has gripped us, pain like that of a woman in labor.
aov_text: Ons het die gerug daarvan gehoor, ons hande het slap geword, benoudheid het ons aangegryp, smart soos van een wat baar.

kjv_text: Go not forth into the field, nor walk by the way; for the sword of the enemy and fear is on every side.
bsb_text: Do not go out to the fields; do not walk the road. For the enemy has a sword; terror is on every side.
aov_text: Gaan nie uit in die veld en loop nie op die pad nie; want die swaard van die vyand is daar, skrik rondom!

kjv_text: O daughter of my people, gird thee with sackcloth, and wallow thyself in ashes: make thee mourning, as for an only son, most bitter lamentation: for the spoiler shall suddenly come upon us.
bsb_text: O daughter of my people, dress yourselves in sackcloth and roll in ashes. Mourn with bitter wailing, as you would for an only son, for suddenly the destroyer will come upon us.
aov_text: Dogter van my volk, omgord jou met ’n roukleed en wentel jou in die as; bedryf rou soos oor ’n enigste kind, ’n bitter rouklag; want skielik kom die verwoester oor ons.

kjv_text: I have set thee for a tower and a fortress among my people, that thou mayest know and try their way.
bsb_text: “I have appointed you to examine My people like ore, so you may know and try their ways.
aov_text: Ek het jou onder my volk as toetser gestel, as vesting, dat jy hulle weg kan ken en toets.

kjv_text: They are all grievous revolters, walking with slanders: they are brass and iron; they are all corrupters.
bsb_text: All are hardened rebels, walking around as slanderers. They are bronze and iron; all of them are corrupt.
aov_text: Hulle is almal die oproerigstes van die oproeriges wat omgaan met kwaadsprekery; koper en yster is hulle; hulle handel almal verderflik.

kjv_text: The bellows are burned, the lead is consumed of the fire; the founder melteth in vain: for the wicked are not plucked away.
bsb_text: The bellows blow fiercely, blasting away the lead with fire. The refining proceeds in vain, for the wicked are not purged.
aov_text: Die blaasbalk blaas hard; wat uit die vuur gereed kom, is lood; tevergeefs hou hulle aan met smelt, maar die slegtes word nie afgeskei nie.

kjv_text: Reprobate silver shall men call them, because the LORD hath rejected them.
bsb_text: They are called rejected silver, because the LORD has rejected them.”
aov_text: Hulle word genoem: Verworpe silwer; want die HERE het hulle verwerp.

kjv_text: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
bsb_text: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
aov_text: DIE woord wat van die HERE tot Jeremia gekom het:

kjv_text: Stand in the gate of the LORD's house, and proclaim there this word, and say, Hear the word of the LORD, all ye of Judah, that enter in at these gates to worship the LORD.
bsb_text: “Stand in the gate of the house of the LORD and proclaim this message: Hear the word of the LORD, all you people of Judah who enter through these gates to worship the LORD.
aov_text: Staan in die poort van die huis van die HERE, en roep hierdie woord daar uit en sê: Hoor die woord van die HERE, o hele Juda, wat deur hierdie poorte ingaan om die HERE te aanbid!

kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, Amend your ways and your doings, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.
bsb_text: Thus says the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel: Correct your ways and deeds, and I will let you live in this place.
aov_text: So sê die HERE van die leërskare, die God van Israel: Maak julle weë en julle handelinge goed, dat Ek julle kan laat woon in hierdie plek.

kjv_text: Trust ye not in lying words, saying, The temple of the LORD, The temple of the LORD, The temple of the LORD, are these.
bsb_text: Do not trust in deceptive words, chanting: ‘This is the temple of the LORD, the temple of the LORD, the temple of the LORD.’
aov_text: Vertrou nie op bedrieglike woorde nie—wat sê: Die HERE se tempel, die HERE se tempel, die HERE se tempel is dit!

kjv_text: For if ye throughly amend your ways and your doings; if ye throughly execute judgment between a man and his neighbour;
bsb_text: For if you really correct your ways and deeds, if you act justly toward one another,
aov_text: Maar as julle jul weë en julle handelinge waarlik goed maak, as julle waarlik reg doen onder mekaar;

kjv_text: If ye oppress not the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow, and shed not innocent blood in this place, neither walk after other gods to your hurt:
bsb_text: if you no longer oppress the foreigner and the fatherless and the widow, and if you no longer shed innocent blood in this place or follow other gods to your own harm,
aov_text: vreemdeling, wees en weduwee nie verdruk nie en geen onskuldige bloed in hierdie plek vergiet nie en agter ander gode nie aan loop tot julle eie skade nie —

kjv_text: Then will I cause you to dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers, for ever and ever.
bsb_text: then I will let you live in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers forever and ever.
aov_text: dan sal Ek julle laat woon in hierdie plek, in die land wat Ek aan julle vaders gegee het, van eeu tot eeu.

kjv_text: Behold, ye trust in lying words, that cannot profit.
bsb_text: But look, you keep trusting in deceptive words to no avail.
aov_text: Kyk, julle vertrou op bedrieglike woorde wat nie baat nie.

kjv_text: Will ye steal, murder, and commit adultery, and swear falsely, and burn incense unto Baal, and walk after other gods whom ye know not;
bsb_text: Will you steal and murder, commit adultery and perjury, burn incense to Baal, and follow other gods that you have not known,
aov_text: Sal julle steel, doodslaan en owerspel bedrywe en vals sweer en vir Baäl offerrook laat opgaan en agter ander gode aan loop, wat julle nie ken nie,

kjv_text: And come and stand before me in this house, which is called by my name, and say, We are delivered to do all these abominations?
bsb_text: and then come and stand before Me in this house, which bears My Name, and say, ‘We are delivered, so we can continue with all these abominations’?
aov_text: en dan kom staan voor my aangesig in hierdie huis waaroor my Naam uitgeroep is, en sê: Ons is verlos!—om al hierdie gruwels te doen?

kjv_text: Is this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, even I have seen it, saith the LORD.
bsb_text: Has this house, which bears My Name, become a den of robbers in your sight? Yes, I too have seen it, declares the LORD.
aov_text: Is hierdie huis waaroor my Naam uitgeroep is, ’n spelonk van moordenaars in julle oë? Ook Ek—kyk, Ek het dit gesien, spreek die HERE.

kjv_text: But go ye now unto my place which was in Shiloh, where I set my name at the first, and see what I did to it for the wickedness of my people Israel.
bsb_text: But go now to the place in Shiloh where I first made a dwelling for My Name, and see what I did to it because of the wickedness of My people Israel.
aov_text: Want gaan tog na my plek wat in Silo was, waar Ek my Naam vroeër laat woon het, en kyk wat Ek daaraan gedoen het weens die boosheid van my volk Israel.

kjv_text: And now, because ye have done all these works, saith the LORD, and I spake unto you, rising up early and speaking, but ye heard not; and I called you, but ye answered not;
bsb_text: And now, because you have done all these things, declares the LORD, and because I have spoken to you again and again but you would not listen, and I have called to you but you would not answer,
aov_text: Omdat julle dan nou al hierdie dinge gedoen het, spreek die HERE, en Ek met julle gespreek het, vroeg en laat, maar julle nie geluister het nie, en Ek julle geroep, maar julle nie geantwoord het nie,

kjv_text: Therefore will I do unto this house, which is called by my name, wherein ye trust, and unto the place which I gave to you and to your fathers, as I have done to Shiloh.
bsb_text: therefore what I did to Shiloh I will now do to the house that bears My Name, the house in which you trust, the place that I gave to you and your fathers.
aov_text: daarom sal Ek aan die huis waaroor my Naam uitgeroep is, waar julle op vertrou, en aan die plek wat Ek aan julle en julle vaders gegee het, doen soos Ek aan Silo gedoen het.

kjv_text: And I will cast you out of my sight, as I have cast out all your brethren, even the whole seed of Ephraim.
bsb_text: And I will cast you out of My presence, just as I have cast out all your brothers, all the descendants of Ephraim.
aov_text: En Ek sal julle van my aangesig wegwerp soos Ek al julle broers, die hele geslag van Efraim, weggewerp het.

kjv_text: Therefore pray not thou for this people, neither lift up cry nor prayer for them, neither make intercession to me: for I will not hear thee.
bsb_text: As for you, do not pray for these people, do not offer a plea or petition on their behalf, and do not beg Me, for I will not listen to you.
aov_text: En jy, bid nie vir hierdie volk nie en hef vir hulle geen smeking of gebed op nie en dring by My nie aan nie, want Ek sal na jou nie luister nie.

kjv_text: Seest thou not what they do in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
bsb_text: Do you not see what they are doing in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
aov_text: Sien jy nie wat hulle in die stede van Juda en op die strate van Jerusalem doen nie?

kjv_text: The children gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead their dough, to make cakes to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto other gods, that they may provoke me to anger.
bsb_text: The sons gather wood, the fathers light the fire, and the women knead the dough to make cakes for the Queen of Heaven; they pour out drink offerings to other gods to provoke Me to anger.
aov_text: Die kinders maak hout bymekaar, en die vaders steek die vuur aan, en die vroue knie deeg om koeke te maak vir die hemelkoningin en vir ander gode drankoffers uit te giet om My te terg.

kjv_text: Do they provoke me to anger? saith the LORD: do they not provoke themselves to the confusion of their own faces?
bsb_text: But am I the One they are provoking? declares the LORD. Is it not themselves they spite, to their own shame?
aov_text: Terg hulle Mý? spreek die HERE. Doen hulle dit nie aan hulleself tot beskaming van hul aangesig nie?

kjv_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, mine anger and my fury shall be poured out upon this place, upon man, and upon beast, and upon the trees of the field, and upon the fruit of the ground; and it shall burn, and shall not be quenched.
bsb_text: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Behold, My anger and My fury will be poured out on this place, on man and beast, on the trees of the field and the produce of the land, and it will burn and not be extinguished.
aov_text: Daarom, so sê die Here HERE: Kyk, my toorn en my grimmigheid sal uitgestort word oor hierdie plek, oor die mense en oor die diere en oor die bome van die veld en oor die vrugte van die land; en dit sal brand en nie uitgeblus word nie.

kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Put your burnt offerings unto your sacrifices, and eat flesh.
bsb_text: This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: Add your burnt offerings to your other sacrifices and eat the meat yourselves!
aov_text: So sê die HERE van die leërskare, die God van Israel: Voeg julle brandoffers by julle slagoffers en eet vleis.

kjv_text: For I spake not unto your fathers, nor commanded them in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, concerning burnt offerings or sacrifices:
bsb_text: For when I brought your fathers out of the land of Egypt, I did not merely command them about burnt offerings and sacrifices,
aov_text: Want Ek het met julle vaders, op die dag dat Ek hulle uit Egipteland uitgelei het, nie gespreek nie en hulle geen bevel gegee in verband met brandoffer of slagoffer nie.

kjv_text: But this thing commanded I them, saying, Obey my voice, and I will be your God, and ye shall be my people: and walk ye in all the ways that I have commanded you, that it may be well unto you.
bsb_text: but this is what I commanded them: Obey Me, and I will be your God, and you will be My people. You must walk in all the ways I have commanded you, so that it may go well with you.
aov_text: Maar hierdie saak het Ek hulle beveel, naamlik: Luister na my stem, dan sal Ek vir julle ’n God wees, en julle sal vir My ’n volk wees; en wandel net in die weg wat Ek julle beveel, dat dit met julle goed kan gaan.

kjv_text: But they hearkened not, nor inclined their ear, but walked in the counsels and in the imagination of their evil heart, and went backward, and not forward.
bsb_text: Yet they did not listen or incline their ear, but they followed the stubborn inclinations of their own evil hearts. They went backward and not forward.
aov_text: Maar hulle het nie geluister en geen gehoor gegee nie, maar gewandel in wat hulle in die verharding van hul bose hart beraadslaag het, en hulle het agteruitgegaan en nie vooruit nie.

kjv_text: Since the day that your fathers came forth out of the land of Egypt unto this day I have even sent unto you all my servants the prophets, daily rising up early and sending them:
bsb_text: From the day your fathers came out of the land of Egypt until this day, I have sent you all My servants the prophets again and again.
aov_text: Van die dag af dat julle vaders uit Egipteland uitgetrek het tot vandag toe het Ek na julle al my knegte, die profete, gestuur, daagliks, vroeg en laat;

kjv_text: Yet they hearkened not unto me, nor inclined their ear, but hardened their neck: they did worse than their fathers.
bsb_text: Yet they would not listen to Me or incline their ear, but they stiffened their necks and did more evil than their fathers.
aov_text: maar hulle het na My nie geluister en geen gehoor gegee nie, maar hul nek verhard; hulle het dit erger gemaak as hul vaders.

kjv_text: Therefore thou shalt speak all these words unto them; but they will not hearken to thee: thou shalt also call unto them; but they will not answer thee.
bsb_text: When you tell them all these things, they will not listen to you. When you call to them, they will not answer.
aov_text: Ook moet jy al hierdie woorde aan hulle meedeel, maar hulle sal na jou nie luister nie; en jy moet na hulle roep, maar hulle sal jou nie antwoord nie.

kjv_text: But thou shalt say unto them, This is a nation that obeyeth not the voice of the LORD their God, nor receiveth correction: truth is perished, and is cut off from their mouth.
bsb_text: Therefore you must say to them, ‘This is the nation that would not listen to the voice of the LORD their God and would not receive correction. Truth has perished; it has disappeared from their lips.
aov_text: Sê dan vir hulle: Dit is die nasie wat na die stem van die HERE hulle God nie geluister het nie en die tugtiging nie aangeneem het nie; die opregtheid het verdwyn en is uitgeroei uit hulle mond.

kjv_text: Cut off thine hair, O Jerusalem, and cast it away, and take up a lamentation on high places; for the LORD hath rejected and forsaken the generation of his wrath.
bsb_text: Cut off your hair and throw it away. Raise up a lamentation on the barren heights, for the LORD has rejected and forsaken the generation of His wrath.’
aov_text: Skeer jou mooi hare af, o Jerusalem, en gooi dit weg, en hef op die kaal heuwels ’n klaaglied aan; want die HERE het die geslag van sy grimmigheid verwerp en verstoot.

kjv_text: For the children of Judah have done evil in my sight, saith the LORD: they have set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to pollute it.
bsb_text: For the people of Judah have done evil in My sight, declares the LORD. They have set up their abominations in the house that bears My Name, and so have defiled it.
aov_text: Want die kinders van Juda het gedoen wat verkeerd is in my oë, spreek die HERE. Hulle het hul verfoeisels gesit in die huis waaroor my Naam uitgeroep is, om dit te verontreinig.

kjv_text: And they have built the high places of Tophet, which is in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire; which I commanded them not, neither came it into my heart.
bsb_text: They have built the high places of Topheth in the Valley of Hinnom so they could burn their sons and daughters in the fire—something I never commanded, nor did it even enter My mind.
aov_text: En hulle het die hoogtes van Tofet gebou wat in die dal van die seun van Hinnom is, om hulle seuns en hulle dogters met vuur te verbrand—iets wat Ek nie beveel het nie en in my hart nie opgekom het nie.

kjv_text: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that it shall no more be called Tophet, nor the valley of the son of Hinnom, but the valley of slaughter: for they shall bury in Tophet, till there be no place.
bsb_text: So behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when this place will no longer be called Topheth and the Valley of Hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter. For they will bury the dead in Topheth until there is no more room.
aov_text: Daarom, kyk, daar kom dae, spreek die HERE, dat nie meer gesê sal word: Tofet en die dal van die seun van Hinnom nie, maar Moorddal. En hulle sal in Tofet begrawe, omdat daar geen plek sal wees nie.

kjv_text: And the carcases of this people shall be meat for the fowls of the heaven, and for the beasts of the earth; and none shall fray them away.
bsb_text: The corpses of this people will become food for the birds of the air and the beasts of the earth, and there will be no one to scare them away.
aov_text: En die lyke van hierdie volk sal dien as voedsel vir die voëls van die hemel en die diere van die aarde sonder dat iemand hulle skrikmaak.

kjv_text: Then will I cause to cease from the cities of Judah, and from the streets of Jerusalem, the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride: for the land shall be desolate.
bsb_text: I will remove from the cities of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem the sounds of joy and gladness and the voices of the bride and bridegroom, for the land will become a wasteland.”
aov_text: En Ek sal uit die stede van Juda en uit die strate van Jerusalem laat ophou die stem van vreugde en die stem van vrolikheid, die stem van die bruidegom en die stem van die bruid; want die land sal ’n puinhoop word.

kjv_text: At that time, saith the LORD, they shall bring out the bones of the kings of Judah, and the bones of his princes, and the bones of the priests, and the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, out of their graves:
bsb_text: “At that time,” declares the LORD, “the bones of the kings of Judah, the bones of the officials, the bones of the priests, the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the people of Jerusalem will be removed from their graves.
aov_text: IN dié tyd, spreek die HERE, sal hulle die bene van die konings van Juda en die bene van sy vorste en die bene van die priesters en die bene van die profete en die bene van die inwoners van Jerusalem uit hulle grafte uithaal,

kjv_text: And they shall spread them before the sun, and the moon, and all the host of heaven, whom they have loved, and whom they have served, and after whom they have walked, and whom they have sought, and whom they have worshipped: they shall not be gathered, nor be buried; they shall be for dung upon the face of the earth.
bsb_text: They will be exposed to the sun and moon, and to all the host of heaven which they have loved, served, followed, consulted, and worshiped. Their bones will not be gathered up or buried, but will become like dung lying on the ground.
aov_text: en hulle sal dit uitsprei voor die son en voor die maan en voor die hele leër van die hemel wat hulle liefgehad en gedien het, en waar hulle agter aan geloop het, en wat hulle gesoek en waarvoor hulle hul neergebuig het; dit sal nie versamel en begrawe word nie, mis sal dit op die aarde wees.

kjv_text: And death shall be chosen rather than life by all the residue of them that remain of this evil family, which remain in all the places whither I have driven them, saith the LORD of hosts.
bsb_text: And wherever I have banished them, the remnant of this evil family will choose death over life,” declares the LORD of Hosts.
aov_text: En die dood sal bo die lewe verkies word deur die hele oorblyfsel, die wat oor is van hierdie bose geslag in al die plekke waarheen Ek hulle verdryf het, spreek die HERE van die leërskare.

kjv_text: Moreover thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the LORD; Shall they fall, and not arise? shall he turn away, and not return?
bsb_text: So you are to tell them this is what the LORD says: “Do men fall and not get up again? Does one turn away and not return?
aov_text: EN jy moet vir hulle sê: So spreek die HERE: Sal iemand val en nie weer opstaan nie? Of sal hy weggaan en nie weer terugkom nie?

kjv_text: Why then is this people of Jerusalem slidden back by a perpetual backsliding? they hold fast deceit, they refuse to return.
bsb_text: Why then have these people turned away? Why does Jerusalem always turn away? They cling to deceit; they refuse to return.
aov_text: Waarom is dan hierdie volk, Jerusalem, afkerig met ’n aanhoudende afkerigheid? Hulle hou vas aan bedrog, hulle weier om terug te keer.

kjv_text: I hearkened and heard, but they spake not aright: no man repented him of his wickedness, saying, What have I done? every one turned to his course, as the horse rusheth into the battle.
bsb_text: I have listened and heard; they do not speak what is right. No one repents of his wickedness, asking, ‘What have I done?’ Everyone has pursued his own course like a horse charging into battle.
aov_text: Ek het geluister en gehoor: hulle spreek wat nie reg is nie; daar is niemand wat berou het oor sy boosheid, dat hy sou sê: Wat het ek gedoen nie? Elkeen spring weg in sy loop soos ’n perd wat storm in die geveg.

kjv_text: Yea, the stork in the heaven knoweth her appointed times; and the turtle and the crane and the swallow observe the time of their coming; but my people know not the judgment of the LORD.
bsb_text: Even the stork in the sky knows her appointed seasons. The turtledove, the swift, and the thrush keep their time of migration, but My people do not know the requirements of the LORD.
aov_text: Selfs ’n groot sprinkaanvoël aan die hemel ken sy bepaalde tye, en ’n tortelduif en ’n swaweltjie en ’n kraanvoël neem die tyd van hulle koms in ag; maar my volk ken die reg van die HERE nie.

kjv_text: How do ye say, We are wise, and the law of the LORD is with us? Lo, certainly in vain made he it; the pen of the scribes is in vain.
bsb_text: How can you say, ‘We are wise, and the Law of the LORD is with us,’ when in fact the lying pen of the scribes has produced a deception?
aov_text: Hoe durf julle sê: Ons is wys, en die wet van die HERE is by ons? Waarlik, kyk, bedrieglik werk die leuenpen van die skrywers.

kjv_text: The wise men are ashamed, they are dismayed and taken: lo, they have rejected the word of the LORD; and what wisdom is in them?
bsb_text: The wise will be put to shame; they will be dismayed and trapped. Since they have rejected the word of the LORD, what wisdom do they really have?
aov_text: Die slim mense kom in die skande, is verslae en verstrik. Kyk, hulle het die woord van die HERE verwerp, en watter wysheid sou hulle hê?

kjv_text: Therefore will I give their wives unto others, and their fields to them that shall inherit them: for every one from the least even unto the greatest is given to covetousness, from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely.
bsb_text: Therefore I will give their wives to other men and their fields to new owners. For from the least of them to the greatest, all are greedy for gain; from prophet to priest, all practice deceit.
aov_text: Daarom sal Ek hulle vroue aan ander gee, hulle landerye aan veroweraars; want van die kleinste tot die grootste maak hulle almal onregverdige wins; van die profeet tot die priester pleeg hulle almal bedrog.

kjv_text: For they have healed the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace.
bsb_text: They dress the wound of the daughter of My people with very little care, saying, ‘Peace, peace,’ when there is no peace at all.
aov_text: En hulle genees die verbreking van die dogter van my volk op die maklikste manier deur te sê: Vrede, vrede!—terwyl daar geen vrede is nie.

kjv_text: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore shall they fall among them that fall: in the time of their visitation they shall be cast down, saith the LORD.
bsb_text: Are they ashamed of the abomination they have committed? No, they have no shame at all; they do not even know how to blush. So they will fall among the fallen; when I punish them, they will collapse, says the LORD.
aov_text: Hulle kom in die skande, omdat hulle gruwel bedryf het, tog skaam hulle hul nie in die minste nie en weet nie om te bloos nie. Daarom sal hulle val onder die wat val; in die tyd van hulle besoeking sal hulle struikel, sê die HERE.

kjv_text: I will surely consume them, saith the LORD: there shall be no grapes on the vine, nor figs on the fig tree, and the leaf shall fade; and the things that I have given them shall pass away from them.
bsb_text: I will take away their harvest, declares the LORD. There will be no grapes on the vine, nor figs on the tree, and even the leaf will wither. Whatever I have given them will be lost to them.”
aov_text: Saamskraap, wegraap sal Ek hulle, spreek die HERE. Daar is geen druiwe aan die wingerdstok en geen vye aan die vyeboom nie, ja, die blare verdor. So het Ek ook vir hulle dié bestel wat dwarsoor hulle sal gaan.

kjv_text: Why do we sit still? assemble yourselves, and let us enter into the defenced cities, and let us be silent there: for the LORD our God hath put us to silence, and given us water of gall to drink, because we have sinned against the LORD.
bsb_text: Why are we just sitting here? Gather together, let us flee to the fortified cities and perish there, for the LORD our God has doomed us. He has given us poisoned water to drink, because we have sinned against the LORD.
aov_text: Waarom bly ons sit? Kom bymekaar, en laat ons in die versterkte stede ingaan en daar omkom; want die HERE onse God laat ons omkom, en Hy laat ons gifwater drink, omdat ons teen die HERE gesondig het.

kjv_text: We looked for peace, but no good came; and for a time of health, and behold trouble!
bsb_text: We hoped for peace, but no good has come, for a time of healing, but there was only terror.
aov_text: Hulle wag op vrede, maar daar is niks goeds nie; op ’n tyd van beterskap, maar kyk, daar is verskrikking.

kjv_text: The snorting of his horses was heard from Dan: the whole land trembled at the sound of the neighing of his strong ones; for they are come, and have devoured the land, and all that is in it; the city, and those that dwell therein.
bsb_text: The snorting of enemy horses is heard from Dan. At the sound of the neighing of mighty steeds, the whole land quakes. They come to devour the land and everything in it, the city and all who dwell in it.
aov_text: Van Dan af word die gesnuif van sy perde gehoor, vir die geluid van die gerunnik van sy perde bewe die hele land; en hulle kom en eet die land op en sy volheid, die stad en die wat daarin woon.

kjv_text: For, behold, I will send serpents, cockatrices, among you, which will not be charmed, and they shall bite you, saith the LORD.
bsb_text: “For behold, I will send snakes among you, vipers that cannot be charmed, and they will bite you,” declares the LORD.
aov_text: Want kyk, Ek stuur slange, basiliske onder julle waarteen daar geen beswering is nie, en hulle sal julle byt, spreek die HERE.

kjv_text: When I would comfort myself against sorrow, my heart is faint in me.
bsb_text: My sorrow is beyond healing; my heart is faint within me.
aov_text: Ag, kon ek my maar opvrolik in kommer! My hart is krank in my.

kjv_text: Behold the voice of the cry of the daughter of my people because of them that dwell in a far country: Is not the LORD in Zion? is not her king in her? Why have they provoked me to anger with their graven images, and with strange vanities?
bsb_text: Listen to the cry of the daughter of my people from a land far away: “Is the LORD no longer in Zion? Is her King no longer there?” “Why have they provoked Me to anger with their carved images, with their worthless foreign idols?”
aov_text: Daar is die hulpgeroep van die dogter van my volk uit ’n baie ver land: Is die HERE nie in Sion nie? Of is sy Koning nie daarin nie? Waarom het hulle My geterg met hulle gesnede beelde, met vreemde, nietige afgode?

kjv_text: The harvest is past, the summer is ended, and we are not saved.
bsb_text: “The harvest has passed, the summer has ended, but we have not been saved.”
aov_text: Die oes is verby, die somer is ten einde, en óns is nie verlos nie!

kjv_text: For the hurt of the daughter of my people am I hurt; I am black; astonishment hath taken hold on me.
bsb_text: For the brokenness of the daughter of my people I am crushed. I mourn; horror has gripped me.
aov_text: Vanweë die verbreking van die dogter van my volk is ek gebreek, is ek in die rou; verbaasdheid het my aangegryp.

kjv_text: Is there no balm in Gilead; is there no physician there? why then is not the health of the daughter of my people recovered?
bsb_text: Is there no balm in Gilead? Is no physician there? Why then has the health of the daughter of my people not been restored?
aov_text: Is daar geen balsem in Gílead nie? Of is daar geen geneesheer nie? Want waarom het die genesing van die dogter van my volk nie tot stand gekom nie?

kjv_text: Oh that my head were waters, and mine eyes a fountain of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people!
bsb_text: Oh, that my head were a spring of water, and my eyes a fountain of tears! I would weep day and night over the slain daughter of my people.
aov_text: AG, was my hoof maar water en my oog ’n fontein van trane! Dan sou ek dag en nag beween die wat verslaan is van die dogter van my volk.

kjv_text: Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men; that I might leave my people, and go from them! for they be all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.
bsb_text: If only I had a traveler’s lodge in the wilderness, I would abandon my people and depart from them, for they are all adulterers, a crowd of faithless people.
aov_text: Ag, het ek in die woestyn maar ’n herberg vir reisigers gehad! Dan sou ek my volk verlaat en van hulle af wegtrek; want hulle is almal owerspelers, ’n hoop ontroue mense.

kjv_text: And they bend their tongues like their bow for lies: but they are not valiant for the truth upon the earth; for they proceed from evil to evil, and they know not me, saith the LORD.
bsb_text: “They bend their tongues like bows; lies prevail over truth in the land. For they proceed from evil to evil, and they do not take Me into account,” declares the LORD.
aov_text: En hulle span hulle tong, soos hulle boog, met leuens, en nie volgens waarheid is hulle magtig in die land nie; want van boosheid tot boosheid gaan hulle voort, maar My ken hulle nie, spreek die HERE.

kjv_text: Take ye heed every one of his neighbour, and trust ye not in any brother: for every brother will utterly supplant, and every neighbour will walk with slanders.
bsb_text: “Let everyone guard against his neighbor; do not trust any brother, for every brother deals craftily, and every friend spreads slander.
aov_text: Pas op, elkeen vir sy vriend, en vertrou op geen broer nie; want elke broer is net ’n onderkruiper, en elke vriend gaan om met kwaadsprekery.

kjv_text: And they will deceive every one his neighbour, and will not speak the truth: they have taught their tongue to speak lies, and weary themselves to commit iniquity.
bsb_text: Each one betrays his friend; no one tells the truth. They have taught their tongues to lie; they wear themselves out committing iniquity.
aov_text: En hulle bedrieg elkeen sy vriend en praat nie die waarheid nie; hulle het hul tong geleer om leuens te praat, hulle maak hul moeg met verdraaiery.

kjv_text: Thine habitation is in the midst of deceit; through deceit they refuse to know me, saith the LORD.
bsb_text: You dwell in the midst of deception; in their deceit they refuse to know Me,” declares the LORD.
aov_text: Jou woning is in die midde van bedrog; deur bedrog weier hulle om My te ken, spreek die HERE.

kjv_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, Behold, I will melt them, and try them; for how shall I do for the daughter of my people?
bsb_text: Therefore this is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Behold, I will refine them and test them, for what else can I do because of the daughter of My people?
aov_text: Daarom, so sê die HERE van die leërskare: Kyk, Ek smelt hulle en toets hulle; want hoe sou Ek anders handel vanweë die dogter van my volk?

kjv_text: Their tongue is as an arrow shot out; it speaketh deceit: one speaketh peaceably to his neighbour with his mouth, but in heart he layeth his wait.
bsb_text: Their tongues are deadly arrows; they speak deception. With his mouth a man speaks peace to his neighbor, but in his heart he sets a trap for him.
aov_text: Hulle tong is ’n moordpyl; dit spreek bedrog; met die mond spreek hulle van vrede met hul naaste, maar in hul binneste beraam hulle listige planne.

kjv_text: Shall I not visit them for these things? saith the LORD: shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
bsb_text: Should I not punish them for these things? declares the LORD. Should I not avenge Myself on such a nation as this?”
aov_text: Sou Ek hieroor aan hulle geen besoeking doen nie? spreek die HERE. Of sou my siel hom nie wreek op ’n nasie soos hierdie een nie?

kjv_text: For the mountains will I take up a weeping and wailing, and for the habitations of the wilderness a lamentation, because they are burned up, so that none can pass through them; neither can men hear the voice of the cattle; both the fowl of the heavens and the beast are fled; they are gone.
bsb_text: I will take up a weeping and wailing for the mountains, a dirge over the wilderness pasture, for they have been scorched so no one passes through, and the lowing of cattle is not heard. Both the birds of the air and the beasts have fled; they have gone away.
aov_text: Ek sal geween en geklaag aanhef oor die berge en ’n klaaglied oor die weivelde van die woestyn; want hulle is verwoes, sodat niemand daar deurtrek nie, en ’n mens hoor geen geluid van vee nie; die voëls van die hemel sowel as die diere—hulle het gevlug, weggetrek.

kjv_text: And I will make Jerusalem heaps, and a den of dragons; and I will make the cities of Judah desolate, without an inhabitant.
bsb_text: “And I will make Jerusalem a heap of rubble, a haunt for jackals; and I will make the cities of Judah a desolation, without inhabitant.”
aov_text: En Ek sal Jerusalem maak tot kliphope, ’n lêplek van jakkalse; en die stede van Juda sal Ek ’n woesteny maak, sonder inwoner.

kjv_text: Who is the wise man, that may understand this? and who is he to whom the mouth of the LORD hath spoken, that he may declare it, for what the land perisheth and is burned up like a wilderness, that none passeth through?
bsb_text: Who is the man wise enough to understand this? To whom has the mouth of the LORD spoken, that he may explain it? Why is the land destroyed and scorched like a desert, so no one can pass through it?
aov_text: Wie is die wyse man wat dit kan verstaan? En met wie het die mond van die HERE gespreek, dat hy dit kan verkondig? Waarom het die land te gronde gegaan, is dit verwoes soos die woestyn, sodat niemand daar deurtrek nie?

kjv_text: And the LORD saith, Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them, and have not obeyed my voice, neither walked therein;
bsb_text: And the LORD answered, “It is because they have forsaken My law, which I set before them; they have not walked in it or obeyed My voice.
aov_text: En die HERE het gesê: Omdat hulle my wet wat Ek hulle voorgehou het, verlaat het en na my stem nie geluister en daarin nie gewandel het nie,

kjv_text: But have walked after the imagination of their own heart, and after Baalim, which their fathers taught them:
bsb_text: Instead, they have followed the stubbornness of their hearts and gone after the Baals, as their fathers taught them.”
aov_text: maar gewandel het agter die verhardheid van hulle hart en agter die Baäls aan, waaraan hulle vaders hulle gewend gemaak het,

kjv_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will feed them, even this people, with wormwood, and give them water of gall to drink.
bsb_text: Therefore this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: “Behold, I will feed this people wormwood and give them poisoned water to drink.

kjv_text: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will punish all them which are circumcised with the uncircumcised;
bsb_text: “Behold, the days are coming,” declares the LORD, “when I will punish all who are circumcised yet uncircumcised:
aov_text: Kyk, daar kom dae, spreek die HERE, dat Ek besoeking sal doen oor almal wat besny is, wat nogtans onbesnede is:

kjv_text: For the customs of the people are vain: for one cutteth a tree out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman, with the axe.

aov_text: Hulle versier dit met silwer en goud, hulle maak dit vas met spykers en hamers, dat dit nie waggel nie.

kjv_text: They are upright as the palm tree, but speak not: they must needs be borne, because they cannot go. Be not afraid of them; for they cannot do evil, neither also is it in them to do good.
bsb_text: Like scarecrows in a cucumber patch, their idols cannot speak. They must be carried because they cannot walk. Do not fear them, for they can do no harm, and neither can they do any good.”
aov_text: Soos ’n voëlverskrikker in ’n komkommertuin is hulle: hulle kan nie praat nie; ja, hulle moet gedra word, want hulle kan nie loop nie. Wees nie bevrees vir hulle nie, want hulle kan geen kwaad doen nie, maar daar is ook geen goeddoen by hulle nie.

kjv_text: Forasmuch as there is none like unto thee, O LORD; thou art great, and thy name is great in might.
bsb_text: There is none like You, O LORD. You are great, and Your name is mighty in power.

bsb_text: Who would not fear You, O King of nations? This is Your due. For among all the wise men of the nations, and in all their kingdoms, there is none like You.
aov_text: Wie sou U nie vrees nie, o Koning van die nasies? Want U kom dit toe; want onder al die wyse manne van die nasies en in hulle hele koninkryk is geeneen soos U nie.

kjv_text: But they are altogether brutish and foolish: the stock is a doctrine of vanities.

aov_text: Maar almal saam word hulle dom en dwaas, die tugtiging van die nietige afgode—dit is hout.

bsb_text: Hammered silver is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz—the work of a craftsman from the hands of a goldsmith. Their clothes are blue and purple, all fashioned by skilled workers.
aov_text: Silwer wat plat geslaan is, word uit Tarsis gebring en goud uit Ufas, die werk van die ambagsman en van die hande van die goudsmid; pers en purperrooi is hulle klere; ’n werk van kunstenaars is hulle almal.

kjv_text: But the LORD is the true God, he is the living God, and an everlasting king: at his wrath the earth shall tremble, and the nations shall not be able to abide his indignation.
bsb_text: But the LORD is the true God; He is the living God and eternal King. The earth quakes at His wrath, and the nations cannot endure His indignation.

kjv_text: Thus shall ye say unto them, The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth, even they shall perish from the earth, and from under these heavens.

aov_text: Hy wat die aarde gemaak het deur sy krag, wat die wêreld gegrond het deur sy wysheid en die hemel uitgespan het deur sy verstand.

kjv_text: Every man is brutish in his knowledge: every founder is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.

kjv_text: And the LORD hath given me knowledge of it, and I know it: then thou shewedst me their doings.
