aov_text: Maar ek was soos ’n mak lam wat hulle lei om te slag; en ek het nie geweet dat hulle planne teen my beraam het nie: Laat ons die boom met sy vrugte verwoes, en laat ons hom uitroei uit die land van die lewendes, sodat aan sy naam nie meer gedink word nie!

kjv_text: But, O LORD of hosts, that judgest righteously, that triest the reins and the heart, let me see thy vengeance on them: for unto thee have I revealed my cause.
bsb_text: O LORD of Hosts, who judges righteously, who examines the heart and mind, let me see Your vengeance upon them, for to You I have committed my cause.
aov_text: Maar, o HERE van die leërskare, regverdige Regter, wat niere en hart toets, laat my u wraak op hulle sien, want aan U het ek my regsaak toevertrou.

kjv_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD of the men of Anathoth, that seek thy life, saying, Prophesy not in the name of the LORD, that thou die not by our hand:
bsb_text: Therefore this is what the LORD says concerning the people of Anathoth who are seeking your life and saying, “You must not prophesy in the name of the LORD, or you will die by our hand.”
aov_text: Daarom, so spreek die HERE aangaande die manne van Ánatot wat jou lewe soek en sê: Jy mag nie profeteer in die Naam van die HERE nie, anders sal jy sterwe deur ons hand —

kjv_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, Behold, I will punish them: the young men shall die by the sword; their sons and their daughters shall die by famine:
bsb_text: So this is what the LORD of Hosts says: “I will punish them. Their young men will die by the sword, their sons and daughters by famine.
aov_text: daarom, so spreek die HERE van die leërskare: Kyk, Ek doen besoeking oor hulle; die jongmanne sal sterwe deur die swaard, hulle seuns en hulle dogters sal sterwe deur hongersnood,

kjv_text: And there shall be no remnant of them: for I will bring evil upon the men of Anathoth, even the year of their visitation.
bsb_text: There will be no remnant, for I will bring disaster on the people of Anathoth in the year of their punishment.”
aov_text: en hulle sal geen oorblyfsel hê nie; want Ek sal onheil bring oor die manne van Ánatot in die jaar van hulle besoeking.

kjv_text: Righteous art thou, O LORD, when I plead with thee: yet let me talk with thee of thy judgments: Wherefore doth the way of the wicked prosper? wherefore are all they happy that deal very treacherously?
bsb_text: Righteous are You, O LORD, when I plead before You. Yet about Your judgments I wish to contend with You: Why does the way of the wicked prosper? Why do all the faithless live at ease?
aov_text: REGVERDIG is U, o HERE, as ek met U sou twis. Tog wil ek oor regsake met U spreek: Waarom is die weg van die goddelose voorspoedig? Waarom lewe hulle rustig, almal wat ontrou bedrywe?

kjv_text: Thou hast planted them, yea, they have taken root: they grow, yea, they bring forth fruit: thou art near in their mouth, and far from their reins.
bsb_text: You planted them, and they have taken root. They have grown and produced fruit. You are ever on their lips, but far from their hearts.
aov_text: U het hulle geplant, ook het hulle wortel geskiet; hulle groei, ook dra hulle vrugte. U is naby in hulle mond, maar ver van hulle niere.

kjv_text: But thou, O LORD, knowest me: thou hast seen me, and tried mine heart toward thee: pull them out like sheep for the slaughter, and prepare them for the day of slaughter.
bsb_text: But You know me, O LORD; You see me and test my heart toward You. Drag away the wicked like sheep to the slaughter and set them apart for the day of carnage.
aov_text: Maar U, o HERE, ken my; U sien my en toets my hart by U. Ruk hulle weg soos slagskape, en heilig hulle vir die dag van slagting.

kjv_text: How long shall the land mourn, and the herbs of every field wither, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein? the beasts are consumed, and the birds; because they said, He shall not see our last end.
bsb_text: How long will the land mourn and the grass of every field be withered? Because of the evil of its residents, the animals and birds have been swept away, for the people have said, “He cannot see what our end will be.”
aov_text: Hoe lank sal die land treur en die plante van die hele veld verdor? Vanweë die boosheid van die wat daarin woon, vergaan diere en voëls; omdat hulle sê: Hy sal ons einde nie sien nie!

kjv_text: If thou hast run with the footmen, and they have wearied thee, then how canst thou contend with horses? and if in the land of peace, wherein thou trustedst, they wearied thee, then how wilt thou do in the swelling of Jordan?
bsb_text: “If you have raced with men on foot and they have worn you out, how can you compete with horses? If you stumble in a peaceful land, how will you do in the thickets of the Jordan?
aov_text: As jy met voetgangers loop, maak hulle jou moeg: hoe sal jy dan wedywer met die perde? En in ’n land van vrede voel jy jou veilig: hoe sal jy dan maak in die pronkbosse van die Jordaan?

kjv_text: For even thy brethren, and the house of thy father, even they have dealt treacherously with thee; yea, they have called a multitude after thee: believe them not, though they speak fair words unto thee.
bsb_text: Even your brothers—your own father’s household—even they have betrayed you; even they have cried aloud against you. Do not trust them, though they speak well of you.
aov_text: Want ook jou broers en die huis van jou vader, ook hulle het troueloos teen jou gehandel; ook hulle roep jou hardop agterna. Glo hulle nie as hulle vriendelik met jou spreek nie.

kjv_text: I have forsaken mine house, I have left mine heritage; I have given the dearly beloved of my soul into the hand of her enemies.
bsb_text: I have forsaken My house; I have abandoned My inheritance. I have given the love of My life into the hands of her enemies.
aov_text: EK het my huis verlaat, Ek het my erfenis verwerp, Ek het die beminde van my siel in die hand van haar vyande gegee.

kjv_text: Mine heritage is unto me as a lion in the forest; it crieth out against me: therefore have I hated it.
bsb_text: My inheritance has become to Me like a lion in the forest. She has roared against Me; therefore I hate her.
aov_text: My erfenis het vir My geword soos ’n leeu in die bos; dit het sy stem teen My verhef; daarom het Ek dit gehaat.

kjv_text: Mine heritage is unto me as a speckled bird, the birds round about are against her; come ye, assemble all the beasts of the field, come to devour.
bsb_text: Is not My inheritance to Me like a speckled bird of prey with other birds of prey circling against her? Go, gather all the beasts of the field; bring them to devour her.
aov_text: Is my erfenis dan vir My ’n bont roofvoël? Is daar roofvoëls rondom teen hom? Kom, maak al die wilde diere van die veld bymekaar, laat hulle kom om te eet.

kjv_text: Many pastors have destroyed my vineyard, they have trodden my portion under foot, they have made my pleasant portion a desolate wilderness.
bsb_text: Many shepherds have destroyed My vineyard; they have trampled My plot of ground. They have turned My pleasant field into a desolate wasteland.
aov_text: Baie herders het my wingerd verniel, hulle het my stuk land vertrap, hulle het my begeerlike stuk land ’n woeste wildernis gemaak,

kjv_text: They have made it desolate, and being desolate it mourneth unto me; the whole land is made desolate, because no man layeth it to heart.
bsb_text: They have made it a desolation; desolate before Me, it mourns. All the land is laid waste, but no man takes it to heart.
aov_text: hulle het dit ’n wildernis gemaak; dit treur voor My, verwoes; die hele land is verwoes, omdat daar niemand is wat dit ter harte neem nie.

kjv_text: The spoilers are come upon all high places through the wilderness: for the sword of the LORD shall devour from the one end of the land even to the other end of the land: no flesh shall have peace.
bsb_text: Over all the barren heights in the wilderness the destroyers have come, for the sword of the LORD devours from one end of the earth to the other. No flesh has peace.
aov_text: Op al die kaal heuwels in die woestyn het verwoesters gekom, want die swaard van die HERE verteer van die een end van die land tot die ander end van die land; daar is geen vrede vir enige vlees nie.

kjv_text: They have sown wheat, but shall reap thorns: they have put themselves to pain, but shall not profit: and they shall be ashamed of your revenues because of the fierce anger of the LORD.
bsb_text: They have sown wheat but harvested thorns. They have exhausted themselves to no avail. Bear the shame of your harvest because of the fierce anger of the LORD.”
aov_text: Hulle het koring gesaai, maar dorings gemaai; hulle het hul uitgeput sonder om baat te vind. Staan dan beskaamd oor julle inkomste, vanweë die toorngloed van die HERE.

kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD against all mine evil neighbours, that touch the inheritance which I have caused my people Israel to inherit; Behold, I will pluck them out of their land, and pluck out the house of Judah from among them.
bsb_text: This is what the LORD says: “As for all My evil neighbors who attack the inheritance that I bequeathed to My people Israel, I am about to uproot them from their land, and I will uproot the house of Judah from among them.
aov_text: So sê die HERE: Aangaande al my goddelose bure wat die erfenis aantas wat Ek my volk Israel laat erf het—kyk, Ek ruk hulle uit hul land uit, en die huis van Juda sal Ek uit hulle midde wegruk.

kjv_text: And it shall come to pass, after that I have plucked them out I will return, and have compassion on them, and will bring them again, every man to his heritage, and every man to his land.
bsb_text: But after I have uprooted them, I will once again have compassion on them and return each one to his inheritance and to his land.
aov_text: Maar nadat Ek hulle uitgeruk het, sal Ek My weer oor hulle ontferm; en Ek sal hulle terugbring, elkeen na sy erfenis en elkeen na sy land.

kjv_text: And it shall come to pass, if they will diligently learn the ways of my people, to swear by my name, The LORD liveth; as they taught my people to swear by Baal; then shall they be built in the midst of my people.
bsb_text: And if they will diligently learn the ways of My people and swear by My name, saying, ‘As surely as the LORD lives’—just as they once taught My people to swear by Baal—then they will be established among My people.
aov_text: En as hulle ywerig die weë van my volk leer om te sweer by my Naam: So waar as die HERE leef, soos hulle my volk geleer het om te sweer by Baäl—dan sal hulle onder my volk gebou word.

kjv_text: But if they will not obey, I will utterly pluck up and destroy that nation, saith the LORD.
bsb_text: But if they will not obey, then I will uproot that nation; I will uproot it and destroy it, declares the LORD.”
aov_text: Maar as hulle nie luister nie, dan sal Ek dié nasie heeltemal uitruk en tot niet maak, spreek die HERE.

kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD unto me, Go and get thee a linen girdle, and put it upon thy loins, and put it not in water.
bsb_text: This is what the LORD said to me: “Go and buy yourself a linen loincloth and put it around your waist, but do not let it touch water.”
aov_text: SO het die HERE vir my gesê: Gaan koop vir jou ’n linnegord en bind dit om jou heupe; maar laat dit nie in die water kom nie.

kjv_text: So I got a girdle according to the word of the LORD, and put it on my loins.
bsb_text: So I bought a loincloth as the LORD had instructed me, and I put it around my waist.
aov_text: En ek het die gord gekoop volgens die woord van die HERE en dit om my heupe gebind.

kjv_text: And the word of the LORD came unto me the second time, saying,
bsb_text: Then the word of the LORD came to me a second time:
aov_text: Toe het die woord van die HERE vir die tweede keer tot my gekom en gesê:

kjv_text: Take the girdle that thou hast got, which is upon thy loins, and arise, go to Euphrates, and hide it there in a hole of the rock.
bsb_text: “Take the loincloth that you bought and are wearing, and go at once to Perath and hide it there in a crevice of the rocks.”
aov_text: Neem die gord wat jy gekoop het, wat om jou heupe is, en maak klaar, gaan na die Eufraat en steek dit daar weg in ’n klipskeur.

kjv_text: So I went, and hid it by Euphrates, as the LORD commanded me.
bsb_text: So I went and hid it at Perath, as the LORD had commanded me.
aov_text: Daarop het ek gegaan en dit weggesteek by die Eufraat, soos die HERE my beveel het.

kjv_text: And it came to pass after many days, that the LORD said unto me, Arise, go to Euphrates, and take the girdle from thence, which I commanded thee to hide there.
bsb_text: Many days later the LORD said to me, “Arise, go to Perath, and get the loincloth that I commanded you to hide there.”
aov_text: En ná verloop van baie dae het die HERE vir my gesê: Maak klaar, gaan na die Eufraat en haal die gord daarvandaan wat Ek jou beveel het om daar weg te steek.

kjv_text: Then I went to Euphrates, and digged, and took the girdle from the place where I had hid it: and, behold, the girdle was marred, it was profitable for nothing.
bsb_text: So I went to Perath and dug up the loincloth, and I took it from the place where I had hidden it. But now it was ruined—of no use at all.
aov_text: Daarop het ek na die Eufraat gegaan en gegrawe en die gord geneem van die plek af waar ek dit weggesteek het; en kyk, die gord het bederf, dit was waardeloos.

kjv_text: Then the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
bsb_text: Then the word of the LORD came to me:
aov_text: Toe het die woord van die HERE tot my gekom en gesê:

kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD, After this manner will I mar the pride of Judah, and the great pride of Jerusalem.
bsb_text: “This is what the LORD says: In the same way I will ruin the pride of Judah and the great pride of Jerusalem.
aov_text: So spreek die HERE: So sal Ek laat bederwe die hoogmoed van Juda en dié van Jerusalem, wat so groot is.

kjv_text: This evil people, which refuse to hear my words, which walk in the imagination of their heart, and walk after other gods, to serve them, and to worship them, shall even be as this girdle, which is good for nothing.
bsb_text: These evil people, who refuse to listen to My words, who follow the stubbornness of their own hearts, and who go after other gods to serve and worship them, they will be like this loincloth—of no use at all.
aov_text: Hierdie goddelose volk wat weier om na my woorde te luister, wat wandel in die verharding van hulle hart en agter ander gode aan loop om hulle te dien en hul daarvoor neer te buig—hulle moet word soos hierdie gord wat waardeloos is.

kjv_text: For as the girdle cleaveth to the loins of a man, so have I caused to cleave unto me the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah, saith the LORD; that they might be unto me for a people, and for a name, and for a praise, and for a glory: but they would not hear.
bsb_text: For just as a loincloth clings to a man’s waist, so I have made the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah cling to Me, declares the LORD, so that they might be My people for My renown and praise and glory. But they did not listen.
aov_text: Want soos die gord kleef aan die heupe van ’n man, so het Ek die hele huis van Israel en die hele huis van Juda aan My laat klewe, spreek die HERE, om vir My te wees ’n volk en ’n roem en ’n lof en ’n sieraad; maar hulle het nie geluister nie.

kjv_text: Therefore thou shalt speak unto them this word; Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Every bottle shall be filled with wine: and they shall say unto thee, Do we not certainly know that every bottle shall be filled with wine?
bsb_text: Therefore you are to tell them that this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Every wineskin shall be filled with wine.’ And when they reply, ‘Don’t we surely know that every wineskin should be filled with wine?’
aov_text: Sê verder aan hulle hierdie woord: So spreek die HERE, die God van Israel: Elke kan word vol wyn gemaak. Dan sal hulle vir jou sê: Weet ons dit dan nie dat elke kan vol wyn gemaak word nie?

kjv_text: Then shalt thou say unto them, Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will fill all the inhabitants of this land, even the kings that sit upon David's throne, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, with drunkenness.
bsb_text: then you are to tell them that this is what the LORD says: ‘I am going to fill with drunkenness all who live in this land—the kings who sit on David’s throne, the priests, the prophets, and all the people of Jerusalem.
aov_text: Maar jy moet vir hulle sê: So spreek die HERE: Kyk, Ek vul met dronkenskap al die inwoners van hierdie land, selfs die konings wat op die troon van Dawid sit, en die priesters en die profete en al die inwoners van Jerusalem.

kjv_text: And I will dash them one against another, even the fathers and the sons together, saith the LORD: I will not pity, nor spare, nor have mercy, but destroy them.
bsb_text: I will smash them against one another, fathers and sons alike, declares the LORD. I will allow no mercy or pity or compassion to keep Me from destroying them.’”
aov_text: En Ek sal hulle verbrysel, die een teen die ander, die vaders en die kinders almal saam, spreek die HERE. Ek sal nie spaar of verskoon of My ontferm nie, dat Ek hulle nie sou verdelg nie.

kjv_text: Hear ye, and give ear; be not proud: for the LORD hath spoken.
bsb_text: Listen and give heed. Do not be arrogant, for the LORD has spoken.
aov_text: Luister en merk op; verhef julle nie, want die HERE het gespreek!

kjv_text: Give glory to the LORD your God, before he cause darkness, and before your feet stumble upon the dark mountains, and, while ye look for light, he turn it into the shadow of death, and make it gross darkness.
bsb_text: Give glory to the LORD your God before He brings darkness, before your feet stumble on the dusky mountains. You wait for light, but He turns it into deep gloom and thick darkness.
aov_text: Gee eer aan die HERE julle God voordat Hy dit donker laat word en voordat julle voete stamp teen die berge in die skemering; terwyl julle wag op lig, maar Hy dit doodskaduwee maak, in donkerheid verander.

kjv_text: But if ye will not hear it, my soul shall weep in secret places for your pride; and mine eye shall weep sore, and run down with tears, because the LORD's flock is carried away captive.
bsb_text: But if you do not listen, I will weep in secret because of your pride. My eyes will overflow with tears, because the LORD’s flock has been taken captive.
aov_text: Maar as julle daar nie na luister nie, sal my siel in skuilplekke ween vanweë die hoogmoed; en my oog sal bitterlik huil en afloop in trane, omdat die kudde van die HERE as gevangenes weggevoer is.

kjv_text: Say unto the king and to the queen, Humble yourselves, sit down: for your principalities shall come down, even the crown of your glory.
bsb_text: Say to the king and to the queen mother: “Take a lowly seat, for your glorious crowns have fallen from your heads.”
aov_text: Sê aan die koning en aan die gebiedster: Gaan baie laag sit, want julle hoofsieraad, julle sierlike kroon, het geval.

kjv_text: The cities of the south shall be shut up, and none shall open them: Judah shall be carried away captive all of it, it shall be wholly carried away captive.
bsb_text: The cities of the Negev have been shut tight, and no one can open them. All Judah has been carried into exile, wholly taken captive.
aov_text: Die stede van die Suidland is toegesluit, en niemand maak oop nie; Juda is in ballingskap weggevoer gans en al, weggevoer volkome!

kjv_text: Lift up your eyes, and behold them that come from the north: where is the flock that was given thee, thy beautiful flock?
bsb_text: Lift up your eyes and see those coming from the north. Where is the flock entrusted to you, the sheep that were your pride?
aov_text: Hef jou oë op, en aanskou die wat uit die noorde kom. Waar is die kudde wat aan jou gegee is, jou pragtige trop kleinvee?

kjv_text: What wilt thou say when he shall punish thee? for thou hast taught them to be captains, and as chief over thee: shall not sorrows take thee, as a woman in travail?
bsb_text: What will you say when He sets over you close allies whom you yourself trained? Will not pangs of anguish grip you, as they do a woman in labor?
aov_text: Wat sal jy sê wanneer Hy as hoof oor jou aanstel diegene wat jy self geleer het om jou vertroude vriende te wees? Sal weë jou nie aangryp soos van ’n barende vrou nie?

kjv_text: And if thou say in thine heart, Wherefore come these things upon me? For the greatness of thine iniquity are thy skirts discovered, and thy heels made bare.
bsb_text: And if you ask yourself, “Why has this happened to me?” It is because of the magnitude of your iniquity that your skirts have been stripped off and your body has been exposed.
aov_text: As jy dan in jou hart sê: Waarom het hierdie dinge my oorgekom? Weens die grootheid van jou ongeregtigheid is jou slippe opgetel, het jou hakskene gely onder geweld.

kjv_text: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? then may ye also do good, that are accustomed to do evil.
bsb_text: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? Neither are you able to do good—you who are accustomed to doing evil.
aov_text: Kan ’n Kusiet sy vel verander of ’n luiperd sy vlekke? Dan sal julle ook in staat wees om goed te doen, julle wat gewend is om kwaad te doen.

kjv_text: Therefore will I scatter them as the stubble that passeth away by the wind of the wilderness.
bsb_text: “I will scatter you like chaff driven by the desert wind.
aov_text: Daarom sal Ek hulle verstrooi soos ’n stoppel wat verbyvlieg voor die wind van die woestyn.

kjv_text: This is thy lot, the portion of thy measures from me, saith the LORD; because thou hast forgotten me, and trusted in falsehood.
bsb_text: This is your lot, the portion I have measured to you,” declares the LORD, “because you have forgotten Me and trusted in falsehood.
aov_text: Dit is jou lot, die deel wat Ek jou toegemeet het, spreek die HERE, omdat jy My vergeet en op leuens vertrou het.

kjv_text: Therefore will I discover thy skirts upon thy face, that thy shame may appear.
bsb_text: So I will pull your skirts up over your face, that your shame may be seen.
aov_text: So het Ek dan ook jou slippe opgetel oor jou aangesig, sodat jou skande gesien word.

kjv_text: I have seen thine adulteries, and thy neighings, the lewdness of thy whoredom, and thine abominations on the hills in the fields. Woe unto thee, O Jerusalem! wilt thou not be made clean? when shall it once be?
bsb_text: Your adulteries and lustful neighings, your shameless prostitution on the hills and in the fields—I have seen your detestable acts. Woe to you, O Jerusalem! How long will you remain unclean?”
aov_text: Jou owerspel en jou gerunnik, jou skandelike hoerery—op die heuwels in die veld het Ek jou verfoeisels gesien. Wee jou, Jerusalem! Hoe lank sal dit nog duur voordat jy rein word?

kjv_text: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah concerning the dearth.
bsb_text: This is the word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah concerning the drought:
aov_text: DIE woord van die HERE wat tot Jeremia gekom het weens die groot droogte.

kjv_text: Judah mourneth, and the gates thereof languish; they are black unto the ground; and the cry of Jerusalem is gone up.
bsb_text: “Judah mourns and her gates languish. Her people wail for the land, and a cry goes up from Jerusalem.
aov_text: Juda treur en sy poorte verval; hulle sit in rou op die grond, en die geskreeu van Jerusalem gaan op.

kjv_text: And their nobles have sent their little ones to the waters: they came to the pits, and found no water; they returned with their vessels empty; they were ashamed and confounded, and covered their heads.
bsb_text: The nobles send their servants for water; they go to the cisterns, but find no water; their jars return empty. They are ashamed and humiliated; they cover their heads.
aov_text: En die vernames onder hulle stuur hulle ondergeskiktes na die water; hulle kom by die bakke, hulle kry geen water nie; leeg kom hulle kanne terug; hulle het beskaamd gestaan en in die skande gekom en bedek hulle hoof.

kjv_text: Because the ground is chapt, for there was no rain in the earth, the plowmen were ashamed, they covered their heads.
bsb_text: The ground is cracked because no rain has fallen on the land. The farmers are ashamed; they cover their heads.
aov_text: Weens die land wat verslae is, omdat daar geen reën op die aarde is nie, kom die landbouers in die skande, hulle bedek hulle hoof.

kjv_text: Yea, the hind also calved in the field, and forsook it, because there was no grass.
bsb_text: Even the doe in the field deserts her newborn fawn because there is no grass.
aov_text: Want selfs die wildsbok in die veld lam en gooi haar lam weg, omdat daar geen jong gras is nie.

kjv_text: And the wild asses did stand in the high places, they snuffed up the wind like dragons; their eyes did fail, because there was no grass.
bsb_text: Wild donkeys stand on barren heights; they pant for air like jackals; their eyes fail for lack of pasture.”
aov_text: En wilde-esels staan op die kaal heuwels, hulle snuif die wind op soos die jakkalse; hulle oë versmag, omdat daar geen gras is nie.

kjv_text: O LORD, though our iniquities testify against us, do thou it for thy name's sake: for our backslidings are many; we have sinned against thee.
bsb_text: Although our iniquities testify against us, O LORD, act for the sake of Your name. Indeed, our rebellions are many; we have sinned against You.
aov_text: Hoewel ons ongeregtighede teen ons getuig, o HERE, doen dit om u Naam ontwil; want ons afkerighede is baie, ons het teen U gesondig.

kjv_text: O the hope of Israel, the saviour thereof in time of trouble, why shouldest thou be as a stranger in the land, and as a wayfaring man that turneth aside to tarry for a night?
bsb_text: O Hope of Israel, its Savior in times of distress, why are You like a stranger in the land, like a traveler who stays but a night?
aov_text: o Verwagting van Israel, sy Verlosser in tyd van benoudheid! Waarom sou U wees soos ’n vreemdeling in die land en soos ’n reisiger wat uitdraai om te vernag?

kjv_text: Why shouldest thou be as a man astonied, as a mighty man that cannot save? yet thou, O LORD, art in the midst of us, and we are called by thy name; leave us not.
bsb_text: Why are You like a man taken by surprise, like a warrior powerless to save? Yet You are among us, O LORD, and we are called by Your name. Do not forsake us!
aov_text: Waarom sou U wees soos ’n man wat verslae is, soos ’n held wat nie kan verlos nie? U is tog in ons midde, o HERE, en u Naam is oor ons uitgeroep. Verlaat ons nie!

kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD unto this people, Thus have they loved to wander, they have not refrained their feet, therefore the LORD doth not accept them; he will now remember their iniquity, and visit their sins.
bsb_text: This is what the LORD says about this people: “Truly they love to wander; they have not restrained their feet. So the LORD does not accept them; He will now remember their guilt and call their sins to account.”
aov_text: So sê die HERE van hierdie volk: Só het hulle daarvan gehou om te swerwe, hulle het hul voete nie teruggehou nie; daarom het die HERE geen behae in hulle nie. Nou sal Hy aan hulle ongeregtigheid dink en hulle sondes besoek.

kjv_text: Then said the LORD unto me, Pray not for this people for their good.
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to me, “Do not pray for the well-being of this people.
aov_text: Verder het die HERE vir my gesê: Bid nie vir hierdie volk ten goede nie.

kjv_text: When they fast, I will not hear their cry; and when they offer burnt offering and an oblation, I will not accept them: but I will consume them by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence.
bsb_text: Although they may fast, I will not listen to their cry; although they may offer burnt offerings and grain offerings, I will not accept them. Instead, I will finish them off by sword and famine and plague.”
aov_text: As hulle vas, luister Ek nie na hulle gesmeek nie; en as hulle brandoffer en spysoffer bring, het Ek in hulle geen behae nie; maar deur die swaard en die hongersnood en die pes maak Ek hulle tot niet.

kjv_text: Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD! behold, the prophets say unto them, Ye shall not see the sword, neither shall ye have famine; but I will give you assured peace in this place.
bsb_text: “Ah, Lord GOD!” I replied, “Look, the prophets are telling them, ‘You will not see the sword or suffer famine, but I will give you lasting peace in this place.’”
aov_text: Toe sê ek: Ag, Here HERE, kyk, die profete sê vir hulle: Julle sal geen swaard sien en geen hongersnood hê nie; maar Ek sal julle ’n duursame vrede gee in hierdie plek.

kjv_text: Then the LORD said unto me, The prophets prophesy lies in my name: I sent them not, neither have I commanded them, neither spake unto them: they prophesy unto you a false vision and divination, and a thing of nought, and the deceit of their heart.
bsb_text: “The prophets are prophesying lies in My name,” replied the LORD. “I did not send them or appoint them or speak to them. They are prophesying to you a false vision, a worthless divination, the futility and delusion of their own minds.
aov_text: En die HERE het vir my gesê: Die profete profeteer vals in my Naam; Ek het hulle nie gestuur en hulle geen bevel gegee en met hulle nie gespreek nie; hulle profeteer vir julle ’n leuengesig en nietige waarsêery en bedrieëry van hulle hart.

kjv_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning the prophets that prophesy in my name, and I sent them not, yet they say, Sword and famine shall not be in this land; By sword and famine shall those prophets be consumed.
bsb_text: Therefore this is what the LORD says about the prophets who prophesy in My name: I did not send them, yet they say, ‘No sword or famine will touch this land.’ By sword and famine these very prophets will meet their end!
aov_text: Daarom, so spreek die HERE: Aangaande die profete wat profeteer in my Naam sonder dat Ek hulle gestuur het, en wat sê: Daar sal geen swaard of hongersnood in hierdie land wees nie—dié profete sal deur die swaard en die hongersnood omkom.

kjv_text: And the people to whom they prophesy shall be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword; and they shall have none to bury them, them, their wives, nor their sons, nor their daughters: for I will pour their wickedness upon them.
bsb_text: And the people to whom they prophesy will be thrown into the streets of Jerusalem because of famine and sword. There will be no one to bury them or their wives, their sons or their daughters. I will pour out their own evil upon them.
aov_text: En die volk vir wie hulle profeteer, sal in die strate van Jerusalem weggegooi lê vanweë die hongersnood en die swaard sonder dat iemand hulle begrawe; hulle, hulle vrouens en hulle seuns en hulle dogters. So sal Ek dan hulle boosheid oor hulle uitstort.

kjv_text: Therefore thou shalt say this word unto them; Let mine eyes run down with tears night and day, and let them not cease: for the virgin daughter of my people is broken with a great breach, with a very grievous blow.
bsb_text: You are to speak this word to them: ‘My eyes overflow with tears; day and night they do not cease, for the virgin daughter of my people has been shattered by a crushing blow, a severely grievous wound.
aov_text: Sê aan hulle dan hierdie woord: Laat my oë afloop in trane nag en dag en nie ophou nie; want die jonkvrou, die dogter van my volk, is gebreek met ’n groot verbreking, met ’n baie smartlike wond.

kjv_text: If I go forth into the field, then behold the slain with the sword! and if I enter into the city, then behold them that are sick with famine! yea, both the prophet and the priest go about into a land that they know not.
bsb_text: If I go out to the country, I see those slain by the sword; if I enter the city, I see those ravaged by famine! For both prophet and priest travel to a land they do not know.’”
aov_text: As ek uitgaan in die veld, lê daar die wat verslaan is deur die swaard; en as ek kom in die stad, is daar die kwale van die hongersnood. Ja, selfs profeet en priester trek rond in die land sonder om iets te weet.

kjv_text: Hast thou utterly rejected Judah? hath thy soul lothed Zion? why hast thou smitten us, and there is no healing for us? we looked for peace, and there is no good; and for the time of healing, and behold trouble!
bsb_text: Have You rejected Judah completely? Do You despise Zion? Why have You stricken us so that we are beyond healing? We hoped for peace, but no good has come, and for the time of healing, but there was only terror.
aov_text: Het U Juda dan heeltemal verwerp? Of het u siel ’n afsku van Sion? Waarom het U ons geslaan, sodat daar geen genesing vir ons is nie? Hulle wag op vrede, maar daar is niks goeds nie; en op ’n tyd van beterskap, maar daar is verskrikking.

kjv_text: We acknowledge, O LORD, our wickedness, and the iniquity of our fathers: for we have sinned against thee.
bsb_text: We acknowledge our wickedness, O LORD, the guilt of our fathers; indeed, we have sinned against You.
aov_text: HERE, ons ken ons goddeloosheid, die ongeregtigheid van ons vaders, want ons het teen U gesondig.

kjv_text: Do not abhor us, for thy name's sake, do not disgrace the throne of thy glory: remember, break not thy covenant with us.
bsb_text: For the sake of Your name do not despise us; do not disgrace Your glorious throne. Remember Your covenant with us; do not break it.
aov_text: Verwerp ons nie ter wille van u Naam; onteer die troon van u heerlikheid nie; hou tog in gedagtenis, verbreek nie u verbond met ons nie.

kjv_text: Are there any among the vanities of the Gentiles that can cause rain? or can the heavens give showers? art not thou he, O LORD our God? therefore we will wait upon thee: for thou hast made all these things.
bsb_text: Can the worthless idols of the nations bring rain? Do the skies alone send showers? Is this not by You, O LORD our God? So we put our hope in You, for You have done all these things.
aov_text: Is daar onder die nietige afgode van die nasies wat reën kan maak? Of kan die hemel reënbuie gee? Is U dit nie, o HERE onse God? En ons wag op U, want Ú doen al hierdie dinge.

kjv_text: Then said the LORD unto me, Though Moses and Samuel stood before me, yet my mind could not be toward this people: cast them out of my sight, and let them go forth.
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to me: “Even if Moses and Samuel should stand before Me, My heart would not go out to this people. Send them from My presence, and let them go.
aov_text: MAAR die HERE het vir my gesê: Al staan Moses en Samuel voor my aangesig, my siel wil niks van hierdie volk weet nie; dryf hulle van my aangesig af weg, en laat hulle heengaan.

kjv_text: And it shall come to pass, if they say unto thee, Whither shall we go forth? then thou shalt tell them, Thus saith the LORD; Such as are for death, to death; and such as are for the sword, to the sword; and such as are for the famine, to the famine; and such as are for the captivity, to the captivity.
bsb_text: If they ask you, ‘Where shall we go?’ you are to tell them that this is what the LORD says: ‘Those destined for death, to death; those destined for the sword, to the sword; those destined for famine, to famine; and those destined for captivity, to captivity.’
aov_text: En as hulle jou vra: Waar moet ons heengaan? sê dan vir hulle: So spreek die HERE: Wie vir die pes bestem is, na die pes; en wie vir die swaard, na die swaard; en wie vir die hongersnood, na die hongersnood; en wie vir die gevangenskap, na die gevangenskap.

kjv_text: And I will appoint over them four kinds, saith the LORD: the sword to slay, and the dogs to tear, and the fowls of the heaven, and the beasts of the earth, to devour and destroy.
bsb_text: I will appoint over them four kinds of destroyers, declares the LORD: the sword to kill, the dogs to drag away, and the birds of the air and beasts of the earth to devour and destroy.
aov_text: En Ek sal oor hulle vier soorte besoekinge doen, spreek die HERE: die swaard om dood te maak en die honde om weg te sleep en die voëls van die hemel en die wilde diere van die aarde om op te eet en te vernietig.

kjv_text: And I will cause them to be removed into all kingdoms of the earth, because of Manasseh the son of Hezekiah king of Judah, for that which he did in Jerusalem.
bsb_text: I will make them a horror to all the kingdoms of the earth because of what Manasseh son of Hezekiah king of Judah did in Jerusalem.
aov_text: En Ek sal hulle ’n skrikbeeld maak vir al die koninkryke van die aarde vanweë Manasse, die seun van Hiskía, die koning van Juda, oor wat hy in Jerusalem gedoen het.

kjv_text: For who shall have pity upon thee, O Jerusalem? or who shall bemoan thee? or who shall go aside to ask how thou doest?
bsb_text: Who will have pity on you, O Jerusalem? Who will mourn for you? Who will turn aside to ask about your welfare?
aov_text: Want wie sal jou bejammer, o Jerusalem? Of wie sal met jou medelyde hê? Of wie sal uitdraai om na jou welstand te vra?

kjv_text: Thou hast forsaken me, saith the LORD, thou art gone backward: therefore will I stretch out my hand against thee, and destroy thee; I am weary with repenting.
bsb_text: You have forsaken Me, declares the LORD. You have turned your back. So I will stretch out My hand against you and I will destroy you; I am weary of showing compassion.
aov_text: Jy het My verwerp, spreek die HERE, jy het ál agteruitgegaan; daarom strek Ek my hand teen jou uit en verwoes jou; Ek is moeg om berou te hê.

kjv_text: And I will fan them with a fan in the gates of the land; I will bereave them of children, I will destroy my people, since they return not from their ways.
bsb_text: I will scatter them with a winnowing fork at the gates of the land. I will bereave and destroy My people who have not turned from their ways.
aov_text: En Ek wan hulle uit met ’n gaffel by die ingange van die land. Ek maak my volk kinderloos, maak hulle tot niet; hulle kom van hulle weë nie terug nie.

kjv_text: Their widows are increased to me above the sand of the seas: I have brought upon them against the mother of the young men a spoiler at noonday: I have caused him to fall upon it suddenly, and terrors upon the city.
bsb_text: I will make their widows more numerous than the sand of the sea. I will bring a destroyer at noon against the mothers of young men. I will suddenly bring upon them anguish and dismay.
aov_text: Hulle weduwees het vir My meer geword as die sand van die see; Ek bring vir hulle oor die moeder van die jong manskappe ’n verwoester op die middag; Ek laat skielik op haar val angs en verskrikkinge.

kjv_text: She that hath borne seven languisheth: she hath given up the ghost; her sun is gone down while it was yet day: she hath been ashamed and confounded: and the residue of them will I deliver to the sword before their enemies, saith the LORD.
bsb_text: The mother of seven will grow faint; she will breathe her last breath. Her sun will set while it is still day; she will be disgraced and humiliated. And the rest I will put to the sword in the presence of their enemies,” declares the LORD.
aov_text: Sy wat sewe gebaar het, het weggekwyn; sy het magteloos neergesink; haar son het ondergegaan terwyl dit nog dag was; sy staan beskaamd en het rooi van skaamte geword. En hulle oorblyfsel gee Ek aan die swaard oor, voor hulle vyande, spreek die HERE.

kjv_text: Woe is me, my mother, that thou hast borne me a man of strife and a man of contention to the whole earth! I have neither lent on usury, nor men have lent to me on usury; yet every one of them doth curse me.
bsb_text: Woe to me, my mother, that you have borne me, a man of strife and conflict in all the land. I have neither lent nor borrowed, yet everyone curses me.
aov_text: Wee my, my moeder, dat u my gebaar het—’n man van twis en ’n man van stryd vir die hele land! Ek het nie uitgeleen nie, en hulle het nie aan my geleen nie; almal vloek my.

kjv_text: The LORD said, Verily it shall be well with thy remnant; verily I will cause the enemy to entreat thee well in the time of evil and in the time of affliction.
bsb_text: The LORD said: “Surely I will deliver you for a good purpose; surely I will intercede with your enemy in your time of trouble, in your time of distress.
aov_text: Die HERE het gesê: Waarlik, Ek bevry jou ten goede; waarlik, Ek maak dat die vyand jou ootmoedig smeek in tyd van onheil en in tyd van benoudheid.

kjv_text: Shall iron break the northern iron and the steel?
bsb_text: Can anyone smash iron—iron from the north—or bronze?
aov_text: Kan ’n mens yster breek, yster uit die noorde, en koper?

kjv_text: Thy substance and thy treasures will I give to the spoil without price, and that for all thy sins, even in all thy borders.
bsb_text: Your wealth and your treasures I will give up as plunder, without charge for all your sins within all your borders.
aov_text: Jou rykdom en jou skatte sal Ek as buit gee, sonder betaling; en dit weens al jou sondes en in jou hele grondgebied.

kjv_text: And I will make thee to pass with thine enemies into a land which thou knowest not: for a fire is kindled in mine anger, which shall burn upon you.
bsb_text: Then I will enslave you to your enemies in a land you do not know, for My anger will kindle a fire that will burn against you.”
aov_text: En Ek sal jou jou vyande laat dien in ’n land wat jy nie ken nie; want ’n vuur is aangesteek in my toorn, oor julle sal dit brand.

kjv_text: O LORD, thou knowest: remember me, and visit me, and revenge me of my persecutors; take me not away in thy longsuffering: know that for thy sake I have suffered rebuke.
bsb_text: You understand, O LORD; remember me and attend to me. Avenge me against my persecutors. In Your patience, do not take me away. Know that I endure reproach for Your honor.
aov_text: o HERE, U weet dit; dink aan my en besoek my, en wreek my op my vervolgers. Neem my in u lankmoedigheid nie weg nie. Weet dat ek smaad dra om U ontwil.

kjv_text: Thy words were found, and I did eat them; and thy word was unto me the joy and rejoicing of mine heart: for I am called by thy name, O LORD God of hosts.
bsb_text: Your words were found, and I ate them. Your words became my joy and my heart’s delight. For I bear Your name, O LORD God of Hosts.
aov_text: Toe u woorde gevind is, het ek hulle opgeëet, en u woord was vir my vreugde en vrolikheid vir my hart; want u Naam is oor my uitgeroep, HERE, God van die leërskare!

kjv_text: I sat not in the assembly of the mockers, nor rejoiced; I sat alone because of thy hand: for thou hast filled me with indignation.
bsb_text: I never sat with the band of revelers, nor did I celebrate with them. Because Your hand was on me, I sat alone, for You have filled me with indignation.
aov_text: Ek het nie gesit in ’n vergadering van spotters of was nie uitgelate nie; vanweë u hand het ek alleen gesit, want U het my met grimmigheid vervul.

kjv_text: Why is my pain perpetual, and my wound incurable, which refuseth to be healed? wilt thou be altogether unto me as a liar, and as waters that fail?
bsb_text: Why is my pain unending, and my wound incurable, refusing to be healed? You have indeed become like a mirage to me—water that is not there.
aov_text: Waarom is my smart ewigdurend en my wond ongeneeslik? Dit weier om gesond te word. Sou U vir my waarlik wees soos ’n bedrieglike stroom, waters wat nie standhoudend is nie?

kjv_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD, If thou return, then will I bring thee again, and thou shalt stand before me: and if thou take forth the precious from the vile, thou shalt be as my mouth: let them return unto thee; but return not thou unto them.
bsb_text: Therefore this is what the LORD says: “If you return, I will restore you; you will stand in My presence. And if you speak words that are noble instead of worthless, you will be My spokesman. It is they who must turn to you, but you must not turn to them.
aov_text: Daarom, so sê die HERE: As jy terugkeer, sal Ek jou laat terugkeer, sal jy voor my aangesig staan; en as jy voortbring wat edel is, en niks onedels nie, sal jy soos my mond wees. Laat húlle na jou terugkeer, maar jy moet nie na hulle terugkeer nie.

kjv_text: And I will make thee unto this people a fenced brasen wall: and they shall fight against thee, but they shall not prevail against thee: for I am with thee to save thee and to deliver thee, saith the LORD.
bsb_text: Then I will make you a wall to this people, a fortified wall of bronze; they will fight against you but will not overcome you, for I am with you to save and deliver you, declares the LORD.
aov_text: En Ek sal jou ’n onneembare kopermuur vir hierdie volk maak; en hulle sal teen jou veg, maar jou nie oorweldig nie; want Ek is met jou om jou te verlos en om jou te red, spreek die HERE.

kjv_text: And I will deliver thee out of the hand of the wicked, and I will redeem thee out of the hand of the terrible.
bsb_text: I will deliver you from the hand of the wicked and redeem you from the grasp of the ruthless.”
aov_text: En Ek sal jou red uit die hand van die goddelose mense en jou verlos uit die vuis van die tiranne.

kjv_text: The word of the LORD came also unto me, saying,
bsb_text: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
aov_text: EN die woord van die HERE het tot my gekom en gesê:

kjv_text: Thou shalt not take thee a wife, neither shalt thou have sons or daughters in this place.
bsb_text: “You must not marry or have sons or daughters in this place.”
aov_text: Jy mag vir jou geen vrou neem nie, en jy mag geen seuns of dogters hê in hierdie plek nie.

kjv_text: For thus saith the LORD concerning the sons and concerning the daughters that are born in this place, and concerning their mothers that bare them, and concerning their fathers that begat them in this land;
bsb_text: For this is what the LORD says concerning the sons and daughters born in this place, and the mothers who bore them, and the fathers who fathered them in this land:
aov_text: Want so sê die HERE van die seuns en die dogters wat in hierdie plek gebore word, en van hulle moeders wat hulle baar, en van hulle vaders wat hulle verwek in hierdie land:

kjv_text: They shall die of grievous deaths; they shall not be lamented; neither shall they be buried; but they shall be as dung upon the face of the earth: and they shall be consumed by the sword, and by famine; and their carcases shall be meat for the fowls of heaven, and for the beasts of the earth.
bsb_text: “They will die from deadly diseases. They will not be mourned or buried, but will lie like dung on the ground. They will be finished off by sword and famine, and their corpses will become food for the birds of the air and beasts of the earth.”
aov_text: Aan dodelike siektes sal hulle sterwe, hulle sal nie beklaag of begrawe word nie, hulle sal mis op die aarde wees; en hulle sal deur die swaard en die hongersnood verteer word, en hulle lyke sal dien as voedsel vir die voëls van die hemel en die wilde diere van die aarde.

kjv_text: For thus saith the LORD, Enter not into the house of mourning, neither go to lament nor bemoan them: for I have taken away my peace from this people, saith the LORD, even loving-kindness and mercies.
bsb_text: Indeed, this is what the LORD says: “Do not enter a house where there is a funeral meal. Do not go to mourn or show sympathy, for I have removed from this people My peace, My loving devotion, and My compassion,” declares the LORD.
aov_text: Want so sê die HERE: Kom nie in die klaaghuis en gaan nie om te rouklaag nie, en betuig geen deelneming met hulle nie; want Ek het my vrede van hierdie volk weggeneem, spreek die HERE, die goedertierenheid en die barmhartigheid.

kjv_text: Both the great and the small shall die in this land: they shall not be buried, neither shall men lament for them, nor cut themselves, nor make themselves bald for them:
bsb_text: “Both great and small will die in this land. They will not be buried or mourned, nor will anyone cut himself or shave his head for them.
aov_text: Groot sowel as klein sal sterwe in hierdie land; hulle sal nie begrawe word nie, en niemand sal hulle beklaag en homself stukkend kerwe of vir hom ’n kaal plek skeer om hulle ontwil nie.

kjv_text: Neither shall men tear themselves for them in mourning, to comfort them for the dead; neither shall men give them the cup of consolation to drink for their father or for their mother.
bsb_text: No food will be offered to comfort those who mourn the dead; not even a cup of consolation will be given for the loss of a father or mother.
aov_text: Ook sal niemand vir hulle treurbrood breek om iemand te troos oor ’n dooie, of aan hulle die troosbeker gee om te drink oor iemand se vader of oor iemand se moeder nie.

kjv_text: Thou shalt not also go into the house of feasting, to sit with them to eat and to drink.
bsb_text: You must not enter a house where there is feasting and sit down with them to eat and drink.
aov_text: Kom ook nie in ’n huis van maaltye om met hulle saam aan te sit nie, om te eet en te drink nie.

kjv_text: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will cause to cease out of this place in your eyes, and in your days, the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride.
bsb_text: For this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: I am going to remove from this place, before your very eyes and in your days, the sounds of joy and gladness, the voices of the bride and bridegroom.
aov_text: Want so sê die HERE van die leërskare, die God van Israel: Kyk, Ek laat uit hierdie plek ophou voor julle oë en in julle dae die stem van vreugde en die stem van vrolikheid, die stem van die bruidegom en die stem van die bruid.

kjv_text: And it shall come to pass, when thou shalt shew this people all these words, and they shall say unto thee, Wherefore hath the LORD pronounced all this great evil against us? or what is our iniquity? or what is our sin that we have committed against the LORD our God?
bsb_text: When you tell these people all these things, they will ask you, ‘Why has the LORD pronounced all this great disaster against us? What is our guilt? What is the sin that we have committed against the LORD our God?’
aov_text: En as jy al hierdie woorde aan hierdie volk bekend maak en hulle jou vra: Waarom het die HERE al hierdie groot onheile oor ons gespreek? En wat is ons ongeregtigheid en ons sonde wat ons teen die HERE onse God begaan het? —

kjv_text: Then shalt thou say unto them, Because your fathers have forsaken me, saith the LORD, and have walked after other gods, and have served them, and have worshipped them, and have forsaken me, and have not kept my law;
bsb_text: Then you are to answer them: ‘It is because your fathers have forsaken Me, declares the LORD, and followed other gods, and served and worshiped them. They abandoned Me and did not keep My instruction.
aov_text: dan moet jy vir hulle sê: Omdat julle vaders My verlaat het, spreek die HERE, en agter ander gode aan geloop en hulle gedien en hul daarvoor neergebuig het, maar My verlaat het en my wet nie gehou het nie,

kjv_text: And ye have done worse than your fathers; for, behold, ye walk every one after the imagination of his evil heart, that they may not hearken unto me:
bsb_text: And you have done more evil than your fathers. See how each of you follows the stubbornness of his evil heart instead of obeying Me.
aov_text: en julle nog erger gehandel het as julle vaders; want kyk, julle wandel elkeen na die verhardheid van sy bose hart, om na My nie te luister nie.

kjv_text: Therefore will I cast you out of this land into a land that ye know not, neither ye nor your fathers; and there shall ye serve other gods day and night; where I will not shew you favour.
bsb_text: So I will cast you out of this land into a land that neither you nor your fathers have known. There you will serve other gods day and night, for I will show you no favor.’
aov_text: Daarom sal Ek julle wegslinger uit hierdie land na ’n land wat julle nie geken het, julle en julle vaders nie; en daar sal julle ander gode dien dag en nag, omdat Ek julle geen genade sal bewys nie.

kjv_text: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that it shall no more be said, The LORD liveth, that brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;
bsb_text: Yet behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when they will no longer say, ‘As surely as the LORD lives, who brought the Israelites up out of the land of Egypt.’
aov_text: Daarom, kyk, daar kom dae, spreek die HERE, dat daar nie meer gesê sal word: So waar as die HERE leef, wat die kinders van Israel uit Egipteland laat optrek het nie;

kjv_text: But, The LORD liveth, that brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north, and from all the lands whither he had driven them: and I will bring them again into their land that I gave unto their fathers.
bsb_text: Instead they will say, ‘As surely as the LORD lives, who brought the Israelites up out of the land of the north and all the other lands to which He had banished them.’ For I will return them to their land that I gave to their forefathers.
aov_text: maar: So waar as die HERE leef, wat die kinders van Israel laat optrek het uit die Noordland en uit al die lande waarheen Hy hulle verdryf het. Ja, Ek sal hulle terugbring in hulle land wat Ek aan hulle vaders gegee het.

kjv_text: Behold, I will send for many fishers, saith the LORD, and they shall fish them; and after will I send for many hunters, and they shall hunt them from every mountain, and from every hill, and out of the holes of the rocks.
bsb_text: But for now I will send for many fishermen, declares the LORD, and they will catch them. After that I will send for many hunters, and they will hunt them down on every mountain and hill, even from the clefts of the rocks.
