kjv_text: Is it nothing to you, all ye that pass by? behold, and see if there be any sorrow like unto my sorrow, which is done unto me, wherewith the LORD hath afflicted me in the day of his fierce anger.
bsb_text: Is this nothing to you, all you who pass by? Look around and see! Is there any sorrow like mine, which was inflicted on me, which the LORD made me suffer on the day of His fierce anger?
aov_text: Lamed. Raak dit julle nie, julle almal wat met die pad verbygaan? Aanskou en kyk of daar ’n smart is soos my smart wat my aangedoen is, waarmee die HERE my bedroef het op die dag van sy toorngloed.

kjv_text: From above hath he sent fire into my bones, and it prevaileth against them: he hath spread a net for my feet, he hath turned me back: he hath made me desolate and faint all the day.
bsb_text: He sent fire from on high, and it overpowered my bones. He spread a net for my feet and turned me back. He made me desolate, faint all the day long.
aov_text: Mem. Uit die hoogte het Hy vuur gestuur in my gebeente en dit oorweldig, Hy het ’n net voor my voet uitgesprei, Hy het my agteruit laat wyk, Hy het my woes gemaak, die hele dag ellendig.

kjv_text: The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand: they are wreathed, and come up upon my neck: he hath made my strength to fall, the LORD hath delivered me into their hands, from whom I am not able to rise up.
bsb_text: My transgressions are bound into a yoke, knit together by His hand; they are draped over my neck, and the Lord has broken my strength. He has delivered me into the hands of those I cannot withstand.
aov_text: Noen. Die juk van my oortredinge is vasgebind deur sy hand, hulle is saamgevleg, hulle het op my nek gekom, dit het my krag laat struikel. Die Here het my oorgegee in die hande van een teen wie ek geen teëstand kon bied nie.

kjv_text: The LORD hath trodden under foot all my mighty men in the midst of me: he hath called an assembly against me to crush my young men: the LORD hath trodden the virgin, the daughter of Judah, as in a winepress.
bsb_text: The Lord has rejected all the mighty men in my midst; He has summoned an army against me to crush my young warriors. Like grapes in a winepress, the Lord has trampled the Virgin Daughter of Judah.
aov_text: Samek. Die Here het al my magtiges binne-in my verwerp, Hy het teen my ’n feestyd uitgeroep om my jongmanne te verbreek; die Here het die parskuip getrap vir die jonkvrou, die dogter van Juda.

kjv_text: For these things I weep; mine eye, mine eye runneth down with water, because the comforter that should relieve my soul is far from me: my children are desolate, because the enemy prevailed.
bsb_text: For these things I weep; my eyes flow with tears. For there is no one nearby to comfort me, no one to revive my soul. My children are destitute because the enemy has prevailed.
aov_text: Ajin. Daarom ween ek, my oog, my oog loop af in water, want ver van my is die trooster wat my verkwik; my kinders is verbyster, omdat die vyand die oorhand het.

kjv_text: Zion spreadeth forth her hands, and there is none to comfort her: the LORD hath commanded concerning Jacob, that his adversaries should be round about him: Jerusalem is as a menstruous woman among them.
bsb_text: Zion stretches out her hands, but there is no one to comfort her. The LORD has decreed against Jacob that his neighbors become his foes. Jerusalem has become an unclean thing among them.
aov_text: Pe. Sion brei haar hande uit, sy het geen trooster nie; die HERE het die wat rondom hom was, teen Jakob ontbied as sy teëstanders; Jerusalem het in hul midde ’n voorwerp van afsku geword.

kjv_text: The LORD is righteous; for I have rebelled against his commandment: hear, I pray you, all people, and behold my sorrow: my virgins and my young men are gone into captivity.
bsb_text: The LORD is righteous, for I have rebelled against His command. Listen, all you people; look upon my suffering. My young men and maidens have gone into captivity.
aov_text: Sade. Regverdig is Hy, die HERE, want ek was teen sy mond wederstrewig. Hoor tog, alle volke, en aanskou my smart; my jonkvroue en my jongmanne het in gevangenskap gegaan.

kjv_text: I called for my lovers, but they deceived me: my priests and mine elders gave up the ghost in the city, while they sought their meat to relieve their souls.
bsb_text: I called out to my lovers, but they have betrayed me. My priests and elders perished in the city while they searched for food to keep themselves alive.
aov_text: Kof. Ek het geroep na my liefhebbers—hulle het my in die steek gelaat; my priesters en my oudstes het in die stad beswyk toe hulle voedsel vir hulle gesoek het om hulleself te verkwik.

kjv_text: Behold, O LORD; for I am in distress: my bowels are troubled; mine heart is turned within me; for I have grievously rebelled: abroad the sword bereaveth, at home there is as death.
bsb_text: See, O LORD, how distressed I am! I am churning within; my heart is pounding within me, for I have been most rebellious. Outside, the sword bereaves; inside, there is death.
aov_text: Resj. Aanskou, HERE, hoe benoud ek is, my ingewande is in beroering, my hart draai om in my binneste, want ek was baie wederstrewig; buitekant het die swaard berowe, binnekant is dit soos die pes.

kjv_text: They have heard that I sigh: there is none to comfort me: all mine enemies have heard of my trouble; they are glad that thou hast done it: thou wilt bring the day that thou hast called, and they shall be like unto me.
bsb_text: People have heard my groaning, but there is no one to comfort me. All my enemies have heard of my trouble; they are glad that You have caused it. May You bring the day You have announced, so that they may become like me.
aov_text: Sjin. Hulle hoor dat ek sug, ek het geen trooster nie; al my vyande hoor van my onheil, hulle is bly dat U dit gedoen het. U laat die dag kom wat U uitgeroep het, dat hulle kan wees soos ek,

kjv_text: Let all their wickedness come before thee; and do unto them, as thou hast done unto me for all my transgressions: for my sighs are many, and my heart is faint.
bsb_text: Let all their wickedness come before You, and deal with them as You have dealt with me because of all my transgressions. For my groans are many, and my heart is faint.
aov_text: Tau. dat al hulle boosheid voor u aangesig kom; en doen aan hulle soos U aan my gedoen het vanweë al my oortredinge, want my versugtinge is baie, en my hart is krank.

kjv_text: How hath the LORD covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger, and cast down from heaven unto the earth the beauty of Israel, and remembered not his footstool in the day of his anger!
bsb_text: How the Lord has covered the Daughter of Zion with the cloud of His anger! He has cast the glory of Israel from heaven to earth. He has abandoned His footstool in the day of His anger.
aov_text: Alef. AG, hoe het die Here in sy toorn die dogter van Sion met wolke oordek! Hy het die sieraad van Israel uit die hemel op die aarde neergewerp en nie gedink aan die voetbank van sy voete op die dag van sy toorn nie.

kjv_text: The LORD hath swallowed up all the habitations of Jacob, and hath not pitied: he hath thrown down in his wrath the strong holds of the daughter of Judah; he hath brought them down to the ground: he hath polluted the kingdom and the princes thereof.
bsb_text: Without pity the Lord has swallowed up all the dwellings of Jacob. In His wrath He has demolished the fortified cities of the Daughter of Judah. He brought to the ground and defiled her kingdom and its princes.
aov_text: Bet. Die Here het al die woonplekke van Jakob sonder verskoning verslind; in sy grimmigheid het Hy die vestings van die dogter van Juda verwoes, op die grond gewerp, die koninkryk en sy vorste ontheilig.

kjv_text: He hath cut off in his fierce anger all the horn of Israel: he hath drawn back his right hand from before the enemy, and he burned against Jacob like a flaming fire, which devoureth round about.
bsb_text: In fierce anger He has cut off every horn of Israel and withdrawn His right hand at the approach of the enemy. He has burned in Jacob like a flaming fire that consumes everything around it.
aov_text: Gimel. Hy het in gloeiende toorn elke horing van Israel afgekap; Hy het sy regterhand teruggetrek voor die vyand, en in Jakob het Hy gebrand soos ’n vuurvlam wat rondom verteer.

kjv_text: He hath bent his bow like an enemy: he stood with his right hand as an adversary, and slew all that were pleasant to the eye in the tabernacle of the daughter of Zion: he poured out his fury like fire.
bsb_text: He has bent His bow like an enemy; His right hand is positioned. Like a foe He has killed all who were pleasing to the eye; He has poured out His wrath like fire on the tent of the Daughter of Zion.
aov_text: Dalet. Hy het sy boog gespan soos ’n vyand, Hom opgestel met sy regterhand soos ’n teëstander en gedood alles wat ’n lus was vir die oog in die tent van die dogter van Sion; Hy het sy grimmigheid uitgegiet soos vuur.

kjv_text: The LORD was as an enemy: he hath swallowed up Israel, he hath swallowed up all her palaces: he hath destroyed his strong holds, and hath increased in the daughter of Judah mourning and lamentation.
bsb_text: The Lord is like an enemy; He has swallowed up Israel. He has swallowed up all her palaces and destroyed her strongholds. He has multiplied mourning and lamentation for the Daughter of Judah.
aov_text: He. Die Here het soos ’n vyand geword, Hy het Israel verslind, al sy paleise verslind, sy vestings verwoes en geklaag en geklag by die dogter van Juda vermenigvuldig.

kjv_text: And he hath violently taken away his tabernacle, as if it were of a garden: he hath destroyed his places of the assembly: the LORD hath caused the solemn feasts and sabbaths to be forgotten in Zion, and hath despised in the indignation of his anger the king and the priest.
bsb_text: He has laid waste His tabernacle like a garden booth; He has destroyed His place of meeting. The LORD has made Zion forget her appointed feasts and Sabbaths. In His fierce anger He has despised both king and priest.
aov_text: Wau. En Hy het sy eie omheining soos ’n tuin verniel, sy eie feesplek verwoes; die HERE het in Sion feestyd en sabbat laat vergeet, en in sy grimmige toorn koning en priester verwerp.

kjv_text: The LORD hath cast off his altar, he hath abhorred his sanctuary, he hath given up into the hand of the enemy the walls of her palaces; they have made a noise in the house of the LORD, as in the day of a solemn feast.
bsb_text: The Lord has rejected His altar; He has abandoned His sanctuary; He has delivered the walls of her palaces into the hand of the enemy. They have raised a shout in the house of the LORD as on the day of an appointed feast.
aov_text: Sajin. Die Here het sy altaar verwerp, sy heiligdom ontheilig, die mure van haar paleise in die hand van die vyand oorgelewer; hulle het gedruis gemaak in die huis van die HERE soos op ’n feesdag.

kjv_text: The LORD hath purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion: he hath stretched out a line, he hath not withdrawn his hand from destroying: therefore he made the rampart and the wall to lament; they languished together.
bsb_text: The LORD determined to destroy the wall of the Daughter of Zion. He stretched out a measuring line and did not withdraw His hand from destroying. He made the ramparts and walls lament; together they waste away.
aov_text: Get. Die HERE het Hom voorgeneem om die muur van die dogter van Sion te verwoes; Hy het die meetsnoer gespan, sy hand nie teruggetrek van vernietiging nie; ja, Hy het voorskans en muur laat treur, saam sak hulle inmekaar.

kjv_text: Her gates are sunk into the ground; he hath destroyed and broken her bars: her king and her princes are among the Gentiles: the law is no more; her prophets also find no vision from the LORD.
bsb_text: Her gates have sunk into the ground; He has destroyed and shattered their bars. Her king and her princes are exiled among the nations, the law is no more, and even her prophets find no vision from the LORD.
aov_text: Tet. Haar poorte het in die grond gesink, Hy het haar grendels te gronde gerig en verbreek; haar koning en haar vorste is onder die heidene; daar is geen onderwysing nie, en haar profete ontvang geen gesig van die HERE nie.

kjv_text: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit upon the ground, and keep silence: they have cast up dust upon their heads; they have girded themselves with sackcloth: the virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground.
bsb_text: The elders of the Daughter of Zion sit on the ground in silence. They have thrown dust on their heads and put on sackcloth. The young women of Jerusalem have bowed their heads to the ground.
aov_text: Jod. Die oudstes van die dogter van Sion sit en swyg op die grond, hulle het stof op hul hoof gegooi, rouklere aangegord; die jonkvroue van Jerusalem het hulle hoof na die aarde gebuig.

kjv_text: Mine eyes do fail with tears, my bowels are troubled, my liver is poured upon the earth, for the destruction of the daughter of my people; because the children and the sucklings swoon in the streets of the city.
bsb_text: My eyes fail from weeping; I am churning within. My heart is poured out in grief over the destruction of the daughter of my people, because children and infants faint in the streets of the city.
aov_text: Kaf. My oë teer weg in trane, my ingewande is in beroering, my lewer is op die grond uitgeskud vanweë die verbreking van die dogter van my volk, omdat kind en suigling op die pleine van die stad versmag,

kjv_text: They say to their mothers, Where is corn and wine? when they swooned as the wounded in the streets of the city, when their soul was poured out into their mothers' bosom.
bsb_text: They cry out to their mothers: “Where is the grain and wine?” as they faint like the wounded in the streets of the city, as their lives fade away in the arms of their mothers.
aov_text: Lamed. wat aan hulle moeders sê: Waar is koring en wyn? terwyl hulle versmag soos gewondes op die pleine van die stad, terwyl hulle lewe uitgestort word aan die bors van hul moeders.

kjv_text: What thing shall I take to witness for thee? what thing shall I liken to thee, O daughter of Jerusalem? what shall I equal to thee, that I may comfort thee, O virgin daughter of Zion? for thy breach is great like the sea: who can heal thee?
bsb_text: What can I say for you? To what can I compare you, O Daughter of Jerusalem? To what can I liken you, that I may console you, O Virgin Daughter of Zion? For your wound is as deep as the sea. Who can ever heal you?
aov_text: Mem. Watter getuienis kan ek vir jou aflê, waarmee kan ek jou vergelyk, dogter van Jerusalem? Waarmee sal ek jou gelykstel, dat ek jou kan troos, jonkvrou, dogter van Sion? Want jou verbrokenheid is so groot soos die see—wie kan jou gesond maak?

kjv_text: Thy prophets have seen vain and foolish things for thee: and they have not discovered thine iniquity, to turn away thy captivity; but have seen for thee false burdens and causes of banishment.
bsb_text: The visions of your prophets were empty and deceptive; they did not expose your guilt to ward off your captivity. The burdens they envisioned for you were empty and misleading.
aov_text: Noen. Jou profete het vir jou bedrieglike en ongerymde dinge gesien en jou ongeregtigheid nie geopenbaar om jou lot te verander nie, maar hulle het vir jou godsprake gesien tot bedrog en verstoting.

kjv_text: All that pass by clap their hands at thee; they hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem, saying, Is this the city that men call The perfection of beauty, The joy of the whole earth?
bsb_text: All who pass by clap their hands at you in scorn. They hiss and shake their heads at the Daughter of Jerusalem: “Is this the city that was called the perfection of beauty, the joy of all the earth?”
aov_text: Samek. Almal wat met die pad verbygaan, slaan die hande saam oor jou; hulle spot en skud hulle hoof oor die dogter van Jerusalem: Is dit die stad waarvan hulle gesê het: Volmaak in skoonheid, vreugde van die hele aarde?

kjv_text: All thine enemies have opened their mouth against thee: they hiss and gnash the teeth: they say, We have swallowed her up: certainly this is the day that we looked for; we have found, we have seen it.
bsb_text: All your enemies open their mouths against you. They hiss and gnash their teeth, saying, “We have swallowed her up. This is the day for which we have waited. We have lived to see it!”
aov_text: Pe. Al jou vyande rek hulle mond oop oor jou, hulle spot en kners op die tande, hulle sê: Ons het verslind, ja, dit is die dag wat ons verwag het; ons het dit bereik, dit belewe!

kjv_text: The LORD hath done that which he had devised; he hath fulfilled his word that he had commanded in the days of old: he hath thrown down, and hath not pitied: and he hath caused thine enemy to rejoice over thee, he hath set up the horn of thine adversaries.
bsb_text: The LORD has done what He planned; He has accomplished His decree, which He ordained in days of old; He has overthrown you without pity. He has let the enemy gloat over you and exalted the horn of your foes.
aov_text: Ajin. Die HERE het gedoen wat Hy Hom voorgeneem het, sy woord volbring wat Hy sedert die dae van die voortyd beveel het; Hy het sonder verskoning afgebreek en die vyand oor jou bly gemaak, die horing van jou teëstanders verhoog.

kjv_text: Their heart cried unto the LORD, O wall of the daughter of Zion, let tears run down like a river day and night: give thyself no rest; let not the apple of thine eye cease.
bsb_text: The hearts of the people cry out to the Lord. O wall of the Daughter of Zion, let your tears run down like a river day and night. Give yourself no relief, and your eyes no rest.
aov_text: Sade. Hulle hart roep na die Here. Muur van die dogter van Sion, laat trane afloop soos ’n stroom, dag en nag; gun jouself geen verposing nie, laat jou oogappel nie rus nie.

kjv_text: Arise, cry out in the night: in the beginning of the watches pour out thine heart like water before the face of the LORD: lift up thy hands toward him for the life of thy young children, that faint for hunger in the top of every street.
bsb_text: Arise, cry out in the night from the first watch of the night. Pour out your heart like water in the presence of the Lord. Lift up your hands to Him for the lives of your children who are fainting from hunger on the corner of every street.
aov_text: Kof. Staan op, skreeu in die nag by die begin van die nagwake, stort jou hart uit soos water voor die aangesig van die Here, hef jou hande op na Hom, ter wille van die lewe van jou kinders wat versmag van honger by die hoek van al die strate.

kjv_text: Behold, O LORD, and consider to whom thou hast done this. Shall the women eat their fruit, and children of a span long? shall the priest and the prophet be slain in the sanctuary of the Lord?
bsb_text: Look, O LORD, and consider: Whom have You ever treated like this? Should women eat their offspring, the infants they have nurtured? Should priests and prophets be killed in the sanctuary of the Lord?
aov_text: Resj. Aanskou, HERE, en merk op aan wie U so gedoen het! Moet vroue dan hulle vrug eet, kindertjies wat op die hande gedra word? Moet dan in die heiligdom van die HERE priester en profeet gedood word?

kjv_text: The young and the old lie on the ground in the streets: my virgins and my young men are fallen by the sword; thou hast slain them in the day of thine anger; thou hast killed, and not pitied.
bsb_text: Both young and old lie together in the dust of the streets. My young men and maidens have fallen by the sword. You have slain them in the day of Your anger; You have slaughtered them without compassion.
aov_text: Sjin. Op die grond lê jonk en oud in die strate; my jonkvroue en my jongmanne het deur die swaard geval; U het hulle gedood op die dag van u toorn, U het geslag sonder verskoning.

kjv_text: Thou hast called as in a solemn day my terrors round about, so that in the day of the LORD's anger none escaped nor remained: those that I have swaddled and brought up hath mine enemy consumed.
bsb_text: You summoned my attackers on every side, as for the day of an appointed feast. In the day of the LORD’s anger no one escaped or survived; my enemy has destroyed those I nurtured and reared.
aov_text: Tau. U het soos op ’n feesdag my verskrikkinge geroep van rondom, en niemand het op die dag van die HERE se toorn vrygeraak of ontkom nie; die wat ek op die hande gedra en grootgemaak het—my vyand het hulle omgebring.

kjv_text: I AM the man that hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.
bsb_text: I am the man who has seen affliction under the rod of God’s wrath.
aov_text: Alef. EK is die man wat ellende gesien het deur die roede van sy grimmigheid.

kjv_text: He hath led me, and brought me into darkness, but not into light.
bsb_text: He has driven me away and made me walk in darkness instead of light.
aov_text: My het Hy gelei en laat wandel in duisternis sonder lig.

kjv_text: Surely against me is he turned; he turneth his hand against me all the day.
bsb_text: Indeed, He keeps turning His hand against me all day long.
aov_text: Ja, altyd weer draai Hy die hele dag sy hand teen my.

kjv_text: My flesh and my skin hath he made old; he hath broken my bones.
bsb_text: He has worn away my flesh and skin; He has shattered my bones.
aov_text: Bet. Hy het my vlees en my vel laat wegteer, my gebeente verbreek.

kjv_text: He hath builded against me, and compassed me with gall and travail.
bsb_text: He has besieged me and surrounded me with bitterness and hardship.
aov_text: Hy het my met ’n bouwerk omsingel van gif en moeite.

kjv_text: He hath set me in dark places, as they that be dead of old.
bsb_text: He has made me dwell in darkness like those dead for ages.
aov_text: Hy het my in donker plekke laat sit soos die wat lankal dood is.

kjv_text: He hath hedged me about, that I cannot get out: he hath made my chain heavy.
bsb_text: He has walled me in so I cannot escape; He has weighed me down with chains.
aov_text: Gimel. Hy het my toegemuur, sodat ek nie kan uitkom nie, my koperboeie swaar gemaak.

kjv_text: Also when I cry and shout, he shutteth out my prayer.
bsb_text: Even when I cry out and plead for help, He shuts out my prayer.
aov_text: Al skreeu ek ook en al roep ek om hulp, Hy laat my gebed onverhoord.

kjv_text: He hath inclosed my ways with hewn stone, he hath made my paths crooked.
bsb_text: He has barred my ways with cut stones; He has made my paths crooked.
aov_text: Hy het my weë toegemuur met gekapte klip, my paaie onbegaanbaar gemaak.

kjv_text: He was unto me as a bear lying in wait, and as a lion in secret places.
bsb_text: He is a bear lying in wait, a lion hiding in ambush.
aov_text: Dalet. Hy is ’n beer wat my voorlê, ’n leeu in skuilplekke.

kjv_text: He hath turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces: he hath made me desolate.
bsb_text: He forced me off my path and tore me to pieces; He left me without help.
aov_text: Hy het my weë laat wegdraai en my verskeur, my tot ’n woesteny gemaak.

kjv_text: He hath bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.
bsb_text: He bent His bow and set me as the target for His arrow.
aov_text: Hy het sy boog gespan en my as ’n teiken vir die pyl opgestel.

kjv_text: He hath caused the arrows of his quiver to enter into my reins.
bsb_text: He pierced my kidneys with His arrows.
aov_text: He. Hy het die pyle uit sy pylkoker in my niere laat ingaan.

kjv_text: I was a derision to all my people; and their song all the day.
bsb_text: I am a laughingstock to all my people; they mock me in song all day long.
aov_text: Ek het ’n belagging geword vir my hele volk, hulle spotlied die hele dag.

kjv_text: He hath filled me with bitterness, he hath made me drunken with wormwood.
bsb_text: He has filled me with bitterness; He has intoxicated me with wormwood.
aov_text: Hy het my met bitter kruie versadig, my genoeg wilde-als laat drink.

kjv_text: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones, he hath covered me with ashes.
bsb_text: He has ground my teeth with gravel and trampled me in the dust.
aov_text: Wau. En Hy het my die tande op gruisklippertjies laat stukkend byt, my in die as neergedruk.

kjv_text: And thou hast removed my soul far off from peace: I forgat prosperity.
bsb_text: My soul has been deprived of peace; I have forgotten what prosperity is.
aov_text: En U het my siel van die vrede verstoot, ek het die goeie vergeet.

kjv_text: And I said, My strength and my hope is perished from the LORD:
bsb_text: So I say, “My strength has perished, along with my hope from the LORD.”
aov_text: Ja, ek het gesê: My roem het vergaan en my hoop op die HERE.

kjv_text: Remembering mine affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the gall.
bsb_text: Remember my affliction and wandering, the wormwood and the gall.
aov_text: Sajin. Dink aan my ellende en my omswerwing, aan die wilde-als en die gif.

kjv_text: My soul hath them still in remembrance, and is humbled in me.
bsb_text: Surely my soul remembers and is humbled within me.
aov_text: As my siel terdeë daaraan dink, buig hy hom neer in my.

kjv_text: This I recall to my mind, therefore have I hope.
bsb_text: Yet I call this to mind, and therefore I have hope:
aov_text: Dit sal ek ter harte neem, daarom sal ek hoop:

kjv_text: It is of the LORD's mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.
bsb_text: Because of the loving devotion of the LORD we are not consumed, for His mercies never fail.
aov_text: Get. dit is die goedertierenhede van die HERE dat ons nie omgekom het nie, want sy barmhartighede het geen einde nie;

kjv_text: They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.
bsb_text: They are new every morning; great is Your faithfulness!
aov_text: hulle is elke môre nuut; u trou is groot.

kjv_text: The LORD is my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.
bsb_text: “The LORD is my portion,” says my soul, “therefore I will hope in Him.”
aov_text: Die HERE is my deel, sê my siel, daarom sal ek op Hom hoop.

kjv_text: The LORD is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.
bsb_text: The LORD is good to those who wait for Him, to the soul who seeks Him.
aov_text: Tet. Goed is die HERE vir die wat op Hom hoop, vir die siel wat Hom soek.

kjv_text: It is good that a man should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD.
bsb_text: It is good to wait quietly for the salvation of the LORD.
aov_text: Dit is goed om in stilheid te hoop op die hulp van die HERE.

kjv_text: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.
bsb_text: It is good for a man to bear the yoke while he is still young.
aov_text: Dit is goed vir ’n man dat hy die juk in sy jeug dra.

kjv_text: He sitteth alone and keepeth silence, because he hath borne it upon him.
bsb_text: Let him sit alone in silence, for God has disciplined him.
aov_text: Jod. Laat hom eensaam sit en swyg, as Hy hom dit opgelê het.

kjv_text: He putteth his mouth in the dust; if so be there may be hope.
bsb_text: Let him bury his face in the dust—perhaps there is still hope.
aov_text: Laat hy sy mond in die stof steek—miskien is daar hoop!

kjv_text: He giveth his cheek to him that smiteth him: he is filled full with reproach.
bsb_text: Let him offer his cheek to the one who would strike him; let him be filled with reproach.
aov_text: Laat hy die wang gee vir die wat hom slaan, laat hy genoeg kry van smaad.

kjv_text: For the LORD will not cast off for ever:
bsb_text: For the Lord will not cast us off forever.
aov_text: Kaf. Want die Here sal nie vir ewig verstoot nie.

kjv_text: But though he cause grief, yet will he have compassion according to the multitude of his mercies.
bsb_text: Even if He causes grief, He will show compassion according to His abundant loving devotion.
aov_text: Maar as Hy bedroef het, ontferm Hy Hom na die grootheid van sy goedertierenhede;

kjv_text: For he doth not afflict willingly nor grieve the children of men.
bsb_text: For He does not willingly afflict or grieve the sons of men.
aov_text: want nie van harte verdruk of bedroef Hy die mensekinders nie.

kjv_text: To crush under his feet all the prisoners of the earth,
bsb_text: To crush underfoot all the prisoners of the land,
aov_text: Lamed. Dat hulle al die gevangenes van die aarde onder hul voete vertrap,

kjv_text: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the most High,
bsb_text: to deny a man justice before the Most High,
aov_text: dat hulle die reg van ’n man verdraai voor die aangesig van die Allerhoogste,

kjv_text: To subvert a man in his cause, the LORD approveth not.
bsb_text: to subvert a man in his lawsuit—of these the Lord does not approve.
aov_text: dat hulle ’n mens onregverdig behandel in sy regsaak—het die Here dit nie gesien nie?

kjv_text: Who is he that saith, and it cometh to pass, when the Lord commandeth it not?
bsb_text: Who has spoken and it came to pass, unless the Lord has ordained it?
aov_text: Mem. Wie spreek daar, en dit gebeur? Het die Here dit nie beveel nie?

kjv_text: Out of the mouth of the most High proceedeth not evil and good?
bsb_text: Do not both adversity and good come from the mouth of the Most High?
aov_text: Gaan uit die mond van die Allerhoogste nie kwaad sowel as goed nie?

kjv_text: Wherefore doth a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?
bsb_text: Why should any mortal man complain, in view of his sins?
aov_text: Wat klaag ’n mens in sy lewe? Laat elkeen klaag oor sy sondes.

kjv_text: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the LORD.
bsb_text: Let us examine and test our ways, and turn back to the LORD.
aov_text: Noen. Laat ons ons weë naspeur en deursoek en ons tot die HERE bekeer;

kjv_text: Let us lift up our heart with our hands unto God in the heavens.
bsb_text: Let us lift up our hearts and hands to God in heaven:
aov_text: laat ons ons hart saam met die hande ophef tot God in die hemel en sê:

kjv_text: We have transgressed and have rebelled: thou hast not pardoned.
bsb_text: “We have sinned and rebelled; You have not forgiven.”
aov_text: Óns het oortree en ons was wederstrewig—Ú het nie vergewe nie.

kjv_text: Thou hast covered with anger, and persecuted us: thou hast slain, thou hast not pitied.
bsb_text: You have covered Yourself in anger and pursued us; You have killed without pity.
aov_text: Samek. U het U in toorn gehul en ons agtervolg, U het gedood sonder verskoning.

kjv_text: Thou hast covered thyself with a cloud, that our prayer should not pass through.
bsb_text: You have covered Yourself with a cloud that no prayer can pass through.
aov_text: U het Uself in ’n wolk gehul, sodat daar geen gebed kon deurdring nie;

kjv_text: Thou hast made us as the offscouring and refuse in the midst of the people.
bsb_text: You have made us scum and refuse among the nations.
aov_text: U het ons ’n uitvaagsel en ’n wegwerpsel onder die volke gemaak.

kjv_text: All our enemies have opened their mouths against us.
bsb_text: All our enemies open their mouths against us.
aov_text: Pe. Al ons vyande het hulle mond teen ons oopgerek;

kjv_text: Fear and a snare is come upon us, desolation and destruction.
bsb_text: Panic and pitfall have come upon us—devastation and destruction.
aov_text: skrik en kuil het ons deel geword, ondergang en verbreking.

kjv_text: Mine eye runneth down with rivers of water for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
bsb_text: Streams of tears flow from my eyes over the destruction of the daughter of my people.
aov_text: My oog loop af in waterstrome oor die verbreking van die dogter van my volk.

kjv_text: Mine eye trickleth down, and ceaseth not, without any intermission,
bsb_text: My eyes overflow unceasingly, without relief,
aov_text: Ajin. My oog vloei rusteloos weg sonder ophou,

kjv_text: Till the LORD look down, and behold from heaven.
bsb_text: until the LORD looks down from heaven and sees.
aov_text: totdat die HERE uit die hemel neersien en aanskou.

kjv_text: Mine eye affecteth mine heart because of all the daughters of my city.
bsb_text: My eyes bring grief to my soul because of all the daughters of my city.
aov_text: My oog gee my pyn oor al die dogters van my stad.

kjv_text: Mine enemies chased me sore, like a bird, without cause.
bsb_text: Without cause my enemies hunted me like a bird.
aov_text: Sade. Hulle het my soos ’n voël rondgejaag, die wat sonder oorsaak my vyande is;

kjv_text: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and cast a stone upon me.
bsb_text: They dropped me alive into a pit and cast stones upon me.
aov_text: hulle het my lewe in ’n kuil tot niet gemaak en klippe op my gegooi.

kjv_text: Waters flowed over mine head; then I said, I am cut off.
bsb_text: The waters flowed over my head, and I thought I was going to die.
aov_text: Water het oor my hoof gestroom, ek het gesê: Dit is klaar met my!

kjv_text: I called upon thy name, O LORD, out of the low dungeon.
bsb_text: I called on Your name, O LORD, out of the depths of the Pit.
aov_text: Kof. Ek roep u Naam aan, HERE, uit die onderste kuil.

kjv_text: Thou hast heard my voice: hide not thine ear at my breathing, at my cry.
bsb_text: You heard my plea: “Do not ignore my cry for relief.”
aov_text: U hoor my stem; verberg u oor nie vir my ontboeseming, vir my hulpgeroep nie.

kjv_text: Thou drewest near in the day that I called upon thee: thou saidst, Fear not.
bsb_text: You drew near when I called on You; You said, “Do not be afraid.”
aov_text: U kom nader die dag as ek U aanroep, U sê: Wees nie bevrees nie!

kjv_text: O LORD, thou hast pleaded the causes of my soul; thou hast redeemed my life.
bsb_text: You defend my cause, O Lord; You redeem my life.
aov_text: Resj. U, Here, verdedig my regsaak, U verlos my lewe.

kjv_text: O LORD, thou hast seen my wrong: judge thou my cause.
bsb_text: You have seen, O LORD, the wrong done to me; vindicate my cause!
aov_text: U sien, HERE, my verdrukking; verskaf my tog reg.

kjv_text: Thou hast seen all their vengeance and all their imaginations against me.
bsb_text: You have seen all their malice, all their plots against me.
aov_text: U sien al hulle wraaksug, al hulle planne teen my.

kjv_text: Thou hast heard their reproach, O LORD, and all their imaginations against me;
bsb_text: O LORD, You have heard their insults, all their plots against me—
aov_text: Sjin. U hoor hulle smaadrede, HERE, al hulle planne teen my,

kjv_text: The lips of those that rose up against me, and their device against me all the day.
bsb_text: the slander and murmuring of my assailants against me all day long.
aov_text: die lippe van my teëstanders en hulle bedenksels die hele dag teen my.

kjv_text: Behold their sitting down, and their rising up; I am their musick.
bsb_text: When they sit and when they rise, see how they mock me in song.
aov_text: Aanskou tog hulle sit en hulle opstaan, ek is hulle spotlied.

kjv_text: Render unto them a recompence, O LORD, according to the work of their hands.
bsb_text: You will pay them back what they deserve, O LORD, according to the work of their hands.
aov_text: Tau. U sal hulle vergeld vir wat hulle gedoen het, HERE.

kjv_text: Give them sorrow of heart, thy curse unto them.
bsb_text: Put a veil of anguish over their hearts; may Your curse be upon them!
aov_text: U sal hulle gee verblinding van hart, u vervloeking oor hulle.

kjv_text: Persecute and destroy them in anger from under the heavens of the LORD.
bsb_text: You will pursue them in anger and exterminate them from under Your heavens, O LORD.
aov_text: U sal hulle in toorn vervolg en hulle verdelg van onder die hemel van die HERE uit.

kjv_text: How is the gold become dim! how is the most fine gold changed! the stones of the sanctuary are poured out in the top of every street.
bsb_text: How the gold has become tarnished, the pure gold has become dull! The gems of the temple lie scattered on every street corner.
aov_text: Alef. AG, hoe is die goud verdonker, die goeie goud verander, die heilige stene weggegooi op die hoek van al die strate!

kjv_text: The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, how are they esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of the potter!
bsb_text: How the precious sons of Zion, once worth their weight in pure gold, are now esteemed as jars of clay, the work of a potter’s hands!
aov_text: Bet. Die kinders van Sion, die kosbares, wat teen fyn goud geskat was, ag, hoe is hulle gereken soos erdekruike, die werk van pottebakkershande.

kjv_text: Even the sea monsters draw out the breast, they give suck to their young ones: the daughter of my people is become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.
bsb_text: Even jackals offer their breasts to nurse their young, but the daughter of my people has become cruel, like an ostrich in the wilderness.
aov_text: Gimel. Selfs jakkalse gee die speen, laat hulle kleintjies drink, maar die dogter van my volk het wreed geword soos die volstruise in die woestyn.

kjv_text: The tongue of the sucking child cleaveth to the roof of his mouth for thirst: the young children ask bread, and no man breaketh it unto them.
bsb_text: The nursing infant’s tongue clings in thirst to the roof of his mouth. Little children beg for bread, but no one gives them any.
aov_text: Dalet. Die tong van die suigling kleef aan sy verhemelte van dors, kindertjies vra brood, niemand breek dit vir hulle nie.

kjv_text: They that did feed delicately are desolate in the streets: they that were brought up in scarlet embrace dunghills.
bsb_text: Those who once ate delicacies are destitute in the streets; those brought up in crimson huddle in ash heaps.
aov_text: He. Hulle wat lekkernye geëet het, het versmag op die strate; die wat op purper gedra is, het die ashope omarm.

kjv_text: For the punishment of the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the punishment of the sin of Sodom, that was overthrown as in a moment, and no hands stayed on her.
bsb_text: The punishment of the daughter of my people is greater than that of Sodom, which was overthrown in an instant without a hand turned to help her.
aov_text: Wau. Want die ongeregtigheid van die dogter van my volk was groter as die sonde van Sodom wat soos in ’n oomblik omgekeer is, sonder dat iemand die hand daaraan geslaan het.

kjv_text: Her Nazarites were purer than snow, they were whiter than milk, they were more ruddy in body than rubies, their polishing was of sapphire:
bsb_text: Her dignitaries were brighter than snow, whiter than milk; their bodies were more ruddy than rubies, their appearance like sapphires.
aov_text: Sajin. Haar vorste was helderder as sneeu, witter as melk, rooier van liggaam as korale, hulle gestalte ’n saffier.

kjv_text: Their visage is blacker than a coal; they are not known in the streets: their skin cleaveth to their bones; it is withered, it is become like a stick.
bsb_text: But now their appearance is blacker than soot; they are not recognized in the streets. Their skin has shriveled on their bones; it has become as dry as a stick.
aov_text: Get. Maar hulle voorkoms het donkerder as swartsel geword, hulle is nie herken op die strate nie; hulle vel kleef aan hul gebeente, dit het droog geword soos hout.

kjv_text: They that be slain with the sword are better than they that be slain with hunger: for these pine away, stricken through for want of the fruits of the field.
bsb_text: Those slain by the sword are better off than those who die of hunger, who waste away, pierced with pain because the fields lack produce.
aov_text: Tet. Die wat deur die swaard verslaan is, is gelukkiger as die wat deur die honger verslaan is, wat, deurboor, vergaan het uit gebrek aan veldvrugte.

kjv_text: The hands of the pitiful women have sodden their own children: they were their meat in the destruction of the daughter of my people.
bsb_text: The hands of compassionate women have cooked their own children, who became their food in the destruction of the daughter of my people.
aov_text: Jod. Die hande van teerhartige vroue het hulle eie kinders gekook; dit het hulle voedsel geword in die verbreking van die dogter van my volk.

kjv_text: The LORD hath accomplished his fury; he hath poured out his fierce anger, and hath kindled a fire in Zion, and it hath devoured the foundations thereof.
bsb_text: The LORD has exhausted His wrath; He has poured out His fierce anger; He has kindled a fire in Zion, and it has consumed her foundations.
aov_text: Kaf. Die HERE het sy grimmigheid laat uitwoed, sy toorngloed uitgegiet en in Sion ’n vuur aangesteek wat die fondamente daarvan verteer het.

kjv_text: The kings of the earth, and all the inhabitants of the world, would not have believed that the adversary and the enemy should have entered into the gates of Jerusalem.
bsb_text: The kings of the earth did not believe, nor any people of the world, that an enemy or a foe could enter the gates of Jerusalem.
aov_text: Lamed. Hulle het dit nie geglo nie, die konings van die aarde en al die inwoners van die wêreld, dat ’n teëstander of ’n vyand in die poorte van Jerusalem sou kom nie.

kjv_text: For the sins of her prophets, and the iniquities of her priests, that have shed the blood of the just in the midst of her,
bsb_text: But this was for the sins of her prophets and the guilt of her priests, who shed the blood of the righteous in her midst.
aov_text: Mem. Dit was oor die sondes van haar profete, die ongeregtighede van haar priesters wat daar binne-in die bloed van die regverdiges vergiet het.

kjv_text: They have wandered as blind men in the streets, they have polluted themselves with blood, so that men could not touch their garments.
bsb_text: They wandered blind in the streets, defiled by this blood, so that no one dared to touch their garments.
aov_text: Noen. Blind het hulle deur die strate gewaggel, met bloed bevlek, sodat ’n mens hulle klere nie kon aanraak nie.

kjv_text: They cried unto them, Depart ye; it is unclean; depart, depart, touch not: when they fled away and wandered, they said among the heathen, They shall no more sojourn there.
bsb_text: “Go away! Unclean!” men shouted at them. “Away, away! Do not touch us!” So they fled and wandered. Among the nations it was said, “They can stay here no longer.”
aov_text: Samek. Staan opsy, onrein!—het die mense hulle toegeroep. Staan opsy, staan opsy, moenie aanraak nie! As hulle vlug, ja, waggel, is onder die heidene gesê: Hulle mag hier nie langer vertoef nie.

kjv_text: The anger of the LORD hath divided them; he will no more regard them: they respected not the persons of the priests, they favoured not the elders.
bsb_text: The presence of the LORD has scattered them; He regards them no more. The priests are shown no honor; the elders find no favor.
aov_text: Pe. Die aangesig van die HERE het hulle verstrooi, Hy sal hulle verder nie meer met welgevalle aansien nie. Vir die persoon van die priesters het hulle geen agting gehad, aan die grysaards het hulle geen genade bewys nie.

kjv_text: As for us, our eyes as yet failed for our vain help: in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us.
bsb_text: All the while our eyes were failing as we looked in vain for help. We watched from our towers for a nation that could not save us.
aov_text: Ajin. Nog altyddeur smag ons oë tevergeefs na hulp vir ons; op ons wagpos sien ons met verwagting uit na ’n nasie wat nie sal help nie.

kjv_text: They hunt our steps, that we cannot go in our streets: our end is near, our days are fulfilled; for our end is come.
bsb_text: They stalked our every step, so that we could not walk in our streets. Our end drew near, our time ran out, for our end had come!
aov_text: Sade. Hulle het jag gemaak op ons voetstappe, sodat ons op ons pleine nie kon loop nie; ons einde het nader gekom, ons dae was vol, ja, ons einde het gekom.

kjv_text: Our persecutors are swifter than the eagles of the heaven: they pursued us upon the mountains, they laid wait for us in the wilderness.
bsb_text: Those who chased us were swifter than the eagles in the sky; they pursued us over the mountains and ambushed us in the wilderness.
aov_text: Kof. Ons vervolgers was vinniger as die arende van die hemel, op die berge het hulle ons hewig agtervolg, in die woestyn het hulle ons voorgelê.

kjv_text: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of the LORD, was taken in their pits, of whom we said, Under his shadow we shall live among the heathen.
bsb_text: The LORD’s anointed, the breath of our life, was captured in their pits. We had said of him, “Under his shadow we will live among the nations.”
aov_text: Resj. Die asem van ons neus, die gesalfde van die HERE, is in hulle kuile gevang, hy onder wie se skaduwee ons gedink het om te lewe onder die nasies.

kjv_text: Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom, that dwellest in the land of Uz; the cup also shall pass through unto thee: thou shalt be drunken, and shalt make thyself naked.
bsb_text: So rejoice and be glad, O Daughter of Edom, you who dwell in the land of Uz. Yet the cup will pass to you as well; you will get drunk and expose yourself.
aov_text: Sjin. Verbly en verheug jou, dogter van Edom, wat in die land Us woon; ook na jou sal die beker kom, jy sal dronk word en jouself ontbloot.

kjv_text: The punishment of thine iniquity is accomplished, O daughter of Zion; he will no more carry thee away into captivity: he will visit thine iniquity, O daughter of Edom; he will discover thy sins.
bsb_text: O Daughter of Zion, your punishment is complete; He will not prolong your exile. But He will punish your iniquity, O Daughter of Edom; He will expose your sins.
aov_text: Tau. Jou straf het sy einde bereik, dogter van Sion, Hy sal jou nie weer in ballingskap laat wegvoer nie. Hy besoek jou ongeregtigheid, dogter van Edom, Hy openbaar jou sondes.

kjv_text: Remember, O LORD, what is come upon us: consider, and behold our reproach.
bsb_text: Remember, O LORD, what has happened to us. Look and see our disgrace!
aov_text: DINK, HERE, aan wat oor ons gekom het, sien en aanskou ons smaad.

kjv_text: Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.
bsb_text: Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers, our houses to foreigners.
aov_text: Ons erfdeel het na vreemdes oorgegaan, ons huise na uitlanders.

kjv_text: We are orphans and fatherless, our mothers are as widows.
bsb_text: We have become fatherless orphans; our mothers are widows.
aov_text: Ons het wese geword, sonder ’n vader, ons moeders is soos weduwees.

kjv_text: We have drunken our water for money; our wood is sold unto us.
bsb_text: We must buy the water we drink; our wood comes at a price.
aov_text: Ons water drink ons vir geld, ons hout kom teen betaling in.

kjv_text: Our necks are under persecution: we labour, and have no rest.
bsb_text: We are closely pursued; we are weary and find no rest.
aov_text: Ons vervolgers is op ons nek; ons is afgemat sonder dat daar rus aan ons gegun word.

kjv_text: We have given the hand to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.
bsb_text: We submitted to Egypt and Assyria to get enough bread.
aov_text: Na Egipte het ons die hand uitgestrek, na Assur om met brood versadig te word.

kjv_text: Our fathers have sinned, and are not; and we have borne their iniquities.
bsb_text: Our fathers sinned and are no more, but we bear their punishment.
aov_text: Ons vaders het gesondig; hulle is daar nie meer nie, en óns dra hulle ongeregtighede.

kjv_text: Servants have ruled over us: there is none that doth deliver us out of their hand.
bsb_text: Slaves rule over us; there is no one to deliver us from their hands.
aov_text: Knegte heers oor ons, niemand ruk ons uit hulle hand weg nie.

kjv_text: We gat our bread with the peril of our lives because of the sword of the wilderness.
bsb_text: We get our bread at the risk of our lives because of the sword in the wilderness.
aov_text: Met lewensgevaar bring ons ons brood in vanweë die swaard van die woestyn.

kjv_text: Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine.
bsb_text: Our skin is as hot as an oven with fever from our hunger.
aov_text: Ons vel gloei soos ’n oond vanweë die gloed van die honger.

kjv_text: They ravished the women in Zion, and the maids in the cities of Judah.
bsb_text: Women have been ravished in Zion, virgins in the cities of Judah.
aov_text: Hulle het vroue in Sion onteer, jonkvroue in die stede van Juda.

kjv_text: Princes are hanged up by their hand: the faces of elders were not honoured.
bsb_text: Princes have been hung up by their hands; elders receive no respect.
aov_text: Vorste is deur hulle hand opgehang, die persoon van die grysaards nie geëer nie.

kjv_text: They took the young men to grind, and the children fell under the wood.
bsb_text: Young men toil at millstones; boys stagger under loads of wood.
aov_text: Jongmanne dra die handmeul, en seuns struikel onder die drag hout.

kjv_text: The elders have ceased from the gate, the young men from their musick.
bsb_text: The elders have left the city gate; the young men have stopped their music.
aov_text: Die oudstes is nie meer in die poort nie, die jongmanne sonder hulle snarespel.

kjv_text: The joy of our heart is ceased; our dance is turned into mourning.
bsb_text: Joy has left our hearts; our dancing has turned to mourning.
aov_text: Die vreugde van ons hart het opgehou, ons koordans het in treurigheid verander.

kjv_text: The crown is fallen from our head: woe unto us, that we have sinned!
bsb_text: The crown has fallen from our head. Woe to us, for we have sinned!
aov_text: Die kroon van ons hoof het geval; wee ons, dat ons gesondig het.

kjv_text: For this our heart is faint; for these things our eyes are dim.
bsb_text: Because of this, our hearts are faint; because of these, our eyes grow dim—
aov_text: Hierom het ons hart krank geword, hierom is ons oë verduister:

kjv_text: Because of the mountain of Zion, which is desolate, the foxes walk upon it.
bsb_text: because of Mount Zion, which lies desolate, patrolled by foxes.
aov_text: ter wille van die berg Sion wat woes lê, waar die jakkalse op rondloop.

kjv_text: Thou, O LORD, remainest for ever; thy throne from generation to generation.
bsb_text: You, O LORD, reign forever; Your throne endures from generation to generation.
aov_text: Ú, HERE, sit vir ewig, u troon is van geslag tot geslag.

kjv_text: Wherefore dost thou forget us for ever, and forsake us so long time?
bsb_text: Why have You forgotten us forever? Why have You forsaken us for so long?
aov_text: Waarom sou U ons vir altyd vergeet, ons verlaat tot in lengte van dae?

kjv_text: Turn thou us unto thee, O LORD, and we shall be turned; renew our days as of old.
bsb_text: Restore us to Yourself, O LORD, so we may return; renew our days as of old,
aov_text: Bekeer ons tot U, HERE, dan sal ons ons bekeer; vernuwe ons dae soos in die voortyd.

kjv_text: But thou hast utterly rejected us; thou art very wroth against us.
bsb_text: unless You have utterly rejected us and remain angry with us beyond measure.
aov_text: Of het U ons heeltemal verwerp, is u toorn teen ons alte groot?

kjv_text: Now it came to pass in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the river of Chebar, that the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.
bsb_text: In the thirtieth year, on the fifth day of the fourth month, while I was among the exiles by the River Kebar, the heavens opened and I saw visions of God.
aov_text: IN die dertigste jaar, in die vierde maand, op die vyfde van die maand, toe ek onder die ballinge by die Kebarrivier was, is die hemele geopen en het ek gesigte van God gesien.

kjv_text: In the fifth day of the month, which was the fifth year of king Jehoiachin's captivity,
bsb_text: On the fifth day of the month—it was the fifth year of the exile of King Jehoiachin—
aov_text: Op die vyfde van die maand—dit was die vyfde jaar van die ballingskap van koning Jójagin —

kjv_text: The word of the LORD came expressly unto Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the hand of the LORD was there upon him.
bsb_text: the word of the LORD came directly to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the River Kebar. And there the LORD’s hand was upon him.
aov_text: het die woord van die HERE uitdruklik gekom tot Eségiël, die seun van Busi, die priester, in die land van die Chaldeërs, by die Kebarrivier; en die hand van die HERE was daar op hom.

kjv_text: And I looked, and, behold, a whirlwind came out of the north, a great cloud, and a fire infolding itself, and a brightness was about it, and out of the midst thereof as the colour of amber, out of the midst of the fire.
bsb_text: I looked and saw a whirlwind coming from the north, a great cloud with fire flashing back and forth and brilliant light all around it. In the center of the fire was a gleam like amber,
aov_text: Toe het ek gekyk—en daar het ’n stormwind uit die noorde gekom, ’n groot wolk met onophoudelike vuur; en ’n glans was rondom die wolk, en daaruit, uit die vuur, het iets soos blinkende metaal geskitter.

kjv_text: Also out of the midst thereof came the likeness of four living creatures. And this was their appearance; they had the likeness of a man.
bsb_text: and within it was the form of four living creatures. And this was their appearance: They had a human form,
aov_text: En daaruit het die gestalte van vier wesens gekom, en dít was hulle voorkoms: hulle het die gestalte van ’n mens gehad;

kjv_text: And every one had four faces, and every one had four wings.
bsb_text: but each had four faces and four wings.
aov_text: en elkeen het vier aangesigte gehad en elkeen van hulle vier vlerke;

kjv_text: And their feet were straight feet; and the sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf's foot: and they sparkled like the colour of burnished brass.
bsb_text: Their legs were straight, and the soles of their feet were like the hooves of a calf, gleaming like polished bronze.
aov_text: en hulle bene was reguit bene en hulle voetsole soos die sole van ’n kalfspoot; en hulle het geglinster soos blink geskuurde koper;

kjv_text: And they had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides; and they four had their faces and their wings.
bsb_text: Under their wings on their four sides they had human hands. All four living creatures had faces and wings,
aov_text: en mensehande was onder hulle vlerke aan hulle vier kante. Maar aangaande die aangesigte en die vlerke van al vier,

kjv_text: Their wings were joined one to another; they turned not when they went; they went every one straight forward.
bsb_text: and their wings were touching one another. They did not turn as they moved; each one went straight ahead.
aov_text: hulle vlerke was aanmekaar verbind. Hulle het nie weggedraai as hulle gaan nie; hulle het elkeen maar reguit vorentoe gegaan.

kjv_text: As for the likeness of their faces, they four had the face of a man, and the face of a lion, on the right side: and they four had the face of an ox on the left side; they four also had the face of an eagle.
bsb_text: The form of their faces was that of a man, and each of the four had the face of a lion on the right side, the face of an ox on the left side, and also the face of an eagle.
aov_text: En hulle aangesigte het gelyk soos die gesig van ’n mens; en al vier het die gesig van ’n leeu gehad aan die regterkant en al vier die gesig van ’n bees aan die linkerkant; ook het al vier die gesig van ’n arend gehad.

kjv_text: Thus were their faces: and their wings were stretched upward; two wings of every one were joined one to another, and two covered their bodies.
bsb_text: Such were their faces. Their wings were spread upward; each had two wings touching the wings of the creature on either side, and two wings covering its body.
aov_text: En hulle vlerke het uitgesprei na boontoe; elkeen het twee gehad wat met mekaar verbind was, en twee wat hulle liggame bedek het.

kjv_text: And they went every one straight forward: whither the spirit was to go, they went; and they turned not when they went.
bsb_text: Each creature went straight ahead. Wherever the spirit would go, they would go, without turning as they moved.
aov_text: En hulle het elkeen reguit vorentoe gegaan; waar die gees ook heen wou gaan, het hulle gegaan; hulle het nie weggedraai as hulle gaan nie.

kjv_text: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, and like the appearance of lamps: it went up and down among the living creatures; and the fire was bright, and out of the fire went forth lightning.
bsb_text: In the midst of the living creatures was the appearance of glowing coals of fire, or of torches. Fire moved back and forth between the living creatures; it was bright, and lightning flashed out of it.
aov_text: Aangaande die gestalte van die wesens: hulle voorkoms was soos gloeiende vuurkole, soos die voorkoms van fakkels; die vuur het heen en weer beweeg tussen die wesens, en die vuur het ’n helder glans gehad, en uit die vuur het blitse uitgeslaan.

kjv_text: And the living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.
bsb_text: The creatures were darting back and forth as quickly as flashes of lightning.
aov_text: En die wesens het heen en weer gesnel, in aansien soos ’n bliksemstraal.

kjv_text: Now as I beheld the living creatures, behold one wheel upon the earth by the living creatures, with his four faces.
bsb_text: When I looked at the living creatures, I saw a wheel on the ground beside each creature with its four faces.
aov_text: Ek het toe die wesens nader bekyk: daar was een wiel op die grond langs die wesens aan elkeen van die vier voorkante.

kjv_text: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like unto the colour of a beryl: and they four had one likeness: and their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel in the middle of a wheel.
bsb_text: The workmanship of the wheels looked like the gleam of beryl, and all four had the same likeness. Their workmanship looked like a wheel within a wheel.
aov_text: Die voorkoms van die wiele en hulle maaksel was soos dié van ’n chrisoliet; en al vier het dieselfde vorm gehad; daarby was hulle voorkoms en hulle maaksel asof daar ’n wiel binne-in ’n wiel was.

kjv_text: When they went, they went upon their four sides: and they turned not when they went.
bsb_text: As they moved, they went in any of the four directions, without pivoting as they moved.
aov_text: Na al vier kante het hulle gegaan as hulle gaan: hulle het nie gedraai as hulle gaan nie.

kjv_text: As for their rings, they were so high that they were dreadful; and their rings were full of eyes round about them four.
bsb_text: Their rims were high and awesome, and all four rims were full of eyes all around.
aov_text: En hulle vellings—dié was hoog en dié was wonderbaar; en hulle vellings was by al vier rondom vol oë.

kjv_text: And when the living creatures went, the wheels went by them: and when the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.
bsb_text: So as the living creatures moved, the wheels moved beside them, and when the creatures rose from the ground, the wheels also rose.
aov_text: En as die wesens gaan, gaan die wiele naasaan hulle; en as die wesens hulle van die grond af ophef, word die wiele opgehef.

kjv_text: Whithersoever the spirit was to go, they went, thither was their spirit to go; and the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
bsb_text: Wherever the spirit would go, they would go, and the wheels would rise alongside them, because the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.
aov_text: Waar die gees ook heen wou gaan, het hulle gegaan in die rigting wat die gees wou gaan; en die wiele is gelyktydig saam met hulle opgehef, want die gees van die wese was in die wiele.

kjv_text: When those went, these went; and when those stood, these stood; and when those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
bsb_text: When the creatures moved, the wheels moved; when the creatures stood still, the wheels stood still; and when the creatures rose from the ground, the wheels rose alongside them, because the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.
aov_text: As dié gaan, gaan hulle; en as dié bly staan, staan hulle; en as dié hulle van die grond af ophef, word die wiele gelyktydig saam met hulle opgehef, want die gees van die wesens was in die wiele.

kjv_text: And the likeness of the firmament upon the heads of the living creature was as the colour of the terrible crystal, stretched forth over their heads above.
bsb_text: Spread out above the heads of the living creatures was the likeness of an awesome expanse, gleaming like crystal.
aov_text: En oor die hoofde van die wesens was iets in die vorm van ’n uitspansel wat blink soos die wonderbare kristal, bo-oor hulle hoofde uitgesprei.

kjv_text: And under the firmament were their wings straight, the one toward the other: every one had two, which covered on this side, and every one had two, which covered on that side, their bodies.
bsb_text: And under the expanse, their wings stretched out toward one another. Each one also had two wings covering its body.
aov_text: En onder die uitspansel heen was hulle vlerke reguit na mekaar uitgestrek; en elkeen het twee gehad wat duskant en anderkant hul liggame bedek het.

kjv_text: And when they went, I heard the noise of their wings, like the noise of great waters, as the voice of the Almighty, the voice of speech, as the noise of an host: when they stood, they let down their wings.
bsb_text: When the creatures moved, I heard the sound of their wings like the roar of many waters, like the voice of the Almighty, like the tumult of an army. When they stood still, they lowered their wings.
aov_text: En as hulle gaan, het ek die geruis van hulle vlerke gehoor soos die geruis van baie waters, soos die stem van die Almagtige—’n gedruis soos die gedreun van ’n leër. As hulle staan, het hulle hul vlerke laat sak.

kjv_text: And there was a voice from the firmament that was over their heads, when they stood, and had let down their wings.
bsb_text: And there came a voice from above the expanse over their heads as they stood still with their wings lowered.
aov_text: En daar het ’n stem gekom bo van die uitspansel af wat oor hulle hoof was; as hulle staan, het hulle hul vlerke laat sak.

kjv_text: And above the firmament that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone: and upon the likeness of the throne was the likeness as the appearance of a man above upon it.
bsb_text: Above the expanse over their heads was the likeness of a throne with the appearance of sapphire, and on the throne high above was a figure like that of a man.
aov_text: En bokant die uitspansel wat oor hulle hoof was, was iets wat soos saffiersteen gelyk het, in die gestalte van ’n troon; en op die troongestalte ’n gestalte wat soos ’n mens gelyk het.

kjv_text: And I saw as the colour of amber, as the appearance of fire round about within it, from the appearance of his loins even upward, and from the appearance of his loins even downward, I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and it had brightness round about.
bsb_text: From what seemed to be His waist up, I saw a gleam like amber, with what looked like fire within it all around. And from what seemed to be His waist down, I saw what looked like fire; and brilliant light surrounded Him.
aov_text: Ek sien toe iets soos blinkende metaal; van wat soos sy lendene gelyk het boontoe soos vuur, rondom in ’n omhulsel gevat; en van wat soos sy lendene gelyk het ondertoe, het ek iets gesien soos vuur met ’n glans daaromheen.

kjv_text: As the appearance of the bow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness round about. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the LORD. And when I saw it, I fell upon my face, and I heard a voice of one that spake.
bsb_text: The appearance of the brilliant light all around Him was like that of a rainbow in a cloud on a rainy day. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the LORD. And when I saw it, I fell facedown and heard a voice speaking.
aov_text: Soos die gedaante van die boog wat in die wolk is op ’n reëndag, so het die glans rondom gelyk. So het die verskyning van die heerlikheid van die HERE gelyk. En toe ek dit sien, het ek op my aangesig geval en die stem gehoor van Een wat spreek.

kjv_text: And he said unto me, Son of man, stand upon thy feet, and I will speak unto thee.
bsb_text: “Son of man,” He said to me, “stand up on your feet and I will speak to you.”
aov_text: EN Hy het vir my gesê: Mensekind, staan op jou voete, dat Ek met jou kan spreek.

kjv_text: And the spirit entered into me when he spake unto me, and set me upon my feet, that I heard him that spake unto me.
bsb_text: And as He spoke to me, the Spirit entered me and set me on my feet, and I heard Him speaking to me.
aov_text: En die Gees het in my gekom sodra Hy met my gespreek het, en my op my voete laat staan; en ek het Hom gehoor wat met my gespreek het.

kjv_text: And he said unto me, Son of man, I send thee to the children of Israel, to a rebellious nation that hath rebelled against me: they and their fathers have transgressed against me, even unto this very day.
bsb_text: “Son of man,” He said to me, “I am sending you to the Israelites, to a rebellious nation that has rebelled against Me. To this very day they and their fathers have rebelled against Me.
aov_text: Hy sê toe vir my: Mensekind, Ek stuur jou na die kinders van Israel, na die opstandige nasies wat teen My opgestaan het; hulle en hul vaders het teen My oortree tot hierdie selfde dag toe.

kjv_text: For they are impudent children and stiffhearted. I do send thee unto them; and thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD.
bsb_text: They are obstinate and stubborn children. I am sending you to them, and you are to say to them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says.’
aov_text: En die kinders is hard van aangesig en verstok van hart. Ek stuur jou na hulle, en jy moet vir hulle sê: So spreek die Here HERE!

kjv_text: And they, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear, (for they are a rebellious house,) yet shall know that there hath been a prophet among them.
bsb_text: And whether they listen or refuse to listen—for they are a rebellious house—they will know that a prophet has been among them.
aov_text: Maar of hulle nou al luister of nie—want hulle is ’n wederstrewige huis—hulle sal moet erken dat daar ’n profeet in hulle midde gewees het.

kjv_text: And thou, son of man, be not afraid of them, neither be afraid of their words, though briers and thorns be with thee, and thou dost dwell among scorpions: be not afraid of their words, nor be dismayed at their looks, though they be a rebellious house.
bsb_text: But you, son of man, do not be afraid of them or their words. Do not be afraid, though briers and thorns surround you, and you dwell among scorpions. Do not be afraid of their words or dismayed by their presence, though they are a rebellious house.
aov_text: En jy, mensekind, wees nie vir hulle of vir hulle woorde bevrees nie, omdat distels en dorings by jou is, en jy by skerpioene woon; wees nie bevrees vir hulle woorde en wees voor hulle aangesig nie verskrik nie, want hulle is ’n wederstrewige huis.

kjv_text: And thou shalt speak my words unto them, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear: for they are most rebellious.
bsb_text: But speak My words to them, whether they listen or refuse to listen, for they are rebellious.
aov_text: Maar jy moet hulle my woorde verkondig, of hulle al luister of nie; want hulle is wederstrewig.

kjv_text: But thou, son of man, hear what I say unto thee; Be not thou rebellious like that rebellious house: open thy mouth, and eat that I give thee.
bsb_text: And you, son of man, listen to what I tell you. Do not be rebellious like that rebellious house. Open your mouth and eat what I give you.”
aov_text: Maar jy, mensekind, luister na wat Ek jou sê; wees nie wederstrewig soos die wederstrewige huis nie; maak jou mond wyd oop, en eet wat Ek jou gee.

kjv_text: And when I looked, behold, an hand was sent unto me; and, lo, a roll of a book was therein;
bsb_text: Then I looked and saw a hand reaching out to me, and in it was a scroll,
aov_text: Toe kyk ek, en daar was ’n hand na my toe uitgesteek, en daarin ’n boekrol!

kjv_text: And he spread it before me; and it was written within and without: and there was written therein lamentations, and mourning, and woe.
bsb_text: which He unrolled before me. And written on the front and back of it were words of lamentation, mourning, and woe.
aov_text: En Hy het dit voor my uitgesprei; en dit was beskrywe op die voor- en agterkant, en daarop was geskrywe klaagliedere en gesug en wee.

kjv_text: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, eat that thou findest; eat this roll, and go speak unto the house of Israel.
bsb_text: “Son of man,” He said to me, “eat what you find here. Eat this scroll, then go and speak to the house of Israel.”
aov_text: DAARNA het Hy vir my gesê: Mensekind, eet op wat jy vind; eet hierdie rol op, en gaan spreek met die huis van Israel.

kjv_text: So I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat that roll.
bsb_text: So I opened my mouth, and He fed me the scroll.
aov_text: Toe het ek my mond oopgemaak, en Hy het my dié rol laat eet

kjv_text: And he said unto me, Son of man, cause thy belly to eat, and fill thy bowels with this roll that I give thee. Then did I eat it; and it was in my mouth as honey for sweetness.
bsb_text: “Son of man,” He said to me, “eat and fill your stomach with this scroll I am giving you.” So I ate, and it was as sweet as honey in my mouth.
aov_text: en vir my gesê: Mensekind, laat jou buik eet, en vul jou ingewande met hierdie rol wat Ek jou gee. En ek het dit geëet, en dit was in my mond soos heuning so soet.

kjv_text: And he said unto me, Son of man, go, get thee unto the house of Israel, and speak with my words unto them.
bsb_text: Then He said to me, “Son of man, go now to the house of Israel and speak My words to them.
aov_text: En Hy het vir my gesê: Mensekind, kom, gaan na die huis van Israel, en spreek hulle aan met my woorde;

kjv_text: For thou art not sent to a people of a strange speech and of an hard language, but to the house of Israel;
bsb_text: For you are not being sent to a people of unfamiliar speech or difficult language, but to the house of Israel—
aov_text: want jy is nie gestuur na ’n volk wat duister van spraak en swaar van tong is nie, maar na die huis van Israel;

kjv_text: Not to many people of a strange speech and of an hard language, whose words thou canst not understand. Surely, had I sent thee to them, they would have hearkened unto thee.
bsb_text: not to the many peoples of unfamiliar speech and difficult language whose words you cannot understand. Surely if I had sent you to them, they would have listened to you.
aov_text: nie na baie volke wat duister van spraak en swaar van tong is nie, wie se woorde jy nie kan verstaan nie; as Ek jou tog na hulle gestuur het, het húlle na jou geluister!

kjv_text: But the house of Israel will not hearken unto thee; for they will not hearken unto me: for all the house of Israel are impudent and hardhearted.
bsb_text: But the house of Israel will be unwilling to listen to you, since they are unwilling to listen to Me. For the whole house of Israel is hard-headed and hard-hearted.
aov_text: Maar die huis van Israel sal na jou nie wil luister nie, omdat hulle na My nie wil luister nie; want die hele huis van Israel het ’n harde voorhoof en ’n ongevoelige hart.

kjv_text: Behold, I have made thy face strong against their faces, and thy forehead strong against their foreheads.
bsb_text: Behold, I will make your face as hard as their faces, and your forehead as hard as their foreheads.
aov_text: Kyk, Ek maak jou aangesig hard net soos hulle aangesig en jou voorhoof hard net soos hulle voorhoof.

kjv_text: As an adamant harder than flint have I made thy forehead: fear them not, neither be dismayed at their looks, though they be a rebellious house.
bsb_text: I will make your forehead like a diamond, harder than flint. Do not be afraid of them or dismayed at their presence, even though they are a rebellious house.”
aov_text: Jou voorhoof maak Ek hard soos ’n diamant, harder as ’n rots; jy mag nie vir hulle bevrees of vir hulle verskrik wees nie, omdat hulle ’n wederstrewige huis is.

kjv_text: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, all my words that I shall speak unto thee receive in thine heart, and hear with thine ears.
bsb_text: “Son of man,” He added, “listen carefully to all the words I speak to you, and take them to heart.
aov_text: Verder het Hy vir my gesê: Mensekind, neem al my woorde wat Ek vir jou sal sê, in jou hart op, en hoor hulle met jou ore;

kjv_text: And go, get thee to them of the captivity, unto the children of thy people, and speak unto them, and tell them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear.
bsb_text: Go to your people, the exiles; speak to them and tell them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says,’ whether they listen or refuse to listen.”
aov_text: en kom, gaan na die ballinge, na die kinders van jou volk, en spreek met hulle en sê vir hulle: So spreek die Here HERE—of hulle al luister of nie.

kjv_text: Then the spirit took me up, and I heard behind me a voice of a great rushing, saying, Blessed be the glory of the LORD from his place.
bsb_text: Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard a great rumbling sound behind me: ‘Blessed be the glory of the LORD in His dwelling place!’
aov_text: Toe het die Gees my opgeneem, en ek het agter my die geluid van ’n groot gedreun gehoor wat sê: Geloofd sy die heerlikheid van die HERE uit sy woonplek!

kjv_text: I heard also the noise of the wings of the living creatures that touched one another, and the noise of the wheels over against them, and a noise of a great rushing.
bsb_text: It was the sound of the wings of the living creatures brushing against one another and the sound of the wheels beside them, a great rumbling sound.
aov_text: En ek het gehoor die geluid van die wesens se vlerke wat die een aan die ander verbind was, en die geluid van die wiele gelyktydig daarmee en die geluid van ’n groot gedreun.

kjv_text: So the spirit lifted me up, and took me away, and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; but the hand of the LORD was strong upon me.
bsb_text: So the Spirit lifted me up and took me away, and I went in bitterness and in the anger of my spirit, with the strong hand of the LORD upon me.
aov_text: Toe het die Gees my opgehef en my weggeneem, en ek het gegaan, verbitterd in die grimmigheid van my gees; maar die hand van die HERE was sterk op my.

kjv_text: Then I came to them of the captivity at Telabib, that dwelt by the river of Chebar, and I sat where they sat, and remained there astonished among them seven days.
bsb_text: I came to the exiles at Tel-abib who dwelt by the River Kebar. And for seven days I sat where they sat and remained there among them, overwhelmed.
aov_text: En ek het by die ballinge gekom in Tel-Abib, wat by die Kebarrivier gewoon het, en by die plek van hulle woning; en ek het daar sewe dae lank verstom in hulle midde gesit.

kjv_text: And it came to pass at the end of seven days, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
bsb_text: At the end of seven days the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
aov_text: EN aan die einde van sewe dae het die woord van die HERE tot my gekom en gesê:

kjv_text: Son of man, I have made thee a watchman unto the house of Israel: therefore hear the word at my mouth, and give them warning from me.
bsb_text: “Son of man, I have made you a watchman for the house of Israel. Whenever you hear a word from My mouth, give them a warning from Me.
aov_text: Mensekind, Ek het jou as wag vir die huis van Israel aangestel; en as jy ’n woord uit my mond hoor, moet jy hulle van my kant waarsku.

kjv_text: When I say unto the wicked, Thou shalt surely die; and thou givest him not warning, nor speakest to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life; the same wicked man shall die in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at thine hand.
bsb_text: If I say to the wicked man, ‘You will surely die,’ but you do not warn him or speak out to warn him from his wicked way to save his life, that wicked man will die in his iniquity, and I will hold you responsible for his blood.
aov_text: As Ek aan die goddelose sê: Jy sal sekerlik sterwe—en jy waarsku hom nie en spreek nie om die goddelose vir sy goddelose weg te waarsku om hom in die lewe te hou nie, dan sal hy, die goddelose, deur sy ongeregtigheid sterwe; maar sy bloed sal Ek van jou hand eis.

kjv_text: Yet if thou warn the wicked, and he turn not from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he shall die in his iniquity; but thou hast delivered thy soul.
bsb_text: But if you warn a wicked man and he does not turn from his wickedness and his wicked way, he will die in his iniquity, but you will have saved yourself.
aov_text: Maar as jý die goddelose waarsku, en hy hom nie van sy goddeloosheid en van sy goddelose weg bekeer nie, dan sal hy deur sy ongeregtigheid sterwe; maar jý het jou siel gered.

kjv_text: Again, When a righteous man doth turn from his righteousness, and commit iniquity, and I lay a stumbling-block before him, he shall die: because thou hast not given him warning, he shall die in his sin, and his righteousness which he hath done shall not be remembered; but his blood will I require at thine hand.
bsb_text: Now if a righteous man turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity, and I put a stumbling block before him, he will die. If you did not warn him, he will die in his sin, and the righteous acts he did will not be remembered. And I will hold you responsible for his blood.
aov_text: En as ’n regverdige hom van sy geregtigheid afkeer en onreg doen, en Ek ’n struikelblok voor hom gooi, dan sal hy sterwe; omdat jy hom nie gewaarsku het nie, sal hy deur sy sonde sterwe, en aan sy geregtigheid wat hy beoefen het, sal nie gedink word nie; maar sy bloed sal Ek van jou hand eis.

kjv_text: Nevertheless if thou warn the righteous man, that the righteous sin not, and he doth not sin, he shall surely live, because he is warned; also thou hast delivered thy soul.
bsb_text: But if you warn the righteous man not to sin, and he does not sin, he will indeed live because he heeded your warning, and you will have saved yourself.”
aov_text: Maar as jý die regverdige waarsku, dat die regverdige nie moet sondig nie, en hy sondig nie, dan sal hy sekerlik lewe, omdat hy hom laat waarsku het; en jy het jou siel gered.

kjv_text: And the hand of the LORD was there upon me; and he said unto me, Arise, go forth into the plain, and I will there talk with thee.
bsb_text: And there the hand of the LORD was upon me, and He said to me, “Get up, go out to the plain, and there I will speak with you.”
aov_text: En die hand van die HERE was daar op my, en Hy het vir my gesê: Staan op, gaan uit na die laagte, en Ek sal daar met jou spreek.

kjv_text: Then I arose, and went forth into the plain: and, behold, the glory of the LORD stood there, as the glory which I saw by the river of Chebar: and I fell on my face.
bsb_text: So I got up and went out to the plain, and behold, the glory of the LORD was present there, like the glory I had seen by the River Kebar, and I fell facedown.
