aov_text: Ek staan toe op en gaan na die laagte uit; en kyk, die heerlikheid van die HERE het daar gestaan soos die heerlikheid wat ek by die Kebarrivier gesien het. En ek het op my aangesig geval.

kjv_text: Then the spirit entered into me, and set me upon my feet, and spake with me, and said unto me, Go, shut thyself within thine house.
bsb_text: Then the Spirit entered me and set me on my feet. He spoke with me and said, “Go, shut yourself inside your house.
aov_text: Toe kom die Gees in my en laat my op my voete staan; en Hy het met my gespreek en vir my gesê: Gaan in, sluit jou toe in jou huis.

kjv_text: But thou, O son of man, behold, they shall put bands upon thee, and shall bind thee with them, and thou shalt not go out among them:
bsb_text: And you, son of man, they will tie with ropes, and you will be bound so that you cannot go out among the people.
aov_text: En jy, mensekind, kyk, hulle sit vir jou toue aan en bind jou daarmee, sodat jy nie onder hulle kan uitgaan nie.

kjv_text: And I will make thy tongue cleave to the roof of thy mouth, that thou shalt be dumb, and shalt not be to them a reprover: for they are a rebellious house.
bsb_text: I will make your tongue stick to the roof of your mouth, and you will be silent and unable to rebuke them, though they are a rebellious house.
aov_text: En Ek sal jou tong aan jou verhemelte laat klewe, sodat jy stom sal word en vir hulle geen bestraffer sal wees nie; want hulle is ’n wederstrewige huis.

kjv_text: But when I speak with thee, I will open thy mouth, and thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; He that heareth, let him hear; and he that forbeareth, let him forbear: for they are a rebellious house.
bsb_text: But when I speak with you, I will open your mouth, and you are to tell them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says.’ Whoever listens, let him listen; and whoever refuses, let him refuse, for they are a rebellious house.
aov_text: Maar as Ek met jou spreek, sal Ek jou mond open, en jy moet aan hulle sê: So spreek die Here HERE. Wie hoor, laat hom hoor; en wie dit nalaat, laat hom dit nalaat; want hulle is ’n wederstrewige huis.

kjv_text: Thou also, son of man, take thee a tile, and lay it before thee, and pourtray upon it the city, even Jerusalem:
bsb_text: “Now you, son of man, take a brick, place it before you, and draw on it the city of Jerusalem.
aov_text: EN jy, mensekind, neem vir jou ’n baksteen en sit dit voor jou neer, en teken daarop ’n stad, naamlik Jerusalem;

kjv_text: And lay siege against it, and build a fort against it, and cast a mount against it; set the camp also against it, and set battering rams against it round about.
bsb_text: Then lay siege against it: Construct a siege wall, build a ramp to it, set up camps against it, and place battering rams around it on all sides.
aov_text: maak dan ’n beleëring daarteen en bou forte daarteen en gooi ’n wal daarteen op en stel laers daarteen op en lê stormramme daarteen aan rondom.

kjv_text: Moreover take thou unto thee an iron pan, and set it for a wall of iron between thee and the city: and set thy face against it, and it shall be besieged, and thou shalt lay siege against it. This shall be a sign to the house of Israel.
bsb_text: Then take an iron plate and set it up as an iron wall between yourself and the city. Turn your face toward it so that it is under siege, and besiege it. This will be a sign to the house of Israel.
aov_text: Verder, neem jy vir jou ’n ysterpan en sit dit as ’n ystermuur tussen jou en die stad; en rig jou aangesig daarop, en dit sal beleër wees, en jy moet dit beleër. ’n Teken is dit vir die huis van Israel.

kjv_text: Lie thou also upon thy left side, and lay the iniquity of the house of Israel upon it: according to the number of the days that thou shalt lie upon it thou shalt bear their iniquity.
bsb_text: Then lie down on your left side and place the iniquity of the house of Israel upon yourself. You are to bear their iniquity for the number of days you lie on your side.
aov_text: Gaan lê ook op jou linkerkant, en sit daarop die ongeregtigheid van die huis van Israel; volgens die getal dae dat jy daarop lê, moet jy hulle ongeregtigheid dra.

kjv_text: For I have laid upon thee the years of their iniquity, according to the number of the days, three hundred and ninety days: so shalt thou bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.
bsb_text: For I have assigned to you 390 days, according to the number of years of their iniquity. So you shall bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.
aov_text: En Ék lê jou die jare van hulle ongeregtigheid op volgens die getal dae, driehonderd-en-negentig dae, dat jy die ongeregtigheid van die huis van Israel moet dra.

kjv_text: And when thou hast accomplished them, lie again on thy right side, and thou shalt bear the iniquity of the house of Judah forty days: I have appointed thee each day for a year.
bsb_text: When you have completed these days, lie down again, but on your right side, and bear the iniquity of the house of Judah. I have assigned to you 40 days, a day for each year.
aov_text: En as jy met hierdie dae klaar is, moet jy, vir die tweede keer, op jou regterkant gaan lê en die ongeregtigheid van die huis van Juda dra, veertig dae lank: vir elke jaar lê Ek jou een dag op.

kjv_text: Therefore thou shalt set thy face toward the siege of Jerusalem, and thine arm shall be uncovered, and thou shalt prophesy against it.
bsb_text: You must turn your face toward the siege of Jerusalem with your arm bared, and prophesy against it.

kjv_text: And, behold, I will lay bands upon thee, and thou shalt not turn thee from one side to another, till thou hast ended the days of thy siege.
bsb_text: Now behold, I will tie you up with ropes so you cannot turn from side to side until you have finished the days of your siege.

kjv_text: Take thou also unto thee wheat, and barley, and beans, and lentiles, and millet, and fitches, and put them in one vessel, and make thee bread thereof, according to the number of the days that thou shalt lie upon thy side, three hundred and ninety days shalt thou eat thereof.

kjv_text: And thy meat which thou shalt eat shall be by weight, twenty shekels a day: from time to time shalt thou eat it.
bsb_text: You are to weigh out twenty shekels of food to eat each day, and you are to eat it at set times.

aov_text: Jy moet ook water by die maat drink, die sesde deel van ’n hin; van tyd tot tyd moet jy drink.

kjv_text: And thou shalt eat it as barley cakes, and thou shalt bake it with dung that cometh out of man, in their sight.

kjv_text: Then said I, Ah Lord GOD! behold, my soul hath not been polluted: for from my youth up even till now have I not eaten of that which dieth of itself, or is torn in pieces; neither came there abominable flesh into my mouth.
bsb_text: “Ah, Lord GOD,” I said, “I have never defiled myself. From my youth until now I have not eaten anything found dead or mauled by wild beasts. No unclean meat has ever entered my mouth.”
aov_text: En ek sê: Ag, Here HERE! Kyk, my siel is nooit verontreinig nie, en ek het van my jeug af tot nou toe geen aas of iets wat verskeur is, geëet nie, en daar het geen bedorwe vleis in my mond gekom nie.

kjv_text: Then he said unto me, Lo, I have given thee cow's dung for man's dung, and thou shalt prepare thy bread therewith.
bsb_text: “Look,” He replied, “I will let you use cow dung instead of human excrement, and you may bake your bread over that.”
aov_text: Toe sê Hy vir my: Kyk, Ek het vir jou beesmis gegee in plaas van mensedrek; daarop moet jy jou brood klaarmaak.

kjv_text: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, behold, I will break the staff of bread in Jerusalem: and they shall eat bread by weight, and with care; and they shall drink water by measure, and with astonishment:

kjv_text: That they may want bread and water, and be astonied one with another, and consume away for their iniquity.

kjv_text: Thou shalt burn with fire a third part in the midst of the city, when the days of the siege are fulfilled: and thou shalt take a third part, and smite about it with a knife: and a third part thou shalt scatter in the wind; and I will draw out a sword after them.
bsb_text: When the days of the siege have ended, you are to burn up a third of the hair inside the city; you are also to take a third and slash it with the sword all around the city; and you are to scatter a third to the wind. For I will unleash a sword behind them.

kjv_text: Thou shalt also take thereof a few in number, and bind them in thy skirts.

kjv_text: Thus saith the Lord GOD; This is Jerusalem: I have set it in the midst of the nations and countries that are round about her.

kjv_text: And she hath changed my judgments into wickedness more than the nations, and my statutes more than the countries that are round about her: for they have refused my judgments and my statutes, they have not walked in them.

bsb_text: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘You have been more insubordinate than the nations around you; you have not walked in My statutes or kept My ordinances, nor have you even conformed to the ordinances of the nations around you.’

kjv_text: And I will do in thee that which I have not done, and whereunto I will not do any more the like, because of all thine abominations.

kjv_text: Wherefore, as I live, saith the Lord GOD; Surely, because thou hast defiled my sanctuary with all thy detestable things, and with all thine abominations, therefore will I also diminish thee; neither shall mine eye spare, neither will I have any pity.

kjv_text: A third part of thee shall die with the pestilence, and with famine shall they be consumed in the midst of thee: and a third part shall fall by the sword round about thee; and I will scatter a third part into all the winds, and I will draw out a sword after them.

kjv_text: Thus shall mine anger be accomplished, and I will cause my fury to rest upon them, and I will be comforted: and they shall know that I the LORD have spoken it in my zeal, when I have accomplished my fury in them.

kjv_text: Moreover I will make thee waste, and a reproach among the nations that are round about thee, in the sight of all that pass by.
bsb_text: I will make you a ruin and a disgrace among the nations around you, in the sight of all who pass by.
aov_text: En Ek sal jou ’n puinhoop en ’n voorwerp van smaad maak onder die nasies wat rondom jou is, voor die oë van almal wat verbygaan.

bsb_text: So you will be a reproach and a taunt, a warning and a horror to the nations around you, when I execute judgments against you in anger, wrath, and raging fury. I, the LORD, have spoken.
aov_text: En dit sal ’n voorwerp van smaad en skimp wees, ’n waarskuwing en ’n voorwerp van verbasing vir die nasies wat rondom jou is, as Ek strafgerigte in jou oefen in toorn en grimmigheid en in grimmige strawwe; Ek, die HERE, het dit gespreek.

kjv_text: When I shall send upon them the evil arrows of famine, which shall be for their destruction, and which I will send to destroy you: and I will increase the famine upon you, and will break your staff of bread:

kjv_text: So will I send upon you famine and evil beasts, and they shall bereave thee; and pestilence and blood shall pass through thee; and I will bring the sword upon thee. I the LORD have spoken it.

bsb_text: The time has come; the day has arrived. Let the buyer not rejoice and the seller not mourn, for wrath is upon the whole multitude.
aov_text: Die tyd het gekom, die dag is naby; laat die koper nie bly wees nie en die verkoper nie treur nie; want toorngloed is daar oor die hele menigte van die land.

kjv_text: For the seller shall not return to that which is sold, although they were yet alive: for the vision is touching the whole multitude thereof, which shall not return; neither shall any strengthen himself in the iniquity of his life.
bsb_text: The seller will surely not recover what he sold while both remain alive. For the vision concerning the whole multitude will not be revoked, and because of their iniquity, not one of them will preserve his life.
aov_text: Want die verkoper sal nie teruggaan na wat verkoop is nie—ook as hy nog in die lewe is; want die gesig aangaande die hele menigte van die land sal nie herroep word nie, en niemand sal homself deur sy ongeregtigheid in sy lewenskrag versterk nie.

kjv_text: They have blown the trumpet, even to make all ready; but none goeth to the battle: for my wrath is upon all the multitude thereof.
bsb_text: They have blown the trumpet and made everything ready, but no one goes to war, for My wrath is upon the whole multitude.
aov_text: Hulle blaas met die trompet en maak alles klaar, maar niemand trek na die oorlog toe nie; want my toorngloed is oor die hele menigte van die land.

kjv_text: The sword is without, and the pestilence and the famine within: he that is in the field shall die with the sword; and he that is in the city, famine and pestilence shall devour him.
bsb_text: The sword is outside; plague and famine are within. Those in the country will die by the sword, and those in the city will be devoured by famine and plague.
aov_text: Die swaard buite, en die pes en die hongersnood binne; hy wat in die veld is, sal deur die swaard sterwe; en hy wat in die stad is, hom sal die hongersnood en die pes verteer.

kjv_text: But they that escape of them shall escape, and shall be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them mourning, every one for his iniquity.
bsb_text: The survivors will escape and live in the mountains, moaning like doves of the valley, each for his own iniquity.
aov_text: En die wat uit hulle ontvlug, sal ontvlug; maar hulle sal op die berge wees soos duiwe van die klowe wat almal klaag, elkeen vanweë sy ongeregtigheid.

kjv_text: All hands shall be feeble, and all knees shall be weak as water.
bsb_text: Every hand will go limp, and every knee will turn to water.
aov_text: Almal se hande sal slap word, en almal se knieë sal wegvloei soos water.

kjv_text: They shall also gird themselves with sackcloth, and horror shall cover them; and shame shall be upon all faces, and baldness upon all their heads.
bsb_text: They will put on sackcloth, and terror will overwhelm them. Shame will cover all their faces, and all their heads will be shaved.
aov_text: Ook sal hulle rouklere aangord, en angs sal hulle oordek; en oor al die aangesigte sal skaamte wees en op al hulle hoofde ’n kaalte.

kjv_text: They shall cast their silver in the streets, and their gold shall be removed: their silver and their gold shall not be able to deliver them in the day of the wrath of the LORD: they shall not satisfy their souls, neither fill their bowels: because it is the stumblingblock of their iniquity.
bsb_text: They will throw their silver into the streets, and their gold will seem unclean. Their silver and gold cannot save them in the day of the wrath of the LORD. They cannot satisfy their appetites or fill their stomachs with wealth, for it became the stumbling block that brought their iniquity.
aov_text: Hul silwer sal hulle op die strate gooi, en hulle goud sal ’n voorwerp van afsku wees; hul silwer en hul goud sal hulle nie kan red in die dag van die grimmigheid van die HERE nie; hul siel sal hulle daarmee nie versadig of hul ingewande daarmee vul nie, want dit was die struikelblok tot hulle ongeregtigheid.

kjv_text: As for the beauty of his ornament, he set it in majesty: but they made the images of their abominations and of their detestable things therein: therefore have I set it far from them.
bsb_text: His beautiful ornaments they transformed into pride and used them to fashion their vile images and detestable idols. Therefore I will make these into something unclean for them.
aov_text: En die pragtige sieraad daarvan het hulle as voorwerp van trots opgestel, en die beelde van hul gruwels, hul verfoeisels het hulle daarmee gemaak; daarom het Ek dit vir hulle tot ’n voorwerp van afsku gemaak.

kjv_text: And I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey, and to the wicked of the earth for a spoil; and they shall pollute it.
bsb_text: And I will hand these things over as plunder to foreigners and loot to the wicked of the earth, who will defile them.
aov_text: En Ek sal dit in die hand van vreemdes oorgee as roof en aan die goddelose van die aarde as buit, dat hulle dit ontheilig.

kjv_text: My face will I turn also from them, and they shall pollute my secret place: for the robbers shall enter into it, and defile it.
bsb_text: I will turn My face away from them, and they will defile My treasured place. Violent men will enter it, and they will defile it.
aov_text: Ook sal Ek my aangesig van hulle afwend, en hulle sal my skat ontheilig: inbrekers sal daar inkom en dit ontheilig.

kjv_text: Make a chain: for the land is full of bloody crimes, and the city is full of violence.
bsb_text: Forge the chain, for the land is full of crimes of bloodshed, and the city is full of violence.
aov_text: Maak ’n ketting klaar, want die land is vol bloedgerigte en die stad is vol geweld.

kjv_text: Wherefore I will bring the worst of the heathen, and they shall possess their houses: I will also make the pomp of the strong to cease; and their holy places shall be defiled.
bsb_text: So I will bring the most wicked of nations to take possession of their houses. I will end the pride of the mighty, and their holy places will be profaned.
aov_text: Daarom sal Ek die kwaadaardigste nasies laat kom, wat hulle huise in besit sal neem, en Ek sal die trots van die sterkes laat ophou, en hulle heiligdomme sal ontheilig word.

kjv_text: Destruction cometh; and they shall seek peace, and there shall be none.
bsb_text: Anguish is coming! They will seek peace, but find none.
aov_text: Die angs kom; en hulle soek vrede, maar dit is nie daar nie.

kjv_text: Mischief shall come upon mischief, and rumour shall be upon rumour; then shall they seek a vision of the prophet; but the law shall perish from the priest, and counsel from the ancients.
bsb_text: Disaster upon disaster will come, and rumor after rumor. Then they will seek a vision from a prophet, but instruction from the priests will perish, as will counsel from the elders.
aov_text: Onheil op onheil kom, en gerug op gerug is daar; en hulle sal ’n gesig verlang van die profeet, maar die wet sal verlore wees vir die priester en die raad vir die oudstes.

kjv_text: The king shall mourn, and the prince shall be clothed with desolation, and the hands of the people of the land shall be troubled: I will do unto them after their way, and according to their deserts will I judge them; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
bsb_text: The king will mourn, the prince will be clothed with despair, and the hands of the people of the land will tremble. I will deal with them according to their conduct, and I will judge them by their own standards. Then they will know that I am the LORD.’”
aov_text: Die koning sal rou, en die vors sal hom beklee met verbasing, en die hande van die mense van die land sal deur skrik verlam wees. Ek sal met hulle handel volgens hulle weg, en volgens hulle verordeninge sal Ek hulle vonnis; en hulle sal weet dat Ek die HERE is.

kjv_text: And it came to pass in the sixth year, in the sixth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I sat in mine house, and the elders of Judah sat before me, that the hand of the Lord GOD fell there upon me.
bsb_text: In the sixth year, on the fifth day of the sixth month, I was sitting in my house, and the elders of Judah were sitting before me; and there the hand of the Lord GOD fell upon me.
aov_text: EN in die sesde jaar, in die sesde maand, op die vyfde van die maand, terwyl ek in my huis sit en die oudstes van Juda voor my sit, het die hand van die Here HERE daar op my geval.

kjv_text: Then I beheld, and lo a likeness as the appearance of fire: from the appearance of his loins even downward, fire; and from his loins even upward, as the appearance of brightness, as the colour of amber.
bsb_text: Then I looked and saw a figure like that of a man. From His waist down His appearance was like fire, and from His waist up He was as bright as the gleam of amber.
aov_text: Ek kyk toe—en daar was ’n gestalte wat soos vuur gelyk het; van wat soos sy lendene gelyk het en ondertoe, was vuur, en van sy lendene af en boontoe iets net soos ’n hemelglans wat soos blinkende metaal geskyn het.

kjv_text: And he put forth the form of an hand, and took me by a lock of mine head; and the spirit lifted me up between the earth and the heaven, and brought me in the visions of God to Jerusalem, to the door of the inner gate that looketh toward the north; where was the seat of the image of jealousy, which provoketh to jealousy.
bsb_text: He stretched out what looked like a hand and took me by the hair of my head. Then the Spirit lifted me up between earth and heaven and carried me in visions of God to Jerusalem, to the entrance of the north gate of the inner court, where the idol that provokes jealousy was seated.
aov_text: Toe steek Hy iets uit wat die vorm van ’n hand het, en vat my aan die kuifhare van my hoof; en die Gees het my opgehef tussen die aarde en die hemel en my in gesigte van God na Jerusalem gebring, by die ingang van die binneste poort wat na die noorde toe kyk, waar die plek was van die afgodsbeeld van ywer wat ywer verwek.

kjv_text: And, behold, the glory of the God of Israel was there, according to the vision that I saw in the plain.
bsb_text: And there I saw the glory of the God of Israel, like the vision I had seen in the plain.
aov_text: En kyk, die heerlikheid van die God van Israel was daar, ooreenkomstig die verskyning wat ek in die laagte gesien het.

kjv_text: Then said he unto me, Son of man, lift up thine eyes now the way toward the north. So I lifted up mine eyes the way toward the north, and behold northward at the gate of the altar this image of jealousy in the entry.
bsb_text: “Son of man,” He said to me, “now lift up your eyes to the north.” So I lifted up my eyes to the north, and in the entrance north of the Altar Gate I saw this idol of jealousy.
aov_text: En Hy sê vir my: Mensekind, slaan tog jou oë op in die rigting van die noorde; en ek het my oë opgeslaan in die rigting van die noorde—en daar was aan die noordekant van die altaarpoort daardie afgodsbeeld van ywer by die ingang!

kjv_text: He said furthermore unto me, Son of man, seest thou what they do? even the great abominations that the house of Israel committeth here, that I should go far off from my sanctuary? but turn thee yet again, and thou shalt see greater abominations.
bsb_text: “Son of man,” He said to me, “do you see what they are doing—the great abominations that the house of Israel is committing—to drive Me far from My sanctuary? Yet you will see even greater abominations.”
aov_text: En Hy sê vir my: Mensekind, sien jy wat hulle doen, die groot gruwels wat die huis van Israel hier aanrig, dat Ek ver van my heiligdom af moet weggaan? Maar jy sal nog ander groot gruwels sien.

kjv_text: And he brought me to the door of the court; and when I looked, behold a hole in the wall.
bsb_text: Then He brought me to the entrance to the court, and I looked and saw a hole in the wall.
aov_text: Daarop bring Hy my by die ingang van die voorhof. Ek kyk toe—en daar was ’n gat in die muur.

kjv_text: Then said he unto me, Son of man, dig now in the wall: and when I had digged in the wall, behold a door.
bsb_text: “Son of man,” He told me, “dig through the wall.” So I dug through the wall and discovered a doorway.
aov_text: En Hy sê vir my: Mensekind, breek tog deur die muur heen. En ek het deur die muur heen gebreek, en kyk, daar was ’n deur.

kjv_text: And he said unto me, Go in, and behold the wicked abominations that they do here.
bsb_text: Then He said to me, “Go in and see the wicked abominations they are committing here.”
aov_text: Daarop sê Hy vir my: Gaan in, en kyk na die growwe gruwels wat hulle hier doen.

kjv_text: So I went in and saw; and behold every form of creeping things, and abominable beasts, and all the idols of the house of Israel, pourtrayed upon the wall round about.
bsb_text: So I went in and looked, and engraved all around the wall was every kind of crawling creature and detestable beast, along with all the idols of the house of Israel.
aov_text: Ek gaan toe in en kyk—en daar was allerhande afbeeldinge van afskuwelike kruipende en viervoetige diere, en allerhande drekgode van die huis van Israel wat al rondom op die muur uitgesny was.

kjv_text: And there stood before them seventy men of the ancients of the house of Israel, and in the midst of them stood Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan, with every man his censer in his hand; and a thick cloud of incense went up.
bsb_text: Before them stood seventy elders of the house of Israel, with Jaazaniah son of Shaphan standing among them. Each had a censer in his hand, and a fragrant cloud of incense was rising.
aov_text: En sewentig manne uit die oudstes van die huis van Israel het daarvoor gestaan, en Jaäsanja, die seun van Safan, onder hulle; en elkeen het sy wierookpan in sy hand gehad, en die geur van die wolk van reukwerk het opgegaan.

kjv_text: Then said he unto me, Son of man, hast thou seen what the ancients of the house of Israel do in the dark, every man in the chambers of his imagery? for they say, The LORD seeth us not; the LORD hath forsaken the earth.
bsb_text: “Son of man,” He said to me, “do you see what the elders of the house of Israel are doing in the darkness, each at the shrine of his own idol? For they are saying, ‘The LORD does not see us; the LORD has forsaken the land.’”
aov_text: Toe sê Hy vir my: Het jy gesien, mensekind, wat die oudstes van die huis van Israel in die duisternis doen, elkeen in sy kamers met beeldwerk? Want hulle dink: Die HERE sien ons nie; die HERE het die land verlaat.

kjv_text: He said also unto me, Turn thee yet again, and thou shalt see greater abominations that they do.
bsb_text: Again, He told me, “You will see them committing even greater abominations.”
aov_text: En Hy sê vir my: Jy sal nog ander groot gruwels sien wat hulle doen.

kjv_text: Then he brought me to the door of the gate of the LORD's house which was toward the north; and, behold, there sat women weeping for Tammuz.
bsb_text: Then He brought me to the entrance of the north gate of the house of the LORD, and I saw women sitting there, weeping for Tammuz.
aov_text: Hy het my toe gebring na die noordelike ingang van die poort by die huis van die HERE, en kyk, daar het die vroue gesit wat Tammus beween.

kjv_text: Then said he unto me, Hast thou seen this, O son of man? turn thee yet again, and thou shalt see greater abominations than these.
bsb_text: “Son of man,” He said to me, “do you see this? Yet you will see even greater abominations than these.”
aov_text: En Hy sê vir my: Het jy dit gesien, mensekind? Jy sal nog ander gruwels, groter as hierdie, sien.

kjv_text: And he brought me into the inner court of the LORD's house, and, behold, at the door of the temple of the LORD, between the porch and the altar, were about five and twenty men, with their backs toward the temple of the LORD, and their faces toward the east; and they worshipped the sun toward the east.
bsb_text: So He brought me to the inner court of the house of the LORD, and there at the entrance to the temple of the LORD, between the portico and the altar, were about twenty-five men with their backs to the temple of the LORD and their faces toward the east; and they were bowing to the east in worship of the sun.
aov_text: Toe bring Hy my na die binneste voorhof van die huis van die HERE; en kyk, by die ingang van die tempel van die HERE, tussen die voorportaal en die altaar, was omtrent vyf-en-twintig man, met hulle rug na die tempel van die HERE en hulle gesig na die ooste, en hulle het hul voor die son neergebuig na die ooste.

kjv_text: Then he said unto me, Hast thou seen this, O son of man? Is it a light thing to the house of Judah that they commit the abominations which they commit here? for they have filled the land with violence, and have returned to provoke me to anger: and, lo, they put the branch to their nose.
bsb_text: “Son of man,” He said to me, “do you see this? Is it not enough for the house of Judah to commit the abominations they are practicing here, that they must also fill the land with violence and continually provoke Me to anger? Look, they are even putting the branch to their nose!
aov_text: En Hy sê vir my: Het jy dit gesien, mensekind? Is dit dan vir die huis van Juda te gering om die gruwels te doen wat hulle hier bedrywe, dat hulle die land met geweld gevul en My nog meer geterg het? En kyk hoe hulle die druiwetak by hulle neus hou!

kjv_text: Therefore will I also deal in fury: mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: and though they cry in mine ears with a loud voice, yet will I not hear them.
bsb_text: Therefore I will respond with wrath. I will not look on them with pity, nor will I spare them. Although they shout loudly in My ears, I will not listen to them.”
aov_text: Daarom sal Ék ook in grimmigheid handel; my oog sal nie verskoon nie, en Ek sal nie spaar nie; en al roep hulle hardop voor my ore, nogtans sal Ek na hulle nie luister nie.

kjv_text: He cried also in mine ears with a loud voice, saying, Cause them that have charge over the city to draw near, even every man with his destroying weapon in his hand.
bsb_text: Then I heard Him call out in a loud voice, saying, “Draw near, O executioners of the city, each with a weapon of destruction in hand.”
aov_text: DAARNA het Hy hardop voor my ore geroep en gesê: Kom nader, geregsdienaars van die stad, en elkeen met sy verwoestende wapen in sy hand.

kjv_text: And, behold, six men came from the way of the higher gate, which lieth toward the north, and every man a slaughter weapon in his hand; and one man among them was clothed with linen, with a writer's inkhorn by his side: and they went in, and stood beside the brasen altar.
bsb_text: And I saw six men coming from the direction of the Upper Gate, which faces north, each with a weapon of slaughter in his hand. With them was another man clothed in linen who had a writing kit at his side. And they came in and stood beside the bronze altar.
aov_text: En kyk, ses manne kom met die pad van die Boonste Poort wat na die noorde toe lê, en elkeen met sy wapen in sy hand om mee te verbrysel; en onder hulle een man wat met linne bekleed was, met ’n skrywer se inkpot aan sy heupe; en hulle het gekom en vlak by die koperaltaar gaan staan.

kjv_text: And the glory of the God of Israel was gone up from the cherub, whereupon he was, to the threshold of the house. And he called to the man clothed with linen, which had the writer's inkhorn by his side;
bsb_text: Then the glory of the God of Israel rose from above the cherubim, where it had been, and moved to the threshold of the temple. And He called to the man clothed in linen who had the writing kit at his side.
aov_text: En die heerlikheid van die God van Israel het opgestyg van die gérub waar dit op was, na die drumpel van die huis toe; en Hy het na die man geroep wat met linne bekleed was, wat die skrywer se inkpot aan sy heupe gehad het.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto him, Go through the midst of the city, through the midst of Jerusalem, and set a mark upon the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry for all the abominations that be done in the midst thereof.
bsb_text: “Go throughout the city of Jerusalem,” said the LORD, “and put a mark on the foreheads of the men sighing and groaning over all the abominations committed there.”
aov_text: En die HERE sê vir hom: Trek dwarsdeur die stad, dwarsdeur Jerusalem, en maak ’n teken op die voorhoofde van die manne wat sug en steun oor al die gruwels wat daarin gedoen word.

kjv_text: And to the others he said in mine hearing, Go ye after him through the city, and smite: let not your eye spare, neither have ye pity:
bsb_text: And as I listened, He said to the others, “Follow him through the city and start killing; do not show pity or spare anyone!
aov_text: Maar aan die ander sê Hy voor my ore: Trek agter hom aan deur die stad, en slaan; laat julle oog nie verskoon nie, en moet nie spaar nie;

kjv_text: Slay utterly old and young, both maids, and little children, and women: but come not near any man upon whom is the mark; and begin at my sanctuary. Then they began at the ancient men which were before the house.
bsb_text: Slaughter the old men, the young men and maidens, the women and children; but do not go near anyone who has the mark. Now begin at My sanctuary.” So they began with the elders who were before the temple.
aov_text: slaan dood grysaards, jongmanne en jongedogters en kinders en vroue tot vernietiging toe; maar raak aan niemand op wie die teken is nie, en begin by my heiligdom. En hulle het begin by die manne, die oudstes, wat voor die huis was.

kjv_text: And he said unto them, Defile the house, and fill the courts with the slain: go ye forth. And they went forth, and slew in the city.
bsb_text: Then He told them, “Defile the temple and fill the courts with the slain. Go forth!” So they went out and began killing throughout the city.
aov_text: En Hy sê vir hulle: Verontreinig die huis en maak die voorhowe vol met mense wat verslaan word. Trek uit! En hulle het uitgetrek en geslaan in die stad.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, while they were slaying them, and I was left, that I fell upon my face, and cried, and said, Ah Lord GOD! wilt thou destroy all the residue of Israel in thy pouring out of thy fury upon Jerusalem?
bsb_text: While they were killing, I was left alone. And I fell facedown and cried out, “Oh, Lord GOD, when You pour out Your wrath on Jerusalem, will You destroy the entire remnant of Israel?”
aov_text: En toe hulle besig was om neer te slaan en ek oorgebly het, het ek op my aangesig geval en uitgeroep en gesê: Ag, Here HERE, gaan U die hele oorblyfsel van Israel vernietig deurdat U u grimmigheid oor Jerusalem uitgiet?

kjv_text: Then said he unto me, The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah is exceeding great, and the land is full of blood, and the city full of perverseness: for they say, The LORD hath forsaken the earth, and the LORD seeth not.
bsb_text: He replied, “The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah is exceedingly great. The land is full of bloodshed, and the city is full of perversity. For they say, ‘The LORD has forsaken the land; the LORD does not see.’
aov_text: Toe sê Hy vir my: Die ongeregtigheid van die huis van Israel en van Juda is buitengewoon groot, en die land is vol bloedskuld, en die stad is vol regsverbreking; want hulle sê: Die HERE het die land verlaat, en die HERE sien nie.

kjv_text: And as for me also, mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity, but I will recompense their way upon their head.
bsb_text: But as for Me, I will not look on them with pity, nor will I spare them. I will bring their deeds down upon their own heads.”
aov_text: Daarom ook, wat My aangaan, my oog sal nie verskoon nie, en Ek sal nie spaar nie; Ek sal hulle wandel op hulle hoof laat neerkom.

kjv_text: And, behold, the man clothed with linen, which had the inkhorn by his side, reported the matter, saying, I have done as thou hast commanded me.
bsb_text: Then the man clothed in linen with the writing kit at his side reported back, “I have done as You commanded.”
aov_text: En kyk, die man wat met linne bekleed was, aan wie se heupe die inkpot was, het berig gebring en gesê: Ek het gedoen soos U my beveel het.

kjv_text: Then I looked, and, behold, in the firmament that was above the head of the cherubims there appeared over them as it were a sapphire stone, as the appearance of the likeness of a throne.
bsb_text: And I looked and saw above the expanse, above the heads of the cherubim, the likeness of a throne of sapphire.
aov_text: DAARNA het ek gekyk—en daar was op die uitspansel, oor die hoof van die gérubs, iets soos ’n saffiersteen; iets wat soos die gestalte van ’n troon gelyk het, het oor hulle sigbaar geword.

kjv_text: And he spake unto the man clothed with linen, and said, Go in between the wheels, even under the cherub, and fill thine hand with coals of fire from between the cherubims, and scatter them over the city. And he went in in my sight.
bsb_text: And the LORD said to the man clothed in linen, “Go inside the wheelwork beneath the cherubim. Fill your hands with burning coals from among the cherubim and scatter them over the city.” And as I watched, he went in.
aov_text: En Hy het die man aangespreek wat met linne bekleed was, en gesê: Gaan in tussen die ratwerk onder die gérub in, en vul jou twee hande met gloeiende kole tussen die gérubs vandaan, en strooi dit oor die stad. Toe gaan hy voor my oë daar in.

kjv_text: Now the cherubims stood on the right side of the house, when the man went in; and the cloud filled the inner court.
bsb_text: Now when the man went in, the cherubim were standing on the south side of the temple, and a cloud filled the inner court.
aov_text: En die gérubs het aan die regterkant van die huis gestaan toe die man daar ingaan, en die wolk het die binneste voorhof gevul.

kjv_text: Then the glory of the LORD went up from the cherub, and stood over the threshold of the house; and the house was filled with the cloud, and the court was full of the brightness of the LORD's glory.
bsb_text: Then the glory of the LORD rose from above the cherubim and stood over the threshold of the temple. The temple was filled with the cloud, and the court was filled with the brightness of the glory of the LORD.
aov_text: Toe het die heerlikheid van die HERE van die gérub af opgestyg oor die drumpel van die huis; en die huis is gevul met die wolk, en die voorhof was vol van die glans van die HERE se heerlikheid.

kjv_text: And the sound of the cherubims' wings was heard even to the outer court, as the voice of the Almighty God when he speaketh.
bsb_text: The sound of the wings of the cherubim could be heard as far as the outer court, like the voice of God Almighty when He speaks.
aov_text: En die geruis van die gérubs se vlerke is gehoor tot in die buitenste voorhof, soos die stem van die almagtige God as Hy spreek.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, that when he had commanded the man clothed with linen, saying, Take fire from between the wheels, from between the cherubims; then he went in, and stood beside the wheels.
bsb_text: When the LORD commanded the man clothed in linen, saying, “Take fire from within the wheelwork, from among the cherubim,” the man went in and stood beside a wheel.
aov_text: En toe Hy aan die man wat met linne bekleed was, bevel gegee het deur te sê: Neem vuur tussen die ratwerk, tussen die gérubs uit, het hy ingegaan en langs die wiel gaan staan.

kjv_text: And one cherub stretched forth his hand from between the cherubims unto the fire that was between the cherubims, and took thereof, and put it into the hands of him that was clothed with linen: who took it, and went out.
bsb_text: Then one of the cherubim reached out his hand and took some of the fire that was among them. And he put it into the hands of the man clothed in linen, who received it and went out.
aov_text: Toe steek die gérub sy hand uit, tussen die gérubs uit, na die vuur wat tussen die gérubs was; en hy neem daarvan en gee dit in die twee hande van hom wat met linne bekleed was; dié het dit geneem en uitgegaan.

kjv_text: And there appeared in the cherubims the form of a man's hand under their wings.
bsb_text: (The cherubim appeared to have the form of human hands under their wings.)
aov_text: En daar is aan die gérubs gesien die vorm van ’n mens se hand onder hulle vlerke.

kjv_text: And when I looked, behold the four wheels by the cherubims, one wheel by one cherub, and another wheel by another cherub: and the appearance of the wheels was as the colour of a beryl stone.
bsb_text: Then I looked and saw four wheels beside the cherubim, one wheel beside each cherub. And the wheels gleamed like a beryl stone.
aov_text: Toe het ek gekyk—en daar was vier wiele langs die gérubs, telkens een wiel langs elke gérub; en die voorkoms van die wiele was soos dié van chrisoliet.

kjv_text: And as for their appearances, they four had one likeness, as if a wheel had been in the midst of a wheel.
bsb_text: As for their appearance, all four had the same form, like a wheel within a wheel.
aov_text: En aangaande hulle voorkoms, al vier het dieselfde voorkoms gehad, asof daar ’n wiel binne-in ’n wiel was:

kjv_text: When they went, they went upon their four sides; they turned not as they went, but to the place whither the head looked they followed it; they turned not as they went.
bsb_text: When they moved, they would go in any of the four directions, without turning as they moved. For wherever the head faced, the cherubim would go in that direction, without turning as they moved.
aov_text: as hulle gaan, het hulle na al vier kante gegaan; hulle het nie gedraai as hulle gaan nie; maar daar waar die voorste heen draai, het hulle agter hom aan gegaan; hulle het nie gedraai as hulle gaan nie.

kjv_text: And their whole body, and their backs, and their hands, and their wings, and the wheels, were full of eyes round about, even the wheels that they four had.
bsb_text: Their entire bodies, including their backs, hands, and wings, were full of eyes all around, as were their four wheels.
aov_text: En hulle hele liggaam en hulle rugge en hulle hande en hulle vlerke en die wiele was vol oë rondom, aan al die vier wiele van hulle.

kjv_text: As for the wheels, it was cried unto them in my hearing, O wheel.
bsb_text: I heard the wheels being called “the whirling wheels.”
aov_text: Aangaande die wiele, hulle is voor my ore die ratwerk genoem.

kjv_text: And every one had four faces: the first face was the face of a cherub, and the second face was the face of a man, and the third the face of a lion, and the fourth the face of an eagle.
bsb_text: Each of the cherubim had four faces: the first face was that of a cherub, the second that of a man, the third that of a lion, and the fourth that of an eagle.
aov_text: En elkeen het vier aangesigte gehad: die eerste aangesig was die aangesig van ’n gérub en die tweede aangesig die aangesig van ’n mens en die derde die aangesig van ’n leeu en die vierde die aangesig van ’n arend.

kjv_text: And the cherubims were lifted up. This is the living creature that I saw by the river of Chebar.
bsb_text: Then the cherubim rose upward. These were the living creatures I had seen by the River Kebar.
aov_text: En die gérubs het opgestyg. Dit was die wese wat ek by die Kebarrivier gesien het.

kjv_text: And when the cherubims went, the wheels went by them: and when the cherubims lifted up their wings to mount up from the earth, the same wheels also turned not from beside them.
bsb_text: When the cherubim moved, the wheels moved beside them, and even when they spread their wings to rise from the ground, the wheels did not veer away from their side.
aov_text: En as die gérubs gaan, gaan die wiele naasaan hulle; en as die gérubs hulle vlerke ophef om van die grond af op te styg, het die wiele ook nie weggedraai naasaan hulle nie.

kjv_text: When they stood, these stood; and when they were lifted up, these lifted up themselves also: for the spirit of the living creature was in them.
bsb_text: When the cherubim stood still, the wheels also stood still, and when they ascended, the wheels ascended with them, for the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.
aov_text: As dié bly staan, staan hulle; en as dié opstyg, het hulle saam opgestyg; want die gees van die wese was in hulle.

kjv_text: Then the glory of the LORD departed from off the threshold of the house, and stood over the cherubims.
bsb_text: Then the glory of the LORD moved away from the threshold of the temple and stood above the cherubim.
aov_text: En die heerlikheid van die HERE het van die drumpel van die huis af weggetrek en bo die gérubs gaan staan.

kjv_text: And the cherubims lifted up their wings, and mounted up from the earth in my sight: when they went out, the wheels also were beside them, and every one stood at the door of the east gate of the LORD's house; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.
bsb_text: As I watched, the cherubim lifted their wings and rose up from the ground, with the wheels beside them as they went. And they stopped at the entrance of the east gate of the house of the LORD, with the glory of the God of Israel above them.
aov_text: En die gérubs het hulle vlerke opgehef en voor my oë van die grond af opgestyg toe hulle weggetrek het, en die wiele gelyktydig met hulle saam; en hulle het gaan staan by die ingang van die Oostelike Poort van die huis van die HERE, terwyl die heerlikheid van die God van Israel bo-oor hulle was.

kjv_text: This is the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river of Chebar; and I knew that they were the cherubims.
bsb_text: These were the living creatures I had seen beneath the God of Israel by the River Kebar, and I knew that they were cherubim.
aov_text: Dit is die wese wat ek onder die God van Israel by die Kebarrivier gesien het; ek merk toe dat dit gérubs was.

kjv_text: Every one had four faces apiece, and every one four wings; and the likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings.
bsb_text: Each had four faces and four wings, with what looked like human hands under their wings.
aov_text: Elkeen het vier aangesigte en elkeen vier vlerke gehad; en iets in die vorm van mensehande was onder hulle vlerke.

kjv_text: And the likeness of their faces was the same faces which I saw by the river of Chebar, their appearances and themselves: they went every one straight forward.
bsb_text: Their faces looked like the faces I had seen by the River Kebar. Each creature went straight ahead.
aov_text: En wat die vorm van hulle aangesigte betref, dit was die aangesigte wat ek by die Kebarrivier gesien het, hulle voorkoms en hulle self; hulle het elkeen reguit vorentoe gegaan.

kjv_text: Moreover the spirit lifted me up, and brought me unto the east gate of the LORD's house, which looketh eastward: and behold at the door of the gate five and twenty men; among whom I saw Jaazaniah the son of Azur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, princes of the people.
bsb_text: Then the Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the gate of the house of the LORD that faces east. And there at the entrance of the gate were twenty-five men. Among them I saw Jaazaniah son of Azzur and Pelatiah son of Benaiah, who were leaders of the people.
aov_text: EN die Gees het my opgehef en my gebring na die Oostelike Poort van die huis van die HERE wat na die ooste kyk; en kyk, by die ingang van die poort was daar vyf-en-twintig man, en onder hulle het ek gesien Jaäsanja, die seun van Assur, en Pelatja, die seun van Benája, vorste van die volk.

kjv_text: Then said he unto me, Son of man, these are the men that devise mischief, and give wicked counsel in this city:
bsb_text: And the LORD said to me, “Son of man, these are the men who plot evil and give wicked counsel in this city.
aov_text: Toe sê Hy vir my: Mensekind, dit is die manne wat ongeregtigheid bedink en slegte raad gee in hierdie stad,

kjv_text: Which say, It is not near; let us build houses: this city is the caldron, and we be the flesh.
bsb_text: They are saying, ‘Is not the time near to build houses? The city is the cooking pot, and we are the meat.’
aov_text: wat sê: Nie so gou kom die tyd om huise te bou nie: hierdie stad is die pot, en ons die vleis.

kjv_text: Therefore prophesy against them, prophesy, O son of man.
bsb_text: Therefore prophesy against them; prophesy, O son of man!”
aov_text: Daarom, profeteer teen hulle, profeteer, mensekind!

kjv_text: And the Spirit of the LORD fell upon me, and said unto me, Speak; Thus saith the LORD; Thus have ye said, O house of Israel: for I know the things that come into your mind, every one of them.
bsb_text: And the Spirit of the LORD fell upon me and told me to declare that this is what the LORD says: “That is what you are thinking, O house of Israel; and I know the thoughts that arise in your minds.
aov_text: Toe val die Gees van die HERE op my, en Hy sê vir my: Spreek, so sê die HERE: So het julle gespreek, o huis van Israel; en wat in julle gees opkom, weet Ék.

kjv_text: Ye have multiplied your slain in this city, and ye have filled the streets thereof with the slain.
bsb_text: You have multiplied those you killed in this city and filled its streets with the dead.
aov_text: Julle het die wat deur julle verslaan is, in hierdie stad vermenigvuldig, en julle het sy strate vol gemaak met die wat verslaan is.

kjv_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Your slain whom ye have laid in the midst of it, they are the flesh, and this city is the caldron: but I will bring you forth out of the midst of it.
bsb_text: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: The slain you have laid within this city are the meat, and the city is the pot; but I will remove you from it.
aov_text: Daarom, so sê die Here HERE: Die wat deur julle verslaan is, wat julle daarin neergelê het, hulle is die vleis, en hierdie stad is die pot, maar júlle sal Ek daar uitbring.

kjv_text: Ye have feared the sword; and I will bring a sword upon you, saith the Lord GOD.
bsb_text: You fear the sword, so I will bring the sword against you, declares the Lord GOD.
aov_text: Julle is bevrees vir die swaard, maar die swaard sal Ek oor julle bring, spreek die Here HERE.

kjv_text: And I will bring you out of the midst thereof, and deliver you into the hands of strangers, and will execute judgments among you.
bsb_text: I will bring you out of the city and deliver you into the hands of foreigners, and I will execute judgments against you.
aov_text: En Ek sal julle daar uitbring en julle oorgee in die hand van vreemdes en strafgerigte onder julle oefen.

kjv_text: Ye shall fall by the sword; I will judge you in the border of Israel; and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
bsb_text: You will fall by the sword, and I will judge you even to the borders of Israel. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
aov_text: Julle sal deur die swaard val; by die grens van Israel sal Ek julle oordeel. En julle sal weet dat Ek die HERE is.

kjv_text: This city shall not be your caldron, neither shall ye be the flesh in the midst thereof; but I will judge you in the border of Israel:
bsb_text: The city will not be a pot for you, nor will you be the meat within it. I will judge you even to the borders of Israel.
aov_text: Hierdie stad sal vir julle nie die pot, en júlle sal daarin nie die vleis wees nie; by die grens van Israel sal Ek julle oordeel.

kjv_text: And ye shall know that I am the LORD: for ye have not walked in my statutes, neither executed my judgments, but have done after the manners of the heathen that are round about you.
bsb_text: Then you will know that I am the LORD. For you have neither followed My statutes nor practiced My ordinances, but you have conformed to the ordinances of the nations around you.”
aov_text: En julle sal weet dat Ek die HERE is, omdat julle nie in my insettinge gewandel en my verordeninge nie gehou het nie, maar gehandel het volgens verordeninge van die nasies wat rondom julle is.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when I prophesied, that Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then fell I down upon my face, and cried with a loud voice, and said, Ah Lord GOD! wilt thou make a full end of the remnant of Israel?
bsb_text: Now as I was prophesying, Pelatiah son of Benaiah died. Then I fell facedown and cried out in a loud voice, “Oh, Lord GOD, will You bring the remnant of Israel to a complete end?”
aov_text: En terwyl ek profeteer, het Pelatja, die seun van Benája, gesterwe. Toe het ek op my aangesig geval en hardop uitgeroep en gesê: Ag, Here HERE, wil U ’n einde maak aan die oorblyfsel van Israel?

kjv_text: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
bsb_text: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
aov_text: Toe het die woord van die HERE tot my gekom en gesê:

kjv_text: Son of man, thy brethren, even thy brethren, the men of thy kindred, and all the house of Israel wholly, are they unto whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, Get you far from the LORD: unto us is this land given in possession.
bsb_text: “Son of man, your brothers—your relatives, your fellow exiles, and the whole house of Israel—are those of whom the people of Jerusalem have said, ‘They are far away from the LORD; this land has been given to us as a possession.’
aov_text: Mensekind, jou broers, jou broers, die manne wat aan jou verwant is, en die hele huis van Israel, almal saam, van wie die inwoners van Jerusalem sê: Bly ver van die HERE af, aan óns is dit, die land, as besitting gegee —

kjv_text: Therefore say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Although I have cast them far off among the heathen, and although I have scattered them among the countries, yet will I be to them as a little sanctuary in the countries where they shall come.
bsb_text: Therefore declare that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Although I sent them far away among the nations and scattered them among the countries, yet for a little while I have been a sanctuary for them in the countries to which they have gone.’
aov_text: Daarom sê: So spreek die Here HERE: Omdat Ek hulle ver weggedryf het onder die nasies, en omdat Ek hulle verstrooi het in die lande en Ek vir hulle ’n kort rukkie ’n heiligdom geword het in die lande waar hulle gekom het —

kjv_text: Therefore say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will even gather you from the people, and assemble you out of the countries where ye have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.
bsb_text: Therefore declare that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘I will gather you from the peoples and assemble you from the countries to which you have been scattered, and I will give back to you the land of Israel.’
aov_text: daarom sê: So spreek die Here HERE: Ek sal julle bymekaarmaak uit die volke en julle versamel uit die lande waarin julle verstrooi is, en Ek sal aan julle die land Israel gee.

kjv_text: And they shall come thither, and they shall take away all the detestable things thereof and all the abominations thereof from thence.
bsb_text: When they return to it, they will remove all its detestable things and all its abominations.
aov_text: En hulle sal daarnatoe kom en al sy verfoeisels en al sy gruwels daaruit verwyder.

kjv_text: And I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within you; and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them an heart of flesh:
bsb_text: And I will give them singleness of heart and put a new spirit within them; I will remove their heart of stone and give them a heart of flesh,
aov_text: En Ek sal hulle een hart gee, en ’n nuwe gees in julle binneste gee; en Ek sal die hart van klip uit hulle vlees verwyder en hulle ’n hart van vlees gee,

kjv_text: That they may walk in my statutes, and keep mine ordinances, and do them: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God.
bsb_text: so that they may follow My statutes, keep My ordinances, and practice them. Then they will be My people, and I will be their God.
aov_text: sodat hulle in my insettinge kan wandel en my verordeninge kan hou en dit doen; en hulle sal vir My ’n volk wees, en Ek sal vir hulle ’n God wees.

kjv_text: But as for them whose heart walketh after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations, I will recompense their way upon their own heads, saith the Lord GOD.
bsb_text: But as for those whose hearts pursue detestable things and abominations, I will bring their conduct down upon their own heads, declares the Lord GOD.”
aov_text: Maar hulle wie se hart agter die hart van hulle verfoeisels en hulle gruwels aan loop—hulle wandel laat Ek op hul hoof neerkom, spreek die Here HERE.

kjv_text: Then did the cherubims lift up their wings, and the wheels beside them; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.
bsb_text: Then the cherubim, with the wheels beside them, spread their wings, and the glory of the God of Israel was above them.
aov_text: Toe het die gérubs hulle vlerke opgehef en die wiele gelyktydig met hulle saam, terwyl die heerlikheid van die God van Israel bo-oor hulle was.

kjv_text: And the glory of the LORD went up from the midst of the city, and stood upon the mountain which is on the east side of the city.
bsb_text: And the glory of the LORD rose up from within the city and stood over the mountain east of the city.
aov_text: En die heerlikheid van die HERE het opgestyg uit die stad uit weg en het gaan staan op die berg wat oos van die stad lê.

kjv_text: Afterwards the spirit took me up, and brought me in a vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea, to them of the captivity. So the vision that I had seen went up from me.
bsb_text: And the Spirit lifted me up and carried me back to Chaldea, to the exiles in the vision given by the Spirit of God. After the vision had gone up from me,
aov_text: Daarna het die Gees my opgeneem en my, in ’n gesig deur die Gees van God, gebring na Chaldéa, na die ballinge; en die gesig wat ek gesien het, het van my af opgetrek.

kjv_text: Then I spake unto them of the captivity all the things that the LORD had shewed me.
bsb_text: I told the exiles everything the LORD had shown me.
aov_text: En ek het aan die ballinge verkondig al die woorde van die HERE wat Hy my laat sien het.

kjv_text: The word of the LORD also came unto me, saying,
bsb_text: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
aov_text: VERDER het die woord van die HERE tot my gekom en gesê:

kjv_text: Son of man, thou dwellest in the midst of a rebellious house, which have eyes to see, and see not; they have ears to hear, and hear not: for they are a rebellious house.
bsb_text: “Son of man, you are living in a rebellious house. They have eyes to see but do not see, and ears to hear but do not hear, for they are a rebellious house.
aov_text: Mensekind, jy woon onder mense van die wederstrewige huis, wat oë het om te sien, maar nie sien nie; ore het om te hoor, maar nie hoor nie, want hulle is ’n wederstrewige huis.

kjv_text: Therefore, thou son of man, prepare thee stuff for removing, and remove by day in their sight; and thou shalt remove from thy place to another place in their sight: it may be they will consider, though they be a rebellious house.
bsb_text: Therefore, son of man, pack your bags for exile. In broad daylight, set out from your place and go to another as they watch. Perhaps they will understand, though they are a rebellious house.
aov_text: Maar jy, mensekind, maak vir jou toebereidsels om in ballingskap te gaan, en gaan oordag in ballingskap voor hulle oë; vertrek soos ’n balling voor hulle oë, van jou woonplek af na ’n ander plek toe—miskien sal hulle dit sien, want hulle is ’n wederstrewige huis.

kjv_text: Then shalt thou bring forth thy stuff by day in their sight, as stuff for removing: and thou shalt go forth at even in their sight, as they that go forth into captivity.
bsb_text: Bring out your baggage for exile by day, as they watch. Then in the evening, as they watch, go out like those who go into exile.
aov_text: En jy moet jou goed oordag uitbring voor hulle oë soos die goed wat vir ’n ballingskap nodig is; maar self moet jy in die aand uitgaan voor hulle oë soos die wat in ballingskap uitgaan.

kjv_text: Dig thou through the wall in their sight, and carry out thereby.
bsb_text: As they watch, dig through the wall and carry your belongings out through it.
aov_text: Breek vir jou ’n gat in die muur voor hulle oë, en bring dit daardeur uit.

kjv_text: In their sight shalt thou bear it upon thy shoulders, and carry it forth in the twilight: thou shalt cover thy face, that thou see not the ground: for I have set thee for a sign unto the house of Israel.
bsb_text: And as they watch, lift your bags to your shoulder and take them out at dusk; cover your face so that you cannot see the land. For I have made you a sign to the house of Israel.”
aov_text: Voor hulle oë moet jy dit op die skouer dra, in die pikdonker moet jy dit uitbring; jou aangesig moet jy bedek, sodat jy die land nie sien nie; want Ek maak jou tot ’n sinnebeeld vir die huis van Israel.

kjv_text: And I did so as I was commanded: I brought forth my stuff by day, as stuff for captivity, and in the even I digged through the wall with mine hand; I brought it forth in the twilight, and I bare it upon my shoulder in their sight.
bsb_text: So I did as I was commanded. I brought out my bags for exile by day, and in the evening I dug through the wall by hand. I took my belongings out at dusk, carrying them on my shoulder as they watched.
aov_text: Ek het toe gedoen soos my beveel is: ek het my goed oordag uitgebring soos die goed wat vir ’n ballingskap nodig is; en in die aand het ek met my hand vir my ’n gat in die muur gebreek; in die pikdonker het ek dit uitgebring, dit op die skouer voor hulle oë gedra.

kjv_text: And in the morning came the word of the LORD unto me, saying,
bsb_text: And in the morning the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
aov_text: Toe kom die woord van die HERE tot my in die môre en sê:

kjv_text: Son of man, hath not the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said unto thee, What doest thou?
bsb_text: “Son of man, hasn’t the rebellious house of Israel asked you, ‘What are you doing?’
aov_text: Mensekind, het die huis van Israel, die wederstrewige huis, nie vir jou gesê: Wat maak jy daar nie?

kjv_text: Say thou unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; This burden concerneth the prince in Jerusalem, and all the house of Israel that are among them.
bsb_text: Tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘This burden concerns the prince in Jerusalem and all the house of Israel who are there.’
aov_text: Sê vir hulle: So spreek die Here HERE: Hierdie las sien op die vors in Jerusalem en die hele huis van Israel wat onder hulle woon.

kjv_text: Say, I am your sign: like as I have done, so shall it be done unto them: they shall remove and go into captivity.
bsb_text: You are to say, ‘I am a sign to you.’ Just as it happened here, so will it be done to them; they will go into exile as captives.
aov_text: Sê: Ek is julle sinnebeeld; soos ek gedoen het, so sal met hulle gedoen word: in ballingskap, in gevangenskap sal hulle gaan.

kjv_text: And the prince that is among them shall bear upon his shoulder in the twilight, and shall go forth: they shall dig through the wall to carry out thereby: he shall cover his face, that he see not the ground with his eyes.
bsb_text: And at dusk the prince among them will lift his bags to his shoulder and go out. They will dig through the wall to bring him out. He will cover his face so he cannot see the land.
aov_text: En die vors wat onder hulle is, sal die goed op die skouer dra, in die pikdonker, en hy sal uitgaan; hulle sal ’n gat in die muur breek om daardeur uit te bring; hy sal sy aangesig bedek, omdat hy self die land met die oog nie sal sien nie.

kjv_text: My net also will I spread upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare: and I will bring him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldeans; yet shall he not see it, though he shall die there.
bsb_text: But I will spread My net over him, and he will be caught in My snare. I will bring him to Babylon, the land of the Chaldeans; yet he will not see it, and there he will die.
aov_text: En Ek sal my net oor hom uitsprei, en in my strik sal hy gevang word; en Ek sal hom na Babel, na die land van die Chaldeërs bring; maar hy sal dit nie sien nie, en daar sal hy sterwe.

kjv_text: And I will scatter toward every wind all that are about him to help him, and all his bands; and I will draw out the sword after them.
bsb_text: And I will scatter to every wind all the attendants around him and all his troops, and I will draw a sword to chase after them.
aov_text: En almal wat rondom hom is, sy hulp, en al sy leërs sal Ek na al die windstreke verstrooi en die swaard agter hulle uittrek.

kjv_text: And they shall know that I am the LORD, when I shall scatter them among the nations, and disperse them in the countries.
bsb_text: And they will know that I am the LORD, when I disperse them among the nations and scatter them throughout the countries.
aov_text: Dan sal hulle weet dat Ek die HERE is, as Ek hulle onder die nasies versprei en hulle in die lande verstrooi;

kjv_text: But I will leave a few men of them from the sword, from the famine, and from the pestilence; that they may declare all their abominations among the heathen whither they come; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
bsb_text: But I will spare a few of them from sword and famine and plague, so that in the nations to which they go, they can recount all their abominations. Then they will know that I am the LORD.”
aov_text: maar Ek sal van hulle ’n klein klompie laat oorbly van die swaard, die hongersnood en die pes, sodat hulle al húlle gruwels kan vertel onder die nasies waar hulle kom; en dié sal weet dat Ek die HERE is.

kjv_text: Moreover the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
bsb_text: Moreover, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
aov_text: Daarna het die woord van die HERE tot my gekom en gesê:

kjv_text: Son of man, eat thy bread with quaking, and drink thy water with trembling and with carefulness;
bsb_text: “Son of man, eat your bread with trembling, and drink your water with quivering and anxiety.
aov_text: Mensekind, jy moet jou brood met bewing eet en jou water met siddering en kommer drink.

aov_text: En jy moet aan die mense van die land sê: So spreek die Here HERE aangaande die inwoners van Jerusalem, in die land Israel: Hulle sal hul brood met kommer eet en hul water in stomme smart drink, sodat hulle land, van sy volheid beroof, woes sal lê vanweë die geweldpleging van almal wat daarin woon.

kjv_text: And the cities that are inhabited shall be laid waste, and the land shall be desolate; and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
bsb_text: The inhabited cities will be laid waste, and the land will become desolate. Then you will know that I am the LORD.’”
aov_text: En die stede wat bewoon is, sal woes word, en die land sal ’n wildernis wees; en julle sal dit weet dat Ek die HERE is.

kjv_text: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

kjv_text: Son of man, what is that proverb that ye have in the land of Israel, saying, The days are prolonged, and every vision faileth?
bsb_text: “Son of man, what is this proverb that you have in the land of Israel: ‘The days go by, and every vision fails’?
aov_text: Mensekind, wat is dit vir ’n spreekwoord wat julle het in die land van Israel, naamlik: Die dae gaan voort, en van al die gesigte kom niks nie.

kjv_text: Tell them therefore, Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will make this proverb to cease, and they shall no more use it as a proverb in Israel; but say unto them, The days are at hand, and the effect of every vision.

aov_text: Daarom, sê vir hulle: So spreek die Here HERE: Ek maak ’n einde aan hierdie spreekwoord, sodat hulle dit nie meer as spreekwoord in Israel sal gebruik nie. Maar sê vir hulle: Die dae is naby, en die woord van elke gesig.

kjv_text: For there shall be no more any vain vision nor flattering divination within the house of Israel.

kjv_text: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
bsb_text: Furthermore, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

aov_text: Mensekind, kyk, die huis van Israel sê: Die gesig wat hy sien, is vir baie dae, en hy profeteer van tye wat ver is.

kjv_text: Therefore say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; There shall none of my words be prolonged any more, but the word which I have spoken shall be done, saith the Lord GOD.

aov_text: Daarom, sê vir hulle: So spreek die Here HERE: Geeneen van my woorde sal meer uitgestel word nie; wat Ek as woord spreek, dit sal gebeur, spreek die Here HERE.

kjv_text: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
bsb_text: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
aov_text: EN die woord van die HERE het tot my gekom en gesê:

kjv_text: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Woe unto the foolish prophets, that follow their own spirit, and have seen nothing!

aov_text: So spreek die Here HERE: Wee die dwase profete wat agter hulle eie gees aan wandel en agter dinge wat hulle nie gesien het nie.

kjv_text: Ye have not gone up into the gaps, neither made up the hedge for the house of Israel to stand in the battle in the day of the LORD.

kjv_text: They have seen vanity and lying divination, saying, The LORD saith: and the LORD hath not sent them: and they have made others to hope that they would confirm the word.

kjv_text: Have ye not seen a vain vision, and have ye not spoken a lying divination, whereas ye say, The LORD saith it; albeit I have not spoken?
bsb_text: Haven’t you seen a false vision and spoken a lying divination when you proclaim, ‘Thus declares the LORD,’ even though I have not spoken?
aov_text: Het julle nie ’n bedrieglike gesig gesien en leuenagtige waarsêery gespreek nie deurdat julle sê: Die HERE spreek, terwyl Ék nie gespreek het nie?

kjv_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye have spoken vanity, and seen lies, therefore, behold, I am against you, saith the Lord GOD.
bsb_text: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Because you have uttered vain words and seen false visions, I am against you, declares the Lord GOD.
aov_text: Daarom, so spreek die Here HERE: Omdat julle valsheid gespreek en leuenagtige gesigte gesien het, daarom kyk, Ek het dit teen julle, spreek die Here HERE.

kjv_text: And mine hand shall be upon the prophets that see vanity, and that divine lies: they shall not be in the assembly of my people, neither shall they be written in the writing of the house of Israel, neither shall they enter into the land of Israel; and ye shall know that I am the Lord GOD.

kjv_text: Because, even because they have seduced my people, saying, Peace; and there was no peace; and one built up a wall, and, lo, others daubed it with untempered morter:

kjv_text: So will I break down the wall that ye have daubed with untempered morter, and bring it down to the ground, so that the foundation thereof shall be discovered, and it shall fall, and ye shall be consumed in the midst thereof: and ye shall know that I am the LORD.

kjv_text: Likewise, thou son of man, set thy face against the daughters of thy people, which prophesy out of their own heart; and prophesy thou against them,

aov_text: En jy, mensekind, rig jou aangesig teen die dogters van jou volk wat as profetesse optree uit hulle eie hart, en profeteer teen hulle

kjv_text: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Woe to the women that sew pillows to all armholes, and make kerchiefs upon the head of every stature to hunt souls! Will ye hunt the souls of my people, and will ye save the souls alive that come unto you?

kjv_text: And will ye pollute me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, to slay the souls that should not die, and to save the souls alive that should not live, by your lying to my people that hear your lies?

kjv_text: Wherefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I am against your pillows, wherewith ye there hunt the souls to make them fly, and I will tear them from your arms, and will let the souls go, even the souls that ye hunt to make them fly.

kjv_text: Your kerchiefs also will I tear, and deliver my people out of your hand, and they shall be no more in your hand to be hunted; and ye shall know that I am the LORD.

kjv_text: Because with lies ye have made the heart of the righteous sad, whom I have not made sad; and strengthened the hands of the wicked, that he should not return from his wicked way, by promising him life:

bsb_text: Therefore speak to them and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘When any Israelite sets up idols in his heart and puts a wicked stumbling block before his face, and then comes to the prophet, I the LORD will answer him according to his great idolatry,

kjv_text: That I may take the house of Israel in their own heart, because they are all estranged from me through their idols.

kjv_text: For every one of the house of Israel, or of the stranger that sojourneth in Israel, which separateth himself from me, and setteth up his idols in his heart, and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and cometh to a prophet to enquire of him concerning me; I the LORD will answer him by myself:

kjv_text: And I will set my face against that man, and will make him a sign and a proverb, and I will cut him off from the midst of my people; and ye shall know that I am the LORD.

kjv_text: Yet, behold, therein shall be left a remnant that shall be brought forth, both sons and daughters: behold, they shall come forth unto you, and ye shall see their way and their doings: and ye shall be comforted concerning the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem, even concerning all that I have brought upon it.

kjv_text: None eye pitied thee, to do any of these unto thee, to have compassion upon thee; but thou wast cast out in the open field, to the lothing of thy person, in the day that thou wast born.

kjv_text: And when I passed by thee, and saw thee polluted in thine own blood, I said unto thee when thou wast in thy blood, Live; yea, I said unto thee when thou wast in thy blood, Live.

kjv_text: Now when I passed by thee, and looked upon thee, behold, thy time was the time of love; and I spread my skirt over thee, and covered thy nakedness: yea, I sware unto thee, and entered into a covenant with thee, saith the Lord GOD, and thou becamest mine.

kjv_text: Then washed I thee with water; yea, I throughly washed away thy blood from thee, and I anointed thee with oil.

kjv_text: And I put a jewel on thy forehead, and earrings in thine ears, and a beautiful crown upon thine head.
bsb_text: I put a ring in your nose, earrings on your ears, and a beautiful crown upon your head.

kjv_text: Thus wast thou decked with gold and silver; and thy raiment was of fine linen, and silk, and broidered work; thou didst eat fine flour, and honey, and oil: and thou wast exceeding beautiful, and thou didst prosper into a kingdom.
bsb_text: So you were adorned with gold and silver, and your clothing was made of fine linen, silk, and embroidered cloth. You ate fine flour, honey, and oil. You became very beautiful and rose to be queen.
aov_text: Ja, jy het jou versier met goud en silwer, en jou klere was fyn linne en sy en veelkleurige stowwe; jy het fynmeel en heuning en olie geëet, en jy was buitengewoon mooi en so voorspoedig dat jy koninklike waardigheid bereik het.

kjv_text: And thy renown went forth among the heathen for thy beauty: for it was perfect through my comeliness, which I had put upon thee, saith the Lord GOD.

kjv_text: Thou hast played the whore also with the Assyrians, because thou wast unsatiable; yea, thou hast played the harlot with them, and yet couldest not be satisfied.
