kjv_text: Therefore, behold, I will allure her, and bring her into the wilderness, and speak comfortably unto her.
bsb_text: “Therefore, behold, I will allure her and lead her to the wilderness, and speak to her tenderly.
aov_text: Daarom, kyk, Ek sal haar lok en haar in die woestyn lei en na haar hart spreek.

kjv_text: And I will give her her vineyards from thence, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope: and she shall sing there, as in the days of her youth, and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt.
bsb_text: There I will give back her vineyards and make the Valley of Achor into a gateway of hope. There she will respond as she did in the days of her youth, as in the day she came up out of Egypt.
aov_text: Dan sal Ek haar daarvandaan haar wingerde gee en die dal Agor tot ’n deur van hoop, en daar sal sy antwoord gee soos in die dae van haar jeug en soos die dag toe sy uit Egipteland opgetrek het.

kjv_text: And it shall be at that day, saith the LORD, that thou shalt call me Ishi; and shalt call me no more Baali.
bsb_text: In that day,” declares the LORD, “you will call Me ‘my Husband,’ and no longer call Me ‘my Master.’
aov_text: En in dié dag, spreek die HERE, sal jy My noem: My man; en jy sal my nie meer noem: My Baäl nie.

kjv_text: For I will take away the names of Baalim out of her mouth, and they shall no more be remembered by their name.
bsb_text: For I will remove from her lips the names of the Baals; no longer will their names be invoked.
aov_text: Dan verwyder Ek die name van die Baäls uit haar mond, sodat hulle by hul naam nie meer genoem sal word nie.

kjv_text: And in that day will I make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven, and with the creeping things of the ground: and I will break the bow and the sword and the battle out of the earth, and will make them to lie down safely.
bsb_text: On that day I will make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field and the birds of the air and the creatures that crawl on the ground. And I will abolish bow and sword and weapons of war in the land, and will make them lie down in safety.
aov_text: Verder sluit Ek in dié dag vir hulle ’n verbond met die wilde diere van die veld en met die voëls van die hemel en die kruipende diere van die aarde; ja, boog en swaard en oorlog sal Ek verbreek uit die land, en Ek sal hulle in veiligheid laat rus.

kjv_text: And I will betroth thee unto me for ever; yea, I will betroth thee unto me in righteousness, and in judgment, and in loving-kindness, and in mercies.
bsb_text: So I will betroth you to Me forever; I will betroth you in righteousness and justice, in loving devotion and compassion.
aov_text: En Ek sal My met jou verloof tot in ewigheid en My met jou verloof in geregtigheid en in reg en in goedertierenheid en in ontferming.

kjv_text: I will even betroth thee unto me in faithfulness: and thou shalt know the LORD.
bsb_text: And I will betroth you in faithfulness, and you will know the LORD.”
aov_text: En Ek sal My met jou verloof in trou; dan sal jy die HERE ken.

kjv_text: And it shall come to pass in that day, I will hear, saith the LORD, I will hear the heavens, and they shall hear the earth;
bsb_text: “On that day I will respond—” declares the LORD—“I will respond to the heavens, and they will respond to the earth.
aov_text: En in dié dag sal Ek verhoor, spreek die HERE, Ek sal die hemel verhoor en dié sal die aarde verhoor.

kjv_text: And the earth shall hear the corn, and the wine, and the oil; and they shall hear Jezreel.
bsb_text: And the earth will respond to the grain, to the new wine and oil, and they will respond to Jezreel.
aov_text: En die aarde sal die koring verhoor en die mos en die olie, en dié sal Jísreël verhoor.

kjv_text: And I will sow her unto me in the earth; and I will have mercy upon her that had not obtained mercy; and I will say to them which were not my people, Thou art my people; and they shall say, Thou art my God.
bsb_text: And I will sow her as My own in the land, and I will have compassion on ‘No Compassion.’ I will say to those called ‘Not My People,’ ‘You are My people,’ and they will say, ‘You are my God.’”
aov_text: En Ek sal haar vir My saai in die land en My oor Lo-Rugáma ontferm, en aan Lo-Ammi sê: Jy is my volk; en hy sal sê: My God!

kjv_text: Then said the LORD unto me, Go yet, love a woman beloved of her friend, yet an adulteress, according to the love of the LORD toward the children of Israel, who look to other gods, and love flagons of wine.
bsb_text: Then the LORD said to me, “Go show love to your wife again, though she is loved by another and is an adulteress. Love her as the LORD loves the Israelites, though they turn to other gods and offer raisin cakes to idols.”
aov_text: EN die HERE het vir my gesê: Gaan nog ’n keer, bemin ’n vrou wat bemin word deur haar vriend, maar wat owerspel bedrywe, net soos die HERE die kinders van Israel bemin, terwyl hulle hul tot ander gode wend en versot is op rosynekoeke.

kjv_text: So I bought her to me for fifteen pieces of silver, and for an homer of barley, and an half homer of barley:
bsb_text: So I bought her for fifteen shekels of silver and a homer and a lethech of barley.
aov_text: Toe het ek haar vir my gekoop vir vyftien sikkels silwer en anderhalf homer gars.

kjv_text: And I said unto her, Thou shalt abide for me many days; thou shalt not play the harlot, and thou shalt not be for another man: so will I also be for thee.
bsb_text: Then I said to her, “You must live with me for many days; you must not be promiscuous or belong to another, and I will do the same for you.”
aov_text: En ek het aan haar gesê: Jy sal ’n lang tyd moet stilsit vir my, nie hoereer nie en aan geen man behoort nie; en so ook ek teenoor jou.

kjv_text: For the children of Israel shall abide many days without a king, and without a prince, and without a sacrifice, and without an image, and without an ephod, and without teraphim:
bsb_text: For the Israelites must live many days without king or prince, without sacrifice or sacred pillar, and without ephod or idol.
aov_text: Want die kinders van Israel sal ’n lang tyd bly sit sonder koning en sonder vors en sonder slagoffer en sonder klippilare en sonder efod en huisgode.

kjv_text: Afterward shall the children of Israel return, and seek the LORD their God, and David their king; and shall fear the LORD and his goodness in the latter days.
bsb_text: Afterward, the people of Israel will return and seek the LORD their God and David their king. They will come trembling to the LORD and to His goodness in the last days.
aov_text: Daarna sal die kinders van Israel hulle bekeer en die HERE hulle God soek en Dawid hulle koning, en met siddering aankom na die HERE en na sy goedheid in die laaste van die dae.

kjv_text: Hear the word of the LORD, ye children of Israel: for the LORD hath a controversy with the inhabitants of the land, because there is no truth, nor mercy, nor knowledge of God in the land.
bsb_text: Hear the word of the LORD, O children of Israel, for the LORD has a case against the people of the land: “There is no truth, no loving devotion, and no knowledge of God in the land!
aov_text: HOOR die woord van die HERE, o kinders van Israel! Want die HERE het ’n regsaak met die inwoners van die land, omdat daar geen trou en geen liefde en geen kennis van God in die land is nie.

kjv_text: By swearing, and lying, and killing, and stealing, and committing adultery, they break out, and blood toucheth blood.
bsb_text: Cursing and lying, murder and stealing, and adultery are rampant; one act of bloodshed follows another.
aov_text: Hulle sweer en lieg en moor en steel en pleeg owerspel; hulle breek in, sodat bloedbad aan bloedbad raak.

kjv_text: Therefore shall the land mourn, and every one that dwelleth therein shall languish, with the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven; yea, the fishes of the sea also shall be taken away.
bsb_text: Therefore the land mourns, and all who dwell in it will waste away with the beasts of the field and the birds of the air; even the fish of the sea disappear.
aov_text: Daarom treur die land, en alles wat daarop woon, kwyn weg: die wilde diere van die veld en die voëls van die hemel, ja, ook die visse van die see kom om.

kjv_text: Yet let no man strive, nor reprove another: for thy people are as they that strive with the priest.
bsb_text: But let no man contend; let no man offer reproof; for your people are like those who contend with a priest.
aov_text: Laat net niemand met ons twis of ons berispe nie! Nogtans is jou volk soos die wat met die priester twis!

kjv_text: Therefore shalt thou fall in the day, and the prophet also shall fall with thee in the night, and I will destroy thy mother.
bsb_text: You will stumble by day, and the prophet will stumble with you by night; so I will destroy your mother—
aov_text: Daarom sal jy struikel bedags, en ook die profeet saam met jou struikel in die nag, en Ek sal jou moeder te gronde laat gaan.

kjv_text: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge: because thou hast rejected knowledge, I will also reject thee, that thou shalt be no priest to me: seeing thou hast forgotten the law of thy God, I will also forget thy children.
bsb_text: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge. Because you have rejected knowledge, I will also reject you as My priests. Since you have forgotten the law of your God, I will also forget your children.
aov_text: My volk gaan te gronde weens gebrek aan kennis; omdat jý die kennis verwerp het, sal Ek jou verwerp, sodat jy vir My die priesteramp nie sal bedien nie; omdat jy die wet van jou God vergeet het, sal Ek ook jou kinders vergeet.

kjv_text: As they were increased, so they sinned against me: therefore will I change their glory into shame.
bsb_text: The more they multiplied, the more they sinned against Me; they exchanged their Glory for a thing of disgrace.
aov_text: Hoe meer hulle vermenigvuldig het, des te meer het hulle teen My gesondig. Ek sal hulle heerlikheid in skande verander.

kjv_text: They eat up the sin of my people, and they set their heart on their iniquity.
bsb_text: They feed on the sins of My people and set their hearts on iniquity.
aov_text: Hulle lewe van die sondoffer van my volk, en na dié se ongeregtigheid verlang hulle siel.

kjv_text: And there shall be, like people, like priest: and I will punish them for their ways, and reward them their doings.
bsb_text: And it shall be like people, like priest. I will punish both of them for their ways and repay them for their deeds.
aov_text: Daarom sal dit met die priester gaan soos met die volk—Ek sal by hom besoeking doen oor sy weë en hom vergeld na sy dade.

kjv_text: For they shall eat, and not have enough: they shall commit whoredom, and shall not increase: because they have left off to take heed to the LORD.
bsb_text: They will eat but not be satisfied; they will be promiscuous but not multiply. For they have stopped obeying the LORD.
aov_text: Dan sal hulle eet, maar nie versadig word nie; hulle sal hoereer, maar nie uitbreek in menigte nie; want hulle het nagelaat om die HERE te vereer.

kjv_text: Whoredom and wine and new wine take away the heart.
bsb_text: Promiscuity, wine, and new wine take away understanding.
aov_text: Hoerery en wyn en mos neem die hart weg.

kjv_text: My people ask counsel at their stocks, and their staff declareth unto them: for the spirit of whoredoms hath caused them to err, and they have gone a whoring from under their God.
bsb_text: My people consult their wooden idols, and their divining rods inform them. For a spirit of prostitution leads them astray and they have played the harlot against their God.
aov_text: My volk raadpleeg sy hout, en sy staf moet hom die inligting gee; want ’n gees van hoerery het hulle verlei, en deur hulle hoerery het hulle van hul God afvallig geword.

kjv_text: They sacrifice upon the tops of the mountains, and burn incense upon the hills, under oaks and poplars and elms, because the shadow thereof is good: therefore your daughters shall commit whoredom, and your spouses shall commit adultery.
bsb_text: They sacrifice on the mountaintops and burn offerings on the hills, under oak, poplar, and terebinth, because their shade is pleasant. And so your daughters turn to prostitution and your daughters-in-law to adultery.
aov_text: Hulle offer op die bergtoppe en laat rook opgaan op die heuwels, onder die eike en populiere en terpentynbome, omdat die skaduwee daar goed is. Daarom pleeg julle dogters hoerery, en julle skoondogters bedryf owerspel.

kjv_text: I will not punish your daughters when they commit whoredom, nor your spouses when they commit adultery: for themselves are separated with whores, and they sacrifice with harlots: therefore the people that doth not understand shall fall.
bsb_text: I will not punish your daughters when they prostitute themselves, nor your daughters-in-law when they commit adultery. For the men themselves go off with prostitutes and offer sacrifices with shrine prostitutes. So a people without understanding will come to ruin.
aov_text: Ek sal oor julle dogters geen besoeking doen omdat hulle hoereer nie, en ook nie oor julle skoondogters omdat hulle owerspel bedryf nie; want die manne sonder hulleself af met die hoere en offer met die tempelhoere. So kom dan die volk wat geen verstand het nie, tot ’n val.

kjv_text: Though thou, Israel, play the harlot, yet let not Judah offend; and come not ye unto Gilgal, neither go ye up to Bethaven, nor swear, The LORD liveth.
bsb_text: Though you prostitute yourself, O Israel, may Judah avoid such guilt! Do not journey to Gilgal, do not go up to Beth-aven, and do not swear on oath, ‘As surely as the LORD lives!’
aov_text: As jy hoereer, o Israel, laat Juda hom tog nie skuldig maak nie! Kom dan nie na Gilgal nie, en gaan nie op na Bet-Awen nie, en sweer nie: So waar as die HERE leef!

kjv_text: For Israel slideth back as a backsliding heifer: now the LORD will feed them as a lamb in a large place.
bsb_text: For Israel is as obstinate as a stubborn heifer. Can the LORD now shepherd them like lambs in an open meadow?
aov_text: Want Israel is wederstrewig soos ’n wederstrewige koei; nou sal die HERE hulle laat wei soos ’n lam in die oop veld.

kjv_text: Ephraim is joined to idols: let him alone.
bsb_text: Ephraim is joined to idols; leave him alone!
aov_text: Efraim is gekoppel aan die afgode: laat hom staan!

kjv_text: Their drink is sour: they have committed whoredom continually: her rulers with shame do love, Give ye.
bsb_text: When their liquor is gone, they turn to prostitution; their rulers dearly love disgrace.
aov_text: As hulle drinkery verby is, dan hoereer hulle te meer. Hulle vorste is versot op skande.

kjv_text: The wind hath bound her up in her wings, and they shall be ashamed because of their sacrifices.
bsb_text: The whirlwind has wrapped them in its wings, and their sacrifices will bring them shame.
aov_text: Die wind bind hulle in sy vleuels, sodat hulle oor hul offers beskaamd sal staan.

kjv_text: Hear ye this, O priests; and hearken, ye house of Israel; and give ye ear, O house of the king; for judgment is toward you, because ye have been a snare on Mizpah, and a net spread upon Tabor.
bsb_text: “Hear this, O priests! Take heed, O house of Israel! Give ear, O royal house! For this judgment is against you because you have been a snare at Mizpah, a net spread out on Tabor.
aov_text: HOOR dit, o priesters, en let op, o huis van Israel, en gee gehoor, o huis van die koning! Want die vonnis raak julle, omdat julle vir Mispa ’n vangnet geword het en ’n uitgespreide net op Tabor.

kjv_text: And the revolters are profound to make slaughter, though I have been a rebuker of them all.
bsb_text: The rebels are deep in slaughter; but I will chastise them all.
aov_text: Ja, in verderflike praktyke verdiep die afvalliges hulle, maar Ek sal hulle almal tot tugtiging wees.

kjv_text: I know Ephraim, and Israel is not hid from me: for now, O Ephraim, thou committest whoredom, and Israel is defiled.
bsb_text: I know all about Ephraim, and Israel is not hidden from Me. For now, O Ephraim, you have turned to prostitution; Israel is defiled.
aov_text: Ek ken Efraim, en Israel is vir My nie verborge nie; want nou het jy owerspel bedrywe, o Efraim! Israel is verontreinig.

kjv_text: They will not frame their doings to turn unto their God: for the spirit of whoredoms is in the midst of them, and they have not known the LORD.
bsb_text: Their deeds do not permit them to return to their God, for a spirit of prostitution is within them, and they do not know the LORD.
aov_text: Hulle dade gedoog geen terugkeer tot hulle God nie, want daar is ’n gees van hoerery in hulle binneste, en hulle ken die HERE nie.

kjv_text: And the pride of Israel doth testify to his face: therefore shall Israel and Ephraim fall in their iniquity; Judah also shall fall with them.
bsb_text: Israel’s arrogance testifies against them; Israel and Ephraim stumble in their iniquity; even Judah stumbles with them.
aov_text: En die trotsheid van Israel getuig openlik teen hom; en Israel en Efraim sal struikel deur hulle ongeregtigheid, ook Juda sal saam met hulle struikel.

kjv_text: They shall go with their flocks and with their herds to seek the LORD; but they shall not find him; he hath withdrawn himself from them.
bsb_text: They go with their flocks and herds to seek the LORD, but they do not find Him; He has withdrawn Himself from them.
aov_text: Met hulle kleinvee en hulle beeste sal hulle heengaan om die HERE te soek, maar Hom nie vind nie. Hy het Hom aan hulle onttrek.

kjv_text: They have dealt treacherously against the LORD: for they have begotten strange children: now shall a month devour them with their portions.
bsb_text: They have been unfaithful to the LORD; for they have borne illegitimate children. Now the New Moon will devour them along with their land.
aov_text: Hulle het troueloos gehandel teen die HERE, want hulle het onegte kinders verwek; nou sal die nuwemaan hulle met hul velde verteer.

kjv_text: Blow ye the cornet in Gibeah, and the trumpet in Ramah: cry aloud at Bethaven, after thee, O Benjamin.
bsb_text: Blow the ram’s horn in Gibeah, the trumpet in Ramah; raise the battle cry in Beth-aven: Lead on, O Benjamin!
aov_text: Blaas die basuin in Gíbea, die trompet in Rama! Hef aan die krygsgeskreeu in Bet-Awen. Agter jou kom dit, Benjamin!

kjv_text: Ephraim shall be desolate in the day of rebuke: among the tribes of Israel have I made known that which shall surely be.
bsb_text: Ephraim will be laid waste on the day of rebuke. Among the tribes of Israel I proclaim what is certain.
aov_text: Efraim sal ’n woesteny word op die dag van straf; onder die stamme van Israel maak Ek bekend wat seker is.

kjv_text: The princes of Judah were like them that remove the bound: therefore I will pour out my wrath upon them like water.
bsb_text: The princes of Judah are like those who move boundary stones; I will pour out My fury upon them like water.
aov_text: Die vorste van Juda is soos hulle wat die grenslyne verlê. Ek sal my grimmigheid oor hulle uitgiet soos water.

kjv_text: Ephraim is oppressed and broken in judgment, because he willingly walked after the commandment.
bsb_text: Ephraim is oppressed, crushed in judgment, for he is determined to follow worthless idols.
aov_text: Efraim is verdruk, verbreek deur die oordeel; want dit het hom behaag om na die gebod van mense te wandel.

kjv_text: Therefore will I be unto Ephraim as a moth, and to the house of Judah as rottenness.
bsb_text: So I am like a moth to Ephraim, and like decay to the house of Judah.
aov_text: Daarom is Ek vir Efraim soos ’n mot en vir die huis van Juda soos ’n verrotting in die gebeente.

kjv_text: When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah saw his wound, then went Ephraim to the Assyrian, and sent to king Jareb: yet could he not heal you, nor cure you of your wound.
bsb_text: When Ephraim saw his sickness and Judah his wound, then Ephraim turned to Assyria and sent to the great king. But he cannot cure you or heal your wound.
aov_text: Toe Efraim sy krankheid sien en Juda sy sweer, het Efraim na Assur gegaan en na koning Jareb gestuur; maar hý kan julle nie genees en julle van die sweer nie gesond maak nie.

kjv_text: For I will be unto Ephraim as a lion, and as a young lion to the house of Judah: I, even I, will tear and go away; I will take away, and none shall rescue him.
bsb_text: For I am like a lion to Ephraim and like a young lion to the house of Judah. I, even I, will tear them to pieces and then go away. I will carry them off where no one can rescue them.
aov_text: Want Ek is soos ’n leeu vir Efraim, en soos ’n jong leeu vir die huis van Juda; Ek, Ek verskeur en gaan heen, Ek dra weg sonder dat iemand red.

kjv_text: I will go and return to my place, till they acknowledge their offence, and seek my face: in their affliction they will seek me early.
bsb_text: Then I will return to My place until they admit their guilt and seek My face; in their affliction they will earnestly seek Me.”
aov_text: Dan gaan Ek heen, Ek keer na my woonplek terug, totdat hulle skuld beken en my aangesig soek. In hulle nood sal hulle My soek.

kjv_text: Come, and let us return unto the LORD: for he hath torn, and he will heal us; he hath smitten, and he will bind us up.
bsb_text: Come, let us return to the LORD. For He has torn us to pieces, but He will heal us; He has wounded us, but He will bind up our wounds.
aov_text: KOM en laat ons terugkeer tot die HERE; want Hy het verskeur en sal ons genees, Hy het geslaan en sal ons verbind.

kjv_text: After two days will he revive us: in the third day he will raise us up, and we shall live in his sight.
bsb_text: After two days He will revive us; on the third day He will raise us up, that we may live in His presence.
aov_text: Hy sal ons ná twee dae lewend maak, op die derde dag ons laat opstaan, sodat ons voor sy aangesig kan lewe.

kjv_text: Then shall we know, if we follow on to know the LORD: his going forth is prepared as the morning; and he shall come unto us as the rain, as the latter and former rain unto the earth.
bsb_text: So let us know—let us press on to know the LORD. As surely as the sun rises, He will appear; He will come to us like the rain, like the spring showers that water the earth.
aov_text: En laat ons ken—laat ons dit najaag om die HERE te ken; sy opgang is so seker soos die dagbreek, en Hy sal tot ons kom soos die reën, soos die laat reëns wat die aarde besproei.

kjv_text: O Ephraim, what shall I do unto thee? O Judah, what shall I do unto thee? for your goodness is as a morning cloud, and as the early dew it goeth away.
bsb_text: What shall I do with you, O Ephraim? What shall I do with you, O Judah? For your loyalty is like a morning mist, like the early dew that vanishes.
aov_text: Wat sal Ek met jou doen, o Efraim; wat sal Ek met jou doen, o Juda? aangesien julle liefde is soos ’n môrewolk en soos ’n dou wat vroeg weer verdwyn.

kjv_text: Therefore have I hewed them by the prophets; I have slain them by the words of my mouth: and thy judgments are as the light that goeth forth.
bsb_text: Therefore I have hewn them by the prophets; I have slain them by the words of My mouth, and My judgments go forth like lightning.
aov_text: Daarom het Ek hulle neergekap deur die profete, hulle gedood deur die woorde van my mond, en die oordele oor jou kom te voorskyn soos ’n ligstraal.

kjv_text: For I desired mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.
bsb_text: For I desire mercy, not sacrifice, and the knowledge of God rather than burnt offerings.
aov_text: Want Ek het ’n behae in liefde en nie in offerande nie, en in kennis van God meer as in brandoffers.

kjv_text: But they like men have transgressed the covenant: there have they dealt treacherously against me.
bsb_text: But they, like Adam, have transgressed the covenant; there they were unfaithful to Me.
aov_text: Maar hulle het soos Adam die verbond oortree, daar het hulle troueloos teen My gehandel.

kjv_text: Gilead is a city of them that work iniquity, and is polluted with blood.
bsb_text: Gilead is a city of evildoers, tracked with footprints of blood.
aov_text: Gílead is ’n stad van kwaaddoeners, vol bloedspore.

kjv_text: And as troops of robbers wait for a man, so the company of priests murder in the way by consent: for they commit lewdness.
bsb_text: Like raiders who lie in ambush, so does a band of priests; they murder on the way to Shechem; surely they have committed atrocities.
aov_text: En soos ’n rower op die loer lê, loer ’n priesterbende; hulle pleeg moord op die pad na Sigem, ja, hulle het skandelike dade gedoen.

kjv_text: I have seen an horrible thing in the house of Israel: there is the whoredom of Ephraim, Israel is defiled.
bsb_text: In the house of Israel I have seen a horrible thing: Ephraim practices prostitution there, and Israel is defiled.
aov_text: In die huis van Israel het Ek ’n afskuwelike ding gesien: Efraim het daar tot hoerery verval, Israel is verontreinig.

kjv_text: Also, O Judah, he hath set an harvest for thee, when I returned the captivity of my people.
bsb_text: Also for you, O Judah, a harvest is appointed, when I restore My people from captivity.
aov_text: Ook vir jou, o Juda, is daar ’n oes beskik as Ek die lot van my volk verander.

kjv_text: When I would have healed Israel, then the iniquity of Ephraim was discovered, and the wickedness of Samaria: for they commit falsehood; and the thief cometh in, and the troop of robbers spoileth without.
bsb_text: When I heal Israel, the iniquity of Ephraim will be exposed, as well as the crimes of Samaria. For they practice deceit and thieves break in; bandits raid in the streets.
aov_text: TERWYL Ek Israel genees, word die ongeregtigheid van Efraim openbaar en die booshede van Samaría; want hulle pleeg bedrog en die dief breek in en ’n rowerbende plunder op die straat.

kjv_text: And they consider not in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness: now their own doings have beset them about; they are before my face.
bsb_text: But they fail to consider in their hearts that I remember all their evil. Now their deeds are all around them; they are before My face.
aov_text: En hulle sê nie in hulle hart dat Ek aan al hulle boosheid dink nie; nou omsingel hulle dade hulle, dit lê oop voor my aangesig.

kjv_text: They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.
bsb_text: They delight the king with their evil, and the princes with their lies.
aov_text: Met hulle boosheid verbly hulle die koning en met hulle leuens die vorste.

kjv_text: They are all adulterers, as an oven heated by the baker, who ceaseth from raising after he hath kneaded the dough, until it be leavened.
bsb_text: They are all adulterers, like an oven heated by a baker who needs not stoke the fire from the kneading to the rising of the dough.
aov_text: Hulle is almal owerspelers; hulle is soos ’n oond wat bly brand, ook al het die bakker opgehou met stook, vandat die deeg geknee word totdat dit deursuur is.

kjv_text: In the day of our king the princes have made him sick with bottles of wine; he stretched out his hand with scorners.
bsb_text: The princes are inflamed with wine on the day of our king; so he joins hands with those who mock him.
aov_text: Op die dag van ons koning is die vorste siek van verhitting deur wyn; hy steek sy hand uit na die spotters.

kjv_text: For they have made ready their heart like an oven, whiles they lie in wait: their baker sleepeth all the night; in the morning it burneth as a flaming fire.
bsb_text: For they prepare their heart like an oven while they lie in wait; all night their anger smolders; in the morning it blazes like a flaming fire.
aov_text: Ja, hulle het hul hart gemaak soos ’n oond in hul arglistigheid; die ganse nag deur slaap hulle bakker, in die môre vroeg brand dit soos ’n vuurvlam.

kjv_text: They are all hot as an oven, and have devoured their judges; all their kings are fallen: there is none among them that calleth unto me.
bsb_text: All of them are hot as an oven, and they devour their rulers. All their kings fall; not one of them calls upon Me.
aov_text: Hulle almal gloei soos ’n oond en verteer hul regeerders, al hulle konings val; daar is niemand onder hulle wat My aanroep nie.

kjv_text: Ephraim, he hath mixed himself among the people; Ephraim is a cake not turned.
bsb_text: Ephraim mixes with the nations; Ephraim is an unturned cake.
aov_text: Efraim—hy vermeng hom met die volke; Efraim is ’n roosterkoek wat nie omgekeer is nie.

kjv_text: Strangers have devoured his strength, and he knoweth it not: yea, gray hairs are here and there upon him, yet he knoweth not.
bsb_text: Foreigners consume his strength, but he does not notice. Even his hair is streaked with gray, but he does not know.
aov_text: Vreemdes verteer sy krag, en hy bemerk dit nie; ook is grysheid oor hom uitgesprei, en hy weet dit nie.

kjv_text: And the pride of Israel testifieth to his face: and they do not return to the LORD their God, nor seek him for all this.
bsb_text: Israel’s arrogance testifies against them, yet they do not return to the LORD their God; despite all this, they do not seek Him.
aov_text: Ja, die trotsheid van Israel getuig openlik teen hom; en tog bekeer hulle hul nie tot die HERE hulle God nie, en ondanks dit alles soek hulle Hom nie.

kjv_text: Ephraim also is like a silly dove without heart: they call to Egypt, they go to Assyria.
bsb_text: So Ephraim has become like a silly, senseless dove—calling out to Egypt, then turning to Assyria.
aov_text: So het Efraim dan geword soos ’n onnosele duif sonder verstand; hulle roep na Egipte, hulle gaan na Assur.

kjv_text: When they shall go, I will spread my net upon them; I will bring them down as the fowls of the heaven; I will chastise them, as their congregation hath heard.
bsb_text: As they go, I will spread My net over them; I will bring them down like birds of the air. I will chastise them when I hear them flocking together.
aov_text: Wanneer hulle gaan, sal Ek my net oor hulle uitsprei; soos die voëls van die hemel trek Ek hulle neer; Ek tugtig hulle soos in hulle samekoms aangekondig is.

kjv_text: Woe unto them! for they have fled from me: destruction unto them! because they have transgressed against me: though I have redeemed them, yet they have spoken lies against me.
bsb_text: Woe to them, for they have strayed from Me! Destruction to them, for they have rebelled against Me! Though I would redeem them, they speak lies against Me.
aov_text: Wee hulle, omdat hulle van My weggevlieg het! Verwoesting oor hulle, omdat hulle teen My oortree het! Ék tog wou hulle verlos, maar húlle het leuens teen My gespreek.

kjv_text: And they have not cried unto me with their heart, when they howled upon their beds: they assemble themselves for corn and wine, and they rebel against me.
bsb_text: They do not cry out to Me from their hearts when they wail upon their beds. They slash themselves for grain and new wine, but turn away from Me.
aov_text: Ook roep hulle nie van harte na My nie, maar jammer op hulle bedde; ter wille van koring en mos kerwe hulle hulself stukkend; hulle is opstandig teen My.

kjv_text: Though I have bound and strengthened their arms, yet do they imagine mischief against me.
bsb_text: Although I trained and strengthened their arms, they plot evil against Me.
aov_text: Alhoewel Ek hulle arms geoefen, versterk het, het hulle kwaad teen My beraam.

kjv_text: They return, but not to the most High: they are like a deceitful bow: their princes shall fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue: this shall be their derision in the land of Egypt.
bsb_text: They turn, but not to the Most High; they are like a faulty bow. Their leaders will fall by the sword for the cursing of their tongue; for this they will be ridiculed in the land of Egypt.
aov_text: Hulle keer terug, maar nie na bo nie; hulle is soos ’n bedrieglike boog; hulle vorste sal val deur die swaard weens die skeldwoorde van hulle tong. Dit is hulle bespotting in Egipteland.

kjv_text: Set the trumpet to thy mouth. He shall come as an eagle against the house of the LORD, because they have transgressed my covenant, and trespassed against my law.
bsb_text: Put the ram’s horn to your lips! An eagle looms over the house of the LORD, because the people have transgressed My covenant and rebelled against My law.
aov_text: DIE basuin aan jou mond! Soos ’n arend skiet dit neer op die huis van die HERE! Omdat hulle my verbond oortree het en teen my wet gesondig het.

kjv_text: Israel shall cry unto me, My God, we know thee.
bsb_text: Israel cries out to Me, “O our God, we know You!”
aov_text: My roep hulle toe: My God, ons, Israel, ken U.

kjv_text: Israel hath cast off the thing that is good: the enemy shall pursue him.
bsb_text: But Israel has rejected good; an enemy will pursue him.
aov_text: Israel het die goeie verwerp—die vyand sal hom agtervolg!

kjv_text: They have set up kings, but not by me: they have made princes, and I knew it not: of their silver and their gold have they made them idols, that they may be cut off.
bsb_text: They set up kings, but not by Me. They make princes, but without My approval. With their silver and gold they make themselves idols, to their own destruction.
aov_text: Húlle het konings aangestel, maar nie uit My nie; hulle het vorste gekies, maar sonder my wete; van hul silwer en goud het hulle vir hul afgode gemaak tot hulle verderf.

kjv_text: Thy calf, O Samaria, hath cast thee off; mine anger is kindled against them: how long will it be ere they attain to innocency?
bsb_text: He has rejected your calf, O Samaria. My anger burns against them. How long will they be incapable of innocence?
aov_text: Jou kalf, o Samaría, is afskuwelik; my toorn is teen hulle ontvlam. Hoe lank sal hulle tot reinheid onbekwaam wees?

kjv_text: For from Israel was it also: the workman made it; therefore it is not God: but the calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces.
bsb_text: For this thing is from Israel—a craftsman made it, and it is not God. It will be broken to pieces, that calf of Samaria.
aov_text: Want dit is ook uit Israel: ’n smid het dit gemaak, en dit is geen god nie; maar tot splinters sal dit word—die kalf van Samaría.

kjv_text: For they have sown the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind: it hath no stalk: the bud shall yield no meal: if so be it yield, the strangers shall swallow it up.
bsb_text: For they sow the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind. There is no standing grain; what sprouts fails to yield flour. Even if it should produce, the foreigners would swallow it up.
aov_text: Want hulle saai wind, maar hulle sal storm maai; dit het geen halm nie; wat uitspruit, lewer geen meel op nie; selfs as dit iets oplewer, sou vreemdelinge dit verslind.

kjv_text: Israel is swallowed up: now shall they be among the Gentiles as a vessel wherein is no pleasure.
bsb_text: Israel is swallowed up! Now they are among the nations like a worthless vessel.
aov_text: Israel is verslind; alreeds is hulle onder die volke soos iets wat waardeloos is.

kjv_text: For they are gone up to Assyria, a wild ass alone by himself: Ephraim hath hired lovers.
bsb_text: For they have gone up to Assyria like a wild donkey on its own. Ephraim has hired lovers.
aov_text: Want húlle het opgetrek na Assur—’n wilde-esel wat eiesinnig rondloop, is Efraim!—hulle het onwettige bondgenootskappe gewerf.

kjv_text: Yea, though they have hired among the nations, now will I gather them, and they shall sorrow a little for the burden of the king of princes.
bsb_text: Though they hire allies among the nations, I will now round them up, and they will begin to diminish under the oppression of the king of princes.
aov_text: Ook al werf hulle onder die volke, Ek sal hulle nou saamraap, en hulle sal begin minder word weens die laste deur die koning van die vorste opgelê.

kjv_text: Because Ephraim hath made many altars to sin, altars shall be unto him to sin.
bsb_text: Though Ephraim multiplied the altars for sin, they became his altars for sinning.
aov_text: Want Efraim het die altare vermenigvuldig om te sondig—die altare het vir hom tot sonde geword.

kjv_text: I have written to him the great things of my law, but they were counted as a strange thing.
bsb_text: Though I wrote for them the great things of My law, they regarded them as something strange.
aov_text: Ek het hom tienduisende leringe van my wet voorgeskrywe, maar dit word as iets vreemds geag.

kjv_text: They sacrifice flesh for the sacrifices of mine offerings, and eat it; but the LORD accepteth them not; now will he remember their iniquity, and visit their sins: they shall return to Egypt.
bsb_text: Though they offer sacrifices as gifts to Me, and though they eat the meat, the LORD does not accept them. Now He will remember their iniquity and punish their sins: They will return to Egypt.
aov_text: Slagoffers, My aangebied, offer hulle—vleis is dit, en hulle eet; die HERE het geen behae daarin nie. Nou sal Hy aan hulle ongeregtigheid dink en oor hulle sondes besoeking doen; hulle sal teruggaan na Egipte.

kjv_text: For Israel hath forgotten his Maker, and buildeth temples; and Judah hath multiplied fenced cities: but I will send a fire upon his cities, and it shall devour the palaces thereof.
bsb_text: Israel has forgotten his Maker and built palaces; Judah has multiplied its fortified cities. But I will send fire upon their cities, and it will consume their citadels.
aov_text: Omdat Israel sy Maker vergeet en paleise gebou het, en Juda ’n menigte versterkte stede, daarom sal Ek ’n vuur in sy stede slinger wat sy paleise sal verteer.

kjv_text: Rejoice not, O Israel, for joy, as other people: for thou hast gone a whoring from thy God, thou hast loved a reward upon every cornfloor.
bsb_text: Do not rejoice, O Israel, with exultation like the nations, for you have played the harlot against your God; you have made love for hire on every threshing floor.
aov_text: WEES nie bly met gejuig, o Israel, soos die volke nie, want jy het gehoereer van jou God af weg; jy het hoereloon liefgehad op al die koringdorsvloere.

kjv_text: The floor and the winepress shall not feed them, and the new wine shall fail in her.
bsb_text: The threshing floor and winepress will not feed them, and the new wine will fail them.
aov_text: Dorsvloer en parskuip sal hulle nie voed nie, en die mos sal hulle in die steek laat.

kjv_text: They shall not dwell in the LORD's land; but Ephraim shall return to Egypt, and they shall eat unclean things in Assyria.
bsb_text: They will not remain in the land of the LORD; Ephraim will return to Egypt and eat unclean food in Assyria.
aov_text: Hulle sal in die land van die HERE nie bly nie; maar Efraim sal na Egipte teruggaan, en in Assur sal hulle eet wat onrein is.

kjv_text: They shall not offer wine offerings to the LORD, neither shall they be pleasing unto him: their sacrifices shall be unto them as the bread of mourners; all that eat thereof shall be polluted: for their bread for their soul shall not come into the house of the LORD.
bsb_text: They will not pour out wine offerings to the LORD, and their sacrifices will not please Him, but will be to them like the bread of mourners; all who eat will be defiled. For their bread will be for themselves; it will not enter the house of the LORD.
aov_text: Hulle sal vir die HERE geen wyn uitgiet nie, en hulle slagoffers sal vir Hom nie welgevallig wees nie; soos tranebrood sal hulle spys vir hulle wees. Almal wat daarvan eet, word verontreinig; want hulle brood is vir hulleself: dit sal nie in die huis van die HERE kom nie.

kjv_text: What will ye do in the solemn day, and in the day of the feast of the LORD?
bsb_text: What will you do on the appointed day, on the day of the LORD’s feast?
aov_text: Wat sal julle dan doen op die feestyd en op die feesdag van die HERE?

kjv_text: For, lo, they are gone because of destruction: Egypt shall gather them up, Memphis shall bury them: the pleasant places for their silver, nettles shall possess them: thorns shall be in their tabernacles.
bsb_text: For even if they flee destruction, Egypt will gather them and Memphis will bury them. Their precious silver will be taken over by thistles, and thorns will overrun their tents.
aov_text: Want kyk, hulle gaan heen weens die verwoesting: Egipte sal hulle versamel, Mof hulle begrawe; onkruid sal hulle skat van silwergoed in besit neem, dorings in hulle tente wees.

kjv_text: The days of visitation are come, the days of recompence are come; Israel shall know it: the prophet is a fool, the spiritual man is mad, for the multitude of thine iniquity, and the great hatred.
bsb_text: The days of punishment have come; the days of retribution have arrived—let Israel know it. The prophet is called a fool, and the inspired man insane, because of the greatness of your iniquity and hostility.
aov_text: Die dae van besoeking het gekom, die dae van vergelding het gekom; Israel sal dit ervaar! Die profeet word ’n dwaas, die man van die gees ’n waansinnige, weens die grootheid van jou ongeregtigheid, en omdat die vyandskap groot is.

kjv_text: The watchman of Ephraim was with my God: but the prophet is a snare of a fowler in all his ways, and hatred in the house of his God.
bsb_text: The prophet is Ephraim’s watchman, along with my God, yet the snare of the fowler lies on all his paths. Hostility is in the house of his God!
aov_text: Efraim is ’n spioen teenoor my God; wat die profeet aangaan, die net van ’n voëlvanger is op al sy weë gesprei, vyandskap in die huis van sy God.

kjv_text: They have deeply corrupted themselves, as in the days of Gibeah: therefore he will remember their iniquity, he will visit their sins.
bsb_text: They have deeply corrupted themselves as in the days of Gibeah; He will remember their guilt; He will punish their sins.
aov_text: Hulle het baie, baie verkeerd gehandel soos in die dae van Gíbea. Hy sal dink aan hulle ongeregtigheid, besoeking doen oor hulle sondes.

kjv_text: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness; I saw your fathers as the firstripe in the fig tree at her first time: but they went to Baalpeor, and separated themselves unto that shame; and their abominations were according as they loved.
bsb_text: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness. I saw your fathers as the firstfruits of the fig tree in its first season. But they went to Baal-peor, and consecrated themselves to Shame; so they became as detestable as the thing they loved.
aov_text: Ek het Israel gevind soos druiwe in die woestyn; Ek het julle vaders gesien soos voorvye aan die vyeboom in sy eerste groei; maar húlle het na Baäl-Peor gekom en hulle aan die skandegod toegewy en ’n verfoeisel geword net soos die voorwerp van hulle liefde.

kjv_text: As for Ephraim, their glory shall fly away like a bird, from the birth, and from the womb, and from the conception.
bsb_text: Ephraim’s glory will fly away like a bird, with no birth, no pregnancy, and no conception.
aov_text: Efraim—sy heerlikheid sal wegvlieg soos ’n voël. Geen geboorte, geen moederskap, geen ontvangenis meer nie!

kjv_text: Though they bring up their children, yet will I bereave them, that there shall not be a man left: yea, woe also to them when I depart from them!
bsb_text: Even if they raise their children, I will bereave them of each one. Yes, woe be to them when I turn away from them!
aov_text: Ja, al sou hulle hul kinders grootmaak, Ek maak hulle kinderloos, sonder mense; ja, wee hulleself ook as Ek van hulle wyk.

kjv_text: Ephraim, as I saw Tyrus, is planted in a pleasant place: but Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer.
bsb_text: I have seen Ephraim, like Tyre, planted in a meadow. But Ephraim will bring out his children for slaughter.
aov_text: Efraim, soos Ek dit sien na Tirus heen, is geplant in ’n mooi omgewing, maar Efraim sal sy seuns na die moordenaar moet uitbring.

kjv_text: Give them, O LORD: what wilt thou give? give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.
bsb_text: Give them, O LORD—what will You give? Give them wombs that miscarry and breasts that dry up!
aov_text: Gee hulle, o HERE—wat sal U gee?—gee hulle ’n kinderlose moederskoot en uitgedroogde borste.

kjv_text: All their wickedness is in Gilgal: for there I hated them: for the wickedness of their doings I will drive them out of mine house, I will love them no more: all their princes are revolters.
bsb_text: All their evil appears at Gilgal, for there I hated them. I will drive them from My house for the wickedness of their deeds. I will no longer love them; all their leaders are rebellious.
aov_text: Al hulle boosheid is byeen in Gilgal, want daar het Ek hulle begin haat weens die boosheid van hulle handelinge; Ek sal hulle uit my huis uitdrywe, hulle nie meer liefhê nie. Al hulle vorste is opstandig.

kjv_text: Ephraim is smitten, their root is dried up, they shall bear no fruit: yea, though they bring forth, yet will I slay even the beloved fruit of their womb.
bsb_text: Ephraim is struck down; their root is withered; they cannot bear fruit. Even if they bear children, I will slay the darlings of their wombs.
aov_text: Efraim is getref, hulle wortel het verdor, hulle dra geen vrug meer nie; ook wanneer hulle kinders baar, sal Ek nogtans die lieflinge van hulle skoot ombring.

kjv_text: My God will cast them away, because they did not hearken unto him: and they shall be wanderers among the nations.
bsb_text: My God will reject them because they have not obeyed Him; and they shall be wanderers among the nations.
aov_text: My God sal hulle verwerp, omdat hulle na Hom nie geluister het nie, en hulle sal rondswerwe onder die nasies.

kjv_text: Israel is an empty vine, he bringeth forth fruit unto himself: according to the multitude of his fruit he hath increased the altars; according to the goodness of his land they have made goodly images.
bsb_text: Israel was a luxuriant vine, yielding fruit for himself. The more his fruit increased, the more he increased the altars. The better his land produced, the better he made the sacred pillars.
aov_text: ISRAEL was ’n weelderig uitbottende wynstok wat sy vrug voortgebring het; hoe meer vrug hy gedra het, des te meer altare het hy gebou; hoe beter dit met sy land gesteld was, des te beter het hy die klippilare gemaak.

kjv_text: Their heart is divided; now shall they be found faulty: he shall break down their altars, he shall spoil their images.
bsb_text: Their hearts are devious; now they must bear their guilt. The LORD will break down their altars and demolish their sacred pillars.
aov_text: Vals is hulle hart; nou sal hulle daarvoor boet; Hy sal hulle altare stukkend breek, hulle klippilare verwoes.

kjv_text: For now they shall say, We have no king, because we feared not the LORD; what then should a king do to us?
bsb_text: Surely now they will say, “We have no king, for we do not revere the LORD. What can a king do for us?”
aov_text: Ja, nou sal hulle sê: Ons het geen koning nie, want ons het die HERE nie gevrees nie; en die koning—wat sou hy vir ons kan doen?

kjv_text: They have spoken words, swearing falsely in making a covenant: thus judgment springeth up as hemlock in the furrows of the field.
bsb_text: They speak mere words; with false oaths they make covenants. So judgment springs up like poisonous weeds in the furrows of a field.
aov_text: Hulle het groot woorde gespreek, vals gesweer, verbonde gesluit—en soos ’n gifplant spruit die oordeel uit in die vore van die landerye.

kjv_text: The inhabitants of Samaria shall fear because of the calves of Bethaven: for the people thereof shall mourn over it, and the priests thereof that rejoiced on it, for the glory thereof, because it is departed from it.
bsb_text: The people of Samaria will fear for the calf of Beth-aven. Indeed, its people will mourn with its idolatrous priests—those who rejoiced in its glory—for it has been taken from them into exile.
aov_text: Oor die kalf van Bet-Awen sal die inwoners van Samaría besorg wees; want sy volk sal oor hom treur en sy afgodspriesters oor hom sidder, oor sy heerlikheid, omdat dit van hom weggevoer is.

kjv_text: It shall be also carried unto Assyria for a present to king Jareb: Ephraim shall receive shame, and Israel shall be ashamed of his own counsel.
bsb_text: Yes, it will be carried to Assyria as tribute to the great king. Ephraim will be seized with shame; Israel will be ashamed of its wooden idols.
aov_text: Hy sal ook self na Assur weggevoer word as ’n geskenk aan koning Jareb; skaamte sal Efraim aangryp, en Israel sal beskaamd staan oor sy eie raadsbesluit.

kjv_text: As for Samaria, her king is cut off as the foam upon the water.
bsb_text: Samaria will be carried off with her king like a twig on the surface of the water.
aov_text: Samaría word vernietig, sy koning is soos ’n spaander op die water.

kjv_text: The high places also of Aven, the sin of Israel, shall be destroyed: the thorn and the thistle shall come up on their altars; and they shall say to the mountains, Cover us; and to the hills, Fall on us.
bsb_text: The high places of Aven will be destroyed—it is the sin of Israel; thorns and thistles will overgrow their altars. Then they will say to the mountains, “Cover us!” and to the hills, “Fall on us!”
aov_text: En die hoogtes van Awen, Israel se sonde, word verdelg, dorings en distels sal opskiet op hulle altare; en hulle sal tot die berge sê: Bedek ons! en tot die heuwels: Val op ons!

kjv_text: O Israel, thou hast sinned from the days of Gibeah: there they stood: the battle in Gibeah against the children of iniquity did not overtake them.
bsb_text: Since the days of Gibeah you have sinned, O Israel, and there you have remained. Did not the battle in Gibeah overtake the sons of iniquity?
aov_text: Sedert die dae van Gíbea het jy gesondig, o Israel! Daar staan hulle—moet die stryd teen die kwaaddoeners hulle nie oorval in Gíbea nie?

kjv_text: It is in my desire that I should chastise them; and the people shall be gathered against them, when they shall bind themselves in their two furrows.
bsb_text: I will chasten them when I please; nations will be gathered against them to put them in bondage for their double transgression.
aov_text: Dit is my begeerte om hulle te tugtig, en volke sal teen hulle versamel word as hulle gebind word aan hulle twee ongeregtighede.

kjv_text: And Ephraim is as an heifer that is taught, and loveth to tread out the corn; but I passed over upon her fair neck: I will make Ephraim to ride; Judah shall plow, and Jacob shall break his clods.
bsb_text: Ephraim is a well-trained heifer that loves to thresh; but I will place a yoke on her fair neck. I will harness Ephraim, Judah will plow, and Jacob will break the hard ground.
aov_text: Maar Efraim is ’n geleerde jong koei wat gewillig dors; nogtans sal Ek self oor haar mooi nek gaan: Ek sal Efraim laat trek; Juda sal die ploeg trek, Jakob sal die eg sleep.

kjv_text: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap in mercy; break up your fallow ground: for it is time to seek the LORD, till he come and rain righteousness upon you.
bsb_text: Sow for yourselves righteousness and reap the fruit of loving devotion; break up your unplowed ground. For it is time to seek the LORD until He comes and sends righteousness upon you like rain.
aov_text: Saai vir julle volgens die eis van geregtigheid, maai in ooreenstemming met die liefde; braak vir julle ’n braakland, want dit is tyd om die HERE te soek, totdat Hy kom en geregtigheid oor julle laat reën.

kjv_text: Ye have plowed wickedness, ye have reaped iniquity; ye have eaten the fruit of lies: because thou didst trust in thy way, in the multitude of thy mighty men.
bsb_text: You have plowed wickedness and reaped injustice; you have eaten the fruit of lies. Because you have trusted in your own way and in the multitude of your mighty men,
aov_text: Julle het goddeloosheid ingeploeë, julle het slegtigheid gemaai, die vrug van leuens geëet, omdat jy op jou weg vertrou het, op die menigte van jou helde.

kjv_text: Therefore shall a tumult arise among thy people, and all thy fortresses shall be spoiled, as Shalman spoiled Betharbel in the day of battle: the mother was dashed in pieces upon her children.
bsb_text: the roar of battle will rise against your people, so that all your fortresses will be demolished as Shalman devastated Beth-arbel in the day of battle, when mothers were dashed to pieces along with their children.
aov_text: Daarom sal daar oorlogsrumoer onder jou volke ontstaan en al jou vestings verwoes word net soos Salman Bet-Arbel verwoes het in die dag van oorlog: moeders is met kinders en al verpletter.

kjv_text: So shall Bethel do unto you because of your great wickedness: in a morning shall the king of Israel utterly be cut off.
bsb_text: Thus it will be done to you, O Bethel, because of your great wickedness. When the day dawns, the king of Israel will be utterly cut off.
aov_text: Net so het Bet-el aan julle gedoen weens julle ontsettende boosheid; in die môre vroeg is dit gedaan, gedaan met die koning van Israel.

kjv_text: When Israel was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt.
bsb_text: When Israel was a child, I loved him, and out of Egypt I called My son.
aov_text: TOE Israel ’n kind was, het Ek hom liefgehad, en uit Egipte het Ek my seun geroep.

kjv_text: As they called them, so they went from them: they sacrificed unto Baalim, and burned incense to graven images.
bsb_text: But the more I called Israel, the farther they departed from Me. They sacrificed to the Baals and burned incense to carved images.
aov_text: Hoe meer die profete hulle geroep het, des te meer het hulle van húlle af weggeloop; hulle het aan die Baäls geoffer en vir die gesnede beelde rook laat opgaan.

kjv_text: I taught Ephraim also to go, taking them by their arms; but they knew not that I healed them.
bsb_text: It was I who taught Ephraim to walk, taking them in My arms, but they never realized that it was I who healed them.
aov_text: En Ek self het Efraim leer loop. Hy het hulle op sy arms geneem, maar hulle het nie erken dat Ek hulle genees het nie.

kjv_text: I drew them with cords of a man, with bands of love: and I was to them as they that take off the yoke on their jaws, and I laid meat unto them.
bsb_text: I led them with cords of kindness, with ropes of love; I lifted the yoke from their necks and bent down to feed them.
aov_text: Met mensebande, met koorde van liefde het Ek hulle getrek; en Ek was vir hulle soos diegene wat die juk van hulle kakebeen af oplig; en Ek het My na hom neergebuig, Ek het hom voedsel gegee.

kjv_text: He shall not return into the land of Egypt, but the Assyrian shall be his king, because they refused to return.
bsb_text: Will they not return to the land of Egypt and be ruled by Assyria because they refused to repent?
aov_text: Hy sal na Egipteland nie terugkeer nie, maar Assur—dié sal sy koning wees; omdat hulle geweier het om hulle te bekeer.

kjv_text: And the sword shall abide on his cities, and shall consume his branches, and devour them, because of their own counsels.
bsb_text: A sword will flash through their cities; it will destroy the bars of their gates and consume them in their own plans.
aov_text: En die swaard sal geswaai word in sy stede en sy grendels vernietig en verteer weens hulle planne.

kjv_text: And my people are bent to backsliding from me: though they called them to the most High, none at all would exalt him.
bsb_text: My people are bent on turning from Me. Though they call to the Most High, He will by no means exalt them.
aov_text: Want my volk dwing om van My afvallig te word; en as die profete hom roep na bo, rig hy hom glad nie op nie.

kjv_text: How shall I give thee up, Ephraim? how shall I deliver thee, Israel? how shall I make thee as Admah? how shall I set thee as Zeboim? mine heart is turned within me, my repentings are kindled together.
bsb_text: How could I give you up, O Ephraim? How could I surrender you, O Israel? How could I make you like Admah? How could I treat you like Zeboiim? My heart is turned within Me; My compassion is stirred!
aov_text: Hoe kan Ek jou oorgee, o Efraim, jou prysgee, o Israel? Hoe kan Ek jou maak soos Adma, jou gelykstel met Seboïm: my hart is omgekeer in My, tegelykertyd is my medelyde opgewek.

kjv_text: I will not execute the fierceness of mine anger, I will not return to destroy Ephraim: for I am God, and not man; the Holy One in the midst of thee: and I will not enter into the city.
bsb_text: I will not execute the full fury of My anger; I will not turn back to destroy Ephraim. For I am God and not man—the Holy One among you—and I will not come in wrath.
aov_text: Ek sal my toorngloed nie laat geld nie, Ek sal Efraim nie weer te gronde rig nie; want Ek is God en nie ’n mens nie, die Heilige in jou midde. En Ek sal nie kom in grimmigheid nie.

kjv_text: They shall walk after the LORD: he shall roar like a lion: when he shall roar, then the children shall tremble from the west.
bsb_text: They will walk after the LORD; He will roar like a lion. When He roars, His children will come trembling from the west.
aov_text: Hulle sal agter die HERE aan trek; Hy sal brul soos ’n leeu. Want Hy sal brul, en die kinders sal sidderende van die seekant aankom.

kjv_text: They shall tremble as a bird out of Egypt, and as a dove out of the land of Assyria: and I will place them in their houses, saith the LORD.
bsb_text: They will come trembling like birds from Egypt and like doves from the land of Assyria. Then I will settle them in their homes, declares the LORD.
aov_text: Hulle sal sidderende aankom soos ’n voëltjie uit Egipte en soos ’n duif uit die land Assur; en Ek sal hulle laat woon in hulle huise, spreek die HERE.

kjv_text: Ephraim compasseth me about with lies, and the house of Israel with deceit: but Judah yet ruleth with God, and is faithful with the saints.
bsb_text: Ephraim surrounds Me with lies, the house of Israel with deceit; but Judah still walks with God and is faithful to the Holy One.
aov_text: EFRAIM het My omsingel met leuens, en die huis van Israel met bedrog; terwyl Juda nog altyd bandeloos is teenoor God, ja, teenoor die Allerheiligste, die Getroue.

kjv_text: Ephraim feedeth on wind, and followeth after the east wind: he daily increaseth lies and desolation; and they do make a covenant with the Assyrians, and oil is carried into Egypt.
bsb_text: Ephraim chases the wind and pursues the east wind all day long; he multiplies lies and violence; he makes a covenant with Assyria and sends olive oil to Egypt.
aov_text: Efraim hou hom besig met wind, en hy agtervolg die oostewind; die hele dag vermeerder hy leuens en geweld, en hulle sluit ’n verbond met Assur, terwyl olie na Egipte gevoer word.

kjv_text: The LORD hath also a controversy with Judah, and will punish Jacob according to his ways; according to his doings will he recompense him.
bsb_text: The LORD also brings a charge against Judah. He will punish Jacob according to his ways and repay him according to his deeds.
aov_text: Die HERE het ook ’n twis met Juda, en Hy sal oor Jakob besoeking doen volgens sy weë, hom vergelde na sy dade.

kjv_text: He took his brother by the heel in the womb, and by his strength he had power with God:
bsb_text: In the womb he grasped his brother’s heel, and in his vigor he wrestled with God.
aov_text: In die moederskoot het hy sy broer by die hakskeen gehou, en in sy manlike krag het hy met God geworstel.

kjv_text: Yea, he had power over the angel, and prevailed: he wept, and made supplication unto him: he found him in Bethel, and there he spake with us;
bsb_text: Yes, he struggled with the angel and prevailed; he wept and sought His favor; he found Him at Bethel and spoke with Him there—
aov_text: Ja, hy het met die Engel geworstel en die oorhand gekry, hy het geween en Hom gesmeek. By Bet-el het hy Hom gevind, en daar het Hy met ons gespreek.

kjv_text: Even the LORD God of hosts; the LORD is his memorial.
bsb_text: the LORD is the God of Hosts—the LORD is His name of renown.
aov_text: En HERE God van die leërskare, HERE is sy gedenknaam.

kjv_text: Therefore turn thou to thy God: keep mercy and judgment, and wait on thy God continually.
bsb_text: But you must return to your God, maintaining love and justice, and always waiting on your God.
aov_text: En jy, tot jou God moet jy terugkeer, beoefen liefde en reg, en hoop gedurigdeur op jou God.

kjv_text: He is a merchant, the balances of deceit are in his hand: he loveth to oppress.
bsb_text: A merchant loves to defraud with dishonest scales in his hands.
aov_text: Kanaän—in sy hand is daar ’n valse weegskaal, hy hou daarvan om af te pers.

kjv_text: And Ephraim said, Yet I am become rich, I have found me out substance: in all my labours they shall find none iniquity in me that were sin.
bsb_text: And Ephraim boasts: “How rich I have become! I have found wealth for myself. In all my labors, they can find in me no iniquity that is sinful.”
aov_text: Maar Efraim sê: Tog het ek ryk geword, ek het vir my ’n vermoë verwerf. Alles wat ek verwerf het, is nie genoeg om op my enige sondeskuld te lê nie.

kjv_text: And I that am the LORD thy God from the land of Egypt will yet make thee to dwell in tabernacles, as in the days of the solemn feast.
bsb_text: But I am the LORD your God ever since the land of Egypt. I will again make you dwell in tents, as in the days of the appointed feast.
aov_text: Maar Ek is die HERE jou God van Egipteland af, Ek sal jou weer in tente laat woon soos in die dae van die huttefees.

kjv_text: I have also spoken by the prophets, and I have multiplied visions, and used similitudes, by the ministry of the prophets.
bsb_text: I spoke through the prophets and multiplied their visions; I gave parables through the prophets.
aov_text: Ek het ook tot die profete gespreek, en Ek het gesigte vermenigvuldig en deur middel van die profete gelykenisse voorgedra.

kjv_text: Is there iniquity in Gilead? surely they are vanity: they sacrifice bullocks in Gilgal; yea, their altars are as heaps in the furrows of the fields.
bsb_text: Is there iniquity in Gilead? They will surely come to nothing. Do they sacrifice bulls in Gilgal? Indeed, their altars will be heaps of stones in the furrows of the field.
aov_text: Was Gílead goddeloosheid—hulle het louter nietigheid geword. In Gilgal het hulle beeste geoffer; so sal dan hulle altare wees soos kliphope op die vore van die landerye.

kjv_text: And Jacob fled into the country of Syria, and Israel served for a wife, and for a wife he kept sheep.
bsb_text: Jacob fled to the land of Aram and Israel worked for a wife—for a wife he tended sheep.
aov_text: En Jakob het gevlug na die veld van Aram, en Israel was diensbaar vir ’n vrou as loon, en vir ’n vrou het hy vee opgepas.

kjv_text: And by a prophet the LORD brought Israel out of Egypt, and by a prophet was he preserved.
bsb_text: But by a prophet the LORD brought Israel out of Egypt, and by a prophet he was preserved.
aov_text: Maar deur ’n profeet het die HERE Israel uit Egipte laat optrek, en deur ’n profeet is hulle opgepas.

kjv_text: Ephraim provoked him to anger most bitterly: therefore shall he leave his blood upon him, and his reproach shall his LORD return unto him.
bsb_text: Ephraim has provoked bitter anger, so his Lord will leave his bloodguilt upon him and repay him for his contempt.
aov_text: Efraim het die HERE bitterlik geterg; daarom sal Hy sy bloedskulde op hom laat neerkom, ja, sy Here sal hom vir die aangedane smaad vergelde.

kjv_text: When Ephraim spake trembling, he exalted himself in Israel; but when he offended in Baal, he died.
bsb_text: When Ephraim spoke, there was trembling; he was exalted in Israel. But he incurred guilt through Baal, and he died.
aov_text: AS Efraim net gespreek het, was daar siddering; hoog het hy gestaan in Israel. Maar hy het hom skuldig gemaak deur die Baäl en gesterwe.

kjv_text: And now they sin more and more, and have made them molten images of their silver, and idols according to their own understanding, all of it the work of the craftsmen: they say of them, Let the men that sacrifice kiss the calves.
bsb_text: Now they sin more and more and make for themselves cast images, idols skillfully made from their silver, all of them the work of craftsmen. People say of them, “They offer human sacrifice and kiss the calves!”
aov_text: En nou gaan hulle voort om te sondig en het vir hulle ’n gegote beeld van hulle silwer gemaak, afgode volgens hulle insig, geheel en al smidswerk; van hulle word gesê: Die mense wat offer, vereer kalwers met kusse!

kjv_text: Therefore they shall be as the morning cloud, and as the early dew that passeth away, as the chaff that is driven with the whirlwind out of the floor, and as the smoke out of the chimney.
bsb_text: Therefore they will be like the morning mist, like the early dew that vanishes, like chaff blown from a threshing floor, like smoke through an open window.
aov_text: Daarom sal hulle wees soos ’n môrewolk en soos dou wat vroeg weer verdwyn, soos kaf wat wegvlieg van die dorsvloer en soos rook uit die venster.

kjv_text: Yet I am the LORD thy God from the land of Egypt, and thou shalt know no god but me: for there is no saviour beside me.
bsb_text: Yet I am the LORD your God ever since the land of Egypt; you know no God but Me, for there is no Savior besides Me.
aov_text: Tog was Ek, die HERE, jou God van Egipteland af, en buiten My het jy geen God geken nie, ja, behalwe My is daar geen Heiland nie.

kjv_text: I did know thee in the wilderness, in the land of great drought.
bsb_text: I knew you in the wilderness, in the land of drought.
aov_text: Ek het jou in die woestyn geken, in die land van droogtes.

kjv_text: According to their pasture, so were they filled; they were filled, and their heart was exalted; therefore have they forgotten me.
bsb_text: When they had pasture, they became satisfied; when they were satisfied, their hearts became proud, and as a result they forgot Me.
aov_text: Ooreenkomstig hulle weiveld het hulle versadig geword; toe hulle versadig was, het hulle hart hoogmoedig geword; daarom het hulle My vergeet.

kjv_text: Therefore I will be unto them as a lion: as a leopard by the way will I observe them:
bsb_text: So like a lion I will pounce on them; like a leopard I will lurk by the path.
aov_text: Toe het Ek vir hulle soos ’n leeu geword, soos ’n luiperd lê Ek by die pad en loer.

kjv_text: I will meet them as a bear that is bereaved of her whelps, and will rend the caul of their heart, and there will I devour them like a lion: the wild beast shall tear them.
bsb_text: Like a bear robbed of her cubs I will attack them, and I will tear open their chests. There I will devour them like a lion, like a wild beast would tear them apart.
aov_text: Ek val hulle aan soos ’n beer wat van kleintjies beroof is, en Ek skeur hulle borskas oop; en soos ’n leeuin verslind Ek hulle daar, die wilde diere van die veld sal hulle verskeur.

kjv_text: O Israel, thou hast destroyed thyself; but in me is thine help.
bsb_text: You are destroyed, O Israel, because you are against Me—against your helper.
aov_text: Dit is jou verderf, o Israel, dat jy teen My, jou helper, is.

kjv_text: I will be thy king: where is any other that may save thee in all thy cities? and thy judges of whom thou saidst, Give me a king and princes?
bsb_text: Where is your king now to save you in all your cities, and the rulers to whom you said, “Give me a king and princes”?
aov_text: Waar is nou jou koning, dat hy jou kan verlos in al jou stede, en jou regters van wie jy gesê het: Gee my ’n koning en vorste?

kjv_text: I gave thee a king in mine anger, and took him away in my wrath.
bsb_text: So in My anger I gave you a king, and in My wrath I took him away.
aov_text: Ek gee jou ’n koning in my toorn, en Ek neem hom weg in my grimmigheid.

kjv_text: The iniquity of Ephraim is bound up; his sin is hid.
bsb_text: The iniquity of Ephraim is bound up; his sin is stored up.
aov_text: Saamgebind is die ongeregtigheid van Efraim, weggebêre is sy sonde.

kjv_text: The sorrows of a travailing woman shall come upon him: he is an unwise son; for he should not stay long in the place of the breaking forth of children.
bsb_text: Labor pains come upon him, but he is an unwise son. When the time arrives, he fails to present himself at the opening of the womb.
aov_text: Barensweë sal hom oorval, hy is ’n onverstandige kind; want as die tyd daar is, stel hy hom nie in die kindergeboorte nie.

kjv_text: I will ransom them from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death: O death, I will be thy plagues; O grave, I will be thy destruction: repentance shall be hid from mine eyes.
bsb_text: I will ransom them from the power of Sheol; I will redeem them from Death. Where, O Death, are your plagues? Where, O Sheol, is your sting? Compassion is hidden from My eyes.
aov_text: Uit die mag van die doderyk sal Ek hulle loskoop, Ek sal hulle verlos van die dood. Dood, waar is jou pestilensies? Doderyk, waar is jou verderf? Berou bly vir my oë verborge.

kjv_text: Though he be fruitful among his brethren, an east wind shall come, the wind of the LORD shall come up from the wilderness, and his spring shall become dry, and his fountain shall be dried up: he shall spoil the treasure of all pleasant vessels.
bsb_text: Although he flourishes among his brothers, an east wind will come—a wind from the LORD rising up from the desert. His fountain will fail, and his spring will run dry. The wind will plunder his treasury of every precious article.
aov_text: Wanneer hy vrug dra onder die broers, kom ’n oostewind, ’n wind van die HERE, wat uit die woestyn opkom; dan droog sy fontein op en sy bron dor uit. Dié sal ’n skat van allerhande kosbare voorwerpe roof.

kjv_text: Samaria shall become desolate; for she hath rebelled against her God: they shall fall by the sword: their infants shall be dashed in pieces, and their women with child shall be ripped up.
bsb_text: Samaria will bear her guilt because she has rebelled against her God. They will fall by the sword; their little ones will be dashed to pieces, and their pregnant women ripped open.
aov_text: SAMARÍA sal daarvoor boet, omdat hy weerspannig was teen sy God; hulle sal val deur die swaard, hulle kinders sal verpletter en hulle swanger vroue oopgesny word.

kjv_text: O Israel, return unto the LORD thy God; for thou hast fallen by thine iniquity.
bsb_text: Return, O Israel, to the LORD your God, for you have stumbled by your iniquity.
aov_text: Bekeer jou, Israel, tot die HERE jou God, want jy het gestruikel deur jou ongeregtigheid.

kjv_text: Take with you words, and turn to the LORD: say unto him, Take away all iniquity, and receive us graciously: so will we render the calves of our lips.
bsb_text: Bring your confessions and return to the LORD. Say to Him: “Take away all our iniquity and receive us graciously, that we may present the fruit of our lips.
aov_text: Neem woorde met julle, en bekeer julle tot die HERE; sê aan Hom: Vergeef alle ongeregtigheid, en neem aan wat goed is; dan sal ons as offerdiere ons lippe aanbied.

kjv_text: Asshur shall not save us; we will not ride upon horses: neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, Ye are our gods: for in thee the fatherless findeth mercy.
bsb_text: Assyria will not save us, nor will we ride on horses. We will never again say, ‘Our gods!’ to the work of our own hands. For in You the fatherless find compassion.”
aov_text: Assur kan ons nie red nie, op perde wil ons nie ry nie en tot die werk van ons hande nie meer sê: Onse God nie! Want by U vind die wees ontferming.

kjv_text: I will heal their backsliding, I will love them freely: for mine anger is turned away from him.
bsb_text: I will heal their apostasy; I will freely love them, for My anger has turned away from them.
aov_text: Ek sal hulle afkerigheid genees, hulle vrywillig liefhê, want my toorn is van hulle afgewend.

kjv_text: I will be as the dew unto Israel: he shall grow as the lily, and cast forth his roots as Lebanon.
bsb_text: I will be like the dew to Israel; he will blossom like the lily and take root like the cedars of Lebanon.
aov_text: Ek sal vir Israel wees soos die dou, hy sal bloei soos ’n lelie en sy wortels uitslaan soos die Líbanon.

kjv_text: His branches shall spread, and his beauty shall be as the olive tree, and his smell as Lebanon.
bsb_text: His shoots will sprout, and his splendor will be like the olive tree, his fragrance like the cedars of Lebanon.
aov_text: Sy lote sal uitsprei, en sy prag wees soos dié van ’n olyfboom en sy geur soos die Líbanon.

kjv_text: They that dwell under his shadow shall return; they shall revive as the corn, and grow as the vine: the scent thereof shall be as the wine of Lebanon.
bsb_text: They will return and dwell in his shade; they will grow grain and blossom like the vine. His renown will be like the wine of Lebanon.
aov_text: Die wat onder sy skaduwee sit, sal weer koring laat groei; en hulle self sal bloei soos die wingerdstok; die roem daarvan sal wees soos die wyn van die Líbanon.

kjv_text: Ephraim shall say, What have I to do any more with idols? I have heard him, and observed him: I am like a green fir tree. From me is thy fruit found.
bsb_text: O Ephraim, what have I to do anymore with idols? It is I who answer and watch over him. I am like a flourishing cypress; your fruit comes from Me.
aov_text: Efraim, wat het Ek nog met die afgode te doen? Ek het hom verhoor en hou my oog oor hom. Ek is soos ’n groen sipres; uit My word jou vrug gevind.

kjv_text: Who is wise, and he shall understand these things? prudent, and he shall know them? for the ways of the LORD are right, and the just shall walk in them: but the transgressors shall fall therein.
bsb_text: Whoever is wise, let him understand these things; whoever is discerning, let him know them. For the ways of the LORD are right, and the righteous walk in them but the rebellious stumble in them.
aov_text: Wie wys is, laat hom op hierdie dinge let! Wie verstandig is, laat hom dit erken! Want die weë van die HERE is reg; en die regverdiges sal daarop wandel, maar die oortreders daarop struikel!

kjv_text: The word of the LORD that came to Joel the son of Pethuel.
bsb_text: This is the word of the LORD that came to Joel son of Pethuel:
aov_text: DIE woord van die HERE wat tot Joël, die seun van Pétuel, gekom het.

kjv_text: Hear this, ye old men, and give ear, all ye inhabitants of the land. Hath this been in your days, or even in the days of your fathers?
bsb_text: Hear this, O elders; and give ear, all who dwell in the land. Has anything like this ever happened in your days or in the days of your fathers?
aov_text: Hoor dit, o oudstes, en luister, alle inwoners van die land! Het so iets ooit in julle dae of in die dae van julle vaders plaasgevind?

kjv_text: Tell ye your children of it, and let your children tell their children, and their children another generation.
bsb_text: Tell it to your children; let your children tell it to their children, and their children to the next generation.
aov_text: Vertel daarvan aan julle kinders, en julle kinders aan hulle kinders, en húlle kinders aan die volgende geslag:

kjv_text: That which the palmerworm hath left hath the locust eaten; and that which the locust hath left hath the cankerworm eaten; and that which the cankerworm hath left hath the caterpiller eaten.
bsb_text: What the devouring locust has left, the swarming locust has eaten; what the swarming locust has left, the young locust has eaten; and what the young locust has left, the destroying locust has eaten.
aov_text: Wat die afknyper laat oorbly het, het die treksprinkaan verslind; en wat die treksprinkaan laat oorbly het, het die voetganger verslind; en wat die voetganger laat oorbly het, het die kaalvreter verslind.

kjv_text: Awake, ye drunkards, and weep; and howl, all ye drinkers of wine, because of the new wine; for it is cut off from your mouth.
bsb_text: Wake up, you drunkards, and weep; wail, all you drinkers of wine, because of the sweet wine, for it has been cut off from your mouth.
aov_text: Word wakker, julle dronkaards, en ween! En huil, al julle wyndrinkers! Oor die mos, omdat dit van julle mond weggeruk is.

kjv_text: For a nation is come up upon my land, strong, and without number, whose teeth are the teeth of a lion, and he hath the cheek teeth of a great lion.
bsb_text: For a nation has invaded My land, powerful and without number; its teeth are the teeth of a lion, and its fangs are the fangs of a lioness.
aov_text: Want ’n sterk en ontelbare nasie het opgetrek oor my land; sy tande is leeutande, en dit kan byt soos ’n leeuin.

kjv_text: He hath laid my vine waste, and barked my fig tree: he hath made it clean bare, and cast it away; the branches thereof are made white.
bsb_text: It has laid waste My grapevine and splintered My fig tree. It has stripped off the bark and thrown it away; the branches have turned white.
aov_text: Dit het my wingerdstok verwoes en my vyeboom versplinter; dit het ál sy bas afgeskil en weggegooi; die lote daarvan het wit geword.

kjv_text: Lament like a virgin girded with sackcloth for the husband of her youth.
bsb_text: Wail like a virgin dressed in sackcloth, grieving for the husband of her youth.
aov_text: Weeklaag soos ’n jonkvrou wat oor die bruidegom van haar jeug met ’n roukleed omgord is.

kjv_text: The meat offering and the drink offering is cut off from the house of the LORD; the priests, the LORD's ministers, mourn.
bsb_text: Grain and drink offerings have been cut off from the house of the LORD; the priests are in mourning, those who minister before the LORD.
aov_text: Spysoffer en drankoffer is ontruk aan die huis van die HERE; die priesters, die dienaars van die HERE, treur.

kjv_text: The field is wasted, the land mourneth; for the corn is wasted: the new wine is dried up, the oil languisheth.
bsb_text: The field is ruined; the land mourns. For the grain is destroyed, the new wine is dried up, and the oil fails.
aov_text: Die veld is verwoes, die akkerland treur; want die koring is verwoes, die mos het weggedroog, die olie het verdwyn.

kjv_text: Be ye ashamed, O ye husbandmen; howl, O ye vinedressers, for the wheat and for the barley; because the harvest of the field is perished.
bsb_text: Be dismayed, O farmers, wail, O vinedressers, over the wheat and barley, because the harvest of the field has perished.
aov_text: Die landbouers staan beskaamd, die wynboere weeklaag oor die koring en oor die gars, omdat die oes op die land verlore is.

kjv_text: The vine is dried up, and the fig tree languisheth; the pomegranate tree, the palm tree also, and the apple tree, even all the trees of the field, are withered: because joy is withered away from the sons of men.
bsb_text: The grapevine is dried up, and the fig tree is withered; the pomegranate, palm, and apple—all the trees of the orchard—are withered. Surely the joy of mankind has dried up.
aov_text: Die wingerdstok het verdor, en die vyeboom het verwelk; die granaat, ook die palm en die appelboom, al die bome van die land het verdor; want beskaamd is die vreugde, weg van die mensekinders af.

kjv_text: Gird yourselves, and lament, ye priests: howl, ye ministers of the altar: come, lie all night in sackcloth, ye ministers of my God: for the meat offering and the drink offering is withholden from the house of your God.
bsb_text: Put on sackcloth and lament, O priests; wail, O ministers of the altar. Come, spend the night in sackcloth, O ministers of my God, because the grain and drink offerings are withheld from the house of your God.
