aov_text: Omgord julle en klaag, o priesters! Huil, dienaars van die altaar! Kom, vernag in rouklere, dienaars van my God! Want die spysoffer en die drankoffer is geweer van die huis van julle God.

kjv_text: Sanctify ye a fast, call a solemn assembly, gather the elders and all the inhabitants of the land into the house of the LORD your God, and cry unto the LORD.
bsb_text: Consecrate a fast; proclaim a solemn assembly! Gather the elders and all the residents of the land to the house of the LORD your God, and cry out to the LORD.
aov_text: Heilig ’n vasdag, roep ’n vergadering saam! Versamel die oudstes, alle inwoners van die land in die huis van die HERE julle God, en roep tot die HERE.

kjv_text: Alas for the day! for the day of the LORD is at hand, and as a destruction from the Almighty shall it come.
bsb_text: Alas for the day! For the Day of the LORD is near, and it will come as destruction from the Almighty.
aov_text: Ag, die dag! Want naby is die dag van die HERE, en hy kom soos ’n verwoesting van die Almagtige.

kjv_text: Is not the meat cut off before our eyes, yea, joy and gladness from the house of our God?
bsb_text: Has not the food been cut off before our very eyes—joy and gladness from the house of our God?
aov_text: Is die spys nie weggeruk voor ons oë nie, blydskap en gejuig weg uit die huis van onse God?

kjv_text: The seed is rotten under their clods, the garners are laid desolate, the barns are broken down; for the corn is withered.
bsb_text: The seeds lie shriveled beneath the clods; the storehouses are in ruins; the granaries are broken down, for the grain has withered away.
aov_text: Die graankorrels het weggekrimp onder hulle kluite, die voorraadkamers is verwoes, die graanbakke afgebreek, want die koring het verdor.

kjv_text: How do the beasts groan! the herds of cattle are perplexed, because they have no pasture; yea, the flocks of sheep are made desolate.
bsb_text: How the cattle groan! The herds wander in confusion because they have no pasture. Even the flocks of sheep are suffering.
aov_text: Hoe sug die vee! Die troppe beeste is onrustig, want daar is geen weiveld vir hulle nie; ook die troppe kleinvee moet boet.

kjv_text: O LORD, to thee will I cry: for the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness, and the flame hath burned all the trees of the field.
bsb_text: To You, O LORD, I call, for fire has consumed the open pastures and flames have scorched all the trees of the field.
aov_text: Tot U, o HERE, roep ek, want ’n vuur het die weivelde van die woestyn verteer, en ’n vlam het al die bome van die veld aan die brand gesteek.

kjv_text: The beasts of the field cry also unto thee: for the rivers of waters are dried up, and the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness.
bsb_text: Even the beasts of the field pant for You, for the streams of water have dried up, and fire has consumed the open pastures.
aov_text: Selfs die diere van die veld smag na U; want die waterstrome het opgedroog, en ’n vuur het die weivelde van die woestyn verteer.

kjv_text: Blow ye the trumpet in Zion, and sound an alarm in my holy mountain: let all the inhabitants of the land tremble: for the day of the LORD cometh, for it is nigh at hand;
bsb_text: Blow the ram’s horn in Zion; sound the alarm on My holy mountain! Let all who dwell in the land tremble, for the Day of the LORD is coming; indeed, it is near—
aov_text: BLAAS die basuin op Sion, en blaas alarm op my heilige berg! Laat al die inwoners van die land bewe, want die dag van die HERE kom, want hy is naby —

kjv_text: A day of darkness and of gloominess, a day of clouds and of thick darkness, as the morning spread upon the mountains: a great people and a strong; there hath not been ever the like, neither shall be any more after it, even to the years of many generations.
bsb_text: a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and blackness. Like the dawn overspreading the mountains a great and strong army appears, such as never was of old, nor will ever be in ages to come.
aov_text: ’n dag van duisternis en donkerheid, ’n dag van wolke en wolkenag; soos die môreskemering, uitgesprei oor die berge, kom ’n talryke en magtige volk, wat van oudsher sy gelyke nie gehad het nie en dit hierna ook nie sal hê tot in die jare van die verste geslagte nie.

kjv_text: A fire devoureth before them; and behind them a flame burneth: the land is as the garden of Eden before them, and behind them a desolate wilderness; yea, and nothing shall escape them.
bsb_text: Before them a fire devours, and behind them a flame scorches. The land before them is like the Garden of Eden, but behind them, it is like a desert wasteland—surely nothing will escape them.
aov_text: Voor hom uit verteer ’n vuur, en agter hom brand ’n vlam; voor hom lyk die land soos die tuin van Eden, en agter hom is dit ’n woeste wildernis; ook kan niks daaraan ontkom nie.

kjv_text: The appearance of them is as the appearance of horses; and as horsemen, so shall they run.
bsb_text: Their appearance is like that of horses, and they gallop like swift steeds.
aov_text: Sy voorkoms is soos dié van perde, en net soos ryperde so hardloop hulle.

kjv_text: Like the noise of chariots on the tops of mountains shall they leap, like the noise of a flame of fire that devoureth the stubble, as a strong people set in battle array.
bsb_text: With a sound like that of chariots they bound over the mountaintops, like the crackling of fire consuming stubble, like a mighty army deployed for battle.
aov_text: Soos die gedruis van waens huppel hulle oor die bergtoppe, soos die geknetter van ’n vuurvlam wat die kaf verteer, soos ’n magtige volk wat vir die geveg opgestel is.

kjv_text: Before their face the people shall be much pained: all faces shall gather blackness.
bsb_text: Nations writhe in horror before them; every face turns pale.
aov_text: Vir hom bewe die volke van angs, alle aangesigte verbleek.

kjv_text: They shall run like mighty men; they shall climb the wall like men of war; and they shall march every one on his ways, and they shall not break their ranks:
bsb_text: They charge like mighty men; they scale the walls like men of war. Each one marches in formation, not swerving from the course.
aov_text: Soos helde hardloop hulle, soos krygsmanne klim hulle op die muur, en elkeen gaan sy eie koers; hulle verander nie van pad nie.

kjv_text: Neither shall one thrust another; they shall walk every one in his path: and when they fall upon the sword, they shall not be wounded.
bsb_text: They do not jostle one another; each proceeds in his path. They burst through the defenses, never breaking ranks.
aov_text: En die een druk nie die ander nie; elkeen gaan sy eie pad; en tussen wapens deur val hulle; maar hulle bly in gelid.

kjv_text: They shall run to and fro in the city; they shall run upon the wall, they shall climb up upon the houses; they shall enter in at the windows like a thief.
bsb_text: They storm the city; they run along the wall; they climb into houses, entering through windows like thieves.
aov_text: Hulle oorval die stad, hulle hardloop op die muur, hulle klim in die huise, hulle dring by die vensters in soos ’n dief.

kjv_text: The earth shall quake before them; the heavens shall tremble: the sun and the moon shall be dark, and the stars shall withdraw their shining:
bsb_text: Before them the earth quakes; the heavens tremble. The sun and moon grow dark, and the stars lose their brightness.
aov_text: Voor hulle bewe die aarde, sidder die hemel; die son en die maan word swart, en die sterre trek hulle glans in.

kjv_text: And the LORD shall utter his voice before his army: for his camp is very great: for he is strong that executeth his word: for the day of the LORD is great and very terrible; and who can abide it?
bsb_text: The LORD raises His voice in the presence of His army. Indeed, His camp is very large, for mighty are those who obey His command. For the Day of the LORD is great and very dreadful. Who can endure it?
aov_text: En die HERE verhef sy stem voor sy leërmag uit; want geweldig groot is sy leër, ja, magtig die uitvoerder van sy woord. Want die dag van die HERE is groot en uitermate vreeslik, en wie kan dit verdra?

kjv_text: Therefore also now, saith the LORD, turn ye even to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning:
bsb_text: “Yet even now,” declares the LORD, “return to Me with all your heart, with fasting, weeping, and mourning.”
aov_text: Maar selfs nou nog, spreek die HERE, bekeer julle tot My met julle hele hart, en met vas en geween en rouklag.

kjv_text: And rend your heart, and not your garments, and turn unto the LORD your God: for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repenteth him of the evil.
bsb_text: So rend your hearts and not your garments, and return to the LORD your God. For He is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion. And He relents from sending disaster.
aov_text: En skeur julle hart en nie julle klere nie, en bekeer julle tot die HERE julle God; want Hy is genadig en barmhartig, lankmoedig en groot van goedertierenheid, en Een wat berou het oor die onheil;

kjv_text: Who knoweth if he will return and repent, and leave a blessing behind him; even a meat offering and a drink offering unto the LORD your God?
bsb_text: Who knows? He may turn and relent and leave a blessing behind Him—grain and drink offerings for the LORD your God.
aov_text: wie weet of dit Hom nie weer sal berou nie, sodat Hy ’n seën sal agterlaat—’n spysoffer en ’n drankoffer aan die HERE julle God.

kjv_text: Blow the trumpet in Zion, sanctify a fast, call a solemn assembly:
bsb_text: Blow the ram’s horn in Zion, consecrate a fast, proclaim a sacred assembly.
aov_text: Blaas die basuin op Sion, heilig ’n vasdag, roep ’n vergadering saam!

kjv_text: Gather the people, sanctify the congregation, assemble the elders, gather the children, and those that suck the breasts: let the bridegroom go forth of his chamber, and the bride out of her closet.
bsb_text: Gather the people, sanctify the congregation, assemble the aged, gather the children, even those nursing at the breast. Let the bridegroom leave his room, and the bride her chamber.
aov_text: Versamel die volk, heilig die gemeente, vergader die oudstes, versamel die kinders en die suiglinge! Laat die bruidegom uit sy kamer uitgaan en die bruid uit haar slaapvertrek.

kjv_text: Let the priests, the ministers of the LORD, weep between the porch and the altar, and let them say, Spare thy people, O LORD, and give not thine heritage to reproach, that the heathen should rule over them: wherefore should they say among the people, Where is their God?
bsb_text: Let the priests who minister before the LORD weep between the portico and the altar, saying, “Spare Your people, O LORD, and do not make Your heritage a reproach, an object of scorn among the nations. Why should they say among the peoples, ‘Where is their God?’”
aov_text: Laat die priesters, die dienaars van die HERE, tussen die voorportaal en die altaar ween en sê: o HERE, spaar u volk, en gee u erfdeel nie oor aan smaadheid, dat die nasies met hulle spot nie; waarom sou hulle onder die volke sê: Waar is hulle God?

kjv_text: Then will the LORD be jealous for his land, and pity his people.
bsb_text: Then the LORD became jealous for His land, and He spared His people.
aov_text: TOE het die HERE geywer vir sy land en sy volk verskoon.

kjv_text: Yea, the LORD will answer and say unto his people, Behold, I will send you corn, and wine, and oil, and ye shall be satisfied therewith: and I will no more make you a reproach among the heathen:
bsb_text: And the LORD answered His people: “Behold, I will send you grain, new wine, and oil, and by them you will be satisfied. I will never again make you a reproach among the nations.
aov_text: En die HERE het geantwoord en aan sy volk gesê: Kyk, Ek stuur vir julle koring en mos en olie, sodat julle daarvan versadig word, en Ek maak julle nie meer tot ’n voorwerp van smaad onder die nasies nie.

kjv_text: But I will remove far off from you the northern army, and will drive him into a land barren and desolate, with his face toward the east sea, and his hinder part toward the utmost sea, and his stink shall come up, and his ill savour shall come up, because he hath done great things.
bsb_text: The northern army I will drive away from you, banishing it to a barren and desolate land, its front ranks into the Eastern Sea, and its rear guard into the Western Sea. And its stench will rise; its foul odor will ascend. For He has done great things.
aov_text: Ja, Ek sal die sprinkaanswerm, uit die noorde afkomstig, van julle af wegjaag en dit wegdrywe na ’n dor en woeste land; sy voorhoede na die Oostelike See en sy agterhoede na die Westelike See toe. En sy stank sal opstyg, en ’n slegte reuk uit hom opgaan; want hy het alte groot dinge gedoen.

kjv_text: Fear not, O land; be glad and rejoice: for the LORD will do great things.
bsb_text: Do not be afraid, O land; rejoice and be glad, for the LORD has done great things.
aov_text: Wees nie bevrees nie, o aarde, juig en wees bly, want die HERE doen groot dinge!

kjv_text: Be not afraid, ye beasts of the field: for the pastures of the wilderness do spring, for the tree beareth her fruit, the fig tree and the vine do yield their strength.
bsb_text: Do not be afraid, O beasts of the field, for the open pastures have turned green, the trees bear their fruit, and the fig tree and vine yield their best.
aov_text: Wees nie bevrees nie, diere van die veld, want die weivelde van die woestyn spruit uit, want die bome dra hulle vrugte, die vyeboom en die wingerdstok lewer hulle drag!

kjv_text: Be glad then, ye children of Zion, and rejoice in the LORD your God: for he hath given you the former rain moderately, and he will cause to come down for you the rain, the former rain, and the latter rain in the first month.
bsb_text: Be glad, O children of Zion, and rejoice in the LORD your God, for He has given you the autumn rains for your vindication. He sends you showers, both autumn and spring rains, as before.
aov_text: En julle, kinders van Sion, juig en wees bly in die HERE julle God, want Hy gee julle die leraar tot geregtigheid en laat op julle neerdaal die reën, die vroeë reëns en die laat reëns, soos voorheen.

kjv_text: And the floors shall be full of wheat, and the vats shall overflow with wine and oil.
bsb_text: The threshing floors will be full of grain, and the vats will overflow with new wine and oil.
aov_text: Dan sal die dorsvloere vol koring wees en die parskuipe van mos en olie oorloop.

kjv_text: And I will restore to you the years that the locust hath eaten, the cankerworm, and the caterpiller, and the palmerworm, my great army which I sent among you.
bsb_text: I will repay you for the years eaten by locusts—the swarming locust, the young locust, the destroying locust, and the devouring locust—My great army that I sent against you.
aov_text: En Ek sal julle vergoed die jare wat die treksprinkaan, die voetganger, die kaalvreter en die afknyper verslind het—my groot leërmag wat Ek teen julle gestuur het.

kjv_text: And ye shall eat in plenty, and be satisfied, and praise the name of the LORD your God, that hath dealt wondrously with you: and my people shall never be ashamed.
bsb_text: You will have plenty to eat, until you are satisfied. You will praise the name of the LORD your God, who has worked wonders for you. My people will never again be put to shame.
aov_text: Dan sal julle oorvloedig eet en versadig wees en die Naam van die HERE julle God prys wat wonderbaar met julle gehandel het, en my volk sal in ewigheid nie beskaamd staan nie.

kjv_text: And ye shall know that I am in the midst of Israel, and that I am the LORD your God, and none else: and my people shall never be ashamed.
bsb_text: Then you will know that I am present in Israel and that I am the LORD your God, and there is no other. My people will never again be put to shame.
aov_text: En julle sal weet dat Ek in die midde van Israel is, en dat Ek die HERE julle God is, en niemand anders nie; en my volk sal in ewigheid nie beskaamd staan nie.

kjv_text: And it shall come to pass afterward, that I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, your old men shall dream dreams, your young men shall see visions:
bsb_text: And afterward, I will pour out My Spirit on all people. Your sons and daughters will prophesy, your old men will dream dreams, your young men will see visions.
aov_text: En daarna sal Ek my Gees uitgiet op alle vlees, en julle seuns en julle dogters sal profeteer, julle ou mense drome droom, julle jongelinge gesigte sien.

kjv_text: And also upon the servants and upon the handmaids in those days will I pour out my spirit.
bsb_text: Even on My menservants and maidservants, I will pour out My Spirit in those days.
aov_text: En ook op die diensknegte en op die diensmaagde sal Ek in dié dae my Gees uitgiet.

kjv_text: And I will shew wonders in the heavens and in the earth, blood, and fire, and pillars of smoke.
bsb_text: I will show wonders in the heavens and on the earth, blood and fire and columns of smoke.
aov_text: En Ek sal wondertekens gee aan die hemel en op die aarde: bloed en vuur en rookpilare.

kjv_text: The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and the terrible day of the LORD come.
bsb_text: The sun will be turned to darkness and the moon to blood before the coming of the great and awesome Day of the LORD.
aov_text: Die son sal verander word in duisternis en die maan in bloed, voordat die groot en deurlugtige dag van die HERE kom.

kjv_text: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the LORD shall be delivered: for in mount Zion and in Jerusalem shall be deliverance, as the LORD hath said, and in the remnant whom the LORD shall call.
bsb_text: And everyone who calls on the name of the LORD will be saved; for on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be deliverance, as the LORD has promised, among the remnant called by the LORD.
aov_text: En elkeen wat die Naam van die HERE aanroep, sal gered word; want op die berg Sion en in Jerusalem sal daar ontkoming wees soos die HERE gesê het, en onder die vrygeraaktes die wat die HERE sal roep.

kjv_text: For, behold, in those days, and in that time, when I shall bring again the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem,
bsb_text: “Yes, in those days and at that time, when I restore Judah and Jerusalem from captivity,
aov_text: WANT kyk, in dié dae en in dié tyd wanneer Ek die lot van Juda en Jerusalem verander,

kjv_text: I will also gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat, and will plead with them there for my people and for my heritage Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations, and parted my land.
bsb_text: I will gather all the nations and bring them down to the Valley of Jehoshaphat. There I will enter into judgment against them concerning My people, My inheritance, Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations as they divided up My land.
aov_text: sal Ek al die nasies versamel en hulle na die dal van Jósafat laat aftrek, om daar met hulle ’n strafgerig te hou ter wille van my volk en my erfdeel Israel wat hulle onder die nasies verstrooi het, en my land wat hulle verdeel het.

kjv_text: And they have cast lots for my people; and have given a boy for an harlot, and sold a girl for wine, that they might drink.
bsb_text: They cast lots for My people; they bartered a boy for a prostitute and sold a girl for wine to drink.
aov_text: En oor my volk het hulle die lot gewerp en ’n jong seun weggegee vir ’n hoer en ’n meisie verkoop vir wyn en dit gedrink.

kjv_text: Yea, and what have ye to do with me, O Tyre, and Zidon, and all the coasts of Palestine? will ye render me a recompence? and if ye recompense me, swiftly and speedily will I return your recompence upon your own head;
bsb_text: Now what do you have against Me, O Tyre, Sidon, and all the regions of Philistia? Are you rendering against Me a recompense? If you retaliate against Me, I will swiftly and speedily return your recompense upon your heads.
aov_text: En ook, wat het julle met My te doen, o Tirus en Sidon en al die landstreke van Filistéa? Wil julle My iets vergelde, of wil julle My iets aandoen? Gou, ylings sal Ek julle dade op julle hoof laat neerkom.

kjv_text: Because ye have taken my silver and my gold, and have carried into your temples my goodly pleasant things:
bsb_text: For you took My silver and gold and carried off My finest treasures to your temples.
aov_text: Want julle het my silwer en my goud geneem en my kosbare skatte na julle tempels gebring.

kjv_text: The children also of Judah and the children of Jerusalem have ye sold unto the Grecians, that ye might remove them far from their border.
bsb_text: You sold the people of Judah and Jerusalem to the Greeks, to send them far from their homeland.
aov_text: Verder het julle die kinders van Juda en die kinders van Jerusalem aan die kinders van Jawan verkoop, om hulle ver van hul grondgebied te verwyder.

kjv_text: Behold, I will raise them out of the place whither ye have sold them, and will return your recompence upon your own head:
bsb_text: Behold, I will rouse them from the places to which you sold them; I will return your recompense upon your heads.
aov_text: Kyk, Ek sal hulle laat opstaan uit die plek waarheen julle hulle verkoop het, en julle dade op julle hoof laat neerkom.

kjv_text: And I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the children of Judah, and they shall sell them to the Sabeans, to a people far off: for the LORD hath spoken it.
bsb_text: I will sell your sons and daughters into the hands of the people of Judah, and they will sell them to the Sabeans—to a distant nation.” Indeed, the LORD has spoken.
aov_text: En Ek sal julle seuns en julle dogters aan die kinders van Juda verkoop, en dié sal hulle verkoop aan die Sabeërs, aan ’n verafgeleë volk; want die HERE het dit gespreek.

kjv_text: Proclaim ye this among the Gentiles; Prepare war, wake up the mighty men, let all the men of war draw near; let them come up:
bsb_text: Proclaim this among the nations: “Prepare for war; rouse the mighty men; let all the men of war advance and attack!
aov_text: Roep dit uit onder die nasies, heilig ’n oorlog! Wek die helde op, laat al die krygsmanne nader kom, opruk!

kjv_text: Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruninghooks into spears: let the weak say, I am strong.
bsb_text: Beat your plowshares into swords and your pruning hooks into spears. Let the weak say, ‘I am strong!’
aov_text: Smee van julle pikke swaarde en van julle snoeimesse spiese; laat die swakke sê: Ek is ’n held.

kjv_text: Assemble yourselves, and come, all ye heathen, and gather yourselves together round about: thither cause thy mighty ones to come down, O LORD.
bsb_text: Come quickly, all you surrounding nations, and gather yourselves. Bring down Your mighty ones, O LORD.
aov_text: Haas julle en kom aan, alle nasies rondom, en versamel julle. Laat u helde, HERE, daarheen aftrek!

kjv_text: Let the heathen be wakened, and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat: for there will I sit to judge all the heathen round about.
bsb_text: Let the nations be roused and advance to the Valley of Jehoshaphat, for there I will sit down to judge all the nations on every side.
aov_text: Die nasies moet hulle klaarmaak en optrek na die dal van Jósafat; want daar sal Ek sit om gerig te hou oor al die nasies rondom.

kjv_text: Put ye in the sickle, for the harvest is ripe: come, get you down; for the press is full, the fats overflow; for their wickedness is great.
bsb_text: Swing the sickle, for the harvest is ripe. Come, trample the grapes, for the winepress is full; the wine vats overflow because their wickedness is great.
aov_text: Steek die sekel in, want die oes is ryp! Kom trap, want die parskuip is vol, die kuipe loop oor! Want hulle boosheid is groot.

kjv_text: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision: for the day of the LORD is near in the valley of decision.
bsb_text: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision! For the Day of the LORD is near in the valley of decision.
aov_text: Menigtes, menigtes in die dal van beslissing, want naby is die dag van die HERE in die dal van beslissing!

kjv_text: The sun and the moon shall be darkened, and the stars shall withdraw their shining.
bsb_text: The sun and moon will grow dark, and the stars will no longer shine.
aov_text: Die son en die maan word duister, en die sterre trek hulle glans in.

kjv_text: The LORD also shall roar out of Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the heavens and the earth shall shake: but the LORD will be the hope of his people, and the strength of the children of Israel.
bsb_text: The LORD will roar from Zion and raise His voice from Jerusalem; heaven and earth will tremble. But the LORD will be a refuge for His people, a stronghold for the people of Israel.
aov_text: En die HERE brul uit Sion, en uit Jerusalem verhef Hy sy stem, sodat hemel en aarde bewe. Maar die HERE sal ’n toevlug wees vir sy volk en ’n skuilplek vir die kinders van Israel.

kjv_text: So shall ye know that I am the LORD your God dwelling in Zion, my holy mountain: then shall Jerusalem be holy, and there shall no strangers pass through her any more.
bsb_text: Then you will know that I am the LORD your God, who dwells in Zion, My holy mountain. Jerusalem will be holy, never again to be overrun by foreigners.
aov_text: Dan sal julle weet dat Ek die HERE julle God is, wat woon op Sion, my heilige berg; dan sal Jerusalem ’n heiligdom wees waar geen vreemdes meer deur sal trek nie.

kjv_text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the mountains shall drop down new wine, and the hills shall flow with milk, and all the rivers of Judah shall flow with waters, and a fountain shall come forth of the house of the LORD, and shall water the valley of Shittim.
bsb_text: And in that day the mountains will drip with sweet wine, and the hills will flow with milk. All the streams of Judah will run with water, and a spring will flow from the house of the LORD to water the Valley of Acacias.
aov_text: En op dié dag sal die berge drup van mos en die heuwels vloei van melk en al die spruitjies van Juda stroom van water; en uit die huis van die HERE sal daar ’n fontein uitkom om die dal Sittim te besproei.

kjv_text: Egypt shall be a desolation, and Edom shall be a desolate wilderness, for the violence against the children of Judah, because they have shed innocent blood in their land.
bsb_text: Egypt will become desolate, and Edom a desert wasteland, because of the violence done to the people of Judah, in whose land they shed innocent blood.
aov_text: Egipte sal ’n woesteny word, en Edom ’n woeste wildernis wees, weens die geweld wat hulle die kinders van Juda aangedoen het, dat hulle onskuldige bloed in hul land vergiet het.

kjv_text: But Judah shall dwell for ever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.
bsb_text: But Judah will be inhabited forever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.
aov_text: Maar Juda sal vir ewig bly, en Jerusalem van geslag tot geslag.

kjv_text: For I will cleanse their blood that I have not cleansed: for the LORD dwelleth in Zion.
bsb_text: For I will avenge their blood, which I have not yet avenged.” For the LORD dwells in Zion.
aov_text: En Ek sal hulle bloed onskuldig verklaar, wat Ek tevore nie onskuldig verklaar het nie; en die HERE sal op Sion bly woon.

kjv_text: The words of Amos, who was among the herdmen of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.
bsb_text: These are the words of Amos, who was among the sheepherders of Tekoa—what he saw concerning Israel two years before the earthquake, in the days when Uzziah was king of Judah and Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel.
aov_text: DIE woorde van Amos, een van die skaapboere uit Tekóa, wat hy gesien het aangaande Israel in die dae van Ussía, koning van Juda, en in die dae van Jeróbeam, die seun van Joas, koning van Israel, twee jaar voor die aardbewing.

kjv_text: And he said, The LORD will roar from Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the habitations of the shepherds shall mourn, and the top of Carmel shall wither.
bsb_text: He said: “The LORD roars from Zion and raises His voice from Jerusalem; the pastures of the shepherds mourn, and the summit of Carmel withers.”
aov_text: En hy het gesê: Die HERE brul uit Sion en verhef sy stem uit Jerusalem, sodat die weivelde van die herders treur en die top van Karmel verdor.

kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Damascus, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have threshed Gilead with threshing instruments of iron:
bsb_text: This is what the LORD says: “For three transgressions of Damascus, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because they threshed Gilead with sledges of iron.
aov_text: So sê die HERE: Oor drie oortredinge van Damaskus, ja, oor vier, sal Ek dit nie afwend nie; omdat hulle Gílead met ysterdorssleë gedors het.

kjv_text: But I will send a fire into the house of Hazael, which shall devour the palaces of Benhadad.
bsb_text: So I will send fire upon the house of Hazael to consume the citadels of Ben-hadad.
aov_text: Daarom sal Ek ’n vuur slinger in die huis van Hásael, en dit sal die paleise van Bénhadad verteer.

kjv_text: I will break also the bar of Damascus, and cut off the inhabitant from the plain of Aven, and him that holdeth the sceptre from the house of Eden: and the people of Syria shall go into captivity unto Kir, saith the LORD.
bsb_text: I will break down the gates of Damascus; I will cut off the ruler of the Valley of Aven and the one who wields the scepter in Beth-eden. The people of Aram will be exiled to Kir,” says the LORD.
aov_text: En Ek sal die grendel van Damaskus verbreek en die inwoners uit die laagte van Awen uitroei en die wat die septer dra, uit Bet-Eden, en die volk van Aram sal in ballingskap gaan na Kir, sê die HERE.

kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Gaza, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they carried away captive the whole captivity, to deliver them up to Edom:
bsb_text: This is what the LORD says: “For three transgressions of Gaza, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because they exiled a whole population, delivering them up to Edom.
aov_text: So sê die HERE: Oor drie oortredinge van Gasa, ja, oor vier, sal Ek dit nie afwend nie; omdat hulle ’n ganse bevolking in ballingskap weggevoer het om dit aan Edom uit te lewer.

kjv_text: But I will send a fire on the wall of Gaza, which shall devour the palaces thereof:
bsb_text: So I will send fire upon the walls of Gaza, to consume its citadels.
aov_text: Daarom sal Ek ’n vuur slinger in die muur van Gasa, en dit sal sy paleise verteer.

kjv_text: And I will cut off the inhabitant from Ashdod, and him that holdeth the sceptre from Ashkelon, and I will turn mine hand against Ekron: and the remnant of the Philistines shall perish, saith the Lord GOD.
bsb_text: I will cut off the ruler of Ashdod and the one who wields the scepter in Ashkelon. I will turn My hand against Ekron, and the remnant of the Philistines will perish,” says the Lord GOD.
aov_text: En Ek sal die inwoners uit Asdod uitroei en die wat die septer dra, uit Áskelon; en Ek sal my hand teen Ekron uitstrek, en die oorblyfsel van die Filistyne sal omkom, sê die Here HERE.

kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Tyrus, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they delivered up the whole captivity to Edom, and remembered not the brotherly covenant:
bsb_text: This is what the LORD says: “For three transgressions of Tyre, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because they delivered up a whole congregation of exiles to Edom and broke a covenant of brotherhood.
aov_text: So sê die HERE: Oor drie oortredinge van Tirus, ja, oor vier, sal Ek dit nie afwend nie; omdat hulle ’n ganse bevolking as ballinge aan Edom uitgelewer het en nie gedink het aan die broederverbond nie.

kjv_text: But I will send a fire on the wall of Tyrus, which shall devour the palaces thereof.
bsb_text: So I will send fire upon the walls of Tyre to consume its citadels.”
aov_text: Daarom sal Ek ’n vuur slinger in die muur van Tirus, en dit sal sy paleise verteer.

kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Edom, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because he did pursue his brother with the sword, and did cast off all pity, and his anger did tear perpetually, and he kept his wrath for ever:
bsb_text: This is what the LORD says: “For three transgressions of Edom, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because he pursued his brother with the sword and stifled all compassion; his anger raged continually, and his fury flamed incessantly.
aov_text: So sê die HERE: Oor drie oortredinge van Edom, ja, oor vier, sal Ek dit nie afwend nie; omdat hy sy broer met die swaard agtervolg het en sy jammergevoel verstik het, sodat sy toorn altyd verskeur en hy gedurigdeur sy grimmigheid behou.

kjv_text: But I will send a fire upon Teman, which shall devour the palaces of Bozrah.
bsb_text: So I will send fire upon Teman to consume the citadels of Bozrah.”
aov_text: Daarom sal Ek ’n vuur slinger in Teman, en dit sal die paleise van Bosra verteer.

kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of the children of Ammon, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have ripped up the women with child of Gilead, that they might enlarge their border:
bsb_text: This is what the LORD says: “For three transgressions of the Ammonites, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because they ripped open the pregnant women of Gilead in order to enlarge their territory.
aov_text: So sê die HERE: Oor drie oortredinge van die kinders van Ammon, ja, oor vier, sal Ek dit nie afwend nie; omdat hulle die swanger vroue van Gílead oopgesny het om hulle grondgebied uit te brei.

kjv_text: But I will kindle a fire in the wall of Rabbah, and it shall devour the palaces thereof, with shouting in the day of battle, with a tempest in the day of the whirlwind:
bsb_text: So I will kindle a fire in the walls of Rabbah to consume its citadels amid war cries on the day of battle and a violent wind on the day of tempest.
aov_text: Daarom sal Ek ’n vuur aansteek in die muur van Rabba, en dit sal sy paleise verteer, met krygsgeskreeu op die dag van stryd, in ’n storm op die dag van die orkaan.

kjv_text: And their king shall go into captivity, he and his princes together, saith the LORD.
bsb_text: Their king will go into exile—he and his princes together,” says the LORD.
aov_text: En hulle koning sal in ballingskap gaan, hy en sy vorste tesame, sê die HERE.

kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Moab, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime:
bsb_text: This is what the LORD says: “For three transgressions of Moab, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because he burned to lime the bones of Edom’s king.
aov_text: SO sê die HERE: Oor drie oortredinge van Moab, ja, oor vier, sal Ek dit nie afwend nie; omdat hy die beendere van die koning van Edom tot kalk verbrand het.

kjv_text: But I will send a fire upon Moab, and it shall devour the palaces of Kirioth: and Moab shall die with tumult, with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet:
bsb_text: So I will send fire against Moab to consume the citadels of Kerioth. Moab will die in tumult, amid war cries and the sound of the ram’s horn.
aov_text: Daarom sal Ek ’n vuur slinger in Moab, en dit sal die paleise van Kérijot verteer; en Moab sal met oorlogsrumoer sterwe, met krygsgeskreeu en basuingeskal.

kjv_text: And I will cut off the judge from the midst thereof, and will slay all the princes thereof with him, saith the LORD.
bsb_text: I will cut off the ruler of Moab and kill all the officials with him,” says the LORD.
aov_text: En Ek sal die regeerder onder hulle uitroei en al hulle vorste saam met hom doodmaak, sê die HERE.

kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Judah, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have despised the law of the LORD, and have not kept his commandments, and their lies caused them to err, after the which their fathers have walked:
bsb_text: This is what the LORD says: “For three transgressions of Judah, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because they reject the Law of the LORD and fail to keep His statutes; they are led astray by the lies in which their fathers walked.
aov_text: So sê die HERE: Oor drie oortredinge van Juda, ja, oor vier, sal Ek dit nie afwend nie; omdat hulle die wet van die HERE verwerp het en sy insettinge nie onderhou het nie; en hulle leuengode het hulle verlei waar hulle vaders agter aan geloop het.

kjv_text: But I will send a fire upon Judah, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem.
bsb_text: So I will send fire upon Judah to consume the citadels of Jerusalem.”
aov_text: Daarom sal Ek ’n vuur slinger in Juda, en dit sal die paleise van Jerusalem verteer.

kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Israel, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they sold the righteous for silver, and the poor for a pair of shoes;
bsb_text: This is what the LORD says: “For three transgressions of Israel, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because they sell the righteous for silver and the needy for a pair of sandals.
aov_text: So sê die HERE: Oor drie oortredinge van Israel, ja, oor vier, sal Ek dit nie afwend nie; omdat hulle die regverdige vir geld verkoop het en die behoeftige vir ’n paar skoene.

kjv_text: That pant after the dust of the earth on the head of the poor, and turn aside the way of the meek: and a man and his father will go in unto the same maid, to profane my holy name:
bsb_text: They trample on the heads of the poor as on the dust of the earth; they push the needy out of their way. A man and his father have relations with the same girl and so profane My holy name.
aov_text: Hulle wat daarna hyg dat die stof van die aarde op die hoof van die armes kom, en wat die weg van die ellendiges buig; en die man en sy vader gaan na dieselfde jongedogter om my heilige Naam te ontheilig.

kjv_text: And they lay themselves down upon clothes laid to pledge by every altar, and they drink the wine of the condemned in the house of their god.
bsb_text: They lie down beside every altar on garments taken in pledge. And in the house of their God, they drink wine obtained through fines.
aov_text: En hulle strek hul uit op verpande klere by elke altaar, en die wyn van die wat beboet is, drink hulle in die huis van hul god.

kjv_text: Yet destroyed I the Amorite before them, whose height was like the height of the cedars, and he was strong as the oaks; yet I destroyed his fruit from above, and his roots from beneath.
bsb_text: Yet it was I who destroyed the Amorite before them, though his height was like that of the cedars, and he was as strong as the oaks. Yet I destroyed his fruit above and his roots below.
aov_text: En tog het Ék die Amoriet voor hulle uit verdelg wie se hoogte was soos die hoogte van die seders, en hy was sterk soos die eikebome; maar Ek het sy vrug daarbo en sy wortels daaronder verdelg.

kjv_text: Also I brought you up from the land of Egypt, and led you forty years through the wilderness, to possess the land of the Amorite.
bsb_text: And I brought you up from the land of Egypt and led you forty years in the wilderness, that you might take possession of the land of the Amorite.
aov_text: Ook het Ek julle uit Egipteland laat optrek en julle veertig jaar lank in die woestyn gelei, om die land van die Amoriet in besit te neem.

kjv_text: And I raised up of your sons for prophets, and of your young men for Nazarites. Is it not even thus, O ye children of Israel? saith the LORD.
bsb_text: I raised up prophets from your sons and Nazirites from your young men. Is this not true, O children of Israel?” declares the LORD.
aov_text: En Ek het uit julle seuns profete en uit julle jongelinge nasireërs verwek. Is dit nie so nie, o kinders van Israel? spreek die HERE.

kjv_text: But ye gave the Nazarites wine to drink; and commanded the prophets, saying, Prophesy not.
bsb_text: “But you made the Nazirites drink wine and commanded the prophets not to prophesy.
aov_text: Maar julle het die nasireërs wyn laat drink en aan die profete bevel gegee en gesê: Julle mag nie profeteer nie!

kjv_text: Behold, I am pressed under you, as a cart is pressed that is full of sheaves.
bsb_text: Behold, I am about to crush you in your place as with a cart full of grain.
aov_text: Kyk, Ek laat dit onder julle kraak, soos ’n wa kraak wat vol gerwe is;

kjv_text: Therefore the flight shall perish from the swift, and the strong shall not strengthen his force, neither shall the mighty deliver himself:
bsb_text: Escape will fail the swift, the strong will not prevail by his strength, and the mighty will not save his life.
aov_text: sodat die wat gou is, nie kan ontvlug nie, en die sterke sy krag nie kan ontwikkel en die held sy lewe nie kan red nie.

kjv_text: Neither shall he stand that handleth the bow; and he that is swift of foot shall not deliver himself: neither shall he that rideth the horse deliver himself.
bsb_text: The archer will not stand his ground, the fleet of foot will not escape, and the horseman will not save his life.
aov_text: En die boogskutter sal nie bly staan en die wat gou is op sy voete, nie vrykom nie, en die perderuiter sal sy lewe nie red nie.

kjv_text: And he that is courageous among the mighty shall flee away naked in that day, saith the LORD.
bsb_text: Even the bravest of mighty men will flee naked on that day,” declares the LORD.
aov_text: En die dapperste onder die helde sal op dié dag naak wegvlug, spreek die HERE.

kjv_text: Hear this word that the LORD hath spoken against you, O children of Israel, against the whole family which I brought up from the land of Egypt, saying,
bsb_text: Hear this word that the LORD has spoken against you, O children of Israel, against the whole family that I brought up out of the land of Egypt:
aov_text: HOOR hierdie woord wat die HERE oor julle gespreek het, o kinders van Israel, oor die hele geslag wat Ek uit Egipteland laat optrek het, naamlik:

kjv_text: You only have I known of all the families of the earth: therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities.
bsb_text: “Only you have I known from all the families of the earth; therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities.”
aov_text: Julle alleen het Ek geken uit al die geslagte van die aarde; dáárom sal Ek by julle besoeking doen oor al julle ongeregtighede.

kjv_text: Can two walk together, except they be agreed?
bsb_text: Can two walk together without agreeing where to go?
aov_text: Sal twee met mekaar wandel tensy hulle eers afgespreek het?

kjv_text: Will a lion roar in the forest, when he hath no prey? will a young lion cry out of his den, if he have taken nothing?
bsb_text: Does a lion roar in the forest when he has no prey? Does a young lion growl in his den if he has caught nothing?
aov_text: Sal ’n leeu brul in die woud as hy geen prooi het nie? Sal ’n jong leeu sy stem uit sy lêplek laat hoor as hy niks gevang het nie?

kjv_text: Can a bird fall in a snare upon the earth, where no gin is for him? shall one take up a snare from the earth, and have taken nothing at all?
bsb_text: Does a bird land in a snare where no bait has been set? Does a trap spring from the ground when it has nothing to catch?
aov_text: Sal ’n voël in ’n net val op die grond as daar vir hom geen strik gestel is nie? Sal ’n wip van die grond af opspring as dit glad nie gevang het nie?

kjv_text: Shall a trumpet be blown in the city, and the people not be afraid? shall there be evil in a city, and the LORD hath not done it?
bsb_text: If a ram’s horn sounds in a city, do the people not tremble? If calamity comes to a city, has not the LORD caused it?
aov_text: Sal die basuin in die stad geblaas word en die bevolking nie skrik nie? Sal daar ’n onheil in die stad voorval as die HERE dit nie bewerk het nie?

kjv_text: Surely the Lord GOD will do nothing, but he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets.
bsb_text: Surely the Lord GOD does nothing without revealing His plan to His servants the prophets.
aov_text: Want die Here HERE doen niks tensy Hy sy raadsbesluit aan sy knegte, die profete, geopenbaar het nie.

kjv_text: The lion hath roared, who will not fear? the Lord GOD hath spoken, who can but prophesy?
bsb_text: The lion has roared—who will not fear? The Lord GOD has spoken—who will not prophesy?
aov_text: Die leeu het gebrul, wie sal nie vrees nie? Die Here HERE het gespreek, wie sal nie profeteer nie?

kjv_text: Publish in the palaces at Ashdod, and in the palaces in the land of Egypt, and say, Assemble yourselves upon the mountains of Samaria, and behold the great tumults in the midst thereof, and the oppressed in the midst thereof.
bsb_text: Proclaim to the citadels of Ashdod and to the citadels of Egypt: “Assemble on the mountains of Samaria; see the great unrest in the city and the acts of oppression in her midst.”
aov_text: Roep dit uit oor die paleise van Asdod en oor die paleise van Egipteland en sê: Versamel julle op die berge van Samaría, en aanskou die groot beroering in die midde van die stad en die verdrukking daarbinne.

kjv_text: For they know not to do right, saith the LORD, who store up violence and robbery in their palaces.
bsb_text: “For they know not how to do right,” declares the LORD. “They store up violence and destruction in their citadels.”
aov_text: Ja, hulle weet nie om reg te doen nie, spreek die HERE—hulle wat geweld en verdrukking opstapel in hulle paleise.

kjv_text: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; An adversary there shall be even round about the land; and he shall bring down thy strength from thee, and thy palaces shall be spoiled.
bsb_text: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: “An enemy will surround the land; he will pull down your strongholds and plunder your citadels.”
aov_text: Daarom, so sê die Here HERE: ’n Vyand! En dit rondom die land; en hy sal jou vesting van jou af neerwerp, en jou paleise sal geplunder word.

kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD; As the shepherd taketh out of the mouth of the lion two legs, or a piece of an ear; so shall the children of Israel be taken out that dwell in Samaria in the corner of a bed, and in Damascus in a couch.
bsb_text: This is what the LORD says: “As the shepherd snatches from the mouth of the lion two legs or a piece of an ear, so the Israelites dwelling in Samaria will be rescued having just the corner of a bed or the cushion of a couch.
aov_text: So sê die HERE: Soos ’n herder ’n paar pote of ’n oorlappie red uit die bek van ’n leeu, net so sal gered word die kinders van Israel wat daar in Samaría in die hoek van ’n bed of op die damás van ’n rusbank sit.

kjv_text: Hear ye, and testify in the house of Jacob, saith the Lord GOD, the God of hosts,
bsb_text: Hear and testify against the house of Jacob, declares the Lord GOD, the God of Hosts.
aov_text: Hoor en waarsku die huis van Jakob, spreek die Here HERE, die God van die leërskare,

kjv_text: That in the day that I shall visit the transgressions of Israel upon him I will also visit the altars of Bethel: and the horns of the altar shall be cut off, and fall to the ground.
bsb_text: On the day I punish Israel for their transgressions, I will visit destruction on the altars of Bethel; the horns of the altar will be cut off, and they will fall to the ground.
aov_text: dat Ek in die dag as Ek die oortredinge van Israel aan hom besoek, ook besoeking sal doen oor die altare van Bet-el, sodat die horings van die altaar afgekap sal word en op die grond val.

kjv_text: And I will smite the winter house with the summer house; and the houses of ivory shall perish, and the great houses shall have an end, saith the LORD.
bsb_text: I will tear down the winter house along with the summer house; the houses of ivory will also perish, and the great houses will come to an end,” declares the LORD.
aov_text: Dan sal Ek die winterhuis saam met die somerhuis tref, en die huise van ivoor sal te gronde gaan, en baie huise sal verdwyn, spreek die HERE.

kjv_text: Hear this word, ye kine of Bashan, that are in the mountain of Samaria, which oppress the poor, which crush the needy, which say to their masters, Bring, and let us drink.
bsb_text: Hear this word, you cows of Bashan on Mount Samaria, you women who oppress the poor and crush the needy, who say to your husbands, “Bring us more to drink.”
aov_text: HOOR hierdie woord, koeie van Basan, wat op die gebergte van Samaría is! Wat die armes verdruk, die behoeftiges hard behandel; wat aan hulle here sê: Bring aan en laat ons drink!

kjv_text: The Lord GOD hath sworn by his holiness, that, lo, the days shall come upon you, that he will take you away with hooks, and your posterity with fishhooks.
bsb_text: The Lord GOD has sworn by His holiness: “Behold, the days are coming when you will be taken away with hooks, and your posterity with fishhooks.
aov_text: Die Here HERE het gesweer by sy heiligheid: Kyk, daar sal dae oor julle kom dat hulle julle met hake sal optrek en die wat van julle oor is, met vishoeke.

kjv_text: And ye shall go out at the breaches, every cow at that which is before her; and ye shall cast them into the palace, saith the LORD.
bsb_text: You will go out through broken walls, each one straight ahead of her, and you will be cast out toward Harmon,” declares the LORD.
aov_text: En julle sal deur bresse in die muur uittrek, elkeen sonder om weg te kyk, en julle sal weggewerp word na Harmon, spreek die Here HERE.

kjv_text: Come to Bethel, and transgress; at Gilgal multiply transgression; and bring your sacrifices every morning, and your tithes after three years:
bsb_text: “Go to Bethel and transgress; rebel even more at Gilgal! Bring your sacrifices every morning, your tithes every three days.
aov_text: Kom na Bet-el, en sondig! Na Gilgal, sondig nog meer! En bring julle slagoffers in die môre en julle tiendes al om die derde dag.

kjv_text: And offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving with leaven, and proclaim and publish the free offerings: for this liketh you, O ye children of Israel, saith the Lord GOD.
bsb_text: Offer leavened bread as a thank offering, and loudly proclaim your freewill offerings. For that is what you children of Israel love to do,” declares the Lord GOD.
aov_text: En laat van wat gesuurd is, ’n lofoffer rook, en roep vrywillige offers uit, laat dit hoor! Want so is dit na julle sin, kinders van Israel, spreek die Here HERE.

kjv_text: And I also have given you cleanness of teeth in all your cities, and want of bread in all your places: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.
bsb_text: “I beset all your cities with cleanness of teeth and all your towns with lack of bread, yet you did not return to Me,” declares the LORD.
aov_text: Alhoewel Ék julle reinheid van tande gegee het in al julle stede en broodsgebrek in al julle woonplekke—nogtans het julle jul tot My nie bekeer nie, spreek die HERE.

kjv_text: And also I have withholden the rain from you, when there were yet three months to the harvest: and I caused it to rain upon one city, and caused it not to rain upon another city: one piece was rained upon, and the piece whereupon it rained not withered.
bsb_text: “I also withheld the rain from you when the harvest was three months away. I sent rain on one city but withheld it from another. One field received rain; another without rain withered.
aov_text: Alhoewel Ék die reën van julle teruggehou het toe dit nog drie maande voor die oestyd was en op die een stad laat reën maar op die ander nie laat reën het nie, die een stuk land reën gekry het, maar die ander waarop geen reën geval het nie, verdor het;

kjv_text: So two or three cities wandered unto one city, to drink water; but they were not satisfied: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.
bsb_text: People staggered from city to city for water to drink, but they were not satisfied; yet you did not return to Me,” declares the LORD.
aov_text: en twee, drie stede na een stad geslinger het om water te drink sonder om die dors te les—nogtans het julle jul tot My nie bekeer nie, spreek die HERE.

kjv_text: I have smitten you with blasting and mildew: when your gardens and your vineyards and your fig trees and your olive trees increased, the palmerworm devoured them: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.
bsb_text: “I struck you with blight and mildew in your growing gardens and vineyards; the locust devoured your fig and olive trees, yet you did not return to Me,” declares the LORD.
aov_text: Ek het julle met brandkoring en met heuningdou swaar getref, baie van julle tuine en julle wingerde en julle vyebome en julle olyfbome het die sprinkaan verslind—nogtans het julle jul tot My nie bekeer nie, spreek die HERE.

kjv_text: I have sent among you the pestilence after the manner of Egypt: your young men have I slain with the sword, and have taken away your horses; and I have made the stink of your camps to come up unto your nostrils: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.
bsb_text: “I sent plagues among you like those of Egypt; I killed your young men with the sword, along with your captured horses. I filled your nostrils with the stench of your camp, yet you did not return to Me,” declares the LORD.
aov_text: Ek het die pes onder julle gestuur, op die manier van Egipte; Ek het julle jongmanne met die swaard gedood saam met die wegvoering van julle perde; en Ek het die stank van julle laer laat opstyg, ja, tot in julle neus—nogtans het julle jul tot My nie bekeer nie, spreek die HERE.

kjv_text: I have overthrown some of you, as God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and ye were as a firebrand plucked out of the burning: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.
bsb_text: “Some of you I overthrew as I overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and you were like a firebrand snatched from a blaze, yet you did not return to Me,” declares the LORD.
aov_text: Ek het julle omgekeer soos God Sodom en Gomorra omgekeer het, sodat julle soos ’n stuk brandhout was wat uit die vuur geruk is—nogtans het julle jul tot My nie bekeer nie, spreek die HERE.

kjv_text: Therefore thus will I do unto thee, O Israel: and because I will do this unto thee, prepare to meet thy God, O Israel.
bsb_text: “Therefore, that is what I will do to you, O Israel, and since I will do this to you, prepare to meet your God, O Israel!
aov_text: Daarom sal Ek só met jou handel, o Israel; omdat Ek só met jou sal handel—maak jou klaar om jou God te ontmoet, o Israel!

kjv_text: For, lo, he that formeth the mountains, and createth the wind, and declareth unto man what is his thought, that maketh the morning darkness, and treadeth upon the high places of the earth, The LORD, The God of hosts, is his name.
bsb_text: For behold, He who forms the mountains, who creates the wind and reveals His thoughts to man, who turns the dawn to darkness and strides on the heights of the earth—the LORD, the God of Hosts, is His name.”
aov_text: Want kyk, Hy wat die berge formeer en die wind skep en aan die mens sy gedagte bekend maak, wat die dageraad duisternis maak, wat op die hoogtes van die aarde wandel, HERE, God van die leërskare, is sy Naam!

kjv_text: Hear ye this word which I take up against you, even a lamentation, O house of Israel.
bsb_text: Hear this word, O house of Israel, this lamentation I take up against you:
aov_text: HOOR hierdie woord wat Ek oor julle as klaaglied aanhef, o huis van Israel!

kjv_text: The virgin of Israel is fallen; she shall no more rise: she is forsaken upon her land; there is none to raise her up.
bsb_text: “Fallen is Virgin Israel, never to rise again. She lies abandoned on her land, with no one to raise her up.”
aov_text: Die jonkvrou van Israel het geval, sy sal nie weer opstaan nie; neergewerp lê sy op haar land, niemand rig haar op nie.

kjv_text: For thus saith the Lord GOD; The city that went out by a thousand shall leave an hundred, and that which went forth by an hundred shall leave ten, to the house of Israel.
bsb_text: This is what the Lord GOD says: “The city that marches out a thousand strong will only see a hundred return, and the one that marches out a hundred strong will have but ten left in the house of Israel.”
aov_text: Want so sê die Here HERE: Die stad wat met duisend uitgetrek het, hou honderd oor; en die wat met honderd uitgetrek het, hou tien oor vir die huis van Israel.

kjv_text: For thus saith the LORD unto the house of Israel, Seek ye me, and ye shall live:
bsb_text: For this is what the LORD says to the house of Israel: “Seek Me and live!
aov_text: Want so sê die HERE aan die huis van Israel: Soek My, dan sal julle lewe!

kjv_text: But seek not Bethel, nor enter into Gilgal, and pass not to Beersheba: for Gilgal shall surely go into captivity, and Bethel shall come to nought.
bsb_text: Do not seek Bethel or go to Gilgal; do not journey to Beersheba, for Gilgal will surely go into exile, and Bethel will come to nothing.
aov_text: Maar soek Bet-el nie, en kom nie na Gilgal nie en trek nie deur na Berséba nie. Want Gilgal sal gewis in ballingskap gaan, en Bet-el sal tot niks word nie.

kjv_text: Seek the LORD, and ye shall live; lest he break out like fire in the house of Joseph, and devour it, and there be none to quench it in Bethel.
bsb_text: Seek the LORD and live, or He will sweep like fire through the house of Joseph; it will devour everything, with no one at Bethel to extinguish it.
aov_text: Soek die HERE, dan sal julle lewe, sodat Hy nie teen die huis van Josef uitbreek soos ’n vuur wat verteer sonder dat iemand dit vir Bet-el kan blus nie.

kjv_text: Ye who turn judgment to wormwood, and leave off righteousness in the earth,
bsb_text: There are those who turn justice into wormwood and cast righteousness to the ground.
aov_text: Julle wat die reg in wilde-als verander en die geregtigheid teen die grond gooi!

kjv_text: Seek him that maketh the seven stars and Orion, and turneth the shadow of death into the morning, and maketh the day dark with night: that calleth for the waters of the sea, and poureth them out upon the face of the earth: The LORD is his name:
bsb_text: He who made the Pleiades and Orion, who turns darkness into dawn and darkens day into night, who summons the waters of the sea and pours them over the face of the earth—the LORD is His name—
aov_text: Hy wat die Sewe-ster en die Oríon gemaak het en die duisternis in môrelig verander en die dag tot nag verduister, wat die waters van die see roep en dit uitgiet oor die oppervlakte van die aarde—HERE is sy Naam!

kjv_text: That strengtheneth the spoiled against the strong, so that the spoiled shall come against the fortress.
bsb_text: He flashes destruction on the strong, so that fury comes upon the stronghold.
aov_text: Hy wat verwoesting laat aanblits oor die sterke, en verwoesting kom oor die vesting!

kjv_text: They hate him that rebuketh in the gate, and they abhor him that speaketh uprightly.
bsb_text: There are those who hate the one who reproves in the gate and despise him who speaks with integrity.
aov_text: Hulle haat die man wat in die poort die reg handhaaf, en hulle het ’n afsku van hom wat in opregtheid spreek.

kjv_text: Forasmuch therefore as your treading is upon the poor, and ye take from him burdens of wheat: ye have built houses of hewn stone, but ye shall not dwell in them; ye have planted pleasant vineyards, but ye shall not drink wine of them.
bsb_text: Therefore, because you trample on the poor and exact from him a tax of grain, you will never live in the stone houses you have built; you will never drink the wine from the lush vineyards you have planted.
aov_text: Daarom, omdat julle die arm man vertrap en van hom ’n heffing van koring neem, het julle huise van gekapte klippe gebou, maar julle sal nie daarin woon nie; julle het pragtige wingerde geplant, maar julle sal die wyn daarvan nie drink nie.

kjv_text: For I know your manifold transgressions and your mighty sins: they afflict the just, they take a bribe, and they turn aside the poor in the gate from their right.
bsb_text: For I know that your transgressions are many and your sins are numerous. You oppress the righteous by taking bribes; you deprive the poor of justice in the gate.
aov_text: Want Ek weet dat julle oortreding menigvuldig en julle sondes geweldig is, julle wat die vyande is van die regverdige, wat omkoopgeld aanneem en die behoeftiges wegstoot in die poort.

kjv_text: Therefore the prudent shall keep silence in that time; for it is an evil time.
bsb_text: Therefore, the prudent keep silent in such times, for the days are evil.
aov_text: Daarom swyg die verstandige in so ’n tyd, want dit is ’n onheilspellende tyd.

kjv_text: Seek good, and not evil, that ye may live: and so the LORD, the God of hosts, shall be with you, as ye have spoken.
bsb_text: Seek good, not evil, so that you may live. And the LORD, the God of Hosts, will be with you, as you have claimed.
aov_text: Soek wat goed is, en nie wat sleg is nie, sodat julle kan lewe en die HERE, die God van die leërskare, só met julle kan wees soos julle sê.

kjv_text: Hate the evil, and love the good, and establish judgment in the gate: it may be that the LORD God of hosts will be gracious unto the remnant of Joseph.
bsb_text: Hate evil and love good; establish justice in the gate. Perhaps the LORD, the God of Hosts, will be gracious to the remnant of Joseph.”
aov_text: Julle moet haat wat sleg is en liefhê wat goed is, en handhaaf die reg in die poort—miskien sal die HERE, die God van die leërskare, Hom ontferm oor die oorblyfsel van Josef.

kjv_text: Therefore the LORD, the God of hosts, the LORD, saith thus; Wailing shall be in all streets; and they shall say in all the highways, Alas! alas! and they shall call the husbandman to mourning, and such as are skilful of lamentation to wailing.
bsb_text: Therefore this is what the LORD, the God of Hosts, the Lord, says: “There will be wailing in all the public squares and cries of ‘Alas! Alas!’ in all the streets. The farmer will be summoned to mourn, and the mourners to wail.
aov_text: Daarom, so sê die HERE, die God van die leërskare, die Here: Op al die pleine weeklag! En op al die strate sal hulle sê: Ag, ag! En hulle sal na die landbouer roep om te treur, en te weeklaag na die wat verstaan om treurliedere te sing.

kjv_text: And in all vineyards shall be wailing: for I will pass through thee, saith the LORD.
bsb_text: There will be wailing in all the vineyards, for I will pass through your midst,” says the LORD.
aov_text: Ook sal daar in al die wingerde weeklag wees wanneer Ek in jou midde deurtrek, sê die HERE.

kjv_text: Woe unto you that desire the day of the LORD! to what end is it for you? the day of the LORD is darkness, and not light.
bsb_text: Woe to you who long for the Day of the LORD! What will the Day of the LORD be for you? It will be darkness and not light.
aov_text: Wee die wat na die dag van die HERE verlang! Wat sal tog die dag van die HERE vir julle wees? Dit sal duisternis wees en geen lig nie.

kjv_text: As if a man did flee from a lion, and a bear met him; or went into the house, and leaned his hand on the wall, and a serpent bit him.
bsb_text: It will be like a man who flees from a lion, only to encounter a bear, or who enters his house and rests his hand against the wall, only to be bitten by a snake.
aov_text: Soos wanneer iemand vlug vir ’n leeu, maar ’n beer loop hom raak; of hy kom in die huis en leun met sy hand teen die muur, en ’n slang byt hom!

kjv_text: Shall not the day of the LORD be darkness, and not light? even very dark, and no brightness in it?
bsb_text: Will not the Day of the LORD be darkness and not light, even gloom with no brightness in it?
aov_text: Is die dag van die HERE nie duisternis en geen lig nie, ja, donkerheid sonder ’n ligstraal?

kjv_text: I hate, I despise your feast days, and I will not smell in your solemn assemblies.
bsb_text: “I hate, I despise your feasts! I cannot stand the stench of your solemn assemblies.
aov_text: Ek haat, Ek versmaad julle feeste en het geen welgevalle aan julle feestye nie.

kjv_text: Though ye offer me burnt offerings and your meat offerings, I will not accept them: neither will I regard the peace offerings of your fat beasts.
bsb_text: Even though you offer Me burnt offerings and grain offerings, I will not accept them; for your peace offerings of fattened cattle I will have no regard.
aov_text: Want al bring julle vir My brandoffers saam met julle spysoffers, Ek het daar geen welbehae in nie, en die dankoffer van julle vetgemaakte kalwers sien Ek nie met welgevalle aan nie.

kjv_text: Take thou away from me the noise of thy songs; for I will not hear the melody of thy viols.
bsb_text: Take away from Me the noise of your songs! I will not listen to the music of your harps.
aov_text: Verwyder van My die geraas van jou liedere! En na die geluid van jou harpe wil Ek nie luister nie.

kjv_text: But let judgment run down as waters, and righteousness as a mighty stream.
bsb_text: But let justice roll on like a river, and righteousness like an ever-flowing stream.
aov_text: Maar laat die reg aanrol soos watergolwe, en geregtigheid soos ’n standhoudende stroom.

kjv_text: Have ye offered unto me sacrifices and offerings in the wilderness forty years, O house of Israel?
bsb_text: Did you bring Me sacrifices and offerings forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?
aov_text: Het julle aan My slagoffers en spysoffers gebring veertig jaar lank in die woestyn, o huis van Israel,

kjv_text: But ye have borne the tabernacle of your Moloch and Chiun your images, the star of your god, which ye made to yourselves.
bsb_text: You have taken along Sakkuth your king and Kaiwan your star god, the idols you made for yourselves.
aov_text: en ook gedra Sakkut, julle koning, en Kewan, julle beelde, julle stergod wat julle vir julle gemaak het?

kjv_text: Therefore will I cause you to go into captivity beyond Damascus, saith the LORD, whose name is The God of hosts.
bsb_text: Therefore I will send you into exile beyond Damascus,” says the LORD, whose name is the God of Hosts.
aov_text: Daarom sal Ek julle anderkant Damaskus in ballingskap wegvoer, sê die HERE wie se Naam God van die leërskare is.

kjv_text: Woe to them that are at ease in Zion, and trust in the mountain of Samaria, which are named chief of the nations, to whom the house of Israel came!
bsb_text: Woe to those at ease in Zion and those secure on Mount Samaria, the distinguished ones of the foremost nation, to whom the house of Israel comes.
aov_text: WEE die gerustes in Sion en die sorgelose op die berg van Samaría, die vernames van die eerste onder die nasies, na wie die huis van Israel kom!

kjv_text: Pass ye unto Calneh, and see; and from thence go ye to Hamath the great: then go down to Gath of the Philistines: be they better than these kingdoms? or their border greater than your border?
bsb_text: Cross over to Calneh and see; go from there to the great Hamath; then go down to Gath of the Philistines. Are you better than these kingdoms? Is their territory larger than yours?
aov_text: Trek deur na Kalne en kyk, gaan van daar na Hamat, die groot stad, en trek af na Gat van die Filistyne! Is hulle beter as hierdie koninkryke? Of is hulle grondgebied groter as julle grondgebied? —

kjv_text: Ye that put far away the evil day, and cause the seat of violence to come near;
bsb_text: You dismiss the day of calamity and bring near a reign of violence.
aov_text: julle wat die dag van onheil veraf stel en die setel van geweld nader skuiwe!

kjv_text: That lie upon beds of ivory, and stretch themselves upon their couches, and eat the lambs out of the flock, and the calves out of the midst of the stall;
bsb_text: You lie on beds inlaid with ivory, and lounge upon your couches. You dine on lambs from the flock and calves from the stall.
aov_text: Wat op bedde van ivoor lê en uitgestrek lê op hulle rusbanke en die lammers van die kleinvee en die kalwers uit die stal eet!

kjv_text: That chant to the sound of the viol, and invent to themselves instruments of musick, like David;
bsb_text: You improvise songs on the harp like David and invent your own musical instruments.
aov_text: Wat liedjies sing met begeleiding van die harp, wat net soos Dawid vir hulle musiekinstrumente uitdink!

kjv_text: That drink wine in bowls, and anoint themselves with the chief ointments: but they are not grieved for the affliction of Joseph.
bsb_text: You drink wine by the bowlful and anoint yourselves with the finest oils, but you fail to grieve over the ruin of Joseph.
aov_text: Wat uit offerkomme wyn drink en hulle met die beste soorte olie salf, maar hulle nie oor die verbreking van Josef bekommer nie.

kjv_text: Therefore now shall they go captive with the first that go captive, and the banquet of them that stretched themselves shall be removed.
bsb_text: Therefore, you will now go into exile as the first of the captives, and your feasting and lounging will come to an end.
aov_text: Daarom sal hulle nou op die voorpunt van die ballinge in ballingskap gaan, en daar sal ’n end kom aan die rumoerige gejubel van die leeglêers.

kjv_text: The Lord GOD hath sworn by himself, saith the LORD the God of hosts, I abhor the excellency of Jacob, and hate his palaces: therefore will I deliver up the city with all that is therein.
bsb_text: The Lord GOD has sworn by Himself—the LORD, the God of Hosts, has declared: “I abhor Jacob’s pride and detest his citadels, so I will deliver up the city and everything in it.”
aov_text: Die Here HERE het by Homself gesweer, spreek die HERE, die God van die leërskare: Ek het ’n afsku van die trotsheid van Jakob en haat sy paleise; daarom lewer Ek die stad oor en al wat daarin is.

kjv_text: And it shall come to pass, if there remain ten men in one house, that they shall die.
bsb_text: And if there are ten men left in one house, they too will die.
aov_text: En as daar tien man in een huis oorgebly het, sal hulle sterwe.

kjv_text: And a man's uncle shall take him up, and he that burneth him, to bring out the bones out of the house, and shall say unto him that is by the sides of the house, Is there yet any with thee? and he shall say, No. Then shall he say, Hold thy tongue: for we may not make mention of the name of the LORD.
bsb_text: And when the relative who is to burn the bodies picks them up to remove them from the house, he will call to one inside, “Is anyone else with you?” “None,” that person will answer. “Silence,” the relative will retort, “for the name of the LORD must not be invoked.”
aov_text: En wanneer iemand se bloedverwant, die een wat hom wil verbrand, hom optel om die bene uit die huis te verwyder, en aan iemand wat in die agterste vertrekke is, sê: Is daar nog iemand by jou? en hy antwoord: Nee—dan sal die eerste sê: Bly stil, want dit is nie gepas om die Naam van die HERE te vermeld nie!

kjv_text: For, behold, the LORD commandeth, and he will smite the great house with breaches, and the little house with clefts.
bsb_text: For the LORD gives a command: “The great house will be smashed to pieces, and the small house to rubble.”
aov_text: Want kyk, die HERE gee bevel, en hulle slaan die groot huis tot ’n puinhoop en die klein huis tot splinters.

kjv_text: Shall horses run upon the rock? will one plow there with oxen? for ye have turned judgment into gall, and the fruit of righteousness into hemlock:
bsb_text: “Do horses gallop on the cliffs? Does one plow the sea with oxen? But you have turned justice into poison and the fruit of righteousness into wormwood—
aov_text: Kan perde draf op rotse, of kan ’n mens met osse daarop ploeë?—dat julle die reg in gif verander en die vrug van geregtigheid in wilde-als.

kjv_text: Ye which rejoice in a thing of nought, which say, Have we not taken to us horns by our own strength?
bsb_text: you who rejoice in Lo-debar and say, ‘Did we not take Karnaim by our own strength?’
aov_text: Julle wat bly is oor ’n nietige ding, wat sê: Het ons nie deur ons eie krag horings gekry nie?

kjv_text: But, behold, I will raise up against you a nation, O house of Israel, saith the LORD the God of hosts; and they shall afflict you from the entering in of Hemath unto the river of the wilderness.
bsb_text: For behold, I will raise up a nation against you, O house of Israel,” declares the LORD, the God of Hosts, “and they will oppress you from Lebo-hamath to the Brook of the Arabah.”
aov_text: Want kyk, Ek gaan teen julle, o huis van Israel, ’n volk opwek, spreek die HERE, die God van die leërskare, en hulle sal julle verdruk van die ingang na Hamat af tot by die spruit van die Vlakte.

kjv_text: Thus hath the Lord GOD shewed unto me; and, behold, he formed grasshoppers in the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth; and, lo, it was the latter growth after the king's mowings.
bsb_text: This is what the Lord GOD showed me: He was preparing swarms of locusts just after the king’s harvest, as the late spring crop was coming up.
aov_text: DIT het die Here HERE my laat sien—kyk, Hy het sprinkane geformeer toe die na-gras begin uitspruit het; en kyk, dit was die na-gras nadat die snysels van die koning af was.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, that when they had made an end of eating the grass of the land, then I said, O Lord GOD, forgive, I beseech thee: by whom shall Jacob arise? for he is small.
bsb_text: And when the locusts had eaten every green plant in the land, I said, “Lord GOD, please forgive! How will Jacob survive, since he is so small?”
aov_text: En toe hulle al die gewasse van die land afgeëet het, sê ek: Here HERE, vergeef tog! Hoe sal Jakob staande bly? want hy is klein.

kjv_text: The LORD repented for this: It shall not be, saith the LORD.
bsb_text: So the LORD relented from this plan. “It will not happen,” He said.
aov_text: Toe het die HERE berou gekry oor hierdie saak. Dit sal nie gebeur nie, het die HERE gesê.

kjv_text: Thus hath the Lord GOD shewed unto me: and, behold, the Lord GOD called to contend by fire, and it devoured the great deep, and did eat up a part.
bsb_text: This is what the Lord GOD showed me: The Lord GOD was calling for judgment by fire. It consumed the great deep and devoured the land.
aov_text: Dit het die Here HERE my laat sien—kyk, die Here HERE roep om ’n regstryd te voer deur vuur, en dit het die groot watervloed verteer en sou die akkerland verteer het.

kjv_text: Then said I, O Lord GOD, cease, I beseech thee: by whom shall Jacob arise? for he is small.
bsb_text: Then I said, “Lord GOD, please stop! How will Jacob survive, since he is so small?”
aov_text: Toe sê ek: Here HERE, hou tog op! Hoe sal Jakob staande bly? want hy is klein.

kjv_text: The LORD repented for this: This also shall not be, saith the Lord GOD.
bsb_text: So the LORD relented from this plan. “It will not happen either,” said the Lord GOD.
aov_text: Die HERE het berou gekry oor hierdie saak. Dit sal ook nie gebeur nie, het die Here HERE gesê.

kjv_text: Thus he shewed me: and, behold, the LORD stood upon a wall made by a plumbline, with a plumbline in his hand.
bsb_text: This is what He showed me: Behold, the Lord was standing by a wall true to plumb, with a plumb line in His hand.
aov_text: Dit het Hy my laat sien—kyk, die Here het op ’n loodregte muur gestaan, en daar was ’n skietlood in sy hand.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto me, Amos, what seest thou? And I said, A plumbline. Then said the LORD, Behold, I will set a plumbline in the midst of my people Israel: I will not again pass by them any more:
bsb_text: “Amos, what do you see?” asked the LORD. “A plumb line,” I replied. “Behold,” said the Lord, “I am setting a plumb line among My people Israel; I will no longer spare them:
aov_text: Toe sê die HERE vir my: Wat sien jy, Amos? En ek het geantwoord: ’n Skietlood. Daarop sê die Here: Kyk, Ek gaan ’n skietlood aanlê in die midde van my volk Israel. Ek sal hom verder nie meer verbygaan nie.

kjv_text: And the high places of Isaac shall be desolate, and the sanctuaries of Israel shall be laid waste; and I will rise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword.
bsb_text: The high places of Isaac will be deserted, and the sanctuaries of Israel will be laid waste; and I will rise up against the house of Jeroboam with My sword.”
aov_text: En die hoogtes van Isak sal verwoes word, en die heiligdomme van Israel sal puinhope wees, en teen die huis van Jeróbeam sal Ek met die swaard optree.

kjv_text: Then Amaziah the priest of Bethel sent to Jeroboam king of Israel, saying, Amos hath conspired against thee in the midst of the house of Israel: the land is not able to bear all his words.
bsb_text: Then Amaziah the priest of Bethel sent word to Jeroboam king of Israel, saying, “Amos has conspired against you in the midst of the house of Israel. The land cannot bear all his words,
aov_text: TOE het Amásia, die priester van Bet-el, Jeróbeam, koning van Israel, laat weet: Amos het ’n sameswering gesmee teen u midde-in die huis van Israel; die land sal dit onder al sy woorde nie kan uithou nie.

kjv_text: For thus Amos saith, Jeroboam shall die by the sword, and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of their own land.
bsb_text: for this is what Amos has said: ‘Jeroboam will die by the sword, and Israel will surely go into exile, away from their homeland.’”
aov_text: Want so het Amos gesê: Jeróbeam sal deur die swaard sterwe, en Israel sal sekerlik uit sy land in ballingskap gaan.

kjv_text: Also Amaziah said unto Amos, O thou seer, go, flee thee away into the land of Judah, and there eat bread, and prophesy there:
bsb_text: And Amaziah said to Amos, “Go away, you seer! Flee to the land of Judah; earn your bread there and do your prophesying there.
aov_text: Toe sê Amásia vir Amos: Gaan weg, siener, vlug na die land Juda en eet daar brood en profeteer daar!

kjv_text: But prophesy not again any more at Bethel: for it is the king's chapel, and it is the king's court.
bsb_text: But never prophesy at Bethel again, because it is the sanctuary of the king and the temple of the kingdom.”
aov_text: Maar in Bet-el mag jy verder nie meer profeteer nie, want dit is ’n koninklike heiligdom en ’n tempel van die ryk.

kjv_text: Then answered Amos, and said to Amaziah, I was no prophet, neither was I a prophet's son; but I was an herdman, and a gatherer of sycomore fruit:
bsb_text: “I was not a prophet,” Amos replied, “nor was I the son of a prophet; rather, I was a herdsman and a tender of sycamore-fig trees.
aov_text: Toe het Amos geantwoord en aan Amásia gesê: Ek was geen profeet en ook geen profete-seun nie; maar ek was ’n veewagter en kweker van wildevyebome.

kjv_text: And the LORD took me as I followed the flock, and the LORD said unto me, Go, prophesy unto my people Israel.
bsb_text: But the LORD took me from following the flock and said to me, ‘Go, prophesy to My people Israel.’
aov_text: Maar die HERE het my agter die kleinvee weggeneem, en die HERE het aan my gesê: Gaan heen, profeteer teen my volk Israel.

kjv_text: Now therefore hear thou the word of the LORD: Thou sayest, Prophesy not against Israel, and drop not thy word against the house of Isaac.
