kjv_text: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the LORD, that I will cut off thy horses out of the midst of thee, and I will destroy thy chariots:
bsb_text: “In that day,” declares the LORD, “I will remove your horses from among you and wreck your chariots.
aov_text: En in dié dag, spreek die HERE, sal Ek jou perde uit jou midde uitroei en jou strydwaens vernietig.

kjv_text: And I will cut off the cities of thy land, and throw down all thy strong holds:
bsb_text: I will remove the cities of your land and tear down all your strongholds.
aov_text: Ook sal Ek uitroei die stede van jou land en al jou vestings afbreek.

kjv_text: And I will cut off witchcrafts out of thine hand; and thou shalt have no more soothsayers:
bsb_text: I will cut the sorceries from your hand, and you will have no fortune-tellers.
aov_text: Verder sal Ek uitroei die towerye uit jou hand, en jy sal geen goëlaars meer hê nie.

kjv_text: Thy graven images also will I cut off, and thy standing images out of the midst of thee; and thou shalt no more worship the work of thine hands.
bsb_text: I will also cut off the carved images and sacred pillars from among you, so that you will no longer bow down to the work of your own hands.
aov_text: En Ek sal uit jou midde uitroei jou gesnede beelde en jou klippilare, sodat jy jou nie meer voor die werk van jou hande sal neerbuig nie.

kjv_text: And I will pluck up thy groves out of the midst of thee: so will I destroy thy cities.
bsb_text: I will root out the Asherah poles from your midst and demolish your cities.
aov_text: En Ek sal uit jou midde uitruk jou heilige boomstamme en jou stede verwoes.

kjv_text: And I will execute vengeance in anger and fury upon the heathen, such as they have not heard.
bsb_text: I will take vengeance in anger and wrath upon the nations that have not obeyed Me.”
aov_text: En Ek sal in toorn en grimmigheid wraak neem op die nasies wat nie geluister het nie.

kjv_text: Hear ye now what the LORD saith; Arise, contend thou before the mountains, and let the hills hear thy voice.
bsb_text: Hear now what the LORD says: “Arise, plead your case before the mountains, and let the hills hear your voice.
aov_text: HOOR tog wat die HERE sê: Staan op, twis in teenwoordigheid van die berge, en laat die heuwels na jou stem luister!

kjv_text: Hear ye, O mountains, the LORD's controversy, and ye strong foundations of the earth: for the LORD hath a controversy with his people, and he will plead with Israel.
bsb_text: Hear, O mountains, the LORD’s indictment, you enduring foundations of the earth. For the LORD has a case against His people, and He will argue it against Israel:
aov_text: Hoor, berge, die twis van die HERE! En onwankelbares, grondslae van die aarde! Want die HERE het ’n twis met sy volk en sal met Israel ’n regsgeding hou.

kjv_text: O my people, what have I done unto thee? and wherein have I wearied thee? testify against me.
bsb_text: ‘My people, what have I done to you? Testify against Me how I have wearied you!
aov_text: My volk, wat het Ek jou aangedoen, en waarmee het Ek jou vermoei? Antwoord My!

kjv_text: For I brought thee up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed thee out of the house of servants; and I sent before thee Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.
bsb_text: For I brought you up from the land of Egypt and redeemed you from the house of slavery. I sent Moses before you, as well as Aaron and Miriam.
aov_text: Ja, Ek het jou uit Egipteland laat optrek en jou uit die slawehuis losgekoop, en Ek het voor jou uit gestuur Moses, Aäron en Mirjam.

kjv_text: O my people, remember now what Balak king of Moab consulted, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim unto Gilgal; that ye may know the righteousness of the LORD.
bsb_text: My people, remember what Balak king of Moab counseled and what Balaam son of Beor answered. Remember your journey from Shittim to Gilgal, so that you may acknowledge the righteousness of the LORD.’”
aov_text: My volk, dink tog aan wat Balak, die koning van Moab, beraadslaag het, en wat Bíleam, die seun van Beor, hom geantwoord het, en wat gebeur het van Sittim af tot by Gilgal, sodat jy kennis kan dra van die regverdige dade van die HERE.

kjv_text: Wherewith shall I come before the LORD, and bow myself before the high God? shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves of a year old?
bsb_text: With what shall I come before the LORD when I bow before the God on high? Should I come to Him with burnt offerings, with year-old calves?
aov_text: Waarmee sal ek die HERE tegemoetgaan en my buig voor die hoë God? Sal ek Hom tegemoetgaan met brandoffers, met jaaroud kalwers?

kjv_text: Will the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams, or with ten thousands of rivers of oil? shall I give my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?
bsb_text: Would the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams, with ten thousand rivers of oil? Shall I present my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?
aov_text: Sal die HERE ’n welbehae hê in duisende ramme en tienduisende strome van olie? Sal ek my eersgeborene gee vir my oortreding, die vrug van my liggaam vir die sonde van my siel?

kjv_text: He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth the LORD require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?
bsb_text: He has shown you, O man, what is good. And what does the LORD require of you but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?
aov_text: Hy het jou bekend gemaak, o mens, wat goed is; en wat vra die HERE van jou anders as om reg te doen en liefde te betrag en ootmoedig te wandel met jou God?

kjv_text: The LORD's voice crieth unto the city, and the man of wisdom shall see thy name: hear ye the rod, and who hath appointed it.
bsb_text: The voice of the LORD calls out to the city (and it is sound wisdom to fear Your name): “Heed the rod and the One who ordained it.
aov_text: Die stem van die HERE roep tot die stad—dit is heilsaam om u Naam te vrees ö: Hoor die roede, en wie dit bestel het.

kjv_text: Are there yet the treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and the scant measure that is abominable?
bsb_text: Can I forget any longer, O house of the wicked, the treasures of wickedness and the short ephah, which is accursed?
aov_text: Is daar nog altyd in die huis van die goddelose skatte van onreg en ’n skrale efa wat vervloek is?

kjv_text: Shall I count them pure with the wicked balances, and with the bag of deceitful weights?
bsb_text: Can I excuse dishonest scales or bags of false weights?
aov_text: Sal Ek rein kan wees by ’n valse weegskaal en by ’n sak vol bedrieglike gewigte?

kjv_text: For the rich men thereof are full of violence, and the inhabitants thereof have spoken lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their mouth.
bsb_text: For the wealthy of the city are full of violence, and its residents speak lies; their tongues are deceitful in their mouths.
aov_text: Want die rykes in die stad is vol geweld, en die inwoners daarvan spreek leuentaal, en hulle tong is bedrog in hulle mond.

kjv_text: Therefore also will I make thee sick in smiting thee, in making thee desolate because of thy sins.
bsb_text: Therefore I am striking you severely, to ruin you because of your sins.
aov_text: So slaan Ek jou dan ook met ’n smartlike wond, met verwoesting weens jou sondes.

kjv_text: Thou shalt eat, but not be satisfied; and thy casting down shall be in the midst of thee; and thou shalt take hold, but shalt not deliver; and that which thou deliverest will I give up to the sword.
bsb_text: You will eat but not be satisfied, and your hunger will remain with you. What you acquire, you will not preserve; and what you save, I will give to the sword.
aov_text: Jy sal eet, maar nie versadig word nie, sodat jou honger in jou binneste bly; en jy sal wegbring sonder om iets te red; en wat jy red, sal Ek aan die swaard oorgee.

kjv_text: Thou shalt sow, but thou shalt not reap; thou shalt tread the olives, but thou shalt not anoint thee with oil; and sweet wine, but shalt not drink wine.
bsb_text: You will sow but not reap; you will press olives but not anoint yourselves with oil; you will tread grapes but not drink the wine.
aov_text: Jy sal saai, maar nie maai nie; jy sal olywe uittrap, maar jou nie met olie salf nie, en mos maak, maar geen wyn drink nie.

kjv_text: For the statutes of Omri are kept, and all the works of the house of Ahab, and ye walk in their counsels; that I should make thee a desolation, and the inhabitants thereof an hissing: therefore ye shall bear the reproach of my people.
bsb_text: You have kept the statutes of Omri and all the practices of Ahab’s house; you have followed their counsel. Therefore I will make you a desolation, and your inhabitants an object of contempt; you will bear the scorn of the nations.”
aov_text: Want die insettinge van Omri word onderhou en al die werke van die huis van Agab; en julle wandel ooreenkomstig hulle planne, sodat Ek jou tot ’n woesteny sou maak en die inwoners daarvan ’n bespotting: en die smaad van my volk sal julle dra.

kjv_text: Woe is me! for I am as when they have gathered the summer fruits, as the grapegleanings of the vintage: there is no cluster to eat: my soul desired the firstripe fruit.
bsb_text: Woe is me! For I am like one gathering summer fruit at the gleaning of the vineyard; there is no cluster to eat, no early fig that I crave.
aov_text: WEE my, want ek het geword soos ná die insameling van somervrugte, soos die natrossies van die wynoes: geen tros om te eet nie, my siel begeer vroeë vye.

kjv_text: The good man is perished out of the earth: and there is none upright among men: they all lie in wait for blood; they hunt every man his brother with a net.
bsb_text: The godly man has perished from the earth; there is no one upright among men. They all lie in wait for blood; they hunt one another with a net.
aov_text: Die vrome het verdwyn uit die land, en daar is geen opregte meer onder die mense nie; hulle loer almal op bloed; hulle jaag elkeen sy broer met die net.

kjv_text: That they may do evil with both hands earnestly, the prince asketh, and the judge asketh for a reward; and the great man, he uttereth his mischievous desire: so they wrap it up.
bsb_text: Both hands are skilled at evil; the prince and the judge demand a bribe. When the powerful utters his evil desire, they all conspire together.
aov_text: Na die kwaad gaan die hande uit, om dit dapper te doen. Die vors eis, en die regter vra betaling, en die groot man spreek die begeerte van sy siel uit, en hulle verdraai dit alles.

kjv_text: The best of them is as a brier: the most upright is sharper than a thorn hedge: the day of thy watchmen and thy visitation cometh; now shall be their perplexity.
bsb_text: The best of them is like a brier; the most upright is sharper than a hedge of thorns. The day for your watchmen has come, the day of your visitation. Now is the time of their confusion.
aov_text: Die beste van hulle is soos ’n doringstruik, die mees opregte erger as ’n doringheining. Die dag van jou wagte, jou besoeking, kom; nou sal hulle verwarring daar wees.

kjv_text: Trust ye not in a friend, put ye not confidence in a guide: keep the doors of thy mouth from her that lieth in thy bosom.
bsb_text: Do not rely on a friend; do not trust in a companion. Seal the doors of your mouth from her who lies in your arms.
aov_text: Vertrou geen metgesel nie, maak op geen vriend staat nie, let op die poorte van jou mond teenoor haar wat in jou skoot lê.

kjv_text: For the son dishonoureth the father, the daughter riseth up against her mother, the daughter in law against her mother in law; a man's enemies are the men of his own house.
bsb_text: For a son dishonors his father, a daughter rises against her mother, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law. A man’s enemies are the members of his own household.
aov_text: Want die seun minag die vader, die dogter staan op teen haar moeder, die skoondogter teen haar skoonmoeder, die man se vyande is sy huisgenote!

kjv_text: Therefore I will look unto the LORD; I will wait for the God of my salvation: my God will hear me.
bsb_text: But as for me, I will look to the LORD; I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.
aov_text: Maar ek sal uitsien na die HERE, ek wil wag op die God van my heil, my God sal my hoor.

kjv_text: Rejoice not against me, O mine enemy: when I fall, I shall arise; when I sit in darkness, the LORD shall be a light unto me.
bsb_text: Do not gloat over me, my enemy! Though I have fallen, I will arise; though I sit in darkness, the LORD will be my light.
aov_text: Wees nie bly oor my nie, o my vyandin! Al het ek geval, ek staan weer op; al sit ek in duisternis, die HERE is ’n lig vir my.

kjv_text: I will bear the indignation of the LORD, because I have sinned against him, until he plead my cause, and execute judgment for me: he will bring me forth to the light, and I shall behold his righteousness.
bsb_text: Because I have sinned against Him, I must endure the rage of the LORD, until He argues my case and executes justice for me. He will bring me into the light; I will see His righteousness.
aov_text: Die toorn van die HERE sal ek dra, want ek het teen Hom gesondig; totdat Hy my saak verdedig en my reg verskaf. Hy sal my uitlei in die lig; ek sal met welgevalle sien hoe Hy geregtigheid oefen.

kjv_text: Then she that is mine enemy shall see it, and shame shall cover her which said unto me, Where is the LORD thy God? mine eyes shall behold her: now shall she be trodden down as the mire of the streets.
bsb_text: Then my enemy will see and will be covered with shame—she who said to me, “Where is the LORD your God?” My eyes will see her; at that time she will be trampled like mud in the streets.
aov_text: Ook sal my vyandin dit sien, en skaamte sal haar bedek wat vir my sê: Waar is die HERE, jou God? My oë sal met welgevalle op haar neersien. Nou sal sy vertrap word soos modder van die strate.

kjv_text: In the day that thy walls are to be built, in that day shall the decree be far removed.
bsb_text: The day for rebuilding your walls will come—the day for extending your boundary.
aov_text: Daar kom ’n dag om jou mure te herbou! In dié dag sal die gebied ruim wees.

kjv_text: In that day also he shall come even to thee from Assyria, and from the fortified cities, and from the fortress even to the river, and from sea to sea, and from mountain to mountain.
bsb_text: On that day they will come to you from Assyria and the cities of Egypt, even from Egypt to the Euphrates, from sea to sea and mountain to mountain.
aov_text: Dit is ’n dag dat hulle na jou sal kom van Assur en die stede van Egipte, en van Egipte tot by die Eufraat, en van see tot see, en van berg tot berg.

kjv_text: Notwithstanding the land shall be desolate because of them that dwell therein, for the fruit of their doings.
bsb_text: Then the earth will become desolate because of its inhabitants, as the fruit of their deeds.
aov_text: Maar die aarde sal ’n wildernis word vanweë sy inwoners, as gevolg van hulle handelinge.

kjv_text: Feed thy people with thy rod, the flock of thine heritage, which dwell solitarily in the wood, in the midst of Carmel: let them feed in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.
bsb_text: Shepherd with Your staff Your people, the flock of Your inheritance. They live alone in a woodland, surrounded by pastures. Let them graze in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.
aov_text: Wei u volk met u staf, die kudde wat u erfdeel is, wat afgesonderd woon in ’n bosveld op Karmel; laat hulle wei in Basan en Gílead soos in die ou dae.

kjv_text: According to the days of thy coming out of the land of Egypt will I shew unto him marvellous things.
bsb_text: As in the days when you came out of Egypt, I will show My wonders.
aov_text: Soos in die dae van jou uittog uit Egipteland sal Ek hom wonders laat sien.

kjv_text: The nations shall see and be confounded at all their might: they shall lay their hand upon their mouth, their ears shall be deaf.
bsb_text: Nations will see and be ashamed, deprived of all their might. They will put their hands over their mouths, and their ears will become deaf.
aov_text: Die nasies sal dit sien en skaam wees ondanks al hulle krag: hulle sal die hand op die mond lê, hulle ore sal doof word.

kjv_text: They shall lick the dust like a serpent, they shall move out of their holes like worms of the earth: they shall be afraid of the LORD our God, and shall fear because of thee.
bsb_text: They will lick the dust like a snake, like reptiles slithering on the ground. They will crawl from their holes in the presence of the LORD our God; they will tremble in fear of You.
aov_text: Hulle sal stof lek soos die slang, hulle sal soos grondkruipers bewende uit hulle vestings te voorskyn kom, hulle sal sidderende kom na die HERE onse God, en hulle sal vir U vrees.

kjv_text: Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity, and passeth by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage? he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth in mercy.
bsb_text: Who is a God like You, who pardons iniquity and passes over the transgression of the remnant of His inheritance—who does not retain His anger forever, because He delights in loving devotion?
aov_text: Wie is ’n God soos U, wat die ongeregtigheid vergewe en by die oortreding van die oorblyfsel van sy erfdeel verbygaan? Hy hou toorn nie vir ewig vas nie, maar het ’n welbehae in goedertierenheid.

kjv_text: He will turn again, he will have compassion upon us; he will subdue our iniquities; and thou wilt cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.
bsb_text: He will again have compassion on us; He will vanquish our iniquities. You will cast out all our sins into the depths of the sea.
aov_text: Hy sal Hom weer oor ons ontferm, ons ongeregtighede vertree; ja, U sal al hulle sondes in die dieptes van die see werp.

kjv_text: Thou wilt perform the truth to Jacob, and the mercy to Abraham, which thou hast sworn unto our fathers from the days of old.
bsb_text: You will show faithfulness to Jacob and loving devotion to Abraham, as You swore to our fathers from the days of old.
aov_text: U sal trou bewys aan Jakob, goedertierenheid aan Abraham, wat U aan ons vaders met ’n eed beloof het sedert die dae van die voortyd.

kjv_text: The burden of Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.
bsb_text: This is the burden against Nineveh, the book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite:
aov_text: GODSPRAAK oor Ninevé. Die boek van die gesig van Nahum, die Élkosiet.

kjv_text: God is jealous, and the LORD revengeth; the LORD revengeth, and is furious; the LORD will take vengeance on his adversaries, and he reserveth wrath for his enemies.
bsb_text: The LORD is a jealous and avenging God; the LORD is avenging and full of wrath. The LORD takes vengeance on His foes and reserves wrath for His enemies.
aov_text: ’n Jaloerse God en ’n wreker is die HERE, ’n wreker is die HERE, en vol grimmigheid; ’n wreker is die HERE vir sy teëstanders, en Hy behou die toorn teen sy vyande.

kjv_text: The LORD is slow to anger, and great in power, and will not at all acquit the wicked: the LORD hath his way in the whirlwind and in the storm, and the clouds are the dust of his feet.
bsb_text: The LORD is slow to anger and great in power; the LORD will by no means leave the guilty unpunished. His path is in the whirlwind and storm, and clouds are the dust beneath His feet.
aov_text: Die HERE is lankmoedig, maar groot van krag; en nooit laat die HERE ongestraf bly nie. Sy weg is in warrelwind en in storm, en wolke is die stof van sy voete.

kjv_text: He rebuketh the sea, and maketh it dry, and drieth up all the rivers: Bashan languisheth, and Carmel, and the flower of Lebanon languisheth.
bsb_text: He rebukes the sea and dries it up; He makes all the rivers run dry. Bashan and Carmel wither, and the flower of Lebanon wilts.
aov_text: Hy dreig die see en maak dit droog en laat al die riviere opdroog; Basan en Karmel kwyn weg, en die groenigheid van die Líbanon verwelk.

kjv_text: The mountains quake at him, and the hills melt, and the earth is burned at his presence, yea, the world, and all that dwell therein.
bsb_text: The mountains quake before Him, and the hills melt away; the earth trembles at His presence—the world and all its dwellers.
aov_text: Die berge bewe voor Hom, en die heuwels smelt weg; en die aarde rys op voor sy aangesig, ja, die wêreld en almal wat daarin woon.

kjv_text: Who can stand before his indignation? and who can abide in the fierceness of his anger? his fury is poured out like fire, and the rocks are thrown down by him.
bsb_text: Who can withstand His indignation? Who can endure His burning anger? His wrath is poured out like fire; even rocks are shattered before Him.
aov_text: Wie sal standhou voor sy grimmigheid? En wie sal bestand wees teen die gloed van sy toorn? Sy gramskap word uitgegiet soos vuur, en die rotse word stukkend geruk voor Hom.

kjv_text: The LORD is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.
bsb_text: The LORD is good, a stronghold in the day of distress; He cares for those who trust in Him.
aov_text: Die HERE is goed, ’n toevlug in die dag van benoudheid, en Hy ken die wat by Hom skuil.

kjv_text: But with an overrunning flood he will make an utter end of the place thereof, and darkness shall pursue his enemies.
bsb_text: But with an overwhelming flood He will make an end of Nineveh and pursue His enemies into darkness.
aov_text: Maar met ’n oorstromende vloed maak Hy ’n einde aan die plek van die stad, en sy vyande vervolg Hy die duisternis in.

kjv_text: What do ye imagine against the LORD? he will make an utter end: affliction shall not rise up the second time.
bsb_text: Whatever you plot against the LORD, He will bring to an end. Affliction will not rise up a second time.
aov_text: Wat wil julle beraam teen die HERE? Hy maak daar ’n einde aan; die benoudheid sal nie twee maal opkom nie.

kjv_text: For while they be folden together as thorns, and while they are drunken as drunkards, they shall be devoured as stubble fully dry.
bsb_text: For they will be entangled as with thorns and consumed like the drink of a drunkard—like stubble that is fully dry.
aov_text: Want al is hulle saamgevleg soos dorings, en soos hulle drank so deur en deur nat—hulle sal soos droë stoppels volkome verteer word.

kjv_text: There is one come out of thee, that imagineth evil against the LORD, a wicked counsellor.
bsb_text: From you, O Nineveh, comes forth a plotter of evil against the LORD, a counselor of wickedness.
aov_text: Van jou, o stad, het een uitgegaan wat kwaad teen die HERE beraam het, wat verderflike planne gemaak het.

kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD; Though they be quiet, and likewise many, yet thus shall they be cut down, when he shall pass through. Though I have afflicted thee, I will afflict thee no more.
bsb_text: This is what the LORD says: “Though they are allied and numerous, yet they will be cut down and pass away. Though I have afflicted you, O Judah, I will afflict you no longer.
aov_text: So sê die HERE: Al is hulle ook in volle krag en só groot in getal, tog sal hulle net só afgemaai word en vergaan. (Ek het jou verneder, Ek sal jou nie meer verneder nie;

kjv_text: For now will I break his yoke from off thee, and will burst thy bonds in sunder.
bsb_text: For I will now break their yoke from your neck and tear away your shackles.”
aov_text: maar nou sal Ek sy juk van jou af verbreek en jou stroppe stukkend ruk.)

kjv_text: And the LORD hath given a commandment concerning thee, that no more of thy name be sown: out of the house of thy gods will I cut off the graven image and the molten image: I will make thy grave; for thou art vile.
bsb_text: The LORD has issued a command concerning you, O Nineveh: “There will be no descendants to carry on your name. I will cut off the carved image and cast idol from the house of your gods; I will prepare your grave, for you are contemptible.”
aov_text: Maar die HERE sal dit oor jóu verorden: Van jou naam sal daar nie meer gesaai word nie; Ek sal uit die huis van jou god uitroei die gesnede en die gegote beelde; Ek sal vir jou ’n graf maak, want jy is te lig bevind.

kjv_text: Behold upon the mountains the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace! O Judah, keep thy solemn feasts, perform thy vows: for the wicked shall no more pass through thee; he is utterly cut off.
bsb_text: Look to the mountains—the feet of one who brings good news, who proclaims peace! Celebrate your feasts, O Judah; fulfill your vows. For the wicked will never again march through you; they will be utterly cut off.
aov_text: Kyk, op die berge die voete van hom wat die goeie boodskap bring, wat vrede laat hoor: Vier jou feesdae, o Juda, betaal jou geloftes! Want die snoodaard sal nooit weer deur jou gebied trek nie; hy is heeltemal uitgeroei!

kjv_text: He that dasheth in pieces is come up before thy face: keep the munition, watch the way, make thy loins strong, fortify thy power mightily.
bsb_text: One who scatters advances against you, O Nineveh. Guard the fortress! Watch the road! Brace yourselves! Summon all your strength!
aov_text: ’N VERWOESTER trek teen jou op; bewaak die vesting, kyk uit langs die weg, versterk die lendene, versterk jou met alle mag!

kjv_text: For the LORD hath turned away the excellency of Jacob, as the excellency of Israel: for the emptiers have emptied them out, and marred their vine branches.
bsb_text: For the LORD will restore the splendor of Jacob like the splendor of Israel, though destroyers have laid them waste and ruined the branches of their vine.
aov_text: Want die HERE herstel die heerlikheid van Jakob net soos die heerlikheid van Israel; want plunderaars het hulle geplunder en hulle wingerdlote verniel.

kjv_text: The shield of his mighty men is made red, the valiant men are in scarlet: the chariots shall be with flaming torches in the day of his preparation, and the fir trees shall be terribly shaken.
bsb_text: The shields of his mighty men are red; the valiant warriors are dressed in scarlet. The fittings of the chariots flash like fire on the day they are prepared, and the spears of cypress have been brandished.
aov_text: Die skild van sy helde is rooi geverf, die dapper manne in skarlaken gekleed, die strydwaens skitter met die glans van staal op die dag as hy hom gereedmaak, en die spiese word geswaai.

kjv_text: The chariots shall rage in the streets, they shall justle one against another in the broad ways: they shall seem like torches, they shall run like the lightnings.
bsb_text: The chariots dash through the streets; they rush around the plazas, appearing like torches, darting about like lightning.
aov_text: Langs die paaie raas die strydwaens, hulle jaag rond oor die vlaktes; hulle voorkoms is soos fakkels, soos bliksemstrale skiet hulle heen en weer.

kjv_text: He shall recount his worthies: they shall stumble in their walk; they shall make haste to the wall thereof, and the defence shall be prepared.
bsb_text: He summons his nobles; they stumble as they advance. They race to its wall; the protective shield is set in place.
aov_text: Hy dink aan sy vername manne; hulle struikel in hul vaart, hulle hardloop na die muur waar die stormdak opgerig staan.

kjv_text: The gates of the rivers shall be opened, and the palace shall be dissolved.
bsb_text: The river gates are thrown open and the palace collapses.
aov_text: Die poorte van die riviere word oopgemaak, en die paleis smelt weg.

kjv_text: And Huzzab shall be led away captive, she shall be brought up, and her maids shall lead her as with the voice of doves, tabering upon their breasts.
bsb_text: It is decreed that the city be exiled and carried away; her maidservants moan like doves, and beat upon their breasts.
aov_text: En dit is beslis: die stad word ontbloot, sy word weggevoer, en haar slavinne klae soos die stem van duiwe en slaan op hulle bors.

kjv_text: But Nineveh is of old like a pool of water: yet they shall flee away. Stand, stand, shall they cry; but none shall look back.
bsb_text: Nineveh has been like a pool of water throughout her days, but now it is draining away. “Stop! Stop!” they cry, but no one turns back.
aov_text: En Ninevé is soos ’n vywer van waters, al die dae van haar bestaan. Maar hulle loop weg! Staan tog, staan! Maar daar is niemand wat omdraai nie.

kjv_text: Take ye the spoil of silver, take the spoil of gold: for there is none end of the store and glory out of all the pleasant furniture.
bsb_text: “Plunder the silver! Plunder the gold!” There is no end to the treasure, an abundance of every precious thing.
aov_text: Roof silwer, roof goud! En onuitputlik is die voorraad, ’n rykdom van allerhande kosbare dinge!

kjv_text: She is empty, and void, and waste: and the heart melteth, and the knees smite together, and much pain is in all loins, and the faces of them all gather blackness.
bsb_text: She is emptied! Yes, she is desolate and laid waste! Hearts melt, knees knock, bodies tremble, and every face grows pale!
aov_text: Leegheid, ontlediging, vernieling! En die hart versmelt, en knieë wankel, en in al die lendene is krampe, en die aangesig van hulle almal word bleek.

kjv_text: Where is the dwelling of the lions, and the feedingplace of the young lions, where the lion, even the old lion, walked, and the lion's whelp, and none made them afraid?
bsb_text: Where is the lions’ lair or the feeding ground of the young lions, where the lion and lioness prowled with their cubs, with nothing to frighten them away?
aov_text: Waar is die lêplek van die leeus, wat die voedingsplek was van die jong leeus? Waar die leeu, die leeuin, die klein leeutjie rondgeloop het sonder dat iemand hulle skrikmaak?

kjv_text: The lion did tear in pieces enough for his whelps, and strangled for his lionesses, and filled his holes with prey, and his dens with ravin.
bsb_text: The lion mauled enough for its cubs and strangled prey for the lioness. It filled its dens with the kill, and its lairs with mauled prey.
aov_text: Die leeu wat vir sy kleintjies geroof en vir sy leeuinne gewurg het, wat sy gate met roof gevul het en sy lêplekke met buit.

kjv_text: Behold, I am against thee, saith the LORD of hosts, and I will burn her chariots in the smoke, and the sword shall devour thy young lions: and I will cut off thy prey from the earth, and the voice of thy messengers shall no more be heard.
bsb_text: “Behold, I am against you,” declares the LORD of Hosts. “I will send your chariots up in smoke, and the sword will devour your young lions. I will cut off your prey from the earth, and the voices of your messengers will no longer be heard.”
aov_text: Kyk, Ek het dit teen jou, spreek die HERE van die leërskare, en Ek laat jou strydwaens in rook opgaan; en die swaard sal jou jong leeus verslind, en Ek sal jou roof van die aarde verdelg; en die stem van jou gesante sal nie meer gehoor word nie.

kjv_text: Woe to the bloody city! it is all full of lies and robbery; the prey departeth not;
bsb_text: Woe to the city of blood, full of lies, full of plunder, never without prey.
aov_text: WEE die bloedstad wat louter bedrog, vol geweld is, terwyl rowery nie ophou nie!

kjv_text: The noise of a whip, and the noise of the rattling of the wheels, and of the pransing horses, and of the jumping chariots.
bsb_text: The crack of the whip, the rumble of the wheel, galloping horse and bounding chariot!
aov_text: Hoor, die sweep! En hoor, die gedreun van wiele! En perde wat jaag, en waens wat stamp!

kjv_text: The horseman lifteth up both the bright sword and the glittering spear: and there is a multitude of slain, and a great number of carcases; and there is none end of their corpses; they stumble upon their corpses:
bsb_text: Charging horseman, flashing sword, shining spear; heaps of slain, mounds of corpses, dead bodies without end—they stumble over their dead—
aov_text: Ruiters op ’n galop en geglinster van swaarde en geblits van spiese! En ’n menigte wat verslaan is, en hope dooies en geen einde aan die lyke nie—’n mens struikel oor hulle lyke!

kjv_text: Because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the wellfavoured harlot, the mistress of witchcrafts, that selleth nations through her whoredoms, and families through her witchcrafts.
bsb_text: because of the many harlotries of the harlot, the seductive mistress of sorcery, who betrays nations by her prostitution and clans by her witchcraft.
aov_text: Weens die veelheid van die hoererye van die hoer vol bevalligheid, ’n meesteres in towerkunste, wat nasies met haar hoererye verkoop het en volkstamme met haar towerkunste.

kjv_text: Behold, I am against thee, saith the LORD of hosts; and I will discover thy skirts upon thy face, and I will shew the nations thy nakedness, and the kingdoms thy shame.
bsb_text: “Behold, I am against you,” declares the LORD of Hosts. “I will lift your skirts over your face. I will show your nakedness to the nations and your shame to the kingdoms.
aov_text: Kyk, Ek het dit teen jou, spreek die HERE van die leërskare, en Ek sal jou slippe optel oor jou aangesig en nasies jou naaktheid laat sien en koninkryke jou skande.

kjv_text: And I will cast abominable filth upon thee, and make thee vile, and will set thee as a gazingstock.
bsb_text: I will pelt you with filth and treat you with contempt; I will make a spectacle of you.
aov_text: En Ek sal vuilgoed op jou gooi en jou aan minagting prysgee en van jou ’n skouspel maak,

kjv_text: And it shall come to pass, that all they that look upon thee shall flee from thee, and say, Nineveh is laid waste: who will bemoan her? whence shall I seek comforters for thee?
bsb_text: Then all who see you will recoil from you and say, ‘Nineveh is devastated; who will grieve for her?’ Where can I find comforters for you?”
aov_text: sodat elkeen wat jou sien, van jou af sal wegvlug en sê: Verwoes is Ninevé! Wie sal met haar medelyde hê? Waar sal ek troosters vir jou gaan soek?

kjv_text: Art thou better than populous No, that was situate among the rivers, that had the waters round about it, whose rampart was the sea, and her wall was from the sea?
bsb_text: Are you better than Thebes, stationed by the Nile with water around her, whose rampart was the sea, whose wall was the water?
aov_text: Is jy beter as No-Amon wat gelê het aan die Nylstrome, met waters rondom hom; wie se voorskans die groot water was, waters sy muur?

kjv_text: Ethiopia and Egypt were her strength, and it was infinite; Put and Lubim were thy helpers.
bsb_text: Cush and Egypt were her boundless strength; Put and Libya were her allies.
aov_text: Kus was sy krag en Egiptenaars sonder getal, Putéërs en Líbiërs was jou tot hulp.

kjv_text: Yet was she carried away, she went into captivity: her young children also were dashed in pieces at the top of all the streets: and they cast lots for her honourable men, and all her great men were bound in chains.
bsb_text: Yet she became an exile; she went into captivity. Her infants were dashed to pieces at the head of every street. They cast lots for her dignitaries, and all her nobles were bound in chains.
aov_text: Nogtans het dit as gevangene in ballingskap gegaan; nogtans is sy kinders by al die straathoeke verpletter, en oor sy edeles is die lot gewerp, en al sy groot manne is met kettings geboei.

kjv_text: Thou also shalt be drunken: thou shalt be hid, thou also shalt seek strength because of the enemy.
bsb_text: You too will become drunk; you will go into hiding and seek refuge from the enemy.
aov_text: Ook jý sal dronk word, beneweld wees, ook jý sal ’n toevlug soek teen die vyand.

kjv_text: All thy strong holds shall be like fig trees with the firstripe figs: if they be shaken, they shall even fall into the mouth of the eater.
bsb_text: All your fortresses are fig trees with the first ripe figs; when shaken, they fall into the mouth of the eater!
aov_text: Al jou vestings is vyebome met voorvye: as ’n mens skud, val hulle in die mond van die eter.

kjv_text: Behold, thy people in the midst of thee are women: the gates of thy land shall be set wide open unto thine enemies: the fire shall devour thy bars.
bsb_text: Look at your troops—they are like your women! The gates of your land are wide open to your enemies; fire consumes their bars.
aov_text: Kyk, jou volk binne-in jou is soos vroue, die poorte van jou land is wyd oopgemaak vir jou vyande, die vuur het jou grendels verteer.

kjv_text: Draw thee waters for the siege, fortify thy strong holds: go into clay, and tread the morter, make strong the brickkiln.
bsb_text: Draw your water for the siege; strengthen your fortresses. Work the clay and tread the mortar; repair the brick kiln!
aov_text: Skep vir jou water vir die beleëring, versterk jou vestings, gaan in die modder en trap klei, gryp die steenvorm.

kjv_text: There shall the fire devour thee; the sword shall cut thee off, it shall eat thee up like the cankerworm: make thyself many as the cankerworm, make thyself many as the locusts.
bsb_text: There the fire will devour you; the sword will cut you down and consume you like a young locust. Make yourself many like the young locust; make yourself many like the swarming locust!
aov_text: Daar sal die vuur jou verteer, die swaard jou uitroei, jou verslind net soos voetgangersprinkane. Al vermenigvuldig jy soos voetgangers, al vermenigvuldig jy soos treksprinkane;

kjv_text: Thou hast multiplied thy merchants above the stars of heaven: the cankerworm spoileth, and fleeth away.
bsb_text: You have multiplied your merchants more than the stars of the sky. The young locust strips the land and flies away.
aov_text: al het jy jou koopmans meer gemaak as die sterre aan die hemel—die voetgangers vervel en vlieg weg!

kjv_text: Thy crowned are as the locusts, and thy captains as the great grasshoppers, which camp in the hedges in the cold day, but when the sun ariseth they flee away, and their place is not known where they are.
bsb_text: Your guards are like the swarming locust, and your scribes like clouds of locusts that settle on the walls on a cold day. When the sun rises, they fly away, and no one knows where.
aov_text: Jou wagters is soos treksprinkane, en jou amptenare is soos swerms sprinkane wat op ’n koue dag op die heining sit—die son breek deur, en hulle vlieg weg, en niemand weet waar hulle beland het nie.

kjv_text: Thy shepherds slumber, O king of Assyria: thy nobles shall dwell in the dust: thy people is scattered upon the mountains, and no man gathereth them.
bsb_text: O king of Assyria, your shepherds slumber; your officers sleep. Your people are scattered on the mountains with no one to gather them.
aov_text: Jou herders sluimer, o koning van Assur, jou edeles lê daar, jou volk is op die berge verstrooi, en niemand versamel hulle nie.

kjv_text: There is no healing of thy bruise; thy wound is grievous: all that hear the bruit of thee shall clap the hands over thee: for upon whom hath not thy wickedness passed continually?
bsb_text: There is no healing for your injury; your wound is severe. All who hear the news of you applaud your downfall, for who has not experienced your constant cruelty?
aov_text: Daar is geen herstel vir jou verbreking nie; jou wond is ongeneeslik; almal wat die tyding omtrent jou verneem, slaan hulle hande saam oor jou; want oor wie het jou boosheid nie voortdurend heengegaan nie?

kjv_text: The burden which Habakkuk the prophet did see.
bsb_text: This is the burden that Habakkuk the prophet received in a vision:
aov_text: DIE Godspraak wat Hábakuk, die profeet, gesien het.

kjv_text: O LORD, how long shall I cry, and thou wilt not hear! even cry out unto thee of violence, and thou wilt not save!
bsb_text: How long, O LORD, must I call for help but You do not hear, or cry out to You, “Violence!” but You do not save?
aov_text: Hoe lank, o HERE, roep ek om hulp, maar U hoor nie; skreeu ek tot U: Geweld!—maar U help nie?

kjv_text: Why dost thou shew me iniquity, and cause me to behold grievance? for spoiling and violence are before me: and there are that raise up strife and contention.
bsb_text: Why do You make me see iniquity? Why do You tolerate wrongdoing? Destruction and violence are before me. Strife is ongoing, and conflict abounds.
aov_text: Waarom laat U my onreg sien en aanskou U die moeite! Ja, verwoesting en geweld is voor my oë; en daar is stryd, en twis begin.

kjv_text: Therefore the law is slacked, and judgment doth never go forth: for the wicked doth compass about the righteous; therefore wrong judgment proceedeth.
bsb_text: Therefore the law is paralyzed, and justice never goes forth. For the wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted.
aov_text: Daarom verloor die wet sy krag, en die reg kom nooit meer te voorskyn nie; want die goddelose omsingel die regverdige, daarom kom die reg verdraaid te voorskyn.

kjv_text: Behold ye among the heathen, and regard, and wonder marvellously: for I will work a work in your days, which ye will not believe, though it be told you.
bsb_text: “Look at the nations and observe—be utterly astounded! For I am doing a work in your days that you would never believe even if someone told you.
aov_text: Aanskou onder die nasies en merk op, en staan verstom, verstom; want Ek gaan iets in julle dae doen wat julle nie sal glo as dit vertel word nie.

kjv_text: For, lo, I raise up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation, which shall march through the breadth of the land, to possess the dwellingplaces that are not theirs.
bsb_text: For behold, I am raising up the Chaldeans—that ruthless and impetuous nation which marches through the breadth of the earth to seize dwellings not their own.
aov_text: Want kyk, Ek gaan die Chaldeërs opwek, daardie kwaai en onstuimige nasie wat trek deur die wydtes van die aarde, om wonings in besit te neem wat aan hom nie behoort nie.

kjv_text: They are terrible and dreadful: their judgment and their dignity shall proceed of themselves.
bsb_text: They are dreaded and feared; from themselves they derive justice and sovereignty.
aov_text: Verskriklik en gedug is hy, van homself gaan sy reg en hoogheid uit.

kjv_text: Their horses also are swifter than the leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves: and their horsemen shall spread themselves, and their horsemen shall come from far; they shall fly as the eagle that hasteth to eat.
bsb_text: Their horses are swifter than leopards, fiercer than wolves of the night. Their horsemen charge ahead, and their cavalry comes from afar. They fly like a vulture, swooping down to devour.
aov_text: En vinniger as luiperds is sy perde en gouer as aandwolwe; en op ’n galop kom sy ruiters, ja, sy ruiters! Van ver kom hulle aangevlieg net soos ’n arend wat op sy prooi neerskiet!

kjv_text: They shall come all for violence: their faces shall sup up as the east wind, and they shall gather the captivity as the sand.
bsb_text: All of them come bent on violence; their hordes advance like the east wind; they gather prisoners like sand.
aov_text: Hulle kom almal om geweld te pleeg; die rigting van hulle gesigte is vorentoe, sodat hy gevangenes versamel soos sand.

kjv_text: And they shall scoff at the kings, and the princes shall be a scorn unto them: they shall deride every strong hold; for they shall heap dust, and take it.
bsb_text: They scoff at kings and make rulers an object of scorn. They laugh at every fortress and build up siege ramps to seize it.
aov_text: Ook dryf hy die spot met konings, en vorste is vir hom ’n belagging; hy lag om elke vesting; hy hoop grond daarteen op en neem dit in.

kjv_text: Then shall his mind change, and he shall pass over, and offend, imputing this his power unto his god.
bsb_text: Then they sweep by like the wind and pass on through. They are guilty; their own strength is their god.”
aov_text: Dan gly hy verby, ’n wind, en trek verder—maar word skuldig, hy wie se krag sy god is.

kjv_text: Art thou not from everlasting, O LORD my God, mine Holy One? we shall not die. O LORD, thou hast ordained them for judgment; and, O mighty God, thou hast established them for correction.
bsb_text: Are You not from everlasting, O LORD, my God, my Holy One? We will not die. O LORD, You have appointed them to execute judgment; O Rock, You have established them for correction.
aov_text: IS U dan nie uit die voortyd nie, o HERE, my God, my Heilige? Ons sal nie sterwe nie. HERE, tot ’n strafoordeel het U hom bestel en, o Rots, tot ’n tugroede het U hom bestem!

kjv_text: Thou art of purer eyes than to behold evil, and canst not look on iniquity: wherefore lookest thou upon them that deal treacherously, and holdest thy tongue when the wicked devoureth the man that is more righteous than he?
bsb_text: Your eyes are too pure to look upon evil, and You cannot tolerate wrongdoing. So why do You tolerate the faithless? Why are You silent while the wicked swallow up those more righteous than themselves?
aov_text: U, wat te rein is van oë om die kwaad aan te sien en die onreg nie kan aanskou nie—waarom aanskou U die trouelose, swyg U wanneer die goddelose dié verslind wat regverdiger is as hy?

kjv_text: And makest men as the fishes of the sea, as the creeping things, that have no ruler over them?
bsb_text: You have made men like the fish of the sea, like creeping things that have no ruler.
aov_text: So maak U dan mense soos visse van die see, soos kruipende gedierte wat geen heerser oor hulle het nie.

kjv_text: They take up all of them with the angle, they catch them in their net, and gather them in their drag: therefore they rejoice and are glad.
bsb_text: The foe pulls all of them up with a hook; he catches them in his dragnet, and gathers them in his fishing net; so he rejoices gladly.
aov_text: Hy trek hulle almal op met die hoek, sleep hulle in sy net en vergader hulle in sy seën; daarom is hy vrolik en juig.

kjv_text: Therefore they sacrifice unto their net, and burn incense unto their drag; because by them their portion is fat, and their meat plenteous.
bsb_text: Therefore he sacrifices to his dragnet and burns incense to his fishing net, for by these things his portion is sumptuous and his food is rich.
aov_text: Daarom offer hy aan sy net en laat rook opgaan vir sy seën; want deur hulle is sy aandeel vet en sy spys weelderig.

kjv_text: Shall they therefore empty their net, and not spare continually to slay the nations?
bsb_text: Will he, therefore, empty his net and continue to slay nations without mercy?
aov_text: Sal hy daarom sy net uitskud en gedurigdeur nasies doodmaak sonder verskoning?

kjv_text: I will stand upon my watch, and set me upon the tower, and will watch to see what he will say unto me, and what I shall answer when I am reproved.
bsb_text: I will stand at my guard post and station myself on the ramparts. I will watch to see what He will say to me, and how I should answer when corrected.
aov_text: OP my wagtoring wil ek gaan staan en op ’n skansmuur my stel, en ek wil speur om te sien wat Hy in my sal spreek, en wat ek op my klagte moet antwoord.

kjv_text: And the LORD answered me, and said, Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables, that he may run that readeth it.
bsb_text: Then the LORD answered me: “Write down this vision and clearly inscribe it on tablets, so that a herald may run with it.
aov_text: Toe antwoord die HERE my en sê: Skryf die gesig op en graveer dit op tafels, sodat hulle dit in die verbygaan kan lees.

kjv_text: For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come, it will not tarry.
bsb_text: For the vision awaits an appointed time; it testifies of the end and does not lie. Though it lingers, wait for it, since it will surely come and will not delay.
aov_text: Want die gesig sal nog duur tot op die vasgestelde tyd; maar dit spoed na die einde en sal nie teleurstel nie. As dit mag vertoef, wag daarop; want alte seker sal dit kom en nie versuim nie:

kjv_text: Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him: but the just shall live by his faith.
bsb_text: Look at the proud one; his soul is not upright—but the righteous will live by faith—
aov_text: Kyk, sy siel is opgeblase in hom en nie reg nie. Maar die regverdige, deur sy geloof sal hy lewe.

kjv_text: Yea also, because he transgresseth by wine, he is a proud man, neither keepeth at home, who enlargeth his desire as hell, and is as death, and cannot be satisfied, but gathereth unto him all nations, and heapeth unto him all people:
bsb_text: and wealth indeed betrays him. He is an arrogant man never at rest. He enlarges his appetite like Sheol, and like Death, he is never satisfied. He gathers all the nations to himself and collects all the peoples as his own.
aov_text: En bowendien, die wyn is ’n bedrieër, ’n trotse man is onbestendig: hy wat sy keel wyd oopmaak soos die doderyk, en soos die dood is hy, so onversadelik—hy vergader vir homself al die nasies en maak vir hom al die volke bymekaar.

kjv_text: Shall not all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, Woe to him that increaseth that which is not his! how long? and to him that ladeth himself with thick clay!
bsb_text: Will not all of these take up a taunt against him, speaking with mockery and derision: ‘Woe to him who amasses what is not his and makes himself rich with many loans! How long will this go on?’
aov_text: Sal hulle nie almal oor hom ’n spreuk, ’n spotlied aanhef nie, raaisels oor hom maak nie, en sê: Wee die man wat hom verryk met wat nie aan hom behoort nie—hoe lank?—en hom beswaar met verpande goed.

kjv_text: Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite thee, and awake that shall vex thee, and thou shalt be for booties unto them?
bsb_text: Will not your creditors suddenly arise and those who disturb you awaken? Then you will become their prey.
aov_text: Sal die wat jou byt, nie skielik opstaan en jou skrikaanjaers nie opwaak, sodat jy vir hulle ’n prooi word nie?

kjv_text: Because thou hast spoiled many nations, all the remnant of the people shall spoil thee; because of men's blood, and for the violence of the land, of the city, and of all that dwell therein.
bsb_text: Because you have plundered many nations, the remnant of the people will plunder you—because of your bloodshed against man and your violence against the land, the city, and all their dwellers.
aov_text: Omdat jy baie nasies uitgebuit het, sal al die volke wat oorgebly het, jou uitbuit, weens die bloed van die mense en die geweld teen die land, die stad en al sy inwoners.

kjv_text: Woe to him that coveteth an evil covetousness to his house, that he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from the power of evil!
bsb_text: Woe to him who builds his house by unjust gain, to place his nest on high and escape the hand of disaster!
aov_text: Wee hom wat vuil gewin maak vir sy huis, om sy nes in die hoogte te bou, om homself te red uit die greep van onheil.

kjv_text: Thou hast consulted shame to thy house by cutting off many people, and hast sinned against thy soul.
bsb_text: You have plotted shame for your house by cutting off many peoples and forfeiting your life.
aov_text: Jy het skande beraadslaag vir jou huis: die uitroeiing van baie volke, en het jou lewe verbeur.

kjv_text: For the stone shall cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the timber shall answer it.
bsb_text: For the stones will cry out from the wall, and the rafters will echo it from the woodwork.
aov_text: Want die steen uit die muur roep, en die balk uit die timmerasie gee hom antwoord.

kjv_text: Woe to him that buildeth a town with blood, and stablisheth a city by iniquity!
bsb_text: Woe to him who builds a city with bloodshed and establishes a town by iniquity!
aov_text: Wee hom wat ’n stad bou met bloed en ’n vesting stig deur onreg.

kjv_text: Behold, is it not of the LORD of hosts that the people shall labour in the very fire, and the people shall weary themselves for very vanity?
bsb_text: Is it not indeed from the LORD of Hosts that the labor of the people only feeds the fire, and the nations weary themselves in vain?
aov_text: Kyk, kom dit nie van die HERE van die leërskare dat volke arbei vir vuur en nasies hulle afmat vir niks nie?

kjv_text: For the earth shall be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea.
bsb_text: For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the LORD as the waters cover the sea.
aov_text: Want die aarde sal vol word met die kennis van die heerlikheid van die HERE soos die waters die seebodem oordek.

kjv_text: Woe unto him that giveth his neighbour drink, that puttest thy bottle to him, and makest him drunken also, that thou mayest look on their nakedness!
bsb_text: Woe to him who gives drink to his neighbors, pouring it from the wineskin until they are drunk, in order to gaze at their nakedness!
aov_text: Wee hom wat aan sy naaste drank gee, wat jou gif daarmee meng, en hulle ook dronk maak om hulle naaktheid te aanskou.

kjv_text: Thou art filled with shame for glory: drink thou also, and let thy foreskin be uncovered: the cup of the LORD's right hand shall be turned unto thee, and shameful spewing shall be on thy glory.
bsb_text: You will be filled with shame instead of glory. You too must drink and expose your uncircumcision! The cup in the LORD’s right hand will come around to you, and utter disgrace will cover your glory.
aov_text: Jy het jou versadig met skande in plaas van met eer—drink jy ook nou, en wees ontbloot. Na jou toe sal die beker van die regterhand van die HERE omgaan, en skande tref jou eer.

kjv_text: For the violence of Lebanon shall cover thee, and the spoil of beasts, which made them afraid, because of men's blood, and for the violence of the land, of the city, and of all that dwell therein.
bsb_text: For your violence against Lebanon will overwhelm you, and the destruction of animals will terrify you, because of your bloodshed against men and your violence against the land, the city, and all their dwellers.
aov_text: Want die geweld aan die Líbanon gepleeg, sal jou oordek; en die verwoesting waarmee die diere skrikgemaak is—weens die bloed van die mense en die geweld teen die land, die stad en al sy inwoners.

kjv_text: What profiteth the graven image that the maker thereof hath graven it; the molten image, and a teacher of lies, that the maker of his work trusteth therein, to make dumb idols?
bsb_text: What use is an idol, that a craftsman should carve it—or an image, a teacher of lies? For its maker trusts in his own creation; he makes idols that cannot speak.
aov_text: Wat baat ’n gesnede beeld dat sy maker dit reggekap het, ’n gegote beeld, wat ’n leuenleraar is, dat die maker op sy eie maaksel vertrou, deur stomme afgode te maak?

kjv_text: Woe unto him that saith to the wood, Awake; to the dumb stone, Arise, it shall teach! Behold, it is laid over with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all in the midst of it.
bsb_text: Woe to him who says to wood, ‘Awake!’ or to silent stone, ‘Arise!’ Can it give guidance? Behold, it is overlaid with gold and silver, yet there is no breath in it at all.”
aov_text: Wee hom wat vir ’n stuk hout sê: Word wakker! vir ’n dooie klip: Ontwaak! Kan hy ’n mens leer? Kyk, hy is oorgetrek met goud en silwer, en daar is géén gees in sy binneste nie!

kjv_text: But the LORD is in his holy temple: let all the earth keep silence before him.
bsb_text: But the LORD is in His holy temple; let all the earth be silent before Him.
aov_text: Maar die HERE is in sy heilige tempel—swyg voor Hom, o ganse aarde!

kjv_text: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet upon Shigionoth.
bsb_text: This is a prayer of Habakkuk the prophet, according to Shigionoth:
aov_text: ’N GEBED van Hábakuk, die profeet, op die wysie van Sjigjonōt.

kjv_text: O LORD, I have heard thy speech, and was afraid: O LORD, revive thy work in the midst of the years, in the midst of the years make known; in wrath remember mercy.
bsb_text: O LORD, I have heard the report of You; I stand in awe, O LORD, of Your deeds. Revive them in these years; make them known in these years. In Your wrath, remember mercy!
aov_text: HERE, ek het die tyding aangaande U verneem, ek het gevrees! HERE, roep u werk in die lewe in die midde van die jare; in die midde van die jare laat dit bekend word. In toorn, dink aan ontferming.

kjv_text: God came from Teman, and the Holy One from mount Paran. Selah. His glory covered the heavens, and the earth was full of his praise.
bsb_text: God came from Teman, and the Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah His glory covered the heavens, and His praise filled the earth.
aov_text: God kom van Teman en die Heilige van die berg Paran. Sela. Sy majesteit bedek die hemel, en die aarde is vol van sy lof.

kjv_text: And his brightness was as the light; he had horns coming out of his hand: and there was the hiding of his power.
bsb_text: His radiance was like the sunlight; rays flashed from His hand, where His power is hidden.
aov_text: En glans soos sonlig is daar, ligstrale aan sy sy; en dáár is die omhulsel van sy krag.

kjv_text: Before him went the pestilence, and burning coals went forth at his feet.
bsb_text: Plague went before Him, and fever followed in His steps.
aov_text: Voor Hom uit loop die pes, en ’n koorsgloed trek uit agter Hom aan.

kjv_text: He stood, and measured the earth: he beheld, and drove asunder the nations; and the everlasting mountains were scattered, the perpetual hills did bow: his ways are everlasting.
bsb_text: He stood and measured the earth; He looked and startled the nations; the ancient mountains crumbled; the perpetual hills collapsed. His ways are everlasting.
aov_text: Hy tree op en laat die aarde wankel, Hy kyk en laat nasies opskrik; verpletterd lê die ewige berge, en neergesink die ou, ou heuwels—paaie van die ou tyd vir Hom.

kjv_text: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction: and the curtains of the land of Midian did tremble.
bsb_text: I saw the tents of Cushan in distress; the curtains of Midian were trembling.
aov_text: Ek sien die tente van Kusan met onheil oordek, en die tentdoeke van die land Mídian bewe.

kjv_text: Was the LORD displeased against the rivers? was thine anger against the rivers? was thy wrath against the sea, that thou didst ride upon thine horses and thy chariots of salvation?
bsb_text: Were You angry at the rivers, O LORD? Was Your wrath against the streams? Did You rage against the sea when You rode on Your horses, on Your chariots of salvation?
aov_text: Is dit teen riviere, o HERE, teen die riviere, dat u toorn ontvlam het? Of geld u grimmigheid die see dat U ry met u perde, u oorwinningswaens?

kjv_text: Thy bow was made quite naked, according to the oaths of the tribes, even thy word. Selah. Thou didst cleave the earth with rivers.
bsb_text: You brandished Your bow; You called for many arrows. Selah You split the earth with rivers.
aov_text: Heeltemal ontbloot is u boog; besweer is die pyle deur die woord. Sela. Tot riviere splyt U die aarde.

kjv_text: The mountains saw thee, and they trembled: the overflowing of the water passed by: the deep uttered his voice, and lifted up his hands on high.
bsb_text: The mountains saw You and quaked; torrents of water swept by. The deep roared with its voice and lifted its hands on high.
aov_text: Die berge sien U en bewe van angs, ’n wolkbreuk storm verby, die wêreldvloed verhef sy stem, steek sy hande omhoog.

kjv_text: The sun and moon stood still in their habitation: at the light of thine arrows they went, and at the shining of thy glittering spear.
bsb_text: Sun and moon stood still in their places at the flash of Your flying arrows, at the brightness of Your shining spear.
aov_text: Die son, die maan bly in hulle woonplek by die lig van u pyle wat verbyskiet, by die glans van u flikkerende spies.

kjv_text: Thou didst march through the land in indignation, thou didst thresh the heathen in anger.
bsb_text: You marched across the earth with fury; You threshed the nations in wrath.
aov_text: In grimmigheid betree U die aarde, in toorn dors U die nasies.

kjv_text: Thou wentest forth for the salvation of thy people, even for salvation with thine anointed; thou woundedst the head out of the house of the wicked, by discovering the foundation unto the neck. Selah.
bsb_text: You went forth for the salvation of Your people, to save Your anointed. You crushed the head of the house of the wicked and stripped him from head to toe. Selah
aov_text: U trek uit tot redding van u volk, tot redding van u Gesalfde. U verbrysel die kop van die huis van die goddelose en ontbloot die fondament tot by die nek. Sela.

kjv_text: Thou didst strike through with his staves the head of his villages: they came out as a whirlwind to scatter me: their rejoicing was as to devour the poor secretly.
bsb_text: With his own spear You pierced his head, when his warriors stormed out to scatter us, gloating as though ready to secretly devour the weak.
aov_text: U deurboor met sy eie pyle die hoof van sy leiers wat storm om my te verstrooi; wie se gejuig is asof hulle die ellendige in die skuilhoek wil verslind.

kjv_text: Thou didst walk through the sea with thine horses, through the heap of great waters.
bsb_text: You trampled the sea with Your horses, churning the great waters.
aov_text: U betree die see met u perde, ’n hoop magtige waters.

kjv_text: When I heard, my belly trembled; my lips quivered at the voice: rottenness entered into my bones, and I trembled in myself, that I might rest in the day of trouble: when he cometh up unto the people, he will invade them with his troops.
bsb_text: I heard and trembled within; my lips quivered at the sound. Decay entered my bones; I trembled where I stood. Yet I must wait patiently for the day of distress to come upon the people who invade us.
aov_text: Toe ek dit hoor, het my ingewande gebewe; my lippe het getril by die geluid, bederf het gekom in my gebeente, ja, ek het gebewe waar ek staan, omdat ek rustig moes wag op die dag van benoudheid dat dit aanbreek vir die volk wat op ons ’n aanval maak.

kjv_text: Although the fig tree shall not blossom, neither shall fruit be in the vines; the labour of the olive shall fail, and the fields shall yield no meat; the flock shall be cut off from the fold, and there shall be no herd in the stalls:
bsb_text: Though the fig tree does not bud and no fruit is on the vines, though the olive crop fails and the fields produce no food, though the sheep are cut off from the fold and no cattle are in the stalls,
aov_text: Alhoewel die vyeboom nie sal bloei en aan die wingerdstokke geen vrug sal wees nie, die drag van die olyfboom sal teleurstel en die saailande geen voedsel oplewer nie, die kleinvee uit die kraal verdwyn en geen beeste in die stalle sal wees nie —

kjv_text: Yet I will rejoice in the LORD, I will joy in the God of my salvation.
bsb_text: yet I will exult in the LORD; I will rejoice in the God of my salvation!
aov_text: nogtans sal ek jubel in die HERE, ek sal juig in die God van my heil.

kjv_text: The LORD God is my strength, and he will make my feet like hinds' feet, and he will make me to walk upon mine high places. To the chief singer on my stringed instruments.
bsb_text: GOD the Lord is my strength; He makes my feet like those of a deer; He makes me walk upon the heights! For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments.
aov_text: Die HERE Here is my sterkte, en Hy maak my voete soos dié van herte, en Hy laat my tree op my hoogtes. Vir die musiekleier op snaarinstrumente.

kjv_text: The word of the LORD which came unto Zephaniah the son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hizkiah, in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah.
bsb_text: This is the word of the LORD that came to Zephaniah son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hezekiah, in the days of Josiah son of Amon king of Judah:
aov_text: DIE woord van die HERE wat gekom het tot Sefánja, die seun van Kusi, die seun van Gedálja, die seun van Amárja, die seun van Hiskía, in die dae van Josía, die seun van Amon, koning van Juda.

kjv_text: I will utterly consume all things from off the land, saith the LORD.
bsb_text: “I will completely sweep away everything from the face of the earth,” declares the LORD.
aov_text: Saamskraap, wegraap sal Ek alles van die aardbodem af weg, spreek die HERE.

kjv_text: I will consume man and beast; I will consume the fowls of the heaven, and the fishes of the sea, and the stumbling blocks with the wicked: and I will cut off man from off the land, saith the LORD.
bsb_text: “I will sweep away man and beast; I will sweep away the birds of the air, and the fish of the sea, and the idols with their wicked worshipers. I will cut off mankind from the face of the earth,” declares the LORD.
aov_text: Ek sal wegraap mense en diere, Ek sal wegraap die voëls van die hemel en die visse van die see en die struikelblokke saam met die goddelose, ja, Ek sal die mense uitroei van die aardbodem af weg, spreek die HERE.

kjv_text: I will also stretch out mine hand upon Judah, and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and I will cut off the remnant of Baal from this place, and the name of the Chemarims with the priests;
bsb_text: “I will stretch out My hand against Judah and against all who dwell in Jerusalem. I will cut off from this place every remnant of Baal, the names of the idolatrous and pagan priests—
aov_text: En Ek sal my hand uitstrek teen Juda en teen al die inwoners van Jerusalem; Ek sal ook uit hierdie plek uitroei wat van Baäl oorgebly het, die naam van die afgodsdienaars saam met die priesters;

kjv_text: And them that worship the host of heaven upon the housetops; and them that worship and that swear by the LORD, and that swear by Malcham;
bsb_text: those who bow on the rooftops to worship the host of heaven, those who bow down and swear by the LORD but also swear by Milcom,
aov_text: en die wat op die dakke die leër van die hemel aanbid; en die aanbidders wat by die HERE sweer en sweer by Milkom.

kjv_text: And them that are turned back from the LORD; and those that have not sought the LORD, nor enquired for him.
bsb_text: and those who turn back from following the LORD, neither seeking the LORD nor inquiring of Him.”
aov_text: Ook die wat van die HERE afvallig word en wat die HERE nie soek en Hom nie raadpleeg nie.

kjv_text: Hold thy peace at the presence of the Lord GOD: for the day of the LORD is at hand: for the LORD hath prepared a sacrifice, he hath bid his guests.
bsb_text: Be silent in the presence of the Lord GOD, for the Day of the LORD is near. Indeed, the LORD has prepared a sacrifice; He has consecrated His guests.
aov_text: Swyg voor die Here HERE! Want die dag van die HERE is naby; want die HERE het ’n offer berei, sy gaste geheilig.

kjv_text: And it shall come to pass in the day of the LORD's sacrifice, that I will punish the princes, and the king's children, and all such as are clothed with strange apparel.
bsb_text: “On the Day of the LORD’s sacrifice I will punish the princes, the sons of the king, and all who are dressed in foreign apparel.
aov_text: En op die dag van die offer van die HERE sal Ek besoeking doen oor die vorste en die prinse en oor almal wat uitlandse klere dra.

kjv_text: In the same day also will I punish all those that leap on the threshold, which fill their masters' houses with violence and deceit.
bsb_text: On that day I will punish all who leap over the threshold, who fill the house of their master with violence and deceit.
aov_text: Ek sal ook op dié dag besoeking doen oor almal wat oor die drumpel spring, wat die huis van hulle here vul met geweld en bedrog.

kjv_text: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the LORD, that there shall be the noise of a cry from the fish gate, and an howling from the second, and a great crashing from the hills.
bsb_text: On that day,” declares the LORD, “a cry will go up from the Fish Gate, a wail from the Second District, and a loud crashing from the hills.
aov_text: En op dié dag, spreek die HERE—hoor! ’n geskreeu van die Vispoort af en ’n gehuil van die Nuwe Stad af en ’n groot gekraak van die heuwels af!

kjv_text: Howl, ye inhabitants of Maktesh, for all the merchant people are cut down; all they that bear silver are cut off.
bsb_text: Wail, O dwellers of the Hollow, for all your merchants will be silenced; all who weigh out silver will be cut off.
aov_text: Huil, o inwoners van die Vysel! want al die koopmans gaan te gronde, almal wat geld afweeg, word uitgeroei.

kjv_text: And it shall come to pass at that time, that I will search Jerusalem with candles, and punish the men that are settled on their lees: that say in their heart, The LORD will not do good, neither will he do evil.
bsb_text: And at that time I will search Jerusalem with lamps and punish the men settled in complacency, who say to themselves, ‘The LORD will do nothing, either good or bad.’
aov_text: En in dié tyd sal Ek Jerusalem met lanterns deursoek en besoeking doen oor die manne wat dik geword het op hulle afsaksel, wat in hulle hart sê: Die HERE doen geen goed en Hy doen geen kwaad nie.

kjv_text: Therefore their goods shall become a booty, and their houses a desolation: they shall also build houses, but not inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, but not drink the wine thereof.
bsb_text: Their wealth will be plundered and their houses laid waste. They will build houses but not inhabit them, and plant vineyards but never drink their wine.
aov_text: En hulle rykdom sal geplunder word, en hulle huise verwoes word; en as hulle huise bou, sal hulle dit nie bewoon nie; en as hulle wingerde plant, sal hulle die wyn daarvan nie drink nie.

kjv_text: The great day of the LORD is near, it is near, and hasteth greatly, even the voice of the day of the LORD: the mighty man shall cry there bitterly.
bsb_text: The great Day of the LORD is near—near and coming quickly. Listen, the Day of the LORD! Then the cry of the mighty will be bitter.
aov_text: Naby is die groot dag van die HERE, naby en baie haastig. Hoor! die dag van die HERE! Bitterlik skreeu die held daar.

kjv_text: That day is a day of wrath, a day of trouble and distress, a day of wasteness and desolation, a day of darkness and gloominess, a day of clouds and thick darkness,
bsb_text: That day will be a day of wrath, a day of trouble and distress, a day of destruction and desolation, a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and blackness,
aov_text: Dié dag is ’n dag van grimmigheid, ’n dag van benoudheid en angs, ’n dag van woestheid en verwoesting, ’n dag van duisternis en donkerheid, ’n dag van wolke en wolkenag,

kjv_text: A day of the trumpet and alarm against the fenced cities, and against the high towers.
bsb_text: a day of horn blast and battle cry against the fortified cities, and against the high corner towers.
aov_text: ’n dag van basuingeklank en krygsgeskreeu teen die versterkte stede en teen die hoë hoekvestings.

kjv_text: And I will bring distress upon men, that they shall walk like blind men, because they have sinned against the LORD: and their blood shall be poured out as dust, and their flesh as the dung.
bsb_text: I will bring such distress on mankind that they will walk like the blind, because they have sinned against the LORD. Their blood will be poured out like dust and their flesh like dung.
aov_text: En Ek sal die mense in benoudheid bring, en hulle sal rondloop soos blindes, omdat hulle teen die HERE gesondig het; en hulle bloed sal vergiet word soos stof en hulle ingewande soos drek.

kjv_text: Neither their silver nor their gold shall be able to deliver them in the day of the LORD's wrath; but the whole land shall be devoured by the fire of his jealousy: for he shall make even a speedy riddance of all them that dwell in the land.
bsb_text: Neither their silver nor their gold will be able to deliver them on the Day of the LORD’s wrath. The whole earth will be consumed by the fire of His jealousy.” For indeed, He will make a sudden end of all who dwell on the earth.
aov_text: Hulle silwer of hulle goud sal nie in staat wees om hulle op die dag van die grimmigheid van die HERE te red nie, maar deur die vuur van sy ywer sal die hele aarde verteer word; want Hy bring vernietiging, ja, ’n verskriklike, oor die inwoners van die aarde.

kjv_text: Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired;
bsb_text: Gather yourselves, gather together, O shameful nation,
aov_text: KOM tot julleself, ja, kom tot inkeer, o nasie wat nie skaam word nie!

kjv_text: Before the decree bring forth, before the day pass as the chaff, before the fierce anger of the LORD come upon you, before the day of the LORD's anger come upon you.
bsb_text: before the decree takes effect and the day passes like chaff, before the burning anger of the LORD comes upon you, before the Day of the LORD’s anger comes upon you.
aov_text: Voordat die besluit baar—soos kaf gaan die dag verby—voordat daar oor julle kom die toorngloed van die HERE, voordat oor julle kom die dag van die toorn van die HERE.

kjv_text: Seek ye the LORD, all ye meek of the earth, which have wrought his judgment; seek righteousness, seek meekness: it may be ye shall be hid in the day of the LORD's anger.
bsb_text: Seek the LORD, all you humble of the earth who carry out His justice. Seek righteousness; seek humility. Perhaps you will be sheltered on the day of the LORD’s anger.
aov_text: Soek die HERE, o alle ootmoediges van die land, wat sy ordening onderhou; soek geregtigheid, soek ootmoedigheid—miskien sal julle verborge bly op die dag van die toorn van die HERE.

kjv_text: For Gaza shall be forsaken, and Ashkelon a desolation: they shall drive out Ashdod at the noon day, and Ekron shall be rooted up.
bsb_text: For Gaza will be abandoned, and Ashkelon left in ruins. Ashdod will be driven out at noon, and Ekron will be uprooted.
aov_text: Want Gasa sal verlate wees en Áskelon tot verwoesting; Asdod sal op die helder middag verdryf word, en Ekron sal ontwortel word.

kjv_text: Woe unto the inhabitants of the sea coast, the nation of the Cherethites! the word of the LORD is against you; O Canaan, the land of the Philistines, I will even destroy thee, that there shall be no inhabitant.
bsb_text: Woe to the dwellers of the seacoast, O nation of the Cherethites! The word of the LORD is against you, O Canaan, land of the Philistines: “I will destroy you, and no one will be left.”
aov_text: Wee die inwoners van die kusstreek, die nasie van die Kretiërs! Die woord van die HERE is teen julle, Kanaän, land van die Filistyne—Ek verdelg jou, sodat daar niemand meer woon nie.

kjv_text: And the sea coast shall be dwellings and cottages for shepherds, and folds for flocks.
bsb_text: So the seacoast will become a land of pastures, with wells for shepherds and folds for sheep.
aov_text: En die kusstreek sal weiplekke met putte wees vir herders en krale vir kleinvee.

kjv_text: And the coast shall be for the remnant of the house of Judah; they shall feed thereupon: in the houses of Ashkelon shall they lie down in the evening: for the LORD their God shall visit them, and turn away their captivity.
bsb_text: The coast will belong to the remnant of the house of Judah; there they will find pasture. They will lie down in the evening among the houses of Ashkelon, for the LORD their God will attend to them and restore their captives.
aov_text: En dit sal wees ’n deel vir die oorblyfsel van die huis van Juda: hulle sal daarop wei; hulle sal saans in die huise van Áskelon gaan lê, want die HERE hulle God sal op hulle ag gee en hulle lot verander.

kjv_text: I have heard the reproach of Moab, and the revilings of the children of Ammon, whereby they have reproached my people, and magnified themselves against their border.
bsb_text: “I have heard the reproach of Moab and the insults of the Ammonites, who have taunted My people and threatened their borders.
aov_text: Ek het gehoor die smaadtaal van Moab en die beskimpinge van die kinders van Ammon, waarmee hulle my volk gesmaad het, en hoe hulle hul groot gehou het teen sy grondgebied.

kjv_text: Therefore as I live, saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, Surely Moab shall be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah, even the breeding of nettles, and saltpits, and a perpetual desolation: the residue of my people shall spoil them, and the remnant of my people shall possess them.
bsb_text: Therefore, as surely as I live,” declares the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, “surely Moab will be like Sodom and the Ammonites like Gomorrah—a place of weeds and salt pits, a perpetual wasteland. The remnant of My people will plunder them; the remainder of My nation will dispossess them.”
aov_text: Daarom, so waar as Ek leef, spreek die HERE van die leërskare, die God van Israel: Moab sal word soos Sodom en die kinders van Ammon soos Gomorra—’n veld van brandnekels en soutpanne en ’n verwoesting vir ewig; die oorblyfsel van my volk sal hulle berowe, en die res van my nasie sal hulle beërwe.

kjv_text: This shall they have for their pride, because they have reproached and magnified themselves against the people of the LORD of hosts.
bsb_text: This they shall have in return for their pride, for taunting and mocking the people of the LORD of Hosts.
aov_text: Dit oorkom hulle vir hul trotsheid, want hulle het geskimp op en hulle groot gehou teen die volk van die HERE van die leërskare.

kjv_text: The LORD will be terrible unto them: for he will famish all the gods of the earth; and men shall worship him, every one from his place, even all the isles of the heathen.
bsb_text: The LORD will be terrifying to them when He starves all the gods of the earth. Then the nations of every shore will bow in worship to Him, each in its own place.
aov_text: Vreeslik sal die HERE teen hulle wees, want Hy laat al die gode van die aarde wegkwyn; sodat hulle Hom kan aanbid elkeen uit sy woonplek, al die kuslande van die nasies.

kjv_text: Ye Ethiopians also, ye shall be slain by my sword.
bsb_text: “You too, O Cushites, will be slain by My sword.”
aov_text: Ook julle, o Kusiete, deurboordes van my swaard is hulle.

kjv_text: And he will stretch out his hand against the north, and destroy Assyria; and will make Nineveh a desolation, and dry like a wilderness.
bsb_text: And He will stretch out His hand against the north and destroy Assyria; He will make Nineveh a desolation, as dry as a desert.
aov_text: Dan sal Hy sy hand uitstrek teen die noorde, en Hy sal Assur vernietig en Ninevé tot ’n verwoesting maak, dor soos die woestyn.

kjv_text: And flocks shall lie down in the midst of her, all the beasts of the nations: both the cormorant and the bittern shall lodge in the upper lintels of it; their voice shall sing in the windows; desolation shall be in the thresholds: for he shall uncover the cedar work.
bsb_text: Herds will lie down in her midst, creatures of every kind. Both the desert owl and screech owl will roost atop her pillars. Their calls will sound from the window, but desolation will lie on the threshold, for He will expose the beams of cedar.
aov_text: En binne-in die stad sal troppe vee lê en allerhande gediertes by troppe, die pelikaan sowel as die krimpvarkie op sy kapitele vernag; hoor! daar word gesing in die venster; verwoesting sit op die drumpel, want hulle het die sederwerk afgeruk.

kjv_text: This is the rejoicing city that dwelt carelessly, that said in her heart, I am, and there is none beside me: how is she become a desolation, a place for beasts to lie down in! every one that passeth by her shall hiss, and wag his hand.
