bsb_text: This carefree city that dwells securely, that thinks to herself: “I am it, and there is none besides me,” what a ruin she has become, a resting place for beasts. Everyone who passes by her hisses and shakes his fist.
aov_text: Dit is die uitgelate stad wat so veilig gewoon het, wat in sy hart gesê het: Dit is ek, en niemand anders nie! Hoe het dit ’n verwoesting geword, ’n lêplek vir wilde diere! Almal wat daar verbytrek, spot, skud met die hand.

kjv_text: Woe to her that is filthy and polluted, to the oppressing city!
bsb_text: Woe to the city of oppressors, rebellious and defiled!
aov_text: WEE die opstandige en die besoedelde, die verdrukkende stad.

kjv_text: She obeyed not the voice; she received not correction; she trusted not in the LORD; she drew not near to her God.
bsb_text: She heeded no voice; she accepted no correction. She does not trust in the LORD; she has not drawn near to her God.
aov_text: Dit luister na geen stem nie, dit neem geen tugtiging aan nie; op die HERE vertrou dit nie, tot sy God kom dit nie nader nie.

kjv_text: Her princes within her are roaring lions; her judges are evening wolves; they gnaw not the bones till the morrow.
bsb_text: Her princes are roaring lions; her judges are evening wolves, leaving nothing for the morning.
aov_text: Sy vorste binne-in hom is brullende leeus; sy regters is aandwolwe wat niks vir die môre oorlaat nie.

kjv_text: Her prophets are light and treacherous persons: her priests have polluted the sanctuary, they have done violence to the law.
bsb_text: Her prophets are reckless, faithless men. Her priests profane the sanctuary; they do violence to the law.
aov_text: Sy profete is ligsinnig, trouelose manne, sy priesters verontreinig wat heilig is, hulle verkrag die wet.

kjv_text: The just LORD is in the midst thereof; he will not do iniquity: every morning doth he bring his judgment to light, he faileth not; but the unjust knoweth no shame.
bsb_text: The LORD within her is righteous; He does no wrong. He applies His justice morning by morning; He does not fail at dawn, yet the unjust know no shame.
aov_text: Die HERE is regverdig binne-in hom, Hy doen geen onreg nie; elke môre laat Hy sy reg aan die lig kom, dit ontbreek nooit nie; maar die kwaaddoener ken geen skaamte nie.

kjv_text: I have cut off the nations: their towers are desolate; I made their streets waste, that none passeth by: their cities are destroyed, so that there is no man, that there is none inhabitant.
bsb_text: “I have cut off the nations; their corner towers are destroyed. I have made their streets deserted with no one to pass through. Their cities are laid waste, with no man, no inhabitant.
aov_text: Ek het nasies uitgeroei, hulle hoekvestings is vernietig; hulle strate het Ek verwoes, sodat niemand meer verbygaan nie; hulle stede is verniel, sodat daar geen mens, geen inwoner in is nie.

kjv_text: I said, Surely thou wilt fear me, thou wilt receive instruction; so their dwelling should not be cut off, howsoever I punished them: but they rose early, and corrupted all their doings.
bsb_text: I said, ‘Surely you will fear Me and accept correction.’ Then her dwelling place would not be cut off despite all for which I punished her. But they rose early to corrupt all their deeds.
aov_text: Ek het gesê: Mag jy My maar vrees, tugtiging aanneem! Dan sou sy woonplek nie uitgeroei word nie, nie plaasvind alles wat Ek teen hom bestel het nie. Nogtans het hulle met ywer al hulle handelinge bederwe.

kjv_text: Therefore wait ye upon me, saith the LORD, until the day that I rise up to the prey: for my determination is to gather the nations, that I may assemble the kingdoms, to pour upon them mine indignation, even all my fierce anger: for all the earth shall be devoured with the fire of my jealousy.
bsb_text: Therefore wait for Me,” declares the LORD, “until the day I rise to testify. For My decision is to gather nations, to assemble kingdoms, to pour out upon them My indignation—all My burning anger. For all the earth will be consumed by the fire of My jealousy.
aov_text: Daarom, verwag My, spreek die HERE, op die dag wat Ek My gereed maak vir die buit; want dit is my strafoordeel om nasies te versamel, koninkryke te vergader om my grimmigheid oor hulle uit te stort, al die gloed van my toorn. Want die ganse aarde sal deur die vuur van my ywer verteer word!

kjv_text: For then will I turn to the people a pure language, that they may all call upon the name of the LORD, to serve him with one consent.
bsb_text: For then I will restore pure lips to the peoples, that all may call upon the name of the LORD and serve Him shoulder to shoulder.
aov_text: Want dan sal Ek aan die volke rein lippe toebring, sodat hulle almal die Naam van die HERE sal aanroep en Hom met ’n eenparige skouer sal dien.

kjv_text: From beyond the rivers of Ethiopia my suppliants, even the daughter of my dispersed, shall bring mine offering.
bsb_text: From beyond the rivers of Cush My worshipers, My scattered people, will bring Me an offering.
aov_text: Oorkant die riviere van Kus vandaan sal my aanbidders, my verstrooide gemeente, my offerande bring.

kjv_text: In that day shalt thou not be ashamed for all thy doings, wherein thou hast transgressed against me: for then I will take away out of the midst of thee them that rejoice in thy pride, and thou shalt no more be haughty because of my holy mountain.
bsb_text: On that day you will not be put to shame for any of the deeds by which you have transgressed against Me. For then I will remove from among you those who rejoice in their pride, and you will never again be haughty on My holy mountain.
aov_text: Op dié dag hoef jy jou nie te skaam weens al jou dade waarmee jy teen My oortree het nie; want dan sal Ek uit jou midde wegruim die wat in jou oormoedig jubel, en jy sal jou nooit hoogmoedig gedra op my heilige berg nie.

kjv_text: I will also leave in the midst of thee an afflicted and poor people, and they shall trust in the name of the LORD.
bsb_text: But I will leave within you a meek and humble people, and they will trust in the name of the LORD.
aov_text: En Ek sal tussen jou in laat oorbly ’n ellendige en geringe volk wat by die Naam van die HERE skuiling soek.

kjv_text: The remnant of Israel shall not do iniquity, nor speak lies; neither shall a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth: for they shall feed and lie down, and none shall make them afraid.
bsb_text: The remnant of Israel will no longer do wrong or speak lies, nor will a deceitful tongue be found in their mouths. But they will feed and lie down, with no one to make them tremble.”
aov_text: Die oorblyfsel van Israel sal geen onreg doen en geen leuentaal spreek nie, en in hulle mond sal geen bedrieglike tong gevind word nie; maar hulle sal wei en neerlê, en niemand sal hulle verskrik nie.

kjv_text: Sing, O daughter of Zion; shout, O Israel; be glad and rejoice with all the heart, O daughter of Jerusalem.
bsb_text: Sing for joy, O Daughter of Zion; shout aloud, O Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, O Daughter of Jerusalem!
aov_text: Jubel, o dogter van Sion, juig, o Israel! Verheug jou en jubel van ganser harte, o dogter van Jerusalem!

kjv_text: The LORD hath taken away thy judgments, he hath cast out thine enemy: the king of Israel, even the LORD, is in the midst of thee: thou shalt not see evil any more.
bsb_text: The LORD has taken away your punishment; He has turned back your enemy. Israel’s King, the LORD, is among you; no longer will you fear any harm.
aov_text: Die HERE het jou oordele opgehef, jou vyand weggeveeg; die koning van Israel, die HERE is by jou, jy sal geen kwaad meer vrees nie.

kjv_text: In that day it shall be said to Jerusalem, Fear thou not: and to Zion, Let not thine hands be slack.
bsb_text: On that day they will say to Jerusalem: “Do not fear, O Zion; do not let your hands fall limp.
aov_text: In dié dag sal aan Jerusalem gesê word: Vrees nie, o Sion, laat jou hande nie slap hang nie!

kjv_text: The LORD thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing.
bsb_text: The LORD your God is among you; He is mighty to save. He will rejoice over you with gladness; He will quiet you with His love; He will rejoice over you with singing.”
aov_text: Die HERE jou God is by jou, ’n held wat verlossing skenk. Hy verheug Hom oor jou met blydskap; Hy swyg in sy liefde; Hy juig oor jou met gejubel.

kjv_text: I will gather them that are sorrowful for the solemn assembly, who are of thee, to whom the reproach of it was a burden.
bsb_text: “I will gather those among you who grieve over the appointed feasts, so that you will no longer suffer reproach.
aov_text: Die wat bedroef is, ver weg van die fees, versamel Ek; hulle hoort by jou, die smaad druk swaar op hulle.

kjv_text: Behold, at that time I will undo all that afflict thee: and I will save her that halteth, and gather her that was driven out; and I will get them praise and fame in every land where they have been put to shame.
bsb_text: Behold, at that time, I will deal with all who afflict you. I will save the lame and gather the scattered; and I will appoint praise and fame for the disgraced throughout the earth.
aov_text: Kyk, in dié tyd sal Ek met al jou verdrukkers handel; en die wat kreupel is, sal Ek red; en die wat verjaag is, versamel; en Ek sal hulle maak tot ’n lof en tot ’n roem wie se skande oor die hele aarde was.

kjv_text: At that time will I bring you again, even in the time that I gather you: for I will make you a name and a praise among all people of the earth, when I turn back your captivity before your eyes, saith the LORD.
bsb_text: At that time I will bring you in; yes, at that time I will gather you. For I will give you fame and praise among all the peoples of the earth when I restore your captives before your very eyes,” says the LORD.
aov_text: In dié tyd sal Ek julle aanbring, ja, in die tyd wanneer Ek julle versamel; want Ek maak julle tot ’n roem en tot ’n lof onder al die volke van die aarde, wanneer Ek voor julle oë julle lot verander, sê die HERE.

kjv_text: In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, in the first day of the month, came the word of the LORD by Haggai the prophet unto Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, saying,
bsb_text: In the second year of the reign of Darius, on the first day of the sixth month, the word of the LORD came through Haggai the prophet to Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, stating
aov_text: IN die tweede jaar van koning Daríus, op die eerste dag van die sesde maand, het die woord van die HERE deur die diens van die profeet Haggai gekom tot Serubbábel, die seun van Seáltiël, die goewerneur van Juda, en tot Josua, die seun van Jósadak, die hoëpriester, en gesê:

kjv_text: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, saying, This people say, The time is not come, the time that the LORD's house should be built.
bsb_text: that this is what the LORD of Hosts says: “These people say, ‘The time has not yet come to rebuild the house of the LORD.’”
aov_text: So spreek die HERE van die leërskare: Hierdie volk sê: Nog het die tyd nie gekom, die tyd dat die huis van die HERE gebou moet word nie.

kjv_text: Then came the word of the LORD by Haggai the prophet, saying,
bsb_text: Then the word of the LORD came through Haggai the prophet, saying:
aov_text: So het die woord van die HERE dan gekom deur die diens van die profeet Haggai en gesê:

kjv_text: Is it time for you, O ye, to dwell in your cieled houses, and this house lie waste?
bsb_text: “Is it a time for you yourselves to live in your paneled houses, while this house lies in ruins?”
aov_text: Is dit vir julle self wel tyd om in julle betimmerde huise te woon, terwyl hierdie huis in puin lê?

kjv_text: Now therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts; Consider your ways.
bsb_text: Now this is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Consider carefully your ways.
aov_text: So sê die HERE van die leërskare dan nou: Gee ag op wat julle wedervaar het:

kjv_text: Ye have sown much, and bring in little; ye eat, but ye have not enough; ye drink, but ye are not filled with drink; ye clothe you, but there is none warm; and he that earneth wages earneth wages to put it into a bag with holes.
bsb_text: You have planted much but harvested little. You eat but never have enough. You drink but never have your fill. You put on clothes but never get warm. You earn wages to put into a bag pierced through.”
aov_text: julle het baie gesaai, maar min ingebring; julle het geëet, maar nie tot versadiging nie; julle het gedrink, maar nie genoeg gekry nie; julle het jul geklee, maar nie warm geword nie; en wie hom vir loon verhuur, verhuur hom om dit in ’n stukkende beurs te steek.

kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Consider your ways.
bsb_text: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Consider carefully your ways.
aov_text: So sê die HERE van die leërskare: Gee ag op wat julle wedervaar het!

kjv_text: Go up to the mountain, and bring wood, and build the house; and I will take pleasure in it, and I will be glorified, saith the LORD.
bsb_text: Go up into the hills, bring down lumber, and build the house, so that I may take pleasure in it and be glorified, says the LORD.
aov_text: Klim op die berg en bring hout aan en bou die huis; dan sal Ek ’n welgevalle daaraan hê en My verheerlik, sê die HERE.

kjv_text: Ye looked for much, and lo, it came to little; and when ye brought it home, I did blow upon it. Why? saith the LORD of hosts. Because of mine house that is waste, and ye run every man unto his own house.
bsb_text: You expected much, but behold, it amounted to little. And what you brought home, I blew away. Why? declares the LORD of Hosts. Because My house still lies in ruins, while each of you is busy with his own house.
aov_text: Julle het uitgesien na baie, en kyk, dit het min geword; en julle het dit in die huis gebring, maar Ek het dit weggeblaas. Waarom? spreek die HERE van die leërskare. Ter wille van my huis wat in puin lê, terwyl elkeen van julle vir sy eie huis hardloop.

kjv_text: Therefore the heaven over you is stayed from dew, and the earth is stayed from her fruit.
bsb_text: Therefore, on account of you the heavens have withheld their dew and the earth has withheld its crops.
aov_text: Daarom het die hemel bo julle die dou ingehou en die aarde het sy opbrings teruggehou.

kjv_text: And I called for a drought upon the land, and upon the mountains, and upon the corn, and upon the new wine, and upon the oil, and upon that which the ground bringeth forth, and upon men, and upon cattle, and upon all the labour of the hands.
bsb_text: I have summoned a drought on the fields and on the mountains, on the grain, new wine, and oil, and on whatever the ground yields, on man and beast, and on all the labor of your hands.”
aov_text: En Ek het droogte oor die land geroep en oor die berge en oor die koring en oor die mos en oor die olie en oor alles wat die grond oplewer; en oor die mense en oor die diere en oor alle arbeid van die hande.

kjv_text: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, with all the remnant of the people, obeyed the voice of the LORD their God, and the words of Haggai the prophet, as the LORD their God had sent him, and the people did fear before the LORD.
bsb_text: Then Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, as well as all the remnant of the people, obeyed the voice of the LORD their God and the words of the prophet Haggai, because the LORD their God had sent him. So the people feared the LORD.
aov_text: Toe het Serubbábel, die seun van Seáltiël, en Josua, die seun van Jósadak, die hoëpriester, en die hele oorblyfsel van die volk gehoor gegee aan die stem van die HERE hulle God en aan die woorde van Haggai, die profeet, volgens die opdrag waarmee die HERE hulle God hom gestuur het; en die volk was vervul met vrees voor die aangesig van die HERE.

kjv_text: Then spake Haggai the LORD's messenger in the LORD's message unto the people, saying, I am with you, saith the LORD.
bsb_text: Haggai, the messenger of the LORD, delivered the message of the LORD to the people: “I am with you,” declares the LORD.
aov_text: Daarop het Haggai, die boodskapper van die HERE, kragtens die boodskap van die HERE, met die volk gespreek en gesê: Ek is met julle, spreek die HERE.

kjv_text: And the LORD stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people; and they came and did work in the house of the LORD of hosts, their God,
bsb_text: So the LORD stirred the spirit of Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, as well as the spirit of all the remnant of the people. And they came and began the work on the house of the LORD of Hosts, their God,
aov_text: En die HERE het die gees van Serubbábel, die seun van Seáltiël, die goewerneur van Juda, en die gees van Josua, die seun van Jósadak, die hoëpriester, en die gees van die hele oorblyfsel van die volk opgewek. En toe het hulle gekom en die werk begin aan die huis van die HERE van die leërskare, hulle God.

kjv_text: In the four and twentieth day of the sixth month, in the second year of Darius the king.
bsb_text: on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month, in the second year of King Darius.
aov_text: Dit was op die vier-en-twintigste dag van die sesde maand, in die tweede jaar van koning Daríus.

kjv_text: In the seventh month, in the one and twentieth day of the month, came the word of the LORD by the prophet Haggai, saying,
bsb_text: On the twenty-first day of the seventh month, the word of the LORD came through Haggai the prophet, saying:
aov_text: OP die een-en-twintigste dag van die sewende maand het die woord van die HERE deur die diens van die profeet Haggai gekom en gesê:

kjv_text: Speak now to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, and to the residue of the people, saying,
bsb_text: “Speak to Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and also to the remnant of the people. Ask them,
aov_text: Spreek tog met Serubbábel, die seun van Seáltiël, die goewerneur van Juda, en met Josua, die seun van Jósadak, die hoëpriester, en met die oorblyfsel van die volk en sê:

kjv_text: Who is left among you that saw this house in her first glory? and how do ye see it now? is it not in your eyes in comparison of it as nothing?
bsb_text: ‘Who is left among you who saw this house in its former glory? How does it look to you now? Does it not appear to you like nothing in comparison?’
aov_text: Wie is onder julle nog oor wat hierdie huis in sy vroeëre heerlikheid gesien het? En hoedanig sien julle dit nou? Lyk dit nie net soos niks in julle oë nie?

kjv_text: Yet now be strong, O Zerubbabel, saith the LORD; and be strong, O Joshua, son of Josedech, the high priest; and be strong, all ye people of the land, saith the LORD, and work: for I am with you, saith the LORD of hosts:
bsb_text: But now be strong, O Zerubbabel, declares the LORD. Be strong, O Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest. And be strong, all you people of the land, declares the LORD. Work! For I am with you, declares the LORD of Hosts.
aov_text: Nou dan, skep moed, Serubbábel, spreek die HERE, en skep moed, Josua, hoëpriester, seun van Jósadak, en skep moed, julle almal, volk van die land, spreek die HERE, en werk! Want Ek is met julle, spreek die HERE van die leërskare,

kjv_text: According to the word that I covenanted with you when ye came out of Egypt, so my spirit remaineth among you: fear ye not.
bsb_text: This is the promise I made to you when you came out of Egypt. And My Spirit remains among you; do not be afraid.”
aov_text: met betrekking tot die verbond wat Ek met julle gesluit het by julle uittog uit Egipteland, en my Gees sal in julle midde bestendig bly; wees nie bevrees nie!

kjv_text: For thus saith the LORD of hosts; Yet once, it is a little while, and I will shake the heavens, and the earth, and the sea, and the dry land;
bsb_text: For this is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Once more, in a little while, I will shake the heavens and the earth, the sea and the dry land.
aov_text: Want so sê die HERE van die leërskare: ’n Rukkie nog, ’n kort tydjie, dan sal Ek die hemel en die aarde en die see en die droë grond laat bewe.

kjv_text: And I will shake all nations, and the desire of all nations shall come: and I will fill this house with glory, saith the LORD of hosts.
bsb_text: I will shake all the nations, and they will come with all their treasures, and I will fill this house with glory, says the LORD of Hosts.
aov_text: Ek sal ook al die nasies laat bewe, sodat die skatte van al die nasies sal toevloei; en Ek sal hierdie huis met heerlikheid vervul, sê die HERE van die leërskare.

kjv_text: The silver is mine, and the gold is mine, saith the LORD of hosts.
bsb_text: The silver is Mine, and the gold is Mine, declares the LORD of Hosts.
aov_text: Aan My behoort die silwer en aan My die goud, spreek die HERE van die leërskare.

kjv_text: The glory of this latter house shall be greater than of the former, saith the LORD of hosts: and in this place will I give peace, saith the LORD of hosts.
bsb_text: The latter glory of this house will be greater than the former, says the LORD of Hosts. And in this place I will provide peace, declares the LORD of Hosts.”
aov_text: Die toekomstige heerlikheid van hierdie huis sal groter wees as die vroeëre, sê die HERE van die leërskare; en op hierdie plek sal Ek vrede gee, spreek die HERE van die leërskare.

kjv_text: In the four and twentieth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the LORD by Haggai the prophet, saying,
bsb_text: On the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, the word of the LORD came to Haggai the prophet, saying,
aov_text: Op die vier-en-twintigste van die negende maand in die tweede jaar van Daríus, het die woord van die HERE gekom deur die diens van die profeet Haggai en gesê:

kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Ask now the priests concerning the law, saying,
bsb_text: “This is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘Ask the priests for a ruling.
aov_text: So sê die HERE van die leërskare: Vra tog aan die priesters inligting uit die wet en sê:

kjv_text: If one bear holy flesh in the skirt of his garment, and with his skirt do touch bread, or pottage, or wine, or oil, or any meat, shall it be holy? And the priests answered and said, No.
bsb_text: If a man carries consecrated meat in the fold of his garment, and it touches bread, stew, wine, oil, or any other food, does that item become holy?’” “No,” replied the priests.
aov_text: As iemand heilige vleis in die slip van sy kleed dra, en hy sou met sy slip aan brood raak of iets wat gekook is, of wyn of olie of watter spys ook al, sal dit heilig word? En die priesters het geantwoord en gesê: Nee.

kjv_text: Then said Haggai, If one that is unclean by a dead body touch any of these, shall it be unclean? And the priests answered and said, It shall be unclean.
bsb_text: So Haggai asked, “If one who is defiled by contact with a corpse touches any of these, does it become defiled?” “Yes, it becomes defiled,” the priests answered.
aov_text: Daarop sê Haggai: As iemand wat deur ’n lyk verontreinig is, aan al hierdie dinge sou raak, sal dit onrein wees? En die priesters het geantwoord en gesê: Dit sal onrein wees.

kjv_text: Then answered Haggai, and said, So is this people, and so is this nation before me, saith the LORD; and so is every work of their hands; and that which they offer there is unclean.
bsb_text: Then Haggai replied, “So it is with this people and this nation before Me, declares the LORD, and so it is with every work of their hands; whatever they offer there is defiled.
aov_text: Toe antwoord Haggai en sê: Só is in my oë hierdie volk en só hierdie nasie, spreek die HERE, en só is al die werk van hulle hande en wat hulle dáár offer—onrein is dit.

kjv_text: And now, I pray you, consider from this day and upward, from before a stone was laid upon a stone in the temple of the LORD:
bsb_text: Now consider carefully from this day forward: Before one stone was placed on another in the temple of the LORD,
aov_text: Merk dan nou tog op, van hierdie dag af terug! Voordat hulle steen op steen gelê het in die tempel van die HERE,

kjv_text: Since those days were, when one came to an heap of twenty measures, there were but ten: when one came to the pressfat for to draw out fifty vessels out of the press, there were but twenty.
bsb_text: from that time, when one came expecting a heap of twenty ephahs of grain, there were but ten. When one came to the winepress to draw out fifty baths, there were but twenty.
aov_text: in dié tyd het iemand gekom by ’n koringmied van twintig maat, en daar was maar tien; hy het gekom by die parskuip om vyftig emmers te skep, en daar was maar twintig.

kjv_text: I smote you with blasting and with mildew and with hail in all the labours of your hands; yet ye turned not to me, saith the LORD.
bsb_text: I struck you—all the work of your hands—with blight, mildew, and hail, but you did not turn to Me, declares the LORD.
aov_text: Ek het julle swaar getref met brandkoring en heuningdou en hael—al die werk van julle hande—nogtans het niemand van julle hom tot My gewend nie, spreek die HERE.

kjv_text: Consider now from this day and upward, from the four and twentieth day of the ninth month, even from the day that the foundation of the LORD's temple was laid, consider it.
bsb_text: Consider carefully from this day forward—from the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, the day the foundation of the LORD’s temple was laid—consider carefully:
aov_text: Merk tog op, van hierdie dag af terug, van die vier-en-twintigste dag van die negende maand, naamlik van die dag af toe hulle die fondament van die tempel van die HERE gelê het; merk op:

kjv_text: Is the seed yet in the barn? yea, as yet the vine, and the fig tree, and the pomegranate, and the olive tree, hath not brought forth: from this day will I bless you.
bsb_text: Is there still seed in the barn? The vine, the fig, the pomegranate, and the olive tree have not yet yielded fruit. But from this day on, I will bless you.”
aov_text: Is daar nog saad in die skuur? Ja, selfs die wingerdstok en die vyeboom en die granaatboom en die olyfboom het niks opgelewer nie. Van hierdie dag af sal Ek seën.

kjv_text: And again the word of the LORD came unto Haggai in the four and twentieth day of the month, saying,
bsb_text: For the second time that day, the twenty-fourth day of the month, the word of the LORD came to Haggai, saying,
aov_text: Vir die tweede maal het die woord van die HERE tot Haggai gekom op die vier-en-twintigste van die maand en gesê:

kjv_text: Speak to Zerubbabel, governor of Judah, saying, I will shake the heavens and the earth;
bsb_text: “Tell Zerubbabel governor of Judah that I am about to shake the heavens and the earth:
aov_text: Spreek met Serubbábel, die goewerneur van Juda, en sê: Ek sal die hemel en die aarde laat bewe.

kjv_text: And I will overthrow the throne of kingdoms, and I will destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the heathen; and I will overthrow the chariots, and those that ride in them; and the horses and their riders shall come down, every one by the sword of his brother.
bsb_text: I will overturn royal thrones and destroy the power of the kingdoms of the nations. I will overturn chariots and their riders; horses and their riders will fall, each by the sword of his brother.
aov_text: En Ek sal die koningstrone omverwerp en die mag van die heidense koninkryke verdelg; en Ek sal die strydwaens en die wat daarop ry, omverwerp, en die perde en hulle ruiters sal val, die een deur die swaard van die ander.

kjv_text: In that day, saith the LORD of hosts, will I take thee, O Zerubbabel, my servant, the son of Shealtiel, saith the LORD, and will make thee as a signet: for I have chosen thee, saith the LORD of hosts.
bsb_text: On that day, declares the LORD of Hosts, I will take you, My servant, Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, declares the LORD, and I will make you like My signet ring, for I have chosen you, declares the LORD of Hosts.”
aov_text: In dié dag, spreek die HERE van die leërskare, sal Ek jou neem, Serubbábel, seun van Seáltiël, my kneg, spreek die HERE, en jou maak tot ’n seëlring, want jou het Ek verkies, spreek die HERE van die leërskare.

kjv_text: In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the LORD unto Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo the prophet, saying,
bsb_text: In the eighth month of the second year of Darius, the word of the LORD came to the prophet Zechariah son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo, saying:
aov_text: IN die agtste maand, in die tweede jaar van Daríus, het die woord van die HERE gekom tot Sagaría, die seun van Berégja, die seun van Iddo, die profeet, en gesê:

kjv_text: The LORD hath been sore displeased with your fathers.
bsb_text: “The LORD was very angry with your fathers.
aov_text: Die HERE was baie vertoornd op julle vaders.

kjv_text: Therefore say thou unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Turn ye unto me, saith the LORD of hosts, and I will turn unto you, saith the LORD of hosts.
bsb_text: So tell the people that this is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘Return to Me, declares the LORD of Hosts, and I will return to you, says the LORD of Hosts.’
aov_text: So moet jy dan aan hulle sê: So spreek die HERE van die leërskare: Keer terug na My, spreek die HERE van die leërskare, en Ek sal na julle terugkeer, sê die HERE van die leërskare.

kjv_text: Be ye not as your fathers, unto whom the former prophets have cried, saying, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Turn ye now from your evil ways, and from your evil doings: but they did not hear, nor hearken unto me, saith the LORD.
bsb_text: Do not be like your fathers, to whom the former prophets proclaimed that this is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘Turn now from your evil ways and deeds.’ But they did not listen or pay attention to Me, declares the LORD.
aov_text: Moenie soos julle vaders wees nie, tot wie die vroeëre profete geroep en gesê het: So sê die HERE van die leërskare: Bekeer julle tog van julle bose weë en julle bose werke; maar hulle het nie gehoor en na My nie geluister nie, spreek die HERE.

kjv_text: Your fathers, where are they? and the prophets, do they live for ever?
bsb_text: Where are your fathers now? And the prophets, do they live forever?
aov_text: Julle vaders—waar is hulle? En sal die profete vir ewig lewe?

kjv_text: But my words and my statutes, which I commanded my servants the prophets, did they not take hold of your fathers? and they returned and said, Like as the LORD of hosts thought to do unto us, according to our ways, and according to our doings, so hath he dealt with us.
bsb_text: But did not My words and My statutes, which I commanded My servants the prophets, overtake your fathers? They repented and said, ‘Just as the LORD of Hosts purposed to do to us according to our ways and deeds, so He has done to us.’”
aov_text: Maar my woorde en my insettinge wat Ek my knegte, die profete, beveel het, het dit julle vaders nie ingehaal nie, sodat hulle tot inkeer gekom en gesê het: Soos die HERE van die leërskare Hom voorgeneem het om aan ons te doen ooreenkomstig ons weë en ons werke, so het Hy met ons gedoen?

kjv_text: Upon the four and twentieth day of the eleventh month, which is the month Sebat, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the LORD unto Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo the prophet, saying,
bsb_text: On the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh month, the month of Shebat, in the second year of Darius, the word of the LORD came to the prophet Zechariah son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo.
aov_text: OP die vier-en-twintigste dag van die elfde maand, dit is die maand Sebat, in die tweede jaar van Daríus, het die woord van die HERE tot die profeet Sagaría, die seun van Berégja, die seun van Iddo, gekom en gesê:

kjv_text: I saw by night, and behold a man riding upon a red horse, and he stood among the myrtle trees that were in the bottom; and behind him were there red horses, speckled, and white.
bsb_text: I looked out into the night and saw a man riding on a red horse. He was standing among the myrtle trees in the hollow, and behind him were red, sorrel, and white horses.
aov_text: Ek het in die nag ’n gesig gesien—daar was ’n man wat op ’n bruin perd ry, en hy het gestaan tussen die mirtebome wat in die diepte was; en agter hom was daar bruin, vos en wit perde.

kjv_text: Then said I, O my lord, what are these? And the angel that talked with me said unto me, I will shew thee what these be.
bsb_text: “What are these, my lord?” I asked. And the angel who was speaking with me replied, “I will show you what they are.”
aov_text: Toe sê ek: Wat beteken dit, my heer? En die engel wat met my gespreek het, antwoord my: Ek sal jou toon wat dit beteken.

kjv_text: And the man that stood among the myrtle trees answered and said, These are they whom the LORD hath sent to walk to and fro through the earth.
bsb_text: Then the man standing among the myrtle trees explained, “They are the ones the LORD has sent to patrol the earth.”
aov_text: En die man wat tussen die mirtebome gestaan het, het aangehef en gesê: Dit is hulle wat die HERE gestuur het om die aarde te deurkruis.

kjv_text: And they answered the angel of the LORD that stood among the myrtle trees, and said, We have walked to and fro through the earth, and, behold, all the earth sitteth still, and is at rest.
bsb_text: And the riders answered the angel of the LORD who was standing among the myrtle trees, “We have patrolled the earth, and behold, all the earth is at rest and tranquil.”
aov_text: Daarop het hulle die Engel van die HERE, wat tussen die mirtebome gestaan het, toegespreek en gesê: Ons het die aarde deurkruis, en kyk, die ganse aarde is stil en rustig.

kjv_text: Then the angel of the LORD answered and said, O LORD of hosts, how long wilt thou not have mercy on Jerusalem and on the cities of Judah, against which thou hast had indignation these threescore and ten years?
bsb_text: Then the angel of the LORD said, “How long, O LORD of Hosts, will You withhold mercy from Jerusalem and the cities of Judah, with which You have been angry these seventy years?”
aov_text: Daarop het die Engel van die HERE aangehef en gesê: HERE van die leërskare, hoe lank nog bly U sonder ontferming oor Jerusalem en oor die stede van Juda waarop U alreeds sewentig jaar vertoornd was?

kjv_text: And the LORD answered the angel that talked with me with good words and comfortable words.
bsb_text: So the LORD spoke kind and comforting words to the angel who was speaking with me.
aov_text: Toe antwoord die HERE die engel wat met my gespreek het, goeie woorde, troosvolle woorde.

kjv_text: So the angel that communed with me said unto me, Cry thou, saying, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; I am jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with a great jealousy.
bsb_text: Then the angel who was speaking with me said, “Proclaim this word: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘I am very jealous for Jerusalem and Zion,
aov_text: Daarop sê die engel wat met my gespreek het: Roep en sê: So spreek die HERE van die leërskare: Ek ywer oor Jerusalem en oor Sion met ’n groot ywer;

kjv_text: And I am very sore displeased with the heathen that are at ease: for I was but a little displeased, and they helped forward the affliction.
bsb_text: but I am fiercely angry with the nations that are at ease. For I was a little angry, but they have added to the calamity.’
aov_text: maar Ek is grootliks vertoornd oor die sorglose nasies wat, terwyl Ek ’n weinig vertoornd was, die onheil aangehelp het.

kjv_text: Therefore thus saith the LORD; I am returned to Jerusalem with mercies: my house shall be built in it, saith the LORD of hosts, and a line shall be stretched forth upon Jerusalem.
bsb_text: Therefore this is what the LORD says: ‘I will return to Jerusalem with mercy, and there My house will be rebuilt, declares the LORD of Hosts, and a measuring line will be stretched out over Jerusalem.’
aov_text: Daarom, so sê die HERE: Ek wend My met ontferming tot Jerusalem; my huis sal daarin gebou word, spreek die HERE van die leërskare, en ’n meetsnoer oor Jerusalem gespan word.

kjv_text: Cry yet, saying, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; My cities through prosperity shall yet be spread abroad; and the LORD shall yet comfort Zion, and shall yet choose Jerusalem.
bsb_text: Proclaim further that this is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘My cities will again overflow with prosperity; the LORD will again comfort Zion and choose Jerusalem.’”
aov_text: Roep verder en sê: So spreek die HERE van die leërskare: My stede sal weer oorstroom wees van goeie dinge, en die HERE sal Sion weer vertroos, en Hy sal Jerusalem weer verkies.

kjv_text: Then lifted I up mine eyes, and saw, and behold four horns.
bsb_text: Then I looked up and saw four horns.
aov_text: EN ek het my oë opgeslaan en gekyk—daar was vier horings.

kjv_text: And I said unto the angel that talked with me, What be these? And he answered me, These are the horns which have scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem.
bsb_text: So I asked the angel who was speaking with me, “What are these?” And he told me, “These are the horns that have scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem.”
aov_text: Toe sê ek aan die engel wat met my gespreek het: Wat beteken dit? En hy antwoord my: Dit is die horings wat Juda, Israel en Jerusalem verstrooi het.

kjv_text: And the LORD shewed me four carpenters.
bsb_text: Then the LORD showed me four craftsmen.
aov_text: Daarop toon die HERE my vier smede.

kjv_text: Then said I, What come these to do? And he spake, saying, These are the horns which have scattered Judah, so that no man did lift up his head: but these are come to fray them, to cast out the horns of the Gentiles, which lifted up their horn over the land of Judah to scatter it.
bsb_text: “What are these coming to do?” I asked. And He replied, “These are the horns that scattered Judah so that no one could raise his head; but the craftsmen have come to terrify them and throw down these horns of the nations that have lifted up their horns against the land of Judah to scatter it.”
aov_text: Toe sê ek: Wat kom hulle maak? En Hy antwoord en sê: Dit is die horings wat Juda só verstrooi het dat niemand sy hoof opgehef het nie; maar hierdie manne het gekom om hulle skrik aan te jaag, om die horings van die nasies neer te werp wat die horing teen die land van Juda opgesteek het om dit te verstrooi.

kjv_text: I lifted up mine eyes again, and looked, and behold a man with a measuring line in his hand.

aov_text: EN ek het my oë opgehef en gekyk—daar was ’n man met ’n meetsnoer in sy hand.

kjv_text: Then said I, Whither goest thou? And he said unto me, To measure Jerusalem, to see what is the breadth thereof, and what is the length thereof.

aov_text: Toe sê ek: Waar gaan u heen? En hy antwoord my: Om Jerusalem te meet, om te sien wat sy breedte en wat sy lengte is.

bsb_text: Then the angel who was speaking with me went out, and another angel came out to meet him
aov_text: En meteens kom die engel wat met my gespreek het, vorentoe; en ’n ander engel het te voorskyn gekom, hom tegemoet,

aov_text: aan wie hy sê: Loop gou, spreek met die jongman en sê: Jerusalem sal lê soos ’n oop land weens die menigte van mense en vee daar binne-in.

kjv_text: For I, saith the LORD, will be unto her a wall of fire round about, and will be the glory in the midst of her.
bsb_text: For I will be a wall of fire around it, declares the LORD, and I will be the glory within it.’”
aov_text: En Ek sal vir hom wees, spreek die HERE, ’n vurige muur rondom en tot heerlikheid daar binne-in.

kjv_text: Ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north, saith the LORD: for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven, saith the LORD.
bsb_text: “Get up! Get up! Flee from the land of the north,” declares the LORD, “for I have scattered you like the four winds of heaven,” declares the LORD.
aov_text: Op, op, vlug uit die Noordland, spreek die HERE! Want Ek het julle na die vier windstreke van die hemel verstrooi, spreek die HERE.

kjv_text: Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon.
bsb_text: “Get up, O Zion! Escape, you who dwell with the Daughter of Babylon!”
aov_text: Op, o Sion, red jouself, jy wat woon by die dogter van Babel!

kjv_text: For thus saith the LORD of hosts; After the glory hath he sent me unto the nations which spoiled you: for he that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye.
bsb_text: For this is what the LORD of Hosts says: “After His Glory has sent Me against the nations that have plundered you—for whoever touches you touches the apple of His eye—
aov_text: Want so sê die HERE van die leërskare: Hy het my gestuur agter heerlikheid aan na die nasies wat julle uitgebuit het; want wie julle aanraak, raak sý oogappel aan.

kjv_text: For, behold, I will shake mine hand upon them, and they shall be a spoil to their servants: and ye shall know that the LORD of hosts hath sent me.

aov_text: Want kyk, Ek sal my hand oor hulle swaai, sodat hulle ’n buit word vir hulle knegte. Dan sal julle weet dat die HERE van die leërskare my gestuur het.

kjv_text: Sing and rejoice, O daughter of Zion: for, lo, I come, and I will dwell in the midst of thee, saith the LORD.
bsb_text: “Shout for joy and be glad, O Daughter of Zion, for I am coming to dwell among you,” declares the LORD.
aov_text: Jubel, en wees bly, o dogter van Sion! Want kyk, Ek kom om in jou midde te woon, spreek die HERE.

kjv_text: And many nations shall be joined to the LORD in that day, and shall be my people: and I will dwell in the midst of thee, and thou shalt know that the LORD of hosts hath sent me unto thee.

aov_text: En baie nasies sal hulle in dié dag by die HERE aansluit, en hulle sal My tot ’n volk wees; en Ek sal in jou midde woon. Dan sal jy weet dat die HERE van die leërskare my na jou gestuur het.

kjv_text: And the LORD shall inherit Judah his portion in the holy land, and shall choose Jerusalem again.

kjv_text: Be silent, O all flesh, before the LORD: for he is raised up out of his holy habitation.
bsb_text: Be silent before the LORD, all people, for He has roused Himself from His holy dwelling.”
aov_text: Swyg alle vlees voor die HERE! Want Hy verhef Hom uit sy heilige woning.

kjv_text: And he shewed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of the LORD, and Satan standing at his right hand to resist him.
bsb_text: Then the angel showed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of the LORD, with Satan standing at his right hand to accuse him.
aov_text: DAARNA het Hy my Josua, die hoëpriester, laat sien, terwyl hy voor die Engel van die HERE staan, en die Satan aan sy regterhand staan om hom aan te klae.

kjv_text: And the LORD said unto Satan, The LORD rebuke thee, O Satan; even the LORD that hath chosen Jerusalem rebuke thee: is not this a brand plucked out of the fire?
bsb_text: And the LORD said to Satan: “The LORD rebukes you, Satan! Indeed, the LORD, who has chosen Jerusalem, rebukes you! Is not this man a firebrand snatched from the fire?”
aov_text: Toe sê die HERE aan die Satan: Mag die HERE jou bestraf, o Satan! Ja, mag die HERE, wat Jerusalem verkies het, jou bestraf! Is hierdie een nie ’n brandhout wat uit die vuur geruk is nie?

kjv_text: Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments, and stood before the angel.
bsb_text: Now Joshua was dressed in filthy garments as he stood before the angel.
aov_text: En Josua was bekleed met vuil klere, terwyl hy voor die Engel staan.

kjv_text: And he answered and spake unto those that stood before him, saying, Take away the filthy garments from him. And unto him he said, Behold, I have caused thine iniquity to pass from thee, and I will clothe thee with change of raiment.

aov_text: Daarop het Hy aangehef en gesê aan die wat voor Hom staan: Neem die vuil klere van hom weg. Toe sê Hy vir hom: Kyk, Ek het jou skuld van jou weggeneem, en Ek beklee jou met feesklere.

kjv_text: And I said, Let them set a fair mitre upon his head. So they set a fair mitre upon his head, and clothed him with garments. And the angel of the LORD stood by.
bsb_text: Then I said, “Let them put a clean turban on his head.” So a clean turban was placed on his head, and they clothed him, as the angel of the LORD stood by.
aov_text: Daarop sê ek: Laat hulle ’n rein tulband op sy hoof sit. En hulle het die rein tulband op sy hoof gesit en hom die klere aangetrek, terwyl die Engel van die HERE daarby staan.

kjv_text: And the angel of the LORD protested unto Joshua, saying,

aov_text: En die Engel van die HERE het Josua plegtig verseker en gesê:

kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; If thou wilt walk in my ways, and if thou wilt keep my charge, then thou shalt also judge my house, and shalt also keep my courts, and I will give thee places to walk among these that stand by.

aov_text: So sê die HERE van die leërskare: As jy in my weë wandel en as jy my verordening onderhou, dan sal jy my huis bestuur sowel as my voorhowe bewaak, en Ek sal jou vrye toegang verleen onder diegene wat hier staan.

aov_text: In dié dag, spreek die HERE van die leërskare, sal julle mekaar uitnooi onder die wingerdstok en onder die vyeboom.

kjv_text: And two olive trees by it, one upon the right side of the bowl, and the other upon the left side thereof.

aov_text: Ook twee olyfbome langs hom, een aan die regterkant van die oliekan en een aan die linkerkant daarvan.

aov_text: Daarop het ek begin spreek en aan die engel wat met my gespreek het, gesê: Wat beteken dit, my heer?

aov_text: Wie is jy, groot berg? Voor Serubbábel sal jy tot ’n gelykte word! En hy sal die sluitsteen te voorskyn bring onder uitroepe van: Genade, genade oor hom!

aov_text: En hy het vir my gesê: Wat sien jy? Toe antwoord ek: Ek sien ’n vlieënde boekrol, sy lengte is twintig el en sy breedte tien el.

kjv_text: I will bring it forth, saith the LORD of hosts, and it shall enter into the house of the thief, and into the house of him that sweareth falsely by my name: and it shall remain in the midst of his house, and shall consume it with the timber thereof and the stones thereof.

bsb_text: And you are to tell him that this is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘Here is a man whose name is the Branch, and He will branch out from His place and build the temple of the LORD.
aov_text: en sê vir hom dít: So spreek die HERE van die leërskare: Kyk, daar kom ’n Man wie se Naam is Spruit, en Hy sal uit sy plek uitspruit, en Hy sal die tempel van die HERE bou.

kjv_text: Even he shall build the temple of the LORD; and he shall bear the glory, and shall sit and rule upon his throne; and he shall be a priest upon his throne: and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.
bsb_text: Yes, He will build the temple of the LORD; He will be clothed in splendor and will sit on His throne and rule. And He will be a priest on His throne, and there will be peaceful counsel between the two.’
aov_text: Ja, Hý sal die tempel van die HERE bou, en Hý sal majesteit verkry en sit en heers op sy troon; ook sal Hy ’n priester wees op sy troon, en die raad van vrede sal tussen hulle twee bestaan.

kjv_text: And the crowns shall be to Helem, and to Tobijah, and to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in the temple of the LORD.
bsb_text: The crown will reside in the temple of the LORD as a memorial to Helem, Tobijah, Jedaiah, and the gracious son of Zephaniah.
aov_text: En die kroon moet as gedagtenis bly aan Helem en Tobía en Jedája, en aan die vriendelikheid van die seun van Sefánja in die tempel van die HERE.

kjv_text: And they that are far off shall come and build in the temple of the LORD, and ye shall know that the LORD of hosts hath sent me unto you. And this shall come to pass, if ye will diligently obey the voice of the LORD your God.
bsb_text: Even those far away will come and build the temple of the LORD, and you will know that the LORD of Hosts has sent Me to you. This will happen if you diligently obey the voice of the LORD your God.”
aov_text: En die wat ver is, sal kom en aan die tempel van die HERE bou. Dan sal julle weet dat die HERE van die leërskare my na julle gestuur het. En dit sal so wees, as julle nougeset luister na die stem van die HERE julle God.

kjv_text: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Darius, that the word of the LORD came unto Zechariah in the fourth day of the ninth month, even in Chisleu;
bsb_text: In the fourth year of King Darius, the word of the LORD came to Zechariah on the fourth day of the ninth month, the month of Chislev.
aov_text: EN in die vierde jaar van koning Daríus het die woord van die HERE tot Sagaría gekom, op die vierde dag van die negende maand, in die maand Kislew.

kjv_text: When they had sent unto the house of God Sherezer and Regemmelech, and their men, to pray before the LORD,
bsb_text: Now the people of Bethel had sent Sharezer and Regem-melech, along with their men, to plead before the LORD
aov_text: Bet-el het toe Saréser en Regem-Meleg met sy manne gestuur om die aangesig van die HERE om genade te smeek

kjv_text: And to speak unto the priests which were in the house of the LORD of hosts, and to the prophets, saying, Should I weep in the fifth month, separating myself, as I have done these so many years?
bsb_text: by asking the priests of the house of the LORD of Hosts, as well as the prophets, “Should I weep and fast in the fifth month, as I have done these many years?”
aov_text: deur aan die priesters wat by die huis van die HERE van die leërskare was, en aan die profete die vraag te stel: Moet ek in die vyfde maand ween met vas soos ek nou al so baie jare gedoen het?

kjv_text: Then came the word of the LORD of hosts unto me, saying,
bsb_text: Then the word of the LORD of Hosts came to me, saying,
aov_text: Daarop het die woord van die HERE van die leërskare tot my gekom en gesê:

kjv_text: Speak unto all the people of the land, and to the priests, saying, When ye fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh month, even those seventy years, did ye at all fast unto me, even to me?
bsb_text: “Ask all the people of the land and the priests, ‘When you fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh months for these seventy years, was it really for Me that you fasted?
aov_text: Spreek tot die hele volk van die land en tot die priesters dít: As julle, nou sewentig jaar lank, in die vyfde en in die sewende maand gevas en getreur het, het julle toe werklik ter wille van My gevas?

kjv_text: And when ye did eat, and when ye did drink, did not ye eat for yourselves, and drink for yourselves?
bsb_text: And when you were eating and drinking, were you not doing so simply for yourselves?
aov_text: En as julle eet en julle drink, is dit dan nie júlle wat eet en júlle wat drink nie?

kjv_text: Should ye not hear the words which the LORD hath cried by the former prophets, when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity, and the cities thereof round about her, when men inhabited the south and the plain?
bsb_text: Are these not the words that the LORD proclaimed through the earlier prophets, when Jerusalem and its surrounding towns were populous and prosperous, and the Negev and the foothills were inhabited?’”
aov_text: Is dit nie so met die woorde wat die HERE deur die diens van die vroeëre profete verkondig het nie, toe Jerusalem en sy omliggende stede nog bewoond en rustig was, en ook die Suidland en die Laeveld nog bewoond was?

kjv_text: And the word of the LORD came unto Zechariah, saying,
bsb_text: Then the word of the LORD came to Zechariah, saying,
aov_text: Verder het die woord van die HERE tot Sagaría gekom en gesê:

kjv_text: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, saying, Execute true judgment, and shew mercy and compassions every man to his brother:
bsb_text: “This is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘Administer true justice. Show loving devotion and compassion to one another.
aov_text: So het die HERE van die leërskare gespreek en gesê: Spreek ’n eerlike vonnis uit en bewys liefde en barmhartigheid die een aan die ander.

kjv_text: And oppress not the widow, nor the fatherless, the stranger, nor the poor; and let none of you imagine evil against his brother in your heart.
bsb_text: Do not oppress the widow or the fatherless, the foreigner or the poor. And do not plot evil in your hearts against one another.’
aov_text: En moet nie die weduwee en die wees, die vreemdeling en die arme verdruk nie en kwaad in julle hart teenoor mekaar bedink nie.

kjv_text: But they refused to hearken, and pulled away the shoulder, and stopped their ears, that they should not hear.
bsb_text: But they refused to pay attention and turned a stubborn shoulder; they stopped up their ears from hearing.
aov_text: Maar hulle het geweier om te luister en wederstrewig die skouer afgewend en hulle ore toegestop om nie te hoor nie.

kjv_text: Yea, they made their hearts as an adamant stone, lest they should hear the law, and the words which the LORD of hosts hath sent in his spirit by the former prophets: therefore came a great wrath from the LORD of hosts.
bsb_text: They made their hearts like flint and would not listen to the law or to the words that the LORD of Hosts had sent by His Spirit through the earlier prophets. Therefore great anger came from the LORD of Hosts.
aov_text: Ook het hulle hul hart soos ’n diamant gemaak, om nie die wet te verneem nie en die woorde wat die HERE van die leërskare deur sy Gees, deur die diens van die vroeëre profete gestuur het nie. So het daar dan van die HERE van die leërskare ’n groot toorn gekom.

kjv_text: Therefore it is come to pass, that as he cried, and they would not hear; so they cried, and I would not hear, saith the LORD of hosts:
bsb_text: And just as I had called and they would not listen, so when they called I would not listen, says the LORD of Hosts.
aov_text: Daarom, soos Hy geroep en hulle nie gehoor het nie—so sal hulle roep, maar Ek nie hoor nie, het die HERE van die leërskare gesê.

kjv_text: But I scattered them with a whirlwind among all the nations whom they knew not. Thus the land was desolate after them, that no man passed through nor returned: for they laid the pleasant land desolate.
bsb_text: But I scattered them with a whirlwind among all the nations that they had not known, and the land was left desolate behind them so that no one could come or go. Thus they turned the pleasant land into a desolation.”
aov_text: Maar Ek sal hulle wegstorm onder al die nasies wat hulle nie geken het nie, terwyl die land agter hulle verwoes is, sodat niemand meer heen en weer trek nie. So het hulle dan die kostelike land tot ’n wildernis gemaak.

kjv_text: Again the word of the LORD of hosts came to me, saying,
bsb_text: Again the word of the LORD of Hosts came to me, saying:
aov_text: EN die woord van die HERE van die leërskare het gekom en gesê:

kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; I was jealous for Zion with great jealousy, and I was jealous for her with great fury.
bsb_text: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “I am jealous for Zion with great zeal; I am jealous for her with great fervor.”
aov_text: So spreek die HERE van die leërskare: Ek ywer oor Sion met ’n groot ywer, ja, Ek ywer met groot grimmigheid daarvoor.

kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD; I am returned unto Zion, and will dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and Jerusalem shall be called a city of truth; and the mountain of the LORD of hosts the holy mountain.
bsb_text: This is what the LORD says: “I will return to Zion and dwell in Jerusalem. Then Jerusalem will be called the City of Truth, and the mountain of the LORD of Hosts will be called the Holy Mountain.”
aov_text: So sê die HERE: Ek keer terug na Sion en sal midde-in Jerusalem woon; en Jerusalem sal genoem word: Die stad van trou, en die berg van die HERE van die leërskare: Die heilige berg.

kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; There shall yet old men and old women dwell in the streets of Jerusalem, and every man with his staff in his hand for very age.
bsb_text: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Old men and old women will again sit along the streets of Jerusalem, each with a staff in hand because of great age.
aov_text: So sê die HERE van die leërskare: Daar sal weer ou manne en ou vroue op die pleine van Jerusalem sit—elkeen met sy stok in sy hand vanweë die veelheid van hulle dae.

kjv_text: And the streets of the city shall be full of boys and girls playing in the streets thereof.
bsb_text: And the streets of the city will be filled with boys and girls playing there.”
aov_text: En die pleine van die stad sal vol wees van seuntjies en dogtertjies wat op die pleine daarvan speel.

kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; If it be marvellous in the eyes of the remnant of this people in these days, should it also be marvellous in mine eyes? saith the LORD of hosts.
bsb_text: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “If this is impossible in the eyes of the remnant of this people in these days, should it also be impossible in My eyes?” declares the LORD of Hosts.
aov_text: So sê die HERE van die leërskare: As dit te wonderbaar is in die oë van die oorblyfsel van hierdie volk in dié dae, sal dit ook in my oë te wonderbaar wees? spreek die HERE van die leërskare.

kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Behold, I will save my people from the east country, and from the west country;
bsb_text: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “I will save My people from the land of the east and from the land of the west.
aov_text: So sê die HERE van die leërskare: Kyk, Ek gaan my volk verlos uit die land van die ooste en uit die land van die weste

kjv_text: And I will bring them, and they shall dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God, in truth and in righteousness.
bsb_text: I will bring them back to dwell in Jerusalem, where they will be My people, and I will be their faithful and righteous God.”
aov_text: en hulle aanbring; en hulle sal midde-in Jerusalem woon. Dan sal hulle vir My ’n volk wees, en Ék sal vir hulle ’n God wees, in trou en geregtigheid.

kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Let your hands be strong, ye that hear in these days these words by the mouth of the prophets, which were in the day that the foundation of the house of the LORD of hosts was laid, that the temple might be built.
bsb_text: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Let your hands be strong, you who now hear these words spoken by the prophets who were present when the foundations were laid to rebuild the temple, the house of the LORD of Hosts.
aov_text: So sê die HERE van die leërskare: Laat julle hande sterk wees, julle wat in hierdie dae sulke woorde gehoor het uit die mond van die profete op die dag toe die fondament gelê is van die huis van die HERE van die leërskare, die tempel, om gebou te word.

kjv_text: For before these days there was no hire for man, nor any hire for beast; neither was there any peace to him that went out or came in because of the affliction: for I set all men every one against his neighbour.
bsb_text: For before those days neither man nor beast received wages, nor was there safety from the enemy for anyone who came or went, for I had turned every man against his neighbor.
aov_text: Want vóór hierdie dae het die mense geen loon getrek nie, ook vir die diere was daar geen loon nie; en vir die wat uit- en ingaan, was daar weens die teëstander geen veiligheid nie; want Ek het al die mense die een teen die ander losgelaat.

kjv_text: But now I will not be unto the residue of this people as in the former days, saith the LORD of hosts.
bsb_text: But now I will not treat the remnant of this people as I did in the past,” declares the LORD of Hosts.
aov_text: Maar nou sal Ek vir die oorblyfsel van hierdie volk nie wees soos in vroeër dae nie, spreek die HERE van die leërskare.

kjv_text: For the seed shall be prosperous; the vine shall give her fruit, and the ground shall give her increase, and the heavens shall give their dew; and I will cause the remnant of this people to possess all these things.
bsb_text: “For the seed will be prosperous, the vine will yield its fruit, the ground will yield its produce, and the skies will give their dew. To the remnant of this people I will give all these things as an inheritance.
aov_text: Want die saad van vrede, die wingerdstok, sal sy vrug gee, en die aarde sy opbrings lewer, en die hemel sal sy dou skenk; en die oorblyfsel van hierdie volk sal Ek al hierdie dinge laat beërwe.

kjv_text: And it shall come to pass, that as ye were a curse among the heathen, O house of Judah, and house of Israel; so will I save you, and ye shall be a blessing: fear not, but let your hands be strong.
bsb_text: As you have been a curse among the nations, O house of Judah and house of Israel, so I will save you, and you will be a blessing. Do not be afraid; let your hands be strong.”
aov_text: En soos julle ’n vloek gewees het onder die nasies, o huis van Juda en huis van Israel, so sal Ek julle verlos, dat julle ’n seën kan wees. Wees nie bevrees nie, laat julle hande sterk wees.

kjv_text: For thus saith the LORD of hosts; As I thought to punish you, when your fathers provoked me to wrath, saith the LORD of hosts, and I repented not:
bsb_text: For this is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Just as I resolved to bring disaster upon you when your fathers provoked Me to anger, and I did not relent,” says the LORD of Hosts,
aov_text: Want so sê die HERE van die leërskare: Soos Ek My voorgeneem het om julle kwaad aan te doen, toe julle vaders My vertoorn het, sê die HERE van die leërskare, en Ek daar geen berou van gehad het nie —

kjv_text: So again have I thought in these days to do well unto Jerusalem and to the house of Judah: fear ye not.
bsb_text: “so now I have resolved to do good again to Jerusalem and Judah. Do not be afraid.
aov_text: so het Ek My weer voorgeneem om in hierdie dae goed te doen aan Jerusalem en die huis van Juda. Wees nie bevrees nie.

kjv_text: These are the things that ye shall do; Speak ye every man the truth to his neighbour; execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates:
bsb_text: These are the things you must do: Speak truth to one another, render true and sound judgments in your gates,
aov_text: Dit is die dinge wat julle moet doen: Spreek die waarheid met mekaar; beoefen waarheid en ’n regspraak van vrede in julle poorte!

kjv_text: And let none of you imagine evil in your hearts against his neighbour; and love no false oath: for all these are things that I hate, saith the LORD.
bsb_text: do not plot evil in your hearts against your neighbor, and do not love to swear falsely, for I hate all these things,” declares the LORD.
aov_text: En julle moet nie mekaar se onheil in jul hart versin nie, en nie die valse eed liefhê nie. Want dit alles haat Ek, spreek die HERE.

kjv_text: And the word of the LORD of hosts came unto me, saying,
bsb_text: Then the word of the LORD of Hosts came to me, saying,
aov_text: En die woord van die HERE van die leërskare het tot my gekom en gesê:

kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; The fast of the fourth month, and the fast of the fifth, and the fast of the seventh, and the fast of the tenth, shall be to the house of Judah joy and gladness, and cheerful feasts; therefore love the truth and peace.
bsb_text: “This is what the LORD of Hosts says: The fasts of the fourth, the fifth, the seventh, and the tenth months will become times of joy and gladness, cheerful feasts for the house of Judah. Therefore you are to love both truth and peace.”
aov_text: So sê die HERE van die leërskare: Die vasdag in die vierde en die vasdag in die vyfde en die vasdag in die sewende en die vasdag in die tiende maand moet vir die huis van Juda ’n vreugde en blydskap wees en vrolike feestye, maar julle moet die waarheid en die vrede liefhê.

kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; It shall yet come to pass, that there shall come people, and the inhabitants of many cities:
bsb_text: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “Peoples will yet come—the residents of many cities—
aov_text: So sê die HERE van die leërskare: Nog sal volke aankom en die inwoners van baie stede.

kjv_text: And the inhabitants of one city shall go to another, saying, Let us go speedily to pray before the LORD, and to seek the LORD of hosts: I will go also.
bsb_text: and the residents of one city will go to another, saying: ‘Let us go at once to plead before the LORD and to seek the LORD of Hosts. I myself am going.’
aov_text: En die inwoners van die een stad sal gaan na die ander en sê: Kom, laat ons heengaan om die aangesig van die HERE om genade te smeek en die HERE van die leërskare te soek. Ek wil ook gaan!

kjv_text: Yea, many people and strong nations shall come to seek the LORD of hosts in Jerusalem, and to pray before the LORD.
bsb_text: And many peoples and strong nations will come to seek the LORD of Hosts in Jerusalem and to plead before the LORD.”
aov_text: So sal dan baie volke en magtige nasies kom om die HERE van die leërskare in Jerusalem te soek en die aangesig van die HERE om genade te smeek.

kjv_text: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; In those days it shall come to pass, that ten men shall take hold out of all languages of the nations, even shall take hold of the skirt of him that is a Jew, saying, We will go with you: for we have heard that God is with you.
bsb_text: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “In those days ten men from the nations of every tongue will tightly grasp the robe of a Jew, saying, ‘Let us go with you, for we have heard that God is with you.’”
aov_text: So sê die HERE van die leërskare: In dié dae sal tien man uit al die tale van die nasies die slip van ’n Joodse man gryp en dit vashou en sê: Ons wil met julle saamgaan, want ons het gehoor dat God met julle is.

kjv_text: The burden of the word of the LORD in the land of Hadrach, and Damascus shall be the rest thereof: when the eyes of man, as of all the tribes of Israel, shall be toward the LORD.
bsb_text: This is the burden of the word of the LORD against the land of Hadrach and Damascus its resting place—for the eyes of men and of all the tribes of Israel are upon the LORD—
aov_text: GODSPRAAK. Die woord van die HERE teen die land Hadrag, en op Damaskus bly dit rus—want die HERE hou die oog op die mense en op al die stamme van Israel.

kjv_text: And Hamath also shall border thereby; Tyrus, and Zidon, though it be very wise.
bsb_text: and also against Hamath, which borders it, as well as Tyre and Sidon, though they are very shrewd.
aov_text: En ook teen Hamat wat daaraan grens; teen Tirus saam met Sidon, want hy is baie slim.

kjv_text: And Tyrus did build herself a strong hold, and heaped up silver as the dust, and fine gold as the mire of the streets.
bsb_text: Tyre has built herself a fortress; she has heaped up silver like dust, and gold like the dirt of the streets.
aov_text: Ja, Tirus het vir hom ’n vesting gebou; ook het hy silwer opgehoop soos stof en goud soos modder van die strate.

kjv_text: Behold, the LORD will cast her out, and he will smite her power in the sea; and she shall be devoured with fire.
bsb_text: Behold, the Lord will impoverish her and cast her wealth into the sea, and she will be consumed by fire.
aov_text: Kyk, die Here sal hom in besit neem en sy skans in die see werp, en hy sal deur vuur verteer word.

kjv_text: Ashkelon shall see it, and fear; Gaza also shall see it, and be very sorrowful, and Ekron; for her expectation shall be ashamed; and the king shall perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon shall not be inhabited.
bsb_text: Ashkelon will see and fear; Gaza will writhe in agony, as will Ekron, for her hope will wither. There will cease to be a king in Gaza, and Ashkelon will be uninhabited.
aov_text: Áskelon sal dit sien en vrees; ook Gasa, wat sal sidder van angs; ook Ekron, omdat sy toeverlaat teleurgestel het; en uit Gasa verdwyn die koning, en Áskelon bly onbewoond;

kjv_text: And a bastard shall dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.
bsb_text: A mixed race will occupy Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.
aov_text: en die baster sal in Asdod woon—so sal Ek dan aan die trotsheid van die Filistyn ’n einde maak —

kjv_text: And I will take away his blood out of his mouth, and his abominations from between his teeth: but he that remaineth, even he, shall be for our God, and he shall be as a governor in Judah, and Ekron as a Jebusite.
bsb_text: I will remove the blood from their mouths and the abominations from between their teeth. Then they too will become a remnant for our God; they will become like a clan in Judah, and Ekron will be like the Jebusites.
aov_text: en Ek sal die bloed uit sy mond verwyder en sy verfoeisels tussen sy tande uit; so sal hy dan ook vir onse God oorbly en wees soos ’n stamhoof in Juda, en Ekron soos ’n Jebusiet.

kjv_text: And I will encamp about mine house because of the army, because of him that passeth by, and because of him that returneth: and no oppressor shall pass through them any more: for now have I seen with mine eyes.
bsb_text: But I will camp around My house because of an army, because of those who march to and fro, and never again will an oppressor overrun My people, for now I keep watch with My own eyes.
aov_text: En Ek sal om my huis ’n laer trek teen die leërmag, teen die wat heen en weer trek, sodat geen oorheerser hulle weer sal oorrompel nie; want nou het Ek dit met my eie oë gesien.

kjv_text: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem: behold, thy King cometh unto thee: he is just, and having salvation; lowly, and riding upon an ass, and upon a colt the foal of an ass.
bsb_text: Rejoice greatly, O Daughter of Zion! Shout in triumph, O Daughter of Jerusalem! See, your King comes to you, righteous and victorious, humble and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.
aov_text: VERHEUG jou grootliks, o dogter van Sion! Juig, o dogter van Jerusalem! Kyk, jou Koning kom na jou; regverdig en ’n oorwinnaar is Hy; nederig en Hy ry op ’n esel—op ’n jong esel, die vul van ’n eselin.

kjv_text: And I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim, and the horse from Jerusalem, and the battle bow shall be cut off: and he shall speak peace unto the heathen: and his dominion shall be from sea even to sea, and from the river even to the ends of the earth.
bsb_text: And I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim and the horse from Jerusalem, and the bow of war will be broken. Then He will proclaim peace to the nations. His dominion will extend from sea to sea, and from the Euphrates to the ends of the earth.
aov_text: En Ek sal die strydwaens uit Efraim en die perde uit Jerusalem uitroei, en die strydboog sal vernietig word. Dan sal Hy aan die nasies vrede verkondig, en sy heerskappy sal wees van see tot see, en van die Eufraat tot aan die eindes van die aarde.

kjv_text: As for thee also, by the blood of thy covenant I have sent forth thy prisoners out of the pit wherein is no water.
bsb_text: As for you, because of the blood of My covenant, I will release your prisoners from the waterless pit.
aov_text: Ook sal Ek, wat jou betref, o Sion, kragtens die bloed van jou verbond jou gevangenes loslaat uit die put sonder water.

kjv_text: Turn you to the strong hold, ye prisoners of hope: even to day do I declare that I will render double unto thee;
bsb_text: Return to your stronghold, O prisoners of hope; even today I declare that I will restore to you double.
aov_text: Keer terug na die vesting, o hoopvolle gevangenes! Ook kondig Ek vandag aan dat Ek jou dubbel sal vergoed.

kjv_text: When I have bent Judah for me, filled the bow with Ephraim, and raised up thy sons, O Zion, against thy sons, O Greece, and made thee as the sword of a mighty man.
bsb_text: For I will bend Judah as My bow and fit it with Ephraim. I will rouse your sons, O Zion, against the sons of Greece. I will make you like the sword of a mighty man.
aov_text: Want Ek span Juda vir My as boog, lê Efraim as pyl daarop; en Ek vuur jou seuns, o Sion, aan teen jou seuns, o Jawan, en Ek maak jou soos die swaard van ’n held.

kjv_text: And the LORD shall be seen over them, and his arrow shall go forth as the lightning: and the LORD God shall blow the trumpet, and shall go with whirlwinds of the south.
bsb_text: Then the LORD will appear over them, and His arrow will go forth like lightning. The Lord GOD will sound the ram’s horn and advance in the whirlwinds of the south.
aov_text: Dan sal die HERE oor hulle verskyn, en soos weerlig sal sy pyl uitskiet; en die Here HERE sal met die basuin blaas en intrek met die storms uit die suide.

kjv_text: The LORD of hosts shall defend them; and they shall devour, and subdue with sling stones; and they shall drink, and make a noise as through wine; and they shall be filled like bowls, and as the corners of the altar.
bsb_text: The LORD of Hosts will shield them. They will destroy and conquer with slingstones; they will drink and roar as with wine. And they will be filled like sprinkling bowls, drenched like the corners of the altar.
aov_text: Die HERE van die leërskare sal hulle beskut; en hulle sal verslind, ja, slingerstene vertrap; ook sal hulle drink, ’n gedruis maak soos deur wyn en vol wees soos die offerkomme, soos die hoeke van ’n altaar.

kjv_text: And the LORD their God shall save them in that day as the flock of his people: for they shall be as the stones of a crown, lifted up as an ensign upon his land.
bsb_text: On that day the LORD their God will save them as the flock of His people; for like jewels in a crown they will sparkle over His land.
aov_text: En die HERE hulle God sal hulle in dié dag verlos as die kudde wat sy volk is; want hulle is kroongesteentes wat hulle skitterend verhef oor sy land.

kjv_text: For how great is his goodness, and how great is his beauty! corn shall make the young men cheerful, and new wine the maids.
bsb_text: How lovely they will be, and how beautiful! Grain will make the young men flourish, and new wine, the young women.
aov_text: Want hoe groot is hulle voortreflikheid, en hoe groot hulle skoonheid! Die koring laat jongmanne en die mos jongedogters groei.

kjv_text: Ask ye of the LORD rain in the time of the latter rain; so the LORD shall make bright clouds, and give them showers of rain, to every one grass in the field.
bsb_text: Ask the LORD for rain in springtime; the LORD makes the storm clouds, and He will give everyone showers of rain and crops in the field.
aov_text: BID tot die HERE om reën in die tyd van die laat reëns; die HERE maak die weerligte, en Hy sal aan hulle ’n stortreën gee, plante op die veld aan iedereen.

kjv_text: For the idols have spoken vanity, and the diviners have seen a lie, and have told false dreams; they comfort in vain: therefore they went their way as a flock, they were troubled, because there was no shepherd.
bsb_text: For idols speak deceit and diviners see illusions; they tell false dreams and offer empty comfort. Therefore the people wander like sheep, oppressed for lack of a shepherd.
aov_text: Want die huisgode spreek bedrog, en die waarsêers sien leuens en verkondig nietige drome, hulle troos met wind. Daarom het hulle weggeswerwe soos ’n kudde; hulle verkeer in verdrukking, omdat daar geen herder is nie.

kjv_text: Mine anger was kindled against the shepherds, and I punished the goats: for the LORD of hosts hath visited his flock the house of Judah, and hath made them as his goodly horse in the battle.
bsb_text: “My anger burns against the shepherds, and I will punish the leaders. For the LORD of Hosts attends to His flock, the house of Judah; He will make them like His royal steed in battle.
aov_text: Teen die herders het my toorn ontvlam, en oor die voorbokke sal Ek besoeking bring; want die HERE van die leërskare gee ag op sy kudde, op die huis van Juda, en maak hulle tot sy pragtige perd in die stryd.

kjv_text: Out of him came forth the corner, out of him the nail, out of him the battle bow, out of him every oppressor together.
bsb_text: The cornerstone will come from Judah, the tent peg from him, as well as the battle bow and every ruler together.
aov_text: Uit hom sal die hoeksteen, uit hom die muurpen, uit hom die strydboog, uit hom die heersers almal saam uitgaan.

kjv_text: And they shall be as mighty men, which tread down their enemies in the mire of the streets in the battle: and they shall fight, because the LORD is with them, and the riders on horses shall be confounded.
bsb_text: They will be like mighty men in battle, trampling the enemy in the mire of the streets. They will fight because the LORD is with them, and they will put the horsemen to shame.
aov_text: En hulle sal wees soos helde wat in die oorlog die modder van die strate vertrap; en hulle sal veg, want die HERE is met hulle; en die ruitery sal beskaamd uitkom.

kjv_text: And I will strengthen the house of Judah, and I will save the house of Joseph, and I will bring them again to place them; for I have mercy upon them: and they shall be as though I had not cast them off: for I am the LORD their God, and will hear them.
bsb_text: I will strengthen the house of Judah and save the house of Joseph. I will restore them because I have compassion on them, and they will be as though I had not rejected them. For I am the LORD their God, and I will answer them.
aov_text: En Ek sal die huis van Juda sterk maak en aan die huis van Josef hulp verleen en hulle ’n woonplek aanwys, want Ek ontferm My oor hulle; en hulle sal wees asof Ek hulle nie verwerp het nie, want Ek is die HERE hulle God, en Ek sal hulle verhoor.

kjv_text: And they of Ephraim shall be like a mighty man, and their heart shall rejoice as through wine: yea, their children shall see it, and be glad; their heart shall rejoice in the LORD.
bsb_text: Ephraim will be like a mighty man, and their hearts will be glad as with wine. Their children will see it and be joyful; their hearts will rejoice in the LORD.
aov_text: En Efraim sal wees soos ’n held, en hulle hart sal vrolik wees soos deur wyn, en hulle kinders sal dit sien en hulle verbly, hulle hart sal juig in die HERE.

kjv_text: I will hiss for them, and gather them; for I have redeemed them: and they shall increase as they have increased.
bsb_text: I will whistle for them to gather, for I have redeemed them; and they will be as numerous as they once were.
aov_text: Ek wil vir hulle fluit en hulle vergader, want Ek het hulle losgekoop; en hulle sal net so talryk wees soos tevore.

kjv_text: And I will sow them among the people: and they shall remember me in far countries; and they shall live with their children, and turn again.
bsb_text: Though I sow them among the nations, they will remember Me in distant lands; they and their children will live and return.
aov_text: En Ek sal hulle saai onder die volke, en in die verafgeleë streke sal hulle aan My dink; en hulle sal saam met hul kinders in die lewe bly en terugkom.

kjv_text: I will bring them again also out of the land of Egypt, and gather them out of Assyria; and I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon; and place shall not be found for them.
bsb_text: I will bring them back from Egypt and gather them from Assyria. I will bring them to Gilead and Lebanon until no more room is found for them.
