kjv_text: Saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel: for they are dead which sought the young child's life.
bsb_text: “Get up!” he said. “Take the Child and His mother and go to the land of Israel, for those seeking the Child’s life are now dead.”
aov_text: en gesê: Staan op, neem die Kindjie en sy moeder, en gaan na die land van Israel; want hulle is dood wat die lewe van die Kindjie gesoek het.

kjv_text: And he arose, and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.
bsb_text: So Joseph got up, took the Child and His mother, and went to the land of Israel.
aov_text: En hy het opgestaan, die Kindjie en sy moeder geneem en in die land van Israel gekom.

kjv_text: But when he heard that Archelaus did reign in Judaea in the room of his father Herod, he was afraid to go thither: notwithstanding, being warned of God in a dream, he turned aside into the parts of Galilee:
bsb_text: But when he learned that Archelaus was reigning in Judea in place of his father Herod, he was afraid to go there. And having been warned in a dream, he withdrew to the district of Galilee,
aov_text: Maar toe hy hoor dat Archeláüs oor Judéa koning was in die plek van sy vader Herodes, was hy bevrees om daarheen te gaan. En hy het ’n goddelike waarskuwing in ’n droom ontvang en na die streke van Galiléa teruggekeer.

kjv_text: And he came and dwelt in a city called Nazareth: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophets, He shall be called a Nazarene.
bsb_text: and he went and lived in a town called Nazareth. So was fulfilled what was spoken through the prophets: “He will be called a Nazarene.”
aov_text: En hy het gaan woon in ’n stad met die naam van Násaret, sodat vervul sou word wat deur die profete gespreek is, dat Hy Nasaréner genoem sou word.

kjv_text: In those days came John the Baptist, preaching in the wilderness of Judaea,
bsb_text: In those days John the Baptist came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea
aov_text: IN daardie dae het Johannes die Doper opgetree en in die woestyn van Judéa

kjv_text: And saying, Repent ye: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
bsb_text: and saying, “Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is near.”
aov_text: gepreek en gesê: Bekeer julle, want die koninkryk van die hemele het naby gekom.

kjv_text: For this is he that was spoken of by the prophet Esaias, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
bsb_text: This is he who was spoken of through the prophet Isaiah: “A voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for Him.’”
aov_text: Want dit is hy van wie deur die profeet Jesaja gespreek is toe hy gesê het: Die stem van een wat roep in die woestyn: Berei die weg van die Here, maak sy paaie reguit!

kjv_text: And the same John had his raiment of camel's hair, and a leathern girdle about his loins; and his meat was locusts and wild honey.
bsb_text: John wore a garment of camel’s hair, with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.
aov_text: En hy, Johannes, het ’n kleed gedra van kameelhare en ’n leergord om sy heupe, en sy voedsel was sprinkane en wilde heuning.

kjv_text: Then went out to him Jerusalem, and all Judaea, and all the region round about Jordan,
bsb_text: People went out to him from Jerusalem and all Judea and the whole region around the Jordan.
aov_text: En Jerusalem en die hele Judéa en die hele omtrek van die Jordaan het uitgegaan na hom toe.

kjv_text: And were baptized of him in Jordan, confessing their sins.
bsb_text: Confessing their sins, they were baptized by him in the Jordan River.
aov_text: En hulle is deur hom in die Jordaan gedoop met belydenis van hulle sondes.

kjv_text: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said unto them, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
bsb_text: But when John saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming to his place of baptism, he said to them, “You brood of vipers, who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?
aov_text: Maar toe hy baie van die Fariseërs en Sadduseërs na sy doop sien kom, sê hy vir hulle: Addergeslag, wie het julle aangewys om te vlug vir die toorn wat aan kom is?

kjv_text: Bring forth therefore fruits meet for repentance:
bsb_text: Produce fruit, then, in keeping with repentance.
aov_text: Dra dan vrugte wat by die bekering pas.

kjv_text: And think not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, that God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.
bsb_text: And do not presume to say to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham as our father.’ For I tell you that out of these stones God can raise up children for Abraham.
aov_text: En moenie dink om by julleself te sê: ons het Abraham as vader nie; want ek sê vir julle dat God mag het om uit hierdie klippe kinders vir Abraham op te wek.

kjv_text: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: therefore every tree which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
bsb_text: The axe lies ready at the root of the trees, and every tree that does not produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire.
aov_text: Maar die byl lê ook al teen die wortel van die bome. Elke boom wat geen goeie vrugte dra nie, word uitgekap en in die vuur gegooi.

kjv_text: I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance: but he that cometh after me is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy to bear: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost, and with fire:
bsb_text: I baptize you with water for repentance, but after me will come One more powerful than I, whose sandals I am not worthy to carry. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.
aov_text: Ek doop julle wel met water tot bekering; maar Hy wat ná my kom, is sterker as ek, wie se skoene ek nie waardig is om aan te dra nie. Hy sal julle doop met die Heilige Gees en met vuur.

kjv_text: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and gather his wheat into the garner; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.
bsb_text: His winnowing fork is in His hand to clear His threshing floor and to gather His wheat into the barn; but He will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”
aov_text: Sy skop is in sy hand, en Hy sal sy dorsvloer deur en deur skoonmaak en sy koring in die skuur saambring, maar die kaf sal Hy met onuitbluslike vuur verbrand.

kjv_text: Then cometh Jesus from Galilee to Jordan unto John, to be baptized of him.
bsb_text: At that time Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to be baptized by John.
aov_text: TOE het Jesus van Galiléa na die Jordaan, na Johannes gekom om deur hom gedoop te word.

kjv_text: But John forbad him, saying, I have need to be baptized of thee, and comest thou to me?
bsb_text: But John tried to prevent Him, saying, “I need to be baptized by You, and do You come to me?”
aov_text: Maar Johannes het Hom ernstig teëgegaan en gesê: Ek het nodig om deur U gedoop te word, en kom U na my toe?

kjv_text: And Jesus answering said unto him, Suffer it to be so now: for thus it becometh us to fulfil all righteousness. Then he suffered him.
bsb_text: “Let it be so now,” Jesus replied. “It is fitting for us to fulfill all righteousness in this way.” Then John permitted Him.
aov_text: Maar Jesus het geantwoord en vir hom gesê: Laat dit nou toe, want só pas dit ons om alle geregtigheid te vervul. Daarna het hy Hom toegelaat.

kjv_text: And Jesus, when he was baptized, went up straightway out of the water: and, lo, the heavens were opened unto him, and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove, and lighting upon him:
bsb_text: As soon as Jesus was baptized, He went up out of the water. Suddenly the heavens were opened, and He saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove and resting on Him.
aov_text: En nadat Jesus gedoop was, het Hy dadelik uit die water opgeklim, en meteens gaan die hemele vir Hom oop, en Hy sien die Gees van God soos ’n duif neerdaal en op Hom kom.

kjv_text: And lo a voice from heaven, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
bsb_text: And a voice from heaven said, “This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased!”
aov_text: En daar kom ’n stem uit die hemel wat sê: Dit is my geliefde Seun in wie Ek ’n welbehae het.

kjv_text: Then was Jesus led up of the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted of the devil.
bsb_text: Then Jesus was led by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.
aov_text: TOE is Jesus deur die Gees weggelei die woestyn in om versoek te word deur die duiwel.

kjv_text: And when he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was afterward an hungred.
bsb_text: After fasting forty days and forty nights, He was hungry.
aov_text: En nadat Hy veertig dae en veertig nagte gevas het, het Hy naderhand honger geword.

kjv_text: And when the tempter came to him, he said, If thou be the Son of God, command that these stones be made bread.
bsb_text: The tempter came to Him and said, “If You are the Son of God, tell these stones to become bread.”
aov_text: En die versoeker het na Hom gekom en gesê: As U die Seun van God is, sê dat hierdie klippe brode word.

kjv_text: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.
bsb_text: But Jesus answered, “It is written: ‘Man shall not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of God.’”
aov_text: Maar Hy antwoord en sê: Daar is geskrywe: Die mens sal nie van brood alleen lewe nie, maar van elke woord wat deur die mond van God uitgaan.

kjv_text: Then the devil taketh him up into the holy city, and setteth him on a pinnacle of the temple,
bsb_text: Then the devil took Him to the holy city and set Him on the pinnacle of the temple.
aov_text: Toe neem die duiwel Hom saam na die heilige stad en laat Hom op die dak van die tempel staan

kjv_text: And saith unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down: for it is written, He shall give his angels charge concerning thee: and in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.
bsb_text: “If You are the Son of God,” he said, “throw Yourself down. For it is written: ‘He will command His angels concerning You, and they will lift You up in their hands, so that You will not strike Your foot against a stone.’”
aov_text: en sê vir Hom: As U die Seun van God is, werp Uself af; want daar is geskrywe: Hy sal sy engele bevel gee aangaande U, en hulle sal U op die hande dra, sodat U nie miskien u voet teen ’n klip stamp nie.

kjv_text: Jesus said unto him, It is written again, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.
bsb_text: Jesus replied, “It is also written: ‘Do not put the Lord your God to the test.’”
aov_text: Jesus sê vir hom: Daar is óók geskrywe: Jy mag die Here jou God nie versoek nie.

kjv_text: Again, the devil taketh him up into an exceeding high mountain, and sheweth him all the kingdoms of the world, and the glory of them;
bsb_text: Again, the devil took Him to a very high mountain and showed Him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory.
aov_text: Weer neem die duiwel Hom saam na ’n baie hoë berg en wys Hom al die koninkryke van die wêreld en hulle heerlikheid,

kjv_text: And saith unto him, All these things will I give thee, if thou wilt fall down and worship me.
bsb_text: “All this I will give You,” he said, “if You will fall down and worship me.”
aov_text: en sê vir Hom: Al hierdie dinge sal ek aan U gee as U neerval en my aanbid.

kjv_text: Then saith Jesus unto him, Get thee hence, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.
bsb_text: “Away from Me, Satan!” Jesus declared. “For it is written: ‘Worship the Lord your God and serve Him only.’”
aov_text: Toe sê Jesus vir hom: Gaan weg, Satan! want daar is geskrywe: Die Here jou God moet jy aanbid en Hom alleen dien.

kjv_text: Then the devil leaveth him, and, behold, angels came and ministered unto him.
bsb_text: Then the devil left Him, and angels came and ministered to Him.
aov_text: Daarna het die duiwel Hom laat staan, en daar het engele gekom en Hom gedien.

kjv_text: Now when Jesus had heard that John was cast into prison, he departed into Galilee;
bsb_text: When Jesus heard that John had been imprisoned, He withdrew to Galilee.
aov_text: EN toe Jesus hoor dat Johannes in die gevangenis gesit was, het Hy na Galiléa teruggegaan.

kjv_text: And leaving Nazareth, he came and dwelt in Capernaum, which is upon the sea coast, in the borders of Zabulon and Nephthalim:
bsb_text: Leaving Nazareth, He went and lived in Capernaum, which is by the sea in the region of Zebulun and Naphtali,
aov_text: En Hy het Násaret verlaat en gaan woon in Kapérnaüm aan die see, in die gebied van Sébulon en Náftali,

kjv_text: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,
bsb_text: to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah:
aov_text: sodat vervul sou word wat gespreek is deur Jesaja, die profeet, toe hy gesê het:

kjv_text: The land of Zabulon, and the land of Nephthalim, by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles;
bsb_text: “Land of Zebulun and land of Naphtali, the Way of the Sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles—
aov_text: Die land Sébulon en die land Náftali, na die see toe, oorkant die Jordaan, Galiléa van die heidene  —

kjv_text: The people which sat in darkness saw great light; and to them which sat in the region and shadow of death light is sprung up.
bsb_text: the people living in darkness have seen a great light; on those living in the land of the shadow of death, a light has dawned.”
aov_text: die volk wat in duisternis sit, het ’n groot lig gesien, en die wat sit in die land en skaduwee van die dood, vir hulle het ’n lig opgegaan.

kjv_text: From that time Jesus began to preach, and to say, Repent: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
bsb_text: From that time on Jesus began to preach, “Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is near.”
aov_text: Van toe af het Jesus begin om te preek en te sê: Bekeer julle, want die koninkryk van die hemele het naby gekom.

kjv_text: And Jesus, walking by the sea of Galilee, saw two brethren, Simon called Peter, and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.
bsb_text: As Jesus was walking beside the Sea of Galilee, He saw two brothers, Simon called Peter and his brother Andrew. They were casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.
aov_text: En terwyl Jesus langs die see van Galiléa loop, sien Hy twee broers, Simon wat genoem word Petrus, en Andréas, sy broer, besig om ’n net in die see uit te gooi; want hulle was vissers.

kjv_text: And he saith unto them, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.
bsb_text: “Come, follow Me,” Jesus said, “and I will make you fishers of men.”
aov_text: En Hy sê vir hulle: Kom agter My aan, en Ek sal julle vissers van mense maak.

kjv_text: And they straightway left their nets, and followed him.
bsb_text: And at once they left their nets and followed Him.
aov_text: En hulle het dadelik die nette laat staan en Hom gevolg.

kjv_text: And going on from thence, he saw other two brethren, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in a ship with Zebedee their father, mending their nets; and he called them.
bsb_text: Going on from there, He saw two other brothers, James son of Zebedee and his brother John. They were in a boat with their father Zebedee, mending their nets. Jesus called them,
aov_text: En toe Hy daarvandaan verder gaan, sien Hy twee ander broers, Jakobus, die seun van Sebedéüs, en Johannes, sy broer, in die skuit saam met hulle vader Sebedéüs, besig om hulle nette heel te maak; en Hy het hulle geroep.

kjv_text: And they immediately left the ship and their father, and followed him.
bsb_text: and immediately they left the boat and their father and followed Him.
aov_text: En hulle het dadelik die skuit en hulle vader verlaat en Hom gevolg.

kjv_text: And Jesus went about all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing all manner of sickness and all manner of disease among the people.
bsb_text: Jesus went throughout Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every disease and sickness among the people.
aov_text: En Jesus het deur die hele Galiléa rondgegaan en in hulle sinagoges geleer en die evangelie van die koninkryk verkondig en elke siekte en elke kwaal onder die volk genees.

kjv_text: And his fame went throughout all Syria: and they brought unto him all sick people that were taken with divers diseases and torments, and those which were possessed with devils, and those which were lunatick, and those that had the palsy; and he healed them.
bsb_text: News about Him spread all over Syria, and people brought to Him all who were ill with various diseases, those suffering acute pain, the demon-possessed, those having seizures, and the paralyzed—and He healed them.
aov_text: En die gerug aangaande Hom is versprei oor die hele Sírië; en hulle het na Hom gebring almal wat ongesteld was, wat gekwel was deur allerhande siektes en pyne en wat van duiwels besete was, en maansiekes en verlamdes; en Hy het hulle gesond gemaak.

kjv_text: And there followed him great multitudes of people from Galilee, and from Decapolis, and from Jerusalem, and from Judaea, and from beyond Jordan.
bsb_text: The large crowds that followed Him came from Galilee, the Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea, and beyond the Jordan.
aov_text: En groot menigtes het Hom gevolg van Galiléa en Dekápolis en Jerusalem en Judéa en van oorkant die Jordaan af.

kjv_text: And seeing the multitudes, he went up into a mountain: and when he was set, his disciples came unto him:
bsb_text: When Jesus saw the crowds, He went up on the mountain and sat down. His disciples came to Him,
aov_text: EN toe Hy die skare sien, het Hy op die berg geklim; en nadat Hy gaan sit het, het sy dissipels na Hom gekom;

kjv_text: And he opened his mouth, and taught them, saying,
bsb_text: and He began to teach them, saying:
aov_text: en Hy het sy mond geopen en hulle geleer en gesê:

kjv_text: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
bsb_text: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
aov_text: Salig is die wat arm van gees is, want aan hulle behoort die koninkryk van die hemele.

kjv_text: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.
bsb_text: Blessed are those who mourn, for they will be comforted.
aov_text: Salig is die wat treur, want hulle sal vertroos word.

kjv_text: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.
bsb_text: Blessed are the meek, for they will inherit the earth.
aov_text: Salig is die sagmoediges, want hulle sal die aarde beërwe.

kjv_text: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.
bsb_text: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they will be filled.
aov_text: Salig is die wat honger en dors na die geregtigheid, want hulle sal versadig word.

kjv_text: Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.
bsb_text: Blessed are the merciful, for they will be shown mercy.
aov_text: Salig is die barmhartiges, want aan hulle sal barmhartigheid bewys word.

kjv_text: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.
bsb_text: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God.
aov_text: Salig is die wat rein van hart is, want hulle sal God sien.

kjv_text: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.
bsb_text: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called sons of God.
aov_text: Salig is die vredemakers, want hulle sal kinders van God genoem word.

kjv_text: Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness' sake: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
bsb_text: Blessed are those who are persecuted because of righteousness, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
aov_text: Salig is die wat vervolg word ter wille van die geregtigheid, want aan hulle behoort die koninkryk van die hemele.

kjv_text: Blessed are ye, when men shall revile you, and persecute you, and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely, for my sake.
bsb_text: Blessed are you when people insult you, persecute you, and falsely say all kinds of evil against you because of Me.
aov_text: Salig is julle wanneer die mense julle beledig en vervolg en valslik allerhande kwaad teen julle spreek om My ontwil.

kjv_text: Rejoice, and be exceeding glad: for great is your reward in heaven: for so persecuted they the prophets which were before you.
bsb_text: Rejoice and be glad, because great is your reward in heaven; for in the same way they persecuted the prophets before you.
aov_text: Verbly en verheug julle omdat julle loon groot is in die hemele; want so het hulle die profete vervolg wat voor julle gewees het.

kjv_text: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men.
bsb_text: You are the salt of the earth. But if the salt loses its savor, how can it be made salty again? It is no longer good for anything, except to be thrown out and trampled by men.
aov_text: JULLE is die sout van die aarde, maar as die sout laf geword het, waarmee sal dit gesout word? Dit deug nêrens meer voor as om buite gegooi en deur die mense vertrap te word nie.

kjv_text: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.
bsb_text: You are the light of the world. A city on a hill cannot be hidden.
aov_text: Julle is die lig van die wêreld. ’n Stad wat bo-op ’n berg lê, kan nie weggesteek word nie;

kjv_text: Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a bushel, but on a candlestick; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house.
bsb_text: Neither do people light a lamp and put it under a basket. Instead, they set it on a stand, and it gives light to everyone in the house.
aov_text: en ’n mens steek ook nie ’n lamp op en sit dit onder die maatemmer nie, maar op die staander, en dit skyn vir almal wat in die huis is.

kjv_text: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.
bsb_text: In the same way, let your light shine before men, that they may see your good deeds and glorify your Father in heaven.
aov_text: Laat julle lig só skyn voor die mense, dat hulle julle goeie werke kan sien en julle Vader wat in die hemele is, verheerlik.

kjv_text: Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil.
bsb_text: Do not think that I have come to abolish the Law or the Prophets. I have not come to abolish them, but to fulfill them.
aov_text: MOENIE dink dat Ek gekom het om die wet of die profete te ontbind nie. Ek het nie gekom om te ontbind nie, maar om te vervul.

kjv_text: For verily I say unto you, Till heaven and earth pass, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass from the law, till all be fulfilled.
bsb_text: For I tell you truly, until heaven and earth pass away, not a single jot, not a stroke of a pen, will disappear from the Law until everything is accomplished.
aov_text: Want voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, voordat die hemel en die aarde verbygaan, sal nie een jota of een titteltjie van die wet ooit verbygaan totdat alles gebeur het nie.

kjv_text: Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven: but whosoever shall do and teach them, the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
bsb_text: So then, whoever breaks one of the least of these commandments and teaches others to do likewise will be called least in the kingdom of heaven; but whoever practices and teaches them will be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
aov_text: Elkeen dus wat een van die minste van hierdie gebooie breek en die mense só leer, sal die minste genoem word in die koninkryk van die hemele; maar elkeen wat dit doen en leer, hy sal groot genoem word in die koninkryk van die hemele.

kjv_text: For I say unto you, That except your righteousness shall exceed the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees, ye shall in no case enter into the kingdom of heaven.
bsb_text: For I tell you that unless your righteousness exceeds that of the scribes and Pharisees, you will never enter the kingdom of heaven.
aov_text: Want Ek sê vir julle dat, as julle geregtigheid nie oorvloediger is as dié van die skrifgeleerdes en Fariseërs nie, julle nooit in die koninkryk van die hemele sal ingaan nie.

kjv_text: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not kill; and whosoever shall kill shall be in danger of the judgment:
bsb_text: You have heard that it was said to the ancients, ‘Do not murder’ and ‘Anyone who murders will be subject to judgment.’
aov_text: Julle het gehoor dat aan die mense van die ou tyd gesê is: Jy mag nie doodslaan nie, maar elkeen wat doodslaan, moet verantwoording doen voor die gereg.

kjv_text: But I say unto you, That whosoever is angry with his brother without a cause shall be in danger of the judgment: and whosoever shall say to his brother, Raca, shall be in danger of the council: but whosoever shall say, Thou fool, shall be in danger of hell fire.
bsb_text: But I tell you that anyone who is angry with his brother will be subject to judgment. Again, anyone who says to his brother, ‘Raca,’ will be subject to the Sanhedrin. But anyone who says, ‘You fool!’ will be subject to the fire of hell.
aov_text: Maar Ek sê vir julle dat elkeen wat vir sy broeder sonder rede kwaad is, verantwoording moet doen voor die gereg; en elkeen wat vir sy broeder sê: Raka! moet verantwoording doen voor die Groot Raad; en elkeen wat sê: Jou dwaas! moet verantwoording doen in die helse vuur.

kjv_text: Therefore if thou bring thy gift to the altar, and there rememberest that thy brother hath ought against thee;
bsb_text: So if you are offering your gift at the altar and there remember that your brother has something against you,
aov_text: As jy dan jou gawe na die altaar bring en dit jou daar byval dat jou broeder iets teen jou het,

kjv_text: Leave there thy gift before the altar, and go thy way; first be reconciled to thy brother, and then come and offer thy gift.
bsb_text: leave your gift there before the altar. First go and be reconciled to your brother; then come and offer your gift.
aov_text: laat jou gawe daar voor die altaar bly en gaan versoen jou eers met jou broeder, en kom dan en bring jou gawe.

kjv_text: Agree with thine adversary quickly, whiles thou art in the way with him; lest at any time the adversary deliver thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and thou be cast into prison.
bsb_text: Reconcile quickly with your adversary, while you are still on the way to court. Otherwise, he may hand you over to the judge, and the judge may hand you over to the officer, and you may be thrown into prison.
aov_text: Wees gou goedgesind teenoor jou teëparty so lank as jy nog saam met hom op die pad is, sodat die teëparty jou nie miskien oorgee aan die regter en die regter jou oorgee aan die geregsdienaar en jy in die gevangenis gewerp word nie.

kjv_text: Verily I say unto thee, Thou shalt by no means come out thence, till thou hast paid the uttermost farthing.
bsb_text: Truly I tell you, you will not get out until you have paid the last penny.
aov_text: Voorwaar Ek sê vir jou, jy sal daar sekerlik nie uitkom voordat jy die laaste oortjie betaal het nie.

kjv_text: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not commit adultery:
bsb_text: You have heard that it was said, ‘Do not commit adultery.’
aov_text: Julle het gehoor dat aan die mense van die ou tyd gesê is: Jy mag nie egbreek nie.

kjv_text: But I say unto you, That whosoever looketh on a woman to lust after her hath committed adultery with her already in his heart.
bsb_text: But I tell you that anyone who looks at a woman to lust after her has already committed adultery with her in his heart.
aov_text: Maar Ek sê vir julle dat elkeen wat na ’n vrou kyk om haar te begeer, reeds in sy hart met haar egbreuk gepleeg het.

kjv_text: And if thy right eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.
bsb_text: If your right eye causes you to sin, gouge it out and throw it away. It is better for you to lose one part of your body than for your whole body to be thrown into hell.
aov_text: As jou regteroog jou dan laat struikel, ruk dit uit en gooi dit weg van jou af; want dit is vir jou beter dat een van jou lede vergaan en nie jou hele liggaam in die hel gewerp word nie.

kjv_text: And if thy right hand offend thee, cut it off, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.
bsb_text: And if your right hand causes you to sin, cut it off and throw it away. It is better for you to lose one part of your body than for your whole body to depart into hell.
aov_text: En as jou regterhand jou laat struikel, kap dit af en gooi dit weg van jou af; want dit is vir jou beter dat een van jou lede vergaan en nie jou hele liggaam in die hel gewerp word nie.

kjv_text: It hath been said, Whosoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorcement:
bsb_text: It has also been said, ‘Whoever divorces his wife must give her a certificate of divorce.’
aov_text: Daar is ook gesê: Elkeen wat van sy vrou skei, moet haar ’n skeibrief gee.

kjv_text: But I say unto you, That whosoever shall put away his wife, saving for the cause of fornication, causeth her to commit adultery: and whosoever shall marry her that is divorced committeth adultery.
bsb_text: But I tell you that anyone who divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, brings adultery upon her. And he who marries a divorced woman commits adultery.
aov_text: Maar Ek sê vir julle dat elkeen wat van sy vrou skei, behalwe omrede van hoerery, maak dat sy egbreuk pleeg, en elkeen wat die geskeie vrou trou, pleeg egbreuk.

kjv_text: Again, ye have heard that it hath been said by them of old time, Thou shalt not forswear thyself, but shalt perform unto the Lord thine oaths:
bsb_text: Again, you have heard that it was said to the ancients, ‘Do not break your oath, but fulfill your vows to the Lord.’
aov_text: Verder het julle gehoor dat aan die mense van die ou tyd gesê is: Jy mag nie vals sweer nie, maar jy moet jou ede aan die Here hou.

kjv_text: But I say unto you, Swear not at all; neither by heaven; for it is God's throne:
bsb_text: But I tell you not to swear at all: either by heaven, for it is God’s throne;
aov_text: Maar Ek sê vir julle: Sweer hoegenaamd nie — nie by die hemel nie, omdat dit die troon van God is;

kjv_text: Nor by the earth; for it is his footstool: neither by Jerusalem; for it is the city of the great King.
bsb_text: or by the earth, for it is His footstool; or by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the great King.
aov_text: ook nie by die aarde nie, omdat dit die voetbank van sy voete is; ook nie by Jerusalem nie, omdat dit die stad is van die groot Koning;

kjv_text: Neither shalt thou swear by thy head, because thou canst not make one hair white or black.
bsb_text: Nor should you swear by your head, for you cannot make a single hair white or black.
aov_text: ook by jou hoof mag jy nie sweer nie, omdat jy nie een haar wit of swart kan maak nie.

kjv_text: But let your communication be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay: for whatsoever is more than these cometh of evil.
bsb_text: Simply let your ‘Yes’ be ‘Yes,’ and your ‘No,’ ‘No.’ Anything more comes from the evil one.
aov_text: Maar laat julle woord wees: Ja ja, nee nee. Wat meer as dit is, is uit die Bose.

kjv_text: Ye have heard that it hath been said, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth:
bsb_text: You have heard that it was said, ‘Eye for eye and tooth for tooth.’
aov_text: Julle het gehoor dat daar gesê is: Oog vir oog en tand vir tand.

kjv_text: But I say unto you, That ye resist not evil: but whosoever shall smite thee on thy right cheek, turn to him the other also.
bsb_text: But I tell you not to resist an evil person. If someone slaps you on your right cheek, turn to him the other also;
aov_text: Maar Ek sê vir julle dat julle ’n slegte mens nie moet weerstaan nie; maar as iemand jou op jou regterwang slaan, draai ook die ander een na hom toe.

kjv_text: And if any man will sue thee at the law, and take away thy coat, let him have thy cloak also.
bsb_text: if someone wants to sue you and take your tunic, let him have your cloak as well;
aov_text: En hy wat met jou na die gereg wil gaan en jou onderkleed wil neem, laat hom ook die bo-kleed kry.

kjv_text: And whosoever shall compel thee to go a mile, go with him twain.
bsb_text: and if someone forces you to go one mile, go with him two miles.
aov_text: En elkeen wat van jou een myl afdwing, loop met hom twee myl saam.

kjv_text: Give to him that asketh thee, and from him that would borrow of thee turn not thou away.
bsb_text: Give to the one who asks you, and do not turn away from the one who wants to borrow from you.
aov_text: Gee aan hom wat jou iets vra, en wys hom nie af wat van jou wil leen nie.

kjv_text: Ye have heard that it hath been said, Thou shalt love thy neighbour, and hate thine enemy.
bsb_text: You have heard that it was said, ‘Love your neighbor’ and ‘Hate your enemy.’
aov_text: Julle het gehoor dat daar gesê is: Jy moet jou naaste liefhê en jou vyand moet jy haat.

kjv_text: But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;
bsb_text: But I tell you, love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you,
aov_text: Maar Ek sê vir julle: Julle moet jul vyande liefhê; seën die wat vir julle vervloek, doen goed aan die wat vir julle haat, en bid vir die wat julle beledig en julle vervolg;

kjv_text: That ye may be the children of your Father which is in heaven: for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and on the good, and sendeth rain on the just and on the unjust.
bsb_text: that you may be sons of your Father in heaven. He causes His sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the righteous and the unrighteous.
aov_text: sodat julle kinders kan word van julle Vader wat in die hemele is; want Hy laat sy son opgaan oor slegtes en goeies, en Hy laat reën op regverdiges en onregverdiges.

kjv_text: For if ye love them which love you, what reward have ye? do not even the publicans the same?
bsb_text: If you love those who love you, what reward will you get? Do not even tax collectors do the same?
aov_text: Want as julle liefhet die wat vir julle liefhet, watter loon het julle? Doen die tollenaars nie ook dieselfde nie?

kjv_text: And if ye salute your brethren only, what do ye more than others? do not even the publicans so?
bsb_text: And if you greet only your brothers, what are you doing more than others? Do not even Gentiles do the same?
aov_text: En as julle net jul broeders groet, wat besonders doen julle dan? Doen die tollenaars nie ook so nie?

kjv_text: Be ye therefore perfect, even as your Father which is in heaven is perfect.
bsb_text: Be perfect, therefore, as your heavenly Father is perfect.
aov_text: Wees julle dan volmaak soos julle Vader in die hemele volmaak is.

kjv_text: Take heed that ye do not your alms before men, to be seen of them: otherwise ye have no reward of your Father which is in heaven.
bsb_text: “Be careful not to perform your righteous acts before men to be seen by them. If you do, you will have no reward from your Father in heaven.
aov_text: PAS op dat julle nie jul liefdadigheid voor die mense bewys om deur hulle gesien te word nie; anders het julle geen loon by julle Vader wat in die hemele is nie.

kjv_text: Therefore when thou doest thine alms, do not sound a trumpet before thee, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may have glory of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
bsb_text: So when you give to the needy, do not sound a trumpet before you, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and on the streets, to be honored by men. Truly I tell you, they already have their full reward.
aov_text: Wanneer jy dan liefdadigheid bewys, moenie ’n trompet voor jou blaas soos die geveinsdes in die sinagoges en op die strate doen, dat hulle deur die mense geëer kan word nie. Voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, hulle het hul loon weg.

kjv_text: But when thou doest alms, let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doeth:
bsb_text: But when you give to the needy, do not let your left hand know what your right hand is doing,
aov_text: Maar jy, as jy liefdadigheid bewys, laat jou linkerhand nie weet wat jou regterhand doen nie,

kjv_text: That thine alms may be in secret: and thy Father which seeth in secret himself shall reward thee openly.
bsb_text: so that your giving may be in secret. And your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.
aov_text: sodat jou liefdadigheid in die verborgene kan wees; en jou Vader wat in die verborgene sien, Hy sal jou in die openbaar vergelde.

kjv_text: And when thou prayest, thou shalt not be as the hypocrites are: for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
bsb_text: And when you pray, do not be like the hypocrites. For they love to pray standing in the synagogues and on the street corners to be seen by men. Truly I tell you, they already have their full reward.
aov_text: En wanneer jy bid, moet jy nie wees soos die geveinsdes nie; want hulle hou daarvan om in die sinagoges en op die hoeke van die strate te staan en bid, om deur die mense gesien te word. Voorwaar Ek sê vir julle dat hulle hul loon weg het.

kjv_text: But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thy closet, and when thou hast shut thy door, pray to thy Father which is in secret; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly.
bsb_text: But when you pray, go into your inner room, shut your door, and pray to your Father, who is unseen. And your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.
aov_text: Maar jy, wanneer jy bid, gaan in jou binnekamer, sluit jou deur en bid jou Vader wat in die verborgene is; en jou Vader wat in die verborgene sien, sal jou in die openbaar vergelde.

kjv_text: But when ye pray, use not vain repetitions, as the heathen do: for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking.
bsb_text: And when you pray, do not babble on like pagans, for they think that by their many words they will be heard.
aov_text: En as julle bid, gebruik nie ’n ydele herhaling van woorde soos die heidene nie, want hulle dink dat hulle deur hul baie woorde verhoor sal word.

kjv_text: Be not ye therefore like unto them: for your Father knoweth what things ye have need of, before ye ask him.
bsb_text: Do not be like them, for your Father knows what you need before you ask Him.
aov_text: Moet dan nie soos hulle word nie, want jul Vader weet wat julle nodig het voordat julle Hom vra.

kjv_text: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.
bsb_text: So then, this is how you should pray: ‘Our Father in heaven, hallowed be Your name.
aov_text: Só moet julle dan bid: Onse Vader wat in die hemele is, laat u Naam geheilig word;

kjv_text: Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.
bsb_text: Your kingdom come, Your will be done, on earth as it is in heaven.
aov_text: laat u koninkryk kom; laat u wil geskied, soos in die hemel net so ook op die aarde;

kjv_text: Give us this day our daily bread.
bsb_text: Give us this day our daily bread.
aov_text: gee ons vandag ons daaglikse brood;

kjv_text: And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors.
bsb_text: And forgive us our debts, as we also have forgiven our debtors.
aov_text: en vergeef ons ons skulde, soos ons ook ons skuldenaars vergewe;

kjv_text: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil: For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.
bsb_text: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.’
aov_text: en lei ons nie in versoeking nie, maar verlos ons van die Bose. Want aan U behoort die koninkryk en die krag en die heerlikheid tot in ewigheid. Amen.

kjv_text: For if ye forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you:
bsb_text: For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.
aov_text: Want as julle die mense hulle oortredinge vergewe, sal julle hemelse Vader julle ook vergewe.

kjv_text: But if ye forgive not men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
bsb_text: But if you do not forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive yours.
aov_text: Maar as julle die mense hulle oortredinge nie vergewe nie, sal julle Vader julle oortredinge ook nie vergewe nie.

kjv_text: Moreover when ye fast, be not, as the hypocrites, of a sad countenance: for they disfigure their faces, that they may appear unto men to fast. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
bsb_text: When you fast, do not be somber like the hypocrites, for they disfigure their faces to show men they are fasting. Truly I tell you, they already have their full reward.
aov_text: En wanneer julle vas, moenie lang gesigte trek soos die geveinsdes nie; want hulle mismaak hul gesigte, sodat dit deur die mense gesien kan word dat hulle vas. Voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, hulle het hul loon weg.

kjv_text: But thou, when thou fastest, anoint thine head, and wash thy face;
bsb_text: But when you fast, anoint your head and wash your face,
aov_text: Maar jy, as jy vas, salf jou hoof en was jou gesig,

kjv_text: That thou appear not unto men to fast, but unto thy Father which is in secret: and thy Father, which seeth in secret, shall reward thee openly.
bsb_text: so that your fasting will not be obvious to men, but only to your Father, who is unseen. And your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.
aov_text: sodat jy nie die mense laat sien dat jy vas nie, maar jou Vader wat in die verborgene is; en jou Vader wat in die verborgene sien, sal jou in die openbaar vergelde.

kjv_text: Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth, where moth and rust doth corrupt, and where thieves break through and steal:
bsb_text: Do not store up for yourselves treasures on earth, where moth and rust destroy, and where thieves break in and steal.
aov_text: MOENIE vir julle skatte bymekaarmaak op die aarde, waar mot en roes verniel en waar diewe inbreek en steel nie;

kjv_text: But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt, and where thieves do not break through nor steal:
bsb_text: But store up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where moth and rust do not destroy, and where thieves do not break in and steal.
aov_text: maar maak vir julle skatte bymekaar in die hemel, waar geen mot of roes verniel nie en waar diewe nie inbreek en steel nie;

kjv_text: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
bsb_text: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.
aov_text: want waar julle skat is, daar sal julle hart ook wees.

kjv_text: The light of the body is the eye: if therefore thine eye be single, thy whole body shall be full of light.
bsb_text: The eye is the lamp of the body. If your eyes are good, your whole body will be full of light.
aov_text: Die lamp van die liggaam is die oog. As jou oog dan reg is, sal jou hele liggaam verlig wees.

kjv_text: But if thine eye be evil, thy whole body shall be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in thee be darkness, how great is that darkness!
bsb_text: But if your eyes are bad, your whole body will be full of darkness. If then the light within you is darkness, how great is that darkness!
aov_text: Maar as jou oog verkeerd is, sal jou hele liggaam donker wees. As dan die lig in jou donkerheid is, hoe groot is die donkerheid nie!

kjv_text: No man can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.
bsb_text: No one can serve two masters: Either he will hate the one and love the other, or he will be devoted to the one and despise the other. You cannot serve both God and money.
aov_text: Niemand kan twee here dien nie; want òf hy sal die een haat en die ander liefhê, òf hy sal die een aanhang en die ander verag. Julle kan nie God én Mammon dien nie!

kjv_text: Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink; nor yet for your body, what ye shall put on. Is not the life more than meat, and the body than raiment?
bsb_text: Therefore I tell you, do not worry about your life, what you will eat or drink; or about your body, what you will wear. Is not life more than food, and the body more than clothes?
aov_text: Daarom sê Ek vir julle: Moenie julle kwel oor jul lewe — wat julle sal eet en wat julle sal drink nie; of oor jul liggaam — wat julle sal aantrek nie. Is die lewe nie meer as die voedsel en die liggaam as die klere nie?

kjv_text: Behold the fowls of the air: for they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feedeth them. Are ye not much better than they?
bsb_text: Look at the birds of the air: They do not sow or reap or gather into barns—and yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Are you not much more valuable than they?
aov_text: Kyk na die voëls van die hemel; hulle saai nie en hulle maai nie en hulle bring nie bymekaar in skure nie, en tog voed julle hemelse Vader hulle. Is julle nie baie meer werd as hulle nie?

kjv_text: Which of you by taking thought can add one cubit unto his stature?
bsb_text: Who of you by worrying can add a single hour to his life?
aov_text: Wie tog onder julle kan, deur hom te kwel, een el by sy lengte voeg?

kjv_text: And why take ye thought for raiment? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin:
bsb_text: And why do you worry about clothes? Consider how the lilies of the field grow: They do not labor or spin.
aov_text: En wat kwel julle jul oor klere? Let op die lelies van die veld, hoe hulle groei; hulle arbei nie en hulle spin nie;

kjv_text: And yet I say unto you, That even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
bsb_text: Yet I tell you that not even Solomon in all his glory was adorned like one of these.
aov_text: en Ek sê vir julle dat selfs Salomo in al sy heerlikheid nie bekleed was soos een van hulle nie.

kjv_text: Wherefore, if God so clothe the grass of the field, which to day is, and to morrow is cast into the oven, shall he not much more clothe you, O ye of little faith?
bsb_text: If that is how God clothes the grass of the field, which is here today and tomorrow is thrown into the furnace, will He not much more clothe you, O you of little faith?
aov_text: As God dan die gras van die veld, wat vandag daar is en môre in ’n oond gegooi word, so beklee, hoeveel te meer vir julle, kleingelowiges?

kjv_text: Therefore take no thought, saying, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, Wherewithal shall we be clothed?
bsb_text: Therefore do not worry, saying, ‘What shall we eat?’ or ‘What shall we drink?’ or ‘What shall we wear?’
aov_text: Daarom moet julle jul nie kwel en sê: Wat sal ons eet, of wat sal ons drink, of wat sal ons aantrek nie?

kjv_text: (For after all these things do the Gentiles seek:) for your heavenly Father knoweth that ye have need of all these things.
bsb_text: For the Gentiles strive after all these things, and your heavenly Father knows that you need them.
aov_text: Want na al hierdie dinge soek die heidene; want julle hemelse Vader weet dat julle al hierdie dinge nodig het.

kjv_text: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
bsb_text: But seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, and all these things will be added unto you.
aov_text: Maar soek eers die koninkryk van God en sy geregtigheid, en al hierdie dinge sal vir julle bygevoeg word.

kjv_text: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.
bsb_text: Therefore do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about itself. Today has enough trouble of its own.
aov_text: Kwel julle dus nie oor môre nie, want môre sal hom oor sy eie dinge kwel. Elke dag het genoeg aan sy eie kwaad.

kjv_text: Judge not, that ye be not judged.
bsb_text: “Do not judge, or you will be judged.
aov_text: MOENIE oordeel nie, sodat julle nie geoordeel word nie.

kjv_text: For with what judgment ye judge, ye shall be judged: and with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you again.
bsb_text: For with the same judgment you pronounce, you will be judged; and with the measure you use, it will be measured to you.
aov_text: Want met die oordeel waarmee julle oordeel, sal julle geoordeel word; en met die maat waarmee julle meet, sal weer vir julle gemeet word.

kjv_text: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
bsb_text: Why do you look at the speck in your brother’s eye, but fail to notice the beam in your own eye?
aov_text: En waarom sien jy die splinter in die oog van jou broeder, maar die balk in jou eie oog merk jy nie op nie?

kjv_text: Or how wilt thou say to thy brother, Let me pull out the mote out of thine eye; and, behold, a beam is in thine own eye?
bsb_text: How can you say to your brother, ‘Let me take the speck out of your eye,’ while there is still a beam in your own eye?
aov_text: Of hoe sal jy vir jou broeder sê: Laat my toe om die splinter uit jou oog uit te haal, en kyk, in jou eie oog is die balk!

kjv_text: Thou hypocrite, first cast out the beam out of thine own eye; and then shalt thou see clearly to cast out the mote out of thy brother's eye.
bsb_text: You hypocrite! First take the beam out of your own eye, and then you will see clearly to remove the speck from your brother’s eye.
aov_text: Geveinsde, haal eers die balk uit jou oog uit, en dan sal jy goed sien om die splinter uit die oog van jou broeder uit te haal.

kjv_text: Give not that which is holy unto the dogs, neither cast ye your pearls before swine, lest they trample them under their feet, and turn again and rend you.
bsb_text: Do not give dogs what is holy; do not throw your pearls before swine. If you do, they may trample them under their feet, and then turn and tear you to pieces.
aov_text: Moenie wat heilig is, aan die honde gee nie; en gooi julle pêrels nie voor die varke nie, sodat hulle dit nie miskien met hulle pote vertrap en omdraai en julle verskeur nie.

kjv_text: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:
bsb_text: Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and the door will be opened to you.
aov_text: Bid, en vir julle sal gegee word; soek, en julle sal vind; klop, en vir julle sal oopgemaak word.

kjv_text: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.
bsb_text: For everyone who asks receives; he who seeks finds; and to him who knocks, the door will be opened.
aov_text: Want elkeen wat bid, ontvang; en hy wat soek, vind; en vir hom wat klop, sal oopgemaak word.

kjv_text: Or what man is there of you, whom if his son ask bread, will he give him a stone?
bsb_text: Which of you, if his son asks for bread, will give him a stone?
aov_text: Of watter mens is daar onder julle wat, as sy seun hom brood vra, aan hom ’n klip sal gee;

kjv_text: Or if he ask a fish, will he give him a serpent?
bsb_text: Or if he asks for a fish, will give him a snake?
aov_text: en as hy ’n vis vra, aan hom ’n slang sal gee?

kjv_text: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children, how much more shall your Father which is in heaven give good things to them that ask him?
bsb_text: So if you who are evil know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give good things to those who ask Him!
aov_text: As julle wat sleg is, dan weet om goeie gawes aan julle kinders te gee, hoeveel te meer sal julle Vader wat in die hemele is, goeie dinge gee aan die wat Hom bid!

kjv_text: Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.
bsb_text: In everything, then, do to others as you would have them do to you. For this is the essence of the Law and the Prophets.
aov_text: Alles wat julle dan wil hê dat die mense aan julle moet doen, net so moet julle aan hulle ook doen; want dit is die wet en die profete.

kjv_text: Enter ye in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat:
bsb_text: Enter through the narrow gate. For wide is the gate and broad is the way that leads to destruction, and many enter through it.
aov_text: Gaan in deur die nou poort, want breed is die poort en wyd is die pad wat na die verderf lei, en daar is baie wat daardeur ingaan.

kjv_text: Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leadeth unto life, and few there be that find it.
bsb_text: But small is the gate and narrow the way that leads to life, and only a few find it.
aov_text: Want die poort is nou en die pad is smal wat na die lewe lei, en daar is min wat dit vind.

kjv_text: Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.
bsb_text: Beware of false prophets. They come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly they are ravenous wolves.
aov_text: Maar pas op vir die valse profete wat in skaapsklere na julle kom en van binne roofsugtige wolwe is.

kjv_text: Ye shall know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles?
bsb_text: By their fruit you will recognize them. Are grapes gathered from thornbushes, or figs from thistles?
aov_text: Aan hulle vrugte sal julle hulle ken. ’n Mens pluk tog nie druiwe van dorings of vye van distels nie!

kjv_text: Even so every good tree bringeth forth good fruit; but a corrupt tree bringeth forth evil fruit.
bsb_text: Likewise, every good tree bears good fruit, but a bad tree bears bad fruit.
aov_text: So dra elke goeie boom goeie vrugte; maar ’n slegte boom dra slegte vrugte.

kjv_text: A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
bsb_text: A good tree cannot bear bad fruit, and a bad tree cannot bear good fruit.
aov_text: ’n Goeie boom kan geen slegte vrugte dra nie, en ’n slegte boom ook geen goeie vrugte nie.

kjv_text: Every tree that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
bsb_text: Every tree that does not bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.
aov_text: Elke boom wat nie goeie vrugte dra nie, word uitgekap en in die vuur gegooi.

kjv_text: Wherefore by their fruits ye shall know them.
bsb_text: So then, by their fruit you will recognize them.
aov_text: So sal julle hulle dan aan hul vrugte ken.

kjv_text: Not every one that saith unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven.
bsb_text: Not everyone who says to Me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only he who does the will of My Father in heaven.
aov_text: Nie elkeen wat vir My sê: Here, Here! sal ingaan in die koninkryk van die hemele nie, maar hy wat die wil doen van my Vader wat in die hemele is.

kjv_text: Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out devils? and in thy name done many wonderful works?
bsb_text: Many will say to Me on that day, ‘Lord, Lord, did we not prophesy in Your name, and in Your name drive out demons and perform many miracles?’
aov_text: Baie sal in daardie dag vir My sê: Here, Here, het ons nie in u Naam geprofeteer en in u Naam duiwels uitgedrywe en in u Naam baie kragte gedoen nie?

kjv_text: And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity.
bsb_text: Then I will tell them plainly, ‘I never knew you; depart from Me, you workers of lawlessness!’
aov_text: En dan sal Ek aan hulle sê: Ek het julle nooit geken nie. Gaan weg van My, julle wat die ongeregtigheid werk!

kjv_text: Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock:
bsb_text: Therefore everyone who hears these words of Mine and acts on them is like a wise man who built his house on the rock.
aov_text: Elkeen dan wat na hierdie woorde van My luister en dit doen, hom sal Ek vergelyk met ’n verstandige man wat sy huis op die rots gebou het.

kjv_text: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell not: for it was founded upon a rock.
bsb_text: The rain fell, the torrents raged, and the winds blew and beat against that house; yet it did not fall, because its foundation was on the rock.
aov_text: En die reën het geval en die waterstrome het gekom en die winde het gewaai en teen daardie huis aangestorm, en dit het nie geval nie, want sy fondament was op die rots.

kjv_text: And every one that heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, which built his house upon the sand:
bsb_text: But everyone who hears these words of Mine and does not act on them is like a foolish man who built his house on sand.
aov_text: En elkeen wat na hierdie woorde van My luister en dit nie doen nie, sal vergelyk word met ’n dwase man wat sy huis op die sand gebou het.

kjv_text: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell: and great was the fall of it.
bsb_text: The rain fell, the torrents raged, and the winds blew and beat against that house, and it fell—and great was its collapse!”
aov_text: En die reën het geval en die waterstrome het gekom en die winde het gewaai en teen daardie huis aangestorm en dit het geval, en sy val was groot.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when Jesus had ended these sayings, the people were astonished at his doctrine:
bsb_text: When Jesus had finished saying these things, the crowds were astonished at His teaching,
aov_text: En toe Jesus hierdie woorde geëindig het, was die skare verslae oor sy leer;

kjv_text: For he taught them as one having authority, and not as the scribes.
bsb_text: because He taught as one who had authority, and not as their scribes.
aov_text: want Hy het hulle geleer soos een wat gesag het, en nie soos die skrifgeleerdes nie.

kjv_text: When he was come down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.
bsb_text: When Jesus came down from the mountain, large crowds followed Him.
aov_text: EN toe Hy van die berg afkom, het groot menigtes Hom gevolg;

kjv_text: And, behold, there came a leper and worshipped him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
bsb_text: Suddenly a leper came and knelt before Him, saying, “Lord, if You are willing, You can make me clean.”
aov_text: en daar het ’n melaatse man gekom en voor Hom neergeval en gesê: Here, as U wil, kan U my reinig.

kjv_text: And Jesus put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will; be thou clean. And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.
bsb_text: Jesus reached out His hand and touched the man. “I am willing,” He said. “Be clean!” And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.
aov_text: Daarop steek Jesus die hand uit en raak hom aan en sê: Ek wil; word gereinig! En dadelik is hy van sy melaatsheid gereinig.

kjv_text: And Jesus saith unto him, See thou tell no man; but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
bsb_text: Then Jesus instructed him, “See that you don’t tell anyone. But go, show yourself to the priest and offer the gift prescribed by Moses, as a testimony to them.”
aov_text: En Jesus sê vir hom: Pas op dat jy dit aan niemand vertel nie, maar gaan vertoon jou aan die priester en offer die gawe wat Moses voorgeskrywe het, tot ’n getuienis vir hulle.

kjv_text: And when Jesus was entered into Capernaum, there came unto him a centurion, beseeching him,
bsb_text: When Jesus had entered Capernaum, a centurion came and pleaded with Him,
aov_text: EN nadat Jesus in Kapérnaüm ingegaan het, kom daar ’n hoofman oor honderd na Hom toe en smeek Hom

kjv_text: And saying, Lord, my servant lieth at home sick of the palsy, grievously tormented.
bsb_text: “Lord, my servant lies at home, paralyzed and in terrible agony.”
aov_text: en sê: Here, my kneg lê tuis verlam en hy ly hewige pyne.

kjv_text: And Jesus saith unto him, I will come and heal him.
bsb_text: “I will go and heal him,” Jesus replied.
aov_text: Daarop sê Jesus vir hom: Ek sal kom en hom gesond maak.

kjv_text: The centurion answered and said, Lord, I am not worthy that thou shouldest come under my roof: but speak the word only, and my servant shall be healed.
bsb_text: The centurion answered, “Lord, I am not worthy to have You come under my roof. But just say the word, and my servant will be healed.
aov_text: En die hoofman oor honderd antwoord en sê: Here, ek is nie werd dat U onder my dak inkom nie; maar spreek net ’n woord, en my kneg sal gesond word.

kjv_text: For I am a man under authority, having soldiers under me: and I say to this man, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.
bsb_text: For I myself am a man under authority, with soldiers under me. I tell one to go, and he goes; and another to come, and he comes. I tell my servant to do something, and he does it.”
aov_text: Want ek is ook ’n man onder gesag, en ek het soldate onder my. En vir hierdie een sê ek: Gaan! en hy gaan; en vir ’n ander een: Kom! en hy kom; en vir my dienskneg: Doen dit! en hy doen dit.

kjv_text: When Jesus heard it, he marvelled, and said to them that followed, Verily I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.
bsb_text: When Jesus heard this, He marveled and said to those following Him, “Truly I tell you, I have not found anyone in Israel with such great faith.
aov_text: Toe Jesus dit hoor, het Hy Hom verwonder en aan sy volgelinge gesê: Voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, selfs in Israel het Ek so ’n groot geloof nie gevind nie.

kjv_text: And I say unto you, That many shall come from the east and west, and shall sit down with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven.
bsb_text: I say to you that many will come from the east and the west to share the banquet with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the kingdom of heaven.
aov_text: Maar Ek sê vir julle dat baie sal kom van ooste en weste en saam met Abraham en Isak en Jakob sal aansit in die koninkryk van die hemele.

kjv_text: But the children of the kingdom shall be cast out into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
bsb_text: But the sons of the kingdom will be thrown into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”
aov_text: Maar die kinders van die koninkryk sal uitgedryf word in die buitenste duisternis. Daar sal geween wees en gekners van die tande.

kjv_text: And Jesus said unto the centurion, Go thy way; and as thou hast believed, so be it done unto thee. And his servant was healed in the selfsame hour.
bsb_text: Then Jesus said to the centurion, “Go! As you have believed, so will it be done for you.” And his servant was healed at that very hour.
aov_text: Toe sê Jesus vir die hoofman oor honderd: Gaan, en laat dit vir jou wees soos jy geglo het. En sy kneg het gesond geword in daardie uur.

kjv_text: And when Jesus was come into Peter's house, he saw his wife's mother laid, and sick of a fever.
bsb_text: When Jesus arrived at Peter’s house, He saw Peter’s mother-in-law sick in bed with a fever.
aov_text: EN toe Jesus in die huis van Petrus kom, sien Hy sy skoonmoeder siek lê aan die koors.

kjv_text: And he touched her hand, and the fever left her: and she arose, and ministered unto them.
bsb_text: So He touched her hand, and the fever left her, and she got up and began to serve Him.
aov_text: En Hy het haar hand aangeraak, en die koors het haar verlaat, en sy het opgestaan en hulle bedien.

kjv_text: When the even was come, they brought unto him many that were possessed with devils: and he cast out the spirits with his word, and healed all that were sick:
bsb_text: When evening came, many who were demon-possessed were brought to Jesus, and He drove out the spirits with a word and healed all the sick.
aov_text: En toe dit aand geword het, het hulle baie na Hom gebring, wat van duiwels besete was; en Hy het die geeste met ’n woord uitgedrywe; en almal wat ongesteld was, het Hy gesond gemaak,

kjv_text: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying, Himself took our infirmities, and bare our sicknesses.
bsb_text: This was to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah: “He took on our infirmities and carried our diseases.”
aov_text: sodat vervul sou word wat gespreek is deur Jesaja, die profeet, toe hy gesê het: Hy het ons krankhede op Hom geneem en ons siektes gedra.

kjv_text: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes about him, he gave commandment to depart unto the other side.
bsb_text: When Jesus saw a large crowd around Him, He gave orders to cross to the other side of the sea.
aov_text: EN toe Jesus groot menigtes rondom Hom sien, het Hy bevel gegee om te vertrek na die oorkant.

kjv_text: And a certain scribe came, and said unto him, Master, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.
bsb_text: And one of the scribes came to Him and said, “Teacher, I will follow You wherever You go.”
aov_text: En ’n sekere skrifgeleerde het gekom en vir Hom gesê: Meester, ek sal U volg waar U ook al mag gaan.

kjv_text: And Jesus saith unto him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.
bsb_text: Jesus replied, “Foxes have dens and birds of the air have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay His head.”
aov_text: En Jesus sê vir hom: Die jakkalse het gate en die voëls van die hemel neste, maar die Seun van die mens het geen plek waar Hy sy hoof kan neerlê nie.

kjv_text: And another of his disciples said unto him, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.
bsb_text: Another of His disciples requested, “Lord, first let me go and bury my father.”
aov_text: En ’n ander een van sy dissipels het vir Hom gesê: Here, laat my toe om eers te gaan en my vader te begrawe.

kjv_text: But Jesus said unto him, Follow me; and let the dead bury their dead.
bsb_text: But Jesus told him, “Follow Me, and let the dead bury their own dead.”
aov_text: Maar Jesus sê vir hom: Volg My, en laat die dooies hul eie dooies begrawe.

kjv_text: And when he was entered into a ship, his disciples followed him.
bsb_text: When He got into the boat, His disciples followed Him.
aov_text: EN toe Hy in die skuit klim, het sy dissipels Hom gevolg.

kjv_text: And, behold, there arose a great tempest in the sea, insomuch that the ship was covered with the waves: but he was asleep.
bsb_text: Suddenly a violent storm came up on the sea, so that the boat was engulfed by the waves; but Jesus was sleeping.
aov_text: En daar het ’n groot storm op die see gekom, sodat die skuit toe was onder die golwe; maar Hy was aan die slaap.

kjv_text: And his disciples came to him, and awoke him, saying, Lord, save us: we perish.
bsb_text: The disciples went and woke Him, saying, “Lord, save us! We are perishing!”
aov_text: Daarop kom sy dissipels en maak Hom wakker en sê: Here, red ons, ons vergaan!

kjv_text: And he saith unto them, Why are ye fearful, O ye of little faith? Then he arose, and rebuked the winds and the sea; and there was a great calm.
bsb_text: “You of little faith,” Jesus replied, “why are you so afraid?” Then He got up and rebuked the winds and the sea, and it was perfectly calm.
aov_text: En Hy sê vir hulle: Waarom is julle bang, kleingelowiges? Toe staan Hy op en bestraf die winde en die see, en daar het ’n groot stilte gekom.

kjv_text: But the men marvelled, saying, What manner of man is this, that even the winds and the sea obey him!
bsb_text: The men were amazed and asked, “What kind of man is this? Even the winds and the sea obey Him!”
aov_text: En die manne het hulle verwonder en gesê: Wat vir ’n mens is Hy, dat selfs die winde en die see Hom gehoorsaam is?

kjv_text: And when he was come to the other side into the country of the Gergesenes, there met him two possessed with devils, coming out of the tombs, exceeding fierce, so that no man might pass by that way.
bsb_text: When Jesus arrived on the other side in the region of the Gadarenes, He was met by two demon-possessed men coming from the tombs. They were so violent that no one could pass that way.
aov_text: EN toe Hy aan die oorkant kom, in die land van die Gergeséners, het twee duiwelbesetenes Hom ontmoet, wat uit die grafte uitgekom het en baie kwaai was, sodat niemand met daardie pad kon verbygaan nie.

kjv_text: And, behold, they cried out, saying, What have we to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God? art thou come hither to torment us before the time?
bsb_text: “What do You want with us, Son of God?” they shouted. “Have You come here to torture us before the appointed time?”
aov_text: En meteens skreeu hulle en sê: Wat het ons met U te doen, Jesus, Seun van God? Het U hier gekom om ons voor die tyd te pynig?

kjv_text: And there was a good way off from them an herd of many swine feeding.
bsb_text: In the distance a large herd of pigs was feeding.
aov_text: En ver van hulle af het ’n groot trop varke gewei.

kjv_text: So the devils besought him, saying, If thou cast us out, suffer us to go away into the herd of swine.
bsb_text: So the demons begged Jesus, “If You drive us out, send us into the herd of pigs.”
aov_text: En die duiwels het Hom gesmeek en gesê: As U ons uitdryf, laat ons toe om in die trop varke te vaar.

kjv_text: And he said unto them, Go. And when they were come out, they went into the herd of swine: and, behold, the whole herd of swine ran violently down a steep place into the sea, and perished in the waters.
bsb_text: “Go!” He told them. So they came out and went into the pigs, and the whole herd rushed down the steep bank into the sea and died in the waters.
aov_text: En Hy sê vir hulle: Gaan! Toe gaan hulle uit en vaar in die trop varke in; en daar storm die hele trop varke van die krans af die see in en kom in die water om.

kjv_text: And they that kept them fled, and went their ways into the city, and told every thing, and what was befallen to the possessed of the devils.
bsb_text: Those tending the pigs ran off into the town and reported all this, including the account of the demon-possessed men.
aov_text: En die wagters het gevlug; en toe hulle in die stad kom, het hulle alles vertel, ook wat met die besetenes gebeur het.

kjv_text: And, behold, the whole city came out to meet Jesus: and when they saw him, they besought him that he would depart out of their coasts.
bsb_text: Then the whole town went out to meet Jesus. And when they saw Him, they begged Him to leave their region.
aov_text: En kyk, die hele stad het uitgekom, Jesus tegemoet; en toe hulle Hom sien, smeek hulle dat Hy uit hulle gebied moet weggaan.

kjv_text: And he entered into a ship, and passed over, and came into his own city.
bsb_text: Jesus got into a boat, crossed over, and came to His own town.
aov_text: EN nadat Hy in die skuit geklim het, het Hy oorgevaar en in sy eie stad gekom.

kjv_text: And, behold, they brought to him a man sick of the palsy, lying on a bed: and Jesus seeing their faith said unto the sick of the palsy; Son, be of good cheer; thy sins be forgiven thee.
bsb_text: Just then some men brought to Him a paralytic lying on a mat. When Jesus saw their faith, He said to the paralytic, “Take courage, son; your sins are forgiven.”
aov_text: En hulle het ’n verlamde man wat op ’n bed lê, na Hom gebring. En toe Jesus hulle geloof sien, sê Hy aan die verlamde: Seun, hou goeie moed, jou sondes is jou vergewe.

kjv_text: And, behold, certain of the scribes said within themselves, This man blasphemeth.
bsb_text: On seeing this, some of the scribes said to themselves, “This man is blaspheming!”
aov_text: En sommige van die skrifgeleerdes het by hulleself gesê: Hierdie man praat godslasterlik.

kjv_text: And Jesus knowing their thoughts said, Wherefore think ye evil in your hearts?
bsb_text: But Jesus knew what they were thinking and said, “Why do you harbor evil in your hearts?
aov_text: En toe Jesus merk wat hulle gedagtes was, sê Hy: Waarom bedink julle slegte dinge in julle harte?

kjv_text: For whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and walk?
bsb_text: Which is easier: to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up and walk?’
aov_text: Want wat is makliker, om te sê: Die sondes is jou vergewe! of om te sê: Staan op en loop?

kjv_text: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (then saith he to the sick of the palsy,) Arise, take up thy bed, and go unto thine house.
bsb_text: But so that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins...” Then He said to the paralytic, “Get up, pick up your mat, and go home.”
aov_text: Maar dat julle kan weet dat die Seun van die mens mag het om op aarde sondes te vergewe — toe sê Hy vir die verlamde man: Staan op, neem jou bed op en gaan na jou huis toe.

kjv_text: And he arose, and departed to his house.
bsb_text: And the man got up and went home.
aov_text: En hy het opgestaan en huis toe gegaan.

kjv_text: But when the multitudes saw it, they marvelled, and glorified God, which had given such power unto men.
bsb_text: When the crowds saw this, they were filled with awe and glorified God, who had given such authority to men.
aov_text: En toe die skare dit sien, was hulle verwonderd en het God verheerlik wat so ’n mag aan die mense gegee het.

kjv_text: And as Jesus passed forth from thence, he saw a man, named Matthew, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he saith unto him, Follow me. And he arose, and followed him.
bsb_text: As Jesus went on from there, He saw a man named Matthew sitting at the tax booth. “Follow Me,” He told him, and Matthew got up and followed Him.
aov_text: EN toe Jesus daarvandaan verder gaan, sien Hy ’n man met die naam van Matthéüs by die tolhuis sit; en Hy sê vir hom: Volg My. En hy het opgestaan en Hom gevolg.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, as Jesus sat at meat in the house, behold, many publicans and sinners came and sat down with him and his disciples.
bsb_text: Later, as Jesus was dining at Matthew’s house, many tax collectors and sinners came and ate with Him and His disciples.
aov_text: En terwyl Hy in die huis aan tafel was, het daar baie tollenaars en sondaars saam met Jesus en sy dissipels aan tafel gegaan.

kjv_text: And when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto his disciples, Why eateth your Master with publicans and sinners?
bsb_text: When the Pharisees saw this, they asked His disciples, “Why does your Teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?”
aov_text: En toe die Fariseërs dit sien, sê hulle vir sy dissipels: Waarom eet julle Meester saam met tollenaars en sondaars?

kjv_text: But when Jesus heard that, he said unto them, They that be whole need not a physician, but they that are sick.
bsb_text: On hearing this, Jesus said, “It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick.
aov_text: Maar toe Jesus dit hoor, sê Hy vir hulle: Die wat gesond is, het die geneesheer nie nodig nie, maar die wat ongesteld is.

kjv_text: But go ye and learn what that meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice: for I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
bsb_text: But go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy, not sacrifice.’ For I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners.”
aov_text: Maar gaan leer wat dit beteken: Ek wil barmhartigheid hê en nie offerande nie; want Ek het nie gekom om regverdiges te roep nie, maar sondaars tot bekering.

kjv_text: Then came to him the disciples of John, saying, Why do we and the Pharisees fast oft, but thy disciples fast not?
bsb_text: At that time John’s disciples came to Jesus and asked, “Why is it that we and the Pharisees fast so often, but Your disciples do not fast?”
aov_text: DAARNA kom die dissipels van Johannes na Hom en sê: Waarom vas ons en die Fariseërs dikwels, maar u dissipels vas nie?

kjv_text: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? but the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken from them, and then shall they fast.
bsb_text: Jesus replied, “How can the guests of the bridegroom mourn while He is with them? But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them; then they will fast.
aov_text: En Jesus sê vir hulle: Kan die bruilofsgaste dan treur so lank as die bruidegom by hulle is? Maar daar sal dae kom wanneer die bruidegom van hulle weggeneem word, en dan sal hulle vas.

kjv_text: No man putteth a piece of new cloth unto an old garment, for that which is put in to fill it up taketh from the garment, and the rent is made worse.
bsb_text: No one sews a patch of unshrunk cloth on an old garment. For the patch will pull away from the garment, and a worse tear will result.
aov_text: En niemand sit ’n nuwe stuk lap op ’n ou kleed nie; want die aangelapte stuk skeur van die kleed af en daar kom ’n erger skeur.

kjv_text: Neither do men put new wine into old bottles: else the bottles break, and the wine runneth out, and the bottles perish: but they put new wine into new bottles, and both are preserved.
bsb_text: Neither do men pour new wine into old wineskins. If they do, the skins will burst, the wine will spill, and the wineskins will be ruined. Instead, they pour new wine into new wineskins, and both are preserved.”
aov_text: ’n Mens gooi ook nie nuwe wyn in ou leersakke nie; anders bars die sakke en die wyn loop uit en die sakke vergaan. Maar ’n mens gooi nuwe wyn in nuwe sakke en altwee bly behoue.

kjv_text: While he spake these things unto them, behold, there came a certain ruler, and worshipped him, saying, My daughter is even now dead: but come and lay thy hand upon her, and she shall live.
bsb_text: While Jesus was saying these things, a synagogue leader came and knelt before Him. “My daughter has just died,” he said. “But come and place Your hand on her, and she will live.”
aov_text: TERWYL Hy vir hulle dit sê, kom daar ’n sekere owerste en val voor Hom neer en sê: My dogter het nou net gesterwe, maar kom en lê u hand op haar, en sy sal lewe.

kjv_text: And Jesus arose, and followed him, and so did his disciples.
bsb_text: So Jesus got up and went with him, along with His disciples.
aov_text: En Jesus het opgestaan en hom gevolg, en ook sy dissipels.

kjv_text: And, behold, a woman, which was diseased with an issue of blood twelve years, came behind him, and touched the hem of his garment:
