bsb_text: Suddenly a woman who had suffered from bleeding for twelve years came up behind Him and touched the fringe of His cloak.
aov_text: En daar het ’n vrou wat twaalf jaar lank aan bloedvloeiing gely het, van agter gekom en die soom van sy kleed aangeraak.

kjv_text: For she said within herself, If I may but touch his garment, I shall be whole.
bsb_text: She said to herself, “If only I touch His cloak, I will be healed.”
aov_text: Want sy het by haarself gesê: As ek maar net sy kleed kan aanraak, sal ek gesond word.

kjv_text: But Jesus turned him about, and when he saw her, he said, Daughter, be of good comfort; thy faith hath made thee whole. And the woman was made whole from that hour.
bsb_text: Jesus turned and saw her. “Take courage, daughter,” He said, “your faith has healed you.” And the woman was cured from that very hour.
aov_text: En Jesus het omgedraai en haar gesien en gesê: Hou goeie moed, dogter, jou geloof het jou gered. En die vrou het gesond geword van daardie uur af.

kjv_text: And when Jesus came into the ruler's house, and saw the minstrels and the people making a noise,
bsb_text: When Jesus entered the house of the synagogue leader, He saw the flute players and the noisy crowd.
aov_text: En toe Jesus in die huis van die owerste kom en die fluitspelers sien, en die skare wat te kere gaan,

kjv_text: He said unto them, Give place: for the maid is not dead, but sleepeth. And they laughed him to scorn.
bsb_text: “Go away,” He told them. “The girl is not dead, but asleep.” And they laughed at Him.
aov_text: sê Hy vir hulle: Gaan weg, want die dogtertjie is nie dood nie, maar sy slaap. En hulle het Hom uitgelag.

kjv_text: But when the people were put forth, he went in, and took her by the hand, and the maid arose.
bsb_text: After the crowd had been put outside, Jesus went in and took the girl by the hand, and she got up.
aov_text: En nadat die skare uitgedryf was, het Hy ingegaan en haar hand gegryp; en die dogtertjie het opgestaan.

kjv_text: And the fame hereof went abroad into all that land.
bsb_text: And the news about this spread throughout that region.
aov_text: En die gerug hiervan het deur daardie hele land versprei.

kjv_text: And when Jesus departed thence, two blind men followed him, crying, and saying, Thou son of David, have mercy on us.
bsb_text: As Jesus went on from there, two blind men followed Him, crying out, “Have mercy on us, Son of David!”
aov_text: EN toe Jesus daarvandaan verder gaan, het twee blindes Hom gevolg, terwyl hulle uitroep en sê: Wees ons barmhartig, Seun van Dawid!

kjv_text: And when he was come into the house, the blind men came to him: and Jesus saith unto them, Believe ye that I am able to do this? They said unto him, Yea, Lord.
bsb_text: After Jesus had entered the house, the blind men came to Him. “Do you believe that I am able to do this?” He asked. “Yes, Lord,” they answered.
aov_text: En nadat Hy in die huis gegaan het, kom die blindes na Hom toe. En Jesus sê vir hulle: Glo julle dat Ek dit kan doen? Hulle antwoord Hom: Ja, Here.

kjv_text: Then touched he their eyes, saying, According to your faith be it unto you.
bsb_text: Then He touched their eyes and said, “According to your faith will it be done to you.”
aov_text: Toe raak Hy hulle oë aan en sê: Laat dit vir julle wees volgens julle geloof.

kjv_text: And their eyes were opened; and Jesus straitly charged them, saying, See that no man know it.
bsb_text: And their eyes were opened. Jesus warned them sternly, “See that no one finds out about this!”
aov_text: En hulle oë het oopgegaan. En Jesus het hulle skerp aangespreek en gesê: Pas op, laat niemand dit te wete kom nie.

kjv_text: But they, when they were departed, spread abroad his fame in all that country.
bsb_text: But they went out and spread the news about Him throughout the land.
aov_text: Maar hulle het heengegaan en Hom in daardie hele land bekend gemaak.

kjv_text: As they went out, behold, they brought to him a dumb man possessed with a devil.
bsb_text: As they were leaving, a demon-possessed man who was mute was brought to Jesus.
aov_text: En terwyl hulle weggaan, bring die mense ’n stom man wat van die duiwel besete was, na Hom toe.

kjv_text: And when the devil was cast out, the dumb spake: and the multitudes marvelled, saying, It was never so seen in Israel.
bsb_text: And when the demon had been driven out, the man began to speak. The crowds were amazed and said, “Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel!”
aov_text: En nadat die duiwel uitgedryf was, het die stomme gepraat. En die skare het hulle verwonder en gesê: So iets is nog nooit in Israel gesien nie!

kjv_text: But the Pharisees said, He casteth out devils through the prince of the devils.
bsb_text: But the Pharisees said, “It is by the prince of demons that He drives out demons.”
aov_text: Maar die Fariseërs het gesê: Deur die owerste van die duiwels dryf Hy die duiwels uit.

kjv_text: And Jesus went about all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every sickness and every disease among the people.
bsb_text: Jesus went through all the towns and villages, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every disease and sickness.
aov_text: EN Jesus het by al die stede en dorpe rondgegaan en in hulle sinagoges geleer en die evangelie van die koninkryk verkondig en elke siekte en elke kwaal onder die volk genees.

kjv_text: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered abroad, as sheep having no shepherd.
bsb_text: When He saw the crowds, He was moved with compassion for them, because they were harassed and helpless, like sheep without a shepherd.
aov_text: En toe Hy die skare sien, het Hy innig jammer gevoel vir hulle, omdat hulle moeg en uitgeput was, soos skape wat geen herder het nie.

kjv_text: Then saith he unto his disciples, The harvest truly is plenteous, but the labourers are few;
bsb_text: Then He said to His disciples, “The harvest is plentiful, but the workers are few.
aov_text: Toe sê Hy vir sy dissipels: Die oes is wel groot, maar die arbeiders min.

kjv_text: Pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he will send forth labourers into his harvest.
bsb_text: Ask the Lord of the harvest, therefore, to send out workers into His harvest.”
aov_text: Bid dan die Here van die oes, dat Hy arbeiders in sy oes mag uitstuur.

kjv_text: And when he had called unto him his twelve disciples, he gave them power against unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal all manner of sickness and all manner of disease.
bsb_text: And calling His twelve disciples to Him, Jesus gave them authority over unclean spirits, so that they could drive them out and heal every disease and sickness.
aov_text: EN Hy het sy twaalf dissipels na Hom geroep en aan hulle mag gegee oor onreine geeste, om hulle uit te dryf en om elke siekte en elke kwaal te genees.

kjv_text: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these; The first, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother; James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother;
bsb_text: These are the names of the twelve apostles: first Simon, called Peter, and his brother Andrew; James son of Zebedee, and his brother John;
aov_text: En dit is die name van die twaalf apostels: die eerste Simon wat Petrus genoem word, en Andréas, sy broer; Jakobus, die seun van Sebedéüs, en Johannes, sy broer;

kjv_text: Philip, and Bartholomew; Thomas, and Matthew the publican; James the son of Alphaeus, and Lebbaeus, whose surname was Thaddaeus;
bsb_text: Philip and Bartholomew; Thomas and Matthew the tax collector; James son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus;
aov_text: Filippus en Bartholoméüs; Thomas en Matthéüs, die tollenaar; Jakobus, die seun van Alféüs, en Lebbéüs wat genoem word Thaddéüs;

kjv_text: Simon the Canaanite, and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.
bsb_text: Simon the Zealot, and Judas Iscariot, who betrayed Jesus.
aov_text: Simon Kananítes en Judas Iskáriot, die een wat Hom verraai het.

kjv_text: These twelve Jesus sent forth, and commanded them, saying, Go not into the way of the Gentiles, and into any city of the Samaritans enter ye not:
bsb_text: These twelve Jesus sent out with the following instructions: “Do not go onto the road of the Gentiles or enter any town of the Samaritans.
aov_text: Jesus het hierdie twaalf uitgestuur en hulle bevel gegee en gesê: Moenie gaan op pad na die heidene nie, en moenie ingaan in ’n stad van die Samaritane nie;

kjv_text: But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
bsb_text: Go rather to the lost sheep of Israel.
aov_text: maar gaan liewer na die verlore skape van die huis van Israel.

kjv_text: And as ye go, preach, saying, The kingdom of heaven is at hand.
bsb_text: As you go, preach this message: ‘The kingdom of heaven is near.’
aov_text: En gaan preek en sê: Die koninkryk van die hemele het naby gekom.

kjv_text: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, raise the dead, cast out devils: freely ye have received, freely give.
bsb_text: Heal the sick, raise the dead, cleanse the lepers, drive out demons. Freely you have received; freely give.
aov_text: Maak siekes gesond, reinig melaatses, wek dooies op, dryf duiwels uit. Julle het dit verniet ontvang, verniet moet julle dit gee.

kjv_text: Provide neither gold, nor silver, nor brass in your purses,
bsb_text: Do not carry any gold or silver or copper in your belts.
aov_text: Moenie vir julle goud of silwer of koper in julle beurse aanskaf nie;

kjv_text: Nor scrip for your journey, neither two coats, neither shoes, nor yet staves: for the workman is worthy of his meat.
bsb_text: Take no bag for the road, or second tunic, or sandals, or staff; for the worker is worthy of his provisions.
aov_text: geen reissak vir die pad of twee kledingstukke of skoene of ’n stok nie; want die arbeider is sy voedsel werd.

kjv_text: And into whatsoever city or town ye shall enter, enquire who in it is worthy; and there abide till ye go thence.
bsb_text: Whatever town or village you enter, find out who is worthy there and stay at his house until you move on.
aov_text: En in watter stad of dorp julle ook al mag ingaan, ondersoek wie daarin waardig is, en bly dáár totdat julle vertrek.

kjv_text: And when ye come into an house, salute it.
bsb_text: As you enter the home, greet its occupants.
aov_text: En as julle die huis ingaan, groet dit;

kjv_text: And if the house be worthy, let your peace come upon it: but if it be not worthy, let your peace return to you.
bsb_text: If the home is worthy, let your peace rest on it; but if it is not, let your peace return to you.
aov_text: en as die huis dit waardig is, laat julle vrede daarop kom, maar as dit nie waardig is nie, laat julle vrede na julle terugkeer.

kjv_text: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear your words, when ye depart out of that house or city, shake off the dust of your feet.
bsb_text: And if anyone will not welcome you or heed your words, shake the dust off your feet when you leave that home or town.
aov_text: En as iemand julle nie ontvang nie en na julle woorde nie luister nie, gaan uit daardie huis of daardie stad uit en skud die stof van julle voete af.

kjv_text: Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.
bsb_text: Truly I tell you, it will be more bearable for Sodom and Gomorrah on the day of judgment than for that town.
aov_text: Voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, dit sal vir die land van Sodom en Gomorra verdraagliker wees in die oordeelsdag as vir daardie stad.

kjv_text: Behold, I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves: be ye therefore wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.
bsb_text: Behold, I am sending you out like sheep among wolves; therefore be as shrewd as snakes and as innocent as doves.
aov_text: Kyk, Ek stuur julle soos skape onder die wolwe in; wees dan versigtig soos die slange en opreg soos die duiwe.

kjv_text: But beware of men: for they will deliver you up to the councils, and they will scourge you in their synagogues;
bsb_text: But beware of men; for they will hand you over to their councils and flog you in their synagogues.
aov_text: Maar pas op vir die mense; want hulle sal jul oorlewer aan regbanke, en in hulle sinagoges sal hulle julle gésel.

kjv_text: And ye shall be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them and the Gentiles.
bsb_text: On My account, you will be brought before governors and kings as witnesses to them and to the Gentiles.
aov_text: En ook voor goewerneurs en konings sal julle gebring word om My ontwil tot ’n getuienis vir hulle en vir die heidene.

kjv_text: But when they deliver you up, take no thought how or what ye shall speak: for it shall be given you in that same hour what ye shall speak.
bsb_text: But when they hand you over, do not worry about how to respond or what to say. In that hour you will be given what to say.
aov_text: Maar wanneer hulle jul oorlewer, moenie julle kwel oor hoe of wat julle sal spreek nie, want dit sal julle in daardie uur gegee word wat julle moet spreek;

kjv_text: For it is not ye that speak, but the Spirit of your Father which speaketh in you.
bsb_text: For it will not be you speaking, but the Spirit of your Father speaking through you.
aov_text: want dit is nie julle wat spreek nie, maar die Gees van julle Vader wat in julle spreek.

kjv_text: And the brother shall deliver up the brother to death, and the father the child: and the children shall rise up against their parents, and cause them to be put to death.
bsb_text: Brother will betray brother to death, and a father his child; children will rise against their parents and have them put to death.
aov_text: Maar die een broer sal die ander tot die dood oorlewer en die vader sy kind, en die kinders sal teen hulle ouers opstaan en hulle doodmaak.

kjv_text: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake: but he that endureth to the end shall be saved.
bsb_text: You will be hated by everyone because of My name, but the one who perseveres to the end will be saved.
aov_text: En julle sal deur almal gehaat word ter wille van my Naam. Maar wie volhard tot die einde toe, hy sal gered word.

kjv_text: But when they persecute you in this city, flee ye into another: for verily I say unto you, Ye shall not have gone over the cities of Israel, till the Son of man be come.
bsb_text: When they persecute you in one town, flee to the next. Truly I tell you, you will not reach all the towns of Israel before the Son of Man comes.
aov_text: En wanneer hulle julle vervolg in die een stad, vlug na die ander toe. Want voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, julle sal met die stede van Israel sekerlik nie klaar kry voordat die Seun van die mens kom nie.

kjv_text: The disciple is not above his master, nor the servant above his lord.
bsb_text: A disciple is not above his teacher, nor a servant above his master.
aov_text: ’n Leerling is nie bo die meester nie en ’n dienskneg ook nie bo sy heer nie.

kjv_text: It is enough for the disciple that he be as his master, and the servant as his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebub, how much more shall they call them of his household?
bsb_text: It is enough for a disciple to be like his teacher, and a servant like his master. If the head of the house has been called Beelzebul, how much more the members of his household!
aov_text: Dit is vir die leerling genoeg dat hy soos sy meester word en die dienskneg soos sy heer. As hulle die heer van die huis Beëlsebul genoem het, hoeveel te meer sy huisgenote!

kjv_text: Fear them not therefore: for there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known.
bsb_text: So do not be afraid of them. For there is nothing concealed that will not be disclosed, and nothing hidden that will not be made known.
aov_text: Vrees hulle dan nie; want daar is niks bedek wat nie ontdek sal word nie, en verborge wat nie bekend sal word nie.

kjv_text: What I tell you in darkness, that speak ye in light: and what ye hear in the ear, that preach ye upon the housetops.
bsb_text: What I tell you in the dark, speak in the daylight; what is whispered in your ear, proclaim from the housetops.
aov_text: Wat Ek vir julle in die donker sê, vertel dit in die lig; en wat julle in die oor hoor, verkondig dit op die dakke.

kjv_text: And fear not them which kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul: but rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell.
bsb_text: Do not be afraid of those who kill the body but cannot kill the soul. Instead, fear the One who can destroy both soul and body in hell.
aov_text: En moenie vrees vir die wat die liggaam doodmaak, maar die siel nie kan doodmaak nie; maar vrees Hom liewer wat die siel sowel as die liggaam kan verderwe in die hel.

kjv_text: Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father.
bsb_text: Are not two sparrows sold for a penny? Yet not one of them will fall to the ground apart from the will of your Father.
aov_text: Word twee mossies nie vir ’n stuiwer verkoop nie? En nie een van hulle sal op die aarde val sonder julle Vader nie.

kjv_text: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
bsb_text: And even the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
aov_text: En van julle is selfs die hare van die hoof almal getel.

kjv_text: Fear ye not therefore, ye are of more value than many sparrows.
bsb_text: So do not be afraid; you are worth more than many sparrows.
aov_text: Wees dan nie bevrees nie: julle is meer werd as baie mossies.

kjv_text: Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven.
bsb_text: Therefore everyone who confesses Me before men, I will also confess him before My Father in heaven.
aov_text: Elkeen dan wat My sal bely voor die mense, hom sal Ek ook bely voor my Vader wat in die hemele is.

kjv_text: But whosoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven.
bsb_text: But whoever denies Me before men, I will also deny him before My Father in heaven.
aov_text: Maar elkeen wat My verloën voor die mense, hom sal Ek ook verloën voor my Vader wat in die hemele is.

kjv_text: Think not that I am come to send peace on earth: I came not to send peace, but a sword.
bsb_text: Do not assume that I have come to bring peace to the earth; I have not come to bring peace, but a sword.
aov_text: Moenie dink dat Ek gekom het om vrede op die aarde te bring nie. Ek het nie gekom om vrede te bring nie, maar die swaard.

kjv_text: For I am come to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.
bsb_text: For I have come to turn ‘a man against his father, a daughter against her mother, a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.
aov_text: Want Ek het gekom om tweedrag te verwek tussen ’n man en sy vader, en tussen ’n dogter en haar moeder, en ’n skoondogter en haar skoonmoeder.

kjv_text: And a man's foes shall be they of his own household.
bsb_text: A man’s enemies will be the members of his own household.’
aov_text: En ’n mens se huisgenote sal sy vyande wees.

kjv_text: He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me: and he that loveth son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me.
bsb_text: Anyone who loves his father or mother more than Me is not worthy of Me; anyone who loves his son or daughter more than Me is not worthy of Me;
aov_text: Wie vader of moeder bo My liefhet, is My nie waardig nie; en wie seun of dogter bo My liefhet, is My nie waardig nie.

kjv_text: And he that taketh not his cross, and followeth after me, is not worthy of me.
bsb_text: and anyone who does not take up his cross and follow Me is not worthy of Me.
aov_text: En wie sy kruis nie neem en agter My volg nie, is My nie waardig nie.

kjv_text: He that findeth his life shall lose it: and he that loseth his life for my sake shall find it.
bsb_text: Whoever finds his life will lose it, and whoever loses his life for My sake will find it.
aov_text: Wie sy lewe vind, sal dit verloor; en wie sy lewe verloor om My ontwil, sal dit vind.

kjv_text: He that receiveth you receiveth me, and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.
bsb_text: He who receives you receives Me, and he who receives Me receives the One who sent Me.
aov_text: Wie julle ontvang, ontvang My; en wie My ontvang, ontvang Hom wat My gestuur het.

kjv_text: He that receiveth a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet's reward; and he that receiveth a righteous man in the name of a righteous man shall receive a righteous man's reward.
bsb_text: Whoever receives a prophet because he is a prophet will receive a prophet’s reward, and whoever receives a righteous man because he is a righteous man will receive a righteous man’s reward.
aov_text: Wie ’n profeet ontvang omdat hy ’n profeet is, sal die loon van ’n profeet ontvang; en wie ’n regverdige ontvang omdat hy ’n regverdige is, sal die loon van ’n regverdige ontvang.

kjv_text: And whosoever shall give to drink unto one of these little ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple, verily I say unto you, he shall in no wise lose his reward.
bsb_text: And if anyone gives even a cup of cold water to one of these little ones because he is My disciple, truly I tell you, he will never lose his reward.”
aov_text: En elkeen wat een van hierdie kleintjies net ’n beker kou water laat drink, omdat hy ’n dissipel is, voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, hy sal sy loon sekerlik nie verloor nie.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when Jesus had made an end of commanding his twelve disciples, he departed thence to teach and to preach in their cities.
bsb_text: After Jesus had finished instructing His twelve disciples, He went on from there to teach and preach in their cities.
aov_text: EN toe Jesus klaar was met bevele aan sy twaalf dissipels te gee, het Hy daarvandaan weggegaan om te leer en te preek in hulle stede.

kjv_text: Now when John had heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples,
bsb_text: Meanwhile John heard in prison about the works of Christ, and he sent his disciples
aov_text: En Johannes het in die gevangenis gehoor van die werke van Christus, en twee van sy dissipels gestuur

kjv_text: And said unto him, Art thou he that should come, or do we look for another?
bsb_text: to ask Him, “Are You the One who was to come, or should we look for someone else?”
aov_text: en vir Hom gesê: Is U die Een wat sou kom, of moet ons ’n ander een verwag?

kjv_text: Jesus answered and said unto them, Go and shew John again those things which ye do hear and see:
bsb_text: Jesus replied, “Go back and report to John what you hear and see:
aov_text: En Jesus het geantwoord en vir hulle gesê: Gaan vertel aan Johannes wat julle hoor en sien:

kjv_text: The blind receive their sight, and the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have the gospel preached to them.
bsb_text: The blind receive sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, and the good news is preached to the poor.
aov_text: blindes sien weer en kreupeles loop, melaatses word gereinig en dowes hoor, dooies word opgewek en aan armes word die evangelie verkondig.

kjv_text: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.
bsb_text: Blessed is the one who does not fall away on account of Me.”
aov_text: En salig is elkeen wat aan My nie aanstoot neem nie.

kjv_text: And as they departed, Jesus began to say unto the multitudes concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken with the wind?
bsb_text: As John’s disciples were leaving, Jesus began to speak to the crowds about John: “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed swaying in the wind?
aov_text: En toe hulle vertrek, begin Jesus vir die skare aangaande Johannes te sê: Wat het julle uitgegaan om in die woestyn te aanskou? ’n Riet wat deur die wind beweeg word?

kjv_text: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? behold, they that wear soft clothing are in kings' houses.
bsb_text: Otherwise, what did you go out to see? A man dressed in fine clothes? Look, those who wear fine clothing are found in kings’ palaces.
aov_text: Maar wat het julle uitgegaan om te sien? ’n Man met sagte klere aan? Kyk, die wat sagte klere dra, is in die huise van konings.

kjv_text: But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? yea, I say unto you, and more than a prophet.
bsb_text: What then did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and more than a prophet.
aov_text: Maar wat het julle uitgegaan om te sien? ’n Profeet? Ja, Ek sê vir julle, ook baie meer as ’n profeet!

kjv_text: For this is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.
bsb_text: This is the one about whom it is written: ‘Behold, I will send My messenger ahead of You, who will prepare Your way before You.’
aov_text: Want dit is hy van wie daar geskrywe is: Kyk, Ek stuur my boodskapper voor u aangesig, wat u weg voor U uit sal regmaak.

kjv_text: Verily I say unto you, Among them that are born of women there hath not risen a greater than John the Baptist: notwithstanding he that is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.
bsb_text: Truly I tell you, among those born of women there has risen no one greater than John the Baptist. Yet even the least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.
aov_text: Voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, onder die wat uit vroue gebore is, het daar nie een opgestaan wat groter is as Johannes die Doper nie; maar die kleinste in die koninkryk van die hemele is groter as hy.

kjv_text: And from the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence, and the violent take it by force.
bsb_text: From the days of John the Baptist until now, the kingdom of heaven has been subject to violence, and the violent lay claim to it.
aov_text: Maar van die dae van Johannes die Doper af tot nou toe word die koninkryk van die hemele bestorm, en bestormers gryp dit met geweld.

kjv_text: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.
bsb_text: For all the Prophets and the Law prophesied until John.
aov_text: Want al die profete en die wet het tot op Johannes geprofeteer.

kjv_text: And if ye will receive it, this is Elias, which was for to come.
bsb_text: And if you are willing to accept it, he is the Elijah who was to come.
aov_text: En as julle dit wil aanneem: hy is Elía wat sou kom.

kjv_text: He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
bsb_text: He who has ears, let him hear.
aov_text: Wie ore het om te hoor, laat hom hoor.

kjv_text: But whereunto shall I liken this generation? It is like unto children sitting in the markets, and calling unto their fellows,
bsb_text: To what can I compare this generation? They are like children sitting in the marketplaces and calling out to others:
aov_text: Maar waarmee sal Ek hierdie geslag vergelyk? Dit is net soos kindertjies wat op die markte sit en na hulle maats roep

kjv_text: And saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned unto you, and ye have not lamented.
bsb_text: ‘We played the flute for you, and you did not dance; we sang a dirge, and you did not mourn.’
aov_text: en sê: Ons het vir julle op die fluit gespeel, en julle het nie gedans nie; ons het vir julle ’n klaaglied gesing, en julle het nie getreur nie.

kjv_text: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, He hath a devil.
bsb_text: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, ‘He has a demon!’
aov_text: Want Johannes het gekom en nie geëet of gedrink nie, en hulle sê: Hy het ’n duiwel.

kjv_text: The Son of man came eating and drinking, and they say, Behold a man gluttonous, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners. But wisdom is justified of her children.
bsb_text: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, ‘Look at this glutton and drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’ But wisdom is vindicated by her actions.”
aov_text: Die Seun van die mens het gekom — Hy eet en drink, en hulle sê: Dáár is ’n mens wat ’n vraat en ’n wynsuiper is, ’n vriend van tollenaars en sondaars. Maar die wysheid is geregverdig deur sy kinders.

kjv_text: Then began he to upbraid the cities wherein most of his mighty works were done, because they repented not:
bsb_text: Then Jesus began to denounce the cities in which most of His miracles had been performed, because they did not repent.
aov_text: TOE het Hy die stede waarin die meeste van sy kragtige dade plaasgevind het, begin verwyt, omdat hulle hul nie bekeer het nie:

kjv_text: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works, which were done in you, had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.
bsb_text: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the miracles that were performed in you had been performed in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.
aov_text: Wee jou, Górasin, wee jou, Betsáida! want as in Tirus en Sidon die kragtige dade plaasgevind het wat in julle plaasgevind het, sou hulle hul lankal in sak en as bekeer het.

kjv_text: But I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the day of judgment, than for you.
bsb_text: But I tell you, it will be more bearable for Tyre and Sidon on the day of judgment than for you.
aov_text: Maar Ek sê vir julle, dit sal vir Tirus en Sidon verdraagliker wees in die oordeelsdag as vir julle.

kjv_text: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted unto heaven, shalt be brought down to hell: for if the mighty works, which have been done in thee, had been done in Sodom, it would have remained until this day.
bsb_text: And you, Capernaum, will you be lifted up to heaven? No, you will be brought down to Hades! For if the miracles that were performed in you had been performed in Sodom, it would have remained to this day.
aov_text: En jy, Kapérnaüm, wat tot die hemel toe verhoog is, jy sal tot die doderyk toe neergestoot word; want as in Sodom die kragtige dade plaasgevind het wat in jou plaasgevind het, sou hy bly staan het tot vandag toe.

kjv_text: But I say unto you, That it shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom in the day of judgment, than for thee.
bsb_text: But I tell you that it will be more bearable for Sodom on the day of judgment than for you.”
aov_text: Maar Ek sê vir julle dat dit vir die land van Sodom verdraagliker sal wees in die oordeelsdag as vir jou.

kjv_text: At that time Jesus answered and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes.
bsb_text: At that time Jesus declared, “I praise You, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because You have hidden these things from the wise and learned, and revealed them to little children.
aov_text: IN daardie tyd het Jesus gespreek en gesê: Ek loof U, Vader, Here van die hemel en die aarde, dat U hierdie dinge verberg het vir wyse en verstandige mense en dit aan kindertjies geopenbaar het.

kjv_text: Even so, Father: for so it seemed good in thy sight.
bsb_text: Yes, Father, for this was well-pleasing in Your sight.
aov_text: Ja, Vader, want so was dit u welbehae.

kjv_text: All things are delivered unto me of my Father: and no man knoweth the Son, but the Father; neither knoweth any man the Father, save the Son, and he to whomsoever the Son will reveal him.
bsb_text: All things have been entrusted to Me by My Father. No one knows the Son except the Father, and no one knows the Father except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal Him.
aov_text: Alles is aan My oorgegee deur my Vader, en niemand ken die Seun nie, behalwe die Vader; ook ken niemand die Vader nie, behalwe die Seun en elkeen aan wie die Seun dit wil openbaar.

kjv_text: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
bsb_text: Come to Me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.
aov_text: Kom na My toe, almal wat vermoeid en belas is, en Ek sal julle rus gee.

kjv_text: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.
bsb_text: Take My yoke upon you and learn from Me; for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.
aov_text: Neem my juk op julle en leer van My, want Ek is sagmoedig en nederig van hart, en julle sal rus vind vir julle siele;

kjv_text: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.
bsb_text: For My yoke is easy and My burden is light.”
aov_text: want my juk is sag en my las is lig.

kjv_text: At that time Jesus went on the sabbath day through the corn; and his disciples were an hungred, and began to pluck the ears of corn, and to eat.
bsb_text: At that time Jesus went through the grainfields on the Sabbath. His disciples were hungry and began to pick the heads of grain and eat them.
aov_text: IN daardie tyd het Jesus op die sabbat deur die gesaaides geloop, en sy dissipels het honger geword en are begin pluk en eet.

kjv_text: But when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto him, Behold, thy disciples do that which is not lawful to do upon the sabbath day.
bsb_text: When the Pharisees saw this, they said to Him, “Look, Your disciples are doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath.”
aov_text: Maar toe die Fariseërs dit sien, sê hulle vir Hom: Kyk, u dissipels doen wat nie geoorloof is om op die sabbat te doen nie.

kjv_text: But he said unto them, Have ye not read what David did, when he was an hungred, and they that were with him;
bsb_text: Jesus replied, “Have you not read what David did when he and his companions were hungry?
aov_text: Maar Hy sê vir hulle: Het julle nie gelees wat Dawid gedoen het nie — toe hy en die wat saam met hom was, honger gehad het  —

kjv_text: How he entered into the house of God, and did eat the shewbread, which was not lawful for him to eat, neither for them which were with him, but only for the priests?
bsb_text: He entered the house of God, and he and his companions ate the consecrated bread, which was not lawful for them to eat, but only for the priests.
aov_text: hoe hy in die huis van God gegaan en die toonbrode geëet het wat vir hom en die wat saam met hom was, nie geoorloof was om te eet nie, maar net vir die priesters alleen?

kjv_text: Or have ye not read in the law, how that on the sabbath days the priests in the temple profane the sabbath, and are blameless?
bsb_text: Or haven’t you read in the Law that on the Sabbath the priests in the temple break the Sabbath and yet are innocent?
aov_text: Of het julle nie in die wet gelees dat die priesters op die sabbat in die tempel die sabbat ontheilig en onskuldig is nie?

kjv_text: But I say unto you, That in this place is one greater than the temple.
bsb_text: But I tell you that something greater than the temple is here.
aov_text: En Ek sê vir julle: Een wat groter is as die tempel, is hier.

kjv_text: But if ye had known what this meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice, ye would not have condemned the guiltless.
bsb_text: If only you had known the meaning of ‘I desire mercy, not sacrifice,’ you would not have condemned the innocent.
aov_text: Maar as julle geweet het wat dit beteken: Ek wil barmhartigheid hê en nie offerande nie, sou julle die onskuldiges nie veroordeel het nie;

kjv_text: For the Son of man is Lord even of the sabbath day.
bsb_text: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”
aov_text: want die Seun van die mens is Here óók van die sabbat.

kjv_text: And when he was departed thence, he went into their synagogue:
bsb_text: Moving on from there, Jesus entered their synagogue,
aov_text: EN Hy het daarvandaan weggegaan en in hulle sinagoge gekom.

kjv_text: And, behold, there was a man which had his hand withered. And they asked him, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath days? that they might accuse him.
bsb_text: and a man with a withered hand was there. In order to accuse Jesus, they asked Him, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?”
aov_text: En daar was ’n man met ’n verdorde hand, en hulle het Hom gevra en gesê: Is dit geoorloof om op die sabbat gesond te maak?  — sodat hulle Hom sou kan aanklae.

kjv_text: And he said unto them, What man shall there be among you, that shall have one sheep, and if it fall into a pit on the sabbath day, will he not lay hold on it, and lift it out?
bsb_text: He replied, “If one of you has a sheep and it falls into a pit on the Sabbath, will he not take hold of it and lift it out?
aov_text: Maar Hy sê vir hulle: Watter mens sal daar onder julle wees wat een skaap het, en as dit op die sabbat in ’n sloot val, dit nie sal gryp en uithaal nie?

kjv_text: How much then is a man better than a sheep? Wherefore it is lawful to do well on the sabbath days.
bsb_text: How much more valuable is a man than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath.”
aov_text: Hoeveel meer is ’n mens dan nie werd as ’n skaap nie! So is dit dan geoorloof om op die sabbat goed te doen.

kjv_text: Then saith he to the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it forth; and it was restored whole, like as the other.
bsb_text: Then Jesus said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” So he stretched it out, and it was restored to full use, just like the other.
aov_text: Toe sê Hy vir die man: Steek jou hand uit! En hy het dit uitgesteek, en dit is herstel, gesond soos die ander een.

kjv_text: Then the Pharisees went out, and held a council against him, how they might destroy him.
bsb_text: But the Pharisees went out and plotted how they might kill Jesus.
aov_text: Daarop het die Fariseërs uitgegaan en saam raad gehou teen Hom, sodat hulle Hom sou kan ombring.

kjv_text: But when Jesus knew it, he withdrew himself from thence: and great multitudes followed him, and he healed them all;
bsb_text: Aware of this, Jesus withdrew from that place. Large crowds followed Him, and He healed them all,
aov_text: Toe Jesus dit bemerk, het Hy daarvandaan weggegaan, en groot menigtes het Hom gevolg, en Hy het hulle almal gesond gemaak,

kjv_text: And charged them that they should not make him known:
bsb_text: warning them not to make Him known.
aov_text: en hulle ’n streng bevel gegee dat hulle Hom nie bekend moes maak nie,

kjv_text: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,
bsb_text: This was to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah:
aov_text: sodat vervul sou word die woord wat gespreek is deur Jesaja, die profeet:

kjv_text: Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the Gentiles.
bsb_text: “Here is My Servant, whom I have chosen, My beloved, in whom My soul delights. I will put My Spirit on Him, and He will proclaim justice to the nations.
aov_text: Kyk, my Kneg wat Ek uitverkies het, my Geliefde in wie my siel ’n welbehae het! Ek sal my Gees op Hom lê, en Hy sal aan die nasies die reg aankondig.

kjv_text: He shall not strive, nor cry; neither shall any man hear his voice in the streets.
bsb_text: He will not quarrel or cry out; no one will hear His voice in the streets.
aov_text: Hy sal nie twis of uitroep nie, en niemand sal sy stem op die strate hoor nie.

kjv_text: A bruised reed shall he not break, and smoking flax shall he not quench, till he send forth judgment unto victory.
bsb_text: A bruised reed He will not break, and a smoldering wick He will not extinguish, till He leads justice to victory.
aov_text: ’n Geknakte riet sal Hy nie verbreek nie, en ’n lamppit wat rook, sal Hy nie uitblus nie, totdat Hy die reg tot oorwinning uitbring.

kjv_text: And in his name shall the Gentiles trust.
bsb_text: In His name the nations will put their hope.”
aov_text: En op sy Naam sal die heidene hoop.

kjv_text: Then was brought unto him one possessed with a devil, blind, and dumb: and he healed him, insomuch that the blind and dumb both spake and saw.
bsb_text: Then a demon-possessed man who was blind and mute was brought to Jesus, and He healed the man so that he could speak and see.
aov_text: TOE het hulle ’n duiwelbesetene wat blind en stom was, na Hom gebring; en Hy het hom gesond gemaak, sodat die blinde en stomme kon praat en sien.

kjv_text: And all the people were amazed, and said, Is not this the son of David?
bsb_text: The crowds were astounded and asked, “Could this be the Son of David?”
aov_text: En die hele menigte was verbaas en het gesê: Is Hy nie miskien die seun van Dawid nie?

kjv_text: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, This fellow doth not cast out devils, but by Beelzebub the prince of the devils.
bsb_text: But when the Pharisees heard this, they said, “Only by Beelzebul, the prince of demons, does this man drive out demons.”
aov_text: Maar toe die Fariseërs dit hoor, sê hulle: Hy dryf die duiwels nie anders uit as deur Beëlsebul, die owerste van die duiwels, nie.

kjv_text: And Jesus knew their thoughts, and said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand:
bsb_text: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself will be laid waste, and every city or household divided against itself will not stand.
aov_text: Maar Jesus het hulle gedagtes geken en vir hulle gesê: Elke koninkryk wat teen homself verdeeld is, word verwoes; en elke stad of huis wat teen homself verdeeld is, sal nie bly staan nie.

kjv_text: And if Satan cast out Satan, he is divided against himself; how shall then his kingdom stand?
bsb_text: If Satan drives out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then can his kingdom stand?
aov_text: En as die Satan die Satan uitdryf, dan is hy teen homself verdeeld. Hoe sal sy koninkryk dan bly staan?

kjv_text: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your children cast them out? therefore they shall be your judges.
bsb_text: And if I drive out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your sons drive them out? So then, they will be your judges.
aov_text: En as Ek deur Beëlsebul die duiwels uitdryf, deur wie dryf julle seuns hulle uit? Daarom sal hulle jul regters wees.

kjv_text: But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God is come unto you.
bsb_text: But if I drive out demons by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.
aov_text: Maar as Ek deur die Gees van God die duiwels uitdryf, dan het die koninkryk van God by julle gekom.

kjv_text: Or else how can one enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.
bsb_text: Or again, how can anyone enter a strong man’s house and steal his possessions, unless he first ties up the strong man? Then he can plunder his house.
aov_text: Of hoe kan iemand in die huis van ’n sterk man ingaan en sy goed roof, as hy nie eers die sterk man geboei het nie? En dan sal hy sy huis beroof.

kjv_text: He that is not with me is against me; and he that gathereth not with me scattereth abroad.
bsb_text: He who is not with Me is against Me, and he who does not gather with Me scatters.
aov_text: Hy wat nie met My is nie, is teen My; en hy wat nie saam met My versamel nie, verstrooi.

kjv_text: Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy against the Holy Ghost shall not be forgiven unto men.
bsb_text: Therefore I tell you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven.
aov_text: Daarom sê Ek vir julle: Elke sonde en lastering sal die mense vergewe word, maar die lastering teen die Gees sal die mense nie vergewe word nie.

kjv_text: And whosoever speaketh a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but whosoever speaketh against the Holy Ghost, it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this world, neither in the world to come.
bsb_text: Whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven, either in this age or in the one to come.
aov_text: En elkeen wat ’n woord spreek teen die Seun van die mens, dit sal hom vergewe word; maar elkeen wat spreek teen die Heilige Gees, dit sal hom nie vergewe word nie, in hierdie eeu nie en ook in die toekomende nie.

kjv_text: Either make the tree good, and his fruit good; or else make the tree corrupt, and his fruit corrupt: for the tree is known by his fruit.
bsb_text: Make a tree good and its fruit will be good, or make a tree bad and its fruit will be bad; for a tree is known by its fruit.
aov_text: JULLE moet òf die boom goed maak en sy vrugte goed, òf julle moet die boom sleg maak en sy vrugte sleg; want aan die vrugte word die boom geken.

kjv_text: O generation of vipers, how can ye, being evil, speak good things? for out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaketh.
bsb_text: You brood of vipers, how can you who are evil say anything good? For out of the overflow of the heart, the mouth speaks.
aov_text: Addergeslag, hoe kan julle goeie dinge praat terwyl julle sleg is? Want uit die oorvloed van die hart praat die mond.

kjv_text: A good man out of the good treasure of the heart bringeth forth good things: and an evil man out of the evil treasure bringeth forth evil things.
bsb_text: The good man brings good things out of his good store of treasure, and the evil man brings evil things out of his evil store of treasure.
aov_text: Die goeie mens bring uit die goeie skat van sy hart goeie dinge te voorskyn, en die slegte mens bring uit die slegte skat slegte dinge te voorskyn.

kjv_text: But I say unto you, That every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment.
bsb_text: But I tell you that men will give an account on the day of judgment for every careless word they have spoken.
aov_text: Maar Ek sê vir julle dat van elke ydele woord wat die mense praat, daarvan moet hulle rekenskap gee in die oordeelsdag.

kjv_text: For by thy words thou shalt be justified, and by thy words thou shalt be condemned.
bsb_text: For by your words you will be acquitted, and by your words you will be condemned.”
aov_text: Want uit jou woorde sal jy geregverdig word, en uit jou woorde sal jy veroordeel word.

kjv_text: Then certain of the scribes and of the Pharisees answered, saying, Master, we would see a sign from thee.
bsb_text: Then some of the scribes and Pharisees said to Him, “Teacher, we want to see a sign from You.”
aov_text: TOE spreek sommige van die skrifgeleerdes en Fariseërs en sê: Meester, ons wil graag ’n teken van U sien.

kjv_text: But he answered and said unto them, An evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given to it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas:
bsb_text: Jesus replied, “A wicked and adulterous generation demands a sign, but none will be given it except the sign of the prophet Jonah.
aov_text: Maar Hy antwoord en sê vir hulle: ’n Slegte en owerspelige geslag soek na ’n teken, en geen teken sal aan hom gegee word nie, behalwe die teken van die profeet Jona.

kjv_text: For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale's belly; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
bsb_text: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the great fish, so the Son of Man will be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
aov_text: Want soos Jona drie dae en drie nagte in die buik van die groot vis was, só sal die Seun van die mens drie dae en drie nagte in die hart van die aarde wees.

kjv_text: The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: because they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.
bsb_text: The men of Nineveh will stand at the judgment with this generation and condemn it; for they repented at the preaching of Jonah, and now One greater than Jonah is here.
aov_text: Die manne van Ninevé sal in die oordeel opstaan saam met hierdie geslag en dit veroordeel; want hulle het hul op die prediking van Jona bekeer, en — meer as Jona is hier!

kjv_text: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for she came from the uttermost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.
bsb_text: The Queen of the South will rise at the judgment with this generation and condemn it; for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon, and now One greater than Solomon is here.
aov_text: Die koningin van die Suide sal in die oordeel opstaan saam met hierdie geslag en dit veroordeel; want sy het gekom van die eindes van die aarde af om die wysheid van Salomo te hoor, en — meer as Salomo is hier!

kjv_text: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest, and findeth none.
bsb_text: When an unclean spirit comes out of a man, it passes through arid places seeking rest and does not find it.
aov_text: En wanneer die onreine gees uit die mens uitgegaan het, gaan hy deur waterlose plekke en soek rus en vind dit nie.

kjv_text: Then he saith, I will return into my house from whence I came out; and when he is come, he findeth it empty, swept, and garnished.
bsb_text: Then it says, ‘I will return to the house I left.’ On its return, it finds the house vacant, swept clean, and put in order.
aov_text: Dan sê hy: Ek sal teruggaan na my huis waar ek uitgegaan het. En hy kom en vind dit leeg, uitgeveeg en versier.

kjv_text: Then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first. Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation.
bsb_text: Then it goes and brings with it seven other spirits more wicked than itself, and they go in and dwell there; and the final plight of that man is worse than the first. So will it be with this wicked generation.”
aov_text: Dan gaan hy en neem sewe ander geeste slegter as hy self met hom saam, en hulle kom in en woon daar; en die laaste van daardie mens word erger as die eerste. Só sal dit ook wees met hierdie bose geslag.

kjv_text: While he yet talked to the people, behold, his mother and his brethren stood without, desiring to speak with him.
bsb_text: While Jesus was still speaking to the crowds, His mother and brothers stood outside, wanting to speak to Him.
aov_text: EN terwyl Hy nog met die skare spreek, staan sy moeder en broers daarbuite en wou graag met Hom praat.

kjv_text: Then one said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to speak with thee.
bsb_text: Someone told Him, “Look, Your mother and brothers are standing outside, wanting to speak to You.”
aov_text: Toe sê iemand vir Hom: Dáár staan u moeder en u broers buite en wil graag met U praat.

kjv_text: But he answered and said unto him that told him, Who is my mother? and who are my brethren?
bsb_text: But Jesus replied, “Who is My mother, and who are My brothers?”
aov_text: Maar Hy antwoord en sê vir die een wat Hom dit vertel het: Wie is my moeder? En wie is my broers?

kjv_text: And he stretched forth his hand toward his disciples, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!
bsb_text: Pointing to His disciples, He said, “Here are My mother and My brothers.
aov_text: En Hy steek sy hand oor sy dissipels uit en sê: Dáár is my moeder en my broers.

kjv_text: For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.
bsb_text: For whoever does the will of My Father in heaven is My brother and sister and mother.”
aov_text: Want elkeen wat die wil doen van my Vader wat in die hemele is, dié is my broer en suster en moeder.

kjv_text: The same day went Jesus out of the house, and sat by the sea side.
bsb_text: That same day Jesus went out of the house and sat by the sea.
aov_text: EN op daardie dag het Jesus uit die huis uitgegaan en by die see gaan sit.

kjv_text: And great multitudes were gathered together unto him, so that he went into a ship, and sat; and the whole multitude stood on the shore.
bsb_text: Such large crowds gathered around Him that He got into a boat and sat down, while all the people stood on the shore.
aov_text: En groot menigtes het by Hom vergader, sodat Hy in ’n skuit geklim en gaan sit het. En die hele skare het op die strand gestaan.

kjv_text: And he spake many things unto them in parables, saying,
bsb_text: And He told them many things in parables, saying,
aov_text: En Hy het baie dinge deur gelykenisse tot hulle gespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: Behold, a sower went forth to sow;
bsb_text: “A farmer went out to sow his seed.
aov_text: ’n Saaier het uitgegaan om te saai;

kjv_text: And when he sowed, some seeds fell by the way side, and the fowls came and devoured them up:
bsb_text: And as he was sowing, some seed fell along the path, and the birds came and devoured it.
aov_text: en terwyl hy saai, val ’n deel langs die pad, en die voëls het gekom en dit opgeëet.

kjv_text: Some fell upon stony places, where they had not much earth: and forthwith they sprung up, because they had no deepness of earth:
bsb_text: Some fell on rocky ground, where it did not have much soil. It sprang up quickly because the soil was shallow.
aov_text: En ’n ander deel het op rotsagtige plekke geval waar daar nie baie grond was nie; en dadelik het dit opgekom, omdat daar geen diepte van grond was nie;

kjv_text: And when the sun was up, they were scorched; and because they had no root, they withered away.
bsb_text: But when the sun rose, the seedlings were scorched, and they withered because they had no root.
aov_text: maar toe die son opgaan, is dit verskroei, en omdat dit geen wortel gehad het nie, het dit verdroog.

kjv_text: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprung up, and choked them:
bsb_text: Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up and choked the seedlings.
aov_text: En ’n ander deel het in die dorings geval, en die dorings het opgekom en dit verstik.

kjv_text: But other fell into good ground, and brought forth fruit, some an hundredfold, some sixtyfold, some thirtyfold.
bsb_text: Still other seed fell on good soil and produced a crop—a hundredfold, sixtyfold, or thirtyfold.
aov_text: En ’n ander deel het in die goeie grond geval en vrug opgelewer: die een honderd-, die ander sestig-, die ander dertigvoudig.

kjv_text: Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
bsb_text: He who has ears, let him hear.”
aov_text: Wie ore het om te hoor, laat hom hoor!

kjv_text: And the disciples came, and said unto him, Why speakest thou unto them in parables?
bsb_text: Then the disciples came to Jesus and asked, “Why do You speak to the people in parables?”
aov_text: En die dissipels het gekom en vir Hom gesê: Waarom spreek U tot hulle deur gelykenisse?

kjv_text: He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.
bsb_text: He replied, “The knowledge of the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven has been given to you, but not to them.
aov_text: Toe antwoord Hy en sê vir hulle: Omdat dit aan julle gegee is om die verborgenhede van die koninkryk van die hemele te ken, maar aan hulle is dit nie gegee nie.

kjv_text: For whosoever hath, to him shall be given, and he shall have more abundance: but whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken away even that he hath.
bsb_text: Whoever has will be given more, and he will have an abundance. Whoever does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.
aov_text: Want hy wat het, aan hom sal gegee word, en hy sal oorvloed hê; maar hy wat nie het nie, van hom sal weggeneem word ook wat hy het.

kjv_text: Therefore speak I to them in parables: because they seeing see not; and hearing they hear not, neither do they understand.
bsb_text: This is why I speak to them in parables: ‘Though seeing, they do not see; though hearing, they do not hear or understand.’
aov_text: Daarom spreek Ek tot hulle deur gelykenisse, omdat hulle, terwyl hulle sien, nie sien nie, en terwyl hulle hoor, nie hoor of verstaan nie.

kjv_text: And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Esaias, which saith, By hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing ye shall see, and shall not perceive:
bsb_text: In them the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled: ‘You will be ever hearing but never understanding; you will be ever seeing but never perceiving.
aov_text: En aan hulle word die profesie van Jesaja vervul wat sê: Met die gehoor sal julle hoor en glad nie verstaan nie, en julle sal kyk en kyk, en glad nie sien nie.

kjv_text: For this people's heart is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes they have closed; lest at any time they should see with their eyes and hear with their ears, and should understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.
bsb_text: For this people’s heart has grown callous; they hardly hear with their ears, and they have closed their eyes. Otherwise they might see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their hearts, and turn, and I would heal them.’
aov_text: Want die hart van hierdie volk het stomp geword, en met die ore het hulle beswaarlik gehoor; en hul oë het hulle toegesluit, sodat hulle nie miskien met die oë sou sien en met die ore hoor en met die hart verstaan en hulle bekeer en Ek hulle genees nie.

kjv_text: But blessed are your eyes, for they see: and your ears, for they hear.
bsb_text: But blessed are your eyes because they see, and your ears because they hear.
aov_text: Maar julle oë is gelukkig, omdat hulle sien; en julle ore, omdat hulle hoor.

kjv_text: For verily I say unto you, That many prophets and righteous men have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.
bsb_text: For truly I tell you, many prophets and righteous men longed to see what you see but did not see it, and to hear what you hear but did not hear it.
aov_text: Want, voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, baie profete en regverdiges het begeer om te sien wat julle sien, en het dit nie gesien nie, en om te hoor wat julle hoor, en het dit nie gehoor nie.

kjv_text: Hear ye therefore the parable of the sower.
bsb_text: Consider, then, the parable of the sower:
aov_text: Luister julle dan na die gelykenis van die saaier.

kjv_text: When any one heareth the word of the kingdom, and understandeth it not, then cometh the wicked one, and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart. This is he which received seed by the way side.
bsb_text: When anyone hears the message of the kingdom but does not understand it, the evil one comes and snatches away what was sown in his heart. This is the seed sown along the path.
aov_text: As iemand die woord van die koninkryk hoor en nie verstaan nie, kom die Bose en roof wat in sy hart gesaai is — dit is hy by wie langs die pad gesaai is.

kjv_text: But he that received the seed into stony places, the same is he that heareth the word, and anon with joy receiveth it;
bsb_text: The seed sown on rocky ground is the one who hears the word and at once receives it with joy.
aov_text: En by wie op rotsagtige plekke gesaai is — dit is hy wat die woord hoor en dit dadelik met blydskap aanneem;

kjv_text: Yet hath he not root in himself, but dureth for a while: for when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word, by and by he is offended.
bsb_text: But since he has no root, he remains for only a season. When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, he quickly falls away.
aov_text: maar hy het geen wortel in homself nie, hy is net vir ’n tyd, en as daar verdrukking en vervolging kom ter wille van die woord, struikel hy dadelik.

kjv_text: He also that received seed among the thorns is he that heareth the word; and the care of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, choke the word, and he becometh unfruitful.
bsb_text: The seed sown among the thorns is the one who hears the word, but the worries of this life and the deceitfulness of wealth choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.
aov_text: En by wie in die dorings gesaai is — dit is hy wat die woord hoor, maar die sorg van hierdie wêreld en die verleiding van die rykdom verstik die woord, en hy word onvrugbaar.

kjv_text: But he that received seed into the good ground is he that heareth the word, and understandeth it; which also beareth fruit, and bringeth forth, some an hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.
bsb_text: But the seed sown on good soil is the one who hears the word and understands it. He indeed bears fruit and produces a crop—a hundredfold, sixtyfold, or thirtyfold.”
aov_text: En by wie op die goeie grond gesaai is — dit is hy wat die woord hoor en verstaan, wat dan ook vrug dra en oplewer: die een honderd-, die ander sestig-, die ander dertigvoudig.

kjv_text: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is likened unto a man which sowed good seed in his field:
bsb_text: Jesus put before them another parable: “The kingdom of heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field.
aov_text: N ANDER gelykenis het Hy hulle voorgehou en gesê: Die koninkryk van die hemele is soos ’n man wat goeie saad in sy land gesaai het;

kjv_text: But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.
bsb_text: But while everyone was asleep, his enemy came and sowed weeds among the wheat, and slipped away.
aov_text: maar terwyl die mense slaap, het sy vyand gekom en onkruid onder die koring gesaai en weggegaan.

kjv_text: But when the blade was sprung up, and brought forth fruit, then appeared the tares also.
bsb_text: When the wheat sprouted and bore grain, then the weeds also appeared.
aov_text: En toe die spruitjies opgeskiet en vrug gevorm het, toe verskyn die onkruid ook.

kjv_text: So the servants of the householder came and said unto him, Sir, didst not thou sow good seed in thy field? from whence then hath it tares?
bsb_text: The owner’s servants came to him and said, ‘Sir, didn’t you sow good seed in your field? Where then did the weeds come from?’
aov_text: En die diensknegte van die huisheer het gekom en vir hom gesê: Meneer, het u dan nie goeie saad in u land gesaai nie? Waar kry dit dan die onkruid vandaan?

kjv_text: He said unto them, An enemy hath done this. The servants said unto him, Wilt thou then that we go and gather them up?
bsb_text: ‘An enemy did this,’ he replied. So the servants asked him, ‘Do you want us to go and pull them up?’
aov_text: En hy antwoord hulle: ’n Vyandige mens het dit gedoen. Toe sê die diensknegte vir hom: Wil u dan hê dat ons dit moet gaan bymekaarmaak?

kjv_text: But he said, Nay; lest while ye gather up the tares, ye root up also the wheat with them.
bsb_text: ‘No,’ he said, ‘if you pull the weeds now, you might uproot the wheat with them.
aov_text: Maar hy antwoord: Nee, dat julle nie miskien, as julle die onkruid bymekaarmaak, die koring daarmee saam uittrek nie.

kjv_text: Let both grow together until the harvest: and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers, Gather ye together first the tares, and bind them in bundles to burn them: but gather the wheat into my barn.
bsb_text: Let both grow together until the harvest. At that time I will tell the harvesters: First collect the weeds and tie them in bundles to be burned; then gather the wheat into my barn.’”
aov_text: Laat altwee saam groei tot die oes toe, en in die oestyd sal ek vir die maaiers sê: Maak eers die onkruid bymekaar en bind dit in bondels om dit te verbrand, maar bring die koring bymekaar in my skuur.

kjv_text: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field:
bsb_text: He put before them another parable: “The kingdom of heaven is like a mustard seed that a man planted in his field.
aov_text: N ANDER gelykenis het Hy hulle voorgehou en gesê: Die koninkryk van die hemele is soos ’n mosterdsaad wat ’n man neem en in sy land saai;

kjv_text: Which indeed is the least of all seeds: but when it is grown, it is the greatest among herbs, and becometh a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in the branches thereof.
bsb_text: Although it is the smallest of all seeds, yet it grows into the largest of garden plants and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and nest in its branches.”
aov_text: wat wel die kleinste is van al die soorte saad, maar as dit gegroei het, groter is as die groentesoorte en ’n boom word, sodat die voëls van die hemel kom en nes maak in sy takke.

kjv_text: Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.
bsb_text: He told them still another parable: “The kingdom of heaven is like leaven that a woman took and mixed into three measures of flour, until all of it was leavened.”
aov_text: ’n Ander gelykenis het Hy hulle vertel: Die koninkryk van die hemele is soos suurdeeg wat ’n vrou neem en in drie mate meel inwerk totdat dit heeltemal ingesuur is.

kjv_text: All these things spake Jesus unto the multitude in parables; and without a parable spake he not unto them:
bsb_text: Jesus spoke all these things to the crowds in parables. He did not tell them anything without using a parable.
aov_text: Al hierdie dinge het Jesus deur gelykenisse vir die skare gesê, en sonder gelykenis het Hy vir hulle niks gesê nie;

kjv_text: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying, I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world.
bsb_text: So was fulfilled what was spoken through the prophet: “I will open My mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden since the foundation of the world.”
aov_text: sodat vervul sou word die woord wat gespreek is deur die profeet: Ek sal my mond open deur gelykenisse; Ek sal uitspreek dinge wat verborge was van die grondlegging van die wêreld af.

kjv_text: Then Jesus sent the multitude away, and went into the house: and his disciples came unto him, saying, Declare unto us the parable of the tares of the field.
bsb_text: Then Jesus dismissed the crowds and went into the house. His disciples came to Him and said, “Explain to us the parable of the weeds in the field.”
aov_text: NADAT Hy die skare weggestuur het, het Jesus huis toe gegaan; en sy dissipels het na Hom gekom en gesê: Verklaar vir ons die gelykenis van die onkruid in die saailand.

kjv_text: He answered and said unto them, He that soweth the good seed is the Son of man;
bsb_text: He replied, “The One who sows the good seed is the Son of Man.
aov_text: En Hy het geantwoord en vir hulle gesê: Hy wat die goeie saad saai, is die Seun van die mens,

kjv_text: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;
bsb_text: The field is the world, and the good seed represents the sons of the kingdom. The weeds are the sons of the evil one,
aov_text: en die saailand is die wêreld. Die goeie saad — dit is die kinders van die koninkryk, en die onkruid is die kinders van die Bose,

kjv_text: The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.
bsb_text: and the enemy who sows them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the harvesters are angels.
aov_text: en die vyand wat dit gesaai het, is die duiwel. Die oes is die voleinding van die wêreld, en die maaiers is die engele.

kjv_text: As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire; so shall it be in the end of this world.
bsb_text: As the weeds are collected and burned in the fire, so will it be at the end of the age.
aov_text: Net soos die onkruid dan bymekaargemaak en met vuur verbrand word, so sal dit wees in die voleinding van hierdie wêreld:

kjv_text: The Son of man shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity;
bsb_text: The Son of Man will send out His angels, and they will weed out of His kingdom every cause of sin and all who practice lawlessness.
aov_text: die Seun van die mens sal sy engele uitstuur, en hulle sal uit sy koninkryk bymekaarmaak al die struikelblokke en die wat die ongeregtigheid doen,

kjv_text: And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
bsb_text: And they will throw them into the fiery furnace, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
aov_text: en sal hulle in die vuuroond gooi. Daar sal geween wees en gekners van die tande.

kjv_text: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
bsb_text: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the kingdom of their Father. He who has ears, let him hear.
aov_text: Dan sal die regverdiges skyn soos die son in die koninkryk van hulle Vader. Wie ore het om te hoor, laat hom hoor.

kjv_text: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field; the which when a man hath found, he hideth, and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field.
bsb_text: The kingdom of heaven is like treasure hidden in a field. When a man found it, he hid it again, and in his joy he went and sold all he had and bought that field.
aov_text: VERDER is die koninkryk van die hemele soos ’n skat wat verborge is in die saailand, wat ’n man kry en wegsteek; en uit blydskap daaroor gaan hy en verkoop alles wat hy het, en koop daardie saailand.

kjv_text: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man, seeking goodly pearls:
bsb_text: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a merchant in search of fine pearls.
aov_text: Verder is die koninkryk van die hemele soos ’n koopman wat mooi pêrels soek;

kjv_text: Who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.
bsb_text: When he found one very precious pearl, he went away and sold all he had and bought it.
aov_text: en toe hy een baie kosbare pêrel kry, gaan hy weg en verkoop alles wat hy het, en koop dit.

kjv_text: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:
bsb_text: Once again, the kingdom of heaven is like a net that was cast into the sea and caught all kinds of fish.
aov_text: Verder is die koninkryk van die hemele soos ’n net wat in die see gegooi word en van elke soort bymekaarbring;

kjv_text: Which, when it was full, they drew to shore, and sat down, and gathered the good into vessels, but cast the bad away.
bsb_text: When it was full, the men pulled it ashore. Then they sat down and sorted the good fish into containers, but threw the bad away.
aov_text: en as dit vol geword het, trek hulle dit op die strand uit en gaan sit en maak die goeies in bakke bymekaar, maar gooi die slegtes weg.

kjv_text: So shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just,
bsb_text: So will it be at the end of the age: The angels will come and separate the wicked from the righteous,
aov_text: So sal dit wees in die voleinding van die wêreld: die engele sal uitgaan en die slegte mense onder die regverdiges uit afskei

kjv_text: And shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
bsb_text: and throw them into the fiery furnace, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
aov_text: en hulle in die vuuroond gooi. Daar sal geween wees en gekners van die tande.

kjv_text: Jesus saith unto them, Have ye understood all these things? They say unto him, Yea, Lord.
bsb_text: Have you understood all these things?” “Yes,” they answered.
aov_text: Jesus sê vir hulle: Het julle ál hierdie dinge verstaan? Hulle antwoord Hom: Ja, Here!

kjv_text: Then said he unto them, Therefore every scribe which is instructed unto the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which bringeth forth out of his treasure things new and old.
bsb_text: Then He told them, “For this reason, every scribe who has been discipled in the kingdom of heaven is like a homeowner who brings out of his storeroom new treasures as well as old.”
aov_text: Toe sê Hy vir hulle: Daarom is elke skrifgeleerde wat ’n leerling geword het in die koninkryk van die hemele, soos ’n huisheer wat uit sy skat nuwe en ou dinge te voorskyn bring.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these parables, he departed thence.
bsb_text: When Jesus had finished these parables, He withdrew from that place.
aov_text: EN toe Jesus hierdie gelykenisse geëindig het, het Hy daarvandaan weggegaan.

kjv_text: And when he was come into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, insomuch that they were astonished, and said, Whence hath this man this wisdom, and these mighty works?
bsb_text: Coming to His hometown, He taught the people in their synagogue, and they were astonished. “Where did this man get such wisdom and miraculous powers?” they asked.
aov_text: En Hy het in sy vaderstad gekom en hulle geleer in hul sinagoge, sodat hulle verslae was en gesê het: Waar kry Hy hierdie wysheid en kragte vandaan?

kjv_text: Is not this the carpenter's son? is not his mother called Mary? and his brethren, James, and Joses, and Simon, and Judas?
bsb_text: “Isn’t this the carpenter’s son? Isn’t His mother’s name Mary, and aren’t His brothers James, Joseph, Simon, and Judas?
aov_text: Is Hy nie die seun van die timmerman nie? Is die naam van sy moeder nie Maria en dié van sy broers Jakobus en Joses en Simon en Judas nie?

kjv_text: And his sisters, are they not all with us? Whence then hath this man all these things?
bsb_text: Aren’t all His sisters with us as well? Where then did this man get all these things?”
aov_text: En sy susters, is hulle nie almal by ons nie? Waar kry Hy dan al hierdie dinge vandaan?

kjv_text: And they were offended in him. But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, save in his own country, and in his own house.
bsb_text: And they took offense at Him. But Jesus said to them, “Only in his hometown and in his own household is a prophet without honor.”
aov_text: En hulle het aanstoot aan Hom geneem. Maar Jesus sê vir hulle: ’n Profeet is nie ongeëerd nie, behalwe in sy vaderland en in sy huis.

kjv_text: And he did not many mighty works there because of their unbelief.
bsb_text: And He did not do many miracles there, because of their unbelief.
aov_text: En Hy het daar vanweë hulle ongeloof nie baie kragtige dade gedoen nie.

kjv_text: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard of the fame of Jesus,
bsb_text: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard the reports about Jesus
aov_text: EN in daardie tyd het Herodes, die viervors, die gerug van Jesus gehoor

kjv_text: And said unto his servants, This is John the Baptist; he is risen from the dead; and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.
bsb_text: and said to his servants, “This is John the Baptist; he has risen from the dead! That is why miraculous powers are at work in him.”
aov_text: en aan sy knegte gesê: Hierdie man is Johannes die Doper. Hy het uit die dode opgestaan, en daarom werk dié kragte in hom.

kjv_text: For Herod had laid hold on John, and bound him, and put him in prison for Herodias' sake, his brother Philip's wife.
bsb_text: Now Herod had arrested John and bound him and put him in prison on account of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife,
aov_text: Want Herodes het Johannes gevang, hom geboei en in die gevangenis gesit vanweë Heródias, die vrou van Filippus, sy broer.

kjv_text: For John said unto him, It is not lawful for thee to have her.
bsb_text: because John had been telling him, “It is not lawful for you to have her.”
aov_text: Want Johannes het vir hom gesê: Dit is u nie geoorloof om haar te hê nie.

kjv_text: And when he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.
bsb_text: Although Herod wanted to kill John, he was afraid of the people, because they regarded John as a prophet.
aov_text: En hoewel hy hom wou doodmaak, het hy die skare gevrees, omdat hulle hom vir ’n profeet gehou het.

kjv_text: But when Herod's birthday was kept, the daughter of Herodias danced before them, and pleased Herod.
bsb_text: On Herod’s birthday, however, the daughter of Herodias danced before them and pleased Herod
aov_text: Maar by die viering van die verjaarsdag van Herodes het die dogter van Heródias voor hulle gedans en Herodes behaag.

kjv_text: Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatsoever she would ask.
bsb_text: so much that he promised with an oath to give to her whatever she asked.
aov_text: Daarom het hy met ’n eed beloof om haar enigiets te gee wat sy sou vra.

kjv_text: And she, being before instructed of her mother, said, Give me here John Baptist's head in a charger.
bsb_text: Prompted by her mother, she said, “Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptist.”
aov_text: Toe sê sy, nadat sy deur haar moeder aangehits was: Gee my hier op ’n skottel die hoof van Johannes die Doper.

kjv_text: And the king was sorry: nevertheless for the oath's sake, and them which sat with him at meat, he commanded it to be given her.
bsb_text: The king was grieved, but because of his oaths and his guests, he ordered that her wish be granted
aov_text: En die koning het treurig geword, maar ter wille van die eed en die feesgenote het hy beveel dat dit gegee moes word.

kjv_text: And he sent, and beheaded John in the prison.
bsb_text: and sent to have John beheaded in the prison.
aov_text: En hy het gestuur en Johannes in die gevangenis onthoof.

kjv_text: And his head was brought in a charger, and given to the damsel: and she brought it to her mother.
bsb_text: John’s head was brought in on a platter and presented to the girl, who carried it to her mother.
aov_text: Sy hoof is toe op ’n skottel gebring en aan die meisie gegee, en sy het dit na haar moeder gebring.

kjv_text: And his disciples came, and took up the body, and buried it, and went and told Jesus.
bsb_text: Then John’s disciples came and took his body and buried it. And they went and informed Jesus.
aov_text: En sy dissipels het gekom en sy liggaam weggeneem en dit begrawe; en hulle het gegaan en dit aan Jesus vertel.

kjv_text: When Jesus heard of it, he departed thence by ship into a desert place apart: and when the people had heard thereof, they followed him on foot out of the cities.
bsb_text: When Jesus heard about John, He withdrew by boat privately to a solitary place. But the crowds found out about it and followed Him on foot from the towns.
aov_text: En toe Jesus dit hoor, het Hy daarvandaan in ’n skuit vertrek na ’n verlate plek alleen. En die skare het dit gehoor en Hom van die stede af te voet gevolg.

kjv_text: And Jesus went forth, and saw a great multitude, and was moved with compassion toward them, and he healed their sick.
bsb_text: When He stepped ashore and saw a large crowd, He had compassion on them and healed their sick.
aov_text: EN toe Jesus uitgaan, het Hy ’n groot skare gesien en innig jammer vir hulle gevoel, en Hy het hulle siekes gesond gemaak.
