kjv_text: And when it was evening, his disciples came to him, saying, This is a desert place, and the time is now past; send the multitude away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves victuals.
bsb_text: When evening came, the disciples came to Him and said, “This is a desolate place, and the hour is already late. Dismiss the crowds so they can go to the villages and buy themselves some food.”
aov_text: En toe dit aand geword het, kom sy dissipels na Hom en sê: Die plek is verlate, en dit is al oor die tyd; stuur die skare weg, sodat hulle na die dorpe kan gaan en vir hulle voedsel koop.

kjv_text: But Jesus said unto them, They need not depart; give ye them to eat.
bsb_text: “They do not need to go away,” Jesus replied. “You give them something to eat.”
aov_text: Maar Jesus sê vir hulle: Hulle hoef nie weg te gaan nie; gee julle vir hulle iets om te eet.

kjv_text: And they say unto him, We have here but five loaves, and two fishes.
bsb_text: “We have here only five loaves of bread and two fish,” they answered.
aov_text: Maar hulle antwoord Hom: Ons het hier net vyf brode en twee visse.

kjv_text: He said, Bring them hither to me.
bsb_text: “Bring them here to Me,” Jesus said.
aov_text: En Hy sê: Bring dit hier vir My.

kjv_text: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the grass, and took the five loaves, and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, and brake, and gave the loaves to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.
bsb_text: And He directed the crowds to sit down on the grass. Taking the five loaves and the two fish and looking up to heaven, He spoke a blessing. Then He broke the loaves and gave them to the disciples, and the disciples gave them to the people.
aov_text: Toe gee Hy die skare bevel om op die gras te gaan sit; en Hy neem die vyf brode en die twee visse, kyk op na die hemel en dank; en nadat Hy die brode gebreek het, gee Hy dit aan die dissipels en die dissipels aan die skare.

kjv_text: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full.
bsb_text: They all ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.
aov_text: En almal het geëet en versadig geword, en hulle het die oorskot van die brokstukke opgetel, twaalf mandjies vol.

kjv_text: And they that had eaten were about five thousand men, beside women and children.
bsb_text: About five thousand men were fed, in addition to women and children.
aov_text: En dit was omtrent vyfduisend manne wat geëet het, buiten die vroue en kinders.

kjv_text: And straightway Jesus constrained his disciples to get into a ship, and to go before him unto the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.
bsb_text: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat and go on ahead of Him to the other side, while He dismissed the crowds.
aov_text: EN Jesus het dadelik sy dissipels gedwing om in die skuit te gaan en voor Hom uit te vaar na die oorkant, terwyl Hy die skare wegstuur.

kjv_text: And when he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into a mountain apart to pray: and when the evening was come, he was there alone.
bsb_text: After He had sent them away, He went up on the mountain by Himself to pray. When evening came, He was there alone,
aov_text: En nadat Hy die skare weggestuur het, klim Hy op die berg om in die eensaamheid te bid. En toe dit aand geword het, was Hy daar alleen.

kjv_text: But the ship was now in the midst of the sea, tossed with waves: for the wind was contrary.
bsb_text: but the boat was already far from land, buffeted by the waves because the wind was against it.
aov_text: En die skuit was al in die middel van die see, geteister deur die golwe; want die wind was teen hulle.

kjv_text: And in the fourth watch of the night Jesus went unto them, walking on the sea.
bsb_text: During the fourth watch of the night, Jesus went out to them, walking on the sea.
aov_text: Maar in die vierde nagwaak het Jesus na hulle gekom, al wandelende op die see.

kjv_text: And when the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, It is a spirit; and they cried out for fear.
bsb_text: When the disciples saw Him walking on the sea, they were terrified. “It’s a ghost!” they said, and cried out in fear.
aov_text: En toe die dissipels Hom op die see sien loop, word hulle ontsteld en sê: Dit is ’n spook! En hulle het geskreeu van vrees.

kjv_text: But straightway Jesus spake unto them, saying, Be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid.
bsb_text: But Jesus spoke up at once: “Take courage! It is I. Do not be afraid.”
aov_text: Maar Jesus het dadelik met hulle gespreek en gesê: Hou goeie moed, dit is Ek! Moenie vrees nie.

kjv_text: And Peter answered him and said, Lord, if it be thou, bid me come unto thee on the water.
bsb_text: “Lord, if it is You,” Peter replied, “command me to come to You on the water.”
aov_text: En Petrus antwoord Hom en sê: Here, as dit U is, beveel my om op die water na U te kom.

kjv_text: And he said, Come. And when Peter was come down out of the ship, he walked on the water, to go to Jesus.
bsb_text: “Come,” said Jesus. Then Peter got down out of the boat, walked on the water, and came toward Jesus.
aov_text: En Hy sê: Kom! Petrus klim toe van die skuit af en loop op die water om na Jesus te gaan.

kjv_text: But when he saw the wind boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me.
bsb_text: But when he saw the strength of the wind, he was afraid, and beginning to sink, cried out, “Lord, save me!”
aov_text: Maar toe hy die sterk wind sien, het hy bang geword; en toe hy begin sink, roep hy uit en sê: Here, red my!

kjv_text: And immediately Jesus stretched forth his hand, and caught him, and said unto him, O thou of little faith, wherefore didst thou doubt?
bsb_text: Immediately Jesus reached out His hand and took hold of Peter. “You of little faith,” He said, “why did you doubt?”
aov_text: En Jesus het dadelik sy hand uitgesteek en hom gegryp en vir hom gesê: Kleingelowige, waarom het jy getwyfel?

kjv_text: And when they were come into the ship, the wind ceased.
bsb_text: And when they had climbed back into the boat, the wind died down.
aov_text: Daarop klim hulle in die skuit, en die wind het gaan lê.

kjv_text: Then they that were in the ship came and worshipped him, saying, Of a truth thou art the Son of God.
bsb_text: Then those who were in the boat worshiped Him, saying, “Truly You are the Son of God!”
aov_text: Toe kom die wat in die skuit was, en val voor Hom neer en sê: Waarlik, U is die Seun van God!

kjv_text: And when they were gone over, they came into the land of Gennesaret.
bsb_text: When they had crossed over, they landed at Gennesaret.
aov_text: En hulle het oorgevaar en in die land Gennésaret gekom.

kjv_text: And when the men of that place had knowledge of him, they sent out into all that country round about, and brought unto him all that were diseased;
bsb_text: And when the men of that place recognized Jesus, they sent word to all the surrounding region. People brought all the sick to Him
aov_text: En die manne van daardie plek het Hom herken en in daardie hele omtrek uitgestuur en almal wat ongesteld was, na Hom gebring;

kjv_text: And besought him that they might only touch the hem of his garment: and as many as touched were made perfectly whole.
bsb_text: and begged Him just to let them touch the fringe of His cloak. And all who touched Him were healed.
aov_text: en hulle het Hom gesmeek dat hulle net maar die soom van sy kleed mag aanraak; en almal wat dit aangeraak het, het gesond geword.

kjv_text: Then came to Jesus scribes and Pharisees, which were of Jerusalem, saying,
bsb_text: Then some Pharisees and scribes came to Jesus from Jerusalem and asked,
aov_text: TOE kom daar skrifgeleerdes en Fariseërs van Jerusalem na Jesus en sê:

kjv_text: Why do thy disciples transgress the tradition of the elders? for they wash not their hands when they eat bread.
bsb_text: “Why do Your disciples break the tradition of the elders? They do not wash their hands before they eat.”
aov_text: Waarom oortree u dissipels die oorlewering van die ou mense? Want hulle was nie hul hande as hulle brood eet nie.

kjv_text: But he answered and said unto them, Why do ye also transgress the commandment of God by your tradition?
bsb_text: Jesus replied, “And why do you break the command of God for the sake of your tradition?
aov_text: Maar Hy antwoord en sê vir hulle: Waarom oortree julle ook die gebod van God ter wille van julle oorlewering?

kjv_text: For God commanded, saying, Honour thy father and mother: and, He that curseth father or mother, let him die the death.
bsb_text: For God said, ‘Honor your father and mother’ and ‘Anyone who curses his father or mother must be put to death.’
aov_text: Want God het bevel gegee en gesê: Eer jou vader en moeder; en: Hy wat vader of moeder vloek, moet sekerlik sterwe.

kjv_text: But ye say, Whosoever shall say to his father or his mother, It is a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me;
bsb_text: But you say that if anyone says to his father or mother, ‘Whatever you would have received from me is a gift devoted to God,’
aov_text: Maar julle sê: Elkeen wat aan vader of moeder sê: enige voordeel wat u van my sou kan geniet, is 'n offergawe —

kjv_text: And honour not his father or his mother, he shall be free.
bsb_text: he need not honor his father or mother with it.
aov_text: dié hoef sy vader of sy moeder glad nie te eer nie.

kjv_text: Thus have ye made the commandment of God of none effect by your tradition.
bsb_text: Thus you nullify the word of God for the sake of your tradition.
aov_text: So het julle dan die gebod van God kragteloos gemaak ter wille van julle oorlewering.

kjv_text: Ye hypocrites, well did Esaias prophesy of you, saying,
bsb_text: You hypocrites! Isaiah prophesied correctly about you:
aov_text: Geveinsdes, tereg het Jesaja oor julle geprofeteer toe hy gesê het:

kjv_text: This people draweth nigh unto me with their mouth, and honoureth me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.
bsb_text: ‘These people honor Me with their lips, but their hearts are far from Me.
aov_text: Hierdie volk nader My met hulle mond en eer My met die lippe, maar hulle hart is ver van My af.

kjv_text: But in vain they do worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.
bsb_text: They worship Me in vain; they teach as doctrine the precepts of men.’”
aov_text: Maar tevergeefs vereer hulle My deur leringe te leer wat gebooie van mense is.

kjv_text: And he called the multitude, and said unto them, Hear, and understand:
bsb_text: Jesus called the crowd to Him and said, “Listen and understand.
aov_text: En Hy het die skare na Hom geroep en vir hulle gesê: Luister en verstaan!

kjv_text: Not that which goeth into the mouth defileth a man; but that which cometh out of the mouth, this defileth a man.
bsb_text: A man is not defiled by what enters his mouth, but by what comes out of it.”
aov_text: Nie wat in die mond ingaan, maak die mens onrein nie; maar wat uit die mond uitgaan, dit maak die mens onrein.

kjv_text: Then came his disciples, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the Pharisees were offended, after they heard this saying?
bsb_text: Then the disciples came to Him and said, “Are You aware that the Pharisees were offended when they heard this?”
aov_text: Daarop kom sy dissipels nader en sê vir Hom: Weet U dat die Fariseërs, toe hulle die woord hoor, aanstoot geneem het?

kjv_text: But he answered and said, Every plant, which my heavenly Father hath not planted, shall be rooted up.
bsb_text: But Jesus replied, “Every plant that My heavenly Father has not planted will be pulled up by its roots.
aov_text: Maar Hy antwoord en sê: Elke plant wat my hemelse Vader nie geplant het nie, sal ontwortel word.

kjv_text: Let them alone: they be blind leaders of the blind. And if the blind lead the blind, both shall fall into the ditch.
bsb_text: Disregard them! They are blind guides. If a blind man leads a blind man, both will fall into a pit.”
aov_text: Laat hulle staan; hulle is blinde leiers van blindes. En as ’n blinde ’n ander blinde lei, sal altwee in die sloot val.

kjv_text: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Declare unto us this parable.
bsb_text: Peter said to Him, “Explain this parable to us.”
aov_text: En Petrus antwoord en sê vir Hom: Verklaar vir ons hierdie gelykenis.

kjv_text: And Jesus said, Are ye also yet without understanding?
bsb_text: “Do you still not understand?” Jesus asked.
aov_text: Maar Jesus sê: Is julle dan ook nog sonder verstand?

kjv_text: Do not ye yet understand, that whatsoever entereth in at the mouth goeth into the belly, and is cast out into the draught?
bsb_text: “Do you not yet realize that whatever enters the mouth goes into the stomach and then is eliminated?
aov_text: Begryp julle nog nie dat alles wat in die mond ingaan, in die maag kom en in die heimlikheid uitgewerp word nie?

kjv_text: But those things which proceed out of the mouth come forth from the heart; and they defile the man.
bsb_text: But the things that come out of the mouth come from the heart, and these things defile a man.
aov_text: Maar die dinge wat uit die mond uitgaan, kom uit die hart, en dit is dié wat die mens onrein maak.

kjv_text: For out of the heart proceed evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witness, blasphemies:
bsb_text: For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murder, adultery, sexual immorality, theft, false testimony, and slander.
aov_text: Want uit die hart kom daar slegte gedagtes, moord, egbreuk, hoerery, diewery, valse getuienis, lastertaal.

kjv_text: These are the things which defile a man: but to eat with unwashen hands defileth not a man.
bsb_text: These are what defile a man, but eating with unwashed hands does not defile him.”
aov_text: Dit is hierdie dinge wat die mens onrein maak; maar om met ongewaste hande te eet, maak die mens nie onrein nie.

kjv_text: Then Jesus went thence, and departed into the coasts of Tyre and Sidon.
bsb_text: Leaving that place, Jesus withdrew to the district of Tyre and Sidon.
aov_text: EN Jesus het daarvandaan weggegaan en na die streke van Tirus en Sidon vertrek.

kjv_text: And, behold, a woman of Canaan came out of the same coasts, and cried unto him, saying, Have mercy on me, O Lord, thou son of David; my daughter is grievously vexed with a devil.
bsb_text: And a Canaanite woman from that region came to Him, crying out, “Lord, Son of David, have mercy on me! My daughter is miserably possessed by a demon.”
aov_text: En ’n Kananése vrou het van daardie gebied gekom en na Hom geroep en gesê: Wees my barmhartig, Here, Seun van Dawid! My dogter is erg van die duiwel besete.

kjv_text: But he answered her not a word. And his disciples came and besought him, saying, Send her away; for she crieth after us.
bsb_text: But Jesus did not answer a word. So His disciples came and urged Him, “Send her away, for she keeps crying out after us.”
aov_text: Maar Hy het haar nie ’n woord geantwoord nie. Toe kom sy dissipels nader en vra Hom en sê: Stuur haar weg, want sy roep agter ons aan.

kjv_text: But he answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
bsb_text: He answered, “I was sent only to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.”
aov_text: Maar Hy antwoord en sê: Ek is net gestuur na die verlore skape van die huis van Israel.

kjv_text: Then came she and worshipped him, saying, Lord, help me.
bsb_text: The woman came and knelt before Him. “Lord, help me!” she said.
aov_text: Daarop kom sy en val voor Hom neer en sê: Here, help my!

kjv_text: But he answered and said, It is not meet to take the children's bread, and to cast it to dogs.
bsb_text: But Jesus replied, “It is not right to take the children’s bread and toss it to the dogs.”
aov_text: Maar Hy antwoord en sê: Dit is nie mooi om die brood van die kinders te neem en dit vir die hondjies te gooi nie.

kjv_text: And she said, Truth, Lord: yet the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters' table.
bsb_text: “Yes, Lord,” she said, “even the dogs eat the crumbs that fall from their master’s table.”
aov_text: En sy sê: Ja, Here, maar die hondjies eet darem van die krummels wat van die tafel van hulle base afval.

kjv_text: Then Jesus answered and said unto her, O woman, great is thy faith: be it unto thee even as thou wilt. And her daughter was made whole from that very hour.
bsb_text: “O woman,” Jesus answered, “your faith is great! Let it be done for you as you desire.” And her daughter was healed from that very hour.
aov_text: Toe antwoord Jesus en sê vir haar: o Vrou, groot is jou geloof; laat dit vir jou wees soos jy wil hê. En haar dogter het gesond geword van daardie uur af.

kjv_text: And Jesus departed from thence, and came nigh unto the sea of Galilee; and went up into a mountain, and sat down there.
bsb_text: Moving on from there, Jesus went along the Sea of Galilee. Then He went up on a mountain and sat down.
aov_text: TOE gaan Jesus daarvandaan weg en kom by die see van Galiléa; en Hy het op die berg geklim en daar gaan sit.

kjv_text: And great multitudes came unto him, having with them those that were lame, blind, dumb, maimed, and many others, and cast them down at Jesus' feet; and he healed them:
bsb_text: Large crowds came to Him, bringing the lame, the blind, the crippled, the mute, and many others, and laid them at His feet, and He healed them.
aov_text: En ondertussen kom daar groot menigtes na Hom met kreupeles, blindes, stommes, gebreklikes en baie ander by hulle, en hulle het dié by die voete van Jesus neergesit, en Hy het hulle gesond gemaak,

kjv_text: Insomuch that the multitude wondered, when they saw the dumb to speak, the maimed to be whole, the lame to walk, and the blind to see: and they glorified the God of Israel.
bsb_text: The crowd was amazed when they saw the mute speaking, the crippled restored, the lame walking, and the blind seeing. And they glorified the God of Israel.
aov_text: sodat die skare verbaas was om te sien dat stommes praat, gebreklikes gesond word, kreupeles loop en blindes sien; en hulle het die God van Israel verheerlik.

kjv_text: Then Jesus called his disciples unto him, and said, I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days, and have nothing to eat: and I will not send them away fasting, lest they faint in the way.
bsb_text: Then Jesus called His disciples to Him and said, “I have compassion for this crowd, because they have already been with Me three days and have nothing to eat. I do not want to send them away hungry, or they may faint along the way.”
aov_text: Toe het Jesus sy dissipels na Hom geroep en gesê: Ek voel innig jammer vir die skare, omdat hulle al drie dae by My bly en niks het om te eet nie; en Ek wil hulle nie graag honger wegstuur nie, sodat hulle nie miskien op die pad beswyk nie.

kjv_text: And his disciples say unto him, Whence should we have so much bread in the wilderness, as to fill so great a multitude?
bsb_text: The disciples replied, “Where in this desolate place could we find enough bread to feed such a large crowd?”
aov_text: En sy dissipels sê vir Hom: Waar sal ons in die woestyn soveel brode vandaan kry om so ’n groot skare te versadig?

kjv_text: And Jesus saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven, and a few little fishes.
bsb_text: “How many loaves do you have?” Jesus asked. “Seven,” they replied, “and a few small fish.”
aov_text: Toe sê Jesus vir hulle: Hoeveel brode het julle? En hulle antwoord: Sewe, en ’n paar vissies.

kjv_text: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground.
bsb_text: And He instructed the crowd to sit down on the ground.
aov_text: En Hy het bevel gegee aan die skare om op die grond te gaan sit.

kjv_text: And he took the seven loaves and the fishes, and gave thanks, and brake them, and gave to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.
bsb_text: Taking the seven loaves and the fish, He gave thanks and broke them. Then He gave them to the disciples, and the disciples gave them to the people.
aov_text: Toe neem Hy die sewe brode en die visse, en nadat Hy gedank het, breek Hy dit en gee dit aan sy dissipels, en die dissipels aan die skare.

kjv_text: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets full.
bsb_text: They all ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up seven basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.
aov_text: En hulle het almal geëet en versadig geword; en hulle het die oorskot van die brokstukke opgetel, sewe mandjies vol.

kjv_text: And they that did eat were four thousand men, beside women and children.
bsb_text: A total of four thousand men were fed, in addition to women and children.
aov_text: En die wat geëet het, was vierduisend manne buiten die vroue en kinders.

kjv_text: And he sent away the multitude, and took ship, and came into the coasts of Magdala.
bsb_text: After Jesus had dismissed the crowds, He got into the boat and went to the region of Magadan.
aov_text: En nadat Hy die skare weggestuur het, het Hy in die skuit gegaan en in die gebied van Mágdala gekom.

kjv_text: The Pharisees also with the Sadducees came, and tempting desired him that he would shew them a sign from heaven.
bsb_text: Then the Pharisees and Sadducees came and tested Jesus by asking Him to show them a sign from heaven.
aov_text: EN die Fariseërs en Sadduseërs het nader gekom om Hom te versoek en het Hom gevra om hulle ’n teken uit die hemel te laat sien.

kjv_text: He answered and said unto them, When it is evening, ye say, It will be fair weather: for the sky is red.
bsb_text: But He replied, “When evening comes, you say, ‘The weather will be fair, for the sky is red,’
aov_text: Maar Hy antwoord en sê vir hulle: In die aand sê julle: Mooi weer, want die lug is rooi.

kjv_text: And in the morning, It will be foul weather to day: for the sky is red and lowring. O ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky; but can ye not discern the signs of the times?
bsb_text: and in the morning, ‘Today it will be stormy, for the sky is red and overcast.’ You know how to interpret the appearance of the sky, but not the signs of the times.
aov_text: En in die môre: Stormweer vandag, want die lug is donkerrooi. Geveinsdes, julle weet wel om die voorkoms van die lug te onderskei, en kan julle nie die tekens van die tye onderskei nie?

kjv_text: A wicked and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given unto it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas. And he left them, and departed.
bsb_text: A wicked and adulterous generation demands a sign, but none will be given it except the sign of Jonah.” Then He left them and went away.
aov_text: ’n Slegte en owerspelige geslag soek na ’n teken, en geen teken sal aan hom gegee word nie, behalwe die teken van Jona, die profeet. En Hy het hulle verlaat en weggegaan.

kjv_text: And when his disciples were come to the other side, they had forgotten to take bread.
bsb_text: When they crossed to the other side, the disciples forgot to take bread.
aov_text: En toe sy dissipels na die oorkant gegaan het, het hulle vergeet om brode saam te neem.

kjv_text: Then Jesus said unto them, Take heed and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.
bsb_text: “Watch out!” Jesus told them. “Beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”
aov_text: Daarop sê Jesus vir hulle: Pas op en wees op julle hoede vir die suurdeeg van die Fariseërs en Sadduseërs.

kjv_text: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have taken no bread.
bsb_text: They discussed this among themselves and concluded, “It is because we did not bring any bread.”
aov_text: En hulle het onder mekaar geredeneer en gesê: Dit is omdat ons geen brode saamgeneem het nie.

kjv_text: Which when Jesus perceived, he said unto them, O ye of little faith, why reason ye among yourselves, because ye have brought no bread?
bsb_text: Aware of their conversation, Jesus said, “You of little faith, why are you debating among yourselves about having no bread?
aov_text: Maar Jesus het dit opgemerk en vir hulle gesê: Wat redeneer julle onder mekaar, kleingelowiges, dat julle geen brode saamgeneem het nie?

kjv_text: Do ye not yet understand, neither remember the five loaves of the five thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?
bsb_text: Do you still not understand? Do you not remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many basketfuls you gathered?
aov_text: Begryp julle nog nie, en onthou julle nie die vyf brode van die vyfduisend, en hoeveel mandjiesvol julle opgetel het nie?

kjv_text: Neither the seven loaves of the four thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?
bsb_text: Or the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many basketfuls you gathered?
aov_text: Of die sewe brode van die vierduisend, en hoeveel mandjiesvol julle opgetel het nie?

kjv_text: How is it that ye do not understand that I spake it not to you concerning bread, that ye should beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees?
bsb_text: How do you not understand that I was not telling you about bread? But beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”
aov_text: Hoe is dit dat julle nie begryp dat Ek nie in verband met brood vir julle gesê het om op te pas vir die suurdeeg van die Fariseërs en Sadduseërs nie?

kjv_text: Then understood they how that he bade them not beware of the leaven of bread, but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.
bsb_text: Then they understood that He was not telling them to beware of the leaven used in bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
aov_text: Toe het hulle begryp dat Hy nie gesê het dat hulle moes oppas vir die suurdeeg van die brood nie, maar vir die leer van die Fariseërs en Sadduseërs.

kjv_text: When Jesus came into the coasts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, Whom do men say that I the Son of man am?
bsb_text: When Jesus came to the region of Caesarea Philippi, He questioned His disciples: “Who do people say the Son of Man is?”
aov_text: EN toe Jesus in die streke van Cesaréa-Filippi kom, vra Hy sy dissipels en sê: Wie sê die mense dat Ek, die Seun van die mens, is?

kjv_text: And they said, Some say that thou art John the Baptist: some, Elias; and others, Jeremias, or one of the prophets.
bsb_text: They replied, “Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, Jeremiah or one of the prophets.”
aov_text: En hulle antwoord: Sommige Johannes die Doper, en sommige Elía, en ander Jeremia of een van die profete.

kjv_text: He saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am?
bsb_text: “But what about you?” Jesus asked. “Who do you say I am?”
aov_text: Hy sê vir hulle: Maar julle, wie sê julle is Ek?

kjv_text: And Simon Peter answered and said, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.
bsb_text: Simon Peter answered, “You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”
aov_text: En Simon Petrus antwoord en sê: U is die Christus, die Seun van die lewende God.

kjv_text: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Blessed art thou, Simon Barjona: for flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven.
bsb_text: Jesus replied, “Blessed are you, Simon son of Jonah! For this was not revealed to you by flesh and blood, but by My Father in heaven.
aov_text: Toe antwoord Jesus en sê vir hom: Salig is jy, Simon Bar-Jona, want vlees en bloed het dit nie aan jou geopenbaar nie, maar my Vader wat in die hemele is.

kjv_text: And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.
bsb_text: And I tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build My church, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it.
aov_text: En Ek sê ook vir jou: Jy is Petrus, en op hierdie rots sal Ek my gemeente bou, en die poorte van die doderyk sal dit nie oorweldig nie.

kjv_text: And I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
bsb_text: I will give you the keys of the kingdom of heaven. Whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven.”
aov_text: En Ek sal jou die sleutels van die koninkryk van die hemele gee; en wat jy ook op die aarde mag bind, sal in die hemel gebonde wees, en wat jy ook op die aarde mag ontbind, sal in die hemel ontbonde wees.

kjv_text: Then charged he his disciples that they should tell no man that he was Jesus the Christ.
bsb_text: Then He admonished the disciples not to tell anyone that He was the Christ.
aov_text: Daarop het Hy sy dissipels bevel gegee dat hulle vir niemand moes sê dat Hy Jesus die Christus is nie.

kjv_text: From that time forth began Jesus to shew unto his disciples, how that he must go unto Jerusalem, and suffer many things of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised again the third day.
bsb_text: From that time on Jesus began to show His disciples that He must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things at the hands of the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and that He must be killed and on the third day be raised to life.
aov_text: Van toe af het Jesus begin om sy dissipels te toon dat Hy na Jerusalem moes gaan en veel van die ouderlinge en owerpriesters en skrifgeleerdes moes ly, en gedood en op die derde dag opgewek word.

kjv_text: Then Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from thee, Lord: this shall not be unto thee.
bsb_text: Peter took Him aside and began to rebuke Him. “Far be it from You, Lord!” he said. “This shall never happen to You!”
aov_text: Toe neem Petrus Hom opsy en begin Hom bestraf en sê: Mag God dit verhoed, Here, dit sal U nooit oorkom nie!

kjv_text: But he turned, and said unto Peter, Get thee behind me, Satan: thou art an offence unto me: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but those that be of men.
bsb_text: But Jesus turned and said to Peter, “Get behind Me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to Me. For you do not have in mind the things of God, but the things of men.”
aov_text: Maar Hy het omgedraai en vir Petrus gesê: Gaan weg agter My, Satan! Jy is vir My ’n struikelblok, omdat jy nie die dinge van God bedink nie, maar die dinge van die mense.

kjv_text: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
bsb_text: Then Jesus told His disciples, “If anyone wants to come after Me, he must deny himself and take up his cross and follow Me.
aov_text: TOE sê Jesus vir sy dissipels: As iemand agter My aan wil kom, moet hy homself verloën en sy kruis opneem en My volg.

kjv_text: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it.
bsb_text: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for My sake will find it.
aov_text: Want elkeen wat sy lewe wil red, sal dit verloor; maar elkeen wat sy lewe om My ontwil verloor, sal dit vind.

kjv_text: For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?
bsb_text: What will it profit a man if he gains the whole world, yet forfeits his soul? Or what can a man give in exchange for his soul?
aov_text: Want wat baat dit ’n mens as hy die hele wêreld win, maar aan sy siel skade ly? Of wat sal ’n mens gee as losprys vir sy siel?

kjv_text: For the Son of man shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then he shall reward every man according to his works.
bsb_text: For the Son of Man will come in His Father’s glory with His angels, and then He will repay each one according to what he has done.
aov_text: Want die Seun van die mens staan gereed om met sy engele in die heerlikheid van sy Vader te kom, en dan sal Hy elkeen vergeld volgens sy dade.

kjv_text: Verily I say unto you, There be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the Son of man coming in his kingdom.
bsb_text: Truly I tell you, some who are standing here will not taste death before they see the Son of Man coming in His kingdom.”
aov_text: Voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, daar is sommige van die wat hier staan, wat die dood sekerlik nie sal smaak voordat hulle die Seun van die mens in sy koninkryk sien kom het nie.

kjv_text: And after six days Jesus taketh Peter, James, and John his brother, and bringeth them up into an high mountain apart,
bsb_text: After six days Jesus took with Him Peter, James, and John the brother of James, and led them up a high mountain by themselves.
aov_text: EN ná ses dae het Jesus vir Petrus en Jakobus en Johannes, sy broer, saamgeneem en hulle op ’n hoë berg in die eensaamheid gebring.

kjv_text: And was transfigured before them: and his face did shine as the sun, and his raiment was white as the light.
bsb_text: There He was transfigured before them. His face shone like the sun, and His clothes became as white as the light.
aov_text: En Hy het voor hulle van gedaante verander, en sy aangesig het geblink soos die son, en sy klere het wit geword soos die lig.

kjv_text: And, behold, there appeared unto them Moses and Elias talking with him.
bsb_text: Suddenly Moses and Elijah appeared before them, talking with Jesus.
aov_text: En kyk, daar verskyn aan hulle Moses en Elía in gesprek met Hom.

kjv_text: Then answered Peter, and said unto Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here: if thou wilt, let us make here three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.
bsb_text: Peter said to Jesus, “Lord, it is good for us to be here. If You wish, I will put up three shelters—one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
aov_text: Toe begin Petrus vir Jesus te sê: Here, dit is goed dat ons hier is; as U wil, laat ons hier drie hutte maak: vir U een en vir Moses een en een vir Elía.

kjv_text: While he yet spake, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them: and behold a voice out of the cloud, which said, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased; hear ye him.
bsb_text: While Peter was still speaking, a bright cloud enveloped them, and a voice from the cloud said, “This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to Him!”
aov_text: Terwyl hy nog spreek, oordek ’n helderligte wolk hulle meteens en daar sê ’n stem uit die wolk: Dit is my geliefde Seun in wie Ek ’n welbehae het. Luister na Hom!

kjv_text: And when the disciples heard it, they fell on their face, and were sore afraid.
bsb_text: When the disciples heard this, they fell facedown in terror.
aov_text: En toe die dissipels dit hoor, het hulle op hul aangesig geval en was baie bevrees.

kjv_text: And Jesus came and touched them, and said, Arise, and be not afraid.
bsb_text: Then Jesus came over and touched them. “Get up,” He said. “Do not be afraid.”
aov_text: En Jesus het nader gekom en hulle aangeraak en gesê: Staan op en moenie vrees nie.

kjv_text: And when they had lifted up their eyes, they saw no man, save Jesus only.
bsb_text: And when they looked up, they saw no one except Jesus.
aov_text: Toe slaan hulle hul oë op en sien niemand meer nie, behalwe Jesus alleen.

kjv_text: And as they came down from the mountain, Jesus charged them, saying, Tell the vision to no man, until the Son of man be risen again from the dead.
bsb_text: As they were coming down the mountain, Jesus commanded them, “Do not tell anyone about this vision until the Son of Man has been raised from the dead.”
aov_text: En onderwyl hulle van die berg afklim, het Jesus hulle bevel gegee en gesê: Julle moet vir niemand iets van die gesig sê voordat die Seun van die mens uit die dode opgestaan het nie.

kjv_text: And his disciples asked him, saying, Why then say the scribes that Elias must first come?
bsb_text: The disciples asked Him, “Why then do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”
aov_text: En sy dissipels vra Hom en sê: Waarom sê die skrifgeleerdes dan dat Elía eers moet kom?

kjv_text: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Elias truly shall first come, and restore all things.
bsb_text: Jesus replied, “Elijah does indeed come, and he will restore all things.
aov_text: En Jesus antwoord en sê vir hulle: Dis waar, Elía kom eers en sal alles herstel;

kjv_text: But I say unto you, That Elias is come already, and they knew him not, but have done unto him whatsoever they listed. Likewise shall also the Son of man suffer of them.
bsb_text: But I tell you that Elijah has already come, and they did not recognize him, but have done to him whatever they wished. In the same way, the Son of Man will suffer at their hands.”
aov_text: maar Ek sê vir julle dat Elía al gekom het, en hulle het hom nie erken nie, maar aan hom alles gedoen wat hulle wou. So sal die Seun van die mens ook deur hulle ly.

kjv_text: Then the disciples understood that he spake unto them of John the Baptist.
bsb_text: Then the disciples understood that He was speaking to them about John the Baptist.
aov_text: Toe verstaan die dissipels dat Hy met hulle van Johannes die Doper gespreek het.

kjv_text: And when they were come to the multitude, there came to him a certain man, kneeling down to him, and saying,
bsb_text: When they came to the crowd, a man came up to Jesus and knelt before Him.
aov_text: EN toe hulle by die skare kom, gaan daar ’n man na Hom en val voor Hom op die knieë en sê:

kjv_text: Lord, have mercy on my son: for he is lunatick, and sore vexed: for ofttimes he falleth into the fire, and oft into the water.
bsb_text: “Lord, have mercy on my son,” he said. “He has seizures and is suffering terribly. He often falls into the fire or into the water.
aov_text: Here, ontferm U oor my seun, want hy is maansiek en ly swaar; want dikwels val hy in die vuur en dikwels in die water.

kjv_text: And I brought him to thy disciples, and they could not cure him.
bsb_text: I brought him to Your disciples, but they could not heal him.”
aov_text: En ek het hom na u dissipels gebring, en hulle kon hom nie gesond maak nie.

kjv_text: Then Jesus answered and said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him hither to me.
bsb_text: “O unbelieving and perverse generation!” Jesus replied. “How long must I remain with you? How long must I put up with you? Bring the boy here to Me.”
aov_text: Toe antwoord Jesus en sê: o Ongelowige en verdraaide geslag, hoe lank sal Ek by julle wees, hoe lank sal Ek julle verdra? Bring hom hier vir My.

kjv_text: And Jesus rebuked the devil; and he departed out of him: and the child was cured from that very hour.
bsb_text: Then Jesus rebuked the demon, and it came out of the boy, and he was healed from that moment.
aov_text: Daarop bestraf Jesus hom; en die duiwel het van hom uitgegaan, en die seun het gesond geword van daardie uur af.

kjv_text: Then came the disciples to Jesus apart, and said, Why could not we cast him out?
bsb_text: Afterward the disciples came to Jesus privately and asked, “Why couldn’t we drive it out?”
aov_text: Toe kom die dissipels na Jesus afsonderlik en sê: Waarom kon ons hom nie uitdryf nie?

kjv_text: And Jesus said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.
bsb_text: “Because you have so little faith,” He answered. “For truly I tell you, if you have faith the size of a mustard seed, you can say to this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move. Nothing will be impossible for you.”
aov_text: En Jesus antwoord hulle: Deur julle ongeloof; want, voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, as julle geloof het soos ’n mosterdsaad sal julle vir hierdie berg sê: Gaan weg hiervandaan daarnatoe! en hy sal weggaan, en niks sal vir julle onmoontlik wees nie.

kjv_text: Howbeit this kind goeth not out but by prayer and fasting.
aov_text: Maar hierdie geslag gaan nie uit behalwe deur gebed en vas nie.

kjv_text: And while they abode in Galilee, Jesus said unto them, The Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of men:
bsb_text: When they gathered together in Galilee, Jesus told them, “The Son of Man is about to be delivered into the hands of men.
aov_text: En terwyl hulle in Galiléa rondgaan, het Jesus vir hulle gesê: Die Seun van die mens sal oorgelewer word in die hande van die mense;

kjv_text: And they shall kill him, and the third day he shall be raised again. And they were exceeding sorry.
bsb_text: They will kill Him, and on the third day He will be raised to life.” And the disciples were deeply grieved.
aov_text: en hulle sal Hom doodmaak, en op die derde dag sal Hy opstaan. En hulle het baie bedroef geword.

kjv_text: And when they were come to Capernaum, they that received tribute money came to Peter, and said, Doth not your master pay tribute?
bsb_text: After they had arrived in Capernaum, the collectors of the two-drachma tax came to Peter and asked, “Does your Teacher pay the two drachmas?”
aov_text: EN toe hulle in Kapérnaüm kom, het die wat die tempelbelasting ontvang, na Petrus gegaan en gesê: Betaal julle Meester nie die tempelbelasting nie?

kjv_text: He saith, Yes. And when he was come into the house, Jesus prevented him, saying, What thinkest thou, Simon? of whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute? of their own children, or of strangers?
bsb_text: “Yes,” he answered. When Peter entered the house, Jesus preempted him. “What do you think, Simon?” He asked. “From whom do the kings of the earth collect customs and taxes: from their own sons, or from others?”
aov_text: Hy antwoord: Ja. En toe hy in die huis inkom, was Jesus hom voor en sê: Wat dink jy, Simon? Van wie neem die konings van die aarde tol of belasting — van hulle seuns of van die vreemdelinge?

kjv_text: Peter saith unto him, Of strangers. Jesus saith unto him, Then are the children free.
bsb_text: “From others,” Peter answered. “Then the sons are exempt,” Jesus declared.
aov_text: Petrus antwoord Hom: Van die vreemdelinge. Jesus sê vir hom: Dan is die seuns vry.

kjv_text: Notwithstanding, lest we should offend them, go thou to the sea, and cast an hook, and take up the fish that first cometh up; and when thou hast opened his mouth, thou shalt find a piece of money: that take, and give unto them for me and thee.
bsb_text: “But so that we may not offend them, go to the sea, cast a hook, and take the first fish you catch. When you open its mouth, you will find a four-drachma coin. Take it and give it to them for My tax and yours.”
aov_text: Maar dat ons hulle geen aanstoot mag gee nie, gaan na die see toe, gooi ’n hoek uit en neem die eerste vis wat opkom; en as jy sy bek oopmaak, sal jy ’n stater kry; neem dit en gee dit aan hulle vir My en vir jou.

kjv_text: At the same time came the disciples unto Jesus, saying, Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?
bsb_text: At that time the disciples came to Jesus and asked, “Who then is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?”
aov_text: IN daardie uur het die dissipels na Jesus gekom en gesê: Wie is tog die grootste in die koninkryk van die hemele?

kjv_text: And Jesus called a little child unto him, and set him in the midst of them,
bsb_text: Jesus invited a little child to stand among them.
aov_text: Toe roep Jesus ’n kindjie na Hom en laat hom in hul midde staan

kjv_text: And said, Verily I say unto you, Except ye be converted, and become as little children, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven.
bsb_text: “Truly I tell you,” He said, “unless you change and become like little children, you will never enter the kingdom of heaven.
aov_text: en Hy sê: Voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, as julle nie verander en soos die kindertjies word nie, sal julle nooit in die koninkryk van die hemele ingaan nie!

kjv_text: Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child, the same is greatest in the kingdom of heaven.
bsb_text: Therefore, whoever humbles himself like this little child is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven.
aov_text: Elkeen dan wat homself verneder soos hierdie kindjie, hy is die grootste in die koninkryk van die hemele.

kjv_text: And whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receiveth me.
bsb_text: And whoever welcomes a little child like this in My name welcomes Me.
aov_text: En elkeen wat een van sulke kindertjies in my Naam ontvang, ontvang My;

kjv_text: But whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea.
bsb_text: But if anyone causes one of these little ones who believe in Me to stumble, it would be better for him to have a large millstone hung around his neck and to be drowned in the depths of the sea.
aov_text: maar elkeen wat een van hierdie kleintjies wat in My glo, laat struikel, dit is vir hom beter dat ’n meulsteen aan sy nek gehang word en hy wegsink in die diepte van die see.

kjv_text: Woe unto the world because of offences! for it must needs be that offences come; but woe to that man by whom the offence cometh!
bsb_text: Woe to the world for the causes of sin. These stumbling blocks must come, but woe to the man through whom they come!
aov_text: Wee die wêreld weens die struikelblokke! Want dit is noodsaaklik dat daar struikelblokke kom, maar wee die mens deur wie die struikelblok kom.

kjv_text: Wherefore if thy hand or thy foot offend thee, cut them off, and cast them from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life halt or maimed, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into everlasting fire.
bsb_text: If your hand or your foot causes you to sin, cut it off and throw it away. It is better for you to enter life crippled or lame than to have two hands and two feet and be thrown into the eternal fire.
aov_text: En as jou hand of jou voet jou laat struikel, kap dit af en gooi dit weg van jou af; dit is vir jou beter om in die lewe in te gaan, kreupel of vermink, as om twee hande of voete te hê en in die ewige vuur gewerp te word.

kjv_text: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire.
bsb_text: And if your eye causes you to sin, gouge it out and throw it away. It is better for you to enter life with one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into the fire of hell.
aov_text: En as jou oog jou laat struikel, ruk dit uit en werp dit weg van jou af. Dit is vir jou beter om met een oog in die lewe in te gaan, as om twee oë te hê en in die helse vuur gewerp te word.

kjv_text: Take heed that ye despise not one of these little ones; for I say unto you, That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven.
bsb_text: See that you do not look down on any of these little ones. For I tell you that their angels in heaven always see the face of My Father in heaven.
aov_text: Pas op dat julle nie een van hierdie kleintjies verag nie; want Ek sê vir julle dat hulle engele in die hemele altyd die aangesig sien van my Vader wat in die hemele is.

kjv_text: For the Son of man is come to save that which was lost.
aov_text: Want die Seun van die mens het gekom om te red wat verlore is.

kjv_text: How think ye? if a man have an hundred sheep, and one of them be gone astray, doth he not leave the ninety and nine, and goeth into the mountains, and seeketh that which is gone astray?
bsb_text: What do you think? If a man has a hundred sheep and one of them goes astray, will he not leave the ninety-nine on the hills and go out to search for the one that is lost?
aov_text: Wat dink julle? As iemand honderd skape het en een van hulle verdwaal, sal hy nie die negen-en-negentig laat staan en op die berge die verdwaalde een gaan soek nie?

kjv_text: And if so be that he find it, verily I say unto you, he rejoiceth more of that sheep, than of the ninety and nine which went not astray.
bsb_text: And if he finds it, truly I tell you, he rejoices more over that one sheep than over the ninety-nine that did not go astray.
aov_text: En as hy hom kry, voorwaar Ek sê vir julle dat hy blyer is oor hom as oor die negen-en-negentig wat nie verdwaal het nie.

kjv_text: Even so it is not the will of your Father which is in heaven, that one of these little ones should perish.
bsb_text: In the same way, your Father in heaven is not willing that any of these little ones should perish.
aov_text: So is dit nie die wil van julle Vader wat in die hemele is, dat een van hierdie kleintjies verlore gaan nie.

kjv_text: Moreover if thy brother shall trespass against thee, go and tell him his fault between thee and him alone: if he shall hear thee, thou hast gained thy brother.
bsb_text: If your brother sins against you, go and confront him privately. If he listens to you, you have won your brother over.
aov_text: EN as jou broeder teen jou sondig, gaan bestraf hom tussen jou en hom alleen. As hy na jou luister, dan het jy jou broeder gewin;

kjv_text: But if he will not hear thee, then take with thee one or two more, that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.
bsb_text: But if he will not listen, take one or two others along, so that ‘every matter may be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.’
aov_text: maar as hy nie luister nie, neem nog een of twee met jou saam, sodat in die mond van twee of drie getuies elke woord kan vasstaan.

kjv_text: And if he shall neglect to hear them, tell it unto the church: but if he neglect to hear the church, let him be unto thee as an heathen man and a publican.
bsb_text: If he refuses to listen to them, tell it to the church. And if he refuses to listen even to the church, regard him as you would a pagan or a tax collector.
aov_text: En as hy na hulle nie luister nie, sê dit aan die gemeente; en as hy na die gemeente ook nie luister nie, laat hom vir jou wees soos die heiden en die tollenaar.

kjv_text: Verily I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever ye shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
bsb_text: Truly I tell you, whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven.
aov_text: Voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, alles wat julle op die aarde bind, sal in die hemel gebonde wees; en alles wat julle op die aarde ontbind, sal in die hemel ontbonde wees.

kjv_text: Again I say unto you, That if two of you shall agree on earth as touching any thing that they shall ask, it shall be done for them of my Father which is in heaven.
bsb_text: Again, I tell you truly that if two of you on the earth agree about anything you ask for, it will be done for you by My Father in heaven.
aov_text: Weer sê Ek vir julle: As twee van julle saamstem op die aarde oor enige saak wat hulle mag vra, dit sal hulle ten deel val van my Vader wat in die hemele is.

kjv_text: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.
bsb_text: For where two or three gather together in My name, there am I with them.”
aov_text: Want waar twee of drie in my Naam vergader, daar is Ek in hul midde.

kjv_text: Then came Peter to him, and said, Lord, how oft shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? till seven times?
bsb_text: Then Peter came to Jesus and asked, “Lord, how many times shall I forgive my brother who sins against me? Up to seven times?”
aov_text: Toe kom Petrus na Hom en sê: Here, hoe dikwels sal my broeder teen my sondig en ek hom vergewe? Tot sewe maal toe?

kjv_text: Jesus saith unto him, I say not unto thee, Until seven times: but, Until seventy times seven.
bsb_text: Jesus answered, “I tell you, not just seven times, but seventy-seven times!
aov_text: Jesus antwoord hom: Ek sê vir jou, nie tot sewe maal toe nie, maar tot sewentig maal sewe toe.

kjv_text: Therefore is the kingdom of heaven likened unto a certain king, which would take account of his servants.
bsb_text: Because of this, the kingdom of heaven is like a king who wanted to settle accounts with his servants.
aov_text: Daarom word die koninkryk van die hemele vergelyk met ’n sekere koning wat met sy diensknegte wou afreken.

kjv_text: And when he had begun to reckon, one was brought unto him, which owed him ten thousand talents.
bsb_text: As he began the settlements, a debtor was brought to him owing ten thousand talents.
aov_text: En toe hy begin afreken, word daar een na hom gebring wat tienduisend talente skuldig was.

kjv_text: But forasmuch as he had not to pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, and his wife, and children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.
bsb_text: Since the man was unable to pay, the master ordered that he be sold to pay his debt, along with his wife and children and everything he owned.
aov_text: En omdat hy nie kon betaal nie, gee sy heer bevel dat hy verkoop moet word, en sy vrou en sy kinders en alles wat hy het, en dat betaal moet word.

kjv_text: The servant therefore fell down, and worshipped him, saying, Lord, have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.
bsb_text: Then the servant fell on his knees before him. ‘Have patience with me,’ he begged, ‘and I will pay back everything.’
aov_text: Toe val die dienskneg neer en buig voor hom en sê: Heer, wees lankmoedig met my, en ek sal u alles betaal.

kjv_text: Then the lord of that servant was moved with compassion, and loosed him, and forgave him the debt.
bsb_text: His master had compassion on him, forgave his debt, and released him.
aov_text: En die heer van daardie dienskneg het innig jammer vir hom gevoel en hom losgelaat en hom die skuld kwytgeskeld.

kjv_text: But the same servant went out, and found one of his fellowservants, which owed him an hundred pence: and he laid hands on him, and took him by the throat, saying, Pay me that thou owest.
bsb_text: But when that servant went out, he found one of his fellow servants who owed him a hundred denarii. He grabbed him and began to choke him, saying, ‘Pay back what you owe me!’
aov_text: Maar toe daardie dienskneg uitgaan en een van sy medediensknegte vind wat hom honderd pennings skuldig was, het hy hom aan die keel gegryp en gesê: Betaal my wat jy skuld.

kjv_text: And his fellowservant fell down at his feet, and besought him, saying, Have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.
bsb_text: So his fellow servant fell down and begged him, ‘Have patience with me, and I will pay you back.’
aov_text: Sy mededienskneg val toe voor sy voete neer en smeek hom en sê: Wees lankmoedig met my, en ek sal jou alles betaal.

kjv_text: And he would not: but went and cast him into prison, till he should pay the debt.
bsb_text: But he refused. Instead, he went and had the man thrown into prison until he could pay his debt.
aov_text: En hy wou nie, maar het gegaan en hom in die gevangenis gewerp totdat hy die skuld sou betaal het.

kjv_text: So when his fellowservants saw what was done, they were very sorry, and came and told unto their lord all that was done.
bsb_text: When his fellow servants saw what had happened, they were greatly distressed, and they went and recounted all of this to their master.
aov_text: En toe sy medediensknegte sien wat gebeur het, was hulle baie bedroef, en hulle het gegaan en aan hulle heer meegedeel alles wat gebeur het.

kjv_text: Then his lord, after that he had called him, said unto him, O thou wicked servant, I forgave thee all that debt, because thou desiredst me:
bsb_text: Then the master summoned him and declared, ‘You wicked servant! I forgave all your debt because you begged me.
aov_text: Daarop roep sy heer hom en sê vir hom: Jou slegte dienskneg, al daardie skuld het ek jou kwytgeskeld, omdat jy my gesmeek het;

kjv_text: Shouldest not thou also have had compassion on thy fellowservant, even as I had pity on thee?
bsb_text: Shouldn’t you have had mercy on your fellow servant, just as I had on you?’
aov_text: moes jy nie jou mededienskneg ook barmhartig wees soos ek jou ook barmhartig gewees het nie?

kjv_text: And his lord was wroth, and delivered him to the tormentors, till he should pay all that was due unto him.
bsb_text: In anger his master turned him over to the jailers to be tortured, until he should repay all that he owed.
aov_text: En sy heer het hom in toorn oorgegee aan die pynigers totdat hy sou betaal het alles wat hy hom skuldig was.

kjv_text: So likewise shall my heavenly Father do also unto you, if ye from your hearts forgive not every one his brother their trespasses.
bsb_text: That is how My heavenly Father will treat each of you unless you forgive your brother from your heart.”
aov_text: So sal ook my hemelse Vader aan julle doen as julle nie elkeen sy broeder van harte sy oortredinge vergewe nie.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these sayings, he departed from Galilee, and came into the coasts of Judaea beyond Jordan;
bsb_text: When Jesus had finished saying these things, He left Galilee and went into the region of Judea beyond the Jordan.
aov_text: EN toe Jesus hierdie woorde geëindig het, het Hy van Galiléa vertrek en in die gebied van Judéa oorkant die Jordaan gekom.

kjv_text: And great multitudes followed him; and he healed them there.
bsb_text: Large crowds followed Him, and He healed them there.
aov_text: En groot menigtes het Hom gevolg, en Hy het hulle daar gesond gemaak.

kjv_text: The Pharisees also came unto him, tempting him, and saying unto him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?
bsb_text: Then some Pharisees came and tested Him by asking, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?”
aov_text: Toe kom die Fariseërs na Hom om Hom te versoek, en sê vir Hom: Is dit ’n man geoorloof om oor allerhande redes van sy vrou te skei?

kjv_text: And he answered and said unto them, Have ye not read, that he which made them at the beginning made them male and female,
bsb_text: Jesus answered, “Have you not read that from the beginning the Creator ‘made them male and female,’
aov_text: En Hy antwoord hulle en sê: Het julle nie gelees dat Hy wat hulle gemaak het, hulle van die begin af man en vrou gemaak het nie,

kjv_text: And said, For this cause shall a man leave father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife: and they twain shall be one flesh?
bsb_text: and said, ‘For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and the two will become one flesh’?
aov_text: en gesê het: Om hierdie rede sal die man sy vader en sy moeder verlaat en sy vrou aankleef, en hulle twee sal een vlees wees;

kjv_text: Wherefore they are no more twain, but one flesh. What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
bsb_text: So they are no longer two, but one flesh. Therefore what God has joined together, let man not separate.”
aov_text: sodat hulle nie meer twee is nie, maar een vlees? Wat God dan saamgevoeg het, mag geen mens skei nie.

kjv_text: They say unto him, Why did Moses then command to give a writing of divorcement, and to put her away?
bsb_text: “Why then,” they asked, “did Moses order a man to give his wife a certificate of divorce and send her away?”
aov_text: Hulle sê vir Hom: Waarom het Moses dan beveel om ’n skeibrief te gee en van haar te skei?

kjv_text: He saith unto them, Moses because of the hardness of your hearts suffered you to put away your wives: but from the beginning it was not so.
bsb_text: Jesus replied, “Moses permitted you to divorce your wives because of your hardness of heart; but it was not this way from the beginning.
aov_text: Hy antwoord hulle: Omdat Moses weens die hardheid van jul harte julle toegelaat het om van julle vroue te skei; maar van die begin af was dit nie so nie.

kjv_text: And I say unto you, Whosoever shall put away his wife, except it be for fornication, and shall marry another, committeth adultery: and whoso marrieth her which is put away doth commit adultery.
bsb_text: Now I tell you that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another woman, commits adultery.”
aov_text: Maar Ek sê vir julle, elkeen wat van sy vrou skei, behalwe oor hoerery, en ’n ander een trou, pleeg egbreuk; en die wat die geskeie vrou trou, pleeg egbreuk.

kjv_text: His disciples say unto him, If the case of the man be so with his wife, it is not good to marry.
bsb_text: His disciples said to Him, “If this is the case between a man and his wife, it is better not to marry.”
aov_text: Sy dissipels sê vir Hom: As die saak van ’n man met ’n vrou so is, dan is dit nie wenslik om te trou nie.

kjv_text: But he said unto them, All men cannot receive this saying, save they to whom it is given.
bsb_text: “Not everyone can accept this word,” He replied, “but only those to whom it has been given.
aov_text: Maar Hy sê vir hulle: Almal vat hierdie woord nie, maar net dié aan wie dit gegee is.

kjv_text: For there are some eunuchs, which were so born from their mother's womb: and there are some eunuchs, which were made eunuchs of men: and there be eunuchs, which have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven's sake. He that is able to receive it, let him receive it.
bsb_text: For there are eunuchs who were born that way; others were made that way by men; and still others live like eunuchs for the sake of the kingdom of heaven. The one who can accept this should accept it.”
aov_text: Want daar is persone wat onbekwaam is om te trou, wat van die moederskoot af so gebore is, en daar is persone wat deur die mense onbekwaam gemaak is, en daar is persone wat hulleself onbekwaam gemaak het ter wille van die koninkryk van die hemele. Wie dit kan vat, laat hom dit vat.

kjv_text: Then were there brought unto him little children, that he should put his hands on them, and pray: and the disciples rebuked them.
bsb_text: Then the little children were brought to Jesus for Him to place His hands on them and pray for them. And the disciples rebuked those who brought them.
aov_text: TOE bring hulle kindertjies na Hom, dat Hy hulle die hande sou oplê en bid; en die dissipels het hulle bestraf.

kjv_text: But Jesus said, Suffer little children, and forbid them not, to come unto me: for of such is the kingdom of heaven.
bsb_text: But Jesus said, “Let the little children come to Me, and do not hinder them! For the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these.”
aov_text: Maar Jesus sê: Laat die kindertjies staan en verhinder hulle nie om na My te kom nie; want aan sulkes behoort die koninkryk van die hemele.

kjv_text: And he laid his hands on them, and departed thence.
bsb_text: And after He had placed His hands on them, He went on from there.
aov_text: En Hy het hulle die hande opgelê en daarvandaan vertrek.

kjv_text: And, behold, one came and said unto him, Good Master, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?
bsb_text: Just then a man came up to Jesus and inquired, “Teacher, what good thing must I do to obtain eternal life?”
aov_text: EN daar kom een na Hom en sê vir Hom: Goeie meester, watter goeie ding moet ek doen, dat ek die ewige lewe kan hê?

kjv_text: And he said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God: but if thou wilt enter into life, keep the commandments.
bsb_text: “Why do you ask Me about what is good?” Jesus replied. “There is only One who is good. If you want to enter life, keep the commandments.”
aov_text: En Hy sê vir hom: Waarom noem jy My goed? Niemand is goed nie, behalwe een, naamlik God. Maar as jy in die lewe wil ingaan, onderhou die gebooie.

kjv_text: He saith unto him, Which?
bsb_text: “Which ones?” the man asked.
aov_text: Hy vra Hom: Watter?

kjv_text: Jesus said, Thou shalt do no murder, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness,
bsb_text: Jesus answered, “‘Do not murder, do not commit adultery, do not steal, do not bear false witness,
aov_text: En Jesus sê — dit: Jy mag nie doodslaan nie, jy mag nie egbreek nie, jy mag nie steel nie, jy mag geen valse getuienis gee nie;

kjv_text: Honour thy father and thy mother: and, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
bsb_text: honor your father and mother, and love your neighbor as yourself.’”
aov_text: eer jou vader en moeder; en: Jy moet jou naaste liefhê soos jouself.

kjv_text: The young man saith unto him, All these things have I kept from my youth up: what lack I yet?
bsb_text: “All these I have kept,” said the young man. “What do I still lack?”
aov_text: Die jongman sê vir Hom: Al hierdie dinge het ek onderhou van my jeug af. Wat kom ek nog kort?

kjv_text: Jesus said unto him, If thou wilt be perfect, go and sell that thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come and follow me.
bsb_text: Jesus told him, “If you want to be perfect, go, sell your possessions and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow Me.”
aov_text: Jesus antwoord hom: As jy volmaak wil wees, gaan verkoop jou goed en gee dit aan die armes, en jy sal ’n skat in die hemel hê; en kom hier, volg My.

kjv_text: But when the young man heard that saying, he went away sorrowful: for he had great possessions.
bsb_text: When the young man heard this, he went away in sorrow, because he had great wealth.
aov_text: Maar toe die jongman dié woord hoor, het hy bedroef weggegaan; want hy het baie besittings gehad.

kjv_text: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, Verily I say unto you, That a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven.
bsb_text: Then Jesus said to His disciples, “Truly I tell you, it is hard for a rich man to enter the kingdom of heaven.
aov_text: En Jesus sê vir sy dissipels: Voorwaar Ek sê vir julle dat ’n ryk man beswaarlik in die koninkryk van die hemele sal ingaan.

kjv_text: And again I say unto you, It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
bsb_text: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God.”
aov_text: En verder sê Ek vir julle, dit is makliker vir ’n kameel om deur die oog van ’n naald te gaan as vir ’n ryk man om in die koninkryk van God in te gaan.

kjv_text: When his disciples heard it, they were exceedingly amazed, saying, Who then can be saved?
bsb_text: When the disciples heard this, they were greatly astonished and asked, “Who then can be saved?”
aov_text: Toe sy dissipels dit hoor, was hulle baie verslae en sê: Wie kan dan gered word?

kjv_text: But Jesus beheld them, and said unto them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.
bsb_text: Jesus looked at them and said, “With man this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”
aov_text: Maar Jesus het hulle aangekyk en vir hulle gesê: By mense is dit onmoontlik, maar by God is alle dinge moontlik.

kjv_text: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Behold, we have forsaken all, and followed thee; what shall we have therefore?
bsb_text: “Look,” Peter replied, “we have left everything to follow You. What then will there be for us?”
aov_text: Daarop antwoord Petrus en sê vir Hom: Kyk, ons het alles verlaat en U gevolg. Wat sal daar dan vir ons wees?

kjv_text: And Jesus said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That ye which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
bsb_text: Jesus said to them, “Truly I tell you, in the renewal of all things, when the Son of Man sits on His glorious throne, you who have followed Me will also sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
aov_text: En Jesus sê vir hulle: Voorwaar Ek sê vir julle dat julle wat My gevolg het, in die wedergeboorte wanneer die Seun van die mens op sy heerlike troon gaan sit, julle ook op twaalf trone sal sit en die twaalf stamme van Israel sal oordeel.

kjv_text: And every one that hath forsaken houses, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name's sake, shall receive an hundredfold, and shall inherit everlasting life.
bsb_text: And everyone who has left houses or brothers or sisters or father or mother or wife or children or fields for the sake of My name will receive a hundredfold and will inherit eternal life.
aov_text: En elkeen wat huise of broers of susters of vader of moeder of vrou of kinders of grond ter wille van my Naam verlaat het, sal honderd maal soveel ontvang en die ewige lewe beërwe.

kjv_text: But many that are first shall be last; and the last shall be first.
bsb_text: But many who are first will be last, and the last will be first.
aov_text: Maar baie wat eerste is, sal laaste wees, en wat laaste is, eerste.

kjv_text: For the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which went out early in the morning to hire labourers into his vineyard.
bsb_text: “For the kingdom of heaven is like a landowner who went out early in the morning to hire workers for his vineyard.
aov_text: WANT die koninkryk van die hemele is soos ’n huisheer wat vroeg in die môre uitgegaan het om arbeiders vir sy wingerd te huur.

kjv_text: And when he had agreed with the labourers for a penny a day, he sent them into his vineyard.
bsb_text: He agreed to pay them a denarius for the day and sent them into his vineyard.
aov_text: En nadat hy met die arbeiders ooreengekom het vir ’n penning op ’n dag, stuur hy hulle in sy wingerd.

kjv_text: And he went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace,
bsb_text: About the third hour he went out and saw others standing in the marketplace doing nothing.
aov_text: En omtrent die derde uur gaan hy uit en sien ander ledig op die mark staan.

kjv_text: And said unto them; Go ye also into the vineyard, and whatsoever is right I will give you. And they went their way.
bsb_text: ‘You also go into my vineyard,’ he said, ‘and I will pay you whatever is right.’
aov_text: En hy sê vir hulle: Gaan julle ook in die wingerd, en wat reg is, sal ek aan julle gee. En hulle het gegaan.

kjv_text: Again he went out about the sixth and ninth hour, and did likewise.
bsb_text: So they went. He went out again about the sixth hour and the ninth hour and did the same thing.
aov_text: Weer het hy omtrent die sesde en die negende uur uitgegaan en net dieselfde gedoen.

kjv_text: And about the eleventh hour he went out, and found others standing idle, and saith unto them, Why stand ye here all the day idle?
bsb_text: About the eleventh hour he went out and found still others standing around. ‘Why have you been standing here all day long doing nothing?’ he asked.
aov_text: En omtrent die elfde uur gaan hy uit en vind ander ledig staan en sê vir hulle: Wat staan julle hier die hele dag ledig?

kjv_text: They say unto him, Because no man hath hired us. He saith unto them, Go ye also into the vineyard; and whatsoever is right, that shall ye receive.
bsb_text: ‘Because no one has hired us,’ they answered. So he told them, ‘You also go into my vineyard.’
aov_text: Hulle antwoord hom: Omdat niemand ons gehuur het nie. Hy sê vir hulle: Gaan julle ook in die wingerd, en wat reg is, sal julle ontvang.

kjv_text: So when even was come, the lord of the vineyard saith unto his steward, Call the labourers, and give them their hire, beginning from the last unto the first.
bsb_text: When evening came, the owner of the vineyard said to his foreman, ‘Call the workers and pay them their wages, starting with the last ones hired and moving on to the first.’
aov_text: En toe dit aand geword het, sê die heer van die wingerd vir sy opsigter: Roep die arbeiders en betaal hulle hul loon; en begin van die laastes af tot by die eerstes.

kjv_text: And when they came that were hired about the eleventh hour, they received every man a penny.
bsb_text: The workers who were hired about the eleventh hour came and each received a denarius.
aov_text: En die wat omtrent die elfde uur begin het, het gekom en elkeen ’n penning ontvang.

kjv_text: But when the first came, they supposed that they should have received more; and they likewise received every man a penny.
bsb_text: So when the original workers came, they assumed they would receive more. But each of them also received a denarius.
aov_text: Die eerstes kom toe en dink dat hulle meer sal ontvang, en hulle het ook elkeen ’n penning ontvang.

kjv_text: And when they had received it, they murmured against the goodman of the house,
bsb_text: On receiving their pay, they began to grumble against the landowner.
aov_text: En toe hulle dit ontvang, murmureer hulle by die huisheer

kjv_text: Saying, These last have wrought but one hour, and thou hast made them equal unto us, which have borne the burden and heat of the day.
bsb_text: ‘These men who were hired last worked only one hour,’ they said, ‘and you have made them equal to us who have borne the burden and the scorching heat of the day.’
aov_text: en sê: Hierdie laastes het een uur gewerk, en u het hulle gelykop behandel met ons wat die las van die dag en die hitte gedra het.

kjv_text: But he answered one of them, and said, Friend, I do thee no wrong: didst not thou agree with me for a penny?
bsb_text: But he answered one of them, ‘Friend, I am not being unfair to you. Did you not agree with me on one denarius?
aov_text: Maar hy antwoord en sê vir een van hulle: Vriend, ek doen jou geen onreg aan nie. Het jy nie met my ooreengekom vir ’n penning nie?

kjv_text: Take that thine is, and go thy way: I will give unto this last, even as unto thee.
bsb_text: Take your pay and go. I want to give this last man the same as I gave you.
aov_text: Neem dan wat joue is, en gaan heen. Ek wil aan hierdie laaste een gee net soos aan jou.

kjv_text: Is it not lawful for me to do what I will with mine own? Is thine eye evil, because I am good?
bsb_text: Do I not have the right to do as I please with what is mine? Or are you envious because I am generous?’
aov_text: Of staan dit my nie vry om met my eie goed te maak wat ek wil nie? Of is jou oog verkeerd, omdat ek goed is?

kjv_text: So the last shall be first, and the first last: for many be called, but few chosen.
bsb_text: So the last will be first, and the first will be last.”
aov_text: So sal die wat laaste is, eerste wees, en die wat eerste is, laaste; want baie is geroep, maar min uitverkies.

kjv_text: And Jesus going up to Jerusalem took the twelve disciples apart in the way, and said unto them,
bsb_text: As Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, He took the twelve disciples aside and said,
aov_text: EN toe Jesus opgaan na Jerusalem, het Hy die twaalf dissipels op die pad alleen geneem en vir hulle gesê:

kjv_text: Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be betrayed unto the chief priests and unto the scribes, and they shall condemn him to death,
bsb_text: “Look, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be delivered over to the chief priests and scribes. They will condemn Him to death
aov_text: Kyk, ons gaan op na Jerusalem, en die Seun van die mens sal oorgelewer word aan die owerpriesters en skrifgeleerdes; en hulle sal Hom tot die dood veroordeel

kjv_text: And shall deliver him to the Gentiles to mock, and to scourge, and to crucify him: and the third day he shall rise again.
bsb_text: and will deliver Him over to the Gentiles to be mocked and flogged and crucified. And on the third day He will be raised to life.”
aov_text: en Hom oorlewer aan die heidene om Hom te bespot en te gésel en te kruisig; en op die derde dag sal Hy opstaan.

kjv_text: Then came to him the mother of Zebedee's children with her sons, worshipping him, and desiring a certain thing of him.
bsb_text: Then the mother of Zebedee’s sons came to Jesus with her sons and knelt down to make a request of Him.
aov_text: Toe kom die moeder van die seuns van Sebedéüs met haar seuns na Hom en buig voor Hom neer om iets van Hom te vra.

kjv_text: And he said unto her, What wilt thou? She saith unto him, Grant that these my two sons may sit, the one on thy right hand, and the other on the left, in thy kingdom.
bsb_text: “What do you want?” He inquired. She answered, “Declare that in Your kingdom one of these two sons of mine may sit at Your right hand, and the other at Your left.”
aov_text: En Hy sê vir haar: Wat wil jy hê? Sy antwoord Hom: Sê dat hierdie twee seuns van my in u koninkryk mag sit, een aan u regter- en een aan u linkerhand.

kjv_text: But Jesus answered and said, Ye know not what ye ask. Are ye able to drink of the cup that I shall drink of, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with? They say unto him, We are able.
bsb_text: “You do not know what you are asking,” Jesus replied. “Can you drink the cup I am going to drink?” “We can,” the brothers answered.
aov_text: Maar Jesus antwoord en sê: Julle weet nie wat julle vra nie. Kan julle die beker drink wat Ek aanstons gaan drink, en gedoop word met die doop waarmee Ek gedoop word? Hulle sê vir Hom: Ons kan.

kjv_text: And he saith unto them, Ye shall drink indeed of my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with: but to sit on my right hand, and on my left, is not mine to give, but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared of my Father.
bsb_text: “You will indeed drink My cup,” Jesus said. “But to sit at My right or left is not Mine to grant. These seats belong to those for whom My Father has prepared them.”
aov_text: En Hy sê vir hulle: Dis waar, my beker sal julle drink en met die doop waarmee Ek gedoop word, sal julle gedoop word; maar om te sit aan my regter- en aan my linkerhand berus nie by My om te gee nie, maar is vir hulle vir wie dit deur my Vader berei is.

kjv_text: And when the ten heard it, they were moved with indignation against the two brethren.
bsb_text: When the ten heard about this, they were indignant with the two brothers.
aov_text: En toe die tien dit hoor, was hulle verontwaardig oor die twee broers.

kjv_text: But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Ye know that the princes of the Gentiles exercise dominion over them, and they that are great exercise authority upon them.
bsb_text: But Jesus called them aside and said, “You know that the rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them, and their superiors exercise authority over them.
aov_text: Maar Jesus het hulle na Hom geroep en gesê: Julle weet dat die owerstes van die nasies oor hulle heers en die groot manne oor hulle gesag uitoefen;

kjv_text: But it shall not be so among you: but whosoever will be great among you, let him be your minister;
bsb_text: It shall not be this way among you. Instead, whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant,
aov_text: maar só moet dit onder julle nie wees nie; maar elkeen wat onder julle groot wil word, moet julle dienaar wees.

kjv_text: And whosoever will be chief among you, let him be your servant:
bsb_text: and whoever wants to be first among you must be your slave—
aov_text: En elkeen wat onder julle die eerste wil word, moet julle dienskneg wees;

kjv_text: Even as the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
bsb_text: just as the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give His life as a ransom for many.”
aov_text: net soos die Seun van die mens nie gekom het om gedien te word nie, maar om te dien en sy lewe te gee as ’n losprys vir baie.

kjv_text: And as they departed from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.
bsb_text: As they were leaving Jericho, a large crowd followed Him.
