aov_text: EN toe hulle uit Jérigo uitgaan, het ’n groot menigte Hom gevolg.

kjv_text: And, behold, two blind men sitting by the way side, when they heard that Jesus passed by, cried out, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou son of David.
bsb_text: And there were two blind men sitting beside the road. When they heard that Jesus was passing by, they cried out, “Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!”
aov_text: En daar het twee blindes langs die pad gesit; en toe hulle hoor dat Jesus verbygaan, roep hulle uit en sê: Wees ons barmhartig, Here, Seun van Dawid!

kjv_text: And the multitude rebuked them, because they should hold their peace: but they cried the more, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou son of David.
bsb_text: The crowd admonished them to be silent, but they cried out all the louder, “Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!”
aov_text: En die skare het hulle bestraf, dat hulle moes stilbly; maar hulle het al harder geroep en gesê: Wees ons barmhartig, Here, Seun van Dawid!

kjv_text: And Jesus stood still, and called them, and said, What will ye that I shall do unto you?
bsb_text: Jesus stopped and called them. “What do you want Me to do for you?” He asked.
aov_text: Toe gaan Jesus staan en roep hulle en sê: Wat wil julle hê moet Ek vir julle doen?

kjv_text: They say unto him, Lord, that our eyes may be opened.
bsb_text: “Lord,” they answered, “let our eyes be opened.”
aov_text: Hulle antwoord Hom: Here, dat ons oë geopen mag word.

kjv_text: So Jesus had compassion on them, and touched their eyes: and immediately their eyes received sight, and they followed him.
bsb_text: Moved with compassion, Jesus touched their eyes, and at once they received their sight and followed Him.
aov_text: En Jesus het innig jammer vir hulle gevoel en hulle oë aangeraak, en dadelik het hulle oë gesien, en hulle het Hom gevolg.

kjv_text: And when they drew nigh unto Jerusalem, and were come to Bethphage, unto the mount of Olives, then sent Jesus two disciples,
bsb_text: As they approached Jerusalem and came to Bethphage on the Mount of Olives, Jesus sent out two disciples,
aov_text: EN toe hulle naby Jerusalem gekom en Bétfagé aan die Olyfberg bereik het, stuur Jesus twee dissipels uit en sê vir hulle:

kjv_text: Saying unto them, Go into the village over against you, and straightway ye shall find an ass tied, and a colt with her: loose them, and bring them unto me.
bsb_text: saying to them, “Go into the village ahead of you, and at once you will find a donkey tied there, with her colt beside her. Untie them and bring them to Me.
aov_text: Gaan na daardie dorp reg voor julle, en dadelik sal julle ’n eselin vind wat vasgemaak is, en ’n vul by haar. Maak haar los en bring hulle vir My.

kjv_text: And if any man say ought unto you, ye shall say, The Lord hath need of them; and straightway he will send them.
bsb_text: If anyone questions you, tell him that the Lord needs them, and he will send them right away.”
aov_text: En as iemand vir julle iets sê, moet julle antwoord: Die Here het hulle nodig; en dadelik sal hy hulle stuur.

kjv_text: All this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying,
bsb_text: This took place to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet:
aov_text: En dit het alles gebeur, sodat vervul sou word die woord wat deur die profeet gespreek is:

kjv_text: Tell ye the daughter of Sion, Behold, thy King cometh unto thee, meek, and sitting upon an ass, and a colt the foal of an ass.
bsb_text: “Say to the Daughter of Zion, ‘See, your King comes to you, gentle and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.’”
aov_text: Sê vir die dogter van Sion: Kyk, jou Koning kom na jou toe, sagmoedig, en Hy sit op ’n esel, ja, ’n jong esel, die vul van ’n pakdier.

kjv_text: And the disciples went, and did as Jesus commanded them,
bsb_text: So the disciples went and did as Jesus had directed them.
aov_text: En die dissipels het gegaan en gedoen soos Jesus hulle beveel het;

kjv_text: And brought the ass, and the colt, and put on them their clothes, and they set him thereon.
bsb_text: They brought the donkey and the colt and laid their cloaks on them, and Jesus sat on them.
aov_text: hulle het die esel en die vul gebring en hulle klere daarop gelê, en Hy het daarop gaan sit.

kjv_text: And a very great multitude spread their garments in the way; others cut down branches from the trees, and strawed them in the way.
bsb_text: A massive crowd spread their cloaks on the road, while others cut branches from the trees and spread them on the road.
aov_text: En die grootste deel van die skare het hulle klere op die pad oopgegooi, en ander het takke van die bome afgekap en op die pad gestrooi.

kjv_text: And the multitudes that went before, and that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna to the son of David: Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord; Hosanna in the highest.
bsb_text: The crowds that went ahead of Him and those that followed were shouting: “Hosanna to the Son of David!” “Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!” “Hosanna in the highest!”
aov_text: En die skare wat voor geloop en die wat gevolg het, het uitgeroep en gesê: Hosanna vir die Seun van Dawid! Geseënd is Hy wat kom in die Naam van die Here! Hosanna in die hoogste hemele!

kjv_text: And when he was come into Jerusalem, all the city was moved, saying, Who is this?
bsb_text: When Jesus had entered Jerusalem, the whole city was stirred and asked, “Who is this?”
aov_text: En toe Hy in Jerusalem inkom, het die hele stad in opskudding geraak en gesê: Wie is hierdie man?

kjv_text: And the multitude said, This is Jesus the prophet of Nazareth of Galilee.
bsb_text: The crowds replied, “This is Jesus, the prophet from Nazareth in Galilee.”
aov_text: En die skare sê: Dit is Jesus, die profeet, van Násaret in Galiléa.

kjv_text: And Jesus went into the temple of God, and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves,
bsb_text: Then Jesus entered the temple courts and drove out all who were buying and selling there. He overturned the tables of the money changers and the seats of those selling doves.
aov_text: EN Jesus het in die tempel van God ingegaan en almal wat in die tempel verkoop en koop, uitgejaag en die tafels van die geldwisselaars en die stoele van die duiweverkopers omgegooi.

kjv_text: And said unto them, It is written, My house shall be called the house of prayer; but ye have made it a den of thieves.
bsb_text: And He declared to them, “It is written: ‘My house will be called a house of prayer.’ But you are making it ‘a den of robbers.’”
aov_text: En Hy sê vir hulle: Daar is geskrywe: My huis moet ’n huis van gebed genoem word. Maar julle het dit ’n rowerspelonk gemaak.

kjv_text: And the blind and the lame came to him in the temple; and he healed them.
bsb_text: The blind and the lame came to Him at the temple, and He healed them.
aov_text: En daar het blindes en kreupeles na Hom gekom in die tempel, en Hy het hulle gesond gemaak.

kjv_text: And when the chief priests and scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children crying in the temple, and saying, Hosanna to the son of David; they were sore displeased,
bsb_text: But the chief priests and scribes were indignant when they saw the wonders He performed and the children shouting in the temple courts, “Hosanna to the Son of David!”
aov_text: En toe die owerpriesters en skrifgeleerdes die wonderwerke sien wat Hy gedoen het, en die kinders wat in die tempel uitroep en sê: Hosanna vir die Seun van Dawid! was hulle verontwaardig

kjv_text: And said unto him, Hearest thou what these say? And Jesus saith unto them, Yea; have ye never read, Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings thou hast perfected praise?
bsb_text: “Do You hear what these children are saying?” they asked. “Yes,” Jesus answered. “Have you never read: ‘From the mouths of children and infants You have ordained praise’?”
aov_text: en sê vir Hom: Hoor U wat hulle daar sê? En Jesus antwoord hulle: Ja, het julle nooit gelees: Uit die mond van kinders en suigelinge het U vir U lof berei nie?

kjv_text: And he left them, and went out of the city into Bethany; and he lodged there.
bsb_text: Then He left them and went out of the city to Bethany, where He spent the night.
aov_text: En Hy het hulle verlaat en uit die stad uitgegaan na Betánië en daar vernag.

kjv_text: Now in the morning as he returned into the city, he hungered.
bsb_text: In the morning, as Jesus was returning to the city, He was hungry.
aov_text: EN vroeg in die môre toe Hy teruggaan na die stad, het Hy honger gehad;

kjv_text: And when he saw a fig tree in the way, he came to it, and found nothing thereon, but leaves only, and said unto it, Let no fruit grow on thee henceforward for ever. And presently the fig tree withered away.
bsb_text: Seeing a fig tree by the road, He went up to it but found nothing on it except leaves. “May you never bear fruit again!” He said. And immediately the tree withered.
aov_text: en Hy sien ’n vyeboom langs die pad en gaan daarnatoe; maar Hy het niks daaraan gevind nie as net blare alleen; en Hy sê vir hom: Laat daar uit jou tot in ewigheid nooit weer ’n vrug kom nie! En onmiddellik het die vyeboom verdroog.

kjv_text: And when the disciples saw it, they marvelled, saying, How soon is the fig tree withered away!
bsb_text: When the disciples saw this, they marveled and asked, “How did the fig tree wither so quickly?”
aov_text: En toe die dissipels dit sien, was hulle verwonderd en sê: Hoe het die vyeboom so onmiddellik verdroog?

kjv_text: Jesus answered and said unto them, Verily I say unto you, If ye have faith, and doubt not, ye shall not only do this which is done to the fig tree, but also if ye shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; it shall be done.
bsb_text: “Truly I tell you,” Jesus replied, “if you have faith and do not doubt, not only will you do what was done to the fig tree, but even if you say to this mountain, ‘Be lifted up and thrown into the sea,’ it will happen.
aov_text: Maar Jesus antwoord en sê vir hulle: Voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, as julle geloof het en nie twyfel nie, sal julle nie alleen doen wat met die vyeboom gebeur het nie; maar al sê julle ook vir hierdie berg: Hef jou op en werp jou in die see — sal dit gebeur.

kjv_text: And all things, whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive.
bsb_text: If you believe, you will receive whatever you ask for in prayer.”
aov_text: En alles wat julle in die gebed vra, sal julle ontvang as julle glo.

kjv_text: And when he was come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came unto him as he was teaching, and said, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority?
bsb_text: When Jesus returned to the temple courts and began to teach, the chief priests and elders of the people came up to Him. “By what authority are You doing these things?” they asked. “And who gave You this authority?”
aov_text: EN toe Hy in die tempel gegaan het, kom die owerpriesters en die ouderlinge van die volk na Hom terwyl Hy besig was om te leer, en hulle sê: Deur watter gesag doen U hierdie dinge, en wie het U hierdie gesag gegee?

kjv_text: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I also will ask you one thing, which if ye tell me, I in like wise will tell you by what authority I do these things.
bsb_text: “I will also ask you one question,” Jesus replied, “and if you answer Me, I will tell you by what authority I am doing these things.
aov_text: En Jesus antwoord en sê vir hulle: Ek sal julle ook een ding vra, en as julle dit vir My sê, sal Ek julle ook vertel deur watter gesag Ek hierdie dinge doen.

kjv_text: The baptism of John, whence was it? from heaven, or of men? And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say unto us, Why did ye not then believe him?
bsb_text: What was the source of John’s baptism? Was it from heaven or from men?” They deliberated among themselves and said, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ He will ask, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’
aov_text: Die doop van Johannes, waar was dit vandaan, uit die hemel of uit mense? En hulle het by hulleself geredeneer en gesê: As ons sê: Uit die hemel — dan sal Hy ons vra: Waarom het julle hom dan nie geglo nie?

kjv_text: But if we shall say, Of men; we fear the people; for all hold John as a prophet.
bsb_text: But if we say, ‘From men,’ we are afraid of the people, for they all regard John as a prophet.”
aov_text: En as ons sê: Uit mense — dan moet ons oppas vir die menigte, want almal hou Johannes vir ’n profeet.

kjv_text: And they answered Jesus, and said, We cannot tell. And he said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.
bsb_text: So they answered, “We do not know.” And Jesus replied, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things.
aov_text: Toe antwoord hulle Jesus en sê: Ons weet nie. Hy sê toe ook vir hulle: Dan vertel Ek julle ook nie deur watter gesag Ek hierdie dinge doen nie.

kjv_text: But what think ye? A certain man had two sons; and he came to the first, and said, Son, go work to day in my vineyard.
bsb_text: But what do you think? There was a man who had two sons. He went to the first one and said, ‘Son, go and work today in the vineyard.’
aov_text: MAAR wat dink julle? ’n Man het twee kinders gehad, en hy gaan na die eerste en sê: Kind, gaan werk vandag in my wingerd.

kjv_text: He answered and said, I will not: but afterward he repented, and went.
bsb_text: ‘I will not,’ he replied. But later he changed his mind and went.
aov_text: En hy antwoord en sê: Ek wil nie; maar later het hy berou gekry en gegaan.

kjv_text: And he came to the second, and said likewise. And he answered and said, I go, sir: and went not.
bsb_text: Then the man went to the second son and told him the same thing. ‘I will, sir,’ he said. But he did not go.
aov_text: Toe het hy na die tweede gegaan en vir hom net so gesê; en hy antwoord en sê: Ja, heer. En hy het nie gegaan nie.

kjv_text: Whether of them twain did the will of his father? They say unto him, The first. Jesus saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That the publicans and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you.
bsb_text: Which of the two did the will of his father?” “The first,” they answered. Jesus said to them, “Truly I tell you, the tax collectors and prostitutes are entering the kingdom of God before you.
aov_text: Wie van die twee het die wil van die vader gedoen? Hulle antwoord Hom: Die eerste. Jesus sê vir hulle: Voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, die tollenaars en die hoere gaan julle voor in die koninkryk van God.

kjv_text: For John came unto you in the way of righteousness, and ye believed him not: but the publicans and the harlots believed him: and ye, when ye had seen it, repented not afterward, that ye might believe him.
bsb_text: For John came to you in a righteous way and you did not believe him, but the tax collectors and prostitutes did. And even after you saw this, you did not repent and believe him.
aov_text: Want Johannes het na julle gekom in die weg van geregtigheid, en julle het hom nie geglo nie; maar die tollenaars en die hoere het hom geglo. En julle het dit gesien en tog nie later berou gekry om hom te glo nie.

kjv_text: Hear another parable: There was a certain householder, which planted a vineyard, and hedged it round about, and digged a winepress in it, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country:
bsb_text: Listen to another parable: There was a landowner who planted a vineyard. He put a wall around it, dug a winepress in it, and built a tower. Then he rented it out to some tenants and went away on a journey.
aov_text: LUISTER na ’n ander gelykenis: Daar was ’n sekere huisheer wat ’n wingerd geplant het; en hy het ’n heining daarom gesit en ’n parskuip daarin gegrawe en ’n wagtoring gebou, en hy het dit aan landbouers verhuur en op reis gegaan.

kjv_text: And when the time of the fruit drew near, he sent his servants to the husbandmen, that they might receive the fruits of it.
bsb_text: When the harvest time drew near, he sent his servants to the tenants to collect his share of the fruit.
aov_text: En toe die vrugtetyd nader kom, stuur hy sy diensknegte na die landbouers om sy vrugte te ontvang.

kjv_text: And the husbandmen took his servants, and beat one, and killed another, and stoned another.
bsb_text: But the tenants seized his servants. They beat one, killed another, and stoned a third.
aov_text: Maar die landbouers het sy diensknegte geneem en een geslaan en ’n ander een doodgemaak en ’n ander een gestenig.

kjv_text: Again, he sent other servants more than the first: and they did unto them likewise.
bsb_text: Again, he sent other servants, more than the first group. But the tenants did the same to them.
aov_text: Weer het hy ander diensknegte gestuur, meer as die eerstes, en hulle het met dié net so gemaak.

kjv_text: But last of all he sent unto them his son, saying, They will reverence my son.
bsb_text: Finally, he sent his son to them. ‘They will respect my son,’ he said.
aov_text: Oplaas het hy sy seun na hulle gestuur en gesê: Hulle sal my seun ontsien.

aov_text: en wie sweer by die hemel, sweer by die troon van God en by Hom wat daarop sit.

kjv_text: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye pay tithe of mint and anise and cummin, and have omitted the weightier matters of the law, judgment, mercy, and faith: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.
bsb_text: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You pay tithes of mint, dill, and cumin. But you have disregarded the weightier matters of the law: justice, mercy, and faithfulness. You should have practiced the latter, without neglecting the former.
aov_text: Wee julle, skrifgeleerdes en Fariseërs, geveinsdes, want julle gee tiendes van kruisement en anys en koljander, en die swaarste van die wet laat julle ná: die reg en die barmhartigheid en die trou. Hierdie dinge behoort julle te doen sonder om die ander na te laat.

kjv_text: Ye blind guides, which strain at a gnat, and swallow a camel.
bsb_text: You blind guides! You strain out a gnat but swallow a camel.
aov_text: Blinde leiers, julle wat die muggie uitsif, maar die kameel insluk!

kjv_text: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye make clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and excess.
bsb_text: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You clean the outside of the cup and dish, but inside they are full of greed and self-indulgence.
aov_text: Wee julle, skrifgeleerdes en Fariseërs, geveinsdes, want julle maak die buitekant van die beker en die skottel skoon, maar binnekant is dit vol roof en onmatigheid.

kjv_text: Thou blind Pharisee, cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter, that the outside of them may be clean also.
bsb_text: Blind Pharisee! First clean the inside of the cup and dish, so that the outside may become clean as well.
aov_text: Blinde Fariseër, maak eers die binnekant van die beker en die skottel skoon, sodat ook die buitekant daarvan skoon kan word.

kjv_text: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are like unto whited sepulchres, which indeed appear beautiful outward, but are within full of dead men's bones, and of all uncleanness.
bsb_text: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You are like whitewashed tombs, which look beautiful on the outside, but on the inside are full of dead men’s bones and every kind of impurity.
aov_text: Wee julle, skrifgeleerdes en Fariseërs, geveinsdes, want julle is net soos gewitte grafte wat van buite wel fraai lyk, maar van binne vol doodsbene en allerhande onreinheid is.

kjv_text: Even so ye also outwardly appear righteous unto men, but within ye are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.
bsb_text: In the same way, on the outside you appear to be righteous, but on the inside you are full of hypocrisy and wickedness.
aov_text: So lyk julle ook van buite vir die mense wel regverdig, maar van binne is julle vol geveinsdheid en ongeregtigheid.

kjv_text: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! because ye build the tombs of the prophets, and garnish the sepulchres of the righteous,
bsb_text: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You build tombs for the prophets and decorate the monuments of the righteous.
aov_text: Wee julle, skrifgeleerdes en Fariseërs, geveinsdes, want julle bou die grafte van die profete en versier die grafstene van die regverdiges;

kjv_text: And say, If we had been in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.
bsb_text: And you say, ‘If we had lived in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partners with them in shedding the blood of the prophets.’
aov_text: en julle sê: As ons in die dae van ons vaders geleef het, sou ons geen deel met hulle gehad het aan die bloed van die profete nie.

kjv_text: Wherefore ye be witnesses unto yourselves, that ye are the children of them which killed the prophets.
bsb_text: So you testify against yourselves that you are the sons of those who murdered the prophets.
aov_text: Julle gee dus teen julself getuienis dat julle kinders is van die wat die profete vermoor het.

kjv_text: Fill ye up then the measure of your fathers.
bsb_text: Fill up, then, the measure of the sin of your fathers.
aov_text: Maak die maat van julle vaders dan vol!

kjv_text: Ye serpents, ye generation of vipers, how can ye escape the damnation of hell?
bsb_text: You snakes! You brood of vipers! How will you escape the sentence of hell?
aov_text: Slange, addergeslag, hoe sal julle die oordeel van die hel ontvlug?

kjv_text: Wherefore, behold, I send unto you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: and some of them ye shall kill and crucify; and some of them shall ye scourge in your synagogues, and persecute them from city to city:
bsb_text: Because of this, I am sending you prophets and wise men and teachers. Some of them you will kill and crucify, and others you will flog in your synagogues and persecute in town after town.
aov_text: Daarom, kyk, Ek stuur profete en wyse manne en skrifgeleerdes na julle toe, en julle sal sommige van hulle doodmaak en kruisig en sommige van hulle in jul sinagoges gésel en van die een stad na die ander vervolg,

kjv_text: That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias, whom ye slew between the temple and the altar.
bsb_text: And so upon you will come all the righteous blood shed on earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zechariah son of Berechiah, whom you murdered between the temple and the altar.
aov_text: sodat oor julle kan kom al die regverdige bloed wat vergiet is op die aarde, van die bloed van die regverdige Abel af tot op die bloed van Sagaría, die seun van Berégja, wat julle vermoor het tussen die tempel en die altaar.

kjv_text: Verily I say unto you, All these things shall come upon this generation.
bsb_text: Truly I tell you, all these things will come upon this generation.
aov_text: Voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, al hierdie dinge sal oor hierdie geslag kom.

kjv_text: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, thou that killest the prophets, and stonest them which are sent unto thee, how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings, and ye would not!
bsb_text: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets and stones those sent to her, how often I have longed to gather your children together, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, but you were unwilling!
aov_text: Jerusalem, Jerusalem, jy wat die profete doodmaak en stenig dié wat na jou gestuur is, hoe dikwels wou Ek jou kinders bymekaarmaak net soos ’n hen haar kuikens onder die vlerke bymekaarmaak, en julle wou nie!

kjv_text: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate.
bsb_text: Look, your house is left to you desolate.
aov_text: Kyk, julle huis word vir julle woes gelaat!

kjv_text: For I say unto you, Ye shall not see me henceforth, till ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.
bsb_text: For I tell you that you will not see Me again until you say, ‘Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord.’”
aov_text: Want Ek sê vir julle: Julle sal My van nou af sekerlik nie sien nie totdat julle sal sê: Geseënd is Hy wat kom in die Naam van die Here!

kjv_text: And Jesus went out, and departed from the temple: and his disciples came to him for to shew him the buildings of the temple.
bsb_text: As Jesus left the temple and was walking away, His disciples came up to Him to point out its buildings.
aov_text: EN Jesus het uitgegaan en van die tempel vertrek, en sy dissipels het nader gekom om Hom die geboue van die tempel te wys.

kjv_text: And Jesus said unto them, See ye not all these things? verily I say unto you, There shall not be left here one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
bsb_text: “Do you see all these things?” He replied. “Truly I tell you, not one stone here will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.”
aov_text: En Jesus sê vir hulle: Sien julle al hierdie dinge? Voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, daar sal hier sekerlik nie een klip op die ander gelaat word, wat nie afgebreek sal word nie.

kjv_text: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives, the disciples came unto him privately, saying, Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world?
bsb_text: While Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to Him privately. “Tell us,” they said, “when will these things happen, and what will be the sign of Your coming and of the end of the age?”
aov_text: En toe Hy op die Olyfberg gaan sit het, kom die dissipels alleen na Hom en sê: Vertel ons, wanneer sal hierdie dinge wees, en wat is die teken van u koms en van die voleinding van die wêreld?

kjv_text: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Take heed that no man deceive you.
bsb_text: Jesus answered, “See to it that no one deceives you.
aov_text: En Jesus antwoord en sê vir hulle: Pas op dat niemand julle mislei nie.

kjv_text: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.
bsb_text: For many will come in My name, claiming, ‘I am the Christ,’ and will deceive many.
aov_text: Want baie sal onder my Naam kom en sê: Ek is die Christus! en hulle sal baie mense mislei.

kjv_text: And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.
bsb_text: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars, but see to it that you are not alarmed. These things must happen, but the end is still to come.
aov_text: En julle sal hoor van oorloë en gerugte van oorloë. Pas op, moenie verskrik word nie, want alles moet plaasvind, maar dit is nog nie die einde nie.

kjv_text: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places.
bsb_text: Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be famines and earthquakes in various places.
aov_text: Want die een nasie sal teen die ander opstaan en die een koninkryk teen die ander; en daar sal hongersnode wees en pessiektes en aardbewings op verskillende plekke.

kjv_text: All these are the beginning of sorrows.
bsb_text: All these are the beginning of birth pains.
aov_text: Maar al hierdie dinge is ’n begin van die smarte.

kjv_text: Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name's sake.
bsb_text: Then they will deliver you over to be persecuted and killed, and you will be hated by all nations because of My name.
aov_text: Dan sal hulle jul aan verdrukking oorgee en julle doodmaak; en julle sal deur al die nasies gehaat word ter wille van my Naam.

kjv_text: And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another.
bsb_text: At that time many will fall away and will betray and hate one another,
aov_text: En dan sal baie tot struikel gebring word en mekaar verraai en mekaar haat.

kjv_text: And many false prophets shall rise, and shall deceive many.
bsb_text: and many false prophets will arise and mislead many.
aov_text: En baie valse profete sal opstaan en baie mense mislei.

kjv_text: And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold.
bsb_text: Because of the multiplication of wickedness, the love of most will grow cold.
aov_text: En omdat die ongeregtigheid vermeerder word, sal die liefde van die meeste verkoel.

kjv_text: But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.
bsb_text: But the one who perseveres to the end will be saved.
aov_text: Maar wie volhard tot die einde toe, hy sal gered word.

kjv_text: And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come.
bsb_text: And this gospel of the kingdom will be preached in all the world as a testimony to all nations, and then the end will come.
aov_text: En hierdie evangelie van die koninkryk sal verkondig word in die hele wêreld tot ’n getuienis vir al die nasies; en dan sal die einde kom.

kjv_text: When ye therefore shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, stand in the holy place, (whoso readeth, let him understand:)
bsb_text: So when you see standing in the holy place ‘the abomination of desolation,’ described by the prophet Daniel (let the reader understand),
aov_text: WANNEER julle dan die gruwel van die verwoesting, waarvan gespreek is deur die profeet Daniël, sien staan in die heiligdom — laat hy wat lees, oplet  —

kjv_text: Then let them which be in Judaea flee into the mountains:
bsb_text: then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.
aov_text: dan moet die wat in Judéa is, na die berge vlug;

kjv_text: Let him which is on the housetop not come down to take any thing out of his house:
bsb_text: Let no one on the housetop come down to retrieve anything from his house.
aov_text: wie op die dak is, moet nie afkom om iets uit sy huis weg te neem nie;

kjv_text: Neither let him which is in the field return back to take his clothes.
bsb_text: And let no one in the field return for his cloak.
aov_text: en wie op die land is, moet nie omdraai om sy klere weg te neem nie.

kjv_text: And woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!
bsb_text: How miserable those days will be for pregnant and nursing mothers!
aov_text: Maar wee die vroue wat swanger is en die wat nog soog, in daardie dae.

kjv_text: But pray ye that your flight be not in the winter, neither on the sabbath day:
bsb_text: Pray that your flight will not occur in the winter or on the Sabbath.
aov_text: En bid dat julle vlug nie in die winter of op die sabbat mag plaasvind nie.

kjv_text: For then shall be great tribulation, such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time, no, nor ever shall be.
bsb_text: For at that time there will be great tribulation, unmatched from the beginning of the world until now, and never to be seen again.
aov_text: Want dan sal daar groot verdrukking wees soos daar van die begin van die wêreld af tot nou toe nie gewees het en ook nooit sal wees nie.

kjv_text: And except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved: but for the elect's sake those days shall be shortened.
bsb_text: If those days had not been cut short, nobody would be saved. But for the sake of the elect, those days will be cut short.
aov_text: En as daardie dae nie verkort was nie, sou geen vlees gered word nie; maar ter wille van die uitverkorenes sal daardie dae verkort word.

kjv_text: Then if any man shall say unto you, Lo, here is Christ, or there; believe it not.
bsb_text: At that time, if anyone says to you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or ‘There He is!’ do not believe it.
aov_text: As iemand dán vir julle sê: Kyk, hier is die Christus! of: Daar! — moet dit nie glo nie.

kjv_text: For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall shew great signs and wonders; insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect.
bsb_text: For false Christs and false prophets will appear and perform great signs and wonders that would deceive even the elect, if that were possible.
aov_text: Want daar sal valse christusse en valse profete opstaan, en hulle sal groot tekens en wonders doen om, as dit moontlik was, ook die uitverkorenes te mislei.

kjv_text: Behold, I have told you before.
bsb_text: See, I have told you in advance.
aov_text: Kyk, Ek het dit vir julle vooruit gesê.

kjv_text: Wherefore if they shall say unto you, Behold, he is in the desert; go not forth: behold, he is in the secret chambers; believe it not.
bsb_text: So if they tell you, ‘There He is in the wilderness,’ do not go out; or, ‘Here He is in the inner rooms,’ do not believe it.
aov_text: As hulle dan vir julle sê: Kyk, Hy is in die woestyn — moenie uitgaan nie; kyk, Hy is in die binnekamer — moet dit nie glo nie.

kjv_text: For as the lightning cometh out of the east, and shineth even unto the west; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
bsb_text: For just as the lightning comes from the east and flashes as far as the west, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.
aov_text: Want soos die weerlig uit die ooste uitslaan en tot in die weste skyn, so sal ook die koms van die Seun van die mens wees.

kjv_text: For wheresoever the carcase is, there will the eagles be gathered together.
bsb_text: Wherever there is a carcass, there the vultures will gather.
aov_text: Want oral waar die dooie liggaam lê, daar sal die aasvoëls saamkom.

kjv_text: Immediately after the tribulation of those days shall the sun be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light, and the stars shall fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken:
bsb_text: Immediately after the tribulation of those days: ‘The sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light; the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken.’
aov_text: EN dadelik ná die verdrukking van daardie dae sal die son verduister word, en die maan sal sy glans nie gee nie, en die sterre sal van die hemel val, en die kragte van die hemele sal geskud word.

kjv_text: And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.
bsb_text: At that time the sign of the Son of Man will appear in heaven, and all the tribes of the earth will mourn. They will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of heaven, with power and great glory.
aov_text: En dan sal die teken van die Seun van die mens in die hemel verskyn, en dan sal al die stamme van die aarde rou bedryf en die Seun van die mens sien kom op die wolke van die hemel met groot krag en heerlikheid.

kjv_text: And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.
bsb_text: And He will send out His angels with a loud trumpet call, and they will gather His elect from the four winds, from one end of the heavens to the other.
aov_text: En Hy sal sy engele uitstuur met harde trompetgeluid, en hulle sal sy uitverkorenes versamel uit die vier windstreke, van die een einde van die hemele af tot die ander einde daarvan.

kjv_text: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When his branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is nigh:
bsb_text: Now learn this lesson from the fig tree: As soon as its branches become tender and sprout leaves, you know that summer is near.
aov_text: En leer van die vyeboom hierdie gelykenis: Wanneer sy tak al sag word en sy blare uitbot, weet julle dat die somer naby is.

kjv_text: So likewise ye, when ye shall see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors.
bsb_text: So also, when you see all these things, you will know that He is near, right at the door.
aov_text: So weet julle ook, wanneer julle ál hierdie dinge sien, dat dit naby is, voor die deur.

kjv_text: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass, till all these things be fulfilled.
bsb_text: Truly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all these things have happened.
aov_text: Voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, hierdie geslag sal sekerlik nie verbygaan voordat al hierdie dinge gebeur het nie.

kjv_text: Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.
bsb_text: Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will never pass away.
aov_text: Die hemel en die aarde sal verbygaan, maar my woorde sal nooit verbygaan nie.

kjv_text: But of that day and hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels of heaven, but my Father only.
bsb_text: No one knows about that day or hour, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.
aov_text: MAAR van dié dag en dié uur weet niemand nie, ook die engele van die hemele nie, maar net my Vader alleen.

kjv_text: But as the days of Noe were, so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
bsb_text: As it was in the days of Noah, so will it be at the coming of the Son of Man.
aov_text: En net soos die dae van Noag was, so sal ook die koms van die Seun van die mens wees.

kjv_text: For as in the days that were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark,
bsb_text: For in the days before the flood, people were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, up to the day Noah entered the ark.
aov_text: Want net soos hulle was in die dae voor die sondvloed toe hulle geëet en gedrink het, getrou en in die huwelik uitgegee het, tot op die dag dat Noag in die ark gegaan het,

kjv_text: And knew not until the flood came, and took them all away; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
bsb_text: And they were oblivious, until the flood came and swept them all away. So will it be at the coming of the Son of Man.
aov_text: en dit nie verstaan het voordat die sondvloed gekom en almal weggevoer het nie, so sal ook die koms van die Seun van die mens wees.

kjv_text: Then shall two be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
bsb_text: Two men will be in the field: one will be taken and the other left.
aov_text: Dan sal daar twee op die land wees; die een word aangeneem en die ander word verlaat.

kjv_text: Two women shall be grinding at the mill; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
bsb_text: Two women will be grinding at the mill: one will be taken and the other left.
aov_text: Twee vroue sal by die meul maal; die een word aangeneem en die ander word verlaat.

kjv_text: Watch therefore: for ye know not what hour your Lord doth come.
bsb_text: Therefore keep watch, because you do not know the day on which your Lord will come.
aov_text: Waak dan, omdat julle nie weet watter uur julle Here kom nie.

kjv_text: But know this, that if the goodman of the house had known in what watch the thief would come, he would have watched, and would not have suffered his house to be broken up.
bsb_text: But understand this: If the homeowner had known in which watch of the night the thief was coming, he would have kept watch and would not have let his house be broken into.
aov_text: Maar weet dit: as die huisheer geweet het in watter nagwaak die dief sou kom, sou hy gewaak en nie toegelaat het dat in sy huis ingebreek word nie.

kjv_text: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
bsb_text: For this reason, you also must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour you do not expect.
aov_text: Daarom moet julle ook gereed wees, want die Seun van die mens kom op ’n uur dat julle dit nie verwag nie.

kjv_text: Who then is a faithful and wise servant, whom his lord hath made ruler over his household, to give them meat in due season?
bsb_text: Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom the master has put in charge of his household, to give the others their food at the proper time?
aov_text: WIE is dan die getroue en verstandige dienskneg vir wie sy heer oor sy diensvolk aangestel het om hulle hul voedsel op tyd te gee?

kjv_text: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.
bsb_text: Blessed is that servant whose master finds him doing so when he returns.
aov_text: Gelukkig is daardie dienskneg vir wie sy heer, as hy kom, op hierdie manier besig sal vind.

kjv_text: Verily I say unto you, That he shall make him ruler over all his goods.
bsb_text: Truly I tell you, he will put him in charge of all his possessions.
aov_text: Voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, hy sal hom oor al sy besittings aanstel.

kjv_text: But and if that evil servant shall say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming;
bsb_text: But suppose that servant is wicked and says in his heart, ‘My master will be away a long time.’
aov_text: Maar as daardie slegte dienskneg in sy hart sê: My heer talm om te kom  —

kjv_text: And shall begin to smite his fellowservants, and to eat and drink with the drunken;
bsb_text: And he begins to beat his fellow servants and to eat and drink with drunkards.
aov_text: en hy sy medediensknegte begin slaan en saam met die dronkaards begin eet en drink,

kjv_text: The lord of that servant shall come in a day when he looketh not for him, and in an hour that he is not aware of,
bsb_text: The master of that servant will come on a day he does not expect and at an hour he does not anticipate.
aov_text: dan sal die heer van dié dienskneg kom op ’n dag dat hy dit nie verwag nie en op ’n uur dat hy dit nie weet nie;

kjv_text: And shall cut him asunder, and appoint him his portion with the hypocrites: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
bsb_text: Then he will cut him to pieces and assign him a place with the hypocrites, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
aov_text: en sal hom pynig en hom ’n deelgenoot van die geveinsdes maak. Daar sal geween wees en gekners van die tande.

kjv_text: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.
bsb_text: “At that time the kingdom of heaven will be like ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.
aov_text: DAN sal die koninkryk van die hemele wees soos tien maagde wat hulle lampe geneem en uitgegaan het om die bruidegom te ontmoet.

kjv_text: And five of them were wise, and five were foolish.
bsb_text: Five of them were foolish, and five were wise.
aov_text: En vyf van hulle was verstandig en vyf dwaas.

kjv_text: They that were foolish took their lamps, and took no oil with them:
bsb_text: The foolish ones took their lamps but did not take along any extra oil.
aov_text: En toe die wat dwaas was, hul lampe neem, het hulle geen olie met hulle saamgeneem nie.

kjv_text: But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.
bsb_text: But the wise ones took oil in flasks along with their lamps.
aov_text: Maar die verstandiges het olie in hulle kanne saam met hul lampe geneem.

kjv_text: While the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept.
bsb_text: When the bridegroom was delayed, they all became drowsy and fell asleep.
aov_text: En terwyl die bruidegom talm om te kom, het hulle almal vaak geword en aan die slaap geraak.

kjv_text: And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegroom cometh; go ye out to meet him.
bsb_text: At midnight the cry rang out: ‘Here is the bridegroom! Come out to meet him!’
aov_text: En middernag was daar ’n geroep: Daar kom die bruidegom; gaan uit hom tegemoet!

kjv_text: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.
bsb_text: Then all the virgins woke up and trimmed their lamps.
aov_text: Toe staan al daardie maagde op en maak hulle lampe gereed.

kjv_text: And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are gone out.
bsb_text: The foolish ones said to the wise, ‘Give us some of your oil; our lamps are going out.’
aov_text: En die wat dwaas was, sê aan die verstandiges: Gee vir ons van julle olie, want ons lampe gaan uit.

kjv_text: But the wise answered, saying, Not so; lest there be not enough for us and you: but go ye rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.
bsb_text: ‘No,’ said the wise ones, ‘or there may not be enough for both us and you. Instead, go to those who sell oil and buy some for yourselves.’
aov_text: Maar die verstandiges antwoord en sê: Miskien sal daar nie genoeg wees vir ons en vir julle nie. Maar gaan liewer na die verkopers en koop vir julleself.

kjv_text: And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage: and the door was shut.
bsb_text: But while they were on their way to buy it, the bridegroom arrived. Those who were ready went in with him to the wedding banquet, and the door was shut.
aov_text: En onderwyl hulle gaan om te koop, het die bruidegom gekom. En die wat gereed was, het saam met hom ingegaan na die bruilof, en die deur is gesluit.

kjv_text: Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us.
bsb_text: Later the other virgins arrived and said, ‘Lord, lord, open the door for us!’
aov_text: Later kom toe die ander maagde ook en sê: Meneer, meneer, maak vir ons oop!

kjv_text: But he answered and said, Verily I say unto you, I know you not.
bsb_text: But he replied, ‘Truly I tell you, I do not know you.’
aov_text: Maar hy antwoord en sê: Voorwaar ek sê vir julle, ek ken julle nie.

kjv_text: Watch therefore, for ye know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of man cometh.
bsb_text: Therefore keep watch, because you do not know the day or the hour.
aov_text: Waak dan, omdat julle die dag en die uur nie weet waarop die Seun van die mens kom nie.

kjv_text: For the kingdom of heaven is as a man travelling into a far country, who called his own servants, and delivered unto them his goods.
bsb_text: For it is just like a man going on a journey, who called his servants and entrusted them with his possessions.
aov_text: WANT dit is soos ’n man wat op reis wou gaan en sy diensknegte roep en aan hulle sy besittings toevertrou.

kjv_text: And unto one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another one; to every man according to his several ability; and straightway took his journey.
bsb_text: To one he gave five talents, to another two talents, and to another one talent—each according to his own ability. And he went on his journey.
aov_text: En aan die een gee hy vyf talente en aan die ander twee en aan die ander een, aan elkeen na sy vermoë; en hy het dadelik op reis gegaan.

kjv_text: Then he that had received the five talents went and traded with the same, and made them other five talents.
bsb_text: The servant who had received the five talents went at once and put them to work and gained five more.
aov_text: En die een wat die vyf talente ontvang het, het daarmee gaan werk en vyf ander talente gewin.

kjv_text: And likewise he that had received two, he also gained other two.
bsb_text: Likewise, the one with the two talents gained two more.
aov_text: Net so het die een wat die twee ontvang het, self ook twee ander verdien.

kjv_text: But he that had received one went and digged in the earth, and hid his lord's money.
bsb_text: But the servant who had received the one talent went off, dug a hole in the ground, and hid his master’s money.
aov_text: Maar hy wat die een ontvang het, het in die grond gaan grawe en die geld van sy heer weggesteek.

kjv_text: After a long time the lord of those servants cometh, and reckoneth with them.
bsb_text: After a long time the master of those servants returned to settle accounts with them.
aov_text: En ná ’n lang tyd het die heer van daardie diensknegte gekom en met hulle afgereken.

kjv_text: And so he that had received five talents came and brought other five talents, saying, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me five talents: behold, I have gained beside them five talents more.
bsb_text: The servant who had received the five talents came and presented five more. ‘Master,’ he said, ‘you entrusted me with five talents. See, I have gained five more.’
aov_text: En die een wat die vyf talente ontvang het, kom en bring vyf ander talente en sê: Meneer, vyf talente het u aan my toevertrou; hier het ek vyf ander talente daarby verdien.

kjv_text: His lord said unto him, Well done, thou good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
bsb_text: His master replied, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant! You have been faithful with a few things; I will put you in charge of many things. Enter into the joy of your master!’
aov_text: En sy heer sê vir hom: Mooi so, goeie en getroue dienskneg, oor weinig was jy getrou, oor veel sal ek jou aanstel. Gaan in in die vreugde van jou heer.

kjv_text: He also that had received two talents came and said, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me two talents: behold, I have gained two other talents beside them.
bsb_text: The servant who had received the two talents also came and said, ‘Master, you entrusted me with two talents. See, I have gained two more.’
aov_text: En die een wat die twee talente ontvang het, kom ook en sê: Meneer, twee talente het u aan my toevertrou; hier het ek twee ander talente daarby verdien.

kjv_text: His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant; thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
bsb_text: His master replied, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant! You have been faithful with a few things; I will put you in charge of many things. Enter into the joy of your master!’
aov_text: Sy heer sê vir hom: Mooi so, goeie en getroue dienskneg, oor weinig was jy getrou, oor veel sal ek jou aanstel. Gaan in in die vreugde van jou heer.

kjv_text: Then he which had received the one talent came and said, Lord, I knew thee that thou art an hard man, reaping where thou hast not sown, and gathering where thou hast not strawed:
bsb_text: Finally, the servant who had received the one talent came and said, ‘Master, I knew that you are a hard man, reaping where you have not sown and gathering where you have not scattered seed.
aov_text: En die een wat die een talent ontvang het, kom ook en sê: Meneer, ek het u geken, dat u ’n harde man is wat maai waar u nie gesaai het nie, en bymekaarmaak waar u nie uitgestrooi het nie;

kjv_text: And I was afraid, and went and hid thy talent in the earth: lo, there thou hast that is thine.
bsb_text: So I was afraid and went out and hid your talent in the ground. See, you have what belongs to you.’
aov_text: omdat ek bang was, het ek gegaan en u talent in die grond weggesteek. Hier het u wat aan u behoort.

kjv_text: His lord answered and said unto him, Thou wicked and slothful servant, thou knewest that I reap where I sowed not, and gather where I have not strawed:
bsb_text: ‘You wicked, lazy servant!’ replied his master. ‘You knew that I reap where I have not sown and gather where I have not scattered seed.
aov_text: Maar sy heer antwoord en sê vir hom: Jou slegte en luie dienskneg, jy het geweet dat ek maai waar ek nie gesaai het nie, en bymekaarmaak waar ek nie uitgestrooi het nie.

kjv_text: Thou oughtest therefore to have put my money to the exchangers, and then at my coming I should have received mine own with usury.
bsb_text: Then you should have deposited my money with the bankers, and on my return I would have received it back with interest.
aov_text: Daarom moes jy my geld by die wisselaars gestort het, en ek sou by my koms wat aan my behoort, met rente ontvang het.

kjv_text: Take therefore the talent from him, and give it unto him which hath ten talents.
bsb_text: Therefore take the talent from him and give it to the one who has ten talents.
aov_text: Neem dan die talent van hom weg en gee dit aan die een wat die tien talente het;

kjv_text: For unto every one that hath shall be given, and he shall have abundance: but from him that hath not shall be taken away even that which he hath.
bsb_text: For everyone who has will be given more, and he will have an abundance. But the one who does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.
aov_text: want aan elkeen wat het, sal gegee word, en hy sal oorvloed hê; maar van hom wat nie het nie, van hom sal weggeneem word ook wat hy het.

kjv_text: And cast ye the unprofitable servant into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
bsb_text: And throw that worthless servant into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’
aov_text: En werp die nuttelose dienskneg uit in die buitenste duisternis; daar sal geween wees en gekners van die tande.

kjv_text: When the Son of man shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:
bsb_text: When the Son of Man comes in His glory, and all the angels with Him, He will sit on His glorious throne.
aov_text: EN wanneer die Seun van die mens in sy heerlikheid kom en al die heilige engele saam met Hom, dan sal Hy op sy heerlike troon sit;

kjv_text: And before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as a shepherd divideth his sheep from the goats:
bsb_text: All the nations will be gathered before Him, and He will separate the people one from another, as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.
aov_text: en voor Hom sal al die nasies versamel word, en Hy sal hulle van mekaar afskei soos die herder die skape van die bokke afskei;

kjv_text: And he shall set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.
bsb_text: He will place the sheep on His right and the goats on His left.
aov_text: en Hy sal die skape aan sy regterhand en die bokke aan sy linkerhand sit.

kjv_text: Then shall the King say unto them on his right hand, Come, ye blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world:
bsb_text: Then the King will say to those on His right, ‘Come, you who are blessed by My Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world.
aov_text: Dan sal die Koning vir die wat aan sy regterhand is, sê: Kom, julle geseëndes van my Vader, beërf die koninkryk wat vir julle berei is van die grondlegging van die wêreld af.

kjv_text: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me drink: I was a stranger, and ye took me in:
bsb_text: For I was hungry and you gave Me something to eat, I was thirsty and you gave Me something to drink, I was a stranger and you took Me in,
aov_text: Want Ek het honger gehad, en julle het My te ete gegee; Ek het dors gehad, en julle het My te drinke gegee; Ek was ’n vreemdeling, en julle het My herberg gegee;

kjv_text: Naked, and ye clothed me: I was sick, and ye visited me: I was in prison, and ye came unto me.
bsb_text: I was naked and you clothed Me, I was sick and you looked after Me, I was in prison and you visited Me.’
aov_text: Ek was naak, en julle het My geklee; Ek was siek, en julle het My besoek; in die gevangenis was Ek, en julle het na My gekom.

kjv_text: Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, and fed thee? or thirsty, and gave thee drink?
bsb_text: Then the righteous will answer Him, ‘Lord, when did we see You hungry and feed You, or thirsty and give You something to drink?
aov_text: Dan sal die regverdiges Hom antwoord en sê: Here, wanneer het ons U honger gesien en gevoed; of dors, en te drinke gegee?

kjv_text: When saw we thee a stranger, and took thee in? or naked, and clothed thee?
bsb_text: When did we see You a stranger and take You in, or naked and clothe You?
aov_text: En wanneer het ons U ’n vreemdeling gesien, en herberg gegee; of naak, en geklee?

kjv_text: Or when saw we thee sick, or in prison, and came unto thee?
bsb_text: When did we see You sick or in prison and visit You?’
aov_text: En wanneer het ons U siek gesien of in die gevangenis, en na U gekom?

kjv_text: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me.
bsb_text: And the King will reply, ‘Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers of Mine, you did for Me.’
aov_text: En die Koning sal antwoord en vir hulle sê: Voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, vir sover julle dit gedoen het aan een van die geringstes van hierdie broeders van My, het julle dit aan My gedoen.

kjv_text: Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand, Depart from me, ye cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels:
bsb_text: Then He will say to those on His left, ‘Depart from Me, you who are cursed, into the eternal fire prepared for the devil and his angels.
aov_text: Dan sal Hy ook vir dié aan sy linkerhand sê: Gaan weg van My, julle vervloektes, in die ewige vuur wat berei is vir die duiwel en sy engele.

kjv_text: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me no meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me no drink:
bsb_text: For I was hungry and you gave Me nothing to eat, I was thirsty and you gave Me nothing to drink,
aov_text: Want Ek het honger gehad, en julle het My nie te ete gegee nie; Ek het dors gehad, en julle het My nie te drinke gegee nie.

kjv_text: I was a stranger, and ye took me not in: naked, and ye clothed me not: sick, and in prison, and ye visited me not.
bsb_text: I was a stranger and you did not take Me in, I was naked and you did not clothe Me, I was sick and in prison and you did not visit Me.’
aov_text: Ek was ’n vreemdeling, en julle het vir My nie herberg gegee nie; naak, en julle het My nie geklee nie; siek en in die gevangenis, en julle het My nie besoek nie.

kjv_text: Then shall they also answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, or athirst, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not minister unto thee?
bsb_text: And they too will reply, ‘Lord, when did we see You hungry or thirsty or a stranger or naked or sick or in prison, and did not minister to You?’
aov_text: Dan sal hulle Hom ook antwoord en sê: Here, wanneer het ons U honger gesien of dors of ’n vreemdeling of naak of siek of in die gevangenis, en U nie gedien nie?

kjv_text: Then shall he answer them, saying, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye did it not to one of the least of these, ye did it not to me.
bsb_text: Then the King will answer, ‘Truly I tell you, whatever you did not do for one of the least of these, you did not do for Me.’
aov_text: Dan sal Hy hulle antwoord en sê: Voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, vir sover julle dit nie gedoen het aan een van hierdie geringstes nie, het julle dit aan My ook nie gedoen nie.

kjv_text: And these shall go away into everlasting punishment: but the righteous into life eternal.
bsb_text: And they will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.”
aov_text: En hulle sal weggaan in die ewige straf, maar die regverdiges in die ewige lewe.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when Jesus had finished all these sayings, he said unto his disciples,
bsb_text: When Jesus had finished saying all these things, He told His disciples,
aov_text: EN toe Jesus al hierdie woorde geëindig het, sê Hy vir sy dissipels:

kjv_text: Ye know that after two days is the feast of the passover, and the Son of man is betrayed to be crucified.
bsb_text: “You know that the Passover is two days away, and the Son of Man will be handed over to be crucified.”
aov_text: Julle weet dat oor twee dae die pasga kom, dan word die Seun van die mens oorgelewer om gekruisig te word.

kjv_text: Then assembled together the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders of the people, unto the palace of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas,
bsb_text: At that time the chief priests and elders of the people assembled in the courtyard of the high priest, whose name was Caiaphas,
aov_text: Toe kom die owerpriesters en die skrifgeleerdes en die ouderlinge van die volk bymekaar in die paleis van die hoëpriester wat Kájafas genoem word,

kjv_text: And consulted that they might take Jesus by subtilty, and kill him.
bsb_text: and they conspired to arrest Jesus covertly and kill Him.
aov_text: en hou saam raad om Jesus met lis gevange te neem en om die lewe te bring.

kjv_text: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar among the people.
bsb_text: “But not during the feast,” they said, “or there may be a riot among the people.”
aov_text: Maar hulle het gesê: Nie op die fees nie, sodat daar nie miskien oproer onder die volk kom nie.

kjv_text: Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,
bsb_text: While Jesus was in Bethany in the home of Simon the Leper,
aov_text: EN toe Jesus in Betánië was in die huis van Simon, die melaatse,

kjv_text: There came unto him a woman having an alabaster box of very precious ointment, and poured it on his head, as he sat at meat.
bsb_text: a woman came to Him with an alabaster jar of expensive perfume, which she poured on His head as He reclined at the table.
aov_text: kom ’n vrou na Hom met ’n albaste fles met baie kosbare salf, en sy gooi dit op sy hoof uit terwyl Hy aan tafel was.

kjv_text: But when his disciples saw it, they had indignation, saying, To what purpose is this waste?
bsb_text: When the disciples saw this, they were indignant and asked, “Why this waste?
aov_text: En toe sy dissipels dit sien, was hulle verontwaardig en sê: Waarvoor is hierdie verkwisting?

kjv_text: For this ointment might have been sold for much, and given to the poor.
bsb_text: This perfume could have been sold at a high price, and the money given to the poor.”
aov_text: Want hierdie salf kon duur verkoop en die geld aan die armes gegee geword het.

kjv_text: When Jesus understood it, he said unto them, Why trouble ye the woman? for she hath wrought a good work upon me.
bsb_text: Aware of this, Jesus asked, “Why are you bothering this woman? She has done a beautiful deed to Me.
aov_text: Maar toe Jesus dit merk, sê Hy vir hulle: Waarom val julle die vrou lastig? Want sy het ’n goeie werk aan My gedoen.

kjv_text: For ye have the poor always with you; but me ye have not always.
bsb_text: The poor you will always have with you, but you will not always have Me.
aov_text: Want die armes het julle altyd by julle, maar My het julle nie altyd nie.

kjv_text: For in that she hath poured this ointment on my body, she did it for my burial.
bsb_text: By pouring this perfume on Me, she has prepared My body for burial.
aov_text: Want toe sy hierdie salf op my liggaam uitgegooi het, het sy dit gedoen met die oog op my begrafnis.

kjv_text: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world, there shall also this, that this woman hath done, be told for a memorial of her.
bsb_text: Truly I tell you, wherever this gospel is preached in all the world, what she has done will also be told in memory of her.”
aov_text: Voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, oral waar hierdie evangelie verkondig sal word in die hele wêreld, sal ook gespreek word van wat sy gedoen het, tot ’n gedagtenis aan haar.

kjv_text: Then one of the twelve, called Judas Iscariot, went unto the chief priests,
bsb_text: Then one of the Twelve, the one called Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests
aov_text: TOE gaan een van die twaalf, met die naam van Judas Iskáriot, na die owerpriesters

kjv_text: And said unto them, What will ye give me, and I will deliver him unto you? And they covenanted with him for thirty pieces of silver.
bsb_text: and asked, “What are you willing to give me if I hand Him over to you?” And they set out for him thirty pieces of silver.
aov_text: en sê: Wat wil u my gee, en ek sal Hom aan u oorlewer? En hulle het vir hom dertig silwerstukke afgeweeg.

kjv_text: And from that time he sought opportunity to betray him.
bsb_text: So from then on Judas looked for an opportunity to betray Jesus.
aov_text: En van toe af het hy ’n goeie geleentheid gesoek om Hom oor te lewer.

kjv_text: Now the first day of the feast of unleavened bread the disciples came to Jesus, saying unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare for thee to eat the passover?
bsb_text: On the first day of the Feast of Unleavened Bread, the disciples came to Jesus and asked, “Where do You want us to prepare for You to eat the Passover?”
aov_text: EN op die eerste dag van die ongesuurde brode kom die dissipels na Jesus en sê vir Hom: Waar wil U hê moet ons vir U klaarmaak om die pasga te eet?

kjv_text: And he said, Go into the city to such a man, and say unto him, The Master saith, My time is at hand; I will keep the passover at thy house with my disciples.
bsb_text: He answered, “Go into the city to a certain man and tell him that the Teacher says, ‘My time is near. I will keep the Passover with My disciples at your house.’”
aov_text: En Hy antwoord: Gaan na die stad na ’n sekere iemand en sê vir hom: Die Meester laat weet: My tyd is naby. By jou sal Ek die pasga hou met my dissipels.

kjv_text: And the disciples did as Jesus had appointed them; and they made ready the passover.
bsb_text: So the disciples did as Jesus had directed them and prepared the Passover.
aov_text: Daarop het die dissipels gedoen soos Jesus hulle beveel het, en hulle het die pasga berei.

kjv_text: Now when the even was come, he sat down with the twelve.
bsb_text: When evening came, Jesus was reclining with the twelve disciples.
aov_text: En toe dit aand geword het, was Hy met die twaalf aan tafel.

kjv_text: And as they did eat, he said, Verily I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
bsb_text: And while they were eating, He said to them, “Truly I tell you, one of you will betray Me.”
aov_text: En terwyl hulle eet, sê Hy: Voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, een van julle sal My verraai.

kjv_text: And they were exceeding sorrowful, and began every one of them to say unto him, Lord, is it I?
bsb_text: They were deeply grieved and began to ask Him one after another, “Surely not I, Lord?”
aov_text: Toe word hulle baie bedroef en begin elkeen van hulle aan Hom te sê: Is dit miskien ek, Here?

kjv_text: And he answered and said, He that dippeth his hand with me in the dish, the same shall betray me.
bsb_text: Jesus answered, “The one who has dipped his hand into the bowl with Me will betray Me.
aov_text: Toe antwoord Hy en sê: Hy wat saam met My sy hand in die skottel insteek, hy sal My verraai.

kjv_text: The Son of man goeth as it is written of him: but woe unto that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! it had been good for that man if he had not been born.
bsb_text: The Son of Man will go just as it is written about Him, but woe to that man by whom He is betrayed. It would be better for him if he had not been born.”
aov_text: Die Seun van die mens gaan wel heen soos daar van Hom geskrywe is, maar wee daardie man deur wie die Seun van die mens verraai word! Dit sou vir hom goed gewees het as daardie man nie gebore was nie.

kjv_text: Then Judas, which betrayed him, answered and said, Master, is it I? He said unto him, Thou hast said.
bsb_text: Then Judas, who would betray Him, said, “Surely not I, Rabbi?” Jesus answered, “You have said it yourself.”
aov_text: En Judas, wat Hom sou verraai, antwoord en sê: Is dit miskien ek, Rabbi? Hy antwoord hom: Jy het dit gesê.

kjv_text: And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed it, and brake it, and gave it to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body.
bsb_text: While they were eating, Jesus took bread, spoke a blessing and broke it, and gave it to the disciples, saying, “Take and eat; this is My body.”
aov_text: En terwyl hulle eet, neem Jesus die brood, en nadat Hy gedank het, breek Hy dit en gee dit aan sy dissipels en sê: Neem, eet, dit is my liggaam.

kjv_text: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and gave it to them, saying, Drink ye all of it;
bsb_text: Then He took the cup, gave thanks, and gave it to them, saying, “Drink from it, all of you.
aov_text: Toe neem Hy die beker, en nadat Hy gedank het, gee Hy dit aan hulle en sê: Drink almal daaruit.

kjv_text: For this is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many for the remission of sins.
bsb_text: This is My blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins.
aov_text: Want dit is my bloed, die bloed van die nuwe testament, wat vir baie uitgestort word tot vergifnis van sondes.

kjv_text: But I say unto you, I will not drink henceforth of this fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father's kingdom.
bsb_text: I tell you, I will not drink of this fruit of the vine from now on until that day when I drink it anew with you in My Father’s kingdom.”
aov_text: Maar Ek sê vir julle: Ek sal van nou af nooit meer van hierdie vrug van die wynstok drink nie, tot op daardie dag wanneer Ek dit met julle nuut sal drink in die koninkryk van my Vader.

kjv_text: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.
bsb_text: And when they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.
aov_text: En nadat hulle die lofsang gesing het, het hulle uitgegaan na die Olyfberg.

kjv_text: Then saith Jesus unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock shall be scattered abroad.
bsb_text: Then Jesus said to them, “This very night you will all fall away on account of Me. For it is written: ‘I will strike the Shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.’
aov_text: TOE sê Jesus vir hulle: Julle sal almal in hierdie nag aanstoot neem aan My, want daar is geskrywe: Ek sal die herder slaan, en die skape van die kudde sal verstrooi word.

kjv_text: But after I am risen again, I will go before you into Galilee.
bsb_text: But after I have risen, I will go ahead of you into Galilee.”
aov_text: Maar nadat Ek opgestaan het, sal Ek voor julle uit na Galiléa gaan.

kjv_text: Peter answered and said unto him, Though all men shall be offended because of thee, yet will I never be offended.
bsb_text: Peter said to Him, “Even if all fall away on account of You, I never will.”
aov_text: Daarop antwoord Petrus en sê vir Hom: Al sal almal ook aanstoot aan U neem, ek sal nooit aanstoot neem nie.

kjv_text: Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this night, before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.
bsb_text: “Truly I tell you,” Jesus declared, “this very night, before the rooster crows, you will deny Me three times.”
aov_text: Jesus sê vir hom: Voorwaar Ek sê vir jou, in hierdie nag, voordat die haan gekraai het, sal jy My drie maal verloën.

kjv_text: Peter said unto him, Though I should die with thee, yet will I not deny thee. Likewise also said all the disciples.
bsb_text: Peter replied, “Even if I have to die with You, I will never deny You.” And all the other disciples said the same thing.
aov_text: Petrus sê vir Hom: Al moes ek ook saam met U sterwe, ek sal U nooit verloën nie! So het ook al die dissipels gesê.

kjv_text: Then cometh Jesus with them unto a place called Gethsemane, and saith unto the disciples, Sit ye here, while I go and pray yonder.
bsb_text: At that time Jesus went with His disciples to a place called Gethsemane, and He told them, “Sit here while I go over there and pray.”
aov_text: TOE kom Jesus met hulle in ’n plek met die naam van Getsémané, en Hy sê vir die dissipels: Sit hier onderwyl Ek daar gaan bid.

kjv_text: And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and very heavy.
bsb_text: He took with Him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee and began to be sorrowful and deeply distressed.
aov_text: En Hy neem Petrus en die twee seuns van Sebedéüs saam en begin bedroef en benoud word.

kjv_text: Then saith he unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful, even unto death: tarry ye here, and watch with me.
bsb_text: Then He said to them, “My soul is consumed with sorrow to the point of death. Stay here and keep watch with Me.”
aov_text: Toe sê Hy vir hulle: My siel is diep bedroef tot die dood toe; bly hier en waak saam met My.

kjv_text: And he went a little farther, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me: nevertheless not as I will, but as thou wilt.
bsb_text: Going a little farther, He fell facedown and prayed, “My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass from Me. Yet not as I will, but as You will.”
aov_text: En Hy het ’n bietjie verder gegaan en op sy aangesig geval en gebid en gesê: My Vader, as dit moontlik is, laat hierdie beker by My verbygaan; nogtans nie soos Ek wil nie, maar soos U wil.

kjv_text: And he cometh unto the disciples, and findeth them asleep, and saith unto Peter, What, could ye not watch with me one hour?
bsb_text: Then Jesus returned to the disciples and found them sleeping. “Were you not able to keep watch with Me for one hour?” He asked Peter.
aov_text: En Hy kom by die dissipels en vind hulle aan die slaap, en Hy sê vir Petrus: So was julle dan nie in staat om een uur saam met My te waak nie?

kjv_text: Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.
bsb_text: “Watch and pray so that you will not enter into temptation. For the spirit is willing, but the body is weak.”
aov_text: Waak en bid, dat julle nie in versoeking kom nie. Die gees is wel gewillig, maar die vlees is swak.

kjv_text: He went away again the second time, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if this cup may not pass away from me, except I drink it, thy will be done.
bsb_text: A second time He went away and prayed, “My Father, if this cup cannot pass unless I drink it, may Your will be done.”
aov_text: Weer het Hy vir die tweede maal gaan bid en gesê: My Vader, as hierdie beker nie by My kan verbygaan sonder dat Ek dit drink nie, laat u wil geskied.

kjv_text: And he came and found them asleep again: for their eyes were heavy.
bsb_text: And again Jesus returned and found them sleeping—for their eyes were heavy.
aov_text: Toe kom Hy en vind hulle weer aan die slaap, want hulle oë was swaar.

kjv_text: And he left them, and went away again, and prayed the third time, saying the same words.
bsb_text: So He left them and went away once more and prayed a third time, saying the same thing.
aov_text: En Hy het hulle met rus gelaat en weer vir die derde maal gaan bid en dieselfde woorde gesê.

kjv_text: Then cometh he to his disciples, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
bsb_text: Then He returned to the disciples and said, “Are you still sleeping and resting? Look, the hour is near, and the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
aov_text: Daarop kom Hy by sy dissipels en sê vir hulle: Slaap maar voort en rus. Kyk, die uur is naby, en die Seun van die mens word oorgelewer in die hande van sondaars.

kjv_text: Rise, let us be going: behold, he is at hand that doth betray me.
bsb_text: Rise, let us go! See, My betrayer is approaching!”
aov_text: Staan op, laat ons gaan; kyk, hy is naby wat My verraai.

kjv_text: And while he yet spake, lo, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and elders of the people.
bsb_text: While Jesus was still speaking, Judas, one of the Twelve, arrived, accompanied by a large crowd armed with swords and clubs, sent from the chief priests and elders of the people.
aov_text: EN terwyl Hy nog spreek, daar kom Judas, een van die twaalf, en saam met hom ’n groot menigte met swaarde en stokke, gestuur deur die owerpriesters en ouderlinge van die volk.

kjv_text: Now he that betrayed him gave them a sign, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he: hold him fast.
bsb_text: Now the betrayer had arranged a signal with them: “The One I kiss is the man; arrest Him.”
aov_text: En sy verraaier het vir hulle ’n teken gegee en gesê: Die een wat ek sal soen, dit is Hy, gryp Hom!

kjv_text: And forthwith he came to Jesus, and said, Hail, master; and kissed him.
bsb_text: Going directly to Jesus, he said, “Greetings, Rabbi!” and kissed Him.
aov_text: En dadelik gaan hy na Jesus en sê: Gegroet, Rabbi! en hy het Hom gesoen.

kjv_text: And Jesus said unto him, Friend, wherefore art thou come? Then came they, and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.
bsb_text: “Friend,” Jesus replied, “do what you came for.” Then the men stepped forward, seized Jesus, and arrested Him.
aov_text: Maar Jesus sê vir hom: Vriend, waarvoor is jy hier? Toe kom hulle nader en slaan die hande aan Jesus en gryp Hom.

kjv_text: And, behold, one of them which were with Jesus stretched out his hand, and drew his sword, and struck a servant of the high priest's, and smote off his ear.
bsb_text: At this, one of Jesus’ companions drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his ear.
aov_text: En een van die wat saam met Jesus was, het meteens sy hand uitgesteek en sy swaard getrek; en hy het die dienskneg van die hoëpriester geslaan en sy oor afgekap.

kjv_text: Then said Jesus unto him, Put up again thy sword into his place: for all they that take the sword shall perish with the sword.
bsb_text: “Put your sword back in its place,” Jesus said to him. “For all who draw the sword will die by the sword.
aov_text: Toe sê Jesus vir hom: Sit jou swaard in sy plek terug; want almal wat die swaard neem, sal deur die swaard vergaan.

kjv_text: Thinkest thou that I cannot now pray to my Father, and he shall presently give me more than twelve legions of angels?
bsb_text: Are you not aware that I can call on My Father, and He will at once put at My disposal more than twelve legions of angels?
aov_text: Of dink jy dat Ek nie nou my Vader kan bid en Hy vir My meer as twaalf legioene van engele beskikbaar sal stel nie?

kjv_text: But how then shall the scriptures be fulfilled, that thus it must be?
bsb_text: But how then would the Scriptures be fulfilled that say it must happen this way?”
aov_text: Hoe sou die Skrifte dan vervul word dat dit so moet gebeur?

kjv_text: In that same hour said Jesus to the multitudes, Are ye come out as against a thief with swords and staves for to take me? I sat daily with you teaching in the temple, and ye laid no hold on me.
bsb_text: At that time Jesus said to the crowd, “Have you come out with swords and clubs to arrest Me as you would an outlaw? Every day I sat teaching in the temple courts, and you did not arrest Me.
aov_text: In daardie uur het Jesus vir die skare gesê: Het julle soos teen ’n rower uitgekom met swaarde en stokke om My gevange te neem? Dag vir dag het Ek by julle gesit en leer in die tempel, en julle het My nie gegryp nie.

kjv_text: But all this was done, that the scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled. Then all the disciples forsook him, and fled.
bsb_text: But this has all happened so that the writings of the prophets would be fulfilled.” Then all the disciples deserted Him and fled.
aov_text: Maar dit het alles gebeur, dat die Skrifte van die profete vervul sou word. Toe het al die dissipels Hom verlaat en gevlug.

kjv_text: And they that had laid hold on Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were assembled.
bsb_text: Those who had arrested Jesus led Him away to the house of Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and elders had gathered.
