aov_text: EN die wat Jesus gevange geneem het, het Hom weggelei na Kájafas, die hoëpriester, waar die skrifgeleerdes en die ouderlinge vergader het.

kjv_text: But Peter followed him afar off unto the high priest's palace, and went in, and sat with the servants, to see the end.
bsb_text: But Peter followed Him at a distance, right up to the courtyard of the high priest. And he went in and sat down with the guards to see the outcome.
aov_text: En Petrus het Hom van ver af gevolg tot by die paleis van die hoëpriester, en hy het ingegaan en by die dienaars gaan sit om die einde te sien.

kjv_text: Now the chief priests, and elders, and all the council, sought false witness against Jesus, to put him to death;
bsb_text: Now the chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin were seeking false testimony against Jesus in order to put Him to death.
aov_text: En die owerpriesters en die ouderlinge en die hele Raad het valse getuienis teen Jesus gesoek om Hom dood te maak, en niks gevind nie.

kjv_text: But found none: yea, though many false witnesses came, yet found they none. At the last came two false witnesses,
bsb_text: But they did not find any, though many false witnesses came forward. Finally two came forward
aov_text: En alhoewel daar baie valse getuies gekom het, het hulle niks gevind nie.

kjv_text: And said, This fellow said, I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.
bsb_text: and declared, “This man said, ‘I am able to destroy the temple of God and rebuild it in three days.’”
aov_text: Maar oplaas kom daar twee valse getuies en sê: Hierdie man het gesê: Ek kan die tempel van God afbreek en dit in drie dae opbou.

kjv_text: And the high priest arose, and said unto him, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?
bsb_text: So the high priest stood up and asked Him, “Have You no answer? What are these men testifying against You?”
aov_text: Daarop staan die hoëpriester op en sê vir Hom: Antwoord U niks nie? Wat getuig hierdie manne teen U?

kjv_text: But Jesus held his peace. And the high priest answered and said unto him, I adjure thee by the living God, that thou tell us whether thou be the Christ, the Son of God.
bsb_text: But Jesus remained silent. Then the high priest said to Him, “I charge You under oath by the living God: Tell us if You are the Christ, the Son of God.”
aov_text: Maar Jesus het stilgebly. En die hoëpriester antwoord en sê vir Hom: Ek besweer U by die lewende God dat U vir ons sê of U die Christus, die Seun van God, is?

kjv_text: Jesus saith unto him, Thou hast said: nevertheless I say unto you, Hereafter shall ye see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.
bsb_text: “You have said it yourself,” Jesus answered. “But I say to all of you, from now on you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power and coming on the clouds of heaven.”
aov_text: Jesus antwoord hom: U het dit gesê. Maar Ek sê vir u almal: Van nou af sal u die Seun van die mens sien sit aan die regterhand van die krag van God en kom op die wolke van die hemel.

kjv_text: Then the high priest rent his clothes, saying, He hath spoken blasphemy; what further need have we of witnesses? behold, now ye have heard his blasphemy.
bsb_text: At this, the high priest tore his clothes and declared, “He has blasphemed! Why do we need any more witnesses? Look, now you have heard the blasphemy.
aov_text: Toe verskeur die hoëpriester sy klere en sê: Hy het godslasterlik gespreek, wat het ons nog getuies nodig? Kyk, nou het julle sy godslastering gehoor!

kjv_text: What think ye? They answered and said, He is guilty of death.
bsb_text: What do you think?” “He deserves to die,” they answered.
aov_text: Wat dink julle? En hulle antwoord en sê: Hy is die dood skuldig.

kjv_text: Then did they spit in his face, and buffeted him; and others smote him with the palms of their hands,
bsb_text: Then they spit in His face and struck Him. Others slapped Him
aov_text: Toe het hulle in sy aangesig gespuug en Hom met die vuis geslaan,

kjv_text: Saying, Prophesy unto us, thou Christ, Who is he that smote thee?
bsb_text: and said, “Prophesy to us, Christ! Who hit You?”
aov_text: en ander het Hom met stokke geslaan en gesê: Profeteer vir ons, Christus! Wie is dit wat U geslaan het?

kjv_text: Now Peter sat without in the palace: and a damsel came unto him, saying, Thou also wast with Jesus of Galilee.
bsb_text: Meanwhile, Peter was sitting out in the courtyard, and a servant girl came up to him. “You also were with Jesus the Galilean,” she said.
aov_text: EN Petrus het buitekant gesit in die binneplaas van die paleis, en ’n sekere diensmeisie het na hom gekom en gesê: Jy was ook by Jesus, die Galiléër!

kjv_text: But he denied before them all, saying, I know not what thou sayest.
bsb_text: But he denied it before them all: “I do not know what you are talking about.”
aov_text: Maar hy het dit voor almal ontken en gesê: Ek weet nie wat jy sê nie.

kjv_text: And when he was gone out into the porch, another maid saw him, and said unto them that were there, This fellow was also with Jesus of Nazareth.
bsb_text: When Peter had gone out to the gateway, another servant girl saw him and said to the people there, “This man was with Jesus of Nazareth.”
aov_text: En terwyl hy uitgaan na die poort toe, sien ’n ander diensmeisie hom en sê aan die wat daar was: Hierdie een was ook by Jesus, die Nasaréner.

kjv_text: And again he denied with an oath, I do not know the man.
bsb_text: And again he denied it with an oath: “I do not know the man!”
aov_text: En met ’n eed ontken hy dit weer: Ek ken die man nie.

kjv_text: And after a while came unto him they that stood by, and said to Peter, Surely thou also art one of them; for thy speech bewrayeth thee.
bsb_text: After a little while, those standing nearby came up to Peter. “Surely you are one of them,” they said, “for your accent gives you away.”
aov_text: Maar ’n bietjie later kom die wat daar staan, en sê vir Petrus: Waarlik, jy is ook een van hulle, want ook jou spraak maak jou bekend.

kjv_text: Then began he to curse and to swear, saying, I know not the man. And immediately the cock crew.
bsb_text: At that he began to curse and swear to them, “I do not know the man!” And immediately a rooster crowed.
aov_text: Toe begin hy homself te verwens en te sweer: Ek ken die man nie.

kjv_text: And Peter remembered the word of Jesus, which said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice. And he went out, and wept bitterly.
bsb_text: Then Peter remembered the word that Jesus had spoken: “Before the rooster crows, you will deny Me three times.” And he went outside and wept bitterly.
aov_text: En dadelik het die haan gekraai, en Petrus het die woord van Jesus onthou wat Hy vir hom gesê het: Voor die haan kraai, sal jy My drie maal verloën. En hy het buitentoe gegaan en bitterlik geween.

kjv_text: When the morning was come, all the chief priests and elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death:
bsb_text: When morning came, all the chief priests and elders of the people conspired against Jesus to put Him to death.
aov_text: EN toe dit dag geword het, het al die owerpriesters en die ouderlinge van die volk saam raad gehou teen Jesus om Hom dood te maak.

kjv_text: And when they had bound him, they led him away, and delivered him to Pontius Pilate the governor.
bsb_text: They bound Him, led Him away, and handed Him over to Pilate the governor.
aov_text: En hulle het Hom geboei en weggelei en Hom oorgelewer aan Pontius Pilatus, die goewerneur.

kjv_text: Then Judas, which had betrayed him, when he saw that he was condemned, repented himself, and brought again the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,
bsb_text: When Judas, who had betrayed Him, saw that Jesus was condemned, he was filled with remorse and returned the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders.
aov_text: Daarna het Judas, sy verraaier, toe hy sien dat Hy veroordeel was, berou gekry en die dertig silwerstukke teruggebring na die owerpriesters en die ouderlinge

kjv_text: Saying, I have sinned in that I have betrayed the innocent blood. And they said, What is that to us? see thou to that.
bsb_text: “I have sinned by betraying innocent blood,” he said. “What is that to us?” they replied. “You bear the responsibility.”
aov_text: en gesê: Ek het gesondig deur onskuldige bloed te verraai. Maar hulle sê: Wat gaan dit ons aan? Jy kan toesien!

kjv_text: And he cast down the pieces of silver in the temple, and departed, and went and hanged himself.
bsb_text: So Judas threw the silver into the temple and left. Then he went away and hanged himself.
aov_text: En hy het die silwerstukke in die tempel neergegooi en weggeloop en homself gaan ophang.

kjv_text: And the chief priests took the silver pieces, and said, It is not lawful for to put them into the treasury, because it is the price of blood.
bsb_text: The chief priests picked up the pieces of silver and said, “It is unlawful to put this into the treasury, since it is blood money.”
aov_text: En die owerpriesters het die silwerstukke geneem en gesê: Dit is nie geoorloof om dit in die skatkis te stort nie, omdat dit bloedgeld is.

kjv_text: And they took counsel, and bought with them the potter's field, to bury strangers in.
bsb_text: After conferring together, they used the money to buy the potter’s field as a burial place for foreigners.
aov_text: En nadat hulle saam raad gehou het, het hulle die stuk grond van die pottebakker daarmee gekoop as ’n begraafplaas vir vreemdelinge.

kjv_text: Wherefore that field was called, The field of blood, unto this day.
bsb_text: That is why it has been called the Field of Blood to this day.
aov_text: Daarom is dié stuk grond genoem Bloedgrond, tot vandag toe.

kjv_text: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremy the prophet, saying, And they took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him that was valued, whom they of the children of Israel did value;
bsb_text: Then what was spoken through Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled: “They took the thirty pieces of silver, the price set on Him by the people of Israel,
aov_text: Toe is vervul wat gespreek is deur Jeremia, die profeet, toe hy gesê het: En hulle het die dertig silwerstukke geneem, die prys van die gewaardeerde wat hulle gewaardeer het vanweë die kinders van Israel;

kjv_text: And gave them for the potter's field, as the Lord appointed me.
bsb_text: and they gave them for the potter’s field, as the Lord had commanded me.”
aov_text: en hulle het dit gegee vir die grond van die pottebakker, soos die Here my beveel het.

kjv_text: And Jesus stood before the governor: and the governor asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And Jesus said unto him, Thou sayest.
bsb_text: Meanwhile Jesus stood before the governor, who questioned Him: “Are You the King of the Jews?” “You have said so,” Jesus replied.
aov_text: EN Jesus het voor die goewerneur gestaan, en die goewerneur het Hom die vraag gestel en gesê: Is U die Koning van die Jode? En Jesus antwoord hom: U sê dit.

kjv_text: And when he was accused of the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.
bsb_text: And when He was accused by the chief priests and elders, He gave no answer.
aov_text: En terwyl Hy deur die owerpriesters en die ouderlinge beskuldig word, het Hy niks geantwoord nie.

kjv_text: Then said Pilate unto him, Hearest thou not how many things they witness against thee?
bsb_text: Then Pilate asked Him, “Do You not hear how many charges they are bringing against You?”
aov_text: Toe sê Pilatus vir Hom: Hoor U nie hoe baie dinge hulle teen U getuig nie?

kjv_text: And he answered him to never a word; insomuch that the governor marvelled greatly.
bsb_text: But Jesus gave no answer, not even to a single charge, much to the governor’s amazement.
aov_text: En Hy het hom op geen enkele woord geantwoord nie, sodat die goewerneur hom baie verwonder het.

kjv_text: Now at that feast the governor was wont to release unto the people a prisoner, whom they would.
bsb_text: Now it was the governor’s custom at the feast to release to the crowd a prisoner of their choosing.
aov_text: En op die fees was die goewerneur gewoond om een gevangene, die een wat hulle wou hê, vir die skare los te laat.

kjv_text: And they had then a notable prisoner, called Barabbas.
bsb_text: At that time they were holding a notorious prisoner named Barabbas.
aov_text: En in daardie tyd het hulle ’n berugte gevangene gehad met die naam van Barábbas.

kjv_text: Therefore when they were gathered together, Pilate said unto them, Whom will ye that I release unto you? Barabbas, or Jesus which is called Christ?
bsb_text: So when the crowd had assembled, Pilate asked them, “Which one do you want me to release to you: Barabbas, or Jesus who is called Christ?”
aov_text: Nadat hulle dan byeengekom het, sê Pilatus vir hulle: Wie wil julle hê moet ek vir julle loslaat: Barábbas, of Jesus wat genoem word Christus?

kjv_text: For he knew that for envy they had delivered him.
bsb_text: For he knew it was out of envy that they had handed Jesus over to him.
aov_text: Want hy het geweet dat hulle Hom uit nydigheid oorgelewer het.

kjv_text: When he was set down on the judgment seat, his wife sent unto him, saying, Have thou nothing to do with that just man: for I have suffered many things this day in a dream because of him.
bsb_text: While Pilate was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent him this message: “Have nothing to do with that innocent man, for I have suffered terribly in a dream today because of Him.”
aov_text: En terwyl hy op die regbank sit, het sy vrou na hom gestuur en gesê: Moet tog niks te doen hê met dié regverdige man nie, want ek het vandag in ’n droom baie gely om sy ontwil.

kjv_text: But the chief priests and elders persuaded the multitude that they should ask Barabbas, and destroy Jesus.
bsb_text: But the chief priests and elders persuaded the crowds to ask for Barabbas and to have Jesus put to death.
aov_text: Maar die owerpriesters en die ouderlinge het die skare oorgehaal dat hulle Barábbas moes begeer en Jesus ombring.

kjv_text: The governor answered and said unto them, Whether of the twain will ye that I release unto you? They said, Barabbas.
bsb_text: “Which of the two do you want me to release to you?” asked the governor. “Barabbas,” they replied.
aov_text: Toe antwoord die goewerneur en sê vir hulle: Wie van die twee wil julle hê moet ek vir julle loslaat? En hulle antwoord: Barábbas!

kjv_text: Pilate saith unto them, What shall I do then with Jesus which is called Christ? They all say unto him, Let him be crucified.
bsb_text: “What then should I do with Jesus who is called Christ?” Pilate asked. They all answered, “Crucify Him!”
aov_text: Pilatus sê vir hulle: Wat moet ek dan doen met Jesus wat genoem word Christus? Hulle sê almal vir hom: Laat Hom gekruisig word!

kjv_text: And the governor said, Why, what evil hath he done? But they cried out the more, saying, Let him be crucified.
bsb_text: “Why?” asked Pilate. “What evil has He done?” But they shouted all the louder, “Crucify Him!”
aov_text: En die goewerneur sê: Watter kwaad het Hy dan gedoen? Maar hulle skreeu nog harder en sê: Laat Hom gekruisig word!

kjv_text: When Pilate saw that he could prevail nothing, but that rather a tumult was made, he took water, and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, I am innocent of the blood of this just person: see ye to it.
bsb_text: When Pilate saw that he was accomplishing nothing, but that instead a riot was breaking out, he took water and washed his hands before the crowd. “I am innocent of this man’s blood,” he said. “You bear the responsibility.”
aov_text: En toe Pilatus sien dat niks help nie, maar dat daar eerder ’n oproer kom, het hy water geneem en sy hande voor die skare gewas en gesê: Ek is onskuldig aan die bloed van hierdie regverdige man; julle kan toesien!

kjv_text: Then answered all the people, and said, His blood be on us, and on our children.
bsb_text: All the people answered, “His blood be on us and on our children!”
aov_text: En die hele volk antwoord en sê: Laat sy bloed op ons en op ons kinders kom!

kjv_text: Then released he Barabbas unto them: and when he had scourged Jesus, he delivered him to be crucified.
bsb_text: So Pilate released Barabbas to them. But he had Jesus flogged, and handed Him over to be crucified.
aov_text: Toe laat hy vir hulle Barábbas los, maar Jesus het hy laat gésel en oorgelewer om gekruisig te word.

kjv_text: Then the soldiers of the governor took Jesus into the common hall, and gathered unto him the whole band of soldiers.
bsb_text: Then the governor’s soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium and gathered the whole company around Him.
aov_text: Daarop neem die soldate van die goewerneur Jesus met hulle saam in die goewerneur se paleis en bring die hele leërafdeling teen Hom bymekaar.

kjv_text: And they stripped him, and put on him a scarlet robe.
bsb_text: They stripped Him and put a scarlet robe on Him.
aov_text: Toe trek hulle sy klere uit en werp ’n rooi mantel om Hom;

kjv_text: And when they had platted a crown of thorns, they put it upon his head, and a reed in his right hand: and they bowed the knee before him, and mocked him, saying, Hail, King of the Jews!
bsb_text: And they twisted together a crown of thorns and set it on His head. They put a staff in His right hand and knelt down before Him to mock Him, saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!”
aov_text: en hulle vleg ’n kroon van dorings en sit dit op sy hoof, en ’n riet in sy regterhand; en hulle val op hul knieë voor Hom en bespot Hom en sê: Wees gegroet, Koning van die Jode!

kjv_text: And they spit upon him, and took the reed, and smote him on the head.
bsb_text: Then they spit on Him and took the staff and struck Him on the head repeatedly.
aov_text: En hulle spuug op Hom en neem die riet en slaan Hom op sy hoof.

kjv_text: And after that they had mocked him, they took the robe off from him, and put his own raiment on him, and led him away to crucify him.
bsb_text: After they had mocked Him, they removed the robe and put His own clothes back on Him. Then they led Him away to crucify Him.
aov_text: En nadat hulle Hom bespot het, trek hulle Hom die mantel uit en trek Hom sy klere aan en lei Hom weg om gekruisig te word.

kjv_text: And as they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name: him they compelled to bear his cross.
bsb_text: Along the way they found a man from Cyrene, named Simon, and they forced him to carry the cross of Jesus.
aov_text: EN toe hulle uitgaan, kry hulle ’n man van Ciréne, met die naam van Simon; hom het hulle gedwing om sy kruis te dra.

kjv_text: And when they were come unto a place called Golgotha, that is to say, a place of a skull,
bsb_text: And when they came to a place called Golgotha, which means The Place of the Skull,
aov_text: En hulle het gekom op ’n plek wat Gólgota genoem word — dit beteken: Plek van die Hoofskedel  —

kjv_text: They gave him vinegar to drink mingled with gall: and when he had tasted thereof, he would not drink.
bsb_text: they offered Him wine to drink, mixed with gall; but after tasting it, He refused to drink it.
aov_text: en vir Hom asyn, met gal gemeng, gegee om te drink; en toe Hy dit proe, wou Hy nie drink nie.

kjv_text: And they crucified him, and parted his garments, casting lots: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, They parted my garments among them, and upon my vesture did they cast lots.
bsb_text: When they had crucified Him, they divided up His garments by casting lots.
aov_text: En nadat hulle Hom gekruisig het, het hulle sy klere verdeel deur die lot te werp, sodat vervul sou word wat deur die profeet gespreek is: Hulle het my klere onder mekaar verdeel en oor my gewaad die lot gewerp.

kjv_text: And sitting down they watched him there;
bsb_text: And sitting down, they kept watch over Him there.
aov_text: En hulle het gaan sit en Hom daar bewaak.

kjv_text: And set up over his head his accusation written, THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
bsb_text: Above His head they posted the written charge against Him: THIS IS JESUS, THE KING OF THE JEWS.
aov_text: En bokant sy hoof het hulle sy beskuldiging in skrif opgestel: DIT IS JESUS, DIE KONING VAN DIE JODE.

kjv_text: Then were there two thieves crucified with him, one on the right hand, and another on the left.
bsb_text: Two robbers were crucified with Him, one on His right hand and the other on His left.
aov_text: Toe word daar saam met Hom twee rowers gekruisig, een aan die regter- en een aan die linkerkant.

kjv_text: And they that passed by reviled him, wagging their heads,
bsb_text: And those who passed by heaped abuse on Him, shaking their heads
aov_text: En die verbygangers het Hom gesmaad terwyl hulle hul hoofde skud

kjv_text: And saying, Thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days, save thyself. If thou be the Son of God, come down from the cross.
bsb_text: and saying, “You who are going to destroy the temple and rebuild it in three days, save Yourself! If You are the Son of God, come down from the cross!”
aov_text: en sê: U wat die tempel afbreek en in drie dae opbou, red Uself! As U die Seun van God is, kom af van die kruis!

kjv_text: Likewise also the chief priests mocking him, with the scribes and elders, said,
bsb_text: In the same way, the chief priests, scribes, and elders mocked Him, saying,
aov_text: En so het ook die owerpriesters saam met die skrifgeleerdes en ouderlinge gespot en gesê:

kjv_text: He saved others; himself he cannot save. If he be the King of Israel, let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe him.
bsb_text: “He saved others, but He cannot save Himself. He is the King of Israel! Let Him come down now from the cross, and we will believe in Him.
aov_text: Ander het Hy verlos, Homself kan Hy nie verlos nie. As Hy die Koning van Israel is, laat Hom nou van die kruis afkom, en ons sal in Hom glo.

kjv_text: He trusted in God; let him deliver him now, if he will have him: for he said, I am the Son of God.
bsb_text: He trusts in God. Let God deliver Him now if He wants Him. For He said, ‘I am the Son of God.’”
aov_text: Hy het op God vertrou; laat Hy Hom nou verlos as Hy behae in Hom het; want Hy het gesê: Ek is die Seun van God.

kjv_text: The thieves also, which were crucified with him, cast the same in his teeth.
bsb_text: In the same way, even the robbers who were crucified with Him berated Him.
aov_text: En op dieselfde manier het die rowers wat saam met Hom gekruisig was, Hom ook beledig.

kjv_text: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land unto the ninth hour.
bsb_text: From the sixth hour until the ninth hour darkness came over all the land.
aov_text: En van die sesde uur af het daar duisternis gekom oor die hele aarde tot die negende uur toe;

kjv_text: And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is to say, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
bsb_text: About the ninth hour Jesus cried out in a loud voice, “Eli, Eli, lema sabachthani?” which means, “My God, My God, why have You forsaken Me?”
aov_text: en omtrent die negende uur het Jesus met ’n groot stem geroep en gesê: Eli, Eli, lama sabagtáni? Dit is: My God, my God, waarom het U My verlaat?

kjv_text: Some of them that stood there, when they heard that, said, This man calleth for Elias.
bsb_text: When some of those standing there heard this, they said, “He is calling Elijah.”
aov_text: En sommige van die wat daar staan, hoor dit en sê: Hy roep Elía.

kjv_text: And straightway one of them ran, and took a spunge, and filled it with vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink.
bsb_text: One of them quickly ran and brought a sponge. He filled it with sour wine, put it on a reed, and held it up for Jesus to drink.
aov_text: Toe hardloop daar dadelik een van hulle en neem ’n spons en maak dit vol asyn, en sit dit op ’n riet en laat Hom drink.

kjv_text: The rest said, Let be, let us see whether Elias will come to save him.
bsb_text: But the others said, “Leave Him alone. Let us see if Elijah comes to save Him.”
aov_text: Maar die ander sê: Wag, laat ons sien of Elía kom om Hom te verlos.

kjv_text: Jesus, when he had cried again with a loud voice, yielded up the ghost.
bsb_text: When Jesus had cried out again in a loud voice, He yielded up His spirit.
aov_text: Daarop het Jesus weer met ’n groot stem geroep en die gees gegee.

kjv_text: And, behold, the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom; and the earth did quake, and the rocks rent;
bsb_text: At that moment the veil of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom. The earth quaked and the rocks were split.
aov_text: En kyk, die voorhangsel van die tempel het in twee geskeur, van bo tot onder, en die aarde het gebewe en die rotse het geskeur;

kjv_text: And the graves were opened; and many bodies of the saints which slept arose,
bsb_text: The tombs broke open, and the bodies of many saints who had fallen asleep were raised.
aov_text: en die grafte het oopgegaan en baie liggame van die ontslape heiliges het opgestaan.

kjv_text: And came out of the graves after his resurrection, and went into the holy city, and appeared unto many.
bsb_text: After Jesus’ resurrection, when they had come out of the tombs, they entered the holy city and appeared to many people.
aov_text: En ná sy opstanding het hulle uit die grafte uitgegaan en in die heilige stad ingekom en aan baie verskyn.

kjv_text: Now when the centurion, and they that were with him, watching Jesus, saw the earthquake, and those things that were done, they feared greatly, saying, Truly this was the Son of God.
bsb_text: When the centurion and those with him who were guarding Jesus saw the earthquake and all that had happened, they were terrified and said, “Truly this was the Son of God.”
aov_text: En toe die hoofman oor honderd en die wat saam met hom Jesus bewaak het, die aardbewing sien en die dinge wat daar gebeur, het hulle baie bevrees geword en gesê: Waarlik, Hy was die Seun van God.

kjv_text: And many women were there beholding afar off, which followed Jesus from Galilee, ministering unto him:
bsb_text: And many women were there, watching from a distance. They had followed Jesus from Galilee to minister to Him.
aov_text: En daar was baie vroue wat dit van ver af aanskou het, wat vir Jesus van Galiléa af gevolg en Hom gedien het.

kjv_text: Among which was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of Zebedee's children.
bsb_text: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joseph, and the mother of Zebedee’s sons.
aov_text: Onder hulle was daar Maria Magdaléna en Maria, die moeder van Jakobus en Joses, en die moeder van die seuns van Sebedéüs.

kjv_text: When the even was come, there came a rich man of Arimathaea, named Joseph, who also himself was Jesus' disciple:
bsb_text: When it was evening, there came a rich man from Arimathea named Joseph, who himself was a disciple of Jesus.
aov_text: EN toe dit aand geword het, het daar ’n ryk man van Arimathéa gekom met die naam van Josef, wat self ook ’n dissipel van Jesus was.

kjv_text: He went to Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus. Then Pilate commanded the body to be delivered.
bsb_text: He went to Pilate to ask for the body of Jesus, and Pilate ordered that it be given to him.
aov_text: Hy het na Pilatus gegaan en die liggaam van Jesus gevra. Toe beveel Pilatus dat die liggaam afgegee moes word.

kjv_text: And when Joseph had taken the body, he wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,
bsb_text: So Joseph took the body, wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,
aov_text: En Josef het die liggaam geneem en dit met skoon linne toegedraai

kjv_text: And laid it in his own new tomb, which he had hewn out in the rock: and he rolled a great stone to the door of the sepulchre, and departed.
bsb_text: and placed it in his own new tomb that he had cut into the rock. Then he rolled a great stone across the entrance to the tomb and went away.
aov_text: en dit in sy nuwe graf gelê wat hy in die rots uitgekap het; en nadat hy ’n groot steen teen die opening van die graf gerol het, het hy weggegaan.

kjv_text: And there was Mary Magdalene, and the other Mary, sitting over against the sepulchre.
bsb_text: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary were sitting there opposite the tomb.
aov_text: En Maria Magdaléna was daar en die ander Maria, en hulle het reg voor die graf gesit.

kjv_text: Now the next day, that followed the day of the preparation, the chief priests and Pharisees came together unto Pilate,
bsb_text: The next day, the one after Preparation Day, the chief priests and Pharisees assembled before Pilate.
aov_text: Die volgende dag — dit is die dag ná die voorbereiding — kom die owerpriesters en die Fariseërs by Pilatus saam

kjv_text: Saying, Sir, we remember that that deceiver said, while he was yet alive, After three days I will rise again.
bsb_text: “Sir,” they said, “we remember that while He was alive that deceiver said, ‘After three days I will rise again.’
aov_text: en sê: My heer, ons herinner ons dat dié verleier, toe hy in die lewe was, gesê het: Oor drie dae staan Ek op.

kjv_text: Command therefore that the sepulchre be made sure until the third day, lest his disciples come by night, and steal him away, and say unto the people, He is risen from the dead: so the last error shall be worse than the first.
bsb_text: So give the order that the tomb be secured until the third day. Otherwise, His disciples may come and steal Him away and tell the people He has risen from the dead. And this last deception would be worse than the first.”
aov_text: Gee dan bevel dat die graf verseker word tot die derde dag toe, dat sy dissipels nie miskien in die nag kom en Hom steel nie, en vir die volk sê: Hy het opgestaan uit die dode. En die laaste dwaling sal erger wees as die eerste.

kjv_text: Pilate said unto them, Ye have a watch: go your way, make it as sure as ye can.
bsb_text: “You have a guard,” Pilate said. “Go, make the tomb as secure as you know how.”
aov_text: Daarop sê Pilatus vir hulle: Julle sal ’n wag kry; gaan verseker dit soos julle dit verstaan.

kjv_text: So they went, and made the sepulchre sure, sealing the stone, and setting a watch.
bsb_text: So they went and secured the tomb by sealing the stone and posting the guard.
aov_text: En hulle het gegaan en die graf verseker deur die steen te verseël in teenwoordigheid van die wag.

kjv_text: In the end of the sabbath, as it began to dawn toward the first day of the week, came Mary Magdalene and the other Mary to see the sepulchre.
bsb_text: After the Sabbath, at dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary went to see the tomb.
aov_text: EN laat ná die sabbat toe dit begin lig word, teen die eerste dag van die week, kom Maria Magdaléna en die ander Maria om na die graf te gaan kyk.

kjv_text: And, behold, there was a great earthquake: for the angel of the Lord descended from heaven, and came and rolled back the stone from the door, and sat upon it.
bsb_text: Suddenly there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from heaven, rolled away the stone, and sat on it.
aov_text: En daar kom ’n groot aardbewing, want ’n engel van die Here het uit die hemel neergedaal en gekom en die steen van die opening weggerol en daarop gaan sit.

kjv_text: His countenance was like lightning, and his raiment white as snow:
bsb_text: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothes were white as snow.
aov_text: En sy gedaante was soos weerlig en sy kleding wit soos sneeu.

kjv_text: And for fear of him the keepers did shake, and became as dead men.
bsb_text: The guards trembled in fear of him and became like dead men.
aov_text: En uit vrees vir hom het die wagte gebewe en soos dooies geword.

kjv_text: And the angel answered and said unto the women, Fear not ye: for I know that ye seek Jesus, which was crucified.
bsb_text: But the angel said to the women, “Do not be afraid, for I know that you are looking for Jesus, who was crucified.
aov_text: Maar die engel antwoord en sê vir die vroue: Moenie vrees nie, want ek weet julle soek Jesus wat gekruisig is.

kjv_text: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.
bsb_text: He is not here; He has risen, just as He said! Come, see the place where He lay.
aov_text: Hy is nie hier nie, want Hy het opgestaan soos Hy gesê het. Kom kyk na die plek waar die Here gelê het;

kjv_text: And go quickly, and tell his disciples that he is risen from the dead; and, behold, he goeth before you into Galilee; there shall ye see him: lo, I have told you.
bsb_text: Then go quickly and tell His disciples, ‘He has risen from the dead and is going ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see Him.’ See, I have told you.”
aov_text: en gaan haastig, sê vir sy dissipels: Hy het opgestaan uit die dode en gaan voor julle uit na Galiléa. Daar sal julle Hom sien. Kyk, ek het julle dit gesê.

kjv_text: And they departed quickly from the sepulchre with fear and great joy; and did run to bring his disciples word.
bsb_text: So they hurried away from the tomb in fear and great joy, and ran to tell His disciples.
aov_text: En hulle het haastig weggegaan van die graf met vrees en groot blydskap, en gehardloop om dit aan sy dissipels te vertel.

kjv_text: And as they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, All hail. And they came and held him by the feet, and worshipped him.
bsb_text: Suddenly Jesus met them and said, “Greetings!” They came to Him, grasped His feet, and worshiped Him.
aov_text: En terwyl hulle op weg was om dit aan sy dissipels te vertel, kom Jesus hulle meteens teë en sê: Wees gegroet! Toe kom hulle nader en gryp sy voete en aanbid Hom.

kjv_text: Then said Jesus unto them, Be not afraid: go tell my brethren that they go into Galilee, and there shall they see me.
bsb_text: “Do not be afraid,” said Jesus. “Go and tell My brothers to go to Galilee. There they will see Me.”
aov_text: En Jesus sê vir hulle: Moenie vrees nie. Gaan heen en vertel my broeders dat hulle na Galiléa moet gaan; en daar sal hulle My sien.

kjv_text: Now when they were going, behold, some of the watch came into the city, and shewed unto the chief priests all the things that were done.
bsb_text: While the women were on their way, some of the guards went into the city and reported to the chief priests all that had happened.
aov_text: EN terwyl hulle op weg was, kom daar sommige van die wag in die stad en vertel die owerpriesters alles wat gebeur het.

kjv_text: And when they were assembled with the elders, and had taken counsel, they gave large money unto the soldiers,
bsb_text: And after the chief priests had met with the elders and formed a plan, they gave the soldiers a large sum of money
aov_text: En nadat hulle saam met die ouderlinge vergader en raad gehou het, het hulle die soldate baie geld gegee

kjv_text: Saying, Say ye, His disciples came by night, and stole him away while we slept.
bsb_text: and instructed them: “You are to say, ‘His disciples came by night and stole Him away while we were asleep.’
aov_text: en gesê: Julle moet sê: Sy dissipels het in die nag gekom en Hom gesteel terwyl ons aan die slaap was.

kjv_text: And if this come to the governor's ears, we will persuade him, and secure you.
bsb_text: If this report reaches the governor, we will satisfy him and keep you out of trouble.”
aov_text: En as dit by die goewerneur gehoor word, sal ons hom tevrede stel en maak dat julle sonder sorg is.

kjv_text: So they took the money, and did as they were taught: and this saying is commonly reported among the Jews until this day.
bsb_text: So the guards took the money and did as they were instructed. And this account has been circulated among the Jews to this very day.
aov_text: Hulle het toe die geld geneem en gedoen soos hulle geleer was. En hierdie verhaal is versprei onder die Jode, tot vandag toe.

kjv_text: Then the eleven disciples went away into Galilee, into a mountain where Jesus had appointed them.
bsb_text: Meanwhile, the eleven disciples went to Galilee, to the mountain Jesus had designated.
aov_text: EN die elf dissipels het na Galiléa gegaan, na die berg waar Jesus hulle bestel het.

kjv_text: And when they saw him, they worshipped him: but some doubted.
bsb_text: When they saw Him, they worshiped Him, but some doubted.
aov_text: En toe hulle Hom sien, het hulle Hom aanbid; maar sommige het getwyfel.

kjv_text: And Jesus came and spake unto them, saying, All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.
bsb_text: Then Jesus came to them and said, “All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to Me.
aov_text: En Jesus het nader gekom en met hulle gespreek en gesê: Aan My is gegee alle mag in die hemel en op aarde.

kjv_text: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost:
bsb_text: Therefore go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit,
aov_text: Gaan dan heen, maak dissipels van al die nasies, en doop hulle in die Naam van die Vader en die Seun en die Heilige Gees; en leer hulle om alles te onderhou wat Ek julle beveel het.

kjv_text: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world. Amen.
bsb_text: and teaching them to obey all that I have commanded you. And surely I am with you always, even to the end of the age.”
aov_text: En kyk, Ek is met julle al die dae tot aan die voleinding van die wêreld. Amen.

kjv_text: The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God;
bsb_text: This is the beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.
aov_text: DIE begin van die evangelie van Jesus Christus, die Seun van God.

kjv_text: As it is written in the prophets, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.
bsb_text: As it is written in Isaiah the prophet: “Behold, I will send My messenger ahead of You, who will prepare Your way.”
aov_text: Soos geskrywe is in die Profete: Kyk, Ek stuur my boodskapper voor u aangesig, wat u pad voor U uit sal regmaak  —

kjv_text: The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
bsb_text: “A voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for Him.’”
aov_text: die stem van een wat roep in die woestyn: Berei die weg van die Here, maak sy paaie reguit!

kjv_text: John did baptize in the wilderness, and preach the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins.
bsb_text: John the Baptist appeared in the wilderness, preaching a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins.
aov_text: Johannes het gekom en was besig om in die woestyn te doop en die doop van bekering tot vergifnis van sondes te verkondig.

kjv_text: And there went out unto him all the land of Judaea, and they of Jerusalem, and were all baptized of him in the river of Jordan, confessing their sins.
bsb_text: People went out to him from all of Jerusalem and the countryside of Judea. Confessing their sins, they were baptized by him in the Jordan River.
aov_text: En die hele Joodse land en die inwoners van Jerusalem het uitgegaan na hom toe, en almal is deur hom gedoop in die Jordaanrivier met belydenis van hulle sondes.

kjv_text: And John was clothed with camel's hair, and with a girdle of a skin about his loins; and he did eat locusts and wild honey;
bsb_text: John was clothed in camel’s hair, with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.
aov_text: En Johannes was gekleed met kameelhare en ’n leergord om sy heupe, en hy het sprinkane en wilde heuning geëet.

kjv_text: And preached, saying, There cometh one mightier than I after me, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and unloose.
bsb_text: And he began to proclaim: “After me will come One more powerful than I, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and untie.
aov_text: En hy het gepreek en gesê: Hy wat sterker is as ek, kom ná my, en ek is nie waardig om neer te buk en sy skoenriem los te maak nie.

kjv_text: I indeed have baptized you with water: but he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost.
bsb_text: I baptize you with water, but He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit.”
aov_text: Ek het julle wel met water gedoop, maar Hy sal julle doop met die Heilige Gees.

kjv_text: And it came to pass in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized of John in Jordan.
bsb_text: In those days Jesus came from Nazareth in Galilee and was baptized by John in the Jordan.
aov_text: EN in daardie dae het Jesus van Násaret in Galiléa gekom en is deur Johannes in die Jordaan gedoop.

kjv_text: And straightway coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens opened, and the Spirit like a dove descending upon him:
bsb_text: As soon as Jesus came up out of the water, He saw the heavens breaking open and the Spirit descending on Him like a dove.
aov_text: En dadelik toe Hy opklim uit die water, sien Hy die hemele skeur en die Gees soos ’n duif op Hom neerdaal.

kjv_text: And there came a voice from heaven, saying, Thou art my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
bsb_text: And a voice came from heaven: “You are My beloved Son; in You I am well pleased.”
aov_text: En daar het ’n stem uit die hemele gekom: U is my geliefde Seun in wie Ek ’n welbehae het.

kjv_text: And immediately the Spirit driveth him into the wilderness.
bsb_text: At once the Spirit drove Jesus into the wilderness,
aov_text: En dadelik het die Gees Hom uitgedryf in die woestyn.

kjv_text: And he was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted of Satan; and was with the wild beasts; and the angels ministered unto him.
bsb_text: and He was there for forty days, being tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals, and the angels ministered to Him.
aov_text: En Hy was daar in die woestyn veertig dae lank, terwyl Hy deur die Satan versoek is; en Hy was saam met die wilde diere, en die engele het Hom gedien.

kjv_text: Now after that John was put in prison, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of the kingdom of God,
bsb_text: After the arrest of John, Jesus went into Galilee and proclaimed the gospel of God.
aov_text: EN nadat Johannes oorgelewer was, het Jesus in Galiléa gekom en die evangelie van die koninkryk van God verkondig

kjv_text: And saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent ye, and believe the gospel.
bsb_text: “The time is fulfilled,” He said, “and the kingdom of God is near. Repent and believe in the gospel!”
aov_text: en gesê: Die tyd is vervul en die koninkryk van God het naby gekom; bekeer julle en glo die evangelie.

kjv_text: Now as he walked by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew his brother casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.
bsb_text: As Jesus was walking beside the Sea of Galilee, He saw Simon and his brother Andrew. They were casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.
aov_text: En terwyl Hy langs die see van Galiléa loop, sien Hy Simon en Andréas, sy broer, besig om ’n net in die see uit te gooi; want hulle was vissers.

kjv_text: And Jesus said unto them, Come ye after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men.
bsb_text: “Come, follow Me,” Jesus said, “and I will make you fishers of men.”
aov_text: En Jesus sê vir hulle: Kom agter My aan, en Ek sal maak dat julle vissers van mense word.

kjv_text: And straightway they forsook their nets, and followed him.
bsb_text: And at once they left their nets and followed Him.
aov_text: En dadelik het hulle hul nette laat staan en Hom gevolg.

kjv_text: And when he had gone a little farther thence, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in the ship mending their nets.
bsb_text: Going on a little farther, He saw James son of Zebedee and his brother John. They were in a boat, mending their nets.
aov_text: En toe Hy daarvandaan ’n bietjie verder gaan, sien Hy Jakobus, die seun van Sebedéüs, en Johannes, sy broer, wat besig was om die nette in die skuit heel te maak.

kjv_text: And straightway he called them: and they left their father Zebedee in the ship with the hired servants, and went after him.
bsb_text: Immediately Jesus called them, and they left their father Zebedee in the boat with the hired men and followed Him.
aov_text: En dadelik het Hy hulle geroep, en hulle het hul vader Sebedéüs met die gehuurde mense in die skuit laat staan en Hom gevolg.

kjv_text: And they went into Capernaum; and straightway on the sabbath day he entered into the synagogue, and taught.
bsb_text: Then Jesus and His companions went to Capernaum, and right away Jesus entered the synagogue on the Sabbath and began to teach.
aov_text: EN hulle het in Kapérnaüm gekom, en dadelik op die sabbat het Hy in die sinagoge ingegaan en begin leer.

kjv_text: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for he taught them as one that had authority, and not as the scribes.
bsb_text: The people were astonished at His teaching, because He taught as one who had authority, and not as the scribes.
aov_text: En hulle was verslae oor sy leer, want Hy het hulle geleer soos een wat gesag het en nie soos die skrifgeleerdes nie.

kjv_text: And there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit; and he cried out,
bsb_text: Suddenly a man with an unclean spirit cried out in the synagogue:
aov_text: En daar was in hulle sinagoge ’n man met ’n onreine gees; en hy het uitgeskreeu

kjv_text: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art, the Holy One of God.
bsb_text: “What do You want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have You come to destroy us? I know who You are—the Holy One of God!”
aov_text: en gesê: Hou op! Wat het ons met U te doen, Jesus, Nasaréner? Het U gekom om ons te verdelg? Ek ken U, wie U is: die Heilige van God!

kjv_text: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him.
bsb_text: But Jesus rebuked the spirit. “Be silent!” He said. “Come out of him!”
aov_text: En Jesus het hom bestraf en gesê: Bly stil en gaan uit hom uit!

kjv_text: And when the unclean spirit had torn him, and cried with a loud voice, he came out of him.
bsb_text: At this, the unclean spirit threw the man into convulsions and came out with a loud shriek.
aov_text: En die onreine gees het hom stuiptrekkings laat kry en met ’n groot stem geskreeu en uit hom uitgegaan.

kjv_text: And they were all amazed, insomuch that they questioned among themselves, saying, What thing is this? what new doctrine is this? for with authority commandeth he even the unclean spirits, and they do obey him.
bsb_text: All the people were amazed and began to ask one another, “What is this? A new teaching with authority! He commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey Him!”
aov_text: En almal was verbaas, sodat hulle onder mekaar vra en sê: Wat is dit? Watter nuwe leer is dit, dat Hy met gesag ook aan die onreine geeste bevel gee en hulle Hom gehoorsaam is?

kjv_text: And immediately his fame spread abroad throughout all the region round about Galilee.
bsb_text: And the news about Jesus spread quickly through the whole region of Galilee.
aov_text: En die gerug aangaande Hom is dadelik versprei in die hele omtrek van Galiléa.

kjv_text: And forthwith, when they were come out of the synagogue, they entered into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.
bsb_text: As soon as Jesus and His companions had left the synagogue, they went with James and John to the home of Simon and Andrew.
aov_text: EN dadelik toe hulle uit die sinagoge uitgegaan het, kom hulle saam met Jakobus en Johannes in die huis van Simon en Andréas.

kjv_text: But Simon's wife's mother lay sick of a fever, and anon they tell him of her.
bsb_text: Simon’s mother-in-law was sick in bed with a fever, and they promptly told Jesus about her.
aov_text: En die skoonmoeder van Simon het siek gelê aan die koors; en dadelik het hulle Hom van haar gesê.

kjv_text: And he came and took her by the hand, and lifted her up; and immediately the fever left her, and she ministered unto them.
bsb_text: So He went to her, took her by the hand, and helped her up. The fever left her, and she began to serve them.
aov_text: Daarop gaan Hy na haar, neem haar hand en rig haar op, en dadelik het die koors haar verlaat, en sy het hulle bedien.

kjv_text: And at even, when the sun did set, they brought unto him all that were diseased, and them that were possessed with devils.
bsb_text: That evening, after sunset, people brought to Jesus all who were sick and demon-possessed,
aov_text: En toe dit aand geword het en die son onder was, het hulle na Hom gebring almal wat ongesteld en van duiwels besete was.

kjv_text: And all the city was gathered together at the door.
bsb_text: and the whole town gathered at the door.
aov_text: En die hele stad het by die deur saamgekom.

kjv_text: And he healed many that were sick of divers diseases, and cast out many devils; and suffered not the devils to speak, because they knew him.
bsb_text: And He healed many who were ill with various diseases and drove out many demons. But He would not allow the demons to speak, because they knew who He was.
aov_text: En baie wat aan allerhande siektes gely het, het Hy gesond gemaak en baie duiwels uitgedryf en die duiwels nie toegelaat om te praat nie, omdat hulle Hom geken het.

kjv_text: And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out, and departed into a solitary place, and there prayed.
bsb_text: Early in the morning, while it was still dark, Jesus got up and slipped out to a solitary place to pray.
aov_text: En vroeg in die môre, nog diep in die nag, het Hy opgestaan en uitgegaan en na ’n eensame plek vertrek en daar gebid.

kjv_text: And Simon and they that were with him followed after him.
bsb_text: Simon and his companions went to look for Him,
aov_text: En Simon en die wat by hom was, het Hom gevolg.

kjv_text: And when they had found him, they said unto him, All men seek for thee.
bsb_text: and when they found Him, they said, “Everyone is looking for You!”
aov_text: En toe hulle Hom vind, sê hulle vir Hom: Almal soek U.

kjv_text: And he said unto them, Let us go into the next towns, that I may preach there also: for therefore came I forth.
bsb_text: But Jesus answered, “Let us go on to the neighboring towns so I can preach there as well, for that is why I have come.”
aov_text: En Hy sê vir hulle: Laat ons na die naburige dorpe gaan, sodat Ek ook daar kan preek; want daarvoor het Ek uitgegaan.

kjv_text: And he preached in their synagogues throughout all Galilee, and cast out devils.
bsb_text: So He went throughout Galilee, preaching in their synagogues and driving out demons.
aov_text: En Hy het die hele Galiléa deur in hulle sinagoges gepreek en die duiwels uitgedryf.

kjv_text: And there came a leper to him, beseeching him, and kneeling down to him, and saying unto him, If thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
bsb_text: Then a leper came to Jesus, begging on his knees: “If You are willing, You can make me clean.”
aov_text: EN daar kom ’n melaatse na Hom toe wat Hom smeek en voor Hom op die knieë val en vir Hom sê: As U wil, kan U my reinig.

kjv_text: And Jesus, moved with compassion, put forth his hand, and touched him, and saith unto him, I will; be thou clean.
bsb_text: Moved with compassion, Jesus reached out His hand and touched the man. “I am willing,” He said. “Be clean!”
aov_text: En Jesus het vir hom innig jammer gevoel en die hand uitgesteek en hom aangeraak en vir hom gesê: Ek wil, word gereinig!

kjv_text: And as soon as he had spoken, immediately the leprosy departed from him, and he was cleansed.
bsb_text: And immediately the leprosy left him, and the man was cleansed.
aov_text: En toe Hy dit sê, het die melaatsheid hom dadelik verlaat, en hy is gereinig.

kjv_text: And he straitly charged him, and forthwith sent him away;
bsb_text: Jesus promptly sent him away with a stern warning:
aov_text: En nadat Hy hom ernstig aangespreek het, stuur Hy hom dadelik weg

kjv_text: And saith unto him, See thou say nothing to any man: but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing those things which Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
bsb_text: “See that you don’t tell anyone. But go, show yourself to the priest and present the offering Moses prescribed for your cleansing, as a testimony to them.”
aov_text: en sê vir hom: Pas op dat jy aan niemand iets vertel nie, maar gaan vertoon jou aan die priester en offer vir jou reiniging wat Moses voorgeskryf het, tot ’n getuienis vir hulle.

kjv_text: But he went out, and began to publish it much, and to blaze abroad the matter, insomuch that Jesus could no more openly enter into the city, but was without in desert places: and they came to him from every quarter.
bsb_text: But the man went out and openly began to proclaim and spread the news. Consequently, Jesus could no longer enter a town in plain view, but He stayed out in solitary places. Yet people came to Him from every quarter.
aov_text: Maar hy het uitgegaan en begin om baie dinge rond te vertel en die saak rugbaar te maak, sodat Hy nie meer openlik in ’n stad kon ingaan nie; maar Hy was buite in verlate plekke, en hulle het van alle kante na Hom gekom.

kjv_text: And again he entered into Capernaum after some days; and it was noised that he was in the house.
bsb_text: A few days later Jesus went back to Capernaum. And when the people heard that He was home,
aov_text: EN ná ’n paar dae het Hy weer in Kapérnaüm gekom, en die mense het gehoor dat Hy in die huis was.

kjv_text: And straightway many were gathered together, insomuch that there was no room to receive them, no, not so much as about the door: and he preached the word unto them.
bsb_text: they gathered in such large numbers that there was no more room, not even outside the door, as Jesus spoke the word to them.
aov_text: En dadelik het baie saamgekom, sodat daar selfs by die deur nie meer plek was nie; en Hy was besig om aan hulle die woord te verkondig.

kjv_text: And they come unto him, bringing one sick of the palsy, which was borne of four.
bsb_text: Then a paralytic was brought to Him, carried by four men.
aov_text: En daar kom mense na Hom met ’n verlamde man wat deur vier gedra word.

kjv_text: And when they could not come nigh unto him for the press, they uncovered the roof where he was: and when they had broken it up, they let down the bed wherein the sick of the palsy lay.
bsb_text: Since they were unable to get to Jesus through the crowd, they uncovered the roof above Him, made an opening, and lowered the paralytic on his mat.
aov_text: En toe hulle vanweë die skare nie naby Hom kon kom nie, maak hulle die dak oop waar Hy was, en nadat hulle dit oopgebreek het, het hulle die bed waar die verlamde op lê, laat afsak.

kjv_text: When Jesus saw their faith, he said unto the sick of the palsy, Son, thy sins be forgiven thee.
bsb_text: When Jesus saw their faith, He said to the paralytic, “Son, your sins are forgiven.”
aov_text: En toe Jesus hulle geloof sien, sê Hy vir die verlamde: Seun, jou sondes is jou vergewe!

kjv_text: But there were certain of the scribes sitting there, and reasoning in their hearts,
bsb_text: But some of the scribes were sitting there and thinking in their hearts,
aov_text: En sommige van die skrifgeleerdes het daar gesit en in hulle harte geredeneer:

kjv_text: Why doth this man thus speak blasphemies? who can forgive sins but God only?
bsb_text: “Why does this man speak like this? He is blaspheming! Who can forgive sins but God alone?”
aov_text: Waarom praat hierdie man so godslasterlik? Wie kan sondes vergewe behalwe Een, naamlik God?

kjv_text: And immediately when Jesus perceived in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, he said unto them, Why reason ye these things in your hearts?
bsb_text: At once Jesus knew in His spirit that they were thinking this way within themselves. “Why are you thinking these things in your hearts?” He asked.
aov_text: En Jesus het dadelik in sy gees geweet dat hulle by hulleself so redeneer, en Hy sê vir hulle: Wat redeneer julle oor hierdie dinge in jul harte?

kjv_text: Whether is it easier to say to the sick of the palsy, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and take up thy bed, and walk?
bsb_text: “Which is easier: to say to a paralytic, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up, pick up your mat, and walk’?
aov_text: Wat is makliker, om vir die verlamde te sê: Die sondes is jou vergewe! of om te sê: Staan op en neem jou bed op en loop?

kjv_text: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (he saith to the sick of the palsy,)
bsb_text: But so that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins...” He said to the paralytic,
aov_text: Maar dat julle kan weet dat die Seun van die mens mag het om op die aarde sondes te vergewe — sê Hy vir die verlamde man:

kjv_text: I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy bed, and go thy way into thine house.
bsb_text: “I tell you, get up, pick up your mat, and go home.”
aov_text: Ek sê vir jou: Staan op, neem jou bed op en gaan na jou huis toe.

kjv_text: And immediately he arose, took up the bed, and went forth before them all; insomuch that they were all amazed, and glorified God, saying, We never saw it on this fashion.
bsb_text: And immediately the man got up, picked up his mat, and walked out in front of them all. As a result, they were all astounded and glorified God, saying, “We have never seen anything like this!”
aov_text: En dadelik staan hy op en neem sy bed op en gaan voor die oë van almal uit, sodat almal verbaas was en God verheerlik en sê: So iets het ons nog nooit gesien nie!

kjv_text: And he went forth again by the sea side; and all the multitude resorted unto him, and he taught them.
bsb_text: Once again Jesus went out beside the sea. All the people came to Him, and He taught them there.
aov_text: EN Hy het weer uitgegaan langs die see, en die hele skare het na Hom gekom, en Hy het hulle geleer.

kjv_text: And as he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the receipt of custom, and said unto him, Follow me. And he arose and followed him.
bsb_text: As He was walking along, He saw Levi son of Alphaeus sitting at the tax booth. “Follow Me,” He told him, and Levi got up and followed Him.
aov_text: En toe Hy verbygaan, sien Hy Levi, die seun van Alféüs, by die tolhuis sit en sê vir hom: Volg My. En hy het opgestaan en Hom gevolg.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, that, as Jesus sat at meat in his house, many publicans and sinners sat also together with Jesus and his disciples: for there were many, and they followed him.
bsb_text: While Jesus was dining at Levi’s house, many tax collectors and sinners were eating with Him and His disciples—for there were many who followed Him.
aov_text: En terwyl Hy in sy huis aan tafel was, kom daar baie tollenaars en sondaars saam met Jesus en sy dissipels aan tafel; want daar was baie, en hulle het Hom gevolg.

kjv_text: And when the scribes and Pharisees saw him eat with publicans and sinners, they said unto his disciples, How is it that he eateth and drinketh with publicans and sinners?
bsb_text: When the scribes who were Pharisees saw Jesus eating with these people, they asked His disciples, “Why does He eat with tax collectors and sinners?”
aov_text: En toe die skrifgeleerdes en die Fariseërs Hom saam met die tollenaars en sondaars sien eet, sê hulle vir sy dissipels: Wat is dit dat Hy saam met die tollenaars en sondaars eet en drink?

kjv_text: When Jesus heard it, he saith unto them, They that are whole have no need of the physician, but they that are sick: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
bsb_text: On hearing this, Jesus told them, “It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick. I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners.”
aov_text: En toe Jesus dit hoor, sê Hy vir hulle: Die wat gesond is, het die geneesheer nie nodig nie, maar die wat ongesteld is. Ek het nie gekom om regverdiges te roep nie, maar sondaars tot bekering.

kjv_text: And the disciples of John and of the Pharisees used to fast: and they come and say unto him, Why do the disciples of John and of the Pharisees fast, but thy disciples fast not?
bsb_text: Now John’s disciples and the Pharisees were often fasting. So people came to Jesus and asked, “Why don’t Your disciples fast like John’s disciples and those of the Pharisees?”
aov_text: EN die dissipels van Johannes en dié van die Fariseërs was besig om te vas. Toe kom hulle en sê vir Hom: Waarom vas die dissipels van Johannes en dié van die Fariseërs, maar u dissipels vas nie?

kjv_text: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them? as long as they have the bridegroom with them, they cannot fast.
bsb_text: Jesus replied, “How can the guests of the bridegroom fast while He is with them? As long as He is with them, they cannot fast.
aov_text: En Jesus sê vir hulle: Kan die bruilofsgaste dan vas terwyl die bruidegom by hulle is? So lank as hulle die bruidegom by hulle het, kan hulle nie vas nie.

kjv_text: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.
bsb_text: But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them; then they will fast.
aov_text: Maar daar sal dae kom wanneer die bruidegom van hulle weggeneem word, en dan sal hulle vas, in daardie dae.

kjv_text: No man also seweth a piece of new cloth on an old garment: else the new piece that filled it up taketh away from the old, and the rent is made worse.
bsb_text: No one sews a patch of unshrunk cloth on an old garment. If he does, the new piece will pull away from the old, and a worse tear will result.
aov_text: En niemand werk ’n nuwe stuk lap op ’n ou kleed nie; anders skeur sy nuwe aangelapte stuk van die oue af, en daar kom ’n erger skeur.

kjv_text: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles: else the new wine doth burst the bottles, and the wine is spilled, and the bottles will be marred: but new wine must be put into new bottles.
bsb_text: And no one pours new wine into old wineskins. If he does, the wine will burst the skins, and both the wine and the wineskins will be ruined. Instead, new wine is poured into new wineskins.”
aov_text: En niemand gooi nuwe wyn in ou leersakke nie; anders sal die nuwe wyn die sakke laat bars, en die wyn loop uit en die sakke vergaan. Maar nuwe wyn moet in nuwe sakke gegooi word.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, that he went through the corn fields on the sabbath day; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of corn.
bsb_text: One Sabbath Jesus was passing through the grainfields, and His disciples began to pick the heads of grain as they walked along.
aov_text: EN terwyl Hy op die sabbat deur die gesaaides loop, het sy dissipels al gaande are begin pluk.

kjv_text: And the Pharisees said unto him, Behold, why do they on the sabbath day that which is not lawful?
bsb_text: So the Pharisees said to Him, “Look, why are they doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath?”
aov_text: Toe sê die Fariseërs vir Hom: Kyk, waarom doen hulle op die sabbat wat nie geoorloof is nie?

kjv_text: And he said unto them, Have ye never read what David did, when he had need, and was an hungred, he, and they that were with him?
bsb_text: Jesus replied, “Have you never read what David did when he and his companions were hungry and in need?
aov_text: En Hy sê vir hulle: Het julle nooit gelees wat Dawid gedoen het nie — toe hy in die nood was, en hy en die wat by hom was, honger gehad het  —

kjv_text: How he went into the house of God in the days of Abiathar the high priest, and did eat the shewbread, which is not lawful to eat but for the priests, and gave also to them which were with him?
bsb_text: During the high priesthood of Abiathar, he entered the house of God and ate the consecrated bread, which was lawful only for the priests. And he gave some to his companions as well.”
aov_text: hoe hy in die huis van God gegaan het in die tyd van Ábjatar, die hoëpriester, en die toonbrode geëet het wat vir niemand behalwe die priesters geoorloof is om te eet nie; en ook aan die wat saam met hom was, gegee het?

kjv_text: And he said unto them, The sabbath was made for man, and not man for the sabbath:
bsb_text: Then Jesus declared, “The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.
aov_text: En Hy sê vir hulle: Die sabbat is gemaak vir die mens, nie die mens vir die sabbat nie.

kjv_text: Therefore the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.
bsb_text: Therefore, the Son of Man is Lord even of the Sabbath.”
aov_text: Daarom is die Seun van die mens Here ook van die sabbat.

kjv_text: And he entered again into the synagogue; and there was a man there which had a withered hand.
bsb_text: Once again Jesus entered the synagogue, and a man with a withered hand was there.
aov_text: EN Hy het weer in die sinagoge gegaan, en dáár was ’n man met ’n verdorde hand.

kjv_text: And they watched him, whether he would heal him on the sabbath day; that they might accuse him.
bsb_text: In order to accuse Jesus, they were watching to see if He would heal on the Sabbath.
aov_text: En hulle het Hom in die oog gehou, of Hy hom op die sabbat gesond sou maak, sodat hulle Hom kon aanklae.

kjv_text: And he saith unto the man which had the withered hand, Stand forth.
bsb_text: Then Jesus said to the man with the withered hand, “Stand up among us.”
aov_text: En Hy sê vir die man met die verdorde hand: Staan op in hul midde.

kjv_text: And he saith unto them, Is it lawful to do good on the sabbath days, or to do evil? to save life, or to kill? But they held their peace.
bsb_text: And He asked them, “Which is lawful on the Sabbath: to do good or to do evil, to save life or to destroy it?” But they were silent.
aov_text: Daarop sê Hy vir hulle: Is dit geoorloof om op die sabbat goed of kwaad te doen, ’n lewe te red of dood te maak? Maar hulle het stilgebly.

kjv_text: And when he had looked round about on them with anger, being grieved for the hardness of their hearts, he saith unto the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it out: and his hand was restored whole as the other.
bsb_text: Jesus looked around at them with anger and sorrow at their hardness of heart. Then He said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” So he stretched it out, and it was restored.
aov_text: En nadat Hy hulle rondom met toorn aangekyk het en tegelykertyd bedroef was oor die hardheid van hulle hart, sê Hy vir die man: Steek jou hand uit! En hy het dit uitgesteek, en sy hand is herstel, gesond soos die ander een.

kjv_text: And the Pharisees went forth, and straightway took counsel with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.
bsb_text: At this, the Pharisees went out and began plotting with the Herodians how they might kill Jesus.
aov_text: Toe gaan die Fariseërs uit en hou dadelik raad met die Herodiane teen Hom, sodat hulle Hom sou kan ombring.

kjv_text: But Jesus withdrew himself with his disciples to the sea: and a great multitude from Galilee followed him, and from Judaea,
bsb_text: So Jesus withdrew with His disciples to the sea, accompanied by a large crowd from Galilee, Judea,
aov_text: En Jesus het met sy dissipels teruggegaan na die see toe, en ’n groot menigte het Hom gevolg uit Galiléa en Judéa

kjv_text: And from Jerusalem, and from Idumaea, and from beyond Jordan; and they about Tyre and Sidon, a great multitude, when they had heard what great things he did, came unto him.
bsb_text: Jerusalem, Idumea, the region beyond the Jordan, and the vicinity of Tyre and Sidon. The large crowd came to Him when they heard what great things He was doing.
aov_text: en Jerusalem en Iduméa en van oorkant die Jordaan af. En die wat om Tirus en Sidon gewoon het, ’n groot menigte, het na Hom gekom toe hulle hoor wat Hy alles doen.

kjv_text: And he spake to his disciples, that a small ship should wait on him because of the multitude, lest they should throng him.
bsb_text: Jesus asked His disciples to have a boat ready for Him so that the crowd would not crush Him.
aov_text: En Hy het aan sy dissipels gesê dat ’n skuitjie altyd vir Hom moes klaar lê vanweë die skare, sodat hulle Hom nie miskien sou verdring nie.

kjv_text: For he had healed many; insomuch that they pressed upon him for to touch him, as many as had plagues.
bsb_text: For He had healed so many that all who had diseases were pressing forward to touch Him.
aov_text: Want Hy het baie gesond gemaak, sodat almal wat vol kwale was, op Hom toegeloop het om Hom aan te raak.

kjv_text: And unclean spirits, when they saw him, fell down before him, and cried, saying, Thou art the Son of God.
bsb_text: And when the unclean spirits saw Him, they fell down before Him and cried out, “You are the Son of God!”
aov_text: En elke keer as die onreine geeste Hom sien, het hulle voor Hom neergeval en geskreeu en gesê: U is die Seun van God!

kjv_text: And he straitly charged them that they should not make him known.
bsb_text: But He warned them sternly not to make Him known.
aov_text: En Hy het hulle herhaaldelik streng gebied om Hom nie bekend te maak nie.

kjv_text: And he goeth up into a mountain, and calleth unto him whom he would: and they came unto him.
bsb_text: Then Jesus went up on the mountain and called for those He wanted, and they came to Him.
aov_text: EN Hy het op die berg geklim en na Hom geroep die wat Hy wou hê, en hulle het na Hom gekom.

kjv_text: And he ordained twelve, that they should be with him, and that he might send them forth to preach,
bsb_text: He appointed twelve of them, whom He designated as apostles, to accompany Him, to be sent out to preach,
aov_text: En Hy het twaalf aangestel, sodat hulle saam met Hom kon wees en Hy hulle kon uitstuur om te preek

kjv_text: And to have power to heal sicknesses, and to cast out devils:
bsb_text: and to have authority to drive out demons.
aov_text: en mag te hê om siektes te genees en die duiwels uit te dryf.

kjv_text: And Simon he surnamed Peter;
bsb_text: These are the twelve He appointed: Simon (whom He named Peter),
aov_text: En aan Simon het Hy die bynaam Petrus gegee;

kjv_text: And James the son of Zebedee, and John the brother of James; and he surnamed them Boanerges, which is, The sons of thunder:
bsb_text: James son of Zebedee and his brother John (whom He named Boanerges, meaning “Sons of Thunder”),
aov_text: en verder Jakobus, die seun van Sebedéüs, en Johannes, die broer van Jakobus — aan hulle het Hy die bynaam Boanérges gegee, dit is, seuns van die donder  —

kjv_text: And Andrew, and Philip, and Bartholomew, and Matthew, and Thomas, and James the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus, and Simon the Canaanite,
bsb_text: Andrew, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, James son of Alphaeus, Thaddaeus, Simon the Zealot,
aov_text: en Andréas en Filippus, en Bartholoméüs en Matthéüs, en Thomas en Jakobus, die seun van Alféus, en Thaddéüs en Simon Kananítes,

kjv_text: And Judas Iscariot, which also betrayed him: and they went into an house.
bsb_text: and Judas Iscariot, who betrayed Jesus.
aov_text: en Judas Iskáriot, hy wat Hom verraai het.

kjv_text: And the multitude cometh together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.
bsb_text: Then Jesus went home, and once again a crowd gathered, so that He and His disciples could not even eat.
aov_text: EN hulle het in ’n huis gegaan, en ’n skare het weer saamgekom, sodat hulle selfs nie brood kon eet nie.

kjv_text: And when his friends heard of it, they went out to lay hold on him: for they said, He is beside himself.
bsb_text: When His family heard about this, they went out to take custody of Him, saying, “He is out of His mind.”
aov_text: Toe sy mense dit hoor, gaan hulle uit om Hom in die hande te kry; want hulle het gesê: Hy is buite sy sinne.

kjv_text: And the scribes which came down from Jerusalem said, He hath Beelzebub, and by the prince of the devils casteth he out devils.
bsb_text: And the scribes who had come down from Jerusalem were saying, “He is possessed by Beelzebul,” and, “By the prince of the demons He drives out demons.”
aov_text: En die skrifgeleerdes wat van Jerusalem af gekom het, het gesê: Hy het Beëlsebul! en: Deur die owerste van die duiwels dryf Hy die duiwels uit.

kjv_text: And he called them unto him, and said unto them in parables, How can Satan cast out Satan?
bsb_text: So Jesus called them together and began to speak to them in parables: “How can Satan drive out Satan?
aov_text: En Hy het hulle na Hom geroep en vir hulle deur gelykenisse gesê: Hoe kan die Satan die Satan uitdryf?

kjv_text: And if a kingdom be divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.
bsb_text: If a kingdom is divided against itself, it cannot stand.
aov_text: En as ’n koninkryk teen homself verdeeld is, kan daardie koninkryk nie bly staan nie;

kjv_text: And if a house be divided against itself, that house cannot stand.
bsb_text: If a house is divided against itself, it cannot stand.
aov_text: en as ’n huis teen homself verdeeld is, kan daardie huis nie bly staan nie;

kjv_text: And if Satan rise up against himself, and be divided, he cannot stand, but hath an end.
bsb_text: And if Satan is divided and rises against himself, he cannot stand; his end has come.
aov_text: en as die Satan teen homself opstaan en verdeeld is, kan hy nie bly staan nie, maar hy kom tot ’n einde.

kjv_text: No man can enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man; and then he will spoil his house.
bsb_text: Indeed, no one can enter a strong man’s house to steal his possessions unless he first ties up the strong man. Then he can plunder his house.
aov_text: Niemand kan in die huis van ’n sterk man ingaan en sy goed roof as hy nie eers die sterk man boei nie; en dan sal hy sy huis berowe.

kjv_text: Verily I say unto you, All sins shall be forgiven unto the sons of men, and blasphemies wherewith soever they shall blaspheme:
bsb_text: Truly I tell you, the sons of men will be forgiven all sins and blasphemies, as many as they utter.
aov_text: Voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, al die sondes sal die mensekinders vergewe word en al die lasteringe wat hulle mag uitgespreek het;

kjv_text: But he that shall blaspheme against the Holy Ghost hath never forgiveness, but is in danger of eternal damnation:
bsb_text: But whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will never be forgiven; he is guilty of eternal sin.”
aov_text: maar wie teen die Heilige Gees gelaster het, het geen vergifnis tot in ewigheid nie, maar is skuldig aan die ewige oordeel  —

kjv_text: Because they said, He hath an unclean spirit.
bsb_text: Jesus made this statement because they were saying, “He has an unclean spirit.”
aov_text: omdat hulle gesê het: Hy het ’n onreine gees.

kjv_text: There came then his brethren and his mother, and, standing without, sent unto him, calling him.
bsb_text: Then Jesus’ mother and brothers came and stood outside. They sent someone in to summon Him,
aov_text: SY broers en sy moeder het toe gekom, en terwyl hulle buite staan, stuur hulle na Hom om Hom te roep.

kjv_text: And the multitude sat about him, and they said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren without seek for thee.
bsb_text: and a crowd was sitting around Him. “Look,” He was told, “Your mother and brothers are outside, asking for You.”
aov_text: En ’n skare het rondom Hom gesit. Hulle sê toe vir Hom: U moeder en u broers soek U daarbuite.

kjv_text: And he answered them, saying, Who is my mother, or my brethren?
bsb_text: But Jesus replied, “Who are My mother and My brothers?”
aov_text: En Hy antwoord hulle en sê: Wie is my moeder of my broers?

kjv_text: And he looked round about on them which sat about him, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!
bsb_text: Looking at those seated in a circle around Him, He said, “Here are My mother and My brothers!
aov_text: En Hy kyk rond na die wat rondom Hom sit, en sê: Dáár is my moeder en my broers!

kjv_text: For whosoever shall do the will of God, the same is my brother, and my sister, and mother.
bsb_text: For whoever does the will of God is My brother and sister and mother.”
aov_text: Want elkeen wat die wil van God doen, dié is my broer en my suster en moeder.

kjv_text: And he began again to teach by the sea side: and there was gathered unto him a great multitude, so that he entered into a ship, and sat in the sea; and the whole multitude was by the sea on the land.
bsb_text: Once again Jesus began to teach beside the sea, and such a large crowd gathered around Him that He got into a boat and sat in it, while all the people crowded along the shore.
aov_text: EN Hy het nog ’n maal by die see begin leer; en ’n groot menigte het by Hom saamgekom, sodat Hy in die skuit geklim en op die see gaan sit het, en die hele skare was op die land by die see.

kjv_text: And he taught them many things by parables, and said unto them in his doctrine,
bsb_text: And He taught them many things in parables, and in His teaching He said,
aov_text: En Hy het hulle baie dinge geleer deur gelykenisse en vir hulle in sy lering gesê:

kjv_text: Hearken; Behold, there went out a sower to sow:
bsb_text: “Listen! A farmer went out to sow his seed.
aov_text: Luister! ’n Saaier het uitgegaan om te saai.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, as he sowed, some fell by the way side, and the fowls of the air came and devoured it up.
bsb_text: And as he was sowing, some seed fell along the path, and the birds came and devoured it.
aov_text: En terwyl hy saai, het ’n deel langs die pad geval, en die voëls van die hemel het gekom en dit opgeëet.

kjv_text: And some fell on stony ground, where it had not much earth; and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of earth:
bsb_text: Some fell on rocky ground, where it did not have much soil. It sprang up quickly because the soil was shallow.
aov_text: En ’n ander deel het op ’n rotsagtige plek geval waar dit nie baie grond gehad het nie; en dadelik het dit opgekom, omdat dit geen diepte van grond gehad het nie.

kjv_text: But when the sun was up, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.
bsb_text: But when the sun rose, the seedlings were scorched, and they withered because they had no root.
aov_text: En toe die son opgaan, is dit verskroei; en omdat dit geen wortel gehad het nie, het dit verdroog.

kjv_text: And some fell among thorns, and the thorns grew up, and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.
bsb_text: Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up and choked the seedlings, and they yielded no crop.
aov_text: En ’n ander deel het in die dorings geval, en die dorings het opgekom en dit verstik; en dit het geen vrug opgelewer nie.

kjv_text: And other fell on good ground, and did yield fruit that sprang up and increased; and brought forth, some thirty, and some sixty, and some an hundred.
bsb_text: Still other seed fell on good soil, where it sprouted, grew up, and produced a crop—one bearing thirtyfold, another sixtyfold, and another a hundredfold.”
aov_text: En ’n ander deel het in die goeie grond geval, en dit het vrug opgelewer; want dit het opgekom en gegroei, en dit het gedra: een dertig- en een sestig- en een honderdvoudig.

kjv_text: And he said unto them, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
bsb_text: Then Jesus said, “He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”
aov_text: En Hy sê vir hulle: Wie ore het om te hoor, laat hom hoor.
