kjv_text: And when he was alone, they that were about him with the twelve asked of him the parable.
bsb_text: As soon as Jesus was alone with the Twelve and those around Him, they asked Him about the parable.
aov_text: En toe Hy alleen was, het die wat saam met die twaalf rondom Hom was, Hom na die gelykenis gevra.

kjv_text: And he said unto them, Unto you it is given to know the mystery of the kingdom of God: but unto them that are without, all these things are done in parables:
bsb_text: He replied, “The mystery of the kingdom of God has been given to you, but to those on the outside everything is expressed in parables,
aov_text: En Hy sê vir hulle: Aan julle is dit gegee om die verborgenheid van die koninkryk van God te ken, maar vir hulle wat buite is, kom alles deur gelykenisse,

kjv_text: That seeing they may see, and not perceive; and hearing they may hear, and not understand; lest at any time they should be converted, and their sins should be forgiven them.
bsb_text: so that, ‘they may be ever seeing but never perceiving, and ever hearing but never understanding; otherwise they might turn and be forgiven.’”
aov_text: sodat hulle kan kyk en kyk, en nie sien nie; en hoor en hoor, en nie verstaan nie, dat hulle hul nie miskien bekeer en die sondes hulle vergewe word nie.

kjv_text: And he said unto them, Know ye not this parable? and how then will ye know all parables?
bsb_text: Then Jesus said to them, “Do you not understand this parable? Then how will you understand any of the parables?
aov_text: En Hy sê vir hulle: Begryp julle nie hierdie gelykenis nie? En hoe sal julle al die gelykenisse verstaan?

kjv_text: The sower soweth the word.
bsb_text: The farmer sows the word.
aov_text: Die saaier saai die woord.

kjv_text: And these are they by the way side, where the word is sown; but when they have heard, Satan cometh immediately, and taketh away the word that was sown in their hearts.
bsb_text: Some are like the seeds along the path, where the word is sown. As soon as they hear it, Satan comes and takes away the word that was sown in them.
aov_text: En dit is hulle wat langs die pad is — waar die woord gesaai word, maar sodra hulle dit gehoor het, kom die Satan dadelik en neem die woord weg wat in hulle harte gesaai is.

kjv_text: And these are they likewise which are sown on stony ground; who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with gladness;
bsb_text: Some are like the seeds sown on rocky ground. They hear the word and at once receive it with joy.
aov_text: Net so ook is hulle by wie op rotsagtige plekke gesaai word — wat, as hulle die woord hoor, dit dadelik met blydskap aanneem,

kjv_text: And have no root in themselves, and so endure but for a time: afterward, when affliction or persecution ariseth for the word's sake, immediately they are offended.
bsb_text: But they themselves have no root, and they remain for only a season. When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, they quickly fall away.
aov_text: maar geen wortel in hulleself het nie; hulle is net vir ’n tyd. Later as daar verdrukking of vervolging kom ter wille van die woord, struikel hulle dadelik.

kjv_text: And these are they which are sown among thorns; such as hear the word,
bsb_text: Others are like the seeds sown among the thorns. They hear the word,
aov_text: En hulle by wie in die dorings gesaai word — dit is hulle wat die woord hoor,

kjv_text: And the cares of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in, choke the word, and it becometh unfruitful.
bsb_text: but the worries of this life, the deceitfulness of wealth, and the desire for other things come in and choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.
aov_text: en die sorge van hierdie wêreld en die verleiding van die rykdom en die begeerlikhede in verband met die ander dinge kom in en verstik die woord, en dit word onvrugbaar.

kjv_text: And these are they which are sown on good ground; such as hear the word, and receive it, and bring forth fruit, some thirtyfold, some sixty, and some an hundred.
bsb_text: Still others are like the seeds sown on good soil. They hear the word, receive it, and produce a crop—thirtyfold, sixtyfold, or a hundredfold.”
aov_text: En dit is hulle by wie in die goeie grond gesaai is — hulle wat die woord hoor en aanneem en vrugte dra: een dertig- en een sestig- en een honderdvoudig.

kjv_text: And he said unto them, Is a candle brought to be put under a bushel, or under a bed? and not to be set on a candlestick?
bsb_text: Jesus also said to them, “Does anyone bring in a lamp to put it under a basket or under a bed? Doesn’t he set it on a stand?
aov_text: EN Hy het vir hulle gesê: Die lamp kom tog nie om onder die maatemmer of onder die bed gesit te word nie. Is dit nie om op die staander gesit te word nie?

kjv_text: For there is nothing hid, which shall not be manifested; neither was any thing kept secret, but that it should come abroad.
bsb_text: For there is nothing hidden that will not be disclosed, and nothing concealed that will not be brought to light.
aov_text: Want daar is niks verborge wat nie openbaar sal word nie, en daar is niks weggesteek nie of dit moet in die lig kom.

kjv_text: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.
bsb_text: If anyone has ears to hear, let him hear.”
aov_text: As iemand ore het om te hoor, laat hom hoor.

kjv_text: And he said unto them, Take heed what ye hear: with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you: and unto you that hear shall more be given.
bsb_text: He went on to say, “Pay attention to what you hear. With the measure you use, it will be measured to you, and even more will be added to you.
aov_text: En Hy het vir hulle gesê: Pas op wat julle hoor; met die maat waarmee julle meet, sal vir julle gemeet word, en daar sal bygevoeg word vir julle wat hoor.

kjv_text: For he that hath, to him shall be given: and he that hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he hath.
bsb_text: For whoever has will be given more. But whoever does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.”
aov_text: Want wie het, vir hom sal gegee word; en wie nie het nie, van hom sal weggeneem word ook wat hy het.

kjv_text: And he said, So is the kingdom of God, as if a man should cast seed into the ground;
bsb_text: Jesus also said, “The kingdom of God is like a man who scatters seed on the ground.
aov_text: EN Hy het gesê: So is die koninkryk van God, soos wanneer ’n mens die saad in die grond gooi;

kjv_text: And should sleep, and rise night and day, and the seed should spring and grow up, he knoweth not how.
bsb_text: Night and day he sleeps and wakes, and the seed sprouts and grows, though he knows not how.
aov_text: en hy gaan slaap en staan op, nag en dag, en die saad spruit uit en word groot — hoe, weet hy self nie.

kjv_text: For the earth bringeth forth fruit of herself; first the blade, then the ear, after that the full corn in the ear.
bsb_text: All by itself the earth produces a crop—first the stalk, then the head, then grain that ripens within.
aov_text: Want vanself bring die aarde vrug voort, eers ’n halm, dan ’n aar, dan die volle koring in die aar.

kjv_text: But when the fruit is brought forth, immediately he putteth in the sickle, because the harvest is come.
bsb_text: And as soon as the grain is ripe, he swings the sickle, because the harvest has come.”
aov_text: En wanneer die vrug dit toelaat, steek hy die sekel dadelik in, omdat die oes daar is.

kjv_text: And he said, Whereunto shall we liken the kingdom of God? or with what comparison shall we compare it?
bsb_text: Then He asked, “To what can we compare the kingdom of God? With what parable shall we present it?
aov_text: EN Hy het gesê: Waarmee moet ons die koninkryk van God vergelyk, of met watter soort gelykenis moet ons dit voorstel?

kjv_text: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, is less than all the seeds that be in the earth:
bsb_text: It is like a mustard seed, which is the smallest of all seeds sown upon the earth.
aov_text: Dit is soos ’n mosterdsaad, wat die kleinste is van al die soorte saad op die aarde wanneer dit in die grond gesaai is;

kjv_text: But when it is sown, it groweth up, and becometh greater than all herbs, and shooteth out great branches; so that the fowls of the air may lodge under the shadow of it.
bsb_text: But after it is planted, it grows to be the largest of all garden plants and puts forth great branches, so that the birds of the air nest in its shade.”
aov_text: en wanneer dit gesaai is, kom dit op en word groter as al die groentesoorte en maak groot takke, sodat die voëls van die hemel onder sy skaduwee nes kan maak.

kjv_text: And with many such parables spake he the word unto them, as they were able to hear it.
bsb_text: With many such parables Jesus spoke the word to them, to the extent that they could understand.
aov_text: En met baie sulke gelykenisse het Hy die woord tot hulle gespreek volgens wat hulle kon verstaan;

kjv_text: But without a parable spake he not unto them: and when they were alone, he expounded all things to his disciples.
bsb_text: He did not tell them anything without using a parable. But privately He explained everything to His own disciples.
aov_text: en sonder gelykenis het Hy tot hulle nie gespreek nie; maar afsonderlik het Hy vir sy dissipels alles uitgelê.

kjv_text: And the same day, when the even was come, he saith unto them, Let us pass over unto the other side.
bsb_text: When that evening came, He said to His disciples, “Let us cross to the other side.”
aov_text: EN toe dit aand geword het op daardie dag, het Hy vir hulle gesê: Laat ons oorvaar na die ander kant.

kjv_text: And when they had sent away the multitude, they took him even as he was in the ship. And there were also with him other little ships.
bsb_text: After they had dismissed the crowd, they took Jesus with them, since He was already in the boat. And there were other boats with Him.
aov_text: En hulle het die skare verlaat en Hom, net soos Hy was, saamgeneem in die skuit; en daar was ook ander skuitjies by Hom.

kjv_text: And there arose a great storm of wind, and the waves beat into the ship, so that it was now full.
bsb_text: Soon a violent windstorm came up, and the waves were breaking over the boat, so that it was being swamped.
aov_text: En ’n groot stormwind het opgekom, en die golwe het in die skuit geslaan, sodat dit al vol wou word.

kjv_text: And he was in the hinder part of the ship, asleep on a pillow: and they awake him, and say unto him, Master, carest thou not that we perish?
bsb_text: But Jesus was in the stern, sleeping on the cushion. So they woke Him and said, “Teacher, don’t You care that we are perishing?”
aov_text: Maar Hy was agter op die skuit aan die slaap op die kussing. En hulle het Hom wakker gemaak en vir Hom gesê: Meester, gee U nie om dat ons vergaan nie?

kjv_text: And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
bsb_text: Then Jesus got up and rebuked the wind and the sea. “Silence!” He commanded. “Be still!” And the wind died down, and it was perfectly calm.
aov_text: En Hy het opgestaan en die wind bestraf en vir die see gesê: Swyg, wees stil! En die wind het gaan lê, en daar het ’n groot stilte gekom.

kjv_text: And he said unto them, Why are ye so fearful? how is it that ye have no faith?
bsb_text: “Why are you so afraid?” He asked. “Do you still have no faith?”
aov_text: Toe sê Hy vir hulle: Waarom is julle so bang? Hoe het julle dan geen geloof nie?

kjv_text: And they feared exceedingly, and said one to another, What manner of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?
bsb_text: Overwhelmed with fear, they asked one another, “Who is this, that even the wind and the sea obey Him?”
aov_text: En ’n groot vrees het hulle oorweldig, en hulle het vir mekaar gesê: Wie is Hy tog, dat selfs die wind en die see Hom gehoorsaam is!

kjv_text: And they came over unto the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.
bsb_text: On the other side of the sea, they arrived in the region of the Gerasenes.
aov_text: EN hulle het aan die oorkant van die see gekom in die land van die Gadaréners.

kjv_text: And when he was come out of the ship, immediately there met him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit,
bsb_text: As soon as Jesus got out of the boat, He was met by a man with an unclean spirit, who was coming from the tombs.
aov_text: En toe Hy uit die skuit gaan, kom daar dadelik uit die grafte Hom tegemoet ’n man met ’n onreine gees,

kjv_text: Who had his dwelling among the tombs; and no man could bind him, no, not with chains:
bsb_text: This man had been living in the tombs and could no longer be restrained, even with chains.
aov_text: wat sy verblyf in die grafte gehad het. En niemand kon selfs met kettings hom bind nie;

kjv_text: Because that he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been plucked asunder by him, and the fetters broken in pieces: neither could any man tame him.
bsb_text: Though he was often bound with chains and shackles, he had broken the chains and shattered the shackles. Now there was no one with the strength to subdue him.
aov_text: want hy was dikwels met voetboeie en kettings gebind, en die kettings is deur hom uitmekaar geruk en die voetboeie stukkend gebreek; en niemand was in staat om hom te tem nie.

kjv_text: And always, night and day, he was in the mountains, and in the tombs, crying, and cutting himself with stones.
bsb_text: Night and day in the tombs and in the mountains he kept crying out and cutting himself with stones.
aov_text: En altyd, nag en dag, het hy aangehou om te skreeu op die berge en in die grafte en homself met klippe stukkend te slaan.

kjv_text: But when he saw Jesus afar off, he ran and worshipped him,
bsb_text: When the man saw Jesus from a distance, he ran and fell on his knees before Him.
aov_text: En toe hy Jesus van ver af sien, hardloop hy en val voor Hom neer

kjv_text: And cried with a loud voice, and said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of the most high God? I adjure thee by God, that thou torment me not.
bsb_text: And he shouted in a loud voice, “What do You want with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I beg You before God not to torture me!”
aov_text: en skreeu met ’n groot stem en sê: Wat het ek met U te doen, Jesus, Seun van die allerhoogste God? Ek besweer U by God om my nie te pynig nie.

kjv_text: For he said unto him, Come out of the man, thou unclean spirit.
bsb_text: For Jesus had already declared, “Come out of this man, you unclean spirit!”
aov_text: Want Hy het vir hom gesê: Onreine gees, gaan uit die man uit!

kjv_text: And he asked him, What is thy name? And he answered, saying, My name is Legion: for we are many.
bsb_text: “What is your name?” Jesus asked. “My name is Legion,” he replied, “for we are many.”
aov_text: En Hy vra hom: Wat is jou naam? En hy antwoord en sê: Legio is my naam, want ons is baie.

kjv_text: And he besought him much that he would not send them away out of the country.
bsb_text: And he begged Jesus repeatedly not to send them out of that region.
aov_text: Toe smeek hy Hom dringend om hulle nie uit die land weg te stuur nie.

kjv_text: Now there was there nigh unto the mountains a great herd of swine feeding.
bsb_text: There on the nearby hillside a large herd of pigs was feeding.
aov_text: En dáár teen die berge het ’n groot trop varke gewei,

kjv_text: And all the devils besought him, saying, Send us into the swine, that we may enter into them.
bsb_text: So the demons begged Jesus, “Send us to the pigs, so that we may enter them.”
aov_text: en al die duiwels het Hom gesmeek en gesê: Stuur ons in die varke, sodat ons in hulle kan vaar.

kjv_text: And forthwith Jesus gave them leave. And the unclean spirits went out, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the sea, (they were about two thousand;) and were choked in the sea.
bsb_text: He gave them permission, and the unclean spirits came out and went into the pigs, and the herd of about two thousand rushed down the steep bank into the sea and drowned in the water.
aov_text: En Jesus het hulle dit dadelik toegelaat; en die onreine geeste het uitgegaan en in die varke gevaar, en die trop — daar was omtrent tweeduisend — het van die krans af in die see gestorm en in die see verdrink.

kjv_text: And they that fed the swine fled, and told it in the city, and in the country. And they went out to see what it was that was done.
bsb_text: Those tending the pigs ran off and reported this in the town and countryside, and the people went out to see what had happened.
aov_text: En die wagters van die varke het gevlug en dit in die stad en in die buitewyke vertel; en hulle het uitgekom om te sien wat daar gebeur het.

kjv_text: And they come to Jesus, and see him that was possessed with the devil, and had the legion, sitting, and clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.
bsb_text: When they came to Jesus, they saw the man who had been possessed by the legion of demons sitting there, clothed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.
aov_text: Toe kom hulle by Jesus en sien die besetene sit, gekleed en by sy verstand — die een wat die legioen gehad het. En hulle was bevrees.

kjv_text: And they that saw it told them how it befell to him that was possessed with the devil, and also concerning the swine.
bsb_text: Those who had seen it described what had happened to the demon-possessed man and also to the pigs.
aov_text: Die wat dit gesien het, vertel toe aan hulle hoe dit met die besetene gegaan het, en ook van die varke.

kjv_text: And they began to pray him to depart out of their coasts.
bsb_text: And the people began to beg Jesus to leave their region.
aov_text: En hulle het Hom begin smeek om weg te gaan uit hulle gebied.

kjv_text: And when he was come into the ship, he that had been possessed with the devil prayed him that he might be with him.
bsb_text: As He was getting into the boat, the man who had been possessed by the demons begged to go with Him.
aov_text: En toe Hy in die skuit klim, het die man wat van die duiwels besete gewees het, Hom gesmeek om by Hom te kan bly.

kjv_text: Howbeit Jesus suffered him not, but saith unto him, Go home to thy friends, and tell them how great things the Lord hath done for thee, and hath had compassion on thee.
bsb_text: But Jesus would not allow him. “Go home to your own people,” He said, “and tell them how much the Lord has done for you, and what mercy He has shown you.”
aov_text: Maar Jesus het hom dit nie toegelaat nie, maar vir hom gesê: Gaan na jou huis na jou mense toe, en vertel hulle watter groot dinge die Here aan jou gedoen het, en dat Hy jou barmhartig was.

kjv_text: And he departed, and began to publish in Decapolis how great things Jesus had done for him: and all men did marvel.
bsb_text: So the man went away and began to proclaim throughout the Decapolis how much Jesus had done for him. And everyone was amazed.
aov_text: En hy het weggegaan en in Dekápolis begin verkondig watter groot dinge Jesus aan hom gedoen het, en almal was verwonderd.

kjv_text: And when Jesus was passed over again by ship unto the other side, much people gathered unto him: and he was nigh unto the sea.
bsb_text: When Jesus had again crossed by boat to the other side, a large crowd gathered around Him beside the sea.
aov_text: EN toe Jesus weer in die skuit oorgevaar het na die ander kant, het ’n groot menigte by Hom vergader. En Hy was by die see.

kjv_text: And, behold, there cometh one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name; and when he saw him, he fell at his feet,
bsb_text: A synagogue leader named Jairus arrived, and seeing Jesus, he fell at His feet
aov_text: En daar kom een van die owerstes van die sinagoge met die naam van Jaïrus; en toe hy Hom sien, val hy aan sy voete neer

kjv_text: And besought him greatly, saying, My little daughter lieth at the point of death: I pray thee, come and lay thy hands on her, that she may be healed; and she shall live.
bsb_text: and pleaded with Him urgently, “My little daughter is near death. Please come and place Your hands on her, so that she will be healed and live.”
aov_text: en smeek Hom dringend en sê: My dogtertjie is op haar uiterste; kom lê haar die hande op, sodat sy gesond kan word, en sy sal lewe.

kjv_text: And Jesus went with him; and much people followed him, and thronged him.
bsb_text: So Jesus went with him, and a large crowd followed and pressed around Him.
aov_text: En Hy het saam met hom gegaan. En ’n groot menigte het Hom gevolg en Hom verdring.

kjv_text: And a certain woman, which had an issue of blood twelve years,
bsb_text: And a woman was there who had suffered from bleeding for twelve years.
aov_text: En ’n sekere vrou wat twaalf jaar lank bloedvloeiing gehad het

kjv_text: And had suffered many things of many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was nothing bettered, but rather grew worse,
bsb_text: She had borne much agony under the care of many physicians and had spent all she had, but to no avail. Instead, her condition had only grown worse.
aov_text: en veel onder baie geneeshere gely en al haar besittings uitgegee het sonder om enige baat te vind, maar eerder erger geword het,

kjv_text: When she had heard of Jesus, came in the press behind, and touched his garment.
bsb_text: When the woman heard about Jesus, she came up through the crowd behind Him and touched His cloak.
aov_text: het van Jesus gehoor en onder die skare van agter gekom en sy kleed aangeraak;

kjv_text: For she said, If I may touch but his clothes, I shall be whole.
bsb_text: For she kept saying, “If only I touch His garments, I will be healed.”
aov_text: want sy het gesê: As ek maar sy klere kan aanraak, sal ek gesond word.

kjv_text: And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up; and she felt in her body that she was healed of that plague.
bsb_text: Immediately her bleeding stopped, and she sensed in her body that she was healed of her affliction.
aov_text: En dadelik het die fontein van haar bloed opgedroog, en sy het aan haar liggaam bemerk dat sy van haar kwaal genees was.

kjv_text: And Jesus, immediately knowing in himself that virtue had gone out of him, turned him about in the press, and said, Who touched my clothes?
bsb_text: At once Jesus was aware that power had gone out from Him. Turning to the crowd, He asked, “Who touched My garments?”
aov_text: En dadelik toe Jesus in Homself die krag gewaarword wat van Hom uitgegaan het, draai Hy Hom om onder die skare en sê: Wie het my klere aangeraak?

kjv_text: And his disciples said unto him, Thou seest the multitude thronging thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?
bsb_text: His disciples answered, “You can see the crowd pressing in on You, and yet You ask, ‘Who touched Me?’”
aov_text: En sy dissipels antwoord Hom: U sien dat die skare U verdring, en U sê: Wie het My aangeraak?

kjv_text: And he looked round about to see her that had done this thing.
bsb_text: But He kept looking around to see who had done this.
aov_text: Toe kyk Hy rond om haar te sien wat dit gedoen het.

kjv_text: But the woman fearing and trembling, knowing what was done in her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.
bsb_text: Then the woman, knowing what had happened to her, came and fell down before Him trembling in fear, and she told Him the whole truth.
aov_text: Die vrou, wat gevrees en gebeef het omdat sy wis wat met haar gebeur het, kom toe en val voor Hom neer en vertel Hom die hele waarheid.

kjv_text: And he said unto her, Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace, and be whole of thy plague.
bsb_text: “Daughter,” said Jesus, “your faith has healed you. Go in peace and be free of your affliction.”
aov_text: En Hy sê vir haar: Dogter, jou geloof het jou gered. Gaan in vrede en wees van jou kwaal genees.

kjv_text: While he yet spake, there came from the ruler of the synagogue's house certain which said, Thy daughter is dead: why troublest thou the Master any further?
bsb_text: While He was still speaking, messengers from the house of Jairus arrived and said, “Your daughter is dead; why bother the Teacher anymore?”
aov_text: Terwyl Hy nog spreek, kom daar mense van die owerste van die sinagoge se huis en sê: U dogter is dood. Waarom val u die Meester nog lastig?

kjv_text: As soon as Jesus heard the word that was spoken, he saith unto the ruler of the synagogue, Be not afraid, only believe.
bsb_text: But Jesus overheard their conversation and said to Jairus, “Do not be afraid; just believe.”
aov_text: Maar dadelik, toe Jesus die woord hoor wat gespreek is, sê Hy vir die owerste van die sinagoge: Moenie vrees nie; glo net.

kjv_text: And he suffered no man to follow him, save Peter, and James, and John the brother of James.
bsb_text: And He did not allow anyone to accompany Him except Peter, James, and John the brother of James.
aov_text: En Hy het niemand toegelaat om saam met Hom te gaan nie, behalwe Petrus en Jakobus en Johannes, die broer van Jakobus.

kjv_text: And he cometh to the house of the ruler of the synagogue, and seeth the tumult, and them that wept and wailed greatly.
bsb_text: When they arrived at the house of the synagogue leader, Jesus saw the commotion and the people weeping and wailing loudly.
aov_text: En Hy kom in die huis van die owerste van die sinagoge en sien ’n rumoer: mense wat baie ween en huil.

kjv_text: And when he was come in, he saith unto them, Why make ye this ado, and weep? the damsel is not dead, but sleepeth.
bsb_text: He went inside and asked, “Why all this commotion and weeping? The child is not dead, but asleep.”
aov_text: En toe Hy binnegaan, sê Hy vir hulle: Waarom gaan julle so te kere en ween julle? Die kind is nie dood nie, maar slaap.

kjv_text: And they laughed him to scorn. But when he had put them all out, he taketh the father and the mother of the damsel, and them that were with him, and entereth in where the damsel was lying.
bsb_text: And they laughed at Him. After He had put them all outside, He took the child’s father and mother and His own companions, and went in to see the child.
aov_text: En hulle het Hom uitgelag. Maar Hy het almal uitgedryf en die vader van die kind saamgeneem en die moeder en die wat by Hom was, en ingegaan waar die kind lê.

kjv_text: And he took the damsel by the hand, and said unto her, Talitha cumi; which is, being interpreted, Damsel, I say unto thee, arise.
bsb_text: Taking her by the hand, Jesus said, “Talitha koum!” which means, “Little girl, I say to you, get up!”
aov_text: Toe gryp Hy die hand van die kind en sê vir haar: Talíta, koemi! wat, as dit vertaal word, beteken: Dogtertjie, Ek sê vir jou, staan op!

kjv_text: And straightway the damsel arose, and walked; for she was of the age of twelve years. And they were astonished with a great astonishment.
bsb_text: Immediately the girl got up and began to walk around. She was twelve years old, and at once they were utterly astounded.
aov_text: En die dogtertjie het dadelik opgestaan en begin rondloop, want sy was twaalf jaar oud. En hulle was uitermate verbaas.

kjv_text: And he charged them straitly that no man should know it; and commanded that something should be given her to eat.
bsb_text: Then Jesus gave strict orders that no one should know about this, and He told them to give her something to eat.
aov_text: En Hy het hulle met nadruk beveel dat niemand dit moes weet nie, en gesê dat daar vir haar iets te ete gegee moes word.

kjv_text: And he went out from thence, and came into his own country; and his disciples follow him.
bsb_text: Jesus went on from there and came to His hometown, accompanied by His disciples.
aov_text: EN Hy het daarvandaan weggegaan en in sy vaderstad gekom, en sy dissipels het Hom gevolg.

kjv_text: And when the sabbath day was come, he began to teach in the synagogue: and many hearing him were astonished, saying, From whence hath this man these things? and what wisdom is this which is given unto him, that even such mighty works are wrought by his hands?
bsb_text: When the Sabbath came, He began to teach in the synagogue, and many who heard Him were astonished. “Where did this man get these ideas?” they asked. “What is this wisdom He has been given? And how can He perform such miracles?
aov_text: En toe dit sabbat geword het, begin Hy in die sinagoge te leer, en baie wat Hom gehoor het, was verslae en sê: Waar kry Hy hierdie dinge vandaan, en watter wysheid is aan Hom gegee, dat ook sulke kragte deur sy hande plaasvind?

kjv_text: Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary, the brother of James, and Joses, and of Juda, and Simon? and are not his sisters here with us? And they were offended at him.
bsb_text: Isn’t this the carpenter, the son of Mary and the brother of James, Joses, Judas, and Simon? Aren’t His sisters here with us as well?” And they took offense at Him.
aov_text: Is Hy nie die timmerman, die seun van Maria, en die broer van Jakobus en Joses en Judas en Simon nie? En is sy susters nie hier by ons nie? En hulle het aanstoot aan Hom geneem.

kjv_text: But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, but in his own country, and among his own kin, and in his own house.
bsb_text: Then Jesus said to them, “Only in his hometown, among his relatives, and in his own household is a prophet without honor.”
aov_text: En Jesus sê vir hulle: ’n Profeet is nie ongeëerd nie, behalwe in sy vaderland en onder sy familie en in sy huis.

kjv_text: And he could there do no mighty work, save that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk, and healed them.
bsb_text: So He could not perform any miracles there, except to lay His hands on a few of the sick and heal them.
aov_text: En Hy kon daar geen krag doen nie, behalwe dat Hy ’n paar siekes die hande opgelê en hulle gesond gemaak het.

kjv_text: And he marvelled because of their unbelief. And he went round about the villages, teaching.
bsb_text: And He was amazed at their unbelief. And He went around from village to village, teaching the people.
aov_text: En Hy was verwonderd oor hulle ongeloof. Daarop het Hy die dorpe rondom deurgegaan en geleer.

kjv_text: And he called unto him the twelve, and began to send them forth by two and two; and gave them power over unclean spirits;
bsb_text: Then Jesus called the Twelve to Him and began to send them out two by two, giving them authority over unclean spirits.
aov_text: EN Hy het die twaalf na Hom geroep en hulle twee-twee begin uitstuur en het hulle mag gegee oor die onreine geeste,

kjv_text: And commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, save a staff only; no scrip, no bread, no money in their purse:
bsb_text: He instructed them to take nothing but a staff for the journey—no bread, no bag, no money in their belts—
aov_text: en hulle bevel gegee om niks vir die pad saam te neem nie as net ’n stok alleen — geen reissak, geen brood, geen geld in die beurs nie,

kjv_text: But be shod with sandals; and not put on two coats.
bsb_text: and to wear sandals, but not a second tunic.
aov_text: maar skoene aan die voete; en: Julle moet nie twee kledingstukke aantrek nie.

kjv_text: And he said unto them, In what place soever ye enter into an house, there abide till ye depart from that place.
bsb_text: And He told them, “When you enter a house, stay there until you leave that area.
aov_text: En Hy het vir hulle gesê: Waar julle ook al in ’n huis mag kom, bly dáár totdat julle daarvandaan vertrek.

kjv_text: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear you, when ye depart thence, shake off the dust under your feet for a testimony against them. Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.
bsb_text: If anyone will not welcome you or listen to you, shake the dust off your feet when you leave that place, as a testimony against them.”
aov_text: En almal wat julle nie ontvang of na julle luister nie, gaan daarvandaan weg en skud die stof onder julle voete af tot ’n getuienis teen hulle. Voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, dit sal vir Sodom of Gomorra verdraagliker wees in die oordeelsdag as vir daardie stad.

kjv_text: And they went out, and preached that men should repent.
bsb_text: So they set out and preached that the people should repent.
aov_text: En hulle het uitgegaan en gepreek dat die mense hulle moes bekeer.

kjv_text: And they cast out many devils, and anointed with oil many that were sick, and healed them.
bsb_text: They also drove out many demons and healed many of the sick, anointing them with oil.
aov_text: En hulle het baie duiwels uitgedryf en baie siekes met olie gesalf en gesond gemaak.

kjv_text: And king Herod heard of him; (for his name was spread abroad:) and he said, That John the Baptist was risen from the dead, and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.
bsb_text: Now King Herod heard about this, for Jesus’ name had become well known, and people were saying, “John the Baptist has risen from the dead! That is why miraculous powers are at work in him.”
aov_text: TOE koning Herodes dit hoor — want sy naam het bekend geword — het hy gesê: Johannes die Doper het uit die dode opgestaan, en daarom werk dié kragte in Hom.

kjv_text: Others said, That it is Elias. And others said, That it is a prophet, or as one of the prophets.
bsb_text: Others were saying, “He is Elijah,” and still others, “He is a prophet, like one of the prophets of old.”
aov_text: Ander het gesê: Hy is Elía, en ander weer het gesê: Hy is ’n profeet of soos een van die profete.

kjv_text: But when Herod heard thereof, he said, It is John, whom I beheaded: he is risen from the dead.
bsb_text: But when Herod heard this, he said, “John, whom I beheaded, has risen from the dead!”
aov_text: Maar toe Herodes dit hoor, sê hy: Johannes wat ek onthoof het, dit is hy; hy het uit die dode opgestaan.

kjv_text: For Herod himself had sent forth and laid hold upon John, and bound him in prison for Herodias' sake, his brother Philip's wife: for he had married her.
bsb_text: For Herod himself had ordered that John be arrested and bound and imprisoned, on account of his brother Philip’s wife Herodias, whom Herod had married.
aov_text: Want Herodes self het gestuur en Johannes gevange geneem en hom in die gevangenis geboei, vanweë Heródias, die vrou van Filippus, sy broer, omdat hy met haar getrou het.

kjv_text: For John had said unto Herod, It is not lawful for thee to have thy brother's wife.
bsb_text: For John had been telling Herod, “It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife!”
aov_text: Want Johannes het aan Herodes gesê: Dit is u nie geoorloof om u broer se vrou te hê nie.

kjv_text: Therefore Herodias had a quarrel against him, and would have killed him; but she could not:
bsb_text: So Herodias held a grudge against John and wanted to kill him. But she had been unable,
aov_text: En Heródias het ’n oog op hom gehad en wou hom om die lewe bring en sy kon nie.

kjv_text: For Herod feared John, knowing that he was a just man and an holy, and observed him; and when he heard him, he did many things, and heard him gladly.
bsb_text: because Herod feared John and protected him, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man. When he heard John’s words, he was greatly perplexed; yet he listened to him gladly.
aov_text: Want Herodes was bang vir Johannes, omdat hy wis dat hy ’n regverdige en heilige man was, en hy het hom beskerm; en nadat hy hom gehoor het, het hy baie dinge gedoen en graag na hom geluister.

kjv_text: And when a convenient day was come, that Herod on his birthday made a supper to his lords, high captains, and chief estates of Galilee;
bsb_text: On Herod’s birthday, her opportunity arose. Herod held a banquet for his nobles and military commanders and the leading men of Galilee.
aov_text: En op die geskikte dag, toe Herodes op sy verjaarsdag vir sy groot manne en die owerstes oor duisend en die vernaamstes van Galiléa ’n maaltyd gegee het;

kjv_text: And when the daughter of the said Herodias came in, and danced, and pleased Herod and them that sat with him, the king said unto the damsel, Ask of me whatsoever thou wilt, and I will give it thee.
bsb_text: When the daughter of Herodias came and danced, she pleased Herod and his guests, and the king said to the girl, “Ask me for whatever you wish, and I will give it to you.”
aov_text: en toe die dogter van dieselfde Heródias inkom en dans, en Herodes en die wat saam aan tafel was, behaag, sê die koning vir die meisie: Vra my net wat jy wil, en ek sal dit aan jou gee.

kjv_text: And he sware unto her, Whatsoever thou shalt ask of me, I will give it thee, unto the half of my kingdom.
bsb_text: And he swore to her, “Whatever you ask of me, I will give you, up to half my kingdom!”
aov_text: En hy het vir haar gesweer: Net wat jy my vra, sal ek jou gee, al was dit ook die helfte van my koninkryk.

kjv_text: And she went forth, and said unto her mother, What shall I ask? And she said, The head of John the Baptist.
bsb_text: Then she went out and asked her mother, “What should I request?” And her mother answered, “The head of John the Baptist.”
aov_text: Daarop gaan sy uit en sê vir haar moeder: Wat sal ek vra? Toe antwoord sy: Die hoof van Johannes die Doper.

kjv_text: And she came in straightway with haste unto the king, and asked, saying, I will that thou give me by and by in a charger the head of John the Baptist.
bsb_text: At once the girl hurried back to the king with her request: “I want you to give me the head of John the Baptist on a platter immediately.”
aov_text: En dadelik gaan sy haastig in na die koning en vra en sê: Ek wil hê dat u my op die daad die hoof van Johannes die Doper op ’n skottel gee.

kjv_text: And the king was exceeding sorry; yet for his oath's sake, and for their sakes which sat with him, he would not reject her.
bsb_text: The king was consumed with sorrow, but because of his oaths and his guests, he did not want to refuse her.
aov_text: Toe word die koning baie bedroef, maar ter wille van die eed en die wat saam aan tafel was, wou hy haar nie afwys nie.

kjv_text: And immediately the king sent an executioner, and commanded his head to be brought: and he went and beheaded him in the prison,
bsb_text: So without delay, the king commanded that John’s head be brought in. He sent an executioner, who went and beheaded him in the prison.
aov_text: En die koning stuur dadelik een van sy lyfwag met die bevel om sy hoof te bring; en hy het gegaan en hom in die gevangenis onthoof

kjv_text: And brought his head in a charger, and gave it to the damsel: and the damsel gave it to her mother.
bsb_text: The man brought John’s head on a platter and presented it to the girl, who gave it to her mother.
aov_text: en sy hoof op ’n skottel gebring en dit aan die meisie gegee, en die meisie het dit aan haar moeder gegee.

kjv_text: And when his disciples heard of it, they came and took up his corpse, and laid it in a tomb.
bsb_text: When John’s disciples heard about this, they came and took his body and placed it in a tomb.
aov_text: En toe sy dissipels dit hoor, het hulle gekom en sy lyk weggeneem en dit in ’n graf neergelê.

kjv_text: And the apostles gathered themselves together unto Jesus, and told him all things, both what they had done, and what they had taught.
bsb_text: Meanwhile, the apostles gathered around Jesus and brought Him news of all they had done and taught.
aov_text: EN die apostels het by Jesus saamgekom en Hom alles vertel wat hulle gedoen sowel as wat hulle geleer het.

kjv_text: And he said unto them, Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while: for there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
bsb_text: And He said to them, “Come with Me privately to a solitary place, and let us rest for a while.” For many people were coming and going, and they did not even have time to eat.
aov_text: En Hy sê vir hulle: Kom julle self in die eensaamheid na ’n verlate plek en rus ’n bietjie. Want daar was baie wat kom en gaan, en hulle het selfs geen geskikte tyd gehad om te eet nie.

kjv_text: And they departed into a desert place by ship privately.
bsb_text: So they went away in a boat by themselves to a solitary place.
aov_text: En hulle het met die skuit vertrek na ’n verlate plek in die eensaamheid.

kjv_text: And the people saw them departing, and many knew him, and ran afoot thither out of all cities, and outwent them, and came together unto him.
bsb_text: But many people saw them leaving and recognized them. They ran together on foot from all the towns and arrived before them.
aov_text: En die skare het hulle sien weggaan, en baie het Hom herken en te voet van al die stede af daar saamgestroom en voor hulle uit gegaan en by Hom vergader.

kjv_text: And Jesus, when he came out, saw much people, and was moved with compassion toward them, because they were as sheep not having a shepherd: and he began to teach them many things.
bsb_text: When Jesus stepped ashore and saw a large crowd, He had compassion on them, because they were like sheep without a shepherd. And He began to teach them many things.
aov_text: En toe Jesus uitklim, sien Hy ’n groot menigte, en Hy het vir hulle innig jammer gevoel, omdat hulle soos skape sonder herder was; en Hy het hulle baie dinge begin leer.

kjv_text: And when the day was now far spent, his disciples came unto him, and said, This is a desert place, and now the time is far passed:
bsb_text: By now the hour was already late. So the disciples came to Jesus and said, “This is a desolate place, and the hour is already late.
aov_text: En toe dit reeds laat geword het, kom sy dissipels na Hom en sê: Die plek is verlate en dit is reeds laat.

kjv_text: Send them away, that they may go into the country round about, and into the villages, and buy themselves bread: for they have nothing to eat.
bsb_text: Dismiss the crowd so they can go to the surrounding countryside and villages and buy themselves something to eat.”
aov_text: Stuur hulle weg, sodat hulle na die buitewyke en dorpe rondom kan gaan om brood vir hulleself te koop, want hulle het niks om te eet nie.

kjv_text: He answered and said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they say unto him, Shall we go and buy two hundred pennyworth of bread, and give them to eat?
bsb_text: But Jesus told them, “You give them something to eat.” They asked Him, “Should we go out and spend two hundred denarii to give all of them bread to eat?”
aov_text: Maar Hy antwoord en sê vir hulle: Gee julle aan hulle iets om te eet. En hulle sê vir Hom: Moet ons gaan en vir tweehonderd pennings brood koop en aan hulle gee om te eet?

kjv_text: He saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? go and see. And when they knew, they say, Five, and two fishes.
bsb_text: “Go and see how many loaves you have,” He told them. And after checking, they said, “Five—and two fish.”
aov_text: En Hy sê vir hulle: Hoeveel brode het julle? Gaan kyk. En toe hulle dit te wete gekom het, sê hulle: Vyf, en twee visse.

kjv_text: And he commanded them to make all sit down by companies upon the green grass.
bsb_text: Then Jesus directed them to have the people sit in groups on the green grass.
aov_text: En Hy het hulle beveel om almal klompies-klompies op die groen gras te laat sit.

kjv_text: And they sat down in ranks, by hundreds, and by fifties.
bsb_text: So they sat down in groups of hundreds and fifties.
aov_text: En hulle het gaan sit in groepe van honderd en van vyftig.

kjv_text: And when he had taken the five loaves and the two fishes, he looked up to heaven, and blessed, and brake the loaves, and gave them to his disciples to set before them; and the two fishes divided he among them all.
bsb_text: Taking the five loaves and the two fish and looking up to heaven, Jesus spoke a blessing and broke the loaves. Then He gave them to His disciples to set before the people. And He divided the two fish among them all.
aov_text: Hy neem toe die vyf brode en die twee visse, kyk op na die hemel en dank; en Hy breek die brode en gee dit aan sy dissipels om dit aan hulle voor te sit. Ook die twee visse het Hy onder almal verdeel.

kjv_text: And they did all eat, and were filled.
bsb_text: They all ate and were satisfied,
aov_text: En almal het geëet en versadig geword;

kjv_text: And they took up twelve baskets full of the fragments, and of the fishes.
bsb_text: and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces of bread and fish.
aov_text: en hulle het van die brokstukke twaalf mandjies vol opgetel, en van die visse.

kjv_text: And they that did eat of the loaves were about five thousand men.
bsb_text: And there were five thousand men who had eaten the loaves.
aov_text: En die wat van die brood geëet het, was omtrent vyfduisend manne.

kjv_text: And straightway he constrained his disciples to get into the ship, and to go to the other side before unto Bethsaida, while he sent away the people.
bsb_text: Immediately Jesus made His disciples get into the boat and go on ahead of Him to Bethsaida, while He dismissed the crowd.
aov_text: EN dadelik het Hy sy dissipels gedwing om in die skuit te gaan en vooruit te vaar na die oorkant, na Betsáida, onderwyl Hy die skare sou wegstuur.

kjv_text: And when he had sent them away, he departed into a mountain to pray.
bsb_text: After bidding them farewell, He went up on the mountain to pray.
aov_text: En nadat Hy van hulle afskeid geneem het, het Hy na die berg gegaan om te bid.

kjv_text: And when even was come, the ship was in the midst of the sea, and he alone on the land.
bsb_text: When evening came, the boat was in the middle of the sea, and Jesus was alone on land.
aov_text: En toe dit aand geword het, was die skuit in die middel van die see en Hy alleen op die land.

kjv_text: And he saw them toiling in rowing; for the wind was contrary unto them: and about the fourth watch of the night he cometh unto them, walking upon the sea, and would have passed by them.
bsb_text: He could see that the disciples were straining to row, because the wind was against them. About the fourth watch of the night, Jesus went out to them, walking on the sea. He intended to pass by them,
aov_text: En Hy het gesien dat hulle swaar kry met roei, want die wind was teen hulle. En omtrent die vierde nagwaak het Hy na hulle gekom, al wandelende op die see. En Hy wou by hulle verbygaan.

kjv_text: But when they saw him walking upon the sea, they supposed it had been a spirit, and cried out:
bsb_text: but when they saw Him walking on the sea, they cried out, thinking He was a ghost—
aov_text: En toe hulle Hom op die see sien loop, het hulle gemeen dat dit ’n spook was en hard uitgeskreeu;

kjv_text: For they all saw him, and were troubled. And immediately he talked with them, and saith unto them, Be of good cheer: it is I; be not afraid.
bsb_text: for they all saw Him and were terrified. But Jesus spoke up at once: “Take courage! It is I. Do not be afraid.”
aov_text: want hulle het Hom almal gesien en was ontsteld. Toe spreek Hy dadelik met hulle en sê vir hulle: Hou goeie moed, dit is Ek; moenie vrees nie.

kjv_text: And he went up unto them into the ship; and the wind ceased: and they were sore amazed in themselves beyond measure, and wondered.
bsb_text: Then He climbed into the boat with them, and the wind died down. And the disciples were utterly astounded,
aov_text: En Hy het by hulle in die skuit geklim, en die wind het gaan lê; en hulle was by hulleself uitermate verbaas en verwonderd.

kjv_text: For they considered not the miracle of the loaves: for their heart was hardened.
bsb_text: for they had not understood about the loaves, but their hearts had been hardened.
aov_text: Want hulle het by die wonder van die brode nie verstandig geword nie, omdat hulle hart verhard was.

kjv_text: And when they had passed over, they came into the land of Gennesaret, and drew to the shore.
bsb_text: When they had crossed over, they landed at Gennesaret and moored the boat.
aov_text: En nadat hulle oorgevaar het, het hulle by die land Gennésaret aangekom en daar aan wal gaan lê.

kjv_text: And when they were come out of the ship, straightway they knew him,
bsb_text: As soon as they got out of the boat, the people recognized Jesus
aov_text: En toe hulle uit die skuit gaan, het die mense Hom dadelik herken,

kjv_text: And ran through that whole region round about, and began to carry about in beds those that were sick, where they heard he was.
bsb_text: and ran through that whole region, carrying the sick on mats to wherever they heard He was.
aov_text: en hulle het in daardie hele omtrek rondgeloop en die wat ongesteld was, op bedde begin ronddra na die plek waar hulle hoor dat Hy is.

kjv_text: And whithersoever he entered, into villages, or cities, or country, they laid the sick in the streets, and besought him that they might touch if it were but the border of his garment: and as many as touched him were made whole.
bsb_text: And wherever He went—villages and towns and countrysides—they laid the sick in the marketplaces and begged Him just to let them touch the fringe of His cloak. And all who touched Him were healed.
aov_text: En waar Hy ook al ingegaan het in dorpe of stede of buitewyke, het hulle die wat ongesteld was, op die markpleine neergesit en Hom gesmeek om, al was dit maar die soom van sy kleed, aan te raak; en almal wat Hom aangeraak het, het gesond geword.

kjv_text: Then came together unto him the Pharisees, and certain of the scribes, which came from Jerusalem.
bsb_text: Then the Pharisees and some of the scribes who had come from Jerusalem gathered around Jesus,
aov_text: EN die Fariseërs en sommige van die skrifgeleerdes wat van Jerusalem gekom het, het by Hom saamgekom;

kjv_text: And when they saw some of his disciples eat bread with defiled, that is to say, with unwashen, hands, they found fault.
bsb_text: and they saw some of His disciples eating with hands that were defiled—that is, unwashed.
aov_text: en toe hulle sommige van sy dissipels met onrein, dit is met ongewaste, hande sien brood eet, het hulle dit afgekeur.

kjv_text: For the Pharisees, and all the Jews, except they wash their hands oft, eat not, holding the tradition of the elders.
bsb_text: Now in holding to the tradition of the elders, the Pharisees and all the Jews do not eat until they wash their hands ceremonially.
aov_text: Want die Fariseërs en al die Jode eet nie as hulle nie deeglik die hande gewas het nie, omdat hulle vashou aan die oorlewering van die ou mense.

kjv_text: And when they come from the market, except they wash, they eat not. And many other things there be, which they have received to hold, as the washing of cups, and pots, brasen vessels, and of tables.
bsb_text: And on returning from the market, they do not eat unless they wash. And there are many other traditions for them to observe, including the washing of cups, pitchers, kettles, and couches for dining.
aov_text: En wanneer hulle van die mark kom, eet hulle nie as hulle nie gewas het nie; en baie ander dinge is daar wat hulle aangeneem het om te onderhou: die wassery van bekers en kanne en kopergoed en bedde.

kjv_text: Then the Pharisees and scribes asked him, Why walk not thy disciples according to the tradition of the elders, but eat bread with unwashen hands?
bsb_text: So the Pharisees and scribes questioned Jesus: “Why do Your disciples not walk according to the tradition of the elders? Instead, they eat with defiled hands.”
aov_text: Daarop stel die Fariseërs en die skrifgeleerdes Hom die vraag: Waarom wandel u dissipels nie ooreenkomstig die oorlewering van die ou mense nie, maar eet brood met ongewaste hande?

kjv_text: He answered and said unto them, Well hath Esaias prophesied of you hypocrites, as it is written, This people honoureth me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.
bsb_text: Jesus answered them, “Isaiah prophesied correctly about you hypocrites, as it is written: ‘These people honor Me with their lips, but their hearts are far from Me.
aov_text: En Hy antwoord en sê vir hulle: Tereg het Jesaja oor julle, geveinsdes, geprofeteer soos geskrywe is: Hierdie volk eer My met die lippe, maar hulle hart is ver van My af.

kjv_text: Howbeit in vain do they worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.
bsb_text: They worship Me in vain; they teach as doctrine the precepts of men.’
aov_text: Maar tevergeefs vereer hulle My deur leringe te leer wat gebooie van mense is.

kjv_text: For laying aside the commandment of God, ye hold the tradition of men, as the washing of pots and cups: and many other such like things ye do.
bsb_text: You have disregarded the commandment of God to keep the tradition of men.”
aov_text: Want terwyl julle die gebod van God nalaat, hou julle aan die oorlewering van mense vas: die wassery van kanne en bekers, en ander dergelike dinge van dieselfde aard doen julle baie.

kjv_text: And he said unto them, Full well ye reject the commandment of God, that ye may keep your own tradition.
bsb_text: He went on to say, “You neatly set aside the command of God to maintain your own tradition.
aov_text: En Hy sê vir hulle: Julle verstaan dit goed om die gebod van God opsy te sit en so julle oorlewering te onderhou.

kjv_text: For Moses said, Honour thy father and thy mother; and, Whoso curseth father or mother, let him die the death:
bsb_text: For Moses said, ‘Honor your father and your mother’ and ‘Anyone who curses his father or mother must be put to death.’
aov_text: Want Moses het gesê: Eer jou vader en jou moeder; en: Hy wat vader of moeder vloek, moet sekerlik sterwe.

kjv_text: But ye say, If a man shall say to his father or mother, It is Corban, that is to say, a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me; he shall be free.
bsb_text: But you say that if a man says to his father or mother, ‘Whatever you would have received from me is Corban’ (that is, a gift devoted to God),
aov_text: Maar julle sê: As ’n mens aan vader of moeder sê: Enige voordeel wat u van my mag geniet, is korban, dit is ’n offergawe  —

kjv_text: And ye suffer him no more to do ought for his father or his mother;
bsb_text: he is no longer permitted to do anything for his father or mother.
aov_text: dan laat julle hom nie meer toe om iets vir sy vader of sy moeder te doen nie.

kjv_text: Making the word of God of none effect through your tradition, which ye have delivered: and many such like things do ye.
bsb_text: Thus you nullify the word of God by the tradition you have handed down. And you do so in many such matters.”
aov_text: So maak julle dan die woord van God kragteloos deur julle oorlewering wat julle bewaar het; en dergelike dinge van dieselfde aard doen julle baie.

kjv_text: And when he had called all the people unto him, he said unto them, Hearken unto me every one of you, and understand:
bsb_text: Once again Jesus called the crowd to Him and said, “All of you, listen to Me and understand:
aov_text: En Hy het die hele skare na Hom geroep en vir hulle gesê: Luister almal na My en verstaan.

kjv_text: There is nothing from without a man, that entering into him can defile him: but the things which come out of him, those are they that defile the man.
bsb_text: Nothing that enters a man from the outside can defile him; but the things that come out of a man, these are what defile him.”
aov_text: Daar is niks wat van buite af in die mens ingaan wat hom onrein kan maak nie; maar die dinge wat van hom uitgaan, dít is die dinge wat die mens onrein maak.

kjv_text: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.
aov_text: As iemand ore het om te hoor, laat hom hoor!

kjv_text: And when he was entered into the house from the people, his disciples asked him concerning the parable.
bsb_text: After Jesus had left the crowd and gone into the house, His disciples inquired about the parable.
aov_text: En toe Hy van die skare af in ’n huis gekom het, vra sy dissipels Hom oor die gelykenis.

kjv_text: And he saith unto them, Are ye so without understanding also? Do ye not perceive, that whatsoever thing from without entereth into the man, it cannot defile him;
bsb_text: “Are you still so dull?” He asked. “Do you not understand? Nothing that enters a man from the outside can defile him,
aov_text: En Hy sê vir hulle: Is julle ook so sonder verstand? Begryp julle nie dat alles wat van buite af in die mens ingaan, hom nie onrein kan maak nie,

kjv_text: Because it entereth not into his heart, but into the belly, and goeth out into the draught, purging all meats?
bsb_text: because it does not enter his heart, but it goes into the stomach and then is eliminated.” (Thus all foods are clean.)
aov_text: omdat dit nie ingaan in sy hart nie, maar in die maag, en dit gaan in die heimlikheid uit en maak al die voedsel rein?

kjv_text: And he said, That which cometh out of the man, that defileth the man.
bsb_text: He continued: “What comes out of a man, that is what defiles him.
aov_text: En Hy sê: Wat uit die mens uitgaan, dit maak die mens onrein.

kjv_text: For from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, murders,
bsb_text: For from within the hearts of men come evil thoughts, sexual immorality, theft, murder, adultery,
aov_text: Want van binne, uit die hart van die mense, kom die slegte gedagtes, egbreuk, hoerery, moord,

kjv_text: Thefts, covetousness, wickedness, deceit, lasciviousness, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, foolishness:
bsb_text: greed, wickedness, deceit, debauchery, envy, slander, arrogance, and foolishness.
aov_text: diewery, hebsug, boosheid, bedrog, losbandigheid, afguns, lastering, hoogmoed, dwaasheid.

kjv_text: All these evil things come from within, and defile the man.
bsb_text: All these evils come from within, and these are what defile a man.”
aov_text: Al hierdie booshede kom van binne uit en maak die mens onrein.

kjv_text: And from thence he arose, and went into the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and entered into an house, and would have no man know it: but he could not be hid.
bsb_text: Jesus left that place and went to the region of Tyre. Not wanting anyone to know He was there, He entered a house, but was unable to escape their notice.
aov_text: EN Hy het opgestaan en daarvandaan na die gebied van Tirus en Sidon vertrek. En toe Hy in die huis gegaan het, wou Hy nie dat iemand dit sou weet nie; maar Hy kon nie verborge bly nie.

kjv_text: For a certain woman, whose young daughter had an unclean spirit, heard of him, and came and fell at his feet:
bsb_text: Instead, a woman whose little daughter had an unclean spirit soon heard about Jesus, and she came and fell at His feet.
aov_text: Want ’n vrou wie se dogtertjie ’n onreine gees gehad het, het van Hom gehoor en gekom en voor sy voete neergeval.

kjv_text: The woman was a Greek, a Syrophenician by nation; and she besought him that he would cast forth the devil out of her daughter.
bsb_text: Now she was a Greek woman of Syrophoenician origin, and she kept asking Jesus to drive the demon out of her daughter.
aov_text: En sy was ’n Griekse vrou, ’n Siro-Feniciese van geboorte, en sy het Hom gevra om die duiwel uit haar dogter uit te dryf.

kjv_text: But Jesus said unto her, Let the children first be filled: for it is not meet to take the children's bread, and to cast it unto the dogs.
bsb_text: “First let the children have their fill,” He said. “For it is not right to take the children’s bread and toss it to the dogs.”
aov_text: Maar Jesus sê vir haar: Laat eers die kinders versadig word; want dit is nie mooi om die brood van die kinders te neem en vir die hondjies te gooi nie.

kjv_text: And she answered and said unto him, Yes, Lord: yet the dogs under the table eat of the children's crumbs.
bsb_text: “Yes, Lord,” she replied, “even the dogs under the table eat the children’s crumbs.”
aov_text: En sy antwoord en sê vir Hom: Ja, Here, maar die hondjies eet darem onder die tafel van die kinders se krummels.

kjv_text: And he said unto her, For this saying go thy way; the devil is gone out of thy daughter.
bsb_text: Then Jesus told her, “Because of this answer, you may go. The demon has left your daughter.”
aov_text: En Hy sê vir haar: Ter wille van hierdie woord kan jy gaan; die duiwel het uit jou dogter uitgevaar.

kjv_text: And when she was come to her house, she found the devil gone out, and her daughter laid upon the bed.
bsb_text: And she went home and found her child lying on the bed, and the demon was gone.
aov_text: En toe sy huis toe gaan, vind sy dat die duiwel uitgevaar het en dat haar dogter op die bed lê.

kjv_text: And again, departing from the coasts of Tyre and Sidon, he came unto the sea of Galilee, through the midst of the coasts of Decapolis.
bsb_text: Then Jesus left the region of Tyre and went through Sidon to the Sea of Galilee and into the region of the Decapolis.
aov_text: EN Hy het weer uit die gebied van Tirus en Sidon vertrek en na die see van Galiléa gegaan, deur die gebied van Dekápolis.

kjv_text: And they bring unto him one that was deaf, and had an impediment in his speech; and they beseech him to put his hand upon him.
bsb_text: Some people brought to Him a man who was deaf and hardly able to speak, and they begged Jesus to place His hand on him.
aov_text: Toe bring hulle na Hom ’n dowe wat swaar praat, en smeek Hom om hom die hande op te lê.

kjv_text: And he took him aside from the multitude, and put his fingers into his ears, and he spit, and touched his tongue;
bsb_text: So Jesus took him aside privately, away from the crowd, and put His fingers into the man’s ears. Then He spit and touched the man’s tongue.
aov_text: En Hy neem hom opsy, weg van die skare, en steek sy vingers in sy ore, en spuug en raak sy tong aan;

kjv_text: And looking up to heaven, he sighed, and saith unto him, Ephphatha, that is, Be opened.
bsb_text: And looking up to heaven, He sighed deeply and said to him, “Ephphatha!” (which means, “Be opened!”).
aov_text: en nadat Hy opgekyk het na die hemel, sug Hy en sê aan hom: Éffata, dit is: Gaan oop!

kjv_text: And straightway his ears were opened, and the string of his tongue was loosed, and he spake plain.
bsb_text: Immediately the man’s ears were opened and his tongue was released, and he began to speak plainly.
aov_text: En dadelik het sy ore oopgegaan en die band van sy tong losgeraak, en hy het reg gepraat.

kjv_text: And he charged them that they should tell no man: but the more he charged them, so much the more a great deal they published it;
bsb_text: Jesus ordered them not to tell anyone. But the more He ordered them, the more widely they proclaimed it.
aov_text: En Hy het hulle beveel om dit aan niemand te sê nie; maar hoe meer Hy hulle dit beveel, hoe meer hulle dit verkondig.

kjv_text: And were beyond measure astonished, saying, He hath done all things well: he maketh both the deaf to hear, and the dumb to speak.
bsb_text: The people were utterly astonished and said, “He has done all things well! He makes even the deaf hear and the mute speak!”
aov_text: En hulle was uitermate verslae en het gesê: Hy het alles goed gedoen: die dowes laat Hy hoor en die stommes praat.

kjv_text: In those days the multitude being very great, and having nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples unto him, and saith unto them,
bsb_text: In those days the crowd once again became very large, and they had nothing to eat. Jesus called the disciples to Him and said,
aov_text: IN dié dae toe daar ’n baie groot menigte was en hulle niks gehad het om te eet nie, het Jesus sy dissipels na Hom geroep en vir hulle gesê:

kjv_text: I have compassion on the multitude, because they have now been with me three days, and have nothing to eat:
bsb_text: “I have compassion for this crowd, because they have already been with Me three days and have nothing to eat.
aov_text: Ek voel innig jammer vir die skare, omdat hulle al drie dae by My bly en niks het om te eet nie.

kjv_text: And if I send them away fasting to their own houses, they will faint by the way: for divers of them came from far.
bsb_text: If I send them home hungry, they will faint along the way. For some of them have come a great distance.”
aov_text: En as Ek hulle honger huis toe stuur, sal hulle op die pad beswyk, want sommige van hulle kom van ver.

kjv_text: And his disciples answered him, From whence can a man satisfy these men with bread here in the wilderness?
bsb_text: His disciples replied, “Where in this desolate place could anyone find enough bread to feed all these people?”
aov_text: En sy dissipels antwoord Hom: Waarvandaan sal ’n mens hulle hier in die woestyn kan versadig met brood?

kjv_text: And he asked them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven.
bsb_text: “How many loaves do you have?” Jesus asked. “Seven,” they replied.
aov_text: Toe vra Hy hulle: Hoeveel brode het julle? En hulle sê: Sewe.

kjv_text: And he commanded the people to sit down on the ground: and he took the seven loaves, and gave thanks, and brake, and gave to his disciples to set before them; and they did set them before the people.
bsb_text: And He instructed the crowd to sit down on the ground. Then He took the seven loaves, gave thanks and broke them, and gave them to His disciples to set before the people. And they distributed them to the crowd.
aov_text: En Hy gee aan die skare bevel om op die grond te gaan sit; daarop neem Hy die sewe brode, en nadat Hy gedank het, breek Hy dit en gee dit aan sy dissipels om dit voor te sit; en hulle sit dit aan die skare voor.

kjv_text: And they had a few small fishes: and he blessed, and commanded to set them also before them.
bsb_text: They also had a few small fish, and Jesus blessed them and ordered that these be set before them as well.
aov_text: Hulle het ook ’n paar vissies gehad; en nadat Hy gedank het, sê Hy dat hulle dit ook moet voorsit.

kjv_text: So they did eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets.
bsb_text: The people ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up seven basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.
aov_text: En hulle het geëet en versadig geword en die oorskot van die brokstukke opgetel, sewe mandjies vol.

kjv_text: And they that had eaten were about four thousand: and he sent them away.
bsb_text: And about four thousand men were present. As soon as Jesus had dismissed the crowd,
aov_text: En die wat geëet het, was omtrent vierduisend. En Hy het hulle weggestuur.

kjv_text: And straightway he entered into a ship with his disciples, and came into the parts of Dalmanutha.
bsb_text: He got into the boat with His disciples and went to the district of Dalmanutha.
aov_text: EN dadelik het Hy met sy dissipels in die skuit geklim en in die streke van Dalmanúta gekom.

kjv_text: And the Pharisees came forth, and began to question with him, seeking of him a sign from heaven, tempting him.
bsb_text: Then the Pharisees came and began to argue with Jesus, testing Him by demanding from Him a sign from heaven.
aov_text: En die Fariseërs het uitgegaan en met Hom begin redetwis en van Hom ’n teken uit die hemel gevra om Hom te versoek.

kjv_text: And he sighed deeply in his spirit, and saith, Why doth this generation seek after a sign? verily I say unto you, There shall no sign be given unto this generation.
bsb_text: Jesus sighed deeply in His spirit and said, “Why does this generation demand a sign? Truly I tell you, no sign will be given to this generation.”
aov_text: Toe sug Hy swaar in sy gees en sê: Waarom begeer hierdie geslag ’n teken? Voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, aan hierdie geslag sal sekerlik geen teken gegee word nie.

kjv_text: And he left them, and entering into the ship again departed to the other side.
bsb_text: And He left them, got back into the boat, and crossed to the other side.
aov_text: En Hy het hulle verlaat en weer in die skuit geklim en na die oorkant gegaan.

kjv_text: Now the disciples had forgotten to take bread, neither had they in the ship with them more than one loaf.
bsb_text: Now the disciples had forgotten to take bread, except for one loaf they had with them in the boat.
aov_text: En hulle het vergeet om brode saam te neem, en het net een brood by hulle in die skuit gehad.

kjv_text: And he charged them, saying, Take heed, beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, and of the leaven of Herod.
bsb_text: “Watch out!” He cautioned them. “Beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of Herod.”
aov_text: En Hy het hulle beveel en gesê: Pas op, wees op julle hoede vir die suurdeeg van die Fariseërs en die suurdeeg van Herodes.

kjv_text: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have no bread.
bsb_text: So they began to discuss with one another the fact that they had no bread.
aov_text: Toe redeneer hulle onder mekaar en sê: Dit is omdat ons geen brode het nie.

kjv_text: And when Jesus knew it, he saith unto them, Why reason ye, because ye have no bread? perceive ye not yet, neither understand?
bsb_text: Aware of their conversation, Jesus asked them, "Why are you debating about having no bread? Do you still not see or understand?
aov_text: En Jesus merk dit en sê vir hulle: Waarom redeneer julle dat julle geen brode het nie? Begryp julle nie en verstaan julle nie?

kjv_text: have ye your heart yet hardened?
bsb_text: Do you have such hard hearts?"
aov_text: Het julle nog jul verharde hart?

kjv_text: Having eyes, see ye not? and having ears, hear ye not?
bsb_text: 'Having eyes, do you not see? And having ears, do you not hear?'
aov_text: Het julle oë en sien julle nie? En het julle ore en hoor julle nie?

kjv_text: and do ye not remember?
bsb_text: And do you not remember?
aov_text: En onthou julle nie

kjv_text: When I brake the five loaves among five thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? They say unto him, Twelve.
bsb_text: When I broke the five loaves for the five thousand, how many basketfuls of broken pieces did you collect?” “Twelve,” they answered.
aov_text: toe Ek die vyf brode vir die vyfduisend gebreek het, hoeveel mandjies vol brokstukke julle opgetel het nie? Hulle sê vir Hom: Twaalf.

kjv_text: And when the seven among four thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? And they said, Seven.
bsb_text: “And when I broke the seven loaves for the four thousand, how many basketfuls of broken pieces did you collect?” “Seven,” they said.
aov_text: En die sewe vir die vierduisend — hoeveel mandjies vol brokstukke het julle opgetel? En hulle sê: Sewe.

kjv_text: And he said unto them, How is it that ye do not understand?
bsb_text: Then He asked them, “Do you still not understand?”
aov_text: Toe sê Hy vir hulle: Hoe verstaan julle dan nie!

kjv_text: And he cometh to Bethsaida; and they bring a blind man unto him, and besought him to touch him.
bsb_text: When they arrived at Bethsaida, some people brought a blind man and begged Jesus to touch him.
aov_text: EN Hy het in Betsáida gekom, en hulle het ’n blinde man na Hom gebring en Hom gesmeek om hom aan te raak.

kjv_text: And he took the blind man by the hand, and led him out of the town; and when he had spit on his eyes, and put his hands upon him, he asked him if he saw ought.
bsb_text: So He took the blind man by the hand and led him out of the village. Then He spit on the man’s eyes and placed His hands on him. “Can you see anything?” He asked.
aov_text: Hy neem toe die blinde by die hand en lei hom uit buitekant die dorp; en nadat Hy in sy oë gespuug en hom die hande opgelê het, vra Hy hom of hy iets sien.

kjv_text: And he looked up, and said, I see men as trees, walking.
bsb_text: The man looked up and said, “I can see the people, but they look like trees walking around.”
aov_text: En hy kyk op en sê: Ek sien die mense, want ek sien hulle soos bome rondloop.

kjv_text: After that he put his hands again upon his eyes, and made him look up: and he was restored, and saw every man clearly.
bsb_text: Once again Jesus placed His hands on the man’s eyes, and when he opened them his sight was restored, and he could see everything clearly.
aov_text: Daarna lê Hy weer die hande op sy oë en laat hom opkyk, en hy is herstel en het almal van ver af duidelik gesien.

kjv_text: And he sent him away to his house, saying, Neither go into the town, nor tell it to any in the town.
bsb_text: Jesus sent him home and said, “Do not go back into the village.”
aov_text: En Hy het hom na sy huis gestuur en gesê: Moenie in die dorp gaan of dit aan iemand in die dorp vertel nie.

kjv_text: And Jesus went out, and his disciples, into the towns of Caesarea Philippi: and by the way he asked his disciples, saying unto them, Whom do men say that I am?
bsb_text: Then Jesus and His disciples went on to the villages around Caesarea Philippi. On the way, He questioned His disciples: “Who do people say I am?”
aov_text: EN Jesus en sy dissipels het uitgegaan na die dorpe van Cesaréa-Filíppi; en op die pad vra Hy sy dissipels en sê vir hulle: Wie sê die mense is Ek?

kjv_text: And they answered, John the Baptist: but some say, Elias; and others, One of the prophets.
bsb_text: They replied, “Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, one of the prophets.”
aov_text: En hulle antwoord: Johannes die Doper, en ander: Elía, en ander: Een van die profete.

kjv_text: And he saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am? And Peter answereth and saith unto him, Thou art the Christ.
bsb_text: “But what about you?” Jesus asked. “Who do you say I am?” Peter answered, “You are the Christ.”
aov_text: En Hy sê vir hulle: Maar julle, wie sê julle is Ek? En Petrus antwoord en sê vir Hom: U is die Christus.

kjv_text: And he charged them that they should tell no man of him.
bsb_text: And Jesus warned them not to tell anyone about Him.
aov_text: En Hy het hulle streng beveel om niemand van Hom te vertel nie.

kjv_text: And he began to teach them, that the Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders, and of the chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.
bsb_text: Then He began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things and be rejected by the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and that He must be killed and after three days rise again.
aov_text: Toe het Hy hulle begin leer dat die Seun van die mens baie moet ly en verwerp word deur die ouderlinge en owerpriesters en skrifgeleerdes en gedood word en ná drie dae opstaan.

kjv_text: And he spake that saying openly. And Peter took him, and began to rebuke him.
bsb_text: He spoke this message quite frankly, and Peter took Him aside and began to rebuke Him.
aov_text: En hierdie woord het Hy ronduit gespreek. En Petrus het Hom opsy geneem en Hom begin bestraf.

kjv_text: But when he had turned about and looked on his disciples, he rebuked Peter, saying, Get thee behind me, Satan: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but the things that be of men.
bsb_text: But Jesus, turning and looking at His disciples, rebuked Peter and said, “Get behind Me, Satan! For you do not have in mind the things of God, but the things of men.”
aov_text: Maar Hy het Hom omgedraai, en terwyl Hy sy dissipels aankyk, het Hy Petrus bestraf en gesê: Gaan weg agter My, Satan! Want jy bedink nie die dinge van God nie, maar dié van die mense.

kjv_text: And when he had called the people unto him with his disciples also, he said unto them, Whosoever will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
bsb_text: Then Jesus called the crowd to Him along with His disciples, and He told them, “If anyone wants to come after Me, he must deny himself and take up his cross and follow Me.
aov_text: EN toe Hy die skare saam met sy dissipels na Hom geroep het, sê Hy vir hulle: Wie agter My aan wil kom, moet homself verloën en sy kruis opneem en My volg.

kjv_text: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it; but whosoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel's, the same shall save it.
bsb_text: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for My sake and for the gospel will save it.
aov_text: Want elkeen wat sy lewe wil red, sal dit verloor; maar elkeen wat sy lewe om My ontwil en om die evangelie ontwil verloor, hy sal dit red.

kjv_text: For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?
bsb_text: What does it profit a man to gain the whole world, yet forfeit his soul?
aov_text: Want wat sal dit ’n mens baat as hy die hele wêreld win en aan sy siel skade ly?

kjv_text: Or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?
bsb_text: Or what can a man give in exchange for his soul?
aov_text: Of wat sal ’n mens gee as losprys vir sy siel?

kjv_text: Whosoever therefore shall be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation; of him also shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he cometh in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.
bsb_text: If anyone is ashamed of Me and My words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man will also be ashamed of him when He comes in His Father’s glory with the holy angels.”
aov_text: Want elkeen wat hom vir My en my woorde skaam in hierdie owerspelige en sondige geslag, vir hom sal die Seun van die mens Hom ook skaam wanneer Hy kom in die heerlikheid van sy Vader met die heilige engele.

kjv_text: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That there be some of them that stand here, which shall not taste of death, till they have seen the kingdom of God come with power.
bsb_text: Then Jesus said to them, “Truly I tell you, there are some standing here who will not taste death before they see the kingdom of God arrive with power.”
aov_text: EN Hy sê vir hulle: Voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, daar is sommige van die wat hier staan, wat die dood sekerlik nie sal smaak voordat hulle die koninkryk van God met krag sien kom het nie.

kjv_text: And after six days Jesus taketh with him Peter, and James, and John, and leadeth them up into an high mountain apart by themselves: and he was transfigured before them.
bsb_text: After six days Jesus took with Him Peter, James, and John, and led them up a high mountain by themselves. There He was transfigured before them.
aov_text: EN ná ses dae het Jesus vir Petrus en Jakobus en Johannes saamgeneem en hulle alleen op ’n hoë berg in die eensaamheid geneem; en Hy het voor hulle van gedaante verander,

kjv_text: And his raiment became shining, exceeding white as snow; so as no fuller on earth can white them.
bsb_text: His clothes became radiantly white, brighter than any launderer on earth could bleach them.
aov_text: en sy klere het blink geword, baie wit soos sneeu, wit soos geen bleiker op aarde dit kan maak nie.

kjv_text: And there appeared unto them Elias with Moses: and they were talking with Jesus.
bsb_text: And Elijah and Moses appeared before them, talking with Jesus.
aov_text: En daar het aan hulle verskyn Elía saam met Moses, en hulle was in gesprek met Jesus.

kjv_text: And Peter answered and said to Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.
bsb_text: Peter said to Jesus, “Rabbi, it is good for us to be here. Let us put up three shelters—one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
aov_text: Toe spreek Petrus en sê vir Jesus: Rabbi, dit is goed dat ons hier is. Laat ons dan drie hutte maak: vir U een en vir Moses een en vir Elía een.

kjv_text: For he wist not what to say; for they were sore afraid.
bsb_text: For they were all so terrified that Peter did not know what else to say.
aov_text: Want hy het nie geweet wat om te sê nie, want hulle was heeltemal verskrik.

kjv_text: And there was a cloud that overshadowed them: and a voice came out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.
