bsb_text: Then a cloud appeared and enveloped them, and a voice came from the cloud: “This is My beloved Son. Listen to Him!”
aov_text: En daar kom ’n wolk wat hulle oordek; en uit die wolk kom ’n stem wat sê: Dit is my geliefde Seun, luister na Hom!

kjv_text: And suddenly, when they had looked round about, they saw no man any more, save Jesus only with themselves.
bsb_text: Suddenly, when they looked around, they saw no one with them except Jesus.
aov_text: En meteens kyk hulle rond en sien niemand meer by hulle nie, behalwe Jesus alleen.

kjv_text: And as they came down from the mountain, he charged them that they should tell no man what things they had seen, till the Son of man were risen from the dead.
bsb_text: As they were coming down the mountain, Jesus admonished them not to tell anyone what they had seen until the Son of Man had risen from the dead.
aov_text: En onderwyl hulle van die berg afklim, gee Hy aan hulle bevel om aan niemand te vertel wat hulle gesien het voordat die Seun van die mens uit die dode opgestaan het nie.

kjv_text: And they kept that saying with themselves, questioning one with another what the rising from the dead should mean.
bsb_text: So they kept this matter to themselves, discussing what it meant to rise from the dead.
aov_text: En hulle het die woord vir hulleself gehou en onder mekaar gevra wat dit beteken om uit die dode op te staan.

kjv_text: And they asked him, saying, Why say the scribes that Elias must first come?
bsb_text: And they asked Jesus, “Why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”
aov_text: En hulle vra Hom en sê: Waarom sê die skrifgeleerdes dat Elía eers moet kom?

kjv_text: And he answered and told them, Elias verily cometh first, and restoreth all things; and how it is written of the Son of man, that he must suffer many things, and be set at nought.
bsb_text: He replied, “Elijah does indeed come first, and he restores all things. Why then is it written that the Son of Man must suffer many things and be rejected?
aov_text: Toe antwoord Hy en sê vir hulle: Dis waar, Elía kom eers om alles te herstel; en tog, hoe staan daar dan van die Seun van die mens geskrywe dat Hy baie moet ly en verag word?

kjv_text: But I say unto you, That Elias is indeed come, and they have done unto him whatsoever they listed, as it is written of him.
bsb_text: But I tell you that Elijah has indeed come, and they have done to him whatever they wished, just as it is written about him.”
aov_text: Maar Ek sê vir julle dat Elía al gekom het, en hulle het aan hom gedoen alles wat hulle wou, soos van hom geskrywe is.

kjv_text: And when he came to his disciples, he saw a great multitude about them, and the scribes questioning with them.
bsb_text: When they returned to the other disciples, they saw a large crowd around them, and scribes arguing with them.
aov_text: EN toe Hy by die dissipels kom, sien Hy ’n groot menigte om hulle, en skrifgeleerdes wat met hulle redetwis.

kjv_text: And straightway all the people, when they beheld him, were greatly amazed, and running to him saluted him.
bsb_text: As soon as all the people saw Jesus, they were filled with awe and ran to greet Him.
aov_text: En dadelik toe die hele skare Hom sien, was hulle baie verbaas en het na Hom gehardloop en Hom gegroet.

kjv_text: And he asked the scribes, What question ye with them?
bsb_text: “What are you disputing with them?” He asked.
aov_text: Daarop vra Hy die skrifgeleerdes: Waarom redetwis julle met hulle?

kjv_text: And one of the multitude answered and said, Master, I have brought unto thee my son, which hath a dumb spirit;
bsb_text: Someone in the crowd replied, “Teacher, I brought You my son, who has a spirit that makes him mute.
aov_text: En een uit die skare antwoord en sê: Meester, ek het my seun wat ’n stomme gees het, na U gebring;

kjv_text: And wheresoever he taketh him, he teareth him: and he foameth, and gnasheth with his teeth, and pineth away: and I spake to thy disciples that they should cast him out; and they could not.
bsb_text: Whenever it seizes him, it throws him to the ground. He foams at the mouth, gnashes his teeth, and becomes rigid. I asked Your disciples to drive it out, but they were unable.”
aov_text: en waar hy hom ook aangryp, skeur hy hom; en hy kry skuim in die mond, en hy kners met sy tande en word styf; en ek het u dissipels gevra om hom uit te dryf, en hulle kon nie.

kjv_text: He answereth him, and saith, O faithless generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him unto me.
bsb_text: “O unbelieving generation!” Jesus replied. “How long must I remain with you? How long must I put up with you? Bring the boy to Me.”
aov_text: Toe antwoord Hy hom en sê: o Ongelowige geslag, hoe lank sal Ek by julle wees, hoe lank sal Ek julle verdra? Bring hom na My toe.

kjv_text: And they brought him unto him: and when he saw him, straightway the spirit tare him; and he fell on the ground, and wallowed foaming.
bsb_text: So they brought him, and seeing Jesus, the spirit immediately threw the boy into a convulsion. He fell to the ground and rolled around, foaming at the mouth.
aov_text: En hulle bring hom na Hom toe; en toe hy Hom sien, laat die gees hom dadelik stuiptrekkings kry, en hy val op die grond neer en rol rond met skuim in die mond.

kjv_text: And he asked his father, How long is it ago since this came unto him? And he said, Of a child.
bsb_text: Jesus asked the boy’s father, “How long has this been with him?” “From childhood,” he said.
aov_text: Daarop vra Hy sy vader: Hoe lank is dit al dat dit hom oorgekom het? En hy sê: Van sy kindsdae af;

kjv_text: And ofttimes it hath cast him into the fire, and into the waters, to destroy him: but if thou canst do any thing, have compassion on us, and help us.
bsb_text: “It often throws him into the fire or into the water, trying to kill him. But if You can do anything, have compassion on us and help us.”
aov_text: en dikwels het hy hom selfs in die vuur en in die water gegooi om hom dood te maak. Maar as U iets kan doen, ontferm U oor ons en help ons.

kjv_text: Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.
bsb_text: “If You can?” echoed Jesus. “All things are possible to him who believes!”
aov_text: En Jesus sê vir hom: Wat dit betref — as jy kan glo, alle dinge is moontlik vir die een wat glo.

kjv_text: And straightway the father of the child cried out, and said with tears, Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.
bsb_text: Immediately the boy’s father cried out, “I do believe; help my unbelief!”
aov_text: En dadelik roep die vader van die kind met trane uit en sê: Ek glo, Here, kom my ongeloof te hulp!

kjv_text: When Jesus saw that the people came running together, he rebuked the foul spirit, saying unto him, Thou dumb and deaf spirit, I charge thee, come out of him, and enter no more into him.
bsb_text: When Jesus saw that a crowd had come running, He rebuked the unclean spirit. “You deaf and mute spirit,” He said, “I command you to come out and never enter him again.”
aov_text: En toe Jesus sien dat ’n skare bymekaar stroom, het Hy die onreine gees bestraf en vir hom gesê: Jou stom en dowe gees, Ek gebied jou, gaan uit hom uit en kom nooit weer in hom nie.

kjv_text: And the spirit cried, and rent him sore, and came out of him: and he was as one dead; insomuch that many said, He is dead.
bsb_text: After shrieking and convulsing him violently, the spirit came out. The boy became like a corpse, so that many said, “He is dead.”
aov_text: En nadat hy geskreeu en hom baie stuiptrekkings laat kry het, het hy uitgegaan. En die seun het soos ’n dooie geword, sodat baie gesê het: Hy is dood.

kjv_text: But Jesus took him by the hand, and lifted him up; and he arose.
bsb_text: But Jesus took him by the hand and helped him to his feet, and he stood up.
aov_text: Maar Jesus het hom by die hand gegryp en hom opgerig; en hy het opgestaan.

kjv_text: And when he was come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, Why could not we cast him out?
bsb_text: After Jesus had gone into the house, His disciples asked Him privately, “Why couldn’t we drive it out?”
aov_text: En toe Hy in die huis kom, vra sy dissipels Hom afsonderlik: Waarom kon ons hom nie uitdrywe nie?

kjv_text: And he said unto them, This kind can come forth by nothing, but by prayer and fasting.
bsb_text: Jesus answered, “This kind cannot come out, except by prayer.”
aov_text: En Hy sê vir hulle: Hierdie geslag kan deur niks anders uitgaan as deur gebed en vas nie.

kjv_text: And they departed thence, and passed through Galilee; and he would not that any man should know it.
bsb_text: Going on from there, they passed through Galilee. But Jesus did not want anyone to know,
aov_text: EN hulle het daarvandaan weggegaan en verbygetrek deur Galiléa; en Hy wou nie hê dat iemand dit moes weet nie.

kjv_text: For he taught his disciples, and said unto them, The Son of man is delivered into the hands of men, and they shall kill him; and after that he is killed, he shall rise the third day.
bsb_text: because He was teaching His disciples. He told them, “The Son of Man will be delivered into the hands of men. They will kill Him, and after three days He will rise.”
aov_text: Want Hy het sy dissipels geleer en vir hulle gesê: Die Seun van die mens word oorgelewer in die hande van die mense, en hulle sal Hom doodmaak; en nadat Hy gedood is, sal Hy die derde dag opstaan.

kjv_text: But they understood not that saying, and were afraid to ask him.
bsb_text: But they did not understand this statement, and they were afraid to ask Him about it.
aov_text: En hulle het die gesegde nie verstaan nie en was bang om Hom uit te vra.

kjv_text: And he came to Capernaum: and being in the house he asked them, What was it that ye disputed among yourselves by the way?
bsb_text: Then they came to Capernaum. While Jesus was in the house, He asked them, “What were you discussing on the way?”
aov_text: En Hy het in Kapérnaüm gekom; en toe Hy in die huis was, vra Hy hulle: Wat het julle op die pad met mekaar geredeneer?

kjv_text: But they held their peace: for by the way they had disputed among themselves, who should be the greatest.
bsb_text: But they were silent, for on the way they had been arguing about which of them was the greatest.
aov_text: Maar hulle het stilgebly; want hulle het op die pad met mekaar gepraat oor wie die grootste is.

kjv_text: And he sat down, and called the twelve, and saith unto them, If any man desire to be first, the same shall be last of all, and servant of all.
bsb_text: Sitting down, Jesus called the Twelve and said, “If anyone wants to be first, he must be the last of all and the servant of all.”
aov_text: En toe Hy gaan sit het, roep Hy die twaalf en sê vir hulle: As iemand die eerste wil wees, moet hy die laaste van almal en almal se dienaar wees.

kjv_text: And he took a child, and set him in the midst of them: and when he had taken him in his arms, he said unto them,
bsb_text: Then He had a little child stand among them. Taking the child in His arms, He said to them,
aov_text: En Hy neem ’n kindjie en laat hom in hul midde staan en slaan sy arms om hom en sê vir hulle:

kjv_text: Whosoever shall receive one of such children in my name, receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me, receiveth not me, but him that sent me.
bsb_text: “Whoever welcomes one of these little children in My name welcomes Me, and whoever welcomes Me welcomes not only Me, but the One who sent Me.”
aov_text: Elkeen wat een van sulke kindertjies ontvang in my Naam, ontvang My. En elkeen wat My ontvang, ontvang nie My nie, maar Hom wat My gestuur het.

kjv_text: And John answered him, saying, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name, and he followeth not us: and we forbad him, because he followeth not us.
bsb_text: John said to Him, “Teacher, we saw someone else driving out demons in Your name, and we tried to stop him, because he does not accompany us.”
aov_text: TOE antwoord Johannes Hom en sê: Meester, ons het iemand gesien wat in u Naam duiwels uitdryf en wat ons nie volg nie; en ons het hom belet, omdat hy ons nie volg nie.

kjv_text: But Jesus said, Forbid him not: for there is no man which shall do a miracle in my name, that can lightly speak evil of me.
bsb_text: “Do not stop him,” Jesus replied. “For no one who performs a miracle in My name can turn around and speak evil of Me.
aov_text: Maar Jesus sê: Moet hom nie belet nie, want daar is niemand wat ’n krag in my Naam sal doen en gou van My sal kan kwaadspreek nie;

kjv_text: For he that is not against us is on our part.
bsb_text: For whoever is not against us is for us.
aov_text: want wie nie teen ons is nie, is vír ons.

kjv_text: For whosoever shall give you a cup of water to drink in my name, because ye belong to Christ, verily I say unto you, he shall not lose his reward.
bsb_text: Indeed, if anyone gives you even a cup of water because you bear the name of Christ, truly I tell you, he will never lose his reward.

bsb_text: Then they led the colt to Jesus and threw their cloaks over it, and He sat on it.
aov_text: En hulle het die vul na Jesus gebring en hulle klere daarop gelê, en Hy het op hom gaan sit.

kjv_text: And many spread their garments in the way: and others cut down branches off the trees, and strawed them in the way.
bsb_text: Many in the crowd spread their cloaks on the road, while others spread branches they had cut from the fields.
aov_text: Toe gooi baie mense hulle klere op die pad oop, en ander kap takke van die bome af en strooi dit op die pad.

kjv_text: And they that went before, and they that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna; Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord:
bsb_text: The ones who went ahead and those who followed were shouting: “Hosanna!” “Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!”
aov_text: En die wat voor geloop en die wat gevolg het, het uitgeroep en gesê: Hosanna! Geseënd is Hy wat kom in die Naam van die Here!

kjv_text: Blessed be the kingdom of our father David, that cometh in the name of the Lord: Hosanna in the highest.
bsb_text: “Blessed is the coming kingdom of our father David!” “Hosanna in the highest!”
aov_text: Geseënd is die koninkryk wat kom in die Naam van die Here, die koninkryk van ons vader Dawid! Hosanna in die hoogste hemele!

kjv_text: And Jesus entered into Jerusalem, and into the temple: and when he had looked round about upon all things, and now the eventide was come, he went out unto Bethany with the twelve.
bsb_text: Then Jesus entered Jerusalem and went into the temple courts. He looked around at everything, but since it was already late, He went out to Bethany with the Twelve.
aov_text: En Jesus het in Jerusalem gekom en in die tempel. En nadat Hy alles rondom bekyk het, en omdat dit al aand was, het Hy met die twaalf uitgegaan na Betánië.

kjv_text: And on the morrow, when they were come from Bethany, he was hungry:
bsb_text: The next day, when they had left Bethany, Jesus was hungry.
aov_text: EN die volgende dag, onderwyl hulle uit Betánië gaan, het Hy honger gehad;

kjv_text: And seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came, if haply he might find any thing thereon: and when he came to it, he found nothing but leaves; for the time of figs was not yet.
bsb_text: Seeing in the distance a fig tree in leaf, He went to see if there was any fruit on it. But when He reached it, He found nothing on it except leaves, since it was not the season for figs.
aov_text: en toe Hy op ’n afstand ’n vyeboom met blare sien, het Hy daarheen gegaan in die hoop om iets daaraan te vind; en toe Hy daarby kom, vind Hy niks as blare nie, want dit was nie die tyd van vye nie.

kjv_text: And Jesus answered and said unto it, No man eat fruit of thee hereafter for ever. And his disciples heard it.
bsb_text: Then He said to the tree, “May no one ever eat of your fruit again.” And His disciples heard this statement.
aov_text: En Jesus spreek en sê vir hom: Laat niemand ooit in der ewigheid van jou ’n vrug eet nie! En sy dissipels het dit gehoor.

kjv_text: And they come to Jerusalem: and Jesus went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves;
bsb_text: When they arrived in Jerusalem, Jesus entered the temple courts and began to drive out those who were buying and selling there. He overturned the tables of the money changers and the seats of those selling doves.
aov_text: En hulle het in Jerusalem gekom; en toe Jesus in die tempel ingaan, begin Hy om die wat in die tempel verkoop en koop, uit te jaag; en die tafels van die geldwisselaars en die stoele van die duiweverkopers het Hy omgegooi;

kjv_text: And would not suffer that any man should carry any vessel through the temple.
bsb_text: And He would not allow anyone to carry merchandise through the temple courts.
aov_text: en Hy het niemand toegelaat om enige voorwerp deur die tempel te dra nie.

kjv_text: And he taught, saying unto them, Is it not written, My house shall be called of all nations the house of prayer? but ye have made it a den of thieves.
bsb_text: Then Jesus began to teach them, and He declared, “Is it not written: ‘My house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations’? But you have made it ‘a den of robbers.’”
aov_text: En Hy het geleer en vir hulle gesê: Is daar nie geskrywe: My huis moet ’n huis van gebed genoem word vir al die nasies nie? Maar julle het dit ’n rowerspelonk gemaak.

kjv_text: And the scribes and chief priests heard it, and sought how they might destroy him: for they feared him, because all the people was astonished at his doctrine.
bsb_text: When the chief priests and scribes heard this, they looked for a way to kill Him. For they were afraid of Him, because the whole crowd was astonished at His teaching.
aov_text: En die skrifgeleerdes en die owerpriesters het dit gehoor en gesoek hoe hulle Hom kon ombring; want hulle was bang vir Hom, omdat die hele skare verslae was oor sy leer.

kjv_text: And when even was come, he went out of the city.
bsb_text: And when evening came, Jesus and His disciples went out of the city.
aov_text: En toe dit laat word, het Hy uitgegaan buitekant die stad.

kjv_text: And in the morning, as they passed by, they saw the fig tree dried up from the roots.
bsb_text: As they were walking back in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered from its roots.
aov_text: En toe hulle vroeg in die môre verbygaan, sien hulle die vyeboom, verdroog van die wortels af.

kjv_text: And Peter calling to remembrance saith unto him, Master, behold, the fig tree which thou cursedst is withered away.
bsb_text: Peter remembered it and said, “Look, Rabbi! The fig tree You cursed has withered.”
aov_text: En Petrus het onthou en vir Hom gesê: Rabbi, kyk, die vyeboom wat U vervloek het, is verdroog.

kjv_text: And Jesus answering saith unto them, Have faith in God.
bsb_text: “Have faith in God,” Jesus said to them.
aov_text: Jesus antwoord en sê vir hulle: Julle moet geloof in God hê.

kjv_text: For verily I say unto you, That whosoever shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he saith shall come to pass; he shall have whatsoever he saith.
bsb_text: “Truly I tell you that if anyone says to this mountain, ‘Be lifted up and thrown into the sea,’ and has no doubt in his heart but believes that it will happen, it will be done for him.
aov_text: Want, voorwaar Ek sê vir julle dat elkeen wat vir hierdie berg sê: Hef jou op en werp jou in die see — en nie in sy hart twyfel nie, maar glo dat wat hy sê, sal gebeur — hy sal verkry net wat hy sê.

kjv_text: Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.
bsb_text: Therefore I tell you, whatever you ask for in prayer, believe that you have received it, and it will be yours.
aov_text: Daarom sê Ek vir julle: Alles wat julle in die gebed vra, glo dat julle dit sal ontvang, en julle sal dit verkry.

kjv_text: And when ye stand praying, forgive, if ye have ought against any: that your Father also which is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses.
bsb_text: And when you stand to pray, if you hold anything against another, forgive it, so that your Father in heaven will forgive your trespasses as well.”
aov_text: En wanneer julle staan en bid, vergeef as julle iets teen iemand het, sodat julle Vader wat in die hemele is, ook julle jul oortredinge mag vergewe.

kjv_text: But if ye do not forgive, neither will your Father which is in heaven forgive your trespasses.
aov_text: Maar as julle nie vergewe nie, sal julle Vader wat in die hemele is, ook julle oortredinge nie vergewe nie.

kjv_text: And they come again to Jerusalem: and as he was walking in the temple, there come to him the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders,
bsb_text: After their return to Jerusalem, Jesus was walking in the temple courts, and the chief priests, scribes, and elders came up to Him.
aov_text: EN hulle het weer in Jerusalem gekom. En terwyl Hy in die tempel rondwandel, kom die owerpriesters en die skrifgeleerdes en die ouderlinge na Hom

kjv_text: And say unto him, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority to do these things?
bsb_text: “By what authority are You doing these things?” they asked. “And who gave You the authority to do them?”
aov_text: en sê vir Hom: Deur watter gesag doen U hierdie dinge, en wie het U dié gesag gegee om dit te doen?

kjv_text: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I will also ask of you one question, and answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.
bsb_text: “I will ask you one question,” Jesus replied, “and if you answer Me, I will tell you by what authority I am doing these things.
aov_text: En Jesus antwoord en sê vir hulle: Ek sal julle ook een ding vra, en antwoord julle My, dan sal Ek julle vertel deur watter gesag Ek hierdie dinge doen.

kjv_text: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men? answer me.
bsb_text: John’s baptism—was it from heaven or from men? Answer Me!”
aov_text: Die doop van Johannes, was dit uit die hemel of uit mense? Antwoord My.

kjv_text: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then did ye not believe him?
bsb_text: They deliberated among themselves what they should answer: “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ He will ask, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’
aov_text: En hulle het by hulleself geredeneer en gesê: As ons sê: Uit die hemel — sal Hy sê: Waarom het julle hom dan nie geglo nie?

kjv_text: But if we shall say, Of men; they feared the people: for all men counted John, that he was a prophet indeed.
bsb_text: But if we say, ‘From men’...” they were afraid of the people, for they all held that John truly was a prophet.
aov_text: Maar as ons sê: Uit mense — dan was hulle vir die volk bang, want almal het gedink dat Johannes werklik ’n profeet was.

kjv_text: And they answered and said unto Jesus, We cannot tell. And Jesus answering saith unto them, Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.
bsb_text: So they answered, “We do not know.” And Jesus replied, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things.”
aov_text: En hulle antwoord en sê vir Jesus: Ons weet nie. En Jesus antwoord en sê vir hulle: Dan vertel Ek julle ook nie deur watter gesag Ek hierdie dinge doen nie.

kjv_text: And he began to speak unto them by parables. A certain man planted a vineyard, and set an hedge about it, and digged a place for the winefat, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country.
bsb_text: Then Jesus began to speak to them in parables: “A man planted a vineyard. He put a wall around it, dug a wine vat, and built a watchtower. Then he rented it out to some tenants and went away on a journey.
aov_text: TOE begin Hy deur gelykenisse vir hulle te sê: ’n Man het ’n wingerd geplant en ’n heining daarom gesit en ’n parskuip gegrawe en ’n wagtoring gebou, en hy het dit aan landbouers verhuur en op reis gegaan.

kjv_text: And at the season he sent to the husbandmen a servant, that he might receive from the husbandmen of the fruit of the vineyard.
bsb_text: At harvest time, he sent a servant to the tenants to collect his share of the fruit of the vineyard.
aov_text: En op die regte tyd het hy ’n dienskneg na die landbouers gestuur om van die landbouers uit die vrug van die wingerd te ontvang;

kjv_text: And they caught him, and beat him, and sent him away empty.
bsb_text: But they seized the servant, beat him, and sent him away empty-handed.
aov_text: maar hulle het hom geneem en geslaan en hom met leë hande weggestuur.

kjv_text: And again he sent unto them another servant; and at him they cast stones, and wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully handled.
bsb_text: Then he sent them another servant, and they struck him over the head and treated him shamefully.
aov_text: En weer het hy ’n ander dienskneg na hulle gestuur; en hom het hulle gestenig en aan die hoof gewond, hom skandelik behandel en teruggestuur.

kjv_text: And again he sent another; and him they killed, and many others; beating some, and killing some.
bsb_text: He sent still another, and this one they killed. He sent many others; some they beat and others they killed.
aov_text: En weer het hy ’n ander een gestuur, en hom het hulle doodgemaak; ook baie ander — sommige het hulle geslaan en ander doodgemaak.

kjv_text: Having yet therefore one son, his wellbeloved, he sent him also last unto them, saying, They will reverence my son.
bsb_text: Finally, having one beloved son, he sent him to them. ‘They will respect my son,’ he said.
aov_text: Hy het toe nog een seun gehad, sy geliefde, en hom die laaste na hulle gestuur en gesê: Hulle sal my seun ontsien.

kjv_text: But those husbandmen said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and the inheritance shall be our's.
bsb_text: But the tenants said to one another, ‘This is the heir. Come, let us kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’
aov_text: Maar daardie landbouers het by hulleself gesê: Dit is die erfgenaam; kom laat ons hom doodmaak, en die erfdeel sal ons s’n wees.

kjv_text: And they took him, and killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.
bsb_text: So they seized the son, killed him, and threw him out of the vineyard.
aov_text: En hulle het hom geneem en doodgemaak en buitekant die wingerd uitgewerp.

kjv_text: What shall therefore the lord of the vineyard do? he will come and destroy the husbandmen, and will give the vineyard unto others.
bsb_text: What then will the owner of the vineyard do? He will come and kill those tenants, and will give the vineyard to others.
aov_text: Wat sal die eienaar van die wingerd dan doen? Hy sal kom en die landbouers ombring en die wingerd aan ander gee.

kjv_text: And have ye not read this scripture; The stone which the builders rejected is become the head of the corner:
bsb_text: Have you never read this Scripture: ‘The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
aov_text: Het julle nie ook hierdie Skrifwoord gelees nie: Die steen wat die bouers verwerp het, dit het ’n hoeksteen geword?

kjv_text: This was the Lord's doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?
bsb_text: This is from the Lord, and it is marvelous in our eyes’?”
aov_text: Hy het van die Here gekom en is wonderbaar in ons oë.

kjv_text: And they sought to lay hold on him, but feared the people: for they knew that he had spoken the parable against them: and they left him, and went their way.
bsb_text: At this, the leaders sought to arrest Jesus, for they knew that He had spoken this parable against them. But fearing the crowd, they left Him and went away.
aov_text: En hulle het probeer om Hom in die hande te kry, maar was bang vir die skare, want hulle het begryp dat Hy die gelykenis met die oog op hulle uitgespreek het. Daarop het hulle Hom verlaat en weggegaan.

kjv_text: And they send unto him certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians, to catch him in his words.
bsb_text: Later, they sent some of the Pharisees and Herodians to catch Jesus in His words.
aov_text: TOE stuur hulle na Hom sommige van die Fariseërs en van die Herodiane om Hom op ’n woord te betrap.

kjv_text: And when they were come, they say unto him, Master, we know that thou art true, and carest for no man: for thou regardest not the person of men, but teachest the way of God in truth: Is it lawful to give tribute to Caesar, or not?
bsb_text: “Teacher,” they said, “we know that You are honest and seek favor from no one. Indeed, You are impartial and teach the way of God in accordance with the truth. Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar or not?
aov_text: En hulle kom en sê vir Hom: Meester, ons weet dat U waaragtig is en U aan niemand steur nie; want U sien nie die persoon van mense aan nie, maar U leer die weg van God in waarheid. Is dit geoorloof om aan die keiser belasting te betaal of nie?

kjv_text: Shall we give, or shall we not give?
bsb_text: Should we pay them or not?”
aov_text: Moet ons betaal of moet ons nie betaal nie?

kjv_text: But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said unto them, Why tempt ye me? bring me a penny, that I may see it.
bsb_text: But Jesus saw through their hypocrisy and said, “Why are you testing Me? Bring Me a denarius to inspect.”
aov_text: Maar Hy het hulle geveinsdheid geken en vir hulle gesê: Waarom versoek julle My? Bring vir My ’n penning, dat Ek dit kan sien.

kjv_text: And they brought it. And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription? And they said unto him, Caesar's.
bsb_text: So they brought it, and He asked them, “Whose image is this? And whose inscription?” “Caesar’s,” they answered.
aov_text: En hulle het dit gebring. En Hy sê vir hulle: Wie se beeld en opskrif is dit? En hulle antwoord Hom: Die keiser s’n.

kjv_text: And Jesus answering said unto them, Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's. And they marvelled at him.
bsb_text: Then Jesus told them, “Give to Caesar what is Caesar’s, and to God what is God’s.” And they marveled at Him.
aov_text: Toe antwoord Jesus en sê vir hulle: Betaal aan die keiser wat die keiser toekom, en aan God wat God toekom. En hulle was verwonderd oor Hom.

kjv_text: Then come unto him the Sadducees, which say there is no resurrection; and they asked him, saying,
bsb_text: Then the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to Jesus and questioned Him:
aov_text: TOE kom daar Sadduseërs na Hom, die wat sê dat daar geen opstanding is nie, en hulle vra Hom en sê:

kjv_text: Master, Moses wrote unto us, If a man's brother die, and leave his wife behind him, and leave no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
bsb_text: “Teacher, Moses wrote for us that if a man’s brother dies and leaves a wife but no children, the man is to marry his brother’s widow and raise up offspring for him.
aov_text: Meester, Moses het ons voorgeskrywe: As iemand se broer sterwe en ’n vrou agterlaat en geen kinders nalaat nie, moet sy broer sy vrou neem en kinders vir sy broer verwek.

kjv_text: Now there were seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and dying left no seed.
bsb_text: Now there were seven brothers. The first one married and died, leaving no children.
aov_text: Nou was daar sewe broers, en die eerste het ’n vrou geneem en gesterwe sonder om kinders na te laat.

kjv_text: And the second took her, and died, neither left he any seed: and the third likewise.
bsb_text: Then the second one married the widow, but he also died and left no children. And the third did likewise.
aov_text: En die tweede het haar geneem en gesterwe, en hy het ook geen kinders nagelaat nie; en die derde net so.

kjv_text: And the seven had her, and left no seed: last of all the woman died also.
bsb_text: In this way, none of the seven left any children. And last of all, the woman died.
aov_text: En al sewe het haar geneem en geen kinders nagelaat nie. Laaste van almal het die vrou ook gesterwe.

kjv_text: In the resurrection therefore, when they shall rise, whose wife shall she be of them? for the seven had her to wife.
bsb_text: In the resurrection, then, whose wife will she be? For all seven were married to her.”
aov_text: In die opstanding dan, wanneer hulle opstaan, wie van hulle se vrou sal sy wees?  — want al sewe het haar as vrou gehad.

kjv_text: And Jesus answering said unto them, Do ye not therefore err, because ye know not the scriptures, neither the power of God?
bsb_text: Jesus said to them, “Aren’t you mistaken, because you do not know the Scriptures or the power of God?
aov_text: En Jesus antwoord en sê vir hulle: Is dit nie daarom dat julle dwaal dat julle die Skrifte en ook die krag van God nie ken nie?

kjv_text: For when they shall rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage; but are as the angels which are in heaven.
bsb_text: When the dead rise, they will neither marry nor be given in marriage. Instead, they will be like the angels in heaven.
aov_text: Want wanneer hulle uit die dode opstaan, trou hulle nie en word hulle nie in die huwelik uitgegee nie, maar is soos engele wat in die hemele is.

kjv_text: And as touching the dead, that they rise: have ye not read in the book of Moses, how in the bush God spake unto him, saying, I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?
bsb_text: But concerning the dead rising, have you not read about the burning bush in the Book of Moses, how God told him, ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’?
aov_text: En wat die dode betref, dat hulle opstaan — het julle nie gelees in die boek van Moses, in die gedeelte oor die doringbos, hoe God vir hom gesê het: Ek is die God van Abraham en die God van Isak en die God van Jakob nie?

kjv_text: He is not the God of the dead, but the God of the living: ye therefore do greatly err.
bsb_text: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You are badly mistaken!”
aov_text: God is nie ’n God van dooies nie, maar ’n God van lewendes. Julle dwaal dus grootliks.

kjv_text: And one of the scribes came, and having heard them reasoning together, and perceiving that he had answered them well, asked him, Which is the first commandment of all?
bsb_text: Now one of the scribes had come up and heard their debate. Noticing how well Jesus had answered them, he asked Him, “Which commandment is the most important of all?”
aov_text: EN toe een van die skrifgeleerdes wat bygekom het, hulle hoor redetwis, en wis dat Hy hulle goed geantwoord het, vra hy vir Hom: Wat is die eerste gebod van almal?

kjv_text: And Jesus answered him, The first of all the commandments is, Hear, O Israel; The Lord our God is one Lord:
bsb_text: Jesus replied, “This is the most important: ‘Hear O Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is One.
aov_text: En Jesus antwoord hom: Die eerste van al die gebooie is: Hoor, Israel, die Here, onse God, is ’n enige Here;

kjv_text: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength: this is the first commandment.
bsb_text: Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind and with all your strength.’
aov_text: en jy moet die Here jou God liefhê uit jou hele hart en uit jou hele siel en uit jou hele verstand en uit jou hele krag. Dit is die eerste gebod.

kjv_text: And the second is like, namely this, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.
bsb_text: The second is this: ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’ No other commandment is greater than these.”
aov_text: En die tweede, hieraan gelyk, is dit: Jy moet jou naaste liefhê soos jouself. Daar is geen ander gebod groter as dié nie.

kjv_text: And the scribe said unto him, Well, Master, thou hast said the truth: for there is one God; and there is none other but he:
bsb_text: “Right, Teacher,” the scribe replied. “You have stated correctly that God is One and there is no other but Him,
aov_text: En die skrifgeleerde sê vir Hom: Goed, Meester, U het met waarheid gesê dat God een is en daar geen ander is as Hy nie;

kjv_text: And to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbour as himself, is more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.
bsb_text: and to love Him with all your heart and with all your understanding and with all your strength, and to love your neighbor as yourself, which is more important than all burnt offerings and sacrifices.”
aov_text: en om Hom lief te hê uit die hele hart en uit die hele verstand en uit die hele siel en uit die hele krag, en om die naaste lief te hê soos jouself, is meer as al die brandoffers en die slagoffers.

kjv_text: And when Jesus saw that he answered discreetly, he said unto him, Thou art not far from the kingdom of God. And no man after that durst ask him any question.
bsb_text: When Jesus saw that the man had answered wisely, He said, “You are not far from the kingdom of God.” And no one dared to question Him any further.
aov_text: Toe Jesus sien dat hy verstandig geantwoord het, sê Hy vir hom: Jy is nie ver van die koninkryk van God nie. En niemand het dit meer gewaag om Hom vrae te stel nie.

kjv_text: And Jesus answered and said, while he taught in the temple, How say the scribes that Christ is the son of David?
bsb_text: While Jesus was teaching in the temple courts, He asked, “How can the scribes say that the Christ is the Son of David?
aov_text: EN terwyl Jesus in die tempel leer, antwoord Hy en sê: Hoe sê die skrifgeleerdes dat die Christus die seun van Dawid is?

kjv_text: For David himself said by the Holy Ghost, The LORD said to my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool.
bsb_text: Speaking by the Holy Spirit, David himself declared: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at My right hand until I put Your enemies under Your feet.”’
aov_text: Want Dawid self het deur die Heilige Gees gesê: Die Here het tot my Here gespreek: Sit aan my regterhand totdat Ek u vyande gemaak het ’n voetbank van u voete.

kjv_text: David therefore himself calleth him Lord; and whence is he then his son? And the common people heard him gladly.
bsb_text: David himself calls Him ‘Lord.’ So how can He be David’s son?” And the large crowd listened to Him with delight.
aov_text: Dawid self noem Hom dus Here; waarvandaan is Hy dan sy seun? En die groot menigte het graag na Hom geluister.

kjv_text: And he said unto them in his doctrine, Beware of the scribes, which love to go in long clothing, and love salutations in the marketplaces,
bsb_text: In His teaching Jesus also said, “Watch out for the scribes. They like to walk around in long robes, to receive greetings in the marketplaces,
aov_text: EN Hy het aan hulle in sy onderrig gesê: Pas op vir die skrifgeleerdes wat graag in lang klere rondloop en van begroetinge op die markte hou

kjv_text: And the chief seats in the synagogues, and the uppermost rooms at feasts:
bsb_text: and to have the chief seats in the synagogues and the places of honor at banquets.
aov_text: en van die voorste banke in die sinagoges en die voorste plekke by die maaltye  —

kjv_text: Which devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayers: these shall receive greater damnation.
bsb_text: They defraud widows of their houses, and for a show make lengthy prayers. These men will receive greater condemnation.”
aov_text: hulle wat die huise van die weduwees opeet en vir die skyn lang gebede doen. Hulle sal ’n swaarder oordeel ontvang.

kjv_text: And Jesus sat over against the treasury, and beheld how the people cast money into the treasury: and many that were rich cast in much.
bsb_text: As Jesus was sitting opposite the treasury, He watched the crowd putting money into it. And many rich people put in large amounts.
aov_text: EN Jesus het reg voor die skatkis gaan sit en gekyk hoe die skare geld in die skatkis gooi. En baie rykes het veel ingegooi.

kjv_text: And there came a certain poor widow, and she threw in two mites, which make a farthing.
bsb_text: Then one poor widow came and put in two small copper coins, which amounted to a small fraction of a denarius.
aov_text: En daar kom een arm weduwee en gooi twee geldstukkies in, dit is ’n oortjie.

kjv_text: And he called unto him his disciples, and saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That this poor widow hath cast more in, than all they which have cast into the treasury:
bsb_text: Jesus called His disciples to Him and said, “Truly I tell you, this poor widow has put more than all the others into the treasury.
aov_text: Toe roep Hy sy dissipels na Hom en sê vir hulle: Voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, hierdie arm weduwee het meer ingegooi as almal wat in die skatkis gegooi het.

kjv_text: For all they did cast in of their abundance; but she of her want did cast in all that she had, even all her living.
bsb_text: For they all contributed out of their surplus, but she out of her poverty has put in all she had to live on.”
aov_text: Want hulle het almal uit hulle oorvloed ingegooi; maar sy het uit haar gebrek ingegooi alles wat sy gehad het, haar hele lewensonderhoud.

kjv_text: And as he went out of the temple, one of his disciples saith unto him, Master, see what manner of stones and what buildings are here!
bsb_text: As Jesus was leaving the temple, one of His disciples said to Him, “Teacher, look at the magnificent stones and buildings!”
aov_text: EN toe Hy uit die tempel uitgaan, sê een van sy dissipels vir Hom: Meester, kyk watter klippe en watter geboue!

kjv_text: And Jesus answering said unto him, Seest thou these great buildings? there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
bsb_text: “Do you see all these great buildings?” Jesus replied. “Not one stone here will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.”
aov_text: En Jesus antwoord en sê vir hom: Sien jy hierdie groot geboue? Daar sal sekerlik nie een klip op die ander gelaat word wat nie afgebreek sal word nie!

kjv_text: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives over against the temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew asked him privately,
bsb_text: While Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter, James, John, and Andrew asked Him privately,
aov_text: En toe Hy gaan sit het op die Olyfberg, regoor die tempel, vra Petrus en Jakobus en Johannes en Andréas Hom afsonderlik:

kjv_text: Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled?
bsb_text: “Tell us, when will these things happen? And what will be the sign that they are about to be fulfilled?”
aov_text: Vertel ons, wanneer sal hierdie dinge wees, en wat is die teken wanneer al hierdie dinge volbring word?

kjv_text: And Jesus answering them began to say, Take heed lest any man deceive you:
bsb_text: Jesus began by telling them, “See to it that no one deceives you.
aov_text: En Jesus antwoord hulle en begin te sê: Pas op dat niemand julle mislei nie.

kjv_text: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.
bsb_text: Many will come in My name, claiming, ‘I am He,’ and will deceive many.
aov_text: Want baie sal onder my Naam kom en sê: Dit is ek! En hulle sal baie mense mislei.

kjv_text: And when ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars, be ye not troubled: for such things must needs be; but the end shall not be yet.
bsb_text: When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, do not be alarmed. These things must happen, but the end is still to come.
aov_text: Maar wanneer julle hoor van oorloë en gerugte van oorloë, moet julle nie verskrik word nie, want dit moet kom. Maar dit is nog nie die einde nie.

kjv_text: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be earthquakes in divers places, and there shall be famines and troubles: these are the beginnings of sorrows.
bsb_text: Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in various places, as well as famines. These are the beginning of birth pains.
aov_text: Want die een nasie sal teen die ander opstaan, en die een koninkryk teen die ander; en daar sal aardbewings wees op verskillende plekke, en daar sal hongersnode wees en beroeringe. Hierdie dinge is ’n begin van die smarte.

kjv_text: But take heed to yourselves: for they shall deliver you up to councils; and in the synagogues ye shall be beaten: and ye shall be brought before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them.
bsb_text: So be on your guard. You will be delivered over to the councils and beaten in the synagogues. On My account you will stand before governors and kings as witnesses to them.
aov_text: Maar wees julle vir julleself op die hoede, want hulle sal julle oorlewer aan regbanke, en in sinagoges sal julle geslaan word en voor goewerneurs en konings gebring word om My ontwil, vir hulle tot ’n getuienis.

kjv_text: And the gospel must first be published among all nations.
bsb_text: And the gospel must first be proclaimed to all the nations.
aov_text: En die evangelie moet eers aan al die nasies verkondig word.

kjv_text: But when they shall lead you, and deliver you up, take no thought beforehand what ye shall speak, neither do ye premeditate: but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour, that speak ye: for it is not ye that speak, but the Holy Ghost.
bsb_text: But when they arrest you and hand you over, do not worry beforehand what to say. Instead, speak whatever you are given at that time, for it will not be you speaking, but the Holy Spirit.
aov_text: En wanneer hulle jul weglei om julle oor te lewer, moenie julle vooraf kwel oor wat julle sal spreek nie, en moenie daaroor dink nie; maar wat julle in dié uur gegee word, dit moet julle spreek; want dit is nie julle wat spreek nie, maar die Heilige Gees.

kjv_text: Now the brother shall betray the brother to death, and the father the son; and children shall rise up against their parents, and shall cause them to be put to death.
bsb_text: Brother will betray brother to death, and a father his child. Children will rise against their parents and have them put to death.
aov_text: En die een broer sal die ander tot die dood oorlewer, en die vader sy kind, en die kinders sal teen hulle ouers opstaan en hulle doodmaak.

kjv_text: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake: but he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.
bsb_text: You will be hated by everyone because of My name, but the one who perseveres to the end will be saved.
aov_text: En julle sal deur almal gehaat word ter wille van my Naam. Maar wie volhard tot die einde toe, hy sal gered word.

kjv_text: But when ye shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not, (let him that readeth understand,) then let them that be in Judaea flee to the mountains:
bsb_text: So when you see the abomination of desolation standing where it should not be (let the reader understand), then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.
aov_text: EN wanneer julle die gruwel van die verwoesting, waarvan gespreek is deur die profeet Daniël, sien staan waar dit nie behoort nie — laat hom wat lees, oplet — dan moet die wat in Judéa is, na die berge vlug;

kjv_text: And let him that is on the housetop not go down into the house, neither enter therein, to take any thing out of his house:
bsb_text: Let no one on the housetop go back inside to retrieve anything from his house.
aov_text: en wie op die dak is, moet nie afkom in die huis en ook nie ingaan om iets uit sy huis weg te neem nie;

kjv_text: And let him that is in the field not turn back again for to take up his garment.
bsb_text: And let no one in the field return for his cloak.
aov_text: en wie op die land is, moet nie omdraai na wat agter is om sy kleed weg te neem nie.

kjv_text: But woe to them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!
bsb_text: How miserable those days will be for pregnant and nursing mothers!
aov_text: Maar wee die vroue wat swanger is en die wat nog soog, in daardie dae!

kjv_text: And pray ye that your flight be not in the winter.
bsb_text: Pray that this will not occur in the winter.
aov_text: En bid dat julle vlug nie in die winter mag plaasvind nie.

kjv_text: For in those days shall be affliction, such as was not from the beginning of the creation which God created unto this time, neither shall be.
bsb_text: For those will be days of tribulation unmatched from the beginning of God’s creation until now, and never to be seen again.
aov_text: Want daardie dae sal daar ’n verdrukking wees soos daar nie gewees het van die begin van die skepping af wat God geskape het tot nou toe, en ook nooit sal wees nie.

kjv_text: And except that the Lord had shortened those days, no flesh should be saved: but for the elect's sake, whom he hath chosen, he hath shortened the days.
bsb_text: If the Lord had not cut short those days, nobody would be saved. But for the sake of the elect, whom He has chosen, He has cut them short.
aov_text: En as die Here dié dae nie verkort het nie, sou geen vlees gered word nie; maar ter wille van die uitverkorenes wat Hy uitverkies het, het Hy dié dae verkort.

kjv_text: And then if any man shall say to you, Lo, here is Christ; or, lo, he is there; believe him not:
bsb_text: At that time if anyone says to you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or ‘There He is!’ do not believe it.
aov_text: En as iemand dán vir julle sê: Kyk, hier is die Christus! of: Kyk, daar! — moet dit nie glo nie.

kjv_text: For false Christs and false prophets shall rise, and shall shew signs and wonders, to seduce, if it were possible, even the elect.
bsb_text: For false Christs and false prophets will appear and perform signs and wonders that would deceive even the elect, if that were possible.
aov_text: Want daar sal valse christusse en valse profete opstaan, en hulle sal tekens en wonders doen om, as dit moontlik was, ook die uitverkorenes te mislei.

kjv_text: But take ye heed: behold, I have foretold you all things.
bsb_text: So be on your guard; I have told you everything in advance.
aov_text: Maar julle moet op jul hoede wees. Kyk, Ek het alles vir julle vooruit gesê.

kjv_text: But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light,
bsb_text: But in those days, after that tribulation: ‘The sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light;
aov_text: MAAR in daardie dae, ná dié verdrukking, sal die son verduister word, en die maan sal sy glans nie gee nie,

kjv_text: And the stars of heaven shall fall, and the powers that are in heaven shall be shaken.
bsb_text: the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken.’
aov_text: en die sterre van die hemel sal val, en die kragte wat in die hemele is, sal geskud word.

kjv_text: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.
bsb_text: At that time they will see the Son of Man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.
aov_text: En dan sal hulle die Seun van die mens op die wolke sien kom met groot krag en heerlikheid.

kjv_text: And then shall he send his angels, and shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from the uttermost part of the earth to the uttermost part of heaven.
bsb_text: And He will send out the angels to gather His elect from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of heaven.
aov_text: En dan sal Hy sy engele uitstuur, en Hy sal sy uitverkorenes uit die vier windstreke versamel, van die einde van die aarde af tot by die einde van die hemel.

kjv_text: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When her branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is near:
bsb_text: Now learn this lesson from the fig tree: As soon as its branches become tender and sprout leaves, you know that summer is near.
aov_text: En leer van die vyeboom hierdie gelykenis: Wanneer sy tak al sag word en sy blare uitbot, weet julle dat die somer naby is.

kjv_text: So ye in like manner, when ye shall see these things come to pass, know that it is nigh, even at the doors.
bsb_text: So also, when you see these things happening, know that He is near, right at the door.
aov_text: So weet julle ook, wanneer julle hierdie dinge sien gebeur, dat dit naby is, voor die deur.

kjv_text: Verily I say unto you, that this generation shall not pass, till all these things be done.
bsb_text: Truly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all these things have happened.
aov_text: Voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, hierdie geslag sal sekerlik nie verbygaan voordat al hierdie dinge gebeur het nie.

kjv_text: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.
bsb_text: Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will never pass away.
aov_text: Die hemel en die aarde sal verbygaan, maar my woorde sal nooit verbygaan nie.

kjv_text: But of that day and that hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels which are in heaven, neither the Son, but the Father.
bsb_text: No one knows about that day or hour, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.
aov_text: Maar van daardie dag en dié uur weet niemand nie, ook nie die engele in die hemel of die Seun nie, maar net die Vader.

kjv_text: Take ye heed, watch and pray: for ye know not when the time is.
bsb_text: Be on your guard and stay alert! For you do not know when the appointed time will come.
aov_text: PAS op, waak en bid, want julle weet nie wanneer die tyd daar is nie.

kjv_text: For the Son of man is as a man taking a far journey, who left his house, and gave authority to his servants, and to every man his work, and commanded the porter to watch.
bsb_text: It is like a man going on a journey who left his house, put each servant in charge of his own task, and instructed the doorkeeper to keep watch.
aov_text: Dit is soos ’n man wat op reis is, wat sy huis agtergelaat en sy diensknegte volmag gegee het, en vir elkeen sy werk, en aan die deurwagter bevel gegee het om te waak.

kjv_text: Watch ye therefore: for ye know not when the master of the house cometh, at even, or at midnight, or at the cockcrowing, or in the morning:
bsb_text: Therefore keep watch, because you do not know when the master of the house will return—whether in the evening, at midnight, when the rooster crows, or in the morning.
aov_text: Waak dan, want julle weet nie wanneer die eienaar van die huis kom nie: in die aand of middernag of met die haangekraai of vroeg in die môre nie;

kjv_text: Lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping.
bsb_text: Otherwise, he may arrive without notice and find you sleeping.
aov_text: dat hy nie miskien skielik kom en julle aan die slaap vind nie.

kjv_text: And what I say unto you I say unto all, Watch.
bsb_text: And what I say to you, I say to everyone: Keep watch!”
aov_text: En wat Ek vir julle sê, sê Ek vir almal: Waak!

kjv_text: After two days was the feast of the passover, and of unleavened bread: and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take him by craft, and put him to death.
bsb_text: Now the Passover and the Feast of Unleavened Bread were two days away, and the chief priests and scribes were looking for a covert way to arrest Jesus and kill Him.
aov_text: EN die pasga en die fees van die ongesuurde brode sou oor twee dae wees; en die owerpriesters en die skrifgeleerdes het gesoek hoe hulle Hom met lis gevange kon neem en doodmaak.

kjv_text: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar of the people.
bsb_text: “But not during the feast,” they said, “or there may be a riot among the people.”
aov_text: Maar hulle het gesê: Nie op die fees nie, sodat daar nie miskien ’n oproer onder die volk kom nie.

kjv_text: And being in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at meat, there came a woman having an alabaster box of ointment of spikenard very precious; and she brake the box, and poured it on his head.
bsb_text: While Jesus was in Bethany reclining at the table in the home of Simon the Leper, a woman came with an alabaster jar of expensive perfume, made of pure nard. She broke open the jar and poured it on Jesus’ head.
aov_text: EN toe Hy in Betánië was, in die huis van Simon, die melaatse, terwyl Hy aan tafel was, kom daar ’n vrou met ’n albaste fles met egte, baie kosbare nardussalf; en sy breek die albaste fles en gooi dit op sy hoof uit.

kjv_text: And there were some that had indignation within themselves, and said, Why was this waste of the ointment made?
bsb_text: Some of those present, however, expressed their indignation to one another: “Why this waste of perfume?
aov_text: En daar was sommige wat by hulleself verontwaardig was en gesê het: Waarvoor het hierdie verkwisting van die salf plaasgevind?

kjv_text: For it might have been sold for more than three hundred pence, and have been given to the poor. And they murmured against her.
bsb_text: It could have been sold for over three hundred denarii and the money given to the poor.” And they scolded her.
aov_text: Want dit kon vir meer as driehonderd pennings verkoop en die geld aan die armes gegee geword het. En hulle het teen haar uitgevaar.

kjv_text: And Jesus said, Let her alone; why trouble ye her? she hath wrought a good work on me.
bsb_text: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone; why are you bothering her? She has done a beautiful deed to Me.
aov_text: Maar Jesus sê: Laat haar staan; waarom val julle haar lastig? Sy het ’n goeie werk aan My gedoen.

kjv_text: For ye have the poor with you always, and whensoever ye will ye may do them good: but me ye have not always.
bsb_text: The poor you will always have with you, and you can help them whenever you want. But you will not always have Me.
aov_text: Want die armes het julle altyd by julle, en wanneer julle wil, kan julle aan hulle goed doen; maar My het julle nie altyd nie.

kjv_text: She hath done what she could: she is come aforehand to anoint my body to the burying.
bsb_text: She has done what she could to anoint My body in advance of My burial.
aov_text: Wat sy kon, het sy gedoen. Sy het vooruit al my liggaam vir die begrafnis gesalf.

kjv_text: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached throughout the whole world, this also that she hath done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her.
bsb_text: And truly I tell you, wherever the gospel is preached in all the world, what she has done will also be told in memory of her.”
aov_text: Voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, oral waar hierdie evangelie oor die hele wêreld verkondig word, daar sal ook gespreek word van wat sy gedoen het, tot ’n gedagtenis aan haar.

kjv_text: And Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve, went unto the chief priests, to betray him unto them.
bsb_text: Then Judas Iscariot, one of the Twelve, went to the chief priests to betray Jesus to them.
aov_text: EN Judas Iskáriot, een van die twaalf, het na die owerpriesters gegaan om Hom aan hulle oor te lewer.

kjv_text: And when they heard it, they were glad, and promised to give him money. And he sought how he might conveniently betray him.
bsb_text: They were delighted to hear this, and they promised to give him money. So Judas began to look for an opportunity to betray Jesus.
aov_text: En toe hulle dit hoor, was hulle bly en het belowe om hom geld te gee. En hy het na ’n goeie geleentheid gesoek om Hom oor te lewer.

kjv_text: And the first day of unleavened bread, when they killed the passover, his disciples said unto him, Where wilt thou that we go and prepare that thou mayest eat the passover?
bsb_text: On the first day of the Feast of Unleavened Bread, when the Passover lamb was to be sacrificed, Jesus’ disciples asked Him, “Where do You want us to prepare for You to eat the Passover?”
aov_text: EN op die eerste dag van die ongesuurde brode, wanneer hulle gewoonlik die pasga geslag het, sê sy dissipels vir Hom: Waar wil U hê moet ons gaan klaarmaak, dat U die pasga kan eet?

kjv_text: And he sendeth forth two of his disciples, and saith unto them, Go ye into the city, and there shall meet you a man bearing a pitcher of water: follow him.
bsb_text: So He sent two of His disciples and told them, “Go into the city, and a man carrying a jug of water will meet you. Follow him,
aov_text: En Hy stuur twee van sy dissipels en sê vir hulle: Gaan na die stad toe; en ’n man wat ’n kruik water dra, sal julle tegemoetkom. Volg hom,

kjv_text: And wheresoever he shall go in, say ye to the goodman of the house, The Master saith, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?
bsb_text: and whichever house he enters, say to the owner, ‘The Teacher asks: Where is My guest room, where I may eat the Passover with My disciples?’
aov_text: en waar hy ook mag ingaan, moet julle vir die eienaar van die huis sê: Die Meester laat weet: Waar is die kamer waar Ek met my dissipels die pasga kan eet?

kjv_text: And he will shew you a large upper room furnished and prepared: there make ready for us.
bsb_text: And he will show you a large upper room, furnished and ready. Make preparations for us there.”
aov_text: En hy sal julle ’n groot bovertrek wys, in gereedheid gebring. Daar moet julle vir ons klaarmaak.

kjv_text: And his disciples went forth, and came into the city, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.
bsb_text: So the disciples left and went into the city, where they found everything as Jesus had described. And they prepared the Passover.
aov_text: En sy dissipels het gegaan en in die stad gekom en dit gevind soos Hy vir hulle gesê het; en hulle het die pasga toeberei.

kjv_text: And in the evening he cometh with the twelve.
bsb_text: When evening came, Jesus arrived with the Twelve.
aov_text: En toe dit aand geword het, kom Hy met die twaalf.

kjv_text: And as they sat and did eat, Jesus said, Verily I say unto you, One of you which eateth with me shall betray me.
bsb_text: And while they were reclining and eating, Jesus said, “Truly I tell you, one of you who is eating with Me will betray Me.”
aov_text: En terwyl hulle aan tafel was en eet, sê Jesus: Voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, een van julle sal My verraai, een wat saam met My eet.

kjv_text: And they began to be sorrowful, and to say unto him one by one, Is it I? and another said, Is it I?
bsb_text: They began to be grieved and to ask Him one after another, “Surely not I?”
aov_text: Toe het hulle begin om bedroef te word en een vir een aan Hom te sê: Is dit miskien ek? En ’n ander een: Is dit miskien ek?

kjv_text: And he answered and said unto them, It is one of the twelve, that dippeth with me in the dish.
bsb_text: He answered, “It is one of the Twelve—the one who is dipping his hand into the bowl with Me.
aov_text: En Hy antwoord en sê vir hulle: Dit is een van die twaalf wat saam met My sy hand in die skottel insteek.

kjv_text: The Son of man indeed goeth, as it is written of him: but woe to that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! good were it for that man if he had never been born.
bsb_text: The Son of Man will go just as it is written about Him, but woe to that man by whom He is betrayed! It would be better for him if he had not been born.”
aov_text: Die Seun van die mens gaan wel heen soos daar van Hom geskrywe is; maar wee daardie man deur wie die Seun van die mens verraai word! Dit sou vir hom goed gewees het as daardie man nie gebore was nie.

kjv_text: And as they did eat, Jesus took bread, and blessed, and brake it, and gave to them, and said, Take, eat: this is my body.
bsb_text: While they were eating, Jesus took bread, spoke a blessing and broke it, and gave it to the disciples, saying, “Take it; this is My body.”
aov_text: En terwyl hulle eet, neem Jesus brood, en nadat Hy gedank het, breek Hy dit en gee dit aan hulle en sê: Neem, eet, dit is my liggaam.

kjv_text: And he took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave it to them: and they all drank of it.
bsb_text: Then He took the cup, gave thanks, and gave it to them, and they all drank from it.
aov_text: Toe neem Hy die beker, en nadat Hy gedank het, gee Hy dit aan hulle, en hulle het almal daaruit gedrink.

kjv_text: And he said unto them, This is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many.
bsb_text: He said to them, “This is My blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many.
aov_text: En Hy sê vir hulle: Dit is my bloed, die bloed van die nuwe testament, wat vir baie uitgestort word.

kjv_text: Verily I say unto you, I will drink no more of the fruit of the vine, until that day that I drink it new in the kingdom of God.
bsb_text: Truly I tell you, I will no longer drink of the fruit of the vine until that day when I drink it anew in the kingdom of God.”
aov_text: Voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, Ek sal nooit meer van die vrug van die wynstok drink nie, tot op daardie dag wanneer Ek dit nuut sal drink in die koninkryk van God.

kjv_text: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.
bsb_text: And when they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.
aov_text: En toe hulle die lofsang gesing het, het hulle uitgegaan na die Olyfberg.

kjv_text: And Jesus saith unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered.
bsb_text: Then Jesus said to them, “You will all fall away, for it is written: ‘I will strike the Shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.’
aov_text: TOE sê Jesus vir hulle: Julle sal almal in hierdie nag aanstoot neem aan My; want daar is geskrywe: Ek sal die herder slaan, en die skape sal verstrooi word.

kjv_text: But after that I am risen, I will go before you into Galilee.
bsb_text: But after I have risen, I will go ahead of you into Galilee.”
aov_text: Maar nadat Ek opgestaan het, sal Ek voor julle uit na Galiléa gaan.

kjv_text: But Peter said unto him, Although all shall be offended, yet will not I.
bsb_text: Peter declared, “Even if all fall away, I never will.”
aov_text: En Petrus sê vir Hom: Al sal almal ook aanstoot neem, dan tog nie ek nie.

kjv_text: And Jesus saith unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this day, even in this night, before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice.
bsb_text: “Truly I tell you,” Jesus replied, “this very night, before the rooster crows twice, you will deny Me three times.”
aov_text: Daarop sê Jesus vir hom: Voorwaar Ek sê vir jou, vandag, in hierdie nag, voordat die haan twee maal gekraai het, sal jy My drie maal verloën.

kjv_text: But he spake the more vehemently, If I should die with thee, I will not deny thee in any wise. Likewise also said they all.
bsb_text: But Peter kept insisting, “Even if I have to die with You, I will never deny You.” And all the others said the same thing.
aov_text: Maar hy het nog baie meer aangehou en gesê: Al moes ek saam met U sterwe, ek sal U nooit verloën nie! En net so het almal ook gesê.

kjv_text: And they came to a place which was named Gethsemane: and he saith to his disciples, Sit ye here, while I shall pray.
bsb_text: Then they came to a place called Gethsemane, and Jesus told His disciples, “Sit here while I pray.”
aov_text: TOE kom hulle in ’n plek waarvan die naam Getsémané was. En Hy sê vir sy dissipels: Sit hier onderwyl Ek gaan bid.

kjv_text: And he taketh with him Peter and James and John, and began to be sore amazed, and to be very heavy;
bsb_text: He took with Him Peter, James, and John, and began to be deeply troubled and distressed.
aov_text: En Hy neem Petrus en Jakobus en Johannes saam met Hom en begin ontsteld en benoud te word.

kjv_text: And saith unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful unto death: tarry ye here, and watch.
bsb_text: Then He said to them, “My soul is consumed with sorrow to the point of death. Stay here and keep watch.”
aov_text: En Hy sê vir hulle: My siel is diep bedroef tot die dood toe; bly hier en waak.

kjv_text: And he went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass from him.
bsb_text: Going a little farther, He fell to the ground and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour would pass from Him.
aov_text: En toe Hy ’n bietjie verder gegaan het, val Hy op die grond en bid dat, as dit moontlik was, dié uur by Hom sou verbygaan.

kjv_text: And he said, Abba, Father, all things are possible unto thee; take away this cup from me: nevertheless not what I will, but what thou wilt.
bsb_text: “Abba, Father,” He said, “all things are possible for You. Take this cup from Me. Yet not what I will, but what You will.”
aov_text: En Hy sê: Abba, Vader, alle dinge is vir U moontlik; neem hierdie beker van My weg; nogtans nie wat Ek wil nie, maar wat U wil.

kjv_text: And he cometh, and findeth them sleeping, and saith unto Peter, Simon, sleepest thou? couldest not thou watch one hour?
bsb_text: Then Jesus returned and found them sleeping. “Simon, are you asleep?” He asked. “Were you not able to keep watch for one hour?
aov_text: En Hy kom en vind hulle aan die slaap en sê vir Petrus: Simon, slaap jy? Was jy nie in staat om een uur te waak nie?

kjv_text: Watch ye and pray, lest ye enter into temptation. The spirit truly is ready, but the flesh is weak.
bsb_text: Watch and pray so that you will not enter into temptation. For the spirit is willing, but the body is weak.”
aov_text: Waak en bid, dat julle nie in versoeking kom nie. Die gees is wel gewillig, maar die vlees is swak.

kjv_text: And again he went away, and prayed, and spake the same words.
bsb_text: Again He went away and prayed, saying the same thing.
aov_text: Hy gaan toe weer weg en bid dieselfde woorde.

kjv_text: And when he returned, he found them asleep again, (for their eyes were heavy,) neither wist they what to answer him.
bsb_text: And again Jesus returned and found them sleeping—for their eyes were heavy. And they did not know what to answer Him.
aov_text: En toe Hy terugkom, vind Hy hulle weer aan die slaap, want hulle oë was swaar; en hulle het nie geweet wat om Hom te antwoord nie.

kjv_text: And he cometh the third time, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: it is enough, the hour is come; behold, the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
bsb_text: When Jesus returned the third time, He said, “Are you still sleeping and resting? That is enough! The hour has come. Look, the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
aov_text: En Hy kom vir die derde keer en sê aan hulle: Slaap maar voort en rus. Dit is genoeg; die uur het gekom. Kyk, die Seun van die mens word oorgelewer in die hande van die sondaars.

kjv_text: Rise up, let us go; lo, he that betrayeth me is at hand.
bsb_text: Rise, let us go. See, My betrayer is approaching!”
aov_text: Staan op, laat ons gaan; kyk, hy is naby wat My verraai.

kjv_text: And immediately, while he yet spake, cometh Judas, one of the twelve, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders.
bsb_text: While Jesus was still speaking, Judas, one of the Twelve, arrived, accompanied by a crowd armed with swords and clubs, sent from the chief priests, scribes, and elders.
aov_text: EN dadelik, terwyl Hy nog spreek, verskyn Judas wat een van die twaalf was, en saam met hom ’n groot menigte met swaarde en stokke, gestuur deur die owerpriesters en die skrifgeleerdes en die ouderlinge.

kjv_text: And he that betrayed him had given them a token, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he; take him, and lead him away safely.
bsb_text: Now the betrayer had arranged a signal with them: “The One I kiss is the man; arrest Him and lead Him away securely.”
aov_text: En sy verraaier het ’n teken met hulle afgespreek en gesê: Die een wat ek sal soen — dit is Hy; gryp Hom en neem Hom met sekerheid weg.

kjv_text: And as soon as he was come, he goeth straightway to him, and saith, Master, master; and kissed him.
bsb_text: Going directly to Jesus, he said, “Rabbi!” and kissed Him.
aov_text: En toe hy kom, gaan hy dadelik na Hom en sê: Rabbi, Rabbi! en soen Hom.

kjv_text: And they laid their hands on him, and took him.
bsb_text: Then the men seized Jesus and arrested Him.
aov_text: Daarop slaan hulle hul hande aan Hom en gryp Hom.

kjv_text: And one of them that stood by drew a sword, and smote a servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.
bsb_text: And one of the bystanders drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his ear.
aov_text: En een van die wat daar gestaan het, het sy swaard uitgetrek en die dienskneg van die hoëpriester geslaan en sy oor afgekap.

kjv_text: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Are ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and with staves to take me?
bsb_text: Jesus asked the crowd, “Have you come out with swords and clubs to arrest Me as you would an outlaw?
aov_text: En Jesus antwoord en sê vir hulle: Het julle soos teen ’n rower uitgetrek met swaarde en stokke om My gevange te neem?

kjv_text: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and ye took me not: but the scriptures must be fulfilled.
bsb_text: Every day I was with you, teaching in the temple courts, and you did not arrest Me. But this has happened that the Scriptures would be fulfilled.”
aov_text: Dag vir dag was Ek by julle in die tempel besig om te leer, en julle het My nie gegryp nie. Maar die Skrifte moes vervul word.

kjv_text: And they all forsook him, and fled.
bsb_text: Then everyone deserted Him and fled.
aov_text: Toe het almal Hom verlaat en gevlug.

kjv_text: And there followed him a certain young man, having a linen cloth cast about his naked body; and the young men laid hold on him:
bsb_text: One young man who had been following Jesus was wearing a linen cloth around his body. They caught hold of him,
aov_text: En ’n sekere jongman met ’n linnedoek om sy naakte lyf het Hom gevolg; en die jongmanne het hom gegryp;

kjv_text: And he left the linen cloth, and fled from them naked.
bsb_text: but he pulled free of the linen cloth and ran away naked.
aov_text: maar hy het die linnedoek laat staan en naak van hulle weggevlug.

kjv_text: And they led Jesus away to the high priest: and with him were assembled all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes.
bsb_text: They led Jesus away to the high priest, and all the chief priests, elders, and scribes assembled.
aov_text: EN hulle het Jesus weggelei na die hoëpriester. En al die owerpriesters en die ouderlinge en die skrifgeleerdes het by hom vergader.

kjv_text: And Peter followed him afar off, even into the palace of the high priest: and he sat with the servants, and warmed himself at the fire.
bsb_text: Peter followed Him at a distance, right into the courtyard of the high priest. And he sat with the officers and warmed himself by the fire.
aov_text: En Petrus het Hom van ver af gevolg tot binne-in die paleis van die hoëpriester, en het saam met die dienaars gesit en hom by die vuur warm gemaak.

kjv_text: And the chief priests and all the council sought for witness against Jesus to put him to death; and found none.
bsb_text: Now the chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin were seeking testimony against Jesus to put Him to death, but they did not find any.
aov_text: En die owerpriesters en die hele Raad het getuienis teen Jesus gesoek om Hom dood te maak, en hulle het niks gevind nie;

kjv_text: For many bare false witness against him, but their witness agreed not together.
bsb_text: For many bore false witness against Jesus, but their testimony was inconsistent.
aov_text: want baie het vals teen Hom getuig en die getuienisse was nie eenders nie.

kjv_text: And there arose certain, and bare false witness against him, saying,
bsb_text: Then some men stood up and testified falsely against Him:
aov_text: En sommige het opgestaan en vals teen Hom getuig en gesê:

kjv_text: We heard him say, I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and within three days I will build another made without hands.
bsb_text: “We heard Him say, ‘I will destroy this man-made temple, and in three days I will build another that is made without hands.’”
aov_text: Ons het Hom hoor sê: Ek sal hierdie tempel wat met hande gemaak is, afbreek en in drie dae ’n ander een opbou wat nie met hande gemaak is nie.

kjv_text: But neither so did their witness agree together.
bsb_text: But even their testimony was inconsistent.
aov_text: En selfs so was hulle getuienis nie eenders nie.

kjv_text: And the high priest stood up in the midst, and asked Jesus, saying, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?
bsb_text: So the high priest stood up before them and questioned Jesus, “Have You no answer? What are these men testifying against You?”
aov_text: Toe staan die hoëpriester in hul midde op en vra Jesus en sê: Antwoord U niks nie? Wat getuig hierdie manne teen U?

kjv_text: But he held his peace, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, and said unto him, Art thou the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?
bsb_text: But Jesus remained silent and made no reply. Again the high priest questioned Him, “Are You the Christ, the Son of the Blessed One?”
aov_text: Maar Hy het stilgebly en geen antwoord gegee nie. Weer stel die hoëpriester Hom die vraag en sê vir Hom: Is U die Christus, die Seun van die geseënde God?

kjv_text: And Jesus said, I am: and ye shall see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.
bsb_text: “I am,” said Jesus, “and you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power and coming with the clouds of heaven.”
aov_text: En Jesus sê: Ek is. En u almal sal die Seun van die mens aan die regterhand van die krag van God sien sit en kom met die wolke van die hemel.

kjv_text: Then the high priest rent his clothes, and saith, What need we any further witnesses?
bsb_text: At this, the high priest tore his clothes and declared, “Why do we need any more witnesses?
aov_text: Toe skeur die hoëpriester sy klere en sê: Wat het ons nog getuies nodig!

kjv_text: Ye have heard the blasphemy: what think ye? And they all condemned him to be guilty of death.
bsb_text: You have heard the blasphemy. What is your verdict?” And they all condemned Him as deserving of death.
aov_text: Julle het die godslastering gehoor; wat dink julle? En hulle het almal Hom veroordeel dat Hy die dood skuldig was.

kjv_text: And some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to buffet him, and to say unto him, Prophesy: and the servants did strike him with the palms of their hands.
bsb_text: Then some of them began to spit on Him. They blindfolded Him, struck Him with their fists, and said to Him, “Prophesy!” And the officers received Him with slaps in His face.
aov_text: En sommige het begin om op Hom te spuug en sy aangesig toe te maak en Hom met die vuis te slaan en vir Hom te sê: Profeteer! En die dienaars het Hom met stokke geslaan.

kjv_text: And as Peter was beneath in the palace, there cometh one of the maids of the high priest:
bsb_text: While Peter was in the courtyard below, one of the servant girls of the high priest came down
aov_text: EN terwyl Petrus onder in die binneplaas was, kom daar een van die diensmeisies van die hoëpriester,

kjv_text: And when she saw Peter warming himself, she looked upon him, and said, And thou also wast with Jesus of Nazareth.
bsb_text: and saw him warming himself there. She looked at Peter and said, “You also were with Jesus the Nazarene.”
aov_text: en toe sy Petrus sien, besig om hom warm te maak, kyk sy na hom en sê: Jy was ook by die Nasaréner, Jesus.
