kjv_text: But he denied, saying, I know not, neither understand I what thou sayest. And he went out into the porch; and the cock crew.
bsb_text: But he denied it. “I do not know or even understand what you are talking about,” he said. Then he went out to the gateway, and the rooster crowed.
aov_text: Maar hy het dit ontken en gesê: Ek weet nie en begryp nie wat jy sê nie. En hy het buite na die voorplein gegaan; en die haan het gekraai.

kjv_text: And a maid saw him again, and began to say to them that stood by, This is one of them.
bsb_text: There the servant girl saw him and again said to those standing nearby, “This man is one of them.”
aov_text: En toe die diensmeisie hom weer sien, begin sy aan die wat daar staan, te sê: Hierdie man behoort by hulle.

kjv_text: And he denied it again. And a little after, they that stood by said again to Peter, Surely thou art one of them: for thou art a Galilaean, and thy speech agreeth thereto.
bsb_text: But he denied it again. After a little while, those standing nearby said once more to Peter, “Surely you are one of them, for you too are a Galilean.”
aov_text: Maar hy het dit weer ontken. En ’n bietjie later weer sê die wat daar staan vir Petrus: Waarlik, jy behoort by hulle, want jy is ook ’n Galiléër en jou spraak is net so.

kjv_text: But he began to curse and to swear, saying, I know not this man of whom ye speak.
bsb_text: But he began to curse and swear, “I do not know this man of whom you speak!”
aov_text: Toe begin hy homself te verwens en te sweer: Ek ken nie daardie man van wie julle praat nie.

kjv_text: And the second time the cock crew. And Peter called to mind the word that Jesus said unto him, Before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice. And when he thought thereon, he wept.
bsb_text: And immediately the rooster crowed a second time. Then Peter remembered the word that Jesus had spoken to him: “Before the rooster crows twice, you will deny Me three times.” And he broke down and wept.
aov_text: En vir die tweede keer het die haan gekraai; en Petrus het die woord onthou wat Jesus vir hom gesê het: Voor die haan twee maal gekraai het, sal jy My drie maal verloën. En hy het in trane uitgebars.

kjv_text: And straightway in the morning the chief priests held a consultation with the elders and scribes and the whole council, and bound Jesus, and carried him away, and delivered him to Pilate.
bsb_text: Early in the morning, the chief priests, elders, scribes, and the whole Sanhedrin devised a plan. They bound Jesus, led Him away, and handed Him over to Pilate.
aov_text: EN dadelik, vroeg in die môre, het die owerpriesters saam met die ouderlinge en skrifgeleerdes en die hele Raad ’n besluit geneem; en nadat hulle Jesus geboei het, het hulle Hom weggelei en aan Pilatus oorgelewer.

kjv_text: And Pilate asked him, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answering said unto him, Thou sayest it.
bsb_text: So Pilate questioned Him, “Are You the King of the Jews?” “You have said so,” Jesus replied.
aov_text: En Pilatus het Hom gevra: Is U die koning van die Jode? En Hy het geantwoord en vir hom gesê: U sê dit.

kjv_text: And the chief priests accused him of many things: but he answered nothing.
bsb_text: And the chief priests began to accuse Him of many things.
aov_text: En die owerpriesters het baie beskuldiginge teen Hom ingebring.

kjv_text: And Pilate asked him again, saying, Answerest thou nothing? behold how many things they witness against thee.
bsb_text: Then Pilate questioned Him again, “Have You no answer? Look how many charges they are bringing against You!”
aov_text: En Pilatus het Hom weer gevra en gesê: Antwoord U niks nie? Kyk hoe baie getuienisse hulle teen U inbring.

kjv_text: But Jesus yet answered nothing; so that Pilate marvelled.
bsb_text: But to Pilate’s amazement, Jesus made no further reply.
aov_text: Maar Jesus het niks meer geantwoord nie, sodat Pilatus hom verwonder het.

kjv_text: Now at that feast he released unto them one prisoner, whomsoever they desired.
bsb_text: Now it was Pilate’s custom at the feast to release to the people a prisoner of their choosing.
aov_text: En op die fees was hy gewoond om een gevangene, die een wat hulle gevra het, vir hulle los te laat.

kjv_text: And there was one named Barabbas, which lay bound with them that had made insurrection with him, who had committed murder in the insurrection.
bsb_text: And a man named Barabbas was imprisoned with the rebels who had committed murder during the insurrection.
aov_text: En daar was ’n sekere Barábbas wat met mede-oproermakers in die gevangenis was; en hulle het in die opstand ’n moord begaan.

kjv_text: And the multitude crying aloud began to desire him to do as he had ever done unto them.
bsb_text: So the crowd went up and began asking Pilate to keep his custom.
aov_text: En die skare het geskreeu en begin vra dat hy vir hulle sou doen soos altyd.

kjv_text: But Pilate answered them, saying, Will ye that I release unto you the King of the Jews?
bsb_text: “Do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?” Pilate asked.
aov_text: Toe antwoord Pilatus en sê vir hulle: Wil julle hê dat ek vir julle die Koning van die Jode moet loslaat?

kjv_text: For he knew that the chief priests had delivered him for envy.
bsb_text: For he knew it was out of envy that the chief priests had handed Jesus over.
aov_text: Want hy het geweet dat die owerpriesters Hom uit nydigheid oorgelewer het.

kjv_text: But the chief priests moved the people, that he should rather release Barabbas unto them.
bsb_text: But the chief priests stirred up the crowd to have him release Barabbas to them instead.
aov_text: Maar die owerpriesters het die skare aangehits dat hy liewer Barábbas vir hulle moes loslaat.

kjv_text: And Pilate answered and said again unto them, What will ye then that I shall do unto him whom ye call the King of the Jews?
bsb_text: So Pilate asked them again, “What then do you want me to do with the One you call the King of the Jews?”
aov_text: Toe antwoord Pilatus weer en sê vir hulle: Wat wil julle dan hê moet ek doen met Hom wat julle Koning van die Jode noem?

kjv_text: And they cried out again, Crucify him.
bsb_text: And they shouted back, “Crucify Him!”
aov_text: En hulle skreeu weer: Kruisig Hom!

kjv_text: Then Pilate said unto them, Why, what evil hath he done? And they cried out the more exceedingly, Crucify him.
bsb_text: “Why?” asked Pilate. “What evil has He done?” But they shouted all the louder, “Crucify Him!”
aov_text: Maar Pilatus sê vir hulle: Watter kwaad het Hy dan gedoen? Hulle skreeu toe nog harder: Kruisig Hom!

kjv_text: And so Pilate, willing to content the people, released Barabbas unto them, and delivered Jesus, when he had scourged him, to be crucified.
bsb_text: And wishing to satisfy the crowd, Pilate released Barabbas to them. But he had Jesus flogged, and handed Him over to be crucified.
aov_text: En omdat Pilatus aan die skare hulle sin wou gee, het hy Barábbas vir hulle losgelaat; en nadat hy Jesus laat gésel het, het hy Hom oorgelewer om gekruisig te word.

kjv_text: And the soldiers led him away into the hall, called Praetorium; and they call together the whole band.
bsb_text: Then the soldiers led Jesus away into the palace (that is, the Praetorium) and called the whole company together.
aov_text: Toe lei die soldate Hom weg in die binneplaas, dit is die goewerneur se paleis, en hulle roep die hele leërafdeling bymekaar

kjv_text: And they clothed him with purple, and platted a crown of thorns, and put it about his head,
bsb_text: They dressed Him in a purple robe, twisted together a crown of thorns, and set it on His head.
aov_text: en trek Hom ’n purperkleed aan en vleg ’n kroon van dorings en sit dit vir Hom op;

kjv_text: And began to salute him, Hail, King of the Jews!
bsb_text: And they began to salute Him: “Hail, King of the Jews!”
aov_text: en hulle begin Hom begroet: Wees gegroet, Koning van die Jode!

kjv_text: And they smote him on the head with a reed, and did spit upon him, and bowing their knees worshipped him.
bsb_text: They kept striking His head with a staff and spitting on Him. And they knelt down and bowed before Him.
aov_text: En hulle slaan Hom met ’n riet op die hoof en spuug op Hom en val op die knieë en bring Hom hulde.

kjv_text: And when they had mocked him, they took off the purple from him, and put his own clothes on him, and led him out to crucify him.
bsb_text: After they had mocked Him, they removed the purple robe and put His own clothes back on Him. Then they led Him out to crucify Him.
aov_text: En toe hulle Hom bespot het, trek hulle Hom die purperkleed uit en trek Hom sy eie klere aan; en hulle lei Hom weg om Hom te kruisig.

kjv_text: And they compel one Simon a Cyrenian, who passed by, coming out of the country, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to bear his cross.
bsb_text: Now Simon of Cyrene, the father of Alexander and Rufus, was passing by on his way in from the country, and the soldiers forced him to carry the cross of Jesus.
aov_text: EN hulle het ’n sekere Simon van Ciréne wat van die veld af gekom het, die vader van Alexander en Rufus, gedwing om sy kruis te dra.

kjv_text: And they bring him unto the place Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, The place of a skull.
bsb_text: They brought Jesus to a place called Golgotha, which means The Place of the Skull.
aov_text: En hulle het Hom gebring op die plek Gólgota, dit is, as dit vertaal word: Plek van die Hoofskedel.

kjv_text: And they gave him to drink wine mingled with myrrh: but he received it not.
bsb_text: There they offered Him wine mixed with myrrh, but He did not take it.
aov_text: Toe gee hulle Hom wyn met mirre gemeng om te drink, maar Hy het dit nie geneem nie.

kjv_text: And when they had crucified him, they parted his garments, casting lots upon them, what every man should take.
bsb_text: And they crucified Him. They also divided His garments by casting lots to decide what each of them would take.
aov_text: En nadat hulle Hom gekruisig het, het hulle sy klere verdeel deur die lot te werp oor wat elkeen moes kry.

kjv_text: And it was the third hour, and they crucified him.
bsb_text: It was the third hour when they crucified Him.
aov_text: En dit was die derde uur toe hulle Hom gekruisig het.

kjv_text: And the superscription of his accusation was written over, THE KING OF THE JEWS.
bsb_text: And the charge inscribed against Him read: THE KING OF THE JEWS.
aov_text: En die opskrif van sy beskuldiging was bokant Hom geskrywe: DIE KONING VAN DIE JODE.

kjv_text: And with him they crucify two thieves; the one on his right hand, and the other on his left.
bsb_text: Along with Jesus, they crucified two robbers, one on His right and one on His left.
aov_text: Hulle het ook twee rowers saam met Hom gekruisig, een aan sy regter- en een aan sy linkerkant.

kjv_text: And the scripture was fulfilled, which saith, And he was numbered with the transgressors.
aov_text: En die Skrif is vervul wat sê: En Hy is by die misdadigers gereken.

kjv_text: And they that passed by railed on him, wagging their heads, and saying, Ah, thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days,
bsb_text: And those who passed by heaped abuse on Him, shaking their heads and saying, “Aha! You who are going to destroy the temple and rebuild it in three days,
aov_text: En die verbygangers het Hom gesmaad, terwyl hulle hul hoof skud en sê: Ha, U wat die tempel afbreek en in drie dae opbou,

kjv_text: Save thyself, and come down from the cross.
bsb_text: come down from the cross and save Yourself!”
aov_text: verlos Uself en kom af van die kruis!

kjv_text: Likewise also the chief priests mocking said among themselves with the scribes, He saved others; himself he cannot save.
bsb_text: In the same way, the chief priests and scribes mocked Him among themselves, saying, “He saved others, but He cannot save Himself!
aov_text: En so het ook die owerpriesters saam met die skrifgeleerdes gespot en vir mekaar gesê: Ander het Hy verlos, Homself kan Hy nie verlos nie.

kjv_text: Let Christ the King of Israel descend now from the cross, that we may see and believe. And they that were crucified with him reviled him.
bsb_text: Let the Christ, the King of Israel, come down now from the cross, so that we may see and believe!” And even those who were crucified with Him berated Him.
aov_text: Laat die Christus, die Koning van Israel, nou van die kruis afkom, sodat ons kan sien en glo! Ook die wat saam met Hom gekruisig is, het Hom beledig.

kjv_text: And when the sixth hour was come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.
bsb_text: From the sixth hour until the ninth hour darkness came over all the land.
aov_text: En toe dit die sesde uur was, kom daar duisternis oor die hele aarde tot die negende uur toe.

kjv_text: And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? which is, being interpreted, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
bsb_text: At the ninth hour, Jesus cried out in a loud voice, “Eloi, Eloi, lema sabachthani?” which means, “My God, My God, why have You forsaken Me?”
aov_text: En die negende uur het Jesus met ’n groot stem uitgeroep en gesê: Eloï, Eloï, lamma sabagtáni? wat, as dit vertaal word, beteken: My God, my God, waarom het U My verlaat?

kjv_text: And some of them that stood by, when they heard it, said, Behold, he calleth Elias.
bsb_text: When some of those standing nearby heard this, they said, “Behold, He is calling Elijah.”
aov_text: En sommige van die wat daar staan, hoor dit en sê: Kyk, Hy roep na Elía.

kjv_text: And one ran and filled a spunge full of vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink, saying, Let alone; let us see whether Elias will come to take him down.
bsb_text: And someone ran and filled a sponge with sour wine. He put it on a reed and held it up for Jesus to drink, saying, “Leave Him alone. Let us see if Elijah comes to take Him down.”
aov_text: Toe hardloop een en maak ’n spons vol asyn en sit dit op ’n riet en laat Hom drink; en hy sê: Wag, laat ons sien of Elía kom om Hom af te haal.

kjv_text: And Jesus cried with a loud voice, and gave up the ghost.
bsb_text: But Jesus let out a loud cry and breathed His last.
aov_text: Maar Jesus het met ’n groot stem geroep en die laaste asem uitgeblaas.

kjv_text: And the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom.
bsb_text: And the veil of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom.
aov_text: En die voorhangsel van die tempel het in twee geskeur van bo tot onder.

kjv_text: And when the centurion, which stood over against him, saw that he so cried out, and gave up the ghost, he said, Truly this man was the Son of God.
bsb_text: When the centurion standing there in front of Jesus saw how He had breathed His last, he said, “Truly this man was the Son of God!”
aov_text: En toe die hoofman oor honderd wat daar reg voor Hom staan, sien dat Hy so uitgeroep en die laaste asem uitgeblaas het, sê hy: Waarlik, Hy was die Seun van God.

kjv_text: There were also women looking on afar off: among whom was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;
bsb_text: And there were also women watching from a distance. Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James the younger and of Joses, and Salome.
aov_text: En daar was ook vroue wat van ver af dit aanskou het. Onder hulle was Maria Magdaléna ook, en Maria, die moeder van Jakobus, die kleine, en van Joses, en Salóme  —

kjv_text: (Who also, when he was in Galilee, followed him, and ministered unto him;) and many other women which came up with him unto Jerusalem.
bsb_text: These women had followed Jesus and ministered to Him while He was in Galilee, and there were many other women who had come up to Jerusalem with Him.
aov_text: hulle wat Hom gevolg en Hom gedien het toe Hy in Galiléa was — en baie ander vroue wat saam met Hom opgegaan het na Jerusalem.

kjv_text: And now when the even was come, because it was the preparation, that is, the day before the sabbath,
bsb_text: Now it was already evening. Since it was Preparation Day (that is, the day before the Sabbath),
aov_text: EN toe dit aand geword het, omdat dit die voorbereiding was, dit is die voorsabbat,

kjv_text: Joseph of Arimathaea, an honourable counsellor, which also waited for the kingdom of God, came, and went in boldly unto Pilate, and craved the body of Jesus.
bsb_text: Joseph of Arimathea, a prominent Council member who himself was waiting for the kingdom of God, boldly went to Pilate to ask for the body of Jesus.
aov_text: kom daar ’n vername raadslid, Josef van Arimathéa, wat self ook die koninkryk van God verwag het; en hy waag dit om na Pilatus in te gaan en die liggaam van Jesus te vra.

kjv_text: And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead: and calling unto him the centurion, he asked him whether he had been any while dead.
bsb_text: Pilate was surprised to hear that Jesus was already dead, so he summoned the centurion to ask if this was so.
aov_text: En Pilatus was verwonderd dat Hy al dood was, en hy het die hoofman oor honderd geroep en hom gevra of Hy al lank dood was.

kjv_text: And when he knew it of the centurion, he gave the body to Joseph.
bsb_text: When Pilate had confirmed it with the centurion, he granted the body to Joseph.
aov_text: En toe hy dit van die hoofman oor honderd verneem het, het hy die liggaam aan Josef geskenk.

kjv_text: And he bought fine linen, and took him down, and wrapped him in the linen, and laid him in a sepulchre which was hewn out of a rock, and rolled a stone unto the door of the sepulchre.
bsb_text: So Joseph bought a linen cloth, took down the body of Jesus, wrapped it in the cloth, and placed it in a tomb that had been cut out of the rock. Then he rolled a stone against the entrance to the tomb.
aov_text: En hy het linne gekoop, en Hom afgehaal en in die linne toegedraai, en Hom neergelê in ’n graf wat in ’n rots uitgekap was. En hy het ’n steen teen die opening van die graf gerol.

kjv_text: And Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses beheld where he was laid.
bsb_text: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joseph saw where His body was placed.
aov_text: En Maria Magdaléna en Maria, die moeder van Joses, het gesien waar Hy neergelê word.

kjv_text: And when the sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome, had bought sweet spices, that they might come and anoint him.
bsb_text: When the Sabbath was over, Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices so they could go and anoint the body of Jesus.
aov_text: EN toe die sabbat verby was, het Maria Magdaléna en Maria, die moeder van Jakobus, en Salóme speserye gekoop om Hom te gaan salf.

kjv_text: And very early in the morning the first day of the week, they came unto the sepulchre at the rising of the sun.
bsb_text: Very early on the first day of the week, just after sunrise, they went to the tomb.
aov_text: En baie vroeg op die eerste dag van die week, net ná sonop, kom hulle by die graf.

kjv_text: And they said among themselves, Who shall roll us away the stone from the door of the sepulchre?
bsb_text: They were asking one another, “Who will roll away the stone from the entrance of the tomb?”
aov_text: En hulle sê vir mekaar: Wie sal vir ons die steen voor die opening van die graf wegrol?

kjv_text: And when they looked, they saw that the stone was rolled away: for it was very great.
bsb_text: But when they looked up, they saw that the stone had been rolled away, even though it was extremely large.
aov_text: En toe hulle opkyk, sien hulle dat die steen weggerol was, want dit was baie groot.

kjv_text: And entering into the sepulchre, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, clothed in a long white garment; and they were affrighted.
bsb_text: When they entered the tomb, they saw a young man dressed in a white robe sitting on the right side, and they were alarmed.
aov_text: En toe hulle in die graf ingegaan het, sien hulle ’n jongman, met ’n lang wit kleed om, aan die regterkant sit, en hulle het baie geskrik.

kjv_text: And he saith unto them, Be not affrighted: Ye seek Jesus of Nazareth, which was crucified: he is risen; he is not here: behold the place where they laid him.
bsb_text: But he said to them, “Do not be alarmed. You are looking for Jesus the Nazarene, who was crucified. He has risen! He is not here! See the place where they put Him.
aov_text: En hy sê vir hulle: Moenie verskrik wees nie. Julle soek Jesus die Nasaréner wat gekruisig is. Hy het opgestaan. Hy is nie hier nie. Dáár is die plek waar hulle Hom neergelê het.

kjv_text: But go your way, tell his disciples and Peter that he goeth before you into Galilee: there shall ye see him, as he said unto you.
bsb_text: But go, tell His disciples and Peter, ‘He is going ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see Him, just as He told you.’”
aov_text: Maar gaan sê vir sy dissipels en vir Petrus dat Hy voor julle uit gaan na Galiléa. Daar sal julle Hom sien soos Hy vir julle gesê het.

kjv_text: And they went out quickly, and fled from the sepulchre; for they trembled and were amazed: neither said they any thing to any man; for they were afraid.
bsb_text: So the women left the tomb and ran away, trembling and bewildered. And in their fear they did not say a word to anyone.
aov_text: Toe gaan hulle haastig uit en vlug van die graf af weg. En bewing en ontsetting het hulle aangegryp. En hulle het vir niemand iets gesê nie, want hulle het gevrees.

kjv_text: Now when Jesus was risen early the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had cast seven devils.
bsb_text: Early on the first day of the week, after Jesus had risen, He appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom He had driven out seven demons.
aov_text: EN nadat Hy opgestaan het, vroeg op die eerste dag van die week, het Hy eers verskyn aan Maria Magdaléna, uit wie Hy sewe duiwels uitgedryf het.

kjv_text: And she went and told them that had been with him, as they mourned and wept.
bsb_text: She went and told those who had been with Him, who were mourning and weeping.
aov_text: Sy het gegaan en dit vertel aan die wat saam met Hom gewees het, terwyl hulle treur en ween.

kjv_text: And they, when they had heard that he was alive, and had been seen of her, believed not.
bsb_text: And when they heard that Jesus was alive and she had seen Him, they did not believe it.
aov_text: En toe hulle hoor dat Hy lewe en deur haar gesien is, het hulle dit nie geglo nie.

kjv_text: After that he appeared in another form unto two of them, as they walked, and went into the country.
bsb_text: After this, Jesus appeared in a different form to two of them as they walked along in the country.
aov_text: En hierna het Hy in ’n ander gedaante verskyn aan twee van hulle terwyl hulle loop, op pad in die veld.

kjv_text: And they went and told it unto the residue: neither believed they them.
bsb_text: And they went back and reported it to the rest, but they did not believe them either.
aov_text: Hulle het ook gegaan en dit aan die ander vertel, maar dié het hulle ook nie geglo nie.

kjv_text: Afterward he appeared unto the eleven as they sat at meat, and upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they believed not them which had seen him after he was risen.
bsb_text: Later, as they were eating, Jesus appeared to the Eleven and rebuked them for their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they did not believe those who had seen Him after He had risen.
aov_text: Later het Hy aan die elf self verskyn toe hulle aan tafel was, en Hy het hulle hul ongeloof en hardheid van hart verwyt, omdat hulle die wat Hom ná sy opstanding gesien het, nie geglo het nie.

kjv_text: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
bsb_text: And He said to them, “Go into all the world and preach the gospel to every creature.
aov_text: En Hy het vir hulle gesê: Gaan die hele wêreld in en verkondig die evangelie aan die ganse mensdom.

kjv_text: He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved; but he that believeth not shall be damned.
bsb_text: Whoever believes and is baptized will be saved, but whoever does not believe will be condemned.
aov_text: Hy wat glo en hom laat doop, sal gered word; maar hy wat nie glo nie, sal veroordeel word.

kjv_text: And these signs shall follow them that believe; In my name shall they cast out devils; they shall speak with new tongues;
bsb_text: And these signs will accompany those who believe: In My name they will drive out demons; they will speak in new tongues;
aov_text: En vir die wat geglo het, sal hierdie tekens volg: in my Naam sal hulle duiwels uitdryf, met nuwe tale sal hulle spreek,

kjv_text: They shall take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it shall not hurt them; they shall lay hands on the sick, and they shall recover.
bsb_text: they will pick up snakes with their hands, and if they drink any deadly poison, it will not harm them; they will lay their hands on the sick, and they will be made well.”
aov_text: slange sal hulle opneem; en as hulle iets dodeliks drink, sal dit hulle geen kwaad doen nie; op siekes sal hulle die hande lê, en hulle sal gesond word.

kjv_text: So then after the Lord had spoken unto them, he was received up into heaven, and sat on the right hand of God.
bsb_text: After the Lord Jesus had spoken to them, He was taken up into heaven and sat down at the right hand of God.
aov_text: Nadat die Here dan met hulle gespreek het, is Hy opgeneem in die hemel en het gaan sit aan die regterhand van God.

kjv_text: And they went forth, and preached every where, the Lord working with them, and confirming the word with signs following. Amen.
bsb_text: And they went out and preached everywhere, and the Lord worked through them, confirming His word by the signs that accompanied it.
aov_text: Maar hulle het uitgegaan en oral gepreek, en die Here het saamgewerk en die woord bevestig deur die tekens wat daarop gevolg het. Amen.

kjv_text: Forasmuch as many have taken in hand to set forth in order a declaration of those things which are most surely believed among us,
bsb_text: Many have undertaken to compose an account of the things that have been fulfilled among us,
aov_text: AANGESIEN baie onderneem het om ’n verhaal op te stel oor die dinge wat onder ons al vervul is,

kjv_text: Even as they delivered them unto us, which from the beginning were eyewitnesses, and ministers of the word;
bsb_text: just as they were handed down to us by the initial eyewitnesses and servants of the word.
aov_text: soos hulle wat van die begin af ooggetuies en dienaars van die Woord was, dit aan ons oorgelewer het,

kjv_text: It seemed good to me also, having had perfect understanding of all things from the very first, to write unto thee in order, most excellent Theophilus,
bsb_text: Therefore, having carefully investigated everything from the beginning, it seemed good also to me to write an orderly account for you, most excellent Theophilus,
aov_text: het ek ook dit goedgedink, hooggeagte Theófilus, nadat ek van voor af alles noukeurig ondersoek het, om dit in volgorde aan u te skrywe,

kjv_text: That thou mightest know the certainty of those things, wherein thou hast been instructed.
bsb_text: so that you may know the certainty of the things you have been taught.
aov_text: sodat u met volle sekerheid kan weet die dinge waaromtrent u onderrig is.

kjv_text: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judaea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the course of Abia: and his wife was of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elisabeth.
bsb_text: In the time of Herod king of Judea there was a priest named Zechariah, who belonged to the priestly division of Abijah, and whose wife Elizabeth was a daughter of Aaron.
aov_text: DAAR was in die dae van Herodes, koning van Judéa, ’n sekere priester met die naam van Sagaría, uit die afdeling van Abía; en sy vrou was uit die dogters van Aäron, en haar naam was Elisabet.

kjv_text: And they were both righteous before God, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless.
bsb_text: Both of them were righteous in the sight of God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and decrees of the Lord.
aov_text: En hulle was altwee regverdig voor God en het in al die gebooie en regte van die Here onberispelik gewandel.

kjv_text: And they had no child, because that Elisabeth was barren, and they both were now well stricken in years.
bsb_text: But they had no children, because Elizabeth was barren, and they were both well along in years.
aov_text: En hulle het geen kind gehad nie, omdat Elisabet onvrugbaar was en albei op ver gevorderde leeftyd.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, that while he executed the priest's office before God in the order of his course,
bsb_text: One day while Zechariah’s division was on duty and he was serving as priest before God,
aov_text: En terwyl hy besig was om die priesteramp voor God te bedien in die beurt van sy afdeling,

kjv_text: According to the custom of the priest's office, his lot was to burn incense when he went into the temple of the Lord.
bsb_text: he was chosen by lot, according to the custom of the priesthood, to enter the temple of the Lord and burn incense.
aov_text: het die lot volgens priesterlike gewoonte op hom geval om in te gaan in die tempel van die Here en reukwerk te brand.

kjv_text: And the whole multitude of the people were praying without at the time of incense.
bsb_text: And at the hour of the incense offering, the whole congregation was praying outside.
aov_text: En die hele menigte van die volk was buite, besig om te bid op die uur van die reukoffer.

kjv_text: And there appeared unto him an angel of the Lord standing on the right side of the altar of incense.
bsb_text: Just then an angel of the Lord appeared to Zechariah, standing at the right side of the altar of incense.
aov_text: Toe verskyn daar aan hom ’n engel van die Here, wat aan die regterkant van die reukofferaltaar staan.

kjv_text: And when Zacharias saw him, he was troubled, and fear fell upon him.
bsb_text: When Zechariah saw him, he was startled and gripped with fear.
aov_text: En toe Sagaría hom sien, was hy ontsteld, en vrees het hom oorval.

kjv_text: But the angel said unto him, Fear not, Zacharias: for thy prayer is heard; and thy wife Elisabeth shall bear thee a son, and thou shalt call his name John.
bsb_text: But the angel said to him, “Do not be afraid, Zechariah, because your prayer has been heard. Your wife Elizabeth will bear you a son, and you are to give him the name John.
aov_text: Maar die engel sê vir hom: Moenie vrees nie, Sagaría, want jou gebed is verhoor, en jou vrou Elisabet sal vir jou ’n seun baar, en jy moet hom Johannes noem.

kjv_text: And thou shalt have joy and gladness; and many shall rejoice at his birth.
bsb_text: He will be a joy and delight to you, and many will rejoice at his birth,
aov_text: En hy sal blydskap en verheuging vir jou wees, en baie sal oor sy geboorte bly wees;

kjv_text: For he shall be great in the sight of the Lord, and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink; and he shall be filled with the Holy Ghost, even from his mother's womb.
bsb_text: for he will be great in the sight of the Lord. He shall never take wine or strong drink, and he will be filled with the Holy Spirit even from his mother’s womb.
aov_text: want hy sal groot wees voor die Here. En wyn en sterk drank sal hy nooit drink nie, en hy sal vervul word met die Heilige Gees reeds van die skoot van sy moeder af.

kjv_text: And many of the children of Israel shall he turn to the Lord their God.
bsb_text: Many of the sons of Israel he will turn back to the Lord their God.
aov_text: En hy sal baie van die kinders van Israel bekeer tot die Here hulle God.

kjv_text: And he shall go before him in the spirit and power of Elias, to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children, and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to make ready a people prepared for the Lord.
bsb_text: And he will go on before the Lord in the spirit and power of Elijah, to turn the hearts of the fathers to their children and the disobedient to the wisdom of the righteous—to make ready a people prepared for the Lord.”
aov_text: En hy sal voor Hom uit gaan in die gees en die krag van Elía, om die harte van die vaders terug te bring tot die kinders en die ongehoorsames tot die gesindheid van die regverdiges, om vir die Here ’n toegeruste volk te berei.

kjv_text: And Zacharias said unto the angel, Whereby shall I know this? for I am an old man, and my wife well stricken in years.
bsb_text: “How can I be sure of this?” Zechariah asked the angel. “I am an old man, and my wife is well along in years.”
aov_text: Toe sê Sagaría vir die engel: Waaraan sal ek dit weet? Want ek is ’n ou man, en my vrou is op ver gevorderde leeftyd.

kjv_text: And the angel answering said unto him, I am Gabriel, that stand in the presence of God; and am sent to speak unto thee, and to shew thee these glad tidings.
bsb_text: “I am Gabriel,” replied the angel. “I stand in the presence of God, and I have been sent to speak to you and to bring you this good news.
aov_text: En die engel antwoord en sê vir hom: Ek is Gabriël wat voor God staan, en ek is gestuur om met jou te spreek en jou hierdie goeie tyding te bring.

kjv_text: And, behold, thou shalt be dumb, and not able to speak, until the day that these things shall be performed, because thou believest not my words, which shall be fulfilled in their season.
bsb_text: And now you will be silent and unable to speak until the day this comes to pass, because you did not believe my words, which will be fulfilled at their proper time.”
aov_text: En kyk, jy sal swyg en nie kan praat nie tot op die dag dat hierdie dinge gebeur, omdat jy my woorde wat op hulle tyd vervul sal word, nie geglo het nie.

kjv_text: And the people waited for Zacharias, and marvelled that he tarried so long in the temple.
bsb_text: Meanwhile, the people were waiting for Zechariah and wondering why he took so long in the temple.
aov_text: En die volk het op Sagaría bly wag en was verwonderd dat hy so lank in die tempel vertoef.

kjv_text: And when he came out, he could not speak unto them: and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple: for he beckoned unto them, and remained speechless.
bsb_text: When he came out and was unable to speak to them, they realized he had seen a vision in the temple. He kept making signs to them but remained speechless.
aov_text: Maar toe hy uitkom, kon hy met hulle nie praat nie; hulle bemerk toe dat hy ’n gesig in die tempel gesien het. En hy het aanhoudend vir hulle beduie en stom gebly.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, that, as soon as the days of his ministration were accomplished, he departed to his own house.
bsb_text: And when the days of his service were complete, he returned home.
aov_text: En toe die dae van sy diens vervul was, het hy huis toe gegaan.

kjv_text: And after those days his wife Elisabeth conceived, and hid herself five months, saying,
bsb_text: After these days, his wife Elizabeth became pregnant and for five months remained in seclusion. She declared,
aov_text: En ná hierdie dae het Elisabet, sy vrou, ontvang en haar vyf maande lank verberg en gesê:

kjv_text: Thus hath the Lord dealt with me in the days wherein he looked on me, to take away my reproach among men.
bsb_text: “The Lord has done this for me. In these days He has shown me favor and taken away my disgrace among the people.”
aov_text: So het die Here met my gedoen in die dae toe Hy my aangesien het om my smaad onder die mense weg te neem.

kjv_text: And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God unto a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,
bsb_text: In the sixth month, God sent the angel Gabriel to a town in Galilee called Nazareth,
aov_text: EN in die sesde maand is die engel Gabriël deur God gestuur na ’n stad in Galiléa met die naam van Násaret,

kjv_text: To a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David; and the virgin's name was Mary.
bsb_text: to a virgin pledged in marriage to a man named Joseph, who was of the house of David. And the virgin’s name was Mary.
aov_text: na ’n maagd wat verloof was aan ’n man met die naam van Josef, uit die huis van Dawid; en die naam van die maagd was Maria.

kjv_text: And the angel came in unto her, and said, Hail, thou that art highly favoured, the Lord is with thee: blessed art thou among women.
bsb_text: The angel appeared to her and said, “Greetings, you who are highly favored! The Lord is with you.”
aov_text: En die engel het by haar binnegekom en gesê: Wees gegroet, begenadigde! Die Here is met jou; geseënd is jy onder die vroue.

kjv_text: And when she saw him, she was troubled at his saying, and cast in her mind what manner of salutation this should be.
bsb_text: Mary was greatly troubled at his words and wondered what kind of greeting this might be.
aov_text: En toe sy hom sien, was sy baie ontsteld oor sy woord, en sy het daaroor nagedink wat hierdie groet tog kon beteken.

kjv_text: And the angel said unto her, Fear not, Mary: for thou hast found favour with God.
bsb_text: So the angel told her, “Do not be afraid, Mary, for you have found favor with God.
aov_text: En die engel sê vir haar: Moenie vrees nie, Maria, want jy het genade by God gevind.

kjv_text: And, behold, thou shalt conceive in thy womb, and bring forth a son, and shalt call his name JESUS.
bsb_text: Behold, you will conceive and give birth to a son, and you are to give Him the name Jesus.
aov_text: En kyk, jy sal swanger word en ’n Seun baar, en jy moet Hom Jesus noem.

kjv_text: He shall be great, and shall be called the Son of the Highest: and the Lord God shall give unto him the throne of his father David:
bsb_text: He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give Him the throne of His father David,
aov_text: Hy sal groot wees en die Seun van die Allerhoogste genoem word; en die Here God sal aan Hom die troon van sy vader Dawid gee,

kjv_text: And he shall reign over the house of Jacob for ever; and of his kingdom there shall be no end.
bsb_text: and He will reign over the house of Jacob forever. His kingdom will never end!”
aov_text: en Hy sal koning wees oor die huis van Jakob tot in ewigheid, en aan sy koninkryk sal daar geen einde wees nie.

kjv_text: Then said Mary unto the angel, How shall this be, seeing I know not a man?
bsb_text: “How can this be,” Mary asked the angel, “since I am a virgin?”

kjv_text: And there was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Aser: she was of a great age, and had lived with an husband seven years from her virginity;
bsb_text: There was also a prophetess named Anna, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher, who was well along in years. She had been married for seven years,
aov_text: En daar was Anna, ’n profetes, die dogter van Fánuel, uit die stam van Aser. Sy was op baie ver gevorderde leeftyd en het van haar maagdom af sewe jaar lank met haar man saamgelewe;

kjv_text: And she was a widow of about fourscore and four years, which departed not from the temple, but served God with fastings and prayers night and day.
bsb_text: and then was a widow to the age of eighty-four. She never left the temple, but worshiped night and day, fasting and praying.
aov_text: en sy was ’n weduwee van omtrent vier-en-tagtig jaar. Sy het nie weggebly van die tempel nie, en met vaste en gebede God gedien, nag en dag.

kjv_text: And she coming in that instant gave thanks likewise unto the Lord, and spake of him to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem.
bsb_text: Coming forward at that moment, she gave thanks to God and spoke about the Child to all who were waiting for the redemption of Jerusalem.
aov_text: En sy het in dieselfde uur daar gekom en die Here geprys en van Hom gespreek met almal in Jerusalem wat die verlossing verwag het.

kjv_text: And when they had performed all things according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city Nazareth.
bsb_text: When Jesus’ parents had done everything required by the Law of the Lord, they returned to Galilee, to their own town of Nazareth.
aov_text: En toe hulle alles volbring het wat volgens die wet van die Here was, het hulle teruggegaan na Galiléa, na hulle stad Násaret.

kjv_text: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, filled with wisdom: and the grace of God was upon him.
bsb_text: And the Child grew and became strong. He was filled with wisdom, and the grace of God was upon Him.
aov_text: En die Kindjie het gegroei en sterk geword in die Gees en vol van wysheid. En die genade van God was op Hom.

kjv_text: Now his parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover.
bsb_text: Every year His parents went to Jerusalem for the Feast of the Passover.
aov_text: EN sy ouers was gewoond om elke jaar met die paasfees na Jerusalem te gaan.

kjv_text: And when he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem after the custom of the feast.
bsb_text: And when He was twelve years old, they went up according to the custom of the Feast.
aov_text: En toe Hy twaalf jaar oud was, het hulle, volgens die gebruik van die fees, na Jerusalem opgegaan.

kjv_text: And when they had fulfilled the days, as they returned, the child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem; and Joseph and his mother knew not of it.
bsb_text: When those days were over and they were returning home, the boy Jesus remained behind in Jerusalem, but His parents were unaware He had stayed.
aov_text: En nadat die feesdae vir hulle verby was, en terwyl hulle teruggaan, het die Kind Jesus in Jerusalem agtergebly; en Josef en sy moeder het dit nie geweet nie.

kjv_text: But they, supposing him to have been in the company, went a day's journey; and they sought him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance.
bsb_text: Assuming He was in their company, they traveled on for a day before they began to look for Him among their relatives and friends.
aov_text: Maar omdat hulle gedink het dat Hy by die reisgeselskap was, het hulle ’n dagreis ver gegaan en Hom onder die familie en onder die bekendes gesoek.

kjv_text: And when they found him not, they turned back again to Jerusalem, seeking him.
bsb_text: When they could not find Him, they returned to Jerusalem to search for Him.
aov_text: En toe hulle Hom nie vind nie, het hulle teruggegaan na Jerusalem en Hom gesoek.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, both hearing them, and asking them questions.
bsb_text: Finally, after three days they found Him in the temple courts, sitting among the teachers, listening to them and asking them questions.
aov_text: En ná drie dae het hulle Hom in die tempel gevind, terwyl Hy in die midde van die leraars sit en na hulle luister en hulle uitvra.

kjv_text: And all that heard him were astonished at his understanding and answers.
bsb_text: And all who heard Him were astounded at His understanding and His answers.
aov_text: En almal wat Hom gehoor het, was verbaas oor sy verstand en sy antwoorde.

kjv_text: And when they saw him, they were amazed: and his mother said unto him, Son, why hast thou thus dealt with us? behold, thy father and I have sought thee sorrowing.
bsb_text: When His parents saw Him, they were astonished. “Child, why have You done this to us?” His mother asked. “Your father and I have been anxiously searching for You.”
aov_text: En toe hulle Hom sien, was hulle verslae. En sy moeder sê vir Hom: Kind, waarom het jy so met ons gemaak? Kyk, jou vader en ek het jou met angs gesoek.

kjv_text: And he said unto them, How is it that ye sought me? wist ye not that I must be about my Father's business?
bsb_text: “Why were you looking for Me?” He asked. “Did you not know that I had to be in My Father’s house?”
aov_text: En Hy sê vir hulle: Waarom het u My gesoek? Het u nie geweet dat Ek in die dinge van my Vader moet wees nie?

kjv_text: And they understood not the saying which he spake unto them.
bsb_text: But they did not understand the statement He was making to them.
aov_text: En hulle het die woord wat Hy aan hulle gesê het, nie verstaan nie.

kjv_text: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth, and was subject unto them: but his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.
bsb_text: Then He went down to Nazareth with them and was obedient to them. But His mother treasured up all these things in her heart.
aov_text: En Hy het saam met hulle gegaan en in Násaret gekom, en Hy was hulle onderdanig. En sy moeder het al hierdie dinge in haar hart bewaar.

kjv_text: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favour with God and man.

aov_text: En Jesus het toegeneem in wysheid en grootte en in genade by God en die mense.

kjv_text: Every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be brought low; and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough ways shall be made smooth;

kjv_text: Then said he to the multitude that came forth to be baptized of him, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

kjv_text: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and begin not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, That God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.

kjv_text: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: every tree therefore which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.

kjv_text: And the people asked him, saying, What shall we do then?

bsb_text: John replied, “Whoever has two tunics should share with him who has none, and whoever has food should do the same.”

aov_text: En Jesus antwoord en sê vir hom: Daar is gesê: Jy mag die Here jou God nie versoek nie.

kjv_text: And when the devil had ended all the temptation, he departed from him for a season.
bsb_text: When the devil had finished every temptation, he left Him until an opportune time.
aov_text: En toe die duiwel elke versoeking geëindig het, het hy ’n tyd lank van Hom gewyk.

kjv_text: And Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee: and there went out a fame of him through all the region round about.
bsb_text: Jesus returned to Galilee in the power of the Spirit, and the news about Him spread throughout the surrounding region.
aov_text: EN Jesus het in die krag van die Gees na Galiléa teruggekeer, en daar het ’n gerug aangaande Hom deur die hele omtrek uitgegaan;

kjv_text: And he taught in their synagogues, being glorified of all.
bsb_text: He taught in their synagogues and was glorified by everyone.
aov_text: en Hy het in hulle sinagoges geleer en is deur almal geprys.

kjv_text: And he came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up: and, as his custom was, he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up for to read.
bsb_text: Then Jesus came to Nazareth, where He had been brought up. As was His custom, He entered the synagogue on the Sabbath. And when He stood up to read,
aov_text: Toe kom Hy in Násaret waar Hy opgevoed was; en soos Hy gewoond was, gaan Hy op die sabbatdag in die sinagoge en staan op om te lees.

kjv_text: And there was delivered unto him the book of the prophet Esaias. And when he had opened the book, he found the place where it was written,
bsb_text: the scroll of the prophet Isaiah was handed to Him. Unrolling it, He found the place where it was written:
aov_text: En die boek van die profeet Jesaja is aan Hom oorhandig; en toe Hy die boek oopmaak, kry Hy die plek waar geskrywe is:

kjv_text: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted,
bsb_text: “The Spirit of the Lord is on Me, because He has anointed Me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent Me
aov_text: Die Gees van die Here is op My, omdat Hy My gesalf het om die evangelie aan die armes te bring. Hy het My gestuur om die wat verbryseld van hart is, te genees;

kjv_text: to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised,
bsb_text: to proclaim liberty to the captives and recovery of sight to the blind, to release the oppressed,
aov_text: om aan gevangenes vrylating te verkondig en aan blindes herstel van gesig; om die wat gebroke is, in vryheid weg te stuur;

kjv_text: To preach the acceptable year of the Lord.
bsb_text: to proclaim the year of the Lord’s favor.”
aov_text: om die aangename jaar van die Here aan te kondig.

kjv_text: And he closed the book, and he gave it again to the minister, and sat down. And the eyes of all them that were in the synagogue were fastened on him.
bsb_text: Then He rolled up the scroll, returned it to the attendant, and sat down. The eyes of everyone in the synagogue were fixed on Him,
aov_text: En nadat Hy die boek toegemaak en aan die dienaar teruggegee het, gaan Hy sit, en die oë van almal in die sinagoge was op Hom gevestig.

kjv_text: And he began to say unto them, This day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears.
bsb_text: and He began by saying, “Today this Scripture is fulfilled in your hearing.”
aov_text: Toe begin Hy vir hulle te sê: Vandag is hierdie Skrif in julle ore vervul.

kjv_text: And all bare him witness, and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth. And they said, Is not this Joseph's son?
bsb_text: All spoke well of Him and marveled at the gracious words that came from His lips. “Isn’t this the son of Joseph?” they asked.
aov_text: En almal het vir Hom getuienis gegee en was verwonderd oor die aangename woorde wat uit sy mond kom; en hulle sê: Is Hy nie die seun van Josef nie?

kjv_text: And he said unto them, Ye will surely say unto me this proverb, Physician, heal thyself: whatsoever we have heard done in Capernaum, do also here in thy country.
bsb_text: Jesus said to them, “Surely you will quote this proverb to Me: ‘Physician, heal yourself! Do here in Your hometown what we have heard that You did in Capernaum.’”
aov_text: En Hy antwoord hulle: Julle sal My ongetwyfeld hierdie spreekwoord toevoeg: Geneesheer, genees uself! Alles wat ons hoor wat in Kapérnaüm gebeur het, doen dit hier in u vaderstad ook.

kjv_text: And he said, Verily I say unto you, No prophet is accepted in his own country.
bsb_text: Then He added, “Truly I tell you, no prophet is accepted in his hometown.
aov_text: En Hy sê: Voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, geen profeet is aangenaam in sy vaderland nie.

kjv_text: But I tell you of a truth, many widows were in Israel in the days of Elias, when the heaven was shut up three years and six months, when great famine was throughout all the land;
bsb_text: But I tell you truthfully that there were many widows in Israel in the time of Elijah, when the sky was shut for three and a half years and great famine swept over all the land.
aov_text: Maar Ek sê vir julle met waarheid, daar was baie weduwees in Israel in die dae van Elía toe die hemel toegesluit was drie jaar en ses maande lank, toe daar ’n groot hongersnood gekom het in die hele land,

kjv_text: But unto none of them was Elias sent, save unto Sarepta, a city of Sidon, unto a woman that was a widow.
bsb_text: Yet Elijah was not sent to any of them, but to the widow of Zarephath in Sidon.
aov_text: en na nie een van hulle is Elía gestuur nie, behalwe na Sarfat in Sidon, na ’n weduwee.

kjv_text: And many lepers were in Israel in the time of Eliseus the prophet; and none of them was cleansed, saving Naaman the Syrian.
bsb_text: And there were many lepers in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet. Yet not one of them was cleansed—only Naaman the Syrian.”
aov_text: En daar was baie melaatses in Israel in die tyd van Elísa, die profeet, en nie een van hulle is gereinig nie, behalwe Naäman, die Síriër.

kjv_text: And all they in the synagogue, when they heard these things, were filled with wrath,
bsb_text: On hearing this, all the people in the synagogue were enraged.
aov_text: En almal in die sinagoge is met woede vervul toe hulle dit hoor;

kjv_text: And rose up, and thrust him out of the city, and led him unto the brow of the hill whereon their city was built, that they might cast him down headlong.
bsb_text: They got up, drove Him out of the town, and led Him to the brow of the hill on which the town was built, in order to throw Him over the cliff.
aov_text: en hulle het opgestaan en Hom uit die stad uitgedryf en Hom gebring tot op die rand van die berg waarop hulle stad gebou was, om Hom van die krans af te gooi.

kjv_text: But he passing through the midst of them went his way,
bsb_text: But Jesus passed through the crowd and went on His way.
aov_text: Maar Hy het tussen hulle deur geloop en weggegaan.

kjv_text: And came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and taught them on the sabbath days.
bsb_text: Then He went down to Capernaum, a town in Galilee, and on the Sabbath He began to teach the people.
aov_text: En Hy het afgekom na Kapérnaüm, ’n stad van Galiléa, en hulle op die sabbat geleer.

kjv_text: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for his word was with power.
bsb_text: They were astonished at His teaching, because His message had authority.
aov_text: En hulle was verslae oor sy leer, want sy woord was met gesag.

kjv_text: And in the synagogue there was a man, which had a spirit of an unclean devil, and cried out with a loud voice,
bsb_text: In the synagogue there was a man possessed by the spirit of an unclean demon. He cried out in a loud voice,
aov_text: EN in die sinagoge was daar ’n man met die gees van ’n onreine duiwel, en hy het met ’n groot stem uitgeskreeu

kjv_text: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art; the Holy One of God.
bsb_text: “Ha! What do You want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have You come to destroy us? I know who You are—the Holy One of God!”
aov_text: en gesê: Ha! wat het ons met U te doen, Jesus, Nasaréner? Het U gekom om ons te verdelg? Ek ken U, wie U is: die Heilige van God!

kjv_text: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him. And when the devil had thrown him in the midst, he came out of him, and hurt him not.
bsb_text: But Jesus rebuked the demon. “Be silent!” He said. “Come out of him!” At this, the demon threw the man down before them all and came out without harming him.
aov_text: En Jesus het hom bestraf en gesê: Bly stil, en gaan uit hom uit! En die duiwel het hom tussen hulle neergegooi en uit hom uitgegaan sonder om hom seer te maak.

kjv_text: And they were all amazed, and spake among themselves, saying, What a word is this! for with authority and power he commandeth the unclean spirits, and they come out.
bsb_text: All the people were overcome with amazement and asked one another, “What is this message? With authority and power He commands the unclean spirits, and they come out!”
aov_text: Toe kom daar verbaasdheid oor almal, en hulle praat met mekaar en sê: Wat vir ’n woord is dit, dat Hy met gesag en mag die onreine geeste gebied, en hulle gaan uit!

kjv_text: And the fame of him went out into every place of the country round about.
bsb_text: And the news about Jesus spread throughout the surrounding region.
aov_text: En daar het ’n gerug aangaande Hom uitgegaan na elke plek van die omgewing.

kjv_text: And he arose out of the synagogue, and entered into Simon's house. And Simon's wife's mother was taken with a great fever; and they besought him for her.
bsb_text: After Jesus had left the synagogue, He went to the home of Simon, whose mother-in-law was suffering from a high fever. So they appealed to Jesus on her behalf,
aov_text: EN Hy het opgestaan uit die sinagoge en in die huis van Simon gekom. En Simon se skoonmoeder was aangetas deur ’n hewige koors, en hulle het Hom geraadpleeg oor haar.

kjv_text: And he stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her: and immediately she arose and ministered unto them.
bsb_text: and He stood over her and rebuked the fever, and it left her. And she got up at once and began to serve them.
aov_text: Toe gaan Hy oor haar staan en bestraf die koors, en dit het haar verlaat, en sy het onmiddellik opgestaan en hulle bedien.

kjv_text: Now when the sun was setting, all they that had any sick with divers diseases brought them unto him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.
bsb_text: At sunset, all who were ill with various diseases were brought to Jesus, and laying His hands on each one, He healed them.
aov_text: En toe die son ondergaan, het almal hulle siekes, mense met allerhande kwale, na Hom gebring, en Hy het een vir een van hulle die hande opgelê en hulle gesond gemaak.

kjv_text: And devils also came out of many, crying out, and saying, Thou art Christ the Son of God. And he rebuking them suffered them not to speak: for they knew that he was Christ.
bsb_text: Demons also came out of many people, shouting, “You are the Son of God!” But He rebuked the demons and would not allow them to speak, because they knew He was the Christ.
aov_text: En duiwels het ook uit baie uitgegaan en geskreeu en gesê: U is die Christus, die Seun van God! En Hy het hulle bestraf en nie toegelaat om te praat nie, omdat hulle geweet het dat Hy die Christus was.

kjv_text: And when it was day, he departed and went into a desert place: and the people sought him, and came unto him, and stayed him, that he should not depart from them.
bsb_text: At daybreak, Jesus went out to a solitary place, and the crowds were looking for Him. They came to Him and tried to keep Him from leaving.
aov_text: En toe dit dag geword het, het Hy uitgegaan en na ’n verlate plek vertrek; en die skare het Hom gesoek en by Hom gekom en Hom teëgehou, dat Hy nie van hulle sou weggaan nie.

kjv_text: And he said unto them, I must preach the kingdom of God to other cities also: for therefore am I sent.
bsb_text: But Jesus told them, “I must preach the good news of the kingdom of God to the other towns as well, because that is why I was sent.”
aov_text: Maar Hy het vir hulle gesê: Ek moet aan die ander stede ook die evangelie van die koninkryk van God bring, want daarvoor is Ek gestuur.

kjv_text: And he preached in the synagogues of Galilee.
bsb_text: And He continued to preach in the synagogues of Judea.
aov_text: En Hy het verder in die sinagoges van Galiléa gepreek.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, that, as the people pressed upon him to hear the word of God, he stood by the lake of Gennesaret,
bsb_text: On one occasion, while Jesus was standing by the Lake of Gennesaret with the crowd pressing in on Him to hear the word of God,
aov_text: EN toe die skare by Hom aandring om die woord van God te hoor, gaan Hy by die meer Gennésaret staan

kjv_text: And saw two ships standing by the lake: but the fishermen were gone out of them, and were washing their nets.
bsb_text: He saw two boats at the edge of the lake. The fishermen had left them and were washing their nets.
aov_text: en sien twee skuite aan die kant van die meer lê; maar die vissers het van hulle af weggegaan en was besig om die nette uit te spoel.

kjv_text: And he entered into one of the ships, which was Simon's, and prayed him that he would thrust out a little from the land. And he sat down, and taught the people out of the ship.
bsb_text: Jesus got into the boat belonging to Simon and asked him to put out a little from shore. And sitting down, He taught the people from the boat.
aov_text: Toe klim Hy in een van die skuite wat aan Simon behoort het, en vra hom om ’n entjie van die land af weg te vaar, en Hy het gaan sit en die skare van die skuit uit geleer.

kjv_text: Now when he had left speaking, he said unto Simon, Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.
bsb_text: When Jesus had finished speaking, He said to Simon, “Put out into deep water and let down your nets for a catch.”
aov_text: En toe Hy ophou met spreek, sê Hy vir Simon: Vaar uit na die diep water en laat julle nette sak om te vang.

kjv_text: And Simon answering said unto him, Master, we have toiled all the night, and have taken nothing: nevertheless at thy word I will let down the net.
bsb_text: “Master,” Simon replied, “we have worked hard all night without catching anything. But because You say so, I will let down the nets.”
aov_text: En Simon antwoord en sê vir Hom: Meester, ons het die hele nag deur hard gewerk en niks gevang nie; maar op u woord sal ek die net laat sak.

kjv_text: And when they had this done, they inclosed a great multitude of fishes: and their net brake.
bsb_text: When they had done so, they caught such a large number of fish that their nets began to tear.
aov_text: En toe hulle dit gedoen het, het hulle ’n groot menigte visse ingesluit; en hulle net wou skeur.

kjv_text: And they beckoned unto their partners, which were in the other ship, that they should come and help them. And they came, and filled both the ships, so that they began to sink.
bsb_text: So they signaled to their partners in the other boat to come and help them, and they came and filled both boats so full that they began to sink.
aov_text: Daarop wink hulle vir hul maats in die ander skuit om hulle te kom help. En hulle het gekom en altwee die skuite vol gemaak, sodat hulle amper gesink het.

kjv_text: When Simon Peter saw it, he fell down at Jesus' knees, saying, Depart from me; for I am a sinful man, O Lord.
bsb_text: When Simon Peter saw this, he fell at Jesus’ knees. “Go away from me, Lord,” he said, “for I am a sinful man.”
aov_text: En toe Simon Petrus dit sien, val hy neer aan die knieë van Jesus en sê: Gaan weg van my, Here, want ek is ’n sondige man!

kjv_text: For he was astonished, and all that were with him, at the draught of the fishes which they had taken:
bsb_text: For he and his companions were astonished at the catch of fish they had taken,
aov_text: Want verbaasdheid het hom aangegryp en almal wat by hom was, oor die vangs van visse wat hulle gemaak het;

kjv_text: And so was also James, and John, the sons of Zebedee, which were partners with Simon. And Jesus said unto Simon, Fear not; from henceforth thou shalt catch men.
bsb_text: and so were his partners James and John, the sons of Zebedee. “Do not be afraid,” Jesus said to Simon. “From now on you will catch men.”
aov_text: en net so ook vir Jakobus en Johannes, die seuns van Sebedéüs, wat Simon se maats was. En Jesus sê vir Simon: Moenie vrees nie; van nou af sal jy mense vang.

kjv_text: And when they had brought their ships to land, they forsook all, and followed him.
bsb_text: And when they had brought their boats ashore, they left everything and followed Him.
aov_text: En nadat hulle die skuite aan land gebring het, het hulle alles verlaat en Hom gevolg.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when he was in a certain city, behold a man full of leprosy: who seeing Jesus fell on his face, and besought him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
bsb_text: While Jesus was in one of the towns, a man came along who was covered with leprosy. When he saw Jesus, he fell facedown and begged Him, “Lord, if You are willing, You can make me clean.”
aov_text: EN terwyl Hy in een van die stede was, kom daar ’n man vol van melaatsheid; en toe hy Jesus sien, val hy op sy aangesig en smeek Hom en sê: Here, as U wil, kan U my reinig.

kjv_text: And he put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will: be thou clean. And immediately the leprosy departed from him.
bsb_text: Jesus reached out His hand and touched the man. “I am willing,” He said. “Be clean!” And immediately the leprosy left him.
aov_text: Daarop steek Hy die hand uit en raak hom aan en sê: Ek wil, word gereinig! En dadelik het die melaatsheid hom verlaat.

kjv_text: And he charged him to tell no man: but go, and shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing, according as Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
bsb_text: “Do not tell anyone,” Jesus instructed him. “But go, show yourself to the priest and present the offering Moses prescribed for your cleansing, as a testimony to them.”
aov_text: Toe gee Hy hom bevel om dit aan niemand te vertel nie; maar, sê Hy, gaan vertoon jou aan die priester en offer vir jou reiniging, soos Moses voorgeskrywe het, vir hulle tot ’n getuienis.

kjv_text: But so much the more went there a fame abroad of him: and great multitudes came together to hear, and to be healed by him of their infirmities.
bsb_text: But the news about Jesus spread all the more, and great crowds came to hear Him and to be healed of their sicknesses.
aov_text: Maar die gerug aangaande Hom is nog meer versprei, en groot menigtes het bymekaargekom om te luister en deur Hom van hulle siektes genees te word.

kjv_text: And he withdrew himself into the wilderness, and prayed.
bsb_text: Yet He frequently withdrew to the wilderness to pray.
aov_text: Maar Hy het Hom in verlate plekke teruggetrek en gebid.

kjv_text: And it came to pass on a certain day, as he was teaching, that there were Pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by, which were come out of every town of Galilee, and Judaea, and Jerusalem: and the power of the Lord was present to heal them.
bsb_text: One day Jesus was teaching, and the Pharisees and teachers of the law were sitting there. People had come from Jerusalem and from every village of Galilee and Judea, and the power of the Lord was present for Him to heal the sick.
aov_text: EN op een van dié dae was Hy besig om te leer; en Fariseërs en wetgeleerdes wat gekom het uit elke dorp van Galiléa en Judéa en uit Jerusalem, het daar gesit, en daar was krag van die Here om hulle te genees.

kjv_text: And, behold, men brought in a bed a man which was taken with a palsy: and they sought means to bring him in, and to lay him before him.
bsb_text: Just then some men came carrying a paralyzed man on a mat. They tried to bring him inside to set him before Jesus,
aov_text: En daar het manne ’n mens wat verlam was, op ’n bed gebring, en hulle het probeer om hom in te bring en voor Hom neer te sit.

kjv_text: And when they could not find by what way they might bring him in because of the multitude, they went upon the housetop, and let him down through the tiling with his couch into the midst before Jesus.
bsb_text: but they could not find a way through the crowd. So they went up on the roof and lowered him on his mat through the tiles into the middle of the crowd, right in front of Jesus.
aov_text: En toe hulle vanweë die skare geen kans sien om hom in te bring nie, klim hulle op die dak en laat hom met die bed afsak deur die panne tussen die mense in en voor Jesus.

kjv_text: And when he saw their faith, he said unto him, Man, thy sins are forgiven thee.
bsb_text: When Jesus saw their faith, He said, “Friend, your sins are forgiven.”
aov_text: En toe Hy hulle geloof sien, sê Hy vir hom: Mens, jou sondes is jou vergewe.

kjv_text: And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, Who is this which speaketh blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?
bsb_text: But the scribes and Pharisees began thinking to themselves, “Who is this man who speaks blasphemy? Who can forgive sins but God alone?”
aov_text: En die skrifgeleerdes en die Fariseërs het begin redeneer en sê: Wie is Hy wat so godslasterlik praat? Wie kan sondes vergewe behalwe God alleen?

kjv_text: But when Jesus perceived their thoughts, he answering said unto them, What reason ye in your hearts?
bsb_text: Knowing what they were thinking, Jesus replied, “Why are you thinking these things in your hearts?
aov_text: Maar Jesus het hulle redeneringe gemerk, en Hy antwoord en sê vir hulle: Wat redeneer julle in jul harte?

kjv_text: Whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Rise up and walk?
bsb_text: Which is easier: to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up and walk?’
aov_text: Wat is makliker, om te sê: Jou sondes is jou vergewe; of om te sê: Staan op en loop?

kjv_text: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power upon earth to forgive sins, (he said unto the sick of the palsy,) I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy couch, and go into thine house.
bsb_text: But so that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on the earth to forgive sins...” He said to the paralytic, “I tell you, get up, pick up your mat, and go home.”
aov_text: Maar dat julle kan weet dat die Seun van die mens mag het om op aarde sondes te vergewe — sê Hy vir die verlamde man: Ek sê vir jou, staan op, neem jou bed op en gaan na jou huis toe.

kjv_text: And immediately he rose up before them, and took up that whereon he lay, and departed to his own house, glorifying God.
bsb_text: And immediately the man stood up before them, took what he had been lying on, and went home glorifying God.
aov_text: Hy staan toe onmiddellik voor hulle op, neem die bed op waar hy op gelê het, en gaan na sy huis, terwyl hy God verheerlik.

kjv_text: And they were all amazed, and they glorified God, and were filled with fear, saying, We have seen strange things to day.
bsb_text: Everyone was taken with amazement and glorified God. They were filled with awe and said, “We have seen remarkable things today.”
aov_text: En verbasing het almal aangegryp, en hulle het God verheerlik en is met vrees vervul en het gesê: Ons het vandag ongelooflike dinge gesien.

kjv_text: And after these things he went forth, and saw a publican, named Levi, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he said unto him, Follow me.
bsb_text: After this, Jesus went out and saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at the tax booth. “Follow Me,” He told him,
aov_text: EN ná hierdie dinge het Hy uitgegaan en ’n tollenaar met die naam van Levi by die tolhuis sien sit en vir hom gesê: Volg My.

kjv_text: And he left all, rose up, and followed him.
bsb_text: and Levi got up, left everything, and followed Him.
aov_text: En hy het alles verlaat en opgestaan en Hom gevolg.

kjv_text: And Levi made him a great feast in his own house: and there was a great company of publicans and of others that sat down with them.
bsb_text: Then Levi hosted a great banquet for Jesus at his house. A large crowd of tax collectors was there, along with others who were eating with them.
aov_text: En Levi het ’n groot feesmaal vir Hom in sy huis gegee; en daar was ’n groot menigte van tollenaars en ander wat saam met hulle aan tafel was.

kjv_text: But their scribes and Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, Why do ye eat and drink with publicans and sinners?
bsb_text: But the Pharisees and their scribes complained to Jesus’ disciples, “Why do you eat and drink with tax collectors and sinners?”
aov_text: En hulle skrifgeleerdes en die Fariseërs het by sy dissipels gemurmureer en gesê: Waarom eet en drink julle saam met die tollenaars en sondaars?

kjv_text: And Jesus answering said unto them, They that are whole need not a physician; but they that are sick.
bsb_text: Jesus answered, “It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick.
aov_text: En Jesus antwoord en sê vir hulle: Die wat gesond is, het die geneesheer nie nodig nie, maar die wat ongesteld is.

kjv_text: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
bsb_text: I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners, to repentance.”
aov_text: Ek het nie gekom om regverdiges te roep nie, maar sondaars tot bekering.

kjv_text: And they said unto him, Why do the disciples of John fast often, and make prayers, and likewise the disciples of the Pharisees; but thine eat and drink?
bsb_text: Then they said to Him, “John’s disciples and those of the Pharisees frequently fast and pray, but Yours keep on eating and drinking.”
aov_text: TOE sê hulle vir Hom: Waarom vas die dissipels van Johannes dikwels en doen gebede; so ook dié van die Fariseërs; maar u dissipels eet en drink?

kjv_text: And he said unto them, Can ye make the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them?
bsb_text: Jesus replied, “Can you make the guests of the bridegroom fast while He is with them?
aov_text: En Hy sê vir hulle: Kan julle die bruilofsgaste dan laat vas solank as die bruidegom by hulle is?

kjv_text: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.
bsb_text: But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them; then they will fast.”
aov_text: Maar daar sal dae kom wanneer die bruidegom van hulle weggeneem word; dan sal hulle vas, in daardie dae.

kjv_text: And he spake also a parable unto them; No man putteth a piece of a new garment upon an old; if otherwise, then both the new maketh a rent, and the piece that was taken out of the new agreeth not with the old.
bsb_text: He also told them a parable: “No one tears a piece of cloth from a new garment and sews it on an old one. If he does, he will tear the new garment as well, and the patch from the new will not match the old.
aov_text: En Hy het ook aan hulle ’n gelykenis vertel: Niemand sit ’n lap van ’n nuwe kleed op ’n ou kleed nie; anders skeur dit die nuwe ook, en die lap wat van die nuwe af kom, pas nie by die oue nie.

kjv_text: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles; else the new wine will burst the bottles, and be spilled, and the bottles shall perish.
bsb_text: And no one pours new wine into old wineskins. If he does, the new wine will burst the skins, the wine will spill, and the wineskins will be ruined.
aov_text: En niemand gooi nuwe wyn in ou leersakke nie; anders sal die nuwe wyn die sakke skeur, en dit sal uitloop, en die sakke sal vergaan.

kjv_text: But new wine must be put into new bottles; and both are preserved.
bsb_text: Instead, new wine is poured into new wineskins.
aov_text: Maar nuwe wyn moet in nuwe sakke gegooi word, en altwee word saam behou.

kjv_text: No man also having drunk old wine straightway desireth new: for he saith, The old is better.
bsb_text: And no one after drinking old wine wants new, for he says, ‘The old is better.’”
aov_text: En niemand wat ou wyn gedrink het, wil dadelik nuwe hê nie; want hy sê: Die oue is beter.

kjv_text: And it came to pass on the second sabbath after the first, that he went through the corn fields; and his disciples plucked the ears of corn, and did eat, rubbing them in their hands.
bsb_text: One Sabbath Jesus was passing through the grainfields, and His disciples began to pick the heads of grain, rub them in their hands, and eat them.
aov_text: EN op die tweede eerste sabbat het Hy deur die gesaaides geloop, en sy dissipels het die are gepluk en met hulle hande uitgevrywe en geëet.

kjv_text: And certain of the Pharisees said unto them, Why do ye that which is not lawful to do on the sabbath days?
bsb_text: But some of the Pharisees asked, “Why are you doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath?”
aov_text: Toe sê sommige van die Fariseërs vir hulle: Waarom doen julle wat nie geoorloof is om op die sabbat te doen nie?

kjv_text: And Jesus answering them said, Have ye not read so much as this, what David did, when himself was an hungred, and they which were with him;
bsb_text: Jesus replied, “Have you not read what David did when he and his companions were hungry?
aov_text: En Jesus antwoord en sê vir hulle: Het julle dan nie gelees wat Dawid gedoen het nie — toe hy honger gehad het, hy en die wat by hom was  —

kjv_text: How he went into the house of God, and did take and eat the shewbread, and gave also to them that were with him; which it is not lawful to eat but for the priests alone?
bsb_text: He entered the house of God, took the consecrated bread and gave it to his companions, and ate what is lawful only for the priests to eat.”
aov_text: hoe hy in die huis van God gegaan en die toonbrode geneem en geëet het, en ook aan die wat by hom was, gegee het, wat hulle nie geoorloof was om te eet nie, maar net vir die priesters alleen?

kjv_text: And he said unto them, That the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.
bsb_text: Then Jesus declared, “The Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”
aov_text: Toe sê Hy vir hulle: Die Seun van die mens is Here óók van die sabbat.

kjv_text: And it came to pass also on another sabbath, that he entered into the synagogue and taught: and there was a man whose right hand was withered.
bsb_text: On another Sabbath Jesus entered the synagogue and was teaching, and a man was there whose right hand was withered.
aov_text: EN op ’n ander sabbat het Hy in die sinagoge gegaan en geleer. En daar was ’n man, en sy regterhand was uitgedor.

kjv_text: And the scribes and Pharisees watched him, whether he would heal on the sabbath day; that they might find an accusation against him.
bsb_text: Looking for a reason to accuse Jesus, the scribes and Pharisees were watching Him closely to see if He would heal on the Sabbath.
aov_text: En die skrifgeleerdes en die Fariseërs het Hom in die oog gehou, of Hy op die sabbat gesond maak, sodat hulle ’n aanklag teen Hom kon vind.

kjv_text: But he knew their thoughts, and said to the man which had the withered hand, Rise up, and stand forth in the midst. And he arose and stood forth.
bsb_text: But Jesus knew their thoughts and said to the man with the withered hand, “Get up and stand among us.” So he got up and stood there.
aov_text: Maar Hy het hulle gedagtes geken en vir die man met die verdorde hand gesê: Staan op hier in hul midde. En hy het opgestaan.

kjv_text: Then said Jesus unto them, I will ask you one thing; Is it lawful on the sabbath days to do good, or to do evil? to save life, or to destroy it?
bsb_text: Then Jesus said to them, “I ask you, which is lawful on the Sabbath: to do good or to do evil, to save life or to destroy it?”
aov_text: Toe sê Jesus vir hulle: Ek sal aan julle ’n vraag stel: wat is geoorloof op die sabbat — om goed te doen of kwaad te doen; om ’n lewe te red of óm te bring?

kjv_text: And looking round about upon them all, he said unto the man, Stretch forth thy hand. And he did so: and his hand was restored whole as the other.
bsb_text: And after looking around at all of them, He said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He did so, and it was restored.
aov_text: En nadat Hy almal rondom aangekyk het, sê Hy vir die man: Steek jou hand uit! En hy het dit gedoen; en sy hand is herstel, gesond soos die ander een.

kjv_text: And they were filled with madness; and communed one with another what they might do to Jesus.
bsb_text: But the scribes and Pharisees were filled with rage and began to discuss with one another what they might do to Jesus.
aov_text: En hulle is met uitsinnigheid vervul en het met mekaar gepraat wat hulle aan Jesus sou doen.

kjv_text: And it came to pass in those days, that he went out into a mountain to pray, and continued all night in prayer to God.
bsb_text: In those days Jesus went out to the mountain to pray, and He spent the night in prayer to God.
aov_text: EN Hy het in daardie dae uitgegaan na die berg om te bid en die nag in die gebed tot God deurgebring.

kjv_text: And when it was day, he called unto him his disciples: and of them he chose twelve, whom also he named apostles;
bsb_text: When daylight came, He called His disciples to Him and chose twelve of them, whom He also designated as apostles:
aov_text: En toe dit dag geword het, het Hy sy dissipels na Hom geroep en twaalf van hulle uitgekies, wat Hy apostels genoem het:

kjv_text: Simon, (whom he also named Peter,) and Andrew his brother, James and John, Philip and Bartholomew,
bsb_text: Simon, whom He named Peter, and his brother Andrew; James and John; Philip and Bartholomew;
aov_text: Simon wat Hy Petrus genoem het, en Andréas, sy broer; Jakobus en Johannes; Filippus en Bartholoméüs;

kjv_text: Matthew and Thomas, James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon called Zelotes,
bsb_text: Matthew and Thomas; James son of Alphaeus and Simon called the Zealot;
