aov_text: Matthéüs en Thomas; Jakobus, die seun van Alféüs, en Simon wat Yweraar genoem word;

kjv_text: And Judas the brother of James, and Judas Iscariot, which also was the traitor.
bsb_text: Judas son of James, and Judas Iscariot, who became a traitor.
aov_text: Judas, die seun van Jakobus, en Judas Iskáriot, wat die verraaier geword het.

kjv_text: And he came down with them, and stood in the plain, and the company of his disciples, and a great multitude of people out of all Judaea and Jerusalem, and from the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon,
bsb_text: Then Jesus came down with them and stood on a level place. A large crowd of His disciples was there, along with a great number of people from all over Judea, Jerusalem, and the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon.
aov_text: EN Hy het met hulle afgeklim en op ’n gelyk plek gaan staan, en daar was ’n skare van sy dissipels en ’n groot menigte van die volk van die hele Judéa en Jerusalem en die kusstreek van Tirus en Sidon af,

kjv_text: which came to hear him, and to be healed of their diseases;
bsb_text: They had come to hear Him and to be healed of their diseases,
aov_text: wat gekom het om Hom te hoor en van hulle kwale genees te word;

kjv_text: And they that were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed.
bsb_text: and those troubled by unclean spirits were healed.
aov_text: en die wat gekwel was deur onreine geeste, is ook genees.

kjv_text: And the whole multitude sought to touch him: for there went virtue out of him, and healed them all.
bsb_text: The entire crowd was trying to touch Him, because power was coming from Him and healing them all.
aov_text: En die hele skare het probeer om Hom aan te raak, omdat krag van Hom uitgegaan het, en Hy het almal gesond gemaak.

kjv_text: And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples, and said, Blessed be ye poor: for yours is the kingdom of God.
bsb_text: Looking up at His disciples, Jesus said: “Blessed are you who are poor, for yours is the kingdom of God.
aov_text: Toe slaan Hy sy oë op oor sy dissipels en sê: Salig is julle, armes, want aan julle behoort die koninkryk van God.

kjv_text: Blessed are ye that hunger now: for ye shall be filled. Blessed are ye that weep now: for ye shall laugh.
bsb_text: Blessed are you who hunger now, for you will be filled. Blessed are you who weep now, for you will laugh.
aov_text: Salig is julle wat nou honger het, want julle sal versadig word. Salig is julle wat nou ween, want julle sal lag.

kjv_text: Blessed are ye, when men shall hate you, and when they shall separate you from their company, and shall reproach you, and cast out your name as evil, for the Son of man's sake.
bsb_text: Blessed are you when people hate you, and when they exclude you and insult you and reject your name as evil because of the Son of Man.
aov_text: Salig is julle wanneer die mense julle haat, en wanneer hulle julle verstoot en beledig en jul naam weggooi soos iets wat sleg is, ter wille van die Seun van die mens.

kjv_text: Rejoice ye in that day, and leap for joy: for, behold, your reward is great in heaven: for in the like manner did their fathers unto the prophets.
bsb_text: Rejoice in that day and leap for joy, because great is your reward in heaven. For their fathers treated the prophets in the same way.
aov_text: Wees bly in daardie dag en spring op, want kyk, julle loon is groot in die hemel, want hulle vaders het net so aan die profete gedoen.

kjv_text: But woe unto you that are rich! for ye have received your consolation.
bsb_text: But woe to you who are rich, for you have already received your comfort.
aov_text: Maar wee julle, rykes, want julle het jul troos weg.

kjv_text: Woe unto you that are full! for ye shall hunger. Woe unto you that laugh now! for ye shall mourn and weep.
bsb_text: Woe to you who are well fed now, for you will hunger. Woe to you who laugh now, for you will mourn and weep.
aov_text: Wee julle wat vol is, want julle sal honger ly. Wee julle wat nou lag, want julle sal treur en ween.

kjv_text: Woe unto you, when all men shall speak well of you! for so did their fathers to the false prophets.
bsb_text: Woe to you when all men speak well of you, for their fathers treated the false prophets in the same way.
aov_text: Wee julle wanneer al die mense goed van julle praat, want hulle vaders het net so aan die valse profete gedoen.

kjv_text: But I say unto you which hear, Love your enemies, do good to them which hate you,
bsb_text: But to those of you who will listen, I say: Love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,
aov_text: Maar Ek sê vir julle wat luister: Julle moet jul vyande liefhê en goed doen aan die wat vir julle haat.

kjv_text: Bless them that curse you, and pray for them which despitefully use you.
bsb_text: bless those who curse you, pray for those who mistreat you.
aov_text: Seën die wat vir julle vervloek, en bid vir die wat julle beledig.

kjv_text: And unto him that smiteth thee on the one cheek offer also the other; and him that taketh away thy cloak forbid not to take thy coat also.
bsb_text: If someone strikes you on one cheek, turn to him the other also. And if someone takes your cloak, do not withhold your tunic as well.
aov_text: Aan hom wat jou op die wang slaan, moet jy ook die ander een aanbied; en aan hom wat jou bo-kleed neem, moet jy ook die onderkleed nie weier nie.

kjv_text: Give to every man that asketh of thee; and of him that taketh away thy goods ask them not again.
bsb_text: Give to everyone who asks you, and if anyone takes what is yours, do not demand it back.
aov_text: Maar gee aan elkeen wat jou iets vra, en eis jou goed nie terug van hom wat dit neem nie.

kjv_text: And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.
bsb_text: Do to others as you would have them do to you.
aov_text: En soos julle wil hê dat die mense aan julle moet doen, so moet julle ook aan hulle doen.

kjv_text: For if ye love them which love you, what thank have ye? for sinners also love those that love them.
bsb_text: If you love those who love you, what credit is that to you? Even sinners love those who love them.
aov_text: En as julle dié liefhet wat vir julle liefhet, watter dank het julle? Want die sondaars het ook dié lief wat vir hulle liefhet.

kjv_text: And if ye do good to them which do good to you, what thank have ye? for sinners also do even the same.
bsb_text: If you do good to those who do good to you, what credit is that to you? Even sinners do the same.
aov_text: En as julle goed doen aan die wat aan julle goed doen, watter dank het julle? Want die sondaars doen ook dieselfde.

kjv_text: And if ye lend to them of whom ye hope to receive, what thank have ye? for sinners also lend to sinners, to receive as much again.
bsb_text: And if you lend to those from whom you expect repayment, what credit is that to you? Even sinners lend to sinners, expecting to be repaid in full.
aov_text: En as julle leen aan dié van wie julle hoop om terug te ontvang, watter dank het julle? Want die sondaars leen ook aan die sondaars, om net soveel terug te ontvang.

kjv_text: But love ye your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing again; and your reward shall be great, and ye shall be the children of the Highest: for he is kind unto the unthankful and to the evil.
bsb_text: But love your enemies, do good to them, and lend to them, expecting nothing in return. Then your reward will be great, and you will be sons of the Most High; for He is kind to the ungrateful and wicked.
aov_text: Maar julle moet jul vyande liefhê en goed doen en leen sonder om iets terug te verwag, en julle loon sal groot wees; en julle sal kinders van die Allerhoogste wees; want Hy self is goedertieren oor die ondankbares en slegtes.

kjv_text: Be ye therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful.
bsb_text: Be merciful, just as your Father is merciful.
aov_text: Wees dan barmhartig, soos julle Vader ook barmhartig is.

kjv_text: Judge not, and ye shall not be judged: condemn not, and ye shall not be condemned: forgive, and ye shall be forgiven:
bsb_text: Do not judge, and you will not be judged. Do not condemn, and you will not be condemned. Forgive, and you will be forgiven.
aov_text: En julle moet nie oordeel nie, dan sal julle nooit geoordeel word nie. Julle moet nie veroordeel nie, dan sal julle nooit veroordeel word nie. Spreek vry, en julle sal vrygespreek word.

kjv_text: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.
bsb_text: Give, and it will be given to you. A good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over will be poured into your lap. For with the measure you use, it will be measured back to you.”
aov_text: Gee, en aan julle sal gegee word. ’n Goeie maat wat ingedruk en geskud en oorlopend is, sal hulle in jul skoot gee, want met dieselfde maat waarmee julle meet, sal weer vir julle gemeet word.

kjv_text: And he spake a parable unto them, Can the blind lead the blind? shall they not both fall into the ditch?
bsb_text: Jesus also told them a parable: “Can a blind man lead a blind man? Will they not both fall into a pit?
aov_text: En Hy het vir hulle ’n gelykenis uitgespreek: ’n Blinde kan tog nie ’n blinde lei nie! Sal hulle nie altwee in die sloot val nie?

kjv_text: The disciple is not above his master: but every one that is perfect shall be as his master.
bsb_text: A disciple is not above his teacher, but everyone who is fully trained will be like his teacher.
aov_text: ’n Leerling is nie bo sy meester nie; maar elkeen wat volleerd is, sal soos sy meester wees.

kjv_text: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but perceivest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
bsb_text: Why do you look at the speck in your brother’s eye, but fail to notice the beam in your own eye?
aov_text: En waarom sien jy die splinter in die oog van jou broeder, maar die balk wat in jou eie oog is, merk jy nie op nie?

kjv_text: Either how canst thou say to thy brother, Brother, let me pull out the mote that is in thine eye, when thou thyself beholdest not the beam that is in thine own eye? Thou hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of thine own eye, and then shalt thou see clearly to pull out the mote that is in thy brother's eye.
bsb_text: How can you say, ‘Brother, let me take the speck out of your eye,’ while you yourself fail to see the beam in your own eye? You hypocrite! First take the beam out of your own eye, and then you will see clearly to remove the speck from your brother’s eye.
aov_text: Of hoe kan jy vir jou broeder sê: Broeder, laat my toe om die splinter wat in jou oog is, uit te haal, terwyl jy self die balk wat in jou oog is, nie sien nie? Geveinsde, haal eers die balk uit jou oog uit, en dan sal jy goed sien om die splinter wat in jou broeder se oog is, uit te haal.

kjv_text: For a good tree bringeth not forth corrupt fruit; neither doth a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
bsb_text: No good tree bears bad fruit, nor does a bad tree bear good fruit.
aov_text: Want dit is nie ’n goeie boom wat slegte vrugte dra nie, en ook nie ’n slegte boom wat goeie vrugte dra nie.

kjv_text: For every tree is known by his own fruit. For of thorns men do not gather figs, nor of a bramble bush gather they grapes.
bsb_text: For each tree is known by its own fruit. Indeed, figs are not gathered from thornbushes, nor grapes from brambles.
aov_text: Want elke boom word geken aan sy eie vrugte. Van dorings pluk ’n mens tog nie vye nie, en ’n mens sny ook nie druiwe van ’n doringbos nie.

kjv_text: A good man out of the good treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is good; and an evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is evil: for of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaketh.
bsb_text: The good man brings good things out of the good treasure of his heart, and the evil man brings evil things out of the evil treasure of his heart. For out of the overflow of the heart, the mouth speaks.
aov_text: Die goeie mens bring uit die goeie skat van sy hart te voorskyn wat goed is; en die slegte mens bring uit die slegte skat van sy hart te voorskyn wat sleg is; want uit die oorvloed van die hart spreek sy mond.

kjv_text: And why call ye me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say?
bsb_text: Why do you call Me ‘Lord, Lord,’ but not do what I say?
aov_text: En wat noem julle My: Here, Here! en doen nie wat Ek sê nie?

kjv_text: Whosoever cometh to me, and heareth my sayings, and doeth them, I will shew you to whom he is like:
bsb_text: I will show you what he is like who comes to Me and hears My words and acts on them:
aov_text: Elkeen wat na My toe kom en na my woorde luister en dit doen — Ek sal julle wys soos wie hy is.

kjv_text: He is like a man which built an house, and digged deep, and laid the foundation on a rock: and when the flood arose, the stream beat vehemently upon that house, and could not shake it: for it was founded upon a rock.
bsb_text: He is like a man building a house, who dug down deep and laid his foundation on the rock. When the flood came, the torrent crashed against that house but could not shake it, because it was well built.
aov_text: Hy is soos ’n man wat ’n huis bou, wat gegrawe en diep ingegaan en die fondament op die rots gelê het; en toe die vloedwater kom en die stroom teen daardie huis losbreek, kon hy dit nie beweeg nie, omdat sy fondament op die rots was.

kjv_text: But he that heareth, and doeth not, is like a man that without a foundation built an house upon the earth; against which the stream did beat vehemently, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.
bsb_text: But the one who hears My words and does not act on them is like a man who built his house on ground without a foundation. The torrent crashed against that house, and immediately it fell—and great was its destruction!”
aov_text: Maar wie dit hoor en dit nie doen nie, is soos ’n man wat ’n huis sonder fondament op die grond bou, en die stroom het daarteen losgebreek en dit het dadelik geval, en die instorting van daardie huis was groot.

kjv_text: Now when he had ended all his sayings in the audience of the people, he entered into Capernaum.
bsb_text: When Jesus had concluded His discourse in the hearing of the people, He went to Capernaum.
aov_text: EN nadat Hy voor die ore van die volk al sy woorde beëindig het, het Hy in Kapérnaüm ingegaan.

kjv_text: And a certain centurion's servant, who was dear unto him, was sick, and ready to die.
bsb_text: There a highly valued servant of a centurion was sick and about to die.
aov_text: En die dienskneg van ’n sekere hoofman oor honderd, wat vir hom baie werd was, was ongesteld en het op sterwe gelê.

kjv_text: And when he heard of Jesus, he sent unto him the elders of the Jews, beseeching him that he would come and heal his servant.
bsb_text: When the centurion heard about Jesus, he sent some Jewish elders to ask Him to come and heal his servant.
aov_text: Toe hy dan van Jesus hoor, het hy ouderlinge van die Jode na Hom gestuur met die versoek aan Hom dat Hy moes kom en sy dienskneg gesond maak.

kjv_text: And when they came to Jesus, they besought him instantly, saying, That he was worthy for whom he should do this:
bsb_text: They came to Jesus and pleaded with Him earnestly, “This man is worthy to have You grant this,
aov_text: En toe hulle by Jesus kom, het hulle Hom dringend gesmeek en gesê: Hy is dit werd dat U dit vir hom doen;

kjv_text: For he loveth our nation, and he hath built us a synagogue.
bsb_text: for he loves our nation and has built our synagogue.”
aov_text: want hy het ons volk lief en het self die sinagoge vir ons gebou.

kjv_text: Then Jesus went with them. And when he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying unto him, Lord, trouble not thyself: for I am not worthy that thou shouldest enter under my roof:
bsb_text: So Jesus went with them. But when He was not far from the house, the centurion sent friends with the message: “Lord, do not trouble Yourself, for I am not worthy to have You come under my roof.
aov_text: En Jesus het saam met hulle gegaan; maar toe Hy nie meer ver van die huis af was nie, stuur die hoofman oor honderd vriende na Hom om vir Hom te sê: Here, moenie moeite doen nie, want ek is nie werd dat U onder my dak inkom nie.

kjv_text: Wherefore neither thought I myself worthy to come unto thee: but say in a word, and my servant shall be healed.
bsb_text: That is why I did not consider myself worthy to come to You. But just say the word, and my servant will be healed.
aov_text: Daarom het ek my ook nie waardig geag om na U te gaan nie; sê dit maar met ’n woord, en my kneg sal gesond word.

kjv_text: For I also am a man set under authority, having under me soldiers, and I say unto one, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.
bsb_text: For I myself am a man under authority, with soldiers under me. I tell one to go, and he goes; and another to come, and he comes. I tell my servant to do something, and he does it.”
aov_text: Want ek is ook ’n man wat aan gesag onderworpe is, en ek het soldate onder my; en vir hierdie een sê ek: Gaan! en hy gaan; en vir ’n ander een: Kom! en hy kom; en vir my dienskneg: Doen dit! en hy doen dit.

kjv_text: When Jesus heard these things, he marvelled at him, and turned him about, and said unto the people that followed him, I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.
bsb_text: When Jesus heard this, He marveled at the centurion. Turning to the crowd following Him, He said, “I tell you, not even in Israel have I found such great faith.”
aov_text: Toe Jesus dit hoor, was Hy oor hom verwonderd, en Hy draai Hom om en sê vir die skare wat Hom volg: Ek sê vir julle, selfs in Israel het Ek so groot ’n geloof nie gevind nie.

kjv_text: And they that were sent, returning to the house, found the servant whole that had been sick.
bsb_text: And when the messengers returned to the house, they found the servant in good health.
aov_text: En toe die wat gestuur was, teruggaan na die huis, vind hulle die siek dienskneg gesond.

kjv_text: And it came to pass the day after, that he went into a city called Nain; and many of his disciples went with him, and much people.
bsb_text: Soon afterward, Jesus went to a town called Nain. His disciples went with Him, accompanied by a large crowd.
aov_text: EN die dag daarna was Hy op weg na ’n stad met die naam van Nain; en baie van sy dissipels en ’n groot menigte het saam met Hom gegaan.

kjv_text: Now when he came nigh to the gate of the city, behold, there was a dead man carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow: and much people of the city was with her.
bsb_text: As He approached the town gate, He saw a dead man being carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow. And a large crowd from the town was with her.
aov_text: En toe Hy naby die poort van die stad kom, word daar net ’n dooie uitgedra, die enigste seun van sy moeder, en sy was ’n weduwee; en ’n groot menigte van die stad was by haar.

kjv_text: And when the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her, and said unto her, Weep not.
bsb_text: When the Lord saw her, He had compassion on her and said, “Do not weep.”
aov_text: En toe die Here haar sien, het Hy innig jammer vir haar gevoel en vir haar gesê: Moenie ween nie!

kjv_text: And he came and touched the bier: and they that bare him stood still. And he said, Young man, I say unto thee, Arise.
bsb_text: Then He went up and touched the coffin, and those carrying it stood still. “Young man,” He said, “I tell you, get up!”
aov_text: En Hy het nader gegaan en die baar aangeraak. Daarop staan die draers stil. En Hy sê: Jongman, Ek sê vir jou, staan op!

kjv_text: And he that was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he delivered him to his mother.
bsb_text: And the dead man sat up and began to speak! Then Jesus gave him back to his mother.
aov_text: En die dooie het regop gaan sit en begin praat; en Hy het hom aan sy moeder teruggegee.

kjv_text: And there came a fear on all: and they glorified God, saying, That a great prophet is risen up among us; and, That God hath visited his people.
bsb_text: A sense of awe swept over all of them, and they glorified God. “A great prophet has appeared among us!” they said. “God has visited His people!”
aov_text: En vrees het almal aangegryp terwyl hulle God verheerlik en sê: ’n Groot profeet het onder ons opgestaan; en: God het sy volk besoek.

kjv_text: And this rumour of him went forth throughout all Judaea, and throughout all the region round about.
bsb_text: And the news about Jesus spread throughout Judea and all the surrounding region.
aov_text: En hierdie woord aangaande Hom het uitgegaan in die hele Judéa en in die hele omtrek.

kjv_text: And the disciples of John shewed him of all these things.
bsb_text: Then John’s disciples informed him about all these things.
aov_text: EN die dissipels van Johannes het hom van al hierdie dinge berig gebring.

kjv_text: And John calling unto him two of his disciples sent them to Jesus, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?
bsb_text: So John called two of his disciples and sent them to ask the Lord, “Are You the One who was to come, or should we look for someone else?”
aov_text: En Johannes het sekere twee van sy dissipels na hom geroep en hulle na Jesus gestuur en gesê: Is U die Een wat sou kom, of moet ons ’n ander een verwag?

kjv_text: When the men were come unto him, they said, John Baptist hath sent us unto thee, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?
bsb_text: When the men came to Jesus, they said, “John the Baptist sent us to ask, ‘Are You the One who was to come, or should we look for someone else?’”
aov_text: En toe die manne by Hom kom, sê hulle: Johannes die Doper het ons na U gestuur en gesê: Is U die Een wat sou kom, of moet ons ’n ander een verwag?

kjv_text: And in that same hour he cured many of their infirmities and plagues, and of evil spirits; and unto many that were blind he gave sight.
bsb_text: At that very hour Jesus healed many people of their diseases, afflictions, and evil spirits, and He gave sight to many who were blind.
aov_text: En in dieselfde uur het Hy baie mense genees van siektes en kwale en bose geeste, en aan baie blindes die gesig geskenk.

kjv_text: Then Jesus answering said unto them, Go your way, and tell John what things ye have seen and heard; how that the blind see, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, to the poor the gospel is preached.
bsb_text: So He replied, “Go back and report to John what you have seen and heard: The blind receive sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, and the good news is preached to the poor.
aov_text: En Jesus antwoord en sê vir hulle: Gaan vertel aan Johannes wat julle sien en hoor: blindes sien weer, kreupeles loop, melaatses word gereinig, dowes hoor, dooies word opgewek, aan armes word die evangelie verkondig.

kjv_text: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.
bsb_text: Blessed is the one who does not fall away on account of Me.”
aov_text: En salig is elkeen wat aan My nie aanstoot neem nie.

kjv_text: And when the messengers of John were departed, he began to speak unto the people concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness for to see? A reed shaken with the wind?
bsb_text: After John’s messengers had left, Jesus began to speak to the crowds about John: “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed swaying in the wind?
aov_text: En nadat die boodskappers van Johannes weggegaan het, begin Hy vir die skare aangaande Johannes te sê: Wat het julle uitgegaan in die woestyn om te aanskou? ’n Riet wat deur die wind beweeg word?

kjv_text: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? Behold, they which are gorgeously apparelled, and live delicately, are in kings' courts.
bsb_text: Otherwise, what did you go out to see? A man dressed in fine clothes? Look, those who wear elegant clothing and live in luxury are found in palaces.
aov_text: Maar wat het julle uitgegaan om te sien? ’n Man met sagte klere aan? Kyk, die wat pragtige klere dra en in weelde lewe, is in die paleise.

kjv_text: But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? Yea, I say unto you, and much more than a prophet.
bsb_text: What then did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and more than a prophet.
aov_text: Maar wat het julle uitgegaan om te sien? ’n Profeet? Ja, Ek sê vir julle, nog baie meer as ’n profeet!

kjv_text: This is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.
bsb_text: This is the one about whom it is written: ‘Behold, I will send My messenger ahead of You, who will prepare Your way before You.’
aov_text: Dit is hy van wie daar geskrywe is: Kyk, Ek stuur my boodskapper voor u aangesig, wat u weg voor U uit sal regmaak.

kjv_text: For I say unto you, Among those that are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptist: but he that is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he.
bsb_text: I tell you, among those born of women there is no one greater than John, yet even the least in the kingdom of God is greater than he.”
aov_text: Want Ek sê vir julle, onder die wat uit vroue gebore is, is daar geen profeet groter as Johannes die Doper nie; maar die kleinste in die koninkryk van God is groter as hy.

kjv_text: And all the people that heard him, and the publicans, justified God, being baptized with the baptism of John.
bsb_text: All the people who heard this, even the tax collectors, acknowledged God’s justice. For they had received the baptism of John.
aov_text: En toe die hele volk en die tollenaars dit hoor, het hulle God geregverdig deur hulle te laat doop met die doop van Johannes.

kjv_text: But the Pharisees and lawyers rejected the counsel of God against themselves, being not baptized of him.
bsb_text: But the Pharisees and experts in the law rejected God’s purpose for themselves, because they had not been baptized by John.
aov_text: Maar die Fariseërs en die wetgeleerdes het die raad van God aangaande hulle verwerp deur hulle nie deur hom te laat doop nie.

kjv_text: And the Lord said, Whereunto then shall I liken the men of this generation? and to what are they like?
bsb_text: “To what, then, can I compare the men of this generation? What are they like?
aov_text: Toe sê die Here: Waarmee sal Ek dan die mense van hierdie geslag vergelyk, en waaraan is hulle gelyk?

kjv_text: They are like unto children sitting in the marketplace, and calling one to another, and saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned to you, and ye have not wept.
bsb_text: They are like children sitting in the marketplace and calling out to one another: ‘We played the flute for you, and you did not dance; we sang a dirge, and you did not weep.’
aov_text: Hulle is net soos kinders wat op die mark sit en na mekaar roep en sê: Ons het vir julle op die fluit gespeel, en julle het nie gedans nie; ons het vir julle ’n klaaglied gesing, en julle het nie gehuil nie.

kjv_text: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine; and ye say, He hath a devil.
bsb_text: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, ‘He has a demon!’
aov_text: Want Johannes die Doper het gekom en het nie brood geëet of wyn gedrink nie, en julle sê: Hy het ’n duiwel.

kjv_text: The Son of man is come eating and drinking; and ye say, Behold a gluttonous man, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners!
bsb_text: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and you say, ‘Look at this glutton and drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’
aov_text: Die Seun van die mens het gekom en Hy eet en drink, en julle sê: Daar is ’n mens wat ’n vraat en ’n wynsuiper is, ’n vriend van tollenaars en sondaars.

kjv_text: But wisdom is justified of all her children.
bsb_text: But wisdom is vindicated by all her children.”
aov_text: Maar die wysheid is geregverdig deur al sy kinders.

kjv_text: And one of the Pharisees desired him that he would eat with him. And he went into the Pharisee's house, and sat down to meat.
bsb_text: Then one of the Pharisees invited Jesus to eat with him, and He entered the Pharisee’s house and reclined at the table.
aov_text: EN een van die Fariseërs het Hom genooi om by hom te eet; en Hy het in die huis van die Fariseër gekom en aan tafel gegaan.

kjv_text: And, behold, a woman in the city, which was a sinner, when she knew that Jesus sat at meat in the Pharisee's house, brought an alabaster box of ointment,
bsb_text: When a sinful woman from that town learned that Jesus was dining there, she brought an alabaster jar of perfume.
aov_text: En toe ’n vrou in die stad, wat ’n sondares was, verneem dat Hy in die Fariseër se huis aan tafel was, het sy ’n albaste fles met salf gebring

kjv_text: And stood at his feet behind him weeping, and began to wash his feet with tears, and did wipe them with the hairs of her head, and kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.
bsb_text: As she stood behind Him at His feet weeping, she began to wet His feet with her tears and wipe them with her hair. Then she kissed His feet and anointed them with the perfume.
aov_text: en agter by sy voete gaan staan en geween; en sy het sy voete begin natmaak met haar trane en hulle afgedroog met die hare van haar hoof; en sy het sy voete gesoen en met salf gesalf.

kjv_text: Now when the Pharisee which had bidden him saw it, he spake within himself, saying, This man, if he were a prophet, would have known who and what manner of woman this is that toucheth him: for she is a sinner.
bsb_text: When the Pharisee who had invited Jesus saw this, he said to himself, “If this man were a prophet, He would know who this is and what kind of woman is touching Him—for she is a sinner!”
aov_text: Toe die Fariseër wat Hom genooi het, dit sien, sê hy by homself: Hy, as Hy ’n profeet was, sou geweet het wie en watter soort vrou dit is wat Hom aanraak; want sy is ’n sondares.

kjv_text: And Jesus answering said unto him, Simon, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And he saith, Master, say on.
bsb_text: But Jesus answered him, “Simon, I have something to tell you.” “Tell me, Teacher,” he said.
aov_text: En Jesus antwoord en sê vir hom: Simon, Ek het iets om aan jou te sê. En hy antwoord: Meester, spreek.

kjv_text: There was a certain creditor which had two debtors: the one owed five hundred pence, and the other fifty.
bsb_text: “Two men were debtors to a certain moneylender. One owed him five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.
aov_text: Hy sê toe: ’n Sekere geldskieter het twee skuldenaars gehad; die een het vyfhonderd pennings geskuld en die ander een vyftig;

kjv_text: And when they had nothing to pay, he frankly forgave them both. Tell me therefore, which of them will love him most?
bsb_text: When they were unable to repay him, he forgave both of them. Which one, then, will love him more?”
aov_text: en omdat hulle niks gehad het om te betaal nie, het hy dit aan altwee geskenk. Sê nou, wie van hulle sal hom die meeste liefhê?

kjv_text: Simon answered and said, I suppose that he, to whom he forgave most. And he said unto him, Thou hast rightly judged.
bsb_text: “I suppose the one who was forgiven more,” Simon replied. “You have judged correctly,” Jesus said.
aov_text: En Simon antwoord en sê: Ek veronderstel dié een aan wie hy die meeste geskenk het. En Hy antwoord hom: Jy het reg geoordeel.

kjv_text: And he turned to the woman, and said unto Simon, Seest thou this woman? I entered into thine house, thou gavest me no water for my feet: but she hath washed my feet with tears, and wiped them with the hairs of her head.
bsb_text: And turning toward the woman, He said to Simon, “Do you see this woman? When I entered your house, you did not give Me water for My feet, but she wet My feet with her tears and wiped them with her hair.
aov_text: Daarop draai Hy om na die vrou en sê vir Simon: Sien jy hierdie vrou? Ek het in jou huis gekom — water het jy nie vir my voete gegee nie; maar sy het met haar trane my voete natgemaak en met die hare van haar hoof afgedroog.

kjv_text: Thou gavest me no kiss: but this woman since the time I came in hath not ceased to kiss my feet.
bsb_text: You did not greet Me with a kiss, but she has not stopped kissing My feet since I arrived.
aov_text: ’n Soen het jy My nie gegee nie; maar sy het, vandat sy ingekom het, nie opgehou om my voete te soen nie.

kjv_text: My head with oil thou didst not anoint: but this woman hath anointed my feet with ointment.
bsb_text: You did not anoint My head with oil, but she has anointed My feet with perfume.
aov_text: Met olie het jy my hoof nie gesalf nie; maar sy het my voete met salf gesalf.

kjv_text: Wherefore I say unto thee, Her sins, which are many, are forgiven; for she loved much: but to whom little is forgiven, the same loveth little.
bsb_text: Therefore I tell you, because her many sins have been forgiven, she has loved much. But he who has been forgiven little loves little.”
aov_text: Daarom sê Ek vir jou: Haar sondes wat baie is, is vergewe, want sy het baie liefgehad; maar hy vir wie weinig vergewe is, het weinig lief.

kjv_text: And he said unto her, Thy sins are forgiven.
bsb_text: Then Jesus said to her, “Your sins are forgiven.”
aov_text: En Hy sê vir haar: Jou sondes is vergewe.

kjv_text: And they that sat at meat with him began to say within themselves, Who is this that forgiveth sins also?
bsb_text: But those at the table began to say to themselves, “Who is this who even forgives sins?”
aov_text: Toe begin die wat aan tafel was, by hulleself te sê: Wie is hierdie man wat selfs die sondes vergewe?

kjv_text: And he said to the woman, Thy faith hath saved thee; go in peace.
bsb_text: And Jesus told the woman, “Your faith has saved you; go in peace.”
aov_text: En Hy sê vir die vrou: Jou geloof het jou gered; gaan in vrede.

kjv_text: And it came to pass afterward, that he went throughout every city and village, preaching and shewing the glad tidings of the kingdom of God: and the twelve were with him,
bsb_text: Soon afterward, Jesus traveled from one town and village to another, preaching and proclaiming the good news of the kingdom of God. The Twelve were with Him,
aov_text: EN daarna het Hy die een stad en dorp ná die ander deurgereis en gepreek en die evangelie van die koninkryk van God verkondig; en die twaalf was saam met Hom,

kjv_text: And certain women, which had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities, Mary called Magdalene, out of whom went seven devils,
bsb_text: as well as some women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities: Mary called Magdalene, from whom seven demons had gone out,
aov_text: ook sekere vroue wat genees was van bose geeste en siektes: Maria wat Magdaléna genoem word, uit wie sewe duiwels uitgegaan het,

kjv_text: And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod's steward, and Susanna, and many others, which ministered unto him of their substance.
bsb_text: Joanna the wife of Herod’s household manager Chuza, Susanna, and many others. These women were ministering to them out of their own means.
aov_text: en Johanna, die vrou van Gusa, ’n bestuurder van Herodes, en Susanna en baie ander wat Hom almal met hulle besittings gedien het.

kjv_text: And when much people were gathered together, and were come to him out of every city, he spake by a parable:
bsb_text: While a large crowd was gathering and people were coming to Jesus from town after town, He told them this parable:
aov_text: EN toe daar ’n groot menigte vergader, en die wat uit die verskillende stede by Hom aangesluit het, sê Hy aan hulle deur ’n gelykenis:

kjv_text: A sower went out to sow his seed: and as he sowed, some fell by the way side; and it was trodden down, and the fowls of the air devoured it.
bsb_text: “A farmer went out to sow his seed. And as he was sowing, some seed fell along the path, where it was trampled, and the birds of the air devoured it.
aov_text: ’n Saaier het uitgegaan om sy saad te saai; en toe hy saai, val ’n deel langs die pad en is vertrap, en die voëls van die hemel het dit opgeëet.

kjv_text: And some fell upon a rock; and as soon as it was sprung up, it withered away, because it lacked moisture.
bsb_text: Some fell on rocky ground, and when it came up, the seedlings withered because they had no moisture.
aov_text: En ’n ander deel het op die rots geval; en nadat dit opgeskiet het, het dit verdroog, omdat dit geen vogtigheid gehad het nie.

kjv_text: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprang up with it, and choked it.
bsb_text: Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up with it and choked the seedlings.
aov_text: En ’n ander deel het tussen die dorings in geval; en die dorings het daarmee saamgegroei en dit verstik.

kjv_text: And other fell on good ground, and sprang up, and bare fruit an hundredfold. And when he had said these things, he cried, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
bsb_text: Still other seed fell on good soil, where it sprang up and produced a crop—a hundredfold.” As Jesus said this, He called out, “He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”
aov_text: En ’n ander deel het in die goeie grond geval en gegroei en honderdvoudige vrug opgelewer. Toe Hy dit gesê het, roep Hy uit: Wie ore het om te hoor, laat hom hoor!

kjv_text: And his disciples asked him, saying, What might this parable be?
bsb_text: Then His disciples asked Him what this parable meant.
aov_text: En sy dissipels het Hom gevra en gesê: Wat beteken hierdie gelykenis tog?

kjv_text: And he said, Unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God: but to others in parables; that seeing they might not see, and hearing they might not understand.
bsb_text: He replied, “The knowledge of the mysteries of the kingdom of God has been given to you, but to others I speak in parables, so that, ‘though seeing, they may not see; though hearing, they may not understand.’
aov_text: En Hy antwoord: Aan julle is dit gegee om die verborgenhede van die koninkryk van God te ken; maar aan die ander deur gelykenisse, sodat hulle, terwyl hulle sien, nie sien nie, en terwyl hulle hoor, nie verstaan nie.

kjv_text: Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.
bsb_text: Now this is the meaning of the parable: The seed is the word of God.
aov_text: Dit is dan die gelykenis: Die saad is die woord van God.

kjv_text: Those by the way side are they that hear; then cometh the devil, and taketh away the word out of their hearts, lest they should believe and be saved.
bsb_text: The seeds along the path are those who hear, but the devil comes and takes away the word from their hearts, so that they may not believe and be saved.
aov_text: Dié langs die pad is die hoorders. Daarna kom die duiwel en neem die woord uit hul hart weg, sodat hulle nie sou glo en gered word nie.

kjv_text: They on the rock are they, which, when they hear, receive the word with joy; and these have no root, which for a while believe, and in time of temptation fall away.
bsb_text: The seeds on rocky ground are those who hear the word and receive it with joy, but they have no root. They believe for a season, but in the time of testing, they fall away.
aov_text: En dié op die rots is hulle wat die woord met blydskap ontvang wanneer hulle dit hoor; en hulle het geen wortel nie, aangesien hulle net vir ’n tyd glo, en in die tyd van versoeking val hulle af.

kjv_text: And that which fell among thorns are they, which, when they have heard, go forth, and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of this life, and bring no fruit to perfection.
bsb_text: The seeds that fell among the thorns are those who hear, but as they go on their way, they are choked by the worries, riches, and pleasures of this life, and their fruit does not mature.
aov_text: En wat in die dorings geval het — dit is die wat gehoor het, en hulle gaan weg en word verstik deur die sorge en rykdom en genietinge van die lewe en dra geen ryp vrug nie.

kjv_text: But that on the good ground are they, which in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, keep it, and bring forth fruit with patience.
bsb_text: But the seeds on good soil are those with a noble and good heart, who hear the word, cling to it, and by persevering produce a crop.
aov_text: En wat in die goeie grond val — dit is die wat, nadat hulle gehoor het, die woord in ’n edele en goeie hart hou en met volharding vrug dra.

kjv_text: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, covereth it with a vessel, or putteth it under a bed; but setteth it on a candlestick, that they which enter in may see the light.
bsb_text: No one lights a lamp and covers it with a jar or puts it under a bed. Instead, he sets it on a stand, so those who enter can see the light.
aov_text: EN niemand steek ’n lamp op en maak dit met iets toe of sit dit onder ’n bed nie; maar hy sit dit op ’n staander, sodat die wat inkom, die lig kan sien.

kjv_text: For nothing is secret, that shall not be made manifest; neither any thing hid, that shall not be known and come abroad.
bsb_text: For there is nothing hidden that will not be disclosed, and nothing concealed that will not be made known and brought to light.
aov_text: Want daar is niks verborge wat nie openbaar sal word nie, of weggesteek wat nie bekend sal word en in die lig sal kom nie.

kjv_text: Take heed therefore how ye hear: for whosoever hath, to him shall be given; and whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he seemeth to have.
bsb_text: Pay attention, therefore, to how you listen. Whoever has will be given more, but whoever does not have, even what he thinks he has will be taken away from him.”
aov_text: Pas dan op hoe julle hoor; want elkeen wat het, aan hom sal gegee word; en elkeen wat nie het nie, van hom sal weggeneem word ook wat hy dink dat hy het.

kjv_text: Then came to him his mother and his brethren, and could not come at him for the press.
bsb_text: Then Jesus’ mother and brothers came to see Him, but they were unable to reach Him because of the crowd.
aov_text: EN sy moeder en broers het na Hom gekom, en weens die skare kon hulle Hom nie bereik nie.

kjv_text: And it was told him by certain which said, Thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to see thee.
bsb_text: He was told, “Your mother and brothers are standing outside, wanting to see You.”
aov_text: Toe bring hulle Hom die boodskap en sê: U moeder en u broers staan buite en wil U sien.

kjv_text: And he answered and said unto them, My mother and my brethren are these which hear the word of God, and do it.
bsb_text: But He replied, “My mother and brothers are those who hear the word of God and carry it out.”
aov_text: Maar Hy antwoord en sê vir hulle: My moeder en my broers is die wat die woord van God hoor en dit doen.

kjv_text: Now it came to pass on a certain day, that he went into a ship with his disciples: and he said unto them, Let us go over unto the other side of the lake. And they launched forth.
bsb_text: One day Jesus said to His disciples, “Let us cross to the other side of the lake.” So He got into a boat with them and set out.
aov_text: EN op een van daardie dae het Hy en sy dissipels in ’n skuit gegaan; en Hy het vir hulle gesê: Laat ons oorvaar na die oorkant van die see. En hulle het weggevaar.

kjv_text: But as they sailed he fell asleep: and there came down a storm of wind on the lake; and they were filled with water, and were in jeopardy.
bsb_text: As they sailed, He fell asleep, and a windstorm came down on the lake, so that the boat was being swamped, and they were in great danger.
aov_text: En terwyl hulle seil, raak Hy aan die slaap. Toe kom daar ’n stormwind op die see af en die skuit het begin vol word, en hulle was in gevaar.

kjv_text: And they came to him, and awoke him, saying, Master, master, we perish. Then he arose, and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water: and they ceased, and there was a calm.
bsb_text: The disciples went and woke Him, saying, “Master, Master, we are perishing!” Then Jesus got up and rebuked the wind and the raging waters, and they subsided, and all was calm.
aov_text: En hulle het na Hom gegaan en Hom wakker gemaak en gesê: Meester, Meester, ons vergaan! Hy staan toe op en bestraf die wind en die watergolwe, en hulle het bedaar en daar het ’n stilte gekom.

kjv_text: And he said unto them, Where is your faith? And they being afraid wondered, saying one to another, What manner of man is this! for he commandeth even the winds and water, and they obey him.
bsb_text: “Where is your faith?” He asked. Frightened and amazed, they asked one another, “Who is this? He commands even the winds and the water, and they obey Him!”
aov_text: En Hy sê vir hulle: Waar is julle geloof? Maar hulle was bang en verwonderd en het vir mekaar gesê: Wie is Hy tog, dat Hy selfs die winde en die water gebied en hulle Hom gehoorsaam is!

kjv_text: And they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is over against Galilee.
bsb_text: Then they sailed to the region of the Gerasenes, across the lake from Galilee.
aov_text: EN hulle het geseil na die land van die Gadaréners, wat reg anderkant Galiléa is.

kjv_text: And when he went forth to land, there met him out of the city a certain man, which had devils long time, and ware no clothes, neither abode in any house, but in the tombs.
bsb_text: When Jesus stepped ashore, He was met by a demon-possessed man from the town. For a long time this man had not worn clothing or lived in a house, but he stayed in the tombs.
aov_text: En toe Hy aan wal uitklim, kom ’n sekere man uit die stad Hom tegemoet, wat vir ’n geruime tyd van duiwels besete was en geen klere gedra het nie; hy het ook nie in ’n huis gewoon nie, maar in die grafte.

kjv_text: When he saw Jesus, he cried out, and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God most high? I beseech thee, torment me not.
bsb_text: When the man saw Jesus, he cried out and fell down before Him, shouting in a loud voice, “What do You want with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I beg You not to torture me!”
aov_text: En toe hy Jesus sien, skreeu hy uit en val voor Hom neer en sê met ’n groot stem: Wat het ons met U te doen, Jesus, Seun van die allerhoogste God? Ek bid U, moet my nie pynig nie  —

kjv_text: (For he had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For oftentimes it had caught him: and he was kept bound with chains and in fetters; and he brake the bands, and was driven of the devil into the wilderness.)
bsb_text: For Jesus had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. Many times it had seized him, and though he was bound with chains and shackles, he had broken the chains and been driven by the demon into solitary places.
aov_text: want Hy het aan die onreine gees bevel gegee om uit die man uit te gaan. Want baiekeer het hy hom saamgesleep; en hulle het hom gebind met kettings en voetboeie om oor hom wag te hou; maar hy het die boeie uitmekaar geruk, en die duiwel het hom in die woestyne gedrywe.

kjv_text: And Jesus asked him, saying, What is thy name? And he said, Legion: because many devils were entered into him.
bsb_text: “What is your name?” Jesus asked. “Legion,” he replied, because many demons had gone into him.
aov_text: Daarop vra Jesus hom en sê: Wat is jou naam? En hy antwoord: Legio — want baie duiwels het in hom ingevaar.

kjv_text: And they besought him that he would not command them to go out into the deep.
bsb_text: And the demons kept begging Jesus not to order them to go into the Abyss.
aov_text: En hulle het Hom gesmeek dat Hy hulle nie sou beveel om in die onderwêreld af te vaar nie.

kjv_text: And there was there an herd of many swine feeding on the mountain: and they besought him that he would suffer them to enter into them. And he suffered them.
bsb_text: There on the hillside a large herd of pigs was feeding. So the demons begged Jesus to let them enter the pigs, and He gave them permission.
aov_text: En daar het ’n groot trop varke op die berg gewei. Toe smeek hulle Hom dat Hy hulle sou toelaat om in dié varke in te vaar. En Hy het hulle toegelaat.

kjv_text: Then went the devils out of the man, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the lake, and were choked.
bsb_text: Then the demons came out of the man and went into the pigs, and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and was drowned.
aov_text: Daarop gaan die duiwels uit die man uit en vaar in die varke in, en die trop het van die krans af in die see gestorm en verdrink.

kjv_text: When they that fed them saw what was done, they fled, and went and told it in the city and in the country.
bsb_text: When those tending the pigs saw what had happened, they ran off and reported this in the town and countryside.
aov_text: En toe die wagters sien wat gebeur het, het hulle gevlug en dit in die stad en in die buitewyke gaan vertel.

kjv_text: Then they went out to see what was done; and came to Jesus, and found the man, out of whom the devils were departed, sitting at the feet of Jesus, clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.
bsb_text: So the people went out to see what had happened. They came to Jesus and found the man whom the demons had left, sitting at Jesus’ feet, clothed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.
aov_text: Daarop het hulle uitgegaan om te sien wat gebeur het; en hulle het by Jesus gekom en die man gevind uit wie die duiwels uitgevaar het, terwyl hy aan die voete van Jesus sit, gekleed en by sy verstand. En hulle het gevrees.

kjv_text: They also which saw it told them by what means he that was possessed of the devils was healed.
bsb_text: Meanwhile, those who had seen it reported how the demon-possessed man had been healed.
aov_text: En die wat ooggetuies was, het ook aan hulle vertel hoe die besetene genees is.

kjv_text: Then the whole multitude of the country of the Gadarenes round about besought him to depart from them; for they were taken with great fear: and he went up into the ship, and returned back again.
bsb_text: Then all the people of the region of the Gerasenes asked Jesus to depart from them, because great fear had taken hold of them. So He got into the boat and started back.
aov_text: En die hele menigte van die omtrek van die Gadaréners het Hom gevra om van hulle weg te gaan, omdat hulle deur ’n groot vrees bevang was. Toe het Hy in die skuit geklim en teruggegaan.

kjv_text: Now the man out of whom the devils were departed besought him that he might be with him: but Jesus sent him away, saying,
bsb_text: The man whom the demons had left begged to go with Jesus. But He sent him away, saying,
aov_text: En die man uit wie die duiwels uitgevaar het, het Hom gebid om by Hom te kan bly. Maar Jesus het hom laat gaan en gesê:

kjv_text: Return to thine own house, and shew how great things God hath done unto thee. And he went his way, and published throughout the whole city how great things Jesus had done unto him.
bsb_text: “Return home and describe how much God has done for you.” So the man went away and proclaimed all over the town how much Jesus had done for him.
aov_text: Gaan terug na jou huis en vertel watter groot dinge God aan jou gedoen het. En hy het gegaan en deur die hele stad verkondig watter groot dinge Jesus aan hom gedoen het.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, that, when Jesus was returned, the people gladly received him: for they were all waiting for him.
bsb_text: When Jesus returned, the crowd welcomed Him, for they had all been waiting for Him.
aov_text: EN toe Jesus terugkom, het die skare Hom verwelkom; want almal was Hom te wagte.

kjv_text: And, behold, there came a man named Jairus, and he was a ruler of the synagogue: and he fell down at Jesus' feet, and besought him that he would come into his house:
bsb_text: Just then a synagogue leader named Jairus came and fell at Jesus’ feet. He begged Him to come to his house,
aov_text: En daar kom ’n man wie se naam Jaïrus was, en hy was ’n owerste van die sinagoge; en hy val voor die voete van Jesus neer en smeek Hom om na sy huis te kom;

kjv_text: For he had one only daughter, about twelve years of age, and she lay a dying. But as he went the people thronged him.
bsb_text: because his only daughter, who was about twelve, was dying. As Jesus went with him, the crowds pressed around Him,
aov_text: want sy enigste dogter van omtrent twaalf jaar het op sterwe gelê. En terwyl Hy gaan, het die skare Hom verdring.

kjv_text: And a woman having an issue of blood twelve years, which had spent all her living upon physicians, neither could be healed of any,
bsb_text: including a woman who had suffered from bleeding for twelve years. She had spent all her money on physicians, but no one was able to heal her.
aov_text: En ’n vrou wat twaalf jaar lank aan bloedvloeiing gely het, en wat haar hele vermoë aan geneeshere uitgegee het en deur niemand gesond gemaak kon word nie,

kjv_text: Came behind him, and touched the border of his garment: and immediately her issue of blood stanched.
bsb_text: She came up behind Jesus and touched the fringe of His cloak, and immediately her bleeding stopped.
aov_text: het van agter af gekom en die soom van sy kleed aangeraak, en haar bloedvloeiing het onmiddellik opgehou.

kjv_text: And Jesus said, Who touched me? When all denied, Peter and they that were with him said, Master, the multitude throng thee and press thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?
bsb_text: “Who touched Me?” Jesus asked. But they all denied it. “Master,” said Peter, “the people are crowding and pressing against You.”
aov_text: Daarop sê Jesus: Wie is dit wat My aangeraak het? En toe almal dit ontken, sê Petrus en die wat by hom was: Meester, die skare druk en verdring U, en U sê: Wie is dit wat My aangeraak het?

kjv_text: And Jesus said, Somebody hath touched me: for I perceive that virtue is gone out of me.
bsb_text: But Jesus declared, “Someone touched Me, for I know that power has gone out from Me.”
aov_text: Maar Jesus antwoord: Iemand het My aangeraak, want Ek het gemerk dat krag van My uitgegaan het.

kjv_text: And when the woman saw that she was not hid, she came trembling, and falling down before him, she declared unto him before all the people for what cause she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately.
bsb_text: Then the woman, seeing that she could not escape notice, came trembling and fell down before Him. In the presence of all the people, she explained why she had touched Him and how she had immediately been healed.
aov_text: En toe die vrou sien dat sy nie verborge gebly het nie, kom sy bewende en val voor Hom neer en vertel Hom voor die hele volk om watter rede sy Hom aangeraak het en hoe sy onmiddellik gesond geword het.

kjv_text: And he said unto her, Daughter, be of good comfort: thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace.
bsb_text: “Daughter,” said Jesus, “your faith has healed you. Go in peace.”
aov_text: En Hy sê vir haar: Hou goeie moed, dogter, jou geloof het jou gered. Gaan in vrede.

kjv_text: While he yet spake, there cometh one from the ruler of the synagogue's house, saying to him, Thy daughter is dead; trouble not the Master.
bsb_text: While He was still speaking, someone arrived from the house of the synagogue leader. “Your daughter is dead,” he told Jairus. “Do not bother the Teacher anymore.”
aov_text: Terwyl Hy nog spreek, kom daar iemand van die owerste van die sinagoge se huis en sê vir hom: U dogter is dood, moenie die Meester lastig val nie.

kjv_text: But when Jesus heard it, he answered him, saying, Fear not: believe only, and she shall be made whole.
bsb_text: But Jesus overheard them and said to Jairus, “Do not be afraid; just believe, and she will be healed.”
aov_text: Maar toe Jesus dit hoor, antwoord Hy hom en sê: Moenie vrees nie. Glo net, en sy sal gered word.

kjv_text: And when he came into the house, he suffered no man to go in, save Peter, and James, and John, and the father and the mother of the maiden.
bsb_text: When He entered the house, He did not allow anyone to go in with Him except Peter, John, James, and the child’s father and mother.
aov_text: En toe Hy in die huis kom, het Hy niemand toegelaat om in te gaan nie, behalwe Petrus en Jakobus en Johannes en die vader en die moeder van die meisie.

kjv_text: And all wept, and bewailed her: but he said, Weep not; she is not dead, but sleepeth.
bsb_text: Meanwhile, everyone was weeping and mourning for her. But Jesus said, “Stop weeping; she is not dead but asleep.”
aov_text: En almal het gehuil en oor haar rou bedryf. Maar Hy sê: Moenie huil nie; sy is nie dood nie, maar slaap.

kjv_text: And they laughed him to scorn, knowing that she was dead.
bsb_text: And they laughed at Him, knowing that she was dead.
aov_text: En hulle het Hom uitgelag, want hulle het geweet dat sy dood was.

kjv_text: And he put them all out, and took her by the hand, and called, saying, Maid, arise.
bsb_text: But Jesus took her by the hand and called out, “Child, get up!”
aov_text: En toe Hy almal na buite uitgejaag het, gryp Hy haar hand en roep uit en sê: Dogtertjie, staan op!

kjv_text: And her spirit came again, and she arose straightway: and he commanded to give her meat.
bsb_text: Her spirit returned, and at once she got up. And He directed that she be given something to eat.
aov_text: En haar gees het teruggekom, en sy het onmiddellik opgestaan; en Hy het beveel dat hulle haar iets te ete moes gee.

kjv_text: And her parents were astonished: but he charged them that they should tell no man what was done.
bsb_text: Her parents were astounded, but Jesus ordered them not to tell anyone what had happened.
aov_text: En haar ouers was verbaas, maar Hy het hulle bevel gegee om aan niemand te sê wat gebeur het nie.

kjv_text: Then he called his twelve disciples together, and gave them power and authority over all devils, and to cure diseases.
bsb_text: Then Jesus called the Twelve together and gave them power and authority over all demons, and power to cure diseases.
aov_text: EN Hy het sy twaalf dissipels saamgeroep en aan hulle mag en gesag gegee oor al die duiwels en om siektes te genees.

kjv_text: And he sent them to preach the kingdom of God, and to heal the sick.
bsb_text: And He sent them out to proclaim the kingdom of God and to heal the sick.
aov_text: En Hy het hulle uitgestuur om die koninkryk van God te verkondig en die siekes gesond te maak

kjv_text: And he said unto them, Take nothing for your journey, neither staves, nor scrip, neither bread, neither money; neither have two coats apiece.
bsb_text: “Take nothing for the journey,” He told them, “no staff, no bag, no bread, no money, no second tunic.
aov_text: en vir hulle gesê: Neem niks vir die pad nie, geen stokke of reissak of brood of geld nie, en geeneen van julle moet twee kledingstukke hê nie.

kjv_text: And whatsoever house ye enter into, there abide, and thence depart.
bsb_text: Whatever house you enter, stay there until you leave that area.
aov_text: En in watter huis julle ook mag ingaan, bly dáár en gaan dáárvandaan verder.

kjv_text: And whosoever will not receive you, when ye go out of that city, shake off the very dust from your feet for a testimony against them.
bsb_text: If anyone does not welcome you, shake the dust off your feet when you leave that town, as a testimony against them.”
aov_text: En almal wat julle nie ontvang nie — as julle van daardie stad weggaan, skud selfs die stof van julle voete af, tot ’n getuienis teen hulle.

kjv_text: And they departed, and went through the towns, preaching the gospel, and healing every where.
bsb_text: So they set out and went from village to village, preaching the gospel and healing people everywhere.
aov_text: En hulle het uitgegaan en dorp vir dorp deurgegaan en oral die evangelie verkondig en siekes gesond gemaak.

kjv_text: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him: and he was perplexed, because that it was said of some, that John was risen from the dead;
bsb_text: When Herod the tetrarch heard about all that was happening, he was perplexed. For some were saying that John had risen from the dead,
aov_text: HERODES, die viervors, hoor toe van al die dinge wat deur Hom gedoen is; en hy was met die saak verleë, omdat deur sommige gesê is: Johannes is uit die dode opgewek;

kjv_text: And of some, that Elias had appeared; and of others, that one of the old prophets was risen again.
bsb_text: others that Elijah had appeared, and still others that a prophet of old had arisen.
aov_text: en deur ander: Elía het verskyn; en deur ander: Een van die ou profete het opgestaan.

kjv_text: And Herod said, John have I beheaded: but who is this, of whom I hear such things? And he desired to see him.
bsb_text: “I beheaded John,” Herod said, “but who is this man I hear such things about?” And he kept trying to see Jesus.
aov_text: En Herodes het gesê: Johannes het ek onthoof; maar wie is hierdie man van wie ek sulke dinge hoor? En hy het probeer om Hom te sien.

kjv_text: And the apostles, when they were returned, told him all that they had done. And he took them, and went aside privately into a desert place belonging to the city called Bethsaida.
bsb_text: Then the apostles returned and reported to Jesus all that they had done. Taking them away privately, He withdrew to a town called Bethsaida.
aov_text: EN toe die apostels terugkom en Hom alles vertel wat hulle gedoen het, het Hy hulle saamgeneem en in die eensaamheid gegaan na ’n verlate plek van ’n stad met die naam van Betsáida.

kjv_text: And the people, when they knew it, followed him: and he received them, and spake unto them of the kingdom of God, and healed them that had need of healing.
bsb_text: But the crowds found out and followed Him. He welcomed them and spoke to them about the kingdom of God, and He healed those who needed healing.
aov_text: Maar die skare het dit te wete gekom en Hom gevolg; en Hy het hulle ontvang en met hulle gespreek oor die koninkryk van God, en die wat genesing nodig gehad het, gesond gemaak.

kjv_text: And when the day began to wear away, then came the twelve, and said unto him, Send the multitude away, that they may go into the towns and country round about, and lodge, and get victuals: for we are here in a desert place.
bsb_text: As the day neared its end, the Twelve came to Jesus and said, “Dismiss the crowd so they can go to the surrounding villages and countryside for lodging and provisions. For we are in a desolate place here.”
aov_text: Toe die dag begin daal, kom die twaalf na Hom en sê vir Hom: Stuur die skare weg, sodat hulle na die dorpe en buitewyke in die omtrek kan gaan en herberg en voedsel kry; want ons is hier in ’n verlate plek.

kjv_text: But he said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they said, We have no more but five loaves and two fishes; except we should go and buy meat for all this people.
bsb_text: But Jesus told them, “You give them something to eat.” “We have only five loaves of bread and two fish,” they answered, “unless we go and buy food for all these people.”
aov_text: Maar Hy sê vir hulle: Gee julle vir hulle iets om te eet. Maar hulle antwoord: Ons het nie meer as vyf brode en twee visse nie, tensy ons voedsel gaan koop vir al hierdie mense.

kjv_text: For they were about five thousand men. And he said to his disciples, Make them sit down by fifties in a company.
bsb_text: (There were about five thousand men.) He told His disciples, “Have them sit down in groups of about fifty each.”
aov_text: Want daar was omtrent vyfduisend manne. Maar Hy sê vir sy dissipels: Laat hulle in groepe van vyftig sit.

kjv_text: And they did so, and made them all sit down.
bsb_text: They did so, and everyone was seated.
aov_text: En hulle het dit gedoen en almal laat sit.

kjv_text: Then he took the five loaves and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed them, and brake, and gave to the disciples to set before the multitude.
bsb_text: Taking the five loaves and the two fish and looking up to heaven, Jesus spoke a blessing and broke them. Then He gave them to the disciples to set before the people.
aov_text: Toe neem Hy die vyf brode en die twee visse, en nadat Hy opgekyk het na die hemel, seën Hy dit en breek dit en gee dit aan die dissipels om dit aan die skare voor te sit.

kjv_text: And they did eat, and were all filled: and there was taken up of fragments that remained to them twelve baskets.
bsb_text: They all ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.
aov_text: En hulle het geëet en is almal versadig, en van wat vir hulle van die brokstukke oorgebly het, is daar twaalf mandjies vol opgetel.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, as he was alone praying, his disciples were with him: and he asked them, saying, Whom say the people that I am?
bsb_text: One day as Jesus was praying in private and the disciples were with Him, He questioned them: “Who do the crowds say I am?”
aov_text: EN toe Hy besig was om alleen te bid, was die dissipels by Hom, en Hy vra hulle en sê: Wie sê die skare is Ek?

kjv_text: They answering said, John the Baptist; but some say, Elias; and others say, that one of the old prophets is risen again.
bsb_text: They replied, “Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, that a prophet of old has arisen.”
aov_text: En hulle antwoord en sê: Johannes die Doper, en ander: Elía, en ander dat een van die ou profete opgestaan het.

kjv_text: He said unto them, But whom say ye that I am? Peter answering said, The Christ of God.
bsb_text: “But what about you?” Jesus asked. “Who do you say I am?” Peter answered, “The Christ of God.”
aov_text: En Hy sê vir hulle: Maar julle, wie sê julle is Ek? En Petrus antwoord en sê: Die Christus van God!

kjv_text: And he straitly charged them, and commanded them to tell no man that thing;
bsb_text: Jesus strictly warned them not to tell this to anyone.
aov_text: Toe gee Hy hulle ’n streng bevel en gebied hulle om dit aan niemand te vertel nie.

kjv_text: Saying, The Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be slain, and be raised the third day.
bsb_text: “The Son of Man must suffer many things,” He said. “He must be rejected by the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and He must be killed and on the third day be raised to life.”
aov_text: En Hy sê: Die Seun van die mens moet baie ly en verwerp word deur die ouderlinge en owerpriesters en skrifgeleerdes en gedood word en op die derde dag opstaan.

kjv_text: And he said to them all, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.
bsb_text: Then Jesus said to all of them, “If anyone wants to come after Me, he must deny himself and take up his cross daily and follow Me.
aov_text: EN Hy sê vir almal: As iemand agter My aan wil kom, moet hy homself verloën en sy kruis elke dag opneem en My volg.

kjv_text: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: but whosoever will lose his life for my sake, the same shall save it.
bsb_text: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for My sake will save it.
aov_text: Want elkeen wat sy lewe wil red, sal dit verloor; maar elkeen wat sy lewe om My ontwil verloor, hy sal dit red.

kjv_text: For what is a man advantaged, if he gain the whole world, and lose himself, or be cast away?
bsb_text: What does it profit a man to gain the whole world, yet lose or forfeit his very self?
aov_text: Wat baat dit ’n mens tog as hy die hele wêreld win, maar homself verloor of skade aandoen?

kjv_text: For whosoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words, of him shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he shall come in his own glory, and in his Father's, and of the holy angels.
bsb_text: If anyone is ashamed of Me and My words, the Son of Man will be ashamed of him when He comes in His glory and in the glory of the Father and of the holy angels.
aov_text: Want elkeen wat hom skaam vir My en my woorde, vir hom sal die Seun van die mens Hom skaam wanneer Hy kom in sy heerlikheid en dié van die Vader en van die heilige engele.

kjv_text: But I tell you of a truth, there be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the kingdom of God.
bsb_text: But I tell you truthfully, some who are standing here will not taste death before they see the kingdom of God.”
aov_text: Ek sê vir julle met waarheid: Daar is sommige van die wat hier staan, wat die dood sekerlik nie sal smaak voordat hulle die koninkryk van God gesien het nie.

kjv_text: And it came to pass about an eight days after these sayings, he took Peter and John and James, and went up into a mountain to pray.
bsb_text: About eight days after Jesus had said these things, He took with Him Peter, John, and James, and went up on a mountain to pray.
aov_text: EN omtrent agt dae ná hierdie woorde het Hy Petrus en Johannes en Jakobus saamgeneem en op die berg geklim om te bid.

kjv_text: And as he prayed, the fashion of his countenance was altered, and his raiment was white and glistering.
bsb_text: And as He was praying, the appearance of His face changed, and His clothes became radiantly white.
aov_text: En terwyl Hy bid, het die voorkoms van sy aangesig anders geword en sy klere skitterend wit.

kjv_text: And, behold, there talked with him two men, which were Moses and Elias:
bsb_text: Suddenly two men, Moses and Elijah, began talking with Jesus.
aov_text: En daar was twee manne in gesprek met Hom; dit was Moses en Elía.

kjv_text: Who appeared in glory, and spake of his decease which he should accomplish at Jerusalem.
bsb_text: They appeared in glory and spoke about His departure, which He was about to accomplish at Jerusalem.
aov_text: Hulle het in heerlikheid verskyn en van sy uitgang gespreek wat Hy in Jerusalem sou volbring.

kjv_text: But Peter and they that were with him were heavy with sleep: and when they were awake, they saw his glory, and the two men that stood with him.
bsb_text: Meanwhile Peter and his companions were overcome by sleep, but when they awoke, they saw Jesus’ glory and the two men standing with Him.
aov_text: En Petrus en die wat saam met hom was, was deur die slaap oorweldig. Maar toe hulle wakker word, sien hulle sy heerlikheid en die twee manne wat by Hom staan.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, as they departed from him, Peter said unto Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias: not knowing what he said.
bsb_text: As Moses and Elijah were leaving, Peter said to Jesus, “Master, it is good for us to be here. Let us put up three shelters—one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.” (He did not know what he was saying.)
aov_text: En toe hulle van Hom weggaan, sê Petrus vir Jesus: Meester, dit is goed dat ons hier is; laat ons dan drie hutte maak, een vir U en vir Moses een en een vir Elía — hy het nie geweet wat hy sê nie.

kjv_text: While he thus spake, there came a cloud, and overshadowed them: and they feared as they entered into the cloud.
bsb_text: While Peter was speaking, a cloud appeared and enveloped them, and they were afraid as they entered the cloud.
aov_text: Maar toe hy dit sê, kom daar ’n wolk en oordek hulle, en hulle het bang geword toe daardie manne in die wolk ingaan.

kjv_text: And there came a voice out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.
bsb_text: And a voice came from the cloud, saying, “This is My Son, whom I have chosen. Listen to Him!”
aov_text: En daar kom ’n stem uit die wolk wat sê: Dit is my geliefde Seun; luister na Hom!

kjv_text: And when the voice was past, Jesus was found alone. And they kept it close, and told no man in those days any of those things which they had seen.
bsb_text: After the voice had spoken, only Jesus was present with them. The disciples kept this to themselves, and in those days they did not tell anyone what they had seen.
aov_text: En nadat die stem gekom het, was Jesus daar alleen. En hulle het geswyg en aan niemand in daardie dae iets vertel van wat hulle gesien het nie.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, that on the next day, when they were come down from the hill, much people met him.
bsb_text: The next day, when they came down from the mountain, Jesus was met by a large crowd.
aov_text: EN op die volgende dag toe hulle van die berg afklim, kom ’n groot skare Hom tegemoet.

kjv_text: And, behold, a man of the company cried out, saying, Master, I beseech thee, look upon my son: for he is mine only child.
bsb_text: Suddenly a man in the crowd cried out, “Teacher, I beg You to look at my son, for he is my only child.
aov_text: En daar roep ’n man uit die skare en sê: Meester, ek bid U, kyk tog na my seun, want hy is my enigste.

kjv_text: And, lo, a spirit taketh him, and he suddenly crieth out; and it teareth him that he foameth again, and bruising him hardly departeth from him.
bsb_text: A spirit keeps seizing him, and he screams abruptly. It throws him into convulsions so that he foams at the mouth. It keeps mauling him and rarely departs from him.
aov_text: En kyk, ’n gees gryp hom, en meteens skreeu hy, en hy laat hom stuiptrekkings kry met skuim in die mond en gaan amper nie van hom weg nie en verniel hom.

kjv_text: And I besought thy disciples to cast him out; and they could not.
bsb_text: I begged Your disciples to drive it out, but they were unable.”
aov_text: En ek het u dissipels gebid om hom uit te drywe, en hulle kon nie.

kjv_text: And Jesus answering said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you, and suffer you? Bring thy son hither.
bsb_text: “O unbelieving and perverse generation!” Jesus replied. “How long must I remain with you and put up with you? Bring your son here.”
aov_text: Toe antwoord Jesus en sê: o Ongelowige en verdraaide geslag, hoe lank sal Ek by julle wees en julle verdra? Bring jou seun hier.

kjv_text: And as he was yet a coming, the devil threw him down, and tare him. And Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, and healed the child, and delivered him again to his father.
bsb_text: Even while the boy was approaching, the demon slammed him to the ground in a convulsion. But Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, healed the boy, and gave him back to his father.
aov_text: En toe hy nog aankom, skeur die duiwel hom en laat hom stuiptrekkings kry. Maar Jesus het die onreine gees bestraf en die seun genees en hom aan sy vader teruggegee.

kjv_text: And they were all amazed at the mighty power of God. But while they wondered every one at all things which Jesus did, he said unto his disciples,
bsb_text: And they were all astonished at the greatness of God. While everyone was marveling at all that Jesus was doing, He said to His disciples,
aov_text: En almal was verslae oor die majesteit van God. En toe almal verwonderd was oor alles wat Jesus gedoen het, sê Hy vir sy dissipels:

kjv_text: Let these sayings sink down into your ears: for the Son of man shall be delivered into the hands of men.
bsb_text: “Let these words sink into your ears: The Son of Man is about to be delivered into the hands of men.”
aov_text: Bewaar hierdie woorde in julle ore; want die Seun van die mens sal oorgelewer word in die hande van die mense.

kjv_text: But they understood not this saying, and it was hid from them, that they perceived it not: and they feared to ask him of that saying.
bsb_text: But they did not understand this statement. It was veiled from them so that they could not comprehend it, and they were afraid to ask Him about it.
aov_text: Maar hulle het hierdie woord nie verstaan nie, en dit was vir hulle bedek, sodat hulle dit nie sou begryp nie; en hulle was bang om Hom iets te vra oor hierdie woord.

kjv_text: Then there arose a reasoning among them, which of them should be greatest.
bsb_text: Then an argument started among the disciples as to which of them would be the greatest.
aov_text: EN daar het ’n redenering onder hulle ontstaan oor wie van hulle dan tog die grootste was.

kjv_text: And Jesus, perceiving the thought of their heart, took a child, and set him by him,
bsb_text: But Jesus, knowing the thoughts of their hearts, had a little child stand beside Him.
aov_text: En toe Jesus die redenering van hulle hart opmerk, neem Hy ’n kindjie en laat dié by Hom staan

kjv_text: And said unto them, Whosoever shall receive this child in my name receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me receiveth him that sent me: for he that is least among you all, the same shall be great.
bsb_text: And He said to them, “Whoever welcomes this little child in My name welcomes Me, and whoever welcomes Me welcomes the One who sent Me. For whoever is the least among all of you, he is the greatest.”
aov_text: en sê vir hulle: Elkeen wat hierdie kindjie ontvang in my Naam, ontvang My; en elkeen wat My ontvang, ontvang Hom wat My gestuur het; want wie die kleinste onder julle almal is, hy sal groot wees.

kjv_text: And John answered and said, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name; and we forbad him, because he followeth not with us.
bsb_text: “Master,” said John, “we saw someone driving out demons in Your name, and we tried to stop him, because he does not accompany us.”
aov_text: EN Johannes het geantwoord en gesê: Meester, ons het iemand gesien wat in u Naam die duiwels uitdryf; en ons het hom belet, omdat hy U nie saam met ons volg nie.

kjv_text: And Jesus said unto him, Forbid him not: for he that is not against us is for us.
bsb_text: “Do not stop him,” Jesus replied, “for whoever is not against you is for you.”
aov_text: Maar Jesus sê vir hom: Moet hom nie belet nie, want wie nie teen ons is nie, is vír ons.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when the time was come that he should be received up, he stedfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem,
bsb_text: As the day of His ascension approached, Jesus resolutely set out for Jerusalem.
aov_text: EN toe die dae van sy opneming nader kom, het Hy sy aangesig gerig om na Jerusalem te reis,

kjv_text: And sent messengers before his face: and they went, and entered into a village of the Samaritans, to make ready for him.
bsb_text: He sent messengers on ahead, who went into a village of the Samaritans to make arrangements for Him.
aov_text: en boodskappers voor Hom uit gestuur; en hulle het vertrek en in ’n dorp van die Samaritane gekom om vir Hom klarigheid te maak.

kjv_text: And they did not receive him, because his face was as though he would go to Jerusalem.
bsb_text: But the people there refused to welcome Him, because He was heading for Jerusalem.
aov_text: En hulle het Hom nie ontvang nie, omdat Hy na Jerusalem op reis was.

kjv_text: And when his disciples James and John saw this, they said, Lord, wilt thou that we command fire to come down from heaven, and consume them, even as Elias did?
bsb_text: When the disciples James and John saw this, they asked, “Lord, do You want us to call down fire from heaven to consume them?”
aov_text: En toe sy dissipels, Jakobus en Johannes, dit sien, sê hulle: Here, wil U hê ons moet sê dat vuur van die hemel afdaal en hulle verteer, soos Elía ook gedoen het?

kjv_text: But he turned, and rebuked them, and said, Ye know not what manner of spirit ye are of.
bsb_text: But Jesus turned and rebuked them.
aov_text: Maar Hy draai Hom om en bestraf hulle en sê: Julle weet nie van hoedanige gees julle is nie;

kjv_text: For the Son of man is not come to destroy men's lives, but to save them. And they went to another village.
bsb_text: And He and His disciples went on to another village.
