aov_text: want die Seun van die mens het nie gekom om die mense se lewe te verderf nie, maar te red. En hulle het na ’n ander dorp vertrek.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, that, as they went in the way, a certain man said unto him, Lord, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.
bsb_text: As they were walking along the road, someone said to Jesus, “I will follow You wherever You go.”
aov_text: EN terwyl hulle op reis was, sê iemand op die pad vir Hom: Here, ek sal U volg, waar U ook mag gaan!

kjv_text: And Jesus said unto him, Foxes have holes, and birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.
bsb_text: Jesus replied, “Foxes have dens and birds of the air have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay His head.”
aov_text: Toe sê Jesus vir hom: Die jakkalse het gate en die voëls van die hemel neste, maar die Seun van die mens het geen plek waar Hy sy hoof kan neerlê nie.

kjv_text: And he said unto another, Follow me. But he said, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.
bsb_text: Then He said to another man, “Follow Me.” The man replied, “Lord, first let me go and bury my father.”
aov_text: En Hy sê aan ’n ander een: Volg My. Maar hy antwoord: Here, laat my toe om eers my vader te gaan begrawe.

kjv_text: Jesus said unto him, Let the dead bury their dead: but go thou and preach the kingdom of God.
bsb_text: But Jesus told him, “Let the dead bury their own dead. You, however, go and proclaim the kingdom of God.”
aov_text: En Jesus sê vir hom: Laat die dooies hul eie dooies begrawe; maar gaan jy en verkondig die koninkryk van God.

kjv_text: And another also said, Lord, I will follow thee; but let me first go bid them farewell, which are at home at my house.
bsb_text: Still another said, “I will follow You, Lord; but first let me bid farewell to my family.”
aov_text: En ’n ander een het ook gesê: Here, ek sal U volg, maar laat my eers toe om afskeid te neem van die wat in my huis is.

kjv_text: And Jesus said unto him, No man, having put his hand to the plough, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God.
bsb_text: Then Jesus declared, “No one who puts his hand to the plow and then looks back is fit for the kingdom of God.”
aov_text: En Jesus antwoord hom: Niemand wat sy hand aan die ploeg slaan en agtertoe kyk, is geskik vir die koninkryk van God nie.

kjv_text: After these things the LORD appointed other seventy also, and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place, whither he himself would come.
bsb_text: After this, the Lord appointed seventy-two others and sent them two by two ahead of Him to every town and place He was about to visit.
aov_text: EN ná hierdie dinge het die Here weer sewentig ander aangestel, en hulle twee-twee voor Hom uit gestuur na elke stad en plek waar Hy sou kom.

kjv_text: Therefore said he unto them, The harvest truly is great, but the labourers are few: pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he would send forth labourers into his harvest.
bsb_text: And He told them, “The harvest is plentiful, but the workers are few. Ask the Lord of the harvest, therefore, to send out workers into His harvest.
aov_text: Hy sê toe vir hulle: Die oes is wel groot, maar die arbeiders min. Bid dan die Here van die oes dat Hy arbeiders in sy oes uitstuur.

kjv_text: Go your ways: behold, I send you forth as lambs among wolves.
bsb_text: Go! I am sending you out like lambs among wolves.
aov_text: Gaan dan; kyk, Ek stuur julle soos lammers onder wolwe.

kjv_text: Carry neither purse, nor scrip, nor shoes: and salute no man by the way.
bsb_text: Carry no purse or bag or sandals. Do not greet anyone along the road.
aov_text: Moenie ’n beurs of ’n reissak of skoene dra nie, en groet niemand op die pad nie.

kjv_text: And into whatsoever house ye enter, first say, Peace be to this house.
bsb_text: Whatever house you enter, begin by saying, ‘Peace to this house.’
aov_text: En in watter huis julle ook al mag ingaan, sê eers: Vrede vir hierdie huis!

kjv_text: And if the son of peace be there, your peace shall rest upon it: if not, it shall turn to you again.
bsb_text: If a man of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; if not, it will return to you.
aov_text: En as dáár ’n man van vrede is, sal julle vrede op hom rus; anders sal dit tot julle terugkeer.

kjv_text: And in the same house remain, eating and drinking such things as they give: for the labourer is worthy of his hire. Go not from house to house.
bsb_text: Stay at the same house, eating and drinking whatever you are offered. For the worker is worthy of his wages. Do not move around from house to house.
aov_text: Bly dan in daardie selfde huis en eet en drink wat hulle het, want die arbeider is sy loon werd. Moenie van huis tot huis gaan nie.

kjv_text: And into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you, eat such things as are set before you:
bsb_text: If you enter a town and they welcome you, eat whatever is set before you.
aov_text: En in watter stad julle ook al mag ingaan en hulle jul ontvang, eet wat aan julle voorgesit word.

kjv_text: And heal the sick that are therein, and say unto them, The kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.
bsb_text: Heal the sick who are there and tell them, ‘The kingdom of God is near you.’
aov_text: En maak die siekes gesond wat daarin is, en sê vir hulle: Die koninkryk van God het naby julle gekom.

kjv_text: But into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you not, go your ways out into the streets of the same, and say,
bsb_text: But if you enter a town and they do not welcome you, go into the streets and declare,
aov_text: Maar in watter stad julle ook al mag ingaan en hulle jul nie ontvang nie, gaan uit op sy strate en sê:

kjv_text: Even the very dust of your city, which cleaveth on us, we do wipe off against you: notwithstanding be ye sure of this, that the kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.
bsb_text: ‘Even the dust of your town that clings to our feet, we wipe off as a testimony against you. Yet be sure of this: The kingdom of God is near.’
aov_text: Selfs die stof wat uit julle stad aan ons kleef, vee ons vir julle af; maar tog moet julle dit weet dat die koninkryk van God naby julle gekom het.

kjv_text: But I say unto you, that it shall be more tolerable in that day for Sodom, than for that city.
bsb_text: I tell you, it will be more bearable on that day for Sodom than for that town.
aov_text: En Ek sê vir julle: Vir Sodom sal dit verdraagliker wees in dié dag as vir daardie stad.

kjv_text: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon, which have been done in you, they had a great while ago repented, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
bsb_text: Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the miracles that were performed in you had been performed in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
aov_text: Wee jou, Górasin, wee jou, Betsáida! want as in Tirus en Sidon die kragtige dade plaasgevind het wat in julle plaasgevind het, sou hulle lankal in sak en as gesit en hulle bekeer het.

kjv_text: But it shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment, than for you.
bsb_text: But it will be more bearable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment than for you.
aov_text: Maar vir Tirus en Sidon sal dit in die oordeel verdraagliker wees as vir julle.

kjv_text: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted to heaven, shalt be thrust down to hell.
bsb_text: And you, Capernaum, will you be lifted up to heaven? No, you will be brought down to Hades!
aov_text: En jy, Kapérnaüm, wat tot die hemel toe verhoog is, jy sal tot die doderyk toe neergestoot word.

kjv_text: He that heareth you heareth me; and he that despiseth you despiseth me; and he that despiseth me despiseth him that sent me.
bsb_text: Whoever listens to you listens to Me; whoever rejects you rejects Me; and whoever rejects Me rejects the One who sent Me.”
aov_text: Wie na julle luister, luister na My; en wie julle verwerp, verwerp My; en wie My verwerp, verwerp Hom wat My gestuur het.

kjv_text: And the seventy returned again with joy, saying, Lord, even the devils are subject unto us through thy name.
bsb_text: The seventy-two returned with joy and said, “Lord, even the demons submit to us in Your name.”
aov_text: En die sewentig het met blydskap teruggekom en gesê: Here, ook die duiwels onderwerp hulle aan ons in u Naam.

kjv_text: And he said unto them, I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven.
bsb_text: So He told them, “I saw Satan fall like lightning from heaven.
aov_text: Toe sê Hy vir hulle: Ek het die Satan soos ’n bliksem uit die hemel sien val.

kjv_text: Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt you.
bsb_text: Behold, I have given you authority to tread on snakes and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy. Nothing will harm you.
aov_text: Kyk, Ek gee aan julle die mag om op slange en skerpioene te trap, en oor al die krag van die vyand; en niks sal julle ooit skade doen nie.

kjv_text: Notwithstanding in this rejoice not, that the spirits are subject unto you; but rather rejoice, because your names are written in heaven.
bsb_text: Nevertheless, do not rejoice that the spirits submit to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven.”
aov_text: Maar julle moenie daaroor bly wees dat die geeste aan julle onderworpe is nie, maar wees liewer bly dat julle name in die hemele opgeskryf is.

kjv_text: In that hour Jesus rejoiced in spirit, and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes: even so, Father; for so it seemed good in thy sight.
bsb_text: At that time Jesus rejoiced in the Holy Spirit and declared, “I praise You, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because You have hidden these things from the wise and learned, and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for this was well-pleasing in Your sight.
aov_text: In dieselfde uur het Jesus Hom in die gees verheug en gesê: Ek loof U, Vader, Here van die hemel en die aarde, dat U hierdie dinge verberg het vir wyse en verstandige mense en dit aan kindertjies geopenbaar het. Ja, Vader, want so was dit u welbehae.

kjv_text: All things are delivered to me of my Father: and no man knoweth who the Son is, but the Father; and who the Father is, but the Son, and he to whom the Son will reveal him.
bsb_text: All things have been entrusted to Me by My Father. No one knows who the Son is except the Father, and no one knows who the Father is except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal Him.”
aov_text: Alles is aan My oorgegee deur my Vader; en niemand weet wie die Seun is nie, behalwe die Vader, en wie die Vader is nie, behalwe die Seun en hy aan wie die Seun dit wil openbaar.

kjv_text: And he turned him unto his disciples, and said privately, Blessed are the eyes which see the things that ye see:
bsb_text: Then Jesus turned to the disciples and said privately, “Blessed are the eyes that see what you see.
aov_text: En Hy het Hom omgedraai na sy dissipels en afsonderlik aan hulle gesê: Salig is die oë wat sien wat julle sien;

kjv_text: For I tell you, that many prophets and kings have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.
bsb_text: For I tell you that many prophets and kings desired to see what you see but did not see it, and to hear what you hear but did not hear it.”
aov_text: want Ek sê vir julle, baie profete en konings het gewens om te sien wat julle sien, en het dit nie gesien nie, en om te hoor wat julle hoor, en het dit nie gehoor nie.

kjv_text: And, behold, a certain lawyer stood up, and tempted him, saying, Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?
bsb_text: One day an expert in the law stood up to test Him. “Teacher,” he asked, “what must I do to inherit eternal life?”
aov_text: EN daar het ’n sekere wetgeleerde opgestaan wat Hom versoek het deur te sê: Meester, wat moet ek doen om die ewige lewe te beërwe?

kjv_text: He said unto him, What is written in the law? how readest thou?
bsb_text: “What is written in the Law?” Jesus replied. “How do you read it?”
aov_text: En Hy antwoord hom: Wat is in die wet geskrywe? Hoe lees jy?

kjv_text: And he answering said, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy strength, and with all thy mind; and thy neighbour as thyself.
bsb_text: He answered, “‘Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength and with all your mind’ and ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’”
aov_text: En hy antwoord en sê: Jy moet die Here jou God liefhê uit jou hele hart en uit jou hele siel en uit jou hele krag en uit jou hele verstand; en jou naaste soos jouself.

kjv_text: And he said unto him, Thou hast answered right: this do, and thou shalt live.
bsb_text: “You have answered correctly,” Jesus said. “Do this and you will live.”
aov_text: Toe sê Hy vir hom: Jy het reg geantwoord; doen dit, en jy sal lewe.

kjv_text: But he, willing to justify himself, said unto Jesus, And who is my neighbour?
bsb_text: But wanting to justify himself, he asked Jesus, “And who is my neighbor?”
aov_text: Maar hy wou homself regverdig, en sê vir Jesus: En wie is my naaste?

kjv_text: And Jesus answering said, A certain man went down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and fell among thieves, which stripped him of his raiment, and wounded him, and departed, leaving him half dead.
bsb_text: Jesus took up this question and said, “A man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho when he fell into the hands of robbers. They stripped him, beat him, and went away, leaving him half dead.
aov_text: En Jesus antwoord en sê: ’n Sekere man het afgegaan van Jerusalem na Jérigo en onder rowers verval, en nadat hulle hom uitgetrek en geslaan het, gaan hulle weg en laat hom half dood lê.

kjv_text: And by chance there came down a certain priest that way: and when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.
bsb_text: Now by chance a priest was going down the same road, but when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.
aov_text: En bygeval het ’n priester met daardie pad afgekom, en toe hy hom sien, gaan hy anderkant verby.

kjv_text: And likewise a Levite, when he was at the place, came and looked on him, and passed by on the other side.
bsb_text: So too, when a Levite came to that spot and saw him, he passed by on the other side.
aov_text: En net so het ook ’n Leviet by dié plek gekom en hom gesien en anderkant verbygegaan.

kjv_text: But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was: and when he saw him, he had compassion on him,
bsb_text: But when a Samaritan on a journey came upon him, he looked at him and had compassion.
aov_text: Maar ’n sekere Samaritaan wat op reis was, het op hom afgekom; en toe hy hom sien, het hy innig jammer gevoel,

kjv_text: And went to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring in oil and wine, and set him on his own beast, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.
bsb_text: He went to him and bandaged his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. Then he put him on his own animal, brought him to an inn, and took care of him.
aov_text: en na hom gegaan, sy wonde verbind en olie en wyn daarop gegooi. Hy het hom toe op sy eie pakdier gehelp en hom na ’n herberg geneem en vir hom gesorg.

kjv_text: And on the morrow when he departed, he took out two pence, and gave them to the host, and said unto him, Take care of him; and whatsoever thou spendest more, when I come again, I will repay thee.
bsb_text: The next day he took out two denarii and gave them to the innkeeper. ‘Take care of him,’ he said, ‘and on my return I will repay you for any additional expense.’
aov_text: En toe hy die volgende môre weggaan, haal hy twee pennings uit en gee dit aan die eienaar van die herberg en sê vir hom: Sorg vir hom, en enige onkoste wat jy nog meer mag hê, sal ek jou betaal as ek terugkom.

kjv_text: Which now of these three, thinkest thou, was neighbour unto him that fell among the thieves?
bsb_text: Which of these three do you think was a neighbor to the man who fell into the hands of robbers?”
aov_text: Wie dan van hierdie drie, dink jy, was die naaste van hom wat onder die rowers verval het?

kjv_text: And he said, He that shewed mercy on him. Then said Jesus unto him, Go, and do thou likewise.
bsb_text: “The one who showed him mercy,” replied the expert in the law. Then Jesus told him, “Go and do likewise.”
aov_text: En hy antwoord: Hy wat barmhartigheid aan hom bewys het. Toe sê Jesus vir hom: Gaan en doen jy net so.

kjv_text: Now it came to pass, as they went, that he entered into a certain village: and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.
bsb_text: As they traveled along, Jesus entered a village where a woman named Martha welcomed Him into her home.
aov_text: EN op hulle reis het Hy in ’n sekere dorp gekom, en ’n vrou met die naam van Martha het Hom in haar huis ontvang.

kjv_text: And she had a sister called Mary, which also sat at Jesus' feet, and heard his word.
bsb_text: She had a sister named Mary, who sat at the Lord’s feet listening to His message.
aov_text: En sy het ’n suster gehad met die naam van Maria; dié het aan die voete van Jesus gesit en na sy woord geluister.

kjv_text: But Martha was cumbered about much serving, and came to him, and said, Lord, dost thou not care that my sister hath left me to serve alone? bid her therefore that she help me.
bsb_text: But Martha was distracted by all the preparations to be made. She came to Jesus and said, “Lord, do You not care that my sister has left me to serve alone? Tell her to help me!”
aov_text: Maar Martha was baie besig om alles klaar te maak. Sy kom toe daar staan en sê: Here, gee U nie om dat my suster my alleen laat bedien nie? Sê dan vir haar dat sy my moet help.

kjv_text: And Jesus answered and said unto her, Martha, Martha, thou art careful and troubled about many things:
bsb_text: “Martha, Martha,” the Lord replied, “you are worried and upset about many things.
aov_text: Maar Jesus antwoord en sê vir haar: Martha, Martha, jy is besorg en verontrus oor baie dinge;

kjv_text: But one thing is needful: and Mary hath chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her.
bsb_text: But only one thing is necessary. Mary has chosen the good portion, and it will not be taken away from her.”
aov_text: maar een ding is nodig; en Maria het die goeie deel uitgekies wat van haar nie weggeneem sal word nie.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, that, as he was praying in a certain place, when he ceased, one of his disciples said unto him, Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples.
bsb_text: One day in a place where Jesus had just finished praying, one of His disciples requested, “Lord, teach us to pray, just as John taught his disciples.”
aov_text: EN toe Hy op ’n sekere plek besig was om te bid, sê een van sy dissipels vir Hom nadat Hy opgehou het: Here, leer ons bid, soos Johannes ook sy dissipels geleer het.

kjv_text: And he said unto them, When ye pray, say, Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done, as in heaven, so in earth.
bsb_text: So Jesus told them, “When you pray, say: ‘Father, hallowed be Your name. Your kingdom come.
aov_text: En Hy sê vir hulle: Wanneer julle bid, sê: Onse Vader wat in die hemele is, laat u Naam geheilig word; laat u koninkryk kom; laat u wil geskied, soos in die hemel net so ook op die aarde;

kjv_text: Give us day by day our daily bread.
bsb_text: Give us each day our daily bread.
aov_text: gee ons elke dag ons daaglikse brood;

kjv_text: And forgive us our sins; for we also forgive every one that is indebted to us. And lead us not into temptation; but deliver us from evil.
bsb_text: And forgive us our sins, for we also forgive everyone who sins against us. And lead us not into temptation.’”
aov_text: en vergeef ons ons sondes, want ons vergewe ook elkeen wat aan ons skuldig is; en lei ons nie in versoeking nie, maar verlos ons van die Bose.

kjv_text: And he said unto them, Which of you shall have a friend, and shall go unto him at midnight, and say unto him, Friend, lend me three loaves;
bsb_text: Then Jesus said to them, “Suppose one of you goes to his friend at midnight and says, ‘Friend, lend me three loaves of bread,
aov_text: EN Hy het vir hulle gesê: Wie van julle sal ’n vriend hê en sal middernag na hom gaan en vir hom sê: Vriend, leen my drie brode,

kjv_text: For a friend of mine in his journey is come to me, and I have nothing to set before him?
bsb_text: because a friend of mine has come to me on a journey, and I have nothing to set before him.’
aov_text: want ’n vriend van my het van ’n reis by my aangekom, en ek het niks om aan hom voor te sit nie  —

kjv_text: And he from within shall answer and say, Trouble me not: the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give thee.
bsb_text: And suppose the one inside answers, ‘Do not bother me. My door is already shut, and my children and I are in bed. I cannot get up to give you anything.’
aov_text: en dié van binnekant sal antwoord en sê: Moenie my lastig val nie; die deur is al gesluit, en my kinders is saam met my al in die bed; ek kan nie opstaan om vir jou te gee nie.

kjv_text: I say unto you, Though he will not rise and give him, because he is his friend, yet because of his importunity he will rise and give him as many as he needeth.
bsb_text: I tell you, even though he will not get up to provide for him because of his friendship, yet because of the man’s persistence, he will get up and give him as much as he needs.
aov_text: Ek sê vir julle, al sou hy ook nie opstaan en vir hom gee omdat hy sy vriend is nie, sal hy tog ter wille van sy onbeskaamdheid opstaan en hom gee soveel as hy nodig het.

kjv_text: And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.
bsb_text: So I tell you: Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and the door will be opened to you.
aov_text: En Ek sê vir julle: Bid, en vir julle sal gegee word; soek, en julle sal vind; klop, en vir julle sal oopgemaak word.

kjv_text: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.
bsb_text: For everyone who asks receives; he who seeks finds; and to him who knocks, the door will be opened.
aov_text: Want elkeen wat bid, ontvang; en hy wat soek, vind; en vir hom wat klop, sal oopgemaak word.

kjv_text: If a son shall ask bread of any of you that is a father, will he give him a stone? or if he ask a fish, will he for a fish give him a serpent?
bsb_text: What father among you, if his son asks for a fish, will give him a snake instead?
aov_text: En vir watter vader onder julle sal sy seun brood vra, en hy sal hom ’n klip gee; of ook ’n vis, en hy sal hom in plaas van ’n vis ’n slang gee;

kjv_text: Or if he shall ask an egg, will he offer him a scorpion?
bsb_text: Or if he asks for an egg, will give him a scorpion?
aov_text: of ook as hy ’n eier vra, hom ’n skerpioen gee?

kjv_text: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children: how much more shall your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to them that ask him?
bsb_text: So if you who are evil know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give the Holy Spirit to those who ask Him!”
aov_text: As julle dan wat sleg is, weet om goeie gawes aan julle kinders te gee, hoeveel te meer sal die hemelse Vader die Heilige Gees gee aan die wat Hom bid?

kjv_text: And he was casting out a devil, and it was dumb. And it came to pass, when the devil was gone out, the dumb spake; and the people wondered.
bsb_text: One day Jesus was driving out a demon that was mute. And when the demon was gone, the man who had been mute spoke. The crowds were amazed,
aov_text: EN Hy het ’n duiwel uitgedryf, en dié was stom. En toe die duiwel uitgaan, het die stom man gepraat; en die skare het hulle verwonder.

kjv_text: But some of them said, He casteth out devils through Beelzebub the chief of the devils.
bsb_text: but some of them said, “It is by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons, that He drives out demons.”
aov_text: Maar sommige van hulle sê: Deur Beëlsebul, die owerste van die duiwels, dryf Hy die duiwels uit.

kjv_text: And others, tempting him, sought of him a sign from heaven.
bsb_text: And others tested Him by demanding a sign from heaven.
aov_text: En ander het Hom versoek en van Hom ’n teken uit die hemel begeer.

kjv_text: But he, knowing their thoughts, said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and a house divided against a house falleth.
bsb_text: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself will be laid waste, and a house divided against a house will fall.
aov_text: Maar Hy het hulle gedagtes geken en vir hulle gesê: Elke koninkryk wat teen homself verdeeld is, word verwoes; en ’n huis wat teen homself is, val.

kjv_text: If Satan also be divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand? because ye say that I cast out devils through Beelzebub.
bsb_text: If Satan is divided against himself, how can his kingdom stand? After all, you say that I drive out demons by Beelzebul.
aov_text: En as die Satan ook teen homself verdeeld is, hoe sal sy koninkryk bly staan? Want julle sê dat Ek deur Beëlsebul die duiwels uitdryf.

kjv_text: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your sons cast them out? therefore shall they be your judges.
bsb_text: And if I drive out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your sons drive them out? So then, they will be your judges.
aov_text: En as Ek deur Beëlsebul die duiwels uitdryf, deur wie dryf julle seuns hulle uit? Daarom sal hulle jul regters wees.

kjv_text: But if I with the finger of God cast out devils, no doubt the kingdom of God is come upon you.
bsb_text: But if I drive out demons by the finger of God, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.
aov_text: Maar as Ek deur die vinger van God die duiwels uitdryf, dan het die koninkryk van God waarlik by julle gekom.

kjv_text: When a strong man armed keepeth his palace, his goods are in peace:
bsb_text: When a strong man, fully armed, guards his house, his possessions are secure.
aov_text: Wanneer ’n sterk man wat goed gewapend is, sy huis bewaak, is sy besittings in veiligheid.

kjv_text: But when a stronger than he shall come upon him, and overcome him, he taketh from him all his armour wherein he trusted, and divideth his spoils.
bsb_text: But when someone stronger attacks and overpowers him, he takes away the armor in which the man trusted, and then he divides up his plunder.
aov_text: Maar as een hom oorval wat sterker is as hy en hom oorwin, neem hy sy volle wapenrusting weg waar hy op vertrou het, en deel sy buit uit.

kjv_text: He that is not with me is against me: and he that gathereth not with me scattereth.
bsb_text: He who is not with Me is against Me, and he who does not gather with Me scatters.
aov_text: Hy wat nie met My is nie, is teen My; en hy wat nie saam met My versamel nie, verstrooi.

kjv_text: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he saith, I will return unto my house whence I came out.
bsb_text: When an unclean spirit comes out of a man, it passes through arid places seeking rest and does not find it. Then it says, ‘I will return to the house I left.’
aov_text: Wanneer die onreine gees uit die mens uitgegaan het, gaan hy deur waterlose plekke en soek rus; en as hy dit nie vind nie, sê hy: Ek sal teruggaan na my huis waar ek uitgegaan het.

kjv_text: And when he cometh, he findeth it swept and garnished.
bsb_text: On its return, it finds the house swept clean and put in order.
aov_text: En hy kom en vind dit uitgevee en versierd.

kjv_text: Then goeth he, and taketh to him seven other spirits more wicked than himself; and they enter in, and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first.
bsb_text: Then it goes and brings seven other spirits more wicked than itself, and they go in and dwell there. And the final plight of that man is worse than the first.”
aov_text: Dan gaan hy en neem sewe ander geeste, slegter as hy self, en hulle kom in en woon daar; en die laaste van daardie mens word erger as die eerste.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, as he spake these things, a certain woman of the company lifted up her voice, and said unto him, Blessed is the womb that bare thee, and the paps which thou hast sucked.
bsb_text: As Jesus was saying these things, a woman in the crowd raised her voice and said, “Blessed is the womb that bore You, and blessed are the breasts that nursed You!”
aov_text: En terwyl Hy dit spreek, het ’n vrou uit die skare haar stem verhef en vir Hom gesê: Salig is die skoot wat U gedra het, en die borste wat U gesoog het.

kjv_text: But he said, Yea rather, blessed are they that hear the word of God, and keep it.
bsb_text: But He replied, “Blessed rather are those who hear the word of God and obey it.”
aov_text: En Hy sê: Ja, maar salig is hulle wat die woord van God hoor en dit bewaar.

kjv_text: And when the people were gathered thick together, he began to say, This is an evil generation: they seek a sign; and there shall no sign be given it, but the sign of Jonas the prophet.
bsb_text: As the crowds were increasing, Jesus said, “This is a wicked generation. It demands a sign, but none will be given it except the sign of Jonah.
aov_text: EN toe die skare saamstroom, begin Hy te sê: Hierdie geslag is boos; dit soek na ’n teken, en geen teken sal aan hom gegee word nie, behalwe die teken van die profeet Jona.

kjv_text: For as Jonas was a sign unto the Ninevites, so shall also the Son of man be to this generation.
bsb_text: For as Jonah was a sign to the Ninevites, so the Son of Man will be a sign to this generation.
aov_text: Want soos Jona ’n teken was vir die Nineviete, so sal die Seun van die mens ook wees vir hierdie geslag.

kjv_text: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and condemn them: for she came from the utmost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.
bsb_text: The Queen of the South will rise at the judgment with the men of this generation and condemn them; for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon, and now One greater than Solomon is here.
aov_text: Die koningin van die Suide sal in die oordeel opstaan saam met die manne van hierdie geslag en hulle veroordeel; want sy het gekom van die eindes van die aarde af om die wysheid van Salomo te hoor, en — meer as Salomo is hier!

kjv_text: The men of Nineve shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.
bsb_text: The men of Nineveh will stand at the judgment with this generation and condemn it; for they repented at the preaching of Jonah, and now One greater than Jonah is here.
aov_text: Die manne van Ninevé sal in die oordeel opstaan saam met hierdie geslag en dit veroordeel; want hulle het hul op die prediking van Jona bekeer, en — meer as Jona is hier!

kjv_text: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, putteth it in a secret place, neither under a bushel, but on a candlestick, that they which come in may see the light.
bsb_text: No one lights a lamp and puts it in a cellar or under a basket. Instead, he sets it on a stand, so those who enter can see the light.
aov_text: EN niemand steek ’n lamp op en sit dit in ’n verborge plek of onder die maatemmer nie, maar op die staander, sodat die wat binnekom, die lig kan sien.

kjv_text: The light of the body is the eye: therefore when thine eye is single, thy whole body also is full of light; but when thine eye is evil, thy body also is full of darkness.
bsb_text: Your eye is the lamp of your body. When your eyes are good, your whole body also is full of light. But when they are bad, your body is full of darkness.
aov_text: Die lamp van die liggaam is die oog. As jou oog dan reg is, is jou hele liggaam ook verlig; maar as dit verkeerd is, is jou liggaam ook donker.

kjv_text: Take heed therefore that the light which is in thee be not darkness.
bsb_text: Be careful, then, that the light within you is not darkness.
aov_text: Pas dan op dat die lig in jou nie duisternis is nie.

kjv_text: If thy whole body therefore be full of light, having no part dark, the whole shall be full of light, as when the bright shining of a candle doth give thee light.
bsb_text: So if your whole body is full of light, with no part of it in darkness, you will be radiant, as though a lamp were shining on you.”
aov_text: As jou hele liggaam dan verlig is en nie enige deel het wat donker is nie, sal dit heeltemal verlig wees, net soos wanneer die lamp met sy skynsel jou verlig.

kjv_text: And as he spake, a certain Pharisee besought him to dine with him: and he went in, and sat down to meat.
bsb_text: As Jesus was speaking, a Pharisee invited Him to dine with him; so He went in and reclined at the table.
aov_text: EN onderwyl Hy besig was om te spreek, het ’n sekere Fariseër Hom uitgenooi om by hom te kom eet; en Hy het ingekom en aan tafel gegaan.

kjv_text: And when the Pharisee saw it, he marvelled that he had not first washed before dinner.
bsb_text: But the Pharisee was surprised to see that Jesus did not first wash before the meal.
aov_text: En toe die Fariseër dit sien, het hy hom verwonder dat Hy nie voor die maaltyd eers gewas het nie.

kjv_text: And the Lord said unto him, Now do ye Pharisees make clean the outside of the cup and the platter; but your inward part is full of ravening and wickedness.
bsb_text: “Now then,” said the Lord, “you Pharisees clean the outside of the cup and dish, but inside you are full of greed and wickedness.
aov_text: Maar die Here sê vir hom: Ja, julle Fariseërs, julle maak die buitekant van die beker en die bord skoon, maar van binne is julle vol roof en boosheid.

kjv_text: Ye fools, did not he that made that which is without make that which is within also?
bsb_text: You fools! Did not the One who made the outside make the inside as well?
aov_text: Onverstandiges, het Hy wat die buitekant gemaak het, nie die binnekant ook gemaak nie?

kjv_text: But rather give alms of such things as ye have; and, behold, all things are clean unto you.
bsb_text: But give as alms the things that are within you, and you will see that everything is clean for you.
aov_text: Maar gee wat daarin is, as aalmoes, en dan is alles vir julle rein.

kjv_text: But woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye tithe mint and rue and all manner of herbs, and pass over judgment and the love of God: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.
bsb_text: Woe to you Pharisees! You pay tithes of mint, rue, and every herb, but you disregard justice and the love of God. You should have practiced the latter without neglecting the former.
aov_text: Maar wee julle, Fariseërs, want julle gee tiendes van die kruisement en die wynruit en elke groentesoort, en julle verwaarloos die reg en die liefde tot God. Hierdie dinge behoort julle te doen sonder om die ander na te laat.

kjv_text: Woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye love the uppermost seats in the synagogues, and greetings in the markets.
bsb_text: Woe to you Pharisees! You love the chief seats in the synagogues and the greetings in the marketplaces.
aov_text: Wee julle, Fariseërs, want julle hou van die voorste banke in die sinagoges en die begroetinge op die markte.

kjv_text: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are as graves which appear not, and the men that walk over them are not aware of them.
bsb_text: Woe to you! For you are like unmarked graves, which men walk over without even noticing.”
aov_text: Wee julle, skrifgeleerdes en Fariseërs, geveinsdes, want julle is soos grafte wat onherkenbaar is, en die mense wat daaroor loop, weet dit nie.

kjv_text: Then answered one of the lawyers, and said unto him, Master, thus saying thou reproachest us also.
bsb_text: One of the experts in the law told Him, “Teacher, when You say these things, You insult us as well.”
aov_text: Toe antwoord een van die wetgeleerdes en sê vir Hom: Meester, as U só spreek, beledig U ons ook.

kjv_text: And he said, Woe unto you also, ye lawyers! for ye lade men with burdens grievous to be borne, and ye yourselves touch not the burdens with one of your fingers.
bsb_text: “Woe to you as well, experts in the law!” He replied. “You weigh men down with heavy burdens, but you yourselves will not lift a finger to lighten their load.
aov_text: En Hy sê: Wee julle ook, wetgeleerdes, want julle lê laste op die mense wat swaar is om te dra, en self roer julle die laste nie met een van julle vingers aan nie.

kjv_text: Woe unto you! for ye build the sepulchres of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.
bsb_text: Woe to you! You build tombs for the prophets, but it was your fathers who killed them.
aov_text: Wee julle, want julle bou die grafte van die profete, en julle vaders het hulle gedood.

kjv_text: Truly ye bear witness that ye allow the deeds of your fathers: for they indeed killed them, and ye build their sepulchres.
bsb_text: So you are witnesses consenting to the deeds of your fathers: They killed the prophets, and you build their tombs.
aov_text: Julle gee dus getuienis vir die werke van julle vaders en het saam welbehae daarin, want hulle het hul gedood en julle bou hul grafte.

kjv_text: Therefore also said the wisdom of God, I will send them prophets and apostles, and some of them they shall slay and persecute:
bsb_text: Because of this, the wisdom of God said, ‘I will send them prophets and apostles; some of them they will kill and others they will persecute.’
aov_text: Daarom het die wysheid van God ook gesê: Ek sal profete en apostels na hulle stuur, en van dié sal hulle doodmaak en vervolg,

kjv_text: That the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation;
bsb_text: As a result, this generation will be charged with the blood of all the prophets that has been shed since the foundation of the world,
aov_text: sodat van hierdie geslag afgeëis kan word die bloed van al die profete wat vergiet is van die grondlegging van die wêreld af,

kjv_text: From the blood of Abel unto the blood of Zacharias, which perished between the altar and the temple: verily I say unto you, It shall be required of this generation.
bsb_text: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zechariah, who was killed between the altar and the sanctuary. Yes, I tell you, all of it will be charged to this generation.
aov_text: van die bloed van Abel af tot op die bloed van Sagaría wat omgekom het tussen die reukaltaar en die huis van God. Ja, Ek sê vir julle, dit sal afgeëis word van hierdie geslag.

kjv_text: Woe unto you, lawyers! for ye have taken away the key of knowledge: ye entered not in yourselves, and them that were entering in ye hindered.
bsb_text: Woe to you experts in the law! For you have taken away the key to knowledge. You yourselves have not entered, and you have hindered those who were entering.”
aov_text: Wee julle, wetgeleerdes, want julle het die sleutel van die kennis weggeneem; self het julle nie ingegaan nie, en vir die wat wou ingaan, het julle verhinder.

kjv_text: And as he said these things unto them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to urge him vehemently, and to provoke him to speak of many things:
bsb_text: As Jesus went on from there, the scribes and Pharisees began to oppose Him bitterly and to ply Him with questions about many things,
aov_text: En toe Hy dit aan hulle sê, begin die skrifgeleerdes en die Fariseërs Hom skerp in die oog te hou en Hom uit te vra oor baie dinge,

kjv_text: Laying wait for him, and seeking to catch something out of his mouth, that they might accuse him.
bsb_text: waiting to catch Him in something He might say.
aov_text: om vir Hom ’n strik te stel en te probeer om iets uit sy mond op te vang, sodat hulle Hom kon beskuldig.

kjv_text: In the mean time, when there were gathered together an innumerable multitude of people, insomuch that they trode one upon another, he began to say unto his disciples first of all, Beware ye of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.
bsb_text: In the meantime, a crowd of many thousands had gathered, so that they were trampling one another. Jesus began to speak first to His disciples: “Beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.
aov_text: TOE duisende van die skare ondertussen saamkom, sodat hulle mekaar vertrap het, begin Hy aan sy dissipels te sê: Pas veral op vir die suurdeeg van die Fariseërs, dit is geveinsdheid.

kjv_text: For there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; neither hid, that shall not be known.
bsb_text: There is nothing concealed that will not be disclosed, and nothing hidden that will not be made known.
aov_text: En daar is niks bedek wat nie geopenbaar sal word nie, en verborge wat nie bekend sal word nie.

kjv_text: Therefore whatsoever ye have spoken in darkness shall be heard in the light; and that which ye have spoken in the ear in closets shall be proclaimed upon the housetops.
bsb_text: What you have spoken in the dark will be heard in the daylight, and what you have whispered in the inner rooms will be proclaimed from the housetops.
aov_text: Daarom, alles wat julle in die donker gesê het, sal in die lig gehoor word; en wat julle in die oor gepraat het in die binnekamers, sal op die dakke verkondig word.

kjv_text: And I say unto you my friends, Be not afraid of them that kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.
bsb_text: I tell you, My friends, do not be afraid of those who kill the body and after that can do no more.
aov_text: EN Ek sê vir julle, my vriende: Moenie vrees vir die wat die liggaam doodmaak en daarna niks meer kan doen nie;

kjv_text: But I will forewarn you whom ye shall fear: Fear him, which after he hath killed hath power to cast into hell; yea, I say unto you, Fear him.
bsb_text: But I will show you whom you should fear: Fear the One who, after you have been killed, has authority to throw you into hell. Yes, I tell you, fear Him!
aov_text: maar Ek sal julle wys wie julle moet vrees: vrees Hom wat, nadat Hy doodgemaak het, by magte is om in die hel te werp; ja, Ek sê vir julle, vrees Hom!

kjv_text: Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings, and not one of them is forgotten before God?
bsb_text: Are not five sparrows sold for two pennies? Yet not one of them is forgotten by God.
aov_text: Word vyf mossies nie vir twee stuiwers verkoop nie? En nie een van hulle is voor God vergeet nie.

kjv_text: But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not therefore: ye are of more value than many sparrows.
bsb_text: And even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. So do not be afraid; you are worth more than many sparrows.
aov_text: Maar selfs die hare van julle hoof is almal getel. Wees dan nie bevrees nie: julle is meer werd as baie mossies.

kjv_text: Also I say unto you, Whosoever shall confess me before men, him shall the Son of man also confess before the angels of God:
bsb_text: I tell you, everyone who confesses Me before men, the Son of Man will also confess him before the angels of God.
aov_text: En Ek sê vir julle: Elkeen wat My sal bely voor die mense, hom sal die Seun van die mens ook bely voor die engele van God.

kjv_text: But he that denieth me before men shall be denied before the angels of God.
bsb_text: But whoever denies Me before men will be denied before the angels of God.
aov_text: Maar hy wat My verloën voor die mense, sal verloën word voor die engele van God.

kjv_text: And whosoever shall speak a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but unto him that blasphemeth against the Holy Ghost it shall not be forgiven.
bsb_text: And everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.
aov_text: En elkeen wat ’n woord teen die Seun van die mens sal spreek, dit sal hom vergewe word; maar vir hom wat gelaster het teen die Heilige Gees, sal dit nie vergewe word nie.

kjv_text: And when they bring you unto the synagogues, and unto magistrates, and powers, take ye no thought how or what thing ye shall answer, or what ye shall say:
bsb_text: When you are brought before synagogues, rulers, and authorities, do not worry about how to defend yourselves or what to say.
aov_text: En wanneer hulle jul sal bring voor die sinagoges en die owerhede en die gesaghebbers, moet julle jul nie kwel oor hoe of waarmee julle jul sal verdedig, of wat julle sal sê nie;

kjv_text: For the Holy Ghost shall teach you in the same hour what ye ought to say.
bsb_text: For at that time the Holy Spirit will teach you what you should say.”
aov_text: want die Heilige Gees sal julle in dieselfde uur leer wat julle moet sê.

kjv_text: And one of the company said unto him, Master, speak to my brother, that he divide the inheritance with me.
bsb_text: Someone in the crowd said to Him, “Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me.”
aov_text: EN een van die skare sê vir Hom: Meester, sê vir my broer dat hy die erfenis met my moet deel.

kjv_text: And he said unto him, Man, who made me a judge or a divider over you?
bsb_text: But Jesus replied, “Man, who appointed Me judge or executor between you?”
aov_text: Maar Hy antwoord hom: Mens, wie het My as ’n regter of deler oor julle aangestel?

kjv_text: And he said unto them, Take heed, and beware of covetousness: for a man's life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth.
bsb_text: And He said to them, “Watch out! Guard yourselves against every form of greed, for one’s life does not consist in the abundance of his possessions.”
aov_text: En Hy sê vir hulle: Pas op en wees op julle hoede vir die hebsug, want iemand se lewe bestaan nie uit die oorvloed van sy besittings nie.

kjv_text: And he spake a parable unto them, saying, The ground of a certain rich man brought forth plentifully:
bsb_text: Then He told them a parable: “The ground of a certain rich man produced an abundance.
aov_text: Toe vertel Hy hulle hierdie gelykenis: ’n Ryk man se grond het goed gedra.

kjv_text: And he thought within himself, saying, What shall I do, because I have no room where to bestow my fruits?
bsb_text: So he thought to himself, ‘What shall I do, since I have nowhere to store my crops?’
aov_text: En hy het by homself geredeneer en gesê: Wat sal ek doen, want ek het geen plek waar ek my oes kan insamel nie?

kjv_text: And he said, This will I do: I will pull down my barns, and build greater; and there will I bestow all my fruits and my goods.
bsb_text: Then he said, ‘This is what I will do: I will tear down my barns and will build bigger ones, and there I will store up all my grain and my goods.
aov_text: Toe sê hy: Dit sal ek doen: ek sal my skure afbreek en groter bou, en ek sal daar al my opbrengste en my goed insamel.

kjv_text: And I will say to my soul, Soul, thou hast much goods laid up for many years; take thine ease, eat, drink, and be merry.
bsb_text: Then I will say to myself, “You have plenty of good things laid up for many years. Take it easy. Eat, drink, and be merry!”’
aov_text: En ek sal vir my siel sê: Siel, jy het baie goed wat weggesit is vir baie jare; neem rus, eet, drink, wees vrolik.

kjv_text: But God said unto him, Thou fool, this night thy soul shall be required of thee: then whose shall those things be, which thou hast provided?
bsb_text: But God said to him, ‘You fool! This very night your life will be required of you. Then who will own what you have accumulated?’
aov_text: Maar God het aan hom gesê: Jou dwaas, in hierdie nag sal hulle jou siel van jou afeis; en wat jy gereedgemaak het, wie s’n sal dit wees?

kjv_text: So is he that layeth up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.
bsb_text: This is how it will be for anyone who stores up treasure for himself but is not rich toward God.”
aov_text: So gaan dit met hom wat vir homself skatte vergader en nie ryk is in God nie.

kjv_text: And he said unto his disciples, Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat; neither for the body, what ye shall put on.
bsb_text: Then Jesus said to His disciples, “Therefore I tell you, do not worry about your life, what you will eat, or about your body, what you will wear.
aov_text: EN Hy het aan sy dissipels gesê: Daarom sê Ek vir julle: Moenie julle kwel oor jul lewe, wat julle sal eet, of oor jul liggaam, wat julle sal aantrek nie.

kjv_text: The life is more than meat, and the body is more than raiment.
bsb_text: For life is more than food, and the body more than clothes.
aov_text: Die lewe is meer as die voedsel en die liggaam as die klere.

kjv_text: Consider the ravens: for they neither sow nor reap; which neither have storehouse nor barn; and God feedeth them: how much more are ye better than the fowls?
bsb_text: Consider the ravens: They do not sow or reap, they have no storehouse or barn; yet God feeds them. How much more valuable you are than the birds!
aov_text: Kyk na die kraaie, want hulle saai nie en hulle maai nie; hulle het geen voorraadkamer of skuur nie, en tog voed God hulle. Hoeveel meer is julle nie werd as die voëls nie!

kjv_text: And which of you with taking thought can add to his stature one cubit?
bsb_text: Who of you by worrying can add a single hour to his life?
aov_text: En wie onder julle kan, deur hom te kwel, een el by sy lengte voeg?

kjv_text: If ye then be not able to do that thing which is least, why take ye thought for the rest?
bsb_text: So if you cannot do such a small thing, why do you worry about the rest?
aov_text: As julle dan selfs nie die geringste kan doen nie, waarom kwel julle jul oor die ander dinge?

kjv_text: Consider the lilies how they grow: they toil not, they spin not; and yet I say unto you, that Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
bsb_text: Consider how the lilies grow: They do not labor or spin. Yet I tell you, not even Solomon in all his glory was adorned like one of these.
aov_text: Kyk na die lelies, hoe hulle groei: hulle arbei nie en hulle spin nie; en Ek sê vir julle, selfs Salomo in al sy heerlikheid was nie bekleed soos een van hulle nie.

kjv_text: If then God so clothe the grass, which is to day in the field, and to morrow is cast into the oven; how much more will he clothe you, O ye of little faith?
bsb_text: If that is how God clothes the grass of the field, which is here today and tomorrow is thrown into the furnace, how much more will He clothe you, O you of little faith!
aov_text: As God dan die gras van die veld wat vandag daar is en môre in ’n oond gegooi word, so beklee, hoeveel meer vir julle, kleingelowiges!

kjv_text: And seek not ye what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink, neither be ye of doubtful mind.
bsb_text: And do not be concerned about what you will eat or drink. Do not worry about it.
aov_text: Julle moet ook nie soek wat julle sal eet of wat julle sal drink nie, en julle nie ongerus maak nie;

kjv_text: For all these things do the nations of the world seek after: and your Father knoweth that ye have need of these things.
bsb_text: For the Gentiles of the world strive after all these things, and your Father knows that you need them.
aov_text: want al hierdie dinge soek die nasies van die wêreld, en julle Vader weet dat julle hierdie dinge nodig het.

kjv_text: But rather seek ye the kingdom of God; and all these things shall be added unto you.
bsb_text: But seek His kingdom, and these things will be added unto you.
aov_text: Maar soek die koninkryk van God, en al hierdie dinge sal vir julle bygevoeg word.

kjv_text: Fear not, little flock; for it is your Father's good pleasure to give you the kingdom.
bsb_text: Do not be afraid, little flock, for your Father is pleased to give you the kingdom.
aov_text: Moenie vrees nie, klein kuddetjie, want julle Vader het ’n welbehae daarin gehad om aan julle die koninkryk te gee.

kjv_text: Sell that ye have, and give alms; provide yourselves bags which wax not old, a treasure in the heavens that faileth not, where no thief approacheth, neither moth corrupteth.
bsb_text: Sell your possessions and give to the poor. Provide yourselves with purses that will not wear out, an inexhaustible treasure in heaven, where no thief approaches and no moth destroys.
aov_text: Verkoop julle besittings en gee aalmoese; maak vir julle beurse wat nie oud word nie, ’n skat in die hemel wat onuitputlik is, waar geen dief by kom of mot verteer nie.

kjv_text: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
bsb_text: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.
aov_text: Want waar julle skat is, daar sal julle hart ook wees.

kjv_text: Let your loins be girded about, and your lights burning;
bsb_text: Be dressed for service and keep your lamps burning.
aov_text: LAAT julle heupe omgord wees en julle lampe aan die brand.

kjv_text: And ye yourselves like unto men that wait for their lord, when he will return from the wedding; that when he cometh and knocketh, they may open unto him immediately.
bsb_text: Then you will be like servants waiting for their master to return from the wedding banquet, so that when he comes and knocks, they can open the door for him at once.
aov_text: En julle moet wees soos mense wat op hulle heer wag wanneer hy van die bruilof terugkom, sodat hulle dadelik vir hom kan oopmaak as hy kom en aanklop.

kjv_text: Blessed are those servants, whom the lord when he cometh shall find watching: verily I say unto you, that he shall gird himself, and make them to sit down to meat, and will come forth and serve them.
bsb_text: Blessed are those servants whom the master finds on watch when he returns. Truly I tell you, he will dress himself to serve and will have them recline at the table, and he himself will come and wait on them.
aov_text: Gelukkig is daardie diensknegte vir wie die heer wakker sal vind as hy kom. Voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, hy sal hom omgord en hulle aan tafel laat gaan en hulle kom bedien.

kjv_text: And if he shall come in the second watch, or come in the third watch, and find them so, blessed are those servants.
bsb_text: Even if he comes in the second or third watch of the night and finds them alert, those servants will be blessed.
aov_text: En as hy in die tweede of in die derde nagwaak kom, en dit so vind — gelukkig is daardie diensknegte.

kjv_text: And this know, that if the goodman of the house had known what hour the thief would come, he would have watched, and not have suffered his house to be broken through.
bsb_text: But understand this: If the homeowner had known at what hour the thief was coming, he would not have let his house be broken into.
aov_text: Maar weet dit: as die huisheer geweet het in watter uur die dief sou kom, sou hy gewaak het en nie in sy huis laat inbreek het nie.

kjv_text: Be ye therefore ready also: for the Son of man cometh at an hour when ye think not.
bsb_text: You also must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour you do not expect.”
aov_text: Julle moet dan ook gereed wees, omdat die Seun van die mens kom op ’n uur dat julle dit nie verwag nie.

kjv_text: Then Peter said unto him, Lord, speakest thou this parable unto us, or even to all?
bsb_text: “Lord,” said Peter, “are You addressing this parable to us, or to everyone else as well?”
aov_text: Toe sê Petrus vir Hom: Here, vertel U hierdie gelykenis vir ons of ook vir almal?

kjv_text: And the Lord said, Who then is that faithful and wise steward, whom his lord shall make ruler over his household, to give them their portion of meat in due season?
bsb_text: And the Lord answered, “Who then is the faithful and wise manager, whom the master puts in charge of his servants to give them their portion at the proper time?
aov_text: En die Here antwoord: Wie is dan die getroue en verstandige bestuurder wat die heer oor sy diensvolk sal aanstel om hulle rantsoen op tyd te gee?

kjv_text: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.
bsb_text: Blessed is that servant whose master finds him doing so when he returns.
aov_text: Gelukkig is daardie dienskneg vir wie sy heer, as hy kom, só besig sal vind.

kjv_text: Of a truth I say unto you, that he will make him ruler over all that he hath.
bsb_text: Truly I tell you, he will put him in charge of all his possessions.
aov_text: Waarlik, Ek sê vir julle, hy sal hom oor al sy besittings aanstel.

kjv_text: But and if that servant say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming; and shall begin to beat the menservants and maidens, and to eat and drink, and to be drunken;
bsb_text: But suppose that servant says in his heart, ‘My master will be a long time in coming,’ and he begins to beat the menservants and maidservants, and to eat and drink and get drunk.
aov_text: Maar as daardie dienskneg in sy hart sê: My heer talm om te kom, en hy die diensknegte en diensmaagde begin slaan, en begin eet en drink en dronk word,

kjv_text: The lord of that servant will come in a day when he looketh not for him, and at an hour when he is not aware, and will cut him in sunder, and will appoint him his portion with the unbelievers.
bsb_text: The master of that servant will come on a day he does not expect and at an hour he does not anticipate. Then he will cut him to pieces and assign him a place with the unbelievers.
aov_text: dan sal die heer van daardie dienskneg kom op ’n dag dat hy dit nie verwag nie, en op ’n uur dat hy dit nie weet nie, en sal hom pynig en hom ’n deelgenoot maak van die ontroues.

kjv_text: And that servant, which knew his lord's will, and prepared not himself, neither did according to his will, shall be beaten with many stripes.
bsb_text: That servant who knows his master’s will but does not get ready or follow his instructions will be beaten with many blows.
aov_text: En daardie dienskneg wat die wil van sy heer geken het en nie klaargemaak of volgens sy wil gedoen het nie, sal met baie slae geslaan word;

kjv_text: But he that knew not, and did commit things worthy of stripes, shall be beaten with few stripes. For unto whomsoever much is given, of him shall be much required: and to whom men have committed much, of him they will ask the more.
bsb_text: But the one who unknowingly does things worthy of punishment will be beaten with few blows. From everyone who has been given much, much will be required; and from him who has been entrusted with much, even more will be demanded.
aov_text: maar hy wat nie geweet het nie en gedoen het wat slae verdien, sal met min slae geslaan word. En elkeen aan wie veel gegee is, van hom sal veel gevorder word; en aan wie hulle veel toevertrou het, van hom sal hulle oorvloediger eis.

kjv_text: I am come to send fire on the earth; and what will I, if it be already kindled?
bsb_text: I have come to ignite a fire on the earth, and how I wish it were already kindled!
aov_text: EK het gekom om vuur op die aarde te werp, en hoe wens Ek dat dit al aangesteek was!

kjv_text: But I have a baptism to be baptized with; and how am I straitened till it be accomplished!
bsb_text: But I have a baptism to undergo, and how distressed I am until it is accomplished!
aov_text: Maar Ek het ’n doop om mee gedoop te word, en hoe benoud word Ek totdat dit volbring is!

kjv_text: Suppose ye that I am come to give peace on earth? I tell you, Nay; but rather division:
bsb_text: Do you think that I have come to bring peace to the earth? No, I tell you, but division.
aov_text: Dink julle dat Ek gekom het om vrede op die aarde te gee? Nee, sê Ek vir julle, maar eerder verdeeldheid.

kjv_text: For from henceforth there shall be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.
bsb_text: From now on, five in one household will be divided, three against two and two against three.
aov_text: Want van nou af sal daar vyf in een huis verdeeld wees, drie teen twee en twee teen drie.

kjv_text: The father shall be divided against the son, and the son against the father; the mother against the daughter, and the daughter against the mother; the mother in law against her daughter in law, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.
bsb_text: They will be divided, father against son and son against father, mother against daughter and daughter against mother, mother-in-law against daughter-in-law and daughter-in-law against mother-in-law.”
aov_text: Die vader sal verdeeld wees teen die seun en die seun teen die vader, die moeder teen die dogter en die dogter teen die moeder, die skoonmoeder teen haar skoondogter en die skoondogter teen haar skoonmoeder.

kjv_text: And he said also to the people, When ye see a cloud rise out of the west, straightway ye say, There cometh a shower; and so it is.
bsb_text: Then Jesus said to the crowds, “As soon as you see a cloud rising in the west, you say, ‘A shower is coming,’ and that is what happens.
aov_text: EN Hy het ook aan die skare gesê: Wanneer julle ’n wolk in die weste sien opkom, sê julle dadelik: Daar kom reën! en dit gebeur ook.

kjv_text: And when ye see the south wind blow, ye say, There will be heat; and it cometh to pass.
bsb_text: And when the south wind blows, you say, ‘It will be hot,’ and it is.
aov_text: En wanneer julle die suidewind sien waai, sê julle: Dit sal gloeiend warm wees! en dit gebeur.

kjv_text: Ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky and of the earth; but how is it that ye do not discern this time?
bsb_text: You hypocrites! You know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and sky. Why don’t you know how to interpret the present time?
aov_text: Geveinsdes, die voorkoms van die aarde en die lug weet julle te beoordeel, maar hoe is dit dat julle hierdie tyd nie kan beoordeel nie?

kjv_text: Yea, and why even of yourselves judge ye not what is right?
bsb_text: And why don’t you judge for yourselves what is right?
aov_text: En waarom oordeel julle ook nie uit julleself wat reg is nie?

kjv_text: When thou goest with thine adversary to the magistrate, as thou art in the way, give diligence that thou mayest be delivered from him; lest he hale thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and the officer cast thee into prison.
bsb_text: Make every effort to reconcile with your adversary while you are on your way to the magistrate. Otherwise, he may drag you off to the judge, and the judge may hand you over to the officer, and the officer may throw you into prison.
aov_text: Want terwyl jy met jou teëstander na die owerheid gaan, doen moeite op die pad om van hom los te kom; sodat hy jou nie miskien voor die regter sleep en die regter jou oorgee aan die geregsdienaar en die geregsdienaar jou in die gevangenis werp nie.

kjv_text: I tell thee, thou shalt not depart thence, till thou hast paid the very last mite.
bsb_text: I tell you, you will not get out until you have paid the very last penny.”
aov_text: Ek sê vir jou, jy sal daar sekerlik nie uitkom voordat jy ook die laaste oortjie betaal het nie.

kjv_text: There were present at that season some that told him of the Galilaeans, whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices.
bsb_text: At that time some of those present told Jesus about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.
aov_text: EN in dieselfde tyd was daar mense teenwoordig wat Hom berig gebring het van die Galiléërs wie se bloed Pilatus met hulle offers gemeng het.

kjv_text: And Jesus answering said unto them, Suppose ye that these Galilaeans were sinners above all the Galilaeans, because they suffered such things?
bsb_text: To this He replied, “Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans, because they suffered this fate?
aov_text: En Jesus antwoord en sê vir hulle: Dink julle dat hierdie Galiléërs groter sondaars was as al die Galiléërs, omdat hulle sulke dinge gely het?

kjv_text: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.
bsb_text: No, I tell you. But unless you repent, you too will all perish.
aov_text: Nee, sê Ek vir julle; maar as julle jul nie bekeer nie, sal julle almal net so omkom.

kjv_text: Or those eighteen, upon whom the tower in Siloam fell, and slew them, think ye that they were sinners above all men that dwelt in Jerusalem?
bsb_text: Or those eighteen who were killed when the tower of Siloam collapsed on them: Do you think that they were more sinful than all the others living in Jerusalem?
aov_text: Of daardie agttien op wie die toring van Silóam geval en hulle gedood het — dink julle dat hulle meer skuldig was as al die mense wat in Jerusalem woon?

kjv_text: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.
bsb_text: No, I tell you. But unless you repent, you too will all perish.”
aov_text: Nee, sê Ek vir julle; maar as julle jul nie bekeer nie, sal julle almal net so omkom.

kjv_text: He spake also this parable; A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard; and he came and sought fruit thereon, and found none.
bsb_text: Then Jesus told this parable: “A man had a fig tree that was planted in his vineyard. He went to look for fruit on it, but did not find any.
aov_text: EN Hy het hierdie gelykenis uitgespreek: ’n Man het ’n vyeboom gehad wat in sy wingerd geplant was, en hy het gekom en vrugte daaraan gesoek en niks gekry nie.

kjv_text: Then said he unto the dresser of his vineyard, Behold, these three years I come seeking fruit on this fig tree, and find none: cut it down; why cumbereth it the ground?
bsb_text: So he said to the keeper of the vineyard, ‘Look, for the past three years I have come to search for fruit on this fig tree and haven’t found any. Therefore cut it down! Why should it use up the soil?’
aov_text: Toe sê hy vir die tuinier: Kyk, drie jaar kom ek om vrugte aan hierdie vyeboom te soek en ek kry niks nie; kap hom uit. Waarvoor maak hy die grond nog onvrugbaar?

kjv_text: And he answering said unto him, Lord, let it alone this year also, till I shall dig about it, and dung it:
bsb_text: ‘Sir,’ the man replied, ‘leave it alone again this year, until I dig around it and fertilize it.
aov_text: Maar hy antwoord en sê vir hom: Meneer, laat hom nog hierdie jaar staan totdat ek om hom gespit en mis gegooi het.

kjv_text: And if it bear fruit, well: and if not, then after that thou shalt cut it down.
bsb_text: If it bears fruit next year, fine. But if not, you can cut it down.’”
aov_text: As hy dan vrugte dra, goed; maar so nie, dan kan u hom anderjaar uitkap.

kjv_text: And he was teaching in one of the synagogues on the sabbath.
bsb_text: One Sabbath Jesus was teaching in one of the synagogues,
aov_text: EN Hy was besig om op die sabbat in een van die sinagoges te leer.

kjv_text: And, behold, there was a woman which had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years, and was bowed together, and could in no wise lift up herself.
bsb_text: and a woman there had been disabled by a spirit for eighteen years. She was hunched over and could not stand up straight.
aov_text: En daar was ’n vrou wat ’n gees van krankheid agttien jaar lank gehad het, en sy was inmekaargetrek en glad nie in staat om regop te kom nie.

kjv_text: And when Jesus saw her, he called her to him, and said unto her, Woman, thou art loosed from thine infirmity.
bsb_text: When Jesus saw her, He called her over and said, “Woman, you are set free from your disability.”
aov_text: En toe Jesus haar sien, roep Hy haar en sê: Vrou, jy is van jou krankheid verlos.

kjv_text: And he laid his hands on her: and immediately she was made straight, and glorified God.
bsb_text: Then He placed His hands on her, and immediately she straightened up and began to glorify God.
aov_text: En Hy het haar die hande opgelê, en onmiddellik het sy regop gestaan en God verheerlik.

kjv_text: And the ruler of the synagogue answered with indignation, because that Jesus had healed on the sabbath day, and said unto the people, There are six days in which men ought to work: in them therefore come and be healed, and not on the sabbath day.
bsb_text: But the synagogue leader was indignant that Jesus had healed on the Sabbath. “There are six days for work,” he told the crowd. “So come and be healed on those days and not on the Sabbath.”
aov_text: Maar die owerste van die sinagoge, wat verontwaardig was dat Jesus op die sabbat genees het, antwoord en sê vir die skare: Daar is ses dae waarop ’n mens behoort te werk; kom dan op dié dae en laat julle genees en nie op die sabbatdag nie.

kjv_text: The Lord then answered him, and said, Thou hypocrite, doth not each one of you on the sabbath loose his ox or his ass from the stall, and lead him away to watering?
bsb_text: “You hypocrites!” the Lord replied. “Does not each of you on the Sabbath untie his ox or donkey from the stall and lead it to water?
aov_text: Toe antwoord die Here hom en sê: Jou geveinsde, maak elkeen van julle nie op die sabbat sy os of esel van die krip los en lei hom weg om hom te laat drink nie?

kjv_text: And ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan hath bound, lo, these eighteen years, be loosed from this bond on the sabbath day?
bsb_text: Then should not this daughter of Abraham, whom Satan has kept bound for eighteen long years, be released from her bondage on the Sabbath day?”
aov_text: Maar hierdie vrou wat ’n dogter van Abraham is, wat die Satan — dink daaraan! — agttien jaar lank gebind het, moes sy nie van hierdie band op die sabbatdag verlos word nie?

kjv_text: And when he had said these things, all his adversaries were ashamed: and all the people rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.
bsb_text: When Jesus said this, all His adversaries were humiliated. And the whole crowd rejoiced at all the glorious things He was doing.
aov_text: En toe Hy dit sê, het al sy teëstanders beskaamd geword; en die hele skare was bly oor al die heerlike dinge wat deur Hom gebeur het.

kjv_text: Then said he, Unto what is the kingdom of God like? and whereunto shall I resemble it?
bsb_text: Then Jesus asked, “What is the kingdom of God like? To what can I compare it?
aov_text: EN Hy het gesê: Hoedanig is die koninkryk van God en waarmee sal Ek dit vergelyk?

kjv_text: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and cast into his garden; and it grew, and waxed a great tree; and the fowls of the air lodged in the branches of it.
bsb_text: It is like a mustard seed that a man tossed into his garden. It grew and became a tree, and the birds of the air nested in its branches.”
aov_text: Dit is soos ’n mosterdsaad wat ’n man geneem en in sy tuin gesaai het; en dit het gegroei en ’n groot boom geword, en die voëls van die hemel het nes gemaak in sy takke.

kjv_text: And again he said, Whereunto shall I liken the kingdom of God?
bsb_text: Again He asked, “To what can I compare the kingdom of God?
aov_text: En weer het Hy gesê: Waarmee sal Ek die koninkryk van God vergelyk?

kjv_text: It is like leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.
bsb_text: It is like leaven that a woman took and mixed into three measures of flour, until all of it was leavened.”
aov_text: Dit is soos suurdeeg wat ’n vrou neem en in drie mate meel inwerk totdat dit heeltemal ingesuur is.

kjv_text: And he went through the cities and villages, teaching, and journeying toward Jerusalem.
bsb_text: Then Jesus traveled throughout the towns and villages, teaching as He made His way toward Jerusalem.
aov_text: EN onderwyl Hy geleer het en op reis was na Jerusalem, het Hy stede en dorpe deurgegaan.

kjv_text: Then said one unto him, Lord, are there few that be saved? And he said unto them,
bsb_text: “Lord,” someone asked Him, “will only a few people be saved?” Jesus answered,
aov_text: Toe sê iemand vir Hom: Here, is die wat gered word, min? En Hy antwoord hulle:

kjv_text: Strive to enter in at the strait gate: for many, I say unto you, will seek to enter in, and shall not be able.
bsb_text: “Make every effort to enter through the narrow door. For many, I tell you, will try to enter and will not be able.
aov_text: Stry hard om in te gaan deur die nou poort, want baie, sê Ek vir julle, sal probeer om in te gaan en sal nie in staat wees nie.

kjv_text: When once the master of the house is risen up, and hath shut to the door, and ye begin to stand without, and to knock at the door, saying, Lord, Lord, open unto us; and he shall answer and say unto you, I know you not whence ye are:
bsb_text: After the master of the house gets up and shuts the door, you will stand outside knocking and saying, ‘Lord, open the door for us.’ But he will reply, ‘I do not know where you are from.’
aov_text: Wanneer die eienaar van die huis opgestaan en die deur gesluit het, en julle begin buitekant te staan en aan die deur te klop en te sê: Here, Here, maak vir ons oop — sal Hy antwoord en vir julle sê: Ek ken julle nie waar julle vandaan is nie.

kjv_text: Then shall ye begin to say, We have eaten and drunk in thy presence, and thou hast taught in our streets.
bsb_text: Then you will say, ‘We ate and drank with you, and you taught in our streets.’
aov_text: Dan sal julle begin sê: Ons het in u teenwoordigheid geëet en gedrink, en U het op ons strate geleer.

kjv_text: But he shall say, I tell you, I know you not whence ye are; depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity.
bsb_text: And he will answer, ‘I tell you, I do not know where you are from. Depart from me, all you evildoers.’
aov_text: En Hy sal sê: Ek sê vir julle, Ek ken julle nie waar julle vandaan is nie. Gaan weg van My, al julle werkers van die ongeregtigheid!

kjv_text: There shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth, when ye shall see Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, and all the prophets, in the kingdom of God, and you yourselves thrust out.
bsb_text: There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth when you see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in the kingdom of God, but you yourselves are thrown out.
aov_text: Daar sal geween wees en gekners van die tande, wanneer julle Abraham en Isak en Jakob en al die profete in die koninkryk van God sal sien, maar julle self uitgedryf buitentoe.

kjv_text: And they shall come from the east, and from the west, and from the north, and from the south, and shall sit down in the kingdom of God.
bsb_text: People will come from east and west and north and south, and will recline at the table in the kingdom of God.
aov_text: En hulle sal kom van oos en wes en van noord en suid en aansit in die koninkryk van God.

kjv_text: And, behold, there are last which shall be first, and there are first which shall be last.
bsb_text: And indeed, some who are last will be first, and some who are first will be last.”
aov_text: En daar is laastes wat eerste sal wees, en daar is eerstes wat laaste sal wees.

kjv_text: The same day there came certain of the Pharisees, saying unto him, Get thee out, and depart hence: for Herod will kill thee.
bsb_text: At that very hour, some Pharisees came to Jesus and told Him, “Leave this place and get away, because Herod wants to kill You.”
aov_text: EN op dieselfde dag het sommige van die Fariseërs na Hom gekom en vir Hom gesê: Gaan weg en vertrek hiervandaan, want Herodes wil U om die lewe bring.

kjv_text: And he said unto them, Go ye, and tell that fox, Behold, I cast out devils, and I do cures to day and to morrow, and the third day I shall be perfected.
bsb_text: But Jesus replied, “Go tell that fox, ‘Look, I will keep driving out demons and healing people today and tomorrow, and on the third day I will reach My goal.’
aov_text: En Hy het vir hulle gesê: Gaan vertel daardie jakkals: Kyk, Ek dryf duiwels uit en maak gesond, vandag en môre, en op die derde dag is Ek klaar.

kjv_text: Nevertheless I must walk to day, and to morrow, and the day following: for it cannot be that a prophet perish out of Jerusalem.
bsb_text: Nevertheless, I must keep going today and tomorrow and the next day, for it is not admissible for a prophet to perish outside of Jerusalem.
aov_text: Maar Ek moet vandag en môre en die volgende dag verder gaan, want dit kan nie gebeur dat ’n profeet buitekant Jerusalem omkom nie.

kjv_text: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, which killest the prophets, and stonest them that are sent unto thee; how often would I have gathered thy children together, as a hen doth gather her brood under her wings, and ye would not!
bsb_text: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets and stones those sent to her, how often I have longed to gather your children together as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, but you were unwilling!
aov_text: Jerusalem, Jerusalem, jy wat die profete doodmaak en die wat na jou gestuur is, stenig, hoe dikwels wou Ek jou kinders bymekaarmaak, soos ’n hen haar kuikens onder die vlerke, en julle wou nie.

kjv_text: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate: and verily I say unto you, Ye shall not see me, until the time come when ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.
bsb_text: Look, your house is left to you desolate. And I tell you that you will not see Me again until you say, ‘Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord.’”
aov_text: Kyk, julle huis word vir julle woes gelaat. Voorwaar Ek sê vir julle dat julle My sekerlik nie sal sien nie totdat die dag kom wanneer julle sal sê: Geseënd is Hy wat kom in die Naam van die Here!

kjv_text: And it came to pass, as he went into the house of one of the chief Pharisees to eat bread on the sabbath day, that they watched him.
bsb_text: One Sabbath, Jesus went to eat in the home of a leading Pharisee, and those in attendance were watching Him closely.
aov_text: EN toe Hy in die huis van een van die owerstes van die Fariseërs gegaan het om brood te eet op die sabbat, het hulle Hom in die oog gehou.

kjv_text: And, behold, there was a certain man before him which had the dropsy.
bsb_text: Right there before Him was a man with dropsy.
aov_text: En daar was voor Hom ’n man wat die water gehad het.

kjv_text: And Jesus answering spake unto the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath day?
bsb_text: So Jesus asked the experts in the law and the Pharisees, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath or not?”
aov_text: En Jesus het gespreek en aan die wetgeleerdes en Fariseërs gesê: Is dit geoorloof om op die sabbat te genees?

kjv_text: And they held their peace. And he took him, and healed him, and let him go;
bsb_text: But they remained silent. Then Jesus took hold of the man, healed him, and sent him on his way.
aov_text: Maar hulle het stilgebly. Toe neem Hy hom en maak hom gesond en laat hom gaan.

kjv_text: And answered them, saying, Which of you shall have an ass or an ox fallen into a pit, and will not straightway pull him out on the sabbath day?
bsb_text: And He asked them, “Which of you whose son or ox falls into a pit on the Sabbath day will not immediately pull him out?”
aov_text: En Hy antwoord en sê vir hulle: Wie van julle se esel of os sal in ’n put val, wat dit nie dadelik op die sabbatdag sal uittrek nie?

kjv_text: And they could not answer him again to these things.
bsb_text: And they were unable to answer these questions.
aov_text: En hulle kon Hom daarop nie antwoord nie.

kjv_text: And he put forth a parable to those which were bidden, when he marked how they chose out the chief rooms; saying unto them,
