bsb_text: When Jesus noticed how the guests chose the places of honor, He told them a parable:
aov_text: EN toe Hy merk hoe hulle die voorste plekke uitkies, vertel Hy aan die genooides ’n gelykenis en sê vir hulle:

kjv_text: When thou art bidden of any man to a wedding, sit not down in the highest room; lest a more honourable man than thou be bidden of him;
bsb_text: “When you are invited to a wedding banquet, do not sit in the place of honor, in case someone more distinguished than you has been invited.
aov_text: Wanneer jy deur iemand na ’n bruilof uitgenooi is, moenie die voorste plek inneem nie, ingeval daar nie miskien een wat waardiger is as jy deur hom uitgenooi is nie,

kjv_text: And he that bade thee and him come and say to thee, Give this man place; and thou begin with shame to take the lowest room.
bsb_text: Then the host who invited both of you will come and tell you, ‘Give this man your seat.’ And in humiliation, you will have to take the last place.
aov_text: en hy wat jou en hom genooi het, kom en vir jou sê: Maak plek vir hierdie man. En dan sal jy met skaamte die agterste plek begin inneem.

kjv_text: But when thou art bidden, go and sit down in the lowest room; that when he that bade thee cometh, he may say unto thee, Friend, go up higher: then shalt thou have worship in the presence of them that sit at meat with thee.
bsb_text: But when you are invited, go and sit in the last place, so that your host will come and tell you, ‘Friend, move up to a better place.’ Then you will be honored in front of everyone at the table with you.
aov_text: Maar wanneer jy genooi is, gaan en neem die agterste plek in; sodat wanneer hy kom wat jou genooi het, hy vir jou kan sê: Vriend, gaan hoër op! Dan sal jy eer hê voor die wat saam met jou aan tafel is.

kjv_text: For whosoever exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.
bsb_text: For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and the one who humbles himself will be exalted.”
aov_text: Want elkeen wat homself verhoog, sal verneder word, en wat homself verneder, sal verhoog word.

kjv_text: Then said he also to him that bade him, When thou makest a dinner or a supper, call not thy friends, nor thy brethren, neither thy kinsmen, nor thy rich neighbours; lest they also bid thee again, and a recompence be made thee.
bsb_text: Then Jesus said to the man who had invited Him, “When you host a dinner or a banquet, do not invite your friends or brothers or relatives or rich neighbors. Otherwise, they may invite you in return, and you will be repaid.
aov_text: En Hy sê ook vir die man wat Hom genooi het: Wanneer jy ’n môre- of middagete gee, moenie jou vriende nooi, of jou broers of bloedverwante of ryk bure nie, sodat hulle jou nie miskien ook eendag weer uitnooi en jy vergelding ontvang nie.

kjv_text: But when thou makest a feast, call the poor, the maimed, the lame, the blind:
bsb_text: But when you host a banquet, invite the poor, the crippled, the lame, and the blind,
aov_text: Maar wanneer jy ’n feesmaal gee, nooi armes, verminktes, kreupeles, blindes,

kjv_text: And thou shalt be blessed; for they cannot recompense thee: for thou shalt be recompensed at the resurrection of the just.
bsb_text: and you will be blessed. Since they cannot repay you, you will be repaid at the resurrection of the righteous.”
aov_text: en jy sal gelukkig wees, omdat hulle niks het om jou te vergeld nie; want dit sal jou vergeld word in die opstanding van die regverdiges

kjv_text: And when one of them that sat at meat with him heard these things, he said unto him, Blessed is he that shall eat bread in the kingdom of God.
bsb_text: When one of those reclining with Him heard this, he said to Jesus, “Blessed is everyone who will eat at the feast in the kingdom of God.”
aov_text: EN toe een van die wat saam aan tafel was, dit hoor, sê hy vir Hom: Salig is hy wat brood eet in die koninkryk van God.

kjv_text: Then said he unto him, A certain man made a great supper, and bade many:
bsb_text: But Jesus replied, “A certain man prepared a great banquet and invited many guests.
aov_text: Maar Hy antwoord hom: ’n Sekere man het ’n groot maaltyd gegee en baie mense uitgenooi.

kjv_text: And sent his servant at supper time to say to them that were bidden, Come; for all things are now ready.
bsb_text: When it was time for the banquet, he sent his servant to tell those who had been invited, ‘Come, for everything is now ready.’
aov_text: En op die uur van die maaltyd het hy sy dienskneg uitgestuur om vir die genooides te sê: Kom, want alles is nou gereed.

kjv_text: And they all with one consent began to make excuse. The first said unto him, I have bought a piece of ground, and I must needs go and see it: I pray thee have me excused.
bsb_text: But one after another they all began to make excuses. The first one said, ‘I have bought a field, and I need to go see it. Please excuse me.’
aov_text: En hulle het hul almal eenparig begin verontskuldig. Die eerste het vir hom gesê: Ek het ’n stuk grond gekoop en ek moet noodsaaklik uitgaan om daarna te kyk. Ek vra u, verskoon my tog.

kjv_text: And another said, I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I go to prove them: I pray thee have me excused.
bsb_text: Another said, ‘I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I am going to try them out. Please excuse me.’
aov_text: En ’n ander een het gesê: Ek het vyf paar osse gekoop en gaan hulle probeer. Ek vra u, verskoon my tog.

kjv_text: And another said, I have married a wife, and therefore I cannot come.
bsb_text: Still another said, ‘I have married a wife, so I cannot come.’
aov_text: En ’n ander een het gesê: Ek het ’n vrou getrou en daarom kan ek nie kom nie.

kjv_text: So that servant came, and shewed his lord these things. Then the master of the house being angry said to his servant, Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in hither the poor, and the maimed, and the halt, and the blind.
bsb_text: The servant returned and reported all this to his master. Then the owner of the house became angry and said to his servant, ‘Go out quickly into the streets and alleys of the city, and bring in the poor, the crippled, the blind, and the lame.’
aov_text: En daardie dienskneg het gekom en dié dinge aan sy heer vertel. Toe het die eienaar van die huis kwaad geword en vir sy dienskneg gesê: Gaan gou uit in die strate en die gangetjies van die stad en bring die armes en verminktes en kreupeles en blindes hier in.

kjv_text: And the servant said, Lord, it is done as thou hast commanded, and yet there is room.
bsb_text: ‘Sir,’ the servant replied, ‘what you ordered has been done, and there is still room.’
aov_text: En die dienskneg het gesê: Meneer, wat u beveel het, is gedoen, en daar is nog plek.

kjv_text: And the lord said unto the servant, Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.
bsb_text: So the master told his servant, ‘Go out to the highways and hedges and compel them to come in, so that my house will be full.
aov_text: Toe sê die heer vir die dienskneg: Gaan uit op die paaie en na die lanings en dwing hulle om in te kom, sodat my huis vol kan word.

kjv_text: For I say unto you, That none of those men which were bidden shall taste of my supper.
bsb_text: For I tell you, not one of those men who were invited will taste my banquet.’”
aov_text: Want ek sê vir julle dat nie een van daardie manne wat genooi is, my maaltyd sal smaak nie.

kjv_text: And there went great multitudes with him: and he turned, and said unto them,
bsb_text: Large crowds were now traveling with Jesus, and He turned and said to them,
aov_text: EN groot menigtes het saam met Hom gegaan, en Hy het Hom omgedraai en vir hulle gesê:

kjv_text: If any man come to me, and hate not his father, and mother, and wife, and children, and brethren, and sisters, yea, and his own life also, he cannot be my disciple.
bsb_text: “If anyone comes to Me and does not hate his father and mother and wife and children and brothers and sisters—yes, even his own life—he cannot be My disciple.
aov_text: As iemand na My toe kom en hy haat nie sy vader en moeder en vrou en kinders en broers en susters, ja, selfs ook sy eie lewe nie, kan hy my dissipel nie wees nie.

kjv_text: And whosoever doth not bear his cross, and come after me, cannot be my disciple.
bsb_text: And whoever does not carry his cross and follow Me cannot be My disciple.
aov_text: En elkeen wat sy kruis nie dra en agter My aan kom nie, kan my dissipel nie wees nie.

kjv_text: For which of you, intending to build a tower, sitteth not down first, and counteth the cost, whether he have sufficient to finish it?
bsb_text: Which of you, wishing to build a tower, does not first sit down and count the cost to see if he has the resources to complete it?
aov_text: Want wie van julle wat ’n toring wil bou, gaan nie eers sit en die koste bereken, of hy die middele het om dit uit te voer nie?  —

kjv_text: Lest haply, after he hath laid the foundation, and is not able to finish it, all that behold it begin to mock him,
bsb_text: Otherwise, if he lays the foundation and is unable to finish the work, everyone who sees it will ridicule him,
aov_text: sodat as hy die fondament gelê het en nie in staat is om dit te voltooi nie, almal wat dit sien, nie miskien met hom sal begin spot

kjv_text: Saying, This man began to build, and was not able to finish.
bsb_text: saying, ‘This man could not finish what he started to build.’
aov_text: en sê: Hierdie man het begin bou en kon nie klaarkry nie.

kjv_text: Or what king, going to make war against another king, sitteth not down first, and consulteth whether he be able with ten thousand to meet him that cometh against him with twenty thousand?
bsb_text: Or what king on his way to war with another king will not first sit down and consider whether he can engage with ten thousand men the one coming against him with twenty thousand?
aov_text: Of watter koning wat optrek om teen ’n ander koning slag te lewer, gaan nie eers sit en beraadslaag of hy in staat is om met tienduisend die een te ontmoet wat met twintigduisend teen hom kom nie?

kjv_text: Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sendeth an ambassage, and desireth conditions of peace.
bsb_text: And if he is unable, he will send a delegation while the other king is still far off, to ask for terms of peace.
aov_text: Anders stuur hy ’n gesantskap as die ander een nog ver is, en vra vredesvoorwaardes.

kjv_text: So likewise, whosoever he be of you that forsaketh not all that he hath, he cannot be my disciple.
bsb_text: In the same way, any one of you who does not give up everything he has cannot be My disciple.
aov_text: So kan dan ook niemand van julle wat nie afsien van al sy besittings, my dissipel wees nie.

kjv_text: Salt is good: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be seasoned?
bsb_text: Salt is good, but if the salt loses its savor, with what will it be seasoned?
aov_text: Die sout is goed, maar as die sout laf geword het, waarmee sal dit smaaklik gemaak word?

kjv_text: It is neither fit for the land, nor yet for the dunghill; but men cast it out. He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
bsb_text: It is fit neither for the soil nor for the manure pile, and it is thrown out. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”
aov_text: Dit is nie bruikbaar vir die grond of vir die ashoop nie. Hulle gooi dit buitekant weg. Wie ore het om te hoor, laat hom hoor.

kjv_text: Then drew near unto him all the publicans and sinners for to hear him.
bsb_text: Now all the tax collectors and sinners were gathering around to listen to Jesus.
aov_text: EN al die tollenaars en sondaars het die gewoonte gehad om na Hom te kom en na Hom te luister.

kjv_text: And the Pharisees and scribes murmured, saying, This man receiveth sinners, and eateth with them.
bsb_text: So the Pharisees and scribes began to grumble: “This man welcomes sinners and eats with them.”
aov_text: En die Fariseërs en die skrifgeleerdes het baie gemurmureer en gesê: Hierdie man ontvang sondaars en eet saam met hulle.

kjv_text: And he spake this parable unto them, saying,
bsb_text: Then Jesus told them this parable:
aov_text: Toe vertel Hy aan hulle hierdie gelykenis en sê:

kjv_text: What man of you, having an hundred sheep, if he lose one of them, doth not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness, and go after that which is lost, until he find it?
bsb_text: “What man among you, if he has a hundred sheep and loses one of them, does not leave the ninety-nine in the pasture and go after the one that is lost, until he finds it?
aov_text: Watter man onder julle wat honderd skape het en een van hulle verloor, laat nie die negen-en-negentig in die woestyn staan en gaan agter die een aan wat verlore is totdat hy dit kry nie?

kjv_text: And when he hath found it, he layeth it on his shoulders, rejoicing.
bsb_text: And when he finds it, he joyfully puts it on his shoulders,
aov_text: En as hy dit kry, sit hy dit met blydskap op sy skouers.

kjv_text: And when he cometh home, he calleth together his friends and neighbours, saying unto them, Rejoice with me; for I have found my sheep which was lost.
bsb_text: comes home, and calls together his friends and neighbors to tell them, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found my lost sheep!’
aov_text: En as hy by die huis kom, roep hy sy vriende en bure bymekaar en sê vir hulle: Wees saam met my bly, want ek het my skaap gekry wat verlore was.

kjv_text: I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.
bsb_text: In the same way, I tell you that there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents than over ninety-nine righteous ones who do not need to repent.
aov_text: Ek sê vir julle dat daar net so blydskap sal wees in die hemel oor een sondaar wat hom bekeer, meer as oor negen-en-negentig regverdiges wat die bekering nie nodig het nie.

kjv_text: Either what woman having ten pieces of silver, if she lose one piece, doth not light a candle, and sweep the house, and seek diligently till she find it?
bsb_text: Or what woman who has ten silver coins and loses one of them does not light a lamp, sweep her house, and search carefully until she finds it?
aov_text: Of watter vrou wat tien pennings het, as sy een penning verloor, steek nie ’n lamp op en vee die huis uit en soek sorgvuldig totdat sy dit kry nie?

kjv_text: And when she hath found it, she calleth her friends and her neighbours together, saying, Rejoice with me; for I have found the piece which I had lost.
bsb_text: And when she finds it, she calls together her friends and neighbors to say, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found my lost coin.’
aov_text: En as sy dit kry, roep sy haar vriendinne en buurvroue bymekaar en sê: Wees saam met my bly, want ek het die penning gekry wat ek verloor het.

kjv_text: Likewise, I say unto you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repenteth.
bsb_text: In the same way, I tell you, there is joy in the presence of God’s angels over one sinner who repents.”
aov_text: So, sê Ek vir julle, is daar blydskap voor die engele van God oor een sondaar wat hom bekeer.

kjv_text: And he said, A certain man had two sons:
bsb_text: Then Jesus said, “There was a man who had two sons.
aov_text: HY het ook gesê: ’n Man het twee seuns gehad.

kjv_text: And the younger of them said to his father, Father, give me the portion of goods that falleth to me. And he divided unto them his living.
bsb_text: The younger son said to him, ‘Father, give me my share of the estate.’ So he divided his property between them.
aov_text: En die jongste van hulle het vir sy vader gesê: Vader, gee my die deel van die eiendom wat my toekom. En hy het die goed tussen hulle verdeel.

kjv_text: And not many days after the younger son gathered all together, and took his journey into a far country, and there wasted his substance with riotous living.
bsb_text: After a few days, the younger son got everything together and journeyed to a distant country, where he squandered his wealth in wild living.
aov_text: En nie baie dae daarna nie het die jongste seun alles bymekaargemaak en weggereis na ’n ver land. En daar het hy sy eiendom verkwis deur losbandig te lewe.

kjv_text: And when he had spent all, there arose a mighty famine in that land; and he began to be in want.
bsb_text: After he had spent all he had, a severe famine swept through that country, and he began to be in need.
aov_text: En toe hy alles deurgebring het, kom daar ’n swaar hongersnood in daardie land, en hy het begin gebrek ly.

kjv_text: And he went and joined himself to a citizen of that country; and he sent him into his fields to feed swine.
bsb_text: So he went and hired himself out to a citizen of that country, who sent him into his fields to feed the pigs.
aov_text: Toe het hy hom by een van die burgers van daardie land gaan voeg. En dié het hom in sy veld gestuur om varke op te pas.

kjv_text: And he would fain have filled his belly with the husks that the swine did eat: and no man gave unto him.
bsb_text: He longed to fill his belly with the pods the pigs were eating, but no one would give him a thing.
aov_text: En hy het verlang om sy maag te vul met die peule wat die varke eet, en niemand het dit aan hom gegee nie.

kjv_text: And when he came to himself, he said, How many hired servants of my father's have bread enough and to spare, and I perish with hunger!
bsb_text: Finally he came to his senses and said, ‘How many of my father’s hired servants have plenty of food? But here I am, starving to death!
aov_text: Maar hy het tot homself gekom en gesê: Hoe baie huurlinge van my vader het oorvloed van brood, en ek vergaan van honger!

kjv_text: I will arise and go to my father, and will say unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and before thee,
bsb_text: I will get up and go back to my father and say to him, “Father, I have sinned against heaven and against you.
aov_text: Ek sal opstaan en na my vader gaan, en ek sal vir hom sê: Vader, ek het gesondig teen die hemel en voor u,

kjv_text: And am no more worthy to be called thy son: make me as one of thy hired servants.
bsb_text: I am no longer worthy to be called your son. Make me like one of your hired servants.”’
aov_text: en ek is nie meer werd om u seun genoem te word nie; maak my soos een van u huurlinge.

kjv_text: And he arose, and came to his father. But when he was yet a great way off, his father saw him, and had compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.
bsb_text: So he got up and went to his father. But while he was still in the distance, his father saw him and was filled with compassion. He ran to his son, embraced him, and kissed him.
aov_text: En hy het opgestaan en na sy vader gegaan. En toe hy nog ver was, het sy vader hom gesien en innig jammer vir hom gevoel en gehardloop en hom omhels en hartlik gesoen.

kjv_text: And the son said unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in thy sight, and am no more worthy to be called thy son.
bsb_text: The son declared, ‘Father, I have sinned against heaven and against you. I am no longer worthy to be called your son.’
aov_text: En die seun sê vir hom: Vader, ek het gesondig teen die hemel en voor u en ek is nie meer werd om u seun genoem te word nie.

kjv_text: But the father said to his servants, Bring forth the best robe, and put it on him; and put a ring on his hand, and shoes on his feet:
bsb_text: But the father said to his servants, ‘Quick! Bring the best robe and put it on him. Put a ring on his finger and sandals on his feet.
aov_text: Maar die vader sê vir sy diensknegte: Bring die beste kleed en trek hom dit aan, en gee ’n ring vir sy hand en skoene vir sy voete.

kjv_text: And bring hither the fatted calf, and kill it; and let us eat, and be merry:
bsb_text: Bring the fattened calf and kill it. Let us feast and celebrate.
aov_text: En bring die vetgemaakte kalf en slag dit, en laat ons eet en vrolik wees.

kjv_text: For this my son was dead, and is alive again; he was lost, and is found. And they began to be merry.
bsb_text: For this son of mine was dead and is alive again! He was lost and is found!’ So they began to celebrate.
aov_text: Want hierdie seun van my was dood en het weer lewendig geword; en hy was verlore en is gevind. En hulle het begin vrolik word.

kjv_text: Now his elder son was in the field: and as he came and drew nigh to the house, he heard musick and dancing.
bsb_text: Meanwhile the older son was in the field, and as he approached the house, he heard music and dancing.
aov_text: En sy oudste seun was in die veld, en terwyl hy al nader na die huis kom, hoor hy musiek en beurtsange.

kjv_text: And he called one of the servants, and asked what these things meant.
bsb_text: So he called one of the servants and asked what was going on.
aov_text: En hy roep een van die diensknegte na hom toe en vra wat dit beteken.

kjv_text: And he said unto him, Thy brother is come; and thy father hath killed the fatted calf, because he hath received him safe and sound.
bsb_text: ‘Your brother has returned,’ he said, ‘and your father has killed the fattened calf, because he has him back safe and sound.’
aov_text: Dié sê toe vir hom: U broer het gekom, en u vader het die vetgemaakte kalf geslag, omdat hy hom gesond teruggekry het.

kjv_text: And he was angry, and would not go in: therefore came his father out, and intreated him.
bsb_text: The older son became angry and refused to go in. So his father came out and pleaded with him.
aov_text: En hy het kwaad geword en wou nie binnegaan nie. Sy vader gaan toe uit en smeek hom.

kjv_text: And he answering said to his father, Lo, these many years do I serve thee, neither transgressed I at any time thy commandment: and yet thou never gavest me a kid, that I might make merry with my friends:
bsb_text: But he answered his father, ‘Look, all these years I have served you and never disobeyed a commandment of yours. Yet you never gave me even a young goat so I could celebrate with my friends.
aov_text: Maar hy antwoord en sê vir sy vader: Kyk, ek dien u so baie jare en ek het nooit u gebod oortree nie, en vir my het u nooit ’n bokkie gegee, sodat ek saam met my vriende vrolik kon wees nie.

kjv_text: But as soon as this thy son was come, which hath devoured thy living with harlots, thou hast killed for him the fatted calf.
bsb_text: But when this son of yours returns from squandering your wealth with prostitutes, you kill the fattened calf for him!’
aov_text: Maar toe hierdie seun van u kom, wat u goed met hoere deurgebring het, het u vir hom die vetgemaakte kalf geslag.

kjv_text: And he said unto him, Son, thou art ever with me, and all that I have is thine.
bsb_text: ‘Son, you are always with me,’ the father said, ‘and all that is mine is yours.
aov_text: Toe sê hy vir hom: Kind, jy is altyd by my, en al wat myne is, is joue.

kjv_text: It was meet that we should make merry, and be glad: for this thy brother was dead, and is alive again; and was lost, and is found.
bsb_text: But it was fitting to celebrate and be glad, because this brother of yours was dead and is alive again; he was lost and is found.’”
aov_text: Ons moet tog vrolik en bly wees, want hierdie broer van jou was dood en het weer lewendig geword, en hy was verlore en is gevind.

kjv_text: And he said also unto his disciples, There was a certain rich man, which had a steward; and the same was accused unto him that he had wasted his goods.
bsb_text: Jesus also said to His disciples, “There was a rich man whose manager was accused of wasting his possessions.
aov_text: EN Hy het ook aan sy dissipels gesê: Daar was ’n ryk man wat ’n bestuurder gehad het; en hy is by hom aangeklaag as een wat sy besittings verkwis.

kjv_text: And he called him, and said unto him, How is it that I hear this of thee? give an account of thy stewardship; for thou mayest be no longer steward.
bsb_text: So he called him in to ask, ‘What is this I hear about you? Turn in an account of your management, for you cannot be manager any longer.’
aov_text: En hy het hom geroep en vir hom gesê: Wat is dit wat ek van jou hoor? Gee verslag van jou bestuur van sake; want jy sal nie meer bestuurder kan wees nie.

kjv_text: Then the steward said within himself, What shall I do? for my lord taketh away from me the stewardship: I cannot dig; to beg I am ashamed.
bsb_text: The manager said to himself, ‘What shall I do, now that my master is taking away my position? I am too weak to dig and too ashamed to beg.
aov_text: Toe sê die bestuurder by homself: Wat sal ek doen? Want my heer neem die bestuurderskap van my weg. Spit kan ek nie; om te bedel, skaam ek my.

kjv_text: I am resolved what to do, that, when I am put out of the stewardship, they may receive me into their houses.
bsb_text: I know what I will do, so that after my removal from management, people will welcome me into their homes.’
aov_text: Ek weet wat ek sal doen, sodat wanneer ek van die bestuurderskap afgesit is, hulle my in hulle huise kan ontvang.

kjv_text: So he called every one of his lord's debtors unto him, and said unto the first, How much owest thou unto my lord?
bsb_text: And he called in each one of his master’s debtors. ‘How much do you owe my master?’ he asked the first.
aov_text: Toe roep hy die skuldenaars van sy heer, een vir een, en sê vir die eerste: Hoeveel skuld jy aan my heer?

kjv_text: And he said, An hundred measures of oil. And he said unto him, Take thy bill, and sit down quickly, and write fifty.
bsb_text: ‘A hundred measures of olive oil,’ he answered. ‘Take your bill,’ said the manager. ‘Sit down quickly, and write fifty.’
aov_text: En hy antwoord: Honderd vat olie. En hy sê vir hom: Neem jou skuldbewys, gaan sit en skryf gou vyftig.

kjv_text: Then said he to another, And how much owest thou? And he said, An hundred measures of wheat. And he said unto him, Take thy bill, and write fourscore.
bsb_text: Then he asked another, ‘And how much do you owe?’ ‘A hundred measures of wheat,’ he replied. ‘Take your bill and write eighty,’ he told him.
aov_text: Daarna sê hy vir ’n ander een: En jy, hoeveel skuld jy? En hy antwoord: Honderd mud koring. Toe sê hy vir hom: Neem jou skuldbewys en skryf tagtig.

kjv_text: And the lord commended the unjust steward, because he had done wisely: for the children of this world are in their generation wiser than the children of light.
bsb_text: The master commended the dishonest manager because he had acted shrewdly. For the sons of this age are more shrewd in dealing with their own kind than are the sons of light.
aov_text: En die heer het die onregverdige bestuurder geprys, omdat hy verstandig gehandel het; want die kinders van hierdie wêreld is verstandiger teenoor hulle geslag as die kinders van die lig.

kjv_text: And I say unto you, Make to yourselves friends of the mammon of unrighteousness; that, when ye fail, they may receive you into everlasting habitations.
bsb_text: I tell you, use worldly wealth to make friends for yourselves, so that when it is gone, they will welcome you into eternal dwellings.
aov_text: En Ek sê vir julle: Maak vir julle vriende deur die onregverdige Mammon, sodat wanneer julle die lewe verlaat, hulle jul in die ewige tente kan ontvang.

kjv_text: He that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in much: and he that is unjust in the least is unjust also in much.
bsb_text: Whoever is faithful with very little will also be faithful with much, and whoever is dishonest with very little will also be dishonest with much.
aov_text: Hy wat getrou is in die minste, is ook in die grote getrou; en hy wat onregverdig is in die minste, is ook in die grote onregverdig.

kjv_text: If therefore ye have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?
bsb_text: So if you have not been faithful with worldly wealth, who will entrust you with true riches?
aov_text: As julle dan nie getrou was in die onregverdige Mammon nie, wie sal julle die ware goed toevertrou?

kjv_text: And if ye have not been faithful in that which is another man's, who shall give you that which is your own?
bsb_text: And if you have not been faithful with the belongings of another, who will give you belongings of your own?
aov_text: En as julle nie getrou was in ’n ander se goed nie, wie sal aan julle jul eie gee?

kjv_text: No servant can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.
bsb_text: No servant can serve two masters. Either he will hate the one and love the other, or he will be devoted to the one and despise the other. You cannot serve both God and money.”
aov_text: Geen huiskneg kan twee here dien nie; want hy sal òf die een haat en die ander een liefhê, òf die een aanhang en die ander een verag. Julle kan nie God én Mammon dien nie.

kjv_text: And the Pharisees also, who were covetous, heard all these things: and they derided him.
bsb_text: The Pharisees, who were lovers of money, heard all of this and were scoffing at Jesus.
aov_text: EN die Fariseërs, wat geldgierig was, het ook al hierdie dinge gehoor en Hom beskimp.

kjv_text: And he said unto them, Ye are they which justify yourselves before men; but God knoweth your hearts: for that which is highly esteemed among men is abomination in the sight of God.
bsb_text: So He said to them, “You are the ones who justify yourselves before men, but God knows your hearts. For what is prized among men is detestable before God.
aov_text: En Hy het vir hulle gesê: Dit is julle wat julself regverdig voor die mense, maar God ken julle harte; want wat by die mens hoog geag word, is ’n gruwel voor God.

kjv_text: The law and the prophets were until John: since that time the kingdom of God is preached, and every man presseth into it.
bsb_text: The Law and the Prophets were proclaimed until John. Since that time, the gospel of the kingdom of God is being preached, and everyone is forcing his way into it.
aov_text: Die wet en die profete was tot op Johannes; van toe af word die evangelie van die koninkryk van God verkondig, en elkeen dring met geweld daarin.

kjv_text: And it is easier for heaven and earth to pass, than one tittle of the law to fail.
bsb_text: But it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away than for a single stroke of a pen to drop out of the Law.
aov_text: Maar dit is makliker dat die hemel en die aarde verbygaan as dat een tittel van die wet sou val.

kjv_text: Whosoever putteth away his wife, and marrieth another, committeth adultery: and whosoever marrieth her that is put away from her husband committeth adultery.
bsb_text: Anyone who divorces his wife and marries another woman commits adultery, and he who marries a divorced woman commits adultery.
aov_text: Elkeen wat van sy vrou skei en ’n ander een trou, pleeg egbreuk; en elkeen wat trou met die vrou wat van haar man geskei is, pleeg egbreuk.

kjv_text: There was a certain rich man, which was clothed in purple and fine linen, and fared sumptuously every day:
bsb_text: Now there was a rich man dressed in purple and fine linen, who lived each day in joyous splendor.
aov_text: EN daar was ’n ryk man, en hy het purper en fyn linne gedra en elke dag vrolik en weelderig gelewe.

kjv_text: And there was a certain beggar named Lazarus, which was laid at his gate, full of sores,
bsb_text: And a beggar named Lazarus lay at his gate, covered with sores
aov_text: En daar was ’n bedelaar met die naam van Lasarus wat vol swere voor sy poort gelê het.

kjv_text: And desiring to be fed with the crumbs which fell from the rich man's table: moreover the dogs came and licked his sores.
bsb_text: and longing to be fed with the crumbs that fell from the rich man’s table. Even the dogs came and licked his sores.
aov_text: En hy het verlang om hom te versadig met die krummels wat van die ryk man se tafel val. Ja, selfs die honde het gekom en sy swere gelek.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, that the beggar died, and was carried by the angels into Abraham's bosom:
bsb_text: One day the beggar died and was carried by the angels to Abraham's side.
aov_text: En toe die bedelaar sterf, is hy deur die engele weggedra na die boesem van Abraham.

kjv_text: the rich man also died, and was buried;
bsb_text: And the rich man also died and was buried.
aov_text: En die ryk man het ook gesterwe en is begrawe.

kjv_text: And in hell he lift up his eyes, being in torments, and seeth Abraham afar off, and Lazarus in his bosom.
bsb_text: In Hades, where he was in torment, he looked up and saw Abraham from afar, with Lazarus by his side.
aov_text: En toe hy in die doderyk sy oë ophef, terwyl hy in smarte was, sien hy Abraham van ver af en Lasarus aan sy boesem.

kjv_text: And he cried and said, Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water, and cool my tongue; for I am tormented in this flame.
bsb_text: So he cried out, ‘Father Abraham, have mercy on me and send Lazarus to dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue. For I am in agony in this fire.’
aov_text: En hy roep en sê: Vader Abraham, wees my barmhartig en stuur Lasarus, dat hy die punt van sy vinger in water kan insteek en my tong verkoel; want ek ly smarte in hierdie vlam.

kjv_text: But Abraham said, Son, remember that thou in thy lifetime receivedst thy good things, and likewise Lazarus evil things: but now he is comforted, and thou art tormented.
bsb_text: But Abraham answered, ‘Child, remember that during your lifetime you received your good things, while Lazarus received bad things. But now he is comforted here, while you are in agony.
aov_text: Maar Abraham antwoord: Kind, onthou dat jy jou goeie dinge in jou lewe ontvang het, en so ook Lasarus die slegte. En nou word hy getroos, maar jy ly smarte.

kjv_text: And beside all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed: so that they which would pass from hence to you cannot; neither can they pass to us, that would come from thence.
bsb_text: And besides all this, a great chasm has been fixed between us and you, so that even those who wish cannot cross from here to you, nor can anyone cross from there to us.’
aov_text: En by dit alles is daar tussen ons en julle ’n groot kloof gevestig, sodat die wat hiervandaan wil oorgaan na julle, nie kan nie; en die wat dáár is, nie na ons kan oorkom nie.

kjv_text: Then he said, I pray thee therefore, father, that thou wouldest send him to my father's house:
bsb_text: ‘Then I beg you, father,’ he said, ‘send Lazarus to my father’s house,
aov_text: En hy sê: Ek bid u dan, vader, om hom na my vader se huis te stuur  —

kjv_text: For I have five brethren; that he may testify unto them, lest they also come into this place of torment.
bsb_text: for I have five brothers. Let him warn them, so that they will not also end up in this place of torment.’
aov_text: want ek het vyf broers — om hulle dringend te waarsku, sodat hulle nie ook in hierdie plek van pyniging kom nie.

kjv_text: Abraham saith unto him, They have Moses and the prophets; let them hear them.
bsb_text: But Abraham replied, ‘They have Moses and the prophets; let your brothers listen to them.’
aov_text: Toe sê Abraham vir hom: Hulle het Moses en die Profete; laat hulle na dié luister.

kjv_text: And he said, Nay, father Abraham: but if one went unto them from the dead, they will repent.
bsb_text: ‘No, father Abraham,’ he said, ‘but if someone is sent to them from the dead, they will repent.’
aov_text: Maar hy antwoord: Nee, vader Abraham, maar as iemand uit die dode na hulle gaan, sal hulle hul bekeer.

kjv_text: And he said unto him, If they hear not Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded, though one rose from the dead.
bsb_text: Then Abraham said to him, ‘If they do not listen to Moses and the prophets, they will not be persuaded even if someone rises from the dead.’”
aov_text: Maar hy sê vir hom: As hulle na Moses en die Profete nie luister nie, sal hulle nie oortuig word nie, al sou iemand ook uit die dode opstaan.

kjv_text: Then said he unto the disciples, It is impossible but that offences will come: but woe unto him, through whom they come!
bsb_text: Jesus said to His disciples, “It is inevitable that stumbling blocks will come, but woe to the one through whom they come!
aov_text: EN Hy het vir sy dissipels gesê: Dit is onvermydelik dat die struikelblokke kom, maar wee hom deur wie hulle kom.

kjv_text: It were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he cast into the sea, than that he should offend one of these little ones.
bsb_text: It would be better for him to have a millstone hung around his neck and to be thrown into the sea than to cause one of these little ones to stumble.
aov_text: Dit is beter vir hom as ’n meulsteen aan sy nek gehang en hy in die see gegooi word, as dat hy een van hierdie kleintjies sou laat struikel.

kjv_text: Take heed to yourselves: If thy brother trespass against thee, rebuke him; and if he repent, forgive him.
bsb_text: Watch yourselves. If your brother sins, rebuke him; and if he repents, forgive him.
aov_text: Pas op vir julleself. En as jou broeder teen jou sondig, bestraf hom; en as hy berou kry, vergewe hom.

kjv_text: And if he trespass against thee seven times in a day, and seven times in a day turn again to thee, saying, I repent; thou shalt forgive him.
bsb_text: Even if he sins against you seven times in a day, and seven times returns to say, ‘I repent,’ you must forgive him.”
aov_text: En as hy sewe maal op ’n dag teen jou sondig en sewe maal op ’n dag na jou terugkom en sê: Ek het berou — moet jy hom vergewe.

kjv_text: And the apostles said unto the Lord, Increase our faith.
bsb_text: The apostles said to the Lord, “Increase our faith!”
aov_text: Toe het die apostels aan die Here gesê: Gee ons meer geloof.

kjv_text: And the Lord said, If ye had faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye might say unto this sycamine tree, Be thou plucked up by the root, and be thou planted in the sea; and it should obey you.
bsb_text: And the Lord answered, “If you have faith the size of a mustard seed, you can say to this mulberry tree, ‘Be uprooted and planted in the sea,’ and it will obey you.
aov_text: En die Here sê: As julle geloof gehad het soos ’n mosterdsaad, sou julle vir hierdie moerbeiboom sê: Word ontwortel en in die see geplant — en hy sou julle gehoorsaam wees.

kjv_text: But which of you, having a servant plowing or feeding cattle, will say unto him by and by, when he is come from the field, Go and sit down to meat?
bsb_text: Which of you whose servant comes in from plowing or shepherding in the field will say to him, ‘Come at once and sit down to eat’?
aov_text: En wie is daar van julle wat ’n dienskneg het wat ploeg of vee oppas, en as hy inkom van die veld vir hom sal sê: Kom dadelik hier aan tafel?

kjv_text: And will not rather say unto him, Make ready wherewith I may sup, and gird thyself, and serve me, till I have eaten and drunken; and afterward thou shalt eat and drink?
bsb_text: Instead, won’t he tell him, ‘Prepare my meal and dress yourself to serve me while I eat and drink; and afterward you may eat and drink’?
aov_text: Sal hy nie eerder vir hom sê nie: Maak vir my die aandete klaar en omgord jou en bedien my totdat ek geëet en gedrink het; en daarna kan jy eet en drink?

kjv_text: Doth he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded him? I trow not.
bsb_text: Does he thank the servant because he did what he was told?
aov_text: Bedank hy daardie dienskneg, omdat hy gedoen het wat hom beveel is? Ek glo nie.

kjv_text: So likewise ye, when ye shall have done all those things which are commanded you, say, We are unprofitable servants: we have done that which was our duty to do.
bsb_text: So you also, when you have done everything commanded of you, should say, ‘We are unworthy servants; we have only done our duty.’”
aov_text: So ook julle, wanneer julle alles gedoen het wat julle beveel is, sê dan: Ons is onverdienstelike diensknegte, want ons het gedoen wat ons verplig was om te doen.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, as he went to Jerusalem, that he passed through the midst of Samaria and Galilee.
bsb_text: While Jesus was on His way to Jerusalem, He was passing between Samaria and Galilee.
aov_text: EN op sy reis na Jerusalem het Hy deur Samaría en Galiléa gegaan.

kjv_text: And as he entered into a certain village, there met him ten men that were lepers, which stood afar off:
bsb_text: As He entered one of the villages, He was met by ten lepers. They stood at a distance
aov_text: En toe Hy in ’n sekere dorp ingaan, kom tien melaatse manne Hom tegemoet, wat op ’n afstand bly staan het.

kjv_text: And they lifted up their voices, and said, Jesus, Master, have mercy on us.
bsb_text: and raised their voices, shouting, “Jesus, Master, have mercy on us!”
aov_text: En hulle het hul stem verhef en gesê: Jesus, Meester, wees ons barmhartig!

kjv_text: And when he saw them, he said unto them, Go shew yourselves unto the priests. And it came to pass, that, as they went, they were cleansed.
bsb_text: When Jesus saw them, He said, “Go, show yourselves to the priests.” And as they were on their way, they were cleansed.
aov_text: En toe Hy hulle sien, sê Hy vir hulle: Gaan vertoon julle aan die priesters. En onderwyl hulle weggaan, het hulle rein geword.

kjv_text: And one of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, and with a loud voice glorified God,
bsb_text: When one of them saw that he was healed, he came back, praising God in a loud voice.
aov_text: En een van hulle, toe hy sien dat hy gesond was, het omgedraai en God met ’n groot stem verheerlik.

kjv_text: And fell down on his face at his feet, giving him thanks: and he was a Samaritan.
bsb_text: He fell facedown at Jesus’ feet in thanksgiving to Him—and he was a Samaritan.
aov_text: En hy het op sy aangesig neergeval by sy voete en Hom gedank. En hy was ’n Samaritaan.

kjv_text: And Jesus answering said, Were there not ten cleansed? but where are the nine?
bsb_text: “Were not all ten cleansed?” Jesus asked. “Where then are the other nine?
aov_text: Toe antwoord Jesus en sê: Het tien nie rein geword nie? En waar is die nege?

kjv_text: There are not found that returned to give glory to God, save this stranger.
bsb_text: Was no one found except this foreigner to return and give glory to God?”
aov_text: Was daar niemand onder hulle te vinde wat omgedraai het om God te verheerlik behalwe hierdie vreemdeling nie?

kjv_text: And he said unto him, Arise, go thy way: thy faith hath made thee whole.
bsb_text: Then Jesus said to him, “Rise and go; your faith has made you well!”
aov_text: En Hy sê vir hom: Staan op en gaan; jou geloof het jou gered.

kjv_text: And when he was demanded of the Pharisees, when the kingdom of God should come, he answered them and said, The kingdom of God cometh not with observation:
bsb_text: When asked by the Pharisees when the kingdom of God would come, Jesus replied, “The kingdom of God will not come with observable signs.
aov_text: EN toe Hy deur die Fariseërs gevra is wanneer die koninkryk van God sal kom, het Hy hulle geantwoord en gesê: Die koninkryk van God kom nie met sigbare tekens nie.

kjv_text: Neither shall they say, Lo here! or, lo there! for, behold, the kingdom of God is within you.
bsb_text: Nor will people say, ‘Look, here it is,’ or ‘There it is.’ For you see, the kingdom of God is in your midst.”
aov_text: En hulle sal nie sê: Kyk hier! of: Kyk daar! nie; want die koninkryk van God is binne-in julle.

kjv_text: And he said unto the disciples, The days will come, when ye shall desire to see one of the days of the Son of man, and ye shall not see it.
bsb_text: Then He said to the disciples, “The time is coming when you will long to see one of the days of the Son of Man, but you will not see it.
aov_text: En Hy sê vir sy dissipels: Daar sal dae kom wanneer julle sal begeer om een van die dae van die Seun van die mens te sien, en julle sal dit nie sien nie.

kjv_text: And they shall say to you, See here; or, see there: go not after them, nor follow them.
bsb_text: People will tell you, ‘Look, there He is!’ or ‘Look, here He is!’ Do not go out or chase after them.
aov_text: En hulle sal vir julle sê: Kyk hier! of: Kyk daar! Moenie gaan nie en moenie agterna loop nie.

kjv_text: For as the lightning, that lighteneth out of the one part under heaven, shineth unto the other part under heaven; so shall also the Son of man be in his day.
bsb_text: For just as the lightning flashes and lights up the sky from one end to the other, so will be the Son of Man in His day.
aov_text: Want soos die weerlig wat van die een kant onder die hemel blits en tot by die ander kant onder die hemel skyn, so sal die Seun van die mens ook in sy dag wees.

kjv_text: But first must he suffer many things, and be rejected of this generation.
bsb_text: But first He must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.
aov_text: Maar eers moet Hy baie ly en deur hierdie geslag verwerp word.

kjv_text: And as it was in the days of Noe, so shall it be also in the days of the Son of man.
bsb_text: Just as it was in the days of Noah, so also will it be in the days of the Son of Man:
aov_text: En soos dit gebeur het in die dae van Noag, so sal dit ook wees in die dae van die Seun van die mens:

kjv_text: They did eat, they drank, they married wives, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark, and the flood came, and destroyed them all.
bsb_text: People were eating and drinking, marrying and being given in marriage, up to the day Noah entered the ark. Then the flood came and destroyed them all.
aov_text: hulle het geëet en gedrink, hulle het getrou en is in die huwelik gegee tot op die dag dat Noag in die ark ingegaan het, en die sondvloed gekom en almal vernietig het.

kjv_text: Likewise also as it was in the days of Lot; they did eat, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they builded;
bsb_text: It was the same in the days of Lot: People were eating and drinking, buying and selling, planting and building.
aov_text: Net soos dit ook gebeur het in die dae van Lot: hulle het geëet en gedrink, gekoop en verkoop, hulle het geplant en gebou.

kjv_text: But the same day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven, and destroyed them all.
bsb_text: But on the day Lot left Sodom, fire and sulfur rained down from heaven and destroyed them all.
aov_text: Maar op die dag toe Lot van Sodom uitgaan, het vuur en swawel van die hemel af gereën en almal vernietig.

kjv_text: Even thus shall it be in the day when the Son of man is revealed.
bsb_text: It will be just like that on the day the Son of Man is revealed.
aov_text: Net so sal dit wees in die dag wanneer die Seun van die mens geopenbaar word.

kjv_text: In that day, he which shall be upon the housetop, and his stuff in the house, let him not come down to take it away: and he that is in the field, let him likewise not return back.
bsb_text: On that day, let no one on the housetop come down to retrieve his possessions. Likewise, let no one in the field return for anything he has left behind.
aov_text: In daardie dag moet hy wat op die dak sal wees, terwyl sy huisraad in die huis is, nie afkom om dit weg te neem nie; en so ook moet hy wat op die land sal wees, nie omdraai na wat agter is nie.

kjv_text: Remember Lot's wife.
bsb_text: Remember Lot’s wife!
aov_text: Dink aan die vrou van Lot!

kjv_text: Whosoever shall seek to save his life shall lose it; and whosoever shall lose his life shall preserve it.
bsb_text: Whoever tries to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life will preserve it.
aov_text: Elkeen wat probeer om sy lewe te red, sal dit verloor; en elkeen wat dit verloor, sal dit behou.

kjv_text: I tell you, in that night there shall be two men in one bed; the one shall be taken, and the other shall be left.
bsb_text: I tell you, on that night two people will be in one bed: one will be taken and the other left.
aov_text: Ek sê vir julle: In daardie nag sal daar twee op een bed wees; die een sal aangeneem en die ander verlaat word.

kjv_text: Two women shall be grinding together; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
bsb_text: Two women will be grinding grain together: one will be taken and the other left.”
aov_text: Twee vroue sal saam maal; die een sal aangeneem en die ander verlaat word.

kjv_text: Two men shall be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
aov_text: Twee sal op die land wees; die een sal aangeneem en die ander verlaat word.

kjv_text: And they answered and said unto him, Where, Lord? And he said unto them, Wheresoever the body is, thither will the eagles be gathered together.
bsb_text: “Where, Lord?” they asked. Jesus answered, “Wherever there is a carcass, there the vultures will gather.”
aov_text: En hulle antwoord en sê vir Hom: Waar, Here? En Hy sê vir hulle: Waar die liggaam lê, daar sal die aasvoëls saamkom.

kjv_text: And he spake a parable unto them to this end, that men ought always to pray, and not to faint;
bsb_text: Then Jesus told them a parable about their need to pray at all times and not lose heart:
aov_text: EN Hy het ook aan hulle ’n gelykenis vertel met die oog daarop dat ’n mens gedurig moet bid en nie moedeloos word nie,

kjv_text: Saying, There was in a city a judge, which feared not God, neither regarded man:
bsb_text: “In a certain town there was a judge who neither feared God nor respected men.
aov_text: en gesê: Daar was ’n regter in ’n stad wat God nie gevrees en geen mens ontsien het nie.

kjv_text: And there was a widow in that city; and she came unto him, saying, Avenge me of mine adversary.
bsb_text: And there was a widow in that town who kept appealing to him, ‘Give me justice against my adversary.’
aov_text: En daar was in daardie stad ’n weduwee, en sy het gedurig na hom gekom en gesê: Doen reg aan my teenoor my teëparty.

kjv_text: And he would not for a while: but afterward he said within himself, Though I fear not God, nor regard man;
bsb_text: For a while he refused, but later he said to himself, ‘Though I neither fear God nor respect men,
aov_text: En ’n tyd lank wou hy nie; maar daarna het hy by homself gesê: Al vrees ek God ook nie en al ontsien ek geen mens nie,

kjv_text: Yet because this widow troubleth me, I will avenge her, lest by her continual coming she weary me.
bsb_text: yet because this widow keeps pestering me, I will give her justice. Then she will stop wearing me out with her perpetual requests.’”
aov_text: tog sal ek, omdat hierdie weduwee my moeite gee, aan haar reg doen, sodat sy nie eindelik kom en my in die gesig slaan nie.

kjv_text: And the Lord said, Hear what the unjust judge saith.
bsb_text: And the Lord said, “Listen to the words of the unjust judge.
aov_text: Toe sê die Here: Hoor wat die onregverdige regter sê.

kjv_text: And shall not God avenge his own elect, which cry day and night unto him, though he bear long with them?
bsb_text: Will not God bring about justice for His elect who cry out to Him day and night? Will He continue to defer their help?
aov_text: Sal God dan nie reg doen aan sy uitverkorenes wat dag en nag tot Hom roep nie, al is Hy ook lankmoedig in hulle geval?

kjv_text: I tell you that he will avenge them speedily. Nevertheless when the Son of man cometh, shall he find faith on the earth?
bsb_text: I tell you, He will promptly carry out justice on their behalf. Nevertheless, when the Son of Man comes, will He find faith on earth?”
aov_text: Ek sê vir julle dat Hy gou aan hulle reg sal doen; maar as die Seun van die mens kom, sal Hy wel die geloof op die aarde vind?

kjv_text: And he spake this parable unto certain which trusted in themselves that they were righteous, and despised others:
bsb_text: To some who trusted in their own righteousness and viewed others with contempt, He also told this parable:
aov_text: EN Hy het ook met die oog op sommige wat op hulleself vertrou dat hulle regverdig is en die ander verag, hierdie gelykenis vertel.

kjv_text: Two men went up into the temple to pray; the one a Pharisee, and the other a publican.
bsb_text: “Two men went up to the temple to pray. One was a Pharisee and the other a tax collector.
aov_text: Twee manne het na die tempel opgegaan om te bid, die een ’n Fariseër en die ander ’n tollenaar.

kjv_text: The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself, God, I thank thee, that I am not as other men are, extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even as this publican.
bsb_text: The Pharisee stood by himself and prayed, ‘God, I thank You that I am not like the other men—swindlers, evildoers, adulterers—or even like this tax collector.
aov_text: En die Fariseër het gaan staan en by homself so gebid: o God, ek dank U dat ek nie soos die ander mense is nie — rowers, onregverdiges, egbrekers, of ook soos hierdie tollenaar nie.

kjv_text: I fast twice in the week, I give tithes of all that I possess.
bsb_text: I fast twice a week and pay tithes of all that I acquire.’
aov_text: Ek vas twee keer in die week, ek gee tiendes van alles wat ek verkry.

kjv_text: And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, God be merciful to me a sinner.
bsb_text: But the tax collector stood at a distance, unwilling even to lift up his eyes to heaven. Instead, he beat his breast and said, ‘God, have mercy on me, a sinner!’
aov_text: En die tollenaar het ver weg gestaan en wou selfs nie sy oë na die hemel ophef nie, maar het op sy bors geslaan en gesê: o God, wees my, sondaar, genadig!

kjv_text: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other: for every one that exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.
bsb_text: I tell you, this man, rather than the Pharisee, went home justified. For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, but the one who humbles himself will be exalted.”
aov_text: Ek sê vir julle, hierdie laaste een het geregverdig na sy huis gegaan eerder as die eerste een; want elkeen wat homself verhoog, sal verneder word, en hy wat homself verneder, sal verhoog word.

kjv_text: And they brought unto him also infants, that he would touch them: but when his disciples saw it, they rebuked them.
bsb_text: Now people were even bringing their babies to Jesus for Him to place His hands on them. And when the disciples saw this, they rebuked those who brought them.
aov_text: EN hulle het ook die klein kindertjies na Hom gebring, sodat Hy hulle kon aanraak; en toe die dissipels dit sien, het hulle hul bestraf.

kjv_text: But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Suffer little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.
bsb_text: But Jesus called the children to Him and said, “Let the little children come to Me, and do not hinder them! For the kingdom of God belongs to such as these.
aov_text: Maar Jesus het hulle na Hom geroep en gesê: Laat die kindertjies na My toe kom en verhinder hulle nie, want aan sulkes behoort die koninkryk van God.

kjv_text: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child shall in no wise enter therein.
bsb_text: Truly I tell you, anyone who does not receive the kingdom of God like a little child will never enter it.”
aov_text: Voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, elkeen wat die koninkryk van God nie soos ’n kindjie ontvang nie, sal daar nooit ingaan nie.

kjv_text: And a certain ruler asked him, saying, Good Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?
bsb_text: Then a certain ruler asked Him, “Good Teacher, what must I do to inherit eternal life?”
aov_text: EN ’n sekere owerste vra Hom en sê: Goeie Meester, wat moet ek doen om die ewige lewe te beërwe?

kjv_text: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? none is good, save one, that is, God.
bsb_text: “Why do you call Me good?” Jesus replied. “No one is good except God alone.
aov_text: En Jesus antwoord hom: Waarom noem jy My goed? Niemand is goed nie behalwe een, naamlik God.

kjv_text: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Honour thy father and thy mother.
bsb_text: You know the commandments: ‘Do not commit adultery, do not murder, do not steal, do not bear false witness, honor your father and mother.’”
aov_text: Jy ken die gebooie: Jy mag nie egbreek nie; jy mag nie doodslaan nie; jy mag nie steel nie; jy mag geen valse getuienis gee nie; eer jou vader en jou moeder.

kjv_text: And he said, All these have I kept from my youth up.
bsb_text: “All these I have kept from my youth,” he said.
aov_text: En hy sê: Al hierdie dinge het ek onderhou van my jeug af.

kjv_text: Now when Jesus heard these things, he said unto him, Yet lackest thou one thing: sell all that thou hast, and distribute unto the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, follow me.
bsb_text: On hearing this, Jesus told him, “You still lack one thing: Sell everything you own and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow Me.”
aov_text: En toe Jesus dit hoor, antwoord Hy hom: Nog een ding ontbreek jou — verkoop alles wat jy het, en verdeel dit onder die armes, en jy sal ’n skat in die hemel hê; kom dan hier, volg My.

kjv_text: And when he heard this, he was very sorrowful: for he was very rich.
bsb_text: But when the ruler heard this, he became very sad, because he was extremely wealthy.
aov_text: Toe hy dit hoor, het hy diep bedroef geword, want hy was baie ryk.

kjv_text: And when Jesus saw that he was very sorrowful, he said, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!
bsb_text: Seeing the man’s sadness, Jesus said, “How hard it is for the rich to enter the kingdom of God!
aov_text: En toe Jesus sien dat hy diep bedroef geword het, sê Hy: Hoe beswaarlik sal hulle wat goed besit, in die koninkryk van God ingaan.

kjv_text: For it is easier for a camel to go through a needle's eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
bsb_text: Indeed, it is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God.”
aov_text: Want dit is makliker vir ’n kameel om deur die oog van ’n naald te gaan as vir ’n ryk man om in die koninkryk van God in te gaan.

kjv_text: And they that heard it said, Who then can be saved?
bsb_text: Those who heard this asked, “Who then can be saved?”
aov_text: Daarop sê die wat dit gehoor het: Wie kan dan gered word?

kjv_text: And he said, The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.
bsb_text: But Jesus said, “What is impossible with man is possible with God.”
aov_text: Maar Hy antwoord: Die dinge wat by mense onmoontlik is, is by God moontlik.

kjv_text: Then Peter said, Lo, we have left all, and followed thee.
bsb_text: “Look,” said Peter, “we have left all we had to follow You.”
aov_text: Toe sê Petrus: Kyk, ons het alles verlaat en U gevolg.

kjv_text: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or parents, or brethren, or wife, or children, for the kingdom of God's sake,
bsb_text: “Truly I tell you,” Jesus replied, “no one who has left home or wife or brothers or parents or children for the sake of the kingdom of God
aov_text: En Hy sê vir hulle: Voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, daar is niemand wat huis of ouers of broers of vrou of kinders verlaat het ter wille van die koninkryk van God,

kjv_text: Who shall not receive manifold more in this present time, and in the world to come life everlasting.
bsb_text: will fail to receive many times more in this age—and in the age to come, eternal life.”
aov_text: wat nie baiemaal soveel in hierdie tyd sal ontvang nie en die ewige lewe in die eeu wat kom.

kjv_text: Then he took unto him the twelve, and said unto them, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem, and all things that are written by the prophets concerning the Son of man shall be accomplished.
bsb_text: Then Jesus took the Twelve aside and said to them, “Look, we are going up to Jerusalem, and everything the prophets have written about the Son of Man will be fulfilled.
aov_text: EN Hy het die twaalf by Hom geneem en vir hulle gesê: Kyk, ons gaan op na Jerusalem, en alles wat deur die profete geskrywe is, sal aan die Seun van die mens vervul word.

kjv_text: For he shall be delivered unto the Gentiles, and shall be mocked, and spitefully entreated, and spitted on:
bsb_text: He will be delivered over to the Gentiles and will be mocked and insulted and spit upon.
aov_text: Want Hy sal oorgelewer word aan die heidene en bespot en mishandel word, en op Hom sal gespuug word;

kjv_text: And they shall scourge him, and put him to death: and the third day he shall rise again.
bsb_text: They will flog Him and kill Him, and on the third day He will rise again.”
aov_text: en nadat hulle Hom gegésel het, sal hulle Hom doodmaak; en op die derde dag sal Hy opstaan.

kjv_text: And they understood none of these things: and this saying was hid from them, neither knew they the things which were spoken.
bsb_text: But the disciples did not understand any of these things. The meaning was hidden from them, and they did not comprehend what He was saying.
aov_text: Maar hulle het niks hiervan begryp nie, en hierdie woord was vir hulle bedek, en hulle het nie verstaan wat gesê is nie.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, that as he was come nigh unto Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the way side begging:
bsb_text: As Jesus drew near to Jericho, a blind man was sitting beside the road, begging.
aov_text: EN terwyl Hy naby Jérigo kom, sit daar ’n blinde man langs die pad en bedel;

kjv_text: And hearing the multitude pass by, he asked what it meant.
bsb_text: When he heard the crowd going by, he asked what was happening.
aov_text: en toe hy ’n skare hoor verbygaan, vra hy wat dit is.

kjv_text: And they told him, that Jesus of Nazareth passeth by.
bsb_text: “Jesus of Nazareth is passing by,” they told him.
aov_text: En hulle vertel hom: Jesus die Nasaréner gaan verby.

kjv_text: And he cried, saying, Jesus, thou son of David, have mercy on me.
bsb_text: So he called out, “Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!”
aov_text: Toe roep hy uit en sê: Jesus, Seun van Dawid, wees my barmhartig!

kjv_text: And they which went before rebuked him, that he should hold his peace: but he cried so much the more, Thou son of David, have mercy on me.
bsb_text: Those who led the way admonished him to be silent, but he cried out all the louder, “Son of David, have mercy on me!”
aov_text: En die wat voor loop, bestraf hom dat hy moet stilbly. Maar hy het al harder uitgeroep: Seun van Dawid, wees my barmhartig!

kjv_text: And Jesus stood, and commanded him to be brought unto him: and when he was come near, he asked him,
bsb_text: Jesus stopped and directed that the man be brought to Him. When he had been brought near, Jesus asked him,
aov_text: En Jesus het gaan staan en bevel gegee dat hy na Hom gebring moes word; en toe hy naby kom, vra Hy hom

kjv_text: Saying, What wilt thou that I shall do unto thee? And he said, Lord, that I may receive my sight.
bsb_text: “What do you want Me to do for you?” “Lord,” he said, “let me see again.”
aov_text: en sê: Wat wil jy hê moet Ek vir jou doen? En hy antwoord: Here, dat ek kan sien.

kjv_text: And Jesus said unto him, Receive thy sight: thy faith hath saved thee.
bsb_text: “Receive your sight!” Jesus replied. “Your faith has healed you.”
aov_text: En Jesus sê vir hom: Sien! Jou geloof het jou gered.

kjv_text: And immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying God: and all the people, when they saw it, gave praise unto God.
bsb_text: Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus, glorifying God. And all the people who saw this gave praise to God.
aov_text: En onmiddellik het hy gesien en Hom gevolg, terwyl hy God verheerlik. En toe die hele volk dit sien, het hulle aan God die lof gegee.

kjv_text: And Jesus entered and passed through Jericho.
bsb_text: Then Jesus entered Jericho and was passing through.
aov_text: EN Hy het in Jérigo gekom en daar deurgegaan.

kjv_text: And, behold, there was a man named Zacchaeus, which was the chief among the publicans, and he was rich.
bsb_text: And there was a man named Zacchaeus, a chief tax collector, who was very wealthy.
aov_text: En daar was ’n man met die naam van Saggéüs, ’n hoof van die tollenaars en ’n ryk man.

kjv_text: And he sought to see Jesus who he was; and could not for the press, because he was little of stature.
bsb_text: He was trying to see who Jesus was, but could not see over the crowd because he was small in stature.
aov_text: En hy het probeer om Jesus te sien, wie Hy was; maar vanweë die skare kon hy nie, omdat hy klein van persoon was.

kjv_text: And he ran before, and climbed up into a sycomore tree to see him: for he was to pass that way.
bsb_text: So he ran on ahead and climbed a sycamore tree to see Him, since Jesus was about to pass that way.
aov_text: En hy het vooruit gehardloop en in ’n wildevyeboom geklim, sodat hy Hom kon sien, want Hy sou daarlangs verbygaan.

kjv_text: And when Jesus came to the place, he looked up, and saw him, and said unto him, Zacchaeus, make haste, and come down; for to day I must abide at thy house.
bsb_text: When Jesus came to that place, He looked up and said, “Zacchaeus, hurry down, for I must stay at your house today.”
aov_text: En toe Jesus by die plek kom, kyk Hy op en sien hom en sê vir hom: Saggéüs, maak gou en klim af, want Ek moet vandag in jou huis bly.

kjv_text: And he made haste, and came down, and received him joyfully.
bsb_text: So Zacchaeus hurried down and welcomed Him joyfully.
aov_text: Hy maak toe gou en klim af en het Hom met blydskap ontvang.

kjv_text: And when they saw it, they all murmured, saying, That he was gone to be guest with a man that is a sinner.
bsb_text: And all who saw this began to grumble, saying, “He has gone to be the guest of a sinful man!”
aov_text: En toe almal dit sien, het hulle gemurmureer en gesê: Hy het by ’n sondige man tuisgegaan.

kjv_text: And Zacchaeus stood, and said unto the Lord; Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore him fourfold.
bsb_text: But Zacchaeus stood up and said to the Lord, “Look, Lord, half of my possessions I give to the poor, and if I have cheated anyone, I will repay it fourfold.”
aov_text: Maar Saggéüs het gaan staan en aan die Here gesê: Here, kyk, die helfte van my goed gee ek vir die armes; en as ek van iemand iets afgepers het, gee ek dit vierdubbel terug.

kjv_text: And Jesus said unto him, This day is salvation come to this house, forsomuch as he also is a son of Abraham.
bsb_text: Jesus said to him, “Today salvation has come to this house, because this man too is a son of Abraham.
aov_text: Toe sê Jesus aan hom: Vandag het daar redding vir hierdie huis gekom, aangesien hierdie man ook ’n seun van Abraham is.

kjv_text: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.
bsb_text: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save the lost.”
aov_text: Want die Seun van die mens het gekom om te soek en te red wat verlore was.

kjv_text: And as they heard these things, he added and spake a parable, because he was nigh to Jerusalem, and because they thought that the kingdom of God should immediately appear.
bsb_text: While the people were listening to this, Jesus proceeded to tell them a parable, because He was near Jerusalem and they thought the kingdom of God would appear imminently.
aov_text: EN terwyl hulle na hierdie dinge luister, vertel Hy daar nog ’n gelykenis by, omdat Hy naby Jerusalem was en hulle gedink het dat die koninkryk van God onmiddellik sou verskyn.

kjv_text: He said therefore, A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom, and to return.
bsb_text: So He said, “A man of noble birth went to a distant country to lay claim to his kingship and then return.
aov_text: Hy het dan gesê: ’n Man van hoë geboorte het na ’n ver land gereis om vir homself ’n koningskap te ontvang en dan terug te kom.

kjv_text: And he called his ten servants, and delivered them ten pounds, and said unto them, Occupy till I come.
bsb_text: Beforehand, he called ten of his servants and gave them ten minas. ‘Conduct business with this until I return,’ he said.
aov_text: En nadat hy tien van sy diensknegte geroep het, gee hy hulle tien ponde en sê vir hulle: Dryf handel daarmee totdat ek kom.

kjv_text: But his citizens hated him, and sent a message after him, saying, We will not have this man to reign over us.
bsb_text: But his subjects hated him and sent a delegation after him to say, ‘We do not want this man to rule over us.’
aov_text: Maar sy medeburgers het hom gehaat en ’n gesantskap agter hom aan gestuur om te sê: Ons wil nie hê dat hierdie man koning oor ons moet wees nie.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, that when he was returned, having received the kingdom, then he commanded these servants to be called unto him, to whom he had given the money, that he might know how much every man had gained by trading.
bsb_text: When he returned from procuring his kingship, he summoned the servants to whom he had given the money, to find out what each one had earned.
aov_text: En toe hy terugkom, nadat hy die koningskap ontvang het, sê hy dat daardie diensknegte aan wie hy die geld gegee het, by hom geroep moes word, sodat hy kon weet wat elkeen met handel verdien het.

kjv_text: Then came the first, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained ten pounds.
bsb_text: The first servant came forward and said, ‘Master, your mina has produced ten more minas.’
aov_text: En die eerste het verskyn en gesê: Meneer, u pond het tien ponde wins gemaak.

kjv_text: And he said unto him, Well, thou good servant: because thou hast been faithful in a very little, have thou authority over ten cities.
bsb_text: His master replied, ‘Well done, good servant! Because you have been faithful in a very small matter, you shall have authority over ten cities.’
aov_text: En hy sê vir hom: Mooi so, goeie dienskneg; omdat jy in die minste getrou gewees het, moet jy gesag hê oor tien stede.

kjv_text: And the second came, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained five pounds.
bsb_text: The second servant came and said, ‘Master, your mina has made five minas.’
aov_text: En die tweede kom en sê: Meneer, u pond het vyf ponde verdien.

kjv_text: And he said likewise to him, Be thou also over five cities.
bsb_text: And to this one he said, ‘You shall have authority over five cities.’
aov_text: En hy sê ook vir hierdie een: En jy moet wees oor vyf stede.

kjv_text: And another came, saying, Lord, behold, here is thy pound, which I have kept laid up in a napkin:
bsb_text: Then another servant came and said, ‘Master, here is your mina, which I have laid away in a piece of cloth.
aov_text: En ’n ander een kom en sê: Meneer, hier is u pond wat ek in ’n doek weggesit het;

kjv_text: For I feared thee, because thou art an austere man: thou takest up that thou layedst not down, and reapest that thou didst not sow.
bsb_text: For I was afraid of you, because you are a harsh man. You withdraw what you did not deposit and reap what you did not sow.’
aov_text: want ek was bang vir u, omdat u ’n strawwe man is; u neem weg wat u nie uitgesit het nie, en maai wat u nie gesaai het nie.

kjv_text: And he saith unto him, Out of thine own mouth will I judge thee, thou wicked servant. Thou knewest that I was an austere man, taking up that I laid not down, and reaping that I did not sow:
bsb_text: His master replied, ‘You wicked servant, I will judge you by your own words. So you knew that I am a harsh man, withdrawing what I did not deposit and reaping what I did not sow?
aov_text: Toe sê hy vir hom: Uit jou mond sal ek jou oordeel, slegte dienskneg! Jy het geweet dat ek ’n strawwe man is wat wegneem wat ek nie uitgesit het nie, en maai wat ek nie gesaai het nie.

kjv_text: Wherefore then gavest not thou my money into the bank, that at my coming I might have required mine own with usury?
bsb_text: Why then did you not deposit my money in the bank, and upon my return I could have collected it with interest?’
aov_text: Waarom het jy dan nie my geld aan die wisselaars gegee nie? Dan kon ek dit by my koms met rente ingevorder het.

kjv_text: And he said unto them that stood by, Take from him the pound, and give it to him that hath ten pounds.
bsb_text: Then he told those standing by, ‘Take the mina from him and give it to the one who has ten minas.’
aov_text: En aan die wat daarby staan, sê hy: Neem die pond van hom weg en gee dit aan hom wat die tien ponde het  —

kjv_text: (And they said unto him, Lord, he hath ten pounds.)
bsb_text: ‘Master,’ they said, ‘he already has ten!’
aov_text: en hulle sê vir hom: Meneer, hy het tien ponde  —

kjv_text: For I say unto you, That unto every one which hath shall be given; and from him that hath not, even that he hath shall be taken away from him.
bsb_text: He replied, ‘I tell you that everyone who has will be given more; but the one who does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.
aov_text: want ek sê vir julle: Aan elkeen wat het, sal gegee word, maar van hom wat nie het nie, sal weggeneem word ook wat hy het.

kjv_text: But those mine enemies, which would not that I should reign over them, bring hither, and slay them before me.
bsb_text: And these enemies of mine who were unwilling for me to rule over them, bring them here and slay them in front of me.’”
aov_text: Maar daardie vyande van my wat nie wou hê dat ek koning oor hulle sou wees nie, bring hulle hier en slaan hulle voor my dood.

kjv_text: And when he had thus spoken, he went before, ascending up to Jerusalem.
bsb_text: After Jesus had said this, He went on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.
aov_text: En toe Hy dit gesê het, gaan Hy vooruit op weg na Jerusalem.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, when he was come nigh to Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount called the mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples,
bsb_text: As He approached Bethphage and Bethany at the Mount of Olives, He sent out two of His disciples,
aov_text: EN toe Hy naby Bétfagé en Betánië kom, by die berg wat die Olyfberg genoem word, het Hy twee van sy dissipels uitgestuur

kjv_text: Saying, Go ye into the village over against you; in the which at your entering ye shall find a colt tied, whereon yet never man sat: loose him, and bring him hither.
bsb_text: saying, “Go into the village ahead of you, and as you enter it, you will find a colt tied there, on which no one has ever sat. Untie it and bring it here.
aov_text: en gesê: Gaan in die dorp reg voor julle; en as julle daar inkom, sal julle ’n eselsvul vind wat vasgemaak is, waar geen mens ooit op gesit het nie. Maak hom los en bring hom.

kjv_text: And if any man ask you, Why do ye loose him? thus shall ye say unto him, Because the Lord hath need of him.
bsb_text: If anyone asks, ‘Why are you untying it?’ tell him, ‘The Lord needs it.’”
aov_text: En as iemand julle vra: Waarom maak julle hom los?  — moet julle so vir hom sê: Die Here het hom nodig.

kjv_text: And they that were sent went their way, and found even as he had said unto them.
bsb_text: So those who were sent went out and found it just as Jesus had told them.
aov_text: En die wat gestuur was, gaan toe en vind dit soos Hy aan hulle gesê het.

kjv_text: And as they were loosing the colt, the owners thereof said unto them, Why loose ye the colt?
bsb_text: As they were untying the colt, its owners asked, “Why are you untying the colt?”
aov_text: En terwyl hulle die vul losmaak, sê die eienaars aan hulle: Waarom maak julle die vul los?

kjv_text: And they said, The Lord hath need of him.
bsb_text: “The Lord needs it,” they answered.
aov_text: En hulle antwoord: Die Here het hom nodig.

kjv_text: And they brought him to Jesus: and they cast their garments upon the colt, and they set Jesus thereon.
bsb_text: Then they led the colt to Jesus, threw their cloaks over it, and put Jesus on it.
aov_text: Toe bring hulle hom na Jesus toe, en hulle lê hul klere op die vul en laat Jesus daarop sit.

kjv_text: And as he went, they spread their clothes in the way.
bsb_text: As He rode along, the people spread their cloaks on the road.
aov_text: En terwyl Hy voortgaan, gooi hulle hul klere oop op die pad.

kjv_text: And when he was come nigh, even now at the descent of the mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works that they had seen;
bsb_text: And as He approached the descent from the Mount of Olives, the whole multitude of disciples began to praise God joyfully in a loud voice for all the miracles they had seen:
aov_text: En toe Hy al naby die afdraand van die Olyfberg kom, begin die hele menigte dissipels God met blydskap te prys met ’n groot stem oor al die kragtige dade wat hulle gesien het,

kjv_text: Saying, Blessed be the King that cometh in the name of the Lord: peace in heaven, and glory in the highest.
bsb_text: “Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord!” “Peace in heaven and glory in the highest!”
aov_text: terwyl hulle sê: Geseënd is die Koning wat kom in die Naam van die Here, vrede in die hemel en heerlikheid in die hoogste hemele!

kjv_text: And some of the Pharisees from among the multitude said unto him, Master, rebuke thy disciples.
bsb_text: But some of the Pharisees in the crowd said to Him, “Teacher, rebuke Your disciples!”
aov_text: En sommige van die Fariseërs uit die skare sê vir Hom: Meester, bestraf u dissipels!

kjv_text: And he answered and said unto them, I tell you that, if these should hold their peace, the stones would immediately cry out.
bsb_text: “I tell you,” He answered, “if they remain silent, the very stones will cry out.”
aov_text: En Hy antwoord en sê vir hulle: Ek sê vir julle, as hulle swyg, sal die klippe uitroep.

kjv_text: And when he was come near, he beheld the city, and wept over it,
bsb_text: As Jesus approached Jerusalem and saw the city, He wept over it
aov_text: En toe Hy naby kom en die stad sien, het Hy daaroor geween

kjv_text: Saying, If thou hadst known, even thou, at least in this thy day, the things which belong unto thy peace! but now they are hid from thine eyes.
bsb_text: and said, “If only you had known on this day what would bring you peace! But now it is hidden from your eyes.
aov_text: en gesê: As jy tog maar geweet het, ja, ook in hierdie dag van jou, die dinge wat tot jou vrede dien! Maar nou is dit vir jou oë bedek.

kjv_text: For the days shall come upon thee, that thine enemies shall cast a trench about thee, and compass thee round, and keep thee in on every side,
bsb_text: For the days will come upon you when your enemies will barricade you and surround you and hem you in on every side.
aov_text: Want daar sal dae oor jou kom dat jou vyande ’n skans rondom jou sal opwerp en jou omsingel en jou van alle kante insluit.

kjv_text: And shall lay thee even with the ground, and thy children within thee; and they shall not leave in thee one stone upon another; because thou knewest not the time of thy visitation.
bsb_text: They will level you to the ground—you and the children within your walls. They will not leave one stone on another, because you did not recognize the time of your visitation from God.”
aov_text: En hulle sal jou en jou kinders in jou teen die grond verpletter; en hulle sal in jou nie een klip op die ander laat bly nie, omdat jy die gunstige tyd toe God jou besoek het, nie opgemerk het nie.

kjv_text: And he went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold therein, and them that bought;
