bsb_text: Then Jesus entered the temple courts and began to drive out those who were selling there.
aov_text: EN toe Hy in die tempel ingegaan het, begin Hy die wat daarin verkoop en koop, uit te jaag.

kjv_text: Saying unto them, It is written, My house is the house of prayer: but ye have made it a den of thieves.
bsb_text: He declared to them, “It is written: ‘My house will be a house of prayer.’ But you have made it ‘a den of robbers.’”
aov_text: En Hy sê vir hulle: Daar is geskrywe: My huis is ’n huis van gebed. Maar julle het dit ’n rowerspelonk gemaak.

kjv_text: And he taught daily in the temple. But the chief priests and the scribes and the chief of the people sought to destroy him,
bsb_text: Jesus was teaching at the temple every day, but the chief priests, scribes, and leaders of the people were intent on killing Him.
aov_text: En elke dag was Hy besig om in die tempel te leer; en die owerpriesters en die skrifgeleerdes en die vernaamstes van die volk het probeer om Hom om te bring;

kjv_text: And could not find what they might do: for all the people were very attentive to hear him.
bsb_text: Yet they could not find a way to do so, because all the people hung on His words.
aov_text: en hulle het niks gevind wat hulle kon doen nie, want die hele volk het Hom aangehang en na Hom geluister.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, that on one of those days, as he taught the people in the temple, and preached the gospel, the chief priests and the scribes came upon him with the elders,
bsb_text: One day as Jesus was teaching the people in the temple courts and proclaiming the gospel, the chief priests and scribes, together with the elders, came up to Him.
aov_text: EN op een van dié dae, terwyl Hy besig was om die volk in die tempel te leer en die evangelie te verkondig, kom die owerpriesters en die skrifgeleerdes saam met die ouderlinge by Hom staan,

kjv_text: And spake unto him, saying, Tell us, by what authority doest thou these things? or who is he that gave thee this authority?
bsb_text: “Tell us,” they said, “by what authority are You doing these things, and who gave You this authority?”
aov_text: en hulle spreek met Hom en sê: Vertel ons deur watter gesag U hierdie dinge doen, of wie dit is wat U hierdie gesag gegee het?

kjv_text: And he answered and said unto them, I will also ask you one thing; and answer me:
bsb_text: “I will also ask you a question,” Jesus replied. “Tell Me:
aov_text: En Hy antwoord en sê vir hulle: Ek sal julle ook een ding vra — sê vir My:

kjv_text: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men?
bsb_text: John’s baptism—was it from heaven, or from men?”
aov_text: die doop van Johannes, was dit uit die hemel of uit mense?

kjv_text: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then believed ye him not?
bsb_text: They deliberated among themselves and said, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ He will ask, ‘Why did you not believe him?’
aov_text: Toe het hulle onder mekaar geredeneer en gesê: As ons sê: Uit die hemel — sal Hy sê: Waarom het julle hom dan nie geglo nie?

kjv_text: But and if we say, Of men; all the people will stone us: for they be persuaded that John was a prophet.
bsb_text: But if we say, ‘From men,’ all the people will stone us, for they are convinced that John was a prophet.”
aov_text: En as ons sê: Uit mense — sal die hele volk ons stenig, want hulle is daarvan oortuig dat Johannes ’n profeet is.

kjv_text: And they answered, that they could not tell whence it was.
bsb_text: So they answered that they did not know where it was from.
aov_text: Toe antwoord hulle dat hulle nie weet waarvandaan nie.

kjv_text: And Jesus said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.
bsb_text: And Jesus replied, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things.”
aov_text: En Jesus sê vir hulle: Dan vertel Ek julle ook nie deur watter gesag Ek hierdie dinge doen nie.

kjv_text: Then began he to speak to the people this parable; A certain man planted a vineyard, and let it forth to husbandmen, and went into a far country for a long time.
bsb_text: Then He proceeded to tell the people this parable: “A man planted a vineyard, rented it out to some tenants, and went away for a long time.
aov_text: TOE begin Hy aan die volk hierdie gelykenis te vertel: ’n Sekere man het ’n wingerd geplant en dit aan landbouers verhuur en vir ’n geruime tyd op reis gegaan.

kjv_text: And at the season he sent a servant to the husbandmen, that they should give him of the fruit of the vineyard: but the husbandmen beat him, and sent him away empty.
bsb_text: At harvest time, he sent a servant to the tenants to collect his share of the fruit of the vineyard. But the tenants beat the servant and sent him away empty-handed.
aov_text: En op die regte tyd het hy ’n dienskneg na die landbouers gestuur, dat hulle hom van die vrug van die wingerd sou gee. Maar die landbouers het hom geslaan en met leë hande weggestuur.

kjv_text: And again he sent another servant: and they beat him also, and entreated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.
bsb_text: So he sent another servant, but they beat him and treated him shamefully, sending him away empty-handed.
aov_text: En hy het weer ’n ander dienskneg gestuur, en hulle het hom ook geslaan en skandelik behandel en met leë hande weggestuur.

kjv_text: And again he sent a third: and they wounded him also, and cast him out.
bsb_text: Then he sent a third, but they wounded him and threw him out.
aov_text: En hy het weer ’n derde gestuur, en hulle het ook hierdie een gewond en uitgedryf.

kjv_text: Then said the lord of the vineyard, What shall I do? I will send my beloved son: it may be they will reverence him when they see him.
bsb_text: ‘What shall I do?’ asked the owner of the vineyard. ‘I will send my beloved son. Perhaps they will respect him.’
aov_text: Toe sê die eienaar van die wingerd: Wat sal ek doen? Ek sal my geliefde seun stuur; miskien sal hulle ontsag hê as hulle hom sien.

kjv_text: But when the husbandmen saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, This is the heir: come, let us kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.
bsb_text: But when the tenants saw the son, they discussed it among themselves and said, ‘This is the heir. Let us kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’
aov_text: Maar toe die landbouers hom sien, het hulle onder mekaar geredeneer en gesê: Dit is die erfgenaam; kom laat ons hom doodmaak, sodat die erfdeel ons s’n kan wees.

kjv_text: So they cast him out of the vineyard, and killed him. What therefore shall the lord of the vineyard do unto them?
bsb_text: So they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him. What then will the owner of the vineyard do to them?
aov_text: En hulle het hom uit die wingerd gewerp en hom doodgemaak. Wat sal die eienaar van die wingerd dan aan hulle doen?

kjv_text: He shall come and destroy these husbandmen, and shall give the vineyard to others. And when they heard it, they said, God forbid.
bsb_text: He will come and kill those tenants, and will give the vineyard to others.” And when the people heard this, they said, “May such a thing never happen!”
aov_text: Hy sal kom en daardie landbouers ombring en die wingerd aan ander gee. En toe hulle dit hoor, sê hulle: Nee, stellig nie!

kjv_text: And he beheld them, and said, What is this then that is written, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner?
bsb_text: But Jesus looked directly at them and said, “Then what is the meaning of that which is written: ‘The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone’?
aov_text: Maar Hy het hulle aangekyk en gesê: Wat beteken dan hierdie Skrifwoord: die steen wat die bouers verwerp het, dit het ’n hoeksteen geword?

kjv_text: Whosoever shall fall upon that stone shall be broken; but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.
bsb_text: Everyone who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces, but he on whom it falls will be crushed.”
aov_text: Elkeen wat op dié steen val, sal verpletter word; maar elkeen op wie hy val, dié sal hy vermorsel.

kjv_text: And the chief priests and the scribes the same hour sought to lay hands on him; and they feared the people: for they perceived that he had spoken this parable against them.
bsb_text: When the scribes and chief priests realized that Jesus had spoken this parable against them, they sought to arrest Him that very hour. But they were afraid of the people.
aov_text: TOE probeer die owerpriesters en die skrifgeleerdes in daardie selfde uur om die hande aan Hom te slaan, maar hulle het die volk gevrees; want hulle het geweet dat Hy hierdie gelykenis met die oog op hulle self uitgespreek het.

kjv_text: And they watched him, and sent forth spies, which should feign themselves just men, that they might take hold of his words, that so they might deliver him unto the power and authority of the governor.
bsb_text: So they watched Him closely and sent spies who pretended to be sincere. They were hoping to catch Him in His words in order to hand Him over to the rule and authority of the governor.
aov_text: En hulle het Hom in die oog gehou en spioene gestuur wat geveins het dat hulle regverdig was, sodat hulle Hom op ’n woord kon betrap, om Hom oor te lewer aan die owerheid en aan die gesag van die goewerneur.

kjv_text: And they asked him, saying, Master, we know that thou sayest and teachest rightly, neither acceptest thou the person of any, but teachest the way of God truly:
bsb_text: “Teacher,” they inquired, “we know that You speak and teach correctly. You show no partiality, but teach the way of God in accordance with the truth.
aov_text: En hulle het Hom gevra en gesê: Meester, ons weet dat U reguit praat en leer en die persoon nie aanneem nie, maar die weg van God in waarheid leer  —

kjv_text: Is it lawful for us to give tribute unto Caesar, or no?
bsb_text: Is it lawful for us to pay taxes to Caesar or not?”
aov_text: is dit ons geoorloof om aan die keiser belasting te betaal of nie?

kjv_text: But he perceived their craftiness, and said unto them, Why tempt ye me?
bsb_text: But Jesus saw through their duplicity and said to them,
aov_text: Maar Hy het hulle listigheid bemerk en vir hulle gesê: Waarom versoek julle My?

kjv_text: Shew me a penny. Whose image and superscription hath it? They answered and said, Caesar's.
bsb_text: “Show Me a denarius. Whose image and inscription are on it?” “Caesar’s,” they answered.
aov_text: Wys My ’n penning. Wie se beeld en opskrif het dit? Hulle antwoord en sê: Die keiser s’n.

kjv_text: And he said unto them, Render therefore unto Caesar the things which be Caesar's, and unto God the things which be God's.
bsb_text: So Jesus told them, “Give to Caesar what is Caesar’s, and to God what is God’s.”
aov_text: Toe sê Hy vir hulle: Betaal dan aan die keiser wat die keiser toekom, en aan God wat God toekom.

kjv_text: And they could not take hold of his words before the people: and they marvelled at his answer, and held their peace.
bsb_text: And they were unable to trap Him in His words before the people; and amazed at His answer, they fell silent.
aov_text: En hulle kon Hom nie voor die volk op ’n woord betrap nie, en verwonderd oor sy antwoord, het hulle geswyg.

kjv_text: Then came to him certain of the Sadducees, which deny that there is any resurrection; and they asked him,
bsb_text: Then some of the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to question Him.
aov_text: EN sommige van die Sadduseërs het gekom — hulle wat ontken dat daar ’n opstanding is — en Hom gevra

kjv_text: Saying, Master, Moses wrote unto us, If any man's brother die, having a wife, and he die without children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
bsb_text: “Teacher,” they said, “Moses wrote for us that if a man’s brother dies and leaves a wife but no children, the man is to marry his brother’s widow and raise up offspring for him.
aov_text: en gesê: Meester, Moses het ons voorgeskrywe: As iemand se getroude broer sterwe en hy sterf sonder kinders, dan moet sy broer die vrou neem en vir sy broer kinders verwek.

kjv_text: There were therefore seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and died without children.
bsb_text: Now there were seven brothers. The first one married a wife, but died childless.
aov_text: Nou was daar sewe broers, en die eerste het ’n vrou geneem en kinderloos gesterwe.

kjv_text: And the second took her to wife, and he died childless.
bsb_text: Then the second
aov_text: En die tweede het die vrou geneem, en hy het ook kinderloos gesterwe.

kjv_text: And the third took her; and in like manner the seven also: and they left no children, and died.
bsb_text: and the third married the widow, and in the same way all seven died, leaving no children.
aov_text: En die derde het haar geneem; en net so al sewe. En hulle het geen kinders nagelaat nie en het gesterwe.

kjv_text: Last of all the woman died also.
bsb_text: And last of all, the woman died.
aov_text: En ten laaste het die vrou ook gesterwe.

kjv_text: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them is she? for seven had her to wife.
bsb_text: So then, in the resurrection, whose wife will she be? For all seven were married to her.”
aov_text: In die opstanding dan, wie van hulle se vrou sal sy wees?  — want al sewe het haar as vrou gehad.

kjv_text: And Jesus answering said unto them, The children of this world marry, and are given in marriage:
bsb_text: Jesus answered, “The sons of this age marry and are given in marriage.
aov_text: Toe antwoord Jesus en sê vir hulle: Die kinders van hierdie eeu trou en word in die huwelik uitgegee;

kjv_text: But they which shall be accounted worthy to obtain that world, and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry, nor are given in marriage:
bsb_text: But those who are considered worthy to share in the age to come and in the resurrection from the dead will neither marry nor be given in marriage.
aov_text: maar die wat waardig geag word om daardie eeu en die opstanding uit die dode te verkry, trou nie en word nie in die huwelik uitgegee nie.

kjv_text: Neither can they die any more: for they are equal unto the angels; and are the children of God, being the children of the resurrection.
bsb_text: In fact, they can no longer die, because they are like the angels. And since they are sons of the resurrection, they are sons of God.
aov_text: Want hulle kan ook nie meer sterwe nie, want hulle is soos die engele en is kinders van God, omdat hulle kinders van die opstanding is.

kjv_text: Now that the dead are raised, even Moses shewed at the bush, when he calleth the Lord the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.
bsb_text: Even Moses demonstrates that the dead are raised, in the passage about the burning bush. For he calls the Lord ‘the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’
aov_text: En dat die dode opgewek word, het Moses ook in die gedeelte oor die doringbos aangedui, waar hy die Here noem die God van Abraham en die God van Isak en die God van Jakob.

kjv_text: For he is not a God of the dead, but of the living: for all live unto him.
bsb_text: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living, for to Him all are alive.”
aov_text: Hy is tog nie ’n God van dooies nie, maar van lewendes, want almal leef vir Hom.

kjv_text: Then certain of the scribes answering said, Master, thou hast well said.
bsb_text: Some of the scribes answered, “Teacher, You have spoken well!”
aov_text: En sommige van die skrifgeleerdes antwoord en sê: Meester, U het goed gespreek.

kjv_text: And after that they durst not ask him any question at all.
bsb_text: And they did not dare to question Him any further.
aov_text: En hulle het Hom nie meer iets durf vra nie.

kjv_text: And he said unto them, How say they that Christ is David's son?
bsb_text: Then Jesus declared, “How can it be said that the Christ is the Son of David?
aov_text: TOE sê Hy vir hulle: Hoe is dit dat hulle sê dat die Christus die seun van Dawid is?

kjv_text: And David himself saith in the book of Psalms, The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,
bsb_text: For David himself says in the book of Psalms: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at My right hand
aov_text: En Dawid self sê in die boek van die Psalms: Die Here het tot my Here gespreek: Sit aan my regterhand

kjv_text: Till I make thine enemies thy footstool.
bsb_text: until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet.”’
aov_text: totdat Ek u vyande gemaak het ’n voetbank van u voete.

kjv_text: David therefore calleth him Lord, how is he then his son?
bsb_text: Thus David calls Him ‘Lord.’ So how can He be David’s son?”
aov_text: Dawid noem Hom dan Here, en hoe is Hy sy seun?

kjv_text: Then in the audience of all the people he said unto his disciples,
bsb_text: In the hearing of all the people, Jesus said to His disciples,
aov_text: EN terwyl die hele volk luister, sê Hy vir sy dissipels:

kjv_text: Beware of the scribes, which desire to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the markets, and the highest seats in the synagogues, and the chief rooms at feasts;
bsb_text: “Beware of the scribes. They like to walk around in long robes, and they love the greetings in the marketplaces, the chief seats in the synagogues, and the places of honor at banquets.
aov_text: Pas op vir die skrifgeleerdes wat graag in lang klere rondloop en van die begroetinge op die markte hou en van die voorste banke in die sinagoges en die voorste plekke by die maaltye.

kjv_text: Which devour widows' houses, and for a shew make long prayers: the same shall receive greater damnation.
bsb_text: They defraud widows of their houses, and for a show make lengthy prayers. These men will receive greater condemnation.”
aov_text: Hulle eet die huise van die weduwees op en doen vir die skyn lang gebede. Hulle sal ’n swaarder oordeel ontvang.

kjv_text: And he looked up, and saw the rich men casting their gifts into the treasury.
bsb_text: Then Jesus looked up and saw the rich putting their gifts into the treasury,
aov_text: EN toe Hy opkyk, sien Hy die rykes wat hulle gawes in die skatkis gooi.

kjv_text: And he saw also a certain poor widow casting in thither two mites.
bsb_text: and He saw a poor widow put in two small copper coins.
aov_text: En Hy het ook ’n arm weduwee daar twee geldstukkies sien ingooi.

kjv_text: And he said, Of a truth I say unto you, that this poor widow hath cast in more than they all:
bsb_text: “Truly I tell you,” He said, “this poor widow has put in more than all the others.
aov_text: En Hy sê: Waarlik, Ek sê vir julle dat hierdie arm weduwee meer as almal ingegooi het.

kjv_text: For all these have of their abundance cast in unto the offerings of God: but she of her penury hath cast in all the living that she had.
bsb_text: For they all contributed out of their surplus, but she out of her poverty has put in all she had to live on.”
aov_text: Want hulle almal het uit hul oorvloed by die gawes van God ingegooi, maar sy het uit haar gebrek ingegooi alles wat sy gehad het om van te lewe.

kjv_text: And as some spake of the temple, how it was adorned with goodly stones and gifts, he said,
bsb_text: As some of the disciples were remarking how the temple was adorned with beautiful stones and consecrated gifts, Jesus said,
aov_text: EN toe sommige oor die tempel praat, dat dit met mooi klippe en gewyde geskenke versierd was, sê Hy:

kjv_text: As for these things which ye behold, the days will come, in the which there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
bsb_text: “As for what you see here, the time will come when not one stone will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.”
aov_text: Hierdie dinge wat julle sien — daar sal dae kom wanneer daar nie een klip op die ander gelaat sal word wat nie afgebreek sal word nie.

kjv_text: And they asked him, saying, Master, but when shall these things be? and what sign will there be when these things shall come to pass?
bsb_text: “Teacher,” they asked, “when will these things happen? And what will be the sign that they are about to take place?”
aov_text: En hulle vra Hom en sê: Meester, wanneer sal dit dan wees, en wat is die teken wanneer dit gaan gebeur?

kjv_text: And he said, Take heed that ye be not deceived: for many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and the time draweth near: go ye not therefore after them.
bsb_text: Jesus answered, “See to it that you are not deceived. For many will come in My name, claiming, ‘I am He,’ and, ‘The time is near.’ Do not follow them.
aov_text: En Hy antwoord: Pas op dat julle nie mislei word nie; want baie sal onder my Naam kom en sê: Dit is ek! en: Die tyd is naby! Gaan dan nie agter hulle aan nie.

kjv_text: But when ye shall hear of wars and commotions, be not terrified: for these things must first come to pass; but the end is not by and by.
bsb_text: When you hear of wars and rebellions, do not be alarmed. These things must happen first, but the end is not imminent.”
aov_text: En wanneer julle hoor van oorloë en opstande, moenie skrik nie; want dié dinge moet eers plaasvind, maar dit is nie dadelik die einde nie.

kjv_text: Then said he unto them, Nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom:
bsb_text: Then He told them, “Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.
aov_text: Toe sê Hy vir hulle: Die een nasie sal teen die ander opstaan en die een koninkryk teen die ander.

kjv_text: And great earthquakes shall be in divers places, and famines, and pestilences; and fearful sights and great signs shall there be from heaven.
bsb_text: There will be great earthquakes, famines, and pestilences in various places, along with fearful sights and great signs from heaven.
aov_text: En daar sal groot aardbewings op verskillende plekke wees en hongersnode en pessiektes; en daar sal verskriklike dinge en groot tekens van die hemel kom.

kjv_text: But before all these, they shall lay their hands on you, and persecute you, delivering you up to the synagogues, and into prisons, being brought before kings and rulers for my name's sake.
bsb_text: But before all this, they will seize you and persecute you. On account of My name they will deliver you to the synagogues and prisons, and they will bring you before kings and governors.
aov_text: Maar voor al hierdie dinge sal hulle die hande aan julle slaan en julle vervolg en oorlewer in sinagoges en gevangenisse en julle voor konings en goewerneurs bring ter wille van my Naam.

kjv_text: And it shall turn to you for a testimony.
bsb_text: This will be your opportunity to serve as witnesses.
aov_text: En dit sal vir julle uitloop op ’n getuienis.

kjv_text: Settle it therefore in your hearts, not to meditate before what ye shall answer:
bsb_text: So make up your mind not to worry beforehand how to defend yourselves.
aov_text: Neem julle dan in jul harte voor om nie vooraf oor julle verdediging te dink nie.

kjv_text: For I will give you a mouth and wisdom, which all your adversaries shall not be able to gainsay nor resist.
bsb_text: For I will give you speech and wisdom that none of your adversaries will be able to resist or contradict.
aov_text: Want Ek sal aan julle woorde en wysheid gee wat al julle teëstanders nie sal kan teëspreek of weerstaan nie.

kjv_text: And ye shall be betrayed both by parents, and brethren, and kinsfolks, and friends; and some of you shall they cause to be put to death.
bsb_text: You will be betrayed even by parents and brothers and relatives and friends, and some of you will be put to death.
aov_text: Maar julle sal oorgelewer word ook deur ouers en broers en bloedverwante en vriende, en hulle sal van julle doodmaak.

kjv_text: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake.
bsb_text: And you will be hated by everyone because of My name.
aov_text: En julle sal gehaat wees deur almal ter wille van my Naam.

kjv_text: But there shall not an hair of your head perish.
bsb_text: Yet not even a hair of your head will perish.
aov_text: En geen haar van julle hoof sal ooit verlore gaan nie.

kjv_text: In your patience possess ye your souls.
bsb_text: By your patient endurance you will gain your souls.
aov_text: Deur julle volharding moet julle jul lewe in besit kry.

kjv_text: And when ye shall see Jerusalem compassed with armies, then know that the desolation thereof is nigh.
bsb_text: But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, you will know that her desolation is near.
aov_text: EN wanneer julle Jerusalem deur leërs omsingeld sien, dan moet julle weet dat sy verwoesting naby is.

kjv_text: Then let them which are in Judaea flee to the mountains; and let them which are in the midst of it depart out; and let not them that are in the countries enter thereinto.
bsb_text: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains, let those in the city get out, and let those in the country stay out of the city.
aov_text: Dan moet die wat in Judéa is, na die berge vlug; en die wat in die stad is, moet uitgaan; en die wat in die buitewyke is, moet nie daar inkom nie.

kjv_text: For these be the days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.
bsb_text: For these are the days of vengeance, to fulfill all that is written.
aov_text: Want dit sal dae van wraak wees, sodat alles wat geskrywe is, vervul kan word.

kjv_text: But woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck, in those days! for there shall be great distress in the land, and wrath upon this people.
bsb_text: How miserable those days will be for pregnant and nursing mothers! For there will be great distress upon the land and wrath against this people.
aov_text: Maar wee die vroue wat swanger is en die wat nog soog in daardie dae; want daar sal ’n groot nood in die land wees en toorn oor hierdie volk.

kjv_text: And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.
bsb_text: They will fall by the edge of the sword and be led captive into all the nations. And Jerusalem will be trodden down by the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.
aov_text: En hulle sal deur die skerpte van die swaard val en as krygsgevangenes geneem word na al die nasies, en Jerusalem sal vertrap word deur die nasies totdat die tye van die nasies vervul is.

kjv_text: And there shall be signs in the sun, and in the moon, and in the stars; and upon the earth distress of nations, with perplexity; the sea and the waves roaring;
bsb_text: There will be signs in the sun and moon and stars, and on the earth dismay among the nations, bewildered by the roaring of the sea and the surging of the waves.
aov_text: EN daar sal tekens wees aan son en maan en sterre, en op die aarde benoudheid van nasies in hulle radeloosheid, wanneer see en branders dreun,

kjv_text: Men's hearts failing them for fear, and for looking after those things which are coming on the earth: for the powers of heaven shall be shaken.
bsb_text: Men will faint from fear and anxiety over what is coming upon the earth, for the powers of the heavens will be shaken.
aov_text: en mense se harte beswyk van vrees en verwagting van die dinge wat oor die wêreld kom. Want die kragte van die hemele sal geskud word.

kjv_text: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
bsb_text: At that time they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
aov_text: En dan sal hulle die Seun van die mens sien kom in ’n wolk, met groot krag en heerlikheid.

kjv_text: And when these things begin to come to pass, then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draweth nigh.
bsb_text: When these things begin to happen, stand up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is drawing near.”
aov_text: En as hierdie dinge begin gebeur, kyk dan na bo en hef julle hoofde op, omdat julle verlossing naby is.

kjv_text: And he spake to them a parable; Behold the fig tree, and all the trees;
bsb_text: Then Jesus told them a parable: “Look at the fig tree and all the trees.
aov_text: Toe vertel Hy hulle ’n gelykenis: Let op die vyeboom en al die bome.

kjv_text: When they now shoot forth, ye see and know of your own selves that summer is now nigh at hand.
bsb_text: When they sprout leaves, you can see for yourselves and know that summer is near.
aov_text: Net soos hulle bot, weet julle vanself, as julle dit sien, dat die somer al naby is.

kjv_text: So likewise ye, when ye see these things come to pass, know ye that the kingdom of God is nigh at hand.
bsb_text: So also, when you see these things happening, know that the kingdom of God is near.
aov_text: So moet julle ook weet dat die koninkryk van God naby is wanneer julle hierdie dinge sien gebeur.

kjv_text: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass away, till all be fulfilled.
bsb_text: Truly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all these things have happened.
aov_text: Voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, hierdie geslag sal sekerlik nie verbygaan voordat alles gebeur het nie.

kjv_text: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.
bsb_text: Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will never pass away.
aov_text: Die hemel en die aarde sal verbygaan, maar my woorde sal nooit verbygaan nie.

kjv_text: And take heed to yourselves, lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting, and drunkenness, and cares of this life, and so that day come upon you unawares.
bsb_text: But watch yourselves, or your hearts will be weighed down by dissipation, drunkenness, and the worries of life—and that day will spring upon you suddenly like a snare.
aov_text: MAAR pas op vir julleself, dat julle harte nie miskien beswaar word deur swelgery en dronkenskap en sorge van die lewe nie, en dié dag julle nie skielik oorval nie.

kjv_text: For as a snare shall it come on all them that dwell on the face of the whole earth.
bsb_text: For it will come upon all who dwell on the face of all the earth.
aov_text: Want soos ’n strik sal hy kom oor almal wat op die hele aarde woon.

kjv_text: Watch ye therefore, and pray always, that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand before the Son of man.
bsb_text: So keep watch at all times, and pray that you may have the strength to escape all that is about to happen and to stand before the Son of Man.”
aov_text: Waak dan en bid altyddeur, sodat julle waardig geag mag word om al hierdie dinge wat kom, te ontvlug en voor die Seun van die mens te staan.

kjv_text: And in the day time he was teaching in the temple; and at night he went out, and abode in the mount that is called the mount of Olives.
bsb_text: Every day Jesus taught at the temple, but every evening He went out to spend the night on the Mount of Olives.
aov_text: EN Hy was oordag in die tempel besig om te leer, en snags het Hy uitgegaan en vernag op die berg wat die Olyfberg genoem word.

kjv_text: And all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple, for to hear him.
bsb_text: And early in the morning all the people would come to hear Him at the temple.
aov_text: En die hele volk het vroeg in die môre na Hom in die tempel gekom om na Hom te luister.

kjv_text: Now the feast of unleavened bread drew nigh, which is called the Passover.
bsb_text: Now the Feast of Unleavened Bread, called the Passover, was approaching,
aov_text: EN die fees van die ongesuurde brode, wat pasga genoem word, was naby.

kjv_text: And the chief priests and scribes sought how they might kill him; for they feared the people.
bsb_text: and the chief priests and scribes were looking for a way to put Jesus to death; for they feared the people.
aov_text: En die owerpriesters en die skrifgeleerdes het gesoek hoe hulle Hom kon ombring, want hulle het die volk gevrees.

kjv_text: Then entered Satan into Judas surnamed Iscariot, being of the number of the twelve.
bsb_text: Then Satan entered Judas Iscariot, who was one of the Twelve.
aov_text: En die Satan het in Judas gevaar, wat Iskáriot genoem word en wat uit die getal van die twaalf was.

kjv_text: And he went his way, and communed with the chief priests and captains, how he might betray him unto them.
bsb_text: And Judas went to discuss with the chief priests and temple officers how he might betray Jesus to them.
aov_text: Toe het hy gegaan en met die owerpriesters en hoofde beraadslaag hoe hy Hom aan hulle kon oorlewer.

kjv_text: And they were glad, and covenanted to give him money.
bsb_text: They were delighted and agreed to give him money.
aov_text: En hulle was bly en het met hom ooreengekom om hom geld te gee.

kjv_text: And he promised, and sought opportunity to betray him unto them in the absence of the multitude.
bsb_text: Judas consented, and began to look for an opportunity to betray Jesus to them in the absence of a crowd.
aov_text: En hy het toegestem en na ’n goeie geleentheid gesoek om Hom sonder oproer aan hulle oor te lewer.

kjv_text: Then came the day of unleavened bread, when the passover must be killed.
bsb_text: Then came the day of Unleavened Bread on which the Passover lamb was to be sacrificed.
aov_text: EN die dag van die ongesuurde brode het gekom waarop die pasga geslag moes word.

kjv_text: And he sent Peter and John, saying, Go and prepare us the passover, that we may eat.
bsb_text: Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, “Go and prepare for us to eat the Passover.”
aov_text: Toe stuur Hy Petrus en Johannes en sê: Gaan berei die pasga vir ons, dat ons dit kan eet.

kjv_text: And they said unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare?
bsb_text: “Where do You want us to prepare it?” they asked.
aov_text: En hulle sê vir Hom: Waar wil U hê moet ons dit berei?

kjv_text: And he said unto them, Behold, when ye are entered into the city, there shall a man meet you, bearing a pitcher of water; follow him into the house where he entereth in.
bsb_text: He answered, “When you enter the city, a man carrying a jug of water will meet you. Follow him to the house he enters,
aov_text: En Hy antwoord hulle: Kyk, as julle in die stad ingaan, sal ’n man julle ontmoet wat ’n kruik water dra; volg hom na die huis waar hy ingaan.

kjv_text: And ye shall say unto the goodman of the house, The Master saith unto thee, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?
bsb_text: and say to the owner of that house, ‘The Teacher asks: Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with My disciples?’
aov_text: En julle moet vir die eienaar van die huis sê: Die Meester vra u — waar is die kamer waar Ek die pasga met my dissipels kan eet?

kjv_text: And he shall shew you a large upper room furnished: there make ready.
bsb_text: And he will show you a large upper room, already furnished. Make preparations there.”
aov_text: En hy sal julle ’n groot bovertrek wys wat reggemaak is; daar moet julle dit berei.

kjv_text: And they went, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.
bsb_text: So they went and found it just as Jesus had told them. And they prepared the Passover.
aov_text: En hulle het gegaan en dit gevind soos Hy vir hulle gesê het, en die pasga berei.

kjv_text: And when the hour was come, he sat down, and the twelve apostles with him.
bsb_text: When the hour had come, Jesus reclined at the table with His apostles.
aov_text: En toe die uur kom, het Hy aan tafel gegaan en die twaalf apostels saam met Hom.

kjv_text: And he said unto them, With desire I have desired to eat this passover with you before I suffer:
bsb_text: And He said to them, “I have eagerly desired to eat this Passover with you before My suffering.
aov_text: En Hy sê vir hulle: Ek het baie sterk daarna verlang om hierdie pasga met julle te eet voordat Ek ly.

kjv_text: For I say unto you, I will not any more eat thereof, until it be fulfilled in the kingdom of God.
bsb_text: For I tell you that I will not eat it again until it is fulfilled in the kingdom of God.”
aov_text: Want Ek sê vir julle: Ek sal sekerlik nie meer daarvan eet voordat dit in die koninkryk van God vervul is nie.

kjv_text: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and said, Take this, and divide it among yourselves:
bsb_text: After taking the cup, He gave thanks and said, “Take this and divide it among yourselves.
aov_text: En toe Hy ’n beker geneem het, dank Hy en sê: Neem dit en deel dit onder julle.

kjv_text: For I say unto you, I will not drink of the fruit of the vine, until the kingdom of God shall come.
bsb_text: For I tell you that I will not drink of the fruit of the vine from now on until the kingdom of God comes.”
aov_text: Want Ek sê vir julle: Ek sal sekerlik nie drink van die vrug van die wynstok voordat die koninkryk van God gekom het nie.

kjv_text: And he took bread, and gave thanks, and brake it, and gave unto them, saying, This is my body which is given for you: this do in remembrance of me.
bsb_text: And He took the bread, gave thanks and broke it, and gave it to them, saying, “This is My body, given for you; do this in remembrance of Me.”
aov_text: Daarop neem Hy brood, en nadat Hy gedank het, breek Hy dit en gee dit aan hulle en sê: Dit is my liggaam wat vir julle gegee word; doen dit tot my gedagtenis.

kjv_text: Likewise also the cup after supper, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood, which is shed for you.
bsb_text: In the same way, after supper He took the cup, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in My blood, which is poured out for you.
aov_text: Net so neem Hy ook die beker ná die maaltyd en sê: Hierdie beker is die nuwe testament in my bloed wat vir julle uitgestort word.

kjv_text: But, behold, the hand of him that betrayeth me is with me on the table.
bsb_text: Look! The hand of My betrayer is with Mine on the table.
aov_text: Maar kyk, die hand van hom wat My verraai, is by My aan tafel.

kjv_text: And truly the Son of man goeth, as it was determined: but woe unto that man by whom he is betrayed!
bsb_text: Indeed, the Son of Man will go as it has been determined, but woe to that man who betrays Him.”
aov_text: Die Seun van die mens gaan wel heen volgens wat bepaal is, maar wee daardie man deur wie Hy verraai word!

kjv_text: And they began to enquire among themselves, which of them it was that should do this thing.
bsb_text: Then they began to question among themselves which of them was going to do this.
aov_text: Toe begin hulle onder mekaar te vra wie van hulle dit tog kon wees wat dit sou doen.

kjv_text: And there was also a strife among them, which of them should be accounted the greatest.
bsb_text: A dispute also arose among the disciples as to which of them would be considered the greatest.
aov_text: EN daar het ook twis onder hulle ontstaan oor wie van hulle die grootste geag moet wees.

kjv_text: And he said unto them, The kings of the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and they that exercise authority upon them are called benefactors.
bsb_text: So Jesus declared, “The kings of the Gentiles lord it over them, and those in authority over them call themselves benefactors.
aov_text: En Hy het vir hulle gesê: Die konings van die nasies heers oor hulle, en die wat gesag voer oor hulle, word weldoeners genoem.

kjv_text: But ye shall not be so: but he that is greatest among you, let him be as the younger; and he that is chief, as he that doth serve.
bsb_text: But you shall not be like them. Instead, the greatest among you should be like the youngest, and the one who leads like the one who serves.
aov_text: Maar so moet julle nie wees nie; maar die oudste onder julle moet word soos die jongste, en wie ’n leier is, soos een wat dien.

kjv_text: For whether is greater, he that sitteth at meat, or he that serveth? is not he that sitteth at meat? but I am among you as he that serveth.
bsb_text: For who is greater, the one who reclines at the table or the one who serves? Is it not the one who reclines? But I am among you as one who serves.
aov_text: Want wie is groter: die een wat aan tafel is, of die een wat dien? Is dit nie hy wat aan tafel is nie? Maar Ek is onder julle soos een wat dien.

kjv_text: Ye are they which have continued with me in my temptations.
bsb_text: You are the ones who have stood by Me in My trials.
aov_text: En dit is julle wat altyddeur by My gebly het in my versoekinge.

kjv_text: And I appoint unto you a kingdom, as my Father hath appointed unto me;
bsb_text: And I bestow on you a kingdom, just as My Father has bestowed one on Me,
aov_text: En Ek beskik vir julle ’n koninkryk soos my Vader dit vir My beskik het,

kjv_text: That ye may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom, and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
bsb_text: so that you may eat and drink at My table in My kingdom, and sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
aov_text: sodat julle kan eet en drink aan my tafel in my koninkryk en op trone sit om die twaalf stamme van Israel te oordeel.

kjv_text: And the Lord said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan hath desired to have you, that he may sift you as wheat:
bsb_text: Simon, Simon, Satan has asked to sift each of you like wheat.
aov_text: EN die Here sê: Simon, Simon, kyk, die Satan het vurig begeer om julle soos koring te sif.

kjv_text: But I have prayed for thee, that thy faith fail not: and when thou art converted, strengthen thy brethren.
bsb_text: But I have prayed for you, Simon, that your faith will not fail. And when you have turned back, strengthen your brothers.”
aov_text: Maar Ek het vir jou gebid, dat jou geloof nie ophou nie; en as jy eendag bekeerd is, moet jy jou broeders versterk.

kjv_text: And he said unto him, Lord, I am ready to go with thee, both into prison, and to death.
bsb_text: “Lord,” said Peter, “I am ready to go with You even to prison and to death.”
aov_text: En hy het vir Hom gesê: Here, ek is gereed om saam met U selfs in die gevangenis en in die dood te gaan.

kjv_text: And he said, I tell thee, Peter, the cock shall not crow this day, before that thou shalt thrice deny that thou knowest me.
bsb_text: But Jesus replied, “I tell you, Peter, the rooster will not crow today until you have denied three times that you know Me.”
aov_text: Maar Hy antwoord: Ek sê vir jou, Petrus, die haan sal vannag nie kraai voordat jy drie maal geloën het dat jy My ken nie.

kjv_text: And he said unto them, When I sent you without purse, and scrip, and shoes, lacked ye any thing? And they said, Nothing.
bsb_text: Then Jesus asked them, “When I sent you out without purse or bag or sandals, did you lack anything?” “Nothing,” they answered.
aov_text: EN Hy sê vir hulle: Toe Ek julle uitgestuur het sonder beurs en reissak en skoene, het julle iets kortgekom? En hulle antwoord: Niks nie.

kjv_text: Then said he unto them, But now, he that hath a purse, let him take it, and likewise his scrip: and he that hath no sword, let him sell his garment, and buy one.
bsb_text: “Now, however,” He told them, “the one with a purse should take it, and likewise a bag; and the one without a sword should sell his cloak and buy one.
aov_text: Toe sê Hy vir hulle: Maar nou, wie ’n beurs het, laat hom dit neem en so ook die reissak; en wie dit nie het nie, moet sy kleed verkoop en ’n swaard koop.

kjv_text: For I say unto you, that this that is written must yet be accomplished in me, And he was reckoned among the transgressors: for the things concerning me have an end.
bsb_text: For I tell you that this Scripture must be fulfilled in Me: ‘And He was numbered with the transgressors.’ For what is written about Me is reaching its fulfillment.”
aov_text: Want Ek sê vir julle dat dít wat geskrywe is, nog aan My vervul moet word: En Hy is saam met misdadigers gereken. Want ook aan die dinge wat betrekking het op My, kom daar ’n einde.

kjv_text: And they said, Lord, behold, here are two swords. And he said unto them, It is enough.
bsb_text: So they said, “Look, Lord, here are two swords.” “That is enough,” He answered.
aov_text: Hulle sê vir Hom: Here, kyk, hier is twee swaarde. En Hy antwoord hulle: Dit is genoeg.

kjv_text: And he came out, and went, as he was wont, to the mount of Olives; and his disciples also followed him.
bsb_text: Jesus went out as usual to the Mount of Olives, and the disciples followed Him.
aov_text: EN Hy het vertrek en volgens gewoonte na die Olyfberg gegaan. En ook sy dissipels het Hom gevolg.

kjv_text: And when he was at the place, he said unto them, Pray that ye enter not into temptation.
bsb_text: When He came to the place, He told them, “Pray that you will not enter into temptation.”
aov_text: En toe Hy op die plek kom, sê Hy vir hulle: Bid dat julle nie in versoeking kom nie.

kjv_text: And he was withdrawn from them about a stone's cast, and kneeled down, and prayed,
bsb_text: And He withdrew about a stone’s throw beyond them, where He knelt down and prayed,
aov_text: En Hy het Hom van hulle afgesonder omtrent so ver as ’n mens met ’n klip kan gooi, en neergekniel en gebid

kjv_text: Saying, Father, if thou be willing, remove this cup from me: nevertheless not my will, but thine, be done.
bsb_text: “Father, if You are willing, take this cup from Me. Yet not My will, but Yours be done.”
aov_text: en gesê: Vader, as U tog maar hierdie beker van My wil wegneem! Laat nogtans nie my wil nie, maar u wil geskied!

kjv_text: And there appeared an angel unto him from heaven, strengthening him.
bsb_text: Then an angel from heaven appeared to Him and strengthened Him.
aov_text: En ’n engel uit die hemel het aan Hom verskyn en Hom versterk.

kjv_text: And being in an agony he prayed more earnestly: and his sweat was as it were great drops of blood falling down to the ground.
bsb_text: And in His anguish, He prayed more earnestly, and His sweat became like drops of blood falling to the ground.
aov_text: En toe Hy in ’n sware stryd kom, het Hy met groter inspanning gebid, en sy sweet het geword soos bloeddruppels wat op die grond val.

kjv_text: And when he rose up from prayer, and was come to his disciples, he found them sleeping for sorrow,
bsb_text: When Jesus rose from prayer and returned to the disciples, He found them asleep, exhausted from sorrow.
aov_text: Toe staan Hy van die gebed op en kom by sy dissipels en vind hulle aan die slaap van droefheid.

kjv_text: And said unto them, Why sleep ye? rise and pray, lest ye enter into temptation.
bsb_text: “Why are you sleeping?” He asked. “Get up and pray so that you will not enter into temptation.”
aov_text: En Hy sê vir hulle: Wat slaap julle? Staan op en bid, dat julle nie in versoeking kom nie.

kjv_text: And while he yet spake, behold a multitude, and he that was called Judas, one of the twelve, went before them, and drew near unto Jesus to kiss him.
bsb_text: While He was still speaking, a crowd arrived, led by the man called Judas, one of the Twelve. He approached Jesus to kiss Him.
aov_text: EN terwyl Hy nog spreek, kom daar ’n skare; en hy wat Judas genoem word, een van die twaalf, het voor hulle uit geloop en nader gekom na Jesus om Hom te soen.

kjv_text: But Jesus said unto him, Judas, betrayest thou the Son of man with a kiss?
bsb_text: But Jesus asked him, “Judas, are you betraying the Son of Man with a kiss?”
aov_text: En Jesus sê vir hom: Judas, verraai jy die Seun van die mens met ’n kus?

kjv_text: When they which were about him saw what would follow, they said unto him, Lord, shall we smite with the sword?
bsb_text: Those around Jesus saw what was about to happen and said, “Lord, should we strike with our swords?”
aov_text: En toe die wat rondom Hom was, sien wat gaan gebeur, sê hulle vir Hom: Here, moet ons met die swaard slaan?

kjv_text: And one of them smote the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.
bsb_text: And one of them struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear.
aov_text: En een van hulle het die dienskneg van die hoëpriester getref en sy regteroor afgekap.

kjv_text: And Jesus answered and said, Suffer ye thus far. And he touched his ear, and healed him.
bsb_text: But Jesus answered, “No more of this!” And He touched the man’s ear and healed him.
aov_text: Maar Jesus het geantwoord en gesê: Hou op, dit is genoeg! En Hy het sy oor aangeraak en hom gesond gemaak.

kjv_text: Then Jesus said unto the chief priests, and captains of the temple, and the elders, which were come to him, Be ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and staves?
bsb_text: Then Jesus said to the chief priests, temple officers, and elders who had come for Him, “Have you come out with swords and clubs as you would against an outlaw?
aov_text: Toe sê Jesus vir die owerpriesters en hoofde van die tempel en ouderlinge wat teen Hom gekom het: Het julle uitgetrek soos teen ’n rower met swaarde en stokke?

kjv_text: When I was daily with you in the temple, ye stretched forth no hands against me: but this is your hour, and the power of darkness.
bsb_text: Every day I was with you in the temple courts, and you did not lay a hand on Me. But this hour belongs to you and to the power of darkness.”
aov_text: Dag vir dag was Ek saam met julle in die tempel, en julle het nie die hande teen My uitgesteek nie. Maar dit is julle uur en die mag van die duisternis.

kjv_text: Then took they him, and led him, and brought him into the high priest's house. And Peter followed afar off.
bsb_text: Then they seized Jesus, led Him away, and took Him into the house of the high priest. And Peter followed at a distance.
aov_text: EN hulle het Hom gevange geneem en weggelei en Hom gebring in die huis van die hoëpriester. En Petrus het van ver af gevolg.

kjv_text: And when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the hall, and were set down together, Peter sat down among them.
bsb_text: When those present had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and sat down together, Peter sat down among them.
aov_text: En toe hulle ’n vuur in die middel van die binneplaas van die paleis gemaak en bymekaar gaan sit het, het Petrus onder hulle gesit.

kjv_text: But a certain maid beheld him as he sat by the fire, and earnestly looked upon him, and said, This man was also with him.
bsb_text: A servant girl saw him seated in the firelight and looked intently at him. “This man also was with Him,” she said.
aov_text: En ’n diensmeisie het hom daar by die vuur sien sit; en nadat sy hom vas aangekyk het, sê sy: Hierdie man was ook saam met Hom.

kjv_text: And he denied him, saying, Woman, I know him not.
bsb_text: But Peter denied it. “Woman, I do not know Him,” he said.
aov_text: Maar hy het Hom verloën en gesê: Vrou, ek ken Hom nie.

kjv_text: And after a little while another saw him, and said, Thou art also of them. And Peter said, Man, I am not.
bsb_text: A short time later, someone else saw him and said, “You also are one of them.” But Peter said, “Man, I am not.”
aov_text: En kort daarna sien iemand anders hom en sê: Jy is ook een van hulle. Maar Petrus sê: Man, ek is nie.

kjv_text: And about the space of one hour after another confidently affirmed, saying, Of a truth this fellow also was with him: for he is a Galilaean.
bsb_text: About an hour later, another man insisted, “Certainly this man was with Him, for he too is a Galilean.”
aov_text: En ná verloop van omtrent een uur het ’n ander een dit verseker en gesê: Sowaar, hierdie man was ook saam met Hom, want hy is ook ’n Galiléër.

kjv_text: And Peter said, Man, I know not what thou sayest. And immediately, while he yet spake, the cock crew.
bsb_text: “Man, I do not know what you are talking about,” Peter replied. While he was still speaking, the rooster crowed.
aov_text: Maar Petrus antwoord: Man, ek weet nie wat jy sê nie. En onmiddellik, terwyl hy nog praat, het die haan gekraai.

kjv_text: And the Lord turned, and looked upon Peter. And Peter remembered the word of the Lord, how he had said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.
bsb_text: And the Lord turned and looked at Peter. Then Peter remembered the word that the Lord had spoken to him: “Before the rooster crows today, you will deny Me three times.”
aov_text: En die Here het Hom omgedraai en Petrus aangekyk, en Petrus het die woord van die Here onthou wat Hy vir hom gesê het: Voordat die haan kraai, sal jy My drie maal verloën.

kjv_text: And Peter went out, and wept bitterly.
bsb_text: And he went outside and wept bitterly.
aov_text: En Petrus het buitentoe gegaan en bitterlik geween.

kjv_text: And the men that held Jesus mocked him, and smote him.
bsb_text: The men who were holding Jesus began to mock Him and beat Him.
aov_text: EN die manne wat Jesus gevange gehou het, het Hom bespot en geslaan.

kjv_text: And when they had blindfolded him, they struck him on the face, and asked him, saying, Prophesy, who is it that smote thee?
bsb_text: They blindfolded Him and kept demanding, “Prophesy! Who hit You?”
aov_text: En hulle het Hom geblinddoek en Hom in die aangesig geslaan en Hom gevra en gesê: Profeteer wie dit is wat U geslaan het.

kjv_text: And many other things blasphemously spake they against him.
bsb_text: And they said many other blasphemous things against Him.
aov_text: En baie ander dinge het hulle lasterlik teen Hom gespreek.

kjv_text: And as soon as it was day, the elders of the people and the chief priests and the scribes came together, and led him into their council, saying,
bsb_text: At daybreak the council of the elders of the people, both the chief priests and scribes, met together. They led Jesus into their Sanhedrin and said,
aov_text: En toe dit dag word, het die oudstes van die volk — die owerpriesters en skrifgeleerdes — vergader en Hom voor hulle Raad gebring

kjv_text: Art thou the Christ? tell us. And he said unto them, If I tell you, ye will not believe:
bsb_text: “If You are the Christ, tell us.” Jesus answered, “If I tell you, you will not believe.
aov_text: en gesê: As U die Christus is, sê vir ons. En Hy antwoord hulle: As Ek vir u sê, sal u tog nie glo nie.

kjv_text: And if I also ask you, ye will not answer me, nor let me go.
bsb_text: And if I ask you a question, you will not answer.
aov_text: En as Ek vra, sal u My tog nie antwoord of loslaat nie.

kjv_text: Hereafter shall the Son of man sit on the right hand of the power of God.
bsb_text: But from now on the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God.”
aov_text: Van nou af sal die Seun van die mens sit aan die regterhand van die krag van God.

kjv_text: Then said they all, Art thou then the Son of God? And he said unto them, Ye say that I am.
bsb_text: So they all asked, “Are You then the Son of God?” He replied, “You say that I am.”
aov_text: En hulle sê almal: Is U dan die Seun van God? En Hy antwoord hulle: U sê dat Ek dit is.

kjv_text: And they said, What need we any further witness? for we ourselves have heard of his own mouth.
bsb_text: “Why do we need any more testimony?” they declared. “We have heard it for ourselves from His own lips.”
aov_text: Daarop sê hulle: Wat het ons nog getuienis nodig! Want ons het dit self uit sy mond gehoor.

kjv_text: And the whole multitude of them arose, and led him unto Pilate.
bsb_text: Then the whole council rose and led Jesus away to Pilate.
aov_text: EN die hele menigte van hulle het opgestaan en Hom na Pilatus gelei.

kjv_text: And they began to accuse him, saying, We found this fellow perverting the nation, and forbidding to give tribute to Caesar, saying that he himself is Christ a King.
bsb_text: And they began to accuse Him, saying, “We found this man subverting our nation, forbidding payment of taxes to Caesar, and proclaiming Himself to be Christ, a King.”
aov_text: En hulle het Hom begin beskuldig en sê: Ons het gevind dat hierdie man die volk verlei en verbied om aan die keiser belasting te betaal, terwyl Hy sê dat Hy self Christus, die Koning, is.

kjv_text: And Pilate asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answered him and said, Thou sayest it.
bsb_text: So Pilate asked Him, “Are You the King of the Jews?” “You have said so,” Jesus replied.
aov_text: Toe vra Pilatus Hom en sê: Is U die Koning van die Jode? En Hy antwoord hom en sê: U sê dit.

kjv_text: Then said Pilate to the chief priests and to the people, I find no fault in this man.
bsb_text: Then Pilate said to the chief priests and the crowds, “I find no basis for a charge against this man.”
aov_text: En Pilatus sê vir die owerpriesters en die skare: Ek vind geen skuld in hierdie man nie.

kjv_text: And they were the more fierce, saying, He stirreth up the people, teaching throughout all Jewry, beginning from Galilee to this place.
bsb_text: But they kept insisting, “He stirs up the people all over Judea with His teaching. He began in Galilee and has come all the way here.”
aov_text: Maar hulle het aangehou en gesê: Hy maak die volk oproerig met sy leer die hele Judéa deur, vandat Hy in Galiléa begin het tot hiertoe.

kjv_text: When Pilate heard of Galilee, he asked whether the man were a Galilaean.
bsb_text: When Pilate heard this, he asked if the man was a Galilean.
aov_text: En toe Pilatus van Galiléa hoor, vra hy of die man ’n Galiléër is.

kjv_text: And as soon as he knew that he belonged unto Herod's jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who himself also was at Jerusalem at that time.
bsb_text: And learning that Jesus was under Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent Him to Herod, who himself was in Jerusalem at that time.
aov_text: En nadat hy verneem het dat Hy uit die magsgebied van Herodes was, stuur hy Hom na Herodes wat self ook in daardie dae in Jerusalem was.

kjv_text: And when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceeding glad: for he was desirous to see him of a long season, because he had heard many things of him; and he hoped to have seen some miracle done by him.
bsb_text: When Herod saw Jesus, he was greatly pleased. He had wanted to see Him for a long time, because he had heard about Him and was hoping to see Him perform a miracle.
aov_text: En toe Herodes Jesus sien, was hy baie bly, want hy was al geruime tyd begerig om Hom te sien, omdat hy veel van Hom gehoor het; en hy het gehoop om een of ander teken te sien wat deur Hom gedoen sou word.

kjv_text: Then he questioned with him in many words; but he answered him nothing.
bsb_text: Herod questioned Jesus at great length, but He gave no answer.
aov_text: En hy het Hom met baie woorde uitgevra, maar Hy het hom niks geantwoord nie.

kjv_text: And the chief priests and scribes stood and vehemently accused him.
bsb_text: Meanwhile, the chief priests and scribes stood there, vehemently accusing Him.
aov_text: En die owerpriesters en die skrifgeleerdes het Hom heftig staan en beskuldig.

kjv_text: And Herod with his men of war set him at nought, and mocked him, and arrayed him in a gorgeous robe, and sent him again to Pilate.
bsb_text: And even Herod and his soldiers ridiculed and mocked Him. Dressing Him in a fine robe, they sent Him back to Pilate.
aov_text: En nadat Herodes saam met sy soldate Hom met veragting behandel en bespot het, werp hy Hom ’n blink kleed om en stuur Hom terug na Pilatus.

kjv_text: And the same day Pilate and Herod were made friends together: for before they were at enmity between themselves.
bsb_text: That day Herod and Pilate became friends; before this time they had been enemies.
aov_text: En Pilatus en Herodes het op daardie dag goeie vriende geword, want hulle was vantevore in vyandskap teenoor mekaar.

kjv_text: And Pilate, when he had called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people,
bsb_text: Then Pilate called together the chief priests, the rulers, and the people,
aov_text: Toe roep Pilatus die owerpriesters en die owerstes en die volk bymekaar en sê vir hulle:

kjv_text: Said unto them, Ye have brought this man unto me, as one that perverteth the people: and, behold, I, having examined him before you, have found no fault in this man touching those things whereof ye accuse him:
bsb_text: and said to them, “You brought me this man as one who was inciting the people to rebellion. I have examined Him here in your presence and found Him not guilty of your charges against Him.
aov_text: Julle het hierdie man na my gebring as een wat die volk afvallig maak. En nou het ek in julle teenwoordigheid ondersoek ingestel en in hierdie man geen skuld gevind aan die dinge waarvan julle Hom beskuldig nie;

kjv_text: No, nor yet Herod: for I sent you to him; and, lo, nothing worthy of death is done unto him.
bsb_text: Neither has Herod, for he sent Him back to us. As you can see, He has done nothing deserving of death.
aov_text: ja, ook Herodes nie, want ek het julle na hom gestuur; en daar is deur Hom niks gedoen wat die dood verdien nie.

kjv_text: I will therefore chastise him, and release him.
bsb_text: Therefore I will punish Him and release Him.”
aov_text: Nadat ek Hom dan gekasty het, sal ek Hom loslaat.

kjv_text: (For of necessity he must release one unto them at the feast.)
aov_text: En hy was verplig om vir hulle op die fees een los te laat.

kjv_text: And they cried out all at once, saying, Away with this man, and release unto us Barabbas:
bsb_text: But they all cried out in unison: “Away with this man! Release Barabbas to us!”
aov_text: Maar die hele menigte skreeu en sê: Weg met Hom, en laat vir ons Barábbas los!

kjv_text: (Who for a certain sedition made in the city, and for murder, was cast into prison.)
bsb_text: (Barabbas had been imprisoned for an insurrection in the city, and for murder.)
aov_text: Dié was oor ’n sekere opstand wat in die stad plaasgevind het, en oor ’n moord in die gevangenis gewerp.

kjv_text: Pilate therefore, willing to release Jesus, spake again to them.
bsb_text: Wanting to release Jesus, Pilate addressed them again,
aov_text: Daarop spreek Pilatus hulle weer toe, omdat hy Jesus wou loslaat;

kjv_text: But they cried, saying, Crucify him, crucify him.
bsb_text: but they kept shouting, “Crucify Him! Crucify Him!”
aov_text: maar hulle het aangehou roep en sê: Kruisig, kruisig Hom!

kjv_text: And he said unto them the third time, Why, what evil hath he done? I have found no cause of death in him: I will therefore chastise him, and let him go.
bsb_text: A third time he said to them, “What evil has this man done? I have found in Him no offense worthy of death. So after I punish Him, I will release Him.”
aov_text: En vir die derde keer sê hy vir hulle: Watter kwaad het Hy dan gedoen? Ek het in Hom niks gevind wat die dood verdien nie. Ek sal Hom dan kasty en loslaat.

kjv_text: And they were instant with loud voices, requiring that he might be crucified. And the voices of them and of the chief priests prevailed.
bsb_text: But they were insistent, demanding with loud voices for Jesus to be crucified. And their clamor prevailed.
aov_text: Maar hulle het aangehou met ’n harde geroep en geëis dat Hy gekruisig moes word; en hulle geroep en dié van die owerpriesters het die oorhand gekry.

kjv_text: And Pilate gave sentence that it should be as they required.
bsb_text: So Pilate sentenced that their demand be met.
aov_text: Toe gee Pilatus uitspraak dat aan hulle eis voldoen moet word.

kjv_text: And he released unto them him that for sedition and murder was cast into prison, whom they had desired; but he delivered Jesus to their will.
bsb_text: As they had requested, he released the one imprisoned for insurrection and murder, and handed Jesus over to their will.
aov_text: En hy het die een vir hulle losgelaat wat oor opstand en moord in die gevangenis gewerp was, die een wat hulle geëis het. Maar Jesus het hy aan hulle wil oorgelewer.

kjv_text: And as they led him away, they laid hold upon one Simon, a Cyrenian, coming out of the country, and on him they laid the cross, that he might bear it after Jesus.
bsb_text: As the soldiers led Him away, they seized Simon of Cyrene on his way in from the country, and put the cross on him to carry behind Jesus.
aov_text: EN toe hulle Hom weglei, neem hulle ’n sekere Simon van Ciréne wat van die veld af gekom het, en sit die kruis op hom om dit agter Jesus aan te dra.

kjv_text: And there followed him a great company of people, and of women, which also bewailed and lamented him.
bsb_text: A great number of people followed Him, including women who kept mourning and wailing for Him.
aov_text: En ’n groot menigte van die volk het Hom gevolg, en vroue wat rou bedryf en Hom beklaag het.

kjv_text: But Jesus turning unto them said, Daughters of Jerusalem, weep not for me, but weep for yourselves, and for your children.
bsb_text: But Jesus turned to them and said, “Daughters of Jerusalem, do not weep for Me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.
aov_text: Maar Jesus het Hom omgedraai en vir hulle gesê: Dogters van Jerusalem, moenie oor My ween nie, maar ween oor julleself en oor julle kinders;

kjv_text: For, behold, the days are coming, in the which they shall say, Blessed are the barren, and the wombs that never bare, and the paps which never gave suck.
bsb_text: Look, the days are coming when people will say, ‘Blessed are the barren women, the wombs that never bore, and breasts that never nursed!’
aov_text: want daar kom dae waarin hulle sal sê: Gelukkig is die onvrugbares en die moederskote wat nie gebaar en die borste wat nie gesoog het nie.

kjv_text: Then shall they begin to say to the mountains, Fall on us; and to the hills, Cover us.
bsb_text: At that time ‘they will say to the mountains, “Fall on us!” and to the hills, “Cover us!”’
aov_text: Dan sal hulle vir die berge begin sê: Val op ons! en vir die heuwels: Bedek ons!

kjv_text: For if they do these things in a green tree, what shall be done in the dry?
bsb_text: For if men do these things while the tree is green, what will happen when it is dry?”
aov_text: Want as hulle dit doen aan die groen hout, wat sal met die droë gebeur!

kjv_text: And there were also two other, malefactors, led with him to be put to death.
bsb_text: Two others, who were criminals, were also led away to be executed with Jesus.
aov_text: En daar is nog twee ander, kwaaddoeners, weggelei om saam met Hom tereggestel te word.

kjv_text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
bsb_text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
aov_text: IN die begin was die Woord, en die Woord was by God, en die Woord was God.

kjv_text: The same was in the beginning with God.
bsb_text: He was with God in the beginning.
aov_text: Hy was in die begin by God.

kjv_text: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.
bsb_text: Through Him all things were made, and without Him nothing was made that has been made.
aov_text: Alle dinge het deur Hom ontstaan, en sonder Hom het nie een ding ontstaan wat ontstaan het nie.

kjv_text: In him was life; and the life was the light of men.
bsb_text: In Him was life, and that life was the light of men.
aov_text: In Hom was lewe, en die lewe was die lig van die mense.

kjv_text: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.
bsb_text: The Light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it.
aov_text: En die lig skyn in die duisternis, en die duisternis het dit nie oorweldig nie.

kjv_text: There was a man sent from God, whose name was John.
bsb_text: There came a man who was sent from God. His name was John.
aov_text: Daar was ’n man van God gestuur, wie se naam Johannes was.

kjv_text: The same came for a witness, to bear witness of the Light, that all men through him might believe.
bsb_text: He came as a witness to testify about the Light, so that through him everyone might believe.
aov_text: Hy het tot ’n getuienis gekom om van die lig te getuig, sodat almal deur hom sou glo.

kjv_text: He was not that Light, but was sent to bear witness of that Light.
bsb_text: He himself was not the Light, but he came to testify about the Light.
aov_text: Hy was nie die lig nie, maar hy moes van die lig getuig.

kjv_text: That was the true Light, which lighteth every man that cometh into the world.
bsb_text: The true Light who gives light to every man was coming into the world.
aov_text: Die waaragtige lig wat elke mens verlig, was aan kom in die wêreld.

kjv_text: He was in the world, and the world was made by him, and the world knew him not.
bsb_text: He was in the world, and though the world was made through Him, the world did not recognize Him.
aov_text: Hy was in die wêreld, en die wêreld het deur Hom ontstaan, en die wêreld het Hom nie geken nie.

kjv_text: He came unto his own, and his own received him not.
bsb_text: He came to His own, and His own did not receive Him.
aov_text: Hy het na sy eiendom gekom, en sy eie mense het Hom nie aangeneem nie.

kjv_text: But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name:
bsb_text: But to all who did receive Him, to those who believed in His name, He gave the right to become children of God—
aov_text: Maar almal wat Hom aangeneem het, aan hulle het Hy mag gegee om kinders van God te word, aan hulle wat in sy Naam glo;

kjv_text: Which were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.
bsb_text: children born not of blood, nor of the desire or will of man, but born of God.
aov_text: wat nie uit die bloed of uit die wil van die vlees of uit die wil van ’n man nie, maar uit God gebore is.

kjv_text: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.
bsb_text: The Word became flesh and made His dwelling among us. We have seen His glory, the glory of the one and only Son from the Father, full of grace and truth.
aov_text: En die Woord het vlees geword en het onder ons gewoon — en ons het sy heerlikheid aanskou, ’n heerlikheid soos van die Eniggeborene wat van die Vader kom — vol van genade en waarheid.

kjv_text: John bare witness of him, and cried, saying, This was he of whom I spake, He that cometh after me is preferred before me: for he was before me.
bsb_text: John testified concerning Him. He cried out, saying, “This is He of whom I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me because He was before me.’”
aov_text: JOHANNES getuig van Hom en roep en sê: Dit was Hy van wie ek gesê het: Hy wat ná my kom, het voor my geword, want Hy was eerder as ek.

kjv_text: And of his fulness have all we received, and grace for grace.
bsb_text: From His fullness we have all received grace upon grace.
aov_text: En uit sy volheid het ons almal ontvang, ja, genade op genade.

kjv_text: For the law was given by Moses, but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ.
bsb_text: For the law was given through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.
aov_text: Want die wet is deur Moses gegee; die genade en die waarheid het deur Jesus Christus gekom.

kjv_text: No man hath seen God at any time; the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared him.
bsb_text: No one has ever seen God, but the one and only Son, who is Himself God and is at the Father’s side, has made Him known.
aov_text: Niemand het ooit God gesien nie; die eniggebore Seun wat in die boesem van die Vader is, dié het Hom verklaar.

kjv_text: And this is the record of John, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, Who art thou?
bsb_text: And this was John’s testimony when the Jews of Jerusalem sent priests and Levites to ask him, “Who are you?”
aov_text: En dit is die getuienis van Johannes, toe die Jode uit Jerusalem priesters en Leviete gestuur het om hom te vra: Wie is u?

kjv_text: And he confessed, and denied not; but confessed, I am not the Christ.
bsb_text: He did not refuse to confess, but openly declared, “I am not the Christ.”
aov_text: En hy het erken en nie ontken nie, maar het erken: Ek is nie die Christus nie.

kjv_text: And they asked him, What then? Art thou Elias? And he saith, I am not. Art thou that prophet? And he answered, No.
bsb_text: “Then who are you?” they inquired. “Are you Elijah?” He said, “I am not.” “Are you the Prophet?” He answered, “No.”
aov_text: Toe vra hulle hom: Wat dan? Is u Elía? En hy sê: Ek is nie. Is u die profeet? En hy antwoord: Nee.

kjv_text: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? that we may give an answer to them that sent us. What sayest thou of thyself?
bsb_text: So they said to him, “Who are you? We need an answer for those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?”
aov_text: Toe sê hulle vir hom: Wie is u?  — dat ons antwoord kan gee aan die wat ons gestuur het. Wat sê u van uself?

kjv_text: He said, I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make straight the way of the Lord, as said the prophet Esaias.
bsb_text: John replied in the words of Isaiah the prophet: “I am a voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way for the Lord.’”
aov_text: Hy antwoord: Ek is die stem van een wat roep in die woestyn: Maak die pad van die Here reguit! soos Jesaja, die profeet, gesê het.

kjv_text: And they which were sent were of the Pharisees.
bsb_text: Then the Pharisees who had been sent
aov_text: En die wat gestuur was, was uit die Fariseërs.

kjv_text: And they asked him, and said unto him, Why baptizest thou then, if thou be not that Christ, nor Elias, neither that prophet?
bsb_text: asked him, “Why then do you baptize, if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the Prophet?”
aov_text: En hulle vra hom en sê vir hom: Waarom doop u dan as u nie die Christus of Elía of die profeet is nie?

kjv_text: John answered them, saying, I baptize with water: but there standeth one among you, whom ye know not;
bsb_text: “I baptize with water,” John replied, “but among you stands One you do not know.
aov_text: Johannes antwoord hulle en sê: Ek doop met water, maar onder julle staan Hy vir wie julle nie ken nie  —

kjv_text: He it is, who coming after me is preferred before me, whose shoe's latchet I am not worthy to unloose.
bsb_text: He is the One who comes after me, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to untie.”
aov_text: dit is Hy wat ná my kom, wat voor my geword het, wie se skoenriem ek nie waardig is om los te maak nie.

kjv_text: These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan, where John was baptizing.
bsb_text: All this happened at Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.
aov_text: Dit het gebeur in Betábara, oorkant die Jordaan, waar Johannes besig was om te doop.

kjv_text: The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world.
bsb_text: The next day John saw Jesus coming toward him and said, “Look, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!
aov_text: Die volgende dag sien Johannes Jesus na hom toe kom, en hy sê: Dáár is die Lam van God wat die sonde van die wêreld wegneem!

kjv_text: This is he of whom I said, After me cometh a man which is preferred before me: for he was before me.
bsb_text: This is He of whom I said, ‘A man who comes after me has surpassed me because He was before me.’
aov_text: Dit is Hy van wie ek gesê het: Ná my kom ’n man wat voor my geword het, want Hy was eerder as ek.

kjv_text: And I knew him not: but that he should be made manifest to Israel, therefore am I come baptizing with water.
bsb_text: I myself did not know Him, but the reason I came baptizing with water was that He might be revealed to Israel.”
aov_text: En ek het Hom nie geken nie; maar dat Hy aan Israel openbaar sou word, daarom het ek gekom en met water gedoop.

kjv_text: And John bare record, saying, I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove, and it abode upon him.
bsb_text: Then John testified, “I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove and resting on Him.
aov_text: En Johannes het getuig en gesê: Ek het die Gees soos ’n duif uit die hemel sien neerdaal, en Hy het op Hom gebly.

kjv_text: And I knew him not: but he that sent me to baptize with water, the same said unto me, Upon whom thou shalt see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him, the same is he which baptizeth with the Holy Ghost.
bsb_text: I myself did not know Him, but the One who sent me to baptize with water told me, ‘The man on whom you see the Spirit descend and rest is He who will baptize with the Holy Spirit.’
aov_text: En ek het Hom nie geken nie; maar Hy wat my gestuur het om met water te doop, Hy het aan my gesê: Op wie jy die Gees sien neerdaal en op Hom bly, dit is Hy wat met die Heilige Gees doop.

kjv_text: And I saw, and bare record that this is the Son of God.
bsb_text: I have seen and testified that this is the Son of God.”
aov_text: En ek het gesien en getuig dat Hy die Seun van God is.

kjv_text: Again the next day after John stood, and two of his disciples;
bsb_text: The next day John was there again with two of his disciples.
aov_text: DIE volgende dag het Johannes weer daar gestaan en twee van sy dissipels;

kjv_text: And looking upon Jesus as he walked, he saith, Behold the Lamb of God!
bsb_text: When he saw Jesus walking by, he said, “Look, the Lamb of God!”
aov_text: en toe hy Jesus sien wandel, sê hy: Dáár is die Lam van God!

kjv_text: And the two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.
bsb_text: And when the two disciples heard him say this, they followed Jesus.
aov_text: En die twee dissipels het hom dit hoor sê en Jesus gevolg.

kjv_text: Then Jesus turned, and saw them following, and saith unto them,
bsb_text: Jesus turned and saw them following.
aov_text: En toe Jesus Hom omdraai en hulle sien volg, sê Hy vir hulle:

kjv_text: What seek ye? They said unto him, Rabbi, (which is to say, being interpreted, Master,) where dwellest thou?
bsb_text: “What do you want?” He asked. They said to Him, “Rabbi” (which means Teacher), “where are You staying?”
aov_text: Wat soek julle? En hulle antwoord Hom: Rabbi — dit wil sê, as dit vertaal word, Meester — waar is U tuis?

kjv_text: He saith unto them, Come and see. They came and saw where he dwelt, and abode with him that day: for it was about the tenth hour.
bsb_text: “Come and see,” He replied. So they went and saw where He was staying, and spent that day with Him. It was about the tenth hour.
aov_text: Hy sê vir hulle: Kom kyk. Hulle het gegaan en gesien waar Hy tuis was en dié dag by Hom gebly. En dit was omtrent die tiende uur.

kjv_text: One of the two which heard John speak, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter's brother.
bsb_text: Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, was one of the two who heard John’s testimony and followed Jesus.
aov_text: Andréas, die broer van Simon Petrus, was een van die twee wat dit van Johannes gehoor en Hom gevolg het.

kjv_text: He first findeth his own brother Simon, and saith unto him, We have found the Messias, which is, being interpreted, the Christ.
bsb_text: He first found his brother Simon and told him, “We have found the Messiah” (which is translated as Christ).
aov_text: Hy het eers sy eie broer Simon gekry en vir hom gesê: Ons het die Messías gevind — dit is, as dit vertaal word, die Christus.

kjv_text: And he brought him to Jesus. And when Jesus beheld him, he said, Thou art Simon the son of Jona: thou shalt be called Cephas, which is by interpretation, A stone.
bsb_text: Andrew brought him to Jesus, who looked at him and said, “You are Simon son of John. You will be called Cephas” (which is translated as Peter).
aov_text: En hy het hom na Jesus gelei. Toe kyk Jesus hom aan en sê: Jy is Simon, die seun van Jona; jy sal genoem word Cefas, wat vertaal word Petrus.

kjv_text: The day following Jesus would go forth into Galilee, and findeth Philip, and saith unto him, Follow me.
bsb_text: The next day Jesus decided to set out for Galilee. Finding Philip, He told him, “Follow Me.”
aov_text: Die volgende dag wou Jesus na Galiléa vertrek; en Hy het Filippus gekry en vir hom gesê: Volg My.
