kjv_text: Now Philip was of Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.
bsb_text: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, the same town as Andrew and Peter.
aov_text: En Filippus was van Betsáida, uit die stad van Andréas en Petrus.

kjv_text: Philip findeth Nathanael, and saith unto him, We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, did write, Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.
bsb_text: Philip found Nathanael and told him, “We have found the One Moses wrote about in the Law, the One the prophets foretold—Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.”
aov_text: Filippus het Natánael gekry en vir hom gesê: Ons het Hom gevind van wie Moses in die wet en ook die profete geskrywe het: Jesus, die seun van Josef van Násaret.

kjv_text: And Nathanael said unto him, Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip saith unto him, Come and see.
bsb_text: “Can anything good come from Nazareth?” Nathanael asked. “Come and see,” said Philip.
aov_text: En Natánael sê vir hom: Kan daar uit Násaret iets goeds wees? Filippus antwoord hom: Kom kyk.

kjv_text: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and saith of him, Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!
bsb_text: When Jesus saw Nathanael approaching, He said of him, “Here is a true Israelite, in whom there is no deceit.”
aov_text: Daarop sien Jesus Natánael na Hom toe kom en sê vir hom: Hier is waarlik ’n Israeliet in wie daar geen bedrog is nie.

kjv_text: Nathanael saith unto him, Whence knowest thou me? Jesus answered and said unto him, Before that Philip called thee, when thou wast under the fig tree, I saw thee.
bsb_text: “How do You know me?” Nathanael asked. Jesus replied, “Before Philip called you, I saw you under the fig tree.”
aov_text: Natánael sê vir Hom: Waarvandaan ken U my? Jesus antwoord en sê vir hom: Voordat Filippus jou geroep het toe jy onder die vyeboom was, het Ek jou gesien.

kjv_text: Nathanael answered and saith unto him, Rabbi, thou art the Son of God; thou art the King of Israel.
bsb_text: “Rabbi,” Nathanael answered, “You are the Son of God! You are the King of Israel!”
aov_text: Natánael antwoord en sê vir Hom: Rabbi, U is die Seun van God, U is die Koning van Israel!

kjv_text: Jesus answered and said unto him, Because I said unto thee, I saw thee under the fig tree, believest thou? thou shalt see greater things than these.
bsb_text: Jesus said to him, “Do you believe just because I told you I saw you under the fig tree? You will see greater things than these.”
aov_text: Jesus antwoord en sê vir hom: Glo jy omdat Ek vir jou gesê het: Ek het jou onder die vyeboom gesien? Jy sal groter dinge sien as dit.

kjv_text: And he saith unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Hereafter ye shall see heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man.
bsb_text: Then He declared, “Truly, truly, I tell you, you will all see heaven open and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.”
aov_text: En Hy sê vir hom: Voorwaar, voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, van nou af sal julle die hemel geopend sien en die engele van God opklim en neerdaal op die Seun van die mens.

kjv_text: And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee; and the mother of Jesus was there:
bsb_text: On the third day a wedding took place at Cana in Galilee. Jesus’ mother was there,
aov_text: EN op die derde dag was daar ’n bruilof te Kana in Galiléa, en die moeder van Jesus was daar.

kjv_text: And both Jesus was called, and his disciples, to the marriage.
bsb_text: and Jesus and His disciples had also been invited to the wedding.
aov_text: En Jesus en sy dissipels was ook na die bruilof genooi.

kjv_text: And when they wanted wine, the mother of Jesus saith unto him, They have no wine.
bsb_text: When the wine ran out, Jesus’ mother said to Him, “They have no more wine.”
aov_text: En toe daar wyn kortkom, sê die moeder van Jesus vir Hom: Hulle het geen wyn nie.

kjv_text: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, what have I to do with thee? mine hour is not yet come.
bsb_text: “Woman, why does this concern us?” Jesus replied. “My hour has not yet come.”
aov_text: Jesus sê vir haar: Vrou, wat het Ek met u te doen? My uur het nog nie gekom nie.

kjv_text: His mother saith unto the servants, Whatsoever he saith unto you, do it.
bsb_text: His mother said to the servants, “Do whatever He tells you.”
aov_text: Sy moeder sê vir die dienaars: Net wat Hy vir julle sê, moet julle doen.

kjv_text: And there were set there six waterpots of stone, after the manner of the purifying of the Jews, containing two or three firkins apiece.
bsb_text: Now six stone water jars had been set there for the Jewish rites of purification. Each could hold from twenty to thirty gallons.
aov_text: En daar het volgens die reinigingsgebruike van die Jode ses klipkanne gestaan, wat elkeen twee of drie ankers hou.

kjv_text: Jesus saith unto them, Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them up to the brim.
bsb_text: Jesus told the servants, “Fill the jars with water.” So they filled them to the brim.
aov_text: Jesus sê vir hulle: Maak die kanne vol water. En hulle het hul tot bo toe volgemaak.

kjv_text: And he saith unto them, Draw out now, and bear unto the governor of the feast. And they bare it.
bsb_text: “Now draw some out,” He said, “and take it to the master of the banquet.” They did so,
aov_text: En Hy sê aan hulle: Skep nou uit en bring dit vir die hoofdienaar. En hulle het dit gebring.

kjv_text: When the ruler of the feast had tasted the water that was made wine, and knew not whence it was: (but the servants which drew the water knew;) the governor of the feast called the bridegroom,
bsb_text: and the master of the banquet tasted the water that had been turned into wine. He did not know where it was from, but the servants who had drawn the water knew. Then he called the bridegroom aside
aov_text: En toe die hoofdienaar die water proe wat wyn geword het — en hy het nie geweet waarvandaan dit was nie, maar die dienaars wat die water geskep het, het geweet — roep die hoofdienaar die bruidegom

kjv_text: And saith unto him, Every man at the beginning doth set forth good wine; and when men have well drunk, then that which is worse: but thou hast kept the good wine until now.
bsb_text: and said, “Everyone serves the fine wine first, and then the cheap wine after the guests are drunk. But you have saved the fine wine until now!”
aov_text: en sê vir hom: Elke mens sit eers die goeie wyn op en, wanneer hulle goed gedrink het, dan die slegste; maar u het die goeie wyn tot nou toe bewaar.

kjv_text: This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him.
bsb_text: Jesus performed this, the first of His signs, at Cana in Galilee. He thus revealed His glory, and His disciples believed in Him.
aov_text: Hierdie eerste een van sy tekens het Jesus te Kana in Galiléa gedoen; en Hy het sy heerlikheid geopenbaar, en sy dissipels het in Hom geglo.

kjv_text: After this he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, and his brethren, and his disciples: and they continued there not many days.
bsb_text: After this, He went down to Capernaum with His mother and brothers and His disciples, and they stayed there a few days.
aov_text: Daarna het Hy na Kapérnaüm afgegaan, Hy en sy moeder en sy broers en sy dissipels, en hulle het daar nie baie dae gebly nie.

kjv_text: And the Jews' passover was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem,
bsb_text: When the Jewish Passover was near, Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
aov_text: EN die pasga van die Jode was naby, en Jesus het opgegaan na Jerusalem.

kjv_text: And found in the temple those that sold oxen and sheep and doves, and the changers of money sitting:
bsb_text: In the temple courts He found men selling cattle, sheep, and doves, and money changers seated at their tables.
aov_text: En Hy het in die tempel gevind die wat beeste en skape en duiwe verkoop, en die geldwisselaars wat daar sit.

kjv_text: And when he had made a scourge of small cords, he drove them all out of the temple, and the sheep, and the oxen; and poured out the changers' money, and overthrew the tables;
bsb_text: So He made a whip out of cords and drove all from the temple courts, both sheep and cattle. He poured out the coins of the money changers and overturned their tables.
aov_text: En Hy het ’n sweep van toutjies gemaak en almal uit die tempel uitgedrywe, ook die skape en die beeste, en die kleingeld van die wisselaars het Hy uitgegooi en hulle tafels omgekeer.

kjv_text: And said unto them that sold doves, Take these things hence; make not my Father's house an house of merchandise.
bsb_text: To those selling doves He said, “Get these out of here! How dare you turn My Father’s house into a marketplace!”
aov_text: En vir die duiweverkopers het Hy gesê: Neem daardie dinge hier weg; moenie die huis van my Vader ’n handelshuis maak nie.

kjv_text: And his disciples remembered that it was written, The zeal of thine house hath eaten me up.
bsb_text: His disciples remembered that it is written: “Zeal for Your house will consume Me.”
aov_text: En sy dissipels het onthou dat daar geskrywe is: Die ywer vir u huis het my verteer.

kjv_text: Then answered the Jews and said unto him, What sign shewest thou unto us, seeing that thou doest these things?
bsb_text: On account of this, the Jews demanded, “What sign can You show us to prove Your authority to do these things?”
aov_text: Toe antwoord die Jode en sê vir Hom: Watter teken toon U aan ons, dat U hierdie dinge doen?

kjv_text: Jesus answered and said unto them, Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.
bsb_text: Jesus answered, “Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up again.”
aov_text: Jesus antwoord en sê vir hulle: Breek hierdie tempel af, en in drie dae sal Ek dit oprig.

kjv_text: Then said the Jews, Forty and six years was this temple in building, and wilt thou rear it up in three days?
bsb_text: “This temple took forty-six years to build,” the Jews replied, “and You are going to raise it up in three days?”
aov_text: En die Jode sê: Ses-en-veertig jaar lank is aan hierdie tempel gebou, en U, sal U dit in drie dae oprig?

kjv_text: But he spake of the temple of his body.
bsb_text: But Jesus was speaking about the temple of His body.
aov_text: Maar Hy het oor die tempel van sy liggaam gespreek.

kjv_text: When therefore he was risen from the dead, his disciples remembered that he had said this unto them; and they believed the scripture, and the word which Jesus had said.
bsb_text: After He was raised from the dead, His disciples remembered that He had said this. Then they believed the Scripture and the word that Jesus had spoken.
aov_text: En toe Hy opgestaan het uit die dode, het sy dissipels onthou dat Hy dit vir hulle gesê het; en hulle het die Skrif geglo en die woord wat Jesus gespreek het.

kjv_text: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the passover, in the feast day, many believed in his name, when they saw the miracles which he did.
bsb_text: While He was in Jerusalem at the Passover Feast, many people saw the signs He was doing and believed in His name.
aov_text: En toe Hy in Jerusalem was op die pasga gedurende die fees, het baie in sy Naam geglo, omdat hulle die tekens gesien het wat Hy doen.

kjv_text: But Jesus did not commit himself unto them, because he knew all men,
bsb_text: But Jesus did not entrust Himself to them, for He knew them all.
aov_text: Maar Jesus self het Hom aan hulle nie toevertrou nie, omdat Hy almal geken het

kjv_text: And needed not that any should testify of man: for he knew what was in man.
bsb_text: He did not need any testimony about man, for He knew what was in a man.
aov_text: en omdat Hy nie nodig gehad het dat iemand van die mens sou getuig nie; want Hy self het geweet wat in die mens is.

kjv_text: There was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews:
bsb_text: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a leader of the Jews.
aov_text: EN daar was ’n man uit die Fariseërs met die naam van Nikodémus, ’n owerste van die Jode.

kjv_text: The same came to Jesus by night, and said unto him, Rabbi, we know that thou art a teacher come from God: for no man can do these miracles that thou doest, except God be with him.
bsb_text: He came to Jesus at night and said, “Rabbi, we know that You are a teacher who has come from God. For no one could perform the signs You are doing if God were not with him.”
aov_text: Hy het in die nag na Jesus gekom en vir Hom gesê: Rabbi, ons weet dat U ’n leraar is wat van God gekom het, want niemand kan hierdie tekens doen wat U doen as God nie met Hom is nie.

kjv_text: Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.
bsb_text: Jesus replied, “Truly, truly, I tell you, no one can see the kingdom of God unless he is born again.”
aov_text: Jesus antwoord en sê vir hom: Voorwaar, voorwaar Ek sê vir jou, as iemand nie weer gebore word nie, kan hy die koninkryk van God nie sien nie.

kjv_text: Nicodemus saith unto him, How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter the second time into his mother's womb, and be born?
bsb_text: “How can a man be born when he is old?” Nicodemus asked. “Can he enter his mother’s womb a second time to be born?”
aov_text: Nikodémus sê vir Hom: Hoe kan ’n mens as hy oud is, gebore word? Hy kan tog nie ’n tweede keer in die skoot van sy moeder ingaan en gebore word nie?

kjv_text: Jesus answered, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.
bsb_text: Jesus answered, “Truly, truly, I tell you, no one can enter the kingdom of God unless he is born of water and the Spirit.
aov_text: Jesus antwoord: Voorwaar, voorwaar Ek sê vir jou, as iemand nie gebore word uit water en Gees nie, kan hy in die koninkryk van God nie ingaan nie.

kjv_text: That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.
bsb_text: Flesh is born of flesh, but spirit is born of the Spirit.
aov_text: Wat uit die vlees gebore is, is vlees; en wat uit die Gees gebore is, is gees.

kjv_text: Marvel not that I said unto thee, Ye must be born again.
bsb_text: Do not be amazed that I said, ‘You must be born again.’
aov_text: Moenie jou verwonder dat Ek vir jou gesê het, julle moet weer gebore word nie.

kjv_text: The wind bloweth where it listeth, and thou hearest the sound thereof, but canst not tell whence it cometh, and whither it goeth: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.
bsb_text: The wind blows where it wishes. You hear its sound, but you do not know where it comes from or where it is going. So it is with everyone born of the Spirit.”
aov_text: Die wind waai waar hy wil, en jy hoor sy geluid, maar jy weet nie vanwaar hy kom en waarheen hy gaan nie. So is elkeen wat uit die Gees gebore is.

kjv_text: Nicodemus answered and said unto him, How can these things be?
bsb_text: “How can this be?” Nicodemus asked.
aov_text: Nikodémus antwoord en sê vir Hom: Hoe kan hierdie dinge gebeur?

kjv_text: Jesus answered and said unto him, Art thou a master of Israel, and knowest not these things?
bsb_text: “You are Israel’s teacher,” said Jesus, “and you do not understand these things?
aov_text: Jesus antwoord en sê vir hom: Jy is die leraar van Israel en jy weet hierdie dinge nie?

kjv_text: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, We speak that we do know, and testify that we have seen; and ye receive not our witness.
bsb_text: Truly, truly, I tell you, we speak of what we know, and we testify to what we have seen, and yet you people do not accept our testimony.
aov_text: Voorwaar, voorwaar Ek sê vir jou, ons spreek wat ons weet en ons getuig van wat ons gesien het, en julle neem ons getuienis nie aan nie.

kjv_text: If I have told you earthly things, and ye believe not, how shall ye believe, if I tell you of heavenly things?
bsb_text: If I have told you about earthly things and you do not believe, how will you believe if I tell you about heavenly things?
aov_text: As Ek julle van die aardse dinge vertel en julle nie glo nie, hoe sal julle glo as Ek julle van die hemelse vertel?

kjv_text: And no man hath ascended up to heaven, but he that came down from heaven, even the Son of man which is in heaven.
bsb_text: No one has ascended into heaven except the One who descended from heaven—the Son of Man.
aov_text: En niemand het opgevaar in die hemel nie, behalwe Hy wat uit die hemel neergedaal het, naamlik die Seun van die mens wat in die hemel is.

kjv_text: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up:
bsb_text: Just as Moses lifted up the snake in the wilderness, so the Son of Man must be lifted up,
aov_text: En soos Moses die slang in die woestyn verhoog het, so moet die Seun van die mens verhoog word,

kjv_text: That whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
bsb_text: that everyone who believes in Him may have eternal life.
aov_text: sodat elkeen wat in Hom glo, nie verlore mag gaan nie, maar die ewige lewe kan hê.

kjv_text: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
bsb_text: For God so loved the world that He gave His one and only Son, that everyone who believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life.
aov_text: Want so lief het God die wêreld gehad, dat Hy sy eniggebore Seun gegee het, sodat elkeen wat in Hom glo, nie verlore mag gaan nie, maar die ewige lewe kan hê.

kjv_text: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.
bsb_text: For God did not send His Son into the world to condemn the world, but to save the world through Him.
aov_text: Want God het sy Seun in die wêreld gestuur nie om die wêreld te veroordeel nie, maar dat die wêreld deur Hom gered kan word.

kjv_text: He that believeth on him is not condemned: but he that believeth not is condemned already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.
bsb_text: Whoever believes in Him is not condemned, but whoever does not believe has already been condemned, because he has not believed in the name of God’s one and only Son.
aov_text: Hy wat in Hom glo, word nie veroordeel nie; maar hy wat nie glo nie, is alreeds veroordeel omdat hy nie geglo het in die Naam van die eniggebore Seun van God nie.

kjv_text: And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.
bsb_text: And this is the verdict: The Light has come into the world, but men loved the darkness rather than the Light because their deeds were evil.
aov_text: En dit is die oordeel: dat die lig in die wêreld gekom het, en die mense het die duisternis liewer gehad as die lig; want hulle werke was boos.

kjv_text: For every one that doeth evil hateth the light, neither cometh to the light, lest his deeds should be reproved.
bsb_text: Everyone who does evil hates the Light, and does not come into the Light for fear that his deeds will be exposed.
aov_text: Want elkeen wat kwaad doen, haat die lig en kom nie na die lig nie, dat sy werke nie bestraf mag word nie.

kjv_text: But he that doeth truth cometh to the light, that his deeds may be made manifest, that they are wrought in God.
bsb_text: But whoever practices the truth comes into the Light, so that it may be seen clearly that what he has done has been accomplished in God.”
aov_text: Maar hy wat die waarheid doen, kom na die lig, sodat sy werke openbaar kan word, dat hulle in God gedoen is.

kjv_text: After these things came Jesus and his disciples into the land of Judaea; and there he tarried with them, and baptized.
bsb_text: After this, Jesus and His disciples went into the Judean countryside, where He spent some time with them and baptized.
aov_text: HIERNA het Jesus en sy dissipels na die land van Judéa gegaan, en Hy het daar met hulle vertoef en gedoop.

kjv_text: And John also was baptizing in Aenon near to Salim, because there was much water there: and they came, and were baptized.
bsb_text: Now John was also baptizing at Aenon near Salim, because the water was plentiful there, and people kept coming to be baptized.
aov_text: En Johannes was ook besig om te doop in Enon naby Salim, omdat daar baie water was. En die mense het daar gekom en is gedoop.

kjv_text: For John was not yet cast into prison.
bsb_text: (For John had not yet been thrown into prison.)
aov_text: Want Johannes was nog nie in die gevangenis gewerp nie.

kjv_text: Then there arose a question between some of John's disciples and the Jews about purifying.
bsb_text: Then a dispute arose between John’s disciples and a certain Jew over the issue of ceremonial washing.
aov_text: Daar het toe van die kant van die dissipels van Johannes ’n redenasie met die Jode ontstaan oor die reiniging.

kjv_text: And they came unto John, and said unto him, Rabbi, he that was with thee beyond Jordan, to whom thou barest witness, behold, the same baptizeth, and all men come to him.
bsb_text: So John’s disciples came to him and said, “Look, Rabbi, the One who was with you beyond the Jordan, the One you testified about—He is baptizing, and everyone is going to Him.”
aov_text: En hulle het na Johannes gekom en vir hom gesê: Rabbi, Hy wat saam met u oorkant die Jordaan was, van wie u getuig het, kyk, Hy doop, en almal gaan na Hom toe.

kjv_text: John answered and said, A man can receive nothing, except it be given him from heaven.
bsb_text: John replied, “A man can receive only what is given him from heaven.
aov_text: Johannes antwoord en sê: ’n Mens kan niks aanneem as dit hom nie uit die hemel gegee is nie.

kjv_text: Ye yourselves bear me witness, that I said, I am not the Christ, but that I am sent before him.
bsb_text: You yourselves can testify that I said, ‘I am not the Christ, but am sent ahead of Him.’
aov_text: Julle is self my getuies dat ek gesê het: Ek is nie die Christus nie; maar dat ek voor Hom uitgestuur is.

kjv_text: He that hath the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, which standeth and heareth him, rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegroom's voice: this my joy therefore is fulfilled.
bsb_text: The bride belongs to the bridegroom. The friend of the bridegroom stands and listens for him, and is overjoyed to hear the bridegroom’s voice. That joy is mine, and it is now complete.
aov_text: Hy wat die bruid het, is die bruidegom; maar die vriend van die bruidegom wat na hom staan en luister, verbly hom baie oor die stem van die bruidegom. So is dan hierdie blydskap van my volkome.

kjv_text: He must increase, but I must decrease.
bsb_text: He must increase; I must decrease.
aov_text: Hy moet meer word, maar ek minder.

kjv_text: He that cometh from above is above all: he that is of the earth is earthly, and speaketh of the earth: he that cometh from heaven is above all.
bsb_text: The One who comes from above is above all. The one who is from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks as one from the earth. The One who comes from heaven is above all.
aov_text: Hy wat van bo kom, is bo almal; hy wat uit die aarde is, is uit die aarde en praat uit die aarde. Hy wat uit die hemel kom, is bo almal.

kjv_text: And what he hath seen and heard, that he testifieth; and no man receiveth his testimony.
bsb_text: He testifies to what He has seen and heard, yet no one accepts His testimony.
aov_text: En wat Hy gesien en gehoor het, dit getuig Hy; en niemand neem sy getuienis aan nie.

kjv_text: He that hath received his testimony hath set to his seal that God is true.
bsb_text: Whoever accepts His testimony has certified that God is truthful.
aov_text: Wie sy getuienis aangeneem het, het sy seël daarop gesit dat God waaragtig is.

kjv_text: For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God: for God giveth not the Spirit by measure unto him.
bsb_text: For the One whom God has sent speaks the words of God, for God gives the Spirit without limit.
aov_text: Want Hy wat God gestuur het, spreek die woorde van God; want God gee Hom die Gees nie met mate nie.

kjv_text: The Father loveth the Son, and hath given all things into his hand.
bsb_text: The Father loves the Son and has placed all things in His hands.
aov_text: Die Vader het die Seun lief en het alles in sy hand gegee.

kjv_text: He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life: and he that believeth not the Son shall not see life; but the wrath of God abideth on him.
bsb_text: Whoever believes in the Son has eternal life. Whoever rejects the Son will not see life. Instead, the wrath of God remains on him.”
aov_text: Hy wat in die Seun glo, het die ewige lewe; maar hy wat die Seun ongehoorsaam is, sal die lewe nie sien nie, maar die toorn van God bly op hom.

kjv_text: When therefore the LORD knew how the Pharisees had heard that Jesus made and baptized more disciples than John,
bsb_text: When Jesus realized that the Pharisees were aware He was gaining and baptizing more disciples than John
aov_text: TOE die Here dan verneem dat die Fariseërs gehoor het dat Jesus meer dissipels maak en doop as Johannes  —

kjv_text: (Though Jesus himself baptized not, but his disciples,)
bsb_text: (although it was not Jesus who baptized, but His disciples),
aov_text: alhoewel Jesus self nie gedoop het nie, maar sy dissipels  —

kjv_text: He left Judaea, and departed again into Galilee.
bsb_text: He left Judea and returned to Galilee.
aov_text: het Hy Judéa verlaat en weer na Galiléa gegaan.

kjv_text: And he must needs go through Samaria.
bsb_text: Now He had to pass through Samaria.
aov_text: En Hy moes deur Samaría gaan.

kjv_text: Then cometh he to a city of Samaria, which is called Sychar, near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.
bsb_text: So He came to a town of Samaria called Sychar, near the plot of ground that Jacob had given to his son Joseph.
aov_text: Hy kom toe by ’n stad van Samaría wat Sígar genoem word, naby die stuk grond wat Jakob aan sy seun Josef gegee het.

kjv_text: Now Jacob's well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus on the well: and it was about the sixth hour.
bsb_text: Since Jacob’s well was there, Jesus, weary from His journey, sat down by the well. It was about the sixth hour.
aov_text: En die fontein van Jakob was daar. Jesus het toe, omdat Hy moeg was van die reis, somaar by die fontein gaan sit. Dit was omtrent die sesde uur.

kjv_text: There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water: Jesus saith unto her, Give me to drink.
bsb_text: When a Samaritan woman came to draw water, Jesus said to her, “Give Me a drink.”
aov_text: Daar kom ’n vrou uit Samaría om water te skep. Jesus sê vir haar: Gee vir My water om te drink  —

kjv_text: (For his disciples were gone away unto the city to buy meat.)
bsb_text: (His disciples had gone into the town to buy food.)
aov_text: want sy dissipels het na die stad gegaan om voedsel te koop.

kjv_text: Then saith the woman of Samaria unto him, How is it that thou, being a Jew, askest drink of me, which am a woman of Samaria? for the Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans.
bsb_text: “You are a Jew,” said the woman. “How can You ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?” (For Jews do not associate with Samaritans.)
aov_text: En die Samaritaanse vrou sê vir Hom: Hoe is dit dat U wat ’n Jood is, van my vra om te drink terwyl ek ’n Samaritaanse vrou is? Want die Jode hou geen gemeenskap met die Samaritane nie.

kjv_text: Jesus answered and said unto her, If thou knewest the gift of God, and who it is that saith to thee, Give me to drink; thou wouldest have asked of him, and he would have given thee living water.
bsb_text: Jesus answered, “If you knew the gift of God and who is asking you for a drink, you would have asked Him, and He would have given you living water.”
aov_text: Jesus antwoord en sê vir haar: As jy die gawe van God geken het en geweet het wie Hy is wat vir jou sê: Gee vir My water om te drink, sou jy Hom gevra het en Hy sou vir jou lewende water gegee het.

kjv_text: The woman saith unto him, Sir, thou hast nothing to draw with, and the well is deep: from whence then hast thou that living water?
bsb_text: “Sir,” the woman replied, “You have nothing to draw with and the well is deep. Where then will You get this living water?
aov_text: Die vrou sê vir Hom: Here, U het nie eens ’n skepding nie, en die put is diep; waarvandaan kry U dan die lewende water?

kjv_text: Art thou greater than our father Jacob, which gave us the well, and drank thereof himself, and his children, and his cattle?
bsb_text: Are You greater than our father Jacob, who gave us this well and drank from it himself, as did his sons and his livestock?”
aov_text: U is tog nie groter as ons vader Jakob nie, wat die put aan ons gegee het en self daaruit gedrink het, en sy seuns en sy vee?

kjv_text: Jesus answered and said unto her, Whosoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again:
bsb_text: Jesus said to her, “Everyone who drinks this water will be thirsty again.
aov_text: Jesus antwoord en sê vir haar: Elkeen wat van hierdie water drink, sal weer dors kry;

kjv_text: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.
bsb_text: But whoever drinks the water I give him will never thirst. Indeed, the water I give him will become in him a fount of water springing up to eternal life.”
aov_text: maar elkeen wat drink van die water wat Ek hom sal gee, sal in ewigheid nooit dors kry nie, maar die water wat Ek hom sal gee, sal in hom word ’n fontein van water wat opspring tot in die ewige lewe.

kjv_text: The woman saith unto him, Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come hither to draw.
bsb_text: The woman said to Him, “Sir, give me this water so that I will not get thirsty and have to keep coming here to draw water.”
aov_text: Die vrou sê vir Hom: Here, gee my daardie water, sodat ek nie dors kry en hier hoef te kom skep nie.

kjv_text: Jesus saith unto her, Go, call thy husband, and come hither.
bsb_text: Jesus told her, “Go, call your husband and come back.”
aov_text: Jesus sê vir haar: Gaan roep jou man en kom hier.

kjv_text: The woman answered and said, I have no husband. Jesus said unto her, Thou hast well said, I have no husband:
bsb_text: “I have no husband,” the woman replied. Jesus said to her, “You are correct to say that you have no husband.
aov_text: Die vrou antwoord en sê: Ek het nie ’n man nie. Jesus sê vir haar: Jy het reg gesê: Ek het nie ’n man nie;

kjv_text: For thou hast had five husbands; and he whom thou now hast is not thy husband: in that saidst thou truly.
bsb_text: In fact, you have had five husbands, and the man you now have is not your husband. You have spoken truthfully.”
aov_text: want jy het vyf mans gehad; en die een wat jy nou het, is nie jou man nie. Dit het jy met waarheid gesê.

kjv_text: The woman saith unto him, Sir, I perceive that thou art a prophet.
bsb_text: “Sir,” the woman said, “I see that You are a prophet.
aov_text: Die vrou sê vir Hom: Here, ek sien dat U ’n profeet is.

kjv_text: Our fathers worshipped in this mountain; and ye say, that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship.
bsb_text: Our fathers worshiped on this mountain, but you Jews say that the place where one must worship is in Jerusalem.”
aov_text: Ons vaders het op hierdie berg aanbid, en julle sê dat die plek waar ons behoort te aanbid, in Jerusalem is.

kjv_text: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, believe me, the hour cometh, when ye shall neither in this mountain, nor yet at Jerusalem, worship the Father.
bsb_text: “Believe Me, woman,” Jesus replied, “a time is coming when you will worship the Father neither on this mountain nor in Jerusalem.
aov_text: Jesus sê vir haar: Vrou, glo My, daar kom ’n uur wanneer julle nie op hierdie berg en ook nie in Jerusalem die Vader sal aanbid nie.

kjv_text: Ye worship ye know not what: we know what we worship: for salvation is of the Jews.
bsb_text: You worship what you do not know; we worship what we do know, for salvation is from the Jews.
aov_text: Julle aanbid wat julle nie weet nie; ons aanbid wat ons weet, want die saligheid is uit die Jode.

kjv_text: But the hour cometh, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth: for the Father seeketh such to worship him.
bsb_text: But a time is coming and has now come when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and in truth, for the Father is seeking such as these to worship Him.
aov_text: Maar daar kom ’n uur, en dit is nou, wanneer die ware aanbidders die Vader in gees en waarheid sal aanbid; want die Vader soek ook mense wat Hom só aanbid.

kjv_text: God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.
bsb_text: God is Spirit, and His worshipers must worship Him in spirit and in truth.”
aov_text: God is Gees; en die wat Hom aanbid, moet in gees en waarheid aanbid.

kjv_text: The woman saith unto him, I know that Messias cometh, which is called Christ: when he is come, he will tell us all things.
bsb_text: The woman said, “I know that Messiah” (called Christ) “is coming. When He comes, He will explain everything to us.”
aov_text: Die vrou sê vir Hom: Ek weet dat die Messías kom, Hy wat Christus genoem word. Wanneer Hy kom, sal Hy ons alles verkondig.

kjv_text: Jesus saith unto her, I that speak unto thee am he.
bsb_text: Jesus answered, “I who speak to you am He.”
aov_text: Jesus sê vir haar: Dit is Ek wat met jou spreek!

kjv_text: And upon this came his disciples, and marvelled that he talked with the woman: yet no man said, What seekest thou? or, Why talkest thou with her?
bsb_text: Just then His disciples returned and were surprised that He was speaking with a woman. But no one asked Him, “What do You want from her?” or “Why are You talking with her?”
aov_text: En op dié oomblik het sy dissipels gekom en hulle verwonder dat Hy met ’n vrou in gesprek was. Tog het niemand gesê: Wat verlang U nie? of: Waarom spreek U met haar?

kjv_text: The woman then left her waterpot, and went her way into the city, and saith to the men,
bsb_text: Then the woman left her water jar, went back into the town, and said to the people,
aov_text: Die vrou het toe haar waterkan laat staan en na die stad gegaan en vir die mense gesê:

kjv_text: Come, see a man, which told me all things that ever I did: is not this the Christ?
bsb_text: “Come, see a man who told me everything I ever did. Could this be the Christ?”
aov_text: Kom kyk ’n man wat my alles vertel het wat ek gedoen het. Is Hy nie miskien die Christus nie?

kjv_text: Then they went out of the city, and came unto him.
bsb_text: So they left the town and made their way toward Jesus.
aov_text: Hulle het toe uit die stad gegaan en na Hom gekom.

kjv_text: In the mean while his disciples prayed him, saying, Master, eat.
bsb_text: Meanwhile the disciples urged Him, “Rabbi, eat something.”
aov_text: EN intussen het sy dissipels by Hom aangedring en gesê: Rabbi, eet.

kjv_text: But he said unto them, I have meat to eat that ye know not of.
bsb_text: But He told them, “I have food to eat that you know nothing about.”
aov_text: Maar Hy sê vir hulle: Ek het voedsel om te eet waar julle nie van weet nie.

kjv_text: Therefore said the disciples one to another, Hath any man brought him ought to eat?
bsb_text: So the disciples asked one another, “Could someone have brought Him food?”
aov_text: Die dissipels sê toe vir mekaar: Het iemand dan vir Hom ete gebring?

kjv_text: Jesus saith unto them, My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work.
bsb_text: Jesus explained, “My food is to do the will of Him who sent Me and to finish His work.
aov_text: Jesus sê vir hulle: My voedsel is om die wil te doen van Hom wat My gestuur het en om sy werk te volbring.

kjv_text: Say not ye, There are yet four months, and then cometh harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are white already to harvest.
bsb_text: Do you not say, ‘There are still four months until the harvest’? I tell you, lift up your eyes and look at the fields, for they are ripe for harvest.
aov_text: Sê julle nie: Dit is nog vier maande, dan kom die oes nie? Kyk, Ek sê vir julle, slaan julle oë op en aanskou die lande dat hulle al wit is vir die oes.

kjv_text: And he that reapeth receiveth wages, and gathereth fruit unto life eternal: that both he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together.
bsb_text: Already the reaper draws his wages and gathers a crop for eternal life, so that the sower and the reaper may rejoice together.
aov_text: En hy wat maai, ontvang loon en vergader vrug vir die ewige lewe, sodat die saaier en die maaier saam bly kan wees.

kjv_text: And herein is that saying true, One soweth, and another reapeth.
bsb_text: For in this case the saying ‘One sows and another reaps’ is true.
aov_text: Want hierin is die woord waar: Dit is een wat saai, en ’n ander wat maai.

kjv_text: I sent you to reap that whereon ye bestowed no labour: other men laboured, and ye are entered into their labours.
bsb_text: I sent you to reap what you have not worked for; others have done the hard work, and now you have taken up their labor.”
aov_text: Ek het julle gestuur om te maai waar julle nie aan gewerk het nie. Ander het gewerk, en julle het in hulle arbeid ingegaan.

kjv_text: And many of the Samaritans of that city believed on him for the saying of the woman, which testified, He told me all that ever I did.
bsb_text: Many of the Samaritans from that town believed in Jesus because of the woman’s testimony, “He told me everything I ever did.”
aov_text: En baie van die Samaritane uit daardie stad het in Hom geglo oor die woord van die vrou wat getuig het: Hy het my alles vertel wat ek gedoen het.

kjv_text: So when the Samaritans were come unto him, they besought him that he would tarry with them: and he abode there two days.
bsb_text: So when the Samaritans came to Him, they asked Him to stay with them, and He stayed two days.
aov_text: Toe die Samaritane dan by Hom kom, het hulle by Hom aangedring om by hulle te bly; en Hy het daar twee dae gebly.

kjv_text: And many more believed because of his own word;
bsb_text: And many more believed because of His message.
aov_text: En baie meer het op grond van sy woord geglo

kjv_text: And said unto the woman, Now we believe, not because of thy saying: for we have heard him ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Saviour of the world.
bsb_text: They said to the woman, “We now believe not only because of your words; we have heard for ourselves, and we know that this man truly is the Savior of the world.”
aov_text: en aan die vrou gesê: Ons glo nie meer op grond van wat jy gesê het nie, want ons het self gehoor en ons weet dat Hy waarlik die Christus, die Saligmaker van die wêreld, is.

kjv_text: Now after two days he departed thence, and went into Galilee.
bsb_text: After two days, Jesus left for Galilee.
aov_text: EN ná die twee dae het Hy daarvandaan weggegaan en na Galiléa vertrek.

kjv_text: For Jesus himself testified, that a prophet hath no honour in his own country.
bsb_text: Now He Himself had testified that a prophet has no honor in his own hometown.
aov_text: Want Jesus self het getuig dat ’n profeet in sy eie vaderland geen eer ontvang het nie.

kjv_text: Then when he was come into Galilee, the Galilaeans received him, having seen all the things that he did at Jerusalem at the feast: for they also went unto the feast.
bsb_text: Yet when He arrived, the Galileans welcomed Him. They had seen all the great things He had done in Jerusalem at the feast, for they had gone there as well.
aov_text: Toe Hy dan in Galiléa kom, het die Galiléërs Hom ontvang, omdat hulle alles gesien het wat Hy in Jerusalem op die fees gedoen het; want hulle het ook na die fees gegaan.

kjv_text: So Jesus came again into Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at Capernaum.
bsb_text: So once again He came to Cana in Galilee, where He had turned the water into wine. And there was a royal official whose son lay sick at Capernaum.
aov_text: Jesus het dan weer gekom te Kana in Galiléa, waar Hy die water wyn gemaak het. En daar was ’n sekere koninklike beampte wie se seun in Kapérnaüm siek was.

kjv_text: When he heard that Jesus was come out of Judaea into Galilee, he went unto him, and besought him that he would come down, and heal his son: for he was at the point of death.
bsb_text: When he heard that Jesus had come from Judea to Galilee, he went and begged Him to come down and heal his son, who was about to die.
aov_text: Toe hy hoor dat Jesus uit Judéa in Galiléa gekom het, gaan hy na Hom en vra Hom om af te kom en sy seun gesond te maak, want hy het op sterwe gelê.

kjv_text: Then said Jesus unto him, Except ye see signs and wonders, ye will not believe.
bsb_text: Jesus said to him, “Unless you people see signs and wonders, you will never believe.”
aov_text: Jesus sê toe vir hom: As julle nie tekens en wonders sien nie, sal julle nooit glo nie.

kjv_text: The nobleman saith unto him, Sir, come down ere my child die.
bsb_text: “Sir,” the official said, “come down before my child dies.”
aov_text: Die koninklike beampte sê vir Hom: Here, kom af voordat my kind sterwe.

kjv_text: Jesus saith unto him, Go thy way; thy son liveth. And the man believed the word that Jesus had spoken unto him, and he went his way.
bsb_text: “Go,” said Jesus. “Your son will live.” The man took Jesus at His word and departed.
aov_text: Jesus antwoord hom: Gaan, jou seun lewe! En die man het die woord geglo wat Jesus vir hom gesê het, en hy het gegaan.

kjv_text: And as he was now going down, his servants met him, and told him, saying, Thy son liveth.
bsb_text: And while he was still on the way, his servants met him with the news that his boy was alive.
aov_text: En toe hy al op pad was huis toe, kom sy diensknegte hom tegemoet en bring die berig en sê: U kind lewe!

kjv_text: Then enquired he of them the hour when he began to amend. And they said unto him, Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.
bsb_text: So he inquired as to the hour when his son had recovered, and they told him, “The fever left him yesterday at the seventh hour.”
aov_text: Hy verneem toe van hulle die uur waarop hy beter geword het. En hulle sê vir hom: Gister, die sewende uur, het die koors hom verlaat.

kjv_text: So the father knew that it was at the same hour, in the which Jesus said unto him, Thy son liveth: and himself believed, and his whole house.
bsb_text: Then the father realized that this was the very hour in which Jesus had told him, “Your son will live.” And he and all his household believed.
aov_text: Die vader merk toe dat dit daardie uur was waarop Jesus vir hom gesê het: Jou seun lewe! En hy het self geglo en sy hele huis.

kjv_text: This is again the second miracle that Jesus did, when he was come out of Judaea into Galilee.
bsb_text: This was now the second sign that Jesus performed after coming from Judea into Galilee.
aov_text: Hierdie tweede teken weer het Jesus gedoen toe Hy uit Judéa in Galiléa gekom het.

kjv_text: After this there was a feast of the Jews; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
bsb_text: Some time later there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
aov_text: HIERNA was daar ’n fees van die Jode, en Jesus het opgegaan na Jerusalem.

kjv_text: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five porches.
bsb_text: Now there is in Jerusalem near the Sheep Gate a pool with five covered colonnades, which in Hebrew is called Bethesda.
aov_text: En daar is in Jerusalem by die Skaapspoort ’n bad met vyf pilaargange wat in Hebreeus Betésda genoem word.

kjv_text: In these lay a great multitude of impotent folk, of blind, halt, withered, waiting for the moving of the water.
bsb_text: On these walkways lay a great number of the sick, the blind, the lame, and the paralyzed.
aov_text: Daarin het ’n groot menigte siekes gelê, blindes en kreupeles en lammes, wat op die roering van die water gewag het.

kjv_text: For an angel went down at a certain season into the pool, and troubled the water: whosoever then first after the troubling of the water stepped in was made whole of whatsoever disease he had.
aov_text: Want ’n engel het op bepaalde tye in die bad neergedaal en die water geroer. Die een wat dan die eerste ingaan ná die roering van die water, het gesond geword, aan watter siekte hy ook al gely het.

kjv_text: And a certain man was there, which had an infirmity thirty and eight years.
bsb_text: One man there had been an invalid for thirty-eight years.
aov_text: En ’n sekere man was daar, wat agt-en-dertig jaar aan sy siekte gely het.

kjv_text: When Jesus saw him lie, and knew that he had been now a long time in that case, he saith unto him, Wilt thou be made whole?
bsb_text: When Jesus saw him lying there and realized that he had spent a long time in this condition, He asked him, “Do you want to get well?”
aov_text: Toe Jesus hom sien lê, terwyl Hy geweet het dat hy al ’n lang tyd siek was, sê Hy vir hom: Wil jy gesond word?

kjv_text: The impotent man answered him, Sir, I have no man, when the water is troubled, to put me into the pool: but while I am coming, another steppeth down before me.
bsb_text: “Sir,” the invalid replied, “I have no one to help me into the pool when the water is stirred. While I am on my way, someone else goes in before me.”
aov_text: Die sieke antwoord Hom: Here, ek het niemand om my in die bad te sit as die water geroer word nie; en onderwyl ek kom, gaan ’n ander een voor my in.

kjv_text: Jesus saith unto him, Rise, take up thy bed, and walk.
bsb_text: Then Jesus told him, “Get up, pick up your mat, and walk.”
aov_text: Jesus sê vir hom: Staan op, neem jou bed op en loop.

kjv_text: And immediately the man was made whole, and took up his bed, and walked:
bsb_text: Immediately the man was made well, and he picked up his mat and began to walk.
aov_text: En dadelik het die man gesond geword en sy bed opgeneem en geloop.

kjv_text: and on the same day was the sabbath.
bsb_text: Now this happened on the Sabbath day,
aov_text: En daardie dag was dit sabbat.

kjv_text: The Jews therefore said unto him that was cured, It is the sabbath day: it is not lawful for thee to carry thy bed.
bsb_text: so the Jews said to the man who had been healed, “This is the Sabbath! It is unlawful for you to carry your mat.”
aov_text: Die Jode sê toe vir hom wat genees was: Dit is sabbat; dit is jou nie geoorloof om jou bed te dra nie.

kjv_text: He answered them, He that made me whole, the same said unto me, Take up thy bed, and walk.
bsb_text: But he answered, “The man who made me well told me, ‘Pick up your mat and walk.’”
aov_text: Hy antwoord hulle: Hy wat my gesond gemaak het, Hy het vir my gesê: Neem jou bed op en loop.

kjv_text: Then asked they him, What man is that which said unto thee, Take up thy bed, and walk?
bsb_text: “Who is this man who told you to pick it up and walk?” they asked.
aov_text: Toe vra hulle hom: Wie is die man wat vir jou gesê het: Neem jou bed op en loop?

kjv_text: And he that was healed wist not who it was: for Jesus had conveyed himself away, a multitude being in that place.
bsb_text: But the man who was healed did not know who it was, for Jesus had slipped away while the crowd was there.
aov_text: Maar hy wat gesond geword het, het nie geweet wie dit was nie; want Jesus het Hom verwyder, omdat daar ’n skare op die plek was.

kjv_text: Afterward Jesus findeth him in the temple, and said unto him, Behold, thou art made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto thee.
bsb_text: Afterward, Jesus found the man at the temple and said to him, “See, you have been made well. Stop sinning, or something worse may happen to you.”
aov_text: Daarna het Jesus hom in die tempel gekry en vir hom gesê: Kyk, jy het gesond geword; moenie meer sondig nie, sodat daar nie iets ergers met jou gebeur nie.

kjv_text: The man departed, and told the Jews that it was Jesus, which had made him whole.
bsb_text: And the man went away and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.
aov_text: Die man het gegaan en aan die Jode vertel dat dit Jesus was wat hom gesond gemaak het.

kjv_text: And therefore did the Jews persecute Jesus, and sought to slay him, because he had done these things on the sabbath day.
bsb_text: Now because Jesus was doing these things on the Sabbath, the Jews began to persecute Him.
aov_text: EN hieroor het die Jode Jesus vervolg en probeer om Hom dood te maak, omdat Hy dit op die sabbat gedoen het.

kjv_text: But Jesus answered them, My Father worketh hitherto, and I work.
bsb_text: But Jesus answered them, “To this very day My Father is at His work, and I too am working.”
aov_text: En Jesus het hulle geantwoord: My Vader werk tot nou toe, en Ek werk ook.

kjv_text: Therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him, because he not only had broken the sabbath, but said also that God was his Father, making himself equal with God.
bsb_text: Because of this, the Jews tried all the harder to kill Him. Not only was He breaking the Sabbath, but He was even calling God His own Father, making Himself equal with God.
aov_text: Hieroor het die Jode toe nog meer probeer om Hom dood te maak, omdat Hy nie alleen die sabbat gebreek het nie, maar ook God sy eie Vader genoem het en Hom met God gelykgestel het.

kjv_text: Then answered Jesus and said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, The Son can do nothing of himself, but what he seeth the Father do: for what things soever he doeth, these also doeth the Son likewise.
bsb_text: So Jesus replied, “Truly, truly, I tell you, the Son can do nothing by Himself, unless He sees the Father doing it. For whatever the Father does, the Son also does.
aov_text: Jesus het toe geantwoord en vir hulle gesê: Voorwaar, voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, die Seun kan niks uit Homself doen tensy Hy die Vader dit sien doen nie. Want alles wat Hý doen, dit doen die Seun ook net so.

kjv_text: For the Father loveth the Son, and sheweth him all things that himself doeth: and he will shew him greater works than these, that ye may marvel.
bsb_text: The Father loves the Son and shows Him all He does. And to your amazement, He will show Him even greater works than these.
aov_text: Want die Vader het die Seun lief en toon Hom alles wat Hy self doen. En groter werke as hierdie sal Hy Hom toon, sodat julle verwonderd kan wees.

kjv_text: For as the Father raiseth up the dead, and quickeneth them; even so the Son quickeneth whom he will.
bsb_text: For just as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, so also the Son gives life to whom He wishes.
aov_text: Want soos die Vader die dode opwek en lewend maak, so maak ook die Seun lewend wie Hy wil.

kjv_text: For the Father judgeth no man, but hath committed all judgment unto the Son:
bsb_text: Furthermore, the Father judges no one, but has assigned all judgment to the Son,
aov_text: Want die Vader oordeel ook niemand nie, maar het die hele oordeel aan die Seun gegee,

kjv_text: That all men should honour the Son, even as they honour the Father. He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father which hath sent him.
bsb_text: so that all may honor the Son just as they honor the Father. Whoever does not honor the Son does not honor the Father who sent Him.
aov_text: sodat almal die Seun kan eer net soos hulle die Vader eer. Wie die Seun nie eer nie, eer nie die Vader wat Hom gestuur het nie.

kjv_text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life.
bsb_text: Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever hears My word and believes Him who sent Me has eternal life and will not come under judgment. Indeed, he has crossed over from death to life.
aov_text: Voorwaar, voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, wie my woord hoor en Hom glo wat My gestuur het, het die ewige lewe en kom nie in die oordeel nie, maar het oorgegaan uit die dood in die lewe.

kjv_text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The hour is coming, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God: and they that hear shall live.
bsb_text: Truly, truly, I tell you, the hour is coming and has now come when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God, and those who hear will live.
aov_text: Voorwaar, voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, daar kom ’n uur, en dit is nou, wanneer die dode die stem van die Seun van God sal hoor; en die wat dit gehoor het, sal lewe.

kjv_text: For as the Father hath life in himself; so hath he given to the Son to have life in himself;
bsb_text: For as the Father has life in Himself, so also He has granted the Son to have life in Himself.
aov_text: Want soos die Vader lewe het in Homself, so het Hy aan die Seun ook gegee om lewe in Homself te hê.

kjv_text: And hath given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of man.
bsb_text: And He has given Him authority to execute judgment, because He is the Son of Man.
aov_text: En Hy het Hom mag gegee om ook te oordeel, omdat Hy die Seun van die mens is.

kjv_text: Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice,
bsb_text: Do not be amazed at this, for the hour is coming when all who are in their graves will hear His voice
aov_text: Moenie julle hieroor verwonder nie. Want daar kom ’n uur wanneer almal wat in die grafte is, sy stem sal hoor

kjv_text: And shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation.
bsb_text: and come out—those who have done good to the resurrection of life, and those who have done evil to the resurrection of judgment.
aov_text: en sal uitgaan, die wat goed gedoen het, tot die opstanding van die lewe, en die wat kwaad gedoen het, tot die opstanding van die veroordeling.

kjv_text: I can of mine own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is just; because I seek not mine own will, but the will of the Father which hath sent me.
bsb_text: I can do nothing by Myself; I judge only as I hear. And My judgment is just, because I do not seek My own will, but the will of Him who sent Me.
aov_text: Ek kan uit Myself niks doen nie. Soos Ek hoor, oordeel Ek; en my oordeel is regverdig, omdat Ek nie my wil soek nie, maar die wil van die Vader wat My gestuur het.

kjv_text: If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true.
bsb_text: If I testify about Myself, My testimony is not valid.
aov_text: As Ek van Myself getuig, is my getuienis nie waar nie.

kjv_text: There is another that beareth witness of me; and I know that the witness which he witnesseth of me is true.
bsb_text: There is another who testifies about Me, and I know that His testimony about Me is valid.
aov_text: Daar is ’n ander Een wat van My getuig, en Ek weet dat die getuienis wat Hy van My getuig, waar is.

kjv_text: Ye sent unto John, and he bare witness unto the truth.
bsb_text: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.
aov_text: Julle het na Johannes gestuur, en hy het vir die waarheid getuig.

kjv_text: But I receive not testimony from man: but these things I say, that ye might be saved.
bsb_text: Even though I do not accept human testimony, I say these things so that you may be saved.
aov_text: Maar Ek neem die getuienis van ’n mens nie aan nie; maar Ek sê dit, dat julle gered kan word.

kjv_text: He was a burning and a shining light: and ye were willing for a season to rejoice in his light.
bsb_text: John was a lamp that burned and gave light, and you were willing for a season to bask in his light.
aov_text: Hy was die lamp wat brand en skyn, en julle was gewillig om julle vir ’n tyd in sy lig te verbly.

kjv_text: But I have greater witness than that of John: for the works which the Father hath given me to finish, the same works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father hath sent me.
bsb_text: But I have testimony more substantial than that of John. For the works that the Father has given Me to accomplish—the very works I am doing—testify about Me that the Father has sent Me.
aov_text: Maar Ek het ’n groter getuienis as dié van Johannes, want die werke wat die Vader My gegee het om te volbring, die werke self wat Ek doen, getuig van My dat die Vader My gestuur het.

kjv_text: And the Father himself, which hath sent me, hath borne witness of me. Ye have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his shape.
bsb_text: And the Father who sent Me has Himself testified about Me. You have never heard His voice nor seen His form,
aov_text: En die Vader wat My gestuur het, Hy het van My getuig. Julle het nog nooit sy stem gehoor of sy gedaante gesien nie.

kjv_text: And ye have not his word abiding in you: for whom he hath sent, him ye believe not.
bsb_text: nor does His word abide in you, because you do not believe the One He sent.
aov_text: En julle het sy woord nie as iets blywends in julle nie, omdat julle Hom wat Hy gestuur het, nie glo nie.

kjv_text: Search the scriptures; for in them ye think ye have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me.
bsb_text: You pore over the Scriptures because you presume that by them you possess eternal life. These are the very words that testify about Me,
aov_text: Julle ondersoek die Skrifte, omdat julle meen dat julle daarin die ewige lewe het; en dit is dié wat van My getuig.

kjv_text: And ye will not come to me, that ye might have life.
bsb_text: yet you refuse to come to Me to have life.
aov_text: En julle wil nie na My kom om die lewe te hê nie.

kjv_text: I receive not honour from men.
bsb_text: I do not accept glory from men,
aov_text: Eer neem Ek van die mense nie aan nie.

kjv_text: But I know you, that ye have not the love of God in you.
bsb_text: but I know you, that you do not have the love of God within you.
aov_text: Maar Ek ken julle, dat julle die liefde van God in julle nie het nie.

kjv_text: I am come in my Father's name, and ye receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him ye will receive.
bsb_text: I have come in My Father’s name, and you have not received Me; but if someone else comes in his own name, you will receive him.
aov_text: Ek het gekom in die Naam van my Vader, en julle neem My nie aan nie. As ’n ander een in sy eie naam kom, hóm sal julle aanneem.

kjv_text: How can ye believe, which receive honour one of another, and seek not the honour that cometh from God only?
bsb_text: How can you believe if you accept glory from one another, yet do not seek the glory that comes from the only God?
aov_text: Hoe kan julle glo wat van mekaar eer aanneem, en die eer wat van die enige God kom, soek julle nie?

kjv_text: Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father: there is one that accuseth you, even Moses, in whom ye trust.
bsb_text: Do not think that I will accuse you before the Father. Your accuser is Moses, in whom you have put your hope.
aov_text: Moenie dink dat Ek julle by die Vader sal beskuldig nie. Daar is een wat julle beskuldig — Moses op wie julle gehoop het.

kjv_text: For had ye believed Moses, ye would have believed me: for he wrote of me.
bsb_text: If you had believed Moses, you would believe Me, because he wrote about Me.
aov_text: Maar as julle Moses geglo het, sou julle My glo, want hy het van My geskrywe.

kjv_text: But if ye believe not his writings, how shall ye believe my words?
bsb_text: But since you do not believe what he wrote, how will you believe what I say?”
aov_text: En as julle sy geskrifte nie glo nie, hoe sal julle my woorde glo?

kjv_text: After these things Jesus went over the sea of Galilee, which is the sea of Tiberias.
bsb_text: After this, Jesus crossed to the other side of the Sea of Galilee (that is, the Sea of Tiberias).
aov_text: DAARNA het Jesus na die oorkant van die see van Galiléa, dit is, van Tibérias, gegaan;

kjv_text: And a great multitude followed him, because they saw his miracles which he did on them that were diseased.
bsb_text: A large crowd followed Him because they saw the signs He was performing on the sick.
aov_text: en ’n groot menigte het Hom gevolg, omdat hulle sy tekens gesien het wat Hy aan die siekes doen.

kjv_text: And Jesus went up into a mountain, and there he sat with his disciples.
bsb_text: Then Jesus went up on the mountain and sat down with His disciples.
aov_text: En Jesus het op die berg geklim en daar met sy dissipels gaan sit.

kjv_text: And the passover, a feast of the Jews, was nigh.
bsb_text: Now the Jewish Feast of the Passover was near.
aov_text: En die pasga, die fees van die Jode, was naby.

kjv_text: When Jesus then lifted up his eyes, and saw a great company come unto him, he saith unto Philip, Whence shall we buy bread, that these may eat?
bsb_text: When Jesus looked up and saw a large crowd coming toward Him, He said to Philip, “Where can we buy bread for these people to eat?”
aov_text: Toe Jesus dan sy oë opslaan en sien dat ’n groot menigte na Hom kom, sê Hy vir Filippus: Waarvandaan sal ons brood koop, sodat hierdie mense kan eet?

kjv_text: And this he said to prove him: for he himself knew what he would do.
bsb_text: But He was asking this to test him, for He knew what He was about to do.
aov_text: Maar Hy het dit gesê om hom op die proef te stel, want Hy het self geweet wat Hy wou doen.

kjv_text: Philip answered him, Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may take a little.
bsb_text: Philip answered, “Two hundred denarii would not buy enough bread for each of them to have a small piece.”
aov_text: Filippus antwoord Hom: Brood vir tweehonderd pennings sal nie genoeg wees vir hulle, sodat elkeen van hulle ’n stukkie kan kry nie.

kjv_text: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, saith unto him,
bsb_text: One of His disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, said to Him,
aov_text: Een van sy dissipels, Andréas, Simon Petrus se broer, sê vir Hom:

kjv_text: There is a lad here, which hath five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?
bsb_text: “Here is a boy with five barley loaves and two small fish. But what difference will these make among so many?”
aov_text: Hier is ’n seuntjie wat vyf garsbrode en twee vissies het, maar wat is dit vir so baie mense?

kjv_text: And Jesus said, Make the men sit down. Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.
bsb_text: “Have the people sit down,” Jesus said. Now there was plenty of grass in that place, so the men sat down, about five thousand of them.
aov_text: En Jesus sê: Laat die mense gaan sit. En daar was baie gras op dié plek. Die manne het toe gaan sit, omtrent vyfduisend in getal.

kjv_text: And Jesus took the loaves; and when he had given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to them that were set down; and likewise of the fishes as much as they would.
bsb_text: Then Jesus took the loaves and the fish, gave thanks, and distributed to those who were seated as much as they wanted.
aov_text: En Jesus het die brode geneem, en nadat Hy gedank het, deel Hy dit uit aan die dissipels en die dissipels aan die wat daar sit; so ook van die vissies, soveel as hulle wou hê.

kjv_text: When they were filled, he said unto his disciples, Gather up the fragments that remain, that nothing be lost.
bsb_text: And when everyone was full, He said to His disciples, “Gather the pieces that are left over, so that nothing will be wasted.”
aov_text: En nadat hulle versadig was, sê Hy vir sy dissipels: Maak die brokstukke bymekaar wat oorgeskiet het, sodat niks verlore gaan nie.

kjv_text: Therefore they gathered them together, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves, which remained over and above unto them that had eaten.
bsb_text: So they collected them and filled twelve baskets with the pieces of the five barley loaves left over by those who had eaten.
aov_text: Hulle maak toe bymekaar en het twaalf mandjies gevul met brokstukke van die vyf garsbrode wat oorgeskiet het by die wat geëet het.

kjv_text: Then those men, when they had seen the miracle that Jesus did, said, This is of a truth that prophet that should come into the world.
bsb_text: When the people saw the sign that Jesus had performed, they began to say, “Truly this is the Prophet who is to come into the world.”
aov_text: Toe die mense dan die teken sien wat Jesus gedoen het, sê hulle: Hy is waarlik die profeet wat in die wêreld sou kom.

kjv_text: When Jesus therefore perceived that they would come and take him by force, to make him a king, he departed again into a mountain himself alone.
bsb_text: Then Jesus, realizing that they were about to come and make Him king by force, withdrew again to a mountain by Himself.
aov_text: En toe Jesus merk dat hulle wou kom en Hom met geweld neem om Hom koning te maak, het Hy weer weggegaan na die berg, Hy alleen.

kjv_text: And when even was now come, his disciples went down unto the sea,
bsb_text: When evening came, His disciples went down to the sea,
aov_text: EN toe dit aand geword het, het sy dissipels afgegaan na die see toe.

kjv_text: And entered into a ship, and went over the sea toward Capernaum. And it was now dark, and Jesus was not come to them.
bsb_text: got into a boat, and started across the sea to Capernaum. It was already dark, and Jesus had not yet gone out to them.
aov_text: En nadat hulle in die skuit geklim het, het hulle oor die see gevaar na Kapérnaüm; en dit was al donker, en Jesus het nog nie by hulle gekom nie.

kjv_text: And the sea arose by reason of a great wind that blew.
bsb_text: A strong wind was blowing, and the sea grew agitated.
aov_text: En die see was onstuimig, omdat ’n sterk wind gewaai het.

kjv_text: So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs, they see Jesus walking on the sea, and drawing nigh unto the ship: and they were afraid.
bsb_text: When they had rowed about three or four miles, they saw Jesus approaching the boat, walking on the sea—and they were terrified.
aov_text: En toe hulle omtrent drie of vier myl geroei het, sien hulle Jesus op die see loop en naby die skuit kom; en hulle het bang geword.

kjv_text: But he saith unto them, It is I; be not afraid.
bsb_text: But Jesus spoke up: “It is I; do not be afraid.”
aov_text: Maar Hy sê vir hulle: Dit is Ek, moenie vrees nie.

kjv_text: Then they willingly received him into the ship: and immediately the ship was at the land whither they went.
bsb_text: Then they were willing to take Him into the boat, and at once the boat reached the shore where they were heading.
aov_text: Toe was hulle gewillig om Hom in die skuit te neem, en dadelik het die skuit by die land aangekom waar hulle na toe gegaan het.

kjv_text: The day following, when the people which stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was none other boat there, save that one whereinto his disciples were entered, and that Jesus went not with his disciples into the boat, but that his disciples were gone away alone;
bsb_text: The next day, the crowd that had remained on the other side of the sea realized that only one boat had been there, and that Jesus had not boarded it with His disciples, but they had gone away alone.
aov_text: DIE volgende dag sien die skare wat oorkant die see gestaan het, dat daar geen ander skuit was nie, behalwe daardie een waarin sy dissipels gegaan het; en dat Jesus nie saam met sy dissipels in die skuit gegaan het nie, maar dat sy dissipels alleen weggevaar het.

kjv_text: (Howbeit there came other boats from Tiberias nigh unto the place where they did eat bread, after that the Lord had given thanks:)
bsb_text: However, some boats from Tiberias landed near the place where the people had eaten the bread after the Lord had given thanks.
aov_text: Maar ander skuite het van Tibérias aangekom naby die plek waar hulle die brood geëet het, nadat die Here gedank het.

kjv_text: When the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there, neither his disciples, they also took shipping, and came to Capernaum, seeking for Jesus.
bsb_text: So when the crowd saw that neither Jesus nor His disciples were there, they got into the boats and went to Capernaum to look for Him.
aov_text: Toe die skare dan sien dat Jesus nie daar was nie en sy dissipels ook nie, het hulle self ook in die skuite geklim en na Kapérnaüm gegaan om Jesus te soek.

kjv_text: And when they had found him on the other side of the sea, they said unto him, Rabbi, when camest thou hither?
bsb_text: When they found Him on the other side of the sea, they asked Him, “Rabbi, when did You get here?”
aov_text: En toe hulle Hom oorkant die see gevind het, sê hulle vir Hom: Rabbi, wanneer het U hier gekom?

kjv_text: Jesus answered them and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Ye seek me, not because ye saw the miracles, but because ye did eat of the loaves, and were filled.
bsb_text: Jesus replied, “Truly, truly, I tell you, it is not because you saw these signs that you are looking for Me, but because you ate the loaves and had your fill.
aov_text: Jesus antwoord hulle en sê: Voorwaar, voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, julle soek My nie omdat julle tekens gesien het nie, maar omdat julle van die brode geëet en versadig geword het.

kjv_text: Labour not for the meat which perisheth, but for that meat which endureth unto everlasting life, which the Son of man shall give unto you: for him hath God the Father sealed.
bsb_text: Do not work for food that perishes, but for food that endures to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give you. For on Him God the Father has placed His seal of approval.”
aov_text: Moenie werk om die spys wat vergaan nie, maar om die spys wat bly tot in die ewige lewe, wat die Seun van die mens julle sal gee; want Hom het God, die Vader, verseël.

kjv_text: Then said they unto him, What shall we do, that we might work the works of God?
bsb_text: Then they inquired, “What must we do to perform the works of God?”
aov_text: Toe vra hulle Hom: Wat moet ons doen om die werke van God te volbring?

kjv_text: Jesus answered and said unto them, This is the work of God, that ye believe on him whom he hath sent.
bsb_text: Jesus replied, “The work of God is this: to believe in the One He has sent.”
aov_text: Jesus antwoord en sê vir hulle: Dít is die werk van God, dat julle in Hom glo wat Hy gestuur het.

kjv_text: They said therefore unto him, What sign shewest thou then, that we may see, and believe thee? what dost thou work?
bsb_text: So they asked Him, “What sign then will You perform, so that we may see it and believe You? What will You do?
aov_text: En hulle sê vir Hom: Watter teken doen U dan, sodat ons kan sien en U glo? Wat werk U?

kjv_text: Our fathers did eat manna in the desert; as it is written, He gave them bread from heaven to eat.
bsb_text: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, as it is written: ‘He gave them bread from heaven to eat.’”
aov_text: Ons vaders het die manna in die woestyn geëet, soos geskrywe is: Hy het brood uit die hemel aan hulle gegee om te eet.

kjv_text: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Moses gave you not that bread from heaven; but my Father giveth you the true bread from heaven.
bsb_text: Jesus said to them, “Truly, truly, I tell you, it was not Moses who gave you the bread from heaven, but it is My Father who gives you the true bread from heaven.
aov_text: En Jesus sê vir hulle: Voorwaar, voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, dit is nie Moses wat die brood uit die hemel aan julle gegee het nie, maar my Vader gee julle die ware brood uit die hemel.

kjv_text: For the bread of God is he which cometh down from heaven, and giveth life unto the world.
bsb_text: For the bread of God is He who comes down from heaven and gives life to the world.”
aov_text: Want die brood van God is Hy wat uit die hemel neerdaal en aan die wêreld die lewe gee.

kjv_text: Then said they unto him, Lord, evermore give us this bread.
bsb_text: “Sir,” they said, “give us this bread at all times.”
aov_text: Toe sê hulle vir Hom: Here, gee ons altyd hierdie brood.

kjv_text: And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.
bsb_text: Jesus answered, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to Me will never hunger, and whoever believes in Me will never thirst.
aov_text: En Jesus sê vir hulle: Ek is die brood van die lewe; wie na My toe kom, sal nooit honger kry nie; en wie in My glo, sal nooit dors kry nie.

kjv_text: But I said unto you, That ye also have seen me, and believe not.
bsb_text: But as I stated, you have seen Me and still you do not believe.
aov_text: Maar Ek het vir julle gesê dat julle My gesien het, en tog glo julle nie.

kjv_text: All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.
bsb_text: Everyone the Father gives Me will come to Me, and the one who comes to Me I will never drive away.
aov_text: Al wat die Vader My gee, sal na My toe kom; en Ek sal hom wat na My toe kom, nooit uitwerp nie.

kjv_text: For I came down from heaven, not to do mine own will, but the will of him that sent me.
bsb_text: For I have come down from heaven, not to do My own will, but to do the will of Him who sent Me.
aov_text: Want Ek het uit die hemel neergedaal, nie om my wil te doen nie, maar die wil van Hom wat My gestuur het.

kjv_text: And this is the Father's will which hath sent me, that of all which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at the last day.
bsb_text: And this is the will of Him who sent Me, that I shall lose none of those He has given Me, but raise them up at the last day.
aov_text: En dit is die wil van die Vader wat My gestuur het, dat al wat Hy My gegee het, Ek daarvan nie sal verloor nie, maar dit opwek in die laaste dag.

kjv_text: And this is the will of him that sent me, that every one which seeth the Son, and believeth on him, may have everlasting life: and I will raise him up at the last day.
bsb_text: For it is My Father’s will that everyone who looks to the Son and believes in Him shall have eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.”
aov_text: En dit is die wil van Hom wat My gestuur het, dat elkeen wat die Seun aanskou en in Hom glo, die ewige lewe mag hê; en Ek sal hom opwek in die laaste dag.

kjv_text: The Jews then murmured at him, because he said, I am the bread which came down from heaven.
bsb_text: At this, the Jews began to grumble about Jesus because He had said, “I am the bread that came down from heaven.”
aov_text: Toe murmureer die Jode oor Hom, omdat Hy gesê het: Ek is die brood wat uit die hemel neergedaal het.

kjv_text: And they said, Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? how is it then that he saith, I came down from heaven?
bsb_text: They were asking, “Is this not Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How then can He say, ‘I have come down from heaven?’”
aov_text: En hulle sê: Is Hy nie Jesus, die seun van Josef, wie se vader en moeder ons ken nie? Hoe sê Hy dan: Ek het uit die hemel neergedaal?

kjv_text: Jesus therefore answered and said unto them, Murmur not among yourselves.
bsb_text: “Stop grumbling among yourselves,” Jesus replied.
aov_text: En Jesus antwoord en sê vir hulle: Moenie onder mekaar murmureer nie.

kjv_text: No man can come to me, except the Father which hath sent me draw him: and I will raise him up at the last day.
bsb_text: “No one can come to Me unless the Father who sent Me draws him, and I will raise him up at the last day.
aov_text: Niemand kan na My toe kom as die Vader wat My gestuur het, hom nie trek nie; en Ek sal hom opwek in die laaste dag.

kjv_text: It is written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught of God. Every man therefore that hath heard, and hath learned of the Father, cometh unto me.
bsb_text: It is written in the Prophets: ‘And they will all be taught by God.’ Everyone who has heard the Father and learned from Him comes to Me—
aov_text: Dit is geskrywe in die profete: En hulle sal almal deur God geleer wees. Elkeen dan wat dit van die Vader gehoor en geleer het, kom na My toe.

kjv_text: Not that any man hath seen the Father, save he which is of God, he hath seen the Father.
bsb_text: not that anyone has seen the Father except the One who is from God; only He has seen the Father.
aov_text: Nie dat iemand die Vader gesien het nie, behalwe Hy wat van God kom: Hy het die Vader gesien.

kjv_text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me hath everlasting life.
bsb_text: Truly, truly, I tell you, he who believes has eternal life.
aov_text: Voorwaar, voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, wie in My glo, het die ewige lewe.

kjv_text: I am that bread of life.
bsb_text: I am the bread of life.
aov_text: Ek is die brood van die lewe.

kjv_text: Your fathers did eat manna in the wilderness, and are dead.
bsb_text: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, yet they died.
aov_text: Julle vaders het die manna in die woestyn geëet en het gesterwe.

kjv_text: This is the bread which cometh down from heaven, that a man may eat thereof, and not die.
bsb_text: This is the bread that comes down from heaven, so that anyone may eat of it and not die.
aov_text: Dít is die brood wat uit die hemel neerdaal, sodat iemand daarvan kan eet en nie sterwe nie.

kjv_text: I am the living bread which came down from heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.
bsb_text: I am the living bread that came down from heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. And this bread, which I will give for the life of the world, is My flesh.”
aov_text: Ek is die lewende brood wat uit die hemel neergedaal het. As iemand van hierdie brood eet, sal hy lewe tot in ewigheid. En die brood wat Ek sal gee, is my vlees wat Ek vir die lewe van die wêreld sal gee.

kjv_text: The Jews therefore strove among themselves, saying, How can this man give us his flesh to eat?
bsb_text: At this, the Jews began to argue among themselves, “How can this man give us His flesh to eat?”
aov_text: Die Jode het toe met mekaar gestry en gesê: Hoe kan Hy ons sy vlees gee om te eet?

kjv_text: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man, and drink his blood, ye have no life in you.
bsb_text: So Jesus said to them, “Truly, truly, I tell you, unless you eat the flesh and drink the blood of the Son of Man, you have no life in you.
aov_text: En Jesus sê vir hulle: Voorwaar, voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, as julle nie die vlees van die Seun van die mens eet en sy bloed drink nie, het julle geen lewe in julleself nie.

kjv_text: Whoso eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, hath eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.
bsb_text: Whoever eats My flesh and drinks My blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.
aov_text: Hy wat my vlees eet en my bloed drink, het die ewige lewe, en Ek sal hom opwek in die laaste dag.

kjv_text: For my flesh is meat indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.
bsb_text: For My flesh is real food, and My blood is real drink.
aov_text: Want my vlees is waarlik spys, en my bloed is waarlik drank.

kjv_text: He that eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, dwelleth in me, and I in him.
bsb_text: Whoever eats My flesh and drinks My blood remains in Me, and I in him.
