aov_text: Wie my vlees eet en my bloed drink, bly in My en Ek in hom.

kjv_text: As the living Father hath sent me, and I live by the Father: so he that eateth me, even he shall live by me.
bsb_text: Just as the living Father sent Me and I live because of the Father, so also the one who feeds on Me will live because of Me.
aov_text: Soos die lewende Vader My gestuur het, en Ek deur die Vader lewe, so sal hy wat My eet, ook deur My lewe.

kjv_text: This is that bread which came down from heaven: not as your fathers did eat manna, and are dead: he that eateth of this bread shall live for ever.
bsb_text: This is the bread that came down from heaven. Unlike your fathers, who ate the manna and died, the one who eats this bread will live forever.”
aov_text: Dít is die brood wat uit die hemel neergedaal het — nie soos julle vaders die manna geëet en gesterwe het nie; wie hierdie brood eet, sal tot in ewigheid lewe.

kjv_text: These things said he in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.
bsb_text: Jesus said this while teaching in the synagogue in Capernaum.
aov_text: Hierdie dinge het Hy gesê in die sinagoge toe Hy in Kapérnaüm onderrig gegee het.

kjv_text: Many therefore of his disciples, when they had heard this, said, This is an hard saying; who can hear it?
bsb_text: On hearing it, many of His disciples said, “This is a difficult teaching. Who can accept it?”
aov_text: EN baie van sy dissipels het gesê toe hulle dit hoor: Hierdie woord is hard, wie kan daarna luister?

kjv_text: When Jesus knew in himself that his disciples murmured at it, he said unto them, Doth this offend you?
bsb_text: Aware that His disciples were grumbling about this teaching, Jesus asked them, “Does this offend you?
aov_text: En Jesus het in Homself geweet dat sy dissipels hieroor murmureer, en Hy sê vir hulle: Is dit julle tot ’n aanstoot?

kjv_text: What and if ye shall see the Son of man ascend up where he was before?
bsb_text: Then what will happen if you see the Son of Man ascend to where He was before?
aov_text: Hoe dan as julle die Seun van die mens daarheen sien opvaar waar Hy tevore was?

kjv_text: It is the spirit that quickeneth; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life.
bsb_text: The Spirit gives life; the flesh profits nothing. The words I have spoken to you are spirit and they are life.
aov_text: Dit is die Gees wat lewend maak, die vlees is van geen nut nie; die woorde wat Ek tot julle spreek, is gees en is lewe.

kjv_text: But there are some of you that believe not. For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were that believed not, and who should betray him.
bsb_text: However, there are some of you who do not believe.” (For Jesus had known from the beginning which of them did not believe and who would betray Him.)
aov_text: Maar daar is sommige van julle wat nie glo nie. Want Jesus het van die begin af geweet wie hulle was wat nie glo nie, en wie hy was wat Hom sou verraai.

kjv_text: And he said, Therefore said I unto you, that no man can come unto me, except it were given unto him of my Father.
bsb_text: Then Jesus said, “This is why I told you that no one can come to Me unless the Father has granted it to him.”
aov_text: En Hy sê: Om hierdie rede het Ek vir julle gesê dat niemand na My toe kan kom as dit hom nie deur my Vader gegee is nie.

kjv_text: From that time many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.
bsb_text: From that time on many of His disciples turned back and no longer walked with Him.
aov_text: Hieroor het baie van sy dissipels teruggegaan en nie meer saam met Hom gewandel nie.

kjv_text: Then said Jesus unto the twelve, Will ye also go away?
bsb_text: So Jesus asked the Twelve, “Do you want to leave too?”
aov_text: Toe sê Jesus vir die twaalf: Wil julle nie ook weggaan nie?

kjv_text: Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life.
bsb_text: Simon Peter replied, “Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words of eternal life.
aov_text: En Simon Petrus antwoord Hom: Here, na wie toe sal ons gaan? U het die woorde van die ewige lewe.

kjv_text: And we believe and are sure that thou art that Christ, the Son of the living God.
bsb_text: We believe and know that You are the Holy One of God.”
aov_text: En ons het geglo en erken dat U die Christus is, die Seun van die lewende God.

kjv_text: Jesus answered them, Have not I chosen you twelve, and one of you is a devil?
bsb_text: Jesus answered them, “Have I not chosen you, the Twelve? Yet one of you is a devil!”
aov_text: Jesus antwoord hulle: Het Ek nie julle twaalf uitverkies nie? En een van julle is ’n duiwel!

kjv_text: He spake of Judas Iscariot the son of Simon: for he it was that should betray him, being one of the twelve.
bsb_text: He was speaking about Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot. For although Judas was one of the Twelve, he was later to betray Jesus.
aov_text: En Hy het bedoel Judas Iskáriot, die seun van Simon; want hy sou Hom verraai, hy wat een van die twaalf was.

kjv_text: After these things Jesus walked in Galilee: for he would not walk in Jewry, because the Jews sought to kill him.
bsb_text: After this, Jesus traveled throughout Galilee. He did not want to travel in Judea, because the Jews there were trying to kill Him.
aov_text: EN daarna het Jesus in Galiléa rondgegaan, want Hy wou nie in Judéa rondgaan nie, omdat die Jode probeer het om Hom dood te maak.

kjv_text: Now the Jews' feast of tabernacles was at hand.
bsb_text: However, the Jewish Feast of Tabernacles was near.
aov_text: En die fees van die Jode, die huttefees, was naby.

kjv_text: His brethren therefore said unto him, Depart hence, and go into Judaea, that thy disciples also may see the works that thou doest.
bsb_text: So Jesus’ brothers said to Him, “Leave here and go to Judea, so that Your disciples there may see the works You are doing.
aov_text: Sy broers het toe vir Hom gesê: Vertrek hiervandaan en gaan na Judéa, sodat u dissipels ook u werke kan sien wat U doen.

kjv_text: For there is no man that doeth any thing in secret, and he himself seeketh to be known openly. If thou do these things, shew thyself to the world.
bsb_text: For no one who wants to be known publicly acts in secret. Since You are doing these things, show Yourself to the world.”
aov_text: Want niemand doen iets in die geheim en soek tegelykertyd om in iedereen se mond te wees nie. As U hierdie dinge doen, vertoon Uself aan die wêreld.

kjv_text: For neither did his brethren believe in him.
bsb_text: For even His own brothers did not believe in Him.
aov_text: Want ook sy broers het nie in Hom geglo nie.

kjv_text: Then Jesus said unto them, My time is not yet come: but your time is alway ready.
bsb_text: Therefore Jesus told them, “Although your time is always at hand, My time has not yet come.
aov_text: Toe sê Jesus vir hulle: My tyd is nog nie daar nie. Maar julle tyd is altyd daar.

kjv_text: The world cannot hate you; but me it hateth, because I testify of it, that the works thereof are evil.
bsb_text: The world cannot hate you, but it hates Me, because I testify that its works are evil.
aov_text: Die wêreld kan julle nie haat nie; maar My haat hy, omdat Ek van hom getuig dat sy werke boos is.

kjv_text: Go ye up unto this feast: I go not up yet unto this feast: for my time is not yet full come.
bsb_text: Go up to the feast on your own. I am not going up to this feast, because My time has not yet come.”
aov_text: Gaan julle op na hierdie fees. Ek gaan nog nie op na hierdie fees nie, omdat my tyd nog nie daar is nie.

kjv_text: When he had said these words unto them, he abode still in Galilee.
bsb_text: Having said this, Jesus remained in Galilee.
aov_text: En nadat Hy dit aan hulle gesê het, het Hy in Galiléa gebly.

kjv_text: But when his brethren were gone up, then went he also up unto the feast, not openly, but as it were in secret.
bsb_text: But after His brothers had gone up to the feast, He also went—not publicly, but in secret.
aov_text: MAAR nadat sy broers opgegaan het, toe het Hy ook opgegaan na die fees, nie openlik nie, maar in die geheim.

kjv_text: Then the Jews sought him at the feast, and said, Where is he?
bsb_text: So the Jews were looking for Him at the feast and asking, “Where is He?”
aov_text: En die Jode het Hom op die fees gesoek en gesê: Waar is Hy?

kjv_text: And there was much murmuring among the people concerning him: for some said, He is a good man: others said, Nay; but he deceiveth the people.
bsb_text: Many in the crowds were whispering about Him. Some said, “He is a good man.” But others replied, “No, He deceives the people.”
aov_text: En daar is baie oor Hom gemompel onder die skare. Sommige het gesê: Hy is goed. Ander weer het gesê: Nee, maar Hy mislei die skare.

kjv_text: Howbeit no man spake openly of him for fear of the Jews.
bsb_text: Yet no one would speak publicly about Him for fear of the Jews.
aov_text: Tog het niemand openlik oor Hom gepraat nie, uit vrees vir die Jode.

kjv_text: Now about the midst of the feast Jesus went up into the temple, and taught.
bsb_text: About halfway through the feast, Jesus went up to the temple courts and began to teach.
aov_text: En toe dit al in die middel van die fees was, het Jesus opgegaan na die tempel en geleer.

kjv_text: And the Jews marvelled, saying, How knoweth this man letters, having never learned?
bsb_text: The Jews were amazed and asked, “How did this man attain such learning without having studied?”
aov_text: En die Jode het hulle verwonder en gesê: Hoe kom Hy aan die geleerdheid terwyl Hy geen onderwys ontvang het nie?

kjv_text: Jesus answered them, and said, My doctrine is not mine, but his that sent me.
bsb_text: “My teaching is not My own,” Jesus replied. “It comes from Him who sent Me.
aov_text: Jesus antwoord hulle en sê: My leer is nie myne nie, maar van Hom wat My gestuur het.

kjv_text: If any man will do his will, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of God, or whether I speak of myself.
bsb_text: If anyone desires to do His will, he will know whether My teaching is from God or whether I speak on My own.
aov_text: As iemand gewillig is om sy wil te doen, sal hy aangaande die leer weet of dit uit God is, en of Ek uit Myself spreek.

kjv_text: He that speaketh of himself seeketh his own glory: but he that seeketh his glory that sent him, the same is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.
bsb_text: He who speaks on his own authority seeks his own glory, but He who seeks the glory of the One who sent Him is a man of truth; in Him there is no falsehood.
aov_text: Hy wat uit homself spreek, soek sy eie eer; maar Hy wat die eer soek van dié Een wat Hom gestuur het, Hy is waaragtig en daar is geen ongeregtigheid in Hom nie.

kjv_text: Did not Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keepeth the law? Why go ye about to kill me?
bsb_text: Has not Moses given you the law? Yet not one of you keeps it. Why are you trying to kill Me?”
aov_text: Het Moses julle nie die wet gegee nie? En niemand van julle hou die wet nie. Waarom wil julle My om die lewe bring?

kjv_text: The people answered and said, Thou hast a devil: who goeth about to kill thee?
bsb_text: “You have a demon,” the crowd replied. “Who is trying to kill You?”
aov_text: Die skare antwoord en sê: U is van die duiwel besete; wie wil U om die lewe bring?

kjv_text: Jesus answered and said unto them, I have done one work, and ye all marvel.
bsb_text: Jesus answered them, “I did one miracle, and you are all amazed.
aov_text: Jesus antwoord en sê vir hulle: Een werk het Ek gedoen, en julle verwonder julle almal.

kjv_text: Moses therefore gave unto you circumcision; (not because it is of Moses, but of the fathers;) and ye on the sabbath day circumcise a man.
bsb_text: But because Moses gave you circumcision, you circumcise a boy on the Sabbath (not that it is from Moses, but from the patriarchs.)
aov_text: Daarom het Moses julle die besnydenis gegee — nie dat dit van Moses is nie, maar van die vaders — en op die sabbat besny julle ’n mens.

kjv_text: If a man on the sabbath day receive circumcision, that the law of Moses should not be broken; are ye angry at me, because I have made a man every whit whole on the sabbath day?
bsb_text: If a boy can be circumcised on the Sabbath so that the law of Moses will not be broken, why are you angry with Me for making the whole man well on the Sabbath?
aov_text: As ’n mens die besnydenis op die sabbat ontvang, sodat die wet van Moses nie verbreek mag word nie, is julle kwaad vir My, omdat Ek ’n mens op die sabbat heeltemal gesond gemaak het?

kjv_text: Judge not according to the appearance, but judge righteous judgment.
bsb_text: Stop judging by outward appearances, and start judging justly.”
aov_text: Moenie oordeel volgens wat julle sien nie, maar oordeel ’n regverdige oordeel.

kjv_text: Then said some of them of Jerusalem, Is not this he, whom they seek to kill?
bsb_text: Then some of the people of Jerusalem began to say, “Isn’t this the man they are trying to kill?
aov_text: Daarop sê sommige van die inwoners van Jerusalem: Is dit nie Hy wat hulle soek om dood te maak  nie?

kjv_text: But, lo, he speaketh boldly, and they say nothing unto him. Do the rulers know indeed that this is the very Christ?
bsb_text: Yet here He is, speaking publicly, and they are not saying anything to Him. Have the rulers truly recognized that this is the Christ?
aov_text: En kyk, Hy spreek openlik en hulle sê vir Hom niks nie! Sou die owerstes dan waarlik weet dat Hy werklik die Christus is?

kjv_text: Howbeit we know this man whence he is: but when Christ cometh, no man knoweth whence he is.
bsb_text: But we know where this man is from. When the Christ comes, no one will know where He is from.”
aov_text: En hierdie man — ons weet van waar Hy is; maar die Christus, wanneer Hy kom, weet niemand van waar Hy is nie.

kjv_text: Then cried Jesus in the temple as he taught, saying, Ye both know me, and ye know whence I am: and I am not come of myself, but he that sent me is true, whom ye know not.
bsb_text: Then Jesus, still teaching in the temple courts, cried out, “You know Me, and you know where I am from. I have not come of My own accord, but He who sent Me is true. You do not know Him,
aov_text: Jesus roep toe uit, terwyl Hy in die tempel leer, en sê: Julle ken My en julle weet ook van waar Ek is; tog het Ek nie uit Myself gekom nie; maar Hy wat My gestuur het, is waaragtig, vir wie julle nie ken nie.

kjv_text: But I know him: for I am from him, and he hath sent me.
bsb_text: but I know Him, because I am from Him and He sent Me.”
aov_text: Maar Ek ken Hom, omdat Ek van Hom kom en Hy My gestuur het.

kjv_text: Then they sought to take him: but no man laid hands on him, because his hour was not yet come.
bsb_text: So they tried to seize Him, but no one laid a hand on Him, because His hour had not yet come.
aov_text: Toe probeer hulle om Hom gevange te neem; en niemand het die hand aan Hom geslaan nie, omdat sy uur nog nie gekom het nie.

kjv_text: And many of the people believed on him, and said, When Christ cometh, will he do more miracles than these which this man hath done?
bsb_text: Many in the crowd, however, believed in Him and said, “When the Christ comes, will He perform more signs than this man?”
aov_text: Maar baie van die skare het in Hom geglo en gesê: Wanneer die Christus kom, sal Hy meer tekens doen as wat hierdie man gedoen het?

kjv_text: The Pharisees heard that the people murmured such things concerning him; and the Pharisees and the chief priests sent officers to take him.
bsb_text: When the Pharisees heard the crowd whispering these things about Jesus, they and the chief priests sent officers to arrest Him.
aov_text: Die Fariseërs het gehoor dat die skare dit van Hom mompel, en die Fariseërs en die owerpriesters het dienaars gestuur om Hom gevange te neem.

kjv_text: Then said Jesus unto them, Yet a little while am I with you, and then I go unto him that sent me.
bsb_text: So Jesus said, “I am with you only a little while longer, and then I am going to the One who sent Me.
aov_text: Toe sê Jesus vir hulle: Nog ’n klein tydjie is Ek by julle, en Ek gaan na Hom wat My gestuur het.

kjv_text: Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come.
bsb_text: You will look for Me, but you will not find Me; and where I am, you cannot come.”
aov_text: Julle sal My soek en nie vind nie; en waar Ek is, kan julle nie kom nie.

kjv_text: Then said the Jews among themselves, Whither will he go, that we shall not find him? will he go unto the dispersed among the Gentiles, and teach the Gentiles?
bsb_text: At this, the Jews said to one another, “Where does He intend to go that we will not find Him? Will He go where the Jews are dispersed among the Greeks, and teach the Greeks?
aov_text: En die Jode sê onder mekaar: Waar wil Hy heengaan, dat ons Hom nie sal vind nie? Hy wil tog nie na die verstrooides onder die Grieke gaan en die Grieke leer nie?

kjv_text: What manner of saying is this that he said, Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come?
bsb_text: What does He mean by saying, ‘You will look for Me, but you will not find Me,’ and, ‘Where I am, you cannot come’?”
aov_text: Wat beteken hierdie woord wat Hy gesê het: Julle sal My soek en nie vind nie; en waar Ek is, kan julle nie kom nie?

kjv_text: In the last day, that great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.
bsb_text: On the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus stood up and called out in a loud voice, “If anyone is thirsty, let him come to Me and drink.
aov_text: En op die laaste dag, die groot dag van die fees, het Jesus gestaan en uitgeroep en gesê: As iemand dors het, laat hom na My toe kom en drink!

kjv_text: He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.
bsb_text: Whoever believes in Me, as the Scripture has said: ‘Streams of living water will flow from within him.’”
aov_text: Hy wat in My glo, soos die Skrif sê: strome van lewende water sal uit sy binneste vloei.

kjv_text: (But this spake he of the Spirit, which they that believe on him should receive: for the Holy Ghost was not yet given; because that Jesus was not yet glorified.)
bsb_text: He was speaking about the Spirit, whom those who believed in Him were later to receive. For the Spirit had not yet been given, because Jesus had not yet been glorified.
aov_text: En dit het Hy gesê van die Gees wat dié sou ontvang wat in Hom glo; want die Heilige Gees was daar nog nie, omdat Jesus nog nie verheerlik was nie.

kjv_text: Many of the people therefore, when they heard this saying, said, Of a truth this is the Prophet.
bsb_text: On hearing these words, some of the people said, “This is truly the Prophet.”
aov_text: Baie van die skare het, toe hulle die woord hoor, gesê: Hy is waarlik die profeet.

kjv_text: Others said, This is the Christ. But some said, Shall Christ come out of Galilee?
bsb_text: Others declared, “This is the Christ.” But still others asked, “How can the Christ come from Galilee?
aov_text: Ander het gesê: Hy is die Christus. En ander het gesê: Kom die Christus dan uit Galiléa?

kjv_text: Hath not the scripture said, That Christ cometh of the seed of David, and out of the town of Bethlehem, where David was?
bsb_text: Doesn’t the Scripture say that the Christ will come from the line of David and from Bethlehem, the village where David lived?”
aov_text: Het die Skrif nie gesê dat die Christus uit die geslag van Dawid kom en uit Betlehem, die dorp waar Dawid was nie?

kjv_text: So there was a division among the people because of him.
bsb_text: So there was division in the crowd because of Jesus.
aov_text: Daar het toe verdeeldheid onder die skare gekom oor Hom.

kjv_text: And some of them would have taken him; but no man laid hands on him.
bsb_text: Some of them wanted to seize Him, but no one laid a hand on Him.
aov_text: En sommige van hulle wou Hom gevange neem, maar niemand het die hand aan Hom geslaan nie.

kjv_text: Then came the officers to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said unto them, Why have ye not brought him?
bsb_text: Then the officers returned to the chief priests and Pharisees, who asked them, “Why didn’t you bring Him in?”
aov_text: Die dienaars kom toe by die owerpriesters en die Fariseërs, en dié sê vir hulle: Waarom het julle Hom nie gebring nie?

kjv_text: The officers answered, Never man spake like this man.
bsb_text: “Never has anyone spoken like this man!” the officers answered.
aov_text: Die dienaars antwoord: Nooit het ’n mens so gespreek soos hierdie mens nie.

kjv_text: Then answered them the Pharisees, Are ye also deceived?
bsb_text: “Have you also been deceived?” replied the Pharisees.
aov_text: En die Fariseërs antwoord hulle: Julle is tog nie ook mislei nie?

kjv_text: Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed on him?
bsb_text: “Have any of the rulers or Pharisees believed in Him?
aov_text: Het iemand uit die owerstes in Hom geglo, of uit die Fariseërs?

kjv_text: But this people who knoweth not the law are cursed.
bsb_text: But this crowd that does not know the law, they are under a curse.”
aov_text: Maar hierdie skare wat die wet nie ken nie, is vervloek!

kjv_text: Nicodemus saith unto them, (he that came to Jesus by night, being one of them,)
bsb_text: Nicodemus, who had gone to Jesus earlier and who himself was one of them, asked,
aov_text: Nikodémus — hy wat in die nag na Hom gegaan het, wat een van hulle was — sê vir hulle:

kjv_text: Doth our law judge any man, before it hear him, and know what he doeth?
bsb_text: “Does our law convict a man without first hearing from him to determine what he has done?”
aov_text: Oordeel ons wet die mens sonder om hom eers te hoor en te weet wat hy doen?

kjv_text: They answered and said unto him, Art thou also of Galilee? Search, and look: for out of Galilee ariseth no prophet.
bsb_text: “Aren’t you also from Galilee?” they replied. “Look into it, and you will see that no prophet comes out of Galilee.”
aov_text: Hulle antwoord en sê vir hom: Jy is tog nie ook uit Galiléa nie? Ondersoek en sien dat daar geen profeet uit Galiléa opgestaan het nie.

kjv_text: And every man went unto his own house.
bsb_text: Then each went to his own home.
aov_text: En elkeen het huis toe gegaan.

kjv_text: Jesus went unto the mount of Olives.
bsb_text: But Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.
aov_text: MAAR Jesus het na die Olyfberg gegaan.

kjv_text: And early in the morning he came again into the temple, and all the people came unto him; and he sat down, and taught them.
bsb_text: Early in the morning He went back into the temple courts. All the people came to Him, and He sat down to teach them.
aov_text: En vroeg in die môre het Hy weer in die tempel gegaan, en al die mense het na Hom gekom, en Hy het gaan sit en hulle geleer.

kjv_text: And the scribes and Pharisees brought unto him a woman taken in adultery; and when they had set her in the midst,
bsb_text: The scribes and Pharisees, however, brought to Him a woman caught in adultery. They made her stand before them
aov_text: En die skrifgeleerdes en die Fariseërs het ’n vrou wat in egbreuk betrap was, na Hom gebring.

kjv_text: They say unto him, Master, this woman was taken in adultery, in the very act.
bsb_text: and said, “Teacher, this woman was caught in the act of adultery.
aov_text: En toe hulle haar tussen hulle in laat staan het, sê hulle vir Hom: Meester, hierdie vrou is op ’n daad van egbreuk betrap;

kjv_text: Now Moses in the law commanded us, that such should be stoned: but what sayest thou?
bsb_text: In the Law Moses commanded us to stone such a woman. So what do You say?”
aov_text: en Moses het ons in die wet bevel gegee om sulke vroue te stenig; maar U, wat sê U?

kjv_text: This they said, tempting him, that they might have to accuse him. But Jesus stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground, as though he heard them not.
bsb_text: They said this to test Him, in order to have a basis for accusing Him. But Jesus bent down and began to write on the ground with His finger.
aov_text: En dit het hulle gesê om Hom te versoek, sodat hulle iets kon hê om Hom te beskuldig; maar Jesus het neergebuk en met die vinger op die grond geskrywe.

kjv_text: So when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.
bsb_text: When they continued to question Him, He straightened up and said to them, “Let him who is without sin among you be the first to cast a stone at her.”
aov_text: Maar toe hulle aanhou om Hom te vra, het Hy Hom opgerig en vir hulle gesê: Laat dié een van julle wat sonder sonde is, die eerste ’n klip op haar gooi.

kjv_text: And again he stooped down, and wrote on the ground.
bsb_text: And again He bent down and wrote on the ground.
aov_text: En weer het Hy neergebuk en op die grond geskrywe.

kjv_text: And they which heard it, being convicted by their own conscience, went out one by one, beginning at the eldest, even unto the last: and Jesus was left alone, and the woman standing in the midst.
bsb_text: When they heard this, they began to go away one by one, beginning with the older ones, until only Jesus was left, with the woman standing there.
aov_text: En toe hulle dit hoor, het hulle, deur hul gewete bestraf, een vir een weggegaan, van die oudste af tot die laaste toe; en Jesus het alleen agtergebly, en die vrou wat daar tussen hulle in gestaan het.

kjv_text: When Jesus had lifted up himself, and saw none but the woman, he said unto her, Woman, where are those thine accusers? hath no man condemned thee?
bsb_text: Then Jesus straightened up and asked her, “Woman, where are your accusers? Has no one condemned you?”
aov_text: En toe Jesus Hom oprig en niemand sien behalwe die vrou nie, sê Hy vir haar: Vrou, waar is daardie beskuldigers van jou? Het niemand jou veroordeel nie?

kjv_text: She said, No man, Lord. And Jesus said unto her, Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.
bsb_text: “No one, Lord,” she answered. “Then neither do I condemn you,” Jesus declared. “Now go and sin no more.”
aov_text: En sy antwoord: Niemand nie, Here. En Jesus sê vir haar: Ek veroordeel jou ook nie. Gaan heen en sondig nie meer nie.

kjv_text: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.
bsb_text: Once again, Jesus spoke to the people and said, “I am the light of the world. Whoever follows Me will never walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”
aov_text: EN Jesus het weer met hulle gespreek en gesê: Ek is die lig van die wêreld; wie My volg, sal sekerlik nie in die duisternis wandel nie, maar sal die lig van die lewe hê.

kjv_text: The Pharisees therefore said unto him, Thou bearest record of thyself; thy record is not true.
bsb_text: So the Pharisees said to Him, “You are testifying about Yourself; Your testimony is not valid.”
aov_text: Toe sê die Fariseërs vir Hom: U getuig van Uself; u getuienis is nie waar nie.

kjv_text: Jesus answered and said unto them, Though I bear record of myself, yet my record is true: for I know whence I came, and whither I go; but ye cannot tell whence I come, and whither I go.
bsb_text: Jesus replied, “Even if I testify about Myself, My testimony is valid, because I know where I came from and where I am going. But you do not know where I came from or where I am going.
aov_text: Jesus antwoord en sê vir hulle: Al getuig Ek ook van Myself, my getuienis is waar, omdat Ek weet van waar Ek gekom het en waarheen Ek gaan. Maar julle weet nie van waar Ek kom en waarheen Ek gaan nie.

kjv_text: Ye judge after the flesh; I judge no man.
bsb_text: You judge according to the flesh; I judge no one.
aov_text: Julle oordeel volgens die vlees. Ek oordeel niemand nie.

kjv_text: And yet if I judge, my judgment is true: for I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.
bsb_text: But even if I do judge, My judgment is true, because I am not alone; I am with the Father who sent Me.
aov_text: En al oordeel Ek, my oordeel is waar, omdat Ek nie alleen is nie, maar Ek en die Vader wat My gestuur het.

kjv_text: It is also written in your law, that the testimony of two men is true.
bsb_text: Even in your own Law it is written that the testimony of two men is valid.
aov_text: En dit is ook in julle wet geskrywe dat die getuienis van twee mense waar is.

kjv_text: I am one that bear witness of myself, and the Father that sent me beareth witness of me.
bsb_text: I am One who testifies about Myself, and the Father, who sent Me, also testifies about Me.”
aov_text: Dit is Ek wat van Myself getuig; en die Vader wat My gestuur het, getuig van My.

kjv_text: Then said they unto him, Where is thy Father? Jesus answered, Ye neither know me, nor my Father: if ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also.
bsb_text: “Where is Your Father?” they asked Him. “You do not know Me or My Father,” Jesus answered. “If you knew Me, you would know My Father as well.”
aov_text: Hulle sê toe vir Hom: Waar is u Vader? Jesus antwoord: Julle ken My nie en ook nie my Vader nie; as julle My geken het, sou julle ook my Vader geken het.

kjv_text: These words spake Jesus in the treasury, as he taught in the temple: and no man laid hands on him; for his hour was not yet come.
bsb_text: He spoke these words while teaching in the temple courts, near the treasury. Yet no one seized Him, because His hour had not yet come.
aov_text: Hierdie woorde het Jesus gespreek by die skatkis terwyl Hy in die tempel geleer het. En niemand het Hom gevange geneem nie, omdat sy uur nog nie gekom het nie.

kjv_text: Then said Jesus again unto them, I go my way, and ye shall seek me, and shall die in your sins: whither I go, ye cannot come.
bsb_text: Again He said to them, “I am going away, and you will look for Me, but you will die in your sin. Where I am going, you cannot come.”
aov_text: En Jesus het weer vir hulle gesê: Ek gaan weg, en julle sal My soek en in julle sonde sterwe. Waar Ek gaan, kan julle nie kom nie.

kjv_text: Then said the Jews, Will he kill himself? because he saith, Whither I go, ye cannot come.
bsb_text: So the Jews began to ask, “Will He kill Himself, since He says, ‘Where I am going, you cannot come’?”
aov_text: Toe sê die Jode: Hy sal Homself tog nie om die lewe bring nie, omdat Hy sê: Waar Ek gaan, kan julle nie kom nie?

kjv_text: And he said unto them, Ye are from beneath; I am from above: ye are of this world; I am not of this world.
bsb_text: Then He told them, “You are from below; I am from above. You are of this world; I am not of this world.
aov_text: En Hy sê vir hulle: Julle is van benede, Ek is van bo; julle is uit hierdie wêreld, Ek is nie uit hierdie wêreld nie.

kjv_text: I said therefore unto you, that ye shall die in your sins: for if ye believe not that I am he, ye shall die in your sins.
bsb_text: That is why I told you that you would die in your sins. For unless you believe that I am He, you will die in your sins.”
aov_text: Ek het dan vir julle gesê dat julle in jul sondes sal sterwe; want as julle nie glo dat dit Ek is nie, sal julle in jul sondes sterwe.

kjv_text: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? And Jesus saith unto them, Even the same that I said unto you from the beginning.
bsb_text: “Who are You?” they asked. “Just what I have been telling you from the beginning,” Jesus replied.
aov_text: Toe sê hulle vir Hom: Wie is U dan? En Jesus antwoord hulle: Net dit wat Ek vir julle sê.

kjv_text: I have many things to say and to judge of you: but he that sent me is true; and I speak to the world those things which I have heard of him.
bsb_text: “I have much to say about you and much to judge. But the One who sent Me is truthful, and what I have heard from Him, I tell the world.”
aov_text: Ek het baie dinge om van julle te sê en te oordeel; maar Hy wat My gestuur het, is waaragtig; en Ek, wat Ek van Hom gehoor het, dit spreek Ek tot die wêreld.

kjv_text: They understood not that he spake to them of the Father.
bsb_text: They did not understand that He was telling them about the Father.
aov_text: Hulle het nie verstaan dat Hy met hulle van die Vader gespreek het nie.

kjv_text: Then said Jesus unto them, When ye have lifted up the Son of man, then shall ye know that I am he, and that I do nothing of myself; but as my Father hath taught me, I speak these things.
bsb_text: So Jesus said, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am He, and that I do nothing on My own, but speak exactly what the Father has taught Me.
aov_text: En Jesus sê vir hulle: Wanneer julle die Seun van die mens verhoog het, dan sal julle weet dat dit Ek is; en uit Myself doen Ek niks nie; maar net wat my Vader My geleer het, dit spreek Ek.

kjv_text: And he that sent me is with me: the Father hath not left me alone; for I do always those things that please him.
bsb_text: He who sent Me is with Me. He has not left Me alone, because I always do what pleases Him.”
aov_text: En Hy wat My gestuur het, is met My; die Vader het My nie alleen gelaat nie, omdat Ek altyd doen wat Hom welgevallig is.

kjv_text: As he spake these words, many believed on him.
bsb_text: As Jesus spoke these things, many believed in Him.
aov_text: Terwyl Hy hierdie dinge spreek, het baie in Hom geglo.

kjv_text: Then said Jesus to those Jews which believed on him, If ye continue in my word, then are ye my disciples indeed;
bsb_text: So He said to the Jews who had believed Him, “If you continue in My word, you are truly My disciples.
aov_text: En Jesus sê vir die Jode wat in Hom geglo het: As julle in my woord bly, is julle waarlik my dissipels.

kjv_text: And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.
bsb_text: Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.”
aov_text: En julle sal die waarheid ken, en die waarheid sal julle vrymaak.

kjv_text: They answered him, We be Abraham's seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?
bsb_text: “We are Abraham’s descendants,” they answered. “We have never been slaves to anyone. How can You say we will be set free?”
aov_text: Hulle antwoord Hom: Ons is die geslag van Abraham en het nog nooit vir iemand slawediens verrig nie; hoe sê U dan: Julle sal vry word?

kjv_text: Jesus answered them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin.
bsb_text: Jesus replied, “Truly, truly, I tell you, everyone who sins is a slave to sin.
aov_text: Jesus antwoord hulle: Voorwaar, voorwaar Ek sê vir julle dat elkeen wat die sonde doen, ’n dienskneg van die sonde is.

kjv_text: And the servant abideth not in the house for ever: but the Son abideth ever.
bsb_text: A slave is not a permanent member of the family, but a son belongs to it forever.
aov_text: En die dienskneg bly nie vir altyd in die huis nie; die seun bly vir altyd.

kjv_text: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.
bsb_text: So if the Son sets you free, you will be free indeed.
aov_text: As die Seun julle dan vrygemaak het, sal julle waarlik vry wees.

kjv_text: I know that ye are Abraham's seed; but ye seek to kill me, because my word hath no place in you.
bsb_text: I know you are Abraham’s descendants, but you are trying to kill Me because My word has no place within you.
aov_text: Ek weet dat julle die geslag van Abraham is; maar julle probeer om My om die lewe te bring, omdat my woord geen ingang in julle vind nie.

kjv_text: I speak that which I have seen with my Father: and ye do that which ye have seen with your father.
bsb_text: I speak of what I have seen in the presence of the Father, and you do what you have heard from your father.”
aov_text: Ek spreek van wat Ek by my Vader gesien het, en julle doen ook wat julle by jul vader gesien het.

kjv_text: They answered and said unto him, Abraham is our father. Jesus saith unto them, If ye were Abraham's children, ye would do the works of Abraham.
bsb_text: “Abraham is our father,” they replied. “If you were children of Abraham,” said Jesus, “you would do the works of Abraham.
aov_text: Hulle antwoord en sê vir Hom: Ons vader is Abraham. Jesus sê vir hulle: As julle die kinders van Abraham was, sou julle die werke van Abraham doen;

kjv_text: But now ye seek to kill me, a man that hath told you the truth, which I have heard of God: this did not Abraham.
bsb_text: But now you are trying to kill Me, a man who has told you the truth that I heard from God. Abraham never did such a thing.
aov_text: maar nou probeer julle om My om die lewe te bring, iemand wat aan julle die waarheid vertel het, wat Ek van God gehoor het. Dit het Abraham nie gedoen nie.

kjv_text: Ye do the deeds of your father. Then said they to him, We be not born of fornication; we have one Father, even God.
bsb_text: You are doing the works of your father.” “We are not illegitimate children,” they declared. “Our only Father is God Himself.”
aov_text: Julle doen die werke van jul vader. Toe sê hulle vir Hom: Ons is nie uit ontug gebore nie; ons het een Vader, naamlik God.

kjv_text: Jesus said unto them, If God were your Father, ye would love me: for I proceeded forth and came from God; neither came I of myself, but he sent me.
bsb_text: Jesus said to them, “If God were your Father, you would love Me, for I have come here from God. I have not come on My own, but He sent Me.
aov_text: En Jesus sê vir hulle: As God julle Vader was, sou julle My liefhê, want Ek het uit God uitgegaan en gekom; want Ek het ook nie uit Myself gekom nie, maar Hy het My gestuur.

kjv_text: Why do ye not understand my speech? even because ye cannot hear my word.
bsb_text: Why do you not understand what I am saying? It is because you are unable to accept My message.
aov_text: Waarom ken julle my spraak nie? Omdat julle na my woord nie kan luister nie.

kjv_text: Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.
bsb_text: You belong to your father, the devil, and you want to carry out his desires. He was a murderer from the beginning, refusing to uphold the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he lies, he speaks his native language, because he is a liar and the father of lies.
aov_text: Julle het die duiwel as vader, en die begeertes van julle vader wil julle doen. Hy was ’n mensemoordenaar van die begin af en staan nie in die waarheid nie, omdat daar in hom geen waarheid is nie. Wanneer hy leuentaal praat, praat hy uit sy eie, omdat hy ’n leuenaar is en die vader daarvan.

kjv_text: And because I tell you the truth, ye believe me not.
bsb_text: But because I speak the truth, you do not believe Me!
aov_text: Maar omdat Ek die waarheid spreek, glo julle My nie.

kjv_text: Which of you convinceth me of sin? And if I say the truth, why do ye not believe me?
bsb_text: Which of you can prove Me guilty of sin? If I speak the truth, why do you not believe Me?
aov_text: Wie van julle oortuig My van sonde? En as Ek die waarheid spreek, waarom glo julle My nie?

kjv_text: He that is of God heareth God's words: ye therefore hear them not, because ye are not of God.
bsb_text: Whoever belongs to God hears the words of God. The reason you do not hear is that you do not belong to God.”
aov_text: Die wat uit God is, luister na die woorde van God. Daarom luister julle nie, omdat julle nie uit God is nie.

kjv_text: Then answered the Jews, and said unto him, Say we not well that thou art a Samaritan, and hast a devil?
bsb_text: The Jews answered Him, “Are we not right to say that You are a Samaritan and You have a demon?”
aov_text: Die Jode antwoord toe en sê vir Hom: Sê ons nie met reg dat U ’n Samaritaan is en van die duiwel besete is nie?

kjv_text: Jesus answered, I have not a devil; but I honour my Father, and ye do dishonour me.
bsb_text: “I do not have a demon,” Jesus replied, “but I honor My Father, and you dishonor Me.
aov_text: Jesus antwoord: Ek is nie van die duiwel besete nie; maar Ek eer my Vader, en julle doen My oneer aan.

kjv_text: And I seek not mine own glory: there is one that seeketh and judgeth.
bsb_text: I do not seek My own glory. There is One who seeks it, and He is the Judge.
aov_text: En Ek soek nie my eer nie; daar is Een wat dit soek en wat oordeel.

kjv_text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, If a man keep my saying, he shall never see death.
bsb_text: Truly, truly, I tell you, if anyone keeps My word, he will never see death.”
aov_text: Voorwaar, voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, as iemand my woord bewaar, sal hy die dood in der ewigheid nie sien nie.

kjv_text: Then said the Jews unto him, Now we know that thou hast a devil. Abraham is dead, and the prophets; and thou sayest, If a man keep my saying, he shall never taste of death.
bsb_text: “Now we know that You have a demon!” declared the Jews. “Abraham died, and so did the prophets, yet You say that anyone who keeps Your word will never taste death.
aov_text: Toe sê die Jode vir Hom: Nou weet ons dat U van die duiwel besete is. Abraham het gesterwe en die profete, en U sê: As iemand my woord bewaar, sal hy die dood in der ewigheid nie smaak nie.

kjv_text: Art thou greater than our father Abraham, which is dead? and the prophets are dead: whom makest thou thyself?
bsb_text: Are You greater than our father Abraham? He died, as did the prophets. Who do You claim to be?”
aov_text: Is U dan groter as ons vader Abraham wat gesterf het? En die profete het gesterwe. Vir wie gee U Uself uit?

kjv_text: Jesus answered, If I honour myself, my honour is nothing: it is my Father that honoureth me; of whom ye say, that he is your God:
bsb_text: Jesus answered, “If I glorify Myself, My glory means nothing. The One who glorifies Me is My Father, of whom you say ‘He is our God.’
aov_text: Jesus antwoord: As Ek Myself verheerlik, is my heerlikheid niks nie. Dit is my Vader wat My verheerlik, van wie julle sê dat Hy julle God is.

kjv_text: Yet ye have not known him; but I know him: and if I should say, I know him not, I shall be a liar like unto you: but I know him, and keep his saying.
bsb_text: You do not know Him, but I know Him. If I said I did not know Him, I would be a liar like you. But I do know Him, and I keep His word.
aov_text: En julle ken Hom nie, maar Ek ken Hom; en as Ek sê dat Ek Hom nie ken nie, sal Ek soos julle ’n leuenaar wees. Maar Ek ken Hom en bewaar sy woord.

kjv_text: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day: and he saw it, and was glad.
bsb_text: Your father Abraham rejoiced that he would see My day. He saw it and was glad.”
aov_text: Abraham, julle vader, het hom verheug dat hy my dag sou sien; en hy het dit gesien en het hom verbly.

kjv_text: Then said the Jews unto him, Thou art not yet fifty years old, and hast thou seen Abraham?
bsb_text: Then the Jews said to Him, “You are not yet fifty years old, and You have seen Abraham?”
aov_text: Toe sê die Jode vir Hom: U is nog nie vyftig jaar oud nie, en het U Abraham gesien?

kjv_text: Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was, I am.
bsb_text: “Truly, truly, I tell you,” Jesus declared, “before Abraham was born, I am!”
aov_text: Jesus sê vir hulle: Voorwaar, voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, voordat Abraham was, is Ek.

kjv_text: Then took they up stones to cast at him: but Jesus hid himself, and went out of the temple, going through the midst of them, and so passed by.
bsb_text: At this, they picked up stones to throw at Him. But Jesus was hidden and went out of the temple area.
aov_text: Hulle het toe klippe opgetel om Hom te stenig; maar Jesus het stilletjies uit die tempel gegaan en tussen hulle deurgeloop; en so het Hy vertrek.

kjv_text: And as Jesus passed by, he saw a man which was blind from his birth.
bsb_text: Now as Jesus was passing by, He saw a man blind from birth,
aov_text: EN toe Hy verbygaan, sien Hy ’n man wat blind was van sy geboorte af.

kjv_text: And his disciples asked him, saying, Master, who did sin, this man, or his parents, that he was born blind?
bsb_text: and His disciples asked Him, “Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?”
aov_text: En sy dissipels vra Hom en sê: Rabbi, wie het gesondig, hierdie man of sy ouers, dat hy blind gebore is?

kjv_text: Jesus answered, Neither hath this man sinned, nor his parents: but that the works of God should be made manifest in him.
bsb_text: Jesus answered, “Neither this man nor his parents sinned, but this happened so that the works of God would be displayed in him.
aov_text: Jesus antwoord: Hy het nie gesondig nie, en sy ouers ook nie; maar die werke van God moet in hom openbaar word.

kjv_text: I must work the works of him that sent me, while it is day: the night cometh, when no man can work.
bsb_text: While it is daytime, we must do the works of Him who sent Me. Night is coming, when no one can work.
aov_text: Ek moet die werke doen van Hom wat My gestuur het, so lank as dit dag is; die nag kom wanneer niemand kan werk nie.

kjv_text: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.
bsb_text: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”
aov_text: So lank as Ek in die wêreld is, is Ek die lig van die wêreld.

kjv_text: When he had thus spoken, he spat on the ground, and made clay of the spittle, and he anointed the eyes of the blind man with the clay,
bsb_text: When Jesus had said this, He spit on the ground, made some mud, and applied it to the man’s eyes.
aov_text: En toe Hy dit gesê het, spuug Hy op die grond en maak klei van die spuug en smeer die klei aan die oë van die blinde man

kjv_text: And said unto him, Go, wash in the pool of Siloam, (which is by interpretation, Sent.) He went his way therefore, and washed, and came seeing.
bsb_text: Then He told him, “Go, wash in the Pool of Siloam” (which means “Sent”). So the man went and washed, and came back seeing.
aov_text: en sê vir hom: Gaan was jou in die badwater Silóam, wat vertaal word: Uitgestuur. En hy het gegaan en hom gewas; en hy het siende teruggekom.

kjv_text: The neighbours therefore, and they which before had seen him that he was blind, said, Is not this he that sat and begged?
bsb_text: At this, his neighbors and those who had formerly seen him begging began to ask, “Isn’t this the man who used to sit and beg?”
aov_text: Die bure dan en die wat hom vroeër gesien het dat hy blind was, sê toe: Is hy nie die een wat gesit en bedel het nie?

kjv_text: Some said, This is he: others said, He is like him: but he said, I am he.
bsb_text: Some claimed that he was, but others said, “No, he just looks like him.” But the man kept saying, “I am the one.”
aov_text: Ander sê: Dit is hy. Ander weer: Hy lyk na hom. Hy antwoord: Dit is ek.

kjv_text: Therefore said they unto him, How were thine eyes opened?
bsb_text: “How then were your eyes opened?” they asked.
aov_text: Hulle sê vir hom: Hoe is jou oë geopen?

kjv_text: He answered and said, A man that is called Jesus made clay, and anointed mine eyes, and said unto me, Go to the pool of Siloam, and wash: and I went and washed, and I received sight.
bsb_text: He answered, “The man they call Jesus made some mud and anointed my eyes, and He told me to go to Siloam and wash. So I went and washed and received my sight.”
aov_text: Hy antwoord en sê: Die man wat Jesus genoem word, het klei gemaak en op my oë gesmeer en vir my gesê: Gaan na die badwater Silóam en was jou. En ek het gegaan en my gewas en ek sien.

kjv_text: Then said they unto him, Where is he? He said, I know not.
bsb_text: “Where is He?” they asked. “I do not know,” he answered.
aov_text: En hulle sê vir hom: Waar is Hy? Hy antwoord: Ek weet nie.

kjv_text: They brought to the Pharisees him that aforetime was blind.
bsb_text: They brought to the Pharisees the man who had been blind.
aov_text: Hulle bring hom na die Fariseërs — die man wat vroeër blind was.

kjv_text: And it was the sabbath day when Jesus made the clay, and opened his eyes.
bsb_text: Now the day on which Jesus had made the mud and opened his eyes was a Sabbath.
aov_text: En dit was sabbat toe Jesus die klei gemaak en sy oë geopen het.

kjv_text: Then again the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. He said unto them, He put clay upon mine eyes, and I washed, and do see.
bsb_text: So the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. The man answered, “He put mud on my eyes, and I washed, and now I can see.”
aov_text: Die Fariseërs vra hom toe weer hoe hy siende geword het. En hy antwoord hulle: Hy het klei op my oë gesit, en ek het my gewas en ek sien.

kjv_text: Therefore said some of the Pharisees, This man is not of God, because he keepeth not the sabbath day. Others said, How can a man that is a sinner do such miracles? And there was a division among them.
bsb_text: Because of this, some of the Pharisees said, “This man is not from God, for He does not keep the Sabbath.” But others said, “How can a sinful man perform such signs?” And there was division among them.
aov_text: En sommige van die Fariseërs sê: Hierdie man kom nie van God nie, omdat Hy die sabbat nie hou nie. Ander sê: Hoe kan ’n sondige mens sulke tekens doen? En daar was verdeeldheid onder hulle.

kjv_text: They say unto the blind man again, What sayest thou of him, that he hath opened thine eyes? He said, He is a prophet.
bsb_text: So once again they asked the man who had been blind, “What do you say about Him, since it was your eyes He opened?” “He is a prophet,” the man replied.
aov_text: Weer sê hulle vir die blinde man: Jy, wat sê jy van Hom, aangesien Hy jou oë geopen het? En hy antwoord: Hy is ’n profeet.

kjv_text: But the Jews did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind, and received his sight, until they called the parents of him that had received his sight.
bsb_text: The Jews still did not believe that the man had been blind and had received his sight until they summoned his parents
aov_text: En die Jode het dit nie van hom geglo dat hy blind was en siende geword het nie, totdat hulle die ouers geroep het van hom wat siende geword het.

kjv_text: And they asked them, saying, Is this your son, who ye say was born blind? how then doth he now see?
bsb_text: and asked, “Is this your son, the one you say was born blind? So how is it that he can now see?”
aov_text: En hulle vra hul en sê: Is dit julle seun van wie julle sê dat hy blind gebore is? Hoe sien hy dan nou?

kjv_text: His parents answered them and said, We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind:
bsb_text: His parents answered, “We know he is our son, and we know he was born blind.
aov_text: Sy ouers antwoord hulle en sê: Ons weet dat hy ons seun is en dat hy blind gebore is;

kjv_text: But by what means he now seeth, we know not; or who hath opened his eyes, we know not: he is of age; ask him: he shall speak for himself.
bsb_text: But how he can now see or who opened his eyes, we do not know. Ask him. He is old enough to speak for himself.”
aov_text: maar hoe hy nou sien, weet ons nie; of wie sy oë geopen het, weet ons nie. Hy is self oud genoeg, vra hom; hy sal vir homself praat.

kjv_text: These words spake his parents, because they feared the Jews: for the Jews had agreed already, that if any man did confess that he was Christ, he should be put out of the synagogue.
bsb_text: His parents said this because they were afraid of the Jews. For the Jews had already determined that anyone who confessed Jesus as the Christ would be put out of the synagogue.
aov_text: Dit het sy ouers gesê omdat hulle bang was vir die Jode; want die Jode het al ooreengekom dat as iemand Hom as die Christus bely, hy uit die sinagoge geban sou word.

kjv_text: Therefore said his parents, He is of age; ask him.
bsb_text: That was why his parents said, “He is old enough. Ask him.”
aov_text: Daarom het sy ouers gesê: Hy is oud genoeg, vra hom.

kjv_text: Then again called they the man that was blind, and said unto him, Give God the praise: we know that this man is a sinner.
bsb_text: So a second time they called for the man who had been blind and said, “Give glory to God! We know that this man is a sinner.”
aov_text: Hulle roep toe vir die tweede keer die man wat blind was, en sê vir hom: Gee aan God die eer; ons weet dat hierdie man ’n sondaar is.

kjv_text: He answered and said, Whether he be a sinner or no, I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.
bsb_text: He answered, “Whether He is a sinner I do not know. There is one thing I do know: I was blind, but now I see!”
aov_text: En hy antwoord en sê: Of Hy ’n sondaar is, weet ek nie. Een ding weet ek: dat ek blind was en nou sien.

kjv_text: Then said they to him again, What did he to thee? how opened he thine eyes?
bsb_text: “What did He do to you?” they asked. “How did He open your eyes?”
aov_text: En hulle sê weer vir hom: Wat het Hy vir jou gedoen? Hoe het Hy jou oë geopen?

kjv_text: He answered them, I have told you already, and ye did not hear: wherefore would ye hear it again? will ye also be his disciples?
bsb_text: He replied, “I already told you, and you did not listen. Why do you want to hear it again? Do you also want to become His disciples?”
aov_text: Hy antwoord hulle: Ek het julle dit alreeds gesê, en julle het nie geluister nie. Waarom wil julle dit weer hoor? Julle wil tog nie ook sy dissipels word nie?

kjv_text: Then they reviled him, and said, Thou art his disciple; but we are Moses' disciples.
bsb_text: Then they heaped insults on him and said, “You are His disciple; we are disciples of Moses.
aov_text: Hulle skel hom toe uit en sê: Jý is ’n dissipel van daardie man, maar ons is dissipels van Moses.

kjv_text: We know that God spake unto Moses: as for this fellow, we know not from whence he is.
bsb_text: We know that God spoke to Moses, but we do not know where this man is from.”
aov_text: Ons weet dat God met Moses gespreek het; maar wat Hom betref, ons weet nie van waar Hy is nie.

kjv_text: The man answered and said unto them, Why herein is a marvellous thing, that ye know not from whence he is, and yet he hath opened mine eyes.
bsb_text: “That is remarkable indeed!” the man said. “You do not know where He is from, and yet He opened my eyes.
aov_text: Die man antwoord en sê vir hulle: Hierin is tog iets wonderliks dat julle nie weet van waar Hy is nie, en Hy het my oë geopen!

kjv_text: Now we know that God heareth not sinners: but if any man be a worshipper of God, and doeth his will, him he heareth.
bsb_text: We know that God does not listen to sinners, but He does listen to the one who worships Him and does His will.
aov_text: En ons weet dat God nie sondaars verhoor nie; maar as iemand godvresend is en sy wil doen, dié verhoor Hy.

kjv_text: Since the world began was it not heard that any man opened the eyes of one that was born blind.
bsb_text: Never before has anyone heard of opening the eyes of a man born blind.
aov_text: Van ouds af is dit nie gehoor dat iemand die oë van ’n blindgebore mens geopen het nie.

kjv_text: If this man were not of God, he could do nothing.
bsb_text: If this man were not from God, He could do no such thing.”
aov_text: As Hy nie van God was nie, sou Hy niks kan doen nie.

kjv_text: They answered and said unto him, Thou wast altogether born in sins, and dost thou teach us? And they cast him out.
bsb_text: They replied, “You were born in utter sin, and you are instructing us?” And they threw him out.
aov_text: Hulle antwoord en sê vir hom: Jy is heeltemal in sondes gebore, en leer jy ons? En hulle het hom uitgeban.

kjv_text: Jesus heard that they had cast him out; and when he had found him, he said unto him, Dost thou believe on the Son of God?
bsb_text: When Jesus heard that they had thrown him out, He found the man and said, “Do you believe in the Son of Man?”
aov_text: Jesus het gehoor dat hulle hom uitgeban het; en toe Hy hom kry, sê Hy vir hom: Glo jy in die Seun van God?

kjv_text: He answered and said, Who is he, Lord, that I might believe on him?
bsb_text: “Who is He, Sir?” he replied. “Tell me so that I may believe in Him.”
aov_text: Hy antwoord en sê: Wie is Hy, Here, dat ek in Hom kan glo?

kjv_text: And Jesus said unto him, Thou hast both seen him, and it is he that talketh with thee.
bsb_text: “You have already seen Him,” Jesus answered. “He is the One speaking with you.”
aov_text: En Jesus sê vir hom: Jy het Hom gesien; en Hy wat met jou spreek, dit is Hy.

kjv_text: And he said, Lord, I believe. And he worshipped him.
bsb_text: “Lord, I believe,” he said. And he worshiped Jesus.
aov_text: Toe sê hy: Ek glo, Here! En hy het Hom aanbid.

kjv_text: And Jesus said, For judgment I am come into this world, that they which see not might see; and that they which see might be made blind.
bsb_text: Then Jesus declared, “For judgment I have come into this world, so that the blind may see and those who see may become blind.”
aov_text: En Jesus sê: Tot ’n oordeel het Ek in hierdie wêreld gekom, sodat die wat nie sien nie, mag sien, en die wat sien, blind mag word.

kjv_text: And some of the Pharisees which were with him heard these words, and said unto him, Are we blind also?
bsb_text: Some of the Pharisees who were with Him heard this, and they asked Him, “Are we blind too?”
aov_text: En dié van die Fariseërs wat by Hom was, het dit gehoor en vir Hom gesê: Is ons dan ook blind?

kjv_text: Jesus said unto them, If ye were blind, ye should have no sin: but now ye say, We see; therefore your sin remaineth.
bsb_text: “If you were blind,” Jesus replied, “you would not be guilty of sin. But since you claim you can see, your guilt remains.”
aov_text: Jesus antwoord hulle: As julle blind was, sou julle geen sonde hê nie; maar nou sê julle: Ons sien! Daarom bly julle sonde.

kjv_text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that entereth not by the door into the sheepfold, but climbeth up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.
bsb_text: “Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever does not enter the sheepfold by the gate, but climbs in some other way, is a thief and a robber.
aov_text: VOORWAAR, voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, wie nie by die deur in die skaapstal ingaan nie, maar van ’n ander kant af inklim, hy is ’n dief en ’n rower.

kjv_text: But he that entereth in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
bsb_text: But the one who enters by the gate is the shepherd of the sheep.
aov_text: Maar hy wat by die deur ingaan, is ’n herder van die skape.

kjv_text: To him the porter openeth; and the sheep hear his voice: and he calleth his own sheep by name, and leadeth them out.
bsb_text: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen for his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.
aov_text: Vir hom maak die deurwagter oop, en die skape luister na sy stem; en hy roep sy eie skape by hulle naam en lei hulle uit.

kjv_text: And when he putteth forth his own sheep, he goeth before them, and the sheep follow him: for they know his voice.
bsb_text: When he has brought out all his own, he goes on ahead of them, and his sheep follow him because they know his voice.
aov_text: En wanneer hy sy eie skape uitgebring het, loop hy voor hulle uit; en die skape volg hom, omdat hulle sy stem ken.

kjv_text: And a stranger will they not follow, but will flee from him: for they know not the voice of strangers.
bsb_text: But they will never follow a stranger; in fact, they will flee from him because they do not recognize his voice.”
aov_text: Hulle sal ’n vreemde nooit volg nie, maar van hom wegvlug, omdat hulle die stem van die vreemdes nie ken nie.

kjv_text: This parable spake Jesus unto them: but they understood not what things they were which he spake unto them.
bsb_text: Jesus spoke to them using this illustration, but they did not understand what He was telling them.
aov_text: Hierdie gelykenis het Jesus aan hulle vertel; maar hulle het nie verstaan wat dit was wat Hy tot hulle gespreek het nie.

kjv_text: Then said Jesus unto them again, Verily, verily, I say unto you, I am the door of the sheep.
bsb_text: So He said to them again, “Truly, truly, I tell you, I am the gate for the sheep.
aov_text: Jesus het toe weer vir hulle gesê: Voorwaar, voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, Ek is die deur van die skape.

kjv_text: All that ever came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them.
bsb_text: All who came before Me were thieves and robbers, but the sheep did not listen to them.
aov_text: Almal wat voor My gekom het, is diewe en rowers; maar die skape het nie na hulle geluister nie.

kjv_text: I am the door: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture.
bsb_text: I am the gate. If anyone enters through Me, he will be saved. He will come in and go out and find pasture.
aov_text: Ek is die deur; as iemand deur My ingaan, sal hy gered word, en hy sal ingaan en uitgaan en weiding vind.

kjv_text: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.
bsb_text: The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy. I have come that they may have life, and have it in all its fullness.
aov_text: Die dief kom net om te steel en te slag en te verwoes. Ek het gekom, dat hulle lewe en oorvloed kan hê.

kjv_text: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.
bsb_text: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down His life for the sheep.
aov_text: Ek is die goeie herder. Die goeie herder lê sy lewe af vir die skape.

kjv_text: But he that is an hireling, and not the shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, seeth the wolf coming, and leaveth the sheep, and fleeth: and the wolf catcheth them, and scattereth the sheep.
bsb_text: The hired hand is not the shepherd, and the sheep are not his own. When he sees the wolf coming, he abandons the sheep and runs away. Then the wolf pounces on them and scatters the flock.
aov_text: Maar die huurling en hy wat nie ’n herder is nie, van wie die skape nie die eiendom is nie, sien die wolf kom en laat die skape staan en vlug, en die wolf vang hulle en jaag die skape uitmekaar.

kjv_text: The hireling fleeth, because he is an hireling, and careth not for the sheep.
bsb_text: The man runs away because he is a hired servant and is unconcerned for the sheep.
aov_text: En die huurling vlug, omdat hy ’n huurling is en niks vir die skape omgee nie.

kjv_text: I am the good shepherd, and know my sheep, and am known of mine.
bsb_text: I am the good shepherd. I know My sheep and My sheep know Me,
aov_text: Ek is die goeie herder, en Ek ken my eie en word deur my eie geken.

kjv_text: As the Father knoweth me, even so know I the Father: and I lay down my life for the sheep.
bsb_text: just as the Father knows Me and I know the Father. And I lay down My life for the sheep.
aov_text: Net soos die Vader My ken, ken Ek ook die Vader; en Ek lê my lewe af vir die skape.

kjv_text: And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold, and one shepherd.
bsb_text: I have other sheep that are not of this fold. I must bring them in as well, and they will listen to My voice. Then there will be one flock and one shepherd.
aov_text: Ek het nog ander skape wat nie aan hierdie stal behoort nie. Ek moet hulle ook lei, en hulle sal na my stem luister, en dit sal wees een kudde, een herder.

kjv_text: Therefore doth my Father love me, because I lay down my life, that I might take it again.
bsb_text: The reason the Father loves Me is that I lay down My life in order to take it up again.
aov_text: Daarom het die Vader My lief, omdat Ek my lewe aflê om dit weer te neem.

kjv_text: No man taketh it from me, but I lay it down of myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. This commandment have I received of my Father.
bsb_text: No one takes it from Me, but I lay it down of My own accord. I have authority to lay it down and authority to take it up again. This charge I have received from My Father.”
aov_text: Niemand neem dit van My af nie, maar Ek lê dit uit Myself af. Ek het mag om dit af te lê en Ek het mag om dit weer te neem. Hierdie gebod het Ek van my Vader ontvang.

kjv_text: There was a division therefore again among the Jews for these sayings.
bsb_text: Again there was division among the Jews because of Jesus’ message.
aov_text: Daar het toe weer verdeeldheid onder die Jode gekom oor hierdie woorde.

kjv_text: And many of them said, He hath a devil, and is mad; why hear ye him?
bsb_text: Many of them said, “He is demon-possessed and insane. Why would you listen to Him?”
aov_text: En baie van hulle het gesê: Hy is van die duiwel besete en is kranksinnig; wat luister julle na Hom?

kjv_text: Others said, These are not the words of him that hath a devil. Can a devil open the eyes of the blind?
bsb_text: But others replied, “These are not the words of a man possessed by a demon. Can a demon open the eyes of the blind?”
aov_text: Ander het gesê: Hierdie woorde is nie van ’n besetene nie; ’n duiwel kan tog nie die oë van blindes open nie.

kjv_text: And it was at Jerusalem the feast of the dedication, and it was winter.
bsb_text: At that time the Feast of Dedication took place in Jerusalem. It was winter,
aov_text: EN dit was die fees van die tempelwyding in Jerusalem, en dit was winter.

kjv_text: And Jesus walked in the temple in Solomon's porch.
bsb_text: and Jesus was walking in the temple courts in Solomon’s Colonnade.
aov_text: En Jesus het in die tempel gewandel in die pilaargang van Salomo.

kjv_text: Then came the Jews round about him, and said unto him, How long dost thou make us to doubt? If thou be the Christ, tell us plainly.
bsb_text: So the Jews gathered around Him and demanded, “How long will You keep us in suspense? If You are the Christ, tell us plainly.”
aov_text: En die Jode het Hom omring en vir Hom gesê: Hoe lank hou U ons in onsekerheid? As U die Christus is, sê dit vir ons ronduit.

kjv_text: Jesus answered them, I told you, and ye believed not: the works that I do in my Father's name, they bear witness of me.
bsb_text: “I already told you,” Jesus replied, “but you did not believe. The works I do in My Father’s name testify on My behalf.
aov_text: Jesus antwoord hulle: Ek het dit vir julle gesê, en julle glo nie. Die werke wat Ek doen in die Naam van my Vader, dié getuig van My.

kjv_text: But ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep, as I said unto you.
bsb_text: But because you are not My sheep, you refuse to believe.
aov_text: Maar julle glo nie, want julle is nie van my skape nie, soos Ek vir julle gesê het.

kjv_text: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:
bsb_text: My sheep listen to My voice; I know them, and they follow Me.
aov_text: My skape luister na my stem, en Ek ken hulle, en hulle volg My.

kjv_text: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.
bsb_text: I give them eternal life, and they will never perish. No one can snatch them out of My hand.
aov_text: En Ek gee hulle die ewige lewe, en hulle sal nooit verlore gaan tot in ewigheid nie, en niemand sal hulle uit my hand ruk nie.

kjv_text: My Father, which gave them me, is greater than all; and no man is able to pluck them out of my Father's hand.
bsb_text: My Father who has given them to Me is greater than all. No one can snatch them out of My Father’s hand.
aov_text: My Vader wat hulle aan My gegee het, is groter as almal; en niemand kan hulle uit die hand van my Vader ruk nie.

kjv_text: I and my Father are one.
bsb_text: I and the Father are one.”
aov_text: Ek en die Vader is een.

kjv_text: Then the Jews took up stones again to stone him.
bsb_text: At this, the Jews again picked up stones to stone Him.
aov_text: Die Jode het toe weer klippe opgetel om Hom te stenig.

kjv_text: Jesus answered them, Many good works have I shewed you from my Father; for which of those works do ye stone me?
bsb_text: But Jesus responded, “I have shown you many good works from the Father. For which of these do you stone Me?”
aov_text: Jesus antwoord hulle: Baie goeie werke het Ek julle getoon van my Vader. Oor watter een van dié werke stenig julle My?

kjv_text: The Jews answered him, saying, For a good work we stone thee not; but for blasphemy; and because that thou, being a man, makest thyself God.
bsb_text: “We are not stoning You for any good work,” said the Jews, “but for blasphemy, because You, who are a man, declare Yourself to be God.”
aov_text: Die Jode antwoord Hom en sê: Dit is nie oor ’n goeie werk dat ons U stenig nie, maar oor godslastering, en omdat U wat ’n mens is, Uself God maak.

kjv_text: Jesus answered them, Is it not written in your law, I said, Ye are gods?
bsb_text: Jesus replied, “Is it not written in your Law: ‘I have said you are gods’?
aov_text: Jesus antwoord hulle: Is daar nie in julle wet geskrywe: Ek het gesê, julle is gode nie?

kjv_text: If he called them gods, unto whom the word of God came, and the scripture cannot be broken;
bsb_text: If he called them gods to whom the word of God came—and the Scripture cannot be broken—
aov_text: As dit húlle gode noem tot wie die woord van God gekom het, en die Skrif nie gebreek kan word nie,

kjv_text: Say ye of him, whom the Father hath sanctified, and sent into the world, Thou blasphemest; because I said, I am the Son of God?
bsb_text: then what about the One whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world? How then can you accuse Me of blasphemy for stating that I am the Son of God?
aov_text: sê julle vir Hom wat die Vader geheilig en in die wêreld gestuur het: U spreek godslasterlik — omdat Ek gesê het: Ek is die Seun van God?

kjv_text: If I do not the works of my Father, believe me not.
bsb_text: If I am not doing the works of My Father, then do not believe Me.
aov_text: As Ek nie die werke van my Vader doen nie, moet julle My nie glo nie;

kjv_text: But if I do, though ye believe not me, believe the works: that ye may know, and believe, that the Father is in me, and I in him.
bsb_text: But if I am doing them, even though you do not believe Me, believe the works themselves, so that you may know and understand that the Father is in Me, and I am in the Father.”
aov_text: maar as Ek dit doen, al glo julle My nie, glo die werke, dat julle kan erken en glo dat die Vader in My is, en Ek in Hom.

kjv_text: Therefore they sought again to take him: but he escaped out of their hand,
bsb_text: At this, they tried again to seize Him, but He escaped their grasp.
aov_text: Toe het hulle weer probeer om Hom gevange te neem, en Hy het uit hulle hand ontkom.

kjv_text: And went away again beyond Jordan into the place where John at first baptized; and there he abode.
bsb_text: Then Jesus went back across the Jordan to the place where John had first been baptizing, and He stayed there.
aov_text: En Hy het weer oor die Jordaan gegaan na die plek waar Johannes eers gedoop het; en Hy het daar gebly.

kjv_text: And many resorted unto him, and said, John did no miracle: but all things that John spake of this man were true.
bsb_text: Many came to Him and said, “Although John never performed a sign, everything he said about this man was true.”
aov_text: En baie het na Hom gekom en gesê: Johannes het wel geen teken gedoen nie, maar alles wat Johannes van Hom gesê het, was waar.

kjv_text: And many believed on him there.
bsb_text: And many in that place believed in Jesus.
aov_text: En baie het daar in Hom geglo.

kjv_text: Now a certain man was sick, named Lazarus, of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.
bsb_text: At this time a man named Lazarus was sick. He lived in Bethany, the village of Mary and her sister Martha.
aov_text: EN daar was ’n man siek, Lasarus van Betánië, die dorp van Maria en haar suster Martha.

kjv_text: (It was that Mary which anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.)
bsb_text: (Mary, whose brother Lazarus was sick, was to anoint the Lord with perfume and wipe His feet with her hair.)
aov_text: En dit was Maria wat die Here gesalf het met salf en sy voete afgedroog het met haar hare, wie se broer, Lasarus, siek was.

kjv_text: Therefore his sisters sent unto him, saying, Lord, behold, he whom thou lovest is sick.
bsb_text: So the sisters sent word to Jesus, “Lord, the one You love is sick.”
aov_text: Die susters het toe na Hom gestuur en gesê: Here, hy vir wie U liefhet, is siek.

kjv_text: When Jesus heard that, he said, This sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of God, that the Son of God might be glorified thereby.
bsb_text: When Jesus heard this, He said, “This sickness will not end in death. No, it is for the glory of God, so that the Son of God may be glorified through it.”
aov_text: En toe Jesus dit hoor, sê Hy: Hierdie siekte is nie tot die dood toe nie, maar tot die heerlikheid van God, sodat die Seun van God daardeur verheerlik kan word.

kjv_text: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.
bsb_text: Now Jesus loved Martha and her sister and Lazarus.
aov_text: En Jesus het Martha en haar suster en Lasarus liefgehad.

kjv_text: When he had heard therefore that he was sick, he abode two days still in the same place where he was.
bsb_text: So on hearing that Lazarus was sick, He stayed where He was for two days,
aov_text: En toe Hy hoor dat hy siek is, het Hy twee dae vertoef in die plek waar Hy was.

kjv_text: Then after that saith he to his disciples, Let us go into Judaea again.
bsb_text: and then He said to the disciples, “Let us go back to Judea.”
aov_text: Eers daarna sê Hy aan die dissipels: Laat ons weer na Judéa gaan.

kjv_text: His disciples say unto him, Master, the Jews of late sought to stone thee; and goest thou thither again?
bsb_text: “Rabbi,” they replied, “the Jews just tried to stone You, and You are going back there?”
aov_text: Die dissipels sê vir Hom: Rabbi, die Jode het onlangs probeer om U te stenig, en gaan U weer daarnatoe?

kjv_text: Jesus answered, Are there not twelve hours in the day? If any man walk in the day, he stumbleth not, because he seeth the light of this world.
bsb_text: Jesus answered, “Are there not twelve hours of daylight? If anyone walks in the daytime, he will not stumble, because he sees by the light of this world.
aov_text: Jesus antwoord: Is daar nie twaalf ure in die dag nie? As iemand in die dag wandel, stamp hy hom nie, omdat hy die lig van hierdie wêreld sien.

kjv_text: But if a man walk in the night, he stumbleth, because there is no light in him.
bsb_text: But if anyone walks at night, he will stumble, because he has no light.”
aov_text: Maar as iemand in die nag wandel, stamp hy hom, omdat die lig nie in hom is nie.

kjv_text: These things said he: and after that he saith unto them, Our friend Lazarus sleepeth; but I go, that I may awake him out of sleep.
bsb_text: After He had said this, He told them, “Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep, but I am going there to wake him up.”
aov_text: Dit het Hy gespreek; en daarna sê Hy vir hulle: Lasarus, ons vriend, slaap; maar Ek gaan om hom wakker te maak.

kjv_text: Then said his disciples, Lord, if he sleep, he shall do well.
bsb_text: His disciples replied, “Lord, if he is sleeping, he will get better.”
aov_text: Sy dissipels sê toe: Here, as hy slaap, sal hy gesond word.

kjv_text: Howbeit Jesus spake of his death: but they thought that he had spoken of taking of rest in sleep.
bsb_text: They thought that Jesus was talking about actual sleep, but He was speaking about the death of Lazarus.
aov_text: Maar Jesus het gespreek van sy dood, terwyl hulle gedink het dat Hy van die rus van die slaap spreek.

kjv_text: Then said Jesus unto them plainly, Lazarus is dead.
bsb_text: So Jesus told them plainly, “Lazarus is dead,
aov_text: En toe sê Jesus vir hulle ronduit: Lasarus is dood.

kjv_text: And I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, to the intent ye may believe; nevertheless let us go unto him.
bsb_text: and for your sake I am glad I was not there, so that you may believe. But let us go to him.”
aov_text: En Ek is bly om julle ontwil dat Ek nie daar was nie, sodat julle kan glo. Maar laat ons na hom toe gaan.

kjv_text: Then said Thomas, which is called Didymus, unto his fellowdisciples, Let us also go, that we may die with him.
bsb_text: Then Thomas called Didymus said to his fellow disciples, “Let us also go, so that we may die with Him.”
aov_text: En Thomas, wat Dídimus genoem word, sê vir sy mededissipels: Laat ons ook gaan om saam met Hom te sterwe.

kjv_text: Then when Jesus came, he found that he had lain in the grave four days already.
bsb_text: When Jesus arrived, He found that Lazarus had already spent four days in the tomb.
aov_text: Toe Jesus dan gekom het, het Hy gevind dat hy al vier dae in die graf was.

kjv_text: Now Bethany was nigh unto Jerusalem, about fifteen furlongs off:
bsb_text: Now Bethany was near Jerusalem, a little less than two miles away,
aov_text: En Betánië was naby Jerusalem, omtrent twee myl daarvandaan.

kjv_text: And many of the Jews came to Martha and Mary, to comfort them concerning their brother.
bsb_text: and many of the Jews had come to Martha and Mary to console them in the loss of their brother.
aov_text: En baie van die Jode het al by Martha en Maria gekom om hulle oor hul broer te troos.

kjv_text: Then Martha, as soon as she heard that Jesus was coming, went and met him: but Mary sat still in the house.
bsb_text: So when Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went out to meet Him; but Mary stayed at home.
aov_text: En toe Martha hoor dat Jesus kom, het sy Hom tegemoetgegaan. Maar Maria het in die huis bly sit.

kjv_text: Then said Martha unto Jesus, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
bsb_text: Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died.
aov_text: En Martha sê vir Jesus: Here, as U hier gewees het, sou my broer nie gesterf het nie.

kjv_text: But I know, that even now, whatsoever thou wilt ask of God, God will give it thee.
bsb_text: But even now I know that God will give You whatever You ask of Him.”
aov_text: Maar selfs nou weet ek dat alles wat U van God vra, God U sal gee.

kjv_text: Jesus saith unto her, Thy brother shall rise again.
bsb_text: “Your brother will rise again,” Jesus told her.
aov_text: Jesus sê vir haar: Jou broer sal opstaan.

kjv_text: Martha saith unto him, I know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day.
bsb_text: Martha replied, “I know that he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day.”
aov_text: Martha antwoord Hom: Ek weet dat hy sal opstaan in die opstanding in die laaste dag.

kjv_text: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:
bsb_text: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. Whoever believes in Me will live, even though he dies.
aov_text: Jesus sê vir haar: Ek is die opstanding en die lewe; wie in My glo, sal lewe al het hy ook gesterwe;

kjv_text: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. Believest thou this?
bsb_text: And everyone who lives and believes in Me will never die. Do you believe this?”
aov_text: en elkeen wat lewe en in My glo, sal nooit sterwe tot in ewigheid nie. Glo jy dit?

kjv_text: She saith unto him, Yea, Lord: I believe that thou art the Christ, the Son of God, which should come into the world.
bsb_text: “Yes, Lord,” she answered, “I believe that You are the Christ, the Son of God, who was to come into the world.”
