aov_text: Sy antwoord Hom: Ja, Here, ek glo dat U die Christus is, die Seun van God, wat in die wêreld sou kom.

kjv_text: And when she had so said, she went her way, and called Mary her sister secretly, saying, The Master is come, and calleth for thee.
bsb_text: After Martha had said this, she went back and called her sister Mary aside to tell her, “The Teacher is here and is asking for you.”
aov_text: En nadat sy dit gesê het, gaan sy en roep Maria, haar suster, stilletjies en sê: Die Meester is hier en Hy roep jou.

kjv_text: As soon as she heard that, she arose quickly, and came unto him.
bsb_text: And when Mary heard this, she got up quickly and went to Him.
aov_text: Sy het, toe sy dit hoor, vinnig opgestaan en na Hom toe gegaan.

kjv_text: Now Jesus was not yet come into the town, but was in that place where Martha met him.
bsb_text: Now Jesus had not yet entered the village, but was still at the place where Martha had met Him.
aov_text: En Jesus het nog nie in die dorp gekom nie, maar was op die plek waar Martha Hom tegemoetgegaan het.

kjv_text: The Jews then which were with her in the house, and comforted her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up hastily and went out, followed her, saying, She goeth unto the grave to weep there.
bsb_text: When the Jews who were in the house consoling Mary saw how quickly she got up and went out, they followed her, supposing she was going to the tomb to mourn there.
aov_text: En toe die Jode wat by haar in die huis was en haar getroos het, sien dat Maria vinnig opstaan en uitgaan, het hulle haar gevolg en gesê: Sy gaan na die graf om daar te ween.

kjv_text: Then when Mary was come where Jesus was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying unto him, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
bsb_text: When Mary came to Jesus and saw Him, she fell at His feet and said, “Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died.”
aov_text: En toe Maria kom waar Jesus was en Hom sien, val sy aan sy voete neer en sê vir Hom: Here, as U hier gewees het, sou my broer nie gesterf het nie.

kjv_text: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews also weeping which came with her, he groaned in the spirit, and was troubled,
bsb_text: When Jesus saw her weeping, and the Jews who had come with her also weeping, He was deeply moved in spirit and troubled.
aov_text: Toe Jesus haar dan sien ween en die Jode wat saam met haar gekom het, ook sien ween, het Hy geweldig bewoë geword in sy gees en Hom ontstel

kjv_text: And said, Where have ye laid him? They said unto him, Lord, come and see.
bsb_text: “Where have you put him?” He asked. “Come and see, Lord,” they answered.
aov_text: en gesê: Waar het julle hom neergelê? Hulle sê vir Hom: Here, kom kyk.

kjv_text: Jesus wept.
bsb_text: Jesus wept.
aov_text: Jesus het geween.

kjv_text: Then said the Jews, Behold how he loved him!
bsb_text: Then the Jews said, “See how He loved him!”
aov_text: Die Jode sê toe: Kyk, hoe lief Hy hom gehad het!

kjv_text: And some of them said, Could not this man, which opened the eyes of the blind, have caused that even this man should not have died?
bsb_text: But some of them asked, “Could not this man who opened the eyes of the blind also have kept Lazarus from dying?”
aov_text: En sommige van hulle sê: Kon Hy wat die oë van die blinde man geopen het, nie maak dat hierdie man ook nie gesterf het nie?

kjv_text: Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the grave. It was a cave, and a stone lay upon it.
bsb_text: Jesus, once again deeply moved, came to the tomb. It was a cave with a stone laid across the entrance.
aov_text: En Jesus het weer in Homself geweldig bewoë geword en by die graf gekom. En dit was ’n spelonk, en ’n steen het daarteen gelê.

kjv_text: Jesus said, Take ye away the stone. Martha, the sister of him that was dead, saith unto him, Lord, by this time he stinketh: for he hath been dead four days.
bsb_text: “Take away the stone,” Jesus said. “Lord, by now he stinks,” said Martha, the sister of the dead man. “It has already been four days.”
aov_text: Jesus sê: Neem die steen weg. Martha, die suster van die oorledene, sê vir Hom: Here, hy ruik al, want hy is al vier dae dood.

kjv_text: Jesus saith unto her, Said I not unto thee, that, if thou wouldest believe, thou shouldest see the glory of God?
bsb_text: Jesus replied, “Did I not tell you that if you believed, you would see the glory of God?”
aov_text: Jesus sê vir haar: Het Ek nie vir jou gesê, as jy glo, sal jy die heerlikheid van God sien nie?

kjv_text: Then they took away the stone from the place where the dead was laid. And Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, Father, I thank thee that thou hast heard me.
bsb_text: So they took away the stone. Then Jesus lifted His eyes upward and said, “Father, I thank You that You have heard Me.
aov_text: Hulle neem toe die steen weg waar die oorledene lê. En Jesus het sy oë opgeslaan en gesê: Vader, Ek dank U dat U My verhoor het;

kjv_text: And I knew that thou hearest me always: but because of the people which stand by I said it, that they may believe that thou hast sent me.
bsb_text: I knew that You always hear Me, but I say this for the benefit of the people standing here, so they may believe that You sent Me.”
aov_text: en Ek het geweet dat U My altyd verhoor, maar ter wille van die skare wat rondom staan, het Ek dit gesê, sodat hulle kan glo dat U My gestuur het.

kjv_text: And when he thus had spoken, he cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come forth.
bsb_text: After Jesus had said this, He called out in a loud voice, “Lazarus, come out!”
aov_text: En nadat Hy dit gesê het, het Hy met ’n groot stem geroep: Lasarus, kom uit!

kjv_text: And he that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with graveclothes: and his face was bound about with a napkin. Jesus saith unto them, Loose him, and let him go.
bsb_text: The man who had been dead came out with his hands and feet bound in strips of linen, and his face wrapped in a cloth. “Unwrap him and let him go,” Jesus told them.
aov_text: En die oorledene het uitgekom, aan hande en voete met grafdoeke gebind, en sy gesig was toegedraai met ’n doek. Jesus sê vir hulle: Maak hom los en laat hom gaan.

kjv_text: Then many of the Jews which came to Mary, and had seen the things which Jesus did, believed on him.
bsb_text: Therefore many of the Jews who had come to Mary, and had seen what Jesus did, believed in Him.
aov_text: EN baie van die Jode wat na Maria gekom het en aanskouers was van wat Jesus gedoen het, het in Hom geglo.

kjv_text: But some of them went their ways to the Pharisees, and told them what things Jesus had done.
bsb_text: But some of them went to the Pharisees and told them what Jesus had done.
aov_text: Maar sommige van hulle het na die Fariseërs gegaan en hulle vertel wat Jesus gedoen het.

kjv_text: Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council, and said, What do we? for this man doeth many miracles.
bsb_text: Then the chief priests and Pharisees convened the Sanhedrin and said, “What are we to do? This man is performing many signs.
aov_text: En die owerpriesters en die Fariseërs het die Raad byeengeroep en gesê: Wat sal ons doen?  — want hierdie man doen baie tekens.

kjv_text: If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him: and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation.
bsb_text: If we let Him go on like this, everyone will believe in Him, and then the Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation.”
aov_text: As ons Hom so laat begaan, sal almal in Hom glo; en die Romeine sal kom en ons land en ons nasie albei afneem.

kjv_text: And one of them, named Caiaphas, being the high priest that same year, said unto them, Ye know nothing at all,
bsb_text: But one of them, named Caiaphas, who was high priest that year, said to them, “You know nothing at all!
aov_text: En een van hulle, Kájafas, wat daardie jaar hoëpriester was, sê vir hulle: Julle weet niks nie

kjv_text: Nor consider that it is expedient for us, that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation perish not.
bsb_text: You do not realize that it is better for you that one man die for the people than that the whole nation perish.”
aov_text: en dink nie daaraan dat dit vir ons voordelig is dat een man vir die volk sterwe en nie die hele nasie omkom nie.

kjv_text: And this spake he not of himself: but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus should die for that nation;
bsb_text: Caiaphas did not say this on his own. Instead, as high priest that year, he was prophesying that Jesus would die for the nation,
aov_text: En dit het hy nie uit homself gesê nie; maar omdat hy daardie jaar hoëpriester was, het hy geprofeteer dat Jesus vir die volk sou sterwe.

kjv_text: And not for that nation only, but that also he should gather together in one the children of God that were scattered abroad.
bsb_text: and not only for the nation, but also for the scattered children of God, to gather them together into one.
aov_text: En nie alleen vir die volk nie, maar ook om die verstrooide kinders van God tot ’n eenheid saam te voeg.

kjv_text: Then from that day forth they took counsel together for to put him to death.
bsb_text: So from that day on they plotted to kill Him.
aov_text: Van dié dag af het hulle toe saam beraadslaag om Hom om die lewe te bring.

kjv_text: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews; but went thence unto a country near to the wilderness, into a city called Ephraim, and there continued with his disciples.
bsb_text: As a result, Jesus no longer went about publicly among the Jews, but He withdrew to a town called Ephraim in an area near the wilderness. And He stayed there with the disciples.
aov_text: Daarom het Jesus nie meer in die openbaar onder die Jode gewandel nie, maar daarvandaan weggegaan na die streek naby die woestyn, na ’n stad met die naam van Efraim. En daar het Hy vertoef met sy dissipels.

kjv_text: And the Jews' passover was nigh at hand: and many went out of the country up to Jerusalem before the passover, to purify themselves.
bsb_text: Now the Jewish Passover was near, and many people went up from the country to Jerusalem to purify themselves before the Passover.
aov_text: En die pasga van die Jode was naby; en baie het uit dié landstreek na Jerusalem opgegaan voor die pasga om hulle te reinig.

kjv_text: Then sought they for Jesus, and spake among themselves, as they stood in the temple, What think ye, that he will not come to the feast?
bsb_text: They kept looking for Jesus and asking one another as they stood in the temple courts, “What do you think? Will He come to the feast at all?”
aov_text: En hulle het Jesus gesoek; en terwyl hulle in die tempel staan, sê hulle vir mekaar: Wat dink julle, sal Hy nie na die fees kom nie?

kjv_text: Now both the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a commandment, that, if any man knew where he were, he should shew it, that they might take him.
bsb_text: But the chief priests and Pharisees had given orders that anyone who knew where He was must report it, so that they could arrest Him.
aov_text: En die owerpriesters en die Fariseërs het ook ’n bevel gegee dat as iemand wis waar Hy was, hy dit moes bekend maak, sodat hulle Hom gevange kon neem.

kjv_text: Then Jesus six days before the passover came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, which had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.
bsb_text: Six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, the hometown of Lazarus, whom He had raised from the dead.
aov_text: EN Jesus het ses dae voor die pasga na Betánië gekom waar Lasarus was, wat dood gewees het en wat Hy uit die dode opgewek het.

kjv_text: There they made him a supper; and Martha served: but Lazarus was one of them that sat at the table with him.
bsb_text: So they hosted a dinner for Jesus there. Martha served, and Lazarus was among those reclining at the table with Him.
aov_text: Hulle het toe vir Hom daar ’n maaltyd berei, en Martha het bedien; en Lasarus was een van die wat saam met Hom aan tafel was.

kjv_text: Then took Mary a pound of ointment of spikenard, very costly, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair: and the house was filled with the odour of the ointment.
bsb_text: Then Mary took about a pint of expensive perfume, made of pure nard, and she anointed Jesus’ feet and wiped them with her hair. And the house was filled with the fragrance of the perfume.
aov_text: En Maria het ’n pond egte, baie kosbare nardussalf geneem en die voete van Jesus gesalf en sy voete afgedroog met haar hare. En die huis is vervul met die reuk van die salf.

kjv_text: Then saith one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, which should betray him,
bsb_text: But one of His disciples, Judas Iscariot, who was going to betray Him, asked,
aov_text: Toe sê een van sy dissipels, Judas Iskáriot, die seun van Simon, wat Hom sou verraai:

kjv_text: Why was not this ointment sold for three hundred pence, and given to the poor?
bsb_text: “Why wasn’t this perfume sold for three hundred denarii and the money given to the poor?”
aov_text: Waarom is hierdie salf nie vir driehonderd pennings verkoop en die geld aan die armes gegee nie?

kjv_text: This he said, not that he cared for the poor; but because he was a thief, and had the bag, and bare what was put therein.
bsb_text: Judas did not say this because he cared about the poor, but because he was a thief. As keeper of the money bag, he used to take from what was put into it.
aov_text: En dit het hy gesê, nie omdat hy oor die armes besorg was nie, maar omdat hy ’n dief was en die beurs gehad het en die bydraes geneem het.

kjv_text: Then said Jesus, Let her alone: against the day of my burying hath she kept this.
bsb_text: “Leave her alone,” Jesus replied. “She has kept this perfume in preparation for the day of My burial.
aov_text: Toe sê Jesus: Laat haar staan; sy het dit bewaar vir die dag van my begrafnis.

kjv_text: For the poor always ye have with you; but me ye have not always.
bsb_text: The poor you will always have with you, but you will not always have Me.”
aov_text: Want die armes het julle altyd by julle, maar My het julle nie altyd nie.

kjv_text: Much people of the Jews therefore knew that he was there: and they came not for Jesus' sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.
bsb_text: Meanwhile a large crowd of Jews learned that Jesus was there. And they came not only because of Him, but also to see Lazarus, whom He had raised from the dead.
aov_text: En ’n groot menigte uit die Jode het verneem dat Hy daar was, en het gekom, nie alleen ter wille van Jesus nie, maar ook om Lasarus te sien, wat Hy uit die dode opgewek het.

kjv_text: But the chief priests consulted that they might put Lazarus also to death;
bsb_text: So the chief priests made plans to kill Lazarus as well,
aov_text: En die owerpriesters het besluit om Lasarus ook om die lewe te bring,

kjv_text: Because that by reason of him many of the Jews went away, and believed on Jesus.
bsb_text: for on account of him many of the Jews were deserting them and believing in Jesus.
aov_text: omdat baie van die Jode deur hom weggegaan en in Jesus geglo het.

kjv_text: On the next day much people that were come to the feast, when they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,
bsb_text: The next day the great crowd that had come to the feast heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem.
aov_text: DIE volgende dag het ’n groot menigte feesgangers, toe hulle hoor dat Jesus na Jerusalem kom,

kjv_text: Took branches of palm trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried, Hosanna: Blessed is the King of Israel that cometh in the name of the Lord.
bsb_text: They took palm branches and went out to meet Him, shouting: “Hosanna!” “Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!” “Blessed is the King of Israel!”
aov_text: palmtakke geneem en uitgegaan Hom tegemoet en geroep: Hosanna! Geseënd is Hy wat kom in die Naam van die Here, die Koning van Israel.

kjv_text: And Jesus, when he had found a young ass, sat thereon; as it is written,
bsb_text: Finding a young donkey, Jesus sat on it, as it is written:
aov_text: En Jesus het ’n jong esel gevind en daarop gaan sit, soos geskrywe is:

kjv_text: Fear not, daughter of Sion: behold, thy King cometh, sitting on an ass's colt.
bsb_text: “Do not be afraid, O Daughter of Zion. See, your King is coming, seated on the colt of a donkey.”
aov_text: Moenie vrees nie, dogter van Sion! Kyk, jou Koning kom en Hy sit op die vul van ’n esel.

kjv_text: These things understood not his disciples at the first: but when Jesus was glorified, then remembered they that these things were written of him, and that they had done these things unto him.
bsb_text: At first His disciples did not understand these things, but after Jesus was glorified they remembered what had been done to Him, and they realized that these very things had also been written about Him.
aov_text: Dit het sy dissipels egter eers nie verstaan nie; maar nadat Jesus verheerlik is, toe het dit hulle bygeval dat hierdie dinge van Hom geskrywe was en dat hulle dit aan Hom gedoen het.

kjv_text: The people therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of his grave, and raised him from the dead, bare record.
bsb_text: Meanwhile, many people continued to testify that they had been with Jesus when He called Lazarus from the tomb and raised him from the dead.
aov_text: En die skare wat by Hom was toe Hy Lasarus uit die graf geroep en hom uit die dode opgewek het, het daarvan getuig.

kjv_text: For this cause the people also met him, for that they heard that he had done this miracle.
bsb_text: That is also why the crowd went out to meet Him, because they heard that He had performed this sign.
aov_text: Daarom het die skare Hom ook tegemoetgegaan, omdat hulle gehoor het dat Hy hierdie teken gedoen het.

kjv_text: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, Perceive ye how ye prevail nothing? behold, the world is gone after him.
bsb_text: Then the Pharisees said to one another, “You can see that this is doing you no good. Look how the whole world has gone after Him!”
aov_text: En die Fariseërs het vir mekaar gesê: Sien julle dat julle niks vorder nie? Kyk, die hele wêreld loop agter Hom aan.

kjv_text: And there were certain Greeks among them that came up to worship at the feast:
bsb_text: Now there were some Greeks among those who went up to worship at the feast.
aov_text: EN daar was sommige Grieke onder die wat opgekom het om op die fees te aanbid;

kjv_text: The same came therefore to Philip, which was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and desired him, saying, Sir, we would see Jesus.
bsb_text: They came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida in Galilee, and requested of him, “Sir, we want to see Jesus.”
aov_text: hulle het na Filippus gegaan wat van Betsáida in Galiléa was, en hom gevra en gesê: My heer, ons wil Jesus graag sien.

kjv_text: Philip cometh and telleth Andrew: and again Andrew and Philip tell Jesus.
bsb_text: Philip relayed this appeal to Andrew, and both of them went and told Jesus.
aov_text: Filippus kom en sê dit vir Andréas, en Andréas en Filippus vertel dit weer aan Jesus.

kjv_text: And Jesus answered them, saying, The hour is come, that the Son of man should be glorified.
bsb_text: But Jesus replied, “The hour has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.
aov_text: Maar Jesus antwoord hulle en sê: Die uur het gekom dat die Seun van die mens verheerlik moet word.

kjv_text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.
bsb_text: Truly, truly, I tell you, unless a kernel of wheat falls to the ground and dies, it remains only a seed; but if it dies, it bears much fruit.
aov_text: Voorwaar, voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, as die koringkorrel nie in die grond val en sterf nie, bly dit alleen; maar as dit sterf, dra dit veel vrug.

kjv_text: He that loveth his life shall lose it; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal.
bsb_text: Whoever loves his life will lose it, but whoever hates his life in this world will keep it for eternal life.
aov_text: Wie sy lewe liefhet, sal dit verloor; maar wie sy lewe haat in hierdie wêreld, sal dit bewaar vir die ewige lewe.

kjv_text: If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will my Father honour.
bsb_text: If anyone serves Me, he must follow Me; and where I am, My servant will be as well. If anyone serves Me, the Father will honor him.
aov_text: As iemand My dien, laat hom My volg; en waar Ek is, daar sal my dienaar ook wees; en as iemand My dien, sal die Vader hom eer.

kjv_text: Now is my soul troubled; and what shall I say? Father, save me from this hour: but for this cause came I unto this hour.
bsb_text: Now My soul is troubled, and what shall I say? ‘Father, save Me from this hour’? No, it is for this purpose that I have come to this hour.
aov_text: Nou is my siel ontsteld, en wat sal Ek sê? Vader, red My uit hierdie uur? Maar hierom het Ek in hierdie uur gekom.

kjv_text: Father, glorify thy name. Then came there a voice from heaven, saying, I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.
bsb_text: Father, glorify Your name!” Then a voice came from heaven: “I have glorified it, and I will glorify it again.”
aov_text: Vader, verheerlik u Naam! Daar het toe ’n stem uit die hemel gekom: Ek hét dit verheerlik, en Ek sal dit weer verheerlik.

kjv_text: The people therefore, that stood by, and heard it, said that it thundered: others said, An angel spake to him.
bsb_text: The crowd standing there heard it and said that it had thundered. Others said that an angel had spoken to Him.
aov_text: En die skare wat daar gestaan en dit gehoor het, het gesê dat daar ’n donderslag gewees het. Ander het gesê: ’n Engel het met Hom gespreek.

kjv_text: Jesus answered and said, This voice came not because of me, but for your sakes.
bsb_text: In response, Jesus said, “This voice was not for My benefit, but yours.
aov_text: Jesus antwoord en sê: Hierdie stem het nie om My ontwil gekom nie, maar om julle ontwil.

kjv_text: Now is the judgment of this world: now shall the prince of this world be cast out.
bsb_text: Now judgment is upon this world; now the prince of this world will be cast out.
aov_text: Nou is dit die oordeel van hierdie wêreld, nou sal die owerste van hierdie wêreld buitentoe gedryf word.

kjv_text: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto me.
bsb_text: And I, when I am lifted up from the earth, will draw everyone to Myself.”
aov_text: En Ek, as Ek van die aarde verhoog word, sal almal na My toe trek.

kjv_text: This he said, signifying what death he should die.
bsb_text: He said this to indicate the kind of death He was going to die.
aov_text: En dit het Hy gesê om aan te dui hoedanige dood Hy sou sterwe.

kjv_text: The people answered him, We have heard out of the law that Christ abideth for ever: and how sayest thou, The Son of man must be lifted up? who is this Son of man?
bsb_text: The crowd replied, “We have heard from the Law that the Christ will remain forever. So how can You say that the Son of Man must be lifted up? Who is this Son of Man?”
aov_text: Die skare antwoord Hom: Ons het uit die wet gehoor dat die Christus tot in ewigheid bly; en hoe sê U dat die Seun van die mens verhoog moet word? Wie is hierdie Seun van die mens?

kjv_text: Then Jesus said unto them, Yet a little while is the light with you. Walk while ye have the light, lest darkness come upon you: for he that walketh in darkness knoweth not whither he goeth.
bsb_text: Then Jesus told them, “For a little while longer, the Light will be among you. Walk while you have the Light, so that darkness will not overtake you. The one who walks in the darkness does not know where he is going.
aov_text: En Jesus sê vir hulle: Nog ’n klein tydjie is die lig by julle. Wandel so lank as julle die lig het, sodat die duisternis julle nie oorval nie. En wie in die duisternis wandel, weet nie waar hy gaan nie.

kjv_text: While ye have light, believe in the light, that ye may be the children of light. These things spake Jesus, and departed, and did hide himself from them.
bsb_text: While you have the Light, believe in the Light, so that you may become sons of light.” After Jesus had spoken these things, He went away and was hidden from them.
aov_text: So lank as julle die lig het, glo in die lig, sodat julle kinders van die lig kan word. Dit het Jesus gespreek, en Hy het weggegaan en Hom vir hulle verberg.

kjv_text: But though he had done so many miracles before them, yet they believed not on him:
bsb_text: Although Jesus had performed so many signs in their presence, they still did not believe in Him.
aov_text: En alhoewel Hy so baie tekens voor hulle gedoen het, het hulle nie in Hom geglo nie;

kjv_text: That the saying of Esaias the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spake, Lord, who hath believed our report? and to whom hath the arm of the Lord been revealed?
bsb_text: This was to fulfill the word of Isaiah the prophet: “Lord, who has believed our message? And to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?”
aov_text: sodat die woord van die profeet Jesaja vervul sou word wat hy gesê het: Here, wie het ons prediking geglo, en aan wie is die arm van die Here geopenbaar?

kjv_text: Therefore they could not believe, because that Esaias said again,
bsb_text: For this reason they were unable to believe. For again, Isaiah says:
aov_text: Daarom kon hulle nie glo nie, omdat Jesaja óók gesê het:

kjv_text: He hath blinded their eyes, and hardened their heart; that they should not see with their eyes, nor understand with their heart, and be converted, and I should heal them.
bsb_text: “He has blinded their eyes and hardened their hearts, so that they cannot see with their eyes, and understand with their hearts, and turn, and I would heal them.”
aov_text: Hy het hulle oë verblind en hulle hart verhard, sodat hulle nie met die oë sou sien en met die hart verstaan en hulle bekeer en Ek hulle genees nie.

kjv_text: These things said Esaias, when he saw his glory, and spake of him.
bsb_text: Isaiah said these things because he saw Jesus’ glory and spoke about Him.
aov_text: Dit het Jesaja gesê toe hy sy heerlikheid gesien en van Hom gespreek het.

kjv_text: Nevertheless among the chief rulers also many believed on him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess him, lest they should be put out of the synagogue:
bsb_text: Nevertheless, many of the leaders believed in Him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess Him, for fear that they would be put out of the synagogue.
aov_text: Maar tog het selfs baie van die owerstes in Hom geglo; maar ter wille van die Fariseërs het hulle dit nie bely nie, om nie uit die sinagoge geban te word nie.

kjv_text: For they loved the praise of men more than the praise of God.
bsb_text: For they loved praise from men more than praise from God.
aov_text: Want hulle het die eer van die mense meer liefgehad as die eer van God.

kjv_text: Jesus cried and said, He that believeth on me, believeth not on me, but on him that sent me.
bsb_text: Then Jesus cried out, “Whoever believes in Me does not believe in Me alone, but in the One who sent Me.
aov_text: En Jesus het uitgeroep en gesê: Wie in My glo, glo nie in My nie, maar in Hom wat My gestuur het.

kjv_text: And he that seeth me seeth him that sent me.
bsb_text: And whoever sees Me sees the One who sent Me.
aov_text: En wie My aanskou, aanskou Hom wat My gestuur het.

kjv_text: I am come a light into the world, that whosoever believeth on me should not abide in darkness.
bsb_text: I have come into the world as a light, so that no one who believes in Me should remain in darkness.
aov_text: Ek het as ’n lig in die wêreld gekom, sodat elkeen wat in My glo, nie in die duisternis sou bly nie.

kjv_text: And if any man hear my words, and believe not, I judge him not: for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.
bsb_text: As for anyone who hears My words and does not keep them, I do not judge him. For I have not come to judge the world, but to save the world.
aov_text: En as iemand na my woorde luister en nie glo nie, Ek oordeel hom nie; want Ek het nie gekom om die wêreld te oordeel nie, maar om die wêreld te red.

kjv_text: He that rejecteth me, and receiveth not my words, hath one that judgeth him: the word that I have spoken, the same shall judge him in the last day.
bsb_text: There is a judge for the one who rejects Me and does not receive My words: The word that I have spoken will judge him on the last day.
aov_text: Wie My verwerp en my woorde nie aanneem nie, het een wat hom oordeel: die woord wat Ek gespreek het, dit sal hom oordeel in die laaste dag.

kjv_text: For I have not spoken of myself; but the Father which sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.
bsb_text: I have not spoken on My own, but the Father who sent Me has commanded Me what to say and how to say it.
aov_text: Want Ek het nie uit Myself gespreek nie; maar die Vader wat My gestuur het, Hy het My ’n gebod gegee wat Ek moet sê en wat Ek moet spreek.

kjv_text: And I know that his commandment is life everlasting: whatsoever I speak therefore, even as the Father said unto me, so I speak.
bsb_text: And I know that His command leads to eternal life. So I speak exactly what the Father has told Me to say.”
aov_text: En Ek weet dat sy gebod die ewige lewe is. Wat Ek dan spreek — net soos die Vader vir My gesê het, so spreek Ek.

kjv_text: Now before the feast of the passover, when Jesus knew that his hour was come that he should depart out of this world unto the Father, having loved his own which were in the world, he loved them unto the end.
bsb_text: It was now just before the Passover Feast, and Jesus knew that His hour had come to leave this world and return to the Father. Having loved His own who were in the world, He loved them to the very end.
aov_text: EN voor die fees van die pasga het Jesus, omdat Hy wis dat sy uur gekom het dat Hy uit hierdie wêreld sou oorgaan na die Vader, en omdat Hy sy eie mense in die wêreld liefgehad het, hulle liefgehad tot die einde toe.

kjv_text: And supper being ended, the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, to betray him;
bsb_text: The evening meal was underway, and the devil had already put into the heart of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, to betray Jesus.
aov_text: En gedurende die maaltyd — die duiwel het dit al in die hart van Judas Iskáriot, die seun van Simon, ingegee om Hom te verraai  —

kjv_text: Jesus knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he was come from God, and went to God;
bsb_text: Jesus knew that the Father had delivered all things into His hands, and that He had come from God and was returning to God.
aov_text: het Jesus, omdat Hy wis dat die Vader alles in sy hande gegee het en dat Hy van God uitgegaan het en na God heengaan,

kjv_text: He riseth from supper, and laid aside his garments; and took a towel, and girded himself.
bsb_text: So He got up from the supper, laid aside His outer garments, and wrapped a towel around His waist.
aov_text: van die maaltyd opgestaan en sy bo-klere uitgetrek en ’n doek geneem en dit om Hom vasgemaak.

kjv_text: After that he poureth water into a bason, and began to wash the disciples' feet, and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded.
bsb_text: After that, He poured water into a basin and began to wash the disciples’ feet and dry them with the towel that was around Him.
aov_text: Daarna het Hy water in ’n bak gegooi en die voete van die dissipels begin was en afdroog met die doek wat Hy omgehad het.

kjv_text: Then cometh he to Simon Peter: and Peter saith unto him, Lord, dost thou wash my feet?
bsb_text: He came to Simon Peter, who asked Him, “Lord, are You going to wash my feet?”
aov_text: Hy kom toe by Simon Petrus en dié sê vir Hom: Here, gaan U my voete was?

kjv_text: Jesus answered and said unto him, What I do thou knowest not now; but thou shalt know hereafter.
bsb_text: Jesus replied, “You do not realize now what I am doing, but later you will understand.”
aov_text: Jesus antwoord en sê vir hom: Wat Ek doen, begryp jy nou nie, maar jy sal dit hierna verstaan.

kjv_text: Peter saith unto him, Thou shalt never wash my feet. Jesus answered him, If I wash thee not, thou hast no part with me.
bsb_text: “Never shall You wash my feet!” Peter told Him. Jesus answered, “Unless I wash you, you have no part with Me.”
aov_text: Petrus sê vir Hom: U sal my voete in der ewigheid nie was nie! Jesus antwoord hom: As Ek jou nie was nie, het jy geen deel aan My nie.

kjv_text: Simon Peter saith unto him, Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head.
bsb_text: “Then, Lord,” Simon Peter replied, “not only my feet, but my hands and my head as well!”
aov_text: Simon Petrus sê vir Hom: Here, nie net my voete nie, maar ook die hande en die hoof.

kjv_text: Jesus saith to him, He that is washed needeth not save to wash his feet, but is clean every whit: and ye are clean, but not all.
bsb_text: Jesus told him, “Whoever has already bathed needs only to wash his feet, and he will be completely clean. And you are clean, though not all of you.”
aov_text: Jesus sê vir hom: Hy wat gewas is, het niks anders nodig as om die voete te was nie, maar is heeltemal rein; en julle is rein, maar nie almal nie.

kjv_text: For he knew who should betray him; therefore said he, Ye are not all clean.
bsb_text: For He knew who would betray Him. That is why He said, “Not all of you are clean.”
aov_text: Want Hy het geweet wie Hom sou verraai. Daarom het Hy gesê: Julle is nie almal rein nie.

kjv_text: So after he had washed their feet, and had taken his garments, and was set down again, he said unto them, Know ye what I have done to you?
bsb_text: When Jesus had washed their feet and put on His outer garments, He reclined with them again and asked, “Do you know what I have done for you?
aov_text: Toe Hy dan hulle voete gewas en sy bo-klere geneem het, gaan Hy weer aan tafel en sê vir hulle: Verstaan julle wat Ek aan julle gedoen het?

kjv_text: Ye call me Master and Lord: and ye say well; for so I am.
bsb_text: You call Me Teacher and Lord, and rightly so, because I am.
aov_text: Julle noem My Meester en Here, en julle is reg, want Ek is dit.

kjv_text: If I then, your Lord and Master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one another's feet.
bsb_text: So if I, your Lord and Teacher, have washed your feet, you also should wash one another’s feet.
aov_text: As Ek dan, die Here en die Meester, julle voete gewas het, is julle ook verplig om mekaar se voete te was.

kjv_text: For I have given you an example, that ye should do as I have done to you.
bsb_text: I have set you an example so that you should do as I have done for you.
aov_text: Want Ek het julle ’n voorbeeld gegee om, net soos Ek aan julle gedoen het, ook so te doen.

kjv_text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord; neither he that is sent greater than he that sent him.
bsb_text: Truly, truly, I tell you, no servant is greater than his master, nor is a messenger greater than the one who sent him.
aov_text: Voorwaar, voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, ’n dienskneg is nie groter as sy heer nie, en ’n gesant is ook nie groter as die een wat hom gestuur het nie.

kjv_text: If ye know these things, happy are ye if ye do them.
bsb_text: If you know these things, you will be blessed if you do them.
aov_text: As julle hierdie dinge weet, salig is julle as julle dit doen.

kjv_text: I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled, He that eateth bread with me hath lifted up his heel against me.
bsb_text: I am not speaking about all of you; I know whom I have chosen. But this is to fulfill the Scripture: ‘The one who shares My bread has lifted up his heel against Me.’
aov_text: Ek spreek nie van julle almal nie — Ek weet wie Ek uitverkies het — maar dat die Skrif vervul kan word: Hy wat saam met My brood eet, het sy hakskeen teen My opgelig.

kjv_text: Now I tell you before it come, that, when it is come to pass, ye may believe that I am he.
bsb_text: I am telling you now before it happens, so that when it comes to pass, you will believe that I am He.
aov_text: Van nou af sê Ek dit aan julle voordat dit gebeur, sodat wanneer dit gebeur, julle kan glo dat dit Ek is.

kjv_text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that receiveth whomsoever I send receiveth me; and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.
bsb_text: Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever receives the one I send receives Me, and whoever receives Me receives the One who sent Me.”
aov_text: Voorwaar, voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, wie iemand ontvang wat Ek stuur, ontvang My; en wie My ontvang, ontvang Hom wat My gestuur het.

kjv_text: When Jesus had thus said, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
bsb_text: After Jesus had said this, He became troubled in spirit and testified, “Truly, truly, I tell you, one of you will betray Me.”
aov_text: TOE Jesus dit gesê het, het Hy in sy gees ontsteld geword en getuig en gesê: Voorwaar, voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, een van julle sal My verraai.

kjv_text: Then the disciples looked one on another, doubting of whom he spake.
bsb_text: The disciples looked at one another, perplexed as to which of them He meant.
aov_text: En die dissipels het na mekaar begin kyk, in twyfel omtrent die een van wie Hy dit sê.

kjv_text: Now there was leaning on Jesus' bosom one of his disciples, whom Jesus loved.
bsb_text: One of His disciples, the one whom Jesus loved, was reclining at His side.
aov_text: En een van sy dissipels, hy vir wie Jesus liefgehad het, het aan tafel teen die bors van Jesus gelê.

kjv_text: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, that he should ask who it should be of whom he spake.
bsb_text: So Simon Peter motioned to him to ask Jesus which one He was talking about.
aov_text: Simon Petrus knik toe vir hom dat hy moet vra wie dit kon wees van wie Hy spreek.

kjv_text: He then lying on Jesus' breast saith unto him, Lord, who is it?
bsb_text: Leaning back against Jesus, he asked, “Lord, who is it?”
aov_text: En hy val op die bors van Jesus en sê vir Hom: Here, wie is dit?

kjv_text: Jesus answered, He it is, to whom I shall give a sop, when I have dipped it. And when he had dipped the sop, he gave it to Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon.
bsb_text: Jesus answered, “It is the one to whom I give this morsel after I have dipped it.” Then He dipped the morsel and gave it to Judas son of Simon Iscariot.
aov_text: Jesus antwoord: Dit is die een aan wie Ek die stukkie sal gee as Ek dit ingedoop het. En toe Hy die stukkie ingedoop het, gee Hy dit aan Judas Iskáriot, die seun van Simon.

kjv_text: And after the sop Satan entered into him. Then said Jesus unto him, That thou doest, do quickly.
bsb_text: And when Judas had taken the morsel, Satan entered into him. Then Jesus said to Judas, “What you are about to do, do quickly.”
aov_text: En nadat hy die stukkie geneem het, het die Satan in hom ingevaar. En Jesus sê vir hom: Wat jy doen, doen dit haastig.

kjv_text: Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him.
bsb_text: But no one at the table knew why Jesus had said this to him.
aov_text: Maar waarom Hy dit vir hom gesê het, het niemand van die wat aan tafel was, verstaan nie.

kjv_text: For some of them thought, because Judas had the bag, that Jesus had said unto him, Buy those things that we have need of against the feast; or, that he should give something to the poor.
bsb_text: Since Judas kept the money bag, some thought that Jesus was telling him to buy what was needed for the feast, or to give something to the poor.
aov_text: Want sommige het gedink, terwyl Judas die beurs gehad het, dat Jesus vir hom sê: Koop wat ons nodig het vir die fees; of dat hy iets aan die armes moes gee.

kjv_text: He then having received the sop went immediately out: and it was night.
bsb_text: As soon as he had received the morsel, Judas went out into the night.
aov_text: Toe hy dan die stukkie geneem het, het hy dadelik uitgegaan. En dit was nag.

kjv_text: Therefore, when he was gone out, Jesus said, Now is the Son of man glorified, and God is glorified in him.
bsb_text: When Judas had gone out, Jesus said, “Now the Son of Man is glorified, and God is glorified in Him.
aov_text: EN toe hy buite was, sê Jesus: Nou is die Seun van die mens verheerlik, en God is in Hom verheerlik.

kjv_text: If God be glorified in him, God shall also glorify him in himself, and shall straightway glorify him.
bsb_text: If God is glorified in Him, God will also glorify the Son in Himself—and will glorify Him at once.
aov_text: As God in Hom verheerlik is, sal God Hom ook in Homself verheerlik en Hy sal Hom dadelik verheerlik.

kjv_text: Little children, yet a little while I am with you. Ye shall seek me: and as I said unto the Jews, Whither I go, ye cannot come; so now I say to you.
bsb_text: Little children, I am with you only a little while longer. You will look for Me, and as I said to the Jews, so now I say to you: ‘Where I am going, you cannot come.’
aov_text: My kinders, nog ’n klein tydjie is Ek by julle. Julle sal My soek, en soos Ek vir die Jode gesê het: Waar Ek heengaan, kan julle nie kom nie — so sê Ek nou ook vir julle.

kjv_text: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.
bsb_text: A new commandment I give you: Love one another. As I have loved you, so you also must love one another.
aov_text: ’n Nuwe gebod gee Ek julle, dat julle mekaar moet liefhê; soos Ek julle liefgehad het, moet julle ook mekaar liefhê.

kjv_text: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
bsb_text: By this everyone will know that you are My disciples, if you love one another.”
aov_text: Hieraan sal almal weet dat julle my dissipels is, as julle liefde onder mekaar het.

kjv_text: Simon Peter said unto him, Lord, whither goest thou? Jesus answered him, Whither I go, thou canst not follow me now; but thou shalt follow me afterwards.
bsb_text: “Lord, where are You going?” Simon Peter asked. Jesus answered, “Where I am going, you cannot follow Me now, but you will follow later.”
aov_text: Simon Petrus sê vir Hom: Here, waar gaan U heen? Jesus antwoord hom: Waar Ek heengaan, kan jy My nou nie volg nie, maar later sal jy My volg.

kjv_text: Peter said unto him, Lord, why cannot I follow thee now? I will lay down my life for thy sake.
bsb_text: “Lord,” said Peter, “why can’t I follow You now? I will lay down my life for You.”
aov_text: Petrus sê vir Hom: Here, waarom kan ek U nie nou volg nie? Ek sal my lewe vir U gee.

kjv_text: Jesus answered him, Wilt thou lay down thy life for my sake? Verily, verily, I say unto thee, The cock shall not crow, till thou hast denied me thrice.
bsb_text: “Will you lay down your life for Me?” Jesus replied. “Truly, truly, I tell you, before the rooster crows, you will deny Me three times.
aov_text: Jesus antwoord hom: Sal jy jou lewe vir My gee? Voorwaar, voorwaar Ek sê vir jou, die haan sal sekerlik nie kraai voordat jy My drie maal verloën het nie.

kjv_text: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.
bsb_text: “Do not let your hearts be troubled. You believe in God; believe in Me as well.
aov_text: LAAT julle hart nie ontsteld word nie; glo in God, glo ook in My.

kjv_text: In my Father's house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.
bsb_text: In My Father’s house are many rooms. If it were not so, would I have told you that I am going there to prepare a place for you?
aov_text: In die huis van my Vader is daar baie wonings; as dit nie so was nie, sou Ek dit vir julle gesê het. Ek gaan om vir julle plek te berei.

kjv_text: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, there ye may be also.
bsb_text: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come back and welcome you into My presence, so that you also may be where I am.
aov_text: En as Ek gegaan en vir julle plek berei het, kom Ek weer en sal julle na My toe neem, sodat julle ook kan wees waar Ek is.

kjv_text: And whither I go ye know, and the way ye know.
bsb_text: You know the way to the place where I am going.”
aov_text: En waar Ek heengaan, weet julle en die weg ken julle.

kjv_text: Thomas saith unto him, Lord, we know not whither thou goest; and how can we know the way?
bsb_text: “Lord,” said Thomas, “we do not know where You are going, so how can we know the way?”
aov_text: Thomas sê vir Hom: Here, ons weet nie waar U gaan nie, en hoe kan ons die weg ken?

kjv_text: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.
bsb_text: Jesus answered, “I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.
aov_text: Jesus antwoord hom: Ek is die weg en die waarheid en die lewe; niemand kom na die Vader behalwe deur My nie.

kjv_text: If ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also: and from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him.
bsb_text: If you had known Me, you would know My Father as well. From now on you do know Him and have seen Him.”
aov_text: As julle My geken het, sou julle my Vader ook geken het, en van nou af ken julle Hom en het julle Hom gesien.

kjv_text: Philip saith unto him, Lord, shew us the Father, and it sufficeth us.
bsb_text: Philip said to Him, “Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us.”
aov_text: Filippus sê vir Hom: Here, toon ons die Vader, en dit is vir ons genoeg.

kjv_text: Jesus saith unto him, Have I been so long time with you, and yet hast thou not known me, Philip? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father; and how sayest thou then, Shew us the Father?
bsb_text: Jesus replied, “Philip, I have been with you all this time, and still you do not know Me? Anyone who has seen Me has seen the Father. How can you say, ‘Show us the Father’?
aov_text: Jesus sê vir hom: Ek is so lankal by julle, en het jy My nie geken nie, Filippus? Hy wat My gesien het, het die Vader gesien. En hoe sê jy: Toon ons die Vader?

kjv_text: Believest thou not that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? the words that I speak unto you I speak not of myself: but the Father that dwelleth in me, he doeth the works.
bsb_text: Do you not believe that I am in the Father and the Father is in Me? The words I say to you, I do not speak on My own. Instead, it is the Father dwelling in Me, performing His works.
aov_text: Glo jy nie dat Ek in die Vader is en die Vader in My nie? Die woorde wat Ek tot julle spreek, spreek Ek nie uit Myself nie; maar die Vader wat in My bly, Hy doen die werke.

kjv_text: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works' sake.
bsb_text: Believe Me that I am in the Father and the Father is in Me—or at least believe on account of the works themselves.
aov_text: Glo My dat Ek in die Vader is, en die Vader in My; of anders, glo My ter wille van die werke self.

kjv_text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater works than these shall he do; because I go unto my Father.
bsb_text: Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever believes in Me will also do the works that I am doing. He will do even greater things than these, because I am going to the Father.
aov_text: Voorwaar, voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, wie in My glo — die werke wat Ek doen, sal hy ook doen; en hy sal groter werke doen as dit, omdat Ek na my Vader gaan.

kjv_text: And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
bsb_text: And I will do whatever you ask in My name, so that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
aov_text: En wat julle ook al in my Naam mag vra, dit sal Ek doen, sodat die Vader in die Seun verheerlik kan word.

kjv_text: If ye shall ask any thing in my name, I will do it.
bsb_text: If you ask Me for anything in My name, I will do it.
aov_text: As julle iets in my Naam vra, sal Ek dit doen.

kjv_text: If ye love me, keep my commandments.
bsb_text: If you love Me, you will keep My commandments.
aov_text: As julle My liefhet, bewaar my gebooie.

kjv_text: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever;
bsb_text: And I will ask the Father, and He will give you another Advocate to be with you forever—
aov_text: En Ek sal die Vader bid, en Hy sal julle ’n ander Trooster gee om by julle te bly tot in ewigheid:

kjv_text: Even the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, neither knoweth him: but ye know him; for he dwelleth with you, and shall be in you.
bsb_text: the Spirit of truth. The world cannot receive Him, because it neither sees Him nor knows Him. But you do know Him, for He abides with you and will be in you.
aov_text: die Gees van die waarheid wat die wêreld nie kan ontvang nie, omdat dit Hom nie sien en Hom nie ken nie; maar julle ken Hom, omdat Hy by julle bly en in julle sal wees.

kjv_text: I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.
bsb_text: I will not leave you as orphans; I will come to you.
aov_text: Ek sal julle nie as wese agterlaat nie; Ek kom weer na julle toe.

kjv_text: Yet a little while, and the world seeth me no more; but ye see me: because I live, ye shall live also.
bsb_text: In a little while the world will see Me no more, but you will see Me. Because I live, you also will live.
aov_text: Nog ’n klein tydjie, en die wêreld sien My nie meer nie; maar julle sien My, omdat Ek lewe en julle sal lewe.

kjv_text: At that day ye shall know that I am in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you.
bsb_text: On that day you will know that I am in My Father, and you are in Me, and I am in you.
aov_text: In dié dag sal julle weet dat Ek in my Vader is, en julle in My, en Ek in julle.

kjv_text: He that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me: and he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself to him.
bsb_text: Whoever has My commandments and keeps them is the one who loves Me. The one who loves Me will be loved by My Father, and I will love him and reveal Myself to him.”
aov_text: Wie my gebooie het en dié bewaar, dit is hy wat My liefhet; en wie My liefhet, hóm sal my Vader liefhê, en Ek sal hom liefhê en My aan hom openbaar.

kjv_text: Judas saith unto him, not Iscariot, Lord, how is it that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?
bsb_text: Judas (not Iscariot) asked Him, “Lord, why are You going to reveal Yourself to us and not to the world?”
aov_text: Judas, nie die Iskáriot nie, sê vir Hom: Here, hoe is dit dat U aan ons U sal openbaar en nie aan die wêreld nie?

kjv_text: Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my words: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.
bsb_text: Jesus replied, “If anyone loves Me, he will keep My word. My Father will love him, and We will come to him and make Our home with him.
aov_text: Jesus antwoord en sê vir hom: As iemand My liefhet, sal hy my woord bewaar, en my Vader sal hom liefhê, en Ons sal na hom toe kom en by hom woning maak.

kjv_text: He that loveth me not keepeth not my sayings: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Father's which sent me.
bsb_text: Whoever does not love Me does not keep My words. The word that you hear is not My own, but it is from the Father who sent Me.
aov_text: Hy wat My nie liefhet nie, bewaar my woorde nie; en die woord wat julle hoor, is nie myne nie, maar is van die Vader wat My gestuur het.

kjv_text: These things have I spoken unto you, being yet present with you.
bsb_text: All this I have spoken to you while I am still with you.
aov_text: Dit het Ek tot julle gespreek terwyl Ek by julle bly;

kjv_text: But the Comforter, which is the Holy Ghost, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you.
bsb_text: But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in My name, will teach you all things and will remind you of everything I have told you.
aov_text: maar die Trooster, die Heilige Gees, wat die Vader in my Naam sal stuur, Hy sal julle alles leer en sal julle herinner aan alles wat Ek vir julle gesê het.

kjv_text: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
bsb_text: Peace I leave with you; My peace I give to you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled; do not be afraid.
aov_text: Vrede laat Ek vir julle na, my vrede gee Ek aan julle; nie soos die wêreld gee, gee Ek aan julle nie. Laat julle hart nie ontsteld word en bang wees nie.

kjv_text: Ye have heard how I said unto you, I go away, and come again unto you. If ye loved me, ye would rejoice, because I said, I go unto the Father: for my Father is greater than I.
bsb_text: You heard Me say, ‘I am going away, and I am coming back to you.’ If you loved Me, you would rejoice that I am going to the Father, because the Father is greater than I.
aov_text: Julle het gehoor dat Ek aan julle gesê het: Ek gaan weg en Ek kom weer na julle toe. As julle My liefgehad het, sou julle bly wees dat Ek gesê het: Ek gaan na my Vader, omdat my Vader groter is as Ek.

kjv_text: And now I have told you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, ye might believe.
bsb_text: And now I have told you before it happens, so that when it does happen, you will believe.
aov_text: En nou het Ek dit aan julle gesê voordat dit gebeur, sodat julle kan glo wanneer dit gebeur.

kjv_text: Hereafter I will not talk much with you: for the prince of this world cometh, and hath nothing in me.
bsb_text: I will not speak with you much longer, for the prince of this world is coming, and he has no claim on Me.
aov_text: Ek sal nie veel meer met julle spreek nie; want die owerste van hierdie wêreld kom en het aan My niks nie.

kjv_text: But that the world may know that I love the Father; and as the Father gave me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go hence.
bsb_text: But I do exactly what the Father has commanded Me, so that the world may know that I love the Father. Get up! Let us go on from here.
aov_text: Maar dat die wêreld kan weet dat Ek die Vader liefhet en doen net soos die Vader My beveel het — staan op, laat ons hiervandaan weggaan.

kjv_text: I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.
bsb_text: “I am the true vine, and My Father is the keeper of the vineyard.
aov_text: EK is die ware wynstok, en my Vader is die landbouer.

kjv_text: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit he taketh away: and every branch that beareth fruit, he purgeth it, that it may bring forth more fruit.
bsb_text: He cuts off every branch in Me that bears no fruit, and every branch that does bear fruit, He prunes to make it even more fruitful.
aov_text: Elke loot wat in My nie vrug dra nie, neem Hy weg; en elke loot wat vrug dra, dié maak Hy skoon, sodat dit meer vrug kan dra.

kjv_text: Now ye are clean through the word which I have spoken unto you.
bsb_text: You are already clean because of the word I have spoken to you.
aov_text: Julle is alreeds rein deur die woord wat Ek tot julle gespreek het.

kjv_text: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.
bsb_text: Remain in Me, and I will remain in you. Just as no branch can bear fruit by itself unless it remains in the vine, neither can you bear fruit unless you remain in Me.
aov_text: Bly in My, soos Ek in julle. Net soos die loot geen vrug kan dra van homself as dit nie in die wynstok bly nie, so julle ook nie as julle in My nie bly nie.

kjv_text: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.
bsb_text: I am the vine and you are the branches. The one who remains in Me, and I in him, will bear much fruit. For apart from Me you can do nothing.
aov_text: Ek is die wynstok, julle die lote. Wie in My bly, en Ek in hom, hy dra veel vrug; want sonder My kan julle niks doen nie.

kjv_text: If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and men gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.
bsb_text: If anyone does not remain in Me, he is like a branch that is thrown away and withers. Such branches are gathered up, thrown into the fire, and burned.
aov_text: As iemand in My nie bly nie, word hy uitgewerp soos die loot en verdroog, en hulle maak dit bymekaar en gooi dit in die vuur, en dit verbrand.

kjv_text: If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ye shall ask what ye will, and it shall be done unto you.
bsb_text: If you remain in Me and My words remain in you, ask whatever you wish, and it will be done for you.
aov_text: As julle in My bly en my woorde in julle, sal julle vra net wat julle wil hê, en julle sal dit verkry.

kjv_text: Herein is my Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; so shall ye be my disciples.
bsb_text: This is to My Father’s glory, that you bear much fruit, proving yourselves to be My disciples.
aov_text: Hierin is my Vader verheerlik, dat julle veel vrug dra; en julle sal my dissipels wees.

kjv_text: As the Father hath loved me, so have I loved you: continue ye in my love.
bsb_text: As the Father has loved Me, so have I loved you. Remain in My love.
aov_text: Soos die Vader My liefgehad het, het Ek julle ook liefgehad. Bly in hierdie liefde van My.

kjv_text: If ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father's commandments, and abide in his love.
bsb_text: If you keep My commandments, you will remain in My love, just as I have kept My Father’s commandments and remain in His love.
aov_text: As julle my gebooie bewaar, sal julle in my liefde bly, net soos Ek die gebooie van my Vader bewaar en in sy liefde bly.

kjv_text: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.
bsb_text: I have told you these things so that My joy may be in you and your joy may be complete.
aov_text: Dit het Ek vir julle gesê, dat my blydskap in julle kan bly en julle blydskap volkome kan word.

kjv_text: This is my commandment, That ye love one another, as I have loved you.
bsb_text: This is My commandment, that you love one another as I have loved you.
aov_text: Dít is my gebod, dat julle mekaar moet liefhê net soos Ek julle liefgehad het.

kjv_text: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.
bsb_text: Greater love has no one than this, that he lay down his life for his friends.
aov_text: Groter liefde het niemand as dit nie, dat iemand sy lewe vir sy vriende gee.

kjv_text: Ye are my friends, if ye do whatsoever I command you.
bsb_text: You are My friends if you do what I command you.
aov_text: Julle is my vriende as julle alles doen wat Ek julle beveel.

kjv_text: Henceforth I call you not servants; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth: but I have called you friends; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you.
bsb_text: No longer do I call you servants, for a servant does not understand what his master is doing. But I have called you friends, because everything I have learned from My Father I have made known to you.
aov_text: Ek noem julle nie meer diensknegte nie, omdat die dienskneg nie weet wat sy heer doen nie. Maar Ek het julle vriende genoem, omdat Ek alles wat Ek van my Vader gehoor het, aan julle bekend gemaak het.

kjv_text: Ye have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you, that ye should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should remain: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.
bsb_text: You did not choose Me, but I chose you. And I appointed you to go and bear fruit—fruit that will remain—so that whatever you ask the Father in My name, He will give you.
aov_text: Julle het My nie uitverkies nie, maar Ek het julle uitverkies en julle aangestel om vrug te gaan dra en dat julle vrug kan bly, sodat wat julle die Vader ook al in my Naam vra, Hy julle dit kan gee.

kjv_text: These things I command you, that ye love one another.
bsb_text: This is My command to you: Love one another.
aov_text: Dit gebied Ek julle, dat julle mekaar moet liefhê.

kjv_text: If the world hate you, ye know that it hated me before it hated you.
bsb_text: If the world hates you, understand that it hated Me first.
aov_text: As die wêreld julle haat, moet julle weet dat hy My voor julle gehaat het.

kjv_text: If ye were of the world, the world would love his own: but because ye are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.
bsb_text: If you were of the world, it would love you as its own. Instead, the world hates you, because you are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world.
aov_text: As julle van die wêreld was, sou die wêreld sy eiendom liefhê. Maar omdat julle nie van die wêreld is nie, maar Ek julle uit die wêreld uitverkies het, daarom haat die wêreld julle.

kjv_text: Remember the word that I said unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they have kept my saying, they will keep yours also.
bsb_text: Remember the word that I spoke to you: ‘No servant is greater than his master.’ If they persecuted Me, they will persecute you as well; if they kept My word, they will keep yours as well.
aov_text: Onthou die woord wat Ek vir julle gesê het: ’n Dienskneg is nie groter as sy heer nie. As hulle My vervolg het, sal hulle jul ook vervolg. As hulle my woord bewaar het, sal hulle jul woord ook bewaar.

kjv_text: But all these things will they do unto you for my name's sake, because they know not him that sent me.
bsb_text: But they will treat you like this because of My name, since they do not know the One who sent Me.
aov_text: Maar al hierdie dinge sal hulle aan julle doen ter wille van my Naam, omdat hulle Hom nie ken wat My gestuur het nie.

kjv_text: If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no cloak for their sin.
bsb_text: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not be guilty of sin. Now, however, they have no excuse for their sin.
aov_text: As Ek nie gekom en met hulle gespreek het nie, sou hulle geen sonde hê nie; maar nou het hulle geen verskoning vir hul sonde nie.

kjv_text: He that hateth me hateth my Father also.
bsb_text: Whoever hates Me hates My Father as well.
aov_text: Wie my haat, haat ook my Vader.

kjv_text: If I had not done among them the works which none other man did, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father.
bsb_text: If I had not done among them the works that no one else did, they would not be guilty of sin; but now they have seen and hated both Me and My Father.
aov_text: As Ek nie die werke onder hulle gedoen het wat niemand anders gedoen het nie, sou hulle geen sonde hê nie. Maar nou het hulle dit gesien, en tog het hulle My sowel as my Vader gehaat.

kjv_text: But this cometh to pass, that the word might be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.
bsb_text: But this is to fulfill what is written in their Law: ‘They hated Me without reason.’
aov_text: Maar die woord wat in hulle wet geskrywe is, moet vervul word: Hulle het My sonder oorsaak gehaat.

kjv_text: But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, even the Spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the Father, he shall testify of me:
bsb_text: When the Advocate comes, whom I will send to you from the Father—the Spirit of truth who proceeds from the Father—He will testify about Me.
aov_text: Maar as die Trooster gekom het wat Ek vir julle van die Vader sal stuur, die Gees van die waarheid wat van die Vader uitgaan, sal Hy van My getuig.

kjv_text: And ye also shall bear witness, because ye have been with me from the beginning.
bsb_text: And you also must testify, because you have been with Me from the beginning.
aov_text: En julle getuig ook, omdat julle van die begin af met My is.

kjv_text: These things have I spoken unto you, that ye should not be offended.
bsb_text: “I have told you these things so that you will not fall away.
aov_text: HIERDIE dinge het Ek vir julle gesê, sodat julle nie mag struikel nie.

kjv_text: They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the time cometh, that whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service.
bsb_text: They will put you out of the synagogues. In fact, a time is coming when anyone who kills you will think he is offering a service to God.
aov_text: Hulle sal julle uit die sinagoges ban. Ja, daar kom ’n uur dat elkeen wat julle om die lewe bring, sal dink dat hy ’n diens aan God bewys.

kjv_text: And these things will they do unto you, because they have not known the Father, nor me.
bsb_text: They will do these things because they have not known the Father or Me.
aov_text: En dit sal hulle aan julle doen, omdat hulle die Vader nie ken nie en My ook nie.

kjv_text: But these things have I told you, that when the time shall come, ye may remember that I told you of them. And these things I said not unto you at the beginning, because I was with you.
bsb_text: But I have told you these things so that when their hour comes, you will remember that I told you about them. I did not tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you.
aov_text: Maar hierdie dinge het Ek vir julle gesê, sodat wanneer die uur kom, julle kan onthou dat Ek julle dit gesê het. Maar Ek het julle dit nie van die begin af gesê nie, omdat Ek saam met julle was.

kjv_text: But now I go my way to him that sent me; and none of you asketh me, Whither goest thou?
bsb_text: Now, however, I am going to Him who sent Me; yet none of you asks Me, ‘Where are You going?’
aov_text: En nou gaan Ek na Hom wat My gestuur het; en niemand van julle vra My: Waar gaan U heen nie?

kjv_text: But because I have said these things unto you, sorrow hath filled your heart.
bsb_text: Instead, your hearts are filled with sorrow because I have told you these things.
aov_text: Maar omdat Ek dit vir julle gesê het, het droefheid julle hart vervul.

kjv_text: Nevertheless I tell you the truth; It is expedient for you that I go away: for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I depart, I will send him unto you.
bsb_text: But I tell you the truth, it is for your benefit that I am going away. Unless I go away, the Advocate will not come to you; but if I go, I will send Him to you.
aov_text: Maar Ek sê julle die waarheid: Dit is vir julle voordelig dat Ek weggaan; want as Ek nie weggaan nie, sal die Trooster nie na julle kom nie; maar as Ek weggaan, sal Ek Hom na julle stuur;

kjv_text: And when he is come, he will reprove the world of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:
bsb_text: And when He comes, He will convict the world in regard to sin and righteousness and judgment:
aov_text: en as Hy kom, sal Hy die wêreld oortuig van sonde en van geregtigheid en van oordeel:

kjv_text: Of sin, because they believe not on me;
bsb_text: in regard to sin, because they do not believe in Me;
aov_text: van sonde, omdat hulle in My nie glo nie;

kjv_text: Of righteousness, because I go to my Father, and ye see me no more;
bsb_text: in regard to righteousness, because I am going to the Father and you will no longer see Me;
aov_text: en van geregtigheid, omdat Ek na my Vader gaan en julle My nie meer sal sien nie;

kjv_text: Of judgment, because the prince of this world is judged.
bsb_text: and in regard to judgment, because the prince of this world has been condemned.
aov_text: en van oordeel, omdat die owerste van hierdie wêreld geoordeel is.

kjv_text: I have yet many things to say unto you, but ye cannot bear them now.
bsb_text: I still have much to tell you, but you cannot yet bear to hear it.
aov_text: Nog baie dinge het Ek om aan julle te sê, maar julle kan dit nou nie dra nie.

kjv_text: Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will shew you things to come.
bsb_text: However, when the Spirit of truth comes, He will guide you into all truth. For He will not speak on His own, but He will speak what He hears, and He will declare to you what is to come.
aov_text: Maar wanneer Hy gekom het, die Gees van die waarheid, sal Hy julle in die hele waarheid lei; want Hy sal nie uit Homself spreek nie, maar alles wat Hy hoor, sal Hy spreek en die toekomstige dinge aan julle verkondig.

kjv_text: He shall glorify me: for he shall receive of mine, and shall shew it unto you.
bsb_text: He will glorify Me by taking from what is Mine and disclosing it to you.
aov_text: Hy sal My verheerlik, omdat Hy dit sal neem uit wat aan My behoort, en aan julle verkondig.

kjv_text: All things that the Father hath are mine: therefore said I, that he shall take of mine, and shall shew it unto you.
bsb_text: Everything that belongs to the Father is Mine. That is why I said that the Spirit will take from what is Mine and disclose it to you.
aov_text: Alles wat die Vader het, is myne; daarom het Ek gesê dat Hy dit sal neem uit wat aan My behoort, en aan julle verkondig.

kjv_text: A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me, because I go to the Father.
bsb_text: In a little while you will see Me no more, and then after a little while you will see Me.”
aov_text: ’n Klein tydjie, en julle sal My nie sien nie; en weer ’n klein tydjie, en julle sal My sien, omdat Ek na die Vader gaan.

kjv_text: Then said some of his disciples among themselves, What is this that he saith unto us, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me: and, Because I go to the Father?
bsb_text: Then some of His disciples asked one another, “Why is He telling us, ‘In a little while you will not see Me, and then after a little while you will see Me’ and ‘Because I am going to the Father’?”
aov_text: Sommige van sy dissipels het toe onder mekaar gevra: Wat is dit wat Hy vir ons sê: ’n Klein tydjie, en julle sien My nie; en weer ’n klein tydjie, en julle sal My sien; en: Ek gaan na die Vader?

kjv_text: They said therefore, What is this that he saith, A little while? we cannot tell what he saith.
bsb_text: They kept asking, “Why is He saying, ‘a little while’? We do not understand what He is saying.”
aov_text: Hulle het dan gevra: Wat is dit wat Hy sê: ’n Klein tydjie? Ons weet nie wat Hy sê nie.

kjv_text: Now Jesus knew that they were desirous to ask him, and said unto them, Do ye enquire among yourselves of that I said, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me?
bsb_text: Aware that they wanted to question Him, Jesus said to them, “Are you asking one another why I said, ‘In a little while you will not see Me, and then after a little while you will see Me’?
aov_text: En Jesus het gemerk dat hulle Hom wou vra, en Hy sê vir hulle: Ondervra julle mekaar daaroor dat Ek gesê het: ’n Klein tydjie, en julle sal My nie sien nie; en weer ’n klein tydjie, en julle sal My sien?

kjv_text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, That ye shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: and ye shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.
bsb_text: Truly, truly, I tell you, you will weep and wail while the world rejoices. You will grieve, but your grief will turn to joy.
aov_text: Voorwaar, voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, julle sal ween en rou bedryf, maar die wêreld sal bly wees. En julle sal bedroef wees, maar julle droefheid sal in blydskap verander.

kjv_text: A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow, because her hour is come: but as soon as she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish, for joy that a man is born into the world.
bsb_text: A woman has pain in childbirth because her time has come; but when she brings forth her child, she forgets her anguish because of her joy that a child has been born into the world.
aov_text: ’n Vrou het droefheid wanneer sy baar, omdat haar uur gekom het; maar wanneer die kindjie gebore is, dink sy nie meer aan haar benoudheid nie, om die blydskap dat ’n mens in die wêreld gebore is.

kjv_text: And ye now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man taketh from you.
bsb_text: So also you have sorrow now, but I will see you again and your hearts will rejoice, and no one will take away your joy.
aov_text: Julle het dan ook nou droefheid, maar Ek sal julle weer sien en julle hart sal bly word, en niemand neem julle blydskap van julle weg nie.

kjv_text: And in that day ye shall ask me nothing. Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name, he will give it you.
bsb_text: In that day you will no longer ask Me anything. Truly, truly, I tell you, whatever you ask the Father in My name, He will give you.
aov_text: En in daardie dag sal julle My niks vra nie. Voorwaar, voorwaar Ek sê vir julle, alles wat julle die Vader sal vra in my Naam, sal Hy julle gee.

kjv_text: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full.
bsb_text: Until now you have not asked for anything in My name. Ask and you will receive, so that your joy may be complete.
aov_text: Tot nou toe het julle niks in my Naam gevra nie. Bid en julle sal ontvang, sodat julle blydskap volkome kan wees.

kjv_text: These things have I spoken unto you in proverbs: but the time cometh, when I shall no more speak unto you in proverbs, but I shall shew you plainly of the Father.
bsb_text: I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. An hour is coming when I will no longer speak to you this way, but will tell you plainly about the Father.
aov_text: Hierdie dinge het Ek deur gelykenisse tot julle gespreek, maar daar kom ’n uur wanneer Ek nie meer deur gelykenisse tot julle sal spreek nie, maar julle openlik van die Vader sal vertel.

kjv_text: At that day ye shall ask in my name: and I say not unto you, that I will pray the Father for you:
bsb_text: In that day you will ask in My name. I am not saying that I will ask the Father on your behalf.
aov_text: In daardie dag sal julle in my Naam bid; en Ek sê nie vir julle dat Ek die Vader aangaande julle sal vra nie;

kjv_text: For the Father himself loveth you, because ye have loved me, and have believed that I came out from God.
bsb_text: For the Father Himself loves you, because you have loved Me and have believed that I came from God.
aov_text: want die Vader self het julle lief, omdat julle My liefgehad en geglo het dat Ek van God uitgegaan het.

kjv_text: I came forth from the Father, and am come into the world: again, I leave the world, and go to the Father.
bsb_text: I came from the Father and entered the world. In turn, I will leave the world and go to the Father.”
aov_text: Ek het van die Vader uitgegaan en in die wêreld gekom. Weer verlaat Ek die wêreld en gaan na my Vader.

kjv_text: His disciples said unto him, Lo, now speakest thou plainly, and speakest no proverb.
bsb_text: His disciples said, “See, now You are speaking plainly and without figures of speech.
aov_text: Sy dissipels sê vir Hom: Kyk, nou spreek U ronduit en gebruik geen gelykenis nie.

kjv_text: Now are we sure that thou knowest all things, and needest not that any man should ask thee: by this we believe that thou camest forth from God.
bsb_text: Now we understand that You know all things and that You have no need for anyone to question You. Because of this, we believe that You came from God.”
aov_text: Nou weet ons dat U alles weet en nie nodig het dat iemand U iets vra nie. Daarom glo ons dat U van God uitgegaan het.

kjv_text: Jesus answered them, Do ye now believe?
bsb_text: “Do you finally believe?” Jesus replied.
aov_text: Jesus antwoord hulle: Glo julle nou?

kjv_text: Behold, the hour cometh, yea, is now come, that ye shall be scattered, every man to his own, and shall leave me alone: and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.
bsb_text: “Look, an hour is coming and has already come when you will be scattered, each to his own home, and you will leave Me all alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with Me.
aov_text: Kyk, die uur kom en het nou gekom dat julle uitmekaar gejaag sal word, elkeen na sy eie toe, en My alleen sal laat; tog is Ek nie alleen nie, omdat die Vader met My is.

kjv_text: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.
bsb_text: I have told you these things so that in Me you may have peace. In the world you will have tribulation. But take courage; I have overcome the world!”
aov_text: Dit het Ek vir julle gesê, dat julle in My vrede kan hê. In die wêreld sal julle verdrukking hê; maar hou goeie moed, Ek het die wêreld oorwin.

kjv_text: These words spake Jesus, and lifted up his eyes to heaven, and said, Father, the hour is come; glorify thy Son, that thy Son also may glorify thee:
bsb_text: When Jesus had spoken these things, He lifted up His eyes to heaven and said, “Father, the hour has come. Glorify Your Son, that Your Son may glorify You.
aov_text: DIT het Jesus gespreek, en Hy het sy oë na die hemel opgehef en gesê: Vader, die uur het gekom; verheerlik u Seun, sodat u Seun U ook kan verheerlik  —

kjv_text: As thou hast given him power over all flesh, that he should give eternal life to as many as thou hast given him.
bsb_text: For You granted Him authority over all people, so that He may give eternal life to all those You have given Him.
aov_text: soos U Hom mag oor alle vlees gegee het, sodat Hy aan almal wat U Hom gegee het, die ewige lewe kan gee.

kjv_text: And this is life eternal, that they might know thee the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom thou hast sent.
bsb_text: Now this is eternal life, that they may know You, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom You have sent.
aov_text: En dit is die ewige lewe, dat hulle U ken, die enige waaragtige God, en Jesus Christus wat U gestuur het.

kjv_text: I have glorified thee on the earth: I have finished the work which thou gavest me to do.
bsb_text: I have glorified You on earth by accomplishing the work You gave Me to do.
aov_text: Ek het U verheerlik op die aarde. Die werk wat U My gegee het om te doen, het Ek volbring.

kjv_text: And now, O Father, glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.
bsb_text: And now, Father, glorify Me in Your presence with the glory I had with You before the world existed.
aov_text: En nou, Vader, verheerlik My by Uself met die heerlikheid wat Ek by U gehad het voordat die wêreld was.

kjv_text: I have manifested thy name unto the men which thou gavest me out of the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them me; and they have kept thy word.
bsb_text: I have revealed Your name to those You have given Me out of the world. They were Yours; You gave them to Me, and they have kept Your word.
