aov_text: Ek het u Naam geopenbaar aan die mense wat U My uit die wêreld gegee het. Hulle het aan U behoort, en U het hulle aan My gegee, en hulle het u woord bewaar.

kjv_text: Now they have known that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are of thee.
bsb_text: Now they know that everything You have given Me comes from You.
aov_text: Nou weet hulle dat alles wat U My gegee het, van U kom.

kjv_text: For I have given unto them the words which thou gavest me; and they have received them, and have known surely that I came out from thee, and they have believed that thou didst send me.
bsb_text: For I have given them the words You gave Me, and they have received them. They knew with certainty that I came from You, and they believed that You sent Me.
aov_text: Want die woorde wat U My gegee het, het Ek aan hulle gegee; en hulle het dit ontvang en waarlik erken dat Ek van U uitgegaan het, en hulle het geglo dat U My gestuur het.

kjv_text: I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for them which thou hast given me; for they are thine.
bsb_text: I ask on their behalf. I do not ask on behalf of the world, but on behalf of those You have given Me; for they are Yours.
aov_text: Ek bid vir hulle; Ek bid nie vir die wêreld nie, maar vir die wat U My gegee het, omdat hulle aan U behoort.

kjv_text: And all mine are thine, and thine are mine; and I am glorified in them.
bsb_text: All I have is Yours, and all You have is Mine; and in them I have been glorified.
aov_text: En alles wat myne is, is uwe; en wat uwe is, is myne; en Ek is in hulle verheerlik.

kjv_text: And now I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I come to thee. Holy Father, keep through thine own name those whom thou hast given me, that they may be one, as we are.
bsb_text: I will no longer be in the world, but they are in the world, and I am coming to You. Holy Father, protect them by Your name, the name You gave Me, so that they may be one as We are one.
aov_text: En Ek is nie meer in die wêreld nie, maar hulle is in die wêreld; en Ek kom na U toe. Heilige Vader, bewaar in u Naam die wat U My gegee het, sodat hulle een kan wees net soos Ons.

kjv_text: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in thy name: those that thou gavest me I have kept, and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.
bsb_text: While I was with them, I protected and preserved them by Your name, the name You gave Me. Not one of them has been lost, except the son of destruction, so that the Scripture would be fulfilled.
aov_text: Toe Ek saam met hulle in die wêreld was, het Ek hulle in u Naam bewaar. Oor die wat U My gegee het, het Ek gewaak; en nie een van hulle het verlore gegaan nie, behalwe die seun van die verderf, sodat die Skrif vervul sou word.

kjv_text: And now come I to thee; and these things I speak in the world, that they might have my joy fulfilled in themselves.
bsb_text: But now I am coming to You; and I am saying these things while I am in the world, so that they may have My joy fulfilled within them.
aov_text: Maar nou kom Ek na U toe; en Ek spreek hierdie dinge in die wêreld, sodat hulle my blydskap volkome in hulle kan hê.

kjv_text: I have given them thy word; and the world hath hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
bsb_text: I have given them Your word and the world has hated them; for they are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.
aov_text: Ek het hulle u woord gegee, en die wêreld het hulle gehaat, omdat hulle nie van die wêreld is nie, net soos Ek nie van die wêreld is nie.

kjv_text: I pray not that thou shouldest take them out of the world, but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil.
bsb_text: I am not asking that You take them out of the world, but that You keep them from the evil one.
aov_text: Ek bid nie dat U hulle uit die wêreld wegneem nie, maar dat U hulle van die Bose bewaar.

kjv_text: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
bsb_text: They are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.
aov_text: Hulle is nie van die wêreld nie, net soos Ek nie van die wêreld is nie.

kjv_text: Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.
bsb_text: Sanctify them by the truth; Your word is truth.
aov_text: Heilig hulle in u waarheid; u woord is die waarheid.

kjv_text: As thou hast sent me into the world, even so have I also sent them into the world.
bsb_text: As You sent Me into the world, I have also sent them into the world.
aov_text: Soos U My gestuur het in die wêreld, het Ek ook hulle in die wêreld gestuur.

kjv_text: And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they also might be sanctified through the truth.
bsb_text: For them I sanctify Myself, so that they too may be sanctified by the truth.
aov_text: En Ek heilig Myself vir hulle, sodat hulle ook in waarheid geheilig kan wees.

kjv_text: Neither pray I for these alone, but for them also which shall believe on me through their word;
bsb_text: I am not asking on behalf of them alone, but also on behalf of those who will believe in Me through their message,
aov_text: Maar Ek bid nie vir hulle alleen nie, maar ook vir die wat deur hulle woord in My sal glo  —

kjv_text: That they all may be one; as thou, Father, art in me, and I in thee, that they also may be one in us: that the world may believe that thou hast sent me.
bsb_text: that all of them may be one, as You, Father, are in Me, and I am in You. May they also be in Us, so that the world may believe that You sent Me.
aov_text: dat almal een mag wees net soos U, Vader, in My en Ek in U; dat hulle ook in Ons een mag wees, sodat die wêreld kan glo dat U My gestuur het.

kjv_text: And the glory which thou gavest me I have given them; that they may be one, even as we are one:
bsb_text: I have given them the glory You gave Me, so that they may be one as We are one—
aov_text: En Ek het hulle die heerlikheid gegee wat U My gegee het, sodat hulle een kan wees, net soos Ons een is.

kjv_text: I in them, and thou in me, that they may be made perfect in one; and that the world may know that thou hast sent me, and hast loved them, as thou hast loved me.
bsb_text: I in them and You in Me—that they may be perfectly united, so that the world may know that You sent Me and have loved them just as You have loved Me.
aov_text: Ek in hulle en U in My, sodat hulle volkome een kan wees; en dat die wêreld kan weet dat U My gestuur het, en hulle liefgehad het net soos U My liefgehad het.

kjv_text: Father, I will that they also, whom thou hast given me, be with me where I am; that they may behold my glory, which thou hast given me: for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world.
bsb_text: Father, I want those You have given Me to be with Me where I am, that they may see the glory You gave Me because You loved Me before the foundation of the world.
aov_text: Vader, Ek wil dat waar Ek is, hulle wat U My gegee het, ook saam met My sal wees, sodat hulle my heerlikheid kan aanskou wat U My gegee het, omdat U My liefgehad het voor die grondlegging van die wêreld.

kjv_text: O righteous Father, the world hath not known thee: but I have known thee, and these have known that thou hast sent me.
bsb_text: Righteous Father, although the world has not known You, I know You, and they know that You sent Me.
aov_text: Regverdige Vader, al het die wêreld U nie geken nie, tog het Ek U geken, en hulle hier het erken dat U My gestuur het.

kjv_text: And I have declared unto them thy name, and will declare it: that the love wherewith thou hast loved me may be in them, and I in them.
bsb_text: And I have made Your name known to them and will continue to make it known, so that the love You have for Me may be in them, and I in them.”
aov_text: En Ek het u Naam aan hulle bekend gemaak en sal dit bekend maak, sodat die liefde waarmee U My liefgehad het, in hulle kan wees, en Ek in hulle.

kjv_text: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went forth with his disciples over the brook Cedron, where was a garden, into the which he entered, and his disciples.
bsb_text: After Jesus had spoken these words, He went out with His disciples across the Kidron Valley, where they entered a garden.
aov_text: NADAT Jesus dit gesê het, het Hy met sy dissipels oor die spruit Kedron gegaan waar daar ’n tuin was, waarin Hy self gegaan het en sy dissipels.

kjv_text: And Judas also, which betrayed him, knew the place: for Jesus ofttimes resorted thither with his disciples.
bsb_text: Now Judas His betrayer also knew the place, because Jesus had often met there with His disciples.
aov_text: En Judas, sy verraaier, het ook die plek geken, omdat Jesus daar dikwels met sy dissipels saamgekom het.

kjv_text: Judas then, having received a band of men and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, cometh thither with lanterns and torches and weapons.
bsb_text: So Judas brought a band of soldiers and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees. They arrived at the garden carrying lanterns, torches, and weapons.
aov_text: En Judas het die afdeling soldate en die dienaars van die owerpriesters en die Fariseërs geneem en daar gekom met fakkels en lampe en wapens.

kjv_text: Jesus therefore, knowing all things that should come upon him, went forth, and said unto them, Whom seek ye?
bsb_text: Jesus, knowing all that was coming upon Him, stepped forward and asked them, “Whom are you seeking?”
aov_text: En omdat Jesus alles geweet het wat oor Hom sou kom, het Hy uit die tuin gegaan en vir hulle gesê: Wie soek julle?

kjv_text: They answered him, Jesus of Nazareth. Jesus saith unto them, I am he. And Judas also, which betrayed him, stood with them.
bsb_text: “Jesus of Nazareth,” they answered. Jesus said, “I am He.” And Judas His betrayer was standing there with them.
aov_text: Hulle antwoord Hom: Jesus, die Nasaréner. Jesus sê vir hulle: Dit is Ek. En ook Judas, sy verraaier, het by hulle gestaan.

kjv_text: As soon then as he had said unto them, I am he, they went backward, and fell to the ground.
bsb_text: When Jesus said, “I am He,” they drew back and fell to the ground.
aov_text: Toe Hy dan vir hulle sê: Dit is Ek, het hulle agteruitgegaan en op die grond geval.

kjv_text: Then asked he them again, Whom seek ye? And they said, Jesus of Nazareth.
bsb_text: So He asked them again, “Whom are you seeking?” “Jesus of Nazareth,” they answered.
aov_text: Hy vra hulle toe weer: Wie soek julle? En hulle sê: Jesus, die Nasaréner.

kjv_text: Jesus answered, I have told you that I am he: if therefore ye seek me, let these go their way:
bsb_text: “I told you that I am He,” Jesus replied. “So if you are looking for Me, let these men go.”
aov_text: Jesus antwoord: Ek het vir julle gesê dat dit Ek is. As julle My dan soek, laat hierdie manne weggaan  —

kjv_text: That the saying might be fulfilled, which he spake, Of them which thou gavest me have I lost none.
bsb_text: This was to fulfill the word He had spoken: “I have not lost one of those You have given Me.”
aov_text: sodat die woord vervul sou word wat Hy gespreek het: Uit die wat U My gegee het, het Ek niemand verloor nie.

kjv_text: Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it, and smote the high priest's servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant's name was Malchus.
bsb_text: Then Simon Peter drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.
aov_text: En Simon Petrus wat ’n swaard gehad het, het dit uitgetrek en die dienskneg van die hoëpriester geslaan en sy regteroor afgekap. En die naam van die dienskneg was Malchus.

kjv_text: Then said Jesus unto Peter, Put up thy sword into the sheath: the cup which my Father hath given me, shall I not drink it?
bsb_text: “Put your sword back in its sheath!” Jesus said to Peter. “Shall I not drink the cup the Father has given Me?”
aov_text: Toe sê Jesus vir Petrus: Steek jou swaard in die skede. Die beker wat die Vader My gegee het, sal Ek dit dan nie drink nie?

kjv_text: Then the band and the captain and officers of the Jews took Jesus, and bound him,
bsb_text: Then the band of soldiers, with its commander and the officers of the Jews, arrested Jesus and bound Him.
aov_text: EN die afdeling en die owerste oor duisend en die dienaars van die Jode het Jesus gevange geneem en Hom geboei;

kjv_text: And led him away to Annas first; for he was father in law to Caiaphas, which was the high priest that same year.
bsb_text: They brought Him first to Annas, who was the father-in-law of Caiaphas, the high priest that year.
aov_text: en hulle het Hom weggelei, eers na Annas; want hy was die skoonvader van Kájafas wat daardie jaar hoëpriester was.

kjv_text: Now Caiaphas was he, which gave counsel to the Jews, that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.
bsb_text: Caiaphas was the one who had advised the Jews that it would be better if one man died for the people.
aov_text: En dit was Kájafas wat aan die Jode die raad gegee het dat dit voordelig is dat een man vir die volk sterwe.

kjv_text: And Simon Peter followed Jesus, and so did another disciple: that disciple was known unto the high priest, and went in with Jesus into the palace of the high priest.
bsb_text: Now Simon Peter and another disciple were following Jesus. Since that disciple was known to the high priest, he also went with Jesus into the courtyard of the high priest.
aov_text: En Simon Petrus en ’n ander dissipel het Jesus gevolg; en daardie dissipel was met die hoëpriester bekend en het saam met Jesus ingegaan in die binneplaas van die hoëpriester se paleis.

kjv_text: But Peter stood at the door without. Then went out that other disciple, which was known unto the high priest, and spake unto her that kept the door, and brought in Peter.
bsb_text: But Peter stood outside at the door. Then the disciple who was known to the high priest went out and spoke to the doorkeeper, and brought Peter in.
aov_text: Maar Petrus het buitekant by die deur bly staan. En die ander dissipel wat bekend was met die hoëpriester, het uitgegaan en met die deurwagster gepraat en Petrus ingebring.

kjv_text: Then saith the damsel that kept the door unto Peter, Art not thou also one of this man's disciples? He saith, I am not.
bsb_text: At this, the servant girl watching the door said to Peter, “Aren’t you also one of this man’s disciples?” “I am not,” he answered.
aov_text: Toe sê die diensmeisie, die deurwagster, vir Petrus: Jy is tog nie ook een van die dissipels van hierdie mens nie? Hy sê: Ek is nie.

kjv_text: And the servants and officers stood there, who had made a fire of coals; for it was cold: and they warmed themselves: and Peter stood with them, and warmed himself.
bsb_text: Because it was cold, the servants and officers were standing around a charcoal fire they had made to keep warm. And Peter was also standing with them, warming himself.
aov_text: En die diensknegte en die dienaars het by ’n koolvuur gestaan wat hulle gemaak het — want dit was koud — en hulle het hul warm gemaak. En Petrus het by hulle gestaan en hom warm gemaak.

kjv_text: The high priest then asked Jesus of his disciples, and of his doctrine.
bsb_text: Meanwhile, the high priest questioned Jesus about His disciples and His teaching.
aov_text: Die hoëpriester ondervra Jesus toe oor sy dissipels en oor sy leer.

kjv_text: Jesus answered him, I spake openly to the world; I ever taught in the synagogue, and in the temple, whither the Jews always resort; and in secret have I said nothing.
bsb_text: “I have spoken openly to the world,” Jesus answered. “I always taught in the synagogues and at the temple, where all the Jews come together. I said nothing in secret.
aov_text: Jesus antwoord hom: Ek het ronduit tot die wêreld gespreek; Ek het altyd in die sinagoge geleer en in die tempel waar die Jode van alle kante vergader; en in die geheim het Ek niks gespreek nie.

kjv_text: Why askest thou me? ask them which heard me, what I have said unto them: behold, they know what I said.
bsb_text: Why are you asking Me? Ask those who heard My message. Surely they know what I said.”
aov_text: Wat ondervra u My? Ondervra hulle wat gehoor het wat Ek tot hulle gespreek het; hulle weet tog wat Ek gesê het.

kjv_text: And when he had thus spoken, one of the officers which stood by struck Jesus with the palm of his hand, saying, Answerest thou the high priest so?
bsb_text: When Jesus had said this, one of the officers standing nearby slapped Him in the face and said, “Is this how You answer the high priest?”
aov_text: En toe Hy dit sê, het een van die dienaars wat daar staan, Jesus in die aangesig geslaan en gesê: Antwoord U die hoëpriester so?

kjv_text: Jesus answered him, If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil: but if well, why smitest thou me?
bsb_text: Jesus replied, “If I said something wrong, testify as to what was wrong. But if I spoke correctly, why did you strike Me?”
aov_text: Jesus antwoord hom: As Ek verkeerd gespreek het, getuig van die verkeerdheid; maar as Ek reg gespreek het, waarom slaan jy My?

kjv_text: Now Annas had sent him bound unto Caiaphas the high priest.
bsb_text: Then Annas sent Him, still bound, to Caiaphas the high priest.
aov_text: En Annas het Hom geboeid na Kájafas, die hoëpriester, gestuur.

kjv_text: And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself. They said therefore unto him, Art not thou also one of his disciples? He denied it, and said, I am not.
bsb_text: Simon Peter was still standing and warming himself. So they asked him, “Aren’t you also one of His disciples?” He denied it and said, “I am not.”
aov_text: En Simon Petrus het hom staan en warm maak. En hulle sê vir hom: Jy is tog nie ook een van sy dissipels nie? Toe ontken hy dit en sê: Ek is nie.

kjv_text: One of the servants of the high priest, being his kinsman whose ear Peter cut off, saith, Did not I see thee in the garden with him?
bsb_text: One of the high priest’s servants, a relative of the man whose ear Peter had cut off, asked, “Didn’t I see you with Him in the garden?”
aov_text: Een van die hoëpriester se diensknegte wat familie was van die man wie se oor Petrus afgekap het, sê: Het ek jou nie in die tuin by Hom gesien nie?

kjv_text: Peter then denied again: and immediately the cock crew.
bsb_text: Peter denied it once more, and immediately a rooster crowed.
aov_text: En Petrus het dit weer ontken; en dadelik het die haan gekraai.

kjv_text: Then led they Jesus from Caiaphas unto the hall of judgment: and it was early; and they themselves went not into the judgment hall, lest they should be defiled; but that they might eat the passover.
bsb_text: Then they led Jesus away from Caiaphas into the Praetorium. By now it was early morning, and the Jews did not enter the Praetorium, to avoid being defiled and unable to eat the Passover.
aov_text: TOE neem hulle Jesus van Kájafas na die goewerneur se paleis. En dit was vroeg in die môre; en hulle het self nie in die paleis ingegaan nie, dat hulle hul nie sou verontreinig nie, maar dat hulle die pasga kon eet.

kjv_text: Pilate then went out unto them, and said, What accusation bring ye against this man?
bsb_text: So Pilate went out to them and asked, “What accusation are you bringing against this man?”
aov_text: En Pilatus het na hulle uitgekom en gesê: Watter beskuldiging bring julle teen hierdie man in?

kjv_text: They answered and said unto him, If he were not a malefactor, we would not have delivered him up unto thee.
bsb_text: “If He were not a criminal,” they replied, “we would not have handed Him over to you.”
aov_text: Hulle antwoord en sê vir hom: As Hy geen kwaaddoener was nie, sou ons Hom nie aan u oorgelewer het nie.

kjv_text: Then said Pilate unto them, Take ye him, and judge him according to your law. The Jews therefore said unto him, It is not lawful for us to put any man to death:
bsb_text: “You take Him and judge Him by your own law,” Pilate told them. “We are not permitted to execute anyone,” the Jews replied.
aov_text: En Pilatus sê vir hulle: Neem julle Hom en oordeel Hom volgens julle wet. En die Jode sê vir hom: Dit is ons nie geoorloof om iemand dood te maak nie  —

kjv_text: That the saying of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spake, signifying what death he should die.
bsb_text: This was to fulfill the word that Jesus had spoken to indicate the kind of death He was going to die.
aov_text: sodat die woord van Jesus vervul sou word wat Hy gesê het om aan te dui hoedanige dood Hy sou sterwe.

kjv_text: Then Pilate entered into the judgment hall again, and called Jesus, and said unto him, Art thou the King of the Jews?
bsb_text: Pilate went back into the Praetorium, summoned Jesus, and asked Him, “Are You the King of the Jews?”
aov_text: Pilatus gaan toe weer in die goewerneur se paleis en roep Jesus en sê vir Hom: Is U die Koning van die Jode?

kjv_text: Jesus answered him, Sayest thou this thing of thyself, or did others tell it thee of me?
bsb_text: “Are you saying this on your own,” Jesus asked, “or did others tell you about Me?”
aov_text: Jesus antwoord hom: Sê u dit uit uself, of het ander u dit van My gesê?

kjv_text: Pilate answered, Am I a Jew? Thine own nation and the chief priests have delivered thee unto me: what hast thou done?
bsb_text: “Am I a Jew?” Pilate replied. “Your own people and chief priests handed You over to me. What have You done?”
aov_text: Pilatus antwoord: Is ek dan ’n Jood? U volk en die owerpriesters het U aan my oorgelewer. Wat het U gedoen?

kjv_text: Jesus answered, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Jews: but now is my kingdom not from hence.
bsb_text: Jesus answered, “My kingdom is not of this world; if it were, My servants would fight to prevent My arrest by the Jews. But now My kingdom is not of this realm.”
aov_text: Jesus antwoord: My koninkryk is nie van hierdie wêreld nie; as my koninkryk van hierdie wêreld was, sou my dienaars geveg het, dat Ek nie aan die Jode oorgelewer word nie. Maar nou is my koninkryk nie van hier nie.

kjv_text: Pilate therefore said unto him, Art thou a king then? Jesus answered, Thou sayest that I am a king. To this end was I born, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.
bsb_text: “Then You are a king!” Pilate said. “You say that I am a king,” Jesus answered. “For this reason I was born and have come into the world, to testify to the truth. Everyone who belongs to the truth listens to My voice.”
aov_text: Pilatus sê toe vir Hom: Is U dan tog ’n koning? Jesus antwoord: U sê dat Ek ’n koning is. Hiervoor is Ek gebore en hiervoor het Ek in die wêreld gekom, om vir die waarheid te getuig. Elkeen wat uit die waarheid is, luister na my stem.

kjv_text: Pilate saith unto him, What is truth? And when he had said this, he went out again unto the Jews, and saith unto them, I find in him no fault at all.
bsb_text: “What is truth?” Pilate asked. And having said this, he went out again to the Jews and told them, “I find no basis for a charge against Him.
aov_text: Pilatus sê vir Hom: Wat is waarheid? En toe hy dit gesê het, gaan hy weer uit na die Jode en sê vir hulle: Ek vind geen skuld in Hom nie.

kjv_text: But ye have a custom, that I should release unto you one at the passover: will ye therefore that I release unto you the King of the Jews?
bsb_text: But it is your custom that I release to you one prisoner at the Passover. So then, do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”
aov_text: Maar julle het ’n gewoonte dat ek vir julle op die pasga iemand moet loslaat; wil julle dan hê dat ek vir julle die Koning van die Jode moet loslaat?

kjv_text: Then cried they all again, saying, Not this man, but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was a robber.
bsb_text: “Not this man,” they shouted, “but Barabbas!” (Now Barabbas was an insurrectionist.)
aov_text: Toe skreeu hulle almal weer en sê: Nie vir Hom nie, maar Barábbas! En Barábbas was ’n rower.

kjv_text: Then Pilate therefore took Jesus, and scourged him.
bsb_text: Then Pilate took Jesus and had Him flogged.
aov_text: TOE neem Pilatus dan vir Jesus en laat Hom gésel.

kjv_text: And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns, and put it on his head, and they put on him a purple robe,
bsb_text: The soldiers twisted together a crown of thorns, set it on His head, and dressed Him in a purple robe.
aov_text: En die soldate het ’n kroon van dorings gevleg en dit op sy hoof gesit, en ’n purper kleed om Hom gewerp

kjv_text: And said, Hail, King of the Jews! and they smote him with their hands.
bsb_text: And they went up to Him again and again, saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!” and slapping Him in the face.
aov_text: en gesê: Wees gegroet, Koning van die Jode! En hulle het Hom in die aangesig geslaan.

kjv_text: Pilate therefore went forth again, and saith unto them, Behold, I bring him forth to you, that ye may know that I find no fault in him.
bsb_text: Once again Pilate came out and said to the Jews, “Look, I am bringing Him out to you to let you know that I find no basis for a charge against Him.”
aov_text: Pilatus gaan toe weer uit buitentoe en sê vir hulle: Kyk, ek bring Hom vir julle buitentoe, sodat julle kan weet dat ek in Hom geen skuld vind nie.

kjv_text: Then came Jesus forth, wearing the crown of thorns, and the purple robe. And Pilate saith unto them, Behold the man!
bsb_text: When Jesus came out wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe, Pilate said to them, “Here is the man!”
aov_text: En Jesus het uitgekom buitentoe en die doringkroon en die purperkleed gedra. En Pilatus sê vir hulle: Dáár is die mens!

kjv_text: When the chief priests therefore and officers saw him, they cried out, saying, Crucify him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Take ye him, and crucify him: for I find no fault in him.
bsb_text: As soon as the chief priests and officers saw Him, they shouted, “Crucify Him! Crucify Him!” “You take Him and crucify Him,” Pilate replied, “for I find no basis for a charge against Him.”
aov_text: En toe die owerpriesters en die dienaars Hom sien, skreeu hulle en sê: Kruisig, kruisig Hom! Pilatus sê vir hulle: Neem julle Hom en kruisig Hom, want ek vind geen skuld in Hom nie.

kjv_text: The Jews answered him, We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.
bsb_text: “We have a law,” answered the Jews, “and according to that law He must die, because He declared Himself to be the Son of God.”
aov_text: Die Jode antwoord hom: Ons het ’n wet en volgens ons wet moet Hy sterf, omdat Hy Homself die Seun van God gemaak het.

kjv_text: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he was the more afraid;
bsb_text: When Pilate heard this statement, he was even more afraid,
aov_text: En toe Pilatus hierdie woord hoor, het hy nog meer bevrees geword

kjv_text: And went again into the judgment hall, and saith unto Jesus, Whence art thou? But Jesus gave him no answer.
bsb_text: and he went back into the Praetorium. “Where are You from?” he asked. But Jesus gave no answer.
aov_text: en weer in die paleis ingegaan en vir Jesus gesê: Van waar is U? Maar Jesus het hom geen antwoord gegee nie.

kjv_text: Then saith Pilate unto him, Speakest thou not unto me? knowest thou not that I have power to crucify thee, and have power to release thee?
bsb_text: So Pilate said to Him, “Do You refuse to speak to me? Do You not know that I have authority to release You and authority to crucify You?”
aov_text: En Pilatus sê vir Hom: Praat U nie met my nie? Weet U nie dat ek mag het om U te kruisig en mag het om U los te laat nie?

kjv_text: Jesus answered, Thou couldest have no power at all against me, except it were given thee from above: therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath the greater sin.
bsb_text: Jesus answered, “You would have no authority over Me if it were not given to you from above. Therefore the one who handed Me over to you is guilty of greater sin.”
aov_text: Jesus antwoord: U sou geen mag teen My hê as dit u nie van bo gegee was nie. Daarom het hy wat My aan u oorlewer, groter sonde.

kjv_text: And from thenceforth Pilate sought to release him: but the Jews cried out, saying, If thou let this man go, thou art not Caesar's friend: whosoever maketh himself a king speaketh against Caesar.
bsb_text: From then on, Pilate tried to release Him, but the Jews kept shouting, “If you release this man, you are no friend of Caesar. Anyone who declares himself a king is defying Caesar.”
aov_text: Hierop het Pilatus probeer om Hom los te laat, maar die Jode het geskreeu en gesê: As u Hom loslaat, is u nie die keiser se vriend nie. Elkeen wat homself koning maak, kom in verset teen die keiser.

kjv_text: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he brought Jesus forth, and sat down in the judgment seat in a place that is called the Pavement, but in the Hebrew, Gabbatha.
bsb_text: When Pilate heard these words, he brought Jesus out and sat on the judgment seat at a place called the Stone Pavement, which in Hebrew is Gabbatha.
aov_text: En toe Pilatus hierdie woord hoor, het hy Jesus buitentoe gebring en op die regterstoel gaan sit in die plek wat Plaveisel genoem word, en in Hebreeus Gábbata.

kjv_text: And it was the preparation of the passover, and about the sixth hour: and he saith unto the Jews, Behold your King!
bsb_text: It was the day of Preparation for the Passover, about the sixth hour. And Pilate said to the Jews, “Here is your King!”
aov_text: En dit was die voorbereiding vir die pasga en omtrent die sesde uur. Toe sê hy vir die Jode: Dáár is julle Koning!

kjv_text: But they cried out, Away with him, away with him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priests answered, We have no king but Caesar.
bsb_text: At this, they shouted, “Away with Him! Away with Him! Crucify Him!” “Shall I crucify your King?” Pilate asked. “We have no king but Caesar,” replied the chief priests.
aov_text: Maar hulle skreeu: Neem weg, neem weg, kruisig Hom! Pilatus sê vir hulle: Moet ek julle Koning kruisig? Die owerpriesters antwoord: Ons het geen koning behalwe die keiser nie.

kjv_text: Then delivered he him therefore unto them to be crucified. And they took Jesus, and led him away.
bsb_text: Then Pilate handed Jesus over to be crucified, and the soldiers took Him away.
aov_text: Toe het hy Hom dan aan hulle oorgegee om gekruisig te word. En hulle het Jesus geneem en Hom weggelei.

kjv_text: And he bearing his cross went forth into a place called the place of a skull, which is called in the Hebrew Golgotha:
bsb_text: Carrying His own cross, He went out to The Place of the Skull, which in Hebrew is called Golgotha.
aov_text: EN Hy het sy kruis gedra en uitgegaan na die sogenaamde Hoofskedelplek, in Hebreeus Gólgota,

kjv_text: Where they crucified him, and two other with him, on either side one, and Jesus in the midst.
bsb_text: There they crucified Him, and with Him two others, one on each side, with Jesus in the middle.
aov_text: waar hulle Hom gekruisig het en saam met Hom twee ander, een aan elke kant, en Jesus in die middel.

kjv_text: And Pilate wrote a title, and put it on the cross. And the writing was, JESUS OF NAZARETH THE KING OF THE JEWS.
bsb_text: Pilate also had a notice posted on the cross. It read: JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.
aov_text: En Pilatus het ook ’n opskrif geskrywe en dit op die kruis gesit; en daar was geskrywe: JESUS, DIE NASARÉNER, DIE KONING VAN DIE JODE.

kjv_text: This title then read many of the Jews: for the place where Jesus was crucified was nigh to the city: and it was written in Hebrew, and Greek, and Latin.
bsb_text: Many of the Jews read this sign, because the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city, and it was written in Hebrew, Latin, and Greek.
aov_text: Hierdie opskrif dan het baie van die Jode gelees, omdat die plek waar Jesus gekruisig is, naby die stad was; en dit was geskrywe in Hebreeus en Grieks en Latyn.

kjv_text: Then said the chief priests of the Jews to Pilate, Write not, The King of the Jews; but that he said, I am King of the Jews.
bsb_text: So the chief priests of the Jews said to Pilate, “Do not write, ‘The King of the Jews,’ but only that He said, ‘I am the King of the Jews.’”
aov_text: En die owerpriesters van die Jode het vir Pilatus gesê: Moenie skrywe: Die Koning van die Jode nie; maar dat Hy gesê het: Ek is die Koning van die Jode.

kjv_text: Pilate answered, What I have written I have written.
bsb_text: Pilate answered, “What I have written, I have written.”
aov_text: Pilatus het geantwoord: Wat ek geskryf het, het ek geskrywe.

kjv_text: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments, and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also his coat: now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.
bsb_text: When the soldiers had crucified Jesus, they divided His garments into four parts, one for each soldier, with the tunic remaining. It was seamless, woven in one piece from top to bottom.
aov_text: En toe die soldate Jesus gekruisig het, neem hulle sy klere en maak vier dele, vir elke soldaat ’n deel, en die onderkleed; maar die onderkleed was sonder naat, van bo af in een stuk gewewe.

kjv_text: They said therefore among themselves, Let us not rend it, but cast lots for it, whose it shall be: that the scripture might be fulfilled, which saith, They parted my raiment among them, and for my vesture they did cast lots. These things therefore the soldiers did.
bsb_text: So they said to one another, “Let us not tear it. Instead, let us cast lots to see who will get it.” This was to fulfill the Scripture: “They divided My garments among them, and cast lots for My clothing.” So that is what the soldiers did.
aov_text: En hulle het vir mekaar gesê: Laat ons dit nie skeur nie, maar laat ons die lot daaroor werp, wie s’n dit sal wees — sodat die Skrif vervul sou word wat sê: Hulle het my klere onder mekaar verdeel en oor my gewaad het hulle die lot gewerp. Dit het die soldate dan gedoen.

kjv_text: Now there stood by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother's sister, Mary the wife of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene.
bsb_text: Near the cross of Jesus stood His mother and her sister, as well as Mary the wife of Clopas and Mary Magdalene.
aov_text: En by die kruis van Jesus het gestaan sy moeder en sy moeder se suster, Maria, die vrou van Klopas, en Maria Magdaléna.

kjv_text: When Jesus therefore saw his mother, and the disciple standing by, whom he loved, he saith unto his mother, Woman, behold thy son!
bsb_text: When Jesus saw His mother and the disciple whom He loved standing nearby, He said to His mother, “Woman, here is your son.”
aov_text: En toe Jesus sy moeder sien en die dissipel wat Hy liefgehad het, by haar staan, sê Hy vir sy moeder: Vrou, dáár is u seun!

kjv_text: Then saith he to the disciple, Behold thy mother! And from that hour that disciple took her unto his own home.
bsb_text: Then He said to the disciple, “Here is your mother.” So from that hour, this disciple took her into his home.
aov_text: Daarop sê Hy vir die dissipel: Dáár is jou moeder! En van daardie uur af het die dissipel haar in sy huis geneem.

kjv_text: After this, Jesus knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the scripture might be fulfilled, saith, I thirst.
bsb_text: After this, knowing that everything had now been accomplished, and to fulfill the Scripture, Jesus said, “I am thirsty.”
aov_text: Hierna, omdat Hy geweet het dat alles al volbring was — sodat die Skrif vervul sou word — het Jesus gesê: Ek het dors!

kjv_text: Now there was set a vessel full of vinegar: and they filled a spunge with vinegar, and put it upon hyssop, and put it to his mouth.
bsb_text: A jar of sour wine was sitting there. So they soaked a sponge in the wine, put it on a stalk of hyssop, and lifted it to His mouth.
aov_text: En daar het ’n kan vol asyn gestaan; en hulle het ’n spons met asyn gevul en op ’n hisopstingel gesit en aan sy mond gebring.

kjv_text: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.
bsb_text: When Jesus had received the sour wine, He said, “It is finished.” And bowing His head, He yielded up His spirit.
aov_text: En toe Jesus die asyn geneem het, sê Hy: Dit is volbring! En Hy het sy hoof gebuig en die gees gegee.

kjv_text: The Jews therefore, because it was the preparation, that the bodies should not remain upon the cross on the sabbath day, (for that sabbath day was an high day,) besought Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.
bsb_text: It was the day of Preparation, and the next day was a High Sabbath. In order that the bodies would not remain on the cross during the Sabbath, the Jews asked Pilate to have the legs broken and the bodies removed.
aov_text: En dat die liggame nie op die sabbat aan die kruis sou bly nie, aangesien dit die voorbereiding was — want die dag van daardie sabbat was groot — het die Jode Pilatus gevra dat hulle bene gebreek en hulle weggeneem moes word.

kjv_text: Then came the soldiers, and brake the legs of the first, and of the other which was crucified with him.
bsb_text: So the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first man who had been crucified with Jesus, and those of the other.
aov_text: Die soldate het toe gekom en die bene van die eerste een gebreek en van die ander een wat saam met Hom gekruisig was;

kjv_text: But when they came to Jesus, and saw that he was dead already, they brake not his legs:
bsb_text: But when they came to Jesus and saw that He was already dead, they did not break His legs.
aov_text: maar toe hulle by Jesus kom en sien dat Hy al dood was, het hulle sy bene nie gebreek nie.

kjv_text: But one of the soldiers with a spear pierced his side, and forthwith came there out blood and water.
bsb_text: Instead, one of the soldiers pierced His side with a spear, and immediately blood and water flowed out.
aov_text: Maar een van die soldate het met ’n spies in sy sy gesteek, en dadelik het daar bloed en water uitgekom.

kjv_text: And he that saw it bare record, and his record is true: and he knoweth that he saith true, that ye might believe.
bsb_text: The one who saw it has testified to this, and his testimony is true. He knows that he is telling the truth, so that you also may believe.
aov_text: En hy wat dit gesien het, het dit getuig, en sy getuienis is waaragtig; en hy weet dat hy die waarheid spreek, sodat julle kan glo.

kjv_text: For these things were done, that the scripture should be fulfilled, A bone of him shall not be broken.
bsb_text: Now these things happened so that the Scripture would be fulfilled: “Not one of His bones will be broken.”
aov_text: Want hierdie dinge het gebeur, dat die Skrif vervul sou word: Geen been van Hom sal gebreek word nie.

kjv_text: And again another scripture saith, They shall look on him whom they pierced.
bsb_text: And, as another Scripture says: “They will look on the One they have pierced.”
aov_text: En weer sê ’n ander Skrif: Hulle sal sien in wie hulle gesteek het.

kjv_text: And after this Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus: and Pilate gave him leave. He came therefore, and took the body of Jesus.
bsb_text: Afterward, Joseph of Arimathea, who was a disciple of Jesus (but secretly for fear of the Jews), asked Pilate to let him remove the body of Jesus. Pilate gave him permission, so he came and removed His body.
aov_text: EN ná hierdie dinge het Josef van Arimathéa, wat ’n dissipel van Jesus was, maar in die geheim, uit vrees vir die Jode, vir Pilatus gevra of hy die liggaam van Jesus mag wegneem. En Pilatus het dit toegelaat. Hy het toe gegaan en die liggaam van Jesus weggeneem.

kjv_text: And there came also Nicodemus, which at the first came to Jesus by night, and brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about an hundred pound weight.
bsb_text: Nicodemus, who had previously come to Jesus at night, also brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about seventy-five pounds.
aov_text: En Nikodémus, wat die eerste maal in die nag na Jesus gegaan het, het ook gekom met ’n mengsel van mirre en alewee van omtrent honderd pond gewig.

kjv_text: Then took they the body of Jesus, and wound it in linen clothes with the spices, as the manner of the Jews is to bury.
bsb_text: So they took the body of Jesus and wrapped it in linen cloths with the spices, according to the Jewish burial custom.
aov_text: En hulle het die liggaam van Jesus geneem en dit in doeke toegedraai saam met die speserye, soos die gewoonte van die Jode is om te begrawe.

kjv_text: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden; and in the garden a new sepulchre, wherein was never man yet laid.
bsb_text: Now there was a garden in the place where Jesus was crucified, and in the garden a new tomb in which no one had yet been laid.
aov_text: En daar was op die plek waar Hy gekruisig is, ’n tuin, en in die tuin ’n nuwe graf waar nog nooit iemand in neergelê was nie.

kjv_text: There laid they Jesus therefore because of the Jews' preparation day; for the sepulchre was nigh at hand.
bsb_text: And because it was the Jewish day of Preparation and the tomb was nearby, they placed Jesus there.
aov_text: Daar het hulle Jesus toe neergelê weens die voorbereiding van die Jode, omdat die graf naby was.

kjv_text: The first day of the week cometh Mary Magdalene early, when it was yet dark, unto the sepulchre, and seeth the stone taken away from the sepulchre.
bsb_text: Early on the first day of the week, while it was still dark, Mary Magdalene went to the tomb and saw that the stone had been removed from the entrance.
aov_text: EN op die eerste dag van die week kom Maria Magdaléna vroeg, terwyl dit nog donker was, by die graf en sien dat die steen van die graf weggeneem was.

kjv_text: Then she runneth, and cometh to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple, whom Jesus loved, and saith unto them, They have taken away the LORD out of the sepulchre, and we know not where they have laid him.
bsb_text: So she came running to Simon Peter and the other disciple, the one whom Jesus loved. “They have taken the Lord out of the tomb,” she said, “and we do not know where they have put Him!”
aov_text: Sy hardloop toe en kom by Simon Petrus en by die ander dissipel vir wie Jesus liefgehad het, en sê vir hulle: Hulle het die Here uit die graf weggeneem, en ons weet nie waar hulle Hom neergelê het nie.

kjv_text: Peter therefore went forth, and that other disciple, and came to the sepulchre.
bsb_text: Then Peter and the other disciple set out for the tomb.
aov_text: Toe gaan Petrus en die ander dissipel uit en kom by die graf.

kjv_text: So they ran both together: and the other disciple did outrun Peter, and came first to the sepulchre.
bsb_text: The two were running together, but the other disciple outran Peter and reached the tomb first.
aov_text: En die twee het saam gehardloop, en die ander dissipel het vooruit gehardloop, vinniger as Petrus, en eerste by die graf gekom.

kjv_text: And he stooping down, and looking in, saw the linen clothes lying; yet went he not in.
bsb_text: He bent down and looked in at the linen cloths lying there, but he did not go in.
aov_text: En terwyl hy neerbuk, sien hy die doeke lê; maar hy het nie ingegaan nie.

kjv_text: Then cometh Simon Peter following him, and went into the sepulchre, and seeth the linen clothes lie,
bsb_text: Simon Peter arrived just after him. He entered the tomb and saw the linen cloths lying there.
aov_text: Toe kom Simon Petrus agter hom aan en gaan in die graf en sien die doeke lê;

kjv_text: And the napkin, that was about his head, not lying with the linen clothes, but wrapped together in a place by itself.
bsb_text: The cloth that had been around Jesus’ head was rolled up, lying separate from the linen cloths.
aov_text: en die doek wat op sy hoof was, sien hy nie by die doeke lê nie, maar opgerol op een plek afsonderlik.

kjv_text: Then went in also that other disciple, which came first to the sepulchre, and he saw, and believed.
bsb_text: Then the other disciple, who had reached the tomb first, also went in. And he saw and believed.
aov_text: Daarop het ook die ander dissipel wat eerste by die graf gekom het, ingegaan, en hy het gesien en geglo.

kjv_text: For as yet they knew not the scripture, that he must rise again from the dead.
bsb_text: For they still did not understand from the Scripture that Jesus had to rise from the dead.
aov_text: Want hulle het nog nie die Skrif verstaan dat Hy uit die dode moes opstaan nie.

kjv_text: Then the disciples went away again unto their own home.
bsb_text: Then the disciples returned to their homes.
aov_text: En die dissipels het weer huis toe gegaan.

kjv_text: But Mary stood without at the sepulchre weeping: and as she wept, she stooped down, and looked into the sepulchre,
bsb_text: But Mary stood outside the tomb weeping. And as she wept, she bent down to look into the tomb,
aov_text: MAAR Maria het buitekant by die graf gestaan en ween; en terwyl sy ween, buk sy na die graf toe

kjv_text: And seeth two angels in white sitting, the one at the head, and the other at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.
bsb_text: and she saw two angels in white sitting where the body of Jesus had lain, one at the head and the other at the feet.
aov_text: en sien twee engele daar sit met wit klere aan, een by die hoof en een by die voete waar die liggaam van Jesus gelê het.

kjv_text: And they say unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? She saith unto them, Because they have taken away my LORD, and I know not where they have laid him.
bsb_text: “Woman, why are you weeping?” they asked. “Because they have taken my Lord away,” she said, “and I do not know where they have put Him.”
aov_text: En hulle sê vir haar: Vrou, waarom ween jy? Sy antwoord hulle: Omdat hulle my Here weggeneem het, en ek weet nie waar hulle Hom neergelê het nie.

kjv_text: And when she had thus said, she turned herself back, and saw Jesus standing, and knew not that it was Jesus.
bsb_text: When she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing there; but she did not recognize that it was Jesus.
aov_text: En toe sy dit gesê het, draai sy haar om agtertoe en sien Jesus staan, en sy het nie geweet dat dit Jesus was nie.

kjv_text: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? whom seekest thou? She, supposing him to be the gardener, saith unto him, Sir, if thou have borne him hence, tell me where thou hast laid him, and I will take him away.
bsb_text: “Woman, why are you weeping?” Jesus asked. “Whom are you seeking?” Thinking He was the gardener, she said, “Sir, if you have carried Him off, tell me where you have put Him, and I will get Him.”
aov_text: Jesus sê vir haar: Vrou, waarom ween jy? Wie soek jy? Sy het gedink dat dit die tuinier was en antwoord hom: Meneer, as u Hom weggedra het, sê vir my waar u Hom neergelê het, en ek sal Hom wegneem.

kjv_text: Jesus saith unto her, Mary. She turned herself, and saith unto him, Rabboni; which is to say, Master.
bsb_text: Jesus said to her, “Mary.” She turned and said to Him in Hebrew, “Rabboni!” (which means “Teacher”).
aov_text: Jesus sê vir haar: Maria! Sy draai haar om en sê vir Hom: Rabboeni! dit beteken Meester.

kjv_text: Jesus saith unto her, Touch me not; for I am not yet ascended to my Father: but go to my brethren, and say unto them, I ascend unto my Father, and your Father; and to my God, and your God.
bsb_text: “Do not cling to Me,” Jesus said, “for I have not yet ascended to the Father. But go and tell My brothers, ‘I am ascending to My Father and your Father, to My God and your God.’”
aov_text: Jesus sê vir haar: Raak My nie aan nie, want Ek het nog nie opgevaar na my Vader nie; maar gaan na my broeders en sê vir hulle: Ek vaar op na my Vader en julle Vader, en my God en julle God.

kjv_text: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the LORD, and that he had spoken these things unto her.
bsb_text: Mary Magdalene went and announced to the disciples, “I have seen the Lord!” And she told them what He had said to her.
aov_text: Maria Magdaléna het aan die dissipels gaan vertel dat sy die Here gesien het en dat Hy dit vir haar gesê het.

kjv_text: Then the same day at evening, being the first day of the week, when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled for fear of the Jews, came Jesus and stood in the midst, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.
bsb_text: It was the first day of the week, and that very evening, while the disciples were together with the doors locked for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood among them. “Peace be with you!” He said to them.
aov_text: EN toe dit aand was op daardie eerste dag van die week en die deure waar die dissipels vergader het uit vrees vir die Jode, gesluit was, het Jesus gekom en in hul midde gestaan en aan hulle gesê: Vrede vir julle!

kjv_text: And when he had so said, he shewed unto them his hands and his side. Then were the disciples glad, when they saw the LORD.
bsb_text: After He had said this, He showed them His hands and His side. The disciples rejoiced when they saw the Lord.
aov_text: En nadat Hy dit gesê het, wys Hy hulle sy hande en sy sy. En die dissipels was bly toe hulle die Here sien.

kjv_text: Then said Jesus to them again, Peace be unto you: as my Father hath sent me, even so send I you.
bsb_text: Again Jesus said to them, “Peace be with you. As the Father has sent Me, so also I am sending you.”
aov_text: Jesus sê toe weer vir hulle: Vrede vir julle! Soos die Vader My gestuur het, stuur Ek julle ook.

kjv_text: And when he had said this, he breathed on them, and saith unto them, Receive ye the Holy Ghost:
bsb_text: When He had said this, He breathed on them and said, “Receive the Holy Spirit.
aov_text: En nadat Hy dit gesê het, blaas Hy op hulle en sê vir hulle: Ontvang die Heilige Gees.

kjv_text: Whose soever sins ye remit, they are remitted unto them; and whose soever sins ye retain, they are retained.
bsb_text: If you forgive anyone his sins, they are forgiven; if you withhold forgiveness from anyone, it is withheld.”
aov_text: As julle die mense hulle sondes vergewe, dan word dit hulle vergewe; as julle die mense hulle sondes hou, dan is dit gehou.

kjv_text: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came.
bsb_text: Now Thomas called Didymus, one of the Twelve, was not with the disciples when Jesus came.
aov_text: En Thomas wat genoem word Dídimus, een van die twaalf, was nie saam met hulle toe Jesus gekom het nie.

kjv_text: The other disciples therefore said unto him, We have seen the LORD. But he said unto them, Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and thrust my hand into his side, I will not believe.
bsb_text: So the other disciples told him, “We have seen the Lord!” But he replied, “Unless I see the nail marks in His hands, and put my finger where the nails have been, and put my hand into His side, I will never believe.”
aov_text: Die ander dissipels sê toe vir hom: Ons het die Here gesien! Maar hy het vir hulle gesê: As ek nie in sy hande die merk van die spykers sien en my vinger steek in die merk van die spykers en my hand in sy sy steek nie, sal ek nooit glo nie.

kjv_text: And after eight days again his disciples were within, and Thomas with them: then came Jesus, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst, and said, Peace be unto you.
bsb_text: Eight days later, His disciples were once again inside with the doors locked, and Thomas was with them. Jesus came and stood among them and said, “Peace be with you.”
aov_text: En agt dae daarna was sy dissipels weer binne, en Thomas saam met hulle. En Jesus het gekom terwyl die deure gesluit was, en het in hul midde gestaan en gesê: Vrede vir julle!

kjv_text: Then saith he to Thomas, Reach hither thy finger, and behold my hands; and reach hither thy hand, and thrust it into my side: and be not faithless, but believing.
bsb_text: Then Jesus said to Thomas, “Put your finger here and look at My hands. Reach out your hand and put it into My side. Stop doubting and believe.”
aov_text: Daarna sê Hy vir Thomas: Bring jou vinger hier, en kyk na my hande; en bring jou hand en steek dit in my sy; en moenie ongelowig wees nie, maar gelowig.

kjv_text: And Thomas answered and said unto him, My LORD and my God.
bsb_text: Thomas replied, “My Lord and my God!”
aov_text: En Thomas antwoord en sê vir Hom: My Here en my God!

kjv_text: Jesus saith unto him, Thomas, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.
bsb_text: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen Me, you have believed; blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed.”
aov_text: Jesus sê vir hom: Omdat jy My gesien het, Thomas, het jy geglo; salig is die wat nie gesien het nie en tog geglo het.

kjv_text: And many other signs truly did Jesus in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book:
bsb_text: Jesus performed many other signs in the presence of His disciples, which are not written in this book.
aov_text: Nog baie ander tekens het Jesus voor sy dissipels gedoen wat in hierdie boek nie beskrywe is nie;

kjv_text: But these are written, that ye might believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye might have life through his name.
bsb_text: But these are written so that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that by believing you may have life in His name.
aov_text: maar hierdie is beskrywe, dat julle kan glo dat Jesus die Christus is, die Seun van God; en dat julle deur te glo die lewe kan hê in sy Naam.

kjv_text: After these things Jesus shewed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias; and on this wise shewed he himself.
bsb_text: Later, by the Sea of Tiberias, Jesus again revealed Himself to the disciples. He made Himself known in this way:
aov_text: NA hierdie dinge het Jesus weer aan sy dissipels verskyn by die see van Tibérias, en Hy het só verskyn:

kjv_text: There were together Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two other of his disciples.
bsb_text: Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus, Nathanael from Cana in Galilee, the sons of Zebedee, and two other disciples were together.
aov_text: Daar was bymekaar Simon Petrus en Thomas wat Dídimus genoem word, en Natánael van Kana in Galiléa en die seuns van Sebedéüs en twee ander van sy dissipels.

kjv_text: Simon Peter saith unto them, I go a fishing. They say unto him, We also go with thee. They went forth, and entered into a ship immediately; and that night they caught nothing.
bsb_text: Simon Peter told them, “I am going fishing.” “We will go with you,” they said. So they went out and got into the boat, but caught nothing that night.
aov_text: Simon Petrus sê vir hulle: Ek gaan visvang. Hulle sê vir hom: Ons gaan ook saam met jou. En hulle het uitgegaan en dadelik in die skuit geklim, en in daardie nag het hulle niks gevang nie.

kjv_text: But when the morning was now come, Jesus stood on the shore: but the disciples knew not that it was Jesus.
bsb_text: Early in the morning, Jesus stood on the shore, but the disciples did not recognize that it was Jesus.
aov_text: En toe dit al dag geword het, staan Jesus op die strand; maar die dissipels het nie geweet dat dit Jesus was nie.

kjv_text: Then Jesus saith unto them, Children, have ye any meat? They answered him, No.
bsb_text: So He called out to them, “Children, do you have any fish?” “No,” they answered.
aov_text: En Jesus sê vir hulle: My kinders, het julle nie iets om te eet nie? Hulle antwoord Hom: Nee.

kjv_text: And he said unto them, Cast the net on the right side of the ship, and ye shall find. They cast therefore, and now they were not able to draw it for the multitude of fishes.
bsb_text: He told them, “Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some.” So they cast it there, and they were unable to haul it in because of the great number of fish.
aov_text: En Hy sê vir hulle: Gooi die net aan die regterkant van die skuit, en julle sal kry. Hulle het toe gegooi en deur die menigte van visse was hulle nie meer in staat om dit te trek nie.

kjv_text: Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved saith unto Peter, It is the Lord. Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he girt his fisher's coat unto him, (for he was naked,) and did cast himself into the sea.
bsb_text: Then the disciple whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It is the Lord!” As soon as Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he put on his outer garment (for he had removed it) and jumped into the sea.
aov_text: Daarop sê die dissipel — die een vir wie Jesus liefgehad het — aan Petrus: Dit is die Here! En toe Simon Petrus hoor dat dit die Here is, gord hy sy bo-kleed om — want hy was naak — en werp homself in die see.

kjv_text: And the other disciples came in a little ship; (for they were not far from land, but as it were two hundred cubits,) dragging the net with fishes.
bsb_text: The other disciples came ashore in the boat. They dragged in the net full of fish, for they were not far from land, only about a hundred yards.
aov_text: Maar die ander dissipels het met die skuitjie gekom en die net met die visse gesleep; want hulle was nie ver van die land nie, maar omtrent tweehonderd el.

kjv_text: As soon then as they were come to land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid thereon, and bread.
bsb_text: When they landed, they saw a charcoal fire there with fish on it, and some bread.
aov_text: En toe hulle geland het, sien hulle ’n koolvuur op die grond en vis daarop lê, en brood.

kjv_text: Jesus saith unto them, Bring of the fish which ye have now caught.
bsb_text: Jesus told them, “Bring some of the fish you have just caught.”
aov_text: Jesus sê vir hulle: Bring van die visse wat julle nou gevang het.

kjv_text: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land full of great fishes, an hundred and fifty and three: and for all there were so many, yet was not the net broken.
bsb_text: So Simon Peter went aboard and dragged the net ashore. It was full of large fish, 153, but even with so many, the net was not torn.
aov_text: Simon Petrus het in die skuit geklim en die net op die land getrek, vol groot visse, honderd-drie-en-vyftig in getal; en alhoewel daar so baie was, het die net nie geskeur nie.

kjv_text: Jesus saith unto them, Come and dine. And none of the disciples durst ask him, Who art thou? knowing that it was the Lord.
bsb_text: “Come, have breakfast,” Jesus said to them. None of the disciples dared to ask Him, “Who are You?” They knew it was the Lord.
aov_text: Jesus sê vir hulle: Kom eet! En niemand van die dissipels het gewaag om Hom te vra: Wie is U nie? omdat hulle wis dat dit die Here was.

kjv_text: Jesus then cometh, and taketh bread, and giveth them, and fish likewise.
bsb_text: Jesus came and took the bread and gave it to them, and He did the same with the fish.
aov_text: En Jesus het gekom en die brood geneem en dit aan hulle gegee, en so ook die vis.

kjv_text: This is now the third time that Jesus shewed himself to his disciples, after that he was risen from the dead.
bsb_text: This was now the third time that Jesus appeared to the disciples after He was raised from the dead.
aov_text: Dit was al die derde keer dat Jesus aan sy dissipels verskyn het nadat Hy opgestaan het uit die dode.

kjv_text: So when they had dined, Jesus saith to Simon Peter, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me more than these? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my lambs.
bsb_text: When they had finished eating, Jesus asked Simon Peter, “Simon son of John, do you love Me more than these?” “Yes, Lord,” he answered, “You know I love You.” Jesus replied, “Feed My lambs.”
aov_text: Toe hulle dan klaar was met die môre-ete, vra Jesus vir Simon Petrus: Simon, seun van Jona, het jy My waarlik lief, meer as hulle hier? Hy antwoord Hom: Ja, Here, U weet dat ek U liefhet. Hy sê vir hom: Laat my lammers wei.

kjv_text: He saith to him again the second time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my sheep.
bsb_text: Jesus asked a second time, “Simon son of John, do you love Me?” “Yes, Lord,” he answered, “You know I love You.” Jesus told him, “Shepherd My sheep.”
aov_text: Hy vra hom weer die tweede maal: Simon, seun van Jona, het jy My waarlik lief? Hy antwoord Hom: Ja, Here, U weet dat ek U liefhet. Hy sê vir hom: Pas my skape op.

kjv_text: He saith unto him the third time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Lovest thou me? And he said unto him, Lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee. Jesus saith unto him, Feed my sheep.
bsb_text: Jesus asked a third time, “Simon son of John, do you love Me?” Peter was deeply hurt that Jesus had asked him a third time, “Do you love Me?” “Lord, You know all things,” he replied. “You know I love You.” Jesus said to him, “Feed My sheep.
aov_text: Hy vra hom die derde maal: Simon, seun van Jona, het jy My lief? Petrus het bedroef geword, omdat Hy hom die derde maal vra: Het jy My lief? En hy antwoord Hom: Here, U weet alles, U weet dat ek U liefhet. Jesus sê vir hom: Laat my skape wei.

kjv_text: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, When thou wast young, thou girdedst thyself, and walkedst whither thou wouldest: but when thou shalt be old, thou shalt stretch forth thy hands, and another shall gird thee, and carry thee whither thou wouldest not.
bsb_text: Truly, truly, I tell you, when you were young, you dressed yourself and walked where you wanted; but when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and someone else will dress you and lead you where you do not want to go.”
aov_text: Voorwaar, voorwaar Ek sê vir jou, toe jy jonger was, het jy jouself gegord en rondgegaan waar jy wou; maar wanneer jy oud geword het, sal jy jou hande uitsteek, en ’n ander een sal jou gord en bring waar jy nie wil wees nie.

kjv_text: This spake he, signifying by what death he should glorify God. And when he had spoken this, he saith unto him, Follow me.
bsb_text: Jesus said this to indicate the kind of death by which Peter would glorify God. And after He had said this, He told him, “Follow Me.”
aov_text: En dit het Hy gesê om aan te dui deur hoedanige dood hy God sou verheerlik; en toe Hy dit gespreek het, sê Hy vir hom: Volg My.

kjv_text: Then Peter, turning about, seeth the disciple whom Jesus loved following; which also leaned on his breast at supper, and said, Lord, which is he that betrayeth thee?
bsb_text: Peter turned and saw the disciple whom Jesus loved following them. He was the one who had leaned back against Jesus at the supper to ask, “Lord, who is going to betray You?”
aov_text: En Petrus het hom omgedraai en die dissipel sien volg vir wie Jesus liefgehad het, die een wat by die maaltyd op sy bors geval en gesê het: Here, wie is u verraaier?

kjv_text: Peter seeing him saith to Jesus, Lord, and what shall this man do?
bsb_text: When Peter saw him, he asked, “Lord, what about him?”
aov_text: Toe Petrus hom sien, vra hy vir Jesus: Here, maar wat van hom?

kjv_text: Jesus saith unto him, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee? follow thou me.
bsb_text: Jesus answered, “If I want him to remain until I return, what is that to you? You follow Me!”
aov_text: Jesus antwoord hom: As Ek wil hê dat hy bly totdat Ek kom, wat gaan dit jou aan? Volg jy My.

kjv_text: Then went this saying abroad among the brethren, that that disciple should not die: yet Jesus said not unto him, He shall not die; but, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee?
bsb_text: Because of this, the rumor spread among the brothers that this disciple would not die. However, Jesus did not say that he would not die, but only, “If I want him to remain until I return, what is that to you?”
aov_text: Hierdie woord het toe onder die broeders uitgegaan dat daardie dissipel nie sou sterwe nie; en Jesus het nie vir hom gesê dat hy nie sou sterwe nie, maar: As Ek wil hê dat hy bly totdat Ek kom, wat gaan dit jou aan?

kjv_text: This is the disciple which testifieth of these things, and wrote these things: and we know that his testimony is true.
bsb_text: This is the disciple who testifies to these things and who has written them down. And we know that his testimony is true.
aov_text: Dit is daardie dissipel wat van hierdie dinge getuig en hierdie dinge geskryf het, en ons weet dat sy getuienis waar is.

kjv_text: And there are also many other things which Jesus did, the which, if they should be written every one, I suppose that even the world itself could not contain the books that should be written. Amen.
bsb_text: There are many more things that Jesus did. If all of them were written down, I suppose that not even the world itself would have space for the books that would be written.
aov_text: En daar is nog baie ander dinge wat Jesus alles gedoen het; maar as hulle een vir een beskrywe moes word, sou die wêreld self, dink ek, die geskrewe boeke nie bevat nie. Amen.

kjv_text: The former treatise have I made, O Theophilus, of all that Jesus began both to do and teach,
bsb_text: In my first book, O Theophilus, I wrote about all that Jesus began to do and to teach,
aov_text: DIE eerste verhaal, Theófilus, het ek opgestel oor alles wat Jesus begin doen en leer het

kjv_text: Until the day in which he was taken up, after that he through the Holy Ghost had given commandments unto the apostles whom he had chosen:
bsb_text: until the day He was taken up to heaven, after giving instructions through the Holy Spirit to the apostles He had chosen.
aov_text: tot op die dag dat Hy opgeneem is, nadat Hy aan die apostels wat Hy uitverkies het, deur die Heilige Gees bevele gegee het;

kjv_text: To whom also he shewed himself alive after his passion by many infallible proofs, being seen of them forty days, and speaking of the things pertaining to the kingdom of God:
bsb_text: After His suffering, He presented Himself to them with many convincing proofs that He was alive. He appeared to them over a span of forty days and spoke about the kingdom of God.
aov_text: aan wie Hy ook, ná sy lyde, Hom lewend vertoon het deur baie kentekens, terwyl Hy gedurende veertig dae aan hulle verskyn het en oor die dinge van die koninkryk van God gespreek het.

kjv_text: And, being assembled together with them, commanded them that they should not depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which, saith he, ye have heard of me.
bsb_text: And while they were gathered together, He commanded them: “Do not leave Jerusalem, but wait for the gift the Father promised, which you have heard Me discuss.
aov_text: En toe Hy nog met hulle saam was, het Hy hulle bevel gegee om nie van Jerusalem weg te gaan nie, maar om te wag op die belofte van die Vader, wat julle, het Hy gesê, van My gehoor het.

kjv_text: For John truly baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost not many days hence.
bsb_text: For John baptized with water, but in a few days you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.”
aov_text: Want Johannes het wel met water gedoop, maar julle sal met die Heilige Gees gedoop word nie lank ná hierdie dae nie.

kjv_text: When they therefore were come together, they asked of him, saying, Lord, wilt thou at this time restore again the kingdom to Israel?
bsb_text: So when they came together, they asked Him, “Lord, will You at this time restore the kingdom to Israel?”
aov_text: Die wat bymekaargekom het, vra Hom toe en sê: Here, gaan U in hierdie tyd die koninkryk vir Israel weer oprig?

kjv_text: And he said unto them, It is not for you to know the times or the seasons, which the Father hath put in his own power.
bsb_text: Jesus replied, “It is not for you to know times or seasons that the Father has fixed by His own authority.
aov_text: En Hy antwoord hulle: Dit kom julle nie toe om die tye of geleenthede te weet wat die Vader deur sy eie mag bepaal het nie;

kjv_text: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
bsb_text: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes upon you, and you will be My witnesses in Jerusalem, and in all Judea and Samaria, and to the ends of the earth.”
aov_text: maar julle sal krag ontvang wanneer die Heilige Gees oor julle kom, en julle sal my getuies wees in Jerusalem sowel as in die hele Judéa en Samaría en tot aan die uiterste van die aarde.

kjv_text: And when he had spoken these things, while they beheld, he was taken up; and a cloud received him out of their sight.
bsb_text: After He had said this, they watched as He was taken up, and a cloud hid Him from their sight.
aov_text: En nadat Hy dit gesê het, is Hy opgeneem terwyl hulle dit sien; en ’n wolk het Hom voor hulle oë weggeneem.

kjv_text: And while they looked stedfastly toward heaven as he went up, behold, two men stood by them in white apparel;
bsb_text: They were looking intently into the sky as He was going, when suddenly two men dressed in white stood beside them.
aov_text: En toe hulle nog stip na die hemel kyk terwyl Hy weggaan, staan daar twee manne in wit klere by hulle,

kjv_text: Which also said, Ye men of Galilee, why stand ye gazing up into heaven? this same Jesus, which is taken up from you into heaven, shall so come in like manner as ye have seen him go into heaven.
bsb_text: “Men of Galilee,” they said, “why do you stand here looking into the sky? This same Jesus, who has been taken from you into heaven, will come back in the same way you have seen Him go into heaven.”
aov_text: wat sê: Galilése manne, waarom staan julle en kyk na die hemel? Hierdie Jesus wat van julle opgeneem is in die hemel, sal net so kom soos julle Hom na die hemel sien wegvaar het.

kjv_text: Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet, which is from Jerusalem a sabbath day's journey.
bsb_text: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the Mount of Olives, which is near the city, a Sabbath day’s journey away.
aov_text: Daarop draai hulle om na Jerusalem van die berg af wat genoem word Olyfberg, wat naby Jerusalem is, ’n sabbatsreis ver.

kjv_text: And when they were come in, they went up into an upper room, where abode both Peter, and James, and John, and Andrew, Philip, and Thomas, Bartholomew, and Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon Zelotes, and Judas the brother of James.
bsb_text: When they arrived, they went to the upper room where they were staying: Peter and John, James and Andrew, Philip and Thomas, Bartholomew and Matthew, James son of Alphaeus, Simon the Zealot, and Judas son of James.
aov_text: En toe hulle daar kom, gaan hulle na die bovertrek waar hulle gewoond was om te vertoef, naamlik: Petrus en Jakobus en Johannes en Andréas, Filippus en Thomas, Bartholoméüs en Matthéüs, Jakobus, die seun van Alféüs, en Simon, die Yweraar, en Judas, die seun van Jakobus.

kjv_text: These all continued with one accord in prayer and supplication, with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brethren.
bsb_text: With one accord they all continued in prayer, along with the women and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with His brothers.
aov_text: Hulle almal het eendragtig volhard in gebed en smeking, saam met ’n aantal vroue en Maria, die moeder van Jesus, en met sy broers.

kjv_text: And in those days Peter stood up in the midst of the disciples, and said, (the number of names together were about an hundred and twenty,)
bsb_text: In those days Peter stood up among the brothers (a gathering of about a hundred and twenty) and said,
aov_text: EN in dié dae het Petrus in die midde van die dissipels opgestaan — die skare van persone daar bymekaar was omtrent honderd-en-twintig — en gesê:

kjv_text: Men and brethren, this scripture must needs have been fulfilled, which the Holy Ghost by the mouth of David spake before concerning Judas, which was guide to them that took Jesus.
bsb_text: “Brothers, the Scripture had to be fulfilled which the Holy Spirit foretold through the mouth of David concerning Judas, who became a guide for those who arrested Jesus.
aov_text: Broeders, hierdie Skrif moes vervul word wat die Heilige Gees voorspel het deur die mond van Dawid aangaande Judas wat die leier was van die wat Jesus gevange geneem het;

kjv_text: For he was numbered with us, and had obtained part of this ministry.
bsb_text: He was one of our number and shared in this ministry.”
aov_text: want hy is saam met ons getal gereken en het die lot van hierdie bediening verkry.

kjv_text: Now this man purchased a field with the reward of iniquity; and falling headlong, he burst asunder in the midst, and all his bowels gushed out.
bsb_text: (Now with the reward for his wickedness Judas bought a field; there he fell headlong and burst open in the middle, and all his intestines spilled out.
aov_text: Hy het dan ’n stuk grond gekoop met die loon van ongeregtigheid en het vooroor geval en oopgebars, en al sy ingewande het uitgestort;

kjv_text: And it was known unto all the dwellers at Jerusalem; insomuch as that field is called in their proper tongue, Aceldama, that is to say, The field of blood.
bsb_text: This became known to all who lived in Jerusalem, so they called that field in their own language Akeldama, that is, Field of Blood.)
aov_text: en dit het bekend geword aan al die inwoners van Jerusalem, sodat daardie stuk grond in hulle eie taal Akeldáma genoem is, dit is Bloedgrond.

kjv_text: For it is written in the book of Psalms, Let his habitation be desolate, and let no man dwell therein: and his bishoprick let another take.
bsb_text: “For it is written in the book of Psalms: ‘May his place be deserted; let there be no one to dwell in it,’ and, ‘May another take his position.’
aov_text: Want daar staan geskrywe in die boek van die Psalms: Laat sy woonplek woes word, en laat daar geen inwoner in wees nie! En: Laat ’n ander een sy opsienersamp neem.

kjv_text: Wherefore of these men which have companied with us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,
bsb_text: Therefore it is necessary to choose one of the men who have accompanied us the whole time the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,
aov_text: Van die manne dan wat saam met ons rondgegaan het al die tyd waarin die Here Jesus by ons in- en uitgegaan het,

kjv_text: Beginning from the baptism of John, unto that same day that he was taken up from us, must one be ordained to be a witness with us of his resurrection.
bsb_text: beginning from John’s baptism until the day Jesus was taken up from us. For one of these must become a witness with us of His resurrection.”
aov_text: van die doop van Johannes af tot op die dag dat Hy van ons opgeneem is — van hulle moet daar een saam met ons getuie word van sy opstanding.

kjv_text: And they appointed two, Joseph called Barsabas, who was surnamed Justus, and Matthias.
bsb_text: So they proposed two men: Joseph called Barsabbas (also known as Justus) and Matthias.
aov_text: En hulle het twee voorgestel: Josef wat genoem is Bársabas, met die bynaam van Justus, en Matthías.

kjv_text: And they prayed, and said, Thou, Lord, which knowest the hearts of all men, shew whether of these two thou hast chosen,
bsb_text: And they prayed, “Lord, You know everyone’s heart. Show us which of these two You have chosen
aov_text: En hulle het gebid en gesê: U, Here, wat die harte van almal ken, wys uit hierdie twee die een aan wat U uitverkies het

kjv_text: That he may take part of this ministry and apostleship, from which Judas by transgression fell, that he might go to his own place.
bsb_text: to take up this ministry and apostleship, which Judas abandoned to go to his rightful place.”
aov_text: om die lot van hierdie bediening en apostelskap te verkry, waarvan Judas afgewyk het om heen te gaan na sy eie plek.

kjv_text: And they gave forth their lots; and the lot fell upon Matthias; and he was numbered with the eleven apostles.
bsb_text: Then they cast lots, and the lot fell to Matthias; so he was added to the eleven apostles.
aov_text: Toe werp hulle die lot, en die lot het op Matthías geval; en hy is gekies om saam met die elf apostels te wees.

kjv_text: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place.
bsb_text: When the day of Pentecost came, they were all together in one place.
aov_text: EN toe die dag van die pinksterfees aangebreek het, was hulle almal eendragtig bymekaar.

kjv_text: And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.
bsb_text: Suddenly a sound like a mighty rushing wind came from heaven and filled the whole house where they were sitting.
aov_text: En daar kom skielik uit die hemel ’n geluid soos van ’n geweldige rukwind, en dit het die hele huis gevul waar hulle gesit het.

kjv_text: And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire, and it sat upon each of them.
bsb_text: They saw tongues like flames of fire that separated and came to rest on each of them.
aov_text: Toe is deur hulle tonge gesien soos van vuur, wat hulleself verdeel en op elkeen van hulle gaan sit.

kjv_text: And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.
bsb_text: And they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak in other tongues as the Spirit enabled them.
aov_text: En hulle is almal vervul met die Heilige Gees en het begin spreek in ander tale, soos die Gees aan hulle gegee het om uit te spreek.

kjv_text: And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, devout men, out of every nation under heaven.
bsb_text: Now there were dwelling in Jerusalem God-fearing Jews from every nation under heaven.
aov_text: En daar het in Jerusalem Jode gewoon, godsdienstige manne, uit elke nasie wat onder die hemel is.

kjv_text: Now when this was noised abroad, the multitude came together, and were confounded, because that every man heard them speak in his own language.
bsb_text: And when this sound rang out, a crowd came together in bewilderment, because each one heard them speaking his own language.
aov_text: En toe hierdie geluid kom, het die menigte saamgestroom en was in die war, want elkeen het gehoor hoe hulle in sy eie taal spreek;

kjv_text: And they were all amazed and marvelled, saying one to another, Behold, are not all these which speak Galilaeans?
bsb_text: Astounded and amazed, they asked, “Are not all these men who are speaking Galileans?
aov_text: en hulle was almal verbaas en verwonderd en sê vir mekaar: Is almal wat daar spreek, dan nie Galileërs nie?

kjv_text: And how hear we every man in our own tongue, wherein we were born?
bsb_text: How is it then that each of us hears them in his own native language?
aov_text: En hoe hoor ons hulle, elkeen in ons eie taal waarin ons gebore is?

kjv_text: Parthians, and Medes, and Elamites, and the dwellers in Mesopotamia, and in Judaea, and Cappadocia, in Pontus, and Asia,
bsb_text: Parthians, Medes, and Elamites; residents of Mesopotamia, Judea and Cappadocia, Pontus and Asia,
aov_text: Parthers en Meders en Elamiete en die inwoners van Mesopotámië, Judéa en Kappadócië, Pontus en Asië,

kjv_text: Phrygia, and Pamphylia, in Egypt, and in the parts of Libya about Cyrene, and strangers of Rome,
bsb_text: Phrygia and Pamphylia, Egypt and the parts of Libya near Cyrene; visitors from Rome,
