aov_text: Frígië en Pamfílië, Egipte en die streke van Líbië by Ciréne, en Romeine wat hier vertoef,

kjv_text: Jews and proselytes,
bsb_text: both Jews and converts to Judaism;
aov_text: Jode en Jodegenote,

kjv_text: Cretes and Arabians, we do hear them speak in our tongues the wonderful works of God.
bsb_text: Cretans and Arabs—we hear them declaring the wonders of God in our own tongues!”
aov_text: Kretense en Arabiere — ons hoor hulle in ons eie taal oor die groot dade van God spreek.

kjv_text: And they were all amazed, and were in doubt, saying one to another, What meaneth this?
bsb_text: Astounded and perplexed, they asked one another, “What does this mean?”
aov_text: En hulle was almal verbaas en radeloos en sê die een vir die ander: Wat kan dit tog wees?

kjv_text: Others mocking said, These men are full of new wine.
bsb_text: But others mocked them and said, “They are drunk on new wine!”
aov_text: Maar ander het gespot en gesê: Hulle is vol soetwyn.

kjv_text: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice, and said unto them, Ye men of Judaea, and all ye that dwell at Jerusalem, be this known unto you, and hearken to my words:
bsb_text: Then Peter stood up with the Eleven, lifted up his voice, and addressed the crowd: “Men of Judea and all who dwell in Jerusalem, let this be known to you, and listen carefully to my words.
aov_text: MAAR Petrus het opgestaan met die elf en sy stem verhef en hulle toegespreek: Joodse manne en almal wat in Jerusalem woon, dit moet julle weet, en luister na my woorde.

kjv_text: For these are not drunken, as ye suppose, seeing it is but the third hour of the day.
bsb_text: These men are not drunk, as you suppose. It is only the third hour of the day!
aov_text: Hierdie mense is tog nie dronk soos julle dink nie, want dit is nog maar die derde uur in die môre.

kjv_text: But this is that which was spoken by the prophet Joel;
bsb_text: No, this is what was spoken by the prophet Joel:
aov_text: Maar dit is wat deur die profeet Joël gespreek is:

kjv_text: And it shall come to pass in the last days, saith God, I will pour out of my Spirit upon all flesh: and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, and your young men shall see visions, and your old men shall dream dreams:
bsb_text: ‘In the last days, God says, I will pour out My Spirit on all people. Your sons and daughters will prophesy, your young men will see visions, your old men will dream dreams.
aov_text: En in die laaste dae, spreek God, sal Ek van my Gees uitstort op alle vlees, en julle seuns en julle dogters sal profeteer, en julle jongelinge sal gesigte sien, en julle ou mense sal drome droom.

kjv_text: And on my servants and on my handmaidens I will pour out in those days of my Spirit; and they shall prophesy:
bsb_text: Even on My menservants and maidservants I will pour out My Spirit in those days, and they will prophesy.
aov_text: En ook op my diensknegte en diensmaagde sal Ek in dié dae van my Gees uitstort, en hulle sal profeteer.

kjv_text: And I will shew wonders in heaven above, and signs in the earth beneath; blood, and fire, and vapour of smoke:
bsb_text: I will show wonders in the heavens above and signs on the earth below, blood and fire and billows of smoke.
aov_text: En Ek sal wonders gee bo in die hemel en tekens onder op die aarde, bloed en vuur en rookdamp.

kjv_text: The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before that great and notable day of the Lord come:
bsb_text: The sun will be turned to darkness, and the moon to blood, before the coming of the great and glorious Day of the Lord.
aov_text: Die son sal verander in duisternis en die maan in bloed voordat die groot en deurlugtige dag van die Here kom.

kjv_text: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be saved.
bsb_text: And everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.’
aov_text: En elkeen wat die Naam van die Here aanroep, sal gered word.

kjv_text: Ye men of Israel, hear these words; Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved of God among you by miracles and wonders and signs, which God did by him in the midst of you, as ye yourselves also know:
bsb_text: Men of Israel, listen to this message: Jesus of Nazareth was a man certified by God to you by miracles, wonders, and signs, which God did among you through Him, as you yourselves know.
aov_text: Israeliete, luister na hierdie woorde! Jesus, die Nasaréner, ’n man deur God vir julle aangewys met kragte en wonders en tekens wat God deur Hom onder julle gedoen het, soos julle ook self weet  —

kjv_text: Him, being delivered by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge of God, ye have taken, and by wicked hands have crucified and slain:
bsb_text: He was delivered up by God’s set plan and foreknowledge, and you, by the hands of the lawless, put Him to death by nailing Him to the cross.
aov_text: Hom, wat deur die bepaalde raad en voorkennis van God oorgelewer is, het julle deur die hande van goddelose manne geneem en gekruisig en omgebring;

kjv_text: Whom God hath raised up, having loosed the pains of death: because it was not possible that he should be holden of it.
bsb_text: But God raised Him from the dead, releasing Him from the agony of death, because it was impossible for Him to be held in its clutches.
aov_text: Hom het God opgewek, nadat Hy die smarte van die dood ontbind het, omdat dit onmoontlik was dat Hy daardeur vasgehou sou word.

kjv_text: For David speaketh concerning him, I foresaw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved:
bsb_text: David says about Him: ‘I saw the Lord always before me; because He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
aov_text: Want Dawid sê van Hom: Ek het die Here altyddeur voor My gesien, want Hy is aan my regterhand, dat Ek nie sou wankel nie.

kjv_text: Therefore did my heart rejoice, and my tongue was glad; moreover also my flesh shall rest in hope:
bsb_text: Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices; my body also will dwell in hope,
aov_text: Daarom is my hart bly en my tong juig, ja, ook sal my vlees nog rus in hoop.

kjv_text: Because thou wilt not leave my soul in hell, neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
bsb_text: because You will not abandon my soul to Hades, nor will You let Your Holy One see decay.
aov_text: Want U sal my siel nie aan die doderyk oorlaat of u Heilige oorgee om verderwing te sien nie.

kjv_text: Thou hast made known to me the ways of life; thou shalt make me full of joy with thy countenance.
bsb_text: You have made known to me the paths of life; You will fill me with joy in Your presence.’
aov_text: U het My die weë van die lewe bekend gemaak, U sal My vervul met vreugde by u aangesig.

kjv_text: Men and brethren, let me freely speak unto you of the patriarch David, that he is both dead and buried, and his sepulchre is with us unto this day.
bsb_text: Brothers, I can tell you with confidence that the patriarch David died and was buried, and his tomb is with us to this day.
aov_text: Broeders, ek kan vry-uit met julle spreek oor die aartsvader Dawid, dat hy gesterf het en ook begrawe is, en sy graf is by ons tot vandag toe.

kjv_text: Therefore being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him, that of the fruit of his loins, according to the flesh, he would raise up Christ to sit on his throne;
bsb_text: But he was a prophet and knew that God had promised him on oath that He would place one of his descendants on his throne.
aov_text: Omdat hy dan ’n profeet was en geweet het dat God vir hom met ’n eed gesweer het dat hy uit die vrug van sy lendene, wat die vlees betref, die Christus sou verwek om op sy troon te sit,

kjv_text: He seeing this before spake of the resurrection of Christ, that his soul was not left in hell, neither his flesh did see corruption.
bsb_text: Foreseeing this, David spoke about the resurrection of the Christ, that He was not abandoned to Hades, nor did His body see decay.
aov_text: het hy, omdat hy dit vooruit gesien het, gespreek van die opstanding van Christus, dat sy siel nie in die doderyk verlaat is en sy vlees ook nie verderwing gesien het nie.

kjv_text: This Jesus hath God raised up, whereof we all are witnesses.
bsb_text: God has raised this Jesus to life, to which we are all witnesses.
aov_text: Hierdie Jesus het God opgewek, waarvan ons almal getuies is.

kjv_text: Therefore being by the right hand of God exalted, and having received of the Father the promise of the Holy Ghost, he hath shed forth this, which ye now see and hear.
bsb_text: Exalted, then, to the right hand of God, He has received from the Father the promised Holy Spirit and has poured out what you now see and hear.
aov_text: Nadat Hy dan deur die regterhand van God verhoog is en van die Vader die belofte van die Heilige Gees ontvang het, het Hy dít uitgestort, wat julle nou sien en hoor.

kjv_text: For David is not ascended into the heavens: but he saith himself, The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,
bsb_text: For David did not ascend into heaven, but he himself says: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at My right hand
aov_text: Want Dawid het nie in die hemele opgevaar nie, maar hy self sê: Die Here het gespreek tot my Here: Sit aan my regterhand

kjv_text: Until I make thy foes thy footstool.

aov_text: totdat Ek u vyande gemaak het ’n voetbank van u voete.

kjv_text: Therefore let all the house of Israel know assuredly, that God hath made that same Jesus, whom ye have crucified, both Lord and Christ.
bsb_text: Therefore let all Israel know with certainty that God has made this Jesus, whom you crucified, both Lord and Christ!”
aov_text: Laat dan die hele huis van Israel sekerlik weet dat God Hom Here en Christus gemaak het, hierdie Jesus wat julle gekruisig het.

kjv_text: Now when they heard this, they were pricked in their heart, and said unto Peter and to the rest of the apostles, Men and brethren, what shall we do?
bsb_text: When the people heard this, they were cut to the heart and asked Peter and the other apostles, “Brothers, what shall we do?”
aov_text: TOE hulle dit hoor, is hulle diep in die hart getref en het vir Petrus en die ander apostels gesê: Wat moet ons doen, broeders?

kjv_text: Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost.
bsb_text: Peter replied, “Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
aov_text: En Petrus sê vir hulle: Bekeer julle, en laat elkeen van julle gedoop word in die Naam van Jesus Christus tot vergewing van sondes, en julle sal die gawe van die Heilige Gees ontvang.

kjv_text: For the promise is unto you, and to your children, and to all that are afar off, even as many as the LORD our God shall call.
bsb_text: This promise belongs to you and your children and to all who are far off—to all whom the Lord our God will call to Himself.”
aov_text: Want die belofte kom julle toe en julle kinders en almal wat daar ver is, die wat die Here onse God na Hom sal roep.

kjv_text: And with many other words did he testify and exhort, saying, Save yourselves from this untoward generation.
bsb_text: With many other words he testified, and he urged them, “Be saved from this corrupt generation.”
aov_text: En met baie ander woorde het hy hulle besweer en vermaan en gesê: Laat julle red uit hierdie verkeerde geslag.

kjv_text: Then they that gladly received his word were baptized: and the same day there were added unto them about three thousand souls.
bsb_text: Those who embraced his message were baptized, and about three thousand were added to the believers that day.
aov_text: Die wat toe sy woord met blydskap aangeneem het, is gedoop; en daar is op dié dag omtrent drieduisend siele toegebring.

kjv_text: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles' doctrine and fellowship, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers.
bsb_text: They devoted themselves to the apostles’ teaching and to the fellowship, to the breaking of bread and to prayer.
aov_text: En hulle het volhard in die leer van die apostels en in die gemeenskap en in die breking van die brood en in die gebede.

kjv_text: And fear came upon every soul: and many wonders and signs were done by the apostles.

aov_text: En vrees het op elkeen gekom, en baie wonders en tekens het deur die apostels plaasgevind.

kjv_text: And sold their possessions and goods, and parted them to all men, as every man had need.
bsb_text: Selling their possessions and goods, they shared with anyone who was in need.
aov_text: En hulle eiendomme en besittings het hulle verkoop en die opbrings onder almal verdeel, volgens wat elkeen nodig gehad het.

kjv_text: And they, continuing daily with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread from house to house, did eat their meat with gladness and singleness of heart,
bsb_text: With one accord they continued to meet daily in the temple courts and to break bread from house to house, sharing their meals with gladness and sincerity of heart,
aov_text: En dag vir dag het hulle eendragtig volhard in die tempel en van huis tot huis brood gebreek en hulle voedsel met blydskap en eenvoudigheid van hart geniet,

kjv_text: Praising God, and having favour with all the people. And the Lord added to the church daily such as should be saved.

aov_text: terwyl hulle God geprys het en in guns was by die hele volk. En die Here het daagliks by die gemeente gevoeg die wat gered is.

kjv_text: Now Peter and John went up together into the temple at the hour of prayer, being the ninth hour.
bsb_text: One afternoon Peter and John were going up to the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth hour.
aov_text: EN Petrus en Johannes het saam na die tempel opgegaan op die uur van die gebed, die negende uur.

bsb_text: And a man who was lame from birth was being carried to the temple gate called Beautiful, where he was put every day to beg from those entering the temple courts.
aov_text: En daar is ’n sekere man aangedra wat van sy geboorte af kreupel was; hulle het hom elke dag neergesit by die tempelpoort wat die Skone genoem word, om ’n aalmoes te vra van die wat in die tempel ingaan.

kjv_text: Who seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple asked an alms.

bsb_text: Peter looked directly at him, as did John. “Look at us!” said Peter.
aov_text: En Petrus saam met Johannes het hom stip aangekyk en gesê: Kyk na ons.

kjv_text: And he gave heed unto them, expecting to receive something of them.
bsb_text: So the man gave them his attention, expecting to receive something from them.
aov_text: En hy het sy oë op hulle gehou in die verwagting dat hy iets van hulle sou ontvang.

bsb_text: But Peter said, “Silver or gold I do not have, but what I have I give you: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, get up and walk!”

bsb_text: Taking him by the right hand, Peter helped him up, and at once the man’s feet and ankles were made strong.

kjv_text: And he leaping up stood, and walked, and entered with them into the temple, walking, and leaping, and praising God.

aov_text: En hy het opgespring en gestaan en rondgeloop en saam met hulle in die tempel ingegaan terwyl hy rondloop en spring en God prys.

bsb_text: When all the people saw him walking and praising God,
aov_text: En die hele volk het gesien hoe hy daar loop en God prys.

aov_text: En toe Petrus dit sien, sê hy vir die volk: Israeliete, waarom is julle hieroor verwonderd, of waarom kyk julle ons so aan asof ons deur ons eie krag of godsvrug bewerk het dat hy loop?

kjv_text: But Peter and John answered and said unto them, Whether it be right in the sight of God to hearken unto you more than unto God, judge ye.

aov_text: want vir ons is dit onmoontlik om nie te spreek oor wat ons gesien en gehoor het nie.

kjv_text: So when they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding nothing how they might punish them, because of the people: for all men glorified God for that which was done.
bsb_text: After further threats they let them go. They could not find a way to punish them, because all the people were glorifying God for what had happened.

aov_text: Want die man aan wie hierdie teken van genesing plaasgevind het, was meer as veertig jaar oud.

kjv_text: And being let go, they went to their own company, and reported all that the chief priests and elders had said unto them.

aov_text: En nadat hulle losgelaat was, het hulle na hul eie mense gegaan en alles vertel wat die owerpriesters en die ouderlinge aan hulle gesê het.

kjv_text: And when they heard that, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord, and said, Lord, thou art God, which hast made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all that in them is:

aov_text: En toe hulle dit hoor, het hulle eendragtig die stem tot God verhef en gesê: Here, U is die God wat die hemel en die aarde en die see en alles wat daarin is, gemaak het,

aov_text: wat deur die mond van u kneg Dawid gesê het: Waarom het die nasies gewoed en die volke nietige dinge bedink?

aov_text: Die konings van die aarde het saamgestaan en die owerstes het saam vergader teen die Here en teen sy Gesalfde.

bsb_text: In fact, this is the very city where Herod and Pontius Pilate conspired with the Gentiles and the people of Israel against Your holy servant Jesus, whom You anointed.
aov_text: Want waarlik, Herodes en Pontius Pilatus het saam met heidene en die volke van Israel vergader teen u heilige Kind Jesus wat U gesalf het,

kjv_text: For to do whatsoever thy hand and thy counsel determined before to be done.
bsb_text: They carried out what Your hand and will had decided beforehand would happen.
aov_text: om alles te doen wat u hand en u raad vooruit bepaal het om plaas te vind.

kjv_text: And now, Lord, behold their threatenings: and grant unto thy servants, that with all boldness they may speak thy word,
bsb_text: And now, Lord, consider their threats, and enable Your servants to speak Your word with complete boldness,
aov_text: En nou, Here, let op hulle dreigemente en gee aan u diensknegte om met alle vrymoedigheid u woord te spreek,

aov_text: deurdat U u hand uitstrek tot genesing, en tekens en wonders deur die Naam van u heilige Kind Jesus plaasvind.

kjv_text: And when they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were assembled together; and they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and they spake the word of God with boldness.
bsb_text: After they had prayed, their meeting place was shaken, and they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and spoke the word of God boldly.
aov_text: En toe hulle gebid het, is die plek geskud waar hulle saam was, en hulle is almal vervul met die Heilige Gees en het die woord van God met vrymoedigheid gespreek.

kjv_text: And the multitude of them that believed were of one heart and of one soul: neither said any of them that ought of the things which he possessed was his own; but they had all things common.
bsb_text: The multitude of believers was one in heart and soul. No one claimed that any of his possessions was his own, but they shared everything they owned.
aov_text: EN die menigte van die wat gelowig geword het, was een van hart en siel, en nie een het gesê dat iets van sy besittings sy eie was nie, maar hulle het alles in gemeenskap gehad.

kjv_text: And with great power gave the apostles witness of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus: and great grace was upon them all.
bsb_text: With great power the apostles continued to give their testimony about the resurrection of the Lord Jesus. And abundant grace was upon them all.
aov_text: En met groot krag het die apostels getuienis gegee van die opstanding van die Here Jesus, en groot genade was oor hulle almal.

bsb_text: There were no needy ones among them, because those who owned lands or houses would sell their property, bring the proceeds from the sales,
aov_text: Want niemand onder hulle was behoeftig nie; want almal wat besitters van gronde of huise was, het dit verkoop en die prys van wat verkoop is, gebring

bsb_text: and lay them at the apostles' feet

bsb_text: for distribution to anyone as he had need.

bsb_text: Joseph, a Levite from Cyprus, whom the apostles called Barnabas (meaning Son of Encouragement),

kjv_text: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession,

aov_text: MAAR ’n sekere man met die naam van Ananías het saam met sy vrou Saffíra ’n eiendom verkoop,

bsb_text: With his wife’s full knowledge, he kept back some of the proceeds for himself, but brought a portion and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
aov_text: en ook met die medewete van sy vrou van die prys agtergehou en ’n sekere deel gebring en aan die voete van die apostels neergelê.

kjv_text: But Peter said, Ananias, why hath Satan filled thine heart to lie to the Holy Ghost, and to keep back part of the price of the land?
bsb_text: Then Peter said, “Ananias, how is it that Satan has filled your heart to lie to the Holy Spirit and withhold some of the proceeds from the land?
aov_text: Toe sê Petrus: Ananías, waarom het die Satan jou hart vervul om vir die Heilige Gees te lieg en van die prys van die grond agter te hou?

kjv_text: Whiles it remained, was it not thine own? and after it was sold, was it not in thine own power? why hast thou conceived this thing in thine heart? thou hast not lied unto men, but unto God.
bsb_text: Did it not belong to you before it was sold? And after it was sold, was it not at your disposal? How could you conceive such a deed in your heart? You have not lied to men, but to God!”
aov_text: As dit nie verkoop was nie, het dit nie joue gebly nie? En toe dit verkoop is, was dit nie in jou mag nie? Waarom is dit dat jy hierdie saak in jou hart voorgeneem het? Jy het nie vir mense gelieg nie, maar vir God.

kjv_text: And Ananias hearing these words fell down, and gave up the ghost: and great fear came on all them that heard these things.
bsb_text: On hearing these words, Ananias fell down and died. And great fear came over all who heard what had happened.
aov_text: En toe Ananías hierdie woorde hoor, het hy neergeval en gesterwe; en ’n groot vrees het gekom oor almal wat dit gehoor het.

kjv_text: And the young men arose, wound him up, and carried him out, and buried him.

aov_text: Daarna het die jongmanne opgestaan en hom toegedraai en uitgedra en begrawe.

kjv_text: And it was about the space of three hours after, when his wife, not knowing what was done, came in.
bsb_text: About three hours later his wife also came in, unaware of what had happened.
aov_text: En ná verloop van omtrent drie uur kom sy vrou in sonder om te weet wat voorgeval het.

kjv_text: And Peter answered unto her, Tell me whether ye sold the land for so much? And she said, Yea, for so much.
bsb_text: “Tell me,” said Peter, “is this the price you and your husband got for the land?” “Yes,” she answered, “that is the price.”
aov_text: En Petrus het haar aangespreek: Sê vir my of julle die grond vir soveel verkoop het? En sy sê: Ja, vir soveel.

kjv_text: Then Peter said unto her, How is it that ye have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? behold, the feet of them which have buried thy husband are at the door, and shall carry thee out.
bsb_text: “How could you agree to test the Spirit of the Lord?” Peter replied. “Look, the feet of the men who buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out also.”
aov_text: En Petrus sê vir haar: Waarom het julle ooreengekom om die Gees van die Here te versoek? Kyk, die voete van die wat jou man begrawe het, is by die deur, en hulle sal jou uitdra.

kjv_text: Then fell she down straightway at his feet, and yielded up the ghost: and the young men came in, and found her dead, and, carrying her forth, buried her by her husband.
bsb_text: At that instant she fell down at his feet and died. Then the young men came in and, finding her dead, carried her out and buried her beside her husband.
aov_text: Toe val sy onmiddellik aan sy voete neer en het gesterwe. En die jongmanne het ingekom en haar dood gevind en haar uitgedra en by haar man begrawe.

kjv_text: And great fear came upon all the church, and upon as many as heard these things.
bsb_text: And great fear came over the whole church and all who heard about these events.
aov_text: En ’n groot vrees het oor die hele gemeente gekom en oor almal wat dit gehoor het.

kjv_text: And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders wrought among the people; (and they were all with one accord in Solomon's porch.
bsb_text: The apostles performed many signs and wonders among the people, and with one accord the believers gathered together in Solomon’s Colonnade.
aov_text: En deur die hande van die apostels het daar baie tekens en wonders onder die volk plaasgevind; en hulle was almal eendragtig saam in die pilaargang van Salomo.

kjv_text: And of the rest durst no man join himself to them: but the people magnified them.
bsb_text: Although the people regarded them highly, no one else dared to join them.
aov_text: En daar was niemand van die ander wat dit gewaag het om hom by hulle te voeg nie, maar die volk het hulle baie geëer.

kjv_text: And believers were the more added to the Lord, multitudes both of men and women.)
bsb_text: Yet more and more believers were brought to the Lord—large numbers of both men and women.
aov_text: En daar is meer en meer gelowiges in die Here bygevoeg, menigtes van manne sowel as vroue,

aov_text: EN die hoëpriester het opgestaan en almal wat saam met hom was — dit is die party van die Sadduseërs — en hulle was met nydigheid vervul,

aov_text: Maar ’n engel van die Here het in die nag die deure van die gevangenis oopgemaak en hulle uitgelei en gesê:

bsb_text: “Go, stand in the temple courts and tell the people the full message of this new life.”
aov_text: Gaan heen, staan en vertel in die tempel aan die volk al die woorde van hierdie lewe.

kjv_text: But when the officers came, and found them not in the prison, they returned, and told,

aov_text: Daarop gaan die hoofman met die dienaars en bring hulle, maar nie met geweld nie, uit vrees vir die volk dat hulle gestenig sou word.

kjv_text: And when they had brought them, they set them before the council: and the high priest asked them,

aov_text: Hulle het hul dan gebring en voor die Raad gestel; en die hoëpriester het hulle gevra en gesê:

bsb_text: “We gave you strict orders not to teach in this name,” he said. “Yet you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching and are determined to make us responsible for this man’s blood.”
aov_text: Het ons julle nie uitdruklik verbied om in dié Naam te leer nie? En kyk, julle het Jerusalem met julle leer vervul; en julle wil die bloed van hierdie Man op ons bring.

kjv_text: And we are his witnesses of these things; and so is also the Holy Ghost, whom God hath given to them that obey him.

kjv_text: And said unto them, Ye men of Israel, take heed to yourselves what ye intend to do as touching these men.

aov_text: Toe sê hy vir hulle: Israeliete, pas op wat julle gaan doen met hierdie manne;

aov_text: maar as dit uit God is, kan julle dit nie vernietig nie — dat dit nie miskien bevind word dat julle selfs teen God stry nie.

aov_text: Kyk dan uit, broeders, na sewe manne uit julle, van goeie getuienis, vol van die Heilige Gees en wysheid, wat ons oor hierdie nodige saak kan aanstel;

bsb_text: and will devote ourselves to prayer and to the ministry of the word.”
aov_text: maar ons sal volhard in die gebed en die bediening van die woord.

kjv_text: And the saying pleased the whole multitude: and they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Ghost, and Philip, and Prochorus, and Nicanor, and Timon, and Parmenas, and Nicolas a proselyte of Antioch:
bsb_text: This proposal pleased the whole group. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, as well as Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolas from Antioch, a convert to Judaism.
aov_text: En die woord het byval gevind by die hele menigte; en hulle het gekies: Stéfanus, ’n man vol van geloof en van die Heilige Gees, en Filippus en Próchorus en Nikánor en Timon en Pármenas en Nikoláüs, ’n Jodegenoot uit Antiochíë,

kjv_text: Whom they set before the apostles: and when they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.
bsb_text: They presented these seven to the apostles, who prayed and laid their hands on them.
aov_text: wat hulle voor die apostels gestel het; en hulle het gebid en hulle die hande opgelê.

kjv_text: And the word of God increased; and the number of the disciples multiplied in Jerusalem greatly; and a great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.
bsb_text: So the word of God continued to spread. The number of disciples in Jerusalem grew rapidly, and a great number of priests became obedient to the faith.
aov_text: En die woord van God het toegeneem, en die getal van die dissipels het in Jerusalem baie vermeerder, en ’n groot menigte van priesters het gehoorsaam geword aan die geloof.

kjv_text: And Stephen, full of faith and power, did great wonders and miracles among the people.
bsb_text: Now Stephen, who was full of grace and power, was performing great wonders and signs among the people.
aov_text: EN Stéfanus, vol van geloof en krag, het groot wonders en tekens onder die volk gedoen.

kjv_text: Then there arose certain of the synagogue, which is called the synagogue of the Libertines, and Cyrenians, and Alexandrians, and of them of Cilicia and of Asia, disputing with Stephen.
bsb_text: But resistance arose from what was called the Synagogue of the Freedmen, including Cyrenians, Alexandrians, and men from the provinces of Cilicia and Asia. They began to argue with Stephen,
aov_text: En daar het sommige van die sogenaamde sinagoge van die Libertyne opgestaan, en van die Cirenéërs en Alexandryne, en van die mense van Cilícië en Asië, en hulle het met Stéfanus geredetwis.

kjv_text: And they were not able to resist the wisdom and the spirit by which he spake.
bsb_text: but they could not stand up to his wisdom or the Spirit by whom he spoke.
aov_text: Maar hulle kon die wysheid en die Gees waardeur hy gespreek het, nie weerstaan nie.

kjv_text: Then they suborned men, which said, We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses, and against God.
bsb_text: Then they prompted some men to say, “We heard Stephen speak words of blasphemy against Moses and against God.”
aov_text: Toe het hulle manne opgestook om te sê: Ons het hom lasterlike dinge hoor praat teen Moses en God.

kjv_text: And they stirred up the people, and the elders, and the scribes, and came upon him, and caught him, and brought him to the council,
bsb_text: So they stirred up the people, elders, and scribes and confronted Stephen. They seized him and brought him before the Sanhedrin,
aov_text: En hulle het die volk en die ouderlinge en die skrifgeleerdes in beweging gebring en op hom afgekom en hom gegryp en voor die Raad gebring.

kjv_text: And set up false witnesses, which said, This man ceaseth not to speak blasphemous words against this holy place, and the law:
bsb_text: where they presented false witnesses who said, “This man never stops speaking against this holy place and against the law.
aov_text: En hulle het valse getuies laat optree om te sê: Dié man hou nie op om lasterlike dinge te praat teen hierdie heilige plek en die wet nie.

kjv_text: For we have heard him say, that this Jesus of Nazareth shall destroy this place, and shall change the customs which Moses delivered us.
bsb_text: For we have heard him say that Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place and change the customs that Moses handed down to us.”
aov_text: Want ons het hom hoor sê: Hierdie Jesus, die Nasaréner, sal hierdie plek afbreek en die sedes wat Moses aan ons oorgelewer het, verander.

kjv_text: And all that sat in the council, looking stedfastly on him, saw his face as it had been the face of an angel.
bsb_text: All who were sitting in the Sanhedrin looked intently at Stephen, and they saw that his face was like the face of an angel.
aov_text: En terwyl almal wat in die Raad sit, hul oë stip op hom hou, sien hulle dat sy gesig soos die gesig van ’n engel was.

kjv_text: Then said the high priest, Are these things so?
bsb_text: Then the high priest asked Stephen, “Are these charges true?”
aov_text: TOE sê die hoëpriester: Is hierdie dinge dan so?

kjv_text: And he said, Men, brethren, and fathers, hearken; The God of glory appeared unto our father Abraham, when he was in Mesopotamia, before he dwelt in Charran,
bsb_text: And Stephen declared: “Brothers and fathers, listen to me! The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham while he was still in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Haran,
aov_text: En hy sê: Broeders en vaders, luister! Die God van die heerlikheid het verskyn aan ons vader Abraham toe hy in Mesopotámië was, voordat hy in Haran gewoon het,

kjv_text: And said unto him, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and come into the land which I shall shew thee.
bsb_text: and told him, ‘Leave your country and your kindred and go to the land I will show you.’
aov_text: en vir hom gesê: Trek uit jou land en uit jou familie, en kom na die land wat Ek jou sal wys.

kjv_text: Then came he out of the land of the Chaldaeans, and dwelt in Charran: and from thence, when his father was dead, he removed him into this land, wherein ye now dwell.
bsb_text: So Abraham left the land of the Chaldeans and settled in Haran. After his father died, God brought him out of that place and into this land where you are now living.
aov_text: Toe het hy getrek uit die land van die Chaldéërs en in Haran gaan woon; en ná die dood van sy vader het Hy hom daarvandaan laat verhuis na hierdie land waarin julle nou woon.

kjv_text: And he gave him none inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on: yet he promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his seed after him, when as yet he had no child.
bsb_text: He gave him no inheritance here, not even a foot of ground. But God promised to give possession of the land to Abraham and his descendants, even though he did not yet have a child.
aov_text: En Hy het hom geen erfdeel daarin gegee nie, selfs nie ’n voetbreed nie, maar Hy het belowe om dit aan hom en sy nageslag ná hom as eiendom te gee, toe hy nog geen kind gehad het nie.

kjv_text: And God spake on this wise, That his seed should sojourn in a strange land; and that they should bring them into bondage, and entreat them evil four hundred years.
bsb_text: God told him that his descendants would be foreigners in a strange land, and that they would be enslaved and mistreated four hundred years.
aov_text: En God het aan hom dít gesê, dat sy nageslag bywoners in ’n vreemde land sou wees en die mense hulle tot slawe sou maak en mishandel, vierhonderd jaar lank.

kjv_text: And the nation to whom they shall be in bondage will I judge, said God: and after that shall they come forth, and serve me in this place.
bsb_text: ‘But I will punish the nation that enslaves them,’ God said, ‘and afterward they will come forth and worship Me in this place.’
aov_text: En die nasie aan wie hulle diensbaar sal wees, sal Ek oordeel, het God gesê; en daarna sal hulle uittrek en My in hierdie plek dien.

kjv_text: And he gave him the covenant of circumcision: and so Abraham begat Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat the twelve patriarchs.
bsb_text: Then God gave Abraham the covenant of circumcision, and Abraham became the father of Isaac and circumcised him on the eighth day. And Isaac became the father of Jacob, and Jacob of the twelve patriarchs.
aov_text: En Hy het hom die verbond van die besnydenis gegee, en so het hy die vader van Isak geword en hom op die agtste dag besny; en Isak het die vader van Jakob geword, en Jakob van die twaalf aartsvaders.

kjv_text: And the patriarchs, moved with envy, sold Joseph into Egypt: but God was with him,
bsb_text: Because the patriarchs were jealous of Joseph, they sold him as a slave into Egypt. But God was with him
aov_text: En die aartsvaders was jaloers op Josef en het hom verkoop na Egipte toe; maar God was met hom

kjv_text: And delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favour and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and he made him governor over Egypt and all his house.
bsb_text: and rescued him from all his troubles. He granted Joseph favor and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh king of Egypt, who appointed him ruler over Egypt and all his household.
aov_text: en het hom uit al sy verdrukkinge verlos en hom guns en wysheid geskenk voor Farao, die koning van Egipte; en dié het hom goewerneur gemaak oor Egipte en oor sy hele huis.

kjv_text: Now there came a dearth over all the land of Egypt and Chanaan, and great affliction: and our fathers found no sustenance.
bsb_text: Then famine and great suffering swept across Egypt and Canaan, and our fathers could not find food.
aov_text: En ’n hongersnood en groot benoudheid het oor die hele Egipteland en Kanaän gekom, en ons vaders kon geen voedsel kry nie.

kjv_text: But when Jacob heard that there was corn in Egypt, he sent out our fathers first.
bsb_text: When Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent our fathers on their first visit.
aov_text: En toe Jakob hoor dat daar koring in Egipte was, het hy ons vaders die eerste keer uitgestuur.

kjv_text: And at the second time Joseph was made known to his brethren; and Joseph's kindred was made known unto Pharaoh.
bsb_text: On their second visit, Joseph revealed his identity to his brothers, and his family became known to Pharaoh.
aov_text: En die tweede keer is Josef deur sy broers herken, en die afkoms van Josef het aan Farao bekend geword.

kjv_text: Then sent Joseph, and called his father Jacob to him, and all his kindred, threescore and fifteen souls.
bsb_text: Then Joseph sent for his father Jacob and all his relatives, seventy-five in all.
aov_text: Toe het Josef gestuur en sy vader Jakob laat roep en sy hele familie, vyf-en-sewentig siele.

kjv_text: So Jacob went down into Egypt, and died, he, and our fathers,
bsb_text: So Jacob went down to Egypt, where he and our fathers died.
aov_text: En Jakob het afgetrek na Egipte en daar gesterwe, hy en ons vaders.

kjv_text: And were carried over into Sychem, and laid in the sepulchre that Abraham bought for a sum of money of the sons of Emmor the father of Sychem.
bsb_text: Their bones were carried back to Shechem and placed in the tomb that Abraham had bought from the sons of Hamor at Shechem for a price he paid in silver.
aov_text: En hulle is oorgebring na Sigem en weggelê in die graf wat Abraham vir ’n som geld gekoop het van die seuns van Hemor, die vader van Sigem.

kjv_text: But when the time of the promise drew nigh, which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,
bsb_text: As the time drew near for God to fulfill His promise to Abraham, our people in Egypt increased greatly in number.
aov_text: En namate die tyd van die belofte wat God aan Abraham met ’n eed beloof het, nader kom, het die volk toegeneem en vermeerder in Egipte,

kjv_text: Till another king arose, which knew not Joseph.
bsb_text: Then another king, who knew nothing of Joseph, arose over Egypt.
aov_text: totdat daar ’n ander koning opgestaan het wat nie vir Josef geken het nie.

kjv_text: The same dealt subtilly with our kindred, and evil entreated our fathers, so that they cast out their young children, to the end they might not live.
bsb_text: He exploited our people and oppressed our fathers, forcing them to abandon their infants so they would die.
aov_text: Hy het listig met ons geslag te werk gegaan en ons vaders mishandel deur hulle te verplig om hul kindertjies weg te gooi, sodat hulle nie in die lewe behou kon word nie.

kjv_text: In which time Moses was born, and was exceeding fair, and nourished up in his father's house three months:
bsb_text: At that time Moses was born, and he was beautiful in the sight of God. For three months he was nurtured in his father’s house.
aov_text: In dié tyd is Moses gebore, en hy was wonderlik mooi. Drie maande lank is hy in die huis van sy vader versorg;

kjv_text: And when he was cast out, Pharaoh's daughter took him up, and nourished him for her own son.
bsb_text: When he was set outside, Pharaoh’s daughter took him and brought him up as her own son.
aov_text: en toe hy weggegooi is, het Farao se dogter hom opgeneem en hom as haar seun grootgemaak.

kjv_text: And Moses was learned in all the wisdom of the Egyptians, and was mighty in words and in deeds.
bsb_text: So Moses was educated in all the wisdom of the Egyptians and was powerful in speech and action.
aov_text: En Moses is opgelei in al die wysheid van die Egiptenaars en was magtig in woorde en dade.

kjv_text: And when he was full forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brethren the children of Israel.
bsb_text: When Moses was forty years old, he decided to visit his brothers, the children of Israel.
aov_text: En nadat hy die ouderdom van veertig jaar bereik het, het dit in sy hart opgekom om sy broers, die kinders van Israel, te besoek;

kjv_text: And seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him, and avenged him that was oppressed, and smote the Egyptian:
bsb_text: And when he saw one of them being mistreated, Moses went to his defense and avenged him by striking down the Egyptian who was oppressing him.
aov_text: en toe hy sien dat iemand onreg aangedoen word, het hy hom verdedig en die man wat mishandel was, gewreek deur die Egiptenaar te verslaan.

kjv_text: For he supposed his brethren would have understood how that God by his hand would deliver them: but they understood not.
bsb_text: He assumed his brothers would understand that God was using him to deliver them, but they did not.
aov_text: En hy het gedink dat sy broers sou verstaan dat God hulle deur sý hand redding sou gee; maar hulle het dit nie verstaan nie.

kjv_text: And the next day he shewed himself unto them as they strove, and would have set them at one again, saying, Sirs, ye are brethren; why do ye wrong one to another?
bsb_text: The next day he came upon two Israelites who were fighting, and he tried to reconcile them, saying, ‘Men, you are brothers. Why are you mistreating each other?’
aov_text: En die volgende dag het hy by hulle verskyn terwyl hulle besig was om te veg, en hy het by hulle aangedring om vrede te maak en gesê: Manne, julle is broers; waarom doen julle mekaar onreg aan?

kjv_text: But he that did his neighbour wrong thrust him away, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge over us?
bsb_text: But the man who was abusing his neighbor pushed Moses aside and said, ‘Who made you ruler and judge over us?
aov_text: Maar hy wat sy naaste onreg aangedoen het, het hom afgestoot en gesê: Wie het jou as ’n owerste en regter oor ons aangestel?

kjv_text: Wilt thou kill me, as thou diddest the Egyptian yesterday?
bsb_text: Do you want to kill me as you killed the Egyptian yesterday?’
aov_text: Jy wil my tog nie doodmaak soos jy gister die Egiptenaar doodgemaak het nie?

kjv_text: Then fled Moses at this saying, and was a stranger in the land of Madian, where he begat two sons.
bsb_text: At this remark, Moses fled to the land of Midian, where he lived as a foreigner and had two sons.
aov_text: En Moses het op hierdie woord gevlug en ’n bywoner geword in die land Mídian, waar hy die vader van twee seuns geword het.

kjv_text: And when forty years were expired, there appeared to him in the wilderness of mount Sina an angel of the Lord in a flame of fire in a bush.
bsb_text: After forty years had passed, an angel appeared to Moses in the flames of a burning bush in the desert near Mount Sinai.
aov_text: En toe veertig jaar verby was, het ’n Engel van die Here aan hom verskyn in die woestyn van die berg Sinai, in die vuurvlam van ’n doringbos.

kjv_text: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight: and as he drew near to behold it, the voice of the LORD came unto him,
bsb_text: When Moses saw it, he marveled at the sight. As he approached to look more closely, the voice of the Lord came to him:
aov_text: En Moses het dit gesien en hom oor die gesig verwonder; en toe hy daarheen gaan om dit te besien, het die stem van die Here tot hom gekom:

kjv_text: Saying, I am the God of thy fathers, the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. Then Moses trembled, and durst not behold.
bsb_text: ‘I am the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.’ Moses trembled with fear and did not dare to look.
aov_text: Ek is die God van jou vaders, die God van Abraham en die God van Isak en die God van Jakob. En Moses het begin bewe en nie gewaag om dit te bekyk nie.

kjv_text: Then said the Lord to him, Put off thy shoes from thy feet: for the place where thou standest is holy ground.
bsb_text: Then the Lord said to him, ‘Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy ground.
aov_text: Toe sê die Here vir hom: Trek die skoene van jou voete af, want die plek waarop jy staan, is heilige grond.

kjv_text: I have seen, I have seen the affliction of my people which is in Egypt, and I have heard their groaning, and am come down to deliver them. And now come, I will send thee into Egypt.
bsb_text: I have indeed seen the oppression of My people in Egypt. I have heard their groaning and have come down to deliver them. Now come, I will send you back to Egypt.’
aov_text: Ek het duidelik gesien die mishandeling van my volk wat in Egipte is, en hulle gesug gehoor en neergedaal om hulle te verlos. En nou, kom hier, Ek wil jou na Egipte stuur.

kjv_text: This Moses whom they refused, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge? the same did God send to be a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel which appeared to him in the bush.
bsb_text: This Moses, whom they had rejected with the words, ‘Who made you ruler and judge?’ is the one whom God sent to be their ruler and redeemer through the angel who appeared to him in the bush.
aov_text: Hierdie Moses wat hulle verloën het deur te sê: Wie het jou aangestel as ’n owerste en regter?  — hom het God as owerste en verlosser gestuur deur die hand van die Engel wat aan hom verskyn het in die doringbos.

kjv_text: He brought them out, after that he had shewed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, and in the Red sea, and in the wilderness forty years.
bsb_text: He led them out and performed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, at the Red Sea, and for forty years in the wilderness.
aov_text: Hy het hulle uitgelei en wonders en tekens in Egipteland en in die Rooi See en in die woestyn gedoen, veertig jaar lank.

kjv_text: This is that Moses, which said unto the children of Israel, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear.
bsb_text: This is the same Moses who told the Israelites, ‘God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your brothers.’
aov_text: Dit is dié Moses wat aan die kinders van Israel gesê het: Die Here julle God sal vir julle ’n Profeet verwek uit julle broers net soos ek is; na Hom moet julle luister.

kjv_text: This is he, that was in the church in the wilderness with the angel which spake to him in the mount Sina, and with our fathers: who received the lively oracles to give unto us:
bsb_text: He was in the assembly in the wilderness with the angel who spoke to him on Mount Sinai, and with our fathers. And he received living words to pass on to us.
aov_text: Dit is hy wat in die vergadering in die woestyn was saam met die Engel wat met hom op die berg Sinai gespreek het, en saam met ons vaders; hy het die lewende woorde ontvang om aan ons te gee.

kjv_text: To whom our fathers would not obey, but thrust him from them, and in their hearts turned back again into Egypt,
bsb_text: But our fathers refused to obey him. Instead, they rejected him and in their hearts turned back to Egypt.
aov_text: Na hom wou ons vaders nie luister nie, maar hulle het hom verstoot en met hulle harte na Egipte teruggekeer

kjv_text: Saying unto Aaron, Make us gods to go before us: for as for this Moses, which brought us out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
bsb_text: They said to Aaron, ‘Make us gods who will go before us! As for this Moses who led us out of the land of Egypt, we do not know what has happened to him.’
aov_text: toe hulle vir Aäron gesê het: Maak vir ons gode wat voor ons uit sal trek; want hierdie Moses wat ons uit Egipteland uitgelei het, ons weet nie wat van hom geword het nie.

kjv_text: And they made a calf in those days, and offered sacrifice unto the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their own hands.
bsb_text: At that time they made a calf and offered a sacrifice to the idol, rejoicing in the works of their hands.
aov_text: En hulle het in daardie dae ’n kalf gemaak en aan die afgodsbeeld ’n offer gebring en hulle in die werke van hulle hande verbly.

kjv_text: Then God turned, and gave them up to worship the host of heaven; as it is written in the book of the prophets, O ye house of Israel, have ye offered to me slain beasts and sacrifices by the space of forty years in the wilderness?
bsb_text: But God turned away from them and gave them over to the worship of the host of heaven, as it is written in the book of the prophets: ‘Did you bring Me sacrifices and offerings forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?
aov_text: Maar God het Hom afgewend en hulle oorgegee om die leër van die hemel te dien, soos geskrywe is in die boek van die profete: Julle het tog nie aan My slagoffers en offers gebring gedurende veertig jaar in die woestyn nie, o huis van Israel?

kjv_text: Yea, ye took up the tabernacle of Moloch, and the star of your god Remphan, figures which ye made to worship them: and I will carry you away beyond Babylon.
bsb_text: You have taken along the tabernacle of Molech and the star of your god Rephan, the idols you made to worship. Therefore I will send you into exile beyond Babylon.’
aov_text: Ja, julle het die tent van Molog opgeneem en die ster van julle god Remfan, die beelde wat julle gemaak het om hulle te aanbid. En Ek sal julle anderkant Babilon wegvoer.

kjv_text: Our fathers had the tabernacle of witness in the wilderness, as he had appointed, speaking unto Moses, that he should make it according to the fashion that he had seen.
bsb_text: Our fathers had the tabernacle of the Testimony with them in the wilderness. It was constructed exactly as God had directed Moses, according to the pattern he had seen.
aov_text: Die tent van die Getuienis was onder ons vaders in die woestyn, soos Hy wat met Moses gespreek het, hom bevel gegee het om dit te maak volgens die afbeelding wat hy gesien het.

kjv_text: Which also our fathers that came after brought in with Jesus into the possession of the Gentiles, whom God drave out before the face of our fathers, unto the days of David;
bsb_text: And our fathers who received it brought it in with Joshua when they dispossessed the nations God drove out before them. It remained until the time of David,
aov_text: En ons vaders het dit ontvang en met Josua ingebring in die besitting van die nasies wat God voor ons vaders uitgedryf het, tot op die dae van Dawid

kjv_text: Who found favour before God, and desired to find a tabernacle for the God of Jacob.
bsb_text: who found favor in the sight of God and asked to provide a dwelling place for the God of Jacob.
aov_text: wat genade gevind het voor God en gevra het om ’n woonplek vir die God van Jakob te verkry.

kjv_text: But Solomon built him an house.
bsb_text: But it was Solomon who built the house for Him.
aov_text: En Salomo het ’n huis vir Hom gebou.

kjv_text: Howbeit the most High dwelleth not in temples made with hands; as saith the prophet,
bsb_text: However, the Most High does not dwell in houses made by human hands. As the prophet says:
aov_text: Maar die Allerhoogste woon nie in tempels wat met hande gemaak is nie, soos die profeet sê:

kjv_text: Heaven is my throne, and earth is my footstool: what house will ye build me? saith the Lord: or what is the place of my rest?
bsb_text: ‘Heaven is My throne and the earth is My footstool. What kind of house will you build for Me, says the Lord, or where will My place of repose be?
aov_text: Die hemel is my troon en die aarde die voetbank van my voete. Watter soort huis sal julle vir My bou, sê die Here, of hoedanig is die plek van my rus?

kjv_text: Hath not my hand made all these things?
bsb_text: Has not My hand made all these things?’
aov_text: Het my hand nie al hierdie dinge gemaak nie?

kjv_text: Ye stiffnecked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, ye do always resist the Holy Ghost: as your fathers did, so do ye.
bsb_text: You stiff-necked people with uncircumcised hearts and ears! You always resist the Holy Spirit, just as your fathers did.
aov_text: Julle hardnekkiges en onbesnedenes van hart en ore, julle weerstaan altyd die Heilige Gees; net soos julle vaders, so ook julle.

kjv_text: Which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted? and they have slain them which shewed before of the coming of the Just One; of whom ye have been now the betrayers and murderers:
bsb_text: Which of the prophets did your fathers fail to persecute? They even killed those who foretold the coming of the Righteous One. And now you are His betrayers and murderers—
aov_text: Watter een van die profete het julle vaders nie vervolg nie? Ja, hulle het dié gedood wat vooraf die koms verkondig het van die Regverdige, van wie julle nou verraaiers en moordenaars geword het;

kjv_text: Who have received the law by the disposition of angels, and have not kept it.
bsb_text: you who received the law ordained by angels, yet have not kept it.”
aov_text: julle wat die wet deur die beskikkinge van engele ontvang het en tog nie onderhou het nie!

kjv_text: When they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed on him with their teeth.
bsb_text: On hearing this, the members of the Sanhedrin were enraged, and they gnashed their teeth at him.
aov_text: En toe hulle dit hoor, was hulle woedend in hul harte en het teen hom op die tande gekners.

kjv_text: But he, being full of the Holy Ghost, looked up stedfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,
bsb_text: But Stephen, full of the Holy Spirit, looked intently into heaven and saw the glory of God and Jesus standing at the right hand of God.
aov_text: Maar hy was vol van die Heilige Gees en het die oë na die hemel gehou en die heerlikheid van God gesien en Jesus wat staan aan die regterhand van God.

kjv_text: And said, Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God.
bsb_text: “Look,” he said, “I see heaven open and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God.”
aov_text: En hy het gesê: Kyk, ek sien die hemele geopend en die Seun van die mens aan die regterhand van God staan.

kjv_text: Then they cried out with a loud voice, and stopped their ears, and ran upon him with one accord,
bsb_text: At this they covered their ears, cried out in a loud voice, and rushed together at him.
aov_text: Maar hulle het met ’n groot stem geskreeu en hulle ore toegestop en soos een man op hom aangestorm.

kjv_text: And cast him out of the city, and stoned him: and the witnesses laid down their clothes at a young man's feet, whose name was Saul.
bsb_text: They dragged him out of the city and began to stone him. Meanwhile the witnesses laid their garments at the feet of a young man named Saul.
aov_text: En hulle het hom buitekant die stad uitgewerp en hom gestenig; en die getuies het hulle klere neergelê by die voete van ’n jongman met die naam van Saulus.

kjv_text: And they stoned Stephen, calling upon God, and saying, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.
bsb_text: While they were stoning him, Stephen appealed, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.”
aov_text: En hulle het Stéfanus gestenig terwyl hy die Here aanroep en sê: Here Jesus, ontvang my gees!

kjv_text: And he kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, Lord, lay not this sin to their charge. And when he had said this, he fell asleep.
bsb_text: Falling on his knees, he cried out in a loud voice, “Lord, do not hold this sin against them.” And when he had said this, he fell asleep.
aov_text: En hy het op sy knieë neergeval en met ’n groot stem uitgeroep: Here, reken hulle hierdie sonde nie toe nie! En met dié woorde het hy ontslaap.

kjv_text: And Saul was consenting unto his death. And at that time there was a great persecution against the church which was at Jerusalem; and they were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judaea and Samaria, except the apostles.
bsb_text: And Saul was there, giving approval to Stephen’s death. On that day a great persecution broke out against the church in Jerusalem, and all except the apostles were scattered throughout Judea and Samaria.
aov_text: EN Saulus het ook sy vermoording goedgekeur. En daar het in dié tyd ’n groot vervolging teen die gemeente in Jerusalem ontstaan, en almal is verstrooi oor die streke van Judéa en Samaría, behalwe die apostels.

kjv_text: And devout men carried Stephen to his burial, and made great lamentation over him.
bsb_text: God-fearing men buried Stephen and mourned deeply over him.
aov_text: En godvresende manne het Stéfanus begrawe en ’n groot rou oor hom bedrywe.

kjv_text: As for Saul, he made havock of the church, entering into every house, and haling men and women committed them to prison.
bsb_text: But Saul began to destroy the church. Going from house to house, he dragged off men and women and put them in prison.
aov_text: Maar Saulus het die gemeente verwoes en in die huise gegaan en manne en vroue uitgesleep en in die gevangenis oorgelewer.

kjv_text: Therefore they that were scattered abroad went every where preaching the word.
bsb_text: Those who had been scattered preached the word wherever they went.
aov_text: En die wat verstrooi was, het die land deurgegaan en die woord van die evangelie verkondig.

kjv_text: Then Philip went down to the city of Samaria, and preached Christ unto them.
bsb_text: Philip went down to a city in Samaria and proclaimed the Christ to them.
aov_text: En Filippus het afgekom in ’n stad van Samaría en Christus aan hulle verkondig.

kjv_text: And the people with one accord gave heed unto those things which Philip spake, hearing and seeing the miracles which he did.
bsb_text: The crowds gave their undivided attention to Philip’s message and to the signs they saw him perform.
aov_text: En die skare het eendragtig ag gegee op die woorde van Filippus toe hulle dit hoor en die tekens sien wat hy doen.

kjv_text: For unclean spirits, crying with loud voice, came out of many that were possessed with them: and many taken with palsies, and that were lame, were healed.
bsb_text: With loud shrieks, unclean spirits came out of many who were possessed, and many of the paralyzed and lame were healed.
aov_text: Want uit baie van die wat onreine geeste gehad het, het die geeste uitgegaan terwyl hulle met ’n groot stem skreeu; en baie wat lam en kreupel was, het gesond geword.

kjv_text: And there was great joy in that city.
bsb_text: So there was great joy in that city.
aov_text: En daar was groot blydskap in daardie stad.

kjv_text: But there was a certain man, called Simon, which beforetime in the same city used sorcery, and bewitched the people of Samaria, giving out that himself was some great one:
bsb_text: Prior to that time, a man named Simon had practiced sorcery in the city and astounded the people of Samaria. He claimed to be someone great,
aov_text: En ’n sekere man met die naam van Simon het vantevore in die stad met towery omgegaan en die bevolking van Samaría verbyster deur te sê dat hy iets besonders was.

kjv_text: To whom they all gave heed, from the least to the greatest, saying, This man is the great power of God.
bsb_text: and all the people, from the least to the greatest, heeded his words and said, “This man is the divine power called the Great Power.”
aov_text: En almal, klein en groot, het hom aangehang en gesê: Hy is die groot krag van God.

kjv_text: And to him they had regard, because that of long time he had bewitched them with sorceries.
bsb_text: They paid close attention to him because he had astounded them for a long time with his sorcery.
aov_text: En hulle het hom aangehang, omdat hy hulle ’n geruime tyd deur sy towerye verbyster het.

kjv_text: But when they believed Philip preaching the things concerning the kingdom of God, and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.
bsb_text: But when they believed Philip as he preached the gospel of the kingdom of God and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.
aov_text: Maar toe hulle Filippus geglo het, wat die evangelie aangaande die koninkryk van God en die Naam van Jesus Christus verkondig het, is hulle gedoop, manne sowel as vroue.

kjv_text: Then Simon himself believed also: and when he was baptized, he continued with Philip, and wondered, beholding the miracles and signs which were done.
bsb_text: Even Simon himself believed and was baptized. He followed Philip closely and was astounded by the great signs and miracles he observed.
aov_text: En Simon het ook self gelowig geword, en nadat hy gedoop was, gedurig by Filippus gebly; en hy was verbaas toe hy die tekens en groot kragte sien gebeur.

kjv_text: Now when the apostles which were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent unto them Peter and John:
bsb_text: When the apostles in Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent Peter and John to them.
aov_text: En toe die apostels in Jerusalem hoor dat Samaría die woord van God aangeneem het, het hulle Petrus en Johannes na hulle gestuur.

kjv_text: Who, when they were come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Ghost:
bsb_text: On their arrival, they prayed for them to receive the Holy Spirit.
aov_text: Húlle het afgekom en vir hulle gebid, dat hulle die Heilige Gees mag ontvang,

kjv_text: (For as yet he was fallen upon none of them: only they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.)
bsb_text: For the Holy Spirit had not yet fallen upon any of them; they had simply been baptized into the name of the Lord Jesus.
aov_text: want Hy het toe nog op niemand van hulle geval nie, maar hulle was net gedoop in die Naam van die Here Jesus.

kjv_text: Then laid they their hands on them, and they received the Holy Ghost.
bsb_text: Then Peter and John laid their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.
aov_text: Hulle het hul toe die hande opgelê, en hulle het die Heilige Gees ontvang.

kjv_text: And when Simon saw that through laying on of the apostles' hands the Holy Ghost was given, he offered them money,
bsb_text: When Simon saw that the Spirit was given through the laying on of the apostles’ hands, he offered them money.
aov_text: En toe Simon sien dat deur die handoplegging van die apostels die Heilige Gees gegee word, het hy hulle geld aangebied

kjv_text: Saying, Give me also this power, that on whomsoever I lay hands, he may receive the Holy Ghost.
bsb_text: “Give me this power as well,” he said, “so that everyone on whom I lay my hands may receive the Holy Spirit.”
aov_text: en gesê: Gee aan my ook hierdie mag, sodat elkeen wat ek die hande oplê, die Heilige Gees kan ontvang.

kjv_text: But Peter said unto him, Thy money perish with thee, because thou hast thought that the gift of God may be purchased with money.
bsb_text: But Peter replied, “May your silver perish with you, because you thought you could buy the gift of God with money!
aov_text: Maar Petrus sê vir hom: Mag jou geld saam met jou vergaan, omdat jy gedink het om die gawe van God deur geld te verkry.

kjv_text: Thou hast neither part nor lot in this matter: for thy heart is not right in the sight of God.
bsb_text: You have no part or share in our ministry, because your heart is not right before God.
aov_text: Jy het geen deel of lot in hierdie saak nie, want jou hart is nie reg voor God nie.

kjv_text: Repent therefore of this thy wickedness, and pray God, if perhaps the thought of thine heart may be forgiven thee.
bsb_text: Repent, therefore, of your wickedness, and pray to the Lord. Perhaps He will forgive you for the intent of your heart.
aov_text: Bekeer jou dan van hierdie boosheid van jou, en bid God of die gedagte van jou hart jou miskien vergewe mag word.

kjv_text: For I perceive that thou art in the gall of bitterness, and in the bond of iniquity.
bsb_text: For I see that you are poisoned by bitterness and captive to iniquity.”
aov_text: Want ek sien dat jy in ’n gal van bitterheid en bande van ongeregtigheid is.

kjv_text: Then answered Simon, and said, Pray ye to the LORD for me, that none of these things which ye have spoken come upon me.
bsb_text: Then Simon answered, “Pray to the Lord for me, so that nothing you have said may happen to me.”
aov_text: Maar Simon het geantwoord en gesê: Bid julle tot die Here vir my, sodat niks van wat julle gesê het, oor my mag kom nie.

kjv_text: And they, when they had testified and preached the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the gospel in many villages of the Samaritans.
bsb_text: And after Peter and John had testified and spoken the word of the Lord, they returned to Jerusalem, preaching the gospel in many of the Samaritan villages.
aov_text: Nadat hulle dan kragtig getuig en die woord van die Here gespreek het, het hulle na Jerusalem teruggegaan en die evangelie aan baie dorpe van die Samaritane verkondig.

kjv_text: And the angel of the Lord spake unto Philip, saying, Arise, and go toward the south unto the way that goeth down from Jerusalem unto Gaza, which is desert.
bsb_text: Now an angel of the Lord said to Philip, “Get up and go south to the desert road that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza.”
aov_text: EN ’n engel van die Here het met Filippus gespreek en gesê: Staan op en gaan na die suide op die pad wat afloop van Jerusalem na Gasa. Dit is ’n eensame pad.

kjv_text: And he arose and went: and, behold, a man of Ethiopia, an eunuch of great authority under Candace queen of the Ethiopians, who had the charge of all her treasure, and had come to Jerusalem for to worship,
bsb_text: So he started out, and on his way he met an Ethiopian eunuch, a court official in charge of the entire treasury of Candace, queen of the Ethiopians. He had gone to Jerusalem to worship,
aov_text: Toe het hy opgestaan en gegaan. En daar was ’n man van Ethiópië, ’n hofdienaar, ’n staatsamptenaar van Kandacé, die koningin van die Ethiópiërs, wat oor al haar skatte was en na Jerusalem gekom het om te aanbid.

kjv_text: Was returning, and sitting in his chariot read Esaias the prophet.
bsb_text: and on his return was sitting in his chariot reading Isaiah the prophet.
aov_text: En hy was op die terugreis en het op sy wa gesit en die profeet Jesaja gelees.

kjv_text: Then the Spirit said unto Philip, Go near, and join thyself to this chariot.
bsb_text: The Spirit said to Philip, “Go over to that chariot and stay by it.”
aov_text: Toe sê die Gees vir Filippus: Gaan daarheen en bly by daardie wa.

kjv_text: And Philip ran thither to him, and heard him read the prophet Esaias, and said, Understandest thou what thou readest?
bsb_text: So Philip ran up and heard the man reading Isaiah the prophet. “Do you understand what you are reading?” Philip asked.
aov_text: En Filippus het daarheen gehardloop en hom die profeet Jesaja hoor lees; en hy sê: Verstaan u wel wat u lees?

kjv_text: And he said, How can I, except some man should guide me? And he desired Philip that he would come up and sit with him.
bsb_text: “How can I,” he said, “unless someone guides me?” And he invited Philip to come up and sit with him.
aov_text: En hy antwoord: Hoe kan ek tog as niemand my die weg wys nie? Toe vra hy Filippus om op te klim en by hom te kom sit.

kjv_text: The place of the scripture which he read was this, He was led as a sheep to the slaughter; and like a lamb dumb before his shearer, so opened he not his mouth:
bsb_text: The eunuch was reading this passage of Scripture: “He was led like a sheep to the slaughter, and as a lamb before the shearer is silent, so He did not open His mouth.
aov_text: En die gedeelte van die Skrif wat hy besig was om te lees, was dít: Soos ’n skaap is Hy gelei om geslag te word, en soos ’n lam wat stom is voor die een wat hom skeer, so maak Hy sy mond nie oop nie.

kjv_text: In his humiliation his judgment was taken away: and who shall declare his generation? for his life is taken from the earth.
bsb_text: In His humiliation He was deprived of justice. Who can recount His descendants? For His life was removed from the earth.”
aov_text: In sy vernedering is sy oordeel weggeneem, en wie sal sy geslag beskrywe? Want sy lewe word van die aarde weggeneem.

kjv_text: And the eunuch answered Philip, and said, I pray thee, of whom speaketh the prophet this? of himself, or of some other man?
bsb_text: “Tell me,” said the eunuch, “who is the prophet talking about, himself or someone else?”
aov_text: En die hofdienaar antwoord en sê vir Filippus: Ek bid u, van wie sê die profeet dit, van homself of van iemand anders?

kjv_text: Then Philip opened his mouth, and began at the same scripture, and preached unto him Jesus.
bsb_text: Then Philip began with this very Scripture and told him the good news about Jesus.
aov_text: En Filippus het sy mond geopen en van hierdie Skrif af begin en die evangelie van Jesus aan hom verkondig.

kjv_text: And as they went on their way, they came unto a certain water: and the eunuch said, See, here is water; what doth hinder me to be baptized?
bsb_text: As they traveled along the road and came to some water, the eunuch said, “Look, here is water! What is there to prevent me from being baptized?”
aov_text: En terwyl hulle voortreis op die pad, kom hulle by water; en die hofdienaar sê vir hom: Daar is water; wat verhinder my om gedoop te word?

kjv_text: And Philip said, If thou believest with all thine heart, thou mayest. And he answered and said, I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God.
aov_text: Toe sê Filippus: As u glo met u hele hart, is dit geoorloof. En hy antwoord en sê: Ek glo dat Jesus Christus die Seun van God is.

kjv_text: And he commanded the chariot to stand still: and they went down both into the water, both Philip and the eunuch; and he baptized him.
bsb_text: And he gave orders to stop the chariot. Then both Philip and the eunuch went down into the water, and Philip baptized him.
aov_text: En hy het beveel dat die wa moes stilhou; en hulle het altwee in die water afgeklim, Filippus en die hofdienaar; en hy het hom gedoop.

kjv_text: And when they were come up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught away Philip, that the eunuch saw him no more: and he went on his way rejoicing.
bsb_text: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord carried Philip away, and the eunuch saw him no more, but went on his way rejoicing.
aov_text: En toe hulle uit die water opklim, het die Gees van die Here Filippus skielik weggevoer, en die hofdienaar het hom nie meer gesien nie, want hy het sy weg met blydskap gereis.

kjv_text: But Philip was found at Azotus: and passing through he preached in all the cities, till he came to Caesarea.
bsb_text: But Philip appeared at Azotus and traveled through that region, preaching the gospel in all the towns until he came to Caesarea.
aov_text: Maar Filippus is in Asdod gevind. En hy het die land deurgegaan en die evangelie verkondig in al die stede, totdat hy in Cesaréa gekom het.

kjv_text: And Saul, yet breathing out threatenings and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went unto the high priest,
bsb_text: Meanwhile, Saul was still breathing out murderous threats against the disciples of the Lord. He approached the high priest
aov_text: MAAR Saulus, wat nog dreiging en moord geblaas het teen die dissipels van die Here, het na die hoëpriester gegaan

kjv_text: And desired of him letters to Damascus to the synagogues, that if he found any of this way, whether they were men or women, he might bring them bound unto Jerusalem.
bsb_text: and requested letters to the synagogues in Damascus, so that if he found any men or women belonging to the Way, he could bring them as prisoners to Jerusalem.
aov_text: en van hom briewe gevra aan die sinagoges in Damaskus, sodat as hy mense sou vind wat van die Weg was, manne sowel as vroue, hy hulle geboeid na Jerusalem kon bring.

kjv_text: And as he journeyed, he came near Damascus: and suddenly there shined round about him a light from heaven:
bsb_text: As Saul drew near to Damascus on his journey, suddenly a light from heaven flashed around him.
aov_text: En toe hy op sy reis naby Damaskus kom, omstraal hom skielik ’n lig van die hemel af;

kjv_text: And he fell to the earth, and heard a voice saying unto him, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?
bsb_text: He fell to the ground and heard a voice say to him, “Saul, Saul, why do you persecute Me?”
aov_text: en hy val op die grond en hoor ’n stem vir hom sê: Saul, Saul, waarom vervolg jy My?

kjv_text: And he said, Who art thou, Lord? And the Lord said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest: it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.
bsb_text: “Who are You, Lord?” Saul asked. “I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting,” He replied.
aov_text: En hy sê: Wie is U, Here? En die Here antwoord: Ek is Jesus wat jy vervolg. Dit is hard vir jou om teen die prikkels te skop.

kjv_text: And he trembling and astonished said, Lord, what wilt thou have me to do? And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the city, and it shall be told thee what thou must do.
bsb_text: “Now get up and go into the city, and you will be told what you must do.”
aov_text: En terwyl hy bewe en verbaas was, sê hy: Here, wat wil U hê moet ek doen? En die Here antwoord hom: Staan op en gaan na die stad, en dit sal jou gesê word wat jy moet doen.

kjv_text: And the men which journeyed with him stood speechless, hearing a voice, but seeing no man.
bsb_text: The men traveling with Saul stood there speechless. They heard the voice but did not see anyone.
aov_text: En die manne wat saam met hom op pad was, het sprakeloos gestaan terwyl hulle wel die stem hoor, maar niemand sien nie.

kjv_text: And Saul arose from the earth; and when his eyes were opened, he saw no man: but they led him by the hand, and brought him into Damascus.
bsb_text: Saul got up from the ground, but when he opened his eyes he could not see a thing. So they led him by the hand into Damascus.
aov_text: Toe staan Saulus van die grond af op, en alhoewel sy oë oop was, het hy niemand gesien nie; en hulle het hom aan die hand gelei en in Damaskus ingebring.

kjv_text: And he was three days without sight, and neither did eat nor drink.
bsb_text: For three days he was without sight, and he did not eat or drink anything.
aov_text: En drie dae lank het hy niks gesien nie, en niks geëet of gedrink nie.

kjv_text: And there was a certain disciple at Damascus, named Ananias; and to him said the Lord in a vision, Ananias. And he said, Behold, I am here, Lord.
bsb_text: In Damascus there was a disciple named Ananias. The Lord spoke to him in a vision, “Ananias!” “Here I am, Lord,” he answered.
aov_text: En daar was ’n dissipel in Damaskus met die naam van Ananías; en die Here het vir hom in ’n gesig gesê: Ananías! En hy antwoord: Hier is ek, Here.

kjv_text: And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the street which is called Straight, and enquire in the house of Judas for one called Saul, of Tarsus: for, behold, he prayeth,
bsb_text: “Get up!” the Lord told him. “Go to the house of Judas on Straight Street and ask for a man from Tarsus named Saul, for he is praying.
aov_text: Toe sê die Here vir hom: Staan op en gaan na die straat wat genoem word Reguitstraat, en vra in die huis van Judas na ’n man met die naam van Saulus van Tarsus, want kyk, hy bid;

kjv_text: And hath seen in a vision a man named Ananias coming in, and putting his hand on him, that he might receive his sight.
bsb_text: In a vision he has seen a man named Ananias come and place his hands on him to restore his sight.”
aov_text: en hy het in ’n gesig ’n man met die naam van Ananías sien inkom en hom die hande oplê, sodat hy weer kon sien.

kjv_text: Then Ananias answered, Lord, I have heard by many of this man, how much evil he hath done to thy saints at Jerusalem:
bsb_text: But Ananias answered, “Lord, many people have told me about this man and all the harm he has done to Your saints in Jerusalem.
aov_text: Maar Ananías antwoord: Here, ek het van baie mense aangaande hierdie man gehoor hoeveel kwaad hy u heiliges in Jerusalem aangedoen het;

kjv_text: And here he hath authority from the chief priests to bind all that call on thy name.
bsb_text: And now he is here with authority from the chief priests to arrest all who call on Your name.”
aov_text: en hy het hier volmag van die owerpriesters om almal te boei wat u Naam aanroep.

kjv_text: But the Lord said unto him, Go thy way: for he is a chosen vessel unto me, to bear my name before the Gentiles, and kings, and the children of Israel:
bsb_text: “Go!” said the Lord. “This man is My chosen instrument to carry My name before the Gentiles and their kings, and before the people of Israel.
aov_text: Maar die Here sê vir hom: Gaan, want hy is vir My ’n uitverkore werktuig om my Naam te dra voor nasies en konings en die kinders van Israel.

kjv_text: For I will shew him how great things he must suffer for my name's sake.
bsb_text: I will show him how much he must suffer for My name.”
aov_text: Want Ek sal hom toon hoeveel hy vir my Naam moet ly.

kjv_text: And Ananias went his way, and entered into the house; and putting his hands on him said, Brother Saul, the Lord, even Jesus, that appeared unto thee in the way as thou camest, hath sent me, that thou mightest receive thy sight, and be filled with the Holy Ghost.
bsb_text: So Ananias went to the house, and when he arrived, he placed his hands on Saul. “Brother Saul,” he said, “the Lord Jesus, who appeared to you on the road as you were coming here, has sent me so that you may see again and be filled with the Holy Spirit.”
aov_text: En Ananías het gegaan en in die huis gekom en hom die hande opgelê en gesê: Saul, broeder, die Here het my gestuur, naamlik Jesus wat aan jou verskyn het op die pad waarmee jy gekom het, sodat jy weer kan sien en met die Heilige Gees vervul word.

kjv_text: And immediately there fell from his eyes as it had been scales: and he received sight forthwith, and arose, and was baptized.
bsb_text: At that instant, something like scales fell from Saul’s eyes, and his sight was restored. He got up and was baptized,
aov_text: En dadelik het daar iets soos skille van sy oë afgeval, en hy kon onmiddellik weer sien; en hy het opgestaan en is gedoop.

kjv_text: And when he had received meat, he was strengthened. Then was Saul certain days with the disciples which were at Damascus.
bsb_text: and after taking some food, he regained his strength. And he spent several days with the disciples in Damascus.
aov_text: En nadat hy voedsel gebruik het, het hy weer sterk geword. En Saulus was ’n paar dae saam met die dissipels in Damaskus.

kjv_text: And straightway he preached Christ in the synagogues, that he is the Son of God.
bsb_text: Saul promptly began to proclaim Jesus in the synagogues, declaring, “He is the Son of God.”
aov_text: EN hy het dadelik Christus in die sinagoges verkondig, dat Hy die Seun van God is.
