kjv_text: But all that heard him were amazed, and said; Is not this he that destroyed them which called on this name in Jerusalem, and came hither for that intent, that he might bring them bound unto the chief priests?
bsb_text: All who heard him were astounded and asked, “Isn’t this the man who wreaked havoc in Jerusalem on those who call on this name? And hasn’t he come here to take them as prisoners to the chief priests?”
aov_text: En almal wat hom gehoor het, was verbaas en het gesê: Is hý nie die man wat in Jerusalem uitgeroei het die wat hierdie Naam aanroep, en hier gekom het met die doel om hulle geboeid na die owerpriesters te bring nie?

kjv_text: But Saul increased the more in strength, and confounded the Jews which dwelt at Damascus, proving that this is very Christ.
bsb_text: But Saul was empowered all the more, and he confounded the Jews living in Damascus by proving that Jesus is the Christ.
aov_text: Maar Saulus het al meer krag ontvang en die Jode wat in Damaskus woon, in die war gebring deur te bewys dat Hy, Jesus, die Christus is.

kjv_text: And after that many days were fulfilled, the Jews took counsel to kill him:
bsb_text: After many days had passed, the Jews conspired to kill him,
aov_text: En ná geruime tyd het die Jode beraadslaag om hom om te bring.

kjv_text: But their laying await was known of Saul. And they watched the gates day and night to kill him.
bsb_text: but Saul learned of their plot. Day and night they watched the city gates in order to kill him.
aov_text: En hulle plan het aan Saulus bekend geword. En hulle het die poorte dag en nag bewaak, dat hulle hom kon ombring;

kjv_text: Then the disciples took him by night, and let him down by the wall in a basket.
bsb_text: One night, however, his disciples took him and lowered him in a basket through a window in the wall.
aov_text: maar die dissipels het hom geneem en in die nag deur die muur neergelaat deur hom in ’n mandjie te laat afsak.

kjv_text: And when Saul was come to Jerusalem, he assayed to join himself to the disciples: but they were all afraid of him, and believed not that he was a disciple.
bsb_text: When Saul arrived in Jerusalem, he tried to join the disciples, but they were all afraid of him, not believing that he was a disciple.
aov_text: En toe Saulus in Jerusalem aankom, het hy probeer om by die dissipels aan te sluit; maar almal was vir hom bang, omdat hulle nie geglo het dat hy ’n dissipel was nie.

kjv_text: But Barnabas took him, and brought him to the apostles, and declared unto them how he had seen the Lord in the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how he had preached boldly at Damascus in the name of Jesus.
bsb_text: Then Barnabas brought him to the apostles and described how Saul had seen the Lord, who spoke to him on the road to Damascus, and how Saul had spoken boldly in that city in the name of Jesus.
aov_text: Maar Bárnabas het hom geneem en na die apostels gebring en hulle vertel hoe hy op die pad die Here gesien het en dat Hy met hom gespreek het, en hoe hy in Damaskus vrymoediglik in die Naam van Jesus gespreek het.

kjv_text: And he was with them coming in and going out at Jerusalem.
bsb_text: So Saul stayed with them, moving about freely in Jerusalem and speaking boldly in the name of the Lord.
aov_text: En hy het saam met hulle in- en uitgegaan in Jerusalem

kjv_text: And he spake boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus, and disputed against the Grecians: but they went about to slay him.
bsb_text: He talked and debated with the Grecian Jews, but they tried to kill him.
aov_text: en vrymoediglik gespreek in die Naam van die Here Jesus, en ook met die Griekssprekende Jode gepraat en geredetwis, maar hulle het probeer om hom dood te maak.

kjv_text: Which when the brethren knew, they brought him down to Caesarea, and sent him forth to Tarsus.
bsb_text: When the brothers learned of this, they took him down to Caesarea and sent him off to Tarsus.
aov_text: En toe die broeders dit agterkom, het hulle hom na Cesaréa afgebring en hom na Tarsus weggestuur.

kjv_text: Then had the churches rest throughout all Judaea and Galilee and Samaria, and were edified; and walking in the fear of the Lord, and in the comfort of the Holy Ghost, were multiplied.
bsb_text: Then the church throughout Judea, Galilee, and Samaria experienced a time of peace. It grew in strength and numbers, living in the fear of the Lord and the encouragement of the Holy Spirit.
aov_text: En die gemeentes deur die hele Judéa en Galiléa en Samaría het vrede gehad; en terwyl hulle opgebou is en gewandel het in die vrees van die Here en die vertroosting van die Heilige Gees, het hulle vermeerder.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, as Peter passed throughout all quarters, he came down also to the saints which dwelt at Lydda.
bsb_text: As Peter traveled throughout the area, he went to visit the saints in Lydda.
aov_text: EN onderwyl Petrus oral rondgaan, het hy ook gekom by die heiliges wat in Lidda woon;

kjv_text: And there he found a certain man named Aeneas, which had kept his bed eight years, and was sick of the palsy.
bsb_text: There he found a man named Aeneas, who had been paralyzed and bedridden for eight years.
aov_text: en hy het daar ’n man gevind met die naam van Enéas, wat al agt jaar bedlêend en verlam was.

kjv_text: And Peter said unto him, Aeneas, Jesus Christ maketh thee whole: arise, and make thy bed. And he arose immediately.
bsb_text: “Aeneas,” Peter said to him, “Jesus Christ heals you! Get up and put away your mat.” Immediately Aeneas got up,
aov_text: En Petrus sê vir hom: Enéas, Jesus Christus maak jou gesond; staan op en maak jou bed op! En hy het dadelik opgestaan.

kjv_text: And all that dwelt at Lydda and Saron saw him, and turned to the Lord.
bsb_text: and all who lived in Lydda and Sharon saw him and turned to the Lord.
aov_text: En al die inwoners van Lidda en Saron het hom gesien en hulle tot die Here bekeer.

kjv_text: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which by interpretation is called Dorcas: this woman was full of good works and almsdeeds which she did.
bsb_text: In Joppa there was a disciple named Tabitha (which is translated as Dorcas), who was always occupied with works of kindness and charity.
aov_text: En in Joppe was daar ’n sekere dissipelin met die naam van Tabíta, wat, as dit vertaal word, beteken Dorkas. Sy was oorvloedig in goeie werke en aalmoese wat sy gedoen het.

kjv_text: And it came to pass in those days, that she was sick, and died: whom when they had washed, they laid her in an upper chamber.
bsb_text: At that time, however, she became sick and died, and her body was washed and placed in an upper room.
aov_text: En in dié dae het sy siek geword en gesterwe, en hulle het haar gewas en in ’n bovertrek neergelê.

kjv_text: And forasmuch as Lydda was nigh to Joppa, and the disciples had heard that Peter was there, they sent unto him two men, desiring him that he would not delay to come to them.
bsb_text: Since Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples heard that Peter was there and sent two men to urge him, “Come to us without delay.”
aov_text: En omdat Lidda naby Joppe was en die dissipels gehoor het dat Petrus daar was, het hulle twee manne na hom gestuur wat hom moes smeek dat hy sonder uitstel na hulle moet oorkom.

kjv_text: Then Peter arose and went with them. When he was come, they brought him into the upper chamber: and all the widows stood by him weeping, and shewing the coats and garments which Dorcas made, while she was with them.
bsb_text: So Peter got up and went with them. On his arrival, they took him to the upper room. All the widows stood around him, weeping and showing him the tunics and other clothing that Dorcas had made while she was still with them.
aov_text: En Petrus het opgestaan en saam met hulle gegaan. En toe hy daar kom, bring hulle hom in die bovertrek; en al die weduwees kom by hom staan en ween en wys hom die onder- en bo-klere wat Dorkas alles gemaak het toe sy nog by hulle was.

kjv_text: But Peter put them all forth, and kneeled down, and prayed; and turning him to the body said, Tabitha, arise. And she opened her eyes: and when she saw Peter, she sat up.
bsb_text: Then Peter sent them all out of the room. He knelt down and prayed, and turning toward her body, he said, “Tabitha, get up!” She opened her eyes, and seeing Peter, she sat up.
aov_text: En Petrus het almal buitentoe gestuur en neergekniel en gebid. En hy het hom na die liggaam gedraai en gesê: Tabíta, staan op! En sy het haar oë oopgemaak; en toe sy Petrus sien, het sy regop gesit.

kjv_text: And he gave her his hand, and lifted her up, and when he had called the saints and widows, presented her alive.
bsb_text: Peter took her by the hand and helped her up. Then he called the saints and widows and presented her to them alive.
aov_text: En hy gee haar sy hand en laat haar opstaan. Daarop roep hy die heiliges en die weduwees en stel haar lewendig voor hulle.

kjv_text: And it was known throughout all Joppa; and many believed in the Lord.
bsb_text: This became known all over Joppa, and many people believed in the Lord.
aov_text: En dit het bekend geword in die hele Joppe, en baie het in die Here geglo.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, that he tarried many days in Joppa with one Simon a tanner.
bsb_text: And Peter stayed for several days in Joppa with a tanner named Simon.
aov_text: En hy het ’n geruime tyd in Joppe gebly by ’n sekere Simon, ’n leerlooier.

kjv_text: There was a certain man in Caesarea called Cornelius, a centurion of the band called the Italian band,
bsb_text: At Caesarea there was a man named Cornelius, a centurion in what was called the Italian Regiment.
aov_text: EN daar was in Cesaréa ’n man met die naam van Cornelius, ’n hoofman oor honderd van die sogenaamde Italiaanse leërafdeling.

kjv_text: A devout man, and one that feared God with all his house, which gave much alms to the people, and prayed to God alway.
bsb_text: He and all his household were devout and God-fearing. He gave generously to the people and prayed to God regularly.
aov_text: Hy met sy hele huis was vroom en godvresend en het baie aalmoese aan die volk gegee en was altyddeur in die gebed tot God.

kjv_text: He saw in a vision evidently about the ninth hour of the day an angel of God coming in to him, and saying unto him, Cornelius.
bsb_text: One day at about the ninth hour, he had a clear vision of an angel of God who came to him and said, “Cornelius!”
aov_text: Hy het duidelik in ’n gesig omtrent die negende uur van die dag ’n engel van God na hom sien inkom en vir hom sê: Cornelius!

kjv_text: And when he looked on him, he was afraid, and said, What is it, Lord? And he said unto him, Thy prayers and thine alms are come up for a memorial before God.
bsb_text: Cornelius stared at him in fear and asked, “What is it, Lord?” The angel answered, “Your prayers and gifts to the poor have ascended as a memorial offering before God.
aov_text: En hy het die oë op hom gehou en vol vrees gesê: Wat is dit, my heer? Toe antwoord hy hom: Jou gebede en jou aalmoese het voor God in gedagtenis gekom.

kjv_text: And now send men to Joppa, and call for one Simon, whose surname is Peter:
bsb_text: Now send men to Joppa to call for a man named Simon who is called Peter.
aov_text: Stuur dan nou manne na Joppe en laat vir Simon haal wat ook Petrus genoem word.

kjv_text: He lodgeth with one Simon a tanner, whose house is by the sea side: he shall tell thee what thou oughtest to do.
bsb_text: He is staying with Simon the tanner, whose house is by the sea.”
aov_text: Hy is tuis by ’n sekere Simon, ’n leerlooier, wie se huis by die see is. Hy sal jou sê wat jy moet doen.

kjv_text: And when the angel which spake unto Cornelius was departed, he called two of his household servants, and a devout soldier of them that waited on him continually;
bsb_text: When the angel who spoke to him had gone, Cornelius called two of his servants and a devout soldier from among his attendants.
aov_text: En toe die engel wat met Cornelius gespreek het, weg was, roep hy twee van sy huisbediendes en ’n vroom soldaat van die wat altyd by hom was,

kjv_text: And when he had declared all these things unto them, he sent them to Joppa.
bsb_text: He explained what had happened and sent them to Joppa.
aov_text: en vertel hulle alles en stuur hulle na Joppe.

kjv_text: On the morrow, as they went on their journey, and drew nigh unto the city, Peter went up upon the housetop to pray about the sixth hour:
bsb_text: The next day at about the sixth hour, as the men were approaching the city on their journey, Peter went up on the roof to pray.
aov_text: En die volgende dag, terwyl hulle op pad was en naby die stad kom, het Petrus omtrent die sesde uur op die dak geklim om te bid;

kjv_text: And he became very hungry, and would have eaten: but while they made ready, he fell into a trance,
bsb_text: He became hungry and wanted something to eat, but while the meal was being prepared, he fell into a trance.
aov_text: en hy het baie honger geword en wou eet; en terwyl hulle besig was om klaar te maak, het daar ’n verrukking van sinne oor hom gekom:

kjv_text: And saw heaven opened, and a certain vessel descending unto him, as it had been a great sheet knit at the four corners, and let down to the earth:
bsb_text: He saw heaven open and something like a large sheet being let down to earth by its four corners.
aov_text: hy sien die hemel geopend en ’n voorwerp soos ’n groot laken na hom afdaal, wat aan die vier hoeke vasgebind is en op die aarde neergelaat word.

kjv_text: Wherein were all manner of fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.
bsb_text: It contained all kinds of four-footed animals and reptiles of the earth, as well as birds of the air.
aov_text: Daarin was al die viervoetige diere van die aarde en die wilde en kruipende diere en die voëls van die hemel.

kjv_text: And there came a voice to him, Rise, Peter; kill, and eat.
bsb_text: Then a voice said to him: “Get up, Peter, kill and eat!”
aov_text: Toe kom daar ’n stem na hom: Staan op, Petrus, slag en eet!

kjv_text: But Peter said, Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten any thing that is common or unclean.
bsb_text: “No, Lord!” Peter answered. “I have never eaten anything impure or unclean.”
aov_text: En Petrus sê: Nooit nie, Here, want ek het nooit iets onheiligs of onreins geëet nie.

kjv_text: And the voice spake unto him again the second time, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.
bsb_text: The voice spoke to him a second time: “Do not call anything impure that God has made clean.”
aov_text: En weer het die stem vir die tweede keer na hom gekom: Wat God rein gemaak het, mag jy nie onheilig ag nie.

kjv_text: This was done thrice: and the vessel was received up again into heaven.
bsb_text: This happened three times, and all at once the sheet was taken back up into heaven.
aov_text: En dit het drie maal gebeur, en die voorwerp is weer in die hemel opgeneem.

kjv_text: Now while Peter doubted in himself what this vision which he had seen should mean, behold, the men which were sent from Cornelius had made enquiry for Simon's house, and stood before the gate,
bsb_text: While Peter was puzzling over the meaning of the vision, the men sent by Cornelius found Simon’s house and approached the gate.
aov_text: En terwyl Petrus by homself daaroor verleë was wat die gesig tog kon beteken wat hy gesien het, staan die manne wat deur Cornelius gestuur was, daar by die poort en verneem na die huis van Simon.

kjv_text: And called, and asked whether Simon, which was surnamed Peter, were lodged there.
bsb_text: They called out to ask if Simon called Peter was staying there.
aov_text: En hulle roep en vra of Simon, wat ook Petrus genoem word, daar tuis is.

kjv_text: While Peter thought on the vision, the Spirit said unto him, Behold, three men seek thee.
bsb_text: As Peter continued to reflect on the vision, the Spirit said to him, “Behold, three men are looking for you.
aov_text: En terwyl Petrus nadink oor die gesig, sê die Gees vir hom: Daar is drie manne wat jou soek.

kjv_text: Arise therefore, and get thee down, and go with them, doubting nothing: for I have sent them.
bsb_text: So get up! Go downstairs and accompany them without hesitation, because I have sent them.”
aov_text: Staan dan op, klim af en gaan saam met hulle sonder om te twyfel, want Ek het hulle gestuur.

kjv_text: Then Peter went down to the men which were sent unto him from Cornelius; and said, Behold, I am he whom ye seek: what is the cause wherefore ye are come?
bsb_text: So Peter went down to the men and said, “Here am I, the one you are looking for. Why have you come?”
aov_text: En Petrus het afgeklim na die manne wat deur Cornelius na hom gestuur was, en gesê: Kyk, dit is ek wat julle soek. Wat is die rede waarom julle hier is?

kjv_text: And they said, Cornelius the centurion, a just man, and one that feareth God, and of good report among all the nation of the Jews, was warned from God by an holy angel to send for thee into his house, and to hear words of thee.
bsb_text: “Cornelius the centurion has sent us,” they said. “He is a righteous and God-fearing man with a good reputation among the whole Jewish nation. A holy angel instructed him to request your presence in his home so he could hear a message from you.”
aov_text: En hulle sê: Cornelius, ’n hoofman oor honderd, ’n regverdige en godvresende man, wat ’n goeie naam het by die hele Joodse nasie, het ’n goddelike openbaring ontvang deur ’n heilige engel, om u te laat haal na sy huis om te hoor wat u sal sê.

kjv_text: Then called he them in, and lodged them. And on the morrow Peter went away with them, and certain brethren from Joppa accompanied him.
bsb_text: So Peter invited them in as his guests. And the next day he got ready and went with them, accompanied by some of the brothers from Joppa.
aov_text: En hy het hulle binnegenooi en geherberg. En die volgende dag het Petrus saam met hulle afgereis, en enkele van die broeders uit Joppe het met hom saamgegaan.

kjv_text: And the morrow after they entered into Caesarea. And Cornelius waited for them, and had called together his kinsmen and near friends.
bsb_text: The following day he arrived in Caesarea, where Cornelius was expecting them and had called together his relatives and close friends.
aov_text: Die dag daarop het hulle in Cesaréa aangekom. En Cornelius was hulle te wagte, en hy het alreeds sy familie en besondere vriende bymekaargeroep.

kjv_text: And as Peter was coming in, Cornelius met him, and fell down at his feet, and worshipped him.
bsb_text: As Peter was about to enter, Cornelius met him and fell at his feet to worship him.
aov_text: Toe Petrus dan binnekom, het Cornelius hom tegemoetgegaan en aan sy voete neergeval en hom hulde bewys.

kjv_text: But Peter took him up, saying, Stand up; I myself also am a man.
bsb_text: But Peter helped him up. “Stand up,” he said, “I am only a man myself.”
aov_text: Maar Petrus het hom opgerig en gesê: Staan op, ek is self ook maar ’n mens.

kjv_text: And as he talked with him, he went in, and found many that were come together.
bsb_text: As Peter talked with him, he went inside and found many people gathered together.
aov_text: En onderwyl hy met hom spreek, gaan hy binne en vind baie wat vergader het;

kjv_text: And he said unto them, Ye know how that it is an unlawful thing for a man that is a Jew to keep company, or come unto one of another nation; but God hath shewed me that I should not call any man common or unclean.
bsb_text: He said to them, “You know how unlawful it is for a Jew to associate with a foreigner or visit him. But God has shown me that I should not call any man impure or unclean.
aov_text: en hy sê vir hulle: Julle weet dat dit ongeoorloof is vir ’n Joodse man om met iemand van ’n ander volk omgang te hê of hom te besoek; maar God het my getoon dat ek geen mens onheilig of onrein mag noem nie.

kjv_text: Therefore came I unto you without gainsaying, as soon as I was sent for: I ask therefore for what intent ye have sent for me?
bsb_text: So when I was invited, I came without objection. I ask, then, why have you sent for me?”
aov_text: Daarom het ek, toe ek gehaal is, gekom sonder om teë te spreek. Ek vra dan om watter rede julle my laat haal het.

kjv_text: And Cornelius said, Four days ago I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour I prayed in my house,
bsb_text: Cornelius answered: “Four days ago I was in my house praying at this, the ninth hour.
aov_text: En Cornelius sê: Vier dae gelede was ek besig om te vas tot op hierdie uur, en die negende uur het ek in my huis gebid,

kjv_text: and, behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing,
bsb_text: Suddenly a man in radiant clothing stood before me
aov_text: en meteens staan daar ’n man voor my in ’n blink kleed

kjv_text: And said, Cornelius, thy prayer is heard, and thine alms are had in remembrance in the sight of God.
bsb_text: and said, ‘Cornelius, your prayer has been heard, and your gifts to the poor have been remembered before God.
aov_text: en sê: Cornelius, jou gebed is verhoor en jou aalmoese is voor God in herinnering gebring.

kjv_text: Send therefore to Joppa, and call hither Simon, whose surname is Peter; he is lodged in the house of one Simon a tanner by the sea side: who, when he cometh, shall speak unto thee.
bsb_text: Therefore send to Joppa for Simon, who is called Peter. He is a guest in the home of Simon the tanner, by the sea.’
aov_text: Stuur dan na Joppe en laat Simon haal wat ook Petrus genoem word. Hy vertoef in die huis van Simon, ’n leerlooier, by die see; as hy kom, sal hy met jou spreek.

kjv_text: Immediately therefore I sent to thee; and thou hast well done that thou art come. Now therefore are we all here present before God, to hear all things that are commanded thee of God.
bsb_text: So I sent for you immediately, and you were kind enough to come. Now then, we are all here in the presence of God to listen to everything the Lord has instructed you to tell us.”
aov_text: Ek het toe op die daad na u gestuur, en u het goed gedoen om te kom. Ons is dan nou almal voor die aangesig van God aanwesig om alles te hoor wat deur God aan u opgedra is.

kjv_text: Then Peter opened his mouth, and said, Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons:
bsb_text: Then Peter began to speak: “I now truly understand that God does not show favoritism,
aov_text: En Petrus het sy mond geopen en gesê: Ek sien waarlik dat God geen aannemer van die persoon is nie,

kjv_text: But in every nation he that feareth him, and worketh righteousness, is accepted with him.
bsb_text: but welcomes those from every nation who fear Him and do what is right.
aov_text: maar dat in elke nasie die een wat Hom vrees en geregtigheid doen, Hom welgevallig is.

kjv_text: The word which God sent unto the children of Israel, preaching peace by Jesus Christ: (he is Lord of all:)
bsb_text: He has sent this message to the people of Israel, proclaiming the gospel of peace through Jesus Christ, who is Lord of all.
aov_text: Dit is die woord wat Hy gestuur het aan die kinders van Israel toe Hy die evangelie van vrede verkondig het deur Jesus Christus — Hy is die Here van almal.

kjv_text: That word, I say, ye know, which was published throughout all Judaea, and began from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;
bsb_text: You yourselves know what has happened throughout Judea, beginning in Galilee with the baptism that John proclaimed:
aov_text: Julle weet van die saak wat deur die hele Judéa gebeur het en van Galiléa af begin het, ná die doop wat Johannes gepreek het,

kjv_text: How God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Ghost and with power: who went about doing good, and healing all that were oppressed of the devil; for God was with him.
bsb_text: how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power, and how Jesus went around doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, because God was with Him.
aov_text: met betrekking tot Jesus van Násaret, hoe God Hom gesalf het met die Heilige Gees en met krag. Hy het die land deurgegaan, goed gedoen en almal genees wat onder die mag van die duiwel was, omdat God met Hom was.

kjv_text: And we are witnesses of all things which he did both in the land of the Jews, and in Jerusalem; whom they slew and hanged on a tree:
bsb_text: We are witnesses of all that He did, both in the land of the Jews and in Jerusalem. And although they put Him to death by hanging Him on a tree,
aov_text: En ons is getuies van alles wat Hy gedoen het in die Joodse land en in Jerusalem. En hulle het Hom omgebring deur Hom aan ’n kruishout op te hang.

kjv_text: Him God raised up the third day, and shewed him openly;
bsb_text: God raised Him up on the third day and caused Him to be seen—
aov_text: Hom het God op die derde dag opgewek en beskik dat Hy sou verskyn

kjv_text: Not to all the people, but unto witnesses chosen before of God, even to us, who did eat and drink with him after he rose from the dead.
bsb_text: not by all the people, but by the witnesses God had chosen beforehand, by us who ate and drank with Him after He rose from the dead.
aov_text: nie aan die hele volk nie, maar aan getuies wat deur God vantevore verkies is, aan ons wat met Hom saam geëet en gedrink het nadat Hy uit die dode opgestaan het.

kjv_text: And he commanded us to preach unto the people, and to testify that it is he which was ordained of God to be the Judge of quick and dead.
bsb_text: And He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that He is the One appointed by God to judge the living and the dead.
aov_text: En Hy het ons bevel gegee om aan die volk te verkondig en met krag te betuig dat dit Hy is wat deur God bestem is as Regter van lewende en dode.

kjv_text: To him give all the prophets witness, that through his name whosoever believeth in him shall receive remission of sins.
bsb_text: All the prophets testify about Him that everyone who believes in Him receives forgiveness of sins through His name.”
aov_text: Aangaande Hom getuig al die profete dat elkeen wat in Hom glo, vergifnis van sondes deur sy Naam ontvang.

kjv_text: While Peter yet spake these words, the Holy Ghost fell on all them which heard the word.
bsb_text: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit fell upon all who heard his message.
aov_text: En toe Petrus nog besig was om hierdie woorde te spreek, het die Heilige Gees op almal geval wat die woord gehoor het.

kjv_text: And they of the circumcision which believed were astonished, as many as came with Peter, because that on the Gentiles also was poured out the gift of the Holy Ghost.
bsb_text: All the circumcised believers who had accompanied Peter were astounded that the gift of the Holy Spirit had been poured out even on the Gentiles.
aov_text: En die gelowiges uit die besnydenis, almal wat saam met Petrus gekom het, was verbaas dat die gawe van die Heilige Gees ook op die heidene uitgestort is.

kjv_text: For they heard them speak with tongues, and magnify God. Then answered Peter,
bsb_text: For they heard them speaking in tongues and exalting God. Then Peter said,
aov_text: Want hulle het gehoor hoe hulle in tale spreek en God groot maak. Toe het Petrus begin spreek:

kjv_text: Can any man forbid water, that these should not be baptized, which have received the Holy Ghost as well as we?
bsb_text: “Can anyone withhold the water to baptize these people? They have received the Holy Spirit just as we have!”
aov_text: Niemand kan tog die water weer, dat hierdie mense, wat net soos ons die Heilige Gees ontvang het, nie gedoop word nie?

kjv_text: And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of the Lord. Then prayed they him to tarry certain days.
bsb_text: So he ordered that they be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked him to stay for a few days.
aov_text: En hy het beveel dat hulle gedoop moet word in die Naam van die Here. Toe het hulle hom gevra om nog ’n paar dae te bly.

kjv_text: And the apostles and brethren that were in Judaea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.
bsb_text: The apostles and brothers throughout Judea soon heard that the Gentiles also had received the word of God.
aov_text: EN die apostels en die broeders wat in Judéa was, het gehoor dat die heidene ook die woord van God aangeneem het.

kjv_text: And when Peter was come up to Jerusalem, they that were of the circumcision contended with him,
bsb_text: So when Peter went up to Jerusalem, the circumcised believers took issue with him
aov_text: En toe Petrus opgaan na Jerusalem, het die wat uit die besnydenis was, met hom getwis

kjv_text: Saying, Thou wentest in to men uncircumcised, and didst eat with them.
bsb_text: and said, “You visited uncircumcised men and ate with them.”
aov_text: en gesê: By onbesnede manne het jy in die huis gegaan en saam met hulle geëet.

kjv_text: But Peter rehearsed the matter from the beginning, and expounded it by order unto them, saying,
bsb_text: But Peter began and explained to them the whole sequence of events:
aov_text: En Petrus het begin en vir hulle die loop van die saak uiteengesit en gesê:

kjv_text: I was in the city of Joppa praying: and in a trance I saw a vision, A certain vessel descend, as it had been a great sheet, let down from heaven by four corners; and it came even to me:
bsb_text: “I was in the city of Joppa praying, and in a trance I saw a vision of something like a large sheet being let down from heaven by its four corners, and it came right down to me.
aov_text: Ek was in die stad Joppe in die gebed, en in ’n verrukking van sinne het ek ’n gesig gesien: ’n voorwerp het uit die hemel neergedaal soos ’n groot laken wat aan die vier hoeke uit die hemel neergelaat word, en dit het tot by my gekom.

kjv_text: Upon the which when I had fastened mine eyes, I considered, and saw fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.
bsb_text: I looked at it closely and saw four-footed animals of the earth, wild beasts, reptiles, and birds of the air.
aov_text: En toe ek die oë daarop hou en dit waarneem, sien ek die viervoetige diere van die aarde en die wilde en die kruipende diere en die voëls van die hemel.

kjv_text: And I heard a voice saying unto me, Arise, Peter; slay and eat.
bsb_text: Then I heard a voice saying to me, ‘Get up, Peter, kill and eat.’
aov_text: En ek hoor ’n stem vir my sê: Staan op, Petrus, slag en eet!

kjv_text: But I said, Not so, Lord: for nothing common or unclean hath at any time entered into my mouth.
bsb_text: ‘No, Lord,’ I said, ‘for nothing impure or unclean has ever entered my mouth.’
aov_text: Maar ek antwoord: Nooit nie, Here, want niks onheiligs of onreins het ooit in my mond ingegaan nie.

kjv_text: But the voice answered me again from heaven, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.
bsb_text: But the voice spoke from heaven a second time, ‘Do not call anything impure that God has made clean.’
aov_text: En die stem het die tweede keer my uit die hemel geantwoord: Wat God rein gemaak het, mag jy nie onheilig ag nie.

kjv_text: And this was done three times: and all were drawn up again into heaven.
bsb_text: This happened three times, and everything was drawn back up into heaven.
aov_text: En dit het drie maal gebeur en alles is weer opgetrek in die hemel.

kjv_text: And, behold, immediately there were three men already come unto the house where I was, sent from Caesarea unto me.
bsb_text: Just then three men sent to me from Caesarea stopped at the house where I was staying.
aov_text: En dadelik staan daar drie manne voor die huis waar ek in was, wat van Cesaréa na my gestuur was.

kjv_text: And the Spirit bade me go with them, nothing doubting. Moreover these six brethren accompanied me, and we entered into the man's house:
bsb_text: The Spirit told me to accompany them without hesitation. These six brothers also went with me, and we entered the man’s home.
aov_text: En die Gees het vir my gesê dat ek saam met hulle moes gaan sonder om te twyfel. En saam met my het ook hierdie ses broeders gegaan, en ons het in die huis van die man ingegaan.

kjv_text: And he shewed us how he had seen an angel in his house, which stood and said unto him, Send men to Joppa, and call for Simon, whose surname is Peter;
bsb_text: He told us how he had seen an angel standing in his house and saying, ‘Send to Joppa for Simon who is called Peter.
aov_text: En hy het ons vertel hoe hy die engel in sy huis sien staan het en vir hom sê: Stuur manne na Joppe en laat vir Simon haal wat ook Petrus genoem word;

kjv_text: Who shall tell thee words, whereby thou and all thy house shall be saved.
bsb_text: He will convey to you a message by which you and all your household will be saved.’
aov_text: hy sal woorde tot jou spreek waardeur jy en jou hele huis gered sal word.

kjv_text: And as I began to speak, the Holy Ghost fell on them, as on us at the beginning.
bsb_text: As I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell upon them, just as He had fallen upon us at the beginning.
aov_text: En toe ek begin spreek, het die Heilige Gees op hulle geval soos ook op ons in die begin.

kjv_text: Then remembered I the word of the Lord, how that he said, John indeed baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost.
bsb_text: Then I remembered the word of the Lord, as He used to say, ‘John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.’
aov_text: En ek het die woord van die Here onthou, hoe Hy gesê het: Johannes het met water gedoop, maar julle sal met die Heilige Gees gedoop word.

kjv_text: Forasmuch then as God gave them the like gift as he did unto us, who believed on the Lord Jesus Christ; what was I, that I could withstand God?
bsb_text: So if God gave them the same gift He gave us who believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I to hinder the work of God?”
aov_text: As God dan aan hulle dieselfde gawe gegee het soos aan ons wat in die Here Jesus Christus geglo het, wie was ek dan, dat ek God kon verhinder?

kjv_text: When they heard these things, they held their peace, and glorified God, saying, Then hath God also to the Gentiles granted repentance unto life.
bsb_text: When they heard this, their objections were put to rest, and they glorified God, saying, “So then, God has granted even the Gentiles repentance unto life.”
aov_text: En toe hulle dit hoor, het hulle geswyg en God verheerlik en gesê: So het God dan ook aan die heidene die bekering tot die lewe geskenk.

kjv_text: Now they which were scattered abroad upon the persecution that arose about Stephen travelled as far as Phenice, and Cyprus, and Antioch, preaching the word to none but unto the Jews only.
bsb_text: Meanwhile those scattered by the persecution that began with Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, speaking the message only to Jews.
aov_text: DIE wat dan verstrooi was deur die verdrukking wat oor Stéfanus ontstaan het, het die land deurgegaan tot by Fenícië en Ciprus en Antiochíë sonder om tot iemand die woord te spreek, behalwe tot die Jode alleen.

kjv_text: And some of them were men of Cyprus and Cyrene, which, when they were come to Antioch, spake unto the Grecians, preaching the LORD Jesus.
bsb_text: But some of them, men from Cyprus and Cyrene, went to Antioch and began speaking to the Greeks as well, proclaiming the good news about the Lord Jesus.
aov_text: En daar was sommige van hulle, Cipriese en Cirenése manne, wat in Antiochíë gekom het en met die Griekssprekende Jode gepraat en die evangelie van die Here Jesus verkondig het.

kjv_text: And the hand of the Lord was with them: and a great number believed, and turned unto the Lord.
bsb_text: The hand of the Lord was with them, and a great number of people believed and turned to the Lord.
aov_text: En die hand van die Here was met hulle, en ’n groot getal het gelowig geword en hulle tot die Here bekeer.

kjv_text: Then tidings of these things came unto the ears of the church which was in Jerusalem: and they sent forth Barnabas, that he should go as far as Antioch.
bsb_text: When news of this reached the ears of the church in Jerusalem, they sent Barnabas to Antioch.
aov_text: En die berig hiervan het die gemeente wat in Jerusalem was, ter ore gekom en hulle het Bárnabas afgestuur om die land deur te gaan tot by Antiochíë.

kjv_text: Who, when he came, and had seen the grace of God, was glad, and exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they would cleave unto the Lord.
bsb_text: When he arrived and saw the grace of God, he rejoiced and encouraged them all to abide in the Lord with all their hearts.
aov_text: Toe hy daar kom en die genade van God sien, was hy bly en het almal vermaan om met hartlike voorneme aan die Here getrou te bly;

kjv_text: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Ghost and of faith: and much people was added unto the Lord.
bsb_text: Barnabas was a good man, full of the Holy Spirit and faith, and a great number of people were brought to the Lord.
aov_text: want hy was ’n goeie man en vol van die Heilige Gees en geloof; en ’n aansienlike skare is aan die Here toegebring.

kjv_text: Then departed Barnabas to Tarsus, for to seek Saul:
bsb_text: Then Barnabas went to Tarsus to look for Saul,
aov_text: Toe vertrek Bárnabas na Tarsus om Saulus te soek, en toe hy hom kry, het hy hom na Antiochíë gebring.

kjv_text: And when he had found him, he brought him unto Antioch. And it came to pass, that a whole year they assembled themselves with the church, and taught much people. And the disciples were called Christians first in Antioch.
bsb_text: and when he found him, he brought him back to Antioch. So for a full year they met together with the church and taught large numbers of people. The disciples were first called Christians at Antioch.
aov_text: En hulle het ’n hele jaar lank in die gemeente saam vergader en aan ’n aansienlike skare onderwys gegee; en die dissipels is in Antiochíë vir die eerste keer Christene genoem.

kjv_text: And in these days came prophets from Jerusalem unto Antioch.
bsb_text: In those days some prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.
aov_text: En in dié dae het daar profete van Jerusalem na Antiochíë afgekom.

kjv_text: And there stood up one of them named Agabus, and signified by the Spirit that there should be great dearth throughout all the world: which came to pass in the days of Claudius Caesar.
bsb_text: One of them named Agabus stood up and predicted through the Spirit that a great famine would sweep across the whole world. (This happened under Claudius.)
aov_text: En een van hulle met die naam van Ágabus het opgestaan en deur die Heilige Gees te kenne gegee dat daar ’n groot hongersnood oor die hele wêreld sou kom, wat ook gekom het onder keiser Claudius.

kjv_text: Then the disciples, every man according to his ability, determined to send relief unto the brethren which dwelt in Judaea:
bsb_text: So the disciples, each according to his ability, decided to send relief to the brothers living in Judea.
aov_text: En die dissipels het besluit dat iedereen van hulle na sy vermoë iets sou stuur tot versorging van die broeders wat in Judéa woon.

kjv_text: Which also they did, and sent it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.
bsb_text: This they did, sending their gifts to the elders with Barnabas and Saul.
aov_text: En dit het hulle ook gedoen en dit deur Bárnabas en Saulus aan die ouderlinge gestuur.

kjv_text: Now about that time Herod the king stretched forth his hands to vex certain of the church.
bsb_text: About that time, King Herod reached out to harm some who belonged to the church.
aov_text: EN omtrent daardie tyd het koning Herodes sy hande geslaan aan sommige uit die gemeente om hulle kwaad aan te doen.

kjv_text: And he killed James the brother of John with the sword.
bsb_text: He had James, the brother of John, put to death with the sword.
aov_text: En hy het Jakobus, die broer van Johannes, met die swaard omgebring.

kjv_text: And because he saw it pleased the Jews, he proceeded further to take Peter also. (Then were the days of unleavened bread.)
bsb_text: And seeing that this pleased the Jews, Herod proceeded to seize Peter during the Feast of Unleavened Bread.
aov_text: En toe hy sien dat dit die Jode welgevallig was, het hy verder ook Petrus in hegtenis geneem. En dit was die dae van die ongesuurde brode.

kjv_text: And when he had apprehended him, he put him in prison, and delivered him to four quaternions of soldiers to keep him; intending after Easter to bring him forth to the people.
bsb_text: He arrested him and put him in prison, handing him over to be guarded by four squads of four soldiers each. Herod intended to bring him out to the people after the Passover.
aov_text: Toe hy hom dan gegryp het, het hy hom in die gevangenis gesit en oorgegee aan vier wagte, elkeen van vier soldate, om hom te bewaak, met die bedoeling om hom ná die paasfees voor die volk te bring.

kjv_text: Peter therefore was kept in prison: but prayer was made without ceasing of the church unto God for him.
bsb_text: So Peter was kept in prison, but the church was fervently praying to God for him.
aov_text: So is Petrus dan in die gevangenis bewaak; maar daar het ’n aanhoudende gebed tot God deur die gemeente vir hom opgegaan.

kjv_text: And when Herod would have brought him forth, the same night Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains: and the keepers before the door kept the prison.
bsb_text: On the night before Herod was to bring him to trial, Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains, with sentries standing guard at the entrance to the prison.
aov_text: En toe Herodes hom wou voorbring, het Petrus in daardie nag tussen twee soldate geslaap, met twee kettings geboei, en wagte voor die deur het die gevangenis bewaak.

kjv_text: And, behold, the angel of the Lord came upon him, and a light shined in the prison: and he smote Peter on the side, and raised him up, saying, Arise up quickly. And his chains fell off from his hands.
bsb_text: Suddenly an angel of the Lord appeared and a light shone in the cell. He tapped Peter on the side and woke him up, saying, “Get up quickly.” And the chains fell off his wrists.
aov_text: En meteens staan daar ’n engel van die Here by hom, en ’n lig skyn in die gevangenis. Toe slaan hy Petrus op die sy, maak hom wakker en sê: Staan gou op! En die boeie het van sy hande afgeval.

kjv_text: And the angel said unto him, Gird thyself, and bind on thy sandals. And so he did. And he saith unto him, Cast thy garment about thee, and follow me.
bsb_text: “Get dressed and put on your sandals,” said the angel. Peter did so, and the angel told him, “Wrap your cloak around you and follow me.”
aov_text: En die engel sê vir hom: Omgord jou en trek jou skoene aan! En hy het dit gedoen. Verder sê hy vir hom: Gooi jou bo-kleed om en volg my!

kjv_text: And he went out, and followed him; and wist not that it was true which was done by the angel; but thought he saw a vision.
bsb_text: So Peter followed him out, but he was unaware that what the angel was doing was real. He thought he was only seeing a vision.
aov_text: En hy het uitgegaan en hom gevolg; en hy het nie geweet dat wat deur die engel plaasgevind het, werklikheid was nie, maar hy het gemeen dat hy ’n gesig sien.

kjv_text: When they were past the first and the second ward, they came unto the iron gate that leadeth unto the city; which opened to them of his own accord: and they went out, and passed on through one street; and forthwith the angel departed from him.
bsb_text: They passed the first and second guards and came to the iron gate leading to the city, which opened for them by itself. When they had gone outside and walked the length of one block, the angel suddenly left him.
aov_text: En toe hulle by die eerste en die tweede wag verbygegaan het, kom hulle by die ysterpoort wat na die stad lei, en dit het vanself vir hulle oopgegaan. En hulle het buitekant gekom en een straat ver gegaan, en dadelik het die engel hom verlaat.

kjv_text: And when Peter was come to himself, he said, Now I know of a surety, that the LORD hath sent his angel, and hath delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from all the expectation of the people of the Jews.
bsb_text: Then Peter came to himself and said, “Now I know for sure that the Lord has sent His angel and rescued me from Herod’s grasp and from everything the Jewish people were anticipating.”
aov_text: Toe kom Petrus tot homself en sê: Nou weet ek waarlik dat die Here sy engel gestuur en my gered het uit die hand van Herodes en uit al die verwagtinge van die Joodse volk.

kjv_text: And when he had considered the thing, he came to the house of Mary the mother of John, whose surname was Mark; where many were gathered together praying.
bsb_text: And when he had realized this, he went to the house of Mary the mother of John, also called Mark, where many people had gathered together and were praying.
aov_text: En nadat dit vir hom duidelik geword het, kom hy by die huis van Maria, die moeder van Johannes wat ook Markus genoem word, waar baie in die gebed bymekaar was.

kjv_text: And as Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a damsel came to hearken, named Rhoda.
bsb_text: He knocked at the outer gate, and a servant girl named Rhoda came to answer it.
aov_text: En toe Petrus aan die deur van die poort klop, het ’n diensmeisie met die naam van Rhodé gegaan om te hoor wie daar was.

kjv_text: And when she knew Peter's voice, she opened not the gate for gladness, but ran in, and told how Peter stood before the gate.
bsb_text: When she recognized Peter’s voice, she was so overjoyed that she forgot to open the gate, but ran inside and announced, “Peter is standing at the gate!”
aov_text: En sy het die stem van Petrus herken en van blydskap die poort nie oopgemaak nie, maar na binne gehardloop en vertel dat Petrus voor die poort staan.

kjv_text: And they said unto her, Thou art mad. But she constantly affirmed that it was even so. Then said they, It is his angel.
bsb_text: “You are out of your mind,” they told her. But when she kept insisting it was so, they said, “It must be his angel.”
aov_text: Maar hulle sê vir haar: Jy is van jou verstand af. Maar sy het volgehou dat dit so is. Daarop sê hulle: Dit is sy engel.

kjv_text: But Peter continued knocking: and when they had opened the door, and saw him, they were astonished.
bsb_text: But Peter kept on knocking, and when they opened the door and saw him, they were astounded.
aov_text: En Petrus het aangehou met klop; en toe hulle oopmaak, sien hulle hom en was verbaas.

kjv_text: But he, beckoning unto them with the hand to hold their peace, declared unto them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. And he said, Go shew these things unto James, and to the brethren. And he departed, and went into another place.
bsb_text: Peter motioned with his hand for silence, and he described how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. “Send word to James and to the brothers,” he said, and he left for another place.
aov_text: Maar hy het hulle met die hand gewink om stil te bly en aan hulle vertel hoe die Here hom uit die gevangenis uitgelei het. En hy sê: Vertel dit aan Jakobus en die broeders. En hy het uitgegaan en na ’n ander plek vertrek.

kjv_text: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers, what was become of Peter.
bsb_text: At daybreak there was no small commotion among the soldiers as to what had become of Peter.
aov_text: En toe dit dag geword het, was daar onder die soldate geen kleine opskudding oor wat van Petrus geword het nie.

kjv_text: And when Herod had sought for him, and found him not, he examined the keepers, and commanded that they should be put to death. And he went down from Judaea to Caesarea, and there abode.
bsb_text: After Herod had searched for him unsuccessfully, he examined the guards and ordered that they be executed. Then he went down from Judea to Caesarea and spent some time there.
aov_text: Daarop het Herodes hom gesoek en nie gekry nie, en die wagte onder verhoor geneem en bevel gegee dat hulle tereggestel moes word. En hy het van Judéa weggegaan na Cesaréa en daar gebly.

kjv_text: And Herod was highly displeased with them of Tyre and Sidon: but they came with one accord to him, and, having made Blastus the king's chamberlain their friend, desired peace; because their country was nourished by the king's country.
bsb_text: Now Herod was in a furious dispute with the people of Tyre and Sidon, and they convened before him. Having secured the support of Blastus, the king’s chamberlain, they asked for peace, because their region depended on the king’s country for food.
aov_text: En Herodes was verbitterd teen die Tiriërs en Sidóniërs. En hulle het eenparig na hom gekom, en nadat hulle Blastus, die koning se hofdienaar, omgepraat het, vrede gevra, omdat hulle land onderhoud uit die koning s’n ontvang het.

kjv_text: And upon a set day Herod, arrayed in royal apparel, sat upon his throne, and made an oration unto them.
bsb_text: On the appointed day, Herod donned his royal robes, sat on his throne, and addressed the people.
aov_text: En op ’n bepaalde dag het Herodes ’n koninklike kleed aangetrek en op die troon gaan sit en hulle toegespreek.

kjv_text: And the people gave a shout, saying, It is the voice of a god, and not of a man.
bsb_text: And they began to shout, “This is the voice of a god, not a man!”
aov_text: Daarop het die volk hom toegeroep: ’n Stem van ’n god en nie van ’n mens nie!

kjv_text: And immediately the angel of the Lord smote him, because he gave not God the glory: and he was eaten of worms, and gave up the ghost.
bsb_text: Immediately, because Herod did not give glory to God, an angel of the Lord struck him down, and he was eaten by worms and died.
aov_text: En onmiddellik het ’n engel van die Here hom getref, omdat hy die eer nie aan God gegee het nie; en hy is deur wurms verteer en het gesterwe.

kjv_text: But the word of God grew and multiplied.
bsb_text: But the word of God continued to spread and multiply.
aov_text: Maar die woord van God het gegroei en toegeneem.

kjv_text: And Barnabas and Saul returned from Jerusalem, when they had fulfilled their ministry, and took with them John, whose surname was Mark.
bsb_text: When Barnabas and Saul had fulfilled their mission to Jerusalem, they returned, bringing with them John, also called Mark.
aov_text: En Bárnabas en Saulus het van Jerusalem teruggekeer, nadat hulle hul diens vervul het, en hulle het Johannes saamgeneem, wat ook Markus genoem word.

kjv_text: Now there were in the church that was at Antioch certain prophets and teachers; as Barnabas, and Simeon that was called Niger, and Lucius of Cyrene, and Manaen, which had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.
bsb_text: Now in the church at Antioch there were prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen (who had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch), and Saul.
aov_text: EN daar was in die plaaslike gemeente in Antiochíë sekere profete en leraars, naamlik Bárnabas en Simeon wat Niger genoem word, en Lúcius, die Cirenéër, en Manáen, wat saam met Herodes, die viervors, grootgeword het, en Saulus.

kjv_text: As they ministered to the Lord, and fasted, the Holy Ghost said, Separate me Barnabas and Saul for the work whereunto I have called them.
bsb_text: While they were worshiping the Lord and fasting, the Holy Spirit said, “Set apart for Me Barnabas and Saul for the work to which I have called them.”
aov_text: En terwyl hulle besig was om die Here te dien en te vas, het die Heilige Gees gesê: Sonder nou Bárnabas en Saulus vir My af vir die werk waarvoor Ek hulle geroep het.

kjv_text: And when they had fasted and prayed, and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.
bsb_text: And after they had fasted and prayed, they laid their hands on them and sent them off.
aov_text: En toe hulle gevas en gebid het en hulle die hande opgelê het, laat hulle hul gaan.

kjv_text: So they, being sent forth by the Holy Ghost, departed unto Seleucia; and from thence they sailed to Cyprus.
bsb_text: So Barnabas and Saul, sent forth by the Holy Spirit, went down to Seleucia and sailed from there to Cyprus.
aov_text: So het hulle dan, deur die Heilige Gees uitgestuur, afgegaan na Seleúcië en daarvandaan weggevaar na Ciprus.

kjv_text: And when they were at Salamis, they preached the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews: and they had also John to their minister.
bsb_text: When they arrived at Salamis, they proclaimed the word of God in the Jewish synagogues. And John was with them as their helper.
aov_text: En toe hulle in Sálamis kom, het hulle die woord van God in die sinagoges van die Jode verkondig; en hulle het ook Johannes as helper gehad.

kjv_text: And when they had gone through the isle unto Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew, whose name was Barjesus:
bsb_text: They traveled through the whole island as far as Paphos, where they found a Jewish sorcerer and false prophet named Bar-Jesus,
aov_text: En hulle het die eiland deurgegaan tot by Pafos en ’n towenaar gevind, ’n valse profeet, ’n Jood met die naam van Bar-Jesus.

kjv_text: Which was with the deputy of the country, Sergius Paulus, a prudent man; who called for Barnabas and Saul, and desired to hear the word of God.
bsb_text: an attendant of the proconsul, Sergius Paulus. The proconsul, a man of intelligence, summoned Barnabas and Saul because he wanted to hear the word of God.
aov_text: Hy was by die goewerneur Sérgius Paulus, ’n verstandige man. Dié het Bárnabas en Saulus laat roep en het versoek om die woord van God te hoor.

kjv_text: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn away the deputy from the faith.
bsb_text: But Elymas the sorcerer (for that is what his name means) opposed them and tried to turn the proconsul from the faith.
aov_text: Maar Élimas die towenaar — want so word sy naam vertaal — het hulle teëgestaan en het probeer om die goewerneur afkerig te maak van die geloof.

kjv_text: Then Saul, (who also is called Paul,) filled with the Holy Ghost, set his eyes on him,
bsb_text: Then Saul, who was also called Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, looked directly at Elymas
aov_text: Maar Saulus, dit is Paulus, vervul met die Heilige Gees, het die oë op hom gehou en gesê:

kjv_text: And said, O full of all subtilty and all mischief, thou child of the devil, thou enemy of all righteousness, wilt thou not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?
bsb_text: and said, “O child of the devil and enemy of all righteousness, you are full of all kinds of deceit and trickery! Will you never stop perverting the straight ways of the Lord?
aov_text: Kind van die duiwel, vol van alle bedrog en alle listigheid, vyand van alle geregtigheid, sal jy nie ophou om die reguit weë van die Here te verdraai nie?

kjv_text: And now, behold, the hand of the Lord is upon thee, and thou shalt be blind, not seeing the sun for a season. And immediately there fell on him a mist and a darkness; and he went about seeking some to lead him by the hand.
bsb_text: Now look, the hand of the Lord is against you, and for a time you will be blind and unable to see the light of the sun.” Immediately mist and darkness came over him, and he groped about, seeking someone to lead him by the hand.
aov_text: En nou, kyk, die hand van die Here is op jou, en jy sal blind wees en die son ’n tyd lank nie sien nie. En onmiddellik het daar donkerheid en duisternis op hom geval, en hy het rondgegaan en gesoek na mense wat hom by die hand kon lei.

kjv_text: Then the deputy, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the doctrine of the Lord.
bsb_text: When the proconsul saw what had happened, he believed, for he was astonished at the teaching about the Lord.
aov_text: Toe die goewerneur dan sien wat daar gebeur het, was hy verslae oor die leer van die Here en het geglo.

kjv_text: Now when Paul and his company loosed from Paphos, they came to Perga in Pamphylia: and John departing from them returned to Jerusalem.
bsb_text: After setting sail from Paphos, Paul and his companions came to Perga in Pamphylia, where John left them to return to Jerusalem.
aov_text: EN Paulus en sy metgeselle het afgevaar van Pafos en by Perge in Pamfílië gekom. En Johannes het hulle verlaat en na Jerusalem teruggekeer.

kjv_text: But when they departed from Perga, they came to Antioch in Pisidia, and went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and sat down.
bsb_text: And from Perga, they traveled inland to Pisidian Antioch, where they entered the synagogue on the Sabbath and sat down.
aov_text: Maar hulle het van Perge af verder gegaan en in Antiochíë in Pisídië aangekom, en hulle het op die sabbatdag in die sinagoge gegaan en gaan sit.

kjv_text: And after the reading of the law and the prophets the rulers of the synagogue sent unto them, saying, Ye men and brethren, if ye have any word of exhortation for the people, say on.
bsb_text: After the reading from the Law and the Prophets, the synagogue leaders sent word to them: “Brothers, if you have a word of encouragement for the people, please speak.”
aov_text: En ná die lesing van die wet en die profete het die hoofde van die sinagoge na hulle gestuur en gesê: Broeders, as julle ’n woord van opwekking vir die volk het, spreek dan!

kjv_text: Then Paul stood up, and beckoning with his hand said, Men of Israel, and ye that fear God, give audience.
bsb_text: Paul stood up, motioned with his hand, and began to speak: “Men of Israel and you Gentiles who fear God, listen to me!
aov_text: Toe staan Paulus op, wink met die hand en sê: Israeliete en julle wat God vrees, luister!

kjv_text: The God of this people of Israel chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they dwelt as strangers in the land of Egypt, and with an high arm brought he them out of it.
bsb_text: The God of the people of Israel chose our fathers. He made them into a great people during their stay in Egypt, and with an uplifted arm He led them out of that land.
aov_text: Die God van hierdie volk Israel het ons vaders uitverkies en die volk verhoog toe hulle bywoners in Egipteland was, en met ’n hoë arm hulle daaruit gelei.

kjv_text: And about the time of forty years suffered he their manners in the wilderness.
bsb_text: He endured their conduct for about forty years in the wilderness.
aov_text: En omtrent veertig jaar lank het Hy hulle in die woestyn verdra.

kjv_text: And when he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Chanaan, he divided their land to them by lot.
bsb_text: And having vanquished seven nations in Canaan, He gave their land to His people as an inheritance.
aov_text: En sewe nasies het Hy in die land Kanaän uitgeroei en hulle land deur die lot aan hulle uitgedeel.

kjv_text: And after that he gave unto them judges about the space of four hundred and fifty years, until Samuel the prophet.
bsb_text: All this took about 450 years. After this, God gave them judges until the time of Samuel the prophet.
aov_text: En daarna omtrent vierhonderd-en-vyftig jaar lank het Hy rigters gegee tot op Samuel, die profeet.

kjv_text: And afterward they desired a king: and God gave unto them Saul the son of Cis, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, by the space of forty years.
bsb_text: Then the people asked for a king, and God gave them forty years under Saul son of Kish, from the tribe of Benjamin.
aov_text: En van toe af het hulle ’n koning begeer, en God het aan hulle gegee Saul, die seun van Kis, ’n man uit die stam van Benjamin, veertig jaar lank.

kjv_text: And when he had removed him, he raised up unto them David to be their king; to whom also he gave testimony, and said, I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after mine own heart, which shall fulfil all my will.
bsb_text: After removing Saul, He raised up David as their king and testified about him: ‘I have found David son of Jesse a man after My own heart; he will carry out My will in its entirety.’
aov_text: En nadat Hy hom afgesit het, het Hy Dawid vir hulle verhef as koning, van wie Hy ook gesê en getuig het: Ek het Dawid, die seun van Ísai, gevind, ’n man na my hart, wat al my welbehae sal doen.

kjv_text: Of this man's seed hath God according to his promise raised unto Israel a Saviour, Jesus:
bsb_text: From the descendants of this man, God has brought to Israel the Savior Jesus, as He promised.
aov_text: Uit die nageslag van hierdie man het God vir Israel, volgens die belofte, Jesus as Verlosser verwek,

kjv_text: When John had first preached before his coming the baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel.
bsb_text: Before the arrival of Jesus, John preached a baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel.
aov_text: nadat Johannes voor sy koms eers die doop van bekering aan die hele volk van Israel verkondig het.

kjv_text: And as John fulfilled his course, he said, Whom think ye that I am? I am not he. But, behold, there cometh one after me, whose shoes of his feet I am not worthy to loose.
bsb_text: As John was completing his course, he said, ‘Who do you suppose I am? I am not that One. But He is coming after me whose sandals I am not worthy to untie.’
aov_text: En toe Johannes aan die einde van sy loopbaan gekom het, het hy gesê: Wie dink julle is ek? Ek is dit nie; maar kyk, Hy kom ná my, wie se skoen ek nie waardig is om van sy voete los te maak nie.

kjv_text: Men and brethren, children of the stock of Abraham, and whosoever among you feareth God, to you is the word of this salvation sent.
bsb_text: Brothers, children of Abraham, and you Gentiles who fear God, it is to us that this message of salvation has been sent.
aov_text: Broeders, kinders van die geslag van Abraham, en die onder julle wat God vrees, vir julle is hierdie woord van verlossing gestuur.

kjv_text: For they that dwell at Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they knew him not, nor yet the voices of the prophets which are read every sabbath day, they have fulfilled them in condemning him.
bsb_text: The people of Jerusalem and their rulers did not recognize Jesus, yet in condemning Him they fulfilled the words of the prophets that are read every Sabbath.
aov_text: Want die inwoners van Jerusalem en hulle owerstes het Hom nie geken nie, en deur Hom te veroordeel, het hulle die woorde van die profete vervul wat elke sabbat gelees word.

kjv_text: And though they found no cause of death in him, yet desired they Pilate that he should be slain.
bsb_text: And though they found no ground for a death sentence, they asked Pilate to have Him executed.
aov_text: En al het hulle niks gevind wat die dood verdien nie, tog het hulle van Pilatus gevra dat Hy omgebring moes word.

kjv_text: And when they had fulfilled all that was written of him, they took him down from the tree, and laid him in a sepulchre.
bsb_text: When they had carried out all that was written about Him, they took Him down from the tree and laid Him in a tomb.
aov_text: En toe hulle alles volbring het wat oor Hom geskrywe is, het hulle Hom van die kruishout afgehaal en in ’n graf neergelê.

kjv_text: But God raised him from the dead:
bsb_text: But God raised Him from the dead,
aov_text: Maar God het Hom uit die dode opgewek.

kjv_text: And he was seen many days of them which came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses unto the people.
bsb_text: and for many days He was seen by those who had accompanied Him from Galilee to Jerusalem. They are now His witnesses to our people.
aov_text: En gedurende baie dae het Hy verskyn aan die wat saam met Hom opgegaan het van Galiléa na Jerusalem, en hulle is sy getuies by die volk.

kjv_text: And we declare unto you glad tidings, how that the promise which was made unto the fathers,
bsb_text: And now we proclaim to you the good news: What God promised our fathers
aov_text: En ons bring julle die goeie tyding van die belofte wat aan die vaders gedoen is, dat God dit aan ons, hulle kinders, vervul het deur Jesus op te wek,

kjv_text: God hath fulfilled the same unto us their children, in that he hath raised up Jesus again; as it is also written in the second psalm, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee.
bsb_text: He has fulfilled for us, their children, by raising up Jesus. As it is written in the second Psalm: ‘You are My Son; today I have become Your Father.’
aov_text: soos daar ook in die tweede psalm geskrywe is: U is my Seun, vandag het Ek U gegenereer.

kjv_text: And as concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he said on this wise, I will give you the sure mercies of David.
bsb_text: In fact, God raised Him from the dead, never to see decay. As He has said: ‘I will give you the holy and sure blessings promised to David.’
aov_text: En dat Hy Hom opgewek het uit die dode, sodat Hy nie meer tot verderwing sou terugkeer nie, het Hy só gespreek: Ek sal aan julle gee die heilige weldade van Dawid wat betroubaar is.

kjv_text: Wherefore he saith also in another psalm, Thou shalt not suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
bsb_text: So also, He says in another Psalm: ‘You will not let Your Holy One see decay.’
aov_text: Daarom sê Hy ook op ’n ander plek: U sal u Heilige nie oorgee om verderwing te sien nie.

kjv_text: For David, after he had served his own generation by the will of God, fell on sleep, and was laid unto his fathers, and saw corruption:
bsb_text: For when David had served God’s purpose in his own generation, he fell asleep. His body was buried with his fathers and saw decay.
aov_text: Want Dawid het ontslaap, nadat hy sy eie geslag volgens die raad van God gedien het, en is by sy vaders weggelê en het verderwing gesien,

kjv_text: But he, whom God raised again, saw no corruption.
bsb_text: But the One whom God raised from the dead did not see decay.
aov_text: maar Hy wat deur God opgewek is, het geen verderwing gesien nie.

kjv_text: Be it known unto you therefore, men and brethren, that through this man is preached unto you the forgiveness of sins:
bsb_text: Therefore let it be known to you, brothers, that through Jesus the forgiveness of sins is proclaimed to you.
aov_text: Laat dit dan aan julle bekend wees, broeders, dat deur Hom vergifnis van sondes aan julle verkondig word,

kjv_text: And by him all that believe are justified from all things, from which ye could not be justified by the law of Moses.
bsb_text: Through Him everyone who believes is justified from everything you could not be justified from by the law of Moses.
aov_text: en dat elkeen wat glo, deur Hom geregverdig word van alles waarvan julle deur die wet van Moses nie geregverdig kon word nie.

kjv_text: Beware therefore, lest that come upon you, which is spoken of in the prophets;
bsb_text: Watch out, then, that what was spoken by the prophets does not happen to you:
aov_text: Pas dan op dat daar nie oor julle kom wat deur die profete gesê is nie:

kjv_text: Behold, ye despisers, and wonder, and perish: for I work a work in your days, a work which ye shall in no wise believe, though a man declare it unto you.
bsb_text: ‘Look, you scoffers, wonder and perish! For I am doing a work in your days that you would never believe, even if someone told you.’”
aov_text: Kyk dan, julle veragters, en wees verwonderd en verdwyn! Want Ek gaan iets in julle dae doen, iets wat julle sekerlik nie sal glo as iemand julle dit vertel nie.

kjv_text: And when the Jews were gone out of the synagogue, the Gentiles besought that these words might be preached to them the next sabbath.
bsb_text: As Paul and Barnabas were leaving the synagogue, the people urged them to continue this message on the next Sabbath.
aov_text: En toe die Jode uit die sinagoge gaan, het die heidene versoek dat daardie woorde op die volgende sabbat tot hulle gespreek sou word.

kjv_text: Now when the congregation was broken up, many of the Jews and religious proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas: who, speaking to them, persuaded them to continue in the grace of God.
bsb_text: After the synagogue was dismissed, many of the Jews and devout converts to Judaism followed Paul and Barnabas, who spoke to them and urged them to continue in the grace of God.
aov_text: En toe die sinagoge uit was, het baie van die Jode en die godsdienstige Jodegenote Paulus en Bárnabas gevolg. Dié het hulle toegespreek en hulle probeer beweeg om in die genade van God te bly.

kjv_text: And the next sabbath day came almost the whole city together to hear the word of God.
bsb_text: On the following Sabbath, nearly the whole city gathered to hear the word of the Lord.
aov_text: En op die volgende sabbat het byna die hele stad saamgekom om die woord van God te hoor.

kjv_text: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with envy, and spake against those things which were spoken by Paul, contradicting and blaspheming.
bsb_text: But when the Jews saw the crowds, they were filled with jealousy, and they blasphemously contradicted what Paul was saying.
aov_text: Maar toe die Jode die skare sien, is hulle met nydigheid vervul en het met lasterlike woorde weerspreek wat deur Paulus gesê is.

kjv_text: Then Paul and Barnabas waxed bold, and said, It was necessary that the word of God should first have been spoken to you: but seeing ye put it from you, and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life, lo, we turn to the Gentiles.
bsb_text: Then Paul and Barnabas answered them boldly: “It was necessary to speak the word of God to you first. But since you reject it and do not consider yourselves worthy of eternal life, we now turn to the Gentiles.
aov_text: Maar Paulus en Bárnabas het vry-uit gespreek en gesê: Dit was noodsaaklik dat die woord van God aan julle eers verkondig moes word. Aangesien julle dit egter verwerp en julleself die ewige lewe nie waardig ag nie — kyk, ons wend ons tot die heidene.

kjv_text: For so hath the Lord commanded us, saying, I have set thee to be a light of the Gentiles, that thou shouldest be for salvation unto the ends of the earth.
bsb_text: For this is what the Lord has commanded us: ‘I have made you a light for the Gentiles, to bring salvation to the ends of the earth.’”
aov_text: Want so het die Here aan ons bevel gegee: Ek het U ’n lig van die nasies gemaak, sodat U tot redding sal wees tot aan die einde van die aarde.

kjv_text: And when the Gentiles heard this, they were glad, and glorified the word of the Lord: and as many as were ordained to eternal life believed.
bsb_text: When the Gentiles heard this, they rejoiced and glorified the word of the Lord, and all who were appointed for eternal life believed.
aov_text: En toe die heidene dit hoor, was hulle bly; en hulle het die woord van die Here geprys; en daar het gelowig geword almal wat verordineer was tot die ewige lewe.

kjv_text: And the word of the Lord was published throughout all the region.
bsb_text: And the word of the Lord spread throughout that region.
aov_text: En die woord van die Here is deur die hele land verbrei.

kjv_text: But the Jews stirred up the devout and honourable women, and the chief men of the city, and raised persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and expelled them out of their coasts.
bsb_text: The Jews, however, incited the religious women of prominence and the leading men of the city. They stirred up persecution against Paul and Barnabas and drove them out of their district.
aov_text: Maar die Jode het die godsdienstige en aansienlike vroue en die vernaamste mense van die stad opgehits en teen Paulus en Bárnabas ’n vervolging in die lewe geroep en hulle buite hul gebied verdryf.

kjv_text: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came unto Iconium.
bsb_text: So they shook the dust off their feet in protest against them and went to Iconium.
aov_text: Toe het hulle die stof van hul voete teen hulle afgeskud en na Ikónium gegaan.

kjv_text: And the disciples were filled with joy, and with the Holy Ghost.
bsb_text: And the disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit.
aov_text: En die dissipels is vervul met blydskap en met die Heilige Gees.

kjv_text: And it came to pass in Iconium, that they went both together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spake, that a great multitude both of the Jews and also of the Greeks believed.
bsb_text: At Iconium, Paul and Barnabas went as usual into the Jewish synagogue, where they spoke so well that a great number of Jews and Greeks believed.
aov_text: EN op dieselfde wyse het hulle in Ikónium in die sinagoge van die Jode ingegaan en so gespreek dat ’n groot menigte Jode sowel as Grieke gelowig geword het.

kjv_text: But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles, and made their minds evil affected against the brethren.
bsb_text: But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles and poisoned their minds against the brothers.
aov_text: Maar die ongehoorsame Jode het die gemoedere van die heidene teen die broeders opgehits en verbitter.

kjv_text: Long time therefore abode they speaking boldly in the Lord, which gave testimony unto the word of his grace, and granted signs and wonders to be done by their hands.
bsb_text: So Paul and Barnabas spent considerable time there, speaking boldly for the Lord, who affirmed the message of His grace by enabling them to perform signs and wonders.
aov_text: Hulle het toe ’n geruime tyd daar deurgebring en vrymoediglik gespreek in die Here, wat aan die woord van sy genade getuienis gegee het deur te beskik dat tekens en wonders deur hulle hande plaasvind.

kjv_text: But the multitude of the city was divided: and part held with the Jews, and part with the apostles.
bsb_text: The people of the city were divided. Some sided with the Jews, and others with the apostles.
aov_text: En die menigte van die stad was verdeeld, en sommige het met die Jode en ander met die apostels saamgegaan.

kjv_text: And when there was an assault made both of the Gentiles, and also of the Jews with their rulers, to use them despitefully, and to stone them,
bsb_text: But when the Gentiles and Jews, together with their rulers, set out to mistreat and stone them,
aov_text: Maar toe daar onder die heidene en ook onder die Jode, saam met hulle owerstes, ’n beweging ontstaan het om hulle te mishandel en te stenig,

kjv_text: They were ware of it, and fled unto Lystra and Derbe, cities of Lycaonia, and unto the region that lieth round about:
bsb_text: they found out about it and fled to the Lycaonian cities of Lystra and Derbe and to the surrounding region,
aov_text: het hulle dit gewaargeword en gevlug na die stede van Likaónië, Listre en Derbe en die omstreke.

kjv_text: And there they preached the gospel.
bsb_text: where they continued to preach the gospel.
aov_text: En daar het hulle die evangelie verkondig.

kjv_text: And there sat a certain man at Lystra, impotent in his feet, being a cripple from his mother's womb, who never had walked:
bsb_text: In Lystra there sat a man crippled in his feet, who was lame from birth and had never walked.
aov_text: En in Listre het daar ’n man gesit wat magteloos was aan sy voete, kreupel van sy geboorte af, en hy het nooit geloop nie.

kjv_text: The same heard Paul speak: who stedfastly beholding him, and perceiving that he had faith to be healed,
bsb_text: This man was listening to the words of Paul, who looked intently at him and saw that he had faith to be healed.
aov_text: Hy het geluister, terwyl Paulus spreek; en Paulus het die oë op hom gehou, en, toe hy sien dat hy geloof het om gesond te word,

kjv_text: Said with a loud voice, Stand upright on thy feet. And he leaped and walked.
bsb_text: In a loud voice Paul called out, “Stand up on your feet!” And the man jumped up and began to walk.
aov_text: met ’n groot stem gesê: Staan regop op jou voete! En hy het opgespring en begin rondloop.

kjv_text: And when the people saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voices, saying in the speech of Lycaonia, The gods are come down to us in the likeness of men.
bsb_text: When the crowds saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voices in the Lycaonian language: “The gods have come down to us in human form!”
aov_text: En toe die skare sien wat Paulus gedoen het, verhef hulle hul stem en sê in Likaónies: Die gode het soos mense geword en neergedaal na ons toe.

kjv_text: And they called Barnabas, Jupiter; and Paul, Mercurius, because he was the chief speaker.
bsb_text: Barnabas they called Zeus, and Paul they called Hermes, because he was the chief speaker.
aov_text: En hulle het vir Bárnabas Júpiter genoem, en vir Paulus Mercurius, omdat hy die woordvoerder was.

kjv_text: Then the priest of Jupiter, which was before their city, brought oxen and garlands unto the gates, and would have done sacrifice with the people.
bsb_text: The priest of Zeus, whose temple was just outside the city, brought bulls and wreaths to the city gates, hoping to offer a sacrifice along with the crowds.
aov_text: En die priester van Júpiter wie se tempel voor hulle stad was, het stiere en kranse na die poorte gebring en wou saam met die skare offer.

kjv_text: Which when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of, they rent their clothes, and ran in among the people, crying out,
bsb_text: But when the apostles Barnabas and Paul found out about this, they tore their clothes and rushed into the crowd, shouting,
aov_text: Maar toe die apostels, Bárnabas en Paulus, dit hoor, het hulle hul klere geskeur en onder die skare ingespring en geroep

kjv_text: And saying, Sirs, why do ye these things? We also are men of like passions with you, and preach unto you that ye should turn from these vanities unto the living God, which made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all things that are therein:
bsb_text: “Men, why are you doing this? We too are only men, human like you. We are bringing you good news that you should turn from these worthless things to the living God, who made heaven and earth and sea and everything in them.
aov_text: en gesê: Manne, waarom doen julle hierdie dinge? Ons is net sulke mense soos julle, en ons verkondig die evangelie dat julle jul van hierdie nietige dinge moet bekeer tot die lewende God wat die hemel en die aarde en die see en alles wat daarin is, gemaak het.

kjv_text: Who in times past suffered all nations to walk in their own ways.
bsb_text: In past generations, He let all nations go their own way.
aov_text: Hy het in die tye wat verby is, toegelaat dat al die nasies in hulle eie weë sou wandel,

kjv_text: Nevertheless he left not himself without witness, in that he did good, and gave us rain from heaven, and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.
bsb_text: Yet He has not left Himself without testimony to His goodness: He gives you rain from heaven and fruitful seasons, filling your hearts with food and gladness.”
aov_text: al het Hy Homself nie onbetuig gelaat nie, deur goed te doen, van die hemel vir ons reën en vrugbare tye te gee en ons harte met voedsel en vrolikheid te vervul.

kjv_text: And with these sayings scarce restrained they the people, that they had not done sacrifice unto them.
bsb_text: Even with these words, Paul and Barnabas could hardly stop the crowds from sacrificing to them.
aov_text: Selfs met hierdie woorde het hulle met moeite die skare verhinder om aan hulle te offer.

kjv_text: And there came thither certain Jews from Antioch and Iconium, who persuaded the people, and, having stoned Paul, drew him out of the city, supposing he had been dead.
bsb_text: Then some Jews arrived from Antioch and Iconium and won over the crowds. They stoned Paul and dragged him outside the city, presuming he was dead.
