aov_text: Maar daar het Jode van Antiochíë en Ikónium aangekom, en hulle het, nadat hulle die skare omgepraat het, Paulus gestenig en hom buitekant die stad gesleep, met die gedagte dat hy dood was.

kjv_text: Howbeit, as the disciples stood round about him, he rose up, and came into the city: and the next day he departed with Barnabas to Derbe.
bsb_text: But after the disciples had gathered around him, he got up and went back into the city. And the next day he left with Barnabas for Derbe.
aov_text: Maar toe die dissipels hom omring, het hy opgestaan en in die stad gekom en die volgende dag saam met Bárnabas na Derbe vertrek.

kjv_text: And when they had preached the gospel to that city, and had taught many, they returned again to Lystra, and to Iconium, and Antioch,
bsb_text: They preached the gospel to that city and made many disciples. Then they returned to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch,
aov_text: En nadat hulle aan daardie stad die evangelie verkondig en ’n aantal dissipels gemaak het, het hulle teruggegaan na Listre en Ikónium en Antiochíë,

kjv_text: Confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God.
bsb_text: strengthening the souls of the disciples and encouraging them to continue in the faith. “We must endure many hardships to enter the kingdom of God,” they said.
aov_text: en die siele van die dissipels versterk en hulle vermaan om in die geloof te bly deur te sê: Ons moet deur baie verdrukkinge in die koninkryk van God ingaan.

kjv_text: And when they had ordained them elders in every church, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord, on whom they believed.
bsb_text: Paul and Barnabas appointed elders for them in each church, praying and fasting as they entrusted them to the Lord, in whom they had believed.
aov_text: En hulle het in elke gemeente vir hulle ouderlinge gekies, en hulle, ná gebed en vas, opgedra aan die Here in wie hulle geglo het.

kjv_text: And after they had passed throughout Pisidia, they came to Pamphylia.
bsb_text: After passing through Pisidia, they came to Pamphylia.
aov_text: Toe gaan hulle deur Pisídië en kom in Pamfílië;

kjv_text: And when they had preached the word in Perga, they went down into Attalia:
bsb_text: And when they had spoken the word in Perga, they went down to Attalia.
aov_text: en nadat hulle die woord in Perge verkondig het, het hulle afgegaan na Attálië.

kjv_text: And thence sailed to Antioch, from whence they had been recommended to the grace of God for the work which they fulfilled.
bsb_text: From Attalia they sailed to Antioch, where they had been commended to the grace of God for the work they had just completed.
aov_text: En daarvandaan het hulle weggevaar na Antiochíë, waar hulle aan die genade van God opgedra was vir die werk wat hulle volbring het.

kjv_text: And when they were come, and had gathered the church together, they rehearsed all that God had done with them, and how he had opened the door of faith unto the Gentiles.
bsb_text: When they arrived, they gathered the church together and reported all that God had done through them, and how He had opened the door of faith to the Gentiles.
aov_text: En toe hulle daar kom en die gemeente saamgeroep het, het hulle verslag gedoen van al die dinge wat God met hulle gedoen het, en dat Hy ’n deur van geloof vir die heidene geopen het.

kjv_text: And there they abode long time with the disciples.
bsb_text: And they spent a long time there with the disciples.
aov_text: En hulle het daar by die dissipels ’n geruime tyd deurgebring.

kjv_text: And certain men which came down from Judaea taught the brethren, and said, Except ye be circumcised after the manner of Moses, ye cannot be saved.
bsb_text: Then some men came down from Judea and were teaching the brothers, “Unless you are circumcised according to the custom of Moses, you cannot be saved.”
aov_text: EN sekere persone wat van Judéa afgekom het, het die broeders geleer: As julle nie besny word volgens die gebruik van Moses nie, kan julle nie gered word nie.

kjv_text: When therefore Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and disputation with them, they determined that Paul and Barnabas, and certain other of them, should go up to Jerusalem unto the apostles and elders about this question.
bsb_text: And after engaging these men in sharp debate, Paul and Barnabas were appointed, along with some other believers, to go up to Jerusalem to see the apostles and elders about this question.
aov_text: Toe daar nou geen klein stryd en woordewisseling van die kant van Paulus en Bárnabas teen hulle ontstaan het nie, het hulle besluit dat Paulus en Bárnabas en nog ’n paar ander van hulle sou opgaan na die apostels en ouderlinge in Jerusalem in verband met hierdie vraagstuk.

kjv_text: And being brought on their way by the church, they passed through Phenice and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles: and they caused great joy unto all the brethren.
bsb_text: Sent on their way by the church, they passed through Phoenicia and Samaria, recounting the conversion of the Gentiles and bringing great joy to all the brothers.
aov_text: En hulle is deur die gemeente uitgelei en het Fenícië en Samaría deurgegaan en vertel van die bekering van die heidene, en aan al die broeders groot blydskap verskaf.

kjv_text: And when they were come to Jerusalem, they were received of the church, and of the apostles and elders, and they declared all things that God had done with them.
bsb_text: On their arrival in Jerusalem, they were welcomed by the church and apostles and elders, to whom they reported all that God had done through them.
aov_text: En by hulle aankoms in Jerusalem is hulle ontvang deur die gemeente en die apostels en die ouderlinge; en hulle het verslag gedoen van al die dinge wat God met hulle gedoen het.

kjv_text: But there rose up certain of the sect of the Pharisees which believed, saying, That it was needful to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.
bsb_text: But some believers from the party of the Pharisees stood up and declared, “The Gentiles must be circumcised and required to obey the law of Moses.”
aov_text: Maar sommige gelowiges uit die party van die Fariseërs het opgestaan en gesê: Dit is noodsaaklik dat hulle besny word en bevel ontvang om die wet van Moses te onderhou.

kjv_text: And the apostles and elders came together for to consider of this matter.
bsb_text: So the apostles and elders met to look into this matter.
aov_text: En die apostels en die ouderlinge het vergader om hierdie saak te ondersoek.

kjv_text: And when there had been much disputing, Peter rose up, and said unto them, Men and brethren, ye know how that a good while ago God made choice among us, that the Gentiles by my mouth should hear the word of the gospel, and believe.
bsb_text: After much discussion, Peter got up and said to them, “Brothers, you know that in the early days God made a choice among you that the Gentiles would hear from my lips the message of the gospel and believe.
aov_text: En toe daar ’n groot woordewisseling plaasvind, het Petrus opgestaan en vir hulle gesê: Broeders, julle weet dat God lank gelede onder ons verkies het dat die heidene deur my mond die woord van die evangelie sal hoor en gelowig word.

kjv_text: And God, which knoweth the hearts, bare them witness, giving them the Holy Ghost, even as he did unto us;
bsb_text: And God, who knows the heart, showed His approval by giving the Holy Spirit to them, just as He did to us.
aov_text: En God wat die harte ken, het vir hulle getuienis gegee deur aan hulle die Heilige Gees te skenk net soos aan ons.

kjv_text: And put no difference between us and them, purifying their hearts by faith.
bsb_text: He made no distinction between us and them, for He cleansed their hearts by faith.
aov_text: En Hy het geen onderskeid tussen ons en hulle gemaak nie, aangesien Hy hulle harte gereinig het deur die geloof.

kjv_text: Now therefore why tempt ye God, to put a yoke upon the neck of the disciples, which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?
bsb_text: Now then, why do you test God by placing on the necks of the disciples a yoke that neither we nor our fathers have been able to bear?
aov_text: Nou dan, waarom versoek julle God deur op die nek van die dissipels ’n juk te lê wat ons vaders en ook ons nie in staat was om te dra nie?

kjv_text: But we believe that through the grace of the LORD Jesus Christ we shall be saved, even as they.
bsb_text: On the contrary, we believe it is through the grace of the Lord Jesus that we are saved, just as they are.”
aov_text: Maar ons glo dat ons deur die genade van die Here Jesus Christus gered word op dieselfde manier as hulle ook.

kjv_text: Then all the multitude kept silence, and gave audience to Barnabas and Paul, declaring what miracles and wonders God had wrought among the Gentiles by them.
bsb_text: The whole assembly fell silent as they listened to Barnabas and Paul describing the signs and wonders God had done among the Gentiles through them.
aov_text: En die hele menigte het geswyg en na Bárnabas en Paulus geluister, terwyl hulle van al die tekens en wonders vertel wat God deur hulle onder die heidene gedoen het.

kjv_text: And after they had held their peace, James answered, saying, Men and brethren, hearken unto me:
bsb_text: When they had finished speaking, James declared, “Brothers, listen to me!
aov_text: En nadat hulle geswyg het, antwoord Jakobus en sê: Broeders, luister na my!

kjv_text: Simeon hath declared how God at the first did visit the Gentiles, to take out of them a people for his name.
bsb_text: Simon has told us how God first visited the Gentiles to take from them a people to be His own.
aov_text: Símeon het vertel hoe God in die begin uitgesien het om ’n volk uit die heidene vir sy Naam aan te neem.

kjv_text: And to this agree the words of the prophets; as it is written,
bsb_text: The words of the prophets agree with this, as it is written:
aov_text: En hiermee stem die woorde van die profete ooreen, soos geskrywe is:

kjv_text: After this I will return, and will build again the tabernacle of David, which is fallen down; and I will build again the ruins thereof, and I will set it up:
bsb_text: ‘After this I will return and rebuild the fallen tent of David. Its ruins I will rebuild, and I will restore it,
aov_text: Daarna sal Ek terugkom en die vervalle hut van Dawid weer oprig, en wat daarvan verwoes is, sal Ek weer oprig en dit herstel,

kjv_text: That the residue of men might seek after the Lord, and all the Gentiles, upon whom my name is called, saith the Lord, who doeth all these things.
bsb_text: so that the remnant of men may seek the Lord, and all the Gentiles who are called by My name, says the Lord who does these things
aov_text: sodat die oorblyfsel van die mense die Here kan soek, en al die nasies oor wie my Naam uitgeroep is, spreek die Here wat al hierdie dinge doen.

kjv_text: Known unto God are all his works from the beginning of the world.
bsb_text: that have been known for ages.’
aov_text: Aan God is al sy werke van ewigheid af bekend.

kjv_text: Wherefore my sentence is, that we trouble not them, which from among the Gentiles are turned to God:
bsb_text: It is my judgment, therefore, that we should not cause trouble for the Gentiles who are turning to God.
aov_text: Daarom oordeel ek dat ons die wat uit die heidene hulle tot God bekeer, nie moet bemoeilik nie,

kjv_text: But that we write unto them, that they abstain from pollutions of idols, and from fornication, and from things strangled, and from blood.
bsb_text: Instead, we should write and tell them to abstain from food polluted by idols, from sexual immorality, from the meat of strangled animals, and from blood.
aov_text: maar aan hulle skrywe dat hulle hul moet onthou van die dinge wat deur die afgode besoedel is en van hoerery en van wat verwurg is en van bloed.

kjv_text: For Moses of old time hath in every city them that preach him, being read in the synagogues every sabbath day.
bsb_text: For Moses has been proclaimed in every city from ancient times and is read in the synagogues on every Sabbath.”
aov_text: Want van die ou tyd af het Moses in elke stad diegene wat hom verkondig, terwyl hy elke sabbat in die sinagoges gelees word.

kjv_text: Then pleased it the apostles and elders, with the whole church, to send chosen men of their own company to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas; namely, Judas surnamed Barsabas, and Silas, chief men among the brethren:
bsb_text: Then the apostles and elders, with the whole church, decided to select men from among them to send to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas. They chose Judas called Barsabbas and Silas, two leaders among the brothers,
aov_text: Toe het die apostels en die ouderlinge saam met die hele gemeente besluit om manne uit hulle te kies en na Antiochíë te stuur saam met Paulus en Bárnabas, naamlik Judas, met die bynaam van Bársabas, en Silas, manne wat voorgangers onder die broeders was.

kjv_text: And they wrote letters by them after this manner; The apostles and elders and brethren send greeting unto the brethren which are of the Gentiles in Antioch and Syria and Cilicia:
bsb_text: and sent them with this letter: The apostles and the elders, your brothers, To the brothers among the Gentiles in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia: Greetings.
aov_text: En hulle het deur hul bemiddeling dít geskrywe: Die apostels en die ouderlinge en die broeders aan die broeders uit die heidene in Antiochíë en Sírië en Cilícië: Groete!

kjv_text: Forasmuch as we have heard, that certain which went out from us have troubled you with words, subverting your souls, saying, Ye must be circumcised, and keep the law: to whom we gave no such commandment:
bsb_text: It has come to our attention that some went out from us without our authorization and unsettled you, troubling your minds by what they said.
aov_text: Aangesien ons gehoor het dat sommige wat van ons uitgegaan het, aan wie ons geen opdrag gegee het nie, julle met woorde ontstel en julle gemoedere verontrus deur te sê dat julle besny moet word en die wet moet onderhou,

kjv_text: It seemed good unto us, being assembled with one accord, to send chosen men unto you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,
bsb_text: So we all agreed to choose men to send to you along with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,
aov_text: het ons eenparig besluit om manne te kies en na julle te stuur saam met ons geliefde Bárnabas en Paulus  —

kjv_text: Men that have hazarded their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
bsb_text: men who have risked their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
aov_text: manne wat hulle lewe oorgegee het vir die Naam van onse Here Jesus Christus.

kjv_text: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who shall also tell you the same things by mouth.
bsb_text: Therefore we are sending Judas and Silas to tell you in person the same things we are writing.
aov_text: Ons het dan Judas en Silas afgevaardig om ook mondeling dieselfde berig te bring.

kjv_text: For it seemed good to the Holy Ghost, and to us, to lay upon you no greater burden than these necessary things;
bsb_text: It seemed good to the Holy Spirit and to us not to burden you with anything beyond these essential requirements:
aov_text: Want die Heilige Gees en ons het besluit om verder geen las op julle te lê nie as hierdie noodsaaklike dinge:

kjv_text: That ye abstain from meats offered to idols, and from blood, and from things strangled, and from fornication: from which if ye keep yourselves, ye shall do well. Fare ye well.
bsb_text: You must abstain from food sacrificed to idols, from blood, from the meat of strangled animals, and from sexual immorality. You will do well to avoid these things. Farewell.
aov_text: dat julle jul onthou van afgodsoffers en van bloed en van wat verwurg is en van hoerery. As julle jul hiervan onthou, sal julle goed doen. Vaarwel!

kjv_text: So when they were dismissed, they came to Antioch: and when they had gathered the multitude together, they delivered the epistle:
bsb_text: So the men were sent off and went down to Antioch, where they assembled the congregation and delivered the letter.
aov_text: So is hulle dan weggestuur en het in Antiochíë gekom, en hulle het die menigte bymekaargeroep en die brief afgelewer.

kjv_text: Which when they had read, they rejoiced for the consolation.
bsb_text: When the people read it, they rejoiced at its encouraging message.
aov_text: En toe hulle dit gelees het, was hulle bly oor die bemoediging.

kjv_text: And Judas and Silas, being prophets also themselves, exhorted the brethren with many words, and confirmed them.
bsb_text: Judas and Silas, who themselves were prophets, said much to encourage and strengthen the brothers.
aov_text: En Judas en Silas, wat self ook profete was, het die broeders met baie woorde bemoedig en versterk.

kjv_text: And after they had tarried there a space, they were let go in peace from the brethren unto the apostles.
bsb_text: After spending some time there, they were sent off by the brothers in peace to return to those who had sent them.
aov_text: En nadat hulle ’n tyd daar deurgebring het, het die broeders hulle met vrede na die apostels laat gaan.

kjv_text: Notwithstanding it pleased Silas to abide there still.
aov_text: Maar Silas het besluit om daar te bly.

kjv_text: Paul also and Barnabas continued in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.
bsb_text: But Paul and Barnabas remained at Antioch, along with many others, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord.
aov_text: EN Paulus en Bárnabas het in Antiochíë gebly en, saam met nog baie ander, onderrig gegee en die blye boodskap van die woord van die Here verkondig.

kjv_text: And some days after Paul said unto Barnabas, Let us go again and visit our brethren in every city where we have preached the word of the LORD, and see how they do.
bsb_text: Some time later Paul said to Barnabas, “Let us go back and visit the brothers in every town where we proclaimed the word of the Lord, to see how they are doing.”
aov_text: En ’n paar dae daarna het Paulus vir Bárnabas gesê: Laat ons teruggaan en ons broeders besoek in al die stede waarin ons die woord van die Here verkondig het, om te sien hoe dit met hulle gaan.

kjv_text: And Barnabas determined to take with them John, whose surname was Mark.
bsb_text: Barnabas wanted to take John, also called Mark.
aov_text: En Bárnabas wou Johannes, wat Markus genoem word, saamneem.

kjv_text: But Paul thought not good to take him with them, who departed from them from Pamphylia, and went not with them to the work.
bsb_text: But Paul thought it best not to take him, because he had deserted them in Pamphylia and had not accompanied them in the work.
aov_text: Maar Paulus het dit nie reg geag om hóm saam te neem wat van Pamfílië af hulle verlaat het en nie saam met hulle na die werk gegaan het nie.

kjv_text: And the contention was so sharp between them, that they departed asunder one from the other: and so Barnabas took Mark, and sailed unto Cyprus;
bsb_text: Their disagreement was so sharp that they parted company. Barnabas took Mark and sailed for Cyprus,
aov_text: Daar het toe ’n verbittering ontstaan, sodat hulle van mekaar geskei het; en Bárnabas het Markus saamgeneem en na Ciprus uitgeseil.

kjv_text: And Paul chose Silas, and departed, being recommended by the brethren unto the grace of God.
bsb_text: but Paul chose Silas and left, commended by the brothers to the grace of the Lord.
aov_text: MAAR Paulus het Silas gekies en afgereis nadat hy deur die broeders aan die genade van God opgedra was.

kjv_text: And he went through Syria and Cilicia, confirming the churches.
bsb_text: And he traveled through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the churches.
aov_text: En hy het Sírië en Cilícië deurgegaan en die gemeentes versterk.

kjv_text: Then came he to Derbe and Lystra: and, behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timotheus, the son of a certain woman, which was a Jewess, and believed; but his father was a Greek:
bsb_text: Paul came to Derbe and then to Lystra, where he found a disciple named Timothy, the son of a believing Jewish woman and a Greek father.
aov_text: EN hy het in Derbe en Listre aangekom; en daar was ’n dissipel met die naam van Timótheüs, seun van ’n gelowige Joodse vrou, maar van ’n Griekse vader.

kjv_text: Which was well reported of by the brethren that were at Lystra and Iconium.
bsb_text: The brothers in Lystra and Iconium spoke well of him.
aov_text: Hy het goeie getuienis gehad van die broeders in Listre en Ikónium.

kjv_text: Him would Paul have to go forth with him; and took and circumcised him because of the Jews which were in those quarters: for they knew all that his father was a Greek.
bsb_text: Paul wanted Timothy to accompany him, so he took him and circumcised him on account of the Jews in that area, for they all knew that his father was a Greek.
aov_text: Paulus wou hê dat hy saam met hom op reis sou gaan, en hy het hom geneem en besny ter wille van die Jode wat in daardie streke was; want hulle het almal geweet dat sy vader ’n Griek was.

kjv_text: And as they went through the cities, they delivered them the decrees for to keep, that were ordained of the apostles and elders which were at Jerusalem.
bsb_text: As they went from town to town, they delivered the decisions handed down by the apostles and elders in Jerusalem for the people to obey.
aov_text: En op hulle reis deur die stede het hulle die verordeninge wat deur die apostels en die ouderlinge in Jerusalem vasgestel was, aan hulle oorgegee om te onderhou.

kjv_text: And so were the churches established in the faith, and increased in number daily.
bsb_text: So the churches were strengthened in the faith and grew daily in numbers.
aov_text: En die gemeentes is versterk in die geloof en het elke dag vermeerder in getal.

kjv_text: Now when they had gone throughout Phrygia and the region of Galatia, and were forbidden of the Holy Ghost to preach the word in Asia,
bsb_text: After the Holy Spirit had prevented them from speaking the word in the province of Asia, they traveled through the region of Phrygia and Galatia.
aov_text: En hulle het deur die land Frígië en Galásië gegaan, omdat die Heilige Gees hulle verhinder het om in Asië die woord te verkondig.

kjv_text: After they were come to Mysia, they assayed to go into Bithynia: but the Spirit suffered them not.
bsb_text: And when they came to the border of Mysia, they tried to enter Bithynia, but the Spirit of Jesus would not permit them.
aov_text: En toe hulle by Mísië kom, het hulle probeer om na Bithínië te gaan, maar die Gees het hulle dit nie toegelaat nie.

kjv_text: And they passing by Mysia came down to Troas.
bsb_text: So they passed by Mysia and went down to Troas.
aov_text: So het hulle dan Mísië verbygegaan en na Troas afgekom.

kjv_text: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night; There stood a man of Macedonia, and prayed him, saying, Come over into Macedonia, and help us.
bsb_text: During the night, Paul had a vision of a man of Macedonia standing and pleading with him, “Come over to Macedonia and help us.”
aov_text: EN Paulus het ’n gesig in die nag gesien — daar staan ’n Macedóniër wat hom smeek en sê: Kom oor na Macedónië en help ons!

kjv_text: And after he had seen the vision, immediately we endeavoured to go into Macedonia, assuredly gathering that the Lord had called us for to preach the gospel unto them.
bsb_text: As soon as Paul had seen the vision, we got ready to leave for Macedonia, concluding that God had called us to preach the gospel to them.
aov_text: En toe hy die gesig gesien het, het ons dadelik probeer om na Macedónië te gaan, omdat ons versekerd was dat die Here ons geroep het om die evangelie aan hulle te verkondig.

kjv_text: Therefore loosing from Troas, we came with a straight course to Samothracia, and the next day to Neapolis;
bsb_text: We sailed from Troas straight to Samothrace, and the following day on to Neapolis.
aov_text: Ons het dan afgevaar van Troas en reguit koers gehou na Samothráce, en die volgende dag na Neápolis,

kjv_text: And from thence to Philippi, which is the chief city of that part of Macedonia, and a colony: and we were in that city abiding certain days.
bsb_text: From there we went to the Roman colony of Philippi, the leading city of that district of Macedonia. And we stayed there several days.
aov_text: en daarvandaan na Filíppi, wat die eerste stad is van daardie deel van Macedónië, ’n kolonie. En ons het in hierdie stad ’n paar dae deurgebring.

kjv_text: And on the sabbath we went out of the city by a river side, where prayer was wont to be made; and we sat down, and spake unto the women which resorted thither.
bsb_text: On the Sabbath we went outside the city gate along the river, where it was customary to find a place of prayer. After sitting down, we spoke to the women who had gathered there.
aov_text: En op die sabbatdag het ons uitgegaan buitekant die stad langs ’n rivier waar die gebruiklike bidplek was, en ons het gaan sit en met die vroue gespreek wat daar bymekaargekom het.

kjv_text: And a certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, which worshipped God, heard us: whose heart the Lord opened, that she attended unto the things which were spoken of Paul.
bsb_text: Among those listening was a woman named Lydia, a dealer in purple cloth from the city of Thyatira, who was a worshiper of God. The Lord opened her heart to respond to Paul’s message.
aov_text: En ’n vrou met die naam van Lídia, ’n purperverkoopster van die stad Thiatíre, ’n godsdienstige vrou, het geluister; die Here het haar hart geopen om ag te gee op wat deur Paulus gesê is.

kjv_text: And when she was baptized, and her household, she besought us, saying, If ye have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house, and abide there. And she constrained us.
bsb_text: And when she and her household had been baptized, she urged us, “If you consider me a believer in the Lord, come and stay at my house.” And she persuaded us.
aov_text: En toe sy en haar huisgesin gedoop is, het sy by ons aangedring en gesê: As u oordeel dat ek in die Here glo, kom dan in my huis en bly daar. En sy het ons gedwing.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, as we went to prayer, a certain damsel possessed with a spirit of divination met us, which brought her masters much gain by soothsaying:
bsb_text: One day as we were going to the place of prayer, we were met by a slave girl with a spirit of divination, who earned a large income for her masters by fortune-telling.
aov_text: En terwyl ons op pad was na die bidplek, kom ’n slavin met ’n waarsêende gees ons teë, wat vir haar eienaars deur waarsêery groot wins ingebring het.

kjv_text: The same followed Paul and us, and cried, saying, These men are the servants of the most high God, which shew unto us the way of salvation.
bsb_text: This girl followed Paul and the rest of us, shouting, “These men are servants of the Most High God, who are proclaiming to you the way of salvation!”
aov_text: Sy het Paulus en ons gevolg en geskreeu en gesê: Hierdie manne is dienaars van God, die Allerhoogste, en hulle verkondig aan julle die weg van verlossing.

kjv_text: And this did she many days. But Paul, being grieved, turned and said to the spirit, I command thee in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her. And he came out the same hour.
bsb_text: She continued this for many days. Eventually Paul grew so aggravated that he turned and said to the spirit, “In the name of Jesus Christ I command you to come out of her!” And the spirit left her at that very moment.
aov_text: En dit het sy baie dae lank gedoen; maar baie ontevrede daaroor, het Paulus hom omgedraai en vir die gees gesê: Ek beveel jou in die Naam van Jesus Christus om uit haar uit te gaan. En hy het op dieselfde oomblik uitgegaan.

kjv_text: And when her masters saw that the hope of their gains was gone, they caught Paul and Silas, and drew them into the marketplace unto the rulers,
bsb_text: When the girl’s owners saw that their hope of making money was gone, they seized Paul and Silas and dragged them before the authorities in the marketplace.
aov_text: En toe haar eienaars sien dat die hoop van hulle wins weg was, het hulle Paulus en Silas gegryp en hulle na die mark voor die owerheid gesleep

kjv_text: And brought them to the magistrates, saying, These men, being Jews, do exceedingly trouble our city,
bsb_text: They brought them to the magistrates and said, “These men are Jews and are throwing our city into turmoil
aov_text: en hulle voor die regters gebring en gesê: Hierdie manne bring ons stad in opskudding, omdat hulle Jode is,

kjv_text: And teach customs, which are not lawful for us to receive, neither to observe, being Romans.
bsb_text: by promoting customs that are unlawful for us Romans to adopt or practice.”
aov_text: en hulle verkondig sedes wat vir ons nie geoorloof is om aan te neem of na te volg nie, omdat ons Romeine is.

kjv_text: And the multitude rose up together against them: and the magistrates rent off their clothes, and commanded to beat them.
bsb_text: The crowd joined in the attack against Paul and Silas, and the magistrates ordered that they be stripped and beaten with rods.
aov_text: En die skare het saam teen hulle opgestaan, en die regters het hulle klere laat afskeur en bevel gegee om hulle met stokke te slaan.

kjv_text: And when they had laid many stripes upon them, they cast them into prison, charging the jailor to keep them safely:
bsb_text: And after striking them with many blows, they threw them into prison and ordered the jailer to guard them securely.
aov_text: En toe hulle hul baie slae gegee het, het hulle hul in die gevangenis gewerp en die tronkbewaarder bevel gegee om hulle sorgvuldig te bewaak.

kjv_text: Who, having received such a charge, thrust them into the inner prison, and made their feet fast in the stocks.
bsb_text: On receiving this order, he placed them in the inner cell and fastened their feet in the stocks.
aov_text: Hy het toe, omdat hy so ’n bevel ontvang het, hulle in die binneste gevangenis gewerp en hulle voete in die blok vasgemaak.

kjv_text: And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto God: and the prisoners heard them.
bsb_text: About midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the other prisoners were listening to them.
aov_text: En omtrent middernag het Paulus en Silas gebid en lofliedere tot eer van God gesing; en die gevangenes het na hulle geluister.

kjv_text: And suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken: and immediately all the doors were opened, and every one's bands were loosed.
bsb_text: Suddenly a strong earthquake shook the foundations of the prison. At once all the doors flew open and everyone’s chains came loose.
aov_text: En skielik kom daar ’n groot aardbewing, sodat die fondamente van die gevangenis geskud het. En onmiddellik het al die deure oopgegaan en die boeie van almal het losgeraak.

kjv_text: And the keeper of the prison awaking out of his sleep, and seeing the prison doors open, he drew out his sword, and would have killed himself, supposing that the prisoners had been fled.
bsb_text: When the jailer woke up and saw the prison doors open, he drew his sword and was about to kill himself, presuming that the prisoners had escaped.
aov_text: En die tronkbewaarder het wakker geword; en toe hy sien dat die deure van die gevangenis oop was, het hy ’n swaard getrek en wou homself om die lewe bring, in die mening dat die gevangenes ontvlug het.

kjv_text: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, Do thyself no harm: for we are all here.
bsb_text: But Paul called out in a loud voice, “Do not harm yourself! We are all here!”
aov_text: Maar Paulus het met ’n groot stem geroep en gesê: Moenie jouself kwaad aandoen nie, want ons is almal hier.

kjv_text: Then he called for a light, and sprang in, and came trembling, and fell down before Paul and Silas,
bsb_text: Calling for lights, the jailer rushed in and fell trembling before Paul and Silas.
aov_text: En toe hy lig gevra het, spring hy na binne en val bewende voor Paulus en Silas neer.

kjv_text: And brought them out, and said, Sirs, what must I do to be saved?
bsb_text: Then he brought them out and asked, “Sirs, what must I do to be saved?”
aov_text: En hy het hulle na buite gebring en gesê: Menere, wat moet ek doen om gered te word?

kjv_text: And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.
bsb_text: They replied, “Believe in the Lord Jesus and you will be saved, you and your household.”
aov_text: Toe sê hulle: Glo in die Here Jesus Christus en jy sal gered word, jy en jou huisgesin.

kjv_text: And they spake unto him the word of the Lord, and to all that were in his house.
bsb_text: Then Paul and Silas spoke the word of the Lord to him and to everyone in his house.
aov_text: En hulle het aan hom die woord van die Here verkondig en aan almal wat in sy huis was.

kjv_text: And he took them the same hour of the night, and washed their stripes; and was baptized, he and all his, straightway.
bsb_text: At that hour of the night, the jailer took them and washed their wounds. And without delay, he and all his household were baptized.
aov_text: En in dieselfde uur van die nag het hy hulle geneem en hulle wonde gewas, en hy is onmiddellik gedoop, hy en al sy mense.

kjv_text: And when he had brought them into his house, he set meat before them, and rejoiced, believing in God with all his house.
bsb_text: Then he brought them into his home and set a meal before them. So he and all his household rejoiced that they had come to believe in God.
aov_text: Toe bring hy hulle in sy huis en sit hulle ’n maaltyd voor; en hy het hom verheug met sy hele huisgesin dat hy tot geloof in God gekom het.

kjv_text: And when it was day, the magistrates sent the serjeants, saying, Let those men go.
bsb_text: When daylight came, the magistrates sent their officers with the order: “Release those men.”
aov_text: En toe dit dag word, stuur die regters die geregsdienaars en sê: Laat daardie manne los.

kjv_text: And the keeper of the prison told this saying to Paul, The magistrates have sent to let you go: now therefore depart, and go in peace.
bsb_text: The jailer informed Paul: “The magistrates have sent orders to release you. Now you may go on your way in peace.”
aov_text: En die tronkbewaarder het hierdie woorde aan Paulus oorgebring: Die regters het laat weet dat julle losgelaat moet word; gaan dan nou uit en reis in vrede!

kjv_text: But Paul said unto them, They have beaten us openly uncondemned, being Romans, and have cast us into prison; and now do they thrust us out privily? nay verily; but let them come themselves and fetch us out.
bsb_text: But Paul said to the officers, “They beat us publicly without a trial and threw us into prison, even though we are Roman citizens. And now do they want to send us away secretly? Absolutely not! Let them come themselves and escort us out!”
aov_text: Maar Paulus sê vir hulle: Hulle het ons in die openbaar onveroordeeld geslaan, ons wat Romeinse burgers is, en ons in die gevangenis gewerp, en wil hulle ons nou in die geheim uitwerp? Volstrek nie! Laat hulle self kom en ons uitlei.

kjv_text: And the serjeants told these words unto the magistrates: and they feared, when they heard that they were Romans.
bsb_text: So the officers relayed this message to the magistrates, who were alarmed to hear that Paul and Silas were Roman citizens.
aov_text: En die geregsdienaars het hierdie woorde aan die regters oorgebring, en dié het bang geword toe hulle hoor dat hulle Romeine was.

kjv_text: And they came and besought them, and brought them out, and desired them to depart out of the city.
bsb_text: They came to appease them and led them out, requesting that they leave the city.
aov_text: Daarop het hulle gekom en hulle gesmeek en uitgelei met die versoek om uit die stad te vertrek.

kjv_text: And they went out of the prison, and entered into the house of Lydia: and when they had seen the brethren, they comforted them, and departed.
bsb_text: After Paul and Silas came out of the prison, they went to Lydia’s house to see the brothers and encourage them. Then they left the city.
aov_text: En nadat hulle die gevangenis verlaat het, het hulle na die huis van Lídia gegaan; en hulle het die broeders gesien, hulle bemoedig en weggegaan.

kjv_text: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where was a synagogue of the Jews:
bsb_text: When they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where there was a Jewish synagogue.
aov_text: TOE het hulle deur Amfípolis en Apollónië gereis en in Thessaloníka gekom, waar ’n sinagoge van die Jode was.

kjv_text: And Paul, as his manner was, went in unto them, and three sabbath days reasoned with them out of the scriptures,
bsb_text: As was his custom, Paul went into the synagogue, and on three Sabbaths he reasoned with them from the Scriptures,
aov_text: En volgens sy gewoonte het Paulus na hulle gegaan en drie sabbatte lank met hulle gespreek uit die Skrifte

kjv_text: Opening and alleging, that Christ must needs have suffered, and risen again from the dead; and that this Jesus, whom I preach unto you, is Christ.
bsb_text: explaining and proving that the Christ had to suffer and rise from the dead. “This Jesus I am proclaiming to you is the Christ,” he declared.
aov_text: en dit uitgelê en aangetoon dat die Christus moes ly en uit die dode opstaan, en Hierdie Jesus wat ek aan julle verkondig, is die Christus.

kjv_text: And some of them believed, and consorted with Paul and Silas; and of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and of the chief women not a few.
bsb_text: Some of the Jews were persuaded and joined Paul and Silas, along with a large number of God-fearing Greeks and quite a few leading women.
aov_text: En sommige van hulle is oortuig en het hulle by Paulus en Silas aangesluit, ook ’n groot menigte van die godsdienstige Grieke en ’n groot aantal van die aansienlikste vroue.

kjv_text: But the Jews which believed not, moved with envy, took unto them certain lewd fellows of the baser sort, and gathered a company, and set all the city on an uproar, and assaulted the house of Jason, and sought to bring them out to the people.
bsb_text: The Jews, however, became jealous. So they brought in some troublemakers from the marketplace, formed a mob, and sent the city into an uproar. They raided Jason’s house in search of Paul and Silas, hoping to bring them out to the people.
aov_text: Maar die ongelowige Jode was afgunstig en het slegte manne van die leeglopers saamgeneem en die stad in opskudding gebring deur ’n volksoploop te bewerk. En hulle het die huis van Jason aangeval en probeer om hulle voor die volk te bring.

kjv_text: And when they found them not, they drew Jason and certain brethren unto the rulers of the city, crying, These that have turned the world upside down are come hither also;
bsb_text: But when they could not find them, they dragged Jason and some other brothers before the city officials, shouting, “These men who have turned the world upside down have now come here,
aov_text: Maar toe hulle hul nie kry nie, het hulle Jason en ’n paar broeders na die stadsowerhede gesleep en geskreeu: Die mense wat die wêreld in opstand bring, hulle het hier ook gekom,

kjv_text: Whom Jason hath received: and these all do contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying that there is another king, one Jesus.
bsb_text: and Jason has welcomed them into his home. They are all defying Caesar’s decrees, saying that there is another king, named Jesus!”
aov_text: en Jason het hulle ontvang. En hulle almal handel teen die bevele van die keiser en sê dat daar ’n ander koning is, naamlik Jesus.

kjv_text: And they troubled the people and the rulers of the city, when they heard these things.
bsb_text: On hearing this, the crowd and city officials were greatly disturbed.
aov_text: En hulle het die skare in opskudding gebring en ook die stadsowerhede wat dit gehoor het.

kjv_text: And when they had taken security of Jason, and of the other, they let them go.
bsb_text: And they collected bond from Jason and the others, and then released them.
aov_text: Maar toe hulle van Jason en die ander genoegsame waarborg ontvang het, het hulle hul losgelaat.

kjv_text: And the brethren immediately sent away Paul and Silas by night unto Berea: who coming thither went into the synagogue of the Jews.
bsb_text: As soon as night had fallen, the brothers sent Paul and Silas away to Berea. On arriving there, they went into the Jewish synagogue.
aov_text: Daarop het die broeders dadelik in die nag Paulus en Silas na Beréa weggestuur. En toe hulle daar kom, het hulle na die sinagoge van die Jode gegaan.

kjv_text: These were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, and searched the scriptures daily, whether those things were so.
bsb_text: Now the Bereans were more noble-minded than the Thessalonians, for they received the message with great eagerness and examined the Scriptures every day to see if these teachings were true.
aov_text: En hierdie mense was edelmoediger as dié in Thessaloníka; hulle het die woord met alle welwillendheid ontvang en elke dag die Skrifte ondersoek of hierdie dinge so was.

kjv_text: Therefore many of them believed; also of honourable women which were Greeks, and of men, not a few.
bsb_text: As a result, many of them believed, along with quite a few prominent Greek women and men.
aov_text: Baie van hulle het dan ook gelowig geword, en van die aansienlike Grieke ’n groot aantal, vroue en manne.

kjv_text: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was preached of Paul at Berea, they came thither also, and stirred up the people.
bsb_text: But when the Jews from Thessalonica learned that Paul was also proclaiming the word of God in Berea, they went there themselves to incite and agitate the crowds.
aov_text: Maar toe die Jode van Thessaloníka verneem het dat die woord van God ook in Beréa deur Paulus verkondig was, het hulle gekom en die skare ook daar opgesweep.

kjv_text: And then immediately the brethren sent away Paul to go as it were to the sea: but Silas and Timotheus abode there still.
bsb_text: The brothers immediately sent Paul to the coast, but Silas and Timothy remained in Berea.
aov_text: Die broeders het Paulus toe dadelik weggestuur om in die rigting van die see te gaan, maar Silas en Timótheüs het daar gebly.

kjv_text: And they that conducted Paul brought him unto Athens: and receiving a commandment unto Silas and Timotheus for to come to him with all speed, they departed.
bsb_text: Those who escorted Paul brought him to Athens and then returned with instructions for Silas and Timothy to join him as soon as possible.
aov_text: EN die wat Paulus begelei het, het hom tot by Athéne gebring, en nadat hulle opdrag ontvang het aan Silas en Timótheüs om so gou moontlik na hom te kom, het hulle vertrek.

kjv_text: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was stirred in him, when he saw the city wholly given to idolatry.
bsb_text: While Paul was waiting for them in Athens, he was deeply disturbed in his spirit to see that the city was full of idols.
aov_text: En terwyl Paulus in Athéne vir hulle wag, het sy gees in hom opstandig geword toe hy sien dat die stad vol afgodsbeelde was.

kjv_text: Therefore disputed he in the synagogue with the Jews, and with the devout persons, and in the market daily with them that met with him.
bsb_text: So he reasoned in the synagogue with the Jews and God-fearing Gentiles, and in the marketplace with those he met each day.
aov_text: Hy het toe in die sinagoge met die Jode gespreek en met die godsdienstige mense, en elke dag op die mark met die wat hom teëkom.

kjv_text: Then certain philosophers of the Epicureans, and of the Stoicks, encountered him. And some said, What will this babbler say? other some, He seemeth to be a setter forth of strange gods: because he preached unto them Jesus, and the resurrection.
bsb_text: Some Epicurean and Stoic philosophers also began to debate with him. Some of them asked, “What is this babbler trying to say?” Others said, “He seems to be advocating foreign gods.” They said this because Paul was proclaiming the good news of Jesus and the resurrection.
aov_text: En sommige van die Epikuréïese en die Stoïsynse wysgere het met hom gestry, en sommige het gesê: Wat sou hierdie praatjiesmaker tog wil sê? Ander weer: Dit lyk of hy ’n verkondiger is van vreemde gode — omdat hy aan hulle die evangelie van Jesus en die opstanding verkondig het.

kjv_text: And they took him, and brought him unto Areopagus, saying, May we know what this new doctrine, whereof thou speakest, is?
bsb_text: So they took Paul and brought him to the Areopagus, where they asked him, “May we know what this new teaching is that you are presenting?
aov_text: En hulle het hom geneem en op die Areópagus gebring en gesê: Kan ons verneem wat hierdie nuwe leer is wat deur u verkondig word?

kjv_text: For thou bringest certain strange things to our ears: we would know therefore what these things mean.
bsb_text: For you are bringing some strange notions to our ears, and we want to know what they mean.”
aov_text: Want u bring sekere vreemde dinge in ons ore. Ons wil dan weet wat dit tog kan wees.

kjv_text: (For all the Athenians and strangers which were there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell, or to hear some new thing.)
bsb_text: Now all the Athenians and foreigners who lived there spent their time doing nothing more than hearing and articulating new ideas.
aov_text: Nou het al die Atheners en die uitlanders wat by hulle gewoon het, vir niks anders tyd gehad as om iets nuuts te sê en te hoor nie.

kjv_text: Then Paul stood in the midst of Mars' hill, and said, Ye men of Athens, I perceive that in all things ye are too superstitious.
bsb_text: Then Paul stood up in the meeting of the Areopagus and said, “Men of Athens, I see that in every way you are very religious.
aov_text: Paulus gaan toe in die middel van die Areópagus staan en sê: Atheners, ek sien dat julle in elke opsig baie godsdienstig is.

kjv_text: For as I passed by, and beheld your devotions, I found an altar with this inscription, TO THE UNKNOWN GOD. Whom therefore ye ignorantly worship, him declare I unto you.
bsb_text: For as I walked around and examined your objects of worship, I even found an altar with this inscription: TO AN UNKNOWN GOD. Therefore what you worship as something unknown, I now proclaim to you.
aov_text: Want terwyl ek rondgegaan en julle heiligdomme aanskou het, het ek ook ’n altaar gevind waarop geskrywe is: Aan ’n onbekende God. Hom dan wat julle vereer sonder om Hom te ken, verkondig ek aan julle.

kjv_text: God that made the world and all things therein, seeing that he is Lord of heaven and earth, dwelleth not in temples made with hands;
bsb_text: The God who made the world and everything in it is the Lord of heaven and earth and does not live in temples made by human hands.
aov_text: Die God wat die wêreld gemaak het en alles wat daarin is, Hy wat Here van hemel en aarde is, woon nie in tempels met hande gemaak nie.

kjv_text: Neither is worshipped with men's hands, as though he needed any thing, seeing he giveth to all life, and breath, and all things;
bsb_text: Nor is He served by human hands, as if He needed anything, because He Himself gives everyone life and breath and everything else.
aov_text: Ook word Hy nie deur mensehande gedien asof Hy aan iets behoefte het nie, omdat Hy self aan almal lewe en asem en alles gee.

kjv_text: And hath made of one blood all nations of men for to dwell on all the face of the earth, and hath determined the times before appointed, and the bounds of their habitation;
bsb_text: From one man He made every nation of men, that they should inhabit the whole earth; and He determined their appointed times and the boundaries of their lands.
aov_text: En Hy het uit een bloed al die nasies van die mensdom gemaak om oor die hele aarde te woon, terwyl Hy vooraf bepaalde tye en die grense van hulle woonplek vasgestel het,

kjv_text: That they should seek the Lord, if haply they might feel after him, and find him, though he be not far from every one of us:
bsb_text: God intended that they would seek Him and perhaps reach out for Him and find Him, though He is not far from each one of us.
aov_text: sodat hulle die Here kon soek, of hulle Hom miskien kon aanraak en vind, al is Hy nie ver van elkeen van ons nie;

kjv_text: For in him we live, and move, and have our being; as certain also of your own poets have said, For we are also his offspring.
bsb_text: ‘For in Him we live and move and have our being.’ As some of your own poets have said, ‘We are His offspring.’
aov_text: want in Hom lewe ons, beweeg ons en is ons, soos sommige van julle digters ook gesê het: Want ons is ook sy geslag.

kjv_text: Forasmuch then as we are the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Godhead is like unto gold, or silver, or stone, graven by art and man's device.
bsb_text: Therefore, being offspring of God, we should not think that the Divine Being is like gold or silver or stone, an image formed by man’s skill and imagination.
aov_text: As ons dan die geslag van God is, moet ons nie dink dat die godheid aan goud of silwer of steen, die beeldwerk van menslike kuns en uitvinding, gelyk is nie.

kjv_text: And the times of this ignorance God winked at; but now commandeth all men every where to repent:
bsb_text: Although God overlooked the ignorance of earlier times, He now commands all people everywhere to repent.
aov_text: God het dan die tye van onkunde oorgesien en verkondig nou aan al die mense oral dat hulle hul moet bekeer,

kjv_text: Because he hath appointed a day, in the which he will judge the world in righteousness by that man whom he hath ordained; whereof he hath given assurance unto all men, in that he hath raised him from the dead.
bsb_text: For He has set a day when He will judge the world with justice by the Man He has appointed. He has given proof of this to everyone by raising Him from the dead.”
aov_text: omdat Hy ’n dag bepaal het waarop Hy die wêreld in geregtigheid sal oordeel deur ’n Man wat Hy aangestel het, en Hy het hiervan aan almal sekerheid gegee deur Hom uit die dode op te wek.

kjv_text: And when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked: and others said, We will hear thee again of this matter.
bsb_text: When they heard about the resurrection of the dead, some began to mock him, but others said, “We want to hear you again on this topic.”
aov_text: Maar toe hulle van die opstanding van die dode hoor, het sommige begin spot, en ander het gesê: Ons sal u weer hieromtrent hoor.

kjv_text: So Paul departed from among them.
bsb_text: At that, Paul left the Areopagus.
aov_text: En so het Paulus van hulle weggegaan.

kjv_text: Howbeit certain men clave unto him, and believed: among the which was Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.
bsb_text: But some joined him and believed, including Dionysius the Areopagite, a woman named Damaris, and others who were with them.
aov_text: Maar sommige manne het by hom aangesluit en gelowig geword, onder wie ook Dionísius, die Areopagiet, was, en ’n vrou met die naam van Dámaris en ander saam met hulle.

kjv_text: After these things Paul departed from Athens, and came to Corinth;
bsb_text: After this, Paul left Athens and went to Corinth.
aov_text: EN daarna het Paulus uit Athéne vertrek en in Korinthe gekom.

kjv_text: And found a certain Jew named Aquila, born in Pontus, lately come from Italy, with his wife Priscilla; (because that Claudius had commanded all Jews to depart from Rome:) and came unto them.
bsb_text: There he found a Jew named Aquila, a native of Pontus, who had recently come from Italy with his wife Priscilla because Claudius had ordered all the Jews to leave Rome. Paul went to visit them,
aov_text: En hy het ’n Jood gevind met die naam van Áquila, afkomstig uit Pontus, wat onlangs met sy vrou Priscílla van Italië gekom het, omdat Claudius beveel het dat al die Jode uit Rome moes vertrek. Na hulle toe het hy gegaan;

kjv_text: And because he was of the same craft, he abode with them, and wrought: for by their occupation they were tentmakers.
bsb_text: and he stayed and worked with them because they were tentmakers by trade, just as he was.
aov_text: en omdat hy van dieselfde ambag was, het hy by hulle gebly en gewerk, want hulle was tentmakers van ambag.

kjv_text: And he reasoned in the synagogue every sabbath, and persuaded the Jews and the Greeks.
bsb_text: Every Sabbath he reasoned in the synagogue, trying to persuade Jews and Greeks alike.
aov_text: En hy het elke sabbat in die sinagoge gespreek en Jode sowel as Grieke oortuig.

kjv_text: And when Silas and Timotheus were come from Macedonia, Paul was pressed in the spirit, and testified to the Jews that Jesus was Christ.
bsb_text: And when Silas and Timothy came down from Macedonia, Paul devoted himself fully to the word, testifying to the Jews that Jesus is the Christ.
aov_text: En toe Silas en Timótheüs van Macedónië afgekom het, was Paulus ywerig besig om aan die Jode kragtig te betuig dat Jesus die Christus is.

kjv_text: And when they opposed themselves, and blasphemed, he shook his raiment, and said unto them, Your blood be upon your own heads; I am clean: from henceforth I will go unto the Gentiles.
bsb_text: But when they opposed and insulted him, he shook out his garments and told them, “Your blood be on your own heads! I am innocent of it. From now on I will go to the Gentiles.”
aov_text: Maar toe hulle aanhou om teëstand te bied en godslasterlike dinge te spreek, het hy sy klere uitgeskud en vir hulle gesê: Julle bloed is op julle hoof. Ek is rein. Van nou af sal ek na die heidene gaan.

kjv_text: And he departed thence, and entered into a certain man's house, named Justus, one that worshipped God, whose house joined hard to the synagogue.
bsb_text: So Paul left the synagogue and went next door to the house of Titus Justus, a worshiper of God.
aov_text: En hy het daarvandaan weggegaan en in die huis gekom van iemand met die naam van Justus, wat ’n godvresende man was, wie se huis naasaan die sinagoge gestaan het.

kjv_text: And Crispus, the chief ruler of the synagogue, believed on the Lord with all his house; and many of the Corinthians hearing believed, and were baptized.
bsb_text: Crispus, the synagogue leader, and his whole household believed in the Lord. And many of the Corinthians who heard the message believed and were baptized.
aov_text: En Crispus, die hoof van die sinagoge, het met sy hele huisgesin in die Here geglo; en ook baie van die Korinthiërs het, toe hulle hom hoor, gelowig geword en is gedoop.

kjv_text: Then spake the Lord to Paul in the night by a vision, Be not afraid, but speak, and hold not thy peace:
bsb_text: One night the Lord spoke to Paul in a vision: “Do not be afraid; keep on speaking; do not be silent.
aov_text: En die Here het deur ’n gesig in die nag aan Paulus gesê: Wees nie bevrees nie, maar spreek en moenie swyg nie;

kjv_text: For I am with thee, and no man shall set on thee to hurt thee: for I have much people in this city.
bsb_text: For I am with you and no one will lay a hand on you, because I have many people in this city.”
aov_text: want Ek is met jou, en niemand sal die hand aan jou slaan om jou kwaad aan te doen nie, want Ek het baie mense in hierdie stad.

kjv_text: And he continued there a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.
bsb_text: So Paul stayed for a year and a half, teaching the word of God among the Corinthians.
aov_text: En hy het daar gebly ’n jaar en ses maande lank en die woord van God onder hulle geleer.

kjv_text: And when Gallio was the deputy of Achaia, the Jews made insurrection with one accord against Paul, and brought him to the judgment seat,
bsb_text: While Gallio was proconsul of Achaia, the Jews coordinated an attack on Paul and brought him before the judgment seat.
aov_text: En toe Gállio goewerneur van Acháje was, het die Jode eenparig teen Paulus opgestaan en hom voor die regterstoel gebring

kjv_text: Saying, This fellow persuadeth men to worship God contrary to the law.
bsb_text: “This man is persuading the people to worship God in ways contrary to the law,” they said.
aov_text: en gesê: Hierdie man haal die mense oor om God op onwettige wyse te vereer.

kjv_text: And when Paul was now about to open his mouth, Gallio said unto the Jews, If it were a matter of wrong or wicked lewdness, O ye Jews, reason would that I should bear with you:
bsb_text: But just as Paul was about to speak, Gallio told the Jews, “If this matter involved a wrongdoing or vicious crime, O Jews, it would be reasonable for me to hear your complaint.
aov_text: En toe Paulus sy mond wou oopmaak, sê Gállio vir die Jode: As daar nou enige oortreding of kwaadwillige skelmstuk was, dan sou ek rede hê om julle te verdra, o Jode;

kjv_text: But if it be a question of words and names, and of your law, look ye to it; for I will be no judge of such matters.
bsb_text: But since it is a dispute about words and names and your own law, settle it yourselves. I refuse to be a judge of such things.”
aov_text: maar as dit ’n geskil is oor ’n woord en oor name en oor ’n wet wat vir julle geld, moet julle toesien, want daaroor wil ek geen regter wees nie.

kjv_text: And he drave them from the judgment seat.
bsb_text: And he drove them away from the judgment seat.
aov_text: En hy het hulle van die regterstoel weggedryf.

kjv_text: Then all the Greeks took Sosthenes, the chief ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. And Gallio cared for none of those things.
bsb_text: At this, the crowd seized Sosthenes the synagogue leader and beat him in front of the judgment seat. But none of this was of concern to Gallio.
aov_text: En al die Grieke het Sósthenes, die hoof van die sinagoge, gegryp en hom voor die regterstoel geslaan; en Gállio het hom aan niks van hierdie dinge gesteur nie.

kjv_text: And Paul after this tarried there yet a good while, and then took his leave of the brethren, and sailed thence into Syria, and with him Priscilla and Aquila; having shorn his head in Cenchrea: for he had a vow.
bsb_text: Paul remained in Corinth for quite some time before saying goodbye to the brothers. He had his head shaved in Cenchrea to keep a vow he had made, and then he sailed for Syria, accompanied by Priscilla and Aquila.
aov_text: En nadat Paulus nog verskeie dae daar gebly het, het hy van die broeders afskeid geneem en na Sírië uitgeseil, en saam met hom Priscílla en Áquila. En in Kenchréë het hy sy hoof geskeer, want hy het ’n gelofte gedoen.

kjv_text: And he came to Ephesus, and left them there: but he himself entered into the synagogue, and reasoned with the Jews.
bsb_text: When they reached Ephesus, Paul parted ways with Priscilla and Aquila. He himself went into the synagogue there and reasoned with the Jews.
aov_text: En hy het in Éfese aangekom en hulle daar laat bly, maar self in die sinagoge gegaan en met die Jode gespreek.

kjv_text: When they desired him to tarry longer time with them, he consented not;
bsb_text: When they asked him to stay for a while longer, he declined.
aov_text: En toe hulle versoek dat hy langer by hulle moes vertoef, het hy nie toegestem nie,

kjv_text: But bade them farewell, saying, I must by all means keep this feast that cometh in Jerusalem: but I will return again unto you, if God will. And he sailed from Ephesus.
bsb_text: But as he left, he said, “I will come back to you if God is willing.” And he set sail from Ephesus.
aov_text: maar van hulle afskeid geneem en gesê: Ek moet sekerlik die komende fees in Jerusalem vier, maar ek sal weer na julle terugkom as God wil. En hy het van Éfese afgevaar.

kjv_text: And when he had landed at Caesarea, and gone up, and saluted the church, he went down to Antioch.
bsb_text: When Paul had landed at Caesarea, he went up and greeted the church at Jerusalem. Then he went down to Antioch.
aov_text: En toe hy in Cesaréa gekom het en opgegaan en die gemeente gegroet het, het hy afgereis na Antiochíë.

kjv_text: And after he had spent some time there, he departed, and went over all the country of Galatia and Phrygia in order, strengthening all the disciples.
bsb_text: After Paul had spent some time in Antioch, he traveled from place to place throughout the region of Galatia and Phrygia, strengthening all the disciples.
aov_text: En nadat hy ’n tyd lank vertoef het, het hy vertrek en agtereenvolgens die land Galásië en Frígië deurgereis en al die dissipels versterk.

kjv_text: And a certain Jew named Apollos, born at Alexandria, an eloquent man, and mighty in the scriptures, came to Ephesus.
bsb_text: Meanwhile a Jew named Apollos, a native of Alexandria, came to Ephesus. He was an eloquent man, well versed in the Scriptures.
aov_text: EN ’n sekere Jood met die naam van Apollos, wat in Alexandríë gebore was, ’n welsprekende man, het in Éfese aangekom; en hy was magtig in die Skrifte.

kjv_text: This man was instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in the spirit, he spake and taught diligently the things of the Lord, knowing only the baptism of John.
bsb_text: He had been instructed in the way of the Lord and was fervent in spirit. He spoke and taught accurately about Jesus, though he knew only the baptism of John.
aov_text: Hy het onderrig ontvang in die weg van die Here; en vurig van gees, het hy gespreek en die dinge aangaande die Here noukeurig geleer, alhoewel hy net van die doop van Johannes geweet het.

kjv_text: And he began to speak boldly in the synagogue: whom when Aquila and Priscilla had heard, they took him unto them, and expounded unto him the way of God more perfectly.
bsb_text: And he began to speak boldly in the synagogue. When Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him in and explained to him the way of God more accurately.
aov_text: En hy het vrymoediglik in die sinagoge begin spreek; maar nadat Áquila en Priscílla hom gehoor het, het hulle hom by hulle geneem en hom noukeuriger die weg van God uitgelê.

kjv_text: And when he was disposed to pass into Achaia, the brethren wrote, exhorting the disciples to receive him: who, when he was come, helped them much which had believed through grace:
bsb_text: When Apollos resolved to cross over to Achaia, the brothers encouraged him and wrote to the disciples there to welcome him. On his arrival, he was a great help to those who by grace had believed.
aov_text: En toe hy wou deurgaan na Acháje, het die broeders hom aangemoedig en aan die dissipels geskrywe om hom te ontvang. En daar aangekom, was hy deur die genade die gelowiges tot veel nut;

kjv_text: For he mightily convinced the Jews, and that publickly, shewing by the scriptures that Jesus was Christ.
bsb_text: For he powerfully refuted the Jews in public debate, proving from the Scriptures that Jesus is the Christ.
aov_text: want hy het die Jode kragtig in die openbaar weerlê en deur die Skrifte bewys dat Jesus die Christus is.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, that, while Apollos was at Corinth, Paul having passed through the upper coasts came to Ephesus: and finding certain disciples,
bsb_text: While Apollos was at Corinth, Paul passed through the interior and came to Ephesus. There he found some disciples
aov_text: EN terwyl Apollos in Korinthe was, het Paulus die boonste landstreke deurgereis en in Éfese gekom; en daar het hy sommige dissipels gevind

kjv_text: He said unto them, Have ye received the Holy Ghost since ye believed? And they said unto him, We have not so much as heard whether there be any Holy Ghost.
bsb_text: and asked them, “Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you became believers?” “No,” they answered, “we have not even heard that there is a Holy Spirit.”
aov_text: en hulle gevra: Het julle die Heilige Gees ontvang toe julle gelowig geword het? En hulle antwoord hom: Ons het nie eens gehoor dat daar ’n Heilige Gees is nie.

kjv_text: And he said unto them, Unto what then were ye baptized? And they said, Unto John's baptism.
bsb_text: “Into what, then, were you baptized?” Paul asked. “The baptism of John,” they replied.
aov_text: En hy vra hulle: Met watter doop is julle dan gedoop? En hulle antwoord: Met die doop van Johannes.

kjv_text: Then said Paul, John verily baptized with the baptism of repentance, saying unto the people, that they should believe on him which should come after him, that is, on Christ Jesus.
bsb_text: Paul explained: “John’s baptism was a baptism of repentance. He told the people to believe in the One coming after him, that is, in Jesus.”
aov_text: Daarop sê Paulus: Johannes het met die doop van bekering gedoop en aan die volk gesê dat hulle moes glo in die Een wat ná hom kom, dit is in Christus Jesus.

kjv_text: When they heard this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
bsb_text: On hearing this, they were baptized into the name of the Lord Jesus.
aov_text: En toe hulle dit hoor, is hulle gedoop in die Naam van die Here Jesus.

kjv_text: And when Paul had laid his hands upon them, the Holy Ghost came on them; and they spake with tongues, and prophesied.
bsb_text: And when Paul laid his hands on them, the Holy Spirit came upon them, and they spoke in tongues and prophesied.
aov_text: En Paulus het hulle die hande opgelê, en die Heilige Gees het op hulle gekom, en hulle het met tale gespreek en geprofeteer.

kjv_text: And all the men were about twelve.
bsb_text: There were about twelve men in all.
aov_text: En altesaam was hulle omtrent twaalf manne.

kjv_text: And he went into the synagogue, and spake boldly for the space of three months, disputing and persuading the things concerning the kingdom of God.
bsb_text: Then Paul went into the synagogue and spoke boldly there for three months, arguing persuasively about the kingdom of God.
aov_text: En hy het in die sinagoge ingegaan en vrymoediglik drie maande lank met hulle geredeneer en hulle probeer oortuig van die dinge wat die koninkryk van God aangaan.

kjv_text: But when divers were hardened, and believed not, but spake evil of that way before the multitude, he departed from them, and separated the disciples, disputing daily in the school of one Tyrannus.
bsb_text: But when some of them stubbornly refused to believe and publicly maligned the Way, Paul took his disciples and left the synagogue to conduct daily discussions in the lecture hall of Tyrannus.
aov_text: Maar toe sommige hulle verhard en ongehoorsaam was en voor die menigte aanhou kwaadspreek van die Weg, het hy van hulle weggegaan en die dissipels afsonderlik geneem en elke dag in die skool van ’n sekere Tiránnus samesprekinge gehou.

kjv_text: And this continued by the space of two years; so that all they which dwelt in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks.
bsb_text: This continued for two years, so that everyone who lived in the province of Asia, Jews and Greeks alike, heard the word of the Lord.
aov_text: En dit het twee jaar lank geduur, sodat al die inwoners van Asië die woord van die Here Jesus gehoor het, Jode sowel as Grieke.

kjv_text: And God wrought special miracles by the hands of Paul:
bsb_text: God did extraordinary miracles through the hands of Paul,
aov_text: En God het buitengewone kragte deur die hande van Paulus gedoen,

kjv_text: So that from his body were brought unto the sick handkerchiefs or aprons, and the diseases departed from them, and the evil spirits went out of them.
bsb_text: so that even handkerchiefs and aprons that had touched him were taken to the sick, and the diseases and evil spirits left them.
aov_text: sodat selfs wanneer doeke of voorskote wat aan sy lyf was, op die siekes gelê is, die siektes van hulle gewyk en die bose geeste van hulle uitgegaan het.

kjv_text: Then certain of the vagabond Jews, exorcists, took upon them to call over them which had evil spirits the name of the LORD Jesus, saying, We adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preacheth.
bsb_text: Now there were some itinerant Jewish exorcists who tried to invoke the name of the Lord Jesus over those with evil spirits. They would say, “I bind you by Jesus, whom Paul proclaims.”
aov_text: En sommige van die rondtrekkende Jode, duiwelbesweerders, het dit gewaag om die Naam van die Here Jesus te noem oor die wat bose geeste gehad het, en te sê: Ons besweer julle by die Jesus wat Paulus verkondig!

kjv_text: And there were seven sons of one Sceva, a Jew, and chief of the priests, which did so.
bsb_text: Seven sons of Sceva, a Jewish chief priest, were doing this.
aov_text: Dit was sekere sewe seuns van Skeva, ’n Joodse owerpriester, wat dit gedoen het.

kjv_text: And the evil spirit answered and said, Jesus I know, and Paul I know; but who are ye?
bsb_text: Eventually, one of the evil spirits answered them, “Jesus I know, and I know about Paul, but who are you?”
aov_text: Maar die bose gees het geantwoord en gesê: Jesus ken ek, en van Paulus weet ek, maar julle, wie is julle?

kjv_text: And the man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, and overcame them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.
bsb_text: Then the man with the evil spirit jumped on them and overpowered them all. The attack was so violent that they ran out of the house naked and wounded.
aov_text: Toe spring die man in wie die bose gees was, op hulle en oormeester en oorweldig hulle, sodat hulle naak en gewond uit daardie huis gevlug het.

kjv_text: And this was known to all the Jews and Greeks also dwelling at Ephesus; and fear fell on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.
bsb_text: This became known to all the Jews and Greeks living in Ephesus, and fear came over all of them. So the name of the Lord Jesus was held in high honor.
aov_text: En dit het bekend geword aan al die Jode en Grieke wat in Éfese woon, en vrees het op hulle almal geval, en die Naam van die Here Jesus is groot gemaak.

kjv_text: And many that believed came, and confessed, and shewed their deeds.
bsb_text: Many who had believed now came forward, confessing and disclosing their deeds.
aov_text: En baie van die wat gelowig geword het, het belydenis kom doen en hulle dade bekend gemaak;

kjv_text: Many of them also which used curious arts brought their books together, and burned them before all men: and they counted the price of them, and found it fifty thousand pieces of silver.
bsb_text: And a number of those who had practiced magic arts brought their books and burned them in front of everyone. When the value of the books was calculated, the total came to fifty thousand drachmas.
aov_text: en verskeie van die wat met towery omgegaan het, het die boeke bymekaargebring en voor almal verbrand; en hulle het die waarde daarvan bereken en gevind dat dit vyftigduisend silwerstukke was.

kjv_text: So mightily grew the word of God and prevailed.
bsb_text: So the word of the Lord powerfully continued to spread and prevail.
aov_text: So het die woord van die Here met krag gegroei en sterk geword.

kjv_text: After these things were ended, Paul purposed in the spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go to Jerusalem, saying, After I have been there, I must also see Rome.
bsb_text: After these things had happened, Paul resolved in the Spirit to go to Jerusalem after he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia. “After I have been there,” he said, “I must see Rome as well.”
aov_text: En toe hierdie dinge verby was, het Paulus hom voorgeneem om deur Macedónië en Acháje te gaan en na Jerusalem te reis. Hy het gesê: Nadat ek daar gewees het, moet ek Rome ook sien.

kjv_text: So he sent into Macedonia two of them that ministered unto him, Timotheus and Erastus; but he himself stayed in Asia for a season.
bsb_text: He sent two of his helpers, Timothy and Erastus, to Macedonia, while he stayed for a time in the province of Asia.
aov_text: Daarop stuur hy twee van sy helpers, Timótheüs en Erástus, na Macedónië, terwyl hy self nog ’n tyd lank in Asië gebly het.

kjv_text: And the same time there arose no small stir about that way.
bsb_text: About that time there arose a great disturbance about the Way.
aov_text: En omtrent hierdie tyd het daar geen klein opskudding met betrekking tot die Weg ontstaan nie.

kjv_text: For a certain man named Demetrius, a silversmith, which made silver shrines for Diana, brought no small gain unto the craftsmen;
bsb_text: It began with a silversmith named Demetrius who made silver shrines of Artemis, bringing much business to the craftsmen.
aov_text: Want iemand met die naam van Demétrius, ’n silwersmid, maker van silwertempeltjies van Diana, het ’n aansienlike verdienste aan die ambagsmanne verskaf.

kjv_text: Whom he called together with the workmen of like occupation, and said, Sirs, ye know that by this craft we have our wealth.
bsb_text: Demetrius assembled the craftsmen, along with the workmen in related trades. “Men,” he said, “you know that this business is our source of prosperity.
aov_text: En toe hy hulle en die werkers in daardie soort bedrywe bymekaargeroep het, sê hy: Manne, julle weet dat ons welvaart uit hierdie verdienste is,

kjv_text: Moreover ye see and hear, that not alone at Ephesus, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul hath persuaded and turned away much people, saying that they be no gods, which are made with hands:
bsb_text: And you can see and hear that not only in Ephesus, but in nearly the whole province of Asia, Paul has persuaded a great number of people to turn away. He says that man-made gods are no gods at all.
aov_text: en julle sien en hoor dat nie alleen in Éfese nie, maar byna in die hele Asië, hierdie Paulus ’n aansienlike skare oorgehaal en afvallig gemaak het deur te sê dat dit geen gode is wat met hande gemaak word nie.

kjv_text: So that not only this our craft is in danger to be set at nought; but also that the temple of the great goddess Diana should be despised, and her magnificence should be destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worshippeth.
bsb_text: There is danger not only that our business will fall into disrepute, but also that the temple of the great goddess Artemis will be discredited and her majesty deposed—she who is worshiped by all the province of Asia and the whole world.”
aov_text: Nou is daar nie alleen gevaar dat hierdie vak van ons in veragting kom nie, maar ook dat die tempel van die groot godin Diana as niks gereken word, en dat haar majesteit wat die hele Asië, ja, die wêreld, vereer, ook tot niet sal gaan.

kjv_text: And when they heard these sayings, they were full of wrath, and cried out, saying, Great is Diana of the Ephesians.
bsb_text: When the men heard this, they were enraged and began shouting, “Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!”
aov_text: En toe hulle dit hoor, is hulle met woede vervul en het geskreeu en gesê: Groot is die Diana van die Efésiërs!

kjv_text: And the whole city was filled with confusion: and having caught Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul's companions in travel, they rushed with one accord into the theatre.
bsb_text: Soon the whole city was in disarray. They rushed together into the theatre, dragging with them Gaius and Aristarchus, Paul’s traveling companions from Macedonia.
aov_text: Daarop raak die hele stad heeltemal in verwarring, en hulle storm soos een man na die skouburg en sleep Gajus en Aristárchus saam, Macedóniërs wat reisgenote van Paulus was.

kjv_text: And when Paul would have entered in unto the people, the disciples suffered him not.
bsb_text: Paul wanted to go before the assembly, but the disciples would not allow him.
aov_text: En toe Paulus onder die volk wou ingaan, het die dissipels hom dit nie toegelaat nie.

kjv_text: And certain of the chief of Asia, which were his friends, sent unto him, desiring him that he would not adventure himself into the theatre.
bsb_text: Even some of Paul’s friends who were officials of the province of Asia sent word to him, begging him not to venture into the theatre.
aov_text: En sommige van die owerstes van Asië wat sy vriende was, het ook na hom gestuur en hom gesmeek dat hy hom nie in die skouburg moes begeef nie.

kjv_text: Some therefore cried one thing, and some another: for the assembly was confused; and the more part knew not wherefore they were come together.
bsb_text: Meanwhile the assembly was in turmoil. Some were shouting one thing and some another, and most of them did not even know why they were there.
aov_text: Hulle het dan aangehou skreeu, sommige dit en ander dat; want die vergadering was in die war, en die meeste het nie geweet waarvoor hulle bymekaargekom het nie.

kjv_text: And they drew Alexander out of the multitude, the Jews putting him forward. And Alexander beckoned with the hand, and would have made his defence unto the people.
bsb_text: The Jews in the crowd pushed Alexander forward to explain himself, and he motioned for silence so he could make his defense to the people.
aov_text: En hulle het Alexander uit die skare vorentoe laat kom, omdat die Jode hom vorentoe gestoot het; en Alexander het met die hand gewink en wou hom by die volk verdedig.

kjv_text: But when they knew that he was a Jew, all with one voice about the space of two hours cried out, Great is Diana of the Ephesians.
bsb_text: But when they realized that he was a Jew, they all shouted in unison for about two hours: “Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!”
aov_text: Maar toe hulle verstaan dat hy ’n Jood is, gaan daar een geroep van almal op terwyl hulle omtrent twee uur lank skreeu: Groot is die Diana van die Efésiërs!

kjv_text: And when the townclerk had appeased the people, he said, Ye men of Ephesus, what man is there that knoweth not how that the city of the Ephesians is a worshipper of the great goddess Diana, and of the image which fell down from Jupiter?
bsb_text: Finally the city clerk quieted the crowd and declared, “Men of Ephesus, doesn’t everyone know that the city of Ephesus is guardian of the temple of the great Artemis and of her image, which fell from heaven?
aov_text: Maar die stadsklerk het die skare tot bedaring gebring en gesê: Efésiërs, watter mens is daar tog wat nie weet dat die stad van die Efésiërs die tempelbewaarder is van die groot godin Diana en van die beeld wat uit die hemel geval het nie?

kjv_text: Seeing then that these things cannot be spoken against, ye ought to be quiet, and to do nothing rashly.
bsb_text: Since these things are undeniable, you ought to be calm and not do anything rash.
aov_text: Terwyl dit dan nie weerspreek kan word nie, behoort julle rustig te wees en niks onbedags te doen nie.

kjv_text: For ye have brought hither these men, which are neither robbers of churches, nor yet blasphemers of your goddess.
bsb_text: For you have brought these men here, though they have neither robbed our temple nor blasphemed our goddess.
aov_text: Want julle het hierdie manne gebring, wat geen tempelrowers is nie en ook nie julle godin laster nie.

kjv_text: Wherefore if Demetrius, and the craftsmen which are with him, have a matter against any man, the law is open, and there are deputies: let them implead one another.
bsb_text: So if Demetrius and his fellow craftsmen have a complaint against anyone, the courts are open and proconsuls are available. Let them bring charges against one another there.
aov_text: As Demétrius en sy ambagsmanne dan ’n saak teen iemand het, die hofsittings word gehou, en daar is regters: laat hulle mekaar aanklaag.
