kjv_text: But if ye enquire any thing concerning other matters, it shall be determined in a lawful assembly.
bsb_text: But if you are seeking anything beyond this, it must be settled in a legal assembly.
aov_text: Maar as julle nog iets anders verlang, dit sal in die wettige vergadering beslis word.

kjv_text: For we are in danger to be called in question for this day's uproar, there being no cause whereby we may give an account of this concourse.
bsb_text: For we are in jeopardy of being charged with rioting for today’s events, and we have no justification to account for this commotion.”
aov_text: Want ons loop gevaar om oor die oproer van vandag aangeklaag te word, aangesien daar geen grond is waarop ons sal kan rekenskap gee van hierdie oploop nie.

kjv_text: And when he had thus spoken, he dismissed the assembly.
bsb_text: After he had said this, he dismissed the assembly.
aov_text: En met hierdie woorde het hy die vergadering ontbind.

kjv_text: And after the uproar was ceased, Paul called unto him the disciples, and embraced them, and departed for to go into Macedonia.
bsb_text: When the uproar had ended, Paul sent for the disciples. And after encouraging them, he said goodbye to them and left for Macedonia.
aov_text: EN nadat die oproer verby was, het Paulus die dissipels na hom geroep en gegroet en het vertrek om na Macedónië te reis.

kjv_text: And when he had gone over those parts, and had given them much exhortation, he came into Greece,
bsb_text: After traveling through that area and speaking many words of encouragement, he arrived in Greece,
aov_text: En hy het daardie streke deurgegaan, en nadat hy hulle met baie woorde bemoedig het, in Griekeland gekom.

kjv_text: And there abode three months. And when the Jews laid wait for him, as he was about to sail into Syria, he purposed to return through Macedonia.
bsb_text: where he stayed three months. And when the Jews formed a plot against him as he was about to sail for Syria, he decided to go back through Macedonia.
aov_text: En daar het hy drie maande gebly; maar toe die Jode teen hom saamgespan het, terwyl hy juis na Sírië sou afvaar, het hy besluit om deur Macedónië terug te gaan.

kjv_text: And there accompanied him into Asia Sopater of Berea; and of the Thessalonians, Aristarchus and Secundus; and Gaius of Derbe, and Timotheus; and of Asia, Tychicus and Trophimus.
bsb_text: Paul was accompanied by Sopater son of Pyrrhus from Berea, Aristarchus and Secundus from Thessalonica, Gaius from Derbe, Timothy, and Tychicus and Trophimus from the province of Asia.
aov_text: En tot in Asië het Sópater van Beréa hom vergesel, en van die Thessalonicense, Aristárchus en Secúndus, en Gajus van Derbe en Timótheüs, en uit Asië Tíchikus en Trófimus.

kjv_text: These going before tarried for us at Troas.
bsb_text: These men went on ahead and waited for us in Troas.
aov_text: Hulle het vooruitgegaan en in Troas op ons gewag.

kjv_text: And we sailed away from Philippi after the days of unleavened bread, and came unto them to Troas in five days; where we abode seven days.
bsb_text: And after the Feast of Unleavened Bread, we sailed from Philippi, and five days later we rejoined them in Troas, where we stayed seven days.
aov_text: Maar ná die dae van die ongesuurde brode het ons van Filíppi uitgeseil en binne vyf dae by hulle in Troas gekom, waar ons sewe dae deurgebring het.

kjv_text: And upon the first day of the week, when the disciples came together to break bread, Paul preached unto them, ready to depart on the morrow; and continued his speech until midnight.
bsb_text: On the first day of the week we came together to break bread. Since Paul was ready to leave the next day, he talked to them and kept on speaking until midnight.
aov_text: En op die eerste dag van die week, toe die dissipels vergader het om brood te breek, het Paulus hulle toegespreek, omdat hy die volgende dag sou vertrek, en hy het sy rede gerek tot middernag toe.

kjv_text: And there were many lights in the upper chamber, where they were gathered together.
bsb_text: Now there were many lamps in the upper room where we were gathered.
aov_text: En daar was baie lampe in die bovertrek waar hulle vergader het.

kjv_text: And there sat in a window a certain young man named Eutychus, being fallen into a deep sleep: and as Paul was long preaching, he sunk down with sleep, and fell down from the third loft, and was taken up dead.
bsb_text: And a certain young man named Eutychus, seated in the window, was sinking into a deep sleep as Paul talked on and on. When he was sound asleep, he fell from the third story and was picked up dead.
aov_text: En ’n sekere jongman met die naam van Eútichus het in die venster gesit en weggesink in ’n diepe slaap; en toe Paulus nog lank gespreek het, is hy oorweldig deur die slaap en het van die derde verdieping afgeval en is dood opgetel.

kjv_text: And Paul went down, and fell on him, and embracing him said, Trouble not yourselves; for his life is in him.
bsb_text: But Paul went down, threw himself on the young man, and embraced him. “Do not be alarmed!” he said. “He is still alive!”
aov_text: Toe gaan Paulus ondertoe en val op hom en slaan sy arms om hom en sê: Moenie so te kere gaan nie, want sy lewe is in hom.

kjv_text: When he therefore was come up again, and had broken bread, and eaten, and talked a long while, even till break of day, so he departed.
bsb_text: Then Paul went back upstairs, broke bread, and ate. And after speaking until daybreak, he departed.
aov_text: En hy het boontoe gegaan en brood gebreek en geëet; en nadat hy nog ’n geruime tyd gespreek het tot dagbreek toe, het hy vertrek.

kjv_text: And they brought the young man alive, and were not a little comforted.
bsb_text: And the people were greatly relieved to take the boy home alive.
aov_text: En hulle het die seun lewendig huis toe weggebring en was uitermate getroos.

kjv_text: And we went before to ship, and sailed unto Assos, there intending to take in Paul: for so had he appointed, minding himself to go afoot.
bsb_text: We went on ahead to the ship and sailed to Assos, where we were to take Paul aboard. He had arranged this because he was going there on foot.
aov_text: Maar ons het vooruit op die skip gegaan en afgevaar na Assus, waar ons van plan was om Paulus aan boord te neem; want so het hy dit bestel, omdat hy self te voet wou gaan.

kjv_text: And when he met with us at Assos, we took him in, and came to Mitylene.
bsb_text: And when he met us at Assos, we took him aboard and went on to Mitylene.
aov_text: Toe hy ons dan in Assus ontmoet, het ons hom aan boord geneem en by Mitiléne gekom.

kjv_text: And we sailed thence, and came the next day over against Chios; and the next day we arrived at Samos, and tarried at Trogyllium; and the next day we came to Miletus.
bsb_text: Sailing on from there, we arrived the next day opposite Chios. The day after that we arrived at Samos, and on the following day we came to Miletus.
aov_text: En daarvandaan het ons weggevaar en die volgende dag teenoor Chios gekom, en die ander dag na Samos oorgevaar en in Trogíllion oorgebly en die dag daarop by Miléte gekom.

kjv_text: For Paul had determined to sail by Ephesus, because he would not spend the time in Asia: for he hasted, if it were possible for him, to be at Jerusalem the day of Pentecost.
bsb_text: Paul had decided to sail past Ephesus to avoid spending time in the province of Asia, because he was in a hurry to reach Jerusalem, if possible, by the day of Pentecost.
aov_text: Want Paulus het besluit om by Éfese verby te vaar, sodat hy nie in Asië tyd sou verloor nie; want hy het hom gehaas om, as dit vir hom moontlik was, op die pinksterdag in Jerusalem te wees.

kjv_text: And from Miletus he sent to Ephesus, and called the elders of the church.
bsb_text: From Miletus, Paul sent to Ephesus for the elders of the church.
aov_text: EN van Miléte het hy gestuur na Éfese en die ouderlinge van die gemeente laat roep.

kjv_text: And when they were come to him, he said unto them, Ye know, from the first day that I came into Asia, after what manner I have been with you at all seasons,
bsb_text: When they came to him, he said, “You know how I lived the whole time I was with you, from the first day I arrived in the province of Asia.
aov_text: En toe hulle by hom kom, sê hy vir hulle: Julle weet hoe ek, van die eerste dag af dat ek in Asië aangekom het, die hele tyd by julle gewees het

kjv_text: Serving the LORD with all humility of mind, and with many tears, and temptations, which befell me by the lying in wait of the Jews:
bsb_text: I served the Lord with great humility and with tears, especially in the trials that came upon me through the plots of the Jews.
aov_text: en die Here gedien het met alle nederigheid en baie trane en beproewinge wat oor my gekom het deur die komplotte van die Jode;

kjv_text: And how I kept back nothing that was profitable unto you, but have shewed you, and have taught you publickly, and from house to house,
bsb_text: I did not shrink back from declaring anything that was helpful to you as I taught you publicly and from house to house,
aov_text: hoe ek niks agtergehou het van wat nuttig is nie, om dit aan julle te verkondig en julle te onderrig in die openbaar en in julle huise,

kjv_text: Testifying both to the Jews, and also to the Greeks, repentance toward God, and faith toward our Lord Jesus Christ.
bsb_text: testifying to Jews and Greeks alike about repentance to God and faith in our Lord Jesus Christ.
aov_text: terwyl ek kragtig by die Jode sowel as die Grieke aangedring het op die bekering tot God en die geloof in onse Here Jesus Christus.

kjv_text: And now, behold, I go bound in the spirit unto Jerusalem, not knowing the things that shall befall me there:
bsb_text: And now, compelled by the Spirit, I am going to Jerusalem, not knowing what will happen to me there.
aov_text: En kyk, ek gaan nou gebind deur die Gees na Jerusalem; en watter dinge my daar sal oorkom, weet ek nie,

kjv_text: Save that the Holy Ghost witnesseth in every city, saying that bonds and afflictions abide me.
bsb_text: I only know that in town after town the Holy Spirit warns me that chains and afflictions await me.
aov_text: behalwe dat die Heilige Gees in elke stad kragtig getuig en sê dat boeie en verdrukkinge my wag.

kjv_text: But none of these things move me, neither count I my life dear unto myself, so that I might finish my course with joy, and the ministry, which I have received of the Lord Jesus, to testify the gospel of the grace of God.
bsb_text: But I consider my life of no value to me, if only I may finish my course and complete the ministry I have received from the Lord Jesus—the ministry of testifying to the good news of God’s grace.
aov_text: Maar ek bekommer my glad nie en ek ag ook my lewe vir myself nie dierbaar nie, sodat ek met blydskap my loopbaan kan volbring en die bediening wat ek van die Here Jesus ontvang het, om kragtig te getuig vir die evangelie van die genade van God.

kjv_text: And now, behold, I know that ye all, among whom I have gone preaching the kingdom of God, shall see my face no more.
bsb_text: Now I know that none of you among whom I have preached the kingdom will see my face again.
aov_text: En nou weet ek dat julle almal onder wie ek rondgegaan en die koninkryk van God verkondig het, my aangesig nie meer sal sien nie.

kjv_text: Wherefore I take you to record this day, that I am pure from the blood of all men.
bsb_text: Therefore I testify to you this day that I am innocent of the blood of all men.
aov_text: Daarom betuig ek aan julle op hierdie dag dat ek rein is van die bloed van almal.

kjv_text: For I have not shunned to declare unto you all the counsel of God.
bsb_text: For I did not shrink back from declaring to you the whole will of God.
aov_text: Want ek het nie nagelaat om aan julle die hele raad van God te verkondig nie.

kjv_text: Take heed therefore unto yourselves, and to all the flock, over the which the Holy Ghost hath made you overseers, to feed the church of God, which he hath purchased with his own blood.
bsb_text: Keep watch over yourselves and the entire flock of which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers. Be shepherds of the church of God, which He purchased with His own blood.
aov_text: Gee dan ag op julleself en op die hele kudde waaroor die Heilige Gees julle as opsieners aangestel het om as herders die gemeente van God te versorg, wat Hy deur sy eie bloed verkry het.

kjv_text: For I know this, that after my departing shall grievous wolves enter in among you, not sparing the flock.
bsb_text: I know that after my departure, savage wolves will come in among you and will not spare the flock.
aov_text: Want ek weet dit, dat ná my vertrek wrede wolwe onder julle sal inkom en die kudde nie sal spaar nie.

kjv_text: Also of your own selves shall men arise, speaking perverse things, to draw away disciples after them.
bsb_text: Even from your own number, men will rise up and distort the truth to draw away disciples after them.
aov_text: Ja, uit julle self sal daar manne opstaan wat verkeerde dinge praat om die dissipels weg te trek agter hulle aan.

kjv_text: Therefore watch, and remember, that by the space of three years I ceased not to warn every one night and day with tears.
bsb_text: Therefore be alert and remember that for three years I never stopped warning each of you night and day with tears.
aov_text: Daarom moet julle waak en onthou dat ek drie jaar lank nag en dag nie opgehou het om elkeen met trane te vermaan nie.

kjv_text: And now, brethren, I commend you to God, and to the word of his grace, which is able to build you up, and to give you an inheritance among all them which are sanctified.
bsb_text: And now I commit you to God and to the word of His grace, which can build you up and give you an inheritance among all who are sanctified.
aov_text: En nou, broeders, dra ek julle op aan God en aan die woord van sy genade, wat magtig is julle op te bou en julle ’n erfdeel te gee onder al die geheiligdes.

kjv_text: I have coveted no man's silver, or gold, or apparel.
bsb_text: I have not coveted anyone’s silver or gold or clothing.
aov_text: Niemand se silwer of goud of klere het ek begeer nie;

kjv_text: Yea, ye yourselves know, that these hands have ministered unto my necessities, and to them that were with me.
bsb_text: You yourselves know that these hands of mine have ministered to my own needs and those of my companions.
aov_text: maar julle weet self dat hierdie hande voorsien het in die behoeftes van my en die wat by my was.

kjv_text: I have shewed you all things, how that so labouring ye ought to support the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, how he said, It is more blessed to give than to receive.
bsb_text: In everything, I showed you that by this kind of hard work we must help the weak, remembering the words of the Lord Jesus Himself: ‘It is more blessed to give than to receive.’”
aov_text: Ek het julle in alles getoon dat ons deur so te arbei die swakkes moet help en die woorde van die Here Jesus moet onthou, dat Hy gesê het: Dit is saliger om te gee as om te ontvang.

kjv_text: And when he had thus spoken, he kneeled down, and prayed with them all.
bsb_text: When Paul had said this, he knelt down with all of them and prayed.
aov_text: En ná hierdie woorde het hy neergekniel en met hulle almal saam gebid.

kjv_text: And they all wept sore, and fell on Paul's neck, and kissed him,
bsb_text: They all wept openly as they embraced Paul and kissed him.
aov_text: En daar het ’n groot geween ontstaan van almal, en hulle het Paulus om die hals geval en hom gesoen,

kjv_text: Sorrowing most of all for the words which he spake, that they should see his face no more. And they accompanied him unto the ship.
bsb_text: They were especially grieved by his statement that they would never see his face again. Then they accompanied him to the ship.
aov_text: veral bedroef oor die woord wat hy gesê het, dat hulle sy aangesig nie meer sou sien nie. En hulle het hom na die skip begelei.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, that after we were gotten from them, and had launched, we came with a straight course unto Coos, and the day following unto Rhodes, and from thence unto Patara:
bsb_text: After we had torn ourselves away from them, we sailed directly to Cos, and the next day on to Rhodes, and from there to Patara.
aov_text: EN nadat ons ons van hulle losgeskeur het, het ons afgevaar en reguit koers gehou en by Kos aangekom, en die volgende dag by Rhodus en daarvandaan by Pátara.

kjv_text: And finding a ship sailing over unto Phenicia, we went aboard, and set forth.
bsb_text: Finding a ship crossing over to Phoenicia, we boarded it and set sail.
aov_text: En ons het ’n skip gevind wat na Fenícië sou oorseil, en daarop gegaan en afgevaar.

kjv_text: Now when we had discovered Cyprus, we left it on the left hand, and sailed into Syria, and landed at Tyre: for there the ship was to unlade her burden.
bsb_text: After sighting Cyprus and passing south of it, we sailed on to Syria and landed at Tyre, where the ship was to unload its cargo.
aov_text: En toe ons Ciprus in die gesig gekry het en dit aan die linkerhand laat lê het, het ons na Sírië gevaar en by Tirus aangekom, want daar sou die skip sy vrag aflaai.

kjv_text: And finding disciples, we tarried there seven days: who said to Paul through the Spirit, that he should not go up to Jerusalem.
bsb_text: We sought out the disciples in Tyre and stayed with them seven days. Through the Spirit they kept telling Paul not to go up to Jerusalem.
aov_text: En nadat ons die dissipels gevind het, het ons daar sewe dae gebly; en hulle het vir Paulus deur die Gees gesê om nie op te gaan na Jerusalem nie.

kjv_text: And when we had accomplished those days, we departed and went our way; and they all brought us on our way, with wives and children, till we were out of the city: and we kneeled down on the shore, and prayed.
bsb_text: But when our time there had ended, we set out on our journey. All the disciples, with their wives and children, accompanied us out of the city and knelt down on the beach to pray with us.
aov_text: Maar toe ons die dae uitgebly het, het ons vertrek en op reis gegaan, terwyl almal, met vroue en kinders, ons tot buitekant die stad begelei; en ons het op die strand neergekniel en gebid.

kjv_text: And when we had taken our leave one of another, we took ship; and they returned home again.
bsb_text: And after we had said our farewells, we went aboard the ship, and they returned home.
aov_text: En nadat ons mekaar gegroet het, het ons aan boord gegaan, en hulle het teruggegaan huis toe.

kjv_text: And when we had finished our course from Tyre, we came to Ptolemais, and saluted the brethren, and abode with them one day.
bsb_text: When we had finished our voyage from Tyre, we landed at Ptolemais, where we greeted the brothers and stayed with them for a day.
aov_text: Maar ons het die seereis van Tirus af voltooi en by Ptolemáis gekom; en ons het die broeders gegroet en een dag by hulle gebly.

kjv_text: And the next day we that were of Paul's company departed, and came unto Caesarea: and we entered into the house of Philip the evangelist, which was one of the seven; and abode with him.
bsb_text: Leaving the next day, we went on to Caesarea and stayed at the home of Philip the evangelist, who was one of the Seven.
aov_text: En die volgende dag het ons, die geselskap van Paulus, vertrek en in Cesaréa aangekom; en ons het ons intrek geneem in die huis van Filippus, die evangelis, wat een van die sewe diakens was, en by hom gebly.

kjv_text: And the same man had four daughters, virgins, which did prophesy.
bsb_text: He had four unmarried daughters who prophesied.
aov_text: En hy het vier ongetroude dogters gehad wat die profetiese gawe besit het.

kjv_text: And as we tarried there many days, there came down from Judaea a certain prophet, named Agabus.
bsb_text: After we had been there several days, a prophet named Agabus came down from Judea.
aov_text: En onderwyl ons baie dae daar oorgebly het, het ’n sekere profeet met die naam van Ágabus van Judéa afgekom.

kjv_text: And when he was come unto us, he took Paul's girdle, and bound his own hands and feet, and said, Thus saith the Holy Ghost, So shall the Jews at Jerusalem bind the man that owneth this girdle, and shall deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles.
bsb_text: Coming over to us, he took Paul’s belt, bound his own feet and hands, and said, “The Holy Spirit says: ‘In this way the Jews of Jerusalem will bind the owner of this belt and hand him over to the Gentiles.’”
aov_text: En toe hy by ons kom, neem hy die gordel van Paulus en bind sy eie hande en voete en sê: Dít spreek die Heilige Gees: So sal die Jode die man wie se gordel dit is, in Jerusalem bind en in die hande van heidene oorlewer.

kjv_text: And when we heard these things, both we, and they of that place, besought him not to go up to Jerusalem.
bsb_text: When we heard this, we and the people there pleaded with Paul not to go up to Jerusalem.
aov_text: En toe ons dit hoor, het ons saam met die broeders van die plek hom gesmeek om nie op te gaan na Jerusalem nie.

kjv_text: Then Paul answered, What mean ye to weep and to break mine heart? for I am ready not to be bound only, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.
bsb_text: Then Paul answered, “Why are you weeping and breaking my heart? I am ready not only to be bound, but also to die in Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.”
aov_text: Maar Paulus het geantwoord: Wat doen julle dat julle ween en my hart week maak? Want ek is bereid nie alleen om gebind te word nie, maar ook om in Jerusalem te sterwe vir die Naam van die Here Jesus.

kjv_text: And when he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, The will of the Lord be done.
bsb_text: When he would not be dissuaded, we fell silent and said, “The Lord’s will be done.”
aov_text: Toe hy dan nie oor te haal was nie, was ons tevrede en het gesê: Laat die wil van die Here geskied!

kjv_text: And after those days we took up our carriages, and went up to Jerusalem.
bsb_text: After these days, we packed up and went on to Jerusalem.
aov_text: En ná hierdie dae het ons vir die reis klaargemaak en na Jerusalem opgegaan.

kjv_text: There went with us also certain of the disciples of Caesarea, and brought with them one Mnason of Cyprus, an old disciple, with whom we should lodge.
bsb_text: Some of the disciples from Caesarea accompanied us, and they took us to stay at the home of Mnason the Cypriot, an early disciple.
aov_text: En sommige van die dissipels van Cesaréa het ook saam met ons gegaan en ons by ’n sekere Mnason van Ciprus gebring, ’n ou dissipel, by wie ons sou tuis gaan.

kjv_text: And when we were come to Jerusalem, the brethren received us gladly.
bsb_text: When we arrived in Jerusalem, the brothers welcomed us joyfully.
aov_text: En toe ons in Jerusalem aankom, het die broeders ons met blydskap ontvang.

kjv_text: And the day following Paul went in with us unto James; and all the elders were present.
bsb_text: The next day Paul went in with us to see James, and all the elders were present.
aov_text: En op die volgende dag het Paulus saam met ons na Jakobus se huis gegaan, en al die ouderlinge was daar teenwoordig.

kjv_text: And when he had saluted them, he declared particularly what things God had wrought among the Gentiles by his ministry.
bsb_text: Paul greeted them and recounted one by one the things that God had done among the Gentiles through his ministry.
aov_text: En nadat hy hulle gegroet het, het hy van stuk tot stuk vertel wat God onder die heidene deur sy diens gedoen het.

kjv_text: And when they heard it, they glorified the Lord, and said unto him, Thou seest, brother, how many thousands of Jews there are which believe; and they are all zealous of the law:
bsb_text: When they heard this, they glorified God. Then they said to Paul, “You see, brother, how many thousands of Jews have believed, and all of them are zealous for the law.
aov_text: En toe hulle dit hoor, het hulle die Here verheerlik en vir hom gesê: U sien, broeder, hoeveel duisende Jode daar is wat gelowig geword het, en almal is yweraars vir die wet.

kjv_text: And they are informed of thee, that thou teachest all the Jews which are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, saying that they ought not to circumcise their children, neither to walk after the customs.
bsb_text: But they are under the impression that you teach all the Jews who live among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, telling them not to circumcise their children or observe our customs.
aov_text: En hulle is aangaande u vertel dat u al die Jode onder die heidene leer om van Moses afvallig te word deur te sê dat hulle die kinders nie moet besny nie en ook nie volgens die sedes moet wandel nie.

kjv_text: What is it therefore? the multitude must needs come together: for they will hear that thou art come.
bsb_text: What then should we do? They will certainly hear that you have come.
aov_text: Wat staan ons dan te doen? Dit is dringend nodig dat die menigte bymekaarkom, want hulle sal hoor dat u gekom het.

kjv_text: Do therefore this that we say to thee: We have four men which have a vow on them;
bsb_text: Therefore do what we advise you. There are four men with us who have taken a vow.
aov_text: Doen dan wat ons vir u sê. Ons het vier manne wat ’n gelofte gedoen het;

kjv_text: Them take, and purify thyself with them, and be at charges with them, that they may shave their heads: and all may know that those things, whereof they were informed concerning thee, are nothing; but that thou thyself also walkest orderly, and keepest the law.
bsb_text: Take these men, purify yourself along with them, and pay their expenses so they can have their heads shaved. Then everyone will know that there is no truth to these rumors about you, but that you also live in obedience to the law.
aov_text: neem hulle en heilig u saam met hulle en betaal die koste vir hulle, sodat hulle hul hoofde kan skeer en almal kan weet dat daar niks is in wat van u vertel word nie, maar dat u self ook wandel as een wat die wet onderhou.

kjv_text: As touching the Gentiles which believe, we have written and concluded that they observe no such thing, save only that they keep themselves from things offered to idols, and from blood, and from strangled, and from fornication.
bsb_text: As for the Gentile believers, we have written to them our decision that they must abstain from food sacrificed to idols, from blood, from the meat of strangled animals, and from sexual immorality.”
aov_text: Wat egter die gelowiges uit die heidene betref, het ons geskrywe en besluit dat hulle niks van dié aard moet onderhou nie, maar hulle net moet onthou van afgodsoffers en bloed en van wat verwurg is, en van hoerery.

kjv_text: Then Paul took the men, and the next day purifying himself with them entered into the temple, to signify the accomplishment of the days of purification, until that an offering should be offered for every one of them.
bsb_text: So the next day Paul took the men and purified himself along with them. Then he entered the temple to give notice of the date when their purification would be complete and the offering would be made for each of them.
aov_text: Toe het Paulus die manne geneem en op die volgende dag hom saam met hulle geheilig en in die tempel gegaan om bekend te maak dat die dae van die heiliging sou voortduur totdat die offer vir elkeen van hulle gebring moes word.

kjv_text: And when the seven days were almost ended, the Jews which were of Asia, when they saw him in the temple, stirred up all the people, and laid hands on him,
bsb_text: When the seven days were almost over, some Jews from the province of Asia saw Paul at the temple. They stirred up the whole crowd and seized him,
aov_text: Maar toe die sewe dae byna verby was, het die Jode van Asië hom in die tempel gesien en die hele skare oproerig gemaak en die hande aan hom geslaan

kjv_text: Crying out, Men of Israel, help: This is the man, that teacheth all men every where against the people, and the law, and this place: and further brought Greeks also into the temple, and hath polluted this holy place.
bsb_text: crying out, “Men of Israel, help us! This is the man who teaches everywhere against our people and against our law and against this place. Furthermore, he has brought Greeks into the temple and defiled this holy place.”
aov_text: en geskreeu: Israeliete, help! Dit is die man wat oral aan almal dinge leer teen die volk en die wet en hierdie plek. Hy het ook nog Grieke in die tempel gebring en hierdie heilige plek ontheilig.

kjv_text: (For they had seen before with him in the city Trophimus an Ephesian, whom they supposed that Paul had brought into the temple.)
bsb_text: For they had previously seen Trophimus the Ephesian with him in the city, and they assumed that Paul had brought him into the temple.
aov_text: Want hulle het vantevore Trófimus, die Efésiër, in die stad by hom gesien en gedink dat Paulus hom in die tempel gebring het.

kjv_text: And all the city was moved, and the people ran together: and they took Paul, and drew him out of the temple: and forthwith the doors were shut.
bsb_text: The whole city was stirred up, and the people rushed together. They seized Paul and dragged him out of the temple, and at once the gates were shut.
aov_text: Toe kom die hele stad in beweging, en daar was ’n oploop van die volk; en hulle het Paulus gegryp en hom buitekant die tempel gesleep; en dadelik is die deure gesluit.

kjv_text: And as they went about to kill him, tidings came unto the chief captain of the band, that all Jerusalem was in an uproar.
bsb_text: While they were trying to kill him, the commander of the Roman regiment received a report that all Jerusalem was in turmoil.
aov_text: En onderwyl hulle probeer om hom dood te maak, het ’n berig die owerste oor duisend van die leërafdeling bereik dat die hele Jerusalem in oproer was.

kjv_text: Who immediately took soldiers and centurions, and ran down unto them: and when they saw the chief captain and the soldiers, they left beating of Paul.
bsb_text: Immediately he took some soldiers and centurions and ran down to the crowd. When the people saw the commander and the soldiers, they stopped beating Paul.
aov_text: En hy het meteens soldate en hoofmanne oor honderd geneem en afgehardloop na hulle; en toe hulle die owerste oor duisend en die soldate sien, het hulle opgehou om Paulus te slaan.

kjv_text: Then the chief captain came near, and took him, and commanded him to be bound with two chains; and demanded who he was, and what he had done.
bsb_text: The commander came up and arrested Paul, ordering that he be bound with two chains. Then he asked who he was and what he had done.
aov_text: Daarop kom die owerste oor duisend nader en neem hom gevange en gee bevel dat hy met twee kettings geboei moet word; en hy het gevra wie hy was en wat hy gedoen het.

kjv_text: And some cried one thing, some another, among the multitude: and when he could not know the certainty for the tumult, he commanded him to be carried into the castle.
bsb_text: Some in the crowd were shouting one thing, and some another. And since the commander could not get at the truth because of the uproar, he ordered that Paul be brought into the barracks.
aov_text: En onder die skare het sommige dit en sommige iets anders geskreeu. En omdat hy weens die rumoer geen sekerheid kon verkry nie, het hy bevel gegee dat hy na die kamp gebring moes word.

kjv_text: And when he came upon the stairs, so it was, that he was borne of the soldiers for the violence of the people.
bsb_text: When Paul reached the steps, he had to be carried by the soldiers because of the violence of the mob.
aov_text: En toe hy op die trappe kom, moes hy deur die soldate gedra word weens die geweld van die skare.

kjv_text: For the multitude of the people followed after, crying, Away with him.
bsb_text: For the crowd that followed him kept shouting, “Away with him!”
aov_text: Want die menigte van die volk het gevolg en geskreeu: Weg met hom!

kjv_text: And as Paul was to be led into the castle, he said unto the chief captain, May I speak unto thee? Who said, Canst thou speak Greek?
bsb_text: As they were about to take Paul into the barracks, he asked the commander, “May I say something to you?” “Do you speak Greek?” he replied.
aov_text: En net toe hy in die kamp gebring sou word, vra Paulus die owerste oor duisend: Is dit my geoorloof om iets vir u te sê? En hy sê vir hom: Ken jy Grieks?

kjv_text: Art not thou that Egyptian, which before these days madest an uproar, and leddest out into the wilderness four thousand men that were murderers?
bsb_text: “Aren’t you the Egyptian who incited a rebellion some time ago and led four thousand members of the ‘Assassins’ into the wilderness?”
aov_text: Is jy dan nie die Egiptenaar wat ’n tyd gelede oproer gemaak het en die vierduisend rowers na die woestyn uitgelei het nie?

kjv_text: But Paul said, I am a man which am a Jew of Tarsus, a city in Cilicia, a citizen of no mean city: and, I beseech thee, suffer me to speak unto the people.
bsb_text: But Paul answered, “I am a Jew from Tarsus in Cilicia, a citizen of no ordinary city. Now I beg you to allow me to speak to the people.”
aov_text: En Paulus antwoord: Ek is ’n Joodse man van Tarsus, ’n burger van geen onvermaarde stad in Cilícië nie; ek versoek u, laat my toe om die volk toe te spreek.

kjv_text: And when he had given him licence, Paul stood on the stairs, and beckoned with the hand unto the people. And when there was made a great silence, he spake unto them in the Hebrew tongue, saying,
bsb_text: Having received permission, Paul stood on the steps and motioned to the crowd. A great hush came over the crowd, and he addressed them in Hebrew:
aov_text: En toe hy dit toegelaat het, gaan Paulus op die trappe staan en wink met die hand vir die volk. En nadat daar ’n groot stilte gekom het, het hy hulle in die Hebreeuse taal toegespreek en gesê:

kjv_text: Men, brethren, and fathers, hear ye my defence which I make now unto you.
bsb_text: “Brothers and fathers, listen now to my defense before you.”
aov_text: BROEDERS en vaders, luister nou na my verdediging teenoor julle!

kjv_text: (And when they heard that he spake in the Hebrew tongue to them, they kept the more silence: and he saith,)
bsb_text: When they heard him speak to them in Hebrew, they became even more silent. Then Paul declared,
aov_text: En toe hulle hoor dat hy hulle in die Hebreeuse taal toespreek, was hulle nog stiller. En hy sê:

kjv_text: I am verily a man which am a Jew, born in Tarsus, a city in Cilicia, yet brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, and taught according to the perfect manner of the law of the fathers, and was zealous toward God, as ye all are this day.
bsb_text: “I am a Jew, born in Tarsus of Cilicia, but raised in this city. I was educated at the feet of Gamaliel in strict conformity to the law of our fathers. I am just as zealous for God as any of you here today.
aov_text: Ek is ’n Jood, gebore in Tarsus in Cilícië, maar opgevoed in hierdie stad aan die voete van Gamáliël, streng ooreenkomstig die voorvaderlike wet, ’n yweraar vir God soos julle almal vandag is.

kjv_text: And I persecuted this way unto the death, binding and delivering into prisons both men and women.
bsb_text: I persecuted this Way even to the death, detaining both men and women and throwing them into prison,
aov_text: Hierdie Weg het ek vervolg tot die dood toe, en manne en ook vroue geboei en in gevangenisse oorgegee,

kjv_text: As also the high priest doth bear me witness, and all the estate of the elders: from whom also I received letters unto the brethren, and went to Damascus, to bring them which were there bound unto Jerusalem, for to be punished.
bsb_text: as the high priest and the whole Council can testify about me. I even obtained letters from them to their brothers in Damascus, and I was on my way to apprehend these people and bring them to Jerusalem to be punished.
aov_text: soos ook die hoëpriester en die hele raad van ouderlinge my getuies is. Van hulle het ek ook briewe ontvang en na die broeders in Damaskus gegaan om ook die wat daar was, geboeid na Jerusalem te bring, sodat hulle gestraf kon word.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, that, as I made my journey, and was come nigh unto Damascus about noon, suddenly there shone from heaven a great light round about me.
bsb_text: About noon as I was approaching Damascus, suddenly a bright light from heaven flashed around me.
aov_text: Maar terwyl ek op reis was en naby Damaskus kom, het daar op die middag skielik ’n groot lig uit die hemel my omstraal,

kjv_text: And I fell unto the ground, and heard a voice saying unto me, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?
bsb_text: I fell to the ground and heard a voice say to me, ‘Saul, Saul, why do you persecute Me?’
aov_text: en ek het op die grond geval en ’n stem vir my hoor sê: Saul, Saul, waarom vervolg jy My?

kjv_text: And I answered, Who art thou, Lord? And he said unto me, I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom thou persecutest.
bsb_text: ‘Who are You, Lord?’ I asked. ‘I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom you are persecuting,’ He replied.
aov_text: En ek het geantwoord: Wie is U, Here? En Hy het vir my gesê: Ek is Jesus, die Nasaréner, wat jy vervolg.

kjv_text: And they that were with me saw indeed the light, and were afraid; but they heard not the voice of him that spake to me.
bsb_text: My companions saw the light, but they could not understand the voice of the One speaking to me.
aov_text: En die wat saam met my was, het wel die lig gesien en bang geword, maar die stem van Hom wat met my gespreek het, nie gehoor nie.

kjv_text: And I said, What shall I do, LORD? And the Lord said unto me, Arise, and go into Damascus; and there it shall be told thee of all things which are appointed for thee to do.
bsb_text: Then I asked, ‘What should I do, Lord?’ ‘Get up and go into Damascus,’ He told me. ‘There you will be told all that you have been appointed to do.’
aov_text: En ek het gesê: Wat moet ek doen, Here? En die Here het vir my gesê: Staan op en gaan na Damaskus, en daar sal jou vertel word alles wat aan jou opgedra is om te doen.

kjv_text: And when I could not see for the glory of that light, being led by the hand of them that were with me, I came into Damascus.
bsb_text: Because the brilliance of the light had blinded me, my companions led me by the hand into Damascus.
aov_text: Toe ek dan weens die glans van daardie lig nie kon sien nie, is ek deur my metgeselle by die hand gelei en het in Damaskus gekom.

kjv_text: And one Ananias, a devout man according to the law, having a good report of all the Jews which dwelt there,
bsb_text: There a man named Ananias, a devout observer of the law who was highly regarded by all the Jews living there,
aov_text: En ’n sekere Ananías, ’n vroom man volgens die wet, wat ’n goeie naam gehad het by al die Jode wat daar woon,

kjv_text: Came unto me, and stood, and said unto me, Brother Saul, receive thy sight. And the same hour I looked up upon him.
bsb_text: came and stood beside me. ‘Brother Saul,’ he said, ‘receive your sight.’ And at that moment I could see him.
aov_text: het na my gekom en by my gaan staan en vir my gesê: Saul, broeder, word siende! En op dieselfde oomblik het ek hom aangekyk.

kjv_text: And he said, The God of our fathers hath chosen thee, that thou shouldest know his will, and see that Just One, and shouldest hear the voice of his mouth.
bsb_text: Then he said, ‘The God of our fathers has appointed you to know His will, and to see the Righteous One, and to hear His voice.
aov_text: En hy het gesê: Die God van ons vaders het jou voorbeskik om sy wil te ken en die Regverdige te sien en die stem uit sy mond te hoor;

kjv_text: For thou shalt be his witness unto all men of what thou hast seen and heard.
bsb_text: You will be His witness to everyone of what you have seen and heard.
aov_text: want jy sal vir Hom by al die mense ’n getuie wees van wat jy gesien en gehoor het.

kjv_text: And now why tarriest thou? arise, and be baptized, and wash away thy sins, calling on the name of the Lord.
bsb_text: And now what are you waiting for? Get up, be baptized, and wash your sins away, calling on His name.’
aov_text: En nou, waarom versuim jy? Staan op, laat jou doop en jou sondes afwas, terwyl jy die Naam van die Here aanroep.

kjv_text: And it came to pass, that, when I was come again to Jerusalem, even while I prayed in the temple, I was in a trance;
bsb_text: Later, when I had returned to Jerusalem and was praying at the temple, I fell into a trance
aov_text: En toe ek in Jerusalem teruggekom het en besig was om in die tempel te bid, het ek in ’n verrukking van sinne gekom

kjv_text: And saw him saying unto me, Make haste, and get thee quickly out of Jerusalem: for they will not receive thy testimony concerning me.
bsb_text: and saw the Lord saying to me, ‘Hurry! Leave Jerusalem quickly, because the people here will not accept your testimony about Me.’
aov_text: en Hom gesien, en Hy het vir my gesê: Maak gou en gaan haastig uit Jerusalem uit, want hulle sal jou getuienis aangaande My nie aanneem nie.

kjv_text: And I said, Lord, they know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue them that believed on thee:
bsb_text: ‘Lord,’ I answered, ‘they know very well that in one synagogue after another I imprisoned and beat those who believed in You.
aov_text: En ek het gesê: Here, hulle weet self dat ek besig was om die wat in U glo, in die gevangenis te werp en in die sinagoges te slaan;

kjv_text: And when the blood of thy martyr Stephen was shed, I also was standing by, and consenting unto his death, and kept the raiment of them that slew him.
bsb_text: And when the blood of Your witness Stephen was shed, I stood there giving my approval and watching over the garments of those who killed him.’
aov_text: en toe die bloed van Stéfanus, u getuie, vergiet is, het ek ook self daarby gestaan en sy vermoording goedgekeur en die klere opgepas van die wat hom doodgemaak het.

kjv_text: And he said unto me, Depart: for I will send thee far hence unto the Gentiles.
bsb_text: Then He said to me, ‘Go! I will send you far away to the Gentiles.’”
aov_text: En Hy het vir my gesê: Gaan heen, want Ek sal jou ver wegstuur na die heidene.

kjv_text: And they gave him audience unto this word, and then lifted up their voices, and said, Away with such a fellow from the earth: for it is not fit that he should live.
bsb_text: The crowd listened to Paul until he made this statement. Then they lifted up their voices and shouted, “Rid the earth of him! He is not fit to live!”
aov_text: Tot by hierdie woord het hulle na hom geluister; toe verhef hulle hul stem en sê: Weg van die aarde met so ’n mens, want hy behoort nie te lewe nie!

kjv_text: And as they cried out, and cast off their clothes, and threw dust into the air,
bsb_text: As they were shouting and throwing off their cloaks and tossing dust into the air,
aov_text: En terwyl hulle so skreeu en hulle klere afgooi en stof in die lug werp,

kjv_text: The chief captain commanded him to be brought into the castle, and bade that he should be examined by scourging; that he might know wherefore they cried so against him.
bsb_text: the commander ordered that Paul be brought into the barracks. He directed that Paul be flogged and interrogated to determine the reason for this outcry against him.
aov_text: het die owerste oor duisend bevel gegee dat hy in die kamp gebring moes word, en gesê dat hulle hom met géselslae moes ondersoek, sodat hy kon weet om watter rede hulle so teen hom uitroep.

kjv_text: And as they bound him with thongs, Paul said unto the centurion that stood by, Is it lawful for you to scourge a man that is a Roman, and uncondemned?
bsb_text: But as they stretched him out to strap him down, Paul said to the centurion standing there, “Is it lawful for you to flog a Roman citizen without a trial?”
aov_text: En onderwyl hulle hom met die rieme uitrek, sê Paulus vir die hoofman oor honderd wat daar staan: Is dit u geoorloof om ’n Romeinse burger, en dit onveroordeeld, te gésel?

kjv_text: When the centurion heard that, he went and told the chief captain, saying, Take heed what thou doest: for this man is a Roman.
bsb_text: On hearing this, the centurion went and reported it to the commander. “What are you going to do?” he said. “This man is a Roman citizen.”
aov_text: Toe die hoofman oor honderd dit hoor, gaan hy dit aan die owerste oor duisend vertel en sê: Pas op wat u gaan doen, want hierdie man is ’n Romein.

kjv_text: Then the chief captain came, and said unto him, Tell me, art thou a Roman? He said, Yea.
bsb_text: The commander went to Paul and asked, “Tell me, are you a Roman citizen?” “Yes,” he answered.
aov_text: En die owerste oor duisend het gekom en hom gevra: Sê vir my of jy ’n Romein is? En hy antwoord: Ja.

kjv_text: And the chief captain answered, With a great sum obtained I this freedom. And Paul said, But I was free born.
bsb_text: “I paid a high price for my citizenship,” said the commander. “But I was born a citizen,” Paul replied.
aov_text: Toe sê die owerste oor duisend: Ek het hierdie burgerreg vir ’n groot som verkry! En Paulus sê vir hom: Maar ek het dit deur geboorte.

kjv_text: Then straightway they departed from him which should have examined him: and the chief captain also was afraid, after he knew that he was a Roman, and because he had bound him.
bsb_text: Then those who were about to interrogate Paul stepped back, and the commander himself was alarmed when he realized that he had put a Roman citizen in chains.
aov_text: Daarop het die wat hom sou ondersoek, hom dadelik laat staan; en die owerste oor duisend het ook gevrees, omdat hy nou wis dat hy ’n Romein was en hy hom geboei het.

kjv_text: On the morrow, because he would have known the certainty wherefore he was accused of the Jews, he loosed him from his bands, and commanded the chief priests and all their council to appear, and brought Paul down, and set him before them.
bsb_text: The next day the commander, wanting to learn the real reason Paul was accused by the Jews, released him and ordered the chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin to assemble. Then he brought Paul down and had him stand before them.
aov_text: EN die volgende dag wou hy met sekerheid weet waarvan hy deur die Jode beskuldig was; en hy het hom van sy boeie losgemaak en bevel gegee dat die owerpriesters en hulle hele Raad moes vergader; en hy het Paulus afgebring en voor hulle laat staan.

kjv_text: And Paul, earnestly beholding the council, said, Men and brethren, I have lived in all good conscience before God until this day.
bsb_text: Paul looked directly at the Sanhedrin and said, “Brothers, I have conducted myself before God in all good conscience to this day.”
aov_text: EN Paulus het die oë op die Raad gehou en gesê: Broeders, ek het met ’n volkome goeie gewete voor God gewandel tot op hierdie dag.

kjv_text: And the high priest Ananias commanded them that stood by him to smite him on the mouth.
bsb_text: At this, the high priest Ananias ordered those standing near Paul to strike him on the mouth.
aov_text: Maar die hoëpriester Ananías het bevel gegee aan die wat by hom staan, om hom op die mond te slaan.

kjv_text: Then said Paul unto him, God shall smite thee, thou whited wall: for sittest thou to judge me after the law, and commandest me to be smitten contrary to the law?
bsb_text: Then Paul said to him, “God will strike you, you whitewashed wall! You sit here to judge me according to the law, yet you yourself violate the law by commanding that I be struck.”
aov_text: Toe sê Paulus vir hom: God sal u slaan, gewitte muur! U sit tog om my volgens die wet te oordeel, en beveel u in stryd met die wet dat ek geslaan moet word?

kjv_text: And they that stood by said, Revilest thou God's high priest?
bsb_text: But those standing nearby said, “How dare you insult the high priest of God!”
aov_text: En die wat daarby staan, sê: Skel jy die hoëpriester van God uit?

kjv_text: Then said Paul, I wist not, brethren, that he was the high priest: for it is written, Thou shalt not speak evil of the ruler of thy people.
bsb_text: “Brothers,” Paul replied, “I was not aware that he was the high priest, for it is written: ‘Do not speak evil about the ruler of your people.’”
aov_text: Daarop sê Paulus: Ek het nie geweet, broeders, dat hy hoëpriester is nie, want daar staan geskrywe: Van ’n owerste van jou volk mag jy nie kwaad spreek nie.

kjv_text: But when Paul perceived that the one part were Sadducees, and the other Pharisees, he cried out in the council, Men and brethren, I am a Pharisee, the son of a Pharisee: of the hope and resurrection of the dead I am called in question.
bsb_text: Then Paul, knowing that some of them were Sadducees and others Pharisees, called out in the Sanhedrin, “Brothers, I am a Pharisee, the son of a Pharisee. It is because of my hope in the resurrection of the dead that I am on trial.”
aov_text: En omdat Paulus geweet het dat die een deel uit Sadduseërs en die ander uit Fariseërs bestaan, het hy in die Raad uitgeroep: Broeders, ek is ’n Fariseër, die seun van ’n Fariseër. Oor die hoop en die opstanding van die dode staan ek voor die gereg.

kjv_text: And when he had so said, there arose a dissension between the Pharisees and the Sadducees: and the multitude was divided.
bsb_text: As soon as he had said this, a dispute broke out between the Pharisees and Sadducees, and the assembly was divided.
aov_text: En toe hy dit sê, het daar twis ontstaan tussen die Fariseërs en die Sadduseërs, en die menigte het verdeeld geraak.

kjv_text: For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection, neither angel, nor spirit: but the Pharisees confess both.
bsb_text: For the Sadducees say that there is neither a resurrection, nor angels, nor spirits, but the Pharisees acknowledge them all.
aov_text: Want die Sadduseërs sê dat daar geen opstanding is nie, ook geen engel of gees nie; maar die Fariseërs bely albei.

kjv_text: And there arose a great cry: and the scribes that were of the Pharisees' part arose, and strove, saying, We find no evil in this man: but if a spirit or an angel hath spoken to him, let us not fight against God.
bsb_text: A great clamor arose, and some scribes from the party of the Pharisees got up and contended sharply, “We find nothing wrong with this man. What if a spirit or an angel has spoken to him?”
aov_text: Toe was daar ’n groot geroep, en die skrifgeleerdes van die party van die Fariseërs het opgestaan en heftig gestry en gesê: Ons vind geen kwaad in hierdie man nie; en as ’n gees met hom gespreek het, of ’n engel, laat ons nie teen God stry nie.

kjv_text: And when there arose a great dissension, the chief captain, fearing lest Paul should have been pulled in pieces of them, commanded the soldiers to go down, and to take him by force from among them, and to bring him into the castle.
bsb_text: The dispute grew so violent that the commander was afraid they would tear Paul to pieces. He ordered the soldiers to go down and remove him by force and bring him into the barracks.
aov_text: En toe daar ’n groot twis ontstaan het en die owerste oor duisend gevrees het dat Paulus deur hulle verskeur sou word, het hy die soldate bevel gegee om te gaan en hom met geweld weg te neem onder hulle uit en in die kamp te bring.

kjv_text: And the night following the Lord stood by him, and said, Be of good cheer, Paul: for as thou hast testified of me in Jerusalem, so must thou bear witness also at Rome.
bsb_text: The following night the Lord stood near Paul and said, “Take courage! As you have testified about Me in Jerusalem, so also you must testify in Rome.”
aov_text: En die volgende nag het die Here by hom gestaan en gesê: Hou goeie moed, Paulus, want soos jy aangaande My in Jerusalem kragtig getuig het, so moet jy in Rome ook getuig.

kjv_text: And when it was day, certain of the Jews banded together, and bound themselves under a curse, saying that they would neither eat nor drink till they had killed Paul.
bsb_text: When daylight came, the Jews formed a conspiracy and bound themselves with an oath not to eat or drink until they had killed Paul.
aov_text: EN toe dit dag geword het, het sommige van die Jode saamgespan en hulleself vervloek deur te sê dat hulle nie sou eet of drink totdat hulle Paulus doodgemaak het nie.

kjv_text: And they were more than forty which had made this conspiracy.
bsb_text: More than forty of them were involved in this plot.
aov_text: En daar was meer as veertig wat hierdie sameswering gemaak het.

kjv_text: And they came to the chief priests and elders, and said, We have bound ourselves under a great curse, that we will eat nothing until we have slain Paul.
bsb_text: They went to the chief priests and elders and said, “We have bound ourselves with a solemn oath not to eat anything until we have killed Paul.
aov_text: Hulle het na die owerpriesters en die ouderlinge gegaan en gesê: Ons het ons met vervloeking verwens om niks te gebruik totdat ons Paulus doodgemaak het nie.

kjv_text: Now therefore ye with the council signify to the chief captain that he bring him down unto you to morrow, as though ye would enquire something more perfectly concerning him: and we, or ever he come near, are ready to kill him.
bsb_text: Now then, you and the Sanhedrin petition the commander to bring him down to you on the pretext of examining his case more carefully. We are ready to kill him on the way.”
aov_text: Laat dan nou, saam met die Raad, aan die owerste oor duisend weet om hom môre af te bring na u toe, asof u oor sy saak noukeuriger ondersoek wil doen. En ons is gereed om hom uit die weg te ruim voordat hy by u kom.

kjv_text: And when Paul's sister's son heard of their lying in wait, he went and entered into the castle, and told Paul.
bsb_text: But when the son of Paul’s sister heard about the plot, he went into the barracks and told Paul.
aov_text: Maar die seun van Paulus se suster het van die hinderlaag gehoor, en hy het gekom en in die kamp gegaan en dit aan Paulus vertel.

kjv_text: Then Paul called one of the centurions unto him, and said, Bring this young man unto the chief captain: for he hath a certain thing to tell him.
bsb_text: Then Paul called one of the centurions and said, “Take this young man to the commander; he has something to tell him.”
aov_text: En Paulus het een van die hoofmanne oor honderd na hom geroep en gesê: Bring hierdie jongman by die owerste oor duisend, want hy het iets om aan hom te vertel.

kjv_text: So he took him, and brought him to the chief captain, and said, Paul the prisoner called me unto him, and prayed me to bring this young man unto thee, who hath something to say unto thee.
bsb_text: So the centurion took him to the commander and said, “Paul the prisoner sent and asked me to bring this young man to you. He has something to tell you.”
aov_text: Daarop neem hy hom saam en bring hom by die owerste oor duisend en sê: Die gevangene, Paulus, het my na hom geroep en versoek om hierdie jongman na u te bring, omdat hy iets het om aan u te sê.

kjv_text: Then the chief captain took him by the hand, and went with him aside privately, and asked him, What is that thou hast to tell me?
bsb_text: The commander took the young man by the hand, drew him aside, and asked, “What do you need to tell me?”
aov_text: Daarop vat die owerste oor duisend hom by die hand en gaan eenkant toe en vra: Wat het jy om aan my te vertel?

kjv_text: And he said, The Jews have agreed to desire thee that thou wouldest bring down Paul to morrow into the council, as though they would enquire somewhat of him more perfectly.
bsb_text: He answered, “The Jews have agreed to ask you to bring Paul to the Sanhedrin tomorrow on the pretext of acquiring more information about him.
aov_text: En hy sê: Die Jode het ooreengekom om u te versoek om Paulus môre af te bring na die Raad asof hulle iets noukeurigers omtrent hom wil verneem.

kjv_text: But do not thou yield unto them: for there lie in wait for him of them more than forty men, which have bound themselves with an oath, that they will neither eat nor drink till they have killed him: and now are they ready, looking for a promise from thee.
bsb_text: Do not let them persuade you, because more than forty men are waiting to ambush him. They have bound themselves with an oath not to eat or drink until they have killed him; they are ready now, awaiting your consent.”
aov_text: Laat u dan nie deur hulle oorhaal nie, want meer as veertig man van hulle lê hom voor wat hulleself vervloek het om nie te eet of te drink totdat hulle hom omgebring het nie. En nou is hulle gereed en wag op u toestemming.

kjv_text: So the chief captain then let the young man depart, and charged him, See thou tell no man that thou hast shewed these things to me.
bsb_text: So the commander dismissed the young man and instructed him, “Do not tell anyone that you have reported this to me.”
aov_text: En die owerste oor duisend het die jongman laat gaan en hom bevel gegee: Vertel aan niemand dat jy dit aan my bekend gemaak het nie.

kjv_text: And he called unto him two centurions, saying, Make ready two hundred soldiers to go to Caesarea, and horsemen threescore and ten, and spearmen two hundred, at the third hour of the night;
bsb_text: Then he called two of his centurions and said, “Prepare two hundred soldiers, seventy horsemen, and two hundred spearmen to go to Caesarea in the third hour of the night.
aov_text: En hy het twee van die hoofmanne oor honderd na hom geroep en gesê: Hou tweehonderd soldate gereed om na Cesaréa te gaan, en sewentig ruiters en tweehonderd liggewapende manne, teen die derde uur van die nag.

kjv_text: And provide them beasts, that they may set Paul on, and bring him safe unto Felix the governor.
bsb_text: Provide mounts for Paul to take him safely to Governor Felix.”
aov_text: En sorg vir pakdiere, dat hulle Paulus daarop kan sit en veilig na Felix, die goewerneur, oorbring.

kjv_text: And he wrote a letter after this manner:
bsb_text: And he wrote the following letter:
aov_text: En hy het ’n brief geskrywe met ongeveer hierdie inhoud:

kjv_text: Claudius Lysias unto the most excellent governor Felix sendeth greeting.
bsb_text: Claudius Lysias, To His Excellency, Governor Felix: Greetings.
aov_text: Claudius Lísias aan die hoogedele goewerneur Felix: Groete!

kjv_text: This man was taken of the Jews, and should have been killed of them: then came I with an army, and rescued him, having understood that he was a Roman.
bsb_text: This man was seized by the Jews, and they were about to kill him when I came with my troops to rescue him. For I had learned that he is a Roman citizen,
aov_text: Toe hierdie man wat deur die Jode gevang is, op die punt gestaan het om deur hulle omgebring te word, het ek met die soldate bygekom en hom gered, omdat ek verneem het dat hy ’n Romein is.

kjv_text: And when I would have known the cause wherefore they accused him, I brought him forth into their council:
bsb_text: and since I wanted to understand their charges against him, I brought him down to their Sanhedrin.
aov_text: Maar omdat ek te wete wou kom wat die oorsaak was waarom hulle hom beskuldig, het ek hom na hulle Raad afgebring

kjv_text: Whom I perceived to be accused of questions of their law, but to have nothing laid to his charge worthy of death or of bonds.
bsb_text: I found that the accusation involved questions about their own law, but there was no charge worthy of death or imprisonment.
aov_text: en uitgevind dat hy beskuldig word oor twisvrae van hulle wet, maar dat hy nie aangeklaag word van iets wat die dood of boeie verdien nie.

kjv_text: And when it was told me how that the Jews laid wait for the man, I sent straightway to thee, and gave commandment to his accusers also to say before thee what they had against him. Farewell.
bsb_text: When I was informed that there was a plot against the man, I sent him to you at once. I also instructed his accusers to present their case against him before you.
aov_text: En omdat aan my meegedeel is dat daar deur die Jode ’n komplot teen die man sou gesmee word, het ek hom meteens na u gestuur en ook sy beskuldigers gelas om wat hulle teen hom het, voor u te sê. Vaarwel!

kjv_text: Then the soldiers, as it was commanded them, took Paul, and brought him by night to Antipatris.
bsb_text: So the soldiers followed their orders and brought Paul by night to Antipatris.
aov_text: En die soldate het Paulus geneem soos hulle beveel is, en hom in die nag na Antípatris gebring.

kjv_text: On the morrow they left the horsemen to go with him, and returned to the castle:
bsb_text: The next day they returned to the barracks and let the horsemen go on with him.
aov_text: En die volgende dag het hulle die ruiters met hom verder laat gaan en self na die kamp teruggekeer.

kjv_text: Who, when they came to Caesarea, and delivered the epistle to the governor, presented Paul also before him.
bsb_text: When the horsemen arrived in Caesarea, they delivered the letter to the governor and presented Paul to him.
aov_text: En dié het in Cesaréa gekom en die brief aan die goewerneur afgegee en ook Paulus voor hom gestel.

kjv_text: And when the governor had read the letter, he asked of what province he was. And when he understood that he was of Cilicia;
bsb_text: The governor read the letter and asked what province Paul was from. Learning that he was from Cilicia,
aov_text: En die goewerneur het die brief gelees en gevra uit watter provinsie hy was; en toe hy verneem dat hy uit Cilícië was,

kjv_text: I will hear thee, said he, when thine accusers are also come. And he commanded him to be kept in Herod's judgment hall.
bsb_text: he said, “I will hear your case when your accusers arrive.” Then he ordered that Paul be kept under guard in Herod’s Praetorium.
aov_text: sê hy: Ek sal jou in verhoor neem wanneer jou beskuldigers ook aangekom het. Toe gee hy bevel dat hy in die paleis van Herodes bewaak moes word.

kjv_text: And after five days Ananias the high priest descended with the elders, and with a certain orator named Tertullus, who informed the governor against Paul.
bsb_text: Five days later the high priest Ananias came down with some elders and a lawyer named Tertullus, who presented to the governor their case against Paul.
aov_text: EN vyf dae daarna het die hoëpriester Ananías met die ouderlinge en ’n sekere advokaat Tertúllus afgekom en Paulus by die goewerneur aangeklaag.

kjv_text: And when he was called forth, Tertullus began to accuse him, saying, Seeing that by thee we enjoy great quietness, and that very worthy deeds are done unto this nation by thy providence,
bsb_text: When Paul had been called in, Tertullus opened the prosecution: “Because of you, we have enjoyed a lasting peace, and your foresight has brought improvements to this nation.
aov_text: En toe hy opgeroep is, begin Tertúllus hom beskuldig en sê:

kjv_text: We accept it always, and in all places, most noble Felix, with all thankfulness.
bsb_text: In every way and everywhere, most excellent Felix, we acknowledge this with all gratitude.
aov_text: Dat ’n groot vrede deur u, hoogedele Felix, ons te beurt val, en dat daar hervorminge deur u voorsorg in elke opsig en oral vir hierdie nasie tot stand kom, neem ons met alle dankbaarheid aan.

kjv_text: Notwithstanding, that I be not further tedious unto thee, I pray thee that thou wouldest hear us of thy clemency a few words.
bsb_text: But in order not to burden you any further, I beg your indulgence to hear us briefly.
aov_text: Maar om u nie te lank op te hou nie, versoek ek u om ons in u vriendelikheid kortliks aan te hoor.

kjv_text: For we have found this man a pestilent fellow, and a mover of sedition among all the Jews throughout the world, and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes:
bsb_text: We have found this man to be a pestilence, stirring up dissension among the Jews all over the world. He is a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes,
aov_text: Want ons het gevind dat hierdie man ’n pes is en ’n verwekker van oproer onder al die Jode in die wêreld en ’n voorman van die sekte van die Nasaréners,

kjv_text: Who also hath gone about to profane the temple: whom we took, and would have judged according to our law.
bsb_text: and he even tried to desecrate the temple; so we seized him.
aov_text: wat selfs probeer het om die tempel te ontheilig. Ons het hom gevange geneem en wou hom volgens ons wet oordeel;

kjv_text: But the chief captain Lysias came upon us, and with great violence took him away out of our hands,
aov_text: maar Lísias, die owerste oor duisend, het gekom en hom met groot geweld uit ons hande weggeneem

kjv_text: Commanding his accusers to come unto thee: by examining of whom thyself mayest take knowledge of all these things, whereof we accuse him.
bsb_text: By examining him yourself, you will be able to learn the truth about all our charges against him.”
aov_text: en bevel gegee dat sy beskuldigers voor u moet kom. Van hom sal u self, ná ondersoek, kennis kan verkry van al hierdie dinge waarvan ons hom beskuldig.

kjv_text: And the Jews also assented, saying that these things were so.
bsb_text: The Jews concurred, asserting that these charges were true.
aov_text: En die Jode het ook saamgestem en gesê dat dit so was.

kjv_text: Then Paul, after that the governor had beckoned unto him to speak, answered, Forasmuch as I know that thou hast been of many years a judge unto this nation, I do the more cheerfully answer for myself:
bsb_text: When the governor motioned for Paul to speak, he began his response: “Knowing that you have been a judge over this nation for many years, I gladly make my defense.
aov_text: En nadat die goewerneur vir hom gewink het om te praat, het Paulus geantwoord: Omdat ek weet dat u oor hierdie volk al baie jare lank regter is, verdedig ek my saak met goeie moed,

kjv_text: Because that thou mayest understand, that there are yet but twelve days since I went up to Jerusalem for to worship.
bsb_text: You can verify for yourself that no more than twelve days ago I went up to Jerusalem to worship.
aov_text: aangesien u te wete kan kom dat dit nie meer as twaalf dae is vandat ek opgegaan het om in Jerusalem te aanbid nie.

kjv_text: And they neither found me in the temple disputing with any man, neither raising up the people, neither in the synagogues, nor in the city:
bsb_text: Yet my accusers did not find me debating with anyone in the temple or riling up a crowd in the synagogues or in the city.
aov_text: En hulle het my nie in die tempel gevind, besig om met iemand te praat of ’n opstand van die volk te verwek nie, en ook nie in die sinagoges of in die stad nie.

kjv_text: Neither can they prove the things whereof they now accuse me.
bsb_text: Nor can they prove to you any of their charges against me.
aov_text: En hulle kan ook die dinge waarvan hulle my nou beskuldig, nie bewys nie.

kjv_text: But this I confess unto thee, that after the way which they call heresy, so worship I the God of my fathers, believing all things which are written in the law and in the prophets:
bsb_text: I do confess to you, however, that I worship the God of our fathers according to the Way, which they call a sect. I believe everything that is laid down by the Law and written in the Prophets,
aov_text: Maar dit erken ek voor u dat ek volgens die Weg wat hulle sekte noem, so die God van my vaders dien, terwyl ek alles glo wat in die wet en in die profete geskrywe is,

kjv_text: And have hope toward God, which they themselves also allow, that there shall be a resurrection of the dead, both of the just and unjust.
bsb_text: and I have the same hope in God that they themselves cherish, that there will be a resurrection of both the righteous and the wicked.
aov_text: en ’n hoop op God het, ’n hoop wat hulle self ook verwag, dat daar ’n opstanding sal wees van die dode, regverdiges sowel as onregverdiges.

kjv_text: And herein do I exercise myself, to have always a conscience void of offence toward God, and toward men.
bsb_text: In this hope, I strive always to maintain a clear conscience before God and man.
aov_text: Daarom oefen ek my ook om altyd voor God en die mense ’n rein gewete te hê.

kjv_text: Now after many years I came to bring alms to my nation, and offerings.
bsb_text: After several years, then, I returned to Jerusalem to bring alms to my people and to present offerings.
aov_text: Maar ná baie jare het ek gekom om aan my volk aalmoese te bring en offers.

kjv_text: Whereupon certain Jews from Asia found me purified in the temple, neither with multitude, nor with tumult.
bsb_text: At the time they found me in the temple, I was ceremonially clean and was not inciting a crowd or an uproar. But there are some Jews from the province of Asia
aov_text: En terwyl ek hiermee besig was, het sekere Jode uit Asië my in die tempel gevind nadat ek geheilig was, nie met ’n skare of met ’n opskudding nie.

kjv_text: Who ought to have been here before thee, and object, if they had ought against me.
bsb_text: who ought to appear before you and bring charges, if they have anything against me.
aov_text: Hulle behoort hier voor u te wees om beskuldiging in te bring as hulle iets teen my het.

kjv_text: Or else let these same here say, if they have found any evil doing in me, while I stood before the council,
bsb_text: Otherwise, let these men state for themselves any crime they found in me when I stood before the Sanhedrin,
aov_text: Of laat hierdie manne self sê of hulle enige onreg in my gevind het toe ek voor die Raad gestaan het,

kjv_text: Except it be for this one voice, that I cried standing among them, Touching the resurrection of the dead I am called in question by you this day.
bsb_text: unless it was this one thing I called out as I stood in their presence: ‘It is concerning the resurrection of the dead that I am on trial before you today.’”
aov_text: behalwe oor hierdie een woord wat ek uitgeroep het terwyl ek onder hulle gestaan het, naamlik: Oor die opstanding van die dode staan ek vandag by u voor die gereg!

kjv_text: And when Felix heard these things, having more perfect knowledge of that way, he deferred them, and said, When Lysias the chief captain shall come down, I will know the uttermost of your matter.
bsb_text: Then Felix, who was well informed about the Way, adjourned the hearing and said, “When Lysias the commander comes, I will decide your case.”
aov_text: Toe Felix dit hoor, het hy hulle saak uitgestel, alhoewel hy noukeurig genoeg met die dinge van die Weg bekend was; en hy het gesê: Wanneer Lísias, die owerste oor duisend, afkom, sal ek julle saak ten volle ondersoek.

kjv_text: And he commanded a centurion to keep Paul, and to let him have liberty, and that he should forbid none of his acquaintance to minister or come unto him.
bsb_text: He ordered the centurion to keep Paul under guard, but to allow him some freedom and permit his friends to minister to his needs.
aov_text: En hy het die hoofman oor honderd beveel om Paulus te bewaak, maar dat hy verligting moes hê, en dat hy niemand van sy eie mense moes verhinder om hom te bedien of te besoek nie.

kjv_text: And after certain days, when Felix came with his wife Drusilla, which was a Jewess, he sent for Paul, and heard him concerning the faith in Christ.
bsb_text: After several days, Felix returned with his wife Drusilla, who was a Jewess. He sent for Paul and listened to him speak about faith in Christ Jesus.
aov_text: En ’n paar dae daarna het Felix gekom saam met Drusílla, sy vrou, wat ’n Jodin was, en het Paulus laat haal en hom aangehoor oor die geloof in Christus.

kjv_text: And as he reasoned of righteousness, temperance, and judgment to come, Felix trembled, and answered, Go thy way for this time; when I have a convenient season, I will call for thee.
bsb_text: As Paul expounded on righteousness, self-control, and the coming judgment, Felix became frightened and said, “You may go for now. When I find the time, I will call for you.”
aov_text: Maar toe hy spreek oor geregtigheid en selfbeheersing en die toekomstige oordeel, het Felix baie bang geword en geantwoord: Gaan vir hierdie keer heen, en as ek ’n geleentheid vind, sal ek jou laat roep.

kjv_text: He hoped also that money should have been given him of Paul, that he might loose him: wherefore he sent for him the oftener, and communed with him.
bsb_text: At the same time, he was hoping that Paul would offer him a bribe. So he sent for Paul frequently and talked with him.
aov_text: En tegelykertyd het hy ook gehoop dat geld aan hom deur Paulus sou gegee word om hom los te laat. Daarom het hy hom ook dikwels laat haal en met hom gesprekke gehad.

kjv_text: But after two years Porcius Festus came into Felix' room: and Felix, willing to shew the Jews a pleasure, left Paul bound.
bsb_text: After two years had passed, Felix was succeeded by Porcius Festus. And wishing to do the Jews a favor, Felix left Paul in prison.
aov_text: Maar twee jaar het verbygegaan, en toe kry Felix vir Porcius Festus as opvolger; en omdat Felix aan die Jode ’n guns wou bewys, het hy Paulus as gevangene agtergelaat.

kjv_text: Now when Festus was come into the province, after three days he ascended from Caesarea to Jerusalem.
bsb_text: Three days after his arrival in the province, Festus went up from Caesarea to Jerusalem,
aov_text: FESTUS het dan in die provinsie gekom en ná drie dae van Cesaréa opgegaan na Jerusalem.

kjv_text: Then the high priest and the chief of the Jews informed him against Paul, and besought him,
bsb_text: where the chief priests and Jewish leaders presented their case against Paul. They urged Festus
aov_text: En die hoëpriester en die vernaamstes van die Jode het Paulus by hom aangeklaag

kjv_text: And desired favour against him, that he would send for him to Jerusalem, laying wait in the way to kill him.
bsb_text: to grant them a concession against Paul by summoning him to Jerusalem, because they were preparing an ambush to kill him along the way.
aov_text: en by hom aangedring en gevra, as ’n guns teen Paulus, dat hy hom na Jerusalem moes laat haal; terwyl hulle intussen ’n hinderlaag voorberei het om hom op die weg om te bring.

kjv_text: But Festus answered, that Paul should be kept at Caesarea, and that he himself would depart shortly thither.
bsb_text: But Festus replied, “Paul is being held in Caesarea, and I myself am going there soon.
aov_text: Maar Festus het geantwoord dat Paulus in Cesaréa bewaak word en dat hy self spoedig daarheen sou reis.

kjv_text: Let them therefore, said he, which among you are able, go down with me, and accuse this man, if there be any wickedness in him.
bsb_text: So if this man has done anything wrong, let some of your leaders come down with me and accuse him there.”
aov_text: Laat dan dié onder julle, sê hy, wat bevoeg is, saamgaan, en as daar iets verkeerds in hierdie man is, hom beskuldig.

kjv_text: And when he had tarried among them more than ten days, he went down unto Caesarea; and the next day sitting on the judgment seat commanded Paul to be brought.
bsb_text: After spending no more than eight or ten days with them, Festus went down to Caesarea. The next day he sat on the judgment seat and ordered that Paul be brought in.
aov_text: En nadat hy nie meer as tien dae onder hulle deurgebring het nie, het hy na Cesaréa afgegaan en die volgende dag op die regterstoel gaan sit en bevel gegee dat Paulus voorgebring moes word.

kjv_text: And when he was come, the Jews which came down from Jerusalem stood round about, and laid many and grievous complaints against Paul, which they could not prove.
bsb_text: When Paul arrived, the Jews who had come down from Jerusalem stood around him, bringing many serious charges that they could not prove.
aov_text: En toe hy verskyn, het die Jode wat van Jerusalem afgekom het, rondom hom gestaan en baie en swaar beskuldiginge teen Paulus ingebring wat hulle nie kon bewys nie,

kjv_text: While he answered for himself, Neither against the law of the Jews, neither against the temple, nor yet against Caesar, have I offended any thing at all.
bsb_text: Then Paul made his defense: “I have committed no offense against the law of the Jews or against the temple or against Caesar.”
aov_text: terwyl hy tot sy verdediging gesê het: Ek het niks teen die wet van die Jode of teen die tempel of teen die keiser gesondig nie.

kjv_text: But Festus, willing to do the Jews a pleasure, answered Paul, and said, Wilt thou go up to Jerusalem, and there be judged of these things before me?
bsb_text: But Festus, wishing to do the Jews a favor, said to Paul, “Are you willing to go up to Jerusalem to stand trial before me on these charges?”
aov_text: Maar omdat Festus aan die Jode ’n guns wou bewys, het hy geantwoord en vir Paulus gesê: Wil jy na Jerusalem opgaan en daar voor my oor hierdie dinge teregstaan?

kjv_text: Then said Paul, I stand at Caesar's judgment seat, where I ought to be judged: to the Jews have I done no wrong, as thou very well knowest.
bsb_text: Paul replied, “I am standing before the judgment seat of Caesar, where I ought to be tried. I have done nothing wrong to the Jews, as you yourself know very well.
aov_text: Toe sê Paulus: Ek staan voor die regterstoel van die keiser waar ek geoordeel moet word. Aan die Jode het ek geen onreg gedoen nie, soos u ook baie goed weet.

kjv_text: For if I be an offender, or have committed any thing worthy of death, I refuse not to die: but if there be none of these things whereof these accuse me, no man may deliver me unto them. I appeal unto Caesar.
bsb_text: If, however, I am guilty of anything worthy of death, I do not refuse to die. But if there is no truth to their accusations against me, no one has the right to hand me over to them. I appeal to Caesar!”
aov_text: Want as ek oortree het of iets gedoen het wat die dood verdien, weier ek nie om te sterwe nie. Maar as daar niks is in die dinge waarvan hulle my beskuldig nie, dan kan niemand my aan hulle by wyse van guns oorlewer nie. Ek beroep my op die keiser!

kjv_text: Then Festus, when he had conferred with the council, answered, Hast thou appealed unto Caesar? unto Caesar shalt thou go.
bsb_text: Then Festus conferred with his council and replied, “You have appealed to Caesar. To Caesar you will go!”
aov_text: Toe antwoord Festus, nadat hy met die Raad gespreek het: Op die keiser het jy jou beroep — na die keiser sal jy gaan!

kjv_text: And after certain days king Agrippa and Bernice came unto Caesarea to salute Festus.
bsb_text: After several days had passed, King Agrippa and Bernice came down to Caesarea to pay their respects to Festus.
aov_text: EN ná verloop van enkele dae het koning Agríppa en Berníce in Cesaréa aangekom om Festus te begroet.

kjv_text: And when they had been there many days, Festus declared Paul's cause unto the king, saying, There is a certain man left in bonds by Felix:
bsb_text: Since they were staying several days, Festus laid out Paul’s case before the king: “There is a certain man whom Felix left in prison.
aov_text: En toe hulle daar verskeie dae deurgebring het, het Festus die saak van Paulus aan die koning voorgelê en gesê: Hier is ’n man deur Felix as gevangene agtergelaat,

kjv_text: About whom, when I was at Jerusalem, the chief priests and the elders of the Jews informed me, desiring to have judgment against him.
bsb_text: While I was in Jerusalem, the chief priests and elders of the Jews presented their case and requested a judgment against him.
aov_text: teen wie die owerpriesters en die ouderlinge van die Jode, toe ek in Jerusalem was, ’n klag ingedien en vonnis teen hom gevra het.
