bsb_text: Those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh; but those who live according to the Spirit set their minds on the things of the Spirit.
aov_text: Want die wat vleeslik is, bedink vleeslike dinge, maar die wat geestelik is, geestelike dinge.

kjv_text: For to be carnally minded is death; but to be spiritually minded is life and peace.
bsb_text: The mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace,
aov_text: Want wat die vlees bedink, is die dood, maar wat die Gees bedink, is lewe en vrede,

kjv_text: Because the carnal mind is enmity against God: for it is not subject to the law of God, neither indeed can be.
bsb_text: because the mind of the flesh is hostile to God: It does not submit to God’s law, nor can it do so.
aov_text: omdat wat die vlees bedink, vyandskap teen God is; want dit onderwerp hom nie aan die wet van God nie, want dit kan ook nie.

kjv_text: So then they that are in the flesh cannot please God.
bsb_text: Those controlled by the flesh cannot please God.
aov_text: En die wat in die vlees is, kan God nie behaag nie;

kjv_text: But ye are not in the flesh, but in the Spirit, if so be that the Spirit of God dwell in you. Now if any man have not the Spirit of Christ, he is none of his.
bsb_text: You, however, are controlled not by the flesh, but by the Spirit, if the Spirit of God lives in you. And if anyone does not have the Spirit of Christ, he does not belong to Christ.
aov_text: julle is egter nie in die vlees nie, maar in die Gees, as naamlik die Gees van God in julle woon. Maar as iemand die Gees van Christus nie het nie, dié behoort nie aan Hom nie.

kjv_text: And if Christ be in you, the body is dead because of sin; but the Spirit is life because of righteousness.
bsb_text: But if Christ is in you, your body is dead because of sin, yet your spirit is alive because of righteousness.
aov_text: Maar as Christus in julle is, dan is die liggaam dood vanweë die sonde, maar die gees is lewe vanweë die geregtigheid.

kjv_text: But if the Spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwell in you, he that raised up Christ from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit that dwelleth in you.
bsb_text: And if the Spirit of Him who raised Jesus from the dead is living in you, He who raised Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through His Spirit, who lives in you.
aov_text: En as die Gees van Hom wat Jesus uit die dode opgewek het, in julle woon, dan sal Hy wat Christus uit die dode opgewek het, ook julle sterflike liggame lewend maak deur sy Gees wat in julle woon.

kjv_text: Therefore, brethren, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.
bsb_text: Therefore, brothers, we have an obligation, but it is not to the flesh, to live according to it.
aov_text: Daarom dan, broeders, is ons skuldenaars, nie aan die vlees om na die vlees te lewe nie;

kjv_text: For if ye live after the flesh, ye shall die: but if ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body, ye shall live.
bsb_text: For if you live according to the flesh, you will die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.
aov_text: want as julle na die vlees lewe, sal julle sterwe, maar as julle deur die Gees die werke van die liggaam doodmaak, sal julle lewe.

kjv_text: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, they are the sons of God.
bsb_text: For all who are led by the Spirit of God are sons of God.
aov_text: Want almal wat deur die Gees van God gelei word, dié is kinders van God.

kjv_text: For ye have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear; but ye have received the Spirit of adoption, whereby we cry, Abba, Father.
bsb_text: For you did not receive a spirit of slavery that returns you to fear, but you received the Spirit of sonship, by whom we cry, “Abba! Father!”
aov_text: Want julle het nie ontvang ’n gees van slawerny om weer te vrees nie, maar julle het ontvang die Gees van aanneming tot kinders, deur wie ons roep: Abba, Vader!

kjv_text: The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit, that we are the children of God:
bsb_text: The Spirit Himself testifies with our spirit that we are God’s children.
aov_text: Die Gees self getuig saam met ons gees dat ons kinders van God is;

kjv_text: And if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ; if so be that we suffer with him, that we may be also glorified together.
bsb_text: And if we are children, then we are heirs: heirs of God and co-heirs with Christ—if indeed we suffer with Him, so that we may also be glorified with Him.
aov_text: en as ons kinders is, dan ook erfgename, erfgename van God en mede-erfgename van Christus, as ons naamlik saam met Hom ly, sodat ons ook saam met Hom verheerlik kan word.

kjv_text: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.
bsb_text: I consider that our present sufferings are not comparable to the glory that will be revealed in us.
aov_text: WANT ek reken dat die lyding van die teenwoordige tyd nie opweeg teen die heerlikheid wat aan ons geopenbaar sal word nie.

kjv_text: For the earnest expectation of the creature waiteth for the manifestation of the sons of God.
bsb_text: The creation waits in eager expectation for the revelation of the sons of God.
aov_text: Want die skepping wag met reikhalsende verlange op die openbaarmaking van die kinders van God.

kjv_text: For the creature was made subject to vanity, not willingly, but by reason of him who hath subjected the same in hope,
bsb_text: For the creation was subjected to futility, not by its own will, but because of the One who subjected it, in hope
aov_text: Want die skepping is aan die nietigheid onderworpe — nie gewillig nie, maar ter wille van Hom wat dit onderwerp het  —

kjv_text: Because the creature itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of God.
bsb_text: that the creation itself will be set free from its bondage to decay and brought into the glorious freedom of the children of God.
aov_text: in die hoop dat ook die skepping self vrygemaak sal word van die slawerny van die verganklikheid tot die vryheid van die heerlikheid van die kinders van God.

kjv_text: For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now.
bsb_text: We know that the whole creation has been groaning together in the pains of childbirth until the present time.
aov_text: Want ons weet dat die hele skepping tesame sug en tesame in barensnood is tot nou toe.

kjv_text: And not only they, but ourselves also, which have the firstfruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for the adoption, to wit, the redemption of our body.
bsb_text: Not only that, but we ourselves, who have the firstfruits of the Spirit, groan inwardly as we wait eagerly for our adoption as sons, the redemption of our bodies.
aov_text: En nie alleen dit nie, maar ons self ook wat die eerstelinge van die Gees het, ons sug ook in onsself in afwagting van die aanneming tot kinders, naamlik die verlossing van ons liggaam.

kjv_text: For we are saved by hope: but hope that is seen is not hope: for what a man seeth, why doth he yet hope for?
bsb_text: For in this hope we were saved; but hope that is seen is no hope at all. Who hopes for what he can already see?
aov_text: Want ons is gered in hoop; maar die hoop wat gesien word, is geen hoop nie; want wat iemand sien, waarom hoop hy dit nog?

kjv_text: But if we hope for that we see not, then do we with patience wait for it.
bsb_text: But if we hope for what we do not yet see, we wait for it patiently.
aov_text: Maar as ons hoop wat ons nie sien nie, dan wag ons daarop met volharding.

kjv_text: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.
bsb_text: In the same way, the Spirit helps us in our weakness. For we do not know how we ought to pray, but the Spirit Himself intercedes for us with groans too deep for words.
aov_text: En net so kom ook die Gees ons swakhede te hulp, want ons weet nie reg wat ons moet bid nie, maar die Gees self tree vir ons in met onuitspreeklike sugtinge.

kjv_text: And he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit, because he maketh intercession for the saints according to the will of God.
bsb_text: And He who searches our hearts knows the mind of the Spirit, because the Spirit intercedes for the saints according to the will of God.
aov_text: En Hy wat die harte deursoek, weet wat die bedoeling van die Gees is, omdat Hy ooreenkomstig die wil van God vir die heiliges intree.

kjv_text: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.
bsb_text: And we know that God works all things together for the good of those who love Him, who are called according to His purpose.
aov_text: En ons weet dat vir hulle wat God liefhet, alles ten goede meewerk, vir hulle wat na sy voorneme geroep is.

kjv_text: For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brethren.
bsb_text: For those God foreknew, He also predestined to be conformed to the image of His Son, so that He would be the firstborn among many brothers.
aov_text: Want die wat Hy vantevore geken het, dié het Hy ook vantevore verordineer om gelykvormig te wees aan die beeld van sy Seun, sodat Hy die eersgeborene kan wees onder baie broeders;

kjv_text: Moreover whom he did predestinate, them he also called: and whom he called, them he also justified: and whom he justified, them he also glorified.
bsb_text: And those He predestined, He also called; those He called, He also justified; those He justified, He also glorified.
aov_text: en die wat Hy vantevore verordineer het, dié het Hy ook geroep; en die wat Hy geroep het, dié het Hy ook geregverdig; en die wat Hy geregverdig het, dié het Hy ook verheerlik.

kjv_text: What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us?
bsb_text: What then shall we say in response to these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
aov_text: WAT sal ons dan van hierdie dinge sê? As God vír ons is, wie kan teen ons wees?

kjv_text: He that spared not his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how shall he not with him also freely give us all things?
bsb_text: He who did not spare His own Son but gave Him up for us all, how will He not also, along with Him, freely give us all things?
aov_text: Hy wat selfs sy eie Seun nie gespaar het nie, maar Hom vir ons almal oorgegee het, hoe sal Hy nie saam met Hom ons ook alles genadiglik skenk nie?

kjv_text: Who shall lay any thing to the charge of God's elect? It is God that justifieth.
bsb_text: Who will bring any charge against God’s elect? It is God who justifies.
aov_text: Wie sal beskuldiging inbring teen die uitverkorenes van God? God is dit wat regverdig maak.

kjv_text: Who is he that condemneth? It is Christ that died, yea rather, that is risen again, who is even at the right hand of God, who also maketh intercession for us.
bsb_text: Who is there to condemn us? For Christ Jesus, who died, and more than that was raised to life, is at the right hand of God—and He is interceding for us.
aov_text: Wie is dit wat veroordeel? Christus is dit wat gesterf het, ja, meer nog, wat ook opgewek is, wat ook aan die regterhand van God is, wat ook vir ons intree.

kjv_text: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?
bsb_text: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Shall trouble or distress or persecution or famine or nakedness or danger or sword?
aov_text: Wie sal ons skei van die liefde van Christus — verdrukking of benoudheid of vervolging of honger of naaktheid of gevaar of swaard?

kjv_text: As it is written, For thy sake we are killed all the day long; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.
bsb_text: As it is written: “For Your sake we face death all day long; we are considered as sheep to be slaughtered.”
aov_text: Soos geskrywe is: Om U ontwil word ons die hele dag gedood, ons is gereken as slagskape.

kjv_text: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.
bsb_text: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through Him who loved us.
aov_text: Maar in al hierdie dinge is ons meer as oorwinnaars deur Hom wat ons liefgehad het.

kjv_text: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come,
bsb_text: For I am convinced that neither death nor life, neither angels nor principalities, neither the present nor the future, nor any powers,
aov_text: Want ek is versekerd dat geen dood of lewe of engele of owerhede of magte of teenwoordige of toekomende dinge

kjv_text: Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
bsb_text: neither height nor depth, nor anything else in all creation, will be able to separate us from the love of God that is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
aov_text: of hoogte of diepte of enige ander skepsel ons sal kan skei van die liefde van God wat daar in Christus Jesus, onse Here, is nie.

kjv_text: I say the truth in Christ, I lie not, my conscience also bearing me witness in the Holy Ghost,
bsb_text: I speak the truth in Christ; I am not lying, as confirmed by my conscience in the Holy Spirit.
aov_text: EK spreek die waarheid in Christus, ek lieg nie — my gewete getuig saam met my in die Heilige Gees  —

kjv_text: That I have great heaviness and continual sorrow in my heart.
bsb_text: I have deep sorrow and unceasing anguish in my heart.
aov_text: dat dit vir my ’n groot droefheid is en ’n onophoudelike smart vir my hart.

kjv_text: For I could wish that myself were accursed from Christ for my brethren, my kinsmen according to the flesh:
bsb_text: For I could wish that I myself were cursed and cut off from Christ for the sake of my brothers, my own flesh and blood,
aov_text: Want ek sou self kon wens om ter wille van my broers, my stamgenote na die vlees, ’n vervloeking te wees, wég van Christus af.

kjv_text: Who are Israelites; to whom pertaineth the adoption, and the glory, and the covenants, and the giving of the law, and the service of God, and the promises;
bsb_text: the people of Israel. Theirs is the adoption as sons; theirs the divine glory and the covenants; theirs the giving of the law, the temple worship, and the promises.
aov_text: Hulle is Israeliete aan wie die aanneming tot kinders behoort en die heerlikheid en die verbonde en die wetgewing en die erediens en die beloftes;

kjv_text: Whose are the fathers, and of whom as concerning the flesh Christ came, who is over all, God blessed for ever. Amen.
bsb_text: Theirs are the patriarchs, and from them proceeds the human descent of Christ, who is God over all, forever worthy of praise! Amen.
aov_text: aan wie die vaders behoort en uit wie die Christus is na die vlees — Hy wat oor alles is, God, lofwaardig tot in ewigheid! Amen.

kjv_text: Not as though the word of God hath taken none effect. For they are not all Israel, which are of Israel:
bsb_text: It is not as though God’s word has failed. For not all who are descended from Israel are Israel.
aov_text: MAAR ek sê dit nie asof die woord van God verval het nie; want hulle is nie almal Israel wat uit Israel is nie.

kjv_text: Neither, because they are the seed of Abraham, are they all children: but, In Isaac shall thy seed be called.
bsb_text: Nor because they are Abraham’s descendants are they all his children. On the contrary, “Through Isaac your offspring will be reckoned.”
aov_text: Ook nie omdat hulle Abraham se nageslag is, is hulle almal kinders nie; maar: in Isak sal jou nageslag genoem word.

kjv_text: That is, They which are the children of the flesh, these are not the children of God: but the children of the promise are counted for the seed.
bsb_text: So it is not the children of the flesh who are God’s children, but it is the children of the promise who are regarded as offspring.
aov_text: Dit wil sê, nie hulle is kinders van God wat die kinders van die vlees is nie, maar die kinders van die belofte word gereken as die nageslag.

kjv_text: For this is the word of promise, At this time will I come, and Sarah shall have a son.
bsb_text: For this is what the promise stated: “At the appointed time I will return, and Sarah will have a son.”
aov_text: Want dit is die woord van die belofte: Omtrent hierdie tyd sal Ek kom, en Sara sal ’n seun hê.

kjv_text: And not only this; but when Rebecca also had conceived by one, even by our father Isaac;
bsb_text: Not only that, but Rebecca’s children were conceived by one man, our father Isaac.
aov_text: En nie alleen dit nie, maar ook Rebekka was swanger uit een, naamlik Isak, ons vader.

kjv_text: (For the children being not yet born, neither having done any good or evil, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him that calleth;)
bsb_text: Yet before the twins were born or had done anything good or bad, in order that God’s plan of election might stand,
aov_text: Want toe die kinders nog nie gebore was en nog geen goed of kwaad gedoen het nie — dat die voorneme van God volgens die verkiesing kon bly staan, nie uit die werke nie, maar uit Hom wat roep  —

kjv_text: It was said unto her, The elder shall serve the younger.
bsb_text: not by works but by Him who calls, she was told, “The older will serve the younger.”
aov_text: is vir haar gesê: Die oudste sal die jongste dien.

kjv_text: As it is written, Jacob have I loved, but Esau have I hated.
bsb_text: So it is written: “Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated.”
aov_text: Soos geskrywe is: Jakob het Ek liefgehad en Esau het Ek gehaat.

kjv_text: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? God forbid.
bsb_text: What then shall we say? Is God unjust? Certainly not!
aov_text: Wat sal ons dan sê? Is daar miskien onreg by God? Nee, stellig nie!

kjv_text: For he saith to Moses, I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion.
bsb_text: For He says to Moses: “I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.”
aov_text: Want aan Moses sê Hy: Ek sal barmhartig wees oor wie Ek barmhartig wil wees en My ontferm oor wie Ek My wil ontferm.

kjv_text: So then it is not of him that willeth, nor of him that runneth, but of God that sheweth mercy.
bsb_text: So then, it does not depend on man’s desire or effort, but on God’s mercy.
aov_text: So hang dit dan nie af van die een wat wil of van die een wat loop nie, maar van God wat barmhartig is.

kjv_text: For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh, Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up, that I might shew my power in thee, and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth.
bsb_text: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh: “I raised you up for this very purpose, that I might display My power in you, and that My name might be proclaimed in all the earth.”
aov_text: Want die Skrif sê aan Farao: Juis hiervoor het Ek jou laat optree, dat Ek in jou my krag kan toon en dat my Naam verkondig kan word op die hele aarde.

kjv_text: Therefore hath he mercy on whom he will have mercy, and whom he will he hardeneth.
bsb_text: Therefore God has mercy on whom He wants to have mercy, and He hardens whom He wants to harden.
aov_text: So is Hy dan barmhartig oor wie Hy wil en Hy verhard wie Hy wil.

kjv_text: Thou wilt say then unto me, Why doth he yet find fault? For who hath resisted his will?
bsb_text: One of you will say to me, “Then why does God still find fault? For who can resist His will?”
aov_text: Jy sal dan vir my sê: Waarom verwyt Hy dan nog, want wie het sy wil weerstaan?

kjv_text: Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against God? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why hast thou made me thus?
bsb_text: But who are you, O man, to talk back to God? Shall what is formed say to Him who formed it, “Why did You make me like this?”
aov_text: Maar tog, o mens, wie is jy wat teen God antwoord? Die maaksel kan tog nie vir die maker sê: Waarom het u my so gemaak nie?

kjv_text: Hath not the potter power over the clay, of the same lump to make one vessel unto honour, and another unto dishonour?
bsb_text: Does not the potter have the right to make from the same lump of clay one vessel for special occasions and another for common use?
aov_text: Of het die pottebakker nie mag oor die klei, om uit dieselfde klomp die een voorwerp tot eer en die ander tot oneer te maak nie?

kjv_text: What if God, willing to shew his wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction:
bsb_text: What if God, intending to show His wrath and make His power known, bore with great patience the vessels of His wrath, prepared for destruction?
aov_text: En as God, al wil Hy sy toorn bewys en sy mag bekend maak, tog met groot lankmoedigheid die voorwerpe van toorn wat vir die verderf toeberei is, verdra het,

kjv_text: And that he might make known the riches of his glory on the vessels of mercy, which he had afore prepared unto glory,
bsb_text: What if He did this to make the riches of His glory known to the vessels of His mercy, whom He prepared in advance for glory—
aov_text: juis om bekend te maak die rykdom van sy heerlikheid oor die voorwerpe van barmhartigheid wat Hy voorberei het tot heerlikheid,

kjv_text: Even us, whom he hath called, not of the Jews only, but also of the Gentiles?
bsb_text: including us, whom He has called not only from the Jews, but also from the Gentiles?
aov_text: ons naamlik wat Hy geroep het, nie alleen uit die Jode nie, maar ook uit die heidene?

kjv_text: As he saith also in Osee, I will call them my people, which were not my people; and her beloved, which was not beloved.
bsb_text: As He says in Hosea: “I will call them ‘My People’ who are not My people, and I will call her ‘My Beloved’ who is not My beloved,”
aov_text: Soos Hy ook in Hoséa sê: Ek sal die wat nie my volk is nie, my volk noem; en haar wat nie bemin is nie, beminde;

kjv_text: And it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people; there shall they be called the children of the living God.
bsb_text: and, “It will happen that in the very place where it was said to them, ‘You are not My people,’ they will be called ‘sons of the living God.’”
aov_text: en in die plek waar aan hulle gesê is: Julle is nie my volk nie! — daar sal hulle genoem word kinders van die lewende God.

kjv_text: Esaias also crieth concerning Israel, Though the number of the children of Israel be as the sand of the sea, a remnant shall be saved:
bsb_text: Isaiah cries out concerning Israel: “Though the number of the Israelites is like the sand of the sea, only the remnant will be saved.
aov_text: En Jesaja roep oor Israel uit: Al is die getal van die kinders van Israel soos die sand van die see, net die oorblyfsel sal gered word;

kjv_text: For he will finish the work, and cut it short in righteousness: because a short work will the Lord make upon the earth.
bsb_text: For the Lord will carry out His sentence on the earth thoroughly and decisively.”
aov_text: want Hy volbring ’n saak en verkort dit in geregtigheid, omdat die Here ’n saak wat verkort is, op die aarde sal doen.

kjv_text: And as Esaias said before, Except the Lord of Sabaoth had left us a seed, we had been as Sodoma, and been made like unto Gomorrha.
bsb_text: It is just as Isaiah foretold: “Unless the Lord of Hosts had left us descendants, we would have become like Sodom, we would have resembled Gomorrah.”
aov_text: En soos Jesaja tevore gesê het: As die Here van die leërskare vir ons nie ’n nageslag oorgelaat het nie, soos Sodom sou ons geword het en aan Gomorra gelyk gewees het.

kjv_text: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, which followed not after righteousness, have attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith.
bsb_text: What then will we say? That the Gentiles, who did not pursue righteousness, have obtained it, a righteousness that is by faith;
aov_text: Wat sal ons dan sê? Dat die heidene, wat die geregtigheid nie nagejaag het nie, die geregtigheid verkry het, naamlik die geregtigheid wat uit die geloof is;

kjv_text: But Israel, which followed after the law of righteousness, hath not attained to the law of righteousness.
bsb_text: but Israel, who pursued a law of righteousness, has not attained it.
aov_text: terwyl Israel, wat die wet van die geregtigheid nagejaag het, die wet van die geregtigheid nie bereik het nie.

kjv_text: Wherefore? Because they sought it not by faith, but as it were by the works of the law. For they stumbled at that stumblingstone;
bsb_text: Why not? Because their pursuit was not by faith, but as if it were by works. They stumbled over the stumbling stone,
aov_text: Waarom? Omdat dit nie uit die geloof was nie, maar net asof dit uit die werke van die wet was; want hulle het hul gestamp teen die steen van aanstoot.

kjv_text: As it is written, Behold, I lay in Sion a stumblingstone and rock of offence: and whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.
bsb_text: as it is written: “See, I lay in Zion a stone of stumbling and a rock of offense; and the one who believes in Him will never be put to shame.”
aov_text: Soos geskrywe is: Kyk, Ek lê in Sion ’n steen van aanstoot en ’n rots van struikeling; en elkeen wat in Hom glo, sal nie beskaam word nie.

kjv_text: Brethren, my heart's desire and prayer to God for Israel is, that they might be saved.
bsb_text: Brothers, my heart’s desire and prayer to God for the Israelites is for their salvation.
aov_text: BROEDERS, die verlange van my hart en die gebed wat ek tot God vir Israel doen, is tot hulle redding.

kjv_text: For I bear them record that they have a zeal of God, but not according to knowledge.
bsb_text: For I testify about them that they are zealous for God, but not on the basis of knowledge.
aov_text: Want ek getuig van hulle dat hulle ’n ywer vir God het, maar sonder kennis.

kjv_text: For they being ignorant of God's righteousness, and going about to establish their own righteousness, have not submitted themselves unto the righteousness of God.
bsb_text: Because they were ignorant of God’s righteousness and sought to establish their own, they did not submit to God’s righteousness.
aov_text: Want omdat hulle die geregtigheid van God nie ken nie en hulle eie geregtigheid probeer oprig, het hulle hul aan die geregtigheid van God nie onderwerp nie.

kjv_text: For Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to every one that believeth.
bsb_text: For Christ is the end of the law, to bring righteousness to everyone who believes.
aov_text: Want Christus is die einde van die wet tot geregtigheid vir elkeen wat glo.

kjv_text: For Moses describeth the righteousness which is of the law, That the man which doeth those things shall live by them.
bsb_text: For concerning the righteousness that is by the law, Moses writes: “The man who does these things will live by them.”
aov_text: Want Moses beskrywe die geregtigheid wat uit die wet is: Die mens wat hierdie dinge doen, sal daardeur lewe.

kjv_text: But the righteousness which is of faith speaketh on this wise, Say not in thine heart, Who shall ascend into heaven? (that is, to bring Christ down from above:)
bsb_text: But the righteousness that is by faith says: “Do not say in your heart, ‘Who will ascend into heaven?’ (that is, to bring Christ down)
aov_text: Maar die geregtigheid wat uit die geloof is, sê dit: Moenie in jou hart sê nie: Wie sal in die hemel opvaar, naamlik om Christus af te bring;

kjv_text: Or, Who shall descend into the deep? (that is, to bring up Christ again from the dead.)
bsb_text: or, ‘Who will descend into the Abyss?’ (that is, to bring Christ up from the dead).”
aov_text: of: Wie sal in die afgrond neerdaal, naamlik om Christus uit die dode op te bring?

kjv_text: But what saith it? The word is nigh thee, even in thy mouth, and in thy heart: that is, the word of faith, which we preach;
bsb_text: But what does it say? “The word is near you; it is in your mouth and in your heart,” that is, the word of faith we are proclaiming:
aov_text: Maar wat sê dit? Naby jou is die woord, in jou mond en in jou hart. Dit is die woord van die geloof wat ons verkondig:

kjv_text: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.
bsb_text: that if you confess with your mouth, “Jesus is Lord,” and believe in your heart that God raised Him from the dead, you will be saved.
aov_text: As jy met jou mond die Here Jesus bely en met jou hart glo dat God Hom uit die dode opgewek het, sal jy gered word;

kjv_text: For with the heart man believeth unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.
bsb_text: For with your heart you believe and are justified, and with your mouth you confess and are saved.
aov_text: want met die hart glo ons tot geregtigheid en met die mond bely ons tot redding.

kjv_text: For the scripture saith, Whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.
bsb_text: It is just as the Scripture says: “Anyone who believes in Him will never be put to shame.”
aov_text: Want die Skrif sê: Elkeen wat in Hom glo, sal nie beskaam word nie.

kjv_text: For there is no difference between the Jew and the Greek: for the same Lord over all is rich unto all that call upon him.
bsb_text: For there is no difference between Jew and Greek: The same Lord is Lord of all, and gives richly to all who call on Him,
aov_text: Want daar is geen onderskeid tussen Jood en Griek nie; dieselfde Here tog is Here van almal en is ryk oor almal wat Hom aanroep.

kjv_text: For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.
bsb_text: for, “Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.”
aov_text: Want: Elkeen wat die Naam van die Here aanroep, sal gered word.

kjv_text: How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher?
bsb_text: How then can they call on the One in whom they have not believed? And how can they believe in the One of whom they have not heard? And how can they hear without someone to preach?
aov_text: Hoe kan hulle Hom dan aanroep in wie hulle nie geglo het nie? En hoe kan hulle in Hom glo van wie hulle nie gehoor het nie? En hoe kan hulle hoor sonder een wat preek?

kjv_text: And how shall they preach, except they be sent? as it is written, How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!
bsb_text: And how can they preach unless they are sent? As it is written: “How beautiful are the feet of those who bring good news!”
aov_text: En hoe kan hulle preek as hulle nie gestuur word nie? Soos geskrywe is: Hoe lieflik is die voete van die wat die evangelie van vrede verkondig, van die wat die evangelie van die goeie verkondig!

kjv_text: But they have not all obeyed the gospel. For Esaias saith, Lord, who hath believed our report?
bsb_text: But not all of them welcomed the good news. For Isaiah says, “Lord, who has believed our message?”
aov_text: Maar hulle was nie almal gehoorsaam aan die evangelie nie; want Jesaja sê: Here, wie het ons prediking geglo?

kjv_text: So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
bsb_text: Consequently, faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of Christ.
aov_text: Die geloof is dus uit die gehoor, en die gehoor is deur die woord van God.

kjv_text: But I say, Have they not heard? Yes verily, their sound went into all the earth, and their words unto the ends of the world.
bsb_text: But I ask, did they not hear? Indeed they did: “Their voice has gone out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world.”
aov_text: Maar ek sê: Het hulle miskien nie gehoor nie? Ja, seker! Oor die hele aarde het hulle stem uitgegaan en tot by die eindes van die wêreld hulle woorde.

kjv_text: But I say, Did not Israel know? First Moses saith, I will provoke you to jealousy by them that are no people, and by a foolish nation I will anger you.
bsb_text: I ask instead, did Israel not understand? First, Moses says: “I will make you jealous by those who are not a nation; I will make you angry by a nation without understanding.”
aov_text: Maar ek vra: Het Israel dit miskien nie verstaan nie? Ten eerste sê Moses: Ek sal julle jaloers maak op dié wat geen volk is nie, en Ek sal julle toorn opwek teen ’n onverstandige volk.

kjv_text: But Esaias is very bold, and saith, I was found of them that sought me not; I was made manifest unto them that asked not after me.
bsb_text: And Isaiah boldly says: “I was found by those who did not seek Me; I revealed Myself to those who did not ask for Me.”
aov_text: En Jesaja durf selfs sê: Ek het My laat vind deur die wat My nie gesoek het nie; Ek het verskyn aan die wat na My nie gevra het nie.

kjv_text: But to Israel he saith, All day long I have stretched forth my hands unto a disobedient and gainsaying people.
bsb_text: But as for Israel he says: “All day long I have held out My hands to a disobedient and obstinate people.”
aov_text: Maar van Israel sê Hy: Die hele dag het Ek my hande uitgebrei na ’n ongehoorsame en teësprekende volk.

kjv_text: I say then, Hath God cast away his people? God forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.
bsb_text: I ask then, did God reject His people? Certainly not! I am an Israelite myself, a descendant of Abraham, from the tribe of Benjamin.
aov_text: EK vra dan: Het God miskien sy volk verstoot? Nee, stellig nie! Want ek is ook ’n Israeliet uit die nageslag van Abraham, van die stam van Benjamin.

kjv_text: God hath not cast away his people which he foreknew. Wot ye not what the scripture saith of Elias? how he maketh intercession to God against Israel, saying,
bsb_text: God did not reject His people, whom He foreknew. Do you not know what the Scripture says about Elijah, how he appealed to God against Israel:
aov_text: God het sy volk wat Hy vantevore geken het, nie verstoot nie. Of weet julle nie wat die Skrif in die gedeelte oor Elía sê nie?  — hoe hy by God optree teen Israel en sê:

kjv_text: Lord, they have killed thy prophets, and digged down thine altars; and I am left alone, and they seek my life.
bsb_text: “Lord, they have killed Your prophets and torn down Your altars. I am the only one left, and they are seeking my life as well”?
aov_text: Here, hulle het u profete gedood en u altare het hulle afgebreek, en ek het alleen oorgebly, en hulle soek my lewe!

kjv_text: But what saith the answer of God unto him? I have reserved to myself seven thousand men, who have not bowed the knee to the image of Baal.
bsb_text: And what was the divine reply to him? “I have reserved for Myself seven thousand men who have not bowed the knee to Baal.”
aov_text: Maar wat sê die Godspraak aan hom? Ek het vir Myself seweduisend manne laat oorbly wat die knie voor Baäl nie gebuig het nie.

kjv_text: Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.
bsb_text: In the same way, at the present time there is a remnant chosen by grace.
aov_text: Net so is daar dan ook in die teenwoordige tyd ’n oorblyfsel, ooreenkomstig die verkiesing van die genade.

kjv_text: And if by grace, then is it no more of works: otherwise grace is no more grace. But if it be of works, then is it no more grace: otherwise work is no more work.
bsb_text: And if it is by grace, then it is no longer by works. Otherwise, grace would no longer be grace.
aov_text: En as dit deur genade is, dan is dit nie meer uit die werke nie; anders is die genade geen genade meer nie. En as dit uit die werke is, dan is dit nie meer genade nie; anders is die werk geen werk meer nie.

kjv_text: What then? Israel hath not obtained that which he seeketh for; but the election hath obtained it, and the rest were blinded.
bsb_text: What then? What Israel was seeking, it failed to obtain, but the elect did. The others were hardened,
aov_text: Wat dan? Wat Israel soek, dit het hy nie verkry nie; maar die uitverkorenes het dit verkry en die ander is verhard.

kjv_text: (According as it is written, God hath given them the spirit of slumber, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear;) unto this day.
bsb_text: as it is written: “God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes that could not see, and ears that could not hear, to this very day.”
aov_text: Soos geskrywe is: God het hulle gegee ’n gees van diepe slaap, oë om nie te sien nie en ore om nie te hoor nie, tot vandag toe.

kjv_text: And David saith, Let their table be made a snare, and a trap, and a stumblingblock, and a recompence unto them:
bsb_text: And David says: “May their table become a snare and a trap, a stumbling block and a retribution to them.
aov_text: En Dawid sê: Laat hulle tafel vir hulle wees ’n vangnet en ’n strik en ’n struikelblok en ’n vergelding.

kjv_text: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see, and bow down their back alway.
bsb_text: May their eyes be darkened so they cannot see, and their backs be bent forever.”
aov_text: Laat hulle oë duister word om nie te sien nie, en buig hulle rug vir altyd krom.

kjv_text: I say then, Have they stumbled that they should fall? God forbid: but rather through their fall salvation is come unto the Gentiles, for to provoke them to jealousy.
bsb_text: I ask then, did they stumble so as to fall beyond recovery? Certainly not! However, because of their trespass, salvation has come to the Gentiles to make Israel jealous.
aov_text: Ek vra dan: Het hulle miskien gestruikel om te val? Nee, stellig nie! Maar deur hulle val het die saligheid tot die heidene gekom om hulle jaloers te maak.

kjv_text: Now if the fall of them be the riches of the world, and the diminishing of them the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fulness?
bsb_text: But if their trespass means riches for the world, and their failure means riches for the Gentiles, how much greater riches will their fullness bring!
aov_text: En as hulle val die rykdom van die wêreld is en hulle tekort die rykdom van die heidene, hoeveel te meer sal hulle volheid dit nie wees nie!

kjv_text: For I speak to you Gentiles, inasmuch as I am the apostle of the Gentiles, I magnify mine office:
bsb_text: I am speaking to you Gentiles. Inasmuch as I am the apostle to the Gentiles, I magnify my ministry
aov_text: Want aan julle heidene sê ek: Vir sover as ek ’n apostel van die heidene is, verheerlik ek my bediening  —

kjv_text: If by any means I may provoke to emulation them which are my flesh, and might save some of them.
bsb_text: in the hope that I may provoke my own people to jealousy and save some of them.
aov_text: as ek tog maar net my eie volk jaloers kan maak en sommige uit hulle kan red!

kjv_text: For if the casting away of them be the reconciling of the world, what shall the receiving of them be, but life from the dead?
bsb_text: For if their rejection is the reconciliation of the world, what will their acceptance be but life from the dead?
aov_text: Want as hulle verwerping die versoening van die wêreld is, wat sal hulle aanneming anders wees as lewe uit die dode?

kjv_text: For if the firstfruit be holy, the lump is also holy: and if the root be holy, so are the branches.
bsb_text: If the first part of the dough is holy, so is the whole batch; if the root is holy, so are the branches.
aov_text: En as die eerstelinge heilig is, dan die deeg ook; en as die wortel heilig is, dan die takke ook.

kjv_text: And if some of the branches be broken off, and thou, being a wild olive tree, wert graffed in among them, and with them partakest of the root and fatness of the olive tree;
bsb_text: Now if some branches have been broken off, and you, a wild olive shoot, have been grafted in among the others to share in the nourishment of the olive root,
aov_text: En as sommige van die takke afgebreek is, en jy wat ’n wilde olyfboom was, onder hulle ingeënt is en deel gekry het aan die wortel en die vettigheid van die olyfboom,

kjv_text: Boast not against the branches. But if thou boast, thou bearest not the root, but the root thee.
bsb_text: do not boast over those branches. If you do, remember this: You do not support the root, but the root supports you.
aov_text: moet dan nie teen die takke roem nie; en as jy roem — dit is nie jy wat die wortel dra nie, maar die wortel vir jou.

kjv_text: Thou wilt say then, The branches were broken off, that I might be graffed in.
bsb_text: You will say then, “Branches were broken off so that I could be grafted in.”
aov_text: Jy sal dan sê: Die takke is afgebreek, sodat ek ingeënt kon word.

kjv_text: Well; because of unbelief they were broken off, and thou standest by faith. Be not highminded, but fear:
bsb_text: That is correct: They were broken off because of unbelief, but you stand by faith. Do not be arrogant, but be afraid.
aov_text: Goed! Deur ongeloof is hulle afgebreek, maar jy staan deur die geloof. Moenie hoogmoedig wees nie, maar vrees.

kjv_text: For if God spared not the natural branches, take heed lest he also spare not thee.
bsb_text: For if God did not spare the natural branches, He will certainly not spare you either.
aov_text: Want as God die natuurlike takke nie gespaar het nie, sal Hy miskien jou ook nie spaar nie.

kjv_text: Behold therefore the goodness and severity of God: on them which fell, severity; but toward thee, goodness, if thou continue in his goodness: otherwise thou also shalt be cut off.
bsb_text: Take notice, therefore, of the kindness and severity of God: severity to those who fell, but kindness to you, if you continue in His kindness. Otherwise you also will be cut off.
aov_text: Let dan op die goedertierenheid en die gestrengheid van God: gestrengheid oor die wat geval het, maar goedertierenheid oor jou as jy in die goedertierenheid bly; anders sal jy ook afgekap word.

kjv_text: And they also, if they abide not still in unbelief, shall be graffed in: for God is able to graff them in again.
bsb_text: And if they do not persist in unbelief, they will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.
aov_text: Maar ook hulle sal, as hulle nie in die ongeloof bly nie, ingeënt word; want God is magtig om hulle weer in te ent.

kjv_text: For if thou wert cut out of the olive tree which is wild by nature, and wert graffed contrary to nature into a good olive tree: how much more shall these, which be the natural branches, be graffed into their own olive tree?
bsb_text: For if you were cut from a wild olive tree, and contrary to nature were grafted into one that is cultivated, how much more readily will these, the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree!
aov_text: Want as jy afgekap is van die olyfboom wat van nature wild was, en teen die natuur op die mak olyfboom ingeënt kan word, hoeveel te meer kan hulle dan wat dit van nature is, op hul eie olyfboom ingeënt word?

kjv_text: For I would not, brethren, that ye should be ignorant of this mystery, lest ye should be wise in your own conceits; that blindness in part is happened to Israel, until the fulness of the Gentiles be come in.
bsb_text: I do not want you to be ignorant of this mystery, brothers, so that you will not be conceited: A hardening in part has come to Israel, until the full number of the Gentiles has come in.
aov_text: Want ek wil nie hê, broeders, dat julle hierdie verborgenheid nie moet weet nie, sodat julle nie eiewys mag wees nie: dat die verharding ten dele oor Israel gekom het totdat die volheid van die heidene ingegaan het;

kjv_text: And so all Israel shall be saved: as it is written, There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer, and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob:
bsb_text: And so all Israel will be saved, as it is written: “The Deliverer will come from Zion; He will remove godlessness from Jacob.
aov_text: en so sal die hele Israel gered word, soos geskrywe is: Die Verlosser sal uit Sion kom en sal die goddelooshede van Jakob afwend;

kjv_text: For this is my covenant unto them, when I shall take away their sins.
bsb_text: And this is My covenant with them when I take away their sins.”
aov_text: en dit is van my kant die verbond met hulle as Ek hulle sondes wegneem.

kjv_text: As concerning the gospel, they are enemies for your sakes: but as touching the election, they are beloved for the fathers' sakes.
bsb_text: Regarding the gospel, they are enemies on your account; but regarding election, they are loved on account of the patriarchs.
aov_text: Wat die evangelie betref, is hulle wel vyande ter wille van julle; maar wat die uitverkiesing betref, bemindes ter wille van die vaders.

kjv_text: For the gifts and calling of God are without repentance.
bsb_text: For God’s gifts and His call are irrevocable.
aov_text: Want die genadegawes en die roeping van God is onberoulik.

kjv_text: For as ye in times past have not believed God, yet have now obtained mercy through their unbelief:
bsb_text: Just as you who formerly disobeyed God have now received mercy through their disobedience,
aov_text: Want soos julle ook vroeër aan God ongehoorsaam was, maar nou barmhartigheid ontvang het deur hulle ongehoorsaamheid,

kjv_text: Even so have these also now not believed, that through your mercy they also may obtain mercy.
bsb_text: so they too have now disobeyed, in order that they too may now receive mercy through the mercy shown to you.
aov_text: so het hulle ook nou ongehoorsaam geword deur die barmhartigheid aan julle, sodat hulle ook barmhartigheid kan ontvang.

kjv_text: For God hath concluded them all in unbelief, that he might have mercy upon all.
bsb_text: For God has consigned everyone to disobedience so that He may have mercy on everyone.
aov_text: Want God het hulle almal in die ongehoorsaamheid ingesluit om vir almal barmhartig te kan wees.

kjv_text: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!
bsb_text: O, the depth of the riches of the wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable are His judgments, and untraceable His ways!
aov_text: O, DIEPTE van die rykdom en wysheid en kennis van God! Hoe ondeurgrondelik is sy oordele en onnaspeurlik sy weë!

kjv_text: For who hath known the mind of the Lord? or who hath been his counsellor?
bsb_text: “Who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been His counselor?”
aov_text: Want wie het die gedagte van die Here geken, of wie was sy raadsman gewees?

kjv_text: Or who hath first given to him, and it shall be recompensed unto him again?
bsb_text: “Who has first given to God, that God should repay him?”
aov_text: Of wie het eers iets aan Hom gegee, dat dit hom vergeld moet word?

kjv_text: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things: to whom be glory for ever. Amen.
bsb_text: For from Him and through Him and to Him are all things. To Him be the glory forever! Amen.
aov_text: Want uit Hom en deur Hom en tot Hom is alle dinge. Syne is die heerlikheid tot in ewigheid. Amen.

kjv_text: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.
bsb_text: Therefore I urge you, brothers, on account of God’s mercy, to offer your bodies as living sacrifices, holy and pleasing to God, which is your spiritual service of worship.
aov_text: EK vermaan julle dan, broeders, by die ontferminge van God, dat julle jul liggame stel as ’n lewende, heilige en aan God welgevallige offer — dit is julle redelike godsdiens.

kjv_text: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.
bsb_text: Do not be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what is the good, pleasing, and perfect will of God.
aov_text: En word nie aan hierdie wêreld gelykvormig nie, maar word verander deur die vernuwing van julle gemoed, sodat julle kan beproef wat die goeie en welgevallige en volmaakte wil van God is.

kjv_text: For I say, through the grace given unto me, to every man that is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think soberly, according as God hath dealt to every man the measure of faith.
bsb_text: For by the grace given me I say to every one of you: Do not think of yourself more highly than you ought, but think of yourself with sober judgment, according to the measure of faith God has given you.
aov_text: Want deur die genade wat aan my gegee is, sê ek vir elkeen wat onder julle is, dat hy nie van homself meer moet dink as wat ’n mens behoort te dink nie; maar dat hy daaraan moet dink om besadig te wees na die maat van geloof soos God dit aan elkeen toebedeel het.

kjv_text: For as we have many members in one body, and all members have not the same office:
bsb_text: Just as each of us has one body with many members, and not all members have the same function,
aov_text: Want soos ons in een liggaam baie lede het en die lede nie almal dieselfde werking het nie,

kjv_text: So we, being many, are one body in Christ, and every one members one of another.
bsb_text: so in Christ we who are many are one body, and each member belongs to one another.
aov_text: so is ons almal saam een liggaam in Christus en elkeen afsonderlik lede van mekaar.

kjv_text: Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us,
bsb_text: We have different gifts according to the grace given us.
aov_text: En ons besit genadegawes wat verskil volgens die genade wat aan ons gegee is:

kjv_text: whether prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of faith;
bsb_text: If one's gift is prophecy, let him use it in proportion to his faith;
aov_text: is dit profesie, na die maat van die geloof;

kjv_text: Or ministry, let us wait on our ministering: or he that teacheth, on teaching;
bsb_text: if it is serving, let him serve; if it is teaching, let him teach;
aov_text: of bediening, in die werk van bediening; of wie leer, in die lering;

kjv_text: Or he that exhorteth, on exhortation: he that giveth, let him do it with simplicity; he that ruleth, with diligence; he that sheweth mercy, with cheerfulness.
bsb_text: if it is encouraging, let him encourage; if it is giving, let him give generously; if it is leading, let him lead with diligence; if it is showing mercy, let him do it cheerfully.
aov_text: of wie vermaan, in die vermaning; wie uitdeel, in opregtheid; wie ’n voorganger is, met ywer; wie barmhartigheid bewys, met blymoedigheid.

kjv_text: Let love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.
bsb_text: Love must be sincere. Detest what is evil; cling to what is good.
aov_text: LAAT die liefde ongeveins wees; verafsku wat sleg is; hang die goeie aan;

kjv_text: Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another;
bsb_text: Be devoted to one another in brotherly love. Outdo yourselves in honoring one another.
aov_text: wees hartlik teenoor mekaar met broederlike liefde; die een moet die ander voorgaan in eerbetoning;

kjv_text: Not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;
bsb_text: Do not let your zeal subside; keep your spiritual fervor, serving the Lord.
aov_text: wees nie traag in die ywer nie; wees vurig van gees; dien die Here;

kjv_text: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;
bsb_text: Be joyful in hope, patient in affliction, persistent in prayer.
aov_text: verbly julle in die hoop; wees geduldig in die verdrukking; volhard in die gebed.

kjv_text: Distributing to the necessity of saints; given to hospitality.
bsb_text: Share with the saints who are in need. Practice hospitality.
aov_text: Maak voorsiening in die behoeftes van die heiliges; streef na gasvryheid;

kjv_text: Bless them which persecute you: bless, and curse not.
bsb_text: Bless those who persecute you. Bless and do not curse.
aov_text: seën die wat julle vervolg, seën en moenie vervloek nie;

kjv_text: Rejoice with them that do rejoice, and weep with them that weep.
bsb_text: Rejoice with those who rejoice; weep with those who weep.
aov_text: wees bly met die wat bly is, en ween met die wat ween;

kjv_text: Be of the same mind one toward another. Mind not high things, but condescend to men of low estate. Be not wise in your own conceits.
bsb_text: Live in harmony with one another. Do not be proud, but enjoy the company of the lowly. Do not be conceited.
aov_text: wees eensgesind onder mekaar; moenie na hoë dinge streef nie, maar voeg julle by die nederige; moenie eiewys wees nie;

kjv_text: Recompense to no man evil for evil. Provide things honest in the sight of all men.
bsb_text: Do not repay anyone evil for evil. Carefully consider what is right in the eyes of everybody.
aov_text: vergeld niemand kwaad vir kwaad nie; bedink wat goed is voor alle mense;

kjv_text: If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.
bsb_text: If it is possible on your part, live at peace with everyone.
aov_text: as dit moontlik is, sover as dit van julle afhang, leef in vrede met alle mense.

kjv_text: Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance is mine; I will repay, saith the Lord.
bsb_text: Do not avenge yourselves, beloved, but leave room for God’s wrath. For it is written: “Vengeance is Mine; I will repay, says the Lord.”
aov_text: Moenie julle wreek nie, geliefdes, maar gee plek vir die toorn; want daar is geskrywe: Aan My kom die wraak toe, Ek sal vergeld, spreek die Here.

kjv_text: Therefore if thine enemy hunger, feed him; if he thirst, give him drink: for in so doing thou shalt heap coals of fire on his head.
bsb_text: On the contrary, “If your enemy is hungry, feed him; if he is thirsty, give him a drink. For in so doing, you will heap burning coals on his head.”
aov_text: As jou vyand dan honger het, gee hom iets om te eet; as hy dors het, gee hom iets om te drink, want sodoende sal jy op sy hoof vurige kole ophoop.

kjv_text: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.
bsb_text: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
aov_text: Laat jou nie deur die kwaad oorwin nie, maar oorwin die kwaad deur die goeie.

kjv_text: Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers. For there is no power but of God: the powers that be are ordained of God.
bsb_text: Everyone must submit himself to the governing authorities, for there is no authority except that which is from God. The authorities that exist have been appointed by God.
aov_text: LAAT elke mens hom onderwerp aan die magte wat oor hom gestel is, want daar is geen mag behalwe van God nie, en die wat daar is, is deur God ingestel,

kjv_text: Whosoever therefore resisteth the power, resisteth the ordinance of God: and they that resist shall receive to themselves damnation.
bsb_text: Consequently, whoever resists authority is opposing what God has set in place, and those who do so will bring judgment on themselves.
aov_text: sodat hy wat hom teen die mag versit, die instelling van God weerstaan; en die wat dit weerstaan, sal hulle oordeel ontvang.

kjv_text: For rulers are not a terror to good works, but to the evil. Wilt thou then not be afraid of the power? do that which is good, and thou shalt have praise of the same:
bsb_text: For rulers are not a terror to good conduct, but to bad. Do you want to be unafraid of the one in authority? Then do what is right, and you will have his approval.
aov_text: Want die owerhede is geen voorwerp van vrees by die goeie dade nie, maar by die slegte. Maar wil jy nie die mag vrees nie, doen wat goed is, en jy sal lof van hom ontvang;

kjv_text: For he is the minister of God to thee for good. But if thou do that which is evil, be afraid; for he beareth not the sword in vain: for he is the minister of God, a revenger to execute wrath upon him that doeth evil.
bsb_text: For he is God’s servant for your good. But if you do wrong, be afraid, for he does not carry the sword in vain. He is God’s servant, an agent of retribution to the wrongdoer.
aov_text: want hy is ’n dienaar van God, jou ten goede. Maar as jy kwaad doen, vrees dan; want hy dra die swaard nie verniet nie, want hy is ’n dienaar van God, ’n wreker om die een wat kwaad doen, te straf.

kjv_text: Wherefore ye must needs be subject, not only for wrath, but also for conscience sake.
bsb_text: Therefore it is necessary to submit to authority, not only to avoid punishment, but also as a matter of conscience.
aov_text: Daarom is dit noodsaaklik om jou te onderwerp, nie alleen ter wille van die straf nie, maar ter wille van die gewete.

kjv_text: For for this cause pay ye tribute also: for they are God's ministers, attending continually upon this very thing.
bsb_text: This is also why you pay taxes. For the authorities are God’s servants, who devote themselves to their work.
aov_text: Want daarom betaal julle ook belastings; want hulle is dienaars van God wat juis hiermee voortdurend besig is.

kjv_text: Render therefore to all their dues: tribute to whom tribute is due; custom to whom custom; fear to whom fear; honour to whom honour.
bsb_text: Pay everyone what you owe him: taxes to whom taxes are due, revenue to whom revenue is due, respect to whom respect is due, honor to whom honor is due.
aov_text: Betaal dan aan almal wat aan hulle verskuldig is: belasting aan die wat belasting, tol aan die wat tol, vrees aan die wat vrees, eer aan die wat eer toekom.

kjv_text: Owe no man any thing, but to love one another: for he that loveth another hath fulfilled the law.
bsb_text: Be indebted to no one, except to one another in love. For he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.
aov_text: WEES aan niemand iets skuldig nie, behalwe om mekaar lief te hê; want hy wat ’n ander liefhet, het die wet vervul.

kjv_text: For this, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not kill, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness, Thou shalt not covet; and if there be any other commandment, it is briefly comprehended in this saying, namely, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
bsb_text: The commandments “Do not commit adultery,” “Do not murder,” “Do not steal,” “Do not covet,” and any other commandments, are summed up in this one decree: “Love your neighbor as yourself.”
aov_text: Want dít: Jy mag nie egbreek nie, jy mag nie doodslaan nie, jy mag nie steel nie, jy mag geen valse getuienis gee nie, jy mag nie begeer nie, en watter ander gebod ook al, word in hierdie woord saamgevat: Jy moet jou naaste liefhê soos jouself.

kjv_text: Love worketh no ill to his neighbour: therefore love is the fulfilling of the law.
bsb_text: Love does no wrong to its neighbor. Therefore love is the fulfillment of the law.
aov_text: Die liefde doen die naaste geen kwaad nie; daarom is die liefde die vervulling van die wet.

kjv_text: And that, knowing the time, that now it is high time to awake out of sleep: for now is our salvation nearer than when we believed.
bsb_text: And do this, understanding the occasion. The hour has come for you to wake up from your slumber, for our salvation is nearer now than when we first believed.
aov_text: En dit te meer, omdat ons die tydsomstandighede ken, dat die uur vir ons reeds daar is om uit die slaap wakker te word; want die saligheid is nou nader by ons as toe ons gelowig geword het.

kjv_text: The night is far spent, the day is at hand: let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and let us put on the armour of light.
bsb_text: The night is nearly over; the day has drawn near. So let us lay aside the deeds of darkness and put on the armor of light.
aov_text: Die nag het ver gevorder en dit is amper dag. Laat ons dan die werke van die duisternis aflê en die wapens van die lig aangord.

kjv_text: Let us walk honestly, as in the day; not in rioting and drunkenness, not in chambering and wantonness, not in strife and envying.
bsb_text: Let us behave decently, as in the daytime, not in carousing and drunkenness, not in sexual immorality and debauchery, not in dissension and jealousy.
aov_text: Laat ons welvoeglik wandel soos in die dag, nie in brassery en dronkenskap, nie in ontug en ongebondenheid, nie in twis en nydigheid nie.

kjv_text: But put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make not provision for the flesh, to fulfil the lusts thereof.
bsb_text: Instead, clothe yourselves with the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the desires of the flesh.
aov_text: Maar beklee julle met die Here Jesus Christus, en maak geen voorsorg vir die vlees om sy begeerlikhede te bevredig nie.

kjv_text: Him that is weak in the faith receive ye, but not to doubtful disputations.
bsb_text: Accept him whose faith is weak, without passing judgment on his opinions.
aov_text: EN neem hom aan wat swak is in die geloof, nie om oor sy gevoelens te oordeel nie.

kjv_text: For one believeth that he may eat all things: another, who is weak, eateth herbs.
bsb_text: For one person has faith to eat all things, while another, who is weak, eats only vegetables.
aov_text: Die een glo dat ’n mens alles mag eet, maar hy wat swak is, eet groente.

kjv_text: Let not him that eateth despise him that eateth not; and let not him which eateth not judge him that eateth: for God hath received him.
bsb_text: The one who eats everything must not belittle the one who does not, and the one who does not eat everything must not judge the one who does, for God has accepted him.
aov_text: Hy wat eet, moet hom wat nie eet, nie verag nie; en hy wat nie eet, moet hom wat eet, nie oordeel nie, want God het hom aangeneem.

kjv_text: Who art thou that judgest another man's servant? to his own master he standeth or falleth. Yea, he shall be holden up: for God is able to make him stand.
bsb_text: Who are you to judge someone else’s servant? To his own master he stands or falls. And he will stand, for the Lord is able to make him stand.
aov_text: Wie is jy wat die huiskneg van ’n ander oordeel? Hy staan of val met betrekking tot sy eie heer; maar hy sal staande bly, want God is magtig om hom staande te hou.

kjv_text: One man esteemeth one day above another: another esteemeth every day alike. Let every man be fully persuaded in his own mind.
bsb_text: One person regards a certain day above the others, while someone else considers every day alike. Each one should be fully convinced in his own mind.
aov_text: Die een ag die een dag bo die ander, die ander ag al die dae gelyk. Laat elkeen in sy eie gemoed ten volle oortuig wees.

kjv_text: He that regardeth the day, regardeth it unto the Lord; and he that regardeth not the day, to the Lord he doth not regard it. He that eateth, eateth to the Lord, for he giveth God thanks; and he that eateth not, to the Lord he eateth not, and giveth God thanks.
bsb_text: He who observes a special day does so to the Lord; he who eats does so to the Lord, for he gives thanks to God; and he who abstains does so to the Lord and gives thanks to God.
aov_text: Hy wat die dag waarneem, neem dit waar tot eer van die Here; en hy wat die dag nie waarneem nie, neem dit nie waar nie tot eer van die Here; en wie eet, eet tot eer van die Here, want hy dank God; en wie nie eet nie, eet nie tot eer van die Here, en hy dank God.

kjv_text: For none of us liveth to himself, and no man dieth to himself.
bsb_text: For none of us lives to himself alone, and none of us dies to himself alone.
aov_text: Want niemand van ons leef vir homself nie en niemand sterf vir homself nie.

kjv_text: For whether we live, we live unto the Lord; and whether we die, we die unto the Lord: whether we live therefore, or die, we are the Lord's.
bsb_text: If we live, we live to the Lord, and if we die, we die to the Lord. So whether we live or die, we belong to the Lord.
aov_text: Want as ons lewe, leef ons tot eer van die Here; en as ons sterwe, sterf ons tot eer van die Here; of ons dan lewe en of ons sterwe, ons behoort aan die Here.

kjv_text: For to this end Christ both died, and rose, and revived, that he might be Lord both of the dead and living.
bsb_text: For this reason Christ died and returned to life, that He might be the Lord of both the dead and the living.
aov_text: Want hiervoor het Christus ook gesterwe en opgestaan en weer lewend geword, om oor dode sowel as lewende te heers.

kjv_text: But why dost thou judge thy brother? or why dost thou set at nought thy brother? for we shall all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.
bsb_text: Why, then, do you judge your brother? Or why do you belittle your brother? For we will all stand before God’s judgment seat.
aov_text: Maar jy, waarom oordeel jy jou broeder? Of jy ook, waarom verag jy jou broeder? Want ons sal almal voor die regterstoel van Christus gestel word.

kjv_text: For it is written, As I live, saith the Lord, every knee shall bow to me, and every tongue shall confess to God.
bsb_text: It is written: “As surely as I live, says the Lord, every knee will bow before Me; every tongue will confess to God.”
aov_text: Want daar is geskrywe: So waaragtig as Ek leef, sê die Here, voor My sal elke knie buig, en elke tong sal God bely.

kjv_text: So then every one of us shall give account of himself to God.
bsb_text: So then, each of us will give an account of himself to God.
aov_text: So sal elkeen van ons dan vir homself aan God rekenskap gee.

kjv_text: Let us not therefore judge one another any more: but judge this rather, that no man put a stumblingblock or an occasion to fall in his brother's way.
bsb_text: Therefore let us stop judging one another. Instead, make up your mind not to put any stumbling block or obstacle in your brother’s way.
aov_text: LAAT ons dan mekaar nie meer oordeel nie, maar besluit dít liewer, om nie die broeder ’n hindernis of struikelblok in die weg te lê nie.

kjv_text: I know, and am persuaded by the Lord Jesus, that there is nothing unclean of itself: but to him that esteemeth any thing to be unclean, to him it is unclean.
bsb_text: I am convinced and fully persuaded in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean in itself. But if anyone regards something as unclean, then for him it is unclean.
aov_text: Ek weet en is oortuig in die Here Jesus dat niks op sigself onrein is nie, maar hy wat reken dat iets onrein is, vir hom is dit onrein.

kjv_text: But if thy brother be grieved with thy meat, now walkest thou not charitably. Destroy not him with thy meat, for whom Christ died.
bsb_text: If your brother is distressed by what you eat, you are no longer acting in love. Do not by your eating destroy your brother, for whom Christ died.
aov_text: Maar as jou broeder deur voedsel gegrief word, dan wandel jy nie meer volgens die liefde nie. Moenie deur jou voedsel hom te gronde rig vir wie Christus gesterf het nie.

kjv_text: Let not then your good be evil spoken of:
bsb_text: Do not allow what you consider good, then, to be spoken of as evil.
aov_text: Laat dan van die goeie wat aan julle behoort, nie kwaad gespreek word nie.

kjv_text: For the kingdom of God is not meat and drink; but righteousness, and peace, and joy in the Holy Ghost.
bsb_text: For the kingdom of God is not a matter of eating and drinking, but of righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.
aov_text: Want die koninkryk van God is nie spys en drank nie, maar geregtigheid en vrede en blydskap in die Heilige Gees.

kjv_text: For he that in these things serveth Christ is acceptable to God, and approved of men.
bsb_text: For whoever serves Christ in this way is pleasing to God and approved by men.
aov_text: Want hy wat Christus hierin dien, is aan God welgevallig en by die mense geag.

kjv_text: Let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace, and things wherewith one may edify another.
bsb_text: So then, let us pursue what leads to peace and to mutual edification.
aov_text: Laat ons dan najaag wat tot vrede en onderlinge stigting dien.

kjv_text: For meat destroy not the work of God. All things indeed are pure; but it is evil for that man who eateth with offence.
bsb_text: Do not destroy the work of God for the sake of food. All food is clean, but it is wrong for a man to let his eating be a stumbling block.
aov_text: Moenie ter wille van voedsel die werk van God afbreek nie. Alles is wel rein, maar dit is verkeerd vir ’n mens om te eet as dit tot aanstoot is.

kjv_text: It is good neither to eat flesh, nor to drink wine, nor any thing whereby thy brother stumbleth, or is offended, or is made weak.
bsb_text: It is better not to eat meat or drink wine or to do anything to cause your brother to stumble.
aov_text: Dit is goed om geen vleis te eet of wyn te drink of iets te doen waardeur jou broeder aanstoot neem of struikel, of waarin hy swak is nie.

kjv_text: Hast thou faith? have it to thyself before God. Happy is he that condemneth not himself in that thing which he alloweth.
bsb_text: Keep your belief about such matters between yourself and God. Blessed is the one who does not condemn himself by what he approves.
aov_text: Het jy geloof? Behou dit vir jouself voor die aangesig van God. Gelukkig is hy wat homself nie oordeel in wat hy vir geoorloof ag nie.

kjv_text: And he that doubteth is damned if he eat, because he eateth not of faith: for whatsoever is not of faith is sin.
bsb_text: But the one who has doubts is condemned if he eats, because his eating is not from faith; and everything that is not from faith is sin.
aov_text: Maar hy wat twyfel as hy eet, is veroordeel, omdat dit nie uit die geloof is nie; en alles wat nie uit die geloof is nie, is sonde.

kjv_text: We then that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves.
bsb_text: We who are strong ought to bear with the shortcomings of the weak and not to please ourselves.
aov_text: EN op ons wat sterk is, rus die verpligting om die swakhede te dra van die wat nie sterk is nie, en nie onsself te behaag nie.

kjv_text: Let every one of us please his neighbour for his good to edification.
bsb_text: Each of us should please his neighbor for his good, to build him up.
aov_text: Want elkeen van ons moet die naaste behaag met die oog op wat goed is tot stigting.

kjv_text: For even Christ pleased not himself; but, as it is written, The reproaches of them that reproached thee fell on me.
bsb_text: For even Christ did not please Himself, but as it is written: “The insults of those who insult You have fallen on Me.”
aov_text: Want ook Christus het Homself nie behaag nie, maar soos geskrywe is: Die smaadhede van die wat U smaad, het op My geval.

kjv_text: For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.
bsb_text: For everything that was written in the past was written for our instruction, so that through endurance and the encouragement of the Scriptures, we might have hope.
aov_text: Want alles wat tevore geskrywe is, is tot ons lering tevore geskrywe, sodat ons deur lydsaamheid en bemoediging van die Skrifte hoop kan hê.

kjv_text: Now the God of patience and consolation grant you to be likeminded one toward another according to Christ Jesus:
bsb_text: Now may the God who gives endurance and encouragement grant you harmony with one another in Christ Jesus,
aov_text: En mag die God van lydsaamheid en bemoediging aan julle gee om eensgesind onder mekaar te wees ooreenkomstig die wil van Christus Jesus,

kjv_text: That ye may with one mind and one mouth glorify God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
bsb_text: so that with one mind and one voice you may glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
aov_text: sodat julle die God en Vader van onse Here Jesus Christus eendragtiglik uit een mond kan verheerlik.

kjv_text: Wherefore receive ye one another, as Christ also received us to the glory of God.
bsb_text: Accept one another, then, just as Christ accepted you, in order to bring glory to God.
aov_text: Neem daarom mekaar aan, soos Christus ons ook aangeneem het, tot heerlikheid van God.

kjv_text: Now I say that Jesus Christ was a minister of the circumcision for the truth of God, to confirm the promises made unto the fathers:
bsb_text: For I tell you that Christ has become a servant of the circumcised on behalf of God’s truth, to confirm the promises made to the patriarchs,
aov_text: En ek sê dat Jesus Christus ’n dienaar geword het van die besnydenis ter wille van die waaragtigheid van God, om die beloftes aan die vaders te bevestig;

kjv_text: And that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy; as it is written, For this cause I will confess to thee among the Gentiles, and sing unto thy name.
bsb_text: so that the Gentiles may glorify God for His mercy. As it is written: “Therefore I will praise You among the Gentiles; I will sing hymns to Your name.”
aov_text: en dat die heidene ter wille van sy barmhartigheid God kan verheerlik, soos geskrywe is: Daarom sal ek U loof onder die nasies en tot eer van u Naam psalmsing.

kjv_text: And again he saith, Rejoice, ye Gentiles, with his people.
bsb_text: Again, it says: “Rejoice, O Gentiles, with His people.”
aov_text: En ook sê Hy: Verbly julle, o nasies, saam met sy volk;

kjv_text: And again, Praise the Lord, all ye Gentiles; and laud him, all ye people.
bsb_text: And again: “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles, and extol Him, all you peoples.”
aov_text: en ook: Loof die Here, alle nasies, en prys Hom, alle volke.

kjv_text: And again, Esaias saith, There shall be a root of Jesse, and he that shall rise to reign over the Gentiles; in him shall the Gentiles trust.
bsb_text: And once more, Isaiah says: “The Root of Jesse will appear, One who will arise to rule over the Gentiles; in Him the Gentiles will put their hope.”
aov_text: En Jesaja sê ook: Die wortel van Ísai sal daar wees, en Hy wat opstaan om oor die nasies te heers, op Hom sal die nasies hoop.

kjv_text: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.
bsb_text: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you believe in Him, so that you may overflow with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit.
aov_text: En mag die God van die hoop julle vervul met alle blydskap en vrede deur die geloof, dat julle oorvloedig kan wees in die hoop deur die krag van die Heilige Gees!

kjv_text: And I myself also am persuaded of you, my brethren, that ye also are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.
bsb_text: I myself am convinced, my brothers, that you yourselves are full of goodness, brimming with knowledge, and able to instruct one another.
aov_text: MAAR ek self ook, my broeders, is oortuig aangaande julle, dat julle self ook vol van goedheid is, vervuld met alle kennis, in staat om ook mekaar te vermaan.

kjv_text: Nevertheless, brethren, I have written the more boldly unto you in some sort, as putting you in mind, because of the grace that is given to me of God,
bsb_text: However, I have written you a bold reminder on some points, because of the grace God has given me
aov_text: Tog het ek ten dele taamlik gewaag om aan julle te skrywe, broeders, as een wat julle herinner, kragtens die genade wat my deur God gegee is

kjv_text: That I should be the minister of Jesus Christ to the Gentiles, ministering the gospel of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be acceptable, being sanctified by the Holy Ghost.
bsb_text: to be a minister of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles in the priestly service of the gospel of God, so that the Gentiles might become an offering acceptable to God, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.
aov_text: om ’n dienaar van Jesus Christus onder die heidene te wees, ’n dienaar van die evangelie van God, sodat die offer van die heidene welgevallig kan wees, geheilig deur die Heilige Gees.

kjv_text: I have therefore whereof I may glory through Jesus Christ in those things which pertain to God.
bsb_text: Therefore I exult in Christ Jesus in my service to God.
aov_text: Ek het dan rede om te roem in Christus Jesus, in die dinge aangaande God.

kjv_text: For I will not dare to speak of any of those things which Christ hath not wrought by me, to make the Gentiles obedient, by word and deed,
bsb_text: I will not presume to speak of anything except what Christ has accomplished through me in leading the Gentiles to obedience by word and deed,
aov_text: Want ek sal nie waag om iets te sê van dinge wat Christus nie deur my gewerk het nie — om die heidene tot gehoorsaamheid te bring, met woord en daad,

kjv_text: Through mighty signs and wonders, by the power of the Spirit of God; so that from Jerusalem, and round about unto Illyricum, I have fully preached the gospel of Christ.
bsb_text: by the power of signs and wonders, and by the power of the Spirit of God. So from Jerusalem all the way around to Illyricum, I have fully proclaimed the gospel of Christ.
aov_text: deur die krag van tekens en wonders, deur die krag van die Gees van God, sodat ek die evangelieverkondiging van Christus volbring het van Jerusalem af en rondom tot by Illírikum;

kjv_text: Yea, so have I strived to preach the gospel, not where Christ was named, lest I should build upon another man's foundation:
bsb_text: In this way I have aspired to preach the gospel where Christ was not known, so that I would not be building on someone else’s foundation.
aov_text: maar só, dat ek my eer daarin gestel het om die evangelie te verkondig, nie waar Christus alreeds bekend was nie — om nie op die fondament van ’n ander te bou nie  —

kjv_text: But as it is written, To whom he was not spoken of, they shall see: and they that have not heard shall understand.
bsb_text: Rather, as it is written: “Those who were not told about Him will see, and those who have not heard will understand.”
aov_text: maar soos geskrywe is: Hulle aan wie niks van Hom vertel is nie, sal dit sien; en hulle wat nie gehoor het nie, sal dit verstaan.

kjv_text: For which cause also I have been much hindered from coming to you.
bsb_text: That is why I have often been hindered from coming to you.
aov_text: Daarom is ek ook elke keer verhinder om na julle te kom.

kjv_text: But now having no more place in these parts, and having a great desire these many years to come unto you;
bsb_text: But now that there are no further opportunities for me in these regions, and since I have longed for many years to visit you,
aov_text: Maar nou dat ek geen plek meer het in hierdie streke nie en al baie jare die begeerte het om na julle te kom,

kjv_text: Whensoever I take my journey into Spain, I will come to you: for I trust to see you in my journey, and to be brought on my way thitherward by you, if first I be somewhat filled with your company.
bsb_text: I hope to see you on my way to Spain. And after I have enjoyed your company for a while, you can equip me for my journey.
aov_text: sal ek na julle kom wanneer ek na Spanje reis; want ek hoop om julle op my deurreis te sien en deur julle daarheen voortgehelp te word, as ek eers ’n tyd lank van julle geniet het.

kjv_text: But now I go unto Jerusalem to minister unto the saints.
