bsb_text: Now, however, I am on my way to Jerusalem to serve the saints there.
aov_text: Maar nou reis ek na Jerusalem in diens van die heiliges.

kjv_text: For it hath pleased them of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor saints which are at Jerusalem.
bsb_text: For Macedonia and Achaia were pleased to make a contribution for the poor among the saints in Jerusalem.
aov_text: Want Macedónië en Acháje het dit goedgevind om iets by te dra vir die armes onder die heiliges in Jerusalem.

kjv_text: It hath pleased them verily; and their debtors they are. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, their duty is also to minister unto them in carnal things.
bsb_text: They were pleased to do it, and indeed they owe it to them. For if the Gentiles have shared in their spiritual blessings, they are obligated to minister to them with material blessings.
aov_text: Hulle het dit goedgevind, sê ek, en hulle is ook hul skuldenaars; want as die heidene deel gekry het aan hulle geestelike voorregte, is hulle ook verskuldig om hulle met stoflike goedere te dien.

kjv_text: When therefore I have performed this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will come by you into Spain.
bsb_text: So after I have completed this service and have safely delivered this bounty to them, I will set off to Spain by way of you.
aov_text: As ek dit volbring het en vir hulle hierdie vrug veilig oorgebring het, sal ek by julle langs na Spanje afreis.

kjv_text: And I am sure that, when I come unto you, I shall come in the fulness of the blessing of the gospel of Christ.
bsb_text: I know that when I come to you, I will come in the fullness of the blessing of Christ.
aov_text: En ek weet dat as ek na julle kom, ek met die volle seën van die evangelie van Christus sal kom.

kjv_text: Now I beseech you, brethren, for the Lord Jesus Christ's sake, and for the love of the Spirit, that ye strive together with me in your prayers to God for me;
bsb_text: Now I urge you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit, to join me in my struggle by praying to God for me.
aov_text: Maar ek vermaan julle, broeders, by onse Here Jesus Christus en by die liefde van die Gees, om saam met my in die gebede te stry vir my by God,

kjv_text: That I may be delivered from them that do not believe in Judaea; and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be accepted of the saints;
bsb_text: Pray that I may be delivered from the unbelievers in Judea, and that my service in Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints there,
aov_text: dat ek verlos mag word van die ongehoorsame mense in Judéa en dat my diensbetoning aan Jerusalem aanneemlik mag wees vir die heiliges,

kjv_text: That I may come unto you with joy by the will of God, and may with you be refreshed.
bsb_text: so that by God’s will I may come to you with joy and together with you be refreshed.
aov_text: sodat ek met blydskap deur die wil van God by julle kan kom en my saam met julle kan verkwik.

kjv_text: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
bsb_text: The God of peace be with all of you. Amen.
aov_text: En die God van vrede sy met julle almal! Amen.

kjv_text: I commend unto you Phebe our sister, which is a servant of the church which is at Cenchrea:
bsb_text: I commend to you our sister Phoebe, a servant of the church in Cenchrea.
aov_text: EK beveel by julle aan ons suster Fébé, wat ’n dienares is van die gemeente in Kenchréë,

kjv_text: That ye receive her in the Lord, as becometh saints, and that ye assist her in whatsoever business she hath need of you: for she hath been a succourer of many, and of myself also.
bsb_text: Welcome her in the Lord in a manner worthy of the saints, and assist her with anything she may need from you. For she has been a great help to many people, including me.
aov_text: dat julle haar ontvang in die Here, soos dit die heiliges betaam, en haar bystaan in elke saak waarin sy julle nodig mag hê. Want sy was vir baie ’n beskermster en ook vir my.

kjv_text: Greet Priscilla and Aquila my helpers in Christ Jesus:
bsb_text: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,
aov_text: Groet Priscílla en Áquila, my medewerkers in Christus Jesus,

kjv_text: Who have for my life laid down their own necks: unto whom not only I give thanks, but also all the churches of the Gentiles.
bsb_text: who have risked their lives for me. Not only I but all the churches of the Gentiles are grateful to them.
aov_text: wat vir my hulle lewe gewaag het; nie ek alleen dank hulle nie, maar ook al die gemeentes van die heidene.

kjv_text: Likewise greet the church that is in their house. Salute my well-beloved Epaenetus, who is the firstfruits of Achaia unto Christ.
bsb_text: Greet also the church that meets at their house. Greet my beloved Epenetus, who was the first convert to Christ in the province of Asia.
aov_text: Groet ook die gemeente by hulle aan huis. Groet Epénetus, my geliefde, wat die eersteling van Acháje is vir Christus.

kjv_text: Greet Mary, who bestowed much labour on us.
bsb_text: Greet Mary, who has worked very hard for you.
aov_text: Groet Maria wat baie vir ons gearbei het.

kjv_text: Salute Andronicus and Junia, my kinsmen, and my fellow-prisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.
bsb_text: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my fellow countrymen and fellow prisoners. They are outstanding among the apostles, and they were in Christ before I was.
aov_text: Groet Andronícus en Júnias, my stamgenote en my medegevangenes, wat in aansien is onder die apostels en reeds voor my in Christus gewees het.

kjv_text: Greet Amplias my beloved in the Lord.
bsb_text: Greet Ampliatus, my beloved in the Lord.
aov_text: Groet Ámplias, my geliefde in die Here.

kjv_text: Salute Urbane, our helper in Christ, and Stachys my beloved.
bsb_text: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and my beloved Stachys.
aov_text: Groet Urbánus, ons medewerker in Christus, en Stáchis, my geliefde.

kjv_text: Salute Apelles approved in Christ. Salute them which are of Aristobulus' household.
bsb_text: Greet Apelles, who is approved in Christ. Greet those who belong to the household of Aristobulus.
aov_text: Groet Apélles, die beproefde in Christus. Groet hulle wat van die huis van Aristobúlus is.

kjv_text: Salute Herodion my kinsman. Greet them that be of the household of Narcissus, which are in the Lord.
bsb_text: Greet Herodion, my fellow countryman. Greet those from the household of Narcissus who are in the Lord.
aov_text: Groet Heródion, my stamgenoot. Groet hulle wat van die huis van Narcíssus is, die wat in die Here is.

kjv_text: Salute Tryphena and Tryphosa, who labour in the Lord. Salute the beloved Persis, which laboured much in the Lord.
bsb_text: Greet Tryphena and Tryphosa, women who have worked hard in the Lord. Greet my beloved Persis, who has worked very hard in the Lord.
aov_text: Groet Triféna en Trifósa, vroue wat in die Here arbei. Groet Pérsis, die geliefde vrou, wat baie in die Here gearbei het.

kjv_text: Salute Rufus chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.
bsb_text: Greet Rufus, chosen in the Lord, and his mother, who has been a mother to me as well.
aov_text: Groet Rufus, die uitverkorene in die Here, en sy moeder en myne.

kjv_text: Salute Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, Patrobas, Hermes, and the brethren which are with them.
bsb_text: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers with them.
aov_text: Groet Asínkritus, Flegon, Hermas, Pátrobas, Hermes en die broeders wat saam met hulle is.

kjv_text: Salute Philologus, and Julia, Nereus, and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints which are with them.
bsb_text: Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas and all the saints with them.
aov_text: Groet Filólogus en Julia, Néreus en sy suster en Olímpas en al die heiliges wat saam met hulle is.

kjv_text: Salute one another with an holy kiss. The churches of Christ salute you.
bsb_text: Greet one another with a holy kiss. All the churches of Christ send you greetings.
aov_text: Groet mekaar met ’n heilige kus. Die gemeentes van Christus groet julle.

kjv_text: Now I beseech you, brethren, mark them which cause divisions and offences contrary to the doctrine which ye have learned; and avoid them.
bsb_text: Now I urge you, brothers, to watch out for those who create divisions and obstacles that are contrary to the teaching you have learned. Turn away from them.
aov_text: En ek vermaan julle, broeders, hou hulle in die oog wat tweedrag en aanstoot veroorsaak teen die leer wat julle geleer het, en vermy hulle.

kjv_text: For they that are such serve not our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by good words and fair speeches deceive the hearts of the simple.
bsb_text: For such people are not serving our Lord Christ, but their own appetites. By smooth talk and flattery they deceive the hearts of the naive.
aov_text: Want sulke mense dien nie onse Here Jesus nie, maar hulle eie buik; en hulle verlei deur hul vriendelike en mooi woorde die harte van die eenvoudiges.

kjv_text: For your obedience is come abroad unto all men. I am glad therefore on your behalf: but yet I would have you wise unto that which is good, and simple concerning evil.
bsb_text: Everyone has heard about your obedience, so I rejoice over you. But I want you to be wise about what is good and innocent about what is evil.
aov_text: Want julle gehoorsaamheid het algemeen bekend geword. Daarom verbly ek my oor julle, en ek wens dat julle wys mag wees teenoor wat goed is, maar onskuldig teenoor wat sleg is.

kjv_text: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
bsb_text: The God of peace will soon crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
aov_text: En die God van vrede sal die Satan spoedig onder julle voete verbrysel. Die genade van onse Here Jesus Christus sy met julle! Amen.

kjv_text: Timotheus my workfellow, and Lucius, and Jason, and Sosipater, my kinsmen, salute you.
bsb_text: Timothy, my fellow worker, sends you greetings, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my fellow countrymen.
aov_text: Timótheüs, my medewerker, groet julle, en Lúcius en Jason en Sosípater, my stamgenote.

kjv_text: I Tertius, who wrote this epistle, salute you in the Lord.
bsb_text: I, Tertius, who wrote down this letter, greet you in the Lord.
aov_text: Ek, Tértius, wat die brief geskryf het, groet julle in die Here.

kjv_text: Gaius mine host, and of the whole church, saluteth you. Erastus the chamberlain of the city saluteth you, and Quartus a brother.
bsb_text: Gaius, who has hosted me and all the church, sends you greetings. Erastus, the city treasurer, sends you greetings, as does our brother Quartus.
aov_text: Gajus, my gasheer en ook van die hele gemeente, groet julle. Erástus, die penningmeester van die stad, en die broeder Quartus groet julle.

kjv_text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
aov_text: Die genade van die Here Jesus Christus sy met julle almal! Amen.

kjv_text: Now to him that is of power to stablish you according to my gospel, and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery, which was kept secret since the world began,
bsb_text: Now to Him who is able to strengthen you by my gospel and by the proclamation of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery concealed for ages past
aov_text: Aan Hom dan wat magtig is om julle te versterk volgens my evangelie en die prediking van Jesus Christus, ooreenkomstig die openbaring van die verborgenheid wat eeue lank verswyg is,

kjv_text: But now is made manifest, and by the scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of the everlasting God, made known to all nations for the obedience of faith:
bsb_text: but now revealed and made known through the writings of the prophets by the command of the eternal God, in order to lead all nations to the obedience that comes from faith—
aov_text: maar nou geopenbaar is en deur die profetiese Skrifte bekend gemaak is onder al die heidene, volgens die bevel van die ewige God, tot gehoorsaamheid van die geloof  —

kjv_text: To God only wise, be glory through Jesus Christ for ever. Amen.
bsb_text: to the only wise God be glory forever through Jesus Christ! Amen.
aov_text: aan die alleenwyse God, aan Hom die heerlikheid deur Jesus Christus tot in ewigheid! Amen.

kjv_text: Paul, called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and Sosthenes our brother,
bsb_text: Paul, called to be an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and our brother Sosthenes,
aov_text: PAULUS, ’n geroepe apostel van Jesus Christus deur die wil van God, en die broeder Sósthenes,

kjv_text: Unto the church of God which is at Corinth, to them that are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called to be saints, with all that in every place call upon the name of Jesus Christ our Lord, both theirs and ours:
bsb_text: To the church of God in Corinth, to those sanctified in Christ Jesus and called to be holy, together with all those everywhere who call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, their Lord and ours:
aov_text: aan die gemeente van God wat in Korinthe is, aan die geheiligdes in Christus Jesus, die geroepe heiligdes, saam met almal wat die Naam van onse Here Jesus Christus in elke plek aanroep, hulle sowel as onse Here:

kjv_text: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
bsb_text: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
aov_text: Genade vir julle en vrede van God onse Vader en die Here Jesus Christus!

kjv_text: I thank my God always on your behalf, for the grace of God which is given you by Jesus Christ;
bsb_text: I always thank my God for you because of the grace He has given you in Christ Jesus.
aov_text: Ek dank my God altyd oor julle vir die genade van God wat aan julle in Christus Jesus gegee is,

kjv_text: That in every thing ye are enriched by him, in all utterance, and in all knowledge;
bsb_text: For in Him you have been enriched in every way, in all speech and all knowledge,
aov_text: dat julle in alle opsigte in Hom ryk gemaak is, in elke woord en alle kennis;

kjv_text: Even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you:
bsb_text: because our testimony about Christ was confirmed in you.
aov_text: soos die getuienis aangaande Christus bevestig is onder julle,

kjv_text: So that ye come behind in no gift; waiting for the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ:
bsb_text: Therefore you do not lack any spiritual gift as you eagerly await the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ.
aov_text: sodat julle in geen enkele genadegawe agterstaan nie, terwyl julle wag op die openbaring van onse Here Jesus Christus,

kjv_text: Who shall also confirm you unto the end, that ye may be blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
bsb_text: He will sustain you to the end, so that you will be blameless on the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
aov_text: wat julle ook sal bevestig tot die einde toe, om in die dag van onse Here Jesus Christus onberispelik te wees.

kjv_text: God is faithful, by whom ye were called unto the fellowship of his Son Jesus Christ our Lord.
bsb_text: God, who has called you into fellowship with His Son Jesus Christ our Lord, is faithful.
aov_text: God is getrou, deur wie julle geroep is tot die gemeenskap met sy Seun Jesus Christus, onse Here.

kjv_text: Now I beseech you, brethren, by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you; but that ye be perfectly joined together in the same mind and in the same judgment.
bsb_text: I appeal to you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that all of you agree together, so that there may be no divisions among you and that you may be united in mind and conviction.
aov_text: MAAR ek vermaan julle, broeders, in die Naam van onse Here Jesus Christus, om almal eenstemmig te wees, en dat daar geen skeuringe onder julle moet wees nie, maar dat julle verenig moet wees in dieselfde gesindheid en in dieselfde mening.

kjv_text: For it hath been declared unto me of you, my brethren, by them which are of the house of Chloe, that there are contentions among you.
bsb_text: My brothers, some from Chloe’s household have informed me that there are quarrels among you.
aov_text: Want dit is aan my deur die huisgenote van Chloë bekend gemaak aangaande julle, my broeders, dat daar twiste onder julle is.

kjv_text: Now this I say, that every one of you saith, I am of Paul; and I of Apollos; and I of Cephas; and I of Christ.
bsb_text: What I mean is this: Individuals among you are saying, “I follow Paul,” “I follow Apollos,” “I follow Cephas,” or “I follow Christ.”
aov_text: Ek bedoel dit, dat elkeen van julle sê: Ek is van Paulus, en ek van Apollos, en ek van Céfas, en ek van Christus.

kjv_text: Is Christ divided? was Paul crucified for you? or were ye baptized in the name of Paul?
bsb_text: Is Christ divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Were you baptized into the name of Paul?
aov_text: Is Christus verdeel? Is Paulus miskien vir julle gekruisig? Of is julle in die naam van Paulus gedoop?

kjv_text: I thank God that I baptized none of you, but Crispus and Gaius;
bsb_text: I thank God that I did not baptize any of you except Crispus and Gaius,
aov_text: Ek dank God dat ek niemand van julle gedoop het nie, behalwe Crispus en Gajus,

kjv_text: Lest any should say that I had baptized in mine own name.
bsb_text: so no one can say that you were baptized into my name.
aov_text: sodat niemand kan sê dat ek in my naam gedoop het nie.

kjv_text: And I baptized also the household of Stephanas: besides, I know not whether I baptized any other.
bsb_text: Yes, I also baptized the household of Stephanas; beyond that I do not remember if I baptized anyone else.
aov_text: Ek het ook nog die huisgesin van Stéfanas gedoop. Verder weet ek nie of ek iemand anders gedoop het nie.

kjv_text: For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the gospel: not with wisdom of words, lest the cross of Christ should be made of none effect.
bsb_text: For Christ did not send me to baptize, but to preach the gospel, not with words of wisdom, lest the cross of Christ be emptied of its power.
aov_text: WANT Christus het my nie gestuur om te doop nie, maar om die evangelie te verkondig, nie met wysheid van woorde nie, sodat die kruis van Christus nie verydel mag word nie.

kjv_text: For the preaching of the cross is to them that perish foolishness; but unto us which are saved it is the power of God.
bsb_text: For the message of the cross is foolishness to those who are perishing, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.
aov_text: Want die woord van die kruis is wel dwaasheid vir die wat verlore gaan, maar vir ons wat gered word, is dit die krag van God;

kjv_text: For it is written, I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, and will bring to nothing the understanding of the prudent.
bsb_text: For it is written: “I will destroy the wisdom of the wise; the intelligence of the intelligent I will frustrate.”
aov_text: want daar is geskrywe: Ek sal die wysheid van die wyse mense vernietig en die verstand van die verstandige mense tot niet maak.

kjv_text: Where is the wise? where is the scribe? where is the disputer of this world? hath not God made foolish the wisdom of this world?
bsb_text: Where is the wise man? Where is the scribe? Where is the philosopher of this age? Has not God made foolish the wisdom of the world?
aov_text: Waar bly die wyse? Waar bly die skrifgeleerde? Waar die redetwister van hierdie eeu? Het God nie die wysheid van hierdie wêreld dwaas gemaak nie?

kjv_text: For after that in the wisdom of God the world by wisdom knew not God, it pleased God by the foolishness of preaching to save them that believe.
bsb_text: For since in the wisdom of God the world through its wisdom did not know Him, God was pleased through the foolishness of what was preached to save those who believe.
aov_text: Want aangesien in die wysheid van God die wêreld deur die wysheid God nie geken het nie, het dit God behaag om deur die dwaasheid van die prediking die wat glo, te red;

kjv_text: For the Jews require a sign, and the Greeks seek after wisdom:
bsb_text: Jews demand signs and Greeks search for wisdom,
aov_text: want die Jode vra ’n teken en die Grieke soek wysheid,

kjv_text: But we preach Christ crucified, unto the Jews a stumblingblock, and unto the Greeks foolishness;
bsb_text: but we preach Christ crucified, a stumbling block to Jews and foolishness to Gentiles,
aov_text: maar ons verkondig Christus wat gekruisig is, ’n struikelblok vir die Jode en dwaasheid vir die Grieke;

kjv_text: But unto them which are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ the power of God, and the wisdom of God.
bsb_text: but to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ the power of God and the wisdom of God.
aov_text: maar vir die wat geroep is, Jode sowel as Grieke: Christus, die krag van God en die wysheid van God.

kjv_text: Because the foolishness of God is wiser than men; and the weakness of God is stronger than men.
bsb_text: For the foolishness of God is wiser than man’s wisdom, and the weakness of God is stronger than man’s strength.
aov_text: Want wat dwaas is by God, is wyser as die mense; en wat swak is by God, is sterker as die mense.

kjv_text: For ye see your calling, brethren, how that not many wise men after the flesh, not many mighty, not many noble, are called:
bsb_text: Brothers, consider the time of your calling: Not many of you were wise by human standards; not many were powerful; not many were of noble birth.
aov_text: Want let op julle roeping, broeders: julle is nie baie wyse na die vlees nie, nie baie magtiges, nie baie edeles nie;

kjv_text: But God hath chosen the foolish things of the world to confound the wise; and God hath chosen the weak things of the world to confound the things which are mighty;
bsb_text: But God chose the foolish things of the world to shame the wise; God chose the weak things of the world to shame the strong.
aov_text: maar maar wat dwaas is by die wêreld, het God uitverkies om die wyse te beskaam; en wat swak is by die wêreld, het God uitverkies om wat sterk is, te beskaam;

kjv_text: And base things of the world, and things which are despised, hath God chosen, yea, and things which are not, to bring to nought things that are:
bsb_text: He chose the lowly and despised things of the world, and the things that are not, to nullify the things that are,
aov_text: en wat onedel is by die wêreld en wat verag is, het God uitverkies, en wat niks is nie, om wat iets is, tot niet te maak,

kjv_text: That no flesh should glory in his presence.
bsb_text: so that no one may boast in His presence.
aov_text: sodat geen vlees voor Hom sou roem nie.

kjv_text: But of him are ye in Christ Jesus, who of God is made unto us wisdom, and righteousness, and sanctification, and redemption:
bsb_text: It is because of Him that you are in Christ Jesus, who has become for us wisdom from God: our righteousness, holiness, and redemption.
aov_text: Maar deur Hom is julle in Christus Jesus, wat vir ons geword het wysheid uit God en geregtigheid en heiligmaking en verlossing.

kjv_text: That, according as it is written, He that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.
bsb_text: Therefore, as it is written: “Let him who boasts boast in the Lord.”
aov_text: Daarom, soos geskrywe is: Die wat roem, moet in die Here roem.

kjv_text: And I, brethren, when I came to you, came not with excellency of speech or of wisdom, declaring unto you the testimony of God.
bsb_text: When I came to you, brothers, I did not come with eloquence or wisdom as I proclaimed to you the testimony about God.
aov_text: EN toe ek by julle gekom het, broeders, het ek nie aan julle die getuienis van God kom verkondig met voortreflikheid van woorde of van wysheid nie,

kjv_text: For I determined not to know any thing among you, save Jesus Christ, and him crucified.
bsb_text: For I resolved to know nothing while I was with you except Jesus Christ and Him crucified.
aov_text: want ek het my voorgeneem om niks anders onder julle te weet nie as Jesus Christus, en Hom as gekruisigde.

kjv_text: And I was with you in weakness, and in fear, and in much trembling.
bsb_text: I came to you in weakness and fear, and with much trembling.
aov_text: Ek was ook by julle in swakheid en in vrees en in veel bewing;

kjv_text: And my speech and my preaching was not with enticing words of man's wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power:
bsb_text: My message and my preaching were not with persuasive words of wisdom, but with a demonstration of the Spirit’s power,
aov_text: en my rede en my prediking was nie in oorredende woorde van menslike wysheid nie, maar in die betoning van gees en krag,

kjv_text: That your faith should not stand in the wisdom of men, but in the power of God.
bsb_text: so that your faith would not rest on men’s wisdom, but on God’s power.
aov_text: sodat julle geloof nie in wysheid van mense sou bestaan nie, maar in die krag van God.

kjv_text: Howbeit we speak wisdom among them that are perfect: yet not the wisdom of this world, nor of the princes of this world, that come to nought:
bsb_text: Among the mature, however, we speak a message of wisdom—but not the wisdom of this age or of the rulers of this age, who are coming to nothing.
aov_text: Tog spreek ons wysheid onder die volwassenes, maar ’n wysheid nie van hierdie wêreld, of van hierdie wêreld se heersers, wat vergaan nie.

kjv_text: But we speak the wisdom of God in a mystery, even the hidden wisdom, which God ordained before the world unto our glory:
bsb_text: No, we speak of the mysterious and hidden wisdom of God, which He destined for our glory before time began.
aov_text: Maar ons spreek die wysheid van God, wat bestaan in verborgenheid wat bedek was en wat God van ewigheid af voorbeskik het tot ons heerlikheid,

kjv_text: Which none of the princes of this world knew: for had they known it, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory.
bsb_text: None of the rulers of this age understood it. For if they had, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory.
aov_text: wat niemand van die heersers van hierdie wêreld geken het nie — want as hulle dit geken het, sou hulle die Here van die heerlikheid nie gekruisig het nie  —

kjv_text: But as it is written, Eye hath not seen, nor ear heard, neither have entered into the heart of man, the things which God hath prepared for them that love him.
bsb_text: Rather, as it is written: “No eye has seen, no ear has heard, no heart has imagined, what God has prepared for those who love Him.”
aov_text: maar soos geskrywe is: Wat die oog nie gesien en die oor nie gehoor en in die hart van ’n mens nie opgekom het nie, wat God berei het vir die wat Hom liefhet.

kjv_text: But God hath revealed them unto us by his Spirit: for the Spirit searcheth all things, yea, the deep things of God.
bsb_text: But God has revealed it to us by the Spirit. The Spirit searches all things, even the deep things of God.
aov_text: Maar God het dit aan ons deur sy Gees geopenbaar, want die Gees ondersoek alle dinge, ook die dieptes van God.

kjv_text: For what man knoweth the things of a man, save the spirit of man which is in him? even so the things of God knoweth no man, but the Spirit of God.
bsb_text: For who among men knows the thoughts of man except his own spirit within him? So too, no one knows the thoughts of God except the Spirit of God.
aov_text: Want wie van die mense weet wat in ’n mens is, behalwe die gees van die mens wat in hom is? So weet ook niemand wat in God is nie, behalwe die Gees van God.

kjv_text: Now we have received, not the spirit of the world, but the spirit which is of God; that we might know the things that are freely given to us of God.
bsb_text: We have not received the spirit of the world, but the Spirit who is from God, that we may understand what God has freely given us.
aov_text: Ons het ewenwel nie die gees van die wêreld ontvang nie, maar die Gees wat uit God is, sodat ons kan weet wat God ons uit genade geskenk het.

kjv_text: Which things also we speak, not in the words which man's wisdom teacheth, but which the Holy Ghost teacheth; comparing spiritual things with spiritual.
bsb_text: And this is what we speak, not in words taught us by human wisdom, but in words taught by the Spirit, expressing spiritual truths in spiritual words.
aov_text: Daarvan spreek ons ook, nie met woorde wat die menslike wysheid leer nie, maar met dié wat die Heilige Gees leer, sodat ons geestelike dinge met geestelike vergelyk.

kjv_text: But the natural man receiveth not the things of the Spirit of God: for they are foolishness unto him: neither can he know them, because they are spiritually discerned.
bsb_text: The natural man does not accept the things that come from the Spirit of God. For they are foolishness to him, and he cannot understand them, because they are spiritually discerned.
aov_text: Maar die natuurlike mens neem die dinge van die Gees van God nie aan nie; want dit is vir hom dwaasheid, en hy kan dit nie verstaan nie, omdat dit geestelik beoordeel word.

kjv_text: But he that is spiritual judgeth all things, yet he himself is judged of no man.
bsb_text: The spiritual man judges all things, but he himself is not subject to anyone’s judgment.
aov_text: Maar die geestelike mens beoordeel wel alle dinge; self egter word hy deur niemand beoordeel nie.

kjv_text: For who hath known the mind of the Lord, that he may instruct him? But we have the mind of Christ.
bsb_text: “For who has known the mind of the Lord, so as to instruct Him?” But we have the mind of Christ.
aov_text: Want wie het die sin van die Here geken, dat hy Hom sou kan onderrig? Maar ons het die sin van Christus.

kjv_text: And I, brethren, could not speak unto you as unto spiritual, but as unto carnal, even as unto babes in Christ.
bsb_text: Brothers, I could not address you as spiritual, but as worldly—as infants in Christ.
aov_text: EN ek, broeders, kon met julle nie spreek soos met geestelike mense nie, maar soos met vleeslike, soos met klein kinders in Christus.

kjv_text: I have fed you with milk, and not with meat: for hitherto ye were not able to bear it, neither yet now are ye able.
bsb_text: I gave you milk, not solid food, for you were not yet ready for solid food. In fact, you are still not ready,
aov_text: Ek het julle met melk gevoed, nie met vaste spys nie, want julle was nog nie daartoe in staat nie, en julle is nou nog nie daartoe in staat nie,

kjv_text: For ye are yet carnal: for whereas there is among you envying, and strife, and divisions, are ye not carnal, and walk as men?
bsb_text: for you are still worldly. For since there is jealousy and dissension among you, are you not worldly? Are you not walking in the way of man?
aov_text: omdat julle nog vleeslik is; want aangesien daar onder julle jaloersheid en twis en tweedrag is, is julle nie vleeslik nie en wandel julle nie na die mens nie?

kjv_text: For while one saith, I am of Paul; and another, I am of Apollos; are ye not carnal?
bsb_text: For when one of you says, “I follow Paul,” and another, “I follow Apollos,” are you not mere men?
aov_text: Want as die een sê: Ek is van Paulus; en die ander: Ek van Apollos — is julle nie vleeslik nie?

kjv_text: Who then is Paul, and who is Apollos, but ministers by whom ye believed, even as the Lord gave to every man?
bsb_text: What then is Apollos? And what is Paul? They are servants through whom you believed, as the Lord has assigned to each his role.
aov_text: Wie is Paulus dan, en wie Apollos anders as dienaars deur wie julle gelowig geword het? En dit soos die Here aan elkeen gegee het.

kjv_text: I have planted, Apollos watered; but God gave the increase.
bsb_text: I planted the seed and Apollos watered it, but God made it grow.
aov_text: Ek het geplant, Apollos het natgemaak, maar God het laat groei.

kjv_text: So then neither is he that planteth any thing, neither he that watereth; but God that giveth the increase.
bsb_text: So neither he who plants nor he who waters is anything, but only God, who makes things grow.
aov_text: So is dan hy wat plant of hy wat natmaak, niks nie, maar God wat laat groei.

kjv_text: Now he that planteth and he that watereth are one: and every man shall receive his own reward according to his own labour.
bsb_text: He who plants and he who waters are one in purpose, and each will be rewarded according to his own labor.
aov_text: Maar hy wat plant en hy wat natmaak, is een, maar elkeen sal sy eie loon volgens sy eie arbeid ontvang.

kjv_text: For we are labourers together with God: ye are God's husbandry, ye are God's building.
bsb_text: For we are God’s fellow workers; you are God’s field, God’s building.
aov_text: WANT ons is medewerkers van God; die akker van God, die gebou van God is julle.

kjv_text: According to the grace of God which is given unto me, as a wise masterbuilder, I have laid the foundation, and another buildeth thereon. But let every man take heed how he buildeth thereupon.
bsb_text: By the grace God has given me, I laid a foundation as an expert builder, and someone else is building on it. But each one must be careful how he builds.
aov_text: Volgens die genade van God wat aan my gegee is, het ek soos ’n bekwame boumeester die fondament gelê, en ’n ander bou daarop; maar elkeen moet oppas hoe hy daarop bou.

kjv_text: For other foundation can no man lay than that is laid, which is Jesus Christ.
bsb_text: For no one can lay a foundation other than the one already laid, which is Jesus Christ.
aov_text: Want niemand kan ’n ander fondament lê as wat daar gelê is nie, dit is Jesus Christus.

kjv_text: Now if any man build upon this foundation gold, silver, precious stones, wood, hay, stubble;
bsb_text: If anyone builds on this foundation using gold, silver, precious stones, wood, hay, or straw,
aov_text: En as iemand op dié fondament bou goud, silwer, kosbare stene, hout, hooi, stoppels  —

kjv_text: Every man's work shall be made manifest: for the day shall declare it, because it shall be revealed by fire; and the fire shall try every man's work of what sort it is.
bsb_text: his workmanship will be evident, because the Day will bring it to light. It will be revealed with fire, and the fire will prove the quality of each man’s work.
aov_text: elkeen se werk sal aan die lig kom, want die dag sal dit aanwys, omdat dit deur vuur openbaar gemaak word; en die vuur sal elkeen se werk op die proef stel, hoedanig dit is.

kjv_text: If any man's work abide which he hath built thereupon, he shall receive a reward.
bsb_text: If what he has built survives, he will receive a reward.
aov_text: As iemand se werk bly staan wat hy daarop gebou het, sal hy loon ontvang;

kjv_text: If any man's work shall be burned, he shall suffer loss: but he himself shall be saved; yet so as by fire.
bsb_text: If it is burned up, he will suffer loss. He himself will be saved, but only as if through the flames.
aov_text: as iemand se werk verbrand word, sal hy skade ly; alhoewel hy self gered sal word, maar soos deur vuur heen.

kjv_text: Know ye not that ye are the temple of God, and that the Spirit of God dwelleth in you?
bsb_text: Do you not know that you yourselves are God’s temple, and that God’s Spirit dwells in you?
aov_text: Weet julle nie dat julle ’n tempel van God is en die Gees van God in julle woon nie?

kjv_text: If any man defile the temple of God, him shall God destroy; for the temple of God is holy, which temple ye are.
bsb_text: If anyone destroys God’s temple, God will destroy him; for God’s temple is holy, and you are that temple.
aov_text: As iemand die tempel van God skend, sal God hom skend; want die tempel van God is heilig, en dit is julle.

kjv_text: Let no man deceive himself. If any man among you seemeth to be wise in this world, let him become a fool, that he may be wise.
bsb_text: Let no one deceive himself. If any of you thinks he is wise in this age, he should become a fool, so that he may become wise.
aov_text: Laat niemand homself mislei nie: as iemand meen dat hy wys is onder julle in hierdie wêreld, laat hom dwaas word, sodat hy wys kan word;

kjv_text: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, He taketh the wise in their own craftiness.
bsb_text: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness in God’s sight. As it is written: “He catches the wise in their craftiness.”
aov_text: want die wysheid van hierdie wêreld is dwaasheid by God; want daar is geskrywe: Hy wat die wyse mense in hulle listigheid vang;

kjv_text: And again, The Lord knoweth the thoughts of the wise, that they are vain.
bsb_text: And again, “The Lord knows that the thoughts of the wise are futile.”
aov_text: en verder: Die Here ken die gedagtes van die wyse mense, dat dit nietig is.

kjv_text: Therefore let no man glory in men. For all things are yours;
bsb_text: Therefore, stop boasting in men. All things are yours,
aov_text: Laat niemand dan op mense roem nie, want alles behoort aan julle;

kjv_text: Whether Paul, or Apollos, or Cephas, or the world, or life, or death, or things present, or things to come; all are yours;
bsb_text: whether Paul or Apollos or Cephas or the world or life or death or the present or the future. All of them belong to you,
aov_text: of dit Paulus is of Apollos of Céfas of die wêreld of lewe of dood of teenswoordige of toekomstige dinge — alles behoort aan julle;

kjv_text: And ye are Christ's; and Christ is God's.
bsb_text: and you belong to Christ, and Christ belongs to God.
aov_text: maar julle behoort aan Christus, en Christus aan God.

kjv_text: Let a man so account of us, as of the ministers of Christ, and stewards of the mysteries of God.
bsb_text: So then, men ought to regard us as servants of Christ and stewards of the mysteries of God.
aov_text: SO moet ons dan beskou word as dienaars van Christus en bedienaars van die verborgenhede van God.

kjv_text: Moreover it is required in stewards, that a man be found faithful.
bsb_text: Now it is required of stewards that they be found faithful.
aov_text: En verder word van die bedienaars vereis dat hulle getrou bevind moet word.

kjv_text: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged of you, or of man's judgment: yea, I judge not mine own self.
bsb_text: I care very little, however, if I am judged by you or by any human court. In fact, I do not even judge myself.
aov_text: Maar vir my beteken dit baie min of ek deur julle of deur ’n menslike regbank beoordeel word; ja, ek beoordeel myself nie eens nie,

kjv_text: For I know nothing by myself; yet am I not hereby justified: but he that judgeth me is the Lord.
bsb_text: My conscience is clear, but that does not vindicate me. It is the Lord who judges me.
aov_text: want ek is my van geen ding bewus nie. Daardeur is ek egter nie geregverdig nie; maar Hy wat my beoordeel, is die Here.

kjv_text: Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord come, who both will bring to light the hidden things of darkness, and will make manifest the counsels of the hearts: and then shall every man have praise of God.
bsb_text: Therefore judge nothing before the appointed time; wait until the Lord comes. He will bring to light what is hidden in darkness and will expose the motives of men’s hearts. At that time each will receive his praise from God.
aov_text: Daarom moet julle nie voor die tyd oordeel, voordat die Here kom nie, wat die verborge dinge van die duisternis in die lig sal bring en die bedoelinge van die harte openbaar sal maak; en dan sal elkeen lof van God ontvang.

kjv_text: And these things, brethren, I have in a figure transferred to myself and to Apollos for your sakes; that ye might learn in us not to think of men above that which is written, that no one of you be puffed up for one against another.
bsb_text: Brothers, I have applied these things to myself and Apollos for your benefit, so that you may learn from us not to go beyond what is written. Then you will not take pride in one man over another.
aov_text: HIERDIE dinge, broeders, het ek op myself en Apollos toegepas om julle ontwil, dat julle aan ons kan leer om nie te dink bo wat geskrywe is nie, sodat julle nie die een ter wille van die ander opgeblase sou wees teen ’n derde nie.

kjv_text: For who maketh thee to differ from another? and what hast thou that thou didst not receive? now if thou didst receive it, why dost thou glory, as if thou hadst not received it?
bsb_text: For who makes you so superior? What do you have that you did not receive? And if you did receive it, why do you boast as though you did not?
aov_text: Want wie trek jou voor? En wat het jy wat jy nie ontvang het nie? En as jy dit dan ontvang het, waarom roem jy asof jy dit nie ontvang het nie?

kjv_text: Now ye are full, now ye are rich, ye have reigned as kings without us: and I would to God ye did reign, that we also might reign with you.
bsb_text: Already you have all you want. Already you have become rich. Without us, you have become kings. How I wish you really were kings, so that we might be kings with you!
aov_text: Alreeds is julle versadig, alreeds het julle ryk geword, sonder ons het julle geheers. Het julle tog maar geheers, sodat ons saam met julle kon heers!

kjv_text: For I think that God hath set forth us the apostles last, as it were appointed to death: for we are made a spectacle unto the world, and to angels, and to men.
bsb_text: For it seems to me that God has displayed us apostles at the end of the procession, like prisoners appointed for death. We have become a spectacle to the whole world, to angels as well as to men.
aov_text: Want dit lyk vir my dat God ons apostels die laaste plek aangewys het as tot die dood veroordeel; want ons het ’n skouspel geword vir die wêreld, vir die engele sowel as vir die mense.

kjv_text: We are fools for Christ's sake, but ye are wise in Christ; we are weak, but ye are strong; ye are honourable, but we are despised.
bsb_text: We are fools for Christ, but you are wise in Christ. We are weak, but you are strong. You are honored, but we are dishonored.
aov_text: Ons is dwaas ter wille van Christus, maar julle is verstandig in Christus. Ons is swak, maar julle sterk. Julle is in aansien, maar ons in oneer.

kjv_text: Even unto this present hour we both hunger, and thirst, and are naked, and are buffeted, and have no certain dwellingplace;
bsb_text: To this very hour we are hungry and thirsty, we are poorly clothed, we are brutally treated, we are homeless.
aov_text: Tot op hierdie uur ly ons honger en dors, is ons naak en word geslaan, en swerwe ons rond,

kjv_text: And labour, working with our own hands: being reviled, we bless; being persecuted, we suffer it:
bsb_text: We work hard with our own hands. When we are vilified, we bless; when we are persecuted, we endure it;
aov_text: en swoeg ons deur met ons eie hande te werk. Word ons uitgeskel, ons seën; word ons vervolg, ons verdra dit;

kjv_text: Being defamed, we intreat: we are made as the filth of the world, and are the offscouring of all things unto this day.
bsb_text: when we are slandered, we answer gently. Up to this moment we have become the scum of the earth, the refuse of the world.
aov_text: word ons belaster, ons troos;  soos uitvaagsels van die wêreld het ons geword, die afskraapsel van almal tot nou toe.

kjv_text: I write not these things to shame you, but as my beloved sons I warn you.
bsb_text: I am not writing this to shame you, but to warn you as my beloved children.
aov_text: Ek skrywe hierdie dinge nie om julle te beskaam nie, maar ek vermaan julle as my geliefde kinders.

kjv_text: For though ye have ten thousand instructors in Christ, yet have ye not many fathers: for in Christ Jesus I have begotten you through the gospel.
bsb_text: Even if you have ten thousand guardians in Christ, you do not have many fathers; for in Christ Jesus I became your father through the gospel.
aov_text: Want al sou julle tienduisend tugmeesters in Christus hê, dan het julle tog nie baie vaders nie; want in Christus Jesus het ek julle vader geword deur die evangelie.

kjv_text: Wherefore I beseech you, be ye followers of me.
bsb_text: Therefore I urge you to imitate me.
aov_text: Ek vermaan julle dan, word my navolgers.

kjv_text: For this cause have I sent unto you Timotheus, who is my beloved son, and faithful in the Lord, who shall bring you into remembrance of my ways which be in Christ, as I teach every where in every church.
bsb_text: That is why I have sent you Timothy, my beloved and faithful child in the Lord. He will remind you of my way of life in Christ Jesus, which is exactly what I teach everywhere in every church.
aov_text: Daarom het ek Timótheüs, wat my geliefde en getroue seun in die Here is, na julle gestuur. Hy sal julle herinner aan my handelwyse in Christus, soos ek oral in elke gemeente leer.

kjv_text: Now some are puffed up, as though I would not come to you.
bsb_text: Some of you have become arrogant, as if I were not coming to you.
aov_text: Maar sommige het opgeblase geword, asof ek nie na julle sou kom nie;

kjv_text: But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord will, and will know, not the speech of them which are puffed up, but the power.
bsb_text: But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord is willing, and then I will find out not only what these arrogant people are saying, but what power they have.
aov_text: tog sal ek gou na julle kom, as die Here wil, en dan sal ek te wete kom, nie die woorde van die wat opgeblase is nie, maar hulle krag;

kjv_text: For the kingdom of God is not in word, but in power.
bsb_text: For the kingdom of God is not a matter of talk but of power.
aov_text: want die koninkryk van God bestaan nie in woorde nie, maar in krag.

kjv_text: What will ye? shall I come unto you with a rod, or in love, and in the spirit of meekness?
bsb_text: Which do you prefer? Shall I come to you with a rod, or in love and with a gentle spirit?
aov_text: Wat wil julle hê? Moet ek met die roede na julle kom of met liefde en in die gees van sagmoedigheid?

kjv_text: It is reported commonly that there is fornication among you, and such fornication as is not so much as named among the Gentiles, that one should have his father's wife.
bsb_text: It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and of a kind that is intolerable even among pagans: A man has his father’s wife.
aov_text: N MENS hoor waarlik van hoerery onder julle, en hoerery van so ’n aard as wat selfs onder die heidene nie bekend is nie: dat iemand die vrou van sy vader het.

kjv_text: And ye are puffed up, and have not rather mourned, that he that hath done this deed might be taken away from among you.
bsb_text: And you are proud! Shouldn’t you rather have been stricken with grief and have removed from your fellowship the man who did this?
aov_text: En tog is julle opgeblase in plaas dat julle liewer getreur het, sodat hy wat hierdie daad gedoen het, kan verwyder word onder julle uit.

kjv_text: For I verily, as absent in body, but present in spirit, have judged already, as though I were present, concerning him that hath so done this deed,
bsb_text: Although I am absent from you in body, I am present with you in spirit, and I have already pronounced judgment on the one who did this, just as if I were present.
aov_text: Want wat my betref, het ek, liggaamlik afwesig maar in die gees teenwoordig, alreeds besluit asof ek teenwoordig was, om hom wat so iets gedoen het,

kjv_text: In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, when ye are gathered together, and my spirit, with the power of our Lord Jesus Christ,
bsb_text: When you are assembled in the name of our Lord Jesus and I am with you in spirit, along with the power of the Lord Jesus,
aov_text: in die Naam van onse Here Jesus Christus, as julle vergader het en my gees saam met die krag van onse Here Jesus Christus  —

kjv_text: To deliver such an one unto Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus.
bsb_text: hand this man over to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, so that his spirit may be saved on the Day of the Lord.
aov_text: om so iemand aan die Satan oor te lewer tot verderf van die vlees, sodat die gees gered kan word in die dag van die Here Jesus.

kjv_text: Your glorying is not good. Know ye not that a little leaven leaveneth the whole lump?
bsb_text: Your boasting is not good. Do you not know that a little leaven works through the whole batch of dough?
aov_text: Julle roem is nie mooi nie. Weet julle nie dat ’n bietjie suurdeeg die hele deeg suur maak nie?

kjv_text: Purge out therefore the old leaven, that ye may be a new lump, as ye are unleavened. For even Christ our passover is sacrificed for us:
bsb_text: Get rid of the old leaven, that you may be a new unleavened batch, as you really are. For Christ, our Passover lamb, has been sacrificed.
aov_text: Suiwer dan die ou suurdeeg uit, sodat julle ’n nuwe deeg kan wees — soos julle inderdaad ongesuurd is — want ook ons paaslam is vir ons geslag, naamlik Christus.

kjv_text: Therefore let us keep the feast, not with old leaven, neither with the leaven of malice and wickedness; but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.
bsb_text: Therefore let us keep the feast, not with the old bread, leavened with malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and of truth.
aov_text: Laat ons dan feesvier, nie met die ou suurdeeg of met die suurdeeg van ondeug en boosheid nie, maar met die ongesuurde brode van reinheid en waarheid.

kjv_text: I wrote unto you in an epistle not to company with fornicators:
bsb_text: I wrote you in my letter not to associate with sexually immoral people.
aov_text: Ek het julle in my brief geskrywe om nie met hoereerders om te gaan nie  —

kjv_text: Yet not altogether with the fornicators of this world, or with the covetous, or extortioners, or with idolaters; for then must ye needs go out of the world.
bsb_text: I was not including the sexually immoral of this world, or the greedy and swindlers, or idolaters. In that case you would have to leave this world.
aov_text: dit wil sê, nie hoereerders van hierdie wêreld of die gierigaards of rowers of afgodedienaars in die algemeen nie, want dan sou julle uit die wêreld moet uitgaan  —

kjv_text: But now I have written unto you not to keep company, if any man that is called a brother be a fornicator, or covetous, or an idolater, or a railer, or a drunkard, or an extortioner; with such an one no not to eat.
bsb_text: But now I am writing you not to associate with anyone who claims to be a brother but is sexually immoral or greedy, an idolater or a verbal abuser, a drunkard or a swindler. With such a man do not even eat.
aov_text: maar nou skryf ek aan julle om nie om te gaan met iemand wat, al staan hy as ’n broeder bekend, ’n hoereerder is of ’n gierigaard of ’n afgodedienaar of ’n kwaadspreker of ’n dronkaard of ’n rower nie; met so iemand moet julle selfs nie saam eet nie.

kjv_text: For what have I to do to judge them also that are without? do not ye judge them that are within?
bsb_text: What business of mine is it to judge those outside the church? Are you not to judge those inside?
aov_text: Want waarom sou ek ook die wat buite is, oordeel? Oordeel julle nie die wat binne is nie?

kjv_text: But them that are without God judgeth. Therefore put away from among yourselves that wicked person.
bsb_text: God will judge those outside. “Expel the wicked man from among you.”
aov_text: Maar die wat buite is, oordeel God. Verwyder tog dié slegte mens onder julle uit.

kjv_text: Dare any of you, having a matter against another, go to law before the unjust, and not before the saints?
bsb_text: If any of you has a grievance against another, how dare he go to law before the unrighteous instead of before the saints!
aov_text: DURF iemand van julle wat ’n saak teen ’n ander het, gaan reg soek voor die onregverdiges en nie voor die heiliges nie?

kjv_text: Do ye not know that the saints shall judge the world? and if the world shall be judged by you, are ye unworthy to judge the smallest matters?
bsb_text: Do you not know that the saints will judge the world? And if you are to judge the world, are you not competent to judge trivial cases?
aov_text: Weet julle nie dat die heiliges die wêreld sal oordeel nie? En as die wêreld deur julle geoordeel word, is julle dan onbevoeg vir die geringste regsake?

kjv_text: Know ye not that we shall judge angels? how much more things that pertain to this life?
bsb_text: Do you not know that we will judge angels? How much more the things of this life!
aov_text: Weet julle nie dat ons engele sal oordeel nie, hoeveel te meer die alledaagse dinge?

kjv_text: If then ye have judgments of things pertaining to this life, set them to judge who are least esteemed in the church.
bsb_text: So if you need to settle everyday matters, do you appoint as judges those of no standing in the church?
aov_text: As julle dan alledaagse regsake het, moet julle dié persone daaroor laat sit wat in die gemeente die minste geag word.

kjv_text: I speak to your shame. Is it so, that there is not a wise man among you? no, not one that shall be able to judge between his brethren?
bsb_text: I say this to your shame. Is there really no one among you wise enough to arbitrate between his brothers?
aov_text: Ek sê dit tot julle beskaming. Is daar dan nie eens een wyse onder julle, wat uitspraak sal kan doen tussen sy broeders nie?

kjv_text: But brother goeth to law with brother, and that before the unbelievers.
bsb_text: Instead, one brother goes to law against another, and this in front of unbelievers!
aov_text: Maar gaan die een broeder met die ander na die regbank, en dit voor ongelowiges?

kjv_text: Now therefore there is utterly a fault among you, because ye go to law one with another. Why do ye not rather take wrong? why do ye not rather suffer yourselves to be defrauded?
bsb_text: The very fact that you have lawsuits among you means that you are thoroughly defeated already. Why not rather be wronged? Why not rather be cheated?
aov_text: Dan is dit al werklik ’n gebrek onder julle, dat julle regsake met mekaar het. Waarom ly julle nie liewer onreg nie? Waarom laat julle jul nie liewer berowe nie?

kjv_text: Nay, ye do wrong, and defraud, and that your brethren.
bsb_text: Instead, you yourselves cheat and do wrong, even against your own brothers!
aov_text: Maar julle doen onreg en pleeg roof, en dit aan broeders.

kjv_text: Know ye not that the unrighteous shall not inherit the kingdom of God?
bsb_text: Do you not know that the wicked will not inherit the kingdom of God?
aov_text: Of weet julle nie dat die onregverdiges die koninkryk van God nie sal beërwe nie?

kjv_text: Be not deceived: neither fornicators, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor effeminate, nor abusers of themselves with mankind,
bsb_text: Do not be deceived: Neither the sexually immoral, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor men who submit to or perform homosexual acts,
aov_text: Moenie dwaal nie! Geen hoereerders of afgodedienaars of egbrekers of wellustelinge of sodomiete

kjv_text: Nor thieves, nor covetous, nor drunkards, nor revilers, nor extortioners, shall inherit the kingdom of God.
bsb_text: nor thieves, nor the greedy, nor drunkards, nor verbal abusers, nor swindlers, will inherit the kingdom of God.
aov_text: of diewe of gierigaards of dronkaards of kwaadsprekers of rowers sal die koninkryk van God beërwe nie.

kjv_text: And such were some of you: but ye are washed, but ye are sanctified, but ye are justified in the name of the Lord Jesus, and by the Spirit of our God.
bsb_text: And that is what some of you were. But you were washed, you were sanctified, you were justified, in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the Spirit of our God.
aov_text: En dit was sommige van julle; maar julle het jul laat afwas, maar julle is geheilig, maar julle is geregverdig in die Naam van die Here Jesus en deur die Gees van onse God.

kjv_text: All things are lawful unto me, but all things are not expedient: all things are lawful for me, but I will not be brought under the power of any.
bsb_text: “Everything is permissible for me,” but not everything is beneficial. “Everything is permissible for me,” but I will not be mastered by anything.
aov_text: ALLES is my geoorloof, maar nie alles is nuttig nie; alles is my geoorloof, maar ek sal my nie deur iets laat oorheers nie.

kjv_text: Meats for the belly, and the belly for meats: but God shall destroy both it and them. Now the body is not for fornication, but for the Lord; and the Lord for the body.
bsb_text: “Food for the stomach and the stomach for food,” but God will destroy them both. The body is not intended for sexual immorality, but for the Lord, and the Lord for the body.
aov_text: Die voedsel is vir die maag, en die maag is vir die voedsel, maar God sal die een sowel as die ander tot niet maak. En die liggaam is nie vir hoerery nie, maar vir die Here; en die Here vir die liggaam.

kjv_text: And God hath both raised up the Lord, and will also raise up us by his own power.
bsb_text: By His power God raised the Lord from the dead, and He will raise us also.
aov_text: En God het ook die Here opgewek en sal ons opwek deur sy krag.

kjv_text: Know ye not that your bodies are the members of Christ? shall I then take the members of Christ, and make them the members of an harlot? God forbid.
bsb_text: Do you not know that your bodies are members of Christ? Shall I then take the members of Christ and unite them with a prostitute? Never!
aov_text: Weet julle nie dat julle liggame lede van Christus is nie? Sal ek dan die lede van Christus neem en dit lede van ’n hoer maak? Nee, stellig nie!

kjv_text: What? know ye not that he which is joined to an harlot is one body? for two, saith he, shall be one flesh.
bsb_text: Or don’t you know that he who unites himself with a prostitute is one with her in body? For it is said, “The two will become one flesh.”
aov_text: Of weet julle nie dat hy wat ’n hoer aanhang, met haar een liggaam is nie? Want die twee, sê Hy, sal een vlees wees.

kjv_text: But he that is joined unto the Lord is one spirit.
bsb_text: But he who unites himself with the Lord is one with Him in spirit.
aov_text: Maar wie die Here aanhang, is een gees met Hom.

kjv_text: Flee fornication. Every sin that a man doeth is without the body; but he that committeth fornication sinneth against his own body.
bsb_text: Flee from sexual immorality. Every other sin a man can commit is outside his body, but he who sins sexually sins against his own body.
aov_text: Vlug vir die hoerery. Enige sonde wat ’n mens doen, is buite die liggaam; maar wie hoerery bedryf, sondig teen sy eie liggaam.

kjv_text: What? know ye not that your body is the temple of the Holy Ghost which is in you, which ye have of God, and ye are not your own?
bsb_text: Do you not know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have received from God? You are not your own;
aov_text: Of weet julle nie dat julle liggaam ’n tempel is van die Heilige Gees wat in julle is, wat julle van God het, en dat julle nie aan julself behoort nie?

kjv_text: For ye are bought with a price: therefore glorify God in your body, and in your spirit, which are God's.
bsb_text: you were bought at a price. Therefore glorify God with your body.
aov_text: Want julle is duur gekoop. Verheerlik God dan in julle liggaam en in julle gees wat aan God behoort.

kjv_text: Now concerning the things whereof ye wrote unto me: It is good for a man not to touch a woman.
bsb_text: Now for the matters you wrote about: It is good to abstain from sexual relations.
aov_text: MET betrekking tot die dinge waaroor julle aan my geskryf het — dit is goed vir ’n man om ’n vrou nie aan te raak nie.

kjv_text: Nevertheless, to avoid fornication, let every man have his own wife, and let every woman have her own husband.
bsb_text: But because there is so much sexual immorality, each man should have his own wife, and each woman her own husband.
aov_text: Maar vanweë die hoererye moet elke man sy eie vrou hê, en elke vrou moet haar eie man hê.

kjv_text: Let the husband render unto the wife due benevolence: and likewise also the wife unto the husband.
bsb_text: The husband should fulfill his marital duty to his wife, and likewise the wife to her husband.
aov_text: Die man moet aan die vrou die verskuldigde welwillendheid bewys, en net so ook die vrou aan die man.

kjv_text: The wife hath not power of her own body, but the husband: and likewise also the husband hath not power of his own body, but the wife.
bsb_text: The wife does not have authority over her own body, but the husband. Likewise the husband does not have authority over his own body, but the wife.
aov_text: Die vrou het nie mag oor haar eie liggaam nie, maar die man; en net so ook het die man nie mag oor sy eie liggaam nie, maar die vrou.

kjv_text: Defraud ye not one the other, except it be with consent for a time, that ye may give yourselves to fasting and prayer; and come together again, that Satan tempt you not for your incontinency.
bsb_text: Do not deprive each other, except by mutual consent and for a time, so you may devote yourselves to prayer. Then come together again, so that Satan will not tempt you through your lack of self-control.
aov_text: Onttrek julle nie aan mekaar nie, behalwe met wedersydse ooreenstemming vir ’n tyd lank om julle aan vas en gebed te kan wy; en kom weer bymekaar, sodat die Satan julle nie in versoeking bring deur julle gebrek aan selfbeheersing nie.

kjv_text: But I speak this by permission, and not of commandment.
bsb_text: I say this as a concession, not as a command.
aov_text: Maar dit sê ek by wyse van toelating, nie by wyse van gebod nie.

kjv_text: For I would that all men were even as I myself. But every man hath his proper gift of God, one after this manner, and another after that.
bsb_text: I wish that all men were as I am. But each man has his own gift from God; one has this gift, another has that.
aov_text: Want ek wens dat alle mense soos ek was; maar elkeen het sy eie genadegawe van God, die een so en die ander weer anders.

kjv_text: I say therefore to the unmarried and widows, It is good for them if they abide even as I.
bsb_text: Now to the unmarried and widows I say this: It is good for them to remain unmarried, as I am.
aov_text: Maar vir die ongetroudes en die weduwees sê ek, dit is vir hulle goed as hulle bly soos ek;

kjv_text: But if they cannot contain, let them marry: for it is better to marry than to burn.
bsb_text: But if they cannot control themselves, let them marry. For it is better to marry than to burn with passion.
aov_text: maar as hulle hul nie kan beheers nie, laat hulle trou; want dit is beter om te trou as om van begeerte te brand.

kjv_text: And unto the married I command, yet not I, but the Lord, Let not the wife depart from her husband:
bsb_text: To the married I give this command (not I, but the Lord): A wife must not separate from her husband.
aov_text: En aan die getroudes beveel ek — nie ek nie, maar die Here — dat die vrou nie van die man moet skei nie;

kjv_text: But and if she depart, let her remain unmarried, or be reconciled to her husband: and let not the husband put away his wife.
bsb_text: But if she does, she must remain unmarried or else be reconciled to her husband. And a husband must not divorce his wife.
aov_text: en as sy tog van hom skei, moet sy ongetroud bly, of haar met haar man versoen; en dat die man sy vrou nie moet verstoot nie.

kjv_text: But to the rest speak I, not the Lord: If any brother hath a wife that believeth not, and she be pleased to dwell with him, let him not put her away.
bsb_text: To the rest I say this (I, not the Lord): If a brother has an unbelieving wife and she is willing to live with him, he must not divorce her.
aov_text: Maar vir die ander sê ek — nie die Here nie — as enige broeder ’n ongelowige vrou het en sy dit goedvind om met hom saam te lewe, moet hy haar nie verstoot nie;

kjv_text: And the woman which hath an husband that believeth not, and if he be pleased to dwell with her, let her not leave him.
bsb_text: And if a woman has an unbelieving husband and he is willing to live with her, she must not divorce him.
aov_text: en as ’n vrou ’n ongelowige man het, en hy dit goedvind om met haar saam te lewe, moet sy hom nie verstoot nie.

kjv_text: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified by the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified by the husband: else were your children unclean; but now are they holy.
bsb_text: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified through his believing wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified through her believing husband. Otherwise your children would be unclean, but now they are holy.
aov_text: Want die ongelowige man is geheilig deur die vrou, en die ongelowige vrou is geheilig deur die man; want anders sou julle kinders onrein wees, maar nou is hulle heilig.

kjv_text: But if the unbelieving depart, let him depart. A brother or a sister is not under bondage in such cases: but God hath called us to peace.
bsb_text: But if the unbeliever leaves, let him go. The believing brother or sister is not bound in such cases. God has called you to live in peace.
aov_text: Maar as die ongelowige wil skei, laat hom skei. In sulke gevalle is die broeder of suster nie gebonde nie. Maar God het ons tot vrede geroep.

kjv_text: For what knowest thou, O wife, whether thou shalt save thy husband? or how knowest thou, O man, whether thou shalt save thy wife?
bsb_text: How do you know, wife, whether you will save your husband? Or how do you know, husband, whether you will save your wife?
aov_text: Want hoe weet jy, vrou, of jy die man sal red; of hoe weet jy, man, of jy die vrou sal red?

kjv_text: But as God hath distributed to every man, as the Lord hath called every one, so let him walk. And so ordain I in all churches.
bsb_text: Regardless, each one should lead the life that the Lord has assigned to him and to which God has called him. This is what I prescribe in all the churches.
aov_text: Maar elkeen moet wandel net soos God hom dit toebedeel het, soos die Here elkeen geroep het. En so bepaal ek in al die gemeentes.

kjv_text: Is any man called being circumcised? let him not become uncircumcised. Is any called in uncircumcision? let him not be circumcised.
bsb_text: Was a man already circumcised when he was called? He should not become uncircumcised. Was a man still uncircumcised when called? He should not be circumcised.
aov_text: Is iemand as ’n besnedene geroep — hy moet die besnydenis nie laat verander nie; is iemand as onbesnedene geroep — hy moet hom nie laat besny nie.

kjv_text: Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing, but the keeping of the commandments of God.
bsb_text: Circumcision is nothing and uncircumcision is nothing. Keeping God’s commandments is what counts.
aov_text: Die besnydenis is niks en die onbesnedenheid is niks, maar die onderhouding van die gebooie van God.

kjv_text: Let every man abide in the same calling wherein he was called.
bsb_text: Each one should remain in the situation he was in when he was called.
aov_text: Laat elkeen in die roeping bly waarin hy geroep is.

kjv_text: Art thou called being a servant? care not for it: but if thou mayest be made free, use it rather.
bsb_text: Were you a slave when you were called? Do not let it concern you—but if you can gain your freedom, take the opportunity.
aov_text: Is jy as slaaf geroep, laat dit jou nie kwel nie; maar as jy ook vry kan word, maak daar des te meer gebruik van.

kjv_text: For he that is called in the Lord, being a servant, is the Lord's freeman: likewise also he that is called, being free, is Christ's servant.
bsb_text: For he who was a slave when he was called by the Lord is the Lord’s freedman. Conversely, he who was a free man when he was called is Christ’s slave.
aov_text: Want die slaaf wat in die Here geroep is, is ’n vrygemaakte van die Here; so is ook hy wat as vryman geroep is, ’n slaaf van Christus.

kjv_text: Ye are bought with a price; be not ye the servants of men.
bsb_text: You were bought at a price; do not become slaves of men.
aov_text: Julle is duur gekoop; moenie slawe van mense word nie.

kjv_text: Brethren, let every man, wherein he is called, therein abide with God.
bsb_text: Brothers, each one should remain in the situation he was in when God called him.
aov_text: Laat elkeen, broeders, in die staat waarin hy geroep is, daarin bly voor God.

kjv_text: Now concerning virgins I have no commandment of the Lord: yet I give my judgment, as one that hath obtained mercy of the Lord to be faithful.
bsb_text: Now about virgins, I have no command from the Lord, but I give a judgment as one who by the Lord’s mercy is trustworthy.
aov_text: In verband met die maagde het ek geen bevel van die Here nie, maar ek gee my mening as iemand wat deur die barmhartigheid van die Here betroubaar is.

kjv_text: I suppose therefore that this is good for the present distress, I say, that it is good for a man so to be.
bsb_text: Because of the present crisis, I think it is good for a man to remain as he is.
aov_text: Ek meen dat dit goed is vanweë die aanstaande nood — dat dit goed is vir ’n mens om so te bly.

kjv_text: Art thou bound unto a wife? seek not to be loosed. Art thou loosed from a wife? seek not a wife.
bsb_text: Are you committed to a wife? Do not seek to be released. Are you free of commitment? Do not look for a wife.
aov_text: Is jy aan ’n vrou verbonde, moenie losmaking soek nie; is jy los van ’n vrou, moenie ’n vrou soek nie.

kjv_text: But and if thou marry, thou hast not sinned; and if a virgin marry, she hath not sinned. Nevertheless such shall have trouble in the flesh: but I spare you.
bsb_text: But if you do marry, you have not sinned. And if a virgin marries, she has not sinned. But those who marry will face troubles in this life, and I want to spare you this.
aov_text: Maar as jy tog trou, sondig jy nie; en as ’n maagd trou, sondig sy nie. Maar sulke mense sal verdrukking hê vir die vlees, en ek wil julle spaar.

kjv_text: But this I say, brethren, the time is short: it remaineth, that both they that have wives be as though they had none;
bsb_text: What I am saying, brothers, is that the time is short. From now on those who have wives should live as if they had none;
aov_text: Maar dit sê ek, broeders, die tyd is kort; van nou af moet ook die wat vroue het, wees asof hulle nie het nie;

kjv_text: And they that weep, as though they wept not; and they that rejoice, as though they rejoiced not; and they that buy, as though they possessed not;
bsb_text: those who weep, as if they did not; those who are joyful, as if they were not; those who make a purchase, as if they had nothing;
aov_text: en die wat ween, asof hulle nie ween nie; en die wat bly is, asof hulle nie bly is nie; en die wat koop, asof hulle nie besit nie;

kjv_text: And they that use this world, as not abusing it: for the fashion of this world passeth away.
bsb_text: and those who use the things of this world, as if not dependent on them. For this world in its present form is passing away.
aov_text: en die wat hierdie wêreld gebruik, asof hulle dit nie ten volle gebruik nie; want die gedaante van hierdie wêreld gaan verby.

kjv_text: But I would have you without carefulness. He that is unmarried careth for the things that belong to the Lord, how he may please the Lord:
bsb_text: I want you to be free from concern. The unmarried man is concerned about the work of the Lord, how he can please the Lord.
aov_text: En ek wil hê dat julle onbesorg moet wees. Die ongetroude is besorg oor die dinge van die Here, hoe hy die Here sal behaag,

kjv_text: But he that is married careth for the things that are of the world, how he may please his wife.
bsb_text: But the married man is concerned about the affairs of this world, how he can please his wife,
aov_text: maar die getroude is besorg oor die dinge van die wêreld, hoe hy die vrou sal behaag.

kjv_text: There is difference also between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman careth for the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit: but she that is married careth for the things of the world, how she may please her husband.
bsb_text: and his interests are divided. The unmarried woman or virgin is concerned about the work of the Lord, how she can be holy in both body and spirit. But the married woman is concerned about the affairs of this world, how she can please her husband.
aov_text: Daar is ook onderskeid tussen ’n vrou en ’n maagd; die ongetroude is besorg oor die dinge van die Here om heilig te wees na die liggaam sowel as na die gees, maar die getroude is besorg oor die dinge van die wêreld, hoe sy die man sal behaag.

kjv_text: And this I speak for your own profit; not that I may cast a snare upon you, but for that which is comely, and that ye may attend upon the Lord without distraction.
bsb_text: I am saying this for your own good, not to restrict you, but in order to promote proper decorum and undivided devotion to the Lord.
aov_text: Ek sê dit tot julle eie voordeel, nie om julle van jul vryheid te beroof nie, maar met die oog op ’n welvoeglike en onafgebroke toewyding aan die Here.

kjv_text: But if any man think that he behaveth himself uncomely toward his virgin, if she pass the flower of her age, and need so require, let him do what he will, he sinneth not: let them marry.
bsb_text: However, if someone thinks he is acting inappropriately toward his betrothed, and if she is beyond her youth and they ought to marry, let him do as he wishes; he is not sinning; they should get married.
aov_text: Maar as iemand meen dat hy onwelvoeglik met sy maagd handel as sy oor die jeugdige leeftyd is, en dit so moet wees, laat hom doen wat hy wil. Hy sondig nie. Laat hulle trou.

kjv_text: Nevertheless he that standeth stedfast in his heart, having no necessity, but hath power over his own will, and hath so decreed in his heart that he will keep his virgin, doeth well.
bsb_text: But the man who is firmly established in his heart and under no constraint, with control over his will and resolve in his heart not to marry the virgin, he will do well.
aov_text: Maar hy wat in sy hart vasstaan en nie onder dwang verkeer nie, maar mag het oor sy eie wil en dit in sy eie hart besluit het om sy maagd te bewaar, hy doen goed.

kjv_text: So then he that giveth her in marriage doeth well; but he that giveth her not in marriage doeth better.
bsb_text: So then, he who marries the virgin does well, but he who does not marry her does even better.
aov_text: Daarom, ook hy wat in die huwelik uitgee, doen goed; maar hy wat in die huwelik nie uitgee nie, doen beter.

kjv_text: The wife is bound by the law as long as her husband liveth; but if her husband be dead, she is at liberty to be married to whom she will; only in the Lord.
bsb_text: A wife is bound to her husband as long as he lives. But if her husband dies, she is free to marry anyone she wishes, as long as he belongs to the Lord.
aov_text: ’n Vrou is deur die wet gebonde so lank as haar man lewe; maar as die man ontslaap het, is sy vry om te trou met wie sy wil, maar net in die Here.

kjv_text: But she is happier if she so abide, after my judgment: and I think also that I have the Spirit of God.
bsb_text: In my judgment, however, she is happier if she remains as she is. And I think that I too have the Spirit of God.
aov_text: Sy is egter gelukkiger as sy so bly, volgens my gevoele. En ek meen dat ek ook die Gees van God het.

kjv_text: Now as touching things offered unto idols, we know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffeth up, but charity edifieth.
bsb_text: Now about food sacrificed to idols: We know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.
aov_text: EN met betrekking tot die offervleis aan die afgode weet ons dat ons almal kennis het. Die kennis maak opgeblase, maar die liefde stig.

kjv_text: And if any man think that he knoweth any thing, he knoweth nothing yet as he ought to know.
bsb_text: The one who thinks he knows something does not yet know as he ought to know.
aov_text: As iemand meen dat hy enige kennis het, weet hy nog niks soos ’n mens behoort te weet nie.

kjv_text: But if any man love God, the same is known of him.
bsb_text: But the one who loves God is known by God.
aov_text: Maar as iemand God liefhet, dié word deur Hom geken.

kjv_text: As concerning therefore the eating of those things that are offered in sacrifice unto idols, we know that an idol is nothing in the world, and that there is none other God but one.
bsb_text: So about eating food sacrificed to idols: We know that an idol is nothing at all in the world, and that there is no God but one.
aov_text: Wat dan die eet van die offervleis aan die afgode betref, weet ons dat ’n afgod niks in die wêreld is nie, en dat daar geen ander God is nie, behalwe Een.

kjv_text: For though there be that are called gods, whether in heaven or in earth, (as there be gods many, and lords many,)
bsb_text: For even if there are so-called gods, whether in heaven or on earth (as there are many so-called gods and lords),
aov_text: Want al is daar ook sogenaamde gode, of dit in die hemel en of dit op die aarde is — soos daar baie gode en baie here is  —

kjv_text: But to us there is but one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we in him; and one Lord Jesus Christ, by whom are all things, and we by him.
bsb_text: yet for us there is but one God, the Father, from whom all things came and for whom we exist. And there is but one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom all things came and through whom we exist.
aov_text: tog is daar vir ons maar een God, die Vader uit wie alles is, en ons tot Hom, en een Here Jesus Christus deur wie alles is, en ons deur Hom.

kjv_text: Howbeit there is not in every man that knowledge: for some with conscience of the idol unto this hour eat it as a thing offered unto an idol; and their conscience being weak is defiled.
bsb_text: But not everyone has this knowledge. Some people are still so accustomed to idols that they eat such food as if it were sacrificed to an idol. And since their conscience is weak, it is defiled.
aov_text: Die kennis is egter nie in almal nie; maar sommige, nog altyd bewus van die afgod, eet dit as ’n afgodsoffer, en hulle gewete, wat swak is, word besoedel.

kjv_text: But meat commendeth us not to God: for neither, if we eat, are we the better; neither, if we eat not, are we the worse.
bsb_text: But food does not bring us closer to God: We are no worse if we do not eat, and no better if we do.
aov_text: Maar die voedsel bring ons nie nader by God nie; want as ons eet, het ons geen oorvloed nie, en as ons nie eet nie, ly ons geen gebrek nie.

kjv_text: But take heed lest by any means this liberty of yours become a stumblingblock to them that are weak.
bsb_text: Be careful, however, that your freedom does not become a stumbling block to the weak.
aov_text: Maar pas op dat hierdie vryheid van julle nie miskien ’n struikelblok word vir die wat swak is nie.

kjv_text: For if any man see thee which hast knowledge sit at meat in the idol's temple, shall not the conscience of him which is weak be emboldened to eat those things which are offered to idols;
bsb_text: For if someone with a weak conscience sees you who are well informed eating in an idol’s temple, will he not be encouraged to eat food sacrificed to idols?
aov_text: Want as iemand jou wat kennis het, aan tafel sien in ’n afgodstempel, sal sy gewete, as hy ’n swak man is, nie aangemoedig word om van die offervleis aan die afgode te eet nie?
