kjv_text: And through thy knowledge shall the weak brother perish, for whom Christ died?
bsb_text: So this weak brother, for whom Christ died, is destroyed by your knowledge.
aov_text: En moet die swakke broeder vir wie Christus gesterf het, verlore gaan deur jou kennis?

kjv_text: But when ye sin so against the brethren, and wound their weak conscience, ye sin against Christ.
bsb_text: By sinning against your brothers in this way and wounding their weak conscience, you sin against Christ.
aov_text: Maar deur so teen die broeders te sondig en hulle gewete wat swak is, seer te maak, sondig julle teen Christus.

kjv_text: Wherefore, if meat make my brother to offend, I will eat no flesh while the world standeth, lest I make my brother to offend.
bsb_text: Therefore, if what I eat causes my brother to stumble, I will never eat meat again, so that I will not cause him to stumble.
aov_text: Daarom, as voedsel my broeder laat struikel, sal ek in der ewigheid geen vleis eet nie, om my broeder nie te laat struikel nie.

kjv_text: Am I not an apostle? am I not free? have I not seen Jesus Christ our Lord? are not ye my work in the Lord?
bsb_text: Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Have I not seen Jesus our Lord? Are you yourselves not my workmanship in the Lord?
aov_text: IS ek nie ’n apostel nie? Is ek nie vry nie? Het ek nie Jesus Christus, onse Here, gesien nie? Is julle nie my werk in die Here nie?

kjv_text: If I be not an apostle unto others, yet doubtless I am to you: for the seal of mine apostleship are ye in the Lord.
bsb_text: Even if I am not an apostle to others, surely I am to you. For you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.
aov_text: As ek vir ander geen apostel is nie, is ek dit tog seker vir julle, want julle is die seël op my apostelskap in die Here.

kjv_text: Mine answer to them that do examine me is this,
bsb_text: This is my defense to those who scrutinize me:
aov_text: My verantwoording aan die wat my beskuldig, is dít:

kjv_text: Have we not power to eat and to drink?
bsb_text: Have we no right to food and to drink?
aov_text: Het ons dan geen vryheid om te eet en te drink nie?

kjv_text: Have we not power to lead about a sister, a wife, as well as other apostles, and as the brethren of the Lord, and Cephas?
bsb_text: Have we no right to take along a believing wife, as do the other apostles and the Lord’s brothers and Cephas?
aov_text: Het ons dan geen reg om ’n suster as vrou met ons rond te neem net soos die ander apostels en die broers van die Here en Céfas nie?

kjv_text: Or I only and Barnabas, have not we power to forbear working?
bsb_text: Or are Barnabas and I the only apostles who must work for a living?
aov_text: Of het net ek en Bárnabas geen reg om die hande-arbeid na te laat nie?

kjv_text: Who goeth a warfare any time at his own charges? who planteth a vineyard, and eateth not of the fruit thereof? or who feedeth a flock, and eateth not of the milk of the flock?
bsb_text: Who serves as a soldier at his own expense? Who plants a vineyard and does not eat of its fruit? Who tends a flock and does not drink of its milk?
aov_text: Wie dien ooit as soldaat op eie koste? Wie plant ’n wingerd en eet nie van sy vrug nie? Of wie pas ’n kudde op en geniet nie van die melk van die kudde nie?

kjv_text: Say I these things as a man? or saith not the law the same also?
bsb_text: Do I say this from a human perspective? Doesn’t the Law say the same thing?
aov_text: Sê ek dit miskien menslikerwys, of sê die wet dit nie ook nie?

kjv_text: For it is written in the law of Moses, Thou shalt not muzzle the mouth of the ox that treadeth out the corn. Doth God take care for oxen?
bsb_text: For it is written in the Law of Moses: “Do not muzzle an ox while it is treading out the grain.” Is it about oxen that God is concerned?
aov_text: Want in die wet van Moses is geskrywe: ’n Os wat graan dors, mag jy nie muilband nie. Is dit miskien oor die osse dat God Hom bekommer?

kjv_text: Or saith he it altogether for our sakes? For our sakes, no doubt, this is written: that he that ploweth should plow in hope; and that he that thresheth in hope should be partaker of his hope.
bsb_text: Isn’t He actually speaking on our behalf? Indeed, this was written for us, because when the plowman plows and the thresher threshes, they should also expect to share in the harvest.
aov_text: Of spreek Hy inderdaad om ons ontwil? Ja, want om ons ontwil is dit geskrywe, omdat hy wat ploeg, op hoop moet ploeg; en hy wat dors, op hoop om wat hy hoop, deelagtig te word.

kjv_text: If we have sown unto you spiritual things, is it a great thing if we shall reap your carnal things?
bsb_text: If we have sown spiritual seed among you, is it too much for us to reap a material harvest from you?
aov_text: As ons vir julle die geestelike gesaai het, is dit ’n groot saak as ons julle stoflike goed maai?

kjv_text: If others be partakers of this power over you, are not we rather? Nevertheless we have not used this power; but suffer all things, lest we should hinder the gospel of Christ.
bsb_text: If others have this right to your support, shouldn’t we have it all the more? But we did not exercise this right. Instead, we put up with anything rather than hinder the gospel of Christ.
aov_text: As ander deel het aan die reg op julle diens, het ons nie nog meer nie? Ons het ewenwel nie gebruik gemaak van hierdie reg nie, maar ons verdra alles om geen hindernis vir die evangelie van Christus te veroorsaak nie.

kjv_text: Do ye not know that they which minister about holy things live of the things of the temple? and they which wait at the altar are partakers with the altar?
bsb_text: Do you not know that those who work in the temple eat of its food, and those who serve at the altar partake of its offerings?
aov_text: Weet julle nie dat die wat met die heilige dinge werk, uit die heiligdom eet nie; en dat die wat by die altaar besig is, met die altaar deel nie?

kjv_text: Even so hath the Lord ordained that they which preach the gospel should live of the gospel.
bsb_text: In the same way, the Lord has prescribed that those who preach the gospel should receive their living from the gospel.
aov_text: So het die Here ook vir die wat die evangelie verkondig, bepaal dat hulle van die evangelie moet lewe.

kjv_text: But I have used none of these things: neither have I written these things, that it should be so done unto me: for it were better for me to die, than that any man should make my glorying void.
bsb_text: But I have not used any of these rights. And I am not writing this to suggest that something be done for me. Indeed, I would rather die than let anyone nullify my boast.
aov_text: MAAR ék het van geeneen van hierdie dinge gebruik gemaak nie. En ek skryf dít nie met die bedoeling dat dit so met my moet wees nie, want dit sou vir my beter wees om te sterwe as dat iemand my roem sou verydel.

kjv_text: For though I preach the gospel, I have nothing to glory of: for necessity is laid upon me; yea, woe is unto me, if I preach not the gospel!
bsb_text: Yet when I preach the gospel, I have no reason to boast, because I am obligated to preach. Woe to me if I do not preach the gospel!
aov_text: Want as ek die evangelie verkondig, is dit vir my geen roem nie; want die dwang is my opgelê, en wee my as ek die evangelie nie verkondig nie!

kjv_text: For if I do this thing willingly, I have a reward: but if against my will, a dispensation of the gospel is committed unto me.
bsb_text: If my preaching is voluntary, I have a reward. But if it is not voluntary, I am still entrusted with a responsibility.
aov_text: Want as ek dit vrywillig doen, het ek loon; maar as ek dit onwillig doen, is ’n rentmeesterskap aan my toevertrou.

kjv_text: What is my reward then? Verily that, when I preach the gospel, I may make the gospel of Christ without charge, that I abuse not my power in the gospel.
bsb_text: What then is my reward? That in preaching the gospel I may offer it free of charge, and so not use up my rights in preaching it.
aov_text: Watter loon het ek dan? Dat as ek die evangelie verkondig, ek die evangelie van Christus kosteloos bring, om nie van my reg in die evangelie ten volle gebruik te maak nie.

kjv_text: For though I be free from all men, yet have I made myself servant unto all, that I might gain the more.
bsb_text: Though I am free of obligation to anyone, I make myself a slave to everyone, to win as many as possible.
aov_text: Want alhoewel ek van almal vry was, het ek my aan almal diensbaar gemaak om soveel van hulle as moontlik te win.

kjv_text: And unto the Jews I became as a Jew, that I might gain the Jews; to them that are under the law, as under the law, that I might gain them that are under the law;
bsb_text: To the Jews I became like a Jew, to win the Jews. To those under the law I became like one under the law (though I myself am not under the law), to win those under the law.
aov_text: Vir die Jode het ek soos ’n Jood geword om die Jode te win; vir die wat onder die wet is, soos een wat onder die wet is, om die wat onder die wet is, te win.

kjv_text: To them that are without law, as without law, (being not without law to God, but under the law to Christ,) that I might gain them that are without law.
bsb_text: To those without the law I became like one without the law (though I am not outside the law of God but am under the law of Christ), to win those without the law.
aov_text: Vir die wat sonder die wet is, soos een sonder wet — al is ek nie sonder die wet van God nie, maar onder die wet van Christus — om die wat sonder die wet is, te win;

kjv_text: To the weak became I as weak, that I might gain the weak: I am made all things to all men, that I might by all means save some.
bsb_text: To the weak I became weak, to win the weak. I have become all things to all people so that by all possible means I might save some.
aov_text: vir die swakkes het ek soos ’n swakke geword om die swakkes te win; vir almal het ek alles geword om in alle geval sommige te red.

kjv_text: And this I do for the gospel's sake, that I might be partaker thereof with you.
bsb_text: I do all this for the sake of the gospel, so that I may share in its blessings.
aov_text: En ek doen dit ter wille van die evangelie, dat ek ’n deelgenoot daarvan kan word.

kjv_text: Know ye not that they which run in a race run all, but one receiveth the prize? So run, that ye may obtain.
bsb_text: Do you not know that in a race all the runners run, but only one receives the prize? Run in such a way as to take the prize.
aov_text: Weet julle nie dat die wat op die baan hardloop, wel almal hardloop, maar dat een die prys ontvang nie? Hardloop só dat julle dit sekerlik kan behaal.

kjv_text: And every man that striveth for the mastery is temperate in all things. Now they do it to obtain a corruptible crown; but we an incorruptible.
bsb_text: Everyone who competes in the games trains with strict discipline. They do it for a crown that is perishable, but we do it for a crown that is imperishable.
aov_text: En elkeen wat aan ’n wedstryd deelneem, onthou hom in alles — húlle nogal om ’n verwelklike krans te ontvang, maar ons ’n onverwelklike.

kjv_text: I therefore so run, not as uncertainly; so fight I, not as one that beateth the air:
bsb_text: Therefore I do not run aimlessly; I do not fight like I am beating the air.
aov_text: Ek hardloop dan soos een wat nie onseker is nie; ek slaan met die vuis soos een wat nie in die lug slaan nie.

kjv_text: But I keep under my body, and bring it into subjection: lest that by any means, when I have preached to others, I myself should be a castaway.
bsb_text: No, I discipline my body and make it my slave, so that after I have preached to others, I myself will not be disqualified.
aov_text: Maar ek kasty my liggaam en maak dit diensbaar, dat ek nie miskien, terwyl ek vir ander gepreek het, self verwerplik sou wees nie.

kjv_text: Moreover, brethren, I would not that ye should be ignorant, how that all our fathers were under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;
bsb_text: I do not want you to be unaware, brothers, that our forefathers were all under the cloud, and that they all passed through the sea.
aov_text: WANT ek wil nie hê, broeders, dat julle nie sou weet nie dat ons vaders almal onder die wolk was en almal deur die see deurgegaan het,

kjv_text: And were all baptized unto Moses in the cloud and in the sea;
bsb_text: They were all baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea.
aov_text: en almal in Moses gedoop is in die wolk en in die see,

kjv_text: And did all eat the same spiritual meat;
bsb_text: They all ate the same spiritual food
aov_text: en almal dieselfde geestelike spys geëet het,

kjv_text: And did all drink the same spiritual drink: for they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them: and that Rock was Christ.
bsb_text: and drank the same spiritual drink; for they drank from the spiritual rock that accompanied them, and that rock was Christ.
aov_text: en almal dieselfde geestelike drank gedrink het, want hulle het gedrink uit ’n geestelike rots wat gevolg het, en die rots was Christus.

kjv_text: But with many of them God was not well pleased: for they were overthrown in the wilderness.
bsb_text: Nevertheless, God was not pleased with most of them, for they were struck down in the wilderness.
aov_text: Maar God het in die meeste van hulle geen welgevalle gehad nie, want hulle is neergeslaan in die woestyn.

kjv_text: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things, as they also lusted.
bsb_text: These things took place as examples to keep us from craving evil things as they did.
aov_text: En hierdie dinge was voorbeelde vir ons, dat ons nie begerig moet wees na slegte dinge soos hulle begerig was nie.

kjv_text: Neither be ye idolaters, as were some of them; as it is written, The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.
bsb_text: Do not be idolaters, as some of them were. As it is written: “The people sat down to eat and to drink, and got up to indulge in revelry.”
aov_text: En wees ook nie afgodedienaars soos sommige van hulle was nie, soos geskrywe is: Die volk het gaan sit om te eet en te drink en het opgestaan om te speel.

kjv_text: Neither let us commit fornication, as some of them committed, and fell in one day three and twenty thousand.
bsb_text: We should not commit sexual immorality, as some of them did, and in one day twenty-three thousand of them died.
aov_text: En laat ons nie hoereer soos sommige van hulle gehoereer het nie, en daar het op een dag drie-en-twintigduisend geval.

kjv_text: Neither let us tempt Christ, as some of them also tempted, and were destroyed of serpents.
bsb_text: We should not test Christ, as some of them did, and were killed by snakes.
aov_text: En laat ons Christus nie versoek soos ook sommige van hulle gedoen het nie, en hulle het deur die slange omgekom.

kjv_text: Neither murmur ye, as some of them also murmured, and were destroyed of the destroyer.
bsb_text: And do not complain, as some of them did, and were killed by the destroying angel.
aov_text: En moenie murmureer soos ook sommige van hulle gemurmureer het nie, en hulle het deur die verderwer omgekom.

kjv_text: Now all these things happened unto them for ensamples: and they are written for our admonition, upon whom the ends of the world are come.
bsb_text: Now these things happened to them as examples and were written down as warnings for us, on whom the fulfillment of the ages has come.
aov_text: Maar al hierdie dinge het hulle oorgekom as voorbeelde en is opgeskrywe as ’n waarskuwing aan ons op wie die eindes van die eeue gekom het.

kjv_text: Wherefore let him that thinketh he standeth take heed lest he fall.
bsb_text: So the one who thinks he is standing firm should be careful not to fall.
aov_text: Daarom, wie meen dat hy staan, moet oppas dat hy nie val nie.

kjv_text: There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.
bsb_text: No temptation has seized you except what is common to man. And God is faithful; He will not let you be tempted beyond what you can bear. But when you are tempted, He will also provide an escape, so that you can stand up under it.
aov_text: Geen versoeking het julle aangegryp behalwe ’n menslike nie; maar God is getrou, wat nie sal toelaat dat julle bo julle kragte versoek word nie; maar Hy sal saam met die versoeking ook die uitkoms gee, sodat julle dit sal kan verdra.

kjv_text: Wherefore, my dearly beloved, flee from idolatry.
bsb_text: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.
aov_text: DAAROM, my geliefdes, vlug vir die afgodediens.

kjv_text: I speak as to wise men; judge ye what I say.
bsb_text: I speak to reasonable people; judge for yourselves what I say.
aov_text: Ek spreek soos met verstandige mense; oordeel self wat ek sê:

kjv_text: The cup of blessing which we bless, is it not the communion of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, is it not the communion of the body of Christ?
bsb_text: Is not the cup of blessing that we bless a participation in the blood of Christ? And is not the bread that we break a participation in the body of Christ?
aov_text: die beker van danksegging wat ons met danksegging seën, is dit nie die gemeenskap met die bloed van Christus nie? Die brood wat ons breek, is dit nie die gemeenskap met die liggaam van Christus nie?

kjv_text: For we being many are one bread, and one body: for we are all partakers of that one bread.
bsb_text: Because there is one loaf, we who are many are one body; for we all partake of the one loaf.
aov_text: Omdat dit een brood is, is ons almal een liggaam, want ons het almal deel aan die een brood.

kjv_text: Behold Israel after the flesh: are not they which eat of the sacrifices partakers of the altar?
bsb_text: Consider the people of Israel: Are not those who eat the sacrifices fellow partakers in the altar?
aov_text: Let op Israel na die vlees: het die wat die offers eet, nie gemeenskap met die altaar nie?

kjv_text: What say I then? that the idol is any thing, or that which is offered in sacrifice to idols is any thing?
bsb_text: Am I suggesting, then, that food sacrificed to an idol is anything, or that an idol is anything?
aov_text: Wat sê ek dan? Dat ’n afgod iets is, of dat ’n afgodsoffer iets is?

kjv_text: But I say, that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to devils, and not to God: and I would not that ye should have fellowship with devils.
bsb_text: No, but the sacrifices of pagans are offered to demons, not to God. And I do not want you to be participants with demons.
aov_text: Nee, maar dat die heidene wat dit offer, aan duiwels offer en nie aan God nie. En ek wil nie hê dat julle met die duiwels gemeenskap moet hou nie.

kjv_text: Ye cannot drink the cup of the Lord, and the cup of devils: ye cannot be partakers of the Lord's table, and of the table of devils.
bsb_text: You cannot drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons too; you cannot partake in the table of the Lord and the table of demons too.
aov_text: Julle kan nie die beker van die Here drink en ook die beker van die duiwels nie. Julle kan nie deel hê aan die tafel van die Here en ook aan die tafel van die duiwels nie.

kjv_text: Do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? are we stronger than he?
bsb_text: Are we trying to provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than He?
aov_text: Of wil ons die ywer van die Here opwek? Is ons miskien sterker as Hy?

kjv_text: All things are lawful for me, but all things are not expedient: all things are lawful for me, but all things edify not.
bsb_text: “Everything is permissible,” but not everything is beneficial. “Everything is permissible,” but not everything is edifying.
aov_text: ALLES is my geoorloof, maar nie alles is nuttig nie; alles is my geoorloof, maar nie alles stig nie.

kjv_text: Let no man seek his own, but every man another's wealth.
bsb_text: No one should seek his own good, but the good of others.
aov_text: Laat niemand sy eie voordeel soek nie, maar elkeen die voordeel van ’n ander.

kjv_text: Whatsoever is sold in the shambles, that eat, asking no question for conscience sake:
bsb_text: Eat anything sold in the meat market without raising questions of conscience,
aov_text: Eet alles wat in die slaghuis verkoop word sonder om navraag te doen, ter wille van die gewete.

kjv_text: For the earth is the Lord's, and the fulness thereof.
bsb_text: for, “The earth is the Lord’s, and the fullness thereof.”
aov_text: Want die aarde behoort aan die Here en die volheid daarvan.

kjv_text: If any of them that believe not bid you to a feast, and ye be disposed to go; whatsoever is set before you, eat, asking no question for conscience sake.
bsb_text: If an unbeliever invites you to a meal and you want to go, eat anything set before you without raising questions of conscience.
aov_text: En as een van die ongelowiges julle nooi en julle is gewillig om te gaan, eet dan alles wat julle voorgesit word sonder om navraag te doen, ter wille van die gewete.

kjv_text: But if any man say unto you, This is offered in sacrifice unto idols, eat not for his sake that shewed it, and for conscience sake: for the earth is the Lord's, and the fulness thereof:
bsb_text: But if someone tells you, “This food was offered to idols,” then do not eat it, for the sake of the one who told you and for the sake of conscience—
aov_text: Maar as iemand aan julle sê: Dit is afgodsoffer — moet dit dan nie eet nie, ter wille van hom wat dit te kenne gegee het, en ter wille van die gewete — want die aarde behoort aan die Here en die volheid daarvan  —

kjv_text: Conscience, I say, not thine own, but of the other: for why is my liberty judged of another man's conscience?
bsb_text: the other one’s conscience, I mean, not your own. For why should my freedom be determined by someone else’s conscience?
aov_text: ek bedoel die gewete, nie van jouself nie, maar van die ander; want waarom word my vryheid geoordeel deur ’n ander se gewete?

kjv_text: For if I by grace be a partaker, why am I evil spoken of for that for which I give thanks?
bsb_text: If I partake in the meal with thankfulness, why am I denounced because of that for which I give thanks?
aov_text: En as ek iets met danksegging geniet, waarom word ek belaster oor iets waarvoor ek dank?

kjv_text: Whether therefore ye eat, or drink, or whatsoever ye do, do all to the glory of God.
bsb_text: So whether you eat or drink or whatever you do, do it all to the glory of God.
aov_text: Of julle dan eet of drink of enigiets doen, doen alles tot verheerliking van God.

kjv_text: Give none offence, neither to the Jews, nor to the Gentiles, nor to the church of God:
bsb_text: Do not become a stumbling block, whether to Jews or Greeks or the church of God—
aov_text: Wees geen oorsaak van struikeling vir Jode of Grieke of vir die gemeente van God nie;

kjv_text: Even as I please all men in all things, not seeking mine own profit, but the profit of many, that they may be saved.
bsb_text: as I also try to please everyone in all I do. For I am not seeking my own good, but the good of many, that they may be saved.
aov_text: net soos ek almal in alles behaag en nie my eie voordeel soek nie, maar dié van baie, sodat hulle gered kan word.

kjv_text: Be ye followers of me, even as I also am of Christ.
bsb_text: You are to imitate me, just as I imitate Christ.
aov_text: WEES my navolgers, soos ek dit ook van Christus is.

kjv_text: Now I praise you, brethren, that ye remember me in all things, and keep the ordinances, as I delivered them to you.
bsb_text: Now I commend you for remembering me in everything and for maintaining the traditions, just as I passed them on to you.
aov_text: EN ek prys julle, broeders, dat julle in alles aan my dink en aan die leringe vashou soos ek dit aan julle oorgelewer het.

kjv_text: But I would have you know, that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman is the man; and the head of Christ is God.
bsb_text: But I want you to understand that the head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is man, and the head of Christ is God.
aov_text: Maar ek wil hê dat julle moet weet dat Christus die hoof is van elke man, en die man die hoof van die vrou, en God die hoof van Christus.

kjv_text: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonoureth his head.
bsb_text: Every man who prays or prophesies with his head covered dishonors his head.
aov_text: Elke man wat bid of profeteer met iets op sy hoof, doen sy hoof oneer aan;

kjv_text: But every woman that prayeth or prophesieth with her head uncovered dishonoureth her head: for that is even all one as if she were shaven.
bsb_text: And every woman who prays or prophesies with her head uncovered dishonors her head, for it is just as if her head were shaved.
aov_text: maar elke vrou wat bid of profeteer met onbedekte hoof, doen haar hoof oneer aan; want dit is een en dieselfde asof haar hoof geskeer is.

kjv_text: For if the woman be not covered, let her also be shorn: but if it be a shame for a woman to be shorn or shaven, let her be covered.
bsb_text: If a woman does not cover her head, she should have her hair cut off. And if it is shameful for a woman to have her hair cut or shaved off, she should cover her head.
aov_text: Want as ’n vrou se hoof nie bedek is nie, laat sy dan ook haar hare afsny; maar as dit vir ’n vrou lelik is om haar hare af te sny of te skeer, laat sy haar hoof bedek.

kjv_text: For a man indeed ought not to cover his head, forasmuch as he is the image and glory of God: but the woman is the glory of the man.
bsb_text: A man ought not to cover his head, since he is the image and glory of God; but the woman is the glory of man.
aov_text: Want ’n man moet die hoof nie bedek nie, omdat hy die beeld en heerlikheid van God is; maar die vrou is die heerlikheid van die man.

kjv_text: For the man is not of the woman; but the woman of the man.
bsb_text: For man did not come from woman, but woman from man.
aov_text: Want die man is nie uit die vrou nie, maar die vrou uit die man.

kjv_text: Neither was the man created for the woman; but the woman for the man.
bsb_text: Neither was man created for woman, but woman for man.
aov_text: Want die man is ook nie ter wille van die vrou geskape nie, maar die vrou ter wille van die man.

kjv_text: For this cause ought the woman to have power on her head because of the angels.
bsb_text: For this reason a woman ought to have a sign of authority on her head, because of the angels.
aov_text: Daarom moet die vrou ’n aanduiding van gesag op die hoof hê ter wille van die engele.

kjv_text: Nevertheless neither is the man without the woman, neither the woman without the man, in the Lord.
bsb_text: In the Lord, however, woman is not independent of man, nor is man independent of woman.
aov_text: En tog, in die Here is die man nie sonder die vrou nie, en die vrou ook nie sonder die man nie.

kjv_text: For as the woman is of the man, even so is the man also by the woman; but all things of God.
bsb_text: For just as woman came from man, so also man is born of woman. But everything comes from God.
aov_text: Want soos die vrou uit die man is, so is ook die man deur middel van die vrou; maar alles is uit God.

kjv_text: Judge in yourselves: is it comely that a woman pray unto God uncovered?
bsb_text: Judge for yourselves: Is it proper for a woman to pray to God with her head uncovered?
aov_text: Oordeel self: Is dit betaamlik dat ’n vrou met onbedekte hoof tot God bid?

kjv_text: Doth not even nature itself teach you, that, if a man have long hair, it is a shame unto him?
bsb_text: Doesn’t nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a disgrace to him,
aov_text: Of leer ook die natuur self julle nie dat as ’n man lang hare dra, dit vir hom ’n oneer is nie;

kjv_text: But if a woman have long hair, it is a glory to her: for her hair is given her for a covering.
bsb_text: but that if a woman has long hair, it is her glory? For long hair is given to her as a covering.
aov_text: maar as ’n vrou lang hare dra, dit vir haar ’n eer is, omdat die lang hare vir haar gegee is as ’n bedekking?

kjv_text: But if any man seem to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither the churches of God.
bsb_text: If anyone is inclined to dispute this, we have no other practice, nor do the churches of God.
aov_text: Maar as iemand meen om twisgierig te wees, ons het nie so ’n gewoonte nie, en ook die gemeentes van God nie.

kjv_text: Now in this that I declare unto you I praise you not, that ye come together not for the better, but for the worse.
bsb_text: In the following instructions I have no praise to offer, because your gatherings do more harm than good.
aov_text: MAAR terwyl ek dit beveel, kan ek dit nie prys nie dat julle saamkom, nie ten goede nie maar ten kwade.

kjv_text: For first of all, when ye come together in the church, I hear that there be divisions among you; and I partly believe it.
bsb_text: First of all, I hear that when you come together as a church, there are divisions among you, and in part I believe it.
aov_text: Want in die eerste plek hoor ek dat, as julle saamkom in die gemeente, daar skeuringe onder julle is, en gedeeltelik glo ek dit.

kjv_text: For there must be also heresies among you, that they which are approved may be made manifest among you.
bsb_text: And indeed, there must be differences among you to show which of you are approved.
aov_text: Want daar moet ook partyskappe onder julle wees, sodat die beproefdes onder julle openbaar kan word.

kjv_text: When ye come together therefore into one place, this is not to eat the Lord's supper.
bsb_text: Now then, when you come together, it is not the Lord’s Supper you eat.
aov_text: As julle dus saamkom, dan wil dit nie sê dat julle die nagmaal van die Here eet nie.

kjv_text: For in eating every one taketh before other his own supper: and one is hungry, and another is drunken.
bsb_text: For as you eat, each of you goes ahead without sharing his meal. While one remains hungry, another gets drunk.
aov_text: Want as julle eet, gebruik elkeen eers sy eie ete; en die een het honger en die ander is dronk.

kjv_text: What? have ye not houses to eat and to drink in? or despise ye the church of God, and shame them that have not? What shall I say to you? shall I praise you in this? I praise you not.
bsb_text: Don’t you have your own homes in which to eat and drink? Or do you despise the church of God and humiliate those who have nothing? What can I say to you? Shall I praise you for this? No, I will not!
aov_text: Het julle dan geen huise om in te eet en te drink nie? Of verag julle die gemeente van God, en maak julle dié beskaamd wat nie het nie? Wat sal ek vir julle sê? Sal ek julle prys? Hierin prys ek julle nie.

kjv_text: For I have received of the Lord that which also I delivered unto you, That the Lord Jesus the same night in which he was betrayed took bread:
bsb_text: For I received from the Lord what I also passed on to you: The Lord Jesus, on the night He was betrayed, took bread,
aov_text: Want ek het van die Here ontvang wat ek ook aan julle oorgelewer het, dat die Here Jesus in die nag waarin Hy verraai is, brood geneem het;

kjv_text: And when he had given thanks, he brake it, and said, Take, eat: this is my body, which is broken for you: this do in remembrance of me.
bsb_text: and when He had given thanks, He broke it and said, “This is My body, which is for you; do this in remembrance of Me.”
aov_text: en nadat Hy gedank het, het Hy dit gebreek en gesê: Neem, eet; dit is my liggaam wat vir julle gebreek word; doen dit tot my gedagtenis.

kjv_text: After the same manner also he took the cup, when he had supped, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood: this do ye, as oft as ye drink it, in remembrance of me.
bsb_text: In the same way, after supper He took the cup, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in My blood; do this, as often as you drink it, in remembrance of Me.”
aov_text: Net so ook die beker ná die ete, met die woorde: Hierdie beker is die nuwe testament in my bloed; doen dit, so dikwels as julle daaruit drink, tot my gedagtenis.

kjv_text: For as often as ye eat this bread, and drink this cup, ye do shew the Lord's death till he come.
bsb_text: For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death until He comes.
aov_text: Want so dikwels as julle hierdie brood eet en hierdie beker drink, verkondig julle die dood van die Here totdat Hy kom.

kjv_text: Wherefore whosoever shall eat this bread, and drink this cup of the Lord, unworthily, shall be guilty of the body and blood of the Lord.
bsb_text: Therefore, whoever eats the bread or drinks the cup of the Lord in an unworthy manner will be guilty of sinning against the body and blood of the Lord.
aov_text: Wie dan op onwaardige wyse hierdie brood eet of die beker van die Here drink, sal skuldig wees aan die liggaam en bloed van die Here.

kjv_text: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of that bread, and drink of that cup.
bsb_text: Each one must examine himself before he eats of the bread and drinks of the cup.
aov_text: Maar die mens moet homself beproef en só van die brood eet en uit die beker drink.

kjv_text: For he that eateth and drinketh unworthily, eateth and drinketh damnation to himself, not discerning the Lord's body.
bsb_text: For anyone who eats and drinks without recognizing the body eats and drinks judgment on himself.
aov_text: Want wie op onwaardige wyse eet en drink, eet en drink ’n oordeel oor homself, terwyl hy die liggaam van die Here nie onderskei nie.

kjv_text: For this cause many are weak and sickly among you, and many sleep.
bsb_text: That is why many among you are weak and sick, and a number of you have fallen asleep.
aov_text: Daarom is daar onder julle baie swakkes en sieklikes, en ’n aantal het ontslaap.

kjv_text: For if we would judge ourselves, we should not be judged.
bsb_text: Now if we judged ourselves properly, we would not come under judgment.
aov_text: Want as ons onsself beoordeel het, sou ons nie geoordeel word nie.

kjv_text: But when we are judged, we are chastened of the Lord, that we should not be condemned with the world.
bsb_text: But when we are judged by the Lord, we are being disciplined so that we will not be condemned with the world.
aov_text: Maar as ons geoordeel word, word ons deur die Here getugtig, sodat ons nie saam met die wêreld veroordeel mag word nie.

kjv_text: Wherefore, my brethren, when ye come together to eat, tarry one for another.
bsb_text: So, my brothers, when you come together to eat, wait for one another.
aov_text: Daarom, my broeders, as julle saamkom om te eet, wag vir mekaar;

kjv_text: And if any man hunger, let him eat at home; that ye come not together unto condemnation. And the rest will I set in order when I come.
bsb_text: If anyone is hungry, he should eat at home, so that when you come together it will not result in judgment. And when I come, I will give instructions about the remaining matters.
aov_text: en as iemand honger het, laat hom by die huis eet, sodat julle nie tot ’n oordeel saamkom nie. Die ander sake sal ek reël wanneer ek kom.

kjv_text: Now concerning spiritual gifts, brethren, I would not have you ignorant.
bsb_text: Now about spiritual gifts, brothers, I do not want you to be uninformed.
aov_text: EN wat die geestelike gawes betref, broeders, wil ek nie hê dat julle onkundig moet wees nie.

kjv_text: Ye know that ye were Gentiles, carried away unto these dumb idols, even as ye were led.
bsb_text: You know that when you were pagans, you were influenced and led astray to mute idols.
aov_text: Julle weet dat julle heidene was, weggevoer na die stomme afgode net soos julle ook al gelei is.

kjv_text: Wherefore I give you to understand, that no man speaking by the Spirit of God calleth Jesus accursed: and that no man can say that Jesus is the Lord, but by the Holy Ghost.
bsb_text: Therefore I inform you that no one who is speaking by the Spirit of God says, “Jesus be cursed,” and no one can say, “Jesus is Lord,” except by the Holy Spirit.
aov_text: Daarom maak ek julle bekend dat niemand wat deur die Gees van God spreek, Jesus ’n vervloeking noem nie; en niemand kan sê dat Jesus die Here is nie, behalwe deur die Heilige Gees.

kjv_text: Now there are diversities of gifts, but the same Spirit.
bsb_text: There are different gifts, but the same Spirit.
aov_text: Daar is wel verskeidenheid van genadegawes, maar dit is dieselfde Gees;

kjv_text: And there are differences of administrations, but the same Lord.
bsb_text: There are different ministries, but the same Lord.
aov_text: en daar is verskeidenheid van bedieninge, en tog is dit dieselfde Here;

kjv_text: And there are diversities of operations, but it is the same God which worketh all in all.
bsb_text: There are different ways of working, but the same God works all things in all people.
aov_text: en daar is verskeidenheid van werkinge, en tog is dit dieselfde God wat alles in almal werk.

kjv_text: But the manifestation of the Spirit is given to every man to profit withal.
bsb_text: Now to each one the manifestation of the Spirit is given for the common good.
aov_text: Maar aan elkeen word die openbaring van die Gees gegee met die oog op wat nuttig is.

kjv_text: For to one is given by the Spirit the word of wisdom; to another the word of knowledge by the same Spirit;
bsb_text: To one there is given through the Spirit the message of wisdom, to another the message of knowledge by the same Spirit,
aov_text: Want aan die een word deur die Gees ’n woord van wysheid gegee, en aan die ander ’n woord van kennis vanweë dieselfde Gees;

kjv_text: To another faith by the same Spirit; to another the gifts of healing by the same Spirit;
bsb_text: to another faith by the same Spirit, to another gifts of healing by that one Spirit,
aov_text: aan ’n ander weer geloof deur dieselfde Gees, en aan ’n ander genadegawes van gesondmaking deur dieselfde Gees;

kjv_text: To another the working of miracles; to another prophecy; to another discerning of spirits; to another divers kinds of tongues; to another the interpretation of tongues:
bsb_text: to another the working of miracles, to another prophecy, to another distinguishing between spirits, to another speaking in various tongues, and to still another the interpretation of tongues.
aov_text: aan ’n ander werkinge van kragte, aan ’n ander profesie, aan ’n ander onderskeiding van die geeste, aan ’n ander allerhande tale, aan ’n ander uitleg van tale.

kjv_text: But all these worketh that one and the selfsame Spirit, dividing to every man severally as he will.
bsb_text: All these are the work of one and the same Spirit, who apportions them to each one as He determines.
aov_text: Maar al hierdie dinge werk een en dieselfde Gees wat aan elkeen afsonderlik uitdeel soos Hy wil.

kjv_text: For as the body is one, and hath many members, and all the members of that one body, being many, are one body: so also is Christ.
bsb_text: The body is a unit, though it is composed of many parts. And although its parts are many, they all form one body. So it is with Christ.
aov_text: WANT net soos die liggaam een is en baie lede het, en al die lede van die een liggaam, al is hulle baie, een liggaam is, so ook Christus.

kjv_text: For by one Spirit are we all baptized into one body, whether we be Jews or Gentiles, whether we be bond or free; and have been all made to drink into one Spirit.
bsb_text: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, slave or free, and we were all given one Spirit to drink.
aov_text: Want ons is almal ook deur een Gees gedoop tot een liggaam, of ons Jode of Grieke is, slawe of vrymanne; en ons is almal van een Gees deurdronge.

kjv_text: For the body is not one member, but many.
bsb_text: For the body does not consist of one part, but of many.
aov_text: Want ook die liggaam is nie een lid nie, maar baie.

kjv_text: If the foot shall say, Because I am not the hand, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?
bsb_text: If the foot should say, “Because I am not a hand, I do not belong to the body,” that would not make it any less a part of the body.
aov_text: As die voet sou sê: Omdat ek nie die hand is nie, behoort ek nie aan die liggaam nie — behoort hy daarom nie aan die liggaam nie?

kjv_text: And if the ear shall say, Because I am not the eye, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?
bsb_text: And if the ear should say, “Because I am not an eye, I do not belong to the body,” that would not make it any less a part of the body.
aov_text: En as die oor sou sê: Omdat ek nie die oog is nie, behoort ek nie aan die liggaam nie — behoort hy daarom nie aan die liggaam nie?

kjv_text: If the whole body were an eye, where were the hearing? If the whole were hearing, where were the smelling?
bsb_text: If the whole body were an eye, where would the sense of hearing be? If the whole body were an ear, where would the sense of smell be?
aov_text: As die hele liggaam oog was, waar sou die gehoor wees? As dit geheel en al gehoor was, waar sou die reuk wees?

kjv_text: But now hath God set the members every one of them in the body, as it hath pleased him.
bsb_text: But in fact, God has arranged the members of the body, every one of them, according to His design.
aov_text: Maar nou het God elkeen van die lede in die liggaam gestel soos Hy gewil het.

kjv_text: And if they were all one member, where were the body?
bsb_text: If they were all one part, where would the body be?
aov_text: As almal een lid was, waar sou die liggaam wees?

kjv_text: But now are they many members, yet but one body.
bsb_text: As it is, there are many parts, but one body.
aov_text: Maar nou is daar wel baie lede, maar net een liggaam.

kjv_text: And the eye cannot say unto the hand, I have no need of thee: nor again the head to the feet, I have no need of you.
bsb_text: The eye cannot say to the hand, “I do not need you.” Nor can the head say to the feet, “I do not need you.”
aov_text: En die oog kan nie vir die hand sê: Ek het jou nie nodig nie; of ook die hoof vir die voete: Ek het julle nie nodig nie.

kjv_text: Nay, much more those members of the body, which seem to be more feeble, are necessary:
bsb_text: On the contrary, the parts of the body that seem to be weaker are indispensable,
aov_text: Maar veel eerder is dié lede van die liggaam noodsaaklik wat die swakste lyk;

kjv_text: And those members of the body, which we think to be less honourable, upon these we bestow more abundant honour; and our uncomely parts have more abundant comeliness.
bsb_text: and the parts we consider less honorable, we treat with greater honor. And our unpresentable parts are treated with special modesty,
aov_text: en dié lede van die liggaam wat vir ons minder eerbaar lyk, beklee ons met oorvloediger eer, en so het ons onsierlike lede oorvloediger sierlikheid,

kjv_text: For our comely parts have no need: but God hath tempered the body together, having given more abundant honour to that part which lacked:
bsb_text: whereas our presentable parts have no such need. But God has composed the body and has given greater honor to the parts that lacked it,
aov_text: terwyl ons sierlike lede dit nie nodig het nie; maar God het die liggaam saamgestel en aan die misdeelde lid oorvloediger eer gegee,

kjv_text: That there should be no schism in the body; but that the members should have the same care one for another.
bsb_text: so that there should be no division in the body, but that its members should have mutual concern for one another.
aov_text: sodat daar geen verdeeldheid in die liggaam mag wees nie, maar dat die lede gelyke sorg vir mekaar mag dra.

kjv_text: And whether one member suffer, all the members suffer with it; or one member be honoured, all the members rejoice with it.
bsb_text: If one part suffers, every part suffers with it; if one part is honored, every part rejoices with it.
aov_text: En as een lid ly, ly al die lede saam; en as een lid geëer word, is al die lede saam bly.

kjv_text: Now ye are the body of Christ, and members in particular.
bsb_text: Now you are the body of Christ, and each of you is a member of it.
aov_text: Maar julle is die liggaam van Christus en lede afsonderlik.

kjv_text: And God hath set some in the church, first apostles, secondarily prophets, thirdly teachers, after that miracles, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, diversities of tongues.
bsb_text: And in the church God has appointed first of all apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then workers of miracles, and those with gifts of healing, helping, administration, and various tongues.
aov_text: En God het sommige in die gemeente gestel: in die eerste plek apostels, ten tweede profete, ten derde leraars, daarna kragte, daarna genadegawes van gesondmaking, helpers, regeringe, allerhande tale.

kjv_text: Are all apostles? are all prophets? are all teachers? are all workers of miracles?
bsb_text: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Do all work miracles?
aov_text: Almal is tog nie apostels nie, almal is tog nie profete nie, almal is tog nie leraars nie, almal is tog nie kragte nie?

kjv_text: Have all the gifts of healing? do all speak with tongues? do all interpret?
bsb_text: Do all have gifts of healing? Do all speak in tongues? Do all interpret?
aov_text: Het almal genadegawes van gesondmaking, spreek almal in tale, kan almal dit uitlê?

kjv_text: But covet earnestly the best gifts: and yet shew I unto you a more excellent way.
bsb_text: But eagerly desire the greater gifts. And now I will show you the most excellent way.
aov_text: Maar beywer julle met die oog op die beste gawes; en ek wys julle ’n nog uitnemender weg.

kjv_text: Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, and have not charity, I am become as sounding brass, or a tinkling cymbal.
bsb_text: If I speak in the tongues of men and of angels, but have not love, I am only a ringing gong or a clanging cymbal.
aov_text: AL sou ek die tale van mense en engele spreek, en ek het nie die liefde nie, dan het ek ’n klinkende metaal of ’n luidende simbaal geword.

kjv_text: And though I have the gift of prophecy, and understand all mysteries, and all knowledge; and though I have all faith, so that I could remove mountains, and have not charity, I am nothing.
bsb_text: If I have the gift of prophecy and can fathom all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have absolute faith so as to move mountains, but have not love, I am nothing.
aov_text: En al sou ek die gawe van profesie hê en al die geheimenisse weet en al die kennis, en al sou ek al die geloof hê, sodat ek berge kon versit, en ek het nie die liefde nie, dan sou ek niks wees nie.

kjv_text: And though I bestow all my goods to feed the poor, and though I give my body to be burned, and have not charity, it profiteth me nothing.
bsb_text: If I give all I possess to the poor and exult in the surrender of my body, but have not love, I gain nothing.
aov_text: En al sou ek al my goed uitdeel, en al sou ek my liggaam oorgee om verbrand te word, en ek het nie die liefde nie, dan sou dit my niks baat nie.

kjv_text: Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up,
bsb_text: Love is patient, love is kind. It does not envy, it does not boast, it is not proud.
aov_text: Die liefde is lankmoedig en vriendelik; die liefde is nie jaloers nie; die liefde praat nie groot nie, is nie opgeblase nie,

kjv_text: Doth not behave itself unseemly, seeketh not her own, is not easily provoked, thinketh no evil;
bsb_text: It is not rude, it is not self-seeking, it is not easily angered, it keeps no account of wrongs.
aov_text: handel nie onwelvoeglik nie, soek nie sy eie belang nie, word nie verbitterd nie, reken die kwaad nie toe nie,

kjv_text: Rejoiceth not in iniquity, but rejoiceth in the truth;
bsb_text: Love takes no pleasure in evil, but rejoices in the truth.
aov_text: is nie bly oor die ongeregtigheid nie, maar is bly saam met die waarheid.

kjv_text: Beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things.
bsb_text: It bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.
aov_text: Dit bedek alles, glo alles, hoop alles, verdra alles.

kjv_text: Charity never faileth: but whether there be prophecies, they shall fail; whether there be tongues, they shall cease; whether there be knowledge, it shall vanish away.
bsb_text: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will cease; where there are tongues, they will be restrained; where there is knowledge, it will be dismissed.
aov_text: Die liefde vergaan nimmermeer; maar profesieë — hulle sal tot niet gaan; of tale — hulle sal ophou; of kennis — dit sal tot niet gaan.

kjv_text: For we know in part, and we prophesy in part.
bsb_text: For we know in part and we prophesy in part,
aov_text: Want ons ken ten dele en ons profeteer ten dele.

kjv_text: But when that which is perfect is come, then that which is in part shall be done away.
bsb_text: but when the perfect comes, the partial passes away.
aov_text: Maar as die volmaakte gekom het, dan sal wat ten dele is, tot niet gaan.

kjv_text: When I was a child, I spake as a child, I understood as a child, I thought as a child: but when I became a man, I put away childish things.
bsb_text: When I was a child, I talked like a child, I thought like a child, I reasoned like a child. When I became a man, I set aside childish ways.
aov_text: Toe ek ’n kind was, het ek gepraat soos ’n kind, gedink soos ’n kind, geredeneer soos ’n kind; maar nou dat ek ’n man is, het ek die dinge van ’n kind afgelê.

kjv_text: For now we see through a glass, darkly; but then face to face: now I know in part; but then shall I know even as also I am known.
bsb_text: Now we see but a dim reflection as in a mirror; then we shall see face to face. Now I know in part; then I shall know fully, even as I am fully known.
aov_text: Want nou sien ons deur ’n spieël in ’n raaisel, maar eendag van aangesig tot aangesig. Nou ken ek ten dele, maar eendag sal ek ten volle ken, net soos ek ten volle geken is.

kjv_text: And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.
bsb_text: And now these three remain: faith, hope, and love; but the greatest of these is love.
aov_text: En nou bly geloof, hoop, liefde — hierdie drie; maar die grootste hiervan is die liefde.

kjv_text: Follow after charity, and desire spiritual gifts, but rather that ye may prophesy.
bsb_text: Earnestly pursue love and eagerly desire spiritual gifts, especially the gift of prophecy.
aov_text: JAAG die liefde na, en beywer julle met die oog op die geestelike gawes, maar veral om te profeteer.

kjv_text: For he that speaketh in an unknown tongue speaketh not unto men, but unto God: for no man understandeth him; howbeit in the spirit he speaketh mysteries.
bsb_text: For he who speaks in a tongue does not speak to men, but to God. Indeed, no one understands him; he utters mysteries in the Spirit.
aov_text: Want hy wat in ’n taal spreek, spreek nie tot mense nie, maar tot God; want niemand verstaan dit nie, maar deur die Gees spreek hy verborgenhede.

kjv_text: But he that prophesieth speaketh unto men to edification, and exhortation, and comfort.
bsb_text: But he who prophesies speaks to men for their edification, encouragement, and comfort.
aov_text: Maar hy wat profeteer, spreek tot die mense woorde van stigting en troos en bemoediging.

kjv_text: He that speaketh in an unknown tongue edifieth himself; but he that prophesieth edifieth the church.
bsb_text: The one who speaks in a tongue edifies himself, but the one who prophesies edifies the church.
aov_text: Hy wat in ’n taal spreek, stig homself; maar hy wat profeteer, stig die gemeente.

kjv_text: I would that ye all spake with tongues, but rather that ye prophesied: for greater is he that prophesieth than he that speaketh with tongues, except he interpret, that the church may receive edifying.
bsb_text: I wish that all of you could speak in tongues, but I would rather have you prophesy. He who prophesies is greater than one who speaks in tongues, unless he interprets so that the church may be edified.
aov_text: Ek wens dat julle almal in tale spreek, maar nog liewer dat julle profeteer. Want hy wat profeteer, is groter as hy wat in tale spreek, of hy moet dit uitlê, sodat die gemeente stigting kan ontvang.

kjv_text: Now, brethren, if I come unto you speaking with tongues, what shall I profit you, except I shall speak to you either by revelation, or by knowledge, or by prophesying, or by doctrine?
bsb_text: Now, brothers, if I come to you speaking in tongues, how will I benefit you, unless I bring you some revelation or knowledge or prophecy or teaching?
aov_text: Maar nou, broeders, as ek na julle kom en in tale spreek, tot watter nut sal ek vir julle wees as ek nie met julle spreek òf deur ’n openbaring, òf deur kennis, òf deur profesie, òf deur lering nie?

kjv_text: And even things without life giving sound, whether pipe or harp, except they give a distinction in the sounds, how shall it be known what is piped or harped?
bsb_text: Even in the case of lifeless instruments, such as the flute or harp, how will anyone recognize the tune they are playing unless the notes are distinct?
aov_text: Net soos met lewelose dinge wat ’n klank gee, ’n fluit of ’n siter, as hulle nie ’n onderskeid in toon laat hoor nie, hoe sal ’n mens weet wat op die fluit of siter gespeel word?

kjv_text: For if the trumpet give an uncertain sound, who shall prepare himself to the battle?
bsb_text: Again, if the trumpet sounds a muffled call, who will prepare for battle?
aov_text: Want as die basuin ook ’n onduidelike klank gee, wie sal klaarmaak vir die oorlog?

kjv_text: So likewise ye, except ye utter by the tongue words easy to be understood, how shall it be known what is spoken? for ye shall speak into the air.
bsb_text: So it is with you. Unless you speak intelligible words with your tongue, how will anyone know what you are saying? You will just be speaking into the air.
aov_text: Net so julle ook, as julle met die tong geen verstaanbare woord uitbring nie, hoe sal ’n mens weet wat gespreek word? Want julle sal wees soos mense wat in die wind praat.

kjv_text: There are, it may be, so many kinds of voices in the world, and none of them is without signification.
bsb_text: Assuredly, there are many different languages in the world, yet none of them is without meaning.
aov_text: Daar is wie weet hoeveel soorte tale in die wêreld, en geeneen daarvan is sonder klank nie.

kjv_text: Therefore if I know not the meaning of the voice, I shall be unto him that speaketh a barbarian, and he that speaketh shall be a barbarian unto me.
bsb_text: If, then, I do not know the meaning of someone’s language, I am a foreigner to the speaker, and he is a foreigner to me.
aov_text: As ek dan die betekenis van die klank nie ken nie, sal ek vir die spreker ’n vreemdeling wees, en die spreker sal vir my ’n vreemdeling wees.

kjv_text: Even so ye, forasmuch as ye are zealous of spiritual gifts, seek that ye may excel to the edifying of the church.
bsb_text: It is the same with you. Since you are eager to have spiritual gifts, strive to excel in gifts that build up the church.
aov_text: So moet julle ook, terwyl julle streef na geestelike gawes, probeer om uit te munt tot stigting van die gemeente.

kjv_text: Wherefore let him that speaketh in an unknown tongue pray that he may interpret.
bsb_text: Therefore, the one who speaks in a tongue should pray that he may interpret.
aov_text: Daarom moet hy wat in ’n taal spreek, bid dat hy dit kan uitlê.

kjv_text: For if I pray in an unknown tongue, my spirit prayeth, but my understanding is unfruitful.
bsb_text: For if I pray in a tongue, my spirit prays, but my mind is unfruitful.
aov_text: Want as ek in ’n taal bid, dan bid my gees, maar my verstand is onvrugbaar.

kjv_text: What is it then? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also: I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.
bsb_text: What then shall I do? I will pray with my spirit, but I will also pray with my mind. I will sing with my spirit, but I will also sing with my mind.
aov_text: Hoe staan die saak dan? Ek sal met die gees bid, maar ek sal ook met die verstand bid. Ek sal met die gees psalmsing, maar ek sal ook met die verstand psalmsing.

kjv_text: Else when thou shalt bless with the spirit, how shall he that occupieth the room of the unlearned say Amen at thy giving of thanks, seeing he understandeth not what thou sayest?
bsb_text: Otherwise, if you speak a blessing in spirit, how can someone who is uninstructed say “Amen” to your thanksgiving, since he does not know what you are saying?
aov_text: Anders, as jy met die gees dank, hoe sal hy wat die plek van ’n onkundige inneem, amen sê op jou danksegging, aangesien hy nie weet wat jy sê nie?

kjv_text: For thou verily givest thanks well, but the other is not edified.
bsb_text: You may be giving thanks well enough, but the other one is not edified.
aov_text: Want jy dank wel goed, maar die ander een word nie gestig nie.

kjv_text: I thank my God, I speak with tongues more than ye all:
bsb_text: I thank God that I speak in tongues more than all of you.
aov_text: Ek dank my God dat ek meer in tale spreek as julle almal;

kjv_text: Yet in the church I had rather speak five words with my understanding, that by my voice I might teach others also, than ten thousand words in an unknown tongue.
bsb_text: But in the church, I would rather speak five coherent words to instruct others than ten thousand words in a tongue.
aov_text: maar in die gemeente wil ek liewer vyf woorde met my verstand spreek om ook ander te onderrig, as tienduisend woorde in ’n taal.

kjv_text: Brethren, be not children in understanding: howbeit in malice be ye children, but in understanding be men.
bsb_text: Brothers, stop thinking like children. In regard to evil be infants, but in your thinking be mature.
aov_text: Broeders, moenie kinders wees in die verstand nie, maar wees kinders in die boosheid en wees volwassenes in die verstand.

kjv_text: In the law it is written, With men of other tongues and other lips will I speak unto this people; and yet for all that will they not hear me, saith the LORD.
bsb_text: It is written in the Law: “By strange tongues and foreign lips I will speak to this people, but even then they will not listen to Me, says the Lord.”
aov_text: In die wet is geskrywe: Ek sal deur mense van ander tale en deur ander lippe tot hierdie volk spreek, en ook so sal hulle na My nie luister nie, sê die Here.

kjv_text: Wherefore tongues are for a sign, not to them that believe, but to them that believe not: but prophesying serveth not for them that believe not, but for them which believe.
bsb_text: Tongues, then, are a sign, not for believers, but for unbelievers. Prophecy, however, is for believers, not for unbelievers.
aov_text: Die tale is dus ’n teken nie vir die gelowiges nie, maar vir die ongelowiges; die profesie egter is nie vir die ongelowiges nie, maar vir die gelowiges.

kjv_text: If therefore the whole church be come together into one place, and all speak with tongues, and there come in those that are unlearned, or unbelievers, will they not say that ye are mad?
bsb_text: So if the whole church comes together and everyone speaks in tongues, and some who are uninstructed or some unbelievers come in, will they not say that you are out of your minds?
aov_text: As die hele gemeente dan saam vergader het en hulle sou almal in tale spreek en daar kom onkundiges of ongelowiges binne, sal hulle nie sê dat julle kranksinnig is nie?

kjv_text: But if all prophesy, and there come in one that believeth not, or one unlearned, he is convinced of all, he is judged of all:
bsb_text: But if an unbeliever or uninstructed person comes in while everyone is prophesying, he will be convicted and called to account by all,
aov_text: Maar as almal profeteer en daar ’n ongelowige of ’n onkundige binnekom, dan word hy deur almal oortuig, deur almal beoordeel;

kjv_text: And thus are the secrets of his heart made manifest; and so falling down on his face he will worship God, and report that God is in you of a truth.
bsb_text: and the secrets of his heart will be made known. So he will fall facedown and worship God, proclaiming, “God is truly among you!”
aov_text: en so kom die geheime van sy hart aan die lig. En so sal hy op sy aangesig val, God aanbid, en verkondig dat God werklik onder julle is.

kjv_text: How is it then, brethren? when ye come together, every one of you hath a psalm, hath a doctrine, hath a tongue, hath a revelation, hath an interpretation. Let all things be done unto edifying.
bsb_text: What then shall we say, brothers? When you come together, everyone has a psalm or a teaching, a revelation, a tongue, or an interpretation. All of these must be done to build up the church.
aov_text: HOE staan die saak dan, broeders? Wanneer julle saamkom, dan het elkeen van julle ’n psalm of ’n lering of ’n taal of ’n openbaring of ’n uitlegging — laat alles tot stigting geskied.

kjv_text: If any man speak in an unknown tongue, let it be by two, or at the most by three, and that by course; and let one interpret.
bsb_text: If anyone speaks in a tongue, two, or at most three, should speak in turn, and someone must interpret.
aov_text: En as iemand in ’n taal spreek, laat dit dan wees twee of hoogstens drie, en by beurte; en laat een dit uitlê.

kjv_text: But if there be no interpreter, let him keep silence in the church; and let him speak to himself, and to God.
bsb_text: But if there is no interpreter, he should remain silent in the church and speak only to himself and God.
aov_text: Maar as daar geen uitlêer is nie, laat hy in die gemeente swyg, en laat hy met homself en met God spreek.

kjv_text: Let the prophets speak two or three, and let the other judge.
bsb_text: Two or three prophets should speak, and the others should weigh carefully what is said.
aov_text: Laat twee of drie profete spreek en die ander dit beoordeel.

kjv_text: If any thing be revealed to another that sitteth by, let the first hold his peace.
bsb_text: And if a revelation comes to someone who is seated, the first speaker should stop.
aov_text: Maar as daar iets geopenbaar is aan ’n ander wat daar sit, laat die eerste swyg.

kjv_text: For ye may all prophesy one by one, that all may learn, and all may be comforted.
bsb_text: For you can all prophesy in turn so that everyone may be instructed and encouraged.
aov_text: Want julle kan almal een vir een profeteer, sodat almal kan leer en almal bemoedig word.

kjv_text: And the spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets.
bsb_text: The spirits of prophets are subject to prophets.
aov_text: En die geeste van die profete is aan die profete onderworpe;

kjv_text: For God is not the author of confusion, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints.
bsb_text: For God is not a God of disorder, but of peace—as in all the churches of the saints.
aov_text: want God is nie ’n God van wanorde nie, maar van vrede, soos in al die gemeentes van die heiliges.

kjv_text: Let your women keep silence in the churches: for it is not permitted unto them to speak; but they are commanded to be under obedience, as also saith the law.
bsb_text: Women are to be silent in the churches. They are not permitted to speak, but must be in submission, as the law says.
aov_text: Julle vroue moet in die gemeentes swyg; want dit is hulle nie toegelaat om te spreek nie, maar om onderdanig te wees, soos die wet ook sê.

kjv_text: And if they will learn any thing, let them ask their husbands at home: for it is a shame for women to speak in the church.
bsb_text: If they wish to inquire about something, they are to ask their own husbands at home; for it is dishonorable for a woman to speak in the church.
aov_text: Maar as hulle iets wil leer, laat hulle tuis hul eie mans vra, want dit is lelik vir vroue om in die gemeente te spreek.

kjv_text: What? came the word of God out from you? or came it unto you only?
bsb_text: Did the word of God originate with you? Or are you the only ones it has reached?
aov_text: Of het die woord van God van julle uitgegaan, of het dit tot julle alleen gekom?

kjv_text: If any man think himself to be a prophet, or spiritual, let him acknowledge that the things that I write unto you are the commandments of the Lord.
bsb_text: If anyone considers himself a prophet or spiritual person, let him acknowledge that what I am writing you is the Lord’s command.
aov_text: As iemand meen dat hy ’n profeet of ’n geestelike mens is, moet hy erken dat wat ek aan julle skrywe, bevele van die Here is.

kjv_text: But if any man be ignorant, let him be ignorant.
bsb_text: But if anyone ignores this, he himself will be ignored.
aov_text: Maar as iemand onkundig is, laat hom onkundig bly.

kjv_text: Wherefore, brethren, covet to prophesy, and forbid not to speak with tongues.
bsb_text: So, my brothers, be eager to prophesy, and do not forbid speaking in tongues.
aov_text: Daarom, broeders, beywer julle om te profeteer en moenie verhinder dat daar in tale gespreek word nie.

kjv_text: Let all things be done decently and in order.
bsb_text: But everything must be done in a proper and orderly manner.
aov_text: Laat alles welvoeglik en ordelik toegaan.

kjv_text: Moreover, brethren, I declare unto you the gospel which I preached unto you, which also ye have received, and wherein ye stand;
bsb_text: Now, brothers, I want to remind you of the gospel I preached to you, which you received, and in which you stand firm.
aov_text: BROEDERS, ek maak julle die evangelie bekend wat ek aan julle verkondig het, wat julle ook aangeneem het, waarin julle ook staan,

kjv_text: By which also ye are saved, if ye keep in memory what I preached unto you, unless ye have believed in vain.
bsb_text: By this gospel you are saved, if you hold firmly to the word I preached to you. Otherwise, you have believed in vain.
aov_text: waardeur julle ook gered word as julle daaraan vashou op die wyse waarop ek dit aan julle verkondig het, of julle moet tevergeefs geglo het.

kjv_text: For I delivered unto you first of all that which I also received, how that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures;
bsb_text: For what I received I passed on to you as of first importance: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,
aov_text: Want in die eerste plek het ek aan julle oorgelewer wat ek ook ontvang het, dat Christus vir ons sondes gesterf het volgens die Skrifte;

kjv_text: And that he was buried, and that he rose again the third day according to the scriptures:
bsb_text: that He was buried, that He was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,
aov_text: en dat Hy begrawe is, en dat Hy op die derde dag opgewek is volgens die Skrifte;

kjv_text: And that he was seen of Cephas, then of the twelve:
bsb_text: and that He appeared to Cephas and then to the Twelve.
aov_text: en dat Hy aan Céfas verskyn het; daarna aan die twaalf.

kjv_text: After that, he was seen of above five hundred brethren at once; of whom the greater part remain unto this present, but some are fallen asleep.
bsb_text: After that, He appeared to more than five hundred brothers at once, most of whom are still living, though some have fallen asleep.
aov_text: Daarna het Hy verskyn aan oor die vyfhonderd broeders tegelyk, waarvan die meeste nou nog lewe, maar sommige al ontslaap het.

kjv_text: After that, he was seen of James; then of all the apostles.
bsb_text: Then He appeared to James, then to all the apostles.
aov_text: Daarna het Hy verskyn aan Jakobus; daarna aan al die apostels;

kjv_text: And last of all he was seen of me also, as of one born out of due time.
bsb_text: And last of all He appeared to me also, as to one of untimely birth.
aov_text: en laaste van almal het Hy verskyn ook aan my as die ontydig geborene.

kjv_text: For I am the least of the apostles, that am not meet to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.
bsb_text: For I am the least of the apostles and am unworthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.
aov_text: Want ek is die geringste van die apostels, wat nie werd is om ’n apostel genoem te word nie, omdat ek die gemeente van God vervolg het.

kjv_text: But by the grace of God I am what I am: and his grace which was bestowed upon me was not in vain; but I laboured more abundantly than they all: yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.
bsb_text: But by the grace of God I am what I am, and His grace to me was not in vain. No, I worked harder than all of them—yet not I, but the grace of God that was with me.
aov_text: Maar deur die genade van God is ek wat ek is, en sy genade aan my was nie tevergeefs nie; maar ek het oorvloediger gearbei as hulle almal; nogtans nie ek nie, maar die genade van God wat met my is.

kjv_text: Therefore whether it were I or they, so we preach, and so ye believed.
bsb_text: Whether, then, it was I or they, this is what we preach, and this is what you believed.
aov_text: Of dit nou ek of hulle is, so preek ons en so het julle geglo.

kjv_text: Now if Christ be preached that he rose from the dead, how say some among you that there is no resurrection of the dead?
bsb_text: But if it is preached that Christ has been raised from the dead, how can some of you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?
aov_text: As dit dan gepreek word dat Christus uit die dode opgewek is, hoe sê sommige onder julle dat daar geen opstanding van die dode is nie?

kjv_text: But if there be no resurrection of the dead, then is Christ not risen:
bsb_text: If there is no resurrection of the dead, then not even Christ has been raised.
aov_text: As daar geen opstanding van die dode is nie, dan is Christus ook nie opgewek nie.

kjv_text: And if Christ be not risen, then is our preaching vain, and your faith is also vain.
bsb_text: And if Christ has not been raised, our preaching is worthless, and so is your faith.
aov_text: En as Christus nie opgewek is nie, dan is ons prediking vergeefs en vergeefs ook julle geloof;

kjv_text: Yea, and we are found false witnesses of God; because we have testified of God that he raised up Christ: whom he raised not up, if so be that the dead rise not.
bsb_text: In that case, we are also exposed as false witnesses about God. For we have testified about God that He raised Christ from the dead, but He did not raise Him if in fact the dead are not raised.
aov_text: en dan word ons valse getuies van God bevind, omdat ons teen God getuig het dat Hy Christus opgewek het, wat Hy nie opgewek het nie, ten minste as die dode nie opgewek word nie.

kjv_text: For if the dead rise not, then is not Christ raised:
bsb_text: For if the dead are not raised, then not even Christ has been raised.
aov_text: Want as die dode nie opgewek word nie, dan is Christus ook nie opgewek nie;

kjv_text: And if Christ be not raised, your faith is vain; ye are yet in your sins.
bsb_text: And if Christ has not been raised, your faith is futile; you are still in your sins.
aov_text: en as Christus nie opgewek is nie, dan is julle geloof nutteloos, dan is julle nog in julle sondes;

kjv_text: Then they also which are fallen asleep in Christ are perished.
bsb_text: Then those also who have fallen asleep in Christ have perished.
aov_text: dan is ook die wat in Christus ontslaap het, verlore.

kjv_text: If in this life only we have hope in Christ, we are of all men most miserable.
bsb_text: If our hope in Christ is for this life alone, we are to be pitied more than all men.
aov_text: As ons net vir hierdie lewe op Christus hoop, dan is ons die ellendigste van alle mense.

kjv_text: But now is Christ risen from the dead, and become the firstfruits of them that slept.
bsb_text: But Christ has indeed been raised from the dead, the firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep.
aov_text: Maar nou, Christus is opgewek uit die dode; Hy het die eersteling geword van die wat ontslaap het.

kjv_text: For since by man came death, by man came also the resurrection of the dead.
bsb_text: For since death came through a man, the resurrection of the dead comes also through a man.
aov_text: Want aangesien die dood deur ’n mens is, is die opstanding van die dode ook deur ’n mens.

kjv_text: For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive.
bsb_text: For as in Adam all die, so in Christ all will be made alive.
aov_text: Want soos hulle almal in Adam sterwe, so sal hulle ook almal in Christus lewend gemaak word;

kjv_text: But every man in his own order: Christ the firstfruits; afterward they that are Christ's at his coming.
bsb_text: But each in his own turn: Christ the firstfruits; then at His coming, those who belong to Him.
aov_text: maar elkeen in sy eie orde: as eersteling Christus, daarna die wat aan Christus behoort by sy koms.

kjv_text: Then cometh the end, when he shall have delivered up the kingdom to God, even the Father; when he shall have put down all rule and all authority and power.
bsb_text: Then the end will come, when He hands over the kingdom to God the Father after He has destroyed all dominion, authority, and power.
aov_text: Daarna kom die einde, wanneer Hy die koninkryk aan God die Vader oorgee, as Hy alle heerskappy en alle gesag en mag vernietig het.

kjv_text: For he must reign, till he hath put all enemies under his feet.
bsb_text: For He must reign until He has put all His enemies under His feet.
aov_text: Want Hy moet as koning heers totdat Hy al sy vyande onder sy voete gestel het.

kjv_text: The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death.
bsb_text: The last enemy to be destroyed is death.
aov_text: Die laaste vyand wat vernietig word, is die dood.

kjv_text: For he hath put all things under his feet. But when he saith all things are put under him, it is manifest that he is excepted, which did put all things under him.
bsb_text: For “God has put everything under His feet.” Now when it says that everything has been put under Him, this clearly does not include the One who put everything under Him.
aov_text: Want Hy het alles aan sy voete onderwerp, maar wanneer Hy sê dat alles onderwerp is, is dit duidelik dat Hy uitgesonder is wat alles aan Hom onderwerp het.

kjv_text: And when all things shall be subdued unto him, then shall the Son also himself be subject unto him that put all things under him, that God may be all in all.
bsb_text: And when all things have been subjected to Him, then the Son Himself will be made subject to Him who put all things under Him, so that God may be all in all.
aov_text: En wanneer alles aan Hom onderwerp is, dan sal ook die Seun self Hom onderwerp aan die Een wat alles aan Hom onderwerp het, sodat God alles in almal kan wees.

kjv_text: Else what shall they do which are baptized for the dead, if the dead rise not at all? why are they then baptized for the dead?
bsb_text: If these things are not so, what will those do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead are not raised at all, why are people baptized for them?
aov_text: Anders, wat sal hulle doen wat hulle vir die dode laat doop, as die dode geheel en al nie opgewek word nie? Waarom laat hulle hul nog vir die dode doop?

kjv_text: And why stand we in jeopardy every hour?
bsb_text: And why do we endanger ourselves every hour?
aov_text: Waarom is ons ook elke uur in gevaar?

kjv_text: I protest by your rejoicing which I have in Christ Jesus our LORD, I die daily.
bsb_text: I face death every day, brothers, as surely as I boast about you in Christ Jesus our Lord.
aov_text: Ek sterf dag vir dag, broeders, so waar as ek op julle roem in Christus Jesus, onse Here.

kjv_text: If after the manner of men I have fought with beasts at Ephesus, what advantageth it me, if the dead rise not? let us eat and drink; for to morrow we die.
bsb_text: If I fought wild beasts in Ephesus for human motives, what did I gain? If the dead are not raised, “Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.”
aov_text: As ek in Éfese op menslike wyse met wilde diere geveg het, watter voordeel was dit vir my? As die dode nie opgewek word nie, laat ons dan eet en drink, want môre sterf ons!

kjv_text: Be not deceived: evil communications corrupt good manners.
bsb_text: Do not be deceived: “Bad company corrupts good character.”
aov_text: Moenie dwaal nie; slegte gesprekke bederf goeie sedes.

kjv_text: Awake to righteousness, and sin not; for some have not the knowledge of God: I speak this to your shame.
bsb_text: Sober up as you ought, and stop sinning; for some of you are ignorant of God. I say this to your shame.
aov_text: Wees nugter op die regte manier, en sondig nie; want sommige het geen kennis van God nie. Ek sê dit tot julle beskaming.

kjv_text: But some man will say, How are the dead raised up? and with what body do they come?
bsb_text: But someone will ask, “How are the dead raised? With what kind of body will they come?”
aov_text: Maar iemand sal sê: Hoe word die dode opgewek, en met hoedanige liggaam kom hulle?

kjv_text: Thou fool, that which thou sowest is not quickened, except it die:
bsb_text: You fool! What you sow does not come to life unless it dies.
aov_text: Dwase mens! Wat jy saai, word nie lewendig as dit nie gesterf het nie.

kjv_text: And that which thou sowest, thou sowest not that body that shall be, but bare grain, it may chance of wheat, or of some other grain:
bsb_text: And what you sow is not the body that will be, but just a seed, perhaps of wheat or something else.
aov_text: En wat jy saai — jy saai nie die liggaam wat sal word nie, maar ’n blote korrel, byvoorbeeld van koring of van iets anders.

kjv_text: But God giveth it a body as it hath pleased him, and to every seed his own body.
bsb_text: But God gives it a body as He has designed, and to each kind of seed He gives its own body.
aov_text: Maar God gee dit ’n liggaam soos Hy gewil het, en aan elkeen van die saadkorrels sy eie liggaam.

kjv_text: All flesh is not the same flesh: but there is one kind of flesh of men, another flesh of beasts, another of fishes, and another of birds.
bsb_text: Not all flesh is the same: Men have one kind of flesh, animals have another, birds another, and fish another.
aov_text: Alle vlees is nie dieselfde vlees nie, maar die vlees van mense is anders as die vlees van vee, en dié van visse anders as dié van voëls.

kjv_text: There are also celestial bodies, and bodies terrestrial: but the glory of the celestial is one, and the glory of the terrestrial is another.
bsb_text: There are also heavenly bodies and earthly bodies. But the splendor of the heavenly bodies is of one degree, and the splendor of the earthly bodies is of another.
aov_text: En daar is hemelse liggame en aardse liggame; maar die heerlikheid van die hemelse is anders as dié van die aardse.

kjv_text: There is one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars: for one star differeth from another star in glory.
bsb_text: The sun has one degree of splendor, the moon another, and the stars another; and star differs from star in splendor.
aov_text: Anders is die heerlikheid van die son en anders die heerlikheid van die maan en anders die heerlikheid van die sterre; want die een ster verskil in heerlikheid van die ander ster.

kjv_text: So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption:
bsb_text: So will it be with the resurrection of the dead: What is sown is perishable; it is raised imperishable.
