aov_text: So is ook die opstanding van die dode: daar word gesaai in verganklikheid, daar word opgewek in onverganklikheid;

kjv_text: It is sown in dishonour; it is raised in glory: it is sown in weakness; it is raised in power:
bsb_text: It is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness; it is raised in power.
aov_text: daar word gesaai in oneer, daar word opgewek in heerlikheid; daar word gesaai in swakheid, daar word opgewek in krag.

kjv_text: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body, and there is a spiritual body.
bsb_text: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. If there is a natural body, there is also a spiritual body.
aov_text: ’n Natuurlike liggaam word gesaai, ’n geestelike liggaam word opgewek. Daar is ’n natuurlike liggaam, en daar is ’n geestelike liggaam.

kjv_text: And so it is written, The first man Adam was made a living soul; the last Adam was made a quickening spirit.
bsb_text: So it is written: “The first man Adam became a living being;” the last Adam a life-giving spirit.
aov_text: So is daar ook geskrywe: Die eerste mens, Adam, het ’n lewende siel geword; die laaste Adam ’n lewendmakende Gees.

kjv_text: Howbeit that was not first which is spiritual, but that which is natural; and afterward that which is spiritual.
bsb_text: The spiritual, however, was not first, but the natural, and then the spiritual.
aov_text: Die geestelike ewenwel is nie eerste nie, maar die natuurlike; daarna die geestelike.

kjv_text: The first man is of the earth, earthy: the second man is the Lord from heaven.
bsb_text: The first man was of the dust of the earth, the second man from heaven.
aov_text: Die eerste mens was uit die aarde aards, die tweede mens is die Here uit die hemel.

kjv_text: As is the earthy, such are they also that are earthy: and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.
bsb_text: As was the earthly man, so also are those who are of the earth; and as is the heavenly man, so also are those who are of heaven.
aov_text: Soos die aardse mens was, so is ook die aardse mense; en soos die hemelse mens is, so is ook die hemelse mense.

kjv_text: And as we have borne the image of the earthy, we shall also bear the image of the heavenly.
bsb_text: And just as we have borne the likeness of the earthly man, so also shall we bear the likeness of the heavenly man.
aov_text: En soos ons die beeld van die aardse gedra het, so sal ons ook die beeld van die hemelse dra.

kjv_text: Now this I say, brethren, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God; neither doth corruption inherit incorruption.
bsb_text: Now I declare to you, brothers, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God, nor does the perishable inherit the imperishable.
aov_text: Maar dit verklaar ek, broeders, dat vlees en bloed die koninkryk van God nie kan beërwe nie; ook beërwe die verganklikheid nie die onverganklikheid nie.

kjv_text: Behold, I shew you a mystery; We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed,
bsb_text: Listen, I tell you a mystery: We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed—
aov_text: Kyk, ek deel julle ’n verborgenheid mee: Ons sal wel nie almal ontslaap nie, maar ons sal almal verander word,

kjv_text: In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.
bsb_text: in an instant, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound, the dead will be raised imperishable, and we will be changed.
aov_text: in ’n oomblik, in ’n oogwink, by die laaste basuin; want die basuin sal weerklink, en die dode sal onverganklik opgewek word; en ons sal verander word.

kjv_text: For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality.
bsb_text: For the perishable must be clothed with the imperishable, and the mortal with immortality.
aov_text: Want hierdie verganklike moet met onverganklikheid beklee word, en hierdie sterflike moet met onsterflikheid beklee word.

kjv_text: So when this corruptible shall have put on incorruption, and this mortal shall have put on immortality, then shall be brought to pass the saying that is written, Death is swallowed up in victory.
bsb_text: When the perishable has been clothed with the imperishable and the mortal with immortality, then the saying that is written will come to pass: “Death has been swallowed up in victory.”
aov_text: En wanneer hierdie verganklike met onverganklikheid beklee is en hierdie sterflike met onsterflikheid beklee is, dan sal vervul word die woord wat geskrywe is: Die dood is verslind in die oorwinning.

kjv_text: O death, where is thy sting? O grave, where is thy victory?
bsb_text: “Where, O Death, is your victory? Where, O Death, is your sting?”
aov_text: Dood, waar is jou angel? Doderyk, waar is jou oorwinning?

kjv_text: The sting of death is sin; and the strength of sin is the law.
bsb_text: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.
aov_text: Die angel van die dood is die sonde, en die krag van die sonde is die wet.

kjv_text: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
bsb_text: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ!
aov_text: Maar God sy dank, wat ons die oorwinning gee deur onse Here Jesus Christus.

kjv_text: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.
bsb_text: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast and immovable. Always excel in the work of the Lord, because you know that your labor in the Lord is not in vain.
aov_text: Daarom, my geliefde broeders, wees standvastig, onbeweeglik, altyd oorvloedig in die werk van die Here, omdat julle weet dat julle arbeid in die Here nie tevergeefs is nie.

kjv_text: Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I have given order to the churches of Galatia, even so do ye.
bsb_text: Now about the collection for the saints, you are to do as I directed the churches of Galatia:
aov_text: WAT die insameling vir die heiliges betref, moet julle ook so doen soos ek vir die gemeentes van Galásië gereël het.

kjv_text: Upon the first day of the week let every one of you lay by him in store, as God hath prospered him, that there be no gatherings when I come.
bsb_text: On the first day of every week, each of you should set aside a portion of his income, saving it up, so that when I come no collections will be needed.
aov_text: Op elke eerste dag van die week moet elkeen van julle self opsy sit en opspaar namate sy voorspoed is, sodat die insamelinge nie eers plaasvind as ek kom nie.

kjv_text: And when I come, whomsoever ye shall approve by your letters, them will I send to bring your liberality unto Jerusalem.
bsb_text: Then, on my arrival, I will send letters with those you recommend to carry your gift to Jerusalem.
aov_text: En wanneer ek aangekom het, sal ek die persone wat julle goedkeur, met briewe stuur om julle gawe na Jerusalem te bring.

kjv_text: And if it be meet that I go also, they shall go with me.
bsb_text: And if it is advisable for me to go also, they can travel with me.
aov_text: En as dit die moeite werd is dat ek ook gaan, kan hulle saam met my reis.

kjv_text: Now I will come unto you, when I shall pass through Macedonia: for I do pass through Macedonia.
bsb_text: After I go through Macedonia, however, I will come to you; for I will be going through Macedonia.
aov_text: MAAR ek sal na julle kom nadat ek deur Macedónië gereis het, want ek gaan deur Macedónië.

kjv_text: And it may be that I will abide, yea, and winter with you, that ye may bring me on my journey whithersoever I go.
bsb_text: Perhaps I will stay with you awhile, or even spend the winter, so that you can help me on my journey, wherever I go.
aov_text: En moontlik sal ek by julle vertoef of ook oorwinter, sodat julle my kan voorthelp waarheen ek ook al mag reis.

kjv_text: For I will not see you now by the way; but I trust to tarry a while with you, if the Lord permit.
bsb_text: For I do not want to see you now only in passing; I hope to spend some time with you, if the Lord permits.
aov_text: Want ek wil julle nie nou net in die verbygaan sien nie, maar ek hoop om ’n tyd lank by julle te bly as die Here dit toelaat.

kjv_text: But I will tarry at Ephesus until Pentecost.
bsb_text: But I will stay in Ephesus until Pentecost,
aov_text: Maar ek sal in Éfese bly tot Pinkster toe.

kjv_text: For a great door and effectual is opened unto me, and there are many adversaries.
bsb_text: because a great door for effective work has opened to me, even though many oppose me.
aov_text: Want ’n groot en kragtige deur het vir my oopgegaan, en daar is baie teëstanders.

kjv_text: Now if Timotheus come, see that he may be with you without fear: for he worketh the work of the Lord, as I also do.
bsb_text: If Timothy comes, see to it that he has nothing to fear while he is with you, for he is doing the work of the Lord, just as I am.
aov_text: En as Timótheüs kom,sorg dat hy sonder vrees by julle is, want hy doen die werk van die Here net soos ek.

kjv_text: Let no man therefore despise him: but conduct him forth in peace, that he may come unto me: for I look for him with the brethren.
bsb_text: No one, then, should treat him with contempt. Send him on his way in peace so that he can return to me, for I am expecting him along with the brothers.
aov_text: Laat niemand hom dan minag nie, maar help hom verder in vrede, dat hy na my toe kan kom; want ek wag vir hom saam met die broeders.

kjv_text: As touching our brother Apollos, I greatly desired him to come unto you with the brethren: but his will was not at all to come at this time; but he will come when he shall have convenient time.
bsb_text: Now about our brother Apollos: I strongly urged him to go to you with the brothers. He was not at all inclined to go now, but he will go when he has the opportunity.
aov_text: Met betrekking tot die broeder Apollos, by hom het ek sterk aangedring om saam met die broeders na julle te gaan; maar hy was heeltemal onwillig om nou te gaan; hy sal egter gaan wanneer die tyd vir hom geleë is.

kjv_text: Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.
bsb_text: Be on the alert. Stand firm in the faith. Be men of courage. Be strong.
aov_text: Waak, staan in die geloof, wees manlik, wees sterk.

kjv_text: Let all your things be done with charity.
bsb_text: Do everything in love.
aov_text: Laat alles by julle in liefde geskied.

kjv_text: I beseech you, brethren, (ye know the house of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia, and that they have addicted themselves to the ministry of the saints,)
bsb_text: You know that Stephanas and his household were the first converts in Achaia, and they have devoted themselves to the service of the saints. Now I urge you, brothers,
aov_text: En ek versoek julle, broeders — julle weet dat die huisgesin van Stéfanas die eersteling van Acháje is en dat hulle hul tot diens van die heiliges gestel het  —

kjv_text: That ye submit yourselves unto such, and to every one that helpeth with us, and laboureth.
bsb_text: to submit to such as these, and to every fellow worker and laborer.
aov_text: dat julle ook onderworpe moet wees aan sulke mense en aan elkeen wat saamwerk en arbei.

kjv_text: I am glad of the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus: for that which was lacking on your part they have supplied.
bsb_text: I am glad that Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus have arrived, because they have supplied what was lacking from you.
aov_text: En ek verbly my oor die aankoms van Stéfanas en Fortunátus en Acháïcus, omdat hulle my gemis aan julle vergoed het.

kjv_text: For they have refreshed my spirit and yours: therefore acknowledge ye them that are such.
bsb_text: For they refreshed my spirit and yours as well. Show your appreciation, therefore, to such men.
aov_text: Want hulle het my gees verkwik en julle s’n ook. Erken sulke manne dan.

kjv_text: The churches of Asia salute you. Aquila and Priscilla salute you much in the Lord, with the church that is in their house.
bsb_text: The churches in the province of Asia send you greetings. Aquila and Prisca greet you warmly in the Lord, and so does the church that meets at their house.
aov_text: Die gemeentes van Asië groet julle. Áquila en Priscílla saam met die gemeente wat in hulle huis is, laat vir julle baie groete weet in die Here.

kjv_text: All the brethren greet you. Greet ye one another with an holy kiss.
bsb_text: All the brothers here send you greetings. Greet one another with a holy kiss.
aov_text: Al die broeders groet julle. Groet mekaar met ’n heilige kus.

kjv_text: The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand.
bsb_text: This greeting is in my own hand—Paul.
aov_text: Die groete van Paulus, met my eie hand.

kjv_text: If any man love not the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be Anathema Maranatha.
bsb_text: If anyone does not love the Lord, let him be under a curse. Come, O Lord!
aov_text: As iemand die Here Jesus Christus nie liefhet nie, laat hom ’n vervloeking wees! Maranáta!

kjv_text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
bsb_text: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with you.
aov_text: Die genade van die Here Jesus Christus sy met julle!

kjv_text: My love be with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen.
bsb_text: My love be with all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.
aov_text: My liefde met julle almal in Christus Jesus! Amen.

kjv_text: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, unto the church of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints which are in all Achaia:
bsb_text: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, To the church of God in Corinth, together with all the saints throughout Achaia:
aov_text: PAULUS, ’n apostel van Jesus Christus deur die wil van God, en Timótheüs, die broeder, aan die gemeente van God wat in Korinthe is, saam met al die heiliges wat in die hele Acháje is:

kjv_text: Grace be to you and peace from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
bsb_text: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
aov_text: Genade vir julle en vrede van God, onse Vader, en die Here Jesus Christus.

kjv_text: Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort;
bsb_text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of compassion and the God of all comfort,
aov_text: GESEËND is die God en Vader van onse Here Jesus Christus, die Vader van ontferminge en die God van alle vertroosting,

kjv_text: Who comforteth us in all our tribulation, that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble, by the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of God.
bsb_text: who comforts us in all our troubles, so that we can comfort those in any trouble with the comfort we ourselves have received from God.
aov_text: wat ons troos in al ons verdrukking, sodat ons die wat in allerhande verdrukking is, kan troos deur die vertroosting waarmee ons self deur God getroos word.

kjv_text: For as the sufferings of Christ abound in us, so our consolation also aboundeth by Christ.
bsb_text: For just as the sufferings of Christ overflow to us, so also through Christ our comfort overflows.
aov_text: Want soos die lyde van Christus oorvloedig is in ons, so is ons troos ook oorvloedig deur Christus.

kjv_text: And whether we be afflicted, it is for your consolation and salvation, which is effectual in the enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer: or whether we be comforted, it is for your consolation and salvation.
bsb_text: If we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation; if we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which accomplishes in you patient endurance of the same sufferings we experience.
aov_text: Maar of ons verdruk word, dit is julle tot troos en redding; en dit laat sy werking blyk deurdat julle dieselfde lyding verduur wat ons ook ondergaan; en of ons getroos word, dit is julle tot troos en redding.

kjv_text: And our hope of you is stedfast, knowing, that as ye are partakers of the sufferings, so shall ye be also of the consolation.
bsb_text: And our hope for you is sure, because we know that just as you share in our sufferings, so also you will share in our comfort.
aov_text: En ons hoop vir julle is vas, omdat ons weet dat net soos julle deelgenote is aan die lyding, so ook aan die troos.

kjv_text: For we would not, brethren, have you ignorant of our trouble which came to us in Asia, that we were pressed out of measure, above strength, insomuch that we despaired even of life:
bsb_text: We do not want you to be unaware, brothers, of the hardships we encountered in the province of Asia. We were under a burden far beyond our ability to endure, so that we despaired even of life.
aov_text: Want ons wil nie hê, broeders, dat julle onbekend moet wees met ons verdrukking wat oor ons in Asië gekom het nie, dat ons dit bo ons krag uitermate swaar gehad het, sodat ons selfs aan ons lewe gewanhoop het.

kjv_text: But we had the sentence of death in ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God which raiseth the dead:
bsb_text: Indeed, we felt we were under the sentence of death, in order that we would not trust in ourselves, but in God, who raises the dead.
aov_text: Ja, ons het al self by onsself die doodvonnis oor ons gehad, sodat ons nie op onsself sou vertrou nie, maar op God wat die dode opwek;

kjv_text: Who delivered us from so great a death, and doth deliver: in whom we trust that he will yet deliver us;
bsb_text: He has delivered us from such a deadly peril, and He will deliver us. In Him we have placed our hope that He will yet again deliver us,
aov_text: wat ons verlos het uit so ’n groot doodsgevaar en nog verlos; op wie ons hoop dat Hy ook nog sal verlos,

kjv_text: Ye also helping together by prayer for us, that for the gift bestowed upon us by the means of many persons thanks may be given by many on our behalf.
bsb_text: as you help us by your prayers. Then many will give thanks on our behalf for the favor shown us in answer to their prayers.
aov_text: terwyl julle ook vir ons saamwerk deur die gebed, sodat daar vir die genadegawe aan ons deur baie persone op baie maniere vir ons gedank mag word.

kjv_text: For our rejoicing is this, the testimony of our conscience, that in simplicity and godly sincerity, not with fleshly wisdom, but by the grace of God, we have had our conversation in the world, and more abundantly to you-ward.
bsb_text: And this is our boast: Our conscience testifies that we have conducted ourselves in the world, and especially in relation to you, in the holiness and sincerity that are from God—not in worldly wisdom, but in the grace of God.
aov_text: WANT ons roem is dit: die getuienis van ons gewete dat ons in eenvoudigheid en reinheid van God, nie in vleeslike wysheid nie, maar in die genade van God in die wêreld verkeer het, en veral by julle.

kjv_text: For we write none other things unto you, than what ye read or acknowledge; and I trust ye shall acknowledge even to the end;
bsb_text: For we do not write you anything that is beyond your ability to read and understand. And I hope that you will understand us completely,
aov_text: Want ons skryf aan julle niks anders as wat julle lees of ook verstaan nie, en ek hoop dat julle dit ook tot die einde toe sal verstaan,

kjv_text: As also ye have acknowledged us in part, that we are your rejoicing, even as ye also are ours in the day of the Lord Jesus.
bsb_text: as you have already understood us in part, so that you may boast of us just as we will boast of you in the day of our Lord Jesus.
aov_text: soos julle ook gedeeltelik van ons verstaan het dat ons julle roem is, net soos julle ook ons roem is in die dag van die Here Jesus.

kjv_text: And in this confidence I was minded to come unto you before, that ye might have a second benefit;
bsb_text: Confident of this, I planned to visit you first, so that you might receive a double blessing.
aov_text: En in hierdie vertroue wou ek vroeër na julle kom, dat julle ’n tweede genade kan ontvang,

kjv_text: And to pass by you into Macedonia, and to come again out of Macedonia unto you, and of you to be brought on my way toward Judaea.
bsb_text: I wanted to visit you on my way to Macedonia, and to return to you from Macedonia, and then to have you help me on my way to Judea.
aov_text: en by julle langs deurgaan na Macedónië, om weer van Macedónië af by julle te kom en deur julle voortgehelp te word na Judéa.

kjv_text: When I therefore was thus minded, did I use lightness? or the things that I purpose, do I purpose according to the flesh, that with me there should be yea yea, and nay nay?
bsb_text: When I planned this, did I do it carelessly? Or do I make my plans by human standards, so as to say “Yes, yes” when I really mean “No, no”?
aov_text: Het ek dan miskien ligsinnig gehandel toe ek my dit voorgeneem het? Of wat ek my voorneem, neem ek my dit voor na die vlees sodat by my tegelyk is:ja ja, en nee nee?

kjv_text: But as God is true, our word toward you was not yea and nay.
bsb_text: But as surely as God is faithful, our message to you is not “Yes” and “No.”
aov_text: So waar as God getrou is — ons woord tot julle was nie ja en nee nie!

kjv_text: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us, even by me and Silvanus and Timotheus, was not yea and nay, but in him was yea.
bsb_text: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was proclaimed among you by me and Silvanus and Timothy, was not “Yes” and “No,” but in Him it has always been “Yes.”
aov_text: Want die Seun van God, Jesus Christus, wat deur ons onder julle verkondig is, deur my en Silvánus en Timótheüs, was nie ja en nee nie, maar was ja in Hom.

kjv_text: For all the promises of God in him are yea, and in him Amen, unto the glory of God by us.
bsb_text: For all the promises of God are “Yes” in Christ. And so through Him, our “Amen” is spoken to the glory of God.
aov_text: Want hoeveel beloftes van God daar ook mag wees, in Hom is hulle ja en in Hom amen, tot heerlikheid van God deur ons.

kjv_text: Now he which stablisheth us with you in Christ, and hath anointed us, is God;
bsb_text: Now it is God who establishes both us and you in Christ. He anointed us,
aov_text: Maar Hy wat ons saam met julle bevestig in Christus en ons gesalf het, is God,

kjv_text: Who hath also sealed us, and given the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts.
bsb_text: placed His seal on us, and put His Spirit in our hearts as a pledge of what is to come.
aov_text: wat ons ook verseël het en die Gees as onderpand in ons harte gegee het.

kjv_text: Moreover I call God for a record upon my soul, that to spare you I came not as yet unto Corinth.
bsb_text: I call God as my witness that it was in order to spare you that I did not return to Corinth.
aov_text: Maar ek roep God as getuie aan oor my siel dat ek om julle te spaar nog nie na Korinthe gekom het nie  —

kjv_text: Not for that we have dominion over your faith, but are helpers of your joy: for by faith ye stand.
bsb_text: Not that we lord it over your faith, but we are fellow workers with you for your joy, because it is by faith that you stand firm.
aov_text: nie dat ons heers oor julle geloof nie, maar ons is medewerkers aan julle blydskap; want in die geloof staan julle vas.

kjv_text: But I determined this with myself, that I would not come again to you in heaviness.
bsb_text: So I made up my mind not to make another painful visit to you.
aov_text: MAAR dit het ek by myself besluit, om nie weer in droefheid na julle te kom nie.

kjv_text: For if I make you sorry, who is he then that maketh me glad, but the same which is made sorry by me?
bsb_text: For if I grieve you, who is left to cheer me but those whom I have grieved?
aov_text: Want as ek julle bedroef maak, wie is hy dan wat my kan verbly anders as hy wat deur my bedroef gemaak is?

kjv_text: And I wrote this same unto you, lest, when I came, I should have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy is the joy of you all.
bsb_text: I wrote as I did so that on my arrival I would not be saddened by those who ought to make me rejoice. I had confidence in all of you, that you would share my joy.
aov_text: En ek het juis dit aan julle geskrywe, dat ek nie by my koms droefheid mag hê deur hulle oor wie ek my moes verbly nie, omdat ek die vertroue in julle almal het dat my blydskap dié van julle almal is.

kjv_text: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote unto you with many tears; not that ye should be grieved, but that ye might know the love which I have more abundantly unto you.
bsb_text: For through many tears I wrote you out of great distress and anguish of heart, not to grieve you but to let you know how much I love you.
aov_text: Want uit groot verdrukking en benoudheid van hart het ek aan julle geskrywe, onder baie trane, nie dat julle bedroef mag word nie, maar dat julle mag weet van die liefde wat ek oorvloedig vir julle het.

kjv_text: But if any have caused grief, he hath not grieved me, but in part: that I may not overcharge you all.
bsb_text: Now if anyone has caused grief, he has not grieved me but all of you—to some degree, not to overstate it.
aov_text: Maar as iemand droefheid veroorsaak het, dan het hy my nie bedroef nie, maar — ek wil nie oordryf nie — min of meer julle almal.

kjv_text: Sufficient to such a man is this punishment, which was inflicted of many.
bsb_text: The punishment imposed on him by the majority is sufficient for him.
aov_text: Vir so iemand is daardie bestraffing deur die meerderheid genoeg;

kjv_text: So that contrariwise ye ought rather to forgive him, and comfort him, lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with overmuch sorrow.
bsb_text: So instead, you ought to forgive and comfort him, so that he will not be overwhelmed by excessive sorrow.
aov_text: sodat julle daarenteen hom liewer moet vergewe en vertroos, dat so iemand nie miskien deur alte groot droefheid verteer word nie.

kjv_text: Wherefore I beseech you that ye would confirm your love toward him.
bsb_text: Therefore I urge you to reaffirm your love for him.
aov_text: Daarom vermaan ek julle om die liefde aan hom te bevestig.

kjv_text: For to this end also did I write, that I might know the proof of you, whether ye be obedient in all things.
bsb_text: My purpose in writing you was to see if you would stand the test and be obedient in everything.
aov_text: Want daarom het ek ook geskrywe om julle beproefdheid te weet, of julle in alles gehoorsaam is.

kjv_text: To whom ye forgive any thing, I forgive also: for if I forgave any thing, to whom I forgave it, for your sakes forgave I it in the person of Christ;
bsb_text: If you forgive anyone, I also forgive him. And if I have forgiven anything, I have forgiven it in the presence of Christ for your sake,
aov_text: Aan wie julle iets vergewe, vergeef ek ook; want wie ek ook vergeef het — as ek iets vergeef het — dit was om julle ontwil voor die aangesig van Christus, sodat ons nie deur die Satan bedrieg sou word nie;

kjv_text: Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices.
bsb_text: in order that Satan should not outwit us. For we are not unaware of his schemes.
aov_text: want ons is met sy planne nie onbekend nie.

kjv_text: Furthermore, when I came to Troas to preach Christ's gospel, and a door was opened unto me of the Lord,
bsb_text: Now when I went to Troas to preach the gospel of Christ and a door stood open for me in the Lord,
aov_text: Maar toe ek in Troas gekom het om die evangelie van Christus te verkondig, hoewel ’n deur vir my in die Here geopen was,

kjv_text: I had no rest in my spirit, because I found not Titus my brother:
bsb_text: I had no peace in my spirit, because I did not find my brother Titus there.
aov_text: het ek geen rus vir my gees gehad nie, omdat ek my broeder Titus nie aangetref het nie;

kjv_text: but taking my leave of them, I went from thence into Macedonia.
bsb_text: So I said goodbye to them and went on to Macedonia.
aov_text: maar ek het van hulle afskeid geneem en na Macedónië vertrek.

kjv_text: Now thanks be unto God, which always causeth us to triumph in Christ, and maketh manifest the savour of his knowledge by us in every place.
bsb_text: But thanks be to God, who always leads us triumphantly as captives in Christ and through us spreads everywhere the fragrance of the knowledge of Him.
aov_text: MAAR God sy dank wat ons altyd laat triomfeer in Christus en wat die reuk van sy kennis deur ons oral versprei.

kjv_text: For we are unto God a sweet savour of Christ, in them that are saved, and in them that perish:
bsb_text: For we are to God the sweet aroma of Christ among those who are being saved and those who are perishing.
aov_text: Want ons is ’n aangename geur van Christus tot eer van God onder die wat gered word en onder die wat verlore gaan;

kjv_text: To the one we are the savour of death unto death; and to the other the savour of life unto life. And who is sufficient for these things?
bsb_text: To the one, we are an odor of death and demise; to the other, a fragrance that brings life. And who is qualified for such a task?
aov_text: vir die laaste ’n reuk van die dood tot die dood, maar vir die eerste ’n reuk van die lewe tot die lewe. En wie is tot hierdie dinge bekwaam?

kjv_text: For we are not as many, which corrupt the word of God: but as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God speak we in Christ.
bsb_text: For we are not like so many others, who peddle the word of God for profit. On the contrary, in Christ we speak before God with sincerity, as men sent from God.
aov_text: Want ons is nie soos baie wat handel dryf met die woord van God nie; maar as uit opregtheid, maar as uit God, in die teenwoordigheid van God, spreek ons in Christus.

kjv_text: Do we begin again to commend ourselves? or need we, as some others, epistles of commendation to you, or letters of commendation from you?
bsb_text: Are we beginning to commend ourselves again? Or do we need, like some people, letters of recommendation to you or from you?
aov_text: BEGIN ons weer om onsself aan te beveel? Of het ons miskien, soos sommige, aanbevelingsbriewe nodig aan julle of van julle?

kjv_text: Ye are our epistle written in our hearts, known and read of all men:
bsb_text: You yourselves are our letter, inscribed on our hearts, known and read by everyone.
aov_text: Julle is ons brief, geskrywe in ons harte, geken en gelees deur alle mense;

kjv_text: Forasmuch as ye are manifestly declared to be the epistle of Christ ministered by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tables of stone, but in fleshy tables of the heart.
bsb_text: It is clear that you are a letter from Christ, the result of our ministry, written not with ink but with the Spirit of the living God, not on tablets of stone but on tablets of human hearts.
aov_text: omdat julle duidelik ’n brief van Christus is deur ons diens berei, geskrywe nie met ink nie, maar met die Gees van die lewende God; nie op kliptafels nie, maar op die vleestafels van die hart.

kjv_text: And such trust have we through Christ to God-ward:
bsb_text: Such confidence before God is ours through Christ.
aov_text: So ’n vertroue het ons deur Christus by God.

kjv_text: Not that we are sufficient of ourselves to think any thing as of ourselves; but our sufficiency is of God;
bsb_text: Not that we are competent in ourselves to claim that anything comes from us, but our competence comes from God.
aov_text: Nie dat ons uit onsself bekwaam is om iets as uit onsself te bedink nie, maar ons bekwaamheid is uit God,

kjv_text: Who also hath made us able ministers of the new testament; not of the letter, but of the spirit: for the letter killeth, but the spirit giveth life.
bsb_text: And He has qualified us as ministers of a new covenant, not of the letter but of the Spirit; for the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.
aov_text: wat ons ook bekwaam gemaak het as dienaars van ’n nuwe testament, nie van die letter nie, maar van die gees; want die letter maak dood, maar die gees maak lewend.

kjv_text: But if the ministration of death, written and engraven in stones, was glorious, so that the children of Israel could not stedfastly behold the face of Moses for the glory of his countenance; which glory was to be done away:
bsb_text: Now if the ministry of death, which was engraved in letters on stone, came with such glory that the Israelites could not gaze at the face of Moses because of its fleeting glory,
aov_text: En as die bediening van die dood, met letters op klippe gegraveer, in heerlikheid was, sodat die kinders van Israel nie die oë kon vestig op die aangesig van Moses nie vanweë die heerlikheid van sy aangesig, wat tog moes vergaan,

kjv_text: How shall not the ministration of the spirit be rather glorious?
bsb_text: will not the ministry of the Spirit be even more glorious?
aov_text: hoeveel te meer sal die bediening van die Gees dan nie in heerlikheid wees nie?

kjv_text: For if the ministration of condemnation be glory, much more doth the ministration of righteousness exceed in glory.
bsb_text: For if the ministry of condemnation was glorious, how much more glorious is the ministry of righteousness!
aov_text: Want as die bediening wat veroordeel, heerlikheid was, veel meer is die bediening wat regverdig maak, oorvloedig in heerlikheid.

kjv_text: For even that which was made glorious had no glory in this respect, by reason of the glory that excelleth.
bsb_text: Indeed, what was once glorious has no glory now in comparison to the glory that surpasses it.
aov_text: Want wat verheerlik was, is ook in hierdie geval nie verheerlik nie, vanweë die alles oortreffende heerlikheid.

kjv_text: For if that which is done away was glorious, much more that which remaineth is glorious.
bsb_text: For if what was fading away came with glory, how much greater is the glory of that which endures!
aov_text: Want as wat moes vergaan, met heerlikheid was, veel meer is wat moet bly, in heerlikheid.

kjv_text: Seeing then that we have such hope, we use great plainness of speech:
bsb_text: Therefore, since we have such a hope, we are very bold.
aov_text: Terwyl ons dan sodanige hoop het, gebruik ons baie vrymoedigheid;

kjv_text: And not as Moses, which put a vail over his face, that the children of Israel could not stedfastly look to the end of that which is abolished:
bsb_text: We are not like Moses, who would put a veil over his face to keep the Israelites from gazing at the end of what was fading away.
aov_text: nie soos Moses nie, wat ’n bedekking oor sy aangesig gesit het, sodat die kinders van Israel nie die oë kon vestig op die einde van wat moes vergaan nie.

kjv_text: But their minds were blinded: for until this day remaineth the same vail untaken away in the reading of the old testament; which vail is done away in Christ.
bsb_text: But their minds were closed. For to this day the same veil remains at the reading of the old covenant. It has not been lifted, because only in Christ can it be removed.
aov_text: Maar hulle sinne is verhard. Want tot vandag toe bly by die lesing van die Ou Testament dieselfde bedekking sonder dat dit opgelig word, die bedekking wat in Christus vernietig word.

kjv_text: But even unto this day, when Moses is read, the vail is upon their heart.
bsb_text: And even to this day when Moses is read, a veil covers their hearts.
aov_text: Ja, tot vandag toe, wanneer Moses gelees word, lê daar ’n bedekking oor hulle hart;

kjv_text: Nevertheless when it shall turn to the Lord, the vail shall be taken away.
bsb_text: But whenever anyone turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.
aov_text: maar wanneer hulle tot die Here bekeer is, word die bedekking weggeneem.

kjv_text: Now the Lord is that Spirit: and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.
bsb_text: Now the Lord is the Spirit, and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom.
aov_text: Die Here is die Gees, en waar die Gees van die Here is, daar is vryheid.

kjv_text: But we all, with open face beholding as in a glass the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory, even as by the Spirit of the LORD.
bsb_text: And we, who with unveiled faces all reflect the glory of the Lord, are being transformed into His image with intensifying glory, which comes from the Lord, who is the Spirit.
aov_text: En terwyl ons almal met onbedekte gesig soos in ’n spieël die heerlikheid van die Here aanskou, word ons van gedaante verander na dieselfde beeld, van heerlikheid tot heerlikheid, as deur die Here wat die Gees is.

kjv_text: Therefore seeing we have this ministry, as we have received mercy, we faint not;
bsb_text: Therefore, since God in His mercy has given us this ministry, we do not lose heart.
aov_text: DAAROM, aangesien ons hierdie bediening het volgens die barmhartigheid wat ons ontvang het, gee ons nie moed op nie.

kjv_text: But have renounced the hidden things of dishonesty, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully; but by manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man's conscience in the sight of God.
bsb_text: Instead, we have renounced secret and shameful ways. We do not practice deceit, nor do we distort the word of God. On the contrary, by open proclamation of the truth, we commend ourselves to every man’s conscience in the sight of God.
aov_text: Maar ons het van die heimlike dinge wat skandelik is, afstand gedoen, en ons wandel nie in listigheid of vervals die woord van God nie; maar deur die waarheid aan die lig te bring, beveel ons ons by elke menslike gewete voor God aan.

kjv_text: But if our gospel be hid, it is hid to them that are lost:
bsb_text: And even if our gospel is veiled, it is veiled to those who are perishing.
aov_text: Maar as ons evangelie dan nog bedek is, is dit bedek in die wat verlore gaan,

kjv_text: In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not, lest the light of the glorious gospel of Christ, who is the image of God, should shine unto them.
bsb_text: The god of this age has blinded the minds of unbelievers so they cannot see the light of the gospel of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God.
aov_text: naamlik die ongelowiges in wie die god van hierdie wêreld die sinne verblind het, sodat die verligting van die evangelie van die heerlikheid van Christus, wat die beeld van God is, op hulle nie sou skyn nie.

kjv_text: For we preach not ourselves, but Christ Jesus the Lord; and ourselves your servants for Jesus' sake.
bsb_text: For we do not proclaim ourselves, but Jesus Christ as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus’ sake.
aov_text: Want ons verkondig nie onsself nie, maar Christus Jesus as Here, en onsself as julle diensknegte om Jesus wil.

kjv_text: For God, who commanded the light to shine out of darkness, hath shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
bsb_text: For God, who said, “Let light shine out of darkness,” made His light shine in our hearts to give us the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
aov_text: Want God wat gesê het dat daar uit duisternis lig moet skyn — dit is Hy wat in ons harte geskyn het om die verligting te bring van die kennis van die heerlikheid van God in die aangesig van Jesus Christus.

kjv_text: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of God, and not of us.
bsb_text: Now we have this treasure in jars of clay to show that this surpassingly great power is from God and not from us.
aov_text: Maar ons het hierdie skat in erdekruike, sodat die voortreflikheid van die krag van God mag wees en nie uit ons nie.

kjv_text: We are troubled on every side, yet not distressed; we are perplexed, but not in despair;
bsb_text: We are hard pressed on all sides, but not crushed; perplexed, but not in despair;
aov_text: In alles word ons verdruk, maar ons is nie terneergedruk nie; ons is verleë, maar nie radeloos nie;

kjv_text: Persecuted, but not forsaken; cast down, but not destroyed;
bsb_text: persecuted, but not forsaken; struck down, but not destroyed.
aov_text: vervolg, maar nie verlate nie; neergewerp, maar nie vernietig nie.

kjv_text: Always bearing about in the body the dying of the Lord Jesus, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our body.
bsb_text: We always carry around in our body the death of Jesus, so that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.
aov_text: Gedurig dra ons die doding van die Here Jesus in die liggaam om, sodat ook die lewe van Christus in ons liggaam openbaar kan word.

kjv_text: For we which live are alway delivered unto death for Jesus' sake, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our mortal flesh.
bsb_text: For we who are alive are always consigned to death for Jesus’ sake, so that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our mortal body.
aov_text: Want altyd word ons wat lewe, oorgelewer in die dood om Jesus wil, sodat ook die lewe van Jesus in ons sterflike vlees openbaar kan word.

kjv_text: So then death worketh in us, but life in you.
bsb_text: So then, death is at work in us, but life is at work in you.
aov_text: So werk die dood dan in ons, maar die lewe in julle.

kjv_text: We having the same spirit of faith, according as it is written, I believed, and therefore have I spoken; we also believe, and therefore speak;
bsb_text: And in keeping with what is written: “I believed, therefore I have spoken,” we who have the same spirit of faith also believe and therefore speak,
aov_text: En omdat ons dieselfde Gees van die geloof het — soos geskrywe is: Ek het geglo, daarom het ek gespreek — glo ons ook, daarom spreek ons ook.

kjv_text: Knowing that he which raised up the Lord Jesus shall raise up us also by Jesus, and shall present us with you.
bsb_text: knowing that the One who raised the Lord Jesus will also raise us with Jesus and present us with you in His presence.
aov_text: Want ons weet dat Hy wat die Here Jesus opgewek het, ons ook deur Jesus sal opwek en saam met julle voor Hom sal stel.

kjv_text: For all things are for your sakes, that the abundant grace might through the thanksgiving of many redound to the glory of God.
bsb_text: All this is for your benefit, so that the grace that is extending to more and more people may overflow in thanksgiving, to the glory of God.
aov_text: Want dit is alles om julle ontwil, sodat die genade, wat groter geword het deur so baie mense, die danksegging oorvloedig kan maak tot die heerlikheid van God.

kjv_text: For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.
bsb_text: Therefore we do not lose heart. Though our outer self is wasting away, yet our inner self is being renewed day by day.
aov_text: DAAROM gee ons nie moed op nie, maar al vergaan ons uiterlike mens ook, nogtans word die innerlike mens dag ná dag vernuwe.

kjv_text: For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory;
bsb_text: For our light and momentary affliction is producing for us an eternal weight of glory that is far beyond comparison.
aov_text: Want ons ligte verdrukking wat vir ’n oomblik is, bewerk vir ons ’n alles oortreffende ewige gewig van heerlikheid;

kjv_text: While we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.
bsb_text: So we fix our eyes not on what is seen, but on what is unseen. For what is seen is temporary, but what is unseen is eternal.
aov_text: omdat ons nie let op die sigbare dinge nie, maar op die onsigbare; want die sigbare dinge is tydelik, maar die onsigbare ewig.

kjv_text: For we know that if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building of God, an house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.
bsb_text: Now we know that if the earthly tent we live in is dismantled, we have a building from God, an eternal house in heaven, not built by human hands.
aov_text: WANT ons weet dat as ons aardse tentwoning afgebreek word, ons ’n gebou het van God, ’n huis nie met hande gemaak nie, ewig, in die hemele.

kjv_text: For in this we groan, earnestly desiring to be clothed upon with our house which is from heaven:
bsb_text: For in this tent we groan, longing to be clothed with our heavenly dwelling,
aov_text: Want om hierdie rede sug ons ook en verlang om met ons woning uit die hemel oorklee te word,

kjv_text: If so be that being clothed we shall not be found naked.
bsb_text: because when we are clothed, we will not be found naked.
aov_text: as ons ten minste gekleed en nie naak bevind sal word nie.

kjv_text: For we that are in this tabernacle do groan, being burdened: not for that we would be unclothed, but clothed upon, that mortality might be swallowed up of life.
bsb_text: So while we are in this tent, we groan under our burdens, because we do not wish to be unclothed but clothed, so that our mortality may be swallowed up by life.
aov_text: Want ons wat nog in die tent is, sug en voel beswaard, omdat ons liewer nie ontklee nie, maar oorklee wil word, sodat die sterflike deur die lewe verslind kan word.

kjv_text: Now he that hath wrought us for the selfsame thing is God, who also hath given unto us the earnest of the Spirit.
bsb_text: And God has prepared us for this very purpose and has given us the Spirit as a pledge of what is to come.
aov_text: Maar Hy wat ons juis hiervoor toeberei het, is God, wat ons ook die Gees as onderpand gegee het.

kjv_text: Therefore we are always confident, knowing that, whilst we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord:
bsb_text: Therefore we are always confident, although we know that while we are at home in the body, we are away from the Lord.
aov_text: Daarom het ons altyd goeie moed en weet dat as ons in die liggaam inwoon, ons van die Here uitwoon.

kjv_text: (For we walk by faith, not by sight:)
bsb_text: For we walk by faith, not by sight.
aov_text: Want ons wandel deur geloof en nie deur aanskouing nie.

kjv_text: We are confident, I say, and willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be present with the Lord.
bsb_text: We are confident, then, and would prefer to be away from the body and at home with the Lord.
aov_text: Maar ons het goeie moed en verkies om liewer uit die liggaam uit te woon en by die Here in te woon.

kjv_text: Wherefore we labour, that, whether present or absent, we may be accepted of him.
bsb_text: So we aspire to please Him, whether we are here in this body or away from it.
aov_text: Daarom lê ons ons ook ywerig daarop toe, of ons inwoon of uitwoon, om Hom welbehaaglik te wees.

kjv_text: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ; that every one may receive the things done in his body, according to that he hath done, whether it be good or bad.
bsb_text: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ, that each one may receive his due for the things done in the body, whether good or bad.
aov_text: Want ons moet almal voor die regterstoel van Christus verskyn, sodat elkeen kan ontvang wat hy deur die liggaam verrig het, volgens wat hy gedoen het, of dit goed is of kwaad.

kjv_text: Knowing therefore the terror of the Lord, we persuade men; but we are made manifest unto God; and I trust also are made manifest in your consciences.
bsb_text: Therefore, since we know what it means to fear the Lord, we try to persuade men. What we are is clear to God, and I hope it is clear to your conscience as well.
aov_text: OMDAT ons dan die vrees van die Here ken, probeer ons om die mense te oortuig; maar voor God is ons openbaar, en ek hoop om ook in julle gewetens openbaar te wees.

kjv_text: For we commend not ourselves again unto you, but give you occasion to glory on our behalf, that ye may have somewhat to answer them which glory in appearance, and not in heart.
bsb_text: We are not commending ourselves to you again. Instead, we are giving you an occasion to be proud of us, so that you can answer those who take pride in appearances rather than in the heart.
aov_text: Want ons beveel ons nie weer by julle aan nie, maar ons gee julle aanleiding tot roem oor ons, sodat julle iets kan hê teenoor die wat hulle op die uiterlike beroem en nie op die hart nie.

kjv_text: For whether we be beside ourselves, it is to God: or whether we be sober, it is for your cause.
bsb_text: If we are out of our mind, it is for God; if we are of sound mind, it is for you.
aov_text: Want as ons uitsinnig is, is dit tot eer van God; en as ons by ons verstand is, is dit om julle ontwil.

kjv_text: For the love of Christ constraineth us;
bsb_text: For Christ's love compels us,
aov_text: Want die liefde van Christus dring ons,

kjv_text: because we thus judge, that if one died for all, then were all dead:
bsb_text: because we are convinced that One died for all, therefore all died.
aov_text: omdat ons van oordeel is, dat as een vir almal gesterf het, hulle dan almal gesterf het;

kjv_text: And that he died for all, that they which live should not henceforth live unto themselves, but unto him which died for them, and rose again.
bsb_text: And He died for all, that those who live should no longer live for themselves, but for Him who died for them and was raised again.
aov_text: en Hy het vir almal gesterwe, sodat die wat lewe, nie meer vir hulself moet lewe nie, maar vir Hom wat vir hulle gesterf het en opgewek is.

kjv_text: Wherefore henceforth know we no man after the flesh: yea, though we have known Christ after the flesh, yet now henceforth know we him no more.
bsb_text: So from now on we regard no one according to the flesh. Although we once regarded Christ in this way, we do so no longer.
aov_text: Ons ken dus van nou af niemand meer na die vlees nie; en al het ons ook Christus na die vlees geken, nou ken ons Hom tóg nie meer so nie.

kjv_text: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.
bsb_text: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old has passed away. Behold, the new has come!
aov_text: Daarom, as iemand in Christus is, is hy ’n nuwe skepsel; die ou dinge het verbygegaan, kyk, dit het alles nuut geword.

kjv_text: And all things are of God, who hath reconciled us to himself by Jesus Christ, and hath given to us the ministry of reconciliation;
bsb_text: All this is from God, who reconciled us to Himself through Christ and gave us the ministry of reconciliation:
aov_text: En dit alles is uit God wat ons met Homself versoen het deur Jesus Christus en ons die bediening van die versoening gegee het,

kjv_text: To wit, that God was in Christ, reconciling the world unto himself, not imputing their trespasses unto them; and hath committed unto us the word of reconciliation.
bsb_text: that God was reconciling the world to Himself in Christ, not counting men’s trespasses against them. And He has committed to us the message of reconciliation.
aov_text: naamlik dat God in Christus die wêreld met Homself versoen het deur hulle hul misdade nie toe te reken nie en die woord van die versoening aan ons toe te vertrou.

kjv_text: Now then we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God did beseech you by us: we pray you in Christ's stead, be ye reconciled to God.
bsb_text: Therefore we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God were making His appeal through us. We implore you on behalf of Christ: Be reconciled to God.
aov_text: Ons tree dan op as gesante om Christus wil, asof God deur ons vermaan. Ons bid julle om Christus wil: Laat julle met God versoen.

kjv_text: For he hath made him to be sin for us, who knew no sin; that we might be made the righteousness of God in him.
bsb_text: God made Him who knew no sin to be sin on our behalf, so that in Him we might become the righteousness of God.
aov_text: Want Hy het Hom wat geen sonde geken het nie, sonde vir ons gemaak, sodat ons kan word geregtigheid van God in Hom.

kjv_text: We then, as workers together with him, beseech you also that ye receive not the grace of God in vain.
bsb_text: As God’s fellow workers, then, we urge you not to receive God’s grace in vain.
aov_text: EN as medewerkers vermaan ons julle ook dat julle die genade van God nie tevergeefs mag ontvang nie.

kjv_text: (For he saith, I have heard thee in a time accepted, and in the day of salvation have I succoured thee: behold, now is the accepted time; behold, now is the day of salvation.)
bsb_text: For He says: “In the time of favor I heard you, and in the day of salvation I helped you.” Behold, now is the time of favor; now is the day of salvation!
aov_text: Want Hy sê: In die tyd van die welbehae het Ek jou verhoor, en in die dag van heil het Ek jou gehelp. Kyk, nou is dit die tyd van die welbehae; kyk, nou is die dag van heil.

kjv_text: Giving no offence in any thing, that the ministry be not blamed:
bsb_text: We put no obstacle in anyone’s way, so that no one can discredit our ministry.
aov_text: Ons lê nie die minste hindernis in die weg nie, sodat die bediening nie beklad mag word nie;

kjv_text: But in all things approving ourselves as the ministers of God, in much patience, in afflictions, in necessities, in distresses,
bsb_text: Rather, as servants of God we commend ourselves in every way: in great endurance; in troubles, hardships, and calamities;
aov_text: maar in alles beveel ons ons aan as dienaars van God, met baie geduld, in verdrukkinge, in node, in benoudhede;

kjv_text: In stripes, in imprisonments, in tumults, in labours, in watchings, in fastings;
bsb_text: in beatings, imprisonments, and riots; in labor, sleepless nights, and hunger;
aov_text: in slae, in gevangenskappe, in oproere, in arbeid, in slapelose nagte, in hongerly;

kjv_text: By pureness, by knowledge, by longsuffering, by kindness, by the Holy Ghost, by love unfeigned,
bsb_text: in purity, knowledge, patience, and kindness; in the Holy Spirit and in sincere love;
aov_text: in reinheid, in kennis, in lankmoedigheid, in vriendelikheid, in die Heilige Gees, in ongeveinsde liefde;

kjv_text: By the word of truth, by the power of God, by the armour of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,
bsb_text: in truthful speech and in the power of God; with the weapons of righteousness in the right hand and in the left;
aov_text: in die woord van waarheid, in die krag van God, deur die wapens van die geregtigheid in die regter- en linkerhand;

kjv_text: By honour and dishonour, by evil report and good report: as deceivers, and yet true;
bsb_text: through glory and dishonor, slander and praise; viewed as imposters, yet genuine;
aov_text: deur eer en oneer, deur slegte en goeie gerug, as verleiers en tog waaragtig;

kjv_text: As unknown, and yet well known; as dying, and, behold, we live; as chastened, and not killed;
bsb_text: as unknown, yet well-known; dying, and yet we live on; punished, yet not killed;
aov_text: as onbekendes en tog goed bekend, as sterwendes en kyk, ons lewe, as getugtig en tog nie gedood nie;

kjv_text: As sorrowful, yet alway rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and yet possessing all things.
bsb_text: sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; poor, yet making many rich; having nothing, and yet possessing everything.
aov_text: as bedroefdes, maar altyd opgeruimd; as armes, maar wat baie ander ryk maak; as mense wat niks het nie en tog alles besit.

kjv_text: O ye Corinthians, our mouth is open unto you, our heart is enlarged.
bsb_text: We have spoken freely to you, Corinthians. Our hearts are open wide.
aov_text: ONS mond het teenoor julle oopgegaan, Korinthiërs, ons hart het verruim geword.

kjv_text: Ye are not straitened in us, but ye are straitened in your own bowels.
bsb_text: It is not our affection, but yours, that is restrained.
aov_text: Nie in ons het julle dit te nou nie, maar in jul binneste het julle dit te nou.

kjv_text: Now for a recompence in the same, (I speak as unto my children,) be ye also enlarged.
bsb_text: As a fair exchange, I ask you as my children: Open wide your hearts also.
aov_text: Maar by wyse van vergoeding — ek praat soos met kinders — moet julle ook verruim word.

kjv_text: Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness? and what communion hath light with darkness?
bsb_text: Do not be unequally yoked with unbelievers. For what partnership can righteousness have with wickedness? Or what fellowship does light have with darkness?
aov_text: Moenie in dieselfde juk trek saam met ongelowiges nie, want watter deelgenootskap het die geregtigheid met die ongeregtigheid, en watter gemeenskap het die lig met die duisternis?

kjv_text: And what concord hath Christ with Belial? or what part hath he that believeth with an infidel?
bsb_text: What harmony is there between Christ and Belial? Or what does a believer have in common with an unbeliever?
aov_text: En watter ooreenstemming het Christus met Bélial, of watter aandeel het die gelowige met die ongelowige?

kjv_text: And what agreement hath the temple of God with idols? for ye are the temple of the living God; as God hath said, I will dwell in them, and walk in them; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
bsb_text: What agreement can exist between the temple of God and idols? For we are the temple of the living God. As God has said: “I will dwell with them and walk among them, and I will be their God, and they will be My people.”
aov_text: Of watter ooreenkoms het die tempel van God met die afgode? Want julle is die tempel van die lewende God, soos God gespreek het: Ek sal in hulle woon en onder hulle wandel, en Ek sal hulle God wees, en hulle sal vir My ’n volk wees.

kjv_text: Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord, and touch not the unclean thing; and I will receive you,
bsb_text: “Therefore come out from among them and be separate, says the Lord. Touch no unclean thing, and I will receive you.”
aov_text: Daarom, gaan onder hulle uit en sonder julle af, spreek die Here; en raak nie aan wat onrein is nie, en Ek sal julle aanneem;

kjv_text: And will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty.
bsb_text: And: “I will be a Father to you, and you will be My sons and daughters, says the Lord Almighty.”
aov_text: en Ek sal vir julle ’n Vader wees, en julle sal vir My seuns en dogters wees, spreek die Here, die Almagtige.

kjv_text: Having therefore these promises, dearly beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from all filthiness of the flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.
bsb_text: Therefore, beloved, since we have these promises, let us cleanse ourselves from everything that defiles body and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.
aov_text: TERWYL ons dan hierdie beloftes het, geliefdes, laat ons ons van alle besoedeling van die vlees en die gees reinig, en laat ons die heiligmaking in die vrees van God volbring.

kjv_text: Receive us; we have wronged no man, we have corrupted no man, we have defrauded no man.
bsb_text: Make room for us in your hearts. We have wronged no one, we have corrupted no one, we have exploited no one.
aov_text: MAAK vir ons ruimte in julle harte. Ons het niemand onreg aangedoen nie, ons het niemand benadeel nie, ons het op niemand voordeel behaal nie.

kjv_text: I speak not this to condemn you: for I have said before, that ye are in our hearts to die and live with you.
bsb_text: I do not say this to condemn you. I have said before that you so occupy our hearts that we live and die together with you.
aov_text: Ek sê dit nie om te veroordeel nie, want ek het vantevore gesê dat julle in ons harte is om saam te sterwe en saam te lewe.

kjv_text: Great is my boldness of speech toward you, great is my glorying of you: I am filled with comfort, I am exceeding joyful in all our tribulation.
bsb_text: Great is my confidence in you; great is my pride in you; I am filled with encouragement; in all our troubles my joy overflows.
aov_text: Ek het groot vrymoedigheid teenoor julle; my roem oor julle is groot; ek is vervul met troos; ek loop oor van blydskap in al ons verdrukking.

kjv_text: For, when we were come into Macedonia, our flesh had no rest, but we were troubled on every side; without were fightings, within were fears.
bsb_text: For when we arrived in Macedonia, our bodies had no rest, but we were pressed from every direction—conflicts on the outside, fears within.
aov_text: Want ook toe ons in Macedónië gekom het, het ons vlees geen rus gehad nie, maar ons is op allerhande maniere verdruk; van buite was daar aanvegtinge, van binne verskrikkinge.

kjv_text: Nevertheless God, that comforteth those that are cast down, comforted us by the coming of Titus;
bsb_text: But God, who comforts the downcast, comforted us by the arrival of Titus,
aov_text: Maar Hy wat die nederiges troos, naamlik God, het ons getroos deur die koms van Titus;

kjv_text: And not by his coming only, but by the consolation wherewith he was comforted in you, when he told us your earnest desire, your mourning, your fervent mind toward me; so that I rejoiced the more.
bsb_text: and not only by his arrival, but also by the comfort he had received from you. He told us about your longing, your mourning, and your zeal for me, so that I rejoiced all the more.
aov_text: en nie deur sy koms alleen nie, maar ook deur die troos waarmee hy oor julle getroos is, deurdat hy aan ons berig gebring het van julle verlange, julle verdriet, julle ywer vir my, sodat ek my nog meer verbly het.

kjv_text: For though I made you sorry with a letter, I do not repent, though I did repent: for I perceive that the same epistle hath made you sorry, though it were but for a season.
bsb_text: Even if I caused you sorrow by my letter, I do not regret it. Although I did regret it, I now see that my letter caused you sorrow, but only for a short time.
aov_text: Want, al het ek julle ook deur die brief bedroef gemaak, is ek nie jammer nie, al was ek ook jammer. Want ek sien dat daardie brief, al was dit vir ’n kort tydjie, julle bedroef gemaak het.

kjv_text: Now I rejoice, not that ye were made sorry, but that ye sorrowed to repentance: for ye were made sorry after a godly manner, that ye might receive damage by us in nothing.
bsb_text: And now I rejoice, not because you were made sorrowful, but because your sorrow led you to repentance. For you felt the sorrow that God had intended, and so were not harmed in any way by us.
aov_text: Nou is ek bly, nie omdat julle bedroef was nie, maar omdat julle bedroef was tot bekering, want julle was bedroef volgens die wil van God, sodat julle deur ons in niks skade gely het nie.

kjv_text: For godly sorrow worketh repentance to salvation not to be repented of: but the sorrow of the world worketh death.
bsb_text: Godly sorrow brings repentance that leads to salvation without regret, but worldly sorrow brings death.
aov_text: Want die droefheid volgens die wil van God werk ’n onberoulike bekering tot redding, maar die droefheid van die wêreld werk die dood.

kjv_text: For behold this selfsame thing, that ye sorrowed after a godly sort, what carefulness it wrought in you, yea, what clearing of yourselves, yea, what indignation, yea, what fear, yea, what vehement desire, yea, what zeal, yea, what revenge! In all things ye have approved yourselves to be clear in this matter.
bsb_text: Consider what this godly sorrow has produced in you: what earnestness, what eagerness to clear yourselves, what indignation, what alarm, what longing, what zeal, what vindication! In every way you have proved yourselves to be innocent in this matter.
aov_text: Want kyk, juis dit, dat julle bedroef geword het volgens die wil van God — wat ’n groot ywer het dit in julle gewerk, ja, verantwoording, verontwaardiging, vrees, verlange, ywer, bestraffing. In alles het julle bewys dat julle in die saak rein is.

kjv_text: Wherefore, though I wrote unto you, I did it not for his cause that had done the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered wrong, but that our care for you in the sight of God might appear unto you.
bsb_text: So even though I wrote to you, it was not on account of the one who did wrong or the one who was harmed, but rather that your earnestness on our behalf would be made clear to you in the sight of God.
aov_text: Al het ek ook aan julle geskrywe, dan was dit nie ter wille van hom wat onreg gedoen het nie, of ter wille van hom wat onreg gely het nie, maar dat ons ywer vir julle aan julle duidelik kan word voor God.

kjv_text: Therefore we were comforted in your comfort: yea, and exceedingly the more joyed we for the joy of Titus, because his spirit was refreshed by you all.
bsb_text: On account of this, we are encouraged. In addition to our own encouragement, we were even more delighted by the joy of Titus. For his spirit has been refreshed by all of you.
aov_text: Daarom is ons getroos oor julle vertroosting en het veral bly geword oor die blydskap van Titus, omdat sy gees deur julle almal verkwik is.

kjv_text: For if I have boasted any thing to him of you, I am not ashamed; but as we spake all things to you in truth, even so our boasting, which I made before Titus, is found a truth.
bsb_text: Indeed, I was not embarrassed by anything I had boasted to him about you. But just as everything we said to you was true, so our boasting to Titus has proved to be true as well.
aov_text: Want as ek iets by hom oor julle geroem het, is ek nie beskaam nie; maar soos ons alles met waarheid tot julle gespreek het, so het ook ons roem by Titus waarheid geword.

kjv_text: And his inward affection is more abundant toward you, whilst he remembereth the obedience of you all, how with fear and trembling ye received him.
bsb_text: And his affection for you is even greater when he remembers that you were all obedient as you welcomed him with fear and trembling.
aov_text: En sy hart is julle veral toegeneë as hy hom die gehoorsaamheid van julle almal herinner, hoe julle hom met vrees en bewing ontvang het.

kjv_text: I rejoice therefore that I have confidence in you in all things.
bsb_text: I rejoice that I can have complete confidence in you.
aov_text: Ek verbly my dus dat ek my in alle opsigte op julle kan verlaat.

kjv_text: Moreover, brethren, we do you to wit of the grace of God bestowed on the churches of Macedonia;
bsb_text: Now, brothers, we want you to know about the grace that God has given the churches of Macedonia.
aov_text: EN ons maak julle bekend, broeders, die genade van God wat aan die gemeentes van Macedónië geskenk is,

kjv_text: How that in a great trial of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded unto the riches of their liberality.
bsb_text: In the terrible ordeal they suffered, their abundant joy and deep poverty overflowed into rich generosity.
aov_text: dat onder baie beproewing deur verdrukking hulle oorvloedige blydskap by hulle diepe armoede oorvloedig was in hulle ryke milddadigheid.

kjv_text: For to their power, I bear record, yea, and beyond their power they were willing of themselves;
bsb_text: For I testify that they gave according to their ability and even beyond it. Of their own accord,
aov_text: Want hulle was na vermoë — ek betuig dit — ja, bo vermoë gewillig,

kjv_text: Praying us with much intreaty that we would receive the gift, and take upon us the fellowship of the ministering to the saints.
bsb_text: they earnestly pleaded with us for the privilege of sharing in this service to the saints.
aov_text: en het ons met groot aandrang gesmeek dat ons hulle gawe en hulle deel in die diensbetoning aan die heiliges moet ontvang;

kjv_text: And this they did, not as we hoped, but first gave their own selves to the Lord, and unto us by the will of God.
bsb_text: And not only did they do as we expected, but they gave themselves first to the Lord and then to us, because it was the will of God.
aov_text: en het nie alleen gedoen soos ons verwag het nie, maar het hulself eers aan die Here gegee, en toe aan ons deur die wil van God,

kjv_text: Insomuch that we desired Titus, that as he had begun, so he would also finish in you the same grace also.
bsb_text: So we urged Titus to help complete your act of grace, just as he had started it.
aov_text: sodat ons Titus versoek het dat hy, net soos hy tevore begin het, so ook by julle nog hierdie liefdedaad moet volbring.

kjv_text: Therefore, as ye abound in every thing, in faith, and utterance, and knowledge, and in all diligence, and in your love to us, see that ye abound in this grace also.
bsb_text: But just as you excel in everything—in faith, in speech, in knowledge, in complete earnestness, and in the love we inspired in you—see that you also excel in this grace of giving.
aov_text: Maar soos julle in alles oorvloedig is — in geloof en woord en kennis en alle ywer en in julle liefde vir ons — sorg dat julle ook in hierdie liefdedaad oorvloedig is.

kjv_text: I speak not by commandment, but by occasion of the forwardness of others, and to prove the sincerity of your love.
bsb_text: I am not making a demand, but I am testing the sincerity of your love in comparison to the earnestness of others.
aov_text: Ek sê dit nie as ’n bevel nie, maar om deur die ywer van ander ook die egtheid van julle liefde op die proef te stel.

kjv_text: For ye know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that ye through his poverty might be rich.
bsb_text: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though He was rich, yet for your sakes He became poor, so that you through His poverty might become rich.
aov_text: Want julle ken die genade van onse Here Jesus Christus, dat Hy, alhoewel Hy ryk was, ter wille van julle arm geword het, sodat julle deur sy armoede ryk kan word.

kjv_text: And herein I give my advice: for this is expedient for you, who have begun before, not only to do, but also to be forward a year ago.
bsb_text: And this is my opinion about what is helpful for you in this matter: Last year you were the first not only to give, but even to have such a desire.
aov_text: En ek gee in hierdie saak my oordeel, want dit is voordelig vir julle, omdat julle alreeds ’n jaar gelede begin het, nie alleen om te doen nie, maar ook om te wil.

kjv_text: Now therefore perform the doing of it; that as there was a readiness to will, so there may be a performance also out of that which ye have.
bsb_text: Now finish the work, so that you may complete it just as eagerly as you began, according to your means.
aov_text: Maar voltooi nou die daad ook, sodat, net soos die bereidheid om te wil daar was, so ook die voltooiing kan wees uit wat julle besit.

kjv_text: For if there be first a willing mind, it is accepted according to that a man hath, and not according to that he hath not.
bsb_text: For if the eagerness is there, the gift is acceptable according to what one has, not according to what he does not have.
aov_text: Want as die bereidwilligheid daar is, is dit welgevallig volgens wat iemand besit, nie volgens wat hy nie besit nie.

kjv_text: For I mean not that other men be eased, and ye burdened:
bsb_text: It is not our intention that others may be relieved while you are burdened, but that there may be equality.
aov_text: Want ek bedoel nie dat daar vir ander verligting moet wees en vir julle verdrukking nie,

kjv_text: But by an equality, that now at this time your abundance may be a supply for their want, that their abundance also may be a supply for your want: that there may be equality:
bsb_text: At the present time, your surplus will meet their need, so that in turn their surplus will meet your need. Then there will be equality.
aov_text: maar dat volgens gelykheid julle oorvloed in hierdie tyd hulle gebrek kan aanvul, sodat ook hulle oorvloed julle gebrek kan aanvul en daar gelykheid kan wees.

kjv_text: As it is written, He that had gathered much had nothing over; and he that had gathered little had no lack.
bsb_text: As it is written: “He who gathered much had no excess, and he who gathered little had no shortfall.”
aov_text: Soos geskrywe is: Hy wat baie gehad het, het nie te veel gehad nie; en hy wat weinig gehad het, het nie te min gehad nie.

kjv_text: But thanks be to God, which put the same earnest care into the heart of Titus for you.
bsb_text: But thanks be to God, who put into the heart of Titus the same devotion I have for you.
aov_text: Maar God sy dank, wat dieselfde ywer vir julle in die hart van Titus gegee het;

kjv_text: For indeed he accepted the exhortation; but being more forward, of his own accord he went unto you.
bsb_text: For not only did he welcome our appeal, but he is eagerly coming to you of his own volition.
aov_text: want hy het my aansporing wel ontvang, maar omdat hy baie ywerig was, het hy uit eie beweging na julle toe vertrek.

kjv_text: And we have sent with him the brother, whose praise is in the gospel throughout all the churches;
bsb_text: Along with Titus we are sending the brother who is praised by all the churches for his work in the gospel.
aov_text: En ons het ook met hom die broeder saamgestuur wat lof het in die evangelie deur al die gemeentes.

kjv_text: And not that only, but who was also chosen of the churches to travel with us with this grace, which is administered by us to the glory of the same Lord, and declaration of your ready mind:
bsb_text: More than that, this brother was chosen by the churches to accompany us with the offering—the gracious gift we administer to honor the Lord Himself and to show our eagerness to help.
aov_text: En dit nie alleen nie, maar hy is ook deur die gemeentes gekies as ons reisgenoot in verband met hierdie liefdewerk wat deur ons berei word, tot die heerlikheid van die Here self en as bewys van julle bereidwilligheid,

kjv_text: Avoiding this, that no man should blame us in this abundance which is administered by us:
bsb_text: We hope to avoid any criticism of the way we administer this generous gift.
aov_text: om te voorkom dat iemand ons sou belaster in verband met hierdie groot bydrae wat deur ons berei word.

kjv_text: Providing for honest things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.
bsb_text: For we are taking great care to do what is right, not only in the eyes of the Lord, but also in the eyes of men.
aov_text: Want ons bedink wat goed is nie alleen voor die Here nie, maar ook voor die mense.

kjv_text: And we have sent with them our brother, whom we have oftentimes proved diligent in many things, but now much more diligent, upon the great confidence which I have in you.
bsb_text: And we are sending along with them our brother whose earnestness has been proven many times and in many ways, and now even more so by his great confidence in you.
aov_text: En ons het met hulle saamgestuur ons broeder wat ons dikwels in baie dinge beproef gevind het, dat hy ywerig is en nou baie yweriger deur sy groot vertroue in julle.

kjv_text: Whether any do enquire of Titus, he is my partner and fellowhelper concerning you: or our brethren be enquired of, they are the messengers of the churches, and the glory of Christ.
bsb_text: As for Titus, he is my partner and fellow worker among you. As for our brothers, they are messengers of the churches, to the glory of Christ.
aov_text: Wat nou Titus betref, hy is my metgesel en medewerker by julle; of ons broeders, hulle is afgesante van die gemeentes, ’n eer vir Christus.

kjv_text: Wherefore shew ye to them, and before the churches, the proof of your love, and of our boasting on your behalf.
bsb_text: In full view of the churches, then, show these men the proof of your love and the reason for our boasting about you.
aov_text: Gee dan aan hulle die bewys van julle liefde en van ons roem oor julle, ook voor die gemeentes.

kjv_text: For as touching the ministering to the saints, it is superfluous for me to write to you:
bsb_text: Now about the service to the saints, there is no need for me to write to you.
aov_text: WANT wat die diensbetoning aan die heiliges betref, is dit vir my oorbodig om aan julle te skrywe.

kjv_text: For I know the forwardness of your mind, for which I boast of you to them of Macedonia, that Achaia was ready a year ago; and your zeal hath provoked very many.
bsb_text: For I know your eagerness to help, and I have been boasting to the Macedonians that since last year you in Achaia were prepared to give. And your zeal has stirred most of them to do likewise.
aov_text: Want ek ken julle bereidwilligheid waarop ek oor julle by die Macedóniërs roem, dat Acháje ’n jaar gelede gereed was, en dat die ywer wat van julle uitgegaan het, baie ander aangespoor het.

kjv_text: Yet have I sent the brethren, lest our boasting of you should be in vain in this behalf; that, as I said, ye may be ready:
bsb_text: But I am sending the brothers in order that our boasting about you in this matter should not prove empty, but that you will be prepared, just as I said.
aov_text: Maar ek het die broeders gestuur, sodat ons roem oor julle in hierdie geval nie verydel mag word nie, dat, soos ek gesê het, julle gereed kan wees,

kjv_text: Lest haply if they of Macedonia come with me, and find you unprepared, we (that we say not, ye) should be ashamed in this same confident boasting.
bsb_text: Otherwise, if any Macedonians come with me and find you unprepared, we—to say nothing of you—would be ashamed of having been so confident.
aov_text: sodat nie miskien, as daar Macedóniërs saam met my kom en julle nie gereed vind nie, ons, om nie te sê julle nie, beskaam word in hierdie vertroue van ons roem nie.

kjv_text: Therefore I thought it necessary to exhort the brethren, that they would go before unto you, and make up beforehand your bounty, whereof ye had notice before, that the same might be ready, as a matter of bounty, and not as of covetousness.
bsb_text: So I thought it necessary to urge the brothers to visit you beforehand and make arrangements for the bountiful gift you had promised. This way, your gift will be prepared generously and not begrudgingly.
aov_text: Ek het dit dus noodsaaklik geag om die broeders te versoek om vooruit te gaan na julle toe en julle vroeër aangekondigde dankoffer vooraf in orde te bring, sodat dit gereed kan wees as ’n dankoffer en nie as iets wat afgepers is nie.

kjv_text: But this I say, He which soweth sparingly shall reap also sparingly; and he which soweth bountifully shall reap also bountifully.
bsb_text: Remember this: Whoever sows sparingly will also reap sparingly, and whoever sows generously will also reap generously.
aov_text: Maar dink daaraan: Wie spaarsaamlik saai, sal ook spaarsaamlik maai; en wie volop saai, sal ook volop maai.

kjv_text: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.
bsb_text: Each one should give what he has decided in his heart to give, not out of regret or compulsion. For God loves a cheerful giver.
aov_text: Laat elkeen gee soos hy hom in sy hart voorneem, nie met droefheid of uit dwang nie, want God het ’n blymoedige gewer lief.

kjv_text: And God is able to make all grace abound toward you; that ye, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work:
