bsb_text: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, so that in all things, at all times, having all that you need, you will abound in every good work.
aov_text: En God het mag om alle genade oorvloedig oor julle te laat wees, sodat julle altyd in alle opsigte volop kan hê en oorvloedig kan wees tot elke goeie werk.

kjv_text: (As it is written, He hath dispersed abroad; he hath given to the poor: his righteousness remaineth for ever.
bsb_text: As it is written: “He has scattered abroad His gifts to the poor; His righteousness endures forever.”
aov_text: Soos geskrywe is: Hy het uitgestrooi, hy het aan die armes gegee, sy geregtigheid bly tot in ewigheid.

kjv_text: Now he that ministereth seed to the sower both minister bread for your food, and multiply your seed sown, and increase the fruits of your righteousness;)
bsb_text: Now He who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food will supply and multiply your store of seed and will increase the harvest of your righteousness.
aov_text: En mag Hy wat saad verskaf aan die saaier, ook brood verskaf om te eet en julle saad vermeerder en die vrug van julle geregtigheid laat toeneem,

kjv_text: Being enriched in every thing to all bountifulness, which causeth through us thanksgiving to God.
bsb_text: You will be enriched in every way to be generous on every occasion, so that through us your giving will produce thanksgiving to God.
aov_text: sodat julle in alles ryk kan word tot alle milddadigheid, wat danksegging aan God deur ons bewerk.

kjv_text: For the administration of this service not only supplieth the want of the saints, but is abundant also by many thanksgivings unto God;
bsb_text: For this ministry of service is not only supplying the needs of the saints, but is also overflowing in many expressions of thanksgiving to God.
aov_text: Want die bediening van hierdie hulpbetoning voorsien nie alleen in die behoeftes van die heiliges nie, maar is ook oorvloedig deur baie danksegginge aan God,

kjv_text: Whiles by the experiment of this ministration they glorify God for your professed subjection unto the gospel of Christ, and for your liberal distribution unto them, and unto all men;
bsb_text: Because of the proof this ministry provides, the saints will glorify God for your obedient confession of the gospel of Christ, and for the generosity of your contribution to them and to all the others.
aov_text: omdat hulle deur die bewys van hierdie diens God verheerlik oor die onderwerping van julle belydenis aan die evangelie van Christus en oor die milddadigheid van die bydrae aan hulle en aan almal,

kjv_text: And by their prayer for you, which long after you for the exceeding grace of God in you.
bsb_text: And their prayers for you will express their affection for you, because of the surpassing grace God has given you.
aov_text: terwyl hulle ook in die gebed vir julle na julle verlang vanweë die uitnemende genade van God aan julle.

kjv_text: Thanks be unto God for his unspeakable gift.
bsb_text: Thanks be to God for His indescribable gift!
aov_text: Maar God sy dank vir sy onuitspreeklike gawe.

kjv_text: Now I Paul myself beseech you by the meekness and gentleness of Christ, who in presence am base among you, but being absent am bold toward you:
bsb_text: Now by the mildness and gentleness of Christ, I appeal to you—I, Paul, who am humble when face to face with you, but bold when away.
aov_text: EN ek self, Paulus, bid julle by die sagmoedigheid en vriendelikheid van Christus, ek wat in julle teenwoordigheid wel nederig is onder julle, maar in my afwesigheid moedig teenoor julle  —

kjv_text: But I beseech you, that I may not be bold when I am present with that confidence, wherewith I think to be bold against some, which think of us as if we walked according to the flesh.
bsb_text: I beg you that when I come I may not need to be as bold as I expect toward those who presume that we live according to the flesh.
aov_text: ek smeek dan dat as ek teenwoordig is, ek nie moedig hoef te wees met die vertroue waarmee ek meen om dit aan te durf teen sommige wat reken dat ons volgens die vlees wandel nie.

kjv_text: For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh:
bsb_text: For though we live in the flesh, we do not wage war according to the flesh.
aov_text: Want hoewel ons in die vlees wandel, voer ons die stryd nie volgens die vlees nie;

kjv_text: (For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds;)
bsb_text: The weapons of our warfare are not the weapons of the world. Instead, they have divine power to demolish strongholds.
aov_text: want die wapens van ons stryd is nie vleeslik nie, maar kragtig deur God om vestings neer te werp,

kjv_text: Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ;
bsb_text: We tear down arguments and every presumption set up against the knowledge of God; and we take captive every thought to make it obedient to Christ.
aov_text: terwyl ons planne verbreek en elke skans wat opgewerp word teen die kennis van God, en elke gedagte gevange neem tot die gehoorsaamheid aan Christus,

kjv_text: And having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience, when your obedience is fulfilled.
bsb_text: And we will be ready to punish every act of disobedience, as soon as your obedience is complete.
aov_text: en ons gereed hou om elke ongehoorsaamheid te straf wanneer julle gehoorsaamheid volkome is.

kjv_text: Do ye look on things after the outward appearance? If any man trust to himself that he is Christ's, let him of himself think this again, that, as he is Christ's, even so are we Christ's.
bsb_text: You are looking at outward appearances. If anyone is confident that he belongs to Christ, he should remind himself that we belong to Christ just as much as he does.
aov_text: Kyk julle na wat voor oë is? As iemand by homself vertrou dat hy aan Christus behoort, laat hy dit by homself weer oorweeg, dat net soos hy self aan Christus behoort, ons ook so aan Christus behoort;

kjv_text: For though I should boast somewhat more of our authority, which the Lord hath given us for edification, and not for your destruction, I should not be ashamed:
bsb_text: For even if I boast somewhat excessively about the authority the Lord gave us for building you up rather than tearing you down, I will not be ashamed.
aov_text: want al sou ek ook nog meer roem oor ons gesag wat die Here ons gegee het om julle op te bou en nie neer te werp nie, sal ek nie beskaamd uitkom nie  —

kjv_text: That I may not seem as if I would terrify you by letters.
bsb_text: I do not want to seem to be trying to frighten you by my letters.
aov_text: anders sou dit die skyn hê asof ek julle deur die briewe wil bang maak.

kjv_text: For his letters, say they, are weighty and powerful; but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech contemptible.
bsb_text: For some say, “His letters are weighty and forceful, but his physical presence is unimpressive, and his speaking is of no account.”
aov_text: Want die briewe, sê hulle, is wel gewigtig en kragtig, maar die persoonlike teenwoordigheid is swak en die woord niks werd nie.

kjv_text: Let such an one think this, that, such as we are in word by letters when we are absent, such will we be also in deed when we are present.
bsb_text: Such people should consider that what we are in our letters when absent, we will be in our actions when present.
aov_text: Laat so iemand bedink dat soos ons met die woord deur briewe in ons afwesigheid is, ons dit ook met die daad in ons aanwesigheid is.

kjv_text: For we dare not make ourselves of the number, or compare ourselves with some that commend themselves: but they measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves among themselves, are not wise.
bsb_text: We do not dare to classify or compare ourselves with some who commend themselves. When they measure themselves by themselves and compare themselves with themselves, they show their ignorance.
aov_text: Want ons waag dit nie om ons te reken of te vergelyk met sommige van die wat hulleself aanbeveel nie. Maar omdat hulle hul met hulself meet en met hulself vergelyk, is hulle onverstandig.

kjv_text: But we will not boast of things without our measure, but according to the measure of the rule which God hath distributed to us, a measure to reach even unto you.
bsb_text: We, however, will not boast beyond our limits, but only within the field of influence that God has assigned to us—a field that reaches even to you.
aov_text: Maar ons sal nie buite die maat roem nie, maar volgens die maat van die werkkring wat God ons as ’n maat toebedeel het om ook julle te bereik.

kjv_text: For we stretch not ourselves beyond our measure, as though we reached not unto you: for we are come as far as to you also in preaching the gospel of Christ:
bsb_text: We are not overstepping our bounds, as if we had not come to you. Indeed, we were the first to reach you with the gospel of Christ.
aov_text: Want ons strek onsself nie te ver uit asof ons julle nie kan bereik nie, want ons het reeds by julle gekom met die evangelie van Christus.

kjv_text: Not boasting of things without our measure, that is, of other men's labours; but having hope, when your faith is increased, that we shall be enlarged by you according to our rule abundantly,
bsb_text: Neither do we boast beyond our limits in the labors of others. But we hope that as your faith increases, our area of influence among you will greatly increase as well,
aov_text: Ons roem nie buite die maat in die arbeid van ander nie, maar ons het hoop om, wanneer julle geloof toeneem, in hoër mate onder julle toe te neem volgens ons werkkring,

kjv_text: To preach the gospel in the regions beyond you, and not to boast in another man's line of things made ready to our hand.
bsb_text: so that we can preach the gospel in the regions beyond you. Then we will not be boasting in the work already done in another man’s territory.
aov_text: om die evangelie te verkondig in plekke anderkant julle, nie om in die werkkring van ’n ander oor wat tot stand gekom het, te roem nie.

kjv_text: But he that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.
bsb_text: Rather, “Let him who boasts boast in the Lord.”
aov_text: Maar wie roem, moet in die Here roem.

kjv_text: For not he that commendeth himself is approved, but whom the Lord commendeth.
bsb_text: For it is not the one who commends himself who is approved, but the one whom the Lord commends.
aov_text: Want nie hy wat homself aanbeveel, dié is beproef nie, maar hy wat deur die Here aanbeveel word.

kjv_text: Would to God ye could bear with me a little in my folly: and indeed bear with me.
bsb_text: I hope you will bear with a little of my foolishness, but you are already doing that.
aov_text: AG, as julle my net ’n bietjie in my dwaasheid wou verdra! Verdra my tog maar!

kjv_text: For I am jealous over you with godly jealousy: for I have espoused you to one husband, that I may present you as a chaste virgin to Christ.
bsb_text: I am jealous for you with a godly jealousy. For I promised you to one husband, to present you as a pure virgin to Christ.
aov_text: Want ek is jaloers oor julle met ’n goddelike jaloersheid, want ek het julle aan een man verbind, om julle as ’n reine maagd aan Christus voor te stel.

kjv_text: But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.
bsb_text: I am afraid, however, that just as Eve was deceived by the serpent’s cunning, your minds may be led astray from your simple and pure devotion to Christ.
aov_text: Maar ek vrees dat, net soos die slang Eva deur sy listigheid bedrieg het, julle sinne so miskien bedorwe kan raak, vervreemd van die opregtheid teenoor Christus.

kjv_text: For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we have not preached, or if ye receive another spirit, which ye have not received, or another gospel, which ye have not accepted, ye might well bear with him.
bsb_text: For if someone comes and proclaims a Jesus other than the One we proclaimed, or if you receive a different spirit than the One you received, or a different gospel than the one you accepted, you put up with it way too easily.
aov_text: Want as iemand kom en ’n ander Jesus verkondig as wat ons verkondig het, of as julle ’n ander gees ontvang as wat julle ontvang het, of ’n ander evangelie as wat julle aangeneem het, laat julle jul dit goed geval.

kjv_text: For I suppose I was not a whit behind the very chiefest apostles.
bsb_text: I consider myself in no way inferior to those “super-apostles.”
aov_text: Want ek reken dat ek niks agterstaan by dié uitnemende apostels nie.

kjv_text: But though I be rude in speech, yet not in knowledge; but we have been throughly made manifest among you in all things.
bsb_text: Although I am not a polished speaker, I am certainly not lacking in knowledge. We have made this clear to you in every way possible.
aov_text: En al is ek ook onbedrewe in woord, dan tog nie in kennis nie; maar ons het ten volle in alle opsigte openbaar geword by julle.

kjv_text: Have I committed an offence in abasing myself that ye might be exalted, because I have preached to you the gospel of God freely?
bsb_text: Was it a sin for me to humble myself in order to exalt you, because I preached the gospel of God to you free of charge?
aov_text: Of het ek sonde gedoen deur my te verneder sodat julle verhoog kan word, omdat ek die evangelie van God kosteloos aan julle verkondig het?

kjv_text: I robbed other churches, taking wages of them, to do you service.
bsb_text: I robbed other churches by accepting their support in order to serve you.
aov_text: Ander gemeentes het ek beroof deur vergoeding te neem om julle te bedien; en toe ek by julle teenwoordig was en gebrek gehad het, het ek niemand lastig geval nie.

kjv_text: And when I was present with you, and wanted, I was chargeable to no man: for that which was lacking to me the brethren which came from Macedonia supplied: and in all things I have kept myself from being burdensome unto you, and so will I keep myself.
bsb_text: And when I was with you and in need, I was not a burden to anyone; for the brothers who came from Macedonia supplied my needs. I have refrained from being a burden to you in any way, and I will continue to do so.
aov_text: Want in my gebrek het die broeders voorsien wat van Macedónië gekom het. En ek het my in alles in ag geneem om julle nie te beswaar nie, en ek sal my in ag neem.

kjv_text: As the truth of Christ is in me, no man shall stop me of this boasting in the regions of Achaia.
bsb_text: As surely as the truth of Christ is in me, this boasting of mine will not be silenced in the regions of Achaia.
aov_text: So seker as die waarheid van Christus in my is, sal hierdie roem in die streke van Acháje my nie ontneem word nie.

kjv_text: Wherefore? because I love you not? God knoweth.
bsb_text: Why? Because I do not love you? God knows I do!
aov_text: Waarom? Omdat ek julle nie liefhet nie? God weet dit.

kjv_text: But what I do, that I will do, that I may cut off occasion from them which desire occasion; that wherein they glory, they may be found even as we.
bsb_text: But I will keep on doing what I am doing, in order to undercut those who want an opportunity to be regarded as our equals in the things of which they boast.
aov_text: Maar wat ek doen, sal ek nog doen om die aanleiding af te sny vir die wat ’n aanleiding wil hê, sodat hulle in die saak waar hulle op roem, net soos ons bevind mag word.

kjv_text: For such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ.
bsb_text: For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as apostles of Christ.
aov_text: Want sulke mense is valse apostels, bedrieglike arbeiders wat hulleself verander in apostels van Christus.

kjv_text: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.
bsb_text: And no wonder, for Satan himself masquerades as an angel of light.
aov_text: En geen wonder nie! Want die Satan self verander hom in ’n engel van die lig.

kjv_text: Therefore it is no great thing if his ministers also be transformed as the ministers of righteousness; whose end shall be according to their works.
bsb_text: It is not surprising, then, if his servants masquerade as servants of righteousness. Their end will correspond to their actions.
aov_text: Dit is dus niks besonders wanneer sy dienaars hulle ook voordoen as dienaars van geregtigheid nie. Maar hulle einde sal wees volgens hulle werke.

kjv_text: I say again, Let no man think me a fool; if otherwise, yet as a fool receive me, that I may boast myself a little.
bsb_text: I repeat: Let no one take me for a fool. But if you do, then receive me as a fool, so that I too may boast a little.
aov_text: WEER sê ek dat niemand moet dink dat ek dwaas is nie; of anders, neem my maar aan as ’n dwaas, sodat ek ook ’n bietjie kan roem.

kjv_text: That which I speak, I speak it not after the Lord, but as it were foolishly, in this confidence of boasting.
bsb_text: In this confident boasting of mine, I am not speaking as the Lord would, but as a fool.
aov_text: Wat ek spreek, sê ek nie vanweë die Here nie, maar as in dwaasheid, in hierdie vertroue dat ek mag roem.

kjv_text: Seeing that many glory after the flesh, I will glory also.
bsb_text: Since many are boasting according to the flesh, I too will boast.
aov_text: Terwyl baie na die vlees roem, sal ek ook roem.

kjv_text: For ye suffer fools gladly, seeing ye yourselves are wise.
bsb_text: For you gladly tolerate fools, since you are so wise.
aov_text: Want julle verdra graag die dwase, omdat julle so verstandig is!

kjv_text: For ye suffer, if a man bring you into bondage, if a man devour you, if a man take of you, if a man exalt himself, if a man smite you on the face.
bsb_text: In fact, you even put up with anyone who enslaves you or exploits you or takes advantage of you or exalts himself or strikes you in the face.
aov_text: Julle verdra dit mos as iemand knegte van julle maak, as iemand julle opeet, as iemand julle beetneem, as iemand hom aanstel, as iemand julle in die gesig slaan.

kjv_text: I speak as concerning reproach, as though we had been weak. Howbeit whereinsoever any is bold, (I speak foolishly,) I am bold also.
bsb_text: To my shame I concede that we were too weak for that! Speaking as a fool, however, I can match what anyone else dares to boast about.
aov_text: Tot my skande moet ek erken dat ons daarvoor te swak was; maar as iemand dit aandurf — ek spreek in dwaasheid — ek durf ook.

kjv_text: Are they Hebrews? so am I. Are they Israelites? so am I. Are they the seed of Abraham? so am I.
bsb_text: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they descendants of Abraham? So am I.
aov_text: Is hulle Hebreërs? Ek ook. Is hulle Israeliete? Ek ook. Is hulle die nakomelinge van Abraham? Ek ook.

kjv_text: Are they ministers of Christ? (I speak as a fool) I am more; in labours more abundant, in stripes above measure, in prisons more frequent, in deaths oft.
bsb_text: Are they servants of Christ? I am speaking like I am out of my mind, but I am so much more: in harder labor, in more imprisonments, in worse beatings, in frequent danger of death.
aov_text: Is hulle dienaars van Christus?  — ek praat in uitsinnigheid — ek nog meer: in arbeid oorvloediger, in slae bo die maat, in gevangenskappe baie meer, in doodsgevare dikwels.

kjv_text: Of the Jews five times received I forty stripes save one.
bsb_text: Five times I received from the Jews the forty lashes minus one.
aov_text: Vyf maal het ek van die Jode ontvang veertig houe op een na.

kjv_text: Thrice was I beaten with rods, once was I stoned, thrice I suffered shipwreck, a night and a day I have been in the deep;
bsb_text: Three times I was beaten with rods, once I was stoned, three times I was shipwrecked. I spent a night and a day in the open sea.
aov_text: Drie maal is ek met stokke geslaan, een maal is ek gestenig, drie maal het ek skipbreuk gely, ’n nag en ’n dag het ek op die diepwater deurgebring  —

kjv_text: In journeyings often, in perils of waters, in perils of robbers, in perils by mine own countrymen, in perils by the heathen, in perils in the city, in perils in the wilderness, in perils in the sea, in perils among false brethren;
bsb_text: In my frequent journeys, I have been in danger from rivers and from bandits, in danger from my countrymen and from the Gentiles, in danger in the city and in the country, in danger on the sea and among false brothers,
aov_text: dikwels op reis, in gevare van riviere, in gevare van rowers, in gevare van my volk, in gevare van die heidene, in gevare in die stad, in gevare in die woestyn, in gevare op see, in gevare onder valse broeders;

kjv_text: In weariness and painfulness, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, in cold and nakedness.
bsb_text: in labor and toil and often without sleep, in hunger and thirst and often without food, in cold and exposure.
aov_text: in arbeid en moeite, in slapelose nagte dikwels, in honger en dors, dikwels sonder ete, in koue en naaktheid.

kjv_text: Beside those things that are without, that which cometh upon me daily, the care of all the churches.
bsb_text: Apart from these external trials, I face daily the pressure of my concern for all the churches.
aov_text: Behalwe dit alles my daaglikse bekommernis, die sorg vir al die gemeentes.

kjv_text: Who is weak, and I am not weak? who is offended, and I burn not?
bsb_text: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is led into sin, and I do not burn with grief?
aov_text: Wie is swak en ek is nie swak nie? Aan wie word ’n struikelblok in die weg gelê en ek is nie aan die brand nie?

kjv_text: If I must needs glory, I will glory of the things which concern mine infirmities.
bsb_text: If I must boast, I will boast of the things that show my weakness.
aov_text: As daar geroem moet word, sal ek in my swakhede roem.

kjv_text: The God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which is blessed for evermore, knoweth that I lie not.
bsb_text: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus, who is forever worthy of praise, knows that I am not lying.
aov_text: Die God en Vader van onse Here Jesus Christus, geseënd tot in ewigheid, weet dat ek nie lieg nie.

kjv_text: In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king kept the city of the Damascenes with a garrison, desirous to apprehend me:
bsb_text: In Damascus, the governor under King Aretas secured the city of the Damascenes in order to arrest me.
aov_text: In Damaskus het die goewerneur van koning Arétas die stad van die Damaskéners laat bewaak om my te vang;

kjv_text: And through a window in a basket was I let down by the wall, and escaped his hands.
bsb_text: But I was lowered in a basket through a window in the wall and escaped his grasp.
aov_text: en ek is in ’n mandjie deur ’n venster in die muur neergelaat en het aan sy hande ontkom.

kjv_text: It is not expedient for me doubtless to glory. I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.
bsb_text: I must go on boasting. Although there is nothing to gain, I will go on to visions and revelations from the Lord.
aov_text: DIT is waarlik vir my nie nuttig om te roem nie, want ek sal kom tot gesigte en openbaringe van die Here.

kjv_text: I knew a man in Christ above fourteen years ago, (whether in the body, I cannot tell; or whether out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;) such an one caught up to the third heaven.
bsb_text: I know a man in Christ who fourteen years ago was caught up to the third heaven. Whether it was in the body or out of it I do not know, but God knows.
aov_text: Ek weet van ’n man in Christus, veertien jaar gelede — of dit in die liggaam was, weet ek nie, of buite die liggaam, weet ek nie, God weet dit — dat so iemand weggeruk is tot in die derde hemel.

kjv_text: And I knew such a man, (whether in the body, or out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;)
bsb_text: And I know that this man—whether in the body or out of it I do not know, but God knows—
aov_text: En ek weet van so ’n man — of dit in die liggaam of buite die liggaam was, weet ek nie, God weet dit  —

kjv_text: How that he was caught up into paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.
bsb_text: was caught up to Paradise. The things he heard were too sacred for words, things that man is not permitted to tell.
aov_text: dat hy weggeruk is in die Paradys en onuitspreeklike woorde gehoor het wat ’n mens nie mag uitspreek nie.

kjv_text: Of such an one will I glory: yet of myself I will not glory, but in mine infirmities.
bsb_text: I will boast about such a man, but I will not boast about myself, except in my weaknesses.
aov_text: Oor so ’n man sal ek roem, maar oor myself sal ek nie roem nie, behalwe in my swakhede.

kjv_text: For though I would desire to glory, I shall not be a fool; for I will say the truth: but now I forbear, lest any man should think of me above that which he seeth me to be, or that he heareth of me.
bsb_text: Even if I wanted to boast, I would not be a fool, because I would be speaking the truth. But I refrain, so no one will credit me with more than he sees in me or hears from me,
aov_text: Want as ek sou wil roem, sou ek nie ’n dwaas wees nie, want ek sou die waarheid praat; maar ek laat dit ná, sodat niemand my hoër mag skat as wat hy van my sien of wat hy van my hoor nie.

kjv_text: And lest I should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, the messenger of Satan to buffet me, lest I should be exalted above measure.
bsb_text: or because of these surpassingly great revelations. So to keep me from becoming conceited, I was given a thorn in my flesh, a messenger of Satan, to torment me.
aov_text: En dat ek my oor die voortreflikheid van die openbaringe nie sou verhef nie, is my ’n doring in die vlees gegee, ’n engel van die Satan, om my met die vuis te slaan, dat ek my nie sou verhef nie.

kjv_text: For this thing I besought the Lord thrice, that it might depart from me.
bsb_text: Three times I pleaded with the Lord to take it away from me.
aov_text: Hieroor het ek die Here drie maal gebid, dat hy van my sou wyk.

kjv_text: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
bsb_text: But He said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is perfected in weakness.” Therefore I will boast all the more gladly in my weaknesses, so that the power of Christ may rest on me.
aov_text: En Hy het vir my gesê: My genade is vir jou genoeg, want my krag word in swakheid volbring. Baie liewer sal ek dus in my swakhede roem, sodat die krag van Christus in my kan woon.

kjv_text: Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for Christ's sake: for when I am weak, then am I strong.
bsb_text: That is why, for the sake of Christ, I delight in weaknesses, in insults, in hardships, in persecutions, in difficulties. For when I am weak, then I am strong.
aov_text: Daarom het ek behae in swakhede, in mishandelinge, in node, in vervolginge, in benoudhede, om Christus wil. Want as ek swak is, dan is ek sterk.

kjv_text: I am become a fool in glorying; ye have compelled me: for I ought to have been commended of you: for in nothing am I behind the very chiefest apostles, though I be nothing.
bsb_text: I have become a fool, but you drove me to it. In fact, you should have commended me, since I am in no way inferior to those “super-apostles,” even though I am nothing.
aov_text: AL roemende het ek dwaas geword. Julle het my daartoe genoodsaak. Want ek moes deur julle aanbeveel geword het; want ek het niks by dié uitnemende apostels agtergestaan nie, al is ek niks nie.

kjv_text: Truly the signs of an apostle were wrought among you in all patience, in signs, and wonders, and mighty deeds.
bsb_text: The true marks of an apostle—signs, wonders, and miracles—were performed among you with great perseverance.
aov_text: Die kentekens tog van ’n apostel is onder julle verwerklik met alle volharding deur tekens en wonders en kragtige dade.

kjv_text: For what is it wherein ye were inferior to other churches, except it be that I myself was not burdensome to you? forgive me this wrong.
bsb_text: In what way were you inferior to the other churches, except that I was not a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong!
aov_text: Want wat is daar waarin julle oortref word deur die ander gemeentes, behalwe dat ek persoonlik julle nie lastig geval het nie? Vergeef my hierdie onreg.

kjv_text: Behold, the third time I am ready to come to you; and I will not be burdensome to you: for I seek not yours, but you: for the children ought not to lay up for the parents, but the parents for the children.
bsb_text: See, I am ready to come to you a third time, and I will not be a burden, because I am not seeking your possessions, but you. For children should not have to save up for their parents, but parents for their children.
aov_text: Kyk, vir die derde keer is ek gereed om na julle te kom; en ek sal julle nie lastig val nie, want ek soek nie julle goed nie, maar julle self; want dit is nie die kinders wat vir die ouers moet opgaar nie, maar die ouers vir die kinders.

kjv_text: And I will very gladly spend and be spent for you; though the more abundantly I love you, the less I be loved.
bsb_text: And for the sake of your souls, I will most gladly spend my money and myself. If I love you more, will you love me less?
aov_text: En ek sal baie graag uitgee, ja, myself weggee vir julle siele, al word ek, terwyl ek julle oorvloediger liefhet, minder bemin.

kjv_text: But be it so, I did not burden you: nevertheless, being crafty, I caught you with guile.
bsb_text: Be that as it may, I was not a burden to you; but crafty as I am, I caught you by trickery.
aov_text: Maar laat dit so wees! Ek het julle nie beswaar nie, maar omdat ek slim was, het ek julle met lis gevang.

kjv_text: Did I make a gain of you by any of them whom I sent unto you?
bsb_text: Did I exploit you by anyone I sent you?
aov_text: Het ek my dan ten koste van julle bevoordeel deur een van die wat ek na julle gestuur het?

kjv_text: I desired Titus, and with him I sent a brother. Did Titus make a gain of you? walked we not in the same spirit? walked we not in the same steps?
bsb_text: I urged Titus to visit you, and I sent our brother with him. Did Titus exploit you in any way? Did we not walk in the same Spirit and follow in the same footsteps?
aov_text: Ek het Titus gevra en die broeder saamgestuur. Het Titus hom dan ten koste van julle bevoordeel? Het ons nie in dieselfde gees, in dieselfde spore gewandel nie?

kjv_text: Again, think ye that we excuse ourselves unto you? we speak before God in Christ: but we do all things, dearly beloved, for your edifying.
bsb_text: Have you been thinking all along that we were making a defense to you? We speak before God in Christ, and all of this, beloved, is to build you up.
aov_text: DINK julle weer dat ons ons by julle verdedig? Ons spreek in die teenwoordigheid van God in Christus, en dit alles, geliefdes, tot julle stigting.

kjv_text: For I fear, lest, when I come, I shall not find you such as I would, and that I shall be found unto you such as ye would not: lest there be debates, envyings, wraths, strifes, backbitings, whisperings, swellings, tumults:
bsb_text: For I am afraid that when I come, I may not find you as I wish, and you may not find me as you wish. I fear that there may be quarreling, jealousy, rage, rivalry, slander, gossip, arrogance, and disorder.
aov_text: Want ek vrees dat ek julle by my koms miskien nie sal vind soos ek wens nie, en dat ek deur julle gevind sal word soos julle nie wens nie — dat daar miskien sal wees twis, jaloersheid, toornigheid, verdeeldheid, kwaadsprekery, nuusdraery, verwaandheid, wanordelikheid;

kjv_text: And lest, when I come again, my God will humble me among you, and that I shall bewail many which have sinned already, and have not repented of the uncleanness and fornication and lasciviousness which they have committed.
bsb_text: I am afraid that when I come again, my God will humble me before you, and I will be grieved over many who have sinned earlier and have not repented of their acts of impurity, sexual immorality, and debauchery.
aov_text: dat as ek gekom het, my God my miskien weer by julle sal verneder en ek sal treur oor baie van die wat vroeër gesondig het en hulle nie bekeer het van die onreinheid en hoerery en ongebondenheid wat hulle bedryf het nie.

kjv_text: This is the third time I am coming to you. In the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.
bsb_text: This is the third time I am coming to you. “Every matter must be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.”
aov_text: DIT is die derde keer dat ek na julle toe kom. In die mond van twee of drie getuies sal elke woord vasstaan.

kjv_text: I told you before, and foretell you, as if I were present, the second time; and being absent now I write to them which heretofore have sinned, and to all other, that, if I come again, I will not spare:
bsb_text: I already warned you the second time I was with you. So now in my absence I warn those who sinned earlier and everyone else: If I return, I will not spare anyone,
aov_text: Ek het dit vroeër gesê, en ek sê dit vooruit soos toe ek die tweede keer aanwesig was, en ek skrywe dit nou in my afwesigheid aan die wat vroeër gesondig het en aan al die ander, dat as ek weer kom, ek nie sal spaar nie,

kjv_text: Since ye seek a proof of Christ speaking in me, which to you-ward is not weak, but is mighty in you.
bsb_text: since you are demanding proof that Christ is speaking through me. He is not weak in dealing with you, but is powerful among you.
aov_text: aangesien julle ’n bewys soek van Christus wat in my spreek, en Hy is teenoor julle nie swak nie, maar kragtig onder julle.

kjv_text: For though he was crucified through weakness, yet he liveth by the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we shall live with him by the power of God toward you.
bsb_text: For He was indeed crucified in weakness, yet He lives by God’s power. And though we are weak in Him, yet by God’s power we will live with Him to serve you.
aov_text: Want al is Hy gekruisig uit swakheid, lewe Hy tog uit die krag van God. Want ons is ook swak in Hom, maar ons sal saam met Hom vir julle lewe deur die krag van God.

kjv_text: Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves. Know ye not your own selves, how that Jesus Christ is in you, except ye be reprobates?
bsb_text: Examine yourselves to see whether you are in the faith; test yourselves. Can’t you see for yourselves that Jesus Christ is in you—unless you actually fail the test?
aov_text: Ondersoek julself of julle in die geloof is; stel julself op die proef. Of is julle nie seker van julself dat Jesus Christus in julle is nie — as julle ten minste nie verwerplik is nie!

kjv_text: But I trust that ye shall know that we are not reprobates.
bsb_text: And I hope you will realize that we have not failed the test.
aov_text: Maar ek hoop dat julle sal insien dat ons nie verwerplik is nie.

kjv_text: Now I pray to God that ye do no evil; not that we should appear approved, but that ye should do that which is honest, though we be as reprobates.
bsb_text: Now we pray to God that you will not do anything wrong—not that we will appear to have stood the test, but that you will do what is right, even if we appear to have failed.
aov_text: Ek bid God dat julle geen kwaad mag doen nie — nie dat ons beproef mag blyk nie, maar dat julle kan doen wat goed is, en ons as verwerplikes kan wees.

kjv_text: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.
bsb_text: For we cannot do anything against the truth, but only for the truth.
aov_text: Want ons kan niks doen teen die waarheid nie, maar wel vír die waarheid.

kjv_text: For we are glad, when we are weak, and ye are strong: and this also we wish, even your perfection.
bsb_text: In fact, we rejoice when we are weak but you are strong, and our prayer is for your perfection.
aov_text: Want ons is bly as ons swak is en julle sterk. En hierom bid ons ook, naamlik om julle volmaking.

kjv_text: Therefore I write these things being absent, lest being present I should use sharpness, according to the power which the Lord hath given me to edification, and not to destruction.
bsb_text: This is why I write these things while absent, so that when I am present I will not need to be severe in my use of the authority that the Lord gave me for building you up, not for tearing you down.
aov_text: Daarom skryf ek dit in my afwesigheid om nie, as ek teenwoordig is, strengheid te gebruik nie, volgens die gesag wat die Here my gegee het om op te bou en nie om af te breek nie.

kjv_text: Finally, brethren, farewell. Be perfect, be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; and the God of love and peace shall be with you.
bsb_text: Finally, brothers, rejoice! Aim for perfect harmony, encourage one another, be of one mind, live in peace. And the God of love and peace will be with you.
aov_text: Verder, broeders, wees bly; word volmaak; laat julle vermaan; wees eensgesind; hou vrede, en die God van liefde en vrede sal met julle wees.

kjv_text: Greet one another with an holy kiss.
bsb_text: Greet one another with a holy kiss.
aov_text: Groet mekaar met ’n heilige kus.

kjv_text: All the saints salute you.
bsb_text: All the saints send you greetings.
aov_text: Al die heiliges groet julle.

kjv_text: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Ghost, be with you all. Amen.
bsb_text: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with all of you.
aov_text: Die genade van die Here Jesus Christus en die liefde van God en die gemeenskap van die Heilige Gees sy met julle almal! Amen.

kjv_text: Paul, an apostle, (not of men, neither by man, but by Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead;)
bsb_text: Paul, an apostle—sent not from men nor by man, but by Jesus Christ and God the Father, who raised Him from the dead—
aov_text: PAULUS, ’n apostel nie vanweë mense of deur ’n mens nie, maar deur Jesus Christus en God die Vader wat Hom uit die dode opgewek het,

kjv_text: And all the brethren which are with me, unto the churches of Galatia:
bsb_text: and all the brothers with me, To the churches of Galatia:
aov_text: en al die broeders wat by my is — aan die gemeentes van Galásië:

kjv_text: Grace be to you and peace from God the Father, and from our Lord Jesus Christ,
bsb_text: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ,
aov_text: Genade vir julle en vrede van God die Vader en onse Here Jesus Christus,

kjv_text: Who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us from this present evil world, according to the will of God and our Father:
bsb_text: who gave Himself for our sins to rescue us from the present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father,
aov_text: wat Homself gegee het vir ons sondes, sodat Hy ons kan uitred uit die teenwoordige bose wêreld, volgens die wil van onse God en Vader,

kjv_text: To whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
bsb_text: to whom be glory forever and ever. Amen.
aov_text: aan wie die heerlikheid toekom in alle ewigheid! Amen.

kjv_text: I marvel that ye are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel:
bsb_text: I am amazed how quickly you are deserting the One who called you by the grace of Christ and are turning to a different gospel—
aov_text: EK verwonder my dat julle so gou afvallig word van hom wat julle deur die genade van Christus geroep het, na ’n ander evangelie toe,

kjv_text: Which is not another; but there be some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ.
bsb_text: which is not even a gospel. Evidently some people are troubling you and trying to distort the gospel of Christ.
aov_text: terwyl daar geen ander is nie; behalwe dat daar sommige mense is wat julle in die war bring en die evangelie van Christus wil verdraai.

kjv_text: But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed.
bsb_text: But even if we or an angel from heaven should preach a gospel contrary to the one we preached to you, let him be under a curse!
aov_text: Maar al sou ons of ’n engel uit die hemel julle ’n evangelie verkondig in stryd met die wat ons julle verkondig het, laat hom ’n vervloeking wees!

kjv_text: As we said before, so say I now again, If any man preach any other gospel unto you than that ye have received, let him be accursed.
bsb_text: As we have said before, so now I say again: If anyone is preaching to you a gospel contrary to the one you received, let him be under a curse!
aov_text: Soos ons vantevore gesê het, sê ek nou ook weer: As iemand julle ’n evangelie verkondig in stryd met die wat julle ontvang het, laat hom ’n vervloeking wees!

kjv_text: For do I now persuade men, or God? or do I seek to please men? for if I yet pleased men, I should not be the servant of Christ.
bsb_text: Am I now seeking the approval of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? If I were still trying to please men, I would not be a servant of Christ.
aov_text: Soek ek dan nou die guns van mense, of van God? Of probeer ek om mense te behaag? As ek nog mense behaag, dan sou ek nie ’n dienskneg van Christus wees nie.

kjv_text: But I certify you, brethren, that the gospel which was preached of me is not after man.
bsb_text: For I certify to you, brothers, that the gospel I preached was not devised by man.
aov_text: Maar ek maak julle bekend, broeders, dat die evangelie wat deur my verkondig is, nie na die mens is nie.

kjv_text: For I neither received it of man, neither was I taught it, but by the revelation of Jesus Christ.
bsb_text: I did not receive it from any man, nor was I taught it; rather, I received it by revelation from Jesus Christ.
aov_text: Want ek het dit ook nie van ’n mens ontvang of geleer nie, maar deur ’n openbaring van Jesus Christus.

kjv_text: For ye have heard of my conversation in time past in the Jews' religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the church of God, and wasted it:
bsb_text: For you have heard of my former way of life in Judaism, how severely I persecuted the church of God and tried to destroy it.
aov_text: Want julle het gehoor van my lewenswandel vroeër in die Jodedom, dat ek die gemeente van God uitermate vervolg en dit verwoes het;

kjv_text: And profited in the Jews' religion above many my equals in mine own nation, being more exceedingly zealous of the traditions of my fathers.
bsb_text: I was advancing in Judaism beyond many of my contemporaries and was extremely zealous for the traditions of my fathers.
aov_text: en dat ek in die Jodedom vooruitgegaan het bo baie van my leeftyd onder my stamgenote, terwyl ek veral ’n yweraar was vir die oorleweringe van my voorvaders.

kjv_text: But when it pleased God, who separated me from my mother's womb, and called me by his grace,
bsb_text: But when God, who set me apart from my mother’s womb and called me by His grace, was pleased
aov_text: Maar toe dit God behaag het, wat my afgesonder het van die skoot van my moeder af en deur sy genade geroep het,

kjv_text: To reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the heathen; immediately I conferred not with flesh and blood:
bsb_text: to reveal His Son in me so that I might preach Him among the Gentiles, I did not rush to consult with flesh and blood,
aov_text: om sy Seun in my te openbaar, sodat ek Hom onder die heidene sou verkondig, het ek dadelik nie vlees en bloed geraadpleeg nie,

kjv_text: Neither went I up to Jerusalem to them which were apostles before me; but I went into Arabia, and returned again unto Damascus.
bsb_text: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to the apostles who came before me, but I went into Arabia and later returned to Damascus.
aov_text: en ook nie na Jerusalem opgegaan na die wat voor my apostels was nie, maar na Arabië vertrek en weer teruggekom na Damaskus.

kjv_text: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to see Peter, and abode with him fifteen days.
bsb_text: Only after three years did I go up to Jerusalem to confer with Cephas, and I stayed with him fifteen days.
aov_text: Vervolgens, drie jaar daarna, het ek na Jerusalem opgegaan om met Petrus kennis te maak en vyftien dae by hom gebly;

kjv_text: But other of the apostles saw I none, save James the Lord's brother.
bsb_text: But I saw none of the other apostles except James, the Lord’s brother.
aov_text: en ek het niemand anders van die apostels gesien nie, behalwe Jakobus, die broer van die Here.

kjv_text: Now the things which I write unto you, behold, before God, I lie not.
bsb_text: I assure you before God that what I am writing to you is no lie.
aov_text: En wat ek julle skryf — voor die aangesig van God, ek lieg nie!

kjv_text: Afterwards I came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia;
bsb_text: Later I went to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
aov_text: Daarna het ek gekom in die streke van Sírië en Cilícië;

kjv_text: And was unknown by face unto the churches of Judaea which were in Christ:
bsb_text: I was personally unknown, however, to the churches of Judea that are in Christ.
aov_text: en ek was persoonlik onbekend by die Christelike gemeentes van Judéa;

kjv_text: But they had heard only, That he which persecuted us in times past now preacheth the faith which once he destroyed.
bsb_text: They only heard the account: “The man who formerly persecuted us is now preaching the faith he once tried to destroy.”
aov_text: hulle het net gehoor: hy wat ons vroeër vervolg het, verkondig nou die geloof wat hy vroeër besig was om uit te roei.

kjv_text: And they glorified God in me.
bsb_text: And they glorified God because of me.
aov_text: En hulle het God verheerlik in my.

kjv_text: Then fourteen years after I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, and took Titus with me also.
bsb_text: Fourteen years later I went up again to Jerusalem, accompanied by Barnabas. I took Titus along also.
aov_text: DAARNA, veertien jaar later, het ek weer na Jerusalem opgegaan met Bárnabas, en Titus ook saamgeneem.

kjv_text: And I went up by revelation, and communicated unto them that gospel which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately to them which were of reputation, lest by any means I should run, or had run, in vain.
bsb_text: I went in response to a revelation and set before them the gospel that I preach among the Gentiles. But I spoke privately to those recognized as leaders, for fear that I was running or had already run in vain.
aov_text: Maar ek het opgegaan op grond van ’n openbaring en hulle die evangelie voorgelê wat ek onder die heidene verkondig; en afsonderlik aan die wat in aansien was, dat ek nie miskien tevergeefs sou loop of geloop het nie.

kjv_text: But neither Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised:
bsb_text: Yet not even Titus, who was with me, was compelled to be circumcised, even though he was a Greek.
aov_text: Maar selfs is Titus, wat by my was, nie gedwing om besny te word nie, alhoewel hy ’n Griek is;

kjv_text: And that because of false brethren unawares brought in, who came in privily to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage:
bsb_text: This issue arose because some false brothers had come in under false pretenses to spy on our freedom in Christ Jesus, in order to enslave us.
aov_text: en dit vanweë die ingesmokkelde valse broeders wat ingesluip het om ons vryheid te bespied wat ons in Christus Jesus het, sodat hulle ons in diensbaarheid kon bring;

kjv_text: To whom we gave place by subjection, no, not for an hour; that the truth of the gospel might continue with you.
bsb_text: We did not give in to them for a moment, so that the truth of the gospel would remain with you.
aov_text: aan wie ons selfs nie ’n oomblik in onderworpenheid toegegee het nie, sodat die waarheid van die evangelie by julle bestendig sou bly.

kjv_text: But of these who seemed to be somewhat, (whatsoever they were, it maketh no matter to me: God accepteth no man's person:) for they who seemed to be somewhat in conference added nothing to me:
bsb_text: But as for the highly esteemed—whatever they were makes no difference to me; God does not show favoritism—those leaders added nothing to me.
aov_text: Maar van die wat in aansien was — wat hulle vroeër was, maak by my geen verskil nie; God neem die persoon van die mens nie aan nie — hulle dan wat in aansien was, het my niks meer opgelê nie.

kjv_text: But contrariwise, when they saw that the gospel of the uncircumcision was committed unto me, as the gospel of the circumcision was unto Peter;
bsb_text: On the contrary, they saw that I had been entrusted to preach the gospel to the uncircumcised, just as Peter had been to the circumcised.
aov_text: Maar, inteendeel, toe hulle sien dat aan my die evangelie vir die onbesnedenes toevertrou is, net soos aan Petrus dié vir die besnedenes

kjv_text: (For he that wrought effectually in Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision, the same was mighty in me toward the Gentiles:)
bsb_text: For the One who was at work in Peter’s apostleship to the circumcised was also at work in my apostleship to the Gentiles.
aov_text: — want Hy wat Petrus bekragtig het met die oog op die apostelskap vir die besnedenes, het my ook bekragtig met die oog op die heidene  —

kjv_text: And when James, Cephas, and John, who seemed to be pillars, perceived the grace that was given unto me, they gave to me and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship; that we should go unto the heathen, and they unto the circumcision.
bsb_text: And recognizing the grace that I had been given, James, Cephas, and John—those reputed to be pillars—gave me and Barnabas the right hand of fellowship, so that we should go to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcised.
aov_text: en toe hulle merk die genade wat aan my gegee is, het Jakobus en Céfas en Johannes, wat as pilare geag is, aan my en Bárnabas die regterhand van gemeenskap gegee, sodat ons na die heidene en hulle na die besnedenes kon gaan;

kjv_text: Only they would that we should remember the poor; the same which I also was forward to do.
bsb_text: They only asked us to remember the poor, the very thing I was eager to do.
aov_text: alleen moes ons aan die armes dink, wat ek my juis ook beywer het om te doen.

kjv_text: But when Peter was come to Antioch, I withstood him to the face, because he was to be blamed.
bsb_text: When Cephas came to Antioch, however, I opposed him to his face, because he stood to be condemned.
aov_text: Maar toe Petrus in Antiochíë gekom het, het ek hom openlik teëgestaan, omdat hy veroordeeld gestaan het.

kjv_text: For before that certain came from James, he did eat with the Gentiles: but when they were come, he withdrew and separated himself, fearing them which were of the circumcision.
bsb_text: For before certain men came from James, he used to eat with the Gentiles. But when they arrived, he began to draw back and separate himself, for fear of those in the circumcision group.
aov_text: Want voordat sommige van Jakobus af gekom het, was hy gewoond om saam met die heidene te eet; maar ná hulle koms het hy hom teruggetrek en hom eenkant gehou uit vrees vir die wat uit die besnydenis is.

kjv_text: And the other Jews dissembled likewise with him; insomuch that Barnabas also was carried away with their dissimulation.
bsb_text: The other Jews joined him in his hypocrisy, so that by their hypocrisy even Barnabas was led astray.
aov_text: En saam met hom het ook die ander Jode geveins, sodat selfs Bárnabas hom laat meevoer het deur hulle geveins.

kjv_text: But when I saw that they walked not uprightly according to the truth of the gospel, I said unto Peter before them all, If thou, being a Jew, livest after the manner of Gentiles, and not as do the Jews, why compellest thou the Gentiles to live as do the Jews?
bsb_text: When I saw that they were not walking in line with the truth of the gospel, I said to Cephas in front of them all, “If you, who are a Jew, live like a Gentile and not like a Jew, how can you compel the Gentiles to live like Jews?”
aov_text: Maar toe ek sien dat hulle nie reguit loop volgens die waarheid van die evangelie nie, het ek vir Petrus in teenwoordigheid van almal gesê: As jy wat ’n Jood is, soos ’n heiden lewe en nie soos ’n Jood nie, waarom dwing jy die heidene om soos Jode te lewe?

kjv_text: We who are Jews by nature, and not sinners of the Gentiles,
bsb_text: We who are Jews by birth and not Gentile “sinners”
aov_text: Ons wat van nature Jode en nie sondaars uit die heidene is nie,

kjv_text: Knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law, but by the faith of Jesus Christ, even we have believed in Jesus Christ, that we might be justified by the faith of Christ, and not by the works of the law: for by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified.
bsb_text: know that a man is not justified by works of the law, but by faith in Jesus Christ. So we, too, have believed in Christ Jesus, that we may be justified by faith in Christ and not by works of the law, because by works of the law no one will be justified.
aov_text: terwyl ons weet dat die mens nie geregverdig word uit die werke van die wet nie, maar alleen deur die geloof in Jesus Christus, selfs ons het in Christus Jesus geglo, sodat ons geregverdig kan word uit die geloof in Christus en nie uit die werke van die wet nie; omdat uit die werke van die wet geen vlees geregverdig sal word nie.

kjv_text: But if, while we seek to be justified by Christ, we ourselves also are found sinners, is therefore Christ the minister of sin? God forbid.
bsb_text: But if, while we seek to be justified in Christ, we ourselves are found to be sinners, does that make Christ a minister of sin? Certainly not!
aov_text: Maar as ons wat streef om in Christus geregverdig te word, self ook sondaars bevind is, is Christus dan ’n dienaar van die sonde? Nee, stellig nie!

kjv_text: For if I build again the things which I destroyed, I make myself a transgressor.
bsb_text: If I rebuild what I have already torn down, I prove myself to be a lawbreaker.
aov_text: Want as ek weer opbou wat ek afgebreek het, dan betoon ek myself ’n oortreder;

kjv_text: For I through the law am dead to the law, that I might live unto God.
bsb_text: For through the law I died to the law so that I might live to God.
aov_text: want deur die wet is ek vir die wet dood om vir God te lewe.

kjv_text: I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.
bsb_text: I have been crucified with Christ, and I no longer live, but Christ lives in me. The life I live in the body, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave Himself up for me.
aov_text: Ek is met Christus gekruisig, en ék leef nie meer nie, maar Christus leef in my. En wat ek nou in die vlees lewe, leef ek deur die geloof in die Seun van God wat my liefgehad het en Homself vir my oorgegee het.

kjv_text: I do not frustrate the grace of God: for if righteousness come by the law, then Christ is dead in vain.
bsb_text: I do not set aside the grace of God. For if righteousness comes through the law, Christ died for nothing.
aov_text: Ek verwerp nie die genade van God nie; want as daar geregtigheid deur die wet is, dan het Christus tevergeefs gesterwe.

kjv_text: O foolish Galatians, who hath bewitched you, that ye should not obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ hath been evidently set forth, crucified among you?
bsb_text: O foolish Galatians! Who has bewitched you? Before your very eyes Jesus Christ was clearly portrayed as crucified.
aov_text: O, ONVERSTANDIGE Galásiërs, wie het julle betower om die waarheid nie gehoorsaam te wees nie, julle voor wie se oë Jesus Christus afgeskilder is as onder julle gekruisig?

kjv_text: This only would I learn of you, Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
bsb_text: I would like to learn just one thing from you: Did you receive the Spirit by works of the law, or by hearing with faith?
aov_text: Dit alleen wil ek van julle weet: het julle die Gees ontvang uit die werke van die wet of uit die prediking van die geloof?

kjv_text: Are ye so foolish? having begun in the Spirit, are ye now made perfect by the flesh?
bsb_text: Are you so foolish? After starting in the Spirit, are you now finishing in the flesh?
aov_text: Is julle so onverstandig? Nadat julle met die Gees begin het, eindig julle nou met die vlees?

kjv_text: Have ye suffered so many things in vain? if it be yet in vain.
bsb_text: Have you suffered so much for nothing, if it really was for nothing?
aov_text: Het julle verniet so baie gely? As dit maar verniet was!

kjv_text: He therefore that ministereth to you the Spirit, and worketh miracles among you, doeth he it by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
bsb_text: Does God lavish His Spirit on you and work miracles among you because you practice the law, or because you hear and believe?
aov_text: Hy wat julle dan die Gees verleen en kragte onder julle werk, doen Hy dit uit die werke van die wet of uit die prediking van die geloof?

kjv_text: Even as Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.
bsb_text: So also, “Abraham believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness.”
aov_text: Net soos Abraham in God geglo het, en dit is hom tot geregtigheid gereken.

kjv_text: Know ye therefore that they which are of faith, the same are the children of Abraham.
bsb_text: Understand, then, that those who have faith are sons of Abraham.
aov_text: Julle verstaan dan dat die wat uit die geloof is, hulle is kinders van Abraham.

kjv_text: And the scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the heathen through faith, preached before the gospel unto Abraham, saying, In thee shall all nations be blessed.
bsb_text: The Scripture foresaw that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, and foretold the gospel to Abraham: “All nations will be blessed through you.”
aov_text: En die Skrif wat vooruit gesien het dat God die heidene uit die geloof sou regverdig, het vooraf aan Abraham die evangelie verkondig met die woorde: In jou sal al die volke geseën word.

kjv_text: So then they which be of faith are blessed with faithful Abraham.
bsb_text: So those who have faith are blessed along with Abraham, the man of faith.
aov_text: Sodat die wat uit die geloof is, geseën word saam met die gelowige Abraham.

kjv_text: For as many as are of the works of the law are under the curse: for it is written, Cursed is every one that continueth not in all things which are written in the book of the law to do them.
bsb_text: All who rely on works of the law are under a curse. For it is written: “Cursed is everyone who does not continue to do everything written in the Book of the Law.”
aov_text: Want almal wat uit die werke van die wet is, is onder die vloek; want daar is geskrywe: Vervloek is elkeen wat nie bly in alles wat geskryf is in die boek van die wet om dit te doen nie.

kjv_text: But that no man is justified by the law in the sight of God, it is evident: for, The just shall live by faith.
bsb_text: Now it is clear that no one is justified before God by the law, because, “The righteous will live by faith.”
aov_text: En dat niemand deur die wet by God geregverdig word nie, is duidelik; want die regverdige sal uit die geloof lewe.

kjv_text: And the law is not of faith: but, The man that doeth them shall live in them.
bsb_text: The law, however, is not based on faith; on the contrary, “The man who does these things will live by them.”
aov_text: Maar die wet is nie uit die geloof nie, maar die mens wat hierdie dinge doen, sal daardeur lewe.

kjv_text: Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us: for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree:
bsb_text: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law by becoming a curse for us. For it is written: “Cursed is everyone who is hung on a tree.”
aov_text: Christus het ons losgekoop van die vloek van die wet deur vir ons ’n vloek te word — want daar is geskrywe: Vervloek is elkeen wat aan ’n hout hang  —

kjv_text: That the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Jesus Christ; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.
bsb_text: He redeemed us in order that the blessing promised to Abraham would come to the Gentiles in Christ Jesus, so that by faith we might receive the promise of the Spirit.
aov_text: sodat die seën van Abraham na die heidene kan kom in Christus Jesus, en dat ons die belofte van die Gees deur die geloof kan ontvang.

kjv_text: Brethren, I speak after the manner of men; Though it be but a man's covenant, yet if it be confirmed, no man disannulleth, or addeth thereto.
bsb_text: Brothers, let me put this in human terms. Even a human covenant, once it is ratified, cannot be canceled or amended.
aov_text: Broeders, ek spreek menslikerwys: selfs ’n mens se testament wat bekragtig is, maak niemand tot niet of voeg daaraan toe nie.

kjv_text: Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made. He saith not, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to thy seed, which is Christ.
bsb_text: The promises were spoken to Abraham and to his seed. The Scripture does not say, “and to seeds,” meaning many, but “and to your seed,” meaning One, who is Christ.
aov_text: Nou is aan Abraham die beloftes toegesê en aan sy saad. Hy sê nie: En aan die sade, asof dit op baie sien nie, maar op een: En aan jou saad, dit is Christus.

kjv_text: And this I say, that the covenant, that was confirmed before of God in Christ, the law, which was four hundred and thirty years after, cannot disannul, that it should make the promise of none effect.
bsb_text: What I mean is this: The law that came 430 years later does not revoke the covenant previously established by God, so as to nullify the promise.
aov_text: Maar ek sê dít: die wet wat vierhonderd-en-dertig jaar later gekom het, maak die verbond wat deur God in Christus vantevore bekragtig is, nie kragteloos om die belofte tot niet te maak nie.

kjv_text: For if the inheritance be of the law, it is no more of promise: but God gave it to Abraham by promise.
bsb_text: For if the inheritance depends on the law, then it no longer depends on a promise; but God freely granted it to Abraham through a promise.
aov_text: Want as die erfenis uit die wet is, dan is dit nie meer uit die belofte nie. Maar God het dit aan Abraham deur ’n belofte genadiglik geskenk.

kjv_text: Wherefore then serveth the law? It was added because of transgressions, till the seed should come to whom the promise was made; and it was ordained by angels in the hand of a mediator.
bsb_text: Why then was the law given? It was added because of transgressions, until the arrival of the seed to whom the promise referred. It was administered through angels by a mediator.
aov_text: Wat beteken die wet dan? Dit is bygevoeg weens die oortredinge, totdat die saad aan wie die belofte gedoen is, sou kom; en dit is deur engele beskik deur tussenkoms van ’n middelaar.

kjv_text: Now a mediator is not a mediator of one, but God is one.
bsb_text: A mediator is unnecessary, however, for only one party; but God is one.
aov_text: En die middelaar is nie net vir een nie; maar God is een.

kjv_text: Is the law then against the promises of God? God forbid: for if there had been a law given which could have given life, verily righteousness should have been by the law.
bsb_text: Is the law, then, opposed to the promises of God? Certainly not! For if a law had been given that could impart life, then righteousness would certainly have come from the law.
aov_text: Is die wet dan teen die beloftes van God? Nee, stellig nie! Want as daar ’n wet gegee was wat krag het om lewend te maak, dan sou die geregtigheid werklik uit die wet wees.

kjv_text: But the scripture hath concluded all under sin, that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe.
bsb_text: But the Scripture pronounces all things confined by sin, so that by faith in Jesus Christ the promise might be given to those who believe.
aov_text: Maar die Skrif het alles ingesluit onder die sonde, sodat die belofte uit die geloof in Jesus Christus aan die gelowiges gegee kon word.

kjv_text: But before faith came, we were kept under the law, shut up unto the faith which should afterwards be revealed.
bsb_text: Before this faith came, we were held in custody under the law, locked up until faith should be revealed.
aov_text: Maar voordat die geloof gekom het, is ons onder die wet in bewaring gehou, ingesluit met die oog op die geloof wat geopenbaar sou word.

kjv_text: Wherefore the law was our schoolmaster to bring us unto Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
bsb_text: So the law became our guardian to lead us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
aov_text: Die wet was dus ons tugmeester na Christus toe, sodat ons geregverdig kan word uit die geloof.

kjv_text: But after that faith is come, we are no longer under a schoolmaster.
bsb_text: Now that faith has come, we are no longer under a guardian.
aov_text: Maar nou dat die geloof gekom het, is ons nie meer onder ’n tugmeester nie.

kjv_text: For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus.
bsb_text: You are all sons of God through faith in Christ Jesus.
aov_text: Want julle is almal kinders van God deur die geloof in Christus Jesus;

kjv_text: For as many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ.
bsb_text: For all of you who were baptized into Christ have clothed yourselves with Christ.
aov_text: want julle almal wat in Christus gedoop is, het julle met Christus beklee.

kjv_text: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.
bsb_text: There is neither Jew nor Greek, slave nor free, male nor female, for you are all one in Christ Jesus.
aov_text: Daar is nie meer Jood of Griek nie, daar is nie meer slaaf of vryman nie, daar is nie meer man en vrou nie; want julle is almal een in Christus Jesus.

kjv_text: And if ye be Christ's, then are ye Abraham's seed, and heirs according to the promise.
bsb_text: And if you belong to Christ, then you are Abraham’s seed and heirs according to the promise.
aov_text: En as julle aan Christus behoort, dan is julle die nageslag van Abraham en volgens die belofte erfgename.

kjv_text: Now I say, That the heir, as long as he is a child, differeth nothing from a servant, though he be lord of all;
bsb_text: What I am saying is that as long as the heir is a child, he is no different from a slave, although he is the owner of everything.
aov_text: MAAR ek sê: So lank as die erfgenaam ’n kind is, verskil hy niks van ’n dienskneg nie, al is hy heer van alles;

kjv_text: But is under tutors and governors until the time appointed of the father.
bsb_text: He is subject to guardians and trustees until the date set by his father.
aov_text: maar hy staan onder voogde en bestuurders tot op die tyd tevore deur die vader bepaal.

kjv_text: Even so we, when we were children, were in bondage under the elements of the world:
bsb_text: So also, when we were children, we were enslaved under the basic principles of the world.
aov_text: So was ons ook, toe ons kinders was, in diensbaarheid onder die eerste beginsels van die wêreld.

kjv_text: But when the fulness of the time was come, God sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,
bsb_text: But when the time had fully come, God sent His Son, born of a woman, born under the law,
aov_text: Maar toe die volheid van die tyd gekom het, het God sy Seun uitgestuur, gebore uit ’n vrou, gebore onder die wet,

kjv_text: To redeem them that were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of sons.
bsb_text: to redeem those under the law, that we might receive our adoption as sons.
aov_text: om die wat onder die wet was, los te koop, sodat ons die aanneming tot kinders kan ontvang.

kjv_text: And because ye are sons, God hath sent forth the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father.
bsb_text: And because you are sons, God sent the Spirit of His Son into our hearts, crying out, “Abba, Father!”
aov_text: En omdat julle kinders is, het God die Gees van sy Seun in julle harte uitgestuur, en Hy roep: Abba, Vader!

kjv_text: Wherefore thou art no more a servant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.
bsb_text: So you are no longer a slave, but a son; and since you are a son, you are also an heir through God.
aov_text: Daarom is jy nie meer dienskneg nie, maar kind; en as jy kind is, dan ook erfgenaam van God deur Christus.

kjv_text: Howbeit then, when ye knew not God, ye did service unto them which by nature are no gods.
bsb_text: Formerly, when you did not know God, you were slaves to those who by nature are not gods.
aov_text: Maar destyds, toe julle God nie geken het nie, het julle dié gedien wat van nature geen gode is nie;

kjv_text: But now, after that ye have known God, or rather are known of God, how turn ye again to the weak and beggarly elements, whereunto ye desire again to be in bondage?
bsb_text: But now that you know God, or rather are known by God, how is it that you are turning back to those weak and worthless principles? Do you wish to be enslaved by them all over again?
aov_text: maar nou dat julle God ken, of liewer deur God geken is, hoe keer julle weer terug tot die swakke en armoedige eerste beginsels wat julle weer van voor af aan wil dien?

kjv_text: Ye observe days, and months, and times, and years.
bsb_text: You are observing special days and months and seasons and years!
aov_text: Julle neem dae en maande en tye en jare waar.

kjv_text: I am afraid of you, lest I have bestowed upon you labour in vain.
bsb_text: I fear for you, that my efforts for you may have been in vain.
aov_text: Ek vrees vir julle dat ek miskien tevergeefs aan julle gearbei het.

kjv_text: Brethren, I beseech you, be as I am; for I am as ye are: ye have not injured me at all.
bsb_text: I beg you, brothers, become like me, for I became like you. You have done me no wrong.
aov_text: Broeders, ek bid julle, word soos ek, want ek is ook soos julle. Julle het my geen onreg aangedoen nie;

kjv_text: Ye know how through infirmity of the flesh I preached the gospel unto you at the first.
bsb_text: You know that it was because of an illness that I first preached the gospel to you.
aov_text: maar julle weet dat ek ten gevolge van krankheid van die vlees die eerste keer die evangelie aan julle verkondig het;

kjv_text: And my temptation which was in my flesh ye despised not, nor rejected; but received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.
bsb_text: And although my illness was a trial to you, you did not despise or reject me. Instead, you welcomed me as if I were an angel of God, as if I were Christ Jesus Himself.
aov_text: en julle het my beproewing in my vlees nie verag of verfoei nie, maar julle het my ontvang as ’n engel van God, ja, as Christus Jesus.

kjv_text: Where is then the blessedness ye spake of? for I bear you record, that, if it had been possible, ye would have plucked out your own eyes, and have given them to me.
bsb_text: What then has become of your blessing? For I can testify that, if it were possible, you would have torn out your eyes and given them to me.
aov_text: Wat was dan julle saligprysing? Want ek getuig van julle dat julle, as dit moontlik was, jul oë uitgegrawe en vir my sou gegee het.

kjv_text: Am I therefore become your enemy, because I tell you the truth?
bsb_text: Have I now become your enemy by telling you the truth?
aov_text: Het ek dan julle vyand geword deur julle die waarheid te vertel?

kjv_text: They zealously affect you, but not well; yea, they would exclude you, that ye might affect them.
bsb_text: Those people are zealous for you, but not in a good way. Instead, they want to isolate you from us, so that you may be zealous for them.
aov_text: Hulle ywer vir julle is nie goed nie, maar hulle wil ons buitesluit, sodat julle vir hulle kan ywer.

kjv_text: But it is good to be zealously affected always in a good thing, and not only when I am present with you.
bsb_text: Nevertheless, it is good to be zealous if it serves a noble purpose—at any time, and not only when I am with you.
aov_text: Dit is goed as daar altyd geywer word in ’n goeie saak en nie alleen wanneer ek by julle teenwoordig is nie,

kjv_text: My little children, of whom I travail in birth again until Christ be formed in you,
bsb_text: My children, for whom I am again in the pains of childbirth until Christ is formed in you,
aov_text: my kinders, vir wie ek weer in barensnood is totdat Christus in julle ’n gestalte verkry.

kjv_text: I desire to be present with you now, and to change my voice; for I stand in doubt of you.
bsb_text: how I wish I could be with you now and change my tone, because I am perplexed about you.
aov_text: EN ek sou wens om nou by julle teenwoordig te wees en my stem te verander, want ek is buite raad met julle.

kjv_text: Tell me, ye that desire to be under the law, do ye not hear the law?
bsb_text: Tell me, you who want to be under the law, do you not understand what the law says?
aov_text: Julle wat onder die wet wil wees, sê vir my, luister julle nie na die wet nie?

kjv_text: For it is written, that Abraham had two sons, the one by a bondmaid, the other by a freewoman.
bsb_text: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the slave woman and the other by the free woman.
aov_text: Want daar is geskrywe dat Abraham twee seuns gehad het, een uit die slavin en een uit die vrye.

kjv_text: But he who was of the bondwoman was born after the flesh; but he of the freewoman was by promise.
bsb_text: His son by the slave woman was born according to the flesh, but his son by the free woman was born through the promise.
aov_text: Maar die een uit die slavin is gebore na die vlees, en die ander een uit die vrye deur die belofte.

kjv_text: Which things are an allegory: for these are the two covenants; the one from the mount Sinai, which gendereth to bondage, which is Agar.
bsb_text: These things serve as illustrations, for the women represent two covenants. One covenant is from Mount Sinai and bears children into slavery: This is Hagar.
aov_text: Dit is sinnebeelde, want dié vroue staan vir twee verbonde: een, van die berg Sinai afkomstig, wat vir die slawerny kinders baar — dit is Hagar;

kjv_text: For this Agar is mount Sinai in Arabia, and answereth to Jerusalem which now is, and is in bondage with her children.
bsb_text: Now Hagar stands for Mount Sinai in Arabia and corresponds to the present-day Jerusalem, because she is in slavery with her children.
aov_text: want Hagar staan vir die berg Sinai in Arabië en kom ooreen met die teenswoordige Jerusalem en is met haar kinders saam in slawerny.

kjv_text: But Jerusalem which is above is free, which is the mother of us all.
bsb_text: But the Jerusalem above is free, and she is our mother.
aov_text: Maar Jerusalem daarbo is vry; en dit is die moeder van ons almal.

kjv_text: For it is written, Rejoice, thou barren that bearest not; break forth and cry, thou that travailest not: for the desolate hath many more children than she which hath an husband.
bsb_text: For it is written: “Rejoice, O barren woman, who bears no children; break forth and cry aloud, you who have never travailed; because more are the children of the desolate woman than of her who has a husband.”
aov_text: Want daar is geskrywe: Verbly jou, onvrugbare wat nie baar nie; breek uit en roep, jy wat geen barensnood het nie, want die kinders van die eensame is meer as van haar wat ’n man het.

kjv_text: Now we, brethren, as Isaac was, are the children of promise.
bsb_text: Now you, brothers, like Isaac, are children of promise.
aov_text: Maar ons, broeders, is soos Isak, kinders van die belofte;

kjv_text: But as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him that was born after the Spirit, even so it is now.
bsb_text: At that time, however, the son born by the flesh persecuted the son born by the Spirit. It is the same now.
aov_text: maar soos destyds hy wat na die vlees gebore is, hom wat na die Gees was, vervolg het, so is dit nou ook.

kjv_text: Nevertheless what saith the scripture? Cast out the bondwoman and her son: for the son of the bondwoman shall not be heir with the son of the freewoman.
bsb_text: But what does the Scripture say? “Expel the slave woman and her son, for the slave woman’s son will never share in the inheritance with the free woman’s son.”
aov_text: Maar wat sê die Skrif? Werp die slavin en haar seun uit, want nooit mag die seun van die slavin saam met die seun van die vrye erwe nie.

kjv_text: So then, brethren, we are not children of the bondwoman, but of the free.
bsb_text: Therefore, brothers, we are not children of the slave woman, but of the free woman.
aov_text: Daarom, broeders, ons is nie kinders van die slavin nie, maar van die vrye.

kjv_text: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.
bsb_text: It is for freedom that Christ has set us free. Stand firm, then, and do not be encumbered once more by a yoke of slavery.
aov_text: STAAN dan vas in die vryheid waarmee Christus ons vrygemaak het, en laat julle nie weer onder die juk van diensbaarheid bring nie.

kjv_text: Behold, I Paul say unto you, that if ye be circumcised, Christ shall profit you nothing.
bsb_text: Take notice: I, Paul, tell you that if you let yourselves be circumcised, Christ will be of no value to you at all.
aov_text: Kyk, ek, Paulus, sê vir julle dat as julle jul laat besny, Christus vir julle tot geen nut sal wees nie.

kjv_text: For I testify again to every man that is circumcised, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.
bsb_text: Again I testify to every man who gets himself circumcised that he is obligated to obey the whole law.
aov_text: En ek betuig dit weer aan elke mens wat hom laat besny, dat hy onder verpligting is om die hele wet te onderhou.

kjv_text: Christ is become of no effect unto you, whosoever of you are justified by the law; ye are fallen from grace.
bsb_text: You who are trying to be justified by the law have been severed from Christ; you have fallen away from grace.
aov_text: Julle wat geregverdig wil wees deur die wet, is losgemaak van Christus; julle het van die genade verval.

kjv_text: For we through the Spirit wait for the hope of righteousness by faith.
bsb_text: But by faith we eagerly await through the Spirit the hope of righteousness.
aov_text: Want óns verwag deur die Gees uit die geloof die geregtigheid waarop ons hoop.

kjv_text: For in Jesus Christ neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision; but faith which worketh by love.
bsb_text: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision has any value. All that matters is faith, expressed through love.
aov_text: Want in Christus Jesus het nòg die besnydenis nòg die onbesnedenheid enige krag, maar die geloof wat deur die liefde werk.
