kjv_text: Ye did run well; who did hinder you that ye should not obey the truth?
bsb_text: You were running so well. Who has obstructed you from obeying the truth?
aov_text: Julle het goed geloop: wie het julle verhinder om die waarheid gehoorsaam te wees?

kjv_text: This persuasion cometh not of him that calleth you.
bsb_text: Such persuasion does not come from the One who calls you.
aov_text: Hierdie oortuiging kom nie van Hom wat julle roep nie.

kjv_text: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.
bsb_text: A little leaven works through the whole batch of dough.
aov_text: ’n Bietjie suurdeeg maak die hele deeg suur.

kjv_text: I have confidence in you through the Lord, that ye will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.
bsb_text: I am confident in the Lord that you will take no other view. The one who is troubling you will bear the judgment, whoever he may be.
aov_text: Ek vertrou van julle in die Here dat julle nie anders sal dink nie; maar die een wat julle in die war bring, sal die oordeel dra, wie dit ook mag wees.

kjv_text: And I, brethren, if I yet preach circumcision, why do I yet suffer persecution? then is the offence of the cross ceased.
bsb_text: Now, brothers, if I am still preaching circumcision, why am I still being persecuted? In that case the offense of the cross has been abolished.
aov_text: Maar ek, broeders, as ek nog die besnydenis verkondig, waarom word ek nog vervolg? Dan is die struikelblok van die kruis vernietig!

kjv_text: I would they were even cut off which trouble you.
bsb_text: As for those who are agitating you, I wish they would proceed to emasculate themselves!
aov_text: Ag, as die wat julle opstandig maak, hulleself tog maar ook wou vermink!

kjv_text: For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.
bsb_text: For you, brothers, were called to freedom; but do not use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh. Rather, serve one another in love.
aov_text: Want julle is tot vryheid geroep, broeders; gebruik net nie julle vryheid as ’n aanleiding vir die vlees nie, maar dien mekaar deur die liefde.

kjv_text: For all the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
bsb_text: The entire law is fulfilled in a single decree: “Love your neighbor as yourself.”
aov_text: Want die hele wet word vervul in een woord, naamlik: Jy moet jou naaste liefhê soos jouself.

kjv_text: But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another.
bsb_text: But if you keep on biting and devouring one another, watch out, or you will be consumed by one another.
aov_text: Maar as julle mekaar byt en opeet, pas op dat julle nie die een deur die ander verteer word nie.

kjv_text: This I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.
bsb_text: So I say, walk by the Spirit, and you will not gratify the desires of the flesh.
aov_text: MAAR ek sê: Wandel deur die Gees, dan sal julle nooit die begeerlikheid van die vlees volbring nie;

kjv_text: For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh: and these are contrary the one to the other: so that ye cannot do the things that ye would.
bsb_text: For the flesh craves what is contrary to the Spirit, and the Spirit what is contrary to the flesh. They are opposed to each other, so that you do not do what you want.
aov_text: want die vlees begeer teen die Gees, en die Gees teen die vlees; en hulle staan teenoor mekaar, sodat julle nie kan doen wat julle wil nie.

kjv_text: But if ye be led of the Spirit, ye are not under the law.
bsb_text: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.
aov_text: Maar as julle deur die Gees gelei word, dan is julle nie onder die wet nie.

kjv_text: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,
bsb_text: The acts of the flesh are obvious: sexual immorality, impurity, and debauchery;
aov_text: En die werke van die vlees is openbaar, naamlik owerspel, hoerery, onreinheid, ongebondenheid;

kjv_text: Idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies,
bsb_text: idolatry and sorcery; hatred, discord, jealousy, and rage; rivalries, divisions, factions,
aov_text: afgodery, towery, vyandskap, twis, jaloersheid, toornigheid, naywer, tweedrag, partyskap;

kjv_text: Envyings, murders, drunkenness, revellings, and such like: of the which I tell you before, as I have also told you in time past, that they which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.
bsb_text: and envy; drunkenness, orgies, and the like. I warn you, as I did before, that those who practice such things will not inherit the kingdom of God.
aov_text: afguns, moord, dronkenskap, brassery en dergelike dinge, waarvan ek julle vooraf sê, soos ek al vroeër gesê het, dat die wat sulke dinge doen, die koninkryk van God nie sal beërwe nie.

kjv_text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,
bsb_text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,
aov_text: Maar die vrug van die Gees is liefde, blydskap, vrede, lankmoedigheid, vriendelikheid, goedheid, getrouheid,

kjv_text: meekness, temperance:
bsb_text: gentleness, and self-control.
aov_text: sagmoedigheid, selfbeheersing.

kjv_text: against such there is no law.
bsb_text: Against such things there is no law.
aov_text: Teen sulke dinge is die wet nie.

kjv_text: And they that are Christ's have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts.
bsb_text: Those who belong to Christ Jesus have crucified the flesh with its passions and desires.
aov_text: Maar die wat aan Christus behoort, het die vlees met sy hartstogte en begeerlikhede gekruisig.

kjv_text: If we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit.
bsb_text: Since we live by the Spirit, let us walk in step with the Spirit.
aov_text: As ons deur die Gees lewe, laat ons ook deur die Gees wandel.

kjv_text: Let us not be desirous of vain glory, provoking one another, envying one another.
bsb_text: Let us not become conceited, provoking and envying one another.
aov_text: Laat ons nie word soekers van ydele eer wat mekaar uittart en mekaar beny nie.

kjv_text: Brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, ye which are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit of meekness; considering thyself, lest thou also be tempted.
bsb_text: Brothers, if someone is caught in a trespass, you who are spiritual should restore him with a spirit of gentleness. But watch yourself, or you also may be tempted.
aov_text: BROEDERS, as iemand ewenwel deur een of ander misdaad oorval word, moet julle wat geestelik is, so een reghelp met die gees van sagmoedigheid, terwyl jy op jouself let, dat jy ook nie versoek word nie.

kjv_text: Bear ye one another's burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.
bsb_text: Carry one another’s burdens, and in this way you will fulfill the law of Christ.
aov_text: Dra mekaar se laste en vervul so die wet van Christus.

kjv_text: For if a man think himself to be something, when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.
bsb_text: If anyone thinks he is something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.
aov_text: Want as iemand meen dat hy iets is, terwyl hy niks is nie, mislei hy homself.

kjv_text: But let every man prove his own work, and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another.
bsb_text: Each one should test his own work. Then he will have reason to boast in himself alone, and not in someone else.
aov_text: Maar laat elkeen sy eie werk op die proef stel; en dan sal hy grond vir roem hê alleen wat homself betref en nie wat die ander betref nie.

kjv_text: For every man shall bear his own burden.
bsb_text: For each one should carry his own load.
aov_text: Want elkeen sal sy eie pak dra.

kjv_text: Let him that is taught in the word communicate unto him that teacheth in all good things.
bsb_text: Nevertheless, the one who receives instruction in the word must share in all good things with his instructor.
aov_text: Maar laat hom wat in die Woord onderwys ontvang, meedeel van alle goeie dinge aan hom wat onderwys gee.

kjv_text: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.
bsb_text: Do not be deceived: God is not to be mocked. Whatever a man sows, he will reap in return.
aov_text: Moenie dwaal nie; God laat Hom nie bespot nie; want net wat die mens saai, dit sal hy ook maai.

kjv_text: For he that soweth to his flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption; but he that soweth to the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap life everlasting.
bsb_text: The one who sows to please his flesh, from the flesh will reap destruction; but the one who sows to please the Spirit, from the Spirit will reap eternal life.
aov_text: Hy wat in sy vlees saai, sal uit die vlees verderf maai; maar hy wat in die Gees saai, sal uit die Gees die ewige lewe maai.

kjv_text: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
bsb_text: Let us not grow weary in well-doing, for in due time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up.
aov_text: En laat ons nie moeg word om goed te doen nie, want op die regte tyd sal ons maai as ons nie verslap nie.

kjv_text: As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good unto all men, especially unto them who are of the household of faith.
bsb_text: Therefore, as we have opportunity, let us do good to everyone, and especially to the family of faith.
aov_text: Laat ons dan, terwyl ons geleentheid het, aan almal goed doen, maar die meeste aan die huisgenote van die geloof.

kjv_text: Ye see how large a letter I have written unto you with mine own hand.
bsb_text: See what large letters I am using to write to you with my own hand!
aov_text: Kyk met watter groot letters ek met my eie hand aan julle skrywe.

kjv_text: As many as desire to make a fair shew in the flesh, they constrain you to be circumcised; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Christ.
bsb_text: Those who want to make a good impression outwardly are trying to compel you to be circumcised. They only do this to avoid persecution for the cross of Christ.
aov_text: Almal wat ’n mooi vertoning in die vlees wil maak, dié dwing julle om julle te laat besny net om nie ter wille van die kruis van Christus vervolg te word nie.

kjv_text: For neither they themselves who are circumcised keep the law; but desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.
bsb_text: For the circumcised do not even keep the law themselves, yet they want you to be circumcised that they may boast in your flesh.
aov_text: Want ook hulle wat besny word, hou self nie die wet nie; maar hulle wil hê dat julle besny moet word, sodat hulle in julle vlees kan roem.

kjv_text: But God forbid that I should glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world.
bsb_text: But as for me, may I never boast, except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.
aov_text: Maar wat my betref, mag ek nooit roem nie, behalwe in die kruis van onse Here Jesus Christus, deur wie die wêreld vir my gekruisig is en ek vir die wêreld.

kjv_text: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.
bsb_text: For neither circumcision nor uncircumcision means anything. What counts is a new creation.
aov_text: Want in Christus Jesus het nòg die besnydenis nòg die onbesnedenheid enige krag, maar ’n nuwe skepsel.

kjv_text: And as many as walk according to this rule, peace be on them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.
bsb_text: Peace and mercy to all who walk by this rule, even to the Israel of God.
aov_text: En mag daar vrede en barmhartigheid wees oor almal wat sal wandel volgens hierdie reël, en oor die Israel van God!

kjv_text: From henceforth let no man trouble me: for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus.

aov_text: deurdat Hy aan ons die verborgenheid van sy wil bekend gemaak het na sy welbehae wat Hy in Homself voorgeneem het,

kjv_text: Which is the earnest of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession, unto the praise of his glory.

bsb_text: He who descended is the very One who ascended above all the heavens, in order to fill all things.
aov_text: Hy wat neergedaal het, is dieselfde as Hy wat opgevaar het bokant al die hemele, sodat Hy alles tot volheid kan bring.

kjv_text: And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers;
bsb_text: And it was He who gave some to be apostles, some to be prophets, some to be evangelists, and some to be pastors and teachers,
aov_text: En Hy het gegee sommige as apostels, ander as profete, ander as evangeliste, ander as herders en leraars,

kjv_text: For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ:
bsb_text: to equip the saints for works of ministry and to build up the body of Christ,
aov_text: om die heiliges toe te rus vir hulle dienswerk, tot opbouing van die liggaam van Christus,

kjv_text: Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a perfect man, unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ:
bsb_text: until we all reach unity in the faith and in the knowledge of the Son of God, as we mature to the full measure of the stature of Christ.
aov_text: totdat ons almal kom tot die eenheid van die geloof en van die kennis van die Seun van God, tot ’n volwasse man, tot die mate van die volle grootte van Christus;

kjv_text: That we henceforth be no more children, tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the sleight of men, and cunning craftiness, whereby they lie in wait to deceive;
bsb_text: Then we will no longer be infants, tossed about by the waves and carried around by every wind of teaching and by the clever cunning of men in their deceitful scheming.
aov_text: sodat ons nie meer kinders sou wees nie wat soos golwe geslinger en heen en weer gedryf word deur elke wind van lering, deur die bedrieëry van die mense, deur sluheid om listiglik tot dwaling te bring;

kjv_text: But speaking the truth in love, may grow up into him in all things, which is the head, even Christ:
bsb_text: Instead, speaking the truth in love, we will in all things grow up into Christ Himself, who is the head.
aov_text: maar, terwyl ons in liefde die waarheid betrag, in alles sou opgroei in Hom wat die Hoof is, naamlik Christus,

kjv_text: From whom the whole body fitly joined together and compacted by that which every joint supplieth, according to the effectual working in the measure of every part, maketh increase of the body unto the edifying of itself in love.
bsb_text: From Him the whole body, fitted and held together by every supporting ligament, grows and builds itself up in love through the work of each individual part.
aov_text: uit wie die hele liggaam — goed saamgevoeg en saamverbind deur die ondersteuning wat elke lid gee volgens die werking van elke afsonderlike deel in sy mate — die groei van die liggaam bevorder vir sy eie opbouing in liefde.

kjv_text: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that ye henceforth walk not as other Gentiles walk, in the vanity of their mind,
bsb_text: So I tell you this, and insist on it in the Lord, that you must no longer walk as the Gentiles do, in the futility of their thinking.
aov_text: DIT sê en betuig ek dan in die Here, dat julle nie meer moet wandel soos die ander heidene ook wandel in die verdwaasdheid van hulle gemoed nie  —

kjv_text: Having the understanding darkened, being alienated from the life of God through the ignorance that is in them, because of the blindness of their heart:
bsb_text: They are darkened in their understanding and alienated from the life of God because of the ignorance that is in them due to the hardness of their hearts.
aov_text: mense wat verduisterd is in die verstand en vervreemd van die lewe van God deur die onkunde wat in hulle is vanweë die verharding van hulle hart;

kjv_text: Who being past feeling have given themselves over unto lasciviousness, to work all uncleanness with greediness.
bsb_text: Having lost all sense of shame, they have given themselves over to sensuality for the practice of every kind of impurity, with a craving for more.
aov_text: wat ongevoelig geword het en hulle oorgegee het aan die ongebondenheid om in hebsug allerhande onreinheid te bedrywe.

kjv_text: But ye have not so learned Christ;
bsb_text: But this is not the way you came to know Christ.
aov_text: Maar julle het Christus nie so leer ken nie,

kjv_text: If so be that ye have heard him, and have been taught by him, as the truth is in Jesus:
bsb_text: Surely you heard of Him and were taught in Him—in keeping with the truth that is in Jesus—
aov_text: as julle ten minste van Hom gehoor het en in Hom onderrig is soos die waarheid is in Jesus:

kjv_text: That ye put off concerning the former conversation the old man, which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts;
bsb_text: to put off your former way of life, your old self, which is being corrupted by its deceitful desires;
aov_text: dat julle, wat die vorige lewenswandel betref, die oue mens moet aflê wat deur die begeerlikhede van die verleiding te gronde gaan,

kjv_text: And be renewed in the spirit of your mind;
bsb_text: to be renewed in the spirit of your minds;
aov_text: en dat julle vernuwe moet word in die gees van julle gemoed

kjv_text: And that ye put on the new man, which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness.
bsb_text: and to put on the new self, created to be like God in true righteousness and holiness.
aov_text: en julle met die nuwe mens moet beklee wat na God geskape is in ware geregtigheid en heiligheid.

kjv_text: Wherefore putting away lying, speak every man truth with his neighbour: for we are members one of another.
bsb_text: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to his neighbor, for we are all members of one another.
aov_text: Daarom, lê die leuen af en spreek die waarheid, elkeen met sy naaste, want ons is mekaar se lede.

kjv_text: Be ye angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath:
bsb_text: “Be angry, yet do not sin.” Do not let the sun set upon your anger,
aov_text: Word toornig en moenie sondig nie; laat die son nie ondergaan oor julle toorn nie;

kjv_text: Neither give place to the devil.
bsb_text: and do not give the devil a foothold.
aov_text: en gee aan die duiwel geen plek nie.

kjv_text: Let him that stole steal no more: but rather let him labour, working with his hands the thing which is good, that he may have to give to him that needeth.
bsb_text: He who has been stealing must steal no longer, but must work, doing good with his own hands, that he may have something to share with the one in need.
aov_text: Laat die een wat steel, nie meer steel nie; maar laat hom liewer arbei deur met sy hande te werk wat goed is, sodat hy iets kan hê om mee te deel aan die een wat gebrek het.

kjv_text: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers.
bsb_text: Let no unwholesome talk come out of your mouths, but only what is helpful for building up the one in need and bringing grace to those who listen.
aov_text: Laat daar geen vuil woord uit julle mond uitgaan nie, maar net ’n woord wat goed is vir die nodige stigting, sodat dit genade kan gee aan die wat dit hoor.

kjv_text: And grieve not the holy Spirit of God, whereby ye are sealed unto the day of redemption.
bsb_text: And do not grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.
aov_text: En bedroef nie die Heilige Gees van God nie, deur wie julle verseël is tot die dag van verlossing.

kjv_text: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice:
bsb_text: Get rid of all bitterness, rage and anger, outcry and slander, along with every form of malice.
aov_text: Alle bitterheid en woede en toorn en geskreeu en lastering moet van julle verwyder word, saam met alle boosheid.

kjv_text: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake hath forgiven you.
bsb_text: Be kind and tenderhearted to one another, forgiving each other just as in Christ God forgave you.
aov_text: Maar wees vriendelik en vol ontferming teenoor mekaar; vergeef mekaar soos God ook in Christus julle vergewe het.

kjv_text: Be ye therefore followers of God, as dear children;
bsb_text: Be imitators of God, therefore, as beloved children,
aov_text: WEES dan navolgers van God soos geliefde kinders;

kjv_text: And walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweetsmelling savour.
bsb_text: and walk in love, just as Christ loved us and gave Himself up for us as a fragrant sacrificial offering to God.
aov_text: en wandel in liefde, soos Christus ons ook liefgehad het en Hom vir ons oorgegee het as ’n gawe en offer aan God tot ’n lieflike geur.

kjv_text: But fornication, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not be once named among you, as becometh saints;
bsb_text: But among you, as is proper among the saints, there must not be even a hint of sexual immorality, or of any kind of impurity, or of greed.
aov_text: Maar hoerery en allerhande onreinheid of hebsug moet onder julle selfs nie genoem word nie, soos dit die heiliges betaam;

kjv_text: Neither filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not convenient: but rather giving of thanks.
bsb_text: Nor should there be obscenity, foolish talk, or crude joking, which are out of character, but rather thanksgiving.
aov_text: ook nie gemeenheid en dwase of lawwe praatjies wat nie pas nie, maar liewer danksegging.

kjv_text: For this ye know, that no whoremonger, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, hath any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
bsb_text: For of this you can be sure: No immoral, impure, or greedy person (that is, an idolater), has any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
aov_text: Want dit moet julle weet dat geen hoereerder of onreine of gierigaard, wat ’n afgodedienaar is, ’n erfdeel het in die koninkryk van Christus en van God nie.

kjv_text: Let no man deceive you with vain words: for because of these things cometh the wrath of God upon the children of disobedience.
bsb_text: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of such things the wrath of God is coming on the sons of disobedience.
aov_text: Laat niemand julle met ydel woorde verlei nie, want daardeur kom die toorn van God oor die kinders van die ongehoorsaamheid.

kjv_text: Be not ye therefore partakers with them.
bsb_text: Therefore do not be partakers with them.
aov_text: Wees dan nie hulle deelgenote nie.

kjv_text: For ye were sometimes darkness, but now are ye light in the Lord: walk as children of light:
bsb_text: For you were once darkness, but now you are light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,
aov_text: Want vroeër was julle duisternis, maar nou is julle lig in die Here — wandel soos kinders van die lig.

kjv_text: (For the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth;)
bsb_text: for the fruit of the light consists in all goodness, righteousness, and truth.
aov_text: Want die vrug van die Gees bestaan in alle goedheid en geregtigheid en waarheid.

kjv_text: Proving what is acceptable unto the Lord.
bsb_text: Test and prove what pleases the Lord.
aov_text: En beproef wat die Here welbehaaglik is;

kjv_text: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them.
bsb_text: Have no fellowship with the fruitless deeds of darkness, but rather expose them.
aov_text: en hou nie gemeenskap met die onvrugbare werke van die duisternis nie, maar bestraf dit liewer.

kjv_text: For it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done of them in secret.
bsb_text: For it is shameful even to mention what the disobedient do in secret.
aov_text: Want wat in die geheim deur hulle gedoen word, is skandelik selfs om te noem.

kjv_text: But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light: for whatsoever doth make manifest is light.
bsb_text: But everything exposed by the light becomes visible, for everything that is illuminated becomes a light itself.
aov_text: Maar al die dinge wat deur die lig bestraf word, word openbaar; want alles wat openbaar word, is lig.

kjv_text: Wherefore he saith, Awake thou that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall give thee light.
bsb_text: So it is said: “Wake up, O sleeper, rise up from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”
aov_text: Daarom sê Hy: Ontwaak, jy wat slaap, en staan op uit die dode, en Christus sal oor jou skyn.

kjv_text: See then that ye walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise,
bsb_text: Pay careful attention, then, to how you walk, not as unwise but as wise,
aov_text: Pas dan op dat julle nougeset wandel, nie as onwyse nie, maar as wyse;

kjv_text: Redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
bsb_text: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
aov_text: en koop die tyd uit, omdat die dae boos is.

kjv_text: Wherefore be ye not unwise, but understanding what the will of the Lord is.
bsb_text: Therefore do not be foolish, but understand what the Lord’s will is.
aov_text: Daarom moet julle nie onverstandig wees nie, maar verstaan wat die wil van die Here is.

kjv_text: And be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess; but be filled with the Spirit;
bsb_text: Do not get drunk on wine, which leads to reckless indiscretion. Instead, be filled with the Spirit.
aov_text: Moenie dronk word van wyn nie — daarin is losbandigheid; maar word met die Gees vervul.

kjv_text: Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;
bsb_text: Speak to one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs. Sing and make music in your hearts to the Lord,
aov_text: Spreek onder mekaar met psalms en lofsange en geestelike liedere; en sing en psalmsing in julle hart tot eer van die Here,

kjv_text: Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;
bsb_text: always giving thanks to God the Father for everything in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
aov_text: terwyl julle God die Vader altyd vir alles dank in die Naam van onse Here Jesus Christus,

kjv_text: Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God.
bsb_text: Submit to one another out of reverence for Christ.
aov_text: en aan mekaar onderdanig is in die vrees van God.

kjv_text: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord.
bsb_text: Wives, submit to your husbands as to the Lord.
aov_text: VROUE, wees aan julle eie mans onderdanig, soos aan die Here.

kjv_text: For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church: and he is the saviour of the body.
bsb_text: For the husband is the head of the wife as Christ is the head of the church, His body, of which He is the Savior.
aov_text: Want die man is die hoof van die vrou, soos Christus ook Hoof is van die gemeente; en Hy is die Verlosser van die liggaam.

kjv_text: Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.
bsb_text: Now as the church submits to Christ, so also wives should submit to their husbands in everything.
aov_text: Maar soos die gemeente aan Christus onderdanig is, so moet die vroue dit ook in alles aan hul eie mans wees.

kjv_text: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it;
bsb_text: Husbands, love your wives, just as Christ loved the church and gave Himself up for her
aov_text: Manne, julle moet jul eie vroue liefhê, soos Christus ook die gemeente liefgehad en Homself daarvoor oorgegee het

kjv_text: That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word,
bsb_text: to sanctify her, cleansing her by the washing with water through the word,
aov_text: om dit te heilig, nadat Hy dit gereinig het met die waterbad deur die woord,

kjv_text: That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.
bsb_text: and to present her to Himself as a glorious church, without stain or wrinkle or any such blemish, but holy and blameless.
aov_text: sodat Hy die gemeente voor Hom kon stel, verheerlik, sonder vlek of rimpel of iets dergeliks; maar dat dit heilig en sonder gebrek sou wees.

kjv_text: So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his wife loveth himself.
bsb_text: In the same way, husbands ought to love their wives as their own bodies. He who loves his wife loves himself.
aov_text: So behoort die mans hul eie vroue lief te hê soos hul eie liggame. Wie sy eie vrou liefhet, het homself lief;

kjv_text: For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as the Lord the church:
bsb_text: Indeed, no one ever hated his own body, but he nourishes and cherishes it, just as Christ does the church.
aov_text: want niemand het ooit sy eie vlees gehaat nie, maar hy voed en koester dit, net soos die Here die gemeente.

kjv_text: For we are members of his body, of his flesh, and of his bones.
bsb_text: For we are members of His body.
aov_text: Want ons is lede van sy liggaam, van sy vlees en van sy bene.

kjv_text: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined unto his wife, and they two shall be one flesh.
bsb_text: “For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and the two will become one flesh.”
aov_text: Daarom moet die man sy vader en sy moeder verlaat en sy vrou aankleef, en hulle twee sal een vlees word.

kjv_text: This is a great mystery: but I speak concerning Christ and the church.
bsb_text: This mystery is profound, but I am speaking about Christ and the church.
aov_text: Hierdie verborgenheid is groot, maar ek sê dit met die oog op Christus en die gemeente.

kjv_text: Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself; and the wife see that she reverence her husband.
bsb_text: Nevertheless, each one of you also must love his wife as he loves himself, and the wife must respect her husband.
aov_text: In alle geval moet elkeen van julle ook afsonderlik sy eie vrou liefhê net soos homself, en die vrou moet die man eerbiedig.

kjv_text: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.
bsb_text: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.
aov_text: KINDERS, julle moet jul ouers gehoorsaam wees in die Here, want dit is reg.

kjv_text: Honour thy father and mother; which is the first commandment with promise;
bsb_text: “Honor your father and mother” (which is the first commandment with a promise),
aov_text: Eer jou vader en jou moeder — dit is die eerste gebod met ’n belofte  —

kjv_text: That it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth.
bsb_text: “that it may go well with you and that you may have a long life on the earth.”
aov_text: sodat dit met jou goed mag gaan en jy lank mag lewe op die aarde.

kjv_text: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.
bsb_text: Fathers, do not provoke your children to wrath; instead, bring them up in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.
aov_text: En vaders, moenie julle kinders vertoorn nie, maar voed hulle op in die tug en vermaning van die Here.

kjv_text: Servants, be obedient to them that are your masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as unto Christ;
bsb_text: Slaves, obey your earthly masters with respect and fear and sincerity of heart, just as you would obey Christ.
aov_text: Diensknegte, wees gehoorsaam aan julle here na die vlees, met vrees en bewing, in opregtheid van julle hart, soos aan Christus;

kjv_text: Not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but as the servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;
bsb_text: And do this not only to please them while they are watching, but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from your heart.
aov_text: nie met oëdiens soos mensebehaers nie, maar soos diensknegte van Christus wat die wil van God van harte doen

kjv_text: With good will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men:
bsb_text: Serve with good will, as to the Lord and not to men,
aov_text: en met goedwilligheid die Here dien en nie mense nie,

kjv_text: Knowing that whatsoever good thing any man doeth, the same shall he receive of the Lord, whether he be bond or free.
bsb_text: because you know that the Lord will reward each one for whatever good he does, whether he is slave or free.
aov_text: omdat julle weet dat elkeen vir die goeie wat hy doen, loon van die Here sal ontvang, of hy ’n slaaf is of ’n vryman.

kjv_text: And, ye masters, do the same things unto them, forbearing threatening: knowing that your Master also is in heaven; neither is there respect of persons with him.
bsb_text: And masters, do the same for your slaves. Give up your use of threats, because you know that He who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no favoritism with Him.
aov_text: En here, doen dieselfde teenoor hulle en laat staan die dreigemente, omdat julle weet dat ook julle eie Here in die hemele is en by Hom geen aanneming van die persoon is nie.

kjv_text: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.
bsb_text: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in His mighty power.
aov_text: EINDELIK, my broeders, word kragtig in die Here en in die krag van sy sterkte.

kjv_text: Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
bsb_text: Put on the full armor of God, so that you can make your stand against the devil’s schemes.
aov_text: Trek die volle wapenrusting van God aan, sodat julle staande kan bly teen die liste van die duiwel.

kjv_text: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.
bsb_text: For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the powers of this world’s darkness, and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms.
aov_text: Want ons worstelstryd is nie teen vlees en bloed nie, maar teen die owerhede, teen die magte, teen die wêreldheersers van die duisternis van hierdie eeu, teen die bose geeste in die lug.

kjv_text: Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.
bsb_text: Therefore take up the full armor of God, so that when the day of evil comes, you will be able to stand your ground, and having done everything, to stand.
aov_text: Daarom, neem die volle wapenrusting van God op, sodat julle weerstand kan bied in die dag van onheil en, nadat julle alles volbring het, staande kan bly.

kjv_text: Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness;
bsb_text: Stand firm then, with the belt of truth buckled around your waist, with the breastplate of righteousness arrayed,
aov_text: Staan dan vas, julle lendene met die waarheid omgord, met die borswapen van die geregtigheid aan,

kjv_text: And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace;
bsb_text: and with your feet fitted with the readiness of the gospel of peace.
aov_text: en as skoene aan julle voete die bereidheid vir die evangelie van vrede.

kjv_text: Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.
bsb_text: In addition to all this, take up the shield of faith, with which you can extinguish all the flaming arrows of the evil one.
aov_text: Behalwe dit alles neem die skild van die geloof op waarmee julle al die vurige pyle van die Bose sal kan uitblus.

kjv_text: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:
bsb_text: And take the helmet of salvation and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God.
aov_text: En neem aan die helm van verlossing en die swaard van die Gees — dit is die woord van God  —

kjv_text: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints;
bsb_text: Pray in the Spirit at all times, with every kind of prayer and petition. To this end, stay alert with all perseverance in your prayers for all the saints.
aov_text: terwyl julle met alle gebed en smeking by elke geleentheid bid in die Gees, en juis daartoe waak met alle volharding en smeking vir al die heiliges

kjv_text: And for me, that utterance may be given unto me, that I may open my mouth boldly, to make known the mystery of the gospel,
bsb_text: Pray also for me, that whenever I open my mouth, words may be given me so that I will boldly make known the mystery of the gospel,
aov_text: en vir my, sodat ’n woord my gegee mag word as ek my mond oopmaak om met vrymoedigheid die verborgenheid van die evangelie bekend te maak,

kjv_text: For which I am an ambassador in bonds: that therein I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.
bsb_text: for which I am an ambassador in chains. Pray that I may proclaim it fearlessly, as I should.
aov_text: waarvoor ek ’n gesant is in kettings, sodat ek daarin vrymoediglik mag spreek soos ek moet spreek.

kjv_text: But that ye also may know my affairs, and how I do, Tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord, shall make known to you all things:
bsb_text: Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will tell you everything, so that you also may know about me and what I am doing.
aov_text: EN dat julle ook my omstandighede kan ken, hoe dit met my gaan, alles sal Tíchikus, die geliefde broeder en getroue dienaar in die Here, julle bekend maak.

kjv_text: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that ye might know our affairs, and that he might comfort your hearts.
bsb_text: I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know about us, and that he may encourage your hearts.
aov_text: Ek het hom juis daarvoor na julle gestuur, dat julle ons omstandighede kan ken en hy julle harte kan troos.

kjv_text: Peace be to the brethren, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
bsb_text: Peace to the brothers and love with faith from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
aov_text: Vrede vir die broeders en liefde, met geloof, van God die Vader en die Here Jesus Christus!

kjv_text: Grace be with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity. Amen.
bsb_text: Grace to all who love our Lord Jesus Christ with an undying love.
aov_text: Die genade sy met almal wat onse Here Jesus Christus in onverganklikheid liefhet! Amen.

kjv_text: Paul and Timotheus, the servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus which are at Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:
bsb_text: Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus, To all the saints in Christ Jesus at Philippi, together with the overseers and deacons:
aov_text: PAULUS en Timótheüs, diensknegte van Jesus Christus, aan al die heiliges in Christus Jesus wat in Filíppi is, saam met die opsieners en diakens:

kjv_text: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
bsb_text: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
aov_text: Genade vir julle en vrede van God onse Vader en die Here Jesus Christus!

kjv_text: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you,
bsb_text: I thank my God every time I remember you.
aov_text: EK dank my God elke maal as ek aan julle dink  —

kjv_text: Always in every prayer of mine for you all making request with joy,
bsb_text: In every prayer for all of you, I always pray with joy,
aov_text: en ek bid altyd in al my gebede vir julle almal met blydskap  —

kjv_text: For your fellowship in the gospel from the first day until now;
bsb_text: because of your partnership in the gospel from the first day until now,
aov_text: oor julle gemeenskap aan die evangelie van die eerste dag af tot nou toe,

kjv_text: Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:
bsb_text: being confident of this, that He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion until the day of Christ Jesus.
aov_text: omdat ek juis hierop vertrou, dat Hy wat ’n goeie werk in julle begin het, dit sal voleindig tot op die dag van Jesus Christus;

kjv_text: Even as it is meet for me to think this of you all, because I have you in my heart; inasmuch as both in my bonds, and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel, ye all are partakers of my grace.
bsb_text: It is right for me to feel this way about all of you, since I have you in my heart. For in my chains and in my defense and confirmation of the gospel, you are all partners in grace with me.
aov_text: soos dit vir my reg is om dit van julle almal te dink, omdat ek julle in my hart dra, aangesien julle almal in my boeie sowel as in die verdediging en bevestiging van die evangelie my deelgenote in die genade is.

kjv_text: For God is my record, how greatly I long after you all in the bowels of Jesus Christ.
bsb_text: God is my witness how I long for all of you with the affection of Christ Jesus.
aov_text: Want God is my getuie hoe ek na julle almal verlang met die innige tederheid van Jesus Christus.

kjv_text: And this I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and in all judgment;
bsb_text: And this is my prayer: that your love may abound more and more in knowledge and depth of insight,
aov_text: En dit bid ek dat julle liefde nog meer en meer oorvloedig mag word in kennis en alle ervaring,

kjv_text: That ye may approve things that are excellent; that ye may be sincere and without offence till the day of Christ;
bsb_text: so that you may be able to test and prove what is best and may be pure and blameless for the day of Christ,
aov_text: om die dinge waar dit op aankom, te onderskei, sodat julle rein en vir niemand ’n aanstoot mag wees  nie, tot op die dag van Christus,

kjv_text: Being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are by Jesus Christ, unto the glory and praise of God.
bsb_text: filled with the fruit of righteousness that comes through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.
aov_text: vervul met die vrug van geregtigheid wat daar is deur Jesus Christus tot heerlikheid en lof van God.

kjv_text: But I would ye should understand, brethren, that the things which happened unto me have fallen out rather unto the furtherance of the gospel;
bsb_text: Now I want you to know, brothers, that my circumstances have actually served to advance the gospel.
aov_text: En ek wil hê dat julle moet weet, broeders, dat wat my wedervaar het, eerder op bevordering van die evangelie uitgeloop het,

kjv_text: So that my bonds in Christ are manifest in all the palace, and in all other places;
bsb_text: As a result, it has become clear throughout the whole palace guard and to everyone else that I am in chains for Christ.
aov_text: sodat my boeie openbaar geword het in Christus onder die hele keiserlike lyfwag en by al die ander,

kjv_text: And many of the brethren in the Lord, waxing confident by my bonds, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.
bsb_text: And most of the brothers, confident in the Lord by my chains, now dare more greatly to speak the word without fear.
aov_text: en die meeste van die broeders wat in die Here deur my boeie vertroue gekry het, dit des te meer waag om die woord onbevrees te spreek.

kjv_text: Some indeed preach Christ even of envy and strife; and some also of good will:
bsb_text: It is true that some preach Christ out of envy and rivalry, but others out of goodwill.
aov_text: Sommige preek Christus wel ook uit afguns en twis, maar ander ook uit welwillendheid:

kjv_text: The one preach Christ of contention, not sincerely, supposing to add affliction to my bonds:
bsb_text: The former, however, preach Christ out of selfish ambition, not sincerely, supposing that they can add to the distress of my chains.
aov_text: die eerste verkondig Christus uit naywer, nie met suiwer bedoelinge nie, met die mening om aan my boeie verdrukking toe te voeg;

kjv_text: But the other of love, knowing that I am set for the defence of the gospel.
bsb_text: The latter do so in love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the gospel.
aov_text: maar die ander uit liefde, omdat hulle weet dat ek bestem is tot die verdediging van die evangelie.

kjv_text: What then? notwithstanding, every way, whether in pretence, or in truth, Christ is preached; and I therein do rejoice, yea, and will rejoice.
bsb_text: What then is the issue? Just this: that in every way, whether by false motives or true, Christ is preached. And in this I rejoice. Yes, and I will continue to rejoice,
aov_text: Maar wat maak dit? In alle geval, op allerlei wyse, of dit onder ’n skyn of in waarheid is, word Christus verkondig; en hierin verbly ek my en sal ek my ook verbly.

kjv_text: For I know that this shall turn to my salvation through your prayer, and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,
bsb_text: because I know that through your prayers and the provision of the Spirit of Jesus Christ, my distress will turn out for my deliverance.
aov_text: Want ek weet dat dit deur julle gebed en die ondersteuning van die Gees van Jesus Christus my tot heil sal strek,

kjv_text: According to my earnest expectation and my hope, that in nothing I shall be ashamed, but that with all boldness, as always, so now also Christ shall be magnified in my body, whether it be by life, or by death.
bsb_text: I eagerly expect and hope that I will in no way be ashamed, but will have complete boldness so that now as always Christ will be exalted in my body, whether by life or by death.
aov_text: volgens my reikhalsende verwagting en hoop dat ek in niks beskaam sal word nie; maar dat Christus met alle vrymoedigheid, soos altyd so ook nou, groot gemaak sal word in my liggaam, of dit deur die lewe of deur die dood is.

kjv_text: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
bsb_text: For to me, to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
aov_text: Want vir my is die lewe Christus en die sterwe wins.

kjv_text: But if I live in the flesh, this is the fruit of my labour: yet what I shall choose I wot not.
bsb_text: But if I go on living in the body, this will mean fruitful labor for me. So what shall I choose? I do not know.
aov_text: Maar as ek in die vlees moet lewe, dan beteken dit vir my vrugbare arbeid; en wat ek sal kies, weet ek nie.

kjv_text: For I am in a strait betwixt two, having a desire to depart, and to be with Christ; which is far better:
bsb_text: I am torn between the two. I desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better indeed.
aov_text: Want ek word van weerskante gedring: ek het verlange om heen te gaan en met Christus te wees, want dit is verreweg die beste;

kjv_text: Nevertheless to abide in the flesh is more needful for you.
bsb_text: But it is more necessary for you that I remain in the body.
aov_text: maar om in die vlees te bly, is nodiger om julle ontwil.

kjv_text: And having this confidence, I know that I shall abide and continue with you all for your furtherance and joy of faith;
bsb_text: Convinced of this, I know that I will remain and will continue with all of you for your progress and joy in the faith,
aov_text: En dit vertrou en weet ek dat ek sal bly, ja, saam met julle almal sal bly tot julle bevordering en blydskap in die geloof,

kjv_text: That your rejoicing may be more abundant in Jesus Christ for me by my coming to you again.
bsb_text: so that through my coming to you again your exultation in Christ Jesus will resound on account of me.
aov_text: sodat julle roem oor my oorvloedig kan wees in Christus Jesus deur my teenwoordigheid weer by julle.

kjv_text: Only let your conversation be as it becometh the gospel of Christ: that whether I come and see you, or else be absent, I may hear of your affairs, that ye stand fast in one spirit, with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel;
bsb_text: Nevertheless, conduct yourselves in a manner worthy of the gospel of Christ. Then, whether I come and see you or only hear about you in my absence, I will know that you stand firm in one spirit, contending side by side for the faith of the gospel,
aov_text: ALLEENLIK, gedra julle waardig die evangelie van Christus, sodat, of ek kom en julle sien dan wel of ek afwesig is, ek van julle omstandighede kan hoor dat julle in een gees vasstaan en, een van siel, saam stry vir die geloof van die evangelie,

kjv_text: And in nothing terrified by your adversaries: which is to them an evident token of perdition, but to you of salvation, and that of God.
bsb_text: without being frightened in any way by those who oppose you. This is a clear sign of their destruction but of your salvation, and it is from God.
aov_text: en dat julle jul in geen opsig laat afskrik deur die teëstanders nie. Dit is vir hulle wel ’n bewys van verderf, maar vir julle van redding, en dit van God;

kjv_text: For unto you it is given in the behalf of Christ, not only to believe on him, but also to suffer for his sake;
bsb_text: For it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ not only to believe in Him, but also to suffer for Him,
aov_text: omdat dit aan julle ter wille van Christus genadiglik gegee is om nie alleen in Hom te glo nie, maar ook vir Hom te ly,

kjv_text: Having the same conflict which ye saw in me, and now hear to be in me.
bsb_text: since you are encountering the same struggle you saw I had, and now hear that I still have.
aov_text: terwyl julle dieselfde stryd het as wat julle in my gesien het en nou van my hoor.

kjv_text: If there be therefore any consolation in Christ, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any bowels and mercies,
bsb_text: Therefore if you have any encouragement in Christ, if any comfort from His love, if any fellowship with the Spirit, if any affection and compassion,
aov_text: AS daar dan enige troos in Christus is, as daar enige vertroosting van die liefde, as daar enige gemeenskap van die Gees, as daar enige innige tederheid en ontferming is,

kjv_text: Fulfil ye my joy, that ye be likeminded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind.
bsb_text: then make my joy complete by being like-minded, having the same love, being united in spirit and purpose.
aov_text: maak dan my blydskap volkome deur eensgesind te wees en dieselfde liefde te hê, een van siel, een van sin.

kjv_text: Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.
bsb_text: Do nothing out of selfish ambition or empty pride, but in humility consider others more important than yourselves.
aov_text: Moenie iets doen uit selfsug of uit ydele eer nie, maar in nederigheid moet die een die ander hoër ag as homself.

kjv_text: Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others.
bsb_text: Each of you should look not only to your own interests, but also to the interests of others.
aov_text: Julle moet nie elkeen na sy eie belange omsien nie, maar elkeen ook na die ander s’n.

kjv_text: Let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus:
bsb_text: Let this mind be in you which was also in Christ Jesus:
aov_text: Want hierdie gesindheid moet in julle wees wat ook in Christus Jesus was.

kjv_text: Who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God:
bsb_text: Who, existing in the form of God, did not consider equality with God something to be grasped,
aov_text: Hy, wat in die gestalte van God was, het dit geen roof geag om aan God gelyk te wees nie,

kjv_text: But made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men:
bsb_text: but emptied Himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in human likeness.
aov_text: maar het Homself ontledig deur die gestalte van ’n dienskneg aan te neem en aan die mense gelyk geword;

kjv_text: And being found in fashion as a man,
bsb_text: And being found in appearance as a man,
aov_text: en in gedaante gevind as ’n mens,

kjv_text: he humbled himself, and became obedient unto death, even the death of the cross.
bsb_text: He humbled Himself and became obedient to death—even death on a cross.
aov_text: het Hy Homself verneder deur gehoorsaam te word tot die dood toe, ja, die dood van die kruis.

kjv_text: Wherefore God also hath highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name:
bsb_text: Therefore God exalted Him to the highest place and gave Him the name above all names,
aov_text: Daarom het God Hom ook uitermate verhoog en Hom ’n naam gegee wat bo elke naam is,

kjv_text: That at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth;
bsb_text: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, in heaven and on earth and under the earth,
aov_text: sodat in die Naam van Jesus sou buig elke knie van die wat in die hemel en die wat op die aarde en die wat onder die aarde is,

kjv_text: And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
bsb_text: and every tongue confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
aov_text: en elke tong sou bely dat Jesus Christus die Here is tot heerlikheid van God die Vader.

kjv_text: Wherefore, my beloved, as ye have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.
bsb_text: Therefore, my beloved, just as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now even more in my absence, continue to work out your salvation with fear and trembling.
aov_text: Daarom, my geliefdes, soos julle altyd gehoorsaam gewees het, nie in my teenwoordigheid alleen nie, maar baie meer nou in my afwesigheid, werk julle eie heil uit met vrees en bewing;

kjv_text: For it is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure.
bsb_text: For it is God who works in you to will and to act on behalf of His good purpose.
aov_text: want dit is God wat in julle werk om te wil sowel as om te werk na sy welbehae.

kjv_text: Do all things without murmurings and disputings:
bsb_text: Do everything without complaining or arguing,
aov_text: Doen alles sonder murmurering en teëspraak,

kjv_text: That ye may be blameless and harmless, the sons of God, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation, among whom ye shine as lights in the world;
bsb_text: so that you may be blameless and pure, children of God without fault in a crooked and perverse generation, in which you shine as lights in the world
aov_text: sodat julle onberispelik en opreg kan wees, kinders van God sonder gebrek te midde van ’n krom en verdraaide geslag onder wie julle skyn soos ligte in die wêreld,

kjv_text: Holding forth the word of life; that I may rejoice in the day of Christ, that I have not run in vain, neither laboured in vain.
bsb_text: as you hold forth the word of life, in order that I may boast on the day of Christ that I did not run or labor in vain.
aov_text: deurdat julle die woord van die lewe vashou, my tot ’n roem teen die dag van Christus, dat ek nie verniet geloop of verniet gearbei het nie.

kjv_text: Yea, and if I be offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I joy, and rejoice with you all.
bsb_text: But even if I am being poured out like a drink offering on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I am glad and rejoice with all of you.
aov_text: Maar al word ek as ’n drankoffer uitgegiet oor die offer en bediening van julle geloof, verbly ek my, ja, verbly ek my saam met julle almal;

kjv_text: For the same cause also do ye joy, and rejoice with me.
bsb_text: So you too should be glad and rejoice with me.
aov_text: en om dieselfde rede moet julle ook bly wees en julle saam met my verbly.

kjv_text: But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timotheus shortly unto you, that I also may be of good comfort, when I know your state.
bsb_text: Now I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered when I learn how you are doing.
aov_text: EN ek hoop in die Here Jesus om Timótheüs gou na julle te stuur, sodat ek ook welgemoed kan wees as ek julle omstandighede te wete gekom het.

kjv_text: For I have no man likeminded, who will naturally care for your state.
bsb_text: I have nobody else like him who will genuinely care for your needs.
aov_text: Want ek het niemand van dieselfde gesindheid wat julle belange opreg sal behartig nie;

kjv_text: For all seek their own, not the things which are Jesus Christ's.
bsb_text: For all the others look after their own interests, not those of Jesus Christ.
aov_text: want hulle soek almal hul eie belange, nie dié van Christus Jesus nie.

kjv_text: But ye know the proof of him, that, as a son with the father, he hath served with me in the gospel.
bsb_text: But you know Timothy’s proven worth, that as a child with his father he has served with me to advance the gospel.
aov_text: Maar julle ken sy beproefdheid, dat hy, soos ’n kind teenoor sy vader, saam met my in die evangelie gedien het.

kjv_text: Him therefore I hope to send presently, so soon as I shall see how it will go with me.
bsb_text: So I hope to send him as soon as I see what happens with me.
aov_text: Ek hoop dan om hom dadelik te stuur, so gou as ek sien hoe dit met my sal gaan;

kjv_text: But I trust in the Lord that I also myself shall come shortly.
bsb_text: And I trust in the Lord that I myself will come soon.
aov_text: en ek vertrou in die Here dat ek self ook spoedig sal kom.

kjv_text: Yet I supposed it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, and companion in labour, and fellowsoldier, but your messenger, and he that ministered to my wants.
bsb_text: But I thought it necessary to send back to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, and fellow soldier, who is also your messenger and minister to my needs.
aov_text: Maar ek het dit noodsaaklik geag om Epafrodítus, my broeder en medewerker en medestryder, julle afgevaardigde en bedienaar van my behoefte, na julle te stuur,

kjv_text: For he longed after you all, and was full of heaviness, because that ye had heard that he had been sick.
bsb_text: For he has been longing for all of you and is distressed because you heard he was ill.
aov_text: want hy het na julle almal verlang en was besorg, omdat julle gehoor het dat hy siek was.

kjv_text: For indeed he was sick nigh unto death: but God had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow.
bsb_text: He was sick indeed, nearly unto death. But God had mercy on him, and not only on him but also on me, to spare me sorrow upon sorrow.
aov_text: Want hy was ook siek tot by die dood; maar God was hom barmhartig, en nie hom alleen nie, maar ook my, dat ek nie droefheid op droefheid sou hê nie.

kjv_text: I sent him therefore the more carefully, that, when ye see him again, ye may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.
bsb_text: Therefore I am all the more eager to send him, so that when you see him again you may rejoice, and I may be less anxious.
aov_text: Ek het hom dus des te spoediger gestuur, sodat julle hom kan sien en julle weer verbly en ek minder bedroef kan wees.

kjv_text: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness; and hold such in reputation:
bsb_text: Welcome him in the Lord with great joy, and honor men like him,
aov_text: Ontvang hom dan in die Here met alle blydskap en hou sulke manne in eer.

kjv_text: Because for the work of Christ he was nigh unto death, not regarding his life, to supply your lack of service toward me.
bsb_text: because he nearly died for the work of Christ, risking his life to make up for your deficit of service to me.
aov_text: Want ter wille van die werk van Christus het hy tot naby die dood gekom en sy lewe gewaag om aan te vul wat julle kortgekom het in die diensbetoning aan my.

kjv_text: Finally, my brethren, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not grievous, but for you it is safe.
bsb_text: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord. It is no trouble for me to write the same things to you again, and it is a safeguard for you.
aov_text: VERDER, my broeders, verbly julle in die Here. Dit is vir my nie lastig om dieselfde dinge aan julle te skrywe nie, en dit gee julle sekerheid.

kjv_text: Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers, beware of the concision.
bsb_text: Watch out for those dogs, those workers of evil, those mutilators of the flesh!
aov_text: Let op die honde; let op die slegte arbeiders; let op die versnyding.

kjv_text: For we are the circumcision, which worship God in the spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh.
bsb_text: For it is we who are the circumcision, we who worship by the Spirit of God, who glory in Christ Jesus, and who put no confidence in the flesh—
aov_text: Want óns is die besnydenis, ons wat God in die Gees dien en in Christus Jesus roem en nie op die vlees vertrou nie;

kjv_text: Though I might also have confidence in the flesh. If any other man thinketh that he hath whereof he might trust in the flesh, I more:
bsb_text: though I myself could have such confidence. If anyone else thinks he has grounds for confidence in the flesh, I have more:
aov_text: alhoewel ek rede het om ook te vertrou op die vlees. As iemand anders meen dat hy op die vlees kan vertrou, ek nog meer.

kjv_text: Circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, an Hebrew of the Hebrews; as touching the law, a Pharisee;
bsb_text: circumcised on the eighth day, of the people of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin; a Hebrew of Hebrews; as to the law, a Pharisee;
aov_text: Ek is besny op die agtste dag, uit die geslag van Israel, uit die stam van Benjamin, ’n Hebreër uit die Hebreërs; wat die wet betref, ’n Fariseër;

kjv_text: Concerning zeal, persecuting the church; touching the righteousness which is in the law, blameless.
bsb_text: as to zeal, persecuting the church; as to righteousness in the law, faultless.
aov_text: wat ywer betref, ’n vervolger van die gemeente; wat die geregtigheid in die wet betref, onberispelik.

kjv_text: But what things were gain to me, those I counted loss for Christ.
bsb_text: But whatever was gain to me I count as loss for the sake of Christ.
aov_text: Maar wat vir my wins was, dit het ek om Christus wil skade geag.

kjv_text: Yea doubtless, and I count all things but loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord: for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and do count them but dung, that I may win Christ,
bsb_text: More than that, I count all things as loss compared to the surpassing excellence of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord, for whom I have lost all things. I consider them rubbish, that I may gain Christ
aov_text: Ja waarlik, ek ag ook alles skade om die uitnemendheid van die kennis van Christus Jesus, my Here, ter wille van wie ek alles prysgegee het en as drek beskou, om Christus as wins te verkry

kjv_text: And be found in him, not having mine own righteousness, which is of the law, but that which is through the faith of Christ, the righteousness which is of God by faith:
bsb_text: and be found in Him, not having my own righteousness from the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness from God on the basis of faith.
aov_text: en in Hom gevind te word, nie met my geregtigheid wat uit die wet is nie, maar met dié wat deur die geloof in Christus is, die geregtigheid wat uit God is deur die geloof;

kjv_text: That I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, being made conformable unto his death;
bsb_text: I want to know Christ and the power of His resurrection and the fellowship of His sufferings, being conformed to Him in His death,
aov_text: sodat ek Hom kan ken en die krag van sy opstanding en die gemeenskap aan sy lyde terwyl ek aan sy dood gelykvormig word,

kjv_text: If by any means I might attain unto the resurrection of the dead.
bsb_text: and so, somehow, to attain to the resurrection from the dead.
aov_text: of ek miskien die opstanding uit die dode kan bereik.

kjv_text: Not as though I had already attained, either were already perfect: but I follow after, if that I may apprehend that for which also I am apprehended of Christ Jesus.
bsb_text: Not that I have already obtained all this, or have already been made perfect, but I press on to take hold of that for which Christ Jesus took hold of me.
aov_text: Nie dat ek dit al verkry het of al volmaak is nie, maar ek jaag daarna of ek dit ook kan gryp, omdat ek ook deur Christus Jesus gegryp is.

kjv_text: Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended:
bsb_text: Brothers, I do not consider myself yet to have taken hold of it.
aov_text: Broeders, ek reken nie dat ek dit self gegryp het nie.

kjv_text: but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before,
bsb_text: But one thing I do: Forgetting what is behind and straining toward what is ahead,
aov_text: Maar een ding: ek vergeet die dinge wat agter is en strek my uit na wat voor is,

kjv_text: I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
bsb_text: I press on toward the goal to win the prize of God’s heavenly calling in Christ Jesus.
aov_text: en jaag na die doel om die prys te verkry van die hoë roeping van God in Christus Jesus.

kjv_text: Let us therefore, as many as be perfect, be thus minded: and if in any thing ye be otherwise minded, God shall reveal even this unto you.
bsb_text: All of us who are mature should embrace this point of view. And if you think differently about some issue, God will reveal this to you as well.
aov_text: Laat ons almal dan wat volmaak is, so gesind wees; en as julle anders gesind is, sal God dit ook aan julle openbaar.

kjv_text: Nevertheless, whereto we have already attained, let us walk by the same rule, let us mind the same thing.
bsb_text: Nevertheless, we must live up to what we have already attained.
aov_text: Maar wat ons reeds bereik het — laat ons volgens dieselfde reël wandel, laat ons eensgesind wees.

kjv_text: Brethren, be followers together of me, and mark them which walk so as ye have us for an ensample.
bsb_text: Join one another in following my example, brothers, and carefully observe those who walk according to the pattern we set for you.
aov_text: Wees ook my navolgers, broeders, en let op die wat so wandel soos julle ons tot voorbeeld het.

kjv_text: (For many walk, of whom I have told you often, and now tell you even weeping, that they are the enemies of the cross of Christ:
bsb_text: For as I have often told you before, and now say again even with tears: Many live as enemies of the cross of Christ.
aov_text: Want baie — van wie ek julle dit dikwels gesê het en nou ook onder trane sê — wandel as vyande van die kruis van Christus.

kjv_text: Whose end is destruction, whose God is their belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who mind earthly things.)
bsb_text: Their end is destruction, their god is their belly, and their glory is in their shame. Their minds are set on earthly things.
aov_text: Hulle einde is die verderf, hulle god is die buik en hulle eer is in hulle skande; hulle bedink aardse dinge.

kjv_text: For our conversation is in heaven; from whence also we look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ:
bsb_text: But our citizenship is in heaven, and we eagerly await a Savior from there, the Lord Jesus Christ,
aov_text: Want ons burgerskap is in die hemele, van waar ons ook as Verlosser verwag die Here Jesus Christus,

kjv_text: Who shall change our vile body, that it may be fashioned like unto his glorious body, according to the working whereby he is able even to subdue all things unto himself.
bsb_text: who, by the power that enables Him to subject all things to Himself, will transform our lowly bodies to be like His glorious body.
aov_text: wat ons vernederde liggaam van gedaante sal verander, om gelykvormig te word aan sy verheerlikte liggaam volgens die werking waardeur Hy ook alles aan Homself kan onderwerp.

kjv_text: Therefore, my brethren dearly beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, so stand fast in the Lord, my dearly beloved.
bsb_text: Therefore, my brothers, whom I love and long for, my joy and crown, that is how you must stand firm in the Lord, my beloved.
aov_text: DAAROM, my geliefde broeders, na wie ek ook verlang, my blydskap en kroon, staan so vas in die Here, geliefdes.

kjv_text: I beseech Euodias, and beseech Syntyche, that they be of the same mind in the Lord.
bsb_text: I urge Euodia and Syntyche to agree with each other in the Lord.
aov_text: Ek vermaan Euódia en ek vermaan Síntiché om eensgesind te wees in die Here.

kjv_text: And I intreat thee also, true yokefellow, help those women which laboured with me in the gospel, with Clement also, and with other my fellowlabourers, whose names are in the book of life.
bsb_text: Yes, and I ask you, my true yokefellow, to help these women who have labored with me for the gospel, along with Clement and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the Book of Life.
aov_text: En ek vra jou ook, opregte metgesel, wees hierdie vroue behulpsaam wat met my saamgestry het in die evangelie, ook saam met Clemens en my ander medearbeiders wie se name in die boek van die lewe is.

kjv_text: Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.
bsb_text: Rejoice in the Lord always. I will say it again: Rejoice!
aov_text: Verbly julle altyd in die Here; ek herhaal: Verbly julle!

kjv_text: Let your moderation be known unto all men. The Lord is at hand.
bsb_text: Let your gentleness be apparent to all. The Lord is near.
aov_text: Laat julle vriendelikheid aan alle mense bekend word. Die Here is naby.

kjv_text: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
bsb_text: Be anxious for nothing, but in everything, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.
aov_text: Wees oor niks besorg nie, maar laat julle begeertes in alles deur gebed en smeking met danksegging bekend word by God.

kjv_text: And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.
bsb_text: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.
aov_text: En die vrede van God, wat alle verstand te bowe gaan, sal julle harte en julle sinne bewaar in Christus Jesus.

kjv_text: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.
bsb_text: Finally, brothers, whatever is true, whatever is honorable, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable—if anything is excellent or praiseworthy—think on these things.
aov_text: Verder, broeders, alles wat waar is, alles wat eerbaar is, alles wat regverdig is, alles wat rein is, alles wat lieflik is, alles wat loflik is — watter deug en watter lof daar ook mag wees, bedink dit.

kjv_text: Those things, which ye have both learned, and received, and heard, and seen in me, do: and the God of peace shall be with you.
bsb_text: Whatever you have learned or received or heard from me, or seen in me, put it into practice. And the God of peace will be with you.
aov_text: En wat julle geleer en ontvang en gehoor en in my gesien het, doen dit, en die God van vrede sal met julle wees.

kjv_text: But I rejoiced in the Lord greatly, that now at the last your care of me hath flourished again; wherein ye were also careful, but ye lacked opportunity.
bsb_text: Now I rejoice greatly in the Lord that at last you have revived your concern for me. You were indeed concerned, but you had no opportunity to show it.
aov_text: EK het my grootliks verbly in die Here dat julle nou eindelik weer opgeleef het om aan my belange te dink; waaraan julle ook gedink het, maar julle het die geleentheid nie gehad nie.

kjv_text: Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content.
bsb_text: I am not saying this out of need, for I have learned to be content regardless of my circumstances.
aov_text: Nie dat ek dit uit gebrek sê nie, want ek het geleer om vergenoeg te wees met die omstandighede waarin ek is.

kjv_text: I know both how to be abased, and I know how to abound: every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.
bsb_text: I know how to live humbly, and I know how to abound. I am accustomed to any and every situation—to being filled and being hungry, to having plenty and having need.
aov_text: Ek weet om verneder te word, ek weet ook om oorvloed te hê; in elke opsig en in alle dinge is ek onderrig: om versadig te word sowel as om honger te ly, om oorvloed te hê sowel as om gebrek te ly.

kjv_text: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.
bsb_text: I can do all things through Christ who gives me strength.
aov_text: Ek is tot alles in staat deur Christus wat my krag gee.

kjv_text: Notwithstanding ye have well done, that ye did communicate with my affliction.
bsb_text: Nevertheless, you have done well to share in my affliction.
aov_text: Nogtans het julle goed gedoen toe julle deel gehad het in my verdrukking.

kjv_text: Now ye Philippians know also, that in the beginning of the gospel, when I departed from Macedonia, no church communicated with me as concerning giving and receiving, but ye only.
bsb_text: And as you Philippians know, in the early days of the gospel, when I left Macedonia, no church but you partnered with me in the matter of giving and receiving.
aov_text: En julle, Filippense, weet ook dat in die begin van die evangelie, toe ek van Macedónië vertrek het, geen gemeente deel gehad het in my rekening van uitgawe en inkomste nie, behalwe julle alleen.

kjv_text: For even in Thessalonica ye sent once and again unto my necessity.
bsb_text: For even while I was in Thessalonica, you provided for my needs again and again.
aov_text: Want ook in Thessaloníka het julle vir my behoefte meer as een maal iets gestuur.

kjv_text: Not because I desire a gift: but I desire fruit that may abound to your account.
bsb_text: Not that I am seeking a gift, but I am looking for the fruit that may be credited to your account.
aov_text: Nie dat ek die gawe soek nie, maar ek soek die vrug wat oorvloedig word op julle rekening.

kjv_text: But I have all, and abound: I am full, having received of Epaphroditus the things which were sent from you, an odour of a sweet smell, a sacrifice acceptable, wellpleasing to God.
bsb_text: I have all I need and more, now that I have received your gifts from Epaphroditus. They are a fragrant offering, an acceptable sacrifice, well-pleasing to God.
aov_text: Maar ek het alles ontvang, en ek het oorvloed. Ek het dit volop noudat ek van Epafrodítus ontvang het wat deur julle gestuur is, ’n lieflike geur, ’n welgevallige offer, welbehaaglik by God.

kjv_text: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.
bsb_text: And my God will supply all your needs according to His glorious riches in Christ Jesus.
aov_text: En my God sal elke behoefte van julle vervul na sy rykdom in heerlikheid deur Christus Jesus.

kjv_text: Now unto God and our Father be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
bsb_text: To our God and Father be glory forever and ever. Amen.
aov_text: Aan onse God en Vader die heerlikheid tot in alle ewigheid! Amen.

kjv_text: Salute every saint in Christ Jesus. The brethren which are with me greet you.
bsb_text: Greet all the saints in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me send you greetings.
aov_text: Groet elke heilige in Christus Jesus. Die broeders wat saam met my is, groet julle.

kjv_text: All the saints salute you, chiefly they that are of Caesar's household.
bsb_text: All the saints send you greetings, especially those from the household of Caesar.
aov_text: Al die heiliges, en veral die wat aan die keiserlike huis behoort, groet julle.

kjv_text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
bsb_text: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.
aov_text: Die genade van onse Here Jesus Christus sy met julle almal! Amen.

kjv_text: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timotheus our brother,
bsb_text: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and Timothy our brother,
aov_text: PAULUS, ’n apostel van Jesus Christus deur die wil van God, en die broeder Timótheüs,

kjv_text: To the saints and faithful brethren in Christ which are at Colosse: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
bsb_text: To the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae: Grace and peace to you from God our Father.
aov_text: aan die heilige en gelowige broeders in Christus wat in Kolosse is: Genade vir julle en vrede van God onse Vader en die Here Jesus Christus!

kjv_text: We give thanks to God and the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,
bsb_text: We always thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, when we pray for you,
aov_text: ONS dank die God en Vader van onse Here Jesus Christus altyd as ons vir julle bid,

kjv_text: Since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love which ye have to all the saints,
bsb_text: because we have heard about your faith in Christ Jesus and your love for all the saints—
aov_text: omdat ons gehoor het van julle geloof in Christus Jesus en julle liefde tot al die heiliges,

kjv_text: For the hope which is laid up for you in heaven, whereof ye heard before in the word of the truth of the gospel;
bsb_text: the faith and love proceeding from the hope stored up for you in heaven, of which you have already heard in the word of truth, the gospel
aov_text: vanweë die hoop wat vir julle weggelê is in die hemele, waarvan julle vroeër gehoor het deur die woord van die waarheid van die evangelie,

kjv_text: Which is come unto you, as it is in all the world; and bringeth forth fruit, as it doth also in you, since the day ye heard of it, and knew the grace of God in truth:
bsb_text: that has come to you. All over the world this gospel is bearing fruit and growing, just as it has been doing among you since the day you heard it and truly understood the grace of God.
aov_text: wat julle sowel as die hele wêreld bereik het; en dit dra vrug, net soos onder julle ook, van die dag af dat julle dit gehoor het en die genade van God in waarheid leer ken het;

kjv_text: As ye also learned of Epaphras our dear fellowservant, who is for you a faithful minister of Christ;
