bsb_text: You learned it from Epaphras, our beloved fellow servant, who is a faithful minister of Christ on our behalf,
aov_text: soos julle ook geleer het van Épafras, ons geliefde mededienskneg, wat ’n getroue dienaar van Christus vir julle is,

kjv_text: Who also declared unto us your love in the Spirit.
bsb_text: and who also informed us of your love in the Spirit.
aov_text: wat ook julle liefde in die Gees aan ons te kenne gegee het.

kjv_text: For this cause we also, since the day we heard it, do not cease to pray for you, and to desire that ye might be filled with the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding;
bsb_text: For this reason, since the day we heard about you, we have not stopped praying for you and asking God to fill you with the knowledge of His will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,
aov_text: Daarom hou ons ook nie op nie, van die dag af dat ons dit gehoor het, om vir julle te bid en te vra dat julle vervul mag word met die kennis van sy wil in alle wysheid en geestelike insig,

kjv_text: That ye might walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;
bsb_text: so that you may walk in a manner worthy of the Lord and may please Him in every way: bearing fruit in every good work, growing in the knowledge of God,
aov_text: sodat julle waardiglik voor die Here mag wandel om Hom in alles te behaag en julle in elke goeie werk vrug mag dra en in die kennis van God mag groei,

kjv_text: Strengthened with all might, according to his glorious power, unto all patience and longsuffering with joyfulness;
bsb_text: being strengthened with all power according to His glorious might so that you may have full endurance and patience, and joyfully
aov_text: en met alle krag bekragtig word volgens die mag van sy heerlikheid tot alle lydsaamheid en lankmoedigheid met blydskap,

kjv_text: Giving thanks unto the Father, which hath made us meet to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light:
bsb_text: giving thanks to the Father, who has qualified you to share in the inheritance of the saints in the light.
aov_text: en die Vader mag dank wat ons bekwaam gemaak het om deel te hê aan die erfdeel van die heiliges in die lig  —

kjv_text: Who hath delivered us from the power of darkness, and hath translated us into the kingdom of his dear Son:
bsb_text: He has rescued us from the dominion of darkness and brought us into the kingdom of His beloved Son,
aov_text: Hy wat ons verlos het uit die mag van die duisternis en oorgebring het in die koninkryk van die Seun van sy liefde,

kjv_text: In whom we have redemption through his blood, even the forgiveness of sins:
bsb_text: in whom we have redemption, the forgiveness of sins.
aov_text: in wie ons die verlossing het deur sy bloed, naamlik die vergifnis van die sondes.

kjv_text: Who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature:
bsb_text: The Son is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn over all creation.
aov_text: Hy is die Beeld van die onsienlike God, die Eersgeborene van die hele skepping;

kjv_text: For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him:
bsb_text: For in Him all things were created, things in heaven and on earth, visible and invisible, whether thrones or dominions or rulers or authorities. All things were created through Him and for Him.
aov_text: want in Hom is alle dinge geskape wat in die hemele en op die aarde is, wat sienlik en onsienlik is, trone sowel as heerskappye en owerhede en magte — alle dinge is deur Hom en tot Hom geskape.

kjv_text: And he is before all things, and by him all things consist.
bsb_text: He is before all things, and in Him all things hold together.
aov_text: En Hy is voor alle dinge, en in Hom hou alle dinge stand.

kjv_text: And he is the head of the body, the church: who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.
bsb_text: And He is the head of the body, the church; He is the beginning and firstborn from among the dead, so that in all things He may have preeminence.
aov_text: En Hy is die Hoof van die liggaam, naamlik die gemeente; Hy wat die begin is, die Eersgeborene uit die dode, sodat Hy in alles die eerste kan wees.

kjv_text: For it pleased the Father that in him should all fulness dwell;
bsb_text: For God was pleased to have all His fullness dwell in Him,
aov_text: Want dit het die Vader behaag dat in Hom die ganse volheid sou woon

kjv_text: And, having made peace through the blood of his cross, by him to reconcile all things unto himself; by him, I say, whether they be things in earth, or things in heaven.
bsb_text: and through Him to reconcile to Himself all things, whether things on earth or things in heaven, by making peace through the blood of His cross.
aov_text: en dat Hy deur Hom alles met Homself sou versoen nadat Hy vrede gemaak het deur die bloed van sy kruis — ek sê deur Hom — die dinge op die aarde sowel as die dinge in die hemele.

kjv_text: And you, that were sometime alienated and enemies in your mind by wicked works, yet now hath he reconciled
bsb_text: Once you were alienated from God and were hostile in your minds, engaging in evil deeds.
aov_text: Ook julle wat vroeër vervreemd was en vyandig gesind deur die bose werke, het Hy nou versoen

kjv_text: In the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and unblameable and unreproveable in his sight:
bsb_text: But now He has reconciled you by Christ’s physical body through death to present you holy, unblemished, and blameless in His presence—
aov_text: in die liggaam van sy vlees deur die dood, om julle heilig en sonder gebrek en onberispelik voor Hom te stel;

kjv_text: If ye continue in the faith grounded and settled, and be not moved away from the hope of the gospel, which ye have heard, and which was preached to every creature which is under heaven; whereof I Paul am made a minister;
bsb_text: if indeed you continue in your faith, established and firm, not moved from the hope of the gospel you heard, which has been proclaimed to every creature under heaven, and of which I, Paul, have become a servant.
aov_text: as julle ten minste gegrond en vas bly in die geloof en julle nie laat afbring van die hoop van die evangelie nie, wat julle gehoor het en wat verkondig is in die ganse mensdom onder die hemel, waarvan ek, Paulus, ’n dienaar geword het.

kjv_text: Who now rejoice in my sufferings for you, and fill up that which is behind of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body's sake, which is the church:
bsb_text: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for you, and I fill up in my flesh what is lacking in regard to Christ’s afflictions for the sake of His body, which is the church.
aov_text: NOU verbly ek my in my lyding vir julle en vul in my vlees aan die oorblyfsels van die verdrukkinge van Christus vir sy liggaam, wat die gemeente is;

kjv_text: Whereof I am made a minister, according to the dispensation of God which is given to me for you, to fulfil the word of God;
bsb_text: I became its servant by the commission God gave me to fully proclaim to you the word of God,
aov_text: waarvan ek ’n dienaar geword het volgens die bediening van God wat aan my gegee is in julle belang, om die woord van God te vervul,

kjv_text: Even the mystery which hath been hid from ages and from generations, but now is made manifest to his saints:
bsb_text: the mystery that was hidden for ages and generations but is now revealed to His saints.
aov_text: naamlik die verborgenheid wat van die eeue en geslagte af verborge was, maar nou geopenbaar is aan sy heiliges,

kjv_text: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:
bsb_text: To them God has chosen to make known among the Gentiles the glorious riches of this mystery, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.
aov_text: aan wie God wou bekend maak wat die rykdom van die heerlikheid van hierdie verborgenheid onder die heidene is, dit is Christus onder julle, die hoop van die heerlikheid.

kjv_text: Whom we preach, warning every man, and teaching every man in all wisdom; that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus:
bsb_text: We proclaim Him, admonishing and teaching everyone with all wisdom, so that we may present everyone perfect in Christ.
aov_text: Hom verkondig ons, terwyl ons elke mens vermaan en elke mens in alle wysheid onderrig, om elke mens volmaak in Christus Jesus voor te stel;

kjv_text: Whereunto I also labour, striving according to his working, which worketh in me mightily.
bsb_text: To this end I also labor, striving with all His energy working powerfully within me.
aov_text: waarvoor ek arbei en stry volgens sy werking wat in my werk met krag.

kjv_text: For I would that ye knew what great conflict I have for you, and for them at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;
bsb_text: For I want you to know how much I am struggling for you and for those at Laodicea, and for all who have not met me face to face,
aov_text: WANT ek wil hê dat julle moet weet wat ’n groot stryd ek oor julle het, en oor die wat in Laodicéa is en almal wat my aangesig in die vlees nie gesien het nie,

kjv_text: That their hearts might be comforted, being knit together in love, and unto all riches of the full assurance of understanding, to the acknowledgement of the mystery of God, and of the Father, and of Christ;
bsb_text: that they may be encouraged in heart, knit together in love, and filled with the full riches of complete understanding, so that they may know the mystery of God, namely Christ,
aov_text: dat hulle harte vertroos mag word, deurdat hulle saamgevoeg word in die liefde en tot alle rykdom van die volle versekerdheid van insig, om die verborgenheid te leer ken van God en die Vader en van Christus,

kjv_text: In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.
bsb_text: in whom are hidden all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.
aov_text: in wie al die skatte van wysheid en kennis verborge is.

kjv_text: And this I say, lest any man should beguile you with enticing words.
bsb_text: I say this so that no one will deceive you by smooth rhetoric.
aov_text: DIT sê ek, sodat niemand julle mag verlei met drogredes nie.

kjv_text: For though I be absent in the flesh, yet am I with you in the spirit, joying and beholding your order, and the stedfastness of your faith in Christ.
bsb_text: For although I am absent from you in body, I am present with you in spirit, and I delight to see your orderly condition and firm faith in Christ.
aov_text: Want al is ek ook na die vlees afwesig, tog is ek by julle in die gees, en ek verbly my om julle goeie orde te sien en die vastigheid van julle geloof in Christus.

kjv_text: As ye have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk ye in him:
bsb_text: Therefore, just as you have received Christ Jesus as Lord, continue to walk in Him,
aov_text: Soos julle dan Christus Jesus, die Here, aangeneem het, wandel so in Hom,

kjv_text: Rooted and built up in him, and stablished in the faith, as ye have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving.
bsb_text: rooted and built up in Him, established in the faith as you were taught, and overflowing with thankfulness.
aov_text: gewortel en opgebou in Hom en bevestig in die geloof, soos julle geleer is, terwyl julle daarin oorvloedig is in danksegging.

kjv_text: Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.
bsb_text: See to it that no one takes you captive through philosophy and empty deception, which are based on human tradition and the spiritual forces of the world rather than on Christ.
aov_text: Pas op dat niemand julle as ’n buit wegvoer deur die wysbegeerte en nietige misleiding nie, volgens die oorlewering van die mense, volgens die eerste beginsels van die wêreld en nie volgens Christus nie.

kjv_text: For in him dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead bodily.
bsb_text: For in Christ all the fullness of the Deity dwells in bodily form.
aov_text: Want in Hom woon al die volheid van die Godheid liggaamlik;

kjv_text: And ye are complete in him, which is the head of all principality and power:
bsb_text: And you have been made complete in Christ, who is the head over every ruler and authority.
aov_text: en julle het die volheid in Hom wat die Hoof is van alle owerheid en mag;

kjv_text: In whom also ye are circumcised with the circumcision made without hands, in putting off the body of the sins of the flesh by the circumcision of Christ:
bsb_text: In Him you were also circumcised, in the putting off of your sinful nature, with the circumcision performed by Christ and not by human hands.
aov_text: in wie julle ook besny is met ’n besnydenis wat nie met hande verrig word nie, deur die liggaam van die sondige vlees af te lê in die besnydenis van Christus,

kjv_text: Buried with him in baptism, wherein also ye are risen with him through the faith of the operation of God, who hath raised him from the dead.
bsb_text: And having been buried with Him in baptism, you were raised with Him through your faith in the power of God, who raised Him from the dead.
aov_text: omdat julle saam met Hom begrawe is in die doop, waarin julle ook saam opgewek is deur die geloof in die werking van God wat Hom uit die dode opgewek het.

bsb_text: When you were dead in your trespasses and in the uncircumcision of your sinful nature, God made you alive with Christ. He forgave us all our trespasses,
aov_text: En julle, wat dood was deur die misdade en die onbesnedenheid van julle vlees, het Hy saam met Hom lewend gemaak deurdat Hy julle al die misdade vergeef het,

bsb_text: having canceled the debt ascribed to us in the decrees that stood against us. He took it away, nailing it to the cross!
aov_text: en die skuldbrief teen ons, wat met sy insettinge ons vyandig was, uitgedelg en weggeruim het deur dit aan die kruis vas te nael,

aov_text: nadat Hy die owerhede en magte uitgeklee en hulle in die openbaar tentoongestel en daardeur oor hulle getriomfeer het.

kjv_text: Let no man therefore judge you in meat, or in drink, or in respect of an holyday, or of the new moon, or of the sabbath days:
bsb_text: Therefore let no one judge you by what you eat or drink, or with regard to a feast, a New Moon, or a Sabbath.
aov_text: Laat niemand julle dan oordeel in spys of in drank of met betrekking tot ’n fees of nuwemaan of sabbat nie,

kjv_text: Which are a shadow of things to come; but the body is of Christ.

aov_text: wat ’n skaduwee is van die toekomstige dinge; maar die liggaam behoort aan Christus.

kjv_text: Let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshipping of angels, intruding into those things which he hath not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,

aov_text: Laat niemand julle van jul prys beroof nie, al sou hy behae hê in nederigheid en verering van die engele en indring in wat hy nie gesien het nie, en sonder oorsaak opgeblase wees deur sy vleeslike gesindheid,

kjv_text: And not holding the Head, from which all the body by joints and bands having nourishment ministered, and knit together, increaseth with the increase of God.
bsb_text: He has lost connection to the head, from whom the whole body, supported and knit together by its joints and ligaments, grows as God causes it to grow.
aov_text: en nie vashou aan die Hoof nie, uit wie die hele liggaam deur die gewrigte en verbindinge ondersteuning ontvang en saamgebind word en so met goddelike groei groot word.

kjv_text: Wherefore if ye be dead with Christ from the rudiments of the world, why, as though living in the world, are ye subject to ordinances,
bsb_text: If you have died with Christ to the spiritual forces of the world, why, as though you still belonged to the world, do you submit to its regulations:
aov_text: As julle dan saam met Christus die eerste beginsels van die wêreld afgesterf het, waarom is julle, asof julle nog in die wêreld lewe, onderworpe aan insettinge

kjv_text: (Touch not; taste not; handle not;
bsb_text: “Do not handle, do not taste, do not touch!”?
aov_text: soos: raak nie, smaak nie, roer nie aan nie?  —

bsb_text: These will all perish with use, because they are based on human commands and teachings.
aov_text: almal dinge wat deur die gebruik bestem is om te vergaan — volgens die gebooie en leringe van mense,

kjv_text: Which things have indeed a shew of wisdom in will worship, and humility, and neglecting of the body; not in any honour to the satisfying of the flesh.
bsb_text: Such restrictions indeed have an appearance of wisdom, with their self-prescribed worship, their false humility, and their harsh treatment of the body; but they are of no value against the indulgence of the flesh.
aov_text: wat, alhoewel dit ’n skyn van wysheid het, in eiesinnige godsdiens en nederigheid en in gestrengheid teen die liggaam, geen waarde het nie, maar strek tot versadiging van die vlees.

kjv_text: If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sitteth on the right hand of God.
bsb_text: Therefore, since you have been raised with Christ, strive for the things above, where Christ is seated at the right hand of God.
aov_text: AS julle dan saam met Christus opgewek is, soek die dinge daarbo waar Christus is en aan die regterhand van God sit.

kjv_text: Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.
bsb_text: Set your minds on things above, not on earthly things.
aov_text: Bedink die dinge wat daarbo is, nie wat op die aarde is nie.

kjv_text: For ye are dead, and your life is hid with Christ in God.
bsb_text: For you died, and your life is now hidden with Christ in God.
aov_text: Want julle het gesterwe, en julle lewe is saam met Christus verborge in God.

kjv_text: When Christ, who is our life, shall appear, then shall ye also appear with him in glory.
bsb_text: When Christ, who is your life, appears, then you also will appear with Him in glory.
aov_text: Wanneer Christus, wat ons lewe is, geopenbaar word, dan sal julle ook saam met Hom in heerlikheid geopenbaar word.

kjv_text: Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth; fornication, uncleanness, inordinate affection, evil concupiscence, and covetousness, which is idolatry:
bsb_text: Put to death, therefore, the components of your earthly nature: sexual immorality, impurity, lust, evil desires, and greed, which is idolatry.
aov_text: Maak dood dan julle lede wat op die aarde is, naamlik hoerery, onreinheid, hartstog, slegte begeertes en gierigheid, wat afgodediens is,

kjv_text: For which things' sake the wrath of God cometh on the children of disobedience:
bsb_text: Because of these, the wrath of God is coming on the sons of disobedience.
aov_text: waardeur die toorn van God oor die kinders van die ongehoorsaamheid kom,

kjv_text: In the which ye also walked some time, when ye lived in them.
bsb_text: When you lived among them, you also used to walk in these ways.
aov_text: waarin julle ook vroeër gewandel het toe julle daarin geleef het.

kjv_text: But now ye also put off all these; anger, wrath, malice, blasphemy, filthy communication out of your mouth.
bsb_text: But now you must put aside all such things as these: anger, rage, malice, slander, and filthy language from your lips.
aov_text: Maar nou moet julle ook dit alles aflê, naamlik toorn, woede, boosheid, laster, skandelike taal uit julle mond.

kjv_text: Lie not one to another, seeing that ye have put off the old man with his deeds;
bsb_text: Do not lie to one another, since you have taken off the old self with its practices,
aov_text: Lieg nie vir mekaar nie, omdat julle die oue mens met sy werke afgelê het

kjv_text: And have put on the new man, which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him:
bsb_text: and have put on the new self, which is being renewed in knowledge in the image of its Creator.
aov_text: en julle jul met die nuwe mens beklee het wat vernuwe word tot kennis na die beeld van sy Skepper,

kjv_text: Where there is neither Greek nor Jew, circumcision nor uncircumcision, Barbarian, Scythian, bond nor free: but Christ is all, and in all.
bsb_text: Here there is no Greek or Jew, circumcised or uncircumcised, barbarian, Scythian, slave, or free, but Christ is all and is in all.
aov_text: waar daar nie Griek en Jood, besnedene en onbesnedene, barbaar, Scith, slaaf, vryman is nie, maar Christus is alles en in almal.

kjv_text: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;
bsb_text: Therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, clothe yourselves with hearts of compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience.
aov_text: Beklee julle dan, as uitverkorenes van God, heiliges en geliefdes, met innerlike ontferming, goedertierenheid, nederigheid, sagmoedigheid, lankmoedigheid.

kjv_text: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.
bsb_text: Bear with one another and forgive any complaint you may have against someone else. Forgive as the Lord forgave you.
aov_text: Verdra mekaar en vergewe mekaar as die een teen die ander ’n klag het; soos Christus julle vergeef het, so moet julle ook doen.

kjv_text: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.
bsb_text: And over all these virtues put on love, which is the bond of perfect unity.
aov_text: En beklee julle bo dit alles met die liefde wat die band van die volmaaktheid is.

kjv_text: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.
bsb_text: Let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, for to this you were called as members of one body. And be thankful.
aov_text: En laat die vrede van God, waartoe julle ook in een liggaam geroep is, in julle harte heers, en wees dankbaar.

kjv_text: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.
bsb_text: Let the word of Christ richly dwell within you as you teach and admonish one another with all wisdom, and as you sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs with gratitude in your hearts to God.
aov_text: Laat die woord van Christus ryklik in julle woon in alle wysheid. Leer en vermaan mekaar met psalms en lofsange en geestelike liedere, en sing in julle hart met dankbaarheid tot eer van die Here.

kjv_text: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.
bsb_text: And whatever you do, in word or deed, do it all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through Him.
aov_text: En wat julle ook al doen in woord of in daad, doen alles in die Naam van die Here Jesus en dank God die Vader deur Hom.

kjv_text: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as it is fit in the Lord.
bsb_text: Wives, submit to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.
aov_text: VROUE, wees julle mans onderdanig soos dit betaamlik is in die Here.

kjv_text: Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them.
bsb_text: Husbands, love your wives and do not be harsh with them.
aov_text: Manne, julle moet jul vroue liefhê en nie teen hulle verbitter word nie.

kjv_text: Children, obey your parents in all things: for this is well pleasing unto the Lord.
bsb_text: Children, obey your parents in everything, for this is pleasing to the Lord.
aov_text: Kinders, julle moet jul ouers in alles gehoorsaam wees, want dit is die Here welbehaaglik.

kjv_text: Fathers, provoke not your children to anger, lest they be discouraged.

aov_text: Vaders, moenie julle kinders terg nie, sodat hulle nie moedeloos word nie.

kjv_text: Servants, obey in all things your masters according to the flesh; not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but in singleness of heart, fearing God:
bsb_text: Slaves, obey your earthly masters in everything, not only to please them while they are watching, but with sincerity of heart and fear of the Lord.
aov_text: Diensknegte, julle moet jul here na die vlees in alles gehoorsaam wees, nie met oëdiens soos mensebehaers nie, maar in eenvoudigheid van hart, omdat julle God vrees.

kjv_text: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;
bsb_text: Whatever you do, work at it with your whole being, for the Lord and not for men,
aov_text: En wat julle ook al doen, doen dit van harte soos vir die Here en nie vir mense nie,

kjv_text: Knowing that of the Lord ye shall receive the reward of the inheritance: for ye serve the Lord Christ.
bsb_text: because you know that you will receive an inheritance from the Lord as your reward. It is the Lord Christ you are serving.
aov_text: omdat julle weet dat julle van die Here die erfenis as vergelding sal ontvang, want julle dien die Here Christus.

bsb_text: Whoever does wrong will be repaid for his wrong, and there is no favoritism.

aov_text: VOLHARD in die gebed en waak daarin met danksegging;

kjv_text: Withal praying also for us, that God would open unto us a door of utterance, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds:

aov_text: saam met Onésimus, die getroue en geliefde broeder wat van julle mense is. Hulle sal julle alles bekend maak wat hier voorval.

bsb_text: My fellow prisoner Aristarchus sends you greetings, as does Mark the cousin of Barnabas. You have already received instructions about him: If he comes to you, welcome him.
aov_text: Aristárchus, my medegevangene, groet julle; en Markus, die neef van Bárnabas, oor wie julle bevele ontvang het — as hy by julle kom, ontvang hom  —

kjv_text: For I bear him record, that he hath a great zeal for you, and them that are in Laodicea, and them in Hierapolis.

kjv_text: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas, greet you.

kjv_text: Salute the brethren which are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the church which is in his house.
bsb_text: Greet the brothers in Laodicea, as well as Nympha and the church that meets at her house.
aov_text: Groet die broeders in Laodicéa en Nimfas en die gemeente wat in sy huis is.

kjv_text: And when this epistle is read among you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans; and that ye likewise read the epistle from Laodicea.
bsb_text: After this letter has been read among you, make sure that it is also read in the church of the Laodiceans, and that you in turn read the letter from Laodicea.

kjv_text: And say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in the Lord, that thou fulfil it.
bsb_text: Tell Archippus: “See to it that you complete the ministry you have received in the Lord.”
aov_text: En sê aan Archíppus: Gee ag op die bediening wat jy ontvang het in die Here, dat jy dit vervul.

kjv_text: The salutation by the hand of me Paul. Remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen.
bsb_text: This greeting is in my own hand—Paul. Remember my chains. Grace be with you.
aov_text: Die groete van Paulus, met my eie hand. Dink aan my boeie. Die genade sy met julle! Amen.

kjv_text: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians which is in God the Father and in the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
bsb_text: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace and peace to you.
aov_text: PAULUS en Silvánus en Timótheüs aan die gemeente van die Thessalonicense wat in God die Vader en die Here Jesus Christus is: Genade vir julle en vrede van God onse Vader en die Here Jesus Christus!

kjv_text: We give thanks to God always for you all, making mention of you in our prayers;
bsb_text: We always thank God for all of you, remembering you in our prayers
aov_text: ONS dank God altyd oor julle almal as ons aan julle dink in ons gebede

kjv_text: Remembering without ceasing your work of faith, and labour of love, and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, in the sight of God and our Father;
bsb_text: and continually recalling before our God and Father your work of faith, your labor of love, and your enduring hope in our Lord Jesus Christ.
aov_text: en onophoudelik in gedagte hou die werk van julle geloof en die arbeid van julle liefde en die lydsaamheid van julle hoop op onse Here Jesus Christus, voor onse God en Vader,

kjv_text: Knowing, brethren beloved, your election of God.
bsb_text: Brothers who are beloved by God, we know that He has chosen you,
aov_text: omdat ons weet van julle verkiesing, broeders wat deur God bemin word.

kjv_text: For our gospel came not unto you in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Ghost, and in much assurance; as ye know what manner of men we were among you for your sake.
bsb_text: because our gospel came to you not only in word, but also in power, in the Holy Spirit, and with great conviction—just as you know we lived among you for your sake.
aov_text: Want ons evangelie het tot julle nie gekom in woord alleen nie, maar ook in krag en in die Heilige Gees en in volle versekerdheid, soos julle weet hoedanig ons onder julle om julle ontwil gewees het.

kjv_text: And ye became followers of us, and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Ghost:
bsb_text: And you became imitators of us and of the Lord when you welcomed the message with the joy of the Holy Spirit, in spite of your great suffering.
aov_text: En julle het navolgers van ons geword en van die Here deurdat julle die woord in baie verdrukking ontvang het met die blydskap van die Heilige Gees,

kjv_text: So that ye were ensamples to all that believe in Macedonia and Achaia.
bsb_text: As a result, you have become an example to all the believers in Macedonia and Achaia.
aov_text: sodat julle voorbeelde geword het vir al die gelowiges in Macedónië en Acháje.

kjv_text: For from you sounded out the word of the Lord not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith to God-ward is spread abroad; so that we need not to speak any thing.
bsb_text: For not only did the message of the Lord ring out from you to Macedonia and Achaia, but your faith in God has gone out to every place, so that we have no need to say anything more.
aov_text: Want van julle uit het die woord van die Here weerklink nie alleen in Macedónië en Acháje nie, maar ook op elke plek het julle geloof in God uitgegaan, sodat ons nie nodig het om daar iets van te sê nie.

kjv_text: For they themselves shew of us what manner of entering in we had unto you, and how ye turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God;
bsb_text: For they themselves report what kind of welcome you gave us, and how you turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God
aov_text: Want hulle vertel self aangaande ons watter ingang ons by julle gehad het en hoe julle jul van die afgode bekeer het tot God, om die lewende en waaragtige God te dien

kjv_text: And to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead, even Jesus, which delivered us from the wrath to come.
bsb_text: and to await His Son from heaven, whom He raised from the dead—Jesus our deliverer from the coming wrath.
aov_text: en sy Seun uit die hemele te verwag, wat Hy uit die dode opgewek het, Jesus wat ons van die toekomstige toorn verlos.

kjv_text: For yourselves, brethren, know our entrance in unto you, that it was not in vain:
bsb_text: You yourselves know, brothers, that our visit to you was not in vain.
aov_text: JULLE weet tog self, broeders, dat ons ingang by julle nie tevergeefs was nie;

kjv_text: But even after that we had suffered before, and were shamefully entreated, as ye know, at Philippi, we were bold in our God to speak unto you the gospel of God with much contention.
bsb_text: As you are aware, we had already endured suffering and shameful treatment in Philippi. But in the face of strong opposition, we were bold in our God to speak to you the gospel of God.
aov_text: maar alhoewel ons vantevore, soos julle weet, in Filíppi gely het en mishandel is, het ons in onse God vrymoedigheid gehad om aan julle die evangelie van God te verkondig onder veel stryd.

kjv_text: For our exhortation was not of deceit, nor of uncleanness, nor in guile:
bsb_text: For our appeal does not arise from deceit or ulterior motives or trickery.
aov_text: Want ons vermaning was nie uit dwaling of uit onsuiwerheid of uit bedrog nie;

kjv_text: But as we were allowed of God to be put in trust with the gospel, even so we speak; not as pleasing men, but God, which trieth our hearts.
bsb_text: Instead, we speak as those approved by God to be entrusted with the gospel, not in order to please men but God, who examines our hearts.
aov_text: maar soos ons deur God waardig geag is dat die evangelie aan ons toevertrou sou word, so spreek ons, nie om mense te behaag nie, maar God wat ons harte beproef.

kjv_text: For neither at any time used we flattering words, as ye know, nor a cloke of covetousness; God is witness:
bsb_text: As you know, we never used words of flattery or any pretext for greed. God is our witness!
aov_text: Want ons het, soos julle weet, ons nooit met vleitaal opgehou of met bedekte hebsug nie. God is getuie.

kjv_text: Nor of men sought we glory, neither of you, nor yet of others, when we might have been burdensome, as the apostles of Christ.
bsb_text: Nor did we seek praise from you or from anyone else, although as apostles of Christ we had authority to demand it.
aov_text: Ook het ons nie eer van mense, òf van julle òf van ander gesoek nie, al kon ons as apostels van Christus met gesag optree.

kjv_text: But we were gentle among you, even as a nurse cherisheth her children:
bsb_text: On the contrary, we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother caring for her children.
aov_text: Maar ons was vriendelik onder julle soos ’n pleegmoeder haar kinders koester.

kjv_text: So being affectionately desirous of you, we were willing to have imparted unto you, not the gospel of God only, but also our own souls, because ye were dear unto us.
bsb_text: We cared so deeply that we were delighted to share with you not only the gospel of God, but our own lives as well. That is how beloved you have become to us.
aov_text: Terwyl ons so na julle verlang het, was dit ons aangenaam om aan julle nie alleen die evangelie van God mee te deel nie, maar ook ons eie lewe, omdat julle vir ons dierbaar geword het.

kjv_text: For ye remember, brethren, our labour and travail: for labouring night and day, because we would not be chargeable unto any of you, we preached unto you the gospel of God.
bsb_text: Surely you recall, brothers, our labor and toil. We worked night and day so that we would not be a burden to anyone while we proclaimed to you the gospel of God.
aov_text: Julle onthou tog, broeders, ons arbeid en inspanning; want terwyl ons nag en dag gewerk het om niemand van julle te beswaar nie, het ons die evangelie van God aan julle verkondig.

kjv_text: Ye are witnesses, and God also, how holily and justly and unblameably we behaved ourselves among you that believe:
bsb_text: You are witnesses, and so is God, of how holy, righteous, and blameless our conduct was among you who believed.
aov_text: Julle is getuies, en God, hoe heilig en regverdig en onberispelik ons ons gedra het teenoor julle wat glo,

kjv_text: As ye know how we exhorted and comforted and charged every one of you, as a father doth his children,
bsb_text: For you know that we treated each of you as a father treats his own children—
aov_text: hoe ons, soos julle weet, net soos ’n vader sy kinders, elkeen van julle vermaan en bemoedig het

kjv_text: That ye would walk worthy of God, who hath called you unto his kingdom and glory.
bsb_text: encouraging you, comforting you, and urging you to walk in a manner worthy of God, who calls you into His own kingdom and glory.
aov_text: en betuig het dat julle waardiglik moet wandel voor God wat julle tot sy koninkryk en heerlikheid roep.

kjv_text: For this cause also thank we God without ceasing, because, when ye received the word of God which ye heard of us, ye received it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, the word of God, which effectually worketh also in you that believe.
bsb_text: And we continually thank God because, when you received the word of God that you heard from us, you accepted it not as the word of men, but as the true word of God—the word which is now at work in you who believe.
aov_text: Daarom dank ons God ook sonder ophou dat, toe julle die woord van God ontvang het wat deur ons verkondig is, julle dit aangeneem het nie as die woord van mense nie, maar, soos dit waarlik is, as die woord van God wat ook werk in julle wat glo.

kjv_text: For ye, brethren, became followers of the churches of God which in Judaea are in Christ Jesus: for ye also have suffered like things of your own countrymen, even as they have of the Jews:
bsb_text: For you, brothers, became imitators of the churches of God in Judea that are in Christ Jesus. You suffered from your own countrymen the very things they suffered from the Jews,
aov_text: Want julle, broeders, het navolgers geword van die gemeentes van God wat in Christus Jesus is in Judéa, omdat julle ook dieselfde dinge gely het van julle eie stamgenote net soos hulle van die Jode,

kjv_text: Who both killed the Lord Jesus, and their own prophets, and have persecuted us; and they please not God, and are contrary to all men:
bsb_text: who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets, and drove us out as well. They are displeasing to God and hostile to all men,
aov_text: wat ook die Here Jesus en hulle eie profete gedood en ons vervolg het en God nie behaag nie en teen alle mense gekant is,

kjv_text: Forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they might be saved, to fill up their sins alway: for the wrath is come upon them to the uttermost.
bsb_text: hindering us from telling the Gentiles how they may be saved. As a result, they continue to heap up their sins to full capacity; the utmost wrath has come upon them.
aov_text: deurdat hulle ons verhinder om tot die heidene te spreek dat hulle gered kan word, sodat hulle die maat van hulle sondes gedurig vol kan maak. Maar die toorn het oor hulle gekom tot die einde toe.

kjv_text: But we, brethren, being taken from you for a short time in presence, not in heart, endeavoured the more abundantly to see your face with great desire.
bsb_text: Brothers, although we were torn away from you for a short time (in person, not in heart), our desire to see you face to face was even more intense.
aov_text: MAAR nadat ons, broeders, ’n kort tydjie van julle geskeie was — in persoon, nie met die hart nie — het ons met groot verlange ons des te meer beywer om julle aangesig te sien.

kjv_text: Wherefore we would have come unto you, even I Paul, once and again; but Satan hindered us.
bsb_text: For we wanted to come to you—indeed I, Paul, tried again and again—but Satan obstructed us.
aov_text: Daarom wou ons na julle toe kom, ek Paulus, meer as een maal; maar die Satan het ons verhinder.

kjv_text: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Are not even ye in the presence of our Lord Jesus Christ at his coming?
bsb_text: After all, who is our hope, our joy, our crown of boasting, if it is not you yourselves in the presence of our Lord Jesus at His coming?
aov_text: Want wie anders as julle is ons hoop of blydskap of kroon van roem in die teenwoordigheid van onse Here Jesus Christus by sy wederkoms?

kjv_text: For ye are our glory and joy.
bsb_text: You are indeed our glory and our joy.
aov_text: Want julle is ons eer en blydskap.

kjv_text: Wherefore when we could no longer forbear, we thought it good to be left at Athens alone;
bsb_text: So when we could bear it no longer, we were willing to be left on our own in Athens.
aov_text: DAAROM, toe ons dit nie langer kon uithou nie, het ons besluit om in Athéne alleen agter te bly;

kjv_text: And sent Timotheus, our brother, and minister of God, and our fellowlabourer in the gospel of Christ, to establish you, and to comfort you concerning your faith:
bsb_text: We sent Timothy, our brother and fellow worker for God in the gospel of Christ, to strengthen and encourage you in your faith,
aov_text: en ons het Timótheüs, ons broeder en dienaar van God en ons medewerker in die evangelie van Christus, gestuur om julle te versterk en julle te bemoedig in julle geloof,

kjv_text: That no man should be moved by these afflictions: for yourselves know that we are appointed thereunto.
bsb_text: so that none of you would be shaken by these trials. For you know that we are destined for this.
aov_text: sodat niemand verontrus mag word onder hierdie verdrukkinge nie; want julle weet self dat ons hiervoor bestemd is.

kjv_text: For verily, when we were with you, we told you before that we should suffer tribulation; even as it came to pass, and ye know.
bsb_text: Indeed, when we were with you, we kept warning you that we would suffer persecution; and as you know, it has come to pass.
aov_text: Want ook toe ons by julle was, het ons julle vooruit gesê dat ons verdruk sou word, soos dit ook gebeur het en soos julle weet.

kjv_text: For this cause, when I could no longer forbear, I sent to know your faith, lest by some means the tempter have tempted you, and our labour be in vain.
bsb_text: For this reason, when I could bear it no longer, I sent to find out about your faith, for fear that the tempter had somehow tempted you and caused our labor to be in vain.
aov_text: Daarom, toe ek dit nie langer kon uithou nie, het ek ook gestuur om julle geloof te wete te kom, of die versoeker julle nie miskien versoek het en ons arbeid tevergeefs sou wees nie.

kjv_text: But now when Timotheus came from you unto us, and brought us good tidings of your faith and charity, and that ye have good remembrance of us always, desiring greatly to see us, as we also to see you:
bsb_text: But just now, Timothy has returned from his visit with the good news about your faith, your love, and the fond memories you have preserved, longing to see us just as we long to see you.
aov_text: Maar nou dat Timótheüs net van julle af by ons aangekom het en ons die goeie tyding van julle geloof en liefde gebring het, en dat julle altyd ’n goeie herinnering aan ons behou en verlang om ons te sien, net soos ons ook vir julle  —

kjv_text: Therefore, brethren, we were comforted over you in all our affliction and distress by your faith:
bsb_text: For this reason, brothers, in all our distress and persecution, we have been reassured about you, because of your faith.
aov_text: daarom, broeders, is ons in al ons verdrukking en nood vertroos oor julle deur jul geloof.

kjv_text: For now we live, if ye stand fast in the Lord.
bsb_text: For now we can go on living, as long as you are standing firm in the Lord.
aov_text: Want nou leef ons, as julle vasstaan in die Here.

kjv_text: For what thanks can we render to God again for you, for all the joy wherewith we joy for your sakes before our God;
bsb_text: How can we adequately thank God for you in return for our great joy over you in His presence?
aov_text: Want watter dank kan ons God vergelde oor julle vir al die blydskap waarmee ons om julle ontwil ons verbly voor onse God,

kjv_text: Night and day praying exceedingly that we might see your face, and might perfect that which is lacking in your faith?
bsb_text: Night and day we pray most earnestly that we may see you face to face and supply what is lacking from your faith.
aov_text: terwyl ons nag en dag baie ernstig bid om julle aangesig te sien en te voltooi wat aan julle geloof ontbreek?

kjv_text: Now God himself and our Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way unto you.
bsb_text: Now may our God and Father Himself, and our Lord Jesus, direct our way to you.
aov_text: Maar mag onse God en Vader self en onse Here Jesus Christus ons weg na julle toe rig;

kjv_text: And the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all men, even as we do toward you:
bsb_text: And may the Lord cause you to increase and overflow with love for one another and for everyone else, just as our love for you overflows,
aov_text: en mag die Here julle ryk en oorvloedig maak in liefde vir mekaar en vir almal, soos ons ook teenoor julle is,

kjv_text: To the end he may stablish your hearts unblameable in holiness before God, even our Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ with all his saints.
bsb_text: so that He may establish your hearts in blamelessness and holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all His saints. Amen.
aov_text: sodat Hy julle harte kan versterk om onberispelik te wees in heiligheid voor onse God en Vader by die wederkoms van onse Here Jesus Christus met al sy heiliges.

kjv_text: Furthermore then we beseech you, brethren, and exhort you by the Lord Jesus, that as ye have received of us how ye ought to walk and to please God, so ye would abound more and more.
bsb_text: Finally, brothers, we ask and encourage you in the Lord Jesus to live in a way that is pleasing to God, just as you have received from us. This is how you already live, so you should do so all the more.
aov_text: VERDER dan, broeders, vra en vermaan ons julle in die Here Jesus dat julle, soos julle van ons geleer het hoe julle moet wandel en God behaag, nog oorvloediger mag wees.

kjv_text: For ye know what commandments we gave you by the Lord Jesus.
bsb_text: For you know the instructions we gave you by the authority of the Lord Jesus.
aov_text: Want julle weet watter bevele ons julle deur die Here Jesus gegee het.

kjv_text: For this is the will of God, even your sanctification, that ye should abstain from fornication:
bsb_text: For it is God’s will that you should be holy: You must abstain from sexual immorality;
aov_text: Want dit is die wil van God: julle heiligmaking; dat julle jul moet onthou van die hoerery;

kjv_text: That every one of you should know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honour;
bsb_text: each of you must know how to control his own body in holiness and honor,
aov_text: dat elkeen van julle moet weet om sy eie vrou te verkry in heiligheid en eer,

kjv_text: Not in the lust of concupiscence, even as the Gentiles which know not God:
bsb_text: not in lustful passion like the Gentiles who do not know God;
aov_text: nie in hartstogtelike begeerlikheid soos die heidene wat God nie ken nie;

kjv_text: That no man go beyond and defraud his brother in any matter: because that the Lord is the avenger of all such, as we also have forewarned you and testified.
bsb_text: and no one should ever violate or exploit his brother in this regard, because the Lord will avenge all such acts, as we have already told you and solemnly warned you.
aov_text: dat niemand sy broeder in hierdie saak moet bedrieg en benadeel nie, omdat die Here ’n wreker is oor al hierdie dinge, soos ons aan julle ook vantevore gesê en betuig het.

kjv_text: For God hath not called us unto uncleanness, but unto holiness.
bsb_text: For God has not called us to impurity, but to holiness.
aov_text: Want God het ons nie tot onreinheid geroep nie, maar tot heiligmaking.

kjv_text: He therefore that despiseth, despiseth not man, but God, who hath also given unto us his holy Spirit.
bsb_text: Anyone, then, who rejects this command does not reject man but God, the very One who gives you His Holy Spirit.
aov_text: Daarom, hy wat dit verwerp, verwerp nie ’n mens nie, maar God wat ook sy Heilige Gees aan ons gegee het.

kjv_text: But as touching brotherly love ye need not that I write unto you: for ye yourselves are taught of God to love one another.
bsb_text: Now about brotherly love, you do not need anyone to write to you, because you yourselves have been taught by God to love one another.
aov_text: Oor die broederliefde het julle nie nodig dat ons julle skrywe nie, want julle is self deur God geleer om mekaar lief te hê;

kjv_text: And indeed ye do it toward all the brethren which are in all Macedonia: but we beseech you, brethren, that ye increase more and more;
bsb_text: And you are indeed showing this love to all the brothers throughout Macedonia. But we urge you, brothers, to excel more and more
aov_text: en julle doen dit ook aan al die broeders in die hele Macedónië; maar ons vermaan julle, broeders, om oorvloediger te wees

kjv_text: And that ye study to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you;
bsb_text: and to aspire to live quietly, to attend to your own matters, and to work with your own hands, as we instructed you.
aov_text: en julle eer daarin te stel om rustig te lewe en julle eie sake te behartig en met julle eie hande te werk, soos ons julle beveel het,

kjv_text: That ye may walk honestly toward them that are without, and that ye may have lack of nothing.
bsb_text: Then you will behave properly toward outsiders, without being dependent on anyone.
aov_text: sodat julle welvoeglik kan wandel teenoor die wat buite is, en aan niks behoefte mag hê nie.

kjv_text: But I would not have you to be ignorant, brethren, concerning them which are asleep, that ye sorrow not, even as others which have no hope.
bsb_text: Brothers, we do not want you to be uninformed about those who sleep in death, so that you will not grieve like the rest, who are without hope.
aov_text: MAAR, broeders, ek wil nie hê dat julle onkundig moet wees met betrekking tot die ontslapenes nie, sodat julle nie treur soos die ander wat geen hoop het nie.

kjv_text: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so them also which sleep in Jesus will God bring with him.
bsb_text: For since we believe that Jesus died and rose again, we also believe that God will bring with Jesus those who have fallen asleep in Him.
aov_text: Want as ons glo dat Jesus gesterwe en opgestaan het, dan sal God ook so die wat in Jesus ontslaap het, saam met Hom bring.

kjv_text: For this we say unto you by the word of the Lord, that we which are alive and remain unto the coming of the Lord shall not prevent them which are asleep.
bsb_text: By the word of the Lord, we declare to you that we who are alive and remain until the coming of the Lord will by no means precede those who have fallen asleep.
aov_text: Want dit sê ons vir julle deur die woord van die Here, dat ons wat in die lewe oorbly tot by die wederkoms van die Here, die ontslapenes hoegenaamd nie sal vóór wees nie.

kjv_text: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first:
bsb_text: For the Lord Himself will descend from heaven with a loud command, with the voice of an archangel, and with the trumpet of God, and the dead in Christ will be the first to rise.
aov_text: Want die Here self sal van die hemel neerdaal met ’n geroep, met die stem van ’n aartsengel en met geklank van die basuin van God; en die wat in Christus gesterf het, sal eerste opstaan.

kjv_text: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.
bsb_text: After that, we who are alive and remain will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. And so we will always be with the Lord.
aov_text: Daarna sal ons wat in die lewe oorbly, saam met hulle in wolke weggevoer word die Here tegemoet in die lug; en so sal ons altyd by die Here wees.

kjv_text: Wherefore comfort one another with these words.
bsb_text: Therefore encourage one another with these words.
aov_text: Bemoedig mekaar dan met hierdie woorde.

kjv_text: But of the times and the seasons, brethren, ye have no need that I write unto you.
bsb_text: Now about the times and seasons, brothers, we do not need to write to you.
aov_text: MAAR oor die tye en geleenthede, broeders, het julle nie nodig dat aan julle geskryf word nie;

kjv_text: For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night.
bsb_text: For you are fully aware that the Day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night.
aov_text: want julle weet self baie goed dat die dag van die Here kom net soos ’n dief in die nag.

kjv_text: For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall not escape.
bsb_text: While people are saying, “Peace and security,” destruction will come upon them suddenly, like labor pains on a pregnant woman, and they will not escape.
aov_text: Want wanneer hulle sê: Vrede en veiligheid — dan oorval ’n skielike verderf hulle soos die barensnood ’n swanger vrou, en hulle sal sekerlik nie ontvlug nie.

kjv_text: But ye, brethren, are not in darkness, that that day should overtake you as a thief.
bsb_text: But you, brothers, are not in the darkness so that this day should overtake you like a thief.
aov_text: Maar julle, broeders, is nie in duisternis, dat die dag julle soos ’n dief sou oorval nie.

kjv_text: Ye are all the children of light, and the children of the day: we are not of the night, nor of darkness.
bsb_text: For you are all sons of the light and sons of the day; we do not belong to the night or to the darkness.
aov_text: Julle is almal kinders van die lig en kinders van die dag; ons is nie van die nag of die duisternis nie.

kjv_text: Therefore let us not sleep, as do others; but let us watch and be sober.
bsb_text: So then, let us not sleep as the others do, but let us remain awake and sober.
aov_text: Laat ons dan nie slaap soos die ander nie, maar laat ons waak en nugter wees.

kjv_text: For they that sleep sleep in the night; and they that be drunken are drunken in the night.
bsb_text: For those who sleep, sleep at night; and those who get drunk, get drunk at night.
aov_text: Want die wat slaap, slaap in die nag; en die wat dronk word, is in die nag dronk.

kjv_text: But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation.
bsb_text: But since we belong to the day, let us be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and the helmet of our hope of salvation.
aov_text: Maar laat ons wat van die dag is, nugter wees, met die borswapen van geloof en liefde aan, en as helm die hoop op die saligheid.

kjv_text: For God hath not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ,
bsb_text: For God has not appointed us to suffer wrath, but to obtain salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ.
aov_text: Want God het ons nie bestem tot toorn nie, maar om die saligheid te verkry deur onse Here Jesus Christus

kjv_text: Who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.
bsb_text: He died for us so that, whether we are awake or asleep, we may live together with Him.
aov_text: wat vir ons gesterf het, sodat ons, of ons waak en of ons slaap, saam met Hom kan lewe.

kjv_text: Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do.
bsb_text: Therefore encourage and build one another up, just as you are already doing.
aov_text: Daarom, bemoedig mekaar en bou die een die ander op, soos julle ook doen.

kjv_text: And we beseech you, brethren, to know them which labour among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you;
bsb_text: But we ask you, brothers, to acknowledge those who work diligently among you, who preside over you in the Lord and give you instruction.
aov_text: MAAR ons vra julle, broeders, erken die wat onder julle arbei en julle voorgangers in die Here is en julle vermaan;

kjv_text: And to esteem them very highly in love for their work's sake. And be at peace among yourselves.
bsb_text: In love, hold them in highest regard because of their work. Live in peace with one another.
aov_text: en bewys hulle in liefde die hoogste agting ter wille van hulle werk. Hou vrede onder mekaar.

kjv_text: Now we exhort you, brethren, warn them that are unruly, comfort the feebleminded, support the weak, be patient toward all men.
bsb_text: And we urge you, brothers, to admonish the unruly, encourage the fainthearted, help the weak, and be patient with everyone.
aov_text: En ons versoek julle, broeders, vermaan die onordelikes, bemoedig die kleinmoediges, ondersteun die swakkes, wees lankmoedig teenoor almal.

kjv_text: See that none render evil for evil unto any man; but ever follow that which is good, both among yourselves, and to all men.
bsb_text: Make sure that no one repays evil for evil. Always pursue what is good for one another and for all people.
aov_text: Sorg dat niemand ’n ander kwaad vir kwaad vergeld nie; maar jaag altyd ná wat goed is, teenoor mekaar sowel as teenoor almal.

kjv_text: Rejoice evermore.
bsb_text: Rejoice at all times.
aov_text: Wees altyddeur bly.

kjv_text: Pray without ceasing.
bsb_text: Pray without ceasing.
aov_text: Bid sonder ophou.

kjv_text: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
bsb_text: Give thanks in every circumstance, for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.
aov_text: Wees in alles dankbaar, want dit is die wil van God in Christus Jesus oor julle.

kjv_text: Quench not the Spirit.
bsb_text: Do not extinguish the Spirit.
aov_text: Blus die Gees nie uit nie.

kjv_text: Despise not prophesyings.
bsb_text: Do not treat prophecies with contempt,
aov_text: Verag die profesieë nie.

kjv_text: Prove all things; hold fast that which is good.
bsb_text: but test all things. Hold fast to what is good.
aov_text: Beproef alle dinge; behou die goeie.

kjv_text: Abstain from all appearance of evil.
bsb_text: Abstain from every form of evil.
aov_text: Onthou julle van elke vorm van kwaad.

kjv_text: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
bsb_text: Now may the God of peace Himself sanctify you completely, and may your entire spirit, soul, and body be kept blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
aov_text: En mag Hy, die God van die vrede, julle volkome heilig maak, en mag julle gees en siel en liggaam geheel en al onberispelik bewaar word by die wederkoms van onse Here Jesus Christus!

kjv_text: Faithful is he that calleth you, who also will do it.
bsb_text: The One who calls you is faithful, and He will do it.
aov_text: Hy wat julle roep, is getrou; Hy sal dit ook doen.

kjv_text: Brethren, pray for us.
bsb_text: Brothers, pray for us as well.
aov_text: Broeders, bid vir ons.

kjv_text: Greet all the brethren with an holy kiss.
bsb_text: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.
aov_text: Groet die broeders almal met ’n heilige kus.

kjv_text: I charge you by the Lord that this epistle be read unto all the holy brethren.
bsb_text: I charge you before the Lord to have this letter read to all the brothers.
aov_text: Ek besweer julle by die Here dat hierdie brief aan al die heilige broeders voorgelees word.

kjv_text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
bsb_text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
aov_text: Die genade van onse Here Jesus Christus sy met julle! Amen.

kjv_text: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
bsb_text: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
aov_text: PAULUS en Silvánus en Timótheüs aan die gemeente van die Thessalonicense in God onse Vader en die Here Jesus Christus:

kjv_text: Grace unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
bsb_text: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
aov_text: Genade vir julle en vrede van God onse Vader en die Here Jesus Christus!

kjv_text: We are bound to thank God always for you, brethren, as it is meet, because that your faith groweth exceedingly, and the charity of every one of you all toward each other aboundeth;
bsb_text: We are obligated to thank God for you all the time, brothers, as is fitting, because your faith is growing more and more, and your love for one another is increasing.
aov_text: ONS moet God altyd oor julle dank, broeders, soos dit billik is, omdat julle geloof grootliks toeneem en die wederkerige liefde van elkeen van julle almal groter word,

kjv_text: So that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that ye endure:
