kjv_text: I will therefore that men pray every where, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and doubting.
bsb_text: Therefore I want the men everywhere to pray, lifting up holy hands, without anger or dissension.
aov_text: Ek wil dan hê dat die manne op elke plek moet bid en heilige hande ophef sonder toorn en twis.

kjv_text: In like manner also, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with shamefacedness and sobriety; not with broided hair, or gold, or pearls, or costly array;
bsb_text: Likewise, I want the women to adorn themselves with respectable apparel, with modesty, and with self-control, not with braided hair or gold or pearls or expensive clothes,
aov_text: SO ook moet die vroue hulle versier met behoorlike kleding, gepaard met beskeidenheid en ingetoënheid, nie met vlegsels of goud of pêrels of kosbare klere nie,

kjv_text: But (which becometh women professing godliness) with good works.
bsb_text: but with good deeds, as is proper for women who profess to worship God.
aov_text: maar, soos dit vroue betaam wat die godsvrug bely, met goeie werke.

kjv_text: Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection.
bsb_text: A woman must learn in quietness and full submissiveness.
aov_text: Die vrou moet haar in stilte laat leer in alle onderdanigheid.

kjv_text: But I suffer not a woman to teach, nor to usurp authority over the man, but to be in silence.
bsb_text: I do not permit a woman to teach or to exercise authority over a man; she is to remain quiet.
aov_text: Ek laat die vrou egter nie toe om onderrig te gee of oor die man te heers nie, maar sy moet haar stil hou.

kjv_text: For Adam was first formed, then Eve.
bsb_text: For Adam was formed first, and then Eve.
aov_text: Want Adam is eerste gemaak, daarna Eva.

kjv_text: And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived was in the transgression.
bsb_text: And it was not Adam who was deceived, but the woman who was deceived and fell into transgression.
aov_text: En Adam is nie verlei nie, maar die vrou het haar laat verlei en het in oortreding gekom.

kjv_text: Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing, if they continue in faith and charity and holiness with sobriety.
bsb_text: Women, however, will be saved through childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and holiness, with self-control.
aov_text: Maar sy sal gered word deur kinders te baar, as hulle bly in geloof en liefde en heiligmaking, met ingetoënheid.

kjv_text: This is a true saying, If a man desire the office of a bishop, he desireth a good work.
bsb_text: This is a trustworthy saying: If anyone aspires to be an overseer, he desires a noble task.
aov_text: DIT is ’n betroubare woord: as iemand na ’n opsienersamp verlang, begeer hy ’n voortreflike werk.

kjv_text: A bishop then must be blameless, the husband of one wife, vigilant, sober, of good behaviour, given to hospitality, apt to teach;
bsb_text: An overseer, then, must be above reproach, the husband of but one wife, temperate, self-controlled, respectable, hospitable, able to teach,
aov_text: ’n Opsiener dan moet onberispelik wees, die man van een vrou, nugter, ingetoë, fatsoenlik, gasvry, bekwaam om te onderrig;

kjv_text: Not given to wine, no striker, not greedy of filthy lucre; but patient, not a brawler, not covetous;
bsb_text: not dependent on wine, not violent but gentle, peaceable, and free of the love of money.
aov_text: geen drinker, geen vegter, geen vuilgewinsoeker nie, maar vriendelik; geen strydlustige, geen geldgierige nie;

kjv_text: One that ruleth well his own house, having his children in subjection with all gravity;
bsb_text: An overseer must manage his own household well and keep his children under control, with complete dignity.
aov_text: een wat sy eie huis goed regeer en sy kinders met alle waardigheid in onderdanigheid hou.

kjv_text: (For if a man know not how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of God?)
bsb_text: For if someone does not know how to manage his own household, how can he care for the church of God?
aov_text: Maar as iemand nie weet om sy eie huis te regeer nie, hoe sal hy vir die gemeente van God sorg dra?

kjv_text: Not a novice, lest being lifted up with pride he fall into the condemnation of the devil.
bsb_text: He must not be a recent convert, or he may become conceited and fall under the same condemnation as the devil.
aov_text: Hy moet nie ’n nuweling wees nie, sodat hy nie verwaand word en in dieselfde oordeel as die duiwel val nie.

kjv_text: Moreover he must have a good report of them which are without; lest he fall into reproach and the snare of the devil.
bsb_text: Furthermore, he must have a good reputation with outsiders, so that he will not fall into disgrace and into the snare of the devil.
aov_text: Maar hy moet ook goeie getuienis hê van die buitestaanders, sodat hy nie in veragting en in die strik van die duiwel val nie.

kjv_text: Likewise must the deacons be grave, not doubletongued, not given to much wine, not greedy of filthy lucre;
bsb_text: Deacons likewise must be dignified, not double-tongued or given to much wine or greedy for money.
aov_text: Net so moet die diakens waardig wees, nie uit twee monde spreek nie, nie verslaaf aan wyn nie, geen vuilgewinsoekers nie,

kjv_text: Holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.
bsb_text: They must hold to the mystery of the faith with a clear conscience.
aov_text: manne wat die verborgenheid van die geloof in ’n rein gewete hou.

kjv_text: And let these also first be proved; then let them use the office of a deacon, being found blameless.
bsb_text: Additionally, they must first be tested. Then, if they are above reproach, let them serve as deacons.
aov_text: En hulle moet ook eers ’n proeftyd deurmaak; daarna, as hulle onberispelik is, kan hulle dien.

kjv_text: Even so must their wives be grave, not slanderers, sober, faithful in all things.
bsb_text: In the same way, the women must be dignified, not slanderers, but temperate and faithful in all things.
aov_text: Net so moet die vroue waardig wees, geen kwaadspreeksters nie, nugter, betroubaar in alles.

kjv_text: Let the deacons be the husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.
bsb_text: A deacon must be the husband of but one wife, a good manager of his children and of his own household.
aov_text: Die diakens moet manne van een vrou wees en hulle kinders en eie huise goed regeer.

kjv_text: For they that have used the office of a deacon well purchase to themselves a good degree, and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.
bsb_text: For those who have served well as deacons acquire for themselves a high standing and great confidence in the faith that is in Christ Jesus.
aov_text: Want die wat goed gedien het, verkry vir hulle ’n eervolle plek en veel vrymoedigheid in die geloof in Christus Jesus.

kjv_text: These things write I unto thee, hoping to come unto thee shortly:
bsb_text: Although I hope to come to you soon, I am writing you these things
aov_text: Ek skryf jou hierdie dinge in die hoop om gou na jou te kom.

kjv_text: But if I tarry long, that thou mayest know how thou oughtest to behave thyself in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.
bsb_text: in case I am delayed, so that you will know how each one must conduct himself in God’s household, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and foundation of the truth.
aov_text: Maar as ek vertoef, dan kan jy weet hoe iemand hom moet gedra in die huis van God, wat die gemeente is van die lewende God, ’n pilaar en grondslag van die waarheid.

kjv_text: And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: God was manifest in the flesh, justified in the Spirit, seen of angels, preached unto the Gentiles, believed on in the world, received up into glory.
bsb_text: By common confession, the mystery of godliness is great: He appeared in the flesh, was vindicated by the Spirit, was seen by angels, was proclaimed among the nations, was believed in throughout the world, was taken up in glory.
aov_text: En, onteenseglik, die verborgenheid van die godsaligheid is groot: God is geopenbaar in die vlees, is geregverdig in die Gees, het verskyn aan engele, is verkondig onder die heidene, is geglo in die wêreld, is opgeneem in heerlikheid.

kjv_text: Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils;
bsb_text: Now the Spirit expressly states that in later times some will abandon the faith to follow deceitful spirits and the teachings of demons,
aov_text: MAAR die Gees sê uitdruklik dat in die laaste tye sommige van die geloof afvallig sal word en verleidende geeste en leringe van duiwels sal aanhang

kjv_text: Speaking lies in hypocrisy; having their conscience seared with a hot iron;
bsb_text: influenced by the hypocrisy of liars, whose consciences are seared with a hot iron.
aov_text: deur die geveinsdheid van leuenaars wat gebrandmerk is in hulle eie gewete,

kjv_text: Forbidding to marry, and commanding to abstain from meats, which God hath created to be received with thanksgiving of them which believe and know the truth.
bsb_text: They will prohibit marriage and require abstinence from certain foods that God has created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth.
aov_text: wat verbied om te trou en gebied dat die mense hulle moet onthou van voedsel wat God geskape het om met danksegging gebruik te word deur die gelowiges en die wat die waarheid ken.

kjv_text: For every creature of God is good, and nothing to be refused, if it be received with thanksgiving:
bsb_text: For every creation of God is good, and nothing that is received with thanksgiving should be rejected,
aov_text: Want alles wat deur God geskape is, is goed, en niks is verwerplik as dit met danksegging ontvang word nie;

kjv_text: For it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer.
bsb_text: because it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer.
aov_text: want dit word geheilig deur die woord van God en die gebed.

kjv_text: If thou put the brethren in remembrance of these things, thou shalt be a good minister of Jesus Christ, nourished up in the words of faith and of good doctrine, whereunto thou hast attained.
bsb_text: By pointing out these things to the brothers, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, nourished by the words of faith and sound instruction that you have followed.
aov_text: AS jy hierdie dinge aan die broeders voorhou, sal jy ’n goeie dienaar van Jesus Christus wees terwyl jy jouself voed met die woorde van die geloof en van die goeie leer waarvan jy ’n navolger geword het.

kjv_text: But refuse profane and old wives' fables, and exercise thyself rather unto godliness.
bsb_text: But reject irreverent, silly myths. Instead, train yourself for godliness.
aov_text: Maar verwerp onheilige en oudwyfse fabels, en oefen jou in die godsaligheid.

kjv_text: For bodily exercise profiteth little: but godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.
bsb_text: For physical exercise is of limited value, but godliness is valuable in every way, holding promise for the present life and for the one to come.
aov_text: Want die liggaamlike oefening is tot weinig nut, maar die godsaligheid is nuttig vir alles, omdat dit die belofte van die teenwoordige en die toekomende lewe het.

kjv_text: This is a faithful saying and worthy of all acceptation.
bsb_text: This is a trustworthy saying, worthy of full acceptance.
aov_text: Dit is ’n betroubare woord en werd om ten volle aangeneem te word;

kjv_text: For therefore we both labour and suffer reproach, because we trust in the living God, who is the Saviour of all men, specially of those that believe.
bsb_text: To this end we labor and strive, because we have set our hope on the living God, who is the Savior of everyone, and especially of those who believe.
aov_text: want hiervoor arbei ons ook en word ons gesmaad, omdat ons gehoop het op die lewende God wat ’n behouder is van alle mense, insonderheid van die gelowiges.

kjv_text: These things command and teach.
bsb_text: Command and teach these things.
aov_text: Beveel en leer hierdie dinge.

kjv_text: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.
bsb_text: Let no one despise your youth, but set an example for the believers in speech, in conduct, in love, in faith, in purity.
aov_text: Laat niemand jou jonkheid verag nie, maar wees ’n voorbeeld vir die gelowiges in woord, in wandel, in liefde, in gees, in geloof, in reinheid.

kjv_text: Till I come, give attendance to reading, to exhortation, to doctrine.
bsb_text: Until I come, devote yourself to the public reading of Scripture, to exhortation, and to teaching.
aov_text: Totdat ek kom, moet jy aanhou met voorlesing, vermaning en lering.

kjv_text: Neglect not the gift that is in thee, which was given thee by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery.
bsb_text: Do not neglect the gift that is in you, which was given you through the prophecy spoken over you at the laying on of the hands of the elders.
aov_text: Verwaarloos nie die genadegawe wat in jou is nie, wat jou gegee is deur die profesie met die handoplegging van die ouderlinge.

kjv_text: Meditate upon these things; give thyself wholly to them; that thy profiting may appear to all.
bsb_text: Be diligent in these matters and absorbed in them, so that your progress will be evident to all.
aov_text: Wees vlytig in hierdie dinge, leef daarin, sodat jou vooruitgang vir almal duidelik kan wees.

kjv_text: Take heed unto thyself, and unto the doctrine; continue in them: for in doing this thou shalt both save thyself, and them that hear thee.
bsb_text: Pay close attention to your life and to your teaching. Persevere in these things, for by so doing you will save both yourself and those who hear you.
aov_text: Let op jouself en op die leer; volhard daarin; want deur dit te doen, sal jy jouself red sowel as die wat jou hoor.

kjv_text: Rebuke not an elder, but intreat him as a father; and the younger men as brethren;
bsb_text: Do not rebuke an older man, but appeal to him as to a father. Treat younger men as brothers,
aov_text: N BEJAARDE man moet jy nie hard bestraf nie, maar vermaan hom soos ’’n vader, jongeres soos broers,

kjv_text: The elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, with all purity.
bsb_text: older women as mothers, and younger women as sisters, with absolute purity.
aov_text: bejaarde vroue soos moeders, jongeres soos susters in alle reinheid.

kjv_text: Honour widows that are widows indeed.
bsb_text: Honor the widows who are truly widows.
aov_text: Eer die weduwees wat waarlik weduwees is.

kjv_text: But if any widow have children or nephews, let them learn first to shew piety at home, and to requite their parents: for that is good and acceptable before God.
bsb_text: But if a widow has children or grandchildren, they must first learn to show godliness to their own family and repay their parents, for this is pleasing in the sight of God.
aov_text: Maar as ’n weduwee kinders of kleinkinders het, laat hulle eers leer om teenoor hulle eie huis eerbied te betoon en vergelding te doen aan hulle ouers; want dit is goed en aangenaam voor God.

kjv_text: Now she that is a widow indeed, and desolate, trusteth in God, and continueth in supplications and prayers night and day.
bsb_text: The widow who is truly in need and left all alone puts her hope in God and continues night and day in her petitions and prayers.
aov_text: En sy wat waarlik weduwee is en alleen gelaat is, hoop op God en bly in smekinge en gebede nag en dag.

kjv_text: But she that liveth in pleasure is dead while she liveth.
bsb_text: But she who lives for pleasure is dead even while she is still alive.
aov_text: Maar sy wat losbandig is, is lewendig dood.

kjv_text: And these things give in charge, that they may be blameless.
bsb_text: Give these instructions to the believers, so that they will be above reproach.
aov_text: Beveel ook hierdie dinge, sodat hulle onberispelik kan wees.

kjv_text: But if any provide not for his own, and specially for those of his own house, he hath denied the faith, and is worse than an infidel.
bsb_text: If anyone does not provide for his own, and especially his own household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.
aov_text: Maar iemand wat vir sy eie mense, en veral sy huisgenote, nie sorg nie, het die geloof verloën en is slegter as ’n ongelowige.

kjv_text: Let not a widow be taken into the number under threescore years old, having been the wife of one man,
bsb_text: A widow should be enrolled if she is at least sixty years old, the wife of one man,
aov_text: Laat ’n weduwee gekies word, nie minder as sestig jaar oud nie, wat die vrou van een man gewees het

kjv_text: Well reported of for good works; if she have brought up children, if she have lodged strangers, if she have washed the saints' feet, if she have relieved the afflicted, if she have diligently followed every good work.
bsb_text: and well known for good deeds such as bringing up children, entertaining strangers, washing the feet of the saints, imparting relief to the afflicted, and devoting herself to every good work.
aov_text: en getuienis het van goeie werke, as sy kinders grootgemaak het, gasvry gewees het, die voete van die heiliges gewas het, verdruktes gehelp en elke goeie werk nagestreef het.

kjv_text: But the younger widows refuse: for when they have begun to wax wanton against Christ, they will marry;
bsb_text: But refuse to enroll younger widows. For when their passions draw them away from Christ, they will want to marry,
aov_text: Maar jy moet die jong weduwees afwys; want wanneer hulle tot oneer van Christus wellustig word, wil hulle trou

kjv_text: Having damnation, because they have cast off their first faith.
bsb_text: and thus will incur judgment because they are setting aside their first faith.
aov_text: en kom onder ’n oordeel, omdat hulle hul eerste geloof verwerp het.

kjv_text: And withal they learn to be idle, wandering about from house to house; and not only idle, but tattlers also and busybodies, speaking things which they ought not.
bsb_text: At the same time they will also learn to be idle, going from house to house and being not only idle, but also gossips and busybodies, discussing things they should not mention.
aov_text: En tegelykertyd leer hulle ook om ledig by die huise rond te gaan; en nie alleen is hulle ledig nie, maar ook praatsiek en bemoeisiek, want hulle praat wat nie behoorlik is nie.

kjv_text: I will therefore that the younger women marry, bear children, guide the house, give none occasion to the adversary to speak reproachfully.
bsb_text: So I advise the younger widows to marry, have children, and manage their households, denying the adversary occasion for slander.
aov_text: Ek wil dan hê dat die jong weduwees moet trou, kinders baar, hulle huise regeer en die teëparty geen aanleiding gee om kwaad te spreek nie.

kjv_text: For some are already turned aside after Satan.
bsb_text: For some have already turned aside to follow Satan.
aov_text: Want sommige het al afgewyk agter die Satan aan.

kjv_text: If any man or woman that believeth have widows, let them relieve them, and let not the church be charged; that it may relieve them that are widows indeed.
bsb_text: If any believing woman has dependent widows, she must assist them and not allow the church to be burdened, so that it can help the widows who are truly in need.
aov_text: As ’n gelowige man of ’n gelowige vrou weduwees by hulle het, moet dié aan hulle hulp verleen; en laat die gemeente nie beswaar word nie, sodat dit die wat waarlik weduwees is, kan help.

kjv_text: Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honour, especially they who labour in the word and doctrine.
bsb_text: Elders who lead effectively are worthy of double honor, especially those who work hard at preaching and teaching.
aov_text: LAAT die ouderlinge wat goed regeer, dubbele eer waardig geag word, veral die wat arbei in woord en leer.

kjv_text: For the scripture saith, Thou shalt not muzzle the ox that treadeth out the corn. And, The labourer is worthy of his reward.
bsb_text: For the Scripture says, “Do not muzzle an ox while it is treading out the grain,” and, “The worker is worthy of his wages.”
aov_text: Want die Skrif sê: Jy mag ’n os wat graan dors, nie muilband nie; en: Die arbeider is sy loon werd.

kjv_text: Against an elder receive not an accusation, but before two or three witnesses.
bsb_text: Do not entertain an accusation against an elder, except on the testimony of two or three witnesses.
aov_text: Moenie ’n beskuldiging teen ’n ouderling aanneem nie, behalwe op die getuienis van twee of drie.

kjv_text: Them that sin rebuke before all, that others also may fear.
bsb_text: But those who persist in sin should be rebuked in front of everyone, so that the others will stand in fear of sin.
aov_text: Bestraf die wat sondig, in die teenwoordigheid van almal, sodat ook die ander kan vrees.

kjv_text: I charge thee before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the elect angels, that thou observe these things without preferring one before another, doing nothing by partiality.
bsb_text: I solemnly charge you before God and Christ Jesus and the elect angels to maintain these principles without bias, and to do nothing out of partiality.
aov_text: Ek besweer jou voor God en die Here Jesus Christus en die uitverkore engele dat jy hierdie dinge sonder vooroordeel in ag neem en niks uit partydigheid doen nie.

kjv_text: Lay hands suddenly on no man, neither be partaker of other men's sins: keep thyself pure.
bsb_text: Do not be too quick in the laying on of hands and thereby share in the sins of others. Keep yourself pure.
aov_text: Moenie haastig iemand die hande oplê nie, en moet ook nie met die sondes van ander gemeenskap hê nie. Hou jou rein.

kjv_text: Drink no longer water, but use a little wine for thy stomach's sake and thine often infirmities.
bsb_text: Stop drinking only water and use a little wine instead, because of your stomach and your frequent ailments.
aov_text: Moenie langer water alleen drink nie, maar gebruik ’n bietjie wyn ter wille van jou maag en jou herhaalde ongesteldhede.

kjv_text: Some men's sins are open beforehand, going before to judgment; and some men they follow after.
bsb_text: The sins of some men are obvious, going ahead of them to judgment; but the sins of others do not surface until later.
aov_text: Die sondes van sommige mense is baie duidelik en gaan voor hulle uit tot die oordeel, maar volg ander eers agterna.

kjv_text: Likewise also the good works of some are manifest beforehand; and they that are otherwise cannot be hid.
bsb_text: In the same way, good deeds are obvious, and even the ones that are inconspicuous cannot remain hidden.
aov_text: Net so is ook die goeie werke baie duidelik, en ook die wat anders is, kan nie weggesteek word nie.

kjv_text: Let as many servants as are under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honour, that the name of God and his doctrine be not blasphemed.
bsb_text: All who are under the yoke of slavery should regard their masters as fully worthy of honor, so that God’s name and our teaching will not be discredited.
aov_text: ALMAL wat diensknegte is onder ’n juk, moet hulle eie here alle eer waardig ag, sodat die Naam van God en die leer nie belaster mag word nie.

kjv_text: And they that have believing masters, let them not despise them, because they are brethren; but rather do them service, because they are faithful and beloved, partakers of the benefit. These things teach and exhort.
bsb_text: Those who have believing masters should not show disrespect because they are brothers, but should serve them all the more, since those receiving their good service are beloved believers. Teach and encourage these principles.
aov_text: En die wat gelowige here het, moet hulle nie verag omdat hulle broeders is nie, maar moet hulle des te meer dien, omdat hulle wat die weldade ontvang, gelowiges en geliefdes is. Leer hierdie dinge en wek daartoe op.

kjv_text: If any man teach otherwise, and consent not to wholesome words, even the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness;
bsb_text: If anyone teaches another doctrine and disagrees with the sound words of our Lord Jesus Christ and with godly teaching,
aov_text: AS iemand iets anders leer en nie instem met die gesonde woorde van onse Here Jesus Christus en met die leer wat volgens die godsaligheid is nie,

kjv_text: He is proud, knowing nothing, but doting about questions and strifes of words, whereof cometh envy, strife, railings, evil surmisings,
bsb_text: he is conceited and understands nothing. Instead, he has an unhealthy interest in controversies and semantics, out of which come envy, strife, abusive talk, evil suspicions,
aov_text: dié is verwaand en verstaan niks nie, maar het ’n sieklike sug na twisvrae en woordestryd waaruit ontstaan afguns, twis, lasteringe, bose agterdog,

kjv_text: Perverse disputings of men of corrupt minds, and destitute of the truth, supposing that gain is godliness: from such withdraw thyself.
bsb_text: and constant friction between men of depraved mind who are devoid of the truth. These men regard godliness as a means of gain.
aov_text: nuttelose stryery van mense wat verdorwe in hulle verstand en van die waarheid beroof is en dink dat die godsaligheid winsgewend is. Onttrek jou aan sulke mense.

kjv_text: But godliness with contentment is great gain.
bsb_text: Of course, godliness with contentment is great gain.
aov_text: Maar die godsaligheid saam met vergenoegdheid is ’n groot wins.

kjv_text: For we brought nothing into this world, and it is certain we can carry nothing out.
bsb_text: For we brought nothing into the world, so we cannot carry anything out of it.
aov_text: Want ons het niks in die wêreld ingebring nie; dit is duidelik dat ons ook niks daaruit kan wegdra nie.

kjv_text: And having food and raiment let us be therewith content.
bsb_text: But if we have food and clothing, we will be content with these.
aov_text: Maar as ons voedsel en klere het, moet ons daarmee vergenoeg wees.

kjv_text: But they that will be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and into many foolish and hurtful lusts, which drown men in destruction and perdition.
bsb_text: Those who want to be rich, however, fall into temptation and become ensnared by many foolish and harmful desires that plunge them into ruin and destruction.
aov_text: Maar die wat ryk wil word, val in versoeking en strikke en baie dwase en skadelike begeerlikhede wat die mense laat wegsink in verderf en ondergang.

kjv_text: For the love of money is the root of all evil: which while some coveted after, they have erred from the faith, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows.
bsb_text: For the love of money is the root of all kinds of evil. By craving it, some have wandered away from the faith and pierced themselves with many sorrows.

kjv_text: All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:
bsb_text: All Scripture is God-breathed and is useful for instruction, for conviction, for correction, and for training in righteousness,
aov_text: Die hele Skrif is deur God ingegee en is nuttig tot lering, tot weerlegging, tot teregwysing, tot onderwysing in die geregtigheid,

kjv_text: That the man of God may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works.
bsb_text: so that the man of God may be complete, fully equipped for every good work.
aov_text: sodat die mens van God volkome kan wees, vir elke goeie werk volkome toegerus.

kjv_text: I charge thee therefore before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, who shall judge the quick and the dead at his appearing and his kingdom;
bsb_text: I charge you in the presence of God and of Christ Jesus, who will judge the living and the dead, and in view of His appearing and His kingdom:
aov_text: EK besweer jou dan voor God en die Here Jesus Christus, wat die lewende en die dode sal oordeel by sy verskyning en sy koninkryk:

kjv_text: Preach the word; be instant in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort with all longsuffering and doctrine.
bsb_text: Preach the word; be prepared in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and encourage with every form of patient instruction.
aov_text: verkondig die woord; hou aan tydig en ontydig; weerlê, bestraf, vermaan in alle lankmoedigheid en lering;

kjv_text: For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears;
bsb_text: For the time will come when men will not tolerate sound doctrine, but with itching ears they will gather around themselves teachers to suit their own desires.
aov_text: want daar sal ’n tyd wees wanneer hulle die gesonde leer nie sal verdra nie, maar, omdat hulle in hul gehoor gestreel wil wees, vir hulle ’n menigte leraars sal versamel volgens hulle eie begeerlikhede,

kjv_text: And they shall turn away their ears from the truth, and shall be turned unto fables.
bsb_text: So they will turn their ears away from the truth and turn aside to myths.
aov_text: en die oor sal afkeer van die waarheid en hulle sal wend tot fabels.

kjv_text: But watch thou in all things, endure afflictions, do the work of an evangelist, make full proof of thy ministry.
bsb_text: But you, be sober in all things, endure hardship, do the work of an evangelist, fulfill your ministry.
aov_text: Maar wees jy in alles nugter; ly verdrukking; doen die werk van ’n evangelis; vervul jou bediening.

kjv_text: For I am now ready to be offered, and the time of my departure is at hand.
bsb_text: For I am already being poured out like a drink offering, and the time of my departure is at hand.
aov_text: WANT ek word alreeds as ’n drankoffer uitgegiet, en die tyd van my heengaan is naby.

kjv_text: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:
bsb_text: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.
aov_text: Ek het die goeie stryd gestry; ek het die wedloop voleindig; ek het die geloof behou.

kjv_text: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.
bsb_text: From now on there is laid up for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous Judge, will award to me on that day—and not only to me, but to all who crave His appearing.
aov_text: Verder is vir my weggelê die kroon van die geregtigheid wat die Here, die regverdige Regter, my in dié dag sal gee; en nie aan my alleen nie, maar ook aan almal wat sy verskyning liefgehad het.

kjv_text: Do thy diligence to come shortly unto me:
bsb_text: Make every effort to come to me quickly,
aov_text: Beywer jou om gou na my te kom.

kjv_text: For Demas hath forsaken me, having loved this present world, and is departed unto Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus unto Dalmatia.
bsb_text: because Demas, in his love of this world, has deserted me and gone to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus to Dalmatia.
aov_text: Want Demas het my verlaat, omdat hy die teenwoordige wêreld liefgekry het, en het na Thessaloníka vertrek, Crescens na Galásië, Titus na Dalmásië.

kjv_text: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with thee: for he is profitable to me for the ministry.
bsb_text: Only Luke is with me. Get Mark and bring him with you, because he is useful to me in the ministry.
aov_text: Lukas is alleen by my. Markus moet jy gaan haal en saam met jou bring, want hy kan my baie tot diens wees.

kjv_text: And Tychicus have I sent to Ephesus.
bsb_text: Tychicus, however, I have sent to Ephesus.
aov_text: Tíchikus het ek na Éfese gestuur.

kjv_text: The cloke that I left at Troas with Carpus, when thou comest, bring with thee, and the books, but especially the parchments.
bsb_text: When you come, bring the cloak that I left with Carpus at Troas, and my scrolls, especially the parchments.
aov_text: As jy kom, moet jy die reismantel bring wat ek by Carpus in Troas laat bly het, en die boeke, veral die perkamente.

kjv_text: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil: the Lord reward him according to his works:
bsb_text: Alexander the coppersmith did great harm to me. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds.
aov_text: Alexander, die kopersmid, het my baie kwaad aangedoen. Mag die Here hom vergeld na sy werke!

kjv_text: Of whom be thou ware also; for he hath greatly withstood our words.
bsb_text: You too should beware of him, for he has vigorously opposed our message.
aov_text: Jy moet ook vir hom oppas, want hy het ons woorde sterk teëgestaan.

kjv_text: At my first answer no man stood with me, but all men forsook me: I pray God that it may not be laid to their charge.
bsb_text: At my first defense, no one stood with me, but everyone deserted me. May it not be charged against them.
aov_text: In my eerste verdediging het niemand my bygestaan nie, maar almal het my verlaat. Mag dit hulle nie toegereken word nie!

kjv_text: Notwithstanding the Lord stood with me, and strengthened me; that by me the preaching might be fully known, and that all the Gentiles might hear: and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.
bsb_text: But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, so that through me the message would be fully proclaimed, and all the Gentiles would hear it. So I was delivered from the mouth of the lion.
aov_text: Maar die Here het my bygestaan en my krag gegee, sodat deur my die prediking heeltemal volbring kan word en al die heidene dit kan hoor; en ek is uit die bek van die leeu verlos.

kjv_text: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
bsb_text: And the Lord will rescue me from every evil action and bring me safely into His heavenly kingdom. To Him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
aov_text: En die Here sal my verlos van elke bose werk en my red om in sy hemelse koninkryk in te gaan. Aan Hom die heerlikheid tot in alle ewigheid! Amen.

kjv_text: Salute Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.
bsb_text: Greet Prisca and Aquila, as well as the household of Onesiphorus.
aov_text: Groet Prisca en Áquila en die huis van Onesíforus.

kjv_text: Erastus abode at Corinth: but Trophimus have I left at Miletum sick.
bsb_text: Erastus has remained at Corinth, and Trophimus I left sick in Miletus.
aov_text: Erástus het in Korinthe gebly. Trófimus het ek siek in Miléte agtergelaat.

kjv_text: Do thy diligence to come before winter. Eubulus greeteth thee, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.
bsb_text: Make every effort to come to me before winter. Eubulus sends you greetings, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers.
aov_text: Beywer jou om voor die winter te kom. Eubúlus en Pudens en Linus en Claudia en al die broeders groet jou.

kjv_text: The Lord Jesus Christ be with thy spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.
bsb_text: The Lord be with your spirit. Grace be with you all.
aov_text: Mag die Here Jesus Christus met jou gees wees! Die genade sy met julle! Amen.

kjv_text: Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God's elect, and the acknowledging of the truth which is after godliness;
bsb_text: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ for the faith of God’s elect and their knowledge of the truth that leads to godliness,
aov_text: PAULUS, ’n dienskneg van God en ’n apostel van Jesus Christus, volgens die geloof van die uitverkorenes van God en die kennis van die waarheid wat na die godsaligheid is,

kjv_text: In hope of eternal life, which God, that cannot lie, promised before the world began;
bsb_text: in the hope of eternal life, which God, who cannot lie, promised before time began.
aov_text: in die hoop van die ewige lewe wat God, wat nie kan lieg nie, van ewigheid af beloof het,

kjv_text: But hath in due times manifested his word through preaching, which is committed unto me according to the commandment of God our Saviour;
bsb_text: In His own time He has made His word evident in the proclamation entrusted to me by the command of God our Savior.
aov_text: en op die regte tyd sy woord bekend gemaak het deur die prediking wat aan my toevertrou is, ooreenkomstig die gebod van God, ons Verlosser —

kjv_text: To Titus, mine own son after the common faith:
bsb_text: To Titus, my true child in our common faith:
aov_text: aan Titus, my ware kind volgens die gemeenskaplike geloof:

kjv_text: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Saviour.
bsb_text: Grace and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Savior.
aov_text: Genade, barmhartigheid, vrede van God die Vader en die Here Jesus Christus, ons Verlosser!

kjv_text: For this cause left I thee in Crete, that thou shouldest set in order the things that are wanting, and ordain elders in every city, as I had appointed thee:
bsb_text: The reason I left you in Crete was that you would set in order what was unfinished and appoint elders in every town, as I directed you.
aov_text: OM hierdie rede het ek jou in Kreta agtergelaat, dat jy nog verder sou regmaak wat oorgebly het, en van stad tot stad ouderlinge sou aanstel soos ek jou beveel het  —

kjv_text: If any be blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly.
bsb_text: An elder must be blameless, the husband of but one wife, having children who are believers and who are not open to accusation of indiscretion or insubordination.
aov_text: as iemand onberispelik is, die man van een vrou, gelowige kinders het wat nie beskuldig word van losbandigheid of tugteloos is nie.

kjv_text: For a bishop must be blameless, as the steward of God; not selfwilled, not soon angry, not given to wine, no striker, not given to filthy lucre;
bsb_text: As God’s steward, an overseer must be above reproach—not self-absorbed, not quick-tempered, not given to drunkenness, not violent, not greedy for money.
aov_text: Want ’n opsiener moet as ’n rentmeester van God onberispelik wees, nie eiesinnig, nie oplopend, geen drinker, geen vegter, geen vuilgewinsoeker nie;

kjv_text: But a lover of hospitality, a lover of good men, sober, just, holy, temperate;
bsb_text: Instead, he must be hospitable, a lover of good, self-controlled, upright, holy, and disciplined.
aov_text: maar gasvry, een wat die goeie liefhet, ingetoë, regverdig, heilig, een wat homself beheers;

kjv_text: Holding fast the faithful word as he hath been taught, that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers.
bsb_text: He must hold firmly to the faithful word as it was taught, so that he can encourage others by sound teaching and refute those who contradict it.
aov_text: een wat vashou aan die betroubare woord wat volgens die leer is, sodat hy in staat kan wees om met die gesonde leer te vermaan sowel as om die teësprekers te weerlê.

kjv_text: For there are many unruly and vain talkers and deceivers, specially they of the circumcision:
bsb_text: For many are rebellious and full of empty talk and deception, especially those of the circumcision,
aov_text: Want daar is baie wat tugteloos is, wat onsin praat en verleiers is, veral die wat uit die besnydenis is;

kjv_text: Whose mouths must be stopped, who subvert whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for filthy lucre's sake.
bsb_text: who must be silenced. For the sake of dishonorable gain, they undermine entire households and teach things they should not.
aov_text: hulle mond moet gestop word. Hulle keer hele huise onderstebo deur te leer wat nie betaam nie, ter wille van vuil wins.

kjv_text: One of themselves, even a prophet of their own, said, The Cretians are alway liars, evil beasts, slow bellies.
bsb_text: As one of their own prophets has said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, lazy gluttons.”
aov_text: Een uit hulle, hul eie profeet, het gesê: Die Kretense is altyd leuenaars, ongediertes, lui buike.

kjv_text: This witness is true. Wherefore rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith;
bsb_text: This testimony is true. Therefore rebuke them sternly, so that they will be sound in the faith
aov_text: Hierdie getuienis is waar. Daarom moet jy hulle skerp bestraf, sodat hulle gesond in die geloof kan wees,

kjv_text: Not giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men, that turn from the truth.
bsb_text: and will pay no attention to Jewish myths or to the commands of men who have rejected the truth.
aov_text: en hulle nie besig hou met Joodse fabels en gebooie van mense wat van die waarheid afwyk nie.

kjv_text: Unto the pure all things are pure: but unto them that are defiled and unbelieving is nothing pure; but even their mind and conscience is defiled.
bsb_text: To the pure, all things are pure; but to the defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure. Indeed, both their minds and their consciences are defiled.
aov_text: Alle dinge is rein vir die reines; vir die besoedeldes en ongelowiges egter is niks rein nie, maar hulle verstand sowel as hulle gewete is besoedel.

kjv_text: They profess that they know God; but in works they deny him, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate.
bsb_text: They profess to know God, but by their actions they deny Him. They are detestable, disobedient, and unfit for any good deed.
aov_text: Hulle bely dat hulle God ken, maar hulle verloën Hom deur die werke, omdat hulle gruwelik en ongehoorsaam is en ongeskik vir elke goeie werk.

kjv_text: But speak thou the things which become sound doctrine:
bsb_text: But as for you, speak the things that are consistent with sound doctrine.
aov_text: MAAR spreek jy wat by die gesonde leer pas.

kjv_text: That the aged men be sober, grave, temperate, sound in faith, in charity, in patience.
bsb_text: Older men are to be temperate, dignified, self-controlled, and sound in faith, love, and perseverance.
aov_text: Die ou manne moet nugter wees, waardig, ingetoë, gesond in die geloof, in die liefde, in die lydsaamheid.

kjv_text: The aged women likewise, that they be in behaviour as becometh holiness, not false accusers, not given to much wine, teachers of good things;
bsb_text: Older women, likewise, are to be reverent in their behavior, not slanderers or addicted to much wine, but teachers of good.
aov_text: Die ou vroue moet ook in hulle gedrag wees soos dit die heiliges betaam, geen kwaadspreeksters of aan baie wyn verslaaf nie, maar leraresse van wat goed is,

kjv_text: That they may teach the young women to be sober, to love their husbands, to love their children,
bsb_text: In this way they can train the young women to love their husbands and children,
aov_text: sodat hulle die jong vroue kan leer om versigtig te wees, hulle mans en kinders lief te hê,

kjv_text: To be discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, obedient to their own husbands, that the word of God be not blasphemed.
bsb_text: to be self-controlled, pure, managers of their households, kind, and submissive to their own husbands, so that the word of God will not be discredited.
aov_text: ingetoë te wees, kuis, huislik, goed, aan hul eie mans onderdanig, sodat die woord van God nie belaster word nie.

kjv_text: Young men likewise exhort to be sober minded.
bsb_text: In the same way, urge the younger men to be self-controlled.
aov_text: Vermaan die jong manne net so om ingetoë te wees.

kjv_text: In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works: in doctrine shewing uncorruptness, gravity, sincerity,
bsb_text: In everything, show yourself to be an example by doing good works. In your teaching show integrity, dignity,
aov_text: Betoon jou in alles ’n voorbeeld van goeie werke, met onvervalstheid in die leer, waardigheid, opregtheid.

kjv_text: Sound speech, that cannot be condemned; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say of you.
bsb_text: and wholesome speech that is above reproach, so that anyone who opposes us will be ashamed, having nothing bad to say about us.
aov_text: Laat die woord gesond en onweerspreeklik wees, sodat die teëstanders beskaam kan word en niks slegs kan hê om van julle te sê nie.

kjv_text: Exhort servants to be obedient unto their own masters, and to please them well in all things; not answering again;
bsb_text: Slaves are to submit to their own masters in everything, to be well-pleasing, not argumentative,
aov_text: Die diensknegte moet onderdanig wees aan hul eie here, hulle in alles behaag en nie teëpraat nie;

kjv_text: Not purloining, but shewing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things.
bsb_text: not stealing from them, but showing all good faith, so that in every respect they will adorn the teaching about God our Savior.
aov_text: hulle moet niks ontvreemd nie, maar alle goeie trou betoon, sodat hulle die leer van God, ons Verlosser, in alles kan versier.

kjv_text: For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men,
bsb_text: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to everyone.
aov_text: WANT die reddende genade van God het aan alle mense verskyn

kjv_text: Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world;
bsb_text: It instructs us to renounce ungodliness and worldly passions, and to live sensible, upright, and godly lives in the present age,
aov_text: en leer ons om die goddeloosheid en wêreldse begeerlikhede te verloën, ingetoë en regverdig en vroom in die teenwoordige wêreld te lewe,

kjv_text: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ;
bsb_text: as we await the blessed hope and glorious appearance of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ.
aov_text: terwyl ons die salige hoop en die verskyning van die heerlikheid verwag van die grote God en ons Verlosser, Jesus Christus,

kjv_text: Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a peculiar people, zealous of good works.
bsb_text: He gave Himself for us to redeem us from all lawlessness and to purify for Himself a people for His own possession, zealous for good deeds.
aov_text: wat Homself vir ons gegee het om ons te verlos van alle ongeregtigheid en vir Homself ’n volk as sy eiendom te reinig, ywerig in goeie werke.

kjv_text: These things speak, and exhort, and rebuke with all authority. Let no man despise thee.
bsb_text: Speak these things as you encourage and rebuke with all authority. Let no one despise you.
aov_text: Spreek hierdie dinge en vermaan en bestraf in alle erns. Laat niemand jou verag nie.

kjv_text: Put them in mind to be subject to principalities and powers, to obey magistrates, to be ready to every good work,
bsb_text: Remind the believers to submit to rulers and authorities, to be obedient and ready for every good work,
aov_text: HERINNER hulle daaraan om onderdanig te wees aan owerhede en magte, om gehoorsaam te wees, bereid tot elke goeie werk;

kjv_text: To speak evil of no man, to be no brawlers, but gentle, shewing all meekness unto all men.
bsb_text: to malign no one, and to be peaceable and gentle, showing full consideration to everyone.
aov_text: om niemand te belaster nie, nie strydlustig te wees nie, vriendelik te wees en aan alle mense alle sagmoedigheid te bewys.

kjv_text: For we ourselves also were sometimes foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving divers lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.
bsb_text: For at one time we too were foolish, disobedient, misled, and enslaved to all sorts of desires and pleasures—living in malice and envy, being hated and hating one another.
aov_text: Want ons was ook vroeër onverstandig, ongehoorsaam, op ’n dwaalweg, verslaaf aan allerhande begeerlikhede en singenot; ons het in boosheid en afguns gelewe; ons was haatlik en het mekaar gehaat.

kjv_text: But after that the kindness and love of God our Saviour toward man appeared,
bsb_text: But when the kindness of God our Savior and His love for mankind appeared,
aov_text: Maar toe die goedertierenheid van God, ons Verlosser, en sy liefde tot die mens verskyn het  —

kjv_text: Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Holy Ghost;
bsb_text: He saved us, not by the righteous deeds we had done, but according to His mercy, through the washing of new birth and renewal by the Holy Spirit.
aov_text: nie op grond van die werke van geregtigheid wat ons gedoen het nie, maar na sy barmhartigheid het Hy ons gered deur die bad van die wedergeboorte en die vernuwing deur die Heilige Gees

kjv_text: Which he shed on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Saviour;
bsb_text: This is the Spirit He poured out on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Savior,
aov_text: wat Hy ryklik uitgestort het op ons deur Jesus Christus, ons Verlosser;

kjv_text: That being justified by his grace, we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
bsb_text: so that, having been justified by His grace, we would become heirs with the hope of eternal life.
aov_text: sodat ons, geregverdig deur sy genade, erfgename kan word ooreenkomstig die hoop van die ewige lewe.

kjv_text: This is a faithful saying, and these things I will that thou affirm constantly, that they which have believed in God might be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men.
bsb_text: This saying is trustworthy. And I want you to emphasize these things, so that those who have believed God will take care to devote themselves to good deeds. These things are excellent and profitable for the people.
aov_text: Dit is ’n betroubare woord, en ek wil hê dat jy hierdie dinge beslis bevestig, sodat die wat in God glo, sorg kan dra om goeie werke voor te staan; dít is wat goed en nuttig is vir die mense.

kjv_text: But avoid foolish questions, and genealogies, and contentions, and strivings about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.
bsb_text: But avoid foolish controversies, genealogies, arguments, and quarrels about the law, because these things are pointless and worthless.
aov_text: Maar vermy dwase strydvrae en geslagsregisters en twis en stryery oor die wet, want dit is nutteloos en doelloos.

kjv_text: A man that is an heretick after the first and second admonition reject;
bsb_text: Reject a divisive man after a first and second admonition,
aov_text: Aan ’n man wat partyskap verwek, moet jy jou onttrek ná die eerste en tweede vermaning,

kjv_text: Knowing that he that is such is subverted, and sinneth, being condemned of himself.
bsb_text: knowing that such a man is corrupt and sinful; he is self-condemned.
aov_text: wetende dat so iemand op ’n verkeerde pad is en sonde doen en selfveroordeeld staan.

kjv_text: When I shall send Artemas unto thee, or Tychicus, be diligent to come unto me to Nicopolis: for I have determined there to winter.
bsb_text: As soon as I send Artemas or Tychicus to you, make every effort to come to me at Nicopolis, because I have decided to winter there.
aov_text: WANNEER ek Ártemas of Tíchikus na jou stuur, doen dan jou bes om na my te kom in Nikópolis, want ek het besluit om daar te oorwinter.

kjv_text: Bring Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently, that nothing be wanting unto them.
bsb_text: Do your best to equip Zenas the lawyer and Apollos, so that they will have everything they need.
aov_text: Jy moet Senas, die wetgeleerde, en Apollos ywerig voorthelp, sodat dit hulle aan niks ontbreek nie.

kjv_text: And let ours also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful.
bsb_text: And our people must also learn to devote themselves to good works in order to meet the pressing needs of others, so that they will not be unfruitful.
aov_text: Ons mense moet ook leer om vir die noodsaaklike behoeftes goeie werke voor te staan, sodat hulle nie onvrugbaar mag wees nie.

kjv_text: All that are with me salute thee. Greet them that love us in the faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.
bsb_text: All who are with me send you greetings. Greet those who love us in the faith. Grace be with all of you.
aov_text: Almal wat saam met my is, groet jou. Groet die wat vir ons liefhet in die geloof. Die genade sy met julle almal! Amen.

kjv_text: Paul, a prisoner of Jesus Christ, and Timothy our brother, unto Philemon our dearly beloved, and fellowlabourer,
bsb_text: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, To Philemon our beloved fellow worker,
aov_text: PAULUS, ’n gevangene van Christus Jesus, en die broeder Timótheüs, aan Filémon, die geliefde en ons mede-arbeider,

kjv_text: And to our beloved Apphia, and Archippus our fellowsoldier, and to the church in thy house:
bsb_text: to Apphia our sister, to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the church that meets at your house:
aov_text: en aan Áppia, die geliefde suster, en aan Archíppus, ons medestryder, en aan die gemeente wat in jou huis is:

aov_text: Genade vir julle en vrede van God onse Vader en die Here Jesus Christus!

bsb_text: I always thank my God, remembering you in my prayers,
