bsb_text: And to whom did He swear that they would never enter His rest? Was it not to those who disobeyed?
aov_text: En aan wie het Hy gesweer dat hulle in sy rus nie sal ingaan nie, behalwe aan die ongehoorsames?

kjv_text: So we see that they could not enter in because of unbelief.
bsb_text: So we see that it was because of their unbelief that they were unable to enter.
aov_text: En ons sien dat hulle deur ongeloof nie kon ingaan nie.

kjv_text: Let us therefore fear, lest, a promise being left us of entering into his rest, any of you should seem to come short of it.
bsb_text: Therefore, while the promise of entering His rest still stands, let us be careful that none of you be deemed to have fallen short of it.
aov_text: LAAT ons dan vrees dat, terwyl die belofte om in sy rus in te gaan nog standhou, dit nie miskien sal blyk dat iemand van julle agtergebly het nie.

kjv_text: For unto us was the gospel preached, as well as unto them: but the word preached did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in them that heard it.
bsb_text: For we also received the good news just as they did; but the message they heard was of no value to them, since they did not share the faith of those who comprehended it.
aov_text: Want aan ons is die evangelie ook verkondig net soos aan hulle; maar die woord van die prediking het hulle nie gebaat nie, omdat dit by die hoorders nie met die geloof verenig was nie.

kjv_text: For we which have believed do enter into rest, as he said, As I have sworn in my wrath, if they shall enter into my rest: although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.
bsb_text: Now we who have believed enter that rest. As for the others, it is just as God has said: “So I swore on oath in My anger, ‘They shall never enter My rest.’” And yet His works have been finished since the foundation of the world.
aov_text: Want ons wat geglo het, gaan die rus in, soos Hy gesê het: Daarom het Ek in my toorn gesweer, hulle sal in my rus nie ingaan nie — alhoewel sy werke van die grondlegging van die wêreld af volbring is.

kjv_text: For he spake in a certain place of the seventh day on this wise, And God did rest the seventh day from all his works.
bsb_text: For somewhere He has spoken about the seventh day in this manner: “And on the seventh day God rested from all His works.”
aov_text: Want Hy het êrens van die sewende dag so gespreek: En God het op die sewende dag van al sy werke gerus;

kjv_text: And in this place again, If they shall enter into my rest.
bsb_text: And again, as He says in the passage above: “They shall never enter My rest.”
aov_text: en nou hier weer: Hulle sal in my rus nie ingaan nie.

kjv_text: Seeing therefore it remaineth that some must enter therein, and they to whom it was first preached entered not in because of unbelief:
bsb_text: Since, then, it remains for some to enter His rest, and since those who formerly heard the good news did not enter because of their disobedience,
aov_text: Terwyl dit dan so is dat sommige daar ingaan, en diegene aan wie die evangelie eers verkondig is, deur ongehoorsaamheid nie ingegaan het nie,

kjv_text: Again, he limiteth a certain day, saying in David, To day, after so long a time; as it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts.
bsb_text: God again designated a certain day as “Today,” when a long time later He spoke through David as was just stated: “Today, if you hear His voice, do not harden your hearts.”
aov_text: bepaal Hy weer ’n sekere dag, naamlik vandag, as Hy soveel later deur Dawid spreek, soos gesê is: Vandag as julle sy stem hoor, verhard julle harte nie.

kjv_text: For if Jesus had given them rest, then would he not afterward have spoken of another day.
bsb_text: For if Joshua had given them rest, God would not have spoken later about another day.
aov_text: Want as Josua aan hulle rus gegee het, sou Hy nie van ’n ander dag daarná spreek nie.

kjv_text: There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God.
bsb_text: There remains, then, a Sabbath rest for the people of God.
aov_text: Daar bly dus ’n sabbatsrus oor vir die volk van God;

kjv_text: For he that is entered into his rest, he also hath ceased from his own works, as God did from his.
bsb_text: For whoever enters God’s rest also rests from his own work, just as God did from His.
aov_text: want wie in sy rus ingegaan het, rus ook self van sy werke soos God van syne.

kjv_text: Let us labour therefore to enter into that rest, lest any man fall after the same example of unbelief.
bsb_text: Let us, therefore, make every effort to enter that rest, so that no one will fall by following the same pattern of disobedience.
aov_text: Laat ons ons dan beywer om in te gaan in dié rus, sodat niemand in dieselfde voorbeeld van ongehoorsaamheid mag val nie.

kjv_text: For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.
bsb_text: For the word of God is living and active. Sharper than any double-edged sword, it pierces even to dividing soul and spirit, joints and marrow. It judges the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
aov_text: Want die woord van God is lewend en kragtig en skerper as enige tweesnydende swaard, en dring deur tot die skeiding van siel en gees en van gewrigte en murg, en is ’n beoordelaar van die oorlegginge en gedagtes van die hart.

kjv_text: Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do.
bsb_text: Nothing in all creation is hidden from God’s sight; everything is uncovered and exposed before the eyes of Him to whom we must give account.
aov_text: En daar is geen skepsel onsigbaar voor Hom nie, maar alles is oop en bloot voor die oë van Hom met wie ons te doen het.

kjv_text: Seeing then that we have a great high priest, that is passed into the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold fast our profession.
bsb_text: Therefore, since we have a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold firmly to what we profess.
aov_text: TERWYL ons dan ’n groot Hoëpriester het wat deur die hemele deurgegaan het, naamlik Jesus, die Seun van God, laat ons die belydenis vashou.

kjv_text: For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but was in all points tempted like as we are, yet without sin.
bsb_text: For we do not have a high priest who is unable to sympathize with our weaknesses, but we have one who was tempted in every way that we are, yet was without sin.
aov_text: Want ons het nie ’n hoëpriester wat nie met ons swakhede medelye kan hê nie, maar een wat in alle opsigte versoek is net soos ons, maar sonder sonde.

kjv_text: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.
bsb_text: Let us then approach the throne of grace with confidence, so that we may receive mercy and find grace to help us in our time of need.
aov_text: Laat ons dan met vrymoedigheid na die troon van die genade gaan, sodat ons barmhartigheid kan verkry en genade vind om op die regte tyd gehelp te word.

kjv_text: For every high priest taken from among men is ordained for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins:
bsb_text: Every high priest is appointed from among men to represent them in matters relating to God, to offer gifts and sacrifices for sins.
aov_text: WANT elke hoëpriester wat uit die mense geneem word, tree ten behoewe van mense op in die dinge wat in betrekking tot God staan, om gawes en offers vir die sondes te bring

kjv_text: Who can have compassion on the ignorant, and on them that are out of the way; for that he himself also is compassed with infirmity.
bsb_text: He is able to deal gently with those who are ignorant and misguided, since he himself is beset by weakness.
aov_text: as een wat kan saamvoel met die onwetendes en dwalendes, omdat hy self ook met swakheid bevange is.

kjv_text: And by reason hereof he ought, as for the people, so also for himself, to offer for sins.
bsb_text: That is why he is obligated to offer sacrifices for his own sins, as well as for the sins of the people.
aov_text: En daarom juis moet hy, net soos vir die volk, so ook vir homself vanweë die sondes offer.

kjv_text: And no man taketh this honour unto himself, but he that is called of God, as was Aaron.
bsb_text: No one takes this honor upon himself; he must be called by God, just as Aaron was.
aov_text: En niemand neem die waardigheid vir homself nie, maar hy wat deur God geroep word, net soos Aäron.

kjv_text: So also Christ glorified not himself to be made an high priest; but he that said unto him, Thou art my Son, to day have I begotten thee.
bsb_text: So also Christ did not take upon Himself the glory of becoming a high priest, but He was called by the One who said to Him: “You are My Son; today I have become Your Father.”
aov_text: So het Christus ook Homself nie verheerlik om Hoëpriester te word nie, maar Hý het Hom verheerlik wat vir Hom gesê het: U is my Seun, vandag het Ek U gegenereer.

kjv_text: As he saith also in another place, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
bsb_text: And in another passage God says: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”
aov_text: Soos Hy ook op ’n ander plek sê: U is priester vir ewig volgens die orde van Melgisédek.

kjv_text: Who in the days of his flesh, when he had offered up prayers and supplications with strong crying and tears unto him that was able to save him from death, and was heard in that he feared;
bsb_text: During the days of Jesus’ earthly life, He offered up prayers and petitions with loud cries and tears to the One who could save Him from death, and He was heard because of His reverence.
aov_text: Hy wat in die dae van sy vlees gebede en smekinge met sterk geroep en trane aan Hóm geoffer het wat Hom uit die dood kon red, en ook verhoor is uit die angs  —

kjv_text: Though he were a Son, yet learned he obedience by the things which he suffered;
bsb_text: Although He was a Son, He learned obedience from what He suffered.
aov_text: Hy, al was Hy die Seun, het gehoorsaamheid geleer uit wat Hy gely het;

kjv_text: And being made perfect, he became the author of eternal salvation unto all them that obey him;
bsb_text: And having been made perfect, He became the source of eternal salvation to all who obey Him
aov_text: en nadat Hy volmaak is, het Hy vir almal wat Hom gehoorsaam is, ’n bewerker van ewige saligheid geword

kjv_text: Called of God an high priest after the order of Melchisedec.
bsb_text: and was designated by God as high priest in the order of Melchizedek.
aov_text: en is deur God genoem ’n hoëpriester volgens die orde van Melgisédek;

kjv_text: Of whom we have many things to say, and hard to be uttered, seeing ye are dull of hearing.
bsb_text: We have much to say about this, but it is hard to explain, because you are dull of hearing.
aov_text: waaroor ons veel te sê het wat swaar is om te verklaar, omdat julle traag geword het om te hoor.

kjv_text: For when for the time ye ought to be teachers, ye have need that one teach you again which be the first principles of the oracles of God; and are become such as have need of milk, and not of strong meat.
bsb_text: Although by this time you ought to be teachers, you need someone to reteach you the basic principles of God’s word. You need milk, not solid food!
aov_text: Want hoewel julle vanweë die tyd leraars behoort te wees, het julle weer nodig dat ’n mens julle die eerste beginsels van die woorde van God moet leer, en julle het weer behoefte aan melk en nie aan vaste spys nie.

kjv_text: For every one that useth milk is unskilful in the word of righteousness: for he is a babe.
bsb_text: For everyone who lives on milk is still an infant, inexperienced in the message of righteousness.
aov_text: Want elkeen wat melk gebruik, is onervare in die woord van geregtigheid, omdat hy ’n kind is.

kjv_text: But strong meat belongeth to them that are of full age, even those who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern both good and evil.
bsb_text: But solid food is for the mature, who by constant use have trained their senses to distinguish good from evil.
aov_text: Maar vaste spys is vir volwassenes, vir die wat geestesvermoëns besit deur die gewoonte geoefen, om goed van kwaad te onderskei.

kjv_text: Therefore leaving the principles of the doctrine of Christ, let us go on unto perfection; not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works, and of faith toward God,
bsb_text: Therefore let us leave the elementary teachings about Christ and go on to maturity, not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works, and of faith in God,
aov_text: DAAROM moet ons nie bly by die begin van die prediking aangaande Christus nie, maar na die volmaaktheid voortgaan sonder om weer die fondament te lê van die bekering uit dooie werke en van die geloof in God,

kjv_text: Of the doctrine of baptisms, and of laying on of hands, and of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.
bsb_text: instruction about baptisms, the laying on of hands, the resurrection of the dead, and eternal judgment.
aov_text: van die leer van die doop en van die handoplegging en van die opstanding van die dode en van die ewige oordeel.

kjv_text: And this will we do, if God permit.
bsb_text: And this we will do, if God permits.
aov_text: En dit sal ons doen as God dit toelaat.

kjv_text: For it is impossible for those who were once enlightened, and have tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Ghost,
bsb_text: It is impossible for those who have once been enlightened, who have tasted the heavenly gift, who have shared in the Holy Spirit,
aov_text: Want dit is onmoontlik om die wat eenmaal verlig geword het en die hemelse gawe gesmaak en die Heilige Gees deelagtig geword het,

kjv_text: And have tasted the good word of God, and the powers of the world to come,
bsb_text: who have tasted the goodness of the word of God and the powers of the coming age—
aov_text: en die goeie woord van God gesmaak het en die kragte van die toekomstige wêreld,

kjv_text: If they shall fall away, to renew them again unto repentance; seeing they crucify to themselves the Son of God afresh, and put him to an open shame.
bsb_text: and then have fallen away—to be restored to repentance, because they themselves are crucifying the Son of God all over again and subjecting Him to open shame.
aov_text: en afvallig geword het — om dié weer tot bekering te vernuwe, omdat hulle ten opsigte van hulleself die Seun van God weer kruisig en openlik tot skande maak.

kjv_text: For the earth which drinketh in the rain that cometh oft upon it, and bringeth forth herbs meet for them by whom it is dressed, receiveth blessing from God:
bsb_text: For land that drinks in the rain often falling on it and that produces a crop useful to those for whom it is tended receives the blessing of God.
aov_text: Want die grond wat die reën indrink wat dikwels daarop val, en nuttige plante voortbring ter wille van hulle vir wie dit ook bewerk word, het deel aan die seën van God.

kjv_text: But that which beareth thorns and briers is rejected, and is nigh unto cursing; whose end is to be burned.
bsb_text: But land that produces thorns and thistles is worthless, and its curse is imminent. In the end it will be burned.
aov_text: Maar as dit dorings en distels oplewer, deug dit nie en is naby die vervloeking — die einde daarvan is verbranding.

kjv_text: But, beloved, we are persuaded better things of you, and things that accompany salvation, though we thus speak.
bsb_text: Even though we speak like this, beloved, we are convinced of better things in your case—things that accompany salvation.
aov_text: Maar, geliefdes, ons is aangaande julle van beter dinge oortuig, dinge wat saamhang met die saligheid, al spreek ons ook so.

kjv_text: For God is not unrighteous to forget your work and labour of love, which ye have shewed toward his name, in that ye have ministered to the saints, and do minister.
bsb_text: For God is not unjust. He will not forget your work and the love you have shown for His name as you have ministered to the saints and continue to do so.
aov_text: Want God is nie onregverdig om julle werk te vergeet nie en die liefde-arbeid wat julle betoon het vir sy Naam, omdat julle die heiliges gedien het en nog dien.

kjv_text: And we desire that every one of you do shew the same diligence to the full assurance of hope unto the end:
bsb_text: We want each of you to show this same diligence to the very end, in order to make your hope sure.
aov_text: Maar ons verlang dat elkeen van julle dieselfde ywer mag toon om te kom tot die volkome sekerheid van die hoop tot die einde toe;

kjv_text: That ye be not slothful, but followers of them who through faith and patience inherit the promises.
bsb_text: Then you will not be sluggish, but will imitate those who through faith and patience inherit what has been promised.
aov_text: sodat julle nie traag word nie, maar navolgers van hulle wat deur geloof en lankmoedigheid erfgename van die belofte is.

kjv_text: For when God made promise to Abraham, because he could swear by no greater, he sware by himself,
bsb_text: When God made His promise to Abraham, since He had no one greater to swear by, He swore by Himself,
aov_text: Want toe God aan Abraham die belofte gegee het, het Hy, omdat Hy by geen meerdere kon sweer nie, by Homself gesweer

kjv_text: Saying, Surely blessing I will bless thee, and multiplying I will multiply thee.
bsb_text: saying, “I will surely bless you and multiply your descendants.”
aov_text: en gesê: Voorwaar, Ek sal jou ryklik seën en jou grootliks vermeerder.

kjv_text: And so, after he had patiently endured, he obtained the promise.
bsb_text: And so Abraham, after waiting patiently, obtained the promise.
aov_text: En so het hy die belofte verkry nadat hy geduldig gewag het.

kjv_text: For men verily swear by the greater: and an oath for confirmation is to them an end of all strife.
bsb_text: Men swear by someone greater than themselves, and their oath serves as a confirmation to end all argument.
aov_text: Want mense sweer by een wat meer is, en die eed van bevestiging is vir hulle die einde van alle teëspraak.

kjv_text: Wherein God, willing more abundantly to shew unto the heirs of promise the immutability of his counsel, confirmed it by an oath:
bsb_text: So when God wanted to make the unchanging nature of His purpose very clear to the heirs of the promise, He guaranteed it with an oath.
aov_text: Daarom het God, omdat Hy nog kragtiger aan die erfgename van die belofte die onveranderlikheid van sy raad wou toon, dit met ’n eed gewaarborg;

kjv_text: That by two immutable things, in which it was impossible for God to lie, we might have a strong consolation, who have fled for refuge to lay hold upon the hope set before us:
bsb_text: Thus by two unchangeable things in which it is impossible for God to lie, we who have fled to take hold of the hope set before us may be strongly encouraged.
aov_text: sodat ons deur twee onveranderlike dinge, waarin dit onmoontlik is dat God sou lieg, kragtige bemoediging kan hê, ons wat ontvlug het, om vas te hou aan die hoop wat voorlê;

kjv_text: Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and stedfast, and which entereth into that within the veil;
bsb_text: We have this hope as an anchor for the soul, firm and secure. It enters the inner sanctuary behind the curtain,
aov_text: en ons het dit as ’n anker van die siel wat veilig en vas is en ingaan tot binnekant die voorhangsel

kjv_text: Whither the forerunner is for us entered, even Jesus, made an high priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
bsb_text: where Jesus our forerunner has entered on our behalf. He has become a high priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.
aov_text: waar Jesus as voorloper vir ons ingegaan het, Hy wat volgens die orde van Melgisédek ’n hoëpriester geword het vir ewig.

kjv_text: For this Melchisedec, king of Salem, priest of the most high God, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings, and blessed him;
bsb_text: This Melchizedek was king of Salem and priest of God Most High. He met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him,
aov_text: WANT hierdie Melgisédek was koning van Salem, priester van God, die Allerhoogste, wat vir Abraham tegemoetgegaan het by sy terugkeer toe hy die konings verslaan het, en hom geseën het;

kjv_text: To whom also Abraham gave a tenth part of all; first being by interpretation King of righteousness, and after that also King of Salem, which is, King of peace;
bsb_text: and Abraham apportioned to him a tenth of everything. First, his name means “king of righteousness.” Then also, “king of Salem” means “king of peace.”
aov_text: aan wie Abraham ook ’n tiende deel van alles gegee het — hy was in die eerste plek, volgens uitleg, koning van die geregtigheid en dan ook koning van Salem, dit is koning van vrede;

kjv_text: Without father, without mother, without descent, having neither beginning of days, nor end of life; but made like unto the Son of God; abideth a priest continually.
bsb_text: Without father or mother or genealogy, without beginning of days or end of life, like the Son of God, he remains a priest for all time.
aov_text: sonder vader, sonder moeder, sonder geslagsregister, sonder begin van dae of lewenseinde, maar gelykgestel aan die Seun van God, bly hy priester altyddeur.

kjv_text: Now consider how great this man was, unto whom even the patriarch Abraham gave the tenth of the spoils.
bsb_text: Consider how great Melchizedek was: Even the patriarch Abraham gave him a tenth of the plunder.
aov_text: Let nou op hoe groot hierdie man was, aan wie selfs Abraham, die aartsvader, ’n tiende van die buit gegee het.

kjv_text: And verily they that are of the sons of Levi, who receive the office of the priesthood, have a commandment to take tithes of the people according to the law, that is, of their brethren, though they come out of the loins of Abraham:
bsb_text: Now the law commands the sons of Levi who become priests to collect a tenth from the people—that is, from their brothers—though they too are descended from Abraham.
aov_text: Nou het hulle wat uit die seuns van Levi die priesterskap ontvang, wel ’n gebod om, volgens die wet, van die volk tiendes te neem, dit is van hulle broers, ofskoon hulle uit die lendene van Abraham voortgekom het;

kjv_text: But he whose descent is not counted from them received tithes of Abraham, and blessed him that had the promises.
bsb_text: But Melchizedek, who did not trace his descent from Levi, collected a tenth from Abraham and blessed him who had the promises.
aov_text: maar hy wat nie uit húlle sy geslagsregister aflei nie, het van Abraham tiendes geneem en die besitter van die beloftes geseën.

kjv_text: And without all contradiction the less is blessed of the better.
bsb_text: And indisputably, the lesser is blessed by the greater.
aov_text: Nou word sonder enige teëspraak die mindere deur die meerdere geseën.

kjv_text: And here men that die receive tithes; but there he receiveth them, of whom it is witnessed that he liveth.
bsb_text: In the case of the Levites, mortal men collect the tenth; but in the case of Melchizedek, it is affirmed that he lives on.
aov_text: En hier neem wel sterflike mense tiendes, maar dáár een van wie getuig word dat hy lewe.

kjv_text: And as I may so say, Levi also, who receiveth tithes, payed tithes in Abraham.
bsb_text: And so to speak, Levi, who collects the tenth, paid the tenth through Abraham.
aov_text: En, om so te sê, het ook Levi wat tiendes ontvang, deur Abraham tiendes gegee;

kjv_text: For he was yet in the loins of his father, when Melchisedec met him.
bsb_text: For when Melchizedek met Abraham, Levi was still in the loin of his ancestor.
aov_text: want hy was nog in die lendene van sy vader toe Melgisédek hom tegemoetgegaan het.

kjv_text: If therefore perfection were by the Levitical priesthood, (for under it the people received the law,) what further need was there that another priest should rise after the order of Melchisedec, and not be called after the order of Aaron?
bsb_text: Now if perfection could have been attained through the Levitical priesthood (for on this basis the people received the law), why was there still need for another priest to appear—one in the order of Melchizedek and not in the order of Aaron?
aov_text: As daar dan volkomenheid deur die Levitiese priesterskap was — want met die oog daarop het die volk die wet ontvang — waarom was dit nog nodig dat ’n ander priester moes opstaan volgens die orde van Melgisédek en dat hy dit nie volgens die orde van Aäron genoem word nie?

kjv_text: For the priesthood being changed, there is made of necessity a change also of the law.
bsb_text: For when the priesthood is changed, the law must be changed as well.
aov_text: Want met verandering van die priesterskap kom daar noodsaaklik ook verandering van wet;

kjv_text: For he of whom these things are spoken pertaineth to another tribe, of which no man gave attendance at the altar.
bsb_text: He of whom these things are said belonged to a different tribe, from which no one has ever served at the altar.
aov_text: omdat Hy met die oog op wie hierdie dinge gesê word, aan ’n ander stam behoort het waaruit niemand die altaar bedien het nie.

kjv_text: For it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Juda; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood.
bsb_text: For it is clear that our Lord descended from Judah, a tribe as to which Moses said nothing about priests.
aov_text: Want dit is volkome duidelik dat onse Here uit Juda voortgespruit het, en met betrekking tot hierdie stam het Moses niks gesê van die priesterskap nie.

kjv_text: And it is yet far more evident: for that after the similitude of Melchisedec there ariseth another priest,
bsb_text: And this point is even more clear if another priest like Melchizedek appears,
aov_text: En nog baie duideliker is dit as daar ’n ander priester opstaan na die ewebeeld van Melgisédek,

kjv_text: Who is made, not after the law of a carnal commandment, but after the power of an endless life.
bsb_text: one who has become a priest not by a law of succession, but by the power of an indestructible life.
aov_text: een wat dit geword het nie kragtens die wet van ’n vleeslike gebod nie, maar uit die krag van die onvernietigbare lewe.

kjv_text: For he testifieth, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
bsb_text: For it is testified: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”
aov_text: Want Hy getuig: U is priester vir ewig volgens die orde van Melgisédek.

kjv_text: For there is verily a disannulling of the commandment going before for the weakness and unprofitableness thereof.
bsb_text: So the former commandment is set aside because it was weak and useless
aov_text: Want aan die een kant is daar die opheffing van die voorafgaande gebod weens die swakheid en nutteloosheid daarvan,

kjv_text: For the law made nothing perfect, but the bringing in of a better hope did; by the which we draw nigh unto God.
bsb_text: (for the law made nothing perfect), and a better hope is introduced, by which we draw near to God.

aov_text: maar Hy, omdat Hy vir ewig bly, besit ’n priesterskap wat nie op ander oorgaan nie.

kjv_text: Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto God by him, seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them.

kjv_text: For such an high priest became us, who is holy, harmless, undefiled, separate from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;
bsb_text: Such a high priest truly befits us—One who is holy, innocent, undefiled, set apart from sinners, and exalted above the heavens.

kjv_text: Who needeth not daily, as those high priests, to offer up sacrifice, first for his own sins, and then for the people's: for this he did once, when he offered up himself.
bsb_text: Unlike the other high priests, He does not need to offer daily sacrifices, first for His own sins and then for the sins of the people; He sacrificed for sin once for all when He offered up Himself.

kjv_text: But now hath he obtained a more excellent ministry, by how much also he is the mediator of a better covenant, which was established upon better promises.

kjv_text: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then should no place have been sought for the second.

kjv_text: For finding fault with them, he saith, Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah:

kjv_text: And they shall not teach every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the Lord: for all shall know me, from the least to the greatest.

kjv_text: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness, and their sins and their iniquities will I remember no more.

aov_text: En ook die Heilige Gees gee aan ons getuienis;

kjv_text: This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days, saith the Lord, I will put my laws into their hearts, and in their minds will I write them;
bsb_text: “This is the covenant I will make with them after those days, declares the Lord. I will put My laws in their hearts and inscribe them on their minds.”
aov_text: want nadat Hy tevore gesê het: Dit is die verbond wat Ek met hulle sal sluit ná dié dae, spreek die Here verder: Ek sal my wette gee in hulle hart, en in hulle verstand sal Ek dit inskrywe,

kjv_text: And their sins and iniquities will I remember no more.
bsb_text: Then He adds: “Their sins and lawless acts I will remember no more.”
aov_text: en aan hulle sondes en hulle ongeregtighede sal Ek nooit meer dink nie.

kjv_text: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.
bsb_text: And where these have been forgiven, an offering for sin is no longer needed.
aov_text: Waar daar nou vergifnis van hierdie dinge is, is daar geen offer meer vir die sonde nie.

kjv_text: Having therefore, brethren, boldness to enter into the holiest by the blood of Jesus,
bsb_text: Therefore, brothers, since we have confidence to enter the Most Holy Place by the blood of Jesus,
aov_text: TERWYL ons dan, broeders, vrymoedigheid het om in die heiligdom in te gaan deur die bloed van Jesus

kjv_text: By a new and living way, which he hath consecrated for us, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh;
bsb_text: by the new and living way opened for us through the curtain of His body,
aov_text: op die nuwe en lewende weg wat Hy vir ons ingewy het deur die voorhangsel heen, dit is sy vlees,

kjv_text: And having an high priest over the house of God;
bsb_text: and since we have a great priest over the house of God,
aov_text: en ons ’n groot Priester oor die huis van God het,

kjv_text: Let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and our bodies washed with pure water.
bsb_text: let us draw near with a sincere heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled to cleanse us from a guilty conscience and our bodies washed with pure water.
aov_text: laat ons toetree met ’n waaragtige hart in volle geloofsversekerdheid, die harte deur besprenkeling gereinig van ’n slegte gewete en die liggaam gewas met rein water.

kjv_text: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)
bsb_text: Let us hold resolutely to the hope we profess, for He who promised is faithful.
aov_text: Laat ons die belydenis van die hoop onwankelbaar vashou, want Hy wat dit beloof het, is getrou;

kjv_text: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works:
bsb_text: And let us consider how to spur one another on to love and good deeds.
aov_text: en laat ons op mekaar ag gee om tot liefde en goeie werke aan te spoor;

kjv_text: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another: and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching.
bsb_text: Let us not neglect meeting together, as some have made a habit, but let us encourage one another, and all the more as you see the Day approaching.
aov_text: en laat ons ons onderlinge byeenkoms nie versuim soos sommige die gewoonte het nie, maar laat ons mekaar vermaan, en dit des te meer namate julle die dag sien nader kom.

kjv_text: For if we sin wilfully after that we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remaineth no more sacrifice for sins,
bsb_text: If we deliberately go on sinning after we have received the knowledge of the truth, no further sacrifice for sins remains,
aov_text: Want as ons opsetlik sondig, nadat ons die kennis van die waarheid ontvang het, bly daar geen offer vir die sondes meer oor nie,

kjv_text: But a certain fearful looking for of judgment and fiery indignation, which shall devour the adversaries.
bsb_text: but only a fearful expectation of judgment and of raging fire that will consume all adversaries.
aov_text: maar ’n verskriklike verwagting van oordeel en ’n vuurgloed wat die teëstanders sal verteer.

kjv_text: He that despised Moses' law died without mercy under two or three witnesses:
bsb_text: Anyone who rejected the law of Moses died without mercy on the testimony of two or three witnesses.
aov_text: As iemand die wet van Moses verwerp het, sterf hy sonder ontferming op die getuienis van twee of drie;

kjv_text: Of how much sorer punishment, suppose ye, shall he be thought worthy, who hath trodden under foot the Son of God, and hath counted the blood of the covenant, wherewith he was sanctified, an unholy thing, and hath done despite unto the Spirit of grace?
bsb_text: How much more severely do you think one deserves to be punished who has trampled on the Son of God, profaned the blood of the covenant that sanctified him, and insulted the Spirit of grace?
aov_text: hoeveel swaarder straf, dink julle, sal hy verdien wat die Seun van God vertrap het en die bloed van die testament waardeur hy geheilig is, onrein geag en die Gees van genade gesmaad het?

kjv_text: For we know him that hath said, Vengeance belongeth unto me, I will recompense, saith the Lord. And again, The Lord shall judge his people.
bsb_text: For we know Him who said, “Vengeance is Mine; I will repay,” and again, “The Lord will judge His people.”
aov_text: Want ons ken Hom wat gesê het: My kom die wraak toe, Ek sal vergelde, spreek die Here; en weer: Die Here sal sy volk oordeel.

kjv_text: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
bsb_text: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
aov_text: Vreeslik is dit om te val in die hande van die lewende God.

kjv_text: But call to remembrance the former days, in which, after ye were illuminated, ye endured a great fight of afflictions;
bsb_text: Remember the early days that you were in the light. In those days, you endured a great conflict in the face of suffering.
aov_text: Maar onthou die vorige dae waarin julle, toe julle verlig geword het, ’n groot lydensworsteling deurstaan het,

kjv_text: Partly, whilst ye were made a gazingstock both by reproaches and afflictions; and partly, whilst ye became companions of them that were so used.
bsb_text: Sometimes you were publicly exposed to ridicule and persecution; at other times you were partners with those who were so treated.
aov_text: gedeeltelik omdat julle deur smaad en verdrukkinge ’n skouspel geword het, gedeeltelik omdat julle deelgenote geword het van die wat in so ’n toestand verkeer het.

kjv_text: For ye had compassion of me in my bonds, and took joyfully the spoiling of your goods, knowing in yourselves that ye have in heaven a better and an enduring substance.
bsb_text: You sympathized with those in prison and joyfully accepted the confiscation of your property, knowing that you yourselves had a better and permanent possession.
aov_text: Want julle het ook saam met my gevoel in my boeie, en julle het die berowing van julle goed met blydskap aanvaar, omdat julle geweet het dat julle in julself ’n beter en blywende besitting in die hemele het.

kjv_text: Cast not away therefore your confidence, which hath great recompence of reward.
bsb_text: So do not throw away your confidence; it holds a great reward.
aov_text: Werp dan julle vrymoedigheid, wat ’n groot beloning het, nie weg nie.

kjv_text: For ye have need of patience, that, after ye have done the will of God, ye might receive the promise.
bsb_text: You need to persevere, so that after you have done the will of God, you will receive what He has promised.
aov_text: Want julle het lydsaamheid nodig, om, nadat julle die wil van God gedoen het, die belofte te verkry.

kjv_text: For yet a little while, and he that shall come will come, and will not tarry.
bsb_text: For, “In just a little while, He who is coming will come and will not delay.
aov_text: Want nog ’n klein tydjie, en Hy wat kom, sal kom en nie versuim nie.

kjv_text: Now the just shall live by faith: but if any man draw back, my soul shall have no pleasure in him.
bsb_text: But My righteous one will live by faith; and if he shrinks back, I will take no pleasure in him.”
aov_text: Maar die regverdige sal uit die geloof lewe; en as hy hom onttrek, het my siel geen welbehae in hom nie.

kjv_text: But we are not of them who draw back unto perdition; but of them that believe to the saving of the soul.
bsb_text: But we are not of those who shrink back and are destroyed, but of those who have faith and preserve their souls.
aov_text: Maar by ons is daar geen onttrekking tot verderf nie, maar geloof tot behoud van die lewe.

kjv_text: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
bsb_text: Now faith is the assurance of what we hope for and the certainty of what we do not see.
aov_text: DIE geloof dan is ’n vaste vertroue op die dinge wat ons hoop, ’n bewys van die dinge wat ons nie sien nie.

kjv_text: For by it the elders obtained a good report.
bsb_text: This is why the ancients were commended.
aov_text: Want daardeur het die mense van die ou tyd getuienis ontvang.

kjv_text: Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God, so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.
bsb_text: By faith we understand that the universe was formed at God’s command, so that what is seen was not made out of what was visible.
aov_text: Deur die geloof verstaan ons dat die wêreld deur die woord van God toeberei is, sodat die dinge wat gesien word, nie ontstaan het uit sienlike dinge nie.

kjv_text: By faith Abel offered unto God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, by which he obtained witness that he was righteous, God testifying of his gifts: and by it he being dead yet speaketh.
bsb_text: By faith Abel offered God a better sacrifice than Cain did. By faith he was commended as righteous when God gave approval to his gifts. And by faith he still speaks, even though he is dead.
aov_text: Deur die geloof het Abel ’n beter offer aan God gebring as Kain, waardeur hy getuienis ontvang het dat hy regverdig was, omdat God oor sy gawes getuienis gegee het; en deur dieselfde geloof spreek hy nog nadat hy dood is.

kjv_text: By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death; and was not found, because God had translated him: for before his translation he had this testimony, that he pleased God.
bsb_text: By faith Enoch was taken up so that he did not see death: “He could not be found, because God had taken him away.” For before he was taken, he was commended as one who pleased God.
aov_text: Deur die geloof is Henog weggeneem om die dood nie te sien nie; en hy is nie gevind nie, omdat God hom weggeneem het; want voor sy wegneming het hy getuienis ontvang dat hy God behaag het.

kjv_text: But without faith it is impossible to please him: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
bsb_text: And without faith it is impossible to please God, because anyone who approaches Him must believe that He exists and that He rewards those who earnestly seek Him.
aov_text: En sonder geloof is dit onmoontlik om God te behaag; want hy wat tot God gaan, moet glo dat Hy is en ’n beloner is van die wat Hom soek.

kjv_text: By faith Noah, being warned of God of things not seen as yet, moved with fear, prepared an ark to the saving of his house; by the which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is by faith.
bsb_text: By faith Noah, when warned about things not yet seen, in godly fear built an ark to save his family. By faith he condemned the world and became heir of the righteousness that comes by faith.
aov_text: Deur die geloof het Noag, toe hy ’n goddelike waarskuwing ontvang het aangaande wat nog nie gesien was nie, met eerbiedige vrees die ark gereed gemaak tot redding van sy huisgesin, waardeur hy die wêreld veroordeel het en ’n erfgenaam geword het van die geregtigheid wat volgens die geloof is.

kjv_text: By faith Abraham, when he was called to go out into a place which he should after receive for an inheritance, obeyed; and he went out, not knowing whither he went.
bsb_text: By faith Abraham, when called to go to a place he would later receive as his inheritance, obeyed and went, without knowing where he was going.
aov_text: Deur die geloof het Abraham, toe hy geroep is, gehoorsaam weggetrek na die plek wat hy as ’n erfenis sou ontvang; en hy het weggetrek sonder om te weet waar hy sou kom.

kjv_text: By faith he sojourned in the land of promise, as in a strange country, dwelling in tabernacles with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise:
bsb_text: By faith he dwelt in the promised land as a stranger in a foreign country. He lived in tents, as did Isaac and Jacob, who were heirs with him of the same promise.
aov_text: Deur die geloof het hy as vreemdeling gaan woon in die land van belofte soos in ’n vreemde land en in tente gewoon met Isak en Jakob, die mede-erfgename van dieselfde belofte.

kjv_text: For he looked for a city which hath foundations, whose builder and maker is God.
bsb_text: For he was looking forward to the city with foundations, whose architect and builder is God.
aov_text: Want hy het die stad verwag wat fondamente het, waarvan God die boumeester en oprigter is.

kjv_text: Through faith also Sara herself received strength to conceive seed, and was delivered of a child when she was past age, because she judged him faithful who had promised.
bsb_text: By faith Sarah, even though she was barren and beyond the proper age, was enabled to conceive a child, because she considered Him faithful who had promised.
aov_text: Deur die geloof het Sara self ook krag ontvang om bevrug te word; en toe sy oor die leeftyd was, het sy gebaar, omdat sy Hom getrou geag het wat dit beloof het.

kjv_text: Therefore sprang there even of one, and him as good as dead, so many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as the sand which is by the sea shore innumerable.
bsb_text: And so from one man, and he as good as dead, came descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky and as countless as the sand on the seashore.
aov_text: Daarom is daar ook gebore uit een vader, en dit ’n verstorwene, kinders soos sterre van die hemel in menigte en soos die sand aan die strand van die see, wat ontelbaar is.

kjv_text: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them afar off, and were persuaded of them, and embraced them, and confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.
bsb_text: All these people died in faith, without having received the things they were promised. However, they saw them and welcomed them from afar. And they acknowledged that they were strangers and exiles on the earth.
aov_text: In die geloof het hulle almal gesterwe sonder om die beloftes te verkry, maar hulle het dit uit die verte gesien en geglo en begroet, en het bely dat hulle vreemdelinge en bywoners op aarde was.

kjv_text: For they that say such things declare plainly that they seek a country.
bsb_text: Now those who say such things show that they are seeking a country of their own.
aov_text: Want die wat sulke dinge sê, verklaar dat hulle ’n vaderland soek.

kjv_text: And truly, if they had been mindful of that country from whence they came out, they might have had opportunity to have returned.
bsb_text: If they had been thinking of the country they had left, they would have had opportunity to return.
aov_text: En as hulle bly dink het aan dié vaderland waaruit hulle weggetrek het, sou hulle geleentheid gehad het om terug te keer.

kjv_text: But now they desire a better country, that is, an heavenly: wherefore God is not ashamed to be called their God: for he hath prepared for them a city.
bsb_text: Instead, they were longing for a better country, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed to be called their God, for He has prepared a city for them.
aov_text: Maar nou verlang hulle na ’n beter een, dit is ’n hemelse. Daarom skaam God Hom nie vir hulle om hulle God genoem te word nie, want Hy het vir hulle ’n stad berei.

kjv_text: By faith Abraham, when he was tried, offered up Isaac: and he that had received the promises offered up his only begotten son,
bsb_text: By faith Abraham, when he was tested, offered up Isaac on the altar. He who had received the promises was ready to offer his one and only son,
aov_text: Deur die geloof het Abraham, toe hy op die proef gestel is, Isak geoffer; ja, hy wat die beloftes ontvang het, het sy eniggeborene geoffer,

kjv_text: Of whom it was said, That in Isaac shall thy seed be called:
bsb_text: even though God had said to him, “Through Isaac your offspring will be reckoned.”
aov_text: aan wie gesê is: In Isak sal jou nageslag genoem word —

kjv_text: Accounting that God was able to raise him up, even from the dead;
bsb_text: Abraham reasoned that God could raise the dead,
aov_text: want hy het gereken dat God mag het om selfs uit die dode op te wek;

kjv_text: from whence also he received him in a figure.
bsb_text: and in a sense, he did receive Isaac back from death.
aov_text: daaruit het hy hom ook, om so te spreek, terug ontvang.

kjv_text: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning things to come.
bsb_text: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning the future.
aov_text: Deur die geloof het Isak vir Jakob en Esau geseën met die oog op die toekoms.

kjv_text: By faith Jacob, when he was a dying, blessed both the sons of Joseph; and worshipped, leaning upon the top of his staff.
bsb_text: By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of Joseph’s sons and worshiped as he leaned on the top of his staff.
aov_text: Deur die geloof het Jakob op sy sterfbed altwee die seuns van Josef geseën; en hy het aanbid terwyl hy leun op die knop van sy staf.

kjv_text: By faith Joseph, when he died, made mention of the departing of the children of Israel; and gave commandment concerning his bones.
bsb_text: By faith Joseph, when his end was near, spoke about the exodus of the Israelites and gave instructions about his bones.
aov_text: Deur die geloof het Josef aan die einde van sy lewe melding gemaak van die uittog van die kinders van Israel en bevel gegee aangaande sy gebeente.

kjv_text: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hid three months of his parents, because they saw he was a proper child; and they were not afraid of the king's commandment.
bsb_text: By faith Moses’ parents hid him for three months after his birth, because they saw that he was a beautiful child, and they were unafraid of the king’s edict.
aov_text: Deur die geloof is Moses ná sy geboorte deur sy ouers drie maande lank weggesteek, omdat hulle gesien het dat die seuntjie mooi was; en hulle het nie die gebod van die koning gevrees nie.

kjv_text: By faith Moses, when he was come to years, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter;
bsb_text: By faith Moses, when he was grown, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter.
aov_text: Deur die geloof het Moses, toe hy grootgeword het, geweier om die seun van Farao se dogter genoem te word,

kjv_text: Choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season;
bsb_text: He chose to suffer oppression with God’s people rather than to experience the fleeting enjoyment of sin.
aov_text: omdat hy verkies het om liewer sleg behandel te word saam met die volk van God as om ’n tyd lank die genot van die sonde te hê,

kjv_text: Esteeming the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures in Egypt: for he had respect unto the recompence of the reward.
bsb_text: He valued disgrace for Christ above the treasures of Egypt, for he was looking ahead to his reward.
aov_text: en die smaad van Christus groter rykdom geag het as die skatte van Egipte, want hy het uitgesien na die beloning.

kjv_text: By faith he forsook Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king: for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.
bsb_text: By faith Moses left Egypt, not fearing the king’s anger; he persevered because he saw Him who is invisible.
aov_text: Deur die geloof het hy Egipte verlaat sonder om die toorn van die koning te vrees, want hy het volgehou soos een wat die Onsienlike sien.

kjv_text: Through faith he kept the passover, and the sprinkling of blood, lest he that destroyed the firstborn should touch them.
bsb_text: By faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of blood, so that the destroyer of the firstborn would not touch Israel’s own firstborn.
aov_text: Deur die geloof het hy die pasga gehou en die besprenkeling van die bloed, sodat die verderwer hulle eersgeborenes nie sou aanraak nie.

kjv_text: By faith they passed through the Red sea as by dry land: which the Egyptians assaying to do were drowned.
bsb_text: By faith the people passed through the Red Sea as on dry land; but when the Egyptians tried to follow, they were drowned.
aov_text: Deur die geloof het hulle die Rooi See deurgegaan soos oor droë grond, terwyl die Egiptenaars, toe hulle dit probeer, verdrink het.

kjv_text: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down, after they were compassed about seven days.
bsb_text: By faith the walls of Jericho fell, after the people had marched around them for seven days.
aov_text: Deur die geloof het die mure van Jérigo geval nadat daar sewe dae lank omheen getrek was.

kjv_text: By faith the harlot Rahab perished not with them that believed not, when she had received the spies with peace.
bsb_text: By faith the prostitute Rahab, because she welcomed the spies in peace, did not perish with those who were disobedient.
aov_text: Deur die geloof het Ragab, die hoer, nie saam met die ongehoorsames omgekom nie, omdat sy die spioene in vrede ontvang het.

kjv_text: And what shall I more say? for the time would fail me to tell of Gedeon, and of Barak, and of Samson, and of Jephthae; of David also, and Samuel, and of the prophets:
bsb_text: And what more shall I say? Time will not allow me to tell of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets,
aov_text: En wat sal ek nog meer sê? Want die tyd sal my ontbreek as ek van Gídeon, Barak en Simson en Jefta, Dawid en Samuel en die profete sou verhaal,

kjv_text: Who through faith subdued kingdoms, wrought righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,
bsb_text: who through faith conquered kingdoms, administered justice, and gained what was promised; who shut the mouths of lions,
aov_text: wat deur die geloof koninkryke oorweldig het, geregtigheid uitgeoefen, beloftes verkry, bekke van leeus toegestop,

kjv_text: Quenched the violence of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, out of weakness were made strong, waxed valiant in fight, turned to flight the armies of the aliens.
bsb_text: quenched the raging fire, and escaped the edge of the sword; who gained strength from weakness, became mighty in battle, and put foreign armies to flight.
aov_text: die krag van vuur uitgeblus, die skerpte van die swaard ontvlug, krag uit swakheid ontvang het, dapper gewees het in die oorlog, leërs van vreemdes op die vlug gedryf het.

kjv_text: Women received their dead raised to life again: and others were tortured, not accepting deliverance; that they might obtain a better resurrection:
bsb_text: Women received back their dead, raised to life again. Others were tortured and refused their release, so that they might gain a better resurrection.
aov_text: Vroue het hulle dode deur opstanding teruggekry, en ander is gefolter en wou geen bevryding aanneem nie, om ’n beter opstanding te kan verkry.

kjv_text: And others had trial of cruel mockings and scourgings, yea, moreover of bonds and imprisonment:
bsb_text: Still others endured mocking and flogging, and even chains and imprisonment.
aov_text: Ander weer het die proef van bespottinge en géselinge deurstaan, ook van boeie en gevangenis.

kjv_text: They were stoned, they were sawn asunder, were tempted, were slain with the sword: they wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins; being destitute, afflicted, tormented;
bsb_text: They were stoned, they were sawed in two, they were put to death by the sword. They went around in sheepskins and goatskins, destitute, oppressed, and mistreated.
aov_text: Hulle is gestenig, in stukke gesaag, versoek, deur die swaard vermoor. Hulle het rondgeloop in skaapvelle en in bokvelle; hulle het gebrek gely, hulle is verdruk, mishandel  —

kjv_text: (Of whom the world was not worthy:) they wandered in deserts, and in mountains, and in dens and caves of the earth.
bsb_text: The world was not worthy of them. They wandered in deserts and mountains, and hid in caves and holes in the ground.
aov_text: die wêreld was hulle nie werd nie — hulle het in woestyne rondgedwaal en op berge en in spelonke en skeure in die grond.

kjv_text: And these all, having obtained a good report through faith, received not the promise:
bsb_text: These were all commended for their faith, yet they did not receive what was promised.
aov_text: En alhoewel hulle almal deur die geloof getuienis ontvang het, het hulle die belofte nie verkry nie,

kjv_text: God having provided some better thing for us, that they without us should not be made perfect.
bsb_text: God had planned something better for us, so that together with us they would be made perfect.
aov_text: omdat God iets beters oor ons beskik het, sodat hulle nie sonder ons volmaak sou word nie.

kjv_text: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,
bsb_text: Therefore, since we are surrounded by such a great cloud of witnesses, let us throw off every encumbrance and the sin that so easily entangles, and let us run with endurance the race set out for us.
aov_text: DAAROM dan, terwyl ons so ’n groot wolk van getuies rondom ons het, laat ons ook elke las aflê en die sonde wat ons so maklik omring, en met volharding die wedloop loop wat voor ons lê,

kjv_text: Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.
bsb_text: Let us fix our eyes on Jesus, the author and perfecter of our faith, who for the joy set before Him endured the cross, scorning its shame, and sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
aov_text: die oog gevestig op Jesus, die Leidsman en Voleinder van die geloof, wat vir die vreugde wat Hom voorgehou is, die kruis verdra het, die skande verag het en aan die regterkant van die troon van God gaan sit het.

kjv_text: For consider him that endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, lest ye be wearied and faint in your minds.
bsb_text: Consider Him who endured such hostility from sinners, so that you will not grow weary and lose heart.
aov_text: Want julle moet ag gee op Hom wat so ’n teëspraak van die sondaars teen Hom verdra het, sodat julle in jul siele nie vermoeid word en verslap nie.

kjv_text: Ye have not yet resisted unto blood, striving against sin.
bsb_text: In your struggle against sin, you have not yet resisted to the point of shedding your blood.
aov_text: Julle het nog nie ten bloede toe weerstand gebied in julle stryd teen die sonde nie.

kjv_text: And ye have forgotten the exhortation which speaketh unto you as unto children, My son, despise not thou the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when thou art rebuked of him:
bsb_text: And you have forgotten the exhortation that addresses you as sons: “My son, do not take lightly the discipline of the Lord, and do not lose heart when He rebukes you.
aov_text: En julle het die vermaning heeltemal vergeet wat tot julle as seuns spreek: My seun, ag die tugtiging van die Here nie gering nie en beswyk nie as jy deur Hom bestraf word nie;

kjv_text: For whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth, and scourgeth every son whom he receiveth.
bsb_text: For the Lord disciplines the one He loves, and He chastises every son He receives.”
aov_text: want die Here tugtig hom wat Hy liefhet, en Hy kasty elke seun wat Hy aanneem.

kjv_text: If ye endure chastening, God dealeth with you as with sons; for what son is he whom the father chasteneth not?
bsb_text: Endure suffering as discipline; God is treating you as sons. For what son is not disciplined by his father?
aov_text: As julle die tugtiging verdra, behandel God julle as seuns; want watter seun is daar wat die vader nie tugtig nie?

kjv_text: But if ye be without chastisement, whereof all are partakers, then are ye bastards, and not sons.
bsb_text: If you do not experience discipline like everyone else, then you are illegitimate children and not true sons.
aov_text: Maar as julle sonder tugtiging is, wat almal deelagtig geword het, dan is julle onegte kinders en nie seuns nie.

kjv_text: Furthermore we have had fathers of our flesh which corrected us, and we gave them reverence: shall we not much rather be in subjection unto the Father of spirits, and live?
bsb_text: Furthermore, we have all had earthly fathers who disciplined us, and we respected them. Should we not much more submit to the Father of our spirits and live?
aov_text: Verder, ons het ons vaders na die vlees as kastyders gehad, en ons het vir hulle ontsag gehad; moet ons nie veel meer aan die Vader van die geeste onderworpe wees en lewe nie?

kjv_text: For they verily for a few days chastened us after their own pleasure; but he for our profit, that we might be partakers of his holiness.
bsb_text: Our fathers disciplined us for a short time as they thought best, but God disciplines us for our good, so that we may share in His holiness.
aov_text: Want húlle het ons wel ’n kort tydjie na hulle beste wete getugtig; maar Hy tot ons beswil, sodat ons sy heiligheid kan deelagtig word.

kjv_text: Now no chastening for the present seemeth to be joyous, but grievous: nevertheless afterward it yieldeth the peaceable fruit of righteousness unto them which are exercised thereby.
bsb_text: No discipline seems enjoyable at the time, but painful. Later on, however, it yields a harvest of righteousness and peace to those who have been trained by it.
aov_text: Nou lyk elke tugtiging of dit op die oomblik nie ’n saak van blydskap is nie, maar van droefheid; later lewer dit egter ’n vredevolle vrug van geregtigheid vir die wat daardeur geoefen is.

kjv_text: Wherefore lift up the hands which hang down, and the feeble knees;
bsb_text: Therefore strengthen your limp hands and weak knees.
aov_text: Daarom, rig die slap hande en die verlamde knieë weer op;

kjv_text: And make straight paths for your feet, lest that which is lame be turned out of the way; but let it rather be healed.
bsb_text: Make straight paths for your feet, so that the lame may not be disabled, but rather healed.
aov_text: en maak reguit paaie vir julle voete, sodat wat kreupel is, nie uit lit raak nie, maar liewer gesond gemaak word.

kjv_text: Follow peace with all men, and holiness, without which no man shall see the Lord:
bsb_text: Pursue peace with everyone, as well as holiness, without which no one will see the Lord.
aov_text: Jaag die vrede na met almal, en die heiligmaking waarsonder niemand die Here sal sien nie;

kjv_text: Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and thereby many be defiled;
bsb_text: See to it that no one falls short of the grace of God, and that no root of bitterness springs up to cause trouble and defile many.
aov_text: en pas op dat niemand in die genade van God veragter nie; dat geen wortel van bitterheid opskiet en onrus verwek en baie hierdeur besoedel word nie.

kjv_text: Lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright.
bsb_text: See to it that no one is sexually immoral, or is godless like Esau, who for a single meal sold his birthright.
aov_text: Laat niemand ’n hoereerder wees nie, of ’n onheilige soos Esau, wat vir één spysgereg sy eersgeboortereg verkoop het.

kjv_text: For ye know how that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected: for he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears.
bsb_text: For you know that afterward, when he wanted to inherit the blessing, he was rejected. He could find no ground for repentance, though he sought the blessing with tears.
aov_text: Want julle weet dat hy, toe hy ook later die seën wou beërwe, verwerp is, want hy het geen geleentheid vir berou gevind nie, al het hy dit met trane vurig begeer.

kjv_text: For ye are not come unto the mount that might be touched, and that burned with fire, nor unto blackness, and darkness, and tempest,
bsb_text: For you have not come to a mountain that can be touched and that is burning with fire; to darkness, gloom, and storm;
aov_text: Want julle het nie gekom by ’n tasbare berg nie en ’n brandende vuur en donkerheid en duisternis en storm

kjv_text: And the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which voice they that heard intreated that the word should not be spoken to them any more:
bsb_text: to a trumpet blast or to a voice that made its hearers beg that no further word be spoken.
aov_text: en basuingeklank en die geluid van woorde waarby die hoorders gesmeek het dat hulle geen woord meer sou toegevoeg word nie  —

kjv_text: (For they could not endure that which was commanded, And if so much as a beast touch the mountain, it shall be stoned, or thrust through with a dart:
bsb_text: For they could not bear what was commanded: “If even an animal touches the mountain, it must be stoned.”
aov_text: want hulle kon die gebod nie verdra nie: selfs as ’n dier die berg aanraak, moet dit gestenig word of met ’n pyl neergeskiet word.

kjv_text: And so terrible was the sight, that Moses said, I exceedingly fear and quake:)
bsb_text: The sight was so terrifying that even Moses said, “I am trembling with fear.”
aov_text: En Moses, so vreeslik was die gesig, het gesê: Ek is verskrik en ek sidder.

kjv_text: But ye are come unto mount Sion, and unto the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to an innumerable company of angels,
bsb_text: Instead, you have come to Mount Zion, to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem. You have come to myriads of angels
aov_text: Maar julle het gekom by die berg Sion en die stad van die lewende God, die hemelse Jerusalem en tienduisende engele,

kjv_text: To the general assembly and church of the firstborn, which are written in heaven, and to God the Judge of all, and to the spirits of just men made perfect,
bsb_text: in joyful assembly, to the congregation of the firstborn, enrolled in heaven. You have come to God the Judge of all, to the spirits of the righteous made perfect,
aov_text: by die feestelike vergadering en die gemeente van eersgeborenes wat in die hemele opgeskrywe is, en by God, die Regter van almal, en by die geeste van die volmaakte regverdiges,

kjv_text: And to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling, that speaketh better things than that of Abel.
bsb_text: to Jesus the mediator of a new covenant, and to the sprinkled blood that speaks a better word than the blood of Abel.
aov_text: en by Jesus, die Middelaar van die nuwe testament, en die bloed van die besprenkeling wat van beter dinge spreek as Abel.

kjv_text: See that ye refuse not him that speaketh. For if they escaped not who refused him that spake on earth, much more shall not we escape, if we turn away from him that speaketh from heaven:
bsb_text: See to it that you do not refuse Him who speaks. For if the people did not escape when they refused Him who warned them on earth, how much less will we escape if we reject Him who warns us from heaven?
aov_text: Pas op dat julle Hom wat spreek, nie afwys nie; want as húlle nie ontvlug het nie wat Hom afgewys het toe Hy op aarde ’n goddelike waarskuwing gegee het, veel minder óns wat ons van Hom afkeer nou dat Hy uit die hemele spreek.

kjv_text: Whose voice then shook the earth: but now he hath promised, saying, Yet once more I shake not the earth only, but also heaven.
bsb_text: At that time His voice shook the earth, but now He has promised, “Once more I will shake not only the earth, but heaven as well.”
aov_text: Toe het sy stem die aarde geskud; maar nou het Hy belowe en gesê: Nog een maal laat Ek nie alleen die aarde nie, maar ook die hemel bewe.

kjv_text: And this word, Yet once more, signifieth the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that are made, that those things which cannot be shaken may remain.
bsb_text: The words “Once more” signify the removal of what can be shaken—that is, created things—so that the unshakable may remain.
aov_text: En hierdie woord: nog een maal, wys duidelik op die verandering van die wankelbare dinge as geskape dinge, sodat die onwankelbare kan bly.

kjv_text: Wherefore we receiving a kingdom which cannot be moved, let us have grace, whereby we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear:
bsb_text: Therefore, since we are receiving an unshakable kingdom, let us be filled with gratitude, and so worship God acceptably with reverence and awe.
aov_text: Daarom, omdat ons ’n onwankelbare koninkryk ontvang, laat ons dankbaar wees, en so God welbehaaglik dien met eerbied en vrees.

kjv_text: For our God is a consuming fire.
bsb_text: “For our God is a consuming fire.”
aov_text: Want onse God is ’n verterende vuur.

kjv_text: Let brotherly love continue.
bsb_text: Continue in brotherly love.
aov_text: DIE broederliefde moet bly.

kjv_text: Be not forgetful to entertain strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.
bsb_text: Do not neglect to show hospitality to strangers, for by so doing some people have entertained angels without knowing it.
aov_text: Vergeet die gasvryheid nie, want daardeur het sommige, sonder om dit te weet, engele as gaste geherberg.

kjv_text: Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them; and them which suffer adversity, as being yourselves also in the body.
bsb_text: Remember those in prison as if you were bound with them, and those who are mistreated as if you were suffering with them.
aov_text: Dink aan die gevangenes asof julle medegevangenes is, en aan die wat mishandel word, as mense wat self ook ’n liggaam het.

kjv_text: Marriage is honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but whoremongers and adulterers God will judge.
bsb_text: Marriage should be honored by all and the marriage bed kept undefiled, for God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.
aov_text: Laat die huwelik in alle opsigte eerbaar wees en die bed onbesmet; want God sal hoereerders en egbrekers oordeel.

kjv_text: Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.
bsb_text: Keep your lives free from the love of money and be content with what you have, for God has said: “Never will I leave you, never will I forsake you.”
aov_text: Julle gedrag moet vry van geldgierigheid wees. Wees tevrede met wat julle het, want Hy het gesê: Ek sal jou nooit begewe en jou nooit verlaat nie.

kjv_text: So that we may boldly say, The Lord is my helper, and I will not fear what man shall do unto me.
bsb_text: So we say with confidence: “The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?”
aov_text: Daarom kan ons met alle vrymoedigheid sê: Die Here is vir my ’n Helper, en ek sal nie vrees nie; wat sal ’n mens aan my doen?

kjv_text: Remember them which have the rule over you, who have spoken unto you the word of God: whose faith follow, considering the end of their conversation.
bsb_text: Remember your leaders who spoke the word of God to you. Consider the outcome of their way of life and imitate their faith.
aov_text: Gedenk julle voorgangers wat die woord van God aan julle verkondig het; aanskou die uiteinde van hulle lewenswandel en volg hulle geloof na.

kjv_text: Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.
bsb_text: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.
aov_text: Jesus Christus is gister en vandag dieselfde en tot in ewigheid.

kjv_text: Be not carried about with divers and strange doctrines. For it is a good thing that the heart be established with grace; not with meats, which have not profited them that have been occupied therein.
bsb_text: Do not be carried away by all kinds of strange teachings, for it is good for the heart to be strengthened by grace and not by foods of no value to those devoted to them.
aov_text: Moenie rondgeslinger word deur allerhande en vreemde leringe nie; want dit is goed dat die hart versterk word deur genade, nie deur voedsel nie, waarvan die wat daarin gewandel het, geen voordeel gehad het nie.

kjv_text: We have an altar, whereof they have no right to eat which serve the tabernacle.
bsb_text: We have an altar from which those who serve at the tabernacle have no right to eat.
aov_text: Ons het ’n altaar waarvan die wat die tabernakel bedien, geen reg het om te eet nie;

kjv_text: For the bodies of those beasts, whose blood is brought into the sanctuary by the high priest for sin, are burned without the camp.
bsb_text: Although the high priest brings the blood of animals into the Holy Place as a sacrifice for sin, the bodies are burned outside the camp.
aov_text: want die diere waarvan die bloed vir die sonde deur die hoëpriester in die heiligdom ingedra word — hulle liggame word buitekant die laer verbrand.

kjv_text: Wherefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people with his own blood, suffered without the gate.
bsb_text: And so Jesus also suffered outside the city gate, to sanctify the people by His own blood.
aov_text: Daarom het Jesus ook, om die volk deur sy eie bloed te heilig, buitekant die poort gely.

kjv_text: Let us go forth therefore unto him without the camp, bearing his reproach.
bsb_text: Therefore let us go to Him outside the camp, bearing the disgrace He bore.
aov_text: Laat ons dan uitgaan na Hom toe buitekant die laer en sy smaad dra.

kjv_text: For here have we no continuing city, but we seek one to come.
bsb_text: For here we do not have a permanent city, but we are looking for the city that is to come.
aov_text: Want ons het hier geen blywende stad nie, maar ons soek die toekomstige.

kjv_text: By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of our lips giving thanks to his name.
bsb_text: Through Jesus, therefore, let us continually offer to God a sacrifice of praise, the fruit of lips that confess His name.
aov_text: Laat ons dan gedurig deur Hom aan God ’n lofoffer bring, dit is die vrug van die lippe wat sy Naam bely.

kjv_text: But to do good and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.
bsb_text: And do not neglect to do good and to share with others, for with such sacrifices God is pleased.
aov_text: Vergeet die weldadigheid en mededeelsaamheid nie, want God het ’n welbehae aan sulke offers.

kjv_text: Obey them that have the rule over you, and submit yourselves: for they watch for your souls, as they that must give account, that they may do it with joy, and not with grief: for that is unprofitable for you.
bsb_text: Obey your leaders and submit to them, for they watch over your souls as those who must give an account. To this end, allow them to lead with joy and not with grief, for that would be of no advantage to you.
aov_text: Wees gehoorsaam aan julle voorgangers en onderdanig, want hulle waak vir julle siele as diegene wat rekenskap moet gee, sodat hulle dit met blydskap kan doen en nie al sugtende nie; want dit is vir julle nie nuttig nie.

kjv_text: Pray for us: for we trust we have a good conscience, in all things willing to live honestly.
bsb_text: Pray for us; we are convinced that we have a clear conscience and desire to live honorably in every way.
aov_text: Bid vir ons, want ons is oortuig dat ons ’n goeie gewete het, omdat ons in alles goed wil wandel.

kjv_text: But I beseech you the rather to do this, that I may be restored to you the sooner.
bsb_text: And I especially urge you to pray that I may be restored to you soon.
aov_text: Des te meer vermaan ek julle om dit te doen, sodat ek gouer aan julle teruggegee kan word.

kjv_text: Now the God of peace, that brought again from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great shepherd of the sheep, through the blood of the everlasting covenant,
bsb_text: Now may the God of peace, who through the blood of the eternal covenant brought back from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great Shepherd of the sheep,
aov_text: MAG die God van die vrede, wat die groot Herder van die skape, naamlik onse Here Jesus Christus, deur die bloed van die ewige testament uit die dode teruggebring het,

kjv_text: Make you perfect in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is wellpleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ; to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
bsb_text: equip you with every good thing to do His will. And may He accomplish in us what is pleasing in His sight through Jesus Christ, to whom be glory forever and ever. Amen.
aov_text: julle volmaak in elke goeie werk, om sy wil te doen, deur in julle te werk wat welbehaaglik is voor Hom deur Jesus Christus aan wie die heerlikheid toekom tot in alle ewigheid! Amen.

kjv_text: And I beseech you, brethren, suffer the word of exhortation: for I have written a letter unto you in few words.
bsb_text: I urge you, brothers, to bear with my word of exhortation, for I have only written to you briefly.
aov_text: En ek vermaan julle, broeders, verdra die woord van vermaning, want ek het ook maar kort aan julle geskrywe.

kjv_text: Know ye that our brother Timothy is set at liberty; with whom, if he come shortly, I will see you.
bsb_text: Be aware that our brother Timothy has been released. If he arrives soon, I will come with him to see you.
aov_text: Julle moet weet dat die broeder Timótheüs vrygelaat is, saam met wie ek julle sal sien as hy spoedig kom.

kjv_text: Salute all them that have the rule over you, and all the saints. They of Italy salute you.
bsb_text: Greet all your leaders and all the saints. Those from Italy send you greetings.
aov_text: Groet al julle voorgangers en al die heiliges. Die wat van Italië is, groet julle.

kjv_text: Grace be with you all. Amen.
bsb_text: Grace be with all of you.
aov_text: Die genade sy met julle almal! Amen.

kjv_text: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad, greeting.
bsb_text: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, To the twelve tribes of the Dispersion: Greetings.
aov_text: JAKOBUS, ’n dienskneg van God en die Here Jesus Christus, aan die twaalf stamme wat in die verstrooiing is: Groete!

kjv_text: My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations;
bsb_text: Consider it pure joy, my brothers, when you encounter trials of many kinds,
aov_text: AG dit louter vreugde, my broeders, wanneer julle in allerhande versoekinge val,

kjv_text: Knowing this, that the trying of your faith worketh patience.
bsb_text: because you know that the testing of your faith develops perseverance.
aov_text: omdat julle weet dat die beproewing van julle geloof lydsaamheid bewerk.

kjv_text: But let patience have her perfect work, that ye may be perfect and entire, wanting nothing.
bsb_text: Allow perseverance to finish its work, so that you may be mature and complete, not lacking anything.
aov_text: Maar die lydsaamheid moet tot volle verwerkliking kom, sodat julle volmaak en sonder gebrek kan wees en in niks kortkom nie.

kjv_text: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
bsb_text: Now if any of you lacks wisdom, he should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault, and it will be given to him.
aov_text: En as iemand van julle wysheid kortkom, laat hom dit van God bid, wat aan almal eenvoudig gee sonder om te verwyt, en dit sal aan hom gegee word.

kjv_text: But let him ask in faith, nothing wavering. For he that wavereth is like a wave of the sea driven with the wind and tossed.
bsb_text: But he must ask in faith, without doubting, because he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, blown and tossed by the wind.
aov_text: Maar hy moet in die geloof bid, sonder om te twyfel; want hy wat twyfel, is soos ’n golf van die see wat deur die wind gedrywe en voortgesweep word.

kjv_text: For let not that man think that he shall receive any thing of the Lord.
bsb_text: That man should not expect to receive anything from the Lord.
aov_text: Want dié mens moenie dink dat hy iets van die Here sal ontvang nie  —

kjv_text: A double minded man is unstable in all his ways.
bsb_text: He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.
aov_text: so ’n dubbelhartige man, onbestendig in al sy weë.

kjv_text: Let the brother of low degree rejoice in that he is exalted:
bsb_text: The brother in humble circumstances should exult in his high position.
aov_text: Maar laat die broeder wat gering is, roem in sy hoogheid,

kjv_text: But the rich, in that he is made low: because as the flower of the grass he shall pass away.
bsb_text: But the one who is rich should exult in his low position, because he will pass away like a flower of the field.
aov_text: en die ryke in sy geringheid, want soos ’n blom van die gras sal hy verbygaan.

kjv_text: For the sun is no sooner risen with a burning heat, but it withereth the grass, and the flower thereof falleth, and the grace of the fashion of it perisheth: so also shall the rich man fade away in his ways.
bsb_text: For the sun rises with scorching heat and withers the plant; its flower falls and its beauty is lost. So too, the rich man will fade away in the midst of his pursuits.
aov_text: Want die son gaan op met sy hitte en laat die gras verdor, en sy blom val af, en die sierlikheid van sy gedaante vergaan; so sal die ryke ook in sy weë verwelk.

kjv_text: Blessed is the man that endureth temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord hath promised to them that love him.
bsb_text: Blessed is the man who perseveres under trial, because when he has stood the test, he will receive the crown of life that God has promised to those who love Him.
