aov_text: Salig is die man wat versoeking verdra, want as hy die toets deurstaan het, sal hy die kroon van die lewe ontvang wat die Here beloof het aan die wat Hom liefhet.

kjv_text: Let no man say when he is tempted, I am tempted of God: for God cannot be tempted with evil, neither tempteth he any man:
bsb_text: When tempted, no one should say, “God is tempting me.” For God cannot be tempted by evil, nor does He tempt anyone.
aov_text: Laat niemand, as hy in versoeking kom, sê: Ek word deur God versoek nie. Want God kan deur die kwaad nie versoek word nie, en self versoek Hy niemand nie.

kjv_text: But every man is tempted, when he is drawn away of his own lust, and enticed.
bsb_text: But each one is tempted when by his own evil desires he is lured away and enticed.
aov_text: Maar elkeen word versoek as hy deur sy eie begeerlikheid weggesleep en verlok word.

kjv_text: Then when lust hath conceived, it bringeth forth sin: and sin, when it is finished, bringeth forth death.
bsb_text: Then after desire has conceived, it gives birth to sin; and sin, when it is full-grown, gives birth to death.
aov_text: Daarna, as die begeerlikheid ontvang het, baar dit sonde; en as die sonde tot volle ontwikkeling gekom het, bring dit die dood voort.

kjv_text: Do not err, my beloved brethren.
bsb_text: Do not be deceived, my beloved brothers.
aov_text: Moenie dwaal nie, my geliefde broeders.

kjv_text: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.
bsb_text: Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of the heavenly lights, with whom there is no change or shifting shadow.
aov_text: Elke goeie gif en elke volmaakte gawe daal van bo af neer, van die Vader van die ligte, by wie daar geen verandering of skaduwee van omkering is nie.

kjv_text: Of his own will begat he us with the word of truth, that we should be a kind of firstfruits of his creatures.
bsb_text: He chose to give us birth through the word of truth, that we would be a kind of firstfruits of His creation.
aov_text: Volgens sy wil het Hy ons voortgebring deur die woord van die waarheid, sodat ons as eerstelinge van sy skepsele kan wees.

kjv_text: Wherefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath:
bsb_text: My beloved brothers, understand this: Everyone should be quick to listen, slow to speak, and slow to anger,
aov_text: SO dan, my geliefde broeders, elke mens moet gou wees om te hoor, stadig om te praat, stadig om toornig te word.

kjv_text: For the wrath of man worketh not the righteousness of God.
bsb_text: for man’s anger does not bring about the righteousness that God desires.
aov_text: Want die toorn van ’n man bewerk nie die geregtigheid voor God nie.

kjv_text: Wherefore lay apart all filthiness and superfluity of naughtiness, and receive with meekness the engrafted word, which is able to save your souls.
bsb_text: Therefore, get rid of all moral filth and every expression of evil, and humbly accept the word planted in you, which can save your souls.
aov_text: Daarom, doen afstand van alle vuiligheid en oorvloed van boosheid, en ontvang met sagmoedigheid die ingeplante woord, wat in staat is om julle siele te red.

kjv_text: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
bsb_text: Be doers of the word, and not hearers only. Otherwise, you are deceiving yourselves.
aov_text: En word daders van die woord en nie net hoorders wat julleself bedrieg nie.

kjv_text: For if any be a hearer of the word, and not a doer, he is like unto a man beholding his natural face in a glass:
bsb_text: For anyone who hears the word but does not carry it out is like a man who looks at his face in a mirror,
aov_text: Want as iemand ’n hoorder van die woord is en nie ’n dader nie, dié is soos ’n man wat sy natuurlike gesig in ’n spieël sien;

kjv_text: For he beholdeth himself, and goeth his way, and straightway forgetteth what manner of man he was.
bsb_text: and after observing himself goes away and immediately forgets what he looks like.
aov_text: want hy sien homself en gaan weg en vergeet dadelik hoe hy gelyk het.

kjv_text: But whoso looketh into the perfect law of liberty, and continueth therein, he being not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the work, this man shall be blessed in his deed.
bsb_text: But the one who looks intently into the perfect law of freedom, and continues to do so—not being a forgetful hearer, but an effective doer—he will be blessed in what he does.
aov_text: Maar hy wat diep insien in die volmaakte wet van die vryheid en daarby bly, hy sal, omdat hy nie ’n vergeetagtige hoorder is nie, maar ’n dader van die werk, gelukkig wees in wat hy doen.

kjv_text: If any man among you seem to be religious, and bridleth not his tongue, but deceiveth his own heart, this man's religion is vain.
bsb_text: If anyone considers himself religious and yet does not bridle his tongue, he deceives his heart and his religion is worthless.
aov_text: As iemand onder julle meen dat hy godsdienstig is en sy tong nie in toom hou nie, maar sy hart mislei, die godsdiens van hierdie man is tevergeefs.

kjv_text: Pure religion and undefiled before God and the Father is this, To visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep himself unspotted from the world.
bsb_text: Pure and undefiled religion before our God and Father is this: to care for orphans and widows in their distress, and to keep oneself from being polluted by the world.
aov_text: Reine en onbesmette godsdiens voor God en die Vader is dit: om wese en weduwees in hulle verdrukking te besoek en jou vlekkeloos te bewaar van die wêreld.

kjv_text: My brethren, have not the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Lord of glory, with respect of persons.
bsb_text: My brothers, as you hold out your faith in our glorious Lord Jesus Christ, do not show favoritism.
aov_text: MY broeders, laat julle geloof in onse Here Jesus Christus, die Here van die heerlikheid, nie wees met aanneming van die persoon nie.

kjv_text: For if there come unto your assembly a man with a gold ring, in goodly apparel, and there come in also a poor man in vile raiment;
bsb_text: Suppose a man comes into your meeting wearing a gold ring and fine clothes, and a poor man in shabby clothes also comes in.
aov_text: Want as daar in julle vergadering ’n man inkom met goue ringe aan die vingers, met ’n pragtige kleed aan, en daar kom ook ’n arm man in met vuil klere aan;

kjv_text: And ye have respect to him that weareth the gay clothing, and say unto him, Sit thou here in a good place; and say to the poor, Stand thou there, or sit here under my footstool:
bsb_text: If you lavish attention on the man in fine clothes and say, “Here is a seat of honor,” but say to the poor man, “You must stand” or “Sit at my feet,”
aov_text: en as julle opsien na hom wat die pragtige kleed dra, en vir hom sê: Gaan u op hierdie goeie plek sit, en vir die arme sê julle: Gaan jy daar staan of hier onder my voetbank sit  —

kjv_text: Are ye not then partial in yourselves, and are become judges of evil thoughts?
bsb_text: have you not discriminated among yourselves and become judges with evil thoughts?
aov_text: het julle dan nie by julleself onderskeid gemaak en regters met verkeerde oorlegginge geword nie?

kjv_text: Hearken, my beloved brethren, Hath not God chosen the poor of this world rich in faith, and heirs of the kingdom which he hath promised to them that love him?
bsb_text: Listen, my beloved brothers: Has not God chosen the poor of this world to be rich in faith and to inherit the kingdom He promised those who love Him?
aov_text: Luister, my geliefde broeders — het God nie die armes van hierdie wêreld uitverkies as rykes in die geloof en erfgename van die koninkryk wat Hy beloof het aan die wat Hom liefhet nie?

kjv_text: But ye have despised the poor. Do not rich men oppress you, and draw you before the judgment seats?
bsb_text: But you have dishonored the poor. Is it not the rich who oppress you and drag you into court?
aov_text: Maar julle het die arm man oneer aangedoen. Is dit nie juis die rykes wat julle oorweldig en julle voor die regbanke sleep nie?

kjv_text: Do not they blaspheme that worthy name by the which ye are called?
bsb_text: Are they not the ones who blaspheme the noble name by which you have been called?
aov_text: Is dit nie hulle wat die edele Naam belaster wat oor julle aangeroep is nie?

kjv_text: If ye fulfil the royal law according to the scripture, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself, ye do well:
bsb_text: If you really fulfill the royal law stated in Scripture, “Love your neighbor as yourself,” you are doing well.
aov_text: As julle ewenwel die koninklike wet volbring volgens die Skrif: Jy moet jou naaste liefhê soos jouself — dan doen julle goed.

kjv_text: But if ye have respect to persons, ye commit sin, and are convinced of the law as transgressors.
bsb_text: But if you show favoritism, you sin and are convicted by the law as transgressors.
aov_text: Maar as julle partydig is, doen julle sonde en word deur die wet as oortreders bestraf.

kjv_text: For whosoever shall keep the whole law, and yet offend in one point, he is guilty of all.
bsb_text: Whoever keeps the whole law but stumbles at just one point is guilty of breaking all of it.
aov_text: Want wie die hele wet onderhou, maar in een opsig struikel, het aan almal skuldig geword.

kjv_text: For he that said, Do not commit adultery, said also, Do not kill. Now if thou commit no adultery, yet if thou kill, thou art become a transgressor of the law.
bsb_text: For He who said, “Do not commit adultery,” also said, “Do not murder.” If you do not commit adultery, but do commit murder, you have become a lawbreaker.
aov_text: Want Hy wat gesê het: Jy mag nie egbreek nie, het ook gesê: Jy mag nie doodslaan nie. As jy nou nie egbreek nie, maar doodslaan, het jy ’n oortreder van die wet geword.

kjv_text: So speak ye, and so do, as they that shall be judged by the law of liberty.
bsb_text: Speak and act as those who are going to be judged by the law that gives freedom.
aov_text: Julle moet so spreek en so doen soos diegene wat deur die wet van vryheid geoordeel sal word.

kjv_text: For he shall have judgment without mercy, that hath shewed no mercy; and mercy rejoiceth against judgment.
bsb_text: For judgment without mercy will be shown to anyone who has not been merciful. Mercy triumphs over judgment.
aov_text: Want die oordeel sal onbarmhartig wees oor die wat geen barmhartigheid bewys het nie; en die barmhartigheid roem teen die oordeel.

kjv_text: What doth it profit, my brethren, though a man say he hath faith, and have not works? can faith save him?
bsb_text: What good is it, my brothers, if someone claims to have faith, but has no deeds? Can such faith save him?
aov_text: WAT baat dit, my broeders, as iemand sê dat hy die geloof het, maar hy het nie die werke nie? Dié geloof kan hom tog nie red nie?

kjv_text: If a brother or sister be naked, and destitute of daily food,
bsb_text: Suppose a brother or sister is without clothes and daily food.
aov_text: As daar nou ’n broeder of suster naak is en aan die daaglikse voedsel gebrek het,

kjv_text: And one of you say unto them, Depart in peace, be ye warmed and filled; notwithstanding ye give them not those things which are needful to the body; what doth it profit?
bsb_text: If one of you tells him, “Go in peace; stay warm and well fed,” but does not provide for his physical needs, what good is that?
aov_text: en een uit julle sou vir hulle sê: Gaan heen in vrede, word warm, word versadig, maar julle gee hulle nie wat vir die liggaam nodig is nie — wat baat dit?

kjv_text: Even so faith, if it hath not works, is dead, being alone.
bsb_text: So too, faith by itself, if it does not result in action, is dead.
aov_text: Net so is ook die geloof, as dit geen werke het nie, in sigself dood.

kjv_text: Yea, a man may say, Thou hast faith, and I have works: shew me thy faith without thy works, and I will shew thee my faith by my works.
bsb_text: But someone will say, “You have faith and I have deeds.” Show me your faith without deeds, and I will show you my faith by my deeds.
aov_text: Maar iemand sal sê: Jy het die geloof en ek die werke. Toon my jou geloof uit jou werke, en ek sal jou uit my werke my geloof toon.

kjv_text: Thou believest that there is one God; thou doest well: the devils also believe, and tremble.
bsb_text: You believe that God is one. Good for you! Even the demons believe that—and shudder.
aov_text: Jy glo dat God één is. Jy doen goed; die duiwels glo dit ook, en hulle sidder.

kjv_text: But wilt thou know, O vain man, that faith without works is dead?
bsb_text: O foolish man, do you want evidence that faith without deeds is worthless?
aov_text: Maar wil jy weet, o nietige mens, dat die geloof sonder die werke dood is?

kjv_text: Was not Abraham our father justified by works, when he had offered Isaac his son upon the altar?
bsb_text: Was not our father Abraham justified by what he did when he offered his son Isaac on the altar?
aov_text: Is Abraham, ons vader, nie uit die werke geregverdig toe hy Isak, sy seun, op die altaar geoffer het nie?

kjv_text: Seest thou how faith wrought with his works, and by works was faith made perfect?
bsb_text: You see that his faith was working with his actions, and his faith was perfected by what he did.
aov_text: Sien jy dat die geloof saamgewerk het met sy werke en dat die geloof volkome geword het uit die werke?

kjv_text: And the scripture was fulfilled which saith, Abraham believed God, and it was imputed unto him for righteousness: and he was called the Friend of God.
bsb_text: And the Scripture was fulfilled that says, “Abraham believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness,” and he was called a friend of God.
aov_text: En die Skrif is vervul wat sê: En Abraham het God geglo, en dit is hom tot geregtigheid gereken, en hy is ’n vriend van God genoem.

kjv_text: Ye see then how that by works a man is justified, and not by faith only.
bsb_text: As you can see, a man is justified by his deeds and not by faith alone.
aov_text: Sien julle dan nou dat die mens geregverdig word uit die werke en nie alleen uit die geloof nie?

kjv_text: Likewise also was not Rahab the harlot justified by works, when she had received the messengers, and had sent them out another way?
bsb_text: In the same way, was not even Rahab the prostitute justified by her actions when she welcomed the spies and sent them off on another route?
aov_text: En is Ragab, die hoer, nie ook net so geregverdig uit die werke toe sy die boodskappers ontvang en met ’n ander pad weggestuur het nie?

kjv_text: For as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also.
bsb_text: As the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without deeds is dead.
aov_text: Want soos die liggaam sonder gees dood is, so is ook die geloof sonder die werke dood.

kjv_text: My brethren, be not many masters, knowing that we shall receive the greater condemnation.
bsb_text: Not many of you should become teachers, my brothers, because you know that we who teach will be judged more strictly.
aov_text: MOENIE baie leermeesters wees nie, my broeders, omdat julle weet dat ons ’n groter oordeel sal ondergaan.

kjv_text: For in many things we offend all. If any man offend not in word, the same is a perfect man, and able also to bridle the whole body.
bsb_text: We all stumble in many ways. If anyone is never at fault in what he says, he is a perfect man, able to control his whole body.
aov_text: Want ons almal struikel dikwels. As iemand in woorde nie struikel nie, is hy ’n volmaakte man, in staat om ook die hele liggaam in toom te hou.

kjv_text: Behold, we put bits in the horses' mouths, that they may obey us; and we turn about their whole body.
bsb_text: When we put bits into the mouths of horses to make them obey us, we can guide the whole animal.
aov_text: Kyk, ons sit stange in die perde se bekke, sodat hulle ons gehoorsaam kan wees, en ons stuur hulle hele liggaam daarmee.

kjv_text: Behold also the ships, which though they be so great, and are driven of fierce winds, yet are they turned about with a very small helm, whithersoever the governor listeth.
bsb_text: Consider ships as well. Although they are so large and are driven by strong winds, they are steered by a very small rudder wherever the pilot is inclined.
aov_text: Kyk, ook die skepe, alhoewel hulle so groot is en deur hewige winde voortgedryf word, word gestuur deur ’n baie klein roer net waarheen die stuurman wil.

kjv_text: Even so the tongue is a little member, and boasteth great things. Behold, how great a matter a little fire kindleth!
bsb_text: In the same way, the tongue is a small part of the body, but it boasts of great things. Consider how small a spark sets a great forest ablaze.
aov_text: Net so is die tong ook ’n klein lid en beroem hom op groot dinge — kyk hoe ’n groot hoop hout steek ’n klein vuurtjie aan die brand.

kjv_text: And the tongue is a fire, a world of iniquity: so is the tongue among our members, that it defileth the whole body, and setteth on fire the course of nature; and it is set on fire of hell.
bsb_text: The tongue also is a fire, a world of wickedness among the parts of the body. It pollutes the whole person, sets the course of his life on fire, and is itself set on fire by hell.
aov_text: Die tong is ook ’n vuur, die wêreld van ongeregtigheid. Net so ’n plek neem die tong onder ons lede in; dit besmet die hele liggaam en steek die hele lewensloop aan die brand en word uit die hel aangesteek.

kjv_text: For every kind of beasts, and of birds, and of serpents, and of things in the sea, is tamed, and hath been tamed of mankind:
bsb_text: All kinds of animals, birds, reptiles, and creatures of the sea are being tamed and have been tamed by man,
aov_text: Want elke soort natuur van wilde diere en voëls en kruipende sowel as seediere word getem en is getem deur die menslike natuur.

kjv_text: But the tongue can no man tame; it is an unruly evil, full of deadly poison.
bsb_text: but no man can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.
aov_text: Maar die tong kan geen mens tem nie; dit is ’n onbedwingbare kwaad, vol dodelike gif.

kjv_text: Therewith bless we God, even the Father; and therewith curse we men, which are made after the similitude of God.
bsb_text: With the tongue we bless our Lord and Father, and with it we curse men, who have been made in God’s likeness.
aov_text: Daarmee loof ons God en die Vader, en daarmee vervloek ons die mense wat na die gelykenis van God gemaak is.

kjv_text: Out of the same mouth proceedeth blessing and cursing. My brethren, these things ought not so to be.
bsb_text: Out of the same mouth come blessing and cursing. My brothers, this should not be!
aov_text: Uit dieselfde mond kom seën en vervloeking. Dit, my broeders, behoort nie so te wees nie.

kjv_text: Doth a fountain send forth at the same place sweet water and bitter?
bsb_text: Can both fresh water and salt water flow from the same spring?
aov_text: ’n Fontein laat tog nie uit dieselfde oog vars en bitter water opborrel nie?

kjv_text: Can the fig tree, my brethren, bear olive berries? either a vine, figs? so can no fountain both yield salt water and fresh.
bsb_text: My brothers, can a fig tree grow olives, or a grapevine bear figs? Neither can a salt spring produce fresh water.
aov_text: ’n Vyeboom, my broeders, kan tog nie olywe voortbring, of ’n wingerdstok vye nie? So kan geen fontein brak en vars water voortbring nie.

kjv_text: Who is a wise man and endued with knowledge among you? let him shew out of a good conversation his works with meekness of wisdom.
bsb_text: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show it by his good conduct, by deeds done in the humility that comes from wisdom.
aov_text: WIE is wys en verstandig onder julle? Laat hom uit sy goeie lewenswandel sy werke in sagmoedige wysheid toon.

kjv_text: But if ye have bitter envying and strife in your hearts, glory not, and lie not against the truth.
bsb_text: But if you harbor bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your hearts, do not boast in it or deny the truth.
aov_text: Maar as julle bittere afguns en selfsug in julle hart het, moenie roem en lieg teen die waarheid nie.

kjv_text: This wisdom descendeth not from above, but is earthly, sensual, devilish.
bsb_text: Such wisdom does not come from above, but is earthly, unspiritual, demonic.
aov_text: Dít is nie die wysheid wat van bo kom nie, maar is aards, natuurlik, duiwels;

kjv_text: For where envying and strife is, there is confusion and every evil work.
bsb_text: For where jealousy and selfish ambition exist, there will be disorder and every evil practice.
aov_text: want waar afguns en selfsug is, daar is wanorde en allerhande gemene dade.

kjv_text: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, and easy to be intreated, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.
bsb_text: But the wisdom from above is first of all pure, then peace-loving, gentle, accommodating, full of mercy and good fruit, impartial, and sincere.
aov_text: Maar die wysheid van bo is ten eerste rein, dan vredeliewend, vriendelik, geseglik, vol barmhartigheid en goeie vrugte, onpartydig en ongeveins.

kjv_text: And the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace of them that make peace.
bsb_text: Peacemakers who sow in peace reap the fruit of righteousness.
aov_text: En die vrug van die geregtigheid word gesaai in vrede vir die wat vrede maak.

kjv_text: From whence come wars and fightings among you? come they not hence, even of your lusts that war in your members?
bsb_text: What causes conflicts and quarrels among you? Don’t they come from the passions at war within you?
aov_text: WAARVANDAAN kom oorloë en vegterye onder julle? Kom hulle nie hiervandaan, van julle welluste wat in julle lede stryd voer nie?

kjv_text: Ye lust, and have not: ye kill, and desire to have, and cannot obtain: ye fight and war, yet ye have not, because ye ask not.
bsb_text: You crave what you do not have; you kill and covet, but are unable to obtain it. You quarrel and fight. You do not have, because you do not ask.
aov_text: Julle begeer en julle het nie, julle pleeg moord en is naywerig en julle kan niks verkry nie. Julle veg en maak oorlog, en julle het nie, omdat julle nie bid nie.

kjv_text: Ye ask, and receive not, because ye ask amiss, that ye may consume it upon your lusts.
bsb_text: And when you do ask, you do not receive, because you ask with wrong motives, that you may squander it on your pleasures.
aov_text: Julle bid en julle ontvang nie, omdat julle verkeerd bid, om dit in julle welluste deur te bring.

kjv_text: Ye adulterers and adulteresses, know ye not that the friendship of the world is enmity with God? whosoever therefore will be a friend of the world is the enemy of God.
bsb_text: You adulteresses! Do you not know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God? Therefore, whoever chooses to be a friend of the world renders himself an enemy of God.
aov_text: Egbrekers en egbreeksters, weet julle nie dat die vriendskap van die wêreld vyandskap teen God is nie? Wie dan ’n vriend van die wêreld wil wees, word ’n vyand van God.

kjv_text: Do ye think that the scripture saith in vain, The spirit that dwelleth in us lusteth to envy?
bsb_text: Or do you think the Scripture says without reason that the Spirit He caused to dwell in us yearns with envy?
aov_text: Of meen julle dat die Skrif tevergeefs sê: Met jaloersheid begeer die Gees wat in ons woon?

kjv_text: But he giveth more grace. Wherefore he saith, God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace unto the humble.
bsb_text: But He gives us more grace. This is why it says: “God opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
aov_text: Maar Hy gee groter genade; daarom sê Hy: God weerstaan die hoogmoediges, maar aan die nederiges gee Hy genade.

kjv_text: Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
bsb_text: Submit yourselves, then, to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
aov_text: Onderwerp julle dan aan God; weerstaan die duiwel, en hy sal van julle wegvlug.

kjv_text: Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye double minded.
bsb_text: Draw near to God, and He will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners, and purify your hearts, you double-minded.
aov_text: Nader tot God, en Hy sal tot julle nader. Reinig die hande, julle sondaars, en suiwer die harte, julle dubbelhartiges!

kjv_text: Be afflicted, and mourn, and weep: let your laughter be turned to mourning, and your joy to heaviness.
bsb_text: Grieve, mourn, and weep. Turn your laughter to mourning, and your joy to gloom.
aov_text: Weeklaag, treur en ween. Laat julle gelag in treurigheid verander word en julle blydskap in bedruktheid.

kjv_text: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he shall lift you up.
bsb_text: Humble yourselves before the Lord, and He will exalt you.
aov_text: Verneder julle voor die Here, en Hy sal julle verhoog.

kjv_text: Speak not evil one of another, brethren. He that speaketh evil of his brother, and judgeth his brother, speaketh evil of the law, and judgeth the law: but if thou judge the law, thou art not a doer of the law, but a judge.
bsb_text: Brothers, do not slander one another. Anyone who speaks against his brother or judges him speaks against the law and judges it. And if you judge the law, you are not a practitioner of the law, but a judge of it.
aov_text: Broeders, moenie van mekaar kwaad spreek nie. Die wat kwaad spreek van sy broeder en sy broeder oordeel, spreek kwaad van die wet en oordeel die wet; en as jy die wet oordeel, is jy nie ’n dader van die wet nie, maar ’n regter.

kjv_text: There is one lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy: who art thou that judgest another?
bsb_text: There is only one Lawgiver and Judge, the One who is able to save and destroy. But who are you to judge your neighbor?
aov_text: Een is die Wetgewer, Hy wat mag het om te red en te verderf. Maar jy, wie is jy wat ’n ander oordeel?

kjv_text: Go to now, ye that say, To day or to morrow we will go into such a city, and continue there a year, and buy and sell, and get gain:
bsb_text: Come now, you who say, “Today or tomorrow we will go to this or that city, spend a year there, carry on business, and make a profit.”
aov_text: KOM nou, julle wat sê: Vandag of môre sal ons na dié en dié stad gaan en daar een jaar deurbring en handel drywe en wins maak  —

kjv_text: Whereas ye know not what shall be on the morrow. For what is your life? It is even a vapour, that appeareth for a little time, and then vanisheth away.
bsb_text: You do not even know what will happen tomorrow! What is your life? You are a mist that appears for a little while and then vanishes.
aov_text: julle wat nie eens weet wat môre sal gebeur nie. Want hoedanig is julle lewe? Dit is tog maar ’n damp wat vir ’n kort tydjie verskyn en daarna verdwyn.

kjv_text: For that ye ought to say, If the Lord will, we shall live, and do this, or that.
bsb_text: Instead, you ought to say, “If the Lord is willing, we will live and do this or that.”
aov_text: In plaas dat julle sê: As die Here wil en ons lewe, dan sal ons dit of dat doen.

kjv_text: But now ye rejoice in your boastings: all such rejoicing is evil.
bsb_text: As it is, you boast in your proud intentions. All such boasting is evil.
aov_text: Maar nou roem julle in jul grootpratery. Al sulke roem is verkeerd.

kjv_text: Therefore to him that knoweth to do good, and doeth it not, to him it is sin.
bsb_text: Anyone, then, who knows the right thing to do, yet fails to do it, is guilty of sin.
aov_text: Wie dan weet om goed te doen en dit nie doen nie, vir hom is dit sonde.

kjv_text: Go to now, ye rich men, weep and howl for your miseries that shall come upon you.
bsb_text: Come now, you who are rich, weep and wail over the misery to come upon you.
aov_text: KOM nou, julle rykes, ween en huil oor die ellendes wat oor julle kom.

kjv_text: Your riches are corrupted, and your garments are motheaten.
bsb_text: Your riches have rotted and moths have eaten your clothes.
aov_text: Julle rykdom is bedorwe, en julle klere is deur die motte verniel.

kjv_text: Your gold and silver is cankered; and the rust of them shall be a witness against you, and shall eat your flesh as it were fire. Ye have heaped treasure together for the last days.
bsb_text: Your gold and silver are corroded. Their corrosion will testify against you and consume your flesh like fire. You have hoarded treasure in the last days.
aov_text: Julle goud en silwer is verroes, en hulle roes sal tot ’n getuienis teen julle wees en sal soos ’n vuur julle vlees verteer. Julle het skatte vergader in die laaste dae.

kjv_text: Behold, the hire of the labourers who have reaped down your fields, which is of you kept back by fraud, crieth: and the cries of them which have reaped are entered into the ears of the Lord of sabaoth.
bsb_text: Look, the wages you withheld from the workmen who mowed your fields are crying out against you. The cries of the harvesters have reached the ears of the Lord of Hosts.
aov_text: Kyk, die loon van die arbeiders wat julle lande afgeoes het, wat deur julle agtergehou is, roep uit; en die geroep van die maaiers het gekom tot in die ore van die Here van die leërskare.

kjv_text: Ye have lived in pleasure on the earth, and been wanton; ye have nourished your hearts, as in a day of slaughter.
bsb_text: You have lived on earth in luxury and self-indulgence. You have fattened your hearts in the day of slaughter.
aov_text: Julle het op die aarde ’n weelderige en losbandige lewe gelei; julle het jul harte vet gevoer soos op ’n slagdag.

kjv_text: Ye have condemned and killed the just; and he doth not resist you.
bsb_text: You have condemned and murdered the righteous, who did not resist you.
aov_text: Veroordeel, vermoor het julle die regverdige; hy versit hom nie teen julle nie.

kjv_text: Be patient therefore, brethren, unto the coming of the Lord. Behold, the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth, and hath long patience for it, until he receive the early and latter rain.
bsb_text: Be patient, then, brothers, until the Lord’s coming. See how the farmer awaits the precious fruit of the soil—how patient he is for the fall and spring rains.
aov_text: WEES dan geduldig, broeders, tot op die wederkoms van die Here. Kyk, die landbouer wag op die kostelike vrug van die aarde en het geduld daarmee totdat dit die vroeë en die laat reën ontvang het.

kjv_text: Be ye also patient; stablish your hearts: for the coming of the Lord draweth nigh.
bsb_text: You, too, be patient and strengthen your hearts, because the Lord’s coming is near.
aov_text: Julle moet ook geduldig wees; versterk julle harte, want die wederkoms van die Here is naby.

kjv_text: Grudge not one against another, brethren, lest ye be condemned: behold, the judge standeth before the door.
bsb_text: Do not complain about one another, brothers, so that you will not be judged. Look, the Judge is standing at the door!
aov_text: Moenie teen mekaar sug nie, broeders, sodat julle nie veroordeel word nie. Kyk, die Regter staan voor die deur.

kjv_text: Take, my brethren, the prophets, who have spoken in the name of the Lord, for an example of suffering affliction, and of patience.
bsb_text: Brothers, as an example of patience in affliction, take the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.
aov_text: Neem as voorbeeld van lyding, my broeders, en van geduld die profete wat in die Naam van die Here gespreek het.

kjv_text: Behold, we count them happy which endure. Ye have heard of the patience of Job, and have seen the end of the Lord; that the Lord is very pitiful, and of tender mercy.
bsb_text: See how blessed we consider those who have persevered. You have heard of Job’s perseverance and have seen the outcome from the Lord. The Lord is full of compassion and mercy.
aov_text: Kyk, ons reken hulle geluksalig wat verdra. Julle het gehoor van die lydsaamheid van Job, en julle het die einddoel van die Here met hom gesien, dat die Here vol medelye en ontferming is.

kjv_text: But above all things, my brethren, swear not, neither by heaven, neither by the earth, neither by any other oath: but let your yea be yea; and your nay, nay; lest ye fall into condemnation.
bsb_text: Above all, my brothers, do not swear, not by heaven or earth or by any other oath. Simply let your “Yes” be yes, and your “No,” no, so that you will not fall under judgment.
aov_text: Maar bo alles, my broeders, moenie sweer nie: nie by die hemel nie, ook nie by die aarde nie en ook geen ander eed nie; maar laat julle ja ja wees en julle nee nee, sodat julle nie onder ’n oordeel val nie.

kjv_text: Is any among you afflicted? let him pray. Is any merry? let him sing psalms.
bsb_text: Is any one of you suffering? He should pray. Is anyone cheerful? He should sing praises.
aov_text: Is daar iemand onder julle wat ly? Laat hom bid. Is iemand opgeruimd? Laat hom psalmsing.

kjv_text: Is any sick among you? let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord:
bsb_text: Is any one of you sick? He should call the elders of the church to pray over him and anoint him with oil in the name of the Lord.
aov_text: Is daar iemand siek onder julle? Laat hom die ouderlinge van die gemeente inroep, en laat hulle oor hom bid nadat hulle hom in die Naam van die Here met olie gesalf het.

kjv_text: And the prayer of faith shall save the sick, and the Lord shall raise him up; and if he have committed sins, they shall be forgiven him.
bsb_text: And the prayer offered in faith will restore the one who is sick. The Lord will raise him up. If he has sinned, he will be forgiven.
aov_text: En die gebed van die geloof sal die kranke red, en die Here sal hom oprig. Selfs as hy sonde gedoen het, sal dit hom vergewe word.

kjv_text: Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.
bsb_text: Therefore confess your sins to each other and pray for each other so that you may be healed. The prayer of a righteous man has great power to prevail.
aov_text: Bely mekaar julle misdade en bid vir mekaar, sodat julle gesond kan word. Die vurige gebed van ’n regverdige het groot krag.

kjv_text: Elias was a man subject to like passions as we are, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain: and it rained not on the earth by the space of three years and six months.
bsb_text: Elijah was a man just like us. He prayed earnestly that it would not rain, and it did not rain on the land for three and a half years.
aov_text: Elía was ’n mens net soos ons, en hy het ernstig gebid dat dit nie moes reën nie, en dit het op die aarde drie jaar en ses maande lank nie gereën nie;

kjv_text: And he prayed again, and the heaven gave rain, and the earth brought forth her fruit.
bsb_text: Again he prayed, and the heavens gave rain, and the earth yielded its crops.
aov_text: en hy het weer gebid, en die hemel het reën gegee en die aarde het sy vrug laat uitspruit.

kjv_text: Brethren, if any of you do err from the truth, and one convert him;
bsb_text: My brothers, if one of you should wander from the truth and someone should bring him back,
aov_text: Broeders, as een onder julle van die waarheid afgedwaal het en iemand hom bekeer,

kjv_text: Let him know, that he which converteth the sinner from the error of his way shall save a soul from death, and shall hide a multitude of sins.
bsb_text: consider this: Whoever turns a sinner from the error of his way will save his soul from death and cover over a multitude of sins.
aov_text: laat hy weet dat die een wat ’n sondaar van sy dwaalweg bekeer, ’n siel uit die dood sal red en ’n menigte sondes sal bedek.

kjv_text: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the strangers scattered throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
bsb_text: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, To the elect who are exiles of the Dispersion throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
aov_text: PETRUS, ’n apostel van Jesus Christus, aan die vreemdelinge van die verstrooiing in Pontus, Galásië, Kappadócië, Asië en Bithínië,

kjv_text: Elect
bsb_text: chosen
aov_text: uitverkore

kjv_text: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, through sanctification of the Spirit, unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace unto you, and peace, be multiplied.
bsb_text: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father and sanctified by the Spirit for obedience to Jesus Christ and sprinkling by His blood: Grace and peace be yours in abundance.
aov_text: volgens die voorkennis van God die Vader, in die heiligmaking van die Gees, tot gehoorsaamheid en besprenkeling met die bloed van Jesus Christus: Mag genade en vrede vir julle vermenigvuldig word!

kjv_text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according to his abundant mercy hath begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
bsb_text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! By His great mercy He has given us new birth into a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
aov_text: GESEËND is die God en Vader van onse Here Jesus Christus wat na sy grote barmhartigheid ons die wedergeboorte geskenk het tot ’n lewende hoop deur die opstanding van Jesus Christus uit die dode,

kjv_text: To an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you,
bsb_text: and into an inheritance that is imperishable, undefiled, and unfading, reserved in heaven for you,
aov_text: sodat ons ’n onverganklike en onbesmette en onverwelklike erfenis kan verkry, wat in die hemele bewaar is vir ons

kjv_text: Who are kept by the power of God through faith unto salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
bsb_text: who through faith are shielded by God’s power for the salvation that is ready to be revealed in the last time.
aov_text: wat in die krag van God bewaar word deur die geloof tot die saligheid wat gereed is om geopenbaar te word in die laaste tyd.

kjv_text: Wherein ye greatly rejoice, though now for a season, if need be, ye are in heaviness through manifold temptations:
bsb_text: In this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while you may have had to suffer grief in various trials
aov_text: Daarin verheug julle jul, al word julle nou — as dit nodig is — ’n kort tydjie bedroef onder allerhande beproewinge,

kjv_text: That the trial of your faith, being much more precious than of gold that perisheth, though it be tried with fire, might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ:
bsb_text: so that the proven character of your faith—more precious than gold, which perishes even though refined by fire—may result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ.
aov_text: sodat die beproefdheid van julle geloof, wat baie kosbaarder is as goud wat vergaan maar deur vuur gelouter word, bevind mag word tot lof en eer en heerlikheid by die openbaring van Jesus Christus;

kjv_text: Whom having not seen, ye love; in whom, though now ye see him not, yet believing, ye rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory:
bsb_text: Though you have not seen Him, you love Him; and though you do not see Him now, you believe in Him and rejoice with an inexpressible and glorious joy,
aov_text: vir wie julle, al het julle Hom nie gesien nie, tog liefhet; in wie julle, al sien julle Hom nou nie, tog glo en julle verbly met ’n onuitspreeklike en heerlike blydskap,

kjv_text: Receiving the end of your faith, even the salvation of your souls.
bsb_text: now that you are receiving the goal of your faith, the salvation of your souls.
aov_text: en die einddoel van julle geloof, die saligheid van julle siele, verkry.

kjv_text: Of which salvation the prophets have enquired and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that should come unto you:
bsb_text: Concerning this salvation, the prophets who foretold the grace to come to you searched and investigated carefully,
aov_text: Aangaande hierdie saligheid het die profete wat geprofeteer het oor die genade wat vir julle bestem is, ondersoek en nagevors,

kjv_text: Searching what, or what manner of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them did signify, when it testified beforehand the sufferings of Christ, and the glory that should follow.
bsb_text: trying to determine the time and setting to which the Spirit of Christ in them was pointing when He predicted the sufferings of Christ and the glories to follow.
aov_text: en hulle het nagespeur op watter of hoedanige tyd die Gees van Christus wat in hulle was, gewys het, toe Hy vooruit getuig het van die lyde wat oor Christus sou kom en die heerlikheid daarna.

kjv_text: Unto whom it was revealed, that not unto themselves, but unto us they did minister the things, which are now reported unto you by them that have preached the gospel unto you with the Holy Ghost sent down from heaven; which things the angels desire to look into.
bsb_text: It was revealed to them that they were not serving themselves, but you, when they foretold the things now announced by those who preached the gospel to you by the Holy Spirit sent from heaven. Even angels long to look into these things.
aov_text: Aan hulle is geopenbaar dat hulle nie vir hulleself nie, maar vir ons dié dinge bedien het wat julle nou aangekondig is deur dié wat die evangelie aan julle verkondig het in die Heilige Gees wat van die hemel gestuur is — dinge waarin die engele begerig is om in te sien.

kjv_text: Wherefore gird up the loins of your mind, be sober, and hope to the end for the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Jesus Christ;
bsb_text: Therefore prepare your minds for action. Be sober-minded. Set your hope fully on the grace to be given you at the revelation of Jesus Christ.
aov_text: DAAROM, omgord die lendene van julle verstand, wees nugter en hoop volkome op die genade wat julle deel word by die openbaring van Jesus Christus.

kjv_text: As obedient children, not fashioning yourselves according to the former lusts in your ignorance:
bsb_text: As obedient children, do not conform to the passions of your former ignorance.
aov_text: Soos gehoorsame kinders moet julle nie jul lewe inrig volgens die begeerlikhede wat tevore in julle onwetendheid bestaan het nie.

kjv_text: But as he which hath called you is holy, so be ye holy in all manner of conversation;
bsb_text: But just as He who called you is holy, so be holy in all you do,
aov_text: Maar soos Hy wat julle geroep het, heilig is, moet julle ook in jul hele lewenswandel heilig word,

kjv_text: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
bsb_text: for it is written: “Be holy, because I am holy.”
aov_text: omdat daar geskrywe is: Wees heilig, want Ek is heilig.

kjv_text: And if ye call on the Father, who without respect of persons judgeth according to every man's work, pass the time of your sojourning here in fear:
bsb_text: Since you call on a Father who judges each one’s work impartially, conduct yourselves in reverent fear during your stay as foreigners.
aov_text: En as julle Hom as Vader aanroep wat sonder aanneming van die persoon oordeel volgens elkeen se werk, wandel dan in vrees gedurende die tyd van julle vreemdelingskap;

kjv_text: Forasmuch as ye know that ye were not redeemed with corruptible things, as silver and gold, from your vain conversation received by tradition from your fathers;
bsb_text: For you know that it was not with perishable things such as silver or gold that you were redeemed from the empty way of life you inherited from your forefathers,
aov_text: omdat julle weet dat julle nie deur verganklike dinge, silwer of goud, losgekoop is uit julle ydele lewenswandel wat deur die vaders oorgelewer is nie,

kjv_text: But with the precious blood of Christ, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot:
bsb_text: but with the precious blood of Christ, a lamb without blemish or spot.
aov_text: maar deur die kosbare bloed van Christus, soos van ’n lam sonder gebrek en vlekkeloos,

kjv_text: Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,
bsb_text: He was known before the foundation of the world, but was revealed in the last times for your sake.
aov_text: wat wel vooruit geken is voor die grondlegging van die wêreld, maar in hierdie laaste tye geopenbaar is om julle ontwil,

kjv_text: Who by him do believe in God, that raised him up from the dead, and gave him glory; that your faith and hope might be in God.
bsb_text: Through Him you believe in God, who raised Him from the dead and glorified Him; and so your faith and hope are in God.
aov_text: julle wat deur Hom glo in God wat Hom uit die dode opgewek en Hom heerlikheid gegee het, sodat julle geloof en hoop op God kan wees.

kjv_text: Seeing ye have purified your souls in obeying the truth through the Spirit unto unfeigned love of the brethren, see that ye love one another with a pure heart fervently:
bsb_text: Since you have purified your souls by obedience to the truth so that you have a genuine love for your brothers, love one another deeply, from a pure heart.
aov_text: As julle in gehoorsaamheid aan die waarheid julle siele deur die Gees tot ongeveinsde broederliefde gereinig het, moet julle mekaar vurig liefhê uit ’n rein hart;

kjv_text: Being born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, by the word of God, which liveth and abideth for ever.
bsb_text: For you have been born again, not of perishable seed, but of imperishable, through the living and enduring word of God.
aov_text: want julle is wedergebore nie uit verganklike saad nie, maar uit onverganklike, deur die lewende woord van God wat tot in ewigheid bly.

kjv_text: For all flesh is as grass, and all the glory of man as the flower of grass. The grass withereth, and the flower thereof falleth away:
bsb_text: For, “All flesh is like grass, and all its glory like the flowers of the field; the grass withers and the flowers fall,
aov_text: Want alle vlees is soos gras, en al die heerlikheid van die mens soos ’n blom van die gras. Die gras verdor en sy blom val af,

kjv_text: But the word of the Lord endureth for ever. And this is the word which by the gospel is preached unto you.
bsb_text: but the word of the Lord stands forever.” And this is the word that was proclaimed to you.
aov_text: maar die woord van die Here bly tot in ewigheid. En dit is die woord wat aan julle verkondig is.

kjv_text: Wherefore laying aside all malice, and all guile, and hypocrisies, and envies, and all evil speakings,
bsb_text: Rid yourselves, therefore, of all malice, deceit, hypocrisy, envy, and slander.
aov_text: LÊ dan af alle boosheid en alle bedrog en geveinsdheid en afguns en alle kwaadpratery;

kjv_text: As newborn babes, desire the sincere milk of the word, that ye may grow thereby:
bsb_text: Like newborn babies, crave pure spiritual milk, so that by it you may grow up in your salvation,
aov_text: en verlang sterk soos pasgebore kindertjies na die onvervalste melk van die woord, dat julle daardeur kan opgroei,

kjv_text: If so be ye have tasted that the Lord is gracious.
bsb_text: now that you have tasted that the Lord is good.
aov_text: as julle ten minste gesmaak het dat die Here goedertieren is.

kjv_text: To whom coming, as unto a living stone, disallowed indeed of men, but chosen of God, and precious,
bsb_text: As you come to Him, the living stone, rejected by men but chosen and precious in God’s sight,
aov_text: Kom na Hom toe, die lewende steen wat deur die mense wel verwerp is, maar by God uitverkore en kosbaar is;

kjv_text: Ye also, as lively stones, are built up a spiritual house, an holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God by Jesus Christ.
bsb_text: you also, like living stones, are being built into a spiritual house to be a holy priesthood, offering spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
aov_text: en laat julle ook soos lewende stene opbou, tot ’n geestelike huis, ’n heilige priesterdom, om geestelike offers te bring wat aan God welgevallig is deur Jesus Christus.

kjv_text: Wherefore also it is contained in the scripture, Behold, I lay in Sion a chief corner stone, elect, precious: and he that believeth on him shall not be confounded.
bsb_text: For it stands in Scripture: “See, I lay in Zion a stone, a chosen and precious cornerstone; and the one who believes in Him will never be put to shame.”
aov_text: Daarom staan dit ook in die Skrif: Kyk, Ek lê in Sion ’n uitverkore en kosbare hoeksteen, en die wat in Hom glo, sal nooit beskaam word nie.

kjv_text: Unto you therefore which believe he is precious: but unto them which be disobedient, the stone which the builders disallowed, the same is made the head of the corner,
bsb_text: To you who believe, then, this stone is precious. But to those who do not believe, “The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone,”
aov_text: Vir julle dan wat glo, is Hy kosbaar; maar vir die ongelowiges geld die woord: Die steen wat die bouers verwerp het, dit het 'n hoeksteen geword;

kjv_text: And a stone of stumbling, and a rock of offence,
bsb_text: and, "A stone of stumbling and a rock of offense."

bsb_text: They stumble because they disobey the word—and to this they were appointed.
aov_text: vir dié wat hulle daarteen stamp, omdat hulle aan die woord ongehoorsaam is, waarvoor hulle ook bestem is.

kjv_text: But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:
bsb_text: But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, to proclaim the virtues of Him who called you out of darkness into His marvelous light.
aov_text: Maar julle is ’n uitverkore geslag, ’n koninklike priesterdom, ’n heilige volk, ’n volk as eiendom verkry, om te verkondig die deugde van Hom wat julle uit die duisternis geroep het tot sy wonderbare lig,

kjv_text: Which in time past were not a people, but are now the people of God: which had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.
bsb_text: Once you were not a people, but now you are the people of God; once you had not received mercy, but now you have received mercy.
aov_text: julle wat vroeër geen volk was nie, maar nou die volk van God is; aan wie toe geen barmhartigheid bewys is nie, maar nou bewys is.

kjv_text: Dearly beloved, I beseech you as strangers and pilgrims, abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;
bsb_text: Beloved, I urge you, as foreigners and exiles, to abstain from the desires of the flesh, which war against your soul.
aov_text: GELIEFDES, ek vermaan julle as bywoners en vreemdelinge om julle te onthou van vleeslike begeertes wat stryd voer teen die siel;

kjv_text: Having your conversation honest among the Gentiles: that, whereas they speak against you as evildoers, they may by your good works, which they shall behold, glorify God in the day of visitation.
bsb_text: Conduct yourselves with such honor among the Gentiles that, though they slander you as evildoers, they may see your good deeds and glorify God on the day He visits us.

kjv_text: Submit yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord's sake: whether it be to the king, as supreme;
bsb_text: Submit yourselves for the Lord’s sake to every human institution, whether to the king as the supreme authority,

aov_text: Want so is dit die wil van God dat julle deur goed te doen die onkunde van die dwase mense tot swye sal bring,

bsb_text: Live in freedom, but do not use your freedom as a cover-up for evil; live as servants of God.
aov_text: as vrymense en nie asof julle die vryheid het as ’n dekmantel vir die boosheid nie, maar as diensknegte van God.

bsb_text: Treat everyone with high regard: Love the brotherhood of believers, fear God, honor the king.
aov_text: Julle moet almal eer, die broederskap liefhê, God vrees, die koning eer.

bsb_text: Servants, submit yourselves to your masters with all respect, not only to those who are good and gentle, but even to those who are unreasonable.

bsb_text: How is it to your credit if you are beaten for doing wrong and you endure it? But if you suffer for doing good and you endure it, this is commendable before God.

kjv_text: Who his own self bare our sins in his own body on the tree, that we, being dead to sins, should live unto righteousness: by whose stripes ye were healed.
bsb_text: He Himself bore our sins in His body on the tree, so that we might die to sin and live to righteousness. “By His stripes you are healed.”
aov_text: wat self ons sondes in sy liggaam op die kruishout gedra het, sodat ons die sondes kan afsterwe en vir die geregtigheid lewe; deur wie se wonde julle genees is.

kjv_text: For ye were as sheep going astray; but are now returned unto the Shepherd and Bishop of your souls.
bsb_text: For “you were like sheep going astray,” but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.
aov_text: Want julle was soos dwalende skape, maar nou het julle teruggekeer na die Herder en Opsiener van julle siele.

kjv_text: Likewise, ye wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; that, if any obey not the word, they also may without the word be won by the conversation of the wives;
bsb_text: Wives, in the same way, submit yourselves to your husbands, so that even if they refuse to believe the word, they will be won over without words by the behavior of their wives
aov_text: NET so moet julle, vroue, aan jul eie mans onderdanig wees, sodat, as sommige aan die woord ongehoorsaam is, hulle ook deur die wandel van die vroue sonder woorde gewin kan word

kjv_text: While they behold your chaste conversation coupled with fear.
bsb_text: when they see your pure and reverent demeanor.
aov_text: as hulle jul reine, godvresende wandel aanskou het.

kjv_text: Whose adorning let it not be that outward adorning of plaiting the hair, and of wearing of gold, or of putting on of apparel;
bsb_text: Your beauty should not come from outward adornment, such as braided hair or gold jewelry or fine clothes,
aov_text: Julle versiering moet nie uiterlik wees nie: haarvlegtery en omhang van goud en aantrek van klere nie,

kjv_text: But let it be the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price.
bsb_text: but from the inner disposition of your heart, the unfading beauty of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is precious in God’s sight.
aov_text: maar die verborge mens van die hart in die onverganklike versiering van ’n sagmoedige en stille gees, wat baie kosbaar is voor God.

kjv_text: For after this manner in the old time the holy women also, who trusted in God, adorned themselves, being in subjection unto their own husbands:
bsb_text: For this is how the holy women of the past adorned themselves. They put their hope in God and were submissive to their husbands,
aov_text: Want so het vroeër ook die heilige vroue wat op God gehoop het, hulleself versier, en hulle was aan hul eie mans onderdanig,

kjv_text: Even as Sara obeyed Abraham, calling him lord: whose daughters ye are, as long as ye do well, and are not afraid with any amazement.
bsb_text: just as Sarah obeyed Abraham and called him lord. And you are her children if you do what is right and refuse to give way to fear.
aov_text: soos Sara gehoorsaam was aan Abraham en hom heer genoem het; wie se kinders julle geword het as julle goed doen en geen enkele verskrikking vrees nie.

kjv_text: Likewise, ye husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge, giving honour unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel, and as being heirs together of the grace of life; that your prayers be not hindered.
bsb_text: Husbands, in the same way, treat your wives with consideration as a delicate vessel, and with honor as fellow heirs of the gracious gift of life, so that your prayers will not be hindered.
aov_text: Net so moet julle, manne, verstandig met hulle saamlewe en aan die vroulike geslag, as die swakkere, eer bewys, omdat julle ook mede-erfgename van die genade van die lewe is — sodat julle gebede nie verhinder mag word nie.

kjv_text: Finally, be ye all of one mind, having compassion one of another, love as brethren, be pitiful, be courteous:
bsb_text: Finally, all of you, be like-minded and sympathetic, love as brothers, be tenderhearted and humble.
aov_text: EN eindelik, wees almal eensgesind, medelydend, vol broederliefde en ontferming, vriendelik.

kjv_text: Not rendering evil for evil, or railing for railing: but contrariwise blessing; knowing that ye are thereunto called, that ye should inherit a blessing.
bsb_text: Do not repay evil with evil or insult with insult, but with blessing, because to this you were called so that you may inherit a blessing.
aov_text: Vergeld geen kwaad met kwaad of skeldwoorde met skeldwoorde nie, maar seën inteendeel, omdat julle weet dat julle hiertoe geroep is, sodat julle seën kan beërwe.

kjv_text: For he that will love life, and see good days, let him refrain his tongue from evil, and his lips that they speak no guile:
bsb_text: For, “Whoever would love life and see good days must keep his tongue from evil and his lips from deceitful speech.
aov_text: Want wie die lewe wil liefhê en goeie dae wil sien, moet sy tong bewaar vir wat verkeerd is, en sy lippe dat hulle geen bedrog spreek nie.

kjv_text: Let him eschew evil, and do good; let him seek peace, and ensue it.
bsb_text: He must turn from evil and do good; he must seek peace and pursue it.
aov_text: Hy moet afwyk van wat verkeerd is, en doen wat goed is; hy moet vrede soek en dit najaag.

kjv_text: For the eyes of the Lord are over the righteous, and his ears are open unto their prayers: but the face of the Lord is against them that do evil.
bsb_text: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and His ears are inclined to their prayer. But the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”
aov_text: Want die oë van die Here is op die regverdiges en sy ore tot hulle gebed, maar die aangesig van die Here is teen die kwaaddoeners.

kjv_text: And who is he that will harm you, if ye be followers of that which is good?
bsb_text: Who can harm you if you are zealous for what is good?
aov_text: En wie is dit wat julle kwaad sal aandoen as julle navolgers is van die goeie?

kjv_text: But and if ye suffer for righteousness' sake, happy are ye: and be not afraid of their terror, neither be troubled;
bsb_text: But even if you should suffer for what is right, you are blessed. “Do not fear what they fear; do not be shaken.”
aov_text: Maar as julle ook moet ly ter wille van die geregtigheid, salig is julle. En vrees hulle glad nie, en wees nie ontsteld nie.

kjv_text: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you
bsb_text: But in your hearts sanctify Christ as Lord. Always be prepared to give a defense to everyone who asks you the reason for the hope that is in you.
aov_text: Maar heilig die Here God in julle harte en wees altyd bereid om verantwoording te doen aan elkeen wat van julle rekenskap eis omtrent die hoop wat in julle is,

kjv_text: with meekness and fear:
bsb_text: But respond with gentleness and respect,
aov_text: met sagmoedigheid en vrees;

kjv_text: Having a good conscience; that, whereas they speak evil of you, as of evildoers, they may be ashamed that falsely accuse your good conversation in Christ.
bsb_text: keeping a clear conscience, so that those who slander you may be put to shame by your good behavior in Christ.
aov_text: met behoud van ’n goeie gewete, sodat in die saak waarin hulle van julle kwaad spreek soos van kwaaddoeners, húlle beskaam mag word wat julle goeie lewenswandel in Christus belaster.

kjv_text: For it is better, if the will of God be so, that ye suffer for well doing, than for evil doing.
bsb_text: For it is better, if it is God’s will, to suffer for doing good than for doing evil.
aov_text: Want dit is beter, as die wil van God dit eis, dat julle ly wanneer julle goed doen as wanneer julle kwaad doen.

kjv_text: For Christ also hath once suffered for sins, the just for the unjust, that he might bring us to God, being put to death in the flesh, but quickened by the Spirit:
bsb_text: For Christ also suffered for sins once for all, the righteous for the unrighteous, to bring you to God. He was put to death in the body but made alive in the Spirit,
aov_text: Want Christus het ook eenmaal vir die sondes gely, Hy die Regverdige vir die onregverdiges, om ons tot God te bring — Hy wat wel gedood is na die vlees, maar lewend gemaak deur die Gees;

kjv_text: By which also he went and preached unto the spirits in prison;
bsb_text: in whom He also went and preached to the spirits in prison
aov_text: in wie Hy ook heengegaan en gepreek het vir die geeste in die gevangenis,

kjv_text: Which sometime were disobedient, when once the longsuffering of God waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was a preparing, wherein few, that is, eight souls were saved by water.
bsb_text: who disobeyed long ago when God waited patiently in the days of Noah while the ark was being built. In the ark a few people, only eight souls, were saved through water.
aov_text: wat eertyds ongehoorsaam was toe die lankmoedigheid van God eenmaal gewag het in die dae van Noag, onderwyl die ark gereed gemaak is, waarin weinig, dit is agt, siele deur water heen gered is;

kjv_text: The like figure whereunto even baptism doth also now save us (not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God,) by the resurrection of Jesus Christ:
bsb_text: And this water symbolizes the baptism that now saves you also—not the removal of dirt from the body, but the pledge of a clear conscience toward God—through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,
aov_text: waarvan die teëbeeld, die doop, ons nou ook red, nie as ’n aflegging van die vuilheid van die vlees nie, maar as ’n bede tot God om ’n goeie gewete — deur die opstanding van Jesus Christus

kjv_text: Who is gone into heaven, and is on the right hand of God; angels and authorities and powers being made subject unto him.
bsb_text: who has gone into heaven and is at the right hand of God, with angels, authorities, and powers subject to Him.
aov_text: wat heengegaan het na die hemel en aan die regterhand van God is, terwyl engele en magte en kragte aan Hom onderwerp is.

kjv_text: Forasmuch then as Christ hath suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves likewise with the same mind: for he that hath suffered in the flesh hath ceased from sin;
bsb_text: Therefore, since Christ suffered in His body, arm yourselves with the same resolve, because anyone who has suffered in his body is done with sin.
aov_text: OMDAT Christus dan vir ons na die vlees gely het, moet julle jul ook wapen met dieselfde gedagte, dat wie na die vlees gely het, opgehou het met die sonde,

kjv_text: That he no longer should live the rest of his time in the flesh to the lusts of men, but to the will of God.
bsb_text: Consequently, he does not live out his remaining time on earth for human passions, but for the will of God.
aov_text: om die orige tyd in die vlees nie meer volgens die begeerlikhede van die mense te leef nie, maar volgens die wil van God.

kjv_text: For the time past of our life may suffice us to have wrought the will of the Gentiles, when we walked in lasciviousness, lusts, excess of wine, revellings, banquetings, and abominable idolatries:
bsb_text: For you have spent enough time in the past carrying out the same desires as the Gentiles: living in debauchery, lust, drunkenness, orgies, carousing, and detestable idolatry.
aov_text: Want dit is genoeg dat ons die afgelope lewenstyd die wil van die heidene volbring het deur te wandel in ongebondenheid, begeerlikheid, dronkenskap, brasserye, drinkpartye en ongeoorloofde afgoderye.

kjv_text: Wherein they think it strange that ye run not with them to the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you:
bsb_text: Because of this, they consider it strange of you not to plunge with them into the same flood of reckless indiscretion, and they heap abuse on you.
aov_text: Daarom vind hulle dit vreemd as julle nie saam loop in dieselfde uitgieting van losbandigheid nie, en hulle laster.

kjv_text: Who shall give account to him that is ready to judge the quick and the dead.
bsb_text: But they will have to give an account to Him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.
aov_text: Hulle sal rekenskap gee aan Hom wat gereed staan om die lewende en die dode te oordeel.

kjv_text: For for this cause was the gospel preached also to them that are dead, that they might be judged according to men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.
bsb_text: That is why the gospel was preached even to those who are now dead, so that they might be judged as men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.
aov_text: Want daarom is ook aan die dode die evangelie verkondig, sodat hulle wel geoordeel kan word na die mens in die vlees, maar lewe na God in die gees.

kjv_text: But the end of all things is at hand: be ye therefore sober, and watch unto prayer.
bsb_text: The end of all things is near. Therefore be clear-minded and sober, so that you can pray.
aov_text: En die einde van alle dinge is naby; wees dan ingetoë en nugter, om te kan bid.

kjv_text: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins.
bsb_text: Above all, love one another deeply, because love covers over a multitude of sins.
aov_text: Maar bo alles moet julle mekaar vurig liefhê, want die liefde sal ’n menigte sondes bedek.

kjv_text: Use hospitality one to another without grudging.
bsb_text: Show hospitality to one another without complaining.
aov_text: Wees gasvry jeens mekaar sonder om te murmureer.

kjv_text: As every man hath received the gift, even so minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.
bsb_text: As good stewards of the manifold grace of God, each of you should use whatever gift he has received to serve one another.
aov_text: Namate elkeen ’n genadegawe ontvang het, moet julle mekaar daarmee dien soos goeie bedienaars van die veelvuldige genade van God.

kjv_text: If any man speak, let him speak as the oracles of God; if any man minister, let him do it as of the ability which God giveth: that God in all things may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be praise and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
bsb_text: If anyone speaks, he should speak as one conveying the words of God. If anyone serves, he should serve with the strength God provides, so that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.
aov_text: As iemand spreek, laat dit wees soos woorde van God; as iemand dien, laat dit wees soos uit die krag wat God verleen, sodat God in alles verheerlik kan word deur Jesus Christus, aan wie die heerlikheid en krag toekom tot in alle ewigheid. Amen.

kjv_text: Beloved, think it not strange concerning the fiery trial which is to try you, as though some strange thing happened unto you:
bsb_text: Beloved, do not be surprised at the fiery trial that has come upon you, as though something strange were happening to you.
aov_text: Geliefdes, verbaas julle nie oor die vuurgloed van vervolging onder julle wat tot julle beproewing dien, asof iets vreemds oor julle kom nie;

kjv_text: But rejoice, inasmuch as ye are partakers of Christ's sufferings; that, when his glory shall be revealed, ye may be glad also with exceeding joy.
bsb_text: But rejoice that you share in the sufferings of Christ, so that you may be overjoyed at the revelation of His glory.
aov_text: maar namate julle gemeenskap het aan die lyde van Christus, moet julle bly wees, sodat julle ook by die openbaring van sy heerlikheid met blydskap kan jubel.

kjv_text: If ye be reproached for the name of Christ, happy are ye; for the spirit of glory and of God resteth upon you: on their part he is evil spoken of, but on your part he is glorified.
bsb_text: If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you.
aov_text: As julle beledig word oor die Naam van Christus, is julle gelukkig, omdat die Gees van die heerlikheid en van God op julle rus. Wat hulle betref, word Hy wel gelaster; maar wat julle betref, word Hy verheerlik.

kjv_text: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or as a thief, or as an evildoer, or as a busybody in other men's matters.
bsb_text: Indeed, none of you should suffer as a murderer or thief or wrongdoer, or even as a meddler.
aov_text: Want niemand van julle moet ly as moordenaar of dief of kwaaddoener of as een wat hom met die sake van ’n ander bemoei nie.

kjv_text: Yet if any man suffer as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God on this behalf.
bsb_text: But if you suffer as a Christian, do not be ashamed, but glorify God that you bear that name.
aov_text: Maar wanneer iemand as ’n Christen ly, moet hy hom nie skaam nie, maar God verheerlik in hierdie opsig.

kjv_text: For the time is come that judgment must begin at the house of God: and if it first begin at us, what shall the end be of them that obey not the gospel of God?
bsb_text: For it is time for judgment to begin with the family of God; and if it begins with us, what will the outcome be for those who disobey the gospel of God?
aov_text: Want die tyd is daar dat die oordeel moet begin by die huis van God. En as dit eers by ons begin, wat sal die einde wees van die wat aan die evangelie van God ongehoorsaam is?

kjv_text: And if the righteous scarcely be saved, where shall the ungodly and the sinner appear?
bsb_text: And, “If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will become of the ungodly and the sinner?”
aov_text: En as die regverdige nouliks gered word, waar sal die goddelose en die sondaar verskyn?

kjv_text: Wherefore let them that suffer according to the will of God commit the keeping of their souls to him in well doing, as unto a faithful Creator.
bsb_text: So then, those who suffer according to God’s will should entrust their souls to their faithful Creator and continue to do good.
aov_text: So laat dan ook die wat volgens die wil van God ly, hulle siele aan Hom as die getroue Skepper toevertrou met goeie dade.

kjv_text: The elders which are among you I exhort, who am also an elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and also a partaker of the glory that shall be revealed:
bsb_text: As a fellow elder, a witness of Christ’s sufferings, and a partaker of the glory to be revealed, I appeal to the elders among you:
aov_text: EK vermaan die ouderlinge onder julle, ek wat ’n mede-ouderling en getuie van die lyde van Christus is, wat ook ’n deelgenoot is van die heerlikheid wat geopenbaar sal word:

kjv_text: Feed the flock of God which is among you, taking the oversight thereof, not by constraint, but willingly; not for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind;
bsb_text: Be shepherds of God’s flock that is among you, watching over them not out of compulsion, but because it is God’s will; not out of greed, but out of eagerness;
aov_text: Hou as herders toesig oor die kudde van God wat onder julle is, nie uit dwang nie, maar gewilliglik; nie om vuil gewin nie, maar met bereidwilligheid;

kjv_text: Neither as being lords over God's heritage, but being ensamples to the flock.
bsb_text: not lording it over those entrusted to you, but being examples to the flock.
aov_text: ook nie as heersers oor die erfdeel nie, maar as voorbeelde vir die kudde.

kjv_text: And when the chief Shepherd shall appear, ye shall receive a crown of glory that fadeth not away.
bsb_text: And when the Chief Shepherd appears, you will receive the crown of glory that will never fade away.
aov_text: En wanneer die Opperherder verskyn, sal julle die onverwelklike kroon van heerlikheid ontvang.

kjv_text: Likewise, ye younger, submit yourselves unto the elder. Yea, all of you be subject one to another, and be clothed with humility: for God resisteth the proud, and giveth grace to the humble.
bsb_text: Young men, in the same way, submit yourselves to your elders. And all of you, clothe yourselves with humility toward one another, because, “God opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
aov_text: Net so moet julle, jongeres, aan die oueres onderdanig wees; en wees almal met ootmoed bekleed in onderdanigheid aan mekaar, want God weerstaan die hoogmoediges, maar aan die nederiges gee Hy genade.

kjv_text: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time:
bsb_text: Humble yourselves, therefore, under God’s mighty hand, so that in due time He may exalt you.
aov_text: Verneder julle dan onder die kragtige hand van God, sodat Hy julle kan verhoog op die regte tyd.

kjv_text: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
bsb_text: Cast all your anxiety on Him, because He cares for you.
aov_text: Werp al julle bekommernis op Hom, want Hy sorg vir julle.

kjv_text: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:
bsb_text: Be sober-minded and alert. Your adversary the devil prowls around like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour.
aov_text: Wees nugter en waaksaam, want julle teëstander, die duiwel, loop rond soos ’n brullende leeu en soek wie hy kan verslind.

kjv_text: Whom resist stedfast in the faith, knowing that the same afflictions are accomplished in your brethren that are in the world.
bsb_text: Resist him, standing firm in your faith and in the knowledge that your brothers throughout the world are undergoing the same kinds of suffering.
aov_text: Hom moet julle teëstaan, standvastig in die geloof, omdat julle weet dat dieselfde lyding opgelê word aan julle broederskap wat in die wêreld is.

kjv_text: But the God of all grace, who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you.
bsb_text: And after you have suffered for a little while, the God of all grace, who has called you to His eternal glory in Christ, will Himself restore you, secure you, strengthen you, and establish you.
aov_text: EN mag die God van alle genade self, wat ons geroep het tot sy ewige heerlikheid in Christus Jesus, nadat ons ’n kort tyd gely het, julle volmaak, bevestig, versterk en grondves!

kjv_text: To him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
bsb_text: To Him be the power forever and ever. Amen.
aov_text: Aan Hom die heerlikheid en die krag tot in alle ewigheid! Amen.

kjv_text: By Silvanus, a faithful brother unto you, as I suppose, I have written briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God wherein ye stand.
bsb_text: Through Silvanus, whom I regard as a faithful brother, I have written to you briefly, encouraging you and testifying that this is the true grace of God. Stand firm in it.
aov_text: Deur Silvánus, die getroue broeder, soos ek meen, het ek kortliks aan julle geskrywe om julle te vermaan en om te betuig dat dit die ware genade van God is waarin julle staan.

kjv_text: The church that is at Babylon, elected together with you, saluteth you; and so doth Marcus my son.
bsb_text: The church in Babylon, chosen together with you, sends you greetings, as does my son Mark.
aov_text: Die mede-uitverkorene in Babilon en Markus, my seun, groet julle.

kjv_text: Greet ye one another with a kiss of charity. Peace be with you all that are in Christ Jesus. Amen.
bsb_text: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace to all of you who are in Christ.
aov_text: Groet mekaar met ’n kus van liefde. Vrede vir julle almal wat in Christus Jesus is! Amen.

kjv_text: Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ, to them that have obtained like precious faith with us through the righteousness of God and our Saviour Jesus Christ:
bsb_text: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, To those who through the righteousness of our God and Savior Jesus Christ have received a faith as precious as ours:
aov_text: SÍMEON Petrus, ’n dienskneg en apostel van Jesus Christus, aan die wat net so ’n kosbare geloof as ons verkry het deur die geregtigheid van onse God en Saligmaker, Jesus Christus:

kjv_text: Grace and peace be multiplied unto you through the knowledge of God, and of Jesus our Lord,
bsb_text: Grace and peace be multiplied to you through the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord.
aov_text: Mag genade en vrede vir julle vermeerder word deur die kennis van God en Jesus, onse Here!

kjv_text: According as his divine power hath given unto us all things that pertain unto life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that hath called us to glory and virtue:
bsb_text: His divine power has given us everything we need for life and godliness through the knowledge of Him who called us by His own glory and excellence.
aov_text: IMMERS, sy goddelike krag het ons alles geskenk wat tot die lewe en godsvrug dien, deur die kennis van Hom wat ons geroep het deur sy heerlikheid en deug,

kjv_text: Whereby are given unto us exceeding great and precious promises: that by these ye might be partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust.
bsb_text: Through these He has given us His precious and magnificent promises, so that through them you may become partakers of the divine nature, now that you have escaped the corruption in the world caused by evil desires.
aov_text: waardeur Hy ons die grootste en kosbare beloftes geskenk het, sodat julle daardeur deelgenote kan word van die goddelike natuur, nadat julle die verdorwenheid ontvlug het wat deur begeerlikheid in die wêreld is.

kjv_text: And beside this, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue; and to virtue knowledge;
bsb_text: For this very reason, make every effort to add to your faith virtue; and to virtue, knowledge;
aov_text: En juis daarom ook moet julle met aanwending van alle ywer by julle geloof voeg die deug, en by die deug die kennis,

kjv_text: And to knowledge temperance; and to temperance patience; and to patience godliness;
bsb_text: and to knowledge, self-control; and to self-control, perseverance; and to perseverance, godliness;
aov_text: en by die kennis die selfbeheersing, en by die selfbeheersing die lydsaamheid, en by die lydsaamheid die godsvrug,

kjv_text: And to godliness brotherly kindness; and to brotherly kindness charity.
bsb_text: and to godliness, brotherly kindness; and to brotherly kindness, love.
aov_text: en by die godsvrug die broederliefde, en by die broederliefde die naasteliefde.

kjv_text: For if these things be in you, and abound, they make you that ye shall neither be barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
bsb_text: For if you possess these qualities and continue to grow in them, they will keep you from being ineffective and unproductive in your knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
aov_text: Want as hierdie dinge by julle aanwesig is en toeneem, dan laat dit julle nie ledig of onvrugbaar tot die kennis van onse Here Jesus Christus nie;
