kjv_text: But he that lacketh these things is blind, and cannot see afar off, and hath forgotten that he was purged from his old sins.
bsb_text: But whoever lacks these traits is nearsighted to the point of blindness, having forgotten that he has been cleansed from his past sins.
aov_text: want hy by wie hierdie dinge nie aanwesig is nie, is blind en kortsigtig, en het die reiniging van sy vorige sondes vergeet.

kjv_text: Wherefore the rather, brethren, give diligence to make your calling and election sure: for if ye do these things, ye shall never fall:
bsb_text: Therefore, brothers, strive to make your calling and election sure. For if you practice these things you will never stumble,
aov_text: Daarom, broeders, moet julle jul des te meer beywer om julle roeping en verkiesing vas te maak; want as julle dit doen, sal julle nooit struikel nie.

kjv_text: For so an entrance shall be ministered unto you abundantly into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.
bsb_text: and you will receive a lavish reception into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.
aov_text: Want so sal ryklik aan julle verleen word die ingang in die ewige koninkryk van onse Here en Saligmaker, Jesus Christus.

kjv_text: Wherefore I will not be negligent to put you always in remembrance of these things, though ye know them, and be established in the present truth.
bsb_text: Therefore I will always remind you of these things, even though you know them and are established in the truth you now have.
aov_text: Daarom sal ek nie nalaat om julle altyd hieraan te herinner nie, alhoewel julle dit weet en vasstaan in die waarheid wat by julle is.

kjv_text: Yea, I think it meet, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by putting you in remembrance;
bsb_text: I think it is right to refresh your memory as long as I live in the tent of my body,
aov_text: En ek beskou dit as reg, so lank as ek in hierdie tentwoning is, om julle deur herinnering op te wek,

kjv_text: Knowing that shortly I must put off this my tabernacle, even as our Lord Jesus Christ hath shewed me.
bsb_text: because I know that this tent will soon be laid aside, as our Lord Jesus Christ has made clear to me.
aov_text: omdat ek weet dat die aflegging van my tentwoning ophande is, soos onse Here Jesus Christus dit ook aan my bekend gemaak het.

kjv_text: Moreover I will endeavour that ye may be able after my decease to have these things always in remembrance.
bsb_text: And I will make every effort to ensure that after my departure, you will be able to recall these things at all times.
aov_text: En ek sal my beywer, dat julle ook gedurig ná my heengaan hierdie dinge in gedagtenis kan hou.

kjv_text: For we have not followed cunningly devised fables, when we made known unto you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but were eyewitnesses of his majesty.
bsb_text: For we did not follow cleverly devised fables when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of His majesty.
aov_text: Want ons het nie kunstig verdigte fabels nagevolg toe ons julle die krag en koms van onse Here Jesus Christus bekend gemaak het nie, maar ons was aanskouers van sy majesteit;

kjv_text: For he received from God the Father honour and glory, when there came such a voice to him from the excellent glory, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
bsb_text: For He received honor and glory from God the Father when the voice came to Him from the Majestic Glory, saying, “This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”
aov_text: want Hy het van God die Vader eer en heerlikheid ontvang toe hierdie stem uit die luisterryke heerlikheid tot Hom gekom het: Dit is my geliefde Seun in wie Ek ’n welbehae het.

kjv_text: And this voice which came from heaven we heard, when we were with him in the holy mount.
bsb_text: And we ourselves heard this voice from heaven when we were with Him on the holy mountain.
aov_text: En hierdie stem het ons uit die hemel hoor kom toe ons saam met Hom op die heilige berg was.

kjv_text: We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts:
bsb_text: We also have the word of the prophets as confirmed beyond doubt. And you will do well to pay attention to it, as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star rises in your hearts.
aov_text: En ons het die profetiese woord wat baie vas is, waarop julle tog moet ag gee soos op ’n lamp wat in ’n donker plek skyn, totdat die dag aanbreek en die môrester opgaan in julle harte;

kjv_text: Knowing this first, that no prophecy of the scripture is of any private interpretation.
bsb_text: Above all, you must understand that no prophecy of Scripture comes from one’s own interpretation.
aov_text: terwyl julle veral dít moet weet, dat geen profesie van die Skrif ’n saak van eie uitlegging is nie;

kjv_text: For the prophecy came not in old time by the will of man: but holy men of God spake as they were moved by the Holy Ghost.
bsb_text: For no such prophecy was ever brought forth by the will of man, but men spoke from God as they were carried along by the Holy Spirit.
aov_text: want geen profesie is ooit deur die wil van ’n mens voortgebring nie, maar, deur die Heilige Gees gedrywe, het die heilige mense van God gespreek.

kjv_text: But there were false prophets also among the people, even as there shall be false teachers among you, who privily shall bring in damnable heresies, even denying the Lord that bought them, and bring upon themselves swift destruction.
bsb_text: Now there were also false prophets among the people, just as there will be false teachers among you. They will secretly introduce destructive heresies, even denying the Master who bought them—bringing swift destruction on themselves.
aov_text: MAAR daar was ook valse profete onder die volk, net soos daar onder julle valse leraars sal wees wat verderflike ketterye heimlik sal invoer, en ook die Here wat hulle gekoop het, verloën en ’n vinnige verderf oor hulleself bring;

kjv_text: And many shall follow their pernicious ways; by reason of whom the way of truth shall be evil spoken of.
bsb_text: Many will follow in their depravity, and because of them the way of truth will be defamed.
aov_text: en baie sal hulle verderflikhede navolg, en om hulle ontwil sal die weg van die waarheid gelaster word;

kjv_text: And through covetousness shall they with feigned words make merchandise of you: whose judgment now of a long time lingereth not, and their damnation slumbereth not.
bsb_text: In their greed, these false teachers will exploit you with deceptive words. The longstanding verdict against them remains in force, and their destruction does not sleep.
aov_text: en uit hebsug sal hulle met verdigte woorde voordeel uit julle trek. Oor hulle is die oordeel van lankal af nie werkeloos nie, en hulle verderf sluimer nie.

kjv_text: For if God spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;
bsb_text: For if God did not spare the angels when they sinned, but cast them deep into hell, placing them in chains of darkness to be held for judgment;
aov_text: Want as God die engele wat gesondig het, nie gespaar het nie, maar hulle in die hel gewerp en aan kettings van duisternis oorgegee het, om vir die oordeel in bewaring gehou te word;

kjv_text: And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly;
bsb_text: if He did not spare the ancient world when He brought the flood on its ungodly people, but preserved Noah, a preacher of righteousness, among the eight;
aov_text: en die ou wêreld nie gespaar het nie, maar Noag, die prediker van geregtigheid, met sewe ander bewaar het toe Hy die sondvloed oor die wêreld van goddelose mense gebring het;

kjv_text: And turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrha into ashes condemned them with an overthrow, making them an ensample unto those that after should live ungodly;
bsb_text: if He condemned the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah to destruction, reducing them to ashes as an example of what is coming on the ungodly;
aov_text: en deur die stede van Sodom en Gomorra tot as te verbrand, hulle tot ondergang veroordeel het en as ’n voorbeeld gestel het vir die wat in die toekoms goddeloos sou wees;

kjv_text: And delivered just Lot, vexed with the filthy conversation of the wicked:
bsb_text: and if He rescued Lot, a righteous man distressed by the depraved conduct of the lawless
aov_text: en die regverdige Lot gered het, wat hom baie gekwel het oor die losbandige lewe van die sedelose mense;

kjv_text: (For that righteous man dwelling among them, in seeing and hearing, vexed his righteous soul from day to day with their unlawful deeds;)
bsb_text: (for that righteous man, living among them day after day, was tormented in his righteous soul by the lawless deeds he saw and heard)—
aov_text: want deur wat hy gesien en gehoor het, het dié regverdige man, wat onder hulle gewoon het, dag vir dag sy regverdige siel gepynig hulle wettelose werke  —

kjv_text: The Lord knoweth how to deliver the godly out of temptations, and to reserve the unjust unto the day of judgment to be punished:
bsb_text: if all this is so, then the Lord knows how to rescue the godly from trials and to hold the unrighteous for punishment on the day of judgment.
aov_text: die Here weet om die godsaliges uit versoeking te verlos en die onregverdiges te bewaar vir die dag van oordeel om gestraf te word;

kjv_text: But chiefly them that walk after the flesh in the lust of uncleanness, and despise government. Presumptuous are they, selfwilled, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignities.
bsb_text: Such punishment is specially reserved for those who indulge the corrupt desires of the flesh and despise authority. Bold and self-willed, they are unafraid to slander glorious beings.
aov_text: en veral die wat die vlees in vuile begeerlikheid agternaloop en die heerskappy verag. Vermetel en aanmatigend, skroom hulle nie om die heerlike wesens te belaster nie,

kjv_text: Whereas angels, which are greater in power and might, bring not railing accusation against them before the Lord.
bsb_text: Yet not even angels, though greater in strength and power, dare to bring such slanderous charges against them before the Lord.
aov_text: terwyl die engele, hoewel groter in sterkte en krag, geen lasterlike oordeel teen hulle by die Here voorbring nie.

kjv_text: But these, as natural brute beasts, made to be taken and destroyed, speak evil of the things that they understand not; and shall utterly perish in their own corruption;
bsb_text: These men are like irrational animals, creatures of instinct, born to be captured and destroyed. They blaspheme in matters they do not understand, and like such creatures, they too will be destroyed.
aov_text: Maar hulle sal, omdat hulle belaster wat hulle nie ken nie, soos redelose diere wat die natuur volg, gebore om gevang en vernietig te word, in hulle verdorwenheid te gronde gaan

kjv_text: And shall receive the reward of unrighteousness, as they that count it pleasure to riot in the day time. Spots they are and blemishes, sporting themselves with their own deceivings while they feast with you;
bsb_text: The harm they will suffer is the wages of their wickedness. They consider it a pleasure to carouse in broad daylight. They are blots and blemishes, reveling in their deception as they feast with you.
aov_text: en die loon van die ongeregtigheid ontvang. Hulle ag die weelderigheid oordag ’n genot; hulle is skandvlekke en smette, weelderig in hul bedrieërye as hulle met julle saamsmul;

kjv_text: Having eyes full of adultery, and that cannot cease from sin; beguiling unstable souls: an heart they have exercised with covetous practices; cursed children:
bsb_text: Their eyes are full of adultery; their desire for sin is never satisfied; they seduce the unstable. They are accursed children with hearts trained in greed.
aov_text: met oë vol van owerspel, wat nie ophou om te sondig nie; hulle verlok onvaste siele, hulle het ’n hart geoefen in hebsug, hulle is kinders van die vervloeking.

kjv_text: Which have forsaken the right way, and are gone astray, following the way of Balaam the son of Bosor, who loved the wages of unrighteousness;
bsb_text: They have left the straight way and wandered off to follow the way of Balaam son of Beor, who loved the wages of wickedness.
aov_text: Hulle het die regte pad verlaat en verdwaal, en die weg gevolg van Bíleam, die seun van Beor, wat die loon van ongeregtigheid liefgehad het,

kjv_text: But was rebuked for his iniquity: the dumb ass speaking with man's voice forbad the madness of the prophet.
bsb_text: But he was rebuked for his transgression by a donkey, otherwise without speech, that spoke with a man’s voice and restrained the prophet’s madness.
aov_text: maar die bestraffing van sy eie oortreding ontvang het: die stom lasdier het met die stem van ’n mens gepraat en die waansinnigheid van die profeet verhinder.

kjv_text: These are wells without water, clouds that are carried with a tempest; to whom the mist of darkness is reserved for ever.
bsb_text: These men are springs without water and mists driven by a storm. Blackest darkness is reserved for them.
aov_text: Hulle is waterlose fonteine, miswolke voortgedrywe deur ’n stormwind, vir wie die donkerheid van die duisternis vir ewig bewaar word.

kjv_text: For when they speak great swelling words of vanity, they allure through the lusts of the flesh, through much wantonness, those that were clean escaped from them who live in error.
bsb_text: With lofty but empty words, they appeal to the sensual passions of the flesh and entice those who are just escaping from others who live in error.
aov_text: Want deur trotse woorde vol onsin uit te spreek, verlok hulle deur begeerlikhede van die vlees en ongebondenheid dié wat waarlik die mense ontvlug het wat in dwaling wandel.

kjv_text: While they promise them liberty, they themselves are the servants of corruption: for of whom a man is overcome, of the same is he brought in bondage.
bsb_text: They promise them freedom, while they themselves are slaves to depravity. For a man is a slave to whatever has mastered him.
aov_text: Hulle belowe vryheid aan hulle, terwyl hulle self slawe van die verdorwenheid is; want waar ’n mens deur oorwin is, daarvan het hy ook ’n slaaf geword.

kjv_text: For if after they have escaped the pollutions of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ, they are again entangled therein, and overcome, the latter end is worse with them than the beginning.
bsb_text: If indeed they have escaped the corruption of the world through the knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, only to be entangled and overcome by it again, their final condition is worse than it was at first.
aov_text: Want as hulle, nadat hulle deur die kennis van die Here en Saligmaker, Jesus Christus, die besmettinge van die wêreld ontvlug het, hulle tog weer deur hierdie dinge laat verstrik en oorwin word, dan het vir hulle die laaste erger geword as die eerste.

kjv_text: For it had been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than, after they have known it, to turn from the holy commandment delivered unto them.
bsb_text: It would have been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness than to have known it and then to turn away from the holy commandment passed on to them.
aov_text: Want dit sou vir hulle beter wees as hulle die weg van die geregtigheid nie geken het nie, as dat hulle, nadat hulle dit leer ken het, hulle afkeer van die heilige gebod wat aan hulle oorgelewer is.

kjv_text: But it is happened unto them according to the true proverb, The dog is turned to his own vomit again; and the sow that was washed to her wallowing in the mire.
bsb_text: Of them the proverbs are true: “A dog returns to its vomit,” and, “A sow that is washed goes back to her wallowing in the mud.”
aov_text: Maar oor hulle het gekom wat die ware spreekwoord sê: Die hond het omgedraai na sy eie uitbraaksel, en die gewaste sog om in die modder te rol.

kjv_text: This second epistle, beloved, I now write unto you; in both which I stir up your pure minds by way of remembrance:
bsb_text: Beloved, this is now my second letter to you. Both of them are reminders to stir you to wholesome thinking
aov_text: DIT is reeds die tweede brief, geliefdes, wat ek aan julle skrywe. In albei wil ek deur herinnering julle suiwere gesindheid opwek,

kjv_text: That ye may be mindful of the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets, and of the commandment of us the apostles of the Lord and Saviour:
bsb_text: by recalling what was foretold by the holy prophets and commanded by our Lord and Savior through your apostles.
aov_text: sodat julle die woorde kan onthou wat deur die heilige profete tevore gespreek is, en die gebod van ons, apostels van die Here en Verlosser.

kjv_text: Knowing this first, that there shall come in the last days scoffers, walking after their own lusts,
bsb_text: Most importantly, you must understand that in the last days scoffers will come, scoffing and following their own evil desires.
aov_text: Dit moet julle veral weet, dat daar aan die einde van die dae spotters sal kom wat volgens hulle eie begeerlikhede wandel

kjv_text: And saying, Where is the promise of his coming? for since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.
bsb_text: “Where is the promise of His coming?” they will ask. “Ever since our fathers fell asleep, everything continues as it has from the beginning of creation.”
aov_text: en sê: Waar is die belofte van sy wederkoms? Want vandat die vaders ontslaap het, bly alles soos dit was van die begin van die skepping af.

kjv_text: For this they willingly are ignorant of, that by the word of God the heavens were of old, and the earth standing out of the water and in the water:
bsb_text: But they deliberately overlook the fact that long ago by God’s word the heavens existed and the earth was formed out of water and by water,
aov_text: Want moedswillig vergeet hulle dat daar van lankal af hemele was en ’n aarde wat uit water en deur water ontstaan het deur die woord van God,

kjv_text: Whereby the world that then was, being overflowed with water, perished:
bsb_text: through which the world of that time perished in the flood.
aov_text: waardeur die toenmalige wêreld met water oorstroom is en vergaan het.

kjv_text: But the heavens and the earth, which are now, by the same word are kept in store, reserved unto fire against the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men.
bsb_text: And by that same word, the present heavens and earth are reserved for fire, being kept for the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.
aov_text: Maar die teenswoordige hemele en die aarde is deur dieselfde woord as ’n skat weggelê en word vir die vuur bewaar teen die dag van die oordeel en die verderf van die goddelose mense.

kjv_text: But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.
bsb_text: Beloved, do not let this one thing escape your notice: With the Lord a day is like a thousand years, and a thousand years are like a day.
aov_text: Maar laat hierdie een ding julle nie ontgaan nie, geliefdes, dat een dag by die Here soos duisend jaar is en duisend jaar soos een dag.

kjv_text: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.
bsb_text: The Lord is not slow in keeping His promise as some understand slowness, but is patient with you, not wanting anyone to perish but everyone to come to repentance.
aov_text: Die Here vertraag nie die belofte soos sommige dit vertraging ag nie, maar Hy is lankmoedig oor ons en wil nie hê dat sommige moet vergaan nie, maar dat almal tot bekering moet kom.

kjv_text: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat, the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up.
bsb_text: But the Day of the Lord will come like a thief. The heavens will disappear with a roar, the elements will be destroyed by fire, and the earth and its works will be laid bare.
aov_text: Maar die dag van die Here sal kom soos ’n dief in die nag, waarin die hemele met gedruis sal verbygaan en die elemente sal brand en vergaan, en die aarde en die werke wat daarop is, sal verbrand.

kjv_text: Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness,
bsb_text: Since everything will be destroyed in this way, what kind of people ought you to be? You ought to conduct yourselves in holiness and godliness
aov_text: Terwyl al hierdie dinge dan vergaan, hoedanig moet julle nie wees in heilige wandel en godsvrug nie?  —

kjv_text: Looking for and hasting unto the coming of the day of God, wherein the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat?
bsb_text: as you anticipate and hasten the coming of the day of God, when the heavens will be destroyed by fire and the elements will melt in the heat.
aov_text: julle wat die koms van die dag van God verwag en verhaas, waardeur die hemele deur vuur sal vergaan en die elemente sal brand en versmelt.

kjv_text: Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness.
bsb_text: But in keeping with God’s promise, we are looking forward to a new heaven and a new earth, where righteousness dwells.
aov_text: Maar ons verwag volgens sy belofte nuwe hemele en ’n nuwe aarde waarin geregtigheid woon.

kjv_text: Wherefore, beloved, seeing that ye look for such things, be diligent that ye may be found of him in peace, without spot, and blameless.
bsb_text: Therefore, beloved, as you anticipate these things, make every effort to be found at peace—spotless and blameless in His sight.
aov_text: Daarom, geliefdes, terwyl julle hierdie dinge verwag, beywer julle dat julle vlekkeloos en onberispelik voor Hom bevind mag word in vrede.

kjv_text: And account that the longsuffering of our Lord is salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also according to the wisdom given unto him hath written unto you;
bsb_text: Consider also that our Lord’s patience brings salvation, just as our beloved brother Paul also wrote you with the wisdom God gave him.
aov_text: En ag die lankmoedigheid van onse Here as saligheid, soos ons geliefde broeder Paulus ook met die wysheid wat aan hom gegee is, aan julle geskryf het,

kjv_text: As also in all his epistles, speaking in them of these things; in which are some things hard to be understood, which they that are unlearned and unstable wrest, as they do also the other scriptures, unto their own destruction.
bsb_text: He writes this way in all his letters, speaking in them about such matters. Some parts of his letters are hard to understand, which ignorant and unstable people distort, as they do the rest of the Scriptures, to their own destruction.
aov_text: net soos in al die briewe. Hy spreek daarin oor hierdie dinge, waarvan sommige swaar is om te verstaan, wat die ongeleerde en onvaste mense verdraai, net soos die ander Skrifte, tot hul eie verderf.

kjv_text: Ye therefore, beloved, seeing ye know these things before, beware lest ye also, being led away with the error of the wicked, fall from your own stedfastness.
bsb_text: Therefore, beloved, since you already know these things, be on your guard so that you will not be carried away by the error of the lawless and fall from your secure standing.
aov_text: Noudat julle dit dan vooruit weet, geliefdes, moet julle op jul hoede wees dat julle nie miskien meegesleep word deur die dwaling van sedelose mense en wegval uit jul eie vastigheid nie.

kjv_text: But grow in grace, and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and for ever. Amen.
bsb_text: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To Him be the glory both now and to the day of eternity. Amen.
aov_text: Maar julle moet toeneem in die genade en kennis van onse Here en Saligmaker, Jesus Christus. Aan Hom kom die heerlikheid toe, nou sowel as in die dag van die ewigheid. Amen.

kjv_text: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon, and our hands have handled, of the Word of life;
bsb_text: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our own eyes, which we have gazed upon and touched with our own hands—this is the Word of life.
aov_text: WAT van die begin af was, wat ons gehoor het, wat ons met ons oë gesien het, wat ons aanskou het en ons hande getas het aangaande die Woord van die lewe  —

kjv_text: (For the life was manifested, and we have seen it, and bear witness, and shew unto you that eternal life, which was with the Father, and was manifested unto us;)
bsb_text: And this is the life that was revealed; we have seen it and testified to it, and we proclaim to you the eternal life that was with the Father and was revealed to us.
aov_text: en die lewe is geopenbaar, en ons het dit gesien, en ons getuig en verkondig aan julle die ewige lewe wat by die Vader was en aan ons geopenbaar is  —

kjv_text: That which we have seen and heard declare we unto you, that ye also may have fellowship with us: and truly our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ.
bsb_text: We proclaim to you what we have seen and heard, so that you also may have fellowship with us. And this fellowship of ours is with the Father and with His Son, Jesus Christ.
aov_text: wat ons gesien en gehoor het, verkondig ons aan julle, sodat julle ook gemeenskap met ons kan hê; en ons gemeenskap is met die Vader en met sy Seun, Jesus Christus.

kjv_text: And these things write we unto you, that your joy may be full.
bsb_text: We write these things so that our joy may be complete.
aov_text: En ons skrywe hierdie dinge aan julle, sodat julle blydskap volkome kan wees.

kjv_text: This then is the message which we have heard of him, and declare unto you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
bsb_text: And this is the message we have heard from Him and announce to you: God is light, and in Him there is no darkness at all.
aov_text: EN dit is die verkondiging wat ons van Hom gehoor het en aan julle verkondig: God is lig, en geen duisternis is in Hom nie.

kjv_text: If we say that we have fellowship with him, and walk in darkness, we lie, and do not the truth:
bsb_text: If we say we have fellowship with Him yet walk in the darkness, we lie and do not practice the truth.
aov_text: As ons sê dat ons met Hom gemeenskap het en in die duisternis wandel, dan lieg ons en doen nie die waarheid nie.

kjv_text: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin.
bsb_text: But if we walk in the light as He is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus His Son cleanses us from all sin.
aov_text: Maar as ons in die lig wandel soos Hy in die lig is, dan het ons gemeenskap met mekaar; en die bloed van Jesus Christus, sy Seun, reinig ons van alle sonde.

kjv_text: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
bsb_text: If we say we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
aov_text: AS ons sê dat ons geen sonde het nie, mislei ons onsself en die waarheid is nie in ons nie.

kjv_text: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
bsb_text: If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
aov_text: As ons ons sondes bely, Hy is getrou en regverdig om ons die sondes te vergewe en ons van alle ongeregtigheid te reinig.

kjv_text: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
bsb_text: If we say we have not sinned, we make Him out to be a liar, and His word is not in us.
aov_text: As ons sê dat ons nie gesondig het nie, dan maak ons Hom tot ’n leuenaar en is sy woord nie in ons nie.

kjv_text: My little children, these things write I unto you, that ye sin not. And if any man sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous:
bsb_text: My little children, I am writing these things to you so that you will not sin. But if anyone does sin, we have an advocate before the Father—Jesus Christ, the Righteous One.
aov_text: MY kinders, ek skryf hierdie dinge aan julle, dat julle nie moet sondig nie; en as iemand gesondig het, ons het ’n Voorspraak by die Vader, Jesus Christus, die Regverdige.

kjv_text: And he is the propitiation for our sins: and not for ours only, but also for the sins of the whole world.
bsb_text: He Himself is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not only for ours but also for the sins of the whole world.
aov_text: En Hy is ’n versoening vir ons sondes, en nie alleen vir ons s’n nie, maar ook vir dié van die hele wêreld.

kjv_text: And hereby we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.
bsb_text: By this we can be sure that we have come to know Him: if we keep His commandments.
aov_text: EN hieraan weet ons dat ons Hom ken: as ons sy gebooie bewaar.

kjv_text: He that saith, I know him, and keepeth not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him.
bsb_text: If anyone says, “I know Him,” but does not keep His commandments, he is a liar, and the truth is not in him.
aov_text: Hy wat sê: Ek ken Hom — en sy gebooie nie bewaar nie — is ’n leuenaar en in hom is die waarheid nie.

kjv_text: But whoso keepeth his word, in him verily is the love of God perfected: hereby know we that we are in him.
bsb_text: But if anyone keeps His word, the love of God has been truly perfected in him. By this we know that we are in Him:
aov_text: Maar elkeen wat sy woord bewaar, in hom het die liefde van God waarlik volmaak geword. Hieraan weet ons dat ons in Hom is.

kjv_text: He that saith he abideth in him ought himself also so to walk, even as he walked.
bsb_text: Whoever claims to abide in Him must walk as Jesus walked.
aov_text: Hy wat sê dat hy in Hom bly, behoort self ook so te wandel soos Hy gewandel het.

kjv_text: Brethren, I write no new commandment unto you, but an old commandment which ye had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which ye have heard from the beginning.
bsb_text: Beloved, I am not writing to you a new commandment, but an old one, which you have had from the beginning. This commandment is the message you have heard.
aov_text: Broeders, dit is geen nuwe gebod wat ek aan julle skryf nie, maar ’n ou gebod wat julle van die begin af gehad het. Die ou gebod is die woord wat julle van die begin af gehoor het.

kjv_text: Again, a new commandment I write unto you, which thing is true in him and in you: because the darkness is past, and the true light now shineth.
bsb_text: Then again, I am also writing to you a new commandment, which is true in Him and also in you. For the darkness is fading and the true light is already shining.
aov_text: En tog skryf ek aan julle ’n nuwe gebod wat waar is in Hom en in julle, want die duisternis gaan verby en die waaragtige lig skyn alreeds.

kjv_text: He that saith he is in the light, and hateth his brother, is in darkness even until now.
bsb_text: If anyone claims to be in the light but hates his brother, he is still in the darkness.
aov_text: Hy wat sê dat hy in die lig is en sy broeder haat, is in die duisternis tot nou toe.

kjv_text: He that loveth his brother abideth in the light, and there is none occasion of stumbling in him.
bsb_text: Whoever loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no cause of stumbling in him.
aov_text: Wie sy broeder liefhet, bly in die lig, en in hom is geen oorsaak van struikeling nie.

kjv_text: But he that hateth his brother is in darkness, and walketh in darkness, and knoweth not whither he goeth, because that darkness hath blinded his eyes.
bsb_text: But whoever hates his brother is in the darkness and walks in the darkness. He does not know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.
aov_text: Maar hy wat sy broeder haat, is in die duisternis en wandel in die duisternis en weet nie waarheen hy gaan nie, omdat die duisternis sy oë verblind het.

kjv_text: I write unto you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name's sake.
bsb_text: I am writing to you, little children, because your sins have been forgiven through His name.
aov_text: Ek skryf aan julle, my kinders, omdat die sondes julle vergewe is om sy Naam ontwil.

kjv_text: I write unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I write unto you, young men, because ye have overcome the wicked one. I write unto you, little children, because ye have known the Father.
bsb_text: I am writing to you, fathers, because you know Him who is from the beginning. I am writing to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I have written to you, children, because you know the Father.
aov_text: Ek skryf aan julle, vaders, omdat julle Hom ken wat van die begin af is. Ek skryf aan julle, jongmanne, omdat julle die Bose oorwin het. Ek skryf aan julle, kinders, omdat julle die Vader ken.

kjv_text: I have written unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I have written unto you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God abideth in you, and ye have overcome the wicked one.
bsb_text: I have written to you, fathers, because you know Him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God abides in you, and you have overcome the evil one.
aov_text: Ek het aan julle geskrywe, vaders, omdat julle Hom ken wat van die begin af is. Ek het aan julle geskrywe, jongmanne, omdat julle sterk is en die woord van God in julle bly en julle die Bose oorwin het.

kjv_text: Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
bsb_text: Do not love the world or anything in the world. If anyone loves the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
aov_text: Moenie die wêreld liefhê of die dinge wat in die wêreld is nie. As iemand die wêreld liefhet, dan is die liefde van die Vader nie in hom nie.

kjv_text: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.
bsb_text: For all that is in the world—the desires of the flesh, the desires of the eyes, and the pride of life—is not from the Father but from the world.
aov_text: Want alles wat in die wêreld is — die begeerlikheid van die vlees en die begeerlikheid van die oë en die grootsheid van die lewe — is nie uit die Vader nie, maar is uit die wêreld.

kjv_text: And the world passeth away, and the lust thereof: but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever.
bsb_text: The world is passing away, along with its desires; but whoever does the will of God remains forever.
aov_text: En die wêreld gaan verby en sy begeerlikheid, maar hy wat die wil van God doen, bly vir ewig.

kjv_text: Little children, it is the last time: and as ye have heard that antichrist shall come, even now are there many antichrists; whereby we know that it is the last time.
bsb_text: Children, it is the last hour; and just as you have heard that the antichrist is coming, so now many antichrists have appeared. This is how we know it is the last hour.
aov_text: KINDERS, dit is die laaste uur; en soos julle gehoor het dat die Antichris kom, bestaan daar ook nou baie antichriste, waaruit ons weet dat dit die laaste uur is.

kjv_text: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would no doubt have continued with us: but they went out, that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us.
bsb_text: They went out from us, but they did not belong to us. For if they had belonged to us, they would have remained with us. But their departure made it clear that none of them belonged to us.
aov_text: Hulle het van ons uitgegaan, maar hulle was nie van ons nie; want as hulle van ons was, sou hulle by ons gebly het; maar dit moes aan die lig kom dat hulle nie almal van ons is nie.

kjv_text: But ye have an unction from the Holy One, and ye know all things.
bsb_text: You, however, have an anointing from the Holy One, and all of you know the truth.
aov_text: En julle het die salwing van die Heilige en weet alles.

kjv_text: I have not written unto you because ye know not the truth, but because ye know it, and that no lie is of the truth.
bsb_text: I have not written to you because you lack knowledge of the truth, but because you have it, and because no lie comes from the truth.
aov_text: Ek het nie aan julle geskrywe omdat julle die waarheid nie ken nie, maar omdat julle dit ken en omdat geen leuen uit die waarheid is nie.

kjv_text: Who is a liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ? He is antichrist, that denieth the Father and the Son.
bsb_text: Who is the liar, if it is not the one who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the antichrist, who denies the Father and the Son.
aov_text: Wie is die leuenaar, behalwe hy wat ontken dat Jesus die Christus is? Dít is die Antichris wat die Vader en die Seun loën.

kjv_text: Whosoever denieth the Son, the same hath not the Father: he that acknowledgeth the Son hath the Father also.
bsb_text: Whoever denies the Son does not have the Father, but whoever confesses the Son has the Father as well.
aov_text: Elkeen wat die Seun loën, het ook nie die Vader nie.

kjv_text: Let that therefore abide in you, which ye have heard from the beginning. If that which ye have heard from the beginning shall remain in you, ye also shall continue in the Son, and in the Father.
bsb_text: As for you, let what you have heard from the beginning remain in you. If it does, you will also remain in the Son and in the Father.
aov_text: Wat julle dan van die begin af gehoor het, laat dit in julle bly. As in julle bly wat julle van die begin af gehoor het, dan sal julle ook in die Seun en in die Vader bly.

kjv_text: And this is the promise that he hath promised us, even eternal life.
bsb_text: And this is the promise that He Himself made to us: eternal life.
aov_text: En dit is die belofte wat Hy ons beloof het, naamlik die ewige lewe.

kjv_text: These things have I written unto you concerning them that seduce you.
bsb_text: I have written these things to you about those who are trying to deceive you.
aov_text: Dit het ek aan julle geskrywe met betrekking tot die wat julle mislei.

kjv_text: But the anointing which ye have received of him abideth in you, and ye need not that any man teach you: but as the same anointing teacheth you of all things, and is truth, and is no lie, and even as it hath taught you, ye shall abide in him.
bsb_text: And as for you, the anointing you received from Him remains in you, and you do not need anyone to teach you. But just as His true and genuine anointing teaches you about all things, so remain in Him as you have been taught.
aov_text: En die salwing wat julle van Hom ontvang het, bly in julle, en julle het nie nodig dat iemand julle leer nie; maar soos dieselfde salwing julle aangaande alles leer, so is dit ook waar en geen leuen nie; en soos dié julle geleer het, so moet julle in Hom bly.

kjv_text: And now, little children, abide in him; that, when he shall appear, we may have confidence, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
bsb_text: And now, little children, remain in Christ, so that when He appears, we may be confident and unashamed before Him at His coming.
aov_text: En nou, my kinders, bly in Hom, sodat ons vrymoedigheid kan hê wanneer Hy verskyn en nie beskaamd van Hom weggaan by sy wederkoms nie.

kjv_text: If ye know that he is righteous, ye know that every one that doeth righteousness is born of him.
bsb_text: If you know that He is righteous, you also know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of Him.
aov_text: As julle weet dat Hy regverdig is, dan weet julle dat elkeen wat die geregtigheid doen, uit Hom gebore is.

kjv_text: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.
bsb_text: Behold what manner of love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God. And that is what we are! The reason the world does not know us is that it did not know Him.
aov_text: KYK wat ’n groot liefde die Vader aan ons bewys het, dat ons kinders van God genoem kan word! Om hierdie rede ken die wêreld ons nie, omdat dit Hom nie geken het nie.

kjv_text: Beloved, now are we the sons of God, and it doth not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is.
bsb_text: Beloved, we are now children of God, and what we will be has not yet been revealed. We know that when Christ appears, we will be like Him, for we will see Him as He is.
aov_text: Geliefdes, nou is ons kinders van God, en dit is nog nie geopenbaar wat ons sal wees nie; maar ons weet dat ons, as Hy verskyn, aan Hom gelyk sal wees, omdat ons Hom sal sien soos Hy is.

kjv_text: And every man that hath this hope in him purifieth himself, even as he is pure.
bsb_text: And everyone who has this hope in Him purifies himself, just as Christ is pure.
aov_text: En elkeen wat hierdie hoop op Hom het, reinig homself soos Hy rein is.

kjv_text: Whosoever committeth sin transgresseth also the law: for sin is the transgression of the law.
bsb_text: Everyone who practices sin practices lawlessness as well. Indeed, sin is lawlessness.
aov_text: Elkeen wat die sonde doen, doen ook die wetteloosheid, want die sonde is wetteloosheid.

kjv_text: And ye know that he was manifested to take away our sins; and in him is no sin.
bsb_text: But you know that Christ appeared to take away sins, and in Him there is no sin.
aov_text: En julle weet dat Hy verskyn het om ons sondes weg te neem, en geen sonde is in Hom nie.

kjv_text: Whosoever abideth in him sinneth not: whosoever sinneth hath not seen him, neither known him.
bsb_text: No one who remains in Him keeps on sinning. No one who continues to sin has seen Him or known Him.
aov_text: Elkeen wat in Hom bly, sondig nie. Elkeen wat sondig, het Hom nie gesien en Hom nie geken nie.

kjv_text: Little children, let no man deceive you: he that doeth righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.
bsb_text: Little children, let no one deceive you: The one who practices righteousness is righteous, just as Christ is righteous.
aov_text: My kinders, laat niemand julle mislei nie: wie die geregtigheid doen, is regverdig soos Hy regverdig is.

kjv_text: He that committeth sin is of the devil; for the devil sinneth from the beginning. For this purpose the Son of God was manifested, that he might destroy the works of the devil.
bsb_text: The one who practices sin is of the devil, because the devil has been sinning from the very start. This is why the Son of God was revealed, to destroy the works of the devil.
aov_text: Hy wat die sonde doen, is uit die duiwel, want die duiwel sondig van die begin af. Vir hierdie doel het die Seun van God verskyn, om die werke van die duiwel te verbreek.

kjv_text: Whosoever is born of God doth not commit sin; for his seed remaineth in him: and he cannot sin, because he is born of God.
bsb_text: Anyone born of God refuses to practice sin, because God’s seed abides in him; he cannot go on sinning, because he has been born of God.
aov_text: Elkeen wat uit God gebore is, doen geen sonde nie, omdat sy saad in hom bly; en hy kan nie sondig nie, want hy is uit God gebore.

kjv_text: In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loveth not his brother.
bsb_text: By this the children of God are distinguished from the children of the devil: Anyone who does not practice righteousness is not of God, nor is anyone who does not love his brother.
aov_text: Hierin is die kinders van God en die kinders van die duiwel openbaar: elkeen wat die geregtigheid nie doen nie, is nie uit God nie, en hy ook wat sy broeder nie liefhet nie.

kjv_text: For this is the message that ye heard from the beginning, that we should love one another.
bsb_text: This is the message you have heard from the beginning: We should love one another.
aov_text: Want dit is die boodskap wat julle van die begin af gehoor het, dat ons mekaar moet liefhê;

kjv_text: Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother's righteous.
bsb_text: Do not be like Cain, who belonged to the evil one and murdered his brother. And why did Cain slay him? Because his own deeds were evil, while those of his brother were righteous.
aov_text: nie soos Kain wat uit die Bose was en sy broer doodgeslaan het nie. En waarom het hy hom doodgeslaan? Omdat sy werke boos was en dié van sy broer regverdig.

kjv_text: Marvel not, my brethren, if the world hate you.
bsb_text: So do not be surprised, brothers, if the world hates you.
aov_text: Verwonder julle nie, my broeders, as die wêreld julle haat nie.

kjv_text: We know that we have passed from death unto life, because we love the brethren. He that loveth not his brother abideth in death.
bsb_text: We know that we have passed from death to life, because we love our brothers. The one who does not love remains in death.
aov_text: Ons weet dat ons oorgegaan het uit die dood in die lewe, omdat ons die broeders liefhet. Hy wat sy broeder nie liefhet nie, bly in die dood.

kjv_text: Whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer: and ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him.
bsb_text: Everyone who hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that eternal life does not reside in a murderer.
aov_text: Elkeen wat sy broeder haat, is ’n moordenaar; en julle weet dat geen moordenaar die ewige lewe as iets blywends in hom het nie.

kjv_text: Hereby perceive we the love of God, because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren.
bsb_text: By this we know what love is: Jesus laid down His life for us, and we ought to lay down our lives for our brothers.
aov_text: Hieraan het ons die liefde leer ken, dat Hy sy lewe vir ons afgelê het; en ons behoort ons lewe vir die broeders af te lê.

kjv_text: But whoso hath this world's good, and seeth his brother have need, and shutteth up his bowels of compassion from him, how dwelleth the love of God in him?
bsb_text: If anyone with earthly possessions sees his brother in need, but withholds his compassion from him, how can the love of God abide in him?
aov_text: Maar wie die goed van die wêreld het en sy broeder sien gebrek ly en sy hart vir hom toesluit, hoe bly die liefde van God in hom?

kjv_text: My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth.
bsb_text: Little children, let us love not in word and speech, but in action and truth.
aov_text: My kinders, laat ons nie liefhê met woorde of met die tong nie, maar met die daad en in waarheid.

kjv_text: And hereby we know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our hearts before him.
bsb_text: And by this we will know that we belong to the truth, and will assure our hearts in His presence:
aov_text: En hieraan weet ons dat ons uit die waarheid is; en ons sal ons harte voor Hom gerusstel,

kjv_text: For if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things.
bsb_text: Even if our hearts condemn us, God is greater than our hearts, and He knows all things.
aov_text: want as ons hart ons veroordeel, God is meer as ons hart, en Hy weet alles.

kjv_text: Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, then have we confidence toward God.
bsb_text: Beloved, if our hearts do not condemn us, we have confidence before God,
aov_text: Geliefdes, as ons hart ons nie veroordeel nie, dan het ons vrymoedigheid teenoor God;

kjv_text: And whatsoever we ask, we receive of him, because we keep his commandments, and do those things that are pleasing in his sight.
bsb_text: and we will receive from Him whatever we ask, because we keep His commandments and do what is pleasing in His sight.
aov_text: en wat ons ook al bid, ontvang ons van Hom, omdat ons sy gebooie bewaar en doen wat welgevallig is voor Hom.

kjv_text: And this is his commandment, That we should believe on the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, as he gave us commandment.
bsb_text: And this is His commandment: that we should believe in the name of His Son, Jesus Christ, and we should love one another just as He commanded us.
aov_text: En dit is sy gebod, dat ons in die Naam van sy Seun, Jesus Christus, moet glo en mekaar liefhê soos Hy ons ’n gebod gegee het.

kjv_text: And he that keepeth his commandments dwelleth in him, and he in him. And hereby we know that he abideth in us, by the Spirit which he hath given us.
bsb_text: Whoever keeps His commandments remains in God, and God in him. And by this we know that He remains in us: by the Spirit He has given us.
aov_text: En hy wat sy gebooie bewaar, bly in Hom, en Hy in hom. En hieraan weet ons dat Hy in ons bly: aan die Gees wat Hy ons gegee het.

kjv_text: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God: because many false prophets are gone out into the world.
bsb_text: Beloved, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits to see whether they are from God. For many false prophets have gone out into the world.
aov_text: GELIEFDES, glo nie elke gees nie, maar stel die geeste op die proef of hulle uit God is, want baie valse profete het in die wêreld uitgegaan.

kjv_text: Hereby know ye the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is of God:
bsb_text: By this you will know the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is from God,
aov_text: Hieraan ken julle die Gees van God: elke gees wat bely dat Jesus Christus in die vlees gekom het, is uit God;

kjv_text: And every spirit that confesseth not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is not of God: and this is that spirit of antichrist, whereof ye have heard that it should come; and even now already is it in the world.
bsb_text: and every spirit that does not confess Jesus is not from God. This is the spirit of the antichrist, which you have heard is coming and which is already in the world at this time.
aov_text: en elke gees wat nie bely dat Jesus Christus in die vlees gekom het nie, is nie uit God nie; en dit is die gees van die Antichris waarvan julle gehoor het dat hy kom, en hy is nou al in die wêreld.

kjv_text: Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.
bsb_text: You, little children, are from God and have overcome them, because greater is He who is in you than he who is in the world.
aov_text: Julle is uit God, my kinders, en het hulle oorwin, omdat Hy wat in julle is, groter is as hy wat in die wêreld is.

kjv_text: They are of the world: therefore speak they of the world, and the world heareth them.
bsb_text: They are of the world. That is why they speak from the world’s perspective, and the world listens to them.
aov_text: Hulle is uit die wêreld; daarom praat hulle uit die wêreld, en die wêreld luister na hulle.

kjv_text: We are of God: he that knoweth God heareth us; he that is not of God heareth not us. Hereby know we the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.
bsb_text: We are from God. Whoever knows God listens to us; whoever is not from God does not listen to us. That is how we know the Spirit of truth and the spirit of deception.
aov_text: Ons is uit God; hy wat God ken, luister na ons; hy wat nie uit God is nie, luister nie na ons nie. Hieruit ken ons die Gees van die waarheid en die gees van die dwaling.

kjv_text: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God.
bsb_text: Beloved, let us love one another, because love comes from God. Everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.
aov_text: GELIEFDES, laat ons mekaar liefhê; want die liefde is uit God, en elkeen wat liefhet, is uit God gebore en ken God.

kjv_text: He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.
bsb_text: Whoever does not love does not know God, because God is love.
aov_text: Hy wat nie liefhet nie, het God nie geken nie, want God is liefde.

kjv_text: In this was manifested the love of God toward us, because that God sent his only begotten Son into the world, that we might live through him.
bsb_text: This is how God’s love was revealed among us: God sent His one and only Son into the world, so that we might live through Him.
aov_text: Hierin is die liefde van God tot ons geopenbaar, dat God sy eniggebore Seun in die wêreld gestuur het, sodat ons deur Hom kan lewe.

kjv_text: Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins.
bsb_text: And love consists in this: not that we loved God, but that He loved us and sent His Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
aov_text: Hierin is die liefde: nie dat ons God liefgehad het nie, maar dat Hy ons liefgehad het en sy Seun gestuur het as ’n versoening vir ons sondes.

kjv_text: Beloved, if God so loved us, we ought also to love one another.
bsb_text: Beloved, if God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.
aov_text: Geliefdes, as God ons so liefgehad het, behoort ons ook mekaar lief te hê.

kjv_text: No man hath seen God at any time. If we love one another, God dwelleth in us, and his love is perfected in us.
bsb_text: No one has ever seen God; but if we love one another, God remains in us, and His love is perfected in us.
aov_text: Niemand het God ooit aanskou nie. As ons mekaar liefhet, bly God in ons en het sy liefde in ons volmaak geword.

kjv_text: Hereby know we that we dwell in him, and he in us, because he hath given us of his Spirit.
bsb_text: By this we know that we remain in Him, and He in us: He has given us of His Spirit.
aov_text: Hieraan weet ons dat ons in Hom bly en Hy in ons, dat Hy ons van sy Gees gegee het.

kjv_text: And we have seen and do testify that the Father sent the Son to be the Saviour of the world.
bsb_text: And we have seen and testify that the Father has sent His Son to be the Savior of the world.
aov_text: En ons het aanskou en ons getuig dat die Vader die Seun as Verlosser van die wêreld gestuur het.

kjv_text: Whosoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God, God dwelleth in him, and he in God.
bsb_text: If anyone confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God abides in him, and he in God.
aov_text: Elkeen wat bely dat Jesus die Seun van God is — God bly in hom, en hy in God.

kjv_text: And we have known and believed the love that God hath to us. God is love; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God, and God in him.
bsb_text: And we have come to know and believe the love that God has for us. God is love; whoever abides in love abides in God, and God in him.
aov_text: En ons het die liefde wat God tot ons het, leer ken en geglo. God is liefde; en hy wat in die liefde bly, bly in God, en God in hom.

kjv_text: Herein is our love made perfect, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment: because as he is, so are we in this world.
bsb_text: In this way, love has been perfected among us, so that we may have confidence on the day of judgment; for in this world we are just like Him.
aov_text: Hierin het die liefde by ons volmaak geword, dat ons vrymoedigheid kan hê in die oordeelsdag; want soos Hy is, is ons ook in hierdie wêreld.

kjv_text: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.
bsb_text: There is no fear in love, but perfect love drives out fear, because fear involves punishment. The one who fears has not been perfected in love.
aov_text: Daar is geen vrees in die liefde nie; maar die volmaakte liefde dryf die vrees buite, want die vrees sluit straf in, en hy wat vrees, het nie volmaak geword in die liefde nie.

kjv_text: We love him, because he first loved us.
bsb_text: We love because He first loved us.
aov_text: Ons het Hom lief, omdat Hy ons eerste liefgehad het.

kjv_text: If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, how can he love God whom he hath not seen?
bsb_text: If anyone says, “I love God,” but hates his brother, he is a liar. For anyone who does not love his brother, whom he has seen, cannot love God, whom he has not seen.
aov_text: As iemand sê: Ek het God lief — en sy broeder haat, is hy ’n leuenaar; want wie sy broeder wat hy gesien het, nie liefhet nie, hoe kan hy God liefhê wat hy nie gesien het nie?

kjv_text: And this commandment have we from him, That he who loveth God love his brother also.
bsb_text: And we have this commandment from Him: Whoever loves God must love his brother as well.
aov_text: En hierdie gebod het ons van Hom dat hy wat God liefhet, ook sy broeder moet liefhê.

kjv_text: Whosoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ is born of God: and every one that loveth him that begat loveth him also that is begotten of him.
bsb_text: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God, and everyone who loves the Father also loves those born of Him.
aov_text: ELKEEN wat glo dat Jesus die Christus is, is uit God gebore; en elkeen wat die Vader liefhet, het ook die een lief wat uit Hom gebore is.

kjv_text: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God, and keep his commandments.
bsb_text: By this we know that we love the children of God: when we love God and keep His commandments.
aov_text: Hieraan weet ons dat ons die kinders van God liefhet: wanneer ons God liefhet en sy gebooie bewaar.

kjv_text: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not grievous.
bsb_text: For this is the love of God, that we keep His commandments. And His commandments are not burdensome,
aov_text: Want dit is die liefde tot God, dat ons sy gebooie bewaar; en sy gebooie is nie swaar nie.

kjv_text: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.
bsb_text: because everyone born of God overcomes the world. And this is the victory that has overcome the world: our faith.
aov_text: Want alles wat uit God gebore is, oorwin die wêreld; en dit is die oorwinning wat die wêreld oorwin het, naamlik ons geloof.

kjv_text: Who is he that overcometh the world, but he that believeth that Jesus is the Son of God?
bsb_text: Who then overcomes the world? Only he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God.
aov_text: Wie anders is dit wat die wêreld oorwin as hy wat glo dat Jesus die Seun van God is?

kjv_text: This is he that came by water and blood, even Jesus Christ; not by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit that beareth witness, because the Spirit is truth.
bsb_text: This is the One who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ—not by water alone, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit who testifies to this, because the Spirit is the truth.
aov_text: Dit is Hy wat deur water en bloed gekom het, Jesus die Christus; nie deur die water alleen nie, maar deur die water en die bloed; en dit is die Gees wat getuig, want die Gees is die waarheid.

kjv_text: For there are three that bear record in heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Holy Ghost: and these three are one.
bsb_text: For there are three that testify:
aov_text: Want daar is drie wat getuig in die hemel: die Vader, die Woord en die Heilige Gees, en hierdie drie is een;

kjv_text: And there are three that bear witness in earth, the Spirit, and the water, and the blood: and these three agree in one.
bsb_text: the Spirit, the water, and the blood—and these three are in agreement.
aov_text: en daar is drie wat getuig op die aarde: die Gees en die water en die bloed, en die drie is eenstemmig.

kjv_text: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater: for this is the witness of God which he hath testified of his Son.
bsb_text: Even if we accept human testimony, the testimony of God is greater. For this is the testimony that God has given about His Son.
aov_text: As ons die getuienis van die mense aanneem — die getuienis van God is groter, omdat dit die getuienis is van God wat Hy aangaande sy Seun getuig het.

kjv_text: He that believeth on the Son of God hath the witness in himself: he that believeth not God hath made him a liar; because he believeth not the record that God gave of his Son.
bsb_text: Whoever believes in the Son of God has this testimony within him; whoever does not believe God has made Him out to be a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has given about His Son.
aov_text: Wie in die Seun van God glo, het die getuienis in homself. Hy wat God nie glo nie, het Hom tot leuenaar gemaak, omdat hy die getuienis nie geglo het wat God aangaande sy Seun getuig het nie.

kjv_text: And this is the record, that God hath given to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
bsb_text: And this is that testimony: God has given us eternal life, and this life is in His Son.
aov_text: En dit is die getuienis: dat God ons die ewige lewe gegee het, en dié lewe is in sy Seun.

kjv_text: He that hath the Son hath life; and he that hath not the Son of God hath not life.
bsb_text: Whoever has the Son has life; whoever does not have the Son of God does not have life.
aov_text: Hy wat die Seun het, het die lewe; wie die Seun van God nie het nie, het nie die lewe nie.

kjv_text: These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God; that ye may know that ye have eternal life, and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God.
bsb_text: I have written these things to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, so that you may know that you have eternal life.
aov_text: Dit het ek geskrywe aan julle wat glo in die Naam van die Seun van God, sodat julle kan weet dat julle die ewige lewe het en kan glo in die Naam van die Seun van God.

kjv_text: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us:
bsb_text: And this is the confidence that we have before Him: If we ask anything according to His will, He hears us.
aov_text: En dit is die vrymoedigheid wat ons teenoor Hom het, dat Hy ons verhoor as ons iets vra volgens sy wil.

kjv_text: And if we know that he hear us, whatsoever we ask, we know that we have the petitions that we desired of him.
bsb_text: And if we know that He hears us in whatever we ask, we know that we already possess what we have asked of Him.
aov_text: En as ons weet dat Hy ons verhoor, dan weet ons dat, wat ons ook al vra, ons die bedes verkry wat ons van Hom gevra het.

kjv_text: If any man see his brother sin a sin which is not unto death, he shall ask, and he shall give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death: I do not say that he shall pray for it.
bsb_text: If anyone sees his brother committing a sin not leading to death, he should ask God, who will give life to those who commit this kind of sin. There is a sin that leads to death; I am not saying he should ask regarding that sin.
aov_text: As iemand sy broeder ’n sonde sien doen wat nie tot die dood is nie, moet hy bid, en Hy sal hom die lewe gee — vir die wat nie ’n sonde tot die dood doen nie. Daar is ’n sonde tot die dood; daarvoor sê ek nie dat hy moet bid nie.

kjv_text: All unrighteousness is sin: and there is a sin not unto death.
bsb_text: All unrighteousness is sin, yet there is sin that does not lead to death.
aov_text: Alle ongeregtigheid is sonde, en daar is ’n sonde wat nie tot die dood is nie.

kjv_text: We know that whosoever is born of God sinneth not; but he that is begotten of God keepeth himself, and that wicked one toucheth him not.
bsb_text: We know that anyone born of God does not keep on sinning; the One who was born of God protects him, and the evil one cannot touch him.
aov_text: Ons weet dat elkeen wat uit God gebore is, nie sondig nie; maar hy wat uit God gebore is, bewaar homself, en die Bose het geen vat op hom nie.

kjv_text: And we know that we are of God, and the whole world lieth in wickedness.
bsb_text: We know that we are of God, and that the whole world is under the power of the evil one.
aov_text: Ons weet dat ons uit God is en die hele wêreld in die mag van die Bose lê.

kjv_text: And we know that the Son of God is come, and hath given us an understanding, that we may know him that is true, and we are in him that is true, even in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.
bsb_text: And we know that the Son of God has come and has given us understanding, so that we may know Him who is true; and we are in Him who is true—in His Son Jesus Christ. He is the true God and eternal life.
aov_text: En ons weet dat die Seun van God gekom het en ons verstand gegee het om die Waaragtige te ken; en ons is in die Waaragtige, in sy Seun, Jesus Christus. Hy is die waaragtige God en die ewige lewe.

kjv_text: Little children, keep yourselves from idols. Amen.
bsb_text: Little children, keep yourselves from idols.
aov_text: My kinders, bewaar julleself van die afgode. Amen.

kjv_text: The elder unto the elect lady and her children, whom I love in the truth; and not I only, but also all they that have known the truth;
bsb_text: The elder, To the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in the truth—and not I alone, but also all who know the truth—
aov_text: DIE ouderling aan die uitverkore vrou en aan haar kinders — wat ek in waarheid liefhet, en nie ek alleen nie, maar ook almal wat die waarheid leer ken het;

kjv_text: For the truth's sake, which dwelleth in us, and shall be with us for ever.
bsb_text: because of the truth that abides in us and will be with us forever:
aov_text: ter wille van die waarheid wat in ons bly en by ons vir ewig sal wees  —

kjv_text: Grace be with you, mercy, and peace, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
bsb_text: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and from Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, will be with us in truth and love.
aov_text: genade, barmhartigheid, vrede sal met julle wees van God die Vader en van die Here Jesus Christus, die Seun van die Vader, in waarheid en liefde.

kjv_text: I rejoiced greatly that I found of thy children walking in truth, as we have received a commandment from the Father.
bsb_text: I was overjoyed to find some of your children walking in the truth, just as the Father has commanded us.
aov_text: EK was baie bly dat ek van u kinders gevind het wat in die waarheid wandel, soos ons ’n gebod van die Vader ontvang het.

kjv_text: And now I beseech thee, lady, not as though I wrote a new commandment unto thee, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.
bsb_text: And now I urge you, dear lady—not as a new commandment to you, but one we have had from the beginning—that we love one another.
aov_text: En nou bid ek u, uitverkore vrou, nie asof ek u ’n nuwe gebod skryf nie, maar een wat ons van die begin af gehad het: dat ons mekaar moet liefhê.

kjv_text: And this is love, that we walk after his commandments. This is the commandment, That, as ye have heard from the beginning, ye should walk in it.
bsb_text: And this is love, that we walk according to His commandments. This is the very commandment you have heard from the beginning, that you must walk in love.
aov_text: En dit is die liefde, dat ons wandel volgens sy gebooie. Dit is die gebod soos julle van die begin af gehoor het dat julle daarin moet wandel.

kjv_text: For many deceivers are entered into the world, who confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist.
bsb_text: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, refusing to confess the coming of Jesus Christ in the flesh. Any such person is the deceiver and the antichrist.
aov_text: Want baie verleiers het in die wêreld ingekom: die wat nie bely dat Jesus Christus in die vlees gekom het nie. Dit is die verleier en die Antichris.

kjv_text: Look to yourselves, that we lose not those things which we have wrought, but that we receive a full reward.
bsb_text: Watch yourselves, so that you do not lose what we have worked for, but that you may be fully rewarded.
aov_text: Wees op julle hoede, dat ons nie verloor wat ons deur arbeid verkry het nie, maar ’n volle loon ontvang.

kjv_text: Whosoever transgresseth, and abideth not in the doctrine of Christ, hath not God. He that abideth in the doctrine of Christ, he hath both the Father and the Son.
bsb_text: Anyone who runs ahead without remaining in the teaching of Christ does not have God. Whoever remains in His teaching has both the Father and the Son.
aov_text: Elkeen wat ’n oortreder is en nie bly in die leer van Christus nie, hy het God nie. Wie in die leer van Christus bly, hý het die Vader sowel as die Seun.

kjv_text: If there come any unto you, and bring not this doctrine, receive him not into your house, neither bid him God speed:
bsb_text: If anyone comes to you but does not bring this teaching, do not receive him into your home or even greet him.
aov_text: As iemand na julle kom en hierdie leer nie bring nie, ontvang hom nie in die huis nie en groet hom nie.

kjv_text: For he that biddeth him God speed is partaker of his evil deeds.
bsb_text: Whoever greets such a person shares in his evil deeds.
aov_text: Want die een wat hom groet, het gemeenskap aan sy bose werke.

kjv_text: Having many things to write unto you, I would not write with paper and ink: but I trust to come unto you, and speak face to face, that our joy may be full.
bsb_text: I have many things to write to you, but I would prefer not to do so with paper and ink. Instead, I hope to come and speak with you face to face, so that our joy may be complete.
aov_text: Alhoewel ek baie het om aan julle te skrywe, wou ek dit nie met papier en ink doen nie, maar ek hoop om na julle te kom en van mond tot mond te spreek, sodat ons blydskap volkome kan wees.

kjv_text: The children of thy elect sister greet thee. Amen.
bsb_text: The children of your elect sister send you greetings.
aov_text: Die kinders van u uitverkore suster groet u. Amen.

kjv_text: The elder unto the wellbeloved Gaius, whom I love in the truth.
bsb_text: The elder, To the beloved Gaius, whom I love in the truth:
aov_text: DIE ouderling aan die geliefde Gajus wat ek in waarheid liefhet.

kjv_text: Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth.
bsb_text: Beloved, I pray that in every way you may prosper and enjoy good health, as your soul also prospers.
aov_text: Geliefde, ek wens dat dit met jou in alles goed mag gaan en dat jy gesond is, soos dit met jou siel goed gaan;

kjv_text: For I rejoiced greatly, when the brethren came and testified of the truth that is in thee, even as thou walkest in the truth.
bsb_text: For I was overjoyed when the brothers came and testified about your devotion to the truth, in which you continue to walk.
aov_text: want ek was baie bly as daar broeders kom en van jou waarheid getuig, soos jy in die waarheid wandel.

kjv_text: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children walk in truth.
bsb_text: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children are walking in the truth.
aov_text: Ek het geen groter blydskap as dit nie, dat ek hoor dat my kinders in die waarheid wandel.

kjv_text: Beloved, thou doest faithfully whatsoever thou doest to the brethren, and to strangers;
bsb_text: Beloved, you are faithful in what you are doing for the brothers, and especially since they are strangers to you.
aov_text: Geliefde, jy handel getrou in alles wat jy doen vir die broeders, en dit vir vreemdelinge

kjv_text: Which have borne witness of thy charity before the church: whom if thou bring forward on their journey after a godly sort, thou shalt do well:
bsb_text: They have testified to the church about your love. You will do well to send them on their way in a manner worthy of God.
aov_text: wat van jou liefde voor die gemeente getuig het. Jy sal goed doen as jy hulle voorthelp op ’n voor God waardige wyse.

kjv_text: Because that for his name's sake they went forth, taking nothing of the Gentiles.
bsb_text: For they went out on behalf of the Name, accepting nothing from the Gentiles.
aov_text: Want vir sy Naam het hulle uitgegaan sonder om iets van die heidene te neem.

kjv_text: We therefore ought to receive such, that we might be fellowhelpers to the truth.
bsb_text: Therefore we ought to support such men, so that we may be fellow workers for the truth.
aov_text: Ons behoort dan sulke mense goed te ontvang, sodat ons mede-arbeiders van die waarheid kan word.

kjv_text: I wrote unto the church: but Diotrephes, who loveth to have the preeminence among them, receiveth us not.
bsb_text: I have written to the church about this, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first, will not accept our instruction.
aov_text: EK het aan die gemeente geskrywe, maar Diótrefes, wat onder hulle die eerste wil wees, steur hom nie aan ons nie.

kjv_text: Wherefore, if I come, I will remember his deeds which he doeth, prating against us with malicious words: and not content therewith, neither doth he himself receive the brethren, and forbiddeth them that would, and casteth them out of the church.
bsb_text: So if I come, I will call attention to his malicious slander against us. And unsatisfied with that, he refuses to welcome the brothers and forbids those who want to do so, even putting them out of the church.
aov_text: Daarom, as ek kom, sal ek hom herinner aan die werke wat hy doen deur met slegte woorde teen ons uit te vaar; en hiermee nie tevrede nie, ontvang hy nie alleen self die broeders nie gasvry nie, maar verhinder ook die wat dit wil doen en werp hulle uit die gemeente.

kjv_text: Beloved, follow not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that doeth good is of God: but he that doeth evil hath not seen God.
bsb_text: Beloved, do not imitate what is evil, but what is good. The one who does good is of God; the one who does evil has not seen God.
aov_text: Geliefde, moenie navolg wat kwaad is nie, maar wat goed is. Hy wat goed doen, is uit God; maar hy wat kwaad doen, het God nie gesien nie.

kjv_text: Demetrius hath good report of all men, and of the truth itself: yea, and we also bear record; and ye know that our record is true.
bsb_text: Demetrius has received a good testimony from everyone, and from the truth itself. We also testify for him, and you know that our testimony is true.
aov_text: Van Demétrius is deur almal getuienis gegee en deur die waarheid self; en ons getuig ook, en julle weet dat ons getuienis waar is.

kjv_text: I had many things to write, but I will not with ink and pen write unto thee:
bsb_text: I have many things to write to you, but I would prefer not to do so with pen and ink.
aov_text: Ek het baie dinge gehad om te skrywe, maar ek wil nie met ink en pen aan jou skryf nie.

kjv_text: But I trust I shall shortly see thee, and we shall speak face to face.
bsb_text: Instead, I hope to see you soon and speak with you face to face.
aov_text: Maar ek hoop om jou gou te sien, en ons sal van mond tot mond spreek.

kjv_text: Peace be to thee. Our friends salute thee. Greet the friends by name.
bsb_text: Peace to you. The friends here send you greetings. Greet each of our friends there by name.
aov_text: Vrede vir jou! Die vriende groet jou. Groet die vriende by die naam.

kjv_text: Jude, the servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to them that are sanctified by God the Father, and preserved in Jesus Christ, and called:
bsb_text: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and a brother of James, To those who are called, loved by God the Father, and kept in Jesus Christ:
aov_text: JUDAS, ’n dienskneg van Jesus Christus en broer van Jakobus, aan die wat geroep, in God die Vader geheilig en vir Jesus Christus bewaar is:

kjv_text: Mercy unto you, and peace, and love, be multiplied.
bsb_text: Mercy, peace, and love be multiplied to you.
aov_text: Mag barmhartigheid en vrede en liefde vir julle vermenigvuldig word!

kjv_text: Beloved, when I gave all diligence to write unto you of the common salvation, it was needful for me to write unto you, and exhort you that ye should earnestly contend for the faith which was once delivered unto the saints.
bsb_text: Beloved, although I made every effort to write to you about the salvation we share, I felt it necessary to write and urge you to contend earnestly for the faith entrusted once for all to the saints.
aov_text: GELIEFDES, terwyl ek alle ywer aanwend om aan julle oor ons gemeenskaplike saligheid te skrywe, het ek die noodsaaklikheid gevoel om julle deur my skrywe te vermaan om kragtig te stry vir die geloof wat eenmaal aan die heiliges oorgelewer is.

kjv_text: For there are certain men crept in unawares, who were before of old ordained to this condemnation, ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness, and denying the only Lord God, and our Lord Jesus Christ.
bsb_text: For certain men have crept in among you unnoticed—ungodly ones who were designated long ago for condemnation. They turn the grace of our God into a license for immorality, and they deny our only Master and Lord, Jesus Christ.
aov_text: Want sekere mense het ingesluip wat lank tevore al opgeskryf is vir hierdie oordeel, goddelose mense wat die genade van onse God verander in ongebondenheid, en die enigste Heerser, God, en onse Here Jesus Christus verloën.

kjv_text: I will therefore put you in remembrance, though ye once knew this, how that the Lord, having saved the people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed them that believed not.
bsb_text: Although you are fully aware of this, I want to remind you that after Jesus had delivered His people out of the land of Egypt, He destroyed those who did not believe.
aov_text: Maar ek wil julle daaraan herinner, al weet julle dit nou eenmaal, dat die Here, nadat Hy die volk uit Egipteland gered het, daarna die wat ongelowig was, omgebring het.

kjv_text: And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.
bsb_text: And the angels who did not stay within their own domain but abandoned their proper dwelling—these He has kept in eternal chains under darkness, bound for judgment on that great day.
aov_text: En die engele wat hul eie beginsel nie bewaar het nie, maar hul eie woning verlaat het, het Hy vir die oordeel van die groot dag met ewige boeie onder die duisternis bewaar;
